"Once I succeed in martial arts, I'll make a trip back to Wu Country, get the one hundred thousand taels of gold from the Emperor of Wu, and also check out his treasury for any valuable items!"
Li Xuan sat in his chair, listening to Xu Yan recount his adventures. Xu Yan told the whole story, very thoroughly.
"I didn't expect the Emperor Qi to be such a decent fellow."
In the end, Xu Yan chuckled.
Li Xuan sighed inwardly, Emperor Qi was a decisive individual. By trapping Gou Rongshan with his reputation, Gou Rongshan would certainly not rebel unless absolutely necessary for the sake of his esteemed status.
"Disciple, you need to remember, you now possess power beyond royalty and the entire Qi Country. No need to feel restricted when handling matters..."
"Yes, Master!"
Xu Yan nodded, then started talking about the Heavenly Mother Sect: "That Kou Ruozhi actually wanted to name me as the Grand Saint of Heaven, tying me to the Heavenly Mother Sect. He's delusional!"
Li Xuan was taken aback, the Grand Saint of Heaven?
What a coincidence, that night the elderly man in the hemp robe and the County Magistrate wanted to name him the Grand Saint of Heaven.
And in the prefecture city, Kou Ruozhi also wanted to make Xu Yan the Grand Saint of Heaven. It seemed the people in the Heavenly Mother Sect were always looking for the right person to become the Grand Saint of Heaven.
So, it was such a coincidence.
Xu Yan was back, and with both his disciples present, Li Xuan shifted his focus more towards the grand scheme of martial arts. Especially how Meng Chong should further cultivate his physical body.
"Master, the cultivation technique that junior brother practices seem a bit different."
Meng Chong was diligent in his practice; he spent over half of his day on cultivation.
Xu Yan watched for a while, revealing an expression of confusion.
"Meng Chong's potential is in his physical strength, what I impart to him is body-oriented martial arts, focusing on the refinement of the physical body..."
Li Xuan calls Meng Chong over.
It is time to explain to his disciple the issues about the martial arts system, future new disciples may possibly open up new branches of martial arts.
"Xu Yan, you are cultivating the orthodox martial arts, your bones are pristine, and the purity of your martial arts has been achieved. You should understand it as well, so there's no need for me to elaborate."
Li Xuan's mysterious aura enshrouds him entirely, making him seem more inscrutable in his clear state of mind.
Xu Yan and Meng Chong are both shocked at how truly inscrutable their master is.
"Meng Chong is cultivating body-oriented martial arts, focusing on physical body refinement, reflecting a strong strength in himself, but it is not brute force...
"The Golden Bell Shield is foundational in body-oriented martial arts, with vitality as strong as the golden bell, confining it into yourself, a defense which is unrivaled..."
Li Xuan briefly explains the body-oriented martial arts.
"Orthodox martial arts' fundamental state is to temper jade bones, jade bones without flaw, martial arts at its purest, this is the foundation of martial arts...
"And the foundation of body-oriented martial arts is the Diamond Glazed Bone. Only after tempering the Diamond Glazed Bone, can one be said to have truly reached the quintessential foundation of body-oriented martial arts.
"Meng Chong, do you understand?"
At the end, Li Xuan looks at Meng Chong and solemnly asks.
Meng Chong's heart tightened, and he respectfully answered, "Disciple understands, I will definitely not let down master, I will indeed temper the Diamond Glazed Bone!"
"Your unwavering determination reassures me."
Li Xuan nodded.
"Master, between orthodox martial arts and body-oriented martial arts, which one is stronger?"
Xu Yan couldn't help but ask.
Body-oriented martial arts doesn't sound simple, achieving the state of the Golden Bell, becoming invincible in defense sounds difficult to break!
And the force of the physical body is extremely powerful.
Li Xuan said calmly with a smile, "Whether it's orthodox martial arts or body-oriented martial arts, there's no real distinction of strong and weak, strength or weakness simply depends on the person.
"Orthodox martial arts practitioners enter with gold bones, body-oriented martial arts practitioners enter with copper bones, who is stronger or weaker?
"Even if both disciplines start with gold bones, who is stronger or weaker? Whoever has a deeper understanding and richer experience in dealing with opponents naturally has an advantage."
Xu Yan nodded silently, excitement showing on his face, he looked at Meng Chong and said, "Junior brother, once you've entered the door, we'll compare notes, the experts in the outside world are too weak, and it's no fun."
"Good! Brother, wait for me to get started!"
Meng Chong has an excited look on his face as well.
"Master, can ordinary people practice martial arts? I want to teach martial arts to my family and let them give it a try!"
Xu Yan lowered his head, sneaking a look at Li Xuan while speaking.
Whether the cultivation technique can be passed on or not requires the master's permission.
"You may pass it on if you wish, but whether they can cultivate is a unknown, how long they will need, and how different everyone's martial arts talent is, those without martial arts talent might not be able to breakthrough their entire lives."
After a brief deliberation, Li Xuan gave Xu Yan permission to pass on the cultivation techniques.
The benefits of sharing completed cultivation techniques with others can be fairly minimal, but what if many people are practicing?
Little streams make a mighty river, there may be unexpected gains?
Since Xu Yan wants to pass it on, it's a good opportunity to see what happens.
The biggest benefit of Golden Finger is undoubtedly direct disciples successfully cultivating unique techniques that he devised. If the technique has been completed and is passed on to other disciples, the feedback is not high.
But that does not mean there are no returns, just that the returns are very low.
What if the technique is widely distributed?
With more people practicing, accumulating over time, there might be unexpected gains.
As Li Xuan thought about it, he decided to try it out by letting Xu Yan share the technique, after all, how many people can succeed in cultivating the technique is still unknown.
Martial arts eventually favor those with talent.
"Thank you, Master!"
Xu Yan was very excited.
"Focus on your cultivation, strengthening oneself is what's important, the martial path is endless!"
Li Xuan encouraged.

chapters.title: Chapter 66 - 66: Xu Yan Achieves Great Success in Qi and Blood, Understands Innate Realm Cultivation Technique_1
chapters.content:
After receiving permission from his master, Xu Yan went home again to teach his parents the method of martial arts cultivation. Naturally, the foundation of martial arts cultivation begins with sensing the Qi and blood flow, and then refining the body's skin.
For this, he deliberately brought back a nine-leaf Ganoderma herb to help his parents cultivate and sense their Qi and blood.
The core protectors of the Xu family currently are Pharmacist Pan and more than a dozen staunch defenders, all of whom were cultivated in secret by Xu Junhe.
Pharmacist Pan possesses the strength of a top martial artist in the rivers and lakes, while the rest of the protectors are all high-level practitioners.
Moreover, Pharmacist Pan can also concoct nourishing medicines.
Since they are core members of the Xu family, Xu Yan also imparted the martial arts cultivation methods to them. Whether they could successfully cultivate or have the gift, will depend on their own fate.
Of course, Xu Yan only taught the method of refining skin, bones, and internal organs. He did not pass on the cultivation technique of the Qi and Blood Realm.
The Qi and Blood Realm is too far beyond their reach.
Xu Yan, who had just returned to East River County, once again set off for the capital city to impart his cultivation technique to his uncles, cousins, and others.
In Yunshan County, Li Xuan leisurely sat on a chair.
Meng Chong was diligently cultivating as usual. As the cultivation progressed, his golden bell-like physique was improving, and his bones had reached the stage of being as hard as iron.
Shi'er also came every day to do chores such as cooking and cleaning. He was a hardworking person, so Li Xuan decided to teach him the martial arts technique of refining the skin.
Shi'er himself was a top martial artist in the rivers and lakes. If he had a talent for martial arts and could sense Qi and refine his skin, his strength would increase significantly, and the speed of completing the skin refinement would not be too slow.
"Shi'er, come here!"
Li Xuan beckoned.
"Senior, what do you need?"
Shi'er hurried over, bending his body and asked.
"You are a sharp and hardworking person. Fine, I need someone to run errands during my time in this world. Are you willing?"
Li Xuan asked in an incredibly calm manner.
"I am willing, I am willing. This is a grand opportunity for me!"
Shi'er was so excited that he knelt to the ground.
"Shi'er, paying respects to the master!"
Thud thud thud!
"Hmm, get up."
Li Xuan nodded and said, "I will teach you the basic method of martial arts. Whether you can grasp it depends on your own talent and fate."
"Yes, thank you, master!"
Shi'er's heart was pounding violently.
Finally, he also had the chance to become a martial arts expert.
"The first step in martial arts cultivation is to sense Qi and blood, and then refine the skin. Today, I will teach you the method of skin refinement. Whether you can master it depends on your own talent and fate."
Li Xuan taught the method of refining skin to Shi'er. As for the later refining bones and internal organs, he would teach them after Shi'er could sense Qi and complete skin refinement.
"Thank you, master!"
Shi'er was extremely excited.
"Go and comprehend it yourself, find a room to live in."
Li Xuan waved his hand.
Since Shi'er had become a servant, he naturally had to live in the courtyard and take care of all the chores.
"Yes!"
Shi'er respectfully backed away.
In the capital of Qi Country, because of Xu Yan's second visit, Emperor Qi and his officials became very cautious again. It felt like a mountain was hanging over their heads, which made Emperor Qi and his officials even more determined to find a martial arts expert.
Only by finding a martial arts expert could this mountain hanging over their heads be moved away.
After teaching the martial arts cultivation techniques, Xu Yan did not immediately return to East River County, but temporarily stayed in Qi King's Mansion.
"I'm about to break through to the peak of the Qi and Blood Realm."
Xu Yan, who was cultivating, was extremely excited, he was only one step away from reaching the highest level of the Qi and Blood Realm.
"I have almost grasped the cultivation techniques of the Innate Realm. I have some understanding now, and not long after reaching the peak of the Qi and Blood Realm, I should be able to comprehend it completely."
After reaching the peak of the Qi and Blood Realm, he was one step closer to the second realm of Martial Arts, the Innate Realm.
"After reaching the peak of the Qi and Blood Realm, I aim to fully master Qi and Blood within a month."
Xu Yan set a goal for himself.
Boom!
The energy and blood surged ever more powerfully. His jade-like bones seemed to glow, his Qi and Blood continued to become increasingly pure and grow, not far from the peak of the Qi and Blood Realm, at a hundred Zhangs' length.
At one moment, the Qi seemed to cross a vast gulf, suddenly soared, and became distinctly purer, and a tide of Qi and Blood erupted, reaching a hundred Zhangs in distance.
Boom!
Immediately afterward, the Qi and Blood that had shot skyward turned into a massive red dragon, soaring as if piercing the sky.
The momentum of Xu Yan's breakthrough was considerable. All people including Guo Rongshan were astonished at the sight of a hundred Zhangs-long dragon rising from Xu Yan's courtyard, taken aback.
"Has Yan'er's strength increased again?"
"Great, very good indeed!"
Guo Rongshan and his son were overjoyed.
From the Qi King's residence, not far from the royal palace, Emperor Qi looked in the direction of the Qi King's residence. His color changed, was Xu Yan flaunting his martial power?
No!
Had his ability grown stronger?
At this moment, Emperor Qi felt a sense of urgency, and must find a martial arts expert quickly!
In the East Palace of the Crown Prince, the Third Prince excitedly ordered, "Quick, prepare gifts, I want to go pay my respects to my mentor!"
The assembly of ministers was awestruck. They whipped their good-for-nothing sons and sent them all out to find martial experts.
The Crown Prince could no longer sit still. That day, he led his palace guards out of the capital to find martial experts.
That day, the capital city of Qi Country was destined to be anything but calm, as a fever for finding martial experts swept the city.
Xu Yan, as the instigator of all this, was immersed in the wonder of his breakthrough, feeling the strengthening of his own ability. Only after the breakthrough did he experience a greater awe of his master's power.
"The full development of Qi and Blood that the master showed me back then had such an overwhelming momentum, such an endless Qi and Blood. It's far stronger than what I have now!"
Xu Yan felt somewhat ashamed in his heart. "I'm still too weak. Even after cultivating Jade bones, I'm still far from enough."
"Master's realm is unimaginably deep. What he showed me was probably how he was when he reached the peak of Qi and Blood Realm. In comparison, I'm lacking too much."
"No wonder master kept telling me to guard against arrogance and impetuosity. My strength is not strong enough."
The more he pondered, the more he felt the strength of his master.
"Although I'm not as powerful as my master, I should not belittle myself. I'm no weaker than the prodigious talents of ancient times; I am even stronger!"
Xu Yan was encouraging himself in his heart.
Master is too strong, like a lofty mountain that cannot be surpassed. But as long as he has faith, he can one day reach the same height as his master."
Xu Yan gathered his Qi and Blood and exhaled deeply.
"My Qi and Blood are at their peak. The cultivation technique of the Innate Realm is becoming increasingly clear to me."
Xu Yan entered his room, sat cross-legged on the bed, let out a breath, and his state of mind gradually became clear, entering a state of complete oneness with the world.
Only the profound understanding, gradually appears in his mind.
The cultivation method of the Innate Realm is becoming increasingly clear, gradually appearing before him like a continuous thread.
How to connect the Heaven and Earth Bridge, how to refine Qi and Blood into Innate True Qi, how to ingest and exhale nature's spiritual energy, open up the Sea of Qi Dantian...
The cultivation technique became increasingly clear, as if an image of breaking through to the Innate Realm appeared in his mind, how to ingest and exhale nature's spiritual energy.
"Connect the Heaven and Earth Bridge, sense the nature's spiritual energy, guide the spiritual energy into the two bridges of Heaven and Earth, open up the Dantian Sea of Qi..."
An excited expression appeared on Xu Yan's face.
The more he comprehended, the clearer the cultivation method of the Innate Realm became. The sequence of breakthroughs, the process of cultivation... gradually emerged in his mind.
"I have finally grasped the cultivation technique of the Innate Realm. Once my Qi and Blood Realm reaches perfection, I can proceed to break through to the Innate Realm!"
Xu Yan opened his eyes, his face was filled with excitement.

chapters.title: Chapter 67 - 67: Breaking Through to the Innate Realm (Seeking First Subscription)_1
chapters.content:
Yunshan County.
Li Xuan looked at the diligently cultivating Meng Chong. Every day he could sense Meng Chong's body getting stronger, which left him very satisfied.
"Meng Chong's body is becoming more and more robust, it will not be long until he temper into a copper body. Achieving a golden body should not be an issue for him.
"However, the Vajra Lustrous Bone will be somewhat challenging."
When Xu Yan was cultivating, the technique he was taught was after all made up on the spot, without any concrete technique for reference, everything depended on Xu Yan's own imagination to perfect.
The difficulty of cultivation is naturally higher than that of Meng Chong.
Xu Yan tempered into a Jade Bone only through combatting and slaying the fire-maned wolf, thereby breaking his shackles to temper into a jade bone.
If Meng Chong wants to temper a Vajra Lustrous Bone, he probably also needs to push himself to his limits, breaking his shackles to make it happen.
"Where can we find the fire-maned wolf? In the Endless Mountains?"
Li Xuan fell into deep thought: "We may not necessarily need the fire-maned wolf. What's needed to break through is shattering the shackles, so…"
He thought of a method.
Perhaps it can help Meng Chong to break the shackles and temper a Vajra Lustrous Bone.
"Can Meng Chong temper into a golden bone within a month? Probably not too far off."
Li Xuan estimated Meng Chong's rate of cultivation progress.
"Once Meng Chong starts on the journey of martial arts, I can gain the Vajra Lustrous Bone. Combining the Jade Bone with the Vajra Lustrous Bone, how powerful will it be?"
Thinking about the rewards from the Golden Finger after Meng Chong's initiation, Li Xuan was filled with anticipation.
In his free time, Shi'er was also diligently cultivating, he had already begun to sense his blood and qi, and was preparing to refine his skin.
"As I thought, cultivating martial arts requires a natural gift. Shi'er's talent is far inferior to Meng Chong's and Xu Yan's."
Li Xuan observed Shi'er's speed of cultivation, and couldn't help but sigh.
Even if martial arts were widely known, the number of successful initiates would not be high. However, with more people practicing martial arts, the base is larger, so the number of successful initiates may not be too few.
Suddenly!
A golden light emerged.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has achieved great success in the Blood and Qi Realm, doubling your Blood and Qi!"
Boom!
The blood and qi in the body surged and doubled instantly.
Li Xuan was overjoyed. Xu Yan had already achieved great success in the realm of blood and qi, and it wouldn't be long until he reached perfection.
In that case, the next step would be breaking into the Innate Realm.
He had made up the second realm of his martial arts journey - the Innate Realm. This is the first realm where one breaks away from the worldly constraints, taking flight through controlling qi, traveling hundreds of miles in an instant!
This is the truly formidable aura of a martial arts powerhouse!
While the Blood and Qi Realm allows you to soar, it is not like flying freely through the air, these two are completely different things.
"Ever since I took in new disciples, the feedback from the Golden Finger has started mentioning the names of the disciples."
Li Xuan noticed the change in the feedback from the Golden Finger.
"Can Xu Yan perfect his Blood and Qi within a month?"
Li Xuan fell into thought.
Given Xu Yan's cultivation speed, he should be able to achieve perfection in the Blood and Qi within the month.
I wonder if he'll be able to comprehend the technique of the Innate Realm.
"I hope you succeed, my disciple. Don't disappoint your master!"
Li Xuan had high expectations for Xu Yan.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has successfully comprehended the Innate Realm cultivation technique you devised. You have broken through to the Innate Realm."
Suddenly, a golden light emerged.
At that moment, Li Xuan could feel the blood and qi in his body condensing into Innate True Qi.
Boom, boom, boom...
It was as though there were thunderclaps echoing within his body, a mysterious feeling enveloped him, as if he had connected with the world, feeling the existence of nature's spiritual energy.
The bridge to the universe had been established!
Boom!
Li Xuan guided nature's spiritual energy into his body, creating a turmoil in his body, and opened up his energy field.
At this time, Li Xuan was completely immersed in the intricacy of the breakthrough.
The Innate Realm Cultivation Technique appeared in his mind - what an incredible mystery it was.
As nature's spiritual energy entered his body, his massive vital energy was refined into Innate True Qi, and his body underwent a transformation. He seemed to have transcended the mundane world, shedding all impurities.
His bones gleamed brilliantly, and his body became pure and flawless, untouched by any worldly filth.
Li Xuan broke through to the Innate Realm, and his body underwent a wonderful transformation. Nature's spiritual energy flowed into his body, causing Innate True Qi to continually surge out.
At the moment when his connection with the world became unblocked, it was as if he had connected with the universe, sensed the existence of nature's spiritual energy, and guided it into his body.
He opened up his energy field and refined it into Innate True Qi.
The body underwent transformation, the bones blossomed brilliantly, and the Innate was flawless!
The worldly filth seemed to have been cleansed at this moment, reverting to its Innate state.
Li Xuan was still sitting in his chair, as if nothing had happened. There was no sign of a breakthrough.
Only Li Xuan knew that at this moment, he had crossed a chasm and stepped into the Innate Realm!
"So this is what Innate is!"
Li Xuan felt his own state, and his heart was filled with excitement!
Such a good disciple!
He actually comprehended the Innate Realm Cultivation Technique in advance, and the Golden Finger directly reflected his Innate Realm's strength!
Therefore, even if Xu Yan does not break through to the Innate Realm, as long as he gains insight in advance, the Golden Finger will also reflect the gains.
As Xu Yan has gained insight into the cultivation technique, it means that his breakthrough into Innate is a sure thing.
Li Xuan guided nature's spiritual energy into his body, feeling the storm-like power coming through the connection with the world. His heart was filled with excitement, but also some doubts.
Why does it feel like the spiritual energy of heaven and earth is not gentle enough?
If it wasn't for the connection to the universe, I probably wouldn't be able to accommodate the spiritual energy into my body.
"The spiritual energy can enhance a person's strength. It's a strong energy. It's normal for it to not be gentle."
Didn't Li Xuan feel that the spiritual energy was not gentle enough? It wasn't strange at all?
He did not delve further into this issue.
As long as there is spiritual energy and he can continue to cultivate, he can continue to become stronger.
Whether it is gentle or not, it does not matter, it won't cause harm.
"Having reached the Innate Realm, I can say that I am no longer of the mortal realm."
"As long as there is spiritual energy from heaven and earth, I can survive without eating or drinking."
Li Xuan's heart was stirred. This was only the second realm of his Martial Arts, and it was already so powerful.
People in the Innate Realm could absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth and didn't need to eat.
"How long can someone in the Innate Realm live? How long is their lifespan?"
Li Xuan suddenly fell into contemplation. Practicing Martial Arts naturally results in a lifespan far beyond that of ordinary people.
Just being in the vital energy realm already makes one's lifespan extraordinary.
But how long one could live was not known.
"The lifespan of the vital energy realm should not be short, especially after refining the jade bones... Let me think."
Li Xuan, with his eyes half-closed and his mind clear, silently calculated the changes in the vital energy realm and the changes after the breakthrough to the Innate Realm to estimate the limit of life.
"After completing organ refining, the organs are strengthened, vitality is enhanced, and lifespan is much longer than ordinary people... So, generally, the lifespan in the vital energy realm should be two to three hundred years."
"If you refine the gold bones, you live longer, at least three hundred years. The jade bones, though, five hundred years?"
Li Xuan was suddenly shocked. Had he calculated it wrong? If what he thought was true, then just at the entrance to Martial Arts, one can live such a long life?
"I calculated it based on the changes in the body and the depletion time of vital energy after entering Martial Arts. I shouldn't be too far off. So, the lifespan of the Innate Realm is over a thousand years?"
"I created this Martial Arts realm to be pretty amazing, the second Martial Arts realm can live for over a thousand years."
Li Xuan was excited. At this moment, he had a feeling that the lifespan division of Martial Arts has been determined!
He calculated correctly!
Could it be that this intuition came from the feedback of the Golden Finger?

chapters.title: Chapter 68 - 68 Meng Chong: The Great Sun Golden Bell Shield is too powerful_1
chapters.content:
The Innate Realm has already transcended the mundane. In the eyes of ordinary people, there's not much difference between them and the deities.
A lifespan of a thousand years was actually within reason.
Inhaling and exhaling nature's spiritual energy, where the Innate True Qi is endless, so naturally, a longer lifespan is out of the ordinary.
And if one has the foundation of jade bones in Innate Realm, naturally, the lifespan would be even longer.
Li Xuan was extremely excited, "What do we cultivate the Martial Arts for?"
The fundamental reason is to become strong, to live forever with invulnerability!
This is the ultimate meaning of the Martial Arts.
"I'm now a beginner in the Innate Realm. My Innate True Qi seems inexhaustible, and I already have the martial arts technique for the Innate Realm. Next, I need to create a technique for the realm above the Innate Realm."
"I need to set the realm specifically, then seamlessly connect it with the Innate Realm to create a complete system."
Li Xuan was completely exhilarated.
His apprentice was too amazing!
"Xu Yan hasn't broken through to the Innate Realm yet, and he doesn't understand the wonders of the Innate Realm, so even if I create a technique for the realm above Innate Realm for him, he would not be able to comprehend it."
"It's impossible, I suppose, to comprehend a technique by crossing realms."
Li Xuan fell into deep thought.
So, the technique of the realm above the Innate Realm would have to wait until Xu Yan breaks through to the Innate Realm, then he would possibly be able to comprehend it.
If he hasn't broken through to the Innate Realm yet, even if he comprehends the technique of the Innate Realm but not personally experienced the changes of Innate, he would not be able to use it as a foundation to comprehend the technique of the realm above Innate Realm.
However, preparations for creating the next realm technique can be started now.
"With Xu Yan's cultivation speed, he should be able to complete his Qi and blood within a month. The breakthrough to the Innate Realm will take a bit of time. Xu Yan should be able to breakthrough to the Innate Realm within two months!"
Every time he thought about this, Li Xuan was filled with anticipation.
Once Xu Yan breaks through to the Innate Realm, he would be able to reap the benefits of the Golden Finger again.
Directly achieve perfection in the Innate Realm!
"It's time to create the next realm; to create the technique!"
Li Xuan was electrified with excitement.
...
Meng Chong has forged himself to the copper bone stage. He sensed his own strength with his flesh-bound body, like it's covered in a golden bell. Clenching his fist, he felt like he could easily defeat a top martial artist with one punch.
If he had this strength back then, he wouldn't have had to risk assassinating the Emperor of Wu and use him to seek vengeance.
"Stone Two, come over!".
Meng Chong shouted out.
"Young Master Meng, what can I do for you?"
Shi'er asked with a smile on his face.
After tough training these days, he was finally about to start refining his skin stage, so he was extremely excited.
"Come on, hit me in the chest!"
Meng Chong gave his chest a slap.
"Huh?"
Shi'er was somewhat stunned.
"What are you dazed for? Come on, hit me!"
Meng Chong urged.
"Isn't this bad?"
Shi'er said, looking troubled.
What if he hurt him?
"You think you can hurt me? Quit talking, quick!"
Meng Chong looked at him with contempt.
"Alright!"
Shi'er took a deep breath, quickly moved forward, and punched Meng Chong hard in the chest.
Thud!
At this moment, Shi'er felt as if he had hit a mountain. His fist hurt a bit, and there was also a bit of backlash that made his arm numb!
"That's it? Are you using all your strength?"
Meng Chong just felt a scratch from that punch.
"Alright, I'll go again!"
Shi'er's eyes narrowed, he let out a great yell and punched hard at Meng Chong's chest.
This punch, he used all his strength.
As a top martial artist, he had trained to the point of having strong explosive force.
A full-strength punch could split stones and break monuments.
However, when it hit Meng Chong's chest, it still felt like punching a mountain, giving him the illusion of an ant colliding with a mountain.
The backlash made him retreat two steps, and his arm became numb.
Thud!
Has Meng Chong really become this strong?
In such a short time, he could already completely ignore the attack of a top-tier martial artist?
"Did you really use all your strength?"
Meng Chong looked at Shi'er with a puzzled expression.
He held back his body's reactive force, afraid of hurting Shi'er.
Is this it?
Has a top expert in the martial world become this weak?
Shi'er was at a loss for words. He said, "That punch was the strongest I've ever thrown."
Meng Chong was extremely excited. The Golden Bell Shield was indeed powerful.
He pulled out the knife embedded in the ground and threw it to Shi'er, saying, "Come, slash me!"
"What?"
Shi'er was stunned, not knowing what to do.
Slash him with a knife?
Did Meng Chong lose his sanity while training?
This is a knife, no matter how strong the flesh is, how can it resist?
Moreover, hasn't Meng Chong mastered martial arts yet?
He's still in the basic stage of training and he wants to resist a steel knife with his bare flesh?
"I'm not afraid, why are you? Hurry up!"
Meng Chong urged.
Shi'er was speechless, you brave fool might not be scared, but I am. What if I hurt you? What will I do then?
"You really want me to slash?"
Shi'er was still hesitant.
"Come on!"
Meng Chong patted his chest.
"Alright then!"
Shi'er, holding the steel knife, stepped forward and slashed at Meng Chong.
Boom!
The sharp steel knife did not cut through.
"Put some effort into it!"
Meng Chong said discontentedly.
Boom!
Another slash with the knife failed to break the defense. There was not a scratch on Meng Chong's body.
"Use all your strength!"
Meng Chong takes a deep breath. His flesh was like a bell, his body flawless, his muscles seemed to glow with a faint golden light.
"Alright!"
Shi'er gritted his teeth and chopped at Meng Chong's chest.
Boom!
The steel knife broke into two, Shi'er staggered back, his hands trembling, his face full of shock.
There was not a scratch on Meng Chong's chest!
He was a top martial artist and his full-strength slash didn't harm Meng Chong's flesh at all?
Too terrifying!
Meng Chong patted his chest, he got his answer. His current physical defenses could completely ignore top martial artists.
Ordinary steel weapons were unable to hurt him at all.
However, if it was that precious blade, it's hard to say!
"Keep practicing, strive to temper the indestructible vajra bones soon, take the martial arts training to the next level"
Meng Chong, in high spirits, continued his intensive training.
Shi'er was also stimulated, and buried himself in his training too!
Li Xuan started walking around Yunshan County when suddenly he heard a voice that caught his attention.
"Young man, you have decent potential. This meeting must be fate. I have a martial arts secret manual here, and I'll sell it to you at a low price!"
These words sounded somewhat familiar.
Li Xuan followed the sound and saw a man with a white beard, dressed in a wide robe, holding a yellowed booklet, speaking to a rich young master.
"Elder, I would like to acknowledge you as my master...
"Your qualifications are just decent, but you are not in my eyes. It's a stroke of fate that we met. I see your earnest desire for martial arts, therefore, I'll sell you a martial arts secret manual."
The bearded man looked like a condescending high expert, adding: "The law shall not be easily transferred, the secret martial arts manual has its own value. I don't want your money, but this is the rule of the martial arts world, secret martial arts manuals must not be given away!"
The rich young master appeared somewhat lost and regretful, but quickly cheered up. Although he was not taken as an apprentice, acquiring a martial arts secret manual made the journey worthwhile.
"Thank you, elder. I will buy the secret manual right now."
"Hmm, it's destiny that brought us together, one hundred taels then."
"Here you go, elder!"
Rich young master handed over the silver and took the secret manual.
"Ponder over it well, practice diligently!"
The white-bearded man offered some encouragement, turned around and left. Then he approached another rich young master, "Young man, you have decent potential. I have a martial art practice here…"
Li Xuan:…
Where did this fraud come from? And someone actually believes him.
It's really unbelievable!

chapters.title: Chapter 69 - 69 Xue Wuxin, The Transformation of the Endless Mountains (Subscription Request)_1
chapters.content:
Li Xuan strolled around the city and discovered that many children of wealthy families had come to Yunsan County, all seeking to find hermits in the mountains and resting temporarily in the county town.
Swindlers like the white-bearded man were not the only ones!
What's more outrageous is that there were fools who fell for it!
"The guys from Tianmu Sect, they're moonlighting as swindlers too?"
Li Xuan felt somewhat helpless to criticize, whether it was the white-bearded man or other deceivers, they turned out to be experts from Tianmu Sect in disguise.
"Brother Shi, you're leaving now?"
"Yes, Brother Tan, I shall take my leave."
"...Brother Shi, did you obtain a Martial Dao manual?"
"How did you know?"
"I got one too, but it seems a bit unreliable..."
A group of wealthy youngsters was somewhat baffled. Had Martial Dao manuals become common goods on the streets?
Impossible, right?
They compared what they had and realized, damn, it was even worse than the martial arts manuals known in Jianghu.
A crowd went to the county government office, clamoring for the Yunsan County Magistrate to capture the swindlers.
Without looking, Li Xuan knew that once these wealthy youngsters arrived at the county office, they would likely be fleeced by the Yunsan County Magistrate again.
After Xu Yan displayed his mighty prowess, a craze for seeking Martial Dao experts surged throughout Qi Country. Not only the children of nobles and dignitaries but also experts from Jianghu were seeking Martial Dao hermits.
Hoping they, too, might encounter serendipity.
Li Xuan thought about the endless mountains and suspected that only by crossing them could he truly understand this world.
Of course, these were only speculations, and whether they held true remained an unknown.
"Wait a little longer. Now that Xu Yan has reached Innate and Meng Chong has made his entry into Martial Dao, the Martial Dao Techniques can be spread to a certain extent."
Li Xuan had some ideas in mind.
Before spreading the cultivation methods of Martial Dao, one must grasp the extent properly, ensuring that everything was under control, with absolutely no risk of losing control.
Having already shared Martial Dao with those close to him, Xu Yan believed that in a few months, it would be clear whether there were people who could not initiate their cultivation or lacked the aptitude for Martial Dao.
In the boundless mountains, a team of more than a hundred people was making their way through the dense forest, continuing to forge ahead.
"If there are hermits to be found anywhere in the world, they are bound to be in the endless mountains," said the son of the Minister of War with confidence.
"Absolutely!"
The son of the Minister of Rites concurred with a nod.
The top profligates from the Capital City who accompanied him all gave their approval.
The endless mountains were infinite, and no one knew what lay at their ends, nor had anyone ever crossed them.
If there were truly hermits in this world, they must be within these endless mountains.
Donghe District was the closest to the endless mountains, and perhaps Xu Yan had found a hermit there.
The group was fully armed with leather armor, powerful crossbows, insect repellent, antidotes, and other essentials, and the guards in the team were all first-rate experts or stronger.
Among them were no shortage of supreme masters.
Despite the dangers of the endless mountains with ferocious beasts roaming, their strength was enough to hunt down any beast.
With insect and snake repellants at hand, there would be no harm from poisonous snakes. In case of a bite, they had antidotes, all renowned in the pugilistic world for their immeasurable effect against venomous insects and snakes.
Moreover, wearing leather armor made it harder to be bitten.
A group of dandies was protected in the middle, with guards clearing the path ahead. Their bodies were smeared with pungent insect and snake repellants, as they swept the long sticks through thorns and undergrowth to drive away snakes and insects.
Somewhere else, some armed with powerful crossbows remained vigilant, ready to shoot at the first sign of danger.
Night fell.
The group found a place to spend the night.
The next day, they continued their journey, heading specifically for the high mountains and dense forests, believing that hermits preferred these places.
In the deep belly of the endless mountains, a piercing roar echoed, followed by silence.
A massive Fire-Mane Wolf lay dead on the ground as a figure in grey crouched on the wolf's neck, devouring its blood.
Had Xu Yan been there, he would have been shocked to find that this Fire-Mane Wolf was more than twice the size of those in the Evil Shale Forest.
Yet such a formidable Fire-Mane Wolf had now met its end.
"Cough cough..."
The person in grey coughed repeatedly, lifting his head with fresh blood on his lips; with each cough, more drops of blood fell from the corner of his mouth.
"Beast blood is impure and can only temporarily suppress the injuries."
Pallor returned to the man's face as a hint of color emerged, but it soon faded, leaving his complexion deathly pale once again.
His eyes glowed with a cold and venomous light as he glared in the direction from which he had come.
"This time, you didn't kill me, Xue Wuxin. Just wait, when I return to the Inner Domain, your nightmares will begin!"
As Xue Wuxin spoke, he looked ahead.
"Beyond the Iron Barrier Mountains lies the Border Wilderness. You wouldn't think I'd flee here, would you?
"In the Border Wilderness, the Tian Di Lingji fades, unable to sense or refine Spiritual Energy. The energy is fierce, impossible to be absorbed into the body, impossible to cultivate with. To you, it's a barren land.
"Once injured, if you come to the Border Wilderness, not only can you not heal, but your condition will worsen continuously until your demise.
"But I, Xue Wuxin, need only consume essence blood to recover from my injuries, to enhance my own strength!"
Xue Wuxin's eyes revealed a look of malicious excitement and bloodthirst.
"The Border Wilderness is devoid of martial artists, unable to cultivate Martial Dao, their strength never exceeding Ninth Grade. Although their essence blood is somewhat lacking, there is plenty in quantity.
"Devouring ten thousand, a hundred thousand, a million... Even if they are ordinary people, not only can I recover my strength, I can break through!"
A look of exhilaration appeared on Xue Wuxin's face.
Coming to the Border Wilderness made him an invincible existence, akin to a deity to the people there.
Relentless slaughter—who could stop him?
Kill as many as come, sacrifice with blood, devour to strengthen oneself.
In the Inner Domain, he couldn't do this, as mass killing would make him a target, followed by a relentless pursuit.
This time, he had killed just dozens of martial artists and had already faced a siege that nearly cost him his life.
"The Border Wilderness is where I, Xue Wuxin, will rise!"
Xue Wuxin's eyes burned with fervor. How many inhabitants should the Border Wilderness have? Surely at least a hundred million?
He only needed to devour a tenth of them to break through the Great Grandmaster realm.
Once he had broken through to the realm of a Great Grandmaster, he could slaughter his way back into the Inner Domain and exact his revenge!
"Although the Spirit Mechanism of heaven and earth has been depleted in the Border Wilderness, if I rely on devouring essence blood, I might still strengthen myself. Despite the significant drawbacks, what does it matter?"
Xue Wuxin had a plan in mind.
He would cultivate a group of people to kill and offer blood sacrifices for him; once these people grew stronger, he would devour them to gain higher quality essence blood.
Moreover, he didn't have to do it himself!
No one doesn't want to strengthen themselves.
"In the Border Wilderness, I am a god, and they will all become my loyal followers, accompanying me as I slaughter my way back into the Inner Domain!"
Xue Wuxin became more and more excited as he thought about it.
It was as though he could see himself returning to the Inner Domain, leading a horde of followers, and killing in all directions.
"Cough cough..."
Getting too excited, he suddenly coughed, his complexion growing even paler.
"No good! The effect of beast blood is too poor; I must devour human blood!"
Xue Wuxin looked up towards the front, his eyes revealing a blood-red color.
With a movement, his figure soared into the sky, flying toward the outside of Tiezhang Mountain.
The party searching for the master had already advanced five hundred li and still had not found the master.
During the journey, they came across a tiger, which the group shot and killed, feasting heartily on its flesh.
"Look, that tall mountain ahead, with its majestic and perilous peaks, might just be the dwelling of a master. Our next destination is that mountain!"
The son of the Minister of War pointed at a mountain in the distance.
While the mountain was visible, it was quite a distance away.
It took them a day and a night, passing through dense forests, crossing over streams, to finally reach the foot of the mountain.
"How do we go up?"
The peaks were treacherous, and it was no easy task to ascend.
A few martial artists with exceptional lightness skills volunteered to go up, and only after a long while did they come down, reporting no reclusive masters there.
The group couldn't help but feel disappointed.
However, they soon rallied their spirits and continued on their journey.
"Let's rest for a while."
"Where on earth did Xu Yan encounter that master!"
"Damn it!"
The group sat down on an open hillside.
"Senior above, please accept my bow!"
Suddenly, someone, overwhelmed with excitement, knelt down with a plop and called out loudly.
The others looked in the direction of the voice, only to see a figure flying toward them from afar.
The figure flew shakily, but there was an indescribable ease about him as he floated in mid-air.
A master!
They had finally encountered a master!
The group was both excited and agitated.
Who else could it be but a master flying in mid-air?
"We pay our respects to the senior master!"
"Senior, I am the son of the Minister of War of Qi Country; please accept me as your disciple!"
The group called out excitedly and fervently.
Xue Wuxin, suffering from an outburst of his injury, swayed as he flew. He was about to find a place to recover when he suddenly heard the loud calls from below, and his spirits immediately lifted.
"Tiezhang Mountain, a barren mountain and wilderness, actually has people? And a group of them at that!"
His eyes lit up with excitement and a bloodthirsty gleam.
He saw a large group of people kneeling on the hillside below.
There were over a hundred.
"Most of them are around Ninth Grade martial artist strength, a small part of them have Eighth Grade martial artist strength, and the strongest few are nearly on par with Seventh Grade martial artists.
"Is this the cream of the crop in the Border Wilderness?
"Those young fellows look like ordinary people, but young blood, the flavor must be not bad."
Xue Wuxin glanced and saw through the strength of the entire group all at once.
"The son of the Minister of War? An extraordinary identity indeed, no wonder there are so many Wasteland strongmen protecting him. These people of Border Wilderness, unaware of the existence of martial artists, of course, they revere me as a deity upon seeing me!"
A smile appeared on Xue Wuxin's face.
No need to look for a place to rest—after devouring these people's blood, some of his injuries could be recovered.
He laughed heartily, in a great mood, and flew directly toward the hillside.
The people on the hillside, hearing the laughter, immediately felt encouraged. The senior seemed delighted, was there hope for becoming disciples?
"We pay our respects to the master!"
All the young nobles on the hillside, as well as the guards, excitedly and respectfully kowtowed and paid their respects.
"Good, very good, you've come at just the right time!"
Xue Wuxin said cheerfully.
The people on the hillside heard this and were overjoyed. The master said they had come at the right time—this meant their opportunity was firm! They finally had the chance to become martial arts powerhouses.
Boom!
Suddenly, a cold and gloomy aura enveloped everyone, causing them all to shudder uncontrollably. As they looked up, shock appeared on their faces.
The master was surrounded by thin, gloomy threads, like spider silk, that flew out in an instant.
They felt a sharp pain in their chests, and looking down, saw a spider silk-like thread entering their chests, seemingly transmitting fresh blood towards the master through the thread.
Their bodies grew weak, and their vision darkened as though they could feel their blood being drained.
"Ah! Help!"
"Spare us, senior!"
"Demon... A demon!"
A few of the top-notch experts screamed miserably, powerless to resist, watching their own blood being drawn out continuously while their hearts throbbed violently, shrivelling more and more.
Their bodies were withering, and their consciousness was fading away.

chapters.title: Chapter 70 - 70 The Drained Corpse (Please Subscribe)_1
chapters.content:
Hic!
From within Xue Wuxin's body came a sound, as if he had eaten his fill and belched.
A healthy color returned to his pale face.
Thread-like streaks of blood retracted from the corpses into his body, and a gloomy aura enveloped him, his face that had just regained color turning pale and lifeless once again.
"People from the Wasteland have such mixed vital essence, I need to refine and purify it. Yet, having devoured so many people's essence, I should be able to recover fifty to sixty percent of my strength," Xue Wuxin muttered to himself.
He looked up towards the endless mountains beyond, his eyes shining with excitement.
The Wasteland shall be the very place of my rise.
"Find a place to refine the vital essence and recover from my injuries. Only when I've regained my strength can I perform the Great Blood Sacrifice, purify the vital essence, and use it for cultivation.
"Haha, all of you just wait for Xue Wuxin's revenge!"
Xue Wuxin, in high spirits, soared into the sky and vanished in the blink of an eye.
Only on the slope, over a hundred withered corpses remained, each withered face vaguely retaining a look of terror.
The craze of seeking great Masters swept through Qi Country, with countless heading to the endless mountains to do so, and not just the Minister of War's son and his group.
The endless mountains were full of dangers, with seekers banding together, accompanied by guards, or recruiting experts to enter the mountains as one.
On this day, a group in search of a Master arrived at the foot of the slope.
"Let's rest up there, who knows where these Masters are hiding in seclusion."
"How come Xu Yan has such good luck in finding a Master?"
"Don't be discouraged. Is it easy to find a Master? Xu Yan searched for many years and was even deceived."
A bunch of dandies, protected by their guards, began to climb up the slope.
"Ah!"
Suddenly, a scream rang out.
"What the hell, you scared the hell out of me!"
"What happened? Aren't you a top-notch expert in the martial world, yet so easily frightened? Ah..."
Screams echoed one after another.
Everyone looking at the scene on the slope felt chilled to the bone, their scalps tingling.
On the slope lay over a hundred corpses, exuding a faint, eerie aura, each body shriveled as if drained of all blood.
On their dried-out faces, the terror of their final moments lingered.
"This is... this is..."
Someone recognized the identities of the corpses.
"The Minister of War's eldest son!"
"The Minister of Rites' second son!"
"And there's more..."
Fear welled up amongst the crowd as they instinctively looked around, as if malicious spirits were about to choose their next victim.
"How did they die?"
A more courageous expert stepped forward to examine the bodies, becoming more shocked and fearful with each one.
"The bodies are withered, they've become mummies..."
Too bizarre!
It wasn't long since the Minister of War's son and his group entered the endless mountains.
Even if they had died, they couldn't have turned into mummies so fast.
Moreover, each person's expression was one of extreme terror, as if they had seen something horrifying before death.
"This is the One-Slash King, a famous top-class expert of the Capital City, and he's dead too!"
People continued to identify the bodies, including many well-known top-class experts.
Over a hundred people, many of them experts, well-equipped with strong crossbows and other gears, had all mysteriously died on that slope.
There was no sign of struggle at the scene.
It was as if everyone had died simultaneously!
The bodies had turned into mummies!
Such a bizarre scene horrified everyone, and no one was in the mood to continue their search for Masters.
"Let's go, let's get out of here!"
"The endless mountains are too dangerous!"
The group didn't dare to linger and quickly descended the mountain.
"Take the Minister of War's son's body, take these bodies, and bring them back to the Capital City."
"Right, bring their bodies back to the Capital City. Their deaths are too strange; we must investigate. Isn't Xu Yan a martial artist? Maybe he can detect something off."
Someone suggested this.
The others found it reasonable to take the bodies back; they might even get a reward for it.
As for the possibility of being suspected of foul play, that was implausible – the bizarre state of the corpses was evident, and besides, with their strength, they couldn't have possibly killed the Minister of War's son and his group.
...
Back in the Capital City, Xu Yan had just broken through the Qi-Blood Realm and gained insight into the Innate Realm cultivation technique, leaving him in high spirits.
Emperor Qi sent someone to congratulate him and intended to hold a banquet in honor of his martial arts progress, but Xu Yan declined.
After staying a few days in the Capital City, Xu Yan set off to return to the East River Prefecture.
Shortly after Xu Yan left the Capital City, the news of the Minister of War's son and his group meeting their mysterious deaths in the endless mountains spread among the officials.
The corpses were brought back.
Even Emperor Qi came personally to investigate.
The desiccated bodies, the lingering terror on their faces – it was all very strange.
"Lord Guo, you'd better call your grandson back to take a look."
"Yes, Lord Guo, this matter is too bizarre!"
The officials started to panic.
Their own sons were out searching for great Masters.
Moreover, most had gone to the endless mountains.
The Ministers of War and Rites were particularly devastated, struck by a tremendous blow.
Guo Rongshan realized that the situation was extremely strange – could there be some monster in the endless mountains?
He immediately sent a message to Xu Yan.
He immediately employed the falcon messaging system that had just been set up not long before.
Since his promotion to the Qi King, as the Great Elder and the Crown Prince's Teacher, he had reallocated a few trained falcons from Qi Country's Falcon Department, specifically for communication between Donghe County and the Capital City.
This ensured smooth and swift communication between Donghe County and the residence of the Qi King.
Xu Yan, weary from travel, hurried back to Donghe County. He had just arrived home and had a meal with his parents, offering some advice on their cultivation, when he received a falcon message from his maternal grandfather.
Shriveled corpses?
Strange circumstances of death?
He was immediately curious.
"I once read in an ancient text a legend about a creature called 'corpse demon' that likes to devour human blood. Could what they encountered be a corpse demon?"
The moment Xu Yan had this thought, his interest was piqued.
"It is said that corpse demons are ferocious, fond of human blood, and possess immense strength. I am now fully accomplished in the Qi-Blood Realm, and my strength has long since surpassed my former self. I was just looking for an opportunity to test my skills."
"If it really is a corpse demon, it might be worth a shot."
Xu Yan's eyes lit up with excitement, and he immediately rushed to the Capital City.
He had only read about the corpse demon in an ancient book; the tale had not circulated among the people, and very few knew of such a legendary creature.
Capital City.
Xu Yan had returned after a short absence.
"Where is the body? Where is it?"
He went straight to the site where the bodies were kept.
He saw those few shriveled corpses.
Emperor Qi and all the ministers were present.
After examining the bodies, Xu Yan frowned; it seemed as if the bodies had been drained of their blood and turned into mummies.
A faint gloom still lingered in the corpses.
However, the condition of these bodies was different from how the text described victims of the corpse demon; there were no bite marks to be seen.
According to the text, the bite would be at the neck.
Moreover, those killed by a corpse demon would not instantly turn into shriveled corpses but would become bluish-black, infused with the demon's poison.
Yet, these several bodies had neither the bluish-black color nor the demon's poison.
They had completely become mummies.
It was as if they had been desiccated into human jerky, and even after such a long period, they hadn't decayed.
"Well, can you see any problem?"
Emperor Qi inquired.
Xu Yan continued examining the bodies and shook his head, "I thought at first that it might be the work of the legendary corpse demon, but looking at the bodies, it doesn't seem so."
"What is a corpse demon?"
Emperor Qi and the ministers looked at one another in confusion; they had never heard of such a creature.
"A type of monster that brutally feeds on human blood," Xu Yan briefly explained.
Emperor Qi and his ministers felt a chill; could such a terrifying creature really exist in this world?
"Young Master Xu, how do you know about the corpse demon?"
A minister, unable to contain his curiosity, asked.
He prided himself on his profound knowledge, extensive reading, and understanding of everything from astronomy and geography to history and relics. Yet he had never heard of the corpse demon.
He couldn't help but wonder if Xu Yan had made it up.
"I saw it in an ancient text, a very old one. I heard it's a unique copy," Xu Yan replied.
Seen in an ancient text?
The minister was taken aback and subconsciously said, "Surely, the contents of texts... "
He abruptly stopped as the words caught in his throat.
He suddenly remembered that Xu Yan had believed in the legends found in ancient texts, seeking masters far and wide in pursuit of true martial arts, silently mocked by others for having a simple mind.
And yet, he had indeed mastered an incredibly powerful martial art!
From this perspective, the legends in texts might not be so unbelievable!
With this thought, he couldn't continue his previous line of questioning.
Xu Yan kept examining the bodies, stripping off their clothes, and turning them over and over.
The Minister of War had tears streaming down his face, his lips trembling as he prepared to speak. But a stern look from Emperor Qi silenced him before he could utter a word.
He could only watch silently as Xu Yan manipulated the bodies.
"Strange, if it wasn't the work of a corpse demon, then what could it be?"
Xu Yan pondered in confusion, thinking back on the texts he'd read. None mentioned anything like this.
Suddenly!
His gaze sharpened as he saw a small hole at the region of the heart on one of the shriveled bodies.
As if something had pierced the heart.
"This is... "
Xu Yan frowned, touching the wound. It was very small, as if made by a tiny awl.
"A mosquito?"
The blood had been drained, turning them into mummies, and there was a small wound at the heart.
Instinctively, Xu Yan's mind conjured an image of a massive mosquito overpowering the son of the Minister of War, piercing his heart with its proboscis, and draining him of blood.
"Could it be some kind of blood-sucking monster, like a mosquito?"
Xu Yan couldn't help but think of the fire-maned wolf, which was not in the category of wild beasts. What ordinary beast had such great strength?
And could the killer of the Minister of War and the others be a creature beyond the category of wild beasts, similar to the fire-maned wolf?
After a moment of contemplation, he said, "I don't know what the killer is, possibly some kind of monster? I will go back and ask my master, he might know."
His master was a hermit, surely he would know what kind of creature this was.
Could the endless mountains be hiding such creatures?
Xu Yan suddenly became interested in the endless mountains and the unknown creatures within. He decided to ask his master whether, with his current strength, he could hunt monsters in the endless mountains.
"I'll go back and ask my master."
Xu Yan left in high spirits, prepared to rush back to Donghe County to consult his master about the nature of the monster that drained people's blood, its strength, and whether he could handle it!

chapters.title: Chapter 71 - 71: The Clash of Martial Arts (Long for Subscriptions) _1
chapters.content:
```
From Capital City to Donghe County, the journey is long, and there is a desolate stretch of the imperial road that spans dozens of miles without a single soul. Qi Country has established a station along this part of the road.
Adjacent to the endless mountains and over a hundred miles from Yunshan County, many high-ranking officials from Capital City would enter the endless mountains here due to Qi Country's craze of seeking out extraordinary figures.
Therefore, choosing to briefly stay at the station, and for this reason, the station increased its staff to serve these distinguished guests.
But on this day, a figure flew out of the endless mountains.
And landed directly in the middle of the station.
"You are..."
A minor official at the station, upon seeing Xue Wuxin descending from the sky, was first shocked, then overwhelmed with ecstasy!
Has my opportunity arrived?!
Thud!
He immediately knelt on the ground and kowtowed.
"Exalted one above, Ma Xia'er pays his respects to you, and earnestly requests you to accept me as your disciple..."
Xue Wuxin was startled. Are people from the Border Wilderness always this direct?
To kneel and kowtow, asking to take him as a master upon first sight?
"Hehe..."
With a sinister laugh, he said, "You, who feed on blood, are not worthy to be my disciple!"
The minor official was startled, feed on blood?
Thud!
Suddenly, he felt a sharp pain in his chest. Looking down, he saw a fine thread had pierced his heart, and his blood seemed to be drawn out.
"Help..."
Filled with horror and just about to call for help, he fell to the ground and turned into a dried-up corpse.
Xue Wuxin frowned. "The blood essence is too poor. In the Wasteland, the Heavenly Earth Lingji fades away, and even the people's blood essence becomes muddled."
From his body, strands spread out, instantly piercing the hearts of the other minor officials in the station.
Thud!
Dried-up corpses fell to the ground.
Not a single living soul was left in the station.
"The blood essence is impure, and every time it needs to be purified before use. Thus, the needed quantity of blood is vast, and blood sacrifices of tens or hundreds of millions of people might not even be enough to break through a minor realm."
Xue Wuxin knitted his brow slightly.
"As of now, I must endure. If one million is not enough, then ten million...
"The Border Wilderness has no shortage of people. What difference would it make if they were all sacrificed in a blood ritual?"
Xue Wuxin's eyes gleamed with a bloodthirsty light.
However, to sacrifice so many people and then purify them, it would take quite some time.
"First, I'll slaughter an entire city to heal my wounds, and then I'll find some suitable candidates, train them as Blood Disciples, so they can perform blood sacrifices and purify the blood essence for me.
"Ten years! Within ten years, I must break through the Great Grandmaster realm!"
Xue Wuxin looked back towards the endless mountains, his eyes revealing a cruel and ruthless color.
"Within ten years, I shall return to the Inner Domain!"
Walking out of the station, he headed towards the nearest city to perform a blood sacrifice and purify blood essence to recover from his injuries.
...
Xu Yan left Capital City filled with doubts, eager to find his master for answers.
He utilized his movement technique, heading straight from Capital City toward Donghe County.
With his current strength, even a thousand-mile horse couldn't match his speed, so Xu Yan didn't opt for horseback. With his qi and blood circulating, he moved like the wind, heading directly to Yunshan County.
"If it's not a corpse fiend, what kind of monster could it be?"
Xu Yan continued to ponder, what could have sucked a corpse dry?
"I'm almost at Yunshan County."
Up ahead was a station, with Yunshan County only a hundred miles beyond.
"Take a break, calm down a bit."
Xu Yan slowed down, planning to rest at the station and casually inquire with the officials whether they had heard of any blood-sucking creatures.
The station, neighboring the endless mountains and staffed by well-informed officials, undoubtedly knew more about the legends of the endless mountains than outsiders.
Having traveled non-stop from Capital City, his qi and blood had been depleted somewhat, and he didn't want to meet his master in such a state, in case his master thought he was being rash and impetuous.
"One mustn't rush in the face of problems!"
That's what Xu Yan thought to himself.
As he ceased using his movement technique, his depleted qi and blood rapidly recovered. His jade-like bones seemed to shine, showcasing the strength of his foundational physique.
By the time Xu Yan stepped into the station, his qi and blood had nearly returned to their peak.
"Something's wrong!"
Suddenly, Xu Yan's expression became solemn!
The keen senses of a martial artist allowed him to detect something was amiss right away. His qi and blood circulated instantaneously, ready for action, and he entered a state of alert.
He felt a lurking danger nearby.
Since practicing martial arts and becoming a martial artist, it was the first time he had this kind of feeling.
Xu Yan immediately realized there was danger inside the station!
And that this danger could threaten even him!
"What on earth is it?"
Xu Yan's qi and blood boiled, his heart swelled with an eager anticipation to face unknown dangers in battle.
He stepped into the station one step at a time.
Suddenly!
His pupils constricted as he saw a dried-out corpse!
The body of the station's minor official!
The shriveled corpse was exactly like those of the sons of the Minister of War!
"Is it that monster?"
Xu Yan's heart tightened, his sharp senses on high alert as he gradually pinpointed the source of danger—it was someone standing behind a door within the station!
"It's not a monster; it seems to be human!"
In that instant, Xu Yan's heart skipped a beat. Could it be a martial artist like himself?
Someone from the Martial Dao Realm?
Where did they come from?
Why would they kill a minor official at the station?
And moreover… drain the minor official's blood!
What kind of martial artist was this?
Thud!
Suddenly, a chill and nearly transparent thread shot through the door toward him, aimed squarely at his heart. The attack was incredibly swift and immensely powerful!
```

chapters.title: Chapter 72 - 71 Confrontation Between Martial Arts (Large for Subscriptions)_2
chapters.content:
In the room of the posthouse, Xue Wuxin's heart was struck with shock.
How can there be martial artists in the Wasteland?
Moreover, this young martial artist seemed somewhat off!
He had been preparing to leave the posthouse to go to a nearby city to kill and offer sacrifices of blood to recover from his injuries.
Suddenly, he sensed a powerful aura rushing towards the official road. The vigor of that blood energy was so strong that it alarmed him.
"A martial artist from the Inner Domain pursuing me?
"No! That's not right, why does he have such terrifying blood energy?"
Xue Wuxin was exceedingly shocked and with a move, he hid back inside the posthouse.
That powerful aura was too unrestrained, too tumultuous, and the strength of the blood energy was terrifying!
How could there be someone with such terrifying blood energy in the world?
"If I could devour his blood energy, wouldn't I instantly recover from my injuries and even become stronger?"
The more Xue Wuxin thought about it, the more excited he became.
"In the Wasteland, the Tian Di Lingji dissipates, making it impossible for martial artists to exist. But there are also no such martial artists with terrifying blood energy in the Inner Domain, not even a Great Grandmaster would possess such vigorous blood energy."
The more Xue Wuxin thought, the more puzzled he became.
"Could it be that it has become possible to cultivate martial arts in the Wasteland?
"No, that's absolutely impossible!"
As Xu Yan entered the posthouse, even though Xu Yan stopped using his movement technique and reined in his blood energy, Xue Wuxin's keen sensitivity towards blood energy still allowed him to sense the vast blood energy within Xu Yan.
The more he sensed it, the more shocked he became.
"Is this blood energy? Why does it feel different and why is there a sensation of being as fierce as fire? It feels as boundless as the ocean; this can't be blood energy, right?"
Xue Wuxin's mind was full of questions.
"To kill him, I can sense that if I could devour his blood energy, not only would I recover from my injuries, but my foundation would also be firmer and I might even make a breakthrough!"
In Xue Wuxin's eyes, a bloodthirsty light emerged.
With a flick of his finger, the devouring blood silk suddenly shot out, aiming straight for Xu Yan's heart.
The moment he made his move, he saw the youth palm strike, and with a rumbling sound, a crimson dragon, carrying a terrifying might, surged forward with a roar.
"What kind of cultivation technique is this!"
Xue Wuxin lost his color in fright.
Rumbling!
The room collapsed, debris flew, and Xu Yan raised his hand and pushed out another palm. The crimson dragon swept across the sky.
The fierce and domineering power of the Descending Dragon Palm instantly evaporated the devouring blood silk. Xu Yan, however, had a solemn expression on his face, and his eyes also held some confusion.
Looking at Xue Wuxin, who had risen into the air to avoid the attack, he was immensely shocked.
"A martial artist of the Innate Realm? Is that True Qi?"
That cold thread seemed to be condensed from True Qi.
"No! Something's not right, True Qi isn't this weak!
"Even the Innate Realm isn't this weak. What's going on with him?"
Xu Yan was full of questions.
Xue Wuxin stared at Xu Yan, the more he looked, the more astonished he became!
"A martial artist! He really is a martial artist!"
"Chased here from the Inner Domain? No! That's not right, if he were a martial artist from the Inner Domain, he would have recognized me by now."
Xue Wuxin dismissed the idea that this was a martial artist from the Inner Domain.
Clearly, this youth was a martial artist from the Wasteland!
"Is he a third-grade martial artist? No, stronger than a third-grade, second-grade? That's not right either, not even second-grade martial artists are this powerful, a first-grade martial artist?
"Such a young first-grade martial artist?
"Something's fishy. What kind of martial artist is this? Even a first-grade martial artist shouldn't be this strong!"
While Xue Wuxin's heart was shocked, he was also full of doubts.
"Blood energy as firm as Gang? What kind of martial artist is this, what kind of martial arts, what kind of cultivation technique? A first-grade martial artist cultivating Gang strength doesn't have such vast and domineering power, nor such might.
"Why does it feel like the aura of a Qi Cultivation Grandmaster?
"However, this doesn't seem to be the Inner Qi of a Grandmaster either. It seems to be just blood energy? Why is the blood energy so incredibly powerful?"
Xue Wuxin felt his brain was in chaos.
What in the world was going on?
Xu Yan was also confused. Xue Wuxin's body exuded a cold aura, and that powerful force seemed like True Qi, yet it was weaker than True Qi and didn't have the strength of Innate True Qi.
Still, the other party was actually soaring through the sky, which was clearly something only those of the Innate Realm could manage.
If he was of the Innate Realm, why was he so weak?
"Could it be that the cultivation technique I practice is too powerful?"
Xu Yan was deep in thought.
"That's not right either, why do I feel that his physical body isn't strong? It seems like his martial arts foundation isn't solid, and it's as if he hasn't cultivated blood energy at all?
"How strange, is he really a Martial Artist of the Innate Realm?"
"Judging by his appearance, he doesn't seem like a good person, be careful!"
His lifeforce surged as a giant dragon coiled around his body, another circled above his head, and yet another dragon raised its head on either side, ready to strike at any moment.
Facing a formidable enemy, Xu Yan dared not be the slightest bit careless.
Xue Wuxin's pupils contracted, that terrifying lifeforce as fierce as fire, posed a strong threat and sparked a yearning within him.
Intuition told him that if he devoured the other's lifeforce, not only could he recover from his injuries, but he could also achieve a breakthrough in strength!
A bloodthirsty light flashed in his eyes.
His already pale complexion became even more ghastly, as a cold aura enveloped him.
A narrow, cold-gleaming blade was drawn from beneath his robes.
Xu Yan's gaze sharpened; he felt a threat emanating from the other's blade.
"It's a precious blade!"
The blade bore resemblances to the sword and blade he had obtained from Qi Country's royal treasure vault, neither of which were made of steel.
"I didn't bring a sword with me!"
Xu Yan's heart tightened slightly.
"After I return, I want to learn swordsmanship!"
He made up his mind; upon his return, he would find his master and learn a set of sword techniques!
Hum!
The long blade in Xue Wuxin's hand buzzed with a somber hum, its light blossoming as the cold blade's Qi spread out, and around the blade floated thread-like fine lines, resembling long needles.
"Strike first to gain the upper hand!"
At the sight of this, Xu Yan pushed forward his hands, and with a thunderous boom, his Descending Dragon Palm struck out.
Xue Wuxin's gaze was cold as he slashed downward with his blade.
The chilling blade Qi, entwined with fine threads, displayed extreme ferocity, and directly shattered the force of the Descending Dragon Palm.
Boom!
The blade Qi dominated, its chilling aura pervading the surroundings as the temperature plummeted in that moment.
Xu Yan swung his hands, unleashing the Descending Dragon Palm, and in an instant nine dragons roared forth from all directions towards Xue Wuxin, with his terrifying lifeforce blazing like intense flames.
The chilling aura was vaporized under his fierce lifeforce.
"This boy must not be left alive!"
Xue Wuxin's intent to kill was chilling; the other's intense lifeforce actually had a restraining effect on his Inner Qi, causing his strength to drop by more than twenty percent.
Had it not been for his higher realm, he would have been utterly crushed if they were at the same level!
In that instant, the blade light swept across, the fine threads, like spider silk, kept twisting around as if solidifying into a giant web.
Thunder roared!
Nine dragons rampaged, striking at Xue Wuxin from all directions, their domineering palm force like endless layers, yet Xue Wuxin's blade light seemed even more sinister and sharp.
Slash after slash, he shattered the dragons, closing in on Xu Yan with nimble shifts of position.
The inn was already reduced to ruins in the midst of the fierce battle.
"So strong!"
Xu Yan's heart tensed; the other's swordplay was brutal and the blade Qi overwhelming, capable of shattering his Descending Dragon Palm. However, he did not shrink back; instead, he was all the more invigorated.
Finally, a worthy opponent.
He could fight to his heart's content!
He had still been unable to fully enjoy the battle against the War God's Mighty Army.
But now, he could!
Martial Artists live to fight!
His lifeforce was surging, the Descending Dragon Palm force grew stronger, and with a thunderous noise, a tenth dragon burst forth, ten dragons roared and coiled, their might further intensifying.
"Why do I feel like he isn't that strong? An Innate Realm Martial Artist shouldn't be this weak."
Though the other momentarily held the upper hand, Xu Yan wasn't panicking at all but began to feel puzzled.
The other was too weak, lacking the power an Innate Realm Martial Artist should have.
If his lifeforce were full, he would certainly be able to defeat the other!
The more Xue Wuxin fought, the more alarmed he became. Even though he seemingly had the upper hand, defeating his opponent was proving to be extremely difficult.
The dragon-shaped palm force was overbearingly domineering and fiercely intense.
Moreover, the dragon-shaped palm force was actually changing its attacks. A dragon's head would strike, but then in mid-air, it would swirl around, turning into a tail swipe!
What kind of palm technique could achieve this?
"Something's off, what cultivation technique is he practicing? Based on my judgment, he seems to be a rank one Martial Artist? But, which rank one Martial Artist possesses such strength and such formidable power?"
Xue Wuxin took a deep breath; he must end the battle quickly!
With a slash of his blade, countless bloodthirsty ghostly threads kept winding around the dragon, hindering its transformation and agility, slowing down the dragon's striking speed.
As he moved, he suddenly caught the moment Xu Yan's Descending Dragon Palm struck, revealing a gap above, and leaped into the air. From mid-air, he thrust his blade downward!

chapters.title: Chapter 73 - 72 Fierce Battle, Descending Dragon Palm Breakthrough (Seeking Monthly Pass)_1
chapters.content:
Xu Yan's strength was indeed formidable, and his Descending Dragon Palm Technique was unmatched in fierceness, but when it came to combat experience, he naturally fell short of Xue Wuxin.
At the moment his Descending Dragon Palm descended, a flaw suddenly appeared above his head. Xu Yan's heart skipped a beat, realizing what the problem was.
However, this fleeting opportunity was sufficient for Xue Wuxin, who had rich combat experience and had survived through life-and-death battles, to determine the outcome of life and death.
Hovering in the air, his long blade emanated a cold chill, slashing down from above.
In an instant, Xu Yan felt his scalp tingle and his hairs stand on end, as an intense sense of crisis descended upon him. In that moment, it was already too late to retract his palm for protection.
An Eight Diagrams pattern involuntarily appeared in his mind. In this moment of crisis, as though struck by sudden enlightenment, his footsteps staggered and his figure shimmered, vanishing from where he stood.
The next moment, he appeared a good ten feet away.
Boom!
A ravine appeared on the ground, where Xue Wuxin's blade had fiercely struck.
His heart sank!
In such a critical moment, his opponent had actually dodged it, but what kind of movement technique was that?
At this moment, Xu Yan's heart was racing, his blood boiling, and a giant dragon seemed to coil around him, its presence growing ever more powerful.
Just then, he had nearly died!
If not for the Eight Diagrams pattern that had emerged in his mind during the crisis, granting him sudden enlightenment and a newfound movement technique, he would have certainly been unable to evade that strike.
Now, he was both shocked and furious.
With a movement, he disappeared from his spot, as if teleporting, and in an instant was beside Xue Wuxin, unleashing his Descending Dragon Palm with a thunderous impact.
Shifting forms and exchanging positions!
Boom!
Xue Wuxin's gaze turned sharp as he wielded his blade, its cold energy crisscrossing as he unfolded his blade technique, relentlessly pressing forward as his formidable strength shattered the strikes of the Descending Dragon Palms one after another.
This forced Xu Yan to constantly use the tactic of shifting forms and exchanging positions to dodge and change his stance.
Strands of Blood Demon Qi seeped out from Xue Wuxin with each attack, spreading from his body and covering the surroundings, as if weaving a huge net.
Xu Yan's gaze grew solemn, for his opponent was slightly stronger than him.
Especially that ruthless blade technique, with its cold and eerie aura, was extraordinarily strange.
If it weren't for his profound and fiery blood energy, capable of ignoring the invasion of the cold aura, he would have likely been stiff and weak in battle by now.
Xu Yan furrowed his brows. The more intense the battle grew, the clearer his mind became, devoid of any distracting thoughts, fully immersing himself in the combat.
In his mind, the Eight Diagrams pattern emerged, and with each step he crossed, he shifted to another position.
His mastery of shifting forms and exchanging positions grew more proficient with the battle.
Boom!
The tyrannical force of his Descending Dragon Palm was once again shattered by the opponent's blade.
As the fierce blade light came at him, Xu Yan shifted form and exchanged position again, dodging away.
At that moment, the mantra of the Descending Dragon Palm emerged in his mind.
