His blood energy boiled even more, as he seemed to be in an excited state. Suddenly, with a roar, he pushed out with interchanging palms, a massive force of the Descending Dragon Palm exploding forward, and midway, it split into eighteen giant dragons, enveloping Xue Wuxin in an instant.
Descending Dragon Palm full mastery!
The more Xue Wuxin fought, the more alarmed he became. The opponent's realm should be inferior to his, and so should his strength.
Nevertheless, that domineering palm force with its astonishing momentum was indeed challenging for him to annihilate, even feeling somewhat strenuous.
Moreover, among the variations of the dragon-shaped palm forces, each time it converged, it formed a combined attack against him.
"This kid is somewhat tricky, actually not the least bit afraid of my Blood Demon Qi, even able to counter it!"
That blazing hot blood energy constantly evaporated his cold aura.
The stronger his craving became, the more he believed that by consuming his opponent, his strength could advance even further.
He had never seen a martial artist with such potent blood energy.
Such pure and refined essence blood contained an immense spiritual essence.
Among the martial artists of the Inner Domain, none possessed such pure essence blood.
Not even a Grandmaster did!
As the eighteen dragons converged in attack, Xue Wuxin's blade energy surged, sweeping through like a wild storm, blasting apart the force of the Descending Dragon Palm, increasing his speed to the extreme as he suddenly charged at Xu Yan.
One blade strike after another, and with his vigorous assault, Xu Yan once again found himself at a disadvantage.
Even as he used shifting forms and exchanging positions more frequently to dodge, he showed no panic, his gaze firm, staring fixedly at Xue Wuxin.
His crystalline bones glowed brightly, his blood energy seeming inexhaustible.
"...his might shocks the world, his anger startles heaven and earth."
Suddenly, the mantra of the Descending Dragon Palm emerged in his mind. In the midst of battle, he had a revelation.
"My Descending Dragon Palm, though powerful and seemingly domineering, lacks true 'might' and cannot shock the world.
"'His might shocks the world, his anger startles heaven and earth,' how can it startle without anger? My Descending Dragon Palm lacks 'might' and 'anger', but only with anger can it startle heaven and earth?"
Xu Yan's mind became crystal clear, a realization emerged, and in that moment, it was as if he had a deeper enlightenment of the Descending Dragon Palm, breaking through a certain boundary.
All of a sudden, he paused his movements, and pushed out with a palm.
This palm was significantly different from the previous ones.
As the palm force was released, it seemed as if a roaring could be heard, a formidable might raging forth.
This dragon-shaped palm force was more solidified, more imbued with divine essence.
And its speed increased drastically in that instant.
Roar!
The giant dragon opened its mouth as if letting out a roar, fiercely bombarding Xue Wuxin.
"Slash!"
Xue Wuxin's heart chilled, and he struck with his blade, but this time his strike did not shatter the palm force, and with an overwhelming might, like a huge mountain charging towards him, its force undiminished, the dragon's tail swept fiercely across.

chapters.title: Chapter 74 - 72 Fierce Battle, Breakthrough of the Descending Dragon Palm (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
chapters.content:
"Not good!"
Xue Wuxin's expression changed slightly as he leaped up to avoid the strike.
Boom!
Another dragon came roaring over.
One after another, dragons continued to howl towards him, each one radiating an awe-inspiring might. Xue Wuxin's heart tightened as he looked towards Xu Yan in alarm.
"Has he made a breakthrough?"
What kind of monster is this!
Xu Yan exhaled the foul air in his chest, his eyes gleaming with an icy radiance. He had achieved enlightenment!
The Descending Dragon Palm had broken through its bottleneck, stepping into a new level.
"Its anger shakes Tian Di. I am not yet able to make the dragon-formed palm energy truly 'angry,' to truly have the momentum of 'anger,' but I can show this anger in another way!"
Xu Yan looked towards Xue Wuxin, who was caught in the combined attack of the Descending Dragon Palm. He had been on the defensive throughout, but now it was his turn.
Let this martial artist, who seemed to be of the Innate Realm, experience the power of the Descending Dragon Palm.
"My current Descending Dragon Palm should be at the second level, right? I have broken through the realm of the Descending Dragon Palm, entering the second level of the Descending Dragon Palm!
"Unfortunately, I am only at the Qi-Blood Realm and completely unable to display the full power that the second level should have.
"But to deal with this guy, it's enough!"
Xu Yan's mind was clear, he had cultivated the Descending Dragon Palm to the second level.
Thunderous Boom!
Eighteen dragons combined their attacks on Xue Wuxin. Just as Xue Wuxin unleashed a fierce blade light, intending to slash through and kill the incoming palm energy, his heart suddenly skipped a beat.
Danger!
A strong sense of crisis emerged in an instant.
His combat experience forged in life-and-death situations made him decisively take to the air, as the blade light swept upwards, attempting to break out from the combined attack.
But he was already one step too late!
With a thunderous explosion!
The eighteen Descending Dragon Palm strikes combined together, and in the instant when they collided, they all burst forth suddenly. The dragons exploded, the explosive power striking Xue Wuxin in an instant!
Xue Wuxin's face changed, a light shout escaped him, and a rolling chill wrapped around his body. His long blade whipped up layers of blade energy to resist the violent explosive force.
How could he have expected the eighteen dragons could explode in an instant, condensing a powerful and unrivaled force?
"Something's off!
"This isn't a normal martial artist; what kind of cultivation technique is this?"
Even among the Grandmasters of the Inner Domain, it was impossible to make the released palm energy suddenly explode at a critical moment.
Once the palm energy is released, how could it be controlled at will?
It's simply impossible!
This Wasteland youth is abnormal!
What the hell is this cultivation technique?
Thunderous Boom!
The blade energy shattered, and the overbearing force of the Descending Dragon Palm, along with its scorching aura, seemed to evaporate the chilly aura from his body.
This made Xue Wuxin feel extraordinarily uncomfortable.
"I shall extinguish you!"
Xue Wuxin, looking bedraggled, said bitterly.
However, what greeted him was another eighteen dragons, forming a combined attack once again.
Thunderous Boom!
"Thinking of extinguishing me? Are you worthy?"
Xu Yan looked exhilarated, paying no heed to Xue Wuxin's threat.
He sent out palm strike after palm strike, each time eighteen dragons combined their attacks, exploding in an instant to form a boundless destructive force that besieged Xue Wuxin.
He was essentially condensing the power of eighteen dragons into a moment of explosive force.
This moment of explosion was the 'anger' that Xu Yan had come to understand.
Because his strength was not yet sufficient to embody it, he could only present the power of 'anger' in this manner.
The effect was extremely good.
"My enlightenment was correct!"
Xu Yan was inwardly ecstatic.
This intense battle yielded a rich harvest.
With a change in position, he had achieved enlightenment.
After perfecting the Descending Dragon Palm, he had broken through and understood the second level of the Descending Dragon Palm!
Thunderous Boom!
Xu Yan's energy seemed inexhaustible, sending out palm strike after palm strike, continuously bombarding Xue Wuxin.
At this moment, Xue Wuxin was in a passive state, getting struck. Several times he tried to break out, but was sent back by the combined force of the eighteen dragons.
What frightened him even more was that the opponent's palm energy was getting stronger and stronger.
Even, he felt a sense of 'anger' from within the palm energy.
Ridiculous!
It was really too ridiculous!
Yet, such a preposterous scene was truly happening before him.
"Cough cough..."
Suddenly, Xue Wuxin felt a sense of emptiness.
His injuries seemed to have flared up again.
The consumption was too great.
"Damn it, doesn't he ever run out of steam?"
Xue Wuxin was seething with fury and astonishment.
To think that he, a Grandmaster Martial Artist, would be in such a sorry state in the Wasteland, unable to deal with a mere youth and instead getting beaten into a sorry state!
In the Inner Domain, he, Xue Wuxin, was also a famously formidable demonic Grandmaster!
Who would believe it if it were to get out?
"I can't keep fighting like this!"
Xue Wuxin knew that if he continued to take hits passively, he would end up being exhausted to death.
Even being killed by the opponent was a possibility.
He could sense that the opponent's palm force was getting wilder and more tyrannical, the might increasingly stronger.
The dragon-shaped palm forces were becoming more solidified, and with every explosion, the savage power vaguely carried a sense of 'fury'.
"Bind!"
Xue Wuxin's long saber whipped up a blade aura, and a cold aura suddenly intensified around him.
The dense, cobweb-like Blood-Ghost Silk covering the vicinity of the battlefield suddenly constricted, binding towards Xu Yan.
"What is this trick?"
Xu Yan was startled, those dense strands carrying a cold aura, melting under his intense Qi-Blood, but there were simply too many of them.
Only now did he realize that he was within the enemy's woven net of silk.
"Careless! A lack of experience!"
Xu Yan sighed inwardly.
However, he was not panicked.
The silken threads looked sinister, and although they were potent, they should not be able to withstand his strong Qi-Blood.
Boom!
A hundred yards of Qi-Blood swept out, a giant dragon coiled around, sweeping towards the enveloping giant net with terrifying force.
One by one, the strands began to break and disappear.
Eventually, the entire giant net melted away into the Qi-Blood.
Xue Wuxin took the opportunity to escape.
He didn't expect the Blood-Ghost Silk to threaten Xu Yan, it was just to distract Xu Yan's power and facilitate his escape.
At this moment, he was soaring a hundred yards in the air.
Looking down at Xu Yan, he swept down with his saber light.
Xu Yan leaped up, launching a palm strike.
However, being of the Qi-Blood Realm, he could not soar through the air, and though leaping a hundred yards was no problem, Xue Wuxin could always maintain the distance, preventing him from getting closer.
Hopping and leaping around, he was at a disadvantage.
The Descending Dragon Palm's attack range was merely a hundred yards.
Xue Wuxin stayed beyond this range, attacking him with frigid saber qi relentlessly pouring down.
Xu Yan could only defend passively, striking out Descending Dragon Palm forces to block the attacks.
Occasionally leaping up, trying to get close to Xue Wuxin, the experienced and crafty Xue Wuxin would not let his advantage slip away and immediately soared away to a distance.
Thus, Xu Yan fell into a passive situation.
In midair, streaks of saber light poured down, chillingly sinister, carving out trenches on the ground.
On the ground, trails of scarlet dragons rose into the air, striking towards the saber light in the sky where they clashed and the sound of their collision thundered throughout.
The battle continued.
The post station had already been completely destroyed, not a trace remaining.
This stretch of the official road also collapsed in the great battle, rendering it impassable for travelers.
The ground was crisscrossed with trenches, followed by giant pits one after another.
The forests nearby had also been destroyed.
"I, Xue Wuxin, am a Grandmaster Martial Artist, I refuse to believe I can't wear you down to death!"
Xue Wuxin's eyes revealed a ruthless color.
Regardless of the cost, he had to annihilate this man.
Devouring his essence blood, every sacrifice would be worth it.
Boom!
"Hmph, we shall see what you can do to me!"
Xu Yan raised his head to look at Xue Wuxin in the sky.
His eyes still blazed with fighting spirit, if he could soar through the air, he would certainly slap the opponent to death!
At this moment, the foundation of the Martial Arts at the Jade-Bone Realm displayed its power.
The Qi-Blood surged, relentlessly churning, and despite such a fierce battle, Xu Yan's Qi-Blood remained undiminished, showing no signs of the excessive consumption.
"Cough cough..."
Xue Wuxin started coughing.
The feeling of emptiness inside him grew stronger, and his injuries seemed to be resurging.
The consumption was too great.
Looking down at Xu Yan below, who still had a high fighting spirit and energy, not showing the slightest hint of exhaustion or weakness, Xue Wuxin's face showed a look of helplessness.
It turned out that it was he, the Grandmaster fighter, who could not afford this attrition.
Although he was injured, he was still a Grandmaster!
In this Wasteland, why was there such a monstrous existence?

chapters.title: Chapter 75 - 73 Consecutive Gains, Xue Wuxin's Shock_1
chapters.content:
Xue Wuxin was filled with frustration, unwillingness, and a sense of suffocation, but he knew he couldn't continue fighting. Otherwise, the one who would surely be worn to death was himself!
"Recover from the injuries, restore all my strength, and then, I'll take that little life of his!"
Xue Wuxin glared venomously at Xu Yan below him.
"The expenditure was too great. I'll have to perform a blood sacrifice on the nearby cities to recover a bit!"
Such were Xue Wuxin's thoughts.
After slashing down with his sword, he immediately flew away from the battlefield.
"Don't go! Keep on fighting!"
Xu Yan hurriedly pursued on the ground; he hadn't had enough of the fight yet.
The more he fought, the more insight he gained; he suddenly realized that a martial artist must engage in combat.
A martial artist who doesn't know how to fight has no future.
"That's Yunshan County; why is he going to Yunshan County? My master is in Yunshan County."
Xu Yan watched as Xue Wuxin's figure disappeared at the edge of his vision, feeling somewhat puzzled.
The direction the other party was heading was indeed Yunshan County!
...
Li Xuan watched as Meng Chong's strength grew stronger day by day, extremely pleased, looking forward to the gains his second disciple would bring by starting his path.
It must be said that Meng Chong's talent was indeed strong, especially in the Physical Body Martial Path. In such a short time, he had already refined his bones to bronze level, and it was not far off from the golden level.
However, there was a bottleneck between the bronze and gold level of bone refinement that needed to be broken through.
Li Xuan believed that the golden bone bottleneck should be nothing for Meng Chong, the only difficult part, perhaps, would be the Diamond Indestructible Bones.
"I am now in the Innate Realm, and the second disciple has just started on his path in the Qi-Blood Realm. Can his progress really affect the enhancement of my own strength?"
Li Xuan pondered.
"The Diamond Indestructible Bones are definitely useful, and the Great Sun Golden Bell Shield should also allow me to further improve my physical body."
Merging both the traditional Martial Arts and the Physical Body Martial Path, how strong will my own power become?
Li Xuan was filled with anticipation.
Shi'er had recently made a slight progress in his cultivation and had even started Skin Refinement. And while he was an absolute master in the pugilistic world, the process of Skin Refinement was not difficult for him, only that his cultivation speed was much slower than Xu Yan's and Meng Chong's.
"Shi'er isn't very old, only in his thirties, and to be an absolute master in the pugilistic world at this age shows that he still has certain talent."
Li Xuan was quite satisfied with this servant.
Efficient in handling affairs and excellent in cooking skills; even though he could abstain from food due to his cultivation, he still had his desires for delicious food.
Shi'er had gone out to buy chicken.
Meng Chong was diligently cultivating, while Li Xuan sat leisurely in his chair.
Suddenly!
"Your disciple Xu Yan has had an epiphany of the movement technique to swap positions mid-battle, you have now mastered 'The Eight Diagrams Shift' to a great extent!"
A golden light emerged.
In an instant, images of The Eight Diagrams surfaced in Li Xuan's mind, the movement technique was mastered, and he had cultivated it to a great extent.
Li Xuan, however, abruptly stood up.
"What's going on?"
Xu Yan had an epiphany of the movement technique while in the midst of a fierce battle?
Where was this battle taking place?
Giving Xu Yan's strength, he should be unrivaled in Qi Country, and even a thousand troops would not be enough to force him into such fierce combat.
This meant Xu Yan had encountered a formidable enemy!
"Was it a martial artist from this world, or a ferocious beast like the Firemane Wolf?"
Li Xuan furrowed his brows in thought.
"Xu Yan wouldn't be in danger, would he?"
An epiphany of the movement technique usually emerged when one was at a disadvantage or in danger during a battle.
This movement technique was ingenious, based on The Eight Diagrams, and allowed for instantaneous shifting of positions to dodge attacks and strike back at the enemy.
In combat, it was more ingenious than the Light Crane movement technique.
This was, in essence, a combat movement technique, and it had already transcended the category of simple movement techniques.
As his cultivation progressed and his realm increased, 'The Eight Diagrams Shift' would continue to become more powerful.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has improved his Descending Dragon Palm to a great extent in the heat of battle, you have now perfected the Descending Dragon Palm."
The Golden Finger continued to provide feedback on the gains.
The Descending Dragon Palm was perfected!
Li Xuan became somewhat restless; what kind of formidable enemy had Xu Yan encountered to have these successive breakthroughs in the midst of combat?
"I must go and see for myself."
He was somewhat worried about Xu Yan's safety but also marveled at Xu Yan's talent to break through successively in combat.
Indeed, martial artists need to fight!
A martial artist who doesn't know how to fight is not a true martial artist.
"Your disciple is battling a strong foe, his combat experience is continuously improving, your combat experience has greatly increased."
The Golden Finger continued to provide feedback.
As if awakened by a battle consciousness in his mind, his combat experience suddenly saw a substantial improvement.
"To Donghe Prefecture!"
Without hesitation, Li Xuan's figure soared into the air and instantly vanished into the sky.
Meng Chong, who was in the midst of his practice, was thoroughly shocked; his master had soared into the sky and disappeared!
In the blink of an eye, his figure had disappeared.
The speed was incredibly fast!
"The Innate Realm can control energy to soar through the sky, covering hundreds of miles in an instant. Is my master an Innate Realm powerhouse?
"No, that's not right!
"My master's realm must far surpass the Innate Realm. My brother once said that our master is a hermit expert, whose cultivation level has probably transcended all the realms of Martial Arts, nearing the existence of 'the Way'."
Meng Chong felt a surge of excitement as if he had been injected with chicken blood.
"I must strive to get started on my path as soon as possible!"
He became even more diligent in his practice, the Great Sun atmosphere emerged around him, and his bronze bones gradually approached perfection!
...
Li Xuan flew through the air, this was his first time soaring after breaking through to the Innate Realm.
"Being a Martial Arts powerhouse is truly wonderful. This is my first time flying in both lives!"
Li Xuan thought with a feeling of wonder.
With his current strength, flying at full speed, he quickly arrived above Donghe Prefecture.

chapters.title: Chapter 76 - 73: Consecutive Gains, Shock of Xue Wuxin_2
chapters.content:
```
They did not sense any signs of battle.
A glance swept over Xu Family's residence, where Xu Yan's parents were cultivating. Half of the family's guards were on duty while the other half were also cultivating, all safe and sound.
"Is Xu Yan in the Capital City?"
Li Xuan's brow furrowed.
The Capital City was too far from Donghe County. Even if he rushed there with all his might, the battle would be over by the time he arrived, with the outcome already decided.
"Should I go to the Capital City?"
Li Xuan hesitated.
Xu Yan was his prized disciple and, with his current strength, he could wipe out Xu Yan's formidable enemies with a wave of his hand.
But the Capital City was distant, and if Xu Yan were to be defeated, he'd be too late to come to the rescue even if he wanted to.
"Your disciple Xu Yan, in the midst of a fierce battle, has broken through to the second level of the Descending Dragon Palm, reaching great proficiency with the second level of your Descending Dragon Palm."
The Golden Finger's feedback came again.
Li Xuan was stunned. The second level of Descending Dragon Palm?
He immediately rejoiced; his disciple was commendable, managing to forcefully elevate the stage of the Descending Dragon Palm. Now that there was a second level, could there also be a third, fourth, fifth level...?
The second level of the Descending Dragon Palm has begun to embody some of Dragon's Might Intent, igniting the "fury" within the palm force, greatly augmenting the power of the Descending Dragon Palm!
Moreover, the dragon-shaped palm force of the Descending Dragon Palm also became more solidified and took on more of a dragon's likeness.
"If Xu Yan can have such an epiphany amid fierce battle, doesn't it mean he is not incapable of facing the enemy? Having grasped the second level of Descending Dragon Palm, he should not be defeated, right?"
Li Xuan pondered.
"Is Xu Yan really in the Capital City, or has he gone somewhere else?
"Are his opponents from this world's martial artists, or creatures like Flame-Mane Wolves?"
Li Xuan leaned toward the former.
"Did Emperor Qi find the martial artist? Or did Xu Yan get involved with the mortal world, hence someone from the Martial Dao Realm came targeting Xu Yan?"
Li Xuan's brows tightened in thought.
"With my current strength, what level of martial artist do I belong to in the Martial Dao Realm?"
"What is the Martial Dao of this world like?"
Li Xuan stared down at the Xu Family residence below, silently waiting.
Up to now, there was still no commotion within the Xu Family estate.
That meant no urgent news had come from the Capital City.
"I'll return and have Shi'er use the Tianmu Sect's intelligence network to find out what's happening in the Capital City."
Li Xuan made up his mind.
He then turned and went back to Yunshan County.
...
As Xue Wuxin hastened toward Yunshan County, the hundred miles seemed to empty him even further, even causing him to breathe heavily.
But he dared not stop.
Xu Yan was pursuing him from behind. Once he descended from the sky and slowed down, he would be in danger if he were caught.
His injuries were relapsing.
"Damn it all! I've reached the Border Wilderness, yet still so wretched!
"No, even more wretched than when I was in the Inner Realm."
Xue Wuxin was filled with anger and frustration, his eyes flickering with bloodthirsty light.
"Once I perform a blood sacrifice of the city and devour the vital blood to recover my strength, I will take your life for sure!" Xue Wuxin thought viciously to himself.
A small city appeared in his field of vision ahead.
"This city isn't large, only about tens of thousands of people. Sacrificing it should restore about eighty to ninety percent of my strength."
A bloodthirsty gleam grew in Xue Wuxin's eyes.
"There shouldn't be any strong warriors in such a small city."
He was also puzzled. On his escape route from the Inner Realm, he had encountered a troop in the mountains, one of whom was a son of Minister of War from Qi Country.
Given his status, there surely should have been protectors who were strong warriors.
Why was there not a single martial artist among that troop?
And how soon after emerging from the mountains had he encountered an incredibly powerful individual? Was it merely coincidence?
Perhaps there were no martial artists in the Border Wilderness, and that individual was an exception?
Xue Wuxin was puzzled.
Now was not the time for probing; recovering from his injuries and restoring his strength was the priority.
He flew directly over Yunshan County.
His sharp senses immediately detected many vigorous individuals in the county, their vitality matching those he had devoured in the mountains.
"What is that place?"
Suddenly, Xue Wuxin sensed a robust vitality.
Within this county, this single vitality seemed more vigorous than all the people in the entire county, stirring a strong craving in him.
"A martial artist!"
He was shocked in his heart.
There actually was a martial artist in this small county!
In the Border Wilderness, where the Heavenly Earth Lingji had faded, there shouldn't exist any martial artists!
```
He concentrated, trying to absorb the spiritual energy between heaven and earth, but he couldn't sense anything.
The Heavenly Earth Lingji had not recovered and was still in a state of dissipation.
"Why would there be a martial artist?"
Xue Wuxin thought of the young man he had fought with, whose cultivation technique was extremely special and different from those in the Inner Domain.
"No matter, once I devour this martial artist's vitality, I will recover.
"Once I've regained my Grandmaster strength, I won't believe that this Wasteland can still have a warrior on par with a Grandmaster."
A Grandmaster level martial artist is also among the top powerhouses in the Inner Domain.
It is absolutely impossible for a Grandmaster powerhouse to appear in the Wasteland.
"This martial artist is much weaker, and shouldn't be difficult to deal with."
Xue Wuxin was exceedingly excited.
With a movement, he arrived above the small courtyard and saw Meng Chong.
Looking at the bald, shiny head, and the muscular, robust Meng Chong, Xue Wuxin's eyes revealed a greedy and pleasant surprise.
"Such vigorous vitality, although not as good as that boy's, my injuries will definitely recover after devouring his essence blood, and my strength will return to its peak.
"After killing that boy and devouring his essence blood, I won't be too far from breaking through to the Great Grandmaster!"
The more Xue Wuxin thought about it, the more excited he became.
Once he broke through to become a Great Grandmaster, let alone the Wasteland, even in the Inner Domain, he wouldn't fear anyone.
Great Grandmaster, that is the pinnacle of the Inner Realm Martial Arts!
"Devour his essence blood!"
To avoid any long night filled with dreams, Xue Wuxin immediately made his move.
He hadn't forgotten that Xu Yan was chasing him in this direction, and he needed to devour the boy before the other party arrived.
As long as he refined the boy's essence blood and his injuries recovered, he would let that boy know what Grandmaster's might was.
With a flick of his finger, a strand of Blood Devouring Ghost Silk shot out, heading straight for the heart.
Meng Chong was cultivating, and he had already perfected his Bronze Bone.
The strength of his Golden Bell Body was growing even stronger, and he was only a step away from reaching Gold Bone.
However, Meng Chong felt a bottleneck in this step and seemed unable to break through to Gold Bone for a while.
Suddenly, his heart skipped a beat!
A sense of danger!
Where did this danger come from?
Before Meng Chong could detect the source of the danger, something suddenly pricked his chest, and an extremely cold breath penetrated into his heart.
With this cold breath entering, his heartbeat violently accelerated, blood rushing out hastily, creating a storm of vitality within his body.
It was like a drop of water in a hot oil pan.
As the storm of blood swept through, the previously stagnant Bronze Bone, unable to continue tempering, suddenly loosened under the intense impact of blood force.
"What is this?"
Meng Chong was shocked. What on earth was this cold thread?
Following the thread, he saw Xue Wuxin standing in the air.
This instant, Meng Chong's scalp tingled and his heart tightened!
"An Innate Realm martial artist? Where did this Innate Realm martial artist come from, isn't Qi Country devoid of martial artists?
"Didn't my senior brother alone sweep through the Divine Might Army and stomp over the Qi royal family?"
This mysterious warrior clearly bore malicious intent!
The thread at his chest was a fatal attack, and only because he practiced the Great Sun Golden Bell Shield, which was incredibly strong defensively, did it not penetrate his heart.
It just pierced a little bit of skin?
Meng Chong threw a punch and directly shattered the thread.
"Where did Master go?"
Meng Chong was sweating profusely with anxiety.
He hadn't even entered the door yet, how could he possibly be a match for that guy in midair?
Where is Master?
Master had just left and had not returned yet.
Did the opponent take advantage of Master's absence to come and kill him?
"Could it be, a killer sent by the Emperor of Wu?"
In an instant, Meng Chong thought of the Emperor of Wu.
He was on Wu Country's most-wanted list, with a bounty of one hundred thousand taels of gold on his head!
Xue Wuxin in midair, however, was utterly shocked.
Although the previously shot Blood Devouring Ghost Silk was not his full power, it could penetrate even stone!
Yet, the Blood Devouring Ghost Silk failed to enter the heart of the bald-headed young man below!
It had merely pierced his skin a bit?
He began to find this Wasteland extremely odd and even somewhat terrifying.
Random encounters here were with bizarrely powerful individuals.
This one had a physical constitution so strong, it was truly unfathomable!
"I must finish this quickly!"
Xue Wuxin's fingers flicked continuously, and two Blood Devouring Ghost Silks burst out.

chapters.title: Chapter 77 - 74 Inner Domain and Border Wilderness, Crush Their Bones and Scatter Their Ashes_1
chapters.content:
Two strands of blood-devouring ghost silk, each faster and more powerful than the last, could easily penetrate a slab of steel.
At this moment, Meng Chong felt an intense sense of crisis dawning on him.
With a low growl, his muscles bulged, and with a 'dong' sound, his body turned as tough as a golden bell, even emitting a faint golden light.
He crossed his fists in front of his chest to protect his vitals.
Thud!
The blood-devouring ghost silk instantly pierced his fists, its cold presence traveling from his fists up his arms and entering his body.
Boom!
His blood qi burst forth wildly within him, sweeping through his body and shattering the bottleneck—he had broken through the limit of copper bones!
However, the danger had not subsided.
Even with the imminent completion of his golden bones, he was no match.
A stabbing pain came from his fists, the cold aura seeming ready to freeze them solid.
With another low growl, the blood qi storm within him surged to his fists under his control.
Thud!
He threw both fists forward, shattering the blood-devouring ghost silks that had pierced them.
Xue Wuxin's heart filled with shock. What kind of flesh was this?
That it could block his blood-devouring ghost silk?
"I refuse to believe that you can block this strike!"
Xue Wuxin took the matter seriously now.
As a grandmaster martial artist, although he had hardly exerted any force, the two previous assaults would have easily pierced through a third-rank martial artist in the Inner Domain.
Even grandmaster-level fighters, relying solely on their physical bodies, couldn't have withstood it.
And this bald youth, although not as strong as a third-rank or higher martial artist, had an extraordinarily resilient body!
Zi!
Xue Wuxin flicked his finger, shooting out a slightly thicker strand of blood-devouring ghost silk, heading straight for Meng Chong's heart.
This strike, he truly used the strength a grandmaster martial artist should possess.
"I can't block it!"
Meng Chong was horrified. He couldn't block this strike no matter what.
He hadn't even entered the threshold of the Martial Arts, and as powerful as the Great Sun Golden Bell Shield was, it couldn't possibly block the attack of a martial artist who was presumably at the Innate Realm.
Even if he were to cultivate golden bones, or even diamond-like lustrous bones, he could not withstand it.
The difference in realms was too vast!
As the crisis of death loomed, Meng Chong was powerless, too weak in the face of Xue Wuxin!
Boom!
Just at the brink of mortal peril, suddenly, a Golden Dragon descended from the heavens, instantly shattering the blood-devouring ghost silk. The Golden Giant Dragon coiled up and restrained Xue Wuxin mid-air, pulling him down from the sky.
Meng Chong was overjoyed, feeling a sense of relief as if he had just survived a catastrophe.
"Master!"
Li Xuan had returned from Donghe County, intending to let Shi'er, using information from the Tian Mu Sect, explore the happenings in the Capital City.
Yet, as soon as he reached Yunshan County, he sensed a cold presence.
Martial Artist!
Moreover, right in his own courtyard!
He was startled at once. Where did this martial artist come from?
With a teleportation move, he appeared above the courtyard.
He arrived just in time to see Meng Chong in crisis and immediately took action, saving Meng Chong and simultaneously binding Xue Wuxin in mid-air.
"Good thing I arrived one step ahead, or my second disciple would have been gone!"
Li Xuan breathed a sigh of relief.
To see his second disciple about to enter the door of Martial Arts and then lose him would have been a colossal loss.
Where else could he find another disciple suitable for cultivating the Great Sun Golden Bell Shield?
With that thought, his anger surged.
He glared fiercely at Xue Wuxin who was bound by the Descending Dragon Palm's force, his gaze growing dark.
This was a martial artist, and not a weak one at that.
It seemed… he was in an injured state.
Moreover, what the other cultivated in his body was not blood qi but a cold and sinister energy with a hint of bloodlust, clearly no good person.
"True Qi?"
Li Xuan's brow furrowed slightly.
"No, it's somewhat like True Qi, but of lower quality."
The "True Qi" within the other's body was nowhere near as pure as his own Innate True Qi, and it was also lacking in power and quality.
"Master, who is he? He came to kill your disciple right away. Could he be sent by the Emperor of Wu?"
Meng Chong, having narrowly escaped death, looked at Xue Wuxin and showed a face filled with anger.
Li Xuan sat down in a chair, a mysterious aura emerging that made him appear even more unfathomable.
"How's the injury?"
Li Xuan glanced at the wound on Meng Chong's fists, which was surrounded by a cold aura.
But it was not a big problem and was only a minor injury.
With Meng Chong's current physical recuperative ability, it would fully heal in two or three days.
Moreover, stimulated by this cold aura, Meng Chong's blood qi became violent, breaking through the bottleneck and exceeding the limit of copper bones, entering the stage of refining golden bones.
Was it a blessing in disguise?
Xue Wuxin lay on the ground, his heart filled with terror.
A Golden Dragon coiled around him, its fearsome pressure holding him down firmly, rendering him unable to move.
His Inner Qi was so suppressed it felt as if it would collapse at any moment.
"Great Grandmaster? How could there be a Great Grandmaster in the Wasteland?
"No! That's not right, this terrifying presence—perhaps not even a Great Grandmaster would possess it.
"Who is this person? He looks so mysterious and profound!"
Xue Wuxin's heart sank.
Because in the Wasteland, the Spirit Mechanism of heaven and earth dissipated, the nature's spiritual energy was violent, and since the Heavenly Earth Lingji did not exist, it was impossible to channel spiritual energy into the body.
The human body also couldn't refine or withstand the violent spiritual energy.
Therefore, it was impossible for martial artists to exist.
It was precisely for this reason he fled to the Wasteland when being pursued relentlessly in the Inner Domain.
Yet, he had never expected to encounter such a powerful being in the Wasteland!
"Is this their master?"
The mysterious strong man had appeared with a Golden Dragon, unstoppable in power, belonging to the same source as that young man's palm techniques. This person must undoubtedly be that young man's master.

chapters.title: Chapter 78 - 74 Inner Domain and Border Wilderness, Crush Their Bones and Scatter Their Ashes_2
chapters.content:
"What on earth is going on in the Wasteland!"
Xue Wuxin felt unbearably oppressed, as if he had traveled a great distance to the Wasteland just to meet his death!
Li Xuan gazed at Xue Wuxin lying on the ground, his brows slightly furrowed. Where did this martial artist come from? Why did he strike at Meng Chong? Could it really be, as Meng Chong had said, that The Emperor of Wu had sent him?
If The Emperor of Wu had sent a martial artist, Qi Country, which was no weaker than Wu Country, should also have its own martial artists. Otherwise, it would have been annexed by Wu Country long ago.
However, after all the trouble Xu Yan caused in Qi Country for so long, there was no sign of any martial artist appearing.
"Not right! Xu Yan was in fierce battle; could it be that Emperor Qi took a breath and went to invite a martial artist to participate?"
The martial potency of Qi Country had always been very low.
From various indications, there seemed to be no martial artists; otherwise, Xu Yan would not have been mocked as someone with a troubled mind for believing in the legends and roaming everywhere seeking a master, desiring to practice the true martial arts.
Li Xuan was about to have Meng Chong interrogate Xue Wuxin about his origins and which level his strength was in the Martial Dao Realm when he saw Xu Yan flying over.
He raised his eyebrows slightly, instantly understanding. Could it be that the martial artist who had fought fiercely with Xu Yan was the same person in front of them?
Xu Yan, following the direction in which Xue Wuxin had fled, pursued him all the way and saw a Golden Dragon flash by outside the Cloud Mountain County, which gave him a start. Was it his master intervening?
Rushing over in haste, he indeed found Xue Wuxin lying on the ground, with a Golden Dragon coiling around him, binding him tightly.
"Master!"
Xu Yan bowed respectfully.
Then, seeing the injury on Meng Chong's hand, he was shocked and asked, "Junior brother, is it he who hurt you?"
"Yes, senior brother, if not for Master returning in time, I would have died," Meng Chong said with lingering fear.
"This guy, he might be sent by The Emperor of Wu to kill me!"
Meng Chong said angrily through gritted teeth.
"Probably not."
Xu Yan was puzzled; Meng Chong had misunderstood.
"You've fought with him; speak," Li Xuan said, looking at Xu Yan.
"Yes, Master!"
Xu Yan nodded and then recounted the events in full detail.
He described going to the Capital City to investigate the cause of the mummified corpses, initially suspecting the legendary Corpse Fiends, and upon finding that was not the case, he planned to return and ask his master what kind of monster was harming people.
However, at a station a hundred miles away, he found that all the station officials had been killed, each drained of blood. That was when he encountered Xue Wuxin's attack and after a fierce battle, Xue Wuxin, unable to continue, fled.
Li Xuan was inwardly shocked to hear this. This is demonic cultivation! Absorbing other people's blood, if not demonic cultivation, then what?
What kind of demonic cultivator was he?
Now he finally understood why the attacker had targeted Meng Chong, who undoubtedly had vigorous blood qi and rich essence blood containing immense power of essence blood.
It could have helped him recover from his injuries and enhance his strength.
But he had misjudged Meng Chong's physically strong body by being careless in his first and second attacks.
It was fortunate that he was careless, otherwise by the time he returned, Meng Chong would've been dead!
"Speak, where are you from, and what are your intentions?"
Li Xuan slightly loosened the Golden Dragon binding Xue Wuxin, allowing him to speak.
This was the perfect opportunity to learn more about the Martial Dao Realm of this world.
What was the level of martial power within the Martial Dao Realm and at what level his own strength currently stood?
"Speak quickly!"
Meng Chong clenched his fists and glared at Xue Wuxin angrily.
"Speak honestly, or I'll kill you!"
He almost had killed already, and now Meng Chong was fuming with anger.
Xue Wuxin's heart sank as he looked at Li Xuan, sensing the mysteriousness and unfathomable depth of his strength, clearly beyond comparison with a Great Grandmaster.
Escape was no longer an option; the only thing left was to find a way to save his own life!
"Elder, please forgive me, my name is Xue Wuxin, I come from the Inner Domain and have been pursued by enemies which is why I fled to the Wasteland!"
Xue Wuxin cautiously chose his words.
The Inner Domain!
The Wasteland!
Li Xuan had already realized that Qi Country and Wu Country were part of the Wasteland, and crossing the endless mountains would lead to the Inner Domain!
There were martial artists in the Inner Domain!
Xue Wuxin must have been a demonic martial artist from the Inner Domain who was surrounded and injured, and thus fled to the Wasteland.
At what level was his strength in the Inner Domain?
And what was the state of martial arts in the Inner Domain?
Xue Wuxin's body was permeated with True Qi which was somewhat lacking in quality. Was it due to the Cultivation Technique he practiced, or was it caused by a difference in the martial arts system?
These questions, Li Xuan, as a reclusive expert, naturally would not ask outright.
As an expert, he must understand this world as though it were the back of his hand.
If he were to ask openly like this, wouldn't it appear as though he, the esteemed expert, knew nothing about the Martial Dao Realm?
Moreover, there was no need for him to ask.
Xu Yan was already excitedly inquiring.
Where is the Inner Domain?
Is it where the Martial Dao Realm is located?
The master always responded with that enigmatic smile, never discussing the Martial Dao Realm, saying only that when one's strength reached a certain level, they would naturally understand.
This was precisely the opportunity to learn about the Martial Dao Realm!
"Where is the Inner Domain? Is it the Martial Dao Realm? Why is our place called the Wasteland?"
Xu Yan's eyes burned with fervor as he asked.
Xue Wuxin was taken aback, looking at Xu Yan with surprise and doubt. He didn't know about the Inner Domain?
He didn't know about the Wasteland?
Then, turning towards Li Xuan, that mysterious and powerful figure, sitting leisurely in his chair, he seemed unconcerned.
"This is a revered figure!
"Could he be a recluse from the Inner Domain, hiding in the Wasteland?
"Is it to avoid enemies, or for some other reason? He has taken in two disciples here, yet he never mentions anything about the Inner Domain, so..."
Xue Wuxin had a bold guess.
"The Inner Domain lies beyond the great mountains. This place is called the Wasteland because here the Heavenly Earth Lingji is extinguished, the Spiritual Energy violent and unrefined, impossible to sense or absorb, rendering the birth of Martial Artists impossible..."
Xu Yan and Meng Chong listened with furrowed brows. The Wasteland, where Heavenly Earth Lingji is extinguished and no Martial Artists can be born?
How can this be possible?
Li Xuan was also bewildered. "I can absorb Tian Di's Spiritual Energy and cultivate... It must be because of the Martial Arts system I created; no wonder I found the Spiritual Energy here to be so harsh."
He finally understood why the Spiritual Energy was not gentle; it was due to the extinction of the Heavenly Earth Lingji.
"It's because of the Tian Di Bridge, which serves as a connector between heaven and earth, allowing cultivation even without the Heavenly Earth Lingji."
Enlightenment dawned in Li Xuan's heart.
"Continue. Spill everything you know. How strong is the Inner Realm Martial Arts community? Are you from the Innate Realm? What level are you at?"
Xu Yan pressed on with his questions.
The Innate Realm?
Xue Wuxin was somewhat dumbfounded. What level was the Innate Realm?
This youth is from the Innate Realm?
"Martial Arts are divided into Ninth Grades, breaking through each grade, one becomes a Qi Refining Grandmaster, a Great Qi Refining Grandmaster... I am a Grandmaster Realm Martial Artist. This is Internal Qi. I sense the Heavenly Earth Lingji and draw in Spiritual Energy into my body, transforming it into Martial Dao Internal Qi..."
Xu Yan and Meng Chong listened, baffled. What were these Ninth Grade level, these Qi Refining Grandmasters, these Great Qi Refining Grandmasters?
The other party turned out to be a Grandmaster level Martial Artist, and a Great Grandmaster is already the most eminent expert in the Inner Domain.
Li Xuan listened silently. According to what Xue Wuxin said, in terms of cultivation levels, the Innate Realm was only a measure of strength within the Inner Domain's Grandmasters, and was significantly weaker than the Innate Realm.
And his own strength was comparable to a Great Grandmaster!
Even stronger, perhaps.
Upon realizing this, he felt a weight lift from his shoulders. With his current strength in the Inner Domain, he was among the top echelons. It wouldn't be long before Xu Yan broke through to the Innate Realm.
His own strength would definitely surpass that of a Great Grandmaster!
"I've told you all that I know."
Xue Wuxin finished sharing all of his knowledge, then earnestly pleaded, "I was only fleeing from a pursuit, with no intention to kill. I implore you, senior..."
It was time to beg for mercy!
However, Li Xuan's hand moved ever so slightly, and the Golden Giant Dragon burst forth with an imposing presence.
Bang!
Xue Wuxin immediately shattered into dozens of pieces, which were then ground to dust by the rolling energy of the Golden Giant Dragon. A gust of wind blew and dispersed the ash completely.
Not a trace was left behind.
Only a pouch and a knife dropped to the ground.
With a sweep of the Golden Dragon, both the knife and pouch fell into Li Xuan's hand.
Xu Yan and Meng Chong were dumbfounded. He had just killed a man?
"Master, what is... "
Xu Yan started, puzzled.
Li Xuan stood up, his expression stern. It was time to teach his disciples a lesson.
"Disciples, remember this: when facing those of unknown origins who harbor malice or hostility, do not show any mercy. Crush their bones, scatter their ashes, extinguish their souls, leaving no trace behind, so they can't be pursued.
"It saves a lot of unnecessary trouble, such as avengers seeking retribution or Sects coming after you for revenge, and so on.
"Crush, scatter, extinguish, without leaving a trace.
"As long as no one knows who did it, it has nothing to do with you!"
Xu Yan and Meng Chong listened intently. This was their master imparting his experience in the Martial Dao Realm!
"Crush bones, scatter ashes, extinguish souls? As long as no one knows I did it, it has nothing to do with me!"
Xu Yan murmured to himself, feeling as if he had just had an epiphany!

chapters.title: Chapter 79 - 75 True Martial Arts and False Martial Arts? (Seeking Monthly Pass)_1
chapters.content:
"Master, I understand!"
Xu Yan said with a look of enlightenment, "If they're enemies, we should crush their bones into dust and obliterate their souls, showing no mercy!"
"And if they have a powerful background or a strong backer, then after eliminating them, erase all traces and disassociate ourselves from the incident.
"As long as no one knows, it's unrelated to us!"
These were the experiences of navigating the Martial Dao Realm.
Although the master was unfathomably powerful, clearly, he couldn't protect his disciple everywhere. A true powerhouse must rely on his own strength to solve all enemies and troubles.
Li Xuan silently nodded. His senior disciple always understood the "hidden message" in his words, which was very good.
"Master, I understand too!"
Meng Chong also had a look of sudden realization.
He felt he also gained some insight by combining his own experiences in the jianghu. He now knew how to deal with these enemies.
If he couldn't handle it himself, find someone else to take the blame.
As long as one could crush the enemy's bones into dust and obliterate their soul, that's enough.
Like when he took revenge, it was The Emperor of Wu he sought. It was done swiftly—everyone was executed!
Li Xuan was gratified; his second disciple also had an epiphany!
Both disciples were individuals with exceptional talents; as a master, he felt very content!
"Master, Xue Wuxin mentioned that Inner Realm Martial Arts are divided into nine grades, with the Grandmaster above Ninth Grade cultivating martial Inner Qi, and even above the Grandmaster is the Great Grandmaster. Why are they different?"
Xu Yan expressed the doubt in his heart.
The Martial Arts taught by the master consisted of Skin Refinement, Bone Refinement, and Viscera Refinement, which were just the foundational realms of Martial Arts, not even considered the entry-level, with the entry-level being the Qi-Blood Realm.
Above the Qi-Blood Realm was the Innate Realm.
The Grandmaster Realm of Inner Realm Martial Arts was similar to the Innate Realm, as one could also fly by controlling the qi, but it didn't involve cultivating Innate True Qi, rather, it was martial Inner Qi.
"Master, we are in the Wasteland, where the Heavenly Earth Lingji has dissipated, making it impossible to cultivate Martial Artists. What's that all about?"
According to Xue Wuxin, in the Wasteland, the Heavenly Earth Lingji has dissipated, the Spiritual Energy is violent, and beings in the wilderness, due to being in a world without Lingji, cannot sense the existence of Spiritual Energy.
It's also impossible to cultivate Martial Arts using Spiritual Energy.
The Spiritual Energy in the world has become violent due to the loss of the Spirit Mechanism and cannot be guided into the body.
All these aspects differed significantly from the Martial Arts taught by the master.
Meng Chong nodded from the side, his face also filled with curiosity.
Li Xuan sat on a chair, his gaze deep, not answering directly, but instead asked, "Disciple, when you fought with Xue Wuxin, how did you find his strength?"
"He's quite formidable. I barely managed to match him, chiefly due to my lack of experience. Of course, he was wounded, too."
After pondering for a moment and assessing Xue Wuxin's strength, Xu Yan added, "If I were at the peak of the Qi-Blood Realm and Xue Wuxin wasn't injured, at his prime, I am confident I wouldn't lose to him, perhaps even defeat him."
Li Xuan smiled and said, "You are merely at the beginner's stage of Martial Arts, in the Qi-Blood Realm, and he is already a Grandmaster."
Xu Yan was startled, "Yes, Xue Wuxin is at the Grandmaster level, a contender among the strong in the Inner Domain, while I am just at the threshold of Martial Arts, in the Qi-Blood Realm."
A mere Martial Arts beginner facing a Grandmaster, who the true Martial Artist was, became self-evident!
In that instant, Xu Yan had an epiphany!
These ranks, Ninth Grade, Eighth Grade, Fifth Grade, Third Grade, First Grade—they didn't sound profound at all.
What I cultivate, though, is Skin Refinement, Bone Refinement, Viscera Refinement; with thunderous tendons and bones and firm Qi-blood, it truly sounds more powerful than First and Third Grades.
"Master, I get it now, what they practice is pseudo Martial Arts!"
Xu Yan exclaimed as if having a great realization.
"So that's it!"
Meng Chong also understood, saying with a look of realization, "So it's pseudo Martial Arts. That means, the so-called Grandmasters are actually pseudo Innates, and their strength is far inferior to the real Innate Realm. No wonder he couldn't kill me in one strike!"
Now everything became clear.
Xue Wuxin wasn't practicing true Martial Arts, hence his inferior strength, which is why he couldn't finish him with a single move.
Li Xuan smiled without saying a word. This was all the disciple's own realization; he hadn't said anything about pseudo Martial Arts!
Of course, the Martial Arts he created, was definitely not just a sham or a pretense; whoever was stronger, that was the true Martial Arts!
For the time being, the Martial Arts he had created seemed superior.
As for future disputes over the authenticity of Martial Arts, that was not a concern for Li Xuan.
"The Qi-Blood Realm should actually correspond to First Grade, Second Grade, and Third Grade, yet the Qi-Blood Realm is stronger than the upper Third Grade Martial Artists of the Inner Domain.
"Xu Yan, after all, has the jade-bone foundation, and his strength is much stronger than any ordinary Qi-Blood Realm cultivator, which is why he can fight beyond his realm against Grandmasters of the Inner Domain. If it were the gold-bone foundation, one might also be able to fight a Grandmaster of the Inner Domain.
"As for those with copper-bone or iron-bone foundations in the Qi-Blood Realm, they could not fight against a Grandmaster. However, they are still stronger than the upper Third Grade in the Inner Domain."
Li Xuan internally evaluated, drawing a rough comparison of the strengths of the two.
In the Inner Domain, a Grandmaster who cultivates Inner Qi is undoubtedly far stronger than a First Grade Martial Artist.
"Grandmasters cultivating martial Inner Qi is just called differently, it could also be referred to as True Qi. It's just that the method of cultivation is different; the True Qi they cultivate, in terms of power, purity, and quality, does not compare to the Innate Realm.
"Even though I am only at the beginner's stage of the Innate Realm, I am as strong as a Great Grandmaster of the Inner Domain."
Li Xuan internally compared and assessed the two Martial Arts systems.
The Qi-Blood Realm corresponds to the upper three grades of the Inner Domain, but a Qi-Blood Realm cultivator is stronger than the upper three grades of Martial Artists in the Inner Domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 80 - 75 True Martial Arts and False Martial Arts? (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Innate Realm, in fact, corresponds to the Qi cultivators of the Inner Realm Grandmasters, all practicing True Qi. However, the Innate True Qi of the Innate Realm is stronger than the Inner Qi of the Inner Realm Grandmasters, and in terms of strength, naturally those in the Innate Realm are stronger.
"For martial artists who enter the Innate Realm with an iron bone foundation, the strength gap with the Inner Realm Grandmasters will be a bit smaller, generally between 30 to 50 percent stronger than Inner Realm Grandmasters.
"As for those with copper bones, gold bones, jade bones… they would be much stronger."
Of course, Inner Realm Grandmasters also vary in strength.
But overall, martial artists of the Innate Realm are still a notch stronger.
The stronger the foundation of the Innate Realm, the greater the gap in strength between the two.
"In the Inner Domain, the Great Grandmaster is already at the pinnacle, but is there something even stronger beyond the Great Grandmaster?"
Xue Wuxin is a martial artist at the Grandmaster realm and a strong figure within the Inner Domain's demonic sects, so he should have a good understanding of the Inner Realm Martial Arts.
"Regardless of whether there are stronger martial artists above the Great Grandmaster, for the moment, they pose no threat to me, as Xu Yan is not far from reaching the completion of the Qi-Blood Realm.
"Once Xu Yan breaks through to the Innate Realm, my strength will be even greater.
"It's about time to come up with the realms beyond the Innate Realm, the rank is provisionally set, and once Xu Yan breaks through the Innate, I'll pass on the cultivation techniques above the Innate Realm to him."
Li Xuan pondered in his heart, the Martial Dao Realm of the Inner Domain posed little threat to him.
After Meng Chong entered the realm of Martial Arts, the feedback from the Golden Finger would also strengthen him further.
"Master, the Heavenly Earth Lingji in the Border Wilderness has been depleted, making it impossible to cultivate martial artists here, what can be done about this?"
Since there was already an answer to the differences in Martial Arts,
The problem of not being able to cultivate martial artists in the Border Wilderness was now laid out before them.
Must one go to the Inner Domain to cultivate?
Although he was eager to make his way in the Inner Domain, the time had not yet come; his parents and family were too weak to suppress the Border Wilderness.
"You are already a martial artist!"
Li Xuan said with a smile.
Xu Yan was startled, then smacked his forehead, saying, "Right, I am already a martial artist, but why did Xue Wuxin say that in the Border Wilderness, with the Heavenly Earth Lingji depleted, martial artists can't emerge?"
He had already entered the path of Martial Arts and was a martial artist of the Qi-Blood Realm. The subsequent cultivation involved nature's spiritual energy, as one must assimilate nature's spiritual energy to break through to the Innate Realm.
"Master, according to Xue Wuxin, with the Heavenly Earth Lingji depleted and unable to take in spiritual energy, does that mean I can't break through to the Innate Realm in the Border Wilderness?"
Xu Yan wore a look of concern.
"That's Xue Wuxin's statement, that's their way of cultivation, the Martial Arts you cultivate are not the Inner Realm Martial Arts."
Li Xuan looked at Xu Yan, who was somewhat worried, and couldn't help but chuckle.
"What does it matter if there is no Heavenly Earth Lingji? By using oneself as a bridge and connecting heaven and earth, who needs the support of the Heavenly Earth Lingji?"
Hearing this, Xu Yan's eyes lit up as he suddenly understood, saying, "I see, so that's how it is!"
Heaven-Earth Bridge!
Why does one need to connect the Heaven-Earth Bridge to break through to the Innate Realm? It's indeed about using oneself as a bridge to communicate with heaven and earth and to breathe in and out nature's spiritual energy!
That is the true Martial Arts.
There's no need to rely on the external Heavenly Earth Lingji to cultivate!
Therefore, what the martial artists of the Inner Domain practice must surely be a false path of Martial Arts!
"Glad you understand!"
Li Xuan nodded his head.
Looking up towards the endless mountains, what kind of world was the Inner Domain?
The Inner Domain should make it easier to find exceptional disciples, right?
Li Xuan thought to himself.
Xue Wuxin had fled to the Border Wilderness; it wouldn't be long before the Inner Domain would discover his whereabouts, and perhaps someone would come to the Border Wilderness to hunt him down.
Although the Border Wilderness was special, which was why Xue Wuxin had fled here, he could rely on devouring essence blood for his cultivation. Other martial artists coming to the Border Wilderness would recover very slowly once they exhausted their strength.
For other martial artists, they would not rashly come here to hunt him down.
However, Li Xuan believed that inevitably someone would come in pursuit.
Therefore, he said, "Xue Wuxin has come from the Inner Domain, so surely other martial artists will come here too."
Xu Yan and Meng Chong were both startled.
"I want to enter the realm of Martial Arts within a month!"
Meng Chong said firmly as he clenched his fists.
The frustration of nearly being killed by Xue Wuxin, he didn't want to experience that again!
Meng Chong went off to cultivate.
He had already broken through the copper bone bottleneck and could now temper his golden bones, and after golden bones, there was still the Diamond Glazed Bones to achieve.
Xu Yan looked at his master with a resolute gaze, saying, "Master, I would like to learn swordsmanship!"
The Descending Dragon Palm was indeed powerful, but he felt it was not enough!
Xue Wuxin's swordsmanship was actually very strong, and at the beginning of their battle, it posed quite the threat to him.
If he knew swordsmanship, how could he have been at a disadvantage?
Li Xuan was not surprised by this, as from the first time he saw Xu Yan, he had a sword hanging at his waist.
Even after practicing martial arts and learning the Descending Dragon Palm, he often still wore a sword on his waist.
This showed that he liked the sword!
And from the Emperor Qi's treasury, he had found a Precious Sword. It was just because of the rush to the Capital City that he hadn't brought it with him.
Li Xuan had been prepared all along.
He had long had a plan for how his two disciples should cultivate and which martial skills and cultivation techniques to impart to them.
Xu Yan would practice both Palm and Sword, unmatched in hand and blade!
And Meng Chong, Knife and Fist, unparalleled with both!
As for the other martial skills and cultivation techniques, it would be up to the disciples themselves to comprehend during their cultivation.
He provided his disciples with a framework to fill in as they wished.
Eventually, when the time came for the disciples to venture into the Inner Domain, they could absorb the essence of the Inner Domain Martial Arts and fit it into this framework, and then it would become their own.

chapters.title: Chapter 81 - 75 Real Martial Arts and Fake Martial Arts? (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_3
chapters.content:
Moreover, having obtained the Inner Realm Martial Arts cultivation techniques, he now had a reference, which made it much easier to develop subsequent techniques; he wouldn't be completely directionless.
But one thing he must take seriously was that any realm techniques he developed from now on must be stronger than those of the Inner Realm Martial Arts, no matter what!
Only by doing so could he firmly establish that what he was teaching was the true essence of Martial Arts!
"If my Martial Arts were to spread, ssshhh!"
Li Xuan suddenly felt alarmed. If it spread, it would inevitably eliminate the existing Inner Realm Martial Arts.
This would trigger a contest of doctrines!
"I must not rush this, I need to be cautious. At least until my disciples grow stronger," he thought.
Li Xuan felt that he needed to play a steady hand.
Rushing into a dispute over authenticity with a storm this big was something his current strength could not withstand.
Besides, his goal was to create cultivation techniques, to gather exceptional disciples, to grow stronger himself, to become invincible.
He could not afford to get embroiled in conflicts that might hinder his progress.
"I can start from the Border Wilderness!"
A plan began to form in Li Xuan's mind.
He would begin promoting his Martial Arts in the Border Wilderness. Once the strength of the region improved, people from the Border Wilderness venturing into the Inner Domain would gradually spread his Martial Arts.
Even if this triggered a dispute over authenticity, he could stay in the background, observing the situation unfold.
The Martial Artists of the Border Wilderness would naturally defend their own version of Martial Arts.
Of course, this was just a rough idea. Whether to implement it, how to implement it, and whether it could be implemented were all uncertainties.
What mattered now was to strengthen himself and to ensure his disciples grew stronger as quickly as possible.
Only when his disciples were strong and successfully cultivated the techniques he developed would he reap greater benefits.
Glancing at Xu Yan, who looked full of anticipation, Li Xuan nodded and said, "Yes, you may. Digest your gains from the fierce battle with Xue Wuxin today and come find me tomorrow."
"Yes, Master!"
Xu Yan nodded excitedly.
"Master, I will return to Donghe County for a moment!"
The Precious Sword was at his home in Donghe County; he had not brought it with him.
"Hmm!"
Li Xuan nodded.
Xu Yan hurried away.
Watching Meng Chong who was immersed in harsh training, Li Xuan spoke to Shi'er, who had just returned and was unaware of recent events, "Just prepare Meng Chong's meal."
"Yes, my lord!"
Shi'er responded respectfully.
Li Xuan rose from his chair, with Xue Wuxin's long knife in one hand and the bag left behind from Xue Wuxin's person in the other, and entered the room.
This bag was something he had intentionally kept.
Upon entering the room, he placed the long knife to one side. This knife was no ordinary steel weapon; it was a precious blade capable of channeling True Qi.
He opened the bag, which contained a small booklet that exuded a blood-red color, clearly no item of righteous origin.
"The cultivation technique practiced by Xue Wuxin!"
Li Xuan's heart leapt with joy; there indeed was a find.
He took out the small booklet.
Inside the bag, there were also two lustrous white Spirit Crystals, which Li Xuan picked up, sensing the Spiritual Energy contained within them.
"These must be the Spirit Stones or Spirit Crystals of the Inner Domain!"
With the presence of the Heavenly Earth Lingji in the Inner Domain and its gentle Spiritual Energy, it was only natural for there to be stones imbued with Spiritual Energy.
And such stones imbued with Spiritual Energy were none other than Spirit Stones or Spirit Crystals.
However, clearly, these were extremely rare items. Xue Wuxin, being a Grandmaster realm Martial Artist himself, only had two Spirit Crystals on him.
He relied on his vital essence for healing, not Spirit Crystals, so there was no issue of using up Spirit Crystals for healing.
Ultimately, it was because Spirit Crystals were so rare that even a Grandmaster like him didn't have many.

chapters.title: Chapter 82 - 76: As a Teacher, I Only Impart Principles, Not Techniques (Seeking Subscriptions)_1
chapters.content:
```
The bag only contained a small booklet and two Spirit Crystals, and nothing else.
Li Xuan's face was filled with disappointment.
Xue Wuxin was a pauper indeed.
He couldn't help but curse inwardly, "You're a demon cultivator, aren't you? Isn't it normal for you to kill people and seize their treasures? You're fleeing to the Border Wilderness, so why didn't you gather some treasures to use here?
"You're truly useless, scattering your ashes, wouldn't be unjust in the least!"
He looked at the bag again, finding it to be just an ordinary one, not something like a storage bag.
He casually tossed it aside.
"I wonder if there are such things as storage bags in the Inner Realm."
He sighed inwardly; should he find a disciple with a talent for Artifact Refining and craft a set of methods for them, letting them comprehend them and refine items such as storage bags?
"I'm not skilled in Artifact Refining either; creating from scratch would be rather difficult. It seems I'll need to head to the Inner Realm to find some Artifact Refining techniques to reference for perfection.
"Only in the Inner Realm could such a prodigy in Artifact Refining possibly exist, right?"
Li Xuan pondered to himself.
Nonetheless, refining artifacts ultimately does not strengthen oneself, so it wasn't urgent. He decided to wait until he might find such a prodigy later on.
He stored the Spirit Crystals away.
He then turned his attention to the blood-red booklet.
As he flipped it open, four characters caught his eye.
"Blood Demon Scripture!"
At a glance, it was clearly a demonic cultivation technique.
However, Li Xuan was unconcerned; he wasn't planning to cultivate these techniques but to reference them in order to understand the Martial Arts of the Inner Realm.
"Is this actually an incomplete scripture?"
Li Xuan was surprised.
The Blood Demon Scripture was incomplete, with parts missing, leaving only fragments.
And yet, even as fragments, they had allowed Xue Wuxin to cultivate to the Grandmaster realm, and even advance towards the Great Grandmaster realm.
Thus, could the complete Blood Demon Scripture allow for cultivation beyond the Great Grandmaster?
Li Xuan flipped through the Blood Demon Scripture, which indeed was a demonic cultivation technique, primarily focused on devouring and refining essence blood to strengthen oneself.
The purer and more vigorous the essence blood, the greater the enhancement obtained.
This also explained why Xue Wuxin had targeted Meng Chong.
The scripture also recorded a special secret technique, the Blood-Eating Ghost Threads, used to devour essence blood.
"There are some tricks to it."
Li Xuan marveled at what he read; the Blood Demon Scripture gave him some inspiration.
For instance, the technique of devouring essence blood and the Blood-Eating Ghost Threads.
Naturally, he would not create a technique that devours essence blood, but he could reference it to design more exquisite and righteous cultivation techniques.
"A new Martial Arts system is almost taking shape."
After going through the Blood Demon Scripture, Li Xuan had some ideas.
Beyond the Physical Body Martial Path, there was now a new system of Martial Arts cultivation, although still imperfect and just a concept at the moment.
Besides, he needed to find the right person for enlightenment.
"The Blood Demon Scripture, in the Inner Realm, is considered a powerful demonic cultivation technique. Xue Wuxin was not weak among the Grandmasters... However, the Blood Demon Scripture, being a yin and sinister technique, is indeed vulnerable to Qi-blood suppression."
The Qi-Blood Realm burns fiercely like fire, perfectly countering the yin and sinister nature of the Blood Demon Scripture.
If at the same level of cultivation, a Martial Artist practicing the Blood Demon Scripture would be suppressed at every turn.
"However, Qi-blood also holds a great temptation for them."
Why did Xue Wuxin crave Meng Chong's essence blood?
Why did he desire Xu Yan's essence blood? It was precisely because of this.
The essence blood of Martial Artists in the Qi-Blood Realm is more vigorous and pure than those in the Inner Realm, making it like a great elixir for those who cultivate the Blood Demon Scripture!
Having looked over the Blood Demon Scripture, Li Xuan remembered its contents down to the last word.
With a thought, the Blood Demon Scripture turned to dust and disappeared.
This demonic cultivation technique certainly couldn't be left behind; what if he became careless one day, or forgot about it after leaving, and someone else picked it up? That could potentially give rise to a new demon cultivator.
Although the Border Wilderness couldn't produce Martial Artists, by devouring essence blood with the Blood Demon Scripture, strength could still be increased.
Of course, due to the diminished Heavenly Earth Lingji, one couldn't break through limits in the Border Wilderness, but it would still be possible to reach the power level of fifth or sixth grade Martial Artists from the Inner Realm.
Such an outcome would certainly not be beneficial for the Border Wilderness.
Having memorized the technique, it was certainly more reassuring to destroy it.
...
In the hills outside Yunshan County City.
Li Xuan stood with one hand behind his back, gazing into the distant sky.
Xu Yan stood respectfully behind him with a Precious Sword in hand.
"Disciple, remember, I only impart the Dao, not techniques, so what I'm passing on is the Sword Dao, not Swordsmanship..."
Li Xuan plucked a twig from a tree and said solemnly, "As I've repeatedly stressed, cultivation is about enlightenment, about comprehending the true meaning. The same goes for Sword Dao. Watch closely now."
"Yes, Master!"
Xu Yan was excited.
Li Xuan pointed out with the twig in his hand, and *whoosh*, a burst of True Qi shot out, creating a hole in a large tree.
Xu Yan's eyes widened with shock: "Master's Sword Dao... no, his Swordsmanship is indeed powerful, holding a mere twig and making such a powerful strike, far stronger than Xue Wuxin's blade energy."
After testing the feel of the twig, Li Xuan began to swing it around, with Innate True Qi enhancing the twig, making it appear extraordinarily sharp, though he was just making random movements.
It was only because of his incredibly powerful Innate True Qi that it seemed so forceful.
Of course, his random motions weren't entirely without form; there were standard sword moves like slashing, stabbing, flicking, cutting across, and wiping that he performed convincingly.
After a series of movements, Li Xuan put the twig away and asked with a deep voice, "Disciple, have you memorized everything?"
```

chapters.title: Chapter 83 - 76: The Master Teaches the Way But Not the Methods (Subscription Requested) _2
chapters.content:
Xu Yan nodded excitedly, saying, "Master, I've memorized everything!"
Everything?
That's not right!
Li Xuan raised the tree branch once again, his voice grave, "Disciple, look again and remember. What I am imparting is Sword Dao, not swordsmanship. Grasp its true meaning!"
Saying this, his hand began to shape the tree branch again, but this time much slower. This time, he was shaping it according to the style of Tai Chi sword from his past life.
The difference was that he augmented it with Innate True Qi.
It seemed slow in motion, yet seemed to form a current of Sword Qi, revolving around him. With his rotation, it carried quite a shocking momentum.
Xu Yan stared unblinkingly, but he was a little puzzled. Why so slow?
How could such slowness attack the enemy?
After Li Xuan finished shaping the branch, he asked again, "Disciple, have you memorized it?"
"Master, I have memorized it all!"
"And the previous one?"
"Also remembered."
This disciple really has a good memory, memorizing everything in one go.
"Disciple, look again!"
Li Xuan once again swung the branch.
This time, the branch moved extremely quickly, swiftly waving and then retracting.
"Remembered?"
Xu Yan was somewhat bewildered at this moment.
Why is the sword movement different every time?
"Remem...Remembered."
Xu Yan nodded.
"And the previous one?"
"Remem..Remembered about ninety percent!"
Xu Yan was taken aback.
He had completely memorized the unwieldy sword moves from earlier.
But the first sword sequence, he only remembered ninety percent. He had actually forgotten a few moves!
"Why did I forget?"
Xu Yan was deeply vexed.
However, Li Xuan was delighted, "Good, disciple, look again!"
And with that, he was off to illustrate once again!
Xu Yan was already confused in his mind, "I forgot, I didn't memorize everything, and yet Master said 'good'?"
"Disciple, have you memorized?"
Li Xuan asked after storing the branch.
"I...I didn't remember them all!"
Xu Yan confessed, looking shamefaced. He had been distracted and failed to remember the sword moves Master demonstrated earlier.
"Good! Good! Disciple, you've taken a step further in comprehending the Sword Dao!"
Li Xuan said with satisfaction.
What?
Xu Yan was at a loss. He couldn't remember the sword moves, how could he have gotten closer to understanding the Sword Dao?
"That's not right!"
"I must not have understood the profound meaning of Master's words."
Lost in thought, Xu Yan was applying his impressive reasoning skills.
"Master repeatedly emphasized that he is only imparting the Dao, not the method. He is teaching me Sword Dao, not swordsmanship…"
"He wants me to grasp its true meaning, understand the Dao, not memorize the swordsmanship. Therefore, what I need to do is not to remember the sword moves."
"But to forget the sword moves!"
"Not to be bound by the sword moves, not to remain fixed within the form, to blend everything together and follow my heart…"
In that instant, Xu Yan felt he had understood the profound meaning of Master's words.
In his mind, he began to recall the sword moves Master had just demonstrated—fast, slow, fierce, tricky…
Gradually, the former and latter sword moves overlapped in his mind, blending together. Slowly, it seemed as though a new set of swordsmanship was forming in his mind.
"I need to learn to forget!"
Xu Yan admonished himself internally.
"Master, I've already forgotten half of it!"
Xu Yan spoke up.
"Good! Good!"
Li Xuan was overjoyed. This disciple had entered a state of enlightenment, a good sign indeed!
It indicated he had taken a solid step towards grasping Sword Dao.
Xu Yan truly had a talent for Sword Dao, and a monstrously exceptional one at that.
"Disciple, continue to observe!"
Li Xuan started demonstrating again.
What he was showing this time was naturally different from the previous ones.
In fact, every move he demonstrated was well thought out. The first time, he demonstrated a rough swordsmanship, then came Tai Chi sword, moving slow yet stepping on the rhythm of Tai Chi.
The third time was swift, the fourth time was tricky, and this fifth time was completely messy.
He had presented everything from slow to swift, from regular to tricky, and naturally it was up to Xu Yan to comprehend it all.
"Master, I've forgotten half of it!"
Xu Yan spoke up after watching.
"Good, watch again!"
Li Xuan continued his demonstration.
He performed several times in succession, Xu Yan watched with a mix of confusion, contemplation, and realization...
In his mind, all the sword moves were shuffled once again, overlapping and blending together, reshuffling and repeating.
A set of swordsmanship seemed to emerge in his mind.
Li Xuan stood by, watching his disciple gain insights.
The time was almost right.
The devised Sword Dao realm should be explained to his disciple, so he could better comprehend the Sword Dao from it.
If successful, this would be another great accomplishment.
Xu Yan opened his eyes, slightly bewildered.
He felt as if he was in chaos.
A jumbled mess of sword moves swirled in his mind, unable to find a direction.
The incomplete swordsmanship made him feel like, he might be on the wrong path.
The sword techniques passed down from his master had been forgotten, he could not remember how the original sword techniques were performed.
"Master, I've forgotten everything!"
Li Xuan spoke with satisfaction, "Good, very good my boy, you're not far from grasping the Sword Dao!"
A jolt of inspiration.
Sure enough, upon hearing this, Xu Yan's spirits revived and his eyes lit up.
"My boy, what I have taught you is the Sword Dao. There are countless martial artists in the world, but only a few can comprehend the Sword Dao. To understand Sword Dao, you first need to get rid of the limitation of mere sword moves."
"Don't let swordsmanship or sword moves shackle you."
Li Xuan turned his body sideways, gazing upwards. With an enhanced aura of enigma, he looked even more like a profound master.
Xu Yan's body trembled slightly, and he respectfully said, "Master, please enlighten me!"
"To be able to forget the sword techniques and moves I demonstrated, it shows you have the potential for Sword Dao, not allowing yourself to be contained by mere sword techniques and sword moves."
"But that's far from enough!
"If you want to comprehend the Sword Dao, only those with a clear understanding of what is Sword Heart, can step into the realm of Sword Dao."
Li Xuan said in a deep voice.
"Sword Heart?"
Xu Yan was taken aback and respectfully asked, "Master, what is Sword Heart?"
