"Sword Heart is the foundation of Sword Dao. Those who have achieved Sword Heart can transcend the restrictions of the techniques and moves to have a clear heart of Sword Dao.
"Sword Heart means a clear heart of Sword Dao. Once you can see through any sword techniques, and sword movements just at a glance, seeing their strengths and weaknesses."
"At a glance, you should be able to freely make use of the sword techniques, and moves, making them your own."
Li Xuan explained his tailored strategy of cultivation based on Sword Dao, 'Sword Heart's Clarity' to Xu Yan.
Xu Yan was deeply moved, "Sword Heart's Clarity. A clear heart of Sword Dao. Understand at a glance, the weaknesses and strengths of a move. Select any move at will, and apply it freely to my advantage."
In his mind, he visualized the sword techniques that his master had demonstrated.
Gradually, he saw himself, extracting moves from his master's techniques, overlapping, integrating, interconnecting, and yet not really forming a complete set of swordsmanship.
If he could master the techniques, combine them perfectly, and form a set of swordsmanship that would be his, drawing upon any move whenever he wanted,
Would that be achieving Sword Heart's Clarity?
He seemed to have a bit of understanding, and said, "Master, Sword Heart's Clarity means that even though I don't have any sword skills or moves, the sword techniques of others are mine; other people's sword moves are my sword moves.
"My adversaries' swordsmanship is transparent in my eyes. I can easily see through their weaknesses, and anticipate the moves they will make...."
Li Xuan was overjoyed. Xu Yan was not far from understanding Sword Heart's Clarity. The Sword Dao realm he had devised was finally taking shape.
"In layman's terms, it's like that. Being able to do this means you have entered the basics of Sword Heart's Clarity."
Li Xuan nodded with a relieved tone.
"Master, I understand some of it, but I don't quite understand...."
Xu Yan was sinking into deep thought.
"My boy, Sword Heart's Clarity is something that can only be comprehended. Once you get it, you have entered the basics. If you don't get it, that's all there is."
Li Xuan said solemnly.
He had never achieved Sword Heart's Clarity, it was just something he made up. How to master it, what the method is, how would he know?
His disciple must rely on his own exceptional ability to fill gaps and his exceptional understanding to comprehend on his own.
"My boy, first you need to clear your Sword Heart. Only when your Sword Heart is clear can you achieve Clarity and not be confined by sword techniques and moves.
"You should ponder on this. I believe you can comprehend it."
After saying this, Li Xuan left the forest, leaving Xu Yan alone to deepen his understanding.

chapters.title: Chapter 84 - 77 Xu Yan Comprehends the Sword Dao, the Sword Heart is Clear_1
chapters.content:
In the mountain forest, Xu Yan was left alone.
He stood amidst the trees, his gaze sweeping the surroundings, where streaks of sword marks crisscrossed, piercing through tree after tree, leaving behind one small hole after another.
Trees that were neatly severed lay on the ground, each chopped into over a dozen pieces.
One could faintly discern the remnants of swordsmanship and techniques.
The more Xu Yan observed, the more he felt a sense of enlightenment, though it was nebulous, as a messy cluster of sword techniques—all previously demonstrated by his master—surfaced in his mind.
But he had forgotten them.
No!
Not forgotten, rather, he had lost the sequence of the moves, forgetting which stroke corresponded to which execution.
The chaotic sword techniques in his mind were verified against the traces around him, and suddenly, a particular technique overlapped with a sword mark on the ground.
"This sword mark was made by this technique," Xu Yan murmured to himself.
"For a sword heart to be crystal clear, first and foremost it must be unobstructed, unconfined by techniques and forms, and then comes transparency..."
Xu Yan felt he was grasping something.
But the state of a crystal-clear sword heart was still too far out of reach.
At this moment, he felt as if he was back in the small village, just beginning his martial arts training, understanding little yet grasping some insights.
"To forget the techniques and forms, not to be restricted by appearances... The first thing to do is to have a clear sword heart, and for this first step, I should completely forget the swordsmanship my master performed.
"No! To forget doesn't really mean to wipe away the memory, it means to shed the form, to break free from the framework of swordsmanship...
"Next, what I need to do is to straighten out the traces of sword techniques, to replicate each and every one of them, and then forget the framework, to freely select sword moves and forms, to ultimately create my own swordsmanship.
"This is the first step. Once I complete this step, I should be not far from achieving a crystal-clear sword heart!"
Xu Yan felt a spark of inspiration, understanding how to comprehend and step into the realm of a crystal-clear sword heart.
He jumped onto a large tree and sat on a horizontal branch, quietly overlapping the sword marks below with the techniques in his mind, mutually verifying them.
"This sword mark has covered the previous one, and the previous mark is almost invisible now, how should I verify it...
"Why am I being caught up in the sword techniques again?
"Though that mark has been covered, its essence still exists... It must be this technique."
It wasn't until darkness fell that Xu Yan returned to Cloud Mountain County.
However, his mind was full of sword techniques and forms.
Li Xuan observed his disciple returning and watched him in silence, letting the disciple comprehend on his own.
Saying too much could create interference.
He was reminded of the time when Xu Yan had practiced in the small village; now, it was simply the process of re-experiencing the past realizations.
Li Xuan believed that Xu Yan could perceive it on his own.
The Sword Dao he had developed was much more refined than the previous haphazard creation, and he had even personally demonstrated the sword moves for Xu Yan.
"A crystal-clear sword heart is the foundation for cultivating the Sword Dao. The starting point of my Sword Dao has raised the bar for talent required.
"Once someone steps into the Sword Dao, its power will naturally be stronger.
"It's a framework, into which any sword moves and forms can be fitted. When Xu Yan goes to the Inner Domain, no matter what swordsmanship he learns, once fit into this framework, it will become his own.
"Moreover, it could outshine the original and form a new swordsmanship."
Li Xuan pondered silently.
He transmitted the Sword Dao to Xu Yan, while for Meng Chong, a muscular man, his talent was not in the Sword Dao.
But in the Saber Dao!
He should also finish developing the related Saber Dao to transmit to Meng Chong.
"Xu Yan remembered my swordsmanship after just one view, indicating an extremely strong memory, which is also a foundation for achieving a crystal-clear sword heart. With this foundation, his comprehension should be much easier."
Li Xuan also marveled internally at Xu Yan's impressive memory.
Remembering after just one view.
And the speed of his demonstration was not slow.
In the following days, Xu Yan immersed himself in comprehending the Sword Dao, striving for the crystal-clear sword heart.
He would rise early to seek understanding in the mountain forest.
And didn't return until nightfall.
Meng Chong, spurred by Xue Wuxin's provocation, trained even more diligently, accelerating his progress in refining his golden bones.
Shi'er had also begun the Skin Refinement process, and was making fair progress.
Qi Country remained without turmoil.
In the Capital City, Qi King Guo Rongshan was still the foremost among the court officials.
The Third Prince paid daily visits to show his respect.
The eldest prince had already gone out to seek masters.
The other high-ranking officials' children were also immersed in the craze of seeking masters.
Although the Minister of War's son and others had turned into mummies, and no one knew why—Xu Yan didn't provide an answer, and no one dared to inquire further.
They speculated that they might have encountered unknown monsters, leading to their deaths.
Thus, those who ventured into the Endless Mountains proceeded with utmost caution, not daring to delve too deep.
With countless peaks in the Endless Mountains, a thorough search would take an indeterminate amount of time, as teams navigated through the mountain ranges.
But they tacitly avoided the direction the Minister of War's son and his group had explored.
It was too dangerous there.
A month had passed.
Meng Chong's golden bones were nearly perfected, soon to encounter the bottleneck where he could no longer refine them further.
Shi'er had completed Skin Refinement.
Having taken such a long time to complete Skin Refinement despite his prowess as a top martial artist in the jianghu, his talent ultimately fell far short of Xu Yan and Meng Chong's.
Furthermore, Li Xuan found that after Shi'er completed Skin Refinement, the strength of his skin and vigor were not on par with Xu Yan and Meng Chong.

chapters.title: Chapter 85 - 77 Xu Yan Comprehends the Sword Dao, A Clear Sword Heart_2
chapters.content:
```
Similarly completing Skin Refinement, however, the strength of the skin membrane had considerable differences.
"Skin Refinement is also graded, it's not the same for everyone who completes it,"
This was due to the disparity in martial arts talent.
After completing Skin Refinement, Shi'er's strength had increased.
Li Xuan then taught him the Bone Refinement technique.
According to what Xu Yan said, his father had already begun Bone Refinement, and his mother had just completed Skin Refinement, which also showed him the disparity in martial arts talent, and that the results of cultivation would vary.
Pharmacist Pan had also entered the Bone Refinement stage.
As for the rest of his trusted guards, a small part had entered Bone Refinement, and some had completed Skin Refinement.
This was still thanks to Pharmacist Pan, who had concocted nourishing medicinal substances to aid in their cultivation.
Guo Rongshan, due to his age and the decline of his vitality and qi-blood, had missed the optimal phase for cultivation. By relying on precious medicines, he barely entered the phase of Skin Refinement.
Guo Yunkai was more talented, having already completed Skin Refinement and was about to start Bone Refinement.
His two cousins, one had completed Skin Refinement, and the other had started Bone Refinement.
"Still a long way from entering the threshold of martial arts; in the short term, it's not possible to verify and receive any feedback."
Li Xuan reflected inwardly.
Among these people, some would likely get stuck at the entrance to the martial arts.
He had noticed that the medicines Pharmacist Pan concocted to nourish qi-blood and assist in cultivation were quite effective.
"Should I get some pills out? But how to formulate them? I don't understand that,"
Li Xuan fell into deep thought.
"The young lady taught by Heavenly Mother, skilled in medicine, perhaps it would be possible to start from her, to try and perceive something?"
Li Xuan was then reminded of the current Heavenly Mother of Heavenly Mother's Sect, that young lady.
The wrongdoers she persuaded ended up never committing evil again—truly, a great skill.
Last time, he made Shi'er pass on a message, asking the Heavenly Mother's young lady to come over, but she was still in Wu Country, not yet in Qi Country.
"No rush, Meng Chong hasn't started yet. As for the third disciple, I'll evaluate him further."
Li Xuan temporarily put the matter aside.
Xu Yan went out yesterday and didn't come back at night; it seemed he had made some progress and was likely about to comprehend the Sword Heart's Clarity!
He was full of anticipation.
Outside the Yunshan county city, on a hillside.
Xu Yan sat cross-legged, quietly watching the sunset on the horizon.
He hadn't been looking at the sword marks in the mountains anymore; instead, he had destroyed them all.
At this moment, as he watched the sunset, his mind was clear, and the sword techniques in his brain were continuously evolving.
The sword technique taught by his master he had long forgotten.
Now, in his mind, a new set of sword techniques was about to take shape.
His state of mind was becoming increasingly clear, as if he had understood all sword techniques and moves.
At a certain moment, it was as if a flash of inspiration struck his mind.
The evolving sword technique had come into being!
And at this moment, he entered a mysterious state.
A heart, clear and bright.
Hum!
The precious sword laying across his knees trembled at this moment.
As if it wanted to leave its sheath.
Sword Heart's Clarity!
Xu Yan had comprehended the Sword Heart's Clarity!
At the moment he comprehended the Sword Heart's Clarity, the door to Sword Dao had opened.
In his heart, there was now a sword technique, traces of the Sword Dao.
He had already escaped the shackles of swordsmanship.
Even the Descending Dragon Palm had gained a new understanding and improved.
Descending Dragon Palm, the second level reached minor completion!
Xu Yan opened his eyes, his finger lightly touched the precious sword across his knees, and with a clang, the sword leapt from its sheath.
With one grasp and a lift of his hand, he struck out with his sword.
The sword light was like a long rainbow, sweeping across the sky, striking hundreds of feet away.
When the sword light touched the ground, there was silence.
If one looked closely, on the ground there would be a thin crack, extending dozens of feet long, its depth unknown!
"Today, I, Xu Yan, have comprehended the Sword Heart's Clarity and finally entered the threshold of Sword Dao. This shall be called Clarity Sword!"
Xu Yan, with two fingers pressed against the blade, said.
Clarity Sword!
This was his first sword, as well as the one that witnessed him stepping through the door of Sword Dao!
"Now that I've comprehended the Sword Heart's Clarity and entered the door of Sword Dao, next is to achieve perfection in qi-blood and break through to the Innate Realm!"
Xu Yan had a look of excitement on his face.
If he had comprehended the Sword Heart's Clarity and stepped into the Sword Dao from the beginning, how could Xue Wuxin have been his opponent?
"Inner Region!"
Xu Yan looked in the direction of the boundless mountains.
```
His heart surged with excitement. The Inner Region had Martial Artists, and the Inner Realm Martial Arts; he'd long yearned for it.
He'd wanted to venture into the Martial Dao Realm for quite some time now.
"Just wait a bit longer, after reaching the Innate Realm, I'll head to the Inner Region!"
His parents' strength hadn't risen yet, and he hadn't broken through to the Innate Realm.
Therefore, he could only suppress the excitement in his heart.
In the small courtyard.
Li Xuan, as always, sat on a chair, organizing the Martial Arts he had created in his mind.
Especially the subsequent Martial Dao Techniques, how to construct them, how to perfect them.
He'd already determined the realms that came after the Innate Realm.
The direction of cultivation had been set, but he also needed an outline for the future realms and directions of Martial Arts.
"My Martial Arts, from the start, is stronger than the Martial Arts of this world, so the subsequent realms of Martial Arts must also become increasingly strong.
"The transition between realms must be well connected. If there are gaps, and the theoretical connection is missing, it will definitely be impossible to comprehend," he said.
After days of continuous reflection and pondering, Li Xuan had basically sorted out the subsequent directions for martial cultivation.
Still, it had to be done step by step.
Only when successful cultivation had been achieved could he be sure it was feasible, and he could continue to perfect the next realm.
"Meng Chong's Golden Bone has reached perfection, but he's stuck at perfect Golden Bone, unable to refine the Diamond Vajra Bones. It's time to try and help my second disciple successfully refine the Diamond Vajra Bones."
Li Xuan glanced at Meng Chong, who was still doggedly practicing.
Once the Diamond Vajra Bones were formed, he could break through to the Qi-Blood Realm.
After all, his cultivation involved simultaneously refining the Skin, Bones, and Viscera.
Suddenly, golden light emerged.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has realized the essence of the Sword Heart, entering the gateway of Sword Dao. Your comprehension of the Sword Heart has been fully actualized, and you've achieved great mastery in Sword Dao!"
In that instant, Li Xuan felt his Sword Heart become crystalline clear, transparent to myriad swords, and his understanding of Sword Dao also kept emerging.
Sword Dao mastery was only the foundation of Sword Dao!
Li Xuan was overjoyed.
"My disciple has the makings of a Sword God; I was not mistaken in him!" he thought proudly.
Well done, Xu Yan. You've indeed realized the essence of the Sword Heart and entered the gateway of Sword Dao.
His future advancement in Sword Dao would depend on himself.
However, Li Xuan believed that once Xu Yan went to the Inner Region, there would be no worries about advancing in Sword Dao.
And as the disciple's Sword Dao advanced, his own Sword Dao would improve even more!
"Now that Sword Heart transparency has been achieved, I should pass on the subsequent Sword Dao concepts to Xu Yan, striving for him to comprehend Sword Intent as soon as possible," Li Xuan thought contentedly.
"Your disciple Xu Yan, Descending Dragon Palm second layer has reached minor accomplishment, and you have perfected the second layer of Descending Dragon Palm!"
Another gain.
The second layer of Descending Dragon Palm had been perfected.
As Xu Yan realized the essence of Sword Heart, his comprehension of Descending Dragon Palm also advanced.
This was within expectations.
This indicated that Xu Yan's talent and insight had improved with the realization of Sword Heart.
Li Xuan lifted a finger, and a streak of Sword Qi emerged.
With a flick, the Sword Qi soared into the sky, silent and unnoticeable, with no trace of its sharp edge.
In the air, a streak of Sword Qi crisscrossed.
"The Sword Dao I've created is truly powerful."
Li Xuan was excited.
"It must be much stronger than the sword techniques of the Inner Region, right?"
The strength of Sword Dao in the Inner Realm Martial Dao Realm, for the time being, remained unknown.
However, it could be roughly inferred that it was still in a stage of powerful sword techniques, yet to touch the level of Sword Dao, naturally incomparable to the Sword Dao he had created.
In the eyes of one who has realized Sword Heart transparency, the sword techniques of the Inner Region Martial Artists could be transparently read, their flaws discernible, their truth and falsity seen through, allowing their sword moves to be taken and used at will.
"With my current strength, even a Great Grandmaster could be slain with a single sword strike!"
Li Xuan flicked his finger, and the Sword Qi in the sky disappeared.
His strength had once again seen a huge increase, and not even a Great Grandmaster from the Inner Region would be his match.
With this, he was truly stable.
He needn't worry about the Inner Region Powerhouses posing a threat to him.
"Master, I'm back!"
Xu Yan came back excitedly.
"Good! Good! Good!"
Li Xuan was greatly relieved and said, "My disciple has the makings of a Sword God, you truly have not disappointed me!"
Email hearing this, Xu Yan felt a surge of energy, as if he had been transformed.
"Master says I have the makings of a Sword God!"
Patting his chest, he said, "Master, your disciple will definitely carry on your Sword Dao legacy and not disappoint you. I will certainly become a Sword God!"
"Good! With such ambition, as your master, I believe you can do it!"
Li Xuan was overjoyed. His disciple was destined to become a Sword God, and as for himself... he might as well start wearing the title 'The Ancestor of Sword Dao' ahead of time!

chapters.title: Chapter 86 - 78: Xu Yan's Breakthrough, Meng Chong's Introduction to Martial Arts_1
chapters.content:
Li Xuan rose to his feet, his expression solemn, and said, "Disciple, the understanding of Sword Intent is only the foundation of the Sword Dao. You still have a long road ahead of you. The path of the Sword Dao is endless and boundless, you must not be impatient!"
Xu Yan's expression became serious, he took a deep breath and respectfully said, "Yes, Master, the Disciple will surely focus my mind and remain calm, and steadfastly advance along the path of the Sword Dao!"
"Good!"
Li Xuan nodded with an expression of satisfaction, "Since you've gained clarity in your Sword Heart and entered the door of the Sword Dao, today I will point out the direction for you on the path of the Sword Dao."
Xu Yan listened intently, his heart surging with excitement.
"After clarity of the Sword Heart, the second realm of the Sword Dao is the Heart Sword Realm.
"When my heart contains a sword, all things in heaven and earth can be my sword.
"Upon encountering a mountain, that mountain is my sword, upon encountering rivers and lakes, they too are my swords... every blade of grass and tree is also my sword.
"Mountains have their own sword momentum, water has its own sword momentum... all things in heaven and earth are swords of my heart..."
The second landscape of the Sword Dao, is the Heart Sword Realm!
Listening to this, Xu Yan's heart pounded fiercely, everything in heaven and earth could become a sword?
Mountains could be my sword.
Rivers could be my sword!
It truly was too profound and mysterious, at this moment, he felt his own insignificance.
The Heart Sword Realm!
It was far too distant from himself.
What sort of Sword Dao landscape was it?
In his mind, he couldn't help but imagine lifting his hand and a mountain transforming into a sword, thundering forth to annihilate his enemies—a powerful scene.
"Disciple, to break through to the Heart Sword Realm, first you need to comprehend Sword Intent," said Li Xuan as he looked at Xu Yan, whose face was flushed with excitement and whose eyes were fervent and longing. Li Xuan spoke with a slight smile.
Sounds quite mystical, doesn't it?
Indeed, the more mystical it was, the more motivated Xu Yan became. He never doubted whether such profound and mysterious things were false or whether they could be achieved.
He would charge towards this goal with the fervor of someone who has been injected with a stimulant.
Truly an excellent disciple!
Li Xuan sighed, taking Xu Yan as a disciple was the most correct thing he had done in his two lifetimes.
"Yes, Master!"
Xu Yan nodded respectfully.
Sword Intent!
To comprehend Sword Intent!
"All things in heaven and earth can be used to comprehend Sword Intent, but you must remember, when it comes to the comprehension of realms, obsession is the greatest taboo. Being too obsessed can trap you in a cage, preventing you from truly understanding.
"And you mustn't blindly comprehend Sword Intent at the expense of your own cultivation.
"With your Sword Heart clear, comprehending Sword Intent is only a matter of time. Perhaps one day while practicing the Descending Dragon Palm, you'll suddenly understand it?
"Sword Intent is not only comprehended through practicing the Sword Dao," instructed Li Xuan earnestly.
You can't let the disciple neglect the practice of Descending Dragon Palm for the cultivation of the Sword Dao.
Mastery in both palm and sword, that is the proper path for Xu Yan.
"If you can grasp the essence of Descending Dragon Palm, you might also learn by analogy and grasp Sword Intent. Similarly, if you can understand Sword Intent, you should also be able to comprehend the essence of Descending Dragon Palm.
"How much you can comprehend is up to you, Disciple," mused Li Xuan, feeling that it might also be time for Xu Yan to try and sense the palm intent within Descending Dragon Palm.
If he truly comprehends it, his strength will surely soar.
"Master, I understand!"
Xu Yan said respectfully.
"Good, continue your practice," said Li Xuan as he sat back down.
The Sword Dao realms beyond the Heart Sword Realm would wait until Xu Yan had comprehended the Heart Sword Realm before being transmitted to him.
Otherwise, giving him too much at once could affect his comprehension, which would be a miscalculation.
One must still remain grounded and proceed step by step.
"Yes, Master!"
Xu Yan nodded.
Li Xuan glanced at Meng Chong and said, "Your junior brother has encountered a bottleneck. Spar with him to stimulate his blood and qi, and help him break through the bottleneck!"
Xu Yan was taken aback, then looked at Meng Chong and immediately understood.
When he had broken through his own bottleneck and successfully refined his bones into Jade Bone, it was with the help of the Fire Mane Wolf.
His junior brother was practicing the Physical Body Martial Path and was stuck at the perfect Gold Bone stage, unable to further refine into the Vajra Lucid Bone.
He needed external forces to temper his physical body, stimulate his blood and qi, and break through the bottleneck.
"Yes, Master!"
Xu Yan nodded.
Meng Chong was cultivating the Physical Body Martial Path, and the best way to break through the shackles was naturally through external tempering. It not only pressured him but would also stimulate his potential and push through the bottleneck.
The method was actually quite simple.
Of course, it also depended on one's talent. If the talent was inadequate, no amount of tempering or pressure would do anything but harm the person's foundation and not lead to a breakthrough.
Meng Chong's physical endowment was clearly high, so there was no risk of damaging his own foundations.
It would only stimulate his potential through tempering and pressure, breaking through the bottleneck to refine the Vajra Lucid Bone.
When Meng Chong had broken through the Copper Bone bottleneck, it was due to the stimulation of Xue Wuxin's chilly Inner Qi, which had triggered his potential and made his blood and qi boil, successfully breaking through in one fell swoop.
"Junior brother, come on, let's have a spar," Xu Yan called out to Meng Chong.
"Okay!"
Meng Chong nodded.
The two immediately left Yunshan County and went outside the city to spar.
Officially, it was a spar, but in reality, it was to temper Meng Chong's physique, to rouse his potential so that he could break through his bottleneck.
Outside Yunshan County, in the midst of the woods.
A rumbling sound broke out.
Xu Yan's blood and qi surged as he struck out palm after palm, his hot blood continuously hammering against Meng Chong's body.
As for Meng Chong, he ran the Great Sun Golden Bell Shield, his body like a golden bell, resounding with a humming sound under the assault of blood qi, his muscles shaking with each impact.
"Not enough, stronger!" urged Meng Chong as he flexed his muscles.
"Alright!"
Xu Yan's eyebrows shot up; his junior brother's body was truly formidable, rightly on the path of the Physical Body Martial Path.

chapters.title: Chapter 87 - 78: Xu Yan Breaks Through, Meng Chong Enters the World of Martial Arts_2
chapters.content:
Boom!
Once again, his blood and Qi increased, encompassing Meng Chong within.
After enduring for half a moment, Meng Chong finally couldn't keep up. He was huffing and puffing, his whole body's skin was burning red, his muscles were trembling, and his bones were making faint noises.
To temper the body, to spur potential, to break through the bottleneck; it's not something that can be done once or twice.
"Junior brother, let's end here today. We will continue tomorrow!"
Xu Yan ceased his actions.
"Alright, thank you, senior brother!"
Both of them returned to the courtyard. Li Xuan glanced at Meng Chong, quietly nodding.
Even though Meng Chong's bottleneck hadn't been broken, advancing to the tempering stage of Vajra Lucid Bone, there already had been some improvement. The bottleneck had loosened a bit.
In the following days, Meng Chong was tempering his body under Xu Yan's bombardment of Qi and blood. However, he was still just a little bit away from breaking through the bottleneck.
After thinking for a bit, Li Xuan believed that if they continued to temper like this, there was a chance to break through the bottleneck. However, it would take a significant amount of time.
Thus, following another session of tempering, Meng Chong's bottleneck had loosened slightly. However, he was still a bit away from a complete breakthrough and needed a little catalyst to stimulate this.
Li Xuan took out a spirit crystal. Reflecting on the technique in the Blood Demon Sutra, on how to absorb essence blood, he slightly adjusted the technique, using his true Qi to absorb the spiritual energy within the spirit crystal.
For Li Xuan right now, this wasn't much of a challenge.
His strength was in clear sight.
Extracting a strand of spiritual energy from the spirit crystal, Li Xuan guided it into Meng Chong's body with a casual wave of his hand.
Shh!
In that instant, Meng Chong's Qi and blood boiled like it was being stimulated, and it felt like it was being replenished. A roaring sound resounded from within his body.
Meng Chong was overjoyed.
He hurriedly channeled his Qi and blood, beginning to cultivate the Great Sun Golden Bell Shield.
Puff!
A muffled sound echoed within his body. His bottleneck was broken, his Qi and blood once again began to temper his bones.
At this moment, a faint lucid brilliance appeared on his golden bones.
"Thank you, Master!"
Meng Chong gratefully bowed to Li Xuan.
"Cultivate well and gain entry as soon as possible."
Li Xuan nodded.
He put away the spirit crystal. For him at his current stage, these two spirit crystals were precious.
If Xu Yan were to have a breakthrough to the Innate Realm and encounter some bottlenecks, he might also need to absorb the spiritual energy in the spirit crystal to aid him in making a faster breakthrough.
The faster his disciple enhanced his strength, the faster he could enhance his own strength.
"Yes, Master!"
Meng Chong nodded excitably.
"Junior brother, when you've gained entry, let's spar again."
Xu Yan suggested expectantly.
"Alright!"
Meng Chong nodded.
"Master, I need to go home."
Xu Yan thought for a while. He should try to achieve the complete realm of Qi and blood in these few days.
He should also go home and guide his family in cultivation.
"Go on."
Li Xuan nodded.
Xu Yan wasn't far from achieving the perfection of the Qi and blood realm.
This was just a matter of a few days.
However, achieving the perfect Qi and blood realm did not imply that he could immediately achieve the Innate Realm.
He needed to consolidate his cultivation for a while before he could start breaking through.
And breaking through also required time.
Meng Chong was cultivating Vajra Lucid Bone. He was getting stronger every day and in less than a month, he could probably complete the tempering of Vajra Lucid Bone.
Shi'er was full of envy.
He too had begun the bone refining process. Only after personally experiencing the bone refining process did he understand the difficulty of it.
During the initial stage of bone refining, the pain of being gnawed by countless ants was really unbearable. Those with a weaker will would scream out loud.
Once one screamed, the Qi and blood would be interrupted, and the bone refining would stop.
In this way, the completion of bone refining was extremely difficult.
Shi'er, with his strong will, barely managed to endure it several times.
However, he finally gritted his teeth and pulled through the most difficult stage.
At this point, he could feel the changes brought about by bone refining. His strength had significantly improved.
"I dare not hope for golden bones, aiming for bronze bones is my goal!"
Shi'er set a goal for himself.
One's own family knows one's own situation best. The goal of golden bones was too lofty, he couldn't achieve it due to his lack of innate talent. Bronze bones were still achievable.
...
"Your disciple Xu Yan has reached the perfect realm of Qi and blood, your true Qi has improved."
Xu Yan had fully broken through the Qi and Blood Realm, and the feedback from the Golden Finger had arrived.
"The feedback is somewhat less due to a realm difference, but the True Qi has also increased by about twice."
Li Xuan sighed lightly.
Although his True Qi had increased twice, he was still in the beginner stage of the Innate Realm, his power had improved furher.
"The clarity of my Sword Heart has reached its peak, the foundation of my Sword Dao is complete. Should I try to understand the essence of Sword Intent?"
Li Xuan couldn't help but ponder.
After a long while, unable to grasp the essence of Sword Intent, he cast it aside.
"Never mind, such strenuous tasks are better left to my apprentices."
Now that Xu Yan had fully broken through the Qi and Blood Realm, he was on the cusp of reaching the Innate Realm. Li Xuan hoped that Meng Chong could enter the Martial Arts, striving to cross the Qi and Blood Realm before Xu Yan's breakthrough into the Innate Realm.
What kind of feedback would the second apprentice get from practicing the newly revised Cultivation Technique?
More importantly, under the assistance of the Great Solar Golden Bell, his defense would be enhanced.
Can he stand motionlessly, with martial artists in the Inner Domain unable to break his defense?
After Xu Yan fully broke through the Qi and Blood realm, he returned to the small courtyard and started to consolidate his realm in preparation for breaking through to the Innate Realm.
He would often go outside Yunshan County, sitting on the mountains, attempting to comprehend the Sword Intent and practice the Descending Dragon Palm, trying to grasp its essence.
However, there had been no significant progress yet.
Ten days after Xu Yan fully broke through the Qi and Blood Realm, during a practice session, Meng Chong began to emit a faint lustrous golden light, his aura undergoing a transformation.
Li Xuan watched silently, his second apprenticeship was about to begin Martial Arts.
Shi'er watched from afar, full of envy. Meng Chong was about to begin his Martial Arts, but his own journey seemed indefinitely far away.
"No wonder the Master accepted him as a disciple, his talent is too powerful. I'm also fortunate to have the opportunity to touch martial arts, practice it, and serve the Master."
Shi'er couldn't help but sigh in his heart.
At this moment, Meng Chong, enveloped in the lustrous golden light, gradually morphed into a golden bell encasing him.
With time, Meng Chong seemed to have turned into a gold figure, with a majestic momentum in concentration.
Li Xuan nodded in approval: "This second disciple of mine, he has a resemblance to the Arhat Vajra. It truly fits him to pass down the Great Solar Golden Bell."
Crack!
Suddenly, a sound rang out, akin to the snapping of tendons and bones.
The lustrous light on Meng Chong's body started to intensify. His muscles were trembling, and the sound of thunder began to emanate from within.
The qi and blood turned into the lustrous light, condensed into the golden bell, merging with his flesh and blood.
A rampant aura, like a storm, was emerging from Meng Chong.
Boom!
The thunder roared, the golden bell appeared!
Thud!
With the appearance of the golden bell, it seemed as if the sound of a bell was ringing.
Blood Qi turned golden bell, lustrous gold light, enveloping Meng Chong, the sound of thunder getting louder.
Some neighbours were looking at the sky, puzzled. How come there was thunder on such a clear day?
Could it be that the County Magistrate has lost his morality?
So, there was thunder in clear weather?
Or perhaps, does Yunshan County have any great grievances?
Li Xuan frowned, flipping his palm, with True Qi surging out, covering the courtyard, concealing the momentum of Meng Chong's breakthrough.
Roar!
With a loud roar from Meng Chong, the snapping sound of tendons and bones echoed, Blood Qi solidified into a golden bell, his body emitting a lustrous golden light, his muscles becoming far more robust, his stature increasing slightly with the movement of his Blood Qi.
His robust and stocky figure had grown even more muscular.
Almost bursting out of his leather pants.
"I, have begun Martial Arts, the Great Solar Golden Bell, I've entered it!"
Meng Chong was extremely excited.
At this moment, he could feel his own strength.
Even steel couldn't compare to the strength of his own body.
In an instant, the golden bell was enveloped, any attack could be ignored.
No weakness existed within him, other than violently breaking his own defense, there were no other methods to damage him.
He had a feeling, unmatched by others in the same realm, able to sweep everything aside.
Shi'er was shocked by Meng Chong's ferocious aura. This was just the beginning of Martial Arts, it was already so terrifying?
He had a feeling that even if his own Blood Qi realm was accomplished, he wouldn't be a match for Meng Chong who had just entered.
The gap was too vast.
"Come on, use the precious blade to strike me!"
Meng Chong excitedly beckoned Shi'er.
Directly instructing Shi'er to use the precious blade Xu Yan had gifted.
"Alright!"
Shi'er did not hesitate this time.
Wielding the precious blade, he rushed forward, using all his strength to swing a hefty blow towards Meng Chong.
Finally, as the second disciple began his Martial Arts, Li Xuan revealed a radiant smile, ignoring Meng Chong testing the blade with his flesh. The long-awaited feedback from the Golden Finger had finally arrived.

chapters.title: Chapter 88 - 79: Innate Spirit Bone, Wind Thunder Vajra Fist_1
chapters.content:
Meng Chong made a breakthrough, stepping into the door of martial arts, the familiar golden light emerged, brilliant and beautiful.
"Your disciple Meng Chong, practicing the cultivation technique you compiled, stepping into martial arts, your Great Sun Golden Bell Cover has become successful."
Boom!
With the feedback of the Golden Finger, Li Xuan could see in his mind the full cultivation technique of the Great Sun Golden Bell Cover. At this moment, his physical body became even stronger.
Although he was in the Innate Realm, the Great Sun Golden Bell Cover could still be used by him.
Using True Qi to activate the Great Sun Golden Bell Cover, the defense is unparalleled, incredibly robust.
The foundation of physical martial arts has been solidified.
Jade bones emerged with the lustrous light of glaze, carrying a sense of Vajra.
This was the fusion of the Vajra Glazed Bones with the Jade Bones, which seemed to be undergoing some kind of transformation.
"You've got an Innate Spirit Bone with your Jade Bones + Vajra Glazed Bones!"
Golden light emerged, with the feedback from the Golden Finger.
Innate Spiritual Bone!
At this moment, Li Xuan felt his whole being had sublimated, his flawless jade bones shone with the gleam of glaze, and the spirit lingering around, as if it were a set of divine bones naturally bestowed on them.
With the emergence of the Innate Spiritual Bone, Li Xuan's Innate True Qi was actually purified, becoming stronger.
The violent nature's spiritual energy, due to the loss of the Heavenly Earth Lingji, became gentle after entering his body.
"The Jade Bones + Vajra Glazed Bones unexpectedly resulted in an Innate Spiritual Bone, this is unexpected!"
Li Xuan's heart was filled with excitement.
He had been pondering whether the stacking of Jade Bones with Vajra Glazed Bones would lead to a transformation, becoming stronger.
He didn't expect to get feedback and acquire an Innate Spiritual Bone, this instantly raised its level.
Whether it's jade bones or Vajra Glazed Bones, after all, they were cultivated in the acquired days, and compared with the innate spiritual bones, they were somewhat inferior.
Moreover, this innate spiritual bone that he possesses has been stacked with the features of both Jade Bones and Vajra Glazed Bones.
"I must take on disciples, I must take on disciples, ah, I have jade bones, I have Vajra Glazed Bones, next time, what kind of bones should I compile?"
Li Xuan's eyes shone, and he toyed with the idea of accepting new disciples again.
After a good while, Li Xuan calmed down his excited mood.
Accepting new disciples is not something that can be done easily, and a new cultivation method has to be compiled and a new kind of bone created.
In the courtyard, Shi'er was waving his treasured sword, slashing at Meng Chong one after another, making a thumping sound but couldn't cause any harm to Meng Chong.
Even though what he held was a treasured sword, it was no exception.
He was deeply shocked. With Meng Chong's current strength, even if he stood among thousands of soldiers, allowing the onslaught, they could not harm him in the slightest.
His hands soft from slashing, Shi'er stopped.
"Too strong!"
His face was full of envy.
Meng Chong was extremely excited at this moment, clenching his fists, feeling the power within him, and this was just the entrance to martial arts.
"Senior Brother, let's go, let's have a competition!"
Meng Chong couldn't wait to have a competition with Xu Yan.
"Alright!"
Xu Yan nodded.
The two directly left the city and arrived at a forest outside the county.
Shi'er excitedly followed to watch the battle.
Li Xuan took a step and came to the top of the forest, watching his two disciples compete.
"Junior Brother, you just entered martial arts, and my brother only uses the strength of the entrance level to compete with you!"
Xu Yan spoke, suppressing his own blood qi, only revealing the blood qi realm of martial arts entry.
He also wanted to see just how strong the body martial arts were.
Whether his own pure martial arts could suppress him in the same realm.
Meng Chong practiced the Vajra Glazed Bones, while Xu Yan practiced Jade Bones. Theoretically, they had the same foundation in martial arts.
The difference in strength depends on the individual.
Xu Yan practiced Sword Dao and Descending Dragon Palm, while Meng Chong hadn't practiced any martial skills yet. But before he practiced the Great Sun Golden Bell Cover, he was already comparable to the top masters in the martial arts world.
He was not a novice, he also knew fists and kicks skills.
"Senior Brother, bring it on!"
Meng Chong was surrounded by glazed golden light, and his whole person became stronger, his muscles bulging, like a Vajra Arhat, with a strong aura undeniably radiating from him.
Xu Yan's expression was serious, with each outpouring of blood qi fiery as if it could incinerate, his blood qi was exceptionally pure, not like Meng Chong's, where his blood qi was like a bell, evolving into a glazed golden form.
Boom!
A palm strike slammed directly onto Meng Chong's chest.
Thump!
A deep sound rang out, Meng Chong's figure swayed a little, but he had no injuries at all!
"Senior Brother, come again!"
Meng Chong, who seemed to have transformed into a glazed golden man, patted his chest and said.
He had cultivated the Great Sun Golden Bell Cover. To defeat him, you had to break his defense and be able to hurt him, otherwise you couldn't defeat him.
This was a prerequisite for defeating him!
No matter how flexible the enemy's attack, no matter how much they tried to deplete him, as long as they could not break his Golden Bell Cover, they would not be able to defeat him.
In terms of a war of attrition, a martial artist like him who practiced body martial arts would not be afraid, would he?
This competition did not need fierce fighting, Meng Chong's current stage did not match Xu Yan's in terms of martial skills and speed.
But if Xu Yan could not break his defense, he could not defeat him.
Even if he wanted to drain Meng Chong with exhaustion, that might not be possible because the martial arts foundation of the two men was about the same.
"Alright!"
Xu Yan's blood boiled, and he became very excited.
He was also a proud person.
He naturally wouldn't use his own advantages to bully his Junior Brother.
So, he lowered his own level of strength and only revealed the strength of martial arts entry, and he didn't use the Descending Dragon Palm and Sword Dao either.

chapters.title: Chapter 89 - 79: Innate Spirit Bone, Wind and Thunder Vajra Fist_2
chapters.content:
Pure Qi attack.
Boom!
Xu Yan took another shot, his True Qi exploded, but this time, he didn't hit Meng Chong with his True Qi, instead, his True Qi gathered on his palm, he moved forward and hit Meng Chong's chest with a palm strike.
Thud!
Meng Chong stumbled back, his body shimmering with golden light, looking like it could collapse at any moment!
But he finally stabilized.
Xu Yan raised an eyebrow, he didn't break through the defense?
The Great Sun Golden Bell Cover was indeed incredibly strong.
He could feel the strength of Meng Chong's body, that palm strike on his chest, if it were any other martial artist, they would probably be numbed by the backlash.
His jade-like bones were flawless, his martial arts foundation was solid, and his True Qi was strong, so he wasn't affected by the backlash.
"Again!"
Meng Chong took a deep breath, took a horse stance, and the golden light on his body became stronger.
A golden bell could be vaguely seen, covering his body.
"Then let's go again!"
Xu Yan inhaled deeply, raised his hand, his True Qi was concentrated but not dispersed, there was no True Qi radiating from his body.
He stepped forward, and hit Meng Chong's chest with a palm strike.
Li Xuan had been silently watching, as soon as Xu Yan threw this palm strike, he knew the result.
Meng Chong's Great Sun Golden Bell Defense was to be breached, the golden bell shield was broken, but the power of Xu Yan's palm strike had almost been completely nullified.
It won't cause Meng Chong any harm.
With Meng Chong's robust physique, he could naturally withstand it.
In Flesh Artistry, it's not like you'll be seriously injured when the golden bell defense is broken, it's just a layer of defense for the body.
The truly formidable thing still lies within the body.
As expected!
Below the palm strike, the golden light on Meng Chong's body shattered with a cracking sound, Xu Yan's palm struck Meng Chong's chest.
Meng Chong stumbled, his True Qi surged, and the golden light quickly recovered.
"Come on, junior brother, let's spar!"
Xu Yan exclaimed excitedly.
Although this palm shattered the golden bell defense, the power of the palm strike also be countered largely, it couldn't harm Meng Chong's strong body at all.
This attack and defense can only be considered evenly matched!
"Okay!"
Meng Chong nodded, took a step forward, and threw a punch.
He used the martial skills he had learned, although he couldn't bring out the power of his True Qi fully, but the moves were still useful.
Xu Yan did not use the Descending Dragon Palm either, he also used a palm technique he had learned before.
The two began to spar.
With booming sounds, trees fell one by one, the golden light and intense True Qi clashed and collided. In less than a quarter of an hour, half of the forest turned into flying debris.
Shi'er was completely stunned.
Even though his body was covered in debris, he couldn't care, watching the fight becoming more and more intense, he felt if he moved slightly closer, the shockwaves might break his bones and kill him on the spot!
"I feel like an ant right now!"
Shi'er thought helplessly.
Li Xuan observed silently, from this spar, he already knew who was strong and who was weak.
"Xu Yan is really better, his martial arts are so pure, and the foundation of martial arts was from him!"
Meng Chong was indeed strong, his Flesh Artistry defense was unmatched, his golden bone was not weaker than the jade bone, but he still lost to Xu Yan by a small margin.
In terms of the purity of martial arts, and the foundation of martial arts, Xu Yan is stronger.
In the end, the foundation of these martial arts was inspired from the methods Xu Yan had concocted on a whim. Xu Yan was superior in his talent, Li Xuan was not surprised at all.
Looking at this world, it is absolutely impossible to find a disciple stronger than Xu Yan.
He didn't continue to watch the battle.
As a senior brother, Xu Yan's position was firm, and his strength was undoubtedly the strongest.
Boom!
Meng Chong was panting, there were several palm prints on his body, and it hurt all over.
"I can't hold on any longer!"
Meng Chong looked helpless.
Xu Yan stopped, with a look of admiration on his face, "Junior brother, your Flesh Artistry is really strong!"
Only a bit weaker than him.
In the same realm, except for him, no one could break through the junior brother's defense.
"Hehe, not bad, I rank just below senior brother in the same realm!"
Meng Chong grinned.
Although he was a little bit inferior, he was not disappointed.
His talent lies in his body, if he were to practice the orthodox martial arts of his senior brother, he wouldn't be close to this strength.
After their sparring session, the two apprentices returned to the courtyard.
Xu Yan continued to focus on self-improvement, preparing for his breakthrough into the Innate Realm.
Meng Chong, on the other hand, made his way over to Li Xuan.
"Master, I have become a disciple, what do you think?"
As he spoke, he rubbed his shaven head, chuckling goofily.
His fellow-apprentice practiced Descending Dragon Palm, a powerful Martial Technique—he should strive to learn such a powerful technique as well.
"Master, I don't want to learn Palm Techniques, I want to learn Fist Techniques!"
Meng Chong excitedly blurted.
"Very well, I'll teach you tomorrow."
Li Xuan nodded in agreement.
He had prepared for this early on.
"Thank you, Master!"
Meng Chong nodded with glee.
The next day.
The forest where Meng Chong and Xu Yan sparred was now an open field, bereft of trees and other vegetation.
Li Xuan stood with one hand behind his back, an air of mystery surrounding him, his aura of a profound master imposingly elevated.
Meng Chong respectfully stood adjacent to him.
"My apprentice, I can only pass on wisdom and not technique. The Fist Technique I'll teach you is not just a technique but the essence of the fist."
Li Xuan spoke gravely.
"The essence lies in comprehension and understanding the meaning within. You must know that only by understanding the essence of this, will one continually grow stronger. All techniques exist within this essence."
"As I teach you the essence of the fist, once you comprehend it, your aptitude will improve, your cultivation will elevate, and you will continually understand the essence within."
"The Martial Path is endless, hence, all along, I've emphasized you to comprehend and understand the true meaning rather than focusing on the form, focusing on the moves.
"Do you understand?"
Meng Chong respectfully replied, "Master, your disciple understands!"
Li Xuan nodded, turned, and looked at his second apprentice, "What I'm passing on to you is the Vajra Fist of Wind and Thunder. Just focus on its essence, forget about the form."
"Yes, Master!"
Meng Chong nodded.
He thought to himself, "Master's Martial Arts is the true Martial Arts!"
Li Xuan clenched his fist and infused it with True Qi, and then he punched out.
This punch exerted mighty True Qi, naturally its might was astonishing.
Moreover, under his intentional control, the True Qi thundered like a lightning bolt, producing a booming sound of thunder.
It seemed like a streak of Angry Thunder had flashed by.
Boom!
Meng Chong was astonished, as if seeing a streak of lightning rush out, reducing the distant trees into dust in an instant.
Too quick!
Too fierce!
Li Xuan nodded contentedly; now wasn't like before when he lacked strength.
Since he had strength now, naturally he displayed it, giving his apprentice a shock with his overwhelming strength, which could help his apprentice achieve enlightenment.
Anyway, his overwhelming power alone, without any martial skills applied, was horrifyingly potent.
Boom!
Then he swung his fists, this time without the furious might of a thunderstorm.
It was as if a gust of wind, rapid punches seemingly piercing through all defenses.
The spectacle dazzled Meng Chong, making him feel somewhat dizzy.
"Too strong!
"Just a demonstration from the Master and yet such might—it is truly unbelievable!
Meng Chong inwardly trembled with awe!
After Li Xuan finished his sequence, he looked at the awed face of Meng Chong, feeling extremely satisfied, and adopting the demeanor of a strict teacher, he stated, "Apprentice, this is the Vajra Fist of Wind and Thunder, performed with the perfect Blood and Energy Achievements."
Nonchalantly bragging without blinking an eye, he started to blow his own trumpet.
"I am that formidable! With my perfect Blood and Energy Achievements, my Vajra Fist of Wind and Thunder is comparable to the Innate Realm, cool isn't it?"
He wanted his apprentice to know that his Master is like a towering mountain, impossible to surpass.
Meng Chong's eyes widened. Was it really the Vajra Fist of Wind and Thunder, executed at the Blood and Energy Perfection Realm?
This was absolutely terrifying.
Even at his best Blood and Energy Achievement, he could not generate such power!
"Master definitely is the true Master!"
Li Xuan spoke in a low voice, "The Vajra Fist of Wind and Thunder, its essence lies in the Wind and Thunder—the thunder's rapid fury and the wind's formless penetration.
"What you need to comprehend is this Wind and Thunder, the swift and stormy, all-pervasive Wind and Thunder in the fist."
"Just now, I demonstrated to you the Vajra Fist of Wind and Thunder's swift and fierce Thunder, and unblockable, all-pervasive Wind. Comprehend it well."
His punch, driven out with power far exceeding his apprentice's, naturally appeared swift and stormy, and all-pervasive to his apprentice. The rest was up to Meng Chong's own comprehension.

chapters.title: Chapter 90 - 80: Visitor from the Inner Domain, the Excited Crown Prince_1
chapters.content:
"Yes, Master, this disciple will surely comprehend it, and will not let you down!"
Meng Chong fervently bowed in salute.
"I believe in you!"
Li Xuan nodded and soared into the sky, quickly disappearing.
Meng Chong took a deep breath, looking at the remnants of his master's Wind Thunder Diamond Fist demonstration, he closed his eyes, the scene of his master unleashing the technique surfaced in his mind.
An intensity that was violently rapid, just like the might of thunder.
It was like a violent wind, leaving no stone unturned.
The terrifying power that the master displayed amazed Meng Chong. Was this really a cultivation from the Blood Qi Realm?
"Master taught the way of the fist, not just the moves!"
"This is the way of the Wind Thunder Diamond Fist. I should grasp its rapid and imposing manner, like thunder, and its invisible penetration, like the wind... not just the movements of my master."
Meng Chong repeatedly reminded himself in his heart.
He caused himself to downgrade the movements his master used during the session, and focus more on the violent natures of the wind and thunder.
After teaching Meng Chong the customised Wind Thunder Diamond Fist, Li Xuan relaxed a bit, occasionally guiding Shi'er in his practice.
As for whether Meng Chong could comprehend it, he believed it shouldn't be a problem.
As for how long it would take for him to comprehend, he couldn't predict that, but it probably wouldn't take too long.
Every day, Meng Chong meditated in the mountains and forests to comprehend the Wind Thunder Diamond Fist, the resounding power of his master's demonstration playing continuously in his mind.
Gradually, he imprinted this power into his memory, continuing to contemplate it.
From then on, Meng Chong spent his days, early till late, training in the mountains and deepening the impression of his master's demonstration of the power of Wind Thunder Diamond Fist in his mind.
Li Xuan, in the meantime, was waiting for Xu Yan to step into the Innate Realm. Once Xu Yan broke through, he could start teaching him the cultivation technique above the Innate Realm.
The way of martial arts needed Xu Yan to forge ahead.
As for Meng Chong's future cultivation, the strategies and methods of training, and the forms of cultivation to follow after Great Sun Golden Bell, Li Xuan had already prepared.
The physical Martial Arts were gradually being perfected.
However, the physical Martial Arts cultivation techniques of the Innate Realm would have to wait until Meng Chong had comprehended the Wind Thunder Diamond Fist. It was best not to bother him too much, lest he become distracted and slow his progress.
...
Endless mountains.
The eldest prince of Qi Country, under the protection of a group of experts, continued to explore the mountains, gradually penetrating deeper into them.
"Where is the expert?"
The Crown Prince's face was filled with desire.
The struggle for the successor to the throne, the position that he was about to snatch, had suddenly disappeared!
And it all happened because of Xu Yan, the martial arts expert, which forced his royal father to bow, forcing the royal family of Qi Country to bow.
Even though Guo Rongshan seemed to be second only to the Emperor, there was actually no one in the entire Qi Country who dared to go against his will, even his own father.
Up until now, Guo Rongshan had not done anything outrageous, mainly because he was bound by the reputation of being a sage, and he did not want to lose that reputation.
Also, his eyes had opened up and he was no longer interested in mundane power.
The Crown Prince felt that his quest to find the expert was not just for his own sake, but also for the whole Qi Country and its royal family.
"Who was it that suggested initially to start confiscating property from Guo Rongshan's son-in-law?"
The Crown Prince gritted his teeth and ground them together in secret.
If they hadn't confiscated Xu Yan's property in the first place, they wouldn't have gotten in this mess.
"Your Highness, we have already traveled more than five hundred miles into these endless mountains, should we continue to go further?"
The eunuch following the Crown Prince expressed his concern.
The son of the Minister of War seemed to have met with an accident more than five hundred miles into the endless mountains.
Of course, it wasn't in these mountains, but a hundred miles away at another entrance to the mountains.
The Crown Prince surveyed his surroundings: their options now were either to explore to the left or right, or to continue deeper, which carried risks.
He looked at his team, all of them were experts, including several dozen high-ranking ones from the Inner Domain.
The combat power of this group was far superior to that of the son of the Minister of War. Even if they were to encounter danger, they would not be helpless.
Even if they had no means to resist, there were so many people, it would be impossible for a beast to attack them all.
The Crown Prince gritted his teeth and said, "Keep going forward to explore!"
One needs to face danger to seek wealth, and so is the case with martial arts!
"Yes, Your Highness!"
The eunuch nodded in compliance, relaying the commands that followed.
However, he thought to himself: "I wonder whether martial arts can grow back my root? Or would losing it affect my cultivation?"
Although he was physically incomplete, he still had a desire for the martial arts.
The Crown Prince's group of more than three hundred people was well-equipped. Wherever they passed, fierce beasts fled, climbed mountains and crossed ridges, and they did not encounter any danger along the way.
Occasionally when poisonous snakes appeared, they were slashed before reaching the inner circle of the group. The bodyguards, wearing leather armour and smeared with snake insect repellent, made most of the poisonous snakes stay far away.
"Where on earth is the expert?"
The spirit of the Crown Prince was somewhat defeated.
Deep within the endless mountains, two figures were leisurely walking, their feet not touching the ground, almost like they were strolling through the woods.
Suddenly!
A roar resounded, and a large colourful tiger leaped out.
The figure in front was a young man in his twenties. He glanced sidelong at the colourful tiger and laughed, "Is this a Red-eyed Tiger?"
The middle-aged man following closely behind nodded and said: "Yes, Young Master."
As the colourful tiger that had leaped out was about to show its might, it was made docile by the young man's glance and laid down on the ground, looking like a well-behaved big cat.
The young man smiled, his gaze towards the exterior of the endless mountains.

chapters.title: Chapter 91 - 80 Visitors from the Inner Domain, The Excited Crown Prince_2
chapters.content:
"Xue Wuxin really knows how to flee, to actually escape to the Wasteland. Could it be that he believes no one would come to the Wasteland to kill him?"
"Others may not dare, but I, Xie Lingfeng, do!"
The middle-aged man spoke cautiously, "Young master, we must not be careless. Xue Wuxin is a Grandmaster of the Blood Demon Cult, and he cultivates the rumored Blood Demon Devil Sutras, which absorb people's blood essence for cultivation, especially the blood essence of Martial Artists.
"Although the Wasteland lacks the Heavenly Earth Lingji and one cannot cultivate there, many people still live there. Given Xue Wuxin's ruthlessness, he will inevitably commit acts of massacring cities for blood sacrifices.
"His strength, I'm afraid, has already recovered, and perhaps even grown stronger."
Xie Lingfeng, however, proudly said, "Hu Shan, you are also a Grandmaster. Even if Xue Wuxin's strength has increased, you and I together can surely kill him!
"Besides, I, Xie Lingfeng alone, am enough to slay him. Grandmaster Martial Artists are not something I haven't killed before!"
Hu Shan thought about it and felt there was reason in these words. His young master was one of the three youngest Grandmasters in the Inner Domain and a famous prodigy of Martial Arts, with formidable strength that far surpasses ordinary Martial Artists.
And he himself was also a Grandmaster level Martial Artist.
Even if the young master alone could not kill Xue Wuxin, with his addition, Xue Wuxin was bound to die without a doubt.
"Hu Shan, it's precisely because there are people living in the Wasteland that we must come to execute Xue Wuxin; otherwise, the Wasteland will turn into purgatory!"
Xie Lingfeng's expression became serious.
His tone turned cold and solemn, "Xue Wuxin has fled to the Wasteland for some time now, I'm afraid he's already committed atrocities!"
Hu Shan nodded. Without strong people in the Wasteland, even a mighty army would be but a gift of heads to Xue Wuxin.
"Let's go, quickly make our way to the Wasteland!"
Xie Lingfeng said as he rose into the air and flew beyond the endless mountains.
Hu Shan closely followed behind him.
"Young master, look, there are people over there!"
Half a Shi Chen later, Hu Shan suddenly pointed ahead to the left and said.
Xie Lingfeng looked and saw a group of more than three hundred people, arranged in a circle, vigilantly watching their surroundings, and protecting the young people inside while appearing somewhat ragged.
The person being protected in the middle obviously had a distinguished status.
Xie Lingfeng sighed and said, "Xue Wuxin has indeed already caused a massacre; these people have been forced to flee into the vast mountains. With their strength, even carrying bows and crossbows, if they continue further, upon encountering fierce beasts like the Crimson-eyed Tiger or the Firemane Wolf, they are likely to be wiped out."
Hu Shan nodded.
It was clear at a glance that this group had come to the mountains to seek refuge, and in conjunction with Xue Wuxin fleeing to the Wasteland, it was not difficult to guess that it was because of Xue Wuxin's slaughter in the Wasteland that these people had fled here.
"Let's go, let's go down and ask!"
Xie Lingfeng flew towards the Crown Prince and the others.
The Crown Prince and his party, who had searched this far, were all extremely tired and began to rest on the spot.
"Where exactly is the expert? Xu Yan, that lad, where did he encounter the expert?"
The Crown Prince was struggling to endure.
Having always lived in comfort and luxury, he had never suffered like this before.
"Your Highness, look quickly, experts!"
The attending eunuch suddenly cried out excitedly.
The Crown Prince's spirit was lifted, and as he looked up, he indeed saw two figures flying in from mid-air.
In an instant, they landed in front.
Experts!
At that moment, the Crown Prince was excited, his face flushed, and his exhaustion swept away.
He leaped up but felt it was improper—barely rising to his feet, he knelt down with a thud.
"The Qi King pays his respects to the expert!"
When the Crown Prince knelt, all the guards around him, overwhelmed with excitement, also knelt down.
"We pay our respects to the expert!"
Xie Lingfeng inwardly sighed. The calamity Xue Wuxin had wrought forced even the noble King of a country to seek experts in the vast mountains to settle a national crisis.
"Rise!"
Xie Lingfeng spoke in a deep voice.
"Yes, expert!"
The Crown Prince stood up excitedly.
Stealing glances at Xie Lingfeng and the other, although Xie Lingfeng appeared a bit younger than him, he would never believe that Xie Lingfeng was younger.
This was an expert, possessing the secret of eternal youth.
Xie Lingfeng spoke gravely, "Has Qi Country faced a disaster, a calamity upon you?"
The Crown Prince was startled; how could the expert know?
Indeed, ever since Xu Yan arrived, Qi Country had undergone a great change. As for a calamity approaching?
It was possible, maybe one day Guo Rongshan would do something rash and rebel?
"Yes, yes, the expert is almost divine!"
The Crown Prince nodded vigorously.
Xie Lingfeng thought to himself, as expected, Xue Wuxin had already started his massacres and blood sacrifices, devouring blood essence to enhance his own power.
If he had not come, the tragedy of the Wasteland was beyond imagining!
Thinking of this, his face showed anger as he said, "This is truly outrageous. Tell me, how many have died?"
How many have died?
The Crown Prince was momentarily stunned; he really didn't know, but Xu Yan had pushed through ten thousand of Qi Country's elite Divine Might Army, which was known to every court official in the Capital City.
As for how many of the Divine Might Army had died because of this, he did not know.
"I don't know the exact number, only that he has pushed through my Qi Country's elite ten thousand Divine Might Army!"
The Crown Prince answered honestly.
Xie Lingfeng's killing intent grew even denser, "So a massacre of ten thousand had already occurred?"
Moreover, it was ten thousand elite troops of Qi Country that had been slaughtered. What about before this incident?
It must have been countless killings already, even a blood sacrifice of an entire city has occurred, causing Qi Country to dispatch its elite troops to encircle and suppress the culprits.
"Tell me, where is that person now?"
Xie Lingfeng asked solemnly.
"Perhaps in Donghe County?"
The Crown Prince was not entirely sure.
However, looking at the esteemed one's appearance, it seems there might be some grudge between him and Xu Yan, or Xu Yan's master?
Having a grudge is good! That way, he will not join forces with Xu Yan.
"Esteemed one, please protect the royal family of Qi Country. Qi Country is willing to honor the esteemed one as the nation-protecting State Preceptor!"
The Crown Prince bowed deeply and said.
"There's no need for the title of nation-protecting State Preceptor. I will settle the disaster of your Qi Country myself."
After thinking for a moment, Xie Lingfeng said, "Follow me back to Qi Country to search for his whereabouts, and I will deal with him!"
"Yes, yes, esteemed one!"
The Crown Prince was slightly disappointed.
However, as long as the esteemed one arrives at the capital city of Qi Country, there would still be a chance for a turnaround.
"Esteemed one, please follow me back to the capital city. Soon, we will find out his whereabouts."
The Crown Prince ordered, preparing to depart immediately to return to the capital city of Qi Country.
Xie Lingfeng saw that the group's pace was too slow. By the time they returned to the capital city of Qi Country, Xue Wuxin could have killed countless more people.
To prevent a long night of more dreams, Xie Lingfeng directly raised his hand, grabbed the Crown Prince's shoulder, and said, "You just point the direction, follow me."
The Crown Prince was confused and gave a wry smile, "That... esteemed one, I'm not familiar with the directions!"
"But my chief companion knows the way!"
The Crown Prince hastily pointed at his attendant eunuch and said.
"Then let's go together."
Xie Lingfeng nodded.
Hu Shan raised his hand and pulled the attendant eunuch over, taking to the air together with Xie Lingfeng.
"They took to the skies!"
The Crown Prince was thrilled, but when he looked down, he trembled all over from fright.
Xu Yan couldn't even fly yet. The strength of this esteemed one surpassed Xu Yan's. Now, let's see how Xu Yan can be arrogant.
The glory of the Guo Rongshan family ends here.
His father, Emperor Qi, has grown old; it was time for him to abdicate the throne.
Just an old good-for-nothing, venting his frustration on his own son!
The Crown Prince was seething inwardly.
"Lead the way."
Xie Lingfeng looked at the attendant eunuch.
"Over there! The capital city is in that direction!"
The attendant eunuch's voice trembled with excitement as he pointed towards the direction of Qi Country's capital city.
At this moment, he really wanted to ask the esteemed one if the severed root could grow back by cultivating Martial Arts.
However, he never mustered the courage to ask.
"Let's go!"
Xie Lingfeng's Martial Arts Inner Qi surged, protecting the Crown Prince as they flew towards the direction of the capital city of Qi Country.
Hu Shan, carrying the attendant eunuch, followed closely behind.
The capital city of Qi Country was still bustling with life.
The ministers had no desire to attend court, and the common people didn't care—as long as no noble was disturbing their lives, what did it matter to them if court was in session?
The Qi King lived up to his reputation as a virtuous and wise sage. Since he took control of the state affairs and assisted Emperor Qi, excessive levies and miscellaneous taxes have been reduced, and life has improved.
Inside the palace, Emperor Qi was entertaining Guo Rongshan, affectionately calling him Brother Guo. Meanwhile, serving at their side was his favorite concubine, Princess Concubine Yun.
Guo Rongshan felt uncomfortable throughout.
Last time, Emperor Qi even considered gifting Princess Concubine Yun to him, frightening him into hastily refusing.
Now, what did it mean to have Princess Concubine Yun serve at his side?
"Brother Guo, I see you're becoming more vigorous as you age, wouldn't you like me to give..."
Emperor Qi said cheerfully.
He was inwardly frustrated. To be an emperor who ended up like this—was he the first one ever?
Where exactly is that expert? Why haven't they found him yet!
"Your Majesty, I am terrified. My wife at home is like a tigress, I dare not even consider it!"
Guo Rongshan hastily declined.
What's going on with Emperor Qi? Has he developed some strange proclivity, contemplating gifting a concubine again?
"Father, the expert has arrived, your son has found the expert!"
Suddenly, an excited voice came from above.

chapters.title: Chapter 92 - 81: An Excited Xu Yan, Xie Lingfeng at Sword Venerate Cliff_1
chapters.content:
Emperor Qi and Guo Rongshan looked upwards upon hearing the sound, as four figures descended from the sky.
A young man, with a precious sword hanging at his waist, carrying the crown prince; another person—a middle-aged man—with a sword at his side as well, carrying the crown prince's attendant eunuch.
Emperor Qi was instantly overjoyed and abruptly stood up.
The highly anticipated masters had finally arrived.
"Greetings to the masters!"
Emperor Qi's demeanor was very humble, almost moved to tears with excitement.
But Guo Rongshan's heart sank, the masters had actually flown here, yet his own grandson Xu Yan, was still unable to fly using his qi.
However, his grandson's master was a peerless master, he ought to be no less capable, right?
He also hurriedly stood up and followed with a salute.
Xie Lingfeng's gaze was sharp, without any nonsense, he directly asked, "Where is the troublemaker?"
Emperor Qi was taken aback, the troublemaker?
Xu Yan?!
Guo Rongshan's heart twitched, this master's tone was unfriendly, could it be that there was some feud with Xu Yan, or Xu Yan's master?
His heart could not help but feel uneasy.
"Guo Rongshan, where is your grandson?"
At this moment, Emperor Qi straightened his back and no longer addressed him as brother, calling him by his name instead.
Guo Rongshan thought for a moment, his grandson was in Donghe County, practicing with his master. If these martial artists were to look there, perhaps Xu Yan's master could deal with them.
"He's in Donghe County!"
He did not conceal the fact, standing straight and even glancing sideways at Emperor Qi.
Emperor Qi's heart skipped a beat. The outcome of this confrontation had yet to be determined. If, in the end, the two masters present were unable to prevail, wouldn't that be disastrous?
He immediately put on a smile and said, "Brother Guo, since the master is seeking your grandson, I dare not conceal the truth."
Upon hearing that Xue Wuxin was in Donghe County, Xie Lingfeng immediately asked, "In which direction is Donghe County?"
The crown prince straightened his back and spoke, "Master, there's no need for you to go in person. Just let someone send a message for him to come to the capital city and pay respects to the master."
While speaking, he gestured towards Guo Rongshan and commanded, "Lord Guo, will you not quickly send word to your grandson, to have him hurry to the capital city to pay respects to the master?"
Guo Rongshan squinted at the crown prince, thinking the young man needed to be disciplined.
The crown prince felt unease under his gaze, but the thought of having the support of a master immediately made him glare back fiercely.
Xie Lingfeng was somewhat baffled, looking at Guo Rongshan with a puzzled expression.
"Your grandson?"
Xue Wuxin is someone's grandson now?
"Indeed, may I know why the master is looking for my grandson?"
Guo Rongshan nodded and asked.
Xie Lingfeng blinked, sensing that there was something amiss about the situation.
Looking at Hu Shan, he communicated telepathically, "How old is Xue Wuxin? Could he be from the Border Wilderness?"
Hu Shan was also puzzled and replied, "Xue Wuxin should be no younger than me. As for the possibility of him moving from the Border Wilderness to the Inner Domain, it's absolutely impossible. The mountain range near the Inner Domain is infested with fierce beasts. Without the strength of at least a fourth or fifth rank, it's impossible to cross!"
"So what's going on here?"
Xie Lingfeng had never imagined that a martial artist would emerge from the Wasteland.
Hu Shan pondered for a moment and said, "Perhaps Xue Wuxin has changed his ways. On the surface, he is the grandson of this man, but in reality, he subtly controls him, helping him to maintain a grip on Qi Country's imperial court while secretly consuming the essence and blood of others, avoiding creating greater chaos."
"To evade our pursuit?"
"If it were someone else who came to the Border Wilderness and found no massacre or blood sacrifice, they wouldn't continue the investigation and would return to the Inner Domain."
Hu Shan analyzed.
Xie Lingfeng felt the reasoning was sound. Having suffered such a loss in the Inner Domain, Xue Wuxin would want to keep a low profile upon first escaping to the Border Wilderness to avoid being pursued by Inner Realm Martial Artists.
In order to hide his identity, he was actually willing to become someone's grandson?
He had underestimated Xue Wuxin's patience and forbearance.
Thinking this, Xie Lingfeng narrowed his eyes and said to Guo Rongshan, "Send a message to your grandson, telling him to come to the capital city for a meeting, and let him know he can't hide."
"Certainly!"
Guo Rongshan agreed without hesitation, nodding in response.
This matter was no longer something he could influence or resolve. He would inform his grandson of the situation, and if truly no match, he would tell his grandson to flee!
"Your Majesty, I request to be excused!"
Guo Rongshan saluted Emperor Qi.
"My loyal subject, take care!"
Emperor Qi was quite pleased inside.
As Guo Rongshan left, Emperor Qi commanded a grand feast to be prepared to entertain Xie Lingfeng and the other.
But Xie Lingfeng refused, only requesting a quiet residence instead.
Emperor Qi readily agreed.
He personally escorted Xie Lingfeng and his companion to a secluded residence within the royal palace. Upon returning to his study, his entire demeanor changed, the imperial majesty was once again present.
"Order issued: keep the Qi King's residence under covert surveillance, and prepare to take control of the Divine Might Army."
Emperor Qi commanded.
"Father, just confiscate Guo Rongshan's property now!"
The crown prince said.
"Foolish!"
Emperor Qi glared at his eldest son and said, "The outcome has not been decided, what's the rush? What if it ends in a draw? What if we lose? You need to be prudent, don't be impatient!"
"Yes, yes, Father is right!"
The crown prince admitted his fault, but was thoroughly displeased with his father, planning to ingratiate himself with the master to gain support for his claim to the throne of Qi Country.
His father was old and muddled, it was time for him to be pushed aside.
...
In Yunshan County, Li Xuan was refining the cultivation technique beyond the Innate Realm.
It would connect seamlessly with the Innate Realm, and the strength of this realm remained immensely powerful, surpassing the Great Grandmasters of the Inner Realm Martial Dao.
On this day, a message from the capital city reached Donghe County.
Martial Artists had arrived in the capital!
Xu Yan was commanded to go to the capital to see them!
It seemed the visitors bore ill intentions!

chapters.title: Chapter 93 - 81: The Excited Xu Yan, Sword Venerate Cliff's Xie Lingfeng_2
chapters.content:
```
The two arrivals descended from the sky; they must be grandmaster martial artists from the Inner Domain.
"Master, I will go to the Capital City and meet with the martial artists of the Inner Domain!"
Xu Yan exclaimed with excitement.
"Inner Domain grandmaster, are you confident?"
Li Xuan pondered for a moment before asking.
Xu Yan had already reached the peak of the Qi-Blood Realm and had a profound understanding of the Sword Dao, having attained a clear heart toward swordsmanship.
His strength had long since diverged from his past self.
However, if the two of them joined forces, Xu Yan would probably have difficulty coping.
What's more, there are different levels of strength even among grandmasters.
"Master, rest assured, I have perceived the essence of the Sword Dao, and my Descending Dragon Palm has also made a breakthrough to the second layer. I do not fear the grandmasters of the Inner Domain. Even if the two of them join forces, I shall not fear!"
Xu Yan declared confidently.
"If you have confidence, then go,"
Li Xuan gave his nod of approval.
"Do you need your teacher to accompany you?"
After thinking about it, Li Xuan spoke again.
