"Master, please stay in Yunshan County to teach my fellow disciple. I alone am sufficient. They come for Xue Wuxin, and has not troubled my grandfather's family; they may not have any significant malice.
"This is a good opportunity to refine my Sword Dao through their challenge. Perhaps, this will help me perceive the Sword Intent."
Xu Yan thought for a moment and then shook his head.
"With such confidence, then go,"
Li Xuan nodded.
"Yes, Master!"
Xu Yan, full of excitement, immediately set off on his journey.
"Inner Domain grandmasters, and there are two of them—have they come to hunt down Xue Wuxin? From what Guo Rongshan conveyed, it seems they do bear ill will, yet they did not trouble the Guo Family.
"Moreover, they did not display any attitude of superiority or arrogance.
"They are not bloodthirsty, Xu Yan's trip shouldn't pose a problem, and with his strength, he won't lose to the grandmasters."
Li Xuan pondered to himself.
"I cannot allow anything to happen to my precious disciple; I shall go and see for myself."
Ultimately, Li Xuan could not put his mind at ease.
"Disciple, the key to the Wind and Thunder Vajra Fist lies within the momentum of wind and thunder. Reflect upon this more, your teacher needs to leave for a bit."
After Meng Chong returned, Li Xuan gave some instructions before soaring into the sky, making his way toward the Capital City of Qi Country.
At the Guo Family in Qi Country's Capital City,
"Father, are those two experts here for Yan'er?"
Guo Yunkai voiced his concerns anxiously.
"In this matter, we are helpless; we'll have to see how Yan'er handles it,"
Guo Rongshan replied helplessly.
Since the arrival of the grandmasters, the court officials were excited and eager to show their loyalty to Emperor Qi,
All just to catch a glimpse of the grandmasters.
The Qi King's residence became deserted in an instant. To the court officials, it seemed as if the Qi King's residence was doomed.
One by one, they distanced themselves as if the Qi King's residence was plagued, afraid to be associated in the slightest.
Emperor Qi had no interest in dealing with the court officials; he visited the grandmasters morning, noon, and night, presenting all kinds of precious medicines and rare jewels, bringing them to the grandmasters' residence.
Although the grandmasters did not accept, he also refused to take them back.
As the saying goes, receiving gifts makes you indebted. Being the sovereign of a nation, he showed great respect and generosity. Surely, the grandmasters ought to reciprocate in some way, right?
Emperor Qi was quite content, simply waiting for the right moment to ask about Martial Dao Techniques,
Hoping to persuade the grandmasters to take a disciple or something of the sort.
The Crown Prince was also diligently serving at their side, hoping to be taken as a disciple to learn powerful Martial Arts.
"Where are they? Have they gone into hiding?"
Xie Lingfeng was becoming impatient.
"Esteemed grandmasters, rest assured, he has already set off for the Capital City,"
The Crown Prince fawned with a flattering expression.
On this day, a figure darted towards the imperial palace.
"Emperor Qi, you old fart, Xu Yan has arrived! Where is that so-called grandmaster?"
Xu Yan had arrived!
Just like last time, he came flying in with unrivaled arrogance.
His imposing aura pressed in all directions, exuding unmatched dominance.
"What's this?"
Xie Lingfeng and Hu Shan's expression changed.
A martial artist!
Where did this martial artist come from?
In an instant, the two disappeared from their spot and soared into the sky, arriving in front of Xu Yan in the blink of an eye.
Xu Yan's gaze sharpened; indeed, they were grandmaster martial artists.
His eyes focused on Xie Lingfeng. His instincts told him this person was the strongest, exuding an aura of sharpness.
At his waist hung a Longsword.
A Sword Dao martial artist!
His eyes lit up instantly. Standing atop the palace roof, he rubbed his palms together, eager to test himself against the Inner Domain's Sword Dao martial artist.
This Inner Domain martial artist was not much older than him, only in his mid-twenties. About ten or twelve years his senior, no?
Yet his strength was even greater than Xue Wuxin's!
"Are you the ones looking for me?"
Xu Yan asked excitedly.
Xie Lingfeng's brows were deeply furrowed, the young man before him seemed a bit off.
He appeared to be a martial artist!
Yet his aura was somewhat different, his Qi-Blood extraordinarily vigorous.
Taking a deep breath, he spoke in a grave voice, "You are not Xue Wuxin, where is Xue Wuxin?"
```
Indeed, they were here looking for Xue Wuxin.
"Xue Wuxin is already dead!"
Xu Yan did not hide the fact.
"Dead?"
Xie Lingfeng was startled, wondering how a Grandmaster Martial Artist could have died in the Wasteland?
"Who killed him?"
He did not believe that the young man before him could have killed Xue Wuxin.
"My master!"
"Who is your esteemed master?"
"There is no need for you to know that. Since you've come looking for me, let's get started. I would also like to experience the strength of a Grandmaster from the Inner Domain!"
Xu Yan's Qi and blood erupted with a thunderous roar.
A crimson dragon coiled around him.
Xie Lingfeng was shocked and said sternly, "Who are you? Have you come from the Inner Domain?"
Xu Yan stood proudly and replied, "What do you mean 'have I come from the Inner Domain'? I am Xu Yan from the Donghe Prefecture of Qi Country, a person of the Wasteland!"
"Impossible! Absolutely impossible!"
Xie Lingfeng's face filled with disbelief.
"It's impossible for a Martial Artist to emerge from the Wasteland!"
Xu Yan sneered and said, "Then what do you think of me? Am I a Martial Artist or not?"
"This..."
Xie Lingfeng was dumbfounded.
Indeed, before him was a Martial Artist from the Wasteland.
Hu Shan too was greatly astounded; he tried to sense the Spirit Mechanism of Heaven and Earth but found nothing.
This indicated that the Spirit Mechanism of Heaven and Earth still did not exist in the Wasteland.
"Enough of the dithering, come on, let's fight!"
Xu Yan, impatient, pointed at Xie Lingfeng and spoke.
"Fine!"
Xie Lingfeng took a deep breath and nodded.
"Let's take it outside the city!"
Xu Yan spoke and then, with a movement technique, he soared out towards the outskirts.
Xie Lingfeng and Hu Shan exchanged a look, both seeing the disbelief in the other's eyes.
They leapt into the air, flying towards the outskirts.
The Capital City was in an uproar.
There was a battle between strong Martial Artists; people poured out of the city wanting to watch, but no one was to be seen.
Several miles outside the Capital City of Qi Country.
Xie Lingfeng strode through the air, Longsword in hand, his aura fierce, his entire being like a sharp sword, his Sword Qi locking onto Xu Yan from a distance.
Xu Yan's Qi and blood boiled, his entire being becoming ecstatic.
"I hail from Sword Venerate Cliff, Xie Lingfeng!"
Xie Lingfeng saluted.
"Donghe Prefecture, Xu Yan!"
Xu Yan returned the salute.
Sensing Xie Lingfeng's sharpness, as sharp as a sword, he grew even more excited. He had just stepped through the gates of the Sword Dao and his Sword Heart was clear, but he had not yet sensed the Sword Intent.
Perhaps this very moment was an opportunity!
To have a battle with a Sword Dao Martial Artist from the Inner Domain and test their mettle!
"Brother Xu!"
Xie Lingfeng cupped his fist and asked curiously, "May I ask which realm Brother Xu is in?"
He was a bit unsure of Xu Yan's realm.
He was neither at the Grandmaster level, nor did he seem like he was at the Ninth Grade.
No Ninth Grade could have such a powerful aura.
What surprised him even more was the crimson dragon coiling around Xu Yan; its presence was quite astonishing, a Cultivation Technique he had never seen in the Inner Domain.
"Martial Arts beginner, the Qi-Blood Realm complete!"
Xu Yan declared outright.
"Qi-Blood Realm?"
Xie Lingfeng was baffled.
What realm was that? He had never heard of it.
Turning to glance at Hu Shan, who was watching the battle from behind, he saw that Hu Shan was also utterly confused.
And only a beginner in Martial Arts?
"Brother Xu, what are the Qi-Blood Realm and Martial Arts beginner? Isn't that the Ninth Grade..."
Xu Yan said impatiently, "Stop wasting words. Let's talk after we fight!"
"Alright!"
Xie Lingfeng's eyes narrowed with intensity. With a flick of his Longsword, Sword Qi swirled at the tip, saying, "Brother Xu, please make a move!"
"Well, I won't hold back then!"
Xu Yan raised his hand and slapped downwards.
Boom!
The Descending Dragon Palm transformed into a massive dragon, striking out with terrifying force.
Xie Lingfeng pointed with his sword, and Sword Qi streaked like lightning, directly piercing the dragon's head and, with a ripping sound, cleanly bisected the dragon-shaped palm force.
Xu Yan's eyes narrowed, recognizing that Xie Lingfeng was stronger than Xue Wuxin, and by more than just a little.
He took a deep breath; with the Descending Dragon Palm, eighteen massive dragons combined to strike out.
Boom!
Xie Lingfeng was shocked. What kind of palm technique was this?
His Longsword swept up, layers of Sword Qi surrounding him, warding off the attack. Then, with a flicker in mid-air, a flash of the sword, swift as a thunderbolt, he aimed a fierce thrust of his blade at Xu Yan's throat.
Xu Yan's gaze sharpened. In that instant, he spotted the weakness in Xie Lingfeng's thrust. But the speed was too great, and he couldn't attack the weak spot in time. Instantly, he shifted his position with a movement technique, narrowly evading the attack.
Xie Lingfeng was startled yet again. What kind of movement technique was this, which allowed for such instant repositioning!

chapters.title: Chapter 94 - 82 Xu Yan vs Xie Lingfeng (Subscription Requested) _1
chapters.content:
Xu Yan directed the flight of eighteen giant dragons in an up and down motion, striking Xie Lingfeng from all directions, fully unleashing the furious power of the Descending Dragon Palm.
Xie Lingfeng's gaze grew intense, his aura increasingly fierce. The sword in his hand shone with a brilliant light. In a moment, he thrust out the sword, and the Sword Qi was like a grand river, the sound of rushing water filled the atmosphere.
Boom!
The Sword Qi swept across the giant dragons, causing roaring sounds and the collapse of the dragons. Although most of the Sword Qi had dissipated, it remained intensely sharp.
Whoosh!
Xie Lingfeng's eyes were cold, a surge of Sword Qi wrapped around him, the brilliant light of the sword in his hand fluctuated, and between the ebb and flow of the Sword Qi, it was like the surge of countless rivers.
Hu Shan who was watching the battle at a distance was shocked in his heart: "What kind of palm technique is this young man using that even the young master has had to employ the ten-thousand river Swordsmanship?"
The ten-thousand river Swordsmanship, a single sword stroke as vast as thousands of rivers, it is one of the top Swordsmanship techniques of Sword Master Cliff.
It is with this Swordsmanship that Xie Lingfeng was once able to slay a Grandmaster Martial Artist!
In the Inner Domain, it is renowned throughout.
"This is Swordsmanship!"
Xu Yan's heart tightened. He could feel intense pressure from Xie Lingfeng's Swordsmanship.
The Sword Qi weaved in all directions, layer upon layer, vast and unstoppably crossing, like a series of cascading rivers.
There is no evasion, no resistance.
The Sword Qi can either be relentlessly fierce or gentle as water, yet there is no gap it cannot penetrate!
Every strike of the Descending Dragon Palm felt as if it was falling into a river, making it increasingly heavy and strenuous!
Dragons should control the water. Now they are trapped in the water, showcasing the extraordinary aspect of this Swordsmanship.
However, Xu Yan also understood that when he was at the realm of blood Qi, he was not able to bring out the true power of the Descending Dragon Palm, hence why he was trapped in the long river.
He felt no disheartenment, instead, he was more excited than ever.
Right now, his mind was clear, and the image of Xie Lingfeng's Swordsmanship technique appeared in his mind.
"This is, the weakness!"
Boom!
A giant dragon broke through a Sword Qi and launched an attack at Xie Lingfeng.
"This is, the point of sharpness. Dodge it!"
A giant dragon suddenly dived upwards, avoiding a Sword Qi, then immediately dived down, destroying another Sword Qi.
Xie Lingfeng's gaze was heavy, the Ten-Thousand River Swordsmanship was continuously executed. The Sword Qi transformed into tens of thousands of rivers, blocking Xu Yan from all sides, making the Sword Qi increasingly denser and fiercer.
Li Xuan, not too far away, silently watched the battle between Xu Yan and Xie Lingfeng. At this moment, with his sword heart clear and complete, he had completely understood the Ten-Thousand River Swordsmanship.
In his mind, he built, based on the foundation of the Ten-Thousand River Swordsmanship, a stronger version of the Ten-Thousand River Swordsmanship.
This is the strength of having a clear Sword Heart.
The enemy's Swordsmanship is my Swordsmanship, the enemy's sword play is my sword play, improving on the strengths and discarding the weaknesses, the Swordsmanship is on a higher level.
His cultivation realm is higher, so he was able to see the Ten-Thousand River Swordsmanship clearly in such a short period of time, improving on its shortcomings.
But Xu Yan, after all, is of lower realm, just entering the realm of Sword Heart Clarity, although he recognized the weaknesses and sharp points of the Swordsmanship, he is not able to fully grasp it all at once.
After all, this is his first time executing Sword Heart Clarity, it is normal to be a little stiff, he will become proficient later.
The battle continued, the Sword Qi transformed into long rivers, crisscrossing each other, and the eighteen giant dragons were rolling in the intertwined Sword Qi. However, the space for their attack was getting smaller and smaller.
If it continues like this, the result is already set.
But Li Xuan knew that this was just Xu Yan learning the Ten-Thousand River Swordsmanship.
He hadn't taken out his sword yet!
Xie Lingfeng was also amazed at Xu Yan's strength, at the borderland, there was such a young Martial Artist, it's truly beyond belief.
And what he said about the entry level of Martial Arts, what is the realm of blood Qi?
He had many questions in his heart.
"Is he just entering the realm of Martial Arts? No! Absolutely impossible!"
How can one who's just entered the realm of Martial Arts have such powerful strength?
Hu Shan was watching the battle from a distance, at this moment, as the Ten-Thousand River Swordsmanship unfolded, there was only one scene in the battlefield, the Sword Qi was like a rushing river, and the powerful giant dragons' attack range was getting smaller.
In not much longer, they would be crushed by the Ten-Thousand River Sword Qi.
"Being able to fight with the young master to this extent, he is truly a heaven-born genius!" Hu Shan couldn't help but exclaim.
Xu Yan's blood Qi was surging, at this moment, he thrust out a palm, and the eighteen giant dragons unexpectedly merged into one, transforming into an even more massive and solid giant dragon!
Boom!
The giant dragon burst out, its power was astounding, bold and ferocious, it directly shattered the crisscrossing Sword Qi, creating a wide opening.
Xu Yan moved a step forward, his palms struck out, and at this moment, his surging blood Qi produced a giant dragon with each palm strike. No fancy tricks, only direct brute force.
The utterly forceful and fiery power of the Descending Dragon Palm shifted to its utmost, and as Xu Yan drove the Descending Dragon Palm to the peak of blood Qi stage, a surge of blood Qi rose above his head.
With the utterly forceful and fiery Palm techniques, directly clashed with the Ten-Thousand River Sword Qi.
"The power of Descending Dragon Palm, aside from its flexible variations, its core lies in its utter strength, utterly hot and forceful, only then can it possess the power to descend dragons!" Xu Yan had a sudden insight.
Xie Lingfeng was taken aback, he quietly exclaimed to himself, what a domineering Palm Technique!
As Xu Yan withstood the Ten-Thousand River Sword Qi with the utterly hot and forceful palm force of Descending Dragon Palm, the originally compressed space began to expand continually.
One after another, the Ten-Thousand River Sword Qi started to collapse.
Xie Lingfeng took a deep breath, his gaze grew more serious, and as he moved his body, the Ten-Thousand River Swordsmanship was continually executed. The Ten-Thousand River Sword Qi intensified significantly, layered upon layer, to the point that it eventually echoed with the sound of flowing river water.

chapters.title: Chapter 95 - 82 Xu Yan vs Xie Lingfeng (Request for subscription)_2
chapters.content:
As if a multitude of rivers were rushing by, the battlefield turned into a domain of water.
With a focused gaze, Xu Yan pushed his blood and energy to the limit and slammed down with a palm.
With this palm strike, a whistling sound accompanied the force of the palm, resembling a dragon's roar.
For a moment, the sound of the myriad rivers surged louder and louder until, in the end, it was like a waterfall cascading down, erupting in a deafening roar.
Hu Shan, observing the battle, had a solemn face, a flash of shock passing through his eyes. The young master was forced to push the Myriad Rivers Swordsmanship to its limit!
Even in the Inner Domain, the Grandmasters who could force the young master to exert the Myriad Rivers Swordsmanship to its zenith were only those well-renowned veteran Grandmasters.
Could this youth's strength truly be comparable to those veteran Grandmaster powerhouses?
In the middle of the waterfall's thunderous roar, the whistling sound still couldn't be drowned out, sounding like a series of furious roars.
All of a sudden, eighteen giant dragons swept out again.
Boom!
The Myriad Rivers Sword Qi collapsed layer by layer, and the eighteen giant dragons also continuously shattered.
Xu Yan's Descending Dragon Palm second level achieved a major breakthrough!
Li Xuan couldn't help but marvel. With every intense battle, Xu Yan had something to gain, something to realize. Truly worthy of being the pioneer of his own Martial Arts endeavor.
"Your disciple Xu Yan, his Descending Dragon Palm second level has achieved a major breakthrough, and your Descending Dragon Palm second level is complete."
The Golden Finger fed back the information.
Li Xuan continued to watch the battle in the arena; the outcome had not been decided yet.
The strength of Xie Lingfeng, it must be said, was much stronger than Xue Wuxin's.
His swordsmanship was also incredibly powerful.
A Martial Arts prodigy, and moreover, his talent in Sword Dao was exceedingly outstanding.
But ultimately, he lacked the Enlightened Sword Heart and had not stepped into the gateway of Sword Dao.
At that moment, Xie Lingfeng's gaze sharpened, and a sword light shot out from his hand.
The sword was like a flying rainbow, fast as lightning!
In that instant, the sword light had already neared Xu Yan's throat.
"Flying Rainbow Swordsmanship! The young master was actually forced to use the Flying Rainbow Swordsmanship!"
Hu Shan was astonished.
Sword Venerate Cliff, one of the three peerless sword techniques.
Xu Yan's gaze sharpened, and his figure suddenly drifted away, light as a feather yet extremely fast.
Whoosh!
He was fast, but Xie Lingfeng's sword was faster, and another streak of Flying Rainbow sword light pierced towards him.
Shifting Form, Changing Position!
Xu Yan instantaneously shifted his location, yet his sleeve was still nicked by the sword's edge!
Hum!
The third sword light followed closely behind.
With his Enlightened Sword Heart, Xu Yan could perceive the weakness of this sword attack, but the fleeting opportunity was not enough to grasp.
"This sword technique must be of no low level!"
Xu Yan thought to himself.
He shifted his form and changed positions again, dodging this sword attack.
Then, with a flick, he touched the Precious Sword at his waist.
Hum!
The sword was unsheathed!
Xie Lingfeng paused his hand and did not continue to attack but instead said, "You are also a Sword Dao Martial Artist? Then let me see what your Sword Dao is like!"
"You won't be disappointed!"
Xu Yan replied with a brilliant smile.
He intended to use the Myriad Rivers Swordsmanship to clash with the opponent.
Xie Lingfeng made his move, and with a flash of his sword, the sword light pressed close to Xu Yan in an instant.
At that moment.
A wave of Sword Qi surged forth, like a great river with a thunderous sound, and the sword light seemed to plunge into the raging river, dissipating without a trace.
Xie Lingfeng was taken aback.
The sword technique Xu Yan exhibited felt familiar!
A ludicrous thought crossed his mind, then he suppressed it.
"Impossible!"
He promptly utilized the Flying Rainbow Swordsmanship, the sword light swift as a rainbow skimming the sky.
Xu Yan drew his sword, and the Myriad Rivers surged and roared, his Sword Qi crisscrossing with the Flying Rainbow sword light, constantly colliding!
Hu Shan, watching from a distance, had widened his eyes, a look of shock across his face.
"Myriad Rivers Swordsmanship? How is that possible!"
This was one of Sword Venerate Cliff's top sword techniques. How could he know it?
"No, something's not right, it seems slightly different from the Myriad Rivers Swordsmanship?"
Hu Shan felt more and more aghast the more he observed.
This Myriad Rivers Swordsmanship, while appearing identical to that of Sword Venerate Cliff, had some differences in certain sword moves. What was more terrifying was that the Sword Qi was even more continuous and had the grandeur of a Myriad Rivers' surge, even embodying the soft flow of river water.
It was as if it was an advanced version of Myriad Rivers Swordsmanship?
Xie Lingfeng was no longer just shocked; his heart was trembling.
This was the Myriad Rivers Swordsmanship!
No one understood Myriad Rivers Swordsmanship better than he did. Even though some of the sword moves Xu Yan used were different from his, it was precisely because of these differences that he was trembling.
Those sword moves, he vaguely felt, were the deficiencies of the Myriad Rivers Swordsmanship.
That failed to showcase the might of the Myriad Rivers' surge.
Now, Xu Yan had actually executed it, stronger than him, with a sword momentum like a myriad of rivers flowing, naturally flawless, without any weak point.
His Feihong Swordsmanship, once caught in it, seemed unable to fully display his skill.
"Wanhe Swordsmanship! How could you know our Sword Venerate Cliff's Wanhe Swordsmanship?"
Xie Lingfeng exclaimed in shock.
Xu Yan raised an eyebrow and said, "You just taught it to me!"
What?
Xie Lingfeng was dumbfounded and then overwhelmed with shock.
"You...you learned it while we were sparring just now?"
How the hell is that possible!
He, Xie Lingfeng, proclaimed to be the first Sword Dao prodigy in a thousand years from Sword Venerate Cliff, couldn't even do that!
"Is there a problem?"
Xu Yan asked with a puzzled face, "Since I've entered the threshold of Sword Dao, aren't all sword techniques visible to me without barriers, to be picked and used as I wish?
"Don't tell me you haven't entered the threshold of Sword Dao?"
Entering the threshold of Sword Dao allows one to adopt another's sword techniques for their own use?
Sword Venerate Cliff's martial artists, all of whom have entered the threshold of Sword Dao, who can freely adopt sword techniques for their own use?
Xie Lingfeng's mind was a mess.
"Are you sure that entering the threshold of Sword Dao means you can freely adopt sword techniques for your own use?"
Xie Lingfeng's face was full of disbelief.
It felt like the other person was insulting his intelligence!
Not to mention entering the threshold, even Great Grandmasters of Sword Dao couldn't do it!
"Of course!"
Xu Yan affirmed with confidence and then looked at Xie Lingfeng with puzzlement, "You couldn't possibly be, still not having entered the threshold of Sword Dao, right?"
This person, with his strong and extremely sharp swordsmanship, would not be easy to defeat.
"Bullshit!"
Xie Lingfeng roared angrily, "I, Xie Lingfeng, entered the threshold of Sword Dao at the age of six!"
"Really?"
"Absolutely true!"
Xie Lingfeng spoke through clenched teeth.
Xu Yan lifted his hand for a strike, the sword light swift as a flying rainbow, as quick as lightning. In an instant, it was already upon Xie Lingfeng's chest.
He was greatly startled and hurriedly dodged.
Sss!
His clothes were slashed with a tear!
But at this moment, he didn't care about that, his face full of terror.
Feihong Swordsmanship!
This was a move he had used himself!
Xu Yan struck with the sword again, once more using the Feihong Swordsmanship.
Xie Lingfeng countered with his sword, but his mind was already in chaos. The unique sword technique from Sword Venerate Cliff, Feihong Swordsmanship; he learned it after watching once?
No!
That's impossible!
"How did you, practice the Feihong Swordsmanship?!"
As Xu Yan executed another Feihong Swordsmanship, he said, "Isn't this what you just displayed? Like I said, for those who have entered the threshold of Sword Dao, all sword techniques are transparent and can be adopted and used at will."
He then shook his head regretfully, "It turns out, you haven't entered the threshold of Sword Dao. I had thought I could find someone to discuss Sword Dao with."
Xie Lingfeng was furious. He was Sword Venerate Cliff's Sword Dao prodigy for a thousand years, having entered the threshold at six, and to be insulted like this!
"You're spouting nonsense!"
Xu Yan raised an eyebrow and said, "Then let me perform a few sword techniques. Let's see if you can adopt them for your own use."
Saying this, he stabbed out with his sword, and with a tearing sound, a sword light stood in place, domineering beyond compare, sweeping through the sky.
Xie Lingfeng's heart tightened, and he hurriedly used his sword to defend, while Xu Yan continued his relentless attacks, one sword technique after another, all swift and ferocious, domineering beyond compare.
"What kind of swordsmanship is this? On par with Wanhe Swordsmanship!"
Xie Lingfeng felt a chill in his heart.
"Have you learned it yet?"
Xu Yan asked.
Xie Lingfeng, grinding his teeth in anger, shouted, "You are mocking me. Who can learn the enemy's sword techniques and moves during a battle?"
No matter how talented, it was not possible.
"Those who have entered the threshold of Sword Dao, can certainly do it. Thus, the battle between Sword Dao martial artists is never about the sword techniques, but the Sword Dao itself!"
Xu Yan stated matter-of-factly.
"Bullshit!"
Xie Lingfeng's face turned red with rage.
Xu Yan sheathed his sword and stepped back, a look of disappointment on his face, "I understand now, you haven't actually entered the Sword Dao, it's just that you don't know it yourself, thinking you have. I can't blame you!
"It's your limited vision that has bounded your understanding!"
Xie Lingfeng's face turned the color of liver, on the verge of exploding with anger. This was the third or fourth time he was being humiliated!
It was too outrageous!
"I, Xie Lingfeng, today with you..."
Before he could finish, Xu Yan interrupted, "I'm afraid you don't even know about the Enlightened Sword Heart, do you?"
What?!
Xie Lingfeng's face was blank with confusion. What did he just say about being enlightened?

chapters.title: Chapter 96 - 83 Xie Lingfeng: I have been practicing pseudo Martial Arts?_1
chapters.content:
"What do you mean?"
Xie Lingfeng took a deep breath, trying to calm his raging heart.
"Clear Mind in Sword Heart, the essence of Sword Dao. Only with a clear mind can one step into Sword Dao, don't you know?"
Xu Yan asked, puzzled.
"???"
Xie Lingfeng looked perplexed. Clear Mind in Sword Heart?
He had never heard of it!
He turned to look at Hu Shan, who was watching the fight from a distance.
Hu Shan was equally bewildered, shaking his head to indicate that he too had never heard of it.
"Are you making up a name to deceive me? Do you think I, Xie Lingfeng, would fall for it?"
Xie Lingfeng drew a deep breath, glaring at Xu Yan.
He kept telling himself: "Don't be fooled, this is a lie, he's deceiving me!"
Xu Yan looked as if he had expected this reaction, saying, "You don't even know the Clear Mind in Sword Heart, yet you claim to have entered the gate of Sword Dao?"
More than ever, he became certain that the Inner Realm Martial Arts were false martial arts, the real martial arts were the ones taught by his master!
"Ha! Why don't you explain what this Clear Mind in Sword Heart is?"
Xie Lingfeng sneered.
He wasn't going to fall for it!
"Those who have Clear Mind in Sword Heart have a clear mind in Sword Dao. They can see through swordsmanship and sword skills at a glance and use them at will.
"Only Clear Mind in Sword Heart can lead one into Sword Dao.
"This is the foundation of Sword Dao!"
Xu Yan thought with pity that Xie Lingfeng didn't even know about the Clear Mind in Sword Heart. Despite having not yet entered the gate of Sword Dao, he mistakenly believed that he was a Sword Dao Martial Artist.
"Nonsense! How can there be someone with Clear Mind in Sword Heart in this world?"
Xie Lingfeng's mind was in a whirl, but he was convinced Xu Yan was lying to him!
If someone had Clear Mind in Sword Heart, wouldn't that make swordsmanship skills easy to learn?
Where would the challenge be then?
"I have Clear Mind in Sword Heart, that's why I can see through your sword play and use it as I wish!"
Xu Yan said arrogantly.
"No! That's impossible!"
Xie Lingfeng gritted his teeth and said: "Stop tricking me, you must have learned my 'Sword Zun Cliff' swordsmanship elsewhere!"
"I only study Sword Dao, not swordsmanship. As for your Sword Zun Cliff swordsmanship, I look down on it. If you don't believe me, let's continue our duel!"
Xu Yan raised his sword, indicating Xie Lingfeng could make his move.
Xie Lingfeng gritted his teeth, but he didn't make a move.
At this moment, he discovered that he didn't have the courage to draw his sword!
As soon as he made a move, his sword skills would be used by the opponent the next moment. How could he fight this way?
Hu Shan, who was watching from a distance, became worried and ran over, saying: "Young Master, don't let him confuse you and shake your confidence!"
Xie Lingfeng gritted his teeth and said: "But his sword skills..."
"He definitely stole them. I'll deal with him!"
Hu Shan said with a grim expression.
He drew his longsword and turned to Xu Yan: "Let's see how you 'borrow' my sword skills for your own use!"
Xu Yan raised an eyebrow, saying, "Go ahead!"
"Take this! Let's see how you 'borrow' my sword tricks!"
Hu Shan sneered, his longsword sweeping out like a violent gale.
Xie Lingfeng took a deep breath, watching the battle with a serious expression, and thought to himself: "Did he also learn Hu Shan's Gale Swordsmanship? When were the Sword Zun Cliff's swordsmanship skills leaked? "
"No! That's impossible, top swordsmanship is not available for ordinary disciples to practice, and among the three top-level swordsmanships, not all core disciples qualify to practice them."
Xie Lingfeng was haunted by an absurd thought.
That was, Xu Yan's words might be true!
He had Clear Mind in Sword Heart, and he could understand the swordsmanship at a glance, and use whatever he wanted at will.
When he thought of this possibility, he felt a bit bewildered.
How could he, who was hailed as the first Sword Dao genius of Sword Zun Cliff in a millennium, not even have entered the gate of Sword Dao?
He found it hard to accept!
Hu Shan sneered in his heart, thinking how ridiculous the idea of Clear Mind in Sword Heart was!
This guy must have stolen Sword Zun Cliff's swordsmanship through some means or channels.
Unleashing his Gale Swordsmanship, Hu Shan launched continuous fierce attacks. Suddenly, Xu Yan drew his sword. His sword was like a gale, and it was Hu Shan's Gale Swordsmanship.
Hu Shan's face displayed a cold smirk, but he didn't seem surprised.
Suddenly, he changed his moves!
Hiding behind the gale work sword qi, a ray of sword light whipped out, following by the second and the third... The ground-hugging sword light, concealed by the gale work sword qi, exploded all of a sudden.
This was his unique kill move, created to kill enemies!
It didn't belong to Sword Zun Cliff. Over the years, through numerous death battles, he created this ground-hugging sword light move and achieved ultimate victories!
Under the cover of the Gale Sword Qi, it produced an unexpected effect.
Anyone who had seen his ground-hugging sword light was dead!
No one knew that he had such a hidden kill move!
Xie Lingfeng, who was watching the duel, was impressive. Hu Shan actually had such a hidden move. This was not Sword Zun Cliff's swordsmanship. Let's see how the opponent borrowed it for his own use!
Xu Yan raised an eyebrow, pointed his sword and swiftly moved his figure to dodge. Then he waved his sword, and among the Gale Sword Qi, one after another ground-hugging sword light launched.
It was stronger, faster, and more exquisite than Hu Shan's!
At this moment, Hu Shan had not noticed the ground-hugging sword light launched by Xu Yan.
Xie Lingfeng, who was watching the battle, his pupils contracted and his heart was hit by a storm. Isn't this the kill move used by Hu Shan?
Does Clear Mind in Sword Heart really exist?!
"Careful!"
Xie Lingfeng hastily drew his sword, rainbow-like sword light burst out, making a sharp whooshing sound, blocking Xu Yan's ground-hugging sword light.
Despite this, there was still a sword of light that burst out from the ground, shearing off a few strands of Hu Shan's hair and leaving a shallow sword mark on his cheek!

chapters.title: Chapter 97 - 83 Xie Lingfeng: The Martial Arts I Cultivate Are Actually False?_2
chapters.content:
Xu Yan sheathed his sword, standing tall and proud.
Hu Shan's lips quivered, his face pale as a sheet, his eyes wide with disbelief.
This was his own original creation!
How could the other party have learned it on the spot and employed it better than he ever did, stronger too?
What kind of monster was this? With such a fiendish talent, who among the world's swordsmen could be his match?
Who could draw a sword against him?
Only if, by possessing a higher realm and crushing him with absolute power.
Otherwise, among those of the same realm, he was invincible!
No!
He could even fight across different realms of power!
At this moment, he had no choice but to believe that what Xu Yan had said was true; he had learned the swordsmanship on the spot and picked it at will for his use.
Xie Lingfeng felt utterly disheartened.
This battle had dealt him such a blow that he even began to doubt his life.
Doubts about his natural talent for the sword had begun to manifest!
It took him a long while to calm his emotions slightly, sheathed his sword, took a deep breath, and conceded with a cupped fist salute, "Brother Xu, it is I who has lost!"
Although, in fact, he had not lost yet.
However, Xie Lingfeng knew that he couldn't achieve victory.
His swordsmanship was thoroughly understood by his opponent; he was merely maintaining an undefeated position by virtue of his higher realm.
"You haven't lost, after all, I haven't beaten you yet!"
After thinking for a moment, Xu Yan spoke the truth.
Xie Lingfeng was strong, a master of the sword, lacking only a clear and enlightened heart of the sword.
Even though Xu Yan could see through the weaknesses in Xie Lingfeng's swordplay, he wasn't confident that he would be able to seize those fleeting opportunities with his current strength.
Moreover, given Xie Lingfeng's extraordinary ability to adapt, even if Xu Yan could strike at a weak point, it wouldn't necessarily mean he could defeat him.
However, if the fight were to continue, Xu Yan felt that he would be victorious.
But seeing the other already so demoralized, he thought it best to leave some room for grace.
Xie Lingfeng gave a bitter smile. His swordsmanship had been seen through; there was no chance of victory, only defeat awaited him. It was just a matter of time.
Xu Yan was merely consoling him.
After a long silence, Xie Lingfeng spoke, "I've been studying the sword since I was a child, entering the path at six, and after twenty years, I became the youngest Grandmaster Martial Artist at Sword Venerate Cliff in a millennium.
"I used to be confident that in the Inner Realm, among my peers, there was no one who could prevail over me. It was only after today's battle with Brother Xu that I realized there are higher skies beyond my own.
"However, I have many questions in my heart, and I wonder if Brother Xu would be willing to enlighten me."
Xu Yan pondered for a moment. Xie Lingfeng's attitude was acceptable; he wasn't overbearing. Besides, Xu Yan also wanted to know more about the Inner Realm to prepare for his future journey there.
So, Xu Yan nodded and said, "I can!"
Xie Lingfeng stared intently at Xu Yan and asked, "Brother Xu, are you from the Wasteland?"
Xu Yan smiled and said, "I know what you want to ask. Don't worry, I'll tell you—I am indeed the person from the Wasteland you speak of.
"You must be wondering how I could become a Martial Artist, right?
"In the Wasteland, without the Heavenly Earth Lingji, it's impossible to cultivate into a Martial Artist, isn't that so?"
Xie Lingfeng nodded, "Exactly!"
He was truly shocked. There existed Martial Artists in the Wasteland, and their strength was formidable.
"The true Martial Arts isn't confined by the Tian Di you're in. Even without the Spirit Mechanism, by making oneself a bridge, you can still connect with Tian Di and become a Martial Artist…" Xu Yan said with a solemn expression.
"The true Martial Arts?"
Xie Lingfeng frowned. What was the true Martial Arts?
Could it be that what he had been practicing was a false path?
This absurd thought surfaced in his mind.
"Yes, the true Martial Arts, whereas what you practice in the Inner Realm is, in fact, a pseudo-Martial Arts," Xu Yan affirmed with a nod.
"Impossible! Absolutely impossible, gibberish!"
Hu Shan roared as he jumped up.
What nonsense!
The Martial Arts practiced in the Inner Realm is false, and those of the Wasteland are true?
Such a statement contradicts everything known!
"I know it's hard for you to accept, but that's the truth!"
Xu Yan was unsurprised by the reaction.
Who would accept it after half a lifetime of cultivation, suddenly being told what you practiced was fake?
Xie Lingfeng's expression became serious as he said in a deep voice, "Brother Xu, why would you say such a thing? How could my martial arts be a sham? There are merely differences between the two, it doesn't make one real and the other fake, does it?"
If the martial arts he cultivated were a sham, wouldn't the legacy of Sword Venerate Cliff also be sham martial arts?
All the martial arts of the Inner Realm are sham martial arts?
He couldn't accept such a result. If the word got out, how many martial artists would fly into a rage, how many lineages and powers would be seething with a murderous aura? This would be shaking the very foundation of the Inner Realm Martial Arts.
"Come on, let's discuss this Martial Arts, discuss it clearly, and you will understand why it is a sham martial arts!"
Xu Yan was invigorated, with a face full of excitement.
Discuss Martial Arts!
Xie Lingfeng and Hu Shan's spirits lifted—discuss Martial Arts!
"Good!"
Xie Lingfeng sat down cross-legged.
"Should you start, or should I?"
Xu Yan's face was still filled with excitement.
Finally, someone could discuss Martial Arts with him. He wanted to tell Xie Lingfeng and the others what true Martial Arts really were.
"I'll begin."
Xie Lingfeng spoke.
"Alright, please do!"
Xu Yan nodded.
"Martial Arts begin from the Ninth Grade... First Grade represents the powerhouses of Martial Arts. Breaking through the constraints of First Grade, drawing nature's spiritual energy into the body, and condensing Martial Arts' Inner Qi makes one a Cultivation Technique Grandmaster, and this identifies one as a powerhouse among Martial Arts.
Above the Cultivation Technique Grandmasters there are the Great Cultivation Technique Grandmasters..."
"Great Cultivation Technique Grandmasters have Martial Arts' Inner Qi flowing like rivers, like blood coursing through the entire body..."
Xie Lingfeng started from the basics of Martial Arts, the Ninth Grade realm, and went all the way to the realm of the Great Cultivation Technique Grandmasters.
That was the Martial Arts of the Inner Realm.
Xu Yan listened with rapt attention. Xie Lingfeng's explanation was more detailed and complete than Xue Wuxin's. It gave him a true understanding of Inner Realm Martial Arts.
Inner Realm Martial Arts were not entirely worthless.
However, Xu Yan's belief that Inner Realm Martial Arts were sham Martial Arts did not waver.
On the contrary, it became even more firm.
Li Xuan, who had been observing quietly, couldn't help but sigh after hearing Xie Lingfeng's exposition, "Inner Realm Martial Arts are strong, but they still fall short of the Martial Arts I created. If my Martial Arts could be widely practiced, once the word spreads, I'm afraid the Inner Realm Martial Arts will be massively impacted."
Every martial artist yearns for strength.
Everyone wants to cultivate more powerful Cultivation Techniques, and his newly founded Martial Arts were stronger than the Martial Arts of the Inner Realm. Once it spread, Inner Realm Martial Arts would gradually be abandoned.
And those Martial Arts forces with ancient legacies would certainly not take this lying down. And since the Martial Arts of the Inner Realm had been passed down for a long time and had countless believers, it would surely trigger a fierce debate on the true and false Martial Arts.
Of course, all this was based on the premise that he would spread his Martial Arts and that it would gain some scale and attract attention.
There would be no danger for Xu Yan in this trip. Xie Lingfeng and the others didn't put on airs because they came from the Inner Realm, so Li Xuan didn't continue to stay.
The final result of the discussion on Martial Arts, he could predict.
"Brother Xu, it's your turn!"
After finishing his explanation, Xie Lingfeng looked solemnly at Xu Yan.
"Alright!"
Xu Yan nodded and began, "To cultivate Martial Arts, one must first have a solid foundation, and that foundation starts with Skin Refinement... Those who transform their bones into golden bones are considered prodigies of ancient times. Once someone has golden bones, even if they die and are buried for ten thousand years, their bones remain shiny and are even more durable than steel..."
"Wait a moment!"
Xie Lingfeng interrupted.
At this moment, his head was buzzing. The foundation of Martial Arts is Skin Refinement? Achieving grand mastery in Skin Refinement makes it hard for regular swords and sabers to injure you?
Following that is Bone Refinement, and it even divides into Iron Bone, Bronze Bone, and Gold Bone?
Having refined Gold Bone, even if they die and are buried underground for ten thousand years, their bones remain shiny and are even more durable than steel?
It sounded so mysterious and unrealistic.
He felt as if his brain was not only buzzing but also in a state of burning, as if it was on fire.
"You're saying, Gold Bone buried underground will still be shiny after ten thousand years?"
This is the foundational realm of Martial Arts?
"Yes!"
Xu Yan nodded and said, "A solid foundation is the essence of Martial Arts, and above Golden Bones are Jade Bones, flawless Jade Bones that remain unchanged for eternity!"
Xie Lingfeng scratched his head, feeling as if his brain was burning, and his mind suffered a tremendous shock.
Is Martial Arts like this?
So mysterious?
Could it be that what I've been practicing is indeed sham Martial Arts?
"Brother Xie, are you alright?"
Xu Yan looked at Xie Lingfeng, who had messed up his hair and whose face was a mix of pale and flushed, seemingly in a quite abnormal state.
"Learning that what he's been practicing is sham Martial Arts, the blow is too deep. Ah, perhaps I shouldn't have been so blunt with him."
Xu Yan sighed in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 98 - 84 Sudden Thunderstorm, Vajra of Wind and Lightning_1
chapters.content:
Xie Lingfeng took several deep breaths to calm himself down, then said in a deep voice, "Brother Xu, continue!"
"Do you really want me to continue?"
Xu Yan asked hesitantly.
"Continue!"
Xie Lingfeng clenched his teeth.
"Alright."
Xu Yan nodded and continued, "After Bone Refinement comes Viscera Refinement... when the sinews and bones thunder and the Qi-Blood is vigorous, that is the entrance to Martial Arts, and I have already perfected the Qi-Blood Realm!"
By the time Xu Yan had finished speaking, Xie Lingfeng felt his head was about to explode, buzzing sounds ringing in his ears, and he felt a burning sensation.
It was as if his brain was on fire!
He breathed heavily, his eyes gradually losing focus, beginning to question his life.
He, who had started practicing Martial Arts at the age of six, and entered the Sword Dao at the same age... was praised by everyone as the Sword Venerate Cliff, the foremost prodigy in Sword Dao in a thousand years.
He had thought so too.
Around the Inner Domain, few of his peers could match him.
And in the art of Sword Dao, he was the best among his peers.
As a result, coming to the Border Wilderness was like discovering the harsh truth; he had never even entered the gates of Sword Dao.
Even worse, the Martial Arts he had been practicing was actually a false practice!
Hu Shan panted heavily, his eyes red with rage, and he growled, "Don't talk nonsense, our Sword Venerate Cliff's legacy, how could it be a false practice!"
Xu Yan was not angry but instead looked at him with pity, thinking how truly pitiful it was to discover after a lifetime of practice that he had been following a false practice.
His inability to accept it was understandable.
He couldn't help but reflect on himself, "Was I, maybe, too blunt?"
He asked aloud, "Tell me this, I have perfected the Qi-Blood Realm, which is just the entrance to Martial Arts, yet you are at the Grandmaster level, the pinnacle of Martial Arts, but your strength is not equal to mine.
"Isn't it obvious which is true and which is false?"
"I..."
Hu Shan was at a loss for words.
One just entering Martial Arts, the other supposedly at the pinnacle, yet the former is stronger than the latter. It goes without saying who's practicing the true and who the false.
Xie Lingfeng rose up dejectedly, cupped his hands in respect, and said, "Brother Xu, thank you for enlightening me. I need some time alone, I will visit you another day to express my gratitude!"
"No worries, Brother Xie, please!"
Xu Yan revealed a bright smile.
Xie Lingfeng and Hu Shan rose into the air and returned to the Capital City of Qi Country.
This trip to the Border Wilderness was originally to slay Xue Wuxin, but it turned out that someone else had already killed him.
To think that the Border Wilderness actually had Martial Artists.
And after a series of sparring matches, they discovered the practice they followed was false Martial Arts?
Their worldview on Martial Arts had collapsed!
The Capital City was bustling.
Emperor Qi and his ministers were all waiting for the outcome of the great battle.
Finally, the two figures returned.
They went straight back to their residence in the imperial palace.
Emperor Qi was overjoyed, "Quick, prepare grand gifts, we must thank the master!"
He shot a provocative glance at Guo Rongshan, as if to say: just you wait and see!
Guo Rongshan's heart sank.
When Emperor Qi left, the ministers scattered like they were avoiding the plague, staying far away from Guo Rongshan and his son, loudly proclaiming the Emperor's wisdom and martial prowess as they hurriedly followed behind him.
"Father!"
Guo Yunkai looked worried.
"Yan'er is back!"
Guo Rongshan suddenly spoke out, visibly relaxing.
Xu Yan arrived, flying over.
"Yan'er, I'm relieved you're alright. What's the result?"
Guo Rongshan asked with a sigh of relief.
"Grandfather, don't worry. The practice Xie Lingfeng and the others have been following is just a false Martial Arts, nothing to worry about. He has already recognized his deficiencies!"
Xu Yan said with a smile.
Guo Rongshan, shocked, looked back towards the palace and narrowed his eyes slightly.
"Yunkai, issue the order, we will hold a grand court meeting tomorrow!"
"Yes, Father!"
Guo Yunkai was also overjoyed.
Xu Yan had won!
At the imperial annex, in the residence of Xie Lingfeng and Hu Shan, the two men sat on stone benches staring blankly at each other after their return, both feeling somewhat numb.
Xu Yan's discussion on Martial Arts had dealt them a huge blow; their beliefs in Martial Arts had crumbled, and they began to doubt their lives.
Especially Xie Lingfeng, who couldn't stop recalling what Xu Yan had said about Martial Arts; the more he thought, the more unfathomable it seemed, it just didn't feel real. He thought so hard his head felt like it was burning, yet he couldn't understand how such a mysterious Martial Arts could be practiced.
"Master, the master, did you bring back Xu Yan's head?"
Emperor Qi came running over excitedly.
Behind him followed the Eldest Prince.
As for the Third Prince, he had been neglected.
"Master?"
Emperor Qi asked with a puzzled look on his face. Why did it feel like the two masters were not quite right?
They had no reaction despite him standing right before them.
"Master? You two masters?"
He reached out and waved his hand in front of Xie Lingfeng's eyes.
"Get lost!"
The master finally reacted, but it was only to grab Emperor Qi by the collar and toss him out.
The Eldest Prince's face turned pale, he swallowed hard, and scurried off, only to find outside the annex that the Emperor was standing up with a livid face.
"Father Emperor!"
He hurriedly went forward to support him.
Emperor Qi, with an angered face, snapped, "The person you brought..."
"Shh!"
The Eldest Prince turned white with fear, quickly raised his finger, and motioned for Emperor Qi to be silent.
Emperor Qi hastily closed his mouth, and with the eunuch's help, he left with a darkened expression on his face.
"Your Majesty, the Grand Chancellor will hold a grand court meeting tomorrow!"
A eunuch rushed in to report.
Emperor Qi, enraged, started, "That Guo..."
"Your Majesty, Xu Yan has returned!"
The eunuch hurriedly interrupted.
Emperor Qi held his words back, his face turning red, and he gritted his teeth, "Issue an imperial decree to the ministers, grand court meeting tomorrow!"
It was truly humiliating!
Inside, Emperor Qi felt an overwhelming frustration. Seeing the Eldest Prince beside him, he took a deep breath and kicked him to the ground.
"You wretch, where did you find such 'masters'? They have enraged me to death!"
After kicking him several times and releasing some of his anger, he strode away.

chapters.title: Chapter 99 - 84: Sudden Thunderstorm, Wind Thunder Vajra_2
chapters.content:
The Crown Prince was so frustrated he felt like puking blood.
He cursed internally, "Old geezer, always taking his anger out on his son, good for nothing!"
Xu Yan settled in the residence of the Qi King, waiting for a visit from Xie Lingfeng.
He was absolutely thrilled.
It was a worthwhile trip - he had exchanged techniques with the grandmaster from the Inner Domain and gained new insights about Sword Dao, which was helpful for his comprehension of Sword Intent.
And he'd shown the martial artists of the Inner Domain that they were practicing false Martial Arts.
In the palace's side residence, Xie Lingfeng and Hu Shan had been sitting still for a day, their minds in turmoil, feeling completely at a loss.
The collapse of their Martial Arts viewpoint had dealt them a devastating blow.
They wanted to refute the claim that they were practicing false Martial Arts, but every time they thought of Xu Yan's explanation of Martial Arts, it was too profound and incredible, making their own Martial Arts pale in comparison.
Xu Yan, being only a beginner in Martial Arts, was already able to fight with them at a grandmaster level. It was apparent which was real and which was false.
Emperor Qi, who had started the day on cloud nine, had his mood drop down, thinking he could reestablish his imperial prestige, yet it all came to naught.
The grand court meeting began.
Court officials fawned with smirky faces, greeting Guo Rongshan before and after, acting even more respectful than they would towards Emperor Qi.
In the current Qi Country, it was common knowledge that Emperor Qi was merely a figurehead with no real power. All matters of state were decided by Guo Rongshan.
The Crown Prince entered the grand hall, only to be tripped up by the Third Prince as soon as he approached him, stumbling and almost falling over.
He immediately glared at the Third Prince.
"Your Majesty, the Crown Prince is behaving improperly in the court meeting..."
Guo Rongshan stood up solemnly and bowed to Emperor Qi.
Before he could finish speaking, Emperor Qi had already lost his temper and shouted, "Bring that rebellious son of mine out, beat him with thirty wooden planks, and beat him hard!"
The Crown Prince was instantly shocked: !!!
Another thirty wooden planks?!?
He cursed inwardly, "You old fool, do you really know how to do anything other than vent your anger on your son?"
Guo Rongshan's mouth twitched as he quietly sat down. He had meant to use this opportunity to definitively disqualify the Crown Prince from the succession, perhaps by confining him to the palace for a month. He didn't expect Emperor Qi to announce such a severe punishment directly.
As expected, the royal family is ruthless indeed!
Guo Rongshan sighed to himself. During the rest of the grand court meeting, several state affairs were discussed, some officials were demoted, some were promoted, and Emperor Qi was not involved at all.
All he needed to do was sit at the top, listen and give his edict.
After the grand court meeting, Guo Rongshan had complete control over the affairs of Qi Country.
Emperor Qi returned to his bookroom, fuming.
Unable to hold back, he once again visited the side residence seeking Xie Lingfeng, and was once again tossed out.
Emperor Qi was nearly enraged to death!
What kind of great man is this? Intolerably arrogant!
"Bring someone to beat my rebellious son with thirty wooden planks again!"
Emperor Qi ordered.
The chief eunuch felt sorry for the Crown Prince and said softly, "Your Majesty, if you beat him with another thirty planks, I'm afraid the Crown Prince won't be able to take it."
Emperor Qi was silent for a moment and said, "Then wait until his injuries have healed a bit, and then beat him!"
After two whole days of sitting still, Xie Lingfeng finally regained some spirit. He took a deep breath and said, "Hu Shan, I'm going to visit Xu Yan."
"Young Master, go ahead, I need some more time to think."
Hu Shan responded listlessly.
Xie Lingfeng left him, emerged from the side residence, and went to visit Xu Yan at Qi King's residence.
"Greetings to Elder Guo!"
Xie Lingfeng pays his respects to Guo Rongshan as he sees him.
Although the man before him was not a martial artist, he was Xu Yan's grandfather, so the respect that should be shown was not to be omitted.
"It's Young Master Xie, Yan'er has been waiting for you. Please, go in."
Guo Rongshan greeted him with a smile.
Today, Emperor Qi has invited him, his sworn brother, to visit the imperial garden.
"Brother Guo is here, please have a seat."
Emperor Qi said with a warm expression.
"Your Majesty is too kind."
Guo Rongshan performed a bow.
After some pleasantries, Emperor Qi said with a trace of anger, "Brother Guo, those two so-called great sages, have no sense of propriety, disrespect elders, and show contempt for the court of my Qi Country. They should be punished severely!"
They have the audacity to throw me out directly!
Even Xu Yan did not do such a thing.
Emperor Qi's anger grew as he thought. Since high-ranking people cannot deal with Xu Yan, let Xu Yan deal with these two high-ranking people and vent his anger.
Yet, Guo Rongshan showed a surprised expression and said, "How could that be? Young Master Xie has always been very respectful to me and is not disrespecting his elders. Who's trying to slander Young Master Xie?"
Emperor Qi: !!!
His composure was somewhat shattered. Everyone is belittling me, aren't they!
He glanced silently at Guo Rongshan, then clenched his teeth and shouted, "The dog slave dare to slander the high-ranking people and instigate troubles. He should be put to death!"
Emperor Qi was seething with rage. He pointed to one of the eunuchs standing on standby outside and commanded, "Take that man down for me and chop him off!"
The eunuch, shocked, lifted his head pleading, "Your Majesty, please spare me, I didn't..."
The Chief Eunuch covered his mouth abruptly, and several other eunuchs surrounding him hastily came forward, restraining and dragging him away.
Guo Rongshan's mouth twitched a little. He felt that Emperor Qi seemed to have been too agitated, and it was taking a toll on his mental state.
"The Emperor has aged. Perhaps it's time for the Crown Prince to ascend to the throne? Young people can better endure such stimulation!" he thought to himself.
Interjected Rongshan, "Your Majesty, thirty lashes would suffice. Please refrain from causing unnecessary death!"
"Hmm!"
Emperor Qi grunted in response.
Such royal duty is stifling!
At Prince An's mansion, the First Prince had already given up on himself.
He was lying on his bed, attended by two beautiful women, seemingly waiting aimlessly for death.
The search for a great master is abandoned.
Before seeking a great master, he was flogged thirty times!
Having found a great master, he still was flogged thirty times. Seems like regardless of finding a great master or not, he would face punishment. So why bother searching for a great master!
Therefore, the First Prince had completely given up.
...
In Yunshan County, Li Xuan had returned from the capital.
He was waiting for a visit from Xie Lingfeng, the great master.
Meng Chong, however, was still contemplating the Fist of Wind and Thunder. For the time being, there did not seem to be much progress.
One day, Yunshan County was shrouded in dark clouds.
Meng Chong was on a hillside outside the county town.
Images of his master demonstrating the Fist of Wind and Thunder repeatedly surfaced in his mind, and he pondered over the intent of the Wind and Thunder in these movements.
Suddenly!
A strong wind swept across!
Whoosh!
Rumble!
Lightning tore through the gloomy skies, flickering and disappearing into the clouds.
A storm is coming!
Meng Chong abruptly looked up at the sky.
Rumble!
In an instant, another blinding bolt of lightning tore through the thick clouds, illuminating the dark sky. A sudden gust of wind swept across.
In that instant, something sparked in Meng Chong's mind. He faintly seized the momentum of the wind and thunder!
Crash!
A bolt of lightning suddenly struck down, instantly splitting a massive tree in the distance.
A gust of wind suddenly arose, rustling the fallen leaves through the cracks of the trees. In an instant, the leaves were flying and dancing among the trees.
"I understand!"
In that moment, a flash of enlightenment crossed Meng Chong's mind. He felt like he had grasped the essence of the momentum of Wind and Thunder.
With his Blood Qi surging, a golden light appeared, and his Blood Qi Golden Bell shone brightly. Meng Chong launched a punch, a powerful force that resembled a thunderbolt, swift and fierce.
Then, one punch following another, like a raging wind that seemed to penetrate everything.
Rumble!
With a sudden punch, like an abrupt flash of lightning, the fierce and unparalleled force of the fist knocked a large tree down.
"Fist of Wind and Thunder, I've understood, this is the momentum of Wind and Thunder!"
Meng Chong was extremely excited, his body moving nimbly as he unleashed a flurry of punches.
Crackle!
Large raindrops began to fall, a storm was approaching.
And amidst the rain, a burly, bald young man was practicing his punches. His fists carrying the momentum of thunderbolts and gusty winds, repelling the falling raindrops.
Each punch seemed to carry a thunderbolt and whip up a gust of wind, scattering the falling raindrops and dissipating the incoming gusty wind!
Around him was a glow of golden light, emitting the fierceness of a Golden Vajra Arhat, each punch raising wind and thunder.
Successful comprehension of the Fist of Wind and Thunder!
"Such a heavy rain!"
Under the eaves, Li Xuan was watching the downpour, the lightning and thunder amid the thick, dark clouds, the strong winds that seemed about to lift the eaves.
"My second disciple is practicing in the woods. He won't get struck by lightning, would he?"
A worry suddenly crossed Li Xuan's mind.
It was uncertain if Meng Chong's current Great Solar Golden Bell could withstand a direct lightning strike?

chapters.title: Chapter 100 - 85 Xu Yan Has a Sudden Enlightenment, Mountains and Rivers Sword Intent_1
chapters.content:
```
Boom!
A bolt of lightning struck down from the sky, the sound of the thunder deafening.
Li Xuan sighed to himself, "The majesty of heaven and earth is truly extraordinary. Even with my current strength, it might be difficult to withstand the power of this lightning."
Curiosity suddenly struck him, wondering whether the Martial Dao of this world involved a concept of transcending tribulations?
"In the Martial Dao I created, I won't include such a tribulation. Why trouble myself with a heavenly test for no reason? Wouldn't that be foolish?"
Li Xuan thought to himself.
As for whether one's strength would be insufficient without the test of heavenly tribulations.
That wasn't a problem at all.
Who says that only those who transcend heavenly tribulations are strong?
To directly control the power of heaven and earth, to master the force of heavenly tribulations without actually undergoing them, wouldn't that be possible?
"As long as the cultivation technique is well-developed, and the disciple is monstrous enough, anything is possible!"
Li Xuan wore a smile on his face.
"Your disciple Meng Chong has successfully cultivated the Wind and Thunder Vajra Fist, your Wind and Thunder Vajra Fist is complete!"
Suddenly, a golden light appeared.
Feedback from the Golden Finger arrived.
Meng Chong had comprehended the Wind and Thunder Vajra Fist and had already cultivated it.
"Good, good, since the Wind and Thunder Vajra Fist has been comprehended, it's time to continue teaching Meng Chong new techniques."
Li Xuan was overjoyed.
In his mind, the technique of the Wind and Thunder Vajra Fist was already so impressive; it was truly powerful.
When he threw a punch, a surge of lightning power followed.
"Against a demonic cultivator like Xue Wuxin, the Wind and Thunder Vajra Fist would utterly restrain him!"
If Xue Wuxin hadn't died, facing the current Meng Chong, the outcome would be uncertain.
The rain pattered down, but the wild wind had stopped.
The flashes of lightning and thunder ceased as well.
Meng Chong returned through the rain.
"Master, I have comprehended the Wind and Thunder Vajra Fist!"
Meng Chong said excitedly.
"Good! You have not disappointed me, disciple. Settle these thoughts for now, for I shall teach you The Eight Diagrams and the way of the saber!"
Li Xuan nodded approvingly.
"Yes, Master!"
Meng Chong was ecstatic.
Li Xuan decided to teach each disciple The Eight Diagrams, leaving it to them to see what they could comprehend.
Each disciple's insights would inevitably be different.
Movement techniques were included within, and other mysteries as well. Perhaps, when the disciple reached a higher realm and their strength increased, they would have new insights.
Take Xu Yan for example, who comprehended the Light Goose movement technique and during the battle with Xue Wuxin, suddenly understood the art of shifting shape and position.
One wonders what kind of movement technique Meng Chong will comprehend.
Perhaps by chance, he might also understand the art of shifting shape and position?
Three days later.
Outside Yunshan County City, in the familiar forest.
At this time, the forest had only trees around the perimeter; the interior was a level piece of land, devoid of even a single blade of grass.
Li Xuan waved his hand, and amidst the surge of True Qi, a pattern of The Eight Diagrams appeared on the ground.
"This is The Eight Diagrams, containing the profound principles of heaven and earth. One can attain insights into movement techniques from it. Now, I will impart to you the way of The Eight Diagrams..."
Li Xuan shared the knowledge of The Eight Diagrams along with his own profound and seemingly powerful theories, one by one, to Meng Chong.
"Have you remembered it all?"
Finally, Li Xuan asked in a deep voice.
"Master, your disciple has remembered it!"
Meng Chong nodded.
Staring at the pattern of The Eight Diagrams, he fell into deep contemplation.
"This way of The Eight Diagrams is truly profound, it sounds powerful, containing the profound principles of heaven and earth, and is worth reflecting on continuously.
"Master said that at every stage, there will be different insights, and each person's insights are also distinct, allowing one to comprehend one's own Martial Dao."
He decided to spend the upcoming time pondering on The Eight Diagrams.
"I have already comprehended the Wind and Thunder Vajra Fist, now I wish to derive a stepping technique, or movement technique, from The Eight Diagrams.
"The movement technique of my eldest senior brother is extremely profound, and he derived it from The Eight Diagrams. I won't learn from my senior brother's technique. I want to comprehend my own movement technique.
"What I comprehend by myself is what's most suitable for me."
As Meng Chong thought, he began to walk on the pattern of The Eight Diagrams.
Seeing this, Li Xuan cautioned, "While you contemplate The Eight Diagrams, do not neglect your own cultivation. Aim to achieve a state of perfect vitality and blood energy."
"Yes, Master!"
Meng Chong respectfully replied.
"Hm, cultivate well!"
Having said this, Li Xuan left.
What comes next is up to Meng Chong, when he can comprehend his own movement technique from The Eight Diagrams.
As for mnemonics related to the movement technique, Li Xuan didn't create any, considering Meng Chong's talent didn't lay in comprehending mnemonics; teaching him mnemonics might instead be counterproductive.
...
Capital City of Qi Country.
The matter of searching for a master had gradually subsided, and the courtiers knew that even if a master was found, it would not shake the status of the Guo Family.
The frenzy of seeking a master also gradually faded away.
The courtiers all wanted to acquire Martial Dao Techniques from the master, or have their descendants become disciples of such a master.
Without exception, they were unable to even meet the master.
At the back courtyard of the Qi King's residence, Xu Yan's dwelling.
Xie Lingfeng held a wooden stick, sparring with Xu Yan, one not using Martial Dao Inner Qi, the other not using blood energy, both were purely practicing their swordsmanship.
This was not the first time.
"Brother Xu, are you sure this kind of sparring helps you to comprehend Sword Intent?"
Xie Lingfeng asked curiously.
After repeatedly discussing Martial Arts with Xu Yan, especially the Sword Dao, Xie Lingfeng realized that he had been practicing a false Martial Dao!
He had not even touched the threshold of the Sword Dao!
Having recognized his own mistakes, it was natural for him to correct them, so he asked Xu Yan what the true Martial Dao was, and how to cultivate it?
```

chapters.title: Chapter 101 - 85 Xu Yan's Enlightenment, Mountain and River Sword Intent_2
chapters.content:
Reestablishing the martial arts path was now out of the question.
One solution Xu Yan proposed was to convert the cultivation of the Grandmaster realm to the cultivation of the Innate realm, with the first step being the cultivation of Innate True Qi.
This was similar to martial arts Inner Qi, but purer, more mystical, with greater potential, and stronger than martial arts Inner Qi.
According to Xu Yan, the Inner Qi of martial artists in the Inner Domain was actually True Qi, merely a false form of martial arts, hence, it was also an imitation True Qi.
Because of this, it lacked the purity and power of Innate True Qi.
Xie Lingfeng found this quite reasonable and believed it wholeheartedly.
However, he didn't know how to convert his whole body's martial arts Inner Qi into Innate True Qi.
Xu Yan couldn't provide a method either, but told him that once he had broken through to the Innate realm and understood its mysteries, he might know the method for transformation.
Before breaking through to the Innate realm, he wanted to grasp the Sword Intent.
The earlier he grasped the Sword Intent, the more solid his foundation in Sword Dao would be. If he could not grasp the Sword Intent within a month, Xu Yan would not continue to suppress it, but choose to break through.
Hence, Xie Lingfeng and Xu Yan began to spar, to help Xu Yan understand the Sword Intent.
"Yes!"
Xu Yan nodded: "The comprehension of Sword Intent lies in calming the mind and spirit, understanding the world, and in Swordsmanship. I have an intuition that sparring constantly with you will be beneficial for comprehending the Sword Intent."
"It will be even more useful in understanding the Sword Intent!"
Xie Lingfeng thrusted his sword, curiously asking, "Brother Yan, what exactly is Sword Intent?"
It sounded mysterious. When he first heard of it, he was utterly baffled.
In the Inner Domain's Sword Dao, only the peerless Swordsmanship, formidable invincible Sword Qi, and chillingly sharp sword light were discussed. Even though there were occasional mentions of Sword Intent, it was a different concept from the Sword Intent Xu Yan spoke of.
"Sword Intent, that is the intent within the sword. It's my intent, the intent of heaven and earth, and also the intent of Sword Dao. It's a kind of understanding, a kind of mood in line with heaven and earth..."
Xu Yan slowly pondered and said.
Xie Lingfeng opened his mouth slightly, looking somewhat baffled. He understood each word, but when put together, he was confused. It was too mysterious, completely beyond his grasp.
At this moment, he sighed inwardly: "I am known as the Sword Majesty Cliff, the top Sword Dao prodigy in a thousand years, but compared to Brother Yan, I'm just a joke!"
Suddenly, Xie Lingfeng was stunned.
His eyes widened in amazement as he looked at Xu Yan in disbelief.
In an instant, he felt the branch in his hand become heavier, as if it was not obeying his commands.
What shocked him even more was that an inexplicable, unfathomable, yet clearly powerful and mystical force was emanating from Xu Yan.
Faintly, elusive, indescribable.
But it carried a sharp intent with an eternal, indestructible charm.
He no longer had control over his Swordsmanship.
His hand was trembling, and the branch in his hand began to crumble bit by bit. Alarmed, he quickly let go and stepped back.
Xu Yan's eyes narrowed slightly; he had entered a state of self-forgetfulness. Rounds and rounds of inexplicable aura emerged from him.
"Sword Intent is the intent within the sword, and the sword in my hand; that is my intent... What should be the intent of Sword Dao? The sharpness of the sword is indispensable, while my bones are flawless, endless.
"The Martial Path is endless, Sword Dao is also endless, and should be eternal..."
Xu Yan self-examined; in his mind, he recollected every word and action of his master, the carefree demeanor when seated, the casual steps when walking; these were all ordinary gestures in life.
However, how extraordinary was his master?
What kind of realm was that?
It surfaced in Xu Yan's mind how he practiced diligently in the small mountain village, fed chickens, cooked meals every day, and how carefree his master's life was. The more he thought about it, the more he realized how profound his master's realm was.
"This is what my master meant by the 'Dao follows nature!'"
Recalling when his master was teaching the Eight Diagrams also surfaced, Qian, Kun, Zhen, Dui...
The more he recalled, the more realization Xu Yan had: "So my master, from the very beginning, laid the foundation for me to understand Sword Dao, to feel Sword Intent."
"But, I've been ignoring it."
"Looking back now, every word and action of my master was in line with the Dao, and I was close to the Dao.
"The realm of the master is so unfathomable that it is almost like the Dao."
At this moment, Xu Yan understood. His Sword Heart was clear and his Sword Intent, transparent.
A Sword Intent rose around him.
He had made a small achievement in the clear Sword Heart.
He had comprehended the Sword Intent!
"The mountains and rivers are immortal, enduring wind and rain, devoid of sentimentality, burying countless lives... My first Sword Intent shall be called Mountain and River Sword Intent."
Xu Yan opened his eyes, the Mountain and River Sword Intent emerged, being thick, long-lasting, sharp and merciless.
Looking up at the shocked Xie Lingfeng, he laughed, "Brother Xie, how about you face one of my Sword Intents? Don't worry, I won't go all out."
He wanted to test the power of this Mountain and River Sword Intent!
Without Xie Lingfeng accompanying him in sword practice, he would not have grasped the Sword Intent so quickly, and finally comprehended the Sword Intent before breaking through to the Innate realm.
Xie Lingfeng's face was full of shock, is this the Sword Intent?
It was too profound to predict.
Taking a deep breath, he solemnly said, "Alright!"
He also wanted to experience firsthand whether this so-called Sword Intent was really that powerful.
Zing!
He unsheathes his sword, his expression incredibly serious.
With a twig in his hand, Xu Yan says, "Brother Xie, you take the first move!"
He's afraid that once he makes his move, Xie Lingfeng won't get the chance to do so.
"Alright!"
Xie Lingfeng doesn't beat around the bush, he thrusts his sword immediately.
The sword light morphs into a flying rainbow, darting across the sky, bridging the gap between them in a split second.
Hum!
A hum resounds in the universe as if for an instant. In his daze, Xie Lingfeng seems to see the mountains and rivers moulding together, continuous but harsh and cruel, as if it could bury all life.
The rainbow sword light plunges into the mountains and rivers, leaving not a trace behind.
But the reflection of the mountains and rivers looks like a landslip and the roaring rivers seem as if they are going to bury all beings, and he— is in there, amongst that life about to be buried!
His heart is struck with terror!
Is this what Sword Intent is?
Shush, shush!
Xie Lingfeng hastily engages his sword, one stroke after another. The twinkle of the rainbow sword light churns up layers of cold light, continuously pouring onto the mountain-river Sword Intent.
He had launched a hundred strokes in a flash!
Plop!
Finally, the mountain-river Sword Intent dissipates.
The twig in Xu Yan's hand has turned to dust.
He feels his head going empty, as if he has greatly strained his mind and used up around 10% of his Qi and blood in an instant.
The Jade bones are gleaming brightly, and his Qi and blood are recovering rapidly.
The drained spirit is also slowly replenishing.
"The Sword Intent is too powerful, it's too draining for me to utilize with my current strength. "
Xu Yan sighs in his heart.
After all, the level of Sword Intent is extremely high, and he is currently only at the Qi and blood realm, the first realm of the Martial Arts. The consumption of actualizing Sword Intent is beyond imagination.
"I'm a Jade Bone foundation, so I'm able to handle it. But if I had a Gold Bone foundation, I would probably only manage to launch Sword Intent once or twice at the Qi and blood realm."
Xu Yan thinks to himself in silence.
His expenditure is significant, but he could still actualize Sword Intent again.
He can manage to hold up if he had to summon it five or six times.
While Xu Yan is shocked by the consumption of Sword Intent, Xie Lingfeng is already stunned.
It was just one Sword Intent.
He gave all his might, launching a hundred strokes, just to put out this one Sword Intent.
Moreover, he could clearly feel that the Sword Intent could drain the power of his swordsmanship. The rainbow sword light plunges into the Sword Intent, like into a quagmire.
Only around 30% of its power remains.
He realizes a problem, a Martial Artist who has comprehended Sword Intent has the power to crush those who haven't!
Once the Sword Intent is understood, it can beat the higher realm!
Sword Intent is indeed terrifying.
No wonder it sounds so mysterious!
After this incident, Xie Lingfeng even more sorrowfully believes that what he had been practicing was fake martial arts!
The so-called martial arts inherited from Sword Lord Cliff since antiquity are all fake martial arts!
And himself, he's no swordsmanship genius!
He is just a common Martial Artist who has learned a bit of swordsmanship!
"I cannot sink any further, I have to comprehend swordsmanship, I also want to enter the door of swordsmanship.
"I want to become a real swordsmanship Martial Artist!"
Xie Lingfeng's eyes are resolute, this trip to the wastelands, quite possibly, is a stroke of fate!
"I want to ask Brother Xu, how can I attain a clear understanding of swordsmanship!"
Only with clear comprehension of swordsmanship can one enter the basics of swordsmanship.
And only with clear understanding can one comprehend Sword Intent!
"Congratulations to Brother Xu for gaining an understanding of Sword Intent!"
With an envious expression, Xie Lingfeng clasps his hands in respect and congratulates him.
"Brother Xie is being too kind, if it weren't for your sparring with me, I wouldn't have been able to understand Sword Intent so quickly."
Xu Yan modestly replies.
"Brother Xu is being modest. I played no part in it. Even without me, it would have taken Xu Yan merely a day or two more to understand it."
Xie Lingfeng says with a wry smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 102 - 86: Jade Bone Draws Mountains and Rivers, Xu Yan Enters Innate (Ask for monthly ticket)_1
chapters.content:
"It wouldn't have been the same without your company for practice. I would not have had a sudden realization, not have understood that my master's words and actions have all laid the groundwork for me to comprehend Sword Intent."
Xu Yan shook his head, speaking truthfully.
Without Xie Lingfeng's questions and company, he would not have had his awakening, so Xie Lingfeng indeed deserves some credit for his rapid comprehension of the Mountain and River Sword Intent.
"Brother Xu, may I meet your master?"
Xie Lingfeng asked, a look of reverence on his face.
"I have to ask my master first."
Xu Yan considered, then replied.
"Thank you, Brother Xu."
Xie Lingfeng expressed his gratitude.
He paused, then sighed, "As Xie Lingfeng, I thought I was gifted in Sword Dao. But it turned out that I haven't even stepped through the door of Sword Dao.
"Brother Xu, how can one attain clarity of the sword's intentions?"
The basis of entering Sword Dao is achieving clarity of the sword's intentions.
