From initially cultivating a randomly improvised Cultivation Technique, Xu Yan has grown. His Martial Arts realm is not low now, and he has broken through the Heart Sword Realm. So it can be said that he has a solid foundation.
It is possible to comprehend the Wisdom Sword Realm, it just needs a longer time.
"Disciple, this is the wonder of the Wisdom Sword Realm, and it is also a representation of it. But the Wisdom Sword Realm is not limited to this;
"For Sword Dao cultivators, they must understand the Wisdom Sword. There is a saying, 'the wisdom sword cuts down inner demons, it cuts emotional ties, it cuts self-attachment... it cuts all obstructions and distractions.'
"Break through mental barriers, break through all kinds of demon hindrance, break through all unknowns... The heart possesses wisdom sword, purifies oneself, everything is a part of 'me'. Not confused, not aimless, not bleak, not self-deluded, not cowardly…"
Li Xuan looked solemn as he passed on the Wisdom Sword Realm to Xu Yan.
At this moment, while Xu Yan was shocked, he also felt inspired, as if a light had been switched on in his brain. The more he contemplated, the more profound the Wisdom Sword Realm seemed.
"... The heart possesses the wisdom sword, it purifies the self, everything is a part of 'me'... Not aimless, not bleak, not cowardly..."
Li Xuan opens up again, "Disciple, the wonders of the Wisdom Sword, cannot be comprehended in a short while, do not get too engrossed in it. Wait till your Primordial Spirit is complete and you understand the wonders of Heaven and Earth Laws, perhaps then you will be able to cultivate the Wisdom Sword Realm.
"From general associations one may obtain specific information, from comprehending yourself, perhaps one day, with a flash of inspiration, you will understand, how to cultivate the Wisdom Sword Realm."
Compared to the martial arts of the Divine Skill Realm, understanding the Wisdom Sword Realm is much harder, even a genius like Xu Yan can't comprehend it in a short time.
About time to first understand the Divine Skill Realm martial arts, maybe after that's understood, then a clue about the Wisdom Sword Realm will emerge?
"Yes, Master, I understand!"
Xu Yan respectfully replied.
The Wisdom Sword Realm was too profound. The master was right, maybe he would be able to cultivate the Wisdom Sword Realm after he fully understood the Divine Skill Realm, or after solidifying his Primordial Spirit, understanding the wonders of the Heaven and Earth Laws?
His Heart Sword Realm had just made a small achievement, and was still far from its peak.
Moreover, perhaps one day he could draw inferences about other cases, and he would get enlightened?
"Hmm, it's good that you understand."
Li Xuan nodded.
The master and disciple returned to their residence.
On the way, Li Xuan lifted his eyes to look, there was Yue'er with her grandfather, searching for something. But the peculiar arrangement of Heaven and Earth enveloped the two, so they couldn't find him.
He smiled, ignoring it. That girl was a little interesting, and her talent was pretty good.
Unfortunately, she was not suitable as his disciple.
And he had no new Martial Arts to teach either.
As for a disciple-in-law, Xu Yan already had two female followers. As for the matter of fate, it was all up to his disciple to settle, being a master, he wouldn't bother about it.
Returning to their residence, Xu Yan entered into a state of seclusion, half cultivating, half comprehending his own Sword Dao, half comprehending the martial arts of the Divine Skill.
The next day.
Upon the mountain peak, this time it was Meng Chong.
The third realm of the Dao of the Sword, it was time to impart it to Meng Chong.
Though Meng Chong's talent was not as monstrous as Xu Yan's, he had a unique talent in the Dao of the Sword.
"The beginning of the Dao of the Sword lies in the awakening of the Sword Soul, you have awakened the Sword Soul, naturally you understand its mysteries.
"The second realm of the Dao of the Sword is the Concealed Sword Realm. Your senior brother's Heart Sword Realm, you also understand some of it. The Concealed Sword Realm not only refers to concealing the edge, but also to the essence of the sword hidden everywhere in Heaven and Earth. It coincides with the Heart Sword Realm, yet has its own unique meaning..."
Li Xuan spoke slowly.
Meng Chong listened respectfully.
As a newcomer to the Hidden Blade Realm, he naturally understood the profundity of this stage. Although he was unable to envision everything as a sword as his senior brother could, he could imagine plants and rocks transforming into blades.
The idea of Hidden Blade signified both the concealment of the blade within oneself as well as the omnipresence of blades in the world.
"The third realm of the Blade Dao is the Bright Knife Realm. A bright knife illuminates my heart, it illuminates my intent…"
Li Xuan began to teach Meng Chong about the third realm of the Blade Dao.
The Bright Knife Realm!
The knife enlightens my intent, the knife understands my will!
"…With a bright knife in one's heart, demonic obstacles naturally dispel… The blade is the dominance of heaven and earth, the blade is the courage of heaven and earth… With a bright knife in the heart, the dominant become mine, unrivaled bravery…"
The Bright Knife Realm, like the Wisdom Sword Realm, had similarities, since Li Xuan had used the Wisdom Sword Realm as a reference to devise it.
However, there were major differences as well, reflecting the dominance and bravery of the blade.
Li Xuan looked upon the Daoist Golden Book on the Soul Pedestal with information on the Bright Knife Realm.
Completion level: Above average.
Stage connection degree: Above average.
Understanding difficulty: High+.
Cultivation difficulty: High.
Though the difficulty of understanding the Bright Knife Realm was slightly lower than the Wisdom Sword Realm, it did not differ by much.
Understanding it remained a daunting task.
Of course, Li Xuan was not bothered by this, since Meng Chong's talents were not inferior, but rather quite extraordinary.
Moreover, once Xu Yan comprehends the Wisdom Sword Realm, Meng Chong could derive insights from it and gradually comprehend the Bright Knife Realm.
This was simply a matter of time.
Listening to this, Meng Chong's blood boiled with excitement; he touched his bald head, his face full of exhilaration and anticipation.
The Bright Knife Realm, how profound, how powerful it was.
"You've just entered the Hidden Blade Realm, the Bright Knife realm is still far from you. Take it one step at a time, practice steadily, and gradually comprehend it.
"Ponder more about the third level of the Undying Golden Body; the mysteries of martial art in regards to the physical body are not as simple as they seem."
Li Xuan spoke solemnly.
"Yes, Master!"
Meng Chong responded respectfully.
"Hmm, keep up your cultivation. Troubles are stirring up in the Ling Domain."
Li Xuan paced back towards his estate.
Meng Chong followed behind him, puzzled. Why did his master say that a storm was brewing in the Ling Domain?
"Is a retaliation from the Crimson Abyss Sect imminent?"
Meng Chong wondered.
A considerable period had passed since the battle of prodigies, yet there had been no stir from the Crimson Abyss Sect. It seemed as if they were observing the rules of the prodigy disputes, refraining from revenge.
But how could that be possible?
Given the domineering nature of the Spirit Sect, they would undeniably seek revenge, moreover, the rules of prodigy disputes had been broken during the conflict with the Wanxing Martial Arts Academy, so they were not abiding by them anymore.
Li Xuan sat down on a chair, having imparted everything he needed to teach. Now it was time to wait for the harvest of his teachings.
As for the unrest in the Ling Domain, it was a sure thing.
The All Ages Alliance, lurking in the shadows, was ready to make their move, seeking an opportunity under the dictatorship of the Spirit Sect to claim a piece of land for themselves.
As for the Crimson Abyss Sect, there had been no action for quite some time, indicating they were gearing up for something significant. It should not be long before they made a big move.
"The Transcendent Spirit Sect is indeed powerful. However, it's uncertain if any superior beings from the sect have noticed this and whether they will react or not."
Li Xuan pondered quietly.
Although he was confident in confronting any Superior Spirit Sect strong with his current strength, he was unaware of the full potential of the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
Moreover, if numerous Superior Spirit Sect strong attacked at once, Li Xuan estimated that he could still handle it at full strength without risking his life.
However, if he could not achieve a decisive victory, it would tarnish his image as a peerless high-level practitioner.
Once again, feign modesty and claim not to bully based on cultivation level?
It would be fine once or twice, but if continued, even his disciple would question whether his cultivation level was on the verge of Dao.
Thinking about this, Li Xuan felt a bit insecure and decided to be more low-key to avoid any encirclement and suppression.
Unless, he broke through the Divine Skill Realm.
At that time, with the power of the Divine Skills, he would make the entire Ling Domain understand what true invincibility looked like!

chapters.title: Chapter 509 - 279: Jianzhai, Battle of Luo State_1
chapters.content:
Yuzhou did not stir because of the downfall of the Jade Spirit Sect and the Su Family, or the killing of the Vermilion Ming's true lineage. Instead, it remains unexpectedly peaceful.
This tranquility made many Spirit Sects, prominent families, and martial artists in Yuzhou wonder. Isn't the Vermilion Ming Sect planning an act of retaliation in line with the so-called Sky's Pride Rivalry rules?
However, there are some who believe this calm is the harbinger of a storm and the Vermilion Ming Sect is planning some major moves.
In the royal palace of the Zheng Country, Emperor Zheng summoned the important members of the royal family and some high-ranking ministers.
"Yuzhou may be about to experience turbulence. We Zheng have always remained neutral and avoided getting involved in conflicts. This time, no one is permitted to get involved.
"If we offend the Spirit Sect, then we will face an irreversible disaster!"
With a serious tone, Emperor Zheng warned.
"Has the Vermilion Ming Sect made any moves?"
A high-ranking minister asked with surprise.
"They should be about to,"
Emperor Zheng responded uncertainly.
"Father, about that Loose Cultivator group in Yuzhou..."
The crown prince cautiously started.
"This matter has nothing to do with us, the Zheng Country. They have neither targeted nor provoked our country, and the Spirit Sect hasn't given any instructions, this has nothing to do with us.
"Remember, unless the Spirit Sect issues a command, or they violate the law of our Zheng Country, we will not interfere, oppress or support..."
Emperor Zheng stated with a heavy voice.
The Zheng Country holds a unique position. As long as they abide by their role and refrain from getting involved in Martial Arts disputes, neither the Loose Cultivator side nor the Spirit Sects' and prominent families' sides will drag the Zheng Country into the conflict.
The Transcendent Spirit Sect, almost seems to have a silent understanding not to interfere in these disputes. After all, the Zheng Country's power, while not extremely strong, won't make much of an impact.
Emperor Zheng issued the decree and after everyone left, he sat in his chair with a slight look of worry. Yuzhou was harbouring a Loose Cultivator group that wasn't weak.
Do other states also have such groups?
"This Ling Domain, every once in a while, some people and powers would try to challenge the authority of the Spirit Sect.
"The one that truly almost challenged the Spirit Sect's authority was the Wàn Xīng (Ten Thousand Stars) Martial Arts Academy. As a result, the Martial Art Academy collapsed, and all of the once Ten Thousand Star Pride vanished.
"The Blood Demon, despite his terrifying reputation and the top-ranked Spirit Sects that he destroyed, was eventually defeated and fled to the Inner Domain, where it ultimately vanished."
Emperor Zheng sighed in his heart.
The Ling Domain is, after all, the world of the Spirit Sect.
With the existence of the Transcendent Spirit Sect, and the absence of Transcendent Prominent Families, the Spirit Sect is the true ruler of the Ling Domain.
The Great Zhou State is an exception. The reason it can stand side by side with the Transcendent Spirit Sect is a secret that nobody knows. It remains a mystery how the Great Zhou Royal Family could stand on par with the Transcendent Spirit Sect!
...
Jian Zhai, the top-ranked Spirit Sect in the Ling Domain, is a Sword Dao Spirit Sect.
Despite being a top-ranked Spirit Sect, Vermilion Ming Sect isn't comparable to Jian Zhai in terms of strength. Moreover, Jian Zhai, in fact, belongs to the Transcendent Spirit Sect and is under the control of the Thousand Martial Hall.
Jian Zhai, which only nurtures Sword Dao, has fewer disciples. However, each disciple is extremely talented in Sword Dao and kills without parallel.
Every disciple who enters the sect needs to undergo "sword-sharpening training" to cultivate their Sword Dao, deepen their understanding of Swordsmanship, and enhance their battle experience.
When disciples of Jian Zhai sharpen their swords, many martial artists inevitably become sharpening stones.
While Loose Cultivators make up the majority of the sharpening stones, there are many disciples from other Spirit Sects and prominent families who also serve this purpose.
If the disciples of Jian Zhai feel that their Sword Dao and Swordsmanship have grown strong and those Loose Cultivators aren't worthy to sharpen their swords on, they may challenge the disciples from the Spirit Sects and prominent families.
This is considered a Tianshao contention between the Spirit Sects.
Over time, the disciples of Jian Zhai have been known for their ruthless killings and aggressive attacks, often winning and rarely losing when using other Sect's disciples as sharpening stones.
Since Jian Zhai is under the rule of the Thousand Martial Hall, any disciple that successfully sharpens their sword and becomes the number one in Jian Zhai, suppressing Tianshao at the same stage from other Spirit Sects, is eligible for promotion to the Thousand Martial Hall.
Jian Zhai is also considered as one gateway to select Tianshao for the Thousand Martial Hall.
"Master Hong!"
Sect Master Xing from the Vermilion Ming Sect respectfully saluted.
Master Hong, the current head of Jian Zhai, is a peak God-refining powerhouse with a determined face and three long beards flowing down his face.
Even though Sect Master Xing is also a peak God-refining warrior, he is extremely respectful towards Master Hong. Master Hong's strength isn't something he can compare to.
Master Hong had dedicated his life to studying the Sword Dao. His swordsmanship had reached its peak long ago. His strength is one of the peak God-refining warriors that are only second to the strongest of the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
It's rumored that he possesses one of the top ten treasures.
Once, he single-handedly battled three peak God-refining warriors and slaughtered them all, causing a sensation.
Neither Master Hong's strength nor his background is something Sect Master Xing can compare to.
"Is Xu Yan's Sword Dao real?"
While looking at the information handed over by Sect Master Xing, Master Hong asked.
"Yes, it is!"
Sect Master Xing responded solemnly.
Master Hong's eyes flashed coldly. After pondering for a while, he said, "Such Sword Dao is indeed remarkable. How can there be such a strong Sword Dao method among Loose Cultivators?
"Even our Jian Zhai have never known of this Sword Dao."
After pausing, he continued, "Our Jian Zhai's Sword Dao is second to none. Xu Yan's Sword Dao indeed has unique aspects. How can a Loose Cultivator like him have such strong Sword Dao?
"I think, his master might have stolen our Jian Zhai secret method. What do you think, Sect Master Xing?"
Sect Master Xing rejoiced at this and nodded, "Exactly! Xu Yan's Sword Dao is certainly Jian Zhai's secret teaching. That's why I came to Jian Zhai, to tell Master Hong that your sect's secret teaching has been stolen!"

chapters.title: Chapter 510 - 279: Sword Room, The Battle of Luo State_2
chapters.content:
Master Hong nodded, "Since the secret transmissions of my Sword Sect have been stolen, we naturally need to retrieve them and eliminate the thief. This time, I will take action and my Sword Sect will also take action."
"Thank you, Master Hong!"
Sect Master Xing said joyfully.
He then continued, "In Luo State, there is a mysterious Loose Cultivator force that has gathered together, with intentions that are possibly ominous. Their powers are beyond imagination and they even possess a Refining God Heavenly Man peak Martial Artist."
"I suspect that this loose cultivator force is associated with the remnants of the Star Cluster, my Crimson Abyss Sect, and the royal families of Luo State are preparing to encircle and eliminate this loose cultivator force."
"However, I fear they are hiding powerful individuals. We ask for your assistance, Master Hong!"
Master Hong's eyes flashed a chilling gleam, saying: "These lowly loose cultivators, are they trying to rebel? Since they have the audacity to rebel, we as the same Spirit Sects, cannot just sit and watch."
"Thank you, Master Hong!"
Sect Master Xing breathed out a sigh in relief, continuing, "I suspect this loose cultivator force is associated with that loose cultivator force in Yuzhou, and it's highly probable that Xu Yan was nurtured as their genius by this force."
"Those remnants of the Star Cluster, not only had they stolen your secret transmissions, but they also attempted to rebel. Their crimes are unpardonable!"
"Well Said!"
Master Hong stood up, coldly declaring, "The unpardonable remnants of the Star Cluster who are hoping to come back from the dust, are delusional! They should be executed!"
That day, the Sect Master of Sword Sect left with two elders, heading to Luo State.
And one day in Luo State, earth-shattering movements suddenly arose.
Forces such as the Crimson Abyss Sect and the royal families of Luo State suddenly acted, attacking secretive bases, and slew many loose cultivators.
Even Refining God Martial Artists were killed a few.
Bang!
The All Ages Alliance in Luo State was suddenly exposed.
"Who leaked the information?"
The Alliance Hierarch of Luo State said furiously.
"Although we have been cautious in our actions, Luo State is not like Yuzhou. I fear the Crimson Abyss Sect and the royal families have already noticed something."
"Now that we have been exposed, let us fight!"
A strong member of the All Ages Alliance in Luo State said solemnly.
"Then, fight. Let's see how powerful the Crimson Abyss Sect and the royal families are!"
The Alliance Hierarch of Luo State spoke coldly.
The All Ages Alliance suddenly appeared.
"The Ling Domain should have a place for us loose cultivators, those who refuse to be oppressed, exploited, or enslaved. We will bet everything we have in this life to fight for the peace of future generations of loose cultivators. Join the All Ages Alliance and seize a place for ourselves!"
The All Ages Alliance appeared and issued a call to action, for loose cultivators to unite and seize a place for themselves, to fight for peace forever!
The war broke out, powerful members of the All Ages Alliance poured out, even the peak Refining God Heavenly Man made a move, killing an elder Refining God Heavenly Man from the Crimson Abyss Sect.
The Alliance Hierarch of Luo State displayed the might of a peak Refining God Heavenly Man, incredibly strong, he even managed to suppress the Grand Elder of the Crimson Abyss Sect.
As the All Ages Alliance appeared and showed their strong power, some loose cultivators who were oppressed and bore grudges against the royal families took the initiative to join the war.
Neither the Crimson Abyss Sect nor the royal families of Luo State expected that the All Ages Alliance was so powerful.
As soon as they made a move, they managed to resist the attack of the royal families and even gained the upper hand.
"Why are they so strong? How could loose cultivator Refining God Heavenly Men have such powerful cultivation techniques?"
"This must be the secret technique of the Star Cluster, it must be the remnants of the Star Cluster causing trouble!"
The Crimson Abyss Sect and the royal families of Luo State, who were shocked and angry, originally thought they could suppress the opposition with overpowering force. Instead, they ended up being on the losing side.
Once they started to lose, the loose cultivators in Luo State seemed to see hope.
As a result, more and more loose cultivators joined the battle. Their aim was to take the opportunity to bring down the royal families. Even if they failed in the end, it would still be nice to seize a portion of the royal families' resources.
The war swept across Luo State, several third-rate Spirit Sects were captured, and their resources were looted by the loose cultivators.
As more and more loose cultivators joined, the Spirit Sects in Luo State became more and more passive. But at this moment, the depth of the Spirit Sects' resources was revealed.
They formed armies of Martial Artists to sweep away the loose cultivators. Until they collided with the elites of the All Ages Alliance and suffered losses on both sides.
The outcome will be decided by the duel between the Refining God Heavenly Men.
Bang!
The Alliance Hierarch of Luo State was very powerful. He was not a weakling among the Refining God Heavenly Men and managed to forcefully repel the Grand Elder of the Crimson Abyss Sect.
Aside from the Alliance Hierarch of Luo State, the All-Ages Alliance also had other peak Refining God Heavenly Men, who were battling against the strong members of the royal families. However, they were at a disadvantage.
"Today, I'll kill you!"
The Alliance Hierarch of Luo State exuded a domineering aura, charging towards the Grand Elder of the Crimson Abyss Sect. He sought to kill this top-tier elder of the Spirit Sect to inspire the hearts of the loose cultivators in Luo State and boost morale!
"Arrogant!"
The Grand Elder of the Chiming Sect could not contain his rage, "Star remnants of Wanxing, they should not be spared!"
"Hmph, it is true that I cultivate the martial arts of Wanxing Martial Arts Institute, but I am not from the Wanxing Martial Arts Institute of yore. The All Ages Alliance is not the Wanxing Martial Arts Institute!"
The Luo State Alliance Hierarch laughed coldly, displaying his martial arts techniques, his powerful force causing the Grand Elder of the Chiming Sect to repeatedly retreat.
"Whether you're remnants of Wanxing or the All Ages Alliance, you're all lowly loose cultivators, daring to defy your superiors! Today, I will let you all know that the power of the Spirit Sect should not be provoked!"
Suddenly, a stern voice echoed.
Swish!
A sword light was cast across the sky, with a force as fierce as a tree being pulled out by its roots, slashing towards the Luo State Alliance Hierarch.
Boom!
The Alliance Hierarch of Luo State's face changed drastically. Hurriedly, he defended himself, but this sword possessed an incredibly destructive power. In an instant, it broke through his defense.
"This is bad!"
Feeling startled, the Alliance Hierarch of Luo State fought back and managed to block the sword. However, his figure was constantly retreating, and he found himself in a terribly awkward situation!
"Great Destruction Sword, Master Hong from the Sword Sect!"
The Alliance Hierarch of Luo State exclaimed through clenched teeth.
Master Hong came wielding his sword, with two elders of the Sword Sect behind him, rushing out to kill the Refining God powerhouses of the All Ages Alliance.
Swish!
In a few moments, a Martial Artist at the early stage of Refining God was swiftly killed on the spot!
"Insolence shall not be forgiven. Today, I'll sharpen my sword on you all!"
As Master Hong raised his sword, his powerful sword light illuminating the sky, his strength was evidently far beyond that of the Grand Elder of the Chiming Sect!
The heart of the Luo State Alliance Hierarch sank. The Sword Sect was indeed a top-ranking spiritual sect under the Thousand Martial Hall. Master Hong's reputation was not undeserved; he couldn't match him!
"Alliance Hierarch, I'll help you!"
A Refining God powerhouse of the All Ages Alliance rushed over.
The fierce battle continued, while Luo State Alliance Hierarch had aid this time, they were still being driven back by Master Hong, who was fighting two-on-one, their bodies covered in injuries.
Originally, the All Ages Alliance had the upper hand, but now, they were clearly on the verge of defeat. Many of the loose cultivators outside the All Ages Alliance stopped fighting and did not dare to attack anymore.
Even worse, they turned to attack the members of the All Ages Alliance in order to curry favor with the Spirit Sect!
The Luo State Alliance Hierarch was coughing up blood, his face pale, panting heavily. The practitioner who assisted him had already lost an arm and was seriously injured.
More than a dozen Refining God powerhouses of the All Ages Alliance had fallen, most of them by the swords of the Sword Sect elders!
"The Sword Sect!"
The Luo State Alliance Hierarch cursed under his breath.
The All Ages Alliance was likely to lose this battle. Their long-established base in Luo State might even be at risk of being destroyed!
The foundation and strength of Sect families were indeed formidable!
"Lowly loose cultivator, you should have the awareness of your lower status. Attempting a rebellion is a path to your own demise, so today it's your time to perish!"
Master Hong's long beard fluttered in the air, his sword light reflecting against the sky, a fierce sword light crashed down from mid-air.
The Great Destruction Sword!
Luo State Alliance Hierarch clenched his teeth and took action, yet he looked helpless. He wouldn't be able to block this sword and was bound to die!
"With one word, you label us 'lowly loose cultivators', but how noble do you Spirit Sect warriors think you are?"
At this moment, a sigh sounded.
The radiance of a crutch, like a luminous moon, touched the sword light in mid-air and with a bang, the sword light burst apart.
Master Hong's gaze was fixed on the elder who had acted.
Silver light emerged behind the elder, like a bright moon, albeit an incomplete and broken one.
Even so, the momentum of the elder remained incredibly strong.
"Who are you?"
The elder spoke indifferently, "The so-called remnants of Wanxing, you always bring up."
"Good, very good. Today, I will kill you, the so-called remnants of Wanxing!"
Master Hong sneered and rushed forward with his sword. However, when the elder pointed with his crutch, a moonlight illuminated half the sky. A strong force poured down and the invincible Great Destruction Sword was unable to break this incomplete moonlight!
Boom!
The two of them clashed for several moments, and Master Hong fell into disadvantage. However, for the elder to win was extremely difficult as well. Their strengths were almost equal.

chapters.title: Chapter 511 - 280: The Strongest in the Thousand Martial Hall, Enlightenment of Divine Skills_1
chapters.content:
Master Hong's face was gloomy. The strength of the opponent was so strong that it suppressed him. The power of the Star Remnants was indeed not to be underestimated!
"Which one of the Star Remnants are you?"
Master Hong struck with his sword again and again, but each attack was fended off by the old man.
The Alliance Hierarch of Luo State breathed a sigh of relief. It turned out to be a strong survivor of the Star Martial Arts Academy who had stepped forward to help. He bowed and said, "Thank you, senior, for your assistance!"
Then he turned around and attacked an elder from the Sword Sect.
The old man jabbed his cane. The halo of the moon behind him was getting brighter, but it was ultimately incomplete.
Boom!
The moonlight collapsed, and the sword light of Master Hong seemed to be weakened, losing its sharpness and becoming slower.
Master Hong's expression changed.
A morbid flush appeared on the old man's face, suggesting that the power he was exerting at the moment was a great strain on him.
"Given your strength, could it be that you're one of the thirty-six heroes of the Star Academy?"
Master Hong asked with a glum face.
The most prestigious individuals in the Star Martial Academy were none other than the thirty-six heroes. Each of them possessed a Spiritual Body and could contend with the young talents of the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
"He, Moon Changming, is indeed remarkable. Even though his spiritual body was shattered in the past, it has not only survived but also grown stronger.
"I must say, Moon Changming, you are quite a person!"
Suddenly, a cold, proud voice rang out.
Accompanying the voice was a Long Spear. With a powerful thrust, the spear nearly knocked Moon Changming's cane out of his hand, causing him to stumble backwards.
The broken moon behind him seemed to be on the verge of collapsing at any time.
Moon Changming's face changed as he backed away and glared at the man, his face gloomy, and said in a deep voice, "Huang Liang, it's you!"
"Yes, it's me!"
The man was holding a spear and had a yellowish beard. He looked indifferent, but his eyes were full of killing intent.
"Elder Huang, why are you here?"
Master Hong hurriedly bowed.
Huang Liang said indifferently, "I heard that there was a talented man named Xu Yan among the Loose Cultivators, whose Sword Dao was extraordinary. After further investigations, I found that his cultivation technique had been stolen from my Thousand Martial Hall.
"Today, I'm here to kill the thief and retrieve the secret technique!"
Master Hong nodded, "I see!"
The cultivation technique of the Sword Sect came from the Thousand Martial Hall. If it had been stolen from the Sword Sect, then it must have been also stolen from the Thousand Martial Hall. There was no difference between the two.
"Shameless! Your Thousand Martial Hall is still as shameless as ever!"
Moon Changming sneered in anger.
"You can quit barking, dog! Today, I'll put down this stray cur!"
Huang Liang said, lifting his spear. Suddenly, a majestic and vast force poured into the spear. The space around the spear rippled as if it had stirred up the upheaval of heaven and earth.
A great aura emerged from Huang Liang, casting a faint yellow light on his body. Master Hong felt a heavy pressure, as if being suppressed by a mountain.
He looked startled and retreated hastily.
Is this the might of the strongest in the Transcendent Spirit Sect?
"Do you see now? This is the power of the strongest in the Transcendent Spirit Sect. Can Loose Cultivators like you even comprehend it? My senior uncle, with this might, shattered your spiritual body in the past, and today I will obliterate you completely!"
Huang Liang stared coldly at Moon Changming.
Moon Changming's face turned pale. His eyes were filled with rage, frustration, and a deep sense of powerlessness.
The strength of the Transcendent Spirit Sect was beyond his imagination.
"Who would have thought, Huang Liang, you waste, be able to reach this step, and be this strong!"
Moon Changming gave a self-deprecating laugh.
In the past, he had not valued this person, but now this person had become one of the strongest!
"Moon Changming, at this point, you are the one who's useless!"
Huang Liang said coldly.
"Moon shines across the sky? What a joke. It's time for you to disappear!"
Huang Liang thrust his spear. The spear, seemingly infused with the Great Power of Heaven and Earth, had not yet reached Moon Changming when he already spat out a mouthful of blood and stumbled backwards. His body seemed to be cracked.
"Is this the might of the strongest? My master couldn't stand it back then, and I can not stand it now!"
Moon Changming felt deeply powerless.
Back then, it was also a powerhouse of the Thousand Martial Hall who had made the move. His master could not withstand it, and his spiritual body was shattered in one strike. Now, it's the same.
Only when he was directly facing this strike did Moon Changming realize how terrifying it was. His master was facing such an attack!
It seemed to be infused with the Great Power of Heaven and Earth.
"That man's means are indeed spectacular, but he can't withstand this strike!"
In Moon Changming's mind, he pictured the young man who had displayed powerful killing means when he raised his hand on the back of the big cat.
While the power was strong and the momentum magnificent, creating a dragon-like might across the heavens and the earth, it was likely incapable of resisting a spear strike that seemed to carry the Great Power of Heaven and Earth!
This is the might of the strongest in the Transcendent Spirit Sect!
Boom!
Moon Changming's expression was serious, his eyes frosty, "Huang Liang, you piece of trash, even if I, Moon Changming, were to die in the hands of women and children, I would never die in your hands.
"You're not worthy!"
He roared and the broken moon suddenly flew out of his body, turning into a real broken moon.
Then, the cane in his hand fell apart. A powerful force welled up from within Moon Changming and poured into that moon.
Boom!
All of a sudden, the moon exploded with great power. The blinding glare lit up all directions and also blocked the spear for a moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 512 - 280: The Strongest in the Thousand Martial Hall, Enlightenment of Divine Skills_2
chapters.content:
When the glowing words faded away, Moon Changming was no longer seen on the original spot.
Huang Liang scoffed coldly, "Moon Changming, I never would have imagined that you could refine the power of your Spiritual Body to such an extent. Now, you've blocked me for a moment using your original Spiritual Body. But, you're completely wasted now."
"You don't have much time to live, 'Moon Reflecting in the Sky' is really gone!"
Huang Liang didn't chase after him. Moon Changming was utterly worn out and even if he tried to pursue him, there was no guarantee he could catch him in a short time.
His indifferent gaze then turned towards the scattered cultivators of the All Ages Alliance.
"Filthy loose cultivators, daring to go against me, deserve to die!"
With a sweep of his long spear, a thunderous crash descended, and in an instant, two Refining God Martial Artists were killed!
"Run quickly!"
The eyes of the Alliance Hierarch of the Luo State were blood red.
Huang Liang was too powerful. Facing him, a Refining God Heavenly Man is akin to a lesser being in front of a Refining God Heavenly Man; the difference in their powers was heaven and earth!
The strongest of the Transcendent Spirit Sect!
"Run? Let's see how many can escape!"
Huang Liang's expression was indifferent. He took a step forward, his long spear thrust out, and a force as heavy as a mountain crushed down. The Refining God Martial Artists originally fleeing abruptly stiffened on the spot.
By the time they broke free from that heavy force intending to escape, the spear light had already obliterated them.
"Kill!"
The Alliance Hierarch of Luo State roared in anger, along with two other Refining God peak experts, they assaulted Huang Liang, directly burning their vitality to execute a desperate Martial Arts secret technique.
Just to impede Huang Liang for a brief moment, so the others would have a chance to escape!
Bang!
Almost all of the Luo State All Ages Alliance was destroyed, and all the powerful fighters of the Luo State Alliance Hierarch died in battle.
Few Refining God Martial Artists managed to escape.
Huang Liang held his spear, looking at the land of Yuzhou, said indifferently, "It's time to take back what belongs to Thousand Martial Hall, the secret transmission of sword dao!"
He stepped towards Yuzhou.
...
"Grandpa, what's wrong with you? Grandpa, don't scare me!"
Yue'er looked at her grandfather, whose face was pale and whose breath was weak, and her eyes welled up with tears.
She hastily pulled out a bunch of Spiritual Medicines and fed them into her grandfather's mouth.
"Yue'er, run quickly. Before you reach Divine Origin Realm, do not wander around. Alternatively, go far away to Azure Sea. Grandpa can't last much longer!"
Moon Changming weakly said.
Yue'er quickly carried her grandfather and fled into the forest, wiping her tears as she asked, "Grandpa, who hurt you? I will avenge you!"
Moon Changming gently stroked her head, his eyes full of doting as he said, "Yue'er, don't be stubborn. Just cultivate well. As long as you're happy, that's all that matters."
"No, without grandpa, I won't be happy until I avenge you."
"Cough, cough ... Grandpa can hang on for a few more years, I won't die just yet!"
Moon Changming coughed a few times.
Then as though he remembered something, he said, "Yue'er, take grandpa to that cave. While grandpa is healing, go find Xu Yan and tell him the strongest of Thousand Martial Hall is coming for his Sword Dao, falsely claiming that he stole the secret Sword Dao of Thousand Martial Hall. Tell him to escape quickly, go far away to Azure Sea, to have a slim chance of survival."
Yue'er bit her lip and said, "I understand, grandpa. It's those bastards of Thousand Martial Hall, I will kill him for sure!"
Moon Changming gave a wry smile.
"Yue'er, promise grandpa. Don't reveal your identity or take action before you become the strongest."
"Grandpa, I understand!"
Yue'er nodded in agreement.
...
All was calm in the manor.
Whether it was Li Xuan or Xu Yan, none of them had ever imagined that such a shameless act would come from Thousand Martial Hall, actually intending to seize the Sword Dao, and even had the audacity to accuse others of stealing their secret transmission."
"These Heaven and Earth Laws are truly mysterious. I've only noted them down, but I'm not able to use them just yet. It's ultimately impossible for anyone at the Divine Origin Realm to use the Heaven and Earth Laws."
"If it were the Divine Skill Realm, with my understanding of the Heaven and Earth Laws, I should be able to use them."
"The realm above Divine Skill Realm is to control the Heaven and Earth Laws for personal use. I'm almost ready to compile it, it's just that Xu Yan hasn't realized the Divine Skill Martial Arts Cultivation Technique yet."
Li Xuan sighed inwardly.
"Who wrote The Book of Tai Cang that even depicts the Heaven and Earth Laws of Tai Cang Realm? It takes an extraordinary level of strength and realm to write it. "
"From what I understand now, Ling Domain does not seem to have such a strong cultivator. "
"Moreover, Ling Domain is only a region in the Tai Cang Sky and Earth. Why do I feel like Tai Cang Sky and Earth has been divided into several regions?"
Li Xuan grew curious.
The Book of Tai Cang was acquired by Meng Chong in the imperial palace of Wu Country. Such a treasure, why would it be found in a remote place?
Who created this Book of Tai Cang?
"No matter what, The Book of Tai Cang is in my hands now. It's beneficial for my martial arts cultivation. With the Book of Tai Cang as a reference, the martial arts I create are more likely to surpass the Grand Azure Martial Dao."
Li Xuan was studying the eighth page of The Book of Tai Cang.
"Fang Hao's strength has increased again. The pace is not slow."
Li Xuan nodded in satisfaction.
Meng Chong and Su Lingxiu were about to break through, and Xu Yan was not far from the perfection of the Divine Intent State.
...
Xu Yan was pondering the Wisdom Sword Realm. The more he explored, the more profound he found it. He couldn't help but sigh, the third realm of Sword Dao is indeed elusive and profound, it's not something that he could comprehend right now.
"Master was right, If I could condense my Primordial Spirit, perhaps I may be able to comprehend the Wisdom Sword Realm."
With that thought, Xu Yan began pondering the Divine Skill Realm Martial Arts.
After such a long time, he had already understood the Martial Dao laws of Divine Origin Realm but he had yet figured out the laws of Divine Skills.
"Divine Skill is about condensing the Primordial Spirit, and when the Primordial Spirit is complete, Divine Skills are born... But how can Divine Skills be born naturally?"
This is the most difficult part to comprehend.
The condensation of the Primordial Spirit involves the fusion of Divine Origin with Divine Intent, which subsequently causes a transformation leading to the formation of the Primordial Spirit. The physical body would also become stronger because of the condensation of the Primordial Spirit.
Divine Origin would also transform as a result, significantly advancing to another level.
The patterns of the Heaven and Earth Laws surfaced in Xu Yan's mind. This was something their master passed onto them to comprehend when they had spare time. After deepening their understanding day by day, they had also attained some insights.
At that moment, Xu Yan's mind flashed with images of his master reading a book and the unconstrained way he carried himself while walking. Despite being a supreme powerhouse, he seemed as ordinary as a common man.
"Dao follows nature? Return to the simplicity…"
In his mind, the image of his master during 'Tianjiao Battle' appeared when his master unleashed a great formation with just a thought, leveraging the great strength of heaven and earth, how awe-inspiring was that scene?
This was merely a display of his constrained realm so as not to be too profound for his fourth disciple to comprehend.
"The great strength of heaven and earth, when it's not invoked, it's invisible and cannot be seen, but it exists between heaven and earth... The Heavenly Earth Lingji is also invisible, but you can feel its existence in the mystery of things.
"Thanks to the Heavenly Earth Lingji, martial artists can cultivate, spiritual energy becomes gentler and martial artists can cultivate spiritual energy.
"The Laws of Heaven and Earth are elusive, difficult to comprehend and control, this is the power of the fundamental laws of heaven and earth.
"If one could utilize the Laws of Heaven and Earth, they would truly master the Great Power of Heaven and Earth. What kind of realm would that be?"
Xu Yan was pondering and contemplating.
"If heaven and earth have laws, does the martial arts also have laws? If a martial artist is like Heaven and Earth, can martial artists also form laws?"
In that instant, a spark flashed in Xu Yan's mind.
"I see it now, Divine Skills!"
His excitement surged suddenly.
"At the divine Skill Realm, when the Primordial Spirit is formed, Divine Skills spontaneously occur. Isn't that the Law of Martial Arts? The Law of Heaven and Earth is the law of all things in heaven and earth;
"Divine Skills represent a martial artist's law, which is the law of martial arts, the law of oneself.
"When the Primordial Spirit emerges, the law becomes apparent, and Divine Skills are born naturally; Divine Skills are my own Martial Arts laws, just like the Laws of Heaven and Earth.
"The Martial Path is endless. With the birth of Divine Skills, the laws of my own martial arts came into being. If the cultivation continues, one day it will transcend the heaven and earth.
"Unbound by the constraints and shackles of heaven and earth, is this the pinnacle of martial arts?"
Xu Yan was excited. He felt like he'd grasped the core of Divine Skill Martial Dao law.
Divine Skills occur naturally, that is, the birth of their own Martial Dao law.
"Master exists in Heaven and Earth, but Heaven and Earth don't know of Master, so Master has transcended Heaven and Earth, existing at the pinnacle of Martial Arts, almost at the level of the Dao?
"It must be so. That's why masters' actions, although seeming ordinary, have actually returned to simplicity, because Master has transcended Heaven and Earth, and are no longer bound and shackled by it!"
Xu Yan's face showed excitement. He then took a deep breath, calmed his spirit and delved into the comprehension of Divine Skill Martial Dao law. He had already comprehended the cultivation of the Divine Skill Realm and was now perfecting his understanding, soon he would fully comprehend the Divine Skill Martial Dao law!

chapters.title: Chapter 513 - 281: Primordial Spirit Gathers Divine Skills, Law of Heaven and Earth_1
chapters.content:
Xu Yan was sorting out his understanding while immersing himself in the comprehension of divine skills in martial arts. As he continually contemplated, the principles of divine skill law became clearer and clearer.
"I finally understand. The diagrams of Heaven and Earth Laws that the master described for me to comprehend was meant to make me understand that as there are laws in heaven and earth, so there are in martial arts, and divine skills are the laws of a martial artist.
"It's a pity that I am too slow-witted, only realizing the deep intent of the master now."
Xu Yan sighed inwardly, thinking that if he had understood the profound intentions of his master earlier, wouldn't he have already comprehended the divine skill martial arts law?
"The master imparts teachings, hoping that I would carve out my own martial arts path, not just retracing his steps. Hence, he would not explicitly tell me the essentials of martial arts, but let me realize it on my own.
"I should've realized earlier that the master definitely had deep intentions."
The more Xu Yan thought about it, the more ashamed he felt.
Li Xuan was studying the Heaven and Earth Laws in the Book of Tai Cang, and suddenly, as if sensing something, he glanced at where Xu Yan was, raising his eyebrows slightly.
"Has Xu Yan had some sort of enlightenment?"
Gradually entering a state where everything else is forgotten, free from external disturbances.
The mind is completely focused on oneself, entering a state similar to sudden enlightenment - these were signs that Xu Yan had reached enlightenment.
"The Divine Skill is not far off!"
Li Xuan was overjoyed.
"Once one enters the realm of divine skills, divine skills generate naturally. What kind of divine skill would be generated when I enter the realm of divine skills? When Xu Yan enters the realm of divine skills, feedback will also be generated, so the divine powers I possess must be plentiful."
"The four martial arts pathways, the peculiar martial arts pathway is singular, will it also have a divine skill? Even if it doesn't give birth to divine skills, there will definitely be means not weaker than divine skills."
"Physical body martial arts divine skill, Dan medicine martial arts divine skill…"
The more Li Xuan thought about it, the more excited he became.
"The divine skills generated by oneself, similar to innate divine skills, are limitless as they improve with the enhancement of the realm's power."
"Apart from this, one can also create postnatal divine skills, which is the divine skill law of martial arts."
When he thought of this, Li Xuan couldn't help but get excited.
"It's about time to compile the martial arts divine skills. After all, the later martial artists, even if they break the divine realm, the divine skills that are born might not be very strong, and there might only be one divine skill."
"Therefore, they need to cultivate other kinds of divine skills. Now that there is a divine skill realm, how can there not be a divine law?"
Thinking of this, Li Xuan started to ponder over how to compile the martial arts divine skills.
"There are strong and weak divine skills, divided into small divine skills and great divine skills. The divine skills generated by oneself are not necessarily stronger than the skills created."
"For example, the divine skills born to martial artists like Shi'er, Zhou Ying might only be small divine skills?"
"Since one's own divine skills are not strong, one could cultivate stronger divine skills to compensate. The strength of Dahua's martial arts lies in this."
Li Xuan's thoughts flowed, and the Divine Skill Martial Arts Law emerged in his mind.
Create divine skills in martial arts!
To further improve, in addition to the self-generated divine skills, one can practice the divine skills created postnatally. The divine skills that are created will definitely be very strong.
"As a martial ancestor, I've spent too much heart on martial arts. It's time to compile a Divine Skill Martial Code."
Li Xuan sighed inwardly.
The Divine Skill Martial Code, encompassing both great divine skills and small divine skills, as well as various divine skill laws.
"There's more work to do."
Li Xuan sighed inwardly. He had to make an effort to compile the divine skills, which would consume his energy.
Of course, there's no rush now. After all, he didn't know what the divine skills were. He needed to wait until he had broken the divine skill realm, understood the wonderful workings of the divine skills, and then use this as a foundation to compile various divine skills.
As for whether the compiled divine skills can be practiced, Li Xuan is not worried. Even if his four disciples do not practice or comprehend them, as long as they are passed on, there will surely be people in the future who can comprehend them.
In this world, there might not be a second monster like Xu Yan, but there won't be a lack of talents. There will always be people who will be able to comprehend the divine skills.
Moreover, he has the Daoist Golden Book to assist him. The compiled divine skills would be relatively perfect and the difficulty in comprehension could be reduced. Even if great divine skills are difficult to comprehend, small divine skills can always be comprehended.
Although Xu Yan understood what a divine skill is, it would take him some time to thoroughly comprehend the divine skill realm martial arts law.
But it's just a matter of two or three days.
Li Xuan continues to delve into the eighth page of the Book of Tai Cang's Heaven and Earth Laws, waiting for Xu Yan to completely comprehend the divine skill realm martial arts law.
On the third day of Xu Yan sorting out the Divine Skill Realm Martial Arts Law, a message came through. The Luo State Alliance of the All Ages Alliance had been exposed, and a great battle had broken out between them and the Spirit Sect's noble families.
Moreover, they called upon Loose Cultivators to unite and confront the Spirit Sect's noble families, and they even gained the upper hand.
"Are the Spirit Sect and noble families in Luo State so weak?"
Fang Hao looked puzzled.
Yu Gao and the others were all excited, itching for action. Once the Luo State Alliance succeeds and gains a foothold in Luo State, the Yuzhou Alliance should also appear.
Li Xuan shook his head after hearing this, saying, "The Luo State Alliance won't be able to accomplish anything."
"Master, why?"
Fang Hao asked curiously.
"The strength and depth of the Spirit Sect and noble families are not so easily shaken. Moreover, since the All Ages Alliance have been exposed passively, it suggests that the Spirit Sect have already grasped them to a large extent."
"The only uncertainty is the actual strength of these loose cultivators being beyond expectations."
"But, that's just about it. Once they recover, they will definitely strike a heavy blow against the Luo State Alliance, and the stronger Spirit Sect hasn't even made a move yet."
At this point, Li Xuan looking unconvinced towards the Luo State Alliance, continued, "Apart from the loose cultivators who have a deep hatred against the Spirit Sect and noble families, the rest will be watching. They might even act against the All Ages Alliance, trying to please the Spirit Sect."

chapters.title: Chapter 514 - 281: The Primordial Spirit Gathers Divine Skills to Live, Law of Heaven and Earth_2
chapters.content:
"Furthermore, the slogan of the All Ages Alliance is too commonplace."
Upon coming to this point, Li Xuan felt the need to instruct his disciple, Fang Hao. He was, after all, the Alliance Hierarch of the All Ages Alliance in Yuzhou, and he mustn't repeat the same mistakes. He shouldn't entertain the idea of competing with Loose Cultivators for a place among them, believing that those cultivators would then throw their support behind him.
Once he began to speak, Li Xuan again started instructing his disciple, finally saying, "Calling for unity among Loose Cultivators is less effective than proclaiming, 'Would a prince or a high minister ever prefer being a farmer?' Those with hot blood will naturally respond.
"Ah, the Loose Cultivators of the Ling Domain, they've been tamed by the Spirit Sect for too long, and their heads are filled with dreams of joining the Spirit Sect's clans. They always aspire to join and stand above others, enjoying a superior status.
"Such Loose Cultivators, once they join the Spirit Sect, tend to be the cruelest towards other Loose Cultivators. Remember not to be too naive about this.
"For the All Ages Alliance to succeed, besides possessing the power to oppose the clans of the Spirit Sect, it must also present benefits that would entice all the Loose Cultivators in the world.
"Tell all the Loose Cultivators in the world, that toppling the Spirit Sect and splitting its resources evenly..."
Listening to his master's teaching, Fang Hao had an epiphany. So it could be done this way, and he understood that for the All Ages Alliance to succeed, it had to possess the power to oppose the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
Otherwise, it would all be talk without substance.
As for the strength of the All Ages Alliance, Fang Hao wasn't exactly sure. Even Yu Gao didn't know much, but they both admitted that the All Ages Alliance had numerous powerhouses!
After instructing Fang Hao, Li Xuan resumed his study of the Book of Tai Cang.
Suddenly, atop his Soul Pedestal, the Daoist Golden Book opened, and golden light surged forth.
He instantly became excited.
Xu Yan, you finally understood the Martial Arts law of the Divine Skill Realm!
"Your disciple Xu Yan has attained comprehension of the Martial Arts law of the Divine Skill Realm that you created, and you have now broken into the Divine Skill Realm."
Boom!
At this moment, Li Xuan felt as though his spiritual essence and intent were merging together, as if he was undergoing a sublime transformation. The Palace of Nirvana inside him was illuminated, his Soul Pedestal expanded, becoming purer and more profound.
As his willpower continued to solidify, a human figure began to form atop his Soul Pedestal.
Li Xuan felt the changes within himself, the mysteries of his Primordial Spirit. He had completely mastered the Martial Arts law of the Divine Skill Realm and couldn't help but feel amazed.
Xu Yan, you truly are my pioneer in Martial Arts!
Divine Skills, the laws for Martial Artists!
The Martial Arts law that Martial Artists practice!
Atop his Soul Pedestal, Li Xuan opened his eyes. At this moment, his Primordial Spirit was almost indistinguishable from his actual body.
Raising his hand, the Daoist Golden Book landed in his palm. He could feel the vastness of the Daoist Golden Book, almost as if he was sensing the Dao itself.
With one hand supporting the Daoist Golden Book, a golden light enveloped his Primordial Spirit.
Atop his Soul Pedestal, the Primordial Spirit of Li Xuan showed a smile.
"So this is the Martial Arts Primordial Spirit!"
Li Xuan didn't truly comprehend it until now — the Martial Arts Primordial Spirit from the Divine Skill Realm law that he created was extremely powerful.
He had fully comprehended the first page of the Heaven and Earth Laws recorded in his mind from the Book of Tai Cang. He really started to comprehend the mysteries of the laws of Heaven and Earth.
"As you break through the Divine Skill Realm and form the Martial Arts Primordial Spirit, you obtain the Divine Skill known as the Law of Heaven and Earth!"
Boom!
At this moment, Li Xuan's Divine Skill was born.
"The Law of Heaven and Earth, I can't believe I gave birth to such a Divine Skill!"
Li Xuan was filled with joy.
The Law of Heaven and Earth, this Divine Skill is absolutely powerful.
"As you break through the Divine Skill Realm and form the Martial Arts Primordial Spirit, you obtain the Divine Skill, Qiankun in the Sword!"
His second Divine Skill was born.
As expected, it was a Sword Dao Divine Skill.
Qiankun in the Sword, everything is within one stroke of the sword. Within the universe, life and death are determined in an instant!
"Excellent, this is very powerful!"
Li Xuan was thrilled.
His Primordial Spirit took form, and two Divine Skills were born. These were Innate Divine Skills, the Martial Arts laws!
"As you break through the Divine Skill Realm and form the Martial Arts Primordial Spirit, you obtain the Divine Skill, Annihilation of the Deity Sword!"
His third Divine Skill was born, and it was also a Sword Dao Divine Skill.
"This Sword Dao Divine Skill is really powerful!"
Annihilation of the Deity Sword, as long as he captures a strand of his enemy's breath, regardless of their location or the distance between them, he could slay their Divine Soul with a single stroke!
"With this Divine Skill, as the realm strength improves, it is no different than the Causality Divine Skill. It requires no breath, and can still slay with a single far-reaching slash!"
Indeed, this Sword Dao Divine Skill is extremely powerful; no matter where the enemy flees, they can be killed with one slash.
Of course, even though you can pierce the enemy's Divine Soul from a long distance with a strand of breath, if the enemy can resist this attack, it still cannot kill them.
Regardless, this Divine Skill is extremely powerful and difficult to defend against. Even if strengths are equal, when faced with this sudden attack, it's hard to withstand.
"Upon breaking the Divine Skill Realm, and forming your Martial Arts Primordial Spirit, you acquire the Divine Skill - Descending Dragon Divine Power!"
Another Martial Arts Divine Skill is born.
However, this Divine Skill belongs to the Descending Dragon Palm. When utilized, it's as though summoning a real divine dragon coming into this world.
Of course, the power of Descending Dragon Divine Power is related to the user's realm.
Regardless, the power of this Divine Skill is extremely potent, possessing the clout of a real divine dragon.
"In the end, Descending Dragon Palm becomes a Divine Skill. Using a dragon to summon a dragon, it truly does summon a dragon!"
Li Xuan feels somewhat embarrassed. Originally, he made up the saying 'Using a dragon to summon a dragon' to deceive Xu Yan, but he never imagined that in the end, it truly summoned a dragon.
"Four Divine Skills now!"
Li Xuan is thrilled in his heart. Upon entering the Divine Skill Realm, forming his Primordial Spirit, he has already birthed four Divine Skills.
"Upon breaking the Divine Skill Realm, forming your Martial Arts Primordial Spirit, you acquire the Divine Skill - Moment of Heaven and Earth!"
The fifth Divine Skill is born!
Moment of Heaven and Earth!
"This is a speed-based Divine Skill. It allows you to cross the Heaven and Earth in a flash, even faster than Divine Lightning Void Tranverse."
Li Xuan feels deeply moved.
Divine Lightning Void Tranverse is powerful; once fully utilized, you can traverse through the void like a divine lightning bolt.
But Moment of Heaven and Earth, the speed of this Divine Skill, is also incredibly fast. In a blink of an eye, it can cross the Heaven and Earth from South to North.
In an instant, it can traverse Heaven and Earth.
Of course, even though Divine Skill is powerful, it still needs enough strength to support it.
Clearly, even after Li Xuan has broken the Divine Skill Realm, he cannot instantly cross Heaven and Earth from South to North or traverse Heaven and Earth.
"I only have five Divine Skills."
After the birth of the Divine Skill Moment of Heaven and Earth, there were no more Divine Skills born. Li Xuan feels a little regret.
"But it's enough. Law of Heaven and Earth, Qiankun in the Sword, Annihilation of the Deity Sword, Descending Dragon Divine Power, Moment of Heaven and Earth... Each Divine Skill is unique, and they are all powerful!"
Li Xuan feels content.
Law of Heaven and Earth, once cast, is much stronger than the Six Chi Golden Body, and if it's stacked, it will be even more terrifying.
Qiankun in the Sword is dual-purpose for attack and defense. It's unparalleled in Sword Dao.
Descending Dragon Divine Power is absolutely overbearing. When the divine dragon comes out, who can challenge it?
"These are the Divine Skills born from my breaking into the Divine Skill Realm. When Xu Yan breaks into the Divine Skill Realm, there will indeed be feedback, and I will also birth Divine Skills at that time.
"The same goes for Meng Chong's breakthrough. He will birth Divine Skills of the flesh body. The Six Chi Golden Body will surely undergo a transformation and become a powerful Divine Skill, similar to Law of Heaven and Earth?
"When Su Lingxiu breaks through, there will also be feedback from Divine Skills. The Divine Skills of a Dan Medical Martial Artist..."
Thinking this way, Li Xuan is filled with anticipation.
After breaking the Divine Skill Realm, his Martial Arts have become more advanced, and he has a clear understanding of Divine Skills. Next, it's time to take action to compile a Divine Skill Martial Code.
"There must be differences between the Divine Skills in terms of magnitude. Although the Divine Skills that I have birthed are all considered major Divine Skills, for a martial artist like Shi'er, if they were to break the Divine Skill Realm and birth Divine Skills, they wouldn't necessarily be so powerful.
"So, let's distinguish the major and minor Divine Skills based on this standard. Based on the perfection and strength of the Martial Arts rules, we can directly understand what are major and minor Divine Skills."
Li Xuan silently thinks to himself.
"Since we are going to compile Divine Skills, then the classification of Divine Skills, including attack-based Divine Skills, defense-based Divine Skills, speed-based Divine Skills, etc., should also be clearly arranged."
Compiling a set of Martial Arts Divine Skills is not something that can be completed overnight, it is inevitably a tough task. But for the prosperity of his own Martial Arts, for his own Martial Arts to become more perfect and powerful, Li Xuan can only persevere.
"Once the Divine Skill Martial Code is compiled, I will let my disciples comprehend it first. Each person gets one, and they should learn as much as they can."
Li Xuan shows a smile.
Once the Divine Skill Martial Code is compiled, how could it collect dust? Of course, it must be given to his disciples to meditate upon it properly.
"Now I have entered the Divine Skill Realm and in this Ling Domain, who else can be my opponent? Can the strongest person of the Transcendent Spirit Sect withstand a slap from me? Can several dozen of the strongest surround and prevent my full-force attack?"
At this moment, Li Xuan is full of confidence. The Divine Skill Realm is not just powerful towards the birthed Divine Skills, the Martial Arts displayed with every move and action, all nearly Divine Skills, it's not comparable to the past!

chapters.title: Chapter 515 - 282: His Master, More Arrogant _1
chapters.content:
After breaking through to the Divine Skill Realm, a greatly invigorated Li Xuan was in high spirits. He called over Red Cat to guide it on the path of Martial Arts for great monsters, teaching it how to cultivate a great monster Primordial Spirit, and how to practice great monster Divine Skills.
After instructing Red Cat, the elated Li Xuan pointed to Yu Xiaolong and unleashed a burst of Sorcery, passing on the great monster Martial Arts technique to him.
"Cultivate well and break through as soon as possible!"
Yu Xiaolong was thrilled and quickly kowtowed in gratitude.
He had already obtained the way of monster Martial Arts from Red Cat, but the concepts were challenging to comprehend. Under Red Cat's guidance, he had barely scratched the surface.
Li Xuan, however, used Sorcery to directly impart the techniques of great monster Martial Arts into Yu Xiaolong's consciousness, enabling him to instantly grasp the skills of great monster Martial Arts.
After all, he isn't an ordinary beast. His spiritual wisdom had long been awakened, and under Li Xuan's guidance via Sorcery, he naturally grasped the way of great monsters rather quickly.
Li Xuan then taught Little Ha the way of great monsters using the same method.
Seeing this, Red Cat felt a hint of pressure, fearing that it would be surpassed by Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha. It aspired to be a great monster king in its own right, how could it possibly be surpassed by its underlings?
Thus, it cultivated more diligently. What eased its worries somewhat was that both Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha were unable to match its cultivation speed.
Red Cat regained its confidence and playfully pounced on Yu Xiaolong a few times to flaunt its great monster prestige.
Then, extending a paw, it gave Little Ha a sharp smack, knocking it over.
"Quack!"
Little Ha let out a soft cry.
Red Cat was satisfied. This frog inherently acknowledged its supremacy, and that was good!
Having flaunted its power, Red Cat didn't forget to show its cuteness in front of its master and to curry favor with Su Lingxiu. It played the dual role of a fierce monster king outside, but a cute and chubby cat at home!
Li Xuan couldn't help but exclaim that this chubby tiger of his was truly adept!
After Xu Yan comprehended the Divine Skill Realm, he was suddenly filled with exhilaration. He had already understood the cultivation technique of martial arts and was just waiting to enhance his power through cultivation.
"Now that I've grasped the Divine Origin Realm and the Divine Skill Realm, my next goal is to break through to perfection in the Divine Intent State."
Xu Yan thought excitedly.
After breaking through to perfection in the Divine Intent State, he would have to figure out how to accumulate experience and make preparations for breaking through to the Divine Origin Realm.
"The cherished resources of the Yu Sect, the Su Family, and the Dai Family are indeed plentiful, and my junior sister has also refined many elixirs. However, if I want to accumulate experience to break through to the Divine Origin Realm, it is still insufficient.
"In particular, high-quality treasures, or some items with a special divine effect, these all need to be sought out."
Xu Yan was already plotting about accumulating experience.
Although he had many resources at hand, they weren't quite enough to maximize his experience and break through to the Divine Origin Realm. Primarily, he lacked certain valuable items with special divine effects.
"The higher the realm, the more experience I need to accumulate, and the higher the quality of spiritual items required, sometimes even requiring spiritual medicine with special effects.
"However, with the vastness of the Ling Domain and the numerous Spirit Sects, it wouldn't be too hard to accumulate experience. It's merely a matter of time."
Xu Yan decided that after breaking through to the Divine Intent State, he should leave Yuzhou and venture into the other states to prepare for accumulating experience.
After all, among the Eighteen States of the Ling Domain, Yuzhou was the weakest and the richest state, which naturally is the state where the Transcendent Spirit Sect resides.
"The process of honing martial arts cannot be missing. Lu Xinting is too weak to hone my martial arts."
Xu Yan was considering his future opponents. Anyone not in the Divine Intent State would not be able to catch his eye, even if they were renowned geniuses!
The manor was like a utopia, undisturbed by the outside world.
After settling her grandfather, Yue'er anxiously sought Xu Yan's whereabouts. However, all these days, she had been trying to find Xu Yan without any results.
Now, how was she supposed to find him?
"Could Xu Yan be hiding in the capital of Zheng Country, or perhaps in its vicinity?"
Yue'er was anxious. according to her grandfather, the strongest martial artist from the Thousand Martial Hall would be coming to Yuzhou soon.
"Xu Yan, run quickly! A supreme martial artist is coming to kill you!"
Out of desperation, Yue'er started calling out loudly while searching for him.
Her idea was simple. If Xu Yan was always paying attention to external information, then the news of her searching for him like this would surely reach his ears.
From the capital of Zheng Country, Yue'er called out while searching all the way. Her face grew more and more anxious as she feared her actions could expose her and her grandfather's whereabouts.
"I can only search for one more day, or else we'll be in danger if we get spotted."
Yue'er thought to herself.
She only hoped that Xu Yan could get the news, that's why she had been shouting all the way here, and naturally, many martial artists in Zheng Country's capital heard her shout too.
They couldn't help but be shocked. A supreme martial artist was coming to kill Xu Yan?
In the Ling Domain, those who could be called supreme martial artists were undoubtedly from the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
Which supreme martial artist from the Transcendent Spirit Sect was making a move? If a supreme martial artist were to make a move, how could Xu Yan escape?
Even those behind him would most certainly meet their end.
The battle of geniuses, the grand scene where the power was like dragons descending from heaven, was shocking yet spectacular, leaving a crowd of onlooking martial artists in awe.
However, in their minds, the strongest martial artists of the Transcendent Spirit Sect were invincible and the true supreme martial artists.
Therefore, in everyone's opinion, however powerful Xu Yan's master was, he was no match for a supreme martial artist.
"Xu Yan, run quickly! Flee to Azure Sea for some hope of survival. A supreme martial artist is coming to kill you really soon!"
As Yue'er's figure flew past the manor in the distance, her voice reverberated in the air.

chapters.title: Chapter 516 - 282: His Master, Even More Crazy_2
chapters.content:
Inside the mansion, everyone was taken aback.
With a sudden movement, Xu Yan vanished from the mansion in the blink of an eye.
Li Xuan raised an eyebrow, was it that girl?
"A supreme being is planning to kill Xu Yan? Which Transcendent Spirit Sect member will be sent to do the job? Just bullying the weak, is that it? Well, he has just entered the Divine Skill Realm, it's an excellent chance to test the Power of Divine Abilities with this so-called supreme being!"
Li Xuan smirked coldly in his heart.
However, seeing Yue'er so openly yelling and searching for Xu Yan, he even started to doubt whether the arrival of this supreme being was just an excuse.
An excuse to lure Xu Yan out?
"Could this girl have fallen for Xu Yan?"
Li Xuan pondered with curiosity.
His leading disciple is handsome, extraordinarily talented and has a powerful cultivation; it wouldn't be surprising for him to charm a girl like her.
As Yue'er was about to proceed to the next major city, a figure suddenly appeared.
"You were looking for me?"
Xu Yan asked as he looked at Yue'er.
"Xu Yan!"
Yue'er showed a surprise, Xu Yan appeared so quickly that she was caught off guard and nearly flung herself right into his arms. She managed to halt her momentum just in time.
Butless than a foot away from Xu Yan.
"It's me!"
Xu Yan nodded, "Why were you looking for me? How did you find out that a supreme being was coming to kill me?"
"My grandfather told me, a supreme being from the Thoudand Martial Hall plans to seize your Sword Dao. To do so, they shamelessly claimed that your master had stolen from the hall's secret teachings..."
Yue'er hurriedly explained.
Xu Yan's immediate reaction was anger,"So it's the Thousand Martial Hall, fine, fine, fine. I, Xu Yan, will remember this. They dare to act so shamelessly. The Thousand Martial Hall would be my stepping stone to the summit of the Spirit Realm. "
"After eradicating your Thousand Martial Hall, let us then see who's the shameless one!"
Yue'er: ...
He was talking about the Transcendent Spirit Sect, was Xu Yan so bold to plan to use the Sect as a stepping stone?
But it was a bold statement that carried a certain charisma!
"Xu Yan, the Thousand Martial Hall is a part of the Transcendent Spirit Sect, and their strength is extremely powerful. A supreme being of the Transcendent Spirit Sect is by no means simple. You and your master should escape quickly."
"Go into hiding in the Azure Sea if you want any chance of survival!"
Although Xu Yan's boldness caused her heart to race, she still felt the need to urge him to flee.
"Escape? What a joke!"
Xu Yan scoffed coldly. So a supreme being was coming for him?
Yes, he may not stand a chance, but in front of his master, that being was but an insignificant ant.
But he couldn't blame Yue'er, after all, she was an outsider and didn't know how powerful his master was, the existence that was almost like the Universe itself.
"By the way, where's your grandfather? How come he didn't come with you?"
Xu Yan asked.
No matter what, Yue'er had come to deliver a warning out of kindness. Regardless of this, she deserved gratitude.
Yue'er seemed sad upon hearing this, she said: "My grandfather is injured, very seriously. I'm afraid he won't live for much longer!"
By the time she finished speaking, Yue'er's eyes were red.
When her grandfather passes, there will be no one left in this world she could depend on.
"He's hurt? Bring your grandfather here, my junior sister can cure him!"
Xu Yan thought for a moment and said.
"It's impossible, my grandfather's injuries have gone deep into his source, he can't be cured."
Yue'er said with sorrow.
"Other people might not be able to cure him, but my junior sister can. Bring your grandfather here, don't worry about the supreme being, he isn't worth mentioning!"
Considering Yue'er's grandfather, who despite his severe injuries, thought about sending him a warning, he appreciated this sentiment. And seeing they were in trouble, it wouldn't hurt to lend a helping hand.
Su Lingxiu, who cultivated the Alchemy, has never treated a seriously injured martial artist, especially those with substantial power. It would be a great chance for Su Lingxiu to display her abilities and gain some experience in healing.
"Then let me ask my grandfather."
With some hesitation, Yue'er nodded.
"I'll wait for you here!"
Xu Yan decided after a moment of thought.
He needed to be cautious. It could be a trap if he followed her. So, to be safe, Xu Yan opted to wait here.
This place was close to the mansion, and even if a powerful being attacked, his master could respond right away.
"Alright!"
Yue'er nodded and dashed away.
Not far from the capital of Zheng Country was where Moon Changming was hiding. Right away, Yue'er went back and said, "Grandfather, I've found Xu Yan. He told me to bring you to him. He said he can heal your injuries."
Moon Changming sighed and said, "My injuries are incurable. Huang Liang will be coming to Yuzhou soon, what did Xu Yan say? Are we all going to run together?"
Yue'er thought for a moment, then said, "Xu Yan won't run. He might have a very powerful master who isn't afraid of the supreme being."
Moon Changming furrowed his brows and sighed. "I know his master is strong, but I'm afraid he doesn't realize the power of the supreme beings of the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
"So be it, let's go meet him. And I'll tell him how terrifying the strongest of the Transcendent Spirit Sect truly is!"
With that said, he struggled to his feet.
His breath was extremely weak, his face pale as paper, as if he could perish at any moment.
With tears in her eyes, Yue'er silently swore to herself that she would avenge her grandfather.
Supporting her grandfather, they left their hiding place and after a few brief moments, came face to face with Xu Yan.
"You're quite injured!"
Upon seeing Moon Changming's condition, Xu Yan was secretly taken aback.
The injuries were severe—it caught him by surprise that Moon Changming could survive such serious injuries for several years.
"Xu Yan, my friend, I have no hope of recovering from my injuries, but I still want to advise you—run away as fast as you can. The power of the strongest one mustn't be underestimated," Moon Changming panted out.
"It's just a minor issue, come with me. Your injuries, grave as they are, may not be impossible to heal!"
Xu Yan didn't say anything unnecessary, accepting Moon Changming's good intention.
As for the strongest of the Transcendent Spirit Sect, they are invincible in their eyes—only because they do not know about the strength of his master.
Seeing this, Moon Changming could only think of persuading him further after meeting Xu Yan's master.
Yue'er, supporting her grandfather, followed behind Xu Yan, and soon arrived in a hidden forest. Following Xu Yan's descent, they unexpectedly ended up in a manor.
She was utterly shocked—there was clearly no such manor from the outside.
"What is this?"
Moon Changming was also surprised in his heart. No wonder they couldn't locate Xu Yan.
"Just a minor formation method," Xu Yan said nonchalantly.
"Formation?"
Moon Changming murmured to himself, bewildered. What was this formation method?
His admiration for Xu Yan's mysterious master grew even more.
Perhaps, he could truly rival the strongest of the Transcendent Spirit Sect?
"Junior sister, see if you can treat him."
As they entered the manor, Su Lingxiu and others came over.
Li Xuan looked up. He couldn't help but exclaim: this old man is in a terrible state. When he first saw him, there were inherent flaws in his body due to old injuries.
He speculated that it was because his special constitution had been shattered, causing such old injuries.
And now?
His special constitution was completely lost, and the origin was hurt. The fact that he could survive for a few more years was a testament to the old man's toughness.
"Spiritual body is gone."
Li Xuan thought to himself.
Looking at Yue'er, this girl indeed has rare talents. She possesses the gift of a spiritual body and cultivates exceptional skills, no wonder she reached the peak of the major human realm at such a young age.
When it came to strength, she was superior to Lu Xinting.
"These injuries are very serious, they have reached the source!"
After examining, Su Lingxiu's face was filled with excitement.
Since beginning her practice of the Alchemy Martial Arts, she finally had a chance to show her abilities.
"But the problem isn't significant. It can be cured, it's just some of his…"
Su Lingxiu reflected on how to describe Moon Changming's condition.
At this moment, Li Xuan spoke: "Spiritual body collapsed, origin lost."
Su Lingxiu nodded, "Yes, the gift of the special constitution has collapsed, the origin is lost. Recovery will be quite difficult!"
Moon Changming looked shocked. His injuries... could be cured?
And moreover, even if his spiritual body had perished and the origin was lost, there was still a chance to restore it, just that it would be quite difficult?
He looked incredulous, almost thinking that the others were bluffing.
But with delight, Yue'er grabbed Su Lingxiu's hand and eagerly questioned, "Sister, can my grandfather really be cured?"
"Of course!"
Su Lingxiu replied confidently, "As long as he is alive, he can be cured!"
"That's wonderful! Thank you, brother Xu Yan, thank you, sister!"
Overwhelmed with joy, Yue'er shed tears.
