After a moment of silence, Moon Changming finally looked at Li Xuan and said, "Huang Liang, the strongest of the Thousand Martial Hall, is heading to Yuzhou. From my perspective, it's best to avoid him for now."
Li Xuan replied calmly, "No worries, he's just a mere ant."
Moon Changming:…...
At this moment, Moon Changming finally understood where Xu Yan's recklessness came from.
His master was even more reckless!
It seemed to run in their lineage!
Also, he was in a complicated mood: if a mere ant could injure him this badly, what was he?
Less than an ant?
He had come with the intention to persuade them to escape, but they were not afraid in the least. To them, the strongest were but mere ants. This left him not knowing how to continue persuading them.

chapters.title: Chapter 517 - 283: Everyone's a Madman, Shock of Moon Changming_1
chapters.content:
Moon Changming opened his mouth, unsure of how to persuade him further.
Meanwhile, Su Lingxiu took out a pill and said, "Here, take this rejuvenation pill first. It will restore a good deal of your injuries."
Moon Changming was seriously injured, and his spiritual body had collapsed completely, which was the fundamental injury.
If his spiritual body's origin isn't restored, even if his injuries heal completely, his strength will drastically decrease.
Since they intended to treat him, they naturally wanted to restore him to his peak condition.
This was the first serious patient after all. It was an excellent opportunity to showcase the art of alchemical healing and accumulate experience. If he wasn't thoroughly healed, wouldn't it tarnish the reputation of a martial artist who is an alchemical healer?
"It's useless. I'm well aware of the severity of my injuries."
Moon Changming shook his head with a bitter smile.
However, he still swallowed the rejuvenation pill.
"Alright, sit down. Let me figure out how to treat you."
Su Lingxiu said, excitement written all over her face.
At this moment, Xu Yan angrily recounted the shameless actions of the Thousand Martial Hall, who falsely accused his master of stealing the secret sword techniques of the hall.
"This Thousand Martial Hall has a death wish!"
Upon hearing this, Li Xuan instantly became enraged.
"So, they love my Sword Dao so much. Then let the Thousand Martial Hall experience it, in order to see how capable the Transcendent Spirit Sect truly is."
"Let's see if they can withstand the power of my divine abilities."
Feeling annoyed, Li Xuan planned to make an example of the Thousand Martial Hall.
By doing so, he could gauge the strength of the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
"I've decided. I will use the Thousand Martial Hall as a stepping stone. I will suppress the Thousand Martial Hall and use it as a stepping stone to ascend to the summit of the Spirit Realm!"
Xu Yan said coldly.
"Master, what do you think?"
He asked while looking at his master.
In his view, his master would not disdain to destroy the Thousand Martial Hall for such a trifle. Moreover, how could he let his master handle such a minor matter personally? It was him, the disciple, who should take action!
"Hmm, it's fine. Consider it as a practice."
Li Xuan nodded in agreement.
Since Xu Yan had such ambition, Li Xuan had to temporarily suppress his thoughts on suppressing the Thousand Martial Hall.
Moreover, the strength of the Transcendent Spirit Sect was still unknown. If he couldn't wipe out the Thousand Martial Hall with a single strike, wouldn't that hurt his image as an unrivaled expert?
He couldn't just wave his hands and obliterate the Thousand Martial Hall. His image as an invincible master would somewhat be affected.
So it was better to play it safe!
"This is good too. Xu Yan has a direction to strive for, and his martial arts will definitely improve. He will grow stronger faster!"
Li Xuan thought to himself silently.
It was a trivial matter to obliterate the Thousand Martial Hall. The important thing was to strengthen Xu Yan. The stronger Xu Yan became, the stronger he would become.
Since Xu Yan had chosen the Thousand Martial Hall as his stepping stone, it should be left for his disciple to practice.
"Senior Brother, you've chosen the Thousand Martial Hall, so which Transcendent Spirit Sect should I choose? There's no sect eyeing my Dao of the Sword. It's a bit tricky, it's not appropriate for me to make a move if they didn't offend me."
Meng Chong scratched his head, speaking in a somewhat depressed tone.
Moon Changming: ...
Yue'er: ...
The grandfather and granddaughter were stunned. Was the Transcendent Spirit Sect so weak in their eyes?
One after another talked about using it as a stepping stone and as a tool to train their disciples...
What a bunch of madmen!
Meng Chong turned towards Moon Changming and asked, "Which Transcendent Spirit Sect practices the Dao of the Sword? I feel like they'll definitely set their sights on me once I show my swordsmanship. Then it'll be easy."
Moon Changming swallowed his saliva and replied, "Speaking of the Dao of the Sword, it still falls to the Thousand Martial Hall."
Upon hearing this, Meng Chong's eyes lit up, "Senior Brother, leave some of the Thousand Martial Hall for me, I want to make a move on them too!"
"Okay!"
Xu Yan nodded.
Without much ado, both disciple and master divided the Thousand Martial Hall among themselves, using it to sharpen their own skills and as a stepping stone to ascend the summit of the Spirit Realm!
Moon Changming felt numb all over.
Was the unattainable and respected Thousand Martial Hall of the Transcendent Spirit Sect merely a stepping stone in their eyes?
"I am glad that you have this ambition. The Thousand Martial Hall should feel honored to have been chosen by you as a stepping stone, even if they are destroyed."
Li Xuan nodded and said.
After arriving in the Spirit Realm, his disciples finally had a goal to strive for. Having a goal led to motivation, and with motivation, their martial arts would progress even faster.
This was indeed a good thing!
What a wonderful sect the Thousand Martial Hall was, to eagerly serve as a stepping stone!
Moon Changming didn't know what to say anymore, completely dismissing the idea of persuading them to flee.
The students here were mad, and the master was even madder. They were all madmen!
The prestigious Transcendent Spirit Sect being able to be destroyed by his disciples was becoming an honorable thing, where on earth could you find another equally mad person?
There was no such person at all!
Something's wrong!
Suddenly, Moon Changming's expression drastically changed, and he stood up abruptly.
"What's wrong, Grandpa?"
Yue'er asked in surprise.
At this moment, Moon Changming looked towards Su Lingxiu. His lips were trembling and quivering, and his pale face had become flushed. His voice was shaking due to excitement.
"What is the rejuvenation pill? Why is it so effective? I feel that my injuries have recovered by ten to twenty percent!"
He was so shocked by the madness of the people here previously, that he neglected his own injuries. Only when he regained his senses did he realize surprisingly that his injuries had healed by ten to twenty percent.
Although his injuries were still severe and his spiritual body's origin had not been restored, he was no longer on the verge of death!
"Grandpa, are your injuries a bit better?"
Yue'er asked joyfully.
"Thank you, Brother Xu Yan, thank you, Sister!"
Su Lingxiu pressed on Moon Changming's shoulder and said, "Sit down, don't get excited. The rejuvenation pill is a concoction I crafted. For ordinary martial artists, even if they had only one breath left, they can recover and their foundation can be restored.

chapters.title: Chapter 518 - 283: Everyone's a Madman, Shock of Moon Changming_2
chapters.content:
"However, as powerful as you are, the injuries you suffered were severe and your spiritual body lost all of its essence, hence you've only regained about 10 to 20% of your strength."
"But don't worry, with me, Su Lingxiu, the miraculous healer at your side, I assure you that I can restore you to your peak!"
Moon Changming looked puzzled, unaware of what these elixirs were.
"Okay, you don't need to ask any more questions. Healing your wounds is more important. Don't move."
Su Lingxiu stopped Moon Changming from asking further.
She held a golden needle in her hand and continuously applied it to Moon Changming's body to begin the treatment. She also took out several spiritual medicines, contemplated for a moment, and then produced an elixir formula.
"Your injuries are quite serious, and your divine soul is weak. The spiritual medicine I'll use this time is a bit more precious. If it weren't for us emptying the treasury of the Jade Spirit Sect and the Su Family, I'm afraid we couldn't have gathered enough spiritual medicine to save you."
As Su Lingxiu spoke, she manipulated the golden needle with her True Yuan, and in an instant, Moon Changming was shocked to discover a hint of vitality emerging within him.
A circulation was forming around his body, with the needle-pricked places trembling slightly, as if there was some pattern, creating a mysterious resonance within his body.
At that moment, he felt considerably more spirited.
Meanwhile, as Su Lingxiu spoke, a pill flame appeared in her hand and she began to refine the elixir.
Her skills in the art of alchemy in the void had almost reached perfection.
The way in which she refined the elixirs deeply impressed Moon Changming. Such a method was unheard of.
Yue'er was the same, with her little mouth slightly open, she looked on in astonishment.
Ever since they entered this estate, everything seemed extraordinarily remarkable.
The Transcendent Spirit Sect, which everyone revered and saw as supreme, was treated as a stepping stone, and what kind of technique was this?
"Sister, I will replace your spiritual medicine."
Yue'er said, and began to take out spiritual medicine from her storage bag.
"No need, I have enough spiritual medicine. Consider it as your reward for delivering us the message."
Su Lingxiu shook her head.
The elixir was now ready.
"Come, take the elixir!"
"Okay, okay!"
Moon Changming was excited. He thought he wouldn't live much longer and worried about leaving his granddaughter behind alone, full of vengeful thoughts and living in pain.
Now, he saw the hope of healing, like seeing light in the darkness.
He swallowed the elixir in one gulp and felt a warm current flowing from his Dantian to his entire body, and then into his divine soul, nourishing the soul. His previously weak and depressed state started to improve.
Su Lingxiu waved her hand and all the golden needles flew back. She said, "You should rest and recover your strength. Although I can't restore you to your peak, at least your level won't drop.
"Your divine soul is weak, but under the nourishment of the elixir, you will recover after a good night's sleep!"
Moon Changming gave a bow, "Thank you, young lady. I cannot express my gratitude enough!"
Yue'er was also overjoyed, "Thank you, Brother Xu Yan. Thank you, Sister."
Su Lingxiu gave her a puzzled look. Why did she always mention the eldest brother in her thanks?
She was the one who saved the man!
"It must be because it was the eldest brother who brought her here."
It was reasonable to thank the eldest brother.
"There's a vacant room over there. You can go rest."
Su Lingxiu pointed inside the house.
"Okay, thank you, sister!"
Yue'er helped Moon Changming to go rest.
"Master, it's challenging to restore his spiritual body. I've checked, and I don't have the necessary spiritual medicine to refine the elixir that can restore his spiritual body."
Su Lingxiu said with some difficulty.
The foundations of Moon Changming's spiritual body were shattered, and it had almost dried up. How easy could it be to restore it?
One might even say there's almost no possibility of recovery.
Of course, if there was appropriate spiritual medicine, and an apt elixir formula was crafted, the elixir could reinvigorate the dried-up spiritual body and replenish the lost essence.
"It doesn't necessarily need a spiritual medicine. A drop of blood from a spiritual body can also substitute."
Li Xuan said.
Su Lingxiu's eyes lit up, "Is she a spiritual body?"
Li Xuan nodded.
Su Lingxiu then curiously asked, "Master, am I a spiritual body, too?"
Li Xuan nodded.
Xu Yan also came over. After every breakthrough, he underwent a transformation, but he wasn't sure whether he was a spiritual body or not.
A spiritual body requires a specific method to be detected.
But for Su Lingxiu, because of her profession as a medical martial artist, she could sense the uniqueness of her constitution after coming into contact with it. However, she lacked the understanding of a treasure body or a spiritual body.
Li Xuan could determine a treasure or spiritual body at a glance due to his mastery of special physiques, especially after his disciple's transformation.
"Master, am I a spiritual body?"
Xu Yan asked curiously.
"Yes, and no!"
Seeing his disciple's confusion, Li Xuan smiled and said, "Whether a treasure body or a spiritual body, it's just a kind of talent. It just gives you a higher starting point than ordinary people.
"However, the martial path is immense and reaching the pinnacle does not only depend on your physique. Understanding, willpower, luck, none can be omitted."
"Even with an ordinary physique, one can step by step, ascend from one realm to another, surpassing so-called treasured bodies or spiritual bodies. Therefore, do not obsess over this."
"Perceive your own self, break through your own self, transform your own self. The martial path is endless, it is about courageously-scaling summits."
When Xu Yan heard this, he immediately understood. Although his master did not explicitly say it, he himself was neither a treasured body nor a spiritual body during his practice of martial arts.
However, now he is not only weaker than the spiritual body, but stronger!
Therefore, treasured and spiritual bodies are just one of many martial talents. They alone will not help reach the peak of martial arts.
"Master, I understand!"
Xu Yan nodded gravely.
"I will go and practice now!"
The stepping stone of the Thousand Martial Hall is too hard. With his current strength, he is unable to step on it yet.
So he must intensively practice, to quickly break through!
Meng Chong felt the same way. After having a target, his passion for practice soared!
Yue'er came out of the house, knelt down to thank Li Xuan, then went to thank Xu Yan and Su Lingxiu, while curiously watching Su Lingxiu alchemy.
"Meow!"
The Red Cat trotted over, rubbing against Su Lingxiu's calf, looking irresistibly cute.
"Red Cat, you've gotten pretty chubby!"
Su Lingxiu said while patting the Red Cat's head.
"Meow!"
The Red Cat indicated that even though it had gotten a little fatter, it felt better to pat now!
"Here, eat sparingly. Even though there's a lot of spiritual medicines, they'd bud luck too!"
Su Lingxiu gave Red Cat the medicinal pills.
Even the discarded ones.
Even though her alchemy skills were exquisite, when creating new high-grade medicinal pills there were still failures. However, nothing was wasted as all were fed to Red Cat.
The Red Cat accepted everything. It had grown used to eating the discarded pills which were now part of its diet.
"Meow!"
The Red Cat was incredibly excited. As for the eradication of spiritual medicines?
By that time, it will just grab another Spirit Sect!
"Is this a cat?"
Yue'er was full of curiosity. No matter how she looked at it, this fat cat resembled a ferocious tiger. However, its size was indeed that of a cat, and it even meowed.
She extended her hand to touch it, but the haughty Red Cat flicked its tail, whipping Yue'er's hand in the process.
Her tender white hand instantly reddened. Yue'er was shocked. This fat cat was powerful!
"It was originally a Red-eyed Tiger, though it is now accustomed to being a cat."
Su Lingxiu explained.
Yue'er was confused. It was originally a tiger but now accustomed to being a cat?
What did that mean?
Haughtily, the Red Cat walked away. Outsiders were not allowed to touch it!
...
At the junction of Luo State and Yuzhou, several ragged figures rushed out, frantically escaping.
They were all Divine Soul martial artists from the Luo State's All Ages Alliance who had luckily escaped.
"Run quickly, notify the Yuzhou alliance, hide!"
These few were covered in wounds. Upon reaching Yuzhou, they headed straight for an All Ages Alliance base.
"Who's there?"
A cold voice echoed as the Left Protector soared into the sky.
His face full of vigilance, several Divine Soul martial artists had appeared. Could it be that the Yuzhou Spirit Sect was about to make a move?
"Notify the allies quickly, hide, do not expose yourselves. The top martial artist of the Thousand Martial Hall has appeared!"
A Divine Soul martial artist covered in blood cried out urgently.
"What?!"
The Left Protector's heart was filled with shock.
The apex martial artist of the Thousand Martial Hall had appeared?
"What happened to the Luo State alliance?"
Seeing the pitiful state of these few, his heart sank with a feeling of ill omens.
"The Luo State Alliance was almost wiped out, the alliance leaders have perished!"
The Divine Soul martial artist of the Luo State Alliance replied sorrowfully.
"Quick, come with me, treating the wounds is paramount."
The Left Protector nervously led these few to a secret hideout.
Meanwhile, he used a Communication Talisman to pass on the message of the almost wiped out Luo State Alliance and the appearance of the top martial artist of Thousand Martial Hall to Yu Gao.
At this moment, at the junction of Luo State and Yuzhou, a figure was slowly advancing. The wind and clouds moved with him, his mighty aura like a rainbow, unsettling everything around him.

chapters.title: Chapter 519 - 284: Let Him Come Here To Die!_1
chapters.content:
Yuzhou was shaken, as the most powerful being of the Transcendent Spirit Sect descended!
Emperor Zheng of Zheng Country led a group of royal powerhouses and several important ministers, each soaring into the sky, heading straight to the border of Yuzhou.
This was a top tier powerhouse, not an authentic successor like Cui Huayu. How could Emperor Zheng and the others dare to slack off!
Apart from Zheng Country, the strong ones from all major Spirit Sects and great families in Yuzhou also emerged, heading to meet them.
At the end of the day, the Ling Domain is governed by the Transcendent Spirit Sect!
The territories of the Jade Sect and the Su Family, which originally belonged to the Wanshi Alliance, were quietly vacating at this moment. Thankfully, other than the powerhouses of the Shen family, nobody knew their identities.
The Shen family also secretly breathed a sigh of relief. If the Transcendent Spirit Sect found out that they were colluding with the Loose Cultivators, they would probably be evicted from the list of noble families.
You must know, the establishment of every Spirit Sect and noble family in the Ling Domain requires the approval of the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
Once evicted, they would no longer be a noble family, would not enjoy the treatment of a noble family, and their territories would be instantly occupied by other Spirit Sects and noble families.
"We pay our respects to the Sovereign!"
Emperor Zheng and others all prostrated themselves on the ground.
Far away, before they even got close, there was a suffocating feeling. As they looked out, a figure in the distance was stirring up winds and clouds in the world, drawing nearer.
Is this the might of a top-tier powerhouse?
"Hmm!"
Huang Liang nodded his head.
He did not conceal the might of a top-tier powerhouse at all. There was a long spear in his hand, as winds and clouds swirled around him.
"We pay our respects to the High Patriarch!"
With the Jade Sect now extinct, the Shen Family had become the leading force of the Yuzhou Spirit Sects. Shen Tai, the Martial Artist who succeeded Zhuluang in the late stages of Spirit Refining, led a group of Yuzhou Spirit Sect nobles to pay his respects.
"Hmm!"
Huang Liang nodded.
With a stern gaze, indifferent expression, and coldly asked, "Where are Xu Yan and his teacher?"
"Reporting to the High Patriarch, we don't know of their whereabouts!"
Shen Tai bowed his head.
Emperor Zheng spoke up, "Sovereign, Xu Yan and the others, although hidden and no trace can be seen, must still be in Yuzhou."
Huang Liang nodded his head and said, "Tell Xu Yan and his teacher, to kneel before me and beg for forgiveness in three days, then perhaps they may be spared, otherwise, death!"
"Yes!"
The strong ones felt a chill in their hearts.
The top-tier powerhouse is making his move, Xu Yan and his teacher are undoubtedly going to die!
Everyone's heart was chilling. Just because of the battle of the genius talents, Lu Xinting was killed and this drew the intervention of a Thousand Martial Hall top-tier powerhouse?
Many people conjured up the scene of Xu Yan's master making his move in their minds.
Too shocking!
It is probably due to Xu Yan's master that the Thousand Martial Hall top-tier powerhouse has personally arrived.
Huang Liang strode forward, heading for the Zheng Country capital to rest.
The strong ones from various Spirit Sects and noble families in Yuzhou dispersed, spreading the news throughout Yuzhou, should it reach Xu Yan's ears.
...
Chenzhou, one of the Eighteen States of the Ling Domain.
Three thousand feet high stood Stone Peak, which is the highest peak in the continuous mountains, and also the heart of these ranges.
The inside of the peak, however, had already been hollowed out.
In the center was a huge square, surrounded by great halls, towers, chambers, and others, all carved out along the stone walls.
This was where the headquarters of Wanshi Alliance was located.
With the news coming from the Luo State Alliance, the Wanshi Alliance was immediately shaken, drawing a crowd of powerful beings to start discussing the next course of action.
The news about Moon Changming's intervention and his defeat by Huang Liang, the strongest warrior of the Thousand Martial Hall, also reached them simultaneously.
In one of the great halls, where strong ones were gathered.
One of them, a burly man with a furious look on his face.
"Huang Liang!"
His face turned red and his eyes were filled with murderous intent.
"I must kill him!"
Sitting at the top of the grand hall, the elegant Wanshi Alliance Hierarch, Tan Wenlin, exclaimed, "Moon Changming, a luminary in my years in the Azure Sea, was also well known.
"I thought he had perished in the catastrophe of the Star Chaos, yet he surprisingly survived.
"With Moon's talents, he should not have been defeated by Huang Liang."
Tan Wenlin voiced his doubts.
The burly man said in rage, "Back in the day, my elder brother Moon was sneak-attacked by a despicable old man from Thousand Martial Hall, who destroyed his Spiritual Body. Otherwise, Huang Liang wouldn't have been a match for my brother Moon!"
"So that's how it is!"
Tan Wenlin nodded his head.
"Alliance Head, the Luo State Alliance was nearly annihilated, Huang Liang is too much, I will kill him!"
The burly man stood up and said.
Tan Wenlin contemplated for a bit, with a solemn look on his face, "Daniu, act cautiously. Huang Liang is after all a top-tier powerhouse, the foundation of the Thousand Martial Hall is not to be underestimated."
"Rest assured Alliance Head, I have everything under control!"
Chang Daniu replied in a deep voice.
Tan Wenlin straightened his face, looked at the strong ones of Wanshi Alliance present, and said, "Brothers, the Luo State alliance has suffered heavy losses, and the other state alliances may have also been exposed. The Spirit Sect will soon take action.
"At this point, there is no need to continue hiding. So Wanshi Alliance, will announce to the Ling Domain, and fight for a place for the Loose Cultivators.
"It's time for Wanshi Alliance to show themselves, and to meet a top-tier ritualist from the Transcendent Spirit Sect!"
All the Wanshi Alliance powerhouses opened their mouths, "Alliance Head is right, it's time for our Wanshi Alliance to reveal ourselves!"
"I have had enough of their suppression!"
"The Spirit Sect has gone too far, our Wanshi Alliance will strive for a place!"
Tan Wenlin put his hand down, and the grand hall instantly quieted down.
"Our branches need strong people to sit in. You should set out immediately, instruct them to prepare to take over the territory of a state. Chenzhou will be our Wanshi Alliance territory!
"Even if we cannot fight for a place for the loose cultivators of the Eighteen States, Chenzhou must be controlled by our alliance.
"Also, the Yuzhou branch will continue to hide and not reveal themselves. We will not send any strong people there. Daniu, you go and sit in Luo State."

chapters.title: Chapter 520 - 284: Let Him Come Here To Die!_2
chapters.content:
Tan Wenlin began assigning tasks.
Once the tasks were assigned, the strong members of the All Ages Alliance stepped out of the headquarters one by one, heading to the various branch alliances across different states.
"Daniu, I know you hate Huang Liang, you hate the Thousand Martial Hall, but Huang Liang is extremely strong after all. Even if you can defeat him, killing him might be difficult. Don't take risks, and don't let yourself get severely injured.
"Almost all of the Luo State Alliance has been wiped out, this grudge must be avenged, let's eliminate the Red Ming Sect!"
Tan Wenlin said solemnly when he saw off Chang Daniu.
"Alliance Hierarch, rest assured, I, Daniu, have everything under control. I will preside over Luo State and exterminate the Red Ming Sect. The blood of my All Ages Alliance brothers will not flow in vain.
"Even if Huang Liang doesn't die, I will severely injure him.
"Whether it is to avenge Brother Moon or to address the old resentments from the academy, I will not easily forgive him!"
Chang Daniu said solemnly.
Tan Wenlin patted his shoulder, not saying anything more.
The Thirty-Six Elites of Wanxing, once famed far and wide, even overshadowing the prodigies of the Transcendent Spirit Sect, but how many of them are alive now?
Chang Daniu is one of them, but he ranks relatively low among the thirty-six.
Chang Daniu left, heading straight for Luo State to intercept Huang Liang and eliminate the Red Ming Sect.
Tan Wenlin stood in place, lost in thought. Each of the thirty-six elites of Wanxing was well-known in the past, and admired by all loose cultivators in Ling Domain, but how many of those loose cultivators still remember those thirty-six elites today?
Even the Blood Demon, who once swept across the Ling Domain and crushed the Spirit Sect families, causing the Blood Demon catastrophe. How many loose cultivators still know about him?
"Spirit Sect!"
The traces of history were almost erased by the Spirit Sect. Only people like them knew about the events back then, but even if they spoke out now, how many loose cultivators would believe that once there was a loose cultivator who overshadowed the prodigies of the Transcendent Spirit Sect?
How many loose cultivators would believe that there was once a man who left a shadow in the hearts of the Spirit Sect families?
They would probably find it absurd.
"The strongest prodigy of Wanxing was not among the thirty-six elites, but is the Blood Demon Lord!"
Tan Wenlin sighed to himself.
He felt heavy. If the Demon Lord, who was so strong in his past, couldn't achieve it, how could he, Tan Wenlin?
...
"The Luo State Alliance has been wiped out!"
Fang Hao was a bit surprised when he saw Yu Gao's message.
He thought that the All Ages Alliance, wanting to fight for a place for loose cultivators, would not be weak. But not long after the Luo State Alliance emerged, it was defeated and almost entirely wiped out.
The Alliance Hierarch of Luo State and other strong members died in battle, and only a very few of them escaped. They fled to Yuzhou.
"The strongest one has come to Yuzhou!"
Fang Hao said solemnly.
Then he angrily said, "Huang Liang of Thousand Martial Hall, it's outrageous. He actually audaciously claims that we must kneel and worship him in three days, or else we will die!"
A cold light flashed in Li Xuan's eyes. This Huang Liang was walking further and further down the road to his own death.
"This is outrageous, Thousand Martial Hall, I must crush it under my feet!"
Xu Yan looked furious.
Moon Changming came out of the house. His injuries had mostly healed after treatment, and his realm had not declined, but because his spiritual body's source was exhausted, his strength was not as good as before.
But being able to survive was already very fortunate.
He didn't dare to ask for too much more.
"Huang Liang is extremely strong, the power of his spear is like the Great Power of Heaven and Earth. We must not underestimate him!"
Moon Changming said in a deep voice.
Li Xuan's eyebrows raised. The power of a spear was like the Great Power of Heaven and Earth?
Could it be that the strongest of the Transcendent Spirit Sect could already use the power of the laws of Heaven and Earth?
On second thought, that shouldn't be the case.
If he could really use the power of the laws of Heaven and Earth, even with a slight move, Moon Changming would have no chance to escape, not even a little bit!
"Tell Huang Liang to come here to die. This insignificant worm dares to call himself the strongest, what a joke!"
Li Xuan said.
"Yes, Master!"
Fang Hao was excited.
Was the master going to make a move again?
He immediately sent a message to Yu Gao, telling him to spread the word that Huang Liang was to come and throw his life away!
Moon Changming didn't try to dissuade them anymore. The strongest had been reduced to a worm, so what was there to dissuade?
If they were really outmatched, they could die together!
Xu Yan and the others didn't seem worried at all. Instead, they were excited, as if they were waiting for the scene where this worm, Huang Liang, would be crushed with one palm.
Su Lingxiu didn't even care about Huang Liang. She started explaining the upcoming treatment to Moon Changming.
"You've exhausted the source of your spiritual body. The difficulty of recovery is somewhat great, mainly because I don't have some special spiritual medicine to activate your source.
"However, it's not without a solution, I can refine a Bloodline Rejuvenating Elixir to activate your spiritual body and replenish the depleted source.
"As long as your spiritual body is activated, and some of your source is restored, you just need to cultivate and your spiritual body can recover to its peak."
Moon Changming's heart trembled. Could the spiritual body really recover?
However, he felt a sense of defeat. If it were only his recent shattered spiritual body, perhaps there was a chance for recovery. Unfortunately, his spiritual body had already been broken and fragmented since his youth.
Now that the origin of his spiritual body had been depleted, how could it possibly recover?
"When I was young, my spiritual body was already broken and fragmented. Now, it has completely collapsed and lost its origin," Moon Changming said.
"It's an old wound, I'm afraid stimulating it will not reactivate my spiritual body or restore it. It's not worth the effort."
Moon Changming shook his head.
"No, that's not acceptable!"
Su Lingxiu shook her head: "It's not easy for me to treat people. If I don't cure them, it would seem that my skills are poor.
"Don't worry, your spiritual body has long been fragmented, but the problem isn't serious, you can still recover."
Moon Changming was shocked: "Can it really be restored?"
If his spiritual body could be restored, it wouldn't be impossible for him to further improve, reaching Huang Liang's strength.
He was a bit excited.
"Of course!"
Su Lingxiu nodded: "However, you need some of the origin of the spiritual body."
She turned to Yue'er, saying, "Sister Yue'er is a spiritual body, and shares the same bloodline with you. We need her essence blood to refine a rejuvenating bloodline pill!"
Moon Changming immediately refused: "No! We cannot harm Yue'er because of me!"
"Grandpa, it's fine, I don't mind a little bit of damage," Yue'er hastily said.
"No!"
Moon Changming was adamant.
Su Lingxiu could not help but say, "You old man, you're just being foolish. I can restore your spiritual body, do you really think I could hurt sister Yue'er's spiritual body?
"Rest assured, these are minor problems, don't judge my alchemy skills based on your perspective."
Moon Changming opened his mouth, speechless. Su Lingxiu's words were quite reasonable!
Next, Su Lingxiu drew some of Yue'er's essence blood, gave her some medicine to recover, and prepared to refine the pill that would restore Moon Changming's spiritual body.
...
On the way to the capital city of Zheng Country, Huang Liang and his party were suddenly approached by a figure in a hurry.
"What's the matter?"
Emperor Zheng asked from afar.
The person who came was a strong warrior from the royal family of Zheng Country.
"Your Majesty, there's news of Xu Yan!"
Emperor Zheng was greatly pleased.
"Speak!"
Huang Liang said in a deep voice.
"Your Highness, the master of Xu Yan has sent someone to deliver a message to Your Highness. He is outside the capital city, asking you to...
The messenger, an alchemy martial artist, suddenly paused, sweat breaking out on his forehead.
He was so eager to take the merit and show-off before the supreme being, that he didn't realize that the message from Xu Yan's master was highly disrespectable!
Huang Liang's brow furrowed, "Say it as it is!"
"Yes, Yes, Your Highness!"
The man took a deep breath, calmed himself, and repeated the message word for word: "Tell Huang Liang to come here and meet his death. It's a joke for a mere ant to claim to be a supreme being."
After finishing, he sighed in relief, thinking to himself that these were not his words, but a quote. The supreme being wouldn't blame him, would he?
"Ha ha, good courage!"
Huang Liang roared with angry laughter.
With a single point of his long spear, a powerful light burst out, instantly killing the messenger.
Emperor Zheng and the others broke out in a cold sweat, feeling extremely nervous. They also silently berated the messenger for talking out of turn. Who asked him to mimic the tone and language? He was courting death!
"Good, good, let's see who the ant is, let's see who is ignorant of the heights of the heaven and the depth of the earth. I wanted to give you a chance to live, but you chose the path to death. I will grant you that," Huang Liang roared with laughter, moving straight towards the Capital city of Zheng Country.
Emperor Zheng and the others hurriedly followed him.
The news spread, and the alchemy martial artists from the major spirit sect families all headed to the outskirts of the capital city of Zheng Country. They were eager to witness the spectacular battle and the strength of the supreme being.
Although in the battle of geniuses, Xu Yan's master demonstrated his shocking power, no one believed he was a match for the supreme being of the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
Xu Yan and his group were bound to die without a doubt.
"The ant has arrived!"
In the manor, Su Lingxiu was preparing to refine the pill. Li Xuan looked up and said indifferently.

chapters.title: Chapter 521 - 285: Displaying Godly Might with the Law of Heaven and Earth_1
chapters.content:
Upon hearing this, Xu Yan and the others looked upwards, only to see the sky filled with surging clouds. A terrifying power was rapidly sweeping over from the horizon.
Moon Changming's face bore a serious expression, these were the strongest ones from the Transcendent Spirit Sect!
"So powerful!"
Xu yan furrowed his brows, commenting.
Already, this power greatly surpassed the pinnacle of the Refining God Heavenly Man!
Moreover, the storm clouds had stirred the heavens, their momentum shaking the earth, as if the sky itself was within their grasp!
"To overpower these strongest ones from the Transcendent Spirit Sect, only those in the Divine Origin Realm could manage it!"
Xu Yan thought to himself.
And yet, even those at the threshold of the Divine Origin realm might not have the strength to overcome!
"Is this what being the strongest really means?"
Meng Chong rubbed his bald head, his face stricken with seriousness.
Crushing the Thousand Martial Hall would require overpowering such mighty beings. What level was Huang Liang's strength compared to the strongest ones in the Transcendent Spirit Sect?
Perhaps there existed even stronger entities within the walls of the Thousand Martial Hall.
While there was some pressure within him, it was outweighed by a vigorous passion. The stronger the enemy, the more satisfaction could be gained from defeating them!
"One day, I shall stand on top of the Thousand Martial Hall, and reach the peak of the Ling Domain!"
Xu Yan declared proudly.
He was not even twenty years old yet.
In a few more years, standing atop the Thousand Martial Hall might not be an impossible goal!
Huang Liang was headed straight for Zheng Country's capital, while Li Xuan simply sat on his chair, watching indifferently without deactivating the formation.
With Huang Liang's power, he could detect the presence of the formation. It was impossible to conceal it from him.
After all, the reinforcing formation that he had set up was already dismantled. The current formation was laid down by Fang Hao, which may deceive those at the Refining God pinnacle but could not fool a powerful person like Huang Liang.
"The strongest ones from the Transcendent Spirit Sect, so this is how they are..."
As Huang Liang approached, Li Xuan realized the truth about the strongest ones from the Transcendent Spirit Sect, understanding why Moon Changming had claimed they were controlling the Great Power of Heaven and Earth.
But in reality, they were far from reaching that level.
"Refining a hint of the Heavenly Earth Lingji into the Divine Soul, and using it to resonate with the power of Heaven and Earth, though only on a small scale, is already much superior to the Refining God pinnacle."
Li Xuan understood in an instant, figuring out what the strongest ones in the Ling Domain were about.
The so-called strongest ones were essentially still in the Refining God Heavenly Man state. What differentiated them was having refined a hint of the Heavenly Earth Lingji into their Divine Soul, allowing them to gather a small amount of the power of Heaven and Earth.
"Only the Heavenly Earth Lingji can cultivate the Grand Azure Martial Dao. Upon reaching the realm of the Refining God Heavenly Man, to progress further you'll need to refine the Lingji into the Divine Soul."
"Only then would one be able to gather the power of Heaven and Earth."
"The Grand Azure Martial Dao uses the Heavenly Earth Lingji as a bridge to perceive the laws of Heaven and Earth."
"The more extensively and densely the Lingji is refined, the stronger the person becomes.
"Once the refinement of the Lingji reaches a certain level, one can then perceive the laws of Heaven and Earth and subsequently refine their power into one's body..."
At this moment, Li Xuan had a clear understanding of the cultivation path after reaching the Refining God Heavenly Man realm.
This was dissimilar to the Martial Arts path he had forged, which assumed himself as the bridge connecting Heaven and Earth and communicating the Dao.
The Grand Azure Martial Dao saw the Heavenly Earth Lingji as its core. Only where the Heavenly Earth Lingji existed could one cultivate the Martial Arts. It was impossible to cultivate without the Heavenly Earth Lingji.
This was the limitation of the Grand Azure Martial Dao.
From the commencement of cultivation till reaching the Grandmaster stage, all was centred around perceiving the Heavenly Earth Lingji. As one's cultivation improves, the more they could perceive. Ultimately, they needed to refine the Heavenly Earth Lingji into their Divine Soul.
Only upon refining the Lingji into one's Divine Soul, can they construct a bridge to connect with the laws of Heaven and Earth. Only then could their cultivation continue, only then could they refine the power of these laws into their body.
"Huang Liang, among the strongest of the Transcendent Spirit Sect, isn't too strong. He has only refined a hint of the Heavenly Earth Lingji. Although he can use this to gather a hint of the power of Heaven and Earth, it is ultimately too weak.
"He is far from being able to connect with the laws of Heaven and Earth, and from refining these laws into his body."
Li Xuan could now clearly judge Huang Liang's strength and had a general estimate of the pinnacle strength of the strongest ones from the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
Refining a hint of the laws of Heaven and Earth was almost at the limit.
A warrior of this level, he could effortlessly kill with a slap!
As for stronger warriors, judging from Li Xuan's understanding of the Grand Azure Martial Dao, they did not exist in the Ling domain.
This was due to the constraints of the Heavenly Earth Lingji.
"The Heavenly Earth Lingji of the Ling Domain, though more active than that of the Inner Domain, still couldn't support stronger cultivation."
After breaking through the Divine Realm, Li Xuan's comprehension of the laws of Heaven and Earth had greatly improved.
At a thought, he could grasp the laws of Heaven and Earth in the Ling Domain.
Furthermore, with his divine skills, he could even utilize some of these laws.
This was due to his deep study of the laws of Heaven and Earth within the Book of Tai Cang.
In fact, he had discovered the patterns of the laws of Heaven and Earth in the Ling Domain from the Book of Tai Cang.
"Refining the Lingji into the Divine Soul. This technique must be one of the fundamental secrets of the Transcendent Spirit Sect, and the basis of its formidable power.
"However, the Ling domain should also possess similar warriors who have mastered such techniques, though I suspect that compared to the Transcendent Spirit Sect, they would likely be inferior in refinement, speed, and efficiency.
"Furthermore, to refine the Heavenly Earth Lingji into the Divine Soul isn't something that can be easily achieved with a technique; it also involves some understanding of the Heavenly Earth Lingji,
"It also has a number of other factors, and the requirement of aptitude isn't low. Plus, it is easier with a spiritual body."
Li Xuan pondered for a moment, then understood its secret.
He glanced at Moon Changming, thinking that this old man probably also knew about the Heavenly Earth Lingji refining into the Divine Soul. It was likely rough and inefficient, requiring a lot from the individuals attempting to refine.

chapters.title: Chapter 522 - 522: 285
chapters.content:
Without a Spiritual Body, one cannot refine the Heavenly Earth Lingji into the Divine Soul!
This was also the reason why Moon Changming has not made further progress. Because his Spiritual Body is incomplete, he cannot refine the Heavenly Earth Lingji into the Divine Soul.
Roar!
Huang Liang's formidable presence is getting closer to the mansion. Xu Yan and others continue to watch silently, not anxious at all.
"Has Huang Liang already begun to harness the power of heaven and earth?"
Fang Hao asked suddenly.
"Probably not."
Xu Yan shook his head, and pondered, "His momentum is strong, capable of stirring the wind and cloud of heaven and earth. I guess some sort of secret technique is acted as a bridge to achieve this step."
"If I could break through to the second level of the Undying Golden Body, the Heavenly Earth Dominating Blade could break his momentum."
Meng Chong said after a moment of contemplation.
Li Xuan opened his mouth and said, "It is just the refinement of a strand of Heavenly Earth Lingji into the Divine Soul that stirs the wind and clouds of the heaven and earth and condenses a strand of the power of Heaven and Earth."
Understanding dawned on Xu Yan and others. "So that's how it is!" They said.
Moon Changming was inwardly startled. Xu Yan's mysterious teacher had seen through everything in a glance.
No wonder he has such confidence. He must be even stronger than Huang Liang.
With that realization, he felt more at ease.
"Only the weak enjoy showing off their strength, proving their power by flaunting it. Like a mantis attempting to stop a chariot or an ant trying to shake a tree. Huang Liang is exactly like this, an ant who is unaware of its own insignificance!"
Li Xuan said with a chuckle.
"Master is right!"
Xu Yan nodded in agreement.
Meng Chong and others also agree unanimously.
Master is so strong, but he never shows off. On the contrary, he is as ordinary as an commoner, indifferent and non-dominant.
This is the mark of a true powerful person!
For a while, Moon Changming didn't know what to say.
Huang Liang is just an ant?
Maybe... Does that really make him an ant in that person's eyes?
Bang!
Huang Liang suddenly stopped and turned his gaze to the mansion.
"They were here all along, good technique, no wonder they were able to hide so well."
As Huang Liang stopped, Emperor Zheng and others, as well as the arriving strong men of the Spirit Sect family, were all puzzled.
There, it was simply a forest where Xu Yan and the others were visually absent.
Li Xuan waved his hand, the formation disappeared, revealing the mansion.
He sat in a chair, looking at Huang Liang indifferently, "Pathetic."
He shook his head with a sigh.
Turning to Xu Yan and others, he said seriously, "Remember, don't ever think of yourself as powerful just because you have a bit of strength. Remember, there are always greater people outside, and there is always a higher sky.
"The power you think you possess may actually be insignificant.
"Just like this Huang Liang, in the eyes of outsiders, he may be the most powerful. But in my eyes, he is nothing more than an ant!"
Xu Yan and others had serious expressions, they bowed and said respectfully, "Yes, Master, your disciples will bear it in mind."
"Hmm."
Li Xuan nodded in satisfaction.
Emperor Zheng and others were stunned. The teacher of Xu Yan was completely audacious.
Teaching his disciples in the face of the strongest, using them as examples?
And Xu Yan and the others, they all had serious faces and were actively listening. They didn't pay any attention to Huang Liang, the strongest.
Moon Changming also felt somewhat numb.
Yue'er, however, her eyes were lit up, she followed and nodded: "I will also keep the teaching of the elder in mind!"
Huang Liang was almost furious.
However, he came here for the Sword Dao of Xu Yan, before he got the Sword Dao, and where the mysterious Sword Dao came from, he wouldn't kill anyone.
He glanced coldly at Moon Changming, not expecting to see him rescued. Although he no longer had a Spiritual Body, his injuries had recovered considerably.
"You have a bold heart, even daring to save someone that I, intended to kill. I'll kill him right in your face!"
Bang!
Huang Liang lifted his Long Spear, the spear light condensed and aimed at Moon Changming!
He intended to intimidate the other party, capture the other party, and take him back to the Thousand Martial Hall to interrogate the secrets of the Sword Dao!
A spear light, like a falling meteor, the wind and clouds of the world dissipated due to this spear light. It didn't move fast, but it was impossible to avoid and was locked by a long distance aura.
The slow spear light, however, seems like the arrival of death, the powerful oppressive force, was overwhelming.
The world only had this one spear light left!
Huang Liang undoubtedly wanted to use this method to shatter the enemy's spirit, give the enemy a powerful sense of oppression, give the enemy despair!
Emperor Zheng and a group of Martial Artists who had refined their souls, trembled all over, and quickly retreated.
It's terrifying!
Is this what the strongest looks like?
This casual spear light seemed to have condensed the power of heaven and earth. Even if it wasn't targeting them, they could still feel a suffocating feeling.
Everyone was focusing on the mansion, curious to see how Li Xuan would block this attack.
"This man is doomed!"
This was almost every Divine Martial Artist's thought.
The Spear Light was not fast, it fell, pointing directly at Moon Changming.
Inside the manor, Li Xuan took a sip of Spiritual Tea and looked at Moon Changming, whose face was full of cold sweat, and said indifferently, "How does it feel? Feel this attack, you can also cultivate the Heavenly Earth Lingji into your Divine Soul."
The Spear Light was less than three feet away from Moon Changming, in a flash, it would completely annihilate him.
Panic appeared on Yue'er's face, it was too late for her to make a move.
At this moment, a palm stretched out and caught the Spear Light.
Bang!
The Spear Light shattered.
Li Xuan looked at Huang Liang, whose expression changed in an instant, and coolly said, "I told you that you are an ant, and you indeed are one, today, I will show you how insignificant you are!"
Boom!
Suddenly, a tall figure stood between Heaven and Earth. His eyes were as bright as the sun, his hair seemed to symbolize the laws of Heaven and Earth, and his horrifying aura was like a divine demon descending into the world!
Law of Heaven and Earth!
At this moment, Huang Liang was completely shaken, trembling over his entire body, and his Long Spear even dropped.
Looking up, the divine demon-like figure stood in front of him, as if two suns were glaring at him from the sky.
Thump!
You, you, you....."
Huang Liang was too shocked to speak.
As for Emperor Zheng and other Divine Disciples, they were almost shattered. They were shocked by the divine demon-like figure. Their minds trembled, their faces turned pale and their livers trembled.
Pff!
Even in the air, there was a strong smell of urine....
How terrifying is this!
No wonder they say Huang Liang is an ant, he really is an ant!
No!
He's even worse than an ant!
In the manor, Xu Yan and others were also shocked. How powerful was that figure, who was as tall as the sky, whose eyes seemed like the sun, and whose hair moved with the laws of heaven and earth.
Excitement followed soon after.
Finally, they saw their master reveal a bit of his power.
Moon Changming was stunned. He thought the opponent was very arrogant and strong, stronger than Huang Liang, so he had the confidence to disdain and dismiss Huang Liang by calling him an ant.
But the result!
Compared to him, Huang Liang really was an ant!
And he, he was even worse than an ant!
Yue'er opened her mouth wide, completely stunned.
"Master Xu Yan is so strong, what kind of martial arts is this?"
Was there such terrifying martial arts in the Ling Domain?
Li Xuan performed the Law of Heaven and Earth, and instantly it seemed like a divine demon descended upon the Ling Domain. In his eyes, Huang Liang truly became an ant.
"This is what a powerhouse is!"
The feeling of overlooking all living beings, the feeling of the unparalleled powerhouse, she finally experienced it.
"Huang Liang, how are you not an ant?"
Li Xuan spoke indifferently.
His voice was like thunder, resounding everywhere. Huang Liang only felt a buzzing sound in his ears, his Divine Soul was trembling.
He wanted to gather a strand of the power of Heaven and Earth to steady himself, but the power of Heaven and Earth seemed to have been blocked, as if it had been drained.
He couldn't gather it!
"Being able to die by my hand is a good fortune in your life!"
Li Xuan calmly said, pressing down with one finger.
Boom!
The ground seemed to be splitting apart, Heaven, and Earth seemed to be shaking, Huang Liang was trying desperately to stimulate cultivation techniques, trying desperately to use Martial Arts secret techniques, he even wanted to say something, but he couldn't speak.
Before the finger could press down, his body had already begun to split, and his Divine Soul was shaking violently.
Pff!
Huang Liang's body disintegrated, his Divine Soul melted and was completely obliterated.
The strongest man in the Thousand Martial Hall couldn't even scream before he died.
Emperor Zheng and other Divine Martial Artists, all bowed their heads low to the ground, shivering, not even having the courage to look up.
Too horrifying, too powerful!
"Alas, an ant is just an ant. If he doesn't see the extraordinary person beyond ordinary people, and the Heaven beyond the Earth, he won't know his own insignificance. He even dares to call himself the strongest!"
Li Xuan shook his head and sighed.
After squishing Huang Liang with one finger, Li Xuan also put away the power of the Law of Heaven and Earth, sat down on his chair, took a relaxed sip of tea.
As if he had casually squashed an ant just now, insignificant.
Emperor Zheng and all the other Divine Martial Artists bowed their heads low to the ground, still not daring to get up after a long time.
Xu Yan and the others were also shocked.
Moon Changming and his granddaughter were completely stunned!
Li Xuan was contented, once this Law of Heaven and Earth was released, it would shock the Four Directions!

chapters.title: Chapter 523 - 286: The Master has Surpassed the Heaven and Earth, All Ages Alliance Present in the World_1
chapters.content:
Huang Liang, coming with the might of heaven and earth, his presence unparalleled, yet dying as insignificant as an ant!
This monumental gap left Emperor Zheng and others in a daze.
Moreover, a thought arose in their minds like never before: So this was the limit of Transcendent Spirit Sect's strongest!
The figure standing between heaven and earth like a god or a devil had deeply imprinted itself into their divine souls. They could never forget it. Each time they thought of it, they could not help but tremble.
After being shocked, Xu Yan excitedly asked, "Master, what kind of martial arts did you just display?"
It was so powerful, so shocking, it seemed like it would tear apart heaven and earth.
"Divine Skills!"
Li Xuan was looking at Huang Liang's storage bag, which he had left behind. After all, he was the strongest in the Transcendent Spirit Sect, there might be valuable things inside the bag.
However, he was somewhat disappointed.
In the storage bag, there were a few strands of divine spiritual medicine, as well as three bottles of medicine pills. Apart from that, there was nothing else.
The items carried must be beneficial to Huang Liang.
The core treasures of the Thousand Martial Hall, the cultivation techniques, and the like, would obviously not be carried around.
"So, this is a Divine Skill!"
Xu Yan was utterly shocked, it was too powerful.
A surge of hot blood rose in his heart. He wished he could break the Divine Realm immediately.
"Hmm, the Divine Skill I used is the Law of Heaven and Earth."
Li Xuan threw the storage bag to Su Lingxiu, his expression calm, yet feeling incredibly pleased within. He lightly stated, "I suppressed my Divine Skill to the bare minimum just now. It didn't even reach one-billionth of my full strength. Well, it's not worth mentioning this heaven and earth."
At the end, Li Xuan shook his head and sighed slightly.
Xu Yan's heart trembled, his eyes revealing a shocked expression.
"I see. Master's power is so great that if he were to slightly unleash his real power, this world might not be able to bear it.
"Yes! That's why master doesn't want to oppress people with his realm. Every time he makes a move, he suppresses his realm and strength."
"The reason is he fears that even a slight leak of his real power could cause turmoil in the world and lead to devastation."
Xu Yan suddenly understood, so it turns out that the master had already reached such a realm.
"Master, what happened to this world?"
Meng Chong scratched his head, feeling a cat-like curiosity in his heart and asked.
"When it's time to know, you will know naturally. It's important to cultivate diligently and enhance your strength!"
Li Xuan waved his hand, showing he was unwilling to discuss more.
With a wave of his hand, the formation reappeared.
"Alright, now that the ant Huang Liang is dead, let's get back to what we were doing."
Li Xuan took out the Book of Tai Cang, preparing to continue studying the laws of heaven and earth.
Every time he made a move, his disciples would be as excited as if they had been injected with a chicken blood. They would practice like crazy.
He was full of anticipation.
"I have basically written the realm above Divine Skills. But I should start pondering about the realm beyond that."
Li Xuan thought to himself.
Seeing that their master was reading, Xu Yan and the others refrained from disturbing him.
Moon Changming was completely dazed at this moment. Why did this superior person's words sound so profound?
He too was itching in his heart. What happened to this world?
This was even more true for Yue'er.
After all, little girls tend to be more curious.
"Elder brother, do you know what happened to this world?"
Su Lingxiu couldn't help asking.
The elder brother understood the master the best and knew more about the master's affairs.
Meng Chong, Fang Hao, Zhou Ying, Shi'er, Meng Shushu, including the three pets of Red Cat, all came over.
Moon Changming also couldn't help but join them.
Yue'er was even blinking her eyes, staring at Xu Yan continuously, waiting for his answer.
Xu Yan pondered for a moment, then said solemnly, "Just remember what I tell you. The meaning of master's words is that this world is very fragile. If he were to slightly leak his real power, even a trace of his real breath would cause turmoil in the world."
"Even if he slightly demonstrates his real power, the world would collapse."
"So, every time our master takes action, he tries his best to suppress his realm and strength. If he can avoid taking action, he will try to avoid it."
"It's because he's afraid of causing a catastrophe to the world!"
Meng Chong and the others were stunned. So that's what it meant.
"No wonder master usually doesn't take action, and each time he does, he suppresses his realm and strength. So that's it!"
Meng Chong suddenly realized.
Red Cat immediately held its waist straight. The whole tiger was proud. So their master was so powerful!
Upon listening to Xu Yan's explanation, Meng Chong and the others showed a look of sudden realization. So, that's how it is. They were shocked, but also incredibly excited.
As for Moon Changming, he was stunned with disbelief all over his face.
A slight reveal of real power, even leaking a trace of real breath, would cause a catastrophe to the world?
What kind of terrifying existence was that!
Could such a powerful entity exist in this world!
He couldn't help but turn back to look at Li Xuan sitting on the chair.
This glance made his body tremble. At this moment, what he saw was an existence that was as magnificent as the heaven and earth, mysterious and unfathomable, as if it had transcended the world!
He shook his head, even subconsciously rubbed his eyes. But when he looked again, everything was as usual, quite ordinary.
However, whenever he was lost in thought and looked again, his body would tremble again!
When he calmed his mind and looked again, it was still as usual.
The more it was like this, the more shocked he was, the more unfathomable Xu Yan's master seemed!
"Could it be, is what Xu Yan said true? Does such a terrifying existence exist in the world?"
Moon Changming was in a daze, no wonder he didn't regard the Transcendent Spirit Sect as anything important, treating it like an ant!
It's not craziness!
It's all based on real strength!
"Xu Yan's master is so powerful!"

chapters.title: Chapter 524 - 286: The Master has Surpassed the Heaven and Earth, All Ages Alliance Present in the World_2
chapters.content:
Yue'er was utterly shocked.
As for Li Xuan, he was inwardly amazed at Xu Yan's vivid imagination, which was truly extraordinary.
He had only meant to retain an air of mystery, but Xu Yan had already filled in the pieces, picturing him as remarkably powerful. A slight leak in his real aura could already wreak havoc on the world.
"With such formidable strength, there should be hope to accomplish my goal. I'll portray the subsequent martial arts in an even more formidable manner, transcending Heaven and Earth is inevitable.
"Disciple, whether I can become as strong as you depicted, utterly lies on you."
Li Xuan also got his spirits high.
Set a small goal, transcend Heaven and Earth!
Become the powerful existence as described by his disciple!
...
Outside the manor, Emperor Zheng and the other Refining God Martial Artists, having seen the manor disappear, breathed a sigh of relief.
Still, they respectfully bowed three times before cautiously retreating and eventually dispersing.
Huang Liang was dead!
The fall of the most powerful being in the Thousand Martial Hall will surely stir up ramifications.
Emperor Zheng's face was unbearably serious. The Ling Domain would no longer be peaceful, and it was highly likely that the Transcendent Spirit Sect would face another challenge.
This time, their opponent was a being as formidable as a god or demon.
If Huang Liang could perish like an insignificant ant, could the remaining powerhouses of the Transcendent Spirit Sect resist?
In this world, there was such a terrifying powerhouse.
"Too scary!"
Emperor Zheng and other strong characters felt a chill in their hearts.
After returning to the palace, Emperor Zheng took a deep breath, pondered for a while, and then began to compose a secret message to send to the Thousand Martial Hall. Whether the hall would believe it or not was out of his hands now.
The thought of the mysterious manor being close to the capital filled him with goosebumps.
It was as if a terrifying demon was residing just outside the palace.
Shen Tai and other strong characters from the Spirit Sect's families were all silent now. They didn't spread the news of Huang Liang's death outward. Such a matter was no longer within their authority to disclose.
In Yuzhou, a considerable number of martial artists were still waiting for the news from the Thousand Martial Hall's strongest being and whether Xu Yan had been killed.
Yet, all of a sudden, no messages came.
Yuzhou was quiet and calm.
This left many martial artists puzzled, but the keen ones had already noticed that something was off.
In Luo State, the battle was almost over.
The purge of the All Ages Alliance Loose Cultivators was nearing its end. Luo State's stronghold was almost wiped out with heavy casualties. Chiming Sect was still leading other second and third-rate Spirit Sect families in Luo State to eliminate the remnants.
A tall figure stepped into Luo State, heading towards the Chiming Sect.
Like Huang Liang, he didn't try to conceal his whereabouts at all, stirring up the elements all around with his daunting momentum. With a clear goal, he intended to abolish Chiming Sect!
"Huang Liang, prepare to die!"
"The Chiming Sect has ruined the Luo State branch of the All Ages Alliance. Today, I will destroy the Chiming Sect. Let's see how they can remain unassailable."
Chang Daniu spoke in a deep voice, his words echoing everywhere.
Luo State shook with the news!
A powerhouse had arrived!
Moreover, he did not come from the Transcendent Spirit Sect, but from the All Ages Alliance!
The Loose Cultivator community also has such a powerful figure?
The Chiming Sect was extremely terrified and hurriedly sent out a distress signal, and the Cangyun Royal Dynasty immediately ceased hunting down the loose cultivators of the All Ages Alliance and began to withdraw its forces.
The Cangyun Emperor instantly reported his situation to the Lei Yun Mountain Manor under the Transcendent Spirit Sect!
A powerhouse had descended upon Luo State!
Above the Chiming Sect, the sky was stirring, and an intimidating force was pressing down.
Chang Daniu was holding a pair of large hammers, his gaze coldly looking down at the Chiming Sect's gate, saying coldly, "I, Chang Daniu, will annihilate the Chiming Sect and challenge Huang Liang of the Thousand Martial Hall to come out and meet his fate!"
He lifted his large hammer high and smashed it down with a loud boom!
In mid-air, a hammer as gigantic as a mountain was coming down amidst the horrified glances of the Chiming Sect's fighters and disciples.
The power of Heaven and Earth was gathered within the hammer, shattering the space and shaking the world.
Boom!
Even if all the Refining God Martial artists of the Chiming Sect put forth their utmost efforts to withstand it, and all sorts of martial arts secret techniques erupted, they still couldn't resist this terrifying strike.
It was as if the Great Power of Heaven and Earth was concentrated in one blow!
The Chiming Sect was smashed into a dent, and then one hammer blow after another, the Chiming Sect was completely destroyed, becoming a pile of ruins, even creating a huge pit.
Luo State was shaken!
Innumerable Spirit Sect families were trembling, especially those forces that had participated in the siege of the All Ages Alliance. They were now all terrified and could only pray that Huang Liang, the most potent being of the Thousand Martial Hall, would hurry back.
Even the Sect Leader of Sword Section, who was originally in Luo State, was avoiding being embroiled in the battle and didn't dare to show up.
He was deeply shocked. How could the All Ages Alliance have such a powerful figure?
"All the brothers of the Luo State Alliance, whoever took action, all of you go back and fight!"
Chang Daniu shouted with a wave of his arm.
The Loose Cultivators participating in Luo State's Alliance were now teared up, the Alliance's reinforcements had finally arrived, taking down the top-level Spirit Sect, Chi Ming Sect!
"Huang Liang, I will extinguish one Spirit Sect per day until you come forward to die!"
Chang Daniu sneered, taking another move and disintegrating another Spirit Sect.
The direction he was heading was towards the Cangyun Kingdom!
Luo State, due to the arrival of Chang Daniu, was once again in turmoil as one Spirit Sect after another was destroyed, causing the Cangyun Kingdom to tremble in fear. Many powerful figures gathered, seeking to repel the strong enemy.
Some older generation Refining God Martial Artists looked pale. This was another major calamity for Spirit Sects after the Blood Demon disaster.
They hoped for the strongest of the Transcendent Spirit Sect to hurry and intervene against the imminent menace.
"You have guts! Dare to challenge the higher authorities, the All Ages Alliance must be extinguished!"
Leiyun Province, Lei Yun Mountain Manor, a cold voice echoed.
After the Blood Demon, another Loose Cultivator has been met with delusions of challenging the reign of Spirit Sects.
Bang!
A powerful figure walked out from the continued mountain range, emanating from Lei Yun Mountain Manor, seeming to be surrounded by thunder and fire.
The terrifying aura swept in all directions, as the ultimate powerhouse made his appearance.
"Leiyun Province, take care of your own territory. There's no need to interfere with Luo State's affairs," a voice came lightly.
A blade light stood erect in mid-air as a figure followed, blocking the powerhouse of Lei Yun Mountain Manor.
"Remnants of the Million Stars!"
The battle of the strongest had begun.
Bang!
One after another, figures emerged from Lei Yun Mountain Manor, all ultimate powerhouses.
Likewise, powerful figures from the All Ages Alliance appeared to resist them.
At the end of it all, as a slender woman draped in a light gown appeared like a rolling colourful wave, once she halted another strongest from Lei Yun Mountain Manor, the Manor's powerhouses were filled with surprise and rage.
"Sea Spirit Tribe members, wouldn't you rather be playing in the Azure Sea than consorting with the All Ages Alliance?"
"Hehe, got tired of the sea and thought of playing in the Eighteen States a little. Why so angry?"
The Lei Yun Mountain Manor's powerhouse was furious, "All Ages Alliance, your crime of colluding with the Sea Spirit Tribe is unforgivable!"
"Alright, don't get so heated up. We, the Sea Spirit Tribe, live in the Azure Sea, we won't come to live in the Eighteen States. We're here just for some fun, out of friendship," she said.
With the aid of the Sea Spirit Tribe's powerhouse during the heated battled in Leiyun Province, the All Ages Alliance astonishingly resisted the Lei Yun Mountain Manor's attack, leading to a stalemate for a while.
Thousand Martial State, under the jurisdiction of Thousand Martial Hall.
Bang!
A figure soared into the sky, roaring, "Those who kill from my Thousand Martial Hall are unforgivable!"
"Did Huang Liang die?"
A surprised voice echoed.
A massive fist pounded towards the strongest from the Thousand Martial Hall.
"Chang Daniu was able to kill Huang Liang?"
The person who attacked was very surprised.
The strongest from the Thousand Martial Hall took their turns to counterattack. The explosive battle raged again and with the All Ages Alliance fighting against the Transcendent Spirit Sect's strongest, other Refining God Heavenly Men warriors also took action.
In an instant, All Ages Alliance challenged the dominion of Spirit Sects as a powerful force emerged in the world.
Win State, under the control of the Great Zhou State.
Unlike Spirit Sects, the Great Zhou State was a kingdom, the only one not ruled by Spirit Sects, a kingdom whose power matched Transcendent Spirit Sect.
The Loose Cultivators in Great Zhou State were considered citizens of the Great Zhou State. Although there were many affluent families, they still had a certain path for promotion, given they had high talents.
Therefore, low-level warriors in Great Zhou State were slightly better off than those in other places.
A man wearing a purple crown, dressed in a purple robe, with a commanding face, stepped out of the Great Zhou capital city to meet a figure outside of Zhou.
"You intend to provoke my Great Zhou?"
The Emperor of Great Zhou spoke indifferently.
"No! Emperor of Great Zhou, I am here on behalf of the All Ages Alliance to negotiate."
The man responded with a smile.
"Speak!"
The Emperor of Great Zhou spoke coldly.
"We, the All Ages Alliance, wish to claim a place for all Loose Cultivators in the world, to strive for a bright world and to equal with the Spirit Sects."
"We hope that Great Zhou State will not get involved, and we, the All Ages Alliance, will also not set foot in the territory of Great Zhou State."
The man spoke earnestly.
"To negotiate terms, one must have the qualifications!"
The Emperor of Great Zhou responded indifferently.
"Then, Emperor of Great Zhou, you look and see if this is enough!"
The powerhouse of the All Ages Alliance raised his hand and punched it towards the mid-air.

chapters.title: Chapter 525 - 287: Guiding Moon Changming, Xu Yan's Idea_1
chapters.content:
The fist seal surged towards the sky as if it was going to shatter the heavens. A powerful force, akin to a natural law, surged in all directions.
Emperor Da Zhou's expression tightened. "A loose cultivator can possess such strength? Why does he have this cultivation technique?"
"Why cannot a loose cultivator possess such strength?"
The All Ages Alliance expert chuckled. "Emperor Da Zhou, is he worthy?"
Emperor Da Zhou smiled. "It's fine, as long as your All Ages Alliance doesn't step into the Da Zhou territory, Da Zhou will not take action."
Finishing his words, he turned to leave but immediately halted. "The All Ages Alliance's strength is indeed impressive but it isn't enough to challenge the Spirit Sect.
"There's more to the Transcendent Spirit Sect than meets the eye."
With that, he strode away.
"Thank you for your advice, Emperor Da Zhou!"
The All Ages Alliance expert saluted.
The most powerful experts of Yuzhou's Yu Ling Mansion began to appear in succession, battling against the Spiritual Beast clansmen who came from the Heavenly Mausoleum State.
"The All Ages Alliance, colluding with Spiritual Beasts, must be executed!"
"If Yu Ling Mansion can ally with the Spiritual Beasts, why can't our All Ages Alliance? Just stay obediently in Yuzhou."
The All Ages Alliance expert sneered.
At Chenzhou, the location of the All Ages Alliance base, as soon as their existence was revealed, they suppressed the Spirit Sect of Chenzhou with their formidable strength and replaced the Spirit Sect with themselves!
Loose cultivators in Chenzhou rejoiced and pledged their allegiance, joining the battle against the Spirit Sect.
A war that swept across the Ling Domain and challenged the Spirit Sect's rule suddenly erupted in each state. Many of the Spirit Sects were caught off guard and quickly fell into a disadvantage.
Those Spirit Sects with weak strength were exterminated by the All Ages Alliance.
As the All Ages Alliance grew more potent, the loose cultivators collectively joined the battle, whether for the Spirit Sect's interests or for personal revenge, these cultivators acted in line with the All Ages Alliance's movements.
In just half a month, the previously dominating Spirit Sect was in peril under the relentless onslaught.
The overwhelmingly powerful Transcendent Spirit Sect didn't even have the strength to lift a hand to rescue the Spirit Sect families in various states.
In Yun Mountain State, where the Taimiao Sect was located...
Unlike the Transcendent Sects such as the Lei Yun Mountain Manor, the Thousand Martial Hall, and the Yu Ling Mansion, the Taimiao Sect truly had a detached and transcendent demeanor.
It seemed to only focus on cultivating in silence, recruiting gifted disciples, and continuously passing on its teachings.
The control over Yun Mountain State seemed more about obtaining resources for the cultivation of their disciples.
Yet, nobody dared to underestimate the Taimiao Sect.
Tan Wenlin, the leader of the All Ages Alliance, personally came to the gate of the Taimiao Sect.
It was evident how much he valued the Taimiao Sect.
"Yun Mountain State shall not be plunged into chaos, do not interfere in the affairs of Yun Mountain State, or die!"
A cold voice resonated from the Taimiao Sect.
Along with it came fantastical flowers, dreamlike as they floated down, imbued with both captivating beauty and deadly murderous intent.
Tan Wenlin's expression was extremely solemn. He pointed out with a pen in his hand, and countless dots appeared as if stars lit up at the stroke of his pen.
Boom!
The mystical flowers collided with the dreamlike power.
Pugh!
The stars collapsed, Tan Wenlin took a few steps back.
The fantastical flowers exploded into nothingness, the dreamlike power gradually turned into illusion, ephemeral like a bubble's reflection, ready to disappear at any moment.
"Well, the All Ages Alliance will not enter Yun Mountain State!"
Tan Wenlin's expression was unimaginably solemn as he pronounced in a deep voice.
The Taimiao Sect remained silent.
Tan Wenlin turned to leave, his hand that held the star-pointing pen trembling slightly.
"Taimiao Xin Mengrou has actually made such progress!"
Tan Wenlin was shocked.
He let out a sigh of relief in his mind. If Xin Mengrou had acted, he might not have been able to resist!
From that day forward, all All Ages Alliance experts withdrew from Yun Mountain State.
At Luo State, Chang Daniu did not meet Huang Liang, but he did receive the news that Huang Liang had been killed in Yuzhou.
He was astounded. Who killed Huang Liang?
Was it an old acquaintance?
Just as he was about to head to Yuzhou, a figure obstructed his path.
This ultimate expert was from Lei Yun Mountain Manor.
...
The emergence of the All Ages Alliance shook the Ling Domain.
Only Yuzhou remained untouched. Cultivators from Luo State, who had fled to Yuzhou, began to return to Luo State to rebuild their branch alliance.
In contrast, people like Yu Gao did not receive any command to appear from the headquarters, rather they were told to keep lurking.
"Who knew, the All Ages Alliance has such strength!"
Fang Hao exclaimed.
He relayed the message to Yu Gao. Everything remains as before.
Hence, the Yu God Sect and Su Family's territory in Yuzhou, continued to be secretly controlled by their branch of the All Ages Alliance, while the Shen Family still held the appearance of being in control.
"Is the Spirit Sect's rule about to end?"
Yue'er asked, excited.
"It's not that easy."
Moon Changming shook his head.
Although the All Ages Alliance had demonstrated immense power, making a high-profile appearance and seemingly suppressing the Spirit Sect's momentum, this was only the beginning.
However, he was still surprised. Where did the All Ages Alliance get so many ultimate experts from?
"Could it be, that the past research of the Martial Institute has succeeded?"
Moon Changming wondered.
At this moment, he was in the process of healing his spiritual body. After consuming the pill refined by Su Lingxiu, his originally collapsed and depleted spiritual body, was miraculously reforming and recovering.
However, complete recovery requires time and a consistent intake of nourishing pills.
"Miss Su, I will find a way to compensate you for the spiritual herbs used for the treatment."
Moon Changming said with gratitude.
Su Lingxiu shifted her gaze and said: "You have good strength too, just in time my junior brother's All Ages Alliance lacks an expert, why don't you go and oversee my junior brother's All Ages Alliance?"
"Consider this as your treatment fee, what do you think?"
Moon Changming nodded: "Alright, no problem!"

chapters.title: Chapter 526 - 287: Guiding Moon Changming, Xu Yan's Idea_2
chapters.content:
Outside, the world was in turmoil, wars were erupting, but the estate was calm and peaceful, untouched by the chaos, with none of the most powerful warriors from the Thousand Martial Hall seeking vengeance.
However, Xu Yan, Meng Chong, and Fang Hao were all getting restless, eager to plunge into the fray, hone their skills, and ascend to the pinnacle.
Li Xuan pondered for a moment. The All Ages Alliance led by Fang Hao indeed lacked a powerful figure to defend it.
He himself could not possibly be that figure, Moon Changming was a decent candidate, but unfortunately his power was insufficient and he couldn't even defeat Huang Liang.
To preside over the All Ages Alliance, one should possess the strength to resist the most powerful warriors from the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
"It's not difficult to incorporate the Heavenly Earth Lingji into the Divine Soul, and even to refine a strand of the power of Heavenly Earth law, it's not too difficult. It just takes some time," he spoke to himself.
In this Spirit Domain, no one understood the Heavenly Earth Laws better than he did.
Li Xuan decided to give Moon Changming some advice, considering it a fortunate opportunity that Moon Changming had the chance to meet with him, a peerless expert.
If one had met a superior figure but gained no benefit or improvement in strength, wouldn't that indicate that he, as the superior figure, was not distinguished enough?
"Moon Changming, right?"
Li Xuan asked while sipping his Spiritual Tea.
"Yes, senior!"
Moon Changming replied respectfully.
This was a genuine peerless expert, he felt a hint of anticipation and excitement in his heart. Perhaps the opportunity to change his destiny was upon him.
"Can you refine the Heavenly Earth Lingji into your Divine Soul?"
Li Xuan casually asked.
"I know a bit, but my spiritual body has not yet recovered, so I can't refine the Heavenly Earth Lingji into my Divine Soul."
Moon Changming replied with concealed excitement.
"The Grand Azure Martial Dao is closely related to the Heavenly Earth Lingji, but the refinement of the Heavenly Earth Lingji does not really hinge on your spiritual body."
Li Xuan extended his hand and captured a strand of ethereal energy, which manifested in his hand.
Heavenly Earth Lingji!
