Moon Changming was taken aback, he hastily memorized the words "Grand Azure Martial Dao", overwhelmed by the sensation of uncovering a small part of the secrets of the heavens and the earth.
Looking at the Heavenly Earth Lingji in Li Xuan's hand, he couldn't help but exclaim, justifying the reputation of a peerless expert who could attract the Heavenly Earth Lingji with a mere gesture.
"After you folks refine your Divine Soul, all you do is refine the Heavenly Earth Lingji into your Divine Soul, and then use the Heavenly Earth Lingji to comprehend the laws of Heaven and Earth, and refine the power of the law into your body...
"You have reached the pinnacle of refining your Divine Soul, your next training is none other than refining the Heavenly Earth Lingji into your Divine Soul, and then comprehending the Heavenly Earth laws and refining them into your body.
"Since it's your fate to be here, I'll teach you the method of refining."
The strand of Heavenly Earth Lingji energy was dancing on Li Xuan's fingertip, moving at his will.
Overcome with excitement, Moon Changming respectfully said, "Thank you, Predecessor, for passing on the method!"
"Hmm."
Li Xuan nodded, creating a method to refine the Heavenly Earth Lingji was not difficult for him at all, nor was creating a method to refine the Heavenly Earth Laws.
With his current strength and understanding of the Heavenly Earth Laws, he could easily come up with it, and he was quite certain, it was definitely stronger and easier to refine than the methods mastered by the Transcendent Spirit Sect and presented smaller difficulties.
"I'm gifting this Heavenly Earth Lingji to you!"
With a flick of Li Xuan's finger, the strand of Heavenly Earth Lingji disappeared into Moon Changming's Divine Soul, together with the refining method he had created.
Then, with a wave of his hand, several patterns appeared, intertwining with one another, bearing a profound sense of mystery, seemingly containing some ultimate principle of the universe.
A piece of paper appeared on the table, and the patterns were imprinted on it. The paper with the imprinted patterns flew in front of Moon Changming.
"These are a few Heavenly Earth Laws. Reflect upon them yourself."
Moon Changming was extremely shocked at that moment. The teaching from the Predecessor was so profound, so incomprehensible.
Refining the Heavenly Earth Lingji was actually so simple and easy?
As he held the paper with the imprinted patterns in his hands, he became even more excited. Were these a few Heavenly Earth Laws?
The Predecessor had even gone as far as imparting the Heaven and Earth Laws on paper for others to comprehend. He was thoroughly convinced that if the Predecessor were to leak even a bit of his aura, it could indeed trigger a catastrophe of Heaven and Earth.
"Thank you, Predecessor, for imparting the methodology!"
Moon Changming respectfully kowtowed.
"Hmm."
Li Xuan nodded indifferently.
Moon Changming started to cultivate, his heart filled with passionate zeal.
"I, Moon Changming, will surely ascend to the summit again. I shall once more, dominate my past opponents!"
After giving advice to Moon Changming, Li Xuan continued to compile the Divine Skills Martial Code, while pondering about the later Martial Art realms.
The Divine Skills have been mastered, the direction and the realms of the subsequent Martial Art cultivation should also start to take form.
While Fang Hao was cultivating, he was also refining a miraculous weapon box that could be integrated into his body. At the same time, he let Yu Gao keep an eye on the outside information, the result of the war between the All Ages Alliance and the Spirit Sect.
The battle still continued, and the strength shown by the All Ages Alliance was beyond imagination.
Surprisingly, the Great Zhou State did not make a move against the All Ages Alliance, but this was understandable, since the Great Zhou State was not strictly speaking, the Spirit Sect.
It was a royal kingdom.
Although its strength and foundation were comparable to those of the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
The other Transcendent Spirit Sect, Taimiao Sect, surprisingly, showed no action either, yet the All Ages Alliance did not create any problems in the Yunshan State that belonged to the Taimiao Sect.
It seemed as if the two sides had reached some agreement.
The stronger the All Ages Alliance became, the more Loose Cultivators were inspired to join it in order to not be disadvantaged in fighting against the Transcendent Spirit Sect. Their momentum grew stronger with increasing numbers.
Of course, there were also Loose Cultivators seizing this opportunity to denounce the All Ages Alliance and elevate their chance to become a Spiritual Sect Warrior by gaining merits from the Spirit Sect!
All the major spiritual clans of Yuzhou were anxiously watching the war between the All Ages Alliance and the Spirit Sect.
However, the Shen Family looked calm and unworried.
After all, they had secretly colluded with the All Ages Alliance a long time ago; but this was a major secret, and only a few people in the whole Shen Family knew about it.
Shen Haizhou came to the manor, having achieved a breakthrough and entered the Divine Realm after obtaining the elixir.
What surprised Li Xuan was that the war between the All Ages Alliance and the Spirit Sect had continued for a month and no one had yet won or lost.
"Is the All Ages Alliance really this strong?"
He couldn't help rooting for the Spirit Sect who commanded the Ling Domain to not be so weak.
More information also came, as Wen Yong was reporting war updates about the All Ages Alliance to Fang Hao.
First, among the strongest of the All Ages Alliance, there were the super prodigies from the erstwhile Martial Academy of the Ten Thousand Stars.
Second, among the strongest of the All Ages Alliance, there were powerful azure sea spirits from the Azure Sea.
Third, a powerful spiritual beast from the Heavenly Mausoleum State's beast clan joined the fight.
This was precisely why the All Ages Alliance could fight the Spirit Sect without being disadvantaged.
"The landscape of the Ling Domain is about to change," Li Xuan thought silently.
Of course, the capacity of the Transcendent Spirit Sect was more than this, otherwise they could have never ruled the Ling Domain. There must be some other factors behind the current situation.
Li Xuan glanced at Xu Yan and Meng Chong, who were diligently cultivating, itching for adventure.
"Your apprentice, Xu Yan, has achieved a breakthrough and reached the peak of the Divine Intent State, which has led to the doubling of your Primordial Spirit."
Xu Yan had made a breakthrough.
Li Xuan's face lit up with joy. His strength had doubled, making his power surge.
As Xu Yan had made a breakthrough, it was time for him to venture out, accumulate his own foundation, and prepare for a transformation when he broke through to the Divine Origin Realm.
A few days after Xu Yan's breakthrough, Meng Chong also broke through.
"Your apprentice, Meng Chong, has made a breakthrough and reached the first peak of the Great day's Indestructible Golden Body. You have reached a minor level in the second round of the Golden Body."
A few days later, Su Lingxiu also made a breakthrough.
"Your apprentice, Su Lingxiu, achieved a major accomplishment in the Divine Intent State, and you've reached a minor level in the Primordial Realm of the Elixir Martial Dao."
One after another, all three apprentices made breakthroughs, which significantly enhanced their strength.
Meanwhile, Fang Hao's miraculous weapon box was being refined and was nearing completion.
Li Xuan glanced at the young girl Yue'er, who was making a breakthrough to the Refining God Heavenly Man realm.
"A Refining God Heavenly Man at this age, in the Ling Domain, is indeed a top prodigy. Her spiritual body talent is indeed remarkable."
Of course, Yue'er's quick breakthrough had a lot to do with the elixir.
She and Su Lingxiu had now become best friends.
"Master!"
Xu Yan came over, respectfully.
"Hmm, eager to move after calm thinking?"
Li Xuan asked with a smile.
"Master, I want to use martial arts to strengthen myself, supported by elixirs and spiritual items, in order to build my foundation, make a breakthrough into the Divine Origin Realm, and transform myself..."
Xu Yan thought for a moment and then shared his thoughts.
He wanted to fight and hone himself in battle, pushing his limits and accumulating his foundation, rather than simply relying on spiritual items to nurture and refine his body.
Li Xuan was a little surprised to hear this. Xu Yan was planning to accumulate his foundation in this way!

chapters.title: Chapter 527 - 288: Above Divine Skills, Martial Arts Divine Appearance _1
chapters.content:
Xu Yan aimed to grow through battles of martial arts, to break his limits, and to build up his heritage.
Li Xuan could not help but think of a phrase - 'Path of the Unrivaled'!
Xu Yan's move, how similar it was to the path of the unrivaled.
Unrivaled all the way, gathering irresistible momentum for breakthrough, conveying an invincible will.
Of course, Xu Yan intended to utilize this to accumulate his foundation, to elevate himself. And unlike others, he will not be affected by defeat and thus disrupt the momentum towards invincibility.
This is Xu Yan's path of the unrivaled!"
Li Xuan thought to himself with wonder.
His apprentice had finally stepped outside the framework he had set, which was a good thing.
Breaking out of the framework indicated his apprentice was getting stronger, and as his apprentice's understanding of martial arts deepened, he himself would also become stronger!
If his apprentice was walking the path of the unrivaled, it was as if he was as well.
"My apprentice, you have a good thinking!"
Li Xuan nodded, approving of his words.
Xu Yan was thrilled. "Master, I want to venture into the Spirit Realm, to challenge all the prodigies. I want to defeat them, and use this as a way of building myself up and reaching the glory of the Spirit Realm!"
Challenging the prodigies of the Spirit Realm, dominating all in the Spirit Realm, and reaching the summit!
This action of his was bound to offend the major families of the Spirit Sects. How could they stand by after their prodigies have been defeated?
The rules of prodigy competition of the past were mere charades.
In the past, even the powerful Ten Thousand Star Martial Arts Institute suffered a defeat in the prodigy competition, leading to its disintegration, and the prodigies suffered heavy casualties.
Of course, only the individuals concerned knew the specific process of the battle of Ten Thousand Stars.
And here, there was a person who was once involved in it - Moon Changming, one of the thirty-six heroes of the Ten Thousand Stars who participated in the competition!
Since his apprentice was going to challenge the prodigies, as his master, he naturally needed to support and protect his apprentice.
As for certain guys, if they wish to personally enter the arena after seeing their prodigies getting defeated, it would be asking for death!
"I know my master can't simply step in, but I have confidence. I can retreat intact, you need not worry, master!"
Xu Yan said with conviction.
A master cannot casually step in. After all, he's too powerful. A slight negligence in suppressing his prowess, or if he becomes angry and reveals a trace of his actual aura or exposes any of his actual power, it could cause a catastrophe to both heaven and earth.
Therefore, Xu Yan did not intend to guard the way for his master. He was confident he could safely retreat. Besides, challenging others was not reckless; he was a martial artist, not a brute.
Li Xuan laughed inside. This had provided him with an excuse. If he confronted an enemy in the future who he could not defeat with a single slap, it would not harm his invincible image.
After all, he couldn't cause a catastrophe!
His eldest disciple was really thoughtful and had prepared a perfect excuse for him in advance.
"Good, good, good. The strong never grow in a hothouse or under protection. My apprentice, your will and confidence make me relieved!"
Li Xuan nodded with a face full of reassurance.
Xu Yan was ecstatic. His master approved of his thoughts; this meant he was on the right path.
Meng Chong also came over.
"Master, I want to learn from my elder brother too. I want to hone my blade and meet all the swordsmen in the Spirit Realm!"
The second disciple also wanted to do the same.
Su Lingxiu excitedly came over, her face flushed with excitement.
"Master..."
Li Xuan looked at his third disciple. Was this girl also intending to pursue the path of the unrivaled?
"I'm not going to follow my eldest brother or second brother's steps. I plan to open a medical martial arts clinic, to treat injured martial artists, to refine my pharmacy skills, there is no point in learning without using it."
Su Lingxiu said with a cheerful smile.
Li Xuan thought to himself, of course, the third disciple is not the violent type; she certainly does not have the will to pursue the path of the unrivaled.
However, it's true what she said - if she learned the medical martial arts, how could she not utilize it?
The situation in the Spirit Realm is still turbulent, the All Ages Alliance is at war with the Spirit Sect, countless are injured, and many martial artists have even suffered disastrous injuries and this will be a good opportunity for her to gain medical experience.
"Lingxiu, you've developed your own ideas too. That's good, it makes me proud!"
Li Xuan said with a smile.
"Hehe, master I've always been full of ideas."
Su Lingxiu fondly rubbed Li Xuan's shoulders as she spoke.
"Master, I plan to participate in the great war in the Spirit Realm with the All Ages Alliance."
Fang Hao spoke.
As the hierarch of the All Ages Alliance in Yuzhou, and a loose cultivator from the Spirit Realm, he naturally longed to shine on the battlefield of the Spirit Realm!
"Okay!"
Li Xuan nodded.
All four of his disciples had now set their own goals.
That was very good.
Xu Yan was walking the path of the unrivaled. Despite his confidence in getting away safely, how could Li Xuan allow him to be in danger?
He necessarily had to assure safety.
This was about the martial arts cause he had committed himself to.
Guarding the path himself was not necessary, but ensuring the necessary safety measures were in place was non-negotiable.
Now that all four disciples had their own direction and goals in cultivation, Li Xuan, as their master, was ecstatic, especially since Xu Yan and Meng Chong were taking a similar path to the martial path of the unrivaled.
Gaining experience and self-improvement within battles, transforming themselves and preparing to break through to the Divine Origin Realm.
Shi'er, Zhou Ying, and Meng Shushu all felt spurred and began to practice diligently, although they were still far from the breakthrough to the Divine Intent State.
Red Cat seemed to have plans and had started to practice fiercely. Li Xuan could sense it getting stronger.
Xu Yan began to prepare for his venture into the Spirit Realm and challenge the prodigies of the Spirit Realm.
Meng Chong was doing the same. This path was not going to be easy, but if they managed to get through, the benefits would be immense.
Su Lingxiu was refining elixirs, preparing a sufficient supply of various kind of elixirs for her two senior brothers.
Fang Hao continued to forge Divine Weapon boxes.
Yue'er was undergoing a breakthrough in the refinement of the True Spirit, and Moon Changming, emitting a gleaming moon-like glow, had already recovered his spiritual body.

chapters.title: Chapter 528 - 288: Above Divine Skills, Martial Arts Divine Appearance _2
chapters.content:
Moreover, having refined the Heavenly Earth Lingji into his Divine Soul, his strength surpassed even that of Huang Liang at this moment.
The Heavenly Earth Lingji that Li Xuan absorbed was much stronger than the Lingji that Huang Liang had refined into his Divine Soul. This was also why Moon Changming was able to quickly surpass Huang Liang in strength.
While refining the Heavenly Earth Lingji, Moon Changming also contemplated the patterns of a certain law.
This was a few pattern imprints extracted from the Heaven and Earth Laws on the first page of the Book of Tai Cang, imprinted on paper by Li Xuan.
For Martial Artists from the Ling Domain, these few patterns were sufficient for their comprehension. Aspiring to comprehend the laws governing the whole universe obviously was impossible.
One could only comprehend one or two of the laws therein.
Li Xuan set aside compiling the Divine Skill Martial Code for the time being and turned to compile realms of Martial Arts beyond Divine Skills. Meanwhile, he also passed on his Martial Arts Cultivation Technique to Xu Yan before he set out on his adventures.
Xu Yan's path towards invincibility was destined to be a road leading to the pinnacle of the Ling domain; progress on this path would naturally lead to an increased understanding of Martial Arts.
Perhaps during this time, he could comprehend all the methods of Martial Arts above Divine Skills.
"For methods above Divine Skills that involve Heaven and Earth Laws, I have compiled them already. The completeness of the Cultivation technique is not bad, with high continuity between realms.
"The path being trodden by martial artists of Tai Cang inevitably involves incorporating the Heaven and Earth Laws into the body. Even if one masters the power of the Heaven and Earth Laws, one still remains subject to the limitations of these laws.
"Transcending heaven and earth is much more difficult, and also lacks the laws of one's own Martial Arts.
"My Martial Arts naturally cannot be constrained. I control the Heaven and Earth Laws, rather than being restricted by them. Therefore, above Divine Skills, I make use of Heaven and Earth Laws for my own benefit.
"By using the Heaven and Earth Laws as my Divine Appearance to enhance my Divine Skills while also maintaining my control, one may call it the Physiognomy realm."
Li Xuan finalized his realm beyond Divine Skills.
The Physiognomy realm!
Transforming the Heaven and Earth Laws into the Divine Appearance of Martial Arts and using the Heaven and Earth Laws for personal use somehow implies overriding the Heaven and Earth Laws.
To be within the heavens and earth, yet in a sense surpassing them, is almost impossible to achieve.
The development of Tai Cang martial artists beyond the Refining God Heavenly Man must be related to the Heaven and Earth Laws. Li Xuan could generally deduce this as nothing more than the refining of the power of the Heaven and Earth Laws.
They can borrow the power of the Heaven and Earth Laws to a certain extent.
Like Huang Liang, such peerless warriors possess the capability to sense the Heaven and Earth Laws by refining the Heavenly Earth Lingji into their body and consolidating the power of a strand of the heavens and earth.
Such actions seem to employ the Heaven and Earth Laws, however, Tai Cang martial artists merely reside under these laws. The release of power is not about "control" or "manipulation" but largely about borrowing.
Perhaps higher realm is needed to be on equal footing with Heaven and Earth Laws and truly manipulate these laws for personal use.
What Li Xuan has to do is to directly manipulate the Heaven and Earth Laws for his own use in his realm beyond Divine Skills which, in a sense, has already laid a foundation for overriding the Heaven and Earth Laws.
The reason why he can manipulate the Heaven and Earth Laws is not only because of the Divine Skill Realm's manipulation of the Laws of Heaven and Earth through his own Martial Arts cultivation techniques but also due to a crucial factor.
The Heaven and Earth Laws recorded in the Book of Tai Cang allow Li Xuan to have a profound understanding of the Heaven and Earth Laws.
He can directly refer to the Heaven and Earth Laws in the Tai Cang Book, incorporate them into the Physiognomy realm and control the method of the Heaven and Earth Laws.
Control the Heaven and Earth Laws and transform them into the Divine Appearance of Martial Arts!
"The Physiognomy Realm has been set. It uses the Heaven and Earth Laws as the Divine Appearance of Martial Arts, and even uses the universe as its Divine Appearance... To transcend the universe, one must cultivate all the way up and not be restricted by the universe.
"The Divine Appearance is the beginning of transcending the Heaven and Earth. Although it is still far away from transcending the Heaven and Earth, it is already not restricted by the laws of heaven and earth, but controlling the laws of Heaven and Earth.
"Considering Xu Yan's special talents, he should have no problem understanding this."
Li Xuan was filled with excitement.
The Physiognomy realm, theoretically, is similar to the realm above Refining God Heavenly Man in stature, but in reality, it surmounts the realm above Refining God Heavenly Man.
"If I can break into the Physiognomy realm and display the Divine Appearance of Martial Arts, coupled with the Divine Skills of the Law of Heaven and Earth... My goodness, the whole universe will feel as if it is under my Law of Heaven and Earth, right?
"This is just too incredible!
"If I perform the Divine Skill of the Dragon Descending, and transform the Divine Appearance of Martial Arts into a divine dragon, then I am making a dragon out of the Heaven and Earth Laws."
The more Li Xuan thought about it, the more excited he became.
He opened the Daoist Golden Book to look up the method of Martial Arts for the Physiognomy realm.
The Martial Art Method of the Physiognomy Realm:
Completeness of Cultivation Technique: Above middle level.
Continuity among realms: High.
Difficulty of Comprehension: High.
Difficulty of Cultivation: Above middle level.
Looking at the information provided by the Daoist Golden Book, Li Xuan was satisfied and nodded.
The completeness of the Cultivation Technique was only above middle level, but it was not low. With Xu Yan's special talents, he could completely comprehend it.
As for the continuity among realms, it got a high rating.
This means that the advancement theory from the Divine Skill Realm to the Physiognomy Realm is completely correct.
The high comprehension difficulty was expected. After all, the Physiognomy realm's martial arts method, which he incorporated into the Book of Tai Cang's Heaven and Earth Laws, can be intuitively understood on how to begin controlling the Heaven and Earth Laws.
The difficulty of cultivation was only above the middle level, which means that as long as it is understood, it would not be too difficult to cultivate.
"The martial arts method of the Physiognomy realm shall stay as it is."
It would be too difficult to improve the completeness of the Cultivation Technique and reduce the comprehension difficulty.
Because after all, if the comprehension difficulty is reduced and the completeness of the Cultivation Technique is improved, the power of this realm in a certain sense would actually decrease.
The closer it is to the Divine Skill Realm, the higher the completeness of the Cultivation Technique will naturally be. However, the farther from the Divine Skill Realm, the greater the power gap between realms would be, hence, it would be more difficult to improve the completeness of the Cultivation Technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 529 - 288: Above Divine Skills, Martial Arts Divine Appearance _3
chapters.content:
Li Xuan did all he could to raise the perfection level of the Cultivation Technique to above average, ensuring that his realm strength would not be lower than expected.
The more mystical and profound the Martial Arts Cultivation Techniques are, the higher the difficulty of comprehension. It's an unavoidable fact.
Choosing so was the only way to become much stronger.
"Now that the Physiognomy realm is set, what would be beyond the Physiognomy realm?"
Li Xuan fell into deep thought.
In the Physiognomy realm, one has already transformed the Laws of Heaven and Earth into a Martial Arts Divine Appearance and used it to control the Laws of Heaven and Earth. How should one proceed along the Martial Arts realm above this?
How to transcend the Heaven and Earth step by step?
The genuine transcendence of Heaven and Earth can't be achieved in a single stride. It occurs realm by realm until finally one transcends Heaven and Earth.
So, how to continue cultivation above the Physiognomy realm, further enhance Martial Arts, and lay a foundation for transcending Heaven and Earth?
Li Xuan felt a bit of a headache. "This Martial Arts compilation is too difficult. The span is too large and there's no link between realms, it's impossible to comprehend. Just like taking too big a step, it's easy to sprain the groin...
"Therefore, it can only be done step by step, realm by realm..."
Even if Xu Yan is extraordinary, if there's no link between one realm and the next, and the span is incredibly large, comprehension would undoubtedly be impossible.
Even if he was extraordinary to the extent that he could comprehend something, who knows how long it would take? Definitely, it would result in staying at one realm for a very long time...
"The Physiognomy realm is about controlling the laws of Heaven and Earth, and above this realm, one must certainly have the ability to break those laws and not be constrained by them, so..."
Li Xuan had some insights.
Meanwhile, within the manor, Li Xuan was formulating Martial Arts law, while Xu Yan was preparing for his adventures beyond, ready to challenge the outstanding talents of the Ling Domain.
Outside, the situation was also changing.
The war of the strongest in Leiyun Province had started once again.
Boom!
In this battle, from the mountain peak where Lei Yun Mountain Manor was located, a streak of lightning shot forth piercing the sky. In a flash, it swept across the sky, attacking one of the strongest warriors from the All Ages Alliance.
Thud!
The warrior's face drastically changed. Regardless of his desperate resistance, he was still hit by the thunder, thrown back, half of his body scorched black, greatly damaged!
Boom!
Another streak of lightning swept past, aiming at the Sea Spirit Tribe's strongest warrior.
"Divine Artifact!"
The face of the Sea Spirit Tribe's strongest warrior changed drastically. Water rippled before him, raising huge waves, but he was still unable to withstand the lightning. Another of the strongest warriors in the All Ages Alliance, not far from him, bravely stepped up to assist.
Boom!
Though they blocked this bolt of lightning, the assisting warrior was heavily injured by one of the warriors from Lei Yun Mountain Manor!
In this moment, the depth of the Transcendent Spirit Sect was on full display.
A figure wrapped in lightning, holding the Divine Artifact, walked out from Lei Yun Mountain Manor.
"Retreat!"
A figure emerged in the All Ages Alliance, speaking in a tone filled with nothing but seriousness.
All warriors of the All Ages Alliance promptly retreated.
Boom!
Another streak of lightning rapidly approached.
"Guardian Yan, be careful!"
The warriors of the All Ages Alliance exclaimed!
"Hmph!"
Guardian Yan snorted, holding a short stick in his hand and struck it out.
Boom!
The powerful blows met, neither gaining the upper hand.
Guardian Yan also had a Divine Artifact in his hand.
Boom!
But at that moment, Lei Yun Mountain Manor surged a sea of thunderclouds, and the red fire of thundercloud rolled in.
Lei Yun Mountain Manor has used the second Divine Artifact!
"Leave Leiyun Province!"
A cold voice echoed from Lei Yun Mountain Manor.
"Ha ha, we'll leave it to you, Lei Yun Mountain Manor!"
Guardian Yan laughed, leading the warriors of the All Ages Alliance in retreat.

chapters.title: Chapter 530 - 289: Dean Wu Tianan of the Myriad Star Academy, The Secret of the Divine Bridge_1
chapters.content:
The battle between the All Ages Alliance and the Spirit Sect entered a new phase, demonstrating the formidable foundation of the Transcendent Spirit Sect after Lei Yun Mountain Manor, Thousand Martial Hall, and Yuling Mansion wielded their Divine Artifacts.
The All Ages Alliance of Leiyun Province retreated, the Alliance in Thousand Martial State was also driven back. However, the Yuling Mansion in Qing State, using a Yuling Divine Artifact, managed to exterminate a spirit beast above the sixth rank, forcefully disrupting the spirit beast and expelling it back into the mountains of Heavenly Mausoleum State.
The Alliance in Qing State was defeated, and their strongest fighters were heavily injured. The situation was only stabilized when the Alliance Hierarch, Tan Wenlin, personally intervened, allowing for a retreat from Qing State.
The Spirit Sects from other states also demonstrated their formidable strength, instantly turning the tides that previously were against them and recapturing large territories.
However, Chenzhou was already under the control of the All Ages Alliance, which also held places in the rest of the states.
Both sides entered into a deadlock.
On the border of Luo State, within the Cangyun Dynasty, Chang Daniu was engaged into a fierce battle with a powerful warrior from Lei Yun Mountain Manor, both parties had matching strength and were well acquainted with each other.
"Remains from the Ten Thousand Stars, do you truly believe you can return in glory?"
The strong warrior from Lei Yun Mountain Manor said coldly.
"The Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy will not return, but the All Ages Alliance will definitely have a place to stand, your era of Spirit Sect ruling over Ling Domain, is ending!"
Chang Daniu said while laughing coldly.
Chenzhou was already under the control of the All Ages Alliance, apart from the directly governed states of the Transcendent Spirit Sect, all other states gave the All Ages Alliance a place to rest.
The situation where the Spirit Sect completely dominated the Ling Domain, had already changed.
"Huh, do you really think you people can get what you wish for? The foundation of my Spirit Sect, how could you, a lowly Loose Cultivator, understand? Even if you allied with the Sea Spirit Tribe, or allied with the Spirit Beast Tribe, what of it?
"This Ling Domain, ultimately belongs to our Spirit Sect."
Chang Daniu laughed wildly, "Is that so? Then let's see what kind of foundation your Spirit Sect holds, the new structure of Ling Domain has already been determined, and Loose Cultivators also have a place!"
The two sides continued to explode into fierce battles, Chang Daniu's dual hammers constantly pounding fiercely, the strong warrior from Lei Yun Mountain Manor also wielded a large hammer surrounded by thunder and lightning.
Both parties continued to contest fiercely, their power inspiring awe, causing the onlookers to be utterly frightened.
Is this the might of the strongest fighters?
Somewhere in the sky of Ling Domain, five figures stood above the clouds, seemingly enveloped by strands of the principles of Heaven and Earth. Though they did not demonstrate any intimidating power, it was as though the Great Power of Heaven and Earth gathered on them.
The Thousand Martial Lord, the Yuling Mansion Master, and the Manor Master of Lei Yun Mountain Manor, the most powerful people of the three Transcendent Spirit Sects, wore cold expressions at this moment, staring at two figures in front of them.
"City Lord Fu, do you really want to fall from grace and stand with this inferior Loose Cultivator?"
The Thousand Martial Lord looked gloomily at the man with his hair tied up by the Azure Sea Divine Pearl, holding a folding fan with an innocent look.
City Lord Fu had a look of helplessness, shaking his head and sighing: "I had no choice, this damned guy tricked me once. I owe him a favor, and I must repay it.
"The three of you, don't get so upset. Haven't you seen that no one from Great Zhou or Taomiao has come at all?
"With the three of you, it is impossible to win."
Towards the end, he shook his folding fan with one hand and rolled up his ponytail around his wrist with the other, sighing: "Do you see the Azure Sea Divine Pearl on the top of my head? I always wanted to use this Divine Pearl for my hair, but it was impossible to dig a hole into it.
"This guy said he could help me. I didn't believe him so I made a bet. As a result, he really did it.
"As you all know, I, Fu Tianhai, am a man of my word, so I have to act."
The three people from Thousand Martial Hall all wore extremely gloomy expressions.
The man standing next to Fu Tianhai held a measuring scale in one hand and a book in the other, looking like a polite scholar with no sign of a warrior's spirit.
However, this man significantly worried the three people from the Thousand Martial Hall.
The dean of the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy, a real legendary figure.
From moving into Ling Domain from the Inner Domain to presiding over the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy, he boosted the strength of the Academy to the level that could rival the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
There had always been rumors that this person was the master of the Blood Demon when it first rose to power.
Even though he was defeated in the battle against the genius of the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy and was wiped out from Eighteen States.
This man had incredibly survived.
"Wu Tianan, if you bring City Lord Fu, do you really think you can fight against us?"
The Manor Master of Lei Yun Mountain Manor stepped forward, thunderous light enveloping his body, and his hand's Thunderyun Pearl emitted cyan thunderous light, demonstrating a simple killing intent.
A short white rod, with a cyan bead the size of a fist on the top, shining with a cyan thunderous light, which was Lei Yun Mountain Manor's Divine Artifact, the Thunderyun Pearl!
The Yuling Mansion master laughed and looked at Fu Tianhai: "City Lord Fu, I understand your difficulties, so why don't you and I stay out of it and let these three fight it out?"
Fu Tianhai laughed, "Agreed!"
The Thousand Martial Lord wielded a knife, a cold light lingered around the blade, releasing a terrifying cold qi. He coldly said: "Wu Tianan, when my mentor severely injured you, I thought you would either die or be crippled, never thought you could still survive to this point.
"However, since you are courting death, I will fulfill your wish today!"
However, Wu Tianan just laughed elegantly, put away the book in his hands, held the measuring scale, and showed no anger or retreat.
"Among the Transcendent Spirit Sects in Ling Domain, Thousand Martial Hall is the most shameless. That old man, your mentor, not only sneak attacked me, but also secretly bribed my men.
"It's better that the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy is gone, I can finally get rid of a responsibility."

chapters.title: Chapter 531 - 289: Wu Tianan, the Dean of the Wanxing Institute, and the Secret of the Divine Bridge_2
chapters.content:
Wu Tianan, holding the Measuring Scale in his right hand, gently patted his own left hand; the sound of it reverberating amidst the clouds. From the face of Thousand Martial Lord and Lord Lei Yun, the most formidable contenders, he showed no fear.
His gaze became distant, as if he was reminiscing the past.
"I was born in a small village in the Inner Domain, in the county of Tianan; without any martial arts cultivation techniques, never even encountering the martial path. Orphaned at an early age, I was alone and destitute."
"People in the village used to call me Little Wild Dog; I didn't even have a name."
"Until I was eight, a celestial-looking elder sister arrived; she was heavily injured, pursued and sought after, seeking sanctuary in our village. I hid her in the cellar."
"I cleared away the residual traces of her presence, deceived her pursuers, and they left…"
Wu Tianan was reminiscing about his childhood, speaking in a leisurely manner.
The Lord of the Thousand Martial Hall and the others were in no rush to strike, instead listening silently. They wanted to know what was the intent behind Wu Tianan's prolonged monologue.
At the same time, they were curious about Wu Tianan's experience.
This was, after all, a legendary figure who was well-known to have come from the Inner Domain, then entered the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy, and only when he took control of the Martial Academy, his formidable power was made known.
Wu Tianan continued, "… The beautiful elder sister was severely injured, but she had medicine with her and could recover. It was then that I was introduced to martial arts."
"She passed on the martial arts techniques to me. I found it quite simple and quickly learned."
"Elder sister was astonished at my talent. Once her injuries healed, she stayed in our small village and guided me in the martial path. By the time I turned sixteen, I was already a Great Grandmaster martial artist."
"I thought we would always be together, but she eventually left. She told me to venture into the Ling Domain and enroll at the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy."
"Before she left, she gave me a name, Wu Tianan!"
"In the Inner Domain, I created the Seven-star Study Palace, spread martial arts, and honed the martial path…"
Wu Tianan, the founder of the Seven-star Study Palace, became a legendary figure after entering the Ling Domain. He joined the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy which became the Ling Domain associate of the Seven-star Study Palace in the Inner Domain.
The previous president of the academy, who had a preexisting injury, diminished lifespan, fell twenty years after Wu Tianan entered the academy.
With his formidable strength and revered reputation, Wu Tianan assumed the position of dean, persisting with his martial path aspiration, spreading martial arts philosophy across the Ling Domain. Under his leadership, the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy rapidly rose through the ranks, producing numerous prodigies.
"… Blood Spirit Child was an anomaly. It was because of you, the aristocratic Cultivator clans, that he was driven to insanity."
In the end, Wu Tianan sighed deeply.
The eyebrows of the three chiefs of the Thousand Martial Hall furrowed, feeling somewhat puzzled as to why Wu Tianan would bring up his background and experiences. Was it to demonstrate how legendary his rise to prominence was?
The Master of the Yu Ling Mansion suddenly frowned and said in a deep voice, "Your connection to the martial path originated from that woman. It was also she who directed you towards the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy."
"Where has she gone?"
Wu Tianan responded with a radiant smile, "I do not know. There is no trace of her in Ling-Realm, I have been searching for her."
Next, he looked at the three men with a profound gaze and said word by word, "That bridge is about to appear, isn't it? Or, do you possess the capacity to summon that bridge?"
When the three leaders of the Thousand Martial Hall heard this, their expressions drastically changed. Their eyes were cold, and a strong intent to kill emerged.
"Fu Tianhai, did you dare to disclose this secret to him?"
Lord Lei Yun angrily looked at Fu Tianhai.
Fu Tianhai rolled his eyes, with an innocent expression on his face, "I, Fu Tianhai, am not a fool. How could I possibly tell him about this secret?"
"How did he know about it? I have no idea."
The Thousand Martial Lord then raised his knife while exuding an overbearing killing aura, "Wu Tianan, you must die today. The All Ages Alliance must also be eradicated!"
Lord Lei Yun's momentum was fully unleashed with thunderbolts rumbling around him. The Yu Ling Mansion Master raised his hand and waved. In the distance, a spirit beast quickly fled from within the clouds.
"So, this is the secret of you Spirit Sect members, only held in your hands."
As Wu Tianan spoke, his expression suddenly turned cold.
"The Martial Academy does not stand in the Eighteen States anymore. The only goal of my life is to ascend that Divine Bridge and see if the one I am searching for is there."
"Who can stop me? Who has the right to stop me!"
"Although I did not create the All Ages Alliance, Wen Lin can be considered as half a disciple of mine. For the Alliance today, I will fight for its place!"
Boom!
At this moment, Wu Tianan's Measuring Scale shone brightly in his hand.
In the clouds and across heaven and earth, nine mystical forces descended all of a sudden surrounding Wu Tianan. At this moment, his aura prevailed over the three formidable opponents.
"You...how is this possible!"
The three Thousand Martial Lords changed their expression abruptly, looking at Wu Tianan in horror.
Nine complex auras, radiating a faint glow, seemed to contain the ultimate truths of heaven and earth!
Fu Tianhai also looked at Wu Tianan in shock. Had he really grown this powerful?
"What is impossible? I am at the limit of the Spiritual Realm Martial Arts. See if I am eligible to fight for a place in the All Ages Alliance and if I am qualified enough to climb that Divine Bridge!"
Wu Tianan swung his Measuring Scale, casting a magnificent radiance and fighting against the three ultimate powerhouses by himself.
In the clouds above, the intense battle erupted. The Thousand Martial Lords each wielded their Divine Artifacts to jointly challenge Wu Tianan, but they still fell short.
The three of them had five complex auras wrapped around them, four less than Wu Tianan, clearly indicating the disparity in strength.
"Bring out your true power of the Transcendent Spirit Sect and see if I, Wu Tianan, can take it!"
Wu Tianan looked indifferent and cold, his scholarly demeanor coupled with an aura of savageness.
He swung the Measuring Scale, forcing the three Thousand Martial Lords to retreat.
"Why make such a fuss."
A sigh resounds.
Flowers, fantastical as a dream, floated down, a dream-like power surged forth, blocking Wu Tianan's attack.
A silhouette, enshrouded in an illusory aura, walked leisurely forward. Despite her blurred features, it was clear that she was extraordinarily beautiful, surpassing all others in the world.
Nine complex auras swirled around her body.
Wu Tianan retreated his Measuring Scale, stared at the figment, the calm on his face mixed with a hint of complication.
"Neither owe a favor, nor owe a grace. From this moment on, I am myself. The heart is like an illusion and the person is like an illusion. It's too vain. Xin Mengrou, I didn't expect you to come this far."
The three Thousand Martial Lords breathed a sigh of relief amidst their shock. Xin Mengrou has actually come this far. Her strength is no less than Wu Tianan's.
The Transcendent Spirit Sect still has the upper hand.
"Wu Tianan knows the secret of the Divine Bridge. He must not be left alive. The All Ages Alliance must also be destroyed. Elder Xin, let's join hands to kill Wu Tianan!"
The Thousand Martial Lord spoke solemnly.
However, Xin Mengrou ignored him, just quietly watching Wu Tianan, seemingly deep in thought.
Wu Tianan looked calm, but there was a hint of complexity and sigh in his eyes.
The naive and lively girl who used to trick him into giving her Martial Arts secrets had changed her character completely due to unpredictable occurrences.
"I went to the Inner Domain and killed him, buried him, and paid back a person who saved me in the Inner Domain. I gave birth to a daughter for him.
"In this world, I don't owe anyone anything.
"After thinking about it, maybe I still owe some to the principal, such as the martial arts secrets you gave me, and the martial arts principles you explained.
"The Spirit Sect has its own rules. As for the secrets of the Divine Bridge, since you know some, you should know them.
"The dispute between the All Ages Alliance and the Spirit Sect can come to an end, and further fighting will only lead to more deaths.
"Let us continue according to the original rules of the geniuses' duel. I believe with you there, no one in the Spirit Sect would dare to break the rules."
Xin Mengrou's voice was gentle, giving people a dream-like feeling.
Wu Tianan sighed, nodded his head without saying anything. Blood Spirit Child eventually died, killed by Xin Mengrou.
The Thousand Martial Lord became anxious. "Elder Xin, this is the Spirit Sect's secret. How can we allow outsiders to know it? The All Ages Alliance must be annihilated. The genius duel is only a joke. How can Loose Cultivators have any geniuses?"
Xin Mengrou looked back at him and said, "If you don't accept it, you can fight Wu Tianan. If you win, we will do as you wish!"
"I..."
The Thousand Martial Lord was speechless.
"There is no rule in the Divine Bridge that only people from the Spirit Sect can ascend. It's just that the Spirit Sect is in charge. If you can kill Principal Wu, everything will remain the same.
"If not, what if Principal Wu ascends?
"If you want to invoke the Divine Bridge, you can do so. I'm not going to be involved."
After Xin Mengrou finished, her dream-like figure drifted away.

chapters.title: Chapter 532 - 290: Clash of Talents, Xu Yan's Invincible Path_1
chapters.content:
Xin Mengrou's figure disappeared into the clouds, but she also revealed a piece of information, that the Transcendent Spirit Sect can bring forth the Divine Bridge before its due time!
The faces of the three Thousand Martial Lords were gloomy beyond measure, the strength of Wu Tianan was unexpectedly formidable.
To kill him, would be extremely difficult.
He was once bound by the Martial Arts Academy, now he stands alone, totally free, with no weak points, which makes him a huge threat to them.
Even if they were to exhaust the resources of the Transcendent Spirit Sect, it wouldn't necessarily guarantee his downfall.
If they provoked him, the Transcendent Spirit Sect would face a terrifying revenge, no sect disciples, or even top powerhouses who have tapped into the Heavenly Earth Lingji would be spared.
"Isn't the competition among the prodigies excellent? Leave it to the younger generation. Besides, is the Transcendent Spirit Sect afraid of loose cultivators?
"You all brought about the ruin of the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy, has the Spirit Sect become so feeble that it depends on its prodigies?"
Fu Tianhai spoke languidly.
"Fu Tianhai, you, the Azure Sea City also belongs to the Transcendent Spirit Sect, what do you intend by making these derisive comments?"
Lord Lei Yun shouted angrily.
"My Azure Sea City is not like you all, we are in the Azure Sea, not in the Eighteen States, and we do not oppress the loose cultivators like your Spirit Sect does.
"In our Azure Sea City, we only consider talent and strength, not one's background."
Fu Tianhai retorted with a sneer.
"Humph!"
Lord Lei Yun's face darkened in annoyance, followed by a cold humph.
"The time is almost ripe for the Spirit Sect martial conference, simply consider the All Ages Alliance as a part of it. If the Spirit Sect is capable, it should defeat everyone from the All Ages Alliance martial conference."
"In this way, there'll be no prodigies from the All Ages Alliance to ascend to the Divine Bridge."
Fu Tianhai proposed in a cheerful manner.
"How about it, isn't my suggestion a good one? If it were to come to a real fight, without the aid of Transcendent Spirit Sect or the Kingdom of Great Zhou, do you three think you can hold him back, even if you were to mobilize some hidden reserves?"
Nearing the end of his remark, Fu Tianhai turned his gaze toward the Thousand Martial Lord, and said with a smile, "Isn't it time for the Thousand Martial Hall to descend and challenge the prodigies of the Spirit Sect in the Ling Domain?
"Would I be wrong in assuming that your generation of Thousand Martial Hall has a few prodigies that stand out distinctly in the martial arts world?
"The prodigies of my Azure Sea City eagerly await your wards of the Thousand Martial Hall."
Wu Tianan was casually reading a book, unlike his earlier formidable demeanor, he looked rather refined, like a scholarly teacher, with his measuring scale tapping gently on the pages of the book.
Waiting for the decision of the three Thousand Martial Lords.
"Very well, let the young ones compete then. Let's see how many prodigies the All Ages Alliance cultivators produce and let's see you, Wu Tianan, how many prodigies you can train.
"We have crushed your Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy, and we can crush your All Ages Alliance as well."
The Thousand Martial Lord sneered in response.
"So be it."
Wu Tianan revealed a smile, "Competition among the prodigies, what an excellent martial atmosphere! We old men should not interfere too much, let's follow the rules.
"Victory or defeat, life or death, it's all up to the younger ones."
As he spoke to the end, his gaze gradually sharpened, "However, I must make it clear beforehand. If any old man interferes, bullying the young, killing a prodigy of the All Ages Alliance, he kills one, and I will kill three.
"Let's see who can block me and who can protect your prodigies!"
The three Thousand Martial Lords all turned solemn. Wu Tianan had let loose completely, even going as far as to speak outright, unlike his previous restraint when he led the Martial Arts Academy.
Precisely because of this, Wu Tianan is a great threat.
"Well, let the young people fight among themselves! We won't interfere!"
Lord Lei Yun scoffed coldly.
"Your Lei Yun Mountain Manor still has some credibility. However, the Thousand Martial Hall is most despicable and I can hardly trust it, so I will be watching them closely."
Wu Tianan remarked with a chuckle.
Fu Tianhai, trying to ease the tension, said, "That's enough. The old members of the Thousand Martial Hall are indeed shameless, but the Thousand Martial Lord isn't. He still has some credibility.
"Although he occasionally resorts to petty tricks, he never stoops to vile acts like ambushes, rapes, and looting ..."
The Thousand Martial Lord's face turned ashen and he grit his teeth, "Fu Tianhai!"
Fu Tianhai gave an awkward smile and then regained his composure, "Thousand Martial Lord, you ought to keep your people in line and follow the rules!"
"Humph!"
The Thousand Martial Lord huffed coldly.
…
The grand battle between the All Ages Alliance and the Spirit Sect temporarily came to a halt, and the competition among prodigies was once again brought up. The two sides will determine the victory and the territorial possession based on their own prodigies' battles.
Just like the competitions of prodigies from the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy in the past years.
Prodigies under the age of thirty can freely compete with each other. Their respective forces cannot interfere or participate, and cannot bully the weak!
Moreover, this time the competition among the prodigies is not only limited to the All Ages Alliance and the Spirit Sect, prodigies from all over the Ling Domain can also participate.
The top ten among the prodigies will be awarded generous prizes as well as a chance to claim a great mystery!
The competition among the prodigies will soon begin, and it will last for ten years!
As the competition among the prodigies is reinstated, several sects intensified their efforts to nurture prodigies and began recruiting loose cultivators with prodigious talents to represent the sect in the battle and receive training from the sect.
It seemed as though loose cultivators all over the world had an opportunity to change their fate.
Because of the power of the sects and the deep-seated notion of desiring to control the Ling Domain, many loose cultivators with excellent talents still chose to join the sects and become one of them, viewing it as an opportunity to ascend from the lower class to the upper class.

chapters.title: Chapter 533 - 290: Clash of Talents, Xu Yan's Invincible Path_2
chapters.content:
As for All Ages Alliance, there were no significant developments. In fact, not a single notable warrior was reported to have emerged from it.
However, the names of the top prodigies from the various sects and families in the Spirit Realm began to spread. People started becoming familiar with these names, as the spirit sects laid the groundwork for the imminent clash of prodigies.
Still, the prodigies from the prominent Transcendent Spirit Sect remained unknown.
The names of a few prodigies from its subordinate sects, on the other hand, started to trickle out.
For example, Cai Yunhong, the prodigy from the emerald cloud dynasty, a subordinate of Lei Yun Mountain Manor. He possessed the first of the ten divine power bodies and was a Refining God Heavenly Man.
Yu Changfeng, the current most potent prodigy in the Sword Zhai, a Spirit Sect subordinate to the Thousand Martial Hall, was also a Refining God Heavenly Man.
The Knife, Gun, Fist, the three moiety prodigies—Wu Tu, Lu Yi, Bao Sheng of the Three Moiety Tower, a Spirit Sect subordinate to the Thousand Martial Hall.
The spirit sects were clearly building momentum. Older martial artists seemed to remember similar stirrings from a time when such clashes between prodigies were commonplace. It reminded them of the Age of Martial Arts between the spirit sects.
Barely had the chatter died down when the Prodigy Rankings surfaced. However, the list consisting of the top one thousand prodigies from the Spirit Realm was still empty.
For a prodigy to join this elite list, they had to achieve victory over the other prodigies. Only those who lost despite being in the Refining God Heavenly Man state could partake in the clash of prodigies.
Those below the Refining God Heavenly Man were no longer considered worthy of participating in this grand battle.
The situation in the Spirit Realm changed rapidly. The battle between the All Ages Alliance and the various sects gave rise to an era of continuous conflict amongst the powerful. All of it leading up to the sudden ceasefire and the beginning of the clash of prodigies all transpired in a short span of time.
The unveiling of the clash of prodigies followed by the preparation of the spirit sects and the release of the Prodigy Rankings, all happened in less than half a month.
...
Meanwhile, the news had reached Li Xuan's estate.
Li Xuan couldn't help but sigh. This upcoming competition was being held for Xu Yan and Meng Chong. Even though Xu Yan was only at the pinnacle of the Divine Intent Realm, he was quickly accumulating the necessary foundation to break through to the Divine Origin Realm.
Meng Chong's defense was unparalleled because of his physical martial arts. It would be very difficult for any prodigy in the Spirit Realm to hurt him.
Apart from that, during the clash, he would undoubtedly rapidly increase his strength and break through the second level of the Indestructible Golden Body.
Fang Hao's strength wasn't inferior either. He didn't have any issues battling with a Refining God Heavenly Man. Once he executed his unique Earthly Door Formation, these prodigies from the Spirit Realm were going to be dumbfounded.
"If Su Lingxiu also participated, my apprentices would undoubtedly occupy the top four spots in the Prodigy Rankings," Li Xuan chuckled to himself.
According to the rules of the clash of prodigies, the weak couldn't be bullied. Powerful Protectors or factions were not allowed to interfere or intervene. It remained to be seen whether the spirit sects would adhere to these rules.
However, the fact that the Transcendent Spirit Sect agreed to the clash of prodigies, to an extent, indicates that there must be some reasons behind their decision.
Xu Yan and others were excited. They were already preparing to challenge the prodigies of the Spirit Realm, and suddenly the Prodigy Rankings appeared.
"The Three Moiety Tower, a top-ranking spirit sect subordinate to the Thousand Military Hall, is perfect for honing my knife skills. I want to meet Wu Tu, the knife prodigy, and Bao Sheng, the fist prodigy," Meng Chong said excitedly, rubbing his head.
"Sword Zhai is also a sect subordinate to the Thousand Martial Hall. The sword prodigy, Yu Changfeng, will be my first challenger," Xu Yan declared, choosing his target with excitement spread all over his face.
He was impatient to challenge Yu Changfeng and show Sword Zhai what true sword dao meant!
At the critical moment of his creation of a mysterious soldier box, Fang Hao's mysterious soldier box burst into light.
With a bang, Fang Hao injected a few drops of his essence blood into the soldier box. On the outside of the soldier box, a pattern that echoed the heavenly pattern inside his body was engraved.
"Return!"
The mysterious soldier box shrunk instantly as Fang Hao pointed his finger in excitement, morphing into a ray of light that entered his body.
"A success!" Fang Hao exclaimed with an excited expression.
To refine this mysterious soldier box, it had taken him a lot of time and energy. Moreover, it had also consumed many treasures from the jade god sect and the Su family.
Especially some rare materials, almost all had been used up.
Yet it was worth it.
Both Moon Changming and Yue'er were stunned. What kind of method was this? What kind of spiritual artifact was being refined?
One that could be absorbed into the body?
"Old man Yue, now that you're the elder of our Yuzhou Alliance, just tell me whatever weapon you need," Fang Hao chuckled, looking at Moon Changming.
With Moon Changming by his side, his status, even in the overall Alliance, was highly esteemed.
"Thank you, Hegemon!" Moon Changming secretly excited, replied, "I used to use a crescent blade, which was destroyed a while back. I'd like a new crescent blade. Please."
He described the appearance of the crescent blade.
"No problem," Fang Hao nodded. Creating a pair of new crescent blades wouldn't be difficult for him as they would be of a far superior grade than the original ones.
The power is even more formidable, and can no longer be measured by the spiritual artifacts of the Spirit Realm.
After all, the spiritual artifacts crafted by Fang Hao are far from comparable to the so-called spiritual artifacts in the Spirit Realm.
"I want one, too! I want one, too!"
Yue'er said excitedly.
She took out a bunch of artifact refining materials from her storage pouch and said, "I have these for refining."
"No problem!"
Fang Hao nodded his head.
Yue'er wanted to refine a whip and a pair of half-moon blades.
Fang Hao agreed without hesitation and immediately began the refining process.
Red Cat, Yu Xiaolong, and Little Ha all gathered around.
…
Li Xuan held the Jade Ruyi in his hand, casually walking with it placed on his back, he confidently ascended a mountain adjacent to the manor.
Xu Yan closely followed by his side.
The disciple was about to traverse the Spirit Realm, challenge the Spirit Realm's prodigies, and ascend to the summit of the Spirit Realm.
But for Xu Yan, he was not only going to challenge the prodigies of the Spirit Realm but also the powerful entities of the Spirit Realm - including even the strongest of them all!
His journey towards invincibility was about to begin.
That's why Li Xuan was about to pass on to Xu Yan the realm that exists above the Divine Skill Realm. This would give him a chance to comprehend it while he embarked on his journey towards invincibility.
"The Physiognomy Realm involves controlling the laws of heaven and earth. It's the Divine Appearance in martial arts. Above the Physiognomy Realm, one cannot transcend heaven and earth. But one can go further, free from the constraints of heaven and earth.
"And this constraint is the space of heaven and earth. It's about breaking the space, traversing the void without being bound by the laws, and breaking through the laws.
"This is the beginning of transcendence. It signifies liberation from the laws of heaven and earth."
After some days of contemplation, Li Xuan had finally figured out the realm above the Physiognomy Realm.
In the Physiognomy realm, the laws of martial arts are embodied in the Divine Appearance and the laws of heaven and earth are manipulated. Above the Physiognomy realm, one no longer submits to the constraints of heaven and earth's space, breaks through the law of heaven and earth, and won't be stopped by the laws.
Shattering the space, traversing the void, transcending the laws of heaven and earth, unbound and free!
To transcend beyond heaven and earth, to advance further!
Above the Physiognomy Realm lies the Void-breaking Realm!
Shattering heaven and earth's space, traversing the void, and resisting the resistance of the laws of heaven and earth.
Although the Void-breaking Realm hadn't achieved transcendence beyond heaven and earth, it had already gone beyond the laws of heaven and earth, unbounded by the physical space, and wasn't far from true transcendence in a real sense.
Of course, it's not easy to break through to the Void-breaking Realm.
Li Xuan looked at the information about the Void-breaking Realm given in the Daoist Golden Book.
Void-breaking Martial Way:
Cultivation Technique Completeness: Moderate.
Realm Connection Degree: Above average.
Comprehension Difficulty: High.
Cultivation Difficulty: High+.
Looking at the cultivation difficulty given by the Daoist Golden Book, one can tell how tough it is to cultivate the Void-breaking Realm. It's about breaking the space and traversing the void.
Ignoring the laws of heaven and earth, breaking the shackles of physical space.
However, Li Xuan had faith in Xu Yan.
Although the cultivation difficulty is high, as long as he comprehends it, he should be able to receive feedback from the Daoist Golden Book and break through to the Void-breaking Realm.
As for Xu Yan, once he comprehends he can practice it. It's just a matter of time.
"What to cultivate after reaching the Void-breaking Realm, there's no clear idea at the moment, and it's not possible to surpass too many. When the martial realm is upgraded, the subsequent martial realm is easier to create.
"For now, just pass on the Physiognomy Realm and the Void-breaking Realm. Hoping Xu Yan will be able to comprehend it before vying for supremacy among the prodigies and cresting the Summit of Spirit Realm."
Li Xuan thought to himself.
He had already created the subsequent martial arts for Xu Yan to practice, but he hadn't yet completed the post-cultivation practice for Meng Chong's physical martial arts, and the cultivation above the Indestructible Golden Body of the big day.
He could only delay it for now. Anyway, Meng Chong was still far from perfecting the three layers of the Indestructible Golden Body of the big day.
He had plenty of time to slowly ponder over the follow-up cultivation issues of the physical martial arts.
"Disciple, you can't wait anymore, you're eager to meet the Spirit Realm's prodigies, aren't you?"
Li Xuan said with a light laugh.
"Yes, Master!"
Xu Yan said enthusiastically.

chapters.title: Chapter 534 - 291: Divine Skills, Jade Talisman, Each On Their Own Path_1
chapters.content:
Li Xuan looked relaxed, smiled, and said, "The struggle of geniuses is to traverse the world of Ling Domain, meeting the world's strong warriors and tempering your own in battles of Martial Arts. This is your invincible path.
"Combat in Martial Arts helps you easily understand and accumulate your own strength.
"Since you have understood the subtlety of Divine Skills, master will teach you the Laws of Martial Arts, which are superior to the Divine Skills, today."
Hearing this, Xu Yan's excitement was uncontainable.
"Master, I will definitely comprehend the law of Martial Arts during the strife of the geniuses, in the battles of Martial Arts."
Li Xuan beamed, "My apprentice has such confidence, which makes me very pleased. But, don't obsess too much. By moving forward step by step, you can eventually reach the peak."
"Yes, Master!"
Xu Yan nodded.
Li Xuan had no doubts about Xu Yan, his favorite disciple. Xu Yan possesses exceptional understanding, a prodigious mind, a measured temperament, and considerable proficiency in Martial Arts.
"The Divine Skill Realm represents the individual's law of Martial Arts. Above Divine Skills is the power to utilize laws of Heaven and Earth for one's own benefit, and not be restricted by the laws of Heaven and Earth.
"How can those who have transcended the world be bound by the laws of Heaven and Earth, or be inferior to them? Therefore, use the laws and do not be restricted by them."
Li Xuan solemnly uttered each word.
Xu Yan was stunned, "Master has indeed transcended Heaven and Earth!"
With his master's mere wave of a finger, Heaven and Earth would tremble. Thus, his master concealed his realm, behaving like an ordinary person, rarely exerted his power, and only fought against opponents of the same realm when he did.
So, is the end of Martial Arts path about transcending Heaven and Earth?!
"No, Master said, the Martial Path is endless. Transcending Heaven and Earth is not the ultimate goal of Martial Arts!"
Xu Yan thought with thrilling aspiration.
"I will set a goal to transcend Heaven and Earth within a hundred years!"
At this moment, Xu Yan set his Martial Arts goal.
Within a hundred years, transcending Heaven and Earth!
Li Xuan continue to speak: "Above Divine Skills, is the Physiognomy realm. With the individual's law, control the Laws of Heaven and Earth and transform it into the Divine Appearance of Martial Arts…"
Word by word, he detailed the Martial Law of the Physiognomy realm that he had constructed to Xu Yan. Naturally, this included the diagrams of laws of Heaven and Earth that he had collected, integrated, and painted.
Without these diagrams of laws of Heaven and Earth, it would be too difficult to practice the Divine Appearance of Martial Arts. But with this diagram, it would be like understanding the loopholes in Heaven and Earth laws. You could integrate your own Martial Laws and control the laws of Heaven and Earth.
This is something that requires a matching understanding. Once Xu Yan comprehends it, practicing the Physiognomy realm will become easier.
Xu Yan wrote down the law of the Physiognomy realm including the diagram of the law of Heaven and Earth. Because it was not his first time studying the diagrams of the law of Heaven and Earth, he took some time and eventually remembered the diagram.
To make it easier for Xu Yan to learn the law of Heaven and Earth, Li Xuan carefully selected and simplified the law of Heaven and Earth in this diagram.
With Xu Yan's talent, it wasn't too difficult for him to learn this with a bit of time.
While Xu Yan was carefully studying the law of the Physiognomy realm, Li Xuan waited silently, without continuing to transmit the Void-breaking Martial Way.
He would wait until Xu Yan had completely memorized and gained some understanding of the Physiognomy technique before transmitting the law of the Void-breaking realm.
"Master, I have etched it into my heart."
Finally, Xu Yan opened his eyes and said respectfully.
"Well, very good!"
Li Xuan's face was filled with satisfaction.
"Since you have memorized the laws of the Physiognomy realm, your master will now pass on to you the laws of Martial Arts that are above the Physiognomy realm."
Li Xuan continued.
"Yes, master!"
Xu Yan was thrilled.
The Physiognomy realm is already so powerful, manipulating the laws of Heaven and Earth for one's own benefit. Above the Physiognomy realm, does one already begin to transcend Heaven and Earth?
"Above the Physiognomy realm, is the Void-Breaking realm, which breaks and crosses the void..."
Li Xuan explained the strength that the Void-Breaking realm possesses.
Breaking the space and crossing the void.
Xu Yan was profoundly shocked. Upon stepping into the Void-Breaking realm, if he took one step, he would start traversing space, crossing the void, tens of thousands of miles, hundreds of thousands of miles, millions of miles in an instant...
Although he hadn't transcended Heaven and Earth yet, he could already ignore the space and laws of Heaven and Earth. It can be said that reaching this realm, he could do as he pleased within the space of Heaven and Earth.
"To shatter space and perforate the Laws of Heaven and Earth, one needs immense strength. This depends on one's own Martial Laws..."
Li Xuan began to transmit the laws of the Void-Breaking realm.
Using one's own Martial Laws to break Heaven and Earth's laws, and travel through the void of Heaven and Earth, is what the Void-Breaking realm entails. Hence the emphasis of the Void-Breaking realm is on strengthening one's own Martial Laws.
Conveying the laws of the Void-breaking realm to Xu Yan in detail. Since this realm was a strong one, Li Xuan was worried about Xu Yan's potential omissions and took the unusual step of explaining it again.
Xu Yan was immersed in the power of the Void-Breaking realm, as if a scene had already emerged in his mind.
With one step, the space of Heaven and Earth cracked open; his figure disappeared between Heaven and Earth, and he stepped out from a distant space in the next step.
Even a palm can cause a golden giant dragon to penetrate space; the next moment, it roars out of the void, across the vast void, to kill the enemy.
The more he thought about it, the more excited he became, and his blood started boiling.
The Void-Breaking realm was simply too strong.
Once stepping into the Void-Breaking realm, if he wants to return to the Inner Domain, or comes from the Inner Domain to Ling Domain, there is no need to go through the Gate of Ling Domain. He can directly traverse the spatial void.
"Master, I remember!"
Xu Yan restrained his excitement and responded respectfully.
"Hmm!"
Li Xuan nodded, looking extremely satisfied.
Having taught the Martial Arts law, Li Xuan turned and left, allowing Xu Yan to further comprehend and digest the knowledge without interruption.

chapters.title: Chapter 535 - 291: Divine Skills, Jade Talisman, Each On Their Own Path_2
chapters.content:
"The great cause of my martial arts depends on you."
Li Xuan thought expectantly.
"If I were to reach the Void-breaking Realm, how powerful would I be."
Li Xuan was secretly excited.
How powerful must the Void-breaking Realm be, given that the Divine Skill Realm was already incredibly strong?
Although he invented the realms, he found it hard to imagine the powerful scene of the Void-breaking Realm.
After all, how the final strength of the Void-breaking Realm turns out, depends on how Xu Yan comprehends and perceives it.
"What would be the power of Divine Skill in the Void-breaking Realm?"
Li Xuan wondered, if he were to reach the Void-breaking Realm, if executing the Law of Heaven and Earth would directly shatter the space around him and stand in the nothingness?
He couldn't imagine the terrifying strength that would require.
…
Xu Yan had not yet embarked on the undefeated path, but the first ranked genius in the spirit realm list had appeared.
Yu Changfeng of Sword Dao.
He killed a genius of the Refining God Heavenly Man realm in Luo State Alliance, declaring a challenge to the loose cultivators, stating that if they could withstand his ten undefeated moves, they could be considered as geniuses.
If not, they are all trash!
The man was wild and obviously very strong.
After Yu Changfeng made his move, Wu Tu of the Three Unbeatable Tower also took action, challenging the genius of All Ages Alliance and defeating his opponent convincingly.
The momentum of Spirit Sect soared instantly, and voices deriding the independent genius cultivators were endless.
The Battle of Geniuses had officially begun.
However, the genius of the Transcendent Spirit Sect had not yet descended from the mountain or even had his name announced.
Everyone knew that the top geniuses of the Transcendent Spirit Sect were all Spiritual Bodies!
Only those with spiritual body talents could be listed among the top geniuses of the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
The Spiritual Realm Martial Way World was bustling, but Yuzhou remained calm.
Huang Liang's death seemed to have not caused too much of a ripple; in the eyes of the Thousand Martial Hall, Huang Liang was killed by a powerful figure from the All Ages Alliance, and there was no subsequent revenge from an equally powerful individual to Yuzhou.
On this day, Xu Yan was going to challenge the genius of the spirit realm to prepare for his breakthrough to the Divine Origin Realm.
Meng Chong was doing the same.
"Although the Battle of Geniuses has rules, there are many shameless people in the world who are arrogant especially within the Spirit Sect. Though I will not take action, I can provide you with some protection."
Li Xuan said to his disciples standing in front of him.
With a wave of his hand, four Jade Talismans appeared.
"Each Jade Talisman contains a divine skill power, similar to the power I used to kill Huang Liang. Once you absorb them, they can naturally protect you in life threatening situations.
"Remember, don't be arrogant and reckless because you have my Divine Skill Jade Talisman. Martial Artists are not brutes, I have already taught you this many times."
The Divine Skill Jade Talisman was the protection Li Xuan provided for his disciples to travel through the Spirit Realm.
"Yes, Master!"
Xu Yan and the others replied respectfully.
Taking the Jade Talisman and absorbing it, Xu Yan respectfully said, "Master, rest assured, I will defeat all the geniuses of the Spirit Realm and reach the summit of the Spirit Realm in this journey.
"I will step on the Thousand Martial Hall and use them as stepping stones."
Xu Yan, who had perfected his Divine Intent State, was full of confidence. His first target was Yu Changfeng from Sword Dao!
He wanted the Spiritual Realm Martial Way World to know that among all sword dao practitioners, he, Sword God Xu Yan, is the most respected!
"Master, I will also let the Spiritual Realm Martial Way World see what is bodily Martial Arts, what is the Dao of the Blade!"
Meng Chong patted his chest and said.
"Master, just watch, I will be the top of All Age Alliance, the position of the Alliance Hierarch must be mine. I will lead All Ages Alliance, to rise above the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
"I will truly break the dominance of the Spirit Sect and let the world see the martial arts of strange doors!"
Fang Hao, with a respectful expression, said, his eyes burning with ambition.
"I, I will stay with Master!"
Su Lingxiu's eyes glittered, she smilingly said.
"Meow!"
At this time, the Red Cat jumped out.
It wrote with its paws on the ground.
"The beast clan is too useless, they lack a true king. I, Red Cat, will lead them to rise and become the king of the spiritual domain's great monsters. I want to go to Heavenly Mausoleum State!"
After writing out the words, the Red Cat rubbed its head against Li Xuan's ankle, making a cute meow sound.
Li Xuan's mouth twitched, he raised his hand and hit the Red Cat's head with Jade Ruyi and said, "You are a tiger, not a cat."
The Red Cat stopped meowing and emitted a deep tiger roar instead.
"Alright, if you have such ambition, then go."
The Red Cat's strength was not enough to be a king, but it was good to go out and wander, as its growth would be faster.
Additionally, passing on the technique of the great monsters to the spirit realm was also a good thing, as long as they practice the technique of the great monsters, they would be under his control, allowing him to command all the great monsters at any time.
He also gave a Divine Skill Jade Talisman for protection to the Red Cat.
The Red Cat was overjoyed, while Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha kept looking pitifully at Xu Yan, one croaked softly in front of Fang Hao.
Li Xuan's mouth twitched. These three pets have all become too cunning.
Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha seemed to have picked up some bad habits from Red Cat.
He casually threw out two Divine Skill Jade Talismans and waved his hand, saying, "Go ahead!"
Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha were overjoyed. After respectfully kowtowing, they ran behind Red Cat, appearing as if they were ready to follow a great leader.
"Meow, meow!"
Red Cat ran to Su Lingxiu to act cute in a bid to get spiritual medicine.
For the sake of the medicine...
"Red Cat's ambition is commendable, a good thing indeed. Here you go."
Su Lingxiu waved her hand and handed Red Cat a Storage Ring.
The mansion's formation was packed up.
"Little brother, where are you going?"
Xu Yan asked Meng Chong.
"I'm going to find Wu Tu from San Jue Tower. I'd like to see how competent his knife skills are."
Meng Chong let out a sinister grin.
"I'm off to find Yu Changfeng."
Xu Yan nodded, took a step forward, and vanished within the mansion.
Meng Chong also soared into the air and disappeared in a blink of an eye.
Fang Hao, accompanied by Moon Changming, headed to the headquarters of the Yu Zhou Alliance in Zhou to officially announce his position as the Alliance Hierarch and participate in the struggle for supremacy among the geniuses.
Red Cat, along with Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha, also swiftly departed.
Since they entered the Spirit Realm, they were finally, on this day, heading towards their individual futures, walking their own paths.
Yue'er didn't follow her grandfather, but stayed with Su Lingxiu.
Li Xuan felt some emotions welling up within him. His disciples were finally walking their own paths. Even Red Cat, once a pet, now had ambitious dreams.
Of the four apprentices, only Su Lingxiu was left by his side.
"Master, will we continue to live here?"
Su Lingxiu asked, blinking her eyes.
She wanted to leave – she didn't want to continue living in seclusion in the mansion.
"You want to practice medicine, right? Then let's go to Luo State. After the big battle, there are many injured people there – more than enough for you to build up your martial arts skills."
Li Xuan smiled and spoke.
The Spirit Realm is so vast, they should travel and explore it a bit.
"Yes, Master!"
Su Lingxiu was overjoyed, ready to start packing.
Shi'er, Zhou Ying, and Meng Shushu were all feeling a bit depressed. They were too weak to venture outside – they could die at any moment.
"When will we finally break through to the Divine Intent state?"
Meng Shushu sighed.
Even if they broke through to the Divine Intent state, they would not have the strength to navigate the Spirit Realm. After all, they were not Xu Yan or Meng Chong, and did not possess such formidable power.
Yue'er was also very excited. She and Su Lingxiu had become good girlfriends and Yue'er was also learning medical arts, eager to assist Su Lingxiu.
Moreover, she was not weak.
In the early stage of being a Refining God Heavenly Man, she could defeat a typical person at the middle stage and even withstand a common Refining God Heavenly Man at the late stage.
After all, she was gifted with a spiritual body.
Li Xuan suddenly regretted letting Red Cat go. He was short of a mount now!
"Master, without Red Cat, what will we do?"
Su Lingxiu also thought of this problem.
Without Red Cat, the Master lacked a mount.
"Forget it, let's just walk."
Li Xuan sighed and with a helpless expression, packed up his chair, toyed with the Jade Ruyi in his hand, and sauntered off.
Su Lingxiu and Yue'er followed closely behind.
Shi'er, Zhou Ying, and Meng Shushu followed at a steady pace, feeling utterly helpless. They were weak, slow, and needed to be taken care of.
Being weak was a terrible feeling.
They missed Red Cat, too. If Red Cat had been there, they wouldn't be facing these problems.
Outside Zheng's imperial city, the mansion was deserted. It was not until three days later that Emperor Zheng cautiously entered. After confirming that no one was there, he breathed a sigh of relief.
After all, living next to a formidable existence akin to a divine demon made him fret each day, afraid disaster would strike at any moment!
Now that the person had left, his heart finally settled down.
In Yuzhou, Li Xuan and his group strolled leisurely, enjoying the landscape of the Spirit Realm as they travelled. Occasionally, Su Lingxiu would pick any spiritual medicine they came across.
