When they stumbled upon a big city, they would enter and tour around. The hot topic among martial artists was the genius competition, and everyone was focusing on the Spirit Sect's geniuses. They didn't have much hope for the All Ages Alliance.
Since they had to look after Shi'er and the others, their progress wasn't fast. They were far from reaching Luo State, when one day, a spiritual beast flew across the sky.
Li Xuan looked up and revealed a smile. He had found a mount!

chapters.title: Chapter 536 - 292: Zhu Xingzheng Selling Spiritual Beasts_1
chapters.content:
Across the sky strode a magical Golden Horned Purple Star deer glowing in a majestic aura. It seemed to be draped in a layer of purple light. On its back sat a young man.
Fair, slightly chubby, with an innocent smile on his face.
Riding his magical creature, Zhu Xingzheng muttered to himself, "Yuzhou Alliance is too weak! That guy, Yu Gao, is a waste. I can't believe the main Alliance has sent me to Yuzhou to intimidate its geniuses.
"What sort of genius would come out of this backwater place, Yuzhou? My real nemesis is Cui Huayu.
"The old guys in the main Alliance don't even know who the real genius is. I, Zhu Xingzheng, will surely make it to the list of geniuses! Sending me to Yuzhou was a totally blind decision."
Though his face wore a silly grin, Zhu Xingzheng was secretly bad mouthing and complaining about the old guys from the main Alliance.
Suddenly!
Zhu Xingzheng noticed someone waving at him from the ground below.
Was this person oblivious to the fact that he was riding a sixth-order magical creature and still dared to wave?
"Hey, those two girls are quite stunning. Maybe they are in some sort of trouble. I should go help them," Zhu Xingzheng thought.
Zhu Xingzheng riding the Golden Horned Purple Star deer came up to Li Xuan's group.
He eagerly dismounted and trotted over to Su Lingxiu and Yue'er, his innocent smile ever radiant, "Ladies, are you having any trouble?"
Su Lingxiu and Yue'er just looked at him in disbelief.
He looked too innocent to be playing any tricks. Moreover, his overly friendly demeanor didn't suggest any ill intentions.
Li Xuan had already circled the Golden Horned Purple Star deer. The more he looked at it, the more satisfied he became. This deer with its golden horn, decorated with purple spots, glowing with a faint purple light.
It was a sixth-order magical creature fit enough for him to ride without tarnishing his world-renowned expert status.
"Hey, chubby boy, how much for this magical creature?"
Li Xuan pulled Zhu Xingzheng away from his disciples whom he was trying to court.
"Not for sale!"
Zhu Xingzheng immediately became cautious.
"This is a magical beast that I trained with hard work. Don't even think about it, I won't sell it for any amount of Spirit Crystals!"
Zhu Xingzheng loudly declared as he guarded his deer.
"Chubby boy, just name a price. My Master needs a mount," spoke Su Lingxiu.
Her master was a high person and would never resort to intimidating tactics or snatching things by force, as it would be beneath him.
Therefore, buying it was the best course of action.
As for whether they could afford it, of course they could.
"Yeah, name a price, chubby boy," Yue'er chimed in.
Zhu Xingzheng looked at Li Xuan. He was these girls' Master?
Now he was torn. His round face twisted in turmoil. "It isn't that I don't want to sell. Girls, what you don't know is Little Jin has been with me for ten years.
"Ten years! Even if it were a mosquito, there would be affection.
"How could I sell him? Spirit Crystals are not the issue here..."
Su Lingxiu took out a bottle of elixir. "This is a bottle of potion, made from precious Spiritual Medicines like the Earth Spirit Flower. The effects of this medicine…."
After explaining the effects of the medicine, she asked, "So, will you sell it?"
"Elixir, is it really that magical?"
Zhu Xingzheng was skeptical.
"Try it and you'll know," Su Lingxiu threw a pill to him.
Zhu Xingzheng examined the pill. His face grew serious. He felt that this pill was no ordinary thing, seemingly containing miraculous effects.
Decisively, he threw the pill into his deer's mouth, "Little Jin, eat quickly. Don't waste it!"
Li Xuan, who was watching, found this funny. This chubby boy was quite amusing.
Su Lingxiu's expression darkened slightly. This jerk was afraid the pill might be poisonous. He talked about his deep bond with his magical creature, but, without hesitation, used it to test the medicine.
After the Golden Horned Purple Star Deer had swallowed the pill, its Divine Soul suddenly became more active. "Delicious! Delicious! My divine soul feels nourished and elevated!"
The purple spots on its body gleamed brighter.
Seeing this, Zhu Xingzheng's eyes immediately lit up. Was the pill indeed magical?
His eyes lingered on the pill bottle in Su Lingxiu's hand, and he couldn't help but desire it. "Miss, this one bottle of medicine, it's... a little too few, isn't it? My magical creature is a sixth-order beast. Look at its skin color, its body shape; how awe-inspiring it is to ride! How prestigious!"
Su Lingxiu couldn't help but laugh, "There are twelve pills in a bottle, it's not less. These are quite rare. Even with Spiritual Medicine, it would take several years to refine only a few…"
Hearing this, Zhu Xingzheng felt it made sense. With such miraculous effects, the elixir certainly wasn't easy to make. Twelve Elixirs in a bottle should be enough to make his Divine Soul stronger, maybe even break through a minor realm?
"Alright, deal!"
Zhu Xingzheng immediately agreed.
Having obtained the elixirs, Zhu Xingzheng was ecstatic. The Golden Horned Purple Star deer, on the other hand, was dumbfounded. Its Divine Soul fluctuated violently as it wailed, "You sold me just like that? I've followed you for ten years. Ten years!"
It stomped its hooves on the ground angrily, apparently maddened and unsatisfied, feeling like it was betrayed.
Li Xuan was rendered speechless.
Zhu Xingzheng placed his palms on the deer's head, his face serious. "Little Jin, I'm doing this for your own good. How could you say I'm selling you? I'm letting you lead a better life!"
The Golden Horned Purple Star deer Divine Soul fluctuated violently, bellowing, "Did you sell my father too? Is that why you lied to me, told me he left seeking good fortune, when in fact he was sold by you, was that it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 537 - 292: Zhu Xingzheng Selling Spiritual Beasts_2
chapters.content:
There was a type of rage born of betrayal.
"I initially thought you generously let my father go for his sake, and I was so grateful to you. I never expected you to sell me out!"
The golden-horned deer bellowed, stamping its hooves, its purple glow becoming increasingly dazzling.
Li Xuan and the others all looked at Zhu Xingzheng with strange expressions.
"Little Jin, listen to me, don't get angry!"
Zhu Xingzheng stroked the golden-horned deer's head, and said earnestly: "I really meant well for you. You see, is this pill not magical? Will you not also get to eat such pills if you follow this beautiful lady's master?
"With these pills, your power will increase, perhaps even to rank above a sixth-level spirit beast, right?"
"What can I give you if you follow me?"
"Rather than making you endure hardship with me, why not follow this beautiful lady? You doubt my good intentions after all that I've done?"
"I, Zhu Xingzheng, treated you like a brother. If it wasn't for your betterment, would I have half-sold, half-given you to this lady?"
The golden-horned deer widened its eyes. Zhu Xingzheng's words seemed to make sense, but something felt not quite right.
"What about my father?"
The golden-horned deer thought of its old father. Originally, Zhu Xingzheng had said there was a grand opportunity and let his father go.
"Know a supremely strong person? A supremely strong person lacking a companion, I arranged for your father to be by his side. Isn't this not a great opportunity?"
Zhu Xingzheng squeezed out a few tears, wiping them away and said: "When I separated from your father, I held him and cried for a long time. Little Jin, you've misunderstood me so much!"
The golden-horned deer stumbled, feeling somewhat ashamed. Bowing its head, it said, "I'm sorry, I misunderstood you!"
The more it thought, the more reasonable it seemed. Being able to be at the side of a supremely strong person was indeed an opportunity.
"Little Jin, you must follow this lady well, be diligent, and there will definitely be pills. You definitely have a chance to become a superior sixth-level spirit beast."
Zhu Xingzheng heaved a sigh of relief in his heart. After soothing the golden-horned deer, he was incredibly excited.
Another spirit beast was sold, earning even more this time!
In his view, how could such a precious pill be randomly given to a mount to consume? It was just a ploy to fool the golden-horned deer.
"Miss, I'm leaving Little Jin to you. This is its command symbol!"
Zhu Xingzheng was secretly overjoyed. He took out a green command token from his storage bag, imprinted with a strand of the golden-horned deer's Divine Soul aura.
This was a command symbol, which could forcibly restrain its Divine Soul and compel obedience in the event the golden-horned deer lost control.
Generally speaking, to master a spirit beast, one must either raise it from a young age until the spirit beast willingly recognizes its master, or conquer it by force and forge a command symbol to control the spirit beast.
Zhu Xingzheng took the third path, using deception…
Li Xuan beckoned and took the golden-horned deer's command symbol. A glance told him that it was crudely made and did not have much control over the spirit beast.
However, Ling Domain's spirit beasts couldn't cultivate themselves and grew solely by bloodline. Once they were ensnared by a command symbol enclosing a strand of Divine Soul, they would be controlled and unable to break free.
Those below the sixth level, who have not yet condensed their Divine Soul, had a strand of their spirit consciousness captured and incorporated into the command symbol.
The command symbol controlled the spirit beast purely by virtue of a certain special material within that could contain the spirit beast's spirit consciousness or Divine Soul, not by refining techniques.
Such a command symbol had no control over creatures like the Red Cat.
However, it did have some restraint on the spirit beasts of the Ling Domain.
While Li Xuan was fiddling with the command symbol, Zhu Xingzheng continued to flatter Su Lingxiu and Yue'er, and also tamed the golden-horned deer. He proudly taught the deer how to please its new master and earn a pill reward...
Under his guidance, the golden-horned deer became eager to please, gazing fondly and sticking its tongue out, showing a pleasing color.
"Miss, may I ask your name, please?"
Zhu Xingzheng asked with a simple smile.
"Su Lingxiu."
"Yue'er."
Zhu Xingzheng was overjoyed. He took out a rein, put it on the golden-horned deer, handed the rein to Su Lingxiu and said happily: "So it's Miss Su and Miss Yue'er. I am Zhu Xingzheng, the upright and just Zhu Xingzheng."
The golden-horned deer was a bit dumbfounded - why was there a rein on it now? It stared at Zhu Xingzheng, suspecting it had been deceived!
"Where are the two ladies going? The Ling Domain is not peaceful right now. Little Jin has a temper, so please bear with him.
"Miss, take this whip."
Zhu Xingzheng pulled out another whip and handed it to Su Lingxiu.
Then, he kicked at the Golden Horn Deer's leg, saying, "What are you standing there for? Quickly transform to a larger size. How are you going to carry people when you're so small? Be smart, don't be so dumb."
The Golden Horn Deer snorted heavily. Zhu Xingzheng patted its head and angrily said, "How will someone give you a pill in this condition? I am doing this for your own good, do you understand?"
Under Zhu Xingzheng's smooth talking, the Golden Horn Deer ceased being angry and seemed to find his words reasonable. If it didn't please its new master, how would it get any pills?
Li Xuan sighed inwardly, Zhu Xingzheng really had a way with handling spiritual beasts.
It made him wonder, were all the spiritual beasts in Heavenly Mausoleum State so naive and easily duped?
If that was the case, wouldn't they all have been tricked by the Red Cat once it arrived?
The Red Cat was no kind tiger.
As the Golden Horn Deer's body grew larger, Li Xuan placed a chair on its back. Finally, he got a mount, making the journey ahead more comfortable.
Shi'er, Zhou Ying, and Meng Shushu also sighed with relief. They no longer had to push themselves to keep moving. Being free of the burden of traveling on foot, they also climbed onto the back of the Golden Horn Deer and sat down.
"Elder, you are quite at leisure!"
Zhu Xingzheng hadn't left. He respectfully and obligingly poured tea and water for Li Xuan, addressing him as 'elder' very enthusiastically.
"Zhu Xingzheng, go about your own business. You're not needed here!"
Su Lingxiu ordered.
"I have nothing else to do, miss. You don't know the situation, this Ling Domain is not safe. With me around, I can handle many dangers. Also, I have a deep connection with Little Jin, it's about to leave me, shouldn't I at least see it off?"
Zhu Xingzheng was very shameless.
Su Lingxiu just rolled her eyes, too lazy to deal with him.
The Golden Horn Deer leapt into the sky, heading toward Luo State. Zhu Xingzheng integrated himself into the group, showing no intention of leaving.
His so-called reason was his deep connection with the Golden Horn Deer and his intention to see it off…
As for the task assigned by the All Ages Alliance, he had long since tossed it to the back of his mind.
The small place like Yuzhou, held no appeal for him.
"Fatty, you're one of the prodigies of the All Ages Alliance, right?"
Li Xuan asked with a smile.
"Yes, yes!"
Zhu Xingzheng nodded, "Elder, which loose cultivator are you?"
In his view, Su Lingxiu and Yue'er were not particularly strong; their master must be a Refining God Heavenly Man, who wouldn't be weaker than him.
After all, he couldn't see through them.
As for Shi'er and the others, their strength was even worse; they looked like followers.
Little did he know that Su Lingxiu and Yue'er had concealed their own strength, which was why he wasn't able to perceive it.
Li Xuan just smiled and didn't respond, but instead asked: "In the All Ages Alliance, how many prodigies like you are there?"
"Not many. After all, I, Zhu Xingzheng have extraordinary talent. I can easily go into the mountains of Heavenly Mausoleum State and coax a spiritual beast to fight for me.
"Those fellows of the Yu Ling Mansion like using spiritual beasts to help them, thinking it's a matter of course. I, Zhu Xingzheng, can do the same.
"If we're talking about the strongest in the All Ages Alliance, there are only those two. They're in the late stage of Refining God, their strength is outrageously strong, especially that cold little woman…"
Zhu Xingzheng apparently didn't know why he felt like spilling everything he knew.
He introduced all the prodigies of the All Ages Alliance, including their numbers and strengths.
Among them, two had the strongest abilities, reaching the late stage of Refining God before the age of thirty.
Those two had even claimed that they would occupy the top two positions on the Prodigy Ranking. The competition for the first place could only happen between them!
Li Xuan nodded frequently. The All Ages Alliance indeed had some capabilities, as they housed such strong prodigies.
As for the top two spots on the Prodigy Ranking, they could forget about it. The first and second place were reserved for Xu Yan and Meng Chong.
If Su Lingxiu also participated, the top four spots would be occupied by his own disciples.
When Li Xuan and his group entered Luo State, Xu Yan was already on his way to challenge Yu Changfeng of the Sword Pavilion.

chapters.title: Chapter 538 - 293: Sword God Xu Yan, Here to Challenge the Spirit Sect's Genius_1
chapters.content:
The major conflicts in Luo State have been quelled, but the tumult remains.
The Luo State Alliance has suffered huge losses and is in the process of rebuilding. With the support of Chang Daniu, the strongest fighter, many Loose Cultivators are joining the Luo State Alliance.
However, the Luo State Alliance strictly screens these Loose Cultivators to avoid potential betrayals.
The majority of those recruited into the alliance bear deep grudges against the Spirit Sect's noble families.
But the freshly reassembled Luo State Alliance, which hasn't yet regained its vigor, has once again taken a hit.
Yu Changfeng, the pride of Jian Zhai, with his formidable sword-fighting skills, killed the Luo State Alliance's top martial artist. Not only that, but Yu Changfeng also swept through all the Loose Cultivator warriors in Luo State under the age of thirty.
In such a short period of time, he killed dozens of Loose Cultivators.
Moreover, without exception, all these murdered Loose Cultivators were gifted individuals.
The Luo State Alliance was helpless.
This situation dealt a heavy blow to the Alliance's morale. The backbone that the Loose Cultivators just managed to straighten seemed to droop once again.
"I knew it, how can the Loose Cultivators fight against the Spirit Sect?"
"The gifted warriors in our eyes are just trash in the eyes of the Spirit Sect."
"Yes, better to keep our heads down and don't offend the Spirit Sect."
"The All Ages Alliance seems strong, but that's all they are. The Spirit Sect hasn't even started showing its true power."
Statements filled with despair, self-mockery, and contempt spread among the Loose Cultivators in Luo State.
At the headquarters of the Luo State Alliance.
Now that the All Ages Alliance is apparent, there is no need to hide anything, and the location of the Luo State Alliance headquarters is already known to warriors.
"I, Yu Changfeng of Jian Zhai, am here to challenge the top warrior of the All Ages Alliance in Luo State. I wonder who will fight me?"
Yu Changfeng's voice echoed in every corner.
A group of bystanders, including many warriors from the Spirit Sect, are all waiting for the Luo State Alliance's response.
However, inside the Luo State Alliance, Chang Daniu's face was grim.
The newly appointed Alliance Hierarch of the Luo State Alliance also looked extremely unhappy—they couldn't find a top Martial Artist to accept the challenge!
Yu Changfeng, a beginner in the Refining God Heavenly Man realm, possesses immense strength.
Not just the prodigies of the Luo State Alliance, there are few among the sitting elders of the Luo State Alliance who could defeat Yu Changfeng.
"Uncle Master Chang, let's ask for reinforcements from the Main Alliance—they should send someone to Luo State to accept the challenge. Jian Zhai isn't the Luo State Spirit Sect, so since he came to challenge in Luo State, we can also send prodigies from the Main Alliance to accept the challenge."
The Alliance Hierarch of the Luo State Alliance suggested with a heavy tone.
Chang Daniu responded with a muffled voice: "The Main Alliance also can't spare anyone. You need to understand that they are facing the Thousand Martial Hall, Lei Yun Mountain Manor, and Yu Ling Mansion."
He was just as enraged, but there was nothing he could do about it.
The Luo State Alliance was simply too weak.
"So we just let Yu Changfeng walk all over us?"
The Luo State Alliance gnashed their teeth in frustration.
"I'll kill him!"
One of the elders stood up in a rage.
"Sit down!"
Chang Daniu's gaze hardened: "The rules of the Prodigy Duel are in place—we the All Ages Alliance mustn't cross the line. Otherwise, the Spirit Sect will have an excuse.
"Before the Spirit Sect breaks the rules of the Prodigy Duel, we the All Ages Alliance absolutely mustn't break it!"
The elder had no choice but to sit back down disgruntledly.
"Is the Luo State Alliance out of prodigies? If so, I'll come back tomorrow to see."
Yu Changfeng's derisive voice echoed in the air.
"Chang Daniu, since your Luo State Alliance can't even produce someone to fight, just remain a coward. Stay confined within this small territory. We in the Spirit Sect will let you be."
Another voice rose mockingly.
The strongest warrior from Lei Yun Mountain Manor.
"Right, just hide in here. Considering you all look quite pathetic, we the Spirit Sect will let you off this time."
A group of Spirit Sect warriors all started laughing.
Various Loose Cultivators of Luo State who were watching all felt stifled—some even seemed to realize that their choice to side with the Spirit Sect was the right one at any given time.
Chang Daniu's face turned dark green with rage.
The next day, Yu Changfeng came again.
Insults were thrown around again. The Luo State Alliance was once again at a loss but could do nothing about it.
In the following days, Yu Changfeng made a scene every day. He challenged constantly, mocked incessantly, and even provoked Refining God Heavenly Man beginners from the Luo State Alliance.
One of the Luo State Alliance's Refining God Heavenly Man beginners, enraged, accepted the challenge and was killed on the spot.
"Trash of the All Ages Alliance, I'm here again. Any challengers today? Your Main Alliance isn't coming to help? Can't send out your so-called prodigies to challenge me?
"Loose cultivators are lowly—I know it's not nice to hear, but that's the reality. Is it so hard to accept where you stand?
"Who gave you the audacity and courage to strive for superiority? Why aren't you speaking up? Come on.
"Never mind, it seems you have no prodigies. I, Yu Changfeng, will lower my status and challenge your Refining God Heavenly Man beginners again today.
"If I lose, you can cut off my head and kick it around as a ball. Come on, why are you scared?
"What a bunch of trash!"
Once Yu Changfeng started talking, his words were nothing short of venomous.
All the Loose Cultivator warriors who were watching had become almost numb—they couldn't even muster up the energy to feel angry.
The successive blows seemingly indicated how laughable it was for the so-called lower-class Loose Cultivators to try to surpass their superiors!
"You've gone too far!"
Chang Daniu roared in fury.
He charged out with two huge hammers in his hands, followed closely by the top warriors of the Luo State Alliance.
"Whelp, I'll end you today!"
Chang Daniu roared as he lifted his hammers.
Yu Changfeng showed no fear, on the contrary, he smiled—he had finally succeeded in riling this group up. His job was done.
"Come on, come on, old waste. If I so much as blink, I'll take your family name!"
Yu Changfeng even stuck out his head a little further in the most contemptuous manner.

chapters.title: Chapter 539 - 293: Sword God Xu Yan, Here to Challenge the Spirit Sect's Genius_2
chapters.content:
Behind Yu Changfeng, a smile had appeared on the faces of the sect leader of the Sword Mastery Pavilion and the two elders.
In front of the trio, there was a hulky man with a stubbly beard, holding two big hammers in his hands. He was the most powerful warrior of Lei Yun Mountain Manor.
Upon seeing Chang Daniu's rage, he broke out into a smile.
"The subordinate sects of Thousand Martial Hall are as shameless and despicable as the Hall itself. Only those people of the Thousand Martial Hall could utter such vile words.
"But that's to be expected. Only this could incite Chang Daniu. As long as he makes a move...
"Let's see how the All Ages Alliance responds. This could be their first violation of the rules of the Heavenly Chosen Confrontation."
Fan Kaisan had already prepared himself to intervene and save Yu Changfeng from Chang Daniu's hands.
Looking at Yu Changfeng, who was still leaning forward in utter contempt of Chang Daniu, he couldn't help but smile. Even in the face of his own disdain, Chang Daniu's volatile temper would certainly explode.
As expected, Chang Daniu was preparing to act.
"You're making me so angry!"
Chang Daniu almost exploded on the spot. That little brat from the Sword Mastery Pavilion was utterly infuriating!
"This isn't right, this won't do at all!"
The Alliance Hierarch of Luo State turned green -- it was evident that Yu Changfeng had intentionally provoked Chang.
"Elder Chang, don't lose your temper, you mustn't make a move!"
The Luo State Alliance Hierarch desperately pleaded with Chang Daniu.
"Yes, you mustn't take action!"
The other Luo State Alliance Refining God martial artists also said anxiously, their faces dripping with cold sweat.
Chang Daniu calmed down a bit, but Yu Changfeng didn't let him, showing a face full of contempt. "You lowly Loose Cultivator, cowardly sort. If you can bear so much, find a tortoise shell and move into it."
Chang Daniu, who had just calmed down a little, suddenly had bloodshot eyes, brimming with murderous intent.
His aura burst forth, and with a loud bang, he pushed back several people from the Luo State Alliance. "Don't get in my way, I'm going to kill this brat today!"
Fan Kaisan, with a smile in his eyes, had tightened his grip on his hammer, positioned half a foot ahead, prepared to intervene and restrain Chang Daniu.
Meanwhile, Yu Changfeng was incredibly nervous inside. While he had Fan Kaisan's support, he was still facing a formidable opponent. If Fan Kaisan was even a fraction too late in intervening, he would be doomed!
All the onlooking martial artists became anxious and silently retreated. The battle between the strongest was about to break out again!
Anyone with discerning eyes could tell that Spirit Sect was deliberately provoking Chang Daniu.
As tensions were reaching a peak and Chang Daniu was about to strike with his hammer, a figure descended and landed in front of Yu Changfeng.
"Are you Yu Changfeng of the Sword Mastery Pavilion? I've finally found you!"
The newcomer was a handsome youth, holding a longsword in his arms.
The abrupt interruption defused Chang Daniu's rage for a moment, he looked at Fan Kaisan with gritted teeth.
"Who are you?"
Yu Changfeng's expression turned cold.
Fan Kaisan and the sect leader of Sword Mastery Pavilion, likewise, looked somber. If it weren't for this man's sudden arrival, their plan would have succeeded.
Xu Yan didn't care about what had happened there. After arriving in Luo State and making inquiries, he had finally found the whereabouts of Yu Changfeng and hurriedly rushed over.
After all, he was running short on time for the meeting of the heavenly prodigies in the Ling Domain.
"I am Sword Sage Xu Yan, and I am here to challenge the prodigy of Spirit Sect!"
Xu Yan spoke calmly.
Sword sage Xu Yan?!
The sect leader of Sword Mastery Pavilion looked at Xu Yan in surprise and doubt.
Huang Liang had gone to Yuzhou for Xu Yan's Sword Dao and ended up dead!
And now, Xu Yan had shown up voluntarily!
"Sword Sage? Haha, you think you're worthy?"
After a moment of surprise, Yu Changfeng burst out in a cold mocking laughter.
"Are you the prodigy of the All Ages Alliance?"
He drew his sword from its sheath, surrounded by sword Qi, looking menacing.
"No!"
Xu Yan shook his head, still holding his longsword, and said, "You make your move first."
Yu Changfeng and others were taken aback by Xu Yan's statement. Xu Yan wasn't from the All Ages Alliance?
"The rumored Xu Yan who transformed a mountain into a sword and killed Lu Xinting?"
"Transform a mountain into a sword? You believe such absurd rumors?"
"Although Xu Yan killed Lu Xinting, how can Lu Xinting be compared to Yu Changfeng? Xu Yan is surely doomed this time!"
All the surrounding martial artists began to discuss feverishly.
At this moment, Chang Daniu let out a sigh of relief. He hoped that Xu Yan would win; even if he wasn't the prodigy of the All Ages Alliance, he was, after all, a Loose Cultivator.
He snorted, looking at Fan Kaisan. Once Xu Yan won, whether it was the sect leader of the Sword Mastery Pavilion or Fan Kaisan who took action, he could step in. And he knew that breaking the rules of the Heavenly Chosen Confrontation would necessitate some sort of payment from the Sword Mastery Pavilion and Lei Yun Mountain Manor.
Xu Yan ignored the discussions around him. When he reached the peak of the Ling Domain and stepped onto the gates of Thousand Martial Hall, all these whispers would turn into praise.
"You make your move. I'm in hurry."
Xu Yan said calmly.
"Fine, then let this arrogant Loose Cultivator see what real Sword Dao is!"
Yu Changfeng sneered coldly.
The Hierarch and the two Elders of the Sword Sect stared intently at Xu Yan, wanting to see if the rumored mysterious Sword Dao of using vegetation and hills as swords truly existed.
Buzz!
Yu Changfeng unsheathed his sword.
Although he seemed to look down on Xu Yan, he went all out as soon as he made a move, not showing any sign of negligence.
The sword light darted, the Sword Qi was incredibly sharp, and in the blink of an eye, it struck.
"Lowly Loose Cultivator, this sword will dissect you into myriad pieces!"
Yu Changfeng said, filled with a chilling intent to kill.
Xu Yan stood still, immovable even as the sword light reached him and the Sword Qi enveloped him.
"Careful!"
Chang Daniu couldn't help but warn.
He couldn't help but feel disappointed, he couldn't even take a single move?
The surrounding martial artists were also shaking their heads. Some even showed mockery. With such power, he dared to proclaim himself a Sword God?
Lu Xinting actually died in his hands, what a waste of life.
Crack!
The Sword Qi arrived, yet Xu Yan stepped into it. Regardless of how the Sword Qi dashed about, it couldn't harm him the slightest!
"Impossible!"
Yu Changfeng's expression changed, he bellowed, and his sword light surged. His aggressive killing intent instantly skyrocket. He even stirred up several sword blossoms, each cold and ruthless sword blossom contained a powerful killing power.
At this moment, he demonstrated the ultimate swordsmanship of the Sword Sect.
Xu Yan still held his longsword, all the Sword Qi, all the sword's light, were seemingly absorbed into an invisible landscape. When they approached Xu Yan, they seemed to have no killing intent like they had surrendered.
"Ling Domain's Sword Dao is nothing more than this, an early stage Refining God Heavenly Man does not qualify to meet my sword,"
Xu Yan thought.
Sword Qi entered his body, along with sword light, but it wasn't directly absorbed. It was only absorbed after being washed by the Sword Intent of mountains.
At the moment, in the battle, the foundation was accumulating rapidly.
The foundation of Sword Dao!
Directly incorporating Yu Changfeng's Sword Qi and sword light into his body, was like incorporating the Sword Dao cultivated by Yu Changfeng into his body.
The Hierarch of the Sword Sect looked horrified. What kind of Cultivation Technique was this?
How did he completely ignore the Sword Dao's attack?
Fan Kaisan also had a serious expression. Among Loose Cultivators, can there really be such an incredible genius?
Chang Daniu at this moment exhaled. He was immediately shocked. What was wrong with Xu Yan? Why couldn't Sword Qi harm him at all?
He seemed to offer no resistance whatsoever.
"Impossible, absolutely impossible. This is an illusion, it's an illusion!"
Yu Changfeng roared, his face grim.
Xu Yan spoke calmly, "You should use a secret technique now, otherwise there won't be a chance."
To squeeze out the value of Yu Changfeng.
"Fine! Fine! Fine! Lowly Loose Cultivator, let me show you the secret technique of the Spirit Sect!"
Yu Changfeng took a deep breath, his eyes grew icy.
Losing to a Loose Cultivator was something he absolutely could not accept!
Only a while ago, he trampled on a Loose Cultivator with arrogance, ridicule, and insult. But now he was being stepped on by the same Loose Cultivator, this outcome was unacceptable!
He would rather die than accept this!
Splat!
Blood sprayed out. In his hand, the sword began to glow red, and a thread of bloody sword light emerged from his body.
"Kill!"
At this moment, Yu Changfeng unleashed the most powerful sword of his life!
He moved along with his sword and charged at Xu Yan.
Swoosh!
At some point, he seemed to be trapped in a landscape, his fierce sword turned gentle. In the gentler breeze of the landscape, it kept melting and integrating into the landscape.
"What kind of Sword Dao is this?"
He was greatly shocked inside, his Divine Soul trembled, and his entire being almost fell into madness.
In the gentle mountain breeze, he felt as if his body was melting away.
No!
It was his Divine Soul that was melting, and his physical body was continuously splitting and forming into pieces.
Even until the moment his consciousness faded, Yu Changfeng saw Xu Yan holding his longsword, standing motionless on the spot!

chapters.title: Chapter 540 - 294: The Sword Dao Rules the World
chapters.content:
Silence!
The entire arena fell into shocking silence, everyone was stunned.
Yu Changfeng unleashed his secret technique, transforming into a bloody sword light, and targeted Xu Yan.
An aggressive, swift, and imposing sword attack. Even a late-stage Refining God Heavenly Man, if not killed, would be severely injured.
However, when all eyes were focused on Xu Yan, looking forward to see how he would counter this attack, they watched in terror as Yu Changfeng, who was closing in on Xu Yan, mysteriously dissolve into nothingness.
And Xu Yan, from start to finish, remained rooted to the spot, his posture didn't even change, and his sword was never unsheathed!
In just a split second, Yu Changfeng was dead!
Turned into ash and vanished.
Thump!
The surrounding martial artists were all shocked at this moment.
What kind of power does Xu Yan possess? What kind of martial arts technique did he use?
"You are so wicked, not even sparing the corpse of my Sword Sect disciple, I won't let you go today!"
The Sword Sect elder drew his sword, seething with anger.
Chang Daniu was invigorated, finally it was his turn to step in. The Spirit Sect had broken the rules, there should be an explanation, right?
Although Xu Yan was not a genius of the All Ages Alliance, the rules of the geniuses' contest were not limited to the Alliance and the Spirit Sect, it even included all loose cultivators.
Xu Yan pondered for a moment, then asked, "Is there a rule that says you must leave a body behind after killing a challenger?"
"There is no such rule, life and death are self-determined, it is not said that you cannot turn a body into ashes!"
Before the Sword Sect elder could respond, Chang Daniu had already roared sharply.
Xu Yan nodded, that's good, he hadn't broken any rules.
Although rules are made to be broken, he has just started his journey in the Ling Domain, keeping a low profile for now wouldn't hurt.
Otherwise, if other people refuse to fight later, that would be troublesome.
He turned to the furious Sword Sect elder, "Leaving a corpse is too much of a hassle, it also pollutes the environment, I, Xu Yan, have always cared for the environment, therefore I prefer to let the enemy return to dust!"
Everybody: ...
He talked about turning the body to ashes as if it was a matter of high moral standing, a first for them all.
The Sword Sect elder was furious, he wanted to fight but Chang Daniu was watching closely, if he made a move it would break the rules and attract disaster to the Sword Sect.
For this geniuses' contest, the upper sect had deliberately issued a command not to violate the rules, unless the All Ages Alliance violates them first!
Xu Yan glanced at the Sword Sect elder, as a late-stage Refining God Heavenly Man, he was much stronger than Zhu Liang, a Refining God. However, in Xu Yan's eyes, it didn't mean much.
Especially because the elder's cultivation was rooted in Sword Dao.
"I know you want to make a move, so I'll allow you to do so. Let's have a go."
Xu Yan casually spoke.
"You are the one who said it!"
The Sword Sect elder was overjoyed, as it wouldn't count as a violation of the rules.
Fearing that Xu Yan would go back on his word, he let out a roar and attacked with his sword.
Xu Yan still held his longsword, but this time, facing the Sword Sect elder's attacks, he occasionally altered his position to evade the opponent's fierce striking assaults.
The Sect leader of Sword Sect became more and more gloomy as he watched. This young man's sword dao was bizarre, and it seemed as if he had already seen through the Sword Sect's swordsmanship. Every move, every sword strike, he seemed to find a flaw.
The Sword Sect elder also noticed this, his face darkened, sword strike after sword strike, he attacked fiercely, using all his might.
All of a sudden, he released his secret technique, presenting himself as one with the sword. Swift and fierce, the sense of killing locked onto Xu Yan and attacked fiercely!
Xu Yan snapped his fingers and a sword light emerged from his fingertips.
At this moment, the Sect leader of Sword Sect had a face full of terror!
Splash!
The body of the Sword Sect elder turned into ash and vanished, leaving only a sword falling to the ground.
Xu Yan's eyes narrowed slightly, at this moment he gained further understanding of the Sword Dao, and his gained insights increased a little.
"He was just a bit short of strength."
Xu Yan turned his gaze to the Sect Leader of Sword Sect.
A pinnacle Refining God Heavenly Man, just a step away from cultivating a strand of Heavenly Earth Lingji, his strength far exceeded that of the man from the Red Ming Sect.
He is truly the helm of the top Spirit Sect under Thousand Martial Hall!
Moreover, the Sect leader of Sword Sect had a force of fierce killing Sword Qi about him. Although he hadn't comprehended Sword Intent yet, this Sword Qi was extraordinary.
Concentrated to an extreme, sharp beyond comparison.
If it was any other martial artist who practiced other martial arts techniques, with Xu Yan's current strength, he wouldn't challenge the leader lightly, after all, he was only at the Perfect Divine Intent State.
However, since the leader of Sword Sect practiced Sword Dao, there was no fear.
He had already reached the small success level of Heart Sword Realm, no matter how strong the Sect Leader's Sword Dao was, he could fully understand his swordsmanship, he could identify the flaws in his Sword Dao.
More importantly, he could even control the opponent's sword!
All things in heaven and earth are swords, the enemy's sword is also his sword!
"I know you want to draw your sword, so do it."
Xu Yan said this as he looked at the Sect Leader of the Sword Sect.
"Young man, be careful, he is the Sect Leader of the Sword Sect!"
Chang Daniu was already shocked by Xu Yan's killing of the Sword Sect elder, but he was going to challenge the Sect Leader of Sword Sect?
"Chang Daniu, just manage your Luo State Alliance."
Fan Kaisan scoffed.
"Xu Yan, you are very arrogant. Since you dare to let me draw my sword, it shows your confidence!"
The Sword Sect Sect Leader stepped forward.
With each step he took, his Sword Qi became stronger. Ultimately, a fierce Sword Qi soared a hundred feet into the sky, the killing intent rippling outwards.
With a sword in hand, the killing intent boils!
Xu Yan's eyes narrowed slightly, the Sword Sect Sect Leader's strength was extremely strong, his sword qi sharp and concentrated, he was the first person to achieve such a level that Xu Yan had ever seen.
After a moment of contemplation, he said, "You are the Sword Sect Sect Leader, you've devoted your life to studying the Sword Dao, although you haven't entered the door of the Sword Dao, and you don't even know what the Sword Dao is, but if I don't draw my sword, it would be like insulting you. I, Xu Yan, have always valued my opponents, so you deserve to face my sword."

chapters.title: Chapter 541 - 541: 294
chapters.content:
People: You really take your opponents seriously!
"Haha, dare you say I haven't even entered the door of Sword Dao? What blatant arrogance!"
The owner of Sword Zaizhai looked at him with cold eyes, his anger surging.
Xu Yan drew his sword from its sheath, stood arrogantly, and said indifferently, "In the world of Sword Dao, I am the most respected. Your Sword Dao is far behind me, you haven't even entered its door!"
Master is the existence beyond the world, so there is no problem with him being the most respected in Sword Dao!
Chang Daniu gasped, this is just too arrogant.
Although the owner of Sword Zaizhai is not as powerful as him, he is definitely a top expert among Refining God Heavenly Men. However, in Xu Yan's eyes, he hasn't even entered the door of Sword Dao?
The surrounding martial artists were all dumbfounded.
"It is rumored that Xu Yan is arrogant. I never thought that he was even more arrogant than the rumors!"
"Is the owner of Sword Zaizhai going to go crazy with anger?"
"Look how red his face is, I even suspect, he might use a secret technique out of anger!"
The martial artists were all whispering.
"Arrogance!"
The owner of Sword Zaizhai roared angrily, a sword slashed out, and the sword qi tore across the sky. The sharp Sword Qi turned all the surrounding grass and trees into dust in an instant.
Xu Yan looked indifferent and swung his sword out.
The light of the sword seemed ordinary, but it encompassed everything like mountains and rivers appearing, covering everything. In an instant, it devoured the Sword Qi of the Sword Zaizhai's master.
The Sword Zaizhai master is a top expert, his sword technique is formidable, his sword qi is like a weaving web, his sword light is fierce, and the battlefield is engulfed by sword qi and sword light.
Even a certain distance away, the fighting martial artists all felt a chilling murderous aura.
So strong!
The weaker onlookers retreated a few steps farther away.
Chang Daniu's eyes condensed, indeed, the power of Sword Zaizhai's master is remarkable, worthy of being the top-level leader of the Spirit Sect under Thousand Martial Hall.
"He is a treasure body!"
Chang Daniu was thinking in his heart.
The master of Sword Zaizhai is talented with a treasure body. Now, he is boosting the potential of his treasure body, displaying his bottom-of-the-box sword technique. Even he feels a strong sense of invincibility and mighty vigor.
Xu Yan stepped within the Sword qi, he targeted every weak spot in the Sword Zaizhai master's sword technique with each step he took. Each of his sword strokes easily resolved the Sword Zaizhai master's killing move.
He seemed relaxed as if strolling in a courtyard, walking in the battlefield amidst the crossing sword qi. His sword strokes showed no sign of murderous intent, seeming quite ordinary.
Each time he made a move, there was no powerful Sword Intent, nor was there any fierce Sword Qi.
But, each of his sword strokes broke through the Sword Zaizhai master's killing move, tearing open his fierce Sword Qi, then slipping through the opening in the attack comfortably.
It seemed no matter what move the Sword Zaizhai master made, or how he displayed his fierce and sophisticated sword technique, Xu Yan seemed to know it like the back of his hand, seeing right through the flaws.
The flaws and weaknesses of these sword techniques were even unknown to Sword Zaizhai himself.
The fight continued, the face of Sword Zaizhai's master became more and more serious, he did not dare to be negligent in the slightest.
The more he fought, the more astonished he was. How was it that Xu Yan could always effortlessly resolve his killing moves with one sword stroke?
When did this killing move have such a huge flaw?
Xu Yan looked serious. It seemed like he was walking casually in the midst of crossing Sword Qi, but he too did not dare to be careless. The understanding of the Heart Sword Realm that surpassed the clarity of the Sword Heart, naturally understood the Sword Zaizhai's master's sword technique easily.
However, the Sword Zaizhai master is indeed very powerful, even if the flaws in his sword technique are seen, one still needs the ability to seize the fleeting opening before making a move.
Sword Qi entered the body, sword light kept slashing towards him, the killing force was getting stronger and stronger.
Xu Yan was immersed in the battle, submerged in his own accumulated foundation. At this moment, his body, even in the Sword Intent, seemed to have accumulated a mysterious momentum.
This momentum seemed to be able to improve the state of mind and the foundation of the Martial Arts.
This was not the momentum shown by martial artists, but a "momentum" in the state of mind.
"When the momentum is full, it's time to break through."
Xu Yan had a clear grasp of it in his heart.
Gathering this momentum of the state of mind and the momentum of Martial Arts to a certain extent, is the time when the foundation is sufficiently accumulated to break through the Divine Origin Realm.
And this momentum could only be accumulated by confronting it in battle and understanding and accommodating the momentum of the enemy's martial arts.
"Xu Yan, you are indeed an anomaly. Your Sword Dao is unparalleled and unprecedented in the Ling Domain."
The master of Sword Zaizhai opened his mouth with a serious expression.
He had to admit that Xu Yan's Sword Dao was very profound and strong.
"But, you are too arrogant, too confident."
While saying this, a faint cold light emanated from the Sword Zaizhai master's body, not from the sword's blade, but from within him.
At this moment, the strength of the Sword Zaizhai master continued to rise, the fierce killing aura grew stronger and began to solidify.
Boom!
At one point, the master of Sword Pavilion was enveloped in cold light.
"Although I am not a spiritual body, I am a cold edge treasure body. I have also practiced swordsmanship that complements my cold edge treasure body. Even if an invincible martial artist only just got started, I can fight him!"
This was the confidence of the Sword Pavilion master.
While a treasure body is indeed weaker than a spiritual body, it does not necessarily mean the treasure body martial artist would be weaker than the spiritual body martial artist.
Everything depends on the individual's cultivation!
He was the helmsman of one of the top-level spirit sects under the command of the Thousand Martial Hall. His innate talents were naturally exceptional and he had the support of the transcendent spirit sect of the Thousand Martial Hall.
He practiced the top-level Sword Dao, continuously refining and sparking his treasure body, and he had cultivated the swordsmanship which fits his treasure body.
Now, he was compelled to activate the treasure body, revealing its full power.
Cold light surged out from within him, like a chilling precious sword.
At this moment, the sword Qi the Sword Pavilion master exerted became piercingly cold, as if the battlefield were frozen by chilly sword Qi, and the space where the battlefield was seemed about to freeze into ice.
As Xu Yan moved, there was a sense of stagnation.
Threads of cold sword Qi seemed to penetrate everything.
"How will you break my lockdown technique? Unless you can force open my sword qi, how will you evade it no matter what?"
The Sword Pavilion master gave a cold laugh.
The cold light became more and more intense, the sword Qi cut through the air, seeming to leave a trail of sharp ice.
The frigid sword Qi constantly condensed, increasingly bearing down on Xu Yan.
The Sword Pavilion master appeared relaxed, but he had already exhausted his full capability, bringing his treasure body to its full potential and sword technique to its pinnacle.
His current state, was not too far off from a powerful martial arts secret technique.
The consumption was enormous, he couldn't afford to fight for too long.
Therefore, he needed to fight quickly and decisively!
The movements of the Sword Pavilion master grew faster and faster, casting his sword moves at a faster pace, the battlefield had turned into a cold light, obscuring the conditions in it.
As for this cold light battlefield, it was slowly shrinking, enclosing a smaller and smaller area.
"You are indeed a formidable opponent. If you were not a Sword Dao practitioner, I would have had to turn tail. But since you are a Sword Dao practitioner, it is no more than so.
"You have spent your lifetime practicing Sword Dao, but do not know what the Sword Dao is. Today, let me show you what a real Sword Dao is.
"Being able to witness a genuine Sword Dao before death, you should be content."
Xu Yan replied indifferently.
A single stroke of the sword emerged, revealing the sword intent of mountains and rivers. In an instant, the sword was like lightning, slashing down in a blink!
Thunderous Sword!
The onlookers, including martial artists, only saw a thunderbolt sword emerging from the battlefield, severing the cold light and tearing the chilly sword Qi.
The cold air seemed on the verge of being extinguished under the thunderbolt sword.
Then, they saw Xu Yan slash with his sword. In a trance, it seemed like they saw mountains and rivers descending, and amidst the mountains and rivers, the people were wielding their swords and slashing down.
Plup!
The Sword Pavilion master showed a disbelief expression. At this moment, he realized his sword was no longer under his control and seemed to have become an enemy's sword!
What was even more terrifying, the sword Qi he executed also became an enemy's sword!
"How is this possible?"
Plup!
His body started to break apart, his divine soul was disintegrating.
"This is considered Sword Dao? What kind of Sword Dao is this?"
The Sword Pavilion master died with regret, anger, and confusion. His body and soul disintegrated and eventually turned to ashes!
The Sword Pavilion master, a top-ranked Spirit Sect expert, a Sword Dao expert, died just like that!
Killed by Xu Yan, a young prodigy!
Sword God Xu Yan!
At this moment, all the martial artists deeply remembered this name.
Fan Kaisan became extremely serious. Among the loose cultivators, was there such a powerful prodigy?
Even the Sword Pavilion master was killed by him.
Xu Yan could now pose a threat to the geniuses of the transcendent Spirit Sect!
He stepped forward, full of expectation and hope that Xu Yan would continue to be rampant and challenge him. Then, he would have a chance to strangle this person in the bud!

chapters.title: Chapter 542 - 295: The Grand Xuan City, Meng Chong Makes His Appearance_1
chapters.content:
Xu Yan killed the master of Jianzhai, and the momentum of the scene he created expanded further, continuously feeding his martial arts foundation, bringing him one step closer to garnering enough foundation.
He glanced at Fan Kaisan, who seemed eager and filled with anticipation, then turned and left without another word.
He was certainly not foolish enough to challenge a martial artist who had cultivated the Heavenly Earth Lingji.
With his current strength, he was absolutely no match for Fan Kaisan.
Unless, he could break through to the Divine Origin Realm.
"You're not fighting anymore?"
Fan Kaisan was somewhat surprised.
Xu Yan paused in his steps and pondered, "I am the pinnacle of the Spiritual Realm prodigies. The rest should submit to me. This journey is to challenge the prodigies of the Spiritual Realm and defeat them all."
"I'm not here to challenge an old guy like you. Your strength is commendable, but it's not worth my time considering your age and the amount of power you have."
"The master of Jianzhai practiced Sword Dao, so I made a move against him, but you are not a practitioner of the Sword Dao. You're not worth my time!"
Fan Kaisan's face alternated between green and red, a surge of resentment gathering in his chest. Was this eminent martial artist actually being despised by a young brat?
What did Xu Yan mean by "so old yet so little power"?
"Boy, are you looking down on me?"
Fan Kaisan said angrily.
Xu Yan, an honest man, simply nodded in affirmation.
"Yes, I am somewhat looking down on you. After all, at your old age, you have such little power. If I were as old as you, I would have transcended the world long ago!"
The crowd of martial artists: ...
Fan Kaisan was so infuriated that his eyes were red, gasping for breath. Chang Daniu also felt offended.
His power and age were similar to Fan Kaisan's. If Xu Yan was looking down on Fan Kaisan, might he not also be looking down on him?
Xu Yan didn't bother with them. With a flicker, he moved on. His next target was Cai Yunhong, the prodigy of the Sky Cloud Dynasty. Time was of the essence, he must accumulate his foundation and break through his realm.
"Where do you think you're going!"
Furious, Fan Kaisan prepared to give chase.
Chang Daniu smirked coldly, "What, does the old man want to bully the younger one? He might not be the prodigy of our Wanshi Alliance, but he is a prodigy of the loose cultivators. Are you going to violate the rules of the Prodigies Tournament?"
"Hmph!"
Fan Kaisan snorted coldly and turned away.
Xu Yan, you arrogant boy, pushing your luck!
If he couldn't confront him openly, he could always take action behind the scenes.
As long as no one knew, it wouldn't count as breaking the rules!
Xu Yan officially embarked on his journey to challenge the prodigies of the Spiritual Realm, forging his own invincible path.
Meanwhile, Meng Chong had also arrived at the territory of the Triple Extinction Tower.
The Triple Extinction Tower wasn't located in Luo State, but in Lizhou.
The Wanshi Alliance of Lizhou was not weak. They had a few prodigies and although they were slightly inferior to Spirit Sect, they were able to hold their own against them.
The main city of Daxuan, the biggest city in Lizhou, was jointly governed by several Spirit Sects.
And the headquarters of the Wanshi Alliance in Lizhou was also located here, in the southern part of the city, confronting the various Spirit Sects.
The Prodigies Tournament in Lizhou was livelier than in Luo State, with more participants.
In the central arena of Daxuan City, two young men clashed fiercely.
One was a loose cultivator, the other a disciple of a certain Spirit Sect.
The two battling, both at the peak of the Grandmaster Realm.
At an age of just under thirty, this level of power was considered prodigious.
Though they were not top-tier prodigies, they were among the ranks of prodigies.
Boom!
Splat!
The loose cultivator was blasted back by a punch. He spat out blood; several bones seemed to have been broken as he was sent flying backwards.
"I concede!" he cried in a hurry.
While the Prodigies Tournament in Lizhou was indeed intense, it was not death or surrender. As long as one party surrendered, the match would cease.
Of course, this rule only applied to prodigies outside the Wanshi Alliance and the top Spirit Sect.
The battles between prodigies were not all with lone cultivators and Spirit Sect prodigies. There were also battles within Spirit Sect clans, which were fairly common.
To climb up the ranks of the prodigy leaderboard and secure the prizes of the Prodigies Tournament, the true opponents were the prodigies of the Spirit Sect clans. After all, lone cultivator prodigies were in the minority.
The majority were weaker than the prodigies of the Spirit Sect and elite clans.
Lone cultivators, in terms of cultivation technique, martial arts experience, weapons, etc., were all inferior to the Spirit Sect and elite clans. The Wanshi Alliance, though made up of lone cultivators, shouldn't be treated as ordinary lone cultivators.
Among the eighteen states of the Spiritual Realm, apart from Yuzhou and Luo State, all the other states were bustling. The Prodigies Tournament was in full swing and the prodigies were ready for battle, all for fame, the rewards of the Tournament, and to get more cultivation resources and higher-level cultivation.
As for the clash between the Wanshi Alliance and the Spirit Sect, it was not something ordinary prodigies could participate in. The final victory depended on the Transcendent Spirit Sect and the Wanshi Alliance Headquarters.
And it was still quite early for their decisive battle.
This Prodigies Tournament was the grandest martial arts event in the world of Spiritual Realm Martial Arts since the calamity of the Blood Demon, after the withdrawal of the All-Star Martial Arts Academy from the eighteen states.
All major Spirit Sects and elite clans invested resources in their prodigies in order to achieve a higher rank and secure a better reputation. This was actually about the distribution of resources and power.
Even if the Wanshi Alliance had not emerged, the tournament of the Spirit Sect and elite clans would have started in a few years. The current Prodigies Tournament was just ahead of schedule.
It had simply incorporated the Wanshi Alliance and all the lone cultivators.
Upon reaching the bustling city of Daxuan without delay, Meng Chong watched the two combatants on the platform. Although they were both at the early stage of the Divine Transformation Realm, their realms were unstable and their strengths were too weak.

chapters.title: Chapter 543 - 295: The Grand Xuan City, Meng Chong Makes His Appearance_2
chapters.content:
It was clear these forces to which they belonged had recently dumped resources into forcefully breaking through the initial stages of the Refining God Heavenly Man phase, making their realm seem insufficiently refined.
Of course, they also seized this opportunity during the Heroes' Contest to fully solidify their realms.
These so-called geniuses were naturally not of interest to Meng Chong. His target was Wu Tu, the genius of San Jue Building.
Aside from Wu Tu, his second target was Bao Sheng.
Of course, if Lu Yi also steps into the ring, Meng Chong would likewise accept the challenge. His journey to the Ling Domain was precisely for the purpose of challenging all kinds of geniuses.
"Building up Martial Arts foundation through battle should yield effective results. After all, Martial Artists ultimately need to grow through battle, confront various Martial Arts, and gain insights into the true essence of Martial Arts, thereby accumulating Martial Arts experience," Meng Chong thought.
The method of Elder Brother must be flawless.
Although he has just reached the initial stages of Undying Golden Body and is still some distance from perfection, he believes that he would be able to swiftly build up his foundation, and make a breakthrough to mastery through battles.
Moreover, he could use his enemies' attacks to practise the Sky Hammer Hundrends Tempering technique, accelerating the upgrade speed of the Undying Golden Body.
The fight on the martial arts stage had ended, with both sides equally injured and neither gaining an advantage.
Just then, a cold gleam descended from the sky.
A knife was thrust upright on the martial arts stage, its blade reflecting the surrounding area. A figure descended from the sky, one foot stepping on the hilt of the upright knife.
"Wu Tu is here!"
"Who will fight him this time in the Lizhou Alliance?"
"Could it be that no one will? No one fought him yesterday. After all, the Loose Cultivators are not as powerful. Wu Tu is one of the three geniuses of the San Jue Building and practices the Dao of Knife."
"After all, the San Jue Building is a subordinate of Thousand Martial Hall. With Wu Tu's talent and strength, he is expected to enter the Thousand Martial Hall in the future. How can Loose Cultivators compare to him?"
The surrounding martial artists were whispering to each other.
Wu Tu, the genius of San Jue Building.
Wu Tu was standing on the hilt of the knife, defiantly looking at the All Ages Alliance from Lizhou with a mocking smile. "Well, is there no one to fight me today too? Why don't you just give up and leave Daxuan City?"
The strong men in the Lizhou Alliance wore grim expressions.
"I'll go and meet him!"
A young man, indignant and holding a long knife, was preparing to step forward and fight. Even if he were defeated, he couldn't show cowardice and decline the challenge!
However, before he could get on stage, he saw a burly figure in the crowd instantly appear on the stage.
"Is he challenging Wu Tu? Is he seeking death?"
The viewing martial artists were all taken aback.
This bald young man who is just a Loose Cultivator, is he really going to challenge Wu Tu?
Meng Chong got directly on the stage.
Many heroes are in Daxuan City. He suddenly came up with an excellent method to avoid running around.
He will directly challenge all the geniuses of Ling Sect in Daxuan City!
Wu Tu's face turned cold. This Loose Cultivator who doesn't know how to live!
"Are you challenging me?"
With a cold smile and rising killing intent, he asked.
"Yes!"
Meng Chong nodded.
Hovering in the air, Wu Tu raised his hand to call his knife, and said coldly: "Anyone who challenges me, there is no forfeiting condition. It's either my death, or the challenger's death!
"Do you still want to challenge me?"
Meng Chong was taken aback. He touched his head and asked in surprise, "Are you seeking death?"
The martial artists around: ...
Does this bald young man not understand?
Almost infuriated to death, Wu Tu replied angrily, "The one seeking death is you, and if you want to die, I will fulfill your wish!"
Meng Chong held his knife in his hand, touched his head and said, "Although you are a disciple of the San Jue Building, which is subordinate to the Thousand Martial Hall, we don't have any grudges against each other. Just for this contest, we have to fight to the death, isn't that too direct?"
Daxuan City genius contest; though it could be a life-or-death situation, he has no intention of killing.
However, it seemed Wu Tu was tired of living, so he would fulfill his wish.
"If you're afraid of death, scram!"
Wu Tu yelled angrily.
"Since you insist on seeking death, then I will fulfill your wish!"
Meng Chong's looked serious. Looking at the audience of the Spirit Sect and All Ages Alliance, he asked in a deep voice, "If I turned him into ashes, would that violate the rules?"
The surrounding martial artists:...
Upon opening his mouth, he wants to reduce Wu Tu to ashes. Is this bald young man cruel?
"I won't violate the rules, but there's no rule that says I must leave my enemy's corpse intact."
The corner of the Alliance Hierarch of Lizhou's mouth twitched as he spoke.
The face of the Master of Triple Extinction Tower darkened even further.
Wu Tu was almost livid with fury, gritting his teeth and said, "I'll break your body into ten thousand pieces!"
He raised his blade, ready to fiercely slaughter his opponent when Meng Chong waved his hand and said, "Hold on."
"If you have any last words, say them now!"
Wu Tu said coldly.
Meng Chong looked serious, holding his knife in his hand, and solemnly said, "I haven't introduced myself yet. Surely, you don't want to die without knowing who killed you, right?"
The crowd of martial artists: ...
In Wu Tu's furious and bloodshot eyes, his blade radiated a fierce blade light and a formidable aura, which surged forth from his body.
Even in his brain, a blade-shaped fluctuation appeared.
"The eldest martial brother is a Sword God, the god of Sword Dao. I practice the Dao of Blade, under the heaven, I am the honorable lord of blades, the name Blade Absolute lacks a bit, hence I should be called Blade Master!"
As the thought crossed his mind, Meng Chong held his blade and bowed, turning around in a circle, and solemnly said, "I, Blade Master Meng Chong, am the supreme in the world of blade Dao!"
The other martial artists were dumbfounded. Where did this Loose Cultivator come from? Was he insanely arrogant, claiming to be the supreme in the world of blade Dao?
Moreover, he spoke this in front of Wu Tu.
You should know, one of the three absolutes in the Triple Extinction Tower, was the Dao of Blade!
The greatest blade of Lizhou always belonged to the Triple Extinction Tower.
"Arrogant fool, die!"
Wu Tu was unable to control his anger. He swung his blade, his formidable and unparalleled blade attack, rushing towards Meng Chong.
Zing!
Meng Chong jabbed out with his blade, gently and swiftly, easily breaking Wu Tu's attack.
The expression on Wu Tu's face instantly turned grave, recognizing that Meng Chong was not an ordinary opponent. He dared not underestimate his opponent and displayed his blade technique to its fullest, going all out.
Meng Chong held his blade in hand, without displaying the Undying Golden Body nor the blade intent, he simply fought with Wu Tu using pure blade techniques.
His blade Qi was domineering and unparalleled, furiously unyielding, and bravely unique.
"This bald guy is so powerful!"
The watching martial artists couldn't help but be astounded.
The strongmen in the Triple Extinction Tower also wore serious expressions. The blade technique of the bald youth was extremely exquisite and varied, sometimes domineering, sometimes like a wild wind, and at times, gentle as a breeze.
His blade technique has reached the realm of perfection!
Wu Tu's expression gradually turned solemn and even shocked. How could a Loose Cultivator's blade Dao be so profound? It was truly unimaginable.
Behind him, there must be a peak blade technique expert!
"You are worth my full fight, Wu Tu!"
Wu Tu said solemnly.
He swung his blade, the blade light twinkling in an instant, dazzling and pretty.
It didn't have the domineering aura, nor was it ferocious. Instead, it was as gentle as a ripple of water with the blade light flowing continuously. However, the hidden killing intent was exceptionally sharp.
Meng Chong's expression was solemn. Wu Tu's Dao of the Blade did have its merits.
He remained unhurried, swinging his blade one after the other. Each strike was simple, yet always precisely hit the weak points in Wu Tu's blade light, dissolving the deadly attack.
The more Wu Tu fought, the more surprised he became. By now, he was using the strongest blade technique from the Triple Extinction Tower. Even amongst those in the Thousand Martial Hall, this technique could rank in the top ten.
However, in Meng Chong's eyes, it seemed full of flaws, easily dissolving the deadly blade technique.
Bang!
Blade Qi instantly became fierce.
Wu Tu let out a low roar, his blade technique changed abruptly, attacking violently like a storm, fighting as if he were mad. The entire martial stage had already been covered by blade Qi.
Above the surging blade Qi, the hidden, dazzling blade light was even more dangerous.
Meng Chong's expression was neither sad nor happy. Thread after thread of blade Qi entered his body. Even the blade gleam slashed onto his body, but he didn't move. The Sky Hammer Technique had already been activated.
He struck out with his blade, instantly breaking Wu Tu's attack and opening a gap, putting even more pressure on Wu Tu to unleash an even stronger attack!
The Master of the Triple Extinction Tower suddenly stood up. His expression was exceptionally dark. Wu Tu seemed to be losing!
How could this be possible!
However, the fact was indeed so. Wu Tu was already in an almost mad state. He had used his strongest blade technique and pushed his cultivation technique to its limit.
As for Meng Chong, he was still calm and composed, easily dealing with the situation. Although it seemed that blade Qi after blade Qi was slashing at him and blade gleam after blade gleam was cutting into him
However, the truly sharp, lethal attacks were all cleverly dissolved by him. The remaining attacks could not harm him at all!
The gap in their abilities was clearly established!

chapters.title: Chapter 544 - 296: Meng Chong Shows His Power, Single-Handedly Intimidates Three Jue Lou_1
chapters.content:
At the martial arts stage, Wu Tu had pushed his cultivation technique to the extreme, and his aggressive attack had reached its strongest state.
However, Meng Chong remained calm and collected.
The look on the face of the Alliance Hierarch of the Three Extreme Building was gloomy; was Wu Tu about to lose?
This was an issue that affected the reputation of the Three Extreme Building, the honor and disgrace of the Spirit Sect, and just after taming the arrogance of Lizhou Alliance, would they now be humiliated by a Loose Cultivator?
Moving his fingers subtly, he wanted to covertly intervene, but he saw the Alliance Hierarch of the Lizhou Alliance looking at him with a smile on his face, seemingly waiting for him to intervene.
Feeling a jolt in his heart, remembering the instructions from the Thousand Martial Hall's upper sect, a sense of dread filled him. The Spirit Sect could not be the first to break the rules of the Genius Confrontation, but they could force the All Ages Alliance to!
As for what considerations lied behind this, he did not know.
Since the upper sect had delivered such an order, it meant that there were factors within the All Ages Alliance that even the upper sect had to take into account.
After pondering for a moment, the Alliance Hierarch of the Three Extreme Building sat down but still sent a message to Meng Chong.
"Meng Chong, I am the Alliance Hierarch of Three Extreme Building. Observing your exceptional martial arts talent and superb swordsmanship, you are undoubtedly a rare genius in the Dao of the Sword. How about joining the Three Extreme Building?
"As long as you join the Three Extreme Building, the title of the first genius in Dao of the Sword will be yours, and I can recommend you to the upper sect of the Thousand Martial Hall.
"Once you join the upper sect of the Thousand Martial Hall, you will become a Transcendental Spirit Sect's genius!"
In view of the Alliance Hierarch of the Three Extreme Building, how can a Loose Cultivator resist the temptation of becoming a Spiritual Sect Warrior?
Especially when there is a chance to become the genius of the Transcendent Spirit Sect of the Thousand Martial Hall.
Meng Chong raised his eyebrow, and gave a glance at the Alliance Hierarch of the Three Extreme Building outside the martial stage.
Seeing him looking over, the Alliance Hierarch of the Three Extreme Building immediately showed a smile, nodded slightly, expecting Meng Chong to join!
Seeing this, the Alliance Hierarch of the Lizhou Alliance felt a jolt in his heart, muttered under his breath, that's not good. If Meng Chong really joined the Three Extreme Building, it would definitely be bad news for them.
Moreover, he also knew that for most Loose Cultivators, joining the Spiritual Sect and becoming a Spiritual Sect Warrior was an opportunity to rise beyond their humble status. Very few could resist this temptation.
Just about to message Meng Chong and try to win him over, even ready to promise him treasures to secure him, Meng Chong let out a cold laugh. Until then, he had been responding calmly, but all of a sudden, he struck out with his sword.
The overpowering, unassailable sword cut through layers of sword aura, shattered numerous rays of sword light, and even knocked Wu Tu's sword out of his hand.
With the fall of this sword, Wu Tu was reduced to ashes!
The face of the Alliance Hierarch of the Three Extreme Building turned gloomy in an instant, murderous intent surging, he abruptly stood up, glaring at Meng Chong.
On the martial arts stage, Meng Chong stood sword in hand, contemplating the insights gained from this battle.
As for the killing intent of the Alliance Hierarch of the Three Extreme Building, he didn't care at all.
The Alliance Hierarch of the Lizhou Alliance revealed a smile, looked at the Alliance Hierarch of the Three Extreme Building, and said casually, "The Genius Confrontation has its own rules. Don't tell me you intend to step in?"
"Hmph!"
The Alliance Hierarch of the Three Extreme Building sat back down with a gloomy look.
After killing Wu Tu, Meng Chong sheathed his sword and said coldly, "I hear that the Three Extreme Building has three geniuses. Wu Tu is one of them. His sword skills are mediocre and not top-notch. I'm curious, how about Bao Sheng's fists?
I, Meng Chong, the Invincible Fist, challenge Bao Sheng of Three Extreme Building!"
The assembled martial artists: ...
Just now he was the Sword Master, now he's the Invincible Fist?
However, everyone knew that Meng Chong was taking on the Three Extreme Building.
They wondered, could Meng Chong have a grudge against the Three Extreme Building?
"Arrogant!"
From the Three Extreme Building, a tall and sturdy figure appeared in the air and landed on the martial arts stage.
His muscular physique was comparable to Meng Chong's. His fists were armed with a pair of gloves, and his face was filled with anger.
Since Meng Chong had openly challenged him, the Three Extreme Building had no choice but to respond. If they were forced by a Loose Cultivator to refuse a fight, would the top-tier Spirit Sect still have any face left?
"Come on! Break out into a hearty fight!"
Meng Chong did not use his sword but clenched his fists. He engaged Bao Sheng directly in a fistfight, bare-handed.
Although Bao Sheng was armed with a spiritual artifact gloves, and Meng Chong was just bare-handed, yet the ferocity of his fists was even stronger. He even directly used his bare hands to resist Bao Sheng's punches.
A direct and hard collision, on the martial arts stage, they could only see two muscular figures, fighting at close quarters, fist to flesh!
Even though Bao Sheng was armed with gloves, during the intense battle, he frequently avoided Meng Chong's attacks, and was clearly in a spot of bother.
On the other hand, Meng Chong, directly resisting Bao Sheng's punches with his bare body, not even furrowing his brows. No injuries were left on his rugged body.
The spectators were astounded. How terrifying was that physique!
The result of the fight was not surprising at all; Bao Sheng got blown up by a punch and turned into ashes!
The martial artists couldn't help but swallow a gulp. This bald youth didn't look too fierce, but why was he so ruthless? He even blew up his opponent into ashes!
The vigorous battle had Meng Chong, his muscles jumping, emitting waves of heat, feeling that his Undying Golden Body had improved after this battle, and the effect of the Heavenly Hammer Hundred Refinement technique had significantly enhanced.
The body cultivation martial arts could be more valiantly displayed during a fight and could gain further improvement.
"Where is Lu Yi? Dare to fight?"
He intended to challenge all three geniuses of the Three Extreme Building.
Daxuan City was boiling over; the famous Wu Tu and Bao Sheng had been killed.
Moreover, Meng Chong was going to challenge Lu Yi.
He intended to take down all three geniuses of the Three Extreme Building!
The Loose Cultivators were even more ecstatic, feeling a sense of relief. Their backs straightened when they walked, they were no longer timorous when meeting a Spiritual Sect Warrior, instead, they held their heads high.

chapters.title: Chapter 545 - 296: Meng Chong Shows His Power, Single-Handedly Intimidates Three Jue Lou_2
chapters.content:
All the warriors from Spiritual Sect looked terribly grim.
They were cursing inwardly the waste from Three Absolute Tower who had been defeated by a loose cultivator!
The strong fighters from Lizhou Alliance were all showing smiles. Even though Meng Chong wasn't a genius from the All Ages Alliance, he was a loose cultivator. As long as he was not on the same side as the Spiritual Sect, he'd be the one they supported.
"Keep an eye on the guys from the Spiritual Sect. If they dare to make a move, do not hold back, we must not let Meng Chong be sneak attacked!"
The Leader of Lizhou Alliance said in a solemn voice.
"Understood!"
A group of strong men from Lizhou Alliance were excitedly nodding.
The Lord of the Three Absolute Tower had an extremely grim expression, his heart roiling with murderous intent. But, when he glanced at the strong men from Lizhou Alliance, he had no choice but to suppress his killing intent.
The rules of the Genius Confrontation cannot be violated by the Spiritual Sect first!
That was the order issued by the higher-ups, absolutely no overt actions could be taken under the watchful eyes!
In regards to backhand moves, they had to make sure they wouldn't be discovered, with no possibilities of exposure.
But clearly, the All Ages Alliance wouldn't give them such an opportunity!
Lu Yi, spear in hand, stepped onto the martial platform.
With no words exchanged, he unleashed an attack like a thunderbolt as he brandished his spear like a dragon. The violent flurry of strikes was like a deluge that swept across towards Meng Chong.
Meng Chong moved his hand and caught his blade, with a single swing, he let out a seemingly unparalleled strike!
Heaven and Earth Dominator!
As expected, Lu Yi died!
The strong men from the Three Absolute Tower all wore gloomy faces, as if they would love nothing more than to peel Meng Chong alive.
The victorious Meng Chong, who had fought three of the top geniuses, however, hadn't left the martial platform. He stood his ground with a blade in hand, glanced around, and declared in a loud voice: "I, Meng Chong, challenge the geniuses from the Spirit Realm, who will teach me?"
Silence!
No one responded.
All the three top geniuses from Three Absolute Tower were dead. Who would dare to brazenly make a move now?
Moreover, Meng Chong had battled with three top geniuses and showed no signs of fatigue?
He intended to continue the battle?
Meng Chong frowned, then spoke again: "As a loose cultivator, I, Meng Chong, challenge the geniuses of the Spiritual Sect clans. Is there anyone who can teach me?"
He emphasized the four words "a loose cultivator", just trying to provoke the geniuses from the Spiritual Sect clans.
Being humbled by a loose cultivator was unbearable for these clans of the Spiritual Sect. In order to save face, to uphold the dignity of the Spiritual Sect, they were bound to send someone to fight.
Still, no one appeared.
"Didn't the Spiritual Sect always act arrogantly? Don't they look down on us loose cultivators? How come, at this point, they're all useless?"
"The so-called geniuses of the Spiritual Sect are really useless. They practice the best cultivation techniques, obtain the most cultivation resources, enjoy the highest treatment, yet they are worse than a mere loose cultivator."
"Right, they were so boastful, claiming that the Spiritual Sect had the true geniuses and loose cultivators didn't, they have some thick skin. Now that they have been invited to fight, why don't they?"
"Humph, spineless Spiritual Sect junk!"
Heckling and sarcastic voices rang out from the crowd.
These were people from the All Ages Alliance. As taunts began to spill out, loose cultivators who were spectating also began to join in.
This was a golden opportunity to trample the Spiritual Sect, and one that did not come very often. Why would they miss it?
At this point, all the martial artists from the Spiritual Sect wore terrible expressions.
"Could it be a battle without possible fatality?"
At that moment, a timid voice asked.
Meng Chong looked in the direction of the voice. This was a disciple from some clan who seemed to want to come on stage to fight but was hesitant, fearing they'd lose and be killed, hence the reluctance to step on stage.
"Yes! I, Meng Chong, am not a blood-thirsty person. The deathmatch wasn't my idea. It was the guys from the Three Absolute Tower who wanted to die!"
Meng Chong touched his head as he said this.
The strong men of the Three Absolute Tower grew even more unhappy.
But indeed, it was Wu Tu who proposed the deathmatch!
They really couldn't blame Meng Chong for this!
"Then I will fight!"
The clan genius heaved a sigh of relief upon hearing this.
And the battle began once again.
However, this genius from a clan, though not weak, was still far inferior to the three geniuses from the Three Absolute Tower.
Within a few moves, he was defeated by Meng Chong.
