After the first one went on stage, more geniuses from the Spiritual Sect trickled in, despite them intending to wear him out by fighting one after another, Meng Chong was just disappointed.
They were too weak, which wouldn't help to improve his Undying Golden Body much.
He shifted his gaze and looked towards the elders of the Three Absolute Tower.
"I know the old guys from the Three Absolute Tower probably want to skin me alive. Now, I'm giving you a chance. Any elder below the mid-stage of the Refining God Heavenly Man, dare to fight me?"
Everyone was taken aback.
Meng Chong is actually challenging the elders of San Jue Tower?
"Be careful, Meng Chong!"
The Alliance Hierarch of Lizhou hurried to dissuade him.
"No need for further discussion. Any Refining God Heavenly Man mid-stage or below, dare to fight me? I, Meng Chong, am giving you a chance for revenge!"
Meng Chong declared firmly.
"Fine, then I'll behead you!"
An elder from the San Jue Tower scaled the stage with a spear.
A refining God Heavenly Man of the mid-stage, closest to the late-stage strength.
"Great, let's fight!"
Meng Chong, with his blood surging, advanced with his blade for the kill.
News spread from Da Xuan City, attracting martial artists who heard about it, while the name of Meng Chong, the Blade Master, began to spread.
Pu!
An elder of San Jue Tower was beheaded.
"Anyone else?"
Meng Chong continued to challenge.
"How daring!"
Another elder from the San Jue Tower descended onto the stage, brandishing a treasure blade, unleashing their secret technique right off the bat.
After beheading three San Jue Tower elders in succession, Meng Chong's momentum soared, astonishing all sides.
The pride of Lizhou were all sullen and bowing their heads.
Too powerful!
After so many battles, he is still at peak condition. Doesn't he get tired?
"You, the late-stage Refining God Heavenly Man of the San Jue Tower, dare to fight?"
Meng Chong upped the challenge.
"Very well, targeting my San Jue Tower, huh? Let's see how capable you are!"
A late-stage Refining God strongman from San Jue Tower mounted the stage with a spear.
Meng Chong had a serious look on his face. The strength of a late-stage Refining God Heavenly Man was extremely formidable; he couldn't afford to be careless even though he had reached the complete Divine Intent State.
However, relying on the formidable Undying Golden Body, he had nothing to fear!
Boom!
This time, the Undying Golden Armor shrouded Meng Chong's body, making him seem like he was clad entirely in gold armor, looking majestic.
"What kind of martial arts technique is this?"
"I don't know, unheard of!"
All the warriors were trembled in shock.
A strong fighter from the Spirit Sect stared unblinkingly at Meng Chong with a sullen expression.
The fight was incredibly intense. Meng Chong's Immortal Golden Armor was even pierced a few times, but his body remained unharmed.
"What kind of body is this? Why is it so terrifying?"
"It's comparable to a spiritual artifact!"
As exclamations of surprise filled the air, a woman's voice sounded out of the blue: "It's so tough, I want to try it."
The warriors: ...
The number of martial artists in Da Xuan City increased, and eventually, Spirit Sect and All Ages Alliance had to maintain order. Those who had not reached the Great Heavenly Man state were forbidden from converging towards the combat platform, in order to reduce the crowd.
The name of Meng Chong echoed through Da Xuan City.
Meanwhile in Da Xuan City, while Meng Chong was demonstrating his might, Xu Yan had already defeated Cai Yunhong, thereby gaining firsthand experience of the horrifying power brought on by Cai Yunhong's divine strength.
He didn't kill Cai Yunhong in this combat, because it was not a battle to the death.
With his power increasing yet again, Xu Yan set off for his next destination.
East of Luo State, the super-first-class family, Mu Family where he would challenge the family's genius, Mu Feiming!
The Mu Family, both in terms of power and reputation in Luo State, far surpassed the Chi Ming Sect and Cang Yun Kingdom. However, the Mu Family is relatively low-key compared to others.
Yet, not everyone in the low-key Mu Family was low-key.
The last generation produced an unparalleled genius, and thanks to this genius, the otherwise low-key Mu family's reputation in Ling Domain immediately skyrocketed.
Mu Feiming, the womanizer of the Mu Family, gained a lot of fame in the Ling Domain with his debauchery. His philandering escapades were the talk of the martial arts world.
Of course, this also invited a lot of trouble for the Mu family, like eloping with a young master's fiancée and being romantically involved with a widow from a noble family.
This caused a lot of headaches for the Mu Family elders. In order to clean up Mu Feiming's mess, they compensated many times with family resources.
In the end, they arranged a wife for Mu Feiming to restrain him. However, just a few days after marriage, he continued his philandering ways. His wife, in frustration, returned to her natal family and started to settle her accounts with the women Mu Feiming was involved with.
Although Mu Feiming's mischief often created trouble, and the Mu Family had to pay quite a bit to clean up his mess, Mu Feiming was talented and strong.
He had already reached the peak stage of the Refining God Heavenly Man. For such a genius, the Mu Family elders had both love and hate for him.

chapters.title: Chapter 546 - 297: Go Straight to Their Door and Step on Their Faces!_1
chapters.content:
It was rumored that the prodigal son of the Mu Family could possibly become a supreme being. However, the means to become a supreme being were only available in the Transcendent Spirit Sect. Whether the Mu Family could obtain it remained uncertain.
Ten years ago, the prodigal son of the Mu Family disappeared without a trace. In the same year, a beautiful woman, accompanied by a twelve or thirteen-year-old boy, arrived at the Mu Family's doorstep.
This boy was the love child of the prodigal son, left behind during his escapades. The beautiful woman was a mere Loose Cultivator. Upon learning of this, the prodigal son's legitimate partner was enraged to the point of bursting.
He called the boy a bastard and wanted to kill him.
However, the Mu Family elders, upon seeing that the boy had a Spiritual Body, were astounded.
The boy's heritage didn't matter. As long as he carried the Mu Family's bloodline and possessed extraordinary talent, it was enough.
That was the reality in aristocratic families. The elders disregarded Tang Jinyan's objections and anger, even warning her not to harbor any resentment towards the Mu Family's prodigy.
This upset Tang Jinyan so much that she couldn't bear to stay in the Mu Family any longer.
This boy is now the Mu Family's prodigy, Mu Feiming. Fearing that he would inherit his father's loose morals, the elders strictly disciplined him to prevent another prodigy from going astray.
Xu Yan looked at Mu Feiming and couldn't help but feel puzzled. How is it that the features in this man's eyebrows resemble his junior sister Su Lingxiu so much?
"Similar facial features can just be a coincidence."
Xu Yan didn't think much of it. After all, there are many people in the world who look alike. Furthermore, it was only a slight resemblance in their facial features.
Mu Feiming stared intently at Xu Yan. Xu Yan's reputation had already spread throughout Luo State. With his ability to kill Yu Changfeng and the leader of the sword sect, there was no way he could match up to Xu Yan.
Cai Yunhong of the Sky Cloud Dynasty had also been defeated.
Now, he was the last prodigy standing in Luo State.
Even though he knew he was outmatched, he had no choice but to fight.
"Brother Xu, let's begin!"
Mu Feiming inhaled deeply.
Xu Yan nodded. After defeating Mu Feiming, his next destination would be Qianwu State, the territory of the Thousand Martial Hall.
The Transcendent Spirit Sect remained aloof, with no prodigy showing up so far. It seemed like they were waiting for the perfect moment to suppress all other prodigies in one fell swoop.
He planned to directly challenge them at the gate of the Thousand Martial Hall, thereby forcing their prodigy to reveal themselves and directly trample on the Thousand Martial Hall's face.
The Mu Family elders were extremely nervous. Xu Yan's notoriety had spread throughout Luo State. So far, all his opponents, except for Cai Yunhong, had been obliterated, their ashes scattered.
"Friend Xu, please show mercy. Don't ruin the harmony. Our Mu Family has some top-grade Spiritual Medicine which I believe is quite suitable for you."
The Mu Family elder secretly sent a message to Xu Yan.
Xu Yan: ...
Seeing Xu Yan's silence, the Mu Family elder grew even more anxious. The Mu Family had finally raised a prodigy who was virtuous and respected by the younger generation. If he were to die, it would be a huge loss for them.
This person was the only choice for the position of the Head of the Mu Family, which was still vacant.
The prodigal son was to blame. Not only he was a liability, but he also had no interest in managing the family affairs, thus leaving the position of the family head vacant.
Just when it seemed like a new prodigy was about to take the Head of the Mu Family's position and lead the Mu Family towards continuous prosperity, if Xu Yan, this tyrant, were to kill him, the Mu Family would undoubtedly suffer severe damage.
"Friend Xu, how about twelve top-grade Spiritual Medicines? That's the most our Mu Family can offer right now!"
The Mu Family elder gritted his teeth and said.
Xu Yan nodded. It was a generous offer of Spiritual Medicines, and they were top-grade ones at that. Why would he reject it?
Moreover, he never intended to kill Mu Feiming. After all, they had no enmity or disputes between them.
Seeing Xu Yan agreeing, the Mu Family elder was overjoyed and quickly transmitted another message: "Friend Xu, how about we make a deal? My Mu Family can offer five more top-grade Spiritual Medicines to delay your defeat of our prodigy. How about it?"
Xu Yan: ...
Looking at the Mu Family elder and then at Mu Feiming, who was ready to meet his fate and fight for the Mu Family's honor, Xu Yan couldn't help but sigh.
Mu Feiming sure was highly valued in his family!
Regarding the Mu Family, Xu Yan had done some research. The family was skilled in cultivating Spiritual Medicine and making potions. It was inevitable that they would have a considerable stockpile of Spiritual Medicine.
The Mu Family's potions were well-known not just in Luo State, but also in the Ling Domain.
However, Xu Yan felt that the Mu Family's potions were a waste of resources.
Xu Yan nodded and agreed.
After all, top-grade Spiritual Medicines were rare treasures. Even after the accumulated treasures of Yu Shen Sect and Su Family, there were not many of such medicines. The Yu Shen Sect and Su Family were relatively poorer among the Spirit Sects, let alone being compared to the Mu Family.
After some thought, Xu Yan transmitted a message to the Mu Family elder: "If I fight with your prodigy for a quarter of an hour, how many top-grade Spiritual Medicines can you offer?"
The Mu Family elder was stunned, fight for a quarter of an hour?
If that got out, it would mean that the Mu Family's prodigy had been able to withstand Xu Yan's onslaught without defeating for a quarter of an hour. That would be a huge boost to his reputation!
If Xu Yan's fame and reputation grew, the Mu Family prodigy's reputation would also rise accordingly.
The Mu Family elder gritted his teeth and said, "Fifty top-grade Spiritual Medicines. We really don't have any more!"
Xu Yan couldn't help but be amazed. The Mu Family, as a Spiritual Medicine aristocratic family, was probably in possession of the method to cultivate the top-grade Spiritual Medicines. That's why they had such a vast collection of top-grade Spiritual Medicines.
"One Hundred!"
Xu Yan didn't believe the words of the Mu Family elder and directly made an offer.
"Well…"
The Mu Family elder hesitated for a moment, and finally, with gritted teeth and a pained expression, said, "Alright, deal!"

chapters.title: Chapter 547 - 297: Go Straight to Their Door and Step on Their Faces!_2
chapters.content:
Xu Yan rolled his eyes; the old members of the Mu family sure knew how to put on a show!
Mu Feiming was unaware of all this. During his exchange of blows with Xu Yan, he was surprised to find their fight evenly matched. Wasn't Xu Yan supposed to be much stronger than the rumors suggested?
As for Xu Yan, during his fight with Mu Feiming, he was constantly absorbing Mu Feiming's martial arts energy into his body. What surprised him was that Mu Feiming's martial arts energy seemed balanced and peaceful.
It seemed related to the cultivation techniques of the Mu family, which lacked explosive power but offered a steady, continuous flow of energy, making it highly resilient to attacks.
The moment a quarter of an hour had passed, Xu Yan struck Mu Feiming with a powerful blow, sending him flying.
Mu Feiming was a bit dazed. How did Xu Yan suddenly display such ferocity? He couldn't withstand it at all!
"I yield!"
Xu Yan courteously said.
"Thank you, Brother Xu, for showing mercy!"
Mu Feiming responded politely.
The elders of the Mu family were very satisfied with Mu Feiming's performance.
"Friend Xu, here is your spiritual medicine!"
In a grove, an old member of the Mu family presented a bag of items.
Xu Yan opened it to check, there were over a hundred divine-grade spiritual medicines. He nodded in satisfaction.
This trade was worth it!
"May I ask, Friend Xu, where do you plan to challenge the heaven's chosen ones next?"
The old man from the Mu family hesitated before asking.
Xu Yan's eyebrows shot up, but he didn't hide it, "I'm heading to the Thousand Martial Province, to challenge the heaven's chosen ones of the Thousand Martial Hall."
Upon hearing this, the old man from the Mu family took out a small booklet from his bag and handed it to Xu Yan, "Friend Xu, this booklet contains rough information about the Thousand Martial Province, as well as a list of the strong combatants and known heaven's chosen ones of the Thousand Martial Hall."
Xu Yan took the booklet and looked puzzledly at the Elder of the Mu family. The elder was providing him with information about the Thousand Martial Province and the Thousand Martial Hall, it appeared as though they held a grudge against the Thousand Martial Hall.
"The Thousand Martial Hall is the most shameless, Friend Xu, beware. Although there are rules in the heaven's chosen fights, those people from Thousand Martial Hall, if defeated, will surely resort to unscrupulous tactics."
The elder of the Mu family warned.
"Does your Mu family have a grudge against the Thousand Martial Hall?"
Xu Yan asked in surprise.
"Not exactly a grudge. If we really had a grudge, the Thousand Martial Hall would have already destroyed the Mu family. It's just that the Thousand Martial Hall once demanded some things from our family, and we paid a heavy price to keep them."
"So, I would be very pleased to see the Thousand Martial Hall suffer."
The elder of the Mu family gave a nonchalant wave of his hand.
He then put on a solemn face and earnestly said: "Friend Xu, you mustn't mention that the Mu family provided you with this information!"
Xu Yan put away the booklet, "Don't worry, I won't mention the Mu family. I'm a lone cultivator after all. If anyone knows I have this information, they will attribute it to the All Ages Alliance."
"That's good, I wish Friend Xu all the best!"
The elder of the Mu family stated with a bow.
"I shall take my leave!"
Xu Yan nodded, took a step forward, and disappeared on the spot.
The Thousand Martial Province is one of the five largest provinces in the Ling Domain, under the exclusive control of the Thousand Martial Hall, and also one of the most powerful provinces in the Ling Domain.
All the powers present in the Province, the Three Kingdoms, Seven Sects, and Eight Great Clans, are all subservient to the Thousand Martial Hall, managing the large province. The Thousand Martial Hall, being the Transcendent Spirit Sect, naturally wouldn't manage these trivial matters itself.
The All Ages Alliance emerged with a strong presence, yet, the Transcendent Spirit Sect couldn't suppress the Alliance's power, and the Spirit Sect's rule over the Ling Domain was challenged to a certain extent.
However, the foundation of the Transcendent Spirit Sect was, after all, extraordinary.
With the start of the contest among the heaven's chosen ones, the top heavenly prodigies from various top Spirit Sects began to make their moves, making their way onto the leaderboard, to compete with the heaven's chosen ones of the All Ages Alliance.
So far into the contest, the Spirit Sect has the absolute upper hand.
The Transcendent Spirit Sect was unflustered, not sending out a single heaven's chosen one as if waiting for the last moment to make an unbeatable appearance and sweep away the heaven's chosen ones of the All Ages Alliance.
Or perhaps, to see how deep the foundation of the All Ages Alliance is.
There is no existence of the All Ages Alliance in the Thousand Martial Province, even less likely that any heaven's chosen of the All Ages Alliance, dare to challenge the Thousand Martial Province.
Therefore, to the heaven's chosen of the Thousand Martial Hall, and even the heaven's chosen of the Three Kingdoms, Seven Sects, and Eight Great Clans, all they needed to do was to focus on cultivating, continuously enhancing their strength, and strive for a good ranking in the final heaven's chosen showdown.
At this stage of the contest among the heaven's chosen, it's the elimination stage, the real heaven's chosen ones always make their move at the end.
Therefore, when Xu Yan, alone with his sword, arrived at the doorstep of the Thousand Martial Hall, defied the heavens with his sword, and challenged the heaven's chosen of the Thousand Martial Hall, the warriors of the Thousand Martial Hall were caught off guard and were somewhat bewildered.
"I am Xu Yan, the Sword God, here to challenge the Heavenly Chosen ones of the Thousand Martial Hall!"
His voice echoed like thunder.
Inside the Thousand Martial Hall, all the powerhouses were taken aback.
Where did this brave man come from, daring to challenge them at the doorstep of the Thousand Martial Hall?
Immediately after, all the warriors of the Thousand Martial Hall turned red with anger, and the elders of the Thousand Martial Hall all wore grim faces.
Has the deterrent power of the Thousand Martial Hall fallen so much?
A loose cultivator actually dares to challenge them?
Moreover, he calls himself the "Sword God"?
Isn't it known to all that the Sword Dao of the Thousand Martial Hall is considered the best in the Ling Domain?
This is a direct slap on their faces!
"From where does this despicable loose cultivator come from? This isn't a place where you can act recklessly!"
A deacon from the Thousand Martial Hall appeared, his aura oppressive, and spoke incensed.
"Well, isn't the pride of Thousand Martial Hall up for a fight?"
Xu Yan's eyes became cold. This martial artist from the Thousand Martial Hall was indeed rude.
"You, a despicable loose cultivator, are not worthy of provoking the pride of my Thousand Martial Hall to fight. Get lost!"
The Deacon of the Thousand Martial Hall had initially intended to take action directly.
But thinking about the rules of the Pride Competition, he had to restrain himself and roared angrily.
"Then I challenge you. Do you dare to fight?"
Xu Yan said coolly.
The deacon of the Thousand Martial Hall was taken aback at first but then became overjoyed. This ignorant loose cultivator dared to challenge him; he was digging his own grave, and nobody could blame him.
"You're courting death, I'll grant you that!"
Even as he spoke, the deacon made his move, striking with lethal force.
The Thousand Martial Hall is indeed shameless, as rumoured!
Xu Yan sneered, his sword slashing out. In an instant, Sword Intent surged, enveloping the mountains and rivers.
This deacon, merely at the peak of Cultivation Realm, was insignificant in Xu Yan's eyes.
Shush, Shush, Shush!
Mountain River Dragon Roar, Thunderclap Sword, Sudden Annihilation Sword!
Splat!
The Deacon of the Thousand Martial Hall was slain on the spot, reduced to ashes!
"Impudence!"
From within the gate of the Thousand Martial Hall, a martial artist was seething with anger.
A deacon, killed in front of the mountain gate of the Thousand Martial Hall; such a thing hadn't happened in many years.
The last time something like this happened, it was done by the Blood Demon.
Now, this scene had happened again. He felt as though he had been slapped hard across the face.
Boom!
The aura of a peak Cultivation Realm martial artist was undoubtedly revealed, and a spear shot out from within the mountain gate.
"Thousand Martial Hall, indeed the most shameless Spirit Sect in Ling Domain. So, you're planning to break the rules of the Pride Competition already?"
Xu Yan sneered rhetorically.
His voice resonated loudly.
From afar, there were already martial artists watching. They all looked shocked. Who was this fearless person who had come to challenge directly at the mountain gate of the Thousand Martial Hall?
The Blood Demon of the past was probably just like this, right?
The spear in mid-air paused. The martial artist from the Thousand Martial Hall had a red face; he would have never cared about the rules of the Pride Competition in the past.
However, the situation was different now.
"I know you want to kill me very much."
A brilliant smile appeared on Xu Yan's face, "The 'pride' of the Thousand Martial Hall is a bunch of cowards, too afraid to take up the challenge. It's understandable if you have to fight on behalf of your Sect's pride.
"Since that's the case, let me challenge you then. Come on, make your move!"
"You're speaking nonsense!"
The martial artist from the Thousand Martial Hall was enraged. He wanted to take action, but if he did, it would validate that his Sect's pride feared battle and had to let him substitute.
If he didn't act, it seemed like he was cowardly, not daring to act when challenged.
"Despicable villain!"
He ground his teeth in anger.
Xu Yan raised an eyebrow, "What's the matter? Not only is your Thousand Martial Hall pride a bunch of cowards, but you, old man, are one too?"
"To death!"
Boom!
The spear was like a dragon, hurtling toward him.
Xu Yan slashed out his sword, the sound of the dragon's roar filled the air, as he stepped forward, directly confronting the attack.
"The spear technique of the Thousand Martial Hall is indeed not bad!"
Xu Yan had to admit, among cultivators of the same realm, martial artists from the Thousand Martial Hall were indeed much stronger than those from other Spirit Sects and families.
Since he had already made his move, that martial artist from the Thousand Martial Hall no longer hesitated. He pushed his cultivation technique to its limit, with the spear technique of a dragon and spear light like thousands of cold stars, sweeping Xu Yan within.
"Today, you will die!"
Xu Yan merely smiled faintly. He executed his Mountain and River Sword Dao, constantly attacking the opponent. The attacking aura of the other party was absorbed into his body strand by strand.
The momentum of his martial arts was growing, gaining different insights from the hands of different martial artists.
"The Divine Origin Realm is not far off."
Xu Yan thought to himself silently.

chapters.title: Chapter 548 - 298: Setting up a Challenge Stage in Front of the Thousand Martial Hall_1
chapters.content:
In front of the Thousand Martial Hall's mountain gate, a great battle was erupting. As soon as the news broke out, an increasing number of martial artists arrived to watch.
All with faces of amazement.
Challenging them right at the Thousand Martial Hall's mountain gate, who gave him such courage?
"Sword God Xu Yan? The one who slew Yu Changfeng in Luo State?"
"Not merely Yu Changfeng - even the Sword Sect's Master was killed."
"Are all Loose Cultivators this bold nowadays? Challenging directly at the Thousand Martial Hall's mountain gate, where lies the dignity of the Transcendent Spirit Sect?"
"Hiss! Xu Yan is so strong and his Sword Dao seems unusual."
"Indeed, I feel it's much more formidable than that of the Thousand Martial Hall."
The watching martial artists were engrossed in discussion.
On the peak of the Thousand Martial Hall mountain, the Thousand Martial Lord and elders were all grim-faced, observing the scene below.
According to plan, the prodigies of the Transcendent Spirit Sect would descend the mountain, sweeping over every prodigy in sight, demonstrating the might of the Transcendent Spirit Sect and then suppressing the prodigies of the All Ages Alliance with a considerable advantage.
They had the confidence and assurance to do so.
Even knowing that the All Ages Alliance had the support of the formidable Wu Tianan, they believed the deep-rooted strength of the Transcendent Spirit Sect was not ordinary.
They had already started devoting more resources to cultivate their prodigies, determined to gain the final victory in the competition.
But now, someone had come to challenge them directly.
This was something they had never expected.
"What kind of Sword Dao is this?"
An elder of the Thousand Martial Hall asked in a deep voice.
The Sword Dao he practiced was of the Thousand Martial Hall's, but on witnessing Xu Yan's Sword Dao, he felt an inexplicable restraint on his sword.
"You too, can't see any clues?"
The Thousand Martial Lord asked solemnly.
"I feel a sense of shame from his sword. It seems that my painstaking Sword Dao practice is nothing more than a child's trick!"
The elder spoke with a grave expression.
"How is that possible!"
The remaining elders were all staggered.
The one who had spoken was the number one practitioner of the Thousand Martial Hall's Sword Dao, the contemporary Sword Master Elder!
"I too, have the same feeling!"
Another elder, who was a Sword Dao practitioner, also spoke with a heavy tone.
"This young man has definitely stolen our Thousand Martial Hall's Sword Dao!"
An elder with glittering eyes opened his mouth maliciously.
"Huang Liang went to Yuzhou because of this, and ended up dead!"
Someone reminded.
"He's already at our gate, what's there to fear?"
"But, the rules of the prodigy competition..."
"Is he a prodigy of the All Ages Alliance? If not, why care? Can the Wu clan come to the rescue of this loose cultivator?"
"Lord, what's your opinion?"
The arguing members turned to the Thousand Martial Lord to ask.
The Thousand Martial Lord pondered for a moment before speaking in a deep voice, "The time is not ripe. Moreover, I'm afraid Xu Yan has some connection with Wu Tianan. Otherwise, where would such an extraordinary Sword Dao come from?
"You have to know that Wu Tianan, once he loses his weakness and goes insane, we might not be able to hold him off.
"When the Divine Bridge is about to descend, it's not too late to make our move. Then we'll see what Wu Tianan can do!"
The elder in charge of the swords agreed, "You're right, Lord. The time is not ripe!"
"Then how should we deal with Xu Yan?"
An elder frowned.
"Among the seven sects and eight families of the three countries, isn't there a single prodigy who can handle Xu Yan? Let them make the move."
The Thousand Martial Lord spoke coldly.
The remaining elders nodded in agreement.
If a prodigy of the Thousand Martial Hall went into battle directly, wouldn't it devalue their status?
Set a threshold first - only after Xu Yan has defeated all the prodigies of the seven sects and eight families of the three countries can he talk about challenging the prodigies of the Thousand Martial Hall!
At the foot of the Thousand Martial Hall mountain, the battle came to an end. Xu Yan swung his sword, and in an instant, the Sword Intent formed a series of sword shapes, overpowering the martial artist from the Thousand Martial Hall.
The cycle of life and death materialized with the swing of the sword. The martial artist's head fell as the sword encircled his neck.
The Sudden Wind Sword Intent swept like a storm, the divine soul dispersed, and the body turned into ashes.
Having slain another martial artist from the Thousand Martial Hall, Xu Yan held his sword sternly, contemptuously staring at the Thousand Martial Hall's mountain gate, and spoke in a cold voice, "Are all prodigies of the Thousand Martial Hall mere cowards?"
The watching martial artists were utterly shocked. The Thousand Martial Hall's face had been slapped relentlessly, yet they didn't thunderously suppress this provocateur?
Could it be that there's some inside story to this Prodigy Competition, so much so that even the dignified Transcendent Spirit Sect's Thousand Martial Hall does not dare to defy it?
"Xu Yan!"
An elder of the Thousand Martial Hall stepped forward. His momentum was overwhelming, as if the Great Power of Heaven and Earth had already converged on him. A supreme being!
Xu Yan slightly narrowed his eyes, ready to flee at any moment. The elder's power was somewhat stronger than Huang Liang's. There was no way he could win this fight.
"So, the Thousand Martial Hall has no more prodigies left, just a bunch of old guys like you?"
Xu Yan stared defiantly at the other side.
"So arrogant!"
"I've heard that Xu Yan is arrogant, and seeing it today, it's indeed the case!"
The crowd of onlookers all drew in a breath of cold air.
This was a supreme being, but Xu Yan was dismissing him so lightly.
Song Zeng was boiling with anger inside but suppressed it. Speaking coldly, he said, "Our Thousand Martial Hall, the Transcendent Spirit Sect holds a distinguished position. Our sect's prodigies are not something a mere Loose Cultivator like you can challenge.
"After you've defeated all the prodigies of the Thousand Martial Hall, then you can come challenge our sect's prodigies. Otherwise, you're not qualified!"
Even though they were attacked and two martial artists were killed, granting them a loss of some face, but to allow their prodigies to engage in battle would devalue them. Would it not?
If they were not bound by the prodigy competition, would they allow Xu Yan to rant at their gate? They would have slapped him to death a long time ago.

chapters.title: Chapter 549 - 298: Setting up a Challenge Stage in Front of the Thousand Martial Hall_2
chapters.content:
However, the Thousand Martial Hall was closely watched by Wu Tianan. Once they violated the rules of the rivalry of the Young Geniuses, Wu Tianan would inevitably find a reason to strike them.
The rest of the Transcendent Spirit Sects might not ally with the Thousand Martial Hall against Wu Tianan because of this issue.
In the previous battle at the Wanxing Martial Arts Academy, the former lord of the Thousand Martial Hall took action and defeated Wu Tianan. But the latter was quite remarkable and managed to escape with his life.
And his strength has further improved, reaching the Martial Arts limit of the Ling Domain!
Under the scrutiny of such a powerful person, the Thousand Martial Hall could only bear it temporarily.
"The strength of the Thousand Martial Hall is very strong. Their young geniuses all have spiritual body talents. With a gap of two major realms, I may not be able to suppress them with my current strength.
"Moreover, once all the young geniuses of the Thousand Martial Hall are defeated, these old guys will definitely not sit still. If they swarm up, it will be a bit difficult for me to escape with my current strength.
"At that time, I will inevitably have to use the Jade Talisman of Divine Skills offered by my Master. This is not good. How can Xu Yan, who walks in the Martial Arts world, rely on the protection of his Master?
"I am about to break through to the Divine Origin Realm. After a few more battles, it should be about right. Once I enter the Divine Origin Realm, there will be nothing to fear."
Xu Yan secretly thought to himself.
"Fine, then I, Xu Yan, will suppress all the Young Geniuses of the Thousand Martial Province!"
Xu Yan nodded coldly.
Song Zeng, with a dark face, thought Xu Yan was truly arrogant. Did he really want to suppress all the Young Geniuses of the Thousand Martial Province by himself?
"This seat really wants to see how you could suppress the Young Geniuses of the Thousand Martial Province!"
Song Zeng snorted coldly.
The surrounding martial artists immediately perked up. The Thousand Martial Province is about to become lively. Those young geniuses are likely to appear one after another.
"Where is Xu Yan going to challenge next? One of the Seven Sects and Eight Families of the Three Kingdoms?"
"Definitely, these are all subordinate forces of the Thousand Martial Hall."
The martial artists conversed privately.
As for Xu Yan, he moved back when everyone thought he was going to leave. But as a result, Xu Yan raised his hand and struck down with a palm.
Boom!
Several hundred feet away from the gate of Thousand Martial Hall, the soil churned and piled up together. In a short while, a platform made of compacted soil appeared, standing tens of feet tall.
On the flat platform, Xu Yan took out various unknown treasures and stabbed them into four corners of the platform. In an instant, an unknown force condensed and gathered on the platform made of piled-up soil.
As this force gathered, the platform made of piled-up soil became as sturdy as a rock.
Xu Yan stood proudly on the platform with his sword and shouted, "I, Sword God Xu Yan, challenge the Young Geniuses of the Thousand Martial Province here outside the gate of the Thousand Martial Hall!"
All the martial artists present were stunned. How could he be so bold?
They thought he was going to leave the gate of Thousand Martial Hall and challenge the various forces, but he ended up building a platform right outside the Thousand Martial Hall to challenge the young geniuses of the Thousand Martial Province?
Song Zeng's face turned green with anger. "Xu Yan, you insolent boy!"
Xu Yan glanced back at him, "This is what you said, I can challenge your Young Geniuses of Thousand Martial Hall after defeating all the Young Geniuses of the Thousand Martial Province. The Thousand Martial Province is so vast, it is tiring for me to go around all by myself.
"Setting up a fighting platform right outside the gate of the Thousand Martial Hall is much more convenient, and it's also easier for you of Thousand Martial Hall to watch the fight. Otherwise, you won't admit it even after I have defeated all the Young Geniuses of the Thousand Martial Province!"
Song Zeng had a dark face. As unreasonable as it might seem, there was truth to his words. But setting up a competition platform openly at the gate of Thousand Martial Hall was practically a direct slap in the face!
"Xu Yan, don't you think you can do whatever you want just because the rules of Young Genius rivalry are in place?"
Song Zeng said murderously.
"I, Xu Yan, have never cared about so-called rules. Rules are restraints for the weak. I, Xu Yan, always break rules. Your Transcendent Spirit Sect's rules are nothing but dog shit in my eyes.
"Today, I challenge the Young Geniuses of the Thousand Martial Province right here. If you don't agree, let your Young Geniuses from the Thousand Martial Hall come and fight.
"If you want to bully the weak because of your size, then just make a move. After all, everyone says that the Thousand Martial Hall is the most shameless....."
Xu Yan looked at Song Zeng obliquely. His posture and expression were filled with disdain and contempt, provoking Song Zeng's rage. He was so angry that his face turned red, his aura condensed, and he unconsciously gripped his knife.
The spectators withdrew a little distance, looking at the figure on the platform, they were amazed. This was the first person to set up a ring outside the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
The Blood Demon of the past, no matter how arrogant and outrageous he was, he never dared to set up a ring outside the Transcendent Spirit Sect. Xu Yan is the first in the history of the Ling Domain!
Thousand Martial Hall is widely recognized as the most shameless in the Transcendent Spirit Sect, even more so than many other sects, a fact almost universally acknowledged in the Ling Domain, among the numerous sects and families.
But nobody has ever dared to outright address them as the most shameless.
Today, history has been witnessed!
A fierce man made his statement in front of Thousand Martial Hall's mountain gate!
Song Zeng's face turned red with anger, he had never been so shamefully insulted before, and it was a loose cultivator, a mere teenager, who was so disdainful and offensive to him in person.
If he swallowed it down, what would that make him more than a coward?
Xu Yan had to die!
"Xu Yan, no matter who is backing you, you must be dead today..."
Song Zeng gritted his teeth, the blade in his hand gathering a thread of the energy of heaven and earth, ready to strike like thunder and kill the annoying boy on the high platform on the spot.
But immediately, his expression drastically changed, as he raised his head to a certain place, a subtle but definitive aura locked onto him, a strong sense of danger rose in his heart.
At the same time, the Thousand Martial Lord moved his body, reaching above the clouds, his face solemn, filled with caution.
Inside the gate of the Thousand Martial Hall, a powerful force was gathering, preparing to strike.
Song Zeng moved his body back to the sect's gate of the Thousand Martial Hall and stood with the elders, looking up at the sky with an extremely grave expression.
Xu Yan was surprised for a moment. Was this coward really going to hide from the battle?
Then his heart jumped, and he looked up at a certain place.
"So strong!"
At this moment, his heart felt ice-cold.
"Much stronger than Huang Liang. If he attacked, apart from my master's Divine Skills Jade Talisman, I wouldn't be able to escape."
At this moment, Xu Yan had to take it seriously.
"I am still too weak. Even if I don't enter the Divine Skill Realm, advancing to the Great Completion of the Divine Origin Realm, I could still face this powerful opponent."
With his keen senses, he noticed that in mid-air, a massive gathering of the Great Power of Heaven and Earth was taking place. This was not simply a coalescing of Heavenly Earth Lingji, but something far more profound.
"Could it be the power of Heaven and Earth Laws?"
Xu Yan muttered in his heart.
Above the clouds, a man who resembled a schoolteacher, holding a book in one hand as if deeply engrossed in it, held a measuring scale in another, paying no attention to the Thousand Martial Lord with his gloomy countenance.
"Wu Tianan!"
The Thousand Martial Lord gritted his teeth and said grimly, "You dare to come to my Thousand Martial Hall, aren't you afraid of your life?"
Wu Tianan flipped a page of the book with his measuring scale, smiling and saying, "You can try to kill me, I am here to ensure no one violates the rules of the Path of the Transcendents competition."
"After all, the Thousand Martial Hall is infamous for its shamelessness. Everybody knows it. Even the little fellow below knows."
"Hmph, let's see how long you can continue your arrogance!"
The Thousand Martial Lord snorted coldly.
The Thousand Martial Lord returned to the Thousand Martial Hall gate, and said in a deep voice. "Wu Tianan has arrived, Xu Yan is likely his disciple, otherwise, he wouldn't have dared to challenge us directly.
So, we must arrange for the Celestial children of the three countries and eight clans to strike and heavily reward anyone who can defeat him, regardless of whether they are within a thousand martial states."
The Thousand Martial Lord commanded with a gloomy face.
"Yes, Lord!"
All the elders felt a chill in their hearts.
Above the clouds, Wu Tianan also looked perplexed, "Why is Xu Yan's Sword Dao so profound and unheard of, where does his inheritance come from?"
Challenge the power of the Thousand Martial Hall directly to its front gate as a loose cultivator. Where does this boy gain his confidence and courage?
Even the former blood spirit child was not so arrogant!
Xu Yan's challenge to the Celestial children of the Thousand Martial states at the gate of Thousand Martial Hall spread at an extremely fast pace.
The entire Thousand Martial states were shocked, everyone was astounded. Who was Xu Yan and why was he so presumptuous and brave?
What was even more baffling, the Thousand Martial Hall did not suppress Xu Yan with thunderous measures, allowing his challenge to the Celestial children at the Mountain gate.
"Xu Yan, do not be arrogant. Celestials of the Thousand Martial Hall are not someone you can challenge. Today, I am here to kill you!"
A figure is flying quickly toward this.

chapters.title: Chapter 550 - 299: One Against Five, One Sword Destroys the Arrogant _1
chapters.content:
Xu Yan looked up at a young man dressed in a golden robe who held a long spear. Based on his clothing, it was clear he hailed from Wei Country, one of the Three Kingdoms and Eight Clans.
The Mu Family's old booklet had an introduction about Wei Country. There were two prodigies produced by the royal family of Wei Country in the present generation, and the one who practiced spear strategies was Wei Yuan.
At the peak of the initial phase of the Refining God Heavenly Man cultivation level, he is half a step away from entering the middle phase. His cultivation level is also extremely stable, and the cultivation technique he practices originates from the Thousand Martial Hall, making him a powerful adversary.
But, even a prodigy who's merely in the initial phase of the Refining God Heavenly Man level, doesn't catch Xu Yan's regard.
Only the legendary spirit-body prodigies would earn his slight respect, and nothing more.
"Xu Yan, you're too arrogant!"
With the arrival of Wei Yuan, two more formidable figures appeared.
"One each from the Hundred Blades Sect of the Seven Sects, and the Wei family from the Eight Great Families. That should be enough," Xu Yan muttered under his breath.
Pointing his longsword forward, he said, "You three, come at me at once. Let's not waste time."
"Always heard that you, Xu Yan, were arrogant. Today, I finally witness it!"
Wei Yuan commented menacingly.
"Arrogance is the impression ignorant people have of me. I, Xu Yan, have never been arrogant. I've always spoken based on my capabilities."
Xu Yan replied indifferently.
The number of martial artists who came to watch the battle was increasing. Apart from the martial artists of Thousand Martial State, there were also martial artists from other states who had traveled to Thousand Martial State, as well as Loose Cultivators and martial artists from various Spirit Sect families who were continuously gathering.
After all, it was an unprecedented event to set up a platform for a challenge in front of the gate of the Thousand Martial Hall, and challenge the prodigies of the Thousand Martial State.
Whether they were Loose Cultivators or the martial artists from Spirit Sect families, they were all excitedly rushing to witness history. In the future, they could brag about having been witnesses and participants in this historical event!
The substantial reward from the Thousand Martial Hall had also spread among the Spirit Sect families. The various prodigies of the Thousand Martial State, seeing a chance to enter the Thousand Martial Hall, came in droves.
"I'll see how skilled you are!"
Wei Yuan charged, his long spear piercing forward, giving off a chilling glint. It coiled like a giant python and flew towards Xu Yan.
"Are we deciding the winner, or life and death?"
Xu Yan parried Wei Yuan's attack and asked in a grave voice.
"In a duel, only life and death matter!"
Wei Yuan coldly retorted, "If you're scared, kneel and beg for mercy from the Thousand Martial Major Sect. Perhaps that can save your life!"
Xu Yan sneered dismissively and replied coldly, "If you're seeking death, I'll naturally oblige."
He looked up at the other two and asked, "And you two?"
"Life and death!"
The other two responded in frigid voices.
Xu Yan sighed and said, "Ah, these Spirit Sect prodigies surely know the art of seeking death well!"
The onlooking martial artists couldn't help but twitch their lips. Xu Yan was truly arrogant!
Boom!
Xu Yan's eyes hardened and with a swing of his sword, he forced Wei Yuan to retreat repeatedly in just three strikes, leaving him in a sorry state.
"Just by yourself, you're not qualified to duel with me, Xu Yan. I'll give you a chance. All three of you, come at once."
Xu Yan coldly declared.
Wei Yuan looked extremely grim. Xu Yan's strength was beyond what he had imagined. He stood no chance alone.
The expressions of the other two changed. They exchanged a glance, nodded, and landed on the platform, standing with Wei Yuan.
"Xu Yan, you're too proud. We'll grant your wish!"
Prodigies should be proud, but this was an opportunity to earn the favor of the Thousand Martial Hall. Besides, when faced with life or death, how many could maintain their pride?
Boom!
The combined might and auras of the three, instantly filled the platform, a formidable force surging.
"Xu Yan is at a disadvantage. The cultivation techniques of the Three Kingdoms and Eight Clans all originate from the Thousand Martial Hall. Once they work together, their auras will merge and their strength will naturally double."
"Exactly, this isn't the ordinary combined strength of three martial artists. It's as if the three of them have fused their powers into one entity. It's like one person practicing three different martial arts."
"Xu Yan is still too young and impulsive. He's too arrogant. He could win one-on-one, but how could he face the combined strength of three?"
Among the spectators, there were those who knew a bit about the martial arts of the Thousand Martial Hall.
At this moment, they all shook their head and sighed. They all believed that Xu Yan was being careless.
This wasn't a simple joint attack by three martial artists. It was more like the three had fused into a single entity, not spreading out their forces.>
There was no way Xu Yan could divide and conquer in a battle against three in a one against three situation.
"In this battle, Xu Yan will undoubtedly lose!"
An older martial artist stated solemnly.
On the platform, Xu Yan, enveloped in sword intent was facing Wei Yuan and two other prodigies. Even he was a bit surprised. The trio, Wei Yuan and the others combined their forces, their auras blending like the fusion of three into one.
"This is good. After this battle, it's time for me to breakthrough!"
Xu Yan silently contemplated.
"Xu Yan, today will be your final day!"
Boom!
Wei Yuan took the lead and thrust his spear. Spear light exploded, filling the sky with a chilling radiance as it tore through the air.
The moment Wei Yuan made his move, the other two attacked from both sides towards Xu Yan.
The three attacked simultaneously, it felt like one martial artist launching attacks from three different directions. The overwhelming murderous intent covered Xu Yan, leaving him no place to escape or hide.
Hum!
Suddenly, sword light filled the air!
Xu Yan looked indifferent as he was surrounded by sword light. In the blink of an eye, a tree in the distance shook violently and soared into the air, turning into a sword that stabbed towards Wei Yuan and the other two.
In the span of an instant, trees and grass create a sharp sword that radiates a chilling light. The sword intent surged, the sword Qi intermingled, forming a scene reminiscent of mountains and rivers.

chapters.title: Chapter 551 - 299: One Against Five, One Sword Destroys the Arrogant of Heaven_2
chapters.content:
Surrounding Xu Yan, sword light surged around him, mountains and rivers evoked, the intent to kill stirred in all directions!
Mountain and River Sword Array!
"What kind of Sword Dao is this?!"
"Using grass and trees as swords, unleashing thousands of swords at once?"
"No, it's not as simple as a barrage of thousands of swords. Haven't you noticed? It seems to form some kind of special pattern, creating an even stronger offensive technique."
The moment the Mountain and River Sword Array appeared, it shocked all around.
Even Wu Tianan, who was high in the clouds, was taken aback at this moment.
"What sort of Sword Dao is this? Has Ling Domain ever come across such a Sword Dao?"
In the Thousand Martial Hall, the Thousand Martial Lord and the others wore extremely serious and solemn expressions.
The Sword Dao of Xu Yan is too profound, too unimaginable!
"Converting mountains into swords, that's incredible!"
An elder said in a deep voice.
"Wu Tianan, how did you come up with such a Sword Dao?"
The elder wielding a sword said, grinding his teeth in shock.
Wei Yuan and the other two felt their hair stand on end at this point. Their faces changed drastically, and they roared together, converging upon each other, their martial arts power blending together.
Boom!
The sword light had already begun pouring down, surrounded by the sword array. The mountains and rivers were changing, their killing intent sharp.
"I reign supreme in the world of Sword Dao. Today, I'll show the likes of Thousand Martial Hall what true Sword Dao is!"
Xu Yan said coldly.
Boom!
"Kill!"
The trio of Wei Yuan were powerful after all. With their combined strength, they unleashed a mighty prowess, repelling and resisting the grass and tree-turned-swords flying at them.
The mountains and rivers changed, the sword light layered upon layer, but the attack never ceased.
With a sword in his hand, Xu Yan swung down, and between the alternations of the sword light, it seemed like the cycle of life and death.
Even though he had fortified the platform with his formation, it was still beginning to crumble in the midst of battle. Xu Yan knitted his brows, forcing the trio of Wei Yuan to leap into the air, off the platform.
He stepped up into the mid-air, one step at a time, continuing the fight there.
A large tree below crumbled in an instant, transforming into dozens of cold, gleaming swords swirling with Sword Intent, flying up into the sky, engulfing the figures of the trio Wei Yuan.
Swish!
Two more figures arrived, also belonging to the prodigal talents of the Seven Sects and Eight Families from the three countries.
"What is this?"
The two newcomers were terrified. What kind of Sword Dao is this?
It's completely beyond comprehension!
Even the martial artists who were watching the fight were shocked.
And the martial artist elder who had previously claimed that Xu Yan would surely lose, now felt his face heating up. It felt like all the stares directed at him were mocking.
He didn't display any change in his expression, but he quietly slipped away from the crowd and moved to a different, unfamiliar crowd, "Xu Yan truly is an exceptional genius, the top Loose Cultivator of this generation. The trio of Wei Yuan will undoubtedly lose!"
As if the person who had declared Xu Yan would lose before wasn't him!
"You two, have also come to challenge? Go ahead together!"
Xu Yan casually looked at the two young men who had just appeared.
"Arrogant!"
One of them said coldly.
But, gritting his teeth, he came forward with his knife.
The other, his face extremely ugly, held a sword in his hand. However, there was a ridiculous thought in his mind. It felt as though the sword in his hand might disobey his control at any moment, or even attack him!
"Even if Xu Yan's Sword Dao is powerful, I won't improve if I cower!"
Drawing in a deep breath, he let out a low roar. Sword Qi stirred as he also charged at Xu Yan.
At this moment, five prodigal talents were engaged in battle with Xu Yan alone!
The spectators were all shocked, with a hint of excitement growing within their hearts. Today, it seemed like they were about to witness a historic event.
An exceptional Loose Cultivator, facing off against five, dominating the talents of the Spirit Sect— a historic event that would rock the martial arts realm, seemed to be taking place today.
And they would be the witnesses!
More and more martial artists gathered to watch the battle, with both Loose Cultivators and Sect martial artists expressing their excitement, hoping that Xu Yan could single-handedly suppress the Spirit Sect prodigies.
However, not a few of the Sect martial artists had gloomy expressions on their faces.
If Xu Yan won this battle, the widely held belief that Spirit Sect prodigies could dominate over Loose Cultivator prodigies would be shattered. This wasn't a good thing for the Spirit Sect.
Xu Yan narrowed his eyes slightly, his Sword Qi raging. As the Sword Array was deployed, the Mountain and River Sword Dao and Life-and-death Sword Cycle were also continuously unleashed.
Facing five opponents at once, he too felt the pressure.
Although the power of the Sword Array was mighty, the five Wei Yuan prodigies were after all prodigies. Moreover, with their Qi intertwined and their martial arts power fused, the power they unleashed was extraordinarily fierce.
It was as if a single person was performing five completely different offensive techniques, and flawlessly integrating these five offensive techniques together.
Moreover, in terms of level, Wei Yuan's group was two levels higher than Xu Yan.
"Emergence into the Heart Sword Realm means that my heart contains a sword, and all things can form a sword. The sword is equivalent to my heart, and every thought is where the sword resides..."
During the battle, Xu Yan closed his eyes.
At this moment, he had a mysterious realization.
Every sword seemed to be his eyes, revealing different paths of attack at his command.
Heart Sword Realm had a new understanding.
Invisibly, the Sword Intent had somewhat changed.
Between his thoughts, Mountain River Sword Intent and Sudden Wind Sword Intent were interchanging. Faintly, there was a feeling that either Intent could transform into the other at a moment's notice.
It appeared as if the Sword Intent in his heart could float up according to his desires.
"I'm still missing something."
Xu Yan thought to himself.
He had some new insights, taking his Sword Dao to a higher level.
Looking back at the Thousand Martial Hall, he felt a tinge of regret. He lacked strength.
Otherwise, he could have directly turned the sect of the Thousand Martial Hall into a giant sword for his use and destroyed it with a mere thought.
"I'm still lacking some strength."
Xu Yan sighed internally, wondering what level he needed to reach to turn the Thousand Martial Hall into his sword with just a thought.
The Divine Skill Realm?
The Lord of the Thousand Martial Hall and his followers wore gloomy expressions, greed flashing in their eyes. Why couldn't such a powerful and mysterious Sword Dao belong to the Thousand Martial Hall?
No!
It would definitely belong to my Thousand Martial Hall!
They were completely unaware of Xu Yan's thought to turn the Thousand Martial Hall into his sword.
The battle grew increasingly intense. Wei Yuan and his companions put forth their full strength, blending their Martial Arts power into a formidable giant and blasting the incoming sharp swords.
And Xu Yan, sitting with his eyes closed, gained insights into Sword Dao, or even into every single sword.
Gradually, the Sword Array began to change, and so did the Sword Dao.
One sword executed the Mountain River Dragon Chant, while another executed the Thunder Sword...
Each sword executed a different Sword Dao. The Sword Daos cooperated with each other, forming the Sword Array and turning into an attacking Sword Array!
"I'm almost perfect now, my foundation has accumulated enough. It's time for my breakthrough into the Divine Origin Realm!"
Xu Yan sensed the "Momentum of Martial Arts" within him, which had gathered almost to perfection and could not accumulate any further.
The attacks from Wei Yuan's gang, and their Martial Arts Qi, were all absorbed by his Mountain River Sword Intent, feeding his Momentum of Martial Arts and allowing him to understand the different subtleties in their Martial Arts.
A few more prodigies arrived, their eyes full of shock. Xu Yan was fighting alone against five prodigies?
How did those scattered sword lights appear all over the sky?
It seemed that anyone entering it would undoubtedly die!
Xu Yan said nothing. Even if they wanted to join in, they had to restrain themselves. After all, they needed to save some face.
Moreover, it was necessary to respect the rules of competition among prodigies!
The powerful contenders from the seven sects and eight clans of the three countries under the rule of Wei Emperor had all arrived, each with their faces etched with gloominess.
Even when the five collaborated, they couldn't defeat Xu Yan?
Though the might of the current prodigy from the Thousand Martial Hall had never been witnessed, it was doubtful if he was capable of fighting single-handedly against the combined forces of the five men led by Wei Yuan, right?
If it was so, wouldn't it mean that none of the prodigies from the Thousand Martial Hall could stand against Xu Yan?
How could a loose cultivator like Xu Yan be this powerful?
Could one man suppress the prodigies of the Spirit Sect?
Xu Yan's eyes shot open, revealing two sword-like glints.
"It's time to end this!"
This battle had provided a sufficient foundation in Martial Arts for Xu Yan, and now it was time for a breakthrough into the Divine Origin Realm.
With a mere beckoning of his hand, the sword fell into his grasp.
He took a step forward and executed a sword strike.
Boom!
In the Mountain River Sword Array, each sword, in an instant, seemed to transform into a person, each holding a sword, striking together at the same time!
"This is bad!"
At this moment, the five men led by Wei Yuan felt a strong sense of life and death crisis.
"Attack!"
At this moment, a light surged from the five men, and their blood essence also spontaneously ignited at this moment, leading them to execute their life-threatening Martial Arts secret techniques.
Boom!
In the eyes of the stunned Martial Artists, the men led by Wei Yuan seemed to fuse into one, unleashing a faintly blood-colored powerful attack that suddenly emerged.
Boom!
The swords shattered. The attack, seemingly unstoppable, was launched at Xu Yan.
Yet, as Xu Yan's sword fell, the sword in that attack suddenly turned around, counterattacking!
With one sword strike, the prodigies were defeated!

chapters.title: Chapter 552 - 300: The Thousand Martial Lord's Plan, Because You're Too Weak_1
chapters.content:
In the Qianwu State, the first battle of the heavenly prodigies occurred. Xu Yan single-handedly fought against five opponents, and killed five heavenly prodigies right outside the gate of the Thousand Martial Hall!
All the martial artists watched in shock as the sword-wielding youth on the high platform displayed his prowess.
A group of the Thousand Martial Hall's strongmen had somber expressions, fury dancing in their eyes.
Yet, none of them suggested intervening, even less did they propose having their own prodigy stepping in.
The timing wasn't right yet!
The Wei Emperor and others were seething with rage, wishing they could tear Xu Yan apart on the spot. However, as it was a contest among the heavenly prodigies, the rules were set in stone. They could not interfere!
Especially since the Thousand Martial Hall had issued such a command and not one person dared to defy this decree.
The other heavenly prodigies also fell into silence at this moment.
Should they step forward to confront him?
If Wei Yuan and his four companions were no match for him, how could one of them alone ever stand a chance?
Xu Yan's aura was surging, the power of his Divine Intent State had accumulated to its limit and it was time for a breakthrough.
He looked back at the Thousand Martial Hall and said loudly, "Today, I'll slay five of the Heavenly Prodigies from Qianwu State, giving you only half a month to prepare. After half a month, I will come challenge you again.
"I hope the honor of the Transcendent Spirit Sect's Thousand Martial Hall would not leave me disappointed!"
In half a month's time, he would be a martial artist of the Divine Origin Realm.
Once he enters the Divine Origin Realm, not to mention challenging heavenly prodigies of the Refining God Heavenly Man realm, he could even clash with the strongest martial artists who had managed to cultivate the Heavenly Earth Lingji to test his strength.
After saying his piece, Xu Yan didn't linger. He moved and disappeared from his spot in a blink of an eye.
"So fast!"
"What kind of movement technique is that?"
"No wonder Xu Yan had such confidence. Even the strongest martial artists might not be able to catch up with him!"
The watching crowd of martial artists realized that Xu Yan's speed surpassed even those peak Refining God Heavenly Man martial artists known for their swift movements.
The masters of the Thousand Martial Hall looked even more sullen, for they saw Xu Yan's movement technique was so swift that not even the usual strongest martial artists could keep up.
"Lord of the Hall, should we really wait half a month?" a elder asked in a deep voice.
"What could you do while Wu Tianan is here?" replied the Thousand Martial Lord, his voice eerily calm.
"We could select several prodigies from the three large countries and seven ancient families, and spend this half month enhancing their strengths, even cultivating a powerful killing mechanism for them."
The Thousand Martial Lord thought for a moment before speaking.
All the elders felt a chill go down their spines upon hearing this. This would be considered a form of cheating.
However, as this was a measure employed by the Transcendent Spirit Sect, there was no rule against it in the battle of the prodigies, nor any other limits. Plus, if the end complied with the cultivation of the powerful killing mechanism, they would either die or drop realms, unable to ever recover.
This would practically amount to mutual destruction.
Back in the clash with the Wanxing Martial Arts Academy, they made use of their sect's prodigies with this same technique, inflicting heavy damage on the prodigies of Wanxing.
And now, they were going to use it on Xu Yan.
The Thousand Martial Lord thought for a moment, then continued, "And within our own sect, select two or three prodigies who meet the requirements, enhance their strength, cultivate the powerful killing mechanism, and let them temporarily wield the power of Divine Artifacts.
"If necessary, let them take action. Regardless, the timing is not right yet, it's not the time for Hu Bubai and others to step in, this battle among the prodigies will be the last one in Ling domain."
"We must completely crush the All Ages Alliance, kill Wu Tianan, and it's time to make some changes to the ruling methods of the Ling domain."
"The Spirit Beast Tribe and the Azure Sea Spirit Tribe pose threats. When the Divine Bridge opens, we must completely suppress them."
The Thousand Martial Lord's eyes were cold, his words filled with murderous intent.
"Yes, Lord of the Hall!"
All the elders felt a chill run down their spines, realizing that the Lord was planning on changing the entire dynamics of the Ling Domain when the Divine Bridge opened.
The Thousand Martial Lord turned to leave, but stopped as if remembering something. He turned back and said, "There are those within our sect who have been unable to cultivate the Heavenly Earth Lingji despite reaching the peak of Refining God. Those who are growing old, it is time for them to serve the Thousand Martial Hall to their best."
"Let them cultivate the powerful killing mechanism, practice the Burning Life Martial Arts, and when necessary, let them assassinate Xu Yan."
"No one will know that they are from our Thousand Martial Hall, so what can Wu Tianan do?"
"This insolent boy, just because Wu Tianan is backing him, dares to show off his might before my Thousand Martial Hall? Will I let him live?"
"Does Wu Tianan truly believe that he alone can intimidate my Thousand Martial Hall and prevent us from taking any action? Without any proof that the Thousand Martial Hall is responsible, I want to see if Wu Tianan will really act recklessly!"
Upon hearing these words, the expressions of the elders grew solemn.
The Lord of the Hall was planning to use this tactic?
"Lord of the Hall, is it really necessary to go this far?" an elder asked in a deep voice.
"The calamity of the Blood Demon happened because we were not decisive enough. Otherwise, how could the Blood Demon rise? We cannot repeat the same mistake!" the Thousand Martial Lord replied sternly.
"Yes, Lord of the Hall!"
Everyone felt a chill on hearing this.
The Blood Demon calamity was the greatest crisis in the history of the Spirit Sect.
In the eyes of the Lord of the Hall, was the threat level of Xu Yan already on par with the Blood Demon?
The Thousand Martial Lord departed, striding away.
The elders began to put arrangements in place for the following battles, preparing for Xu Yan's challenge in half a month's time.
In the core area behind the Thousand Martial Hall Mountain, there was a gigantic underground hall that one could access through a cave. This massive hall was carved out of a spirit mine, and strange auras emanated from the glowing spirit crystals on its ceiling.

chapters.title: Chapter 553 - 300: The Thousand Martial Lord's Plan, Because You're Too Weak_2
chapters.content:
The originally gleaming Spirit Crystal was now reflecting a colorful halo that constantly changed, resembling the rotation of the four seasons.
At the rear of the lobby, there were several small Spirit Crystal houses. Five of these Spirit Crystal houses were closed, clearly with people inside cultivating in seclusion.
The Thousand Martial Lord watched for a while, the profound aura that permeated from the Spirit Crystal mine into the lobby was very faintly absorbed into the five Spirit Crystal houses.
"All Ages Alliance, Wu Tianan, the essence of the Transcendent Spirit Sect is not something you can comprehend. You are bound to fail in the competition of the Prodigies!"
A murderous intent filled the heart of the Thousand Martial Lord.
"In the past, the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy recruited too many Spirit-body Prodigies, allowing you to show some power. Our core prodigies from the Transcendent Spirit Sect have yet to act."
"This time, let the Loose Cultivators of the Ling Domain witness the true power of our core prodigies from the Transcendent Spirit Sect!
"Wu Tianan, you're a country bumpkin. You think that just because you've practiced some Martial Arts and reached the Spirit Realm Limit, you can act recklessly?
"You're eager to cross the Divine Bridge, but I won't let you!"
Gazing at the five Spirit Crystal houses, the Thousand Martial Lord's expression relaxed. However monstrous Xu Yan was, he could never be compared to the core prodigies from the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
The core prodigies of the Transcendent Spirit Sect have rarely shown themselves in the Ling Domain since time immemorial, and even when they do, their names are never revealed and remain unknown to many.
"The existence of the Transcendent Spirit Sect is for the core prodigies... Wu Tianan, you're nothing but a frog in a well."
The Thousand Martial Lord muttered to himself, then entered an empty Spirit Crystal house and began to cultivate.
…
Xu Yan was preparing to find a place to break through when he suddenly came to a halt and turned around to see a figure rapidly approaching.
The man, who looked like a teacher, had a measuring scale in his hand.
"My, he's powerful!"
The strongest he could sense was this man.
"Friend Xu Yan, please wait a moment."
Wu Tianan greeted him with a smile.
"Who are you?"
Xu Yan halted and asked.
"Wu Tianan."
Wu Tianan's face was filled with smiles. He was very interested in Xu Yan, whose Sword Dao was extremely profound and marvelous.
"What do you want with me?"
Xu Yan pondered; he had never heard of such a powerful figure before.
Looking at the other's appearance, he didn't seem to be from the Spirit Sect. With such immense strength, appearing in front of the Thousand Martial Hall, and intimidating the strength of Thousand Martial Hall, he most likely belonged to the All Ages Alliance.
Could he be the Alliance Hierarch of the All Ages Alliance?
"I noticed that you appear to be a Loose Cultivator, but your Sword Dao is truly astounding and extraordinary, hence my curiosity. May I ask where did you learn your skills?"
Wu Tianan asked with a smile.
"My master is a recluse. The Sword Dao he taught me is naturally unique in this world. To me, the so-called Sword Dao in the Spirit Realm is nothing more than entry-level. All they have touched upon is the threshold of Sword Dao, and they are still far from true competence. To put it bluntly, there is only Swordsmanship in the Spirit Realm and not Sword Dao!"
Xu Yan pondered for a moment before speaking.
Wu Tianan's lip twitched. There was no Sword Dao in the Spirit Realm?
What a bold claim!
But then again, given Xu Yan's mysterious Sword Dao, it was plausible that he would think this way, since the Sword Dao of the Spirit Realm could not achieve such profoundness and wonderment.
If, in Xu Yan's eyes, they haven't even entered the gates of Sword Dao, it wasn't surprising.
As for saying that there is only Swordsmanship but no Sword Dao in the Spirit Realm ... Wu Tianan pondered for a moment, feeling that there was some truth to it.
The Sword Dao in the Spirit Realm centered around the art of killing and exquisite moves, but when compared to Xu Yan's Sword Dao, it fell short. When Xu Yan made his moves, no traces of Swordsmanship could be detected. He had long transcended the scope of Swordsmanship.
So, is this the true Sword Dao?
"Your Master's Sword Dao is indeed one of a kind. It arouses my admiration. I wonder if I could visit your Master to express my respect?"
Wu Tianan asked with his heart moved.
Xu Yan thought for a moment and replied, "To pay a visit to my master, you need his permission. I don't have the authority to decide. After all, my master abhors disputes and prefers to live in a quiet environment. Since you are the Alliance Hierarch of the All Ages Alliance, you can ask Yuzhou Alliance Hierarch to convey your intention."
Wu Tianan was startled. The Yuzhou Alliance Hierarch could contact Xu Yan's master?
He shook his head and said, "You have misunderstood. I am neither the Alliance Hierarch of the All Ages Alliance nor a member."
"Then who are you?"
Xu Yan was surprised. The other party was neither the Alliance Hierarch of All Ages Alliance nor a member of the All Ages Alliance. Could it be a strong individual from Transcendent Spirit Sect?
Wu Tianan pondered for a moment before asking: "Have you ever heard of Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy?"
"I know a bit, the rumor has it that the Spirit Sect destroyed Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy, it already disappeared from the Eighteen States."
Xu Yan nodded.
"Are you a member of the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy?"
Wu Tianan was much stronger than Moon Changming, even though Moon Changming had condensed the Heavenly Earth Lingji and even comprehended some Heaven and Earth Laws, his strength was not as strong as Wu Tianan.
One of the thirty-six heroes of Ten Thousand Stars?
"I was once the headmaster of Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy."
Wu Tianan gave a bitter smile.
Xu Yan knew about Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy, but he didn't know that Wu Tianan was the headmaster of Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy. It showed that not much information about Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy had been handed down in the Eighteen States anymore.
Xu Yan was full of surprise, "You were the headmaster of Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy?"
"Exactly!"
Wu Tianan ruminated, "In the battle of the Martial Academy years ago, I was attacked and plotted against. I was then ambushed by the old guy of the Thousand Martial Hall and seriously injured. Ultimately, the Martial Academy could not recover and was broken up, withdrawing from the Eighteen States."
Xu Yan suddenly realized. No wonder Wu Tianan would appear in the Thousand Martial Hall, so it turns out that he had such a deep hatred with them.
"However, it's for the better. I've unburdened myself and can act freely now. If the Spirit Sect violates the rules of the competition for talent, I can fight back without hesitation.
"Ha, I, Wu Tianan, have walked all the way from the mountain village in the Inner Domain to the peak of Spiritual Realm Martial Arts. The Spirit Sect can't manipulate me as they wish."
Wu Tianan said with a cold smile.
Xu Yan was full of surprise. Wu Tianan came from the Inner Domain?
Moreover, he was the headmaster of Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy. The Seven-star Study Palace, the superior of the Inner Domain in the Spirit Realm, was from Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy. Could Wu Tianan possibly be the ancestor of the Seven-star Study Palace?
Thinking about this, Xu Yan suddenly became interested.
"You come from the Inner Domain? Could you be the ancestor of the Seven-star Study Palace?"
Wu Tianan was shocked, "How do you know about the Seven-star Study Palace?"
"I have heard of it. The Gate of Lingyu was opened, and some people came from the Inner Domain. I heard them talking about it."
Xu Yan nodded.
He did not mention that he came from the Inner Domain. The necessary caution should always be maintained.
"I see!"
Wu Tianan finally understood. He knew a thing or two about the opening of the Gate of Lingyu.
"Yes, I am the founder of the Seven-star Study Palace."
There was no need to hide this.
"I wonder how the Seven-star Study Palace is doing now?"
Speaking of the academy he founded in the Inner Domain, he still felt a trace of nostalgia, and sighs arose in his heart.
"I heard it changed its name."
Xu Yan replied.
"The name was changed, huh."
Wu Tianan sighed regretfully and didn't inquire further.
He respectfully said, "Ever since I reached the pinnacle of Spiritual Realm Martial Arts, I've hardly met a worthy opponent in the Spirit Realm or someone I could discuss Martial Arts with. I suppose your master must be a great master. His strength must have reached the peak of the Spirit Realm by now.
"I want to seek advice from your master, exchange knowledge about martial arts, as well as secrets about heaven and earth in the Spirit Realm."
He revealed his intentions.
Although Xin Mengrou's strength was not weaker than his, after all, she was a member of the Taimiao Sect. The Transcendent Spirit Sect had its own traditional martial arts, so they naturally had a better understanding of the secrets of heaven and earth in the Spirit Realm.
Finally, he came across a martial artist whose strength would not be weaker than his own, and whose sword dao was truly one of a kind. Wu Tianan was confident that as a martial arts scholar and also a Loose Cultivator like him, they would surely have a common language.
Perhaps they could become confidants and explore the secrets of heaven and earth in the Spirit Realm together.
However, Xu Yan shook his head and said, "There's no problem if you want to ask my master for advice. I'm sure my master can guide you. But if it's about exchanging martial art experiences, that's not going to happen."
"Why not?"
Wu Tianan was puzzled. Was Xu Yan's master a stubborn person who was wary of imparting his martial arts knowledge to anyone else?
Xu Yan thought for a while and decided to tell the straight truth, "Because you're too weak!"
Wu Tianan was dumbfounded.
His mind kept echoing Xu Yan's words: because you're too weak!
This was the first time he had heard someone say he was weak!
Even in the confrontation with the Spirit Sect years ago, when he was severely wounded by the previous Lord of the Thousand Martial Hall, the other party did not dare to scorn him by saying: you're too weak!
And yet Xu Yan had actually said that he was too weak?!

chapters.title: Chapter 554 - 301: The Stunning Zhu Xingzheng by two TaiMiao Women_1
chapters.content:
Wu Tianan was completely baffled. Because he was too weak, he wasn't qualified to exchange insights on martial arts with Xu Yan's master?
He took a deep breath and said, "My young friend, you probably don't know the extent of my power, and therefore think I'm weak. Let me tell you, I'm currently at nearly the limit of the Spirit Realm."
He assumed that Xu Yan was underestimating him because of misunderstanding about his power.
They thought that he was just an ordinary strong person who had absorbed the Heavenly Earth Lingji.
But they didn't know that his power had almost reached the limit of the Spirit Realm, and it was definitely not weaker than Xu Yan's master's.
"This is exactly why I said you're weak."
Xu Yan retorted seriously.
Wu Tianan was close to breaking down. Did Xu Yan not understand the concept of being at the limit of the Spirit Realm?
"Dean Wu, although I speak bluntly, I am sharing the truth. I don't want to deceive you."
Xu Yan stated sincerely.
You truly are an honest man!
Wu Tianan scoffed in his heart, but wore an expression of bemusement on his face: "Young friend, you probably don't realize the incredible power of being at the limit of the Spirit Realm. I guarantee that it's definitely not weaker than your master's."
Seeing his stubbornness, believing that being at the summit of the Spirit Realm was already very strong and could match his master, Xu Yan sighed.
He bowed and said, "Dean Wu, the power at the limit of the Spirit Realm truly isn't strong. I admit that you are powerful in the Spirit Realm. But my master has transcended beyond world restrictions and is a genuine world-class expert."
"In my master's eyes, you're truly weak. If you want to visit my master, you can contact the Alliance Hierarch of Yuzhou. If my master agrees to meet you, it's certainly a great opportunity."
"Meeting a great expert is a profound blessing, Dean Wu. I wish you good luck. I must now take my leave."
There was no point in continuing the conversation. The next moment, Xu Yan vanished into thin air.
I must find a place for my breakthrough!
Wu Tianan was dumbfounded, standing motionless and his mind was buzzing.
What was Xu Yan talking about?
His master had transcended beyond the world?
Could martial artists actually transcend beyond the world? What kind of martial arts was that?
He was just thinking about breaking through the limit of the Spirit Realm. Transcending beyond the world was a thought he had never conceived, not just him but probably every martial artist in the world had never thought of it.
"Meeting a great expert is a profound blessing, I wish you good luck?"
Wu Tianan looked in the direction where Xu Yan had gone, his thoughts were in disarray. Were there really people in this world who had transcended beyond the world?
And such an expert was not far from him?
"Alliance Hierarch of Yuzhou? I must meet this expert to see if they're genuinely a great expert!"
At this moment, Wu Tianan's curiosity was piqued, and he even had an absurd thought that he must seize this opportunity.
...
After bidding farewell to Wu Tianan, Xu Yan came to a deserted mountain, sat cross-legged in a spot, and prepared for a breakthrough to Divine Origin Realm.
"This is the place!"
As for whether Wu Tianan believes him or whether his master would meet him, Xu Yan didn't care. As he had said, those who have the opportunity to meet a great expert possess a profound blessing. If Wu Tianan has this fortune, he will naturally meet his master.
He took out the Array Plate from the Storage Ring, waved his hand and set up the formation.
