These Array Plates were crafted by Fang Hao, prepared for dealing with the Spirit Realm. Having the Array Plates on hand made setting up a formation simple.
After all, he wasn't completely ignorant about formations.
After setting up the formation, Xu Yan started breaking through to the Divine Origin Realm.
At the entrance of the Thousand Martial Hall, on the fighting platform, a man killed five acclaimed talents alone. The name "Xu Yan, the Sword God", was being spread rapidly throughout the Spirit Realm.
Meanwhile, the competition of the world's greatest talents in the Great Xuan City was amplified. Talents from various places gathered in the Great Xuan City.
The name of the Blade Master, Meng Chong, was also spreading quickly.
...
In the Taimiao Sect, the peak of the Taimiao mountain where the sect was located towered into the clouds, and was shrouded in mist, making it appear elusive.
On the Taimiao Peak, elegant courtyards dotted the mountainside like chess pieces. Each courtyard was the dwelling of a Taimiao Sect disciple.
Unlike other transcendent Spirit Sects, the number of disciples in the Taimiao Sect was not large, and they did not participate much in martial arts disputes, which made them appear aloof like sects of a different world.
However, the power of Taimiao Sect was always underestimated. It was even rumoured that the Taimiao Sect was the number one among the Spirit Sects, transcending the secular world.
The disciples of the Taimiao Sect were primarily female, but there were male disciples as well, although the requirements for male disciples were very high.
In terms of appearance alone, ninety percent of the world's talents would be eliminated.
The Taimiao Sect did not harbour unattractive people, and this was common knowledge among Spirit Sects.
On the peak of Taimiao, a young girl with flushed cheeks and excitement in her eyes was hopping around in a lively manner, rushing into a courtyard towards a building.
"Young lady, young lady, there is big news, big news!"
She began to exclaim excitedly before she even entered the room.
"Cui'er, remember, you're in the Taimiao Sect! You shouldn't be so loud and impetuous. Calm down."
A woman's voice came from the room.
"Oh, young lady,"
Cui'er pouted and said, "I thought you would be happy to hear about Young Master Xu's news."
"What? News of Young Master Xu?"
Du Yuying rushed out of the room.
She quickly massaged Cui'er's head and asked anxiously, "Tell me quickly, what is the news?"
"Yes, Sister Cui'er, tell us quickly!"
An elegant figure floated over from the neighboring courtyard, her face full of anticipation as she asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 555 - 301: Two Women from Tai Miao, Zhu Xingzheng Stunned _2
chapters.content:
Cui'er suddenly perked up and excitedly said, "Young Master Xu is so powerful, he directly challenged them by blocking the gate of the Thousand Martial Hall!"
As soon as Xu Yan was mentioned, Cui'er became uncontrollably excited, blushing bright red on her cheeks.
At the mention of Xu Yan, Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao suddenly became anxious. Xu Yan had actually dared to challenge the Thousand Martial Hall at the front gate?
This is the Transcendent Spirit Sect!
After entering the Ling Domain, especially since they have joined the Taimiao Sect, they had come to realize deeply how powerful the Transcendent Spirit Sect is. Wouldn't Xu Yan, who had challenged the entrance to the Thousand Martial Hall, be in danger?
"Quickly tell us, how is Young Master Xu doing?"
Du Yuying urged impatiently.
"Young Master Xu is so powerful, he defeated five genius warriors all by himself..."
Cui'er detailed everything about Xu Yan.
"Jian Shen Xu Yan, now has a grand reputation in the Ling Domain, and is known as the first person among the Loose Cultivators."
The more Cui'er spoke, the more excited she became, her eyes filled with admiration. Finally, she asked, "Miss, when will you be with Young Master Xu?"
She could hardly wait to become a lady's maid!
"Xu Yan is so strong? But he has offended the Thousand Martial Hall, even if there are rules for the genius battle, it is rumored that the Thousand Martial Hall is the most shameless..."
Du Yuying looked worried.
Xu Yan's master, that senior, is indeed incredibly strong, but could he stand against the entire Thousand Martial Hall?
She did not know!
"The gap with Xu Yan is getting wider and wider. The genius battle has begun, I cannot fall behind, I have to participate."
Yun Miaomiao gritted her teeth and turned to leave.
"Where are you going?"
Du Yuying asked with a frown.
"To find Ancestor Grandma. I also want to participate in the genius battle, it is just that my current strength is too weak!"
Yun Miaomiao said without looking back.
"I am coming too!"
Du Yuying hastily followed.
In the courtyard, there was only Cui'er left, daydreaming when she could become a lady's maid.
Meanwhile, in another courtyard, Wushuang looked helpless. As soon as Xu Yan's name was mentioned, both her disciple and girl Du seemed to have their souls stolen away.
"What's so good about that boy except for being handsome, strong, and extraordinarily talented?"
She muttered to herself.
She felt that Xu Yan's master was more attractive!
After all, that senior could be the strongest among the strongest!
At the summit of Taimiao Peak, the clouds were thin, everything seemed unreal, like a dream.
Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao respectfully came to the small platform below the peak's summit and bowed.
"Yuying asks to see Ancestor Grandma!"
"Miaomiao asks to see Ancestor Grandma!"
After a while, a dreamlike voice came from the summit, "Come up."
Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao carefully walked to the summit. They came to a grass-house where an enchanting figure was sitting, dim clouds wreathing around her, looking unreal, just like a dream.
Both of them respectfully bowed and lowered their heads, not daring to look directly.
"What do you want to say?"
The voice of Xin Mengrou came.
"Ancestor Grandma, I want to participate in the genius battle, but my current strength is too weak..."
Yun Miaomiao said softly.
"Ancestor Grandma, me too!"
Du Yuying quickly followed.
As the shallow clouds rolled around, there was no sound, the area was silent, and the two girls suddenly became nervous.
"Then just participate."
The voice finally arrived just when the two girls could no longer bear the oppression.
Two jade medals flew over and fell into their hands.
"Take the jade medal to find the Sect Master, she will arrange everything."
Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao were overjoyed and quickly expressed their thanks, "Thank you, Ancestor Grandma!"
They carefully descended the summit with the jade medals in their hands.
At this moment, the person in the grass-house turned around, looking at the two girls descending the mountain. Her exquisite face showed no expression, as if she was indifferent to everything in the world.
However, there was a hint of complexity in the depths of her eyes as bits and pieces of memories floated up in her heart.
These two girls, one was her own bloodline left in the Inner Domain to return a favor, and the other was a legacy she had left in the Inner Domain for the same reason.
"Everything is like a dream, isn't it."
A sigh echoed, making the mist atop the mountain thicken.
...
In Luo State, where the former Chi Ming Sect was located, a manor was being established.
Zhu Xingzheng was busily working, making every effort, while Li Xuan was sitting comfortably in his chair, leisurely reading the Book of Tai Cang.
At this moment, he was already on the ninth page of the book.
He had read half of it already.
The Heaven and Earth Laws on the ninth page were more profound and mysterious, constantly changing – to completely imprint them would require remembering the changes of these laws.
And the changes of the Heaven and Earth Laws on the ninth page weren't something that could be fully understood overnight, it required accumulation over a certain amount of time.
"This page of Heaven and Earth Laws appears to be a fusion of the ninth pages and also seems to be an overarching topic for all pages' Heaven and Earth Laws," Li Xuan pondered.
He was still creating the Divine Skill Martial Code, and had already developed several Small Divine Powers.
"Your apprentice Xu Yan has slain a Refining God Heavenly Man, your combat experience increased."
The Daoist Golden Book opened, gold light gushed out; Xu Yan had slain another Refining God Heavenly Man.
Li Xuan was already accustomed to this.
"Your apprentice Xu Yan has slain a Peak Refining God, you have acquired the sixth form of Oblivion."
Xu Yan's slaying of a Peak Refining God saw him gain the sixth form of Oblivion.
"The nine Oblivion forms combine into a Divine Power, looks like I will have another Divine Power soon."
Li Xuan's face filled with joy.
Of course, the news about Xu Yan would spread soon.
The gifted swordsman, Yu Changfeng, would certainly not be a match for Xu Yan, even if he was the sect master of Sword Sect because he cultivated sword dao and therefore would naturally not be a threat to Xu Yan.
With Xu Yan having attained the small achievement of Heart Sword Realm, facing even the powerfully-skilled Sword Sect master's swordsmanship would already be testament to his considerable strength.
He raised his head to glance at Zhu Xingzheng, this chubby fellow was hardworking to an impressive degree. He had practically built the manor himself, even Shi'er and Meng Shushu weren't doing much.
"Miss Su, what do you think of this manor?"
Zhu Xingzheng asked with a face full of smiles.
"This bottle of Healing Pills is for you, consider it a reward."
Su Lingxiu handed over a bottle of pills.
"Madam, you shouldn't have. I, Zhu Xingzheng, didn't do this for a reward. I really just wanted to spend some more time with Little Jin," he replied earnestly,
"I see you two aren't here to do chores. So, I took the initiative. I have never once thought about any sort of reward." he said sincerely.
At the same time, he deftly stowed the bottle of pills away in his storage bag.
"Alright, you're excused now."
Su Lingxiu rolled her eyes.
She turned to leave but suddenly remembered something, "Oh right, hang a sign, Chang Qing Pavilion, and make sure to spread the word that Chang Qing Pavilion can cure any and all illnesses and injuries of martial artists; things like damaged foundations, damaged Divine Soul, vital energy deficiency, and other extraordinary diseases. We can cure everything."
"But of course, we charge a fee. The heavier the illness or injury, the higher the fee. We don't accept Spirit Crystals as payment - only spiritual medicine or rare resources…"
"When I have the time, I'll make a simple price list for consultations. You help me get the word out."
Zhu Xingzheng was stunned, swallowing hard, he said in shock, "Miss Su, are you joking? You can cure damaged foundations and damaged Divine Souls?"
If a Divine Soul isn't severely damaged, it can be slowly healed with time and soul nourishing spiritual medicine.
If it is severely damaged, it's almost impossible to fully recover.
As for a damaged foundation, it's even less likely to be restored. In the Ling Domain, it's an almost irreversible heavy blow.
"They're all minor issues. As long as you can afford the spiritual medicine, you've seen my pills before. Do you think I would lie to you?"
Su Lingxiu said, raising her chin.
The path her senior and junior brothers were walking did not suit her. Healing and treating illnesses was an excellent way to accumulate her foundation, enhance her insight, and boost her strength.
"I'll definitely do it!"
Zhu Xingzheng's heart was filled with excitement.
There were many severely wounded martial artists in the All Ages Alliance, even some supreme beings who were almost crippled due to injuries inflicted by the Transcendent Spirit Sect's divine artifacts. Surviving was already hard enough, let alone recovering.
"We'll know if it works after we try. Let's find someone to test it out."
Zhu Xingzheng planned to find someone to test it on. After all, they were already severely injured. What if they could actually be healed?
"Get going and hang the sign for Chang Qing Pavilion already."
Su Lingxiu said.
Having finished speaking, she took out a bottle of medicine and walked towards the Golden Horned Deer. As she was used to feeding the Red Cat, she took out a pill and threw it to the deer without hesitation.
"Come on, I've got a pill for you!"
The Golden Horned Deer was extremely excited and let out a light call. It lifted its forelegs, opened its mouth, and caught the thrown pill.
Zhu Xingzheng was dumbfounded. That was a pill! It was just given to the Golden Horned Deer like that?
His teasing words to the Golden Horned Deer couldn't possibly come true, right? That it would never lack pills in the future?

chapters.title: Chapter 556 - 302: New Situation in Yuzhou, Idea of Building a Flying Boat_1
chapters.content:
Su Lingxiu looked at the Golden Horn Deer. Its appearance was quite appealing, but it couldn't compare to the chunkiness and soft feel of the Red Cat.
She suddenly missed her pet, the Red Cat.
Feeling somewhat dispirited, she tossed the bottle of pills in her hand over and said, "Here, take it!"
The Golden Horn Deer was ecstatic. After catching the medicine, it started expressing its appreciation.
What a good master!
Zhu Xingzheng didn't fool it, he was really looking out for its best interests!
Meanwhile, Zhu Xingzheng was stupefied, she had given the entire bottle of pills to the Golden Horn Deer?
Su Lingxiu went into her room, started preparing the gold for treatment, and got ready to treat the next martial artist.
Yue'er also came in, assisting Su Lingxiu.
"Did Zhu Xingzheng stay with some ulterior motive?"
Yue'er asked in a low voice.
"No matter, let him have his schemes, they won't succeed. If he doesn't leave, consider him free labor. In any case, I've given him a bottle of healing pills, that should be more than enough for his payment."
Su Lingxiu said nonchalantly.
Yue'er nodded. With an elder in the room, no matter what Zhu Xingzheng plotted, he would only bring trouble upon himself.
"Little Jin, show me the pill. What are its effects?"
At this moment, Zhu Xingzheng came to the Golden Horn Deer with a smiley face.
"It's a pill that can enhance the user's abilities!"
The Golden Horn Deer was extremely excited, its eyes filled with expression of gratitude. If Zhu Xingzheng hadn't sold it, how could it have obtained such a valuable pill?
Therefore, it didn't have the slightest guard up and handed over the pill to Zhu Xingzheng.
"There's a bit too much in this pill. This is what we'll do, Little Jin, you keep this one pill, I'll keep the rest."
Zhu Xingzheng poured out a pill and handed it to the Golden Horn Deer, pocketing the rest.
"No way, these are mine!"
The Golden Horn Deer started losing its temper.
Whack!
Zhu Xingzheng slapped it on the head and asked, "Do you think I'm embezzling your pill? I, Zhu Xingzheng, am an upright and just person.
"I'm considering your father. This pill is meant for him. Now that he has the opportunity, if your father takes the pill, he might have the chance to become a level six spirit beast.
"He's almost at level six, does he need to be accompanied by stronger creatures?"
The Golden Horn Deer wanted to say something, but Zhu Xingzheng smacked it on the head again and angrily said, "Are you incapable of filial piety?
"Little Jin, how can you be this kind of deer?
"If Miss Su and Miss Yue knew about this, knew that you are an unfilial deer, what would their opinion of you be?
"If they knew you were an unfilial deer, would they still treat you so highly?"
The Golden Horn Deer's face turned red with shame. "You're right, take the pills and give them to my father."
Zhu Xingzheng nodded in satisfaction.
"This is how it should be. In future, you keep thirty percent of the pills and hand the rest to me to give to your father."
"No...no. I can't do that."
The Golden Horn Deer was dumbfounded. Losing seventy percent all at once, it was hurting.
That's not how respect for one's father is displayed.
Zhu Xingzheng sighed and said, "Little Jin, it's your father, he's about to become a level six spirit beast, he needs more pills. Besides, once your father becomes a level six spirit beast, means you have a level six backing."
"Is 70 percent too much? Moreover, Miss Su and Miss Yue might grant you even more pills, knowing your filial piety. If so, your pill count would actually increase."
The Golden Horn Deer blinked its eyes, it took a while for its tiny brain to process, but it felt like Zhu Xingzheng had a good point.
"Well...alright then!"
It nodded in agreement.
"That's like it, be a filial deer. Look at Miss Su, she's so filial to her master. Once she knows about your filial piety, she'll naturally think well of you and your number of pills would naturally increase."
Zhu Xingzheng patted the Golden Horn Deer's head and nodded in satisfaction.
Li Xuan watched all this and was rendered speechless. What a way to con the spirit beast Zhu Xingzheng had!
After duping the Golden Horn Deer, Zhu Xingzheng started making a signboard for the Chang Qing Pavilion. He completed Su Lingxiu's assignment flawlessly, and then asked Su Lingxiu if his injured elder could come for treatment.
Su Lingxiu nodded and asked him to bring the person over, while preparing for the necessary spiritual medicine for the diagnostic gold.
A manor was built at the location of the abandoned Chi Ming Sect's site. The plaque "Chang Qing Pavilion" naturally caught the attention of the Luo State's Spirit Sects.
All of them watched quietly, wondering where the Chang Qing Pavilion came from, whether it was from the All Ages Alliance, Thousand Martial Hall or Lei Yun Mountain Manor.
If it was before, some Spirit Sect families would have come directly to inquire about the background, but after the battle with the All Ages Alliance, and witnessing Chang Daniu's great power, the families of the Spirit Sect here began to tread lightly.
In particular, since Yu Changfeng was killed not long ago and the head of the Sword Sect was also killed, the loose cultivators who had been trampled in the mud suddenly stood up straight.
Even Fan Kaisan, the strongest being of Lei Yun Mountain Manor who is located in Luo State, had a bad expression on his face.
Su Lingxiu was currently maintaining contact with Fang Hao through a Communication Talisman, getting the latest news of the Spiritual Realm Martial Way World. As for Xu Yan and Meng Chong, they were too far away and exceeded the range of the Communication Talisman, so she couldn't get in touch with them.
Even though her disciples were making their way in the world, Li Xuan just moved to another place, continued to leisurely probe the Laws of Heaven and Earth, and continued to compile the Divine Skill Martial Code.

chapters.title: Chapter 557 - 302: New Situation in Yuzhou, Idea of Building a Flying Boat_2
chapters.content:
Every once in a while, the Daoist Golden Book would feedback, either about Xu Yan slaying a Refining God Heavenly Man or about Meng Chong slaying a Refining God Heavenly Man.
It seems that both my first and second disciples are on a killing spree.
Fang Hao, the Alliance Hierarch of the Yuzhou Alliance, met with Yuzhou's strongest person, Shen Tai, and reached some agreements. Moreover, Fang Hao made his appearance directly, putting pressure on the remaining Spirit Sects and aristocratic families.
The Yuzhou Alliance officially surfaced. And it smoothly took over the territories of the former Yushen Sect and the Su Family, which is now public knowledge.
Of course, when the territories were taken over, it was done under the guise of defeating the strongest members of the Shen family. The transaction with the Shen family was kept hidden and not exposed.
The Shen Family is a worldly family, and with its status, it can obtain some information about the Spirit Sect and worldly families privately.
Therefore, there is no need to expose each other's relationships. Once exposed, it would not be good for both parties.
After stabilizing the situation in Yuzhou, the Yuzhou Alliance officially secured its place.
In addition, it continued to issue regulations for loose cultivators and published principles about equal coexistence with the Spirit Sect and worldly families and equal sharing of resources, and so forth.
Furthermore, it continued to eliminate Spirit Sects and worldly families of the second rank and below. Only top-tier Spirit Sects and worldly families remain in Yuzhou. The situation has maintained a balance, with the Spirit Sect and worldly families representing one faction and the Yuzhou Alliance representing another.
As for Zheng Country, the Yuzhou Alliance did not interfere, allowing Zheng Country to continue maintaining its neutral and special status and performing some of its assigned tasks.
By now, the situation in Yuzhou had undergone earth-shaking changes.
Loose Cultivators truly have their place.
Besides that, Martial Arts Cultivation Techniques have started to be disseminated, garnered from the Yushen Sect and the Su Family.
Among the eighteen states of the Ling Domain, apart from Chenzhou where the Wanshi Alliance headquarters is located, Yuzhou is the only one of the other seventeen states that have genuinely carved out a place for Loose Cultivators and coexisted equally with the Spirit Sect and worldly families.
The name of Fang Hao, the Alliance Hierarch of Yuzhou, also began to spread in the Ling Domain. The Wanshi Alliance headquarters was shocked. The Alliance Hierarch of the Yuzhou Alliance had quietly changed to a different person.
Suddenly, he accomplished what the Wanshi Alliance had always wanted to complete.
Fang Hao continued to rectify Yuzhou, continually announcing a series of rules, setting up an intelligence system, constructing a communication system, replacing the outdated Flying Swallow message-delivery method.
He set up formations in the Spirit Crystal mines and built the great city of the Yuzhou Alliance.
After Shen Tai said he was powerless to prevent the Yuzhou Alliance, the other top-tier Spirit Sects and worldly families had no choice but to sign an agreement under Fang Hao's pressure.
Moreover, seeing the Shen Family seize the opportunity to expand their territory, taking over the territory and resources originally owned by second-tier and lower Spirit Sects and worldly families, they were also green with envy.
Normally, to take over the territory of a Spirit Sect or worldly family, there needs to be a proper reason. Moreover, they need to bring down the opposing party with their strength, and finally, they have to report to receive acknowledgment and approval from the upper sects.
Generally speaking, without a proper reason, it is not permitted to launch a full-scale attack to fully occupy the other Spirit Sects and worldly families. Otherwise, they will be punished by the upper sects.
These are the unspoken rules of the Spirit Sect controlling the entire Ling Domain; everything has to be carried out under the rules of the Spirit Sect.
However, the Wanshi Alliance is not bound by these rules, so it is very logical and appropriate for the Yuzhou Alliance to defeat the second-rank and lower Spirit Sects and worldly families, and for the Shen Family to take over opportunistically. Not only does this not violate the rules, but it is also considered preserving the territory of the Spirit Sect from loss.
Precisely because of this, after Fang Hao privately promised that they could have some territories and resources from the second-tier and lower Spirit Sects and worldly families, the remaining top-tier Spirit Sects and worldly families instantly agreed.
They completely ignored the pleas for help from the second-tier and lower Spirit Sects and worldly families. And so, the second-tier and lower Spirit Sects and worldly families were quickly annihilated.
Neither the Thousand Martial Hall nor Lei Yun Mountain Manor had the time to care about the situation in Yuzhou. After all, Yuzhou's overall strength is relatively weak and Zheng Country was not affected.
They tacitly maintained Zheng Country's special status, and that was enough.
The name of Fang Hao was also taken note of by the major Spirit Sects.
An enormous eagle was flying through the clouds in mid-air. On the eagle's back sat three people.
Zhu Xingzheng looked respectful, "Uncle Master, Miss Su said she can heal you. Since you're already in this state, treating a dead horse as though it's alive isn't a bad idea. If she can actually cure you, that would be a piece of good fortune."
Next to Zhu Xingzheng was a man with hair burnt black, the right half of his face also burnt black, breathing heavily, weak and infrequent, occasionally shaking his head as if trying to stay focused. His face turned even darker at the moment.
What does treating a dead horse as though it's alive mean?
"Fatty, does this kind of divine doctor really exist? If she can't heal me, then me agreeing to help your Wanshi Alliance this time would be a great loss."
Another person on the eagle's back sighed.
This was a beautiful woman, but on her soft cheeks was a patch of black as if a blemish on exquisite porcelain.
She was dressed in a gown that glowed brilliantly in the sunlight.
What was even more eye-catching, were the fin-like cicada wings on her elbows, which occasionally opened to reveal a fan shape that flowed with brilliant radiance.
Her slender attractive legs also bore similar fins at her ankles.
Sitting next to her, one could feel a sense of moisture, as if there were mist gathering around her.
The Sea Spirit Tribe!
A unique race of the Azure Sea and also its dominant race, the Sea Spirit Tribe.
"Don't worry senior, we should be able to cure them."
Zhu Xingzheng withdraws his smile, saying this without much certainty.
"We, the Wanshi Alliance, will not forget this favor. We will do everything in our power to find heaven-sent treasures that can restore your health."
The man with half of his face charred said solemnly.
"You should take care of yourself. Half of you is burnt."
The woman rolled her eyes and said.
The speed of the sixth-order spirit beast really attracted the attention of many martial artists, especially the powerhouses from the Spirit Sect noble families.
"If they are not people from the Yu Ling Mansion, how did the Wanshi Alliance manage to strike cooperation with the beast tribe?"
A Refining God Heavenly Man from the Cangyun Dynasty frowned.
"Are they heading to the Changqing Pavilion? It seems like the Changqing Pavilion belongs to the Wanshi Alliance."
Seeing the direction the eagle was heading, the faces of the Spirit Sect powerhouses darkened.
"Did Zhu Xingzheng come back?"
Su Lingxiu and Yue'er looked up at the eagle that appeared in the sky, a sixth-order spirit beast.
Li Xuan suddenly felt upset.
Looking at the golden deer, though it appeared valuable, it was still a sixth-order spirit beast. Moreover, riding a spirit beast did not highlight his superior status.
Among the powerhouses in the Spirit Realm, not all of them traveled by spirit beasts.
For instance, the people from the Yu Ling Mansion.
"Traveling by spirit beast is too common. As an extraordinary person, how can I be so ordinary?"
A thought came to Li Xuan with a flash of inspiration.
"The flying boat! How could I forget about it? I've mastered the artifact refining technique, the formation, and all restrictions. Why not refine a flying divine artifact?"
"Both the Spirit Realm or the entire Taicang do not have any flying divine artifacts or flying boats. As an extraordinary person, only traveling by flying boat can show my remarkable status."
The more Li Xuan thought about it, the more excited he became. The flying boat, which could be big or small, can be put into the storage ring when it's small, or become hundreds and even thousands of feet long when it's big...
"What a great idea! Why haven't I thought of that before? It's time to give Fang Hao something to do. He can refine a flying boat for me!"
Li Xuan looked up at the large eagle descending from the sky.
"Huh?"
He was a little surprised when his eyes landed on the Sea Spirit Tribe woman.
"Is this the Sea Spirit Tribe? They look really hydrated. Is it because they live in the sea?"
He involuntarily thought of mermaids in his mind.
Of course, there is a great difference between the Sea Spirit Tribe and mermaids.
Sea Spirit Tribe members below the Heavenly Man Realm aren't able to stay on land for too long. Once they break through to the Heavenly Man Realm, they can walk on land.
However, only those in the Refining God Heavenly Man Realm can freely roam the land for a long time without any impact.
But if they are severely injured, they must return to the water for a quicker recovery.
The Sea Spirit Tribe woman in front of them is severely injured. Due to her strong power, she can still walk on land without going back into the water to heal.
Moreover, her injuries are somewhat unique. Even if she returned to the water, she might not be able to recover.
"Miss Su, we have a patient!"
Zhu Xingzheng helped the man off the eagle's back.
"Quick, quick, lay down."
Su Lingxiu was excited and pushed the prepared sickbed. She asked the man to lie down.
Being looked at by the excited and eager Su Lingxiu shot down Jiao Li's expectations. How could a young girl possibly treat his injuries?
Could it be that Zhu Xingzheng had been tricked?
However, since he was already here, it didn't hurt to try. As Zhu Xingzheng said, there was nothing to lose; it was time to treat a dead horse as if it were still alive.
So, he laid on the sickbed.

chapters.title: Chapter 558 - 303 Too Scary_1
chapters.content:
Li Xuan glanced at Jiao Li, and quickly understood the extent of his injuries.
His Divine Soul was damaged, his essence and blood were almost entirely depleted, more than half of his flesh had been charred by lightning, and even the Heavenly Earth Lingji he had cultivated into his Divine Soul was on the verge of disintegrating.
He was a martial artist who was even stronger than Huang Liang, having cultivated two strands of Heavenly Earth Lingji.
However, at this moment, he was severely injured and bordering on uselessness.
Especially his injury to the Divine Soul, which made him unable to concentrate, often distracts him and he had to focus over 90% of his attention on maintaining the integrity of the Heavenly Earth Lingji, to prevent it from crumbling.
This led to him being even more prone to distraction, and he would occasionally shake his head in an attempt to alleviate the distracted state of his mind.
In a way, his injuries were even more severe than those Moon Changming had initially suffered from, mainly injuries to his Divine Soul.
"Injured by the Artifact of Lei Yun Mountain Manor?"
Li Xuan made a judgment.
The news of the battle between the All Ages Alliance and the Transcendent Spirit Sect had already spread, and it was also known that the Lei Yun Mountain Manor and others had used divine artifacts to repel the powerhouses of the All Ages Alliance.
"The power of this artifact is not too strong, it's mediocre."
Li Xuan evaluated it, Lei Yun Mountain Manor's divine artifact was just so-so.
If there were enough suitable materials, Fang Hao could refine a weapon with even greater power.
"Lie down and don't move. Let me examine you."
Su Lingxiu was excited. The first time Chang Qing Pavilion opened in the Spirit Realm, such a heavily injured patient arrived as her perfect opportunity to test the diagnostic spiritual artifact!
Yue'er was also very excited, she pushed a small cart over and stopped it at the head of the sick-bed.
This small cart was quite unique with a square instrument on it, though it was unclear what it was for.
When Li Xuan saw this small cart, he couldn't help but smile.
This was the diagnostic instrument he had mentioned once. With this tool, even without Su Lingxiu's art of Dan medicine, a diagnosis could be made.
It was for this reason that Su Lingxiu had studied Artifact Refining with Fang Hao for a while, in order to refine such a diagnostic spiritual artifact according to her own insights and ideas.
Of course, this endeavor had not been without the assistance of Fang Hao.
Now, the diagnostic spiritual artifact could be put to use.
Zhu Xingzheng looked at this small cart and was somewhat dumbfounded. Were they playing a game here?
Cai Ling'er was also full of curiosity, as she stood in front of the bed watching Su Lingxiu treat Jiao Li.
Excited, Su Lingxiu pulled a tube from the diagnostic spiritual artifact, and the tip of the tube was fitted with a patch-like device.
She applied it to Jiao Li's forehead.
Then, while Yue'er handed over the tube to Su Lingxiu, she stared at the square instrument.
Her finger touched the instrument, and originally blank, smooth screen lighted up, displaying a vague image along with several wavy lines.
Jiao Li only felt something warm on his forehead, like it was probing his Divine Soul, and the tube attached to his chest seemed to examine his entire body.
At this moment, he felt a bit confused. Could this be an attempt to harm him?
However, he did not struggle, instead he waited silently, wanting to see how they would proceed next.
"The results are coming out!"
Su Lingxiu was thrilled, staring at the instrument screen.
This was the first diagnostic spiritual artifact, whose effectiveness and precision necessitated a series of verifications.
Zhu Xingzheng and Cai Ling'er also stared with curiosity.
Could this thing diagnose injuries?
As martial artists, especially those who had cultivated their Divine Soul, it's easy for them to determine their injuries. Why bother with all the hassle of using a bizarre spiritual artifact for diagnosis?
Results appeared on the diagnostic spiritual artifact.
Rows of words emerged on the smooth screen.
"Divine Soul injured, reached its origin, symptoms include inability to concentrate, frequent distraction…"
"Essence and blood depleted by 90%, evaporated due to high heat, flesh charred, burned by lightning…"
Zhu Xingzheng and Cai Ling'er seemed a bit stunned seeing the diagnosis lines listed on the instrument.
They knew that Jiao Li's Divine Soul was damaged, and his essence and blood were depleted, these injuries were well known and easy to determine.
However, such detailed diagnoses, even determining the location of the damage to the Divine Soul and the causes of the depletion of essence and blood, were displayed on this spiritual artifact, making it more detailed than their own assessments.
After taking a look, Su Lingxiu nodded in satisfaction. Although the diagnostic result was not as accurate as her own, it was nevertheless remarkable, considering that a mere diagnostic spiritual artifact could make such a detailed diagnosis.
Yue'er was excited: "If it can also generate a treatment plan, then it will be even more perfect. Diagnosis and treatment integrated!"
Su Lingxiu had a bright idea and clapped her hands: "That's a good point, we can ponder on that."
She put the tube that was attached to Jiao Li back into the spiritual artifact and upon seeing Cai Ling'er, Su Lingxiu's eyes lit up as if she had discovered some treasure.
The look in her eyes made Cai Ling'er feel a bit confused.
What kind of look was that from this girl?
"You also got injured, and it's not minor. Come, come, let me diagnose you."
The Sea Spirit Tribe.
This was the first time she met one, and moreover, a powerhouse of the Sea Spirit Tribe.
Su Lingxiu even had an idea to dissect a member of the Sea Spirit Tribe, to see what the difference between them and the Human Clan was.
"Shi'er, quickly wheel another bed over!"
She cried out.
"Coming!"
Shi'er, who was practising his knife skills, hurriedly pushed over another sick-bed.
"Respected elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe, please lie down and I will diagnose you."
Su Lingxiu and Yue'er, on both sides, excitedly helped an utterly confused Cai Ling'er onto the bed.
Then, they took several tubes from the diagnostic spiritual artifact and attached them to Cai Ling'er's body.

chapters.title: Chapter 559 - 303 Too Scary_2
chapters.content:
Cai Ling'er looked at Su Lingxiu, stroking her cheeks and the fin at her elbows. Her eyes gleamed alarmingly, as if she had some sinister ideas.
Yue'er looked almost the same.
The diagnostic findings were in, and Su Lingxiu glanced at them, her delicate eyebrows furrowing slightly.
"Is there some discrepancy because of the Sea Spirit Tribe?"
The results from the Spiritual Artifact were slightly different from her own diagnosis. Was this discrepancy due to Cai Ling'er being from the Sea Spirit Tribe?
Did this mean that the Sea Spirit Tribe's physical and divine soul structures differed from those of the Human Clan, leading to the discrepancies in the Spiritual Artifact's diagnosis?
Interested in the Sea Spirit Tribe's physical structure, Su Lingxiu put Jiao Li aside.
"Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe..."
Su Lingxiu began, meditating on her words.
"Just call me Cai Ling'er. Stop calling me elder, it makes me feel old."
Cai Ling'er stated.
"Sister Cai Ling'er, could we make a deal? For this treatment, I won't charge you a consultation fee, but could you let me research you a bit?"
Su Lingxiu asked, her face full of anticipation.
"Not charging a consultation fee? Are you sure you can heal me?"
Cai Ling'er was shocked. Was this little girl joking?
"Of course, Sister Cai Ling'er's injuries are a small matter to me."
Su Lingxiu reassured.
Cai Ling'er was about to agree when she suddenly remembered what Su Lingxiu meant by "research."
"What do you mean by research?"
Su Lingxiu, her face full of anticipation and excitement, took out a thin, razor-sharp scalpel and said, "You see, Sister Cai Ling'er, you're part of the Sea Spirit Tribe, and I want to see what differences exist between the Sea Spirit Tribe and the Human Clan in terms of physical structure and so on."
Cai Ling'er looked at the scalpel in Su Lingxiu's hand, a bad feeling rising, but she still asked, "How do you plan to research?"
Su Lingxiu gestured with the scalpel in her hand, saying, "Dissection. That way, we can clearly see the structural differences, including those in Martial Arts cultivation, and even the soul. Don't worry, Sister Cai Ling'er, you're strong and venerated, plus with the elixirs I've prepared, there won't be any danger to your life, or pain.
And I promise, after the research, you will remain unharmed, no loss at all."
Dissection?!
Cai Ling'er's hairs stood on end as she jumped off the bed, "Are you trying to harm me? Are you from the Spirit Sect?"
Unscathed after a dissection?
Even thinking about it was terrifying!
Jiao Li, who had been lying on the bed, sat up in shock.
Zhu Xingzheng went into a daze as he saw Su Lingxiu, knife in hand, bright-eyed, eager to dissect Cai Ling'er of the Sea Spirit Tribe, he felt his heart sink and tremble.
She was terrifying!
Li Xuan was speechless. Ever since he had allowed Su Lingxiu to dissect and study the undead from the Yinlou Pavilion in the Inner Domain, she had made many new research breakthroughs.
She was very skilled in dissection.
Seeing Cai Ling'er from the Sea Spirit Tribe now, she was immediately interested, but Cai Ling'er wasn't a corpse. Was Su Lingxiu really bold enough to ask for her consent for dissection?
Only if Cai Ling'er had water in her brain, would she agree to that!
"Sister Cai Ling'er, don't be angry. I'm not from the Spirit Sect, and I definitely don't mean any harm. I just want to deeply study the differences between the Sea Spirit Tribe and the Human Clan."
Su Lingxiu hurriedly interjected.
Despite not believing her, Cai Ling'er prepared to fend for herself.
"Cough!"
Li Xuan cleared his throat, "Girl, don't be foolish!"
"All right, Master!"
Su Lingxiu replied, visibly disappointed.
Cai Ling'er's aggressive aura dissipated instantly, and her eyes widened in shock at Li Xuan.
Although that cough seemed rather mundane to others, it echoed deafeningly in her soul, capable of shattering it at any moment!
Such a formidable presence!
At that moment, Cai Ling'er dared not show any further aggression, understanding that he was warning her!
Since Cai Ling'er wasn't willing, even though Su Lingxiu was disappointed, she didn't force the issue and started treating Jiao Li.
"Your Divine Soul is damaged, your foundation is compromised, and your vital essence is depleted by ninety percent. Your flesh is charred and remains ignited by lightning energy..."
Su Lingxiu explained his injuries one by one, then turned to Zhu Xingzheng and asked, "Where's the consultation fee?"
"Here, here it is!"
Zhu Xingzheng hurriedly handed over a bag for storing items.
Yue'er took it, opened it to check, and nodded, "The consultation fee is acceptable!"
"Lie down properly, I'm going to treat you now!"
Su Lingxiu nodded, pressed down on Jiao Li's shoulder, making him lie on the sickbed. Though half-crippled, Jiao Li was unable to resist even if he wanted to. His heart was shocked, this girl is really strong!
Swish!
The Golden Needle, in a mere moment, pierced into Jiao Li's body. At the same time, Su Lingxiu took out a pill and put it into Jiao Li's mouth.
"This is a pill to replenish your vital essence and blood."
Cai Ling'er was anxiously watching the situation from time to time. When she saw Li Xuan leisurely reading a book and showing no signs of causing trouble, she let out a small sigh of relief.
She then focused all her attention on Su Lingxiu treating Jiao Li.
She had never seen or heard of this treatment method, namely the use of some kind of pill.
"You have residual thunderous energy in your flesh and blood, so we need to use a pill to expel the heat of the thunderous energy, as well as the Golden Needle to transfer the energy out."
As Su Lingxiu spoke, she took out some spiritual medicine.
A flame emerged, and she began to concoct the necessary pill on the spot.
This scene left Cai Ling'er and Zhu Xingzheng in awe. What is this method?
The medicinal properties of those spiritual medicines are not the same, but they can be combined together?
"My vital essence and blood are recovering rapidly!"
Jiao Li suddenly exclaimed in surprise.
His vital essence and blood, which was almost depleted and damaged at its very source, was unable to be replenished even with the aid of spiritual medicine. However, it did prevent further depletion.
Moreover, his charred flesh still retained thunderous energy, which had not yet been expelled, making it impossible to make up for the depletion of his vital essence and blood.
As a result, after eating a pill, he suddenly found that his vital essence and blood were regenerating and beginning to recover!
How could he not be shocked?
"Stay calm!"
Yue'er patted his shoulder seriously and said.
"Yes, yes!"
Jiao Li hurriedly nodded, but he couldn't help but breathe heavily. It seemed that there was indeed hope for his recovery.
The astonishment on Cai Ling'er's and Zhu Xingzheng's faces was palpable. Can his injuries actually be cured?
Not long after, the antidote for expelling the thunderous energy was prepared, and Su Lingxiu said solemnly: "Come, take this pill!"
Jiao Li did as instructed and took the pill.
A moist and cool sensation spread throughout his body, and the burning pain of the thunderous energy gradually lessened.
At this moment, Su Lingxiu was meticulously injecting the Golden Needles into him in a certain sequence, vibrating the needles while manipulating them in a precise rhythm, her expression growing more serious.
After all, this was her first time treating such injuries and expelling the residual force in the patient's body.
However, Jiao Li felt that the thunderous energy in his body was converging towards his right palm. It seemed to be inflating slowly, turning red and emitting heat.
If it weren't for a warm sensation protecting him, he would have suspected that his right palm would have been charred and necrotic!
"Raise your hand up!"
Su Lingxiu ordered.
Jiao Li reflexively raised his right hand, and with a flick of Su Lingxiu's finger, a Golden Needle slid across his fingertips. With a plop, his fingers spurt out thunderous energy.
After a good while, the thunderous energy disappeared, and his palm returned to normal.
"Take this pill, it can help regenerate your flesh."
Su Lingxiu again gave Jiao Li another pill to eat.
Then, all the Golden Needles went into Jiao Li's head. "I'm going to treat your divine soul injury. This process will be very painful. If you can't bear it, take this pill and enter a deep sleep. When you wake up, your divine soul will be fully repaired."
Having come this far in the treatment and seeing the hope of recovery, Jiao Li naturally took the pill without hesitation, and then fell into a deep sleep.
Su Lingxiu was secretly excited, but she looked seriously at Zhu Xingzheng and Cai Ling'er and said, "Treating a divine soul injury is no easy task, and it needs to be done in a closed room to avoid external influences. You should wait here!"
"I trust Miss Su!"
Zhu Xingzheng said with a serious face.
Cai Ling'er didn't say anything. If the other party did have ill intentions, it would be easy for them to handle her given their frightening strength.
Yue'er had already pushed the sickbed away and went inside the room with Su Lingxiu.

chapters.title: Chapter 560 - 304 Divine Truth, Collapsed Jiao Li_1
chapters.content:
Li Xuan watched as Su Lingxiu and Yue'er excitedly pushed the sickbed into the room, as if preparing to do something that must stay hidden from sight.
"This girl, she's not thinking about dissecting his Divine Soul, is she?"
A thought sprang up, and Li Xuan couldn't help but inhale sharply.
Su Lingxiu, this lass, was really delving deeper and deeper into the path of medicinal martial arts. She was even beginning to prepare to dissect the Divine Soul.
"She isn't going to dissect his soul and then be unable to put it back together, is she?"
Li Xuan couldn't help but question.
With a thought, the scene in the room became clear before him.
Su Lingxiu was setting up a restriction, one she had specifically researched for medicinal martial arts, similar to a restriction that seals spiritual medicine.
A soul sealing restriction.
She then dripped a drop of elixir liquid onto Jiao Li's head.
"I'm ready!"
Su Lingxiu's expression became solemn.
Yue'er was a bit nervous, yet also excited, she asked, "Are you sure there will be no problems?"
"Don't worry, there won't be any problems. It's essential for a medicinal martial artist to treat and understand the Divine Soul,"
Su Lingxiu stated confidently.
"If we could completely understand the secret of the Divine Soul's origin, pinpoint the Divine Soul's root, then enhancing the cultivation of the Divine Soul would greatly improve; and therefore, I could also increase my power quickly."
Yue'er stated with a hopeful expression.
Su Lingxiu was adjusting the Golden Needle inserted into Jiao Li's head with her True Yuan, initiating a certain pattern of operation. Gradually, a faint ripple started appearing on Jiao Li's head.
Slowly, the ripple took on a human form. Once it floated above the head, the ripple began to solidify and transformed into a somewhat ethereal figure, crafted like ripples in a pond.
This was Jiao Li's Divine Soul.
However, the Divine Soul seemed slightly damaged, appearing somewhat tattered.
At the core of the Divine Soul, there were two breaths of spiritual rhyme that seemed ready to disperse at any time. That was the Heavenly Earth Lingji that Jiao Li had refined.
"So this is the Divine Soul of a superior individual, it is a lot more condensed.
Yue'er exclaimed.
A human-shaped ripple emerged from her head. It was her Divine Soul, which seemed much more ethereal compared to Jiao Li's and not as solid.
"This is the Heavenly Earth Lingji he refined. It cannot disperse, I'll seal it first,"
Su Lingxiu said carefully. She inputted her True Yuan into the Divine Soul, using the restriction to seal the Heavenly Earth Lingji to avoid it from dispersing.
Her True Yuan did not cause any harm to the Divine Soul when entering it, but instead invigorated it. This showcased the unique abilities of a medicinal martial artist.
Then Su Lingxiu started to research the Divine Soul, investigating its secrets. Yue'er, both nervous and excited, watched attentively, trying to glean some knowledge about the secrets of the Divine Soul.
Jiao Li's Divine Soul was significantly damaged. The method Su Lingxiu was now using to heal it was not by restoring it with elixir but by using external means to repair the defects in the Divine Soul.
The True Yuan transformed into strands and a small knife, carefully repairing the damaged Divine Soul of Jiao Li. At the same time, it gently separated some part of it, explored the secrets of the Divine Soul, and then reintegrated it.
Yue'er watched closely, her Divine Soul power silently observing Jiao Li's Divine Soul's changes.
Previously, Su Lingxiu had also studied her Divine Soul, but because her Divine Soul was fragile, she wasn't able to delve too deep into it.
Now was an excellent opportunity.
"The Divine Soul concerns consciousness and everything. Losing the Divine Soul would mean losing consciousness, memory and so forth. My True Yuan won't damage the Divine Soul but rather even repair it. However, if a spiritual artifact refined using treasures that nurture the Divine Soul is used, wouldn't that also avoid damaging the Divine Soul?"
While carefully studying Jiao Li's Divine Soul, Su Lingxiu wondered.
"Crafting such a spiritual artifact would be very difficult, and the materials are hard to find,"
Yue'er pondered and replied.
The exploration of Jiao Li's Divine Soul by Su Lingxiu became more in-depth, even invoking a snippet of his memory. It was an image from Jiao Li's big fight at Lei Yun Mountain Manor.
At that moment, Su Lingxiu gained a certain understanding, and a secret technique emerged in her mind.
A technique used to explore someone's memory.
Li Xuan silently observed and couldn't help sighing at Su Lingxiu's curiosity and eagerness to research, from dissecting corpses to starting to dissect and research the Divine Soul.
"Truly a qualified medicinal martial artist. She's about to take another step up this path,"
Li Xuan was expectantly thinking.
"Your disciple Su Lingxiu, exploring the secrets of the Divine Soul, has a rudimentary understanding of the memory search technique, you acquired the Soul Searching Technique!"
Atop the Soul Pedestal, the Daoist Golden Book surged with golden light.
Soul Searching Technique!
"Sure enough, I have gained something. Now that I have mastered the Soul Searching Technique, I can easily extract secrets by directly searching through the soul of an enemy. Simple and crude!"
Li Xuan was overjoyed.
As he continued to silently watch Su Lingxiu investigate the Divine Soul, he noticed that even if she had a preliminary grasp of how to search Divine Soul's memory, Su Lingxiu did not meddle with Jiao Li's memories.
After all, that constituted a person's privacy, and Jiao Li was a patient, not an enemy.
She adhered to her principles, always maintaining her professional etiquette.
"Your disciple Su Lingxiu, studying profoundly the secrets of the Divine Soul, exploring the origin of the Divine Soul, you have gained the Understanding of the Divine!"
The Daoist Golden Book relayed its feedback once more.
The Understanding of the Divine pertained to the mysteries and origins of the "Divine" related to all living beings in Heaven and Earth, including Divine Souls, Primordial Spirits, and so on.
Having gained the Understanding of the Divine, Li Xuan immediately came to understand the roots of Divine Souls, the roots of Primordial Spirits, all of their mysteries, and he had complete understanding of the consciousness of living beings in Heaven and Earth.

chapters.title: Chapter 561 - 304 Divine Truth, Collapsed Jiao Li_2
chapters.content:
"I have already grasped all of this."
Li Xuan sighed.
With the Divine True Solution, he can easily create secret techniques and divine skills for the Primordial Spirit.
Even more, he can improve the spiritual intelligence of lower-intelligence beasts in a special way, making their "Divine" complete, spiritually intelligent!
This has already allowed Li Xuan to touch a very profound domain.
"I am somewhat enlightened, on how to strengthen the divine soul, how to weaken the divine soul, and how to make the divine soul more robust."
Su Lingxiu said excitedly.
Although she is far from touching the secret of the divine soul, she is not without gain.
"I also have some gains!"
Yue'er was also excited.
She finally understood what the divine soul of the most powerful being looks like.
"Why does this Heavenly Earth Lingji need to be spread out?"
After Su Lingxiu had repaired Jiao Li's divine soul, she looked at the two strands of Heavenly Earth Lingji in the depths of the divine soul and said in a somewhat puzzled manner.
"I don't understand either."
Yue'er shook her head.
The Heavenly Earth Lingji of her grandfather, Moon Changming, was given by the elders. After refining it into the divine soul, it became much stronger than these two strands of Jiao Li.
Despite Jiao Li having two strands of Heavenly Earth Lingji, seeming more than Moon Changming, in terms of strength and use of Heavenly Earth Lingji, he is far behind Moon Changming.
"It's probably because he was injured that the Heavenly Earth Lingji split into two strands."
Su Lingxiu doesn't understand the specific state of Ling Domain Martial Artists when refining Heavenly Earth Lingji. In her knowledge of martial arts, the continuously refined Lingji naturally keeps growing, not dividing into strands.
So, she instinctively believes that Jiao Li's two strands of Heavenly Earth Lingji have become like this because of the injury.
"Help him merge the Heavenly Earth Lingji as well, consider it as pay for studying the divine soul."
Su Lingxiu thought as such, her True Yuan probed into the divine soul, used prohibition method, and assisted with the strength of the elixir to slowly merge the two strands of Heavenly Earth Lingji.
As the two strands of Heavenly Earth Lingji merged, Jiao Li's divine soul shivered slightly. In an instant, the spiritual aura of the Heavenly Earth Lingji increased dramatically.
Seeing this, Li Xuan couldn't help but sigh. Jiao Li offered his divine soul for Su Lingxiu's study and gained a lot in return.
He realized why Ling Domain Martial Artists refine the Heavenly Earth Lingji in strands instead of refining them into a whole.
It is because of the limitations of their own refining techniques and the lack of techniques to merge Heavenly Earth Lingji within the divine soul, and their control over the divine soul, is somewhat inadequate.
Since they can't refine and merge as one, to continue getting stronger, they could only make up with quantity.
However, the number of refinements is not unlimited, it is related to the strength of the divine soul. Refining nine strands of Heavenly Earth Lingji is already the limit.
Heavenly Earth Lingji divided into strands naturally is not as strong as the Lingji refined into a whole, so Jiao Li has made a breakthrough this time.
"This girl is still too inexperienced. A little problem has arisen and she didn't even notice."
Li Xuan shook his head, but didn't remind Su Lingxiu, this is a small problem, Jiao Li will naturally know once he wakes up.
At that time, letting Su Lingxiu solve it herself can enhance her understanding and knowledge of the divine soul.
After Su Lingxiu merged Jiao Li's Heavenly Earth Lingji, she took out a pill that nourishes the divine soul and directly transformed it into Jiao Li's divine soul.
The treatment ended here, perfectly.
Then, Su Lingxiu let Jiao Li's divine soul return to his body and removed the prohibition.
In the courtyard, Zhu Xingzheng was anxiously waiting for the treatment result, while Cai Ling'er was somewhat restless, occasionally glancing at Li Xuan sitting in the chair.
Wanting to leave, but not daring to speak.
She could only wait for the result of Jiao Li's treatment, to see what the situation is.
Finally, Yue'er pushed the sickbed out of the room.
Su Lingxiu had a bright smile as she said, "It's done, the treatment is over, now I will wake him up."
"It's already over?"
Zhu Xingzheng was somewhat surprised, and asked, "Miss Su, are you saying the divine soul injury has already healed?"
"Yes!"
Su Lingxiu nodded.
Zhu Xingzheng and Cai Ling'er were incredulous. Divine soul injury, healed in such a short time?
Su Lingxiu held a golden needle between her fingers, stabbed it into Jiao Li's head, the golden needle quivered a few times, waking Jiao Li from his slumber.
"Get up and take a look, your injuries are almost fully healed, you just need to rest a few days to recover to your peak!"
Su Lingxiu nodded.
Jiao Li opened his eyes, initially a little confused, then immediately shocked!
"My divine soul has recovered!"
The originally damaged divine soul had already fully recovered, although it seemed a bit weak, just a few days of rest and he could fully recover, returning to his peak.
What shocked him even more was that his Heavenly Earth Lingji, which was originally two strands, had become one. Nevertheless, it was not weaker than when it was two strands, but stronger.
"Did... did the two strands of my Heavenly Earth Lingji merge together?"
Jiao Li was incredibly shocked.
"Has his Divine Soul recovered?"
Cai Ling'er was stunned.
Zhu Xingzheng was also taken aback, but soon became excited. He felt like he had made a significant achievement, and what's more, he had secured the support of this Divine Doctor; as long as he didn't die, he wouldn't have to worry about the severity of his injuries - they could all be cured!
"Yes, it has recovered!"
Jiao Li was excited and thrilled, he was about to get out of bed to express his gratitude to Su Lingxiu.
However, his arms suddenly shot up into the air.
"What's going on? What am I raising my hand for?"
Jiao Li was taken aback.
When he tried to sit up, his legs flipped over his head.
Jiao Li: ???
Something seemed awry!
Su Lingxiu and Yue'er were perplexed as they watched Jiao Li's strange actions.
The same went for Zhu Xingzheng and Cai Ling'er. Why would he suddenly throw his legs over his head?
Jiao Li suddenly felt panicked. He tried to drop his legs back down, but as he did so, his upper body shot up, and his head poked out from between his legs.
Jiao Li: ???
Su Lingxiu, Yue'er: ...
Zhu Xingzheng, Cai Ling'er: ...
"Master, what are you doing? Are you trying to test how well you've recovered?"
Zhu Xingzheng asked cautiously.
He had a feeling that something wasn't quite right with his Master!
"I..."
Jiao Li was dumbstruck.
He tried to turn his head to look at Cai Ling'er, but his head turned in the opposite direction instead. At this moment, he realized there was a severe problem.
His consciousness was out of sync with his physical body!
For example, he intended to lift his leg but ended up lifting his hand instead!
After some deep contemplation, Jiao Li finally managed to return to his original lying position on the bed. He mentally tried to raise his left leg, but his left hand rose instead.
When he tried to raise his left hand, his left leg rose...
His face crumbled in despair. Even though his Divine Soul had recovered, it seemed that a greater problem had arisen.
"Master, is there a problem?"
Zhu Xingzheng watched as Jiao Li bizarrely lifted his hand and leg in turns, wiped away his cold sweat, and cautiously asked.
"There's a big problem."
With a distraught look, Jiao Li said, "I clearly want to raise my hand, but my foot goes up instead. I want to raise my foot, but my hand goes up..."
Zhu Xingzheng, Cai Ling'er: ???
Neither of them could understand what Jiao Li meant in the moment. What did he mean by wanting to raise his hand but his foot goes up instead?
Could a foot be the same as a hand?
Su Lingxiu suddenly realized the issue at hand and took out a pill, placing it into Jiao Li's mouth with an awkward expression.
"Just a minor issue, I will treat you again."
Yue'er swiftly pushed the bed back into the room, leaving Zhu Xingzheng and Cai Ling'er baffled and sweating. Had there just been a medical incident?
A quarter of an hour later, Yue'er pushed the bed back out.
"There are no issues now."
Su Lingxiu confidently stated.
She woke up the sleeping Jiao Li and said, "Sit up, this time I've thoroughly cured you."
"Really?"
Jiao Li was beyond excited and sat up from the bed.
He moved his hands and feet, twisted his waist, and sighed in relief. He was now completely recovered.
He no longer had the problem where he intended to raise his hand but ended up lifting his foot instead.
"Thank you for healing me, Miss Su. I, Jiao Li, owe you a favour. If there is anything you require, just say the word!"
Jiao Li said earnestly, bowing in respect.

chapters.title: Chapter 562 - 305: The Fairy of Elixir, The Secret of the Sea Spirit_1
chapters.content:
Su Lingxiu waved her hand, "You owe me no favors. You have already paid me for my diagnosis, and treating you is only right since I received my consultation fee."
But Jiao Li insisted solemnly, "Although Miss took a consultation fee, such a severe injury cannot be paid off with just a fee. I, Jiao Li, am indebted to you for this good deed. If there's a need, just notify me, even if it means exceeding my power a million times over!"
He had thought himself a crippled man, that the Heavenly Earth Lingji would collapse, that he would fall from his status, yet, unexpectedly, he was now seeing a new dawn.
"I am Jiao Li, one of the protectors of the Wanshi Alliance. I have not yet asked your name, miss."
Jiao Li inquired, putting his fist to his palm, a traditional gesture of respect.
"Elixir Doctor Immortal Su Lingxiu!"
Yue'er cheerfully interrupted before Su Lingxiu could answer.
"Elixir Doctor Immortal, as reputed, I, Jiao Li, will remember!"
Jiao Li nodded solemnly.
He turned back to look at Cai Ling'er, excitedly saying, "My injuries could be healed, yours undoubtably can be!"
Cai Ling'er was also boiling with excitement, her wounds could be healed.
"Haha, I, Jiao Li, has healed, is Fan Kaisan in Luo State? I'll find him for a match."
Jiao Li was brimming with excitement. He jumped up and disappeared into the sky, eager to show up and stun the inhabitants of Lei Yun Mountain Manor.
In their eyes, how did a useless man like him recover to his peak condition?
Li Xuan watched Jiao Li's excited departure and couldn't help but shake his head.
"This apprentice, is really careless, he left a minor issue unnoticed."
It really was just a minor issue.
That is, when Jiao Li widened his eyes in anger, his mouth would also open...
As long as he doesn't glare, it's fine.
Zhu Xingzheng was overwhelmed with excitement at the moment. If even his Uncle Master's severe injuries could be healed, then the rest of the injured people in the Wanshi Alliance could also be treated.
"Sister Cai Ling, would you consider my conditions?"
Su Lingxiu wouldn't give up.
"Uh... we should treat the wounds first."
Cai Ling'er's heart trembled. This lady was too intimidating.
"Alright!"
Su Lingxiu nodded. It was much easier to treat Cai Ling'er's injuries. Once the required elixir was administered, Cai Ling'er's injuries would be completely healed in no time.
At that moment, Cai Ling'er was amazed to discover that Su Lingxiu's treatment was indeed unparalleled.
The effects of the elixir were surprisingly magical!
Thinking of Su Lingxiu's conditions, if she agreed, there would be various rewards.
"How about it, Sister Cai Ling? As long as you agree, I can provide you with the elixirs free of charge, of course, you will need to provide some of the medicinal herbs."
"I can also provide the elixirs you need for cultivation free of charge, such as those to strengthen the divine soul."
"If you get injured in the future, I can also heal you free of charge. These are all rewards; seize the opportunity!"
Su Lingxiu laid out generous rewards to entice Cai Ling'er.
Yue'er also chimed in, "Sister Cai Ling, there isn't only one of you in the Sea Spirit Tribe, our conditions, if spread to the Sea Spirit Tribe, there will certainly be strong Sea Spirit Tribe members fighting over them.
"There are virtually no losses, only enormous gains."
Cai Ling'er was tempted. She could foresee that once word spread of Elixir Doctor Immortal Su Lingxiu, these generous rewards would certainly attract strong Sea Spirit Tribe members.
Now, the opportunity was right in front of her.
As long as she agreed, she could not only receive generous rewards but also establish a friendship with Su Lingxiu.
"Will it really be alright?"
Cai Ling'er worriedly asked.
"Rest assured, there will be no issues. I won't let you suffer a bit, Sister Cai Ling. Even if there is a small issue, my master is here."
Su Lingxiu patted her chest to assure.
Cai Ling'er looked at Li Xuan, a deeply unfathomable and terribly strong existence. His apprentice was so powerful; naturally, he was even more so.
"There won't be any scars, will there?"
Cai Ling'er was still having a difficult time letting go.
"Absolutely not!"
Seeing her wavering, Su Lingxiu quickly reassured her, taking out a bottle of elixir, handing it to her saying, "This is the revival elixir, even for a strong person like Sister Cai Ling, after sustaining heavy damage, just take this elixir, and you'll mostly recover."
"Okay, I agree!"
Cai Ling'er took the elixir and gritted her teeth in affirmation.
"Great!"
Su Lingxiu was ecstatic, along with Yue'er, who was on the other side, they helped Cai Ling'er lay on the bed. Before Cai Ling'er could retract her words, she immediately placed an elixir in Cai Ling'er's mouth and let her enter a sleep state.
Zhu Xingzheng, full of envy, couldn't help but say, "Miss Su, what about me?"
Su Lingxiu glanced at him and shook her head, "Go away."
With Yue'er, they pushed the bed excitedly into the room, preparing to study the physiological structure of the Sea Spirit Tribe and see how it varied from the Human Clan.
Li Xuan: .....
He had not expected that Cai Ling'er would agree to let Su Lingxiu dissect her.
"Will it really cause no issues? I better keep an eye on them."
Li Xuan murmured to himself.
Thus, he continued to stealthily observe the situation inside the room.
"Hiss, are the Sea Spirit Tribe all this white and smooth?"
"Flawless as jade, free of body hair... Is it just her, or are all the Sea Spirit Tribe like this?"
Li Xuan shocked inwardly.
Su Lingxiu and Yue'er were studying the physical structure differences between the Sea Spirit Tribe and the Human Clan. Li Xuan watched silently from the shadows. If anything unexpected happened, he could step in in time and not let severe consequences occur.

chapters.title: Chapter 563 - 305: Fairy of the Elixir, Secret of the Sea Spirit _2
chapters.content:
"Your disciple Su Lingxiu, understands the structural differences between the Sea Spirit Tribe and the Human Clan. You have a deeper understanding of the Sea Spirit Tribe now. You now possess the true understanding of the Sea Spirits."
The feedback from the Daoist Golden Book came.
"In this world, no one understands the Sea Spirits better than I do."
Li Xuan sighed with emotion.
After gaining the true understanding of the Sea Spirits, even the Sea Spirit Tribe themselves didn't comprehend their existence as well as he did.
"This Cai Ling'er is incredible. Among the Sea Spirit Tribe, she is a flawless Sea Spirit, with enormous potential. She possesses a royal lineage, though the current Sea Spirit Tribe probably doesn't understand this.
"This whole concept of a flawless Sea Spirit is truly remarkable."
Li Xuan was intrigued at how extraordinary Cai Ling'er was.
After gaining the true understanding of the Sea Spirit Tribe, he realized they had already fallen into decay, not even knowing about the existence of the royal bloodline, much less having a method to activate it.
Once the latent royal lineage is activated, they will be granted the secret heritage of the Sea Spirit tribe.
Though Li Xuan had realized that Cai Ling'er carried the royal lineage of the Sea Spirits, he had no intention of teaching her the method to activate it. After all, she was not his disciple.
The first thing Cai Ling'er did when she woke up was to inspect herself. Finding nothing unusual, she finally breathed a sigh of relief, even developing some suspicion.
"Cai Ling'er, the Sea Spirit Tribe is really unique."
Su Lingxiu exclaimed in surprise.
"You really understand the physical structure of my Sea Spirit Tribe? You understand the difference between us and the Human Clan?"
Cai Ling'er asked in surprise.
"Of course!"
Su Lingxiu nodded.
"It's not that big of a secret. The differences between the Sea Spirit Tribe and the Human Clan have long been delineated in the annals of the Ling Domain."
Cai Ling'er shook her head.
She suspected that Su Lingxiu may have felt the texts weren't reliable, hence the firsthand research.
"It's different."
Su Lingxiu shook her head.
The differences recorded in the texts of the Ling Domain weren't as profound as what she had learnt.
After leaving the room, Cai Ling'er decided to stay in the manor. She had developed a keen curiosity for Su Lingxiu's miraculous methods of healing.
Jiao Li's kind of injury that had been quite irreversible, reducing him to a half-invalid with no hope of a long life, was completely incurable.
Even the most precious Spiritual Medicines couldn't reverse it.
But with Su Lingxiu, he recovered completely in a short time and with apparent ease.
Su Lingxiu was very satisfied. Her research on the Divine Soul had yielded some results, and she had new ideas on how to refine medicines to enhance the Divine Soul.
Also, the consultation fee was substantial.
While the All Ages Alliance was a loose cultivator organization, Jiao Li was a powerful individual, and wouldn't have been too poor.
...
"Ha ha, Fan Kaisan, come out and fight!"
With his injuries just healed, Jiao Li, though not yet at his peak, was already eager to show off a bit and let the people of the Lei Yun Mountain Manor know that he hadn't become crippled!
If his injuries could recover, then the other injured members of the All Ages Alliance could surely recover as well.
So, he went straight to the Cangyun Dynasty as soon as possible.
"Jiao Li?"
Fan Kaisan was shocked.
Jiao Li, who had been critically injured by the Divine Artifact of Lei Yun Mountain Manor, damaging both his Divine Soul and foundation, and had been deemed a half-invalid, now stood before him, alive and kicking.
Though his energy had not yet fully recovered, his injuries had healed.
Just a few days' rest would be enough for him to fully regain his peak condition.
"How is this possible!"
Fan Kaisan couldn't believe his eyes.
In the battle with the All Ages Alliance, some members of the Spirit Sect had also been seriously injured, even affecting their foundations. Despite their plentiful resources, some of them were unable to recover.
If Jiao Li, who had been so heavily injured, could recover, then wouldn't all the other members of the All Ages Alliance be able to regain their peak condition too?
Compared to this, the loss of the Spirit Sect seemed greater.
At this moment, Fan Kaisan felt very distressed.
"Ha ha ha, hadn't you thought I would recover! Come, let's have a battle and see how much of my strength has recovered."
Jiao Li was extremely excited.
The merging of two strands of the Heavenly Earth Lingji into one should have increased his strength. He wanted to test it out.
Boom!
Jiao Li attacked in an instant.
"Scared of you? Far from it!"
Fan Kaisan swung out his war hammer, and the two began to fight.
After a fierce battle, Jiao Li became more and more excited. His strength had indeed improved, the forces of heaven and earth responded to him more quickly, and he was now slightly stronger.
Fan Kaisan also realized this and his face darkened.
"How did he recover?"
Fan Kaisan looked stern.
"The ruins of the Chi Ming Sect, Chang Qing Pavilion? Are they related?"
In an instant, Fan Kaisan thought of a possibility.
Not long ago, he received information that Jiao Li and a member of the Sea Spirit Tribe had arrived in Luo State, seemingly aiming for Chang Qing Pavilion.
So, he concluded that Chang Qing Pavilion was set up by the All Ages Alliance.
"Did you receive your treatment at Chang Qing Pavilion?"
Fan Kaisan said in a deep voice.
"What if I did?"
Jiao Li chuckled. He knew that his secret recuperation in Chang Qing Pavilion could not be hidden.
"Excellent, Chang Qing Pavilion it is, I will surely pay a visit."
Fan Kaisan snorted.
"In Chang Qing Pavilion, you have no say!"
Jiao Li sneered, glaring, but found himself at a loss - why did his mouth open when he glared?
I didn't mean to open my mouth!
"What were you about to say?"
Fan Kaisan frowned and asked.
Jiao Li glared, his mouth wide open, as if about to spew harsh words, but he remained speechless, feeling puzzled.
"None of your damn business!"
He threw a few punches, turned and left, no longer participating in the battle.
The moment he turned around, Jiao Li glared, and his mouth opened again uncontrollably. He felt slightly hurt inside.
I'm not completely healed yet!
"It's nothing but the aftereffects. I just need to rest for a few days, and it'll resolve on its own. There's no need to seek Miss Su for treatment."
Jiao Li reassured himself internally.
I can't glare anymore. Every time I glare, my mouth opens. It damages my dignity.
Fan Kaisan didn't make a move, but pondered and relayed the information back to Lei Yun Mountain Manor. If Chang Qing Pavilion could heal even Jiao Li's severe injuries, it wasn't to be undermined.
What's the origin of Chang Qing Pavilion's miraculous healing method? Is it related to the All-Stars Martial Arts Academy?
Fan Kaisan mulled it over, got an idea, and summoned Cangyun Huang to make some arrangements.
In Chang Qing Pavilion, Shi'er, Zhou Ying, and Meng Shushu were busy preparing for treating injured martial artists. Various kinds of elixirs were put into medicine cabinets according to their efficacy.
The diagnostic spiritual artifact had been prepped. Minor injuries could be treated with a single elixir.
For common injuries, a spirit crystal could be accepted as a consultation fee. If the injury was severe, or the injured person was powerful, the consultation fee would be calculated separately.
As Chang Qing Pavilion had a limited staff, only a certain number of patients could be seen each day.
After all, treatment should augment one's martial arts cultivation and provide experience, rather than impede one's own cultivation.
"Miss Su, we have some allies in the All Ages Alliance with serious injuries, could you help treat them?"
Jiao Li returned, respectful in his request.
"It's possible, as long as you have the consultation fee."
Su Lingxiu nodded and added, "Some injuries may require special spiritual medicine. You may need to prepare some of the medicines yourselves. I can't guarantee I have them all here.
"When the patients arrive, I'll let you know if anything is missing after I examine them."
Jiao Li was thrilled and nodded, "Of course, we won't lack for consultation fees. We will cover the cost of the spiritual medicine needed for the treatment."
He instructed Zhu Xingzheng to handle it properly and stay available for Su Lingxiu's orders, then he mounted the big eagle and left.
Meanwhile, Cai Ling'er stayed back in the manor. She was curious about everything, learning something new at every corner.
"Physician of Chang Qing Pavilion, can you treat my son's injury?"
A burly man walked in, holding up a young lad whose aura was weak and lethargic, as if he could pass out any moment.
Su Lingxiu frowned at a glance and said, "Quite a severe move, it has completely debilitated him."
The burly man was furious, his eyes red, "The people of Spirit Sect are truly despicable!"
"Pay the consultation fee."
Su Lingxiu didn't want to say much. The Spirit Sect injuring people was merely a probe.
"Here!"
The burly man took out a divine-grade spiritual medicine.
"Give him this pill."
Su Lingxiu handed him a Resurrection Pill.
The young man's strength was too weak. Even if he had been incapacitated, a Resurrection Pill could completely restore him.

chapters.title: Chapter 564 - 306 - The Great Divine Power and the Chance to Meet a High Person_1
chapters.content:
"This will heal him?"
The burly man looked disbelieving. Could one single pill restore someone who was once considered beyond help?
As hard as it was to believe, still, he fed the medicine to the young man.
In a matter of moments, the young man's breathing stabilized and his pale face regained its color.
"Dad, I can feel myself getting better!"
The young man opened his eyes, brimming with excitement.
"Really, that's fantastic, fantastic!"
The burly man was equally excited.
"Thank you, Divine Doctor, for saving his life. May I ask your honorable name so I can repay this debt?"
Zhu Xingzheng interrupted, "This is the Pill Doctor, Su Lingxiu!"
"Pill Doctor?"
The burly man muttered to himself for a moment, then, with a thousand thanks, carried away the boy.
"Miss Su, it's possible that Spirit Sect send him. They seem to be targeting Chang Qing Pavilion. But don't worry; as long as I, Zhu Xingzheng, am here, I won't let the brats from Spirit Sect create any trouble!"
Zhu Xingzheng patted his chest confidently.
"If those Spirit Sect scoundrels dare to make trouble, they better not blame me. Anyway, it's been quite some time since I've buried someone. My burial skills are getting rusty!"
Su Lingxiu snorted coldly.
Do they actually think she's a soft-hearted pushover?
Over the next few days, several severely wounded martial artists came. Nearly all of them had their foundations destroyed and were considered irrecoverable in Ling Domain. They were essentially useless.
The wounded martial artists ranged from Grandmasters, Great Grandmasters, Small Heavenly Men, Large Heavenly Men to the strongest one among them, a Refining God Heavenly Man.
It was obvious that this was a test by the Spirit Sect, but it was entirely expected.
Since the establishment of Chang Qing Pavilion, they had been prepared for such situations. Su Lingxiu didn't care about it. As long as there was sufficient compensation, it was fine.
She didn't even bother to step forward herself. Yue'er directly treated them with pills.
"Spirit Sect is really generous indeed!"
Yue'er stared at a few stalks of divine spiritual medicine, sighing in admiration.
"I've decided to raise the consultation fee for Spirit Sect, the stronger their disciples are, the higher the fee. If they aren't willing to pay, they can just leave. We don't need to indulge them and can do everything at our own pace."
Su Lingxiu eagerly decided.
She had no objection to treating the wounded warriors of Spirit Sect, but the consultation fee must be adjusted, allowing them to gain more resources from Spirit Sect.
Li Xuan didn't care about the Spirit Sect's probe at all. God's Domain was his bargaining chip.
These days, updates from Meng Chong and Xu Yan were coming from time to time. But news about the two was not so quick in arriving.
After all, the spread of information took time and Xu Yan and Meng Chong had long since left Luo State.
"Your disciple Xu Yan single-handedly defeated five Spirit Sect prodigies, you have gained the ninth form of Divine Destruction."
The feedback from Daoist Golden Book came again.
The Divine Destruction had already collected nine forms.
"You merged the nine forms of Divine Destruction, and obtained the Great Divine Power, Divine Destruction."
Great Divine Power!
