Li Xuan was silently excited. The power of Divine Destruction was undoubtedly tremendous. Once the ninth form was integrated into the Great Divine Power and put into use, its power would not be weaker than his current Divine Techniques.
If he layered the Law of Heaven and Earth with Divine Destruction, he couldn't even imagine the formidable power it would possess.
His power has been enhanced again.
"Xu Yan has fought a lot and should have the foundation to break through the Divine Origin Realm soon, huh?"
Li Xuan looked hopeful.
"Meng Chong is about to reach the perfection of the first level of Undying Golden Body too."
For Meng Chong who is cultivated in physical martial arts, the enhancements in Undying Golden Body from the battles were quite impressive.
Su Lingxiu is only a half step away from reaching the completion of Divine Intent State.
So, Meng Chong is about to have a breakthrough soon too.
A few days later, feedback from Daoist Golden Book came.
"Your disciple Meng Chong reached perfection in the first level of the Indestructible Golden Body of the Big Day, you've achieved a great success in the second level of Undying Golden Body."
Li Xuan felt relaxed, expecting Meng Chong to comprehend the third level of Undying Golden Body soon. Then he himself could break through the Divine Skill Realm in physical martial arts and thus, gain a self-generated divine technique. He looked forward to the divine techniques he might get from physical martial arts.
"This girl, Su Lingxiu, should be close to comprehending the Pill Medical Martial Road's Divine Skill Realm right?"
Looking at Su Lingxiu, Li Xuan anticipated.
If all three martial arts breakthrough to the Divine Skill Realm, the increase in power would be unimaginable.
Of course, Strange Door Martial Arts was slightly short. But Strange Door Martial Arts were special, their Divine Skill Realm was not the same as the other three martial arts.
"Fang Hao still has some ways to go, but it's not slow either. He has understood quite a bit about Strange Door Martial Arts."
While Li Xuan was still studying the ninth page of the Book of Tai Cang, he also started to ponder the cultivation above the Divine Skill Realm in Physical Martial Arts.
"Quite some progress has been made, it shouldn't be a big problem to piece it together. It's just comparing the Divine Appearance with Breaking the Void. Physical Martial Arts is unique, but the realm is quite similar."
Li Xuan mused, he had some ideas about the subsequent cultivation of Physical Martial Arts. It would just take some time to carefully compile them.
With Daoist Golden Book, there was no need to worry about its strength.
One day, Jiao Li brought over a dozen wounded people. All of them were severely injured, their foundations nearly destroyed.
Su Lingxiu was thrilled, the stronger the person, the more severe their injuries. When she treated them, she would gain more.
In just a few hours, Su Lingxiu had healed the injuries of all the wounded. Of course, their bodies were still weak and needed to rest for a while.
During the recovery period, taking pills would speed up the healing process, and the pills needed money to buy.
Another considerable sum of consultation fee came in, which included high-grade spiritual medicine and some rare materials.
The medicine needed for treatment of these strong members of the All Ages Alliance was supplied by them. Su Lingxiu was even happier and offered a 20% discount on future treatment fees if they were hurt again!

chapters.title: Chapter 565 - 306 - The Great Divine Power and the Chance to Meet a High Person_2
chapters.content:
The powerful members of the All Ages Alliance were left astounded. Could there be such miraculous medical skills in the world?
They had even tried to invite Su Lingxiu to join the All Ages Alliance, but she declined.
After their injuries were treated, the powerful members of the All Ages Alliance prepared to return to their headquarters to recuperate for some time.
Upon their departure, they naturally purchased a large quantity of healing pills.
"Miss Cai, won't you return with me?"
Jiao Li stared at Cai Ling'er in surprise.
"I won't return. I'll stay here to repay Sister Lingxiu for healing me."
Cai Ling'er said against her wishes.
"Alright then."
Jiao Li reluctantly nodded understandingly. Cai Ling'er and her fellow members of the Sea Spirit Tribe were invited to provide aid. They would not take orders from them.
He couldn't compel Cai Ling'er to return to the alliance's headquarters.
In addition, Cai Ling'er remaining behind was a good thing for fostering a closer bond with Su Lingxiu.
All the powerful members of the All Ages Alliance had left, but Zhu Xingzheng shamelessly stayed behind. He claimed that the Chang Qing Pavilion was short of manpower, so he decided to stay and help.
Cai Ling'er had an intuition that there were opportunities for her here.
"Elder, this is a specialty of my Sea Spirit Tribe, Azure Sea Spirit Pearl Tea. Please have a taste."
Cai Ling'er moved beside Li Xuan with a respectful expression and served a pot of tea.
"Hmm!"
Li Xuan nodded.
He lifted the tea cup and took a sip. His eyes lit up slightly. This Azure Sea Spirit Pearl Tea was quite good, it had a better taste than the Spiritual Tea he was drinking, and it had more spiritual flavor.
"Good!"
He nodded appreciatively.
A surge of joy welled up in Cai Ling'er's heart, "I'm glad you like it, elder!"
From this day on, Cai Ling'er began to act with extreme diligence in front of Li Xuan, almost like a maid.
Li Xuan didn't mind; having a beautiful girl attentively take care of him was a pleasure and quite relazing.
Fang Hao arrived.
"Master, Sister!"
Accompanying him was Moon Changming.
"Greetings, elder!"
Moon Changming respectfully greeted Li Xuan.
"Hmm!"
Li Xuan nodded. He glanced at Moon Changming, sighing in his heart. As expected from a former Star Talent of the Ten Thousand Stars, after Li Xuan's instructions and providing him with several Heaven and Earth Laws patterns, Moon Changming's power skyrocketed after a period of cultivation and comprehension.
Moon Changming had even managed to integrate a sliver of Heaven and Earth Laws energy into his body.
This was not Heavenly Earth Lingji, but a further development of condensing Heavenly Earth Lingji, integrating the Heaven and Earth Laws energy.
This made Moon Changming a member of the highest tier of the Spirit Domain.
He was even more powerful than Jiao Li and Cai Ling'er.
"Grandpa!"
Yue'er ran over happily upon seeing her grandfather.
Cai Ling'er was startled, Moon Changming gave off a strong aura, similar to those in the All Ages Alliance.
A true powerhouse!
And such a powerhouse was exceptionally respectful towards Su Lingxiu's master, which clearly indicated, how powerful this elder was. Truly awe-inspiring!
She had made the right choice!
Fang Hao came here to go to the All Ages Alliance headquarters, to compete with the prodigies of the Great Alliance and the Spirit Sect, and to prepare for his smooth ascendancy to the position of head of the All Ages Alliance.
The arrival of Fang Hao would cause a great leap forward for the All Ages Alliance, especially in the passing of information, significantly surpassing the Spirit Sect.
After reminiscing for a while, Li Xuan called Fang Hao over, instructing him on the direction of his Martial Arts cultivation and the most important idea of refining the Flying Boat.
Fang Hao was immediately ecstatic upon hearing this.
But he paused for a moment, then said, "Master, it seems like refining a Flying Boat won't be difficult. However, it may consume quite a bit of energy to fly, even more than using Martial Arts. It wouldn't be as easy as riding on spirit beasts."
Li Xuan looked speechlessly at Fang Hao, how could his disciple have such limited imagination? Having refined a Flying Boat,should he still rely on exerting his own True Yuan to move it?
Spirit Crystal!"
Li Xuan sighed.
Fang Hao was stunned, as if a whole new door had opened up for him. Panoply of inspirations flooded his mind, followed by a hint of shame as he lowered his head and said, "I've been shortsighted!"
"The art of Qi Men Martial Arts lies in the courage to innovate, the courage to think out of the box, remember this!"
Li Xuan solemnly instructed.
"Yes, the disciple will keep this in mind!"
Fang Hao nodded solemnly.
"Well, the object you crafted for Shen Haizhou previously showed originality. After practicing Qi Men Martial Arts, don't confine your creative thinking.
"Think more, observe more, innovate more; dare to imagine, and dare to innovate, do not limit yourself to formations, artifact refining, prohibitions, and so on."
Li Xuan continued his earnest instruction.
"Yes, Master!"
Fang Hao respectfully agreed.
"Well, go and start crafting."
Li Xuan nodded.
Of course, the hard work of crafting the flying boat was delegated to his disciple. After all, taking a disciple means having someone to serve the master.
Due to the need to craft the flying boat, Fang Hao had to postpone his visit to the headquarters of the All Ages Alliance and started working on it in the manor.
First, he drew up the shape and function of the flying boat.
Su Lingxiu was thrilled to hear about this and offered ideas on the sidelines.
"Junior brother, destined to be a doctor who travels far and wide, having a flying boat would make things much more convenient. If we could move Chang Qing Pavilion onboard the Flying Boat, it would serve as a vehicle when flying and a pavilion-like manor when grounded.
"Think about it, and see how you can do it."
Fang Hao, hearing Su Lingxiu's words, realized that crafting the flying boat would not be easy and that it would require careful planning.
Of course, if he succeeded in crafting one, it would be a great achievement for him.
"The flying boat, on which my master is to ride, can't be haphazardly crafted, and the materials needed should not be taken lightly either."
An idea came to Fang Hao.
Thus, he put his whole heart into the grand task of crafting the flying boat.
Moon Changming took this opportunity to consult Li Xuan on the laws of Heaven and Earth. He felt that he needed to gain a better understanding of these laws.
How easily could one comprehend the profound laws of Heaven and Earth?
He couldn't help but marvel at how his past kind intentions of wanting to tip Xu Yan to avoid danger led him to meet this great mentor and gain this opportunity.
As Cai Ling'er was preparing tea for Li Xuan, she was shocked to hear that Moon Changming was asking about the laws of Heaven and Earth. Were they seriously discussing the practice of such profound laws?
She hesitated whether to step back, but noticing that Li Xuan didn't imply for her to retreat, she decided to stay, pouring a cup of tea and serving them like a maid.
As for explaining a bit of the laws of Heaven and Earth, Li Xuan didn't care. If Cai Ling'er listened, it would all depend on her talents for understanding.
To come across a great mentor, one must be destined.
For such a unparalleled master like himself, it's only natural for those who've been serving tea and running errands for him to be bestowed with opportunities.
With a single stroke of his hand, a ripple formed in front of him. It was a simple line, yet it seemed to contain some sort of profound truth of the universe.
"For you, it is sufficient to concentrate on comprehending one law of Heaven and Earth at a time. Once you thoroughly understand a law, proceed to the next law of Heaven and Earth.
"Every law of Heaven and Earth has its mysteries, and each person's understanding is unique.
"The operation of the laws, the rules of Heaven and Earth, a single law, has its rule; the rules are constant, yet they are not immutable, and changes also occur within the rules.
"Once you understand the rule of a law, you will grasp its changes; first, understand one of the changes, after achieving enlightenment, then understand the next change. Take this step by step, and naturally, you will understand the rules of a law."
The laws of Heaven and Earth that Li Xuan depicted in front of him are one of the several laws of Heaven and Earth that he gave to Moon Changming.
He was confident that no one in the Ling Domain, or even the entire Taicang, had a better understanding of the laws of Heaven and Earth than he did.
Moon Changming listened respectfully, his mind illuminating with understanding. Watching that law of Heaven and Earth, he was overwhelmingly excited. No doubt, this was the guidance of a person transcending Heaven and Earth.
A few words enlightened him and found the direction to comprehend the laws of Heaven and Earth.
"Thank you for your guidance!"
Moon Changming respectfully saluted and left to find a place to meditate after bidding farewell.
Cai Ling'er was left stunned and amazed, so the laws of Heaven and Earth can just be drawn casually?
Who could achieve such a feat?
"Is comprehending the laws of Heaven and Earth that simple?"
Cai Ling'er felt both excited and uplifted, realizing that it was wise of her to stay.
What a tremendous opportunity!
The laws of Heaven and Earth that Li Xuan painted vanished with a wave of his hand, as he quietly savored his tea.
As for how much Cai Ling'er could comprehend, it all depends on her talents.
He had given her the opportunity, whether or not she could seize it was up to her.
Cai Ling'er bowed and left to find a place to meditate.

chapters.title: Chapter 566 - 307: The wealthy and domineering Lei Yun Mountain Manor_1
chapters.content:
Inside the Chang Qing Pavilion, everyone was busy. There were no injured people seeking treatment yet, and the reputation of Chang Qing Pavilion had not been widely known.
Fang Hao was pondering on refining a flying boat with Su Lingxiu assisting him. This was the first time she put in so much focus on something other than alchemy and martial arts.
Yue'er was managing Chang Qing Pavilion, organizing the necessary spiritual medicine and so on.
Shi'er was diligently cultivating.
So was Zhou Ying. Meng Shushu and Zhu Xingzheng were deep immersed in their studies. The two of them had become very familiar.
Li Xuan continued to quietly be a handsome man reading a book.
"The ninth page is a general summary of the Heaven and Earth Laws of Tai Cang and is a consolidation. Is the tenth page not about the Heaven and Earth Laws?"
Li Xuan was deep in thought.
He had not completely memorized the ninth page yet. Once he did, it would mean that he had memorized the Heaven and Earth laws of Tai Cang in their entirety.
The Book of Tai Cang had a total of eighteen pages. If the ninth page was a summary and consolidation of the Heaven and Earth Laws, what would follow after the tenth page?
Could it be a higher level of Heaven and Earth Laws?
A strong individual from the Spirit Sect paid a visit on this day.
Fan Kaisan, the person in charge of Luo State was naturally included. Besides him, there were two more powerful individuals whose strength exceeded that of Fan Kaisan.
One of them had even cultivated a wisp of the Heaven and Earth Law's aura, and was only slightly weaker than Moon Changming.
This showed that the visitor from Lei Yun Mountain Manor was extraordinary and was definitely one of the strongest individuals there.
Moreover, the visitor had a small purple hammer hanging from his waist with a faint semblance of lightning circulating around it. It was a Divine Artifact!
Divine Artifacts were extremely powerful and couldn't be kept in the Ling Domain's storage pouch. They had to be carried in person.
Among the dozen or so people that were part of the Lei Yun Mountain Manor group, majority of them were injured. Their injuries were serious and couldn't even completely cured by the numerous treasures of Lei Yun Mountain Manor.
One of the injured individuals was a powerful person who had cultivated the Heavenly Earth Lingji, and his injuries were extremely severe, just slightly better than Jiao Li from before.
He was wounded by a person from the All Ages Alliance who was wielding a Divine Artifact.
Moon Changming, who was comprehending the Heaven and Earth Laws opened his eyes abruptly and slowly stood up.
Zhu Xingzheng was secretly surprised. Lei Yun Mountain Manor had sent such a powerful individual. Could their intention be to coerce Chang Qing Pavilion to return to Lei Yun Mountain Manor?
But this group of people had entered through the front entrance and it appeared as though they had merely come for a consultation.
"I am Lei Tong from Lei Yun Mountain Manor. I seek an audience with the Fairy Alchemist to treat the wounded from my Manor," the strong individual with the Divine Artifact said, making a fist and palm salute.
"No problem at all, as long as the consultation fee is sufficient, curing any injury is a small matter," Su Lingxiu excitedly approached them.
As for the threat of Lei Yun Mountain Manor, she wasn't worried in the slightest.
Seeing Su Lingxiu, Lei Tong was surprised. The Fairy Alchemist was so young?
Did she even reach twenty years old?
"The consultation fee is a small matter. As long as Miss Su can heal the injuries of my members, I will pay double the consultation fee," Lei Tong said.
Su Lingxiu was even more delighted. "No wonder Lei Yun Mountain Manor is part of the Transcendent Spirit Sect. They are really generous!"
She took a glance at the wounded and quickly understood.
"These injuries are not light. Giving treatment would be quite troublesome and hence, the consultation fee won't be cheap," Lei Tong said, taking out a storage pouch. "I have fifty divine quality spiritual medicines."
Su Lingxiu shook her head, "It's not about the spiritual medicine. And fifty divine quality spiritual medicines aren't enough to cover the consultation fee for these injuries."
Lei Tong didn't get angry but merely raised an eyebrow. "Miss, please name your price."
"Sure, sure. Just wait a moment."
Su Lingxiu quickly went over to Fang Hao. Having a powerful person from Lei Yun Mountain Manor seeking consultation was a good opportunity to get some rare materials needed for refining the Flying Boat.
"Apprentice Brother, quickly make a list of the materials you need. Lei Yun Mountain Manor is wealthy. There's no need to worry about them not being able to afford it."
Hearing this, Fang Hao immediately perked up and started listing the extremely rare materials.
"The Flying Boat of Master cannot be casually made. It must be impressive. Lei Yun Mountain Manor has a unique type of thundering purple iron. That's exactly what we're missing.
"With this thundering purple iron, the Flying Boat that is refined will have purple lightning revolving around, making it look imposing..."
Fang Hao listed the missing materials and also the double set in case they failed in refining and had to replenish the materials.
After receiving the list, Su Lingxiu added some divine quality spiritual medicines with different effects, then handed it to Lei Tong. "This is the consultation fee. Once it is paid, I can start the treatment."
Lei Tong looked at the consultation fee and didn't say anything. It was evident that they were asking for a high price because they knew Lei Yun Mountain Manor was rich.
"Miss, this consultation fee of yours..."
Fan Kaisan was secretly furious and was about to speak when Lei Tong waved his hand to interrupt him. He raised his head with a serious expression, "The consultation fee is not an issue, but may I ask, Miss, are you really able to heal their injuries?"
"Of course!"
Su Lingxiu nodded.
"And if you are not able to heal their injuries after accepting the consultation fee?" Lei Tong asked sternly.
"If I am unable to cure them, I am willing to compensate," Su Lingxiu replied with a arrogant raise of her eyebrow.
"Excellent!"
Lei Tong nodded in satisfaction and passed the list to Fan Kaisan. "Please prepare double the consultation fee. If I, Lei Tong, say I will pay double, I will certainly stick to my word."
"Yes!"
Fan Kaisan hurriedly left with the list of the consultation fee.
"Please have a seat, sirs. Those who paid the fee will have their treatment soon."
Su Lingxiu was all smiles.
Lei Yun Mountain Manor was truly wealthy.
Lei Tong nodded and took a seat in the waiting hall of Chang Qing Pavilion with the injured members. He was not irritated and had no intention of making trouble or showing off the might of the Transcendent Spirit Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 567 - 307: The Wealthy Lei Yun Mountain Manor_2
chapters.content:
Moon Changming saw this and continued to comprehend his own Heaven and Earth Laws.
However, Cai Ling'er seemed somewhat worried and sought out Su Lingxiu, saying, "Sister Lingxiu, Lei Tong is ranked the fifth elder of the Lei Yun Mountain Manor, the holder of the Divine Artifact, Heavenly Purple Thundercloud Hammer, commanding immense power.
"With such a generous payment for the consultation, I fear he may have a hidden agenda."
Su Lingxiu just smiled and responded, "Regardless of the injuries, I can cure them all. Whatever tactics they use, I do not care. If they want to play with devious plots, I still do not care.
"Master once said that any conspiracy, before the face of absolute strength, is mere trifles. Simply push them aside.
"With Master here, if they try any deviant strategy, they will only end up with greater losses."
Cai Ling'er was startled, glancing at the carefree expert seated on the chair and immediately felt her worries disappear.
Yes, before this mysterious elder, any strategy or conspiracy, is nothing more than trifles!
The strength of Lei Yun Mountain Manor is nothing more than a perception, applicable only to the weak, like them.
Li Xuan glanced at Lei Tong and his group, a smile rippling in his heart, "So even the Transcendent Spirit Sect would resort to such underhanded tricks?"
He roughly guessed Lei Tong's intention. After Su Lingxiu cured the injured, the victims would probably quickly die, which would allow them to accuse Su Lingxiu.
As for compensation, it would be decided by Lei Yun Mountain Manor.
Shaking his head, Li Xuan thought if Lei Yun Mountain Manor had simply threatened him directly, he would have respected them a bit, as it would resonate the might of the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
In the end, they chose to resort to such measures?
Of course, it is still too early to say for certain.
One day later.
Fan Kaisan returned, handing the consultation fee to Su Lingxiu.
"Begin the treatment."
Lei Tong watched in silence.
"Just minor issues!"
Su Lingxiu and Yue'er began their work. In treating these injured people, they didn't resort to quickly using elixirs but Su Lingxiu personally employed her medical skills instead.
With each person she treated, her understanding and proficiency in the Daoist Alchemy Martial Arts naturally improved.
This time, Su Lingxiu spent a full day treating and healing everyone, finally revealing a face filled with exhaustion.
"It's done, they're all healed!"
Lei Tong and the other powerful individuals silently watched, their hearts shocked greatly. How incredible was this technique that healed the injured so rapidly.
These were not merely trivial injuries - their foundations had severely been damaged. For any martial artist, it was near fatal.
In just a short span of a day, they had all been healed!
"Miss, can you assure us they have all completely healed, without leaving any side effects?"
Lei Tong asked solemnly.
Has the storm come?
Moon Changming quietly prepared to act, any time now.
Lei Tong was, indeed, strong but not stronger than him by a significant margin.
Over these days, his comprehension of the Heaven and Earth laws had improved tremendously and the aura he exuded was now a round stronger.
Still smiling, Su Lingxiu replied, "Of course, they're healed. You can inspect them right here and try to ascertain how their strength has recovered. However, I would like to mention that once you leave Chang Qing Pavilion and later come back saying the injuries have not been healed, I won't recognize such claims.
I can't take responsibility for mishaps occurring after you leave the Chang Qing Pavilion."
After giving this some thought, Lei Tong nodded, "Miss is right. I'm also worried about their injuries not having fully healed yet. After all, such miraculous medical techniques are unheard of. To ensure their recovery, I think it would be best if we stay here and observe them for some time. What do you think, Miss?
Of course, Lei Yun Mountain Manor will cover the costs for the subsequent observation and treatment."
Su Lingxiua was taken aback. She hadn't expected Lei Tong to ask to stay for observation.
Li Xuan also found this unexpected. Stay here? After giving it a little bit more thought, he began to understand Lei Yun Mountain Manor's intent.
To observe Chang Qing Pavilion, even attempt to steal the miraculous Daoist Alchemy technique, and to obstruct the All Ages Alliance members from coming here for treatment!
"That wouldn't necessarily be impossible. But the fee for subsequent observation and treatment would be..."
Su Lingxiu started, with a smile.
"One top-tier Spiritual Medicine per day!"
Lei Tong said, with a grave expression.
"Deal!"
She couldn't refuse when someone was bringing top-tier Spiritual Medicine to her. Su Lingxiu instantly agreed.
Her swift agreement left Lei Tong feeling a little disconcerted.
"Zhu Xingzheng, quickly set up an observation hall for the patients."
Su Lingxiu turned and instructed Zhu Xingzheng.
"Alright, no problem!"
Zhu Xingzheng, already quite adept at setting up shelters, immediately sprang into action, calling on Golden Horned Deer to swiftly construct the hall on the empty land of the manor.
"That's it for now. Lei and I will come back to visit in a few days."
Upon seeing this, Lei Tong gave a respectful bow.
Fan Kaisan handed a storage pouch to Su Lingxiu, saying: "Here are thirty stalks of divine-grade spiritual medicine, keep them well, miss!"
"Take care, see you!"
Su Lingxiu excitedly accepted.
Thirty stalks of divine-grade spiritual medicine, that's a month's stay at the Chang Qing Pavilion.
"Miss Su, the house is set up!"
Zhu Xingzheng came in a hurry.
"Dear guests, please make yourself at home there."
Su Lingxiu pointed at the just-built house.
"Thank you for your hospitality!"
The martial artists of Lei Yun Mountain Manor thanked her respectfully.
They were very pleased with their lodgings, which were near the main gate of Chang Qing Pavilion, convenient for observation.
Among the injured, there was one who had condensed the Heavenly Earth Lingji, powerful enough to deter most of the mighty All Ages Alliance.
"Why let them stay?"
Cai Ling'er asked curiously.
"One divine-grade spiritual medicine per day, where else can you find such a good deal?"
Su Lingxiu giggled.
With these divine-grade medicines, the grade of the elixir can be raised another notch.
"Master, set up a formation."
She found Fang Hao and asked cheerfully.
"No problem, though one of them is quite powerful, he may not be fooled."
Fang Hao nodded his head.
However, among the injured from Lei Yun Mountain Manor, there was one powerful enough that he couldn't stealthily deploy a formation with his current strength.
"No worries, with master here."
Su Lingxiu scurried over to Li Xuan, kneading her master's shoulders and saying: "Master, you blind and deafen that guy, so he won't detect the formation that junior brother is setting."
"Alright!"
Li Xuan looked helpless.
After Fang Hao set up the formation, the people from Lei Yun Mountain Manor had no idea they were being enveloped by it. They thought they were keeping an eye on everything at Chang Qing Pavilion.
Even when they left the house to mingle and find out about the Chang Qing Pavilion, they had no clue that they were merely wandering around that same house.
Their so-called conversation was nothing more than a soliloquy.
"Fang Hao's accomplishments in formations and Heavenly Earth Trap Designs have improved quite a bit."
Li Xuan was gratified.
Three days later, Lei Tong came, under the guise of visiting the injured.
However, he found nothing out of the ordinary, let alone the existence of a formation. After secretly exchanging words with the injured, he thought he had gained some valuable information.
Little did he know, the moment he set foot in Chang Qing Pavilion, he had stepped into Li Xuan's Heavenly Earth trap. All he saw and heard was but illusion.
With Li Xuan's current power and understanding of the Laws of Heaven and Earth, even Lei Tong, a powerhouse like him, couldn't detect his trap design.
After all, in the Spirit Domain, formations and Heavenly Earth Trap Designs were unheard-of things, naturally there was no caution against them, and no deliberate search for their existence.
After another three days, Lei Tong came again.
Having visited the injured and praised Su Lingxiu, he left satisfied.
But in the eyes of Moon Changming and Cai Ling'er, there was an odd look on his face. What was odd about Lei Tong?
Sometimes he would mumble to himself, saying words of gratitude, even clapping and exclaiming, as if hearing some stimulating news.
If one didn't know the inside story, one might think Lei Tong had lost his mind.
"Even a powerhouse like Lei Tong is at the mercy of others!"
Cai Ling'er sighed inwardly.
"I'm close to committing the ninth page to memory."
Li Xuan was thrilled, he was about to fully memorize the ninth page of the Book of Tai Cang.
Above his Soul Pedestal, the Daoist Golden Book was opened, and golden light surged out.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has broken through to the Divine Origin Realm, and your Divine Origin is magnified a hundred times!"
Li Xuan was overjoyed. Xu Yan had broken through to the Divine Origin Realm, and his Divine Origin had increased a hundredfold. His power had soared once more, and the power of his divine abilities had exploded.
Increase in strength feels good for a while, continuous increase feels good all the time.
"Divine Origin Realm, I must be close to mastering Divine Skills."
Li Xuan had high hopes for his main disciple.

chapters.title: Chapter 568 - 308 Divine Body of Mountains and Rivers, Life-Burning Killing Machine_1
chapters.content:
Li Xuan felt an uncontrollable surge of excitement. Xu Yan's swift accumulation of foundational strength and subsequent breakthrough into the Divine Origin Realm was tied to his undefeated path.
"With this breakthrough of Xu Yan, unless anything unforeseen occurs, he should morph into a Divine Body, right?"
When Xu Yan broke through the Divine Intent State, he became a Divine Bone Spiritual Body. Now, he trascended into the Divine Origin Realm, and unless something unexpected happens, he would morph into a Divine Body, uniting Divine Bones and Divine Body. This further enhanced his innate talent, making his strength far superior within the same realm.
"Your disciple, Xu Yan, has transformed into a Mountain River Divine Body. You obtain the innate Mountain River Divine Body."
Upon acquiring the innate Mountain River Divine Body, Li Xuan's strength was once again elevated. It felt as though he embodied mountains and rivers within him, shaping his Martial Arts principles akin to the principles of mountains and rivers.
"The feeling of power-up is amazing!"
Li Xuan was brimming with excitement.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has comprehended the sixth layer of Descending Dragon Palm (True Dragon Form) - your Descending Dragon Palm has reached grand completion at the sixth layer!"
The Descending Dragon Palm had also advanced.
The sixth layer of Descending Dragon Palm was the True Dragon Form. Every palm strike was as if he was commanding a true dragon, with the dragon-shaped palm force nearly indistinguishable from a real dragon.
"Truly worthy of being my Martial Arts pioneer."
Li Xuan exclaimed in exhilaration.
"Xu Yan has broken through to the Divine Origin Realm. It won't be long before I could completely comprehend Martial Art methods of the Physiognomy Realm, I presume?"
He was full of anticipation.
Compared to Martial Arts methods of the Physiognomy Realm, Xu Yan was relatively easy to comprehend, and Li Xuan had faith in him.
However, the Martial Arts method of the Void-breaking Realm would be much more difficult.
It was likely that Xu Yan would need to upgrade his Martial Arts comprehension further, after reaching the Divine Skill Realm, to comprehend the Martial Art method of the Void-breaking Realm.
With this breakthrough of Xu Yan, his strength soared massively and even the peak Refining God Heavenly Man Martial Artists could no longer pose a threat to him.
Even for a supreme individual like Huang Liang who had condensed the Heavenly Earth Lingji, Xu Yan might not be able to defeat him, but he wouldn't pose a threat to Xu Yan either.
This was the confidence brought on by the breakthrough into the Divine Origin Realm.
"With Xu Yan's current strength, unless Spiritual Body Refining God Heavenly Men, no one else is a match for him."
Of course, even Refining God Heavenly Men with a Spiritual Body talent who wanted to fight Xu Yan must be at the peak of the Refining God Realm.
Xu Yan, be it in Martial Arts or foundational strength, was far superior to the Spirit-body Prodigies of the Ling Domain.
"Having broken through the Divine Origin Realm, the undefeated path should come to an end for now. I wonder what Xu Yan will do next?"
Li Xuan was becoming curious.
Of course, the extensive Eighteen States of the Ling Domain were enough for Xu Yan to wander and explore, and participate in the Martial Arts competitions everywhere, which could also help enhance his Martial Arts comprehension.
"The competition between the Prodigies of the Ling Domain is pretty much decided, Xu Yan is the supreme."
The competition for the Prodigies lasts ten years, and when the final Prodigy battle arrives, it is expected that without any surprises, Xu Yan should have reached the Divine Skill Realm.
Even if he isn't in the Divine Skill Realm, he will definitely be in the complete realm of Divine Element.
Let alone the Prodigies of the Ling Domain, even the strongest person in the Transcendent Spirit Sect would not be a match for Xu Yan.
"Your disciple, Su Lingxiu, has completed the breakthrough in the Divine Intent State. Your Dan Medical Martial Art Divine Origin Realm has reached grand completion."
Su Lingxiu had completed the breakthrough in the Divine Intent State, so she too was about to begin accumulating foundational strength in preparations for her breakthrough into the Divine Origin Realm. However, it would be much more convenient for Su Lingxiu to accumulate foundational strength.
By healing the injured, especially the strong ones, she could gain Dan Medical experience, obtain Spiritual Medicine, refine it into pills. With enough high-grade pills of various types, she could quickly accumulate sufficient foundational strength.
Being a Dan Medical Martial Artist, accumulating foundational strength quickly is the essence of the path of Dan Medicine.
"Senior Brother is too strong!"
Fang Hao was shocked.
News about Xu Yan had arrived.
He went directly to the Thousand Martial State, challenged the gate of the Thousand Martial Hall, killed Martial Artists of the Thousand Martial Hall continuously, and single-handedly defeated five prodigies, shaking the Thousand Martial State.
"Strange, how did the Thousand Martial Hall maintain such discipline?"
Su Lingxiu asked suspiciously.
Within the Transcendent Spirit Sect, the Thousand Martial Hall is the most notorious. That's common knowledge.
Yet, despite being challenged at their gate, they accepted it without violating the rules of the Prodigy competition by inviting a strong person to compete. This was not in line with the Thousand Martial Hall's style.
"There must be another reason, it's related to the start of this Prodigy competition."
Fang Hao pondered.
The Thousand Martial Hall must have felt some apprehension which is why they did not send strong ones to fight.
"Second Senior Brother is also strong. With a single person, he swept the Prodigy Battle of Daxuan City, causing Spirit Sect to lose face."
News from Meng Chong also arrived.
Fang Hao was fired up, and couldn't wait to go to the main league immediately, claim the Prodigy title of the main league on his own, then challenge the Prodigies of the Spirit Sect, and gain fame in the Ling Domain.
Among the four brothers and sisters, he was the only one who was not famous enough. Although it seemed like he had made a name for himself in Yuzhou, Yuzhou was still weak. No matter how famous he was, regardless of how clever his methods were, he would not be taken seriously by real Prodigies.
In the end, the Spirit Sect of Yuzhou was indeed too weak.
Therefore, if he wanted to really make a name for himself in the Ling Domain, he still had to rely on strong power to crush each Spirit Sect Prodigy.
The time had come for the show of strength for his odd door martial arts.
Senior Sister Su Lingxiu, although she seemed low-key and not well-known, it was quite clear that before long, her name as a Dan Medical Fairy would spread throughout the Ling Domain.
"I need to refine the Flying Boat as soon as possible!"
Fang Hao thought excitedly.
He continued to start refining the Flying Boat. Now that the concept of the Flying Boat had been confirmed, he could start refining. It was the first time he was crafting such a complex and mysterious Flying Boat, the process was extremely complicated, and he had to be careful with every single component, given the limited rare materials, he couldn't waste any.
Moreover, apart from refining a Flying Boat for his Master, he also had to refine one for his own usage.

chapters.title: Chapter 569 - 308: Divine Body of Mountains and Rivers, Life-Risking Assassination_2
chapters.content:
...
At the entrance to the Thousand Martial Hall in the land of Qian Wu, many martial artists lingered, waiting for Xu Yan's return.
They wanted to see if the pride of the Thousand Martial Hall would be forced out of hiding.
Wu Tianan was pondering whether to leave Qian Wu or stay and wait for Xu Yan's appearance.
After all, without his potential deterrence, the despicable members of the Thousand Martial Hall might intervene personally, bullying the weak with their strength.
But he was truly curious to meet Xu Yan's master.
An existence beyond Heaven and Earth?
That was a power he did not dare to even dream of.
"If Xu Yan is correct, why would a disciple of such a terrifying existence be threatened by the Thousand Martial Hall? There's no need for me to worry about him."
After much consideration, Wu Tianan couldn't resist his curiosity and turned to leave for the Wanshi Alliance headquarters to find the Alliance Hierarch of Yuzhou, intending to personally inquire whether he could visit Xu Yan's master.
Inside the Thousand Martial Hall, about a dozen talented martial artists were sitting with their legs crossed. They were from all the major Spirit Sects in Qian Wu, and even the weakest had reached the mid-stage of Refining God Heavenly Man.
The most formidable had even reached the peak stage of the Refining God Heavenly Man.
Of course, their cultivation level appeared inflated, but their power was significantly boosted.
This was all done by the Thousand Martial Hall to be ready for Xu Yan's challenge.
"This Self-Annihilation Killing Mechanism, combining your Divine Souls, vitality, and everything you have, is a real ultimate move and a must-have technique for the elites of the Thousand Martial Hall.
"This is a mutual destruction technique; once it's triggered, you wouldn't live long.
"But when you are outclassed, it gives you the assurance to mutually destruct with your enemy, knowing that they will die too."
The four elders sat at four corners, gathering strands of their energy and infusing them into the bodies of the young elites, helping them to gather the Self-Annihilation Killing Mechanism.
Without the help of these formidable powers, these talents wouldn't be able to gather the Self-Annihilation Killing Mechanism.
"The opportunity to make meritorious contributions for the Thousand Martial Hall is coming. You are now disciples of the Thousand Martial Hall, the pride of Thousand Martial Hall.
"When danger comes, do not hesitate to trigger the Self-Annihilation Killing Mechanism!
"Martial artists from the Thousand Martial Hall must possess this courage and determination. Do you understand?"
The group of elites looked serious, but their eyes were firm. This was an opportunity to become a disciple of the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
Even if they died, their families and powers behind them would benefit greatly.
"We understand!"
The group of elites replied firmly.
"Good!"
The elder of the Thousand Martial Hall showed a smile.
Meanwhile, in a secret room of the Thousand Martial Hall, five young men who all had reached the peak stage of Refining God Heavenly Man were sitting cross-legged.
These five men were the publicly known elites of the Thousand Martial Hall.
At this moment, they were also gathering the Self-Annihilation Killing Mechanism with the help of the elders.
Compared with the talents from the three countries, the seven sects and the eight noble families, the elites cultivated by the Thousand Martial Hall personally were undoubtedly stronger.
Even if they had achieved the peak stage of Refining God Heavenly Man by means of special means in a short period of time, and their cultivation level appeared inflated, their power was still far stronger than that of regular peak-stage Refining God Heavenly Man martial artists.
"Your Self-Annihilation Killing Mechanism is extraordinary. When the time comes, you must use it decisively. As elites of the Thousand Martial Hall, you absolutely cannot be timid or hesitate!"
An elder said in a heavy voice.
"Elder, rest assured, even if we can't defeat Xu Yan, even if we die, we will never let Xu Yan get away with it!"
A few disciples of the Thousand Martial Hall said coldly.
"Good!"
The elder smiled satisfyingly.
In another secret location within the Thousand Martial Hall, the Thousand Martial Lord walked in.
"How is it going?"
Looking at the young man sitting cross-legged, a long knife resting across his knees, he turned to the elder next to him who was responsible for the knife and asked.
"It's successful. The Shockingly Cold Knife can now be used."
The elder responsible for the knife said in a low voice.
The Shockingly Cold Knife was one of the Divine Artifacts of the Thousand Martial Hall.
"Lord, do we really need to use the Divine Artifact? And it's for the Self-Annihilation Killing Mechanism to activate the Shockingly Cold Knife."
The elder responsible for the knife asked incredulously.
Was Xu Yan so powerful that he could force the Thousand Martial Hall to resort to this?
Even the Divine Artifact had to be used.
Moreover, in order to avoid being influenced by Xu Yan's Sword Dao, the Shockingly Cold Knife, a Divine Artifact, was deliberately chosen as the weapon. However, just being at the peak of refining God Heavenly Man wasn't enough to activate the power of the Divine Artifact.
Therefore, he infused a thread of condensed Heavenly Earth Lingji into the Shockingly Cold Knife, blended it with the disciple's Divine Soul, and used the Self-Annihilation Killing Mechanism as the activation, to burst out the power of the Shockingly Cold Knife in one go.
Such a move would be enough to kill even those powerful beings who had condensed a strand of Heavenly Earth Lingji.
They plan to use it against Xu Yan!
No matter how strong Xu Yan is, it's far from enough to resist those who have successfully condensed the Heavenly Earth Lingji.
If it really comes to the point where all these measures need to be used, it means that the prodigies of the Thousand Martial Hall would all undoubtedly die.
Of course, the death of these apparent prodigies would not cause too much damage to the Thousand Martial Hall, after all, the existence of the Hall is to cultivate core prodigies.
In the end, their generation of elders, controlling the Thousand Martial Hall, can continue to prolong the time, waiting to nurture the appropriate successors.
"A prepared mind fears no trouble!"
The Thousand Martial Lord calmly said.
"Wu Tianan, has he really reached that step? If he sets foot on the Divine Bridge, wouldn't…"
The Elder Blade Master said with a serious face.
The Thousand Martial Hall probably harbors the strongest grudge against Wu Tianan.
"He won't have a chance!"
The Thousand Martial Lord said expressionlessly.
"I'll go see the old preceptors."
The Thousand Martial Lord turned and left.
"Master, is it really necessary for those old preceptors to do this?"
The Elder Blade Master said heavily.
"Not necessarily targeting Xu Yan, it could also be targeting the All Ages Alliance. They are old, their lifespan isn't much longer and they have no chance to set foot on the Divine Bridge. For their descendants, they will be willing to gamble once.
"This is a tradition within the Thousand Martial Hall."
Having said that, the Thousand Martial Lord turned and left.
The Elder Blade Master fell silent, as one of those old preceptors was the person who brought him into the Thousand Martial Hall.
"Perhaps this is the best end."
The Elder Blade Master sighed.
Without the qualification to step onto the Divine Bridge, eventually, their lifespan will exhaust, and choosing to gamble before death, hoping to win a better treatment for their successors.
'Preceptors, have you all prepared?'
The Thousand Martial Hall Master looked at several old men with white hair and kindly features and asked in a deep voice.
"Master, rest assured, we are already ready."
An old man with a wrinkled face smiled and said.
'That's good, just wait for the command.'
The Thousand Martial Hall master nodded his head.
These old preceptors were the elders of the Thousand Martial Hall, who were also considered prodigies in their prime. Those who could become disciples of the Thousand Martial Hall surely had the title of prodigies.
Either they encountered some accidents and their realm could no longer be promoted, or their talent was ultimately limited and they could no longer continue on the path of martial arts.
Despite this, these individuals cultivated themselves for such a long time, combined with the secret technique they practiced in order to prepare for the present mission.
There have always been such a group of people in the Thousand Martial Hall.
Just like before, when they were contesting with the Wanxing Martial Arts Academy, and when they destroyed the Blood Demon Sect, it was the same.
The foundation and hidden strengths of the Transcendent Spirit Sect were far more complex than they seemed.
This is not only true for the Thousand Martial Hall, but for the rest of the Transcendent Spirit Sect as well.
"Wu Tianan, All Ages Alliance, how will you fight?"
The Thousand Martial Lord sneered in his heart.
"Xu Yan, a young man with some talents, is so self-conceited. Do you really think that you are the most honoured prodigy in the Ling Domain? Throughout the ages of the Ling Domain, countless monsters have emerged, which one of them has shaken the Spirit Sect?
"How many monsters who opposed the Spirit Sect have turned to dust? The Blood Demon was one of them, you, Xu Yan, will not be an exception!"
A murderous intent flashed in the eyes of the Thousand Martial Lord.
The half-month period is about to come, he wanted to see if Xu Yan could still be so arrogant!
There were more and more martial artists outside the gate of the Thousand Martial Hall, even including experts who had rushed here from other regions.
They all wanted to witness the rise of a monster, and also see the fall of a monster.
Xu Yan is the first person in the history of the Ling Domain to challenge at the gate of the Transcendent Spirit Sect and set up a ring.
In the crowd, a giant eagle landed on a large tree. There was a small palace on the back of the eagle, Cui Huayu, wearing a colourful feather coat, poked her head out of the palace.
"Xu Yan, what a brave man!"
Cui Huayu could not help but sigh. As one of the direct disciples of the Yu Ling Mansion, he was also a well-known prodigy. Since witnessing the battle between Xu Yan and Lu Xinting, he was deeply shocked.
It wasn't long after, Xu Yan became the first person to challenge the Transcendent Spirit Sect and set the ring at the gate of the sect.
I have to admire that!

chapters.title: Chapter 570 - 309: So Embarrassing, Coming on a Sword_1
chapters.content:
In front of the gate of the Thousand Martial Hall, there was unprecedented hustle and bustle. Almost all the strong ones from the Thousand Martial Province had gathered here.
The powers from the three countries, seven sects, and eight ancient families were all there, standing solemnly around the gate, their presence and attitudes maintaining order.
Cui Huayu yawned muttered, "Xu Yan will either die or his face will be swollen from getting beaten by the Thousand Martial Hall, but the probability of death is too high.
"The people from the Thousand Martial Hall won't swallow their pride easily. Even if Xu Yan wins now, he won't live long.
"They say that the Thousand Martial Hall is the most shameless, often resorting to underhanded means behind the scenes. They've been known to strike against both Loose Cultivators and their own sect members."
Cui Huayu thought Xu Yan's brilliance would probably only last a moment, and that his downfall was fast approaching.
"I wonder if the All Ages Alliance will send any powerful fighters."
Cui Huayu stuck his head out again, surveying the surroundings.
So far, there was no mention of Xu Yan being the genius of the All Ages Alliance, but since he was a Loose Cultivator, it was unlikely that the All Ages Alliance would not send anyone powerful.
After all, they had to guard against the possibility of the Thousand Martial Hall breaking rules.
"How did the Thousand Martial Hall swallow their pride last time?"
Cui Huayu was somewhat puzzled.
Given the nature of the Thousand Martial Hall, shouldn't they have dispatched a powerful fighter to suppress Xu Yan when he challenged them at their doorstep last time?
But, they didn't!
Could it be because they were afraid to lose face and tarnish the reputation of the Thousand Martial Hall under public scrutiny?
"There must be some inside information."
Cui Huayu chuckled.
Just as he was about to pull his head back in, he suddenly turned towards the sky, his expression one of surprise.
"Why is she here?"
A lady with a thin silk veil completely covering her face was stealthily making her way towards him, taking a position on a big tree not far away.
"Why would someone from the Taimiao Sect join in on this commotion? Even if they wanted to, they should have sent a disciple, not her."
Cui Huayu looked on, bewildered.
The visitor was none other than Yarong, disciple of Xin Mengrou from the Taimiao Sect!
"She's at the peak of the Refining God Heavenly Man level and is a disciple of Xin Mengrou. Definitely not someone to be underestimated."
Muttering to himself, Cui Huayu pulled his head back into the palace, awaiting the appearance of Xu Yan.
Time passed and the day of reckoning arrived.
Everyone was eagerly waiting for Xu Yan's appearance.
At the gate of the Thousand Martial Hall, various geniuses had gathered, their faces icy. Thousand Martial Lord looked indifferent, also waiting for Xu Yan's appearance.
"What's going on? Did Xu Yan back down?"
"It's possible. He might have sustained major injuries after the fight. That's probably why he asked for a half-month postponement—to heal his wounds."
"Sounds reasonable."
Seeing that Xu Yan had not appeared, the crowd of martial artists began to speculate.
"Do you think there's a chance that Xu Yan said he'd be back in half a month just to hold off the Thousand Martial Hall, then took the opportunity to escape and hide?"
"Now that you mention it, it could be possible!"
As Xu Yan was nowhere in sight, many participants presumed he might not have recovered from the injuries he sustained during the previous fight, hence the appointed half-month wait.
Others speculated that he might have used the half-month schedule to distract the Thousand Martial Hall, then took the opportunity to escape and go into hiding.
Due to the growing speculations, even the Thousand Martial Hall began to doubt.
They wore gloomy expressions.
After investing a significant amount of resources and secret techniques to enhance their geniuses' abilities, preparing an all-out attack to bring Xu Yan down, it turned out he'd escaped?
Had the Thousand Martial Hall been played for fools?
The longer Xu Yan's absence, the more plausible it seemed to them. Their faces darkened further, murderous intents palpable. They wished they could devour Xu Yan alive.
The expressions on the faces of the elders of the Thousand Martial Hall were equally stern.
Meanwhile, the geniuses who had been prepared to risk everything were exchanging glances. They had labored for half a month, fully prepared for a fight to the death only to find out their opponent had run off.
Still, they felt a small sense of relief—they no longer needed to risk their lives. Plus, they had become disciples of the Thousand Martial Hall, an enormous gain.
In fact, they should be thanking Xu Yan. Without him, how could they have become disciples of the Thousand Martial Hall that easily?
Even though Xu Yan hadn't shown up, their statuses as disciples of the Thousand Martial Hall and their increased strengths were undeniable, which were great opportunities.
Just then, a figure in the sky approached at an extreme speed.
All noise ceased as they turned to look, only to be disappointed again.
It wasn't Xu Yan!
"A representative from the All Ages Alliance?"
"This one is powerful—an elite from the All Ages Alliance."
In the crowd of observers, someone recognized the identity of the new arrival, a supreme member of the All Ages Alliance.
"It seems to be... Tian Ji, the Great Protector of the All Ages Alliance."
"Right, it is indeed him. I didn't expect the All Ages Alliance to send him. Unfortunately, Xu Yan seems to have backed off."
Tian Ji hurriedly approached, landing on a large tree. He didn't get too close to the Thousand Martial Hall. His gaze fell on the arena, and he paused.
Where are they?
He had rushed over as soon as he received the news, fearing that the shameless ones from the Thousand Martial Hall might bully the weak.
But, where were they?
Had he arrived a step too late? Had Xu Yan already been killed?
"Where's Xu Yan? You shameless rogues from the Thousand Martial Hall, how dare you defy the rules of the genius battle!"
Tian Ji was furious.
He reached out and slapped, and the big halberd on his back soared into the air, landing into his hand.
This was one of the Divine Artifacts of the All Ages Alliance, the Thousand Mountain Halberd!

chapters.title: Chapter 571 - 309: So Embarrassing, Coming on a Sword_2
chapters.content:
Each strike was as heavy as thousands of mountains, its power was astonishing.
"Hiss! So powerful!"
As Tian Ji's momentum erupted, many martial artists showed solemn expressions on their faces.
No wonder he's the Great Protector of the All Ages Alliance. His power is incredibly strong, and he even brought a divine artifact!
But, did he misunderstand? The Thousand Martial Hall has not even made a move, it's just that Xu Yan backed off.
The Thousand Martial Lord and the elders nearly died of anger!
Damn it, does my Thousand Martial Hall appear so vulnerable in your eyes?
You enjoy bullying the weak, don't you?
Damn!
One by one, they were seething with anger, wishing they could kill Tian Ji!
"What's the matter, don't you dare to take responsibility for your actions in the Thousand Martial Hall?"
Tian Ji roared furiously.
Damn!
The elder holding a knife in the Thousand Martial Hall roared: "Tian Ji, don't be reckless! My Thousand Martial Hall is respectful, how can we stoop to the level of Loose Cultivators? It's just that Xu Yan chickened out and didn't come!"
Tian Ji was stunned, Xu Yan backed off and didn't show up?
He looked at the crowd of onlookers and from their expressions, he got the answer.
For a moment, his face turned red.
Damn!
This is so embarrassing!
He silently put the 'Thousand-Mountains Halberd' back on his back, coughed and said: "Young people are unreliable. Why dawdle and cause a misunderstanding!"
The martial artists were all speechless.
However, they were not surprised by Tian Ji's reaction. After all, the style of the Thousand Martial Hall... was indeed easy to misunderstand.
The faces of the Thousand Martial Lord and others turned black.
Cui Huayu's mouth twitched. He asked a martial artist who had also watched the battle last time about when Xu Yan left.
The martial artist did not think too much and told Cui Huayu the time.
"What's the rush? The agreed time hasn't even come yet!"
Cui Huayu was muttering in his heart.
Would Xu Yan back off?
He didn't believe that. The agreed time had not yet arrived, and Xu Yan was a punctual man.
This time, it surely won't be an exception.
"Let's disperse. There's no excitement to watch anymore, we can't witness history. I came all this way, but Xu Yan stepped on the face of the Thousand Martial Hall and might have hidden somewhere."
A martial artist said with disappointment.
Once he said this, the other martial artists all nodded in agreement.
"The Thousand Martial Hall made a big mistake, Xu Yan stepped on their faces and became the first in the history of Ling Domain to do so, then directly hid. I guess it wouldn't be easy for the Thousand Martial Hall to find him."
"The Thousand Martial Hall is really going to become a joke this time!"
A martial artist said with a gloating smile on his face.
But, they laughed too soon.
Mocking the Thousand Martial Hall in front of their mountain door, isn't this asking for death?
Boom!
An attack came from the mountain door of the Thousand Martial Hall, and in the shocked gaze of that martial artist, it blasted him to death!
The other martial artists were all shocked and silent, no one dared to discuss it anymore.
They didn't dare to show a hint of schadenfreude.
At this moment, they realized that the Thousand Martial Hall was indeed a Transcendent Spirit Sect and they could not brazenly comment and mock just because Xu Yan had stepped on their faces.
The powerful ones from the three countries, seven sects, and eight families were all glaring at the other martial artists, seething with murderous intent. If anyone dared to disrespect, they would react ferociously.
Some martial artists quietly retreated. There was no excitement to watch and the Thousand Martial Hall was in a fury. To avoid becoming their punching bag, it's better to leave quickly.
After all, Loose Cultivators are very likely to become punching bags.
"After sunset, Xu Yan didn't show up. Order all the Spirit Sects in Ling Domain to chase Xu Yan! He, who goes against his word and breaks the rules, should be executed! The rules of the contest of the Heaven's Chosen do not apply!"
The Lord of the Thousand Martial Hall turned away with a gloomy face.
"Yes, Lord!"
The faces of the elders of the Thousand Martial Hall looked extremely grim.
They were stepped on and were preparing for revenge, but the other party quit playing!
Wasn't their face stepped on for nothing?
It's the humiliation of the Thousand Martial Hall. Who knows how many martial artists will laugh behind their backs in the future!
"Is it almost time?"
Cui Huayu poked his head out and looked around. He was also a little nervous, fearing that he had guessed wrong and Xu Yan really did back off and didn't keep his promise.
At this moment, Tian Ji felt very embarrassed, not knowing whether he should leave or not.
Suddenly, a martial artist exclaimed in near disbelief, "Look, what is that?"
Everyone turned to look, utterly stunned at the sight.
In the distance, one tree after another soared into the sky, transforming into a giant sword suspended in mid-air, radiant with the chilling sword energy.
A figure was making its way over, each step landing on a giant sword that had risen from the ground. As he approached closer and closer, more and more trees soared into the air, morphing into giant swords.
When the figure was near the gate of the Thousand Martial Hall, all the swords formed a circle. One sword connected to another, their tips piercing the edges of the original fighting ring, effectively encircling it.
The youth was handsome, radiating an unyielding spirit all around him!
Xu Yan had arrived!
Silence!
All the martial artists were flabbergasted. The transformation of plants into swords and creating a sword pathway, what kind of power was this?
"I knew it, Xu Yan is a punctual person!"
Cui Huayu murmured to herself.
The moment Xu Yan arrived, he had stunned everyone around.
Those who had claimed that Xu Yan had shrunk back and hidden were now flushed and embarrassed. They could only force themselves to remain composed, denying they had ever made such assertions.
"Xu Yan, he truly deserves to be the number one prodigy of the Ling Domain. Who said he retreated? Ah, I indeed have discerning eyes, I had predicted that Xu Yan would definitely show up!"
"Wasn't it you who said Xu Yan was hiding?"
"You're full of nonsense! What I said was, it's absolutely impossible for Xu Yan to hide!"
"I remember that the last time Xu Yan left, it was also around this hour. Xu Yan is really punctual!"
A martial artist exclaimed with admiration.
Tian Ji was shocked. Rumors about Xu Yan abound, whisperings of his intricate sword skills sounding too surreal to be believed as something credible.
Only now, watching him in action, he realized that some rumors were indeed true.
The ingenuity of Xu Yan's swordsmanship was now beyond any mythical description.
The Thousand Martial Lord, who had just left, returned to the gate once more, his face gravely serious. Seeing Xu Yan's entry, he seemed to have grown stronger?
The pride of Thousand Martial Hall was now heavy-hearted. Xu Yan was here!
This meant they had to fight with all their might.
Upon Xu Yan's arrival, he shocked everyone present with his overwhelming power and the profoundness of his swordsmanship. It was indeed unimaginable.
Under normal circumstances, they would not stand a chance against him.
They would inevitably have to risk everything, even their lives. As it turned out, it wouldn't matter if Xu Yan lived or died, they were destined to die!
However, now that Xu Yan had appeared, there was no other choice!
Yarong stood on a large tree, watching the youth, her heart filled with astonishment.
"Such an unparalleled young master in the world, it's no wonder he caught the hearts of those two girls."
Who could it have been that cultivated such a disciple, displaying such demeanor?
Yarong suddenly desired to meet Xu Yan's master.
"After all, he's still too young. Publicly coming to set up a fighting ring at the gate of Thousand Martial Hall, aiming to suppress the Thousand Martial Hall, how could it be so easy? Even if the Thousand Martial Hall doesn't take advantage of him due to his young age, there are still ways to deal with him."
Yarong sighed in her heart, feeling Xu Yan was ultimately too young and hot-blooded, somewhat absurd.
Xu Yan stood on the platform, gazing at the gate of the Thousand Martial Hall. This time, he must crush the pride of the Thousand Martial Hall under his feet.
"Reached Divine Origin Realm, the peak of an ordinary Refining God Heavenly Man is nothing more than this. I hope the pride of the Thousand Martial Hall, really have some capability."
Xu Yan thought to himself.
He couldn't yet claim the peak of the Ling Domain by stepping on the Thousand Martial Hall. The Divine Origin Realm was just the beginning and insufficient to suppress the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
"After this battle, regardless of whether the old guy from Thousand Martial Hall takes action personally or not, I should traverse the Ling Domain and challenge all martial artists."
After breaking the Divine Realm, he would traverse the Ling Domain, challenge all martial artists, observe the mountains and rivers of Ling Domain, and understand the mysteries of martial arts.
"Breaking the Divine Skill Realm within ten years."
Xu Yan set a goal for himself.
The cultivation of Martial Arts, the higher the level, the more time it takes, but he was confident he could break the Divine Skill Realm within ten years.
"Once entering the Divine Powers, unmatched in the Ling Domain!"
Every time Xu Yan thought of the shock his master had caused when he demonstrated the Law of Heaven and Earth, he couldn't help but feel thrilled and expectant of what kind of divine skills he would develop when he broke through the Divine Skill Realm.
"Underneath is Sword God Xu Yan, challenging the pride of the Thousand Martial Hall."
Xu Yan spoke out arrogantly.
At the gate of the Thousand Martial Hall, the elder who held the command knife looked at a figure, signaling him to fight.
"The pride of Thousand Martial Hall is not something you can challenge at will. Let's see if you can pass my hurdle first."
A figure, holding a sword, flew from the gate of the Thousand Martial Hall and landed on the ring.
"Are we deciding the winner, or life and death?"
Xu Yan asked indifferently.
To decide the victor, or life and death, Xu Yan left the choice to the opponent.
"Decide life and death!"
The figure spoke coldly. He had no other choice but to opt for an impromptu death match.

chapters.title: Chapter 572 - 310 - Just a Little Skill, Nothing More Than This _1
chapters.content:
The battle of the prodigies once again started in front of the Thousand Martial Hall's gate. All martial artists were excited, witnessing history again.
"I initially thought the Blood Demon of previous years was already audacious and arrogant enough. It's fortunate that I've lived until now to realize that there's always someone better. Xu Yan is crazier than the Blood Demon!"
An elder sighed in reaction.
Xu Yan was the first to challenge at the gate of the Transcendent Spirit Sect's mountain.
"It's too exciting!"
Cui Huayu leaned halfway out of the palace entrance, a handful of spirit beans in her hand. She threw them into her mouth one by one, eagerly watching the battle about to erupt.
On the fighting platform, Xu Yan sprang up into the air, as did the genius of the Thousand Martial Hall. After all, if they were to fight on the platform, the stage would crumble instantly due to inability to endure the fight.
Of course, the genius of the Thousand Martial Hall was not concerned about the platform crumbling. However, the platform was too close to the front gate of the Thousand Martial Hall, there would be collateral damage from the warfare.
Therefore, he followed Xu Yan into the air to engage in mid-air combat.
"Xu Yan, a mere Loose Cultivator, daring to challenge the ruling Sect of the Thousand Martial Hall. Who gave you the courage? Today you are sure to die!"
The genius's aura surged, his blade radiated, his strength was far stronger than the previous five geniuses he had faced.
"Is this one of the genius from the Hundred Blades Sect among the seven sects?"
"Yes, it's him. I didn't expect his strength to have become so strong."
A lot of martial artists through the crowd recognized the genius, from one of the seven sects, the Hundred Blades Sect.
He already has a resounding reputation in the Thousand Martial State.
The Sect leader and many elders from the Hundred Blades Sect watched their genius attentively. If he could kill Xu Yan, the status of the Hundred Blades Sect would increase dramatically.
The Three Kingdoms and Seven Sects, Eight Aristocratic Families all had geniuses who had entered the Thousand Martial Hall. They underwent a half-month of power enhancement and trained in strong secret techniques.
Merely half a month of time and their strength had taken such a massive leap. The depth and tactics of the Transcendent Spirit Sect were truly unimaginable.
Being able to rule over the Ling Domain for countless ages, the depth of the Transcendent Spirit Sect was naturally unimaginable.
Xu Yan looked indifferent. Although the opponent's strength had become much stronger, he was no longer in the Divine Intent State but had broken through to the Divine Origin Realm. Even though he had just recently made the breakthrough, his overall strength was no longer comparable to half a month ago.
He brought his right-hand middle and index fingers together, pointing up at the sky, as divine origin transformed into a longsword.
"Arrogance!"
The genius of the Hundred Blades Sect was enraged.
Xu Yan actually despised him so much that he didn't even bother to draw his sword. He roared, slashing with his blade.
Although angry at Xu Yan's contempt and arrogance, he attacked with his strongest strike. A stormy barrage of blade light unleashed like a gushing tempest.
The strongest ultimate technique of the Hundred Blades Sect, also a mighty blade technique from the Thousand Martial Hall, One Hundred Blades in One Strike!
Layering a hundred blades into one strike!
"Trivial tricks!"
Xu Yan laughed coldly, pointing with his two fingers. The longsword transformed from divine origin struck out. It seemed like an ordinary, unremarkable thrust, but it instantly shattered the strike of the Hundred Blades Sect genius.
Boom!
The blade light exploded and dissipated. He staggered backward, his face filled with disbelief.
Xu Yan reached out and grabbed. The longsword transformed from divine origin fell into his hand. Sword Intent had silently spread, permeating the surroundings and merged with the environment.
The genius of the Hundred Blades Sect was totally unaware of it.
"It seems like Xu Yan has become stronger!"
"Has he spent half a month, just to enhance his strength?"
Among the observing martial artists, those who had witnessed the previous battle were now filled with amazement.
In just half a month, Xu Yan had become even stronger.
"Did you guys notice, there's something different about Xu Yan's Martial Arts? His Martial Arts power is really unusual."
"I've also noticed. It's quite different from the Martial Arts power as I understand. It seems to be something more divine?"
"Does anyone know Xu Yan's ranking? It doesn't look like the Refining God Heavenly Man Realm."
Many of the martial artists showed puzzlement.
Xu Yan's Martial Arts was beyond their knowledge. It appeared to be unlike the standard Spiritual Realm Martial Arts.
"It's not surprising at all. Xu Yan is so powerful. Consequently, the Martial Arts Cultivation Technique he practices is certainly extraordinary. This is probably the reason for his confidence."
"Right, the grade of his Martial Arts Cultivation Technique is extremely top-notch. This is his strength to dare to confront the Transcendent Spirit Sect genius."
Some martial artists were not bothered by it.
They believed that it was only because of Xu Yan practicing a very profound Martial Arts Cultivation Technique.
"In the old days, the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy existed for researching Martial Arts, and even claimed to create a unique Martial Arts Cultivation Technique. Could what Xu Yan is practicing be their cultivation theory?"
"This possibility cannot be ruled out!"
Some martial artists who had experienced the period of the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy said in amazement.
The Thousand Martial Hall's Lord and others atop the gate of the hall all wore grim expressions.
"Xu Yan has become stronger, and his Martial Arts Cultivation Technique…"
With their insight, of course, they could see that Xu Yan's Martial Arts was not ordinary.
Moreover, they were even unable to accurately determine Xu Yan's realm, whether he was still in the Refining God Heavenly Man Realm.
Of course, the powerhouses of the Thousand Martial Hall also believed that it was Wu Tianan and other warriors from previous years at the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy who had researched and developed a unique Martial Arts Cultivation Technique.
"You're strong, but that's all there is!"
The genius of the Hundred Blades Sect's face was cold and severe. Xu Yan's single sword had broken his attack, making him realize that no matter how he made his move, he would not be a match for Xu Yan.
The only thing he could do was to use a Life-Burning Killing Move!
However, once he unleashed the Life-Burning Killing Move, he was sure to die. He wouldn't live much longer.

chapters.title: Chapter 573 - 310 - Just a Little Skill, Nothing More Than This _2
chapters.content:
At this point, there was no choice left. It was time to risk it all.
Boom!
The pride of the Hundred Blades Gate made his move again, his attack now more ferocious than before. With each of his hundred blades stacked into one strike, and every hundred strikes into one slash, this was undoubtedly his most powerful killing move.
"So, this is the unique skill of the Hundred Blades Gate?"
"How powerful!"
The crowd of martial artists was astounded.
Hovering over the arena, layers of blade lights compacted in the blink of an eye, forming a single slash down from the sky, illuminating the atmosphere. It was as though with one slash, he was about to split the heavens and Earth in two!
"He's using his life-risking killing move!"
The Thousand Martial Lord and others all wore serious expressions.
Would his life-risking technique be able to kill Xu Yan?
Or, could it perhaps heavily wound him?
Xu Yan released a sword swing, revealing a mirage of mountains and rivers. The layer upon layer of sword light seemed to dissolve all attacks within the landscape.
An effortless sword stroke, but abundant with endless killing intent.
"The time is now!"
The Hundred Blades champion stiffened, and abruptly, a surge of crimson emerged from within him.
A terrifying killing intent descended abruptly!
Whoosh!
The bloody blade light breached the distance and barrier, appearing immediately in front of Xu Yan!
This horrifying killing intent carried a sense of absolute taboo.
However, upon deploying his life-threatening move, the Hundred Blades champion seemed to have lost his divine soul. His life force was almost entirely depleted, and his physical body withered visibly.
Yet, he wore a smile.
How was Xu Yan supposed to defend against this attack?
The moment the life-threatening move was revealed, all the martial artists were taken aback. What kind of terrifying secret technique was this?
Tian Ji's face darkened, as a halberd instantly appeared in his hand.
However, even if he wanted to help, it was already too late!
This attack was too quick and too powerful. No one anticipated that the pride of the Hundred Blades Gate could deliver such a terrifying strike.
This had surpassed the offensive power that this realm could muster!
"Despicable!"
Tian Ji was filled with surprise and rage. This kind of secret technique must've been cultivated with the assistance of the most powerful being from the Thousand Martial Hall.
Is this the true depth and means of the Transcendent Spirit Sect?
Although shameless, in the rules of the competition among geniuses, there was no limitation on self-immolating attacks!
As for the allegation of the most powerful beings assisting in cultivation, there was no evidence the Thousand Martial Hall would admit that. Also, there was no such limitation in the rules of the competition.
No one anticipated such methods when they drafted the rules of the competition!
No one had expected the Hundred Blades champion to burst out with such a terrifying killing intent, including Xu Yan.
That was the extent of the Hundred Blades pride's strength.
Just as Xu Yan was about to finish his opponent off with a single sword stroke, a sudden killing intent descended.
The bloody blade glow seemed to carry a scent of taboo.
This was a strike powered by the burning of his divine soul and life force.
In the blink of an eye, everything was consumed to fuel the attack, a secret technique not something the Hundred Blades champion could cultivate alone. Even if he cultivated such a technique, it wouldn't allow him to burn his divine soul and vitality instantly into a single attack!
His realm would not allow it!
Moreover, there were constraints when one chose to burn their divine soul and life force willingly.
Undoubtedly, a more powerful being had helped him cultivate it, prepared beforehand so that it could be executed in an instant!
The life-risking killing move arrived suddenly. The bloody blade light closed in, and a crisis fell abruptly.
Though the killing intent came suddenly, Xu Yan was not in the Divine Intent State but the Divine Origin Realm, his martial arts experience already extraordinarily rich.
His ability to handle a crisis was in no way inferior.
Despite being his first time facing such an abrupt crisis, Xu Yan did not panic or lose his composure.
Whoosh!
In an instant, Xu Yan disappeared from his original spot, moving to a different location.
Movement Shift!
However, his expression slightly changed.
The blood-red blade light did not change its course due to his evasion but went after him again!
"Humph!"
Xu Yan harrumphed. The blood-red blade light, burning the opponent's divine soul, had locked onto him, rendering evasion useless. Only raw power could annihilate this attack!
Whoosh!
The blood-red blade light was incredibly close in an instant. Xu Yan didn't dodge. He pointed his two fingers at it. As the divine origin circulated, the sword light illuminated the heaven and earth, carrying a sense of vast righteousness.
Clang!
All the martial artists heard a sword chant in their ears, and then saw Xu Yan thrust out his sword. This sword seemed to conjure a bolt of thunder out of thin air, like a sword of heavenly punishment.
Thunder Shocking Sword!
Pop!
The thunderous sword, like a divine punishment, and the blood-red blade light collided together. A muffled boom echoed with a 'dong' sound.
In mid-air, the thunder exploded, and the blood-red light, like a blood-red firework, exploded in mid-air, swallowed up by the thunder and dissipated into nothingness.
Pop!
The aftermath of the battle swept down. The Heaven's Chosen of Hundred Blade Sect, who was plummeting downward due to the exertion of burning his life force, was engulfed by the aftermath, his body collapsed and turned into flying ashes and dissipated.
Silence!
Such a terrifying strike didn't heavily injure Xu Yan. Instead, he easily blocked it.
At this moment, Xu Yan held his sword, his eyes sharp as he looked at the mountain gate of the Thousand Martial Hall.
People say that Thousand Martial Hall is the most shameless, and this time, it has been deeply proven.
"Such petty tricks, even if you run out of life force and divine soul, it is nothing more than that!"
Xu Yan's sarcastic voice echoed out.
The Thousand Martial Lord and all the elders had terribly gloomy expressions.
The Heavenly Chosen of the Hundred Blade Sect suddenly used the life-burning assassination method, not only did it not kill Xu Yan, but it couldn't even substantially wound him.
Xu Yan's strength once again surpassed expectations!
If this man doesn't die, they felt restless!
It was as if they saw the shadow of the Blood Demon of the past. It was because of their contempt and carelessness that the disaster of the Blood Demon occurred!
"This is serious, really serious!"
Cui Huayu wiped the sweat beads from his forehead, his gaze at the arrogant young man holding the sword, full of admiration.
A monstrous talent has emerged in this Ling Domain, and it's even more terrifying than the Blood Demon of the past!
"Burning life to kill, the people of Thousand Martial Hall, even prepared for this. I didn't expect Xu Yan to block it. Terrifying!"
Being one of the true inheritors of the Yu Ling Mansion, Cui Huayu naturally knew about the means of the Thousand Martial Hall.
