Yarong stood on a big tree, just before, she thought Xu Yan was undoubtedly going to die.
But as a result, not only did he survived, but he was unscathed!
"Xu Yan has taken it, he is prepared, next time it might not be able to cause him harm."
The Elders in charge of the blade technique said solemnly.
The remaining Heavenly Chosen, their strength is similar to that of the Hundred Blade Sect's. The power of their life-burning assassin technique isn't much different either. If Xu Yan could block the life-burning assassin technique of the Hundred Blade Sect's Chosen, he could naturally block the others too.
The Thousand Martial Lord took a deep breath, "So what? We'll still try Xu Yan's strength, we'll still test his coping measures."
The Heavenly Chosen of the Seven Sects and Eight Families of the Three Kingdoms are merely cannon fodders, used to probe Xu Yan's response. The real Heavenly Chosen of the Thousand Martial Hall can subsequently strike in a targeted manner.
"What if Xu Yan doesn't continue to challenge?"
"Heh, then we'll challenge him in turn! I don't believe it, he can suppress everyone!"
The Thousand Martial Hall lord said darkly.
Even if it takes continuous fights, they must keep Xu Yan, otherwise, where would be the face of the Thousand Martial Hall?
"You trash of Thousand Martial Hall, I want to see how many lives you have to burn."
Xu Yan smiled coldly, pointed his sword, and arrogantly said: "Come on, just like last time, five of you come together, I will challenge you five alone!"
At these words, all the martial artists were shocked.
The blow just now was already quite terrifying. Is Xu Yan not afraid of five people launching it at the same time?
Could it be that he is so self-confident, he can withstand the attack of five people?
"A bit arrogant!"
Yarong whispered to herself.
"Young people, they're impulsive!"
Tian Ji shook his head and sighed.
Cui Huayu was so excited, he continued stuffing Ling beans into his mouth, chewing them loudly. His excited face turned red, and he mumbled: "Unbelievable, unbelievable, this is too thrilling!"
"Indulge him, I want to see where does he Xu Yan get his arrogant confidence from!"
The chief blade elder said angrily.
Looking at the five chosen to fight, he commanded, "Give it your all, let's launch the life-burning killing technique together!"
"Yes, Elder!"
The Heavenly Chosen from the Seven Sects and Eight Families nodded their heads with determined expressions, ready to stake it all.
Whoosh!
Five figures soared into the sky, directly surrounding Xu Yan, their intentions to kill ferocious and intense.
The martial artists watched closely, staring hard, with their hearts clenched. The five Heavenly Chosen surrounded Xu Yan in the middle, ready to execute that terrifying killing technique in an instant. Xu Yan had no place to hide!

chapters.title: Chapter 574 - 311: Divine Element Incarnation Startles All Directions_1
chapters.content:
Xu Yan didn't care in the least about being surrounded in the middle, and he understood the intent of the Thousand Martial Hall. Instead of challenging them one by one, it was better to engage them all at once.
He was determined to thoroughly suppress the talents of the Thousand Martial Hall.
He did not believe that he could not force out the talent of the Thousand Martial Hall this time.
After this fight, he intended to travel throughout the Ling Domain, understanding the world and the universe, and awaiting the final battle of the prodigies.
Even if this time he pressured the strongest in the Thousand Martial Hall to take action personally, he didn't care.
"Take your shot. After all, your lives are worth nothing in the Thousand Martial Hall."
Xu Yan said this with an indifferent smile.
"Xu Yan, your provocation won't work. Today we can fight for the honor of our sect. If we die, it will be glorious."
A sectarian talent said coldly.
"No!"
Xu Yan shook his head, and said, "Your glory in death is not due to fighting for the Thousand Martial Hall, but because you died at my hands. You are stepping stones for me to reach the pinnacle of martial arts in the Ling Domain. Indeed, your deaths are glorious."
Damn!
The group turned green with rage.
"Here we go again. Xu Yan is as arrogant as ever!"
Cui Huayu sighed with admiration.
All the martial artists present were speechless, witnessing Xu Yan's arrogance firsthand.
Xu Yan smiled indifferently, saying: "My name, Sword God Xu Yan, will eventually echo throughout all ends of the earth. You, as steppingstones in my rise, will naturally be mentioned.
"Becoming the stepping stones of the peerless strong will make your name etched in the annals of martial arts. Even after countless ages, there will still be people talking about the stepping stones of the 'sword god'.
"In the annals of martial arts, it will be recorded that you died gloriously at the hands of Sword God Xu Yan!"
Silence!
All the martial artists were dumbfounded. What kind of outrageous theory was this?
"Too overbearing. Hasn't Xu Yan ever thought that he might not live to leave the Thousand Martial Hall?"
"If there's a craziest person in this world, and if Xu Yan ranks second, there will be no person willing to rank first!"
"My goodness! I am smitten, I wish I could be born hundreds of years later!"
After being dumbfounded, the martial artists started whispering among themselves.
Tian Ji was completely stupefied. Could Xu Yan be such an arrogant man?
"I thought our Alliance Hierarch was quite arrogant, but now I realize compared to Xu Yan, our Hierarch is humble!"
Yarong frowned, uncertain how to assess Xu Yan.
The five men surrounding Xu Yan were practically exploding with rage.
Is it an honor to become stepping stones?
"Xu Yan, you deserve to die!"
"Today, we will kill you!"
The five men were on the verge of breakdown.
What an arrogant man. He regards them as stepping stones the moment he opens his mouth?
"Attack!"
Boom!
The five men moved!
The violent attack came from all directions towards Xu Yan, blocking all his escape routes.
The sword light was overwhelming, hills and rivers appeared, sweeping across with Xu Yan at the center, all attacks shattered within the scenery.
This scene made all who were watching awe-inspired.
"Die!"
By now, even the five men who attacked knew, without using their life burning killer moves, it was impossible to inflict any damage on Xu Yan.
His strength was beyond imagination!
And Xu Yan, how old was he? Much younger than all of them!
What kind of monster was he?
At this moment, they even started to doubt whether the real talents of the Thousand Martial Hall could compete with Xu Yan.
Boom!
Bloodthirsty killing intent emerged in an instant, the killing intent of the five men moved towards Xu Yan.
Blocking all his evasion paths.
The five, who had used their life burning killer moves, stared with wide eyes, wanting to see how Xu Yan would be killed.
However!
At this moment, it seemed as if they saw a mountain and a river appearing, they were in the mountain and river, Xu Yan was outside.
No!
Xu Yan was the master of the mountain and the river!
The life burning killing intent at this moment, was actually being constantly extinguished, and the sword light was constantly washing over the killing intent within the lively mountain and river.
Roar!
The battlefield shook, and a wave of aftermath swept across.
The five men's bodies shattered, turning into dust.
Xu Yan stood proudly as ever, calm and relaxed. The sword in his hand shone brilliantly. A gentle breeze followed on the battlefield.
The five terrifying killing intents disappeared.
"What Sword Dao is this? Illusion? Is it a magic technique?"
In the silence, someone mumbled to themselves.
What kind of technique was that sword river and mountain?
In an instant, what everyone originally thought was that five prodigies had surrounded Xu Yan, but it turned out they were in the mountain and river of the sword?
And Xu Yan was the master of the mountain and river!
The sword intent was formless, blending into the surroundings.
Xu Yan stood proudly, from the beginning, the battlefield was within his sword intent.
The Thousand Martial Lord and all the elders were wearing extremely gloomy expressions, Xu Yan had repeatedly exceeded their expectations.
They originally thought that with five men attacking together, even if they were not as strong as Xu Yan, he should still sustain some injuries, or even appear a bit disheveled. However, Xu Yan remained as calm and collected as ever.
It was as if killing the five prodigies was as easy as swatting a fly.
Still, they had yet to see Xu Yan's bottom line. They were still unsure if he had used all his strength.
"My lord, let our prodigies from the Thousand Martial Hall take action."
The Elder with control over the knives said gravely.
The Thousand Martial Lord nodded.
Immediately he said, "Get Wu Yuan ready. He now commands the Absolute Ice Blade and is to use all his strength in his first move. I don't believe that Xu Yan won't get injured!"
The Elder with control over the knives nodded in agreement.
Wu Yuan was one of the acknowledged talents of the Thousand Martial Hall and could now activate the Divine Artifact the Absolute Ice Blade. He was the strongest of the talents that the Thousand Martial Hall had prepared to face Xu Yan.
As for those five core prodigies, it was not yet time for them to reveal themselves, and they would not easily make a move.

chapters.title: Chapter 575 - 311: The Divine Element Incarnation Shocks All Around_2
chapters.content:
Before anyone from the Thousand Martial Hall could step forward to challenge him, Xu Yan still stood proudly in midair, coldly looking at the Thousand Martial Hall. "Where are the prodigies of the Thousand Martial Hall?" he sneered. "Are they all seedless cowards, too afraid to fight?"
"If you're afraid of death, we can fight for victory, not for life or death. I, Xu Yan, am not keen on killing!"
After pausing for a moment, he continued, "If you believe you cannot defeat me alone, then send another five. After all, I, Xu Yan, am a prodigy among this world. To give you a chance, it's my obligation!"
All the martial artists turned their gazes to the Thousand Martial Hall.
The mighty Transcendent Spirit Sect was being challenged at its own doorstep. The sect's prodigies did not step up to accept the challenge, having their affiliated forces' prodigies fight instead, and provided various tests.
However, all of these allied prodigies were defeated.
Could it be that at this moment, the prodigies of the Thousand Martial Hall also wouldn't show up?
Or is it actually as Xu Yan said, are they all seedless cowards?
"Xu Yan, if you are antsy to seek your death, then we'll grant your wish!" deplored the Elder with the Dao, snickering coldly.
Five more, right?
This time, the five were the Thousand Martial Hall's prodigies. They were nothing like the prodigies of the Three Kingdoms and Eight Major Clans.
Five figures stepped out from the gate of the Thousand Martial Hall. Each practiced different martial arts, Saber, Fist, Spear, Halberd, Ax; deliberately avoiding the Sword Dao.
Clearly, the Thousand Martial Hall admitted defeat to Xu Yan in the way of Sword Dao, fearing Xu Yan's arcane swordsmanship.
"So strong!"
As soon as the five people showed up, all the martial artists could not help but be tremendously shocked.
Is this the strength of the prodigies of the Thousand Martial Hall?
Although five against one tarnished the dignity of the Transcendent Spirit Sect, it was undeniable that the prodigies of the Thousand Martial Hall were much stronger than those of the Three Kingdoms and Eight Major Clans.
The condensed air around them, the grand energy, and the combined strength formed from the merging energy far surpassed the previous five challengers.
Each one was at the peak of Refining God Heavenly Man.
Moreover, the combined force of the five different martial arts made them even more formidable and hard to deal with.
"Xu Yan, you're indeed strong. Any of us alone wouldn't be your match, but you up against five will be you walking the road to your death!" said the youth with the saber, glancing coldly.
The five didn't scatter, but instead gathered, their energy merging, as if they possessed a joint attack technique.
Xu Yan frowned at the five, feeling somewhat disappointed. Looks like The Thousand Martial Hall were still holding back their actual prodigies. He wasn't sure why they weren't sending their real prodigies to fight.
There had always been a rumor that all the prodigies of the Transcendent Spirit Sect have spiritual bodies.
Yet, among these five, not one has the talent of a spiritual body.
This meant that they were not the core prodigies of Thousand Martial Hall.
Although the strength of those with a spiritual body varied, even a prodigy without a spiritual body couldn't be considered top-notch among prodigies.
"Looks like, I need to put some pressure on the Thousand Martial Hall."
Xu Yan narrowed his eyes slightly.
"True prodigies are invincible within the same realm, and it's common for one to beat ten thousand of the same realm, let alone you five."
Xu Yan uttered a faint smile.
He remembered his master saying that it was normal for one to defeat ten thousand within the same realm. Although he might not be able to accomplish that, his goal was to work towards defeating a thousand within the same realm!
Although the martial artists were almost getting used to Xu Yan's arrogance, they couldn't help but roll their eyes at this moment.
It could be understood that one was invincible within the same realm, but defeating ten thousand of the same realm, was absolutely impossible!
Even if the prodigy was very powerful, it was absolutely impossible for him to fight against ten thousand of the same realm with his power alone.
Not to mention ten thousand, it's not possible even for a hundred.
It was a fight within the same realm, not a fight where one suppresses others with a higher realm!
Furthermore, within the same realm, there were also prodigies. Even if they were a little weaker, they were still prodigies. They could win against one or a few people, but it was absolutely impossible to win against ten or a hundred, let alone defeat ten thousand.
"Such an arrogant fella!" the saber-wielding youth scoffed.
"I, Xu Yan, am never arrogant. If you think I'm arrogant, it's because you're like a frog at the bottom of a well. You don't understand the mystique of martial arts. Today, I'll show you what true martial arts are!"
Xu Yan gave a proud smirk.
After breaking into the Divine Origin Realm, he can manifest his divine body. Today, he would show these people the mysteries of martial arts. To further pressure the Thousand Martial Hall.
The crowd was already numb.
"Xu Yan is indeed a prodigy. One boastful statement after another. Now I understand, true arrogance is expressed in a calm tone, speaking the most outrageous lines. For example, letting us see what real martial arts are, isn't this indirectly saying that the martial arts we practice are fake?"
"Haha, you're right!"
"If I had his talent and power, I would be crazier than Xu Yan!"
"Come off it, if you had his talent and power, you scoundrel would be the first to be the Spirit Sect's lapdog!"
"You're courting death!"
The martial artists huddled in whispers, abuzz with speculation, even small disturbances began to appear.
"Xu Yan, we who stand as chosen elites of the Thousand Martial Hall are not unfair. You have the opportunity to make the first move!"
The young man holding the knife said coldly.
Their auras merged, as their energies connected, synchronizing five forms of martial arts, forming a joint attack of five forces for both offense and defense.
They believed that individually, they were no match for Xu Yan, but together, using combined attacks, the situation would be different!
Watching the momentum of the five men, Xu Yan couldn't help reflecting upon it.
"A combined attack? The Spiritual Realm Martial Arts don't have formations and do not recognize the concept of formations.
"What if I split myself into four forms using Divine Origin, forming a sword array? What kind of power will it be? It's worth trying."
Xu Yan had an idea.
The five elite members of the Thousand Martial Hall were employing combined attacks against him.
Then he, using the Divine Origin to form an array with four of his forms, would enlighten these people about the mysteries of martial arts, and show them that the power of the sword array was far beyond their combined attacks.
"Combined attacks, are nothing more than child's play. Today is indeed the day for you, the lofty Transcendent Spirit Sect of the Thousand Martial Hall, to get a taste of a true Formation Dao, to witness the power of the sword array.
"Watch carefully, don't blink!"
With a hearty laugh, Xu Yan's body shone dazzlingly, and in an instant, four other figures appeared and scattered in different directions.
Initially, there was only one Xu Yan on the battlefield!
But now, there were five Xu Yans!
Silence!
The entire field fell into silence!
What kind of technique was this?
Was there such a marvelous technique in martial arts?
All the martial artists were terrified, their faces filled with shock and disbelief.
"How is this possible!"
On the hillside door of the Thousand Martial Hall, the Thousand Martial Lord and the elders were horrified!
They were the top existence in the Spiritual Realm Martial Arts, and the elders of the Transcendent Spirit Sect, with a long inherited knowledge of many martial arts secrets.
However, this sight left them speechless.
How did the four Xu Yans appear?
How could one person split into four?
There is no such miraculous technique in martial arts!
At this moment, the powerhouses of Thousand Martial Hall had light apprehension in their eyes, and to their surprise, there was even a hint of fear!
"Xu Yan must die!"
The Thousand Martial Lord said sternly, his tone filled with murderous intent!
"What kind of skill is this?"
All the martial artists were shocked, their eyes wide open, without even blinking!
"Xu Yan is in danger!"
Tian Ji's face darkened, gripping his divine artifact, the Wan Mountain Halberd even tighter.
A Xu Yan who could display such a magical technique, the Thousand Martial Hall would not stand by. They would do everything they could to kill Xu Yan.
"This is really dreadful, too dreadful. If Xu Yan doesn't die, the Ling Domain will ultimately honor him. Definitely can't afford to offend him.
"The Blood Demon could rise again after three falls, and Xu Yan, who is more terrifying and demonic than the Blood Demon, will definitely be harder to deal with.
"No, I must tell the old man from the Yu Ling Mansion. Try not to provoke Xu Yan, otherwise, it might go awry!"
Cui Huayu mumbled while wiping the sweat beads from his forehead.
In his mind, the image of Xu Yan challenging Lu Xinting, sitting on the big cat, sipping tea, reappeared.
With a wave of his hand, the power of heaven and earth descended. It was extremely spectacular.
Now that Xu Yan had revealed this kind of marvelous martial arts technique, how terrifying could that mysterious figure, who was his master, be?
Xu Yan, daring to come to the Thousand Martial Hall to challenge them, apart from his personal strength and eccentricity, his biggest confidence probably comes from his mysterious master!
"How... how did one person turn into four?"
Yarong was also shocked beyond words.
The Taimiao Sect had a very long heritage and knew much more about the secrets and rumors of martial arts than even the Thousand Martial Hall, but they had never heard of such a miraculous technique in the world.
"Who is Xu Yan's master? Is he a peerless expert? Could he really be an esteemed hermit?"
At this moment, Yarong was starting to believe that Xu Yan's Master was truly an unparalleled expert.

chapters.title: Chapter 576 - 312: Perfection of the Heart Sword Realm, The Might of the Divine Artifact_1
chapters.content:
The spectators were all horrified, and the participants were even more shocked beyond speech!
The five prodigies of the Thousand Martial Hall were at this moment staring with their eyes wide open, their faces filled with disbelief, at the sudden appearance of four more Xu Yans.
Four people, positioned in four directions, seemingly forming some kind of pattern, and seemingly in tune with some profound mystery.
Initialy, they had the advantage of being five against one, but in the blink of an eye, it became one to one?
Moreover, it was five people fighting against five Xu Yans!
"You, you, you…"
The knife-wielding young man was too shocked to speak.
"It's just a trick, why make such a fuss?"
The five Xu Yans all spoke at the same time.
This is just a trick?!
When Xu Yan started speaking, he couldn't help but pause for a moment. It was the first time he used the Divine Avatar technique, and he was still a little rusty, so when he spoke, all the avatars spoke at the same time.
With a thought, he said, "There's no need to be so surprised. This is the mystery of martial arts. It seems like there are five me, but there is actually only one me, the other five are just avatar of power."
Xu Yan spoke indifferently.
It was high time these frogs in a well got their eyes opened!
This time when he spoke, only his main body spoke, the other four avatars remained silent.
"Today, I, Xu Yan, am here to let the Thousand Martial Hall, this self-assumed Transcendent Spirit Sect, witness the mysteries of martial arts, so as to save them from being narrow-minded and thinking of their prodigies as highly noble. In my eyes, they are nothing."
An avatar of Xu Yan spoke casually.
"Attack. Today, you will witness what is a Sword Array."
Another avatar of Xu Yan added.
Everyone was dumbfounded.
The five knife-wielding young men took a few deep breaths, calming their shocked hearts, gritted their teeth and roared: "Kill!"
This battle was inevitable!
Even if Xu Yan revealed such incredible technique, there was no reason for them to retreat!
"This is nothing but an attempt to deceive us, it could only fool others. Your pitiful illusion, can't deceive us!"
The spear-wielding teenager shouted angrily, stabbing out with his spear.
"Exactly, trying to deceive people with illusionary techniques, it's laughable!"
The young man with the fist gauntlet also joined in.
Even though, they knew this was not an illusion, they could only hypnotize themselves in this way to boost their spirits and dispel the tiny bit of fear deep in their hearts.
"So it's an illusion, but this illusion is indeed very powerful."
"It scared me, I thought there was such a marvelous technique."
The martial artists present all breathed a sigh of relief when they heard this.
Perhaps it was because they were too far away to realize it was an illusion.
Even though many people had a hunch that this was not an illusion, none of them said it out, but only sat there in silence with furrowed brows.
The Thousand Martial Hall Lord and the others frowned. Was this an illusion?
Even if it was an illusion, to be able to deceive as such, it was extremely ingenious.
"It should be an illusion, right? I've never heard of such a marvelous technique."
An elder seemed to comfort himself as he spoke.
The others remained silent.
Bang!
"Illusion?"
Xu Yan chuckled softly, self-hypnotizing is enough?
"You all should take the initiative, or else you won't get the chance to do so!"
Xu Yan spoke indifferently.
"Kill!"
The five of them made their move.
Their energies combined, martial arts merged, five attacks blasted out. Their forms moving in unison, they coordinated perfectly. The second attack was closely followed by.
This combined attack technique indeed had its uniqueness.
Boom!
"Combined attack technique, nothing more!"
Xu Yan chuckled lightly, one avatar swung out with a sword, the sound of dragon chanting resonated.
Another avatar's sword light fell like a lightning bolt.
As their forms swapped positions, the sword light was fierce, sweeping across the battlefield.
"This is the Sword Array, watch closely!"
Five sword lights, with a pattern and rules that the martial artists could hardly comprehend, intersected and crisscrossed, in an instant, they only felt the sword light had become more fierce.
It blocked all retreat routes, sealed off all spaces, leaving only crisscrossing sword light, and every sword light had a different killing method.
It was as if five people were performing five types of Sword Dao.
With a swish, the sword lights intersected, the forms switched positions, tearing apart the combined attack technique of the Thousand Martial Hall prodigies and breaking their combined momentum instantly.
Thus, it turned into a situation where Xu Yan was encircling the five of them, not they surrounding Xu Yan.
"How is this possible!"
The spectator martial artists were all taken aback.
Looking at the scene now, it was not the five prodigies of the Thousand Martial Hall attacking Xu Yan, but each of the Thousand Martial Hall prodigies having to face the attacks of five Xu Yans.
Clearly both sides had five people, but every prodigy of the Thousand Martial Hall seemed to be under the siege of five Xu Yans, was this a Sword Array?
Such incredible and profound understanding.
"The combined attack technique of the Thousand Martial Hall seems fragile, no, all the combined attack techniques of the Spirit Sects seem fragile in front of the Sword Array.
"This is Xu Yan splitting into four himself with some profound technique, and performing the Sword Array."
"What if a Sword Array was formed by five different people?"
Cui Huayu was shaken to the core.
This Sword Array technique simply crushed the combined attack technique of the Spirit Sects.
Yarong also frowned, at this moment she was more curious than ever about the mysterious master of Xu Yan.
"Could it be that Xu Yan's master is the legendary 'Lord'? No, even the legendary 'Lord' doesn't seem to have such amazing techniques."
Yarong mused.
The battle was still going on, the profoundness of the Sword Array continued to unfold, and the five prodigies of the Thousand Martial Hall were already unable to form a combined attack.
Moreover, they were exhausted from dealing with it, and in constant danger.

chapters.title: Chapter 577 - 312: Perfection of the Heart Sword Realm, The Might of the Divine Artifact_2
chapters.content:
Clearly, Xu Yan did not exert all his power to instantly kill the five, instead, he used them to present to the world what a sword array is!
The Thousand Martial Lord and others wore terrifyingly gloomy expressions.
The joint attack technique was so pitifully weak under the sword array.
"Let Wu Yuan prepare to act."
Spoke the Thousand Martial Lord in a deep voice.
This fight had already lost its uncertainity.
The five were sure to lose.
In fact, he was wavering at this moment. Even if Wu Yuan, who had used the Divine Artifact Longsword, really had the ability to deal a heavy blow, could he kill Xu Yan?
After all, Wu Yuan was not the strongest being.
Taking a deep breath, the Thousand Martial Lord issued instructions again: "Let the old predecessors seize the opportunity to kill Xu Yan."
The elder holding the sword and others were taken aback. Did the lord actually believe that Wu Yuan could not severely wound or kill Xu Yan?
"Lord, if Wu Yuan uses the sacred artifact, can Xu Yan withstand it?"
The elder holding the blade had an incredulous look on his face.
"Has Xu Yan exerted all his effort yet?"
The Thousand Martial Lord asked solemnly.
The elder holding the sword was taken aback. Yeah right, when had Xu Yan exerted all his energy?
He had always demonstrated his skills with ease.
"I understand now!"
The elder holding the blade nodded solemnly.
On the battlefield, Xu Yan, through the use of his divinely transformed body, exhibited the Sword Array, and at this moment, he had another insight.
He was currently applying the elite of the Thousand Martial Hall and verifying his own perception.
In a twinkling of an eye, the Sword Array quietly underwent a transformation.
One of the incarnations exhibited in the Sword Dao was the Sword Intent of Mountain and River.
Another incarnation exhibited, was the Sudden Wind Sword Intent.
And the third incarnation exhibited the interchange of Mountain and River Sword Intent and Sudden Wind Sword Intent.
The fourth incarnation was attempting to unify the Mountain and River Sword Intent and Sudden Wind Sword Intent.
Xu Yan, in his original form, narrowed his eyes slightly, the spiritual energy of the world around him was transforming into swords, invisible swords!
The remnant waves of the fight swept over and turned into swords.
He even hoped to transform the incoming force into his own sword!
But it was too difficult.
He couldn't do it.
"Heart Sword Realm, my heart has a sword, everything in the heaven and earth can transform into a sword; my heart has Sword Intent, can a single thought materialize the Sword Intent?
"Whether it's the Mountain and River Sword Intent or the Sudden Wind Sword Intent, both are borne from my comprehension.
"Since they are the Sword Intents in my heart, why can't they transform into other Sword Intents? The wind blows over the mountains and rivers, waves ripple, water flows on..."
At a certain moment, the fourth incarnation stabbed a sword forward. Its Sword Intent was unceasing, killing intent was invisible, there was no sharpness to be perceived, instead, it carried the gentle touch of water.
However, in an instant, the youth holding the blade felt as though he had plunged into the water, into the raging sea, invisible and horrifying, seemingly gentle but containing a horrifying killing power.
"Ah!"
He roared, pouring all his strength into a strike, cutting through layers of gentle killing intent.
Xu Yan broke into a smile. Although he was far from being able to control Sword Intent at will, his Sword Dao realm had improved, which marked the completion of the Heart Sword Realm! There was only one step remaining to reach the Perfect Heart Sword Realm.
"The Wisdom Sword Realm is too profound, I still have no clues."
Xu Yan sighed, he had not completely comprehended the Heart Sword Realm, let alone realize its profound meaning, the Wisdom Sword Realm was even more beyond reach.
"Kill!"
The five from the Thousand Martial Hall knew that if the fight continued, they would undoubtedly lose.
They could only stake everything on one shot.
In an instant, a killing intent emerged.
Blood red killing intent surged out from the five, mutually merging into an even more terrifying killing intent.
This killing intent, as if containing the power of five martial arts, five killing intents, was a fivefold terrifying killing intent!
Xu Yan's eyebrows furrowed. This killing intent was much stronger than that of the previous five, and the unity of the five killing intents was even more powerful.
He didn't dare to take it lightly.
Whoosh!
The divine transformation returned to his original form, restoring his strength to its peak state.
He lifted his hand to hold the longsword. The Sword Intents of Mountain and River and Sudden Wind merged together. Stacks upon stacks of mountains and rivers, as if thousands of people were wielding swords, swung and slashed down.
Boom!
The blood-red killing intent collided with the sword light. The sword light seeped in all directions, while the blood-red killing intent kept surging as well, holding each other off.
The powerful aftermath has already obliterated the five prodigies of the Thousand Martial Hall, turning them into floating ashes.
All the martial artists widened their eyes, staring at the scene on the battlefield, where swords light shone like surging waves, continually spreading and seeming as though it could not resist the blood-red intent to kill.
However, the blood-red murderous intent also gradually began to dim.
Hum!
The sword light suddenly became delicate, like a gentle stream, frail and weak. Yet, this seemingly weak stream was stopping the bloody intent to kill from advancing.
And it was constantly melting, finally dissipating completely.
Xu Yan had won again. What would the Thousand Martial Hall do next?
Would the prodigy still not dare to come forward?
All the martial artists turned their eyes toward the entrance of the Thousand Martial Hall, including the powerful individuals from the three countries - the seven sects and eight noble houses.
Could the esteemed Transcendent Spirit Sect really not bring out a prodigy to compete with Xu Yan?
This was not only the concern of the Thousand Martial Hall alone, but it also had implications for the honor of the Ling Domain and the Spirit Sect. If they were suppressed by a loose cultivator, how could the Spirit Sect maintain its lofty position and look down upon all the other cultivators?
Xu Yan stood with his sword, the light from it extending for a hundred feet, defiantly pointing toward the entrance of the Thousand Martial Hall.
"Does the Thousand Martial Hall have a prodigy who dares to fight?"
The light from the hundred feet long sword pointed directly at the entrance of the Thousand Martial Hall, straightforwardly challenging them. Could it be that the prodigy of the Thousand Martial Hall still didn't dare to come out?
If that was really the case, as Xu Yan said, they were all spineless.
"Xu Yan, you are just a loose cultivator who dares to be arrogant. If it weren't for the fact that my brothers are in closed-door cultivation and unable to fight, you would have been suppressed long ago!"
A voice came. On the entrance of the Thousand Martial Hall, a figure started to approach.
A horrifying blade light shot up from his body.
All the martial artists looked, and were suddenly struck with terror.
The prodigy of the Thousand Martial Hall had made his move, and he was even using a Divine Artifact?
And from his words, they learned that the prodigy of the Thousand Martial Hall hadn't appeared because he was in closed-door cultivation and temporarily unable to fight?
"Is this... could this be Wu Yuan from the Thousand Martial Hall?"
Someone whispered.
"Shameless!"
Tian Ji scornfully remarked.
The Thousand Martial Hall actually had Wu Yuan use the Divine Artifact right away. Although this wasn't bullying the weak, it seemed somewhat shameless.
However, there were no limitations on what weapons the prodigies could use in the prodigy contention, so the actions of the Thousand Martial Hall did not violate any rules.
"Is Wu Yuan looking for death?"
Cui Huayu was shocked.
As a true disciple of the Transcendent Spirit Sect, he obviously understood what kind of price Wu Yuan had to pay to use a Divine Artifact and evoke its might.
Yarong frowned, looking at Xu Yan. The boy still showed no signs of panic, but his expression clearly became a lot heavier.
Xu Yan's expression became serious. He recognized who was appearing right now. It was Wu Yuan, the prodigy of the Thousand Martial Hall mentioned in the booklet that the Mu family had given him.
Wu Yuan had shown up and he was using the Divine Artifact of the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
The blade light soared into the sky, the might of the Divine Artifact was not to be underestimated!
"Xu Yan, take my slash. If you survive, I will temporarily consider it your victory. After ten years, when my brothers come out of their closed-door cultivation, we will have another match!"
Wu Yuan said coldly.
He needed to find a reason for a possible defeat, to save face for the Thousand Martial Hall.
He wanted to tell everyone present that it was not that the Thousand Martial Hall didn't have any prodigies. It was not that they didn't have anyone who could suppress Xu Yan, they were just in closed-door cultivation and couldn't come out to fight.
The final victory of this prodigy competition could only be determined at the end!
"Kill!"
A horrifying intent to kill emerged from Wu Yuan's body, but it wasn't the color of blood. It seemed that it wasn't a life-consuming intent to kill. The cold intent to kill poured into a saber.
The cold blade light, at this moment, shone in front of the Thousand Martial Hall.
Even from a distance, all the martial artists felt a chill run down their spine, as if a cold blade was hanging over their neck.
"Get back!"
The martial artists closer to the action changed their expressions and immediately retreated some distance.
"The Cold Extinction Blade!"
Cui Huayu's expression became serious.
One of the Divine Artifacts of the Thousand Martial Hall, possessing formidable destructive power, was generally in the hands of the elder who wielded the blade.
And Wu Yuan, using this Divine Artifact, must have acquired the elder's support. With this slash, even the strongest individuals who had condensed a Heavenly Earth Lingji would find it difficult to block.
"Does Xu Yan have a Divine Artifact?"
Cui Huayu looked at Xu Yan, now somewhat unconfident. Even if Xu Yan had a Divine Artifact, with his current realm, he wouldn't be able to unleash the power of a Divine Artifact. How could he block Wu Yuan's slash?
"I hope it only seriously injures him. As long as he doesn't die, he will have a chance to recover."
Cui Huayu murmured to himself.
Although he was a true disciple of the Transcendent Spirit Sect, and not on the same side as Xu Yan, he felt a sense of admiration for Xu Yan deep inside. He didn't want such a prodigy to die under this slash.

chapters.title: Chapter 578 - 313: Snatching the Divine Artifact Right from Their Faces, Who Gave Him the Courage?_1
chapters.content:
Xu Yan's face was solemn, the icy blade's aura brought intense pressure upon him.
Wu Yuan's strength was not weak and he used a secret technique, similar to burning life as killing intent, to stimulate the Divine Artifact of the Thousand Martial Hall. The power of this strike was no less than Huang Liang's blow in the past.
Moreover, with Wu Yuan's current state, to be able to stimulate the power of the Divine Artifact to this extent, he must have received the blessing of the strongest.
Boom!
At this moment, Xu Yan's divine essence circulated, and the clear sword stored within him trembled slightly, but he did not draw it out.
The sword in his hand was refined by Fang Hao, it was a top-level Spiritual Artifact.
Of course, the artifacts refined by Fang Hao's artifact refining technique were beyond comparison to any Spiritual Artifact in the Ling Domain.
However, the power of the Divine Artifact of the Thousand Martial Hall was fully stimulated by Wu Yuan using his entire cultivation base, also accompanied by the blessing of the strongest.
The sword in his hand would remain undamaged even against the power of the Divine Artifact but blocking this strike with only the sword was impossible.
Xu Yan's countenance was grave, but he did not retreat at all.
Just because he couldn't block it with a single sword didn't mean he had no way to block it at all!
Boom!
At this moment, the great swords plugged around the ring rose into the air and lined up in front of Xu Yan. Behind Xu Yan, countless points of sword light also emerged.
Zing!
At this moment, the martial artists watching the battle suddenly found that they couldn't control their swords.
"My sword!"
Cries of shock emanated from the crowd.
Seeing the cold light flying and swords bursting out, arranging themselves around Xu Yan.
At this moment, Wu Yuan's momentum also reached its peak.
His entire body began to wither, his Divine Soul, essence and blood, and his entire cultivation base poured into his cold, killing intent sword at this moment.
"Xu Yan, die!" he cried.
His withered body seemed to ride the sword and yet also seemed to be driven by the sword.
An icy blade light burst forth from the gates of the Thousand Martial Hall, traversing the sky, and the icy killing intent was so chilling that even those far away felt as though they were falling into an ice cave.
From the gate of the Thousand Martial Hall to the position where Xu Yan stood, the spiritual energy of the heavens and earth seemed to be frozen by the icy blade light, and a cold blade light path appeared in mid-air.
Boom!
At the end of the attack, the Divine Artifact's cold sword even had the Great Power of Heaven and Earth poured into it, and the icy blade light turned azure blue.
In the eyes of the martial artists, it seemed as if they saw a few hundred feet tall azure sword, in a blink of an eye, slashing towards a shadow figure in mid-air!
Whoosh!
Sword light surged in mid-air, like thousands of swords being unsheathed at once, bursting forth.
In front and all around Xu Yan, countless swords formed into a storm, surging towards the azure blade light.
Thump! Thump! Thump!
However, one sword after another shattered continuously. The azure blade light still came slashing, as if it was impossible to resist the power of this strike.
Tian Ji's heart clenched, quietly cursing the Thousand Martial Hall for its shamelessness.
It also reminded him that the All Ages Alliance needed to make more preparations for the decisive battle of the young heroes. If the Thousand Martial Hall had such means, the other Transcendent Spirit Sects would not be far behind.
The Spirit Sect was absolutely unwilling to lose this battle, and so they would undoubtedly use every method at their disposal!
Yarong was staring intently at Xu Yan, could he withstand this strike?
Had he kept his trump cards hidden as well?
Otherwise, where did he get the confidence to challenge the Thousand Martial Hall?
"Block it!" Cui Huayu uttered nervously in her heart.
The storm of swords constantly bombarded, continuously attacking the azure blade light. Even the large trees were pulled out and turned into long swords.
It seemed as if the spiritual energy of the heavens and earth had also turned into sword light, constantly washing over the azure blade light.
However, although the azure blade light slowed down and even dimmed slightly, it still headed towards Xu Yan. Even if he retreated, he couldn't avoid it.
This strike had already locked onto his aura. There was no retreating, no evasion!
Of course, that was what other people thought. For Xu Yan, if he wanted to avoid this strike, he could do it!
However, although Xu Yan was not reckless, he was not the kind of person who was timid and retreated at the slightest danger.
Despite the power of the Divine Artifact being so strong, it was not impossible to resist!
The previously violent storm of swords suddenly became weak, resembling a rolling stream. The azure blade light slashing through the stream of swords got somewhat trapped, and its power was continuously weakened.
Xu Yan made one strike after another, and the gentle breeze turned into a viscous liquid. The "Mountain and River Sword Intent" held thousands of strikes, constantly weakening the azure blade light.
"Did he block it without a single scratch?"
Cui Huayu was shocked.
"What kind of Sword Dao is this? It's a bit unusual to be able to weaken the power of the Cold Sword to such an extreme extent."
Cui Huayu pondered in amazement.
"Not good, this Cold Sword, there's another attack hidden in it!"
Suddenly, Cui Huayu's face changed.
In the battlefield, the situation shifted drastically.
The azure light that had originally been weakening and the freezing aura, both fading, suddenly exploded with blinding light.
It seemed like the real lethal strike had just been unleashed.
Boom!
The storm of swords collapsed, and what felt like a liquid stream was cut open. The gentle breeze was also slashed apart.
The blade light had slashed towards Xu Yan!
Although the power of this blade had been weakened, all of Xu Yan's Defensive Sword Dao had been smashed apart.
The martial artists stared with wide eyes, a single thought crossed their minds: Xu Yan, danger!
Xu Yan, the one who made history, was about to die under this blade!
Many sighed in their hearts, provoking the Transcendent Spirit Sect, no matter how talented, is ultimately doomed to die!

chapters.title: Chapter 579 - 313: Snatching the Divine Artifact Right from Their Faces, Who Gave Him the Courage?_2
chapters.content:
This ultimate assassination move was evidently the real killing technique, being the remnants of Wu Yuan's divine soul, seizing this opportunity to activate the Cold Desolation Blade's authentic killing technique.
This strike bore the reflection of a supreme being.
Clearly, it was the supreme being of the Thousand Martial Hall who had augmented the power of Wu Yuan's strike, leaving behind the most crucial attack!
Although the method was somewhat unscrupulous, the effect was undoubtedly astounding.
No one had ever expected that Wu Yuan's strike would hide such a killing technique inside.
Presumably, Xu Yan hadn't seen it coming either.
Now, as the myriad sword torrent was broken and the Sword Dao's defense blasted open, and he was caught in a moment of defensive vulnerability, it was clearly too late for him to resist this blade.
Moreover, how could an attempt to defend hastily withstand this blade?
Even if he miraculously survived, he would inevitably suffer severe damage, or even have his foundation destroyed!
Xu Yan hadn't expected Wu Yuan's very same blade to harbor such a lethal attack!
The crisis suddenly hit!
However, Xu Yan remained unafraid. He was no longer a green martial artist. Even if he hadn't experienced life-or-death crises, he still had ways to deal with a sudden dangerous situation.
The myriad sword torrent and all Sword Dao defenses had already been blasted open. The attack was imminent.
The divine energy circulated like a rushing river. Xu Yan abruptly slapped out a palm.
Striking towards that blade!
He isn't just unparalleled in the Sword Dao, but his Descending Dragon Palm is also unrivaled in the world!
Ah!
At the moment when everyone thought Xu Yan would either die or severely injured, with his foundation destroyed, the Lord of the Thousand Martial Hall among others, showed a cold smile. A dragon roar resounding through heaven and earth arose.
Under the astonishing gazes of everyone, Xu Yan slapped out a palm, and a golden giant dragon roared out!
The dragon's majesty surged, supreme and dominating!
"A True Dragon?!"
Someone screamed in shock. The golden dragon was roaring, thunderously rushing out. How alike was it to the golden dragon of legend?
Moreover, this tremendous pressure seemed to make all living beings tremble. How alike was it to the majesty of the true dragon rumored in legend?
The sixth level of the Descending Dragon Palm, the True Dragon form, was nearly a real dragon!
The golden giant dragon issued a roar that resounded through heaven and earth, thunderously confronting the Cold Desolation Blade. It opened its huge mouth, swallowed the powerful attack into its stomach, and then swooped upwards, heading straight for the clouds!
Boom!
There was an explosion in the cloud layer. The golden giant dragon shattered, but it had completely blocked that attack.
The Cold Desolation Blade remained in Wu Yuan's hand. His withered body had long since lost any vitality, but when the blade was shown, it still aimed to kill Xu Yan.
Of course, it posed no threat anymore.
The chilling aura of the Cold Desolation Blade had faded, but a faint azure glow still lingered on the blade.
Before the Thousand Martial Hall could react, Xu Yan slapped out another palm and another golden giant dragon rushed out, instantly swallowing the Cold Desolation Blade into its belly.
Wu Yuan's corpse turned into flying ashes in an instant.
"Since the Thousand Martial Hall no longer has a prodigy to fight, I will take my leave. We'll meet again at the final battle of the Prodigy Clash. I hope the shameless Thousand Martial Hall won't let me down!"
Xu Yan laughed cheerfully.
The blockade of the Thousand Martial Hall ended. From Wu Yuan's remarks when he made his move, Xu Yan knew that there would be no more prodigies from the Thousand Martial Hall to challenge him.
Regardless of whether Wu Yuan's words were true or false, the Thousand Martial Hall clearly wouldn't continue to consume time with him.
In that case, he would quit while he was ahead.
This divine artifact, the Cold Desolation Blade, he would just claim it as the spoils of this battle.
"This blade will be my trophy from the war. Farewell!"
After swallowing the Cold Desolation Blade, the golden giant dragon coiled around Xu Yan. With a wave of his hand, his figure vanished from the spot in the blink of an eye!
"Impudence!"
A furious roar came from the entrance of the Thousand Martial Hall.
The Elder of the Blade was furious. How dare Xu Yan brazenly snatch the divine artifact of the Thousand Martial Hall!
Who gave him the audacity?!
All martial artists were stupefied. Only after Xu Yan snatched the Cold Desolation Blade and left, did they come back to their senses, their faces instantly covered in cold sweat.
That was the divine artifact of the Thousand Martial Hall! He'd snatched away the divine artifact right in front of the Thousand Martial Hall, who gave Xu Yan the audacity? Are the young people of this generation all so fearless?
No!
It's just that this young man, Xu Yan, is brave!
Stealing the divine artifact of the Transcendent Spirit Sect, Xu Yan is the first! Moreover, he seized it in front of the Thousand Martial Hall! is he not afraid of being pursued and killed by the supreme beings of the Thousand Martial Hall?
"This... this is disastrous!"
Cui Huayu wiped the sweat from his forehead, his eyes wide in shock.
"Xu Yan!"
A murderous voice echoed from the gate of the Thousand Martial Hall, as a figure shot out, charging straight towards Xu Yan.
Its imposing aura was shocking to all directions.
It was the Elder of the Blade from the Thousand Martial Hall!
"You plan to use your strength to bully the weak?"
Tian Ji roared, thrusting his halberd forward. It seemed as though a myriad of mountains were crashing down, in the thunderous noise, blocking the Elder of the Blade who was about to pursue and kill Xu Yan!
Boom!
The Elder of the Blade roared in fury, a blade flew from the gate of the Thousand Martial Hall into his hand. One slash shattered the myriad of mountains, and the next slash was aimed at Tian Ji.
"Xu Yan stole the Divine Artifact of my Thousand Martial Hall! You, Tian Ji, want to intervene? Do you want to die with him?"
Even as Tian Ji was shaking inside, he retorted: "In a competition between martial prodigies, the winner has the right to the spoils of the fight. Although the Divine Artifact belongs to the Thousand Martial Hall, it was used by Wu Yuan. Wu Yuan lost, and naturally, his spoils belongs to Xu Yan!"
"Nonsense!"
Another roar of rage filled the air.
An even more formidable aura surged from the gate of the Thousand Martial Hall. It was the Lord of the Thousand Martial Hall!
Subsequently, one after another powerful auras began to rise.
Tian Ji turned pale, after launching his halberd, he turned around and fled!
"Xu Yan, you cheeky lad, you're really too daring! Even though I wanted to support you, I bloody don't have enough backbone, I can't bear anymore, you're on your own!"
Tian Ji fled in desperation, if he were too slow, he'd not only put himself in danger, but also risk losing the Divine Artifact in his hand!
After all, this time he stood up for Xu Yan to prevent the Thousand Martial Hall from bullying the weak. Since he was a protector of the All Ages Alliance, it was normal for him to defend loose cultivators.
As a result, Xu Yan brazenly snatched the Divine Artifact of the Thousand Martial Hall!
Tian Ji, didn't have the backbone, he just couldn't take it any longer!
Yarong's mouth hung open, staring blankly at the direction where Xu Yan was disappearing to, too shocked to snap out of it.
Just then, a voice echoed at the front of the gate of the Thousand Martial Hall.
"This blade is now my spoils, Xu Yan's spoils. If Thousand Martial Hall is not convinced, feel free to dispatch anyone to chase and kill me, they will just become stepping stones for me, Xu Yan, to ascend to the summit of the Spirit Realm!"
Everybody followed the sound. In the sky not far away, Xu Yan stood tall, openly despising the Thousand Martial Hall.
"You're seeking death!"
The Elder of the Blade rallied and charged, but before he could reach Xu Yan, he vanished and dissipated into the heavens and earth!
What kind of method was that?
Every martial artist fell silent.
"Xu Yan, let's see how far you can escape!"
The Elder of the Blade roared in anger, charging towards the direction Xu Yan escaped in. He was confident that with his strength, it would not take long to catch up with Xu Yan.
"You are seeking your own death!"
The Elder of the Blade sneered in his heart.
Xu Yan had given him a reason to attack, and it was a compelling one!
The Divine Artifact can't be stored in the storage bag. Xu Yan's tracks can't be hidden, and he would definitely be unable to escape from the pursuit of the Thousand Martial Hall!
As for the Thousand Martial Hall, those several old men had disappeared quietly, going to hunt down Xu Yan.
"A hefty reward for those who can provide Xu Yan's whereabouts!"
The Lord of the Thousand Martial Hall said coldly.
He didn't mention what the reward was, but a single word from the Transcendent Spirit Sect could amount to a fortune. There would certainly be countless powers and martial artists going crazy for it!
And this was only for providing information on Xu Yan's whereabouts.
If one could capture him... it was almost unimaginable how great the reward would be!
Of course, the martial artists present knew that trying to capture Xu Yan, to beat Xu Yan, unless you were extremely strong, would be no different from seeking death.
Xu Yan's strength was beyond what peak Refining God Heavenly Man were capable of opposing.
Even if ten or eight teamed up, they would only be killed!
"Are there any martial prodigies in the Spirit Realm who can match Xu Yan?"
This thought popped up in the minds of many martial artists.
A Xu Yan who could only be opposed by the extremely strong, who else among the martial prodigies could be his match?
"Unbelievable, unbelievable, I'm witnessing history, I'm witnessing history!"
Cui Huayu excitedly darted into the palace.
This trip was worthwhile, it was too thrilling, Xu Yan was too daring!
Since ancient times until now, the bravest loose cultivator was none other than Xu Yan!
The cloud penetrating roc soared into the sky, flying towards the direction Xu Yan escaped in.
Yarong furrowed her eyebrows and immediately followed. Xu Yan wouldn't be able to get far, once caught by the Elder of the Blade, he would undoubtedly die!
Unless, he had some kind of trump card that could counter the Elder of the Blade. But how was that possible?

chapters.title: Chapter 580 - 314: Grand Xuancheng, the Power of Physical Martial Arts Revealed_1
chapters.content:
"Is that the powerful figure from the All Ages Alliance? Such bravery!"
Xu Yan had stolen the divine artifact from the Thousand Martial Hall and ran away, while Tian Ji tried to stop the elder who was wielding a knife. Such audacity from the powerful figure of the All Ages Alliance surprised him.
He really stood up for the unaffiliated cultivator!
With this interference, Xu Yan had already made his escape. The elder attempting to pursue him was undoubtedly fantasizing.
The speed of the Heavenly Lightning Flash, especially after Xu Yan had breached the Divine Origin Realm, was so fast that not even the strongest could catch up!
Of course, the Elder with the blade and the Thousand Martial Hall were so confident in their pursuit of Xu Yan due to their fixed belief that a divine artifact could not be stored inside a storage bag.
Carrying the Cold Absolute Blade with him, how could Xu Yan hide and escape their pursuit?
That was impossible!
However, the lord of the Thousand Martial Hall and others never expected that while a divine artifact could not be placed within a storage bag, it could be stored inside a Storage Ring!
Xu Yan glanced at the Cold Absolute Blade in his hand. The blade was indeed extraordinary, especially the material used to forge it.
"What a fine blade. If second brother doesn't like it, we could melt it down for fourth brother. The crafting material of this blade is extraordinary!"
A Divine Artifact is undoubtedly the highest level treasure in the Ling Domain and lies at the core of the Transcendent Spirit Sect's foundation.
"This trip was totally worth it!"
Xu Yan was quite satisfied as he directly put the blade into his storage ring.
Having blocked the entrance to the Thousand Martial Hall, killed so many of their exemplary talents, and stolen one of their divine artifacts, Xu Yan finally released some of the pent-up frustration from being falsely accused by Huang Liang of stealing his sword techniques from the Thousand Martial Hall.
He then waved his hand, and the transformation from the Divine Origin Realm vanished.
Tian Ji had escaped, and perhaps the Thousand Martial Hall was not willing to start a large-scale war with the All Ages Alliance at this moment, so they did not chase after him.
"So where to next?"
Xu Yan contemplated for a moment. He was planning to travel around the Ling Domain, so after a brief consideration, he chose a direction and headed straight for it.
"Find a city to settle down in and gather some information about the Ling Domain. I wonder how second brother is doing."
Xu Yan didn't care at all about the pursuit from Thousand Martial Hall.
Stealing a Divine Artifact was meant to provoke the Thousand Martial Hall into pursuing him. Travelling in this manner would be far more exciting and full of challenges!
...
The news of Xu Yan blocking the Thousand Martial Hall and killing their talented warriors, before stealing their Divine Artifact - the Cold Absolute Blade, in front of all the stronghold members, swept across the entire Ling Domain like a storm.
Ever since the disaster of the Blood Demon, the Ling Domain had not experienced such a shocking event.
Moreover, it was the first time in history that someone had stolen a Divine Artifact from the Transcendent Spirit Sect!
Xu Yan, what a fierce man!
In a certain prominent family, a dignified man exclaimed, "I wish my son could be like Xu Yan!"
He then turned to look at his good-for-nothing son, his face flushed with anger, and a whip appeared in his hand which he used to lash out.
"If only you had one percent of Xu Yan's abilities, it would be enough for me to be proud!"
"Damn!"
Inside a large city, a group of martial artists gathered, all discussing the theft of the Divine Artifact from the Thousand Martial Hall and their disgrace of having their doors blocked.
An old man suddenly exclaimed, "There are countless talents in the world, but Xu Yan is an example to all!"
Upon hearing this, a young man instantly became fired up and said proudly: "You're right, I'll take Xu Yan as my example! He blocked the Transcendent Spirit Sect's gates, so I'll block those of a first-rate spirit clan!"
People watched as the young man strode off with his head held high, as though they were watching a fool heading off to his death.
You think you're capable of challenging a first-tier Spirit Sect?
Are you tired of living?
In Daxuan city, Meng Chong stood on the stage with his sword, and even now, no other junior dared to come forth and contest him.
All the strong cultivators from the spirit sects had grim expressions.
Especially the Three Extremes Tower, they wished they could skin Meng Chong alive.
One person, suppressing many top talents from the Spirit Sects.
The usually high and mighty Spirit Sect juniors who looked down on scatter cultivators no longer carried their usual haughty arrogance.
Meng Chong sighed inwardly, these Spirit Sect juniors were a bit too weak.
He had already perfected his Divine Intent State and was accumulating his foundation, preparing for a breakthrough to transform himself.
Seeing that no more juniors were coming to fight, he shifted his gaze towards the Master of the Three Extremes Tower and the others.
He began to have an idea.
"The Master of the Three Extremes Tower is certainly not weak, but he is not unbeatable. Including the couple of elders from the Three Extremes Tower, one-on-one they pose no threat to me at all.
"Even accumulating martial arts foundation won't go well, with my current Undying Golden Body, it's almost impossible for them to seriously injure me. Since that's the case, let's take a gamble.
"The physical Martial Dao requires constant tempering to improve itself. With the help of the Heavenly Hundred Refinement Skill, foundation accumulation will be quicker.
"I can't keep dragging this on. The Ling Domain is huge, it's meaningless to consume time in Daxuan City. I wonder how Big Brother is doing. I heard he blocked the Thousand Martial Hall a few days ago.
"Maybe after I've finished with Daxuan City, I should also go block the Thousand Martial Hall?"
Meng Chong was muttering to himself.
When that thought came to mind, he looked at the Master of the Three Extremes Tower, scratched his head and grinned, "You folks from the Three Extremes Tower must absolutely despise me now, and want to kill me, right?"
The audience of martial artists who were watching the challenge instantly rolled their eyes. Isn't that obvious?
You have killed all three of their chosen talents, annihilating them completely, how could they not hate you to death?
Not just the Three Extremes Tower, even the strong warriors of the other top-level Spirit Sects hate you to death!
The Master of the Three Extremes Tower and the group of elders all wore gloomy expressions, eyes filled with intent to kill. However, they glanced at the Alliance Hierarch and the command from the Sect, they could only suppress their desire to kill.

chapters.title: Chapter 581 - 314: Grand Xuancheng, the Power of Physical Martial Arts Revealed_2
chapters.content:
"Today, I, Meng Chong, am giving you all a chance. The leader of Three-Pinnacle Tower and elders, you can make your moves now. I'm challenging you old fools and has-beens!"
Meng Chong pointed with his blade, arrogantly declaring.
The leader of Three-Pinnacle Tower and the elders were taken aback, even doubting whether they had heard wrong. Was Meng Chong really challenging them?
All at once?
Where did he get the courage and audacity?
The spectating martial artists were stunned. Had Meng Chong become so arrogant because he considered himself invincible after defeating many other prodigies? Did he really think he could take down the leader of Three-Pinnacle Tower and the elders all by himself?
He was courting death!
"No!"
The Alliance Hierarch of Lizhou changed color and hurriedly tried to dissuade him.
Yet, the leader of Three-Pinnacle Tower wouldn't miss this chance. He descended straight onto the arena, sneering, "This is your own challenge. Killing you wouldn't be against the rules of the Prodigies Showdown!"
"What a fool!"
The Lizhou Alliance Hierarch and others sighed with disappointment.
Young and impulsive, lacking in awareness!
Meng Chong glanced at the leader of Three-Pinnacle Tower and at the elders outside the arena, sneering, "You alone are far from enough, all elders, just join in.
"Watch how I, Meng Chong, sweep through the strong ones of Three-Pinnacle Tower!"
The leader of Three-Pinnacle Tower was stunned. Was this bald young man out of his mind?
Taking a deep breath, he nodded, and the elders of Three-Pinnacle Tower descended onto the arena, surrounding Meng Chong.
Picking on the weak and ganging up was shameful, but they didn't care as it was Meng Chong who initiated the challenge. If he sought death, they were just granting his wish.
"He's way too arrogant!"
"Meng Chong is going to meet his doom in Daxuan City."
"This isn't youthful impulsivity, this is youthful arrogance, he's disregarding everyone."
The spectators sighed.
"Come on!"
Meng Chong led with a punch, making the first move.
"Kill!"
The leader of Three-Pinnacle Tower and the others burst with vigor and launched their attacks. Their overwhelming power shook the surroundings as they rose from the platform and began battling in mid-air.
After a while, with a loud thud, a figure was thrown down, creating a human-shaped crater on the arena!
"Meng Chong is in danger!"
Everyone exclaimed.
The Lizhou Alliance Hierarch was also helpless. Even if he wanted to intervene, he had no reason to. Moreover, the top warriors of the Spirit Sect were on guard at this moment, not giving him a chance to assist.
Meng Chong dusted himself off and laughed loudly, "You weaklings, didn't you have your meals? Put in all your strength."
He jumped up and attacked again.
"You're insolent!"
The leader of Three-Pinnacle Tower and the others were astounded. After such a powerful blow that sent Meng Chong flying, he didn't have a single injury?
What an invincible body he had.
Boom!
The intense battle continued, Meng Chong kept getting bombarded. Yet he was unafraid, continuously throwing punches and slashing, even only focusing his attacks on one elder, wanting to kill him outright.
He was even taking the leader of Three-Pinnacle Tower and the others' attacks head-on with his body.
Boom!
A defensive technique, the Undying Armor, emerged, shining golden. Meng Chong looked like a god of war clad in golden armor.
"What kind of defense is this!"
Boom!
"Almost there, just a bit more!"
Despite taking a series of powerful attacks, having his Undying Armor constantly blasted away and then recovering, and his body resounding with loud thuds while sporadically feeling pain,
he was, nonetheless, excited beyond words.
The Hundred Training Heavenly Hammer technique was activated, and his foundation of martial arts was constantly built in the midst of the assaults.
Immediately after, a small bottle appeared in his hand. He gulped down healing medicines, accelerating the accumulation of his martial arts foundation.
"He's injured!"
The leader of Three-Pinnacle Tower and the others grew confident seeing Meng Chong's injury and his consumption of healing medicines.
His body was not invulnerable.
Boom!
However, Meng Chong focussed his attack on one elder, who was coughing blood and heavily injured. If the elder was attacked any further, he would surely die.
The leader of Three-Pinnacle Tower became stressed, continuously attacking and assisting.
However, it seemed Meng Chong was set on killing that elder, as if he had a deep-set grudge against him!
"I will fight you till the end!"
The elder roared in anger, his energy bursting forth as he executed a secret technique.
With a thunderous explosion, a berserk punch landed on Meng Chong.
Thump!
Meng Chong was thrown down, creating a big pit on the arena platform, and that elder, he was immediately killed by Meng Chong's punch!
"Die!"
The remaining members of Three-Pinnacle Tower had eyes filled with blood, and they rained down ferocious attacks.
Boom!
The spectators immediately retreated, fearing they would be affected by the fight.
"Meng Chong is dead, right?"
Everyone watched the spot where Meng Chong was engulfed by the brutal attacks of the opponents from Three-Pinnacle Tower.
Boom!
Suddenly, golden light burst forth. To their shock, a golden giant stood up.
Both of his fists struck out, clashing against the falling attacks.
"How...how is this possible?"
"What kind of martial arts is this?"
Looking at the golden giant who suddenly appeared, everyone was horrified.
In front of the six zhang tall giant, all of them felt like a tiny grasshopper!
Has there ever been such a martial art in the Ling Domain?
Could this be Meng Chong's true form?
Was he a giant?
Has there ever been a giant in the Ling Domain?
No!
Meng Chong displayed the Six-Zhang Golden Body technique. Like a small giant, he launched an attack on the remaining members of Three-Pinnacle Tower.
"Enjoyable, let's continue!"
The remaining members of Three-Pinnacle Tower were petrified.
However, at this point, there was no backtracking.
"Kill!"

chapters.title: Chapter 582 - 314: Grand Xuancheng, the Power of Physical Martial Arts Revealed_3
chapters.content:
With a furious roar, they rushed forward, surrounding Meng Chong in attack.
"Encircle him!"
The owner of the Sanxue building commanded in a deep voice.
The giant seems formidable, yet he's undoubtedly not agile enough.
"Encirclement?"
Meng Chong grinned, his great fist swept across, moving sharply and rapidly. His movement technique was agile with such speed, there wasn't a hint of clumsiness to him.
Each punch he released was extremely violent; amidst the tumultuous winds and thunder, he relentlessly attacked one of the elders, completely ignoring other attacks and trusting his physical resistance to endure.
Meng Chong, who was exhibiting the six-meter tall Golden Body, had his defenses further enhanced. The elder being targeted by him could not evade the ferocious punches coming his way. His face was filled with despair.
Sanxue Tower's Master and the remaining elders fiercely attacked Meng Chong. Despite making his body tremble and his Undying Armor crack, they were unable to deal significant damage to him.
"I'll risk it all with you!"
The elder exercised his secret technique once again.
Boom!
Meng Chong's enormous body backtracked a few steps but quickly regained balance. He grinned, facing another elder, and said, "It's your turn."
The expressions of Sanxue Tower's Master and the others immediately turned into dread.
Eyewitnesses also felt chills down their spines. Meng Chong was incredibly violent. He was intentionally solely targeting one individual at a time.
They had initially thought Meng Chon was digging his own grave. However, it seemed that those digging their graves were Sanxue Tower's Master and the others!
The top cultivators of Spirit Sect stared at Meng Chong's gigantic body, their faces hardening.
How could a Loose Cultivator possess such a formidable and extraordinary martial arts technique?
What was this martial arts cultivation technique?
This is terrifying!
Sanxue Tower's Master felt an urge to retreat. But Meng Chong grinned and said, "Since the fight has started, we must fight to the end. Retreating isn't an option."
"Fight him!"
Sanxue Tower's Master roared in anger.
He was also determined to fight till the end.
The remaining elders shared the same merciless intent. Their eyes were cold, and their energy surged. Instantaneously, they all launched their attacks together, aiming for Meng Chong's head.
Boom!
Bathed in blood-colored light, the people from Sanxue Tower activated their ultimate secret techniques by exhausting their own life essence.
Meng Chong's face went grave. At that moment, he felt a strong sense of danger.
If he endured this attack head-on, it could break through his physical defenses and cause significant injuries.
A vial of elixir was emptied into his mouth, and his golden body shone brightly, reaching its limit.
He threw powerful punches successively. Amid the echoing thunderous noises, blade lights emerged from his fists.
Boom!
Sanxue Tower's Master and others launched their attacks with desperate intent, aiming for Meng Chong. They broke through the gusts of wind and thunder, shattered the oncoming blade light, and directed their attack towards Meng Chong's head.
Meng Chong moved back at an incredible speed.
"It's about time!"
At a certain moment, Meng Chong roared, using his hand as a blade, he unleashed a blade light. Amid a loud boom, the attack was split in half.
Immediately, he delivered another blade strike, transforming the attack into countless pieces.
Despite this, the energy from the attack didn't fade; it remained appallingly aggressive. The attack had transformed from a single concentrated beam into dozens, each equally threatening.
"That should do it!"
Meng Chong's eyes focused. He had weakened the attack to a point that he could withstand it.
Mobilizing all the strength from his Heavenly Hammer Cultivation Technique, he stepped forward to meet the attack.
Boom!
The Undying Armor shattered, even leaving shallow injuries on his physical body. However, under the refining process of the Heavenly Hammer Cultivation Technique, the energy from the attack was converted into refining power.
It was converted into martial arts essence. Meng Chong felt that the essence he had accumulated was just slightly away from reaching completion.
At that slight difference, the refining of a few elixirs, or spiritual medicine, or a bit of time for cultivation would suffice to reach its peak.
When that time arrives, he would break through to the second level of the Undying Golden Body.
The battle of Daxuan City was about to reach its conclusion!

chapters.title: Chapter 583 - 315: Shocking the Ling Domain, Pursuit of the Thousand Martial Hall_1
chapters.content:
The Heavenly Battle of Daxuan City came to an end with Meng Chong single-handedly overpowering and killing the masters of Sanjuelou.
Sanjuelou, the top-tier spiritual sect under Thousand Martial Hall, was almost wiped clean of its powerhouses, thus losing its prestige as a top-tier spiritual sect.
Stories about Meng Chong's six-meter-tall golden body and his golden-armored giant also spread like a storm throughout the various parts of the Ling Domain.
Although it wasn't as brutal as Xu Yan's actions, it shocked many martial artists and shook countless spiritual sects.
Meng Chong, the respected swordsman, suppressed the pride of Lizhou by himself in Daxuan City, and single-handedly brought down Sanjuelou!
"Has Thousand Martial Hall run out of luck?"
"Maybe they are too shameless and had to face retribution."
In the Spiritual Realm Martial Way World, discussions about Thousand Martial Hall were rife.
Jianzhai, its pride and the sect master, were all killed by Xu Yan, one of the affiliated sects of Thousand Martial Hall.
In Sanjuelou, the pride was killed by Meng Chong, the sect master and elders were also killed by Meng Chong, greatly reducing their strength. This was also a force affiliated with Thousand Martial Hall.
As for the Thousand Martial Hall itself, its pride was killed and their Divine Artifact was stolen!
Among the major Transcendent Spirit Sects, Thousand Martial Hall was the first to suffer losses and encounter setbacks.
The Spiritual Realm Martial Way World buzzed with excitement because of Xu Yan and Meng Chong, making the competition between the best even more engaging.
"Haven't they caught Xu Yan yet?"
"No!"
"Thousand Martial Hall's reputation is damaged."
"Xu Yan is impressive indeed, stealing the Divine Artifact of Thousand Martial Hall and they still can't catch him!"
Originally, everyone thought that Xu Yan wouldn't be able to run for long, and he would be killed by the powerhouses of the Thousand Martial Hall, retrieving their Divine Artifact.
However, Xu Yan seemed to be wandering freely, and the palm-attacking elder of Thousand Martial Hall was scrambling blindly and couldn't find him!
"Xu Yan has appeared! Xu Yan has appeared!"
"Really, was he killed?"
"No, he killed a powerhouse of Thousand Martial Hall and then ran again!"
Occasionally, news about Xu Yan slipped out, revealing his whereabouts.
After several times, everyone couldn't help but suspect that Xu Yan was deliberately revealing his whereabouts, leading the powerhouses of Thousand Martial Hall to chase him.
"Have you heard about Fairy Dan, the miraculous doctor? It is said that she can heal even if the foundation is completely destroyed."
"I heard that too, and her miraculous medicine is truly incredible."
"Yes, the son of my distant cousin's sworn brother's brother had his foundation completely destroyed by some evil bastard from a spiritual sect, and became useless. But he was saved and has now recovered his strength to the Small Celestial State."
"Is it really so miraculous?"
"Of course!"
"Where is Fairy Dan?"
"In Luo State, Chang Qing Pavilion, the original location of the Chiming Sect."
While the events involving Xu Yan and Meng Chong were spreading tumultuously throughout the Ling Domain, and every martial artist was keenly discussing them, another piece of news began to spread in the Ling Domain.
Fairy Dan, Su Lingxiu of Chang Qing Pavilion, has miraculous healing powers that could revive the dead. Any serious injury can be healed, as long as the person is not yet dead!
The prerequisite was that you could afford the consultation fee, and the spiritual medicine required for treatment!
Some people were amazed, wondering why such a miraculous technique suddenly appeared in the Ling Domain?
Others were skeptical.
Regardless, the name of Fairy Dan, Su Lingxiu, gradually began to spread throughout the Ling Domain.
"Eldest senior brother is too powerful!"
In a large city, Meng Chong, who wore a wig on his head, couldn't help but exclaim.
He originally wanted to lay siege to the mountain gate of Thousand Martial Hall, but the news came that not only did his eldest senior brother kill the pride of Thousand Martial Hall, but he also took the Divine Artifact of Thousand Martial Hall and ran away.
Thousand Martial Hall is in a frenzy now.
So, he dismissed the idea of laying siege to the mountain gate of Thousand Martial Hall. If he tried to besiege the mountain gate of Thousand Martial Hall at this time, the powerhouses of Thousand Martial Hall might go crazy.
"Or shall I lay siege to the gate of Lei Yun Mountain Manor?"
Meng Chong fell into deep thought.
Since there is no immediate grudge with Lei Yun Mountain Manor, directly going there to lie in wait doesn't seem quite right. Moreover, after the lesson learned from Thousand Martial Hall, Lei Yun Mountain Manor might react very aggressively.
Even though he is not afraid, as he has the Divine Skills Jade Talisman from his master.
However, to make a name in the Martial Arts World, one must rely on oneself in the end.
"It's better to find a place to seclude myself for some time and strive to break through to the second level of the Undying Golden Body."
Meng Chong was deep in thought. Apart from breaking through to the second level of the Undying Golden Body, he also needed to comprehend the training methods of the third level of the Undying Golden Body.
It was about time to comprehend it.
He was almost at the verge of breaking through to the second level, so it was about time to put the comprehension of the techniques of the third level on the agenda.
"What kind of Divine Skills will I be able to produce when my physical Martial Arts break through to the Divine Realm?"
Meng Chong was looking forward to it.
"After breaking through, I should also go out and experience the Ling Domain, travel around, compete in martial arts with others everywhere, comprehend the universe in all directions, and accumulate martial arts experience."
After Meng Chong had a plan in his heart, he left the big city to find a place to break through in seclusion.
"Junior sister is also famous now!"
Hearing some martial artists discuss Fairy Dan, he couldn't help but exclaim.
"However, the reputation of the fourth junior brother is somewhat lesser in comparison."
Although Fang Hao, the Alliance Hierarch of Yuzhou, also had a bit of fame, he was the first one to break the pattern of Yuzhou, and he even broke the pattern of the Ling Domain for the first time.
However, Yuzhou was ultimately too weak.
Therefore, it naturally did not attract as much attention.
...
Xu Yan looked at the old man standing in his way with a murderous look on his face, and his eyebrows frowned slightly.
The old man's aura was very special, and it gave him a faint sense of danger.
"Xu Yan, the unequaled Heavenly Pride, today is your doomsday!"
The old man's hoarse voice echoed ominously.
"Someone from Thousand Martial Hall?"
Xu Yan knitted his brows, this old man seemed a little off.
This time, barely revealing a trace of himself ended up drawing such an old guy's attention.
"Where is Leng Juedao?"
