chapters.title: Chapter 584 - 315: Shocking the Ling Domain, Pursuit of the Thousand Martial Hall_2
chapters.content:
The elder did not reply, but furrowed his brows instead.
The Cold Absolute Blade was not on Xu Yan, could he have thrown it away?
But how could that be possible? It was a Divine Artifact after all!
Had he hidden it somewhere?
"Declare the whereabouts of the Cold Absolute Blade, and I will grant you a swift end!"
The elder spoke coldly.
Xu Yan smirked. With a wave of his hand, he drew out the Cold Absolute Blade.
"If you think you're capable, come and snatch back this useless blade."
At once, he stowed the Cold Absolute Blade back into the Storage Ring.
The elder was utterly astonished.
Wasn't that a Storage Bag that could hold Divine Artifacts?
"Die now!"
The elder growled, his white hair dancing wildly, and a red flush spread across his old face.
An aura intertwining both cold and death-like energy burst forth, and he sent forth a fierce punch towards Xu Yan.
Xu Yan countered with a sword strike that felt like it encompassed the entire landscape.
Boom!
The landscape crumbled. The elder drew close and threw another punch.
The air was filled with murderous intent and permeated with death energy.
"Petty tricks!"
Xu Yan sneered coldly.
He knew he could not afford to prolong the fight. If the Blademeister Elder from Thousand Martial Hall were to pursue him, it would take quite some time to shake him off.
Buzz!
In that moment, Xu Yan slashed downward with his sword, blending Sudden Wind Sword Intent with landscape-like Sword Intent. Seemingly just a single sword strike, the blow had the might of a landscape brought full force onto his opponent.
The elder fell silent as a gray light was emitted from his body. Death energy was swirling around him, enveloping him entirely.
In that moment, the surrounding temperature seemed to drop, and a bone-chilling aura of death filled the air.
Whoosh!
He swung another punch. His aged body became more haggard as his Divine Soul kept melting away.
No signs of pain appeared on the elder's face. Instead, he wore a smile and seemed indifferent.
Xu Yan felt a tug at his heart. This attack was extraordinary; it was enveloped in the aura of death—this was the elder's lifelong cultivation of Martial Arts that were being released in this instant.
"The Transcendent Spirit Sect indeed has some skills. Does the Thousand Martial Hall also possess such a secret technique? Is he a martyr of Thousand Martial Hall?"
Two Wheel of Swords appeared before Xu Yan.
The Wheel of Life and Death!
Like bargaining chips between life and death, they whittled away at the elder's strike. However, the elder's strike, compared to Wu Yuan's, was even more fierce. A deathly air, once attached, was as corrosive as lethal poison, constantly wearing at him.
Xu Yan circulated his divine essence, resisting this deathly aura.
"That was a little harsh!"
A strand of divine essence had been tainted with the deathly aura. Xu Yan immediately severed that strand of divine essence, dispelling it into mid-air.
He continued his offensive while simultaneously retreating.
The elder's attack was drawing closer and becoming more relentless, especially that deathly air, as tenacious and deadly as a parasite.
"One must have spent a long time and paid a considerable price to refine the lifeforce and Divine Soul into such an aura of death, right?"
"Moreover, it can only be launched when one's lifespan is running out.
"I have to admit, its power is indeed tremendous, but in my eyes, such a secret technique is merely rubbish!"
Xu Yan remained calm and composed. During this confrontation, he had deduced how the elder had trained to achieve such deadly power.
The elder's expression darkened, a hint of apprehension flashed in his eyes.
Just within an instant, Xu Yan had discerned the source of his secret technique?
This boy was far too monstrous. He surpassed even the Blood Demon of yesteryears. This threat must be eliminated!
Bang!
In that moment, his physical body began to disintegrate. His attack intensified, the deathly air neared blackness. It was like maggots gnawing at a corpse, constantly corroding Xu Yan's attack, pressing closer with increasing intensity.
"What difference does it make if you know? You can't escape!"
His attack had locked onto Xu Yan's presence, and he had no choice but to take the blow head-on—there was no possibility of him evading.
And with Xu Yan's power, even if he successfully withstands the attack, he would undoubtedly be corroded by the death aura, corroding his martial fundamentals, corroding his Divine Soul.
He was assured to suffer a great deal!
Moreover, looking at the present situation, Xu Yan couldn't even withstand the attack!
The elder's eyes were frosty. Xu Yan was fated to die without question!
Even if he himself would not last, others would soon find this location, and the Blademeister Elder would soon be on their trail.
The Cold Absolute Blade would be repossessed.
And Xu Yan's body would be hung at the entrance of the Thousand Martial Hall, deterring all in Ling Domain. This was the outcome of angering the Thousand Martial Hall!
"Who said I can't escape?"
Xu Yan revealed a splendid smile.
His figure instantly disappeared from its original location, shifting to another.
"You think..."
Before the elder could finish, a look of horror suddenly appeared on his face.
"No!"
His blow had, unexpectedly, lost its direction!
Originally, it had locked onto Xu Yan's presence, yet at this moment his presence had vanished, even though he was clearly not far away!
"All this time, I have been effortlessly defeating enemies head-on. But that doesn't mean I lack other techniques. Today you'll have the honor of witnessing them."
Xu Yan's smile was brilliant, the elder's attack fell flat and was dissipating. He did not make a move, just watching with mocking eyes as the elder raged helplessly, fear evident in his eyes as he faced impending death!
"You... must… die!"
With the elder's final roar, he completely vanished.
However, the lingering deathly aura from his attack still laced the surroundings and wouldn't dissipate for a while.
"Thousand Martial Hall actually has such a method. The remaining Transcendent Spirit Sects must have something similar too. I mustn't underestimate them."
Xu Yan murmured to himself before his figure flickered and disappeared from the spot.
Less than quarter an hour after he left, the form of an old man appeared. His expression changed drastically as he detected the lingering deathly aura.

chapters.title: Chapter 585 - 315: Shocking the Ling Domain, Pursuit of the Thousand Martial Hall_3
chapters.content:
"Failed?"
He found it hard to believe, couldn't he even manage to detain Xu Yan?
Could it be that Xu Yan had already grown this powerful?
This lad is a ticking time bomb, even a bigger hidden danger than the Blood Demon of yesteryears!
"Where's Xu Yan?"
A voice filled with anger echoed.
The Elder of Blades arrived, immediately his expression altered.
"We could not detain Xu Yan, but I do not know if we've injured him."
The old man spoke solemnly.
"Continue the pursuit!"
The Elder of Blades's face was grim.
However, in the following days, there was not a trace of news about Xu Yan. It was as if he had vanished into thin air. The Elder of Blades and others couldn't help but wonder if Xu Yan had been injured and was hiding, not daring to reveal his whereabouts.
"Xu Yan's hiding skills are far more profound than the Blood Demon of the past. This boy must die!"
This chilling thought hovered in the Elder of Blades's mind.
In the distance, a transcendence eagle was flying. On the back of the eagle was a small palace, and wearing colorful feathered clothes was Cui Huayu, her face serious and reserved.
Xu Yan looked around the small palace, and exclaimed: "You guys from the Transcendent Spirit Sect sure know how to enjoy life!"
"No choice, I've been frail and sick since I was young. I can't stand the cold wind, so this is the only way."
With a sickly pale complexion, Cui Huayu uttered a dry laugh.
She happened to bump into Xu Yan, greeted him impulsively, and then Xu Yan made himself comfortable and entered her small palace.
Fortunately, she didn't have any beautiful women accompanying her during this trip. Otherwise, it would have been quite awkward.
"You're frail and sickly?"
Xu Yan curiously stared at Cui Huayu. This person seemed to carry a sick pallor, giving off a weak impression.
However, she was a late-stage Refining God Heavenly Man Martial Artist.
"The Yu Ling Mansion is part of the Transcendent Spirit Sect too, eh? Your realm as a true disciple is a bit low."
Xu Yan said, astonished.
The strength of Cui Huayu was only at the late stage of Refining God Heavenly Man, compared to Wu Yuan and the others from the Thousand Martial Hall, she was quite lacking.
"No choice, being frail and sickly, reaching this level is already quite an achievement."
Cui Huayu heaved a sigh.
"If that's the case, how did you become a true disciple of the Yu Ling Mansion?"
Xu Yan didn't buy her bluff.
"Because I have connections. My master is a supreme being. My uncle is also a supreme being."
Cui Huayu cheerfully answered.
"You're so weak, why would your master accept you as a disciple?"
Xu Yan still didn't believe.
"Well..."
Cui Huayu awkwardly grinned, then lowered her voice, "Don't tell anyone, but actually, I am the illegitimate son of my master, you understand?"
"Your master is a supreme being, wouldn't he dare to acknowledge his own illegitimate son? Is your master's wife very domineering?"
Xu Yan asked in surprise.
Cui Huayu ruffled his hair, blushing, "My mother is the sister of the current head of the Yu Ling Mansion."
Xu Yan suddenly understood. No wonder Cui Huayu's father could only acknowledge him as a disciple but not reveal his identity.
"Don't worry, I will keep this a secret and will not let your mother know the truth."
Xu Yan said earnestly.
"Brother Xu, you don't have to be so cautious. Actually, my mother is also my biological mother!"
Cui Huayu continued awkwardly.
"I feel like you might be playing me."
Xu Yan glared at him.
"No, no, don't misunderstand. I'm telling the truth."
Cui Huayu was almost sweating bullets. Xu Yan was, after all, someone ruthless, who hadn't spared anyone, regardless of their background. Annoying him could be dangerous.
"My parents were likely not quite normal, insisting on accepting me as their disciple and for us to address each other as master and disciple. I feel helpless too."
A look of helplessness emerged on Cui Huayu's face.

chapters.title: Chapter 586 - 316: The secret of Spiritual Body, Sword Intent Follows the Heart_1
chapters.content:
"I suppose I can trust your outrageous tales for now."
Xu Yan shook his head, not delving into Cui Huayu's past.
"I heard that all prodigies of Transcendent Spirit Sect are spirit-bodies. Then why aren't there any spirit-body prodigies in the Thousand Martial Hall?"
This was a question that Xu Yan had wondered for a long time.
Could it be possible that the Thousand Martial Hall was concealing the true prodigies?
But that wasn't logical as they still hadn't show up to fight, even when he had challenged them to their faces.
Or did they avoid the fight because they didn't have the certainty of winning?
"Spirit bodies are rare in the world. Once one obtains a spirit body, no matter how humble their origins, they will gain recognition and will be taken in by the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
"Reporting a Spirit-body Prodigy to the Transcendent Spirit Sect is a great achievement.
"The core prodigies of the Transcendent Spirit Sect possess the spirit body. Such prodigies usually do not travel through Ling Domain, for even if they do, their names remain unknown to others."
Cui Huayu said after thoughtful consideration.
Xu Yan raised an eyebrow, sensing a hidden secret in all of this.
"For more covert matters, I am unaware. But as far as I know, the Transcendent Spirit Sect exists to cultivate spirit-body prodigies.
"As for what lies behind all this, it is beyond my knowledge."
Cui Huayu spread his hands helplessly.
"Are spirit bodies that rare?"
Xu Yan asked thoughtfully.
His Junior Sister Su Lingxiu is a spirit body, and so is Yue'er.
Moon Changming is also a spirit body.
While he and Meng Chong weren't born with spirit bodies, they've undergone transcendence and transformation with each breakthrough, which is incomparable to spirit bodies.
There are also rumors that all thirty-six heroes of the Wanxing Martial Arts Institute are Spirit-body Prodigies.
"Of course they're rare!"
Cui Huayu said seriously.
"I've heard that all thirty-six heroes of Wanxing are Spirit-body Prodigies..."
Xu Yan questioned.
Cui Huayu shook his head saying, "That's a misrepresentation. The spirit bodies mentioned in the martial arts world are somewhat different from what the Transcendent Spirit Sect recognizes."
"Oh, how so?"
Xu Yan was surprised. Could there be another definition of Spirit Body in the Transcendent Spirit Sect?
Cui Huayu explained, "The spirit bodies widely recognized in the Ling Domain are mostly Spirit Resonance Bodies and not genuine spirit bodies. A Spirit Resonance Body carries the manifestation resembling spirit bodies but it is simply a body with spiritual resonance, not a genuine spirit body.
"While Spirit Resonance Bodies carry the traits resembling spirit bodies, they are not genuine spirit bodies. Nevertheless, spiritual resonance is also a remarkable talent that brings one closer to nature's spiritual energy and makes them more receptive to the Heavenly Earth Lingji…"
Through Cui Huayu's explanation, Xu Yan realized that the spirit bodies commonly referred to in the Ling Domain are actually bodies with spirit resonance, not genuine spirit bodies.
Identifying a genuine spirit body requires special spirit items and some unique methods.
Generally, most sects below the Top Spirit Sects don't possess these identification methods and therefore often mistake bodies with spirit resonance for spirit bodies.
The Transcendent Spirit Sect didn't clarify this. Although bodies with spirit resonance are not as good as spirit bodies, they still possess remarkable talents.
"Once a martial artist with a Spirit Resonance Body advances in their cultivation stage, the resonance gradually merges into their cultivation and they no longer possess the manifestation of spirit bodies.
"Wu Yuan from the Thousand Martial Hall is in fact a Spirit Resonance Body. His resonance has already merged with his cultivation level, making his power even stronger than the prodigies with innate bodies."
Cui Huayu further explained.
"I see!"
Xu Yan finally understood. "In that case, the thirty-six heroes of Wanxing are actually Spirit Resonance Bodies, not spirit bodies."
"Most of the thirty-six heroes are bodies with spirit resonance but there are indeed genuine Spirit-body Prodigies. It's said that the top five among them are true spirit bodies."
Cui Huayu heaved a sigh.
"How can a spirit body be distinguished?"
Xu Yan curiously asked.
Although he could sense spirit bodies, if they were bodies possessing spirit resonance with manifestation of spirit bodies, without experience in distinguishing the differences, he wouldn't be able to make a proper judgement.
"You'll need spirit items and some methods."
Cui Huayu thought for a moment and took out a small green tree.
"A spirit body touching this spirit tree, stimulated via a unique method will cause the leaves to glow. If it is a Spirit Resonance Body, the leaves will only glow faintly."
He was eager to find out if Xu Yan was a spirit body.
Given his exceptional prowess, he was undoubtedly a spirit body.
Xu Yan thoughtfully said, "Spirit Resonance Bodies seem more illusory, while spirit bodies appear more reserved and substantial. Is that the difference?"
Once Cui Huayu had clarified, Xu Yan understood the difference between Spirit Resonance Bodies.
By comparing with his Junior Sister Su Lingxiu, or Yue'er, he could determine whether he has a spirit body or possesses a Spirit Resonance Body.
"That could be it."
Cui Huayu nodded, puzzled in his mind. Could it be that Xu Yan could differentiate without using spirit items?
Xu Yan reached out to touch the small tree in Cui Huayu's hand. Ecstatic, Cui Huayu hastily used his method to examine the strength of Xu Yan's spirit body.
There were different strengths of spirit bodies, divided into different grades.
Snap!
The tree barely glowed before it instantly disintegrated into debris.
Cui Huayu was stunned.
Xu Yan blinked and said, "Your tree is not all that reliable!"
But he thought to himself, "Indeed, I am above spirit bodies. I'll ask my master when I return."
Xu Yan felt a secret thrill.
Cui Huayu scratched his head, wondering if there was a problem with his Spirit Testing Tree.
"How many spirit bodies are there in Yu Ling Mansion?"
Xu Yan asked curiously.
"I don't know, this is the deepest secret of the Transcendent Spirit Sect."
Cui Huayu shook his head.
The two chatted idly for a while. Then Cui Huayu asked curiously, "Brother Xu, where do you plan to hide from the Thousand Martial Hall?"

chapters.title: Chapter 587 - 316: The Secret of Spiritual Body, Sword Intent Follows the Heart_2
chapters.content:
"No need to hide, I want to find a place suitable for fighting and learning martial arts, and traverse the entire Ling Domain."
Xu Yan unflappably smiled, barely concerned about the pursuit of the Thousand Martial Hall.
"You are a true disciple of the Yu Ling Mansion and relatively familiar with the Ling Domain. Do you know where it is more chaotic and easier to fight?"
Roaming under the heavens of the Ling Domain, perceiving the corners of the world, the more chaotic a place is, the more chances for battles to erupt. So, Xu Yan had decided that his next destination would be a place of chaos and disorder.
A place easily attracting enemies, where conflicts and battles could unfold.
"In terms of chaotic places within the Ling Domain, Dachuan must be the top. That place is riddled with mountains, bandits, dense forests and the second highest amount of spiritual beasts only after Heavenly Mausoleum State. With mountains and rivers crisscrossing, the land of Dachuan is extremely fierce.
"Even the prestige of the Transcendent Spirit Sect is weaker in Dachuan than other states. The Blood Demon had originally established the Blood God Religion there and rose to power.
"It is rumored that remnants of the Blood God Religion still remain in Dachuan to this day. Even if one wanted to exterminate them, it would be extremely difficult.
"There are too many mountains, which provide excellent places to hide. There are even rumors that occasionally, tombs from ancient times appear in Dachuan. But of course, this is a tale from long ago.
"There is also a rumor that when the Blood Demon was rising to power, he obtained his Blood God Technique from the ancient tomb in Dachuan."
After contemplating, Cui Huayu replied.
Xu Yan's eyes sparkled. "Then let's go to Dachuan. You let people spread the message to the Thousand Martial Hall that Xu Yan has gone to Dachuan. Let them feel anxious."
The Blood Demon rose to power in Dachuan. Now that he was going there, could the Thousand Martial Hall really not be concerned?
A twitch formed at the corner of Cui Huayu's mouth. Xu Yan was planning to ambush the warriors of the Thousand Martial Hall in Dachuan. He really wasn't concerned about the Thousand Martial Hall at all.
"No problem!"
Cui Huayu agreed immediately.
"Let's go, see you if we're destined to!"
Xu Yan took a step out of the palace, preparing to set off for Dachuan.
He then suddenly turned his head and said, "Looking at your frail condition, it seems there really is a problem with your body. You can go to the Chang Qing Pavilion and have my junior sister check you out."
Cui Huayu was shocked. "Chang Qing Pavilion? I understand!"
Xu Yan nodded, then stepped away, vanishing on the spot and headed straight for Dachuan.
Cui Huayu exhaled, finally relaxing. The pressure of facing Xu Yan was indeed too much.
Looking at the shattered divination branch, he was a bit puzzled. Did something really go wrong with his branch?
"Returning to Yu Ling Mansion... I have a premonition. Do not become enemies with Xu Yan, no matter what!"
Cui Huayu had a hunch: the good fortune of the Thousand Martial Hall may have run out this time.
The momentum of Xu Yan's rise was unstoppable and far surpassed that of the Blood Demon's in the past.
Days later, news of Xu Yan heading to Dachuan began to circulate. The strong members of the Thousand Martial Hall indeed became more serious. Besides the chief elder and two other elders, they headed to Dachuan to hunt down Xu Yan.
Meanwhile, in the Chang Qing Pavilion of Luo State...
The title of "Dan Medical Immortal" was gradually spreading. Various martial artists came to see the doctor, most of them suffering from chronic diseases that had not been healed for years, or even martial artists with damaged foundations, coming forth with a glimmer of hope.
The people in the Chang Qing Pavilion started to get busy.
For those with weak injuries and diseases, giving them dan medicine was enough, while Su Lingxiu personally stepped in to deal with martial artists above the Refining God Heavenly Man realm.
Lei Tong also visited every few days, each time leaving very satisfied, as if he had made huge gains.
He was totally unaware that everything he knew was but an illusion.
Fang Hao was in the middle of making a Flying Boat. The contours of the Flying Boat were already defined, and some of its functions were almost complete.
But there was still a piece missing from its successful refinement.
Li Xuan took a glance and nodded in satisfaction. This Flying Boat was pretty good, and they wouldn't have to ride spiritual beasts around the Ling Domain like peasants any longer.
Moreover, the Flying Boat could be directly transformed into the Chang Qing Pavilion, which was convenient for Su Lingxiu to heal people everywhere.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has achieved great success in the Heart Sword Realm, and you have the Sword Intent at will."
Xu Yan has achieved great success in the Heart Sword Realm.
"Sword intent at will!"
Li Xuan was excited in his heart. From now on, he did not need to comprehend Sword Intent anymore. Wherever his heart was, the Sword Intent would be there.
Any kind of Sword Intent was merely a thought away.
"My strength has increased again."
Li Xuan sighed in his heart. Moreover, his martial arts experience was continually improving. Zhang Chong and Xu Yan kept giving him feedback about martial arts experience.
Time flew by, with continuous news from Xu Yan and Zhang Chong.
In the Chang Qing Pavilion, everyone was amazed. Even someone like Shi'er was boiling with enthusiasm, with a keen urge to go out and create a great name for himself.
Of course, he could only wish for it, but not dare to act on it, because his strength was simply too weak.
"The senior brother is too strong!"
Fang Hao was sincerely in awe.
Xu Yan took away the Divine Artifact from the Thousand Martial Hall outright, and the Thousand Martial Hall was unable to do anything against him. It was outrageously powerful.
The aloof Transcendent Spirit Sect was trampled facely this time.
The reverence that the Loose Cultivators had for the Transcendent Spirit Sect was imperceptibly weakened.
"There are thousands of geniuses in the world, is Xu Yan a model?"
Li Xuan gave a dumbfounded smile.
"Meng Chong is not bad either, he should be about to break through."
Li Xuan was very satisfied with this.
Four disciples, all of them had achieved their own, he, as a high-ranking master, was relieved.
"It's been a month now, all of you from Lei Yun Mountain Manor have completely recovered without any relapses. Do you still wish to continue paying the observation fee?"
Yue'er asked, looking at Lei Tong.
The agreed term of a month had already arrived.
"No need, I will take them back right away."
Lei Tong's face was full of smiles, as if he had achieved a great harvest.
"Alright."
Yue'er's face showed regret.
Lei Tong led the injured away, and the formation of the Chang Qing Pavilion was also lifted, with martial artists coming in an endless stream.
Of course, there was a daily limit to the number of visitors. Once the limit was reached, those who came after would have to wait until the next day.
Therefore, there were always people lining up outside the Chang Qing Pavilion every day.
There were indeed uninvited guests who caused trouble, but under the deterrence of Zhu Xingzheng, the Refining God Heavenly Man, the troublemakers had paid a heavy price.
Even a late-stage Refining God Spiritual Sect Warrior who didn't want to queue up caused trouble, and was killed by a slap from Cai Ling'er.
Powerful ones!
Thus, no one dared to make trouble anymore.
Lei Tong, who was on his way back to Lei Yun Mountain Manor, and the others were hurrying and their faces were filled with excitement.
"Have you already acquired the technique of Dan medicine?"
Lei Tong asked in a deep voice.
"Yes!"
A martial artist nodded.
"Good, there are countless prodigies in my Lei Yun Mountain Manor. Once we thoroughly study the technique, Chang Qing Pavilion will disappear!"
Lei Tong's eyes flickered with a cold light.
"Did you also steal some of the pills?"
"Yes!"
Another martial artist nodded.
"Let's have a look at the secret book of Dan medicine technique."
Lei Tong couldn't wait to speak.
The martial artist who considered himself to have obtained the secret technique of Dan Medicine took out a small booklet from his storage bag.
"Elder, here it is!"
Lei Tong took it and opened the booklet, and his smile immediately turned stiff.
"Did you grab the wrong one?"
He asked doubtfully.
"No, elder, it's this one!"
Lei Tong took a deep breath, threw the booklet at him, and angrily said, "What is this?!"
The martial artist was taken aback, he opened the booklet and saw that it looked like ghost symbols, with crooked characters written on it. It was totally a mess.
His face changed, he hurriedly flipped to the back, but each page was almost the same.
"H-how is this possible, I clearly copied it down, I didn't miss anything."
He took out his storage bag and laid out everything from inside.
The copied Dan medicine technique was indeed that booklet, but why...?
Lei Tong had a bad premonition, he looked at the martial artist who claimed to have stolen the pill, and said in a deep voice, "Where's your pill?"
That martial artist also had a bad feeling, he took out the stolen pill, poured it into his palm, and took a closer look, his face turned green instantly.
It seemed to be a few mud pills!
Lei Tong's face turned gloomy, he felt as if he was being played like a monkey, and maybe the people in Chang Qing Pavilion were laughing at them now.
Thinking about it more deeply, this was an extremely terrifying matter.
Even the Refining God Heavenly Man, and powerful ones like him, could be deluded and fall into illusion. What else could be more terrifying than this?
"I didn't notice any anomalies!"
One of the injured, a powerful man from the Lei Yun Mountain Manor, said solemnly at this moment.
"Elder, they humiliate us in such a way, this is an insult to our Lei Yun Mountain Manor, let's fight back, let's capture them!"
A martial artist said angrily.

chapters.title: Chapter 588 - 317: The Divine Skill of Martial Arts in Flesh and Blood, Reborn in One Thought _1
chapters.content:
Lei Tong's face was gloomy, but his eyes were filled with a trace of apprehension.
He wondered what kind of strength did it take to completely deceive everyone, including him, without being detected?
He had the power to do it?
The fact that the other party had acted so brazenly indicated that they were not afraid of their actions being discovered later, nor the retaliation of Lei Yun Mountain Manor. They were confident.
The All Ages Alliance?
Lei Tong took a deep breath, saying in a deep voice, "You all go back. I'll go and investigate the Chang Qing Pavilion."
"Take care, Elder!"
The others also understood that the Chang Qing Pavilion must be more than capable.
After everyone left, Lei Tong stood still, recalling each time he entered Chang Qing Pavilion, unable to figure out where the problem could be.
"Not right!"
Suddenly, his expression changed.
Finally realizing, what was wrong.
In the recent days, wounded martial artists had been lingering outside the Chang Qing Pavilion, but near the pavilion, everything appeared normal, with no sight of any warriors seeking medical treatment.
This was obviously abnormal.
The injured seeking treatment were stationed so far away, yet, there were no patients near the pavilion?
Obviously, he must have been hypnotized once he entered a certain range, and everything he saw was an illusion.
Even including the people!
The more he thought about it, the more his scalp tingled. What kind of tactic was this that had even managed to ensnare him, a powerful being? And yet, with the strength of his divine soul, he didn't realize it at all.
"I had thought those Martial Artists were just curious and gathered around to watch the Chang Qing Pavilion, but I never expected this!"
Lei Tong muttered to himself.
Due to the distance from the Chang Qing Pavilion, the patients stayed together in a loose formation and did not even form a line. Hence, he didn't realize that those were the warriors seeking medical attention.
"Excellent tactic!"
Lei Tong moved and headed towards Chang Qing Pavilion.
Outside the Chang Qing Pavilion, patients were lined up waiting to enter, including the Refining God Heavenly Man, and even a Spirit Sect Elder he recognized.
This elder had once been seriously injured, with his foundation destroyed and no further progress in cultivation, and his lifespan reduced. Even he was waiting in line for treatment now.
With his status as a topnotch Elder of the Spirit Sect, to be in line with some Loose Cultivators, even behind one gravely ill martial artist bearing old wounds, was quite a sight.
The sight made Lei Tong's heart sink.
Something must have happened at the Chang Qing Pavilion, otherwise, the Spirit Sect elder would not be standing in line waiting obediently?
He took a deep breath and walked into the Chang Qing Pavilion.
"Get in line at the back!"
A warrior in the line stared at him discontentedly.
"What are you looking at? Think you're amazing because you're a Spiritual Sect Warrior? A few days ago, some Spirit Sect Warrior who broke the rules was smacked to death. If you don't line up properly, you won't get treatment."
The Warrior was not a bit cowed.
"Humph!"
Lei Tong snorted coldly, a touch of his aura erupted, instantly paling the warrior who fell trembling to the ground.
The other warriors in line seeking treatment were all shaking uncontrollably.
Was this, a supreme warrior?
"An Elder of Lei Yun Mountain Manor!"
The Spirit Sect Warrior in the line changed his expression. From Lei Tong's clothing, he recognized that this was an Elder from Lei Yun Mountain Manor.
Lei Tong then stepped into Chang Qing Pavilion.
At that moment, he discovered that the Chang Qing Pavilion was unlike what he had always seen.
He clenched his teeth, saying darkly, "Chang Qing Pavilion, what a tactic!"
Fury gnawed at him the whole time. The fact he, a respected elder of Lei Yun Mountain Manor and a supreme figure bearing a trace of the Heaven and Earth Laws' aura, had been made a fool of was unbearable.
"Elder Lei, do you need anything else?"
Yue'er asked with surprise.
She seemed to have no idea that Lei Tong was about to explode with anger right on the spot.
The others looked up at Lei Tong and then continued with their work, completely indifferent to him.
"After you return, take one pill per day for three days, and you should be cured."
Meng Shushu handed three medicinal pills to an injured person.
"Next!"
He continued the examination without any hurry.
Yue'er asked Lei Tong a question and then continued operating on the diagnostic spiritual artifact, diagnosing the patients while Meng Shushu and Shi'er were responsible for prescribing pills according to the diagnosis.
Zhou Ying was in charge of collecting the fees.
Su Lingxiu was absorbed in working on the Flying Boat, helping to perfect its shape without showing her face.
Moon Changming was in a corner, concentrating on gathering the Heaven and Earth Laws' aura.
Li Xuan was lounging on a chair, leisurely reading the Book of Tai Cang and sipping spiritual tea brewed by Cai Ling'er.
No one paid any attention to his anger.
Tightly clenching his fists, Lei Tong trembled all over with rage. The divine artifact hanging on his waist was emitting a weak glow of thunder, seeming like he was about to lash out thunderously at any moment.
But he eventually restrained himself.
He saw the powerful figure from the Sea Spirit Tribe, making tea for a young man!
The latter was leisurely and undisturbed, with his aura hidden, like an ordinary person.
But, the calmer he was, the more Lei Tong worried. This meant the other side was extremely confident.
"Humph!"
Lei Tong coldly harrumphed, with a chill in his voice, "Chang Qing Pavilion, you better watch yourselves!"
Then he turned around and left.
"Just ignore him, he's just a clown."
"Seems like he's furiously impotent. He can't stand the fact he's powerless."
"Is he going to die of anger?"
"Not likely, he's supposedly a supreme figure. He won't be that weak."
Meng Shushu's and Shi'er's voices reached him from behind.
Lei Tong's eyes turned blood red. How dare these weaklings mock him?
They were pushing him too far!
One of his hands clutched the divine artifact at his waist, ready to strike back and annihiliate those two insignificant ants who dared to mock him!

chapters.title: Chapter 589 - 317: The Divine Skill of Martial Arts in Flesh and Blood, Reborn in One Thought _2
chapters.content:
"Cough! You two, stop needlessly irritating others."
Li Xuan was rendered speechless. Meng Shushu and Shi'er, caused quite a commotion that almost led to an explosion.
Lei Tong, who was about to attack, felt a buzzing sound in his head, and his Divine Soul was shaken, as if a thunder had exploded in his mind with Li Xuan's cough.
Horrified, his eyes filled with fear.
Without uttering a word, he hurriedly left.
Too powerful!
"Such a strong person!"
Lei Tong's heart was filled with awe. No wonder the Chang Qing Pavilion was so fearless, they possessed such powerful strength, that's where their confidence came from!
"Stronger than Wu Tianan? How is that possible!"
With a solemn expression, Lei Tong hurried back to Lei Yun Mountain Manor. This must be reported to the Manor Head. There is such a powerful existence in the Ling Domain.
The reputation of the Chang Qing Pavilion gradually spread, and the name of the Elixir Master Fairy, Su Lingxiu, began to spread throughout Ling Domain. Numerous people admired her from various states, bringing more information.
For example, Xu Yan went to Dachuan.
Xu Yan killed the martial artists of Thousand Martial Hall and others, while Meng Chong swept the triple towers, and achieved a six-meter Undying Golden Body, etc.
As for Su Lingxiu, she was also preparing for Breaking the Divine Origin Realm.
"Just a little bit more, and I can comprehend and engrave the ninth page of Heaven and Earth Laws."
Li Xuan was extremely excited.
The ninth page is the general outline of the Heaven and Earth Laws, and once engraved, it means that he has thoroughly understood the Heaven and Earth Laws.
The refining of the Flying Boat is coming to an end. Fang Hao, full of excitement, was looking forward to refining his own Flying Boat after his Master's Flying Boat was finished.
Once his own flying boat is successfully refined, he will set off for Wanshi Alliance Headquarters, which has already been delayed for some time.
He also wanted to show his divine power to suppress the talented.
"Finally, everything has been engraved."
Li Xuan put away the Book of Tai Cang. He had completely engraved the ninth page of Heaven and Earth Laws.
He squinted slightly, and a net of Heaven and Earth Laws appeared above his Soul Pedestal. His Primordial Spirit observed this net of Law, and continued to understand the Heaven and Earth Laws.
At this moment, the Heaven and Earth Laws in his perception were so clear.
They corresponded one-to-one with the Heaven and Earth Laws he had engraved.
Even, to some extent, he could manipulate the Heaven and Earth Laws for his own use.
Of course, with his current strength in the Divine Skill Realm, even if he had understood the Heaven and Earth Laws, the scope he could control was still very small.
"Once I enter the Divine Appearance Realm, I will have full control of the Heaven and Earth Laws."
Li Xuan was full of anticipation.
Upon entering the Divine Appearance Realm, he could take a Heaven and Earth Law as a weapon whenever he raised his hand!
This was mainly due to his comprehension of the Tai Cang Heaven and Earth Laws. Otherwise, it would be impossible for an ordinary warrior in the Divine Appearance Realm to pick and use a Law as easily as he did.
Li Xuan was wildly excited. His strength had increased again. "When will Xu Yan comprehend the method of Divine Appearance Realm Martial Arts?"
"He has just entered the Divine Skill Realm, and there is no rush. Next, I should continue to compile the Divine Skill Martial Code."
He opened the tenth page of the Book of Tai Cang, curious to know if it would depict higher-level Heaven and Earth Laws?
Next, what he had to do was to compile the Divine Skill Martial Code while memorizing the tenth page of the Book of Tai Cang and write it into the Daoist Golden Book, gaining the information of the tenth page of the Book of Tai Cang.
"The Body Martial Arts method after the Undying Golden Body should also be figured out."
By his estimation, Meng Chong was about to break through the second layer of the Indestructible Golden Body.
The third layer of the Indestructible Golden Body of the Big Day is the Divine Skill Realm. Li Xuan was also looking forward to what kind of powerful Divine Skill would be born in Body Martial Arts.
"The tenth page is more profound. Even with my cultivation base in the Divine Skill Realm and my understanding of the Heaven and Earth Laws, it will take a while to engrave it."
Looking at the tenth page of the Book of Tai Cang, Li Xuan sighed in his heart.
The patterns depicted on the tenth page did not change much, and they seemed to be permanent, but they were extremely profound. He found it difficult to engrave even one pattern, let alone comprehend the mysteriousness in it.
As he was studying the tenth page of the Book of Tai Cang, suddenly, the Daoist Golden Book opened on his Soul Pedestal and golden light emerged.
This scene had become very familiar.
Li Xuan even faced it calmly. Obviously, a feedback had come. Either Xu Yan had killed an enemy, or Meng Chong had.
"Your apprentice, Meng Chong, has comprehended the third layer of the Indestructible Golden Body of the Big Day, and you have broken through the third layer of the Indestructible Golden Body of the Big Day."
Li Xuan put away the Book of Tai Cang, extremely excited.
Meng Chong had understood the third layer of the Indestructible Golden Body of the Big Day. His Body Martial Arts was also about to break through the Divine Skill Realm. What kind of Divine Skill would be born from Body Martial Arts?
At this moment, he felt his body ascending and transforming, his Primordial Spirit was strengthened, and his Divine Soul became even stronger, entering a mysterious state.
Both the orthodox martial arts and body martial arts had broken through the Divine Skill Realm.
Naturally, his strength increased dramatically again.
"Your Body Martial Arts have broken through the Divine Skill Realm, and you have obtained the Divine Skill 'One Thought Rebirth'!"
Divine skills reborn in a flash!
Li Xuan was excited and thrilled to his core.
"This divine skill is incredible!"
With the undying Primordial Spirit, flesh and blood can be reborn in a thought!
As long as you are not obliterated in one blow, as long as the Primordial Spirit still has a breath left, you can rebirth flesh and blood in a thought.
Of course, although this divine skill is formidable, it also has limits and cannot be used endlessly.
Each time it is used, there's a buffer interval required to reaccumulate the power of rebirth before it can be used again.
However, the higher the realm, the stronger the power, the shorter the interval time. Upon reaching a certain realm, it might be possible to continuously deploy without a break.
"As long as I'm not obliterated in one strike, I can rise again!"
This divine skill is equivalent to having an extra life.
After being obliterated with one hit, the Primordial Spirit deploys the Returning Technique instantly, evading the enemy's search, and makes the enemy mistakenly think they have been completely annihilated.
Once the enemy leaves, find a place to regenerate in a thought, the flesh reassembles, and the body recovers. Then quietly improve the power, and when strong enough, find the enemy for revenge!
This divine skill undoubtedly offers a second chance!
"Divine Physical skills are indeed unique in their powerful recovery ability."
Li Xuan was incredibly excited.
"My Divine Skill Martial Code could compile similar divine skills and introduce them to Xu Yan for him to understand."
Li Xuan's eyes lit up with a new idea.
"Your Martial Arts breakthrough to Divine Skill Realm has gained the Divine Skill of Heaven and Earth Slash."
Heaven and Earth Slash can cut down heaven and earth in one strike!
This is an offensive divine skill.
"This divine skill when superimposed with Law of Heaven and Earth and Divine Annihilation, holds even more power!"
Li Xuan was thoroughly satisfied.
"Your Martial Art breakthrough to Divine Skill Realm has obtained the Divine Skill of Heaven and Earth Wind Thunder."
Heaven and Earth Wind Thunder, when exercised, makes the body like a high mountain, with wind and thunder in hand, sweeping across heaven and earth.
"The Martial Art at Divine Origin Realm Possesses the Nine Feet Golden Body, Divine Skill Realm has Eighteen Feet Golden Body, this divine skill is based on this transformation."
Li Xuan understood in his heart.
"Having three divine skills from Martial Art is quite good."
This time, the martial art breakthrough to Divine Skill Realm has given birth to three divine skills.
A look of gratification spread across Li Xuan's face. His hard work in training his disciple was not in vain, the gain was plenty enough.
"When Meng Chong breaks through, he will gain feedback from the divine skill, and the divine skill will increase again."
Li Xuan looked forward to Meng Chong breaking through the Divine Skill Realm.
"This girl Su Lingxiu should be close to comprehending the Divine Skill Realm of Dan-yi Martial Art, right?"
The practice method of Dan-yi Martial Art is similar to orthodox Martial Art, there's not much difference. Xu Yan has already explained to Su Lingxiu about the practice method of the Divine Skill Realm of Martial Art.
These days, Su Lingxiu was in a state of settling her understanding, should be close to comprehending it clearly.
"What divine skills would the breakthrough of Dan-yi Martial Art bring me?"
The uniqueness of Dan-yi Martial Art will certainly give birth to unique divine skills.
"Will it bring a longer life span? Or a divine skill to recover from injuries?"
Li Xuan was guessing in his heart.
With increased strength, his mood was greatly uplifted.
While in high spirits, he took the initiative to guide Shi'er, Meng Shushu, and Zhou Ying in their cultivation, imparting the Martial Art techniques.
With just a wave of his hand, the power of Heaven and Earth Laws began to gather.
"Try to understand it well."
Without a care, he threw the gathered Heaven and Earth Laws power to Moon Changming.
Even though it was only a strand, the Heaven and Earth Laws power was unlike any law aura, it was far superior.
Moon Changming was beyond thrilled. After receiving that strand of Heaven and Earth Laws power, he felt his Divine Soul transform, even experiencing a sense of tearing.
In addition, he sensed the existence of Heaven and Earth Laws.
"Thank you, senior, for the opportunity!"
Moon Changming bowed in gratitude and excitement.
Immediately afterward, he hastened to continue his cultivation, while understanding and refining this strand of Heaven and Earth Laws power.
Such a great opportunity!
Moon Changming believed that once he refined this strand of Heaven and Earth Laws power, even the Transcendent Spirit Sect might not have anyone to match him!

chapters.title: Chapter 590 - 318: An Exalted Gives Opportunity, Wu Tianan Pays Respects_1
chapters.content:
Cai Ling'er, who was brewing Spiritual Tea for Li Xuan while standing by, was visibly shocked. With a casual wave of her hand, she was able to harness and shape the power of Heaven and Earth Laws?
That was the power of Heaven and Earth Laws!
Looking at Moon Changming, a look of envy crossed her face.
Fortune comes with seeing a master. Is her own fortune too weak?
While she envied, she dared not demand!
Feeling good, Li Xuan took a sip of his tea, and only then did he remember that he hadn't bestowed any opportunity upon Cai Ling'er yet.
He was a master in high spirits, ready to grant opportunity, wouldn't it be remiss to overlook this?
Moreover, the girl Cai Ling'er had been serving him diligently lately.
Lifting his hand, he formed a strand of Heaven and Earth Laws power, scrutinized her, and shook his head saying, "You are still too weak."
Releasing his grip slightly, the power of the Heaven and Earth Laws became extremely faint.
Only then did he hand it to Cai Ling'er.
Cai Ling'er could only withstand this faint strand of Heaven and Earth Laws. Otherwise, at her level that still hadn't even begun to condense the aura of the Heaven and Earth Laws, it would be impossible to withstand it.
Overwhelmed with excitement, Cai Ling'er knelt and expressed her heartfelt thanks, "Thank you, Master, for bestowing this to me."
She regretted her own weakness, that she couldn't even withstand great opportunities!
"Mmm, study and comprehend it well."
Li Xuan nodded in approval.
Cai Ling'er transferred the strand of Heaven and Earth Laws into her Divine Soul. Suddenly, she felt a striking pain. Her sight blurred and it felt as though her Divine Soul was on the verge of failing under the pressure.
She hurriedly found a place to sit cross-legged, then took out the Soul Nourishing Pill that she received from Su Lingxiu and swallowed it, only then did she begin to understand and refine this strand of Heaven and Earth Laws' power.
Li Xuan was so happy that he was even considering humming a tune. However, to maintain his poise as a wise mentor, he suppressed his urge to hum out loud.
"Who else will come to visit this wise one? To see a master is to have great fortune, isn't it?"
Li Xuan murmured to himself.
At the moment, he was in a good mood, so anyone who came to see him was certain to receive a bit of good luck.
Now, those who come to seek medicine do not count!
They are not here to visit him!
Fang Hao abruptly walked over and reported:" Master, someone wishes to visit you."
Puzzled, Li Xuan wondered to himself who would want to visit him?
There were no friends in the Ling Domain. Even in the Inner Domain, not everyone could visit a master like him.
Xie Tianheng?
The first person that came to his mind was Xie Tianheng, who just entered the Ling Domain. However, he soon dismissed that thought. Since Xie Tianheng was one of his disciples in Sword Dao, he would just visit him directly if he were arriving.
"Who wishes to visit this master?"
Li Xuan casually asked while savoring his tea.
"Yu Gao messaged me that a man claiming to be Dean Wu Tianan of the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy was guided by the big senior brother to find the Yuzhou Alliance. He wishes to visit you, Master," Fang Hao said, holding up the Communication Talisman.
The dean of the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy?
Since he was directed by his eldest disciple, it wouldn't hurt to meet him. He had just made a breakthrough and was in a great mood. Anyone visiting him at this time was certainly remarkably fortunate.
If one meets a master, they are blessed after all.
"Let him come then," Li Xuan agreed with a nod.
"I will send a message to Yu Gao immediately and ask him to convey this message to the visitor," Fang Hao affirmed with a nod.
"Mmm."
Li Xuan nodded, and Fang Hao moved on to work on creating the Flying Boat.
"The dean of the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy and Moon Changming was once the famed individual of the Ten Thousand Stars, so they are somewhat old acquaintances, isn't it?"
The Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy was ruined, yet their dean managed to survive, attesting to his formidable strength.
Wu Tianan was puzzled at learning about the location of Xu Yan's master at Luo State's Chang Qing Pavilion. Rumor had it that the widely-renowned miraculous Elixir Doctor was Xu Yan's master.
Even the foundation of a martial artist can be restored, it was truly miraculous!
He hurried toward the Chang Qing Pavilion. The distance was great and the journey could be long.
"How is it?"
From the Chang Qing Pavilion, Li Xuan looked at Moon Changming and asked.
"Junior has almost completely refined the strand of Heaven and Earth Laws yet, but a little more time is still required for full refinement," Moon Changming respectfully responded.
"The fact that you were able to wield this strand of Heaven and Earth Laws in such a short period implies you have exceptional talent," Li Xuan nodded approvingly.
Despite Moon Changming's damaged spiritual body, he had managed to recover once again, displaying traits similar to a phoenix's rebirth.
The talent of a spiritual body was indeed extraordinary. Its close connection to Heaven and Earth Laws was far superior compared to other martial artists.
Cai Ling'er was, of course, not short on talent. A descendant of the royal bloodline of the Sea Spirit Tribe, she simply hasn't activated it. She was not as advanced as Moon Changming, hence it required more time to refine the strand of Heaven and Earth Laws' power.
"Thanks entirely to your grant of opportunity, Senior. Otherwise, Changming wouldn't have been able to achieve what he did," Moon Changming expressed his gratitude.
"Dean Wu Tianan of the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy will be paying a visit soon. He's technically an acquaintance of yours. You can take care of the hosting duty when the time comes," Li Xuan, after some thought, said.
Moon Changming was surprised, "The dean didn't die?"
"Do you believe he's dead?" Li Xuan quirked an eyebrow.
"When the academy suffered a mutiny, it was reported that the dean was severely poisoned and suffered a sneak attack. His injuries were serious, plus being attacked by the former master of the Thousand Martial Hall, his life was hanging by a thread and the rumors indicated his death," Moon Changming said seriously.
Impressed inwardly, Li Xuan thought this Wu Tianan was no simple person. After surviving such catastrophic experiences and reappearing, plus visiting him, it seemed like Wu Tianan was really lucky.
"I see," Li Xuan responded with a nod.
Moon Changming curiously asked,"Senior, do you know the dean?"
"I do not!"
Li Xuan shook his head and replied, "Xu Yan directed him to visit me. I have some spare time at the moment, so I decided to meet him."

chapters.title: Chapter 591 - 318: An Exalted Gives Opportunity, Wu Tianan Pays Respects_2
chapters.content:
Moon Changming suddenly realized: how could the headmaster possibly know such a transcendent figure? He had esteemed the headmaster far too highly.
"This is Chang Qing Pavilion."
Finally, Wu Tiannan arrived at Chang Qing Pavilion. He watched martial artists lining up to the Pavilion for treatment, they were all seriously injured, some even suffered foundational damages or hard-to-heal old wounds.
After all, the medical fee of Chang Qing Pavilion was not cheap, not a place to seek treatment for minor injuries.
Wu Tiannan took a deep breath and walked towards Chang Qing Pavilion. He was slightly nervous. What kind of powerhouse could Xu Yan's master be?
A transcendent being?
He could hardly imagine!
"Impossible, absolutely impossible, I've never heard of anyone transcending the heavens and the earth."
Wu Tiannan kept reassuring himself.
However, deep down he found himself hoping Xu Yan wasn't lying. If it was true, this journey would be worthwhile.
"Wu Tiannan humbly requests an audience with... senior!"
Wu Tiannan took a deep breath, lowered his posture, and addressed the figure as a senior.
"Come in."
A steady voice called out.
"Thank you!"
Wu Tiannan stepped into Chang Qing Pavilion.
"Headmaster, it's really you!"
Suddenly, a voice full of surprise sounded.
Wu Tiannan looked up and said incredulously, "You are... Moon Changming?"
It took him quite a while to recognize the person in front of him was Moon Changming, the once proud student of his martial arts school.
"It's me!"
At this moment, Moon Changming's eyes were filled with tears.
"You... have reached this stage in your cultivation."
Wu Tiannan was shocked beyond belief.
Then he felt it made perfect sense, "Worthy of being one of the top prodigies of my martial arts school, your spiritual body is truly extraordinary. It's not surprising to see your progress over such a long time!"
Moon Changming, however, felt ashamed and said, "The Headmaster doesn't know everything. I was barely surviving until recently when the senior granted me an opportunity, and I made this accomplishment."
On hearing this, Wu Tiannan was once again shocked. He cast a glance at Moon Changming, then shifted his gaze to the young man sitting leisurely on a chair in the yard, holding a book in his hand.
At the sight of him, Wu Tiannan was taken aback, his eyes full of reverence.
Mysterious, majestic, as if seated in the midst of time, yet seemingly not part of this world, the more he looked, the more mysterious and unpredictable the man seemed!
Superior being!
An unparalleled superior being!
Suddenly, he somewhat believed Xu Yan's words, his master was indeed a supernatural being.
He couldn't waste any more time chatting with Moon Changming. He walked up to Li Xuan and bowed respectfully, "Wu Tiannan pays respects to the senior!"
"Hmm, sit. No need to be formal."
Li Xuan nodded.
"Thank you, senior!"
Wu Tiannan carefully sat on the chair, taking only half of it. He was slightly stiff and did not dare to look directly at this superior being.
Li Xuan withdrew his mysterious aura, and at this moment, he appeared perfectly ordinary.
He silently appreciated his mysterious aura. It was really useful!
Moon Changming came over and poured Wu Tiannan a cup of Spiritual Tea. He began to catch up with Wu Tiannan and asked about the headmaster's experiences over the years.
Wu Tiannan also slowly started narrating some old stories and his experiences over the years. Talking to Moon Changming eased his tension and provided him an opportunity to inform the senior about his journey indirectly.
"Wu Tiannan, quite capable!"
The moment Wu Tiannan walked in, Li Xuan had already discerned his cultivation level. The All Ages Alliance could stand tall, resisting the blows of the Transcendent Spirit Sect, probably greatly due to Wu Tiannan.
Even if Moon Changming had assimilated that wisp of the Heavenly Earth Law's power, he was still not Wu Tiannan's match.
Inside Wu Tiannan, nine strands of Heavenly Earth Law's essences were refining. If that were it, the power of heaven and earth condensed by his nine essences would merely be on par with the power Moon Changming acquired by refining the wisp of Heavenly Earth Law's power.
But each of Wu Tiannan's nine Heavenly Earth Law's essences harbored a power of the law. Although each essence's power was weaker than the wisp bestowed upon Moon Changming, he possessed nine strands of such powers.
"He is pretty good at hiding."
Li Xuan muttered in his heart. It seemed Wu Tiannan was quite a cunning guy as well.
Hiding the power of laws without revealing it, he must have suffered a great loss in the past, thus, hiding his true strength as much as possible, leading his enemies to underestimate his real power.
"Already at the summit of the Spirit Realm!"
Li Xuan sighed, Wu Tianan has cultivated to this point, which is already the limit of the Spirit Realm.
The next realm is where the nine paths of law aura are all transformed into laws and then merged into one, refining the aura of the Heaven and Earth Laws into the body.
Obviously, this step cannot be taken within the Spirit Realm.
The reason for this is nothing more than that the Heavenly Earth Lingji of the Spirit Realm is insufficient to support a martial artist's true understanding of the Heaven and Earth Laws and truly refining the aura of the Heaven and Earth Laws into their body.
Wu Tianan is also narrating his own experiences. After the collapse of the Wanjing Martial Dao Academy, the residual power fled to the Azure Sea, and a new Martial Dao Academy was eventually established in the Azure Sea city of Yuntian.
The City Lord of YunTian Azure Sea City had a good relationship with Wu Tianan. While the city belongs to the Transcendent Spirit Sect, it only rules over the Azure Sea and coexists with the Sea Spirit Tribe. Therefore, it does not have the strict hierarchy of the Eighteen States.
"After my covert cultivation, I have reached the limit of the Spirit Realm. The Refining God Heavenly Man condenses Divine Soul, and after condensing the Divine Soul, it is the fusion of the Heavenly Earth Lingji into the Divine Soul..."
Wu Tianan started to recount his martial arts insights. It seems that he is explaining it to Moon Changming, but in fact, he is recounting his martial arts queries at this opportunity.
After Refining God Heavenly Man's cultivation, it is divided into the fusion of Heavenly Earth Lingji into the Divine Soul. Generally speaking, refining nine strands of Heavenly Earth Lingji is the limit, and then nine strands of Heavenly Earth Lingji are combined into one to condense the aura of the Heaven and Earth Laws.
After condensing the nine Heavenly Earth Laws, the next step is to condense the power of the Heaven and Earth laws.
However, typically, after condensing the nine Heavenly Earth Laws, it is almost the pinnacle, and it is hard to break through again because the Heavenly Earth Lingji is not enough to support the condensation of the power of the Heaven and Earth laws.
"In the Azure Sea, I comprehended a more active Heavenly Earth Lingji in a certain relic, and thus, after condensing nine of the Heavenly Earth Laws, I concealed the nine strands of Heavenly Earth Laws within the aura of the Heavenly Earth Laws.
"But I can't integrate into one, which is not enough to support my continued progress."
Wu Tianan sighed.
Moon Changming also sighed incessantly. The cultivation of each stage is extremely difficult, in addition to needing refining methods, there must be enough talent.
As for the strength of spirit-body prodigies, it lies in their closeness to the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, their closeness to the Heavenly Earth Lingji, making it easier to comprehend and consolidate the Heavenly Earth Lingji, and easier to understand the Heaven and Earth laws.
Moon Changming also understood the purpose of Wu Tianan's visit to see his senior, he wanted to find a way to move forward.
"Even the head of the academy can't continue to break through, let alone other martial artists."
Moon Changming sighed.
"The secret of the Transcendent Spirit Sect should have this approach, I think it has something to do with the Divine Bridge."
Wu Tianan also recounted some secrets he knew, such as the existence of a Divine Bridge. Of course, he only knew about the existence of the Divine Bridge and that ascending the Divine Bridge might provide an opportunity to break through.
However, the specifics of the Divine Bridge are unknown to him, this is the core secret of the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
Even though he has a good relationship with the City Lord of Yuntian Azure Sea City, the latter is unwilling to talk about this secret.
"Divine Bridge? The another space linked to Taicang heaven and earth?"
Li Xuan thought to himself.
No matter the Inner Domain, or the Spirit Realm, they all belong to Taicang.
And Taicang is clearly not only the Inner Domain and the Spirit Realm.
"Why does Taicang divide the heaven and earth into separate regions? There must be some secrets hidden."
Li Xuan speculated in his heart.
Of course, these secrets are not strongly attractive to him. After all, the martial arts he has founded belongs to him and is not a Taicang martial arts, hence it won't be restricted by the Heavenly Earth Lingji.
"The competition of prodigies has to do with this. I forced the Thousand Martial Hall, the Lei Yun Mountain Manor, and the Yu Ling Mansion to accept the rules. When the Divine Bridge opens, I will ascend the Divine Bridge.
"One, is to break through myself; two, is to look for someone."
Moon Changming was shocked and asked, "Headmaster, who are you looking for?"
"My martial arts guide."
Wu Tianan, his expression full of reminiscence, said, "I, Wu Tianan, came from a poor mountain village in the Inner Domain, step by step to the peak of the Spirit Realm, all because of the guidance of my sister."
Li Xuan was shocked, Wu Tianan, this guy, actually came from the Inner Domain?
"The ancestor of Seven-star Study Palace?"
He immediately thought of Wu Tianan's identity.
"Headmaster came from the Inner Domain?"
Moon Changming exclaimed.
"Yes!"
Wu Tianan nodded, and then talked about his childhood experiences and his rise in the Inner Domain.
Su Lingxiu, who had been quietly listening, couldn't help but come over and sit next to Li Xuan, her eyes wide open, looking up and down at Wu Tianan.
They're both from the Inner Domain.
Furthermore, he's the founding ancestor of Seven-star Study Palace, a legendary figure!

chapters.title: Chapter 592 - 319 Evergreen Divine Fire, Bone Transformation_1
chapters.content:
Li Xuan admired inwardly, Wu Tianan was indeed someone with great fortune.
A country boy rescued a beautiful, powerful woman and set off on the path of martial arts under her guidance. He rose all the way, establishing the Seven-star Study Palace and taking charge of the Ten Thousand Star Martial Arts Institute in the Spirit Realm.
Although he was defeated in the initial fierce competition, he rose again, cultivating to the pinnacle of the Spirit Realm. Furthermore, when he was good-spirited after breaking through physical martial arts into divine skills, he came to pay his respects to me.
Such a blessed person.
After recounting his martial arts journey, Wu Tianan expressed his current dilemma - he can't continue to cultivate. He can't refine the Heavenly Earth Law into his body.
This was the reason for his visit.
Li Xuan spoke calmly, "Grand Azure Martial Dao is limited by the heavenly earth mechanism. The spirit realm has such a limit on the spirit mechanism. Gathering the power of rules is already the real limit. It is impossible to refine the Heavenly Earth Law into your body."
Wu Tianan was stunned. The great master was not describing the Spiritual Realm Martial Arts, but the Grand Azure Martial Dao!
"Senior, how can I break through this constraint?"
Wu Tianan asked respectfully.
"Go beyond the Spirit Realm. Just like the journey from the Inner Domain to the Spirit Realm, Taicang is also like this."
Li Xuan said calmly.
The words couldn't be said too directly. As an elder, one's words must always convey a sense of profound, thought-provoking meaning.
Wu Tianan murmured to himself, "Beyond the Spirit Realm, from the Inner Domain to the Spirit Realm, the Divine Bridge!"
At this moment, he thought of the Divine Bridge. Perhaps that was the bridge to the outside of the Spirit Realm.
Li Xuan continued, "Of course, it's not that there's no way at all. It's just that for you, the difficulty is too great."
After thinking for a bit, he reached out and grabbed the materials for artifact refining used by Fang Hao, and they flew into his hands.
In a blink of an eye, a thin piece of spiritual paper appeared in his hand. It was refined from those materials and used to carry the power of the Heavenly Earth Law.
Then he raised his hand again, the power of Heavenly Earth Law gathered, and he traced a few strokes on the spiritual paper.
A few Heavenly Earth Laws drawn by the power of Heavenly Earth Law were imprinted on the paper. These few laws corresponded to the laws of the Blue Sky and Earth.
If you could comprehend the law on this spirit paper, you could use it as a foundation, break through the shackles, refine the Heavenly Earth Law into your body, and break the limit of the Spirit Realm.
However, achieving this was not something could be done within a short period of time.
Since Wu Tianan had come to see him, as a wise man, he would give him this chance.
"This is one of the Heavenly Earth Laws. If you can comprehend it fully, you can use it as a foundation and refine the corresponding Heavenly Earth Law."
With a wave of his hand, Li Xuan sent the spiritual paper to Wu Tianan.
Wu Tianan was extremely excited. He humbly accepted the spiritual paper with both hands and said, "Thank you for your guidance, senior!"
Li Xuan lifted his tea cup and tasted the spiritual tea, and said indifferently, "It's your good fortune to be directed to me by my great disciple."
If it hadn't been for Xu Yan guiding Wu Tianan to him, and that he had just broken through and was in a very good mood, he wouldn't be so generous to give Wu Tianan this opportunity.
Wu Tianan inwardly marveled, Xu Yan was right. Meeting a wise person was indeed remarkably fortunate!
Today was indeed his lucky day!
After paying his respects, he and Moon Changming went to a quiet place to meditate.
At the one glance, he was deeply shocked. It seemed as though there were Heavenly Earth Laws operating on the spiritual paper, which were profoundly mysterious and hard to comprehend.
Moon Changming took a look, realized that he was still far from understanding the real Heavenly Earth Law, and continued to refine his strand of Heavenly Earth Law power.
Wu Tianan sat cross-legged, the spirit paper placed on his knee. His divine soul power observed minutely, as though he had fallen into a profound state of mind.
It was as if he was seeing the operation of the rules of Heaven and Earth, which were hard to comprehend and hard to enlighten.
"This Wu Tianan is not bad."
Li Xuan glanced at him, then lost interest.
Without a doubt, Wu Tianan's talent was very strong. Although he wasn't a divine body talent, he had reached the pinnacle of the Spirit Realm. In addition to his fortune, his comprehension skills were indispensable.
The Chang Qing Pavilion did not change in any way just because Wu Tianan was there. In fact, Wu Tianan was always in a neglected corner, contemplating the Heavenly Earth Law on the spiritual paper.
Li Xuan continued to delve into and memorize the patterns on the tenth page of the Book of Tai Cang.
"Your disciple Meng Chong has broken through to the second level of the Indestructible Golden Body of the Big Day. Your power has increased a hundredfold!"
Meng Chong had broken through to the Divine Origin Realm.
"I've become stronger again!"
Li Xuan was excited.
His physical strength had increased a hundredfold. He didn't need to operate his cultivation technique with just physical brute force. A light punch could blow up a martial artist like Wu Tianan.
"That girl Su Lingxiu is about to break through, too."
Li Xuan was full of anticipation.
"Your disciple Meng Chong has sublimated and transformed into a Vajra Divine Body. You have obtained the Innate Earthly Vajra Divine Body."
Meng Chong had successfully transformed into a Divine Body.
Just a few days after Meng Chong's breakthrough, news came that Meng Chong had brutally killed an old fellow from the Thousand Martial Hall, and like Xu Yan, he had gone to Dachuan.
The Thousand Martial Hall was furious, swore to kill Xu Yan and Meng Chong, and sent another powerful fighter to Dachuan to hunt down the two.
Li Xuan shook his head, these elders of the Thousand Martial Hall did not have much time left. They were going to become stepping stones.
Given the speed of Xu Yan and Meng Chong's strength improvement, it wouldn't take long for martial artists who had refined the Heavenly Earth Lingji to become no match for them.
"My God Martial True Body has increased again"
Li Xuan found out that his God Martial True Body had now increased to nine. And once the nine were combined, his God Martial True Body would reach a higher level.

chapters.title: Chapter 593 - 319: Evergreen Divine Fire, Bone Rebirth_2
chapters.content:
"The inner domain's Dahua Martial Arts are developing faster and faster, with a million Dahua martial artists on the horizon."
Although, a million Dahua martial artists in the inner domain are really nothing, but these million Dahua martial artists, are just a beginning.
Moreover, they are all strong practitioners from the inner domain who have started to cultivate Dahua Martial Arts.
As the number of Dahua martial artists increases, the Dahua Martial Arts spread wider, and with this trend, Inner Realm Martial Arts will eventually be phased out."
"The highest level of the Inner Domain's Dahua Martial Arts Techniques is the Divine Origin Realm, only mastered by Xu Junhe, and it's still early for him to break the Divine Origin Realm."
Martial arts techniques with an upper limit of Divine Origin Realm are already not low in the inner domain.
If you want to see a martial artist at the Divine Origin Realm, it would probably take a very long time, although the Dahua Martial Arts are not limited by the Heavenly Earth Lingji, after all, the nature's spiritual energy in the inner domain is relatively thin, so the speed of cultivation naturally slows down.
And Divine Origin Realm, even the ordinary Divine Origin Realm martial artists, their strength will not be weaker than Refining God Heavenly Man.
Dahua Martial Arts have thus taken a step further beyond the Grand Azure Martial Dao.
"The day when the Inner Domain is full of Dahua Martial Artists, I, the Grand Ancestor of Dahua Martial Arts, might have truly transcended Heaven and Earth."
Li Xuan sighs in lament.
"Your disciple, Su Lingxiu, has comprehended the divine technique of alchemy and martial arts, you have broken the Divine Skill Realm in Alchemy."
The Daoist Golden Book opens above the soul pedestal, bursting with golden light.
Su Lingxiu has comprehended the Divine Techniques of the Divine Skill Realm.
With the breakthrough in Alchemy, Li Xuan feels a continuous life force, his lifespan seems endless, and life never dries up.
"You have broken through the Divine Skill Realm in Alchemy, you have obtained the Divine Skill of the Divine Furnace of Ten Thousand Dao."
The first divine technique of Alchemy has been born.
The Divine Furnace of Ten Thousand Dao, the ten thousand dao becomes a god furnace, which can refine elixirs and can also melt all things. With a wave of your hand, the divine furnace covers everything, melting all objects.
This is both an Alchemy Divine Skill and a Mortal Combat Divine Skill.
"Good, the divine version of the Heaven and Earth God Furnace Alchemy technique, refining elixirs is just a thought away. If the strength is strong enough, you can directly extract the Heaven and Earth Laws to refine it into an elixir."
Li Xuan is very excited in his heart.
The Divine Furnace of Ten Thousand Dao almost upgrades the Alchemy to the strongest level. As long as the power is strong enough, refining Heaven and Earth into an elixir is not impossible.
"With my current strength, I can extract a strand of Heaven and Earth Law as the main material and refine it into an elixir."
The Heaven and Earth Laws as the main material to refine the elixir, will enhance the comprehension of the Heaven and Earth Laws and enhance the talent of the law.
"You have broken the Divine Skill Realm in Alchemy, you have obtained the Divine Skill Long Qing Divine Fire!"
The second Divine Technique of Alchemy has been born.
Li Xuan sees on his soul pedestal, a faint blue flame is burning, gradually getting stronger, like a small bonfire.
This is not a real flame, the Divine Techniques of the Divine Skill Realm can be seen as the manifestation of a martial artist's laws.
Therefore, this Long Qing Divine Fire is in fact a God Fire derived from a certain law, its power and growth potential are far more than the real flame can compare.
"Long Qing Divine Fire, it has no temperature, it's not a burning fire..."
Above the soul pedestal, a faint blue flame is burning, jumping slightly, without any feeling of temperature.
It also lacks strong burning power, only endless vitality, as if this is a flame of life.
Long Qing Divine Fire is indeed a fire of life, it can give life, but it can also devour life!
It seems to have no temperature, lacks the power of burning, but the burning way of Long Qing Divine Fire is just different from the normal flame.
Its fierceness lies in the melting of life, burning of life, devouring of life.
Any creature, once tainted, can hardly extinguish.
The flame will not extinguish as long as life remains, until the person's life is burned and completely devoured.
The Long Qing Divine Fire can also give life. Even a person on the verge of death, a strand of Long Qing Divine Fire can give them life and extend their lifespan.
Even if a strand of Long Qing Divine Fire is given to another person, as long as the god fire does not extinguish, life will not perish!
This is a Divine Flame unique to the Alchemy martial Dao.
"It's powerful!"
Li Xuan is very excited, Alchemy is not known for its strength, but the divine techniques he has born are not weak in terms of killing power.
This is probably related to him, not being a purely alchemy martial artist.
Of course, it is also because he is the founder of Alchemy, and has the halo of this level, that such powerful Divine Techniques have been born.
"The physical Martial Arts brought me three Divine Skills, and the Alchemy Martial Arts should also bring me three Divine Skills."
Li Xuan was looking forward to what the third divine skill would be.
It must also be related to the characteristics of Alchemy Martial Arts.
"The Divine Furnace of Ten Thousand Dao can refine elixirs, Evergreen Divine Fire is the fire of life. It can bestow life, but also burn and devour life.
"What characteristic will the third divine skill have?"
Li Xuan looked at the Soul Pedestal above, the Evergreen Divine Fire had been completely born, the third divine skill should have been born too.
"Upon breaking through the Divine Skill Realm with your Alchemy Martial Arts, you obtain the divine skill Resurrection From Bone!"
The third divine skill, Resurrection From Bone!
Li Xuan was extremely shocked. This was completely beyond his expectations. This divine skill was so incredible.
Resurrection From Bone is a divine skill that can bring the dead back to life!
Even a single bone can be resurrected!
Of course, a cultivator at the divine skill realm cannot perform resurrection from bone. However, Resurrection From Bone is the most powerful aspect of this divine skill.
"Even though I can't make bones come back to life, if the death is recent, I can indeed bring them back to life."
Li Xuan murmured in his heart.
"As long as I'm strong enough to deploy this divine skill, I can even resurrect from bones. This is incredibly powerful and unthinkable.
"But possibly, I need to truly transcend heaven and earth to achieve this.
"And, maybe, the stronger the original power of the bones, the greater the resistance to resurrection, the more difficult it is?"
Li Xuan was greatly shocked by this third divine skill.
The divine skill Resurrection From Bone can resurrect both others and oneself.
But there's only one chance.
At the time of falling, deploying this divine skill on oneself could indeed resurrect from death. But once resurrected, this divine skill will enter a dormant state.
"If I use Resurrection From Bone with Rebirth By A Thought, I can reduce the consumption of Resurrection From Bone. After resurrection, the divine skill will not become dormant.
"This is an absolutely perfect combo, equivalent to having multiple lives."
The more he thought about it, the more Li Xuan was amazed by the power of Resurrection From Bone.
"With this divine skill, I don't have to fear any injuries. Even if I'm severely injured by an enemy, I can recover instantly with this divine skill.
"If I can resurrect from death, what's the fuss about severe injuries?"
At this moment, Li Xuan has unprecedented confidence.
"I shouldn't be complacent. Tai Cang probably still has very powerful beings. For example, the person who wrote the Book of Tai Cang, who could depict the Tai Cang Heaven and Earth Laws, must be incredibly powerful.
"I am only invincible in the Ling Domain right now, but I should be far from being invincible in Tai Cang.
"If I'm not transcending heaven and earth, I can't be truly invincible in Tai Cang."
Li Xuan took a deep breath, warning himself in his heart not to be complacent and arrogant.
No matter how wonderful a divine skill is, if your cultivation realm is too low, it can still be shattered.
"The Resurrection From Bone is such a miraculous divine skill. I must find a way to create a similar divine skill.
"The true Great Divine Power, cultivating this divine skill, is equivalent to having an extra life."
Li Xuan had one more divine skill he needed to create. A divine skill similar to Rebirth By A Thought, which regenerated flesh and blood, plus a divine skill similar to Resurrection From Bone which revived the dead.
The Resurrection From Bone can be used to save people, but the technique to be created does not necessarily have to have the power to save people.
It just needs to have the ability to resurrect oneself.
However, creating such a divine skill is indeed not easy, even though he already has the Resurrection From Bone as a reference.
"With these powerful divine skills, only Xu Yan might be able to comprehend and cultivate them.
"However, if it's related to the physical path, Meng Chong can also do it. The comprehension ability of these two disciples is monstrous, only slightly worse than Xu Yan."
Li Xuan was filled with excitement, and momentarily put down the tenth page of the Book of Tai Cang, focusing all his thoughts on creating divine skills.
While he had inspiration and divine skills as a reference, it felt easier to create, and more logically grounded.
"What should I call this divine skill? I need to think about it."
Li Xuan took a deep breath, and created the initial theory of the divine skill. He would slowly perfect it. It would take some time, after all, it was such a powerful and profound divine skill.

chapters.title: Chapter 594 - 320: The Origin of Su Lingxiu, Tang Jinyan's Guess_1
chapters.content:
Li Xuan shifted his attention from the Book of Tai Cang to the Divine Skill Martial Code, and by now, he had drafted several Small Divine Powers.
As for the Great Divine Powers, temporarily, none of them had been created yet.
However, two major Divine Powers like "Rebirth in a Thought" and "Regeneration from Bones" had begun to take shape in theory. It was just a matter of time before they were fleshed out.
