"These Great Divine Powers should be as perfect as possible, and the difficulty in understanding and practicing them should be reduced as far as possible, which can ensure they can definitely be understood and practiced."
Li Xuan mumbled to himself.
However, he also knew that the more powerful the Martial Arts, the higher the difficulty in understanding them. It would be hard to reduce the difficulty.
If the difficulty is really lowered too much, it will, on the contrary, make the power of the Martial Arts seem insufficient.
Su Lingxiu began preparations for her breakthrough to the Divine Origin Realm. Unless something unexpected occurs, Su Lingxiu would also transform into a Divine Body.
"Three Martial Arts have already reached the Divine Skill Realm. Strange Martial Arts are a bit behind, but it's no big deal."
Strange Martial Art training is, to begin with, different from the others, and it involves Formations, prohibitions, natural oddities and the like. These strange Martial Art methods would increase their power with the increase in strength.
Li Xuan could set up a formation equivalent to the Divine Skill Realm.
The Chang Qing Pavilion had Martial Artists seeking treatment every day. From the Loose Cultivators to the Spirit Sect families, everyone was represented.
Although the daily treatment quota was limited, for those Martial Artists who were severely injured, plagued by old wounds, or even those whose foundations were damaged, this was an opportunity to change their fate, and naturally, they would not give up.
Li Xuan suddenly noticed that Meng Shushu was secretly chatting with the Martial Artists who came for treatment, intentionally or unintentionally mentioning a name.
It seemed he was trying to inquire about a certain person.
The Martial Artists that Meng Shushu was asking were all from the Spirit Sect or families. After all, the information that the Spirit Sect and family Martial Artists could obtain, and some secrets they could discover, were incomparable to those of the Loose Cultivators.
"I heard of a Martial Artist named Mu Qianliu who seems to be quite talented, handsome and healthy. Is it true? Have you heard of him?"
Meng Shushu asked curiously.
"Mu Qianliu?"
The Spirit Sect Warrior was a bit surprised, looking at Meng Shushu with astonishment. Why was this person bringing up Mu Qianliu?
However, this guy was from the Chang Qing Pavilion and in charge of distributing the pills, he couldn't be offended. If he played his cards correctly and pleased him, maybe he would get an extra pill.
"The Mu Qianliu you're talking about should be the most eligible bachelor of the Mu Family, right? His abilities are indeed strong, he possesses natural talent and his handsome appearance is notable."
The Mu Family's most eligible bachelor was indeed famous, especially in Luo State.
"Eligible bachelor?"
Meng Shushu was puzzled and asked, "Why do they call him the eligible bachelor?"
The Warrior had a strange look on his face. If Meng Shushu knew of Mu Qianliu's name, why didn't he know the origin of Mu family's most eligible bachelor?
In the Ling Domain, and even in Luo State, few people might know the name Mu Qianliu, but almost everybody knew of the Mu Family's most eligible bachelor.
"He's a notorious ladies' man, didn't you know that?"
The warrior said in surprise.
Meng Shushu was a bit stunned, and he seemed taken aback. He took a deep breath and said, "Describe it a bit, how does he attract women?"
"This is a long story..."
The warrior coughed dryly, his face slightly pale, clearly his old injuries hadn't healed yet.
Meng Shushu shoved a pill into his hand.
Among all the Spirit Sect family warriors he had asked, only the person in front of him seemed to know Mu Qianliu. The rest could only guess that he was probably of the Mu Family's lineage.
The warrior was immediately overjoyed. He pocketed the pill and began to recount tales of Mu Qianliu's charm, how he owed many emotional debts, and what kind of troubles ensued.
Of course, the warrior also admired the exceptional talent of the Mu family's most eligible bachelor. He was already at the peak of God Refining, and might even be on the threshold of reaching the Extreme Realm.
Meng Shushu was in a daze.
The image of a certain person collapsed in his heart, and he felt a bit uncomfortable for a while.
"Brother Mu is such a person!"
Images of the past suddenly flashed before him. Who would've thought that Brother Mu, who had a graceful and extraordinary demeanor and was well-loved by countless beauties, was also a womanizing scoundrel?
Every time he thought of the scene where a graceful and beautiful woman affectionately clung to Mu Qianliu, he felt indignant. What he had thought was a match made in heaven turned out to be based on deception.
He was just one of many women in Mu Qianliu's life
For a while, Meng Shushu was in a daze, like a soulless body. He turned around and was about to leave when suddenly, he turned back and asked, "Where is Mu Qianliu?"
Although the warrior found Meng Shushu's reaction strange, he shook his head and answered, "I don't know, the Mu Family's most eligible bachelor has been missing for some time. There're rumors that he is hiding from his love debts, some say he's looking for a way to breakthrough to the Extreme Realm, and others claim he's off finding a new lover."
Meng Shushu was heartbroken. The image of that woman in his heart had completely collapsed.
Back at Chang Qing Pavilion, Meng Shushu looked downcast as he sat alone in a corner, lost in thought.
Li Xuan's mouth twitched as he finally understood. Meng Shushu had seen Su Lingxiu's father and knew he was from the Ling Domain.
Now he's looking for someone
"Mu Family's most eligible bachelor? Tsk, tsk, such a character. The Mu Feiming who was defeated by Xu Yan, could he be his son? Su Lingxiu's half-brother by the same father?"
Li Xuan didn't dwell on this. He didn't care about Su Lingxiu's background. Besides, these grudges could be settled by Su Lingxiu herself.
Whether she would acknowledge that man as her father was Su Lingxiu's own business.

chapters.title: Chapter 595 - 320: The Origin of Su Lingxiu, Tang Jinyan's Guess_2
chapters.content:
Of course, as a disciple of his own, she definitely should not be bullied by others.
Even if he, the master, does not make a stand, Xu Yan and Meng Chong, her two senior brothers, would stand up for her, including her junior brother Fang Hao.
The daily consultation period of the Chang Qing Pavilion ended, the gate closed, and Shi'er went on with his bitter cultivation.
Zhou Ying found Meng Shushu, who was sitting in the corner and lost in thought.
These days, Meng Shushu had been shuttling through the queue of patients, she had been watching this and had guessed a bit.
"Meng Shushu, do you know the identity of the young master?"
Zhou Ying asked telepathically.
Meng Shushu looked up at her, his expression complex. He sighed and said, "Let's not mention him."
"You really do know!"
Zhou Ying frowned.
"Tell me, what exactly did you find out?"
Meng Shushu was silent for a while, then asked, "Did Sister Su instruct you on anything?"
Zhou Ying knitted her brows, staring at Meng Shushu for a good while.
"Why are you looking at me like that? I've been calling her that since I was a child. Even though my dad beat me and told me to call her aunt, I like to call her sister. Sister Su also accepts it. So, don't pull out these nonsense about generations not matching."
Meng Shushu said in dissatisfaction.
Zhou Ying thought for a while, then took out a jade token and said, "Miss instructed me that if there's any news from outside the Inner Domain, I can go out of the Inner Domain, or if a Martial Artist appears from outside the Inner Domain.
"You can leave the Inner Domain with this jade token."
As for this jade token, she already knew what it was. It's a Yu Ling token from the Spirit Sect royal family!
"Young Master, is he from the Mu Family of Luo State?"
Zhou Ying looked at the jade token and asked.
Meng Shushu nodded.
The Mu Family of Luo State, a superior royal family with extreme strength. It is rumored to master the secret technique of nurturing Spiritual Medicine and has a strong influence in the Ling Domain.
"What did you find out?"
Zhou Ying asked seriously.
"Brother Mu...he's a playboy."
Meng Shushu sighed, and then told Zhou Ying everything he had found out.
"The infamous playboy of the Mu Family..."
Zhou Ying's face looked bad. Did this mean that Miss had been deceived?
"Is the unseen mastermind behind Yinlou Pavilion the Mu Family?"
Zhou Ying suddenly thought of this issue.
Giving the Spirit Sect's family in Ling Domain's view of the Inner Domain, perhaps they wanted to erase the playboy's romantic affairs in the Inner Domain and the remaining bloodline for the sake of saving the Mu Family's face after learning that the Miss bore the bloodline of the Mu Family!
"I don't know!"
Meng Shushu shook his head: "However, I can confirm - it has nothing to do with Brother Mu."
"How can you be sure?"
Zhou Ying was extremely angry in her heart.
"Spiritual Medicine, Brother Mu left some Spiritual Medicine behind...for Sister Su's physical recuperation..."
Meng Shushu sighed.
Zhou Ying was silent for quite a while before asking again, "Should we tell Miss that her father is the playboy from the Mu Family?"
Meng Shushu shook his head and said: "I don't know, leave it to fate!"
He sighed and added, "Perhaps not knowing is also a good thing!"
Zhou Ying thought for a while, then nodded. Right now, Su Lingxiu was living happily. If she knew her origins and that she had such a debauched father, she might get upset again.
Meng Shushu and Zhou Ying decided to act as if nothing had happened, as if they knew nothing, and stopped inquiring about the playboy from the Mu Family.
Su Lingxiu broke through to the Divine Origin Realm.
"Your disciple, Su Lingxiu, has broken through to the Divine Origin Realm, your Changqing Divine Origin amplification increases by a hundredfold!"
As Su Lingxiu broke through, the final stage of Fang Hao's Flying Boat refinement truly began.
Boom!
A Flying Boat only about ten feet long, surrounded by purple lightning, with pavilions, dragons, and phoenix carvings, was suspended in front of them. Fang Hao was performing the final refinement.
Li Xuan glanced at it and nodded in satisfaction.
Wu Tianan awoke from his comprehension of the Heaven and Earth Laws, watched curiously from the side, and was shocked. This was some sort of divine skill.
Cai Ling'er felt the same.
"It's about to be successful!"
Su Lingxiu was thrilled.
She had also invested a lot of effort into this flying boat, especially in its design, to which she contributed numerous suggestions.
...
Shui Xing Palace, although currently a second-rate Spirit Sect, had once enjoyed its own grandeur. Even its present decline to a second-rate Spirit Sect didn't make it any less exceptional in Luo State.
It was rumored that the Palace Master of Shui Xing Palace would soon break through to the peak of the Refining God Heavenly Man realm.
The daughter of the Palace Master, Tang Jinyan, was the legitimate wife of Mu Family's playboy. Despite angrily returning to Shui Xing Palace, she still managed some affairs of the Mu Family, particularly dealing with the debts left by her philandering husband.
With her connection to Mu Family, a top-tier clan, no force in Luo State dared to provoke Shui Xing Palace. Furthermore, the playboy of the Mu Family was extraordinarily talented, rumored to have reached the level of the strongest.
No matter whether Mu Qianliu had feelings for his legitimate wife, Tang Jinyan, he was, after all, married to her. Who would dare show disrespect to a woman who might be the wife of a top-level power?
The Shui Xing Palace maintained its territory without any intention of external expansion. They seemed to only wish to carry on their legacy. Thus, no one targeted Shui Xing Palace anymore.
But Lady Tang Jinyan of the Mu Family was in a very bad mood.
Jiao Ming, Ping'er, and Grandma Jing went to the Inner Domain to capture the evil spawn, but there has been no news since then. Worse still, the Gate of Lingyu has been closed.
This indicated that the trio either died or decided to stay in the Inner Domain for good.
And the likelihood of them being dead was as high as 90 percent.
Tang Jinyan even felt a wave of panic, fearing that Mu Qianliu might have left means to protect the mother and daughter, resulting in the deaths of Jiao Ming, Ping'er, and Grandma Jing.
Bear in mind, Grandma Jing was in the realm of the Grand Heavenly Man.
She was once restless, fearing that this incident would anger Mu Qianliu, who might divorce her in his fury.
Mu Qianliu was too flirtatious and didn't harbor deep feelings for her. He merely married her, his legitimate wife, under the arrangement of the clan, stayed in the family as a trophy wife to shut the elders up.
Mu Qianliu was never homebound. Not long after their wedding, he left and never returned.
Mu Qianliu had no feelings for her, but Tang Jinyan adored him with all her heart. The more she thought that the lowly servant girl would only tarnish her husband's bloodline, the more she couldn't help desiring to remove those lowly beings that tarnished her husband.
After discreetly dealing with several women who had shared a night with her husband and finding that the elders of the Mu Family didn't care and her husband had lost contact, her guts gradually grew larger and her actions increasingly ruthless.
As a result, when a lowly woman came to the door of the Mu Family with a son, she was preparing to kill them.
What was annoying was that the son that the worthless woman gave birth to was a Spiritual Body!
The elders of the Mu Family were quite excited about it and warned her. Upset, Tang Jinyan returned to Shui Xing Palace.
She hadn't returned to the Mu Family since then. Given the unexpected incident in the Inner Domain, one can imagine her mood. Her face was gloomy every day.
"Miss!"
The maid walked in cautiously.
Even as Tang Jinyan's personal maid, she was punished several times for Tang Jinyan's bad mood ever since the mishap in the Inner Domain.
"What's the matter?"
Tang Jinyan asked sluggishly.
"The matter in the Inner Domain..."
The maid hesitated in her response.
"Speak up, what's going on in the Inner Domain?"
Tang Jinyan said angrily.
"Miss, that... that person seems to be in the Lingyu Domain now,"
The maid said in a low voice.
"What did you say?"
Tang Jinyan suddenly stood up, her face full of anger, "Did she use the Yu Ling to acknowledge her ancestors and return to the Mu Family? Were those old immortals also accepting?"
When the Gate of Lingyu was first opened, some people from the Inner Domain had entered. Could that lowly spawn be among them?
Was she holding the Yu Ling left by her own husband in the Inner Domain, going to the Mu Family to acknowledge ancestors and returning to the clan?
If indeed so, and if she could be approved by those old immortals, she must have an extraordinary talent!
"She didn't go to the Mu Family, instead... instead she went to the Chang Qing Pavilion."
The maid said cautiously in a low voice, "The Fairy Healer of Chang Qing Pavilion, Su Lingxiu, might be her!"
"What did you say, this is impossible!"
Tang Jinyan had a drastic change in her face and exclaimed.
"Miss, the original message bore the name Su Lingxiu. With all the signs, it's highly possible that the Fairy Healer of Chang Qing Pavilion is her, especially with the timing of the emergence of Chang Qing Pavilion..."
The maid explained the clues she got recently one by one.
Combined, all these clues pointed to the fact that the Fairy Healer of Chang Qing Pavilion was the person Tang Jinyan wanted to capture, and she was from the Inner Domain!
Tang Jinyan has turned pale and restless. If the news was true and her attempt to assassinate her in the Inner Domain gets revealed, the consequences would be unthinkable.
"Chang Qing Pavilion, Inner Domain, Xu Yan..."
At that moment, Tang Jinyan had a terrible suspicion. The renowned Xu Yan in Lingyu Domain might also be from the Inner Domain. The opening of the Gate of Lingyu, the rise of Xu Yan...
The timing was too coincidental.

chapters.title: Chapter 596 - 321: Seven Years in Ling Domain, the Fifth Gate of Martial Arts' Idea_1
chapters.content:
"Fetch Elder Liu for me."
Tang Jinyan instructed in a serious tone after a moment of silence.
"Yes, Miss!"
The maidservant left.
"Elder Liu, I've heard you have some connections in Zheng Country of Yuzhou. I plan to visit there in a few days, could you perhaps introduce me to some people?"
Tang Jinyan asked with a smile.
"A minor matter indeed, just bring these tokens to Zheng Country, young palace master."
Elder Liu nodded.
"Thank you, Elder Liu!"
Tang Jinyan joyfully responded.
After dismissing Elder Liu, Tang Jinyan began to arrange her trip to Yuzhou. These confidential matters naturally required her personal attention to ensure no leaks.
That day, Tang Jinyan embarked on her journey to Yuzhou.
...
"It worked!"
Looking at the Flying Boat floating in front of him, Fang Hao wiped a bead of sweat and exclaimed excitedly.
"Let me try!"
Su Lingxiu couldn't wait to give it a try.
Su Lingxiu moved to the air, released the Flying Boat.
Bang!
A hundred-foot-long Flying Boat with various pavilions emerged in mid-air, surrounded by purple lightning, giving the illusion of a purple dragon coiling around it as it was activated.
"The Flying Boat can expand and contract, its main body can disappear underground and become a mansion, with both defensive and offensive capabilities.
"Through a formation, it can activate a shield and project fantastic illusions like that of a real dragon circling it.
"However, it requires a fair amount of Spirit Crystal to operate, but it's all worth it.
"It can hover mid-air, and its top speed isn't slower than a top-notch Martial Artist, and it possesses some stealth abilities."
Fang Hao explained.
"With this Flying Boat, I can now practice medicine all over the Ling Domain. Changqing Pavilion's name will be known throughout the Ling Domain, and those who meet the Elixir Fairy will surely have good luck!"
Su Lingxiu said cheerfully.
Shi'er, Zhou Ying, and Meng Shushu also excitedly entered the Flying Boat, starting to familiarize and control it.
As for the Spirit Crystals needed for the Flying Boat, it was nothing to them.
They had looted the Yushen Sect and the Su Family's treasure house, they had plenty of Spirit Crystals.
Moreover, Changqing Pavilion had a lucrative daily income form Spirit Crystals, so they could use them freely.
Fang Hao began to forge his own Flying Boat. With experience and his second Flying Boat not needing to be as powerful as the first, it was not hard to forge.
The Flying Boat used by his master would naturally require more thought and effort, but for his own personal use, anything convenient would do.
After a few days, the second Flying Boat was finally forged.
It was also time for Fang Hao to visit the Wanshi Alliance headquarters.
That day, he said his goodbyes to his master and comrades.
"Big brother and second brother are already famous across the Ling Domain, and my name as the Elixir Fairy is also well known. Now it's your turn."
Su Lingxiu handed an elixir to Fang Hao.
"Rest assured, big sister, my name, Fang Hao, will soon be known throughout the Ling Domain."
Fang Hao confidently replied.
A thirty-feet-long Flying Boat took off into the sky, turned into a stream of light, and disappeared instantly.
On the Flying Boat stood two people, Fang Hao and Moon Changming.
"Time to find a new place to treat patients."
Su Lingxiu commented.
Therefore, Shi'er, Zhou Ying, and Meng Shushu started packing, moving everything into the Flying Boat.
Zhu Xingzheng came to say goodbye.
Though he wanted to stay at Changqing Pavilion too, he knew he ultimately did not belong there. Also, it was time for him to prepare for the Tianjiao Competition.
"Zhu Xingzheng, this elixir is for you."
Su Lingxiu handed him an elixir.
"I'll return the Golden Horn Deer to you as well."
Su Lingxiu added.
The Golden Horn Deer was cute, but not as adorable as the Red Cat which made her miss the Red Cat slightly.
"Thank you, Miss Su!"
Zhu Xingzheng expressed his gratitude.
"Little Jin, you're such a failure!"
Zhu Xingzheng rode the Golden Horn Deer away while rambling.
"I've secured such a great opportunity for you, yet you didn't make an impression. Your karma was simply not enough. From now on, just stick with me. Follow my instructions and you won't go wrong.
"If you had listened to me, you wouldn't have missed the opportunity."
"So, when I tell you to give all you've got, you must give all you've got. Even if I tell you to face an attack head-on, you mustn't hesitate, because it's all for a greater good."
The Golden Horn Deer grumbled and nodded, "I got it, I won't make mistakes or doubt your decisions."
Li Xuan's lip twitched as he watched Zhu Xingzheng. He didn't expect him to make use of this opportunity to brainwash the Golden Horn Deer.
"Changqing Pavilion will be taking its medical practice on the road and will leave this place. Today, those waiting for treatment can leave. See you when fate brings us together again."
Cai Ling'er told the row of martial artists waiting for treatment.
A powerful aura burst forth, making the martial artists retreat in disappointment.
Bang!
An impressive Flying Boat appeared in the sky above Changqing Pavilion. Purple lightning surrounded it and rays of dazzling light scattered in all directions. Even a real dragon seemed to be circling it.
This dramatic scene stunned the martial artists.
"What kind of divine artifact is that?"
"I have no idea, never heard of it!"
The Flying Boat ascended slowly into the sky, its speed was not fast, seeming to show off intentionally.
Li Xuan sat on top of the pavilion of the Flying Boat, relaxed and enjoying the scenery along the way, with Cai Ling'er serving by his side.

chapters.title: Chapter 597 - 321: Seven Years in Ling Domain, the Fifth Gate of Martial Arts' Idea_2
chapters.content:
She had no intention of returning to the Sea Spirit Tribe anymore.
The flying boat landed somewhere in Luo State, with a loud rumble, the entire flying boat expanded drastically, pavilions, terraces and towers emerged, transforming into a mansion.
The signboard of the Evergreen Pavilion shone brightly.
From this day forward, the Evergreen Pavilion only accepted complicated and severe cases, specifically treating Martial Artists whose foundations were destroyed. They refused to treat common injuries and ailments, but Healing Pills could be purchased.
Su Lingxiu then set forth to travel around the Spiritual Realm. The Evergreen Pavilion's flying ship would not stay in one place for too long, after a while it would take to the skies to journey to the next destination.
Gradually, word of the Evergreen Pavilion's flying ship spread throughout the Spiritual Realm. The idea that encountering the Evergreen Pavilion was a matter of luck, also spread far and wide.
Inside the Lei Yun Mountain Manor, Lei Tong and the powerful warriors all remained silent after the sudden emergence of the flying ship. This Divine Artifact had shocked them.
"It appears that even a Lord in the Spiritual Realm can't harbor any thoughts against the Evergreen Pavilion before the Divine Bridge is opened."
The Lord of Lei Yun Manor said solemnly.
"Lord, why would there be a Lord in the Spiritual Realm?"
Lei Tong asked in bewilderment.
"I'm not sure, we will have all our answers once the Divine Bridge opens."
The Lord of Lei Yun Manor replied, shaking his head.
"The Spiritual Realm is going to get lively, the competition among the Heaven's Chosen has begun, it's time for the Heaven's Chosen of all the Spirit Sects to make a move. Don't just focus on Xu Yan and Meng Chong.
"Xu Yan and Meng Chong's fame is now prominent, they both have the reputation of being the first and second among Heaven's Chosen, but only the final battle can determine who will be at the top."
The Lord of Lei Yun Manor stated seriously.
"Understood!"
All the elders nodded.
Unlike the previous time, the contest of Heaven's Chosen this time had also arrived at the time of the opening of the Divine Bridge, the core Heaven's Chosen of the Transcendent Spirit Sect will reveal themselves this time.
As Xu Yan entered Dachuan, his trace became obscured, and the heated discussion about him in the Spiritual Realm Martial Arts world gradually subsided. Meng Chong didn't make a public appearance either to challenge other Heaven's Chosen, so the heated discussions about him too dwindled.
On the other hand, Heaven's Chosen from various Spirit Sects continuously emerged and almost every large city saw a Heaven's Chosen battleground everyday.
With the escalation of the Heaven's Chosen contest, the rankings on the Heaven's Chosen board kept changing. The only things that did not change were Xu Yan and Meng Chong holding the first and second ranks respectively.
The elimination rules for the Heaven's Chosen contest were also published.
A three-time consecutive loss means elimination!
The Spiritual Realm Martial Arts world was bustling with activities, while the Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship and the name of the Pill Doctor Fairy kept spreading far and wide.
Even the severely injured Heaven's Chosen and those whose foundations were shattered were able to have a new lease on life thanks to the miraculous healing skills of the Pill Doctor Fairy after being admitted to the Evergreen Pavilion.
Some of the Heaven's Chosen were even able to challenge their opponents again, defeat them, and secure their place in the next round of the Heaven's Chosen battle.
In Yuzhou, Tang Jinyan was searching for a link about the martial artist who had entered the Spiritual Realm from the Inner Domain from within the mansion of a high-ranking official of Zheng Country. She wanted to find out the truth about Xu Yan.
The high-ranking official of Zheng Country pondered for a while before giving her a portrait. The portrait was of the martial artist who had entered the Spiritual Realm from the Inner Domain by holding the Yu Ling.
As for Du Yuying and the others, anything related to the Transcendent Spirit Sect wasn't leaked out to him by the official.
He simply provided the name of an insignificant person.
This person had entered the Spiritual Realm holding the Su Family's Yu Ling. However, since the Su Family has been exterminated, whether the person was still alive or not he wasn't sure.
Tang Jinyan started her search in Yuzhou. To prevent any leaks, she had not leveraged other resources, but set out alone with her trusted maid to investigate within the original Su Family territory.
To avoid recognition, she disguised herself.
Yuzhou was no longer the domain of the Spirit Sect nobles, but was jointly ruled with the All Ages Alliance. The status of Loose Cultivators had greatly increased, and Spirit Sect and noble martial artists were no longer as aloof as before.
The Su Family's territory was vast, with several large cities. How easy could it be to find one person?
Moreover, whether that person was still alive was a mystery.
"It's been seven years already, hasn't it?"
In Da Ze State, one of the Eighteen States of the Spiritual Realm, this state was named Da Ze State because it was full of rivers, lakes and swamps.
Golden Lotus Lake, a famous lake in Da Ze State, was named so because it exclusively sprouted golden lotus in the Spiritual Realm.
The setting sun glowed, casting a resplendent glow on the golden lotus, which gave the lake an air of nobility.
The flying boat gently swayed with the ripples on the lake. In the pavilion on the boat, Li Xuan was drinking Spiritual Tea, appreciating the beauty of the Golden Lotus Lake.
He had been in the Spiritual Realm for seven years and the final battle of the Heaven's Chosen contest was fast approaching.
In these seven years, new Heaven's Chosen kept rising to prominence one after another in the Spiritual Realm. However, so far, no one had been able to replace Xu Yan and Meng Chong's rankings.
Even Fang Hao.
By now, Fang Hao had become a prominent Heaven's Chosen of the All Ages Alliance, helping it rise to power. With the introduction of the Communication Talisman, he created a more efficient communication system that shocked the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
Next, he arranged teleportation array that connected the big cities of the All Ages Alliance, greatly shortening the time it took for aid and travel.
Although the teleportation arrays were unable to conduct inter-state transportation yet, they were gradually being linked, one after another.
Chenzhou had already completed this arrangement. Powerful warriors could quickly come to the aid of others in a short amount of time through the teleportation array, effectively making Chenzhou an impenetrable stronghold.
The series of actions that subverted the common sense of Martial Artists in the Spiritual Realm had deeply ingrained Fang Hao's name in everyone's minds. Even the Loose Cultivators were starting to feel empowered and no longer looked up to the Spirit Sect and noble families.
The sovereignty of the Spirit Sect had been genuinely threatened for the first time!
Stealing the secrets of Fang Hao's Martial Arts, ambushing Fang Hao, and capturing Fang Hao had become the most urgent targets of the Spirit Sect.
Fang Hao had faced more than one assassination attempt!

chapters.title: Chapter 598 - 321: Seven Years in Ling Domain, the Fifth Gate of Martial Arts' Idea_3
chapters.content:
Even though it is known to originate from Spirit Sect, with the shadow of Transcendent Spirit Sect lurking behind, there are no concrete pieces of evidence.
Transcendent Spirit Sect, at this moment, revealed some of its hidden talents!
Fang Hao found himself in the most dangerous situation once. He was even tainted with the aura of death. This sinister power was extremely troublesome. It could only be sealed within a meridian with forbidden techniques and then eradicated using purifying formation arrays to dispel the aura of death.
Moon Changming once again had the entire Ling Domain reeling in fear. As the protector by Fang Hao's side, he revealed formidable power in the face of assassins.
Especially when Fang Hao was momentarily careless and tainted with the aura of death, Moon Changming initiated an attack and killed a top cultivator from the Thousand Martial Hall.
Now, Fang Hao already held the position of the Young Master of the Wan Shi Alliance. Taking the Alliance Hierarch's position was only a matter of time. There was nobody in the entire Wan Shi Alliance who did not revere him.
Even the most powerful prodigies of the Wan Shi Alliance that Zhu Xingzheng had mentioned felt the same way.
Fang Hao's martial arts methods were unfathomably profound. They surpassed their imaginations. They could not but surrender!
"Your disciple, Xu Yan, has completed his breakthrough to the Divine Origin Realm, and your Divine Skill Realm is also completed."
The Daoist Golden Book opened, and golden lights poured out.
Xu Yan had undergone another breakthrough.
Over the past seven years, Xu Yan had never been at ease in Dachuan. He had ventured into ancient tombs, obliterating some of the lingering divine souls.
The gains were enormous.
Of course, he also encountered some peculiar but powerful beings, but all were killed by Xu Yan.
Now, he had managed to complete his breakthrough into the Divine Origin Realm.
"This is the joy of enhancing your cultivation."
Li Xuan was thrilled.
Xu Yan was getting closer to the Divine Skill Realm.
Now, his four types of martial arts have all risen to the Divine Skill Realm.
Fang Hao, while researching formations, forbidden techniques, and fighting various assailants, had made significant progress in his understanding of the future path of Qimen martial arts. Li Xuan had already condensed five innate peculiar patterns, where one was a divine skills pattern.
The Divine Skill Realm of Qimen martial arts did not birth any divine skills, but divine skills patterns were origins of divine skills. By arranging these divine skills patterns, he could set up a heavenly earth Lingji, which possessed the power and subtlety of divine skills.
It was essentially no different from divine skills.
Among the four disciples, Xu Yan was still the strongest. Now that he had completed his breakthrough into the Divine Origin Realm, even Wu Tianan would not be a match for him, despite Wu Tianan's significant increase in power.
Now Xu Yan can be said to stand at the summit of the Spirit Realm.
Meng Chong and Su Lingxiu were still in the initial stage of the Divine Origin Realm.
Although Fang Hao was also in the Divine Origin Realm, the strength of his Qimen martial arts lay in techniques like formations. It was no trouble for him to lay down a large formation and slay those cultivators refining the heavenly earth Lingji.
"Time to ponder upon the fifth martial arts path."
Li Xuan had a notion of initiating the fifth martial arts path.
"I have already compiled the cultivation method after the Divine Skill Realm in body refining martial arts, and I've also made progress on the methods after breaking through to the Void-breaking realm. The cultivation directions for alchemy martial arts and Qimen martial arts have already been set, there's no need for pondering over them.
"It's time to think about the fifth martial arts path. As for the fifth disciple, I should be able to find one in this vast Ling Domain."
Li Xuan was mumbling to himself.
A couple of days earlier, Wu Tianan had left Chang Qing Pavilion. Following his advice, he began to travel and realize the heavenly earth spirit of Ling Domain to prepare for breaking his shackles.
He could send a message to Wu Tianan to have him keep an eye out for any promising talents in the Ling Domain, in preparation for taking in the fifth disciple.
"How should I compile the fifth martial arts path, then?"
Li Xuan, for the moment, didn't have many ideas.

chapters.title: Chapter 599 - 322: Understanding the Method of Divine Appearance, Beheading the Elder with the Palm Knife_1
chapters.content:
Li Xuan had no inkling regarding the fifth Martial Arts door for the moment, so he decided to put it aside for now. As he looked at the tenth page of the Book of Tai Cang, he couldn't help but feel amazed.
He originally thought that after the tenth page of the Book of Tai Cang, there would be higher-level Heaven and Earth Laws, hence the result came as a surprise.
After memorizing the patterns on the tenth page, he spent five years on the patterns of the eleventh page and still hadn't fully memorized them.
The patterns were profound and hard to register, as if they were always changing and yet remained constant.
"I wonder how long it will take to fully comprehend the Book of Tai Cang, the one who could record it must have been immensely powerful."
Every time he thought of the master of the Book of Tai Cang, Li Xuan was overwhelmed with awe. The master's strength was beyond his comprehension.
"However, one day, I will surpass you,"
Li Xuan was full of confidence.
With the Book of Tai Cang as reference, his Martial Arts, which he had created would eventually surpass the master of the Book of Tai Cang. He was also confident about Xu Yan.
He opened the Daoist Golden Book and looked at the information given on the tenth page of the Book of Tai Cang.
Tai Cang's Dao Principles (partial): Establish the Laws of Heaven and Earth, understand the changes of the Dao!
Dao Principles!
Beginning from the tenth page of the Book of Tai Cang, it presents Tai Cang's Dao Principles, the foundation of Heaven and Earth!
Because of this, even with Li Xuan's current cultivation level, it was extremely strenuous to memorize the patterns of the eleventh page.
"Above the Laws of Heaven and Earth are the Dao Principles of Heaven and Earth, which serves as the foundation of Heaven and Earth. The Void-breaking Realm is unbounded by the Laws of Heaven and Earth, ascends beyond these laws, and forges its own Martial Arts power.
"So, above the Void-breaking Realm, one must prepare for the Dao Principles to touch the roots of the Dao of Heaven and Earth."
Li Xuan muttered to himself.
He now had a rough idea about his cultivation level after the Void-breaking Realm, and a general conception of it.
The Flying Boat of the Evergreen Pavilion was floating on Golden Lotus Lake.
Before long, the news of the arrival of Evergreen Pavilion at Golden Lotus Lake in Da Ze State spread.
The geniuses injured in the duel, as well as those with old injuries, those whose Martial Art foundation was damaged, and even the Martial Artists whose Divine Souls were injured, started coming to seek treatment.
These patients had long prepared their payment and were waiting for the appearance of Evergreen Pavilion so that they could hasten to seek medical help.
Having travelled in the Ling Domain for such a long time, no one dared to make trouble in the Evergreen Pavilion, nor did anyone dare to violate the rules of the Evergreen Pavilion.
Even those who thought they were powerful adhered to this rule.
With Martial Artists coming to Evergreen Pavilion for treatment, the Pavilion was bustling with activity. But none of this concerns Li Xuan, he was still sitting in the pavilion, studying Tai Cang's Dao Principles.
This time, Evergreen Pavilion would stay at Golden Lotus Lake for half a month before moving to the next place.
Su Lingxiu seldom showed up for personal consultations now. Only if there were strange diseases or extremely serious injuries or if the patient had substantial strength, would she personally take action.
Normally, people who came for consultation were tended to by Shi'er, Zhou Ying, Meng Shushu, or Yue'er.
With improved diagnostic spiritual artifacts, even severe or concealed old injuries could be diagnosed. The treatment was then provided based on the diagnosis result.
Yue'er had reached the peak of Refining God Heavenly Man, and her Divine Soul was stronger than other warriors at the peak of Refining God Heavenly Man. This was thanks to Su Lingxiu's study of Divine Soul and the more efficient methods to enhance it she had worked out.
Yue'er, with her spiritual body talent, had started to prepare to incorporate Heavenly Earth Lingji into her divine soul to step into the realm of the strongest in the Ling Domain.
An old man, leaning on his walking stick, came to Evergreen Pavilion.
Li Xuan glanced at him, raising an eyebrow, but he did not pay much attention.
Hidden within the old man was a death aura. This aura had been condensed through a special secret technique and was combined with the impending death due to the exhaustion of his life span.
It could only be activated once, and after that, he would die.
Even his Divine Soul had congealed the death aura. It was apparent that this old man was one of the death warriors of a certain Transcendent Spirit Sect.
As for the purpose of his visit to Evergreen Pavilion, Li Xuan didn't care, as he couldn't make a ripple.
"Huh, your symptoms are unusual."
Shi'er, who was providing the consultation, stared at the old man in surprise.
"Is there a potential treatment?"
The old man asked in a hoarse voice.
"I'm unable to help. Furthermore, your condition is unique. Even the diagnostic spiritual artifact couldn't diagnose you. Please wait a moment."
This kind of special patient could only be treated by Su Lingxiu herself.
Zhou Ying informed Su Lingxiu.
"Can Divine Doctor Su treat my illness?"
The old man looked nervously and hopefully at Su Lingxiu.
"Your condition is unusual. Your lifespan is near its end, and you need a pill to extend it. Furthermore, the death aura in your body also needs to be eliminated.
"The treatment won't be cheap. I'll give you a list of what is needed. As long as you can find the items on it, you can be cured, and extending your life by a hundred years won't be a problem."
Su Lingxiu spoke calmly.
"Really?"
The old man was excited.
"My life can be extended by a hundred years?"
Su Lingxiu handed him the treatment list: "Of course, it's just a matter of refining a Lifespan Extension Pill. It's nothing big."
"That's wonderful. I can live on!"
The old man was thrilled. His excitement seemed to cause some uncontrolled discharge of the suppressed death aura, turning his hand grey-black. As he reached for the prescription paper, he excitedly stood up.
Boom!
At this moment, the old man's eyes suddenly turned icy, a horrifying death aura surged out, gloomy and terrible, it morphed into a ghost claw-like form, attacking Su Lingxiu.

chapters.title: Chapter 600 - 322: Understanding the Method of Divine Appearance, Slaying the Elder of the Palm Blade_2
chapters.content:
At such a close range, the old man was confident that his sudden attack could critically wound the opponent!
Once the death energy entered the body, especially one so vast, even if it's the Elixir Fairy, she would undoubtedly die, merely managing to linger on for some more time.
However, to his astonishment, faint blue light emerged from Su Lingxiu, who simply sat there, quietly looking at him.
The attack transformed by the death energy, upon encountering the faint blue light, started to dissolve as if it had faced its nemesis.
"Impossible!"
The old man looked horrified.
"Thousand Martial Hall? Or Lei Yun Mountain Manor?"
As if Su Lingxiu had already anticipated, she shook her head and said, "The likelihood of Lei Yun Mountain Manor is slim. It must be Thousand Martial Hall. An elder of Thousand Martial Hall was once injured by my junior brother's formation, which devastated his fundamentals. He wanted my help, but I refused."
"So, this is revenge? Not allowing Thousand Martial Hall to be healed, nor other martial artists to get healing?"
The old man's expression changed. How could Fang Hao be her junior brother?
Did they come from the same sect?
At this moment, he saw Su Lingxiu reaching out to touch his head.
Puff!
He felt his consciousness being drained, his divine soul seemed torn away too, and the death energy started converging towards Su Lingxiu's palm. At one point, his consciousness shattered and dispersed.
In Su Lingxiu's hand, a ball of death energy appeared.
"This is wonderful. I should study how this death energy is condensed."
Su Lingxiu looked happy.
She left the diagnostic work to Shi'er and the others as she cheerfully returned to the loft, to examine the ball of death energy.
This assassination did not cause any turbulence, Shi'er and the others did not seem to care about it, considering it a minor issue.
...
At Dachuan, standing atop a perilous mountain, Xu Yan was waiting for someone.
"This Dachuan seems to be filled with endless graves. The residual divine souls in these ancient tombs are somewhat unusual!"
Xu Yan had covered a lot of dangerous places within Dachuan over the years and had explored some of the ancient tombs.
In some tombs, renegade souls were hidden. However, they were not the usual remains of the divine souls of the martial artists from the Ling Domain.
They were filled with gloomy energy and seemed very brutal.
Once, a grand family in Dachuan had dug up a large tomb in a mountain and they found a powerful corpse monster inside. It nearly annihilated the entire family.
Xu Yan happened upon it and was astonished. He acted swiftly and killed the corpse monster.
Half a year ago, he encountered an extraordinary martial artist. He had unusual powers, and in the end, when Xu Yan killed him, he discovered that an unknown residual soul had possessed the martial artist.
"Why does Dachuan feel like it's filled with tombs? Each large mountain looks like a grave with martial artists buried beneath."
Xu Yan mumbled to himself.
Despite the dangers and continuous attacks lurking within Dachuan, and especially within the mountains, they had actually helped Xu Yan to greatly improve his martial arts understanding and enhance his strength over the years.
Now, he had fully reached the Divine Origin Realm.
"I hope this mountain isn't hiding a tomb underneath it too?"
Xu Yan glanced at the perilous mountain he was standing on and mumbled to himself.
"The martial arts of the Physiognomy realm, I am just a little away from completely understanding it."
Xu Yan muttered to himself, for he was waiting for someone.
After this battle, he should be able to fully comprehend the martial arts of the Physiognomy realm.
"Xu Yan, I've finally found you!"
A cold and murderous voice rang out.
A smile appeared on Xu Yan's face, "I've been waiting for you for a long time."
The elder from the Thousand Martial Hall, who wielded the knife, faltered, "You intentionally revealed your whereabouts to me?"
"Of course!"
Xu Yan looked at the elder, one of the most powerful fighters from the Thousand Martial Hall, who had gathered the aura of Heaven and Earth Laws, not just a strand of it either.
"Are you seeking death, or are you so confident in escaping from me?"
The elder swept his gaze around, using his divine soul strength to search inch by inch, but didn't find any ambush.
"I am here to kill you."
Xu Yan looked at the knife in the elder's hand. Although it could be regarded as a Divine Artifact, it wasn't as powerful as the Extinguish Knife.
So, he took out the Extinguish Knife.
He casually threw it to the elder, "Let me borrow your knife. You should make a move. Let me witness the strength of the most powerful warrior from the Thousand Martial Hall."
The elder's brows furrowed as Xu Yan actually returned the Extinguish Knife?
"If you wish to die, I'll gladly oblige!"
As he held the Extinguish Knife, the knife's edge surged towards the sky, the cold knife energy agitated the entire surrounding area. The power of the Divine Artifact was unavoidably revealed, far surpassing Wu Yuan.
Seeing Xu Yan's confidence, the elder didn't dare to let his guard down. After all, back at the gates of the Thousand Martial Hall, although Xu Yan seemed arrogant, he inevitably demonstrated the basis of his arrogance.
A few years had passed, Xu Yan's strength must have increased, and that's why he was so confident.
The elder sneered inwardly. Xu Yan was still too arrogant. Did he think that possessing a Divine Artifact like the Extinguish Knife made him comparable to a typical supreme warrior?
"Make your move!"
Xu Yan made a gesture, and his Divine Origin transformed into a sword held in his hand.
"Die!"
The elder brought down his knife, icy cold and deadly, causing a fearsome slash to descend.
Bang!
Xu Yan thrust his sword forward, barely touching before withdrawing. His body leaped into the air, dodging the edge of the knife.
He carefully observed the power of the elder's knife and the process of gathering the power of Heaven and Earth Laws.
Bang!
Under the edge of the knife, the perilous mountain was instantly split in two!

chapters.title: Chapter 601 - 322: Understanding the Method of Divine Appearance, Slaying the Elder of the Palm Blade_3
chapters.content:
"Kill!"
The Elder with the knife in hand, his momentum erupted, and his body was enveloped in three deep and profound auras, as if it merged with the heavens and the earth, the Great Power of Heaven and Earth constantly gathered, infusing into the Absolute Cold Blade.
At this moment, the Elder showed off the true strength of an ultimate powerhouse in the Ling Domain.
Boom!
The battle was intense, mountains crumbled one after another, even turning into powder and disappearing.
And Xu Yan, stabbing out one sword after another, was like a small boat, adrift in the raging waves, seemingly about to capsize at any moment.
The Elder's eyes contracted, he was secretly shocked. Xu Yan seemed to be at a disadvantage, even showing signs of being passively beaten, yet he was never truly in danger.
This meant that the battle was within Xu Yan's control.
Thinking of this, the Elder's expression became colder, and another Divine Artifact long knife he brought with him was also held in his hand.
With the dual knives in motion, the Great Power of Heaven and Earth turned into blade light, sweeping across the battlefield, enveloping Xu Yan within.
"Xu Yan, you are indeed strong, but you are too arrogant! Do you really think I could become the Elder of Thousand Martial Hall, just like any other formidable figure?"
The Elder sneered.
Inside his body, a surge of radiance emerged, fusing into the Divine Artifacts, the three profound auras, at this moment seemed to completely merge with the heavens and the earth.
At this moment, an even greater power of Heaven and Earth constantly flowed into the two Divine Artifacts, and the power of the Divine Artifacts increased manifold in an instant.
"So this is the power of refining the Heavenly Earth Law? Just able to refine a bit, and it's rather crude, even if breaking into the next realm, it's just the physique refining Heavenly Earth Law.
"Although able to use the power of the Heavenly Earth Law, it's still under the law, not using the law for own use.
"The Physiognomy realm is in control of the Heavenly Earth Law for the Martial Divine Appearance, it is above the Heavenly Earth Law, controlling the Heavenly Earth Law, I have some enlightenment."
Xu Yan remained unflustered in the face of the Elder's increasingly frenzied attacks.
The images of mountains and rivers emerged, incorporating all the attacks, meticulously understanding, comprehending the direction of the spiritual realm martial arts cultivation, observing how the Elder condensed the power of the Heavenly Earth Law.
The battle became more and more intense, Xu Yan was still like a small boat, on the verge of capsizing at any moment, the images of mountains and rivers that emerged had been destroyed several times.
But he didn't care in the slightest.
Boom!
The Elder's attacks were also getting stronger and stronger, it seemed that as the battle continued, the power of the Heavenly Earth Law that was condensed, continuously accumulated, making the power of the Divine Artifact constantly increase.
It seemed like, once the power of the Heavenly Earth Law accumulated to a peak, it would truly explode.
"Xu Yan, die!"
At some moment, the Elder's eyes were sharp as blades, the two knives fused into one, and suddenly slashed down.
In mid-air, the power of the Heavenly Earth Law accumulated to its limit, with the slash of the dual blades, a terrifying blade light came slashing down from the sky.
The blade light, as if it came from the sky, came down in an instant, wanting to completely annihilate Xu Yan!
"It's time to end this!"
Xu Yan let out a breath, he had almost fully comprehended the Law of the Martial Divine Appearance.
He slashed out with his sword.
Although the Sword Intent was formless, it possessed a destructive force, the mountains and rivers turned into a Thundering Sword, and the sword fell silently.
The Elder was shocked beyond belief, he felt a strong sense of life and death crisis.
Under this one sword, the blade light collapsed, and before he could react, a subtle breeze suddenly swept past him.
The instant the breeze blew past, he suddenly felt a terrifying intent to kill, his Divine Soul shattered, his body turned into fragments, and his consciousness faded.
The Elder of Thousand Martial Hall had fallen!

chapters.title: Chapter 602 - 323: Red Cat Establishes the Demon Clan_1
chapters.content:
Xu Yan gestured, and the Cold Absolute Sword and another sword fell into his hands, which he then put away.
"Done!"
In this battle, Xu Yan contemplated and understood the doubts of the Physiognomy Martial Arts, and all he needed was to organize his sudden enlightenment to complete the conceptualization success.
"The trip to Dachuan is over, it's time to leave!"
Lowering his head, Xu Yan sees that the precipitous mountain had collapsed by 90% during the fierce battle, unearthing an ancient tomb.
Shaking his head, initially, he was quite interested when he discovered the ancient tomb, but now he doesn't have the interest to explore it.
With a shift in his form, he vanished from the spot and left Dachuan on the same day.
"It's time to explore other states, once the Divine Origin Realm is complete, I can start preparing to break into the Divine Skill Realm."
Before breaking through the Divine Skill Realm, the embodied foundation needs some time to settle.
"The ultimate battle to become the best of the best, you may not be able to enter if you don't have divine power, but there is absolutely no problem if the Divine Origin Realm is complete."
Xu Yan was walking amidst the towering mountains of Dachuan, simultaneously organizing the enlightenments of the Physiognomy Martial Arts as he left Dachuan.
"I wonder if my second junior brother is in Dachuan?"
Meng Chong had also come to Dachuan before, and they had met once.
"That's right, where did Brother Xie go?"
Xu Yan thought of Xie Lingfeng, he hadn't heard from him since they entered Ling Domain.
"After so many years, Brother Xie must have already broken through the Divine Intent State, or even reached the complete state of the Divine Intent State."
Xu Yan murmured. After Xie Lingfeng had broken through the complete state of Divine Intent State, there were no additional cultivation techniques.
"Since I am on a travel journey in Ling Domain, I might as well look for Brother Xie's whereabouts along the way. It's time for me to pass on the martial arts cultivation techniques of the Divine Origin Realm and Divine Skill Realm to him."
Xu Yan pondered for a moment, the next destination, Yúnshān!
...
Heavenly Mausoleum State is known as the State of Spiritual Beasts.
Compared to Dachuan, the mountains in Heavenly Mausoleum State are higher, the forests are denser, the mountains are continuous with countless caves and subterranean rivers.
It's because of the unique terrain of Heavenly Mausoleum State that it has become the State of Spiritual Beasts, with eighty percent of the spiritual beasts in the Ling Domain gathered here.
In the central mountain range of Heavenly Mausoleum State, amidst the tall ancient trees and rolling mountains, lies the core territory of the Spiritual Beasts, a place occupied by beasts above the sixth rank.
Humans seldom come here. Even the strongest warriors from the Yu Ling Mansion don't easily set foot here.
Between the mountains, at some unknown time, a grand palace was built on the highest peak. The golden rooftop shone brilliantly under the sunlight.
Upon closer inspection, it is clear that this grand palace was carved out from a giant stone peak and topped off with rare golden materials.
The palace is surrounded by various gemstones, exuding opulence.
To the left and right side of the grand palace, there are two smaller palaces, seemingly guarding the grand one in the middle.
Whoosh!
A spiritual beast flies in from amongst the mountains and lands in front of the grand palace. Its gigantic form, originally several feet tall, reduces to about three feet before stepping into the palace.
This is a beast above the sixth rank, its strength is comparable to a martial artist who has refined the Heavenly Earth Lingji.
In the following hours, spiritual beasts above the sixth rank arrive from various places. Each beast would shrink their size before entering the palace.
On this day, all the dominant spiritual beasts above the sixth rank from all over Heavenly Mausoleum State gather and enter this grand palace.
These spiritual beasts that entered the palace are arranged according to their strength. Some squat, some lie down, neatly arranged, but all their heads are turned towards the upper part of the grand hall.
Above the grand hall, there are a large and two small thrones.
In the middle of the grand throne, bathed in the golden light, sits a mighty tiger with a massive gold chain around its neck.
The tiger has a huge body, sitting upright on the throne with its claws on the armrests. From its high position, it looks down at the line of spiritual beasts below.
Coiled on the chair to the left of the giant tiger is a white dragon, slightly raising its head to look at the beasts below.
Squatted on the chair to the right is a toad, smaller than the giant tiger but still like a small mountain.
The tiger in the middle is naturally Red Cat.
The two on the sides are Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha. Ever since their arrival in Heavenly Mausoleum State, the Red Cat, a cultured tiger, has been fluctuating in the spiritual beast clan.
When they were weak, they would ally with a stronger force to strengthen their foundation.
Through their rise, Red Cat has now become the king of the spiritual beasts in Heavenly Mausoleum State!
Its strength is enough to intimidate all the spiritual beasts above the sixth rank. All the spiritual beasts that were present, the dominators of all regions, were all defeated by it and surrendered.
Yu Xiaolong has practiced the Great Demon Clan's technique, already breaking through bloodline shackles, transforming into a dragon, and now his strength is not weaker than beasts above the sixth rank.
Little Ha, a toad that can devour mountains, is arguably the most powerful toad in Ling Domain's history, with strength comparable to beasts above the sixth rank.
With its devouring ability and huge spatial force in its belly, it has defeated many beasts of the same rank.
Finally, it has set foot firmly in Heavenly Mausoleum State.
Red Cat is the Great Demon King, Yu Xiaolong is the Second Demon King, Little Ha is the Third Demon King.
"I wonder why the king summoned us, what are the orders?"
Below, one of the supreme spiritual beasts spoke.
"Today, I have summoned you all because I have an important announcement. It is related to the future of our spiritual beast clan, and it is related to the rise of our spiritual beast clan."

chapters.title: Chapter 603 - 323: Red Cat establishes the Demon Clan _2
chapters.content:
The consciousness of the Red Cat fluctuated, letting out a majestic voice that fully demonstrated the divine might of a Demon King.
The spirit beasts felt a surge of spirit and lifted their heads, not knowing what their king wanted to command.
The Red Cat's eyes shone brilliantly and a golden radiance emerged from its body, enhancing its majestic appearance. The might of a great Demon King reverberated through the hall.
The spirit beasts shivered in their hearts, feeling the oppressive aura and a sense of reverence emerged within them, which further intensified.
This implied that the strength of the king had once again increased.
"The clan of spirit beasts shall dissolve from today. As the king, I shall establish the Clan of the Demons. We are from the Demon Clan, not beasts. As of today, the Heavenly Mausoleum State is the territory of the Demon Clan, and I am the Great Demon King."
The majestic voice of the Red Cat echoed throughout the hall.
The Demon Clan?!
All the spirit beasts were stunned.
One of the spirit beasts spoke out, "My King, we are naturally spirit beasts. How can we forget our ancestors? This is not acceptable!"
Slap!
The Red Cat glared with its eyes, its demon aura overwhelming. Yu Xiaolong swept its tail, slapped it across, and instantly sent the spirit beast flying, crashing onto the ground.
"How dare you! Did the king allow you to speak?"
Yu Xiaolong sternly reprimanded.
Their coordination was perfect. As soon as the spirit beast began to question, they immediately slapped it away.
The Red Cat looked down at the spirit beasts below, and coldly said: "Forget your ancestors? Are you willing to be trapped in your bloodline, unable to progress, and never surpass your ancestors?
"Furthermore, weren't your ancestors merely beasts too?
"A spirit beast is merely a beast. Are you willing to degrade yourselves?
"As the Great Demon King, I will establish the Demon Clan and naturally teach you the ways of the Great Demon. Break through the shackles of bloodline, and follow the path of our Demon Clan."
The Red Cat suddenly rose from its chair, standing upright. As it stood, Yu Xiaolong also lifted its tail from the ground, straightening into a upright position, a head shorter than the Red Cat.
Little Ha was also standing on the ground.
When the king stood, they naturally couldn't continue sitting.
The Red Cat raised its left paw, where tremendous wind and flames swirled around its huge tiger-like claw. This displayed a strong wind and fire aura. This was one of the great demon magics that the Red Cat had cultivated.
It was the great demon magic that suppressed all the above sixth-order spirit beasts. It was a method that the Red Cat gradually cultivated by constantly depicting the array diagram in its acupuncture points.
"Have you seen it? This is my Phoenix Fire Demon Technique, whose power you have all witnessed. This is only one of my demon techniques.
"You are trapped in the shackles of the bloodline, but I do not have this annoyance. Just like the Human Clan martial artists, I can keep cultivating and keep getting stronger.
"Are you willing to be trapped in the shackles of the bloodline, never able to surpass your ancestors? Do you want to be beasts forever?"
The spirit beasts felt a stir in their hearts. For them, breaking through the shackles of the bloodline was their lifelong pursuit.
Not forgetting their ancestors, it was simply because their ancestors were stronger and their bloodline had become thin over time. They only pursued bloodline purity in order to get closer to their ancestors' strength.
Now, with the opportunity to break through the shackles of the bloodline, not only could they catch up with their ancestors, but even surpass them. How could they not be excited?
Yu Xiaolong also spoke at this moment. "I am the Crystal Jade Serpent. You all know the limits of my bloodline. But look at me now, what is my strength now?"
The spirit beasts' eyes flickered. Although the Crystal Jade Serpent had the bloodline of a Jiao, it was almost impossible to transform into a Jiao unless it devoured the essence blood of a Jiao.
The strength of Yu Xiaolong was incredibly strong, and he also had mastered a great demon technique. It was obvious that his strength did not come from an elevated bloodline.
It came from cultivating the great demon technique!
The Red Cat lifted its paw and patted Little Ha on the head next to it, saying, "See, the third king among you is the Mountain Swallowing Toad, and now, it has far surpassed its ancestors."
The spirit beasts were even more tempted. The Mountain Swallowing Toad was a low-level spirit beast that was often used by the Spirit Sect families to make storage bags.
But the third king, the Mountain Swallowing Toad, had unimaginable strength.
"Our king is wise and mighty, leading us to rise in the world. I swear to follow our king to the death and fight for the rise of our Demon Clan!"
One of the spirit beasts, a white-furred wolf, jumped up, knelt down on both knees, and spoke in a loud voice.
"Good, good! From today onwards, you shall be the Chief Elder of the Demon Clan!"
The Red Cat nodded approvingly.
This White Wolf is extremely powerful; among the above sixth-order spirit beasts, it could be ranked in the top three. It is also very cunning, capable of appraising the situation and making decisions in its own favor.
Just like before, when the Red Cat made its move, it immediately surrendered. It was the only one among the above sixth-order spirit beasts that was not beaten.
"Thank you for your grace, my King!"
The White Wolf excitedly bumped its head on the ground, shouting loudly.
"From today onwards, there is no more spirit beast clan, only the Demon Clan. Who supports, and who opposes?"
As the Red Cat sat back down in its chair, it looked down at the above sixth-order spirit beasts below and asked.
"Our King is wise. From today onwards, we are Demons, not spirit beasts!"
The spiritual beasts looked at one another. The power dynamics were unchangeable, and they too wished to break free from the shackles of their bloodline, so they all bowed and spoke in loud voices.
"Good, very good, spread my Great Demon King's Decree. The Heavenly Mausoleum State belongs to our Demon Clan, establish the Demon Clan Elder Hall, the protector hall, and establish the Demon Clan Guard Army..."
"Everyone, choose a group of our Demon Clan's pride to come to the sacred mountain, I will personally teach them, cultivating our Demon Clan's pride!"
Red Cat excitedly issued the command.
"Yes, Great King!"
All the spiritual beasts responded in unison.
Red Cat raised a claw, and an image appeared. Although the face was not clear, it gave a sense of unfathomable depth.
"This is our Demon Clan's Ancestor, a great demon of the world. You must worship the Ancestor, remember his grace, and establish the foundation of our Demon Clan..."
Red Cat spoke with reverence and solemnity.
The spiritual beasts were bewildered, wondering why their Ancestor was a human?
They were doubtful but dared not voice their questions.
They were afraid to upset the Great King and possibly, being suppressed by him.
"What are you standing there for, kneel and worship the Ancestor!"
Yu Xiaolong reminded them.
All the spiritual beasts knelt in unison: "Greetings to the Ancestor!"
Red Cat nodded in satisfaction.
One must never forget their master and should always seek to please them; this is the right path.
With another gesture, another image appeared. It was a beautiful silhouette. Although the specific features were not visible, the elegance was unparalleled. Anyone would be able to recognize it, once they meet in person.
"This is the Holy Mother of the Demon Clan!"
The spiritual beasts were once again perplexed, the Holy Mother of the Demon Clan was also a human.
"Greetings to the Holy Mother!"
No matter what, just bow!
They owed their rapid increase in strength to the pills refined by Su Lingxiu. So, besides pleasing their master, they also needed to please Su Lingxiu.
Red Cat was satisfied with the behavior of the spiritual beasts.
After a moment's thought, Xu Yan was a fierce character, very fierce. Even though it was the Great Demon King now, it still couldn't afford to offend him.
So, with a wave, another image appeared.
"This is the Supreme of the Demon Clan."
"Greetings to the Supreme!"
"This is the Second Supreme of the Demon Clan!"
"Greetings to the Second Supreme!"
"This is the Third Supreme of the Demon Clan!"
"Greetings to the Third Supreme!"
All the spiritual beasts were numb. Why were all the bigwigs of our Demon Clan human?
Red Cat thought for a while, now that Xu Yan was the Supreme of the Demon Clan, wouldn't Meng Chong and Fang Hao get upset if they found out there was no place for them?
Fang Hao's artifact refining and array diagramming skills were necessary to it, so they couldn't be offended, perhaps even needing to please them a bit.
As for Meng Chong, his physical strength was formidable, second only to Xu Yan. He couldn't be offended either.
So why not simply include them all as the bigwigs of the Demon Clan.
As for Shi'er and the others, naturally, they could not surpass the Great King.
"Today, as the Demon Clan is just establishing, we need to set our clan's rules. The Elder Hall will be headed by Snow Wolf as the elder. The protector of the protector hall will be personally selected and taught by me..."
Red Cat started issuing the Demon Clan rules, establishing the Demon Clan Guard Army and the Demon Clan Academy. All Demon Clan geniuses must learn to read and write.
They should become a cultured demon like it, the Great King Red Cat.
"Isn't the Demon Clan more than beasts, how can it be devoid of culture? Everyone present, you lack some culture. I have a book here that sums up my wisdom.
"I'll distribute it to you today. After you go back, you must study it conscientiously. I will give an examination.
"Those who perform outstandingly will be given the Great Demon Technique by me earlier."
With a wave of his hand, Red Cat sent the prepared booklets flying to all the spiritual beasts.
"Yes, Great King!"
All the spiritual beasts received the booklets and put them away solemnly.
Just as Red Cat was about to carry on with his task assignments, a spiritual beast suddenly came running in and knelt with one front leg, "Great King, that person who cheated us spiritual beasts has come again!"

chapters.title: Chapter 604 - 324: The True Form of the Demon Ancestor, Breakthrough to the Physiognomy Realm_1
chapters.content:
Upon hearing this, Red Cat's eyes widened, and he said in a deep voice, "Bring that man to me!"
"Your Majesty, that man is not weak, it won't be easy to capture him."
The spirit beast said.
Upon hearing this, Red Cat looked at the super sixth rank spirit beasts, and commanded, "Who will bring that man to me?"
"Your Majesty, I will!"
Without giving others a chance, the Snow Wolf leapt out, took the spirit beast, and rushed out of the hall to capture the man.
Somewhere in the Heavenly Mausoleum State, Zhu Xingzheng was again deceiving spirit beasts. But he was puzzled. Why were these spirit beasts acting differently from before?
Before, when he entered the Heavenly Mausoleum State, it wasn't difficult to deceive and ultimately control spirit beasts, but now it had become more difficult.
These spirit beasts seemed reluctant to be fooled, they covered their ears as if they didn't want to listen.
"Strange, I haven't let out the secret of my deception of spirit beasts, why do these spirit beasts act as if they are afraid to be fooled by my sweet talk?"
Zhu Xingzheng was full of confusion.
Suddenly, his face changed. A super sixth-rank spirit beast!
Then he calmed down. It was only a super sixth-rank spirit beast. It wasn't as if he hadn't deceived one before. As the peak of a Refining God Heavenly Man, he should have been able to handle a super sixth-rank spirit beast.
"Zhu Xingzheng of the All Ages Alliance greets the Spirit Beast King!"
No matter if the other party is the Beast King or not, being a super sixth rank spirit beast, he figured it would be appropriate to butter him up.
"So, it's you who's been deceiving my Demon Clan, isn't it? Come here!"
Zhu Xingzheng was dumbfounded.
Demon Clan?
Moreover, the other party was ready to take action without even a word.
He wanted to resist, but the other party was too strong, overwhelmingly so, and if he resisted, there would no chance for compromise.
"Your Highness, let's talk calmly. I have no malice... I have..."
He was about to take out a pill, and then use the name of the All Ages Alliance to fool the super sixth rank spirit beast.
"Who are you calling a beast?" I am of the Demon Clan, the Elder of the Demon Clan!"
The Snow Wolf retorted.
Zhu Xingzheng was completely dumbfounded. He called him Beast King, why did he take it as an insult?
Moreover, the Elder of the Demon Clan?
When was there ever a Demon Clan in the Ling Domain? Weren't they all super sixth-rank spirit beasts?
"By the order of the mighty Demon King, I am here to capture you!"
Saying this, the Snow Wolf swiftly apprehended Zhu Xingzheng.
In the hall, the Red Cat was sitting in a chair, looking down.
On either side of the hall, a group of super sixth-rank spirit beasts stood solemnly, watching as the Snow Wolf brought Zhu Xingzheng in.
At this moment, a wave of panic swept over Zhu Xingzheng. He finally realized that things were not looking good!
Smack!
The Snow Wolf threw Zhu Xingzheng onto the ground and said respectfully, "The mighty Demon King, I have brought this man as per your order!"
"Hmm, very good!"
Red Cat nodded.
By this point, Zhu Xingzheng's face had turned green. All of the beasts in the hall were super sixth-rank spirit beasts. What's more terrifying was the existence of a real king among the spirit beasts!
He ruled over the entire clan of spirit beasts.
Zhu Xingzheng looked up and saw three chairs. On them sat a flamboyantly decorated tiger with a gold chain around its neck, exuding an aura of extravagance and nouveau riche, on the left was a jade dragon, and on the right - a Toad Lizard?
A Toad Lizard so powerful?
"Honorable Demon King, I, Zhu Xingzheng represent the All Ages Alliance. I came to the Heavenly Mausoleum State to discuss the affiliation agreement between us and the Spirit Beasts..."
Feeling the great pressure, Zhu Xingzheng hurriedly spoke with respect on his face.
He directly mentioned the All Ages Alliance, showing that he was a representative and that it is forbidden to kill an envoy.
"To show the sincerity of the All Ages Alliance, we have prepared a rare and precious pill that is hard to find in the world as a tribute to the honorable Demon King."
Zhu Xingzheng quickly took out a bottle of pills.
Due to his good relationship with the Chang Qing Pavilion, he had bought many pills since the young Alliance Hierarch, Fang Hao, was the disciple of Pavilion Master Su Lingxiu, the master of the Chang Qing Pavilion.
His rapid improvement in strength was also related to these pills.
Of course, he also used pills to deceive many spirit beasts over the years to leave the Heavenly Mausoleum State with him...
Zhu Xingzheng believed that as long as he mentioned the All Ages Alliance, and presented the pills as a tribute, this trip would be safe and without risk.
Red Cat looked at the pill in Zhu Xingzheng's hand and fell into deep thought. Only the Chang Qing Pavilion had such pills in the world, and the entire Ling Domain only had Su Lingxiu who could refine them.
She was the Saint Mother of the Demon Clan!
If he was a friend of the Chang Qing Pavilion, he couldn't be killed. However, he wasn't sure about the current state of the Chang Qing Pavilion. Were they already selling their pills to outsiders?
With a wave of his claw, the pill in Zhu Xingzheng's hand flew over. He opened the bottle to check, and indeed it was an unquestionable pill made by Su Lingxiu.
He put it away immediately.
Seeing this, Zhu Xingzheng breathed a sigh of relief.
"Hand over your storage bag!"
Then, Red Cat lifted one of his claws, exposing a sharp claw, and beckoned to Zhu Xingzheng.
"Yes, yes!"
Zhu Xingzheng cursed in his heart, but had no choice but to hand over his storage bag obediently.
"Fortunately, I've got a Storage Ring from the young Alliance Hierarch, or else I would have been thoroughly looted."
Zhu Xingzheng felt secretly relieved. His valuable possessions were in the Storage Ring.
The storage bag, which was outdated in Ling Domain, only housed a small part of his collections. He kept this in case one day someone took it away.
"Hand over that ring as well."
Red Cat continued to beckon with his claw.
"Honorable and mighty Demon King, this ring was given to me by my beloved as a token of our love. I beg for your mercy. My beloved has left me, and this is the only thing she left me..."

chapters.title: Chapter 605 - 324: The True Form of the Demon Ancestor, Breakthrough to the Physiognomy Realm_2
chapters.content:
Zhu Xingzheng's heart skipped a beat. What was going on with this fat tiger? Why was it so interested in the storage ring?
Nevertheless, he immediately began to spin a story. It was a keepsake from my dearly beloved, he said, nearly shedding tears by the end.
His story moved many, being regarded as a man of a deep sense of loyalty.
All the spiritual beasts looked at Zhu Xingzheng with sympathetic eyes.
"Hand it over. I'm not going to take your ring."
The Red Cat said, keeping a straight face.
Zhu Xingzheng cursed internally, Why isn't this fat tiger showing any sympathy?
Feeling the piercing gaze, he swallowed hard and handed over the ring.
"Don't worry. The ring crafted by the Alliance Hierarch himself, I had left a mark on it, so others can't discover that there's a space inside."
Zhu Xingzheng calmed his nerves and said, "Respectful Great Demon King, please return my token of love. Without it, I wouldn't know how to keep living..."
"Don't worry, it will be returned to you."
The Red Cat nodded and under Zhu Xingzheng's stunned gaze, the Red Cat removed his mark, transferred everything from the Storage Ring into a storage bag, and threw the Storage Ring back at him.
"Returned it to you!"
Zhu Xingzheng felt like crying but couldn't. He was in great pain, but he could only grimace and express gratitude. "Thank you, Great Demon King!"
"Mmm."
The Red Cat nodded and thought to itself, Did he think he could fool me with that trick?
The Red Cat climbed off its seat, stood upright, walked over to Zhu Xingzheng, hooked him with a huge claw, and turned Zhu Xingzheng pale with fright.
"How much did you pay for the pills?"
Red Cat asked, glaring at him.
"Huh?"
Zhu Xingzheng was startled.
"I know more things than you, so speed it up!"
The Red Cat demanded authoritatively.
"The pill is expensive..."
Zhu Xingzheng wanted to inflate the price of the pills he bought, but he had a sudden hunch that if he made the pills seem too pricey, it might cause a problem.
So he changed his tune and said, "Even though the pill is expensive, I do have some connections. It's buy one, get one free. If Your Majesty needs any, I'm willing to purchase them on your behalf!"
The Red Cat got his point. Buy one get one free. This guy must have some sort of relationship with Chang Qing Pavilion.
"All of you, leave now and carry out my orders. The Demon Clan is newly established and there are numerous matters to attend to. Snow Wolf and the rest of you, draft a charter and hand it over to me."
The Red Cat commanded with a wave of its paw.
"Yes, Your Majesty!"
The spiritual beasts all left to handle various matters. The Demon Clan had just been established and would be quite busy in the following period.
The Red Cat slung an arm around Zhu Xingzheng's shoulder as if he were a little chick, and said, "Come, let's have a good chat..."
Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha also came over.
...
At Jinhe Lake in Da Ze State, on the flying ship of Evergreen Pavilion, Su Lingxiu and Yue'er were discussing where to go next.
"Why don't we go to Sheng Zhou?"
Yue'er suggested after giving it some thought.
"Great Zhou State?"
Su Lingxiu hesitated for a moment and then nodded.
Sheng Zhou, under the control of Great Zhou State, was the only dynasty in Ling Domain comparable to the Transcendent Spirit Sect and not controlled by the Spirit Sect. It was also the only place in the Eighteen States with a martial arts school.
The martial arts schools in Great Zhou were established to select prodigies and serve as the foundation for training strong soldiers for Great Zhou State.
Moreover, there was a royal martial arts academy in the capital of Great Zhou, and every student enrolled there was exceptionally talented. The children of Great Zhou statesmen, with distinguished abilities, also studied in this academy.
"Then let's head to Great Zhou. It will be a good chance to meet some old friends."
Zi Yun's jade token had come from the royal family of Great Zhou. I wondered how she was doing there.
"After Great Zhou, let's go to Yunshan State."
Su Lingxiu thought for a moment and said.
It's been a long time since Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao have arrived at the Ling Domain from the Taimiao Sect, it's about time we get together. After all, we all come from the Inner Domain and have a good relationship with each other.
"We will stay for three more days, and leave after three days."
Su Lingxiu decided.
In the pavilion, Li Xuan exhaled, he had finally completely memorized the pattern of the Tao on the tenth page of the Book of Tai Cang.
"The twelfth page will be more profound, more difficult to remember."
Li Xuan sighed inwardly.
Suddenly, the Daoist Golden Book opened, and golden light emerged from it.
"Your pet, Red Cat, has established the Demon Clan, hailed you as the Ancestor of Demons, and you have obtained the True Form of the Ancestor of Demons!"
Li Xuan paused.
Demon Clan?
"This Red Cat, really did it!"
