Li Xuan silently exclaimed in his heart and then became happy. His cultivation of Red Cat was indeed not in vain, and it didn't let him down!
The True Form of the Ancestor of Demons, unlike the True Form of the God of War, is akin to a clone, and its strength cannot match the true body.
However, the True Form of the Ancestor of Demons is on par with his true body, the stronger the Demon Clan, the stronger the True Form of the Ancestor of Demons, and it can even temporarily increase its strength by gathering the power of the Demon Clan.
There is one limitation, the arts deployed by the True Form of the Ancestor of Demons are all from the Demon Clan, even the Divine Skills are fixed as Demon Clan's Divine Skills.
Moreover, the True Form of the Ancestor of Demons doesn't have a constant form, it could be a humanoid form or could transform into various giant demon forms.
Any Demon Clan arts must be mastered by the True Form of the Ancestor of Demons, and their power will be doubled.
Moreover, the True Form of the Ancestor of Demons has one unique feature, as the Ancestor of Demons, it can pass on its will to all members of the Demon Clan, and even give guidance and inheritance to the demon children and grandchildren in a dreamlike manner.
"I've got to pay more attention to this Demon Martial Arts, the strength of Red Cat isn't strong enough yet, and it hasn't grasped the concept of Great Demon Divine Skills. I have to pass on more Great Demon arts and Great Demon Divine Skills to it."
Li Xuan was thinking to himself and decided to dig deeper into Demon martial arts.
Now that he has the True Form of the Ancestor of Demons, he can pass on some concepts of Great Demon Divine Skills to Red Cat and let it continue to practice and comprehend.
"Who would have thought that the big cat that I caught on a whim, would have such talent."
Li Xuan was full of sighs.
He found that ever since Red Cat started learning to read with Mother Xu, it seemed to become more enlightened, and its intelligence was also continuously increasing. It was truly an educated tiger.
"The direction of Demon Martial Arts has been determined, I don't have to worry about it, but I don't have any Great Demon Divine Skills yet. I need to enrich the techniques of Demon Martial Arts and guide Red Cat more."
Li Xuan was excited inside. If he encounters a strong enemy one day, the opponent may think that they will be evenly matched, but he would suddenly bring out his True Form of the Ancestor of Demons to fight the enemy, and that would surely defeat the enemy within a few minutes.
Just thinking about it is thrilling!
So, Li Xuan temporarily put down the research on the twelfth page of the Book of Tai Cang, and started to enrich the Demon Martial Arts, especially the concept of Demon Clan Divine Skills.
Three days later, the Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship ascended into the sky, heading straight to the Great Zhou State.
Above the clouds, a dazzling flying ship was flying at a speed comparable to that of a Martial Artist who had reached the Spirit Nurturing Stage, without rushing on their journey.
"It's almost time, I hope that Red Cat, won't let me down."
Li Xuan had finally enriched the concepts like Demon Clan Divine Skills, mainly in the form of array diagrams. After all, Red Cat's Great Demon arts were all enlightened from array diagrams.
These array diagrams, Li Xuan compiled them into the Laws of Heaven and Earth, even the last few array diagrams, he incorporated a few rules from the tenth page of the Tai Cang Book.
"Use the True Form of the Ancestor of Demons to give Red Cat a dream? Let this big cat see the means of its master."
Just as Li Xuan was about to use the ability of the True Form of the Ancestor of Demons to contact Red Cat in a dream-like manner, the Daoist Golden Book suddenly opened.
"Your disciple, Xu Yan, has understood the way of the Physiognomy realm, and you have broken through to the Physiognomy realm!"
At this moment, his strength soared dramatically, as if he could control the Laws of Heaven and Earth in an instant.
He broke through to the Physiognomy realm!
Li Xuan was extremely excited, he had finally broken through again.
In the Physiognomy realm, he can truly control the Laws of Heaven and Earth!
With his understanding of the Laws of Heaven and Earth, now that he had broken through to the Physiognomy realm, he could nearly control the Laws of Heaven and Earth at will.
Moreover, when he broke through to the Physiognomy realm, he gained the ability to understand the laws above the Laws of Heaven and Earth.
The Laws of Heaven and Earth are clearly visible to Li Xuan, he can control them with a single thought, transform them into the Divine Appearance of Martial Arts, and use it for himself.
Above the Laws of Heaven and Earth, he could sense a more profound principle.
In a vague sense, it seemed that he could see the operation of the principles corresponding to the tenth page of the Book of Tai Cang.

chapters.title: Chapter 606 - 325: Taimiao Sect Searching for Old Friends_1
chapters.content:
"So this is the subtlety of Dao principles."
With a sigh of realization in his heart, Li Xuan guessed that studying the principles of the Book of Tai Cang would no longer be as exhausting as before. It would become significantly easier.
"Beyond the Divine Appearance Realm lies the Void-Breaking Realm, breaking free from the shackles of the Heaven and Earth Laws. And above the Void-Breaking, approaching Dao principles becomes possible.
"Dao principles are the foundation of Heaven and Earth. The martial artist's own martial arts laws must also be further upgraded to transform into Dao principles of martial artists.
"However, this improvement is not instantaneous. For a martial artist, the body and Primordial Spirit are considered Heaven and Earth..."
With the breakthrough into the Divine Appearance Realm, Li Xuan becomes more enlightened about Dao principles, and he began to have more profound thoughts about the martial arts realm above the Void-Breaking. He now had a theory of martial arts.
He even gained inspiration for the next two or three realms.
"Another busy period lies ahead."
Li Xuan sighed. In the forthcoming time, he would throw himself into the great cause of martial arts, making continuous improvements to the orientation of martial arts, striving to build a stronger theoretical framework.
The Divine Skill Martial Code had yet to be fully perfected.
The subsequent cultivation of Meng Chong's physical martial arts also needed further refining.
"Let's start by passing on the Demon Clan's Divine Skills to Red Cat."
Li Xuan pondered for a moment, then utilized the ability of his Demon Ancestor body, and in a manner like delivering a message through dreams, transmitted the Divine Skills of the Demon Clan to Red Cat.
Heavenly Mausoleum State, within the Demon King Palace.
Red Cat suddenly felt a trance, its consciousness seemingly drifting into a dream where it saw its master.
In this instant, it immediately transformed into a chubby cat, trotting over to its master's side, rubbing against his foot, "Meow!"
Appearing cute to win its master's favor!
Even in its dreams, it remembered to curry favor with its master!
"You are quite an interesting big cat."
Li Xuan chuckled, scruffing Red Cat's chubby head, saying, "Enough, no need to act cute. Since you have established the Demon Clan, I'll pass on the Demon Clan's Divine Skills to you. Remember them, and ponder over them. Grow the Demon Clan stronger."
He paused for a moment, then said, "If you want to fully control those Spirit Beasts, you can safely teach them the laws of Great Demons. It won't get out of control and you can also draw conclusions from it.
"It depends on your abilities now, whether it's successful or not, it's up to you to decide."
Following his words, Li Xuan used a point of Demon Art to transfer the array of the Demon Clan's Divine Skills into Red Cat's consciousness.
After finishing the transfer, Li Xuan rubbed Red Cat's chubby head again, saying: "Alright, carefully ponder it over yourself."
The scene shattered, and Red Cat regained consciousness in a daze. Within its eyes lay some confusion. Was it because it missed its master so much that it had this dream?
Suddenly, its eyes widened. In its consciousness were the patterns of the Demon Clan's Divine Skills; these were given to it by its master.
"Meow meow, Red Cat will definitely strive to make the Demon Clan stronger!"
At this moment, Red Cat understood that its master had clearely understood its establishment of the Demon Clan, thus providing it with the Demon Clan's Divine Skills, allowing it to possess more methods, and further develop the Demon Clan.
After transferring all of his Demon Clan Divine Skills to Red Cat, Li Xuan put his soul and body back into his martial arts cause, enhancing his martial arts theories.
To flesh out the practice theories for the martial arts realms after the Void-Breaking realm, to complete the cultivation methods for physical martial arts after the Indestructible Golden Body of the big day.
To compile the Divine Skill Martial Code and so on.
At the same time, he freed up time every day to study the Heaven and Earth principles of the Book of Tai Cang.
"Martial arts are too difficult. I have to wrack my brains and work hard every day to understand martial arts. Hardly any martial artist works as hard as I do."
Li Xuan sighed internally. Although he didn't need to work hard on cultivation, understanding martial arts was indeed no easy task.
...
As Xu Yan was on his way to Yunshan, he reviewed the principles of martial arts for the Divine Appearance Realm, finally comprehending them completely. He understood martial arts for the Divine Appearance Realm.
"The Void-Breaking Realm is too hard to comprehend. Perhaps only after breaking through to the Divine Skill Realm and truly understanding the mysteries of Divine Skills, will I gain some insight,"
Xu Yan shook his head. Just contemplating the Divine Appearance Realm's martial arts had already taken up a lot of his time.
Developing an understanding of the martial arts for the Void-Breaking Realm with his current martial arts realm was probably not achievable.
He wasn't in a hurry. As of now, after breaking through to the complete realm of the divine element and accumulating deep foundations, he could revisit the matter of understanding the Divine Skill Realm.
"I wonder how Miss Du and Miss Yun are."
Upon arriving at Yunshan, naturally, he would want to go to the Taimiao Sect.
Both Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao, who held Yu Ling, enter the Ling Domain, although they entered the Ling Domain and arrived at the Transcendent Spirit Sect of the Taimiao Sect. However, with the rigidity, hierarchy of the Ling Domain, and the discriminatory attitude towards people from the Inner Domain, life might not be easy for them.
"I wonder where Brother Xie is, I should ask Miss Du and the others."
Since entering the Ling Domain, news of Xie Lingfeng and his father Xie Tianheng has been scarce. Despite Xu Yan's fame spreading through the Ling Domain via Chang Qing Pavilion, and his name shaking the Ling Domain, Xie Lingfeng has never sought out Xu Yan.
"With Brother Xie's aptitude, he should have reached the complete Divine Intent State by now. Without further cultivation techniques, he will not be able to break through."
Xu Yan set off for Taimiao Sect.
Xie Tianheng's father and son, along with Du Yuying and two other women, entered the Ling Domain together. Perhaps he could find out the whereabouts of Xie Lingfeng, heading toward one of the Spirit Sects in the Ling Domain.
In Yunshan, the Battle of the Young Geniuses is in full swing. By now, those who can participate in the Battle of the Young Geniuses are all outstanding talents nurtured by top-tier Spirit Sects.
Everyone has a treasured body talent.
However, for Xu Yan, these so-called prodigies are no longer in his sights.
He doesn't even have the interest to make a move.
Their power level is not on the same level as his.
"So, this is Taimiao Sect."
Standing before the entrance of Taimiao Sect, Xu Yan looked up. The peak of the mountain was obscured by clouds and fog. With his strength, he couldn't see the peak. For some reason, he felt an illusory and unrealistic feeling about the peak.

chapters.title: Chapter 607 - 325: Searching for an Old Acquaintance in Taimiao Sect _2
chapters.content:
"The Taimiao Sect is said to be one of the most rooted and strongest in the Transcendent Spirit Sect, truly possessing a transcendental disposition."
"They seldom interfere in matters of the Spiritual Realm Martial Way World, and their dominion over Yunshan State is not as overbearing as the other sects of the Transcendent Spirit Sect."
Xu Yan walked towards the gate of the Taimiao Sect.
Information about the Taimiao Sect surfaced in his mind.
The Taimiao Sect is mainly comprised of female disciples, and holds extremely high standards for both talent and looks. This inevitably results in fewer Taimiao Sect disciples compared to the other sects of Transcendent Spirit Sect."
As for male disciples, they are rumored to make up only about twenty percent of the Taimiao Sect, and every one of them is undoubtedly handsome."
"The male disciples of the Taimiao Sect are mockingly referred to as 'pretty boys of Taimiao Sect', lacking in masculine spirit…"
Xu Yan muttered to himself. This was the information about the Taimiao Sect that he had gathered."
"Only disciples of Taimiao Sect are allowed past this gate. Outsider men, keep out!"
In front of the Taimiao Sect gate, a beardless, handsome young man stepped in front of Xu Yan.
Xu Yan scrutinized him. The young man was at the peak of the Refining God Heavenly Man stage, with a clean-shaven face and handsome features. His demeanor truly spoke of a 'pretty face.'
"I am Xu Yan, the Sword God, visiting friends in the Taimiao Sect!"
Xu Yan took a step forward and spoke.
Outsider men not being allowed in was no obstacle for him. Xu Yan didn't care much for it.
He would simply have someone notify Miss Du and Miss Yun of his arrival. That should be enough.
"You are Xu Yan?"
The young man's expression instantly changed.
"Indeed!"
Xu Yan nodded.
The man's expression drastically changed, and he hastily retreated, shouting, "Xu Yan is blocking the gate of our Taimiao Mountain. Elders, come quickly!"
As he yelled, he desperately fled into the mountain gate.
Xu Yan: ???
Was there something wrong with this guy? Was he deaf?
Hadn't he already stated that he was here to visit old friends? How on earth did that translate to him blocking the entrance to Taimiao Mountain?
Feeling somewhat perplexed, Xu Yan watched the man's retreating figure disappear into Taimiao Mountain, unsure of what to say.
With no one left at the gate, Xu Yan decided to take a step towards the entrance of Taimiao Sect.
The rule 'Outsider men not allowed in' no longer held today.
Meanwhile, the entire Taimiao Sect was in an uproar!
After the Thousand Martial Hall, was Xu Yan now planning to block the gate of the Taimiao Sect?
"What arrogance!"
"Does Xu Yan think that our Taimiao Sect will be as easily bullied as the Thousand Martial Hall?"
"Elders, allow me to go suppress him!"
"Who is Xu Yan challenging?"
With a still shocked expression, the young man replied, "He came directly to our Taimiao mountain gate, saying he was 'visiting old friends.' That must mean he's here to challenge us and block our sect's entrance. It's fortunate that I ran quickly or I would've ended up as his pawn to show off his might!"
When Xu Yan blocked the Thousand Martial Hall, he used the martial artist guarding the gate to show off his might. If it wasn't for his quick reactions, he might have ended up like that martial artist, being used to show his might and force a duel with the Taimiao Sect genius with a heaven-defying talent.
Xu Yan's fierce reputation precedes him.
After the young man's thoughts ran wild, the more he thought, the more terrified he became. Sweat rolling down his forehead, he was also glad that his quick reactions allowed him to flee into the mountain gate.
The Elder's face hardened at this. How audacious of Xu Yan to think of using the gate keepers to flaunt his might!
She swiftly moved towards the mountain gate.
Behind her were the agitated Taimiao Sect disciples, alongside several other elders.
"Xu Yan, you are insolent!"
Before the elder could reach the mountain gate, she saw Xu Yan casually ascending the mountain. Her anger flared.
"In what way have I been insolent? It's instead your Taimiao Sect that is lacking in propriety. I travelled from afar to pay a visit, is this the way you treat guests?"
"Or perhaps you think that I, Xu Yan, am not worthy of visiting your Taimiao Sect?"
Xu Yan also wore an expression of displeasure. He wasn't here to make a fuss, did they really need to be this confrontational?
"A visit? Aren't you here to block our Taimiao Sect mountain gate?"
The elder's eyes grew cold. Then she furiously continued: "Our Taimiao Sect has rules: outsider men are not allowed in. By stepping foot in our entrance, you have trampled upon Taimiao Sect. Today, we will capture you and unless you regret and repent, don't think of leaving the Taimiao Sect!"
As he spoke, he raised his hand to grab Xu Yan.
The Great Power of Heaven and Earth was focused into his attack, which seemed elusive, making it difficult for one to track its trajectory.
"What's the big deal about stepping into the Taimiao mountain gate? Weren't you the ones who first showed disrespect?"
Xu Yan palmed out.
Roar!
The Golden Giant Dragon burst out sharply, instantly throwing the elder flying out.
He no longer paid any heed to a Martial Artist who had only condensed two wisps of Heavenly Earth Lingji.
A golden giant dragon soared up from the foot of Taimiao mountain. On the dragon's head, a handsome young man was standing proudly!
The disciples of Taimiao mountain, who were originally in outrage, all stared wide-eyed at the golden giant dragon soaring from the foot of the mountain, stunned by the sight of the young man atop its head.
There, before the golden giant dragon, an elder was sent flying backward and slammed onto the ground. This was the elder who had just gone down the mountain to punish.
At this moment, none stepped forth to lend aid, all casting shocked gazes at Xu Yan, who had traveled here on a dragon.
The Taimiao Sect guard, heaved a sigh of relief, grateful for his swift reactions or he would have been the one to suffer. Just as said in the rumors, Xu Yan was indeed savage!
"Xu Yan is indeed handsome!"
From within the crowd, an admiring voice arose!
"Yes, yes, Xu Yan is so handsome, so imposing, so..."
Many of the Taimiao Sect female disciples, let out exclamations of awe.
Male disciples: ...
He is the enemy, elder sisters, can you have a bit of integrity?!!
"I am Xu Yan, and I mean no harm. I am here to visit old friends!"
Xu Yan spoke up.
The golden giant dragon beneath his feet faded away, he landed, looking indifferently at the Taimiao Sect disciples.
"So many beauties, this is a good place to hone my temperament, but I no longer need to hone it now."
Xu Yan sighed internally.
"Xu Yan, whom are you here to visit? Are there those who are acquainted with you among our Taimiao Sect?"
The Taimiao Sect's Elder Protector asked solemnly.
"My old friends are Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao. Where are the two of them now?"
Xu Yan asked.
"Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao?"
The Elder Protector's gathered his eyebrows, unfamiliar with the pair. He looked back and asked the elder who was in charge of the disciple registry, "In Taimiao Sect, are there such disciples?"
"No!"
The elder shook his head.
"Xu Yan, the people you are looking for are not in the Taimiao Sect."
Xu Yan knitted his eyebrows. Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao had successfully entered the Ling Domain using Taimiao Yuling. They should have joined the Taimiao Sect. Could it be because they came from the Inner Domain, that something had happened?
"My two friends hold the Yuling and came here. You should think carefully. Are they truly not here, or has something unspeakable happened?"
Xu Yan's tone became heavy.
"Yuling?"
The Elder Protector was startled. Then he said, "The Taimiao Sect hasn't issued a Yuling for a long time. The arrival of someone holding a Yuling is practically impossible!"
"Xu Yan, your friends must have held a fake Yuling. The Taimiao Sect does not have the people you are looking for!"
Xu Yan frowned. It was impossible for the Taimiao Yuling to be fake. Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao's Yuling were both given by the same person.
Thinking of this, he said in a deep voice, "The Yuling my friends hold was left by Taimiao Xin Mengrou."
"Impudence!"
The Elder Protector was furious. He scolded coldly, "The name of our sect officer is not something you can casually utter! You, Xu Yan are audacious, finding an excuse to provoke the Taimiao Sect. Today, I'll make sure you understand the might of Taimiao!"
Xu Yan's brows knitted, something was not quite right. However, the Elder Protector swung both his hands, scattering petal-like attacks. Each one contained the power of Heavenly Earth Law condensed into it.
In terms of strength, he was a notch higher than the Elder in Charge of Thousand Martial Hall's Sword!
Since he had already made his move, Xu Yan was out of patience. He would get clarity directly from Xin Mengrou anyway.
If they truly had not come to Taimiao Sect, then he would have to go to Yuzhou to investigate with the Zheng royal family.
"The Yuling my friends hold was left by Xin Mengrou. As for its authenticity, let Xin Mengrou come out, and we will know!"
Xu Yan's palm struck out. Eighteen golden giant dragons spun around, slamming towards the Taimiao Sect's Elder Protector. The might of the True Dragon Form Intent, made waves in all directions as if a real dragon was descending.

chapters.title: Chapter 608 - 326: The Phantom Elephant, the Path of the Wise Sword_1
chapters.content:
The elders of the Taimiao Sect, suddenly pale, were stunned at how quickly Xu Yan's strength had grown in just a few short years.
Who among the prodigies of the Ling Domain could match him?
The protector elder's face hardened, sensing a great threat.
"Attack!"
Ignoring the shame of ganging up on a less favored, the other elders took action, directing their attacks towards Xu Yan.
Panic set in amongst the Taimiao Sect disciples as they hastily retreated; collateral damage could leave them severely injured if not dead.
They were struck with awe. How old was Xu Yan, and how terrifying his strength had grown?
"He is amazing, Xu Yan!"
"Yes, he is so handsome and strong!"
"Right, I thought our Junior Brother Yuying was a rare handsome young master, but compared to Xu Yan, he's still lacking!"
"Junior Brother Yuying falls far short, lacking the masculine dominance. Look at Xu Yan, so unyielding, so domineering, so powerful! He commands the True Dragon with a wave of his hand!"
Listening to these comments from their sisters, the male disciples of the Taimiao Sect turned green with envy.
Particularly that "Junior Brother Yuying", he was beside himself!
A huge battle kicked off, shaking the Taimiao Sect - was this powerful offensive from the All Ages Alliance?
With a quick movement, Yarong appeared on the battlefield and was immediately shaken.
Xu Yan?
By now, Yarong had already become a martial artist with the Heavenly Earth Lingji capabilities.
"Bring Xin Mengrou forth, I need answers. Where are Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao? Has the Taimiao Sect been doing something unspeakable?"
Xu Yan spoke coldly.
In the blink of an eye, eighteen gigantic dragons transformed into eighteen massive swords. The radiant sword array surrounded and trapped several elders of the Taimiao Sect.
Did he come here to find someone?!
Yarong was somewhat helpless. Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao were involved in the secret matters of their master, Xin Mengrou. Therefore, these elders were kept in the dark when they joined the Taimiao Sect.
"Stop it!"
With a single movement, Yarong was by Xu Yan's side. "I'll take you to whom you want to see."
Xu Yan raised his eyebrows, the sword array disappeared. He recognized this woman from Taimiao Sect. She was observing the war from afar during the big fight at the gate of Thousand Martial Hall.
"Junior Sister Yarong, you... "
While the protector elder was shocked by Xu Yan's strength, she could not help but look at Yarong with a furrowed brow.
"The old friends of Xu Yan are with our master."
Yarong exhaled and explained.
The protector elder frowned, how was it that she didn't know about this?
However, it appeared that Yarong always served this master as his apprentice. Those two must have been of extraordinary identity.
"But Xu Yan..."
However, when thinking of Xu Yan's arrogance, not only did he violate the Taimiao Sect's unspoken rules and tread unceremoniously into the Sect, but also sent one of the elder flying. This was a direct challenge!
Would the Sect's majesty survive if they let this pass?
"I said it clearly at the entrance, I came to visit old friends. But your guards went on ranting that I, Xu Yan, was here to cause trouble. You can't blame me for this!"
Xu Yan interjected.
Though he did walk into the Taimiao Sect, it was undeniably their fault in the first instance.
Of course, Xu Yan thought for a moment, even if the guards had asked him who he came to visit, they probably wouldn't have found Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao, and he would have still stormed in.
Ultimately, a fight was inevitable.
The protector elder hesitated, sending for the guards at the gate. Xu Yan did not bother to argue; instead, he looked at Yarong and instructed, "Where are they? Lead me there, or invite them to see me."
His purpose for coming here was twofold: to visit old friends and to find out the whereabouts of Xie Lingfeng.
"You... "
Yarong was about to tell Xu Yan to wait while she informed her master, but she suddenly paused mid-sentence, then changed what she was going to say: "Please, follow me."
She turned around and started leading Xu Yan towards the top of the Taimaio mountain peak.
"Junior Sister Yarong, you... "
The protector elder's expression changed. The mountain peak was the core area of the Taimiao Sect. Even regular elders were not permitted to ascend there, let alone a stranger.
However, she was suddenly struck silent, ceasing her objections.
Xu Yan raised his eyebrow. It appeared that someone had secretly conveyed a message. Could it be Xin Mengrou?
Following the tortuous, narrow mountain path towards the peak, the sides were adorned with elegant courtyards, the residences of the Taimiao Sect's elites.
The closer they got to the peak, the more flowers lined the path, increasingly beautiful, blooming lavish colors in the foggy clouds, creating a hazy, dreamlike beauty.
"You can go up by yourself. Below the peak, there are two elegant courtyards, they are the residences of the ones you're looking for."
Yarong stopped and instructed.
"Great!"
Without hesitation or fear of any conspiracy, Xu Yan nodded. His confidence was backed by his power. Even if his strength was not enough to cope with the potential dangers, he also had his master's jade talisman divine skills.
The closer to the peak of Taimiao, the stronger the mysterious feeling, increasing the sense of unreality.
"Hmm?"
Xu Yan suddenly stopped, looking at a certain point on the peak with a slight frown. Something there seemed unusual.
"Is it the secret place of the Taimiao Sect?"
With no intentions of exploring, he understood this was the secret of the Taimiao Sect, and continued making his way up the mountain.
The two courtyards were now visible.
They were elegant courtyards surrounded by blooming flowers, and standing in front of the courtyard gates were two lovely women.
It was Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao.
After years of separation, the two women were more beautiful and charming than ever.
Especially Yun Miaomiao, even more captivating than her time at Wushuang Hall, her beauty was constantly playing with people's heartstrings.
"Young Master Xu!"
Du Yuying revealed a bright smile, her skin flushing.

chapters.title: Chapter 609 - 326: The Phantom Elephant, the Path of the Wise Sword_2
chapters.content:
"Young Master Xu!"
The voice of Yun Miaomiao came, touching his heartstrings directly.
"Miss Du, Miss Yun, it's been a long time."
Xu Yan revealed a smile, taking a step forward, only to abruptly halt!
Something felt wrong!
He drew a deep breath, his gaze turned serious, his consciousness spreading out, still, the scenery he saw didn't seem to have any problems.
"Young Master Xu, come over quickly."
Du Yuying quickly walked over, seemingly to lead him into the courtyard.
Yet, Yun Miaomiao also rushed over. The two women glared at each other mid-way, seemingly arguing about something, but it looked more like their voices were clashing silently.
The expressions on the two ladies' faces turned colder, and their hostile stance towards each other began to exhibit more clearly.
"Young Master Xu knew me first and should catch up with me first!"
"Hmm, when Young Master Xu first came to my Wushuang Pavilion, I entertained him with all my heart. He should catch up with me first."
Immediately afterwards, the two women wanted to settle the dispute with a fight!
Xu Yan frowned, scanning his surroundings, feeling as if he'd fallen into some kind of illusion or dream.
However, what his consciousness and eyes saw all seemed real: the courtyard was genuine, could it be that the only fake things were the two women?
"Something's not right. What kind of trick is this?"
A shiver ran through Xu Yan's heart. This was no regular martial arts attack. Instead, it was kind of illusion, a dream, akin to an illusion technique?
Yet, it was not merely an illusion technique. It was as though it relied on the real environment to form a false dream.
Xu Yan paid no heed to the dispute among the women, nor did he pay attention to their fierce fight. He ignored the beautiful scene that suddenly appeared before him and continued observing this dream-like spectacle.
"Illusion, maze, state of mind…Only by shattering the illusion can I find reality. How could I have been covered by the illusion due to momentary carelessness with my current state.
"This shows that my state of mind is ultimately lacking."
"In the Heart Sword Realm, I have a sword in my heart, and everything can be a sword, including the illusion.
"But after all, I was in the illusion before I launched a counterattack. How can I ignore all of these illusions, all of these unreal things?
"My master said that in the Wisdom Sword Realm, the Wisdom Sword slashes inner demons, Wisdom Sword cuts emotional threads, Wisdom Sword severs the self…slashes all demons, slashes all unknowns.
"With the Wisdom Sword in the heart, purifying self, everything is me, not to be confused, not to confuse myself…"
Some understanding came to Xu Yan's mind. At this moment, his mind was illuminated as if he had understood how to cultivate in the Wisdom Sword Realm.
Once he stepped into the Wisdom Sword Realm, any illusion or any demonic barrier, will be like mirages, with nowhere to hide in his heart.
At this moment, Xu Yan decided to sit down directly, watching the two women fighting, watching their clothes being ripped apart, and their charming postures. Every movement was captivating, and their beautiful bodies presented a seductive scene.
An illusion is not real, but it can indeed show the most beautiful scenery in the world.
It can touch the human heart directly, awakening the most beautiful, or the most evil or scariest side of people's hearts.
Xu Yan didn't rush to get out of the illusion, but directly sensed himself within the illusion, further clarifying the path of cultivating the Wisdom Sword Realm.
This was an opportunity.
After understanding the cultivation path of the Wisdom Sword Realm, when his Heart Sword realm is perfect, he can attempt to break through into the Wisdom Sword Realm.
The profound Wisdom Sword Realm was no longer out of his reach but something he could cultivate!
At this moment, Xu Yan was secretly thrilled. His trip to Taimiao Sect was not in vain!
No matter who was behind this illusion or what their purpose was, it didn't matter anymore. Instead, it gave him some insight and helped him find his way to the Wisdom Sword Realm.
Atop Taimiao Peak, Xin Mengrou was puzzled. What was with Xu Yan? He actually sat down as if watching a play?
And it seemed like he had discovered this illusion?
"Where is the flaw?"
Xin Mengrou was pondering.
Looking at Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao next to her, she had a guess. Maybe it was due to the behavior and attitude of these two women that flaws were revealed?
With a move of her thoughts, the illusion seemed to become more real. The two women fighting initially now approached Xu Yan, as if they wanted him to make a choice.
"It's time to bring this to an end!"
Xu Yan mumbled to himself. Raising his hand, he swung a sword down without hesitation and in a straightforward manner. Under this one sword, the two women instantly disintegrated.
Xin Mengrou raised her eyebrows when she saw this. He was rather decisive. What if the person was real?
Furthermore, he showed no change in complexion when he made his move, not a hint of hesitation. Like a beautiful woman was just a skeleton, he didn't feel the slightest bit of pity.
Xu Yan took a step, mountains and rivers emerging underfoot, shattering like shadows in a dream. No big changes occurred in the scenery before his eyes, but it was no longer illusionary, but genuine.
Two elegant courtyards were there, but without Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao, he still spotted two other acquaintances.
Cui'er and Wushuang.
"Young Master Xu?!"
Cui'er rubbed her eyes, her face filled with disbelief. She quickly flushed, then rushed over.
"Young Master Xu, is it really you? I've missed you so much!"
Cui'er was incredibly excited and didn't even remember to notify her mistress.
The little girl had changed a bit. She seemed to have become prettier, and her strength had greatly improved, too.
She had reached the Great Heavenly Being Realm.
Although she'd only just entered the Great Heavenly Realm, considering Cui'er's current age, her Cultivation Realm was not bad. It was comparable to some ordinary talents.
Wushuang pursed her lips. The little kid had actually run to the Taimiao Sect, and he was even permitted to come here.
"This guy's fame in the Ling Domain is quite significant. Known as the number one talent of the Ling Domain, his reputation for being fierce is widespread. Yet, he still remembers these two girls. I guess he's a sentimental person." Wushuang mumbled to herself.
"I wonder how his master is doing."
The master of Xu Yan, that mysterious expert, should be above the strongest, right?
"It's Cui'er, isn't it?"
Xu Yan smiled and asked, "Where is Miss Du?"
"Miss Du is at the peak, with Ancestor Grandma."
As Ye Cui'er held on to her dress hem, about to invite Young Master Xu into the courtyard for a chat, she saw Xu Yan raise his head to look at the peak and say, "Then I'll go find Miss Du. You should know the whereabouts of Brother Xie, shouldn't you?"
Without waiting for Cui'er's response, Xu Yan stepped forward and went straight to the peak.
Cui'er was dumbfounded, and Wushuang was also taken aback. She muttered under her breath, "This kid Xu Yan came here to find out Xie Lingfeng's whereabouts. He really doesn't understand a woman's heart!"
"I've heard that Xin Mengrou of the Taimiao Sect is very strong. My name is Xu Yan, and I came to learn!"
Under the shocked gazes of Ye Cui'er and Wushuang, a golden giant dragon appeared under Xu Yan's feet. It roared and rushed towards the peak.
As if he was riding a dragon, Xu Yan held a longsword in his hand. His Sword Intent surged, and the fierce intent to kill pointed straight to the peak!
Although the previous illusion had given him inspiration and made him enlightened about the cultivation path of the Wisdom Sword Realm, he was not the kind of person to get hit without fighting back. Even if Xin Mengrou did not make a move, and only probed with illusions...
For Xu Yan, this was also a provocation. How could he not respond?
At the top of the peak, Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao suddenly woke up from their cultivation. They looked at the golden giant dragon soaring into the sky, and the teenager standing proudly on the head of the dragon.
While feeling excited, they couldn't help but worry.
They glanced at Ancestor Grandma next to them. They couldn't see her face or her expression, making their hearts even more apprehensive.
"Everyone says Xu Yan is mad, indeed he is!"
The voice of Xin Mengrou was elusive as if it was part of a fantasy, flower petals cascading from the peak. Each petal represented a strand of the Heaven and Earth Laws' power.
With so many petals falling like rain, they were dreamy and elusive, but they also contained chilling killing intent.
"So strong!"
Xu Yan's heart tightened; Xin Mengrou was the strongest person he had met, aside from Wu Tianan.
Of course, as to how strong Wu Tianan's actual strength was, Xu Yan couldn't judge because he hadn't seen him make a move. When he first saw Wu Tianan, he felt that he was an old schemer, as if he was hiding some of his strength.
Roar!
The golden giant dragon roared, its draconic aura surged violently, and Xu Yan's hand swung, slashing out with his sword. The sword light boomed out like a wheel of life and death, the Sword Intent raging.
Pew! Pew!
The petals shattered one by one, and the sword light continuously broke apart. The golden giant dragon was already riddled with holes.
Bang!
The golden giant dragon shattered, the sword light dimmed, but the petals continued to fall.
Whoosh!
Without any warning, the stones and plants under Xu Yan's feet turned into sharp swords, soaring into the sky, and slashing at the falling petals. Moreover, the number of swords became more and more, and the flood of ten thousand swords was about to be launched.

chapters.title: Chapter 610 - 327: Meeting Old Friends, King Qing's Mansion of Great Zhou_1
chapters.content:
The torrent of thousands of swords hadn't been launched yet, the petals floating down from the peak had disappeared, and Xin Mengrou's voice came: "Enough, the plants here in the Taimiao Sect are not for you to waste like this."
If they continued to clash, regardless of the outcome, the mountain stones and vegetation on the peak would probably disappear and leave a barren mountaintop.
Left with no choice, Xu Yan, who had been about to transform everything into swords, had to stop.
Two charming figures descended from the peak.
"Young Master Xu!"
"Young Master Xu!"
Xu Yan nodded, these were the genuine Miss Du and Miss Yun.
"Wait a moment while I take a look up there."
Xu Yan did not abandon his intention to ascend to the peak.
"Young Master Xu, I fear it would be best not to. Ancestor Grandma doesn't see outsiders."
Fearing that she might upset Ancestor Grandma, Du Yuying gently tried to persuade him.
"Indeed, Young Master Xu, it's best not to disturb Ancestor Grandma."
Yun Miaomiao also tried to dissuade him.
Raising an eyebrow, Xu Yan observed that the relationship between Xin Mengrou and these two women seemed unusually close – one referred to her as Ancestor Grandma, the other as Ancestor Grandma Guru. From this, it appeared that Du Yuying was a descendant of Xin Mengrou.
And Yun Miaomiao's lineage also owed to Xin Mengrou.
"I just want to pay her a visit, it's no big deal. You don't need to worry. She's one of the two strongest people I've encountered in the Spiritual Realm. Naturally, I want to see her."
As Xu Yan said this, he continued heading towards the peak.
Swoosh!
A beautiful figure appeared, standing right in front of Xu Yan.
Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao were shocked, hurriedly saluting, "Ancestor Grandma!"
Looking at Xin Mengrou, Xu Yan was a bit surprised. She seemed encased in a dream, emitting an unreal feeling, her face obscured and unclear.
However, she must undoubtedly be a woman of peerless beauty.
His eyes focused, and in that moment, it seemed as if he saw through numerous dreams, beholding her true face.
At this sight, Xu Yan was astounded. He turned to look at Du Yuying.
Du Yuying's face bore a strong resemblance to Xin Mengrou's.
The bloodline had reverted back to its origin. No wonder Du Yuying had such a strong talent.
"Your cultivation technique is rather mystical. It's the most unique, mystical martial arts technique I've ever seen in the Ling Domain."
Xu Yan paused before saying blue and Xu Mengrou's.
The cultivation method that Xin Mengrou was practicing was very mystical and unique, the most profound technique that he had ever seen in the martial arts of the Ling Domain.
"You're somewhat extraordinary, able to see my true face."
Compared to Xu Yan's calmness, Xin Mengrou was much more shocked.
Xu Yan had actually seen through her dream and seen her true face. She knew that unless she herself revealed her true face willingly, even Wu Tianan would not be able to see it.
"It's not difficult."
Xu Yan casually remarked.
After pondering for a moment, Xin Mengrou asked, "Who is the other of the two strongest people you've encountered? Your master?"
"How can you compare to the strength of my master? Compared to him, you're nothing more than a tiny ant. Not worth mentioning at all.
"The other person I mentioned is the Dean of the Wuxing Martial Arts Academy, Wu Tianan."
Xu Yan provocatively replied.
This Xin Mengrou was getting a little arrogant, even perceiving herself as on par with his master?
For a moment, Xin Mengrou didn't know what to say. This Xu Yan was far too arrogant, comparing herself to an insignificant ant in comparison to his master?
"With your limited experience, it's only natural for you to think your master is the strongest."
Xin Mengrou shook her head, deciding not to engage with this, she didn't get angry.
"What do you think of Wu Tianan's strength compared to mine?"
After pondering, Xu Yan said, "I believe you might not be his match. Dean Wu has met my master. He must have received guidance from him and undoubtedly enhanced his strength."
Xin Mengrou gave a wry smile. In the end, he was still praising his master.
"If fate permits, I'll have to pay a visit to your master!"
Having said that, Xin Mengrou rose lightly into the air and returned to the mountaintop.
Since he had seen her now, Xu Yan didn't persist in going to the mountaintop. Xin Mengrou had come down willingly to meet him, indicating that the peak concealed certain secrets that outsiders like him could not access.
In Du Yuying's courtyard, old friends reunited, and naturally engaged in reminiscence.
Cui'er was too excited, her face flush, as she served them tea and the cakes she had personally made.
Wushuang, sitting by her disciple, wore a helpless expression. Now that Xu Yan was here, her disciple's heart had completely moved to him.
After a considerable length of time spent reminiscing, Xu Yan asked about Xie Lingfeng's whereabouts.
"I don't know which Spirit Sect the jade commands held by Elder Xie and Young Master Xie belong to, I didn't feel it was appropriate to ask at the time. However, King Qing of the Great Zhou State said he would escort Elder Xie and his son to..."
Du Yuying said apologetically.
"Is that so?"
Xu Yan's brows slightly furrowed. Based on this, he would need to go to Great Zhou State and find King Qing or Zi Yun to learn about Xie Lingfeng's whereabouts.
"Senior Sister Yarong should know something. I'll ask Senior Sister Yarong about it."
At this thought, Yun Miaomiao stood up hastily, "Young Master Xu, please wait a moment, I'll be back shortly."
"I'm indebted to Miss Yun."
Xu Yan expressed his thanks.
"No trouble at all, Young Master Xu. There's no need to be formal."
Yun Miaomiao hurried off.
"Miss Du has progressed quite swiftly in her strength. Are you going to participate in the competition of geniuses?"
Xu Yan asked with a smile.
Du Yuying had surprisingly reached the peak of Refining God Heavenly Man realm, her strength surpassing Wushuang's.
Yun Miaomiao was also at the peak of the Refining God Heavenly Man realm. This level of strength, in the Transcendent Spirit Sect, was considered that of top geniuses.
"As far as the competition of geniuses is concerned, Young Master Xu naturally takes precedence. Yuying simply wishes to participate."
Du Yuying responded with a gentle smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 611 - 327: Meeting Old Friends, King Qing's Mansion of Great Zhou_2
chapters.content:
"Miss Du, your power is indeed top-notch amongst the prodigies in Ling Domain. Don't belittle yourself."
Xu Yan took out a few bottles of elixirs that greatly enhance the practice of the divine soul.
At this moment, Yun Miaomiao had returned, accompanied by Yarong.
"You're really from the inner domain?"
Yarong looked at Xu Yan with disbelief.
Once Yun Miaomiao had asked her about the origin of Xie Lingfeng's Yu Ling, she had thought of Xu Yan and decided to come along.
"Is there a problem?"
Xu Yan responded indifferently.
Yarong was silent for a moment before she sighed, "The inner domain has actually produced a freak like you."
Yun Miaomiao appeared apologetic. She hadn't expected Yarong to guess that Xu Yan was from the inner domain.
Xu Yan didn't mind. It was only a matter of time before his origin from the inner domain would be revealed. Moreover, the Gate of Lingyu has been sealed by his master so no one could enter anyways, and there's no need to worry about the destruction in the inner domain.
"The Yu Ling held by the father and son of the Xie Family is actually the Yuntian Yu Ling, which comes from the Azure Sea City of Yuntian."
Yarong didn't persist in questioning about Xu Yan's origin from the inner domain.
"Azure Sea City of Yuntian?"
Xu Yan expressed surprise. The Azure Sea City of Yuntian was one of the Transcendent Spirit Sect, different from the Thousand Martial Hall, the Lei Yun Mountain Manor, and the Yu Ling Mansion. It wasn't located among the eighteen states of Ling Domain, but in the Azure Sea.
It was located on the largest island of the Azure Sea and was also the first city of the sea, ruling over endless islands. In a sense, the Sea Spirit Tribe was also under the rule of Azure Sea City, earning it the title of Sacred Land of the Overseas.
"Correct, if you want to find them, I'm afraid you'll have to go to Azure Sea City of Yuntian."
Yarong nodded.
After finishing her sentence, she left to meet her master at the peak without disturbing others. Meanwhile, Xu Yan, realizing that Xie Lingfeng had gone to Azure Sea City of Yuntian, decided he should journey to Azure Sea next. Rumor had it that the sea harbored divine objects.
It would be a perfect opportunity for him to gather resources to build his foundation for the breakthrough to the Divine Skill Realm.
"These elixirs, I will gift them to the two ladies,"
Xu Yan divided the elixirs and presented them to the two women.
"Thank you, Young Master!"
Both Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao were overjoyed.
"What about me, Young Master Xu?"
Cui'er asked, blinking her eyes.
"Here you go!"
Xu Yan handed a bottle of elixir to her.
"Thank you, Young Master!"
Cui'er was absolutely delighted.
"Are you two attempting to refine the Heavenly Earth Lingji?"
Xu Yan pondered for a moment before asking.
"Yes."
Du Yuying nodded, sighed softly, and said: "Refining the Heavenly Earth Lingji is somewhat difficult, I hope we could complete it before the final battle of the prodigy dispute."
"Although the Heavenly Earth Lingji is ubiquitous and detectible, refining it into the divine soul is a challenging feat."
Yun Miaomiao sighed as well.
"In fact, refining the Heavenly Earth Lingji isn't that difficult."
Xu Yan thought for a while, then said: "My master once guided others in this respect. If you two ladies do not mind, I can share his method with you."
Upon hearing Xu Yan's words, both Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao were overjoyed. They hurriedly nodded and said: "We're certain that the method from such a predecessor would definitely be extraordinary. We would appreciate if you could guide us, Young Master Xu."
Both women knew that the martial arts practiced by Xu Yan was different from that of the Ling Domain.
Xu Yan didn't need to refine the Heavenly Earth Lingji at all. The method was casually invented by the old predecessor when guiding others.
The high realm of the predecessor was truly unimaginable.
Xu Yan then shared the method of refining the Heavenly Earth Lingji with the two women, followed by a long conversation about the past events concerning the Chang Qing Pavilion and ind the All Ages Alliance.
Afterward, Xu Yan bid them farewell and departed.
The two women watched him leave, reluctant to say goodbye. They probably wouldn't meet again until the final battle of the prodigy dispute.
Xu Yan descended the mountain. The trip had been quite fruitful and he had found out where Xie Lingfeng had gone.
"I should return to Chang Qing Pavilion before heading to Azure Sea City of Yuntian."
A thought came to Xu Yan's mind.
"Where is your master?"
A figure suddenly appeared.
Xin Mengrou!
Xu Yan raised an eyebrow, "My master is in Chang Qing Pavilion. If you want to see him, you can go and try. However, I can't guarantee if my master will see you or not."
Xin Mengrou didn't say anything, her figure moved and vanished from the spot.
...
The capital of the Great Zhou State, King Qing's Mansion.
The Qing King lineage is one of the nine royal linages of the Great Zhou dynasty, which has already fallen. However, the current generation of King Qing possesses remarkable aptitude and exceeds others in stratagem, showing signs of rejuvenating the lineage of King Qing's Mansion.
Xiang Qing has condensed the Heavenly Earth Lingji into his Divine Soul and even managed to refine three strands of Heavenly Earth Lingji, making him one of the strongest individuals in the Great Zhou State.
Although not the strongest, he could nevertheless support the continuous expansion of the King Qing's Mansion.
Some years ago, King Qing Xiang Qing brought back a young girl from outside and adopted her as his foster daughter, known as Commandery Princess Zi Yun.
There were rumors that Commandery Princess Zi Yun had arrived during the opening of the Gate of Lingyu, holding a jade order left by the predecessor King Qing. Despite her exceptional talent, rumors about her origination from a lower Inner Domain brought her occasional odd looks.
However, Commandery Princess Zi Yun was determined and is now in the later stages of the Refining God Heavenly Man realm. Her strength is also notable among those in the same realm.
Xiang Qing only has one son, who, rumor has it, has been sent to Yuntian Azure Sea City for intense cultivation. The younger generation of King Qing's Mansion currently relies entirely on Zi Yun.
As King Xiang's adopted daughter, no one in King Qing's Mansion dares to be disrespectful to her. However, most of the descendants of the other eight royal linages of the Great Zhou royal family ostracize her, and Zi Yun has always been unable to fit into the circle of the royal family's children.
Even the descendants of some Great Zhou ministers, who show respect to Zi Yun on the surface, often look down upon her behind her back.
Zi Yun didn't mind this, only focusing on improving her strength.
"Father."
Zi Yun ran into Xiang Qing's study.
"Zi Yun, have you been bullied by someone again?"
Xiang Qing's eyebrows furrowed slightly. He was somewhat discontented with the other eight royal lineages' descendants. Ostracizing Zi Yun was tantamount to ostracizing his lineage of King Qing.
Yet, although he had condensed the Heavenly Earth Lingji into his Divine Soul, his strength still couldn't compete with the strongest members of the other eight royal lineages, making it hard for him to stand firm.
"No, I don't care about them at all."
Zi Yun, clenching her dress' hem, replied, "Chang Qing Pavilion has come to our Great Zhou State. Rumor has it that they will be in the capital soon, and I want to go and purchase some elixirs for cultivation."
The elixirs from Chang Qing Pavilion are renowned throughout the Lingyu, but they are expensive, and it's not guaranteed that you can buy them even if you have the money. The pavilion master's mood dictates everything.
"Oh, in that case, let Steward Aqiu accompany you."
Xiang Qing nodded his approval.
Zi Yun is in the late stage of the Refining God Heavenly Man, only one step away from reaching the peak. With the help of elixirs, she should be able to make a breakthrough in a short time.
"It's hard to purchase elixirs from Chang Qing Pavilion. You may not be able to buy them on your trip there."
Xiang Qing thought for a moment and said.
"Don't worry, Father, I'm sure I can buy them."
Zi Yun confidently rebutted.
She could hardly wait to go to Chang Qing Pavilion. "I wonder if Meng Chong is there, I haven't seen him for so long, I miss him so much. Meng Chong is the best."
"If Meng Chong were there, I would beat those bastards to death."
Zi Yun thought angrily.
"Here are a few divine-grade spiritual medicines. You can use them to purchase elixirs."
Xiang Qing, indifferent towards Zi Yun's confidence, handed her a storage bag.
"Thanks, Father!"
Zi Yun took the storage bag and left in a hurry. She found Steward Aqiu in King Qing's Mansion, and together they left the capital of Great Zhou State, heading towards the current location of Chang Qing Pavilion.
In the capital of Great Zhou State, in a certain royal mansion.
"Princely Heir, that girl from King Qing's Mansion has left the capital."
"Oh, she left the capital? Good, let those people take action. King Qing brought degradation upon himself, we cannot let our Great Zhou royal bloodline be tainted because of him.
"A girl from a lower region doesn't deserve to be a commandery princess of Great Zhou."
"What if King Qing finds out..."
"Clean up afterwards. The Lingyu is unstable right now, the All Ages Alliance wants to overturn the Spirit Sect's rule. They are audacious. Assassinating a Zhou commandery princess wouldn't be surprising."
"Understood. However, if we make a move and Steward Aqiu is there from King Qing's Mansion, won't we..."
"As long as we don't reveal that the assassination is from our Great Zhou royal family, we're fine. If possible, kill her and leave no trace!"
"Yes, I understand!"
"Prepare to go to Chang Qing Pavilion and pay a visit to the fairy herb-doctor."
"Yes, Princely Heir."
The news of Chang Qing Pavilion's arrival in Great Zhou has long been spread throughout the whole state. Many of the powerful, especially those with old injuries, are preparing to go to Chang Qing Pavilion.
Not a few from the Great Zhou royal family are preparing to go to Chang Qing Pavilion.
A few thousand li away from the capital of Great Zhou, a burly man was striding along, his bald head reflecting dazzling light under the sun.
"This Great Zhou is indeed prosperous. I wonder how that woman Zi Yun's doing."
Meng Chong touched his bald head and muttered to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 612 - 328: Meng Chong Takes Action, Tang Jinyan's Move_1
chapters.content:
Leaving Dachuan, Meng Chong traversed the Ling Domain and arrived in the Great Zhou State in Shengzhou. He thought of Zi Yun, an old acquaintance from the Inner Domain, and decided to pay her a visit.
"Even though I entered with a Yu Ling, will the royal family of Da Zhou treat me with the same coldness as they did at Spirit Sect?"
Meng Chong mumbled to himself. After all, he and Zi Yun had quite a deep friendship. If he couldn't stay, he could always go to Chang Qing Pavilion.
He was on good terms with his junior sister apprentice.
Doing odd jobs at Chang Qing Pavilion would be better than facing constant rejection from the Da Zhou royal family, right?
With these thoughts in mind, Meng Chong increased his pace. However, he didn't fly into the air towards Da Zhou's capital city, but instead, continued to walk there in large strides.
Boom!
Suddenly, a fierce battle between martial artists erupted not far to his left. Those involved were of substantial strength, almost equivalent to a martial artist who has cultivated the Heavenly Earth Lingji.
"How dare you, who are you people?"
A roar of anger resounded, followed by the explosive force of a martial artist who cultivated the Heavenly Earth Lingji.
The fight suddenly intensified with a sudden burst of aura from the attacker.
"Huh? These are suicidal warriors?"
Meng Chong was surprised. The aura of these warriors was tinged with deathly air, similar to those old timers from the Thousand Martial Hall.
"Interesting. Are they trying to kill that Lingji martial artist?"
Meng Chong shook his head, he had no interest in the spectacle. Such assassinations and revenge killings were frequently staged in the Ling Domain, and he'd already witnessed it several times.
However, he'd never encountered such a powerful assassination attempt before.
"This is bad!"
The martial artist who cultivated Heavenly Earth Lingji had a grave tone, his aura exploding to its peak.
"Commandery Princess Zi Yun, run!"
Suddenly, the martial artist made a forceful strike, breaking through the enemy's encirclement and pushed one person out of the killing circle, then he gave it his all to buy more time for the protected person to escape.
"Steward Aqiu!"
A scream of shock echoed, quickly followed by a figure cloaked in purple, attempting to escape at a rapid speed.
"You can't escape. When my All Ages Alliance wants to kill someone, we will not allow them to escape."
A cold voice rang out as an elderly figure appeared, blocking the path of the purple figure.
"You..."
Zi Yun's face turned pale. She never, ever thought that she would be ambushed on her way to Chang Qing Pavilion.
The enemy clearly had been plotting this for quite some time!
Even someone as strong as Steward Aqiu would probably not fare well!
Even though she knew she was no match, Zi Yun was unwilling to surrender. Just as she was preparing to fight to the death, a suddenly a huge fist came soaring upwards from below.
"Who is it!"
The old man blocking Zi Yun's path had a drastic change of expression, his aura erupted as he was about to escape. However, that punch was too fast and too powerful, leaving him no room to dodge or fight back.
Boom!
He was blown up instantly, reduced to ashes.
Zi Yun was shocked. Such a furious punch reminded her of someone.
"Meng Chong!"
She turned her gaze to where the punch originated from, her face plastered with disbelief.
The well-built figure and the bald head, these were unmistakably the traits of Meng Chong!
Meng Chong originally didn't want to meddle, but when he heard Zi Yun's name, he couldn't help but feel a sudden stir in his heart, thinking how could it be such a coincidence?
Indeed, Zi Yun was being chased to be killed.
He stepped forward without hesitation, instantly killing that old man.
Moreover, the man intended to frame the Wan Shi Alliance warriors, this was a setup!
Even though he wasn't part of the Wan Shi Alliance, his junior brother Fang Hao was the Young Master of the Wan Shi Alliance, and the future Alliance Hierarch of the Wan Shi Alliance.
He had a deep connection with the Wan Shi Alliance.
Zi Yun was thrilled and excited, she rushed over and practically threw herself into Meng Chong's arms.
"Wuwu... Meng Chong, it's really you. I almost thought I would never see you again!"
Meng Chong had a helpless expression on his face, why is she hanging all over him again?
"Meng Chong, hurry up, save Steward Aqiu."
Zi Yun quickly raised her head to speak.
"Alright!"
Meng Chong soared into the air, and in the blink of an eye, he had arrived at the battlefield.
At the moment, Steward Aqiu was covered in wounds and was close to succumbing.
Boom!
Meng Chong threw a punch, causing wild, thunderous uproar. The power of his giant fist obliterated all the attackers instantly.
Steward Aqiu, known as A Qiu, was stunned. He turned his head and noticed Zi Yun hanging onto a muscular man, which surprised him.
"Princess Zi Yun!"
"I'm fine."
Zi Yun breathed a sigh of relief, but after seeing Steward Aqiu's severe injuries, she realized that if he wasn't treated promptly, it could lead to foundational damage.
"Meng Chong, do you have any healing pellets?"
Zi Yun asked.
"Here you go!"
Meng Chong handed her a bottle of pellets and said with a helpless look, "Can you please stop clinging onto me."
Zi Yun happily climbed off Meng Chong and handed a pellet to Steward Aqiu, saying, "Steward Aqiu, quickly treat your injuries."
"What is this?"
Steward Aqiu was stunned. Considering his injuries, he hastily swallowed the pellet and turned to Meng Chong asking, "Princess Zi Yun, who is this?"
"An old friend of mine."
Zi Yun's excited face flushed red. After giving Steward Aqiu the pill, she continued, " Steward Aqiu, you should go back to the imperial city. Inform my father about this matter and have him escort me to Chang Qing Pavilion. There wouldn't be any more accidents."
Steward Aqiu hesitated, but Zi Yun urged him saying, "Hurry back. He's much stronger than you."
"Alright. Please be careful, Princess Zi Yun."
Steward Aqiu did not insist any further.
As soon as Steward Aqiu left, and there were no outsiders left, Zi Yun excitedly jumped up, hugged Meng Chong, and asked: "Meng Chong, did you come to find me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 613 - 328: Meng Chong Makes a Move, Tang Jinyan's Actions_2
chapters.content:
"That sums it up, I guess."
Meng Chong slapped his lips, "You seem to be having a good life."
"Pretty okay. I'm now part of the King Qing of the Great Zhou dynasty lineage. My adoptive father is King Qing. But the rest of the imperial family of the Great Zhou, they look down on me, thinking I come from the inferior Inner Domain, disgraceful to their Great Zhou.
"Humph! Once I become powerful, I will humiliate them one by one by stomping their faces on the ground. Let's see if they dare to underestimate me then."
Zi Yun said coldly.
"I was lucky to run into you, Meng Chong this time. Otherwise, I'd have been in danger. The All Ages Alliance is detestable, thinking that the Qing Wang Mansion is easy to bully, so they targeted me, didn't they?"
Thinking about the crisis just now, Zi Yun was so angry, she gritted her teeth.
"It doesn't have anything to do with the All Ages Alliance, the technique of the suicide squad is more likely from a top-ranked Spirit Sect, or even the Transcendent Spirit Sect."
Meng Chong shook his head and said.
"Where are you headed?"
He asked Zi Yun.
"Heading to the Chang Qing Pavilion. I missed you, and Lingxiu...and senior."
Since Meng Chong said it had nothing to do with the All Ages Alliance, she stopped dwelling on the issue.
"In that case, let's go together. I was planning to pay a visit to the Chang Qing Pavilion anyway."
Meng Chong nodded his head.
The two left the battlefield and set off for Chang Qing Pavilion's current location.
"Meng Chong, you're so impressive. Even in Great Zhou, I've heard of your fame."
Zi Yun said with admiration in her eyes.
"Oh, it's not a big deal. I'm just second."
Meng Chong chuckled.
Emperor Da Zhou's Palace, Qing Wang Mansion.
"What did the attacker look like?"
Xiang Qing asked Aqiu gloomily.
"The identity information they leaked...comes from the All Ages Alliance..."
Aqiu described the details of the attack.
"Hmph!"
Xiang Qing's eyes gleamed coldly, "The All Ages Alliance? If they wanted to target the Great Zhou, would they choose Zi Yun? My adoptive daughter's background is no one's business to comment on.
"They really think I, Xiang Qing, don't have a temper, right?"
"What does the prince mean?"
Aqiu looked surprised, could the attacker have come from the imperial family of the Great Zhou?
Xiang Qing took a deep breath and asked solemnly, "The person who came to the rescue, what did he look like? Do you know his identity?"
Aqiu pondered for a moment, then said, "Prince, I seem to recall someone, but I find it somewhat hard to believe."
"Oh, who?"
"The Blade Master, Meng Chong!"
He was tall, burly, and bald, a dead giveaway. It was clearly Meng Chong, who was famously known as the second prodigy of the Ling Domain!
However, he found it hard to believe.
Was Meng Chong so powerful?
The power of his fist was so enormous that even he, a warrior who had cultivated a strand of Heavenly Earth Lingji, would be blown to pieces!
"Meng Chong!"
Xiang Qing paused as if he had thought of something. Astonished, he realized that Zi Yun and Meng Chong were old acquaintances, which could only mean one thing: Meng Chong came from the Inner Domain!
Such a monstrous figure had emerged from the Inner Domain!
"The information about Meng Chong coming to the rescue is not to be leaked. Tell the outside that it was an anonymous Loose Cultivator who came to her rescue."
Xiang Qing said after some thought.
"Yes, my Prince!"
Aqiu responded with respect.
...
Yuzhou, within a city once ruled by the Su Family, Tang Jinyan looked at the person she was in search of, feeling a mix of excitement and nervousness.
Emperor Zi Yun carefully genuflected without daring to look directly at the distinguished person above him.
Since he had entered the Ling Domain, he thought he would be able to cultivate stronger Martial Arts with the help of the Yu Ling, and become a powerful figure. However, the reality was a far cry from his expectations.
He had directly become the most lowly servant!
How could he accept being reduced to a servant when he was once a powerful emperor?
After getting severely beaten a few times, he had recognized the situation and was very regretful. He shouldn't have entered the Ling Domain; even if he had surrendered to the Dahua in the Inner Domain, he would have been respected and had a high status.
He wanted to obtain the Heavenly Man Martial Arts, but how could he, a lowly servant, be eligible to attain it?
Fortunately, the Su family went extinct in no time.
Even though he became a Loose Cultivator, his situation seemed to improve somewhat, which made him feel both grief and joy. Eventually, he got what he wanted: the way of the Heavenly Man Martial Arts, and finally managed to break through to the Small Heavenly Man Realm.
However, in the Ling Domain, the Heavenly Man Realm was considered no more than an average warrior. Above the Small Heavenly Man was the Greater Heavenly Man, and above them was the exalted Refining God Heavenly Man Realm.
Later, word spread of an even stronger supreme being.
The Purple Cloud Emperor even considered returning to the Inner Domain and, with his own Lesser Heavenly Man strength, reigning supreme there. However, he had no way of opening the Gate of Lingyu.
Over the years, he mixed with Loose Cultivators, gradually adapting to the identity, also deliberately hiding his identity from the Inner Domain.
However, he was being hunted by a high-ranking member of the Spiritual Sect today, which terrified him beyond measure.
Tang Jinyan stared at the Purple Cloud Emperor indifferently, her cold voice ringing out. "Do you know about Chang Qing Pavilion? And Xu Yan?"
"I...don't know!"
The Purple Cloud Emperor shook his head.
Xu Yan, swept through the Inner Domain unopposed, and upon arriving in the Ling Domain, he blocked the entrance to the Transcendental Spirit Sect within a short time. How monstrous is he?
In any case, he must not be offended.
Even, if given the opportunity to meet, he might obtain some opportunities due to their shared origins from the Inner Domain.
"You come from the Inner Domain, how could you not know?"
Tang Jinyan laughed coldly, her eyes indifferent. "I'll give you a chance. Tell the truth, and you can join the Spirit Sect, becoming a Spiritual Sect Warrior. The treatment is worlds apart.
"Don't think that with the All Ages Alliance, Loose Cultivators can turn the tables. Think it over carefully."
By the end of her speech, an undercurrent of murderous intent surfaced, scaring the Purple Cloud Emperor into trembling uncontrollably.
"I, I really don't know, I'm just an inferior person from the Inner Domain, how could I know a monster like Xu Yan?"
The Purple Cloud Emperor stammered.
"Without evidence, how could I find you? Initially, I had sent people into the Inner Domain!"
Tang Jinyan laughed coldly.
The Purple Cloud Emperor got a fright, immediately feeling a force converging over his head, as if ready to strike him at any time.
"Speak, the Pavilion Master's identity in the Inner Domain, Xu Yan's identity in the Inner Domain…"
Tang Jinyan spoke coldly, her voice full of murderous intent. "If you tell, you will be rewarded. If you don't tell, you die!"
"I'll talk, I'll talk!"
The Purple Cloud Emperor gave up, if he continues to deny, he will surely die.
"Chang Qing Pavilion is founded by the granddaughter of the Medicine King of the Inner Domain, Su Zhen, Xu Yan is her fellow student. They both have a mysterious master behind them..."
The Purple Cloud Emperor spoke tremblingly.
Tang Jinyan's expression didn't change but shock welled up in her heart. Xu Yan and Su Lingxiu were fellow disciples, what about Meng Chong?
"What about Meng Chong?"
She asked in a heavy tone.
"Meng Chong is Xu Yan's junior, they are fellow students."
The Purple Cloud Emperor spilled everything he knew about them, especially about the mysterious master.
"What about Fang Hao?"
Tang Jinyan asked again.
These few people, who had suddenly risen to power in Lingyu, were monstrous. Fang Hao's methods were deeply profound and mysterious, especially his communication device, which had disrupted the communication pattern in Lingyu.
"I don't know, I really don't know anything about Fang Hao!"
The Purple Cloud Emperor hurriedly shook his head.
Tang Jinyan murmured in her heart: "Xu Yan, Meng Chong, Su Lingxiu, they all hail from the Inner Domain, with a master backing them.
"How could such monsters come from the lowly lands of the Inner Domain?
"Who is their master? The Blood Demon!"
In an instant, a possibility crossed her mind that sent waves of shock crashing in her heart.
The Blood Demon is not dead?!
Moreover, he has returned in a more covert manner, nurturing monstrous disciples and stirring up a storm in Lingyu. His scheme must be massive.
"So, can I go now, sir?"
The Purple Cloud Emperor carefully asked.
"Rest assured, I won't kill you, you're still of use."
Tang Jinyan waved her hand and the Purple Cloud Emperor's eyes turned black and he passed out.
"Take him and head to the Thousand Martial Hall!"
At this moment, Tang Jinyan gritted her teeth and said.
"Yes, miss!"
The maidservant took out a bag, put the Purple Cloud Emperor in it, and carried it on her shoulder.
The master and servant quietly left Yuzhou, heading towards the Thousand Martial Hall.
The fact that the Blood Demon may be behind Xu Yan and Meng Chong would shake the entire Ling Domain. She, Tang Jinyan, had achieved something great. The Shui Xing Palace would also rise with the tide, leaning on the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
Moreover, she could use the hand of the Transcendent Spirit Sect to eliminate the threat of Chang Qing Pavilion and kill that bastard!
"The Transcendent Spirit Sect, realizing the crisis, will definitely go all out. The elixirs and the art of medicine in Chang Qing Pavilion are coveted by countless people.
"I really want to see how you people can fight against the entire Spirit Sect families!"
If Xu Yan's master is indeed the Blood Demon, the Transcendent Spirit Sect will surely join hands to kill him. Any rules of the Tianjiao Contest will be ignored.
The Blood Demon must die. This is the bottom line principle of the Transcendent Spirit Sect!

chapters.title: Chapter 614 - 329: Breaking through Wisdom Sword Realm_1
chapters.content:
Tang Jinyan, along with the Ziyun Emperor, was heading towards the Thousand Martial Hall. Their action against the Chang Qing Pavilion was being planned.
The Chang Qing Pavilion has already descended upon the renowned scenic location in the Great Zhou State, the Small Star Lake. Everyday, they accept no more than a hundred visitors for appointments and visits, first come first served.
At Small Star Lake, queues had formed. Injured warriors from all over the Great Zhou and some prodigies all hoped to be able to enter the Chang Qing Pavilion.
Leaving aside the miraculous pill healing technique, just the Chang Qing Pavilion itself was a shockingly astonishing Divine Artifact that many wanted to behold its extraordinariness.
Li Xuan was at ease, sitting in the pavilion at the top of the Chang Qing Pavilion. Su Lingxiu was massaging his shoulders, "Master, I am preparing to cultivate the alchemy that has just been comprehended. I need some special main materials and you need to help me."
"Your master has no treasures to offer you."
Li Xuan shook his head.
"Not treasures, I want master to help me coalesce some Heavenly Earth Lingji and power of the Heaven and Earth Laws. I want to use Heavenly Earth Lingji as the main material for practicing a new type of alchemy."
Su Lingxiu laughed.
"Alright."
Li Xuan nodded.
The alchemy that Su Lingxiu wanted to cultivate was what she gained insight into—the Heavenly Earth Divine Furnace Alchemy.
She intended to practice the Heavenly Earth Divine Furnace Alchemy using Heavenly Earth Lingji and power of the Heaven and Earth Laws as main materials. The resulting pill would make even the most powerful beings in the Ling Domain envious.
"Thank you master!"
Su Lingxiu couldn't have been happier.
She took out several small bottles. These bottles, refined by Fang Hao, contained restrictions and were used to store the Heavenly Earth Lingji and power of the Heaven and Earth Laws.
Li Xuan reached out and coalesced Heavenly Earth Lingji in his palm, continuously infusing it into the small bottles.
Even the power of Heaven and Earth Laws could be coalesced and seized—it was no different for Heavenly Earth Lingji.
Su Lingxiu closed the bottles, activated the restriction, and securely locked the Heavenly Earth Lingji in the bottles.
She took out a few more bottles.
Li Xuan raised his hand, and the power of Heaven and Earth Laws coalesced. Each bottle was infused with a trace of Law power.
The reason for infusing only a trace into each bottle was the fear that Su Lingxiu wouldn't be able to control it if there was too much. After all, this was her first time using Law power to cultivate pills and practice a new type of alchemy.
"Thank you master!"
Su Lingxiu, excited, put away the small bottles and couldn't wait to practice alchemy.
For the visiting Martial Artists, naturally Shi'er and others received them. Yue'er was busy assisting her and did not have the time to pay attention to these matters.
As for Cai Ling'er, she had essentially become a servant to Li Xuan, attending to him. She even began to learn how to make delicious Spirit Cakes and other similar foods.
The formation for the Chang Qing Pavilion's Flying Ship had already started. If you want to enter the Chang Qing Pavilion, you must come from the entrance and get permission.
Shi'er and Meng Shushu directly treated Martial Artists at the entrance, not even allowing them to come in. The ones who were not injured were directly asked to leave.
When it was time to be domineering, that's when they were domineering. The Chang Qing Pavilion had the confidence to do so.
Boom!
Suddenly, there was a roar from inside the chamber of the Chang Qing Pavilion's Flying Ship, which was specially prepared for Su Lingxiu to practice alchemy, as if something exploded.
"Cough cough!"
Yue'er's originally fair-face was now covered in soot, and she was coughing out black smoke.
"Miss!"
Zhou Ying was startled and rushed into the alchemy chamber.
Su Lingxiu's hair was a little messy, but she wasn't injured. She had a look of frustration on her face.
The furnace had unexpectedly exploded!
Yue'er had even been covered in soot from the Spiritual Medicine.
"Aunt Zhou, I'm fine."
Su Lingxiu shook her head, took out another bottle, and prepared for the second round of alchemy.
Yue'er leaned over with the Spiritual Medicine in her hand, ready to throw it in as soon as Su Lingxiu gave the order.
Seeing this, Zhou Ying could only leave the alchemy chamber. With her weak strength, if an explosion happened, not only would Su Lingxiu have to protect her, it would make things even more dangerous.
Whoosh!
Su Lingxiu waved her hands, and her divine power formed an alchemy furnace. Pill flames burned as she threw a trace of Heavenly Earth Lingji into the furnace, slowly unraveling the restriction on the Lingji.
Bang!
A light noise rang out in the alchemy chamber.
"Another failure."
Su Lingxiu looked at the pitch-black pill in her hand—this was a waste pill. "Too bad the Red Cat isn't here, otherwise this pill wouldn't go to waste."
After three failures, Su Lingxiu finally succeeded in using the Heavenly Earth Lingji to refine a pill. She was extremely excited, and so was Yue'er.
That meant she could reassert the Heavenly Earth Lingji into her Divine Soul quickly and easily.
"Actually, Heavenly Earth Lingji is everywhere. Even these Spiritual Medicines contain Heavenly Earth Lingji. Otherwise, they wouldn't be able to become Spiritual Medicines. It's just that the Lingji they contain is very sparse."
"The higher the grade of the Spiritual Medicine, the more the Heavenly Earth Lingji it contains. However, once the Spiritual Medicine is harvested, the Lingji will vanish."
"We need to find a way that allows us to completely seal the Lingji contained in the Spiritual Medicine when harvesting it. This prevents it from disappearing."
"Only in this way can we create a pill using Lingji drawn from Spiritual Medicine."
Su Lingxiu looked at the Heavenly Earth Lingji pill in her hand and mused this.
She can ask her master to coalesce the Heavenly Earth Lingji for pill refining, but what if she can't coalesce the Heavenly Earth Lingji? Wouldn't it be impossible to refine it?
Therefore, she needs to find a compromise. Even if the effect of the pill is weaker, she should at least be able to refine similar pills without the assistance of a strong expert.
However, the coalescing of the power of Heaven and Earth Laws for pill refining cannot be compromised. It has to depend on the assistance of strong experts to coalesce the power of the Laws of Heaven and Earth.

chapters.title: Chapter 615 - 329: Breakthrough in Wisdom Sword Realm_2
chapters.content:
"We don't necessarily need to rely on a mountain; we could perhaps rely on formations; setting up formations, gathering the Laws of Heaven and Earth."
Su Lingxiu pondered for a moment, deciding to let Fang Hao research how to use formations to gather the Laws of Heaven and Earth.
Outside Chang Qing Pavilion, there was a long line, in which not only prodigies of the Great Zhou state but also people with respectable identities were being treated with such slowness, naturally they wouldn't be heartened.
However, Shi'er and Meng Shushu turned a deaf ear.
Li Xuan continued to delve into his martial arts endeavors. On the Divine Skill Martial Code, an additional Divine Skill was added.
The theoretical framework for the realm above the Void-breaking Realm had been further refined.
The subsequent cultivation technique for the physical martial arts already had a cultivation direction, and the first layer had been compiled.
"Your disciple, Xu Yan, has enlightened the path of cultivation of the Wisdom Sword Realm; you have broken through the Wisdom Sword Realm!"
The Daoist Golden Book opened with a flurry of golden light.
Li Xuan was taken aback, and then overwhelmingly excited.
Such a profound Wisdom Sword Realm, such a difficult to comprehend Sword Dao's third realm, Xu Yan had actually found its cultivation direction?
