At this moment, his Sword Dao broke through to the third realm, and a profound and mystifying state of mind emerged.
"So this is the Wisdom Sword Realm!"
Li Xuan sighed in his heart, true enough, it was the third realm of Sword Dao that he had compiled himself, profound and inexplicable.
His cultivation did not break through, but his Sword Dao stepped into the Wisdom Sword Realm, and his strength had a huge increase!
In a moment, above the Little Star Lake, a water sword condensed.
This sword seemed to have its own spirituality, as if it was born to master the Sword Dao of water.
On one side of the Little Star Lake, an eight or nine-year-old boy was waving a sword in his hand, mumbling, "I want to be the second Xu Yan, I also want to be a Sword Dao practitioner!"
"Little friend, do you like Sword Dao?"
Suddenly, a voice came out of nowhere.
The little boy looked up, his eyes widened in surprise.
In front of him, a water sword stood upright, even twirling its blade. It seemed as if a mouth on the hilt were talking, "Can you tell me why you like Sword Dao?"
"You, you are, what are you?"
The little boy was somewhat flabbergasted but was not frightened by this sight.
"I am the Water Sword, master of my Water Dao."
"Can you teach me then?"
"I can, but first, explain why you like Sword Dao."
"Xu Yan is my idol. I want to be like Xu Yan, to challenge the Spirit Sect's mountain gate in the future!"
The little boy said excitingly.
"Good, good, you have ambition. Come, hold me. I'll show you the world of Sword Dao."
The Water Sword nodded in satisfaction.
The little boy was thrilled, he stepped forward and grabbed the hilt of the Water Sword, and brought the Water Sword home. When the boy just returned home, he found that a fight was breaking out inside.
It turned out that his sworn enemies had come. His parents were resisting with all their might, but they were already heavily injured.
"Zhen'er, run!"
Seeing this, his mother immediately shouted in panic.
"I'm not leaving, you all can drop dead!"
The little boy rushed up holding the water sword, charging at one of the enemies.
"Little friend, follow my feeling, I'll take you into the world of Sword Dao."
The voice of the Water Sword came, and at this moment, the little boy's mind seemed to enter a wondrous state. It wasn't him using the sword, but the sword teaching him Sword Dao.
Shush!
Soft and slender sword light, like ripples on water, gentle as water, yet contained fierce killing intent.
In a mere instant, all enemies were slain.
The little boy was immersed in the mystery of Sword Dao, and his parents were stunned.
"The marvel of the Wisdom Sword."
Li Xuan sighed inwardly.
He had condensed a water sword and then let the water sword go. As a result, the water sword took a little boy into the world of Sword Dao and unlocked his sword talent.
Decades later, a Sword Dao prodigy would emerge in the Ling Domain.
The cheerful Li Xuan reached out and grabbed, and the power of the Laws of Heaven and Earth condensed and was casually refined by him into a Law Pill.
"Here you go!"
He casually threw it to Cai Ling'er, who was serving a plate of spiritual cakes.
"Thank you, senior!"
Cai Ling'er took the Law Pill in surprise and excitement, and quickly took it into her Divine Soul, carefully pondering it and slowly refining it.
She became even more convinced of her decision, indeed staying by the side of a high person, was the greatest opportunity!
Li Xuan picked up a piece of a spiritual cake and put it into his mouth, then nodded, "The taste is not bad!"
Upon hearing this, Cai Ling'er was even more determined to learn a few more skills to make desserts. As long as the senior was happy, a casual reward would be a great opportunity.
Cai Ling'er withdrew to perceive the Law Pill in her Divine Soul, while Li Xuan sipped his Spiritual Tea, ate his Spiritual Cake, and continued his great martial arts endeavors.
Li Xuan suddenly raised his head, disengaging the Flying Boat formation.
"Master, I'm back!"
Outside the Changqing Pavilion, Meng Chong, with Zi Yun at his side, stepped forward. Looking at the Changqing Pavilion, his face was filled with astonishment. Was this the Flying Boat that his junior fellow disciple had forged?
Truly marvelous.
"Zi Yun pays her respects to the senior!"
Zi Yun reverently greeted him with a bow.
"Hmm."
Li Xuan nodded, guessing that this young woman would probably become a second disciple-in-law.
With a wave of his hand, the Jade Talisman he had once given to Zi Yun was now infused with a divine skill.
"Thank you for your generous gift Senior!"
Zi Yun was delighted as she bowed.
She had once been surrounded and was about to be killed. Without Meng Chong's intervention, she would have triggered this Jade Talisman to fight with her life. Although she didn't know how powerful this Jade Talisman was, she supposed it could slay a Refining God Heavenly Man.
Now that the senior had enhanced the Jade Talisman, even the most formidable foes would not intimidate her in the future.
Just as Meng Chong was about to take Zi Yun to meet Su Lingxiu, his brow suddenly furrowed and his sword sprung from its sheath. Looking toward the mid-air, he coldly snorted, "Dare to be so bold and presumptuous here?"
Just when he was about to strike with his sword, Li Xuan smiled and said, "Dreams are but bubble shadows. This young girl, you must be the Xin Mengrou that Wu Tianan mentioned."
In mid-air, the vaguely emerging images of dreams were suddenly shattered - they turned out to be an illusion.
A stunning silhouette descended. She looked at the figure sitting leisurely in the pavilion, her face filled with surprise.
Xin Mengrou!
She came from the Taimiao Sect, only because Yarong had told her that Xu Yan was from the Inner Domain.
The first person Xin Mengrou thought of was Blood Spirit Child. Could it be that he wasn't dead?
Was Xu Yan his disciple?
So, she personally came to the Changqing Pavilion to investigate.
"I thought you were Blood Spirit Child, but it turns out I was wrong. You are from the Inner Domain?"
Xin Mengrou calmed her emotions and asked.
Did such powerful figures exist in the Inner Domain?
"Kind of."
Li Xuan replied with a mysterious smile.
"Huh?"
Meng Chong was suddenly taken aback. Looking at Xin Mengrou, he saw in her a reflection of Miss Du and asked in surprise, "Miss Du is your descendant?"
Xin Mengrou nodded, looking at Meng Chong with great shock in her heart.
The two monstrous geniuses of the Ling Domain were actually both his disciples!
No!
There was another one - Changqing Pavilion's Fairy Doctor!
"Sit."
Li Xuan pointed to the chair in front of him and said.
"Thank you, senior."
Xin Mengrou sat down, withdrawing her mesmerizing power to finally reveal her true appearance.
Exquisitely beautiful, a peerless beauty.
Li Xuan sighed inwardly. Xin Mengrou's cultivation technique was extraordinary. It was dreamlike and extremely powerful. If a peer was slightly careless, they would fall into a dream.
Even they could not distinguish between illusions and reality.
No wonder Wu Tianan had high praise for her, claiming that in the entire Ling Domain, only Xin Mengrou was his equal.
Li Xuan understood a bit more now. Xu Yan's discovery of the Wisdom Sword Realm was probably related to Xin Mengrou's illusory dream power.
"Why do you visit?"
Li Xuan asked indifferently.
"Firstly, Xu Yan said that in front of his master I'm nothing but an ant. Secondly, I wanted to see whether the powerful figure from the Inner Domain was an old acquaintance."
Xin Mengrou didn't hide anything as she was straightforward.
"How do you find it?"
Li Xuan asked with a mild smile, his aura becoming enigmatic.
Xin Mengrou took a deep breath, then said, "Senior is unfathomable!"
"There's nothing unfathomable about me. I'm just an ordinary idler."
Li Xuan shook his head and laughed, his mysterious aura vanished, he now appeared as an ordinary man.
However, the more he acted like this, the more amazed Xin Mengrou became. She considered him even more profound and unfathomable.
Cai Ling'er had stopped her attempts to comprehend and refine the law pill. She walked over and took care of Li Xuan, then poured a cup of tea for Xin Mengrou.
Xin Mengrou looked at her, greatly shocked.
"Why is there such a powerful force of laws within your divine soul?"
Cai Ling'er had just been trying to comprehend and refine the law pill, so a hint of the law's aura had leaked out, making Xin Mengrou sense the force of laws contained within her divine soul.

chapters.title: Chapter 616 - 330: The Shocked Xin Mengrou, The Furious Xiang Mingmao_1
chapters.content:
"It was given to me by the elder."
Colorful Spirit Child said with pride on her face.
Xin Mengrou was shocked. Can the Heavenly and Earthly Rules be given to people?
"It's not worth mentioning."
But Li Xuan just shook his head.
With a flick of a hand, the power of the Heavenly and Earthly Rules was pulled in, condensed into Laws' Pills and tossed them casually on the table.
With an indifferent expression, he said: "If you need them, you can take them!"
Xin Mengrou was too shocked to speak, spontaneously condensing the power of the Heavenly and Earthly Rules into elixirs, by what means?
"I dare not accept a reward without merit."
Xin Mengrou suppressed her shock and said respectfully.
Li Xuan raised an eyebrow. Xin Mengrou had a good heart, but the Colorful Spirit Child next to her paled in comparison. Seeing the Laws' Pills on the table, she couldn't blink or look away.
"You are here due to fate, don't be modest."
Li Xuan said with a smile.
"In that case, thank you, elder, for your generosity!"
Xin Mengrou pondered for a while, took two of the Laws' Pills, and said: "Two will suffice!"
Li Xuan nodded, waved his hand, and threw the remaining Laws' Pills to Su Lingxiu, to let his disciple study them carefully.
Cai Ling'er's face fell in disappointment.
"Gluttony is bad."
Li Xuan said with a wry smile.
"Cai Ling'er was greedy."
Cai Ling'er shamefully lowered her head.
Xin Mengrou considered for a moment and respectfully asked, "Can the elder advise on my martial arts practice?"
She had already reached the peak of the Spirit Realm and it was extremely difficult for her to advance further.
However, with the Laws' Pills, she was closer to the next stage.
Li Xuan smiled faintly and said, "Dream when you dream, it is not a dream when you dream. Dreams are reality, reality is a dream. Illusory yet real, is it a dream or reality..."
After a round of profound instruction, Li Xuan finally said in front of Xin Mengrou's thoughtful and puzzled gaze, "If you can understand the secret here, you can walk your own path, break away from the shackles of the martial arts you are practicing.
"By then, you can be regarded as the founder of a certain path."
Li Xuan was not concerned about whether Xin Mengrou could do it. If she could, it would be entirely thanks to his own guidance. If she couldn't, then her insight was no good, and she had missed the golden opportunity.
No matter what, he didn't lose, thus showing a great demeanor.
Of course, his profound instruction was not baseless and contained some theoretical elements.
Xin Mengrou was greatly shocked, the more she pondered, the more she felt the extraordinaryness of the elder's instruction. It seemed to contain the ultimate truth of heaven and earth. If she really comprehends this, it seems that she can really create her own martial arts.
"The martial arts I practice is Taimiao Magic. There are very few people who have successfully practiced it from ancient times to the present. And I am the only one who has successfully practiced in the Taimiao Sect ....
"If I can understand the instruction of the elder, it will exceed the Taimiao Magic and create a martial art that is comparable to or even stronger than the Taimiao Magic."
Xin Mengrou thought to herself.
Her extraordinary position in the Taimiao Sect was all because she succeeded in practicing the Taimiao Magic, a marvelous martial art.
Thinking about this, Xin Mengrou stood up and bowed with respect and said, "Xin Mengrou thanks the elder for his guidance!"
"Hmm!"
Li Xuan nodded.
Since she is not an enemy and can meet himself who is a wise man and acquire some chances is normal.
Besides, Du Yuying is Xin Mengrou's bloodline, which is somewhat related.
Xin Mengrou confirmed that Xu Yan's master was truly a high-level person, not the Blood Spirit Child, took the Laws' Pills and left without staying too long after saying goodbye.
She needs to return to the Taimiao Sect to contemplate the elder's instructions.
As soon as Xin Mengrou left, Cai Ling'er also went back to ponder and refine the Laws' Pills.
Zi Yun and Su Lingxiu met and naturally had a chat. Su Lingxiu introduced each other to Yue'er, and the three women gathered together.
Su Lingxiu continued to make elixirs, but with an extra person to assist her, namely Zi Yun.
After paying respects to his master, Meng Chong shared his adventures in the Spirit Realm, as well as his insights and gains in martial arts.
Outside the Chang Qing Pavilion, a young man walked in.
With his appearance, all martial artists who were originally queuing gave way.
"Xi Mingmao is here to visit Fairy Tale Doctor!"
Shi'er looked up at the young man. The man was dignified in his purple gown, filled with an aura of nobility, although his carefree expression couldn't fully hide his deep-seated arrogance.
The pride of the Da Zhou Royal Family.
Although the other party's identity was not low, he might be a prince or a king of Da Zhou Royal Family, Shi'er was indifferent. After all, Su Lingxiu is busy now, how could she have time to see you?
"The Pavilion Master is unavailable today, please come back another day, next!"
Xi Mingmao was slightly angry. As the Princely Heir of the Purple King, one of the Nine Veins of the Da Zhou Royal family, his potential successor, was it even possible to be treated this lightly?
However, he didn't lose his temper on the spot, after all, Chang Qing Pavilion was not common, so he repeated: "Please let her know that the Princely Heir of the Purple King of Da Zhou is here to visit Fairy Doctor."
Xi Mingmao was furious, as he never had to be so humble before.
"As I have said, she's unavailable, whether you're the Purple King's Princely Heir or even if the Emperor Da Zhou himself came, she wouldn't see him!"
Shi'er rolled his eyes and continued, "Next!"

chapters.title: Chapter 617 - 330: The Shocked Xin Mengrou, The Furious Xiang Mingmao_2
chapters.content:
Item Mingmao's face immediately turned ashen, and the martial artists lined up behind him hastily retreated in fear, daring not to step forward.
They were absolutely shocked; the manager of the Evergreen Pavilion was outrageously arrogant, stating that even if Emperor Da Zhou came, the Alchemist Fairy wouldn't meet with him?
This was happening within the territory of Da Zhou, weren't they afraid of infuriating the Da Zhou royal family?
"Insolent!"
A middle-aged man standing next to Item Mingmao immediately shouted in anger, "You, a mere subordinate of the Evergreen Pavilion, dare to be so arrogant? You dare to disrespect my Da Zhou Emperor, you have such audacity!"
Boom!
The aura of the apex being burst out and suppressed toward Shi'er.
Swipe!
In front of Shi'er, a ripple of light surged out, surrounded by purple thunder light. This activated the defensive formation of the Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship.
The formation of the Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship, although arranged by Fang Hao, Li Xuan had also casually strengthened the power of the formation.
Even Xin Mengrou could not break the formation of the Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship unless the Spirit Crystal was completely exhausted and could no longer support the opening of the formation.
Shi'er was nonchalant and did not mind the other party losing his temper. Instead, he picked his ear and said, "I'm just telling the truth. Even if Emperor Da Zhou comes today, he won't be able to meet anyone. If you think you can make a fuss here, go ahead and try."
At this moment, Shi'er finally experienced some of the pleasure of being a powerhouse.
For example, Xu Yan, everyone said he was wild, but everyone acknowledged he had the strength to be wild!
"So, being wild is this refreshing."
Shi'er sighed inwardly.
Item Mingmao and his guards looked at the rippling purple thunder light, their eyes constricting. The Evergreen Pavilion was rumored to be a divine artifact, and it indeed proved to be so today.
"Don't be rude!"
Item Mingmao furrowed his brows, reproving his guard.
"Yes, Prince!"
The guard immediately withdrew his aura.
"Since the Alchemist Fairy does not see guests today, I will come again tomorrow!"
Item Mingmao smilingly saluted.
"Tomorrow? Coming tomorrow will be useless too; still not seeing outsiders."
Shi'er said expressionlessly.
A wave of anger surged inside Item Mingmao, but he didn't explode, and instead asked, "I wonder when the Alchemist Fairy will be free to see guests?"
"How would I know? I can't make decisions!"
Shi'er rolled his eyes in response.
His demeanor almost made Item Mingmao lose his cool.
He turned and left with a darkened face.
"I'm not in a good mood today, the Evergreen Pavilion will not receive patients today!"
Shi'er, with an unhappy face, directly activated the formation and closed the patient portal, then left.
But in his heart, he was thoroughly pleased, "Even though I'm not a powerhouse, I've experienced the joy of a powerhouse!"
The incident with Item Mingmao was just a minor episode, no one paid it any mind.
As Shi'er said, even if Emperor Da Zhou came, he wouldn't be able to meet Su Lingxiu.
The news of Item Mingmao being turned away spread around Little Star Lake, and everybody in Da Zhou's martial arts world was waiting to see if Item Mingmao, the princely heir of the Purple King and one of Da Zhou royal family's prodigies, would swallow this insult.
After a day, Item Mingmao came again.
This time, the one receiving patients was Meng Shushu. Shi'er had left to cultivate.
"The undersigned is Item Mingmao, the princely heir to the Purple King of Da Zhou. I am here to visit the Alchemist Fairy."
As he spoke, he handed over a box.
"A token of my sincerity, I hope you will accept it."
Meng Shushu opened the box and took a look, it was a divine spiritual medicine. However, he had seen so many divine spiritual medicines that he didn't find it particularly precious.
"The Pavilion Master is busy with alchemy today and has no time for guests!"
As he said this, he took the spiritual medicine and took out a small bottle, such a small bottle would only hold one pill.
"This is a Resurrection Pill. It's healing medicine. Even if a Refining God Heavenly Man's foundations are damaged, it can still recover. Given your sincere intent, I'll sell it to you at a low price!"
A divine spiritual medicine purchased a Resurrection Pill, which was already giving enough face to the Da Zhou royal family.
This was what Meng Shushu thought.
But Item Mingmao didn't see it this way; the resentment in his heart was about to overflow. He was the princely heir of the Purple King, the pride of the Da Zhou royal family. Wherever he went, wasn't he ushered in with grandeur?
As a result, he was turned away again!
"When will the Alchemist Fairy have time to meet guests?"
Item Mingmao took a deep breath to calm down his raging heart and asked.
"That's hard to say."
Meng Shushu pondered a moment, then said, "The Pavilion Master will only receive guests when she has spare time after her research on alchemy. No one is allowed to disturb her during this period."
It's understandable for the Alchemist Fairy to not receive guests while busy researching alchemy.
Thus, Xiang Mingmao gulped down his emotions, posing a question, "When will the Alchemical Fairy come out of seclusion?"
"How would I know? You can come and ask every day. Whether or not you'll get to see her depends on your luck."
Meng Shushu stated somewhat impatiently.
"Then I'll come back tomorrow!"
Xiang Mingmao left with no other choice.
The very next day.
Xiang Mingmao returned and this time, he was met by Zhou Ying.
"I..."
"We're not accepting visitors!"
Before he could finish, Zhou Ying interrupted.
Xiang Mingmao's face became flushed, veins popping on his forehead, about to explode with anger.
At that moment, Xu Yan returned.
Walking straight into the Evergreen Pavilion, Xiang Mingmao saw this and finally let his anger burst forth. "Why can he enter? Yet I, a Princely Heir, am kept waiting outside. Is this the Evergreen Pavilion's way of showing contempt for the imperial family of Da Zhou?"
Such unbearable disrespect!
Xu Yan looked back over his shoulder. The favored son of Da Zhou's imperial family?
He's not weak, having condensed a strand of Heavenly Earth Lingji. However, to him, at his current level of strength, he could slap such a being to death with a single palm.
Not even interested in lifting a hand, he turned around and left.
Xiang Mingmao was infuriated. What kind of a look was that?
So disdainful, so contemptuous?
"Your Evergreen Pavilion sits within the territory of Da Zhou, yet you dare behave so arrogantly, showing contempt for Da Zhou. Do you really think..."
Xiang Mingmao thoroughly lost his composure.
Then, he saw a girl as beautiful as a fairy from the Evergreen Pavilion, running out excitedly to meet the man who just left, happily shouting, "Senior Brother, you're back!"
Next, he saw another beautiful woman appearing, also excitedly rushing towards the man. Then a figure in purple appeared before his eyes.
Zi Yun!
Commandery Princess Zi Yun of Qing King's Mansion, the woman from that lower-ranked region!
"Zi Yun! Although she is the Commandery Princess of Qing King's Mansion, she does not share the bloodline of my imperial family of Da Zhou. You let a woman from a lower-ranked region enter the Evergreen Pavilion, yet refused me, the favored son of Da Zhou's imperial family. Your Evergreen Pavilion is truly arrogant.
"This is your disrespect towards the imperial family of Da Zhou, your disrespect towards my Purple King lineage!"
At this moment, Xiang Mingmao was completely filled with rage, roaring like a beast.
Inside the Evergreen Pavilion, when Xu Yan came back, Su Lingxiu and the others came out happily to meet him. However, they heard an angry roar outside the Pavilion.
Zi Yun looked up, puzzled, "Why is he here?"
"You know him?"
Su Lingxiu asked, equally puzzled.
"He is the Princely Heir of Purple King of Da Zhou, not on good terms with my Qing King's Mansion. He is very arrogant and has often undermined me behind my back, saying things like people from lower-ranked regions like me are not suitable for the imperial family of Da Zhou, that I tarnish his Da Zhou, and that Qing King has willingly fallen and so on."
Zi Yun's face was filled with resentment and a hint of contempt.
"I see. Don't mind him, just let him go crazy out there."
Su Lingxiu finally understood and called Zhou Ying back, activating the formation directly.
Then, she and her fellow disciples went on with their reunion.
Even the sound was blocked out.
Boom!
Xiang Mingmao was filled with rage and attacked the Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship along with his guards.
Su Lingxiu couldn't be bothered. After all, it was not the first time someone attacked the Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship. Even a mighty person from the Transcendent Spirit Sect had tried before.
As soon as Xiang Mingmao launched his attack, it triggered the ship's defense formation. A surge of purple lightning charged at them.
"Not good!"
One of Xiang Mingmao's guards blanched and stepped in front of him, saying, "Your Highness, run!"
Boom!
He let out all his strength, blocking the purple lightning but his body started emitting black smoke.
Xiang Mingmao's face changed drastically. He fell back frantically, roaring, "The Evergreen Pavilion truly dares! Are you trying to provoke Da Zhou!"
Boom!
Another thunderbolt exploded towards them. The guard roared and fought back with all his might, but he still got killed by the thunderbolt!
The entire Little Star Lake trembled, leaving all the martial artists shocked.
The Evergreen Pavilion dared to attack the Princely Heir of the Purple King?
This was provoking the imperial family of Da Zhou, especially on Da Zhou's home grounds. How would Da Zhou swallow this?
Xiang Mingmao was also terrified. He never expected them to completely disregard his status and kill directly.
He hastily fled, afraid that if he was a moment too late, he would be killed.

chapters.title: Chapter 618 - 331: Suspected Lord, Azure Sea Abyss_1
chapters.content:
Xiao Star Lake was in turmoil. A powerhouse of the Great Zhou Royal Family had been killed by Chang Qing Pavilion, and the pride of the Great Zhou dynasty, the imperial heir Zi Wang, almost met the same fate, escaping in disgrace.
Upon hearing the news, all powerful forces of Great Zhou were markedly shocked.
This was a challenge to the Great Zhou Royal Family. Chang Qing Pavilion truly had great audacity. Were they really so confident that they could withstand the retaliation of the Great Zhou Royal Family?
Martial artists who had originally planned to visit Chang Qing Pavilion or even seek medical advice were immediately frightened and chose not to go anymore, all closely watching the development of the situation.
Yet, all this turmoil was completely ignored by Su Lingxiu as well as Xu Yan and Meng Chong. After all, it was just a death of a powerhouse who had refined the Heavenly Earth Lingji. It wasn't the first time a powerhouse was killed either.
Zi Yun expressed her worries cautiously, "The Great Zhou Royal Family is really strong. Will there be any trouble?"
Of course, though she was a bit worried, she didn't feel that there was any danger. Instead, she thought that there might just be some trouble.
"It's just a small matter. He attacked first, shouldn't we be allowed to retaliate?"
Su Lingxiu casually remarked.
"Exactly, if the Great Zhou Royal Family doesn't accept defeat, I'll go and block the entrance to his imperial palace and fight until he submits."
Xu Yan nodded in agreement.
Zi Yun was amazed, suddenly remembering that Xu Yan had challenged the Thousand Martial Hall by blocking its entrance a few years ago. His strength now had clearly become even more astonishing.
Chang Qing Pavilion was bustling with activity as Xu Yan recounted his experiences in Dachuan and his slaying of the sword controller elder of the Thousand Martial Hall.
He took out the cold blade from the Thousand Martial Hall and another Divine Artifact, and gave them to Meng Chong, saying, "Little brother, do you think this blade is appropriate?"
Meng Chong weighed it and said, "The blade looks good, but I'm more used to the blade you crafted. However, I can still use this. I'll study it and make a blade array."
After learning about Xu Yan's Sword Array, Meng Chong also became interested in creating his own blade array.
Chang Qing Pavilion was bustling with activity.
Meanwhile, at the top of the Thousand Martial Hall Mountain, the Thousand Martial Lord and his elders looked gravely serious. Was Xu Yan from the Inner Domain ?
Was Meng Chong also from the Inner Domain?
Does that mean that the Blood Demon is behind Xu Yan and Meng Chong?
A pest that's like an incessant headache for the Spirit Sect, falling and rising three times, seemingly unkillable. If the Blood Demon really returns, it would surely be even more dangerous.
Knowing how to hide itself now, planning before moving, and cultivating disciples as monstrously talented.
"The Transcendent Spirit Sect should gather. Inform Lei Yun Mountain Manor, Yu Ling Mansion, Taimiao Sect, and Great Zhou Xiang Family to discuss great matters."
The Thousand Martial Lord said with a cold expression.
"Yes!"
The sword controller elder had not sent any news for some time. He was a little uneasy. Could something have happened?
Was it Xu Yan who killed him, or was it someone behind Xu Yan?
If the sword controller elder really had fallen, the Thousand Martial Lord tended towards the latter. It was impossible for Xu Yan, in just a few years, to have the power to kill the sword controller elder.
Somewhere in Ling Domain, above the clouds.
Thousand Martial Lord brought a person with him. Lei Yun Manor Master, Mansion Master of Yu Ling, Taimiao Sect Master, and the representative from the Great Zhou Royal Family, was Zi Wang.
"What is it that you have called us here for?"
Lei Yun Manor Master asked in a deep voice.
"The matter of the competition of the geniuses will proceed as it is outlined in the rules. My Taimiao Sect won't support anything that violates these rules."
Taimiao Sect Master said in a deep voice.
The matter of the genius competition, to the the Taimiao Sect, cannot be changed by anyone since Xin Mengrou has already made a decision.
"Not about this."
Thousand Martial Lord said deeply, "I suspect that the Blood Demon has returned!"
As soon as these words were said, everyone present changed their expressions.
"Are you sure about this?"
Zi Wang asked in shock.
"The Blood Demon definitely couldn't have returned. My senior uncle had already killed it!"
Taimiao Sect Master said coldly.
Looking coldly at Thousand Martial Lord, "Do you have any evidence?"
"This person came from the Inner Domain during the opening of the last Gate of Lingyu. According to the information we have, Xu Yan is from the Inner Domain and Meng Chong is from the Inner Domain. They are disciples of the same sect!"
Thousand Martial Lord picked up Zi Yun Huang and said solemnly.
Mansion Master of Yu Ling and Zi Wang looked at Zi Yun Huang and asked in a deep voice, "Is this true?"
Zi Yun Huang, pale as paper and trembling with fear, now that it had come to this, how could he hide it anymore?
"Xu Yan really is from the Inner Domain, and so is Meng Chong. They are the sect's geniuses, undefeatable geniuses. They have a mentor, a mysterious, highly skilled practitioner."
Thousand Martial Lord said in a deep voice, "The Inner Domain is a low-level place, as you and I should know. Apart from the Blood Demon who fled into the Inner Domain back then, where are there any highly skilled practitioners? Xu Yan's backer must be the Blood Demon from back then without a doubt!"
Mansion Master of Yu Ling and Zi Wang nodded with extremely grave expressions. Apart from the Blood Demon, where else could there be highly skilled practitioners in the Inner Domain?
"Impossible, the Blood Demon is already dead. My senior uncle personally buried him. As for Xu Yan and Meng Chong being from the Inner Domain, my senior uncle is aware of it too. He has investigated it, and they definitely are not the Blood Demon."
Taimiao Sect Master shook his head.
Lei Yun Manor Master opened his mouth with a grave expression, "I, Lei Yun Manor, have some contact with Chang Qing Pavilion. I have sought treatment from the Immortal Pill Doctor and have seen that person.
"I agree with what Sect Master of Taimiao says. He is not the Blood Demon, but... Lord!"
When he finished, Lei Yun Manor Master's voice became low, "The purpose of Lord's arrival is not something we can probe into. I, Lei Yun Manor, will not participate in this matter."
Mansion Master of Yu Ling and a few others' expressions changed, and they exclaimed in surprise,"Is this really true?"
"Ninety percent sure!"
Lei Yun Manor Master solemnly said.
"Is it really not the Blood Demon?"

chapters.title: Chapter 619 - 331: Suspected Lord, Azure Sea's Abyss_2
chapters.content:
The Thousand Martial Lord wore a look of utter disbelief.
"The opening of Divine Bridge is imminent. If it truly is a Lord, you should all be very cautious. None of you can withstand the wrath of a Lord."
The Master of Taimiao Sect turned and left.
"Blood Demon is undoubtedly dead. As for the Lord, it's better to proceed cautiously."
Zi Wang hesitated for a moment before saying this, then he also turned and left.
If it truly is a Lord who can ignore some rules and linger in the Inner Domain and Ling Domain, the Lord's power, and even identity, would not be simple.
"Let's leave it at that."
The Lord of Yu Ling Mansion also turned and left.
The Thousand Martial Lord's expression alternated between dark and light. He seemed unwilling as he carried Zi Yun Emperor and retreated.
Halfway down, he casually discarded Zi Yun Emperor and returned to the Thousand Martial Hall with a dark expression.
However, halfway through, he abruptly turned back. Under Zi Yun Emperor's horrified gaze, he struck and completely annihilated Zi Yun Emperor. Not a bone remained!
After killing Zi Yun Emperor, the Thousand Martial Lord returned to his Sect.
A group of elders surrounded him.
"Nothing to do with Blood Demon, but…"
The Thousand Martial Lord mentioned the conjecture about the Lord, which shocked the elders.
"Lord, if he really is a Lord, what is he doing in the Inner Domain? And, Xu Yan is from the Inner Domain, does he have any connections there, we..."
An elder spoke up, his voice dripping with malice.
"Hmm, indeed."
The Thousand Martial Lord nodded, "This matter cannot be revealed. You two will secretly open the Gate of Lingyu and enter the Inner Domain."
He assigned two elders.
"Yes, Lord!"
The two elders nodded.
"What to do with Tang Jinyan?"
The elder holding the sword asked in a deep voice.
"Kill her."
One of the elders spoke.
"Keep her, she might still be useful."
The Thousand Martial Lord hesitated for a moment before saying this.
He then instructed the two elders who were dispatched to the Inner Domain, saying: "Remember, you are not going there to kill. You are going to find their weakness. Once you find their weakness, it will definitely be useful one day.
"As long as we have Xu Yan's weakness, he better be monstrous, the stronger the better!"
The two elders grinned and said, "Lord's words are the absolute truth!"
The Thousand Martial Lord then summoned Tang Jinyan and her attendant. As soon as they entered the hall, the Thousand Martial Lord gestured, and Tang Jinyan's maid was immediately blown apart without leaving a trace!
Tang Jinyan's face went instantly as pale as a sheet of paper. With terror in her eyes, she knelt on the ground with a thud.
"Rest assured, I won't kill you."
The Thousand Martial Lord calmly said, "You cannot reveal a single word of this to anyone. If you do, you and the Shui Xing Palace will be reduced to ashes!"
"Yes, yes!"
Tang Jinyan nodded frantically.
"Alright, Shui Xing Palace will take refuge in the Thousand Martial Temple. Go back and await orders."
The Thousand Martial Lord waved his hand.
"Yes, thank you Master!""
Tang Jinyan was elated.
With Thousand Martial Hall as its backer, who would dare to offend Shui Xing Palace?
As for the matter of Su Lingxiu of Chang Qing Pavilion, she did not dare to ask, from the attitude of the Thousand Martial Lord, it clearly involved the secrets of the Spirit Sects.
At the imperial capital of Great Zhou, after Zi Wang reported the matter of this trip to Emperor Da Zhou, he had just returned to the palace and learned that Xiang Mingmao had almost been killed, and his bodyguard had died on the spot.
Xiang Mingmao had fled back in a sorry state.
"Father, they are provoking our Great Zhou royal family, they are provoking our Zi Wang lineage. We should take action and eradicate them using our Great Zhou power!"
Xiang Mingmao's eyes were bloodshot as he spoke in a resentful tone.
"Who was it?"
Zi Wang asked in a deep voice.
"Chang Qing Pavilion!"
Xiang Mingmao said through gritted teeth.
"Good, good, taking on Chang Qing Pavilion, they really think that I ... wait, did you say Chang Qing Pavilion?"
The Purple King was about to fly into a rage when he suddenly became startled and asked in a deep voice.
"Yes, Father!"
Xiang Mingmao nodded.
The Purple King fell silent. Behind the scenes at the Chang Qing Pavilion, it seemed like a Lord existed.
This was no longer a decision he could make.
"Only the Emperor can determine matters about the Chang Qing Pavilion. It's not for me, a descendant of the Purple King lineage to arbitrate. You must not act impulsively, or you'll likely bring trouble upon our lineage."
After all, this issue involved the supposed existence of a Lord. It was beyond his decision-making authority.
So, with a solemn expression, the Purple King gazed at Xiang Mingmao and spoke.
"Father, could it be that..."
Xiang Mingmao was startled. Did the waters of the Chang Qing Pavilion run this deep? Might he have inadvertently caused trouble?
"Enough, I will report the matter to the Emperor. We must wait for His decisions on how to handle this, even…"
The Purple King stared at his son and spoke in a grave tone, "Even whether an apology is necessary is yet to be determined!"
Xiang Mingmao's face drastically changed.
After warning Xiang Mingmao not to leave the Purple King Mansion, the Purple King headed to the imperial palace to inform the Emperor of the situation.
The retaliation of the Great Zhou royal family did not arrive.
It seemed that the Great Zhou royal family was completely unaware of the fall of a formidable individual at the hands of the Chang Qing Pavilion.
Even the Purple King Mansion remained quiet.
This created an air of unease among the various power factions and martial artists of Great Zhou.
The background of the Chang Qing Pavilion wasn't simple. Even the Great Zhou royal family wouldn't seek reprisal over a minor clash.
"I told you, the art of the Elixir Doctor is so miraculous. Who wouldn't be tempted? Who wouldn't be jealous of the Ling Sect? This Chang Qing Pavilion is extraordinary."
"You're right, let alone other transcendent ling sects, the infamous Thousand Martial Hall would surely try to seize the opportunity. It only makes sense that they've already made their move. And yet, the Chang Qing Pavilion remains peaceful, clearly demonstrating their tremendous confidence."
"Chang Qing Pavilion houses a divine artifact. Which among the great transcendent sects possesses such an incredible divine artifact?
The great Zhou martial artists discussed among themselves. Some powers and martial artists who had been observing started moving toward Chang Qing Pavilion for medical consultation or to purchase elixirs.
The Chang Qing Pavilion was bustling once again.
A few days later, during a reunion, Li Xuan took the opportunity to guide Xu Yan, further improving and detailing the martial arts technique of the Void-breaking realm.
He mentioned dao laws, which were related to the next stage of cultivation.
To this end, he personally made a divine paper, carved several dao laws onto it, and gave it to Xu Yan for comprehension, laying the foundation for his understanding of dao laws.
After all, the dao laws were profound and mysterious; even carving a few patterns was no small feat. Ordinary items simply could not bear it.
So Li Xuan personally created the divine paper to hold the carved dao law patterns.
"I'm only half a step away from the complete Divine Origin Realm. I should start preparing to accumulate a foundation to break through the Divine Skill Realm. Brother Xie has gone to the Yuntian Azure Sea City. I plan to deliver the cultivation technique to him."
Xu Yan stated his next goal.
"Rumor has it that the Azure Sea holds divine items. If I can acquire one, accumulating a foundation will be much simpler. I'll return before the Pride's Showdown."
Li Xuan knew that Xu Yan wouldn't stay for long upon his return. After years of exploration in the Ling Domain and rapid advancement in martial arts, Xu Yan wouldn't settle for intensive practices in one place, would he?
The Ling Domain was composed of eighteen states. While Xu Yan hadn't set foot in several of them, he decided to visit the Azure Sea. His purposes were twofold: one, to find Xie Lingfeng and transmit him the martial arts technique after Divine Intent State, and two, to seek the divine item of the Azure Sea to nourish his foundations and prepare for breaking through to the Divine Skill Realm.
"Cai Ling'er is from the Azure Sea. You can ask her about it."
Li Xuan nodded and said.
Cai Ling'er was useful at occasions like this.
She belonged to the Sea Spirit Tribe, and given her abilities, she held a high status within the tribe.
"Master, I understand."
Xu Yan was eager to leave for the Azure Sea. He immediately sought out Cai Ling'er to learn about the Azure Sea.
"The Azure Sea is vast, with numerous islands. Currently, it is co-ruled by our Sea Spirit Tribe and Yuntian City. The Azure Sea is full of spiritual items, and rumors suggest the existence of a divine entity."
"The most famous divine item is the Azure Sea Divine Pearl. It is said that it is the City Lord of Yuntian's hair binding accessory. This Divine Pearl is said to have mysterious properties and can nourish and augment the divine soul, thereby enhancing martial comprehension."
"Of course, as I haven't yet obtained it, I'm not certain whether all this is true."
Cai Ling'er shared all her knowledge, providing a detailed introduction to the Azure Sea.
"Azure Sea Abyss is notorious. Rumor has it that divine items originate from there. I watched from afar and it looked perilous. I did not dare to approach it out of sheer risk."
"I can't be certain about the existence of divine items in other places, but there's a 90% chance that divine items exist in the abyss."
"However, I advise you to stay away. It's a genuinely deadly place. We, the Sea Spirit Tribe, can roam freely in the sea, but even we dare not venture into the abyss..."
Xu Yan nodded. He remembered the Azure Sea Abyss. There was a high possibility that divine items existed there.
As for the danger mentioned by Cai Ling'er, Xu Yan naturally wouldn't enter recklessly. However, he was not like other martial artists of Lingyu; he had more tricks up his sleeve.
If his real body didn't enter, his divine body could. Even if danger arose, it would only deplete some of his divine elements. It was a minor issue.

chapters.title: Chapter 620 - 332: Indestructible Body of the Big Sun Stars, The Gate of Lingyu Disappears_1
chapters.content:
The Azure Sea, apart from the deadly abyss, also had some other dangerous areas, but these were no match for the abyss, hence the possibility of the presence of divine objects was greatly diminished.
"Apart from the Azure Sea Abyss, there is another place where divine objects are said to exist. It is incredibly hard to locate, and it is rumored that the Divine Pearl of the Azure Sea resides there."
Cai Ling'er thought about it a moment and said, "The Jade Sea Dark Abyss is a unique location within the Azure Sea. In terms of danger, it certainly exists, for there is a likelihood of losing one's direction if one delves too deeply within."
"Especially for the Human Clan, the risks become even greater, so much so that they might end up trapped within."
As per Cai Ling'er's explanation, the Jade Sea Dark Abyss isn't truly a deep abyss. It got its name because of an area in the Azure Sea that is as dark as ink, akin to a dark abyss.
Upon entering, not only is one's vision obstructed, making it difficult to see far, but even the range of one's Divine Soul's search significantly reduces.
"Due to the peculiarity of this Dark Abyss, even if a divine object does exist, it's not easy to find. It's completely reliant on luck and opportunity, so remember not to venture too deep, or else there's a danger of losing your course,"
"You might think that you're floating to the surface when in fact you're sinking down, or drifting off to the other side."
"Also, it's said that some unique entities inhabit the Dark Abyss and attack those who enter. Although most of them are not strong, powerful existences might not be absent deeper into the abyss."
CaI Ling'er said solemnly.
Xu Yan nodded, noting down these various places. After proceeding to the Azure Sea, he planned to explore each one.
"I once heard from an elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe that the Dark Abyss is suspected to be a remnant of an ancient battlefield, which is why it's so peculiar."
Cai Ling'er added at the end.
Then, she took out a small, translucent seashell and a small shell. Carved within the shell were patterns, and at the center were the characters 'Cai Ling.'
"This is my token. If needed, you can use my token to seek assistance from the Sea Spirit Tribe. If ever you lose your direction or want to scout the area, you can blow into this seashell."
"If there are Sea Spirits nearby, they'll follow the sound and guide you."
Xu Yan accepted the seashell and the shell, expressing his thanks. "Thank you!"
"It's no trouble!"
Cai Ling'er replied, all smiles.
These little things were nothing compared to the opportunities she had received from the elder, hardly worth mentioning."
Xu Yan resumed his journey through the Ling Domain, this time venturing to the Azure Sea to find Xie Lingfeng and also to seek out the Divine Object of the Azure Sea.
Meng Chong scratched his head, "After I've traveled through the other provinces, I might also pay a visit to the Azure Sea."
Su Lingxiu was intrigued and made a decision. She decided that Evergreen Pavilion's upcoming itinerary would be directed towards the Azure Sea.
The Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship lifted into the air, heading for the capital city of Great Zhou.
The Great Zhou royal family made no moves, showing they knew they were in the wrong and had no intent to retaliate.
Li Xuan sat in the pavilion, with only Meng Chong present.
It was time to pass on the cultivation techniques that follow Indestructible Golden Body to Meng Chong.
The subsequent cultivation method of the Body Cultivation Martial Art has also been compiled.
"Master!"
Meng Chong greeted with respect.
"You've already gained insight into the Indestructible Golden Body. As for the ongoing cultivation of Body Cultivation Martial Art, do you have any instincts?"
Li Xuan nodded and asked.
"Master, I'm not very bright. Regarding the ongoing cultivation of the Indestructible Golden Body, I have no guidance."
Responsive, Meng Chong scratched his bald head.
"Today, your master will transmit to you the cultivation technique that surpasses the Indestructible Golden Body."
Li Xuan nodded, not surprised by this. If Meng Chong had a feeling and guidance on the ongoing cultivation of the Body Cultivation Martial Art, wouldn't he need his cultivation technique compiled then?
"Thanks, Master!"
Meng Chong was instantly overjoyed.
The Indestructible Golden Body was already powerful enough to plainly manifest the violence of the Body Cultivation Martial Art. With his current strength, even if he stood still, the Martial Artists who condensed the Heavenly Earth Lingji could not even scratch him.
Even if they pulled out a Divine Artifact, Martial Artists who condensed Heavenly Earth Lingji would probably only inflict minor injuries on him. Meng Chong even doubted that his physical body was robust enough to be compared with a Divine Artifact of a Spirit Sect.
Li Xuan took on a solemn look and slowly said, "On top of the Indestructible Golden Body is the Indestructible Body of the Big Sun Stars, a star for each aperture. The stars surround the sun and have their own laws. The first layer of the Indestructible Body of the Big Sun Stars is the constellation. The body is like the sun, surrounded by stars..."
The subsequent Martial Art cultivation technique of the Indestructible Golden Body is the Indestructible Body of the Big Sun Stars. Li Xuan finally confirmed it after contemplating it repeatedly.
This lads a foundation for the direction of subsequent physical cultivation. Each golden body aperture corresponds to a star.
Each star embodies a mystery.
Or a Divine Skill.
Like the Indestructible Golden Body, the Indestructible Body of the Big Sun Stars also has three layers. The first layer corresponds to the Physiognomy realm. The body is like the sun, surrounded by stars, which are the stars of the Aperture, formed by the Heaven and Earth Laws.
In order to keep Body Cultivation Martial Art as strong as always and to achieve a certain realm status of the Body Cultivation Martial Art, Li Xuan spent quite a bit of time pondering it.
Despite this, only two layers of the Indestructible Body of the Big Sun Stars have been compiled. The third layer is yet to be perfected and still needs to be further refined.
Meng Chong felt excited. Just listening to the master's description, he praised the power and dominance of the Indestructible Body of the Day Stars. With a thought, the golden body is like a sun, stars are circling around, the divine power is majestic!
Each star is a mystery and a Divine Skill.
"Master will transmit the first layer to you, remember it..."
Li Xuan began to transmit the first layer of the Indestructible Body of the Big Sun Stars to Meng Chong. This layer of cultivation technique also incorporated the patterns of the Heaven and Earth Laws, making it easier to figure out how to control the Heaven and Earth Laws and how to cultivate the Aperture Stars with Heaven and Earth Laws.

chapters.title: Chapter 621 - 332: The Indestructible Body of the Big Sun Stars, The Gate of Ling Domain has Disappeared_2
chapters.content:
While instructing Meng Chong in his cultivation technique, Li Xuan looked at the information given by the Daoist Golden Book.
Indestructible Body of the Big Sun Stars (Level One):
Technique Perfection: Above average.
Realm Continuity: High.
Comprehension Difficulty: High.
Cultivation Difficulty: High.
The perfection of the technique was maintained as much as possible at above average.
The continuity between realms had indeed improved a lot.
After Li Xuan explained the Indestructible Body of the Big Sun Stars once, he repeated it again for Meng Chong to remember it thoroughly.
Meng Chong was attentively understanding and fully memorizing the technique, not letting any detail, word or sentence slip by.
Once Meng Chong had fully absorbed the first level of the technique, Li Xuan began to pass on to him the second level.
Indestructible Body of the Big Sun Stars (Level Two):
Technique Perfection: Above average.
Realm Continuity: Above average.
Comprehension Difficulty: High.
Cultivation Difficulty: High.
The realm continuity of the second level of the Indestructible Body of the Big Sun Stars had also taken Li Xuan quite a lot of time to raise to an above average level.
But that was good enough.
As long as Meng Chong comprehends the first level of the Indestructible Body of the Big Sun Stars, he should naturally be able to understand the second level. With an above-average level of realm continuity, he would simply have to spend a little more time comprehending it.
In the same way, Li Xuan explained the Indestructible Body of the Big Sun Stars twice, and emphasized the key points and explained in detail again, so that Meng Chong could fully remember and understand it.
"I'll teach you the second level of the Indestructible Body of the Big Sun Stars, and when you've comprehended the first level, I'll teach you the third. This will help you remember it better."
After teaching the second level, Li Xuan said, waving his hand.
"Yes, Master!"
Respectfully saluting, Meng Chong excused himself and left to find a place to settle down, ponder thoroughly, and fully memorize the cultivation technique, making sure he didn't miss out on anything.
The Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship had already landed on an open ground outside the capital of Emperor Da Zhou, and a small manor had emerged, with the pavilion of Evergreen Pavilion commanding attention.
"The Evergreen Pavilion has arrived."
In the capital of Great Zhou, countless martial artists were waiting for the further moves of the Da Zhou dynasty.
The Evergreen Pavilion was right outside the capital now. They had just killed a powerful person from the Da Zhou royal family at Lake Xiaoxing not long ago, and now they had stopped right outside the capital city of Da Zhou. It seemed provocative no matter how one looked at it.
Although everyone knew the Evergreen Pavilion wandered everywhere, maybe this was their planned next destination. But just after the conflict at Lake Xiaoxing, their sudden arrival in the capital raised suspicions. Were they deliberately provoking?
This caused, even though the Evergreen Pavilion had arrived, there were no martial artists coming to seek treatment, and it felt unusually deserted. Everyone was watching the attitude of the Great Zhou royal family.
"What's wrong with the people in the Da Zhou capital? Are there no injured martial artists? Or are they not interested in the elixirs?"
Shi'er said, puzzled.
"Everyone's probably waiting for the Da Zhou royal family to take a stand."
Meng Shushu said with a laugh.
"Zi Yun, is there anything interesting to do in Da Zhou capital?"
Su Lingxiu asked curiously.
"Should be?"
Zi Yun seemed uncertain, then said, "I'm not familiar with those guys from the royal family, and I'm too lazy to please them. I spend most of my time cultivating.
"However, my adoptive father is very kind to me. My royal brother went to Yuntian city, and I don't know why my adoptive father sent him there."
"I see."
Su Lingxiu pondered for a moment, then said, "Let's go sightseeing in the capital tomorrow. After all, it's the only dynasty in the Ling Domain that is not under the control of the Spirit Sect. I'd like to see how prosperous the Da Zhou capital is."
"Miss, won't it be troublesome to enter the Great Zhou capital?"
Zhou Ying said with concern.
"What trouble could there be? I'm not afraid of trouble. If the Xiang family of Da Zhou wants to court death, let them be. With Master here, I have nothing to worry about."
Su Lingxiu said dismissively.
Upon reflection, Zhou Ying found it reasonable.
The last thing the Evergreen Pavilion was afraid of was trouble.
"This is the Da Zhou capital, the first royal city in the Ling Domain. We're here now, how can we not go sightseeing?"
Li Xuan looked at the Da Zhou capital and also felt like going for a stroll.
"The royal family of Da Zhou, with rebel offspring, come to apologize to the Elixir Fairy!"
As Su Lingxiu and others were discussing the trip to Da Zhou capital, a sudden voice came.
"The Purple King?"
Su Lingxiu was surprised. Was the royal family of Da Zhou conceding?
Had the Purple King come to apologize?
"That Xiang Mingmao is the son of the Purple King."
Zi Yun said.
"I see."
Su Lingxiu nodded. She activated the formation to open a portal and said, "Come in."
The purple-robed King Zi, with a young man with his head bowed behind him, walked in. It was Xiang Mingmao!
"Greetings, King Zi!"
Zi Yun bowed.
As a member of the Great Zhou imperial family now, she had to bow when meeting King Zi, unlike Su Lingxiu and others who took it lightly.
King Zi nodded.
"Greetings, Miss Su!"
King Zi clasped his fists with an apologetic face and said, "Some time ago, my foolish son behaved arrogantly and offended Miss Su. I was entwined in important affairs and did not apologize to Miss Su in time, I hope you won't take it to heart.
"Today, I heard that Miss Su has come to the imperial capital and therefore, I have brought my son to apologize to Miss Su!"
After finishing, he glared at Xiang Mingmao.
"Earlier, I rashly offended the Evergreen Pavilion and Miss Su. I apologize and ask Miss Su for her forgiveness. I hope Miss Su can be magnanimous!"
Xiang Mingmao was completely unwilling.
However, this was the decision of Emperor of Da Zhou, no matter how unwilling he was, he could only obey. Otherwise, his position as the Princely Heir of King Zi would probably be at stake.
Seeing Zi Yun standing next to Su Lingxiu, he was both jealous and unwilling, but he hid it all deep in his heart, not daring to reveal any of it.
While apologizing, Xiang Mingmao held a box high above his head with both hands.
"It's a small matter, there's no need for compensation."
Su Lingxiu shook her head.
"A little compensation, I do not wish Miss Su to take offense!"
King Zi chuckled.
"If so, thanks!"
Su Lingxiu nodded.
Zhou Ying stepped forward and took the box.
"Our Emperor of Da Zhou wishes to host a banquet for Miss Su. May I know if Miss Su will be available?" asked King Zi.
Su Lingxiu shook her head, "I'm busy. I do not like attending banquets!"
Although the Emperor of Da Zhou's attitude was very humble, Su Lingxiu still shook her head and refused.
"In that case, I take my leave!"
King Zi nodded, bid his farewell and left with Xiang Mingmao.
"King Zi is so easy to speak with? I heard he was very domineering."
Zi Yun wondered.
"He's only domineering to the weak. Against the strong, he naturally can't be domineering."
Meng Chong walked over and said.
King Zi was very strong.
However, Meng Chong didn't really care, with his current strength, he would not be inferior to King Zi in the slightest. If they were to fight, the defeated one would surely be King Zi.
The next day, Zi Yun took Meng Chong, Su Lingxiu, Yue'er, and Cai Ling'er to the imperial capital, while Shi'er, Meng Shushu, and Zhou Ying stayed onboard the Flying Boat, fearing they would become a burden if any mishap occurred due to their weak strength.
Currently, Li Xuan was wandering in the Palace of Emperor Da Zhou, sighing in admiration, "Incredible! Comparable to the heritage of the Transcendent Spirit Sect, this strength is not bad, the Emperor of Da Zhou's strength is very strong."
While the strength of Emperor Da Zhou was undoubtedly weaker than Xin Mengrou and Wu Tianan, according to Wu Tianan, he was somewhat stronger than the Thousand Martial Lord, Lord Lei Yun, and the Yuling Mansion Master.
Of course, the Emperor of Da Zhou's apparent strength was about the same as the Thousand Martial Lord and others. True to his imperial nature, he hid his cards well.
Emperor Da Zhou did not conceal his strength with cultivation techniques, but with a divine artifact that he carried with him which obscured his true strength.
Yuzhou, Zheng Country!
Two elders of the Thousand Martial Hall quietly arrived and directly found Emperor Zheng. They led him to the grand hall where the Gate of Lingyu was opened.
"Open the Lingyu Gate, this matter must not be leaked. If there's any leak, you will be executed!"
An elder of the Thousand Martial Hall sternly said to Emperor Zheng and the two martial artists guarding the hall.
"Yes, Elder!"
Sweat was about to drip from Emperor Zheng and the three others.
These elders were from the Transcendent Spirit Sect after all.
"Elder, please wait for a moment!"
The two martial artists, without any delay, hurriedly began to open the Gate of Lingyu.
"Just open a crack."
An elder instructed.
They didn't want to make a big move, to avoid being detected. The two of them scanned the surroundings to ensure no other martial artist was present who could discover the opening of the Lingyu Gate.
"Elder, it is ready!"
Said one of the guards.
"Hmm!"
The elder of the Thousand Martial Hall crossed the grand hall, full of excitement, and headed towards the location of the Lingyu Gate. As he walked out of the grand hall and looked up, he froze.
Where was the Gate of Lingyu?
Where the Lingyu Gate had originally been was now completely empty!
Had the Lingyu Gate disappeared?!

chapters.title: Chapter 622 - 333: Thousand Martial Lord's Decision, Escape Sea Boat_1
chapters.content:
The two elders of the Thousand Martial Hall stared at the spot where the Gate of Ling Domain once stood; it was now just empty space. Where had the Gate of Ling Domain gone?
Their hearts quivered in their chests, a prickling sensation climbing up their scalps.
Emperor Zheng was also dumbfounded. He felt a chill run down his spine and his vision started to fade. He felt like he was about to collapse.
With the Gate of Ling Domain gone, the mission of the Zheng Country was also gone. How could they maintain their unique status? How could they continue to have the protection of the Transcendent Spirit Sect?
At the thought, Emperor Zheng nearly lost his mind.
"Sir, I'll go have a look to see if those two bastards managed to restart it!"
Emperor Zheng said as he ran frantically into the main hall.
"Activate the Gate of Ling Domain, fully activate it!"
He said gravely.
The two Martial Artists guarding the hall noticed Emperor Zheng's strange expression and hastily activated the Gate of Ling Domain.
Once Emperor Zheng made sure the Gate of Ling Domain was fully activated, only then did he hurriedly cross the main hall. But the spot where the Gate of Ling Domain once stood was still empty.
Everything went dark before his eyes, and his legs grew weak.
"Is the Gate of Ling Domain fully opened?"
An elder from the Thousand Martial Hall asked gravely.
Even he himself didn't notice that his voice was wavering slightly.
"Sir, it's fully opened, completely open, there's not a single issue!"
Emperor Zheng kneeled on the ground and answered.
"This…."
The faces of the two elders from Thousand Martial Hall were filled with incredulity, their hearts trembling.
The Gate of Ling Domain was gone!
The Gate of Ling Domain, which has existed for countless eons and connected to the Inner Domain, was just gone?
This was a monumental event for Ling Domain!
"What should we do?"
"This matter can't be disclosed. We should report back to the Thousand Martial Lord before making further decisions."
"We can only do this!"
The two elders communicated through their minds.
"Only you and I know about the disappearance of the Gate of Ling Domain. Do you understand?"
One of the elders said graveyly.
Emperor Zheng turned as pale as a sheet and nodded. "Sir, I understand!"
"Hmm!"
The two elders nodded their heads.
If not for Emperor Zheng being a special case, where his death would attract the attention of other Transcendent Spirit Sects, the two of them would definitely have killed him to keep him quiet.
When they got back to the main hall.
"Close the Gate of Ling Domain. From today onwards, nobody is to open the Gate of Ling Domain without the command from Thousand Martial Hall!"
An elder from the Thousand Martial Hall said sternly.
"Yes, Sir!"
The two Martial Artists hastily closed the Gate of Ling Domain.
Even though they thought it was strange that the two leaders opened the Gate of Ling Domain and then immediately closed it, they didn't dare to ask too many questions.
When it comes to the secrets of powerful beings like these, the less you knew the safer you were.
The two elders of the Thousand Martial Hall took Emperor Zheng out of the main hall, gave him multiple stern warnings, and then finally left.
And then, a day later, Emperor Zheng came to the main hall under the pretext of inspecting it and accused the guards of negligence of duty, executing them on spot and replacing them with new ones.
This was a minor matter; killing two guards just because Emperor Zheng was displeased was not something people tended to care about.
No one knew about the disappearance of the Gate of Ling Domain.
Emperor Zheng didn't dare leak a single word, not even to the other Transcendent Spirit Sects. Or else, he would surely be killed.
Meanwhile, the two elders of the Thousand Martial Hall were hurrying back to the Thousand Martial Hall.
"Did you find Xu Yan's weakness? Has it been controlled?"
The Thousand Martial Lord looked surprised. "That was quick."
"Lord, something big has happened!"
The faces of the two elders were heavy.
"What happened?"
Thousand Martial Lord's expression turned serious. "Did Xu Yan find out about our operation?"
"No, Lord, it's something even bigger than that."
"Speak. What is it?"
"The Gate of Ling Domain is gone!"
"What did you say?"
Thousand Martial Lord stood up abruptly.
"The Gate of Ling Domain has disappeared!"
The other elder added heavily.
"Disappeared? How can the Gate of Ling Domain just disappear?"
The Thousand Martial Lord's face was filled with disbelief.
"Lord, it's the absolute truth!"
The two elders explained everything in detail, their expressions deeply serious.
"For now, only the three of us know about this. The guards should have been dealt with already. Lord, what should we do? Should we inform the other houses?"
An elder asked.
Thousand Martial Lord began pacing back and forth. He still couldn't believe it - the Gate of Ling Domain had vanished?
How did it vanish?
Why did it vanish?
"Since the last time it was opened, has anyone opened the Gate of Ling Domain again?"
Thousand Martial Lord stopped pacing and asked gravely.
"No!"
Thousand Martial Lord started pacing again. The disappearance of the Gate of Ling Domain was a monumental event for the Ling Domain. To the other Spirit Sect families, it might seem like they simply lost a gate to a lower plane in the Inner Domain.
However, to them, the Transcendent Spirit Sect, they knew the importance of the Gate of Ling Domain.
At present, what the Thousand Martial Lord needed to consider was whether or not to cover up the disappearance of the Gate of Ling Domain as if nothing happened, or to report it to the other powerful Transcendent Spirit Sects.
If they reported it to the other houses, it would expose their intention to travel to the Inner Domain.
If this matter were to be exposed, it could either become a big problem, or a small one. After all, it involved the existence behind Xu Yan that was presumably a Lord.
"The matter of the Gate of Ling Domain disappearing must not be leaked. We'll act as if we don't know about it. Also, keep an eye on the other houses to see if anyone is planning to open the Gate of Ling Domain to go to the Inner Domain."
The Thousand Martial Lord finally made a decision.
"Yes, Lord!"
The two elders nodded.
One of them, with worry etched onto his face, asked, "Lord, there might be a problem with the Gate of Ling Domain disappearing. If we don't inform the other houses and something happens…"
Thousand Martial Lord said gravely, "The opening of the Divine Bridge is imminent, and the competition of the outstanding talents will soon enter its final stage. The time has come for us to enter that place;

chapters.title: Chapter 623 - 333: Thousand Martial Lord's Decision, Escape Sea Boat_2
chapters.content:
"Behind Xu Yan, there might be a Lord existing, what are they doing in the Inner Domain, let alone the Ling Domain?
"Are they trying to prevent some changes resulting from the disappearance of the Gate of Lingyu? These are not the things you and I can know.
"If this matter leaks, and they discover that we, the Thousand Martial Hall, found out and leaked it in advance, how can we handle it if they take action against us?
"Regardless, we should pretend to know nothing. The Thousand Martial Hall is not involved. Everything else waits until the Divine Bridge is open!"
The two elders trembled at these words, agreeing that the Hall Master was making sense.
"Yes, Hall Master, we understand!"
The Thousand Martial Lord nodded, and said in a serious tone, "Let this matter end here. Don't mention finding Xu Yan's weakness anymore, let's focus on the battle of the Heaven's Chosen."
The disappearance of the Gate of Lingyu weighed heavily on the Thousand Martial Lord's mind, he could only pretend to know nothing about it.
In the Imperial City of Great Zhou, Su Lingxiu and others, led by Zi Yun, started to tour around. Naturally, the Chosen of Great Zhou, who wanted to curry favor with them, were driven away without exception.
Meng Chong was also quickly recognized.
Blade Lord Meng Chong!
As Meng Chong's identity was recognized, some Chosen members of the Great Zhou were excited to challenge him. Meng Chong responded by sending a well-known Chosen member, who was quite prestigious in the Imperial City, flying with a single punch.
It was just an ordinary spar, so he naturally did not use his full strength.
Li Xuan was strolling leisurely in the Palace of Da Zhou, walking around without anyone noticing an extra stranger in the palace.
"Xu Yan once honed his mentality in Emperor Qi's harem, this harem of Great Zhou is far more than those of the kingdoms in the fringe areas, Emperor Da Zhou indeed has a good eye.
"The dances performed by martial artists are mesmerizing, their postures, their flexible waists, and their difficult poses. The cultivation technique of Emperor Da Zhou is based on the path of fire, it seems he has always been spirited."
Li Xuan sat on top of a decorative mountain, watching the concubines of the Great Zhou performing a dance, he couldn't help but sigh.
The Emperor of Great Zhou had a torrential and violent power in his body, cultivating a technique based on the path of fire, his power was not weak and probably this was why his spirit kept flourishing.
Li Xuan strolled leisurely in the Great Zhou Imperial Palace and made his way into the Great Zhou Collection Pavilion without a care in the world.
Even though there were top warriors guarding the Collection Pavilion, Li Xuan did not care a bit. In just one step, a mysterious door quietly appeared. In the eyes of the guarding martial artists, everything was normal, with no one approaching, and no one entering the gate of the Collection Pavilion.
Li Xuan leisurely strolled through the Collection Pavilion, heading straight to the top floor. This was where the core items were kept, containing items that piqued his interest.
Sitting on a chair at the top floor, he beckoned with his hand, and a book flew towards him.
In such a leisurely manner, Li Xuan read through the collections of the Great Zhou, including cultivation techniques and secret records, and so on.
While Su Lingxiu and the others were touring the bustling Imperial City of Da Zhou, Li Xuan was leisurely reading through the collections of the Great Zhou Imperial Palace inside the Collection Pavilion.
As for Xu Yan, he had already arrived in Chenzhou, to find Fang Hao.
"Big Brother!"
Fang Hao hurried over after receiving the communication, with Moon Changming following him.
"Fourth Brother, you're doing a great job as the Junior Alliance Hierarch."
Xu Yan said with a smile.
"Hehe, not bad!"
Fang Hao chuckled. Although he was just the Junior Hierarch now, he was actually the real person in charge of the All Ages Alliance.
Ever since the advent of the communication talisman, it established a new communication system.
With the deployment of the teleportation formation, it connected all the big cities, facilitating travel.
Chenzhou was undergoing a great transformation; loose cultivators were flocking to the city, and even some Spirit Sects and families were considering setting up branches in Chenzhou.
The ease of travel between cities was swift and efficient which increased the popularity of Chenzhou, and that gradually started to thrive.
However, everyone knew that the Transcendent Spirit Sect would not sit by and watch the All Ages Alliance continue to grow stronger. They were merely waiting for the right opportunity and looking for ways to crush the All Ages Alliance during the battle of the Chosen.
They might even be plotting something behind the scenes.
Even so, the warriors from various states who came to Chenzhou were in an endless stream, even if only to experience the magic of the teleportation formation.
Almost imperceptibly, Chenzhou was trending towards becoming the center of the Ling Domain.
Xu Yan and his Senior Brother Fang Hao reminisced for a while, and then Xu Yan talked about his upcoming trip to the Azure Sea.
"Little brother, do you have a Flying Boat?"
Xu Yan inquired.
His reason for coming was for the Flying Boat. The Azure Sea was vast, and having a Flying Boat would make things easier and the journey more relaxed.
"Big Brother, you're going to the Azure Sea to search for treasures. You'll definitely have to go into the sea. I'll refine a boat for you that can travel undersea."
Fang Hao pondered for a moment before responding.
"That's perfect. There are several places in the Azure Sea that need to be explored. With a Flying Boat helping, it'll be much easier."
Xu Yan nodded in approval.
"Senior Brother, please wait a few days for me to refine the flying boat."
"Okay!"
Xu Yan nods.
Fang Hao begins to create a flying boat for Xu Yan. One of its most crucial functions will be to traverse the seas and travel underwater, requiring careful planning.
Several days later, Fang Hao holds up a pale blue flying boat and says, "Senior Brother, the flying boat is ready. It can travel underwater, diverts water, and has a built-in orientation system."
Fang Hao introduces this flying boat, and its most significant function is indeed navigation and a return journey setting to avoid getting lost.
"This is the Navigation Bead. Place it anywhere, and if you lose your way, activate the navigation formation on the boat, and you will return to the location of the Navigation Bead."
Fang Hao takes out several fist-sized pale blue beads.
Upon hearing this, Xu Yan rejoices. If it works as described, he won't need to worry about losing his way in the Jade Sea Dark Abyss.
"However, the formation can also be interfered with; the further away it is, the less likely it is to navigate back. Within a thousand miles, the navigation strength is the strongest, so senior brother, please be cautious."
Fang Hao reminds him.
"Understood."
Xu Yan nods. Afterall, the formation can indeed be influenced by interference. The disturbance from the Dark Abyss still remains unknown; naturally, one must be careful and cautious.
"Since this flying boat can submerge in the ocean, let's call it the Sea Submerging Boat."
Xu Yan says, holding the azure flying boat in his palm.
"Junior brother, I will be back before the match of the talented."
Xu Yan states with a smile.
"I am waiting for the day senior brother suppresses the talented of Lingyu!"
Fang Hao cheerfully comments.
"Haha, the top four in Lingyu's ranking of the talented will be taken by us."
Xu Yan smiles, takes to the air, and a thirty-foot-long flying boat emerges, transforming into a blue light and takes off.
"Jade Sea!"
Fang Hao sighs somewhat wistfully.
Ever since he joined the All Ages Alliance and took on the title of Young Hierarch, he could no longer live as freely and easily as his senior brothers and sisters.
"Envious of your Senior Brother's freedom and liberty?"
Moon Changming says with a smile.
"A bit, but soon, I will achieve it."
Fang Hao nods.
The All Ages Alliance is just one of the experiences on his martial arts journey. He won't get stuck there forever. Once the situation in the Ling Domain changes, he must put down the affairs of the All Ages Alliance and walk his own path of martial arts.
Just as free and easy as his senior brothers and sisters.
Traveling all around, challenging the world, defeating all the talents!
"I feel that Chenzhou will become a stormy place."
Moon Changming sighs.
The more incredible the transportation formation, the bigger storm it may bring. Today's tranquility is just brewing; once it breaks out, it will be unimaginably fierce.
"No matter how big the storm, it can only signify the All Ages Alliance's failure. It can't blow me down, can it?"
Fang Hao laughs.
Moon Changming nods. Regardless of how potent the storm, it can only imply the failure of the All Ages Alliance. Who could hurt Fang Hao?
After all, he has a distinguished master.
Xu Yan sat in the small attic of the flying boat. After adding enough Spirit Crystals to the boat, he began cultivating and comprehending his martial arts.
The flying boat turns into a pale blue light, flying towards the direction of the Azure Sea, even faster than the usual speed of peak Refining God Heavenly Men.
One day, the flying boat enters a cloud-covered sky.
Xu Yan opens his eyes.
"We've reached the State of Fog."
The State of Fog, one of the Eighteen States of the Lingyu that is named for its abundant clouds and mists. It's also connected to the Azure Sea.
Xu Yan plans to enter the Azure Sea via the State of Fog and head towards Yuntian Azure Sea City.
After finding Xie Lingfeng and passing on the cultivation technique, he plans to explore the Jade Sea Dark Abyss and the Jade Sea Abyss.

chapters.title: Chapter 624 - 334: The Change in Ice State, Mu Qianliu's Tragic Encounter_1
chapters.content:
The pale blue flying boat shot through the foggy sky without any pause, ready to cross the Fog State directly and enter the Azure Sea.
"Even if I can't reach the Divine Skill Realm on this journey to the Azure Sea and back to the Eighteen States, I will inevitably reach the complete realm of the divine element," Xu Yan thought to himself.
If things go smoothly and he can obtain the divine object of the Azure Sea, it should be enough to lay the foundation for breaking through the Divine Skill Realm.
"Before the start of the Battle of the Geniuses, reaching the completion of the Divine Origin Realm is inevitable. I hope to accumulate enough foundation so that I can break through the Divine Skill Realm immediately after the battle," Xu Yan planned.
If he could enter the Divine Skill Realm, he would be matchless in the Ling Domain. Apart from his master, there would be no opponent for him in the entire Ling Domain.
He could overpower the Transcendent Spirit Sect single-handedly without a problem.
"If I can accumulate enough foundation and there's not much time left for the Battle of the Geniuses, then I might as well break through after the battle, there's no rush," Xu Yan mused.
Indeed, whether he could accumulate enough foundation before the Battle of the Geniuses remains uncertain.
Even if he successfully obtains the divine object of the Azure Sea, the accumulation of the foundation requires time to settle.
...
Ice State, among the Eighteen States of Ling Domain, was the least populated state.
Covered in perennial ice and snow, it was monotonously white as far as the eye could see, with hardly any signs of green vegetation.
Occasionally visible plants were mostly white, emitting a faint chill.
The Ice State is a rich source of cold spiritual medicine in Ling Domain. If one occasionally encounters a non-white plant within Ice State, it is undoubtedly divine spiritual medicine.
In Ice State, there was a Spirit Sect, the Quiet Snow Palace. Although it didn't belong to the Transcendent Spirit Sect, it was still within the top-notch existence of the top-ranking Spirit Sects. Rumor has it that this sect has a powerful existence that had condensed the Heavenly Earth Lingji.
The Quiet Snow Palace located deep within the Ice State, within the Quiet Snow Mountain Range.
The Quiet Snow Palace is a rare female Spirit Sect in the Ling Domain, consisting entirely of women, with no male martial artists.
The women of the Quiet Snow Palace were known for their exceptional beauty. As beautiful as the flowers in the snow, they had stunning figures and their skin was as smooth and cold as jade.
Due to the harsh cold of Ice State, even small celestial martial artists were unwilling to live there for too long. Hence, it was tough to find towns or gathering places in such a vast place.
Disciples of the Quiet Snow Palace were generally selected from other states. They cultivated ice-cold techniques, so they were not afraid of the severe cold. In fact, the harsh cold environment was more conducive to their cultivation.
The beauties of the Quiet Snow Palace had a small reputation in Ling Domain. Rumor has it that once a genius from a Spirit Sect went to ask for a lady's hand in marriage and managed to return home with a beautiful woman he fancied.
There was a rumor in the Ling Domain that the beauties of Quiet Snow Palace were stunning, icy yet seductive, especially on hot days. There were also rumors that a martial artist cultivating fire techniques would have an exciting experience if he married a beauty from the Quiet Snow Palace, as he could experience the wonderful blend of ice and fire.
However, as these comments became widespread, the Quiet Snow Palace took great offence to such remarks, and it became almost impossible for a genius from a Spirit Sect to marry a lady from the Palace.
