When the disaster of the Blood Demon swept across Ice State, a period of turmoil arose, causing a series of wars to break out as the Blood God cultists coveted the ladies of the Quiet Snow Palace.
As the Blood God Sect was eventually destroyed and the Blood Demon retreated to the Inner Domain, Ice State also began to receive less attention. Anecdotes about the Quiet Snow Palace seldom circulated in the Ling Domain.
The Quiet Snow Palace seemed to be forgotten by the other states and appeared to enter a state of seclusion.
At this moment, most of the previous structures in the Palace had already disappeared.
Only a snow palace was built, and all around it, the Quiet Snow Palace was radiant with colors and extraordinarily beautiful.
The Divine spiritual medicine filled the Quiet Snow Palace.
Deep inside the snow palace, there was a black vortex-like cave. This cave seemed to appear on the ground, giving people a sense that it was not an earthly cave, but a hole that appeared between Heaven and Earth.
There was an unknown aura inside the cave. It seemed to be expanding, and even a warm feeling could be felt from within.
Outside the snow palace, a man in thin clothes, shivering in the cold wind, was swallowing a divine spiritual medicine.
The medicine was blood-red and had a great effect in replenishing vitality.
"That's the ninth one. I've recovered again and should be able to hold on," said the handsome man with an elegant air about him, but deep down in his eyes, there was a hint of regret and fear.
He looked up at the Quiet Snow Palace. In the scarce buildings, he could vaguely see graceful women. Each of them had unique features.
Whether they had stunning figures, were gentle and soft-spoken, or were shy...he had slept with all these beauties.
He had been here for over ten years.
Ever since he happened to hear a rumor and received a piece of news, he came to the Quiet Snow Palace. Since then, he had been kept busy, and from time to time, he felt exhausted and needed to replenish his energy.
There were many beauties here. When he walked among them and tasted the varying beauties of the world, he was initially very excited.
But later on, he turned afraid.
And now, he even felt numb.
Because all the beautiful women in the Quiet Snow Palace were the same person!
Their divine souls were all the same!
He even suspected that these beauties' bodies belonged to the same person.
Of course, this was just a suspicion. The possibility was low, but he was a hundred percent sure that their divine souls all belonged to the same person.
These beauties might have been the disciples or elders of the Quiet Snow Palace. Their divine consciousness had been devoured long ago, and their bodies were inhabited by a divine soul.
What scared him even more was that this divine soul, which belonged to the same person, was very peculiar and vastly different from the divine souls cultivated by martial artists from Ling Domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 625 - 334: Changes in Ice State, The Tragic Experience of Mu Qianliu_2
chapters.content:
The beauties that resided here differed in their appearances and even their tempers. Every day he had to deal with the differing tempers of these beauties.
Using all the skills and sweet words he had accumulated all his life, he was barely able to manage the situation.
Just when he breathed a sigh of relief and was preparing to seize an opportunity to escape, the mastermind revealed herself.
Three years prior!
Three years ago, he had seen her, the irresistible beauty who commanded these Divine Souls. Her attractiveness flared like fire, unrivalled in her allure, possessing a bewitching charm akin to draining one's marrow.
Since then, he was plunged into endless agony.
He reached up to touch his cheek, the shallow hole signalling his inability to fully recover, even after swallowing the Divine Grade Spiritual Medicine.
"If it continues like this, I'll be drained to death!"
The man muttered to himself.
The feeling was admittedly intoxicating, and the process of death would likely not be miserable. Instead, he would pass away in bliss, which could arguably be described as the most wonderful way to die.
But he didn't want to die!
The image of a gentle and understanding woman, radiant as jade, surfaced in his mind. Among all the women he had encountered, she was the most unforgettable.
"When I left, it seemed as though you were pregnant. I had wanted to stay with you until our child was born, and I had wanted to bring you home... But tragedies happened and I had to return early.
"Having been trapped here ever since, you might feel as though I've deceived you."
"I never lied to you. Even though I've shown partiality to many, you're still the one I love the most!"
The man murmured to himself.
At that moment, an indulging call echoed from the icy palace hall, sending ripples through his heart, "Mumu, I want you, come quick!"
Shit!
Although the man cursed internally, he couldn't really say it was a curse, since he was about to take action soon.
"I'm coming, my most beloved treasure!"
The man's face revealed an indulgent smile, his eyes bursting with excitement as he made his way into the icy palace hall.
In the icy palace hall, amid the frost and snow, a woman lay nude upon a pink embellished couch, her skin so pure it seemed to blend into the ice itself.
Even her hair was as white as the snow. Her captivating beauty could topple countless men.
When he first saw her, he was indeed toppled. But now, he had a sense of fear deep in his heart, a feeling he dared not expose.
This woman didn't seem to be human!
Of course, she wasn't a sea spirit either, after all, he already had a sea spirit beauty.
"Mumu, you've finally returned handsomely."
"There's no one in this world more handsome than I, Mu Qianliu, even if it costs me my soul and body for you, it's all worth it!"
"Don't say things like that, how can I bear to see you wither away. You're the only one I cherish in this world."
"Ah, my treasure, you're still so icy and enchanting..."
This man was none other than the long-lost prodigal son of the Mu Family, Mu Qianliu!
One day later.
"Wuuwuu, Mumu, you're all dried up. What should we do, I drained you too much this time!"
At that moment, Mu Qianliu's body was shriveled up, appearing as though it had been hollowed out. His handsome and energetic allure was nowhere to be seen.
His eyes were vacant, with a hint of residual fear lingering deep within his pupils.
His body tremored slightly, his lips quivered as he said, "It doesn't matter, I was thrilled, I was happy, and I'm content even if I die."
"Mumu, I won't let you die. Without you, where can I find happiness."
As the woman spoke, she stuffed a few Divine Grade Spiritual Medicines into Mu Qianliu's mouth.
After gulping down several Divine Grade Spiritual Medicines, Mu Qianliu barely managed to regain some vitality. However, his body still looked withered and hollow.
"Oh no, you've been hurt at your core. Eating so many Divine Grade Spiritual Medicines, the effects aren't showing."
The woman raised a slender eyebrow and said.
Struggling, Mu Qianliu managed to stand up, he draped a thick spiritual robe over himself. His body tremored, his legs shook, but he said with resolution, "It's a minor hiccup. I will gather some Divine Grade Spiritual Medicines, find a friend, and prepare a replenishing potion. After resting for about ten days or half a month, I'll be back to normal."
"Really?"
"Of course, it's just too cold. Darling, I'm afraid I might freeze to death when I go out!"
With hands wrapped around his shoulders, Mu Qianliu said.
"Is that so? That's a small matter."
The woman beckoned, and a small stone flew out from a swirl of black in the depths of the icy palace hall. The pale red stone was as if heated iron, and yet, it only emanated a gentle warmth.
"Carry this with you, and you won't feel cold anymore."
Mu Qianliu took the stone and put it in his pocket, eagerly moved forward, embracing the woman before reluctantly saying, "Baby, when I come back, we'll battle for three days and three nights!"
"Hmmm, three days and three nights, that sounds entrancing."
The woman nodded, a look of longing across her blush-flushed face.
"A fortnight, a fortnight at the latest, I'll be back."
"Mumu, I'll wait for you!"
Mu Qianliu left the palace, swallowing several stalks of Spiritual Medicine, and headed outside the Quiet Snow Palace, constantly picking and keeping more Spiritual Medicine.
After leaving the mountain range where the Quiet Snow Palace was located, Mu Qianliu glanced back, the fear deep in his eyes, somehow failing to hide it.
"Something is wrong here, a crisis, the crisis of the Ling Domain, is it going to break out here?"
His gaze was firm, he departed one step at a time, initially slow but gradually took to the sky, heading out of the Ice State.
"My origin is almost exhausted, it can't be replenished this time, I never thought I, Mu Qianliu, would meet such an end!"
He felt entirely drained.
"A fortnight, just a fortnight, once they exceed that, she would come looking for me!"
Mu Qianliu thought to himself.
To make this escape, for the past three years, each time he was nearly drained, he would leave the Quiet Snow Palace under the excuse of going treasure hunting and replenishing himself.
Each time, he would return to the Quiet Snow Palace at most in a fortnight.
Returning faithfully time after time, finally causing the other side to loosen their surveillance, earning him this chance to escape.
In the past, nearly drained, he would use secret techniques to restore himself.
Used too often, his origin was severely damaged.
This time, it's too difficult to recover.
There's no doubt – he is doomed!
"She should be unable to leave the Ice State, as long as I get out, I'll be completely free, most of her divine soul's power, consciousness and attention, are all in that cave."
"So, she didn't notice that my origin is almost completely dry, and it can't be replenished."
"Otherwise, there was absolutely no way to leave successfully."
"What is that cave, what's happening in the Quiet Snow Palace?"
Mu Qianliu pondered, his speed getting faster and faster, frantically escaping from the Ice State.
Economic agents must leave the Ice State within a fortnight.
Once, when he entered the Ice State, he had condensed the Heavenly Earth Lingji, and it was more than one strand, just half a step away from condensing the aura of Heaven and Earth Laws.
With such strength, he was among the top in the Ling Domain.
In the end, he couldn't resist at all.
That woman was terrifyingly powerful, so much so that Mu Qianliu even suspected that she had no flesh and blood!
"I can't survive, I'll leave the Ice State, and see her one last time."
Mu Qianliu sighed inwardly.
The incident at the Quiet Snow Palace was too weird.
Desperate in his flight, in the end, he even used one of the secret techniques. His speed increased drastically, and finally, before the end of the fortnight, he managed to escape Ice State.
Mu Qianliu did not stop at all, he didn't even dare to go back to the Mu Family, fearing bringing disaster upon them.
He arrived at a big city, found a hideout, handed a letter to a person there, asking them to send it to someone.
After doing all of this, Mu Qianliu went straight to Yuzhou.
Back at the Quiet Snow Palace in the Ice State, a charming figure suddenly appeared above the palace, her eyes gradually cold;
"You fooled me! You dare to fool me, I'll grind you into dust, I've been so good to you, and yet you dare to fool me.
"You can't escape, I'll find you, I hate being deceived the most!"
Boom!
At some point, the Snow Palace melted away, the women in the Quiet Snow Palace sped away, searching in all directions for Mu Qianliu.
The result, naturally, was futile!
"Damn you! You're going to die! You tricked me, you played with me, and left me, I want to flay your skin!"
The woman screamed, seemingly mad.
Boom!
The previously black cave started spreading heat, a touch of red gushed out, the surrounding ice and snow started to melt.
The warm air kept spreading, advancing across the entire Ice State, the black cave, also, was slowly enlarging.

chapters.title: Chapter 626 - 335: Meng Shushu's anger, the Green token_1
chapters.content:
The changes in the Bingzhou Jingxue Palace, the black cave spewing red light, the perpetual ice and snow beginning to melt, Mu Qianliu was unaware of all this.
He was on his way to Yuzhou.
Before he died, he wanted to see that gentle woman, he wanted to die outside of the Ling Domain.
The mysteriously creepy woman in the Jingxue Palace was too terrifying. It terrified him so much that he dared not die in the Ling Domain, even having the feeling that even if he died, he would be dug up and smashed into dust by that woman!
"You deceived me, how dare you deceive me, you deserve to die, you deserve to die!"
A voice full of madness, anger, and boundless hatred echoed in the mountains of Jingxue Palace.
"I loved you so much, I liked you so much, I gave so much for you. Even though I absorbed some of your essence, you were also happy.
"You actually deceived me, you actually wanted to run away. I hate you, I hate you, you deserve to die, you deserve death!"
The snow and ice in the mountains where the Jingxue Palace is located are continuously melting, the black cave is slowly enlarging, and more and more red light is spewing out.
It seems to be not that intense, but the snow and ice are constantly melting.
No one knew what kind of disaster the changes in Bingzhou would bring. Even Mu Qianliu himself did not realize the severity of it. In his view, Bingzhou could only be occupied.
Now, Bingzhou can actually be said to have been occupied.
As long as you don't enter Bingzhou, there's no danger, and among the eighteen states of the Ling Domain, Bingzhou is not too much of a concern.
Mu Qianliu's letter, because of his change in appearance, was not taken seriously compared to the original time and was not delivered as quickly as he wished. Instead, it was delivered to the recipient's desk after a delay.
And the recipient was preparing to go to Changqing Pavilion and didn't notice this letter.
Su Lingxiu and her group were still in the Great Zhou imperial city and even went to King Qing's Mansion as guests under Zi Yun's guidance.
Xiang Qing was overjoyed, never anticipating that Changqing Pavilion had such a relationship with Zi Yun.
Su Lingxiu sold a few pills refined by the heavenly earth spirit mechanism to Xiang Qing, including one refined using the power of the Heaven and Earth Laws.
For Xiang Qing, this is like a fortuitous opportunity which can greatly increase his strength in a short period of time.
As a result, his position as King Qing will also be greatly enhanced.
Xiang Qing sighs in his heart that taking Zi Yun as his adopted daughter is the most correct decision he has made in his life.
Meng Chong is preparing to set off to explore the Ling Domain.
Zi Yun was unwilling to part, wanting Meng chong to stay, but she also knew that Meng Chong would not listen to her, so she had no choice but to bid him farewell reluctantly.
"Alright, try to improve your strength. Aren't you also going to participate in the Genius War?"
Meng Chong said, pulling Zi Yun who was hanging on him.
"I am leaving and we'll meet again before the Decisive Battle of the Genius War."
Meng Chong waved his hand and left in big strides.
The Ling Domain is so vast, he needs to explore more, walk more, wander around, and understand martial arts.
"Wait for it, I will soon be able to condense the Heavenly Earth Spirit Mechanism!"
Zi Yun hummed.
Changqing Pavilion's stay in the Great Zhou Imperial City was longer than ever before. The glamour of the Great Zhou imperial city made Su Lingxiu and her group busily enjoyed themselves.
In the end, Shi'er, Meng Shushu, and Zhou Ying also went to the imperial city to have fun for a few days.
Li Xuan calmly came out from the Great Zhou Royal Collection Pavilion and returned to Changqing Pavilion. He had seen all of the most core treasures in the Collection Pavilion.
It must be said that the Great Zhou Royal Family, which can be compared with the Transcendent Spirit Sect, has too many secrets in its collection, including various major events, rumors and even the list of famous geniuses in the history of the Ling Domain, and so on.
Li Xuan was a bit disappointed though. He did not find the secret of the Divine Bridge in the Collection Pavilion.
The secret of the Divine Bridge is probably the real core secret. It is not even recorded in the Collection Pavilion, but is passed down from generation to generation among the high-levels to avoid the possibility of leaks.
Su Lingxiu and her group returned to Changqing Pavilion and planned their next stop.
"Zi Yun, will you come with us?"
Yue'er asked.
"I'd love to go with you, but my adoptive father mentioned getting me some kind of quota that might involve some of the secrets of the Great Zhou Imperial Family. I want to stay and see what that's about."
Zi Yun thought for a moment and said.
Even though she felt that following Changqing Pavilion would definitely be better as they had an endless supply of pills and even high-level guidance, plus it was easier to see Meng Chong.
However, the secret resources of the Great Zhou Imperial Family also aroused her curiosity and she couldn't help but want to have a look.
"That's fine, I'm also a bit curious about the secrets of the Great Zhou. Zi Yun, if you want to find us, take this communication talisman and contact the All Ages Alliance with it. Using their communication channels, you can find us quickly.
"Or we'll meet again after the Genius War."
Su Lingxiu nodded and said.
After finishing their tour of the Great Zhou Imperial City, Changqing Pavilion started diagnosing patients again. After this round of consultation is finished, they will leave for the next destination.
"For the next destination, let's go to Yunshan State and reencounter some old friends."
Su Lingxiu thought and said.
Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao are at the Taimiao Sect. It will be good to visit them in Yunshan State. They got along well when they were on Canglan Island.
Moreover, they are also from the Inner Domain.
With the beginning of Changqing Pavilion's consultation, the situation of queuing up appeared again. Most of them were there to cure old injuries, chronic diseases, or to purchase pills.
Zi Yun was also helping in the Changqing Pavilion.
One day, the queue suddenly parted.
A woman with elegant temperament, proud posture, and unparalleled beauty walked gracefully. On her left and right followed two beautiful maids, each holding a box.

chapters.title: Chapter 627 - 335: Meng Shushu's Anger, The Green Token_2
chapters.content:
"It's the Princess!"
Someone whispered in the crowd.
Princess Xiang Wei of Great Zhou es!
The dream girl of countless Great Zhou's gifted youths. Numerous talented young men tried their best to win her favor, exhausting their talents, working hard, and finding every possible way to accomplish the meritorious deeds.
However, the Princess suddenly decided not to get married.
There was even a rumor once circulated that the Princess had a butler.
This made countless young talents envious, secretly resenting why they themselves weren't her butler?!
Of course, some rumors about Princess's romantic affairs did not last long and were soon prohibited. Even about the existence of this butler became unknown.
Who this butler was, no one knew.
In contrast, there was a rumor from a Duke's Mansion that the Princess already had someone in her heart, and had secretly pledged her love to this person.
However, nothing came of these rumors, and they soon faded away.
Xiang Wei came to see off. In the capital, she had built a relationship with Su Lingxiu, a fairy dan doctor, on behalf of Xiang Family.
Shi'er guided Xiang Wei into Chang Qing Pavilion, where Su Lingxiu, Zi Yun, and Yue'er were already waiting.
Su Lingxiu still had a good impression of Xiang Wei. When they were sightseeing around the capital, they had traveled together. Xiang Wei gave her the feeling of a big sister.
At the entrance of Chang Qing Pavilion's consultation place, Meng Shushu had taken over and continued to receive patients in place of Shi'er.
"Today is the last day, and Chang Qing Pavilion will leave tomorrow."
Meng Shushu spoke up.
"Fast! Fast! This is the last day, and my old wound is not healed yet."
"The person in front, hurry up."
"Hey, this brother, I see you are withered, even if you go to Chang Qing Pavilion, there's probably no hope for you, right? Don't occupy a spot then?"
"Yes, you going will just waste the consultation time? The time spent on diagnosing you is enough to treat several people."
In the queuing crowd, someone looked at a man in line and muttered.
A man in the crowd, decrepit and almost incurable, was quietly standing in line.
Mu Qianliu was indifferent to the surrounding noise, he looked at the front, there were still a dozen people, and then it would be his turn. He did not come for medical treatment, but to see Xiang Wei.
Originally, he planned to go to the Inner Domain, but the Gate of Lingyu refused to open, unless there was an order from the Transcendent Spirit Sect, so he had to find Xiang Wei.
For Mu Qianliu, he didn't want to meet his lover in this manner, but he had no choice but to brace himself for it.
The method he used to refine the Heavenly Earth Lingji was obtained from Xiang Wei.
"Did she see the letter?"
Mu Qianliu wondered, if Xiang Wei had read his letter, she shouldn't have been so calm and still have the mood to visit the Chang Qing Pavilion.
"I hope no one else knows me except her."
Mu Qianliu thought silently.
He dared not mention the Ice State matter to Xiang Wei, fearing that Xiang Wei would want to take revenge for him and get caught in the Ice State.
That weird woman was too terrifying.
Even if he were to die, he wouldn't dare die in Lingyu but would rather die in the Inner Domain and take one last look at that gentle woman without bothering her to avoid bringing disaster.
Finally, it was Mu Qianliu's turn.
He looked up, ready to let someone inform Xiang Wei that an old friend was visiting, but to his shock, he found that the person treating him was — Meng Shushu!
He rubbed his eyes, fearing that his own illusion or simply a resemblance, only to find out that it really was Meng Shushu.
"Meng Shushu?"
Mu Qianliu was excited but also incredulous.
He was not aware of the opening of the Gate of Lingyu, so he was so shocked when he saw Meng Shushu in Lingyu. And if Meng Shushu was in Lingyu, wouldn't that mean that the gentle woman was also there?
Meng Shushu was in the process of a consultation, suddenly heard someone calling him. Also, the voice seemed a bit familiar, so he raised his head in surprise.
Standing before him was a man who was withered, with hollowed-out cheeks, dull hair, sunken eye sockets, like a man who had been sucked dry and was nearly like a dried corpse.
Such injuries had harmed the source, or even the source already dried up.
It was even more serious than the injury Moon Changming had before. The weirdest thing was that for some unknown reason, Meng Shushu always felt that this man was like someone who had indulged excessively in carnal pleasures and had become completely hollowed out.
"Who are you?"
He was a little puzzled. Who was this man?
He didn't recognize him.
And this man seemed very excited, which made him wonder even more. After a close look, he saw the faintly familiar outline.
"It's me, Shushu, is Wan'er here? How did you guys get to Lingyu?"
Mu Qianliu's voice trembled as he asked.
Meng Shushu's face suddenly turned pale, his eyes widened, and he had an incredulous look on his face.
He couldn't reconcile this man with the handsome, elegant man from before.
The gap was too vast.
However, the man standing in front of him was indeed the Mu Qianliu of the past!
In an instant, Meng Shushu exploded in fury. He grabbed Mu Qianliu and dragged him outside Chang Qing Pavilion, using the formation from the Pavilion to conceal them both.
"Mu Qianliu, you have the nerve to come here?"
Mu Qianliu opened his mouth, but before he could defend himself, Meng Shushu furiously interjected: "I, Meng Shushu, treated you with such respect, Sister Su admired you, loved you. You said you had an urgent matter and left without returning.
"Turns out, everything you said was lies, you deceived Sister Su's feelings."
"In the Ling Domain, you have so many lovers everywhere, you are renowned as a womanizer of the Mu family, aren't you?
"What happened to you now? You just destroyed yourself. Serves you right!"
The more Meng Shushu thought about it, the angrier he got, and he began to berate Mu Qianliu.
Mu Qianliu remained silent. When Meng Shushu had finished cursing, he painfully admitted, "Yes, I hid the fact that I had many lovers, but there's one thing I didn't lie about.
"Wan'er was indeed the one I liked best!"
"You have the audacity to say that? Mu Qianliu, you're talking nonsense!"
Meng Shushu was livid.
He railed against Mu Qianliu again, unleashing the anger that had been building inside him.
"How is Wan'er?"
Mu Qianliu asked after Meng Shushu had finished venting.
Meng Shushu fell silent, and after a long while, he replied, "Sister Su has already passed away!"
Mu Qianliu swayed, grabbing Meng Shushu's arms and asked, "How did this happen? How could Wan'er have died?"
Meng Shushu gritted his teeth, "After giving birth to Lingxiu, Sister Su's body was severely depleted and she became more and more frail, and eventually passed away from illness!"
"What about the spiritual medicine I gave? The spiritual medicine?"
Mu Qianliu asked in anger.
"It was all used up, otherwise, Lingxiu wouldn't have been born."
Mu Qianliu fell silent, his sunken eyes empty of tears.
"What about the old man?"
"He's dead! Murdered!"
"What happened?"
Mu Qianliu was stunned.
"It was done by people from Yinlou Pavilion, Lingxiu has taken her revenge."
Meng Shushu briefly explained the incident.
Mu Qianliu's eyes suddenly flared with anger, and he roared through gritted teeth, "Tang Jinyan!"
"What did you say?"
Meng Shushu was taken aback.
"Where is Lingxiu?"
Mu Qianliu suppressed his anger and asked with a shaking voice.
"You don't need to worry, Lingxiu has her loving master and senior brothers. She's the renowned Fairy healer in the Ling Domain and lives a good life. However, your appearance makes me conflicted."
Meng Shushu's expressions were mixed.
Should I tell Lingxiu that this is her biological father?
Would Lingxiu's life still be as carefree?
"As long as she's living well... living well... A damned man like me will not disturb her."
Mu Qianliu nodded in agreement.
Then, with trembling hands, he took out a pale blue plaque from his chest and handed it to Meng Shushu, saying, "This is the most precious thing in my life. I had to leave the Inner Domain in a hurry because of it.
"Find an excuse to give it to Lingxiu."
"Remember, this holds some unknown secrets. Don't attempt to explore them on your own. When the time is right, it will give you a hint.
"Also, remember, do not go to Ice State. Never go to Ice State. It's a place of extreme danger.
"Ice State now is not what it used to be, remember!"
Mu Qianliu spoke solemnly.
Meng Shushu initially didn't want to take the blue plaque, but seeing Mu Qianliu in this state and his current pain, he ended up accepting it.
After Mu Qianliu finished, he prepared to leave. However, he turned back and said seriously: "Shushu, remember not to mention me to anyone. Pretend that this never happened, that you've never seen me.
"Remember, no matter what, never mention me and don't let anyone know that you've seen me and that you know me!"
Meng Shushu was bewildered. With Mu Qianliu being so stern, what could possibly have happened to him, causing him such fear?

chapters.title: Chapter 628 - 336: Heavenly Grotto Order, Azure Sea Blood Blade Bandit_1
chapters.content:
"I had hoped to see Wan'er from a distance before I die. Now that I can't see her anymore, I have no wishes left."
Mu Qianliu's expression became calm.
"Never tell Lingxiu about my existence. Pretend I never existed!"
After saying that, Mu Qianliu turned around to leave.
Meng Shushu's expression was complex, he sighed to himself and said: "Wait a moment."
Mu Qianliu turned back to look at him, puzzled.
"Although I don't know why you ended up like this... Since we've met, take these pills. Recover as much as you can."
Meng Shushu thrust several bottles of pills into Mu Qianliu's hands.
"They might not get you back on top, but they'll definitely help you recover seventy to eighty percent."
Mu Qianliu shook his head, "It's useless, I know my own condition."
"Huh, these are pills refined by Lingxiu. Even if your roots are damaged, even if your Spiritual Body collapses, you can still recover. Your condition is severe, but it's not beyond recovery.
"If Lingxiu personally treated you, your injuries would be nothing. You could return to your peak state in just a few days."
Meng Shushu said with a cold laugh.
"Really?"
Mu Qianliu looked at him with disbelief.
"Of course!"
Meng Shushu said coldly, "Do you want to find Lingxiu for treatment? She has never seen you, she wouldn't know that you're her father."
"No need!"
Mu Qianliu shook his head, packed up the pills, and said, "If I were to see her, it would harm her. It's best that we part ways, with no chance of meeting again."
Meng Shushu fell silent, Mu Qianliu's answer was unexpected. He thought that once Mu Qianliu learned he could fully recover and that Lingxiu could heal him, Mu Qianliu would want to reveal his identity and ask Lingxiu for help.
Mu Qianliu left.
He disappeared into the crowd, never to return.
Meng Shushu didn't know how to feel, he had to admit that his heart softened at the last moment, which is why he gave Mu Qianliu the pills.
He looked at the token in his hand. It was a blue token with some intricate patterns, but apart from that, there was nothing special about it.
"What is this?"
He shook his head, deciding to find an opportunity, an excuse to give it to Lingxiu.
Back at Chang Qing Pavilion, Lingxiu was still chatting with Princess Xiang Wei. Their trip to the Imperial City of Great Zhou was over.
"Ice State, we can't go to Ice State."
Meng Shushu remembered Mu Qianliu's warning and was puzzled. What happened in Ice State?
"Then let's not go."
Meng Shushu thought to himself, Ice State was sparsely populated, there was no need to go. If Lingxiu wanted to go, he would find a reason to dissuade her.
It wasn't that he was afraid of any danger in Ice State, but he was afraid that if they went to Ice State, they would uncover something about Mu Qianliu and his connection with Lingxiu may be revealed.
"Am I doing the right thing?"
Meng Shushu was conflicted.
In the end, Mu Qianliu is Lingxiu's real father, but he didn't want Lingxiu to bear the sadness and anger because of Mu Qianliu's existence.
If Mu Qianliu wasn't such a Don Juan, Meng Shushu would undoubtedly tell Lingxiu the truth.
"Let it be."
Meng Shushu sighed internally. He came to the pavilion on top of Chang Qing Pavilion with the blue token in hand.
"Senior!"
Meng Shushu said with respect.
He knew that the senior would know everything.
"Hmm!"
Li Xuan nodded. He had seen and heard all the things between Meng Shushu and Mu Qianliu.
"Senior, am I right or wrong to do this?"
Meng Shushu couldn't help but ask.
"Right and wrong lie within your heart. Just let it be."
Li Xuan shook his head.
If Lingxiu found out the truth about her father, she would likely be upset. Where would she find the carefree joy she has now to delve into medicine and martial arts?
Since Mu Qianliu chose to step back voluntarily, he obviously didn't want Lingxiu to disrupt her peaceful life because of his appearance.
"Senior, what is this?"
Meng Shushu nodded. If the senior said so, it must be right.
He put the blue token on the table and asked.
"I'll give it to Lingxiu."
Li Xuan glanced at the token, and just said flatly.
As for what it was, how would he know?
He avoided answering, as if telling Meng Shushu, knowing too much as a weakling isn't good.
"Thank you, Senior!"
Meng Shushu didn't ask anymore.
The token would be given to Lingxiu by the senior. That would make her take it more seriously than if he gave it to her.
Otherwise, if he gave it to Lingxiu, she might forget about it one day.
After all, it was the most precious thing to Mu Qianliu. Meng Shushu hoped that Lingxiu could take it seriously.
After Meng Shushu left, Li Xuan picked up the blue token and inspected it carefully. He wondered, what is this?
The material of the token is not simple.
Just judging from the material, it would not lose to a Divine Artifact from the Spirit Realm.
But it was not a Divine Artifact.
The patterns on the token didn't seem to have special meanings, they were just for decoration.
Li Xuan pondered for a moment and infused a strand of divine power into the token.
The blue token emitted a faint blue light, and three words appeared on it:
"Heavenly Grotto Token!"
As these three words appeared, Li Xuan also saw a few lines of small characters inside the token:
"Token out, Grotto appears; The bearer of the Heavenly Grotto Token may enter and command the Grotto!"
Li Xuan withdrew his divine power and fell into a deep thought.
"Heavenly Grotto? A secret realm of sorts? Is this the key to enter the Heavenly Grotto, or the token to control it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 629 - 336: Heavenly Grotto Order, Azure Sea Blood Blade Bandit_2
chapters.content:
He was puzzled.
What is the Heavenly Grotto?
His best guess was that it was some kind of secret realm.
Did such a place exist in the Ling Domain?
He had never heard of it, not even in the vast repository of the Great Zhou.
"It's probably something like a secret realm. When the Heavenly Grotto appears, the token will show something and then I'd be able to enter," Li Xuan pondered.
"I'll just give it to Su Lingxiu. Who knows when it will show up."
He shook his head, no longer dwelling on the Heavenly Grotto token.
Even if it was a secret realm, it didn't hold much attraction for him, seeing that he wasn't practicing the martial arts of this world, but his own creation.
"Back to my martial arts career," Li Xuan muttered to himself.
Li Xuan shook his head, getting back into his routine of martial arts, creating Divine Skills and interpreting the Book of Tai Cang simultaneously.
After seeing off Xiang Wei, he prepared to leave Chang Qing Pavilion.
Zi Yun reluctantly returned to the palace of King Qing.
"Where to next?"
"Let's move on to Heavenly Mausoleum State and find the Red Cat. I miss that fat cat; it's been so long!", Su Lingxiu casually suggested.
"Alright, to Heavenly Mausoleum State it is!"
Chang Qing Pavilion's garden was folded up into a Flying Boat soaring into the sky, disappearing in an instant.
The powerful onlookers marveled at the Chang Qing Pavilion—truly a Divine Artifact unheard of before.
On the city wall of Da Zhou, Mu Qianliu watched the flying boat's departure. He made out a young girl's figure in the distance and was content. Soon thereafter, an estrangement flashed across his face.
"Tang Jinyan!"
The moment Meng Shushu mentioned the Yinlou Pavilion assault, he knew there was something bigger at play, and the first person he thought of was his official wife, Tang Jinyan.
"You deserve to die!"
Mu Qianliu turned around and left, not bothering to meet any of his lovers anymore. It was his final visit to see Tang Jinyan, to send her to her death!
After taking the elixir given by Meng Shushu, although Mu Qianliu didn't fully recover, his seemingly withered form improved, regaining his once good looks.
Within the Shui Xing Palace, Tang Jinyan had shut herself away, refusing any visitors.
Upon returning from the Thousand Martial Hall, a sense of dread shadowed her everyday life, realizing that something must be wrong based on the warning she received from the head of the Thousand Martial Hall.
So, Tang Jinyan secluded herself in Shui Xing Palace, choosing to focus solely on her cultivation, even momentarily forgetting about her desire to take down Su Lingxiu.
What she didn't expect was the long-lost Mu Qianliu to visit Shui Xing Palace to see her. Tang Jinyan was so delighted that she rushed out to greet her husband.
A few days later.
When a patriarch of a revered family visited Shui Xing Palace, trying to establish rapport with the martial arts sect and gain proximity to the Thousand Martial Hall, he was horrified to find Shui Xing Palace destroyed.
He was shocked. This was, after all, a subsidiary of the Thousand Martial Hall.
Who could so audacious to destroy the Shui Xing Palace? Could it be the All Ages Alliance?
But if it was the All Ages Alliance, there seemed to be no need for such covert behavior.
The news spread quickly, making waves in Luo State. Mu Family was also shocked, and they sent an elder to investigate as Tang Jinyan was, nominally, still the official wife of Mu Qianliu.
After thorough investigation, they found nothing of use.
Given that Tang Jinyan was dead and there was no word from Mu Qianliu, the Mu Family's elders deliberated and placed Mu Feiming's mother as Mu Qianliu's official wife.
With this, Mu Feiming assumed his legitimate role as the young master of the family!
Upon hearing of the demise of Shui Xing Palace, the Thousand Martial Hall naturally sent a powerfully unparalleled elder to investigate the cause. They also issued a notice pledging to capture the culprits who dared to challenge them.
"Who else could silently destroy the Shui Xing Palace, unnoticed by others, save for an unparalleled force?" The Lord of The Thousand Martial Hall chuckled.
"Master, could the news of the Gate of Lingyu have been leaked?"
"Whether it is or isn't, we just need a scapegoat to establish a symbol of power. As for the matter of Shui Xing Palace, let's put a rest to it. As long as the Transcending Spirit Sects are not opening up the Gate of Lingyu, it means that the news has not been leaked," said the Lord of The Thousand Martial Hall coldly.
Once the news was leaked, the disappearance of the terrifying Gate of Lingyu would certainly attract the attention of the other transcending sects who would seek to verify the news.
Not long after, a renowned Loose Cultivator who kept himself secluded, bearing the pinnacle strength, was caught by the Thousand Martial Hall and beheaded publicly in front of Shui Xing Palace.
The fact that his flesh and blood was scattered inside the gate of Shui Xing Palace signified that they had avenged Shui Xing Palace!
The reasoning put forth was that the Loose Cultivator had covertly plotted to seize the resources of Shui Xing Palace, weakened the power of the strong functionaries of Shui Xing Palace using secret poison over several decades, and finally was able to wipe out Shui Xing Palace without causing a stir.
Every martial artist in Luo state was stunned. The Loose Cultivator was audacious indeed.
The remaining sects and prestigious families became fearful and started conducting massive internal investigations.
...
The Azure Sea was vast, with no one knowing where it ended.
Compared to the Eighteen States of the Ling Domain, martial artists were relatively scarce in the vast Azure Sea, with only a few scattered sects. Only on famous islands were there martial artist residences.
The area centered around Yuntian city in the Azure Sea, with sects, elite families, and martial artists distributed across it, was known as the Yuntian Sea Territory.
No doubt, Yuntian Sea Territory was the most prosperous sea territory in the Azure Sea, bustling with martial artists of the Human Clan and Sea Spirit Tribe alike.
Naturally, outside of Yuntian Sea Territory, there were some sects and elite families, with martial artists also frequenting the area.
A large ship, sailing in the Azure Sea was trading its cargo at Yuntian city to exchange the necessary materials.

chapters.title: Chapter 630 - 336: Heavenly Grotto Order, Azure Sea Blood Blade Bandit_3
chapters.content:
"I heard that these waters are tumultuous, everybody be careful."
A Martial Artist aboard the large ship said in a deep voice.
The Azure Sea is vast, even for a Refining God Heavenly Man, who prefer to travel by ship. After all, relying solely on one's own strength to fly is too tiring. Besides, if too much power is consumed, it can be dangerous if attacked.
"What's there to fear? We have over twenty Refining God Heavenly Men, are we still scared of those bandits?"
A Martial Artist said disdainfully.
The Azure Sea is infested with pirates, most of them lurking outside the Yuntian Sea, robbing passing Martial Artists.
These pirates are either vicious Martial Artists who escaped from the Eighteen States, or fallen Spirit Sect or family martial artists that have banded together.
There are even sea spirits that became pirates.
In the entire Azure Sea, outside of the Yuntian Sea, pirates could be encountered anywhere.
"Are we reassured just because we have twenty or so Refining God Heavenly Men? Have we forgotten the incident three months ago when Shiteng Island was plundered? How many Martial Artists managed to escape from the island?"
"Don't scare us, we won't be so unlucky as to run into the culprits who destroyed Shiteng Island."
"In any case, it's better to be cautious!"
The group of Martial Artists on the ship took the warning seriously, vigilantly keeping watch all around.
If anything seemed amiss, they would immediately flee!
"Oh no, pirates are attacking!"
Suddenly, someone on the ship cried out in shock.
Everyone looked up and saw figures appearing from all directions, rapidly closing in.
The attackers, each wearing a black mask and holding a bloody long knife radiating with a crimson aura.
"It's the Blood Knife Bandits who destroyed Shiteng Island!"
The Martial Artists on the ship cried out in alarm.
"Jump!"
A Refining God Heavenly Man attempted to escape from the ship with a flash.
"Where do you think you're going?"
Boom!
A bloody knife light came crashing down, forcing the fleeing Martial Artist back onto the ship.
"Everyone, stay put. We only rob, we don't kill. Anyone who resists, dies!"
The leader of the Blood Knife Bandits sneered.
On the ship, Martial Artists below the level of Refining God Heavenly Man turned as pale as a sheet, handing over their bags, throwing them onto the deck.
"Good!"
"Big Heavenly Men stand here, small Heavenly Men there, Refining God Heavenly Men kneel!"
The Blood Knife Bandit ordered the Martial Artists on the ship to line up, directing them with his knife, while the twenty-or-so Refining God Heavenly Men, though livid, could only kneel down grudgingly.
The Blood Knife Bandits were too strong, each at the peak of the Martial Artist realm, and they outnumbered them.
A fight was definitely out of the question, even escape seemed improbable.
"Excellent!"
"We Blood Knife Bandits, love cooperative folks."
"Hand over your bags, no hiding... This chick isn't bad, you don't need to hand over your bag, just give up your beauty. Either we rob wealth or beauty, we Blood Knife Bandits have principles. Since we are robbing beauty, we won't rob wealth!"
The female Martial Artist turned pale, and her lips trembled, "Big brother, please spare me. Just rob my wealth, okay?"
"You don't have a choice! Go lie over there obediently, or else we will rob both wealth and beauty!"
The Blood Knife Bandit slapped the woman's cheek with his long knife.
The woman's face turned ashen, she silently went over to lie down in the corner.
The Blood Knife Bandit nodded in satisfaction, striding over arrogantly, "If you cooperate well, I'll even reward you with Spirit Crystals!"
Such audacity!
The woman was practically fuming, feeling an immense humiliation.
From the rear of the large ship, a small azure boat was racing across the sea.

chapters.title: Chapter 631 - 337: One Person Robbing a Group of People_1
chapters.content:
The moment Xu Yan stepped into the Azure Sea, he felt an overwhelming sense of spiritual enlightenment. He gazed out at the boundless ocean and felt as though he himself were a tiny grain amidst the vast expanse.
Yuntian's Azure Sea City is located in the Yuntian sea region, far away from the offshore of Fog Province.
The Seafaring Vessel did not fly in the sky, instead, it cruised over the surface of the sea.
Since he had arrived at the Azure Sea, why on earth would he continue to fly in mid-air? Would that not be a wasted journey?
After a few days of traveling by sea, Xu Yan became intrigued and pulled out a fishing rod.
"When Master was on Canglan Island, he loved to fish by the Cang River. There must be a deeper meaning to that. Is it to meditate on the ways of nature?"
"Or is it a kind of mental cultivation?"
"I have a feeling that Master is implying through his actions that fishing is a way to achieve self-realization, purify one's mind, and cultivate one's spirit."
The more Xu Yan pondered, the more plausible it seemed.
Looking at the fishing rod in his hand, he had asked Fang Hao to forge it, keeping the day he would follow in his Master's footsteps and try fishing. He wondered if he would make any gains.
"What bait should I use?"
Xu Yan mumbled to himself as he attached a Dan pill to the hook.
The fishing line and hook were both forged by Fang Hao, both of a Spiritual Artifact grade. Once hooked, there would be no escape.
Without exaggeration, even a sea creature comparable to a Godly Refining Stage, if hooked, could not hope to break free!
The Sea Spirit Tribe undoubtedly dominates the Azure Sea, but besides them, there are also many sea creatures.
According to Cai Ling'er, some sea creatures in the Azure Sea reach a power equivalent to a Godly Refining martial artist when they mature, although they do not possess martial arts and rely only on brute strength.
Moreover, without developed intelligence, even their massive brute force is of little use. Even an average Godly Refining martial artist would have difficulty hunting such ferocious sea creatures alone.
Sea creatures may not possess intelligence, but they can instinctively evade danger and dive into the sea.
Once a human martial artist enters the sea, unless they possess great strength, they are no match for such powerful sea creatures.
Godly Refining Stage sea creatures are almost exclusively hunted by the Sea Spirit Tribe. They are also the main items traded by the Sea Spirit Tribe with powerful human warriors in Yuntian's Azure Sea City.
The Seafaring Vessel raced in the Azure Sea until it was far from the offshore of Fog Province, and only then did Xu Yan cast his hook to fish.
As soon as the hook was lowered, Xu Yan noticed that some fish approached, hungering for the bait. He immediately shook his divine power and flung the fish back into the sea.
"I'm here to catch big fish, not small ones."
Xu Yan muttered to himself.
The Seafaring Vessel continued on its course toward the Yuntian sea region.
After fishing for two days without encountering a sea creature comparable to the Godly Refining Stage, Xu Yan was surprised.
He suddenly thought, "My mindset is wrong. Since I'm fishing, why should I care about the size of the fish? Isn't this contrary to the purpose of fishing?"
Once he thought like this, Xu Yan stopped paying attention to what the bait on the hook was attracting.
In a short while, he caught a three-foot-long fish. After changing the bait, he continued to fish.
After catching a few fish of various sizes, this time Xu Yan threw his fishing hook far out into the ocean. He overlaid his bait with a divine power restriction, which strong sea creatures could not resist.
Xu Yan sat cross-legged on the Seafaring Vessel, continuing his cultivation and comprehension of Martial Arts. The Vessel navigated on a predetermined course, and the fishing rod was hung from the boat, providing a dropping line to fish.
A day later, while Xu Yan was in cultivation, he suddenly opened his eyes. The fishing rod was shaking, and a massive tugging force was transmitted through it.
There was a bite!
Xu Yan was overjoyed. In front of the Seafaring Vessel, the sea was churning. A huge brown sea creature was struggling violently, but it could not escape the hook.
"This sea creature's strength is comparable to the late stage of Godly Refining."
Xu Yan marvelled.
The struggling sea creature turned around and headed toward the Seafaring Vessel. Xu Yan smiled slightly, raised his hand, and pressed a force down, suppressing the oncoming creature.
It was not until the sea creature stopped struggling that he released the force.
After a few times of this, the sea creature realized the danger of the Seafaring Vessel and began to escape frantically, dragging the Vessel and racing across the Azure Sea.
"This direction happens to be toward the Yuntian sea region, let it pull us."
Xu Yan directly shut down the Seafaring Vessel, letting the sea creature pull it across the sea.
The sea creature had amazing stamina and extremely fast speed. Occasionally, it attempted to dive into the sea to escape, but it could not pull the Seafaring Vessel underwater. After a few attempts, the creature could only continue to flee forward.
Xu Yan sat on the Seafaring Vessel, continuing his cultivation and comprehension of his Martial Arts.
A day later, the sea creature was still fleeing wildly, and its speed was getting faster and faster, showing a force that threatened to crash into anything in its path.
On the ship, a blood-saber bandit excitedly arrived at a corner, looking at a well-behaved female martial artist. He was overjoyed. "Now you're behaving, it's just a bit of color you are losing, compared to those who lost all their property, you're much luckier!"
The female martial artist bit her lip, her eyes closed, not daring to make a sound. Her trembling figure revealed the fear of her heart.
"Babe, I'm coming!"
The blood-saber bandit writhed, shedding his clothes in an instant, ready to pounce on her. But at that moment, there was a loud noise, followed by a deafening roar!
The sudden noise scared him instantly, making him limp. His face turned pale as he turned to look in the direction of the noise, immediately becoming frightened. Hastily, he put on his clothes and took hold of his knife.
The shocked female martial artist also opened her eyes. She looked in surprise to see a giant sea creature leaping out from behind the ship, letting out an angry roar.

chapters.title: Chapter 632 - 337: One Person Robbing a Group of People_2
chapters.content:
And trailing behind the sea monster, a strange small light blue boat seemed to be towing.
"Quickly, cut down the sea creature!"
The leader of the Blood Dagger Bandits roared in rage.
This sea monster seemed to be charging toward the big ship.
The sudden turn of events allowed the Refining God Martial Artists on board the big ship, who had prepared themselves to be captured, to suddenly look elated. After a quick exchange of whispers, they instantly ascended into the air, jointly escaping in a certain direction.
Better to seize this opportunity and flee than to leave one's fate in the hands of the Blood Dagger Bandits!
The twenty-something Refining God Martial Artists combined their efforts to storm out. The Blood Dagger Bandits in that direction frowned in panic, hurrying to sidestep the assault.
"You're dead!"
The furious leader of the Blood Dagger Bandits flung his hand and roared, "Kill them!"
Whoosh!
A squad of Blood Dagger Bandits brandished their blades and moved forward, eager to slaughter the fleeing Refining God Martial Artists. Two of the bandits raised their blades and sliced towards the sea monster in mid-air with a bloody light.
This sea monster was no pushover. Its thick skin and durable frame were shockingly defensive, and it was unlikely to be killed with one strike.
Xu Yan, who was cultivating at the time, opened his eyes in surprise. The sea monster was actually attempting to ram the ship, wanting to use this as an opportunity to escape.
"It really knows how to use its environment to avoid danger."
Xu Yan mumbled under his breath.
Seeing two bloody blade lights slashing towards the sea monster, Xu Yan gave his fishing rod a flick, and the sea creature, which was initially leaping into the air about to crash onto the big ship, was suddenly yanked back by him.
The two blade lights instantly missed their target.
"Sorry, I've disturbed you all with the sea creature I'm fishing!"
Xu Yan apologized, opening his mouth to speak.
The marine escape boat flew upwards, he waved his hand, and a divine origin surged up, lifting the sea creature mid-air and flew up above the big ship.
"Robbery, leave the sea creature and that small boat!"
All of a sudden, a figure blocked his path, a long, blood-red blade in hand.
At the sound of this furious roar, all the Blood Dagger Bandits, including those who were preparing to chase and kill the Refining God Martial Artists, quickly returned and encircled Xu Yan.
The leader of the Blood Dagger Bandits' eyes shone as he stared fixedly at the marine escape boat, a treasure upon first glance!
Fast and capable of flying, if they got their hands on this treasure, then the Blood Dagger Bandits would become even more elusive.
Xu Yan was taken aback, a robbery?
"Are you sure you want to rob me?"
He glanced at the crowd of Blood Dagger Bandits that were closing in and asked.
"Youngster, we Blood Dagger Bandits always have our principles. Leave the sea creature and the boat and you can go. We won't take your life. Otherwise, there will be one more corpse on this Azure Sea!"
The leader of the Blood Dagger Bandits spoke with a grave voice.
Xu Yan chuckled. Pirates also have principles?
Cai Ling'er had once told him that the Azure Sea is home to a few pirates, though rarely encountered, there were only a few incidents of them ransacking and killing each year.
Of course, for Xu Yan, pirates were naturally no threat. Cai Ling'er just happened to mention them while introducing the Azure Sea.
Unexpectedly, he hadn't been in the Azure Sea long before he encountered pirates attempting a robbery.
"I am also a man of principle."
Xu Yan looked at the crowd of Blood Dagger Bandits, revealing a smile. "Hand over your bags of loot, and I'll spare your lives. Otherwise, I'll have your bones ground to dust and your souls extinguished!"
All of the Blood Dagger Bandits froze, their faces filled with disbelief.
What did this kid mean?
Robs them in return?
One man robbing a crowd?
Where did he get the courage?
"Good, good, good, in my life as a Blood Dagger, I've never met someone as arrogant as you. One against many, flipping the tables and robbing us?
"Such bravery, such arrogance. Although I admire youngsters like you very much, but…"
Smack!
Before he could finish speaking, he suddenly felt a slap on his cheek. The leader of the Blood Dagger Bandits flew out, his head felt dizzy, seeing stars.
"Enough talk, hand over your bags of loot if you don't want to get robbed!"
Xu Yan said with a cold smile.
Gulp!
The Blood Dagger Bandits stared in horror.
"Did you see him make a move just now?"
"No, I only saw the leader fly out."
"Me neither!"
The Blood Dagger Bandits started whispering, their hearts sinking.
"You little bastard, I want you dead!"
The leader of the Blood Dagger Bandits shook his head vigorously, roaring in anger and exploding with a murderous aura as the bloody blade light blossomed.
"Everyone, attack! Kill him!"
Although he was surprised, he remained calm. There was strength in numbers, and no matter how powerful the enemy was, could they ever stand against their combined forces?
Whoosh!
However, just as he finished speaking, a ray of sword light descended in the blink of an eye, vanishing him into oblivion.
The rest of the Blood Dagger Pirates, who were about to attack, became instantly cold. Their boss had been one-shotted?
Even if they attacked together, they would inevitably suffer heavy casualties.
They were indeed pirates but not desperadoes. Even if they won, who could guarantee that they would not fall during the struggle?
Moreover, with their boss dead, they were now like a snake without a head.
"Don't attack! Young hero, don't attack! We'll hand over our possession bags, our possession bags!"
The Blood Dagger Pirates were sweating bullets.
"That's more like it. I'm not fond of killing. Just hand over your livesaving money."
Xu Yan said with a smile on his face.
"Yes, yes!"
The Blood Dagger Pirates handed over their possession bags one after another, a look of pain etched on their faces.
As pirates, all their belongings were with them. Everything in their possession bags represented all their accumulated wealth.
Once they handed them over, they would be left with nothing!
Xu Yan waved his hand, collected all the possession bags, and pointed at a few of the Blood Dagger Pirates saying, "Hand over your hidden possession bags, or die!"
The named Blood Dagger Pirates looked pained but could only obediently hand over their secondary possession bags.
"Alright. You may all scram now!"
Xu Yan waved his hand dismissively.
"Yes, yes!"
The Blood Dagger Pirates nodded frantically, turning around to leave.
Xu Yan waved his hand, and the sea beast under his control plunged into the sea. He planned to continue having the sea beast pulling his boat and save some spirit crystals.
"Watch out for the Blood Dagger Pirates!"
A woman's voice came from the big boat.
"Die!"
Spotting an apparent opportunity, the Blood Dagger Pirates who were preparing to flee seized the moment of Xu Yan's relaxation, and viciously raised their blades.
They had quietly agreed to attack all at once. The blood-red blade light illuminated half the sky, gearing up for a deadly assault that would completely engulf Xu Yan.
The Blood Dagger Pirates' faces twisted with ferocity. They were accustomed to robbing others, how could they be robbed themselves?
The girl on the boat daringly raised the alarm. After killing this lad, they decided, they would show her the brutality of the Blood Dagger Pirates.
"Why rush to your death?"
Xu Yan sighed, lifted two fingers and slashed backward. A ray of sword light emerged, spanning the sky, shattering all attacks.
As the blade light dispersed, the sword light came slashing forward. In an instant, the sword light divided into dozens of strands, each one aimed at a Blood Dagger Pirate.
Whoosh!
Under the horrified eyes of the Blood Dagger Pirates, the sword light fell, reducing them to ashes.
The martial artists aboard the big boat were flabbergasted.
Especially the woman who gave the warning. She had immediately regretted her action and had mentally prepared to be tormented by the Blood Dagger Pirates until death.
However, not only had that man single-handedly robbed a group of people, but he had also exterminated the Blood Dagger Pirates with a stroke of his sword!
She knew that these Blood Dagger Pirates were at the peak of the Refining God stage.
Destroying a group of thieves with a wave of his hand, how formidable was his strength?
In the Azure Sea, there couldn't be too many individuals with such strength, could there?
The woman suddenly thought of someone, a legendary figure whose sword dao was reputed to be the best in the world.
After slaughtering the Blood Dagger Pirates with a wave of his hand, Xu Yan prepared to let the sea beast continue racing, pulling his boat towards the Yuntian Sea Region.
Although the Blood Dagger Pirates were relatively strong, martial artists at the peak of the Refining God stage were no longer a match for Xu Yan, who could easily exterminate them.
Even martial artists who had condensed the Heavenly Earth Lingji were not considered threats. The only opponents he could cross swords with were the likes of the Elder leading the Thousand Martial Hall.
The only person that could make him genuinely engage in battle was someone as powerful as Xin Mengrou.
He was not far from the complete realm of the divine element, and his current strength was incomparable to when he first entered the Divine Origin Realm.
Just as he was about to command the sea beast to sail away, a woman's voice suddenly called out.
"Benefactor, wait!"
Xu Yan turned to look. It was the woman who had warned him before.
"What's the matter?"
The woman was stunning and had an attractive figure marked by an aura of enchantment.
Her strength was at the early stage of Refining God Heavenly Man.
She looked somewhat excited. Seeing Xu Yan's young and handsome face, her heart pounded with excitement.
"Benefactor, are you the Sword King?"
The woman asked excitedly.

chapters.title: Chapter 633 - 338: The Azure Sea Sword King, The Fallen Arrogant Genius_1
chapters.content:
"Sword King?"
Xu Yan paused for a moment, then shook his head: "I am not the Sword King, I am the Sword God!"
The name of Sword King is beneath him.
Woman: ???
She was bewildered. How did a Sword God suddenly appear?
"Respected one, aren't you the Sword King? Only the Sword King has such a Sword Dao within the Azure Sea!"
The woman said, somewhat incredulously.
Upon hearing this, Xu Yan became interested.
Azure Sea has a Sword King?
"The Azure Sea has a Sword King? Where does he reside and how powerful is he?"
He declared himself as the Sword God, and the Azure Sea has a Sword King. He was indeed curious about this individual's Sword Dao skills. However, he assumed it would be similar to the Martial Arts of the Thousand Martial Hall.
The woman was certain now, this man was not the rumored Sword King. She was more shocked than ever. When did such a powerful Sword Dao martial artist show up in the Azure Sea?
"The Sword King resides in Yuntian City. He wields a single sword and has defeated all swordsman in the Azure Sea, sweeping across the Sword Dao of Yuntian City. No one among the Azure Sea swordsman doesn't yield."
"Everyone says that the Sword King's sword is the true Sword Dao."
"Rumors say that the Sword King is a very arrogant person. Although he claims that his own Sword Dao has just started, he has just stepped into the world of Sword Dao without understanding the true meaning."
"But in his eyes, all the swordsman in Yuntian City are treated as trash."
The more Xu Yan listened, the more familiar it seemed.
He couldn't help but ask, "What's the name of this Sword King you speak of?"
The woman felt somewhat embarrassed: "I only know him as Sword King, I don't know his real name."
At this point, one of the Refining God martial artists who had previously fled and was comparatively stronger, had been targeted and surrounded by the Blood-Blade bandits, so he hadn't fled immediately.
It was only after Xu Yan made his move and annihilated a group of Blood-Blade bandits that he was finally able to breathe a sigh of relief.
At the moment, he walked over and said, "The Sword King is named Xie Tianheng!"
Xu Yan nodded, no wonder the conduct seemed so familiar. It's actually Xie Tianheng!
"I didn't expect it. Xie Tianheng gained the name of Sword King."
Xu Yan sighed inwardly. This implies that Xie Tianheng's strength has grown rapidly over the past few years in the Inner Domain and he must have entered the ranks of the powerful.
"Have you heard of Xie Lingfeng?"
Xu Yan asked.
As Xie Tianheng had made a name as the Sword King, Xie Lingfeng, who was equally talented and wouldn't be outdone in Sword Dao by Xie Tianheng, should have also made some reputation for himself.
"You mean, the son of Sword King?"
"That martial artist asked thoughtfully."
Xu Yan nodded.
"The son of the Sword King was once a young prodigy in Yuntian city, but in recent years he has made no progress and has been overtaken by those he once defeated. His name as a prodigy has been dusted, and he has now fallen into obscurity."
The martial artist sighed regretfully.
"The fall of a prodigy! The son of the Sword King is now mocked as a failure!"
Xu Yan was shocked. Has Xie Lingfeng's situation grown so dire?
He must have already accomplished the perfect state of Divine Intent with his talent, and it would be no problem for him to fight the early stages of a refining god with his accomplished Divine Intent.
However, he had been unable to break through, while his former foes kept making breakthroughs, reaching the late stages of refining God or the peak of refining God. Naturally, Xie Lingfeng wouldn't be their match.
No wonder he fell into obscurity.
Who could have imagined that he'd be mocked as a failure!
"Brother Xie, just wait a little longer. I'll come to find you. You can rise again and suppress those who once defeated you."
Xu Yan muttered to himself.
The Xie father and son duo must have encountered certain incidents in Yuntian City in the Azure Sea to be renowned instead of keeping a low profile.
Xu Yan asked about news of the Xie father and son.
The martial artist didn't know much. All he knew was that a few years ago, Xie Tianheng first made his name by challenging a martial artist in the early stages of refining god.
At that time, Xie Tianheng was at the great Heavenly Man level.
Everyone thought that he was doomed to lose.
However, Xie Tianheng rose strongly, demonstrating an extraordinary Sword Dao, defeating his opponent across realms, and started to earn his reputation since then.
"It's rumored that the Sword King's wife comes from a remarkable background, otherwise, with the Sword King's arrogance back then, he would've been beaten to death long ago."
The martial artist remarked regretfully.
Xu Yan nodded. Xie Tianheng's wife was from the Ling Domain and understandably carried notable background. He was curious how Xie Tianheng, an Inner Domain martial artist, managed to marry a woman from the Ling Domain.
After asking about some of Xie Lingfeng's affairs and realizing that the martial artist didn't know much more, Xu Yan bid him farewell and left.
The sea beast pulled the escape vessel, rushing across the Azure Sea.
"Sword God? Could it be that another Sword Dao contest is on the horizon?"
The martial artist was very excited. Such a grand event couldn't be missed.
If the Sword King hears that someone has dared to call himself a Sword God, he might explode in anger, won't he?
...
Yuntian Azure Sea City, the Transcendent Spirit Sect of the Azure Sea controls the entirety of the Azure Sea, even the Sea Spirit Tribe, the ruler of Azure Sea, obeys City Lord Manor.
The Fu Family is the family of the City Lord of Yuntian. In this generation, the City Lord Fu Tianhai possesses tremendous power. It's said his strength has surpassed that of the previous city lords.
He is undoubtedly the strongest man in the Azure Sea.
While Yuntian City is ruled by the City Lord Manor, there are many other powers. The Sea Spirit Tribe holds important positions in the City Lord Manor, enjoying a lofty status.
There have been ongoing rumors since ancient times that Yuntian City and the Sea Spirit Tribe have a pact, jointly ruling the Azure Sea. In certain circumstances, the Sea Spirit Tribe must obey Yuntian City's orders.
Only the real high-level personnel of Yuntian City and the Sea Spirit Tribe know the specific content and terms of the pact.
Among the many powers in Yuntian City, Wanxing Martial Arts Academy is one of them. Ever since it was defeated and retreated from the Eighteen States to Yuntian City then established a martial arts academy, it has cultivated several well-known martial artists.

chapters.title: Chapter 634 - 338: The Azure Sea Sword King, The Fallen Arrogant Genius_2
chapters.content:
The principal of the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy was rumored to have a deep friendship with City Lord Fu, so the academy was also regarded as having backing from the Lord's mansion.
As it stands today, the influence of the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy in Yuntian City, and even the entire Azure Sea, has become very profound.
The students of the Academy include the talented individuals from various parts of the Azure Sea, as well as some sons of aristocratic families from Yuntian City, especially the offspring of declining noble families.
The Academy also has students from the Sea Spirit Tribe, who are increasingly fond of sending their younger generations to the Academy for cultivation.
A few years ago, an incident occurred in Yuntian City.
Firstly, the Princely Heir of King Qing of Great Zhou was sent to the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy for cultivation. Secondly, City Lord Fu Tianhai also incidentally gained a son-in-law and a grandson!
What's more absurd is the rumor that his son-in-law came from the Inner Domain, a surprising choice for the Fu Family of Yuntian City.
All the major forces in Yuntian City were astounded.
And those who had long admired the City Lord's daughter were utterly dumbfounded. Could it be that they were inferior to a man from the Inner Domain?
The goddess of their hearts had given herself to a man from the Inner Domain?
And she even had a son there?
When this news spread among the major forces in Yuntian City, many couldn't help but recall a past incident.
The City Lord's daughter had once traveled to the Eighteen States, reportedly because the news of the capricious actions of Mu Qianliu, the libertine of the Mu Family, had reached the Azure Sea. Feeling that Mu Qianliu was too unworthy, she went to punish him.
The City Lord's daughter pursued Mu Qianliu all the way to the Inner Domain and only returned to Yuntian City after many years.
As for the punishment of Mu Qianliu, no further news was heard.
And Mu Qianliu seemed to have disappeared. For a while, there was a rumor in Yuntian City that the libertine of the Mu Family might have been killed by the City Lord's daughter.
Then, after a visit to the Inner Domain, she'd had a son?
The admirers were struck by lightning, all wanting to see the man from the Inner Domain who had won the heart of the City Lord's daughter.
Rumor has it that upon learning that he suddenly had a son-in-law and a grandson, City Lord Fu Tianhai almost died of anger. But what's done was done; he could only bear with it, he couldn't kill them, could he?
Furthermore, the son-in-law seemed to have a good aptitude, having broken through to the Xiao Tianren realm not long after arriving in the Ling Domain.
In the beginning, to avoid trouble, the son-in-law kept a low profile, rarely venturing out of the City Lord's Mansion, despite the rumors, and appeared to be very obedient to the City Lord's orders.
However, after the daughter's husband broke through to the Da Tianren realm, he started to become arrogant.
The first thing he did was beat up a princeling who had always admired his wife.
Then, he challenged another princeling, a martial artist who had just entered the refining stage, calling him trash and showing utter contempt and arrogance, which angered him beyond measure.
In the end, the son-in-law, who was in the Da Tianren realm, defeated the martial artist in the early stage of the refining realm.
At this point, all the major forces couldn't help but take a second look.
Upon his breakthrough to the Refining God Heavenly Man realm, the son-in-law became even more arrogant, looking down on everyone as trash, and beat up all the people who had once admired his wife.
And the city lord's grandson gradually showed his prowess, defeating one princely heir after another.
However, the city lord's grandson now belonged to the fallen talent. As glorious as he was in the past, he was now in a sorry state, surpassed by his previous subordinates and ridiculed by them.
His strength no longer advanced at all; he became a representative of wastes.
The words, "A momentarily talented is not always talented and could also be a waste, just like the son of the Sword King," even started circulating in Yuntian City, being propagated by those bearing grudges.
The brilliance of the Sword King's son faded, but the Sword King himself became more and more arrogant, living up to his name.
He even once despised his father-in-law and ended up getting a good beating.
In the City Lord's Mansion, within a small courtyard.
A young man was sitting cross-legged on a pond in the courtyard with a sword horizontally on his knees. The swirling Sword Intent around him generated wave-like sounds, which emanated from the Sword Intent.
"What kind of martial arts have you let my Fang'er practice? Now he's stuck at his current level!"
At the courtyard entrance, a beautiful woman, hand on her hip, complained to Xie Tianheng.
She was the daughter of Fu Tianhai, Fu Yun.
Xie Tianheng grinned, "He chose it himself. Besides, being stuck at one level is due to the lack of subsequent cultivation techniques. That's a minor problem. I will go to the Eighteen States when I find some time and bring the cultivation techniques back."
"Is that Dahua Martial Arts you talked about really that strong? Why didn't you memorize more techniques then?" Fu Yun was still dissatisfied.
"If I memorize too much, it would have been harder to comprehend." Xie Tianheng replied helplessly.
"Don't worry. I'll go to the Eighteen States in a few days. Although Fang'er hasn't had a breakthrough yet, his sword intent is more rounded, and his understanding of the Sword Dao has deepened. Once he has a breakthrough, his strength will definitely improve."
Fu Yun sighed, saying, "I just realized I must have been tricked into venturing to the Inner Domain, I was too young back then!"
Xie Tianheng's lips twitched a bit as he said, "Madam, I didn't trick you. Everything I promised you, I have accomplished. Within the Azure Sea, regarding the Sword Dao, I am supreme!"
"Well, you're only showing off in the Azure Sea. I've heard that an individual hailed as the Sword God has emerged in the Eighteen States. Barely in his twenties, he has already suppressed the heaven's chosen ones in the Ling Domain.
"Furthermore, he had even blocked the entrance to the Thousand Martial Hall to issue a challenge, killing the Heaven's Chosen of the Thousand Martial Hall and taking the Divine Artifact right in front of the powerful ones of Thousand Martial Hall, who could do nothing to stop him."
Fu Yun rolled her eyes as she spoke.
Xie Tianheng was startled and asked, "Such a heaven's chosen has emerged in the Eighteen States? What's his name?"
He had a suspicion in his mind: "Could it be Xu Yan?"
Directly blocking the entrance to challenge the Transcendent Spirit Sect with such brazen behavior, and moreover, claiming to be the Sword God, Xu Yan was the first person who came to his mind.
"Xu Yan, Sword God Xu Yan, he's rather well-known within the Eighteen States."
Fu Yun declared.
Just as I thought!
Xie Tianheng lamented in his heart, Xu Yan was indeed as expected, worthy of being a disciple of the predecessors. I still have a long way to go.
"Set a minor goal, when I have the power to suppress my father-in-law, then I can really start to act unbridled!"
Xie Tianheng murmured to himself.
"Have there been any rumors about the Eighteen States? Like anyone exceptional with a blade, or any remarkable elixirs?"
Xie Tianheng asked.
Fu Yun gave him a puzzled look, and asked, "Don't you already know?"
"I have no idea, I've been too busy dealing with those bastards to bother learning about all these details."
Xie Tianheng shook his head.
"There is one called Blade Venerable Meng Chong who is also incredibly powerful, slightly inferior to Xu Yan. There's also Chang Qing Pavilion, where they say the Fairy Doctor can revive the dead and the efficacy of her elixirs is nothing short of miraculous.
"Allegedly, she can easily heal and restore those with shattered foundations, collapsed spiritual bodies, or chronic injuries.
"These rumors seem unbelievable. I'm starting to consider going to the Eighteen States to see for myself."
Fu Yun talked about the news from the Eighteen States with an expression of disbelief on her face.
Xie Tianheng nodded, all these were within his expectations. He'd already made quite a name for himself in Yuntian City by the Azure Sea, so how could Xu Yan and Meng Chong be any weaker?
If anything, they were probably even stronger.
He glanced at Xie Lingfeng who was still honing his Sword Intent, and couldn't help but feel a sense of helplessness. His son seemed to have halted his rapid advancement.
"In a few days, I'll take Feng to the Eighteen States for a trip."
Xie Tianheng thought for a moment and said.
"Is it for Feng's cultivation technique?"
Fu Yun asked.
Xie Tianheng nodded, saying, "Isn't the Battle of Heaven's Chosen beginning? If Feng goes to the Eighteen States, he will have a chance to participate. Otherwise, given his current strength, he would not be able to participate in the Battle of Heaven's Chosen."
Fu Yun sighed, "If you''re aiming for the Battle of Heaven's Chosen, I'm afraid it'll be too late. As you know, the strength of the Heaven's Chosen who can participate in the final battle must at least condense one strand of Heavenly Earth Lingji."
"That's not necessarily true!"
Xie Tianheng laughed.
"Where does your confidence come from? You are merely comparable to martial artists who have condensed a strand of Heavenly Earth Lingji. Feng is even further away. It's less than three years to the Battle of Heaven's Chosen. Will Feng, even with the follow-up cultivation techniques, manage to achieve the strength comparable to the mighty within two years?"
Fu Yun questioned with a frown.
"That's why we must go to the Eighteen States, for a chance."
Xie Tianheng said with a smile.
By going to the Eighteen States, with the help of elixirs for cultivation, and receiving guidance, two years would be enough!
At this moment, a steward hurried up to them.
"What's the matter? Is someone else challenging Feng? Tell them no!"
Fu Yun's face grew dark as soon as she saw the steward.
"Miss, there's someone named Xu Yan outside the city lord's mansion. He claims to be an old acquaintance of the young master."
The steward reported.

chapters.title: Chapter 635 - 339: Xu Yan who Never Follows the Rules_1
chapters.content:
"Haha, my time to rise, Xie Lingfeng, has arrived!"
Xie Lingfeng, who was in the midst of honing his Sword Intent, laughed heartily upon hearing the caretaker's words.
"Brother Xu has actually come to see me!"
He shot into the air and headed straight for the mansion of the City Lord.
Xie Tianheng paused, Xu Yan had come?
This meant he wouldn't have to go to the Eighteen States?
"Xu Yan? Could it be the Xu Yan from the Eighteen States?"
Fu Yun looked incredulous, then turned to Xie Tianheng, "Do you and your son know Xu Yan?"
Xie Tianheng nodded, "The Sword Dao that Lingfeng practices was taught by Xu Yan. My Sword Dao also stems from the same root; the Martial Arts that Lingfeng practices belongs to Xu Yan."
Standing outside the City Lord's mansion in Yuntian, Xu Yan couldn't help feeling impressed by Xie Tianheng's resourcefulness. He wondered how he managed to marry Xie Lingfeng's mother.
The young mistress of the Spirit Sect of Yuntian in the Azure Sea of the Ling Domain, who had agreed to marry him—a martial artist from the Inner Domain—it was utterly unbelievable.
When Xu Yan arrived in Yuntian City and asked about the whereabouts of the Sword King of the Azure Sea, he was told that the Sword King resided at the City Lord's mansion.
Despite their disdain for the Sword King—the man viewed as the foremost Sword Dao martial artist in the Azure Sea but who was supported by his wife—Xu Yan could see the envy in their eyes.
Arriving at the City Lord's mansion in Yuntian, Xu Yan couldn't help but admire the grandeur of the mansion that resembled a grand city—it was indeed worthy of the Transcendent Spirit Sect that ruled the Azure Sea.
After announcing his intentions, Xu Yan began his wait.
Shortly, a figure flew in—it was the long-lost Xie Lingfeng.
"Brother Xu!"
