Tears welled up in Xie Lingfeng's eyes, he could finally continue his cultivation, and he could once again hold his head high, and suppress those who had been defeated by his hands.
"Brother Xie, long time no see!"
Xu Yan was all smiles.
"Indeed, it has been years, and I've missed you dearly."
The words were filled with nostalgia from Xie Lingfeng.
"Brother Xu, this isn't the place for reminiscing. Let's go inside and catch up!"
"Sure!"
Xu Yan nodded.
As he was about to follow Xie Lingfeng into the City Lord's mansion, a mocking voice suddenly rang out, "Oh, look! Isn't that Xie Lingfeng, the son of the Sword King, and the once pride and joy of the world of Sword Dao? Dare to step outside today?"
The word "once" being stressed in the sentence.
Xie Lingfeng's face darkened, while Xu Yan didn't even bother to turn his head, he just casually swung a slap backward.
"I hate the sound of flies buzzing around my ear."
Smack!
The man who had made a mockery was sent flying, landing heavily on the ground, his face swelling up instantly.
"Brother Xie, let's go!"
Xu Yan casually spoke, treating the matter as if he was swatting a fly.
Xie Lingfeng was stunned for a moment, then a smile spread across his face. This was Xu Yan's way.
"Please!"
He led Xu Yan into the City Lord's mansion, but his face showed his embarrassment. "I apologize for the display, Brother Xu. That man has quite a background in Yuntian City. He was once defeated by me, but he is now stronger than I am, so he has gotten cocky."
"No worries, Brother Xie. You'll soon put him back in his place."
Xu Yan merely chuckled.
Xie Lingfeng, the grandson of the City Lord, was being mocked and ridiculed, showing just how low the once bright star had fallen.
"In Yuntian City, it is customary that the elders don't interfere in the younger generation's disputes, and the same applies to the City Lord's mansion. Especially when there's conflict among Yuntian's leading powers, so long as it doesn't escalate to life and death, the elders don't step in."
Xie Lingfeng explained with a bitter smile.
To avoid being beaten up by those he had once defeated, he had not left the City Lord's mansion for quite some time.
Being the son of the Sword King and the grandson of the City Lord came with its pressures. If he were to be defeated, it would only bring shame to the City Lord's mansion, and no one within the mansion would seek retribution on his behalf.
"Xie Lingfeng, as the grandson of the City Lord, you dared to allow someone to attack me openly. You're too arrogant. I challenge you to a face-off!"
"Hand him over! Attacking a genius openly in front of the City Lord's mansion, what crime should such a person be charged with? We plead with the City Lord's mansion to arrest this attacker!"
Outside the City Lord's mansion, the cries of anger rang out.
A big commotion was stirred up.
Xu Yan stopped in his tracks.
"Brother Xu, don't bother about him. My mother will handle this."
Xie Lingfeng said helplessly.
"I can handle small matters like this myself. No need to bother others!"
Xu Yan replied, as he turned around and walked back.
Xie Lingfeng's face twitched, he hurriedly followed. He looked around for his parents with a troubled expression. Why weren't they stepping in yet?
Knowing Xu Yan's temperament, he was certain that things would only escalate.
"Great Commander, someone is causing trouble at the gates of the City Lord's mansion, openly challenging Yuntian Azure Sea City. We ask the Great Commander to ensure justice is served!"
"Yes, we plead with the Great Commander to ensure justice is served!"
Quite a crowd had gathered outside the City Lord's mansion.
All of them were either previously defeated by Xie Lingfeng, or held a grudge against Xie Tianheng. They were all eager to take this opportunity to exert some pressure.
"You're looking for me?"
Xu Yan walked out of the City Lord's mansion.
Outside the City Lord's mansion, the crowd was bustling. Most of them were there just to watch the spectacle.
The genius who had been struck was currently holding his swollen cheek and pointed at Xu Yan, "It was him, who brazenly attacked right outside the City Lord's mansion. I implore the Great Commander to ensure justice is served!"
Smack!
Before he could finish, he was met with a fierce slap on the other cheek. His head nearly twisted to the side, and he stood there, dumbfounded.
The rest of the crowd was stunned as well.
Just who was this brutal man who dared to strike someone in front of the Great Commander!

chapters.title: Chapter 636 - 339: Xu Yan who Never Follows the Rules_2
chapters.content:
"You... you're too arrogant!"
The divine talent covers his face with both hands, feeling like his head was bloating.
"Anyone else not convinced? Step forward!"
Xu Yan coldly looked at the clamoring crowd.
There was a silence outside the City Lord's Mansion!
Too arrogant!
When had there ever been such an audacious person in Yuntian City, who dared to rant in front of the City Lord's Mansion?
"Great Commander, as the one responsible for maintaining order in the City Lord's Mansion, why don't you capture this impudent fellow? What is the dignity of our Yuntian City?"
The elder of the beaten divine prodigy now spoke up, emanating indignation.
The Great Commander of the City Lord's Mansion also wore a helpless expression. Why was this young man so audacious? Not only did he openly assault someone, but he also dared to spew such bold words.
Had he not seen him together with that lad Xie Lingfeng, he would have dealt with him right then and there.
However, given the current circumstances, he had no choice but to intervene. The matter of how to punish him would be left to the City Lord to decide.
After all, this issue involved his own grandson.
"Yuntian City's rules: In front of the City Lord's Mansion, no one is allowed to fight, to engage in martial arts, or to hurt people. You have violated Yuntian City's rules. Come with me,"
The Great Commander stepped forward, speaking with just righteousness.
Xu Yan glanced at him disdainfully, "Rules are meant to restrain the weak. They are useless for the strong. What kind of crappie rule is this? It doesn't apply to me!"
The scene grew quiet again.
The onlookers were dumbfounded. The Great Commander had stepped in, yet the other party still remained so arrogant?
Was he just relying on his relationship with Xie Lingfeng?
This was the Great Commander of the City Lord's Mansion, a powerful figure who maintained the order of Yuntian City in public. How could he be so provocative?
Xie Lingfeng also felt a little numb on his scalp. He couldn't help communicating through spirit: "Brother Xu, give me a heads up, how strong are you? Can you withstand it?"
Although he knew Xu Yan would not act so recklessly without confidence, he was still a little uneasy.
"No big deal. My strength is quite good, it should be no problem to hold your grandfather down and beat him up on the ground."
Xu Yan replied through spirit.
"That's good, that's good!"
Xie Lingfeng breathed a sigh of relief.
The Great Commander chuckled, "Young man, rules are rules. Because you are powerful, can you just disregard them?"
"Rules are made by the powerful to maintain order. Whether to abide by them depends on the mood of the powerful. Do you think your City Lord would also comply with these rules?"
Xu Yan replied calmly.
"Of course! Our City Lord has always been the one to lead by example in adhering to the rules!"
The Great Commander declared solemnly.
Even if the City Lord has the power to ignore the rules, he couldn't openly admit it.
Xu Yan scoffed, "That's your City Lord. He hasn't encountered any challenges. If he has, he can still keep this stupid rule. There's only one reason for that."
"Oh, what's the reason?"
Curious, the Great Commander raised an eyebrow.
"The reason is simple. Your City Lord is too weak and can only cowardly abide by the rules."
Xu Yan said indifferently.
The Great Commander felt a bit uncomfortable. This young man was too outrageous, disregarding even the City Lord. Did he not know that the current City Lord was the most powerful of all the recent generations of City Lords?
The onlookers were taken aback. Where did this young man come from?
Right in front of the City Lord's Mansion, he was so arrogant, disregarding even the City Lord?
"You are being contemptuous! Are the City Lord's dignity and Majesty something you dare to insult?"
The Great Commander shouted angrily, his aura flaring up. The might of the powerful who managed to condense the Heaven and Earth Laws' breath could not be doubted at this moment.
He had initially planned to delay time, waiting for the mother of Xie Lingfeng, the beloved daughter of the City Lord, Fu Yun, to bail them out. However, he did not see her shadow at all. Instead, this young man had started disrespecting even the City Lord.
At this moment, he had no choice but to take action.
"You are too weak. I advise you not to make a move."
Xu Yan shook his head.
"This commander is weak?"
The Great Commander's face turned red. He raised his hand and condensed a Heaven and Earth Law power, transforming it into a giant hand aiming at Xu Yan.
"Young man, state your name, let me see how you..."
Before the Great Commander could finish, Xu Yan raised his hand and pointed a finger, a burst of sword light emerged, completely obliterating the giant hand.
Following that, Xu Yan took a step forward and in an instant, he was standing in front of the Great Commander.
Not good!
The Great Commander's face changed drastically. How could this youth be so powerful?
He seemed to be only in his twenties!
He roared angrily, unleashing his fists with a momentum that seemed to roll over everything. Three mysterious auras circled around him, converging the power of the Heaven and Earth Laws into a formidable attack.
Yet Xu Yan was eerily calm, his palm shooting out directly. This palm seemed to cover all rivers and mountains, and in a blink, a river and mountains emerged, engulfing the Great Commander's attack. Then, the scenery morphed again, with the mountains and rivers covering the Great Commander himself.
Booming noise!
In this moment, the Great Commander was horrified to find that he was unable to gather the power of the Heaven and Earth Laws.
It was as if he was being obstructed!
Unless, he could break through this obstruction, he wouldn't be able to gather the power of the Heaven and Earth Laws!
What cultivation technique was this?
Before he could respond, a hand had already reached in, grabbing his collar and hoisting him up.
"I told you, you are too weak."
The Great Commander's face turned red, his body's strength completely confined, without any resistance left.
Xu Yan nodded satisfactorily, his strategy indeed was correct. He just needed to use the Mountain-and-River Sword Intent to form a blockade which could prevent Ling Domain martial artists from gathering the power of Heaven and Earth Laws, thus significantly weakening their powers.
Even if it only lasted for a moment, this moment was enough to decide victory or defeat, life or death.
Of course, this could only be achieved because Xu Yan's Mountain-and-River Sword Dao was already powerful and condensed, and because the Great Commander underestimated him without expecting that his Heavenly and Earthly Laws power could be blocked.
Everything happened in a blink of an eye, from the Great Commander attacking, to being captured by Xu Yan.
When the onlookers recovered, they were all in immense shock.
The Great Commander had actually been captured?
And he seemed powerless to resist!
Who was this young man, why was he so powerful?
Even the genius whose swollen cheek Xu Yan had slapped was stunned right now; he totally forgot about the pain. After all, even the Great Commander couldn't resist, who was he to resist Xu Yan?
That he could still keep his life was entirely Xu Yan's mercy.
"Who are you?"
The Great Commander's face turned dark.
"Sword God Xu Yan!"
Xu Yan replied with a smile.
He took the Great Commander and Xie Lingfeng together into City Lord's Manor, and then casually released the former.
"Brother Xie, let's go!"
Xu Yan said with a smile.
"Okay!"
Xie Lingfeng nodded.
In his heart, he couldn't help but marvel at Xu Yan, still as formidable as ever. Whether it was the Inner Domain or the Ling Domain, Xu Yan's power remained unmatched.
"Sword God Xu Yan?"
The Great Commander was dumbstruck, goosebumps appearing on his skin as he thought of a certain individual.
A formidable prodigy who once challenged outside the Thousand Martial Hall and had publicly snatched away from their Protecting Divine Artifact.
He had actually come to Yuntian city?
And he directly fought people in the City Lord's manor!
That was very much in line with Xu Yan's usual style. He dared to challenge at the gate of Thousand Martial Hall years ago, now after these years, his strength was terrifying. Beating people in the City Lord's manor was no surprise.
Killing people would be considered insignificant!
Outside the City Lord's Manor, the onlookers were taken aback.
"Sword God Xu Yan? Wouldn't the Sword King explode in anger if he heard this title?"
Someone whispered.
"What do you know? Sword God Xu Yan is the unique prodigy of the Eighteen States, who once dared to challenge at the gate of the Thousand Martial Hall, and snatched the Divine Artifact in front of the Thousand Martial Hall's strong men."
"No wonder there's such a madman, so it's Xu Yan. That makes sense."
"Actually, I had already guessed it. Looking at the entire Ling Domain, the only person who could be so mad is Xu Yan, I can't think of a second one."
"Xu Yan has actually come to Yuntian City and seems to have a deep relationship with Xie Lingfeng, the dormant genius. This is going to be exciting!"
"Do you think the city lord will step in and suppress Xu Yan for his provocation?"
"It won't happen. If the city lord tries to suppress Xu Yan and succeeds, he'll be accused of bullying the weak. If it fails, he'll lose face. Why take the risk?"
"You're bold, daring to question the City Lord's strength!"
...
News of Xu Yan, who once proclaimed himself the greatest in the Sword Dao, blockaded the gate of Thousand Martial Hall to challenge their experts and who took their Divine Artifact, not caring about any rules, had arrived in Yuntian City of Azure Sea, spread like wildfire!
Gradually, rumors began to circulate that Xu Yan came to suppress the Azure Sea geniuses, intending to let the world of Ling Domain know that he was the supreme genius!
As the news spread, the Azure Sea Geniuses were enraged!
However, Xu Yan's strength, which was shown when he took down the Great Commander, left many Azure Sea geniuses feeling deflated. They really couldn't beat him!
But there were nonetheless some unsatisfied geniuses who wanted to challenge Xu Yan.

chapters.title: Chapter 637 - 340: The Challenge of the Azure Sea's Genius, Xie Lingfeng's Breakthrough_1
chapters.content:
The arrival of Xu Yan caused a noticeable stir in Yuntian's Azure Sea City.
Atop a high tower in the City Lord's Mansion, Fu Tianhai stood in a corridor, flanked by Xie Tianheng and Fu Yun on either side.
Fu Yun had initially planned to provide some relief, but was held back by Fu Tianhai.
"Unmistakably, it's Xu Yan!"
Xie Tianheng sighed.
Then he shot a glance at his father-in-law and remarked, "See what happened because you didn't let her relieve the situation, it's the City Lord's Mansion that's losing face now, right?"
Fu Tianhai's face darkened as he placed a hand on Xie Tianheng's shoulder and chuckled, "Do you dare to question my decision? Who gave you such courage? Just because you hold the title of Sword King, don't think you are so remarkable.
"In my eyes, you are nothing."
Xie Tianheng bared his teeth. At the moment, he felt as if he was being crushed by a mountain, his whole body nearly falling apart. His father-in-law's strength was indeed formidable.
However, he stubbornly muttered, "If I were at your level, you would stand no chance against me!"
"Overpowering others with a higher realm is also a form of strength!" Fu Tianhai coldly scoffed.
"Heh, if I was your age, I would've been at a much higher realm than you. With all these resources for cultivation and such a long time to practice, only to have such little strength, I would absolutely feel ashamed." Xie Tianheng persisted in his defiance.
Fu Tianhai clenched his five fingers and fell silent for a moment before responding, "You're unfilial!"
Boom!
"Damn it! You're bullying the weak, aren't you ashamed!"
"A father-in-law beating his son-in-law, where's the shame in that?"
Fu Yun wore an expression of helplessness. When Xie Tianheng first arrived, he was very low-key, not showing off at all, always obeying his father-in-law, doing everything to please him.
She even began to doubt if Xie Tianheng was the same person she had known before?
Could he have changed?
However, once his strength improved, he reverted back to his arrogant self.
"Father, go easy on him!"
Upon hearing this, Fu Tianhai doubled down.
In the courtyard, after catching up with Xie Lingfeng, Xu Yan began to impart the Martial Arts of the Divine Origin Realm to him and took out the healing pills to assist Xie Lingfeng in his cultivation.
"Brother Xie, you've honed your Divine Intent State to perfection for a long time and accumulated some foundation, but it's still not enough. Accumulate more and when the time comes to breakthrough, transform yourself. Once you enter the Divine Origin Realm, your strength will increase even more," Xu Yan advised.
For the next half month, Xu Yan guided Xie Lingfeng in his training and schooling him in the Sword Dao.
It wasn't until Xie Lingfeng had accumulated enough foundation and began to retreat to break through the Divine Origin Realm, that Xu Yan finally met Xie Tianheng, whom he hadn't seen for a long time, and Xie Lingfeng's mother, Fu Yun, the heiress of the City Lord.
However, Xie Tianheng's face was swollen and bruised as if he had been beaten up.
This aroused his curiosity. Who could possibly beat up the Azure Sea Sword King?
"Do you have any healing pills? Give me one, that old man hit me too hard!" Xie Tianheng covered his face.
A few days had passed and a force remained coiling around his face, preventing his wounds from healing.
With such a face, he naturally couldn't go out, otherwise, wouldn't it tarnish the prestige of the Sword King?
Xu Yan then realized, so it was his father-in-law who beat him up.
He handed a potion of pills to Xie Tianheng.
After another round of reminiscing, Xie Tianheng introduced Fu Yun. He was extremely proud every time he mentioned her.
Back in the Inner Domain, he had married Fu Yun, a prestigious Spirit-body Prodigy. No one in the Inner Domain could compare to her, that's why he always thought the others were worthless.
"My Sword Dao seems a bit stagnant, I always feel like I'm just on the brink of breakthrough," Xie Tianheng sighed.
He had come to Xu Yan for advice on his understanding of Sword Dao.
Xu Yan naturally then guided Xie Tianheng in his Sword Dao.
Barely finished with guiding Xie Tianheng, a manager hurried over, saying, "Young Lady, Li Shao from the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy specifically challenges Young Master Xu!"
"Li Shao?"
Fu Yun was taken aback.
Xie Tianheng furrowed his brows, saying, "How did this guy come to challenge?"
Xu Yan raised an eyebrow, curiously asking, "Li Shao, how strong is he?"
"Li Shao is hailed as the leading genius of the Ten Thousand Stars Martial Academy, and even known as the number one prodigy of the Azure Sea. He is rumored to have condensed the Qi of three Heavenly Earth Laws," Fu Yun explained.
Xie Tianheng added, "It's rumored that Li Shao has a spiritual body."
Xu Yan became interested, he had always heard about Spirit-body Prodigies without actually having a chance to challenge one. So, Li Shao turned out to be a Spirit-body Prodigy?
No wonder he had managed to condense the Qi of three Heavenly Earth Laws.
Spiritual bodies are closer to the Heavenly Earth Lingji, making it easier to condense the Heavenly Earth Lingji and the Qi of the Heavenly Earth Laws.
Turning to the manager, he said, "Tell Li Shao, if he wants to challenge me he can, but first he has to defeat the Great Commander. Otherwise, he isn't qualified to challenge me!"
Although he was curious about the Spirit-body Prodigies, not everyone was qualified to challenge him.
If Li Shao defeats the Great Commander, then, he can challenge Xu Yan. But if he can't even defeat the Great Commander, then there's no point thinking about challenging him.
"Well..."
The manager looked at Fu Yun, after receiving her permission, then hurried off.
Not long after, the manager hurried back.
"Young Lady, Haibo'er from the Sea Spirit Tribe, specifically wants to challenge Young Master Xu!"
Fu Yun was once again surprised.
"Haibo'er is the strongest genius of the Sea Spirit Tribe. It's said that she has an extraordinary bloodline and is the granddaughter of the Sea Spirit Tribe's current tribal leader. She is also said to have condensed the Qi of three Heavenly Earth Laws, and shares the title of Azure Sea's Twin Prodigies with Li Shao," Fu Yun explained.
"The old rules. If she defeats the Great Commander, I'll accept the challenge!" Xu Yan waved his hand and said.
The manager hurried off again.
The Great Commander's face turned extremely dark as he looked at the man and woman challenging him. He was about to cough up blood in his frustration.

chapters.title: Chapter 638 - 340: The Challenge of the Azure Sea's Genius, Xie Lingfeng's Breakthrough_2
chapters.content:
The other party had come to challenge Xu Yan, but now they needed to defeat him to be accepted for the challenge.
This left him very upset.
He even regretted attacking in the first place.
Now everyone knew that he, the Great Commander, was no match for Xu Yan!
"Great Commander, please teach me!"
Li Shao held a spear in his hand and spoke in a deep voice.
The Great Commander glowered at Li Shao. "I concede. Now you can challenge Xu Yan."
But to his surprise, Li Shao shook his head. "I, Li Shao, will not engage in such sham. For the fight of the chosen ones, let's battle with honor. If I cannot defeat the Great Commander, it proves that I'm not qualified to challenge Xu Yan.
"Great Commander, have some respect for me!"
Staring at Li Shao with his short, thick hair and stubbly beard, the Great Commander almost felt like spitting blood. Could you not be so serious?!
Damn it!
He glared at Haibo'er. "I concede. Go and challenge Xu Yan."
"You're talking nonsense. I, Haibo'er, aspire to be the king of the Sea Spirit Tribe and won't play any games. You, Great Commander, might be shameless, but I, Haibo'er, have a reputation to uphold!"
Damn it!
The Great Commander's face darkened even more.
Haibo'er was the darling of the Sea Spirit Tribe. Even if she was disrespectful, there was nothing he could do about it. She was well-known throughout the Azure Sea for her well-established temper.
He took a deep breath and said, "In this case, you guys may strike."
Haibo'er held a bright blue trident in her hand. This was one of the Sea Spirit Tribe's divine artifacts, the Sea-Splitting Trident. Looking at the Great Commander, her pretty face filled with anger. "Great Commander, who are you looking down on? Are you qualified to have me and Li Shao join forces?"
Li Shao nodded in agreement.
The Great Commander was so furious he felt like his nose was going crooked. He raised his saber and said with a dark face, "Who will strike first?"
Li Shao glanced at Haibo'er, "I'll go first. Once I've defeated him, you can make your move. We will have a higher chance of winning."
"You're talking nonsense. I, Haibo'er, never take advantage of others."
However, a disagreement over who should make the first move led to a fight between Li Shao and Haibo'er.
The Great Commander was so furious he almost spat blood. Do these people still recognize him as the Great Commander?
It seemed that ever since Xu Yan came, the authority of his position as the Great Commander had been dwindling.
...
Xie Lingfeng had broken through to the Divine Origin Realm. Xu Yan didn't wait for the challenges from Li Shao and Haibo'er, nor did he pay attention to these two. He figured they probably hadn't defeated the Great Commander.
If that's the case, they were not qualified to challenge him.
When Xie Lingfeng broke through, he also underwent a complete transformation. The basis of his martial arts had truly and thoroughly converted into Dahua martial foundation, and he has also acquired a spirit bone.
Though Xie Lingfeng, at the beginning of the Divine Origin Realm, still paled in comparison to Xu Yan, he had no problem defeating the top warriors who were still refining their spirituality.
Even if the opponent was one who had already condensed some Heavenly Earth Lingji, he could still put up a fight.
His current strength was not far off from Xie Tianheng's.
But the intricacies of the Divine Origin Realm didn't just stop there, Xie Lingfeng's strength would get stronger and stronger. He could once again trample his past adversaries under his feet.
With the improvement of sword dao comprehension, once Xie Lingfeng breaks through the Complete realm of the Divine Origin Realm, his strength would not lose to City Lord Yuntian, maybe even stronger.
No matter what, Xie Lingfeng was also a chosen one, his strength cannot be compared with ordinary martial artists.
Xu Yan started to impart the Divine Skill Realm martial art technique to Xie Lingfeng. This required some detailed explanation to help Xie Lingfeng not only memorize the cultivation technique but also understand it.
After imparting the Divine Skill Realm martial arts technique, Xu Yan gave Xie Lingfeng the Physiognomy realm cultivation method, as for the Void-breaking Martial Way, he had not figured it out himself, thus he could not impart it.
Moreover, for Xie Lingfeng, the Physiognomy realm is quite remote, let along the Divine Skill Realm.
It should be enough for his cultivation for a long time.
There's no rush to pass on the Void-breaking cultivation method in the future.
After imparting the cultivation techniques to Xie Lingfeng, providing guidance on sword dao and leaving behind some elixirs, this trip to Yuntian Azure Sea City has come to an end.
Next, Xu Yan was going to explore Azure Sea and look for the divine objects of the Azure Sea.
Fu Yun gave Xu Yan a sea map of Azure Sea, which included the dangerous areas, the treasure lands, and the sea areas where divine objects might appear in the Azure Sea.
It was much more detailed than what Cai Ling'er had introduced.
Just as Xu Yan was about to leave to explore the Azure Sea and search for divine objects, Li Shao and Haibo'er came to challenge him.
Both of them had defeated the Great Commander separately.
That surprised Xu Yan and after enquiring further he found out that the fight between Li Shao and Haibo'er had started because of their disagreement over who would defeat the Great Commander first. As a result, they both got injured.
They could only rest for a few days before they defeated the Great Commander separately and came to challenge him.
"Let me see for myself, the capabilities of the chosen ones of Azure Sea."
Xu Yan smiled.
The battleground was chosen to be atop the sea outside the walls of Yuntian Azure Sea City. As soon as the news spread, Yuntian Azure Sea City was abuzz with excitement.
Countless martial artists gathered in the decisive sea area, awaiting the arrival of the epic battle between the prodigies.
On one side was the most formidable prodigy of the Azure Sea, while on the other side was the Sword God Xu Yan from the Eighteen States, both were renowned figures.
Xu Yan stood proudly on the surface of the sea, gazing towards two opponents.
Li Shao appeared to be a roguish youth, unkempt, with short, scruffy hair and a short beard, holding a spear in his hand.
Haibo'er was pretty-faced, slightly petite in build, but possessed an impressive bust. She held a trident in her hand.
"Both of you come at me together, I'm in a hurry!"
Xu Yan, sword in hand, suggested in a casual tone.
"Xu Yan, your arrogance is indeed impressive. But I, Li Shao, disdain for ganging up. Triumph is won fair and square, defeat is accepted the same way. I'm not one of the shameless members of those Spirit Sects in the Eighteen States."
Li Shao advanced, spear in hand, across the waves; his aura surged with each step forward.
Boom!
The waves surged, mirroring the shape of a giant spear.
Li Shao's body emitted an ethereal glow, merging with the power of the Heaven and Earth Laws.
"So that's a Spiritual Body."
Xu Yan sighed. A spiritual body has affinity with Spiritual Energy and Heavenly Earth Lingji. It resonates better with the power of Heaven and Earth Laws, making it easier to gather and merge with it.
Having refined three forms of Heaven and Earth Law's energy, this was why Li Shao was more powerful than the Great Commander.
Xu Yan swung his sword, transforming the Azure Sea into flowing rivers and mountains. The waves became countless swords, causing a surge of swords within an instant.
"Kill!"
Li Shao's expression focused. Swinging his long spear, he repelled the wave-formed swords and advanced, indestructible. It seemed as if one man and his spear were going to shatter the mountain and the river, and demolish the myriad of swords!
Boom!
Xu Yan lifted his hand, and the waves around him surged, morphing into giant swords. In an instant, the swords began to circle around, displaying the might of the sword array.
In a mere moment, Li Shao was trapped within the sword array. He had nowhere to escape.
"Aren't you going to join in?"
Xu Yan eyed Haibo'er.
"Hmph, I'll deal with you later!"
Haibo'er's face turned serious, as she pointed her trident, causing the sea to part. Immediately afterward, the strength of terrifying tidal waves erupted from the Azure Sea.
The Sea Spirit Tribe ruled the sea, and the Azure Sea was their home field.
Covered by the Azure Sea and masked by its mighty power, Haibo'er initiated her attack against Xu Yan.
Xu Yan chuckled softly, stepping on the sea. With a tremendous sound, a golden giant dragon emerged from the monstrous waves. In an instant, Haibo'er was forced out of the Azure Sea.
Moreover, she lost the aid of the Azure Sea's might.
It seemed as if this stretch of sea had found a new master!
All the spectators were astonished. What kind of ability was this, summoning a real dragon?
A True Dragon's resemblance, possessing some of the abilities of a true dragon such as controlling the sea. How could the Sea Spirit Tribe compare with a true dragon?
The moment the golden giant dragon appeared, the outcome of this battle was already determined.
"The victor is clear."
Fu Tianhai said with a sigh.
Standing beside him was the chieftain of the Sea Spirit Tribe, his face a picture of helplessness. He let out a regretful sigh, "Xu Yan's cultivation technique is indeed divine. Is he mimicking the might of a True Dragon?"
"With the prodigy Xu Yan holding the title, no one can challenge him."
Fu Tianhai stated with a smile.
"Even those from the Transcendent Spirit Sect of the Eighteen States can't challenge him?"
The chieftain of the Sea Spirit Tribe questioned.
"Do you think Li Shao and Haibo'er would lose to them?"
Fu Tianhai responded with a smile.
What were the tasks of the Transcendent Spirit Sect? How could he, as the City Lord, not have knowledge about it?
Yuntian Azure Sea City too, was part of the Transcendent Spirit Sect's jurisdiction.
The chieftain of the Sea Spirit Tribe nodded and changed the topic, "Will Azure Sea participate in the Prodigy's Battle?"
"Let the young ones decide whether or not they want to participate. The Divine Bridge is about to open and the opportunities have come again. We should ascend the Divine Bridge and proceed to the far shore of the Divine Bridge."
Fu Tianhai stated with a laugh.
The chieftain of the Sea Spirit Tribe nodded and turned his gaze back to the battlefield.

chapters.title: Chapter 639 - 341: The Power of the Demon King, The Art of Transformation_1
chapters.content:
The outcome had been predetermined from the start.
Li Shao and Haibo'er were defeated together, and with the defeat of the two geniuses of the Azure Sea, it also meant that Xu Yan had suppressed all the geniuses of the Azure Sea of this generation.
From this day forward, the name of Sword God Xu Yan, will resonate across the Azure Sea!
After defeating Li Shao and Haibo'er, Xu Yan did not linger. The Sea Escape Ship emerged, and he stood on it, waving at Xie Lingfeng. The Sea Escape Ship turned into a faint blue light and disappeared from everyone's sight.
"First I'll go to the nearest Azure Sea treasure land, then head to the Azure Sea Abyss, and finally to the Jade Sea Dark Abyss. After that, I should return to the Eighteen States and participate in the genius battle."
Xu Yan stood on the Sea Escape Ship, looking at the sea chart in his hand, and made a decision on the next exploration route.
As for Xie Lingfeng, at this moment he was watching the generals who had once been defeated under his hands, a smile on his face. From today onwards, these defeated generals will once again be stepped under his feet.
While Xu Yan was searching for divine objects in the Azure Sea, Meng Chong was also traveling through the Ling Domain, gaining insights into his own martial arts.
In the Heavenly Mausoleum State, after the establishment of the Demon Clan, their control over the state was steadily increasing, and they even began to train an army.
The Demon Clan's Holy Temple, Red Cat's residence.
At this moment, Red Cat was hugging Zhu Xingzheng's shoulder, his sharp claws casually extending and swinging in front of Zhu Xingzheng's chest, making Zhu Xingzheng's scalp tingle!
"Not bad, Brother Zhu, you really know how to do business. Let's make a killing together and get rich!"
Red Cat said quite satisfied.
Zhu Xingzheng was almost in tears, he felt that if he continued to cooperate with this fat tiger, he may be beaten to death by people!
This is just too unscrupulous.
"Qingzhou is a prosperous place, next we should expand our market there. What do you think, Brother Zhu?"
Red Cat asked, swinging his exposed claws.
"I think it's a fantastic idea. I will definitely open up the Qingzhou market."
Zhu Xingzheng replied seriously.
"Very well, then please do your best, Brother Zhu."
Red Cat lifted his paw, patted Zhu Xingzheng on the shoulder, and showed a smile.
"My lord, this kind of business won't last long. Why don't we change our approach?"
Zhu Xingzheng thought for a while, squeezed out a smile and said.
"We don't need it to last long, this is a one-time deal, so you need to find a large batch of customers at once."
Red Cat said in a deep voice.
"Well, okay!"
Zhu Xingzheng relented.
Hopefully everything goes smoothly this time.
Red Cat handed him a storage bag and said, "There are 300 command tokens inside, including six above the sixth level. You know what to do, right?"
"Yes!"
Zhu Xingzheng took the storage bag with slightly trembling hands, but he had no choice.
I'm already on this pirate ship, it's not so easy to get off.
Zhu Xingzheng left the Heavenly Mausoleum State, entered Qingzhou, and began to sell command tokens and spirit beasts!
That's right!
The business that Zhu Xingzheng and Red Cat were engaged in was selling spirit beasts.
If it were a normal sale, Zhu Xingzheng would not be so intimidated, but this business was too irregular.
The command tokens were fake and couldn't command the spirit beasts at all.
After the spirit beasts were sold, Red Cat led a group of spirit beasts, charged into the buyer's house, accusing the buyer of trafficking the Demon Clan and demanding compensation for the loss.
The martial artists who bought the spirit beasts were all terrified. When a group of spirit beasts above the sixth level attacked, they were lucky to survive, let alone haggle over the price?
They bought a spirit beast cheaply, but ended up losing all their wealth, and even the spirit beast was gone, they were at a complete loss.
Zhu Xingzheng seriously doubted that he, as a spirit beast dealer, might be beaten to death!
Qingzhou was a wealthy state under the rule of the Transcendent Spirit Sect's Yu Ling Mansion. The martial artists here enjoyed commanding spirit beasts and catching them.
Zhu Xingzheng's spirit beasts were inexpensive and naturally welcomed, and the spirit beasts he sold were all sixth-tier spirit beasts, with even some beyond the sixth tier.
The Spirit Sect in Qingzhou couldn't sit still, wondering how did he manage to command spirit beasts beyond the sixth tier?
You should know that in the entire Qingzhou, only the Yu Ling Mansion had spirit beasts that were above the sixth tier.
Finally, an elder from the Yu Ling Mansion found Zhu Xingzheng, wanting to purchase all his spirit beasts, Zhu Xingzheng agreed without hesitation.
The transaction took place in a branch of the Yu Ling Mansion.
The spirit beasts were brought by Zhu Xingzheng. Some of them were cursing all the way, causing the people of the Yu Ling Mansion to realize that he was such a master at deceiving spirit beasts.
Even spirit beasts beyond the sixth tier were deceived?
The elder of the Yu Ling Mansion even wanted to purchase his trick of deceiving spirit beasts, but Zhu Xingzheng could only muddle through.
After the transaction was completed, Zhu Xingzheng hurriedly took his leave.
Because these spirit beasts were not commanded at all, there would soon be trouble.
As expected, a shocking event that shook Qingzhou took place!
A ferocious, multicolored tiger, claiming to be the Great Demon King, led a group of spirit beasts beyond the sixth level, stormed into a branch of the Yu Ling Mansion. He yelled at the elders of the Yu Ling Mansion for allegedly trafficking the Demon Clan.
He detained the elder of the Yu Ling Mansion and threatened to hold them accountable, demanding compensation for the losses suffered by the Demon Clan!
Demons!
At this moment, Qingzhou was shaken, and so was the Yu Ling Mansion.
When did the spirit beast clan become the Demon Clan?
The powerful people of the Yu Ling Mansion were furious and refused to submit, naturally they made a strong response.
However, what they didn't expect was that the Great Demon King was as powerful as the Yuling Mansion Master, and his demonic art was even more exquisite.
For example, within an instant, he created a confusing illusion, and the two elders of the Yu Ling Mansion were caught off guard. They were ambushed by the spirit beasts above the sixth level and were captured!

chapters.title: Chapter 640 - 341: The Power of the Demon King, The Art of Transformation_2
chapters.content:
The spiritual beasts were already powerful, and the Demon King was even more so. He seemed to be rather unscrupulous, using incomprehensible methods. The Yuling Mansion was caught off guard and suffered heavy losses.
In the end, Yuling Mansion commanded the spiritual beasts to suppress the Demon Clan. However, the Demon King, through unknown means, managed to free a Level 6 spiritual beast that was under control.
Under the sugar-coated words of the Demon King, the Level 6 spiritual beast's eyes were fanatical, betraying Yuling Mansion and bawling its desire to dedicate itself to the revival of the Demon Clan.
Yuling Mansion was truly frightened.
Caught off guard and without a proper response, they had no choice but to negotiate while holding their noses.
At the same time, they dispatched people to hunt down Zhu Xingzheng, the despicable beast trader.
Soon afterward, the collaboration between Zhu Xingzheng, the beast trader, and the beasts to scam people was exposed, and Zhu Xingzheng's bounty was seen all over Qingzhou.
Zhu Xingzheng's complexion turned green, hiding in Heavenly Mausoleum State, not daring to go anywhere; he even dared not return to the All Ages Alliance as he had conned several powerhouses in the Alliance.
He didn't want to con people from the Alliance, but they had been targeted by the Red Cat. Under the threat of the Red Cat's sharp claws, he had no choice but to grit his teeth and proceed.
Now, there was no turning back.
"It's Karma!"
Zhu Xingzheng was filled with grief and despair, he had scammed too many spiritual beasts and ended up getting scammed himself.
At the boundary between Heavenly Mausoleum State and Qingzhou, the Yuling Mansion and the Demon Clan were negotiating. Even the master of Yuling Mansion took it upon himself to conduct the negotiations.
On the Demon Clan's side, the Red Cat was as big as a small mountain, sitting in a giant chair, its paws laid on the armrests, looking down at the Yuling Mansion's powerhouses before it.
To its left was Yu Xiaolong, and on the right was Little Ha.
All three Demon Kings had come out.
Behind the three Demon Kings were Level 6 powerhouses of the Demon Clan.
In the Yuling Mansion camp, Cui Huayu looked at the Demon King, wearing a puzzled expression; why did it seem so familiar?
It appeared to be that giant cat?
"Yuling Mansion, you have treated my Demon Clan with utmost contempt, kidnapping our young demon warriors, an insult of the highest order. Today, you, Yuling Mansion, must give us an explanation."
The daunting demon aura of the Red Cat reverberated, with its formidable voice echoing outwards.
The Master of Yuling Mansion's mouth twitched slightly, always feeling that this fat tiger seemed quite fond of flaunting its power.
However, what exactly was this Demon Clan?
"The King of Spiritual Beasts..."
"I am the Great Demon King!"
"Great Demon King, there was some misunderstanding between us, the Yuling Mansion, and your spiritual beasts, the Demon Clan. This misunderstanding was all created by the beast trader..."
"Bullshit! What misunderstanding? That trader is definitely from your Yuling Mansion. Don't try to argue, you must give an explanation!"
The face of the Master of Yuling Mansion darkened.
The negotiation between the Demon Clan and Yuling Mansion was ongoing.
Meanwhile, behind the negotiations, a flying boat was floating above a mountain peak.
"This Red Cat, it's become corrupt!"
Li Xuan sighed.
This cultured tiger had actually learned to trick people.
"Red Cat looks quite mighty."
Yue'er remarked.
"I still prefer the chubby Little Red Cat."
Su Lingxiu mumbled.
As the negotiations continued, the Red Cat's demands grew stronger, initially asking Yuling Mansion to compensate ten thousand strands of divine spiritual medicine.
The Master of Yuling Mansion nearly exploded. Ten thousand strands of divine spiritual medicine, this fat tiger was really audacious!
After a series of bargaining, they reached an agreement. The Red Cat was very satisfied, it was a profitable deal.
As for the revenge from Yuling Mansion, it was of no concern.
Heavenly Mausoleum State was the best barrier; even if Yuling Mansion collaborated with the other Transcendent Spirit Sects, they couldn't annihilate the Demon Clan but would instead suffer heavy losses.
Yuling Mansion brought back the captured elders, while the Red Cat and the others retreated back to Heavenly Mausoleum State.
"Meow!"
After the Red Cat, along with Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha, had arranged the tasks of the Demon Clan, they ran to the flying boat.
As always, Red Cat turned into a chubby cat, rubbing its body against Li Xuan's feet, pleasing its master. It then went to please Su Lingxiu.
By the way, it handed over the spiritual medicine it obtained from Yuling Mansion to Su Lingxiu.
"Red Cat, you're really making something of yourself!"
Su Lingxiu rubbed the chubby head of the Red Cat, her smile blooming like a flower.
"Meow!"
Red Cat looked proud and pleased with itself.
Yu Xiaolong looked around but didn't see Xu Yan, feeling a bit disappointed.
Little Ha too failed to spot Fang Hao. They didn't linger on the flying boat for long and returned to the Demon Clan's sacred temple to handle demon affairs.
The flying boat was drifting all over Heavenly Mausoleum State. Taking this opportunity, Red Cat stayed aboard to please its master and Su Lingxiu, while also replenishing its consumed spiritual medicine.
"There's still a lot of room to improve your demon technique, like the Divine Skills of the Demon Clan, you should contemplate more on them," said Li Xuan as he lightly tapped Red Cat's head with the Jade Ruyi.
Red Cat nodded!
"You're already ahead of other spirit beasts. You can set the pace, and you've chosen to pursue the demon martial arts. Since you're determined to establish the Demon Clan, why not contemplate transformation?"
Li Xuan raised his hand, conveying the secret transformation technique he had formulated into Red Cat's consciousness through the way of demon technique.
If it were to be a Demon Clan but doesn't know how to transform, remaining in beast form would fall short of the impression of a Demon Clan.
Red Cat pondered this - transformation?
It looked back on the time when it stood upright like a human, hugging Zhu Xingzheng. The idea of transforming, boasting a mighty tiger head with rippled muscles, and waving Zhu Xingzheng in one big hand seemed quite domineering.
Moreover, the martial arts for demons would be different after transformation, capable of performing the same martial skills and cultivation techniques as martial artists.
"Meow!"
Red Cat nodded, it must transform!
"Master, I think Red Cat is cuter the way it is now. It won't be cute anymore after transformation," giggled Su Lingxiu.
"Meow, meow!" Red Cat hurriedly indicated that it would always be this cute and would only transform outside.
Li Xuan burst into helpless laughter. Red Cat was clever enough to understand how to get better treatment!
The flying boat was drifting in Heavenly Mausoleum State, and Red Cat had the Demon Clan collect plenty of spiritual medicine. Just before leaving Heavenly Mausoleum State, Su Lingxiu gave Red Cat a bundle of spiritual medicines.
With these spiritual medicines, the strength of the Demon Clan would further enhance.
And Red Cat began to cultivate the talented individuals of the Demon Clan, training its own disciples.
"Let's head to Yunshan State."
Su Lingxiu suggested.
Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao were at the Taimiao Sect in Yunshan State, a perfect opportunity for a reunion.
The flying boat travelled to Yunshan State, descending outside the nearest major city to the Taimiao Sect. Once the news reached the Taimiao Sect, Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao left the sect to visit the Chang Qing Pavilion.
Cui'er and Wushuang were naturally present too.
Old acquaintances reunited, and a round of catching up was inevitable. Li Xuan also enhanced the power of the Jade Talisman they had initially received by infusing it with a divine skill.
Time, like flowing water, waits for no one.
The competition amongst prodigies had entered its final stage and the Spirit Realm prodigy list was already claiming spots.
Xu Yan, Meng Chong, Fang Hao, and Su Lingxiu had secured the top four positions.
On the day the list was established, Su Lingxiu defeated the original fourth-placed prodigy, replacing their spot.
Aside from this prodigy list, core disciples of the Transcendent Spirit Sect did not appear.
Although they were not included, they also had the qualification to participate in the finals. This was the privilege of the Transcendent Spirit Sect, and no one could challenge it.
The location of the showdown for the prodigy competition was finalized, it was to be in Hongzhou.
Hongzhou, another maritime state, was linked to the Azure Sea, just like Mist State. It was the traditional venue for the decisive battle for the prodigy spots among the various Spirit Sects.
The top 100 from this prodigy competition will earn a spot, plus an opportunity.
The nature of this opportunity and the exact use of the spots were not disclosed by any of the several transcendent spirit sects.
In three months, the day of the showdown for the prodigy competition was set to begin.
Prodigies from all directions, the powerhouses of the Spirit Realm, all began to gather in Hongzhou.
The entire Spiritual Realm Martial Way World was drawn to the final showdown of the prodigy competition. This round had no prodigy from the Ice State, and this was overlooked by many.
The Transcendent Spirit Sect, due to the matters of the All Ages Alliance, naturally couldn't manage too much. Other Spirit Sects also did not pay much attention to this.
The upheaval that had occurred in the Ice State went unnoticed.
A crisis was silently on its way.

chapters.title: Chapter 641 - 342: Mysterious Cave, Enlightenment of Breaking the Void_1
chapters.content:
Being named after the frequent appearance of rainbows in the sky, Hongzhou welcomed a flying boat which landed on a mountain peak in the battle ground. Li Xuan looked out over the nearby Azure Sea. Shouldn't Xu Yan almost return?
Half a month before, Xu Yan had reached the complete realm of divine element.
And Su Lingxiu and Meng Chong had also broken the Divine Origin Realm, reaching the great achievement.
Fang Hao had refined the fourth symbol of heaven and earth, equivalent to the Divine Origin Realm.
His martial arts of the mysterious gate became increasingly pure, achieving great improvement in formations, artifact refining, prohibitions, and the strange techniques of heaven and earth.
"Greetings to the senior!"
Wu Tianan respectfully saluted.
Li Xuan nodded.
The final battle of this prodigy contest not only determined the victory and defeat of the All Ages Alliance and the Spirit Sect, but also shaped the final pattern of the Ling Domain.
As the Hierarch, naturally, Wu Tianan had to preside over the All Ages Alliance.
Although he had not broken through the next realm and was still subject to some limitations, his strength had greatly increased.
Vaguely, he had touched the threshold of the next realm.
"Master!"
Meng Chong was back.
Li Xuan nodded. Meng Chong hadn't comprehended the first level of the Indestructible Body of the Big Sun Stars yet, but appeared to have gained some insights. Perhaps, he was not far from comprehension.
Meng Chong found a spot to sit cross-legged, continuing to comprehend martial arts, while awaiting the arrival of the contest of the prodigies.
"Master!"
Fang Hao came over to greet the master, carrying a weapon box on his back.
"Hmm!"
Li Xuan nodded.
"Where is Big Senior Brother?"
Fang Hao asked, puzzled.
"Big Senior Brother isn't back yet."
Su Lingxiu said.
"I would like to invite Big Senior Brother and Second Senior Brother to assist me in the All Ages Alliance."
Fang Hao began.
To ensure victory in this battle, Fang Hao decided to ask his senior brothers to pitch in. As long as they took action, no matter how many prodigies the Transcendent Spirit Sect has, they could only be suppressed.
After this battle, the situation in the Ling Domain will be settled, and he will take over the position of Hierarch of the All Ages Alliance.
"No problem."
Meng Chong opened his eyes and said.
"Thank you, second senior brother!"
Su Lingxiu huffed twice and said, "Little brother, why didn't you ask sister to help? Do you think sister is weak?"
"How dare I little brother! Isn't that because sister doesn't like to fight?"
Fang Hao laughed hee hee.
"That's right, I only need to fight once to secure the fourth place."
Su Lingxiu thought for a moment and said.
"How could that be? Sister, you definitely deserve the third place."
Fang Hao chuckled.
"That's right, I am the sister."
Su Lingxiu immediately brightened up at this.
The prodigies of Ling Domain were gathering one after another.
The Transcendent Spirit Sect also arrived successively. However, their core prodigies had yet to reveal themselves.
Of course, many people were looking towards the Thousand Martial Hall, wondering whether they could regain their face in this battle.
After all, they were stopped by Xu Yan at their mountain gate and had their prodigies defeated and Divine Artifact stolen.
Furthermore, the Elder who was following Xu Yan had lost contact.
He probably fell.
It was unknown whether he was killed by Xu Yan or had suffered some unexpected mishap.
...
The Jade Sea Dark Abyss.
A light blue boat was heading into the black sea. A protection formation was keeping the seawater away as it descended.
Xu Yan had already explored the Jade Sea Abyss. He had to admit, the Jade Sea Abyss was dangerous. Inside the Abyss, he had lost two divine element avatars.
But he also gained some harvest and obtained the divine item of the Jade Sea.
Not just one.
After that, he came to the Jade Sea Dark Abyss and had been exploring there for almost half a year.
There was one time when he almost lost his way. Relying on the Orient Pearl, he finally returned to the sea surface.
Xu Yan looked at several divine pearls in his hand. These were found in the Dark Abyss. Besides the Jade Sea divine pearl, he also accidentally discovered a fragment of something.
It seemed to be the wreckage of some sort of weapon, but it was different from known weapons and was made of a rather special material.
But one thing was certain, even in its incomplete state, the item was of equal rank to the Divine Artifacts in the Ling Domain.
If the weapon was intact, it would probably be even stronger.
Moreover, he found some faintly visible ancient traces in the Dark Abyss, which seemed to be left over from a great battle.
This place might truly be a battlefield.
"I have enough divine items. I am a little short of accumulating enough foundation. After the prodigy battle, I should be able to break through the Divine Skill Realm."
Xu Yan was very excited.
A few days ago, he was preparing to leave the Dark Abyss and return to the Eighteen States to participate in the Prodigy Battle.
Unexpectedly, one of his divine element avatars discovered a strange phenomenon in some part of the Dark Abyss. When he went closer to investigate, he lost his senses. It seemed as if the distance had suddenly expanded.
Xu Yan was curious and went to the place where that avatar disappeared to explore. It wasn't easy to identify the location in the pitch-black Dark Abyss though, so it took him some time to find the place where the avatar had disappeared.
"It should be here."
Xu Yan began to be cautious, slowing down and approaching carefully.
After all, the sudden disappearance of the divine element avatar, as if it was sucked away, suggested that some danger may exist there.
"Huh!"
Suddenly, Xu Yan sensed his divine element avatar.
To his surprise, the avatar was in a bizarre cavern. The cavern was very strange, it seemed to appear under the sea, but it didn't look like an undersea cavern as there was no soil around it.
It felt like an independent space, like a hole opened up between heaven and earth.
Xu Yan continued to get closer, contacting the avatar with his consciousness. What he saw before him was a small cavern about three feet in all directions, into which his divine element avatar had been sucked.

chapters.title: Chapter 642 - 342: Mysterious Cave, Enlightenment of Breaking the Void_2
chapters.content:
Strangely, the cave seemed to ripple like waves, as though it was slowly expanding, and a unique force incessantly surged from the bottom of the cave.
"It's the power of the Heaven and Earth Laws, as well as an penetrating force that seems to stretch the Heaven and Earth Laws, creating a hole, not a regular underground cave," Xu Yan said as he knotted his brows.
He felt the forces of Heaven and Earth Laws surrounding the cave, yet it was as if they had been stretched out, making it appear as if the cave did not possess any Heaven and Earth Laws inside.
Yet, an unknown force was eroding inside the cave, expanding the Heaven and Earth Laws and forming a cave.
Xu Yan, being cautious, connected with his divine clone and gradually approached the location of the cave.
In the pitch-dark surroundings, it was almost impossible to distinguish the cave. The cave could only be identified by a unique force that seeped out from it.
"What kind of cave is this? The root of the Jade Sea Dark Abyss is caused by this cave?"
Xu Yan expressed his surprise.
At this moment, he was outside the cave, with his divine clone inside the cave. Seeing it from both perspectives made it easier for him to understand the cave's specifics.
"The Heaven and Earth Laws seem to be extended, as if forming a separate space, just like a hole penetrating through the space..."
Xu Yan suddenly paused.
An idea flashed in his mind, and he thought of the realm above the Physiognomy realm, the Void-Breaking Realm!
Although the cave had nothing to do with the Void-Breaking Realm, the existence of the cave was like a hole that had penetrated through the space and left a hole-like cave behind.
At that moment, Xu Yan had some enlightenment. He could refer to this unique cave and comprehend the laws of the Void-Breaking Martial Way.
Thinking of this, Xu Yan seated himself cross-legged on his magical vessel. He projected his consciousness, covering the entire cave. Instantly, he felt a sensation of his consciousness wanting to break through.
At the same time, his divine clone inside the cave was also meticulously perceiving the cave. He reached out and touched the cave wall, allowing the unknown force from the cave to drag his hand into it.
The clone was crumbling, yet it was continuously regathering. However, as a result, the clone was steadily weakning.
Xu Yan felt as though he had found the right direction to comprehend the Void-Breaking Martial Way.
In the pitch-black cave, Xu Yan's divine clone had one hand inside the cave wall, cautiously investigating the cave's peculiarities.
The divine clone's hand continuously collapsed and reformed, worn down by the unknown force that emerged from the cave. After each round of disintegration and regeneration, the clone's hand weakened.
In the end, Xu Yan decided to make his divine clone collapse altogether, transform into a cloud of divine energy, and canvass the entire cave, even clashing against the force that penetrated from the cave.
Outside the cave, Xu Yan gradually saw the Martial Dao methods of the Void-Breaking Realm become more apparent, as if he was on the verge of comprehending what breaking the void entailed, how to shatter the sky and earth's void, and how not to be restricted by the space of the Heaven and Earth.
"This force does not seem strong, but it can stretch the Heaven and Earth Laws and open a hole. This demonstrates its peculiarity. Where did this force come from?"
"The bottom of the cave is not earth, but an unknown force. It seems like the Heaven and Earth Laws, or a kind of spatial foundation."
"How was this cave formed, and how does it exist?"
"Moreover, it is continuously expanding slowly. Although the speed is very slow, it keeps evolving without stopping. If the cave continues to develop in this way, it will become huge."
"It appears as if there is another small space in the cave."
As Xu Yan understood more, he became increasingly puzzled about the appearance of this mysterious cave. Despite this, he gained a deeper understanding of the Martial Arts of the Void-Breaking realm.
However, he was still very perplexed. How did the cave come into existence?
Did some changes occur between the Heaven and Earth that led to the cave's formation?
Was it naturally formed?
No matter why the cave appeared, it did provide Xu Yan with some understanding and touched the threshold of the Martial Dao of the Void-Breaking realm.
The divine clone inside the cave disappeared completely. Xu Yan made another divine clone and sent it into the cave again to continue his studies and observing the changes in the cave.
Time flew, and almost half a month passed in the blink of an eye.
Xu Yan opened his eyes from his contemplation and looked at the pitch-black cave, which had grown a little bit. However, at this stage, it seemed to have stagnated, suppressed by the space of Heaven and Earth, unable to further expand.
"I'm just a little away from comprehending the Void-Breaking Realm."
Xu Yan heaved a regretful sigh.
Ultimately, he could not completely comprehend the methods of the Void-Breaking Realm. However, he was only a little bit away. With some more time to sort out his understanding, and a little more deliberation, he should be able to comprehend it fully.
"It's time to go back, the showdown of the outstanding talents should be about to start."
Xu Yan waved his hand and two navigation pearls flew out. One entered the cave while the other sank to the seafloor outside the cave several dozens of feet deep.
With the navigation pearl for positioning, there was no need to worry about locating the cave anymore.
Retrieving the Divine God Yuan Body inside the cave, Xu Yan looked around. Darkness everywhere. Not only was his vision blocked but even his divine consciousness was inhibited.
The Azure Sea Dark Abyss was inherently dangerous. Aside from losing one's way, there were something like leftover souls floating about.
However, these soul-like entities were somewhat unusual as they harbored a resentment-like aura, containing intense malice and would ruthlessly charge whenever they encountered living beings.
Xu Yan had previously witnessed a sea beast being torn apart and devoured by one such strange soul-like entity with extreme brutality and cruelty, as if harboring a deep-seated resentment against sea beasts.
He had once killed a similar soul-like entity, but Xu Yan had no idea how these entities were formed.
The Escape Sea Boat radiated light, illuminating the pitch-black seabed. Controlling the boat, Xu Yan began to leave the Azure Sea Dark Abyss.
Shortly after Xu Yan exited the cave, there was a sudden fluctuation at the bottom of the cave. A thing that looked like an eye faintly appeared at the bottom, appearing to look out from the cave.
The eye seemed a bit puzzled. Why was it pitch black without being able to see anything?
Blinking, it seemed to be trying hard to look outside the cave, while the Heaven and Earth Laws that were originally expanded suddenly shook, beginning to compress towards the cave.
The cave trembled. With the compression, it shrank a bit and the eye at the bottom of the cave vanished.
Controlling the Escape Sea Boat, Xu Yan had already reached the outer periphery of the Azure Sea Dark Abyss. He suddenly looked back, a surprised expression on his face. Did some disturbance just occur in the Abyss?
He vaguely sensed the shaking power of Heaven and Earth Laws, but it disappeared in just a moment.
"Forget it, let's head back to the Eighteen States."
Xu Yan shook his head, suppressing the thought of returning to have a look.
The Escape Sea Boat burst out of the sea surface, transformed into a faint blue light and disappeared between heaven and earth, leaving the Azure Sea Dark Abyss unchanged, as if nothing had occurred.
However, that mysterious cave, started to slowly expand once again.
Hongzhou.
Outstanding talents gather, as well as many strong people from Ling Domain!
Unlike before, in addition to the competition among the outstanding talents from different Spirit Sects, this time, due to the rise of the All Ages Alliance, loose cultivators from all over have also participated, which was spread throughout the entire Ling Domain.
An event universally known in the world of martial arts.
However, even for such grand events, martial artists outside of Hongzhou who wanted to come and watch needed at least the strength of a Refining God Heavenly Man.
Otherwise, just the risks involved in the long journey would be numerous.
On this day, only three days were left until the showdown among the outstanding talents.
Suddenly, a roar echoed through the sky. In the demon clouds, several huge divine beasts were carrying a golden chair, flying towards them.
"It's Red Cat!" cried out Su Lingxiu in surprise.
Li Xuan's mouth twitched at the sight. It seemed that his pet cat understood more and more how to make its presence overwhelming!
All martial artists raised their heads to look and exclaim, "It's the Demon Clan!"
"Such a grand appearance from the Demon Clan, are they here to provoke?"
The Beast Tribe was seldomly mentioned after their confrontation with Yu Ling Mansion. After that, the name of the Demon Clan was spread throughout the martial arts world.
Since then, in Ling Domain, there was no mention of the Beast Tribe anymore, only the Demon Clan!
"That's the Great Demon King!"
Someone recognized the figure seated on the golden chair, it was the Great Demon King of the Demon Clan.
According to the rumors, the Great Demon King was the founder of the Demon Clan. However, in addition to the Great Demon King, the Demon Clan also had an extremely powerful and mysterious Demon Ancestor.
Beneath the Demon Ancestor were the incredibly powerful entities like the Supreme of the Demon Clan and the Holy Mother.
However, no one had ever seen the Supreme or the Holy Mother of the Demon Clan.

chapters.title: Chapter 643 - 343: You All from Thousand Martial Hall, Strike Together_1
chapters.content:
The swirling demon cloud descended outside the Spirit Sect and All Ages Alliance camps, forming its own faction. As the cloud dispersed, the martial artists saw a vibrant tiger sitting on a giant golden chair.
The sight made the corners of the martial artists' mouths twitch. This massive tiger, the size of a small hill, had a large gold chain around its neck. Its legs were slightly spread on the ground, and its claws rested on the chair arms.
Its eyes were wide and intimidating, exuding an aura of unruly defiance.
"Great Demon King, what's your purpose for coming to this battlefield of prodigies?" the Yuling Mansion Master asked with a stern face.
"I've come to participate in the battle of prodigies. Since it's a contest for the prodigies of the Spirit Domain, should my Demon Clan be left out?" Red Cat replied with a powerful voice.
"Great Demon King, you've got some nerve! This is a competition for the young prodigies, and here you are, old enough to be their father but not ashamed to participate?" the Yuling Mansion Master retorted sarcastically.
"I've not even reached thirty since my birth. So by age, I too belong to the prodigies' ranks!" Red Cat proudly declared.
"What?"
Everyone was shocked. Was the Great Demon King not even thirty years old?
That's impossible!
"Master, is Red Cat really not thirty?" Su Lingxiu curiously asked.
Li Xuan twiched his mouth, replied, "It might actually be true!"
When he first captured Red Cat in the mountains, it was already a grown cat. But counting from its birth, it probably hadn't yet reached thirty years.
"Unexpectedly, Red Cat is also a prodigy." Su Lingxiu burst into laughter.
"Great Demon King, quit joking around!" The Lord Lei Yun stated sternly.
"Who's joking with you? Verify my age if you must. I came here specifically for the battle of prodigies!" Red Cat huffed.
With a cold glare, he looked towards the Spirit Sect and asked, "What, you look down on my Demon Clan?"
Behind Red Cat, the strong members of the Demon clan let out roars, ready to cause trouble if they were denied participation in this battle.
"Since the Demon Clan is part of the Spirit Domain, they obviously can't be left out. The All Ages Alliance has no objections," Fang Hao said with a smile.
The Yuling Mansion Master frowned. The Great Demon King was too strong, already exceeding the average prodigy. Was he going to let him claim the first place?
"As long as the Great Demon King truly complies with the rules, there's no harm in letting him participate," Emperor Da Zhou said with a smile.
In the end, Red Cat successfully joined the competition.
Once confirmed, Red Cat disappeared into the Demon Clan's camp and reappeared on the Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship, meowing to please his master, Li Xuan.
"You are quite an interesting cat," Li Xuan laughed. Jade Ruyi tapped on Red Cat's head.
Red Cat's power had greatly increased, and he had mastered many Demon magic techniques. If he fought with the Yuling Mansion Master again, the latter would probably not be a match for Red Cat.
"Greetings, seniors!"
Xie Tianheng and his son arrived from Yuntian Azure Sea City.
Li Xuan nodded, looking at Xie Tianheng's wife Fu Yun. He was somewhat surprised. How did Xie Tianheng manage to marry Fu Yun in the Inner Domain?
Fu Yun also looked at Li Xuan with curiosity. Is this the mysterious expert?
Xie Lingfeng was also participating in the battle of prodigies. There were a few prodigies from Yuntian Azure Sea city who had also come along, naturally including Li Shao and Haibo'er.
"Where is Brother Xu?" Xie Lingfeng asked curiously after catching up with Meng Chong and the others.
"Our senior brother hasn't returned yet, but he should be back soon," Meng Chong said with a smile.
The day of the battle of prodigies arrives.
Boom!
As a rainbow streaked across the sky, illuminating the Azure Sea with gorgeous light, several figures scattered in all directions.
"Today, the final battle of the prodigies will decide the top hundred, who will each receive one quota. The top ten will receive five quotas, and the top three will get ten quotas.
"Don't ask what these quotas are for. You will find out after the battle.
"In the battle of the prodigies, life and death are determined by the prodigies. Revenge is not permitted in this battle..." Emperor Da Zhou announced the rules of the battle of prodigies.
"Why hasn't senior brother returned yet?" Su Lingxiu asked, puzzled.
"He's back." Li Xuan said with a light smile.
Everyone looked up to see a pale blue light streaking across the sky. Soon, a figure landed on the Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship, holdinag a pale blue flying boat in his hand.
"Master, second apprentice brother, third apprentice sister... Brother Xie!"
Xu Yan greeted them with a smile.
When he returned to Wu State, he learned that the final battle was being held in Hongzhou. So he hurried back and fortunately arrived just as the final battle was about to begin.
After Emperor Da Zhou finished announcing the rules for the battle of prodigies, he added, "The battle of prodigies begins! You may challenge according to the rankings, or challenge anyone on the prodigy list directly."
As he finished speaking, a young man stepped forward from the Thousand Martial Hall camp.
He held a long sword, a divine artifact, in his hand.
As he stepped forward, the spirit light within his body emerged, blending in with the Heavenly Earth Lingji and the essence of Heaven and Earth Laws. Threads of law power kept converging.
A prodigy with a spiritual body!
This young man was obviously the real prodigy of Thousand Martial Hall.
"His strength isn't bad!" Xu Yan said with a smile.
As Thousand Martial Hall's prodigy stepped out, the rest of the prodigies all looked serious. They thought that after Xu Yan had taunted Thousand Martial Hall, they wouldn't have a decent prodigy left for the competition.
Unexpectedly, they had such a powerful prodigy. Judging by his strength, he definitely wasn't inferior to the Thousand Martial Lord!
"Thousand Martial Hall is quite lucky this time!" Emperor Da Zhou exclaimed.
Fu Tianhai, the City Lord of Yuntian Azure Sea City standing next to him, nodded enviously and said, "Indeed, they have five core prodigies. Our Yuntian City only has three."

chapters.title: Chapter 644 - 343: You All from Thousand Martial Hall, Strike Together_2
chapters.content:
"There's only one from the Sea Spirit Tribe?"
Emperor Da Zhou asked with surprise.
"Only Haibo'er's bloodline can be considered as equivalent to a Spirit Body."
Fu Tianhai affirmed with a nod.
"Who do you think he'll challenge?"
Emperor Da Zhou asked with a smile.
"Xu Yan!"
Fu Tianhai said, laughing.
Emperor Da Zhou nodded thoughtfully. The competition amongst the spirit-body prodigies had just begun, and a core talent from the Thousand Martial Hall had already emerged, clearly targeting Xu Yan.
This was especially evident given that this individual also practiced Sword Dao.
"How likely do you think it is that Xu Yan will win?"
Emperor Da Zhou inquired after some contemplation.
"You're asking the wrong question."
Fu Tianhai shook his head and laughed: "You should ask, how many moves Xu Yan will need to defeat his opponent!"
Emperor Da Zhou seemed taken aback, looking at Fu Tianhai incredulously. He asked in amazement, "Is Xu Yan really that powerful in your eyes?"
"Xu Yan surpasses all in the world of Sword Dao, there's no need to doubt that!"
Fu Tianhai let out a small laugh, dismissing the subject without further words.
Xu Yan stood alone, crushing the prodigies of the Azure Sea. Even the combined forces of Li Shao and Haibo'er were no match for him. Compared to his past, today's Xu Yan is undoubtedly stronger.
Apart from Emperor Da Zhou and Fu Tianhai, other experts also recognized that the talent from the Thousand Martial Hall was targeting Xu Yan.
"Where is Xu Yan?"
"Is he here yet?"
"Of course he is here, how could he miss such a grand competition? Especially as he is proclaimed the preeminent prodigy in the Ling Domain!"
Sure enough.
The young swordsman took the center stage and declared in a cold voice, "I, Niu Qiansheng of the Thousand Martial Hall, challenge Xu Yan to battle!"
"This is the prodigy that the Thousand Martial Hall has been hiding?"
Xu Yan remarked, his face filled with disappointment.
"He's too weak."
Despite the opponent being weak, he dared to directly challenge him. To not respond would certainly be seen as an act of disrespect.
With a single step, Xu Yan instantly appeared in the battleground.
"You're too weak, tell your Thousand Martial Hall to send someone else… or better yet, all of you come at once."
Xu Yan sighed, his voice brimming with disappointment.
The crowd: ...
Just as expected of Xu Yan, he's even more provocative after just a few years. He truly pays no heed to the Thousand Martial Hall.
The faces of the Thousand Martial Lord and his men turned gloomy. Xu Yan was too arrogant!
"Xu Yan, do not be arrogant, the last time I was in closed-door cultivation, hence I was unable to respond to your challenge. However, things would have been different if I were there!"
Niu Qiansheng pointed his sword and coldly declared, "You, Xu Yan, claim to be the best at the Sword Dao. That is because you have not met me! Today, I shall show you what the true Sword Dao of the Thousand Martial Hall is about!"
The Spiritual Sect Warriors present were all enlightened.
"I knew it! The Transcendent Spirit Sect's Thousand Martial Hall would not lack the courage to confront Xu Yan. They were merely in closed-door cultivation, unable to come out and fight."
"The martial arts of the Thousand Martial Hall are incredibly powerful, especially their Sword Dao. Xu Yan will finally have a worthy opponent. Let's see how arrogant he can still be."
For those Spiritual Sect Warriors, the Thousand Martial Hall was an inviolable Transcendent Spirit Sect. Its power was deeply ingrained, so seeing it defeated by a loose cultivator would be extremely uncomfortable.
Watching Niu Qiansheng's commanding performance, spirits were lifted. It seemed the Thousand Martial Hall was about to have its moment of glory.
However, Xu Yan had a look of contempt. He shook his head, "Your Thousand Martial Hall has no Sword Dao, just Swordsmanship. In front of me, your so-called Sword Dao is nothing more than fluff."
"If you don't believe me, just wait and see. Let's find out if the sword in your hand remains yours."
"Presumptuous!"
Niu Qiansheng raised his sword, the Sword Qi spread out and the power of the Heaven and Earth laws gathered. It was as if the sky and the earth became one, an awe-inspiring momentum.
The fierce sword light illuminated the surroundings.
"So strong!"
"This is the core prodigy of the Thousand Martial Hall spoken of in the rumours?"
"This is the talent of a spirit body?"
Among the watching warriors, those who had refined the Heavenly Earth Lingji, or even those who had refined the breath of the Heavenly Earth Law, were astonished by Niu Qiansheng's move.
Even the elders of the Thousand Martial Hall experienced the same feelings.
The power of a Spirit Body was something they truly understood at this moment.
Although both had refined the breath of the Heavenly Earth Law and gathered the power of the Heavenly Earth Law, the force gathered by a Spirit Body was stronger and more seamless.
It felt as if the power of the Heavenly Earth laws could be used more freely.
"The meaning of a spiritual sect's existence is for the spirit-body prodigies. It exists to discover spirit-body prodigies, which is why it is named a spiritual sect. Loose cultivators, the All Ages Alliance, and even 99% of spiritual sects don't understand this point."
Emperor Da Zhou sighed.
Fu Tianhai chuckled softly, within the secrets of the Spirit Sect, its core existence revolved around the Spirit-body Prodigies, all established to unearth and nurture the Spirit-body Prodigies.
"What do you think would happen if the Spirit-body Prodigy of the Thousand Martial Hall falls?"
Fu Tianhai suddenly voiced out his thoughts.
"Perhaps the Thousand Martial Hall would go insane".
Emperor Da Zhou pondered before responding.
"Will the Divine Bridge be activated prematurely?"
Fu Tianhai then asked after a moment's contemplation.
"There's not necessarily a need to activate the Divine Bridge. You know, the activation of the Divine Bridge has fixed timings. But there's also the possibility to temporarily open a phantom bridge, guiding Spirit-body Prodigies to depart, or summoning esteemed presences.
"If the Spirit-body Prodigy of Thousand Martial Hall is killed, the hall would likely open a phantom bridge."
Emperor Da Zhou said this while laughing.
"As long as there's a good show to watch."
Fu Tianhai declared gleefully.
On the battlefield, all eyes of the warriors converged on one spot. The moment Niu Qiansheng made his move, he exuded an awe-inspiring momentum.
The Sword's aura was unleashed in an instant, charging towards Xu Yan.
But Xu Yan remained indifferent, his sword wasn't even unsheathed, one hand was even resting behind him – His disregard for Niu Qiansheng's attack was colossal.
"You dare to draw your sword in front of me, the Sword God, when you haven't even step foot in the door of the Sword Dao?"
Xu Yan laughed and pointed forward with one hand.
Boom!
To everyone's astonishment, the Sword's aura, originally heading towards Xu Yan, had suddenly halted, then it turned around and charged towards Niu Qiansheng.
Even more terrifying, Niu Qiansheng's sword lost control.
It trembled violently, rocked unstable, then slipped out of his hand and landed in Xu Yan's grasp.
"How can this be possible!"
Niu Qiansheng had a horrified look on his face.
The Sword's aura surged and stopped in front of him.
Xu Yan casually looked at the sword in his hand, even though it was a Divine Artifact, it didn't catch his eye. With his current Martial Art state, especially his cultivation in Swordsmanship, Niu Qiansheng who hasn't stepped into the Sword Dao or comprehend the Sword Intent, does he even have the qualification to draw his sword against him?
In just a moment, Niu Qiansheng's sword turned into his own sword!
The exquisite nature of his mindset, how could those who haven't stepped into the Sword Dao ever possibly understand?
"He is truly worthy of the title Sword God. Even I would find it hard to draw my sword against Xu Yan!"
Xie Tianheng sighed admiringly.
Even though he had a clear Sword Intent, and although he wouldn't be as discomfited as Niu Qiansheng, drawing a sword against Xu Yan was still an uphill battle.
The Thousand Martial Lord and others abruptly stood up with shocked expressions.
Niu Qiansheng was, after all, ranked number one in the Thousand Martial Hall in terms of Sword Dao.
