He was a Spirit-body Prodigy! How could he not match Xu Yan?
"No, Xu Yan's Sword Dao is extraordinarily strange, all Sword Dao martial artists will have a hard time defeating him!"
The Thousand Martial Lord declared in a deep voice.
At this moment, despite his unwillingness, he had to admit - among all the Sword Dao practitioners, Xu Yan was the superior!
Xu Yan didn't follow up with another attack. Turning his gaze towards the Thousand Martial Hall, he tossed Niu Qiansheng's sword back.
Even though it was a Divine Artifact, it was still not to his taste.
"You, the Thousand Martial Hall, have always wanted to trample upon me, Xu Yan, to recover some of the face you lost before, today I, Xu Yan, grant you an opportunity.
"All of you from the Thousand Martial Hall, come on together. Not limited to just the prodigies."
With a casual tone, he threw out the most arrogant challenge.
Silence!
All the martial artists were dumbstruck as they watched. There were rumors about Xu Yan's arrogance, but hearing rumors and witnessing it first-hand are entirely different things
Challenging the entire Thousand martial hall alone?
Not limited to just the prodigies, meaning everyone from the Thousand Martial Hall can take action together.
Where does Xu Yan get such confidence from!
Whoosh!
All eyes were on the Thousand Martial Hall.
Everyone waited for the decision of the Thousand Martial Hall. Would they all attack Xu Yan together, or, would they send out a stronger prodigy?
Niu Qiansheng was obviously not enough, as he couldn't even make a move.
It seems the great momentum was nothing more than a bluff.
The faces of the Thousand Martial Lord and the rest were extremely grim, with murderous intent gleaming in their eyes.
All attack together?
Even though the Thousand Martial Hall has been deemed the most shameless Spirit Sect, it doesn't mean they actually have no sense of face.
Xu Yan could arrogantly challenge them, but they couldn't just swarm and attack.
If so, where would the face of the prestigious Transcendent Spirit Sect stand?

chapters.title: Chapter 645 - 344: The Melting Snow of Ice State, the Catastrophe of Ling Domain_1
chapters.content:
"Hu Bubai, take your shot now,"
The host of the Thousand Martial Hall took a deep breath, his face somber as he turned to address a disheveled-bearded young man standing by.
"Alright!"
Hu Bubai nodded.
"Niu Qiansheng, come back!"
The Lord of the Thousand Martial Hall called out in a deep voice.
Xu Yan wore a smile, he let Niu Qiansheng retreat without killing him, directly dispersing the layers of sword light.
Hu Bubai was about to join the fight, long spear in hand. The host of the Thousand Martial Hall hesitated a moment before instructing, "Hu Bubai, fight to determine victory, not for life or death!"
He was suddenly not so confident anymore.
If Hu Bubai gets killed, the consequences would be dire, and he doesn't know how to explain it
Each spiritual body prodigy is extremely precious.
Hu Bubai paused at this, dragging his long spear on the ground as he marched forward. "Win or lose, live or die, I'll give it my all," he declared.
As Hu Bubai stepped forward, the power of the Heavenly Earth Laws came together, forming a long spear that merged with Hu Bubai's spear dragged on the ground.
"This boy is very strong!"
Emperor Da Zhou remarked gravely.
"I didn't expect the Thousand Martial Hall to have such a talent. He isn't far from the next realm," Fu Tianhai sighed.
In the Taimiao Sect camp, Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao tensed up, keeping their eyes nervously trained on the battlefield, while also stealing glances at Xin Mengrou next to them.
"Ancestor Grandma, that's Hu Bubai, right? How strong is he?" Yun Miaomiao couldn't help but ask.
"He's alright, not too far from the next realm," Xin Mengrou replied.
"Ancestor Grandma, what is the next realm?" Du Yuying couldn't help but ask, curiosity piqued.
Xin Mengrou was silent for a moment, then declared, "It is the realm of refining the laws of Heaven and Earth into one's body; the realm of coagulation. This isn't just about gathering the power of the laws of Heaven and Earth, but refining them into one's body. The two are different worlds apart."
"When one manages to refine the laws of Heaven and Earth, it means they possess the power of the laws of Heaven and Earth."
"Above the Refining God Heavenly Man is the Coagulation Law Heaven Revered!"
Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao were shocked. Only now did they understand that the realm above Refining God Heavenly Man was Coagulation Law Heaven Revered!
Refining the laws of Heaven and Earth into the body means one possesses the power of the laws of Heaven and Earth.
"Ancestor Grandma, are you a Coagulation Law Heaven Revered?"
Du Yuying asked curiously.
"Not quite yet," Xin Mengrou replied, her gaze resting on the Chang Qing Pavilion as she murmured.
The pill of the law bestowed upon her by her senior had brought her within half a step of refining the rules of heaven and earth into her body.
This was practically unthinkable in the Spirit Realm.
She had surpassed the limits of the cultivation of the Spirit Realm.
In the entire Spirit Realm, only she and another person, Wu Tianan, had made it this far. And Wu Tianan reached this point with the guidance of that senior.
"Xu Yan, you are powerful. I, Hu Bubai, have never been defeated in my life. I don't believe you can beat me," Hu Bubai declared solemnly.
"Today, your name will change to Hu Once-defeated."
Xu Yan laughed. Hu Bubai was very strong, the strongest he had come across, excluding Xin Mengrou and Wu Tianan.
"It depends on your ability!"
Hu Bubai shook his spear and attacked instantly.
Xu Yan thrust his sword out, and in the blink of an eye Hu Bubai was covered in numerous wounds.
"You have lost!"
Xu Yan sheathed his sword, his gaze sweeping across the Thousand Martial Hall before turning to take in the crowd.
It was quiet!
No one expected Hu Bubai to lose so quickly, so thoroughly.
Even Hu Bubai himself looked unbelievable.
He thought that even if he was sure to lose, it would be after an intense fight.
Yet, as soon as he made a move, he saw sword light circling around him, and within a few flashes, he had lost!
"Big brother is so powerful!"
Su Lingxiu exclaimed.
The Red Cat sitting in the golden chair now looked at the strong demon warriors and said, "Did you see it? This is the power of our demon clan's supreme!"
The group of demon warriors all wore baffled expressions.
Our demon supreme... Is he really of the human clan?
"Long live the supreme!"
"Worthy of being our demon clan's supreme!"
It doesn't matter—anyone the demon king recognizes as a supreme is valid. The demon king is always right.
The demon warriors all agreed with shared pride, feeling unmatched glory.
Li Xuan wasn't surprised by this, as Xu Yan was unmatched in the entire ling domain, and neither Wu Tianan nor Xin Mengrou could compete with him.
Xu Yan was already in the complete realm of the divine origin, and had accumulated a profound foundation. He was only a little short of fully mastering his foundation and breaking into the Divine Skill Realm.
"I Xu Yan, sit at the top of the Prodigies of Spirit Realm. All of you prodigies can come at me together!" Xu Yan looked at the spirit prodigies and proudly declared.
Although he was arrogant, at this moment, no prodigy stood out, nor was there any uproar amongst them.
Because Xu Yan has earned the right!
Seeing no one challenge him, Xu Yan found things to be dull immediately. These Spirit Realm prodigies were all cowards.
"Xu Yan, you ranked first on the Prodigies List. You don't need to take further action. Anyone who is dissatisfied could issue a challenge," said Emperor Da Zhou.
There was no one who dared object!
Xu Yan left the battlefield, looking at the Thousand Martial Hall, feeling a sense of boredom. Though he now had the strength to suppress the Thousand Martial Hall, he felt there was no longer a need for that.
He had already reached the peak of the Spirit Realm.
The people of the Thousand Martial hall, including the lord himself, wore expressions of unwillingness yet helplessness. Even Hu Bubai had lost. The only relief was that Xu Yan did not kill him.
"It's strange that Xu Yan didn't kill him."

chapters.title: Chapter 646 - 344: The Melting Snow of Ice State, the Catastrophe of Ling Domain_2
chapters.content:
Fu Tianhai expresses some regrets.
Emperor Da Zhou sneers at him and says, "Xu Yan is already a strong man. His mindset has long changed. People like Hu Bubai are seen as juniors in his eyes. He is too lazy to kill them.
"Furthermore, Xu Yan doesn't have a grudge against the Thousand Martial Hall, does he? Even if there were disagreements in the past, he should have vented his anger by now. He's already at the pinnacle of the Spirit Realm.
"He's not like certain people who take pleasure in bullying juniors."
Fu Tianhai rolls his eyes and says, "I just want to watch the show. It will be interesting to see if the shameless guys of the Thousand Martial Hall will open that illusory bridge after suffering a big loss."
Emperor Da Zhou couldn't be bothered to argue with him.
"Senior Brother Xu, why didn't you kill those guys from the Thousand Martial Hall?"
On the Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship, Meng Shushu curiously asks.
"In my eyes, they are already juniors. Killing them would be pointless."
Xu Yan shakes his head and replies.
Meng Shushu: ...
Is this the mindset of the strong?
Or should I say, Xu Yan has the initial mindset of a superior being?
"It's my turn to make a move!"
Meng Chong grins, sword in hand, and instantly arrives at the battlefield.
Boom!
As soon as he lands, he transforms into a nine-foot-tall golden body, covered with indestructible divine armor, as if a god has descended from above, exuding an awe-inspiring aura.
"I am Meng Chong, known as Daozun, a proud son of the Spirit Sect. Dare you to fight me?"
Such an awe-inspiring aura shocks everyone watching.
"It's Meng Chong!"
"He's so strong. Who do you think is stronger, Meng Chong or Xu Yan?"
"Definitely Xu Yan!"
A man strides out from the Lei Yun Mountain Manor, a purple hammer in his hands. Thunderclouds swirl around him and, as he steps forward, the sound of thunder echoes from above.
Thunder and lightning surge, brewing a storm.
"Let me test the might of Daozun!"
"You go ahead!"
Meng Chong replies indifferently.
Boom!
A furious storm of lightning follows his hammer blow, pouring down and engulfing Meng Chong's massive body.
When the lightning vanished, Meng Chong still stood proudly, grinning, "Just average, it merely felt a bit itchy. Since you attack with thunder, take my Fist of Windstorm!"
With that, he punched out.
The Fist of Windstorm roared out. Despite the opponent's continuous wielding of his divine artifact, he was helpless against the might of that singular punch.
Boom!
The proud son of Lei Yun Mountain Manor is defeated!
Without surprise, in the heated contest between the proud sons, Xu Yan came out first, Meng Chong second, and Su Lingxiu third.
By the time Fang Hao took to the field, the proud sons of the Transcendent Spirit Sect had already made their moves one by one. This was about the rule over the Spirit Sect and associated with the pattern of the Spirit Realm.
The unique martial arts had, for the first time, truly made a powerful appearance in the Spirit Realm. Once the unique weapons box was opened, thousands of swords flew out and a razor-sharp knife light covered the sky and earth, reversing directions. The formation trapped one opponent after another.
Watching the great battle in the arena, the Thousand Martial Lord, Niu Qiansheng, the proud son of Lei Yun Mountain Manor, and the proud son of the Yuling Mansion made their moves, yet they were helplessly unable to do anything to Fang Hao and even got trapped themselves.
Now, the Transcendent Spirit Sect couldn't sit still anymore.
"What kind of martial arts is this?"
"Fang Hao is extraordinary. We, the Transcendent Spirit Sect, fail to do anything about it."
"Does it mean we have to accept that the All Ages Alliance would break the pattern of the Spirit Realm and Spirit Sect?"
The Thousand Martial Lord and others discussed in deep voices.
"Summon the respected one!"
The Thousand Martial Lord coldly ordered.
"Isn't this rash?"
Lord Lei Yun asked, frowning.
"Once the Divine Bridge is activated, there will be judgement. Why should we call upon the respected one now?"
Yuling Mansion Master also said gravely.
"Are you really going to let them enter that place?"
The Thousand Martial Lord angrily asked.
Lord Lei Yun and the Yuling Mansion Master fell silent.
After a long while, Lord Lei Yun sighed, "It's been too long since anyone's been in that place. How much good fortune could still be there? Even if they do enter, what can they possibly achieve?"
"Indeed!"
The Yuling Mansion Master nodded.
"As you wish!"
Upon seeing this, the Thousand Martial Lord snorted and left with a wave of his sleeve.
Seeing this, Lord Lei Yun and the Yuling Mansion Master also returned to their respective camps.
"Lord, what now?"
The elders of the Thousand Martial Hall gathered to ask.
"They refused to invite the venerable presence!"
The Thousand Martial Lord gritted his teeth and snorted coldly.
"That's it?"
The elders of the Thousand Martial Hall resentfully said.
"They didn't invite, we Thousand Martial Hall will. Xu Yan, Meng Chong, Fang Hao, these people must die!"
The Thousand Martial Lord spoke with murderous intent.
"You all prepare. I, Thousand Martial Hall, will invite the venerable presence!"
The Thousand Martial Lord commanded solemnly.
"Yes, Lord!"
The elders of the Thousand Martial Hall responded in unison.
The decisive battle of the Proud Sons of Heaven is being conducted fiercely. Using the mysterious martial arts, Fang Hao defeated one after the other of the Transcendent Spirit Sect's Proud Sons of Heaven, ranking him fourth in the battle of the boastful sons.
The powerful figures of the Transcendent Spirit Sect, one by one, looked upset, while the Thousand Martial Hall was preparing to pit Fang Hao, Xu Yan, Meng Chong, and Su Lingxiu against each other to determine the final rankings.
However, when facing Xu Yan, Meng Chong, and Su Lingxiu, Fang Hao directly conceded.
There will be no battles within the top four, so the Proud Sons of Heaven from the Spirit Sect are preparing to fight for the fifth place.
Then, Red Cat stepped onto the stage.
The overpowering might of the Great Demon and the demonstrations of the Demon Clan's major techniques defeated one Proud Son of Heaven after another, even defeating the undefeated Hu Bubai.
All the fighters of the Spirit Sect looked upset.
Not one of the top five on the Proud Sons of Heaven list belonged to the Spirit Sect!
The subsequent battles of the Proud Sons of Heaven competition became normal, with intense competition among the Sons of Heaven.
Xie Lingfeng also stepped onto the stage.
Du Yuying, Yun Miaomiao, and Zi Yun also consecutively took the stage, and all eventually ranked in the top one hundred.
While the competition was ongoing, the preparations for the summoning of the Venerable were underway. But far outside of Hongzhou, a dramatic change was taking place in Ice State, one of the eighteen states of Ling Domain.
The original site of the Quiet Snow Palace had turned into a black cave.
A warm but not scorching energy was continuously flowing out from the black cave, spreading across the entire Ice State.
Ice and snow could no longer be seen in Ice State at this moment, all the accumulated snow had melted.
The entirety of Ice State had started to warm up.
As the massive amounts of ice and snow in Ice State melted, large amounts of water flowed out from Ice State. The first to suffer was the neighboring Yun State.
Boundless water came rolling from Ice State, an impending crisis was quietly looming.
This was a crisis for the entire Ling Domain!
Renowned strongmen from Yun State had all traveled to Hongzhou State to witness the grand event in the Spirit Realm.
The entire Spirit Realm was discussing the competition, waiting for news from the battle of Proud Sons of Heaven to see who would be crowned first and recognized as the first amongst them.
On a small river in Yun State bordering Ice State, several boats were floating, and dozens of martial artists were discussing the competition.
Rumble!
Suddenly, the rumbling sound came across, and the earth began to tremble.
"What's happening?"
A group of martial artists looked up in bewilderment.
"Quick, what is that?"
Suddenly, one of the martial artists pointed forward in horror.
Everyone looked up and saw that in the midst of the rumbling, a mountain in the distance had suddenly collapsed, and along with the collapse of the mountain, a terrifying rush of water was sweeping toward them!
This earth-shattering force horrified everyone.
"Run!"
An alarm was raised, and the martial artists on the boat all leaped into the air, fleeing towards the back.
Among these martial artists, some were Lesser Celestials, and others were Grandmasters.
However, facing such a terrifying flood, they all felt a chill in their hearts.
Not just the area bordering Ice State, all the places bordering it were witnessing scenes of a cataclysmic flood. Even the Lesser Celestial martial artists, if they were a bit slow to escape, were instantly engulfed by the flood, disappearing into the rolling torrent.
"Escape quickly!"
In a large city, everyone was horrified.
The martial artists with a level above Lesser Celestials had just enough time to grab their weaker family members and soar into the sky to escape into the distance.
Boom!
The city collapsed and was engulfed by the flood.
Those who didn't escape quickly enough all vanished into the flood. Even Great Celestials, if trapped in the flood, were in extreme danger.
"What's going on?"
"Everyone run, I'll try to hold back the flood for a while!"
In one of the cities, a few Celestial Refinements exploded into the sky, their energy bursting, intending to resist the onslaught of the flood, buying time to escape!
However, faced with the terrifying flood of such power as of heaven and earth, even a group of Celestial Refinements found it difficult to resist. After not too long, their energies were exhausted, leaving them faltering.
"We can't hold on any longer!"
"Why is this flood so terrifying? It seems to come from Ice State?"
Some of the Celestial Refinements rose to the clouds to avoid the flood and went to investigate the source of the flood.
In a short period of time, Yun State was flooded, with heavy casualties. It looked like a human inferno, the bustling scenes were gone, martial artists who had lost their loved ones were all stunned, watching this scene in disbelief.
However, the flood didn't stop there; the enormous flood was heading for Da Ze State.

chapters.title: Chapter 647 - 345 Seductive Witch's Hunting Ground, Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body
chapters.content:
Da Ze State, known for its numerous mountains, rivers, and lakes, had many structures built upon and even directly above these lakes.
On this day, dozens of Divine Refinement Celestials from Yun State arrived in a hurry, finding the Spirit Sect of Da Ze State, bringing with them horrifying news.
A cataclysmic flood was heading towards Da Ze State, and Yun State had already fallen, with countless casualties!
As the news spread, Da Ze State was shaken, with countless people becoming terrified. Some made swift decisions, immediately fleeing with their families to higher ground.
There were also those who were skeptical.
On this day, the rivers in Da Ze State suddenly swelled, and the flood arrived!
Although the force of the flood had been much weakened after passing through Yun State, Da Ze State, with its many rivers and lakes, now seemed like an enormous lake under the sweep of the flood.
Countless cities were submerged, and numerous people who couldn't escape in time disappeared into the flood.
The flood continued to spread, rushing towards Dachuan and Lizhou, but after the buffer of Yun and Da Ze State, the flood caused by the melting snows of Ice State had significantly weakened.
And Dachuan, with its numerous mountains and rivers, effectively prevented the flood from spreading further.
Then, even more shocking events occurred; there was something unusual about the floodwater. Those who came into contact with it, Martial Artists below the Grandmaster level, began to experience a raging heat throughout their bodies, their skin turning red as they became increasingly irritable.
Even in Yun State, Grandmaster Martial Artists who got tainted by these waters showed the same symptoms, needing several days to recover.
Ice State had already become as warm as spring.
Enchanting women were walking through the rivers formed after the melting of Ice State's snow, clad only in thin, translucent silks, their graceful figures occasionally revealing glimpses of spring.
These women were all Martial Artists from the Quiet Snow Palace, but they were no longer the same people.
And behind them, a beautiful woman lay lazily on a couch, drifting along the river out of Ice State, a gentle aura trailing behind her.
The gentle aura permeated the air, and the Spiritual Energy between heaven and earth seemed to become abnormal. The Power of Domain Laws continually emerged, yet it appeared unable to locate the source that was disturbing the Domain.
"Those who deceive me never end well,"
"You think you can escape Ice State and be safe?"
"I'm coming!"
Coldness filled the eyes of the beauty.
She turned to look back at the location of Quiet Snow Palace, where a black cave continued to expand as if a black hole had appeared between heaven and earth.
"It has finally widened, finally I can put more power through."
A smile appeared on the beauty's lips.
After thousands of years of erosion, today, a cave had finally been successfully opened to transfer power.
"Friends from Quiet Snow Palace, what has happened in Ice State?"
Divine Refinement Celestials from Yun State saw the women on the river and couldn't help but ask.
These were all Martial Artists from Quiet Snow Palace, and the palace was Ice State's ruling Spirit Sect.
Though they were puzzled as to why the people from Quiet Snow Palace were so scantily dressed?
But with such a catastrophe akin to the end of the world, they had no mind to appreciate the view, and hurriedly approached to inquire.
At this moment, looking around, where was there a trace of ice and snow in Ice State?
A dire thought crossed their minds: the melting ice and snow of Ice State had formed a flood, sweeping towards Yun State and Da Ze State.
Why would the ice and snow of Ice State melt?
It was an incredible thing, through countless years, the snow of Ice State had never melted before.
"Giggle... It's nothing much, come, let me tell you!"
The enchanting woman let out a crisp, girlish laugh.
"Come on!"
Behind them, a Divine Refinement Celestial froze in place, sensing that something was amiss with the Martial Artists from Quiet Snow Palace.
But the Divine Refinement Celestials in front were completely bewildered, pulled onto the boat by the women from Quiet Snow Palace, stripped of their clothes, watching the palace beauties kneel down and open their mouths...
They were thoroughly dumbfounded!
Had the beauties of Quiet Snow Palace become so depraved?
In that instant, these Divine Refinement Celestials internally struggled, whether to continue investigating the source of the crisis or to first enjoy the pleasures before them?
Yun State was almost hell on earth, and they still had the mood to indulge?
Beasts!
Quite a few Divine Refinement Celestials cursed themselves silently, ready to sternly rebuke the women from Quiet Snow Palace and push away the beauties kneeling before them.
But suddenly, their faces showed a look of terror.
Such an overwhelming pleasure pierced directly into their Divine Souls, but what was more terrifying was that this pouring pleasure seemed unstoppable, not only draining their lifeblood but also their Divine Souls.
"No!"
"Damn it!"
In that instant, the Divine Refinement Celestials realized the crisis.
Shocked beyond belief, they wanted to kill the woman beneath them, only to discover, horrified, that they could no longer move!
Thump!
Their desiccated bodies, as if completely drained, fell back, their sunken eye sockets filled with fear.
Yet, it was as if they died in a state of bliss!
"Such a delightful taste, I can become stronger now, where the water flows, I can also go."
The lazily reclining beauty on the couch revealed a contented expression.
A slight flush appeared on her tender white face.
All the Divine Refinement Celestials had perished.
The Divine Refinement Celestial who had stopped in his tracks now felt chills on his scalp and fear in his eyes!
Something had gone wrong in Quiet Snow Palace!
He turned around and fled in a mad rush.
"Don't run away, come and enjoy!"
The alluring voice behind him penetrated his soul, stirring his primal desires, almost causing him to lose his mind.
"Ah!"
The Divine Refinement Celestial's eyes turned fierce, and with a roar, he self-inflicted damage on a portion of his Divine Soul.

chapters.title: Chapter 648 - 345 Seductive Witch's Hunting Ground, Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body_2
chapters.content:
The intense agony allowed him to break free from that soul-seducing voice.
Enduring the excruciating pain, he fled frantically.
"Such a ruthless person,"
a woman from Jingxue Palace remarked with a tone full of admiration.
"Run for your lives, notify the powerhouses of Upper Sect, calamity has befallen Jingxue Palace, the snow in Ice State is melting..."
Enduring the soul-searing pain, the Divine Refinement Celestial who escaped from Ice State encountered another group of martial artists who had come to explore the surging disaster and bellowed out these words.
"What has happened?"
The martial artist, despite intense soul agony of his own, relayed the situation.
All were horrified.
One of the Divine Refinement Celestials at the pinnacle spoke gravely, "Send a message to Hongzhou promptly. I'll head to the location of Jingxue Palace to investigate."
After speaking, he hastily took a wide berth around the area, circling a great distance to the location of Jingxue Palace.
Meanwhile, several groups of martial artists entered Ice State, only to disappear without a trace eventually.
"Little brother in the water, come up quickly!"
A woman from Jingxue Palace, having left Ice State by boat, arrived at Yun State and called out to the man in the water.
Slaughter unfolded in Yun State.
Withered corpses drifted with the current in all directions.
No matter their gender, anyone who encountered the women from Jingxue Palace turned into withered corpses. Even the spirit beasts inevitably met the same fate.
"How wonderful, how marvelous, this is my Seductive Witch's hunting ground, my treasure land!"
The lazy beauty's face blushed as if drunk, murmuring to herself.
"I must take complete possession of this place, no one better tries to compete with my hunting ground, unique and incomparable. But where has my Mumu gone?
"Mumu, you are the best. I will find you."
The Seductive Witch mumbled to herself.
In front of the black cave where Jingxue Palace once stood, a Divine Refinement warrior stood in shock.
"What is this? What's going on here?"
He was tremendously shaken, his intuition telling him that this catastrophe was related to the cave that resembled a black hole.
"Such caves have never existed in the Spiritual Realm before. No, I must go to Hongzhou and report to Upper Sect!"
He moved instantly, avoiding the Black Cave from afar and dashing madly towards Hongzhou, not daring to stop even for a moment.
"Finally, someone noticed. Let's hope more powerful people come; the hunt is only interesting when they're a bit stronger. These are still too weak,"
the Seductive Witch's figure suddenly appeared above the cave, and she smiled.
The changes in Ice State, the great upheavals within the Spiritual Realm, had not yet reached Hongzhou.
The communication system set up by the Wanshi Alliance, due to its short establishment time and the obstruction by the Transcendent Spirit Sect, had not spread to Hongzhou.
It was precisely because of this that the calamities in Ice State, Yun State, and Da Ze State had not been swiftly communicated to Hongzhou, leaving the governing Transcendent Spirit Sect in the dark about the drastic changes that had occurred.
In Yun State, Da Ze State, and Dachuan State, Divine Refinement Celestials were rushing towards Hongzhou.
Yun State had become a lake, and the martial artists who survived the massive flood faced a new disaster.
The battle of exceptional youths was nearing its conclusion.
The top hundred geniuses were about to emerge.
All the warriors from Spirit Sect looked exceptionally grim. Having dominated the Spiritual Realm for countless years, not a single Spirit Sect prodigy had made it into the top five of this competition.
The Spirit Body Prodigies were supposed to demonstrate their divine might and uphold the honor of Transcendent Spirit Sect. Instead, none made it into the top five; all were overshadowed by Loose Cultivators.
Wanshi Alliance was in the limelight, especially the young Alliance Hierarch Fang Hao, whose martial arts prowess and tactics once again shocked all corners of the Spiritual Realm.
Right then, every Loose Cultivator seemed to have found their backbone, their fighting spirit soaring with oaths to change the structure of the Spiritual Realm and overturn the rule of Spirit Sect.
Aboard Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship, Xu Yan took out the divine objects he had obtained from Azure Sea. After keeping enough of them to ensure his own foundation could accumulate fully, he gave the rest to Meng Chong and Su Lingxiu.
Li Xuan inwardly admired that his senior brother Xu Yan was perfectly suited for his role, making indelible contributions to his great martial enterprise.
As the battle of the geniuses continued, Xu Yan had already begun to accumulate his foundation again, preparing for breaking into the Divine Skill Realm.
Meng Chong and Su Lingxiu were striving to reach perfection in the Divine Origin Realm.
"It's coming to an end,"
Li Xuan sighed. The grand competition among the geniuses was drawing to a close.
The Wanshi Alliance was truly standing tall in the Spiritual Realm, completely disrupting the order and shaking the rule of Spirit Sect.
But was the Transcendent Spirit Sect just willing to give up like this?
Li Xuan doubted whether something was being prepared in the shadows. Could it be possible that the other parts of the Transcendent Spirit Sect were indifferent to their defeat, Thousand Martial Hall in particular? After being humiliated, wouldn't they seek revenge?
The Daoist Golden Book opened, and golden light surged forth.
"Your disciple Meng Chong has comprehended the first level of the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body, and you have broken through to the first level of the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body."
Meng Chong had finally understood the Martial Arts Techniques of the first level of the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body.
Boom!
Li Xuan felt the changes in his physical body, and was excited beyond measure, as his strength had once again increased.
Both the orthodox Martial Arts and Physical Body Martial Arts had broken through to the Physiognomy Realm.
As for the Alchemical Medical Martial Arts, it couldn't be far behind.
Xu Yan was already explaining the Physiognomy Realm Martial Arts Techniques to Su Lingxiu.
Moreover, Li Xuan felt that Xu Yan seemed to have some insights into the Void-breaking Martial Arts Techniques as well.
"Breaking the Void shouldn't be too far away either, right?"
Li Xuan looked forward to it in his heart.
On this day, the battle for the pride of heaven finally came to a close.
The Emperor Da Zhou, Fu Tianhai, Lord Leiyun, the Master of Yuling Mansion, the Thousand Martial Lord, and the Taimiao Sect Master stood in the air, announcing the results of this battle for heavenly pride.
"The number one prodigy of the Spiritual Realm is Xu Yan, the second Meng Chong..."
The voice of the Emperor Da Zhou was resounding and spread in all directions.
"The top hundred prodigies from the Spiritual Realm have obtained their places, and will enter a precious land in the Spiritual Realm together in one month..."
As for what precious land, the Emperor Da Zhou did not specify.
The expression of the Thousand Martial Lord was cold as he looked towards the ranks of the Thousand Martial Hall; the elder holding the sword nodded, indicating they were ready.
Having finished speaking, the Emperor Da Zhou then fell silent.
As for the matters of the Wanshi Alliance, they were unrelated to his Da Zhou State; the land of victory belonged to the direct rule of Da Zhou State, and the Wanshi Alliance could not interfere.
As for the territories controlled by other Spirit Sects, he couldn't be bothered to care.
"The Spiritual Realm is ruled by the Spirit Sects; this is an unbreakable pattern. Any person or force that tries to change this will be obliterated.
"The Blood Demon and the Blood God Sect were thus, and if the Wanshi Alliance refuses to cease its stubbornness, it will ultimately meet the same fate.
"The Wanshi Alliance is adept in its methods, especially the young Alliance Hierarch Fang Hao, with his Way of the Array, astonishing the world. But if he thinks he can act recklessly and violate the rules of the Spiritual Realm, he is seeking his own death.
"However, considering the establishment of the Wanshi Alliance, and its importance to the stability of the Spiritual Realm, it is not unreasonable to discuss terms. But there is one rule that cannot be changed.
"The Spiritual Realm is the territory ruled by the Spirit Sects. If the Wanshi Alliance wishes to exist, it can only become a Spirit Sect!"
Lord Leiyun looked towards the Wanshi Alliance as he spoke in a deep voice.
The Spiritual Realm is the territory of the Spirit Sects and must not be violated!
However, the fact that the Wanshi Alliance is powerful is undeniable, hence if the Wanshi Alliance wishes to exist, it must be promoted to a Spirit Sect and not remain a Loose Cultivator force.
As to whether it will be promoted to a top Spirit Sect or be listed among the Transcendent Spirit Sects, Lord Leiyun left unsaid, clearly leaving some room for the Wanshi Alliance.
This statement could also be considered as giving the Wanshi Alliance a way to step down.
Being promoted to a Spirit Sect, like them, would belong to the Spirit Sects. In this way, the existence of the Wanshi Alliance would no longer be an issue.
"The Spiritual Realm must be ruled by the Spirit Sects; what kind of rule is this?"
Tan Wenlin spoke out in a deep voice.
"A rule is a rule, not something you or I can decide, nor is it something our Transcendent Spirit Sect can decide. You and the Wanshi Alliance best watch yourselves."
The Master of Yuling Mansion said in a solemn voice.
"Rules are meant to be broken. My Wanshi Alliance will not join the Spirit Sects; let's see what can be done about it?"
Fang Hao said with a light laugh.
Lord Leiyun was about to say something else when, at that moment, more than a dozen figures rushed over in a frenzy, their voices anxious and trembling:
"Upper Sect Master, something terrible has happened. The Ice State and Yun State have suffered a great calamity, countless dead and injured!"
"The ice in Ice State has melted, a massive flood swept through Yun State and Da Ze State; Yun State is already submerged, with innumerable casualties!"
"Upper Sect Master, quickly take control! A great disaster has befallen the Spiritual Realm!"
The whole place fell silent.
Especially the powerhouses from Yun State and Da Ze State, all of whom changed their expressions drastically.
Lord Leiyun and the others' expressions changed dramatically too, and they instantly met up with the newcomers.
"What happened?"
"Is there anyone from Ice State?"
"Something's not right, there is not a single Martial Artist from Ice State. Did no one from the Quiet Snow Palace come?"
Only at this moment did they horrifyingly realize that such an event of the Spiritual Realm had not witnessed a single Martial Artist from Ice State!

chapters.title: Chapter 649 - 346 Please Honor Us with Your Presence, Ice State Heavenly Grotto
chapters.content:
The snow in Ice State melted, leading to a massive deluge that swept through Yun State and Da Ze State—the greatest catastrophe in the history of the Spiritual Realm descended!
Lord Leiyun and other strong cultivators were all shocked!
The gathered powerhouses in Hongzhou were all greatly altered in countenance.
"Quick, go back!"
"What a great disaster in Yun State!"
The strong cultivators from Yun State frantically left, heading back to Yun State.
Family, friends, Sects—all were in Yun State. How many had escaped this great calamity?
"This is not ordinary, Jing Xue Palace certainly doesn't have the capability to create such a crisis; there must have been some unknown changes. We must investigate this thoroughly and quickly."
Lord Leiyun's expression was grave.
He led a group from Leiyun Mountain Manor and left directly.
Following this, strong cultivators from Taimiao Sect, Yuling Mansion, the Great Zhou State, including powerhouses from various top-tier Spirit Sects, also left one after another, heading for Yun State and Da Ze State.
"The snows of Ice State have melted?"
Li Xuan's eyebrows twitched as he thought of Mu Qianliu's warning not to go to Ice State.
Meng Shushu also changed color, remembering Mu Qianliu's words. Could it be that Mu Qianliu had already known about the great disaster hidden in Ice State?
Following that last time, Mu Qianliu had disappeared again.
He didn't return to the Mu Family.
However, when the news about the destruction of Shui Xing Palace arrived, others might not care, but Meng Shushu took notice and even made some inquiries, learning about Tang Jinyan's identity.
Thinking back to Mu Qianliu's reaction when she mentioned the murder of Elder Su, and his mention of Tang Jinyan, it seems that Tang Jinyan was very likely the mastermind behind the scenes.
Mu Qianliu eradicated Shui Xing Palace and killed Tang Jinyan.
And then he completely vanished.
Meng Shushu suspected that after killing Tang Jinyan and wiping out Shui Xing Palace, Mu Qianliu might also have fallen there, perhaps committing suicide?
To atone for the guilt in his heart?
The man had disappeared, never to be found again.
What exactly happened in Ice State, perhaps no one will ever know.
Du Yuying, Yun Miaomiao, and Zi Yun arrived at the Evergreen Pavilion.
"The snow in Ice State has melted. Yun State is flooded, Da Ze State is underwater; it is said that the casualties are severe, what a calamity!"
Du Yuying sighed.
Such a catastrophe, entire states flooded—how tragic the casualties must be.
The Spiritual Realm's Eighteen States, any single state was broader than the entire Inner Domain—it was hard to imagine the horror of such a catastrophe.
"Master, I want to lead the people from the Wanshi Alliance to Yun State and Da Ze State…"
Fang Hao came to bid farewell.
Being born and raised in the Spiritual Realm, he naturally felt more sorrow for such a vast disaster there.
"Go ahead!"
Li Xuan nodded.
Fang Hao led some of the Wanshi Alliance's strong cultivators to leave for Yun State and Da Ze State, while Tan Wenlin remained to preside over the Alliance, responsible for subsequent affairs.
"Senior, I should also do my part for the disaster in Yun State!"
Wu Tianan said with a solemn expression.
"Go ahead!"
Li Xuan nodded.
After Wu Tianan left, Su Lingxiu also prepared to head to Yun State.
Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship was about to start, when suddenly, a rainbow light appeared abruptly, resembling a bridge rising from Hongzhou, seemingly spanning the Azure Sea, reaching directly to the other shore of the Azure Sea.
"What is this?"
Everybody was startled.
Li Xuan narrowed his eyes slightly. This beam of rainbow light was formed by the convergence of the Power of Domain Laws, reaching beyond the Azure Sea.
"Could this be the Divine Bridge?"
Xu Yan asked in astonishment.
"It is not the Divine Bridge but an ethereal bridge. The Divine Bridge is solid, not like this. This is someone opening an ethereal bridge to invite a revenant to descend!"
Fu Yunxiu said with tightly knitted brows.
"Invite a revenant to descend?"
Xu Yan and others looked at her with puzzlement.
Li Xuan was also curious, but as a sage, he had to be in control, knowing everything that happened between Heaven and Earth, so he looked as if he had long understood the matter at hand.
"Mother, what's going on?"
Xie Lingfeng was curious as well and urged for an answer.
"A Transcendent Spirit Sect has opened the ethereal bridge. Each Transcendent Spirit Sect has a complex background. Whenever spirit body prodigies need to leave the Spiritual Realm, an ethereal bridge is opened.
"The ethereal bridge is opened to invite a revenant to descend and take the spirit body prodigies away, after which the ethereal bridge will disappear.
"Generally speaking, the ethereal bridge can only be opened once within ten years, and it won't last for very long."
Fu Yun explained briefly.
Xie Lingfeng was about to ask where the spirit bodies were leaving for when he saw the Thousand Martial Lord and a group of elders standing amid the rainbow light.
"Thousand Martial Hall invites the Venerable to descend and eradicate those who defy the rules of the Spiritual Realm!"
The Thousand Martial Lord shouted loudly.
"Thousand Martial Hall!"
Fu Tianhai moved swiftly, arriving at the Evergreen Pavilion with a somewhat grave expression.
"Xu Yan, you should hide. The Thousand Martial Hall inviting a Venerable to descend must certainly be targeting you."
Xu Yan's eyebrows rose as he said, "I'd like to see what kind of Venerable the Thousand Martial Hall can invite!"
What was there to fear with Master by his side?
Li Xuan's eyebrows twitched, his gaze following the rainbow light to its end, also wanting to see what strong cultivator would descend and what lay at the end of the rainbow light.
He had reached the Physiognomy Realm, his strength surpassing that of the Divine Refinement Celestials, hence he still had some confidence in himself.
Fu Tianhai's gaze lingered on Li Xuan—this mysterious senior likely had an extraordinary origin, and might not fear the support of the Thousand Martial Hall.
Thus, he ceased his attempts to persuade.
Boom!
The rainbow light shimmered, and a figure appeared from the end of the rainbow.
Potent aura rippled in all directions; with every move, it seemed as though the Great Power of Domain was embodied within him.
"It is Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable!"
Fu Tianhai said in a deep voice.
"Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable?"
Li Xuan thought to himself, indeed, just as he had conjectured, cultivation beyond Divine Refinement Celestials involved condensing Domain Laws into one's body.

chapters.title: Chapter 650 - 346: Please Honor Us with Your Presence, Ice State Heavenly Grotto_2
chapters.content:
The person who came from within the rainbow light had an extraordinarily powerful aura, one that surpassed that of any martial artist who had merely condensed the power of principles.
The opponent had already condensed the Heaven and Earth Laws into their body, possessing the Great Power of Domain, and with every move, the might of heaven and earth was at their fingertips.
Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable!
"Not in the early stage of condensing law, but rather in the later stages like this!"
As the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable approached, Li Xuan also deduced the other person's strength and realm.
The Heaven and Earth Laws were profound, blending with the Divine Soul, the Great Power of Domain fully within the body, the thick Heaven and Earth Laws were not as simple as just entering the realm of Condensation Law.
It must be in the late stage of the Condensation Law Realm!
The opponent held a long spear in their hand, which was a Divine Artifact, much more powerful than those of the Spiritual Realm, if the Spiritual Realm Divine Artifacts were considered inferior, what the opponent held was superior.
"Their strength is comparable to that of the Divine Skill Realm."
Theoretically, the realm of the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable is higher than that of the Divine Skill Realm, but their strength matches it.
"Even if Xu Yan reaches the perfection of the Divine Origin Realm, he is no match for a Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable, but he wouldn't fear the Divine Skill Realm anymore."
Li Xuan sighed in relief.
He had been able to overpower a Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable back when he was in the Divine Skill Realm, and now that he was in the Physiognomy Realm, he was even less afraid.
"With my current strength, I exceed the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable."
Great Wilderness Martial Arts, when in the Divine Origin Realm, already far exceeded the Taicang Martial Arts. Upon entering the Divine Skill Realm, theoretically, it was comparable to the Divine Refinement Celestials, but actually, its strength was the realm of a Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable.
And even stronger than a Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable at that.
The profundity of Divine Skills is extraordinary, naturally a notch stronger.
The people from the Thousand Martial Hall were ecstatic, hastily prostrating themselves to welcome with great respect, "Thousand Martial Hall respectfully welcomes the arrival of the Heavenly Venerable!"
"Who has violated the rules of the Spiritual Realm, to warrant summoning the Venerable here?"
The figure atop the rainbow light had arrived above Hongzhou, and his voice thundered across the sky.
The remaining powerhouses in Hongzhou were all stunned.
Tan Wenlin and other Wanshi Alliance martial artists all had drastic changes in expression, looking towards the person coming from within the rainbow light, their hearts trembling.
Is this the foundation of the Transcendent Spirit Sect?
Is this the reliance on which the Transcendent Spirit Sect commands the Spiritual Realm, also the origin of the rules of the Spiritual Realm?
"So powerful!"
Xu Yan spoke with a grave expression.
He was no match!
"I really am still too weak!"
Xu Yan sighed.
What does it count for to be at the peak of the Spiritual Realm?
Master was right, I cannot be complacent and proud just because I have some strength, Martial Arts are limitless, just when I think I am the strongest, there may be someone even stronger!
The person who arrived from within the rainbow light was clad in a black armor, holding a long spear, resembling a war general, with a murderous aura enveloping him.
As if he had fought through countless battles, as if he was a powerhouse who had emerged from the battlefield.
Boom!
He stepped out from the rainbow light, fully entering the borders of Hongzhou. The Heavenly Venerable's might surged in all directions, the Domain's Heaven and Earth Laws seemed to be under his control.
The long spear in his hand had a chilling murderous aura, a sight that would make one's heart go cold.
"We salute the Heavenly Venerable!"
The lord of the Thousand Martial Hall and others spoke with reverence and zeal.
The Heavenly Venerable's gaze swept over, and upon seeing Hu Bubai and the five other core prodigies, he smiled and said, "Good, very good. For acting on behalf of the Thousand Martial Lord and taking in five Spiritual Body disciples, you have established a merit."
The people from the Thousand Martial Hall were overjoyed again.
"Speak, who has defied the rules of the Spiritual Realm, who has offended the Thousand Martial Hall!" The Heavenly Venerable said with a fierce look.
"Reporting to the Heavenly Venerable, it is..." The Thousand Martial Lord was just about to speak when at that moment, a figure rushed frantically from the sky.
Even being at the peak of Divine Refinement Celestial, he was now pale as a ghost, gasping for air, exhausted.
His voice was colored with panic, shouting loudly: "My lord from the Upper Sect, there's been a terrible development, an unknown Black Cave has appeared at the location of Ice State's Quiet Snow Palace.
"The snowmelt in Ice State is all related to this!"
This person was the Divine Refinement Celestial at the peak who had rushed desperately from Ice State.
Having to avoid unknown dangers, he took a great detour and had only now hastily arrived.
The Thousand Martial Lord was furious, for being interrupted while reporting urgent matters to the Heavenly Venerable, this person deserved to die!
He glared angrily, about to rebuke the other.
Unexpectedly, upon hearing the news, the expression of the newly arrived Heavenly Venerable suddenly changed drastically.
Raising his hand, he instantly captured the incoming martial artist, his eyes widened in shock and asked, "What did you just say?"
The martial artist was so terrified that he turned pale, his whole body shaking, his lips quivering. This powerhouse was too frightening.
"Do not panic, I have no ill-intent, speak quickly!"
The Heavenly Venerable took a deep breath and asked again with a calmer tone.
"At the location of Ice State's Quiet Snow Palace, it has turned into a Black Cave, extremely strange. The snowmelt in Ice State seems to be largely related to this, after I made the discovery, I rushed to report it!" The martial artist said, his lips trembling.
The Heavenly Venerable's expression changed drastically in an instant, disbelief written all over his face, "A Heavenly Cave has appeared in the Spiritual Realm? How is this possible!"
"Where is Ice State located?"
The Heavenly Venerable asked solemnly.
"We will be able to reach Ice State soon!"
The Martial Artist pointed with a gesture.
"By the order of the Heavenly Venerable, all Spiritual Sect Warriors of the Spiritual Realm are to gather in Ice State!"
The Heavenly Venerable turned to the Thousand Martial Lord and spoke in a deep voice.
No sooner had his voice faded than he soared into the sky, declaring, "I myself will go to Ice State to confront the enemies!"
Without regarding the astonished looks of the Thousand Martial Lord and the others, he was gone in the blink of an eye, heading straight for Ice State.
"Lord, what should we do?"
The elders of the Thousand Martial Hall were stunned.
Originally, the summoning of the Heavenly Venerable was meant to quell the Wanshi Alliance and defeat Xu Yan and the others. Yet upon hearing of the trouble in Ice State, the Heavenly Venerable had set off for Ice State directly.
To confront the enemy?
"The orders of the Heavenly Venerable must not be disobeyed!"
Despite his reluctance, the Thousand Martial Lord had no choice but to comply with the Heavenly Venerable's decree.
He turned to the pale-faced Martial Artist and began to inquire about the specifics of the situation.
After having heard the full account, the Thousand Martial Lord's expression changed radically; the incident in Ice State seemed to be even more dreadful than he had imagined!
"A Heavenly Grotto? In the Spiritual Realm, there is only one set of Heavenly Grotto Ruins, so why would there be a Heavenly Grotto at the Quiet Snow Palace in Ice State?"
The Thousand Martial Lord's heart turned cold.
Although he was yet to comprehend what the Heavenly Grotto signified, the fact that it had provoked such intense caution and concern from the Heavenly Venerable meant it was certainly a massive crisis.
"Fu Tianhai, relay the order to the Spiritual Sect Warriors to convene in Ice State; it is the command of the Heavenly Venerable!"
The Thousand Martial Lord called out loudly.
He then led the Martial Artists of the Thousand Martial Hall, as well as the forces of the affiliated Spirit Sects, straight toward Ice State.
"Wanshi Alliance, your luck is good. Tan Wenlin, go to Ice State!"
Fu Tianhai said with a smile.
Ice State was in major trouble.
All Martial Artists, one by one, set off for Ice State.
"Master, shall we also go to Ice State to see what's happened?"
Su Lingxiu asked with a curious face. What exactly had happened in Ice State that the Heavenly Venerable himself would go directly there?
Li Xuan nodded.
Meng Shushu originally wanted to advise against it, but on second thought, considering that their senior was an unparalleled master, no disaster in Ice State could pose a threat to Evergreen Pavilion.
Red Cat, Yu Xiaolong, and Little Ha also arrived at the Evergreen Pavilion and set out together for Ice State.
Boom!
The Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Boat soared into the air, transforming into a beam of light, racing straight toward Ice State.
...
In Yun State, the scene was desolate with slaughter ongoing.
The Martial Artists who had just returned to Yun State had already suffered some casualties.
"The monsters from Quiet Snow Palace deserve death!"
Roars of anger and rage were never-ending.
"Something is wrong. The people from Quiet Snow Palace are not the originals anymore; only their bodies remain!"
Xin Mengrou spoke with a grave gaze.
Boom!
Wu Tianan made a move, annihilating a female disciple from Quiet Snow Palace.
Rumble!
The body of the Quiet Snow Palace woman was destroyed by his blow, but the sinister Divine Soul that dwelt within seemed to be retracted as if collected back.
"The source is in Ice State, in the Quiet Snow Palace, let's go directly there," Lord Leiyun said somberly.
This disaster in the Spiritual Realm was even more terrifying than the calamity of the Blood Demon from before.
The group headed straight for the location of the Quiet Snow Palace.
"The snow in Ice State has all melted."
Upon entering Ice State, no pure white snow was to be seen; the bone-chilling cold was gone, replaced by the warmth of spring.
There was no fiery heat, just a comfortable warmth.
"Something isn't right!"
On the Flying Boat, Fang Hao's expression was heavy with concern.
The Domain Qimen's force seemed peculiar after entering Ice State; he had noticed something unusual.
Within the gentle aura, there appeared to be an unknown force that insulated the Domain Lingji, causing it to lose its vitality.
On the surface, the Domain Lingji seemed normal, but it had lost the responsiveness inherent to it.
This meant that the Domain Lingji could not detect some of the abnormalities occurring between heaven and earth.
This discovery weighed heavily on his mind, prompting him to slow the Flying Boat.
"Let's wait for the seniors to arrive; there's no need to take risks!"
Moon Changming said gravely.
Fang Hao nodded and sent a message to the Wanshi Alliance's strong figures not to advance rashly and to always be prepared to escape if necessary.

chapters.title: Chapter 651 - 347: Soul-devouring Enchantress, The Heavenly Venerable Arrives
chapters.content:
Ice State, location of the Heavenly Grotto.
A bed floated above the Heavenly Grotto, surrounded by light gauze that faintly revealed a graceful figure lazily lying within.
And around the bed, hundreds of beautiful women circled.
They varied in appearance, some gentle, some hot, some cute, some quiet... without exception, all were shrouded in sheer gauze, pink, white, black, green, yellow, all different colored veils.
And these people were all once Martial Artists of the Quiet Snow Palace.
"Prey has come."
The Seductive Witch murmured with a laugh.
Her charming face was filled with anticipation.
"Are all the prey ready? Allowing you to die blissfully is also the greatest mercy I can give. My, the Seductive Witch, am truly kind-hearted!"
The Seductive Witch said with a smile that brimmed with happiness.
"What is that?"
Wu Tianan and other strong warriors arrived outside the Heavenly Grotto and were shocked upon seeing the original location of the Quiet Snow Palace transformed into a dark cave.
"Is that the Heavenly Grotto?"
Xin Mengrou furrowed her brows.
"It seems to be the Heavenly Grotto, but why would the Quiet Snow Palace have a Heavenly Grotto? In the Spiritual Realm, there is only one Heavenly Cave Ruins!"
Lord Leiyun expressed his doubt.
Among these strong warriors, Wu Tianan was the only one who wasn't a Spirit Sect warrior, so he looked completely bewildered. What was the Heavenly Grotto?
"The Heavenly Grotto is a mysterious cave that doesn't exist on the ground; it's like an independent little space, yet also as if it's a hole opened between heaven and earth.
"In the Spiritual Realm, there is a set of Heavenly Cave Ruins, with some opportunities inside, but because the ages have passed for so long, there's probably not much left.
"The slot for the battle of the heavenly talents is to enter the Heavenly Cave Ruins."
Xin Mengrou explained to him.
"How did the Heavenly Grotto come about?"
Wu Tianan asked with a frown.
"We don't know!"
Xin Mengrou and several others shook their heads.
"The Heavenly Grotto that appeared in the Quiet Snow Palace seems to be not right; there could be danger, everyone be careful."
The Yuling Mansion Master said in a deep voice.
"Those are people from the Quiet Snow Palace!"
"That one, is she the Jade Palace Master of the Quiet Snow Palace?"
"They all are..."
Seeing the group of beauties circling the Heavenly Grotto, the Spirit Sect strong warriors couldn't help but be astounded.
At this moment, all the people of the Quiet Snow Palace seemed somewhat dissolute.
"Something's not right!"
"Perhaps they are no longer the people they used to be, or their hearts and minds have greatly changed?"
"I can't believe the Jade Palace Master would..."
An elder from the Yuling Mansion said with a pained heart.
"Since the guests have come from afar, please forgive our inadequate hospitality!"
The Jade Palace Master said with a coquettish smile.
"Since you are here, why not join us for a deeper exchange?"
An elder from the Yuling Mansion, his expression growing serious, stepped forward and said, "Allow me to investigate and see what peculiar changes have occurred!"
With that, he headed straight for the Jade Palace Master.
"Forget it, he had a secret crush on the Jade Palace Master in the past, and now..."
"Alas, everyone keep an eye out, let's hope nothing goes wrong!"
The rest of the Yuling Mansion elders sighed.
Everyone watched closely, ready to act at any sign of trouble.
"Hiss, the Jade Palace Master is actually like this... like this..."
"Is that really the Jade Palace Master? Something's not right!"
The strong warriors watched as the Yuling Mansion elder approached and the Jade Palace Master greeted him with joy. Then, she squatted down, reached out with both hands to pull the elder's pants and opened her small mouth...
They all looked on, stupefied and in disbelief.
"Ah!"
Suddenly, a scream came from the Yuling Mansion elder.
"Quick, take action. They are not who they used to be, be careful they devour..."
The Yuling Mansion elder said in horror.
Boom!
The Yuling Mansion Master took drastic action, as the might of the Divine Artifact surged forth.
But, a faint pink light emerged, casually blocking the might of the Divine Artifact, and the Yuling Mansion elder turned into a shriveled corpse.
"What a wonderful taste, so wonderful!"
The Jade Palace Master laughed alluringly, her cheeks flushed, even burping.
At this moment, everyone felt the chill down their spine, their scalps tingling with dread!
"What kind of technique is this? Divine Soul Parasitic? The Jade Palace Master herself is not weak, how could she be parasitized? Moreover, this technique isn't something the Jade Palace Master had..."
"When has the Spiritual Realm ever seen such a strange method?"
"The appearance of the Heavenly Grotto probably heralds the arrival of a crisis. Strike them down!"
Lord Leiyun and others said with a heavy expression.
"Take action!"
Xin Mengrou stepped forward, and as she walked, a dreamy mist spread out, like an illusion yet real.
"So strong!"
Lord Leiyun and everyone else's expressions tightened.
Boom!
Wu Tianan held the measuring stick and struck from the air, bombing directly towards the Jade Palace Master.
With his move, Lord Leiyun, the Yuling Mansion Master, Emperor Da Zhou, and others all showed a slight change in expression, Wu Tianan's strength had grown stronger.
"Strike!"
Several from the Transcendent Spirit Sect acted, each wielding a Divine Artifact.
"So many wonderful tastes, how fun!"
The Seductive Witch narrowed her eyes from atop the bed.
"Taimiao Dream? Interesting!"
Her gaze fell on Xin Mengrou.
Boom!
An intense battle erupted, with Lord Leiyun and company being among the strongest in the Spiritual Realm, wielding Divine Artifacts and unleashing powerful forces.
Lord Leiyun held the Leiyun Hammer Divine Artifact, with lightning illuminating half the sky and thundering down violently, smashing towards the people of Quiet Snow Palace.
Pink radiance began to permeate, stirring in all directions.
The Jade Palace Master and others took action as well, their moves causing all the strong warriors' hearts to grow cold.
The battle intensified.
Xin Mengrou fought the Jade Palace Master, the power of illusion constantly changing, a mix of reality and fantasy hiding a chilling killing intent.
Wu Tianan, holding the measuring stick, continuously struck, forcing several Quiet Snow Palace Martial Artists to retreat in defeat.

chapters.title: Chapter 652 - 347: Soul-devouring Enchantress, The Heavenly Venerable Arrives_2
chapters.content:
As the crowd drew closer to the Heavenly Grotto, the bed behind the ladies of the Silent Snow Palace also came into view. Everyone knew that the figure on the bed was the mastermind behind the scenes.
"Who are you to wreak such havoc and bring disaster upon the Spiritual Realm?"
Emperor Da Zhou, his body enveloped in crimson flames, demanded in a deep voice.
"The Seductive Witch's hunting ground naturally requires death. You are all my prey,"
the Seductive Witch said with a charming laugh.
Boom!
Suddenly, the gauze on the bed was lifted, revealing the enchanting figure for a moment before everyone's eyes. At that same moment, a delicate white hand reached out from the bed toward Emperor Da Zhou.
"Your Majesty, be careful!"
A Supreme Expert of Great Zhou by Emperor Da Zhou's side cried out, shifting his figure instantly to shield Emperor Da Zhou, unleashing the Divine Artifact's wild assault.
However, the delicate white hand cut straight through the wild attack and clutched his neck.
Whoosh!
The man was pulled onto the bed without any resistance.
Through the lifted gauze, everyone saw the beauty on the bed open her mouth slightly and suck the Supreme Expert's Divine Soul into her mouth.
"Ah!"
A cry of terror rang out.
Crack!
The body was thrown out and landed among the women of the Silent Snow Palace. One of the women caught the body and bit into the corpse that had lost its Divine Soul.
In just a moment, the body withered away.
This horrifying sight sent shivers down the spines of all the strong warriors present.
Especially Emperor Da Zhou, who turned deathly pale.
"To suck away a person's Divine Soul, what demonic technique is this?"
Lord Leiyun asked in horror.
The calamity once wrought by the Blood Demon was merely about sacrificing common people and refining their blood for cultivation. It was never so strange as to directly suck away a person's Divine Soul, and furthermore, impossible to resist!
"The hunt has begun!"
From the bed, the delicate white hand reached out and grabbed an elder from the Yuling Mansion.
"Attack!"
Wu Tianan and Xin Mengrou both retreated and stopped their attacks on the women of the Silent Snow Palace, instead aiming for the delicate white hand.
Boom!
However, the white hand, as if ignoring the violent attacks, directly seized the elder and pulled him onto the bed.
"A bit old, but it doesn't matter, does it?"
The Seductive Witch said, opened her mouth, and sucked away the soul. The corpse was thrown to the women of the Silent Snow Palace!
"This woman is too strong, retreat quickly!"
Lord Leiyun said with a face full of alarm.
Wu Tianan and Xin Mengrou, being the two strongest among them, also felt an eerie tingling on their scalps.
The woman on the bed was too strange, too powerful.
"She might come from the Heavenly Grotto. Why would such a terrifying existence be in the Heavenly Grotto?"
Emperor Da Zhou said gravely.
Boom!
The delicate white hand reached out once more, targeting an elder from Leiyun Mountain Manor.
The crowd struck out frantically, yet they still could not fend off that single delicate white hand.
Another strong warrior fell!
In that moment, everyone's hearts trembled with fear.
And the opponent started by targeting the weaker ones, seemingly toying with the strong warriors.
"Leave! We must exit Ice State!"
The master of Yuling Mansion said in a stern voice.
They were facing an enemy beyond their capability to deal with.
"Thousand Martial Hall should have already invited a Heavenly Venerable. Let's quickly return to Hongzhou and ask a Heavenly Venerable to take action!"
Emperor Da Zhou said.
The group began to retreat cautiously.
"Where do you think you're going? We have only just begun!"
A light laugh spread as the bed flew over, and the delicate white hand reached for another.
Another person fell!
The crowd fled in a frenzy, but before they could reach the border of Ice State, they found their retreat was cut off.
The bed floated there silently.
The beauty was radiant and smiling charmingly, yet it caused beads of sweat to form on everyone's foreheads.
"Men can go die, and the women, oh, you shall become my flesh puppets, help me devour the essence of men—it's delightful."
Everyone felt chills all over their bodies.
"Let's fight for it!"
Wu Tianan raised his measuring staff, his aura surging, releasing his full power in an instant, his formidable presence shaking Lord Leiyun and the others.
Xin Mengrou's expression remained calm as she walked step by step forward, flower petals scattering in mid-air, the dreamlike illusion expanding continuously.
"Let's go all out!"
Lord Leiyun and others, holding Divine Artifacts, burst forth with imposing auras, ready to use secret techniques at any moment.
Boom!
Suddenly, several Formation banners fell from the sky, with wind, fire, lightning, and smoke appearing in an instant, enveloping the bed within, displaying a chaotic and dizzying vision in that very moment.
"Quick, escape!"
Fang Hao's figure appeared in the distance before he turned and fled.
Wu Tianan and the others were invigorated, seizing the opportunity to escape frantically while the Seductive Witch was covered by the Formation.
"Interesting tactic, but it's a bit weak!"
Boom!
The Formation was broken, and the Seductive Witch stood atop the bed, stepping forward, and in the blink of an eye, once again blocked everyone's path, raising her hand to capture Fang Hao who was fleeing into the distance.
However, Fang Hao's figure flickered and vanished on the spot in an instant.
Instantaneous Shift Symbol!
The Seductive Witch's brow furrowed; this method was somewhat unusual.
"I'm going to catch that little guy now, no time to play with you all. Prey should meet the end that prey deserves."
The Seductive Witch raised a tender white hand.
Wu Tianan and the others wore looks of despair. The strength of the Seductive Witch had surpassed the limits of the Spiritual Realm; even if they joined forces, they couldn't resist.
At that moment, an overwhelmingly mighty aura appeared between heaven and earth, and a figure soared towards them.
The authority of heaven and earth billowed in all directions. The newcomer clad in black armor, holding a Long Spear, and with a cold voice declared, "Heavenly Grotto scum, do not be impudent!"
The Heavenly Venerable has arrived!
"We're saved, it's the Heavenly Venerable!"
Lord Leiyun and the others were overjoyed.
At this moment, they truly thanked the shameless scoundrels of Thousand Martial Hall. Had they not summoned the Venerable, how would they have been saved?
The Seductive Witch turned her head, her expression growing serious.
"Heavenly Venerable, this demoness devours Divine Souls, her tricks are extremely strange, and she represents a great calamity for our Spiritual Realm!"
Lord Leiyun shouted.
Seizing the opportunity, everyone fled frantically, distancing themselves from Ice State and hiding behind the Heavenly Venerable.
The Heavenly Venerable's expression was grave, his Long Spear emitting a cold light, as he approached step by step. With every step he took, the Principles of Heaven and Earth emerged, and the Great Power of Domain gathered around him.
With the clouds whirling around him, the authority of heaven and earth laid in his palm.
Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable!
"Issue my order, seal off Ice State. Do not allow anyone from Ice State to leave. After I slay this foe, we will investigate one by one."
The Heavenly Venerable commanded with a deep voice.
"Yes!"
Lord Leiyun and the others responded respectfully.
As the Heavenly Venerable approached the Seductive Witch step by step, the Witch no longer possessed her prior composure. Her brows knit together, the appearance of this Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable was beyond her expectations.
And he had appeared in the Spiritual Realm so swiftly.
"A rather interesting prey. Once I've devoured you, I'll become even stronger."
The Seductive Witch smirked coldly.
Boom!
Pink radiance emerged from her body. The martial artists of the Quiet Snow Palace nearby fell to the ground, lifeless, as the Divine Souls that occupied their bodies returned to the Seductive Witch, further enhancing her strength.
In the face of this Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable, the Seductive Witch did not dare to be careless.
"It should be impossible for anyone from the Heavenly Grotto to appear in the Spiritual Realm. How did you get here?"
The Heavenly Venerable asked coldly.
"Nothing is impossible."
The Seductive Witch's smile was brilliant.
"Although the Spiritual Realm is weak, with a little erosion over a long time, it's possible to create an opening and inject part of one's strength inside."
The Heavenly Venerable's gaze sharpened, but then he let out a sigh of relief.
"So it's just you who dared to invade, seeking your own death!"
The Seductive Witch covered her mouth and laughed, her charm on full display, and the pink radiance offered an allure that seemed capable of invoking primal desires.
Above her head, a pink lotus-shaped flower emerged.
An intoxicating fragrance spread around her, seemingly enchanting enough to stir primal instincts.
Within the pink lotus, there stood a figure resembling the Seductive Witch but not quite identical, with a lotus mark on her forehead and her hair resembling slender snakes.
The Domain Lingji where the Seductive Witch resided seemed to become disordered at that moment, as unknown energies gathered continuously from the Heavenly Grotto, assembling above the Witch to form a pink cloud.
"My hunting ground is naturally my own. Wouldn't be sharing it with others now, would I? You're quite an interesting quarry."
The Seductive Witch smiled brilliantly.
However, that Heavenly Venerable, observing the pink lotus and the figure of the Witch atop it, his expression shifted drastically while he gripped his spear even tighter.
His eyes were filled with profound solemnity.

chapters.title: Chapter 653 - 348 Don't panic, everyone; we have a master in the Spiritual Realm.
chapters.content:
"Soul-devouring Enchantress!"
The Heavenly Venerable gritted his teeth as he spoke in a deep voice.
"Giggle, the big game actually knows about me; looks like you're someone with insights!"
The Seductive Witch covered her mouth and laughed, extending a tender white leg forward, alluring in posture.
"Your Seductive Witch Clan truly deserves death!"
The rage of the Heavenly Venerable could not be contained.
"Today, I shall slay you!"
With a flick of his Long Spear, he charged forward to kill.
"The Seductive Witch Clan?"
The Seductive Witch was evidently taken aback for a moment, then her smile became even more radiant.
"Such an insightful big game!"
Boom!
Pink light surged, and with a wave of her tender white hand, a zither appeared. The sound of its strings, ringing out, brought forth waves of attacks.
At this moment, the Seductive Witch seemed to be immersed in playing her zither.
The pink radiance reflected across the Heaven and Earth, colliding with the formidable aura of the Heavenly Venerable.
Finally, the Thousand Martial Lord and Fu Tianhai arrived.
"What's going on?"
Shocked by the great battle ahead, they couldn't help but be astonished.
Who could this enemy be, to battle the Heavenly Venerable?
"It's the Heavenly Grotto!"
Lord Leiyun spoke solemnly, explaining, "The Silent Snow Palace has turned into a Heavenly Grotto, and a strange woman called the Seductive Witch appeared, capable of devouring Divine Souls, unimaginably powerful…"
Soul-devouring Enchantress!
That's what the Heavenly Venerable said.
Moreover, from the Heavenly Venerable's few words, it was understood that the Heavenly Grotto was dangerous and powerful enemies could emerge.
As for how the Heavenly Grotto appeared and why such a strange enemy was there, it remained unknown.
And it seemed the Seductive Witch was a clan?
"It's a good thing the Heavenly Venerable arrived in time, or we would have been doomed!"
Emperor Da Zhou sighed and spoke.
"If the Seductive Witch is so powerful, can the Heavenly Venerable really subdue her?"
Fu Tianhai voiced his worries.
"Ha!"
The Thousand Martial Lord sneered with contempt, "Fu Tianhai, that is the Heavenly Venerable we're speaking of, summoned by our Thousand Martial Hall. Whatever power that Seductive Witch has, how can she be a match for the Heavenly Venerable?
"Once the Heavenly Venerable suppresses the enemy of the Heavenly Grotto, the layout of the Spiritual Realm should be reassessed!"
Lord Leiyun and the master of Yuling Mansion nodded, adding, "If even the Heavenly Venerable cannot prevail, our Spiritual Realm is truly in danger; no one can match the Seductive Witch!"
"I think we should prepare for the worst-case scenario."
Emperor Da Zhou said in a grave tone.
"Emperor Da Zhou, do you dare question the might of the Heavenly Venerable?"
The Thousand Martial Lord, confident with the support of the Heavenly Venerable, was filled with arrogance and gave Emperor Da Zhou a cold glance.
Emperor Da Zhou's face darkened, "Do not slander me; how could I possibly question the might of the Heavenly Venerable?"
"Then what do you mean by preparing for the worst-case scenario?"
The Thousand Martial Lord persisted with an unyielding disposition.
"Hmph, the Divine Bridge still needs time to open. If an unexpected event occurs, such as more powerful enemies emerging from the Heavenly Grotto, what then?
"I believe we should invite another venerable being to ensure absolute safety."
Emperor Da Zhou spoke with a grim face.
"Then let your Great Zhou open the Divine Bridge and invite the venerable being," the Thousand Martial Lord said with a sneer.
"My Great Zhou last opened the Divine Bridge nine years ago to send two Spirit Body Prodigies on their way; it is not yet time to open the bridge again!"
Emperor Da Zhou glared at the Thousand Martial Lord furiously.
The Divine Bridge could only be opened once every ten years, and Great Zhou had already done so nine years ago to send away Spirit Body Prodigies.
The name Hongzhou was related to the opening of the Divine Bridge; its rainbow light reflected across Heaven and Earth, hence its name.
However, those unaware of the secret merely thought it was an ordinary rainbow light, unique to Hongzhou's scenery, unaware that it was a bridge, a bridge that sent Spirit Body Prodigies away.
"Emperor Da Zhou speaks sensibly; we must take precautions!"
The master of Yuling Mansion nodded in agreement.
This Heavenly Venerable was invited by the Thousand Martial Hall, representing the backing power of the Thousand Martial Hall. Although every family had their own backing, there was some trepidation when facing a Heavenly Venerable that was not their own.
Moreover, the Thousand Martial Hall was known for being somewhat shameless.
What if their backing was also shameless? Wouldn't that spell disaster?
For example, their Spirit Body Prodigies being forcibly taken away...
"Heh!"
The Thousand Martial Lord laughed proudly.
The other members of the Transcendent Spirit Sect who wanted to open the Divine Bridge were too late.
The great battle would soon end, and the might of the Heavenly Venerable would sweep across the Spiritual Realm. They could only obey orders; with the Heavenly Venerable supporting the Thousand Martial Hall, they could accomplish much more.
The structure of the Spiritual Realm was not something anyone could disrupt.
His gaze turned cold as he glanced at Wu Tianan.
Wu Tianan did not take the Thousand Martial Lord seriously at all, focusing intently on the battle between the Heavenly Venerable and the Seductive Witch.
He wasn't too far from reaching the level of Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable.
But this half-step was a huge leap.
To the outside, it seemed only a half-step away, yet this half-step was as different as Heaven from Earth.
"This is the might of the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable, just as the elder mentioned, refining the Heaven and Earth Laws... The Spiritual Realm's Spirit Mechanism is insufficient to refine the Heaven and Earth Laws, hence the inability to break through."
Wu Tianan murmured to himself.
Xin Mengrou was also focused on the great battle, as she was only half a step away from Condensation Law herself.
Now, with the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable before her, it was an opportunity to glimpse the power of Condensation Law.
"Something's not right!"
Suddenly, Wu Tianan's brow slightly furrowed.
He couldn't shake the feeling that the Heavenly Venerable seemed to be at a disadvantage, slightly overwhelmed by the Seductive Witch.
He looked towards Xin Mengrou and found that she was looking back at him. Both felt a sinking realization in their hearts, sensing that things were going terribly wrong!
The Heavenly Venerable, overwhelmed by the Seductive Witch!
Clueless of this, the Thousand Martial Lord remained insufferably arrogant, his gaze covertly on Wu Tianan as if it wouldn't be long before this formidable foe would be subdued by the Heavenly Venerable!

chapters.title: Chapter 654 - 348 Don't Panic, We Have Experts in the Spiritual Realm_2
chapters.content:
The masters of Yuling Mansion and Lord Leiyun had already thought to open the Divine Bridge, inviting a venerable descent, but opening the Divine Bridge is not something that could be done overnight.
It required a certain amount of time for preparation, and right now, the Heavenly Venerable was fighting a great battle with the enemy and had ordered the sealing of Ice State. If they were to rashly leave, they would offend this Heavenly Venerable, and without the backing of a Heavenly Venerable to support them, they might be in a terrible situation when the time came.
"Something's not right!"
Emperor Da Zhou's eyebrows suddenly furrowed.
He cast a sidelong glance at Wu Tianan and Xin Mengrou, noting their grave expressions and apparent readiness to retreat, which gave him a sinking feeling.
He then turned his gaze to Fu Tianhai, who also sensed that something was amiss at this time.
The Heavenly Venerable seemed as overwhelmingly powerful as ever, with each strike containing the might of Heaven and Earth, as if to suppress the Seductive Witch completely.
But it was vaguely visible that pink light seemed to have penetrated within the Heavenly Venerable's defenses.
