Pink lotuses surrounded the Heavenly Venerable's attacks, continuously invading and sealing, restricting the Heavenly Venerable's paths of retreat, making it impossible for the Heavenly Venerable to escape.
"My dear prey, after consuming you, my strength will rise again."
The coquettish laugh of the Seductive Witch came through.
Boom!
The Heavenly Venerable struck with his spear, and his figure instantly swelled, with the power of the Domain Laws pouring forth. The battlefield stirred with wind and cloud, and a great spear traversed the sky, aiming at the encircling pink radiance.
Whoosh!
Lotus flowers swirled out in pink, twining along the spear like chains, seeking to lock it in place, while the Seductive Witch's slender form pressed closer.
Her pale hands reached back, plunging directly into the Heavenly Grotto, and from within, she extracted a pink pitchfork.
The pitchfork broke through the layers of defense and stabbed into the Heavenly Venerable, causing cracks to appear in his black armor.
"Flee quickly, and open the Divine Bridge, call upon the True King to descend to the Spiritual Realm and suppress the Seductive Witch's Heavenly Grotto!"
The Heavenly Venerable roared at this moment.
The Thousand Martial Lord and others were stunned.
The Heavenly Venerable was defeated by the Seductive Witch?
"Flee now!"
The Thousand Martial Lord was the first to turn and flee. His back was drenched in cold sweat—the Heavenly Venerable was actually no match!
It was too terrifying!
"The Spiritual Realm is doomed."
"Hurry to Hongzhou, the Divine Bridge is not yet closed, quickly call for reinforcements!"
"It's too late, judging by the time, the Divine Bridge has already closed!"
"Yuling Mansion and Leiyun Mountain Manor, open the Divine Bridge quickly, invite the Venerable to descend!"
"It's too late, it can't be opened overnight!"
A group of mighty individuals panicked, fleeing desperately.
"Prey, you cannot escape from my Seductive Witch's hunting ground."
The voice of the Seductive Witch echoed from afar.
In that instant, all the mighty ones broke into a cold sweat.
"What do we do? What do we do? The Spiritual Realm is likely finished; we can only wait for the Divine Bridge to be opened and for the Heavenly Venerables to descend to resolve this crisis!"
"By the time the Divine Bridge is opened, we'll all be dead!"
"To the Inner Domain!"
"Yes, to the Inner Domain!"
Some of the strong ones suggested in panic.
"The Inner Domain... we can't go, the gate to the Spiritual Realm has disappeared!"
The Thousand Martial Lord lamented.
"What?"
All the strong ones were greatly alarmed—could the disappearance of the Spiritual Realm Gate be related to the appearance of the Heavenly Grotto?
"Escape as long as we can."
Emperor Da Zhou lamented.
"Everyone, don't panic, our Spiritual Realm has experts in hiding!"
Wu Tianan suddenly spoke in a heavy voice.
"Experts?"
"Where are these experts?"
Everyone was taken aback.
"Yes, experts, peerless experts. Our Spiritual Realm has hidden experts. Only by asking these experts to act can our Spiritual Realm be saved from this devastating calamity."
Xin Mengrou's eyes also shone brightly as she spoke.
How could they have forgotten that senior?
Emperor Da Zhou and others felt reassured. If even Xin Mengrou said so, then surely, it must be an unimaginably powerful expert, right?
But deep down, they weren't entirely confident.
"Can experts compare to the Heavenly Venerable? Even the Heavenly Venerable has perished. Moreover, after the Seductive Witch consumes the Heavenly Venerable, her strength will become even greater!"
The Thousand Martial Lord said with little confidence.
"He is a true peerless expert, how could he be compared to a Heavenly Venerable?"
Wu Tianan, however, spoke with confidence.
That senior, he is an existence that transcends Heaven and Earth. Can a Heavenly Venerable transcend Heaven and Earth?
"Where is this expert?"
The Lord of Yuling Mansion asked anxiously.
"Evergreen Pavilion!"
Wu Tianan and Xin Mengrou responded simultaneously.
...
The Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Boat had already reached Yun State. Looking down from above, the vast Yun State was reduced to only mountain peaks poking out of the water while the cities had long disappeared.
"There's something strange about these waters."
Su Lingxiu frowned slightly as she spoke.
"The erosion of a special aura. Just cut off the source and everything will go back to normal."
Xu Yan pondered for a moment before speaking.
The source lay within the Heavenly Grotto in Ice State.
Li Xuan was holding the Book of Taicang in his hands, having reached the thirteenth page.
As his cultivation level increased, so too did the speed at which he memorized the Dao Principles.
Suddenly.
The Daoist Golden Book opened, and golden light surged forth.
"Great Wilderness Warriors breakthrough reaches ten million; you have obtained the Great Wilderness Physiognomy!"
The number of warriors cultivating the Great Wilderness Martial Arts in the Inner Domain had broken through ten million!
The speed was incredibly fast.
Moreover, as the number of Great Wilderness Warriors continued to grow, the rate of increase would accelerate even more.
"This Great Wilderness Physiognomy is quite impressive!"
Li Xuan felt elated within. The Great Wilderness Physiognomy would grow increasingly powerful and vast as the number of warriors increased.
"The Great Wilderness is like the beginning of the domain, a vision of Chaos first opening..."
Once the Great Wilderness Physiognomy was deployed, the image of an unparalleled expert would become even more awe-inspiring, making people look up to it as unfathomable.
"Not bad. Combined with the mysterious aura, even a martial artist stronger than me would feel their legs go weak at the sight," Li Xuan muttered to himself.
Great Wilderness Physiognomy + mysterious aura would scare even those who were more powerful than himself into submission!
"Who knows what's really happening at the Heavenly Grotto in Ice State. I hope it won't require me to suppress everything by hand," Li Xuan looked towards Ice State, his thoughts deepening.
"That Heavenly Venerable has already gone to Ice State. I wonder how the situation is now and whether the problem can be resolved."
The warrior that the Thousand Martial Hall had invited should have decent strength. With the might of the Domain, he should be able to suppress the Heavenly Grotto, right?
The Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Boat continued towards Ice State at a moderate speed.
Swish!
Two figures rushed through the sky in haste.
Fang Hao and Moon Changming.
"Junior brother, what's the situation?" Su Lingxiu asked curiously.
"Things are dire!" Fang Hao said with a grave expression, "A gigantic cavern has appeared in Ice State, and the cavern seems a bit peculiar, as if it's a hole that has formed between heaven and earth.
"Inside the Heavenly Grotto, there's a powerful woman called the Seductive Witch, who actually devours divine souls, seemingly preying on the divine souls of martial artists.
"Her strength is immense. Even when senior martial artists like Wu joined hands, they were no match. I used a Great Formation to catch her by surprise and managed to restrain her for a moment, but she quickly escaped and gave chase.
"However, right now, that Heavenly Venerable is engaged in battle with the Seductive Witch. I'm not sure what the outcome will be."
Fang Hao recounted the events in detail.
All present were shocked.
Feeding on divine souls?
"What kind of sorceress is this? The Spiritual Realm has actually produced such a bizarre person," Xu Yan expressed his astonishment.
Then, eager to face her, he declared, "Allow me to meet her myself!"
Fang Hao shook his head with a serious expression, "Big brother, even if our fellow disciples joined forces, we would be no match for her. I have a feeling that the Heavenly Venerable might be defeated!
"Moreover, once she devours the Heavenly Venerable, her power might grow even stronger!
"That Heavenly Grotto is very special, and it's unclear what its emergence truly signifies."
Xu Yan and the others turned to look at their master.
Li Xuan remained unperturbed, focusing on the Book of Taicang in his hands, seemingly indifferent to the Heavenly Grotto in Ice State and the mysterious Seductive Witch.
In reality, he was somewhat astonished, "Devouring divine souls? The Heavenly Venerable is no match? If he is defeated, who in the entire Spiritual Realm could be her opponent?
"Ultimately, I suppose I will have to take action. What if the Seductive Witch's strength is beyond imagination? Wouldn't that pose some danger?"
Li Xuan reassessed his own strength once again, contemplating how many Heavenly Venerables he could handle on his own.
"With my cultivation level at the Physiognomy Realm, the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body, various divine skills, the Great Wilderness Physiognomy, the true form of the Primeval Ancestor... One against a hundred Heavenly Venerables wouldn't be a problem.
"Considering this, the Heavenly Venerable should be capable of fighting her for a while even if he gets devoured and her power increases. It looks like I could still suppress her.
"However, does the Heavenly Grotto hold even stronger enemies?
"I must be cautious. I can't afford to capsize in the gutter."
Li Xuan felt somewhat helpless inside, as he had wanted to lay low and avoid taking action if possible. Now, it appeared it was time for him to step in once again!
Fortunately, his strength was sufficiently formidable.

chapters.title: Chapter 655 - 349 This is what a master is, truly too high
chapters.content:
"Master, what is the Heavenly Grotto?"
Unable to suppress his curiosity any longer, Xu Yan finally asked.
"The Heavenly Grotto,"
Li Xuan's eyes deepened, and he slowly said, "When your strength becomes powerful, your horizons broaden, and your understanding of the Domain deepens, you will naturally come to know.
"If your master told you the root of it directly, you would lose the heart to seek, and that might not be good. It's the desire to explore the mysterious that embodies the spirit of seeking in the Martial Arts..."
What the Heavenly Grotto was, Li Xuan certainly did not know.
As a peerless senior figure that transcended the Domain, the all-knowing master could not admit his ignorance.
Therefore, Li Xuan looked at his disciple with a teaching tone and said.
"Master is right!"
Xu Yan was momentarily stunned, then nodded his head, finding his master's words to be sensible. Losing curiosity about the mysterious would diminish the heart of seeking.
"Master is telling me to keep the heart of seeking. The path of Martial Arts is a long one; only by maintaining the heart of seeking can one expand one's horizons and carve out one's own path in Martial Arts!"
Xu Yan suddenly came to a realization.
Li Xuan nodded, his face full of gratification, "You understand the painstaking efforts of your master, and I am very comforted!"
With the master having said this, Su Lingxiu was too embarrassed to express her curiosity out loud, despite feeling it keenly.
The Flying Boat left Yun State, entering the boundary of Ice State when suddenly, a group of people scurried towards them in a dire escape.
"Please, senior, lend a hand to save the Spiritual Realm!"
The moment Wu Tianan saw the Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship, he became overwhelmingly excited.
"Please, senior, a rescue for the Spiritual Realm!"
Lord Leiyun and others rushed to prostrate on the ground, calling out loudly.
By now, this was their only hope.
Wu Tianan and Xin Mengrou both believed that only a high-ranking individual from the Evergreen Pavilion could save the Spiritual Realm, and they had always suspected that the person from the Pavilion might be a Heavenly Venerable.
Even the Thousand Martial Lord and others had no choice but to prostrate on the ground at this moment.
No enmity or feud was worth more than one's life.
One must seek help when necessary.
"Master!"
Xu Yan and the others all looked toward their master.
Li Xuan remained unperturbed, holding a book, seemingly without sensing any crisis.
"Let's go have a look at the Heavenly Grotto," he said calmly.
The Flying Boat headed towards the Heavenly Grotto.
Wu Tianan and his companions were thrilled. Was the senior about to take action and suppress the Soul-devouring Enchantress?
The Thousand Martial Lord and the others also wore expressions full of anticipation. How formidable was this mysterious senior, could he be stronger than a Heavenly Venerable?
Could he perhaps be the True King referred to by the Heavenly Venerable?
As for what a True King was, they weren't quite sure. To their knowledge, the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable was already supreme.
What then, was the realm of a True King?
As they drew closer to the Heavenly Grotto, the aftermath of the battle had already dissipated.
The canopy bed floated above the Grotto, and the Martial Artists of the Silent Snow Palace were once again gracefully standing before the bed.
Inside the bed, a figure had just stopped struggling.
A delicate white hand was clasped around the neck of a Heavenly Venerable, having devoured his Divine Soul, erased his consciousness, and converted it into her cultivation.
The corpse of the Heavenly Venerable had gradually become shriveled.
Gulp!
All those who witnessed this scene felt their hearts tremble. Even the mighty Heavenly Venerable had his Divine Soul sucked away!
The Seductive Witch looked towards the Flying Boat, her elegant eyebrows furrowing slightly. What kind of Divine Artifact was this?
She didn't rush to make a move, but instead concentrated on assimilating the Heavenly Venerable's Divine Soul to enhance her own strength.
From deep within the Heavenly Grotto, streams of pink aura continually surged up, entering her body, making her appear even more glamorous and slightly more powerful.
"Please, senior, eliminate the great enemy of the Heavenly Grotto!" Xin Mengrou said respectfully.
"No rush," Li Xuan glanced over and inwardly relaxed. The Seductive Witch's strength wasn't too formidable; he could annihilate her with a single strike.
However, her source of power was emanating from the Heavenly Grotto itself.
Unless he cut off the connection with the Heavenly Grotto, he couldn't completely eliminate the adversary in one strike.
To do so, though, would require some effort.
Li Xuan's gaze became pensive as he looked on, his brows slightly furrowing. Something about the Seductive Witch was off, as if she was not a being of flesh and blood.
"Similar to an avatar?"
"Yet not quite like one, it seems as though she has been born from a certain method into this body."
Li Xuan mused.
"What does the senior mean?" Xin Mengrou asked in surprise, wondering why there was no urgency.
"Once her strength reaches its peak, I will naturally make a move," Li Xuan stated nonchalantly.
"A true expert indeed. Such confidence, such an air of superiority. He does not exploit the vulnerable!" Wu Tianan inwardly marveled.
A breath of relief swept through the powerful onlookers.
By giving the Seductive Witch a chance to refine the Heavenly Venerable's Divine Soul without taking advantage of the situation, it showcased the senior's confidence and strength.
The Spiritual Realm was safe!
The Seductive Witch would no longer be able to bring chaos to the Spiritual Realm!
For a moment, all the mighty ones awaited the expert's powerful intervention to subdue the Enchantress.
Xu Yan looked towards the Heavenly Grotto, his expression filled with astonishment.
This was identical to the cavern he had seen in the black abyss of the Azure Sea. The only difference was that the cavern in the Azure Sea was tiny, whereas this Grotto was vast.
So this was the Heavenly Grotto?
He couldn't help but step out of the Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Boat and approach the Heavenly Grotto.
At this moment, the cave seemed like a colossal hole between the heavens and the earth as if a mighty power had pierced through the Domain, leaving behind a massive gaping void.
This was the Heavenly Grotto!
"The Heavenly Grotto, a hole in the Domain?
"The Void-breaking Realm, unconstrained by the Heaven and Earth Laws, free from the spatial bonds of the Domain. It tears through the emptiness of the Domain, traversing the void.
"There's a similarity with this Heavenly Grotto.
"The difference is that the Power of Void-breaking, traversing the void of the Domain, walking within the emptiness of the Domain, does not leave behind a colossal hole in the Domain."

chapters.title: Chapter 656 - 349 This is what a master is, truly too high_2
chapters.content:
"The reason for the existence of the Heavenly Grotto is the relentless force that props open the Heaven and Earth Laws, expands the space of heaven and earth, allowing the Heavenly Grotto to persist."
"It's almost as if a hole has been punctured through heaven and earth?"
Xu Yan had some enlightenment in his heart, understanding the Void-breaking Realm more deeply. He vaguely felt he was only a little bit away from fully grasping the Martial Arts Techniques of the Void-breaking Realm.
Step by step, he moved toward the Heavenly Grotto; he wanted to see for himself exactly what the Heavenly Grotto was and how it had pierced through the domain to form.
The Heavenly Grotto of the Azure Sea's dark abyss was too small, offering limited insight, while this immense Heavenly Grotto allowed for a clearer perception.
"What is the eldest senior brother doing?"
Meng Chong said with surprise.
Everyone else was just as astonished. Was Xu Yan about to take action and battle the Seductive Witch?
He was indeed powerful, standing at the pinnacle among the geniuses of the Spiritual Realm, and in terms of strength, he was at the peak of the Spiritual Realm too.
But ultimately, he was not as powerful as the Heavenly Venerable.
The Heavenly Venerable had been killed, and after the Seductive Witch devoured the Heavenly Venerable's Divine Soul, her strength became even more formidable. How could Xu Yan match her?
Li Xuan's eyebrows raised slightly, his heart secretly thrilled.
"Xu Yan, seeing the Heavenly Grotto, has he gained some enlightenment of the Martial Arts Techniques of the Void-breaking Realm?
"This means that his breakthrough into the Void-breaking Realm might come very soon."
Li Xuan was full of anticipation; the strength of the Void-breaking Realm was the foundation for transcending the domain, even though it did not transcend heaven and earth itself.
And he had nearly finished creating the techniques above the Void-breaking Realm.
If Xu Yan could comprehend the Martial Arts Techniques of the Void-breaking Realm, he could pass on the techniques above the Void-breaking Realm to Xu Yan in advance.
Perhaps it wouldn't take long for him to understand as well?
"Xu Yan is not far from the Divine Skill Realm, is he!"
Li Xuan was brimming with expectation. Once Xu Yan entered the Divine Skill Realm, Li Xuan would gain feedback from his divine skills.
"Such a fragrant scent!"
Suddenly, the Seductive Witch looked up at Xu Yan, who was approaching the Heavenly Grotto, her eyes shining brightly.
"However, why does it feel like something is not quite right with him, as if swallowing him will be very, very difficult..."
The Seductive Witch was somewhat puzzled.
She always felt that this man was unusual, and swallowing him up seemed to be much harder than the Heavenly Venerable she had dealt with earlier.
"Little brother, feeling lonely by yourself? Do you need sister to keep you company?"
From the Jade Palace, Palace Master Yuying, her smile blooming like flowers, approached Xu Yan.
Her eyes shimmered with a faint pink glow.
The power of charm surged continuously as if trying to evoke primal desires.
"Be careful!"
Wu Tianan couldn't help but warn.
Xu Yan, however, did not even spare a glance; such charm power was utterly ineffective against him.
Li Xuan quietly put away the Book of Taicang, silently watching the Seductive Witch, ready to strike her down if she made a move!
As for the likes of the Jade Palace Master, she was merely a minor parasitic Divine Soul, not worth considering and unable to pose any threat to Xu Yan.
"Little brother..."
Palace Master Yuying drew closer and closer, the light veil on her body almost drifting away, revealing almost all of her tender white skin with a faint pink hue.
The scene of extreme seduction seemingly aimed to snatch away Xu Yan's heart and soul.
Fu Tianhai and the other experts of the Spiritual Realm stared with wide eyes, shocked to their core. Even at such a distance, and though not the intended target, they were somewhat affected by the power of charm.
How could Xu Yan, who was directly facing this charm and was full of youthful vigor, withstand it?
"Shameless!"
"Despicable woman who deserves to die!"
From the Evergreen Pavilion, Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao angrily cursed.
"Get lost!"
Xu Yan said coldly.
He raised his hand and slashed with his sword.
This sword, swift as a flash, was like the convergence of mountains and rivers, as if all living beings wielded the sword for the strike.
Boom!
The Jade Palace Master did not expect Xu Yan to disregard her charm power.
With a change in expression, she hastily tried to defend herself.
Spurt!
However, under this sword strike, the Jade Palace Master's physical body instantly disintegrated.
The sliver of Divine Soul parasitizing in the Jade Palace Master's body was also shattered by the Sword Intent, dissolving into nothingness!
The Seductive Witch, who had been lazily reclining on a couch, suddenly changed her expression.
"What kind of Sword Dao is this? It can even destroy a strand of my Divine Soul?"
She sat up in shock, looking toward the young man who had reached the edge of the Heavenly Grotto.
"Little brother, you're killing this poor girl…"
Raising a tender white hand, she was about to grab Xu Yan.
"Do not disturb my disciple's comprehension."
A voice thundered in her mind, like a clap of thunder.
The hand that had been raised instantly stalled.
The Seductive Witch's expression changed dramatically, and she turned to look at the Evergreen Pavilion with a solemn look.
"Who are you?"
Li Xuan replied indifferently, "My name is more than you can bear!"
"What a joke!"
Standing up, the Martial Artists of the Quiet Snow Palace around the couch had all slumped to the ground, their Divine Souls all returning to the Seductive Witch's original body.
Meanwhile, more pink light emerged from the Heavenly Grotto, entering into the Seductive Witch's body.
Her strength continued to increase.
"There's no name my Seductive Witch can't bear!"
Li Xuan was still completely unperturbed, "The weight of my name isn't just unbearable for you, but even the Domain itself can't bear it!"
Blowing his own trumpet? He was very good at that!
Fu Tianhai and the others were greatly shocked. This was what a great master was like, wasn't it?
Indeed, he was too high to reach!
"Is that so? Then I, the Seductive Witch, must witness it…"
The Seductive Witch stepped out from the bed.
"You have not yet reached your ultimate peak. Wait until you have reached it before we talk. Now be quiet and do not disturb my disciple's comprehension," Li Xuan said as a mysterious aura flashed briefly around him.
The Seductive Witch was greatly shaken, her face extremely grave; this person seemed truly powerful.
She took a deep breath, silently standing in place, madly refining the Heavenly Venerable Divine Soul to enhance her strength, while trying to draw as much power as possible from the Heavenly Grotto.
Although the power that could be drawn from this Heavenly Grotto was limited, stronger by even a bit would still make a difference. Only with greater strength would she have the confidence to deal with this man!
The Seductive Witch's expression was extremely grave; she couldn't fathom why such a powerful person had appeared in the Spiritual Realm, even giving her a sense of unfathomability.
Her gaze flicked over, looking at Xu Yan who was peering intently into the bottom of the Heavenly Grotto, her eyebrows knitting slightly. What was he looking at?
Could he actually comprehend something from the Heavenly Grotto?
Taking a deep breath, a pink lotus flower emerged above her head.
In the center of the lotus, the likeness of the Seductive Witch appeared, the Heavenly Grotto trembling slightly and expanding just a bit.
Threads of pink aura continuously emerged from the bottom of the gray-black Heavenly Grotto, entering into the center of the lotus where the Seductive Witch's true form resided.
Xu Yan silently watched the Heavenly Grotto, a massive grotto that seemed to be underground but was actually in a gray and black cavernous space.
It was like a hole torn in the realm, as pink aura continuously emerged from the bottom of the gray-black Heavenly Grotto, as if transmitting from beyond the world through this hole.
"What is the Heavenly Grotto? Could it be connected through Heaven and Earth, with these auras coming from outside the Domain?"
Xu Yan mused internally.
The understanding of the Void-breaking Realm gradually became clear to him.
"Void-breaking, piercing through the void, shattering the void… Divine Skills are the principles of martial artists, and Physiognomy controls the principles of Heaven and Earth.
"Using one's own principles to penetrate the principles of Heaven and Earth, how to do that?
"It requires the Power of Void-breaking, but how to cultivate this power? Seep through, push open, tear apart, penetrate…"
As his comprehension deepened, Xu Yan's insight into the Void-breaking Realm became clearer and clearer.
Gradually, he had an idea about the Power of Void-breaking.
"The Void-breaking Realm is a major leap, and my master has transcended the Domain, truly a great figure. Even a slight display of his true aura can cause turmoil in the Domain.
"Because my master has surpassed the Domain, and clearly, Void-breaking is a foundation for that transcendence. One must possess the Power of Void-breaking, able to disregard the bonds of spatial Domain, to lay the foundation for surpassing the Domain.
"I see, I'm beginning to understand!"
Xu Yan had an epiphany at that moment; this was what the Void-breaking Realm was.
At this point, many insights surfaced in his mind, and the martial arts techniques of the Void-breaking Realm were almost all sorted out.
"I'll need some time to organize and refine my cultivation technique; then the martial arts techniques of the Void-breaking Realm will truly be comprehended!"
Xu Yan was overjoyed.
This trip was worth it!
Moreover, he had developed a strong interest in the Heavenly Grotto; standing here, he vaguely sensed something extraordinary within it.
It was not the nature's spiritual energy, but an indefinable, indescribable aura.
Coming back to his senses, he looked at the Seductive Witch, whose aura had recovered to its peak, and he turned and headed back to the Evergreen Pavilion.
Seeing that the Seductive Witch's aura had not increased further, having reached its limit, Li Xuan also breathed a sigh of relief.
He was genuinely afraid she would keep increasing in strength until she could oppose him; if he, as a great figure, couldn't suppress her with one hand, it would damage his image.
The reason he didn't stop the Seductive Witch was not simply to show off, but rather the threads of aura emanating from the Heavenly Grotto also helped Xu Yan in his comprehension of the Void-breaking Martial Arts Techniques.
This was the true reason he had not made a move until now.

chapters.title: Chapter 657 - 350 The Descent of the Dragon, Decisively Slaying the Gods
chapters.content:
"How did it go?"
Seeing Xu Yan return, Li Xuan asked with a smile.
"I just need to sort through what I've gained, and then I can have a clear understanding."
Xu Yan said joyfully.
Li Xuan was even happier than him, for it meant that he was about to step into the Void-breaking Realm!
He had taken a crucial step towards transcending the domain!
"Very good!"
Li Xuan nodded in satisfaction.
"Master, there seems to be some extraordinary presence in the Heavenly Grotto, not spiritual energy, and I don't know what it is. I wish to go inside the Heavenly Grotto and take a look, to feel it, and see if there's something to be gained."
Xu Yan said.
Li Xuan nodded his head; he was also curious about the appearance of the Heavenly Grotto and what could have caused it.
Since Xu Yan mentioned that there was an extraordinary presence in the Heavenly Grotto, there might be something to gain, so naturally, he would have to clear the way for his disciple to enter the Heavenly Grotto.
The obstacle, of course, was the Seductive Witch.
For the sake of his grand martial arts endeavor, the Seductive Witch must die!
"I see you've also reached the peak. Are you ready?"
Li Xuan was still sitting in his chair, too lazy even to stand up.
"A Seductive Witch with the strength to kill a Heavenly Venerable, and yet such might doesn't even warrant making this expert stand up and be serious?"
"Truly an expert indeed!"
Fu Tianhai and the others were utterly astounded in their hearts.
"Xu Yan's master is so powerful, truly an unparalleled expert. We must not provoke him, absolutely must not!"
The Thousand Martial Lord fiercely reminded himself in his heart.
At the same time, he felt somewhat relieved that he hadn't taken action personally at the beginning. It was a very wise decision, otherwise, had he acted, the Thousand Martial Hall might have already been wiped out.
He glanced at Fang Hao atop the Evergreen Pavilion, and his heart skipped a beat.
"Fang Hao, is he also a disciple of an expert? With the Wanshi Alliance disrupting the balance of the Spiritual Realm, how should we respond?
"This isn't something my Thousand Martial Hall can handle."
Thinking this, the Thousand Martial Lord was already contemplating how to resolve some of the conflicts with Fang Hao.
Yet the Seductive Witch was uncontrollably furious. The opponent's arrogance, their complete disregard for her, was utterly infuriating.
"I want to see how you plan to kill me, the Seductive Witch. As long as the Heavenly Grotto remains, you can't possibly kill me, even if you are stronger than me!"
Pink brilliance emerged from the Seductive Witch's body.
An unusual aura stirred around, making even the Domain Lingji uncomfortable, as if the nature's spiritual energy was dyed a faint shade of pink.
"So strong!"
Wu Tianan and the others felt a chill in their hearts.
The power displayed by the Seductive Witch at this moment was obviously stronger than when she fought against the Heavenly Venerable.
"Having stepped into this domain, you dream if you think you can banish me completely. My power as the Seductive Witch is infinite. Let's see how you manage to kill me.
"No matter how strong you are, what can you do?"
The Seductive Witch said fearlessly.
Li Xuan looked on indifferently, then glanced at the Heavenly Grotto, pondering.
What the Seductive Witch said wasn't wrong; she wasn't so easily annihilated completely.
But she had encountered himself, an expert whose power was not of the Taicang Domain's martial arts.
"Heavenly Grotto, a gap of heaven and earth. The Seductive Witch came from the Heavenly Grotto—an enemy from beyond?"
Li Xuan suddenly speculated.
He became curious about the Heavenly Grotto; could it provide a glimpse beyond the domain?
"Which Divine Skill should I use?"
Li Xuan immediately became troubled again. Using Law of Heaven and Earth would be powerful and breathtaking but would mean leaving his chair. That didn't match the expert demeanor he embodied, explaining his principles while casually suppressing the Seductive Witch with a flick of his wrist.
"Should I use Sword's Universe?"
Li Xuan immediately dismissed this idea, then settled on the Divine Skill he would use.
Descend of the Dragon God!
A mere wave of his hand and the Dragon God would descend, vanquishing the insignificant, wouldn't that be shocking?
It would also be quite eye-opening for the martial artists of the Spiritual Realm.
"Are you ready? I'm about to make my move," Li Xuan said, disregarding the Seductive Witch's raging fury, indifferently.
"Come then, let's see what power you have to be so arrogant!"
The Seductive Witch sneered coldly.
Pink light surged as a huge pink lotus hovered above her head.
Li Xuan sat in his chair, looking at her with an indifferent gaze, lifted a hand, and made a light pat!
Ao!
As he lightly patted down, an immense force descended, the wind and clouds of the domain changed color, and a dragon cry resounded as if all the beings of the domain trembled at the sound!
Golden light appeared as a Golden Giant Dragon suddenly materialized, its eyes fierce and commanding, looking down at the Seductive Witch without a shred of emotion, indifferently.
The overwhelming dragon might rolled up the clouds of the domain, with thunder manifesting in midair.
Fu Tianhai and the other Spiritual Realm Experts widened their eyes, shivering, their breath seemingly suspended, faces filled with shock!
The overwhelming might of the Golden Giant Dragon made their Divine Souls tremble as if they couldn't even look upon it directly.
"A True Dragon!"
The Seductive Witch too went pale with dread.
The Golden Giant Dragon lifted a claw, the wind, clouds, and thunder entwining it, and struck fiercely.
"I don't believe it!"
The Seductive Witch screamed shrilly, the pink lotus explosively dispersing, attacking the Golden Giant Dragon.
However, the pink light was shattering.
The Golden Giant Dragon, like a Dragon God descending, shattered all defenses and attacks with one claw strike.
Bang!
The might of the dragon surged, its whiskers fluttering; with one strike, the Seductive Witch disintegrated instantly, the pink brilliance, under the sweep of the dragon might, disappeared completely!
Around the domain, there was no longer any trace of the Seductive Witch's presence, only the swirling dragon might, stirring the clouds of the domain.
"The Seductive Witch is dead!"
"Not even the Heavenly Venerable was her match, and after devouring the Heavenly Venerable, the even stronger Seductive Witch has been killed in one strike!"
"Was that the legendary True Dragon?"
"An unparalleled expert, a True Dragon descending with one palm strike, what incredible strength!"

chapters.title: Chapter 658 - 350 The Descent of the Dragon, Ceasing Breath to Slay the Gods_2
chapters.content:
The crowd was stunned.
"This is the Subduing Dragon Palm!"
Xu Yan was also greatly shocked.
"A Divine Skill level of the Subduing Dragon Palm, this is the divine skill of Subduing Dragon Palm!"
Xu Yan felt a burning desire in his heart, wishing that he could immediately break into the Divine Skill Realm and, just like his master, summon a true dragon with a single palm!
"Did master use even one ten-thousandth of his strength?"
Fang Hao murmured to himself.
"What are you saying, master dares not reveal even a wisp of his original breath, for fear of creating a catastrophe of heaven and earth, how could he use one ten-thousandth of his strength?"
Xu Yan corrected seriously.
Meng Chong nodded in deep agreement, "Elder Brother is right, master's palm used no more than one in a trillion parts of his strength!"
Fang Hao felt ashamed, thinking that master had actually used one ten-thousandth of his strength!
Indeed, it was Elder Brother who understood master the most, and only Elder Brother could glimpse a trace of master's true strength!
At this moment, Xu Yan's face was filled with shame, "It's all my fault for not improving my strength fast enough, otherwise, why would master need to take action? Every time master makes a move, he has to suppress himself as much as possible, for fear of bringing a catastrophe to the world, it really is too difficult for master!"
Upon hearing this, Meng Chong and Fang Hao also could not help but show shame on their faces.
It was their incompetence as disciples that they could not deal with such a weak enemy and needed to trouble master to take action.
Wu Tianan and the others: ...
Are they even speaking human language?
They didn't know how to describe the shock in their hearts at this moment.
Li Xuan felt a little embarrassed inside, his disciples were really laying it on thick.
"Fortunately, as a master, my strength is strong enough to maintain such a lofty and unfathomable image of a high personage!"
The crowd looked towards the Heavenly Grotto, where the golden giant dragon had not yet disappeared, circling above the Heavenly Grotto with a golden glint in its eyes.
"Master, is the Seductive Witch dead?"
Su Lingxiu asked excitedly.
"Dead, yet not dead!"
Li Xuan said indifferently.
"What do you mean 'dead, yet not dead'?"
Lingxiu asked, puzzled.
Xu Yan and the others felt the same. Master had annihilated the Seductive Witch with one strike, so how was she not dead?
"The Seductive Witch came from the Heavenly Grotto, her true body is not in the Spiritual Realm."
Li Xuan explained calmly.
"This is not her true body?"
Xu Yan and several others were surprised.
Especially Wu Tianan and the others, even the Heavenly Venerable was devoured, how could such a powerful Seductive Witch not be in her true form?
Li Xuan did not explain, as he waited for the Seductive Witch to reassemble and appear.
Pink light emerged from the Heavenly Grotto.
The silhouette of the Seductive Witch appeared once more, albeit looking somewhat weak, for it was a newly reconstituted body.
"Impressive methods, sir, I will remember you, offending me, the Seductive Witch, comes with no good end!"
The reconstituted Seductive Witch, with a cold gaze, seemed like a different person.
It was as if she had changed her personality.
Li Xuan stood up, walked out from Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship, and said indifferently, "Do you know why I waited for you?"
The Seductive Witch was puzzled.
"I am here to tell you, killing you is not difficult, even across countless spaces, it remains so."
As Li Xuan spoke, a mysterious aura emerged.
The Great Wilderness Physiognomy also appeared.
This Seductive Witch was definitely a Supreme Expert, her true body must be very strong.
It's just that she couldn't come over, that's all.
Therefore, Li Xuan wanted to intimidate her, to instill a sense of dread in her.
As the Great Wilderness Physiognomy emerged, a look of shock appeared in the impassive eyes of the Seductive Witch.
Behind that man, it seemed as if the beginning of heaven and earth, the dawn of chaos, primal, ancient, eternal... Mysteriously unfathomable, as if compared to him, the world itself was insignificant.
Not only was the Seductive Witch shocked!
Wu Tianan and the others were even more stunned; their eyes nearly popped out of their sockets, and their mouths were agape without realizing it, completely stupefied.
"What is this?"
Inside Evergreen Pavilion, Xu Yan and the others were deeply shaken.
Li Xuan slightly raised his hand, and with his movement, the domain shook as if it was about to turn upside down. It was as though the domain itself was going to shatter.
The hand paused momentarily, not continuing to rise, but with a flick of his finger, a wisp of the Seductive Witch's essence fell into his hand.
"This sword is a warning to you!"
Li Xuan said, flicking his finger. The golden giant dragon dived down and instantly tore apart the Seductive Witch, then transformed into a gigantic golden sword that stabbed towards the Heavenly Grotto before vanishing in the blink of an eye.
Annihilation of the Deity Sword!
It directly used a strand of the Seductive Witch's breath to pierce into her true body!
This was a warning.
Li Xuan estimated that although this sword strike was powerful, it might not necessarily manage to slay the Seductive Witch.
However, it was enough to deter her.
He glanced back at the Great Wilderness Physiognomy, shook his head, the mysterious aura receded, and the Great Wilderness Physiognomy disappeared. He returned to the Evergreen Pavilion and sat down on a chair.
Once again, he appeared utterly ordinary.
From the emergence of the Great Wilderness Physiognomy to the hand-raising suppress of the Seductive Witch, only a short time had passed.
Nevertheless, Fu Tianhai and the other Spiritual Realm experts were all appalled, their eyes displaying a dazed look.
What kind of powerful existence was this?
Xu Yan said that even a leak of his master's Domain Origin breath could bring about a cosmic catastrophe; he had thought it was merely boasting about his master, but it turned out to be true!
It was only a casual lifting of a hand, yet the Domain shook as if it were about to collapse.
Such a mighty being was inconceivable!
He had utterly surpassed Xu Yan's understanding of strength!
How difficult it must be for a superior being like him! To save the Spiritual Realm and slay the Seductive Witch, he had no choice but to take action but dared not to use any of his true strength, forcefully suppressing his own cultivation level. One could imagine how helpless the superior being must feel.
At this moment, the Spiritual Realm experts felt as if their horizons had been broadened. There truly existed such terrifying beings in the world, completely exceeding their understanding of the "upper limit" of strength.
"We thank the superior being for saving our Spiritual Realm!"
"The superior being's grace, the Spiritual Realm shall remember for eternity!"
Emperor Da Zhou was the first to kowtow on the ground and loudly call out.
Fu Tianhai and the others also kowtowed on the ground, full of reverence.
In their hearts, they were thrilled. With such a superior being in the Spiritual Realm, they could rest easy. What crisis could there be?
However, the calamities caused by this ordeal in Yun State and Da Ze State were unimaginable and would take a long time to recover from.
"It's a mere trifle,"
Li Xuan said indifferently.
His disciple had said that with just a movement, he could cause the Domain to shake, so of course he had to prove it.
Hence, when he just lifted his hand earlier, although it seemed like the Domain was shaking, it was actually just a direct manipulation of the Heaven and Earth Laws to create an illusion.
Because the turmoil was created using the Heaven and Earth Laws, it felt no different from the actual shaking of the Domain, making it hard to detect the difference.
When it came to understanding the Heaven and Earth Laws, Li Xuan was confident that if he claimed to be second, no one would dare claim to be the first.
Peace returned to the Heavenly Grotto, no pink aura emerged, and the Seductive Witch seemed to have been thoroughly slain.
The Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Boat arrived above the Heavenly Grotto, and everyone looked down to see a gray-black cave that resembled a massive hole with an unknown aura lingering within it.
"A hole in the Domain, is this a space opened within the Realm itself?"
Li Xuan was somewhat astonished.
No wonder Xu Yan was able to comprehend the principles of the Void-breaking Realm inside the Heavenly Grotto, for its existence was like a hole pried open within the void of the Domain.
With a movement, he stepped into the Heavenly Grotto.
His divine sense covered the entire grotto, and that extraordinary aura that Xu Yan had spoken of—Li Xuan had already sensed it. It indeed had a special quality, faintly carrying an indelible charm.
In an instant, strands of aura coalesced.
The invisible, intangible aura swirled around his palm, and Li Xuan quietly observed it. These auras were very unique, as if they could not be refined.
The inability to refine meant that martial artists could not use them and, furthermore, once they entered the body in large quantities, they could have an adverse effect on the martial artist.
"What kind of aura is this?"
Li Xuan was curious in his heart, his gaze shifting towards the bottom of the Heavenly Grotto.
This part of the Heavenly Grotto wasn't very large, but it wasn't small either. Aside from resembling a gray-black cavity with a diffuse extraordinary aura, there was nothing else.
The Seductive Witch too had disappeared.
The bottom of the Heavenly Grotto was neither made of soil nor Heaven and Earth Laws.
"Some kind of barrier, a Domain Barrier perhaps?"
Li Xuan pondered thoughtfully.
Traces of aura were emerging from the bottom of the Heavenly Grotto, and the power of the Seductive Witch had also emerged in this manner.
"Beyond the Domain."
Li Xuan could almost ascertain that the Seductive Witch was an enemy from beyond the Domain.
"A whiff of the Dao Principles, yet not quite complete. This place is a Domain Barrier, obstructing entrance from the outside and also preventing the leakage of Spiritual Energy from within the Domain.
"What exactly is beyond the Domain?
"The Heavenly Grotto resulted from an external impact, allowing outsiders to seep in, but those within the Domain are unable to cross the barrier to the outside.
"Is it both protection to prevent leaking of the Domain's Origin and also a kind of constraint?"
The more Li Xuan sensed the bottom of the Heavenly Grotto, the more unusual he found its existence.

chapters.title: Chapter 659 - 659: 351
chapters.content:
Li Xuan stood at the bottom of the Heavenly Grotto, attempting to sense beyond the Heavenly Grotto, when Xu Yan, Meng Chong, Su Lingxiu, and others also arrived at the Heavenly Grotto, curiously exploring.
First thing, Xu Yan attempted to capture that extraordinary aura, observing it as it swirled around in his palm.
Wu Tianan and a group of Spiritual Realm Experts also cautiously entered, their eyes full of curiosity. What exactly had formed this Heavenly Grotto?
"There's a strange aura here,"
Wu Tianan frowned and said.
"Be careful, I feel that if we absorb this aura, it will linger in the body and might cause some issues,"
Xin Mengrou warned with a grave tone.
Li Xuan felt somewhat helpless within his heart, lacking in strength, unable to sense the situation beyond the Domain.
After all, he was not truly transcendent of the Domain.
"What exactly is this aura?"
The extraordinary aura gathering in his palm became more and more abundant, enveloping his entire palm.
Li Xuan furrowed his brow, his intuition telling him that this aura was no simple matter, as it couldn't be refined, giving him a sense of perpetual existence.
"Should I give it a try?"
A thought flickered in Li Xuan's heart as he looked towards the Daoist Golden Book on the Spirit Pedestal.
Having obtained the information of the Book of Taicang patterns using the Daoist Golden Book, could he also obtain the information of this extraordinary aura?
However, the Daoist Golden Book was on the Spirit Pedestal— he needed to draw a strand of the aura into the Spirit Pedestal and inject it into the Daoist Golden Book to do so.
What would happen if this strand of aura entered the Spirit Pedestal, he could not guarantee.
It was because of this that Li Xuan hesitated.
On the other side, Xu Yan was also sensing this extraordinary aura.
"It's just a strand, it shouldn't cause too much trouble,"
In the end, Li Xuan clenched his teeth and decided to give it a try.
This extraordinary aura was only impossible to refine— a mere strand couldn't possibly cause significant issues. Besides, he possessed so many Divine Skills and ultimately would have ways to expel it from his body.
With this in mind, Li Xuan carefully captured a strand of the aura and introduced it into the Spirit Pedestal.
To prevent any mishaps, his Primordial Spirit had already retreated to a corner of the Spirit Pedestal, defenses fully deployed, and the Daoist Golden Book even more so shielded in front of the Primordial Spirit.
As the aura entered the Spirit Pedestal, Li Xuan immediately saw the Spirit Pedestal tremble slightly, as if with a sense of Chaos, seemingly affected by the aura and vaguely exhaling an aura of eternity and immortality.
Yet Li Xuan did not feel joy at this but instead his heart grew tense, for he perceived that the Spirit Pedestal had become heavy as if a mountain was pressing down upon it.
And there was a feeling that, over time, the Spirit Pedestal might not hold and could collapse.
"This aura, for a martial artist in the Spiritual Realm, once the Divine Soul is tainted, it will be as if a great mountain is pressing down, and eventually, the Divine Soul will become muddled, consciousness scattered,"
Even with the strength of his Spirit Pedestal and the robustness of his Primordial Spirit, he felt a sense of heaviness—let alone the Divine Souls of other Spiritual Realm martial artists.
The Daoist Golden Book flipped open, and Li Xuan channeled that strand of aura into the book.
His gaze remained fixed on the Daoist Golden Book.
A surge of golden light emerged, and the Daoist Golden Book absorbed the strand of aura.
On the pages of the Daoist Golden Book, information emerged;
"Imperishable Qi, undying and imperishable, muddled and chaotic, only the Dao and the initial opening of the Domain can refine it… once it enters a martial artist's Divine Soul, it scatters consciousness, returning to a primal, unenlightened state…"
Imperishable Qi!
Li Xuan was shocked as he read, this Imperishable Qi was extremely special.
Only the Dao and the initial opening of the Domain could refine it, transforming it into the foundation of the Domain, and thus varieties of Spiritual Energy and the like were derived from it.
Once it enters a martial artist's Divine Soul, it would cause consciousness to scatter, reverting to a primal, unenlightened state.
"Is this an aura from beyond the Domain?"
Li Xuan muttered to himself in astonishment.
Imperishable Qi, if it could be used for cultivation, would undoubtedly be a Supreme Treasure, potentially greatly enhancing a martial artist's strength.
However, due to its imperishable nature, thus martial artists were unable to use it for cultivation.
"It's not entirely unusable, though. Taicang Martial Arts may not work, but that doesn't mean my martial arts won't work. Even if it doesn't now, I could devise a method, right?
"Moreover, Imperishable Qi at this stage is not entirely unusable, as long as it is not introduced into the Spirit Pedestal or Primordial Spirit."
Li Xuan, considering the information given out by the Daoist Golden Book, was bursting with ideas.
Imperishable Qi might not be used for cultivation to improve one's cultivation level, but it could be used to cultivate Divine Skills.
Not just Divine Skills, but also Prohibitions and such were possible applications.
Li Xuan divided the Imperishable Qi on his hand into fine strands, and with a flick of his fingers, he turned Imperishable Qi into a Prohibition and embedded it at the bottom of the Heavenly Grotto.
This was an experiment, applying Imperishable Qi to a Prohibition.
Hum!
As the Prohibition, drawn with Imperishable Qi, entered the bottom of the Heavenly Grotto, in an instant, that area at the bottom seemed as if sealed.
"Indeed, my idea was correct,"
Li Xuan was inwardly pleased; just because Taicang Martial Arts couldn't achieve it, did not mean his martial arts couldn't.
The power of Divine Origin, indeed, was more wondrous than the force of Taicang Martial Arts.
The Prohibition outlined with Imperishable Qi was more potent and more challenging forcibly to break due to the nature of Imperishable Qi.
To breach this seal, one must understand its trick, to unlock the seal; otherwise, overpowering it would require a force far beyond the sealer's tremendous strength.
Li Xuan looked at the permeating Imperishable Qi within the Heavenly Grotto—this Imperishable Qi was all surging up from the bottom of the grotto, and it wasn't continuously emerging. Once a certain amount of Imperishable Qi was reached, it would maintain a balance and would no longer continue to surge forth.

chapters.title: Chapter 660 - 351 Imperishable Qi_2
chapters.content:
Only if the Imperishable Qi of the Heavenly Grotto was consumed, would it continue to emerge to replenish and form a balance.
Furthermore, Imperishable Qi would not flow out of the Heavenly Grotto.
Glancing at Xu Yan, the eldest disciple was pondering over the Imperishable Qi, while Wu Tianan and others were curiously exploring the grotto.
"Once the Imperishable Qi enters the Divine Soul, it will dissipate consciousness, return to a state of unenlightened, unawakened mind..."
Li Xuan reminded aloud.
"Imperishable Qi?"
Xu Yan was startled, saying curiously, "Master, I feel that the Imperishable Qi seems somewhat special, as if it cannot be refined, but it is also extraordinary..."
The rest were alarmed, hastily containing their spirits for fear of absorbing the Imperishable Qi.
"The uses of Imperishable Qi are too numerous; although it cannot be refined like Spiritual Energy to enhance one's Cultivation Realm, it can still be used to cultivate Divine Skills, establish Prohibitions, and so on..."
Li Xuan briefly introduced.
The rest, he did not continue to explain, leaving it to his disciples to ponder.
"There are such benefits?"
Fang Hao was overjoyed and began to fumble with jars, preparing to collect Imperishable Qi.
"Can it be used for Alchemy?"
Su Lingxiu's eyes lit up.
"Yes, and no."
Li Xuan said indifferently, not closing off the possibility.
He suddenly thought of his own Alchemical Medical Martial Arts Divine Skill, the Divine Furnace of All Paths, which could melt all paths of Domain and wondered whether it could also melt Imperishable Qi?
Theoretically speaking, if it could melt even Paths, why not Imperishable Qi?
Imperishable Qi would only disperse when the Domain first opened or during the creation of Paths, and since the Divine Furnace of All Paths could refine all paths of Domain, in theory, it could also refine Imperishable Qi.
"It should be possible, but with my current strength, using the Divine Furnace of All Paths is insufficient to refine Imperishable Qi," Li Xuan concluded internally.
Xu Yan and others were collecting Imperishable Qi, preparing to cultivate Divine Skills.
Wu Tianan and other Spiritual Realm Martial Artists felt helpless with this; they could not utilize it and did not even know what Divine Skills were.
The concept of Divine Skills was unheard of in Spiritual Realm Martial Arts.
As Li Xuan walked through the Heavenly Grotto, suddenly, he kicked against something.
The grotto appeared to be a cave, but it was actually shaded with grey and black and bore no plant life, and the walls of the grotto were smooth, as though untouched by dust.
Curious about kicking something in such an environment, Li Xuan looked down.
It was a fist-sized, grey-black stone.
"This stone is somewhat special."
With a gesture from his hand, the stone fell into his palm.
Although it was only the size of a fist, it was as heavy as a great mountain.
Moreover, the stone had a similar quality to Imperishable Qi, giving a sense of imperishability and indestructibility.
"Imperishable stone?"
Li Xuan silently pocketed the stone.
He planned to test if he could refine it with the Divine Furnace of All Paths upon returning, to see if he could melt the stone.
"With my current realm, it's likely I cannot refine an Imperishable stone. Once I'm able to, it will also mean that I can refine Imperishable Qi."
Li Xuan mused to himself.
In the Heavenly Grotto, apart from this one Imperishable stone and Imperishable Qi, there was nothing particularly special.
As Xu Yan and the others continuously collected Imperishable Qi, the base of the grotto began to see more Qi flowing in.
"What's different about the site of the Heavenly Cave Ruins that the prodigies went to?" Wu Tianan asked Xin Mengrou curiously.
"That Heavenly Cave Ruin is very ancient; it's a mystery from which era it remains. It's much larger than this place.
"There are Divine Artifacts in the Spiritual Realm, and apart from several places in Azure Sea, only the Heavenly Cave Ruins of the Eighteen States have such artifacts.
"Moreover, the Divine Artifacts within the ruins are quite special; the materials needed to forge Divine Artifacts are all excavated from the ruins.
"However, after countless explorations, the Heavenly Cave Ruins today probably don't have much opportunity left."
Xin Mengrou explained.
The Heavenly Cave Ruins of the Spiritual Realm were the secret of the Transcendent Spirit Sect. Even though access was restricted each time, after numerous explorations, the ruins no longer held much opportunity.
While collecting Imperishable Qi, Xu Yan spoke up, "It would be good to see how that site differs from this grotto."
Li Xuan was also curious about how the Spiritual Realm's Heavenly Cave Ruins differed from this one.
This grotto had hosted the powerful entity known as the Seductive Witch.
Had a similar entity appeared in the other ruins but was suppressed?
Turning it into a ruin?
"This grotto still has the potential to be infiltrated, it must be sealed," Li Xuan thought.
If his guess was correct, and the Seductive Witch was an enemy from beyond this world, infiltrating through the grotto, then, even though the witch was dead, there could be other entities from beyond this world that could penetrate into the Spiritual Realm.
Given the relatively weak strength of the Spiritual Realm, it definitely could not handle enemies like the Seductive Witch.
Thus, as Li Xuan walked along the base of the grotto, he began drawing upon Imperishable Qi to form Prohibition glyphs, sealing the base of the grotto.
Xu Yan and the others, having collected enough Imperishable Qi, ceased their efforts.
"What is Master doing?" Meng Chong asked curiously.
"Sealing the Heavenly Grotto!" Fang Hao said, eyes unwavering.
The Master was using Imperishable Qi, tracing it into Prohibition glyphs to seal the base of the grotto!
"So, Imperishable Qi can also be employed in this way."

chapters.title: Chapter 661 - 351 Imperishable Qi_3
chapters.content:
Fang Hao's mind began to teem with activity.
"Thanks to the senior's intervention, or else the Spiritual Realm would have been in danger,"
Wu Tianan lamented with a sigh.
"Did the senior seal the bottom of the Heavenly Grotto to prevent the emergence of entities like the Seductive Witch?"
"That should be the case."
Once the bottom of the Heavenly Grotto was sealed off, except for the Imperishable Qi, which could still flow in, every other force would be blocked and sealed outside.
Li Xuan twirled the Jade Ruyi in one hand as he confidently walked out of the Heavenly Grotto.
There was nothing of value left inside the Heavenly Grotto.
With this, the crisis of Ice State's Heavenly Grotto was considered resolved.
Upon returning to the Evergreen Pavilion, Li Xuan sat casually in his chair, his thoughts, however, were focused on the direction of future Martial Arts and some speculations about realms beyond the Domain.
Xu Yan and his fellow disciples also returned to the Evergreen Pavilion one after another.
Wu Tianan and others also came out of the Heavenly Grotto; Xin Mengrou, Emperor Da Zhou, and other figures dispatched elders to Yun State and Da Ze State to handle the aftermath of the catastrophe.
"The result of the contest of the proud scions is out, now we set out for the Heavenly Cave Ruins,"
Fu Tianhai spoke in a deep voice.
"I agree!"
Lord Leiyun nodded.
None of the others had any objections, including the Thousand Martial Lord.
After this incident, the Thousand Martial Lord and other powerhouses all adopted a more low-key approach, no longer daring to raise the issues they had with Xu Yan.
They even feared attracting Xu Yan's attention.
They sought out Fang Hao privately to negotiate peace.
With such a high-level entity existing in the Spiritual Realm, and Fang Hao being the apprentice of that entity, a shift in the structure of the Spiritual Realm was a foregone conclusion.
Continuing to antagonize could provoke the entity's displeasure, and the Thousand Martial Hall would be destroyed.
One should remember, even a Mighty Heavenly Venerable was killed by the Seductive Witch, and yet, that same witch, stronger than when she killed the Heavenly Venerable, was obliterated with a mere gesture from the entity.
The difference in strength was simply too vast.
The matters in Yun State, Ice State, and Da Ze State would naturally be handled by various supreme Spirit Sects, with the Wanshi Alliance also participating.
As proud scions listed in the top four, Xu Yan and his disciples were naturally entitled to enter the Heavenly Cave Ruins. They were all very curious about the Heavenly Cave Ruins in the Spiritual Realm, wanting to see how they differed from those in Ice State.
The Flying Boat left Ice State, and under Fu Tianhai's leadership, they headed towards the Heavenly Cave Ruins.
The ruins of the Heavenly Grotto in the Spiritual Realm were located beneath a coastal cliff in Hongzhou, tens of thousands of miles from the battleground of the supreme scions.
"The Heavenly Cave Ruins can be entered only at certain times. Although some time is still required before the next entrance opportunity, we can activate it early and enter now,"
Having arrived at the location of the Heavenly Grotto, there was no grotto to be seen beneath the cliff, which Fu Tianhai explained.
"Is this the Heavenly Cave Ruins?"
Li Xuan immediately spotted the location of the Heavenly Grotto. This particular Heavenly Cave Ruins had been locked by a convergence of Domain Lingji, sealing off the entrance of the Heavenly Grotto with the Power of Domain Laws.
Periodically, the Domain Lingji would disperse slightly, the Power of Domain Laws would relax, and the entrance to the Heavenly Grotto would reveal itself.
This was an artificial seal.
Such a feat couldn't possibly be accomplished by an ordinary Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable.
"A technique arranged by a Martial Artist beyond the realm of Condensation Law,"
Li Xuan surmised in his heart.
With a flick of his finger, the entrance to the Heavenly Grotto appeared.
This grotto was over ten times larger than the one in Ice State, and that was just the entrance.
"Let's go in,"
Li Xuan said indifferently.
The Flying Boat directly entered the Heavenly Cave Ruins. Fu Tianhai, Emperor Da Zhou, and the others had no choice but to hurriedly follow. The rule that only scions could enter seemed to no longer apply.
After all, it wasn't themselves who were breaking the rules.
Moreover, the so-called rules don't apply to high-level entities; the rules of the high-level entities are the true rules.

chapters.title: Chapter 662 - 352 Heavenly Cave Ruins, Blood Spirit Remnants
chapters.content:
```
The Heavenly Cave Ruins in Hongzhou were much larger than those in Ice State, just without the sensation of a heavenly or earthy hole, feeling more like a real underground cavern.
You could even see soil, sandstone, and some small hills.
In the seemingly gloomy Heavenly Cave, there was also some light, as if the break of dawn, a state of gray mist.
"The bottom of the Heavenly Cave has stopped the influx of Imperishable Qi, and it has solidified, with the power of Dao Principles condensing, as if the Domain Barrier had sealed it off completely.
"It is because of this that it has become a ruin."
Li Xuan's gaze turned toward the bottom of the Heavenly Cave, and he felt he had found his answer.
The reason it had become a ruin was exactly because the Heavenly Cave had been completely sealed off, with the appearance of soil and sandstone, and without the influx of Imperishable Qi.
The Domain Barrier was solid, and the essence from outside the Domain could no longer infiltrate.
"The remaining Imperishable Qi is very sparse, but it has also affected the Heavenly Cave, which is the reason for the birth of divine objects."
Li Xuan observed the Heavenly Cave Ruins.
Xu Yan and the others had already started exploring the ruins of the Heavenly Cave, and the other prodigies who had entered were searching around, feeling very curious about the Heavenly Cave Ruins.
Wu Tianan strolled leisurely, walking through the ruins of the Heavenly Cave, equally filled with curiosity.
Once the head of the Wanxing Martial Academy and a peak existence in the Spiritual Realm, he was surprisingly ignorant about the Heavenly Cave Ruins.
This indicated that the Heavenly Cave Ruins were a core secret of the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
Starting from the request for the Heavenly Venerable to come to Thousand Martial Hall, Wu Tianan realized that the Transcendent Spirit Sect had a powerful backing.
It was as if the Transcendent Spirit Sect was actually a subordinate sect of some forces in the Spiritual Realm.
What exactly was on the other side of the Divine Bridge?
The Heavenly Venerables came from beyond the Divine Bridge, and the main task of the Transcendent Spirit Sect was to find and cultivate Spirit Body Prodigies.
In the vast Spiritual Realm, Spirit Body Prodigies were extremely rare.
These Spirit Body Prodigies would eventually be sent to where the Divine Bridge lies, entering the powerhouses they belong to.
Only by going to the other side of the Divine Bridge could one break through the realm of Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable.
Suddenly, Wu Tianan paused in his steps.
He looked at the small hill in front of him with surprise and skepticism.
"What is this?"
The hill wasn't large; it was no higher than two zhang and only about five or six zhang in circumference, and Wu Tianan discovered some peculiarities on the hill.
Traces left by humans!
These traces were inconspicuous, and only someone familiar with them could recognize that they were man-made!
"Did he come to the Heavenly Cave Ruins? How did he slip past the Transcendent Spirit Sect and get in? Is this a message left for me?"
Wu Tianan frowned.
He thought of one person from these traces.
The Blood Demon, Blood Spirit Child!
Once a prodigy of the Wanxing Martial Academy, and the one he had once considered as a successor to the position of the head.
Only, the world is unpredictable, and the Blood Spirit Child ended up taking a path of slaughter.
Even though he was mad and committed unparalleled killings, the Blood Demon never struck against the Wanxing Martial Academy, nor did he purposefully target it.
All these signified that in his heart, there was still some reminiscence.
Perhaps, it was out of sentiment for his position as the head of the academy.
Wu Tianan's mind drifted, as if returning to those years, to the unyielding youth, to the one who swore to rise up, the youth who promised to make his abandoning family regret their decision.
He sighed in his heart, lifting his hand to trace the subtle marks, repeatedly slicing downwards.
Fine crevices began to appear on the hill, growing deeper into it.
At a certain moment, Wu Tianan's eyebrows raised, as he actually found something left behind.
A small box, which he extracted by following the traces.
The box was a pale red, as if stained by fresh blood, with several thin silk threads wrapped around it, as if arranged in a certain way.
If not for following the traces to extract the box, directly digging into the hill would have caused the box to instantly shatter, destroying whatever was inside.
"What have you left for me?"
Wu Tianan was curious.
The Blood Spirit Child had fallen and risen three times, and no one knew that one of those times, it was Wu Tianan who had saved him.
As for the other two, how he rose up again, Wu Tianan was also unaware.
Especially that last time, when the Blood Spirit Child turned into the Blood Demon, refining martial artists with Blood Refining, slaughtering countless, provoking the combined assassination attempt by the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
Moreover, the Blood Spirit Child's strength at that time seemed to have reached the limit of the Spiritual Realm, surpassing him at that time!
Wu Tianan, gripped by curiosity, opened the box.
The pale red box contained something that was also a dark red, as if stained by fresh blood.
Inside the box was a dark red pearl, seemingly condensed from essence blood, exuding a malevolent aura, yet seemingly harboring a vendetta within.
Beneath the red pearl was a small booklet.
The pale red booklet was made of some type of leather.
Wu Tianan took out the booklet.
"That recorded inside, could it be the Blood Refining Method?"
Wu Tianan furrowed his brows, for the Blood Spirit Child's Blood Refining Method was exceptionally malicious, a true demonic cultivation technique and, in the history of the Spiritual Realm, the real sense of a demonic cultivation method.
"You should know that no matter how powerful this cultivation technique is, I would not cultivate it," he murmured to himself.
"Could it be that you think this technique can breach the limits of the Spiritual Realm? Do you think that when I feel stagnant and desperate, I would also cultivate this demonic method?"
Apart from this reason, Wu Tianan really couldn't fathom why the Blood Spirit Child would think he would cultivate such a demonic cultivation technique.
He flipped open the booklet and looked at the small print on the first page.
"What is this?"
The first page held words left by the Blood Spirit Child.
"I don't know if the headmaster will be able to come here, find this box... but I think it's time I left something behind.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 663 - 352 Heavenly Cave Ruins, Blood Spirit Remnants_2
chapters.content:
"I am no longer myself, for the opportunity I received came from beyond the heavens and the earth.
"The Hundred Prison Blood Refining Skill is indeed a powerful cultivation technique, capable of breaking through the limits of Spiritual Realm Martial Arts and advancing to higher realms, but this path is paved with blood..."
Wu Tianan found his heart growing more and more apprehensive as he continued reading, his expression increasingly solemn.
The rise and fortune of the Blood Spirit Child was so unimaginably bizarre.
Came from beyond the heavens and the earth?
At this moment, he thought of the Seductive Witch from the Heavenly Cave Ruins in the Ice State.
Could it be that the Blood Spirit Child encountered a being similar to the Seductive Witch, which led to his ascent?
The Hundred Prison Blood Refining Technique cultivates with blood essence, allowing one to disregard the limits of Spiritual Realm Martial Arts and breakthrough continuously.
There was even more important information above.
"I am no longer myself!"
What did this mean?
Had the Blood Spirit Child been parasitized?
Wu Tianan furrowed his brows, recalling the Blood Spirit Child's deeds. Although wild and unmatched in slaughter, there had been no signs of parasitism.
"Could it be that practicing the Hundred Prison Blood Refining Skill leads to a drastic change in one's nature?"
Wu Tianan pondered.
Continuing to read, the messages left by the Blood Spirit Child were not many, just a brief mention of the fortune he had encountered, which was also due to a coincidence that led him to these Heavenly Grotto Ruins.
More importantly, when he entered the Heavenly Grotto Ruins, it wasn't at a time when the ruins were open to access, but at that time the ruins underwent some anomalies.
There appeared a small black hole, and the Blood Spirit Child had been sucked into it by a force.
According to the Blood Spirit Child, he met a strange remnant soul.
A blood-colored remnant soul turned into a bracelet and was worn on his wrist. That was the opportunity of his rise and how he acquired the Hundred Prison Blood Refining Skill from the remnant soul.
This remnant soul claimed to come from beyond the world, an entity that has transcended the limits of the heavens and the earth, and this strand of remnant soul was merely a trace of its power that entered this domain from beyond the heavens and the earth.
The Blood Spirit Child's second defeat was also related to this remnant soul. The Blood Spirit Child was ruthless, and he eventually trapped and refined this strand of remnant soul!
As for what he gained after refining the remnant soul, the Blood Spirit Child did not reveal much.
Wu Tianan looked at the blood-red pearl,
"Netherworld Blood Orb? What's its use?"
This pearl, named the Netherworld Blood Orb, its purpose was not mentioned by the Blood Spirit Child.
"If your bones still exist, should I bury you with the Netherworld Blood Orb?"
Wu Tianan muttered to himself.
Whether the remains of the Blood Demon still exist in the Inner Domain, only Xin Mengrou would know.
"Could you possibly revive yourself with this?"
Wu Tianan shook his head and chuckled.
"You are no longer the person you once were; do you think I would fulfill your last wish?"
Wu Tianan sighed.
The information left by the Blood Spirit Child had some unusual details. Regardless of the ultimate goal, Wu Tianan would not bury the Netherworld Blood Orb with the Blood Spirit Child.
He turned to the second page of the booklet.
"Above the Divine Refinement Celestials are those in the Condensation Law Realm, condensing the Heaven and Earth Laws into the body, they are called Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables; above the Condensation Law are those in the Truth Refinement Realm, not yet truly integrated with the condensed laws, refining the Heaven and Earth Laws into one with the body, they are called True King Heavenly Venerables; above the Truth Refinement Realm is the Immortal Realm, becoming one with the domain, assuming the honor of controlling a realm of heavens and earth, living as long as the world itself, hence named Immortal Heavenly Venerable..."
The second page introduced the realms above the Divine Refinement Celestials, which were the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable, True King Heavenly Venerable, and Immortal Heavenly Venerable. The realms of Truth Refinement and Immortality were unheard of by Wu Tianan.
However, he had seen a Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable before.
Although that Heavenly Venerable was slain by the Seductive Witch, there was no denying the imposing might of the Heavenly Venerable, truly powerful without equal.
"So, when the Heavenly Venerable spoke of summoning the True King, he meant calling upon a Heavenly Venerable of the Truth Refinement Realm."
What kind of existence then, is an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, one who lives as long as the heavens and the earth?
"However, even being immortal, they have not yet transcended the domain of heaven and earth."
The senior, however, was an existence that transcended heaven and earth; in front of such a predecessor, even an Immortal Heavenly Venerable would not count for much.
Wu Tianan continued to read. What followed was the Hundred Prison Blood Refining Skill cultivation technique, and the more he read, the more he trembled with fear, truly demonic in nature, exceptionally cruel.
He read only a third of it before he could no longer continue.
Too cruel, too brutal.
"Refining the blood of living beings in the Spiritual Realm, one may attain immortality!"
This was the message given by the Blood Spirit Child. Originally, he refined the blood of all living beings, exterminating one Spirit Sect family after another, refining city after massive city.
"The Blood Spirit Child must have already broken through the Condensation Law Realm back then."
According to deductions, having refined so many martial artists, so many great cities, the Blood Spirit Child must have transcended the Condensation Law Realm, surpassing the limits of Spiritual Realm Martial Arts.
Wu Tianan took a deep breath and returned the booklet and the Netherworld Blood Orb back into the box.
"This box, I should present it to the senior."
Wu Tianan sighed, such a demonic cultivation technique should be kept by the predecessor.
With this thought, Wu Tianan arrived at the Evergreen Pavilion.
"Senior, this is what I discovered, an item left behind by the Blood Spirit Child from years past. It contains demonic cultivation techniques, and I entrust it to the senior for disposal."
He respectfully lifted the box and said.
"Hmm."
Li Xuan's eyebrows raised slightly. What was the deal with this Blood Spirit Child, leaving behind some objects in these Heavenly Cave Ruins?
Raising his hand, he summoned the box into his palm. Without opening it to look inside, he seemingly disinterestedly stowed it away.
Wu Tianan excused himself and left to find Xin Mengrou, to inquire about how the Transcendent Spirit Sect had driven the Blood Spirit Child into the Inner Domain during the calamity of the Blood Demon.
Inside the Heavenly Cave Ruins, only Li Xuan sat calmly in the Evergreen Pavilion, while the others were curiously exploring the relics around them.
Xu Yan suddenly came to a halt.
He gazed at a grey-black withered tree, deep in thought.
And at that moment, a soft voice reached his ear, carrying a hint of temptation as if calling out to him.
"Youngster, to arrive here is your fortune. Pass the trial, and you shall receive the Immortal inheritance."
The voice originated from that small tree.
"Immortal inheritance?"
Xu Yan was filled with curiosity.
"Yes! Youngster, perhaps you don't understand what Immortal means? Above Condensation Law is Truth Refinement, and above Truth Refinement, there is Immortality.
"The Immortal ones blend with the Domain, their life spans equal to that of the Domain… Such is an Immortal Heavenly Venerable!"
The voice continued to reach him, its temptation growing stronger.
If it were any other genius of the Spiritual Realm, they might have been swayed by the temptation, but such tricks were useless against Xu Yan.
"To only live as long as the Domain?"
Xu Yan asked in surprise.
The voice paused, wondering what this young man meant.
"Immortality lies in existing forever with the undying Domain, this is the pinnacle of Martial Arts, young man..."
The tempting voice resumed speaking.
"To be called the pinnacle of Martial Arts without transcending the Domain?"
Xu Yan expressed doubt!
The tempting voice fell silent for a moment, this young man's aspiration seemed a bit too extravagant!
"How could one transcend the Domain? Young man, do not aim too high; achieving Immortality is already the pinnacle of Martial Arts..."
Xu Yan nodded and said, "You're right, one mustn't aim too high, it's better to be practical. So, do you have any divine objects?"
The tempting voice was silenced once again.
This is just too practical!
Demanding divine objects straight away?
"Why are you silent now? Are you deceiving people? You don't actually have any inheritance, do you?"
Xu Yan frowned as he said this.
"Young man, you may leave. Your comprehension is poor, not suitable for this inheritance."
The tempting voice spoke up.
Xu Yan silently drew his sword, stepped towards the small tree, and struck it with a slash!
Crack!
The small tree split, and a faint trace of blood-red light emerged from the trunk, turning into a ferocious face.
However, the face looked bemusedly at Xu Yan.
Drawing a sword without a word?
"A Remnant Soul?"
Xu Yan's eyebrows raised as he slashed with his sword in hand.
Sudden Annihilation Sword!
"Wait..."
The ferocious face, now with a look of utter fear, hurriedly spoke.
But it was too late!
With a single sword strike, a 'puff' sound was heard as the face disintegrated, the Remnant Soul completely dissipated under the might of the Sudden Wind Sword Intent.
"Not a Remnant Soul of a Spiritual Realm Martial Artist."
Xu Yan thoughtfully excavated the small tree, and there at the root hung a blood-red pearl the size of a fingertip.
"What is this? It seems like it could enhance the power of flesh and blood."
Xu Yan collected the blood-red pearl and planted his Longsword into the ground, unleashing the Sudden Wind Sword Intent.
Boom!
Centered on the small tree, a storm swept through, as if a tempest of Sudden Wind Sword Intent engulfed the area within hundreds of feet.
Puff!
Ten feet away, a blood light emerged, forming a human face which looked somewhat bewildered.
"Kid, you're going too far, I am—" the face was cut off mid-sentence as it was utterly exterminated by the Sudden Wind Sword Intent storm.
