chapters.title: Chapter 664 - 353: Annihilating the Remnant Soul, The Far Side of the Divine Bridge
chapters.content:
"Indeed, they are all cunning and deceitful, one cannot be careless, or he would have escaped."
Xu Yan nodded; these remnant souls being able to survive until now naturally wasn't simple.
Fortunately, he had been cautious enough to completely annihilate the other party.
In the Heavenly Cave Ruins, the existence of such remnant souls meant that someone must have encountered them before, and perhaps had been misled by them.
Xu Yan searched the surroundings for a while longer to make sure nothing was missed, then continued his exploration.
The Heavenly Cave Ruins were not considered large, but they were not small either.
A meticulous exploration would take several days to complete.
"Huh?"
Suddenly, he discovered a skull buried under loose soil, which was even more bizarre; it was blood-red as if it had been soaked in fresh blood.
With a wave of his hand, the skull floated up.
"Finally, I've been waiting for you!"
A faint red flame flickered within the eye sockets of the skull, emitting a sighing sound.
"I have been in silence for a long time, just waiting for a fated person to inherit my legacy…"
"Are there divine objects among these treasures?"
Xu Yan interrupted the other party and asked.
"Divine objects? What are they worth? Young man, don't set your sights too low. As long as you obtain my inheritance, not to mention divine objects, even the supreme treasures of the domain are at your disposal…"
The skull said proudly.
Xu Yan drew his sword. Surrounded by Sudden Wind Sword Intent, he said calmly, "Stop babbling, don't beat around the bush. Without divine objects, go to your death. As for your inheritance, I'm not interested!"
The skull was taken aback; how could this young man be so impatient and shortsighted?
Could it be that it had misjudged him?
"Young man, do you know who I am? Missing my inheritance will be the greatest regret of your life. All for some measly divine object..."
Xu Yan couldn't be bothered to listen any longer, swinging his sword directly to cut it down!
"Wait!"
The skull hurriedly spoke up.
"Speak!"
Xu Yan's sword stopped less than three inches above the skull.
"There are divine objects; my skull is a divine object. Once you accept my inheritance, you can have my divine object..."
Crack!
The skull was split open by a single strike, and the leaping red flame seemed to show a hint of bewilderment.
Why did the strike come so suddenly?
"What is this?"
He was immediately startled.
Whoosh!
Like a howling gust of wind, the red flame hadn't had the chance to say anything more before it was completely extinguished.
Xu Yan drove his sword into the ground, with the storm of Sudden Wind Sword Intent sweeping across all directions. Only after ensuring that no remnant souls were hiding did he sheathe his sword.
"What's up with these remnant souls?"
Xu Yan pondered.
Whether it was the remnant soul on the small tree earlier or this skull remnant soul, they exerted a kind of seductive power while speaking, aiming to bewilder people's minds.
He thought about the other exceptional talents who had entered the Heavenly Cave Ruins; if they encountered such remnant souls, they might easily be beguiled.
"With Master here, even if I were beguiled, it wouldn't become a serious issue."
Xu Yan continued his exploration.
Above the Evergreen Pavilion, Li Xuan suddenly looked towards the Heavenly Cave Ruins, showing a contemplative expression.
"These remnant souls, how odd it is that they all like to approach Xu Yan?"
No one else had encountered remnant souls like Xu Yan did. Among all the people, only Xu Yan had come across them.
It seemed the remnant souls were specifically targeting Xu Yan.
"These remnant souls don't belong to multiple people, but to one person, and..."
Li Xuan took a deep breath, harboring some speculations.
The remnant souls of the Heavenly Cave Ruins all belonged to one person, and they could not even be called remnant souls, but divided souls!
Some powerful being had divided its soul within the Heavenly Cave Ruins and, after suffering grave injuries, split into multiple remnant souls, existing in a unique way.
Furthermore, these remnant souls could not leave the Heavenly Cave Ruins.
Should they leave the Heavenly Cave Ruins, they would be obliterated by the Heaven and Earth Laws.
"Foreign invaders?"
Li Xuan suddenly became intrigued. If there were remnant souls present, couldn't he just capture one and interrogate it to learn the situation?
"Here comes another one aiming for Xu Yan; so keen on eyeing my disciple, are you?"
Li Xuan reached out with his hand, and a giant palm descended from the sky, aiming for the newly emerged remnant soul.
Xu Yan watched the leaping pearl in front of him, enveloped by the aura of a remnant soul, about to take action and annihilate it, when he saw his master intervene.
Above the Evergreen Pavilion, Li Xuan sat leisurely in a chair.
The small Great Wilderness Physiognomy appeared above his head, and a mysterious aura surged around him.
A pale red pearl hovered in front of him, spinning round and round, and suddenly a human face emerged on the pearl.
The face was filled with shock.
"Who are you?"
The face on the pearl asked in a deep voice.
"Speak, why target my disciple."
Li Xuan, however, looked indifferently at the face and asked.
The face on the pearl tensed up, frowning deeply as he said, "Since he's your disciple, let's leave things as they are, shall we?"
"Ha!"
Li Xuan chuckled lightly. "Speak plainly and clearly, there might still be room for negotiation. Otherwise, your soul power won't need to exist anymore."
"Why must you do this, sir? I merely noticed your disciple is quite unique, different from the martial artists of this domain, and thus I was simply curious."
The face spoke with a somewhat cowardly tone.
"Is that all?"
Li Xuan looked at him dispassionately, "Explain properly—identity, background, intentions—all of it."
The face fell silent.
"Sir, I can't afford to provoke you, let's just drop it."
The face suddenly began to disintegrate, disintegrating instantly into nothingness.
Choosing to self-destruct rather than reveal anything, it preferred not to provoke Li Xuan, a presence that seemed unfathomable in its eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 665 - 353: Destroying the Remnant Soul, the Other Side of the Divine Bridge_2
chapters.content:
```
Hide one's identity as much as possible to avoid the original body from being targeted.
"Quite resolute!"
Li Xuan had no regrets about this.
The other party was clearly no ordinary martial artist. Since they chose self-demise, and did not want to offend him, it was evident that his aura of Great Wilderness divinity + mysterious presence had intimidated the other party.
"If you are going to self-demise, why still hide your remaining soul power?"
Li Xuan's gaze turned towards the Heavenly Cave Ruins, raising a hand and gently pointing.
Whoosh!
A breeze swept through the entire Heavenly Cave Ruins, drawing out all remnant souls at this moment, causing them to disintegrate and dissipate in the wind.
"Your Excellency..."
A voice arose, only to fall silent immediately after.
Li Xuan's gaze was indifferent. Since he couldn't get any information out of them and they were of no value, why keep them?
Naturally, he swept them away with a wave of his hand.
The exploration of the Heavenly Cave Ruins came to an end.
The gains were minimal, almost nonexistent.
As for those remnant souls, they were thoroughly eradicated. This spot of the Heavenly Cave Ruins would not have anything special about it for a long time to come.
Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship emerged from the Heavenly Cave Ruins, with Fu Tianhai and other experts from the Spiritual Realm, as well as a crowd of prodigies, also leaving the ruins.
"The Divine Bridge will open in two years. When it opens, we can enter the other side of the Divine Bridge," said Emperor Da Zhou.
As for how the Divine Bridge would open and its existence, they knew nothing.
Although they knew of the land on the other side of the Divine Bridge, they did not understand what it was like there.
The existence of the Transcendent Spirit Sect was to mine the Spirit Body Prodigies, cultivate them to the limit of the Spiritual Realm, and then send them into the beyond of the Divine Bridge.
By doing so, they established their merits. When the time came, they too could go to the other side of the Divine Bridge.
The power structure of the Spiritual Realm was also decided by the forces belonging to the other side of the Divine Bridge. Now that the structure of the Spiritual Realm had been broken, and behind Fang Hao was an unfathomable existence.
Thus, the Transcendent Spirit Sect could only negotiate with the Wanshi Alliance to re-determine the structure of the Spiritual Realm.
As for opinions on the other side of the Divine Bridge after it opens, that was no longer something they could deal with. By then, the decisions would naturally be made by even stronger entities.
"City Lord Fu, a small Heavenly Grotto has appeared in the Azure Sea's Black Abyss; I once had an epiphany there..." said Xu Yan, looking at Fu Tianhai.
"What?"
Fu Tianhai and others' expressions changed dramatically.
The emergence of the Heavenly Grotto in Ice State had already caused such a tremendous disaster.
Was there also a Heavenly Grotto in the Azure Sea?
"In the Black Abyss of the Azure Sea?"
Fu Tianhai's expression became grave.
This was a dangerous place, easy to enter but difficult to find one's way out.
"Exactly!"
Xu Yan nodded, recounting how he discovered the grotto in the Black Abyss and concluded, "Near the Heavenly Grotto, I placed a guide pearl. It should be possible to find it, without getting lost easily."
Fu Tianhai and others frowned deeply; they had no understanding of any guide pearl.
It was surely another one of Fang Hao's strokes.
They then looked towards Fang Hao.
"Alliance Leader Fang, about the Heavenly Grotto in the Black Abyss of the Azure Sea..."
Fang Hao said solemnly, "It concerns the safety of the Spiritual Realm. My Wanshi Alliance cannot shirk the responsibility. I will go there shortly to set up a Great Formation and seal off this small Heavenly Grotto."
"Then we will rely on Alliance Leader Fang!"
Fu Tianhai gave a fist and palm salute.
After discussing the matter of the Azure Sea Heavenly Grotto a bit more, Fu Tianhai hurriedly left to prepare to lead the strong warriors of the Sea Spirit Tribe to the Black Abyss to set up the seal for the Grotto.
The Thousand Martial Lord and others also took their leave.
Fang Hao did not stay long at Evergreen Pavilion. After gathering for a few days and receiving guidance from his master, he promptly left with Moon Changming.
The structure of the Spiritual Realm, as well as the situations in Ice State, Yun State, and Da Ze State, all required attention.
And Fang Hao had officially taken over the Wanshi Alliance, negotiating with the Transcendent Spirit Sect regarding the structure of the Spiritual Realm.
Red Cat stayed for a few days and then returned to Heavenly Mausoleum State. As the Great Demon King, leading the Demon Clan to cooperate with the Wanshi Alliance, it took its place in the Spiritual Realm.
The storms had passed, and the Spiritual Realm was entering a new era. In a certain sense, the supreme rule of the Spirit Sects was beginning to end.
Evergreen Pavilion went to Yun State to heal those affected by the calamity there.
```
Xu Yan was sorting out the Martial Arts Techniques of the Void-breaking Realm and accumulating a foundation, preparing for his breakthrough into the Divine Skill Realm.
Xie Tianheng and his wife, Fu Yun, traveled through the eighteen states of the Spiritual Realm, carving out a reputation that was distinctly his own.
Xie Lingfeng, on the other hand, stayed behind and was in the midst of arduous cultivation.
Zi Yun clung to Meng Chong, clamoring to follow him on his adventures through the Spiritual Realm.
Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao also chose to stay at the Evergreen Pavilion, no longer willing to return to the Taimiao Sect.
Cai Ling'er, upon learning about the matter of the Azure Sea Heavenly Cave, felt some urgency as a member of the Sea Spirit Tribe, but ultimately chose not to leave, opting to continue staying at the Evergreen Pavilion.
To remain by the side of a great master.
This was an opportunity she didn't want to miss!
The Evergreen Pavilion became lively again, with plenty of helping hands and an increasing number of patients seeking treatment every day.
The Martial Artist who, during the Ice State incident, had made a ruthless decision to damage his own Divine Soul to escape death and send a warning, also came to the Evergreen Pavilion seeking medical help.
Meng Chong had broken through to the perfection of the Divine Origin Realm, and Li Xuan's Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body had been enhanced.
Su Lingxiu also broke through to the perfection of the Divine Origin Realm and had an epiphany regarding the cultivation methods of the Physiognomy Realm. Li Xuan's Alchemical Medical Martial Arts also broke through the Physiognomy Realm.
Fang Hao was also rapidly improving his strength.
Li Xuan was looking at what Blood Spirit Child left behind, given to him by Wu Tianan.
The blood-red pearl was not simple, hiding wisps of Soul Power within.
"Thinking of reviving yourself with this Netherworld Blood Orb?"
Li Xuan smiled, understanding Wu Tianan's concerns; the one revived might not necessarily be the Blood Spirit Child, but rather, the original owner of that Remnant Soul.
The Blood Spirit Child was indeed a ruthless character.
"Hundred Prison Blood Refining Skill, truly a demonic technique, but I must admit, it does have its unique characteristics and is indeed quite powerful," Li Xuan mused after reviewing the Hundred Prison Blood Refining Skill manual.
Moreover, he discovered that while this cultivation technique seemed similar to the Spiritual Realm Martial Arts, it was not actually from the Spiritual Realm; it was likely a technique from beyond the Domain.
"Things are getting more interesting now," Li Xuan thought to himself.
What then, lay beyond the Taicang Domain?
Li Xuan put away the manual, which might serve as a reference for his martial arts composition.
He took out the Book of Taicang to continue studying, for he intended to completely commit it to memory. Once he memorized the Book of Taicang, it would mean he had memorized the principles of the Taicang Domain Dao as well.
It would signify that the fundamental transformations and core principles of the entire Domain were within his grasp.
"On the other side of the Divine Bridge lies another region of Taicang, where the Domain Lingji and Spiritual Energy are more active and rich," Li Xuan pondered.
The Taicang Domain was divided into areas like a grid, the closer to the center of the Taicang Domain, the more active and rich the Domain Lingji and Spiritual Energy became.
The ceiling for martial arts was higher there.
But why was the Taicang Domain segmented in such a way?
And why was each region connected by gateways and bridges, with no freedom to come and go? What exactly was the reason for this?
Li Xuan was quite curious about this.
"Getting to the other side of the Divine Bridge should reveal the answer, right?" he muttered to himself.
"Above the Divine Refinement Celestial lies the Heavenly Venerable, such as the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable, True King Heavenly Venerable, Immortal Heavenly Venerable... The Physiognomy Realm should correspond to the Condensation Law Realm, but my martial arts, starting from the Divine Origin Realm, have already transcended the realms of Taicang Martial Arts.
"With a strength corresponding to the Truth Refinement Realm, being of the same realm as the True King Heavenly Venerable, it seems my strength is still somewhat lacking compared to the Immortal Heavenly Venerable," Li Xuan reflected.
There must be an Immortal Heavenly Venerable in the place where the Divine Bridge leads.
With his current level of strength, even if he could battle an ordinary Immortal Heavenly Venerable, he would not be invincible upon arriving on the other side of the Divine Bridge.
"Am I invincible under 'immortal'?" he wondered.
Being dubbed an Immortal Heavenly Venerable represented a massive leap, just as it was a significant divide between a great celestial and a Divine Refinement Celestial.
"To merge with the Domain, to command a part of it as a Venerable, with a lifespan as enduring as the Domain itself… In theory, as long as the Domain doesn't perish, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable would not die, which is truly formidable," he sighed.
What it means to be immortal is precisely this, a near-infinite existence.
They could only be killed, but would not perish simply because their lifespan had come to an end.
"But the Void-breaking Realm is more powerful. While the Immortal Heavenly Venerable merges with the Domain, commanding a part of the Domain as Venerable, the Void-breaking Realm is about breaking through the void of the Domain, unfettered by the Heaven and Earth Laws, moving beyond time and space...
"So long as you enter the Void-breaking Realm, even Immortal Heavenly Venerables need not be considered," Li Xuan's confidence surged. With his understanding of the Heaven and Earth Laws and Domain Dao Principles, once he entered the Void-breaking Realm, it would be a breeze to suppress an Immortal Heavenly Venerable single-handedly.
The threshold for the Void-breaking Realm was not distant; Xu Yan was about to completely decipher the Martial Arts Techniques of the Void-breaking Realm and reach full comprehension!

chapters.title: Chapter 666 - 354: Xu Yan Enters the Divine Skills
chapters.content:
Xu Yan emerged from the Heavenly Cave Ruins and began organizing his comprehension of the Void-breaking Martial Arts. By now, he had almost finished sorting through his insights.
The comprehensions of Void-breaking all surfaced in his mind, how to step into the Void-breaking Realm from the Physiognomy Realm, how to possess the Power of Void-breaking, all gradually became clear and understandable.
From the insights in the small Heavenly Cave deep in the Azure Sea's dark abyss, to the observations in the Ice State Heavenly Cave, piercing through Heaven and Earth, breaking open the void of Heaven and Earth, how to be uninhibited by spatial constraints of Heaven and Earth, how to be free from the binding of the Heaven and Earth Laws.
For Xu Yan, a clear path had now been laid out.
The techniques of the Void-breaking Realm Martial Arts were thus presented one by one, and the first step to transcending Heaven and Earth had been opened.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has gained a clear understanding of the Void-breaking Realm Martial Arts techniques you created; you have broken through to the Void-breaking Realm!"
The Daoist Golden Book opened and golden light emerged.
Li Xuan didn't have to wait long; the feedback from the Daoist Golden Book arrived.
The Void-breaking Realm!
Boom!
In that instant, the techniques of the Void-breaking Realm Martial Arts were presented in his mind, and the mysteries of the Void-breaking Realm were also revealed one by one.
At this moment, Heaven and Earth appeared different in his eyes.
As if with a single thought, he could traverse the void and reach the other side of Heaven and Earth.
The Principles of Heaven and Earth, the Domain Dao Rules, all were distinctly presented in his eyes.
Though he could not transcend Heaven and Earth, he was no longer constrained by the spatial bounds of Heaven and Earth.
With a single punch, he could traverse space!
"So this is the Void-breaking Realm."
Li Xuan's heart surged with excitement. Only after a true breakthrough did he deeply understand the power of the Void-breaking Realm.
Although he had created it and considered it to be very powerful,
it was only after the breakthrough that he realized the true Void-breaking Realm was beyond the simple descriptions he could articulate.
"My Divine Skills are even stronger now!"
The terror of Divine Skills executed in the Void-breaking Realm – what kind of power would that be?
Li Xuan hardly dared to imagine!
"Could I shatter an Immortal Heavenly Venerable with a single punch?"
At this moment, Li Xuan's confidence surged, and he was itching to find an Immortal Heavenly Venerable to fight.
Looking toward the Inner Domain, the barriers between the Spiritual Realm and the Inner Domain were now clearly delineated in his sight.
"So that's how it is!"
The barriers between the Inner Domain and the Spiritual Realm were formed by the Heaven and Earth Laws, like a grid formed naturally by the Taicang Domain itself.
The gate to the Spiritual Realm was a portal formed by the laws, which, when operated in a certain manner, would cause the force of the laws to disperse on either side, and the portal would naturally open.
"What about the journey to the far side of the Divine Bridge? Is the Divine Bridge also formed by the Heaven and Earth Laws?"
He took out the Book of Taicang, and now it was much easier to remember the Dao Principles upon looking at them.
"Indeed, only with an elevated realm can one more easily remember and comprehend."
Li Xuan was invigorated within.
He was in the Void-breaking Realm!
"The next realm should also be prepared. Xu Yan is not far from Divine Skills!"
Li Xuan pondered for a while. After breaking through to the Void-breaking Realm, his understanding of Martial Arts deepened, inspiring even more thoughts.
After all, the higher the realm, the clearer and more understandable the direction of Martial Arts cultivation becomes, making it easier to create stronger Martial Arts.
Li Xuan pondered a bit and got a rough idea of the direction for the next Martial Arts techniques.
The Martial Arts Realm after the Void-breaking Realm, as well as the subsequent cultivation of the Physical Body Martial Arts and the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body, also needed to be created.
The further development of the Qimen Martial Art should also be outlined, and although the direction of Qimen Martial Art had been established, new ideas could be continually added to expand the path of Qimen Martial Art.
"The Fifth Door of Martial Arts should also be pondered over when time permits."
Li Xuan mused.
"The Divine Skills crafted from the Divine Skill Martial Code are not enough; the next effort will be the Divine Skill Martial Code, including how to cultivate Divine Skills Technique with the Imperishable Qi."
Having set his direction and goals, Li Xuan appeared relaxed, yet he was actually bustling with activity.
Time passed, and the situation in Yun State gradually stabilized. In the center of Yun State, a vast lake emerged, with islands formed by former mountains.
This enormous lake was named the Yun State Heavenly Lake.
As the waters of Yun State converged upon the Heavenly Lake, the remnants of the great city were laid bare, presenting a scene of desolation.
In this catastrophe, the casualties in Yun State were incalculable, and the Spirit Sects and noble families all suffered heavy losses, while the structure of the Spiritual Realm also changed, no longer dominated by the strong grip of the Spirit Sects.
New cities rose in Yun State, and Martial Artists from other states began to settle down in Yun State.
The Wanshi Alliance and the Transcendent Spirit Sect continued their affairs, but a broadly accepted consensus had been reached that the status of Loose Cultivators had been elevated to equal that of the Spiritual Sect Warriors.
The order of the Spiritual Realm Martial Arts World, or rather the rules, were in the process of being established.
Fang Hao had already set off for the Azure Sea's dark abyss, tasked with sealing the Heavenly Cave there.
The Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship floated on Yun State Heavenly Lake, with long queues forming daily, waiting for medical consultation.
Xu Yan was accumulating his foundation, preparing for the breakthrough to the Divine Skill Realm.
Meng Chong and Su Lingxiu were doing the same, though both were still some distance from gathering sufficient foundation.
Meng Shushu was finally on the verge of breaking into the Divine Intent Realm.
Shi'er and Zhou Ying were envious, but they too were nearing their breakthrough into the Divine Intent Realm.
Although breaking into the Divine Intent Realm greatly increased their strength, in the Spiritual Realm, it hardly counted for much, especially when their strength could not compare to Xie Lingfeng's.
Li Xuan was busy crafting the Divine Skill Martial Code, racking his brains for the great undertaking of Martial Arts.
Meanwhile, the powerful members of the Transcendent Spirit Sect were getting ready for the opening of the Divine Bridge.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has perfected the Heart Sword Realm, and you have made early progress in the Wisdom Sword Realm."
Feedback from the Daoist Golden Book arrived.

chapters.title: Chapter 667 - 354 Xu Yan Enters Divine Skills_2
chapters.content:
```
Xu Yan finally reached perfection in the Heart Sword Realm, getting one step closer to the Wisdom Sword Realm.
"It's time to prepare for the Sword Dao realm after the Wisdom Sword Realm."
Li Xuan muttered to himself.
A few days later, the Daoist Golden Book gave feedback again.
"Your disciple, Meng Chong, has grasped the cultivation direction of the Bright Knife Realm and has entered the gateway to the Bright Knife Path," it said.
Li Xuan felt a surge of joy in his heart, as his own blade path had also improved.
"Meng Chong finally found it, the path of cultivation in the Bright Knife Realm, it wasn't easy."
Li Xuan sighed with emotion in his heart.
Meng Chong's blade path realm had also broken through the culmination of the Concealed Blade Realm.
"Today, I shall ascend to the Divine Skill Realm!"
Xu Yan's gaze was calm, but there was a trace of excitement in his heart.
He had finally accumulated enough foundation to break into the Divine Skill Realm, and once he ascended, how powerful would he become?
The Evergreen Pavilion halted its consultations, and the flying boat rose into the sky, hovering above the clouds.
Xu Yan sat cross-legged above the clouds, enshrouded in a divine radiance.
His aura grew stronger, and divine light filled the area.
"The Divine Skill Realm..."
Xie Lingfeng's face was filled with amazement, Xu Yan was about to break into the Divine Skill Realm, and it was still a far-off dream for him.
He was only just accomplished in the Divine Origin Realm.
Li Xuan's face was also filled with anticipation, wondering what divine skills Xu Yan would manifest upon breaking into the Divine Skill Realm.
Sword Arts Divine Skills were certainly going to manifest, and there might even be more than one.
"How many divine skills will Xu Yan manifest when breaking the Divine Skill Realm?"
The divine skills that spontaneously arise during the breakthrough of the Divine Skill Realm, enhance continuously as one's realm increases and have no upper limit; these can be referred to as the martial artist's innate divine skills.
The cultivated divine skills differ from the spontaneously arisen ones.
As Xu Yan was breaking through, the clouds above churned with energy, and a mighty momentum had already begun amassing even before the breakthrough.
Li Xuan's thoughts shifted, and he sealed off any disturbance caused by the breakthrough.
"What kind of divine skills will Big Brother master?"
Su Lingxiu asked curiously.
"Definitely very powerful ones."
Meng Chong said, stroking his bald head.
"What are these divine skills you speak of?"
Zi Yun asked with curiosity.
Du Yuying, Yun Miaomiao, and others also looked on, wondering what exactly martial arts divine skills were like.
They had never seen them before!
The concept of divine skills did not exist in the martial arts they cultivated.
"Of course, they're very powerful indeed!"
Meng Chong said with a heavy voice.
Zi Yun rolled her eyes, wasn't that obvious?
"There are myriad divine skills, each with its distinction, and their strengths vary!"
Li Xuan stated calmly.
"Senior, can we also cultivate divine skills?"
Du Yuying asked curiously.
"It depends on your own enlightenment."
Li Xuan didn't make any promises.
At these words, Du Yuying and the others felt their hearts stir.
If they could also cultivate divine skills, wouldn't their strength greatly increase?
However, divine skills were no trifling matter, being the core cultivation techniques of martial arts, they were too embarrassed to openly ask for methods of cultivating divine skills.
They would have to wait for the right opportunity.
"The breakthrough is imminent!"
Li Xuan was getting excited inside, "Just how will Xu Yan transform upon breaking into the Divine Skill Realm?"
Above the clouds, the divine radiance around Xu Yan constricted into his body, and a more profound glimmer intermittently shone from within him.
"Your disciple Xu Yan, practicing the martial arts you created, has broken into the Divine Skill Realm, increasing the power of your divine skills a hundredfold!"
Feedback from the Daoist Golden Book came.
"Immortal Heavenly Venerable, which of you can withstand a single one of my divine skills?"
Li Xuan was ecstatic; his divine skills were already incredibly powerful, and now their might had increased a hundredfold. With one divine skill, he could easily obliterate an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, right?
His confidence soared!
"I continue to be invincible!"
Li Xuan was thoroughly exhilarated, indeed the greatest joy in the world was the happiness that came with an increase in strength.
Xu Yan continued with his breakthrough.
```
"Your disciple Xu Yan has achieved perfection during the breakthrough into the Divine Realm, transforming into the Mountain and River Sacred Bone. You've obtained the Innate Mountain and River Sacred Bone!"
At this moment, Li Xuan felt a sense of sacred radiance. The images of mountains and rivers appeared within him, and the profound and holy intentions enveloped him.
It seemed that in an instant, the mountains and rivers within him could transform into a realm for all life.
"Mountain and River Sacred Bone!"
Li Xuan was thrilled, knowing Xu Yan's next breakthrough would surely be the ascension to a Sacred Body!
"I think I understand what physique will come from continuing this transformation."
A realization dawned on Li Xuan.
"Should the divine skills be born now?"
Li Xuan silently observed Xu Yan's breakthrough, knowing that the divine skills would be born at this moment.
A sword light emerged from Xu Yan, shrouded by mountains and rivers. The area around him, in an instant, turned into a landscape of mountains and rivers.
The mountains and rivers were seen, but not the person!
"Your disciple Xu Yan has broken through to the Divine Realm, giving birth to the divine skill 'Mountains and Rivers in the Sword.' You've obtained the divine skill 'Mountains and Rivers in the Sword'!"
Xu Yan's first divine skill was, as expected, related to the Sword Dao.
Mountains and Rivers in the Sword!
"It's similar to 'Universe within the Sword,' just slightly weaker, but still very powerful."
Li Xuan nodded to himself.
Xu Yan's divine skill was as Li Xuan had anticipated, after all, Mountain and River Swordsmanship was the Sword Dao that Xu Yan had comprehended. It was only natural that it would become a divine skill.
"With Xu Yan's insight into the Martial Arts, Mountain and River Swordsmanship can continue to strengthen, meaning that the 'Mountains and Rivers in the Sword' divine skill will keep growing more powerful."
Li Xuan thought to himself. With Xu Yan's aptitude, he would surely continue to enhance his Sword Arts Divine Skill.
As the mountains and rivers disappeared, Xu Yan's figure reemerged, and immediately two mysterious sword lights surged within him.
"Another Sword Arts Divine Skill!"
Xu Yan had given birth to a second Sword Arts Divine Skill.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has broken through to the Divine Realm, giving birth to the divine skill 'Yin Yang Undying Sword.' You've obtained the divine skill 'Yin Yang Undying Sword'."
Li Xuan's heart shook with surprise and joy.
"This Sword Arts Divine Skill is not bad, circulating in a Yin Yang cycle. It can redirect an enemy's attack back at them... It's somewhat like the 'Stellar Shift,' but the 'Yin Yang Undying Sword' has more variations and is more profound."
The second Sword Arts Divine Skill that Xu Yan had given birth to clearly came from his cycle of life and death swords.
The Yin Yang Undying Sword could not just reflect attacks; it could also boost his own attacks.
Furthermore, it could accumulate the enemy's attacks, transforming them into the defensive power of the Yin Yang Undying Sword, and in an instant, redirect the accumulated attacks back at the enemy.
Moreover, the Yin Yang Undying Sword was endlessly cyclical, uninterrupted. To break the Yin Yang Undying Sword in an instant, the attacker's strength must be at least three times greater than Xu Yan's.
Otherwise, it would be impossible to break through the Yin Yang Undying Sword!
With this divine skill, even when facing an opponent stronger than oneself, it would be possible to manage the fight easily.
Xu Yan continued to make his breakthrough, and the birth of divine skills had not stopped.
The Yin Yang sword light faded, and immediately a fierce killing intent, capable of extinguishing heaven and earth, emerged vaguely. The sharpness of the sword light had a faint hint of black and red.
Li Xuan's heart trembled. This was a Sword Arts Divine Skill of pure slaughter!
"Your disciple Xu Yan has broken through to the Divine Realm, giving birth to the divine skill 'Supreme Heavenly Sword.' You've obtained the divine skill 'Supreme Heavenly Sword'!"
Supreme Heavenly Sword!
With one strike of this sword, heaven and earth could be extinguished!
Of course, to extinguish heaven and earth would require great strength, far beyond the reach of the Divine Realm, but this shows the violent nature of the skill.
"Worthy to be my Martial Arts trailblazer, this divine skill is powerful indeed!"
Li Xuan was immensely gratified.
His foremost disciple never disappointed him.
"Three Sword Arts Divine Skills have been born, three divine skills! Will there be another divine skill born?"
Li Xuan was full of anticipation.
When he had broken through to the Divine Realm, he had given birth to five divine skills, and Xu Yan should also produce five divine skills.
After all, every time Xu Yan gave birth to a divine skill, he would also gain one more.
The divine skills he possessed far surpassed those of his disciple.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has broken through to the Divine Realm, giving birth to the divine skill 'True Dragon Rage.' You've obtained the divine skill 'True Dragon Rage'!"
The divine skill, True Dragon Rage!
This was a divine skill derived from the Subduing Dragon Palm.
The wrath of the True Dragon, changing the very colors of heaven and earth!
"Not bad, the power of this divine skill is also very strong, second only to my 'Divine Dragon's Descent'!"
While the True Dragon Rage couldn't quite match the Divine Dragon's Descent, its wild fury was indeed more powerful than the Divine Dragon's Descent.
The Divine Dragon's Descent, a divine skill where the dragon's might is vast and supreme, and the True Dragon Rage represents a state of violent fury, both differing in their essence.
"The fourth divine skill has been born, will there be a fifth divine skill continuing to emerge?"
Li Xuan watched Xu Yan, who was still in the midst of his breakthrough, with high expectations.
After the violent True Dragon's might dissipated, a barely noticeable flash of lightning emerged from Xu Yan.
The lightning was nearly imperceptible, just a fleeting flash, so faint it seemed to blend with heaven and earth, traceless and undiscoverable.

chapters.title: Chapter 668 - 355 The Power of Divine Skills, Meng Chong Breaks Through
chapters.content:
Seeing the lightning on Xu Yan's body, which was almost imperceptible, fleeting, as if blending into the domain, Li Xuan understood in his heart.
This was a Divine Skill related to speed.
The Heavenly Lightning Flash cultivated by Xu Yan was an inherently powerful movement technique, with speed so fast that it could transcend realms.
"Your disciple Xu Yan broke through the Divine Skill Realm, giving birth to the Divine Skill 'In a Thought, Traceless.' You have gained the Divine Skill 'In a Thought, Traceless!'"
As expected, it was a speed-based Divine Skill.
In a Thought, Traceless!
In the span of a thought, without a trace.
"Five Divine Skills now."
Li Xuan continued watching with some anticipation, wondering whether Xu Yan could unexpectedly give birth to a sixth Divine Skill.
Xu Yan's aura continued to strengthen and then slowly converged once again.
By now, Xu Yan's breakthrough to the Divine Skill Realm had been completed.
Li Xuan withdrew his attention.
Xu Yan had broken through to the Divine Skill Realm and given birth to five Divine Skills. How many Divine Skills would Meng Chong give birth to when he broke through the Divine Skill Realm?
Li Xuan guessed that Meng Chong probably wouldn't be far behind.
Although he had only given birth to three Divine Skills when his Physical Body Martial Arts broke through the Divine Skill Realm, this was because he had already given birth to Divine Skills, so the number of new Divine Skills he could give birth to was reduced.
Besides Meng Chong, there was Su Lingxiu.
Li Xuan was very much looking forward to seeing which Divine Skills Su Lingxiu would give birth to when she broke through the Divine Skill Realm.
"The big senior brother has already broken through."
Meng Chong looked utterly shocked, as he suddenly felt as weak as an ant compared to his senior brother.
"The improvement of the Divine Skill Realm is too strong."
Meng Chong sighed deeply, feeling his blood boil, wishing he could immediately gather a full foundation and then break through the Divine Skill Realm.
"I feel that the big senior brother won't be weaker than the Seductive Witch!"
Su Lingxiu spoke up.
"I wonder what Divine Skills the big senior brother has given birth to."
Upon entering the Divine Skill Realm, Xu Yan's strength had become incomparable to the past.
Even the Seductive Witch of the past was nothing for Xu Yan to fear.
Xu Yan, who was sitting cross-legged above the clouds, vanished in an instant. Meng Chong and the others hadn't even reacted before another person appeared beside them.
Xu Yan!
"Big senior brother!"
Meng Chong was profoundly shocked. His senior brother had appeared so suddenly that he couldn't even react, nor did he perceive how his senior brother had done it.
"This is Divine Skill, huh!"
Xu Yan exclaimed.
"Only by breaking through to the Divine Skill Realm can one truly understand the wonders of Martial Arts."
Upon entering the Divine Skill Realm, only then did one truly comprehend the power and mystery of Martial Arts.
The practice before Divine Skills seemed to be merely a prelude to the path of Martial Arts, laying the foundation for Divine Skills!
And Divine Skills were just the starting point of a new Martial Arts journey.
Martial Arts Endless Realm!
At this moment, Xu Yan understood this meaning much more profoundly!
"Big senior brother, what Divine Skills have you given birth to?"
Su Lingxiu asked excitedly.
"I have only given birth to five Divine Skills, so-so, I guess."
Xu Yan sighed.
He looked toward his master to see what he thought about his performance of giving birth to only five Divine Skills.
"Not bad!"
Li Xuan nodded, giving a moderate assessment. He couldn't let his disciple become complacent; he must always make his disciple feel that their performance isn't good enough, so they would strive even harder!
"As expected!"
Xu Yan sighed with relief while also feeling a bit of regret.
"I'm still somewhat far from where Master was back then, but I'm glad I didn't disappoint him too much!"
In Xu Yan's mind, his master's moderate assessment meant that he wasn't too disappointed, nothing more.
"I need to work harder, aiming to reach at least half of what my master achieved at the next realm!"
Xu Yan set this resolve secretly in his heart.
Meng Chong suddenly felt enormous pressure, with his big senior brother so powerful, yet only receiving a "Not bad" from their master, he knew he had to work doubly hard.
Otherwise, he might not even receive that "Not bad" assessment!
"Big senior brother, display your Divine Skill."
Su Lingxiu called out excitedly.
"Sure!"
Xu Yan revealed a smile, but in an instant, Su Lingxiu and the others were stunned.
Evergreen Pavilion was still the Evergreen Pavilion, but it seemed as if it was in another domain, and there was a feeling as if they could be annihilated at any moment!
"This is my Sword Dao Divine Skill, Mountains and Rivers in the Sword. Within my mountains and rivers, life and death are in my one thought."
Xu Yan's voice rang out.
"This is Divine Skill, huh!"
Du Yuying, Yun Miaomiao, and others who cultivated Taicang Martial Arts were utterly astounded. Divine Skill was so mystical, truly inconceivable!
The strength of Divine Skills, beyond imagination!
Cai Ling'er's jade face turned serious. She considered herself nearly at the limit of the Spiritual Realm, but facing this Divine Skill, she had not a shred of resistance.
Moreover, if not for Xu Yan's reminder, if they hadn't known that Xu Yan was about to use Divine Skills, they wouldn't even have realized that they were within the Divine Skill already.
As Xu Yan withdrew his Divine Skills, two streaks of sword light emerged around him, spinning incessantly.
"Junior brother, strike at me with all your might!"
Xu Yan stood with his hands behind his back, smiling as he spoke.
"Alright!"
Meng Chong nodded.
What Divine Skill was the big senior brother showing now?
Golden light surged on his body, and with a punch charged with thunder, he struck fiercely.
Boom!
This punch was Meng Chong's utmost effort, the ferocious thunderous punch shocked Cai Ling'er and the others.
Seeing this punch, Cai Ling'er couldn't help but sigh to herself that she couldn't possibly withstand such a ferocious attack.
Rumble!
However, such a ferocious punch, when it hit the swirling sword light around Xu Yan, seemed to enter a vortex. As it circulated with the sword light, it neither harmed Xu Yan nor did the punch's power dissipate.
"Junior brother, keep going!"
Xu Yan still stood with his hands behind his back, unmoving.

chapters.title: Chapter 669 - 355 The Power of Divine Skills, Meng Chong Breaks Through
chapters.content:
Meng Chong unleashed his fists, punch after punch, and within the blink of an eye, he had thrown more than twenty punches.
With all his strength, the twenty-some punches were ferociously terrifying, yet such violent punching power seemed to be absorbed into a vortex of sword light.
"Watch closely, this is another of my Sword Arts Divine Skills, the Yin Yang Undying Sword!"
Xu Yan said with a smile, his thoughts fixed on the present moment. As the sword light whirled, an incredibly violent storm of fist power erupted and slammed into the empty sky.
This storm of fist power, accumulated from Meng Chong's more than twenty punches, was so formidable that not even Meng Chong himself could withstand it.
That's why Xu Yan directed this violent power of fists towards the empty sky.
Gulp!
Meng Chong wiped the sweat off his head, his face filled with shock. The power of his own twenty-some punches had converged into one strike, so strong it was astounding.
"This Sword Arts Divine Skill is too powerful."
In that moment, Meng Chong realized the strength of his senior brother's Sword Arts Divine Skill.
It could return an enemy's attack, and if facing a siege, it could even redirect the enemies' attacks towards one another.
The Yin Yang Undying Sword, Yin and Yang never perish, endlessly regenerating.
"I have to practice, I must break through the Divine Realm as soon as possible!"
After witnessing the power of Divine Skills, Meng Chong's enthusiasm soared, and he wished he could immediately accumulate the essence to break through the Divine Realm.
"What kind of Divine Skill will my Physical Body Martial Arts give birth to?"
Meng Chong was filled with anticipation.
He went to practice, striving to break through the Divine Realm as soon as possible.
So did Su Lingxiu. She stopped seeing patients too, focusing all her thoughts on accumulating the essence in preparation for breaking through the Divine Realm.
"I must also break through the Divine Realm soon, within five… ten years, I must make the breakthrough!"
Xie Lingfeng was also stirred up.
Even Meng Shushu, Shi'er, and Zhou Ying, despite their lower strength, were also filled with fiery enthusiasm. For the sake of Divine Skills, they must practice diligently!
"Is it too late to switch to practicing Martial Arts now?"
Yue'er said enviously.
"It's too late to switch now, we should just focus on enhancing our strength and hope we can cultivate Divine Skills,"
Du Yuying sighed.
Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship was not seeing patients anymore, but was drifting among the clouds.
Everyone was devoted to cultivation.
Even Li Xuan was immersing himself in the great endeavor of Martial Arts.
Xu Yan had broken through to the Divine Realm, and the Divine Skills Martial Code he compiled could now come in handy.
Although the number of Divine Skills he compiled was not numerous, they were sufficient for the time being.
While Xu Yan was consolidating his realm and sorting through his own path in Martial Arts, gaining insights into Divine Skills, Li Xuan was not in a hurry to pass on the Divine Skills from the Martial Code he had created.
Time flew, and the opening of the Divine Bridge was drawing ever closer.
The structure of the Spiritual Realm was basically set in stone. The Wanshi Alliance had become the overlord of the Spiritual Realm, the status of Loose Cultivators had been elevated, and large cities were being established across the Eighteen States.
Each big city began to set up Teleportation Formations, facilitating travel for Martial Artists of the Spiritual Realm and the exchange of resources.
The Heavenly Grotto in the black abyss of Azure Sea was successfully sealed and would no longer expand, nor would it cause a disaster like the Heavenly Grotto in Ice State to the Azure Sea.
Fang Hao occasionally returned to Evergreen Pavilion to receive guidance from his master. The path of Qimen Martial Art was broadening for him, and it was not long before he would refine the Divine Ability Pattern.
Notably, the Demon Clan had truly established itself, with Heavenly Mausoleum State becoming the territory of the Demon Clan.
Red Cat propagated the Great Demon Martial Arts, greatly enhancing the strength of the Demon Clan in a short period of time.
In the current Spiritual Realm, Azure Sea is home to the Sea Spirit Tribe, while the great mountains of Heavenly Mausoleum State are where the Demon Clan resides.
In Evergreen Pavilion, Xu Yan was flipping through a booklet given to him by his master, containing Martial Arts Divine Skills, divided into Great Divine Powers and lesser Divine Skills.
There were many lesser Divine Skills, but only a few Great Divine Powers.
According to his master, this was part of the Divine Skill Martial Code.
Xu Yan had already comprehended two lesser Divine Skills suited to himself. Although called lesser, their power was not weak.
Even the weakest Divine Skill is still a Divine Skill!
Li Xuan felt gratified. Although the Divine Skill Martial Code was not perfect and only a small part had been created, it could meet Xu Yan's training needs for the current stage.
It had not been long, but Xu Yan had already cultivated two of the lesser Divine Skills from it.
"Although they are just lesser Divine Skills, their power is not weak. Great Divine Powers are indeed more difficult, but it's just a matter of taking a little more time to comprehend them."
Li Xuan felt somewhat regretful that he hadn't created Divine Skills like Blood Resurrection or White Bone Rebirth; he needed to further refine the code to elevate the levels of the Divine Skills.
"Meow meow!"
Red Cat, the Great Demon King, had returned to Evergreen Pavilion a few days ago and was being adorable and trying to please everyone.
"Red Cat, your Great Demon Ability still falls short; put some more effort into it," Li Xuan said as he tapped Red Cat's head with the Jade Ruyi in his hand.
Red Cat was still a bit away from birthing its Great Demon Ability and needed to double its efforts.
"Meow meow!"
Red Cat nodded, being cute in front of its owner and then went to familiarize itself with Xu Yan, who after all was a Supreme Sovereign of the Demon Clan and one of its backers.
As for Shi'er, it could only groom and massage it.
Li Xuan was speechless, this cat was truly clever.
"Meng Chong and Su Lingxiu are also on the verge of breaking into the Divine Skill Realm,"
Li Xuan couldn't wait.
Once Meng Chong and Su Lingxiu made their breakthrough, he would gain new Divine Skills and his strength would further increase.
"The feeling of being invincible is truly wonderful."
However, Li Xuan also knew that there were still formidable beings in the Taicang Domain; the Immortal Heavenly Venerable was definitely not the strongest.
He could defeat the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, but he was definitely no match for the owner of the Book of Taicang.
So, he couldn't get too carried away.
He must stay steady, survive, and not let himself become arrogant.
Only when he truly transcended the Domain could he have the confidence to defeat the master of the Book of Taicang.
"The Book of Taicang dropped into the Border Wilderness; perhaps its owner had already perished?"
Li Xuan mused to himself.
Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship was drifting towards Yuzhou.
Only half a year remained until the Divine Bridge opened, and the path of Martial Arts that lay ahead was heading towards the other side of the Divine Bridge.
This departure, who knows in what year and month he would return.
So, he should also return to the Inner Domain or perhaps to the Great Wilderness to take a look.
"This time going back to the Great Wilderness, I should travel around more, look around more; perhaps there will be some discoveries."
Li Xuan pondered.
Why would such a Supreme Treasure as the Book of Taicang, which contains the principles and Dao Principles of the Taicang Domain, appear in the Border Wilderness Wasteland?
"The Heavenly Grotto, the hole in the Domain, comes from enemies beyond the heavens; the Taicang Domain must have encountered something in the past, creating the current separation between the Inner Domain and the Spiritual Realm,"
Li Xuan reflected thoughtfully.
Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship had already floated to Luo State, and Yuzhou was not far away.
Meng Chong's aura surged; he had finally gathered enough foundation to perfection and was ready to break through to the Divine Skill Realm.
The Flying Ship stopped above the clouds.
"I am going to break into the Divine Skill Realm!"
Meng Chong was thrilled.
What Divine Skill will he birth?
Once he entered the Divine Skill Realm, he could practice his master's Divine Skill Martial Code.
Above the clouds, Meng Chong was breaking into the Divine Skill Realm.
Li Xuan was full of anticipation.
"The Divine Skill Realm's Great Sun Indestructible Golden Body can transform into an eighteen-zhang golden body, a true little giant. When Divine Skills are utilized, the might of Physical Body Martial Arts is undeniable."
Reaching this step in the Divine Skill Realm, the sheer might of Physical Body Martial Arts further revealed itself.
"Your disciple Meng Chong, by practicing the Martial Arts Techniques you have compiled and breaking into the Divine Skill Realm, has increased the strength of your physique by a hundredfold!"
The feedback from the Daoist Golden Book arrived.
A hundredfold increase in physical strength made Li Xuan ecstatic. He clenched his fists, feeling he could now squeeze to death the Immortal Heavenly Venerable with his bare hands.
"I must not get carried away. My Physical Body Martial Arts has currently only reached the first level of the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body, merely the Physiognomy Realm. Although it has increased a hundredfold, thinking of killing the Immortal Heavenly Venerable with just my physical strength is still a bit of a stretch."
Li Xuan steadied his inflated ego and continued to stay grounded, he couldn't afford to become arrogant.
"Your disciple Meng Chong, in breaking into the Divine Skill Realm, has fully metamorphosed and shed his old self to become the Vajra Sacred Bone, and you have gained the Innate Indestructible Vajra Sacred Bone."
The metamorphosis of Meng Chong during his breakthrough was all within expectations, and Li Xuan was no longer excited about it.
Based on previous experiences, once Su Lingxiu breaks through and fully metamorphoses to become a Sacred Bone, he will receive the reward of the Innate Indestructible Sacred Bone.
"What Divine Skill will Meng Chong give birth to? Will there be a Divine Skill similar to 'Rebirth with a Single Thought' belonging uniquely to Physical Body Martial Arts?"
Li Xuan watched Meng Chong, who was in the midst of his breakthrough, with expectation.
The First Divine Technique was about to be born.

chapters.title: Chapter 670 - 356 Infinite Divine Waves, Life and Death Reversed
chapters.content:
"Your disciple Meng Chong has broken through the Divine Skill Realm, giving birth to the boundless divine waves skill, and you have obtained the boundless divine waves skill!"
Boundless divine waves!
"The unique aspect of the divine skill in Physical Body Martial Arts is its unparalleled defense, its extraordinary thickness and solidity."
Li Xuan felt awe in his heart.
The Boundless Divine Waves skill meant that surging waves moved around the body, tumultuous and unmatched, rendering all attacks invisible within the raging waves.
This includes attacks targeting the Primordial Spirit, which can be defended against as well.
And the Boundless Divine Waves could also transform into surging attacks, like a sweeping tsunami, enveloping the enemy with an unstoppable, profound force.
"Meng Chong's skill is impressive. Physical Body Martial Arts are already physically robust, and with this divine skill for defense, an enemy wishing to break through would need extremely powerful divine skills; otherwise, even if they have double the strength, it will be difficult to breach."
Once he deploys the eighteen-zhang golden body and transforms into a little giant, then uses the Boundless Divine Waves skill, it will effortlessly sweep across thousands of troops.
"Your disciple Meng Chong has broken through the Divine Skill Realm, giving birth to the regrowth divine skill, and you have obtained the regrowth divine skill!"
Meng Chong's second divine skill wasn't as formidable as instant regeneration or regeneration from a drop of blood but being able to regrow limbs still meant it was exceptionally robust.
This implies that even if he suffers any severe injury, he can recover in a short period of time.
"Regrowth requires consumption of Martial Arts origin energy and one's own vital blood, but for Physical Body Martial Artists, what they have in abundance is vital blood and a robust Martial Arts origin."
As long as the Martial Arts origin isn't exhausted in an instant, and even if it is consumed, it can be cultivated and recovered over time.
Physical Body Martial Artists have inherently strong regenerative abilities; regrowing limbs even once hardly consumes much Martial Arts origin energy.
"My Martial Arts will never be in a state where once the origin is depleted, it cannot be recovered. This divine skill is also good, showcasing the uniqueness of Physical Body Martial Arts."
Li Xuan nodded, reasonably satisfied with Meng Chong's second divine skill.
"Regrowth will likely become a divine skill that inevitably arises for Physical Body Martial Artists."
Li Xuan pondered thoughtfully.
After giving birth to the second divine skill, Meng Chong continued breaking through, his aura changing, and above his head seemed to appear the outline of a great sun.
"Your disciple Meng Chong has broken through the Divine Skill Realm, giving birth to the Great Sun God Obscuration skill, and you have obtained the Great Sun God Obscuration skill!"
Meng Chong's third divine skill, Great Sun God Obscuration!
"This is an offensive divine skill, fiery and domineering, with considerable power!"
Li Xuan inwardly nodded.
Upon using Great Sun God Obscuration, it was as if a great sun hung above his head, and when unleashed, it was like the sun had descended upon the world, its might shocking.
Moreover, it could be fused into Sword Intent, fully displaying its domineering force and fiery energy, seemingly capable of annihilating everything.
"Your disciple Meng Chong has broken through the Divine Skill Realm, giving birth to the Peerless Wind Thunder Slash skill, and you have obtained the Peerless Wind Thunder Slash skill!"
The fourth divine skill was also an offensive divine skill.
With wind and thunder in hand, a blade that surpasses this world, domineering and without equal!
"Your disciple Meng Chong has broken through the Divine Skill Realm, giving birth to the Great Sun Crossing the Sky skill, and you have obtained the Great Sun Crossing the Sky skill!"
Great Sun Crossing the Sky is a movement technique-based divine skill, in the blink of an eye, like a great sun traversing the skies, fully displaying wildness and fierceness.
"This movement technique fits very well with the characteristics of Physical Body Martial Arts!"
Li Xuan nodded silently.
Xu Yan's One Thought Traceless, disappearing in an instant, invisible and traceless, coming and going without a sign.
However, Meng Chong's style was like a great sun, descending in an instant, wholly manifesting domineering and wildness.
"If Meng Chong doesn't wish to be so conspicuous, he could also cultivate a low-profile and swift movement technique divine skill."
Li Xuan muttered.
In the Divine Skill Martial Code, he also compiled several movement and speed-based divine skills.
Having broken through the Divine Skill Realm, Meng Chong likewise birthed five divine skills, and without any surprises, Su Lingxiu would also attain five divine skills upon her breakthrough.
As for Xie Lingfeng breaking through the Divine Skill Realm, he probably wouldn't birth as many divine skills.
After his breakthrough in the Divine Skill Realm, Meng Chong, after a period of consolidation, became excited, and began to deploy his divine skills.
Boom!
The eighteen-zhang golden body stood between heaven and earth, with boundless divine waves surging, like a Heavenly God descending upon the world!
Zi Yun became utterly fascinated by the sight.
"Second junior brother, let's spar a bit!"
Xu Yan rubbed his hands together and said.
"Alright!"
Meng Chong nodded.
Boom!
The clash of divine skills erupted above the clouds.
Around Xu Yan was the Yin Yang Undying Sword, while Meng Chong unleashed the Boundless Divine Waves, with both colliding into each other.
Boom!
Meng Chong's hand wielded wind and thunder, cleaving down with his blade, the wild light of the wind and thunder blade as if heralding the end of the world.
Xu Yan pointed out with his sword, Mountains and Rivers in the Sword, the wild wind and thunder blade light instantly concealed within the mountains and rivers.
Immediately after, the wind and thunder blade surged from the Yin Yang Undying Sword, counter-attacking Meng Chong.
Boom!
Above Meng Chong's head, a great sun emerged, and as he punched out, the might of Great Sun God Obscuration followed.
The sparring continued.
Above the Evergreen Pavilion, Su Lingxiu and others were astounded.
The might of these divine skills was truly frightening!
"I suddenly feel like the battles of those powerhouses in the Spiritual Realm are akin to children playing house."
Cai Ling'er murmured to herself.
It's a completely different level of power.
The might of divine skills is indeed incomprehensible.
"Master, Master, who is stronger, the eldest senior brother or the second senior brother?"
Su Lingxiu, excitedly grasping her master's arm, asked curiously.
"Your eldest senior brother!"
Li Xuan glanced over and already knew the outcome.
Xu Yan was undoubtedly a notch above.
Even though Meng Chong's Boundless Divine Waves was incredibly defensive, Xu Yan's divine skills were also immensely potent.
Especially the Supreme Heavenly Sword, this Sword Arts Divine Skill, could obliterate heaven and earth and tear through the Boundless Divine Waves; that too was achievable.

chapters.title: Chapter 671 - 356 Infinite Divine Waves, Life and Death Reversed_2
chapters.content:
Of course, just this one sword attack might not necessarily be able to injure Meng Chong.
Another strong point of Xu Yan was the divine skill, Mountains and Rivers in the Sword. Once Meng Chong was enveloped in the mountain and river domain, all divine skills and battles would take place within Xu Yan's sword.
The final victor would naturally be Xu Yan.
However, it wouldn't be so easy for Xu Yan to defeat Meng Chong.
It could only be said that Xu Yan was a notch above, and his insights in the path of martial arts were even more profound, his martial path, purer.
Although Xu Yan seemingly cultivated orthodox martial arts, he also extracted the essence of Physical Body Martial Arts, Alchemical Medical Martial Arts, Qimen Martial Art, purifying his own martial path.
Among the four disciples, the one who was most likely to carve out a unique path in martial arts was undoubtedly Xu Yan.
His martial path was extremely pure, and even when integrating the essences of other martial arts techniques into his own, he remained on a path of extreme martial purity.
Xu Yan and Meng Chong exchanged moves, each displaying their divine skills. After this exchange, they had gained new insights into their divine skills.
"Master!"
After the exchange was over and they returned to the flying boat, Meng Chong excitedly spoke.
"Hmm, not bad!"
Li Xuan nodded his head.
Meng Chong grinned, feeling relieved in his heart—he hadn't disappointed his master too much!
"Meng Chong! You're so awesome, you're so fierce!"
Zi Yun hopped over excitedly, hanging onto Meng Chong's body and caressing him with her hands.
Meng Chong pulled her off, "Stop messing around!"
"Hehe..."
Zi Yun chuckled with a mischievous laugh.
The second senior brother had also achieved a breakthrough, which suddenly put some pressure on Su Lingxiu. If the fourth junior brother also made a breakthrough, wouldn't that make her, the senior sister, appear too weak?
"I need to enter seclusion, I want to break through to the divine realm!"
Su Lingxiu went off to cultivate diligently.
She was just a bit shy of gathering the full foundation necessary for a breakthrough to the Divine Skill Realm.
After Meng Chong's breakthrough in the Divine Skill Realm, the subsequent cultivation of the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body was also to be perfected.
The Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship continued to drift, heading toward Yuzhou.
As soon as they entered Yuzhou, Su Lingxiu had her breakthrough opportunity.
"Your disciple Su Lingxiu has cultivated the martial arts techniques you compiled, breaking through to the Divine Skill Realm, and your Primordial Spirit has been amplified a hundredfold!"
Boom!
With the feedback from the Daoist Golden Book, Li Xuan's Primordial Spirit instantly increased a hundredfold, and on the Spirit Pedestal, his Primordial Spirit's form now resembled no different from his physical body.
Even separated from the physical body, you couldn't tell the difference between the Primordial Spirit and the physical form.
"Divine powers a hundredfold stronger, physical body a hundredfold stronger, Primordial Spirit a hundredfold stronger—this comprehensive hundredfold enhancement feels great!"
Li Xuan appeared calm and composed on the outside, undisturbed, but inside he was incredibly thrilled.
"I really want to fight against an Immortal Heavenly Venerable to gauge the strength of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable"
Although he had never encountered an Immortal Heavenly Venerable and didn't fully understand their power, Li Xuan was confident that with his current strength, it wouldn't be a problem to defeat an Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
"Your disciple Su Lingxiu has thoroughly sublimated and evolved into the Evergreen Sacred Bone during her breakthrough to the Divine Skill Realm, and you have obtained the Innate Indestructible Sacred Bone!"
As expected, every evolution and breakthrough of his disciples followed a pattern, advancing in a certain direction.
The next realm's breakthrough will be the evolution into a Sacred Body.
And he, too, will obtain an Innate Indestructible Sacred Body!
"If the cultivation and evolution continue, what kind of constitution will it transform into?"
Li Xuan could hardly imagine, as if there truly were no limits.
"This girl Su Lingxiu is an Alchemical Medical Warrior, not known for her killing power, but she isn't without the ability to kill. What divine skill will she birth?"
Li Xuan silently observed Su Lingxiu's breakthrough.
"Your disciple Su Lingxiu has broken through to the Divine Skill Realm and birthed the divine skill 'Life and Death Reversal,' and you have obtained the 'Life and Death Reversal' skill!"
Life and Death Reversal!
"This divine skill isn't bad."
The Life and Death Reversal divine skill could reverse life and death, transfer injuries, as well as snatch away and bestow vitality.
It could both heal and save lives, as well as kill invisibly.
It could also transfer and reverse damages targeting oneself, with profound mysteries within it.
"Your disciple Su Lingxiu has broken through to the Divine Skill Realm and birthed the divine skill 'Domain Spirit Flame,' and you too have obtained the 'Domain Spirit Flame'!"
As Su Lingxiu's second divine skill, Domain Spirit Flame emerged from the Spirit Pedestal, which could merge with the domain and spiritual energy without revealing its presence, its uses both alchemy and lethal.
"Though it's not as powerful as my Evergreen Divine Fire, this Domain Spirit Flame is also quite extraordinary, and it can also transform as strength increases."
The Daoist Golden Book certified the divine skill Domain Spirit Flame as an inevitable divine skill for Alchemical Medical Warriors. Other warriors reaching the Divine Skill Realm would also give birth to such a skill.
Of course, even if it's the same Domain Spirit Flame or other related flame divine skills, their strength and ranks differ.
Su Lingxiu was undoubtedly the one with the highest level of Domain Spirit Flame among Alchemical Medical Warriors, aside from him.
"Your disciple Su Lingxiu has broken through to the Divine Skill Realm, giving birth to the 'Divine Furnace Hundred Refinements' divine skill, and you have gained 'Divine Furnace Hundred Refinements'!"
The third divine skill of Su Lingxiu, 'Divine Furnace Hundred Refinements', is a unique skill that can refine higher quality pills, purify all things between heaven and earth, and even transform life and death, among countless other wondrous uses.
As long as one's strength is sufficiently mighty and continues to ascend, even the Imperishable Qi could be refined.
"Not bad!"
Li Xuan nodded silently to himself.
The three divine skills Su Lingxiu had birthed were not focused on slaughter, but that did not mean they lacked the power to kill.
"Your disciple Su Lingxiu has broken through the Divine Skill Realm, giving birth to the 'Stellar Heavenly Light' divine skill, and you have gained 'Stellar Heavenly Light'."
Li Xuan was surprised for a moment, as another skill with offensive characteristics had been born.
'Stellar Heavenly Light', a divine skill known for its strong ability to conceal, hidden within the Domain, can unleash starlight as sharp as needles, killing invisibly in the blink of an eye.
"Using 'Stellar Heavenly Light' to heal others is also feasible, and it can even treat many people at the same time over a large area."
Li Xuan mused to himself.
Using 'Stellar Heavenly Light' to administer the Golden Needle Transference Technique could also work; the starlight needle array, dense and extensive, could treat a large group of people with Golden Needles all at once.
"The last divine skill is left."
Li Xuan had a guess about Su Lingxiu's final divine skill—it must be a movement technique.
After all, Su Lingxiu had also comprehended The Eight Diagrams and had achieved insight into a cultivation technique.
The birth of divine skills is connected to the Martial Arts one practices.
"Your disciple Su Lingxiu has broken through the Divine Skill Realm, giving birth to 'Illusion Thousand Directions' divine skill, and you have gained 'Illusion Thousand Directions'."
As expected, Su Lingxiu's fifth divine skill was indeed a movement technique.
'Illusion Thousand Directions' allows one to conjure numerous illusions with a single thought, making it impossible for enemies to locate the true body, vanishing without a trace in an instant.
With the birth of the fifth divine skill, Su Lingxiu completely broke through the Divine Realm. Among the four disciples, three were already in the Divine Skill Realm.
Only Fang Hao, who practiced Qimen Martial Art, was slightly behind.
But Fang Hao wasn't far from taking the next step either.
After her breakthrough, Su Lingxiu returned to the Flying Boat, brimming with excitement.
"Master!"
She looked eagerly at her master, waiting for his appraisal.
"Pretty good."
Li Xuan nodded slightly in response.
"Master, you're being perfunctory!"
Su Lingxiu frowned slightly.
"No, really, it's quite good!"
Li Xuan showed a look of helplessness on his face.
"Junior sister, what divine skills have you given birth to?"
Meng Chong asked curiously.
"None of them are for killing people!"
Su Lingxiu sighed.
Her aura flickered, and a faint shimmer of black and white light flashed by.
Meng Chong's expression tightened—in that instant, his own divine energy surged immeasurably, and his own divine skills manifested rapidly, showing that the black and white light posed no small threat to him.
"Seizing life essence?"
Meng Chong said in surprise.
"Not just that, it can also grant life essence, transfer damage, and even reverse life and death..."
Su Lingxiu became more and more delighted as she spoke.
She raised her slender hand, and a pale cyan flame burned in her palm.
In no time, the flame disappeared into the Domain, almost leaving no trace to be found.
"With the Spirit Flame of the Domain, alchemy becomes much easier. I can refine purer and higher-quality pills..."
Then, Su Lingxiu demonstrated the 'Divine Furnace Hundred Refinements' divine skill.
"Junior sister, you actually have such a concealed offensive divine skill?"
Xu Yan exclaimed in surprise.
"Big senior brother, you noticed?"
Su Lingxiu was visibly bothered.
As she focused her thoughts, starlight as sharp as needles densely surrounded the area, ensconcing everyone within a starlight halo.
Du Yuying and the others felt their scalps tingle; they had no idea how or when these star points appeared and surrounded them.
Even the Red Cat started to bristle!
Only in the instant when the starlight appeared did it realize the attack—if the starlight had really targeted it, it would probably have been pricked into a porcupine by now.

chapters.title: Chapter 672 - 357 Changes of the Great Wilderness
chapters.content:
With Su Lingxiu's breakthrough, the Flying Boat continued on its way to Zheng Country, Yuzhou.
Yuzhou, now far from what it was when it first entered the Spiritual Realm, had three large cities erected within it, each equipped with a Teleportation Formation—a symbol of prosperity and the most bustling area within Yuzhou.
Yu Gao and Shen Tai had become the strongest entities in Yuzhou, upholding its order.
Zheng Country maintained its independent existence, preserving its unique status, though now it not only fell under the governance of the Transcendent Spirit Sect but also the overarching authority of the Wanshi Alliance.
The disappearance of the Spiritual Realm Gate was something only a select few at the very pinnacle of the Spiritual Realm knew about.
And a decree was issued that no one was allowed to open the Spiritual Realm Gate without permission.
Moreover, it was falsely claimed that a Supreme Expert acted, sealing the method to open the Spiritual Realm Gate, making it impossible to open without the Yu Ling.
"I wonder how the Great Wilderness is faring now?"
Xu Yan was beginning to miss his parents.
Having been in the Spiritual Realm for so many years, the mother-son beads he left behind had not shattered, meaning they had not encountered any uncontrollable danger.
With the Divine Bridge soon to open, he was about to travel to its other shore. Parting this time, he didn't know when he would be able to return to the Great Wilderness again.
"The closure of the Spiritual Realm Gate is a good thing, as it prevents certain crises."
With his parents in the Great Wilderness and Spiritual Realm warriors unable to enter, naturally, they posed no threat to the Great Wilderness's stabilizing power, ensuring his family would not face danger.
Furthermore, as time passed and his family's strength improved, especially if they managed to break into the Divine Skill Realm, then the warriors of the Spiritual Realm would pose no threat to the Great Wilderness.
Nor would they endanger the safety of his family.
Though the spiritual energy in the Great Wilderness was sparse, it only meant that cultivation would be somewhat slower, unlike the Inner Domain and Spiritual Realm warriors, who would find it impossible to break through after reaching a certain realm.
Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship arrived at the location of the Spiritual Realm Gate.
Looking down, Li Xuan saw the formation unchanged; the Spiritual Realm Gate might have been closed, but through his eyes, it was laid bare as if two forces of the Domain Laws closed it shut.
With a mere gesture of his hand, his power at the Void-breaking Realm allowed him to reconfigure the formation covering the Spiritual Realm Gate.
After his adjustments, even the Immortal Heavenly Venerable could not hope to open the Spiritual Realm Gate.
The barrier between the Spiritual Realm and the Inner Domain was a product of the Domain Laws; with the strength of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, he probably didn't need to pass through the Spiritual Realm Gate to enter the Inner Domain.
Therefore, Li Xuan prepared to reinforce this barrier to ensure that even the Immortal Heavenly Venerable could not cross it.
"Master, I'll go open the Spiritual Realm Gate," Xu Yan said.
"No need!"
Li Xuan shook his head and pointed forward, causing space to shatter instantly. A pitch-black space appeared in midair, into which the Flying Boat flew directly.
As the Flying Boat entered, the opened space began to heal.
"This is Void-breaking. Reflect on it carefully!" Li Xuan said, looking at Xu Yan and Meng Chong.
"Yes, Master!" Xu Yan and Meng Chong were internally shaken. Was this Void-breaking?
With just a gentle tap, they ripped through the void, crossing space directly!
On Evergreen Pavilion, everyone was profoundly shocked yet excited, feeling honored to witness a senior exhibiting some of his power.
Indeed!
When suppressing the Seductive Witch, the senior had not even displayed one ten-thousandth of his power.
Boom!
The Flying Boat passed through the void and emerged through a void portal, having traversed the barrier to enter the Great Wilderness.
Instantly feeling the thinness of nature's spiritual energy compared to the abundant spiritual energy they were accustomed to in the Spiritual Realm caused everyone to frown involuntarily.
"So, this is Void-breaking," Xu Yan mused, still immersed in the recent shattering of space.
"Void-breaking is difficult to understand. Master showed it because he saw me breaking the Divine Realm, to let me witness Void-breaking firsthand and gain a more direct understanding of the mystery of the Void-breaking Realm," Xu Yan realized.
Li Xuan looked up at the firmament. The spiritual energy in the Great Wilderness had thinned somewhat, related to the separation from the Taicang Domain, but this was not an immutable situation.
He could not change it when his power was insufficient.
Now, he could.
Having mastered the Domain Laws and grasped some of the Domain Dao Principles, he could enhance the spiritual energy of the Great Wilderness to a new level. Though difficult, it was not impossible.
"Since this is the Great Wilderness, I might as well take this opportunity to improve the concentration of spiritual energy," Li Xuan decided.
The stronger the Great Wilderness became, the more benefits he would reap.
"At last, we're back. Let's head to Canglan Island!" exclaimed Xu Yan, coming out of his contemplation and speaking enthusiastically.
The Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Boat turned into a streak of light, aiming for Canglan Island.
...
On Canglan Island, as usual, it was peaceful and serene.
Although Xu Yan had left the Great Wilderness, his deterrence remained. With the backing of the strong warriors from the Great Wilderness Martial Arts Institute, Heavenly Treasure Pavilion, and many other formidable individuals, any occasional disturbances were quickly quelled.
The notion of the Great Wilderness had long taken root in people's hearts.
Gradually, almost no one mentioned the term "Inner Realm" anymore.
Especially children born in the last decade, or youths who had only recently embarked upon the path of martial arts, were almost entirely unaware of the Inner Realm's name, knowing only the Great Wilderness.
Moreover, legends about the Great Wilderness were spreading among these young people.
Some of the former Inner Domain warriors staunchly adhered to the Inner Realm Martial Arts Techniques, while others struggled by all means to switch to practicing Great Wilderness Martial Arts. Regardless, the Inner Domain was gradually being abandoned and seldom mentioned.
With the unification of the Great Wilderness, a consistent order and laws were established. The most renowned among them was undoubtedly the Great Wilderness Martial Arts Academy, where many talented youths aspired to refine their skills.

chapters.title: Chapter 673 - 357 Changes in the Great Wilderness_2
chapters.content:
The Great Wilderness Martial Arts Academy of today is no longer the Seven-star Study Palace of the past; the criteria for recruiting martial arts students have been further elevated, and only prodigies can gain entry.
Starting from this year, the Great Wilderness has implemented new policies.
In every city and town across the Great Wilderness, schools have been established, popularizing education and martial arts.
Moreover, they have clearly defined the hierarchy of school levels.
From the time children enter school, they can advance to higher-level academies through assessments, ultimately aiming to be admitted to the Great Wilderness Martial Arts Academy.
Those who enter the Great Wilderness Academy are without exception one of the top prodigies in the entire Great Wilderness.
The martial arts sects across the land still exist, but some of the weaker sects have already experienced crises in continuing their legacies.
Since they all have to practice the Great Wilderness Martial Arts, why would they need to enter a sect and accept so many restrictions?
To survive, the sects, with their unique talents and charms, are racking their brains to research and develop martial arts techniques that conform to the Great Wilderness Martial Arts.
