For example, certain powerful palm and fist techniques, among others.
Originally, sects with profound heritage, using Inner Realm Martial Arts as a reference and their sect's techniques as a foundation, quickly developed techniques more suited to Great Wilderness Martial Arts.
Furthermore, some sects have, with these researched techniques, defeated one Great Wilderness Warrior after another, establishing their sect's status.
As every major sect steps up their game, this leads to a rapid accumulation of various martial skills, secret techniques, and combat strategies in Great Wilderness Martial Arts, becoming increasingly abundant and diversified.
Every place in the Great Wilderness is caught up in this upsurge, except for Canglan Island, which remains as it always was.
In the Great Wilderness, aside from the Academy, another undeniable Holy Land of Martial Arts is Canglan Island.
But no one dares to rashly visit Canglan Island; only those at the very pinnacle have the right to call upon it.
"The Divine Intent Realm is indeed challenging!"
On Canglan Island, Xu Junhe sighed.
He had reached the pinnacle of the Tongxuan Realm, but was stuck at the threshold of the Divine Intent Realm, unable to break through.
Although with his current strength, he was among the very top of the Great Wilderness, and the martial arts techniques he mastered—whether in swordsmanship, palm techniques, or movement technique—far surpassed other warriors.
Yet, without entering the Divine Intent Realm, he could not ultimately suppress the entire Great Wilderness alone.
"The Divine Intent Realm is indeed difficult!"
Kou Ruozhi followed with a sigh of his own.
He too had reached the peak of the Tongxuan Realm.
"Has the Great Wilderness been stable recently?"
Xu Junhe asked.
"It's been just over a decade; the deterrence still lingers. Who dares cause trouble? Even if there are those who want to do something, they wouldn't act rashly. They need to weigh their own abilities," Kou Ruozhi said with a smile.
Xu Junhe nodded.
The once strong figures of the Inner Domain, even if they harbored some thoughts, wouldn't dare to take any action.
The top powerhouses all belong to the Great Wilderness and heed the orders of Canglan Island.
"It's been over a decade; I wonder how the Spiritual Realm is doing," Kou Ruozhi said, curiosity on his face.
The Spiritual Realm gave those from the Inner Domain a very negative impression, which is one of the reasons why those strong figures from the Inner Domain were willing to stay rather than go to the Spiritual Realm.
After all, being there was like being worse than pigs and dogs!
With that being the case, why not stay in the Inner Domain and continue to hold high positions?
Perhaps, when their lifespan is almost exhausted, they will develop a desperate desire to break through—even being worse than pigs and dogs would be a price worth paying, right?
But for now, those powerhouses are not yet desperate to that extent.
Moreover, Great Wilderness Martial Arts have given them hope.
Xu Junhe fell silent. Since Xu Yan entered the Spiritual Realm, there has been no news, and no way to establish contact.
Only in times of crisis would one crush a 'parent-child bea'd to send a simple message.
But since there has been no crisis, there is no need to crush the 'parent-child bea'd.
"With a senior there, nothing would have happened," Xu Junhe said with a smile.
Kou Ruozhi nodded.
After discussing some recent policies and making several arrangements, Kou Ruozhi left to head to the capital of the Great Wilderness to assist Guo Rongshan with managing the affairs of state and other matters.
"Only by breaking through to the Divine Intent Realm can I truly feel at ease," Xu Junhe murmured to himself.
When Xu Yan will return, or if he will return at all, remains uncertain.
My son has grown up and wants to venture out into this vast world, to pursue the Martial Arts he holds dear in his heart, and when he might return home for a visit remains an unknown.
Once too much time passes by, some people who are unable to continue making breakthroughs and face their own mortality might begin to harbor certain thoughts.
At such times, only by having overwhelming strength can one suppress these ideas.
Only by breaking through to the Divine Intent Realm can one possess such strength.
As for the Divine Origin Realm, that's far too distant, with no known time on when the breakthrough can occur.
Just breaking through to the Divine Intent Realm would be enough to dominate the unbeatable Great Wilderness.
"Madam, you should spend more time cultivating,"
In the Spirit Fruit Forest of Canglan Island, Xu Junhe watched his wife with a helpless expression.
More than a decade had passed, Mother Xu still looked as youthful as ever, but her strength had improved quite a bit, having reached the Perfection of the Innate Realm.
In recent years, she had been in the Spirit Fruit Forest, drawing Formation Diagrams and delving into the study of Formations,
seemingly making some gains.
"Cultivating is too tiresome. I'd rather continue researching Formation Diagrams. The Innate Realm is long-lived enough, and besides, I'll be able to break through in a few years, so what's the rush?"
Mother Xu glanced at her husband with dissatisfaction.
Xu Junhe had a look of resignation and could only let her be, turning to ask, "Madam, have you made any progress with your research into formations?"
"Of course, I have. It's just that I'm lacking some materials, or else I could have set it up by now."
As soon as Mother Xu started talking about formations, she proudly said,
then sighed suddenly, "I don't know when Yan'er or Red Cat will return."
"They should be back soon,"
Xu Junhe said with a smile.
Mother Xu gave him a look, "You've been saying that for years."
Immediately, she sighed again, "Yan'er is fixated on Martial Arts, venturing in the Spiritual Realm, how could he return so quickly? It might take decades, or even a century."
Xu Junhe fell silent.
The Flying Boat headed straight for Canglan Island, observing the drastic changes in the Great Wilderness along the way.
Every ten thousand miles stood a huge city, established by the Great Wilderness in various regions, with each city governing tens of thousands of miles around it.
And every hundred thousand miles, there was an even bigger city, ruling over ten cities, each bustling immensely.
"The Great Wilderness has changed so much, and although the Spiritual Energy is thinner, in terms of prosperity, it's not inferior to the Spiritual Realm,"
Xu Yan exclaimed.
The changes in the Great Wilderness would continue unabated, the region itself was vast and boundless.
The cities were built on strategic locations, connected and commanding each other, and there were even more wild, seldom trodden places that were usually where Spiritual Medicines were harvested.
"That's an Elixir Field."
Meng Shushu pointed ahead to the medicinal fields carved out between the mountains as she spoke.
"Upon my return, I should impart more knowledge to the Great Wilderness,"
Du Yuying said with a beaming smile.
After all, the Spiritual Realm was more prosperous than the Great Wilderness and its Martial Arts more flourishing, with more advanced methods of cultivating Spiritual Medicines. This return was just the right opportunity to bring these advancements back to the Great Wilderness.
Cai Ling'er and Yue'er were somewhat surprised.
Xu Yan and the others, it seemed, came from the legendary Inner Domain?
The Inner Domain, to have produced such a prodigious figure?
Their gazes shifted to Li Xuan, and then they understood; where a high-caliber individual resided naturally became a land of blessings, producing prodigies was no surprise at all.
"The Inner Domain is vast, with so many cities. If each city had a Teleportation Formation, connected with each other, it would facilitate the flow of people and even more prosperity.
"Unfortunately, I didn't ask Brother Bai for some Teleportation Formations,"
Xu Yan said with a tinge of regret.
Such matters as setting up formations naturally were not something to trouble his master with.
The Flying Boat became a pale green streak of light, heading towards Canglan Island, intentionally slowing down to survey the changes in the Great Wilderness along the way.
Inside a certain Prefecture City, the boisterous new branch of the Great Wilderness Martial Arts Academy was filled with a clamor of voices and a gathering of strong individuals, where the pride of this prefecture eagerly awaited their assessments.
Bai Yunkong sat at the forefront, personally visiting this branch academy and watching the arriving prodigies with satisfaction. Among these talents, a small number would be admitted to the Great Wilderness Academy, becoming members of the institution.
Students from the Great Wilderness Academy were the individuals the region emphasized on nurturing, the true cornerstone of the Great Wilderness, bearing the responsibility of maintaining and strengthening the domain.
Suddenly, his expression sharpened, and his heart skipped a beat.
In the sky, a pale green light was passing by, and that light was extraordinary!
Without attracting any attention, he nodded to the academy's dean and excused himself. He did not alarm the others, and his figure soared into the sky in an instant, chasing after the streak of light.

chapters.title: Chapter 674 - 358 Reunion on Canglan Island
chapters.content:
The Flying Boat shot through the sky like a streak of light, and Xu Yan turned to look back, smiling as he said, "An old acquaintance has arrived."
Bai Yunkong, the headmaster of the Great Wilderness Martial Arts Institute, hadn't seen much change in his strength over the years, but the Martial Arts he practiced had become different, neither the Inner Realm Martial Arts nor the pure Great Wilderness Martial Arts.
He was trying to break the shackles of the Inner Domain, attempting to advance beyond the Minor Celestial Realm.
Of course, if he were to break through, he wouldn't be called a Minor Celestial, but a Pseudo Divine Intent, which would be a more fitting description.
The speed of the Flying Boat slowed down.
It was only when he drew near the radiant light that Bai Yunkong realized this was an immense vessel he had never heard of before, its entire body radiating light, imposing and dominant.
It was a sight that inspired awe!
Surely such a Flying Boat didn't exist in the Inner Domain!
"Could it be from the Spiritual Realm?"
Bai Yunkong's heart sank, but if the Spiritual Realm Gate had opened, news would have quickly spread.
However, there was no news of the Spiritual Realm Gate opening.
Even if something had happened at the Heavenly Treasure Pavilion that prevented them from sending a message, the scouts they had arranged should have delivered the news immediately.
The Flying Boat in front slowed down, obviously having noticed his presence.
At this moment, Bai Yunkong's heart was filled with trepidation, hesitating to move forward.
"Headmaster Bai, it's been many years, but you seem to have become more timid," a familiar voice called out.
Bai Yunkong was startled and then saw a familiar figure on the Flying Boat ahead!
Xu Yan!
"Xu Yan?!"
Bai Yunkong was overjoyed and hurriedly approached the Flying Boat.
"You're back?"
Xu Yan said with a smiling face, "Just came back to take a look!"
After boarding the Flying Boat, Bai Yunkong saw Li Xuan and hurriedly bowed in respect.
Li Xuan nodded his head.
Then, he saw other familiar faces, Meng Chong, Su Lingxiu, Du Yuying, Yun Miaomiao, and others were all on the Flying Boat.
Xie Lingfeng from Sword Venerate Cliff was also there.
Bai Yunkong glanced quickly at the people on the Flying Boat; there were old acquaintances as well as strangers.
For instance, the peerlessly beautiful woman attending to an elder did not seem like a woman of the Human Clan.
Following that, he was greatly astonished by the Flying Boat beneath his feet.
Is this something only found in the Spiritual Realm?
"This is a Flying Boat, refined by my junior brother, it doesn't exist in the Spiritual Realm," Xu Yan explained with a smile.
"Junior brother?"
Bai Yunkong instinctively looked towards Meng Chong.
"Definitely not me. The junior brother our master took in the Spiritual Realm isn't here," Meng Chong rolled his eyes. How could this old man think he had refined the Flying Boat?
"I see!"
Bai Yunkong inwardly exclaimed, a great person is indeed a great person.
Even after going to the Spiritual Realm, he's still peerless.
The Flying Boat obviously didn't exist in the Spiritual Realm, indicating it was crafted according to a Dharma bestowed by a great elder.
A reunion with old friends naturally led to catching up on old times.
Bai Yunkong spoke of the changes in the Great Wilderness over the years. Now, the Great Wilderness was divided into thirty-six counties, each with a massive Prefecture City. Under each Prefecture City, there were ten government cities, and under those were numerous counties and towns.
With the Great Wilderness united, order had been established, and the laws were continuously being improved. The Martial Arts were also developing constantly, and the new Martial Artists were all practicing Great Wilderness Martial Arts.
As Bai Yunkong was detailing the changes in the Great Wilderness, Xu Yan and the others couldn't help but feel astonished at how much had changed in just over a decade.
These years had not all been peaceful; upheavals occasionally occurred, instigated by the steadfast adherents of the Inner Realm Martial Arts and by some with malicious intent.
However, the scale was not large, and they were quickly suppressed.
The strongest ninety-nine percent of the Inner Domain had joined the Great Wilderness, and the rest were unable to cause any significant trouble.
Xu Yan also saw some potential worries. After all, there were many Martial Artists in the Inner Domain. If they saw no hope in practicing Great Wilderness Martial Arts and found their paths cut off, they would inevitably harbor certain thoughts.
Especially those top Martial Artists of the Inner Domain were driven to despair by the Spiritual Realm, not willing to live like beasts, but the Great Wilderness Martial Arts had given them hope, hence they supported it.
If they were unable to break through, and their lifespans were drawing to a close, they would likely start to develop dangerous ideas and cause various problems.
However, all of this would no longer be a problem with his return.
With Xu Yan's current understanding of Martial Arts, he had enough insight to guide these people on a path of Martial Arts, even if it wasn't orthodox Great Wilderness Martial Arts, as long as they could continue to improve.
As for how far they could go, it all depended on their talent and aptitude.
If the aptitude was too poor, it was nobody else's fault.
To address these potential threats, personal strength was key. Therefore, on this return trip, Xu Yan intended to offer guidance to his father and others, enhancing their strength to be capable of suppressing the Great Wilderness.
How to train his confidants and cultivate loyal prodigies no longer required his concern; whether it was his grandfather or his father, they understood more than he did.
After Bai Yunkong finished introducing the current situation of the Great Wilderness, he curiously asked, "Xu Yan, what is your current strength?"
Xu Yan smiled and replied, "An undisputed strength in the Spiritual Realm!"
Bai Yunkong was astounded and then sighed with admiration, it was indeed Xu Yan who, even in the Spiritual Realm, remained unmatched.
Truly worthy of being the direct disciple of a great person!
"Headmaster Bai, I encountered the ancestor of your Seven-star Study Palace in the Spiritual Realm," Xu Yan said cheerfully.
"Oh, how is the ancestor doing?" Bai Yunkong asked, not inquiring about the ancestor's strength.
It was certain that he couldn't compare to Xu Yan.
Xu Yan had claimed he was an undisputed force in the Spiritual Realm, indicating the ancestor surely was among those suppressed.
It just wasn't clear if the ancestor had offended Xu Yan and gotten suppressed.
"He's doing well; he's no longer concerned with the academy or spreading Martial Arts but is seeking his destined partner!"

chapters.title: Chapter 675 - 358 Reunion on Canglan Island_2
chapters.content:
Xu Yan sighed and lamented.
Wu Tianan, too, was a man blessed with good fortune.
Drawn into the world of martial arts because of a woman, he rose up until his peak, when he fell from grace. Yet he managed to rise once more, stabilizing the limit of the Spiritual Realm, and then, by chance, received guidance from his own master, forming a good karma.
He must certainly be a person with extraordinary destiny.
"So that's how it is!"
Bai Yunkong nodded. Ancestors were too far in the past; there was nothing left to reminisce about.
Now, the Seven-star Study Palace had become a thing of history; today it is the Great Wilderness Martial Arts Academy.
He is the first dean of the Great Wilderness Martial Arts Academy!
"Dean Bai, your martial arts journey has been correct, but also not quite right …"
Since they had met, Xu Yan also offered some guidance.
With his guidance, it wouldn't be long before Bai Yunkong could break through the pseudo Divine Intent Realm.
Bai Yunkong was overjoyed, his expression full of attentive eagerness, not daring to miss a single detail. Xu Yan's guidance was like pointing them—warriors of the Inner Realm—towards the path ahead in their martial journey.
As long as there is a path forward, there is hope!
Though he could let go and wouldn't harbor any ulterior thoughts, the same could not be said for some others.
Of course, for the time being, no one had entertained any other thoughts, as they had yet to feel the despair of a closed path ahead.
After receiving Xu Yan's guidance, Bai Yunkong had a moment of enlightenment.
So it is!
He didn't practice Inner Realm Martial Arts and nor did he cultivate the pure Great Wilderness Martial Arts. Yet he could also break through and continue to enhance his strength and improve his realm.
The path ahead was already before his eyes!
…
As usual, Canglan Island was undisturbed, with no one daring to cause trouble.
Xu Junhe was diligently cultivating, hoping to break through the Divine Intent Realm soon, while Mother Xu, as always, was pondering over formation diagrams in the Spirit Fruit orchard.
Suddenly!
A streak of light descended.
Xu Junhe moved and appeared above Canglan Island. Watching the streak of light arrive, he was stunned.
What is this?
"Dad, Mom!"
The figure of Xu Yan appeared.
"Yan'er!"
Xu Junhe was overjoyed.
The Flying Boat landed on an open space on Canglan Island, shrinking continuously as it descended.
"Yan'er!"
Mother Xu's face was filled with excitement as she took Xu Yan's hands, looking him over from left to right. Seeing that her treasured son was unharmed, she finally breathed a sigh of relief.
"Greetings, elder!"
After his excitement, Xu Junhe respectfully greeted Li Xuan.
"Hmm!"
Li Xuan nodded his head.
Stepping off the Flying Boat, Canglan Island remained as it was, the Spirit Fruit orchard lusher than ever. Glancing at the Formation Diagram Mother Xu was drawing, he was slightly surprised.
He hadn't expected that Xu Yan's mother had some talent for formations.
After a long separation, their reunion was naturally joyous. Feasts were laid out on Canglan Island, all made from Spirit Fruits and spiritual ingredients.
However, for those accustomed to higher-grade spiritual items in the Spiritual Realm, the spiritual food on Canglan Island wasn't very enticing.
But it was all for the joy of the gathering.
"Red Cat!"
Mother Xu happily rubbed the plump head of Red Cat, lifting it up in her arms.
"Oh, Red Cat, you've gotten so much heavier!"
Mother Xu was overjoyed and took out pills to feed Red Cat.
Having tasted high-end pills, the somewhat lower-grade pills didn't quite suit Red Cat's palate, but since Mother Xu offered them, it swallowed them without complaints.
Yue'er watched Red Cat with a look of amusement on her face. The king of the Demon Clan in the Spiritual Realm, the mighty Great Demon King, now behaved like a docile, chubby cat!
Mother Xu's strength wasn't formidable, and with Red Cat's power, it likely couldn't be lifted by her, which indicated that Red Cat had restrained its strength, allowing Mother Xu to pick it up.
Li Xuan wasn't surprised by this. Mother Xu was indeed very indulgent with Red Cat, spoiling it even more than Su Lingxiu. Back on Canglan Island, most of the pills Red Cat got were from Mother Xu.
Mother Xu had taught it to read, and Red Cat had a deep affection for her.
At that moment, Red Cat was contemplating a problem – in founding the Demon Clan, it seemed to have forgotten about Mother Xu.
"Decided, she's the Honored Mother of my Demon Clan. Whoever dares to show disrespect, I'll kill them!"
Red Cat made a decision.
Xu Yan's mother was the Honored Mother of the Demon Clan. If the Demon Clan was in trouble and Xu Yan didn't take action, wouldn't it be unacceptable?
"Meow meow!"
Red Cat sat in front of Mother Xu, taking out one Spirit Fruit after another, all of which it had collected from the Spiritual Realm, offerings from the Tian Nan Demon Clan to him, the Great Demon King.
"These Spirit Fruits!"
Mother Xu knew at a glance that these were not ordinary fruits that could be compared with those from the Great Wilderness.
"Red Cat has learned to be filial!"
Mother Xu was filled with joy.
For Xu Yan, what mattered was his mother's happiness; everything else was unimportant.
He approved of Red Cat's actions and didn't regret that his mother had doted on it so much in the past.
On Canglan Island, the atmosphere was warm and jubilant as Xu Yan and his companions recounted their experiences and shared news of the Spiritual Realm.
Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao were especially eager to please in front of Mother Xu.
Yue'er, too, shuffled over to join them.
Time flew by, and it had been half a month since they returned to Canglan Island. Guo Rongshan, Kou Ruozhi, and others also arrived on Canglan Island. They gathered together, planning the future direction for the Great Wilderness.
The spiritual items brought from the Spiritual Realm, as well as the refined pills, were also being distributed.
Formations were laid out on Canglan Island.
Several Array Plates were then handed to Guo Rongshan, who was taught how to set up formations, instructing him to arrange them at key locations.
With the Array Plates, setting up formations was an incredibly simple task, so he quickly mastered it.
To prevent the Array Plates from being stolen and used against them, these plates were enhanced with owner recognition capabilities. Once bound, they would not be taken or used to control the formations by others.

chapters.title: Chapter 676 - 358 Reunion on Canglan Island_3
chapters.content:
Before returning to the Great Wilderness, I had specifically asked Fang Hao to refine an Array Plate, and now it came in handy.
In the Spirit Fruit forest, Li Xuan took some time to instruct Mother Xu on the arrangement of formations. After his instructions, Mother Xu had actually mastered it and could arrange the most basic formation.
Since she had learned how to set up formations, and the treasures required for setting up formations were not difficult to refine—just requiring more time and materials to practice.
Of course, the formation that Mother Xu mastered was only the most basic, but it was enough for her use in the Great Wilderness.
Li Xuan then gave her a small booklet on formations, allowing Mother Xu to study it slowly.
The Spiritual Energy on Canglan Island became much denser, which was due to the arrangement of formations that converged Spiritual Energy.
With a single thought, Li Xuan changed the domain of Canglan Island, turning it into a convergence point for Spiritual Energy, making Canglan Island truly a Martial Art Holy Land of the Great Wilderness from that day forward.
Xu Yan began to instruct his parents in cultivation, but after listening for a while, Mother Xu became distracted and eventually said directly, "Yan'er, pass it on to your dad, and later he can tell me about it."
After saying that, she went off to find Red Cat.
Xu Yan was helpless in this matter, but since his mother's temperament was such, he decided it was best to let her do as she pleased.
He resolved Xu Junhe's confusion about Martial Arts and taught him techniques for Divine Skill Realm, Physiognomy Realm, and Void-breaking Realm.
The Physiognomy and Void-breaking Realms only required memorizing the Martial Arts Techniques. Given Xu Junhe's current stage, it was impossible for him to comprehend them; even rote memorization was difficult.
It took a long time to memorize the Martial Arts Techniques.
Xu Yan focused on explaining the techniques for Divine Origin Realm and Divine Skill Realm, which Xu Junhe could fully engrave in his memory.
Once the explanation was over, Xu Junhe began his Breakthrough into the Divine Intent Realm.
With the aid of higher-tier pills for cultivation, breaking through the Divine Skill Realm was just a matter of time, and higher Martial Arts Realms were not something to be considered at this stage.
Xu Yan's thoughts were simple: when his own strength increased, he would then guide his parents in cultivation or find higher-tier treasures for them, so they could naturally continue to break through.
A day later, Xu Junhe broke through the Divine Intent Realm, truly standing at the pinnacle of the Great Wilderness.
Guo Rongshan was also breaking through the Tongxuan Realm.
Having started Martial Arts at an older age and having to deal with the affairs of the Great Wilderness, his cultivation had inevitably been neglected for some time.
Kou Ruozhi, being the person in charge of the Evergreen Pavilion in the Great Wilderness, naturally received guidance from Su Lingxiu. This included the other apprentices of the Evergreen Pavilion, who were improving their Alchemy under Su Lingxiu's instructions to refine more pills.
Meng Chong, having nothing else to do, also instructed others in Martial Arts.
With Xu Yan's return, the core members of the Canglan Island faction in the Great Wilderness saw their strengths substantially increase.
Xu Yan began to arrange various affairs to ensure that even in his absence, the Great Wilderness would not fall into chaos, and even if chaos were to arise, Canglan Island would be able to ensure safety and even suppress everything.
He personally went to the Great Wilderness Martial Arts Academy and instructed the trusted prodigies cultivated by Xu Junhe and others over the years, bestowing them with pills and Spiritual Artifacts.
He also met with the Pavilion Master of the Heavenly Treasure Pavilion and a host of other powerful individuals at the Great Wilderness Martial Arts Academy. He instructed them in cultivation one by one and guided them on their path forward.
These powerful individuals were thrilled and understood Xu Yan's intentions and deterrence. They naturally complied, continuing to hold their esteemed positions in the Great Wilderness.
As for the Spiritual Realm, they had completely given up on that idea. Why bother living like pigs or dogs?
Xu Yan was able to make his way in the Spiritual Realm because he was awesome, which was something they could only envy!

chapters.title: Chapter 677 - 359 Mysterious Stone House, The Hidden Secret of Wu Country
chapters.content:
Great Wilderness, because of Xu Yan's return, will undoubtedly ascend to a higher level of strength, and with a broad road ahead, in a few years, its power will certainly not be inferior to that of the Spiritual Realm.
All the strong believed this in their hearts, and they were also holding back a surge of indignation.
Once the Great Wilderness grows strong, they will let the warriors of the Spiritual Realm know that we of the Great Wilderness are not to be insulted!
At the Duke Du residence, Du Yuying returned with Cui'er.
After all, this was her home, where both her father and grandfather were very fond of her.
Prince Du was overjoyed, even though he had a prominent position in the Great Wilderness, his strength was ultimately not of the highest tier, and it all depended on his relationship with Du Yuying.
Now that Du Yuying had returned, and she brought treasures as well as the path of cultivation imparted by Xu Yan, it meant that the status of the Duke Du residence was now thoroughly solidified.
Especially now, as most of the powerhouses in the Great Wilderness were aware of the relationship between Du Yuying and Xu Yan.
Xu Yan's mother treated her as if she was her own daughter-in-law.
Everyone was busy with their own tasks, even Yue'er and Cai Ling'er, curious, traveled all over the Great Wilderness to see the different customs and cultures from those in the Spiritual Realm.
Meanwhile, Li Xuan was walking above the clouds of the Great Wilderness; at every place, he would adjust the Heaven and Earth Laws, even harnessing the power of Domain Dao Rule.
He enhanced the Spirit Mechanism of the Great Wilderness and made the Power of Domain Laws more active.
Thus altering the current state of the Great Wilderness's sparse spiritual energy.
To avoid causing any disturbances, these changes were gradual; the spiritual energy wouldn't increase instantly but rather progressively, and over the years, its density would not be inferior to the Spiritual Realm.
"What a laborious task!"
Li Xuan sighed.
Even with his strength, this kind of task was very arduous.
"With the increase of spiritual energy in the Great Wilderness, the speed of cultivation to the Divine Skill Realm will increase; it's time to see what kind of Divine Skills will be born among the Great Wilderness warriors.
"How many Divine Skill Realm warriors will emerge, and what feedback will that bring?"
Li Xuan looked forward with anticipation.
Of course, given the current momentum of development in the Great Wilderness, the first Divine Skill Realm warrior would likely be Xu Junhe, followed perhaps by Kou Ruozhi.
The rest of the non-traditional Great Wilderness warriors may not be able to develop Divine Skills. They might produce only fake Divine Skills, so he directly ruled them out.
"There are still some geniuses in the Great Wilderness; their potential is also not bad. With the increase in spiritual energy, the chances of geniuses emerging will also increase."
From south to north, then from north to east, Li Xuan completed his deployment and sighed to himself, "Such burdensome work, best done only once."
Arduous tasks were always delegated to disciples, but since the disciples were not strong enough, he had to take matters into his own hands.
...
At the border wilderness, where the Wu Country Royal Palace was located.
In that palace, within that stone house, a murmuring voice suddenly emerged.
"Who is changing the momentum of heaven and earth? Who is adjusting the Heaven and Earth Laws, and who is harnessing the power of Dao Principles?"
"Who would come here near the Border Wilderness?"
"Oh no, could it be an enemy? Are they looking for me?"
"No good, I need to hide, yes, hide, cannot let anyone find me, absolutely cannot let anyone find out, play dead, yes, play dead!"
"As long as I play dead, nobody can find me, this is the way to do it!"
The murmuring voice died down and soon fell silent.
In the Wu Country Royal Palace, one of the two Great Wilderness Emperors, The Emperor of Wu, made a rare return visit.
Although he was only a nominal figurehead, without any real power in the Great Wilderness, his status as one of the two Great Wilderness Emperors commanded respect, and the Great Wilderness Cabinet was obliged to honor him within the rules.
Guo Rongshan, who was in charge of the Cabinet, never exceeded his bounds in dealing with The Emperor of Wu and Emperor Qi, preventing anyone from daring to speak of deposing the two Emperors.
The Emperor of Wu held Guo Rongshan in high regard; his dignified position in the Great Wilderness was unassailable, and nobody would dare defy him.
All the powerful warriors, especially those who served the Great Wilderness, obeyed only Guo Rongshan's commands.
Even so, Guo Rongshan maintained a respectful attitude toward him and Emperor Qi, neither arrogant nor impetuous, displaying the demeanor of a sage with great virtue.
Regardless of whether Guo Rongshan was striving for the reputation of great virtue or for some other reason, The Emperor of Wu was thoroughly satisfied.
Of course, he and Emperor Qi never truly acted high and mighty in front of Guo Rongshan as the two Emperors of the Great Wilderness.
They spent most of their time invested in Martial Arts Cultivation.
Now, The Emperor of Wu had just broken through to the Tongxuan Realm, and after consolidating his power, he returned to his homeland in Wu Country for a visit.
Walking leisurely with his head held high, The Emperor of Wu, full of pride, entered the palace and went into the stone house.
"I have become a Martial Artist, surprised?"
The Emperor of Wu laughed wildly.
"You have always been reluctant to pass on Martial Arts, using various excuses to avoid it. Now that I have become a Martial Artist with considerable strength, what are your thoughts?"
The stone house was quiet, and that mysterious voice did not make an appearance.
The Emperor of Wu's brows furrowed and he spoke sternly, "Come out, are you dead or something?"
But, there was no response from the stone house for a long time.
The Emperor of Wu was somewhat gloomy; he had come to boast and to provoke that mysterious voice, but was it gone now?
"That's not right, the mysterious voice has always been here, how could it suddenly be gone? Could it really be dead?"
The Emperor of Wu was filled with doubt.
The little stone house and that mysterious voice were the most secret matters of Wu Country's Royal Family, known only to the reigning emperor.
"Do you think it's unbelievable, afraid of being ridiculed by me, so you stay silent? Won't you come out, don't you want to know how I became a Martial Artist?"

chapters.title: Chapter 678 - 359 Mysterious Stone House, The Secret of Wu Country_2
chapters.content:
The Emperor of Wu was not content and continued to speak.
However, no matter what he said, no matter how he tried to provoke the other party, the stone house remained eerily silent, with not a hint of response.
"Has it really disappeared?"
The Emperor of Wu walked out of the stone house, frowning with a look of confusion on his face.
"Forget it, no one knows what's going on with this thing anyway."
With a shake of his head and a sense of disappointment that he couldn't flaunt as intended, it wasn't anything too critical in his mind.
After staying a few days in the old lands of Wu Country, the Emperor of Wu returned to the Great Wilderness City.
As soon as he came back, he learned of Xu Yan's return from the Spiritual Realm and that, seemingly, Xu Yan had provided fortuitous opportunities to those officers, bestowing wondrous pills and spiritual items.
"Although I am one of the two emperors of the Great Wilderness, with lofty status, such treasures are difficult to come by..."
The Emperor of Wu sighed.
Ask Lord Guo for treasures necessary for martial arts cultivation?
What if this causes dissatisfaction in Lord Guo, making him feel like he wants too much, alienating and isolating him, wouldn't that make things difficult?
The Emperor of Wu was filled with anxiety.
He knew that to suppress Emperor Qi, he needed to obtain precious treasures.
"Exchange, I can trade!"
The Emperor of Wu suddenly brightened up, as if he had thought of something.
But then he hesitated again, "That expert stayed in the Border Wilderness for some time; would he not know about the mysterious voice from that little stone house?
"The expert left the Border Wilderness and went to the Spiritual Realm, and now that voice has also disappeared; could it be related?"
The Emperor of Wu was torn.
He believed that the mysterious stone house was a valuable item for exchange.
But what if the expert already knew about the stone house?
For a while, the Emperor of Wu was undecided and became increasingly irritable.
"Wu youngster, come and fight!"
The arrogant voice of Emperor Qi came.
The two emperors of the Great Wilderness needed to determine who was stronger and who was weaker, and when they had nothing better to do, they would clash with each other, but neither could gain the upper hand.
"I'm busy!"
The Emperor of Wu, already in a bad mood, refused outright.
"Are you scared? I'm stronger than you now, come and let me beat you up for fun!"
But Emperor Qi was relentless.
"Heh, old Qi. If it weren't for Lord Guo cutting you some slack because of your loyalty, could you fight to a draw with me?"
The Emperor of Wu sneered.
Since Emperor Qi insisted on a fight, then they might as well battle and vent his frustration.
"That was also due to my own capabilities!"
Emperor Qi said proudly.
The two emperors of the Great Wilderness began their duel in the palace square, a sight that had become commonplace for the imperial guards.
As a result of the battle, the Emperor of Wu was defeated!
With a bruised face and a look of bewilderment.
"Old Qi, how… how could you possibly!"
The Emperor of Wu's face was filled with disbelief.
Emperor Qi was triumphant, arrogantly saying, "I, having a close relationship with Xu Yan, received advice and gifted treasures from him. How could you ever be my match?
"From now on, I am the foremost of the two emperors of the Great Wilderness!"
Emperor Qi was very pleased with himself; he felt the best decision he had ever made was to let Xu Yan enter his harem to view the beauties back then.
It was said that Xu Yan was refining his temperament.
As to why he went to the harem for tempering, it's said that the actions of such exceptional beings are always different from the rest.
Because of that relationship, when Xu Yan returned, Emperor Qi shamelessly sought an audience and reminisced, praising how Xu Yan had remained clear-hearted and unmoved by beauty in his harem.
The goal was to seek benefits.
After receiving guidance and benefits from Xu Yan, and thus strengthening his own power, Emperor Qi came to beat up the Emperor of Wu.
"Haha, I am the true first emperor of the Great Wilderness; how could you compare to me?"
Emperor Qi left triumphantly.
The Emperor of Wu was utterly disheartened, but ultimately, he set his teeth and made up his mind to seek benefits from the expert!
He had to take back what he had lost!
...
Li Xuan had been busy for half a month and finally returned to Canglan Island, sitting in a chair, continuing with his grand martial arts endeavor.
The Divine Skill Martial Code was still being written.
The subsequent martial arts cultivation was also continuously being refined.
With the opening of the Divine Bridge fast approaching, it meant that the time to leave was nearing.
When he would return to the Great Wilderness again was unknown.
Everything had been properly arranged, the development of the Great Wilderness was on the right track, and security would not be an issue. Xu Yan could set out on his adventures with peace of mind.
Cai Ling'er and Yue'er had also returned.
"We're about to return to the Spiritual Realm."
Yun Miaomiao gazed at every blade of grass and tree on Canglan Island with a look of reluctance to leave.
The Red Cat lay next to Mother Xu in the Spirit Fruit orchard, watching her fiddling with a formation chart while continuing to teach it to recognize words and other knowledge.
This departure was indefinite, with no knowing when they would return.
That day, unexpectedly, there came a visitor seeking an audience.
The Emperor of Wu!
He did not come to seek an audience with Xu Yan, nor did he come to meet Meng Chong and others, but to meet the esteemed Li Xuan.
"Elder, should I go and decline his request for an audience?"
Xu Junhe asked.
"Let him come."
Li Xuan pondered for a moment before deciding to let the Emperor of Wu come to see what he wanted.
The reason Li Xuan agreed to see the Emperor of Wu was because he recalled the Book of Taicang, which had been discovered in the royal treasury of the Emperor of Wu.
It was perhaps some kind of fate.
The Emperor of Wu followed Xu Junhe nervously and excitedly, arriving before the esteemed figure.
With a thud, he kowtowed to the ground.
"Greetings to the esteemed one!"
The Emperor of Wu bowed reverently.
"Rise, what brings you to seek me?"
Li Xuan spoke indifferently.
The Emperor of Wu lifted his head, glanced at Xu Junhe beside him, and hesitated slightly.
With a twitch of his mouth, Xu Junhe wondered if the Emperor of Wu had come to complain? And was he worried that Xu Junhe might hear?
After bowing to Li Xuan, Xu Junhe turned to leave.
Li Xuan smiled and said, "Speak, what matter is so secretive?"
"To answer the esteemed one, there is a hidden place in the Wu Country Royal Palace, a small stone house, very peculiar, with a mystic voice inside..."
The Emperor of Wu did not hesitate and revealed the secret of the small stone house.
Li Xuan was initially unconcerned, listening with a smile as though the secret mattered little to him or as if he already knew it.
In truth, however, his heart was anything but calm.
A small stone house, a mystic voice?
The Border Wilderness Wasteland concealed such a mysterious place, which might involve the secrets of Taicang!
"The Book of Taicang appeared in the collection of Wu, could it be related to this mystic voice? Could it be that he is the master of the Book of Taicang?"
At this thought, Li Xuan tensed up.
The master of the Book of Taicang would surely be extremely powerful.
Yet, according to the Emperor of Wu, the mystic voice seemed unable to leave the stone house and had no power to attack.
It appeared to be bound, even sealed.
"...but recently, that voice has seemed to disappear, no matter how I call, there is no response."
With trepidation, the Emperor of Wu finished speaking while quietly observing the esteemed figure's expression.
The esteemed one sat there, his expression calm, always smiling, with no surprise or shock, as if he had known all along.
"Indeed! The esteemed one is aware; how could the secrets of the Border Wilderness Wasteland escape the esteemed one," thought the Emperor of Wu, somewhat disheartened.
"Since it is your Wu Country's secret, then keep it well and no need to speak of it to others,"
Li Xuan said with a smile after letting him finish.
"Yes, esteemed one, this junior understands!"
The Emperor of Wu felt utterly dejected, understanding that the esteemed one already knew these so-called secrets, which meant he was being told not to divulge the ancestral secret.
It also became clear to him that divulging the secret was intended to gain benefits.
In that instant, the Emperor of Wu felt a sense of shame and regret for his decision, afraid that he had left a poor impression on the esteemed one!
"Take these, practice well!"
With a flick of his hand, Li Xuan gave the Emperor of Wu a booklet and a bottle of pills.
The booklet naturally contained Martial Arts Techniques, simple ones, but for martial artists like the Emperor of Wu, they were immensely powerful. Once mastered, his strength would surge among peers of the same realm.
The pills were also for aiding cultivation and were of no low grade, sufficient for the Emperor of Wu's needs.
The talents of the Emperor of Wu weren't poor but weren't particularly impressive either, nowhere near Xu Junhe or Kou Ruozhi. With these Martial Arts Techniques and pills, he would still lag far behind Xu Junhe and Kou Ruozhi and the others.
"Thank you, esteemed one! Thank you, esteemed one!"
The Emperor of Wu was overjoyed.
His eyes were moist with gratitude. The esteemed one truly had the magnanimity of one who embraces the domain, not minding his petty thoughts, and instead indulged them.
Graciously accepting the booklet and pills, the Emperor of Wu bowed deeply and said, "This junior will surely heed the esteemed one's teachings, hold the secret to death, and never leak the slightest!"
"Mhm!"
Li Xuan nodded, satisfied with his attitude.
After this incident, Li Xuan believed the Emperor of Wu would no longer mention the Mysterious Stone House to anyone else.
As for silence through murder, Li Xuan disdained to commit such an act for a mere secret. Besides, with the Emperor of Wu guarding it, the Mysterious Stone House was even less likely to have its secrets discovered by outsiders.

chapters.title: Chapter 679 - 360: Returning to the Spiritual Realm, Fang Hao's Breakthrough
chapters.content:
The Emperor of Wu left satisfied, brimming with fighting spirit, and decided to engage in arduous cultivation for a while before settling accounts with Emperor Qi.
"Qi, old fool, you just wait!"
The Emperor of Wu departed, his fighting spirit soaring high.
Xu Junhe watched in puzzlement, what could have made the Emperor of Wu so spirited?
Did the elder say something inspirational to him?
Li Xuan looked at the Book of Taicang in his hand, and couldn't help but ponder.
Was the voice in the mysterious stone cottage really the owner of the Book of Taicang?
Would visiting the stone cottage be dangerous for him?
The owner of the Book of Taicang must be stronger than him at this stage.
"The voice has vanished, has it truly died? Or did it purposefully avoid showing itself to the Emperor of Wu? According to what the Emperor said, the voice seemed to be bound and no longer free.
"If that's the case, there's no danger. Let's go have a look; we might uncover the secrets of the Taicang Domain."
Li Xuan made up his mind.
His figure vanished in an instant, and the next moment he was already at the Wu Country Royal Palace, staring at that palace.
"There's nothing out of the ordinary!"
Li Xuan furrowed his brows, failing to notice anything amiss; the Heaven and Earth Laws were normal, the Domain Dao Rule was unaltered, there were no seals in place, nor any trace of a powerful being being bound.
"Has it disappeared, or is it that with my current strength, I can't detect any clues?"
Li Xuan fell into deep thought.
According to the Emperor of Wu, the owner of that voice seemed unable to perceive anything beyond the stone cottage.
"Let's go inside and take a look!"
Li Xuan made his decision.
A figure walked out from within him and entered the palace.
The Divine Martial True Form!
This was the first time he used the Divine Martial True Form; even if there were dangers in the stone cottage, destroying the Divine Martial True Form wouldn't affect his true self in the slightest.
The aura of the Divine Martial True Form had been altered, completely unlike Li Xuan's own, to prevent the other party from tracking his true body through it.
Caution was still necessary!
Li Xuan, his presence inconspicuous, sat like an ordinary person in a tavern in the Capital City of Wu Country.
The Divine Martial True Form silently entered the palace, coming upon that simple stone cottage.
Without hesitating, it walked right in.
Upon entering the stone cottage, Li Xuan spoke, "Come out and meet me."
It was dead silent with no response at all.
Seeing this, Li Xuan no longer hid himself, revealing the aura of his Divine Martial True Form as he looked at the stone cottage, wanting to peer into its secrets.
The stone cottage was just built of ordinary stones, seemingly simple and fragile as if a slightly stronger breath could crumble it to dust.
"There's something unusual about this stone cottage."
Li Xuan quickly noticed something odd.
The stone cottage was indeed ordinary, but those stones had once been wrapped in Dao Principles.
Now that the power of the Dao Principles had dissipated, the stone cottage appeared mundane.
If it were any other strong being, they might not have noticed this subtlety, but it could not escape Li Xuan's detection.
Although he hadn't fully memorized or mastered the Taicang Dao Principles, he had memorized half and was all too familiar with the power of the Taicang Dao Principles.
"Nearly undetectable traces where Dao Principles once existed indicate that the Principles haven't been gone long and must be purposefully concealed; if the principles had vanished a long time ago, there would be no residue."
Li Xuan quickly came to a conclusion.
If the power of the Dao Principles in the stone cottage had long dissipated, there would be no trace left; even if he was deeply familiar with the Principles, he wouldn't be able to sense their nuances.
"The Dao Principles only vanished when I manipulated the Great Wilderness Domain Laws, enhancing the Spiritual Energy – this indicates the other party noticed the Laws of Heaven and Earth being deliberately stirred and chose to conceal themselves."
Li Xuan understood clearly in his heart.
The Emperor of Wu sought the other party and received no response; the other had hidden himself.
"Why hide and not meet? I mean no harm; I'm just idly visiting to have a chat. Aren't you lonely after such a long time here?
"I've known of your presence here for quite some time. Today I whimsically sought to converse with you, why hide and not show yourself?"
Li Xuan said, smiling.
There was no echo from within the stone cottage.
Li Xuan didn't mind and sighed, "Well then, if you won't meet, so be it. When I have time, I'll come visit you again."
After speaking, there was still no response from the stone cottage, so Li Xuan turned and left, vanishing in an instant.
The Divine Martial True Form returned and after Li Xuan pondered for a moment, he departed.
He was certain, the existence within the stone cottage, even if it was the owner of the Book of Taicang, didn't pose a threat as it must be bound.
However, given his current strength, he could not ascertain the other's whereabouts.
"If it really is the owner of the Book of Taicang and such strength is bound, the waters run deep. With my current capabilities, caution is still the wiser approach."
Since the Book of Taicang's owner might not pose a threat because of being bound, what about the powerful being who bound the Book's owner? Should they ever become aware, they would surely make an appearance.
Even if they had bound the owner of the Book of Taicang through some cunning scheme, their strength had to be immense, and with his current power, he likely wasn't their match.
Furthermore, the inhabitant of the stone cottage might not even be the owner of the Book of Taicang—it could be an entity sealed by the Book's owner.
If that were the case, it would be even more terrifying.
"Once I fully comprehend the Book of Taicang and grasp the root Dao Principles of the Taicang Domain, I should be able to see where the other is, right?"
Li Xuan mumbled to himself.
His strength was still not powerful enough.
"Only by transcending this Domain can I truly have the confidence to face everything!"
Li Xuan took a deep breath, feeling a subtle pressure in his heart.
In the end, he wasn't truly invincible.

chapters.title: Chapter 680 - 360: Returning to the Spiritual Realm, Fang Hao's Breakthrough (Part 2)
chapters.content:
```
The small stone house in the Wu Country Royal Palace, Li Xuan took note of, is the place where the secrets of the Taicang Domain can be understood.
Once his strength further increases, or after he has thoroughly comprehended the Book of Taicang, he will make another trip here.
The small stone house was silent and unremarkable, with no abnormalities, and that mysterious voice did not appear again; it seemed as though it was unaware that Li Xuan had ever visited.
Canglan Island.
Upon returning from the Wu Country Royal Palace, Li Xuan devoted even more time to the Dao Principles of the Book of Taicang, striving to thoroughly engrave all the principles in his memory as soon as possible.
Of course, he also took the time to ponder the Divine Skill Martial Code and the techniques of the Fifth Door of Martial Arts.
The Martial Arts of the Void-breaking Realm above and the subsequent techniques of the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body were also being continuously perfected.
"Xu Yan has reached the Divine Skill Realm and has gained insight into the techniques of the Void-breaking Realm Martial Arts. The Martial Arts techniques above the Void-breaking Realm should also be compiled as soon as possible and passed on to him in my spare time," Li Xuan mused.
Li Xuan pondered; he had already determined the direction of his cultivation after the Void-breaking Realm, waiting only to perfect the theoretical framework of Martial Arts techniques.
"Fang Hao should be close to breaking through as well, right?"
Li Xuan pondered; less than a month remained until the opening of the Divine Bridge.
Xu Yan returned from outside, spending time with his parents. He had arranged everything in the Great Wilderness, and his parents' safety would no longer be an issue.
This farewell, who knows what year he will return.
"Yan'er has grown up, and it's time for him to walk his own path," Mother Xu said indulgently.
"Mother need not worry, Canglan Island is very safe, too. The Formation is quite interesting—mother has been putting thought into it, trying to set up that what's-it-called Teleportation Formation at the earliest opportunity."
Mother Xu wasn't too saddened by the farewell; she had already known Xu Yan would be venturing into a more expansive world.
"Mother doesn't ask for much, just for Yan'er to be safe during his travels," she said.
Xu Yan nodded, "Don't worry, Mother, I have a lot of experience and won't encounter danger; with Master as my support, even if there are old fellows, they can't threaten me."
Mother Xu nodded.
Only ten days were left until the opening of the Divine Bridge.
Xu Yan left behind a large stock of cultivation resources for his parents, along with two Flying Boats and a Divine Origin Avatar.
In silence, Li Xuan had transformed the Divine Origin Avatar originally left to Xu Junhe and the others into a Divine Ability Jade Talisman, imbued with the power of the Void-breaking Realm.
With this talisman, even the Immortal Heavenly Venerable's descent could be safely countered.
"Red Cat, you might be too heavy to hold when you come back next time!" Mother Xu said somewhat reluctantly as she stroked Red Cat's chubby head.
"Meow meow!"
Red Cat's paw moved, and a line of text appeared.
"Can hold, definitely can hold!"
Mother Xu happily rubbed its head again.
The Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship soared into the sky, turning into a streak of light that disappeared into the horizon.
In the northern part of the Domain, where the gate to the Spiritual Realm is located.
The barrier to the Spiritual Realm had been reinforced by Li Xuan so that even the Immortal Heavenly Venerable would have a difficult time crossing it.
Xu Yan and the others looked back at the Great Wilderness, not knowing when they would return to their native land again.
"The path of Martial Arts is long and arduous, and to have companions who can accompany you to the very end is a fortunate thing in life. True power brings loneliness, for invincibility is always lonely," Li Xuan said quietly.
"Yes, Master!"
The disciples felt a tremor in their hearts and hastily responded with respect.
"So it turns out, Master's seclusion in the Border Wilderness was due to the loneliness of being invincible and having no companions left—because Master was too strong.
"Invincibility is always lonely. Master has been lonely for too long. After much contemplation in silence, he finally chose to take me as a disciple and re-enter the world to live freely!" Xu Yan thought to himself, realizing that the reason Master had secluded himself in the small mountain village and taken him as a disciple was due to his prolonged loneliness.
Amidst deep contemplation, he felt it was fate that had brought them together, which is why he took him as a disciple, leaving the small mountain village, and began mingling with the world once again.
In front of the Flying Boat, space tore open, and they entered the void once more, with Xu Yan, Meng Chong, and Su Lingxiu hastily refocusing their minds to comprehend the mysteries of Void-breaking.
...
In Hongzhou, prodigies of the Spiritual Realm and top powerhouses gathered.
Wu Tianan looked out over the Azure Sea, his eyes full of anticipation. Could the person he was seeking be on the other side of the Divine Bridge?
Fang Hao and Moon Changming had also arrived in Hongzhou. Now that the major situation in the Spiritual Realm had been settled, even the arrival of strong warriors from beyond the Divine Bridge could not change it.
Everything depended on strength, and his master's strength was invincible.
"What kind of place is beyond the Divine Bridge?"
```
Fang Hao curiously spoke up.
Xie Tianheng and his wife Fu Yun came over, and Fu Yun said, "The other side of the Divine Bridge is the Divine Realm. According to the records in ancient tomes, it is close to the central area of the Domain, but specific information is not known."
Divine Realm!
"What power does Yuntian Azure Sea City belong to in the Divine Realm?"
Fang Hao asked curiously.
The Transcendent Spirit Sect of the Spiritual Realm was subordinate to a certain Sect of the Divine Realm, which was why they could govern the Spiritual Realm, seeking and nurturing Spirit Body Prodigies for their superior Sect.
These secrets were known to them as powerful beings.
"I'm not too sure myself; Yuntian Azure Sea City and the Sea Spirit Tribe, we both belong to the same Upper Sect. Only my father and the leader of the Sea Spirit Tribe would know."
Fu Yun shook her head.
Fang Hao did not continue to ask and instead, his figure moved toward the Azure Sea. He was about to break through.
Moon Changming hurriedly followed.
In a certain area of the Azure Sea, a Great Formation was set up. Fang Hao took a deep breath as the Domain's momentum converged, and the Azure Sea stirred up towering waves. Today, he was going to break through.
"Is that Fang Hao?"
"What is he doing, is he trying to break through?"
"How strong will Fang Hao be after his breakthrough?"
The Thousand Martial Lord, the Yuling Mansion Lord, and Lord Leiyun all frowned as they looked toward the turbulent area of the Azure Sea.
Now, they had no other concerns since after all, Fang Hao's master was an immensely formidable being. Even the Upper Sect to which they belonged would probably dare not offend him.
Given this, the only option was to seek good relations and resolve any grievances.
The surging waves continued. The Domain's power gathered, and the power of Principle converged. Above the Firmament, it seemed as if mysterious patterns were forming.
Fang Hao sat cross-legged, the power of the Domain infused into his body, the Domain Qimen Patterns condensing. The first one took shape, shimmering with radiance and possessing a divine and mysterious power.
This Qimen Pattern was different from the previous ones as if it was a Principle Pattern, a nascent form of the Qimen Martial Arts Rule.
"The Martial Arts my senior brothers practice result in Divine Abilities manifesting by themselves when breaking through to the Divine Skill Realm. Divine Abilities are the Principles of a Martial Artist. My Qimen Pattern, too, is like a Divine Ability, belonging to the Principles of Qimen Martial Art."
"This is a Divine Ability Pattern!"
Fang Hao had an epiphany in his mind. He was now condensing Divine Ability Patterns upon his breakthrough.
Once the Divine Ability Pattern was formed, it could exhibit the profound mysticism of Divine Skills when employing the Domain Qimen Strategies.
The Divine Ability Pattern continued to condense, and the second Divine Ability Pattern was formed.
One Divine Ability Pattern allowed the casting of one Domain Qimen Strategy with the subtlety of a Divine Skill, and two Divine Ability Patterns enabled the casting of two Domain Qimen Strategies with Divine Skill power.
The breakthrough continued, and Divine Ability Patterns kept condensing.
The Abyss of the Azure Sea, the most dangerous place in the Azure Sea and where divine items were born.
But due to the extreme danger, to this day, no one dares to delve deep into the Abyss.
Those who entered the Abyss have not returned alive.
Even Xu Yan's Divine Origin Avatar could not make it into the depths of the Abyss, nor could he uncover its secrets.
At this moment, at the bottom of the Abyss, a streak of blood light emerged.
This blood light surged from a dark and gloomy cave.
Heavenly Grotto!
The blood light kept emerging, the dark Heavenly Grotto turned into a faint blood color, and looking into the grotto, one could see blood waves raging, as if they were boiling and bursting with blood bubbles.
Boom!
The waters of the Azure Sea remained outside the Heavenly Grotto, while inside, the blood waves churned as if boiling with the blood light continuously growing stronger.
In a moment, figures began to appear within the blood waves.
Though these figures appeared no different from humans, their skin was blood red, as if drenched in fresh blood, and their aura emanated a sanguinary intent.
If someone familiar with them were present, they would recognize these faces as the powerful explorers who once entered the Abyss of the Azure Sea and then disappeared without a trace.
Their eyes were a pale red as they looked up from the grotto, toward the billowing waves of the Azure Sea, as if waiting for the right moment.
Gurgle!
In the blood waves of the Heavenly Grotto, waves suddenly surged as the individuals formed a circle, watching respectfully toward the source of the turbulence.
Pop!
A head emerged.
Blood-red hair, a ghastly pale visage, a fine line of blood at the center of the brows, eyes crimson as blood, holding a blood-red long knife in hand.
A slender figure rose from the blood waves, standing atop them and looking out from the grotto, a cold smile playing on his lips.

chapters.title: Chapter 681 - 361 Collapse of the Divine Bridge, The Fall of the Heavenly Venerable
chapters.content:
No one knew that beneath the Azure Sea Abyss was a Heavenly Grotto where waves of blood surged. In the grotto, silhouettes stood, silently watching the world outside.
Gazing at the vast Azure Sea, it was as if they were waiting for something.
The man with blood-red hair stood with a blade in hand, shrouded in an aura of murderous intent. The crimson long blade, with a faint glint of sword light, seemed to be gathering energy, ready to unleash a powerful strike at any moment.
"The time has come, the Spiritual Realm shall belong to Netherworld. It's the hunting ground for my 762nd Blood Disciple, are the Blood Slaves ready?"
The 762nd Blood Disciple spoke coldly.
"Master, we are ready, let the blood light shine upon the Spiritual Realm!"
The figures roared with a frenzied look in their eyes!
"Good! The long years of plotting and waiting have finally reached the time of harvest."
The 726th Blood Disciple revealed a smile.
"Once I take over the Spiritual Realm and sacrifice it with blood, I, the 726th Blood Disciple, will certainly ascend to the status of a Blood Child!"
Longing appeared in the eyes of the 726th Blood Disciple.
The position of a Netherworld Blood Child was exalted, with the chance to receive the true teachings. Every Blood Child's strength was incredibly powerful.
"The Divine Bridge spans above the Abyss, connecting the Divine Realm, and is the bridge to the Divine Realm. Once it collapses, it cannot be repaired or re-opened in a short time.
"What's more, the Divine Realm is about to face a great war, especially the Qinghua state where the Divine Bridge is located, unrest will begin.
"From now on, the Spiritual Realm will become the Blood Realm!"
The 726th Blood Disciple's eyes were excited, unblinkingly fixed on the Heavenly Grotto above and the Azure Sea Abyss, waiting for the Divine Bridge to open.
When the Divine Bridge appears, that will be his moment to strike, collapsing the Bridge in one fell swoop and severing the contact between the Spiritual Realm and the Divine Realm!
Without the Mighty of the Divine Realm coming to the aid, isn't the mere Spiritual Realm his hunting ground?
From now on, the Spiritual Realm will turn into the Blood Realm, and by the time the Mighty from the Divine Realm come to aid, he will have already retreated into the Heavenly Grotto. Moreover, the Spiritual Realm would struggle to recover, and this part of the world will reveal a significant weakness.
He, the 726th Blood Disciple, will have accomplished a great feat, ascending to the Blood Child position, receiving stronger inheritance, and his strength will greatly increase!
The future is bright!
The 726th Blood Disciple was excited, envisioning the splendor and glory of ascending to the Blood Child.
...
The turmoil of the Azure Sea had subsided, Fang Hao had completed his breakthrough, refining five Divine Ability Patterns.
Fang Hao was thrilled; with a single thought, he laid out the Domain Qimen, calming the waves of the Azure Sea, yet hidden undercurrents lurked beneath. Suddenly, a huge vortex surfaced, seemingly capable of devouring and erasing everything in an instant!
The Divine Ability Patterns shone brightly, granting the Domain Qimen the might of Divine Skills.
"This can be called a Qimen Divine Skill!"
With a wave of his hand, Fang Hao restored calm, moved his figure, and returned to Hongzhou, waiting for the Divine Bridge to open.
Moon Changming, witnessing this scene, couldn't help but sigh. From now on, Fang Hao would no longer need his protection. If they encountered a strong enemy, it was rather he who would need Fang Hao's care.
In fact, Fang Hao's strength had already surpassed his own.
It was only after this breakthrough that the gap in their strengths seemed as vast as heaven and earth.
"Only by breaking through to the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable can the gap in strength be narrowed," Moon Changming thought.
The realm of Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable was not too far out of reach for him. Perhaps after reaching the other side of the Divine Bridge, he could begin his breakthrough.
But Moon Changming knew that even if he broke through to become a Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable, he wouldn't be a match for Fang Hao. The difference in their strengths would just be less pronounced.
In Hongzhou, the mighty and the chosen ones gathered, all secretly excited, especially the chosen ones who were full of anticipation.
What kind of cultivation Holy Land was on the other side of the Divine Bridge?
However, the mighty ones were all waiting for the appearance of that Flying Boat.
In Yuzhou, the Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship appeared, heading straight for Hongzhou without stopping.
"Your disciple Fang Hao has refined Divine Ability Patterns, and you have obtained Innate Divine Ability Patterns."
Fang Hao had made his breakthrough.
Li Xuan inwardly sighed, Innate Divine Ability Patterns seemed to exist like Dao Principles Patterns.
"The direction of cultivation for the Qimen Martial Art has been set. The next Realm breakthrough will be to continue refining patterns, and these patterns will gradually transform towards the patterns of Dao Principles."
Li Xuan thought silently.
Five Divine Ability Patterns allowed him to utilize five Domain Qimen Divine Skills.
He had already outlined the Realm above the Void-breaking Realm and was further refining it.
The Flying Boat turned into a streak of light, heading towards Hongzhou as Xu Yan and others contemplated their own Martial Arts without resting even for a moment.
Cai Ling'er was doing the same.
Li Xuan seemed carefree and composed, but in reality, he was racking his brains for the great endeavor of Martial Arts, also very busy.
With three days until the Divine Bridge opened, a streak of light descended from the sky, and Evergreen Pavilion arrived.
Fang Hao came aboard the Flying Ship to greet his master and reunite with his martial siblings. Xie Tianheng and his wife were naturally present, making Evergreen Pavilion cheerful and harmonious.
Wu Tianan and Xin Mengrou also came to meet the elders.
Even Fu Tianhai, through his daughter's connection, came to Evergreen Pavilion to pay respects to the elders and get closer to Xu Yan and the others.
Naturally, the conversation turned to the other side of the Divine Bridge. Xu Yan and the others were very curious about it.
"The Divine Realm is vast and boundless, said to be divided into Thirty-six Realms, each not smaller than the Spiritual Realm. The Divine Bridge is connected to the Qinghua state…"
As the City Lord of Yuntian Azure Sea City, Fu Tianhai's understanding of the Divine Realm was naturally not something Fu Yun could compare to, possessing the true secrets of the Transcendent Spirit Sect.
Since the Divine Realm was a topic of discussion, and with the opening of the Divine Bridge imminent, and Xu Yan and the others would also head to the Divine Realm, there was no need to keep these so-called secrets hidden anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 682 - 361 Collapse of the Divine Bridge, The Heavenly Venerable Falls_2
chapters.content:
Explaining it at this moment would actually enhance the relationship with Xu Yan and the others.
Moreover, my own grandson Xie Lingfeng and Xu Yan already had a deep friendship and shared a connection.
As Fu Tianhai explained, Xu Yan and the others had a moment of realization and finally grasped a general understanding of the Divine Realm.
The Divine Realm consists of Thirty-six Realms, each of which is no smaller than the Spiritual Realm, and each realm's strength is different. The Divine Bridge is connected to one of the Thirty-six Realms, the Qinghua state.
The Thousand Martial Hall, Leiyun Mountain Manor, and Yuling Mansion's superior Divine Realm forces all come from Qinghua state.
The Thousand Martial Hall belongs to the Qinghua state's Tianwu Sect.
The Leiyun Mountain Manor belongs to the Qinghua state's Myriad Thunder Sect.
The Yuling Mansion belongs to the Qinghua state's Da Yue Country.
"Our Yuntian Azure Sea City does not belong to an upper sect in the Qinghua state but to the Azure Sea Sphere's Yuntian Island, where the Sea Spirit Tribe also exists... Da Zhou State's superior seems to be a dynasty that controls a domain in the Divine Realm on its own.
"In terms of strength and status, the upper sect of Da Zhou State is somewhat stronger than those of the Thousand Martial Hall.
"As for the Taimiao Sect, in the Divine Realm's Sects, it is also called Taimiao and is immensely powerful...
"What I know is really just a general idea. As for the specific situation in the Divine Realm, one can only understand it by experiencing it firsthand," said Fu Tianhai with a sigh.
Li Xuan listened quietly all along.
"The Divine Realm is not the core of Taicang; it seems that in the Divine Realm, one will not encounter the real powerhouses."
When Li Xuan thought of that Mysterious Stone House, he couldn't help but ponder, what was the existence behind the mysterious voice mentioned by the Emperor of Wu?
The other party must know why the Taicang Domain is divided into several regions.
"The Heavenly Grotto seeps in from outside the Domain, could it possibly be a threat to the Taicang Domain?"
Li Xuan mused to himself.
To understand the secrets of the Taicang Domain, clues were in that Mysterious Stone House.
"Once I have inscribed the Taicang Domain Dao Principles or my strength breaks through again, I'll go back and explore, to see if I can find where that mysterious voice comes from."
Li Xuan made up his mind.
The day the Divine Bridge was to open arrived, and everyone was excitedly waiting.
In the sky, a rainbow emerged, spanning across the Azure Sea.
The halo of the Domain began to emerge between heaven and earth, different from the illusory bridge opened by the Thousand Martial Hall last time. This time, the rainbow light became more and more solid, a shadow of a bridge was emerging.
This rainbow bridge seemed to lie above the firmament, spanning across the Azure Sea.
Li Xuan looked up to see that the rainbow light was a convergence of the Heaven and Earth Laws; a principle of heaven and earth emerged, surrounded by faint, colorful rainbow light.
This principle seemed to have become a bridge descending from the sky.
"What is this?"
Li Xuan raised his eyebrows; the Divine Bridge was a convergence of the Domain Dao Rule, which surprised him. The principle was very special and seemed to be born specifically for the Divine Bridge.
The Divine Bridge Rule was like a chain, connecting the Spiritual Realm with the Divine Realm, forming a bridge.
Besides connecting the Spiritual Realm and the Divine Realm, this principle had no other effects, not even the power of attack or the capability of binding.
"This Domain Dao Rule is quite interesting."
Li Xuan was confident that, in the Taicang Domain, no one understood the Domain Dao Rules better than he did.
He saw through the essence of the Divine Bridge Rule at a glance – it was born when the Taicang Domain separated the space of heaven and earth and delineated territories, solely to connect the Spiritual Realm with the Divine Realm.
The Divine Bridge began to transform from the ethereal to the solid, a rainbow light bridge spanning across the Azure Sea, with one end hanging over Hongzhou and the other end hanging over the Divine Realm's Qinghua state, continued to coalesce.
From an imaginary bridge shadow, it gradually became a tangible bridge.
The Divine Bridge was a hundred paces wide and its length stretched thousands of miles, with its end out of sight. Rainbow light swirled around it, and at one moment, the Divine Bridge descended.
Boom!
One end of the Divine Bridge arrived in Hongzhou, and the other in the Divine Realm's Qinghua state.
"The Divine Bridge has opened!"
At this moment, everyone was extremely excited.
Even Wu Tianan could hardly wait to ascend the Divine Bridge immediately and search for his own martial arts guide in the Divine Realm.
"Welcome the Heavenly Venerable's descent!"
Fu Tianhai, Emperor Da Zhou, and others bowed in front of the Divine Bridge.
Last time, when the Thousand Martial Hall invited the Heavenly Venerable to descend, a Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable came but was slain by the Seductive Witch.
This time the Divine Bridge opened, would the Tianwu Sect, which belongs to the Thousand Martial Hall, send an even stronger Heavenly Venerable?
Or, did they believe that the previous Heavenly Venerable had merely been detained by other matters and had not been able to return in time, still unaware of the Heavenly Venerable's demise?
If that were the case, they might not send a stronger being.
Everyone was watching the Divine Bridge, waiting for the Heavenly Venerable to descend.
On the Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship, Li Xuan also watched silently, Xu Yan and the others were not eager to enter the Divine Realm, but were waiting for the Divine Realm's Heavenly Venerable to descend.
As the Wanshi Alliance Hierarch, Fang Hao was leaving this time, not knowing when he would return to the Spiritual Realm. Therefore, the position of Wanshi Alliance Hierarch had already been passed to someone else.
As the Heavenly Venerable from the Divine Realm descended, whether it would impact the existing structure of the Spiritual Realm remained to be seen. However, Fang Hao was not afraid in the slightest, with his master in charge.
After all, the Martial Arts Realm was ultimately ruled by the strong.
Below the Azure Sea Abyss, Blood Disciple 726 stood with a blade, floating up to the mouth of the Heavenly Grotto, excitedly looking up at the Divine Bridge, waiting for the moment to strike.
The other Blood Slaves also floated up to the mouth of the Heavenly Grotto, weapons in hand, simply waiting for the order to surge forth, to slash at the Divine Bridge, to slaughter the Spiritual Realm, and to turn the Spiritual Realm into the Blood Realm.
"Soon, I can feel it!"
The eyes of Blood Disciple 726 glowed with excitement and bloodlust.
Boom!
The Divine Bridge trembled slightly as a powerful figure approached from the Divine Realm with light steps.
"Hmm?"
Blood Disciple 726 suddenly frowned, showing a look of astonishment, "Could the Divine Realm have detected the existence of this Heavenly Grotto of mine?
"Impossible, I've hidden for such a long time, never exposed, and moreover, the Qinghua state is in great turmoil right now.
"According to usual practice, they would send only a Condensation Law Venerable. Why did they send a Truth Refinement Venerable this time?"
The one walking on the Divine Bridge was a Truth Refinement True King Heavenly Venerable!
"Blood Power gather in me, we must kill the opponent in one strike."
Blood Disciple 726 ordered the group of Blood Slaves looking at them.
"Yes!"
The Blood Slaves said respectfully.
Blood light gathered, all entering Blood Disciple 726, focusing on his blood blade.
"Here it comes!"
In Hongzhou, a group of Spiritual Realm experts was thrilled.
Looking at the figure reflected by the Divine Bridge, the Heavenly Venerable had arrived!
"Hmm?"
Li Xuan raised his eyebrows. Was this the True King Heavenly Venerable?
"Is this sensing the fall of the previous Heavenly Venerable? No, the opponent seems to have just gone through a great battle."
Li Xuan was astonished.
The True King Heavenly Venerable that had arrived seemed to have just gone through a great battle and was not in peak condition.
Moreover, this True King Heavenly Venerable didn't belong to Tianwu Sect of the Thousand Martial Hall; it seemed he was from the Myriad Thunder Sect of Leiyun Mountain Manor?
Just as everyone was staring at the Divine Bridge, watching the Heavenly Venerable approach, suddenly, a streak of blood light swept up from the Azure Sea, slashing towards the Divine Bridge, attacking the Heavenly Venerable.
The experts of the Spiritual Realm were all startled, not yet comprehending what had happened, when they heard a loud boom—the Divine Bridge was severed in the middle and collapsed!
The view reflected by the Divine Bridge was that of the astonished and furious face of the Heavenly Venerable, along with the terrifying scarlet blade light.
This blade seemed so familiar!
"Blood Demon?"
"No, something even more terrifying than the Blood Demon!"
Suddenly, from the collapsing Divine Bridge, a furious roar was heard.
"Netherworld Blood Disciple, how could they appear in the Spiritual Realm!"
Boom!
Waves shook the Azure Sea, and even from a vast distance, the shocking sight of blood light soaring into the sky could be seen as the powerful Heavenly Venerable was sliced into a mist of blood under the blood light!
The Divine Bridge collapsed, the Heavenly Venerable had fallen!
The sudden catastrophe stunned all the experts, and everyone felt a chill all over, with cold sweat on their foreheads, unable to utter a single sound.
The Divine Bridge had collapsed!
The Heavenly Venerable had fallen!
What on earth had happened to cause this catastrophe?
Undoubtedly, a major event was about to unfold in the Spiritual Realm!
"It's the Azure Sea Abyss!"
Fu Tianhai said in shock.
"Not good, my Sea Spirit Tribe is in danger!"
The leader of the Sea Spirit Tribe said with a pale face.
The collapsing Divine Bridge was turning into a phantom and disappearing, as if the chain linking the Spiritual Realm with the Divine Realm had been cut by a blade!
Scarlet light surged from the end of the Azure Sea like a torrent of blood, sweeping toward Hongzhou, and vaguely, the figures of blood could be seen, each nearly as formidable as the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable.
