In that moment, the hearts of all Spiritual Realm experts trembled. A single Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable was enough to sweep through the Spiritual Realm, let alone hundreds of blood figures comparable to the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable.
"Don't panic, our Spiritual Realm has a senior expert!"
At this moment, all the Spiritual Realm experts tried to calm themselves with pale faces, full of hope as they looked in the direction of the Evergreen Pavilion.

chapters.title: Chapter 683 - 362: Netherworld Blood Disciple, Divine Skills Show Their Power
chapters.content:
The sudden calamity that came out of nowhere took everyone by surprise, including Li Xuan, who was unexpectedly shocked when the Divine Bridge collapsed and a True King Heavenly Venerable was slain on the spot.
Although the strength of that True King Heavenly Venerable was not at its peak, he was after all a True King Heavenly Venerable, whose strength was far beyond the last Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable.
In terms of strength, even more formidable than the Seductive Witch back then.
This indicated that the strength of the person who made the move was extraordinary.
Looking towards the sky over the Azure Sea, which was filled with surging blood light, one figure after another emerged, and Li Xuan thought of the booklet left behind by the Blood Spirit Child.
"From this day forth, the Spiritual Realm is the hunting ground of Netherworld Blood Disciple Seven Two Six, from this day forth, the Spiritual Realm is the Blood Realm. Those with adequate talent and strength, if you wish to live, then become Blood Slaves.
"Those who wish to survive, kneel and bow quickly!"
A cold and harsh voice spread throughout.
A powerful momentum rose from the Azure Sea, with a blood light reflecting across the sky. The aura of Blood Fiends could be felt even from a vast distance away.
Wu Tianan and others were heavy-hearted; the speaker was too strong!
Even separated by a great distance, that Blood Fiend aura gave them a chilling sensation, as if an invisible mountain was pressing down on their hearts!
This person had cut off the Divine Bridge, slain a Heavenly Venerable; their strength was much greater than that of the Seductive Witch in the Heavenly Grotto of Ice State.
And those figures of blood light must be the Blood Slaves mentioned by the other party, right?
Netherworld Blood Disciples?
Could the Heavenly Grotto of the Azure Sea Abyss be called Netherworld Cave?
Where on earth did these Netherworld Blood Disciples come from?
The Divine Bridge has collapsed; won't the Divine Realm send strong men to rescue them?
"The Qinghua State is in no position to look after itself now, no one can save you. The Divine Bridge is broken; no one can come. Your fates are all within the thoughts of Blood Disciple Seven Two Six.
"Trash becomes blood food, those with talent, those with strength, become my Blood Slaves. Only by making a Blood Sacrifice of the Spiritual Realm can you find a way to live.
"Your only hope for survival is to pledge allegiance to my Netherworld!"
The voice of Blood Disciple Seven Two Six thundered, piercing into the hearts of the listeners, seemingly plucking at the strings of fear.
As Seven Two Six's voice rose, the surging blood light seemed to dye the Azure Sea into a crimson color. The Blood Fiend's aura stained half of the sky red, even tainting nature's spiritual energy with a faint red hue.
"Seven Two Six? Is it the rank of the seven hundred and twenty-sixth Blood Disciple, or is their strength ranked at seven hundred twenty-six?"
Li Xuan muttered to himself.
Seven Two Six was clearly the name of this Netherworld Blood Disciple, and could also be considered the other party's name, but whether it was a ranking by strength or by sequence was unknown.
However, Li Xuan was inclined to believe that it was a ranking by strength.
"What kind of strength do the top ten ranked Blood Disciples possess, and what about those above the Blood Disciples?"
Li Xuan sighed internally, certain that there must be extremely strong beings in the Netherworld.
"The Divine Bridge is broken; doesn't that mean I can't go to the Divine Realm?"
Xie Tianheng spoke with some reluctance.
As for the blood light surging above the Azure Sea, he was not worried in the slightest. What truly bothered him was the inability to reach the Divine Realm, which made him uncomfortable.
"Broken? Just connect it back,"
Xu Yan stated nonchalantly.
"Connect it back?"
Xie Tianheng's eyes lit up and said, "Can you reconnect the Divine Bridge?"
Xu Yan shook his head and looked at his master, saying, "Master can reconnect it, right?"
Xie Tianheng smacked his forehead; he really was muddled. If Xu Yan was to go to the Divine Realm, would his senior not make a move to ensure his disciple could go?
"That Seven Two Six Blood Disciple, so arrogant and bloodthirsty, where did these enemies come from? From their posture, they seem determined to make a blood sacrifice of the Spiritual Realm."
Xie Lingfeng said with furrowed brows.
Besides Blood Disciple Seven Two Six, the strength of those Blood Slaves was formidable. Although not as powerful as the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable, they were certainly on the same level.
In the entire Spiritual Realm, aside from a few people in the Evergreen Pavilion, no one could match them.
If Blood Disciple Seven Two Six succeeds, the Spiritual Realm will surely become a field of blood, and as said by the other side, the Spiritual Realm from now on is the Blood Realm!
A domain nourished by vital blood!
The Heavenly Grotto of Ice State brought immense calamity to Yun State and Da Ze State, but the disaster brought by the Blood Disciples from the Heavenly Grotto of the Azure Sea Abyss was even more terrifying.
However, because there were powerful individuals present, the Netherworld Blood Disciples were doomed to fail.
"Such rich blood energy, these Blood Slaves are like blood reservoirs; if refined, one could obtain pills that greatly nourish qi, blood, and the physical body!"
Su Lingxiu remarked with a sigh.
Boom!
The rolling Blood Fiend aura had already reached the shores of Hongzhou, and the powerhouses of the Spiritual Realm felt as if they were suffocating, with fear rising unbidden in their hearts.
The blood light seemed to symbolize a great catastrophe, sweeping towards Hongzhou, and aimed to envelop the entire Spiritual Realm.
Above the Azure Sea, figures in blood-red appeared, wielding blood-red long knives as they killed their way forward.
Wu Tianan's expression was solemn, and Xin Mengrou's beautiful eyebrows also furrowed. Including the Thousand Martial Lord and other powerful figures, all had flashbacks of the past calamity of the Blood Demon.
The Blood God Cultists also had such rolling Blood Fiend aura.
But they could not compare to these Blood Slaves; they did not possess such intense Blood Fiend aura, nor were they entirely dyed blood-red as if soaked in fresh blood.
Wu Tianan thought back to the booklet left by the Blood Spirit Child, almost certain that the strength of the Blood Spirit Child back then would not have been weaker than these Blood Slaves.
Yet, unwilling to be controlled by others and to grind away the Remnant Soul, his strength plummeted. Even so, he still created the calamity of the Blood Demon in the Spiritual Realm, making blood sacrifices of Spirit Sects, noble clans, and cities.
One Blood Demon caused such a huge disaster in the Spiritual Realm; these Blood Slaves were not something the Spiritual Realm could withstand at all. Without the intervention of a powerful individual, the Spiritual Realm would perish, and Martial Artists would be sacrificed to blood!

chapters.title: Chapter 684 - 362: Netherworld Blood Disciple, Divine Skills Show Their Power_2
chapters.content:
```
"Blood food, delicious blood food, those who are willing join me in the Netherworld, and together, let's enjoy the wonderful blood sacrifice!"
The voice of the 726th Blood Disciple seemed infused with bewitching tones.
"I'm going to meet him!"
Atop the Evergreen Pavilion, Xu Yan's fighting spirit soared.
Having broken into the Divine Skill Realm, he was finally able to demonstrate the formidable power of divine skills.
Though the 726th Blood Disciple was strong, Xu Yan was fearless; he yearned for a real challenge against an enemy stronger than himself.
With one step, Xu Yan instantly vanished from the Flying Boat.
"I'll go meet with these Blood Slaves."
Meng Chong patted his bald head and smiled.
"I'll join you!"
Fang Hao nodded.
The time had come to demonstrate their divine might.
"I'll join in on the fun, too."
Su Lingxiu muttered under her breath.
Li Xuan remained casually seated in his chair, but his gaze followed Xu Yan, watching his fight with the 726th Blood Disciple, attentively.
The 726th Blood Disciple, capable of slaying even a True King, had strength beyond the current Xu Yan.
However, with Xu Yan's Yin Yang Undying Sword Divine Ability being incredibly powerful, unless the 726th Blood Disciple could shatter this divine ability with a single blow, he would not be able to inflict actual harm on Xu Yan.
This was the very reason for Xu Yan's confidence in challenging formidable opponents.
Even if the enemy's strength was double his own, Xu Yan felt confident in emerging unbeaten, relying solely on the Yin Yang Undying Sword Divine Ability!
"This is good, Xu Yan's enemies have never been stronger than him, and now that he's truly battling against someone stronger, it could help him comprehend martial arts, divine skills, and enhance his own strength."
Li Xuan looked forward to the gains Xu Yan would reap from this battle.
Since the 726th Blood Disciple was stronger than Xu Yan, Li Xuan couldn't be careless and kept a vigilant watch, ready to strike in time to save Xu Yan if he were in danger, crushing the 726th Blood Disciple effortlessly.
Above the Azure Sea, the 726th Blood Disciple glowed with bloodthirsty aura, carrying a crimson long knife on his shoulder, stepping over the waves, moving steadily toward Hongzhou.
The immense oppressive force surged towards Hongzhou— he wanted the experts of the Spiritual Realm to kneel and beg for mercy under this pressure, to submit!
The speed of the Blood Slaves was not particularly fast, their intent was to inflict psychological pressure on the experts of the Spiritual Realm, to break through their mental defenses.
The potent bloodthirsty aura rolled and reflected onto the waves, the Azure Sea seemed to transform into a sea of blood.
Suddenly, a figure emerged. A youth with a sword stood in the way, blocking his path.
The 726th Blood Disciple frowned, surprised as he looked at Xu Yan. The youth had appeared silently and instantly, especially the unusual aura that the boy exuded.
"Boy, you have good talent and could be the chief of the Blood Slaves; it would be your honor to kneel and receive my grace."
The 726th Blood Disciple spoke with a cold voice.
Xu Yan was extraordinary, but his strength was far from his own.
"726th Blood Disciple? I've come to meet you. If you want to blood sacrifice the Spiritual Realm, you'll have to get past me first. Remember this, I am Sword God Xu Yan!"
The Yin Yang Undying Sword instantly appeared, encircling his body, endlessly cycling and indestructible.
"Seeking death!"
The 726th Blood Disciple's crimson eyes flashed with a bloodthirsty gleam!
Raising his crimson long knife, his aura erupted, revealing his formidable strength.
"Even ants dare to block my path!"
The 726th Blood Disciple slashed down, and the crimson blade light seemed to split heaven and earth in two.
In Hongzhou, the experts of the Spiritual Realm were all shaken.
Did the senior not make a move, yet Xu Yan did?
That was the one who shattered the Divine Bridge and killed a Heavenly Venerable— did Xu Yan truly dare to challenge him directly?
Wu Tianan was also shocked beyond belief. Could it be that in just a short time, Xu Yan had grown so powerful?
Xu Yan's expression was unchanged as he brought down his sword!
Divine Skill, Supreme Heavenly Sword!
In an instant, a black sword light seemed to descend from the heavens, willing to eradicate everything!
With this one strike, the 726th Blood Disciple's expression tensed.
What kind of Sword Dao was this?
So horrifying that if the opponent were a rank stronger, he would not be able to withstand this sword!
"You are too weak!"
Boom!
The blood-colored blade light was unleashed.
"How powerful! What Sword Dao is this?"
"I don't know, but it's worthy of the senior's direct transmission!"
The experts of the Spiritual Realm were all amazed.
```
However, the slash from 726 was even stronger. The bloodthirsty blade light cut through the black sword light and directly slashed towards Xu Yan!
"Not good, Xu Yan is in danger!"
Wu Tianan and other experts instinctively looked towards Evergreen Pavilion, hoping that the lofty individual there would come to the rescue, right?
But, what shocked them ensued.
The crimson blade light, when it struck in front of Xu Yan, seemed to circle around, and the blade light incredibly ricocheted back.
"How is that possible!"
726, the Blood Disciple, was also startled.
Having fought in numerous battles and slain Martial Artists beyond count, the name of 726 Blood Disciple was earned through a bloody path of slaughter.
Yet, he had never come across such an eerie Martial Art that could send his own attacks back at him!
Boom!
726 Blood Disciple struck out with another blade to fend off the attack, then said in a deep voice, "What kind of Martial Arts is this?"
"This is a Divine Skill!"
Xu Yan felt the pressure; although that slash hadn't broken through the Yin Yang Undying Sword, it nevertheless imposed a heavy burden on him, as if the Yin Yang Undying Sword was about to shatter at any moment.
"So powerful!"
The more intense the situation, the higher Xu Yan's fighting spirit soared. At last, he had the chance to truly battle against a stronger foe across levels.
"Divine Skill?"
726 Blood Disciple furrowed his brows. What was a Divine Skill?
Before he could ask further, Xu Yan struck out with his palm, unleashing a Golden Giant Dragon that erupted with a fearsome roar. A wave of True Dragon Rage came crashing down with wild fury.
Divine Skill, True Dragon Rage!
At that moment, Xu Yan dared not be negligent. He went all out, a faint glow emanating from his body with the faint image of mountains and rivers appearing like a phantom.
Mountains and Rivers in the Sword, Yin Yang Undying Sword, Supreme Heavenly Sword, and True Dragon Rage – all Divine Skills were deployed, showcasing the entirety of his Martial Arts skills.
726 Blood Disciple grew increasingly astonished as the battle raged on. He was stronger than his opponent, but couldn't crush the relentlessly resilient and extraordinary sword light of the other.
Moreover, each of his attacks was countered.
Although every strike caused his opponent's body to wobble and the sword light to flicker as if it would collapse at any moment, it defensively withstood each blow with incredible tenacity.
726 Blood Disciple, wishing to chain his killing moves to shatter that wondrous Sword Wheel, found that after each of his strikes, Xu Yan would instantly disappear and relocate to another position, never giving him the chance to chain attacks on the Sword Wheel.
The fierce battle was at a deadlock. Xu Yan, admittedly in a disadvantageous position, yet remained undefeated.
"How can there be such a powerful person in the Spiritual Realm? Could it be that the Divine Realm had already known of my plans? Impossible, absolutely impossible!"
726 seethed with fury, roaring loudly as the blood light around him intensified!
The battlefield was shrouded in the bloody aura of slaughter, cloaked in blood light, as the bloodthirsty and grim power poured out continuously, seeking to grind Xu Yan into dust.
At this moment, Xu Yan's Yin Yang Undying Sword circled incessantly. Though it flickered unsteadily, seemingly ready to collapse at any time, it barely withstood the onslaught, resembling a small boat heaving in the stormy seas, at risk of capsizing at any moment.
"Blood Sacrifice the Spiritual Realm!"
726 Blood Disciple commanded murderously, his voice cold.
The horde of Blood Slaves, which had already slowed down and was preparing to return to surround and attack Xu Yan, immediately responded with respect, "Yes!"
Their eyes gleaming with bloodthirsty killing intent, they turned towards the experts of Hongzhou as if they had spotted treasures and pounced over.
Boom!
Suddenly, a massive figure emerged as if a Heavenly God had descended, an eighteen-foot golden body enveloped in divine waves, exuding unparalleled majesty!
"Blood Slaves? Do you really think you monsters can run wild in the Spiritual Realm?"
Meng Chong said with a cold smile.
Boom!
A great sun emerged behind his head, and with a punch, the fierce power of the Great Sun swept through.
A ferocious wind and thunder transformed into a blade, slashing horizontally.
He, alone, battled against a multitude of Blood Slaves!
Displaying his Divine Skill, he went all out, fighting furiously with a majestic divine presence.
Boom!
Before the horde of Blood Slaves had a chance to unite, the Azure Sea surged, forming a Qimen formation in an instant, sweeping a portion of the Blood Slaves into it.
"Your opponent is me!"
Fang Hao, carrying the Qimen Armory on his back, revealed a brilliant smile.
The Weapon Box opened, and a torrent of swords surged forth along with various Qimen weapons flying out, setting up one Great Formation after another.
The Domain Qimen stackable Great Formation, empowered with the intricacies of Divine Skills.
A graceful figure arrived in a flash, and suddenly, layers of illusions appeared above the Azure Sea, obscuring her true position. Green flames emerged.
In the midst of thunderous sounds, it was as if a gigantic Divine Furnace had formed, engulfing a portion of the Blood Slaves, unleashing a terrifying refining force that seemed to disintegrate them.
Divine Skill, Divine Furnace Refinement!
Between heaven and earth, pinpoints of starlight suddenly pierced into a Blood Slave, snuffing out its life force in the process of extinction!

chapters.title: Chapter 685 - 363 Displaying Divine Skills, Fierce Battle with the Blood Disciple
chapters.content:
As they launched their assault on Hongzhou, ready to sweep across the Spiritual Realm and perform a blood sacrifice, the group of Blood Slaves now saw their expressions drastically change, faces filled with disbelief.
How could there be such powerful fighters in the Spiritual Realm?
Moreover, what kind of Martial Arts technique is this, and why is it so terrifying?
Meng Chong transformed into a giant, fighting the group of Blood Slaves single-handedly with exhilarating vigour. Punch after punch, slash after slash, he was incredibly ferocious, completely disregarding the attacks from the Blood Slaves.
The boundless Divine Skills deflected all attacks, failing to shake him in the slightest.
Meng Chong single-handedly fought against the most Blood Slaves, followed by Fang Hao. With the power of Domain Qimen combined with the Great Formation, he fought the Blood Slaves by himself, second only to Meng Chong.
Su Lingxiu was both excited and nervous; after all, she seldom engaged in combat with enemies, and this was her first time fighting such powerful Blood Slaves.
However, now that she had reached the Divine Skill Realm, she too wished to personally showcase the exquisite nature of Divine Skills. So, the more she fought, the more excited she became, and aside from appearing a bit inexperienced at the outset, her skills became increasingly sophisticated as the battle wore on.
Although most of the hundred or so Blood Slaves were held back by Meng Chong, Fang Hao, and Su Lingxiu amidst the raging battle, there were still several Blood Slaves that slipped through.
At this moment, these few Blood Slaves, not participating in the battle, had their eyes flickering with bloodthirsty light, continuing to advance towards Hongzhou, seeking to perform the blood sacrifice upon the Spiritual Realm, devouring vital essence.
"No good! We're no match for them!"
"Will the expert lend a hand?"
As the elite of the Spiritual Realm were shocked by the formidable strength of Xu Yan and the other three, as well as the overpowering Martial Arts, they became anxious seeing the Blood Slaves that continued to advance.
However, there wasn't too much panic, for though Xu Yan and his companions couldn't spare a hand, there was still an expert among them.
The expert could wipe out these few Blood Slaves with a mere wave of his hand.
Wu Tianan took a deep breath, gritted his teeth, and stepped forward; he wanted to confront a Blood Slave, to seek a life-and-death trial, perhaps to even achieve a breakthrough in the Condensation Law Realm right here in the Spiritual Realm!
Roar!
Just then, a deafening roar echoed, and a huge Splendid Ferocious Tiger the size of a small hill suddenly burst forth, landing in front of those few Blood Slaves.
Surrounded by fierce winds, its splendid fur fluttered like roaring flames!
"It's the Great Demon King!"
"Is the Great Demon King this powerful?"
The master of Yuling Mansion looked on with stunned shock.
It hadn't been long, but the strength of the Great Demon King had already completely overwhelmed him.
"Why do I feel like the Great Demon King is that fat cat from the Evergreen Pavilion?"
Xin Mengrou said, puzzled.
"That fat cat might just be the Great Demon King!"
Wu Tianan said in a deep voice.
The others were shocked; it seemed that all these exceptionally talented beings in the Spiritual Realm were connected with the expert.
Red Cat, too, entered the scene excitedly, transforming into the size of a small hill, with his Demon might vast and powerful. At this moment, it had finally cultivated the Great Demon Ability.
Its strength had long since become incomparable to that of the past.
Boom!
Immediately following that, Red Cat stood on its hind legs, a giant blade gripped in one paw. Swinging the blade, it charged forward, and alone fended off the remaining Blood Slaves.
In front of Hongzhou, above the Azure Sea, the battle was intense.
The golden giant, like a Heavenly God descending to earth, with each punch and slash was incredibly fierce, driving the Blood Slaves back step by step. In just an instant, one Blood Slave was struck and burst on the spot.
Elsewhere, enshrouded by a Great Formation, with the changes of Domain Qimen unpredictable, the battlefield was no longer visible, but almost everyone knew that Fang Hao was surely gaining the upper hand.
Su Lingxiu's battle was not as intense; blue flames spread as the Hundred Refinement Divine Furnace was deployed, with the horde of Blood Slaves seeming to be smelted within a furnace.
Starry Divine Lights kept emerging unpredictably, with layer upon layer of illusory images preventing the Blood Slaves from pinpointing Su Lingxiu's true location.
Suddenly, a hoe swept through, instantly severing the neck of a Blood Slave.
Red Cat's battle was similar to Meng Chong's, both being immensely violent as if indulging in close-quarters brawling.
Being the Great Demon King, its physical body was naturally extraordinarily powerful, and moreover, it had cultivated defensive Divine Skills, thus it feared not the attacks of the Blood Slaves.
Roar!
All at once, Red Cat opened its mouth to roar, and one Blood Slave staggered under the force of the roar, and then Red Cat sucked it into its mouth. Inside the vast maw, it seemed as if a flame was burning, as if a Furnace had been placed inside, and the Blood Slave fell into the Furnace, instantly disintegrating within it.
Spurt!
Red Cat spewed out of its mouth, ejecting a blood-red Pearl.
In its eyes was a tinge of confusion. Why would killing a Blood Slave yield a pearl? Could this pearl, seemingly containing essence of blood, be a great supplement to the physical body?
The Furnace in its mouth was a Great Demon Ability, burning enemies to ashes, and this was the first time it used this Divine Skill.
The battle here was fiercely intense, and all the Blood Slaves had been stopped, seemingly unable to overcome the blockade set by the three people and the tiger.
Elsewhere, the battle between Xu Yan and the Six Blood Disciples was equally intense. Roars of the True Dragon continuously thundered across Yuntian, stirring up tumultuous winds and changing the colours of the clouds.
The sword light was exceedingly sharp, helping Xu Yan fight with unmatched ferocity.
Yet that blood-colored blade light appeared even more terrifying; with each slash, half the sky would turn blood-red, and the bloodthirsty, fierce blade aura, even from a great distance, gave off a sense of horror.
The strong ones of the Spiritual Realm could hardly imagine how Xu Yan was able to fend off such terrifying attacks.
Gradually, the elite fighters noticed something unusual about Xu Yan. The surging sword lights, endlessly cycling, not only deflected the attacks of the Six Blood Disciples but also countered the remaining attacks back at them.

chapters.title: Chapter 686 - 363 Displaying Divine Skills, Fierce Battle with Blood Disciple_2
chapters.content:
"What kind of martial arts is this?"
"To use an enemy's attack and return it against them, it's inconceivable."
"Xu Yan seemed to be retreating step by step, as if he could be defeated at any moment, yet he has always held on, relying on this miraculous martial art!"
The powerhouses of the Spiritual Realm were all shaking with shock.
The Thousand Martial Lord's face was bitter. When Xu Yan had challenged them at the mountain gate, he had already felt that Xu Yan was a monster. But now, he realized that Xu Yan's monstrous nature was far beyond his wildest imaginations, almost unbelievable that such a monstrosity could exist in this world.
When compared to those Spirit Body Prodigies, even though they were all top-notch prodigies, next to Xu Yan, they weren't even fit to carry his shoes.
Indeed, he is the disciple of a master!
No wonder he was taken as a disciple by a master; his monstrous nature truly should not be viewed with common sense.
The 726 Blood Disciple was enraged and shocked, having lurked and plotted for such an extended period, all for this opportunity to blood sacrifice the Spiritual Realm and turn it into the Blood Realm!
The Netherworld had fully infiltrated, inserting a nail in this domain, creating a weak spot for future continuous infiltration.
He could also use this great feat to promote himself to a Xuezhi in one fell swoop!
Resultingly, the Divine Bridge was shattered, and that Heavenly Venerable was killed. He had never expected there to be such an unusual martial artist in the Spiritual Realm.
This boy was fundamentally weaker than him in strength, yet relying on that mysterious and strange Sword Light, he could deflect most of the power from his attacks and even retaliate with the remaining force.
Whenever he wanted to take the chance to strike again and shatter that Sword Light, his opponent would dodge with a swift movement, avoiding consecutive attacks.
And the opponent's movement technique, silent and traceless, would instantly shift his position without leaving any trace, evading his second strike every time.
What made him even more outraged was that a group of Blood Slaves were also being blocked.
That bald giant was incredibly powerful, with a bodily defense so terrifying that he ignored all attacks from the Blood Slaves, with each punch and slash, and that Big Sun behind his head, all revealing mighty power.
Although there were many Blood Slaves, they couldn't shake the bald giant and failed to break through the interception and kill their way up to the Spiritual Realm.
The strength of these Blood Slaves seemed comparable to that of the initial-stage Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables, yet their true strength was just a little weaker than theirs.
To withstand an early-stage Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable, it would take two or three Blood Slaves.
Apart from the bald giant, there was also an area enveloped by an obscure and magical aura that blocked many Blood Slaves.
On the other side, though there was no such fierce battle, they still trapped the Blood Slaves, and some were even refining the Blood Slaves, causing their inherent Blood Beads to be revealed once refined!
These Blood Beads were the source of the Blood Slaves' power, refined by them into a treasure. They were beneficial to martial artists' cultivation.
Besides, what also shocked the 726 Blood Disciple was the Red Cat. This giant tiger was extremely odd; it didn't seem like a spirit beast from this domain at all!
"What kind of tiger is this? Something is wrong with the Spiritual Realm!"
The 726 Blood Disciple's heart sank.
"I can't keep dragging this out!"
The 726 Blood Disciple knew that if he continued to fight Xu Yan, he could always suppress the opponent but couldn't defeat him.
The only solution now was to have the Blood Slaves kill their way into the Spiritual Realm, blood sacrifice the Spiritual Realm to enhance his power, and then crush the enemy in one go.
So the 726 Blood Disciple went mad, attacking fiercely. After forcing Xu Yan to dodge, his figure flashed, aiming to attack Meng Chong and rescue the Blood Slaves who were blocked.
"Your opponent is me!"
Ao!
Suddenly, one after another, golden giant dragons roared and charged over from all directions.
In an instant, there were eighteen golden giant dragons.
In this moment, Xu Yan continuously unleashed the True Dragon's Rage Divine Skill, the vision of mountains and rivers on his body becoming even more vivid.
Weng!
At the same time, the Mountains and Rivers in the Sword Divine Skill enveloped down, engulfing the 726 Blood Disciple in an instant.
Black Sword Light, sharp and ruthless, as if wanting to exterminate everything, emerged amidst the mountains and rivers.
Apart from that, Xu Yan struck out with another palm and sword strike.
These were Divine Skills from the Divine Skill Martial Code, which Xu Yan had only recently cultivated.
In this instant, Xu Yan almost exhausted all his strength, unleashing the Divine Skills one after another.
The 726 Blood Disciple's eyes narrowed, and in his blood-red eyes, a surge of mad rage was emerging.
"You rat, you must die!"
Boom!
```
The terrifying crimson overflowed from the 726th Blood Disciple in madness, with blade lights surrounding him, and a sinister blood light also burst forth from the blood pattern on his forehead.
Boom!
At that instant, a horrifying scarlet blade light erupted, the bloodthirst of the Blood Sha filled the sky, and in the blink of an eye, it exploded in all directions, seemingly seeking to invade Xu Yan's divine essence.
Thunderous roar!
But in a flash, "Mountains and Rivers in the Sword" collapsed, the Golden Giant Dragon shattered, a series of attacks all crumbled under the wrathful strike of the 726th Blood Disciple!
Xu Yan's expression tensed, his figure shifted, and in an instant, he disappeared from the spot.
"Where will you hide!"
The 726th Blood Disciple's crimson eyes flashed with blood light, and it seemed as if an aura was closely locked onto Xu Yan, as if it had seeped into his divine essence.
Preventing Xu Yan from escaping the 726th Blood Disciple's lock-on.
"Hmm?"
Xu Yan's eyebrows raised, his figure shifted again, and he vanished from the spot once more, while at the same time, the "Supreme Heavenly Sword" slashed down again.
Hum!
In the instant Xu Yan's "Supreme Heavenly Sword" came slashing down, his divine essence surged for a moment, and instantly, the aura of the 726th Blood Disciple was purified and disappeared.
"How is this possible!"
The 726th Blood Disciple was shocked; he had just permeated the opponent's Martial Arts with his life's blood essence, it should have been impossible to evade his aura lock.
This wasn't his first battle with martial artists from this domain, and anyone whose Martial Arts was permeated by his life's blood essence should absolutely be unable to purge it so quickly, especially in the midst of combat.
This was also the method the Netherworld Blood Disciples employed to hunt down martial artists of this domain.
But this time, it had failed!
At this moment, the 726th Blood Disciple's heart tensed, realizing there was something unusual about the Spiritual Realm, and he should not continue the fight any longer; he had to break through the situation quickly.
Wanting to fight a quick battle and crush Xu Yan, the 726th Blood Disciple admitted he was no longer capable of doing so unless he was willing to pay a price and use some of his ace secret techniques.
But he couldn't be sure whether Xu Yan had already given his all, whether all secret techniques had been used.
Thus, after forcing Xu Yan back once again, he fled toward the battle site of Meng Chong and the horde of Blood Slaves.
Only to be blocked by Xu Yan again.
The fierce battle continued relentlessly, and although Xu Yan blocked the 726th Blood Disciple each time, the Blood Disciple was still approaching the battlefield where Meng Chong was, just more slowly.
Xu Yan was helpless; the gap in strength between them was too great, and if it hadn't been for the marvelousness of the "Yin Yang Undying Sword," how could he have fought until now?
"The second junior brother has not yet defeated all the Blood Slaves; once he gets closer, I'm afraid it'll be dangerous!"
Xu Yan's heart grew heavy.
Meng Chong's boundless divine defense was indeed Wushuang, his physique was incredibly strong, but after all, the gap in strength was too large to withstand many attacks.
"My Divine Skills are powerful, but they are primarily designed for slaughter. 'Mountains and Rivers in the Sword' can only trap the adversary for a moment and cannot stop him from continuing to approach the second junior brother!"
Although the Master was present and would not allow danger to occur, it would reflect poorly on the disciples' capability if the Master had to act every time.
"I can't let the Master down. If I cannot even stop a mere Blood Disciple, how can I reach half the power of the Master at the same stage?"
Xu Yan's mind conjured up the Divine Skill Martial Code, in which several Divine Skills emerged, especially a few Great Divine Powers.
A Great Divine Power emerged in his mind.
Great Sky Hand!
The Domain itself could be plucked into the hand, this Divine Skill instantly captures the enemy upon release!
It wielded the dual power of capture and slaughter.
Boom!
Xu Yan's eyes sharpened, and with a grab of his hand, a colossal palm instantly descended from the void, seeking to capture the 726th Blood Disciple.
However, this colossal palm was too weak in power; at best, it was formed by the aggregation of nature's spiritual energy and lacked the power of a Divine Skill!
Pff!
The 726th Blood Disciple sneered, his bloodthirsty aura surged, and in an instant, the colossal palm shattered.
His figure shifted, continuing his onslaught toward Meng Chong.
Xu Yan took a deep breath, pointed with his sword, and in an instant, waves rose into a towering surge, turning into numerous giant swords, each exuding a chilling Sword Intent.
Sword after sword lined up in formation, and in an instant, the giant swords encircled, their Sword Intents melded together, forming a Sword Array!
```

chapters.title: Chapter 687 - 364 Xu Yan: If you strike again, I won't be able to hold out.
chapters.content:
Above the Azure Sea, the battle was intense, stirring up terrifying waves that even swept across the cliffs on the Hongzhou coast, numbing the geniuses of the Spiritual Realm who were watching.
The gap between individuals could be despairingly vast.
The 726 Blood Disciple, upon his arrival, had shattered the Divine Bridge and killed the Heavenly Venerable, with unmatched might, yet was still unable to do anything to Xu Yan.
Wu Tianan and Xin Mengrou, who stood at the pinnacle of Spiritual Realm Martial Arts, also didn't know what to feel at this moment. It was a crisis for the Spiritual Realm, yet they, the top powers of the Spiritual Realm, were unable to intervene.
To say nothing of intervening, they didn't even dare to get close!
Any small backlash that swept their way would annihilate them.
In the distance, the fierce battle between Xu Yan and the 726 Blood Disciple grew ever more intense. All of a sudden, on top of the Azure Sea, one huge sword after another stood tall.
The terrifying waves turned into giant swords, emanating a chilling Sword Intent. Even from a great distance, it made hearts quiver with fear.
"Truly worthy of the title Sword God!"
Someone exclaimed in admiration.
Such a profound mastery of the Sword Dao, unique in the heavens and earth, belonged to no one other than Xu Yan.
After all, a superior person had already transcended the confines of heaven and earth.
As the Sword Array rose, it started to impede the 726 Blood Disciple again, and Xu Yan continued to strike out with palm after palm, trying to practice the Great Sky Hand, a Great Divine Power.
Even though he unleashed the Sword Array and a myriad of Divine Skills, the 726 Blood Disciple was still slowly moving towards the direction where Meng Chong was located.
It was just that his speed had once again decreased.
Atop the Evergreen Pavilion, Li Xuan was closely watching the battle. Seeing Xu Yan attempting to cultivate the Great Sky Hand brought a smile to his face.
This Great Divine Power was something he had put a lot of thought into creating.
With a wave of his hand, he could pluck the stars and grasp the moon, immensely powerful.
"Could it be that the first Great Divine Power is about to be cultivated?"
Li Xuan was full of anticipation.
Indeed, true prodigies grew in battle, especially when fighting against strong opponents, in treacherous environs.
Even Su Lingxiu, who was neither skilled nor fond of fighting, had greatly improved her strength after a series of battles.
Not to mention her combat experience, which was rapidly accumulating.
"The Heavenly Grotto truly is a great place for Martial Artists to train."
Li Xuan murmured to himself.
Looking up at the collapsing Divine Bridge, since it had fallen, the connection between the Spiritual Realm and the Divine Realm was severed. Even if the Divine Realm wanted to send help, it was unlikely they could do so quickly.
Moreover, the Qinghua state of the Divine Realm was probably in great chaos.
"The Taicang Domain might be facing some crises."
Li Xuan pondered.
The Divine Bridge was formed by the Principle of Heaven and Earth, a rule established to connect the Spiritual Realm and the Divine Realm; its own strength was not particularly robust.
It was not the true Principle of Domain Origin, hence it was destroyed by the 726 Blood Disciple.
Although the Divine Bridge Rule had collapsed, over time, it would slowly reconnect and be restored as before, but it would take a considerable amount of time.
Boom!
The great battle persisted, with a third of the Blood Slaves fighting Meng Chong already slain.
Fang Hao, too, was honing himself through this, constantly deploying Qimen Martial Art. The Great Formation kept shifting, transforming the Qimen Armory into a torrent, bombarding the Blood Slaves.
Lingxiu was doing the same, using the opportunity to polish her own Martial Arts.
The 726 Blood Disciple was relentless; even with Xu Yan's determined resistance, his face remained grim. He wasn't fixated solely on Xu Yan but was trying to break free from Xu Yan's entanglement as much as possible.
He knew very well that if he couldn't break away from Xu Yan, their plan for the Spiritual Realm would fail.
And his wish to ascend to a Blood Child would be dashed!
"Scoundrel, I must kill you!"
The 726 Blood Disciple was filled with murderous intent. Xu Yan's interference was like an obstruction on his Martial Way and his path to becoming a Blood Child, a great enmity!
Xu Yan raised his hand, and in an instant, a spiritual radiance emerged, enlightenment flooding his mind. At this moment, he felt he had fully comprehended the Great Sky Hand Divine Power.
Boom!
With a wave of his hand, a gigantic hand instantly seemed to grasp the very space where the 726 Blood Disciple was.
The giant hand appeared to contain a space of its own!
Xu Yan was elated, having finally cultivated the Great Sky Hand!
Boom!
The 726 Blood Disciple felt darkness before his eyes, as if space itself was bound, engulfed by a powerful gripping force that instantly gave him the sensation of being held in the palm of a hand.
Shocked, the bloodthirsty energy surged wildly within him, the blood-red saber light becoming even more fierce, splitting a terrifying blood light.
However, in that instant, he was left with the feeling of being flung away by someone.
Xu Yan was well aware that despite successfully cultivating the Great Sky Hand, he was still no match for the 726 Blood Disciple and couldn't suppress him.
The primary purpose of mastering this Divine Power was to prevent the 726 Blood Disciple from approaching Meng Chong.
Thus, as soon as the Great Sky Hand grasped the 726 Blood Disciple, Xu Yan flung him away.
Immediately after, he moved swiftly, following up closely, continuously unleashing True Dragon Rage, the Supreme Heavenly Sword, and Mountains and Rivers in the Sword.
Boom!
The Great Hand collapsed, and the blood light rekindled. The dual pupils of the 726 surged with blood-red flames of fury, uncontainable!
At that moment, he realized he was even further from Meng Chong, thrown behind by Xu Yan.
The two were entangled in combat once more, and although Xu Yan was pressured, he never lost. Like an unshakeable leaf on the vast waters, no matter how ferocious the waves, they couldn't sink the tiny vessel.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has successfully cultivated the Great Divine Power, the Great Sky Hand, you've created to perfection."

chapters.title: Chapter 688 - 364 Xu Yan: If you strike again, I won't be able to fend it off_2
chapters.content:
Li Xuan felt a surge of excitement within his heart, having mastered an incredibly powerful Divine Skill, and moreover, he had perfected it directly.
"Continue to strive, and create even stronger Divine Skills."
Li Xuan looked at the Divine Skill Martial Code he had created, which still did not encompass enough Divine Skills, nor were there enough of them.
Especially the Great Divine Powers, he had created too few of them.
Divine Skills like One Thought Rebirth, White Bone Rebirth, had not yet been created; there was only a framework, and he needed to continue working hard.
Boom!
726 Blood Disciple still didn't change his goal, even as the distance widened, he still tried every possible means to approach Meng Chong, but he kept a wary eye out for Xu Yan's Great Sky Hand.
However, even so, when Xu Yan displayed the Great Sky Hand, 726 Blood Disciple, despite immediately shattering the giant hand, was still sent flying.
After several such incidents, 726 Blood Disciple was about to lose his mind.
A terrifying surge of blood energy emitted from his body, sweeping in all directions and seemingly turning the battlefield into a blood prison, with a frightening scent of blood suffusing the space between heaven and earth.
Even the rolling waves of the Azure Sea turned scarlet within that region, as if it had transformed into surging blood waves.
"You deserve to die!"
In this moment, 726 Blood Disciple began to use his last-resort tactics.
He knew that he couldn't approach Meng Chong, as for the other two and one tiger, they were even further away and even less likely to get close.
It seemed that the Blood Slaves would likely be annihilated.
Boom!
At the location of the Azure Sea Abyss, a vortex suddenly appeared, the black mouth of the Heavenly Grotto beginning to reveal itself.
Gradually, a blood-red vortex emerged, with strands of blood energy constantly emerging and entering into 726 Blood Disciple's body!
In this moment, 726 Blood Disciple's strength soared dramatically; with a lift of his Scarlet Long Knife, its power was no weaker than the slash that had collapsed the Divine Bridge.
Xu Yan's expression was extremely solemn; swords, one after another, emerged, and Sword Arrays, one after another, assembled, while the Yin Yang Undying Sword was pushed to its extreme.
Raising his hand, he struck out with the Divine Skill, True Dragon Rage!
Mountains and Rivers in the Sword also emerged, and in an instant, he unleashed seven of them, layering them together.
The Supreme Heavenly Sword was also utilized.
In this moment, Xu Yan truly gave it his all.
726 Blood Disciple's slash gave him an extremely intense sensation of danger; the Yin Yang Undying Sword alone seemed unlikely to withstand this strike.
"His realm is that of a True King Heavenly Venerable, and not just an ordinary one. With my entry-level Divine Skill Realm strength, even if the Yin Yang Undying Sword is profound, it will not be able to stand against it!"
Xu Yan's heart tensed, but he remained unafraid.
Boom!
The Sacred Bone and Divine Body, at this moment, showcased their extraordinary nature, their martial arts accumulations after breaking into the Divine Skill Realm, and after this great battle, also finally reached its peak.
Nature's spiritual energy rushed in frantically, even resembling a dense fog enveloping Xu Yan.
The Divine Skill Realm was achieved!
"To break through in the midst of battle, truly worthy of being the pioneer of my martial arts undertaking," said Li Xuan with a look of surprise.
Through the course of this grand battle, Xu Yan had achieved a breakthrough to the initial stage of the Divine Skill Realm.
"Your disciple, Xu Yan, has achieved a breakthrough to the initial stage of the Divine Skill Realm, you to the initial stage of the Void-breaking Realm."
His strength had increased again.
Boom!
The slash that had once shattered the Divine Bridge appeared once again; the space between heaven and earth seemed to be cleaved into two by the scarlet blade light.
This slash, which had shattered the Divine Bridge, was now facing Xu Yan!
Wu Tianan among other strong fighters, looked on with shocked expressions at this terrifying slash, which in their eyes, was blindingly scarlet—one would liken it to the sword of death, flying up from the Azure Sea.
The blade light was not only striking towards Xu Yan, but also heading in the direction of Hongzhou.
Everyone subconsciously looked up to the figure seated indifferently at the Evergreen Pavilion.
How would Xu Yan withstand such a terrifying slash?
His unceasing sword light could no longer defend against such a horrific strike.
Atop the Evergreen Pavilion, Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao, as well as Yue'er, were all extremely nervous, with their bright eyes looking towards Li Xuan, who sat in the chair.
Even Xie Tianheng and his wife, Xie Lingfeng, and Meng Shushu, were all doing the same.
But Li Xuan remained leisurely seated, seemingly indifferent to Xu Yan's life or death.
726 Blood Disciple's slash was undoubtedly very powerful; even a True King Heavenly Venerable had been slain by it. If it were Xu Yan before his breakthrough, his Yin Yang Undying Sword would not have been able to fully defend against this strike and would have surely been shattered in one blow.
But, Xu Yan had broken through!
He had reached the initial stage of the Divine Skill Realm, and though it was just a breakthrough, his Divine Skills had significantly improved.
Relying on his Sword Array, True Dragon Rage, Supreme Heavenly Sword, and Mountains and Rivers in the Sword, he would be able to withstand this slash.
Boom!
```
Ao!
The golden giant dragon roared, its terrifying dragon might and raging fury bombarding the knife light.
The black sword light, annihilating all in its path, also slashed toward the scarlet knife light.
Xu Yan continuously struck out, yet this blade seemed unstoppable, annihilating both the golden giant dragon and the black sword light, shattering the Mountains and Rivers in the Sword, and continued to slash toward Xu Yan.
Weng!
In that instant, a sword wheel expanded in a flash, turning into a hundred zhang in size.
The hundred zhang sword wheel spun round and round, endless and unceasing.
Rumbling!
The knife light struck into the midst of the sword wheel, with the sound of cracking echoing out, as the endlessly spinning sword wheel developed cracks at this moment.
Moreover, the cycle became slower and even seemed about to halt.
Visible to the naked eye, that stream of scarlet knife light was being carried around by the sword wheel, constantly being transferred from within the wheel to other places.
Click, click, click...
Amidst a series of clicking sounds, the sword wheel developed numerous cracks, but ultimately completed a full cycle.
In the moment the sword wheel completed a cycle, the scarlet knife light that had been taken into the wheel abruptly slashed out, cutting back in the direction from which the knife light had come.
It cut toward the six hundred and twenty-sixth Blood Disciple.
Boom!
As this blade was unleashed, the sword wheel also collapsed, transforming into a fierce sword light that fused into the knife light, adding to this slash.
Shua!
The power of this blade, while not as strong as when the six hundred and twenty-sixth had unleashed it, still possessed six to seven-tenths of its strength!
"Return to sender!"
Xu Yan's breath was somewhat labored, but he spoke with a brimming smile.
Weng!
A new sword wheel once again emerged around him, continuing to spin endlessly and unceasingly!
"How is this possible! What kind of monster are you!"
The six hundred and twenty-sixth Blood Disciple's entire body seemed to lose some of its scarlet hue.
Grinding his teeth, he swung his blade to block the retaliatory strike.
Bang!
Staggering back several steps, he looked toward the youth, a trace of fear flashing through the depths of his eyes.
Having gone through countless battles, slain many a martial artist, and even been hunted by stronger warriors, he had never encountered such a tenacious and unbelievably difficult foe!
At that moment, a deep sense of powerlessness welled up inside him.
Even though the opponent was far weaker in strength, he had withstood his onslaught by relying on that bizarre martial arts technique; even one of his trump card moves had been blocked.
"In this Domain, such a monster should not exist. Why is there such a monster?
"Something's not right, something's very wrong. I must report this, I must find a way to kill this person while he is still in his growth stage.
"Otherwise, he will become a great threat!
"If his strength were equal to mine today... no, even if he were weaker, I would have already been slain by him!"
The more the six hundred and twenty-sixth Blood Disciple thought about it, the more terrified he became.
At this moment, occupying the Spiritual Realm and performing a Blood Sacrifice on it was no longer his goal. He needed to return to the Netherworld to report this, to absolutely find a way to kill Xu Yan!
If such a bizarre and demonic being were allowed to grow, it would surely become a huge problem!
This Domain could not have such a paradigm-shifting monster present!
Thinking this, the six hundred and twenty-sixth Blood Disciple took a deep look at Xu Yan, then turned around and left, paying no heed to the Blood Slaves.
This plan had failed!
As he caught his breath, regaining his expended energy, Xu Yan couldn't help but be stunned.
"You're not going to carry out the Blood Sacrifice on the Spiritual Realm? If you attack with one more slash, I won't be able to withstand it!"
Xu Yan called out.
The aura on the six hundred and twenty-sixth Blood Disciple surged with fury for a moment, but he suppressed the madness and rage in his heart.
"Fool, do not push your luck!"
Xu Yan took a few steps forward and said, "I never lie. Just one more slash from you, and I truly won't be able to resist."
Fuck!
Is there no end to this?!
The six hundred and twenty-sixth Blood Disciple felt on the verge of collapse inside, feeling excessively bullied!
His speed suddenly increased. He no longer paid any attention to Xu Yan and even closed off his hearing to avoid being angered into losing his reason and returning to continue the fight recklessly.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 689 - 365: Searching the Soul, Enemy from Beyond
chapters.content:
The 726 Blood Disciple actually didn't hesitate to retreat directly, which was beyond Xu Yan's expectations, especially since that last strike was extremely powerful, so powerful that even after he had broken through to the minor achievement stage of the Divine Skill Realm, it was still somewhat strenuous to resist.
As he moved to block the path of the 726 Blood Disciple, the latter seemed to have anticipated this and turned into a streak of blood light that instantly escaped into the depths of the Azure Sea.
He was determined to flee, with no regard for the lives of those Blood Slaves.
The 726 Blood Disciple felt a heavy weight on his heart. Xu Yan was already so terrifying; what if there were a dozen or more Xu Yans in this Domain?
Once they grew in power, they would pose a tremendous threat.
He must report this matter and formulate a plan to eradicate them.
Apart from Xu Yan, the other three people and one tiger were not to be underestimated; in the same realm, perhaps no one in the Netherworld could match them!
With his mind set on fleeing, Xu Yan knew it would be difficult to stop the 726 Blood Disciple, especially after the great battle they just had, and particularly after withstanding that last strike, Xu Yan had expended quite a bit of energy.
Even with his prodigious martial arts foundation, which was rapidly recovering, he had not yet returned to his peak condition, so Xu Yan didn't insist on stopping the Blood Disciple.
Instead, he followed closely behind, wanting to see what the Heavenly Grotto in the Azure Sea Abyss was all about.
The figure of the 726 Blood Disciple had already reached above the Azure Sea Abyss and was about to enter the Heavenly Grotto when suddenly the Domain darkened, and space itself seemed to freeze.
The figure of the 726 Blood Disciple instantly froze, unable to move at all, as if space itself had bound him in place.
"What is this?"
The 726 Blood Disciple was shocked.
A powerful being!
Could it be that a strong figure from the Divine Realm has come to aid us?
The Divine Bridge had collapsed, and even if a powerful being came to help, they would need to restore the Divine Bridge to reach the Spiritual Realm in such a short time!
However, the Divine Bridge had not been repaired!
A massive hand reached down, as if scooping up the space the disciple occupied along with him.
The Great Sky Hand!
"Master!"
Xu Yan paused, recognizing the Great Sky Hand!
"The same Great Sky Hand, my understanding of it is far too inferior compared to Master!"
Xu Yan sighed to himself.
When Li Xuan saw that the 726 Blood Disciple was not continuing the fight and instead fleeing in haste, he would not let him get away, so he directly made a move and captured him.
The emergence of the Ice State Grotto had caused a disaster, and the Heavenly Grotto of the Azure Sea Abyss was far more threatening than the Ice State Grotto; the 726 Blood Disciple had even destroyed the Divine Bridge and killed a Heavenly Venerable.
And to understand the existence of the Heavenly Grotto, the 726 Blood Disciple was undoubtedly a clue.
What precisely was the Netherworld?
For this reason, Li Xuan personally took action and captured the 726 Blood Disciple.
With his current strength, capturing the 726 Blood Disciple was merely a matter of thought and as effortless as blowing off dust.
The 726 Blood Disciple was terrified. In the blink of an eye, he found himself before a young man.
The man sat leisurely in a chair.
Next to him stood an incredibly beautiful woman, seemingly a beauty from the Sea Spirit Tribe.
"You..."
The 726 Blood Disciple's face showed disbelief. Was there such a powerful being in the Spiritual Realm?
An Immortal Heavenly Venerable?
The Netherworld Blood Child was at the level of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable and could easily capture him without effort.
But the person before him seemed to be much more than just an Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
"Netherworld?"
Li Xuan looked down at the 726 Blood Disciple with a tone that seemed somewhat disdainful of the Netherworld.
He lifted a hand and pressed it directly on the 726 Blood Disciple's head.
There was no need for interrogation; direct soul searching would be more efficient.
He hadn't used the Soul Searching Secret Technique since acquiring it, and regardless of what damage it might cause the 726 Blood Disciple, he naturally didn't care.
This was an invader; this was an enemy.
The 726 Blood Disciple felt his consciousness roar, as if he had fallen into a strange state, with memories and consciousness being sifted through, and he was profoundly shocked!
Realizing something was wrong, he roared in his heart, trying to resist this terrifying power.
However, he could not muster even a hint of resistance.
Li Xuan's gaze was indifferent, and as he searched through the memories of the 726 Blood Disciple, they began to unfold until a sudden surge of blood light appeared, as if a mysterious force had sealed off the secrets deep within the 726's consciousness.
In an instant, the 726 Blood Disciple burst into a cloud of blood mist and dissipated completely.
Li Xuan's eyebrows twitched. The memories of the 726 Blood Disciple that involved some secret seemed to be protected by a kind of seal.
Once touched, it instantly ignited, completely collapsing the disciple's consciousness, collapsing the 726 Blood Disciple.
"Very powerful."
Li Xuan's heart chilled slightly. The one behind the scenes who could collapse the consciousness of the 726 Blood Disciple in an instant, under his soul searching, was certainly not as simple as an Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
"The Netherworld Blood Lord?"
Li Xuan mused.
Although he had not managed to uncover the core secrets of the 726 Blood Disciple's consciousness, he did obtain a lot of useful information.
The Netherworld seemed to be a certain Domain.
The 726 Blood Disciple was a servant or perhaps a disciple of the Netherworld Blood Lord, and above the Blood Disciple was the Xuezhi.
As for the Netherworld Blood Lord, he was enigmatic and mysterious. Li Xuan only saw this name in the memories of the 726 Blood Disciple, and as for the appearance and other details, perhaps they were core secrets, now inaccessible due to the collapse of the 726's consciousness.
"The Netherworld Cave?"
Li Xuan murmurs to himself.
The 726 Blood Disciple had plotted for a long time for this day, but in the end, he still failed.

chapters.title: Chapter 690 - 690: 365
chapters.content:
"The enemy from beyond the heavens,"
Li Xuan sighed.
The Heavenly Grotto, the hole of the Domain, located at the rift of this world, eroded by external forces and thus forming a Heavenly Grotto.
There were Heavenly Grottos of various sizes. The smaller ones were merely little holes, like the one Xu Yan discovered in the dark pool of the Azure Sea.
As for the enormous Heavenly Grottos, they were vast in space.
And the Azure Sea Abyss happened to have once experienced a Domain rift, which under the infiltration of Netherworld's power, transformed into a Heavenly Grotto.
"Is the Seductive Witch also from the Netherworld?"
Li Xuan pondered.
The Heavenly Grotto in Ice State had already been sealed by him, and the Seductive Witch could no longer enter.
"The Taicang Domain seems to face external threats? The Heavenly Grotto is the channel for the invasion of enemies, though the enemies can infiltrate through the Grotto, the martial artists of this Domain cannot enter their territory and can only sit and defend."
Li Xuan thought about the small stone house in the Wu Country Royal Palace. The being that was sealed inside, was it the master of the Book of Taicang or an invading enemy from afar?
Logically, being sealed within this Domain, it seemed more likely to be an external invader.
But who sealed it?
Master of the Book of Taicang?
If it was a seal for an enemy, why wasn't there any expert guarding it?
Could it be that the master of the Book of Taicang sealed the enemy but also perished in the process, and no one knew that an enemy was sealed there?
Li Xuan recalled when The Emperor of Wu mentioned that mysterious voice, he had said the other party once raved madly, uttering things about imposters… Moreover, since they knew that Martial Arts couldn't be cultivated in the Border Wilderness and seemed quite familiar with the Taicang Domain,
It seemed that it might not be an enemy invader after all.
"The truth will become clear once I find the other party,"
Li Xuan thought to himself.
Boom!
The battle was nearing its end, Meng Chong at this moment displayed his Divine Skills, slaughtering a group of Blood Slaves.
And Su Lingxiu felt like she had practiced enough and began making deadly moves.
Fang Hao and Red Cat did the same.
"To the Azure Sea Abyss."
Li Xuan ordered.
Humm!
The Flying Boat transformed into a streak of light, heading towards the Azure Sea Abyss.
Spiritual Realm Experts like Wu Tianan simultaneously heaved a sigh of relief and quickly followed.
A massive black vortex emerged from the Azure Sea Abyss. Through the black vortex, one could see the surging waves of blood below.
"This is..."
Wu Tianan and others trembled at the sight, filled with a sense of horror, not daring to rashly enter.
"Master!"
Xu Yan came to the Flying Boat and respectfully said.
"Hmm!"
Li Xuan nodded, not entering the Heavenly Grotto below immediately.
Boom!
The battle finally calmed down, Meng Chong, Su Lingxiu, Fang Hao, and Red Cat all returned to the Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship.
"Let's go in,"
Li Xuan said.
The Flying Boat shone with thunder, the Formation activated, and entered the Heavenly Grotto below. After arriving, they discovered that this Heavenly Grotto was much larger than the one in Ice State.
Moreover, at the bottom of the Grotto, waves of blood rolled tumultuously, appearing to be formed by the erosion of some sort of blood-evil Qi on the invading sea water.
Spiritual Realm Experts like Wu Tianan stood by the Grotto, hesitating to enter.
Boom!
The waves of blood roared, permeated by the blood-evil Qi, surging forward as if intending to dye even the Flying Boat blood-red.
Li Xuan raised his hand and with a boom, the waves began to condense and clear up, reversing back up as the seawater returned to the Azure Sea.
At this moment, three blood-red pearls appeared in the center of the Heavenly Grotto.
Netherworld Blood Orbs!
"These are treasures that greatly replenish vital blood!"
Su Lingxiu stated.
Li Xuan nodded. Netherworld Blood Orbs were also a type of treasure. If used properly, they could enhance vital blood, heal injuries caused by vital blood loss, and to a certain extent, strengthen the physical body.
If combined with other Spiritual Medicines to refine pills, the effects would be even stronger.
And the Netherworld Blood Orbs, perhaps due to the abundant blood Qi contained in the Netherworld, were therefore able to condense into Blood Beads.
Whether for Blood Slaves or Blood Disciples, each possessed a life-origin Blood Bead, also cultivated from Netherworld Blood Orbs.
At the bottom of the Heavenly Grotto lay a pale red barrier, thin as a membrane that seemed to suggest a glimpse of the outside world could be seen through it.
However, this membrane was a Domain Barrier, and despite Li Xuan's current Void-breaking Realm, he could not traverse it to leave this specific domain.
After all, he had not truly transcended the domain.
"The bottom of the Heavenly Grotto seems rather small; this space must have formed later on,"
Fang Hao remarked with surprise.
The bottom of the Heavenly Grotto wasn't very large, similar to the one in Ice State, but the Domain Barrier here appeared somewhat weaker, with threads of blood energy constantly flowing into the grotto. It had grown to such an immense size over time due to the long erosion by the blood energy.
"There's no trace of Imperishable Qi here; does this mean that the Heavenly Grotto is different?"
Xu Yan pondered as he explored the grotto.
"Quite likely, and I feel this blood energy might actually aid in the practice of Physical Body Martial Arts to a certain extent, although it is of no use to me at my current physical state,"
Meng Chong added as he walked through the grotto.
"What do we do now? Will there be Netherworld Blood Disciples coming into the Spiritual Realm?"
Fang Hao asked with some concern.
As a resident of the Spiritual Realm, this place was his homeland.
Despite having stepped down from his position as Alliance Hierarch of the Wanshi Alliance, they still held great respect for him.
"Just seal it,"
Li Xuan had investigated the base of the Heavenly Grotto and, despite not being able to see the details, he knew that it was a location prepared by one of the Six Blood Disciples looking to ascend to the rank of Xuezhi, who had not informed anyone else.
Fearing others might take credit for it, this Netherworld Cave remained unknown for the time being.
It merely required sealing; unless someone's strength was too overwhelming, it would be difficult to discover.
"We're lacking a pupil-based Divine Skill,"
Li Xuan muttered to himself, deciding that at some point he would take the time to create several pupil-based Divine Skills, such as 'Heaven's Eye,' 'Golden Eyes of Fire,' 'Eyes of Illusion-Breaking,' and so forth.
Whether they could be cultivated or not would be left for his disciple to figure out.
"Master, please seal this Heavenly Grotto,"
Fang Hao respectfully requested.
"Hmm,"
Li Xuan nodded, waving his hand; threads of Imperishable Qi emerged, and in an instant, transformed into a massive seal that enveloped the base of the Netherworld Cave.
Completely concealing the grotto.
"There's nothing of value here; let's leave!"
The Flying Boat left the Heavenly Grotto and then headed to the Black Abyss of the Azure Sea. Li Xuan glanced at the grotto Xu Yan had discovered; it was too small, and he was unsure how long it would take to expand.
Especially after Fang Hao's seal, its expansion rate had slowed to a crawl, making enlargement nearly impossible.
With a wave of his hand, another seal descended, thoroughly sealing off the grotto.
Shortly after Li Xuan sealed the grotto and departed, the once small base of the Heavenly Grotto suddenly manifested an eye that seemed to be trying to see through.
However, it saw nothing, filled with confusion and even doubting whether there was an issue with its vision. After blinking a few times and straining to see, it found nothing and eventually closed its eyes, full of bewilderment.
The Divine Bridge had broken, and the path to the Divine Realm was severed as well.
The turmoil in the Black Abyss of the Azure Sea had all the experts of the Spiritual Realm deeply worried, Fang Hao included.
"Is there anywhere else in the Spiritual Realm where danger might erupt at any moment?"
Wu Tianan asked in a grave tone.
"We should explore all of the well-known dangerous places within the Spiritual Realm,"
Xin Mengrou suggested.
While a formidable figure was still within the Spiritual Realm, if any dangers did exist, they could ask for assistance in sealing them off.
They all looked towards Fang Hao.
Given that Fang Hao was the disciple of the formidable figure and held in high esteem by the Wanshi Alliance, he was deeply concerned about any potential crisis in the Spiritual Realm.
"Master, I would like to explore the Spiritual Realm and uncover other potential crises!"
Fang Hao spoke respectfully.
"Hmm, go ahead!"
Li Xuan nodded.
If a crisis lay hidden in the Spiritual Realm, Fang Hao would worry even if he were in the Divine Realm. Rather than that, it would be better to investigate the Spiritual Realm now and resolve any underlying threats.
Only then would Fang Hao be able to go to the Divine Realm with peace of mind.
"Junior Brother, let's split up and work quickly to finish the investigation,"
Xu Yan suggested.
As the Spiritual Realm was connected to the Inner Domain, any catastrophe that befell it could likely spread there; and currently, the overall strength of the Inner Domain was far weaker than the Spiritual Realm.
"Alright!"
Fang Hao agreed.
Xu Yan, Meng Chong, and Fang Hao immediately departed, while Red Cat did the same. It returned to the Demon Clan to arrange various tasks and also participate in the search across the Spiritual Realm.
Wu Tianan, Xin Mengrou, and other experts of the Spiritual Realm dispersed, employing the powers of the Transcendent Spirit Sect to scour the entire realm. They would investigate any abnormality, even if it was just a rumor, personally.

chapters.title: Chapter 691 - 366 Eye of the Heavenly Dao, Turmoil in the Divine Realm
chapters.content:
The Spiritual Realm was vast, and even with the collective efforts of the Transcendent Spirit Sect and the communication system constructed by the Wanshi Alliance, it would still take considerable time to thoroughly search the entire Spiritual Realm.
Li Xuan was in no rush, waiting in Hongzhou for news from Xu Yan and the others aboard the Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Boat.
"The Spiritual Realm should not have so many hidden dangers as to have another Heavenly Grotto," Li Xuan made up his mind.
However, a thorough search would ultimately bring more peace of mind.
Inside the Evergreen Pavilion, Su Lingxiu was deeply engrossed in studying the Netherworld Blood Orb.
The others were all diligently cultivating their own skills, Du Yuying, Yun Miaomiao, and Zi Yun even more so; the recent battle had left them feeling as if they were too weak.
They must strive to achieve Perfection in their cultivation as soon as possible, so that once they entered the Divine Realm, they could quickly prepare to break through to the level of Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable.
Li Xuan was developing a new Divine Skill, a Pupil Technique Divine Skill.
"Thousand Mile Vision? Not a strong enough name. Heavenly Eye? Eye of the Deceiver? Illusory Void God Pupil?" Li Xuan muttered to himself as he began to ponder over the pupil technique-based Divine Skills,
"Let's keep it simple and call it the Eye of the Heavenly Dao. It can see through illusions and deceptions, captivate the soul, observe the flow of time and space, and carry the authority of the Heavenly Dao..." Li Xuan's inspiration surged as a powerful Pupil Technique Divine Skill took shape.
The Eye of the Heavenly Dao!
"It's powerful, but hard to develop, and even harder to comprehend... The Eye of the Heavenly Dao will just be regarded as an extremely powerful Great Divine Power. But before it's perfected, I can create a downgraded version of the Eye of the Heavenly Dao.
"Let's call it the Minor Eye of the Heavenly Dao. It will serve as the entry requirement and foundation for cultivating the Eye of the Heavenly Dao.
"That's what I'll do. I'll create the Minor Eye of the Heavenly Dao first, and once it's comprehended, it will be easier to develop the true Eye of the Heavenly Dao.?" Li Xuan decided.
The Eye of the Heavenly Dao, in his concept, was undoubtedly mighty, but not easy to create, and once created, it was not easy to comprehend.
This would require an extremely high Realm, and theoretically, the Eye of the Heavenly Dao couldn't even be used by those of lower Realms.
Therefore, he would create a fundamental Realm, the Minor Eye of the Heavenly Dao, as a foundation for cultivation.
"The Minor Eye of the Heavenly Dao, although not as powerful as the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, is still extremely strong at this stage. The higher the Realm, the more powerful it is.
"Moreover, it's more suitable for Xu Yan's current Realm to comprehend."
Li Xuan began to develop the Minor Eye of the Heavenly Dao. Although he had already created many Martial Arts Techniques and Divine Skills, and had plenty of experience, it was still not easy to create the Minor Eye of the Heavenly Dao.
Randomly creating without a theoretical framework wouldn't work—how would you comprehend it otherwise?
"In addition to the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, I should also develop other pupil technique-based Divine Skills. After all, the number of people who will cultivate Divine Skills will increase in the future, and the difficulty of cultivating the Eye of the Heavenly Dao is bound to be extremely high, only prodigies can manage to cultivate it.
"Therefore, I also need to create some weaker ones, or those focused on a particular ability such as attacking enemies, seeing through deception, or enchanting the mind..."
Li Xuan began adding a new category to the Divine Skill Martial Code, the Pupil Technique Divine Skills!
"There are countless Divine Skills, all dependent on my creation. No matter how I develop them, there are limits. The most fundamental thing is to create a system of how to cultivate and self-comprehend Divine Skills.
"In this way, the prodigies will realize their own Divine Skills, and as time accumulates, the Martial Arts Divine Skills will inevitably become more and more diverse."
Li Xuan suddenly had a realization; relying solely on himself to create Divine Skills, no matter how hard he tried or how much he racked his brain, it was ultimately limited.
Only by creating a system for cultivating and self-comprehending Divine Skills could the future prodigies realize them for themselves!
"I just need to create powerful Divine Skills!"
At this moment, Li Xuan found his position in creating Divine Skills.
As Li Xuan developed the Minor Eye of the Heavenly Dao, he also began to ponder the Fifth Door of Martial Arts, of which he already had a preliminary idea.
It wasn't yet finalized, but it was worth considering and refining to see if it was feasible.
Time passed as Li Xuan was developing the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, and pondering the Fifth Door of Martial Arts; a month had passed since the collapse of the Divine Bridge.
On the side of the Divine Realm, there was no movement, nor any Supreme Experts who came forward to repair the Divine Bridge.
It was unclear whether there were no Supreme Experts capable of such a feat, or if the Qinghua state of the Divine Realm was truly in great turmoil, already too distracted to care about the matters of the Spiritual Realm.
"Master!"
Xu Yan and the others had finally returned.
Li Xuan nodded; just as he thought, the Spiritual Realm did not hide any further crises.
Wu Tianan and the other Spiritual Realm Experts gradually returned to Hongzhou, all waiting for a great person to take action, to repair the Divine Bridge, and open it to enter the Divine Realm.
Although the Qinghua state of the Divine Realm might be in chaos, it did not deter their determination to venture into the Divine Realm.
Only by venturing into the Divine Realm could they aspire to reach higher Martial Arts Realms and witness the thriving Martial Arts of the Divine Realm.
"Since that's the case, then let's go," Li Xuan said.
Li Xuan raised his hand and made a grasping motion; a rumbling sound followed, and in mid-air, it was as if a hole had been torn open!
Rainbow light emerged once again, and a bridge appeared before everyone's eyes.
The broken bridge seemed to be slowly repairing itself.
A giant hand grasped the segment of the bridge in Hongzhou, flung it forward like a chain.
Boom!
Rainbow light spanned the Azure Sea, crossing it, as if reaching the far shore.
Hum!
All of a sudden, the Divine Bridge was activated once more.
Rainbow light was hazy; the Divine Bridge continued to solidify, emerging in mid-air, spanning the Azure Sea, reaching directly to the other side.

chapters.title: Chapter 692 - 366: The Eye of the Heavenly Dao, Turmoil in the Divine Realm_2
chapters.content:
The Divine Bridge was a principle, and not a particularly strong one at that; it merely possessed the ability to connect the Spiritual Realm to the Divine Realm. With Li Xuan's current strength and his understanding of the Heaven and Earth Laws, linking up with the Divine Bridge was as easy as flipping his hand.
As the Divine Bridge manifested, everyone was excited and thrilled.
At the same time, they felt fortunate that the Spiritual Realm was blessed with the presence of such mighty figures; otherwise, it would have certainly faced a great disaster.
The Spiritual Realm would probably have perished!
The Divine Bridge had been restored, but on the Divine Realm's side, no strong practitioners appeared.
Logically, since the Divine Bridge had collapsed and now been restored, strong practitioners from the Divine Realm should have come to investigate.
But none did!
The hearts of the strong practitioners within the Spiritual Realm sank!
Such a situation implied that the state of affairs in the Divine Realm's Qinghua state was not good.
"Let's go!"
Li Xuan said indifferently.
The Flying Boat turned into a stream of light and landed upon the Divine Bridge, following it toward the Divine Realm.
Wu Tianan took a deep breath and stepped onto the Divine Bridge with a mix of excitement and nervousness in his heart.
Could the person he was looking for really be in the Divine Realm?
And if so, were they still alive?
All of this was unknown.
But no matter what, he would keep searching.
"Follow up!"
Emperor Da Zhou and other supreme experts of the Spiritual Realm looked at the prodigies and said solemnly.
A group of people stepped onto the Divine Bridge, and shortly after they had set out, the end of the bridge on the side of Hongzhou began to grow dim, fading from sight.
Every time one ascended the Divine Bridge, there was a time limit. Once someone stepped onto the bridge and the time elapsed, the bridge would vanish between Heaven and Earth.
All who wished to go to the Divine Realm needed to step onto the Divine Bridge within a certain time—once the time passed, they would wait in vain!
The Divine Bridge spanned the Azure Sea, reaching the far shore, which also meant that the bridge was very long.
The Flying Boat moved slowly on the Divine Bridge, while Xu Yan and several others curiously observed the bridge, even pondering the Divine Bridge Rule, trying to see how the bridge actually existed.
Because the journey wasn't fast, this stretch felt somewhat lengthy.
Finally, they saw the other end of the bridge beyond the Azure Sea, landing in front of a narrow valley, seemingly a rift between Heaven and Earth.
Through a barely discernible glimpse, it seemed they could see the vast expanse of land beyond the valley.
…
Divine Realm, Qinghua state.
The Qinghua state, connected to the Spiritual Realm, was a gateway opened by the Divine Bridge and one of the Thirty-six Realms of the Divine Realm.
It was that time again when the Divine Bridge was to open.
However, during this period, the Qinghua state was anything but peaceful, amidst the great chaos of the Heavenly Grotto.
The Qinghua state was governed by three major forces: the Tianwu Sect, the Myriad Thunder Sect, and the Da Yue Dynasty.
Apart from these three forces, other powers were dependent on them and had to follow their commands.
Besides the three major forces, there was a power within the Qinghua state called Blood Shadow Tower. It was formed by martial artists who had pledged allegiance to the Netherworld Cave and had always been a thorn in the side for Qinghua state.
Even after countless sieges, Blood Shadow Tower remained unbeatable, causing trouble periodically and even cooperating with the Netherworld Cave to invade Qinghua state.
The unrest in Qinghua state began several years ago and initially involved the three major forces simply due to the regular chaos caused by the Netherworld Cave.
