As the time for the Divine Bridge to open approached, and counting the cycle, it was again time for prodigies from the Spiritual Realm to be sent into the Divine Realm.
True enough, underneath the Tianwu Sect, the Thousand Martial Hall opened the virtual bridge, and a Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable descended into the Spiritual Realm, ready to escort the prodigies back.
Due to the threat of the Netherworld Cave, the three major forces were allies to some extent, as branches of the same tree.
Throughout the entire Divine Realm, the situation was much the same, as the biggest threat to the Divine Realm were the Heavenly Grottos.
Every power bore the responsibility of suppressing the Heavenly Grotto in their area.
The enemies from the Heavenly Grottos facing Qinghua state came from the Netherworld, with hundreds of large and small caves. Among them, only three Netherworld Caves were genuinely powerful.
Conveniently, each of the three major forces was responsible for guarding one of these Netherworld Caves.
The struggle against the Netherworld Caves had been ongoing for countless years, with numerous Netherworld Blood Disciples slain, and just as many warriors from Qinghua state fallen.
```
But from the clashes within the Netherworld Cave, many formidable figures had risen, and while the Heavenly Grotto was a threat, it was also a treasure trove of extraordinary peril.
By slaying invaders like the Netherworld Blood Disciples and Blood Slaves, one could obtain treasures from beyond the Divine Realm, even from beyond this world.
It was precisely because of this that the martial artists of Qinghua state, despite knowing full well the dangers of the Netherworld Cave, did not lack for those willing to battle therein.
In addition to the rewards offered by the three great powers, one could also acquire some treasures from within the cave.
Thousand Martial Hall opened the Divine Bridge, and Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable of Tianwu Sect, representing the three great powers, descended to the Spiritual Realm, bringing back the Spirit Body Prodigies they had nurtured.
Following past precedents, these Spirit Body Prodigies, upon entering the Divine Realm, would break through to the Condensation Law Realm within three years.
Once having broken through to the Condensation Law Realm, they could preside over an area in the Heavenly Grotto, considering themselves a minor power.
Yet, this time it seemed that an unexpected event had occurred.
After the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable of Tianwu Sect descended to the Spiritual Realm, till the vanishing of the Divine Bridge, he had never returned, indicating that something had changed in the Spiritual Realm.
Tianwu Sect had prepared to dispatch powerful fighters to descend once again to the Spiritual Realm, but had to call off the mission when their defended Netherworld Cave suffered a large-scale invasion.
The turmoil in the Heavenly Grotto grew increasingly rampant, and what was even more astonishing to the three great powers was the appearance of an Immortal Realm martial artist from Blood Shadow Tower!
Immortal Heavenly Venerable, how many are there in the entire Qinghua state?
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable from Blood Shadow Tower suddenly launched a sneak attack on Emperor Da Yue's Immortal presiding over the Heavenly Grotto, joining forces with a Netherworld Blood Child from within the cave, and injured the Immortal Heavenly Venerable from Da Yue Dynasty.
It was at this time that the massive invasion from the Heavenly Grotto began, the endless Blood Shadows ravaged Da Yue Dynasty, and the great chaos thus unfurled.
Tianwu Sect and Myriad Thunder Sect, while needing to send support to Da Yue Dynasty, also faced the threat from the Heavenly Grotto they guarded themselves, rendering them at their wits' end.
At this critical juncture, the Divine Bridge was opened.
Compelled by necessity, a True King who had fought his way back from the Heavenly Grotto of Myriad Thunder Sect embarked towards the Spiritual Realm.
Unbeknownst to all, at the time the Divine Bridge opened, the Heavenly Grottos in the whole of Qinghua state erupted into chaos, Blood Shadow Tower wreaked havoc everywhere, and one after another, the grottos fell into enemy hands.
Blood Slaves massacred their way into Qinghua state, and even Blood Disciples stepped into it, plunging Qinghua state into an extremely grave crisis.
The strong of Qinghua state emerged, suppressing the Netherworld Caves, slaughtering rebels everywhere, blocking the Blood Disciples and Blood Slaves.
Then came an even more shocking development: the Divine Bridge collapsed!
The Spiritual Realm was invaded by the Heavenly Grotto!
That True King was even slain!
Several True King Heavenly Venerables of Myriad Thunder Sect prepared to venture to the Spiritual Realm for rescue, but they were intercepted en route, caught in incessant battle, forever unable to arrive at the Spiritual Realm.
At this moment, the entire Qinghua state was in utter disarray, the Netherworld Blood Disciples ran amok, and city after city was sacrificed in blood.
In desperation, some martial artists of Qinghua state defected to the Netherworld Blood Disciples, partaking in the blood rituals.
Suddenly, the three great powers were overwhelmed, unable to free themselves to rescue the Spiritual Realm; and with the Divine Bridge shattered, only the Immortal Heavenly Venerables were capable of descending to the Spiritual Realm without it.
However, at that moment, every single Immortal could not afford to leave their post, needing to deter the Netherworld Blood Children to prevent them from invading Qinghua state.
"We must call for help!"
The three great powers were embroiled in harsh battles, and the whole of Qinghua state seemed to have turned into a purgatorial battlefield, with some of the more remote and weaker cities, by this point, having been reduced to ghost towns.
Only a faint blood mist lingered within the cities.
"Open the Realm Gate, seek external assistance!"
Emperor Da Yue, holding his long spear, stood at the edge of the Heavenly Grotto, confronting a blood-colored figure within.
Da Yue Country had fallen!
Neither Tianwu Sect nor Myriad Thunder Sect could afford to come to the rescue at this moment, and without external aid, the casualties Da Yue Country would suffer were unimaginable.
"Yes!"
A burly man clad in silver armor, wielding a long saber, responded solemnly.
Open the Realm Gate!
For expedient passage between the thirty-six realms of the Divine Realm, one had to rely on the Realm Gates, which would allow immediate travel from the central region of one realm to the central region of another.
The existence of the Realm Gates was not man-made, but formed from the accumulation of the Heaven and Earth Laws, a phenomenon that appeared after the great changes of the heavens and earth and the division of the Divine Realm into thirty-six realms.
The thirty-six realms are interconnected, but the Realm Gates are located in the central region of the thirty-six realms, also within the control of the strongest forces in each realm.
Once opened, one could directly travel from the central region of one realm to the central region of another, skipping the time-consuming journey.
They also serve as vital channels for seeking aid between the thirty-six realms.
At this moment, with Qinghua state plunged into chaos and Da Yue Country facing crisis, there was no choice but to seek help from outside, although the neighboring realms might also be in turmoil, they would surely provide assistance if they had the spare capacity.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 693 - 367: The Fierce Young Man from the Spiritual Realm
chapters.content:
The Divine Realm, Qinghua state, was in utter chaos, with sounds of battle, screams of agony, and the roars of martial artists everywhere.
One city after another turned into a city of the dead.
In Linguan City, where the Divine Bridge originated, a heaven-shaking battle was taking place, as a few powerful figures fought a fierce battle in midair against more than a dozen blood-colored figures.
Bloodlight illuminated the sky, and within it, there was the thunderous roar of lightning. However, the powerful lightning was being suppressed by the bloodlight and seemed unable to hold out much longer.
Below, in Linguan City, a massacre was playing out.
Hundreds of blood-colored figures were reaping lives, as resistance from martial artists proved futile.
Boom!
Qi of blood pervaded Linguan City, as the martial artists' blood congregated to form roiling evil spirits.
Crimson long knives were slaughtering everywhere within the city, slicing open one throat after another. The blood, as if drawn by some force, didn't splatter on the ground but instead turned into qi of blood, converging towards the center of the city.
At the city's center, within the original City Lord's mansion, a blood pool was bubbling with blood foam, shrouded in qi of blood and surrounded by lurking evil spirits.
Boom!
"Beasts of Blood Shadow Tower, you deserve to die! Bastards from the Netherworld, this vengeance will be repaid!"
An angry and sorrowful roar echoed from the sky.
However, all was in vain.
As the throat of the last person was slit and their fresh blood turned into qi of blood, converging into the blood pool within the City Lord's mansion, Lingguang City became a dead city!
The blood pool emitted qi of blood as if it was boiling, seemingly cooking the blood. The blood within the pool kept condensing and decreasing in volume.
In the end, it turned into a dark red jelly, permeated with a faint smell of blood and wafting with an unknown scent of aroma.
Several Blood Shadows appeared around the blood pool, their eyes ablaze with excitement and greed as if beholding the finest delicacy in the world.
They took out crimson knives and began to divide the dark red jelly, storing it into boxes one by one.
Boom!
Suddenly, there was a tremor from the canyon standing outside Linguan City. A rainbow light surged forward.
"The Divine Bridge has opened, how is that possible!"
In midair, a man with a flaming red beard wielding dual hammers surrounded by thunderous lightning, fighting alone against three Blood Shadows, wore a look of shock and disbelief on his face.
The Divine Bridge had collapsed, the Spiritual Realm had lost connection!
According to estimates, the Spiritual Realm had probably fallen and become a living hell.
Even the Immortal Heavenly Venerable could only descend into the Spiritual Realm and was incapable of reconnecting the shattered Divine Bridge. The only option was to wait for the bridge to heal itself.
Yet, it hadn't been long at all. According to estimates, it was far from the time when the Divine Bridge should have been able to heal itself.
At this moment, Cheng Zhan felt his heart sink. Could it be that the formidable enemies from the Netherworld had found a way to repair the Divine Bridge and then invade the Divine Realm from the Spiritual Realm?
If that were true, then Qinghua state was in peril!
"Kill!"
Cheng Zhan bellowed in rage, his body wreathed in fierce lightning. His pair of hammers whipped up violent thunderstorms as he lashed out at the three Blood Shadows.
He was an elder of Myriad Thunder Sect, in the late stages of the Truth Refinement Realm, and a True King Heavenly Venerable whose strength was renowned throughout the entire Qinghua state.
After the collapse of the Divine Bridge, he led the strong warriors of Myriad Thunder Sect and Tianwu Sect in support, hoping to rescue the Spiritual Realm, only to be intercepted.
Breaking through the encirclement, he encountered an ambush in Linguan City, which was now undergoing a blood sacrifice!
Despite the violent thunderstorms showing some restraining effect against the evil spirit of blood, Cheng Zhan fell into a disadvantage being outnumbered three to one. Besides, he had already exhausted a great deal along the way and could barely hold on any longer.
Boom!
From the gap in the canyon, rainbow light was shining through. It was certain that the Divine Bridge was open and someone had ascended it!
"The Divine Bridge? Let's see who comes from the Spiritual Realm. Could it be a young hero?"
A Blood Shadow uttered a chilling laugh.
The battle raged on, and the Blood Shadows that had blood-sacrificed Linguan City had already converged toward the canyon's exit, waiting for those to arrive.
...
The Flying Boat finally crossed the Divine Bridge and reached the Divine Realm.
"The spiritual energy has grown much denser, and the Domain Lingji seems to be exceedingly active."
Xu Yan remarked with surprise.
As expected of the Divine Realm, a place for the stronger warriors, he now felt the same way he did when he first stepped from the Inner Domain into the Spiritual Realm.
Wu Tianan and others also followed on the Flying Boat, excited upon arriving at the Divine Realm. Especially Wu Tianan, who felt he could make a breakthrough at any moment.
The Flying Boat flew toward a massive canyon. Just as they entered the canyon and before truly entering the Divine Realm, they sensed something was amiss.
The evil spirit of blood was pervading the air.
And with it, the rumbling of a great battle also reached them.
"The Divine Realm is indeed in turmoil!"
Fang Hao sighed.
No wonder no powerful warriors had come to the aid of the Spiritual Realm.
At the canyon's exit, Blood Shadows were thick on the ground, hundreds of them waiting, ready to pounce on their prey.
The hearts of Wu Tianan and others following the Flying Boat sank. Their strength was still weak; with the Divine Realm in such chaos, the status of their Upper Sect was uncertain.
Could it be that upon entering the Divine Realm, they might be reduced to Loose Cultivators?
"These are the Blood Slaves of the Netherworld... no, that's not quite right, they seem different from Blood Slaves!"
Xu Yan said, furrowing his brows.
"The Cultivation Technique they practice in refining blood is almost indistinguishable from that of Blood Slaves."
Li Xuan's brow creased slightly. To think his first sight upon entering the Divine Realm would be such a scene.
Before them, a fierce battle was underway, and below in that city, everyone was gone. A faint scent of blood hung in the air—it had become a city of the dead!
Blood sacrifice!
A whole city had been blood-sacrificed. Though he had heard tales of blood sacrifice in the Spiritual Realm, he had never witnessed it with his own eyes.
Now, a city that had undergone a blood sacrifice lay before him, and even though Li Xuan considered himself above others, unshakable by any worldly matters, the sight still struck a chord.

chapters.title: Chapter 694 - 367: The Fierce Young Man from the Spiritual Realm_2
chapters.content:
But at this moment, a trace of anger surged in his heart.
Not long ago, this city must have been bustling with people coming and going, prosperous and flourishing, with young men and women, children, even newborn babies. But all of that had disappeared.
The people in these cities had all been sacrificed, turned into nourishment for someone's cultivation!
Having lived for two lifetimes, this was the first time Li Xuan had witnessed such a tragic scene, and his eyes turned cold.
"Kill them all!"
He said indifferently.
"Yes, Master!"
Xu Yan and the others were startled. This was the first time their master had ordered them to kill.
But they didn't ask why. If the master said to kill, then they would kill!
Howl!
Xu Yan led the charge, raising his hand and blasting out with a palm strike, unleashing Divine Skills True Dragon Rage!
Boom!
Meng Chong transformed directly into an eighteen-zhang tall giant, with the Great Sun God Obscuration floating above, furiously unleashing wind and thunder, killing his way forward.
Fang Hao slapped his Weapon Box, Domain Qimen Great Formation, myriad weapons crisscrossed as he charged into battle.
Su Lingxiu held a shovel, with green flames burning vigorously as she too made a move.
Since the master had spoken, even if she disliked fighting, she had to participate. She couldn't disappoint her master.
Roar!
Red Cat was even more eager, finally able to do something for its master.
With an angry roar, it transformed into a giant tiger, the size of a small hill, and pounced directly forward.
Howl!
Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha, too, joined the fray.
They too had barely cultivated their own Great Demon Ability, and although their strength was not as great as Red Cat's, let alone that of Xu Yan and the others, they were still able to handle a Blood Shadow of the Condensation Law Realm.
Behind the Flying Boat, Wu Tianan and the others were looking on with shock, watching the great battle ahead and the group of Blood Shadows blocking the canyon exit, feeling a deep sense of powerlessness.
At this moment, they keenly felt just how weak they were.
What exactly had befallen the Divine Realm?
Cheng Zhan roared again and again, trying to break through the encirclement, but was unable to do so. Instead, he was battered from left to right, surrounded by dangers.
The others were even more battered and bruised, barely holding on, with no hope for reinforcements in sight.
They fought while distractedly watching the mouth of the canyon.
Suddenly, a roar that resonated through heaven and earth erupted, a terrifying force surged, the clouds and winds changed color, and a Golden Giant Dragon appeared, embodying fearsome dragon might in its eyes, filled with boundless rage.
It charged at the group of Blood Shadows!
In that instant, including Cheng Zhan and all the Blood Shadows, their faces were struck with horror, and the fight momentarily came to a halt.
"A True Dragon?"
Cheng Zhan exclaimed in shock.
Could it be that the Divine Bridge was restarted by this True Dragon, which continued the broken bridge from the Spiritual Realm into the Divine Realm?
And the hundreds of Blood Shadows blocking the canyon's mouth were even more terrified, their forms shaking, ready to flee!
Boom!
The Golden Giant Dragon was wildly ferocious, charging into the midst of the Blood Shadows and in an instant, tore apart several of them, obliterated them on the spot.
Although there were several hundred Blood Shadows, with many possessing the strength of the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable Realm, more than half were a bit short of that level of power and couldn't resist Xu Yan's strike of True Dragon Rage!
"Not a True Dragon, but some sort of Martial Arts technique?"
At this moment, Cheng Zhan realized that the Golden Giant Dragon was not a real dragon, but a dragon-shaped Martial Arts technique. However, its ferocity and strength were so immense, so close to that of a real dragon, he had never heard of such a technique!
Immediately, he saw a young man encircled by a wheel of swords, a never-ending cycle, as a black sword light thunderously slashed out, targeting the group of Blood Shadows.
Before he could marvel at the young man's strength, he saw a golden giant radiating light, with a giant sun-like object above its head, emerging from the canyon, and with one punch, it blew up a Blood Shadow on the spot.
"Who are these people?"
Cheng Zhan and some of the Divine Realm True King Heavenly Venerables were dumbfounded, wondering when the Spiritual Realm had become so strong?
Something's not right!
The last time they guided Spirit Body Prodigies into the Divine Realm did not seem so long ago. At that time, the Spiritual Realm had no abnormalities and did not possess such strong warriors or unimaginable Martial Arts.
So, in just a short period of time, had the Spiritual Realm produced such a phenomenon?
Buzz!
Immediately afterward, a man with a weapon box strapped to his back stepped out, and weapons flew out from the box as if endlessly, sweeping toward a group of Blood Shadows.
At the same time, he took a step forward, and mysterious formations seemed to be laid out beneath his feet, as wind, fire, lightning, and thunder descended continuously. What kind of Martial Arts was that?
In the canyon, a beautiful young girl floated out, waving an iron shovel. Blue flames rose and transformed into a huge furnace, as if to refine everything.
In the void, stars faintly moved with her motions, and what's more terrifying, with a wave of her hand, a blue light diffused as if reversing life and death, and a Blood Shadow's vitality began to wither!
Thump!
Cheng Zhan, shocked, forgot that he was being besieged, and stared blankly at Xu Yan and the three others who came out of the canyon, displaying inconceivable Martial Arts techniques.
It wasn't over yet. Following a tiger's roar, a fierce wind suddenly rose from within the canyon. A Splendid Ferocious Tiger the size of a small hill leaped out, stood upright in mid-air, and drew a giant saber...
Following the Splendid Giant Tiger was a white jade-colored Flood Dragon and a toad as large as a small hill...
Cheng Zhan rubbed his eyes in shock and turned to look at a Blood Shadow who was just as bewildered, asking in astonishment, "Is that toad the Mountain Devourer Toad?"
Fuck!
Since when had the Mountain Devourer Toad become so powerful?
Let alone the Spiritual Realm, even in the Divine Realm, a Mountain Devourer Toad at best only reaches the early Divine Refinement Realm. Even so, such a powerful Mountain Devourer Toad is considered extremely rare.
Yet the Mountain Devourer Toad in front of him not only had a strength comparable to the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable, but it also had formidable abilities, on par with Martial Arts techniques.
It spat out a black vortex, shredding a Blood Shadow in an instant. More exaggeratedly, the toad held a fork in each of its two claws and wielded them with great power.
"It looks like it's the Mountain Devourer Toad!"
The Blood Shadow responded, equally stunned.
Immediately his eyes grew cold. What was he dawdling for? Killing was the priority!
"Die!"
In a panic, he swung his blade toward Cheng Zhan.
Cheng Zhan struggled to defend himself and, for the moment, fell back into the midst of the besiegement, surrounded by dangers.
"Go kill them!"
A Blood Shadow gave the command coldly.
"I'll go!"
One of the Blood Shadows besieging Cheng Zhan immediately drew his sword and backed away, preparing to slay Xu Yan and the others who were in a fierce battle with a group of Blood Shadows.
Cheng Zhan became anxious upon seeing this!
Whether it was the four youths, the Splendid Giant Tiger, the Flood Dragon, or the Mountain Devourer Toad, they were indeed strong, but not opponents for the True King Heavenly Venerable.
"Young man, run! Don't worry about us, go seek help from the Myriad Thunder Sect. Lingxiu City has been blood sacrificed by the Blood Shadow Tower, tell the Qinghua state warriors to seek revenge against the Blood Shadow Tower!"
Cheng Zhan, while struggling against his injuries, was also trying to hold back the Blood Shadow as he coughed up blood and shouted.
At that moment, Xu Yan's Divine Skills were fully unleashed, and he was single-handedly slaughtering the Blood Shadows. Those Blood Shadows, the strongest only being at the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable Realm, were no match for him. With a wave of his hand, he could slay them, his Divine Skills powerfully on display.
At this moment, he had an epiphany.
"Master once said that it's nothing extraordinary for one to overpower tens of thousands in the same realm. Now I have this feeling, too. An ordinary Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable, I alone can overpower a dozen of them.
"If Master could overpower tens of thousands in the same realm, what a sight that must have been!"
The more Xu Yan thought, the more he admired his master, who was an insurmountable mountain.
He thought himself extremely strong within his realm, but every time he thought of his master, he felt an unreachable distance, as if no matter how hard he tried, he couldn't reach even half of his master's power in the same realm!
Suddenly, upon hearing Cheng Zhan's shouting, he looked up, seeing a fierce battle in mid-air.
The strength of those Blood Shadows was not much weaker than that of the Six Blood Disciples.
Xu Yan was surging with excitement. The Six Blood Disciples couldn't trouble him, and neither could any of the Blood Shadows above, as long as he wasn't ganged up on!
"My opponents have never been within my realm, but against more difficult odds!"
Xu Yan moved swiftly, slaughtering his way out from the midst of the Blood Shadows and charging straight toward the battlefield in the sky.
"I'll block one for you!"
The Yin Yang Undying Sword surrounded him. With a lift of his hand, the Heaven-defying Sword instantly struck out, aiming at one of the Blood Shadows.
Cheng Zhan was completely stunned.
When had the youths of the Spiritual Realm become so bold?
"Young man, listen to me..."
Cheng Zhan became frantic.
Was the young man really so reckless, not realizing the opponent's strength was greater?
But before he could finish speaking, that sword had already struck a Blood Shadow, and landscapes of extraordinary visions emerged instantaneously, enveloping the Blood Shadow and transporting him to another side of the battlefield.

chapters.title: Chapter 695 - 368: Slaying Blood Shadow, The Tale of Netherworld
chapters.content:
Cheng Zhan was left utterly astonished by what he saw, a young man who came from the Spiritual Realm, whose strength was beyond expectation, and yet he was also so brave and fearless?
Hoping to triumph over the stronger by being weaker, to defeat that Blood Shadow who was in the Truth Refinement Realm?
Boom!
"Die!"
The Blood Shadow had not anticipated this, so when Xu Yan made his move, he took the opportunity to disengage from his fight with Cheng Zhan, aiming to quickly suppress Xu Yan.
However, when the powerful slash came down, the blade light made one cycle within the circle of swords and then counterattacked.
"What kind of Martial Arts is this?"
The Blood Shadow was astonished.
Wielding his blade, the crimson light of the blade reflecting, he immediately used a powerful killing move.
Xu Yan was unfazed, the Yin Yang Undying Sword in action, the True Dragon Rage, Mountains and Rivers in the Sword, Supreme Heavenly Sword, and other Divine Skills, subsequently unleashed, engaging in a fierce battle with his opponent.
He felt again what he had felt during the intense battle with the Seven Twenty-Six Blood Disciple.
Boom!
Back when he had fought with Seven Two Six, he had achieved minor completion in the Divine Skill Realm amidst the battle. This Blood Shadow's strength was somewhat weaker compared to that Blood Disciple.
Xu Yan, having reached minor completion in the Divine Skill Realm, found the fight easier compared to the battle with Seven Two Six Blood Disciple.
This Blood Shadow was also quite shocked, his own strength was obviously greater, why couldn't he kill his opponent?
Even his opponent's defense seemed impenetrable, each strike felt like sinking into a quagmire, or even worse, it might be counteracted.
"Who are you?"
He asked with a gloomy look in his eyes.
"Sword God Xu Yan!"
Xu Yan said coldly.
At this moment, he was using the Blood Shadow to temper himself, his Sword Dao, his Divine Skills, to enhance his own strength.
Meanwhile, Meng Chong was sweeping through foes with fists and blades, the Great Sun God Obscuration unleashing terrifying power, almost a one-sided slaughter.
A Flying Boat emerged once more from the canyon, hovering midair.
Li Xuan looked towards the battlefield, the Martial Artists from the Myriad Thunder Sect were in a perilous state, all heavily injured.
Meng Chong and others' strong intervention almost unilaterally massacred those Blood Shadows.
Xu Yan, single-handedly battling a Blood Shadow comparable to a True King Heavenly Venerable, was at a disadvantage, even dodging from time to time, yet he remained undefeated.
Relying on the Yin Yang Undying Sword Divine Ability, he continued to temper his own Martial Arts.
With a slight motion of his finger, silent and undetectable, even before anyone realized, a Sword Intent had already landed on the Blood Shadow fighting Cheng Zhan.
Pfft!
In an instant, that Blood Shadow didn't even have a chance to cry out before disintegrating into ash.
Cheng Zhan was shocked but also ecstatic, were supreme experts here to aid?
Pfft! Pfft!
All the other Blood Shadows turned to ash and dispersed.
Cheng Zhan, gasping for breath, turned towards the extraordinary flying ship, a shock in his heart, it came from the Spiritual Realm?
Seeing Xu Yan still engaged in fierce battle with that Blood Shadow, he made a move to assist and slay the Blood Shadow.
"You don't need to intervene."
A voice entered his ears.
Cheng Zhan took a deep breath, leading the several severely wounded Martial Artists towards the Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship.
"Thank you, senior, for the grace of saving our lives!"
He said with deep respect towards Li Xuan.
"Mm!"
Li Xuan nodded.
He glanced at the few people behind Cheng Zhan, pale-faced and grievously injured, and spoke indifferently, "Heal your wounds."
Shi'er, Meng Shushu, Zhou Ying, and Yue'er immediately attended to the several Martial Artists, assessed their injuries, and then offered Healing Pills.
The Martial Artists were dumbfounded as they looked at the diagnostic Spiritual Artifact with strange expressions, especially feeling their injuries rapidly recovering upon ingesting the Pill, utterly astonished.
What kind of Healing Medicine was this?
"Thank you!"
The Martial Artists were deeply moved.
"Don't mention it, it's not for free. You'll still have to pay the consultation fee. Just tell us how much it's worth and give us a price."
Yue'er spoke seriously.
The Martial Artists' lips twitched, then they quickly brought out their Storage Bags and extracted several Spiritual Medicines.
Each one was a divine-grade Spiritual Medicine, and a few even exceeded that grade – Divine Medicines!
"Such a miraculous recovery! With such severe injuries, and yet to be able to recover so quickly is truly unimaginable.
"This consultation fee is hardly enough. If it's not adequate, I am willing to sign a note of debt, and I will definitely pay it back in the future!"
One Martial Artist said with a fist and palm salute.
They were all in the Truth Refinement Realm, known as True King Heavenly Venerables in the Divine Realm. With their current injuries, it would probably take more than half a month to recover.
Now, in just a short time, they had recovered sixty to seventy percent, and to return to their peak condition would only take two or three more days.
In their eyes, the consultation fee was not too much, it was too little!
Yue'er's eyes lit up. As expected from the Divine Realm, these strong individuals acted generously. Were those few plants the legendary Divine Medicines?
The Spiritual Realm could not produce Divine Medicines, divine items were extremely scarce.
In the Divine Realm, they were not so rare, but these few Divine Medicines were no ordinary Divine Medicines.
"It's the thought that counts, this will do for the consultation fee."
Yue'er waved her hand, collecting the consultation fee, and handed out several small bottles, one to each person, "Inside each of these, there are Healing Pills. Take them."
"Thank you!"
The Martial Artists were overwhelmed with emotion, aware of the miraculous effects of these pills.
Of course, they were also curious, why would there be such powerful figures in the Spiritual Realm, and such wondrous healing medicine?
But they did not dare to voice their questions and instead watched silently as Cheng Zhan.
Here, Cheng Zhan was the leader.
The Blood Shadow who was combating Xu Yan was now filled with dread, no longer had the heart to fight, and sought to escape.

chapters.title: Chapter 696 - 368: Slaying Blood Shadow, The Theory of Netherworld_2
chapters.content:
The result was that before he'd gotten far, a large hand reached out and grabbed him, dragging him back.
The one who made the move was Xu Yan, who used the Great Sky Hand to recapture Blood Shadow.
Li Xuan sat calmly, in no hurry to ask Cheng Zhan some questions, but rather focused on the battle of Xu Yan and the others.
As Meng Chong killed the last person, he looked up at the True King Blood Shadow who was fiercely battling with the eldest apprentice brother.
"Eldest apprentice brother, I'll help you!"
Meng Chong soared into the sky, his body began to shrink to its normal size, covered with boundless divine energy, he charged forth with his sword.
"Today, we brothers will slay a True King Heavenly Venerable!"
Fang Hao laughed loudly as countless weapons flew out from the Weapon Box, the Domain Qimen emerged, the Great Formation opened, and instantly enveloped the Blood Shadow.
Su Lingxiu thought for a moment and finally did not make a move; instead, she returned to the Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship.
Roar!
Red Cat let out a roar and pounced into the fray.
But it wasn't long before it was beaten down from mid-air, crashing to the ground.
Nevertheless, with its thick skin and strong defense, although it wasn't injured, the fall still caused the Red Cat to grimace in pain.
Looking up, Red Cat felt deflated, turned into a little fat cat, and returned to the Evergreen Pavilion. It first cozied up at Li Xuan's feet then approached Su Lingxiu.
"Meow meow!"
It let out pitiful meows, indicating it was hurt and needed a healing pill!
Seeing this scene, Cheng Zhan and the others didn't quite know how to feel at the moment. Why did it seem that everyone here was a bit unusual?
The distant battle grew increasingly fierce, but three against one, the Blood Shadow couldn't hold on much longer.
Meng Chong's divine energy was unparalleled in defense, entirely fearless of the opponent's attacks, demonstrating the ferocity and dominance of his physical body. What was even more terrifying was that, with the restraint of Fang Hao and Xu Yan, Meng Chong got up close and personal, engaging in close-quarters combat!
The Blood Shadow was strong, but his physical body was far inferior to Meng Chong's. Once engaged in close combat, Blood Shadow was completely on the defensive, being battered until his skin split and flesh broke.
The outcome had been determined.
Li Xuan nodded silently; all three of his disciples were very strong, and each one had their specialties. Fang Hao's Divine Skills Qimen also showed impressive powers.
The Blood Shadow was indeed much stronger than any one of Xu Yan's group, but unable to break through the defenses of the three, his fall was inevitable!
"A True King Heavenly Venerable in the early or middle stages can't break through Xu Yan's Yin Yang Undying Sword, which means Xu Yan stands unbeatable against ordinary True King Heavenly Venerables.
"Meng Chong's physical body is formidable, and with his Divine Skills, early-stage True King Heavenly Venerables can't hurt him.
"Fang Hao, relying on Domain Qimen and formations, also doesn't fear early-stage True King Heavenly Venerables."
Li Xuan made his judgment about the strength of his three disciples.
Ordinary True King Heavenly Venerables couldn't threaten Xu Yan and his group.
His gaze fell on Cheng Zhan; the situation in the Divine Realm could be learned from this man.
"I pay respects to senior!"
Cheng Zhan greeted him respectfully, carefully asking, "May I ask Senior, do you come from the Spiritual Realm?"
He was deeply puzzled; how could there be such a powerful being from the Spiritual Realm?
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable?
He had already seen that behind this mysterious ship were martial artists from Leiyun Mountain Manor, which was a Sect under the Myriad Thunder Sect.
Among the crowd were Spirit Body Prodigies, surely those nurtured by Leiyun Mountain Manor this time, making it certain that these people all came from the Spiritual Realm.
"Yes, and no," Li Xuan responded indifferently.
Cheng Zhan was taken aback. Yes and no?
Confused but not daring to ask for details, he respectfully said, "May I ask senior, how is the Spiritual Realm now?"
After all, the collapse of the Divine Bridge and the fall of the elders who were headed to the Spiritual Realm meant that a great disaster had befallen the Spiritual Realm.
"The Spiritual Realm is unscathed."
Li Xuan's tone was flat.
Cheng Zhan wanted to ask what exactly had happened in the Spiritual Realm, why the Netherworld Cave had appeared there, and who had killed the elder.
However, upon further thought, he felt that he perhaps was not qualified to ask his senior about such trifles.
For a moment, Cheng Zhan did not continue to inquire.
Li Xuan nodded silently, thinking that Cheng Zhan had a sense of propriety, so he asked in an even tone, "What happened, tell me."
What he was asking, of course, was about the current situation in the Divine Realm's Qinghua state.
Su Lingxiu and the others all looked over as well.
The Divine Realm, a place with numerous strong Martial Artists, was actually in such chaos, as if it had been beaten into disarray by the enemy, faring worse than the Spiritual Realm.
They were curious about what kind of catastrophe had occurred and what sort of enemy they were facing.
Cheng Zhan's mind stirred, realizing that this senior must have gone into seclusion in the Spiritual Realm and only now returned to the Divine Realm.
As for why he would choose to seclude himself in the Spiritual Realm, where Spiritual Energy was relatively sparse, one could only guess that the powerful had their peculiar hobbies, or their mindset was beyond the understanding of the weaker.
Currently, the Qinghua state was facing a dire crisis, with all the major Heavenly Grottos nearly falling, and within the Qinghua state, the master of the Blood Shadow Tower had broken through to Immortal Heavenly Venerable, causing a great catastrophe.
Now, although he was being restrained by another Immortal Heavenly Venerable, the rest of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables had to defend the Heavenly Grottos to prevent the Netherworld Blood Children from breaking out.
If the Qinghua state had one more Immortal Heavenly Venerable at this moment, it would be enough to change and reverse the situation, to calm the chaos.
Even, together with another Immortal Heavenly Venerable, they could join forces to kill the master of the Blood Shadow Tower!
Hope shone in Cheng Zhan's eyes as he took a deep breath, his expression becoming even more respectful, "To go back to your inquiry, senior, the Qinghua state is currently facing devastation from the Netherworld Cave..."
Just then, there was a booming sound, followed by a scream.
The Blood Shadow finally couldn't hold on, as Meng Chong's punch had pierced through his chest. Taking advantage of the moment, Xu Yan delivered a sword strike, instantly killing the opponent.
In the midst of the booming sounds, the Blood Shadow was completely annihilated in an instant, turned to dust and disappeared!
Cheng Zhan watched with trepidation, although the Blood Shadow had weakened due to prolonged combat, Xu Yan's trio had managed to overcome the strong as the weak, fighting against adversity, which was incredibly shocking.
What prodigies they were!
Moreover, Cheng Zhan felt that the Martial Arts displayed by Xu Yan and his peers were unusual, different from the Martial Arts of the Divine Realm.
Yet he didn't dwell on it, as it wasn't unthinkable for an Immortal Heavenly Venerable to possess unique martial techniques, which only indicated that this strong individual had distinctive martial skills.
Xu Yan and his companions returned, their faces still showing unsatisfied longing.
Li Xuan nodded, pleased with the performances of his three disciples.
He looked at Cheng Zhan, signaling him to continue.
"...There are three major Netherworld Caves in the Qinghua state, each under the guard of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, and every so often, a great battle erupts. It is a matter of pride for the Martial Artists of the Qinghua state to enter the caves and kill the Blood Disciples and Blood Slaves, as well as to gain Martial Arts resources..."
As Cheng Zhan narrated, everyone began to grasp a more comprehensive understanding of the current situation of the Qinghua state.
Chaos!
The Qinghua state was in great turmoil, even facing the crisis of collapse.
Especially Da Yue Country, it was almost entirely overrun, with Blood Slaves running rampant, Blood Disciples slaughtering in all directions, blood-sacrificing city after city, causing horrendous casualties.
And the Tianwu Sect and Myriad Thunder Sect, at this moment, had no strength to seek help and could only defend their own territories.
In the Qinghua state, countless small and large Heavenly Grottos abound, some of which had become ruins without any threat left, while others still harbored Blood Disciples and Blood Slaves, always ready to invade.
And in each of the three major Heavenly Grottos, there was a Netherworld Blood Child eyeing them covetously, each Netherworld Blood Child being a match for an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, immensely powerful.
"What is the Netherworld? How did the Heavenly Grottos come to be? Is it only possible to defend passively, without thinking of counterattack?"
Xu Yan asked, voicing the doubts in his heart.
Up to this point, what the Netherworld was and where the Netherworld Blood Disciples came from remained vague and unclear.
Cheng Zhan paused for a moment, but then suddenly understood. Xu Yan was young, and the senior likely had not spoken to his disciples about the Heavenly Grottos before, which was why Xu Yan was unaware.
So he began to explain, "The Netherworld, it is said, lies beyond our Domain, always seeking to invade our Domain, to consume it; and the Netherworld Blood Disciples are Netherworld Warriors, classified by strength, corresponding to the strength of True King Heavenly Venerables; whereas the Blood Slaves are Netherworld Warriors below the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable state.
"Of course, there are also Blood Slaves from our Divine Realm, traitors who have accepted the infusion of Netherworld blood essence and transformed into bloodthirsty Blood Slaves.
"Some of the Blood Disciples also stem from the fall of Divine Realm Warriors.
"Blood Disciples are nameless, identified only by numerical codes, only the Blood Children have names..."
Cheng Zhan began to explain rumors regarding the Netherworld.

chapters.title: Chapter 697 - 369 Killing Blood Refining Cover
chapters.content:
As Cheng Zhan spoke, everyone gained a deeper understanding of the Netherworld and some knowledge about Blood Disciples, Blood Slaves, and Xuezhi.
"It is said that above the Xuezhi, there are Blood Spirits. Whether it's Blood Spirits, Xuezhi, or Blood Slaves, in fact, they all belong to the mysterious and unknown Blood Lord of the Netherworld; they are either the disciples or the servants of the Blood Lord..."
Cheng Zhan continued to speak.
When he mentioned the Netherworld powerhouses at the Blood Spirit level, above the Xuezhi, Li Xuan couldn't help but raise his eyebrows, thinking of the Blood Spirit Child!
Wu Tianan, who was outside the flying boat and also listening to Cheng Zhan's explanation, was also taken aback. Since seeing the legacy of the Blood Spirit Child, he had come to know that the child's devilish powers originated from a remnantsoul.
All signs indicated that the remnantsoul came from the Netherworld, and it was initially thought to be that of a Blood Disciple of the Netherworld. Now it seemed highly likely that it was the remnantsoul of a Blood Spirit level powerhouse of the Netherworld.
The real name of the Blood Spirit Child was not "Blood Spirit Child," a name he took only after he became a Blood Demon.
Had a Blood Spirit level powerhouse from the Netherworld once invaded the Heavenly Cave Ruins of the Spiritual Realm? And who had slain them?
Wu Tianan was very curious about this.
Cheng Zhan kept on explaining.
The Netherworld existed beyond the Domain, and it was the main enemy of the Qinghua state. The Heavenly Caves appearing in the Qinghua state were all Netherworld Caves—even a major sect like the Myriad Thunder Sect did not know how long the caves had been appearing.
It was as if the Heavenly Caves had existed since the beginning of the Qinghua state.
As the name suggests, the Heavenly Caves are the holes in the Domain, which connect to the Netherworld. The creatures of the Netherworld invaded through them, hence the name Netherworld Caves.
"... It's not that we don't want to counterattack the Netherworld and take it over, but despite the Heavenly Caves being the holes in the Domain, we are still restricted and unable to leave this Domain.
"And moreover, the Netherworld is indeed very powerful. The Qinghua state alone is far from enough to invade the Netherworld.
"Each state in the Divine Realm has Heavenly Caves, and not every state faces the same enemies. The enemy of the Qinghua state outside the Domain is the Netherworld.
"The enemies faced by other states, however, may not necessarily come from the Netherworld."
Cheng Zhan sighed, expressing his helplessness.
Without changing his facial expression, Li Xuan's mind became more active. The Taicang Domain faced external threats, and the emergence of Heavenly Caves was most likely due to some flaws in the Domain.
"Perhaps only by fully comprehending the Dao Principles of the Book of Taicang and then verifying the Dao Principles of the current Domain, can I understand where the flaw truly lies.
"Is the Netherworld another Domain? Could it be that beyond the Taicang Domain, there exist other Domains, and this is a struggle between Domains?"
Li Xuan felt his guess was very close to the truth.
Cheng Zhan continued to explain about the Netherworld Caves, but when he spoke about the Blood Shadow Tower of the Qinghua state, he was grinding his teeth with indignation. This place was a disgrace, a den of traitors, to be executed by everyone!
To become a Blood Shadow, one must perform a blood sacrifice, so every Blood Shadow's hands were stained with blood, brutally slaughtering the innocent.
Xu Yan and others took the opportunity to ask some questions, probing into the situation of the Divine Realm and understanding its common knowledge.
In the end, Cheng Zhan respectfully bowed to Li Xuan, saying, "I implore the senior to take pity on the common people of the Divine Realm, and take action to suppress the master of the Blood Shadow Tower!"
The addition of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable could change the situation in the Qinghua state.
"Where is the person?"
Li Xuan asked indifferently.
If he encountered the master of the Blood Shadow Tower, he would suppress and kill him on the spot.
Such a brutal person, how could there be any reason not to kill him?
"He should be in Da Yue Country!"
Cheng Zhan was overjoyed and hurriedly said with respect.
"Then let's go to Da Yue Country."
Li Xuan nodded.
The Qinghua state, especially Da Yue Country, was now the most chaotic. Many powerhouses needed to be stationed at the Heavenly Caves to fight against the Blood Disciples and Blood Slaves invading from the Netherworld, leaving no one available to restore order.
Neither the Myriad Thunder Sect nor the Tianwu Sect could offer support.
Following this, people like Lord Leiyun successively paid their respects to Cheng Zhan, revealing looks of worry on their faces.
Thousand Martial Hall was under the Tianwu Sect, and Leiyun Mountain Manor under the Myriad Thunder Sect. Now, both were amidst chaos, and they feared becoming cannon fodder.
The master of the Yuling Mansion looked even more upset; after all, the Yuling Mansion belonged to Da Yue Country. Da Yue Country was obviously in bad shape at the moment, at risk of destruction at any time.
Emperor Da Zhou, Fu Tianhai, and Xin Mengrou were a bit more at ease. Their Upper Sect was not in the Qinghua state, perhaps the region where their Upper Sect resided was not experiencing such turmoil?
However, to reach their Upper Sect, they would have to pass through the Qinghua state, and it had always been the practice for the three major forces of the Qinghua state to convey messages. Otherwise, they had to wait for the Sect Master to send someone proactively.
As a result, they would have to stay in the Qinghua state for a while. With their current strength in the chaotic Qinghua state, it was far too dangerous.
They were at risk of being sacrificed at any moment.
"We must stick close to the expert!"
This thought was cradled in everyone's mind. Only by following the expert closely could they be safe. Even if they encountered a Xuezhi, there would be no fear.
"Come aboard."
Fang Hao glanced at Emperor Da Zhou and the others. After receiving Li Xuan's permission, he spoke.
"Thank you, senior!"
"Thank you, noble one!"
Emperor Da Zhou and the others were overjoyed and extremely excited inside.
They all made their way onto the Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship.
Boom!
The Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Boat once again expanded, transforming into a colossal ship several hundred zhang in size.
Cheng Zhan and the others were shocked. What kind of Divine Artifact was this?
Too magical, too mysterious.

chapters.title: Chapter 698 - 369 Killing Blood Refining Cover_2
chapters.content:
"Where is Da Yue Country?"
Fang Hao asked Cheng Zhan, looking at him.
"From here, it's Da Yue Country!"
Cheng Zhan hurriedly pointed in one direction.
"What about this city?"
Xu Yan and several others looked down at the already dead silent Lingguan City.
"After the Netherworld turmoil is settled, we'll arrange for people to come here,"
sighed Cheng Zhan.
This city served as a hub connecting to the Spiritual Realm, receiving prodigies, and was the reception point for martial artists coming from the Spiritual Realm.
Those with superior talents were taken back to the Sects for training.
While the remaining martial artists with average talents and strength were usually bestowed with cultivation techniques and some cultivation resources, and they would stay in Lingguan City.
More than half of the martial artists in Lingguan City were actually descendants of the Spiritual Realm martial artists, or martial artists from the Spiritual Realm itself.
Now, they had been blood sacrificed.
The flying boat transformed into a streak of light, heading towards Da Yue Country. As the flying boat departed, Li Xuan raised his hand and pointed towards the canyon.
Aboard the flying boat, no one knew of his action, nor did they know that Li Xuan had just sealed the path to the Spiritual Realm.
It wasn't completely sealed but rather, unless the Divine Bridge was activated, one couldn't travel to the Spiritual Realm.
Even if one were an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, it would be difficult to traverse and arrive without it.
With this measure, there was no need to worry about traitors like Blood Shadow secretly causing trouble in the Spiritual Realm.
The Divine Bridge, although connected by Li Xuan, had been partially destroyed by him after arriving in the Divine Realm. Unless the Divine Bridge was restored, it couldn't be activated.
For the short term, there's no hope of opening the Divine Bridge.
...
Qi Yun County, one of Da Yue Country's ten strongest counties, boasted twenty-three True King Heavenly Venerables, and even the Prefecture City itself had eighteen True King Heavenly Venerables stationed within.
It has always been one of the safest counties in Da Yue Country, where even the Blood Shadow Tower dared not recklessly commit evil deeds.
Qi Yun County also had a Netherworld Cave, but due to its strong power, it could easily keep the cave under control.
They even considered this cave a source of resources.
Invading Netherworld, slaying Netherworld Blood Disciples, one could obtain items they carried, among which the Netherworld Blood Orbs were treasures that greatly replenished one's lifeblood.
They were extremely useful in treating martial artists' injuries, restoring depleted lifeblood, or when cultivating some domineering martial arts techniques.
Besides, one could also acquire treasures from the Netherworld, things that came from beyond the Divine Realm, which possessed some extraordinary functions.
If one was lucky, after slaying a Blood Disciple, they could obtain a Netherworld Artifact carried by them.
Moreover, due to the Heavenly Grotto's ancient existence, through continuous erosion from the Netherworld's bloody qi, along with countless battles and the fall of many martial artists, some unique Divine Medicines and treasures were also born.
Even, one could acquire the inheritance of fallen martial artists.
There was once someone who, inside the Heavenly Grotto, acquired the personal notes of an ancient martial artist, gaining access to a powerful secret technique, as well as knowledge about the Martial Arts Realm from Ancient Times.
This time, the large-scale invasion of the Netherworld Cave seemed to be a well-planned operation by the Netherworld, and to everyone's surprise, the master of the Blood Shadow Tower broke through to the Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm.
Caught off guard, Da Yue Country was suddenly thrown into chaos. Although Qi Yun County managed to keep control of the Grotto, pushing back the invading Blood Disciples and Blood Slaves,
they even had spare strength to support other areas.
In Qi Yun County, of the eighteen True King Heavenly Venerables, currently, only eight were present in the city to stand guard. They could still handle occasional mischief from the Blood Shadow Tower.
Despite this, Qi Yun County was on high alert, with all martial artists fully on guard, ready to respond to any crisis that might arise.
Outside Qi Yun Prefecture City, several figures stood, gazing at the great city.
Leading them was a young man with a pattern on his brow. Different from the crimson skin of the Blood Disciples, his skin had only a faint hint of red.
Standing respectfully beside the young man were several individuals with pale red skin, donned in blood-red robes.
Martial artists from the Blood Shadow Tower.
"My lord, this is Qi Yun County. Currently, eight True Kings are stationed here,"
one of the Blood Shadows said respectfully.
"Hmm, good. Once this city is blood sacrificed, I will be able to ascend as Xuezhi. Prepare to take action according to the plan,"
the young man's eyes shone with a bloodthirsty light.
"Yes, my lord!"
The Blood Shadow replied excitedly.
Xuezhi!
As long as their lord became Xuezhi, his status would soar, and he might even have a chance to break through to the Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm, like the master of the Blood Shadow Tower.
"Work hard, Qi Yun County serves as the stepping stone for me to become Xuezhi, and Da Yue Country is an even greater opportunity for my advancement to Blood Spirit.
"There's no need to blood sacrifice the entire Da Yue Country, a third will suffice. Once I become a Blood Spirit, you will be a Xuezhi under my command!"
The youth said solemnly.
"Yes, my lord!"
To become a Xuezhi is to have a status surpassing that of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, truly integrating into the Netherworld; as long as one is not truly integrated into the Netherworld, these Blood Shadows are people without status.
The youth before them hailed from the Netherworld and had some background there; Blood Shadow Tower had plotted for a long time before they successfully helped him enter the Divine Realm.
This massive invasion of the Netherworld seemed to be for the purpose of helping this lord advance to Xuezhi, and then to Blood Spirit!
"Qinghua state must have sought help from outside by now, we need to act quickly and complete the plan before reinforcements arrive!" the youth instructed gravely.
"Rest assured, my lord, Qi Yun County can be blood sacrificed in three days!"
Blood Shadow bowed and retreated.
Meanwhile, the youth also stepped towards Qi Yun County, not hurrying, matching the speed that would allow three days to enter Qi Yun County.
At this moment, within Qi Yun County, eight True King Heavenly Venerables gathered to discuss defensive measures.
After the meeting concluded, a True King Heavenly Venerable, claiming to have an important matter to report, drew close to the City Lord of Qi Yun County.
The City Lord of Qi Yun County had no suspicion, curiously looking towards that True King Heavenly Venerable, while the other True Kings had already begun to depart, ready to defend their respective areas.
Out of nowhere, the City Lord of Qi Yun County roared furiously, bursting forth with powerful momentum, but in an instant, it weakened again.
The other True King Heavenly Venerables immediately changed their expressions and turned back in disbelief.
The True King Heavenly Venerable who falsely claimed to have an important matter had launched a sneak attack on the City Lord, heavily wounding him in an instant.
One must know, the City Lord was the strongest in Qi Yun County, at the pinnacle of the Truth Refinement Realm, known as the first True King Heavenly Venerable of Qi Yun County.
"Traitor, kill him!"
In the blink of an eye, the other True King Heavenly Venerables regained their senses and roared, preparing to kill him.
Boom!
That was when a blood light soared into the sky, and several Blood Shadows swooped over, each possessing the strength of a True King Heavenly Venerable, with one even on par with the peak of the Truth Refinement Realm.
Now, with the City Lord heavily injured, no one was his match!
The City Lord of Qi Yun County let out a sudden furious roar and swung a halberd across the air, summoning his last bits of strength to severely wound the assailant.
Another True King Heavenly Venerable nearby seized the opportunity to strike, killing the treacherous True King Heavenly Venerable!
This was an unwritten rule within Qinghua state, an enemy might be spared, but a traitor must die!
This served as a warning to anyone considering betrayal to weigh their options carefully!
Boom!
Qi Yun County was thrown into chaos, the sound of killing shaking the heavens, as Blood Shadows emerged one after another.
"They are Blood Shadows, kill them!"
The martial artists of Qi Yun County were formidable, and in an instant, many Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables, along with warriors of various realms, roared in unison, attacking those Blood Shadows.
"Quick, send a message, Qi Yun County is being attacked, there's a traitor!"
Hum!
Just then, within Qi Yun County, a crimson blood light appeared, engulfing the entire sky above Qi Yun County like a cover.
Beneath the crimson blood light, streaks that resembled crimson flames, swirling like giant pythons, swept across the entirety of Qi Yun County.
"What is this?"
The True King Heavenly Venerables engaged in battle constricted their pupils and revealed expressions of shock.
"Netherworld Artifact, Killing Blood Refining Cover!"
At that moment, the faces of the True King Heavenly Venerables and many other knowledgeable warriors turned pale, showing fear.
The Netherworld Artifact, Killing Blood Refining Cover, was notorious for being unrivaled in slaughter, a demonic divine artifact used for blood sacrifice of warriors.
Only a Netherworld Blood Disciple or higher could possess such a slaughtering artifact.
The appearance of the Killing Blood Refining Cover signified that a Netherworld Blood Disciple or even a Xuezhi had emerged.
And it was certain that a blood sacrifice of a region was about to unfold.
The Killing Blood Refining Cover, an artifact for blood sacrifice, could instantly envelop a region, making all living beings within its range subject to blood sacrifice, turning into sustenance for the Netherworld Warriors.
The Killing Blood Refining Cover also varied in strength, and one capable of enveloping Qi Yun County had a power that even these True King Heavenly Venerables could not shatter.
Xuezhi!
In that instant, the hearts of several True King Heavenly Venerables sank.

chapters.title: Chapter 699 - 370 Xuezhi Tu, Taikun Abandons a Piece
chapters.content:
A streak of light rose from the city of Lingguan, soaring through the mid-air and heading towards Da Yue Country.
The closer they got to Da Yue Country, the more they could see the pervasive killings and the ravages of Blood Shadows, and even Blood Slaves and Blood Disciples were slaughtering everywhere.
Even worse, upon encountering a small town, it was suffering from the massacre by Blood Slaves, and some Martial Artists, in order to survive, defected to the Netherworld Blood Slaves and became a member of the Blood Shadow.
At this point, Cheng Zhan and the others would take action to kill the Blood Shadows and Blood Slaves they encountered along the way, saving the towns in crisis.
The more Wu Tianan and the others watched, the more alarmed they became. The chaos in the Divine Realm was beyond imagination, and even Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable could encounter danger at any time and fall at any moment.
In the Spiritual Realm, Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable belonged to an invincible existence and was powerful enough to suppress the Spiritual Realm.
But in the Divine Realm, Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable was as common as the lesser celestial beings of the Spiritual Realm and was not one of the top powerhouses.
On the way, the speed of the Flying Boat was not fast, as they continuously killed the Blood Shadows and sporadically encountered Netherworld Blood Slaves along the way.
As a result, one day, a shocking piece of news came from Qinghua state.
In a city where the rampaging Blood Slaves and Blood Shadows had been killed, a message came from Qi Yun County of Da Yue Country.
The Prefecture City of Qi Yun County had a True King Heavenly Venerable betray, and two more True King Heavenly Venerables surrendered in desperation!
In addition to the two True King Heavenly Venerables, a group of Martial Artists from Qi Yun County also surrendered, and the Prefecture City of Qi Yun County was blood sacrificed!
The Netherworld Artifact, the Killing Blood Refining Cover appeared, locking down the Prefecture City, and along with the surrendered Martial Artists, took action together, blood sacrificing the entire county city.
This news shook Qinghua state!
The Prefecture City of Qi Yun County, having a significant reputation in the entire Qinghua state, with many Martial Artists and renowned comprehensive strength, was actually blood sacrificed!
The number of casualties was so great that it could rank in the top ten disasters in the history of Qinghua state!
With the spread of this news, Da Yue Country was shaken, and both Myriad Thunder Sect and Tianwu Sect were greatly horrified.
The appearance of the Killing Blood Refining Cover indicated that a powerful Netherworld Blood Disciple, or even a Blood Child, had infiltrated Qinghua state.
If even Qi Yun County Prefecture City was blood sacrificed, other cities with weaker strength were at risk of the same calamity at any moment.
Especially the other cities within Qi Yun County were now in danger.
And with this news, in Da Yue Country, Tianwu Sect, and the Immortal Heavenly Venerable of Myriad Thunder Sect stationed at Netherworld Cave, Blood Children appeared, triggering a massive battle.
This was to hold back these Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable confronting the master of Blood Shadow Tower struck out madly, wishing to crush the master of Blood Shadow Tower and go to Qi Yun County to kill those responsible for the blood sacrifice.
"This is bad!"
Cheng Zhan's face turned pale on Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship.
"What's wrong?"
Xu Yan asked with a furrowed brow.
As the news of Qi Yun County Prefecture City being blood sacrificed came, the Flying Ship had already changed course to head towards Qi Yun County.
Although they were not from the Divine Realm, such a terrifying and brutal method also made Xu Yan and the others extremely angry.
"A Blood Child is about to be born!"
Cheng Zhan said with a look of panic on his face.
"Qi Yun County Prefecture City was blood sacrificed, and the Killing Blood Refining Cover appeared, it must be a Blood Disciple wanting to advance to a Blood Child by using this!
"Such a vast amount of Martial Artists' essence blood is enough for the other party to advance to a Blood Child.
"Each Blood Child is an existence comparable to an Immortal Heavenly Venerable!"
If a Blood Child is born in Qinghua state, the trouble will be tremendous, and if the individual manages to hide and is not killed in time, they can create a massive disaster.
This is a huge hidden danger.
Moreover, although they thought the arrival of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable reinforcement would be enough to turn the tide in Qinghua state, if a Blood Child is born, the situation would continue.
They could only wait for aid from strong warriors from other realms.
And from other realms, there may not necessarily be strong warriors available to provide help, as not only Qinghua state was in turmoil!
It seemed as if the enemies from beyond had joined forces and launched a major invasion on the Divine Realm.
"Even if a Blood Child is born, there's no need to panic; as long as my master takes action, he can exterminate the other party."
Xu Yan patted Cheng Zhan's shoulder to comfort him.
Cheng Zhan opened his mouth and sighed. The young man didn't understand the power of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
Even among Immortal Heavenly Venerables, while there are differences in strength, it is not easy for a strong Immortal Heavenly Venerable to kill a weaker one.
Besides, the strength of this Blood Child is definitely not that of a weak Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
In the history of Qinghua state, the number of fallen Immortal Heavenly Venerables can be counted on one hand.
Immortal Heavenly Venerables are integrated with the Domain and share its lifespan; to kill an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, one must collapse the piece of the Domain integrated with the Immortal Heavenly Venerable to kill them completely.
Otherwise, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable will undoubtedly find a chance to escape.
And to collapse a piece of the Domain is not something easy to achieve.
What's more, that piece of Domain fused with the power of the Heavenly Venerable, to collapse it, the instant forging power must far exceed that of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
There are no weak Netherworld Blood Children, and the martial arts of Netherworld's Blood Children are slightly different from those of Divine Realm Warriors, making them even harder to kill.
In the long history of resisting the Netherworld Cave, countless Blood Disciples have fallen, but the number of fallen Blood Children is very few.
The Flying Boat hadn't reached Qi Yun County yet, and while they were dealing with a Blood Slave invading a large city, they received the latest news from Qi Yun County.
Just as Cheng Zhan predicted, a Blood Child was born!
Xuezhi Tuo!
Blood Disciples are nameless, but Blood Children have names.
This Blood Child's name is Tuo!
The moment Blood Child Tuo appeared, he displayed an overwhelmingly strong power, a strength that even the master of Blood Shadow Tower could not match.

chapters.title: Chapter 700 - 370 Xuezhi Tu, Taikun Abandons a Piece_2
chapters.content:
```
Comparable to the top-tier Immortal Heavenly Venerables, in the entire Qinghua state, there were only three Immortal Heavenly Venerables with such strength.
They were the Emperor Da Yue, the Myriad Thunder Sect Master, and the Tianwu Clan Master!
And these three individuals could not afford to leave.
Da Yue Country was in danger!
Realizing this, among the strong of Qi Yun County, there were more defectors, one after another True King Heavenly Venerable, who pledged allegiance to Xuezhi Tuo.
There were even more True King Heavenly Venerables who died in battle.
Every True King Heavenly Venerable who joined the fold would, under the use of the Netherworld Artifact by Xuezhi Tuo, and granted the breath of the Netherworld Blood, turn into a Netherworld Blood Disciple.
After their defection, the very first thing they had to do was to blood sacrifice Qi Yun County, collecting more essence blood for Xuezhi Tuo!
Because the news spread slowly, by the time Evergreen Pavilion received the message, Qi Yun County was probably already close to becoming a land of death!
In Qi Yun County City, it is now deathly still, with only a faint scent of blood lingering within the city.
Standing on the tallest tower of the once City Lord's Mansion, there's a young man whose face is pale, with a small red emblem at the center of his forehead.
Xuezhi Tuo!
Behind him, more than thirty people knelt respectfully, among them seven with blood-red eyes, no longer Blood Shadows but Blood Disciples.
All these thirty or so individuals were True King Heavenly Venerables.
"Pledging yourselves to this Blood Lord is a wise move. Your task now is for each of you to blood sacrifice at least ten million martial artists.
"The first to complete this task will be the number one Blood Disciple under this Blood Lord. Once I ascend to Blood Spirit, you will be candidates for Blood Lord.
"Remember, your time is limited. I need to obtain enough essence blood within a very short period of time to ascend to Blood Spirit.
"Once I ascend to Blood Spirit, all of you will be regarded as having rendered a great service."
Xuezhi Tuo's tone was gentle, as if he was discussing an ordinary matter.
"Yes, my lord!"
More than thirty True King Heavenly Venerables replied respectfully.
"Good, go now!"
Xuezhi Tuo waved his hand, and in front of each person, a little bottle appeared. The blood-red bottle emitted an aura of blood, and the mouth of the bottle seemed to possess a suction force capable of swallowing essence blood.
Blood Refining Bottle!
Watching one figure after another depart, Xuezhi Tuo revealed a gentle smile, standing on top of the high building, overlooking this dead and silent great city, with an expression of enjoyment.
"I've finally taken this step. Next is to become a Blood Spirit. As long as I succeed, I will be the great contributor of Netherworld.
"I will surely gain the favor of the Blood Lord, be taken in as a disciple, and only by becoming a Blood Path Successor can I shed this lowly servitude."
In the eyes of the Blood Slaves and Blood Disciples, the Blood Lord is exalted, dignified, and powerful.
However, Xuezhi Tuo knew that the Blood Lord was nothing more than a slave, at any time to be absorbed as a nutrient.
Only by becoming a Blood Path Successor can one truly rid oneself of the status of a slave.
"Taicang Domain, truly deserving of being the paramount domain."
Xuezhi Tuo muttered to himself. He was a person with backing; this trip to the Qinghua state was to pave the way for him.
To become a Blood Path Successor.
Following Xuezhi Tuo's command, Qi Yun County was suddenly beset by a great calamity. The True King Heavenly Venerables who had defected turned into Blood Disciples and were now slaughtering all over the place.
Sounds of fighting and curses echoed throughout Qi Yun County, as one True King after another fell or escaped with severe injuries.
In just a few short days, Qi Yun County had become like a hell on earth, with every city turned silent as the dead, only the faint scent of blood lingering.
Xia Shan City, a small city belonging to Qi Yun County and considered a mere rural town in the entire Da Yue Country.
Because Xia Shan City is not near Netherworld Cave, it has always been quite peaceful, and its overall strength is not very strong.
The strongest person is only a Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable, who participated in the great battle at Netherworld Cave and is only at the late stage of the Condensation Law Realm.
Even so, he held considerable prestige in Xia Shan City. Even the City Lord showed him respect.
The changes in Qi Yun County had not yet reached here, after all, it was a small town, and news traveled slower.
Near the gates of Xia Shan City, a young man who leaned against the city walls as if he had just woken from a drunken stupor, opened his blurry eyes.
"Evening has arrived again? Time to see the beauty of Xia Shan."
He muttered to himself, forcing himself to perk up, lifting his head, yawning, and gazing at the mountaintop outside Xia Shan City.
With the setting sun casting its glow, the mountaintop glowed crimson. Hence the name Xia Shan, derived from this very scene.
```
A Martial Artist rushed into Xia Shan City in haste, eyes filled with panic. Soon, a piece of news spread throughout Xia Shan City.
A great calamity had descended upon Qi Yun County—one of the Xuezhi had been born there and had sided with the True King Heavenly Venerable Xuezhi Tu, who was now on a killing spree, blood-sacrificing Martial Artists.
Xia Shan City trembled, filled with the colors of terror.
"Leave Qi Yun County!"
A thunderous shout rose, belonging to Xia Shan City's strongest, Tang Qian. With his prestige, having also been part of the suppression war within the Heavenly Grotto, his roar seemed to give the people of Xia Shan City a backbone.
They began to prepare to flee Qi Yun County, hoping against hope that their small city wouldn't draw attention and that they could escape smoothly before disaster struck.
"It's too late."
Sitting at the base of the city wall, a listless young man murmured.
Boom!
A formidable presence descended, blood light casting its glow—a True King had arrived.
"Mountain True King, is it you? Why have you...?"
Tang Qian's voice rang out in disbelief.
The Mountain True King, one of Qi Yun County's ten great True King Heavenly Venerables.
He had actually sided with Xuezhi Tu!
The Mountain True King, expressionless, looked at Tang Qian and said, "Considering you once fought under me, I'll spare your life. Surrender, and become a Blood Slave under my command!"
Tang Qian's eyes suddenly turned blood-red as he screamed, "You mangy cur, if you want to be the dog of the Netherworld, don't drag me into it!
"I, Tang Qian, would rather die than commit betrayal.
"If you want to blood-sacrifice Xia Shan City, you'll have to kill me first!"
With a roar, Tang Qian's aura burst forth, and in an instant, he used his most powerful secret technique and charged at the Mountain True King.
He knew his death was certain yet showed no fear. Tang Qian was well aware that once turned into a traitorous Blood Disciple, there would only be violent killing; Xia Shan City was doomed!
Thud!
Tang Qian was dead.
The Mountain True King, face still expressionless, turned to look at Xia Shan City and muttered to himself, "With the blood-sacrifice of this place, I'll reach ten million. I should be the first to complete the mission."
"All in!"
At that moment, all the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables in Xia Shan City let out a roar, igniting their essence blood and charging towards the Mountain True King.
"No need to waste your essence blood like this."
The Mountain True King remained expressionless, effortlessly suppressing the attacking Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables. A small bottle absorbed all their essence blood.
"It's your turn now!"
Looking at everyone in the city, who were scared, crying out, and begging for mercy, the Mountain True King's face remained unmoved as the blood light spread, the small bottle enlarging, ready to perform Blood Refining.
All of a sudden, his figure stalled as he looked towards the base of the city wall, where a young man had stood up.
The young man shook his head and even banged it against the city wall, eventually taking out a dagger and stabbing himself in the shoulder.
The intense pain brought him from his listless state to some focus.
He silently took out a Long Spear, looked up at the Mountain True King with a wry smile and said, "I thought I had lost all compassion, that I no longer cared about anything. But seeing people march towards death, hearing the cries of infants, the terrified calls of children for their parents—
"I have softened. I think it's time to make a move. After all, I am already a cripple; what better value could there be for a cripple than to die saving a city?"
The young man spoke deliberately, ascending step by step towards the heavens, the Long Spear glowing with light, the fierce intent of slaughter converging.
At the same time, a powerful Divine Soul Force surged in all directions, unleashing a storm.
The Mountain True King watched him, silently drawing a crimson long knife, his expression gradually becoming solemn.
"Rumors claim that the Taikun Realm Jiang Clan once had a bastard child, a prodigy with an unusual Divine Soul, immensely powerful, hailed as the youngest True King Heavenly Venerable in Taikun.
"Sadly, such a prodigy was crippled and cast out of Taikun, vanishing without a trace.
"If my guess isn't wrong, you are that discarded child of Taikun, that doomed prodigy, Jiang Buping!"
Jiang Buping's figure slightly paused before revealing a self-mocking expression. "To think I'd be recognized right as I'm about to die. I might be a cripple, but I'm still better than a traitor like you.
"Today, let this crippled genius pit against one of the top ten True King Heavenly Venerables of Qi Yun County!"
Boom!
A spear strike, sharp and unparalleled, like a blaze of cold light, tearing through the sky, aimed straight at the Mountain True King.

chapters.title: Chapter 701 - 371: Nourished by the Immortal Heavenly Venerable
chapters.content:
Outside Xia Shan City, the great battle had ended, and the Mountain True King was dead.
"Cough cough..."
Jiang Buping coughed, blood flowing from the corner of his mouth, dripping incessantly as if it would never stop. His flesh was scarred all over, seemingly on the verge of collapse at any moment.
He turned to glance at Xia Shan City, where people knelt on the ground while some warriors wanted to come out and treat him. Jiang Buping waved his hand dismissively, took a few steps, and disappeared into the distance.
"I can't hold on anymore, I am truly going to die this time.
"Regrettable? Perhaps, but that's how the world works. What can frustration do?
"A castaway of Taikun? Hahaha, it's truly laughable. Would I, Jiang Buping, care about the so-called glory of the Taikun Jiang Clan? Since they have no place for a child of mine, then leaving is just as well!"
Jiang Buping muttered to himself, yet his head kept shaking.
Suddenly, he tore off a piece of flesh from his chest. Agonizing pain followed, which brought his consciousness into sharp focus, slightly reviving his spirit.
He stuffed the torn piece of flesh back into the wound. A force of Divine Spirit Soul permeated the area, fusing the flesh onto the wound.
"Wherever I end up, so be it. If my body collapses, my Divine Soul will merely be driftwood, and how much longer can my consciousness, my clarity, last?"
Jiang Buping smiled at his self-mockery.
He was born with a Divine Soul unlike ordinary people, truly unlike them. Only Jiang Buping knew that he had possessed a Divine Soul from birth!
Wandering aimlessly, Jiang Buping even passed by a silent city, sighing to himself. When would the calamity of the Qinghua state end?
Who could stem the tide and put an end to this disaster?
Xuezhi Tuo, comparable to an Immortal Heavenly Venerable and among the strongest, Qinghua state had no spare Immortal Heavenly Venerables to contend with him.
Unless aid came from beyond.
In a certain part of Da Yue Country, two powerful figures were engaged in furious battle. One, clad in armor and wielding a halberd, seemed to merge with the Domain, as if holding an entire realm in his hands.
The other radiated blood light that pierced the sky, his potent Blood Power intertwining with the Domain. Though slightly less formidable, he was still able to fend off the armored man's assaults.
"Traitor, you deserve death!"
Sui Hongwu's halberd swept across the sky, roaring with hits that forced the master of Blood Shadow Tower to retreat step by step, yet he obstinately withstood the attacks.
