"To forsake a good life for servitude in the Netherworld, you traitor!"
Sui Hongwu's eyes reddened with rage. The calamity in Qi Yun County had reached his ears, and to his astonishment, a Blood Disciple had emerged in the Qinghua state.
This was the first time in history that a Netherworld Warrior had become a Blood Disciple through blood sacrifice in the Qinghua state.
If no one intervened, Qi Yun County would become a land of death!
"Forget about heading to Qi Yun County. If you dare leave, I'll blood sacrifice a region. You have only one choice: either confront me or go to Qi Yun County, but I will also blood sacrifice a great city."
The master of Blood Shadow Tower spoke coldly.
"Haha, truth be told, Lord Xuezhi Tuo aims not only to become a Blood Disciple but also to ascend as a Blood Spirit, and he's already halfway to success.
"What do you think? Are you eager to stop Lord Xuezhi Tuo?
"You could abandon me and try to thwart Lord Xuezhi Tuo, but I can also perform the blood sacrifice to aid in Lord Xuezhi Tuo's ascension to Blood Spirit.
"You can only rage powerlessly here!"
The master of Blood Shadow Tower was insufferably arrogant. Even though he was at a disadvantage, containing Sui Hongwu was not difficult for him.
While Sui Hongwu was undoubtedly stronger, he was not a top-tier Immortal Heavenly Venerable and could not defeat him quickly.
The battle raged on, Sui Hongwu unleashing powerful attacks, causing the Domain to tremble. The Heaven and Earth Laws thundered, but he still couldn't crush the master of Blood Shadow Tower.
He felt a surge of helplessness in his heart.
Just then, an overwhelming aura appeared.
"Sui lad, I'm here to lend you a hand!"
With a thunderous roar, a colossal fist seal tore through the sky and struck the blood light enveloping the master of Blood Shadow Tower.
Splat!
The blood light, entwined with the Domain, was shattered in an instant. Seizing the opportunity, Sui Hongwu thrust his halberd. The master of Blood Shadow Tower hastily defended, but his shoulder was still wounded.
At that moment, his expression changed drastically, and he staggered backwards.
"Feng Yan old brother, your timing is impeccable, let's join forces and kill this traitor!"
Sui Hongwu was overjoyed, finally receiving reinforcements.
A man with silver hair and a white beard who looked middle-aged, with a burly figure and wearing a pair of gauntlets, didn't say another word but instead, with both fists pounding, attacked the master of Blood Shadow Tower.
"In my entire life, I've hated traitors the most; you deserve death!"
The master of Blood Shadow Tower's face turned pale, as facing two opponents put him in danger.
He launched a blade strike, seizing the chance before being encircled, and immediately fled.
"Kill!"
Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu pursued him.
The master of Blood Shadow Tower headed straight for Qi Yun County. Xuezhi Tuo had completed his ascension, and his strength was greater than that of the master within the Immortal Heavenly Venerables. Thus, only by joining forces could he face Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu.
"Brother Feng Yan, I am truly grateful for your aid this time!"
Sui Hongwu expressed his gratitude.
"It's a small matter. The situation in the Nine Mountain Realm has stabilized, so as soon as I received the distress message, I rushed over. Sadly, I was a step too late, and that damned Netherworld rabble has blood sacrificed Qi Yun County City."
Feng Yan spoke with unabated anger.
Three figures, one leading and two following, rushed directly toward Qi Yun County.
In Qi Yun County City, Xuezhi Tuo still stood atop a high building, waiting for Blood Disciples and Blood Slaves to bring the blood of the sacrifice.

chapters.title: Chapter 702 - 371 Using the Immortal Heavenly Venerable as Nutrient_2
chapters.content:
"If the Qinghua state could become my hunting ground, how wonderful that would be," Xuezhi Tu thought.
Xuezhi Tu knew that unless he advanced to a Blood Spirit, he would have no chance of accomplishing this.
Otherwise, entertaining the thought of occupying the Qinghua state was nothing but a pipe dream.
"Hmm?"
Suddenly, he looked up, and a Blood Shadow flashed towards him almost instantaneously.
"Lord Xuezhi Tu, reinforcements from Da Yue Country have arrived, and I am unable to contain them alone..."
The master of the Blood Shadow Tower spoke hastily and respectfully.
"You have done well enough."
Xuezhi Tu nodded and gestured, "Come, let's join forces to crush the enemy!"
"Yes, my lord!"
The master of the Blood Shadow Tower breathed a sigh of relief and came to the top of the high tower, bowing respectfully to Xuezhi Tu.
"Your Blood Power is not pure enough. I will pass on a secret technique to you that can enhance your strength," Xuezhi Tu said, extending a hand. "Watch carefully. This secret technique is a Netherworld Technique, incredibly powerful..."
The master of the Blood Shadow Tower was overjoyed and thanked him, "Thank you, my lord!"
Hum!
A blood-light twined around Xuezhi Tu's fingers, turning into a Blood Blade. As the Blood Blade swayed, more blades appeared one after another. These blades were cold, bloodthirsty, and seemed to devour one's essence and strength continuously upon the slightest touch.
"This is the Blood-drinking Yin Destroying Blade. In an instant, it can devour the essence and offer up Martial Artists in a blood sacrifice, turning them into nourishment for oneself... It is a Netherworld Technique, not something all Xuezhis can cultivate. Do you understand?" Xuezhi Tu conveyed the Blood Blade to the master of the Blood Shadow Tower and said with a grave voice.
"Your servant understands!"
The master of the Blood Shadow Tower was thrilled.
Xuezhi Tu had revealed his extraordinary status in the Netherworld, not comparable to ordinary Xuezhis, and by passing this secret technique to him, he intended to make him a trusted follower under Xuezhi Tu's command.
Once Xuezhi Tu advanced to a Blood Spirit, he would be one of the Xuezhis under his command. With this technique, his status would be higher than that of regular Xuezhis!
"Next, reflect on it carefully!"
Xuezhi Tu said indifferently.
"Yes, thank you, my lord!"
The master of the Blood Shadow Tower started to meditate deeply, surrounded by the revolving Blood Blades.
"Xuezhi Tu, your life ends here!"
At this moment, Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu had already come in pursuit. Seeing the desolate Qi Yun County City, their eyes nearly exploded with rage, and with a roar, they attacked the lone figure together.
"Merely at the early stage of Immortal," Xuezhi Tu said with a faint smile. Taking a step forward, his blood-light illuminated half of the sky, and in a snap of his fingers, scarlet brilliance shot out, as he fought alone against two Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
Boom!
The master of the Blood Shadow Tower was shocked; Lord Xuezhi Tu was immensely strong. Having just advanced, he was already able to fight two against one without falling behind.
At this moment, he heard Xuezhi Tu's voice transmitted to him.
"Quickly comprehend the technique. Boost your strength, and together, we'll slay these two. The essence of Immortal Heavenly Venerables is a great supplement, aiding me in progressing further towards becoming a Blood Spirit."
The master of the Blood Shadow Tower hastily refocused and began to contemplate the secret technique.
A Blood Blade, following his contemplation, entered his body along with his Divine Soul, exuding an aura that seemed to bring marvelous understandings to his mind.
While fighting Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu, Xuezhi Tu's smile broadened, and the blood pattern between his eyebrows suddenly lit up.
A strange force abruptly emerged.
"Ah!"
A scream rang out, and the master of the Blood Shadow Tower suddenly showed a look of horror.
"My lord..."
Xuezhi Tu's cold laughter came through: "I've nurtured you for such a long time, and you even broke through to the Immortal Realm. It's time for the harvest. You are quite the nourishment..."
Boom!
In the shocked eyes of Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable-level master of the Blood Shadow Tower suddenly turned into a mass of blood qi. This blood qi seemed to contain the essence of immortality.
Swish!
In an instant, the blood qi entered Xuezhi Tu's body.
At that moment, Xuezhi Tu, whose complexion was previously pale, now had a rosy complexion, and his breath was strengthening.
```
"Not good!"
Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu felt a jolt of horror in their hearts.
After devouring the master of Blood Shadow Tower, Xuezhi Tu's power had grown even stronger.
Boom!
In just an instant, Xuezhi Tu's strength climbed another step, and with a flick of his fingers, a myriad of Blood Blades materialized, densely surrounding the airspace and encapsulating the entire battlefield.
He completely sealed off all the paths of retreat, revealing a cold and sinister smile as he looked at Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu as though they were prey.
"Next, it's your turn. The essence-blood of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm is a great tonic. Blood refining you two, though still far from the Blood Spirit, brings me a step closer."
"Arrogant! Let's see how you plan to blood refine me, Feng Yan!"
Feng Yan roared in anger, not daring to be the slightest bit careless. A layer of gray light surged, and in an instant, his body seemed to be covered with a layer of stone armor.
The entire man appeared to have turned into a stone figure.
Sui Hongwu's expression was grave. His halberd radiated light and, joining forces with Feng Yan, the two wielded the power of their domain, merging and aligning with the Heaven and Earth Laws.
To kill the two of them, one would have to collapse this domain space and burst open the Heaven and Earth Laws.
However, Xuezhi Tu smiled coldly as the Blood Blades circled, stirring up a blood-colored storm on the battlefield, constantly sweeping and slicing. Although it could not penetrate Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu's domain, as the battle continued, their complexions turned pale.
The two found that their blood qi seemed to be uncontrollable, fusing with the domain. Normally, this wouldn't be dangerous for an Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
Their blood qi merging with the domain strengthened their control over the power of that domain.
However, the blood qi continuously merging into the domain started to dissipate, being drawn away by Xuezhi Tu, slowly swallowed up. If this continued, the two were doomed!
But faced with this situation, they had no solution.
"Killing Blood Refining Cover!"
Feng Yan ground his teeth and said coldly.
Xuezhi Tu's Killing Blood Refining Cover was no ordinary artifact; it was a stronger Netherworld Artifact.
"Your fate has already been sealed. Even pleading or surrendering is useless. You may last a bit longer if you resist, but you'll be devoured quickly if you don't resist.
"If you want a comfortable death, you can choose not to resist."
Xuezhi Tu laughed with a hint of softness.
Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu's hearts sank deeper. At this moment, all they could do was to keep resisting, to wait and hope for a change.
Perhaps Emperor Da Yue, or the Myriad Thunder Sect Master, or the Tianwu Clan Master, any one of them could break free and come to Qi Yun County to suppress Xuezhi Tu, and then they would be saved.
In Qi Yun County City, blood qi filled the air, turning this domain into a blood-colored domain, as if dyed red with fresh blood.
The battle continued.
It was no longer a battle, but rather a grim resistance by Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu.
Xuezhi Tu's strength, on the other hand, grew slowly. As the situation deteriorated for them, the two did not know how long they could hold out!
At a certain moment, Xuezhi Tu threw out two Netherworld Blood Orbs and said with a laugh, "Replenish your blood qi a bit, so you can resist a little longer."
Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu glared furiously at Xuezhi Tu but eventually had no choice but to refine the Netherworld Blood Orbs to replenish their depleted blood qi.
Naturally, Xuezhi Tu was not benevolent; he was simply treating the two of them as cultivation nourishment. The more blood qi they could provide, the more beneficial it was for him.
And the Netherworld Blood Orbs could undoubtedly restore their depleted essence-blood and even make their essence-blood purer, more potent with the power of essence-blood.
Knowing Xuezhi Tu's intentions, the two still had to accept the Netherworld Blood Orbs to restore their losses, as only by doing so could they last longer, hoping for an opportunity.
In Xuezhi Tu's soft and complacent smile, contentment shone through. After a while, he would offer two more Netherworld Blood Orbs. The Netherworld Blood Orbs he carried were all high-grade Blood Beads, even useful to Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
When the two of them could no longer enhance their blood qi using the Netherworld Blood Orbs, that would be the end of their lives.
"Don't harbor any hope of being rescued. Anyone with the strength to do it can't get here."
Xuezhi Tu said with a playful smile.
The Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship turned into a streak of light and entered Qi Yun County, heading straight for Qi Yun County City, encountering a True King along the way who was preparing to blood sacrifice a small city.
Li Xuan flicked his finger, and in an instant, annihilated the opponent.
"Qinghua state, a purgatory on earth!"
What they saw along the way made everyone who came from the Spiritual Realm feel an oppressive heaviness in their hearts.
Xu Yan clenched his fists, filled with indignation. These Netherworld enemies must be punished!
He was neither from the Divine Realm nor from the Qinghua state, but he was a person of this Domain. The enemies from the Netherworld, in a sense, were also his enemies.
Besides, such acts that angered gods and men alike would outrage anyone who hadn't lost their humanity.
"That person looks pitiful, let's rescue him onto the ship," said Su Lingxiu suddenly.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 703 - 372: This is the Child of Fortune, the Blood Slave Army
chapters.content:
Jiang Buping didn't know how long he had been walking or how far he had gone until a sense of drowsiness and fatigue overwhelmed him, and he finally collapsed against a large tree.
The powerful force of his Divine Soul was still pervasive throughout his body, healing his grievous physical injuries and preventing his body from completely breaking down.
His consciousness was no longer clear, and he entered a state akin to deep sleep.
In his haze, he felt as if his body was floating and thought he could hear voices, but in his subconscious, he dismissed it as nothing more than hallucinations born from his muddled mind.
On Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship, everyone's attention was fixed on Jiang Buping.
Li Xuan was no exception; he was secretly astonished. The man's Divine Soul was stronger than his flesh, and he was maintaining his body from collapsing with the power of his Divine Soul.
If it were just that, he wouldn't have been so surprised.
What truly shocked him was the trace of Imperishable Qi tainting the man's Divine Soul!
Even just a trace of this Imperishable Qi was an absolute disaster for a Martial Artist, as it led to the loss of Spiritual Wisdom and a state of confusion and stupor.
Yet, this young man, who was about the same age as Xu Yan and the others, had not lost his Spiritual Wisdom or fallen into confusion; he just seemed listless and sleepy, perpetually lacking energy as if he could not wake up.
It was simply inconceivable.
Moreover, considering the severity of his injuries—which indicated a recent battle—the only thing keeping him alive was his powerful Divine Soul.
"A Divine Soul stronger than his physical body, stronger than his Realm, and tainted with Imperishable Qi but still maintaining consciousness—this is monstrous!
"His Divine Soul also seems unusual; it seems not to have been cultivated but innate, with cultivation only making it stronger."
At this moment, Li Xuan felt that he could now proceed with his Fifth Door of Martial Arts.
Su Lingxiu was busy treating Jiang Buping, her face showing surprise as she said, "His injuries are so severe that his body is almost collapsing, yet it's maintained by the power of his Divine Soul.
"Moreover, I feel there is something within his Divine Soul."
Healing physical injuries was easy for Su Lingxiu, but abnormalities within the Divine Soul were not so easily resolved.
"Do not let your Primordial Spirit come in contact with his Divine Soul; be cautious of being infected with Imperishable Qi," warned Li Xuan.
"Imperishable Qi!"
Su Lingxiu was thoroughly shocked.
Xu Yan and the others also showed surprised faces; there was Imperishable Qi within this man's Divine Soul?
Cheng Zhan watched Jiang Buping for a while and vaguely recalled someone, his expression filled with disbelief.
"Imperishable Qi? Is it the Qi from Imperishable Heaven Cave?"
Xu Yan asked in astonishment, "Don't you know?"
Cheng Zhan shook his head and said, "I've heard some rumors. There are powerful caves in the Divine Realm, known as Imperishable Heaven Caves, said to contain what's known as Imperishable Qi. I don't know the specifics."
After pondering for a moment, he added, "Both Qinghua state and the adjacent Nine Mountains Realm do not have Imperishable Heaven Caves; hence, there is a lack of understanding."
Xu Yan and the others nodded in realization, no longer inquiring but instead curiously gathered around Jiang Buping, marveling at his condition.
The injuries to Jiang Buping's physical body weren't a big deal and were quickly healed, no longer on the verge of collapsing. His biggest issue, however, was his Divine Soul.
Even Su Lingxiu was somewhat at a loss.
Unless the Imperishable Qi could be removed from his Divine Soul, Jiang Buping would not truly recover. But removing the Imperishable Qi was not an easy task, and Su Lingxiu, for the time being, had no good solutions.
After all, Imperishable Qi was extremely special, and although she had researched it for some time and gained a deeper understanding, she still had not found a way to refine the Imperishable Qi.
"His Divine Soul is very powerful, seemingly stronger than his body, and it feels as though his body can hardly contain the Divine Soul."
Su Lingxiu said, frowning with concern.
"Strengthening the body will do, I'll pass on the Heavenly Hammer Refining Skill to him, and with the aid of pills for cultivation, it will surely strengthen his body," suggested Meng Chong.
From Jiang Buping's injuries, it seemed like he had fought a fierce battle against a Blood Disciple.
"Second senior brother, I think that won't solve the problem. If his body becomes stronger, his Divine Soul will also strengthen. The root lies in his Divine Soul…
"Perhaps it is the uniqueness of his Divine Soul that, even after being contaminated with Imperishable Qi, did not lose spiritual wisdom," Su Lingxiu shook her head.
"Let's wait until he wakes up," Xu Yan said.
Due to the fierce battle Jiang Buping had endured and the impact of the Imperishable Qi, he was now in a deep slumber.
"That's all we can do for now," Su Lingxiu agreed, nodding.
She had run out of solutions temporarily, unless her master was willing to intervene. Thus, everything was dependent on Jiang Buping's fate.
Cheng Zhan watched Jiang Buping intently, the more he looked, the more astounded he became, thinking of someone.
"Cheng, do you know him?" asked Xu Yan curiously.
"I've thought of someone," Cheng Zhan mused for a moment and then said, "There was once a prodigy in the Taikun Realm of the Divine Realm, hailed as the youngest True King Heavenly Venerable. Rumors say his Divine Soul was exceptionally strong, but he's been rumored to have failed, ridiculed as a fallen prodigy…
"If I'm not mistaken, he should be the Taikun cast-off, Jiang Buping!"
Upon hearing this, Xu Yan and the others were immediately intrigued, urging Cheng Zhan to share the story of the Taikun cast-off Jiang Buping.
Upon seeing Jiang Buping, Li Xuan had found the direction for his Fifth Door of Martial Arts and started preparing fervently.
"Imperishable Qi may be difficult to refine, but his case of being tainted with Imperishable Qi without losing spiritual wisdom, plus having an innate Divine Soul, represents an opportunity to potentially refine the Imperishable Qi.

chapters.title: Chapter 704 - 372: This is a Child of Fortune, Blood Slave Army_2
chapters.content:
"No, it's not necessarily about refining, but about integrating the Imperishable Qi completely into the Divine Soul, endowing the Divine Soul with the characteristic of being imperishable."
"This is both a great disaster and a tremendous opportunity."
Li Xuan was beside himself with excitement. He found a prospect for his fifth disciple and began to organize and perfect the Fifth Door of Martial Arts, adding more profound theories, while he paid attention to Cheng Zhan's narration.
"Born of a concubine, a genius ruined, banished, a discarded child... Isn't he the Child of Destiny? And to think he met me, a highly-skilled individual— isn't this fate?
"The fifth disciple, it's him, Jiang Buping!"
Li Xuan was thrilled within his heart.
Wasn't Jiang Buping a Child of Destiny, both born of a concubine and ruined as a genius, and also a discarded child?
And because of the Imperishable Qi, he became ruined but did not become muddle-headed. This is both a great disaster and a tremendous opportunity.
"The Imperishable Qi in the Divine Soul is probably the result of being plotted against, right?"
Li Xuan muttered to himself.
Jiang Buping has accumulated so many encounters of a Child of Destiny. Now all that's missing is a betrayal by a beloved or perhaps a fiancée.
If he had that, he'd be the absolute archetype of a protagonist.
The thought made Li Xuan couldn't help but ask, "Does he have a fiancée?"
Cheng Zhan was taken aback, but then he hastily nodded and said, "Yes, it is rumored he has a fiancée. However, after being banished, his relationship with his fiancée was severed, and it seems she has someone else in her heart now!"
That's more like it!
Li Xuan nodded and did not speak any further.
The more he looked at Jiang Buping, the more he liked him. This child was sure to achieve greatness!
The Fifth Door of Martial Arts would depend on him to thrive and prosper.
Cheng Zhan, with a thoughtful look, asked, "Senior, do you mean that he might have been sabotaged by his fiancée?"
Li Xuan neither confirmed nor denied it!
Jiang Buping continued to lie unconscious, unaware of when he would awaken.
The attention of everyone shifted from Jiang Buping to Xuezhi Tu and to the crisis currently faced by the Qinghua state.
Boom!
Suddenly, blood-red light soared into the sky ahead, where several Blood Disciples were jointly attacking a large city. This was the third largest city in Qi Yun County, with a True King Heavenly Venerable stationed in it.
However, it was now in grave danger.
"Kill!"
Cheng Zhan roared with anger and charged into battle.
Meanwhile, the other Martial Artists accompanying Cheng Zhan had already dispersed on their way to Qi Yun County to provide support in various directions.
Currently, only Cheng Zhan was on the Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship.
The Flying Ship turned into a streak of light and arrived instantly.
Both the Blood Disciples and the True King Heavenly Venerables of Qi Yun County in the midst of battle noticed the massive ship shooting towards them, and they were all astonished. What Divine Artifact was this?
"The rebels must be punished!"
In the midst of Cheng Zhan's thunderous roar, he joined the battle, hammer in hand.
The three hard-pressed True King Heavenly Venerables, upon seeing reinforcements arrive, were immediately heartened and roared as they struck out.
Fang Hao sighed and said, "Divine Realm's great cities are too fragile without City Protection Formation Methods. If it weren't so easy to breach with a Great Formation and strong beings to guard them, how could they be attacked so easily?"
All those on the Flying Ship nodded in agreement, having witnessed the marvels of Formations.
Li Xuan flicked his finger, instantly slaying the Blood Disciples. Without stopping, the Flying Ship continued towards Qi Yun County.
Soon, Cheng Zhan and the two True King Heavenly Venerables came to thank the senior for intervening.
When they learned of an Immortal existence, they were overjoyed, feeling that Qi Yun County had hope at last, finally having a powerful being to contain Xuezhi Tu.
In their eyes, containment was all that was necessary.
After all, Xuezhi Tu was not an ordinary Immortal Heavenly Venerable; his strength was immense, and he was not easily slain.
Even Emperor Da Yue, the Myriad Thunder Sect Master or the Tianwu Clan Master, any one of them would likely find it difficult to slay Xuezhi Tu.
The battle at Qi Yun County continued raging, and at that moment, Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu swallowed the eighth Netherworld Blood Orb and seemed to have reached their limit, unable to recover their expended vital blood any further.
At that very moment, as Feng Yan's body trembled, he looked like a stony strongman and suddenly launched a massive punch. This punch seemed to gather the Domain Power of an entire realm.
Sui Hongwu also hurled his Halberd as if tossing the domain itself into a mighty strike that blasted open a huge gap through the Blood Blades encircling Xuezhi Tu!
```
Boom!
And then, the halberd, struck by Feng Yan's fist seal, fused together with the powerful blow in an instant.
The halberd also shattered at this moment, as if a piece of the heavens and earth had collapsed.
This strike blasted open Xuezhi Tu's blockade and penetrated the surrounding Blood Blades.
Heaven and Earth Laws emerged, the breath of the heavens and earth surged violently, and Qi Yun County collapsed into ruins from the aftershocks of the attack.
The space of heaven and earth where Qi Yun County was located began to shake, as if there was a momentary weakening of the Domain Power.
The Domain Power that was drawn away converged on the strike delivered by Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu.
"Go!"
Two figures seized the opportunity and instantly fled, disheveled and gasping for breath, Sui Hongwu had even lost his Divine Artifact.
"Do you think you can escape?"
Xuezhi Tu walked matter-of-factly, stepping out to give chase.
Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu, panting heavily, looked back with extremely somber expressions, nearly having become nourishment for Xuezhi Tu.
Fortunately, they had managed to deceive Xuezhi Tu, seizing the chance to escape.
Had Xuezhi Tu succeeded, the consequences would have been unimaginable, not only would the two have lost their lives, but Xuezhi Tu's strength would have increased further, leaving no one in the Qinghua state capable of opposing him!
Once no one could restrain him, the chances of Xuezhi Tu ascending to a Blood Spirit would greatly increase.
"Where will you flee? Even if you two escape, so what?"
Xuezhi Tu pursued relentlessly, with Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu fleeing desperately. Behind them, the sky was filled with bloody light and the ascending qi of Blood Sha.
Unbeknownst to them, an army of Blood Disciples and Blood Slaves had already gathered behind Xuezhi Tu!
Dozens of Blood Disciples, tens of thousands of Blood Slaves, all from the Netherworld Cave in Qi Yun County. The Martial Artists guarding the cave had been slaughtered by Xuezhi Tu, and Blood Disciples and Blood Slaves had entered the Qinghua state.
Now they had all gathered under Xuezhi Tu's command.
"Let's see who can stop me, Xuezhi Tu. The blood sacrifice of Da Yue begins today,"
came the cold voice of Xuezhi Tu.
"You two, either submit to death obediently, with the essence blood of two Immortal Heavenly Venerables, you can save many lives. Or shall I continue my blood sacrifice along the way, would you sacrifice yourselves to save billions of lives?"
The sinister and venomous voice crept into their ears.
Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu's faces were ashen, fists clenched tightly, yet they said nothing and buried their heads in escape, heading towards the Myriad Thunder Sect!
Only by leading people to the Myriad Thunder Sect and having the Myriad Thunder Sect Master restrain Xuezhi Tu.
Emperor Da Yue was already unable to intervene, and Tianwu Sect was too far, leaving only Myriad Thunder Sect as the sole option.
The two worried that Xuezhi Tu would see through their ruse and give up on them, instead choosing to blood sacrifice in the cities of Da Yue.
"You and I have consumed so many Netherworld Blood Orbs, refined our essence blood, and purified our essence blood, and we have yet to fully refine the Netherworld Qi within the Netherworld Blood Orbs.
"Our essence blood is precious to Xuezhi Tu, who will not give us up,"
Feng Yan said in a deep voice.
"Let's hope so!"
Sui Hongwu said through clenched teeth.
The two had no other options, neither daring to flee completely out of fear that Xuezhi Tu would give them up and instead go to blood sacrifice the cities of Da Yue.
Nor did they dare to get too close to Xuezhi Tu, as being caught by him could have unpredictable consequences.
Now, their only bet was that Xuezhi Tu did not know the whereabouts of the Myriad Thunder Sect and was unfamiliar with it, thus following them in pursuit.
As the two madly fled, even as Immortal Heavenly Venerables, after experiencing a fierce battle, especially the strike that had broken through Xuezhi Tu's blockade which had drained them considerably, they felt an exhausting fatigue they hadn't felt in a long time.
Looking back, they saw the sky was bathed in blood-red, with Blood Sha rolling in like a storm.
"Avoid the great cities, absolutely do not pass through the great cities!"
Sui Hongwu said with gritted teeth.
The two started to avoid the routes that led to the great cities, but Xuezhi Tu behind them maintained an ominously complacent smile, as if ignorant of the two's intentions.
Leading the Blood Slave Army, he continued to pursue relentlessly.
"The essence blood of Martial Artists from the Myriad Thunder Sect tastes even more delicious, right? Blood sacrifice a few cities of the Myriad Thunder Sect, blood refine some True Kings, and if it is possible, to combine forces with those from the cave, blood refine the Myriad Thunder Sect Master,"
Xuezhi Tu murmured to himself.
As Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu fled, they suddenly saw a streak of light flying towards them from ahead, which turned out to be a gigantic ship, flying in mid-air, the likes of which they had never seen before.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 705 - 373: A Master Demonstrates His Divine Might, Shocking the Domain with a Single Palm
chapters.content:
On the Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship, everyone only saw in front of them in the sky, a stroke of bloodlight illuminating half of the sky, with blood evil rolling in, sweeping towards them like a storm.
"This, this, Netherworld Army? Has Heavenly Grotto fallen?"
Cheng Zhan was utterly astonished!
Although Qi Yun Prefecture City had already been blood sacrificed, and Xuezhi Tuo was in Qi Yun County, the fall of Heavenly Grotto was a matter of time.
But still, the appearance of this scene was shocking.
With Heavenly Grotto fallen, Blood Disciples and Blood Slaves invading the Qinghua state would bring disaster that would last a long time. Even after the Heavenly Grotto chaos was quelled, it would take quite some time to clear the Blood Disciples and Blood Slaves within the Qinghua state.
What's more, once a Blood Disciple or Blood Slave hid deeply, by the time they were discovered, it was likely they had already caused much trouble and blood refined numerous people.
Especially the remote small cities and towns, once they encountered an attack, they would not stand a chance and would inevitably be blood sacrificed to the last.
"This is bad!"
Cheng Zhan's face turned pale.
He could almost imagine what kind of turmoil Qinghua state would face and how many weak small cities and towns would be slaughtered.
"What is that?"
Suddenly, he saw two figures ahead frantically trying to escape amidst the rolling blood evil.
Their auras were chaotic, but incredibly strong.
Immortal Heavenly Venerable!
Cheng Zhan's heart sank as he thought that two Immortal Heavenly Venerables, joining hands, were still fleeing in such disarray. Could it be that there wasn't just one Blood Spirit Child?
What's scarier is, if it was only Xuezhi Tuo who had forced the two Immortal Heavenly Venerables into such disarray, how terrifying would Xuezhi Tuo's strength be?
Across the entire Qinghua state, only Emperor Da Yue, Myriad Thunder Sect Master, and Tianwu Clan Master could possibly accomplish that, right?
These were, after all, the three strongest Immortal Heavenly Venerables in the Qinghua state.
"Is this the Immortal Heavenly Venerable?"
Li Xuan also watched the fleeing Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu and was momentarily surprised, as their strength fell short of his expectation for an Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
"Are these two just weak, or did I overestimate the strength of Immortal Heavenly Venerables?"
Li Xuan couldn't help but fall into deep thought.
With his current strength, he could easily crush the two Immortal Heavenly Venerables ahead without any difficulty.
After all, he was already in the Void-breaking Realm. The Power of Void-breaking could easily kill Immortal Heavenly Venerables and burst through the Immortal Heavenly Venerables' unity with the Domain, managing a piece of Domain Power was not much of a challenge.
Moreover, his Divine Skills, Primordial Spirit, and physique were all a hundred times stronger; he could not be viewed as a mere Void-breaking Realm Warrior.
"Xuezhi Tuo? Indeed quite strong. So this is the power of the Blood Path? Using essence blood as nourishment... No, the Netherworld Warriors by their very nature are a bit different, and it's probably related to the environment of the Netherworld.
"Blood Refining to increase strength seems fast and powerful, but the downside is also obvious: the higher the Realm, the easier it is to lose control and harm oneself.
"The only way to address this issue is to settle and refine oneself. By doing so, however, it loses the advantage of rapid strength enhancement.
"But if one doesn't settle and refine oneself, there will inevitably come a day when control is lost, and it backfires."
Li Xuan's eyes were deep as he looked towards the rolling blood evil sweeping in like a storm, leading the tens of thousands of the Netherworld Army, that effeminate young man in the lead.
Xuezhi Tuo.
Blood Refining may indeed increase strength quickly, but its drawbacks are also very clear, prone to losing control and harming oneself.
At the level of Xuezhi Tuo, if he doesn't settle himself and continues to use Blood Refining to increase his strength, he will likely quickly lose control and harm himself.
This could also be called going into demonic possession!
"To want to rapidly advance to a Blood Spirit is impossible. Even if advancement is achieved, control will soon be lost, harm will come to oneself, even if for a time one temporarily suppresses it with a Supreme Treasure, leaving it to slowly settle and digest.
"But during this time of suppression, it is not possible to make use of the strength of the Blood Spirit, and if one forcibly does..."
Li Xuan, who could now be considered a Martial Arts expert, a real master, saw through the pros and cons of the Netherworld's Blood Path Cultivation Technique at a glance.
Of course, this was also thanks to having seen the Cultivation Techniques left by the Blood Spirit Child, and having a deeper understanding of Blood Refining.
"So this is an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, how strong!"
Meng Chong couldn't help but exclaim.
Xu Yan nodded and said, "It's just a bit of a sorry state!"
Cheng Zhan: ...
Those are Immortal Heavenly Venerables! Two of them together can only flee, both are in such disarray, and you all don't panic at all?
Do you actually have the leisure to appraise and discuss?
"Xuezhi Tuo is too strong, the Netherworld Army is fierce. We should escape, return to the Myriad Thunder Sect to hold fast!"
Cheng Zhan swallowed and suggested.
Xu Yan glanced at him. How could the true King Heavenly Venerable from the Divine Realm be so timid?
"It's only a minor scene, no need to panic!"
Cheng Zhan: ...
Is this a minor scene?
Is there really a bigger scene than this in the Spiritual Realm?
At that moment, Cheng Zhan was somewhat stunned; how could the people from the Divine Realm be so bold?
He, a True King Heavenly Venerable, had never seen such a scene, even his heart trembled in fear, especially seeing two Immortal Heavenly Venerables fleeing in such a sorry state, which was unheard of!
And yet, Xu Yan actually said that this was a minor scene?
Moreover, looking at the expressions of Meng Chong and the others, they seemed to agree with Xu Yan's view of this as a minor scene!
Cheng Zhan took another look at the calm and composed senior and suddenly realized something.
"Right, two Immortal Heavenly Venerables fled in disarray, but when you add this senior, that makes three Immortal Heavenly Venerables. And this senior seems to be even stronger.
"Three Immortal Heavenly Venerables joining forces should be enough to hold the situation steady; indeed, there's no need to panic!"
Cheng Zhan, who believed he understood this point, suddenly straightened his back and nodded, "That's right, no need to panic!"

chapters.title: Chapter 706 - 373: The Master Shows Divine Might, One Palm Shocks the Domain_2
chapters.content:
"I'll go explain the situation to the two elders and join forces immediately!"
Cheng Zhan, unable to contain his urgency, moved and went to meet Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu.
Time was of the essence. To avoid any delay in communication that might lead to a failure to join forces in time, Cheng Zhan hastily left the Flying Boat to discuss the situation in advance and join forces to deal with the threat.
Xu Yan and others: ???
Join forces?
Old Cheng Zhan really is a frog at the bottom of a well, oblivious to the strength of our master, who is a highly skilled expert!
They scorned Cheng Zhan severely.
The two True King Heavenly Venerables who had come with Cheng Zhan sighed with relief and nodded, saying, "Yes, by joining forces, we'll surely be able to deal with Xuezhi Tu!"
Xu Yan and the others couldn't be bothered to say anything. They'll realize what an expert is when their master makes a move.
In our master's eyes, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable is no different from an ant!
The two True King Heavenly Venerables were somewhat bewildered, as Xu Yan and the others had stopped talking. Why were even Wu Tianan and the other weak ones looking at them strangely?
Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu were in the midst of escape when they spotted the mysterious giant ship ahead, their hearts skipped a beat, and their faces suddenly changed.
Such a Divine Artifact did not exist in the Qinghua state.
Even the Nine Mountain Realm next to the Qinghua state did not possess such Divine Artifacts.
As for the entire Divine Realm, no such Divine Artifact was known to exist for the time being.
Could it be a Netherworld Artifact, with another Netherworld Blood Child entering the Qinghua state?
If that was the case, the Qinghua state was in danger!
With grim faces, Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu were about to avoid the Flying Boat to prevent being sandwiched between enemies when they saw a figure flying towards them from the ship ahead.
"Elders, come join us on the Flying Boat quickly and join forces to face the formidable enemy!"
Cheng Zhan called out in a hurry.
"Huh, seems like an elder from the Myriad Thunder Sect."
Sui Hongwu exclaimed in surprise.
"Let's go ask!"
Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu approached him.
"I am Sui Hongwu, commander of the inner guards of Da Yue. Who might you be?"
Cheng Zhan was startled, realizing he was addressing the commander of the inner guards of Da Yue, who appeared to be in such a sorry state. Rumors had it that the commander's Divine Weapon was a halberd, which was now nowhere to be seen.
This indicated the grave crisis the man must have encountered.
"I am Cheng Zhan from the Myriad Thunder Sect. There's no time to lose, Elders, please come with me..."
Cheng Zhan spoke respectfully.
He then informed Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu about the presence of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable aboard the Flying Boat, who appeared to be even stronger. With the three Immortal Heavenly Venerables joining forces, they would surely withstand Xuezhi Tu's overwhelming presence!
Upon hearing this, Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu were immediately overjoyed.
"Let's go, the three of us joining forces will surely restrain Xuezhi Tu. Once the Sect Master of Myriad Thunder makes a move, we will eliminate him in one fell swoop!"
Feng Yan said elatedly.
Seeing that Xuezhi Tu and the tens of thousands of Blood Slaves were catching up, the two didn't dare to delay. They grabbed Cheng Zhan's shoulder, and their speed surged, reaching the Flying Boat in an instant.
At a glance, they focused their attention on Li Xuan.
Feng Yan, an impetuous man, rushed over and said, "There's no time to lose. If we three join forces, we will certainly hold back Xuezhi Tu!"
Li Xuan was contemplating the Fifth Door of Martial Arts when he looked up and said indifferently, "Young man, do not be in such a rush."
Feng Yan was taken aback for a moment but then flared up, puffing his beard and glaring as if he was about to explode, "What did you call me? Young man? Do you not know who I, Feng Yan..."
Li Xuan extended a hand and placed it on Feng Yan's shoulder.
Gulp!
Feng Yan swallowed hard, "The elder actually called me a young man, I'm too excited, too happy. I thought I was already old, but it turns out I'm still a young man.
"Elder, you've made me realize that I am still young, that I can still strive for more. I am truly grateful to you!"
Li Xuan gave him a look. Was this man really caving in so completely?
He was someone who knew the importance of timing.
Just as Sui Hongwu was about to persuade Feng Yan not to get angry, prioritizing the greater good, after all, being called a young man as a dignified Immortal Heavenly Venerable was a blow to his dignity.
Feng Yan was known to be hot-tempered and was bound to rage.
But what did he just hear?
Feng Yan had backed down, addressing the other as elder again and again?
For a moment, he was puzzled.
Only Feng Yan himself knew very well how his heart was trembling at that time.
That hand resting on his shoulder made him aware that, although he clearly saw the hand coming, he couldn't avoid it. What was more terrifying was that at that moment, he felt as if he was being crushed by a giant mountain, always on the verge of being squashed into a meat patty!
Too terrifying!
The strength of the person before me surpassed imagination!
Not cowering would be impossible!
Li Xuan withdrew his hand and said, "Quiet!"
"Yes, yes!"
Feng Yan stood aside quietly with the demeanor of a respectful junior.
Sui Hongwu realized something was amiss. Feng Yan actually behaved like a junior, which gave him a great shock. The person's strength must be extremely terrifying; otherwise, Feng Yan wouldn't have acted that way!
"Sui Hongwu pays respects to the senior!"
At that moment, Sui Hongwu hastily and respectfully offered his salutations.
Cheng Zhan was dumbfounded by now, even Immortal Heavenly Venerable was calling him "senior," what kind of powerful being was this?
No wonder Xu Yan said it was a minor scene.
Li Xuan nodded and looked toward the approaching mass that resembled a blood fiend storm, the Blood Slave Army, and Xuezhi Tu wielding a scarlet long knife that radiated a bloodthirsty chill.
"The power of the Blood Path may indeed allow fast advancement in strength in the initial stages, but the drawbacks are also significant. You do not follow the righteous path and instead commit such brutality. What should your crime be?" Li Xuan's voice resounded like heavenly might.
Xuezhi Tu's expression tightened slightly, then he sneered, "What drawbacks? I simply have not received the true transmission of the Blood Path. Once I have Blood Refined the Qinghua state and advanced to Blood Spirit, becoming a Blood Path Successor, how could the likes of you compare?"
"Blood Lord? You're nothing but a clown. The so-called Blood Path is nothing but a crooked and evil way!" Li Xuan spoke indifferently.
How powerful the Blood Lord was, he did not care, but that didn't stop him from showing disdain, showcasing his unmatched superiority.
Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu silently gasped. Who exactly was this senior who viewed the rumored Blood Lord of the Netherworld with such contempt, his words filled with disdain?
Xuezhi Tu was momentarily stunned, then became furious, "Insulting the Blood Lord, I will Blood Refine you for three days and three nights, making you endure the torments of this world..."
Before he could finish, Xuezhi Tu suddenly shook with shock.
As he raged, Li Xuan took a step forward and Heaven and Earth Laws stood tall between Heaven and Earth. His overwhelming might made everything else seem insignificant.
Everyone on the Flying Boat was stunned.
Even Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu, both being Immortal Heavenly Venerables, trembled. What sort of terrifying existence was this, a supremely exalted Divine Demon?
Even though they knew Li Xuan was an unequaled hermit like Wu Tianan and others, they were still shocked right now. Was this the true form of a hermit?
Though it was not the first time seeing their master employ the Heavenly Law and Earthly Phenomena Divine Technique, Xu Yan and the others were still deeply shaken upon witnessing it again.
Cheng Zhan was dumbstruck, completely at a loss.
"This is a hermit, a supreme hermit, understand?" Wu Tianan patted Cheng Zhan's shoulder and said with a sigh.
Gulp!
Cheng Zhan swallowed hard and immediately became excited. A hermit showcased his divine might, and the Qinghua state was saved!
Xuezhi Tu felt as if even the knife in his hand had gone limp, his whole body became numb, his heart and liver trembling. What kind of terrifying entity was this?
Was the Blood Lord, his senior, this fearsome?
He did not know!
"To call the Blood Lord a clown is his honor; otherwise, he would be less than an ant!" Li Xuan's voice boomed from the firmament like Splendid Heavenly Might.
Boom!
A palm descended, and in his final moment, Xuezhi Tu roared, unleashing the strongest power he had ever mustered, as blood light surged to the sky.
However, all resistance was futile.
Thunderous boom!
Xuezhi Tu and tens of thousands in the Blood Slave Army were obliterated to ashes under that palm.
The might of a single palm struck fear into Heaven and Earth!
Heaven and Earth seemed to be collapsing, vibrating, and even a black hole appeared between them as though they could not withstand the might of that palm, causing the space of Heaven and Earth to break apart.
The black hole, entwined with the Laws of Heaven and Earth, was gradually healing.
On the Flying Boat, Li Xuan sat casually in his chair, looking at the shocked expression of Feng Yan, Sui Hongwu, and the others, feeling extremely satisfied.
Let these warriors of the Divine Realm witness the divine might of unequaled hermits!
Xuezhi Tu was dead!
Tens of thousands in the Netherworld Army allowed to ashes.
A great calamity was thus easily resolved.
The hermit displayed divine might, a palm that shocked Heaven and Earth!
Even as strong as Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu were, they too trembled to the core, their scalps numbed as they looked at the ashes of Xuezhi Tu and the tens of thousands of Blood Slaves, as if in a dream.

chapters.title: Chapter 707 - 707: 374 request for a master to save my Da Yue, Heavenly Grotto is a treasure land
chapters.content:
On the flying boat, everyone was in shock, unable to recover their senses for a long time.
Jiang Buping shook his head, his blurry eyes opening to find that the injuries on his body had completely healed and even his flesh had grown stronger.
"Was someone saving me?"
He was puzzled. With injuries like his, who could have saved him?
His physical body was nearly collapsing, every piece of flesh held together by the force of the Divine Spirit Soul. Once that force was withdrawn, he would instantly collapse.
With such a terrifying injury, who could have saved him?
Who would be willing to use divine materials and treasures to help him recover?
Did the Immortal Heavenly Venerable save him?
Shaking his head and looking up, his blurry gaze froze in shock.
What was that?
A giant standing high against the heavens?
No!
That wasn't an ordinary giant, that was a Divine Demon as vast as the heavens and earth?!
"Has my Divine Soul also gone awry, for me to be seeing such hallucinations for the first time? Has the Imperishable Qi finally begun to influence my consciousness?
"Will I become befuddled, lose my intelligence, like a beast?
"Better to be dead than to live like that. Just sleep, it will all be fine if I sleep!"
Thinking thus, Jiang Buping's head tilted, his Divine Spirit Soul Force retracted, and he fell into a deep slumber.
Standing tall between heaven and earth, resembling a Divine Demon with magnificent divinity shaking the surroundings—how could such a powerful being exist? It was certainly a hallucination, mistaking a martial artist for such a figure.
Jiang Buping felt a hint of sorrow in his heart; the Imperishable Qi ultimately began to affect his consciousness. He really couldn't hold on any longer!
He felt somewhat unwilling to accept this!
With a trace of unwillingness, Jiang Buping no longer forced himself to stay awake but gave in to the feeling of drowsiness and fell into a deep sleep.
After the shock, Sui Hongwu was the first to recover his senses.
Thump!
Filled with excitement, Sui Hongwu suddenly knelt down.
"Sui Hongwu beseeches the master to save our Da Yue Country!"
Xuezhi Tu was dead.
But the turbulence in Da Yue Country had not ceased, especially in the Da Yue Abyss, which was in the midst of a fierce battle. Emperor Da Yue was tied up there, with many of Da Yue's strongholders restrained as well.
And the smaller heavenly grottoes could fall at any moment.
Only the esteemed person before them could turn the tide and save Da Yue Country!
The Qi Yun County's grotto had already been breached, although the Netherworld Army within was led out by Xuezhi Tu and was exterminated.
But people must be dispatched quickly to guard it, lest new Netherworld Warriors enter and infiltrate Qi Yun County.
"I implore the master to save our Da Yue!"
The other two True King Heavenly Venerables from Da Yue Country also hastily knelt down and respectfully spoke.
Li Xuan's gaze shifted, and since he had already taken action, what harm was there in doing so again?
After all, his knowledge of the Divine Realm was limited, and those everlasting Heavenly Venerables of Da Yue Country, especially Emperor Da Yue, were more familiar with it.
Moreover, Xu Yan, Meng Chong, and Fang Hao were eager to try their luck in the grottoes, itching for a fight.
Li Xuan also knew that it was only through combat that Xu Yan and the others could advance their martial arts more swiftly.
Moreover, inside the grottoes lay treasures and unique items from the Netherworld, essential for each breakthrough in one's realm, which would be ideal for Xu Yan and the others to gather and consolidate their foundations.
"Then let's make a trip there," Li Xuan said.
Sui Hongwu immediately rejoiced, "Many thanks to my elder!"
With the crisis in Qi Yun County resolved, there was no need to go to Prefecture City. The flying boat turned its direction, heading towards the capital city of Da Yue Country.
Due to the distance, even with the flying boat at full speed, it would take some time to reach its destination.
However, with the calamity in Qi Yun County resolved and the master of Blood Shadow Tower dead, Emperor Da Yue and other strongholders were more than capable of defending the grotto, preventing any major disaster, so there was no need for excessive haste.
Although Xuezhi Tu and the Blood Slave Army had been annihilated, Qi Yun County's grotto had been breached, and now they needed to rearrange for someone to sit in defense.
Sui Hongwu immediately ordered the two True King Heavenly Venerables from Qi Yun County to guard the grotto and to pass the message to the remaining True King Heavenly Venerables within Qi Yun County to deal with the aftermath of the calamity.
The traitorous True King Heavenly Venerables also needed to be slain one by one.
For this, Sui Hongwu apologized to Li Xuan, stating he needed to personally take care of these matters, and had Feng Yan lead the way instead.
With an Immortal Heavenly Venerable taking action, the troubles in Qi Yun County would soon subside.
The flying boat transformed into a streak of light, heading toward the capital city of Da Yue Country, where that one Netherworld Cave was located.
"This flying boat is a bit slow, and somewhat lacking," Fang Hao said with a sigh.
Limited by the materials obtained in the Spiritual Realm, the Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship was ultimately somewhat deficient and did not quite match their strength, needing an upgrade.
Now that they had arrived in the Divine Realm, they could naturally obtain all kinds of divine items and materials, capable of enhancing the ship to an extremely high level.
On the flying boat, with Feng Yan, an Immortal Heavenly Venerable present, Xu Yan and the others took the opportunity to consult Feng Yan about the Divine Realm and its various treasures.
After all, breaking through from the Divine Skill Realm to the Physiognomy Realm required much more accumulation, and higher-grade treasures were needed.
It could be imagined that the deeper one went into cultivation, the rarer and greater the number of treasures needed for foundation building, and preparations must be made early.
In addition to these, there were also discussions about the grottoes, especially the unique treasures that might be found within.
The secrets held by the Immortal Heavenly Venerables were naturally far beyond what Cheng Zhan, a True King Heavenly Venerable, could compare with.
For instance, Feng Yan knew much more about the Imperishable Heaven Cave and the Imperishable Qi.
Li Xuan paid close attention, gathering more information about the Divine Realm and the grottoes from Feng Yan, while he contemplated the Fifth Door of Martial Arts, developing the theory and techniques of the fifth Martial Arts Door.

chapters.title: Chapter 708 - 374 Seek a High Person to Save My Da Yue, The Heavenly Grotto is a Treasure Land_2
chapters.content:
Feng Yan naturally knew everything there was to know, after all, this was a disciple of a highly skilled master, and it was clear that they were new to the world with little knowledge about the Divine Realm. This was also an opportunity for him to draw closer to Xu Yan and the others.
Only by facing a high-level master could one comprehend the depth of their unfathomable abilities!
"The three great Netherworld Caves of the Qinghua state each contain a unique Divine Material called Blood Cloud Gold, which is formed from the Netherworld's blood energy seeping in over the years.
"Blood Cloud Gold can not only be forged into Divine Artifacts but also has a characteristic that allows it to be merged into one's essence blood. Once integrated into the bloodstream, it can replenish essence blood.
"It can even be nurtured with essence blood to become a Divine Artifact unique to oneself, although Blood Cloud Gold is not easy to obtain and is extremely difficult to mine.
"Blood Cloud Gold is located near the Netherworld Headquarters, and the closer it is to the core area, the higher the grade of Blood Cloud Gold that forms. Since Blood Cloud Gold is not very useful for Netherworld Warriors, it is not mined..."
As Feng Yan explained, Xu Yan and his companions' interest grew stronger and stronger.
Blood Cloud Gold was undoubtedly an extraordinary treasure, especially the characteristic of nurturing it within one's bloodstream. If refined properly or merged into one's personal weapons, it could surely yield significant benefits.
Moreover, Blood Cloud Gold was one of the treasures that could accumulate one's foundation.
According to Feng Yan, there was a considerable amount of Blood Cloud Gold in the three great Caves, but it was difficult to mine deep inside the territory guarded by the Netherworld Blood Child.
Only the Immortal Heavenly Venerable would dare to venture into them and hastily mine a piece before escaping.
Because of this, Blood Cloud Gold was an exceedingly rare treasure in the Qinghua state. After all, even the Immortal Heavenly Venerable did not dare to linger too long, and the quantity obtained each time was limited.
With Feng Yan's explanation, Xu Yan and the others sighed in their hearts, thinking the Divine Realm Warriors indeed wasted heaven's gifts! Such a rare and extraordinary treasure, and that's how they used it?
It was too crude, too simple, and did not bring out the full value of the treasure.
Besides Blood Cloud Gold, the Netherworld Caves naturally contained other treasures, but most were deep within the core of the Caves, in areas controlled by Netherworld Warriors, making them difficult to obtain.
Xu Yan and his companions grew increasingly interested in the Netherworld Caves. These were truly treasure troves. If one wanted to accumulate a foundation, just looting a few Caves could easily gather enough treasures.
Seeing Xu Yan and his companions interested in the treasures of the Divine Realm, Feng Yan did not skimp, took out his Storage Bag, and retrieved some Divine Materials and Divine Medicines he carried with him.
"Come on, little brothers, take whatever you fancy, don't be shy with your older brother here!"
Feng Yan said generously, patting his chest.
"Big brother, you, a great Immortal Heavenly Venerable, are using a Storage Bag too?"
Fang Hao looked at the Storage Bag in his hand and said with surprise.
"My Storage Bag is not like those used by True King Heavenly Venerables. It's made from a higher-grade Mountain Devourer Toad, so the space inside is much larger."
Feng Yan explained that as an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, the Storage Bag he used was naturally no ordinary item.
"Here, I'll give you this Storage Ring. Storage Bags are outdated."
Fang Hao took out a Storage Ring and handed it to him.
"Storage Ring?"
Feng Yan paused, looked at the Storage Ring he received, and muttered to himself, surprised that Storage Bags were considered outdated,
What a joke!
After Fang Hao explained the Storage Ring, Feng Yan was dubious but let his Divine Soul Force probe into it and was instantly amazed.
The small Storage Ring had an internal space that was even larger than his Storage Bag.
"You mean, by dropping blood here, a seal can be formed, and except for oneself, no one else can open it?? Unless the mark is forcibly broken?"
Feng Yan looked incredulous.
"Yes, it's a simple sealing technique, not only to prevent theft but also, should it be lost, you can use it to quickly locate its whereabouts," Fang Hao nodded.
As he spoke, Fang Hao was examining the pile of Divine Materials and Divine Medicines that Feng Yan had dumped out. All of these were excellent things.
Su Lingxiu couldn't take her eyes off the Divine Medicines.
She immediately picked up a few small bottles, opened them, and looked inside.
As Feng Yan was still amazed by the workings of the Storage Ring, he saw this and said, "These are pills made by simmering and refining various Divine Medicines. Even for an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, consuming them can heal injuries and restore vitality."
However, Su Lingxiu looked on with disdain and immense distress. These pills used such precious Divine Medicines that if she were to refine them into pills, the effect would be unimaginable and could rapidly improve one's cultivation.
"You're simply wasting heaven's gifts! Such rare Divine Medicines, and you've just rolled them into a few pills? They aren't even as good as the Life-Returning Pills I refined with Divine Spiritual Medicine!"
Su Lingxiu expressed her pain while gathering the rest of the Divine Medicines to herself.
She then took out two bottles of pills and handed them to Feng Yan, "Here, this is for you. These are Life-Returning Pills. Even for an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, eating them can quickly heal injuries.
"By the way, it's just that I refined these from Divine Spiritual Medicine."
Feng Yan looked dumbfounded. Refined from Divine Spiritual Medicine?
What are these pills?
He opened a bottle dubiously and poured out a pill into the palm of his hand. Upon seeing it, his heart trembled; his intuition told him that this pill was extraordinary in efficacy.
Unable to resist, Feng Yan swallowed the pill in one gulp.
"This... this... Is it really refined from Divine Spiritual Medicine rather than superior Divine Medicine?"
"Why would I lie to you?"
Su Lingxiu and Yue'er were sorting Feng Yan's Divine Medicines and said, "These Divine Medicines are just a waste on you. How about this—I'll use these to refine a few bottles of pills for you, and I'll keep the rest as my fee. How does that sound?"
"It's a deal! It's a deal!"
Feng Yan nodded vigorously.
Pills refined from Divine Spiritual Medicine already had such effects, so what kind of miraculous efficacy would those refined from Divine Medicine possess?
The value was beyond imagination!
Fang Hao was sifting through a pile of Divine Materials and said, "Brother Feng Yan, I'll refine a set of Inner Armor for you, and take the rest of the Divine Materials as my fee. How does that sound?"
"Inner Armor?"
Feng Yan was puzzled.
"It can be nurtured within the body and provide defense from inside out in an instant."
Fang Hao explained briefly.
Once again, Feng Yan's heart trembled, and he nodded fiercely, "Sure, sure, you can have them all!"
Inner Armor that could be nurtured within the body—what kind of Divine Artifact was that?
Cheng Zhan, standing by, was itching with curiosity. Even the Immortal Heavenly Venerable was agitated, which indicated that the pills and the like must be extremely exceptional.
At last, he couldn't resist.
He took out a Storage Bag, with a sycophantic smile he said, "I have some items here too. Would they catch your interest?"
He dumped them all out in one go, piling them up on the deck of the Flying Boat.
The items in Cheng Zhan's Storage Bag, while not as rare and high-grade as Feng Yan's, were far more abundant and varied in quantity and types.
After all, Feng Yan was an Immortal Heavenly Venerable—many treasures were of no use to him, so the ones he carried were those he needed, naturally of higher grade, but as a result, fewer in variety and quantity.
"It will do."
Fang Hao also gave him a Storage Ring.
Su Lingxiu promised him pills as well.
Thus, on the Flying Boat, Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu—one prepared for Artifact Refining, the other for Alchemy—while Yun Miaomiao, Du Yuying, and Yue'er busied themselves sorting through the items of Feng Yan and Cheng Zhan.
Watching Fang Hao refine the Inner Armor, the techniques and the mysterious methods of Artifact Refining he used left Feng Yan's eyes wide, and he couldn't help but wonder.
"It's indeed the disciple of a master; these skills are truly magical. Could this master be from that place spoken of in legends?"
Feng Yan pondered, feeling it was very likely that this master came from the place in the rumors.
Only such a legendary place could possess such extraordinary methods.
"Could it be that the Divine Realm is about to undergo a major change, and that's why the master has appeared, to deal with the changing situation? Or even, is this Domain about to face a transformation?"
Feng Yan's heart suddenly felt heavy.
If not for this reason, why would there be a powerful figure emerging from the place of legends?
On the Flying Boat, Xu Yan and others were busy, while Wu Tianan and others felt quite uncomfortable, especially people like Emperor Da Zhou, who encountered such a situation upon arriving in the Divine Realm.
Right now, they did not even know where to go next.
Should they simply settle down in the Evergreen Pavilion?
They wanted to, hoping to be close to the master for a great opportunity.
But clearly, that was unrealistic.
They could only proceed with trepidation, taking one step at a time; fearing to become cannon fodder upon entering the Upper Sect of the Divine Realm like Lord Leiyun and others.
They were profoundly uneasy.
After Fang Hao finished refining the Inner Armor for Feng Yan, he began to ponder on how to enhance the Flying Boat.
Li Xuan's mind was focused on the Daoist Golden Book. The Fifth Door of Martial Arts was finally getting perfected, and he was filled with anticipation.

chapters.title: Chapter 709 - 375 Your Majesty, a Master Has Made a Move
chapters.content:
The Capital City of Da Yue Country was under high alert, with numerous True King Heavenly Venerables patrolling in all directions. The vast city was filled with Martial Artists whose expressions were solemn, ready to respond to a potential great battle that might ensue.
Within the Capital City, there was an aura aligned with the Domain, as if it governed the piece of Domain where the Capital City was located. Any enemy attempting to invade the Capital City would not escape the owner of this aura.
To invade the Capital City, one would have to defeat the powerful being who controlled this piece of the Domain.
Although the strong being in charge of this part of the Domain of the Capital City seemed somewhat weakened, he was still an Immortal Heavenly Venerable. Even in weakness, he was not someone that Martial Artists below the Immortal Heavenly Venerables could afford to offend.
On the watchtowers of the Capital City, a group of grim-faced soldiers clad in armor watched intently at the four great mountains that encircled the city a hundred miles away.
Each of those great mountains was originally guarded by an Immortal Heavenly Venerable. However, one of them, during a battle with a Xuezhi from the Heavenly Cave, suffered a sneak attack by the master of Blood Shadow Tower and was heavily wounded, retreating back to the Capital City.
This was now the Immortal Heavenly Venerable who controlled this part of the Domain of the Capital City.
The original commander of the internal guards of the Capital City, Sui Hongwu, had launched an offense to pursue the master of Blood Shadow Tower.
This meant that there was one less Immortal Heavenly Venerable guarding the original four mountains. The grand invasion from the Heavenly Cave forced Emperor Da Yue, the strongest in Da Yue, to personally take action and guard the Heavenly Cave.
The situation in the Heavenly Cave was not yet clear.
Moreover, the incident in Qi Yun County had cast a shadow over everyone's hearts.
The situation in Da Yue Country was chaotic, almost to the point of collapse, and the Capital City seemed calm only because it had an Immortal Heavenly Venerable presiding over it.
And if the Heavenly Cave could not be held, the Capital City would be the first to be hit.
The Da Yue Abyss was one of the three great Netherworld Caves in the Qinghua state, and the Da Yue Country Capital City was built here to guard this particular cave.
The four great mountains surrounded the middle, where the Da Yue Abyss was located.
Looking down from the mountains, the entrance of the Heavenly Cave stretched for a thousand miles, and Heaven and Earth Laws, like chains, circled the mouth of the cave, preventing it from expanding further.
The entrance to the murky Heavenly Cave, which originally showed a faint blood-red light, was now engulfed in a sky full of blood light, with an aura of bloodthirstiness filling the air.
Emperor Da Yue, dressed in golden armor and wielding a Long Spear, seemed to merge with the Domain, taking control of this part of the Domain of the Heavenly Cave Entrance.
He faced off against a soft-looking young man with a pale face and seven blood-colored lines on his forehead.
In the hands of the young man, there was a crimson Long Spear, its aura cold and bloodthirsty, soaring into the sky, clashing constantly with Emperor Da Yue's momentum.
The two were locked in a stalemate.
At the Heavenly Cave Entrance, three Immortal Heavenly Venerables in armor with overbearing auras were locked in fierce combat with three bloody figures, neither side giving way or being able to overwhelm the other.
However, the sound of fighting at the entrance of the Heavenly Cave was incessant, with squads of armored Martial Artists forming military formations under the lead of various True King Heavenly Venerables, fighting against the onslaught of Blood Disciples and Blood Slaves.
The battlefield was extremely brutal, with constant casualties on both sides and endless slaying of Blood Disciples and Blood Slaves.
Blood stained the entrance of the Heavenly Cave, even turning into a rain of blood that sprinkled down into the cave.
Moreover, a force led by a peak True King Heavenly Venerable, composed entirely of Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables, had torn through the Blood Slave Army and had already penetrated into the entrance of the Heavenly Cave.
This great battle had been going on for a very long time.
The scale of this invasion by the Heavenly Cave surpassed all previous ones, and its duration was the longest. Even with the soldiers taking turns to resist, each one felt exhausted.
What worried Emperor Da Yue even more was the current situation within Da Yue Country, especially the incident in Qi Yun County, but he could not afford to address it.
The Nine Mountain Realm was also facing an onslaught from the Heavenly Cave and was temporarily unable to provide more powerful reinforcements. They could only hope that Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu would be able to contain Xuezhi Tuo and the master of Blood Shadow Tower.
Otherwise, the situation was dire!
Moreover, Emperor Da Yue could now only hope that the Myriad Thunder Sect and the Tianwu Sect would be able to spare forces to aid them.
"Xuezhi Ji, will you continue?" Emperor Da Yue asked, his gaze coldly fixed on his old foe, Xuezhi Ji!
As the strongest in the Da Yue Abyss, one could tell by the number of blood lines on his forehead that his status among the Xuezhi was not low.
Moreover, the Blood Path Method practiced by Xuezhi Ji was, it seemed, somewhat stronger.
Xuezhi Ji looked back indifferently, his voice light and laughing, "Is Da Yue in chaos? Is your heart in chaos too, Emperor Da Yue?"
Emperor Da Yue was silent.
"Emperor Da Yue, should you surrender to my Netherworld, your life may be spared. I value you highly, Xuezhi Ji. To tell you the truth, you can't hold Qinghua state," Xuezhi Ji continued.
Emperor Da Yue's expression darkened, and he let out a cold laugh, "Just with you? Xuezhi Ji, you're still lacking a little."
Boom!
With a thrust of his spear, it was as though the Heaven and Earth Laws were transformed into the spear itself, with Domain Power pouring into it. The space in this part of the Domain rippled with waves.
Boom!
Xuezhi Ji also thrust his spear, emitting an incisive blood light, the spear's glow a crimson red.
Their attacks clashed, and neither was willing to back down any longer.
Both Emperor Da Yue and Xuezhi Ji knew each other's strength very well; neither could do anything to the other.
"Emperor Da Yue, this operation was initiated by an ancient Blood Spirit. The Qinghua state, this time, you can't defend it. Don't count on any strong reinforcements, be it the Nine Mountains Realm or any other domain, they're all in chaos at the moment.
"To tell you the truth, Qinghua state is one entry point, the real entry point to invade your Domain."

chapters.title: Chapter 710 - 375 Your Majesty, a Master Has Made a Move_2
chapters.content:
"Qinghua state is doomed to fall, your world is bound to be occupied, so why defend it to the death?"
"If you surrender now, with Emperor Da Yue's abilities, your status won't be inferior to mine."
Xuezhi Ji said indifferently.
But his voice spread throughout the Heavenly Grotto, and the faces of the Martial Artists resisting the Netherworld invasion all changed slightly.
Emperor Da Yue sneered and said, "So what about the Blood Spirit? Can he pass through the Domain Barrier to come here? Since he cannot enter, no matter how strong he is, what can he do?
"This Heavenly Grotto can only accommodate one outsider with strength like yours, Xuezhi Ji. This is the limit, not even a second Xuezhi with strength comparable to yours can come here, let alone the Blood Spirit!"
The other Martial Artists engaged in the battle breathed a sigh of relief. Emperor Da Yue's words made sense—it wasn't just the Blood Spirit; even a second Xuezhi with strength comparable to Xuezhi Ji could not come.
There is an upper limit to the strength of the powerhouses that Heavenly Grotto can accommodate.
Otherwise, if two or three more Xuezhi with strength like Xuezhi Ji came, Emperor Da Yue wouldn't be able to hold on, let alone needing the Blood Spirit to make a move?
However, Xuezhi Ji laughed, "Emperor Da Yue is a sensible person, aware that the Blood Spirit cannot pass through the Domain Barrier, but what if the Blood Spirit is not coming from outside, but is born within Qinghua state?"
Emperor Da Yue scoffed and said, "Xuezhi Ji, stop trying to disturb my army's morale with your tricks, it's a poor attempt. A Blood Spirit born in my Qinghua state—let's not talk about whether it can be done, even if it can be done, how much time would that take?
"Tens of years, hundreds of years, or thousands of years?
"Do you think I will give Qinghua state such an opportunity?"
However, Emperor Da Yue's heart was not as relaxed as he sounded. He thought of Xuezhi Tu—since Xuezhi Ji said it, it could be possible.
"Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu should be able to hold him back, right?"
At this moment, Emperor Da Yue started to feel unsure.
This time, the entire Qinghua state was in great turmoil; all the Heavenly Grottoes rebelled, invading en masse, containing him and also holding back the Sect Masters of the Myriad Thunder Sect and the Tianwu Clan.
Almost all the Immortal Heavenly Venerables were constrained on the battlefield of the Heavenly Grotto.
Such actions were probably meant to create the opportunity for Xuezhi Tu to ascend as a Blood Spirit within Qinghua state!
"Although the Netherworld Blood Path refines essence blood to rapidly increase strength, it is not easy to ascend as a Blood Spirit, and it won't happen."
Emperor Da Yue consoled himself internally.
The drawbacks of the Netherworld Blood Path were also quite evident; most Blood Slaves and Blood Disciples appeared to have somewhat inflated realms, weaker within their realms compared to Divine Realm Warriors.
The number of Blood Disciples and Blood Slaves comparable to Divine Realm Warriors was not large.
Moreover, Blood Disciples and Blood Slaves in the Netherworld were akin to slaves, even material for cultivation used by stronger practitioners!
Besides, Martial Artists practicing the Netherworld Blood Path tended to be irritable and bloodthirsty, even occasionally unable to suppress impulsive emotions, possibly entering a frenzied state.
Netherworld Warriors like Xuezhi Ji, who thoroughly controlled the power of the Blood Path without being affected, were likely to belong to the Netherworld's genius level.
And, their cultivation time probably wasn't short, having settled their own strength, they were free from being inflated!
Yet, Emperor Da Yue still felt unease; a Blood Spirit that has lost control, even with chaotic consciousness, could be even more terrifying!
But now, he couldn't change anything, he could only hope for an external force to intervene and break the current situation.
A figure arrived quickly, landing next to Emperor Da Yue.
It was a True King Heavenly Venerable, and moreover, one skilled in speed, mainly responsible for messaging.
"Your Majesty, Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu are no match for Xuezhi Tu. I fear Qi Yun County may be lost..."
The person arrived panting, their voice trembling slightly.
"The Heavenly Grotto of Qi Yun County has fallen, and tens of thousands of the Blood Slave Army have invaded..."
Towards the end, the person expressed a look of fear.
Emperor Da Yue's heart sank, but his face remained expressionless. This matter could not be spread, otherwise, it would cause the morale to dissipate, and defeat was certain!
Even worse, some might despair and turn to the Netherworld!
"Evacuate everyone from outside Qi Yun County as soon as possible. Inform the Myriad Thunder and Tianwu Sects; whoever is capable of intervening, please act quickly... The Netherworld intends to create a Blood Spirit within Qinghua state.
"Prepare to go to the Realm Gate, solicit help from the other Great Realms outside the Nine Mountain Realm, and inform them of the current crisis in Qinghua state..."
Emperor Da Yue ordered telepathically.
Apart from seeking help from the Great Realms, there was no other strategy.
Emperor Da Yue just hoped that the Great Realms would have powerhouses who could spare support, and that they would be fast enough; otherwise, the consequences were unpredictable.
But the Great Realm was too far from Qinghua state, separated by the Nine Mountains Realm and others, so it was uncertain whether help could be solicited in time.
"Yes, Your Majesty!"
The Messaging True King hurried away.
Emperor Da Yue's demeanor remained calm, but his heart was somewhat in turmoil.
Less than an hour after that Messaging True King had left, he returned in a rush, his face flushed, panting heavily, his whole body trembling, and for a moment, Emperor Da Yue couldn't tell whether the man was excited or afraid.
"Your Majesty, Your Majesty..."
"Don't panic, tell me, have Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu fallen?"
Emperor Da Yue felt a heavy heart—was this person scared out of his wits?
He couldn't even speak clearly.
Could it be that Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu have fallen?
The death of two Immortal Heavenly Venerables would certainly be enough to terrify anyone.
"No, no, my liege, I have received a message from Commander Sui Hongwu. The crisis in Qi Yun County has been resolved. A master appeared and slew Xuezhi Tu and tens of thousands of Blood Slave Army with a single palm strike.
"The master, upon Commander Sui Hongwu's earnest request and under the lead of Elder Feng Yan, is now on his way to our Da Yue Abyss.
"Your Majesty, a master is coming to our aid; Xuezhi Ji is doomed!"
Towards the end, the Messaging True King became so excited that his speech turned incoherent.
Emperor Da Yue was dumbfounded.
A master?
If even an Immortal Heavenly Venerable calls someone a master, what kind of power do they possess?
He, Emperor Da Yue, one of the three great Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Qinghua state, was far from being called a master in the eyes of other Immortal Heavenly Venerables!
Even an Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Great Realm would not be referred to as a master.
Said to be a master by an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, there probably doesn't exist such a person across the entire Divine Realm.
With this thought, Emperor Da Yue even doubted whether the Messaging True King had suffered some shock and was not in his right mind.
"You say that a master struck down Xuezhi Tu and tens of thousands of Blood Slave Army with a single palm?"
Emperor Da Yue asked, frowning.
"Your Majesty, it wasn't me who said it, it was Commander Sui Hongwu!"
The Messaging True King said excitedly.
"Sui Hongwu said it was a master?"
Emperor Da Yue became even more baffled.
Sui Hongwu was the Commander of the Guard, a man of steadiness, whom he knew quite well.
He certainly wouldn't spout nonsense.
