But what kind of strength would one need to be considered a master in the eyes of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable?
In the Divine Realm's Martial Arts Realm, there is a saying: In the eyes of the Immortal, there are no masters!
Sui Hongwu must understand this principle.
"That's right, Your Majesty, we have a master coming to Qinghua state. The master is now en route to Da Yue Abyss, and Xuezhi Ji, that bastard, is as good as dead!"
The Messaging True King said both excitedly and eagerly.
He even spat in the direction of Xuezhi Ji, his eyes looking at him as if he were already dead.
Xuezhi Ji's face darkened, that ant beside Emperor Da Yue was looking down on him like this?
He lunged forward with his spear.
Emperor Da Yue frowned and, with a similar spear thrust, blocked Xuezhi Ji's attack.
Looking towards the Messaging True King, he took a deep breath and said, "I am very much looking forward to seeing just how high the status of this master Commander Sui Hongwu speaks of really is, and in what way they are so high!"
Emperor Da Yue found the whole thing absurd and laughable. Who could be considered a master in the eyes of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable?
"Very high, incredibly high, as high as the heavens and earth, Your Majesty!"
The Messaging True King, caught up in his excitement, didn't pick up on Emperor Da Yue's tone and nodded vigorously.
Emperor Da Yue's expression darkened.
Taking a deep breath, he asked, "Then when can this so-called master arrive?"
Regardless of whether the person was a true master, at least it would be a strong reinforcement that could break the current deadlock, and Emperor Da Yue valued that highly.
"Your Majesty, they will arrive within three days at most!"
The Messaging True King replied.
"Now that the crisis in Qi Yun County has been resolved, send a message to Sui Hongwu and have him personally take action and suppress all the unrest in the abyss."
Emperor Da Yue said with a grave voice.
Now that an Immortal Heavenly Venerable powerhouse was freed up, it was the perfect time to patrol Da Yue and quell the chaotic abyss. This way, all regions of Da Yue would be calm and stable for a long time, allowing for a period of recovery and rejuvenation.
"Yes, Your Majesty!"
The Messaging True King hurried off.
Emperor Da Yue's gaze was profound, filled with anticipation.
"Let me see just who you are, to be called a master in front of the Immortal!"
Emperor Da Yue was very curious about the mysterious strong individual who had used some means to be called a master by Sui Hongwu!
Their strength must be formidable, and shouldn't be weaker than his own, right?
Emperor Da Yue thought to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 711 - 376: The Arrival of a Master, The Shocked Emperor Da Yue
chapters.content:
Although Emperor Da Yue was skeptical about the notion of a superior being, he felt relieved inside. The intervention of a powerful figure potentially as strong as himself had resulted in the slaying of Xuezhi Tu, thwarting the schemes of the Netherworld.
Moreover, it had also lifted the immediate crisis facing Da Yue.
Yet, Emperor Da Yue still harbored some doubts. How could someone kill Xuezhi Tu with a single palm strike, annihilating tens of thousands of Blood Slave Army?
Even he couldn't achieve such a feat.
According to earlier reports, the combined efforts of Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu were not sufficient to defeat Xuezhi Tu. Hence, estimating Xuezhi Tu's strength, he shouldn't be much weaker than himself.
Despite that, he was obliterated by that mysterious strongman with a single palm strike?
"That palm strike must have been his killing move, a full-strength attack, maybe even at a slight cost? Coupled with Xuezhi Tu's underestimation of the enemy, that's how he was killed with one blow."
Emperor Da Yue was confident that his guess was very close to the truth.
Feng Yan and Sui Hongwu didn't know the real circumstances, truly believing that the strongman had casually killed Xuezhi Tu, hence they mistook him for a senior expert?
"I must thank this brother who intervened to save us. His killing of Xuezhi Tu must have come at a cost. I should prepare some divine treasures as a token of gratitude."
Emperor Da Yue made up his mind.
Learning that the crisis in Qi Yun County was averted and Xuezhi Tu was killed, nullifying the plot of the Netherworld, he felt a weight lifted from his shoulders.
Looking at Xuezhi Ji, he revealed a smile.
"Xuezhi Ji, all your meticulous plotting in the Netherworld is inevitably in vain. What you call, 'the birth of a Blood Spirit in the Qinghua state', was it relying on that Xuezhi Tu who sneaked in?
"He did reach the first step, advancing to Xuezhi, and his strength was not weak, but alas, we have masters in Qinghua state!"
Despite not truly considering the intervening strongman as a master, it didn't stop him from using it to intimidate Xuezhi Ji, instilling wariness in the Netherworld to deter any rash actions, all to gain a period of peace for the Heavenly Grotto.
Xuezhi Ji frowned, "A master?"
With a sneer, he said, "I, Xuezhi Ji, have also heard a saying in the Divine Realm, 'To the Immortal, there are no masters.' Do you dare to claim there are masters in Qinghua state?"
Emperor Da Yue calmly replied, "Even the Immortal refers to masters; you should know how powerful a true master is."
He then revealed a pleased smile and continued, "Xuezhi Tu is dead! A master killed him with one slap."
As he spoke, he raised his hand, mimicking the action of swatting a fly, and said mockingly, "Just like this, a snap, and he's gone!"
Xuezhi Ji's eyebrows furrowed, half-believing and half-doubting. Xuezhi Tu was dead?
This major operation was specifically for coordinating with Xuezhi Tu, allowing him to ascend to Xuezhi within Qinghua state and then advance to Blood Spirit.
If Xuezhi Tu was dead, then all their planning was for naught.
However, Xuezhi Ji suddenly laughed, looking at Emperor Da Yue, "Emperor Da Yue, since Xuezhi Tu has successfully ascended to Xuezhi, with your current strength in Qinghua state, who could kill him?
"You, Emperor Da Yue, are unable to intervene, and neither Wan Lei nor Tianwu can take action. Moreover, once he ascends to Xuezhi, his strength won't be much weaker than yours.
"The more Blood Refining is carried out, the stronger he becomes, and he's even likely to surpass me very soon. Emperor Da Yue, if you're trying to disrupt my thoughts and deceive me to end this battle, don't waste your efforts."
Xuezhi Ji suddenly realized, the idea of a master intervening and killing Xuezhi Tu with a slap was utterly impossible.
Emperor Da Yue simply wanted to deceive him into standing down so that he could deal with the crisis in Da Yue.
But Emperor Da Yue just laughed with a relaxed expression, "Believe it or not, that's up to you. Indeed, Xuezhi Tu is dead. Why would I lie to you? This place, the Abyss, will soon be suppressed, and you, Xuezhi Ji, will definitely die without question."
Xuezhi Ji's brows furrowed tighter. The demeanor of Emperor Da Yue seemed genuinely relaxed, as if the crisis in Da Yue had already been lifted.
"Failed? Truly dead? Could it be, there really is another powerful figure in Qinghua realm?"
Xuezhi Ji pondered in his heart.
If Xuezhi Tu was indeed dead, this was no trivial matter. Not only would the Netherworld's plan come to naught, but a certain someone would also become extremely angry over this.
A great war was inevitable, and once it began, it would be on a scale far beyond what was currently unfolding.
Xuezhi Tu had been conferred the name Tuo before he even ascended to Xuezhi, indicating his exceptional standing in the Netherworld and the opportunity he had to become a true Blood Path Successor.
Xuezhi Ji, frowning, transmitted this message back to the depths of the Abyss, and from there back to the Netherworld. Regardless of whether it was true, it was news related to Xuezhi Tu.
He decided to use Emperor Da Yue's claim, that a master had killed him.
The standoff and battle within Da Yue Abyss continued unabated and even intensified to a fierce degree.
The sounds of combat echoed throughout the Abyss.
And deep within the Abyss, a dense surge of Blood Spirit energy billowed out like waves of blood mist gushing forth incessantly.
Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Ship soared through the skies like a streak of light. Feng Yan and Cheng Zhan, one an Immortal Heavenly Venerable and the other a True King Heavenly Venerable, looked on with the awe of country bumpkins, full of curiosity as Fang Hao modified and upgraded the ship.
Ever since donning the Inner Armor refined by Fang Hao, Feng Yan was greatly excited. This Inner Armor was truly miraculous, nurtured within the body, actively providing protection when attacked.
If one were ambushed, this Inner Armor alone could save one's life.
Moreover, this piece doubled his defensive capabilities, and Feng Yan even felt that had he had this armor during his confrontation with Xuezhi Tu, he wouldn't have been beaten so disgracefully.
As Fang Hao worked on the ship's transformation and upgrades, he mused that the Divine Realm was indeed more prosperous in Martial Arts; the quality of these Divine Materials far surpassed that of the Spiritual Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 712 - 376 The Arrival of the Sage, The Shocked Emperor Da Yue_2
chapters.content:
The Divine Materials brought by the Immortal Heavenly Venerable were of even higher grade. Used for refining Divine Artifacts, their power would be significantly stronger.
If the transformation were completed, the Evergreen Pavilion's Flying Boat would see a substantial enhancement in speed, defense, and even stealth capabilities, far surpassing its performance before the modification.
It would indeed qualify as an exceptional Divine Artifact.
At this moment, Li Xuan was composing the Fifth Door of Martial Arts. The theoretical framework had already been established, and the Martial Arts Cultivation Methods were nearly complete.
This set of Martial Arts was specifically tailored for Jiang Buping.
It would perfectly match his unique talents, leaving no worry that he couldn't cultivate it.
The only difficulty lay in the Imperishable Qi within Jiang Buping's Divine Soul.
Integrating the Imperishable Qi completely into the Divine Soul, making it a part of the soul, was an extremely difficult task.
And once successful, it would signify that Jiang Buping had undergone a complete transformation, indeed turning misfortune into a blessing and achieving a perfect fit with the Fifth Door of Martial Arts.
Therefore, Li Xuan was now devoting most of his energy to how to integrate this strand of Imperishable Qi into the Divine Soul to transform it entirely.
"The Imperishable Qi is difficult to refine, but Jiang Buping's Divine Soul, tainted by the Imperishable Qi, did not lose its spiritual wisdom. This indicates that his soul is inherently special,"
"The Imperishable Qi might not only be usuable once refined. For instance, it could be used for cultivating Divine Skills... In which case, let's integrate the Imperishable Qi through Divine Skill Techniques."
"Once merged with the Imperishable Qi, there will no longer be issues affecting the spiritual consciousness after the soul's transformation. Such a transformed Divine Soul could be referred to as the Imperishable Divine Soul."
"With this foundation, Jiang Buping will also be able to slowly absorb Imperishable Qi in the future to cultivate his Divine Soul and practice the Fifth Door of Martial Arts."
Li Xuan had found the method to integrate this thread of Imperishable Qi.
It is well-known that Imperishable Qi cannot be used for cultivation.
But, if Jiang Buping succeeded, it would mean that the Fifth Door of Martial Arts could incorporate some Imperishable Qi for cultivation.
Even more, by extension, other forms of Martial Arts might also discover ways to utilize Imperishable Qi to enhance one's strength.
After a long journey, the Flying Boat finally arrived at the Capital City of Da Yue Country.
"That is where the Da Yue Abyss is located."
Feng Yan pointed towards the land surrounded by four grand mountains.
The Flying Boat turned into a streak of light, flying straight toward the Da Yue Abyss.
Xu Yan and the others were instantly invigorated, showing excitement at the prospect of finally seeing one of the three great Heavenly Caves of the Qinghua state.
Meng Chong was rubbing his hands together eagerly, saying, "Are there truly many treasures inside the Heavenly Cave? It must be in the midst of a great battle, how exciting."
Feng Yan had no choice but to remind them, "The battles within the Da Yue Abyss are intense. Even Heavenly Venerables and True Kings may fall at any moment, and there is more than one Xuezhi."
"Xuezhi Ji, the one presiding over the Da Yue Abyss, has a strength that rivals Emperor Da Yue. You young brothers should be careful!"
Meng Chong nodded, his face showing a hint of regret. After all, his own strength was too weak.
Feng Yan swiftly moved towards the Da Yue Abyss, shouting, "Emperor Da Yue, a noble guest has arrived!"
His voice thundered like rolling thunder, spreading towards the Da Yue Abyss and even suppressing the clamor of the battle below.
This was the authority of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
Emperor Da Yue's eyebrows lifted slightly, and then his face turned somewhat dark. What was Feng Yan up to?
A noble guest?
You are an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, after all. Even if you wanted to elevate the other party's status, wasn't this a bit much?
Now, Emperor Da Yue felt somewhat awkward. How should he receive this visitor?
To call out a welcome to the noble guest?
Does Emperor Da Yue have no face to save?
Xuezhi Ji revealed a sneer, "A noble guest? Laughable. I would like to see what sort of noble guest this is!"
A streak of light approached the entrance of the Heavenly Cave. The massive Flying Boat began to descend.
Emperor Da Yue looked surprised. What kind of Divine Artifact was this?
Meanwhile, aboard the Flying Boat, Xu Yan and the others gazed at the imposing entrance of the Heavenly Cave and the fierce battle, all quite taken aback.
It was their first time witnessing such a grand battle of Martial Artists.
"Thank you, senior, for resolving Da Yue's crisis, and thank you for coming to the rescue!"
In the end, Emperor Da Yue gritted his teeth and addressed the other as a senior.
To call someone a senior after resolving the crisis of Da Yue Country was not excessive!
"Hmm,"
Li Xuan responded indifferently.
Curiosity showed in his eyes as he stood up, looking down from above.
At first glance, he noticed Emperor Da Yue.
Very strong!
Then he saw Xuezhi Ji, who was confronting Emperor Da Yue, also immensely powerful.
But, to him, neither posed much of a challenge.
The Void-breaking Realm had the capability to penetrate the spaces of heaven and earth, naturally allowing one to break through the Domain Power handled by an Immortal Heavenly Venerable. In a sense, the Martial Arts power of the Void-breaking Realm was more domineering and even had the ability to counter the unified power of heaven and earth.
"Is this the master?"
Emperor Da Yue's face was full of curiosity. How could he appear so ordinary and unremarkable?
"Very strong!"
A chill settled in his heart. The stronger someone was, the more unremarkable they seemed, and it meant he couldn't fathom their real strength, implying that their power might very well surpass his own.
"Haha, so you're the so-called master? The one who killed Xuezhi Tuo?"
Xuezhi Ji's face was filled with scorn.
The crimson long spear was raised, its sharp edge pointing towards the flying boat, towards Li Xuan.
"Xuezhi Tuo, did you truly kill him?"
Li Xuan's gaze was indifferent. It was time for him to make a move again, to fully display the demeanor of a master.
"It's also time to educate my disciples once more."
Li Xuan muttered to himself that the last time he taught by word and example was in the Inner Domain, where he had pushed through all opposition in the same realm with an invincible stance.
Ignoring Xuezhi Ji completely, he turned towards Xu Yan and his four disciples, "Watch closely. Today, your master will teach you once again how to overpower an enemy and how to utilize Divine Skills!"
Upon hearing this, Xu Yan and his fellow disciples became excited.
"Yes, Master!"
Xuezhi Ji, feeling ignored, flew into a rage. The crimson long spear burst forth with a cold and piercing light, filled with a murderous intent, while from the depths of the Heavenly Grotto, a surge of blood-red light flowed toward him, merging into his body.
Emperor Da Yue's expression grew tense; Xuezhi Ji was going to strike with all his might.
"Let's see how capable you really are!"
With an angry roar, Xuezhi Ji's figure leaped into the air, his spear aimed directly at the flying boat.
Just as Emperor Da Yue was about to intervene, Li Xuan took a step off the boat.
"Noise!"
With a slap, a thunderous boom resounded, and a pitch-black void appeared as if his palm had pierced through the space of the Domain.
Smack!
With a single palm strike, a look of terror surfaced on the face of the incoming Xuezhi Ji, who didn't have the slightest power to resist and was dissipated into a mist of blood.
At this moment, Emperor Da Yue's heart quivered, his lips trembling, and he almost threw the long spear in his hands.
At this moment, he didn't know whether the trembling in his heart was due to the joy or the plain fear.
Xuezhi Ji, an old rival, whom he had fought countless times, neither able to best the other.
And then!
A single slap, and he was dead!
Just like a fly, casually swatted dead by a palm.
That very palm that killed Xuezhi Ji could just as easily kill him as well.
Master!
This is what a real master looks like!
The hand holding the spear shook slightly as Emperor Da Yue gazed at Li Xuan, who looked as calm as if he'd just swatted an annoying fly. A sense of worship began to well up within him.
What nonsense about 'there are no masters in the eyes of the Immortal', bullshit! That's because they haven't seen a true master!
Inside the Da Yue Abyss, the sound of combat fell silent as the Immortal Heavenly Venerables from Da Yue were all stunned.
Xuezhi Ji is dead?!
The Xuezhi from the Netherworld side turned pale and began to flee toward the depths of the Heavenly Grotto.
"This is the Great Sky Hand!"
Xu Yan murmured to himself, realizing that the Great Sky Hand could be wielded in such a manner!
Boom!
In the next moment, a mysterious aura surged around Li Xuan as he stood tall like a mountain, with the force of wind and thunder in his hand, and a golden giant dragon coiling around him.
The configuration of the Domain Qimen was unleashed in an instant, and with a single thought, it seemed as if Divine Skills formed a formation, with a Divine Furnace capable of smelting all creation, and in one step he descended into the Da Yue Abyss.
Boom!
"Physical Body Martial Arts Divine Skill, Qimen Martial Arts Divine Skill, Alchemical Medical Martial Arts Divine Skill..."
Xu Yan and the others looked shocked.
This was the first time they had seen their master simultaneously use four types of Martial Arts Divine Skills, truly powerful beyond imagination.
Moreover, the master's Divine Skills were effortlessly integrated and transformed, something they were far from able to achieve.
Emperor Da Yue and the others were utterly astounded.
What kind of Martial Arts was this?
Too powerful, too terrifying, especially that fleeting, unfathomable, and elusive aura from the master.
"This is a true master indeed!"
Emperor Da Yue's lips quivered as he muttered to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 713 - 377: Flattening the Heavenly Grotto, Ingenious Use of Formations
chapters.content:
Li Xuan displayed several of his Divine Skills simultaneously, their magnificent might shocking all directions. The Xuezhi, Blood Disciples, and Blood Slaves in Da Yue Abyss were all stunned at this moment.
Facing the Qinghua state in battle and standoff for countless years, when had they ever seen such a terrifyingly strong figure?
Especially a few of the Xuezhi, who already had pale faces, were now even paler and even trembling all over.
It was truly because the aura that Li Xuan displayed at this moment was too astonishing and unconventional.
"Xuezhi Ji, his strength is indeed not weak. I also used quite a bit of strength to kill him with one palm."
Li Xuan sighed in his heart.
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable was indeed very strong.
However, he was stronger, after all, whether it was Divine Skills or his physical body, all had been augmented a hundredfold.
"Watch carefully, what are Divine Skills. As your master, I will only make one move!"
Li Xuan's voice resounded as if it carried the might of heaven itself.
"Yes, Master!"
Xu Yan and the others were extremely excited, watching intensely and fixedly staring at their master down below, whose presence was as solid as Da Yue and whose hands commanded the wind and thunder... their master surrounded by Divine Skills.
Li Xuan took a step forward, looking down at the several Xuezhi and crowds of Blood Disciples preparing to escape. He raised his hand and swept it down, unleashing Divine Skills.
Boom!
At this moment, Emperor Da Yue and all other Da Yue Martial Artists stared wide-eyed in horror.
Da Yue Abyss, which had been guarded for long years, was now trembling and shaking, the blood fiend rolling through it suddenly overwhelmed by the magnificent might.
The blood fiend seemed to have evaporated, that terrifying power directly engulfing the Xuezhi, Blood Disciples, and Blood Slaves within it.
One could see the violent storm and thunder, a Golden Giant Dragon sweeping across, and even more so magical forces surging and arranging, purifying the vast blood fiend Qi.
And there was a terror like a gigantic furnace, melting everything into nothingness.
In their lives, they had never seen such a terrifying application of Martial Arts Techniques.
"Divine Skills?"
Emperor Da Yue murmured to himself.
In this moment, he felt, as if in a trance, the great power and wonder contained within the word "Divine Skills"!
On the Flying Boat, everyone was in a state of shock.
Exactly how strong the superior figure was remained a mystery.
For Wu Tianan and the others, this was an existence that transcended the domain of heaven and earth. What they were witnessing was just a Divine Skill casually displayed by the superior figure to instruct his disciples.
Probably not even one ten-thousandth of his strength had been used.
Feng Yan and Cheng Zhan were presently completely stunned.
The superior figure's elimination of Xuezhi Tu had been shocking enough.
But now, suppressing the Abyss revealed an even more terrifying might.
Of course, they also knew that the superior figure did not use his real strength.
Otherwise, if the Divine Demon Body that was used to exterminate Xuezhi Tu had been displayed, it would probably have directly burst the Da Yue Abyss, right?
Perhaps, precisely because of this, the superior figure did not reveal his Divine Demon-like body.
After Li Xuan made his move, he returned to the Flying Boat and sat leisurely in his chair.
Meanwhile, Da Yue Abyss, which had been crowded with Xuezhi, Blood Disciples, and Blood Slaves, was now empty, and even the thick blood fiend Qi had faded away.
"This is the true way to use Divine Skills, I still have much to learn," Xu Yan remarked, coming back to his senses and sighing.
"Mmm!"
Meng Chong, Su Lingxiu, Fang Hao, all nodded in agreement.
Just waking up and shaking his head, Jiang Buping, whose eyes were still bleary, also witnessed the scene and was utterly astonished.
"It's done for, the Imperishable Qi is affecting my consciousness more and more severely. I'll sleep a bit longer and hope that next time I wake up, I can be a bit more normal," he muttered to himself before his head tilted and he continued to fall asleep.
The Heavenly Cave was silent and still.
Emperor Da Yue looked shocked, unable to recover for a long time, while the rest of the Da Yue Martial Artists were completely petrified, lost in the magnificent scene, unable to extricate themselves.
"Go into the cave and scavenge for Blood Cloud Gold, plunder the treasures of the Abyss!" Su Lingxiu said excitedly.
This Abyss, their master had conquered, and its spoils of war, of course, belonged to the master. But the master did not care about these things, so these spoils of war all belonged to the disciples.
The Flying Boat turned into a streak of light, entering Da Yue Abyss.
After the Flying Boat entered the Abyss, Emperor Da Yue and the other mighty warriors finally came back to their senses and became immensely excited.
Today, Da Yue Abyss was to be leveled.
"Let's go, follow me into the Abyss, in one effort we will level this Heavenly Cave and thank the superior figure for helping our Da Yue eradicate the Abyss," Emperor Da Yue said invigoratingly.
He ordered one of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables to return and take charge of Capital City, while the rest of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables, along with a group of True King Heavenly Venerables, followed him into Da Yue Abyss to thoroughly exterminate the Netherworld Warriors within the cave.
The majority of the Netherworld Warriors stationed around the Heavenly Cave Entrance held the bulk of the Abyss, but there were still Netherworld Warriors and even Xuezhi remaining in the depths of the cave.
But they were no longer fearful, with the current strength of Da Yue Country sufficient to wipe them out and level the Abyss.
The Flying Boat entered Da Yue Abyss and looked as if it had entered a small world.
The Heavenly Caves that appeared in the Spiritual Realm, by comparison, were worlds apart.
"This is a true Heavenly Cave," Xu Yan sighed.
Meng Chong and the others all nodded in agreement.
The walls of the cave were grayish, but inside the Abyss, there was a faint red glow, with strands of blood fiend Qi wafting through. Even the ground was painted with a layer of blood as if stained with fresh blood.
The Netherworld Blood Disciples and Blood Slaves around the entrance had all been annihilated, so once the Flying Boat entered, they saw no sign of any Blood Disciples or Blood Slaves.
The Flying Boat headed directly for the deeper parts of the Abyss.
Boom!
A blood light surged from the depths of the cave, powerful in momentum, belonging to a Xuezhi.

chapters.title: Chapter 714 - 377 Clearing the Heavenly Grotto, Ingenious Use of Formations_2
chapters.content:
Clearly, this was a Xuezhi left behind by the Netherworld forces, sensing the changes at the Heavenly Cave Entrance and thus coming to investigate.
"I will go and meet him!"
Feng Yan's figure moved and he went straight up to his opponent.
Behind him, several people from the Emperor Da Yue's party had also arrived.
"Thank you, master, for resolving the great peril facing Da Yue!"
Emperor Da Yue said respectfully as he performed a ceremonial bow.
"Hmm!"
Li Xuan nodded indifferently.
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable who had come with Emperor Da Yue immediately stepped forward to join Feng Yan in encircling and attacking the Xuezhi.
"Senior, we wish to eradicate the Netherworld Nest. May we proceed?"
Emperor Da Yue asked with respect.
"Go ahead!"
Li Xuan nodded.
"Thank you, senior!"
Emperor Da Yue sighed in relief and then instructed the True King Heavenly Venerables behind him, "Go, exterminate the Netherworld fiends. Do not take any treasures from the Heavenly Cave, understand?"
"Yes, Your Majesty!"
The True King Heavenly Venerables replied respectfully.
As the True King Heavenly Venerables, led by an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, marched mightily towards the depths of the Heavenly Cave, it signified that this area of the Heavenly Cave was about to be cleared.
While Emperor Da Yue took part in the attack on the Xuezhi, wielding his spear. With Emperor Da Yue taking action, the Xuezhi could not hold out for long before being killed by a thrust of Emperor Da Yue's spear.
He respectfully presented the items carried by the Xuezhi on board the Flying Boat.
Looking at the master sitting leisurely in his chair, Emperor Da Yue speculated, "The senior must surely come from that legendary place. If that's the case, what Xuezhi Ji said is probably true, they desire to invade the Qinghua state.
"It must be because this senior has seen through the Netherworld's schemes that he appears in the Qinghua state."
Li Xuan looked over and said, "Emperor Da Yue? Tell me about this Heavenly Cave."
The Da Yue Abyss was significantly different from the Heavenly Caves that appeared in the Spiritual Realm, with soil, plants, and the essence of the Heaven and Earth Laws, giving the impression that a small world or a minor celestial realm had been carved out within this space of the Domain.
The Domain Barrier was not at the bottom of the Heavenly Cave, but rather above it, like the sky above the cave, with a faint barrier impeding passage.
Li Xuan sensed the presence of the Dao Principles within it.
"Senior, you can just call me Da Yue!"
Emperor Da Yue quickly said.
He then began to introduce this Heavenly Cave.
According to Emperor Da Yue, this Heavenly Cave was of ancient origin, existing even before he became a Martial Artist and founded the Da Yue Dynasty.
"There are legends that a cosmic catastrophe once occurred, and afterwards, the cave holes of Heaven and Earth began to appear. Initially, there were no invaders, it was only later that the invaders discovered the Heavenly Cave and hence wanted to infiltrate this Domain.
"According to the records, when the Heavenly Cave first appeared, some Martial Artists attempted to explore it and even tried to use it to peer beyond the heavens, but none succeeded.
"Only when extraterrestrial enemies invaded did we realize that the Heavenly Cave could be entered from the outside but could not be departed from within...no, that's not exactly right. It's that the living creatures of this Domain could not leave.
"The objective of the extraterrestrial invaders was to occupy this Domain, to plunder the essence of the living beings of this Domain... they created countless disasters.
"Later on, defending the Heavenly Caves became an inevitable responsibility for the Divine Realm Warriors, and over time, more and more Heavenly Caves appeared, as if the Domain was continuously developing holes.
"The entire Qinghua state, with its three largest and most ancient Heavenly Caves..."
Li Xuan listened silently as Emperor Da Yue described.
According to Emperor Da Yue, this Domain had once experienced a cosmic catastrophe, but precisely what the catastrophe was, he did not know.
The appearance of the Heavenly Cave was after the catastrophe, while the invasion of extraterrestrial enemies through the Heavenly Cave happened later.
"...It is said that the Netherworld is also a Domain, desiring to swallow the Domain we inhabit. The Heavenly Caves of the Qinghua state are all Netherworld Caves, facing the invasion of the Netherworld creatures.
"As for detailed information, we do not know, as what lies beyond the Domain, not even the Immortal Heavenly Venerables, are capable of exploring."
Emperor Da Yue said with a sigh.
While the Immortal Heavenly Venerables are mighty, as enduring as the heavens themselves, they cannot leave this Domain, nor explore beyond it. They are, ultimately, restricted.
In the end, he looked towards the senior.
"Sage, do you know of the matters beyond the heavens and earth?"
It was the same for Xu Yan and the others. Their master, who transcended the heavens and earth, surely knew better than anyone else what lay beyond, right?
Li Xuan, the ever-calm deity, replied indifferently, "As for what lies beyond the heavens and earth, you will know once your realm is sufficient. If your realm is inadequate, such knowledge is of no benefit."
A sage, of course, knows everything. The reason he does not tell you is that you are too weak; even if you knew, it would be of no use.
The Emperor Da Yue thought to himself that this was indeed characteristic of a true sage, to know the matters beyond the heavens and earth.
He then continued to talk about the Da Yue Abyss, the great battles fought by generations defending it, when the Xuezhi Ji and other Xuezhi appeared, and the disasters they created, and so on.
"Now, although the enemies from the Netherworld within the Abyss have been wiped out, it is impossible to prevent the invasion of the Netherworld. They will surely send stronger beings to try to take over this Heavenly Cave as a foothold for invading the Domain," said the Emperor Da Yue, somewhat helplessly.
"The strength that the Heavenly Cave can withstand is limited. Currently, the strongest invader that can enter is only on the level of Xuezhi Ji."
That was also the reason why Da Yue Country could hold the Heavenly Cave.
If a Blood Spirit expert came, it would be enough to crush the Qinghua state.
Upon hearing this, Li Xuan nodded. Indeed, as he had expected, the extraterrestrial invaders were ultimately limited by the Domain Barrier. Those with too much power could not enter.
And for a Netherworld powerhouse like Xuezhi Ji, to him, it was but a slap's effort and thus not a concern.
As for Blood Spirit-level experts, regardless of their power, they could not enter this Domain, so there was no point in discussing a threat.
"Emperor Da Yue, one can set up a Great Formation inside the Heavenly Cave to guard the entrance. To enter, one must break through the Formation. And with an Immortal Heavenly Venerable presiding over and seated within the Great Formation, even enemies at the level of Xuezhi Ji cannot break in," Fang Hao suggested enthusiastically after listening to the Emperor Da Yue.
"Moreover, with the Great Formation as an obstacle, once a strong enemy is detected, reinforcements can come before the Great Formation is breached, continuing to fend off the enemy outside of the Heavenly Cave."
Fang Hao could not help but speak out after listening to the Emperor Da Yue's account.
The Heavenly Cave was the perfect place to set up a Great Formation to thwart enemy invasions. Moreover, one could arrange one Formation after another to trap and annihilate the invading enemies.
Furthermore, Defensive Formations could also be set up in the city, and with them, it was possible to use the Formations to resist strong enemies despite being at a disadvantage and to buy time for strong reinforcements to arrive.
"What is a Formation?" asked the Emperor Da Yue in confusion.
After Fang Hao explained, the Emperor Da Yue's face was painted with shock. Was there truly such a profound and mysterious art?
"The Formation Path is one of the arts within the Qimen Martial Art I practice. It cannot be explained clearly in just a few words. Let me demonstrate, and then you will understand," said Fang Hao, his demeanor slightly exhilarated. He had suddenly realized that the Qimen Martial Art would once again demonstrate its divine prowess in the Divine Realm, especially in guarding the Heavenly Cave.
"Your Majesty, the enemies from the Netherworld have all been exterminated!" reported the Messaging True King at that moment.
"Good!"
The Emperor Da Yue nodded with great joy.
The speed of the Flying Boat increased sharply, and in an instant, they arrived at the core of the Heavenly Cave. What met their eyes was a sea of bloodred, and especially above, there seemed to be a layer of blood membrane covering it, with blood light pervading down.
"The enemies from the Netherworld, especially those of the Xuezhi Realm, all enter the Heavenly Cave and invade this Domain from here," the Emperor Da Yue pointed up to the place covered by a blood membrane.
Fang Hao nodded and directed, "Watch carefully as I demonstrate what a Formation is!"
With a sweeping glance, he saw that the core of the Heavenly Cave was not lacking in blood essence gold and other materials. So, he waved his hand, calling over materials one by one.
Boom!
An Artifact Refining furnace emerged, with Fang Hao refining Formation tools on the spot.
The tools refined from materials of the Divine Realm were more durable, and the Formations set up with them were stronger.
Finally, the Formation tools were ready. Fang Hao waved his hand grandly, a flurry of lights soared up, landing in all directions, with eight small banners shooting upward and settling on the layer of the blood membrane.
"Emperor Da Yue, observe carefully. What I'm setting up now is the Eight Directions Banning Locking Spirit Formation," said Fang Hao.
With a thunderous boom, the Formation activated, and a mystical light emerged. In just a flash, phoenix fire surged, and chains crisscrossed. Within moments, the invasion point of the Netherworld was completely sealed within the Formation.
The Emperor Da Yue was astounded by the mysterious power of the Formation. Although the sealing power of this Formation did not seem very strong, it was hastily set up after all.
Moreover, to be able to block for a while was enough to gain much time, enough to turn the tide of battle.
"Brother Fang, Da Yue wishes to appoint you as the State Preceptor, to help Da Yue resist the Netherworld enemies, and to aid the Qinghua state in fending off the Netherworld threat!" said the Emperor Da Yue with formal gratitude.

chapters.title: Chapter 715 - 378: Cooperation Conditions, Passing on the Divine Skill Technique
chapters.content:
Fang Hao revealed the marvelous uses of formation at this moment, naturally with a purpose.
The further one advanced in cultivation, the more resources were needed, especially since he was cultivating the Qimen Martial Art. Whether it was upgrading the Qimen Armory, refining artifacts, or practicing formations, all required a vast consumption of resources.
In the early stages, it all depended on contributions from the eldest and second senior brothers. Now that he had the strength, it was time for him to earn his own resources for cultivation.
And in the Divine Realm, there was a shortage of formations, for defending the Heavenly Grotto and repelling foreign enemies, the ingenious use of formations was undoubtedly evident.
Thus, he could obtain a continuous supply of cultivation resources, constantly delving into the study of artifact refining and formations without worrying about depleting those resources.
With such an enormous supply of resources and continuous study of various artifact refining and formation techniques, the speed of his strength improvement and the enhancement of his knowledge in formations would all enter a rapid growth phase.
The cultivation of Qimen Martial Art, which involved artifact refining and formations, consumed far more resources than Pure Martial Arts or Physical Body Martial Arts.
Now was the opportunity.
Li Xuan nodded silently. After going through the trials of the Wanshi Alliance, Fang Hao had also grown shrewd, knowing how to seize the moment to pave the way for his future cultivation.
The Way of the Array, even if it spread out, it was not necessarily a bad thing.
In the end, the one who benefited was him.
Xu Yan and Meng Chong, both had their own paths, knowing how to lay the groundwork for their own cultivation. Soon, both would leave to venture into the Qinghua state and the Divine Realm.
Whether it was Pure Martial Arts or Physical Body Martial Arts, in the refining process, in combat, while traversing the domain, one could better comprehend the true essence of Martial Arts.
Just like Xu Yan in the Spiritual Realm, traveling far and wide, his Martial Arts progressed by leaps and bounds.
In the Divine Realm, he would certainly follow this path, and it was the right one.
Fang Hao's cultivation depended entirely on the provision of resources, allowing him to exhibit the subtleties of Qimen Martial Art to the fullest, delving into Qimen, formations, artifact refining, prohibitions, and so on.
In the Spiritual Realm, with the massive resources provided by the Wanshi Alliance, this was why Fang Hao could improve so rapidly.
It was the same for Su Lingxiu, except she was into alchemy and healing.
"Becoming the State Preceptor isn't out of the question, but I have a few conditions..."
Fang Hao said with a smile.
"Please speak, young brother!"
Emperor Da Yue said joyfully.
"The conditions are quite simple. The Formation Path ultimately requires a fair amount of materials..."
Fang Hao stated each of his conditions.
Then he added, "Alone, I naturally cannot travel to various cities to set up formations, but I can teach those with a talent for formations how to set them up and even how to refine equipment for forming arrays."
The Qimen Martial Art covered a broad range, and formations and artifact refining were just part of it. Fang Hao also harbored the idea of spreading the knowledge of formations and artifact refining.
Perhaps, once strong enough, founding a sect was also a possibility.
Of course, that was still a long way off.
Upon hearing this, Emperor Da Yue immediately became excited and nodded, "Good, everything shall adhere to Brother Fang's wishes. I will establish a Formation Academy in Da Yue, entirely under Brother Fang's leadership.
"All of Da Yue, no one shall oppose Brother Fang's intentions. Da Yue's resources will be monopolized to supply Brother Fang with the means to deploy formations!"
Fang Hao showed a smile, saying, "Good, it's a deal!"
Su Lingxiu took out several bottles, her eyes brimming with smiles, "Emperor Da Yue, I have some pills here. Would you like to see how effective they are?"
A thought struck in Emperor Da Yue's heart; the disciple of a high-level expert was bound to be extraordinary.
"Good!"
He took a look at the pills and, with his strength, naturally perceived the miraculous effects of the pills. What shocked him even more was that these pills seemed to have been made from ordinary Spiritual Medicine, not Divine Medicine.
If Divine Medicine were used in their creation, what kind of miraculous effect would they possess?
"Miss Su, what are your conditions?"
Emperor Da Yue naturally realized the value of these pills—once there were enough pills, the speed at which Martial Artists cultivated, broke through bottlenecks, healed injuries, and recovered from exhaustion during combat, would all greatly increase.
"More or less the same conditions as my junior brother!"
Su Lingxiu said with a smile.
"Good!"
Emperor Da Yue agreed without hesitation.
Cheng Zhan was sweating with anxiety yet couldn't interject, after all, he was only a True King Heavenly Venerable, whereas Emperor Da Yue was at the Qinghua state, one of the three Supreme Experts.
With Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu now collaborating with Da Yue, what about the Myriad Thunder Sect?
The Myriad Thunder Sect needed them too.
He could only secretly decide to look for Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu privately to discuss terms once Emperor Da Yue had left.
Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu actually hadn't considered the Myriad Thunder Sect. The reason being, the Myriad Thunder Sect was a Martial Arts Sect, whereas Da Yue Country wasn't. Ultimately, there was a difference between the two.
Da Yue could be freer and better express its strengths.
Besides, if the Myriad Thunder Sect or the Tianwu Sect needed anything, the two were willing to assist, for the right price.
They were not bound to Da Yue Country.
Furthermore, how long they would stay in the Qinghua state remained uncertain; eventually, the day would come when they would leave. The Divine Realm was vast, and they both wanted to explore more of it.
Emperor Da Yue looked expectantly at Xu Yan and Meng Chong.
"Don't look at me, my Martial Arts are different. I, Xu Yan, am going to walk the expanse of the Divine Realm, to meet these prodigies of the Divine Region, and these mighty figures."
Xu Yan spoke calmly.
"Me too!"
Meng Chong said, stroking his bald head.
Emperor Da Yue was somewhat disappointed.
Without any need for Xu Yan and the others to act, Emperor Da Yue ordered a multitude of True Kings to scavenge the resources of the Heavenly Grotto, including Blood Cloud Gold and the like, all delivered to the Flying Boat.
These were spoils of war!
After exploring the Heavenly Grotto for a while, the Flying Boat left the Heavenly Grotto, and Emperor Da Yue arranged for people to stand guard at the Heavenly Grotto, to prevent invasions from the enemies of the Netherworld.
Then, they returned to the Capital City of Da Yue to address the chaos within.

chapters.title: Chapter 716 - 378: Cooperation Conditions, Passing on the Divine Skill Technique_2
chapters.content:
The strongholds holding the Da Yue Abyss finally found their opportunity to fight, being dispatched to clear out the rebels and Blood Disciples, Blood Slaves within the Da Yue territories, and to suppress other uprisings at the Heavenly Grottos.
Some of the strongholds were even sent to aid the Myriad Thunder Sect and the Tianwu Sect.
In the Da Yue Emperor's palace's detached compound, arrangements were made for Li Xuan and his group to stay. After the Emperor Da Yue apologized to the esteemed masters, he became busy with political affairs.
Within the detached compound, Cheng Zhan was laying out his terms.
Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu also made pledges, leaving Cheng Zhan no choice but to accept that it was impossible to invite them to join the Myriad Thunder Sect.
Nevertheless, there was room for cooperation.
The chaos in the Heavenly Grottoes had entered the stage of pacification, and it was time to make arrangements for the Spirit Body Prodigies who had come from the Spiritual Realm.
The people from Yuling Mansion swear allegiance to the Da Yue Dynasty, and a True King has already made the arrangements.
Out of respect for the esteemed masters, their treatment has improved, and they no longer need to worry about becoming cannon fodder.
The strongholders from the Spiritual Realm heaved a sigh of relief. Although they could not continue to follow the esteemed masters, being benefitted by their radiance, they received generous treatment, and the assurance of not becoming cannon fodder was enough.
Next, it was all about diligently cultivating, striving to breakthrough Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable, True King Heavenly Venerable, and even aim for the Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
They had heard that among the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Da Yue Country, one was once a Spirit Body Prodigy from the Spiritual Realm's Yuling Mansion.
The Martial Artists from Yuling Mansion pledged their services to him.
Cheng Zhan took the people from Leiyun Mountain Manor and Thousand Martial Hall away, those who pledged to Myriad Thunder Sect, were sent there, and those who belonged to Tianwu Sect, were escorted to it.
As for Fu Tianhai, Emperor Da Zhou, Xin Mengrou and others, their upper Sects were not in the Qinghua state, so they had to wait for representatives from their own Sects to come.
Emperor Da Yue had arranged for messages to be sent to each of their Sects, but it would take some time for their people to arrive.
According to what Cheng Zhan said, the Sects under the Spiritual Realm outside of Qinghua state were all the responsibility of Da Yue Country to communicate with, and the upper Sects, within the time Divine Bridge was open, would mostly come to Qinghua state.
Originally, each Sect had dispatched personnel to Lingguan City, but since Lingguan City had been destroyed, only Da Yue Country was left to send the messages.
Xin Mengrou, Fu Tianhai, Emperor Da Zhou and others could only temporarily reside in the capital of the Da Yue Country, waiting for people from their respective upper Sects to arrive.
Because the Da Yue Abyss had been leveled, Da Yue Country was able to dispatch more strongholds to sweep through their territory, killing off the invading Blood Disciples, Blood Slaves, and rebels.
Moreover, Immortal Heavenly Venerables took this opportunity to pacify the Grottoes across the land.
The grand battle between the Myriad Thunder Sect and the Tianwu Sect was coming to an end with the support of the strongholds from Da Yue Country. Whether it was the Sect Master of Myriad Thunder or the Tianwu Clan Master, both were greatly shocked. Could it really be that such a high personage had descended upon Qinghua state?
They, like the Emperor Da Zhou, all suspected that the appearance of this high personage was to thwart the schemes of the Netherworld.
In the Capital City of Da Yue, two adjacent Martial Arts Institutes rose from the ground, namely the Qimen Institute and the Alchemical Medical Institute, and Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu had already been stationed there.
Accompanying Su Lingxiu were Yue'er, Meng Shushu, Zhou Ying, as well as Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao, who were responsible for helping with the affairs of the Alchemical Medical Institute.
Within the Qimen Institute, Moon Changming still followed Fang Hao, and the Emperor Da Zhou had also dispatched assistants.
Su Lingxiu began to treat the wounds of Da Yue Country's Martial Artists, ordinary injuries were treated with pills, but for injuries that affected their foundation, Su Lingxiu would personally take action.
Of course, treatment was not free.
After arriving in the Divine Realm, everything began to move onto the right track as they started on their respective paths of Martial Arts.
Xu Yan and Meng Chong, for the time being, did not venture out for further experiences but instead focused on consolidating themselves, perceiving their Divine Skills, and practicing the Divine Skills from the Divine Skill Martial Code.
Xie Lingfeng was also seizing every moment to cultivate desperately.
Wu Tianan painted a portrait. This was the mentor who had guided him in Martial Arts, and the person he had been seeking throughout his life.
Now that he was in the Divine Realm, he naturally had to continue his search.
Relying on his association with those under the esteemed master, Wu Tianan searched for strongholds in Da Yue and inquired about news.
However, he found no trace.
Neither Emperor Da Zhou nor any of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables, nor even the strongholds that once came from the Spiritual Realm, had seen the person in his portrait.
But Wu Tianan was not discouraged; the Divine Realm was vast, and Qinghua was only part of it.
He would eventually find a clue someday.
"Senior, the path of my Martial Arts has been made clear. I feel that I have found the suitable Martial Arts path for me to follow, but I fear that my power is insufficient to traverse the Divine Realm in search of this person.
"The Divine Skills, may I also practice them?" Wu Tianan asked, prostrating on the ground.
Li Xuan glanced at him, pondered for a moment, and then replied, "Whether you can practice Divine Skills depends on yourself. If you wish to learn, it's alright to pass on a few Divine Skills to you."
He did not object to passing on Divine Skills to those who practice Taicang Martial Arts. After all, if it was Taicang Martial Arts, they could also cultivate Divine Skills, and ultimately, he would still benefit.
Even the Taicang Martial Arts could assimilate and become tinged with traces of his Martial Arts.
The wider the spread of Martial Arts, the more he, as the Martial Ancestor, stood to gain.
"Many thanks, senior!"
Wu Tianan was beyond excited, bowing respectfully.
"I'll pass on a few Divine Skills to you."
Li Xuan pondered for a moment, and then passed on a few minor Divine Skills that Xu Yan had already comprehended to Wu Tianan, as well as two other appropriate Divine Skills that had yet to be mastered.
Raising his hand to point, he directly transmitted the Divine Skill Techniques into Wu Tianan's Divine Soul.
Wu Tianan's spirits lifted, feeling as though suddenly, within his Divine Soul and consciousness, the marvelous Divine Skill Techniques had emerged. Just upon carefully contemplating them, he sensed their profound mysteries and experienced a feeling of being unable to fully comprehend them.
"Many thanks, senior!"
Li Xuan nodded.
Upon seeing this, Xie Tianheng's spirits also lifted. The Martial Arts he practiced were neither the Great Wilderness Martial Arts nor purely Taicang Martial Arts, but generally, the path of the Martial Arts still followed that of the Taicang way.
"Honorable one, I too wish to comprehend Divine Skills!"
Xie Tianheng bowed respectfully.
He was a disciple of Li Xuan's Sword Dao and had a closer relationship with him than Wu Tianan.
"Very well!"
Li Xuan passed several Divine Skills to Xie Tianheng, including those of the Sword Dao Divine Skills.
Xin Mengrou was somewhat tempted, but she was ultimately too shy and not close enough to brazenly ask for the Divine Skill Techniques.
Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao's eyes lit up; they had always coveted the Divine Skill Techniques, and now was their opportunity.
"Senior, we too wish to learn Divine Skills!"
"Alright then!"
Li Xuan nodded, considering that these two girls were practically like his own disciples; there was no reason not to allow them.
With a wave of his hand, he transmitted several Divine Skills to the two women, and without waiting for Zi Yun to ask, he also passed the techniques to her.
He casually passed them to Yue'er and Moon Changming as well.
"Regarding the Divine Skill Techniques, if you manage to comprehend them, or feel someone else should inherit them, then pass them on; they are not exclusively Martial Arts secrets," Li Xuan finally said.
"Yes, senior!"
Xin Mengrou inwardly relaxed, knowing she could also gain the Divine Skill Techniques from Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao.
"Having passed on so many Divine Skills, how many will be able to comprehend them? If Taicang Martial Arts practitioners find a way to cultivate Divine Skills, the strength of Taicang Martial Arts will receive no small enhancement," Li Xuan pondered to himself.
Zi Yun, having received the Divine Skill Techniques, furrowed her brows cutely, unable to understand them. Her eyes twinkling, she approached Meng Chong, took his hand, and asked him to explain the Divine Skill Techniques to her.
Meng Chong wore a helpless expression on his face.
Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao's eyes shined brighter, and they went immediately to seek Xu Yan's guidance, although Yue'er had already taken the first step to do so.
Seeing this, Xu Yan had no choice but to explain Divine Skills to everyone; such matters surely couldn't trouble their master, right? As the eldest senior brother, it was his responsibility.
Thus, Wu Tianan, Xie Tianheng, and the others were all listening to Xu Yan's explanations of Divine Skills, and even Xu Yan was pointing out directions for cultivating Divine Skills within the Taicang Martial Arts path.
Li Xuan listened silently for a while, then couldn't help but nod, "Indeed worthy of being the pioneer of my Martial Arts, having quite an understanding of Taicang Martial Arts and surpassing everyone else in his insights into Martial Arts.
"Xu Yan is the one with the best chance of truly carving his own Martial Arts path," he thought.
Xu Yan's Martial Arts lay in purity—a multi-faceted purity, not a singular one—bearing a sense that all Martial Arts lie in the heart, to be wielded as one desires.
Of course, Xu Yan was not yet able to have Martial Arts in his heart and wield them as he wished, but he already had the foundation and outline for it.
This was also the solid ground upon which Xu Yan established his own path in Martial Arts.
Li Xuan looked forward to finding out what he himself would gain when Xu Yan carved out his own path in Martial Arts!

chapters.title: Chapter 717 - 379 Taking Jiang Buping as a Disciple, The 5th Martial Art
chapters.content:
Xu Yan elucidated the Divine Skill Techniques, and by the end, he himself had a new insight and actually comprehended another Divine Skill.
Although it was only a minor Divine Skill, it was still an addition to the vast array of Divine Skills in the Great Wilderness Martial Arts.
Wu Tianan and the others also gained something, each taking their insights to reflect and deepen.
Sui Hongwu returned to express his thanks for the life-saving favor once again. He brought precious Divine Medicines and Divine Materials as gifts and even requested Fang Hao to refine a new Divine Artifact for him.
Fang Hao agreed without hesitation and even custom-made a Divine Artifact for Sui Hongwu. The materials for the artifact were naturally provided by Sui Hongwu, and the compensation was not low.
One could anticipate that the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Qinghua state would be eager to request artifact refinement from him.
"Brother Feng Yan, I owe you my thanks for coming to assist me this time. Here is a token of my gratitude."
Sui Hongwu spoke with appreciation.
"It's a trifle."
Feng Yan waved his hand dismissively.
"I'm not sure if the turmoil in the Nine Mountain Realm has settled down yet. When will Brother Feng Yan return there? Would you need my assistance?"
Sui Hongwu asked again.
"No hurry, no hurry, the situation in the Nine Mountain Realm is not major. If there really was a problem, aid would have been sought long ago."
Feng Yan waved his hand again.
Sui Hongwu could tell that Feng Yan intended to use this opportunity to stay behind. Following the disciple of a revered master didn't seem to differ much from following the master himself, right?
Feng Yan hurriedly ran off to assist Fang Hao, leaving Sui Hongwu with a helpless expression. Where was the pride of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable?
He seemed like a sycophant.
Little did he know, Feng Yan was itching to learn the Divine Skill Techniques, so he was working hard in the hopes of being rewarded with them sooner.
After all, he didn't need a revered master to impart them when Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu already possessed the Divine Skill Techniques.
Hence, he was working especially diligently.
Li Xuan didn't mind, having an Immortal Heavenly Venerable tagging along was not bad; after all, he couldn't personally intervene in all matters his disciples couldn't handle, could he?
Having an Immortal Heavenly Venerable as an enforcer would perfectly fill that gap.
Red Cat enjoyed mingling in the Qimen Institute and Alchemical Medical Institute and occasionally even slipped into the Da Yue Imperial Palace. It was living a carefree life, carrying on with Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha to find out where there were Spirit Beasts, planning to establish a Demon Clan in the Divine Realm.
Powerhouses like Emperor Da Yue were aware that this plump cat was the pet of a revered master, so they turned a blind eye and even occasionally offered treasures as treats.
"Red Cat is truly getting better at leveraging its advantages."
Red Cat, a cultural tiger, was shrewd indeed.
"It's finally compiled."
Li Xuan looked at the Daoist Golden Book, letting out a sigh of relief.
The Martial Arts Techniques above the Void-breaking Realm were finally completely compiled, and the Martial Arts Techniques for beyond that had already a theoretical framework.
The second and third layers of the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body were also crafted.
This would be perfect to pass on the Martial Arts Techniques to Xu Yan and Meng Chong before they ventured out into the world.
"The Fifth Door of Martial Arts is also nearing completion."
What excited Li Xuan the most was that the Fifth Door of Martial Arts was nearly finished.
This was a Martial Arts path created for Jiang Buping, tailored to his talents. And since Jiang Buping's strength was already considerable, once he comprehended and entered into the Fifth Door of Martial Arts, his power would not be weak.
"Myriad Thunder Sect and Tianwu Sect have come to see the revered master!"
Outside the Alchemical Medical Institute, a respectful voice rang out.
"Come in."
Li Xuan spoke indifferently.
The visitors were the leaders of Myriad Thunder Sect and Tianwu Sect, each escorting an Immortal Heavenly Venerable from their sects to visit.
Li Xuan sat in his chair with ease, Cai Ling'er beside him pouring tea, her eyes wide with curiosity watching the newcomers.
One of them exuded a sense of powerful strength, his sturdy build nearly matching that of Meng Chong.
Leader of the Tianwu Sect!
The other seemed to carry thunder within him, giving off an aura of ferocity.
Leader of the Myriad Thunder Sect.
Behind each of them followed an Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
The mysterious aura around Li Xuan flickered in and out of visibility, and occasionally behind him emerged the shadowy visage of the Great Wilderness Physiognomy. As the Myriad Thunder Sect Leader and the Tianwu Sect Leader looked up, they were instantly shaken.
A revered master!
Unfathomable!
Their attitude grew even more respectful.
"We are here to see the revered master and to express our gratitude for resolving the peril of the Qinghua state."
The four from Myriad Thunder Sect bowed with deep respect.
They also presented substantial gifts.
Shi'er stepped forward to accept them and quietly moved to the side.
The Myriad Thunder Sect Leader and the Tianwu Sect Leader came not only to meet the enigmatic master and make themselves known in his presence but also sought Fang Hao's Formation expertise and Su Lingxiu's Pill medicine.
After paying homage to the master, the two sought out Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu to finalize collaborative agreements. Once they obtained their desired pills and Array Plates, they left satisfied.
With the newly acquired Formation expertise, the Qinghua state would be robust as a fortress in the future, and the threat from the Netherworld would be greatly reduced.
Boom!
Emperor Da Yue suddenly departed for the Da Yue Abyss.
A power not weaker than Xuezhi Ji emerged from the Netherworld, intending to enter the Abyss. The Immortal Heavenly Venerable stationed there could not hold back the threat for long, forcing Emperor Da Yue to intervene personally.
After this incident, two Immortal Heavenly Venerables were stationed in the Da Yue Abyss, and Fang Hao meticulously arranged a Nine Heavy Formation.
With the Nine Heavy Formation and two Immortal Heavenly Venerables in place, it would be easy to defend against an attacker of Emperor Da Yue's caliber for more than a day and a night.
It might even provide full protection.
"My strength is still lacking; the Formations I've set up aren't strong enough," Fang Hao sighed to himself. However, he would soon be able to increase his strength. With ample resources, his power was bound to advance by leaps and bounds.

chapters.title: Chapter 718 - 379 Taking Jiang Buping as a Disciple, The 5th Martial Art_2
chapters.content:
Li Xuan sat leisurely in his chair, eyes slightly squinted, appearing to be enjoying a comfortable nap, yet his mind was entirely focused on the Daoist Golden Book.
"Finally, it's completed."
The Fifth Door of Martial Arts was finally completed in its entirety, whether it was the theoretical framework, the Martial Arts Techniques, or even the fusion of Imperishable Qi into a part of the Divine Soul, he had written it all.
Next, it all depended on Jiang Buping himself.
"Jiang Buping, this lad, once a prodigy turned into trash, and then discarded; born with a Divine Soul and possessing the aura of a child of fortune, should have no problem comprehending and cultivating it."
Li Xuan still had quite a bit of confidence in Jiang Buping.
Jiang Buping shook his head, awakening once again from a deep sleep, and this time he breathed a sigh of relief, no longer plagued by those unimaginable visions.
However, he was immediately taken aback.
Where was he?
Had someone rescued him?
He got up listlessly.
"You're awake."
Shi'er appeared in front of him.
"Thank you, big brother, for rescuing me."
Jiang Buping expressed his gratitude.
"It wasn't me who saved you, come with me."
Shi'er led Jiang Buping to where Li Xuan was.
Xu Yan, Meng Chong, Su Lingxiu, and Fang Hao, upon hearing that Jiang Buping was awake, all came over out of curiosity.
Jiang Buping was somewhat stunned, but gratefully said, "Jiang Buping, thank you all for saving my life!"
"The discarded child of Taikun, Jiang Buping?"
Feng Yan muttered to himself, looking quite surprised.
Jiang Buping's mouth twitched, and only then did he notice Feng Yan, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
Suddenly, he realized that these people, including Feng Yan, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, all stood respectfully beneath the young man.
Li Xuan watched Jiang Buping and thought to himself, truly a child of fortune, tainted with Imperishable Qi, and only slightly listless, not easy to focus his mind, that's all; he wasn't devoid of Spiritual Wisdom, nor was he muddleheaded.
Today, he was going to take a disciple, and outsiders were not needed anymore.
So he looked at Feng Yan, and Feng Yan tactfully withdrew.
In the courtyard, only Xu Yan was a disciple, and Shi'er, Zhou Ying, Meng Shushu, and the Red Cat were not outsiders.
Xie Lingfeng was in seclusion, enduring hard cultivation and had not yet come out.
Xie Tianheng was comprehending Divine Skills, and was thus not there.
"Jiang Buping."
Li Xuan spoke.
"Senior, it's me!"
Jiang Buping forced himself to become more energetic as he responded.
"You were born with a Divine Soul, you're quite gifted; but you've been tainted with Imperishable Qi, causing your Divine Soul to become heavy, often leaving you listless and unable to concentrate your consciousness.
"Tainted with the Imperishable Qi, yet you didn't lose your Spiritual Wisdom or become muddleheaded, which shows your Divine Soul is extraordinary," Li Xuan said, pronouncing each word clearly.
Jiang Buping was startled. The fact he was born with a Divine Soul was known only to his mother and himself, and since his mother had long passed away, no one in this world knew about it.
Had this senior seen through it with just one glance?
How could that be possible?
Whether a Divine Soul is natural or not cannot be detected by others once one breaks through to the Divine Refinement Realm and condenses the Divine Soul.
Back when he was ambushed and tainted with the Imperishable Qi, he pretended to be muddleheaded and lost his Spiritual Wisdom. The Jiang Clan had an Immortal Heavenly Venerable who investigated his Divine Soul and noticed nothing.
Otherwise, how could he have managed to successfully bluff his way out and escape from the Taikun Realm?
"Senior, how did you know I have a natural Divine Soul?"
Jiang Buping took a deep breath and asked.
What's meant to be, will be; what's not, will pass.
He decided to frankly admit it.
"Nothing can escape my eyes."
Li Xuan said with a mysterious smile.
This was his preparation for passing on the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path.
"You have an exceptional gift and a remarkable will; your Divine Soul, tainted with Imperishable Qi, is both a calamity and an opportunity. I have a Martial Art that can let you be reborn from the ashes, surpass your peak, and wash away the unfairness in your heart. Are you willing to take me as your master?" Li Xuan asked earnestly.
Jiang Buping was stunned. This senior wanted to take him as a disciple?
Tainted with Imperishable Qi, was it both a calamity and a chance? Could the senior resolve the effects of the Imperishable Qi?
```
No matter what, this is an opportunity.
It is an opportunity for him to rise again, and if there is a chance to ascend once more, how could he be willing to sink into oblivion?
Alas, his Divine Soul is tainted with Imperishable Qi, which is an unsolvable issue. He is fortunate not to have lost his Spiritual Wisdom, not to have become muddle-headed, so how dare he hope for recovery?
Now, the opportunity to return to the pinnacle has appeared!
Jiang Buping knelt down with a plop, respectfully kowtowing and saying, "Disciple Jiang Buping, greets Master!"
"Hmm, rise."
Li Xuan nodded.
Jiang Buping stood up excitedly and asked, "Master, is it really possible to resolve the Imperishable Qi contaminating my Divine Soul?"
"It depends on you, if you can comprehend, then you can resolve it."
Li Xuan did not assert a certain outcome.
Looking at Xu Yan and the other three disciples, he said, "This is your Eldest Senior Brother Xu Yan, the Second Senior Brother Meng Chong, Third Senior Sister Su Lingxiu, and Fourth Senior Brother Fang Hao."
"Jiang Buping pays respect to Eldest Senior Brother, Second Senior Brother..."
Jiang Buping said respectfully as he saluted.
"Fifth Junior Brother is too courteous!"
Xu Yan said with a smile.
Jiang Buping, with a Divine Soul bestowed by nature, no wonder Master had the idea to take in another disciple.
After getting familiar with his fellow disciples, Jiang Buping looked at his Master full of anticipation.
"Your teacher here has a Martial Arts Technique called Extreme Soul Martial Arts... Given your naturally bestowed Divine Soul, it suits you perfectly. This technique, as its name suggests, focuses on the word 'extreme'.
"Those who practice Extreme Soul focus on the soul, treat the body as a furnace, and all cultivation is centered upon the Divine Soul, aiming to refine the path of the Divine Soul to the utmost limit.
"For an Extreme Soul Warrior, the physical body becomes insignificant, as they rely on the soul as their substance and foundation, and are not adrift like duckweed without a physical body even if their physical form no longer exists.
"Nor will they need to reassemble a new body or take over another life when their flesh perishes.
"For Extreme Soul Warriors, the body is merely a crucible for refining the Extreme Soul, and it is not a necessity for the crucible to be a body of flesh and blood..."
Li Xuan expounded the theory of Extreme Soul Martial Arts as the Fifth Door of Martial Arts.
Extreme Soul Martial Arts!
Focusing on the soul as the essence and foundation, it is a way of Martial Arts taken to the extreme, which can also be seen as a method of the ultimate path.
Jiang Buping was excited and listened respectfully, afraid of missing even the slightest detail.
The more he heard, the more exhilarated he became. The Extreme Soul Martial Arts was just right for him to practice. If he had started with it from the beginning, his strength now might not have been weaker than that of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
Xu Yan and the others listened too, especially Xu Yan, who pondered thoughtfully. While Extreme Soul Martial Arts might not suit his own practice, he could incorporate some of its elements into his own techniques.
Meng Chong was also contemplative. He practiced Physical Body Martial Arts, which is the ultimate in physical form, while Extreme Soul Martial Arts is the ultimate concerning the Divine Soul or Primordial Spirit.
Indeed, these are two ultimate forms of Martial Arts.
After listening to Master's explanation of Extreme Soul Martial Arts, Xu Yan and the other three understood why Master wanted to take Jiang Buping as a disciple; he was truly too suitable for this Martial Arts.
As Li Xuan lectured on the theory of Extreme Soul Martial Arts, he too quietly anticipated what feedback he could get once Jiang Buping succeeded in his practice.
Transformation of the Primordial Spirit?
His Primordial Spirit is now very strong and likely not much weaker than his physical body.
If it were to transform again, how powerful could it become?
Fortunately, he also designed a Physical Body Martial Arts Technique, which also strives for the ultimate body. Once Meng Chong comprehends it, his own strength will see a significant increase.
"Whether it's Physical Body Martial Arts, Alchemical Medical Martial Arts, Extreme Soul Martial Arts, or Qimen Martial Art, they are all based on Pure Martial Arts. The strength of Pure Martial Arts is the foundation that unleashes their greatest power."
Li Xuan marveled internally.
Moreover, Xu Yan, the pioneer of his Martial Arts, would certainly draw what he needed from Extreme Soul Martial Arts to further enhance and purify his Pure Martial Arts, making it ever more potent!
The Daoist Golden Book gave the following information about Extreme Soul Martial Arts:
Extreme Soul Martial Arts:
Technique Completion Degree: Above average.
Comprehension Difficulty: High.
Training Difficulty: High.
The main reason for the high training difficulty is because, for Jiang Buping to succeed in entering the ranks, he must resolve the Imperishable Qi on his Divine Soul.
Otherwise, with Jiang Buping's naturally bestowed Divine Soul, the training difficulty would not be rated as high.
"... Extreme Soul Martial Arts focuses on cultivating an Imperishable Spirit Soul. Only by cultivating an Imperishable Spirit Soul can the true power of Extreme Soul Martial Arts be revealed.
"And the cultivation of an Imperishable Spirit Soul usually requires step-by-step practice, enduring several Extreme Soul transformations, which may involve some suffering along the way.
"Because of these reasons, Extreme Soul Martial Arts is difficult to cultivate, not something ordinary people can practice; it requires tremendous willpower.
"Whereas your Divine Soul has been contaminated with Imperishable Qi, it is actually an opportunity. If you can fully integrate the Imperishable Qi into your Divine Soul, making it a part of it, your Divine Soul will directly transform into an Imperishable Spirit Soul.
"Directly bypassing the long and painful cultivation process, achieving it in one step, and becoming a true Extreme Soul Warrior. However, the prerequisite is that you can successfully resolve the Imperishable Qi."
In the end, Li Xuan looked gravely at Jiang Buping and said.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 719 - 380 Above Void-breaking, Using the Body as the Domain
chapters.content:
Jiang Buping was overwhelmingly excited. There existed such an incredible and powerful Martial Arts in the world that it was beyond imagination, completely different from any Martial Arts he knew.
It was like the difference between heaven and earth.
The might of Extreme Soul Martial Arts even surpassed his understanding of Martial Arts.
Opportunity!
His great opportunity had come.
Finally, he saw a chance to rise, and one day, he would sweep away the injustices in his heart!
"Master, your disciple will definitely practice diligently and will not disappoint your expectations!"
Jiang Buping prostrated himself on the ground and respectfully said.
"The path of Martial Arts is endless. There is no limit to it, so practice diligently. Now, I will impart to you the method of Extreme Soul Martial Arts. Once you successfully integrate Imperishable Qi into your Divine Soul, cultivate the Imperishable Spirit Soul, you will have recovered,"
Li Xuan said as he began to transmit the Extreme Soul Martial Arts Method to Jiang Buping.
Jiang Buping listened respectfully, afraid of missing even the slightest detail, especially the method to resolve the Imperishable Qi.
"Have you remembered everything?"
Li Xuan asked after explaining the Martial Arts Techniques.
"Disciple has remembered it!"
Jiang Buping respectfully said.
"Hmm!"
Li Xuan nodded satisfactorily, but he still repeated and elaborated on the key points to Jiang Buping.
"Thank you for imparting the teachings, Master!"
Jiang Buping respectfully bowed and said.
"Reflect on it well, and strive to make early progress in your practice,"
Li Xuan nodded.
"Yes, Master!"
Jiang Buping took a deep breath, his gaze firm, determined to go into seclusion and comprehend Extreme Soul Martial Arts.
Only, the Imperishable Qi constantly affected him, making it difficult for him to concentrate, which meant that the difficulty of comprehending the Cultivation Technique had greatly increased.
However, he already had a solution to this problem. He would stimulate his consciousness with pain, allowing him to focus, just as he had done during his last battle with the Mountain True King.
"Fifth Junior Brother, your Divine Soul is affected by the Imperishable Qi, and it's difficult for your consciousness to concentrate. I have a type of pill here that can help you focus,"
Su Lingxiu said with a smile brimming with goodwill.
"Really? Thank you, Senior Sister!"
Jiang Buping was overjoyed.
"This pill was specially refined by me for you. After taking it, it will constantly stimulate the Divine Soul and rejuvenate your spirit, as well as nourish the Divine Soul. One pill can maintain your mental state for six hours,"
Su Lingxiu handed a bottle of pills to Jiang Buping and said.
She had specially researched and developed this pill while studying Imperishable Qi, particularly Jiang Buping's condition.
"Thank you, Senior Sister!"
Jiang Buping was delighted.
"If the pills are not enough, tell me, and I will refine more for you,"
Su Lingxiu said with a smile.
"Yes, Senior Sister!"
Jiang Buping was immensely grateful.
"Fifth Junior Brother, my realm is Artifact Refining, and I have a few Divine Artifacts here that can also help you. This is an Array Plate, which can gather nature's spiritual energy..."
Fang Hao also took out several Divine Artifacts and said.
"Thank you, Third Senior Brother!"
Jiang Buping was stunned; the items his senior brother and sister casually gave were things he had never seen before, all mysterious and extraordinary treasures.
Even in the Taikun Realm, one of the top Great Realms in the Divine Realm, he had never seen such mystical treasures.
Xu Yan said with a smile, "Your Eldest Senior Brother, I practice Pure Martial Arts and don't have these things to give you. However, I can offer you some advice on Martial Arts issues."
Meng Chong patted his bald head and chuckled, "I practice Physical Body Martial Arts. If you want to know how to use the physical body, just come to me."
Jiang Buping's heart swelled with excitement. Each senior brother and sister had their own extraordinary abilities. Who could stop his rise within such a powerful and mystical Sect?
After Li Xuan finished transmitting Extreme Soul Martial Arts to Jiang Buping, and as the five disciples interacted with each other to deepen their bond, he quietly turned his attention to the Daoist Golden Book.
Minor Heavenly Path's Eye:
Cultivation Technique completion: Medium.
Comprehension difficulty: High.
Practice difficulty: High.
This was a simplified version of the Eye of the Heavenly Dao and also the foundation for cultivating it. Li Xuan had put in much effort to finally compile it.
"The Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path is already quite strong. However, the difficulty of comprehending and practicing it is not small. As for whether there are certain precious natural materials that can aid in cultivation, I'll leave that for the disciples to explore,"
Li Xuan mused to himself.
Next, he would impart the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path to Xu Yan and the other three disciples.
As for Jiang Buping, since he was practicing Extreme Soul Martial Arts, the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path was not suitable for him, but Extreme Soul Martial Arts also had its unique Divine Skills.
Moreover, because of the ultimate focus on the Divine Soul, Extreme Soul Martial Arts naturally possessed certain abilities to see through illusion.
After Jiang Buping successfully mastered the practice, he would compile some Divine Skills suitable for Extreme Soul Martial Arts and pass them onto him.
Xu Yan and Meng Chong were also almost ready to venture out, perhaps to the Heavenly Grottoes of the Myriad Thunder Sect and Tianwu Sect, or even to leave the Qinghua state.
The Divine Realm was vast, with Thirty-six Realms each having their distinctions. Roaming the Domain and fighting all over could help them advance their strength more quickly and deepen their understanding of Martial Arts.
Therefore, the Martial Arts Techniques beyond the Void-breaking Realm and the second and third stages of the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body also needed to be passed on to Xu Yan and Meng Chong.
Jiang Buping went into seclusion with great excitement to comprehend the Extreme Soul Martial Arts.
"Do you know how your master could tell at a glance that your Fifth Junior Brother has a naturally Divine Soul?"
