At this moment, Li Xuan looked at his four disciples and said with a smile.
"Master, is there some Divine Skill that can see through all of this?"
Xu Yan's eyes brightened as he excitedly asked.
Li Xuan nodded.
"Master, Master, what is that Divine Skill!"
Su Lingxiu was beside herself with excitement, rushing over to her master's side, massaging his shoulders as she urged, "Master, Master, please pass it on to your disciple."

chapters.title: Chapter 720 - 380 Above Void-breaking, Using the Body as the Domain_2
chapters.content:
Li Xuanle chuckled and patted Su Lingxiu's small hand, which was massaging his shoulder, with the Jade Ruyi. "Alright, today I will pass on this divine skill to you all."
Xu Yan and the other three were thrilled beyond measure. If they successfully cultivated this divine skill, wouldn't it mean that no disguise or extraordinary person could ever deceive their eyes?
"The divine skill I am going to impart to you is a type of pupil technique, the Eye of the Heavenly Dao. Of course, with your current realm, it is impossible for you to cultivate the Eye of the Heavenly Dao.
"Therefore, I will teach you the foundation of cultivating the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, the Minor Eye of the Heavenly Dao."
Li Xuan explained the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, extolling its profound mystery and formidable power. His four disciples listened with excitement, their faces flushed with eagerness, wishing they could master it right away.
"The Minor Eye of the Heavenly Dao, though only the foundation of the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, is also unfathomably subtle. Once cultivated successfully, seeing through illusions, breaking enchantments, slaying enemies, and tracking targets will be effortless..."
Next, Li Xuan elaborated on the Minor Eye of the Heavenly Dao he had concocted, meticulously explaining it to the four disciples.
After ensuring that his disciples had thoroughly memorized it, he added, "As for how to cultivate it, how to comprehend it, and whether external aids can be used, you will need to explore on your own.
"The Minor Eye of the Heavenly Dao varies according to perception; the result of cultivation will differ among individuals, and will not be identical for everyone."
Li Xuan was already quite skilled at fabricating such things. To prevent discrepancies in the cultivation results among his disciples after they discussed and explored, he preemptively addressed this potential loophole.
"Yes, Master!"
The four disciples, including Xu Yan, responded excitedly.
After passing on the Minor Eye of the Heavenly Dao, it was time to pass on the subsequent martial arts cultivation techniques.
His gaze settled on Xu Yan, and he spoke, "My disciple, you have come to understand the Martial Arts Techniques of the Void-breaking Realm, and you have made significant progress in cultivating divine skills. I believe it won't be long before you break through to the Physiognomy Realm and even the Void-breaking Realm.
"Today, I will pass on to you the Martial Arts Principles that transcend the Void-breaking Realm!"
Upon hearing this, Xu Yan instantly became spirited and said excitedly, "Yes, thank you, Master!"
Li Xuan twirled the Jade Ruyi in his hand, his gaze profound, and he spoke solemnly, "The Void-breaking Realm, breaking through the confines of space within heaven and earth, unbound by the spatial restrictions of this world. Since you have come to understand its principles, you must realize that the Void-breaking Realm lays the foundation for transcending heaven and earth."
Xu Yan nodded, respectfully replying, "Disciple understands!"
Li Xuan stood up, one hand clasped behind his back as he slightly tilted his head to look towards the firmament, a mysterious aura flickering about him, which instantly elevated the image of a sage to boundless heights.
"Heaven and earth, to the feeble, are vast and boundless; even in a lifetime, one cannot traverse its full expanse. Yet, to those aspiring to the pinnacle of martial arts, once they reach a certain realm, it seems more like a prison.
"Countless martial prowess talents ultimately seek to transcend heaven and earth, to break free from restrictions, to step onto the peak of martial arts. Yet, how many of those talents find themselves trapped within the confines of heaven and earth throughout their lives..."
A somber voice rang out, causing Xu Yan's heart to tremble. It was as if he saw countless martial prowess talents, trapped and sighing within heaven and earth, some even undergoing drastic changes in temperament.
"The Heavenly Grotto is a fissure in heaven and earth, through which enemies from beyond invade. Yet, the martial artists of this domain are unable to leave and transcend heaven and earth.
"Surely, many a powerful being must feel helpless and indignant, wouldn't you think?"
As Xu Yan pondered these words, he deeply felt the desolation of those martial prowess talents mentioned by his master.
Li Xuan, feeling that the groundwork had been sufficiently laid, declared with a dignified tone, "Above the Void-breaking Realm lies the Domain Realm!
"Embodying heaven and earth, detaching from the external world, opening up a martial domain with the principles of martial arts.
"Establishing the will of martial arts as the Will of the Earth!"
The Domain Realm!
Xu Yan's spirit lifted, his face alight with excitement. At that moment, all the martial arts realms below the Void-breaking Realm flashed through his mind.
From the foundations of Skin Refinement, Bone Refinement, Viscera Refinement, to the Qi-Blood Realm, the Innate Realm... all the way to the Void-breaking Realm. He had ascended through the martial arts realms step by step, cultivating each one in turn.
In the end, it was all to lay the foundation for the Domain Realm!
"So it is! Just as in the Divine Intent Realm, where my intent is the Heavenly Intent, my heart is the Heavenly Heart. Isn't this precisely the foundation for allowing the intent of martial arts to become the Will of the Earth?
"In the Divine Origin Realm, intent merges with True Yuan to undergo a transformation. Isn't this where the Qi of Domain, the Power of Domain, incorporates the martial artist's will, that the realm truly becomes one's own Domain?"
The more Xu Yan pondered, the clearer his understanding became. He extracted the true intent of each martial arts realm, forming the framework for a martial artist's Domain.
Watching Xu Yan, Li Xuan nodded to himself in satisfaction. Worthy of being a cultivator forging his own path in martial arts, he was now enlightened. It seemed that understanding the Martial Arts Law of the Domain Realm would not be too difficult.
"Master, are all the realms below the Void-breaking Realm just the foundation for establishing one's own Domain?"
After his moment of enlightenment, Xu Yan excitedly asked.
Li Xuan showed a look of gratification on his face, "Disciple, you have finally understood!"
But in his heart, he lamented, "What a prodigy, to have completed the mental construct and directly linked all the realms to form a cycle?"
With his master's affirmation, Xu Yan became even more excited.
"In the Domain Realm, the Martial Arts Principles serve as the foundation, creating a Martial Artist's own Heaven and Earth within the body. However, it does not mean that one in the Domain Realm has transcended Heaven and Earth.
"It's just that using one's body as Heaven and Earth, equal to the external Heaven and Earth, enables one's own domain to influence this great Heaven and Earth, genuinely possessing the might of Heaven and Earth.
"The cultivation in the Domain Realm is very difficult, as it requires the integration of one's own Martial Arts Principles, Spirit Pedestal, Primordial Spirit, and so on, into the realm of Heaven and Earth.
"Perception varies, and so does Heaven and Earth. The state of Heaven and Earth differs from person to person, each unique in their own way…"
Li Xuan continued to explain the theory of the Domain Realm.
After finishing the explanation of the Domain Realm theory and revealing the intent behind this realm, Xu Yan gained a direct understanding. Only then did Li Xuan begin to impart the Cultivation Methods of the Domain Realm.
This realm, as Li Xuan said, is very difficult to cultivate and break through. However, once broken through, it represents a tremendous uplift. It wouldn't be far from truly transcending Heaven and Earth.
The Martial Arts Techniques of the Domain Realm are even harder to comprehend than those of the Void-breaking Realm, more complex, and more challenging to actualize; the entire Cultivation Technique is also more lengthy.
"Although the Martial Arts Techniques of the Domain Realm are more complex and involve more aspects, with Xu Yan's prodigious abilities, he is ultimately capable of comprehending it.
"As long as he successfully comprehends the Domain Realm, then the realms above it will become somewhat easier.
"It can be said that the Domain Realm is a significant leap. From this realm onwards, one begins to touch upon the level of the Dao."
Li Xuan thought to himself silently.
Information about the Domain Realm from the Daoist Golden Book:
Domain Realm:
Cultivation Technique Perfection: Medium.
Realm Connection: Medium-Low.
Comprehension Difficulty: High.
Cultivation Difficulty: High+.
Li Xuan racked his brains trying to make the Domain Realm strong yet manageable to cultivate, but he couldn't reduce the difficulty level of cultivation.
In the end, he could only decide on it like this. However, he believed that with Xu Yan's monstrous talents, he was capable of comprehending and successfully cultivating it.
It was timely that Xu Yan was about to venture into the Divine Realm and traverse the Divine Territory, comprehending the mysteries of Heaven and Earth, which would aid him in grasping the Domain Realm and how to cultivate by embodying Heaven and Earth.
Li Xuan began to impart the Martial Arts Techniques of the Domain Realm, and Xu Yan listened attentively with a solemn expression. He realized that this realm was of utmost importance – a transformational stage.
Once he entered this state, he would truly embark on the path to the martial pinnacle and take a crucial step towards transcending Heaven and Earth.
This time, Li Xuan broke with tradition and explained the Domain Martial Arts Law three times, and Xu Yan, exceptionally, asked several questions about it.
Li Xuan answered each question patiently.
Not until Xu Yan had committed the Domain Martial Arts Law to memory and grasped a preliminary concept, was the imparting of the Martial Arts Law finally completed.
Meng Chong, Su Lingxiu, and Fang Hao, who had been quietly listening, were utterly shocked. It was too mysterious, too powerful, and too difficult to comprehend.
Indeed, the further one goes in Martial Arts, the more challenging it becomes to comprehend and break through.
Su Lingxiu also memorized the Cultivation Technique by heart, as after all, the advancement in realms for Alchemical Medical Martial Arts was similar to that of Pure Martial Arts.
Fang Hao was deep in thought. The path of Qimen Martial Art was set out before him; all he needed to do was keep cultivating.
But, he had not yet fully grasped what lay ahead.
"Domain Qimen Patterns are difficult to condense, the challenge is significant."
Fang Hao sighed in his heart, then immediately buoyed himself up, knowing that once he successfully condensed them, his deployment of Domain Qimen would be like controlling Heaven and Earth.
For those entering his Qimen, it would be like entering his own domain. In his Domain, life and death, everything would be within his control.

chapters.title: Chapter 721 - 381: Above the Sword of Wisdom, Awaiting the Spread of Fame to the Divine Realm
chapters.content:
```
After passing on the Martial Arts Techniques beyond the Void-breaking Realm to Xu Yan, Li Xuan sighed with emotion in his heart, acknowledging that the higher the realm, the more difficult it became to devise Martial Arts as one progressed further in cultivation.
For every realm, one had to think deeply and ensure as much as possible that the increase in strength was significant and the concepts were coherent and easy to comprehend, to prevent the stagnation of Martial Arts due to difficulty in understanding.
He had put much careful thought into the Domain Martial Arts Law, finally satisfied with its strength after crafting it.
"Above the Domain Realm, the direction of cultivation is generally determined, but there's no rush to flesh it out entirely. It requires deeper thought to make it as perfect as possible,"
Li Xuan muttered to himself.
In Taicang Martial Arts, how to cultivate beyond the Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm and what that realm would be, were still unclear to him.
Looking at Emperor Da Yue and the other Immortal Heavenly Venerables, it seemed they too lacked a clear understanding of the path ahead.
"Immortal Heavenly Venerable is harmonious with Domain and shares its longevity, but in reality, it is not truly unified with Domain. It may appear to possess the power to control a part of Domain, but ultimately it seems somewhat illusory.
"From what I understand, beyond Immortal Heavenly Venerable should lie the power to truly unify with Domain, to control a part of Domain entirely, truly possessing the power to control the Heaven and Earth Laws,"
Li Xuan speculated on the realm beyond the Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
And for Taicang Martial Arts, the next level of cultivation would inevitably involve Dao Principles.
"Condensation Law merges into the body to become Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable, so if it involves Dao Principles, it would be the condensation of Dao Principles into the body, the Condensation Dao Realm?"
Li Xuan thought pensively.
"What realm does the owner of the Book of Taicang belong to, able to record the laws and Dao Principles of Taicang Domain?"
Li Xuan's thoughts shifted to the owner of the Book of Taicang and the mysterious little stone house in the Wu Country Royal Palace.
He had not yet fully committed the Book of Taicang to memory.
The Dao Principles were ultimately too profound, even with his Void-breaking Realm cultivation, memorizing them in a short span of time was difficult, and the further one went, the more complex and challenging they became.
"Aiming for transcendence beyond Domain, once I've transcended Domain, I will truly be invincible, won't I? Even the owner of the Book of Taicang need not be feared."
Li Xuan was filled with confidence in his heart.
Of course, whether the owner of the Book of Taicang was still alive remained unknown.
He even suspected that the entity within the mysterious little stone house might be the sealed owner of the Book of Taicang.
After passing on the Domain Martial Arts Law to Xu Yan, Li Xuan naturally moved on to impart to Meng Chong the second and third layers of the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body Cultivation Technique.
"Physical Body Martial Arts is the ultimate achievement of the body. Each aperture a star, isn't this also creating one's own Domain? Physical Domain, the body as vast as Domain itself, as robust as Domain..."
Li Xuan began explaining the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body, going over the second and third layers in detail, especially the third, which involved the cultivation of the Physical Domain.
Once Meng Chong had fully memorized it, Li Xuan supplemented Fang Hao's understanding with additional Qimen Martial Art methods to further enhance his Qimen Martial Art.
With this, the transmission of Martial Arts Cultivation Methods was complete.
Savoring the Spiritual Tea, Li Xuan then said to Xu Yan, "Disciple, you are only half a step away from the Wisdom Sword Realm. Today, I will pass on to you the realms beyond the Wisdom Sword Realm."
Xu Yan was very close to the Wisdom Sword Realm, and it was time to pass on the subsequent Sword Dao realms to him.
Above the Wisdom Sword Realm lay the Holy Sword Realm.
Li Xuan had already prepared this, which was the best realm to bridge from the Wisdom Sword Realm.
"Above the Wisdom Sword Realm is the Holy Sword Realm, signified by the word 'holy'!
"You must truly comprehend the essence of holiness, the grandeur of the sword. No sword refuses to bow, follow, or honor, and none dare to oppose it.
"With a single thought of the Holy Sword, all swords in the world will respond and worship in obedience.
"A thought of the Holy Sword summons all swords of Domain, gathered for your use with just a thought..."
Li Xuan passed on the Holy Sword Realm to Xu Yan one by one.
Xu Yan was moved and greatly shocked. The Wisdom Sword Realm was already mysteriously powerful, but the Holy Sword Realm was beyond imagination.
In a single thought, all the swords in the world could be put to use, become followers of the Holy Sword?
Could it be that, in a single thought, all swords under heaven gain spiritual wisdom, ready to go through fire and water for the Holy Sword?
Unthinkable!
"With the Wisdom Sword Realm already so difficult to comprehend, so profound and powerful, when will I be able to fully understand the Holy Sword Realm?
"Perhaps only when I transcend Domain, with sufficient Martial Arts Realm and insights, will I be able to truly understand the Holy Sword Realm," thought Xu Yan with a sigh.
After imparting the Holy Sword Realm to Xu Yan, Li Xuan naturally passed on the realms beyond Bright Knife Realm to Meng Chong. There were similarities between the Blade Path and Sword Dao.
Therefore, beyond the Bright Knife Realm, there was also something called the Holy Knife Realm, similar to the Holy Sword Realm once one entered it.
Li Xuan had thought about giving a distinctive and profound name to the realms beyond Bright Knife Realm in the Blade Path, to be different from Sword Dao.
Alas, it was not easy to devise, so he had to settle for the name Holy Knife Realm.
"Whether it's Sword Dao or Blade Path, in the end, both lead to the same destination, differing only in the intent of the blade or sword,"
Li Xuan concluded after the impartation.
The teaching of Martial Arts had come to an end, and from here on, it would all depend on his disciples.
As for Li Xuan, it was time to arrange for the subsequent Martial Arts, including creating powerful Divine Skills and classifying their levels.
"Being a Martial Ancestor isn't easy after all, it's too taxing on the brain,"
```

chapters.title: Chapter 722 - 381: Above the Sword of Wisdom, Awaiting the Spread of My Fame to the Divine Realm_2
chapters.content:
Li Xuan sighed inwardly.
Xu Yan and Meng Chong each found a place to settle down and contemplate.
Fang Hao also went back to busy himself with the affairs of the Qimen Institute, where both artifact refining and formations were incredibly demanding tasks. Not to mention the whole Qinghua state, even just the demand for formations from the Da Yue Country was immense.
Su Lingxiu was the same, busy with alchemy and researching various pills.
As for Jiang Buping, this newly accepted disciple, he was also in seclusion comprehending the Extreme Soul Martial Arts Techniques, but Li Xuan guessed that it would be quite some time before he could make any headway.
The Imperishable Qi was not so easily overcome.
"Finally, I can quietly study the Book of Taicang again."
Li Xuan exhaled and took out the Book of Taicang to continue his research.
Time flew by. After arriving in the Divine Realm, everyone was busy. No one disturbed Li Xuan in his courtyard, and he enjoyed the peace.
However, he was far from leisurely. Though he appeared to be calmly reading, his mind was engaged elsewhere, racking his brains over the grand cause of Martial Arts.
One day, Wu Tianan broke through into the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable Realm.
Xin Mengrou and Moon Changming also achieved their breakthroughs one after the other, followed by Fu Tianhai and Emperor Da Zhou, who also broke through into the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable Realm.
Xie Tianheng soon followed, and once he broke through, he became arrogant again, seeking out his father-in-law for a spar and defeating Fu Tianhai.
Fu Tianhai was not pleased and spent his days with a gloomy face, complaining to his daughter about the kind of husband she had chosen, one who did not know how to show filial piety to his father-in-law.
Fu Yun was so annoyed that every time Fu Tianhai complained, she would beat up Xie Tianheng once, making the family quite lively.
The farce only ended when Xie Tianheng admitted defeat to his father-in-law.
"Your disciple Xu Yan, has broken through into the grand achievement stage of the Divine Skill Realm, and your divine power has doubled."
Xu Yan had achieved the grand completion of the Divine Skill Realm.
"My strength has grown a bit more."
Li Xuan felt a twinge of regret that he hadn't advanced in realm, and that only his divine power had doubled.
With Xu Yan's breakthrough, Meng Chong also achieved a minor completion in the Divine Skill Realm.
Su Lingxiu also advanced to a minor completion, and Li Xuan's power grew once more, although the increase wasn't much.
Half a year after arriving in Da Yue Country, Du Yuying, Yun Miaomiao, Zi Yun, and Yue'er all successively broke through into the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable Realm.
And that day, the Upper Sects of Taimiao Sect, Da Zhou State, and Yuntian Azure Sea City, each sent their powerhouses over.
Finally, it was time to say goodbye again.
"Meng Chong, you must come to find me, okay?"
Zi Yun clung to Meng Chong and said.
She had also wanted to stay, but considering that the Martial Arts she cultivated were ultimately different, only by going to the Upper Sect of Da Zhou Country could she cultivate better.
"Alright, when I travel the Divine Realm, I'll definitely visit your place."
Meng Chong nodded.
The background of Da Zhou Country, stronger than Yuling Mansion, Thousand Martial Hall, and Leiyun Mountain Manor, belonged to the first dynasty of the Divine Realm, the subordinate of the Da Yan Dynasty.
The Da Yan Dynasty ruled over the Da Yan Realm within the great domains of the Divine Realm, with extremely strong power, surpassing Da Yue Country by far too much.
Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao were also about to leave, bidding farewell to Xu Yan and Su Lingxiu.
The Upper Sect of Taimiao Sect, which was the Taimiao God Sect, possessed tremendous strength, ranking among the top powers in the Divine Realm.
And because of the unique cultivation technique Xin Mengrou practiced, joining the Taimiao God Sect would also garner attention, ensuring her status would not be low.
The forces of Yuntian Island in the Azure Sea Sphere of Yuntian Azure Sea City were also extremely strong, inhabited by the Sea Spirit clan.
However, Cai Ling'er had no plans to go to the Azure Sea Sphere; she chose to stay behind. For her, the greatest opportunity was to follow a true master.
"Brother Xu, I will wait for you in the Azure Sea Sphere!"
Xie Lingfeng said with a smile.
He was set to head to the Azure Sea Sphere with his parents and grandfather.
"Alright!"
Xu Yan nodded.
Xie Lingfeng was not far from the Divine Skill Realm, and it was believed that upon arriving in the Azure Sea Sphere, he would soon break through.
Moreover, all Martial Arts Techniques up to the Void-breaking Realm had been passed on to Xie Lingfeng; there would be no stagnation in his cultivation.
If Xie Lingfeng cultivated to the Void-breaking Realm, his strength would be stronger than that of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable and sufficient to be unrivaled in the Divine Realm.
However, with the existence of the Heavenly Grotto in the Divine Realm and the threat of invaders from beyond, entering the Heavenly Grotto to fight was ultimately dangerous.
Fortunately, everyone had life-saving charms.
After bidding a reluctant farewell, they set off on the road to the Upper Sects with their leaders.
As everyone familiar from the Spiritual Realm left, Wu Tianan stayed for a few more days before taking his leave to wander the Divine Realm in search of his guide in Martial Arts.
Everyone had found their path in Martial Arts, and Xu Yan with Meng Chong were also ready to venture out.
"Master, I will not return until I reach the Void-breaking Realm!"
Xu Yan respectfully bid farewell to his master.
"Go, the path of martial arts ultimately lies beneath your feet. Explore the divine domain of the world, marvel at its mysteries, and it will aid in the comprehension of martial arts,"
Li Xuan nodded and said.
He wasn't worried about his disciple's safety—after all, he possessed life-saving jade charms.
Moreover, Xu Yan and Meng Chong were no longer greenhorns in the martial arts realm; they were seasoned and experienced.
Additionally, they both possessed life-preserving divine skills.
Xu Yan was not far from reaching the Physiognomy Realm. Once he stepped into it, even ordinary Immortal Heavenly Venerables would not be able to breach his Yin Yang Undying Sword's defenses.
Meng Chong was the same, with incredibly strong defenses, and his techniques for concealment and escape were far beyond those of a Taicang martial artist.
Su Lingxiu, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping, who had been in seclusion comprehending Extreme Soul Martial Arts, surfaced temporarily.
"Big Senior Brother, Second Senior Brother, I await the spread of your fame throughout the divine domain,"
Su Lingxiu said cheerfully.
"Alright!"
Xu Yan nodded.
Meng Chong, rubbing his bald head, said, "Junior Sister just wait, my fame will spread throughout the divine domain just like it did in the Spiritual Realm."
"Junior Brother, where are you heading next?"
Xu Yan asked Meng Chong with a smile.
"I plan to roam Qinghua state for now. I want to explore Heavenly Grotto, kill some blood slaves and blood disciples, and loot some treasures from there,"
Meng Chong replied after some thought.
"I've had the same thought. I'll head to the Tianwu Sect's territory; it's precisely in the Thousand Martial Hall's upper sect. Suddenly, I miss those days of besieging the Thousand Martial Hall's gates. Sadly, I can't do the same in Tianwu Sect,"
Xu Yan said with a hint of regret.
"If Big Senior Brother is going to Tianwu Sect, then I'll head to the Myriad Thunder Sect,"
Meng Chong decided.
The two sworn brothers, after bidding farewell to their junior brothers and sisters, set off on their respective journeys.
Fang Hao looked on with envy, "What a pity, I can't leave my duties, and my strength is somewhat lacking. My path in martial arts differs from Big Senior Brother and Second Senior Brother; otherwise, I would also explore. I'll have to wait until my strength increases before I take my turn,"
Su Lingxiu, however, had no such thoughts and spoke with a smile, "I still prefer to stay by Master's side. Wherever Master goes, I shall follow, and likewise, I can traverse the world."
Jiang Buping had an envious look on his face, sighing, "It's a shame that I have ailments and haven't yet entered the threshold of martial arts, or else I would also venture out into this divine domain."
His gaze firmed, his expression solemn, "I will return to the Taikun Realm. There are some people, some debts that must be settled!"
"Junior Brother, I believe you will surely succeed in your cultivation, and you will resolve the issue of the Imperishable Qi. Then, you can seek your revenge,"
Su Lingxiu comforted him.
"Fifth Junior Brother, if you need anything, your Senior Brother here will lend you a hand to help you demonstrate your might in the Taikun Realm, showing those people how you look down upon the prodigies of the divine domain!"
Fang Hao patted Jiang Buping on the shoulder and said.
"Thank you, Third Senior Sister and Fourth Senior Brother. I will definitely succeed in my cultivation,"
Jiang Buping said with renewed vigor.
Fang Hao continued to be busy with the affairs of the Qimen Institute, while also teaching the art of Formation.
And Su Lingxiu did the same, starting to teach the art of Alchemical Medical and impart knowledge of alchemy.
Jiang Buping returned to his grueling seclusion.
The small courtyard quieted down. Li Xuan sat in a chair, holding the Book of Taicang, with only Cai Ling'er attending to him.
"Your bloodline is extraordinary, carrying the Sea Spirit Emperor's bloodline that has yet to be activated. Once activated, you will inherit the Sea Spirit Emperor's legacy.
"Well, you have followed me for some time now, so I shall guide you to activate your bloodline,"
Li Xuan said, looking at Cai Ling'er who was quietly brewing tea and attending to him.
"Thank you, Predecessor!"
Cai Ling'er was startled, then quickly knelt down excitedly to thank him.
"Since you've chosen to serve by my side, don't call me Predecessor anymore, call me... Master,"
Li Xuan said with a smile.
"Yes, Master!"
Cai Ling'er said joyfully.
Li Xuan lifted a finger and transmitted the method to activate the bloodline into Cai Ling'er's divine soul.
"Go, find a place to activate your bloodline by yourself. You need not serve by my side for the next few days,"
Li Xuan's gaze returned to the Book of Taicang.
"Yes!"
Cai Ling'er bowed reverently and left excitedly to seclude herself and activate her bloodline.

chapters.title: Chapter 723 - 382 Iron Ridge Heavenly Grotto, Wisdom Sword Slays Demons
chapters.content:
Qinghua state experienced a massive invasion from the Netherworld Cave, and although the great battle had subsided, the two sides had resumed their standoff.
Yet within Qinghua state, turmoil was unceasing.
This time, the large-scale invasion by the Netherworld had caused Qinghua state, and especially Da Yue Country, to reel as if on the verge of collapse, leading some martial artists to defect to the Netherworld.
Now that the Netherworld had been repelled, these defectors, who had become Blood Shadows, were hiding everywhere, even sowing chaos, for they could not turn back.
Those who had secretly pledged allegiance, but yet to become Blood Shadows or Blood Slaves, Blood Disciples, were living in constant fear, dreading the day their betrayal would be exposed.
Some, as a result, had been caught and were being used by others.
Although Qinghua state was ruled by three major powers, there were many other forces, big and small, and a reshuffling of the power landscape was quietly unfolding.
For Da Yue Country, Myriad Thunder Sect, and Tianwu Sect, as long as the shifts among those forces did not concern them, they paid no mind, so long as the tasks of guarding their respective Heavenly Grottos were completed.
Within the territory overseen by Tianwu Sect, in the range of Iron Ridge Mountain, there was a Heavenly Grotto, which in Qinghua state, was considered above average.
The guardians of this Heavenly Grotto were a second-tier family sect, and one of the family heads had perished in the recent assault, weakening their power.
The Sect Master of this sect, seeing that he could not hold out and fearing Qinghua state was at risk of falling, had secretly sworn fealty to the Netherworld.
But before he could fulfill his role as an inside agent, Da Yue Country defeated the Netherworld invaders, dispatching powerful reinforcements to aid the four corners, with several True King Heavenly Venerables arriving to suppress this Heavenly Grotto.
Unfortunately, his seemingly secretive pledge of allegiance had been leaked, he was being blackmailed, and his power was being stripped away step by step, leaving him helpless.
The sect had reached a critical juncture.
The elders within the sect had all expressed their dissatisfaction with him as Sect Master, so he could only temporarily assuage them with the excuse of having suffered hidden injuries during the battle, which had weakened him and forced him to retreat.
He even used the pretext of needing to meditate and heal to avoid managing the affairs of the sect.
"Master Wei, you know what to do, right?"
In a hidden valley of Iron Ridge Mountain, a man in a black robe, wearing a mask, spoke with a sinister laugh.
Master Wei's face was extremely somber as he said in a heavy voice, "Your Shao Family, have you pledged to the Netherworld?"
The Shao Family, one of the second-tier families of Iron Ridge, was also the power that had suffered the least in the Netherworld invasion.
"Master Wei, who told you that I am from the Shao Family?"
The masked man sneered.
"Heh, you strive at every turn to seize power for the Shao Family, to extend their influence in Iron Ridge. If you're not from the Shao Family, then who else would you be?"
Master Wei retorted with a cold laugh.
"Master Wei, I advise you not to overthink things. The plan must be completed, or you know the consequences."
The masked man said with a smile.
"Iron Ridge Sky Cave cannot accommodate the entry of Xuezhi, even if I am willing to act as an inside agent, Xuezhi cannot get in!"
Master Wei stated firmly.
"Qinghua state needs a Xuezhi to back us up, but not to let Xuezhi in, a Blood Disciple will suffice. In three days, a Blood Disciple will enter the Iron Ridge Sky Cave.
"All you need to do, your task is to deceive the guard and allow the Blood Disciple to enter Qinghua state. Once the Blood Disciple enters Qinghua state, ascent to Xuezhi will be easy."
The masked man spoke with gravity.
Master Wei's expression changed as he thought of Xuezhi Tu, who had initially entered Qinghua state as a Blood Disciple and had sacrificed the Prefecture City of Qi Yun County to ascend to Xuezhi.
"What's the matter, Master Wei? Have you developed a conscience and no longer wish to carry out such deeds?"
The masked man looked at the hesitant Master Wei and spoke with a sinister tone.
"Rest assured, I will ensure the task is done,"
Master Wei took a deep breath and said.
By now, he had no way of turning back.
"That is best, I will await the good news from Master Wei!"
After speaking, the masked man's figure shifted and then vanished from the spot.
"No turning back now!"
Master Wei muttered to himself and then turned to leave.
Not long after the two had left, Xu Yan stepped out from behind a large tree.
"Qinghua state really is in chaos, full of traitors."
Both the masked man and Master Wei were True King Heavenly Venerables, and they were not weak. Killing the two would be no easy feat.
"Head to Iron Ridge Sky Cave, eh? A Blood Disciple, is it? If I kill the Blood Disciple they've gone through so much trouble to escort here, and then reveal their traitorous identities..."
Xu Yan plotted internally.
Facing off against a Blood Disciple and killing him would be very difficult.
Even now that he had reached the pinnacle of the Divine Skill Realm, a Blood Disciple tasked with infiltrating Qinghua state to replicate the feat of Xuezhi Tu would undoubtedly be among the stronger of the Blood Disciples.
If he couldn't kill his opponent in a direct confrontation, then he wouldn't confront directly.
The turmoil at Iron Ridge Sky Cave had settled, and on this day, it was the turn of Master Wei's sect to guard the Sky Cave.
"Sect Master, you've come?"
The elder guarding the cave was taken aback upon seeing Master Wei's arrival.
"Yes, I'm going to check on the Heavenly Grotto to prevent another Blood Disciple invasion."
Master Wei nodded.
After entering the Heavenly Grotto, he reached its depths, where another True King Heavenly Venerable was stationed.
"I will seclude myself here for a few days; you should return to the sect and rest for a while,"
He said to the True King Heavenly Venerable.
"Yes, Sect Master."
The True King Heavenly Venerable paused briefly before getting up and leaving.
Since the great battle, the sect's power had waned. Master Wei had repeatedly made concessions to the Shao Family, and they bore the brunt of the grueling task of guarding the Heavenly Grotto.

chapters.title: Chapter 724 - 382: Iron Ridge Sky Cave, Wisdom Sword Slays Demons_2
chapters.content:
The duty rotation was much longer than the time of the Shao Family's experts.
The Sect Master's visit was perhaps guilt-ridden, replacing him to temporarily guard for a few days.
Moreover, with the Sect Master's strength surpassing his, there naturally wouldn't be any issues with the Sect Master guarding this place.
In the depths of the Heavenly Grotto, only Master Wei remained.
He took out a Netherworld Blood Orb and threw it towards the blood membrane above, where the Blood Orb then merged into the membrane.
"Are the arrangements complete?"
After a while, a chilly voice came through.
"My Lord, everything has been arranged properly,"
Master Wei said solemnly.
"Very good!"
Amidst the blood mist, a blood-colored figure descended from within the blood membrane.
This Blood Disciple had pale red skin and a slightly white complexion, and his slender fingers were like steel claws, emitting a faint cold light.
His aura was incredibly powerful, although not quite on par with Xuezhi, yet comparable to the pinnacle of True King Heavenly Venerables.
"You've done well!"
The Blood Disciple nodded approvingly at Master Wei.
"Serving My Lord is my honor!"
Master Wei bowed deeply in respect.
"Let's go."
"Yes, My Lord, but to avoid revealing our tracks, please put on this armor,"
Master Wei said, taking out a set of armor he had prepared beforehand and handing it to the Blood Disciple.
After donning the armor, the Blood Disciple was fully enveloped in it, only his eyes visible. However, to deceive the other Martial Artists guarding the Heavenly Grotto with just this would not suffice.
"My Lord, please wait a moment while I send the people away."
Approaching the entrance of the Heavenly Grotto, Master Wei whispered.
"Hmm!"
The Blood Disciple responded with a sound.
Rushing to the entrance of the Heavenly Grotto, Master Wei looked at the guarding elder and said, "The Qimen Institute from Da Yue Country is coming today to set up some Formation. Take men to meet them a hundred miles away. I can guard here on my own."
The elder was startled and said, "Sect Master, shouldn't you lead the team…"
"I don't want to see the Shao Family's ugly faces!"
Anger was hidden in Master Wei's low voice.
"If that is the case, I will take people there," the elder said helplessly.
Since the Sect Master had been humiliated by the Shao Family, his temper had grown volatile.
To their regret, the Sect's strength had declined, and they couldn't reclaim their pride for the time being.
The elder, taking a few Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables with him, left, leaving only a small number of them guarding the entrance of the Heavenly Grotto. Master Wei took a look but wasn't concerned.
"My Lord, it's clear now. Those few people at the entrance are your Blood Nourishment," Master Wei said, smiling at the side of the Blood Disciple.
"Good, very good, consider this a merit for you," the Blood Disciple said joyfully.
Suddenly, the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables guarding the Heavenly Grotto had their expression change, raising their heads towards the incoming figure clad in armor.
"A Netherworld Blood Disciple!"
"Sect Master, what is this?"
Everyone was stunned. Had the Sect Master betrayed them and turned to the Netherworld?
Boom!
The Blood Disciple made his move, his fingernails, like steel claws, suddenly burst forth with a crimson light, grabbing several Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables at once.
"Ah! The Sect Master has betrayed us!"
A Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable roared angrily, attempting to send the message further out.
"Hmph!"
Master Wei snorted coldly, his True King Heavenly Venerable power already covering all directions, preventing the sound from escaping.
"Hehe, a fine blood meal."
The Blood Disciple laughed coldly, his claws suddenly lunging at one person's chest as if trying to dig out his heart.
Hum!
Suddenly, a black sword light slashed out from that person's hand.
This sword seemed capable of annihilating everything, unparallelled in its sharpness, unmatched in its lethality.
The sudden turn of events greatly changed the Blood Disciple's expression. Blood light surged on his body, and his form shook as he tried to block or evade the sword strike.
However, the sword was too fast, too unexpected.
A mere Condensation Law Realm warrior - he had never taken him seriously, hence he was unguarded. By the time the sword struck, it was already too late for him to react.
Pff!
The Supreme Heavenly Sword, eradicating all!
Xu Yan's fully prepared strike instantly killed the Blood Disciple!
He then raised his hand and struck a palm; the fiery red palm force, like the fire of the sun, directly obliterated the disintegrating corpse of the Blood Disciple, leaving not even ashes behind.
Caught off guard by the turn of events, Master Wei was shocked, feeling a tingling on his scalp. That sword's sharpness was like nothing he had ever seen before.
If such a sword were to be used against him, death was certain!
At this moment, his heart sank; he had exposed himself!
The Blood Disciple was killed!
"Sect Master, I never imagined you would actually betray us!"
At this moment, the guardian True King, who should have left, appeared in the Heavenly Cave, his expression furious, gritting his teeth in anger.
"You all knew already?"
Master Wei responded with a bitter smile.
"If it weren't for this young brother, you would have deceived us!"
An elder said coldly.
"Since that's the case, there's nothing more to say, let's fight!"
Master Wei took a deep breath, his gaze suddenly fierce, and he struck out at Xu Yan with a palm.
"Who are you!"
In front of Xu Yan, the Yin Yang Undying Sword cycled endlessly, and he said indifferently, "Sword God Xu Yan!"
"You've foiled my grand plan; today, I must kill you!"
Master Wei said uncontrollably angry.
"Sect Master, you are stubborn to the extreme!"
The two elders guarding the Heavenly Cave took action and jointly attacked Master Wei.
Boom!
Suddenly, the Heavenly Cave shook, blood light blossomed in the depths, and a series of bloody figures descended.
The Netherworld had invaded.
"Quickly send a message for reinforcements; the Iron Ridge Heavenly Cave has been invaded by enemies from the Netherworld!"
An elder said in a deep voice.
"Elder, the message has already been sent out."
At the entrance of the Heavenly Cave, a Martial Artist responded.
"I'll go suppress the Netherworld invaders."
Xu Yan moved, heading deep into the Heavenly Cave, and with a palm-lift, a dragon's roar sounded, a Golden Giant Dragon roaring as it charged toward the descending bloody figures.
Boom!
Great battle erupted.
Seeing the endless appearance of Blood Slaves and even a Blood Disciple, Xu Yan was invigorated, his eyes brimming with battle intent.
"This is a perfect chance to hone my Divine Skills!"
In an instant, mountains and rivers appeared, Mountains and Rivers in the Sword!
True Dragon Rage, Supreme Heavenly Sword, Great Sky Hand... Several Divine Skills were used at the same time, one person holding off the invading Netherworld Army.
One after another, Blood Slaves were slaughtered in the sword light, and even that Blood Disciple felt threatened, his crimson long knife slashing repeatedly but unable to wound Xu Yan in the slightest.
Behind, the two elders who were attacking Master Wei were still at a disadvantage; amidst the great battle, all three were shocked. What kind of Martial Arts was this?
It was too powerful.
A young man alone, fighting the enemies from the Netherworld without falling behind.
Xu Yan became more and more excited as he fought, growing stronger and stronger; amidst his boiling passion, it was as if he had gained a new understanding of Martial Arts, Divine Skills, and the way of killing.
"This is my path, the path to being unrivaled."
Xu Yan reflected deeply in his heart.
Hum!
At a certain moment, a sword slashed out, and the sword light in midair, as if having its own spiritual wisdom, turned a corner, bypassing the Blood Disciple's defense, piercing into the shoulder of the Blood Disciple from behind.
Splurt!
Blood sputtered as the Blood Disciple wore an expression of shock. A sword with spirit?
What kind of Sword Dao was this?
At a certain moment, a dragon's roar sounded; this roar was somewhat different from the previous ones.
It was as if it held a form of spirituality.
The Golden Giant Dragon's piercing eyes exuded divine might; it raised a dragon claw and fiercely struck, with lightning appearing on its claw, it then shifted its position as though it wasn't just a force of palm but a real True Dragon.
Xu Yan closed his eyes slightly; sword light continuously surged from his hand, each strand seemingly executing a form of Swordsmanship, as if it could fight on its own.
Roar!
Another Golden Giant Dragon roared forth, slaughtering into the Blood Slaves and even diving up, striking the blood membrane, directly annihilating the Blood Slaves that had yet to descend.
"This is the marvel of the Wisdom Sword indeed!"
Xu Yan was absorbed in his profound understandings, and the mysteries of the Wisdom Sword Realm continued to emerge.
Above the Spirit Pedestal, the Primordial Spirit held a sword, and the invisible Sword Intent appeared to spread throughout the Spirit Pedestal, forming a profound state.
At a certain moment, a small golden dragon appeared above the Spirit Pedestal, circling around the Primordial Spirit; its eyes sparkled brilliantly, as if full of spiritual wisdom.
"Subduing Dragon Palm's seventh layer, arises with wind and thunder, hides without a trace..."
At a certain moment, the Golden Giant Dragon disappeared among the Blood Slave Army, as if it had concealed itself with no trace to be found; suddenly, a dragon claw emerged, wrapped in the power of wind and thunder, instantly tearing apart a Blood Slave.
Soon another dragon's roar resounded, the wind and thunder roared, the dragon shadows whirled, the dragon's might was vast, and a fierce rage surged.
Hum!
Inside the Heavenly Cave, a sound of sword singing arose as if all things in the Heavenly Cave had become swords, each possessing a sort of spiritual wisdom, and more terrifyingly, these swords formed some kind of sword array.
"Wisdom Sword Slays Demons!"
Xu Yan opened his eyes, his demeanor free and easy; with a wave of his hand, the Sword Formation was arrayed, and the dragon's might rose, including the Blood Disciple and all the Netherworld invaders, entirely turned to dust and smoke!

chapters.title: Chapter 725 - 383 Physical Body Martial Arts Breakthrough, The New Era of Qinghua State
chapters.content:
```
In the Iron Ridge Sky Cave, Xu Yan demonstrated his divine might, slaying a host of enemies from the Netherworld, while Master Wei, who was battling two elders, was now overcome with fear.
"Who is this person, so powerful, and their Martial Arts Techniques are simply unimaginable."
"Never have I heard of such wondrous methods in the Qinghua state; could he be an unparalleled genius from the Great Realm?"
Escape!
I must escape!
Master Wei struck out frantically, causing the two elders to be in a sorry state, seeking a chance to flee. Suddenly, a sword light descended from the sky, accompanied by the sound of a dragon's roar.
Moreover, a large hand, imbued with tremendous might, came crashing down on him.
Xu Yan had already made his move!
The upheaval in the Iron Ridge Sky Cave and Master Wei's betrayal swiftly spread through the territory of the Tianwu Sect, which became furious upon realizing that some traitors had not yet been exposed.
An immediate order for investigation was issued, starting inspections of all forces guarding the Sky Caves within their territory.
The name of Sword God Xu Yan also spread throughout the Tianwu Sect's domain, a man who annihilated the invaders from the Netherworld and ultimately killed Master Wei.
Although assisted by two True King Heavenly Venerables, to be able to slay Master Wei in such a short time, his strength was considerably formidable—within the Qinghua state, there was likely no peer to compare.
Especially that mystical Sword Dao and the lifelike True Dragon surpassed all imagination. Such Martial Arts Techniques were truly inconceivable.
"He truly is the disciple of a great master," the Sect Master of Tianwu Sect exclaimed with admiration.
The other elders nodded in agreement, awed by the wonder of the disciple of a high and mighty figure.
In the Tianwu Sect, no one of the same generation could match him.
"No one should offend the disciple of a great master; afford him every convenience possible," the Sect Master of Tianwu Sect solemnly stated.
Whether due to the formidable deterrence of a great master or due to cooperation with Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu, it was imperative to adopt the correct attitude and not offend the disciple of a high and mighty figure.
Xu Yan traveled within the regions ruled by the Tianwu Sect, entering various Sky Caves to hone his Martial Arts.
Not long afterward, within the domain of the Myriad Thunder Sect, news spread of a bald, fierce youth with an extraordinarily robust physique, single-handedly vanquishing Blood Slaves. The ferociousness of his battles shocked the observing martial artists.
With a giant sun overhead and wind and thunder at his command—transforming into a Golden Armor Giant—he was unstoppable, akin to a Heavenly God.
Consequently, the name Heavenly God Meng Chong began to spread, outweighing the previous title of Knife Ultimate Meng Chong.
The name of Heavenly God Meng Chong began to proliferate widely.
"Heavenly God Meng Chong, no longer called Knife Ultimate, huh," Su Lingxiu remarked with a sigh in the small courtyard of Alchemical Medical Institute in the Capital City of Da Yue Country.
"Senior Sister, you're still known as the Alchemical Medical Fairy," Fang Hao said with a smile.
News of Xu Yan and Meng Chong's exploits had reached them. Since Fang Hao began refining Communication Talismans and rebuilding a communication system similar to the Wanshi Alliance in the Qinghua state, information was being transmitted much faster.
Teleportation Formations were also being arranged, and the teaching of the Formation Path had begun. Some simple formations no longer required his direct involvement.
Li Xuan marveled internally that truly wandering the Martial Arts Realm was more suitable for Xu Yan and Meng Chong. It had not been long since their last exploits, and they were already making advancements.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has broken through to the Wisdom Sword Realm; your understanding of the Wisdom Sword Realm has become profound," Li Xuan thought as Xu Yan finally stepped into the Wisdom Sword Realm.
As for when he could comprehend and practice the direction of the Holy Sword Realm was still unknown, but Li Xuan had confidence in Xu Yan.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has broken through to the seventh layer of the Subduing Dragon Palm; your mastery of the Subduing Dragon Palm has reached the seventh layer."
The Subduing Dragon Palm had also made a breakthrough.
The seventh layer of the Subduing Dragon Palm represented a significant breakthrough—with one palm strike, it was no longer merely the violent and incomparable force of the Subduing Dragon Palm but as if an actual True Dragon was being conjured.
This True Dragon possessed a measure of the true dragon's essence.
"The seventh layer of the Subduing Dragon Palm has reached the level of Divine Skills now, embodying the beginnings of the Subduing Dragon principle," thought Li Xuan with joy.
Xu Yan's True Dragon Rage, a Divine Skill derived from the Subduing Dragon Palm, and the seventh layer of the Subduing Dragon Palm itself was equivalent to Divine Skills.
True Dragon Rage and the Subduing Dragon Palm could be perfectly combined, as if merging two Divine Skills, naturally increasing its power.
"Your disciple Meng Chong has attained enlightenment of the second layer of the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body; your Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body has broken through the second layer."
As news of Xu Yan and Meng Chong's achievements reached one after another, Meng Chong, in the Myriad Thunder Sect's Sky Cave, endured an attack from a top-tier Blood Disciple using his robust physique. He demonstrated his mighty physical strength but also suffered some minor injuries at that moment.
The feedback from the Daoist Golden Book also appeared.
Meng Chong had attained enlightenment of the second layer of the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body—it was clearly a result of his epiphany during a fierce battle, as he boldly resisted attacks with his body, revealing a dominant physical might.
In the midst of battle, facing perilous fights, even sustaining minor injuries as a price, he had been enlightened on the second layer of the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body.
"Physical Body Martial Arts have also broken through to the Void-breaking Realm."
Li Xuan's body underwent a transformation; within his acupoints, it was as if stars were being nurtured. The mighty stars that orbited his body made it seem as if it were as vast as the Domain itself.
"The convergence of myriad stars into one body—I almost have a direction for the subsequent layers of the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body's physical aspect."
At that moment, Li Xuan had an idea; he had found the path for the continuing development of the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body.
"With my current strength, crushing Emperor Da Yue with just one hand would be a breeze."
Li Xuan was thrilled.
As his Physical Body Martial Arts broke through to the Void-breaking Realm, his strength naturally increased significantly, and with sheer brute force alone, he could easily crush an Immortal Heavenly Venerable like Emperor Da Yue.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 726 - 383 Breakthrough in Physical Body Martial Arts, The New Era of Qinghua State_2
chapters.content:
"Su Lingxiu, that girl, should also be about to grasp the Void-breaking Realm, right?"
Li Xuan was filled with anticipation.
Once Su Lingxiu also comprehended it, all three of his Martial Arts would have reached the Void-breaking Realm, which would naturally result in a further increase in strength.
Fang Hao's Qimen Martial Art had always been progressing, after all, the cultivation of the Qimen Martial Art was quite special; elevating it to a level comparable to the Void-breaking Realm was not so easy.
"When will Jiang Buping finally succeed in cultivating the Extreme Soul Martial Art?"
Li Xuan thought of his newly accepted disciple, Jiang Buping.
During this period of time, he had been in seclusion, trying to integrate the Imperishable Qi, to resolve the Imperishable Qi within the Divine Soul, transforming it into an Imperishable Divine Soul.
However, the Imperishable Qi wasn't so easy to resolve.
Nonetheless, Jiang Buping had made progress. As he continued to comprehend and try to integrate the Imperishable Qi, his mental consciousness, even without being stimulated, started to focus a bit more.
This was a good sign, indicating that the method to resolve the Imperishable Qi was correct. What followed would rely on time, to slowly dissolve it bit by bit.
The process would inevitably take a long time, but at least there was hope.
And the first step was often the hardest; once the Imperishable Qi was resolved, his Divine Soul would no longer fear it. He could even try to absorb a little Imperishable Qi to cultivate his Divine Soul.
"Jiang Buping is at the True King Heavenly Venerable Realm. Once he resolves the Imperishable Qi and transforms into an Imperishable Divine Soul and successfully cultivates the Extreme Soul Martial Art, his strength will not be weaker than a True King Heavenly Venerable.
"And this is just the beginning. As his cultivation progresses, the power of the Extreme Soul Martial Art will continue to unfold, and he may be able to raise his strength to that of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable in a relatively short time."
Li Xuan had a rough assessment of Jiang Buping's potential for a strength increase.
"For Xu Yan, this elder brother, maintaining his strong strength will be a bit of pressure now. But he's not far from the Physiognomy Realm. By the time Jiang Buping resolves the Imperishable Qi, Xu Yan will have already broken through to the Physiognomy Realm."
With Xu Yan's skill, once he enters the Physiognomy Realm, True King Heavenly Venerables will not be a match for him.
With the Yin Yang Undying Sword Divine Ability, even ordinary Immortal Heavenly Venerables would find it difficult to harm him.
"This is the new Communication Talisman. Although it cannot be used to send messages to the Divine Realm, communicating across most of the Qinghua state is not an issue, making the setup of a communication system much more convenient."
Fang Hao handed a stack of Communication Talismans to Emperor Da Yue, saying.
These were the new Communication Talismans he had refined, significantly extending the communication range. The next stage of Communication Talismans would be able to send messages wherever the Heaven and Earth Laws existed.
Due to the involvement of the Heaven and Earth Laws, Fang Hao's current strength was not enough to refine them, and his understanding of the Heaven and Earth Laws was also insufficient.
"Very good, very good. With these Communication Talismans, if any city in Qinghua state faces an incident, we can be informed promptly."
Emperor Da Yue was overjoyed.
Cheng Zhan, representing the Myriad Thunder Sect, was also overjoyed. The Communication Talismans had brought Qinghua state into a new era.
"At present, the Teleportation Formation can carry across a maximum distance of a hundred thousand li, which is currently the limit. Going further is not supported by the available Divine Materials.
"And, refining and setting up a hundred thousand li Teleportation Formation is not easy, requiring considerable expense."
Fang Hao followed up saying.
He was excited in his heart; collaborating with Emperor Da Yue was indeed a wise move.
With such vast resources at his disposal, whether it was Formation, Artifact Refining, Prohibition, etc., there had been significant improvements, reaching a new level.
The Qimen Martial Art was also rapidly advancing.
"Brother Fang, whatever you need, just say the word. The hundred thousand li Teleportation Formation should also be sufficient for now. The speed of support in all directions will significantly increase."
Emperor Da Yue said excitedly.
"Okay, then I won't be polite. Each activation of the Teleportation Formation requires the use of Spirit Crystals. These are minor issues. The main point is that the protective Great Formation of the Teleportation Formation must be able to withstand attacks.
"Moreover, it is very important that, if the Teleportation Formation gets attacked and damaged during the process, the people being teleported can still emerge unscathed..."
Fang Hao then became busy with the arrangements for setting up the Teleportation Formation.
Elsewhere, in the Alchemical Medical Institute, with a wave of her hand, Su Lingxiu made a large jar appear, filled with Pills.
"Emperor Da Yue, these pills can increase the chances of a breakthrough from the Condensation Law Realm to the Truth Refinement Realm, and can help overcome the bottleneck of the Condensation Law Realm. This is the Truth Refinement Pill, a total of ten thousand pieces.
I dare not say more, but it should be enough to increase your Da Yue Country's ranks by a few hundred True King Heavenly Venerables,"
A few hundred True King Heavenly Venerables would significantly increase the strength of Da Yue Country.
"Good, good, good!"
Emperor Da Yue was overjoyed and naturally continued to provide a steady stream of various rare divine medicines to Su Lingxiu's hands.
"This pill can heal the damage to the foundation, even if it's a True King Heavenly Venerable. For general foundation injuries, it can achieve recovery. If the damage is too severe, they would need to come to me for treatment,"
Su Lingxiu continued to take out more pills.
"Many thanks, Miss Su!"
Emperor Da Yue was thrilled.
Immediately thereafter, he asked with a solemn expression, "Miss Su, do you have any pills that can increase the chances of breaking through to the Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm?"
It is easy to refine truth, but hard to step into immortality!
This saying was widely circulated in the Divine Realm.
In the entire Qinghua state, there was no precise count of how many True King Heavenly Venerables there were, but the number of Immortal Heavenly Venerables was clear. Only Da Yue Country, Myriad Thunder Sect, and Tianwu Sect had Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
All together, there were fewer than twenty!
From this, it could be seen just how difficult it was to enter the Immortal Realm.
Many ancient True King Heavenly Venerables had long been at the peak of True Kings and even continued to accumulate their foundation for countless years until their lifespan was exhausted without ever stepping into the Immortal Realm.
The appearance of pills gave Emperor Da Yue and others hope that the chances of breaking through to the Immortal Realm might be increased.
Every additional Immortal Heavenly Venerable was of great significance to Qinghua state, capable of significantly boosting the overall strength of the realm.
They would be better equipped to handle invasions from the Netherworld.
Even if this Immortal Heavenly Venerable was somewhat weaker, it would still be so.
Su Lingxiu fell into deep thought. The Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm was too high, and moreover, she didn't practice Taicang Martial Arts. How to refine pills that could increase the chances of breaking through to the Immortal Heavenly Venerable wasn't easy for her and would require more time to ponder.
Furthermore, even if she figured it out, whether she could actually refine them at her current level was uncertain.
One thing that was certain was that the ingredients required to refine pills for breaking through to the Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm would be extremely extraordinary. A single failure in refinement would mean a significant loss.
Of course, these losses would be borne by Emperor Da Yue and the others. Su Lingxiu wasn't concerned with this. What she needed to consider was how to research the appropriate pills.
"Emperor Da Yue, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm is truly extraordinary. To increase the chances of a breakthrough is not easy, and the required ingredients will certainly be extremely rare.
"How about this, you can provide me with a list of heavenly treasures from the Divine Realm, and even gather some for me. Only then can I more easily research the suitable pills,"
Su Lingxiu finally spoke.
"Of course, no problem!"
Emperor Da Yue nodded.
The pills to increase the chances of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm breakthrough were not just a matter for him. Thus, the ingredients needed by Su Lingxiu were not to be shouldered by Da Yue Country alone.
Once she truly made a breakthrough in her research, not just Da Yue Country, Myriad Thunder Sect, and Tianwu Sect, but the very top True King Heavenly Venerables on the verge of stepping into the Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm would benefit.
With the help of pills, it was inevitable that some would achieve a breakthrough.
Emperor Da Yue left contentedly with the pills, Cheng Zhan on behalf of Myriad Thunder Sect also purchased the needed pills from Su Lingxiu. Tianwu Sect did the same, everyone was happy.
Su Lingxiu understood that whether it was Da Yue Country, Myriad Thunder Sect, or Tianwu Sect's respectful treatment towards her, their eagerness to fulfill her wishes, and their abstention from harboring any ulterior motives, were all due to the deterrent effect of her master.
"I can't rely on my master for everything. I need to improve my own strength too. Although my Alchemical Medical Martial Arts doesn't specialize in combat, that is only when compared to the first senior brother and the second senior brother,"
Su Lingxiu murmured to herself, realizing that only with strong personal strength could she truly face any threat.
The emergence of formations and pills undoubtedly ushered the Martial Arts Realm of Qinghua state into a new era, turning a new page. For the martial artists of Qinghua state, formations and pills were no longer unfamiliar terms.
However, the scarcity of pills also made them a luxury in the Martial Arts Realm of Qinghua state.

chapters.title: Chapter 727 - 384: The Way of Divine Skills, Witch's Heavenly Grotto
chapters.content:
```
The Qinghua state was undergoing earth-shaking changes, starting with pills, which gradually entered the vision of Martial Artists in the Condensation Law Realm, with all Martial Artists sharing a common knowledge: Pills can accelerate the cultivation of Martial Arts and increase the chances of breakthroughs.
Artifact Refining also came into the view of Martial Artists, as almost all former blacksmiths turned to learn and cultivate the Technique of Artifact Refining. With the spread of Artifact Refining, the biggest change was the increased power of the weapons in the Martial Artists' hands.
This also resulted in a significant enhancement to the overall strength of Qinghua state, most vividly reflected in the Blood Disciples and Blood Slaves in the Netherworld Cave. The pressure faced in battles had increased greatly—from the last battle to the next.
The power displayed by the weapons of Qinghua state's Martial Artists had increased by more than thirty percent.
And with the spread of pills, casualties were greatly reduced.
The most direct example was a Martial Artist who was severely damaged by a strike in battle, would have had no chance to survive the battlefield before, but after consuming a pill, recovered sixty to seventy percent of the injuries in a short time and roared back into the fray.
Gradually, a saying spread within Qinghua state: "Qimen produces exceptional Artifact Refining, the source of the Alchemy Dao lies in Lingxiu."
Artifact Refining comes from Qimen's Fang Hao, and the Alchemy Dao from the Alchemical Medical Fairy, Su Lingxiu!
The names of Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu echoed throughout Qinghua state, becoming figures worshipped by the Martial Artists there. Any Martial Artist involved in Artifact Refining or Alchemy paid homage to Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu.
And gradually, Artifact Refiners and Alchemists held revered positions within Qinghua state, with everyone aspiring to become one.
However, whether it was Artifact Refining or Alchemy, both required a certain talent.
In five years, Qinghua state had gone from initial crisis and turmoil, nearly being successfully invaded by the Netherworld, to now entering a new era, with a significant surge in the strength of the Martial Arts realm and the emergence of two special types of Martial Artists: Artifact Refiners and Alchemists.
The Netherworld Caves were being cleared one after another, greatly suppressing the arrogance of the Netherworld and significantly reducing their chances of invading.
And all of these changes were rooted in what happened five years ago when the Divine Bridge opened, and revered figures descended!
Because of this, those Prodigies that came from the Spiritual Realm received a lot of attention and preferential cultivation. Of course, these Spirit Body Prodigies also had remarkable natural talent, and their strength improved rapidly.
The names Xu Yan and Meng Chong were already well-known throughout Qinghua state.
Not long ago, Xu Yan exchanged several blows with a Xuezhi in a Tianwu Sect Cave. Although he was defeated, he retreated with ease.
And with Xu Yan's fame spreading far and wide, the ideology of Sword Dao began to disseminate throughout Qinghua state, inspiring every Sword Dao Martial Artist to pursue the true path of Sword Dao.
For instance, attaining Sword Heart Clarity or comprehending Sword Intent.
Now, in the entire Qinghua state, all Martial Artists who practiced Sword Dao believed that without Sword Heart Clarity, one could not be considered to have truly entered the threshold of Sword Dao.
Similarly, the concept of Sword Momentum spread, and many Sword Dao Martial Artists began to start by cultivating Sword Momentum, which also resulted in a significant increase in their strength.
In the world of Sword Dao, Xu Yan is revered, and this saying is widely circulated in Qinghua state.
The name Heavenly God Meng Chong also resonated through Qinghua state and was worshipped by Martial Artists who respected sheer physical strength and brawn as the paragon of Body Cultivation and a guide for those paths.
This was because Meng Chong taught the Warriors Heavenly Hammer Hundred Refinement Skill, leading these Martial Artists onto the path of Body Cultivation. Although it was not a pure Physical Body Martial Arts, it did carve out a branch in the realm of Taicang Martial Arts.
Five years is not a long time for the powerful, but for Qinghua state, it was a period of transformative change.
Even some strong individuals who retreated into seclusion for intensive cultivation found the entire Qinghua state unrecognizable when they emerged just a few years later.
There were discussions of Formations and pills everywhere, with Martial Artists conversing about Sword Momentum, Sword Heart Clarity, Sword Intent, or discussing what kind of Spiritual Artifact they wanted to refine.
Even bulky, muscular Martial Artists discussed how to cultivate the body and where to buy pills that aid in the cultivation of the physical body.
It was utterly different from every previous emergence from seclusion, which used to be about which Heavenly Grotto was in turmoil or which had suffered devastating casualties. Discussions on matters of the Heavenly Grottos had become rare.
In an instant, there was a sense that the Heavenly Grottos had been completely pacified, evolving over time—a mere few years had passed!
In these five years, Li Xuan had reached the sixteenth page of the Book of Taicang, with only two pages left to complete the book.
His understanding of the Dao Principles of the Taicang Domain, and Dao Principles themselves, had increased significantly.
"Five years already, eh? The gains are not bad," Li Xuan mused inwardly. Indeed, once one was powerful, time became inconsequential.
In the blink of an eye, five years had passed.
In these five years, whether it was the spread of Formation methods, the spread of Alchemy, or the emergence of Taicang Martial Arts Body Cultivation—all of it had brought substantial feedback to him.
His strength had further increased.
Xu Yan had also reached the Perfection of the Divine Skill Realm a few days ago, and was preparing to accumulate the essence to break through into the Physiognomy Realm.
Meng Chong had achieved great accomplishment in the Divine Skill Realm, Su Lingxiu also reached great accomplishment in the Divine Skill Realm, and furthermore had already enlightened the Alchemical Medical Martial Arts and the principles of the Void-breaking Martial Arts Techniques.
Li Xuan had stepped into the Void-breaking Realm in all three of his realms of Martial Arts.
Fang Hao's Qimen Martial Art was also making rapid progress, and he further enlightened the future path of Qimen Martial Art, greatly enhancing Li Xuan's Qimen Martial Art. Although it was not yet comparable to the Void-breaking Realm, it was close.
In these five years, Qinghua state was changing day by day, starting with large cities being equipped with City Protection Formation Methods, and major urban centers being connected through Teleportation Formations for convenience.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 728 - 384: The Way of Divine Skills, Witch's Heavenly Grotto_2
chapters.content:
```
As the Teleportation Formation evolved, the current formations could cover distances of up to 300,000 kilometers in a single transfer, greatly facilitating the travel of martial artists and support for crisis-stricken Heavenly Grottoes.
This also led to a continuous decline in the threat posed by the Netherworld Cave.
Even so, strong individuals would suddenly depart, suppress a Heavenly Grotto, and once the suppression of a Heavenly Grotto was completed, before the strength-drained enemies of the Netherworld inside could react, the strong individuals had already returned to their station in the Heavenly Grotto.
This tactic was tried and true, leading to consecutive defeats for the Netherworld.
"Taicang Body Cultivation is quite interesting,"
Li Xuan chuckled inwardly. The appearance of a body cultivation lineage within the Taicang Martial Arts was beyond his expectations.
Of course, since the body cultivation originated with Meng Chong, and Meng Chong was the practitioner of the Physical Body Martial Arts he wrote, his disciple.
Naturally, the emergence of the Taicang Body Cultivators also provided him with some feedback.
"Master, this is the new spiritual cake I've made!"
Cai Ling'er came over with a plate of spiritual cakes.
Since activating the royal bloodline of the Sea Spirit Tribe, Cai Ling'er's strength had been rapidly improving, and in just five short years, she had already reached the mid-stage of Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable.
Especially after activating the royal bloodline, Cai Ling'er looked even more beautiful and pure, with a subtle air of majesty.
"Hmm!"
Li Xuan nodded.
In five years, Jiang Buping also made considerable progress, although he still hadn't dealt with the Imperishable Qi within his Divine Soul, nor had he stepped into the door of Extreme Soul Martial Arts.
However, he no longer needed external stimulation and was able to concentrate his mental awareness, the influence of the Imperishable Qi was further diminishing.
Given this trend, the day would come when he would resolve the Imperishable Qi and enter the door of Extreme Soul Martial Arts.
"Xu Yan has already reached perfection in his Divine Skills. Over these five years, he has traversed the Qinghua Realm. Perhaps it's time for him to leave the Qinghua Realm?"
Li Xuan mused to himself.
The Domain Realm was indeed too mystical. Over these five years, Xu Yan had still been unable to fully grasp and comprehend it.
"Walking and travelling, viewing the splendors of the Domain and grasping the true essence of Martial Arts, I believe Xu Yan will eventually come to understand,"
Li Xuan was not in a hurry. After all, it had only been five years.
The further one advanced in their realm, the more mystical it became, and naturally, the harder it was to comprehend, especially the Domain Realm, which represented a significant leap.
"I have already come to understand more than half of the Taicang Dao Principles, and I can almost establish the techniques of Martial Arts above the Domain Realm.
"Principles, the root of the Domain, where the operation of heaven and earth resides."
Li Xuan sighed inwardly.
The Heaven and Earth Laws are derived from the Domain, while the Domain Dao Principles represent the root of the Domain, the fundamentals of its operation. Without the Dao Principles, or should they collapse, the very Domain would cease to exist.
"Beyond the Domain Dao Rules, how should I craft it? Transcendence of the Domain cannot be the end – for the Martial Arts Endless Realm awaits,"
Li Xuan had already started pondering the direction of Martial Arts beyond the transcendence of the Domain, as well as the Martial Arts Techniques.
"There's no need to rush. Once I truly transcend the Domain, I will naturally know how to proceed."
Li Xuan mumbled to himself.
"Wu Tianan has cultivated the Heavenly Wave Palm; you've earned the Divine Skill Technique from the Divine Skills you created."
Suddenly, the Daoist Golden Book opened, and an unexpected feedback arrived.
Li Xuan was taken aback, Wu Tianan had actually succeeded in cultivating a Divine Skill, and more to his delight was the feedback from the Daoist Golden Book.
The Divine Skill Technique represents understanding of the intrinsic meaning of Divine Skills, aiming directly at their foundation, mastery of the Divine Skill Technique implies comprehension of the fundamentals of Divine Skills, which allows for the creation of new Divine Skills.
"My Divine Skill Martial Code, similar to Divine Skills like White Bone Rebirth and Instantaneous Rebirth, can now be created."
Li Xuan was overjoyed.
With mastery over the Divine Skill Technique, his Divine Skill Martial Code was no longer a blind concoction.
The Divine Skills he would create would all be practicable, and he knew exactly how to create even the most profound ones.
For instance, he now truly understood how to create Divine Skills like White Bone Rebirth, which he had always yearned for.
```
"Heavenly Wave Palm, although it's just a minor Divine Skill, is still quite impressive and very powerful,"
The Heavenly Wave Palm was one of the minor Divine Skills he had created, and one that Xu Yan had already mastered. A palm strike would ripple out like waves, continuous and unending, its power quite remarkable.
"The Divine Skill Technique can now be cultivated within Taicang Martial Arts. Although it's limited to minor Divine Skills for the time being, and some of the real Great Divine Powers are still beyond reach, it can already enhance the strength of Taicang Martial Arts."
"I thought that Xie Tianheng would be the first to cultivate a Divine Skill, but it turned out to be Wu Tianan."
"This guy is truly worthy of being the once-favored son of the Inner Domain. His talent and destiny are both extraordinary. I wonder who his martial arts mentor is and how strong they are," Li Xuan mused inwardly. After learning of Wu Tianan's past, he marveled at the man's great fortune.
At the same time, Li Xuan became curious about Wu Tianan's martial arts mentor for the first time.
"I should finish writing the Divine Skill Martial Code soon and set it at three thousand Divine Skills."
Li Xuan had an idea in mind.
All kinds of Divine Skills, both Great and minor, would amount to a total of three thousand.
In the following days, Li Xuan memorized the Dao Principles of the Book of Taicang while starting to compose Divine Skills.
...
"Having perfected my Divine Skills, it's time to accumulate a foundation. Although I've obtained many treasures, some special items are lacking. There's a good chance that Qinghua State doesn't have such special treasures, time to venture into other Realms."
Atop a mountain peak, Xu Yan opened his eyes, his expression contemplative.
He had new insights on how to continue building his foundation in the Divine Skill Realm. Finding a treasure with unique properties would ensure a stronger and more unique transformation when breaking through to the Physiognomy Realm.
With that in mind, Xu Yan vanished from where he stood, seeking out the Tianwu Sect Master to inquire about where he might find such special treasures.
The Tianwu Sect Master was very warm in welcoming Xu Yan's visit, displaying none of the airs of one of the three most powerful experts in Qinghua State. He treated Xu Yan as an equal, as this was the disciple of a highly esteemed master.
"The treasures you seek, Brother Xu, are heavy and condensing, solid yet supple... Such items are likely not found in Qinghua State; however, they may exist in the Nine Mountain Realm."
"The Nine Mountain Realm consists of nine enormous mountains, and their vastness is beyond imagination. There, a heavy metal is produced; perhaps in the Nine Mountain Realm, you'll find the heavy and condensing treasures you seek."
After hearing the purpose of Xu Yan's visit, the Tianwu Sect Master pondered for a moment before speaking.
Being an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, he was well-traveled and knowledgeable, and though he might not know all the Thirty-six Realms of the Divine Realm, he was quite familiar with the adjacent Nine Mountain Realm.
"The Nine Mountain Realm?"
Xu Yan nodded thoughtfully, recalling Feng Yan, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable from the Nine Mountain Realm.
"The Nine Mountain Realm is thick with forests and abundant in Spirit Beasts, and it has a greater variety of Divine Medicine than Qinghua State.
