Apart from the Netherworld Cave, it has other caves as well, one of which contains a treasure known as the Ten Thousand Catty Duckweed. A tiny duckweed yet it weighs ten thousand catties, and what's curious is that it can float on water.
"Young friend, you might want to look for it, as it may just be what you need."
The Tianwu Sect Master thoughtfully suggested a unique treasure exclusive to the Nine Mountain Realm.
Xu Yan inquired with curiosity, "What is that cave in the Nine Mountain Realm called?"
Having been in the Divine Realm for years, he knew quite a bit about caves. The Divine Realm faced threats not only from the Netherworld, and thus the caves were categorized.
"It seems to be the Witch Demon Cave, and since this particular cave is small, the threat is considered minor, so it hasn't garnered much attention," the Tianwu Sect Master said after some thought.
"Thank you, Tianwu Clan Master. I take my leave!"
After receiving the information he needed, Xu Yan saluted and said farewell, ready to head to the Nine Mountain Realm and explore the Witch Demon Cave for himself.
"Farewell, young friend!"
Departing from the Tianwu Sect, Xu Yan headed straight for the Realm Gate, the fastest way to reach the Nine Mountain Realm.
The Realm Gate was located at the boundary of three great powers—Da Yue, Wan Lei, and Tianwu—who had built a large city at this junction called Qinghua City.
The Realm Gate is a special gateway allowing swift travel among the Thirty-six Realms of the Divine Realm, formed by the Heaven and Earth Laws, somewhat akin to the Spiritual Realm Gate.
Passing through the Realm Gate, one could directly arrive at another Realm.
The Nine Mountain Realm got its name from the nine colossal peaks within its borders.
The vastness of the Nine Mountains was beyond imagination, and each mountain housed a cave, indicating the presence of a powerful force overseeing each peak.

chapters.title: Chapter 729 - 385: The Witch's Conspiracy, The Marvelous Use of Blood Heart Fruits
chapters.content:
Thousand Layered Mountain, one of the Nine Mountains, is named for the appearance of a thousand mountains stacking up.
In a corner of Thousand Layered Mountain, there is a Heavenly Grotto, dim and dark. The grotto is not very large and among the strong warriors stationed there, only two are True King Heavenly Venerables.
Not many martial artists enter this particular Heavenly Grotto, with only a dozen or so each day, and most of the time, they are warriors below the level of Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables.
This grotto has almost become a training ground for disciples from smaller factions within Thousand Layered Mountain.
The reason for having True King Heavenly Venerables stationed here is that this grotto once harbored a witch demon comparable to True King Heavenly Venerable in strength, which caused a slaughter that nearly wiped out a smaller faction.
It was for that very reason that True King Heavenly Venerables were arranged to take turns guarding this place.
Howl!
A howl like that of a wolf echoed from the grotto, occasionally accompanied by the sounds of combat. The martial artists who entered the grotto this time were led by three Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables, followed by a dozen young practitioners from the Divine Refinement Realm.
The witch demon of this grotto was called Wolf Witchcraft because of its wolf-like face.
These powerful Wolf Witchcraft were mostly at the level of Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables, with many at the Divine Refinement Realm, and some even at the Lesser Celestial Realm.
Since it borders the Qinghua state, the fame of the prodigies of Qinghua state naturally spread to the Nine Mountains. The names of Sword God Xu Yan and Heavenly God Meng Chong also made their way to the Nine Mountains.
As for the prodigies of the Nine Mountains, they were skeptical of these rumors.
Such monstrously talented individuals from the Qinghua state?
Impossible, they're probably just exaggerated to save face for the Qinghua state.
After all, not long ago, they sought help during a crisis.
Although they believed there was some boasting involved from the Qinghua state, they nonetheless thought that Xu Yan and Meng Chong were indeed exceptional talents but that their reputation was probably overblown.
To even presumptuously claim the titles of Sword God and Heavenly God!
Inside the grotto, a group of young men were fiercely attacking a robust man with a wolf's face; the battle was intense, while two Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables were skirting the edge of the fight.
Howl!
The man with the wolf face wielded a Wolf Fang Club, exhibiting immense power as he swung it. Despite being surrounded and attacked, he showed no fear, and even with numerous wounds all over his body, his eyes still glowed with a fierce light.
"Such a powerful physical body, this Wolf Witch. I heard rumors about a Body Cultivation warrior emerging from the Qinghua realm, I wonder how they would compare."
One of the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables exclaimed in admiration.
"What Body Cultivation? It's just an emphasis on physical training; they've concocted a name for it," retorted another Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable dismissively.
"Fair point."
"Still, that prodigy called Sword God Xu Yan must have extraordinary talent. Even if it's a bit exaggerated, there must be some impressive aspect about him."
"That's inevitable. However, I've heard that this young fellow Xu Yan has a divine set of palm techniques. Seems it's called the True Dragon Palm? A palm strike that summons a true dragon, I wonder how he cultivated such a technique."
"True Dragon Palm? Rumor has it it's named Subduing Dragon Palm. If the true dragons of legend hear about this palm technique, they'd probably die of anger, wanting to crush him to death!"
"It's truly audacious to name it the Subduing Dragon Palm."
The two Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables chatted merrily amongst themselves, discussing bits of news that had come from the Qinghua realm.
At this moment, the Wolf Witch, despite his ferocity, soon began to falter under the barrage of attacks.
Boom!
Suddenly, the Wolf Witch's leg was heavily injured, causing him to fall to the ground, and the continuing onslaught quickly led to his death.
"Elder, we've killed the Wolf Witch!"
A young practitioner excitedly picked up the Wolf Witch's Wolf Fang Club weapon and spoke.
"Good, with this experience, you will not lose your composure when you fight in the Heavenly Grotto in the future," said one of the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables with a nod.
"Let's go, we're heading back. This grotto should no longer attract any witch demons," the other Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable gestured.
Just as they were about to lead the disciples out of the training grotto, a faint pink glow suddenly spread through the area.
"What is this?"
The two Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables were startled and looked back, only to see a graceful figure descending deep within the grotto.
Clad in a light veil, her stunningly enchanting and beautiful face was lounging on a couch, irresistibly captivating.
As this graceful figure arrived, those disciples undergoing trials widened their eyes, becoming entranced by the beauty and unable to extricate themselves.
"Not good!"
One of the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables felt an alarm in his heart.
Just as he was about to wake the disciples, he saw the woman on the couch reach out and grab them.
Despite the great distance, her hand seemed to stretch indefinitely, grasping his neck and pulling him onto the couch.
Before the other Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable could cry for help, he felt a tightness around his neck as a hand snatched him over as well.
"Come over here!"
The woman on the couch beckoned with her fingers, and all the young disciples ran over crazily. Yet, as soon as they reached the edge of the couch, their eyes lost their luster.
One could see Divine Souls being sucked into the woman's mouth.
Immediately after, the eyes of these martial artists lit up again, as if nothing had happened, but upon closer inspection, it was clear their Divine Souls were no longer the original ones.
The two Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables, now unable to move, were filled with terror in their eyes.
What kind of witch demon was this?
One who fed on Divine Souls must be a fearsome being, but why would such a horrifying entity descend into this insignificant grotto?
With a bewitching smile, the woman looked at the two Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables and asked lazily, "Were you just talking about someone who could strike with their palm and bring forth a true dragon?"
"Yes, yes!"
The Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable nodded stiffly.
"What kind of true dragon?"

chapters.title: Chapter 730 - 385: The Witch's Conspiracy, The Marvelous Use of Blood Heart Fruits_2
chapters.content:
"Rumors speak of a golden giant dragon, with a stir wind and thunder arise, shrouded in the most profound mystery…"
"Do you know what that person looks like?"
"It is said he is exceptionally handsome, calling himself Sword God Xu Yan, but I haven't seen him…"
After listening, the woman's eyes revealed a cold light as she murmured, "Is it your disciple? He actually came to the Divine Realm, I'll see just how capable your disciple is, and how you plan to save your disciple!"
Lazily lying on the couch, she opened her rosy lips slightly, and with a gentle inhalation, the divine souls of two Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables were sucked into her mouth.
She squinted her bright eyes, looking around this dim Heavenly Grotto.
"How should I lure him in here? Heavenly and earthly treasures? I could give that a try."
She mumbled to herself.
Meanwhile, one of the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables turned to leave, and before long, one True King Heavenly Venerable followed behind him.
"Who are you?"
The newly arrived True King Heavenly Venerable was shocked and instantly burst with aura, ready to overwhelm and slay the enchanting woman before him with a forceful move.
"Don't be so hot-headed, dear."
A seductive, soft voice sounded, and soon after, he found himself clutching a soft and tender body. In that moment, his heart trembled.
"I'm lonely, so I sought you out for some fun; don't you want to?"
The True King Heavenly Venerable appeared bewitched, feeling his blood heating up, dividing into two streams: one rushing up to his forehead, filling his mind with raging emotions instantly.
The other flowing downward, promptly causing a bulge in his trousers.
"Come on."
The woman exhaled seductively like an orchid, with enticing eyes that seemed like silk. Between bewilderment and lust, he had already lost himself, his arms around the woman, his entire being in an excited state.
"Giggle… I will make you happy, you just have to behave and listen, understand?"
"I will, I will, I'll be obedient."
Pink petals swirled around them, and the woman lay sprawled lazily on the bed, while at her feet, the True King Heavenly Venerable crouched like a dog eager to please its master.
"Go get things done, and don't forget, oh, make sure to lure him here. And your brother, let him in too."
"Yes, yes!"
The True King Heavenly Venerable left.
Soon after, another True King Heavenly Venerable entered and quickly became ensnared, turning into a loyal dog.
"It's time to decorate this Heavenly Grotto a bit, make it look prettier, and bring some stuff over, that will make it more attractive."
The woman muttered to herself.
Two Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables, leading their disciples, began to arrange the Heavenly Grotto.
…
"The Nine Mountain Realm is full of dense forests and rich in spiritual and divine medicine, just as expected!"
As Xu Yan walked through the mountains and forests, he couldn't help but marvel.
The spiritual medicine that could be seen everywhere here would be considered extremely rare in the Inner Domain and even in the Spiritual Realm.
Along this path, he had encountered no less than a thousand plants of divine spiritual medicine.
"The Nine Mountain Realm is so much better suited for junior sister; there is absolutely no worry about lacking alchemy materials here."
Xu Yan sighed with emotion.
"The Witches' Cave in Thousand Layered Mountain is rather distant from here. On my way there, I will pass several caves and enter them to see how they differ from the caves in the Qinghua state."
The destination of Xu Yan was the Witches' Cave in the Thousand Layered Mountain, but it was quite far from his current location. On his route, he needed to pass through several caves, and one of them even had a Xuezhi presiding over it.
It would be an excellent opportunity to undertake a trial and enhance his own foundation.
As long as one is a Divine Realm Warrior, they can enter the Heavenly Grotto to battle, and there are no rules barring foreign warriors from entering, which facilitated Xu Yan's actions.
Dahai Mountain, one of the Nine Mountains in the Nine Mountain Realm, is the first family's territory governed by the Wan Family in the Nine Mountain Realm. Within the entire Dahai Mountain region, there are hundreds of large and small forces, all of which exist by affiliating themselves with the Wan Family.
Snake Peak Cave is the third-ranked Heavenly Grotto on Dahai Mountain. Within the cave resides a Xuezhi that launches an assault every so often, attempting to break free from the cave.
Seated in the cave was the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, an elder of the Wan Family. He had clashed with the Xuezhi dozens of times, but neither could defeat the other.
The martial artists who enter Snake Peak Cave must be at least of the Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable level to do battle with a host of Blood Slaves and Blood Disciples. Apart from eliminating the ever-growing number of Blood Slaves, they also vie for the treasures within Snake Peak Cave.
Among the treasures in Snake Peak Cave is a most precious one called the Blood Heart Fruit. It has the power to nourish the Divine Soul and clear the consciousness, assisting in the comprehension of Cultivation Techniques and aiding the practice of extremely violent and powerful killing techniques that are prone to loss of control.
With the aid of the Blood Heart Fruit in cultivation, the violently unstable killing techniques can become milder, allowing for successful practice without the risk of losing control and harming oneself.
Due to the scarcity of Blood Heart Fruit and the difficulty in obtaining it, as it mostly grows in the core areas of the Netherworld, it is highly valuable.
Every so often, the elders of the Wan Family would initiate a challenge to the Xuezhi, leading to a great battle that creates an opportunity to obtain the Blood Heart Fruit.
The last great battle had just ended, but this time, they did not procure any Blood Heart Fruit, and the Wan Family was brewing plans to launch a fight against the Netherworld enemies within Snake Peak Cave.
Their goal, of course, was the Blood Heart Fruit, for the outstanding prodigy of the Wan Family, Wan Tianlin!
Moreover, the Wan Family had issued a high bounty, offering a substantial reward. Thus, many True King Heavenly Venerables were eager to take a chance.
"Blood Heart Fruit? It can nourish the Divine Soul and clarify the consciousness, aiding in the comprehension of Cultivation Techniques?"
Upon learning about the Blood Heart Fruit, Xu Yan's eyes lit up.
The nourishing of the Divine Soul was of no concern to him; what mattered was its help in comprehending Cultivation Techniques. To some extent, he wondered if his perception could gain a temporary boost after consuming the Blood Heart Fruit?
"What a treasure; I wonder if it could allow me to gain insight into the Domain Martial Arts Law?"
The Domain Realm was too mysterious. He had been cultivating in the Qinghua state for such a long time and had only attained vague insights, still far from truly comprehending the techniques.
The miraculous effects of the Blood Heart Fruit might help him progress further in comprehending the Domain Martial Arts Law.
"The Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path, I've already gained some insight, but I'm still missing the last piece. Even if the Blood Heart Fruit doesn't greatly help with comprehending the Domain Realm, it should be useful for the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path."
Xu Yan began to ponder.
If he was right and the Blood Heart Fruit could enhance insight for a short time after consumption, that short burst of insight would be enough for him to comprehend the Divine Skill of the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path.
Over the years, Xu Yan had been practicing and had gained quite a few insights; he was just one step away from success. With the help of the Blood Heart Fruit, he could significantly reduce the time needed to master the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path.
To Xu Yan, the marvels of the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path were of great importance. With it one could see through all confusion and all illusions.
Moreover, the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path also had a formidable offensive capability.
In combat, it could even predict the enemy's attacks and discern the opponent's weak points, a Divine Skill with infinite wonderful uses.
"If the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path is already so mysterious, it is hard to imagine what wonders the Eye of the Heavenly Dao must hold."
Xu Yan made his decision - to venture to Snake Peak Cave in search of the Blood Heart Fruit!
Every day, martial artists would enter Snake Peak Cave, one to obtain Netherworld Blood Beads for cultivation, seeking treasures within the cave; the other to reduce the number of Blood Slaves to maintain a certain balance.
"Is the Blood Heart Fruit only found in the core region?"
"Not necessarily, it could also grow elsewhere, but it's just too rare and too hard to come by, and it might already have been picked by others."
"What a pity. If I could harvest one and present it to young master Tianlin, I would certainly receive a great reward."
"Heh, I don't care about any great rewards. If I can get a Blood Heart Fruit, I'll use it to trade for the opportunity to follow young master Tianlin."
"You've got it right. What reward could compare with following young master Tianlin? He's the pinnacle prodigy of the Wan Family, rumored to have the qualifications to become an Immortal Heavenly Venerable."
"That's where you're wrong. Young master Tianlin wants the Blood Heart Fruit to comprehend a Cultivation Technique. Once he succeeds, he's destined to become an Immortal Heavenly Venerable in the future!"
Outside Snake Peak Cave, a group of martial artists gathered, chatting about the Blood Heart Fruit and Wan Tianlin, the prodigy of the Wan Family.
"If the prodigy of the Wan Family values the Blood Heart Fruit so highly for aiding in Cultivation Technique practice, it seems the Blood Heart Fruit must have exceptional effects. If used in Alchemy, could it be possible to refine pills with even more miraculous effects that enhance insight?"
Xu Yan thought to himself. However, even if he had to obtain the Blood Heart Fruit, he had no intention of returning to the Qinghua state to give it to Su Lingxiu for Alchemy; the round trip would cost too much time.
If there were any Blood Heart Fruits left over, he could gift it to Su Lingxiu the next time they reunite.

chapters.title: Chapter 731 - 386 Pretending to Infiltrate, I am Blood Disciple 666
chapters.content:
Snake Peak Cave was shrouded in a faint blood aura, as if an external breath was converging within the cave.
Every Heavenly Grotto with a Xuezhi stationed acted as if it were a small world of its own.
"Although this is also a Netherworld Cave, it's somewhat different from the ones in the Qinghua state. The blood aura here is denser, and there seems to be an external breath.
"The breath of the Netherworld? Could it be that the world's fabric here is more fragile, allowing the breath of the Netherworld to gather without dispersing?"
Xu Yan walked through the cave, noticing the peculiarities of this Heavenly Grotto and couldn't help but feel curious.
"Could the treasure known as Blood Heart Fruit have arisen due to the convergence of the Netherworld breath with the domain's own, resulting in their fusion?"
Within the entrance of Snake Peak Cave, a large city had been built. Enemies from the Netherworld who wished to storm out of the cave would have to break through this defensive city.
In some sense, the side of Dahai Mountain held an advantage, otherwise, they wouldn't have been able to construct a defensive city within the cave.
In the center of the great city was a high tower, where a powerful presence could be faintly felt—that was a Wan Family elder, an Immortal Heavenly Venerable strongman.
"Blood Heart Fruits grow deep within the cave, right at the heart of the Netherworld faction's core territory. There might be Blood Heart Fruits in other places, but they're rare and hard to find, so the most convenient way is to go deep into the cave to harvest them."
Xu Yan looked towards the depths of the cave, sensing some battles happening around him.
He had learned from other Martial Artists that the Wan Family planned to initiate a battle against the Netherworld side in twenty days, striking deep into the cave to harvest Blood Heart Fruits.
For this, the Wan Family offered generous rewards, attracting Loose Cultivator True King Heavenly Venerables to gather and lend their strength.
"Twenty days is too long."
Xu Yan couldn't wait twenty days; each day was extremely precious to him.
"Among those in this cave, only Xuezhis pose a threat to me. As long as I avoid the Xuezhis, the rest of the Blood Disciples are not a concern."
Xu Yan continued his journey towards the depths of the cave.
The cave had recently witnessed a large battle, hence only scattered conflicts and skirmishes remained, with the Blood Slaves and Blood Disciples having retreated to their main camp, and few were patrolling outside.
"Can I impersonate a Blood Disciple?"
Xu Yan suddenly thought of this possibility.
"Imitating the aura of a Blood Disciple doesn't seem too difficult. Like merging with the dust, I could also merge with the aura of a Blood Disciple…"
Xu Yan pondered thoughtfully.
He hadn't considered impersonating a Blood Disciple before, but the idea came to him out of necessity to harvest Blood Heart Fruits.
"However, the skin of a Blood Disciple is blood-red in color; even the strongest Blood Disciple isn't that red, but still has a hint of redness.
"To impersonate a Blood Disciple, the first step is turning the skin blood-red."
Imitating the aura wasn't difficult, but how could he mimic blood-red skin?
Xu Yan thought deeply, recalling the Martial Arts' first realm, the Qi-Blood Realm. Would not his skin turn red if he brought his Qi-Blood to the surface?
"It's worth a try."
Xu Yan became inwardly excited. "As long as I avoid that Xuezhi, I won't be found out. And that Xuezhi couldn't possibly monitor every returning Blood Disciple. Once I've harvested the Blood Heart Fruit, I'll immediately leave.
"If I manage to get Blood Heart Fruits, even if I'm exposed, I can retreat.
Xu Yan figured that with his own speed of escape, he could reach the great city at the Heavenly Cave Entrance before the Xuezhi caught up to him.
The Wan Family elder would naturally fend off the incoming Xuezhi.
"I'll impersonate a patrolling Blood Disciple."
Xu Yan began searching for a Blood Disciple within the cave.
Finally, near the outer edge of the cave's depths, he encountered a Blood Disciple leading a group of more than ten Blood Slaves on patrol.
Whoosh!
To avoid causing too much commotion and risking the failure of his impersonation plan, Xu Yan's first attack was Mountains and Rivers in the Sword, enveloping the group in an instant, trapping them within his Mountains and Rivers in the Sword.
Gurgle gurgle!
The Blood Slaves turned into mists of blood and perished in the blink of an eye.
"Roar!"
The Blood Disciple, greatly shocked, took up his blade to unleash a fierce strike, trying to fend off the attack and simultaneously sending out a distress call.
But within the confines of Mountains and Rivers in the Sword, all sounds were stifled, unable to carry.
Hum!
With fierce Sword Intent and a sweep of light, the Blood Disciple was killed in just a few breaths of time!
Xu Yan reached out, and the Blood Beads of the Blood Disciple were drawn towards him and stored on his person. The clothes and Scarlet Long Knife were also taken.
After changing into the Blood Disciple's clothes and hanging the Scarlet Long Knife at his waist, Xu Yan's facial muscles twitched subtly, adopting the appearance of the fallen Blood Disciple.
Taking a deep breath, his long-dormant Qi-Blood surged, turning his skin a light shade of red.
His own aura also began to change, merging with that of the Blood Beads he wore; in this moment, Xu Yan was indistinguishable from a true Blood Disciple.
"I shouldn't be discovered, right?"
After scrutinizing himself to ensure there were no flaws, Xu Yan set off towards the core of the Netherworld Territory, deep within the cave.
As for the squad of Blood Slaves he was supposed to lead, their disappearance could easily be explained as an attack, with the Blood Slaves slain in the incident.
Such occurrences were not new.
In fact, Xu Yan had heard that some Blood Disciples, when wounded or depleted in Blood Power, would even devour their own Blood Slaves to replenish their strength.
In the Netherworld, such matters were hardly a secret.
The deeper into the cave he ventured, the denser the bloody aura, casting a glow in all directions, a chilling breath lingering in the air.
Along the way, he encountered several patrol groups. To him, a lone Blood Disciple, the others didn't question him much, their expressions suggesting they already assumed he had been attacked and injured, having consumed his subordinate Blood Slaves.

chapters.title: Chapter 732 - 386: Pretending to Infiltrate, I am Blood Disciple 666_2
chapters.content:
Huge blood-red stone houses were lined up in rows, forming neat queues. Looking over the cluster of houses, one could see a towering giant stone house at its center, its summit sparkling with a bloody light.
That was where Xuezhi resided.
Around Xuezhi's towering stone house, the inner circle housed the Blood Disciples, while the outermost circle was home to the Blood Slaves. Xu Yan discovered that the Blood Slaves did not live solo in a stone house.
Blood Disciples had their own independent stone houses. The strength of the bloody light emanating from the houses could reveal the relative power and status among them.
"Which stone house is mine?"
Xu Yan suddenly fell into thought.
"Forget it, I'm here to find Blood Heart Fruits, not to settle down. But where could the Blood Heart Fruits be?"
Xu Yan entered the cluster of stone houses, trying to act nonchalantly and as if he knew his way around, while secretly searching for the Blood Heart Fruits.
"Eh, is that the Blood Heart Fruit?"
Suddenly, Xu Yan saw a blood-red plant that resembled a vine growing in front of a Blood Disciple's stone house not far away. The plant crept up the building, and a blood-red fruit the size of an egg, shaped like a heart, hung from the vine.
Xu Yan casually, as if strolling leisurely in a garden, approached the stone house and stood beneath the Blood Heart Fruit, examining it for a moment before he reached up and plucked it.
Crack!
The door of the stone house opened, and a Blood Disciple stepped out, glaring at him in anger, "867, that is mine!"
867?
Xu Yan's heart skipped a beat, and he quickly realized that this was the code of the Blood Disciple he was impersonating.
"Brother, come on, here's your chance to make a merit!"
Xu Yan moved closer, casually slinging his arm around the other's shoulder like an old chum, pulling him into the stone house.
"I have a brilliant plan that could earn us great merit. Since this is yours, let's join forces, and we'll share the credit..."
Xu Yan spoke in hushed, mysterious tones, as if afraid of outsiders overhearing the opportunity to gain merit.
The Blood Disciple looked bemused. Was he that familiar with 867?
"What opportunity to earn merit?"
Still, he couldn't help but ask instinctively.
The two of them entered the stone house, and everything inside fell into Xu Yan's view. To his surprise, there were two more Blood Heart Fruits on the table.
"These Blood Heart Fruits don't seem to have much use for Blood Disciples, other than being consumed as Spirit Fruit?"
Xu Yan was a bit surprised internally, yet considering the beings of Netherworld were inherently different, training in distinct martial arts paths, he was no longer taken aback.
Blood Heart Fruits, such a unique treasure, only worked miraculously for Martial Artists of this Domain.
"This could be very useful, for drawing people in..."
Xu Yan stepped forward swiftly, taking the Blood Heart Fruits, and as he did so, he leaned in closer to the Blood Disciple's shoulder, saying, "Brother, listen, I've got a grand plan..."
"867, why do I feel like something's off about you!"
The Blood Disciple suddenly furrowed his brows, showing a hint of wariness.
"It's because I..."
Thump!
A sword pierced the Blood Disciple's chest, extinguishing his life force in an instant, and amidst his disbelieving gaze, Xu Yan said slowly, "...am not Blood Disciple 867."
Thump!
The Blood Disciple disintegrated into ash.
Xu Yan collected his Blood Beads and switched his aura, taking on the appearance of the Blood Disciple he had just killed.
"Let's see what other treasures there might be."
Xu Yan began to search the stone house.
Soon, he found the name of the slain Blood Disciple: 666.
"From now on, I am Blood Disciple 666!"
Xu Yan smiled.
After donning the garments of Blood Disciple 666, he walked out of the stone house and continued his search for the Blood Heart Fruits. These were treasures, and the Wan Family was offering a hefty reward for acquiring them.
The Wan Family was the overlord of Dahai Mountain, ruling over its land with abundant resources and countless heavenly treasures. Perfect for trading the Blood Heart Fruit for the special treasures he desired.
Xu Yan went straight to the adjacent stone house and knocked on the door. A Blood Disciple opened it, looking at him perplexedly, "Old Six, what brings you here?"
"That's how it is..."
Xu Yan casually draped his arm over the other's shoulder as they entered the stone house, then swiftly closed the door behind them. His sequence of movements was extremely practiced, as if rehearsed countless times.
"Old Six, I've come today to share a grand plan with you, one that will earn us great merit. You know about this kind of fruit, right? Actually..."
As Xu Yan spoke, he picked up a Blood Heart Fruit from the table, his voice taking on a mysterious tone.
The Blood Disciple asked curiously, "What plan? What can you, a simpleton, possibly come up with?"
Xu Yan was certain that this Blood Disciple was on very good terms with the Six Blood Disciple, after all, they were neighbors. And the look in the other's eyes seemed to hold a trace of surprise, as if wondering why the old neighbor had undergone a change of character.
Therefore, this person had to be eliminated; otherwise, the risk of exposure loomed.
"Hey, you just don't understand. I, Old Six, have always been prudent..."
Thud!
With one hand on the other's shoulder, a sword pierced the Blood Disciple's heart, extinguishing his life force and preventing him from making even the slightest sound before dying.
The Blood Disciple was stunned. Old Six actually wanted to kill him!
After dealing with the Blood Disciple, Xu Yan put away the Blood Heart Fruit and left the stone house, pondering for a moment before heading towards the next one.
"What a pauper, not even a single Blood Heart Fruit!"
Xu Yan cursed to himself as he emerged from a stone house.
This was the eighth stone house he had visited, and not all Blood Disciples possessed a Blood Heart Fruit.
"Ah, there's a Blood Heart Fruit here."
He casually plucked a Blood Heart Fruit growing outside a Blood Disciple's house, waited a bit, and when no one came out of the stone house, which seemed empty, he turned and left.
"This Netherworld Blood Disciple wields considerable power, likely commanding hundreds of Blood Disciples. The closer you get to the inner Blood Disciples, the stronger they are, the higher their rank.
"This also means that these Blood Disciples have more resources."
Xu Yan pondered for a moment, and then slowly walked towards the row of stone houses deeper inside.
Assuming the identity of the Six Blood Disciple, he visited one Blood Disciple after another.
"There are still too few Blood Heart Fruits. I've killed over a hundred Blood Disciples and only collected a little over thirty Blood Heart Fruits. I also don't know whether the Blood Heart Fruit is effective with every intake."
Xu Yan sighed inwardly, knowing that even in the Netherworld, the Blood Heart Fruit was extremely rare.
Along the way, he had emptied over a hundred stone houses; their owners had all been eliminated by him, the Six Blood Disciple.
"The Wan Family should thank me, for I have weakened the power of the Heavenly Grotto."
Xu Yan sighed to himself.
"When I was in the Qinghua state, why didn't I think of impersonating a Blood Disciple?"
The stone house in front of him belonged to the innermost circle of the Blood Disciples' houses, and it was the largest row of them.
This meant that the Blood Disciples inside were the most powerful, certainly on par with the peak of the True King Heavenly Venerable.
"After all, I am not a Blood Disciple. If I were scrutinized closely, I would still be exposed, so I must be cautious."
Xu Yan knocked on the door of the stone house.
Given the high status and position of this stone house's owner, there must be no shortage of treasures, right? Items like the Blood Heart Fruit should probably be in abundance, right?
However, since the other's power was too formidable, he needed to annihilate him in one blow without causing a commotion, or else, if he alarmed the Netherworld Blood Disciple, there would be serious trouble.
The stone house door opened, revealing a burly, fierce-looking Blood Disciple. Xu Yan was about to imitate what he'd seen before, but the Blood Disciple beat him to it, asking with a puzzled face, "Little Six, what do you want with me?"
Upon hearing this, Xu Yan's heart skipped a beat, "The Six Blood Disciple takes orders from this person, this is going to be difficult."
With many Blood Disciples around, there were naturally those who led them, divided into many groups. From the tone and expression of the Blood Disciple before him, it was clear that the Six Blood Disciple was under his command.
"It's a major issue!"
Xu Yan spoke gravely, his face etched with seriousness as he entered the stone house as if the significant matter he referred to could not be known to others.
"What major issue?"
The fierce-looking Blood Disciple frowned, looking somewhat displeased, but it was only displeasure without any suspicion. Ever since the Netherworld invaded this Domain, there had never been an instance of infiltration by an imposter.
The breath of life was difficult to conceal from each other, just as the Netherworld Blood Disciples and Blood Slaves could not impersonate and infiltrate the forces of this Domain either.
As soon as Xu Yan entered the stone house, he saw several Blood Heart Fruits placed on a plate on the table, and he could not help but praise inwardly – as one of the strongest Blood Disciples, the treatment was indeed excellent.
"This is what I heard from the Wan Family side..."
Xu Yan leaned in close to the Blood Disciple, lowered his voice, and began speaking with a heavy and serious tone.

chapters.title: Chapter 733 - 387: Killed 70% of the Blood Disciples, Xuezhi Attacks
chapters.content:
Xu Yan knew he only had one chance to strike, and he couldn't make any noise, otherwise, he would surely alert Xuezhi inside that stone house.
This row of stone houses was already the innermost row, very close to the dwelling of Xuezhi. With Xuezhi's formidable strength, any slight disturbance would be sensed.
And because this Blood Disciple was the leader of the Six Blood Disciples, his status was outstanding; naturally, he couldn't strike him down in the overtly casual manner as he could with the other Blood Disciples.
He could only get as close as possible and use conversation to draw the other's attention, then take advantage of his distraction to suddenly assassinate him, especially without giving him the chance to sound an alarm.
Xu Yan was very aware that, even if the Blood Disciple was dissatisfied with the Six Blood Disciples or even found them abnormal, he wouldn't expect someone to be impersonating them and try to kill him. This was the opportunity!
"Xiao Liu, just spit it out!"
The brows of the Blood Disciple furrowed, his expression discontented, but he did not become defensive nor did he move away, allowing Xu Yan to approach him.
Xu Yan had already gotten in front of the other, nearly pressing against him as he raised a palm and said with a slightly excited tone, "Look, what is this!"
"Hmm?"
The Blood Disciple with a fierce face felt that being called "Xiao Liu" was too disrespectful, not even addressed as "Boss", his heart growing more displeased. However, he still looked down at Xu Yan's palm extended to his chest.
Whizz!
In that instant, the sword pierced his chest, and the sword, as if endowed with spiritual wisdom, reached his throat in a blink, shattering his larynx and preventing any scream.
His eyes suddenly widened, his gaze filled with disbelief; the Six Blood Disciple dared to attack him with the temerity usually reserved for someone lower in status!
Even then, he did not suspect an impersonation.
Boom!
His body surged with a mighty aura, about to unleash his powerful strength to suppress this insolent assailant.
But at that very moment, he seemed to see a land of mountains and rivers; as if he himself was standing within them, he saw a sword light slash through the landscape.
The one wielding the sword appeared to be the sovereign of all living beings in these mountains and rivers.
"An enemy!"
Only then did he realize in horror that the Six Blood Disciple was an impostor, a fake!
Spurt!
Blood had barely begun to spurt as he was about to execute his secret technique—not seeking to escape, but only to protect himself.
But it was already too late.
The black sword light fell, his consciousness instantly extinguishing, his physical body turning to ash in a moment!
Xu Yan's taut nerves finally relaxed, and droplets of sweat even began to bead on his forehead. He had completely eradicated his foe without making a sound.
He had prepared to flee; had the Blood Disciple succeeded in sounding the alarm, he would have decisively escaped!
"It's done!"
Xu Yan exhaled a breath of air, then immediately became exhilarated, starting to rummage through the stone house and looting all of the Blood Disciple's resources.
"So many Blood Heart Fruits, these should trade for a good number of the heavenly materials and earth treasures I need, right?"
This trip was indeed worthwhile!
"Six Six Blood Disciple?"
Through looting, Xu Yan also learned the name of this Blood Disciple.
Six Six Blood Disciple.
"From now on, I am the Six Six Blood Disciple!"
Xu Yan decisively changed his identity; swapping clothes, taking the Six Six Blood Disciple's Blood Beads for himself, merging his energy with that of the Blood Beads, and after his facial muscles twitched a few times, his appearance roughly matched that of the Six Six Blood Disciple.
However, since the Six Six Blood Disciple had a hulking build, Xu Yan could only circulate his cultivation technique to somewhat expand his body and make himself as imposing.
Although he did not practice the Physical Body Martial Arts, his control over his own flesh was also extraordinarily exceptional.
"After all, I've only expanded my build through running my cultivation technique, which is a flaw. If I spend too much time with the Blood Disciples, they'll notice something off and I'll be exposed."
Xu Yan, however, was not concerned; he was not planning to infiltrate for an extended period.
Furthermore, since no infiltrators had ever appeared in the Netherworld, their understanding was that Divine Realm Warriors could not impersonate or infiltrate them, for their energy could not be altered.
It was precisely for this reason that, even if some anomalies were detected, they would not immediately suspect an outsider was masquerading as one of their own, which in turn provided Xu Yan with opportunities to strike from the shadows.
"The identity of the Six Six Blood Disciple should be even more useful now.
Xu Yan emerged from the stone house, looking at the innermost row of stone houses. Each house was inhabited by a Blood Disciple, and each was among the best of the Netherworld Blood Disciples of the Snake Peak Cave.
One could say they were one of the core figures.
He approached the door of the next stone house and knocked.
"Who is it?"
A muffled voice came from inside, seemingly upset about being disturbed.
"Me, Six Six."
Xu Yan mimicked the Six Six Blood Disciple's voice as he spoke.
The door opened, and the figure inside frowned at him, "What do you want?"
"Let's talk inside."
Xu Yan walked into the stone house as if it was his own, and the other person, though frowning, didn't say anything and closed the door behind him.
When Xu Yan emerged from the house, it was already empty.
"Let's continue!"
Xu Yan continued on with his actions, being extremely cautious every time he struck. After all, each Blood Disciple's strength was not weak, and the slightest mishap could cause a disturbance.
A day later, Xu Yan stood in front of another stone house.
This stone house, one of the largest among those of the Blood Disciples, had a particularly glaring blood light on its roof.
Without exception, it indicated that the strength of this Blood Disciple was among the top ten of all Blood Disciples.
"How many Blood Disciples have I killed now?"
Xu Yan pondered for a moment, looking back at the stone houses. About seventy percent of them were empty now, he estimated.

chapters.title: Chapter 734 - 387: Killed 70% of Blood Disciples, Xuezhi Strikes_2
chapters.content:
Apart from those who were out on patrol, most of the Blood Disciples who remained in the stone house had been killed by him, resulting in an exceptionally rich harvest.
"I must be more careful now."
Xu Yan had already decided, he would retreat after finishing this task.
The Blood Heart Fruits were already plentiful enough.
"What is it?"
To Xu Yan's surprise, this Blood Disciple turned out to be a woman, with a cold expression as if she held great disdain for the Six Blood Disciples.
"Let's go inside and talk."
Just as Xu Yan was about to enter the stone house, the woman blocked his way and coldly said, "Are you worthy to go in?"
"Then I'll leave!"
Xu Yan decisively turned around to leave, to find another target.
"Did I say you could leave?"
That was what she coldly retorted.
"Then what do you want?"
Xu Yan was at a loss.
He cursed inwardly, wondering if this woman had a grudge against the Six Blood Disciples.
"What do you want with me, speak up!"
She furrowed her brows, looking as if she was about to start teaching him a lesson at any moment.
"I've discovered that this thing can attract the warriors from the Wan Family..."
Xu Yan took out a Blood Heart Fruit, approached, and said in a deep voice.
"I have a big plan and am looking to partner with someone on it. If it succeeds, it will be a great achievement. How about we go inside to discuss the details?"
After hesitating for a long while, she turned and entered the stone house.
Xu Yan followed her in and casually shut the door.
He began to think about how he would make his move.
It was clear that she would not allow him to be too close, let alone to be overly familiar, so it wouldn't be easy to strike from the shadows.
"My plan is..."
As Xu Yan moved closer, her brows furrowed, and suddenly she raised her hand and aimed a slap at him.
"You are getting more and more..."
Boom!
At that moment, Xu Yan also struck.
When she made her move, it was only meant as a lesson, not a killing blow; whereas Xu Yan's move, while appearing to be defensive, was actually a sneak attack.
"You…"
The female Blood Disciple's expression changed as blood light surged on her body. Just then, the Mountains and Rivers enveloped downwards, sword light chilling, and in the instant that Xu Yan unleashed his full power, he instantly reverted to his original form.
As he resumed his true form, the female Blood Disciple's eyes widened in horror, her mouth opening to sound an alarm. Amidst the rumbling, Mountains and Rivers surged, as if on the verge of collapsing the next moment.
Hum!
Xu Yan unleashed a sword strike, his Sudden Wind Sword Intent from his slashing Divine Soul reaching its peak. At the same time, the sword light moved as if alive, entering the female Blood Disciple's body at a tricky angle.
Puh!
Blood spurted out, and in that moment, Mountains and Rivers were breached by an opening as a low, deep cry of agony was uttered.
Boom!
Xu Yan's expression was icy as he, in an instant, engulfed her with sword light, utterly eradicating her.
However, this sneak attack caused the stone house to shake for a moment, creating noise. Xu Yan quickly looted everything inside the stone house, resumed the appearance of a Six Blood Disciple, and even feigned swelling on his left cheek.
He opened the door of the stone house, looking somewhat disheveled, with one hand covering his swollen face, sneaking out of the house in an utterly embarrassed manner.
The commotion had already alarmed the Blood Disciples in the nearby stone houses.
"Six Blood Disciple, what were you doing in there?"
A gaunt Blood Disciple asked coldly.
"None of your damn business!"
Xu Yan replied gruffly, mimicking the Six Blood Disciple's tone.
"That's my woman. You went into my woman's house; you're asking for death!"
Enraged, the gaunt Blood Disciple's aura exploded, a Scarlet Long Knife in hand.
Xu Yan was momentarily startled.
He was on the verge of being exposed, better make a quick escape.
"Your woman is quite something!"
After saying this, Xu Yan swiftly fled towards the perimeter of the Netherworld camp.
"You're courting death!"
"Come at me then, let's talk with our strength!"
Xu Yan took on a stance as if he was ready to fight for the woman with the other Blood Disciple.
Boom!
The gaunt Blood Disciple transformed into a streak of blood light in pursuit, and in an instant, the whole camp was stirred up.
But Xu Yan wasn't worried or hurried as he kept flying outwards, while saying, "Come on, let's have a bout!"
As if he was challenging the other Disciple to a duel outside the camp.
At this moment, he still looked like the Six Blood Disciple, with no one suspecting he was an imposter.
"The Xuezhi haven't noticed anything wrong yet. As soon as I get out of the camp, I'll make a quick getaway!"
Xu Yan's heart was taut.
Atop the largest stone house, a figure raised their head, looking at the two departing Blood Disciples without much thought, only to realize suddenly that the Blood Disciples in the camp were sparse. Why were there so few?
It was as if seventy percent had vanished into thin air.
With such a commotion, all the Blood Disciples would have definitely appeared, but in the living areas of the camp, only a few unmoved Blood Disciples seemed to be spectating.
"Where are they?"
The figure moved and stepped out of the stone house, looking at those few Blood Disciples and asked in a deep voice, "Where are the others?"
"Sir, we don't know."
The remaining Blood Disciples were also confused. It was only then that they realized the others were gone.
Xu Yan had already left the camp, and the pursuers were about to catch up with him. His speed surged instantly, rapidly increasing the distance between them.
"Six Six, you stay behind for me!"
The gaunt Blood Disciple behind him roared continuously, his speed also suddenly surging.
After distancing himself from the Netherworld camp, Xu Yan's expression turned cold and with a thought, the Sword Array emerged instantly.
"Slice!"
Turning around abruptly, he brought his sword down in one swift cut.
Divine Skills, Supreme Heavenly Sword!
"You're not a Six Blood Disciple!"
The gaunt Blood Disciple's face was filled with shock, a terrifying thought surfacing in his mind. Could the intruder have killed his woman?
"Your killer!"
At that moment, Xu Yan made his move suddenly, catching his opponent off guard. In the blink of an eye, he unleashed all his Divine Skills, determined to slay the foe in the shortest time possible.
Boom!
The fight was exceptionally fierce. With the advantage of taking the initiative and catching his enemy off guard, coupled with the profoundness of his Divine Skills which were beyond the opponent's imagination, the slight negligence resulted in the loss of an arm to the sword in an instant.
"Who are you?"
The gaunt Blood Disciple, shocked and unwilling to tangle any longer, attempted to flee.
"Sword God Xu Yan!"
Sword lights emerged, each one vibrating with a type of Sword Intent, as if alive, circling around the gaunt Blood Disciple, enveloping him with Mountains and Rivers in the Sword.
Ao!
True Dragon Rage manifested within the mountains and rivers.
Seizing the opportunity of the initiative and his opponent's injured state which significantly weakened him, Xu Yan unleashed a violent barrage of attacks.
Spurt!
At last, a sword light pierced into the enemy's body.
Once inside, the sword light, as if alive, roved within the opponent's body, not allowing any chance to expel it. In the span of a few breaths, Xu Yan finally slew his foe with one stroke.
"Had I not caught him off guard and inflicted serious injuries, it would have been difficult to kill him!"
Xu Yan sighed.
At the pinnacle of the Divine Skill Realm, he was still just short of the mark. Had he broken through to the Physiognomy Realm, he could have overcome the opponent in a frontal confrontation.
Boom!
All at once, a terrifying surge of blood energy soared into the sky from the direction of the Netherworld camp, and a powerful momentum rapidly approached.
Xu Yan turned and fled!
He applied the Divine Skill Invisibility Without a Trace and disappeared instantly, returning to the front of the great city at Snake Peak Cave in a blink.
"Xuezhi is attacking!"
Xu Yan shouted.
Boom!
Above the high-rise building, the aura of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable emerged, instantly descending upon them.
"Xuezhi is attacking?"
The elder of the Wan Family said, surprised.
Could it be that the Netherworld sought another major invasion?
"Yes, I had just picked a Blood Heart Fruit when I saw Xuezhi's aura, heading this way to kill!"
Xu Yan said, nodding as he entered the great city.
"You obtained a Blood Heart Fruit?"
The thrilled voice of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable rang out.
"You despicable and shameless scoundrel Wan, what trick did you use to kill my Blood Disciples!"
The raging roar could already be heard coming this way.
The dreadful surge of blood energy swept towards the great city, with the Xuezhi furious beyond measure.
"Someone from my Wan Family shall settle the score with you."
The elder of the Wan Family left these words and went to meet the oncoming Xuezhi.
Within the city, the color drained from the faces of many Martial Artists as they readied for battle, and the fierce fight between Xuezhi and the elder of the Wan Family had already begun, more intense than any before. The Xuezhi seemed to be fighting desperately.
For the moment, the elder of the Wan Family was caught somewhat off guard, puzzled as to when he had ever extinguished the Xuezhi's Blood Disciples.
No wonder the Xuezhi was so enraged. After counting and investigating, he was shocked to find the Blood Disciple's stone houses were half empty. The Blood Disciples he had painstakingly raised were at least seventy percent gone!
His immediate thought was that it was the doing of the elder of the Wan Family, for apart from him, no other Martial Artist had the strength to do so.
Out of anger, he immediately launched an assault.
Seventy percent gone, a direct loss of seventy percent of the Blood Disciples. What method did that old undying scoundrel of the Wan Family use to achieve this?

chapters.title: Chapter 735 - 388: Wan Tianlin, The Assault Emerges
chapters.content:
"You old dog of the Wan Family, you despicable and shameless scoundrel, how did you kill so many of my Blood Disciples? I'll never rest until you're dead!"
"This debt must be avenged; none of your people will be allowed to walk in the Heavenly Grotto. I, Xuezhi, will personally step in to annihilate you all!"
"Old Wan, meet your death!"
The Snake Peak Xuezhi had gone mad!
While the old Patriarch of the Wan Family was trying desperately to block the Snake Peak Xuezhi from advancing towards the major city, and cursing, "Stop talking nonsense! When have I ever killed your Blood Disciples?"
"Don't try to argue; who else could it be but you? Sneaking onto my territory, assassinating my Blood Disciples, killing seven-tenths of them, you lowlife, shameless scoundrel, ah ah ah, I've set my sights on your Wan Family Martial Artists— I will kill you all!"
The Snake Peak Xuezhi was acting completely insane!
The old Patriarch of the Wan Family was dumbfounded. Seven-tenths of Snake Peak Xuezhi's Blood Disciples had been killed?
F*ck!
It's no wonder he was under suspicion; aside from him, an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, who else could do it?
But, he couldn't have done it either.
As soon as he approached the Netherworld Territory, the Snake Peak Xuezhi would have detected him instantly.
If he could infiltrate without making a sound, why bother with the Blood Disciples? He would have directly assassinated the Snake Peak Xuezhi!
Suddenly, the image of that young man popped into his mind.
"Could it have been him? No, that's impossible. Who could infiltrate the Netherworld Territory and carry out assassinations? Even if they could infiltrate and assassinate one or two Blood Disciples, it would be remarkable. Yet someone assassinated seven-tenths of them?"
"It's out of the question, it must be that the Snake Peak Xuezhi is feigning madness as an excuse, trying to break the tacit agreement formed between us!"
The old Patriarch of the Wan Family suddenly understood. Naturally, there was an understanding that the Snake Peak Xuezhi would not attack any other Divine Realm Warriors except for him, and vice versa, he would not attack anyone below Xuezhi.
That is, their only opponents were each other.
Now, it seemed that the Snake Peak Xuezhi was looking for an excuse to break this understanding.
Thinking that he had grasped the reason, the old Patriarch of the Wan Family also roared in anger and fought the Snake Peak Xuezhi as if he had gone mad.
"You treacherous fiend from the Netherworld, if you want to fight, then fight! Stop looking for excuses!"
Boom!
This intense battle was the most fierce and tragic of all the numerous clashes they had ever engaged in.
The Snake Peak Xuezhi believed that the old Patriarch of the Wan Family was looking down on him—how could he swallow such an insult?
And the old Patriarch of the Wan Family thought that the Snake Peak Xuezhi was making excuses. If so, he would show how he too could unleash his fury. How could he show weakness?
Thus, the two powerhouses fought ferociously. The battle lasted a day and a night, and neither rested, as if determined to take it to the death!
The sight made the skin of all the Martial Artists in the city crawl. They had never witnessed such a violent battle at the Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm before!
"The old Wan can win, right?"
"He should be able to, right?"
"Oh no, look, the old Wan is spitting blood!"
"Don't panic, the Snake Peak Xuezhi is spitting blood too."
The Martial Artists in the city felt uneasy. If the old Patriarch of the Wan Family were to lose, wouldn't this major city fall?
Meanwhile, Xu Yan, the instigator, watching the battle outside the city walls, was full of admiration.
"Truly worthy of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable. When they go mad, it's terrifying!"
He was secretly relieved that he had escaped in time, or else he would have to face the frenzied Snake Peak Xuezhi.
"They can't keep fighting like this, can they? They won't both perish, will they?"
Xu Yan was secretly astounded.
The Snake Peak Xuezhi, apparently having lost seven-tenths of his Blood Disciples, was so enraged that he had lost his reason, determined to fight to the death.
If at this moment the old Patriarch of the Wan Family showed any timidity and his frenzied state subsided, he would surely fall into disadvantage and defeat would be inevitable.
"Not bad, this old Patriarch of the Wan Family is not in the least bit timid; he has the air of someone ready to perish together with his opponent!"
Xu Yan nodded secretly to himself. True to being a seasoned character, the old man knew well that now was not the time to shrink back. He fought with more and more ferocity as the battle raged on.
"The matter of the Blood Heart Fruit will be discovered by the Wan Family soon, and that will be the time to strike a deal. However, the trade can't happen here, as it's always wise to guard against others."
Xu Yan didn't continue to watch the battle. He turned and left the Snake Peak Cave, waiting for the proud Wan Tianlin of the Wan Family to come to him.
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable clash at the Snake Peak Cave lasted three days and three nights, and the ferocity was beyond imagination— it was called the most brutal Immortal Heavenly Venerable battle in the history of the Snake Peak Cave.
"Old Wan, this isn't over; you just wait!"
While spitting blood, the Snake Peak Xuezhi turned into a streak of blood-light and retreated.
"Afraid of you? As if!"
The old Patriarch of the Wan Family, though severely injured and bleeding from the mouth, was far from fear.
He wondered, did the Snake Peak Xuezhi go mad just because seven-tenths of his Blood Disciples had been killed?
"Doesn't make sense though, who could kill so many Blood Disciples?"
Unless he took action himself, but the Snake Peak Xuezhi surely would not have been deceived by that. And which Martial Artists below Immortal Heavenly Venerable could have such strength?
Even through covert attacks and assassinations, it wouldn't be possible.
"I've got to heal up quickly. The plan to attack the Netherworld camp has to be scrapped. Thankfully, someone has already harvested the Blood Heart Fruit."
Immediately, the old Patriarch of the Wan Family returned to the city to focus on healing, knowing the Snake Peak Xuezhi might return in a frenzy at any moment.
Plans don't always work out. The ambush on the Netherworld camp and the harvesting of Blood Heart Fruit were canceled, and the Martial Artists who had come for this purpose couldn't help but feel disappointed.
But they knew it was unavoidable.
After all, the battle that had just ended was shockingly brutal. The severity of the old Patriarch of the Wan Family's injuries was beyond imagination.
For the first time, they saw an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, so lofty and in command of his Domain, reduced to such a piteous and sorry state.

chapters.title: Chapter 736 - 388 Wan Tianlin, The Assassination Approaches_2
chapters.content:
"Watching the battle for three days and three nights, witnessing such a powerful clash, it was worth it—not a wasted trip!"
"Indeed, it wasn't a wasted trip."
"Without achieving immortality, all will eventually turn to dust. How can one step into the Immortal Realm?"
After witnessing the power of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, a host of True King Heavenly Venerables sighed deeply in their hearts, filled with both envy and admiration.
However, the Immortal Realm seemed like an insurmountable chasm, one which maybe one in ten thousand could cross.
Many once-glorious geniuses ultimately stopped before the Immortal Realm, never able to make that final step.
To step into the Immortal Realm requires not only talent but also fortune, great destiny, and immense willpower.
"Has someone obtained a Blood Heart Fruit?"
"Yes, young master."
"Where are they, and what do they want?"
"At Yu Zhu Slope, it seems they wish to exchange it for rare treasures of heaven and earth."
"Let's go, to Yu Zhu Slope."
Upon hearing of the Blood Heart Fruit, Wan Tianlin, the third young master of the Wan Family, immediately set off for Yu Zhu Slope.
Yu Zhu Slope, somewhat famous in Dahai Mountain due to the jade-like bamboo that grows there, was picturesque and a favorite place among martial artists for secluded cultivation.
Xu Yan had revealed the existence of the Blood Heart Fruit and his whereabouts to the people of the Wan Family and was now waiting at Yu Zhu Slope.
"With the Wan Family's resources and prestige, they wouldn't stoop to stealing treasures. For the Blood Heart Fruit, try to trade for as many needed heavenly and earthly treasures as possible."
A few strands of Yu Zhu had been intertwined by Xu Yan into a makeshift chair, upon which he sat leisurely, awaiting the arrival of Wan Tianlin.
Xu Yan had already made a list of the treasures he required, and with the resources of the Wan Family, even if they couldn't provide everything, they should be able to fulfill most of it.
As for whether there was danger in the trade, Xu Yan wasn't concerned.
Moreover, considering the resources and prestige of the Wan Family, they probably wouldn't resort to outright robbery over a single Blood Heart Fruit, especially since they were prepared to trade for it.
Of course, if they did harbor evil intentions and wanted to seize the Blood Heart Fruit, Xu Yan wasn't afraid. With no Immortal Heavenly Venerables present, those True King Heavenly Venerables could hardly trouble him.
Even if he couldn't defeat them, he could easily retreat.
"I hope Wan Tianlin doesn't intend to oppress a loose cultivator."
Xu Yan muttered to himself. If he could avoid offending the Wan Family, he naturally wouldn't do so, as it was a formidable family with more than one Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
But he also wouldn't fear the strength of the Wan Family. If there was a need to strike, he would—regardless of the present disparity in power, as he was confident that any accounts would eventually be settled once his strength increased.
Moreover, Xu Yan believed that aside from the Immortal Heavenly Venerables, no martial artist below the True King Heavenly Venerable could pose any threat to him.
Even if overpowered, he could easily escape.
Each Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Divine Realm would not leave their post lightly, fearing giving an opportunity to powerful enemies from the Heavenly Grotto to invade. This meant the likelihood of being hunted down by an Immortal Heavenly Venerable was extremely low.
Xu Yan waited at Yu Zhu Slope, and a day later, three people arrived.
The leader was a young man with a refined appearance, exuding a barely concealed arrogance in his gaze.
His strength was at the early stage of the Truth Refinement Realm.
The other two were at the late stage of the Truth Refinement Realm, serving as guards.
Xu Yan's eyes fell on the refined young man. At such an age, to have already become a True King Heavenly Venerable, his talent was undoubtedly extraordinary.
Furthermore, his aura was stable, as if concealing a formidable power, making his strength remarkable among his peers.
Wan Tianlin!
"Are you the one who obtained the Blood Heart Fruit?"
As soon as he arrived, Wan Tianlin asked eagerly.
"Yes, it's me!"
Xu Yan nodded.
"Good, very good. What are your conditions? Do you want to join the Wan Family, follow me, or do you need cultivation techniques, or perhaps the protection of the Wan Family?"
Wan Tianlin asked excitedly.
"I neither wish to follow you nor need the protection of your Wan Family. I only want some treasures. If you have the treasures I seek, the Blood Heart Fruit is yours."
Xu Yan handed over the list he had prepared.
Wan Tianlin raised an eyebrow, clearly surprised. How could mere treasures compare to the value of following him or having the protection of the Wan Family?
With the Wan Family as a backing, why would one worry about lack of treasures?
Nevertheless, since the other party wanted treasures, it simplified matters. The trade became much more straightforward.
"All right, no questio..."
Wan Tianlin took over the list and was about to agree when his eyes landed on the treasures listed and he suddenly hesitated.
His brows furrowed slightly.
"Are you sure these are the treasures you want?"
He looked up at Xu Yan with furrowed brows.
"Of course!"
Xu Yan nodded, but seeing that Wan Tianlin seemed to be having some difficulty, he added, "It doesn't have to be complete, even fifty percent would be fine."
Wan Tianlin examined the list, pondering for a long while before saying, "To be frank, I can only gather about ten percent of the treasures you need right now, as the items you require are somewhat special."
"Ten percent is too little; fifty percent, or no deal!"
Xu Yan shook his head.
The value of the Blood Heart Fruit was higher than half the treasures on his list, but the treasures he needed were focused on certain effects, perhaps scarce in the Nine Mountain Realm and not because they were excessively valuable.
"Fifty percent will take time to collect, could something else replace them? Like a Cultivation Technique from the Immortal Realm."
Wan Tianlin pondered before speaking.
"There's no need for Cultivation Techniques; with your Wan Family's capabilities, collecting fifty percent shouldn't be difficult, right?"
Xu Yan shook his head.
Wan Tianlin, with a furrowed brow, uttered, "You give me the Blood Heart Fruit, and once I've gathered the treasures, I will send them to you, how about that?"
Xu Yan smiled, "A face-to-face transaction, owing nothing to each other, or forget about it."
"Do you not trust me, Wan Tianlin? Or do you not trust the Wan Family's credibility?"
Wan Tianlin's expression grew colder.
Xu Yan smiled indifferently, completely unconcerned with the other's attitude, noting from the moment Wan Tianlin appeared, that he was an arrogant, even self-important individual.
"It's just a transaction, why bring up trust? If you can't produce the items, then let's call off the deal, and I'll find someone else willing to trade."
Xu Yan looked directly at Wan Tianlin as he spoke.
"I can gather eighty percent of the items you need, but I urgently require the Blood Heart Fruit. Give me the Blood Heart Fruit and the items will surely be delivered to you completely, how about that?"
Wan Tianlin took a deep breath, speaking in a grave tone.
"It's not out of the question, you can make a Martial Arts oath."
Xu Yan thought for a moment before responding.
"No one has ever dared ask me, Wan Tianlin, to swear an oath. You're wearing down my patience; do you know the consequences?"
Wan Tianlin's demeanor became even colder.
"Or perhaps, you plan to simply take it by force?"
Xu Yan took out a Blood Heart Fruit, holding it in his hand, and spoke cheerfully.
Wan Tianlin focused on the Blood Heart Fruit in his palm, seemingly afraid that Xu Yan would destroy it, and took a deep breath, saying, "I'll gather the items in three days!"
"Agreed!"
Xu Yan nodded.
Wan Tianlin turned and departed, while Xu Yan watched his retreating figure then looked up at the sky, mumbling, "Should I leave now, or wait and risk offending the Wan Family?"
At this moment, he was a bit hesitant.
Judging from Wan Tianlin's attitude, he probably wouldn't go through with a fair trade, but was preparing to play dirty.
Still, fearing the destruction of the Blood Heart Fruit, retreating for now was just a stalling tactic.
What Xu Yan had to consider was whether to leave directly, abandoning the trade with Wan Tianlin, and in doing so, avoid conflict with the Wan Family.
Or stay, ready to defend himself if Wan Tianlin indeed tried to take the fruit by force, which would inevitably offend the Wan Family.
"If I decide to strike, it must be to completely eradicate the enemy. If I kill Wan Tianlin, will the Wan Family just let it go?
"Enough, the Blood Heart Fruit isn't exclusive to the Wan Family, and there's no need to invite unnecessary trouble."
After much contemplation, Xu Yan decided to leave, not wanting to waste more time on Wan Tianlin.
"Let's go to Thousand Layered Mountain, and along the way, find a place to consume the Blood Heart Fruit and comprehend the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path."
Xu Yan was not afraid of offending the Wan Family but saw no reason to waste time entangled with them, ultimately deciding to call off the transaction.
Leaving Yu Zhu Slope, Xu Yan briefly discerned the direction before setting off towards the Thousand Layered Mountain region.
"Strive to obtain enough treasures as soon as possible, accumulate my foundation, and break through to the Physiognomy Realm."
Xu Yan was full of anticipation, wondering what special physique he would acquire after this breakthrough and transformation.
A Sacred Body?
Suddenly, two powerful presences descended, one on each side, with bone-chilling sharpness, heading straight for him.

chapters.title: Chapter 737 - 389: The Sword Slashes the Incoming Enemy, Wan Tianlin is Attacked
chapters.content:
```
Two figures suddenly appeared, launching lethal strikes the moment they emerged.
Xu Yan's expression remained unchanged, and in the span of a thought, a large tree beside him instantly transformed into a colossal sword, exuding a chilling Sword Intent, slashing towards the attacker on the left!
Grasses, bristling with a chilling aura, as if imbued with Spiritual Wisdom, densely shot towards the assailant on the right.
Simultaneously, Xu Yan's figure moved, and he slashed his sword towards the front!
Supreme Heavenly Sword!
Swish!
A figure emerged, roaring as a punch was thrown out, attempting to block Xu Yan's sword strike.
"Hiding your head and showing your tail."
Xu Yan sneered coldly, and in the eyes of the three shocked assailants, all the vegetation transformed into fearsome Swords of Slaughter. What's even more terrifying was that each sword seemed to possess its own Spiritual Wisdom, its own swordsmanship.
In an instant, the three attackers found themselves as if inside a world of swords.
"Wan Family's men?"
Xu Yan glanced at the three masked attackers, their true faces hidden, and frowned slightly as he spoke.
"Hand over the Blood Heart Fruit, and you may be spared from death!"
One of them said in a hoarse voice.
"With just you?"
Xu Yan showed a look of disdain.
Three Martial Artists at the mid phase of True King Heavenly Venerable daring to assassinate him? Did they tire of living?
"Make it quick. Three at the True King mid phase I do not fear, but faced with three at the True King Heavenly Venerable Peak, I might have to temporarily avoid their edge."
Xu Yan's eyes grew cold, his Sword Arts Divine Skill unleashed in an instant, while the visage of Mountains and Rivers in the Sword appeared, and the three attackers felt as though they'd entered a world within the Sword Dao.
Endless killing intent, endless swords, densely packed, caused the trio's expressions to drastically change.
The battle concluded, and where the fight took place, not a single plant remained, the air still vibrating with sharp Sword Intent.
"Wan Family, I, Xu Yan, have noted this!"
Xu Yan sneered coldly.
All three attackers were dead. In light of his near-full-powered assault, and having entered his Mountains and Rivers in the Sword Divine Skill realm, how could mere mid-phase True King Heavenly Venerables escape death?
Yet, Xu Yan found no clues to their identities on their bodies.
However, other than Wan Tianlin who coveted the Blood Heart Fruit, no one else would have reason to attack him. Moreover, for the powerful Wan Family, it was all too simple to train a group of expendables to do dirty work.
"Wan Tianlin, you seek a path to your demise!"
Xu Yan's figure flickered, disappearing from the spot instantly. Now that Wan Tianlin had made his move, there was no need for him to hold back any longer.
Killing Wan Tianlin, let's see what the Wan Family can do!
Boom!
Several figures arrived to encircle and kill, each wearing a mask, revealing only their cold eyes. Their strikes were meant to kill, even at the cost of injury to themselves, preferring death as long as they could inflict harm.
"Young master, flee quickly, this is a trap!"
The protector at the peak of True King, valiantly fought off the attackers' barrages.
Wan Tianlin's gaze was icy, his voice chillingly cold: "Very well, very well, what a bold move, disregarding the Wan Family. All for the sake of luring me in with the Blood Heart Fruit.
"Let's see just how capable you are of killing me, Wan Tianlin!"
Hum!
Suddenly, a streak of cold light swept out like a ribbon, engulfing an attacker.
Wan Tianlin made his move.
His weapon was the Spirit Cicada Blade, thin as a cicada's wing, slender and long, and as softly pliable as silk, its attacks versatile.
As the scion of the Wan Family, Wan Tianlin's strength was naturally dominant among his contemporaries.
Puchi!
The moment the Spirit Cicada Blade was wielded, its tip flickered and, embodying various changes, sliced open a wound on the adversary's chest.
Blood spurted forth.
"Speak, who sent you?"
Wan Tianlin demanded harshly.
The response was the attacker's frenzied assault, as if they were fighting without regard for their lives. One of them, ignoring his attack, allowed the Spirit Cicada Blade to pierce through his body, determined to inflict injury upon him!
"Young master!"
The two protectors, seeing Wan Tianlin's shoulder wound, were shocked, and one of them roared, unleashing a secret technique. In an instant, the peak power of True King exploded in that strike.
Puff!
The attacker was promptly slain.
"Young master, we must leave quickly, any delay could mean trouble!"
The protector who used the secret technique urgently spoke.
"Fine!"
Wan Tianlin nodded, seizing the chance to break free from the encirclement.
The other protector followed closely, not leaving his side.
"Young master, I'll go kill the one with the Blood Heart Fruit and seize it from him!"
After the last attacker fell, the protector who had used the secret technique, burning with anger, sent a message.
Wan Tianlin frowned, about to call out to the protector, but the man had already returned to Yu Zhu Slope, ablaze with rage and intent to kill.
"Young master, this is no trivial matter. If they realize the ambush failed, there might be more powerful contenders arriving."
The protector by Wan Tianlin's side spoke gravely.
"Let's go!"
Wan Tianlin nodded and swiftly retreated, his eyes brimming with lethal intent.
Dahai Mountain, being the Wan Family's domain, to dare an ambush on their territory against him, the pride of the Wan Family, was a provocation that could not be forgiven!
Within the entire Dahai Mountain region, who did not know that he, Wan Tianlin, sought the Blood Heart Fruit to aid in his study of the Wan Family's secret arts and to plot for breaking through to Immortal Heavenly Venerable?
The temptation of the Blood Heart Fruit was too great for him, and the enemy seized upon this to lure him in with the fruit, aiming to catch him off guard and assassinate him.
Before this incident, who could have imagined that someone would be so audacious as to attack him, the scion of the Wan Family, on Dahai Mountain?
```

chapters.title: Chapter 738 - 389: Sword Slashes the Incoming Enemy, Wan Tianlin is Attacked_2
chapters.content:
"You underestimate the power of Wan Tianlin!"
Wan Tianlin's gaze was gloomy. Had he not been powerful, the assassin's attack just now would have been more than a minor injury.
Even though he was undying, he might have suffered a severe blow, even endangering his martial arts foundations!
The more he thought about the previous danger, the more murderous Wan Tianlin became.
...
After killing the assassin, Xu Yan headed back towards Yu Zhu Slope, pursuing in the direction Wan Tianlin had fled.
If they dared to assassinate him, they should be prepared to be killed in return.
As for the strength of the Wan Family, Xu Yan didn't care at all; it was probably just like when he first entered the Spiritual Realm, rising from adversity and then striking back.
"Here they come!"
A strong presence appeared, and the newcomer was filled with murderous intent.
It was one of the two guards accompanying Wan Tianlin, a Martial Artist at the True King Heavenly Venerable Peak.
Xu Yan was not afraid at all.
He stopped in his tracks, and in an instant, with him at the center, he silently set up the Mountain and River Sword Intent, quietly enveloping his surroundings with the Mountains and Rivers in the Sword.
The grass and trees on the ground were also ready to strike, as the Sword Array was prepared.
Once the enemy stepped into the Mountain and River, they would be struck with annihilation.
"Hand over the Blood Heart Fruit, tell me who you are, and I'll grant you a swift death!"
Wan Tianlin's guard said with chilling murderous intent.
"Where is Wan Tianlin? I've been looking for him!"
Xu Yan let out a cold laugh.
"You deserve to die!"
Wan Tianlin's guard attacked immediately. He had used a secret technique which couldn't be sustained for too long, so he wasted no more words, intending to kill Xu Yan and retrieve the Blood Heart Fruit from him if Xu Yan had it.
Boom!
A powerful punch, like a great mountain crashing down, was daunting.
"Draw the sword!"
Xu Yan's eyes glinted coldly.
Mountains and rivers emerged, with grass and trees transforming into a myriad of sword streams, shooting upwards as the Sword Array also materialized.
"Hmm?"
The guard's gaze sharpened, surprised at this Sword Dao.
In that instant, he felt as though he had entered another domain, surrounded by a biting cold intent, with the aura of slaughter immensely terrifying.
"What Martial Arts Technique is this!"
The guard was greatly alarmed. Such Martial Arts Techniques he had neither seen nor heard of before.
A strong sense of crisis surged in his heart, and he was deeply shocked. After all, he was at the peak of True King Heavenly Venerable; even though he was currently in a period of decline due to the secret technique, he still possessed the peak strength of a True King Heavenly Venerable.
Faced with these sword lights, he actually felt a life-and-death crisis.
"Agh!"
With a loud roar, his face flushed with blood color, and then it turned pale. At the same time, his aura increased by another thirty percent.
Faced with a life-and-death crisis, he used another secret technique, one that greatly harmed himself but could significantly enhance his strength temporarily.
"Die!"
The guard's fists kept pounding out. In mid-air, the sound of thunderous booms kept ringing out as punch after punch, each like a mountain, piled on top of the other, relentlessly charging.
Rumble!
The mountains and rivers shook, as swords were continuously blown away, but more swords replenished them incessantly.
As far as the eye could see, the sword light seemed endless.
"Die! Die for challenging the Wan Family, you are bound to die!"
Xu Yan's eyes became harsher.
"Using a secret technique, huh? Let's see how long you can maintain it!"
Xu Yan sneered in his heart.
This True King Heavenly Venerable's strength was indeed formidable. Even if Xu Yan went all out, killing the opponent would take some time.
