The fight grew more and more intense, with the battlefield showing nothing but sword streams like torrents and punch impressions like massive mountains, ramming and continuously scattering the torrent of sword lights.
At one moment, Xu Yan's eyes became focused.
The opponent's momentum was weakening, and a fleeting sense of stagnation appeared.
The opportunity has come!
A sword transformed from a blade of grass, silently passing through layers of sword light, moved like a nimble snake, avoiding the dense imprints of fists.
It seemed to possess spiritual wisdom, diverting the attention of the guards, swift and agile, emitting a cold and fierce sword light, creating an extremely dangerous sensation.
The guard, a True King Heavenly Venerable, immediately had a solemn look on his face, not daring to be careless, focusing completely on this sword, shocked in his heart. How could this sword seemingly possess spiritual wisdom?
However, in the moment his attention shifted, another flash of sword light suddenly dimmed, blending with the environment of the battlefield. Amidst the gentle breeze, it had already approached the back of his head!
Thud!
The sword light, like a serpent, drilled into his head, and in an instant turned into a raging windstorm battering his Divine Soul!
"Ah!"
The True King Heavenly Venerable let out a scream, his eyes bulging with blood, as the intense pain in his Divine Soul caused him to subconsciously cover his head with both hands.
Meanwhile, the sword that had transformed from the blade of grass, swift as ever, pierced his chest at this moment!
Immediately, layers of sword light swept over like surging waves, completely engulfing him.
Xu Yan waved his hand, and a Storage Bag flew towards him from amidst the layers of sword light.
The opponent was at the peak of True King Heavenly Venerable and also a guard for Wan Tianlin; anyone serving as a guard for such a peerless talent like Wan Tianlin must hold a significant position within the Wan Family.
Xu Yan, who was currently in the phase of accumulating resources, naturally wouldn't waste the belongings carried by the other party.
"Wan Tianlin, let's see what you can do now!"
Xu Yan sneered and once more pursued Wan Tianlin.
However, this pursuit was fruitless; it appeared that Wan Tianlin had already returned to the Wan Family.
"Wait three more days, let's see if you come for the trade!"
Xu Yan contemplated inwardly.
Since they had brazenly sent a guard to ambush and steal the Blood Heart Fruit, perhaps Wan Tianlin might choose not to come for the trade in three days, but instead organize a team to ambush and attempt to steal from Xu Yan.
"But it's not necessarily so!"
Xu Yan mused. If Wan Tianlin came to Yu Zhu Slope for the trade in three days as if nothing had happened, then strong protectors would certainly follow him secretly.
It couldn't be the Immortal Heavenly Venerable; given his status, even if Wan Tianlin was a peerless talent, he wouldn't be worthy of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable's personal protection.
But, for those who stood at the threshold of the Immortal Realm yet could progress no further, it was possible that someone of that level could come.
Or perhaps, he might bring several guards.
"Then let's wait and see in three days. If you don't come, I'll change my identity and continue selling the Blood Heart Fruit to see if you take the bait!"
Xu Yan had a plan in mind.
He immediately returned to Yu Zhu Slope and pondered for a moment before a figure emerged from his body and sat in the chair he had originally occupied.
Divine Origin Avatar!
To avoid being trapped in an encirclement, Xu Yan decided to wait for Wan Tianlin with his Divine Origin Avatar.
"So what if it is the Divine Realm? Would you ever have imagined such wondrous Martial Arts Techniques?"
Xu Yan smiled.
The aura of the Divine Origin Avatar was exactly the same as his, indistinguishable by those unaware that such avatars existed in the world of Martial Arts.
Moreover, Xu Yan's Divine Origin Avatar had cast the Dust Technique, making its presence ordinary, with not a hint of the aura typical of avatars.
In such a situation, even those aware of the existence of avatars couldn't detect that this was one.
After leaving behind a Divine Origin Avatar, Xu Yan immediately departed and concealed himself thirty miles from the avatar.
At this distance, the Divine Origin Avatar remained connected to his consciousness, allowing him to direct the avatar with his mind without worrying about it falling into dormancy.
"At worst, I would only lose a bit of my Divine Origin."
If his Divine Origin Avatar were destroyed, Xu Yan would only suffer a loss of some Divine Origin, which he could easily cultivate back.
"Destroying my Divine Origin Avatar is no different from killing me. Prepare for my visit, Xu Yan's retaliation."
Xu Yan was already plotting; if he robbed the Wan Family's treasure vaults, wouldn't he no longer need to worry about the resources needed to build his foundation?
Wan Tianlin, upon returning to the Wan Family, immediately arranged for people to start investigating Xu Yan's information.
At the same time, he looked into which power the attacker might belong to.
In the Nine Mountain Realm, those who had the confidence to confront the Wan Family were only the remaining eight families; however, there had never been any significant hatred between them, and they would even aid each other in the face of crises from the Heavenly Grotto.
This was an unspoken agreement; faced with the threat from the Heavenly Grotto, all other enmities were put on hold, a consensus in the Divine Realm, a rule adhered to across the Thirty-six Realms.
But apart from the other eight powers, what other forces in the Nine Mountain Realm would dare provoke the Wan Family?
As for the news of Wan Tianlin's assault, once it reached the ears of the Wan Family elders, they were greatly enraged, prompting the entire Wan Family to mobilize.
However, they did not make a public spectacle; instead, they conducted their investigation in secret, and the outside world remained oblivious.
As for the bounty on the Blood Heart Fruit, it had been doubled!

chapters.title: Chapter 739 - 390 Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow
chapters.content:
Dahai Mountain, due to Wan Tianlin being injured in an attack, is currently undergoing dark undercurrents, while Xu Yan is waiting to see if Wan Tianlin will come to Yu Zhu Slope three days from now.
No matter whether Wan Tianlin comes or not, Xu Yan will not let matters rest.
Those who dare to attack him and covet the Blood Heart Fruit must bear the appropriate price.
As for the Wan Family, no matter how strong they are, so what?
Being unable to defeat today does not mean forever defeated; one day, he will trample the Wan Family into the dust.
"I'll set the Wan Family as my target, and cultivate diligently to destroy them!"
Xu Yan thought to himself determinedly.
The Divine Origin Avatar sat leisurely on a chair, waiting for visitors, while Xu Yan's true self had already hidden away, blending into the surroundings.
Even the Immortal Heavenly Venerable couldn't see through his concealment.
This was Xu Yan's confidence; as long as he wasn't directly intercepted by the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, he could use this to avoid being pursued by them.
As long as he could escape from Dahai Mountain, leave the Nine Mountain Realm, the Wan Family would pose no threat to him. Once his strength increased, he would seek out the Wan Family to settle their grievances.
"If Wan Tianlin doesn't come, someone else will make the trip,"
Xu Yan muttered to himself.
He had already been pondering, with a change of identity, to entice Wan Tianlin to appear again with the Blood Heart Fruit as bait.
Wan Family.
News of Xu Yan had already been delivered to Wan Tianlin.
"Entered the Snake Peak Cave and picked the Blood Heart Fruit..."
Wan Tianlin mused.
About Xu Yan's identity, it remains unknown, but it's almost certain that he is not a Martial Artist of Dahai Mountain.
Did he enter the Snake Peak Cave specifically to obtain the Blood Heart Fruit?
"Something isn't right!"
Wan Tianlin took a deep breath, his expression extremely grim. According to information from the Snake Peak Cave, from Xu Yan's appearance to the Xuezhi's madness, it was all too coincidental.
"Why would the Snake Peak Xuezhi turn so wildly mad? Going so far as to not shy away from a mutually destructive battle, all because he appeared in the Snake Peak Cave..."
Wan Tianlin's gaze became sharper.
The turmoil at the Snake Peak Cave was this person's doing; it might even be possible that he had colluded with the Netherworld.
However, upon further thought, if he had indeed colluded with the Netherworld, why would the Snake Peak Xuezhi be willing to incur such losses for his actions?
What was the purpose?
For the Snake Peak Xuezhi, there were no benefits.
"Not necessarily colluding with the Netherworld, but merely using the Netherworld to weaken my Wan Family, specifically targeting my Wan Family... The Blood Heart Fruit, perhaps, wasn't picked this time. He merely entered the Snake Peak Cave, pretending to have picked the Blood Heart Fruit. Using some method, he enraged the Snake Peak Xuezhi, causing him to lash out in fury..."
Wan Tianlin sniffed out a trace of conspiracy.
"Has the person returned?"
Wan Tianlin suddenly looked up and asked.
"No!"
The guard responded gravely.
"Things are looking grim!"
A murderous intent flashed in Wan Tianlin's eyes.
"Young Master, are we still going to Yu Zhu Slope?"
The guard asked hesitantly.
"You go there and see if he is present,"
Wan Tianlin pondered for a moment before instructing.
"Young Master, what if he is there?"
"Proceed with the transaction as agreed. First, get the Blood Heart Fruit. If he's not there, it's clear he has a guilty conscience."
Wan Tianlin sneered, "Once the Blood Heart Fruit is in hand, the next step is to probe the powers behind him. I will eradicate them root and branch!"
"Young Master, I understand!"
The guard nodded.
"This time, two clan elders will follow in secret; you can rest assured."
For Wan Tianlin, obtaining the Blood Heart Fruit was an urgent matter and something he had to acquire.
Getting the Blood Heart Fruit from the Snake Peak Cave had always been challenging, especially since the Snake Peak Xuezhi had just had a bout of madness, and the clan elders had also sustained serious injuries. There would be no opportunity to pick the Blood Heart Fruit anytime soon.
Therefore, the Blood Heart Fruit in Xu Yan's possession was extremely important to him.
"Additionally, have someone check who has obtained the Blood Heart Fruit in the past, as well as who has entered the depths of the Snake Peak Cave and had the chance to pick the Blood Heart Fruit.
"Compile a list, probe secretly, and see if there are any findings!"
Wan Tianlin thought for a moment and then gave the orders.
The rarity and uniqueness of the Blood Heart Fruit meant that those who got their hands on it would consume it to aid in their comprehension of Martial Arts Cultivation Techniques, especially Martial Artists at a bottleneck.
Even if they didn't use it themselves, they would trade it immediately to acquire essential resources needed urgently.
Even the Wan Family didn't have any stockpiled.
To acquire the Blood Heart Fruit, one could only wait for the war with the Netherworld to create an opportunity to pick it, and even then, quantities were limited and not everyone could get it.
Gifted individuals like Wan Tianlin would receive special treatment, making proactive efforts to procure the Blood Heart Fruit for him, but plans could not keep up with changes.
For the time being, to get the Blood Heart Fruit quickly, he had to trade with Xu Yan.
In a certain Dark Cave of Dahai Mountain, several figures gathered together.
"The plan is progressing smoothly so far,"
the lead figure said in a deep voice.
The few people in the cave all wore masks, and the leader's mask was adorned with a pair of fangs, appearing extremely ferocious.
Among them, it was this person who had the greatest strength.
"Wan Tianlin wasn't killed, and Xu Yan didn't die either. How can the plan be considered smooth?"
One of them voiced their doubt.
"If Wan Tianlin and Xu Yan were killed so easily, it would raise suspicions about whether this could cause enough turmoil.
"Now that the Wan Family is investigating Xu Yan, and Xu Yan will surely blame the Wan Family for the assassination attempt, all we need to do is keep intensifying their conflict and deepen their mutual hatred.

chapters.title: Chapter 740 - 390: Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow_2
chapters.content:
"We only need to wait for the crucial moment, to kill Wan Tianlin or perhaps Xu Yan, and our objective will be achieved. A conflict between Qinghua state and Nine Mountain Realm will be inevitable!"
The person in the Ferocious Mask said with a cold laugh.
"Xu Yan is not one of the three major powers of Qinghua state; can he really provoke a conflict between the two sides?"
Someone doubted.
"The name of Sword God Xu Yan is renowned throughout Qinghua state, and he is the object of reverence for all sword cultivators there; his identity is not simple. Had I not gone to Qinghua state myself, I would probably be unable to confirm his significance.
"Now that Xu Yan has come to the Nine Mountain Realm and intends to transact Blood Heart Fruit with Wan Tianlin, it is an opportunity bestowed by heaven, not to be missed,"
said the person in the Ferocious Mask, full of confidence.
"What should we do next?"
Another masked person asked.
"Wan Tianlin currently urgently needs the Blood Heart Fruit, and as Xu Yan possesses it, he will inevitably engage in a transaction with Xu Yan. Our next move is much simpler—further intensify the conflict…"
The person in the Ferocious Mask said, laying out their following actions with chilling intent.
...
When the time arranged to meet with Wan Tianlin arrived, Xu Yan was surprised to find that the person who came was one of Wan Tianlin's guards from before.
Moreover, they indeed came to transact the Blood Heart Fruit.
"This is the treasure you require; check it,"
the guard said, getting straight to the point with a cold demeanor, as if both sides understood something had been done without saying it out loud.
Xu Yan nodded, not bothering with pleasantries, and began to check the items. After verifying there were no mistakes, he went ahead and traded away a Blood Heart Fruit.
Since the other party was so straightforward, Xu Yan considered himself someone who honors promises, and the transaction had to be conducted as agreed. As for the matter of killing Wan Tianlin, it could be dealt with after the transaction.
Besides, since Wan Tianlin had not come, it was clear that he wanted to avoid deepening the conflict. Given his status as the Wan Family's prodigy, it certainly wasn't out of fear, but rather because the Blood Heart Fruit was more important to him.
"I take my leave!"
The guard sighed with relief after successfully obtaining the Blood Heart Fruit. As for what came after, that was no longer his concern.
Xu Yan smiled without stopping him. Judging by the guard's expression, it probably wouldn't be long before someone came after him.
He would just wait.
Besides, this Divine Origin Avatar of his was incapable of retaining the guard.
Watching the guard depart, Xu Yan sneered inwardly, "Now that I have the Blood Heart Fruit, let's see what you will do, Wan Tianlin."
To Xu Yan's surprise, the people from the Wan Family never came.
He couldn't help but feel perplexed. Could he have guessed wrong?
Was Wan Tianlin truly sincere about the transaction, cancelling all previous conflicts?
Swallowing his pride over the killing of his guard?
"Considering the power of the Wan Family, it's strange that Wan Tianlin could swallow such pride."
Xu Yan was filled with doubt, now somewhat conflicted. Since Wan Tianlin chose to back down, should he still seek revenge?
After all, he wasn't at a loss!
"No, the Wan Family's assassination attempt cannot be simply forgotten. Wan Tianlin may have backed down, but he hasn't compensated me at all."
With that thought, Xu Yan decided he still needed to draw out Wan Tianlin to settle the score.
After the Divine Origin Avatar returned, Xu Yan held the needed heavenly materials and earthly treasures in his hands, feeling ecstatic. He was one step closer to accumulating sufficient foundation.
"There are still quite a few Blood Heart Fruits. Besides the Wan Family, the geniuses of other powers will certainly need them as well. Trading another one should almost give me what I need,"
Xu Yan calculated, deciding to find a spot to consume the Blood Heart Fruit and meditate on the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path.
As Xu Yan left Yu Zhu Slope, the guard of Wan Tianlin had already died.
A peak True King Heavenly Venerable powerhouse was killed, and the transacted Blood Heart Fruits naturally disappeared without a trace.
The two clan elders who had followed the guard secretly were in turn obstructed by strong adversaries, preventing them from following the guard the whole way,
nor escorting the Blood Heart Fruit back.
Instead, they each suffered some minor injuries. After repelling the strong enemies and rushing over quickly, they only found the guard's corpse.
Boom!
Yu Zhu Slope was swept by a surge of immense force, reducing the bamboos to dust, and the martial artists who had been hiding and cultivating at Yu Zhu Slope all changed color, hastily fleeing for their lives.
The elders of the Wan Family went mad; this was not an enemy they could afford to offend.
Bang!
Wan Tianlin slammed the table, his killing intent chilling, his eyes filled with a desire to devour.
For the sake of the Blood Heart Fruit, he had originally decided to bide his time and directly proceed with the transaction, only to have the other party murder and rob him of his treasure!
Such an intolerable provocation!
"Find him for me, I want to tear his body into ten thousand pieces!"
Wan Tianlin roared with a deep fury.
The entire Wan Family was stirred by this incident, two of Wan Tianlin's guards had actually died, and with someone setting a trap using the Blood Heart Fruit, it was clearly targeted against Wan Tianlin.
This meant a challenge against the entire Wan Family, it was an attempt to strangle the prodigy of the Wan Family.
Even an Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Wan Family took notice of this matter, and the entire Wan Family began to demonstrate their deep foundation and power.
Dahai Mountain was shrouded in a storm of activity.
Some martial artists who showed even the slightest trace of suspicion were captured, interrogated to confirm identities, and only then were they released.
Any who resisted slightly, were executed without mercy!
"What major incident has happened? Has Heavenly Grotto invaded, or is there a traitor lurking?"
"Apart from Heavenly Grotto infiltrators or traitors, the Wan Family wouldn't engage in such thorough scrutiny."
"This doesn't feel right, if it were truly infiltrators from the Heavenly Grotto or traitors, the Wan Family would certainly offer a bounty, not keep it so secretive, not disclosing anything."
The martial artists of Dahai Mountain were all in utter shock.
The Wan Family's massive mobilization to search Dahai Mountain only made sense if Heavenly Grotto infiltrators or traitorous martial artists of significant strength and status who sided with the Heavenly Grotto had appeared.
However, in the past, such matters would have been made public, and a reward announced, yet this time, the large-scale search was led by the Wan Family's Core Guard and core forces allied with the Wan Family.
Many martial artists suspected that some kind of drastic change must have occurred within the Wan Family, hence they were only deploying their core forces without offering a large bounty.
In a certain city of Dahai Mountain, two common-looking men resembling lower-tier Loose Cultivators, watching the Wan Family's guard forces searching the city, exchanged a glance, seeing the smugness in each other's eyes.
"We need to add more fuel to the fire, arrange for someone to attack Xu Yan and make use of the Earth Shadow from the Wan Family guard."
"The Earth Shadow within the Wan Family guard is already prepared to act, but with his strength, he's unable to kill Xu Yan."
"There's no hurry to kill Xu Yan. For now, we just need both parties to confirm the other's involvement, without a third party suspect, and leave Xu Yan to be killed by the Wan Family."
"Understood. We, Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, only incite conflicts and fuel hatred without getting involved. We only need to provoke the hostility; they will naturally proceed with the killing. If we get too involved, it's easier to expose flaws."
"In the Thirty-six Realms of the Divine Realm, facing an invasion from the Heavenly Grotto, they are of one breath and branch, supporting each other. Let the conflict begin between the Nine Mountain Realm and the Qinghua state.
"Our Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow faction is probably not known to many, and that's a good thing."
The two men communicated through sound transmission.
Their eyes gleamed with self-satisfaction, as if stirring up the enmity between the Wan Family and Xu Yan was something to be proud of.
A day later.
Within a dark cave, several masked individuals gathered again.
"Haven't found Xu Yan?"
"Correct!"
"All the Earth Shadows spread out and the ones embedded in various forces brought back no trace of Xu Yan?"
"Yes, Xu Yan seems to have vanished into thin air."
The cave fell silent for a moment, a glitch had occurred in their plan.
Having lost track of Xu Yan, without his whereabouts, how could they assassinate Xu Yan, and how could they further escalate the hatred between the Wan Family and Xu Yan?
"Has Xu Yan been captured by the Wan Family?"
"The Earth Shadows lurking in the Wan Family have received no news of Xu Yan being captured by the Wan Family."
"What if an Immortal personally took action?"
"Nowadays, the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Wan Family can't easily leave their defensive positions unless Wan Tianlin dies. Otherwise, none of the Immortals would take action.
"Moreover, even if Wan Tianlin were dead, the Immortals wouldn't be able to act immediately. They would have to stabilize the situation to avoid being attacked by the Xuezhi at a critical moment before making a move."
The cave became quiet once again, everyone was perplexed. Since Xu Yan had not been captured by the Wan Family, and the Immortal Heavenly Venerables had not intervened,
How did Xu Yan just disappear into thin air?
"Search, find Xu Yan as quickly as possible."
The wearer of the Ferocious Mask spoke in a heavy tone.
As they saw it, the next step of their plan could have been perfectly successful had Xu Yan not disappeared!
How could this be acceptable?
They must spare no expense to find him!

chapters.title: Chapter 741 - 391: The Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path and Destiny of the Heavenly Intent
chapters.content:
The Wan Family and Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, who were searching for Xu Yan, at this moment, he was hiding in a small cave on Dahai Mountain in some desolate place, having taken out an Array Plate to set up a Concealing Formation.
Beyond setting up the formation, with a thought from Xu Yan, Mountain and River Sword Intent permeated the surroundings, as if transforming into an invisible range of mountains and rivers, enveloping the cave within.
After everything was ready, Xu Yan began preparing to comprehend the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path.
"The Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path is the foundation of the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, and also incredibly mysterious. Once comprehended and successfully cultivated, my strength will inevitably improve."
Xu Yan was inwardly extremely excited.
It could be anticipated that after the comprehension of the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path, when it came to breaking through to the Physiognomy Realm, another sublimation and transformation would certainly enhance his underlying potential.
"Just a little bit more to fully understand the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path. I hope the Blood Heart Fruit truly has such divine efficacy to help me grasp this final bit and shorten the time needed for comprehension."
Xu Yan took out a Blood Heart Fruit, looking forward to it.
It had been such a long time since Li Xuan passed the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path to him. In the Qinghua state, Xu Yan had been contemplating it, missing just the final step to fully comprehend it.
And for this final step, Xu Yan had been hoping the Blood Heart Fruit could provide the help to quickly come to an understanding.
After swallowing a Blood Heart Fruit,
Xu Yan felt a smooth and moist aura flowing through his body, soon appearing within his Primordial Spirit, nourishing the Primordial Spirit and causing the Spirit Pedestal to emit a misty radiance.
In that moment, his mind became tranquil, seemingly entering a state akin to sudden enlightenment.
And at that moment, Xu Yan began to contemplate the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path.
The last unclear part, which was just short of the final step, suddenly enlightened him, instantly becoming clear. How to cultivate the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path, its profound mysteries, and its formidable power—all became clear in his mind.
"So that's how it is!"
Xu Yan was thrilled, having finally fully comprehended the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path. The efficacy of the Blood Heart Fruit in aiding the comprehension of cultivation techniques was indeed extraordinary. It was no wonder Wan Tianlin was so obsessed with obtaining the Blood Heart Fruit.
After understanding the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path, Xu Yan began to contemplate the Domain Cultivation Method.
Even with the help of the Blood Heart Fruit, his mind sank into deep concentration and his Spirit Pedestal glowed with misty radiance, he still struggled to comprehend the Domain Cultivation Method, still feeling the profound and inscrutable nature of this realm.
Immersed in contemplation, it wasn't until the Spirit Pedestal stopped emitting misty light and the effect of the Blood Heart Fruit faded that Xu Yan returned from his deep contemplation.
"Some progress was made, but still a lot is lacking to fully understand the Domain Realm. It's because of my lack of experience and too little understanding of Martial Arts and the Domain."
Xu Yan felt a sense of regret.
The Domain Cultivation Method was too profound and inscrutable. Even with the aid of the Blood Heart Fruit, which brought him to an immersive state as if enlightenment struck, he could not comprehend much.
But it wasn't without progress—at least now Xu Yan had some direction and clues to contemplate.
"I wonder if eating another Blood Heart Fruit would still be effective."
Xu Yan took out another Blood Heart Fruit.
He had collected quite a few Blood Heart Fruits in Snake Peak Cave, enough for him to squander lavishly for a while.
After consuming the second Blood Heart Fruit, Xu Yan found that it was still effective, albeit its potency had decreased by a third.
"Let's contemplate Divine Skills then," he took a deep breath. With the diminished efficacy, it was clearly unrealistic to use it to comprehend the Domain Cultivation Method; it would be more appropriate for contemplating the Divine Skills in the Divine Skill Martial Code.
"Which Divine Skill should I contemplate?" Xu Yan pondered. There were many Divine Skills in the Divine Skill Martial Code, including Great Divine Power and lesser ones, but he was somewhat disdainful of the lesser ones.
If he were to contemplate, naturally, it would be the Great Divine Power.
Soon, he decided on the Great Divine Power to contemplate.
This was a quite special Divine Skill called "Destiny of the Heavenly Intent."
This Divine Skill was not offensive or defensive; rather, it was a type of control over others' Divine Souls and wills.
My intent is the Heavenly Intent. The Heavenly Intent determines their Divine Soul, fixes their divine intellect, and fixes their consciousness, making those affected by the Divine Skill act according to one's own will.
Once affected by this Divine Skill, even if ordered to kill their beloved ones, they would execute the act without hesitation.
The most loyal person, once stricken by this Divine Skill, would be controlled to act according to the inscrutable Heavenly Intent. Even if they are aware and resistant in their own mind, they cannot control themselves to act against their involuntary will.
"Let's go with this Divine Skill," Xu Yan secretly rejoiced, thinking of the wonderful uses of this skill. Since there was already a conflict with Wan Tianlin and the Wan Family, these unconventional methods could have unexpected effects at times.
For instance, if a Martial Artist of the Wan Family were targeted with this Divine Skill, and ordered to assassinate Wan Tianlin.
In such a case, the person afflicted by the Divine Skill would be conscious and unwilling, yet unable to defy the inscrutable intent of the Heavenly Dao, their Divine Soul and divine intellect being fixed.
"Wan Tianlin probably won't expect that the Martial Artists around him, even the most loyal ones, could attack him, right? The entire Wan Family would be thrown into chaos because of this."
One could foresee that if a previously loyal Martial Artist suddenly turned traitor and attacked, the Wan Family would undoubtedly become anxious and would immediately start an internal investigation to root out the traitor.
"If even an elder turned traitor..."
The corner of Xu Yan's mouth lifted, so the significance of comprehending the Destiny of the Heavenly Intent was essential.
The more special the Divine Skill, often at certain times, it can have unforeseen effects.

chapters.title: Chapter 742 - 391: The Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path and Destiny of the Heavenly Intent_2
chapters.content:
Xu Yan began to comprehend Destiny of the Heavenly Intent. As the Blood Heart Fruit was consumed, his understanding of this divine skill deepened, and he was on the verge of fully comprehending it.
When the effects of the Blood Heart Fruit faded, Xu Yan felt some regret; he had not managed to fully comprehend Destiny of the Heavenly Intent with just one fruit.
"The higher one's comprehension, the stronger the effect of the Blood Heart Fruit when consumed for the first time."
Xu Yan pondered thoughtfully.
In a short period of time, the Blood Heart Fruit enhanced a martial artist's comprehension of cultivation techniques. The extent of its effect was linked to the martial artist's inherent comprehension.
According to Xu Yan's estimation, the Blood Heart Fruit could briefly enhance a martial artist's comprehension by thirty percent, which seemed to be a relatively fixed amount.
The better one's comprehension was, the easier it became to grasp cultivation techniques after an improvement of thirty percent.
If a martial artist had poor comprehension, even a thirty percent increase would not compare to those with naturally high comprehension.
"I'll eat one last fruit."
With a sigh, Xu Yan took out another Blood Heart Fruit.
The third Blood Heart Fruit's effect was only ten percent, but it was better than nothing. For Xu Yan, it was enough to thoroughly comprehend the great divine power of Destiny of the Heavenly Intent.
As the third Blood Heart Fruit was consumed, Xu Yan distinctly felt its potency reduced by a large margin, and the luminous aura around his Spirit Pedestal dimmed significantly.
"Finally, I've comprehended it!"
Once the Blood Heart Fruit's effects wore off, Xu Yan opened his eyes, his face beaming with a radiant smile.
"Blood Heart Fruits are truly treasures. I wonder what the effects would be if refined into pills. Having eaten the Blood Heart Fruit, would the pills made from it still be effective?"
Xu Yan mused.
"Besides the Blood Heart Fruit, are there other heavenly and earthly treasures with similar effects? Would they still work on me?"
Xu Yan pondered secretly. If there were treasures stronger than the Blood Heart Fruit to aid in comprehending Domain Martial Arts Law, wouldn't he be able to understand it very quickly?
"Such treasures must be quite rare."
Xu Yan sighed inwardly, resolving to keep an eye out while traversing the Divine Realm.
Should he encounter such heavenly and earthly treasures again, he would have to figure out a way to acquire them.
"Now, it's time to cultivate."
Taking a deep breath, Xu Yan's eyes shone with excitement.
Having comprehended both the Minor Heavenly Path Eye and Destiny of the Heavenly Intent, it was time to start cultivating them.
"Cultivate the Minor Heavenly Path Eye."
Xu Yan decided to cultivate the Minor Heavenly Path Eye first.
Cultivating divine skills was not something that could be accomplished overnight. Xu Yan concealed himself in a cave, protected by a Concealing Formation, and inside the cave was like an invisible mountain and river.
Even if an Immortal Heavenly Venerable passed by, they would not be able to detect his presence.
As Xu Yan cultivated divine skills, Dahai Mountain became increasingly bustling, as though a storm was brewing. The Wan Family became more active, seemingly enraged for not having found Xu Yan yet.
In addition to the Wan Family, members of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow were also secretly investigating, even willing to use their Earth Shadow Members embedded within other forces.
However, Xu Yan seemed to have vanished into thin air. Not only was the Wan Family secretly alarmed, but even Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow was baffled.
Where was he?
Where had he gone?
From the Wan Family's actions, it was clear they hadn't found Xu Yan.
Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's subsequent actions halted temporarily due to Xu Yan's disappearance, just as their plans were about to succeed and were progressing smoothly.
Suddenly, there was an unexpected change, and it caught them off guard.
"Did Xu Yan return to the Qinghua state?"
"Even if he had returned to the Qinghua state, he would have needed to leave Dahai Mountain, but no trace of him was found."
"He has just come from the Qinghua state; would he go back in such a short amount of time? Perhaps he has already left the Dahai Mountain region."
"The question is, how did he leave Dahai Mountain without a sound under the Wan Family's search?"
It was not just the Wan Family, but also them, Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
The members of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow were silent for a moment.
The Wan Family also suspected that Xu Yan had quietly escaped Dahai Mountain and thus sought the help of neighboring major powers to assist in the search, naturally to no avail.
"To challenge the Wan Family, to kill our people and still roam freely, safe and sound outside, evading the pursuit of the Wan Family, is a disgrace to us.
"If we can't find him, where does that leave the face of the Wan Family?"
The elders of the Wan Family were filled with rage.
Wan Tianlin was so furious that his face turned black, even going so far as to offer the Blood Heart Fruit as a reward again, risking his own safety in hopes of luring the person out.
The result, naturally, was nothing.
Apart from the Wan Family and the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, there was a third party of martial artists also searching for Xu Yan's whereabouts.
Coming from the Thousand Layered Mountain, the Witch's Heavenly Grotto.
Each one was a True King Heavenly Venerable, and although their numbers were not large, one True King Heavenly Venerable could gather several Condensation Law Heavenly Venerables as informants to run errands for them.
Therefore, this force secretly searching for Xu Yan was not small in number.
Those True King Heavenly Venerables had been charmed, having long since fallen under the skirts of a certain person, becoming loyal lackeys, with nothing but flattery on their minds, all for the sake of winning a beauty's smile and completing her plans.
"I've finally succeeded in my cultivation."
Oblivious to the outside world and solely focused on cultivating divine skills, Xu Yan opened his eyes.
At this moment, his eyes were filled with an inscrutable meaning, as if the sun and the moon were orbiting within his pupils, and as if stars surrounded him, or some form of divine presence lingered.
The Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path.
After an extensive period of cultivation, Xu Yan had finally reached the entry level of the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path.
"The Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path, one gaze as if it's dictated by divine intent, seeing through everything, everything under control…"
Only after cultivating the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path did Xu Yan truly understand the power and mystery of this divine skill.
At this moment, in his eyes, formations were clearly visible, even seeing through the flaws of formations and understanding the trajectories of their operations at a glance.
"Fourth Junior Brother's formation should be improved otherwise, it seems a bit weak," Xu Yan sighed.
Of course, he knew that these were Array Plates refined by Fang Hao, which were different from Fang Hao's personal deployment of the Domain Qimen layered formations.
Moreover, Qimen Martial Art also had its own extraordinary mysteries.
"Besides these eyes, there's also…"
After cultivating the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path, not only his eyes but between his brows, it seemed as if another eye had appeared.
Of course, the eye between the brows seemed to have its own mysteries, possessing an immense might when opened.
"Is this the foundation of the Eye of the Heavenly Dao?" Xu Yan pondered inwardly.
In an instant, between his brows, a faint glow emerged, carrying a certain majestic might, resembling an eye.
This glow, situated between his brows and shaped like an eye, nurtured an overwhelming power, and Xu Yan could feel that the eye between his brows could unleash a tremendously powerful strike.
"I have more methods at my disposal now, my strength has also increased, and my foundation is more solid," Xu Yan rejoiced.
"The next step is to cultivate Destiny of the Heavenly Intent."
With the successful cultivation of the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path, only Destiny of the Heavenly Intent remained unmastered.
Xu Yan decided that after completing the cultivation of Destiny of the Heavenly Intent, he would leave this place to settle accounts with Wan Tianlin; if Wan Tianlin truly intended to resolve their grudges, he must offer substantial compensation.
For example, gathering all the treasures and materials that Xu Yan required.
"With the aid of the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path, if I deploy Destiny of the Heavenly Intent with my current strength, it seems I could make a True King Heavenly Venerable act according to my will," Xu Yan thought.
However, it couldn't be a True King Heavenly Venerable who was too powerful.
Otherwise, there was a certain chance they could break free from the control of the Destiny of the Heavenly Intent divine skill.
After all, he had only reached the perfection of the Divine Skill Realm, and controlling one's will was inherently the most difficult task, while those who could cultivate to True King Heavenly Venerable were all individuals of unyielding will.
After some deliberation, Xu Yan estimated that, with his current strength, he could only control martial artists at the early stages of the True King Heavenly Venerable.
"For the time being, that should be enough to cause some trouble for Wan Tianlin and the Wan Family, creating chaos within the Wan Family is sufficient!" Xu Yan took a deep breath and began to cultivate the Destiny of the Heavenly Intent divine skill.
Meanwhile, at Dahai Mountain, the Wan Family finally became restless and offered a high reward.
Anyone providing clues to Xu Yan's whereabouts would receive a generous reward, and those who could capture Xu Yan with these clues would be promised entrance into the Wan Family, becoming a member and having their cultivation resources increased by ten percent.
The Wan Family's generous bounty instantly caused a sensation in Dahai Mountain. As for the reason behind the bounty, the Wan Family did not disclose the specifics.
This led to much discussion among the martial artists of Dahai Mountain, who felt it might be a scandal best not broadcast widely.
Even rumors started to spread that the wanted individual had dishonored the Wan Family's daughter, having had his way with her and then fled, prompting such drastic measures by the Wan Family. These juicy tidbits circulated vibrantly throughout Dahai Mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 743 - 392 Let me show you the techniques of Xu Yan
chapters.content:
```
"Where did Xu Yan go? Why can't a single trace be found? Could he have simply vanished into thin air?"
The man in the Ferocious Mask spoke in a deep voice.
"Search, continue the search for me, we must find him!"
The man in the Ferocious Mask said through gritted teeth, "I refuse to believe that with the Earth Shadow's network, we still can't find him!"
As the plan progressed to the most critical juncture, just one more successful step, and the entire plan would be largely complete.
Yet now, Xu Yan, the piece in this game, was gone!
How could this be tolerated?
"Which power is covering up Xu Yan's tracks?"
Wan Tianlin asked with a cold gaze.
"I don't know!"
"Mobilize all the forces we can, we must find him, otherwise how shall the Wan Family save face?"
Wan Tianlin, with a murderous intent, then said, "Check out all those rumors, find out where they started from, maybe we can find a clue!"
"Yes, Young Master!"
The Wan Family was also taking action, mobilizing more forces just to find Xu Yan.
Besides Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow and the Wan Family, the several True King Heavenly Venerables from another party were also frowning in distress: where on earth had Xu Yan gone to?
Having almost turned over Dahai Mountain, they still couldn't find him. How could they lure him into the witch's Heavenly Grotto within Thousand Layered Mountain without finding him?
What made them even more uncomfortable was that while they hadn't found Xu Yan, the Wan Family mistakenly thought they were the power behind Xu Yan, and some conflicts had arisen as a result.
Engaging in conflict with the Wan Family, on Wan Family's turf, was an extremely unwise move. Therefore, they quickly conceded and made it clear that they too were there to search for Xu Yan's whereabouts.
The two parties even exchanged information, agreeing to notify each other if they found any trace of Xu Yan.
Xu Yan, oblivious to the outside world, focused all his attention on cultivating the Divine Skill, Destiny of the Heavenly Intent.
"I've finally succeeded in cultivating it!"
Xu Yan revealed a smile, a glimmer of light appearing between his eyebrows, resembling an eye, and atop this eye, a force seemed to linger, akin to the will of the heavens.
"The Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path, combined with the Destiny of the Heavenly Intent for casting, gives a higher success rate and makes it easier to immobilize the enemy's spirit."
Xu Yan thought excitedly to himself.
"With this Divine Skill, I can do a lot."
The light between his eyebrows disappeared, Xu Yan raised his palm, and it seemed as though a mighty heavenly will swirled within his hand.
It gave off a sense of vastness and undeniable power.
"It's time to leave seclusion."
Now that his Divine Skill was completely cultivated, it was time to continue gathering the necessary treasures, building up his foundation, and preparing for the breakthrough.
"Wan Tianlin, are you ready? I'm about to give you a little shock."
Xu Yan wore a smile on his face.
Even if Wan Tianlin had conceded, Xu Yan would not easily forgive. Daring to send someone to assassinate him meant being prepared to face the consequences.
With just a thought, landscapes vanished, formations retracted.
With a wave of his hand, Xu Yan erased all traces and aura, and in a single step, disappeared from the spot.
"Dahai Mountain is Wan Family's territory. Let's find a big city of the Wan Family, get to know more about the Wan Family, get to know how Wan Tianlin is doing.
"If he is in seclusion, comprehending cultivation techniques, then planning against him will have to wait."
Wan Tianlin, as the pride of the Wan Family, would be in a place with strict defenses, where ordinary Wan Family members could not get close.
"Choose a target and test out the Destiny of the Heavenly Intent."
Xu Yan decided to go to one of the big cities of the Wan Family to select a suitable target and control them to shock Wan Tianlin.
Walking on Dahai Mountain, Xu Yan followed a direction and headed for one of the big cities of the Wan Family.
Shen Kui was a member of the Earth Shadow in Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, lurking within the Wan Family, belonging to the martial artists close to the Core Guard.
This time, he received an order from Earth Shadow to find Xu Yan, assassinate Xu Yan, and conclusively pin the assassination on the Wan Family.
Although assassinating Xu Yan was a very dangerous task, as he was only at the early stage of the Truth Refinement Realm, a novice among True King Heavenly Venerables.
But as an Earth Shadow Member, dedicating everything to Earth Shadow was an honor.
Shen Kui was excited for the opportunity to serve Earth Shadow. If he survived by chance, his status within Earth Shadow would be elevated.
In the Wan Family, he would also have a chance to join the ranks of the Core Guard.
Even more, he might be granted the Wan surname, truly becoming a confidant of the Wan Family, or even a devoted retainer.
So, Shen Kui was very zealous in searching for Xu Yan, both for the glory of Earth Shadow and to show his dedication to the Wan Family.
Even if he failed to find Xu Yan, perhaps this performance would earn him a place in the Core Guard.
Shen Kui didn't know whether there were other Earth Shadow Members within the Wan Family besides himself; each member could not know the true identities of the others.
They couldn't even know each other's appearances.
Earth Shadow was responsible for lurking, waiting for opportunities, instigating conflicts, and so on, while Heavenly Slaughter led all this and was also the strongest fighting force.
As for how many Heavenly Slaughters and how many Earth Shadow Members there were in the Earth Shadow Organization, Shen Kui didn't know, as he was not the lowest, but also not high-level within Earth Shadow.
"Is that... Xu Yan?"
Suddenly, Shen Kui spotted a young man ahead – wasn't this Xu Yan, whom they were so desperately searching for?
Immediately, he was elated.
"My opportunity has come!"
Shen Kui moved swiftly, his aura fading slightly, and his figure seemed to be cloaked in a shadow, hiding him within nearby shadows to conceal himself.
This was an Earth Shadow technique, to conceal and ambush.
Xu Yan was very strong; the last people who attempted to assassinate Xu Yan did not return.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 744 - 392: Let You Witness My Methods, Xu Yan_2
chapters.content:
But he was only at the early stage of True King Heavenly Venerable, no match for Xu Yan in a direct confrontation; his only option was to lurk and launch a sneak attack.
"If I can injure Xu Yan and also escape smoothly..."
Shen Kui became more and more excited at the thought.
Since Earth Shadow members are good at sneaking, they naturally excel at stealth attacks and evading pursuit, which gave him some confidence that he could successfully flee after attacking Xu Yan.
"Here he comes!"
Shen Kui felt a bit nervous in his heart.
Even with expert concealment, facing a strong opponent like Xu Yan, he would undoubtedly be discovered once the distance was too close.
He had to judge the distance perfectly, attacking suddenly before being spotted while being close enough for the attack to be instantaneous, leaving no time for the target to react.
Hence, mastering this measure of distance was critical.
This was a skill every Earth Shadow member had to master and was the top priority.
Shen Kui believed that his own experience was also exceptionally cunning.
Beyond the training provided by Earth Shadow, he had also been nurtured by the Wan Family, and had used these tactics when carrying out their missions, hence gaining a wealth of experience.
"Another thirty feet closer, and I'll make my move!"
Shen Kui's heart was racing with excitement and also some nervousness.
"This person from the Wan Family does have some skills, adept at the art of concealment indeed!"
Xu Yan had long since detected Shen Kui's presence.
When it came to stealth and lurking, Xu Yan considered himself second to none, and Shen Kui, a mere early-stage True King Heavenly Venerable martial artist, thought his sophisticated techniques of stealth were invisible to Xu Yan?
Not to mention that Xu Yan had already mastered the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path, making any form of concealment or hiding futile against his gaze.
Even without the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path, the lurking techniques of Earth Shadow were nothing to him.
"This will be a good test for the Destiny of the Heavenly Intent and a shock for Wan Tianlin."
Xu Yan was secretly thrilled.
This person must be sent by the Wan Family to assassinate him; so be it, Xu Yan would use the Wan Family's own agent to strike back at them.
"The Wan Family will start suspecting they have a traitor, won't they?"
With a single step, Xu Yan left behind a Divine Origin Avatar to confuse Shen Kui while his true self, silent as a shadow, arrived behind Shen Kui.
"No good!"
In that instant, Shen Kui felt a tingling on his scalp, his martial artist's sense of crisis emerging sharply.
Danger!
He didn't suspect the threat was from Xu Yan but thought another powerful adversary was about to target him!
"Quite vigilant."
Xu Yan was not surprised by this, after all, being a True King Heavenly Venerable, not noticing when someone got behind him and started exerting power would have been too incompetent.
But, even with this realization, it was already too late!
Boom!
Invisible mountains and rivers had already enveloped Shen Kui, binding him instantly.
And a palm, swirling with a faint aura, as grand as the will of heaven, descended upon his head.
Boom!
In that moment, Shen Kui felt his divine soul, consciousness, and spiritual wisdom completely immobilized.
All resistance was futile.
What's more terrifying was the sensation of being faced with the immense will of heaven, as if everything was inevitable!
His consciousness seemed both lucid and hazy, and he was even somewhat confused about his current state.
"Go back, sneak attack and kill the one who ordered you to assassinate me!"
A will descended into his divine soul, like the inescapable destiny decreed by the heavens, impossible to resist.
It was as though a lock of heavenly might firmly secured him.
"Go back, kill the one who ordered you!"
In Shen Kui's mind, there was only this grand, irresistible will.
"Yes, yes!"
Shen Kui nodded his head.
Xu Yan lifted his hand, his face full of anticipation.
This was his first time using the Destiny of the Heavenly Intent divine skill, and to prevent Shen Kui from breaking free, Xu Yan exerted his full power, assisted by the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path.
"Go."
To prevent any chance of Shen Kui overcoming the divine skill midway, Xu Yan waved his hand and gave the order.
"Use your methods, gain their trust, get close to them, sneak attack, and kill him!"
Xu Yan let out a sly chuckle.
"Yes, I will definitely do it!"
Shen Kui had become respectfully submissive, not even daring to raise his head as if he couldn't look directly at heavenly intent.
His figure shifted and he vanished instantaneously, rushing back in a frenzy.
"Kill Heavenly Slaughter, it was Heavenly Slaughter who ordered me to attack Xu Yan, so I must kill Heavenly Slaughter."
Shen Kui swiftly identified his target.
Even though the Wan Family had also given him orders, as a member of Earth Shadow, the command he truly acknowledged came from the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow Organization.
Since his task was to strike down the one who sent him, his target was naturally Heavenly Slaughter from the Earth Shadow Organization, the one who had given the order.
"Wan Tianlin, this is just the beginning."
As he watched Shen Kui leave, Xu Yan's eyes flashed with a cold smile.
Shen Kui was the first but wouldn't be the last.
"As my master said, a true martial artist is not a brute. How could I, Xu Yan, engage in such brutish actions? These tactics, I am also very adept at, the Wan Family is strong, right? Let's see them witness, the methods of Xu Yan!"
Xu Yan continued toward the great city, proceeding with his plans.
And Shen Kui, not daring to delay, raced madly all the way, straight to one of the secret strongholds of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
"Have I gone mad? To actually want to kill Heavenly Slaughter?"
Deep in Shen Kui's heart, in the depths of his consciousness, he was somewhat clear-headed, knowing that what he was doing was wrong.
However, he was unable to resist that inscrutable will, painfully watching himself sprint non-stop towards the stronghold.

chapters.title: Chapter 745 - 392: Let You Witness My Methods, Xu Yan_3
chapters.content:
As they neared the stronghold, Shen Kui donned his mask.
He had been running at breakneck speed, and even for a True King Heavenly Venerable, he was somewhat out of breath.
"Where is Lord Heavenly Slaughter?"
As soon as Shen Kui entered the stronghold, he urgently asked as if he had an important matter that needed immediate reporting.
"Lord Heavenly Slaughter is not here, what is the urgent matter?"
The person in charge of the stronghold asked in a deep voice.
"Quick, notify Lord Heavenly Slaughter to come here, I have a secret matter to report."
Shen Kui spoke hastily.
"Alright, please wait!"
The person in charge of the stronghold was taken aback. What kind of secret matter required a personal report to Lord Heavenly Slaughter?
Within the ranks of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, there were strict rules. If a secret matter could only be reported to Heavenly Slaughter, no one else was allowed to inquire about it.
Moreover, there were strict classifications regarding the levels of secrecy.
Every Earth Shadow member knew this like the back of their hand and wouldn't report rashly.
Shen Kui seemed very anxious, waiting for Heavenly Slaughter's arrival.
Half an hour later.
A person in a Ferocious Mask appeared at the stronghold, looking at Shen Kui with a solemn voice, "It was you who had a secret matter to report?"
"Yes, my lord!"
Shen Kui nodded solemnly.
As he spoke, he leaned in close to the Ferocious Mask, his expression intensely grave, his lips moving slightly, his gaze shifting to the stronghold's person in charge, while he prepared to communicate the report through a secret transmission.
The Ferocious Mask didn't suspect a thing; instead, he leaned in, "Is it about the Wan Family..."
Phut!
At that moment, a flash of cold light, a sharp luminance, pierced into his chest.
The Ferocious Mask was stunned, as was the person in charge of the stronghold, who had been ready to leave to avoid suspicion.
Boom!
This strike contained all of Shen Kui's life's strength, the most powerful attack he believed he had ever executed.
The victim, this member of Heavenly Slaughter, was completely unprepared and at such close range. Moreover, never before had there been a traitor within the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow faction.
Such an act of insubordination had also never occurred before.
Every member of Earth Shadow was utterly loyal, ready to die for the goals of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow without blinking an eye.
In such a faction, no one would have expected there to be insubordination and a surprise attack!
"You!"
The person in the Ferocious Mask roared in anger, but Shen Kui, having landed his strike, burst forth with all his might, his power flowing out in an instant.
Boom!
The chest of the Ferocious Mask exploded into a hole, even though he was at the peak of True King Heavenly Venerable, merely one step away from becoming an Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
Under the force of the blow, his injuries were severe, nearly fatal.
Boom!
In that moment of shock and rage, the Ferocious Mask retaliated with a fierce palm strike, sending Shen Kui flying away.
At the same time, the person in charge of the stronghold also took action.
"How dare you betray Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow?"
Astonishment and rage filled the air. The first traitor within Earth Shadow had emerged!
Moreover, it was a member of Earth Shadow who had infiltrated the Wan Family. Could it be that he had defected to the Wan Family?
As a result, was the plan of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow known to and seized by the Wan Family?
"Kill him!"
The Ferocious Mask, clutching his wound and taking out Spiritual Medicine to consume, ordered furiously.
In this moment, Shen Kui's heart trembled uncontrollably. He was aware, deep inside, that this moment was one of sheer desperation.
He had betrayed Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow!
Boom!
The battle ended in just a brief moment. Shen Kui, having exhausted his strength in the surprise attack on the Ferocious Mask, had no time to recover. The stronghold's person in charge was already stronger than him, so Shen Kui, unable to resist for long, chose to end his own life, falling dead on the spot!

chapters.title: Chapter 746 - 393 You Traitor, Xu Yan Appears
chapters.content:
Shen Kui was dead. Although his surprise attack did not kill the Ferocious Mask, it had severely injured the adversary. What was more significant was that this was the first time such an incident had occurred within the forces of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, and it was just the beginning of the upheaval.
The Ferocious Mask's breath was weak, and the injuries were extremely grievous. Had it not been for his formidable strength, he would likely have perished by now.
Even so, his injuries were so severe that it would take years of convalescence to recover fully, and even then, the damage to his foundation meant his power had slipped.
"My lord…"
The person in charge of the stronghold who had killed Shen Kui hurried over, wishing to treat the Ferocious Mask's injuries.
"Stop!"
The Ferocious Mask said with a changed and stern look in his eyes.
The person in charge of the stronghold stopped in his tracks, his eyes full of innocence. His lips moved slightly as he said, "My lord, I have nothing to do with this…"
He was unjustly accused. How could he have known that a member of Earth Shadow would betray them?
"I know you're not involved, but this is a serious matter. Whether the plans of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow have been leaked remains to be investigated.
"Send for the others to come here…"
The Ferocious Mask's gaze shifted slightly, his voice becoming gentler as he issued the command.
"Yes, my lord!"
The person in charge of the stronghold felt his face beneath the mask go slightly pale, his heart sinking; he seemed to be in danger!
Lord Heavenly Slaughter was the one he had informed to come here. Wouldn't he be suspected after being attacked?
He was only speaking this way because he had been severely injured and feared that he might take advantage of the situation.
If the other members of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow arrived, would he find himself in danger?
Or even be treated as a traitor?
Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow had never had a traitor before, and he couldn't imagine what might happen to the first one.
His gaze landed on the Ferocious Mask ingrained with two leaves, signifying that he was a Second-leaf Heavenly Slaughter.
Heavenly Slaughter was categorized by strength, and a Second-leaf Heavenly Slaughter was not the weakest but also not among the strongest.
Rumor had it that a Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter was a warrior of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm.
Earth Shadow, on the other hand, was not categorized by strength, but by their ability to infiltrate and the deeds they accomplished or the missions they completed.
"My lord, I have sent the message."
The person in charge of the stronghold reported respectfully after finishing the task.
"Cough cough, very good!"
The Ferocious Mask nodded, maintaining vigilance despite grave injuries.
For a moment, the stronghold fell silent, the atmosphere growing tense.
The person in charge of the stronghold looked at the body of Shen Kui lying on the ground, his eyes flickering with thought. The true traitor was dead, and it was he who had first come into contact with him.
It was also he who had sent the message summoning Lord Heavenly Slaughter here.
The more he thought, the more his heart sank, and he stole another glance at the Ferocious Mask. Despite severe injuries, the man retained only a tenth of his strength.
Moreover, he was still on guard, wary of him.
"My lord, do you suspect me?"
Finally, the person in charge of the stronghold spoke up in a heavy tone.
"Why would that be? Don't overthink it!"
The Ferocious Mask felt a pang of anxiety.
"The traitor is dead, and I was the last one he saw before dying. I'm also the one who notified you, lord. It's normal to suspect me, but I truly am innocent."
As he spoke, he suddenly gritted his teeth and drew his weapon.
"My lord, you were ambushed, why didn't you die? If you had, all of this trouble would have been avoided!"
The person in charge of the stronghold suddenly had a realization—the only thing he needed to happen was for Lord Heavenly Slaughter to die. Then the one responsible for the ambush would be Shen Kui, and he himself would be innocent.
It was just that he was too weak to save Lord Heavenly Slaughter in time.
Yes!
That was exactly it!
"You traitor!"
The Ferocious Mask roared with anger, disregarding his injuries, bursting with a powerful aura as he lashed out and prepared to flee.
However, how could he, with such grievous injuries, manage to escape?
A brief confrontation erupted within the stronghold, ending quickly in silence.
The chest wound on the Ferocious Mask had grown larger, and by then, he had already taken his last breath.
"My lord, you died at the hands of a traitor…"
The person in charge of the stronghold muttered to himself.
Tumult spread among Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow as a traitor had appeared. For a time, everyone became more vigilant, fearing an unexpected attack from those around them.
Unseen, the impact of Shen Kui's actions on Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow would continue.
Meanwhile, Xu Yan, the instigator of all this, was completely unaware, still thinking that Shen Kui was a member of the Wan Family, who had gone to attack members of the Wan Family after his return.
He was going to attack Wan Tianlin.
Xu Yan had already entered a major city on Dahai Mountain.
Then, he discovered that a bounty had been placed on him, and those behind the bounty were the Wan Family!
"Very well, very well. While I have been cultivating, you have been looking for me, wanting to take me by surprise, huh?
"Having killed Wan Tianlin, let's see what the Wan Family can do to me!"
Xu Yan was furious in his heart.
He didn't even bother to conceal his identity and strutted around the city. He even deliberately visited a shop owned by the Wan Family to spread word that he was looking to sell the Blood Heart Fruit.
"The man wanted by the Wan Family has appeared, seize him!"
"The chance to serve the family and win favor for young master Wan Tianlin has come!"
Several True Kings in the city were excited beyond measure.
Xu Yan, whom they had desperately sought, had actually appeared!
Especially the Martial Artists of the Wan Family, who seemed to see a vision of their own advancement through merit.
Xu Yan strode out from the city, followed by the pursuing True King Heavenly Venerables.
"Where do you think you're going!"
A True King of the Wan Family bellowed, rapidly advancing to attack.

chapters.title: Chapter 747 - 393 You Traitor, Xu Yan Appears_2
chapters.content:
Xu Yan unleashed a sword strike, the Supreme Heavenly Sword Divine Skill!
Whoosh!
Under this single strike, the True King scrambled to defend but still failed to parry the attack and was instantly severely wounded.
Just this one sword strike was enough to make a group of True Kings step back.
"Tell Wan Tianlin, if he wants the Blood Heart Fruit, if he wants to kill me, then come,"
Xu Yan sneered coldly, his figure vanishing from the spot in an instant.
Willing to brave dangers, Wan Tianlin wanted to lure him to go. Xu Yan simply used the Blood Heart Fruit to directly draw Wan Tianlin to him.
With Wan Tianlin's pride, and the backing of the Wan Family, he would surely make an appearance.
"I want to see just how many True Kings from the Wan Family will come to hunt me,"
Xu Yan thought, sneering inwardly.
Even at the peak of True King strength, they still weren't enough to pose a threat to him.
If he wanted to leave, no one could stop him.
Although the Wan Family had an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, he could not easily leave his post and could not leave the area he was anchored to so lightly.
The moment Xu Yan appeared, he immediately caused an uproar in the Dahai Mountain region.
Both the Wan Family and the True King Heavenly Venerables coming from the Thousand Layered Mountain began to make their moves.
"To draw me out to show up, well, I, Wan Tianlin, will go. I want to see what power stands behind you!"
Wan Tianlin sneered coldly.
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable may not be able to leave his seat of power so easily, but the Wan Family's deterrence isn't solely reliant on the Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
Among the True King Heavenly Venerables, there is also a vast disparity in strength.
"The Wan Family is surely set on murder. This person cannot die, we must lead him to the Thousand Layered Mountain. So whatever happens, if he is in danger, we must help him escape at all costs!"
The True King Heavenly Venerables who had come from the Thousand Layered Mountain huddled together and said in a grave tone.
Their task was to lure Xu Yan to the Witch Heavenly Grotto of the Thousand Layered Mountain. If Xu Yan died, how could they complete their mission?
"Xu Yan has shown up. How shall we proceed? Is there any flaw in the plan?"
In another place, within a cave, several masked figures gathered together.
This time they came together, one person was missing—the one with the Ferocious Mask.
Moreover, they all tacitly kept a certain distance from each other, warily watching as if there was a traitor among them.
"We sit back and watch the tigers fight; whether Wan Tianlin dies or Xu Yan dies, the plan will be considered a success,"
one person said.
"What if Xu Yan and Wan Tianlin come to an agreement?"
"What a joke, how can they possibly reach an agreement? Their hatred runs deep,"
"You should know, the enmity between Xu Yan and Wan Tianlin has been instigated by us from behind the scenes. If the plan were to leak, would Wan Tianlin and Xu Yan continue to fight each other?"
For a moment, the cave fell silent.
They all fell silent.
The traitor, from the Earth Shadow embedded within the Wan Family—if the plan leaked...
They dared not think further!
"When will the new Lord Heavenly Slaughter arrive?"
One person broke the silence.
"In the next two or three days, perhaps,"
The previous Lord Heavenly Slaughter, in charge of this area, was killed. Having sent the message up, they were waiting for the arrival of the new Lord Heavenly Slaughter.
"Let's wait until Lord Heavenly Slaughter arrives before we make a decision!"
Eventually, the group made a relatively advantageous decision.
With the situation unclear within the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, they couldn't act rashly; otherwise, if there was a problem, it would be easy to become a target!
Within the Dahai Mountain region, a straight and towering Shi Feng stood, with Xu Yan proudly stationed at the peak, waiting for Wan Tianlin's arrival.
He stood so openly, making no effort to conceal his tracks.
"Xu Yan is there. Should we go up and tell him to quickly escape, or tempt him with treasures to go to the Thousand Layered Mountain?"
"Don't reveal yourself. Wait until Xu Yan is in danger, then we can move to assist him. That way, he will surely follow us to the Thousand Layered Mountain."
"Makes sense!"
The True King Heavenly Venerables from the Thousand Layered Mountain were excited at this moment, finally about to complete their mission.
"I, Wan Tianlin, have arrived. Whatever tricks you have, bring them on,"
Three figures arrived, one of them was Wan Tianlin.
The other two, standing to his left and right, were elders whose presences seemed to blend with the Domain, far beyond the comparison to ordinary True King Heavenly Venerable Peaks.
Wan Tianlin had also come directly, not bothering with concealment, making his presence known.
The two clan elders following him were powerful True Kings whose statuses in the Wan Family were revered.
Xu Yan's eyebrows twitched—these two True Kings from the Wan Family were extremely strong!
However, they were still not strong enough to break the defense of the Yin Yang Undying Sword, so there was no need to worry.
He raised his hand, and a Blood Heart Fruit rested in his palm.
"The Blood Heart Fruit you want is here. Whether you can obtain it depends on your abilities, Wan Tianlin!"
Xu Yan said nonchalantly with a smile.
"Good!"
Wan Tianlin took a deep breath, the cold light swept forth like whipped silk. The Spirit Cicada Blade launched, its supple frost edge swept through, rolling towards Xu Yan.
"You're too weak!"
Xu Yan's sword slashed out, its radiance vast and consuming, like a surge of astonishing waves rolling forth, completely suppressing Wan Tianlin's attacks and continuing forward, threatening to submerge Wan Tianlin altogether.
Wan Tianlin was merely at the early stages of True King Heavenly Venerable, and although his strength was top-tier within his level, and much stronger than Shen Kui, he was still somewhat weaker in the face of Xu Yan.
He couldn't pose the slightest threat to him.
Killing Wan Tianlin wouldn't be too difficult.
His eyes shimmering with light, every strike from Wan Tianlin seemed riddled with flaws in Xu Yan's sight.
Every sword strike hit right at the weak points of Wan Tianlin's attacks.
Boom!
Their exchange lasted but an instant before Wan Tianlin had to retreat and avoid the sharp edge, his expression growing extremely solemn.
His heart was greatly shaken. This man seemed younger than him, yet his strength was so formidable. From which power did such a talented individual hail?
Especially his mastery of Sword Dao, which was truly enigmatic and exceptional.
"Young man, considering your decent talent, hand over the Blood Heart Fruit, submit to the Wan Family, and I may spare your life!"
As Wan Tianlin couldn't withstand Xu Yan's attacks, an elder from the Wan Family stepped forward and spoke with a grave voice.
"Do not speak to me in such a manner, even if you were the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, let alone you not being one."
Xu Yan chuckled dismissively.
"Arrogant!"
Boom!
The Wan Family elder struck out with his hand.
This strike seemed to envelop the aura of heaven and earth, like a colossal hammer coming down.
Hum!
Around Xu Yan, the Yin Yang Undying Sword continuously revolved, displaying the Mountains and Rivers in the Sword.
Boom!
Under the cycle of the Yin Yang Undying Sword, the attack of the Wan Family elder was instantly weakened and then countered back to him.
"What is this!"
The complexion of the Wan Family elder changed as he struck again, with a thunderous boom, blocking the countered attack.
Wan Tianlin's face darkened. This man's martial arts were profound and enigmatic; from which force could he have come?
"Attack together!"
The Wan Family elder took a deep breath, shockingly realizing that by himself, he seemed unable to break through this mysteriously cyclic sword light.
Boom!
Another elder from the Wan Family, with his aura erupting, also prepared to join in the attack.
Just at that moment, several figures flew swiftly towards them.
"The Wan Family has no shame, ganging up on the fewer in number. Your opponent is us!"
Several True King Heavenly Venerables, despite being less powerful, stood their ground with unyielding spirit, bracing for a desperate battle.
"Is it you?"
Wan Tianlin's gaze turned icy cold. "You are indeed in league with each other!"
He recognized them; these were the group of foreign True King Heavenly Venerables who were looking for Xu Yan, seemingly from Thousand Layered Mountain.
Could it be that Thousand Layered Mountain was targeting the Wan Family and Wan Tianlin himself?
"Do not underestimate the Wan Family. They have come prepared this time. Do not be careless, quickly follow me and leave."
A True King Heavenly Venerable arrived in front of Shi Feng and began to speak.
Xu Yan looked surprised. Why were these True King Heavenly Venerables helping him?
True King Heavenly Venerables from the Qinghua realm?
"Who are you?"
Xu Yan asked with a look of astonishment.
"We are here under the orders of a benefactor, tasked with protecting the young master!" the True King Heavenly Venerable said earnestly.
The man was lying!
Xu Yan's brows rose slightly, and as he used the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path, he began to see the truth.
"Their will is compromised, seduced?"
These True King Heavenly Venerables had their minds controlled and had become servants to another.
Who was targeting him?
Xu Yan's heart tensed as he considered. He had just arrived in the Nine Mountain Realm and had not made any enemies. These True King Heavenly Venerables were not from the Wan Family, either.
Besides the Wan Family, who else could be targeting him?
"The Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path, indeed incredibly wondrous. Without it, I wouldn't have been able to detect their bewitched state and that they had been charmed."
All of a sudden, Xu Yan was taken aback. Charmed? It was a nagging familiarity; the state of these True Kings seemed something he had witnessed before.
"Ice State, the Seductive Witch!"
Xu Yan's heart turned cold; he knew the Seductive Witch hadn't died, for his master had told him so.
Who would have thought that upon his arrival in the Nine Mountain Realm, he would be marked by the Seductive Witch?
"She wants revenge?"
Xu Yan's heart chilled, not daring to be negligent.
How strong the Seductive Witch was remained an uncertainty, and the extent of her power now upon the Nine Mountain Realm was also unknown.

chapters.title: Chapter 748 - 394: Seeing Through, Wan Tianlin's Sincerity
chapters.content:
Xu Yan was on high alert at this moment. The True King Heavenly Venerable who had suddenly emerged appeared to be aiding him, but Xu Yan sensed ill intent. It was evident that they had come specifically looking for him.
Influenced by the Seductive Witch's seduction, they were acting under her orders.
What good could come from the Seductive Witch seeking him out?
Revenge?
"I don't need your so-called protection. Keep out of my business with the Wan Family and get lost!"
Xu Yan said with a cold, mocking smile.
"Young master, the power of the Wan Family..."
The anxious True King Heavenly Venerable started to speak. Their strength was not very formidable among the True King Heavenly Venerables, and they wouldn't be able to hold off the Wan Family elders for long.
"Get lost!"
Xu Yan's gaze turned frosty as fierce Sword Intent surged out, forcing the True King to hastily retreat.
Meanwhile, the Wan Family elder who was fighting the obstructing True King Heavenly Venerable was being pushed back steadily, and soon it looked like he would not be able to hold on any longer. Despite this, Xu Yan refused to take the opportunity to leave, which made these True King Heavenly Venerables extremely anxious.
With a furrowed brow, Wan Tianlin realized that these True King Heavenly Venerables who had abruptly appeared did not seem to be forces behind Xu Yan, but rather they had some other motive.
With a flick of the Spirit Cicada Blade, he didn't strike again but instead looked towards Xu Yan with a solemn expression and said in a deep voice, "Since you dare to provoke my Wan Family, do you dare to leave your name behind?"
"Why wouldn't I?"
Xu Yan said proudly, "Listen well, I keep my name and do not change my surname: Sword God Xu Yan!"
"You are Xu Yan? The Xu Yan of the Qinghua state?"
Wan Tianlin's expression was taken aback.
"You know of me? It seems that my name, Xu Yan, carries some weight after all."
Xu Yan was surprised for a moment.
He had made quite a reputation for himself in the Qinghua state, especially in teaching the Sword Dao. The Martial Artists who were swordsmen in the Qinghua state revered him immensely.
He didn't expect his name to have reached the Nine Mountains Realm so quickly.
"Rumors say that Sword God Xu Yan is a marvel with the Sword Dao, esteemed among swordsmen in Qinghua state, and it's also said that Xu Yan can summon a True Dragon..." Wan Tianlin said gravely.
Xu Yan raised his hand and a Golden Dragon roared forth, its dragon might vast and powerful.
Seeing this, Wan Tianlin confirmed that this was indeed the Xu Yan from Qinghua state, who was now acclaimed as the foremost among the younger generation.
There were many rumors about Xu Yan, mystical and exaggerated. However, in the Nine Mountains Realm, most people simply believed that Qinghua state, having suffered a great blow, needed to restore its prestige, and the stories were mostly embellished for this purpose.
Having met him today, Wan Tianlin felt that the rumors were unnecessary!
Xu Yan's skill in the Sword Dao was indeed extraordinary, his command of the True Dragon made him a formidable force. Even the family elders by his side could not get the better of him.
It was almost as if, unless an Immortal Heavenly Venerable emerged, he would stand invincible.
"Brother Xu, I, Wan Tianlin, have never offended you, and I approached our trade with sincerity. Even if you find me Wan Tianlin a bit arrogant, there is no need for you to target me or my Wan Family so specifically, right?
"The Wan Family has never had any grievances with Brother Xu, have we?"
Wan Tianlin took a deep breath, speaking with a grave face.
The two family elders also ceased their attacks. Since the youth was Xu Yan from Qinghua state, and if he truly held a grudge against the Wan Family, the matter was no longer simple.
It might even involve conflicts between powerful forces from Qinghua state and the Nine Mountains Realm.
Conflicts between the two realms were not something warriors at their level could get involved with.
Xu Yan's eyebrows raised in a cold smile and said, "I, Xu Yan, never look for trouble, but I'm also not afraid of it. Since I brought out the Blood Heart Fruit for trade, it was with honest intentions. I don't care about your attitude, just pay the agreed treasures for the trade.
"But you, Wan Tianlin, seem a bit too greedy, daring to send someone to attempt to assassinate me. Do you really think I'm someone who wouldn't strike back?"
Wan Tianlin's brows furrowed. It was true that one of his bodyguards had tried to kill Xu Yan.
However, the bodyguard attacked Xu Yan because he himself had been surrounded and attacked.
If the other party was indeed Xu Yan from Qinghua state, and the Wan Family had no enmity with him, why would he recklessly attack them?
Could there be a misunderstanding here?
Wan Tianlin felt a sinking feeling in his heart as if he had caught the scent of conspiracy.
As the pride of the Wan Family, he was not only exceptionally talented but also wasn't just a hot-headed warrior obsessed with martial arts and cultivation.
