If Wan Tianlin had been just a brawny man with outstanding cultivation talent, he would not have been so highly regarded by the Wan Family, nor groomed to be the future family head.
Taking a deep breath, Wan Tianlin bowed and said, "Brother Xu, after completing our negotiations at Yu Zhu Slope, I was preparing to return to the Wan Family to gather the items needed for the trade.
"Unfortunately, I was attacked on the way..."
Having realized something was amiss, Wan Tianlin immediately shared what had happened that day.
"My bodyguard, he returned to Yu Zhu Slope to attack you, Brother Xu, due to this misunderstanding. The Wan Family is willing to make reparation to you for this!"
Wan Tianlin said with a serious tone.
Xu Yan's eyebrows raised. All of a sudden, he turned his gaze towards those True King Heavenly Venerables controlled by the Seductive Witch. At that moment, he understood that a third party was stirring up the conflict between him and the Wan Family from behind the scenes.
"When I left Yu Zhu Slope, I encountered assassins trying to steal the Blood Heart Fruit. I, Xu Yan, am not one to take a beating without fighting back, so I returned to pursue you and encountered your bodyguard along the way..."
Wan Tianlin's expression grew ugly.
"What about the trade for the Blood Heart Fruit?"
At this moment, he suddenly realized that there was something unusual about this matter.
"It's with your bodyguard!"
"My bodyguard is dead, and he did not claim the Blood Heart Fruit!"
At this moment, Wan Tianlin understood that someone was manipulating everything from the shadows.
Xu Yan was furious inside, incensed at being treated like a pawn.
He looked fiercely towards those few True King Heavenly Venerables and said coldly, "Is it one of you behind this? Or perhaps, the one backing you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 749 - 394: Seeing Through, Wan Tianlin's Sincerity Part 2
chapters.content:
Whoosh!
With a single sword stroke, he attacked a True King Heavenly Venerable.
Regardless of the truth, since they were controlled by the Seductive Witch, they absolutely harbored ill intentions.
"Capture them alive!"
Upon seeing Xu Yan make his move, Wan Tianlin also acted immediately, along with two elders of the Wan Family, all wishing to capture a prisoner to interrogate about the mastermind behind the scenes.
The True Kings from Thousand Layered Mountain were somewhat caught off guard at this moment. Their original intention was to rescue Xu Yan from his predicament, but they ended up being targeted by both parties instead.
"It's not us, this matter has nothing to do with us!"
They hurriedly tried to explain.
However, neither the Wan Family nor Xu Yan were convinced, both maintaining stern expressions as they furiously attempted to apprehend them.
"We were only following the orders of a noble person to find Young Master Xu, not the attackers!"
But their explanations were futile.
In Xu Yan's eyes, they had already been controlled by the Seductive Witch and were considered dangerous individuals.
In Wan Tianlin's eyes, these were clues for investigating the person behind the scenes.
"Run!"
Realizing they were no match, the True Kings panicked and could only attempt to flee!
However, facing two elders of the Wan Family, how could it be easy to escape?
"Not good!"
Under the gaze of the Minor Heavenly Path Eye, Xu Yan's eyes narrowed as he saw one of the True King Heavenly Venerables, who was trapped by an elder of the Wan Family and about to be captured, suddenly erupt with power from within.
Boom!
An intense aura surged, and a vast force exploded from within that True King Heavenly Venerable.
As this power erupted, it seemed to gather the lifetime's strength of the True King Heavenly Venerable, blasting away the elder of the Wan Family.
Even that Wan Family elder's expression changed, and he retreated to avoid the brunt of the assault.
That True King Heavenly Venerable then completely burst apart, as if exhausting all his cultivation for that one explosion.
In the eyes of Xu Yan, at the moment the True King Heavenly Venerable exploded, a wisp of faint pink energy flickered briefly before dissipating into the domain.
That was the Charm Power of the Seductive Witch, controlling the True King Heavenly Venerable.
Under its influence, he chose to self-destruct on the spot, rather than fall into the hands of the Wan Family elder.
"Deadly devotees!"
Wan Tianlin's expression turned ugly.
Such decisive self-destruction, unwilling to be captured, could only be attributed to deadly devotees, a feat other martial artists could not achieve.
In the end, three of the True King Heavenly Venerables managed to escape.
Wan Tianlin's expression remained grim. Since these were deadly devotees, without formidable measures, it was impossible to capture them alive and extract any information from them.
For Xu Yan, now that he was certain they were people of the Seductive Witch and had come for him, that was enough.
Capturing them alive was not an easy task.
"This has been a misunderstanding. Rest assured, my Wan Family will definitely uncover the person behind this,"
Wan Tianlin said with a bow.
"You are so certain it has nothing to do with me?"
Xu Yan asked, one eyebrow raised in question.
"Brother Xu comes from the Qinghua state and represents the pride of Qinghua state. Even if there were grievances between us and Brother Xu, there's no need for such tactics.
"Moreover, this matter has far-reaching implications, so I believe Brother Xu is unrelated and is, in fact, a victim. Someone behind the scenes wants to use Brother Xu to target my Wan Family."
After a pause, Wan Tianlin added, "Even more so, to provoke a conflict between my Wan Family and the Qinghua state!"
Xu Yan nodded, his gaze cold as he said, "Anyone who dares to use me, Xu Yan, must pay the price. If Brother Wan has any leads, you can inform me. Perhaps there is an opportunity for us to cooperate!"
"Of course!"
Wan Tianlin's heart stirred, and he spoke up, "Although this matter was caused by the instigation of evildoers, it ultimately resulted from my Wan Family's failure to detect it in time. We misunderstood Brother Xu and issued a public bounty against you, causing some damage to Brother Xu's reputation.
"On behalf of my Wan Family, I, Wan Tianlin, am willing to apologize to Brother Xu and would like to offer compensation for this matter, which also serves to lay the groundwork for our cooperation."
Xu Yan looked at Wan Tianlin in surprise, "What exactly do you plan to offer me as compensation?"
Wan Tianlin said earnestly, "I will gather the items Brother Xu requires as quickly as possible and deliver them to your hands!"
"Really?"
"Naturally!"
Xu Yan couldn't help but regard Wan Tianlin more favorably. Seeing that the other party was so sincere and willing to collect treasures for him, he felt he should also show goodwill.
"In that case, I present this Blood Heart Fruit to Brother Wan,"
Xu Yan took out a Blood Heart Fruit and gave it directly to Wan Tianlin.
"Additionally, there is a person from your Wan Family who once tried to assassinate me. I used some methods on him that will likely result in him returning to attack your Wan Family. You may want to look into this."
With a wave of his hand, Xu Yan gathered spiritual energy, and as the ripples undulated, the visage of Shen Kui was revealed.
"Thank you!"
Wan Tianlin said with a solemn bow.
"In as short as five or six days, or at most half a month, the items Brother Xu requires should be assembled. If there are any clues, I will also inform Brother Xu!"
After receiving the list, Wan Tianlin spoke gravely.
Xu Yan thought for a moment, took out a Communication Talisman, and passed it over, saying, "This is a Communication Talisman. You can send messages to me using this. Within five hundred thousand li, I can receive the messages."
Wan Tianlin was greatly shocked, could this talisman really send messages?
"Brother Xu..."
The importance of the Communication Talisman went without saying.
"Don't look for me, I don't have many Communication Talismans either. They are all for backup."
Xu Yan shook his head.
He stepped forward, vanished instantly from the spot, and his voice echoed in Wan Tianlin's ears: "Brother Wan, I await your good news."
Wan Tianlin and the two Wan Family elders changed their expressions ever so slightly; Xu Yan's speed was too fast, disappearing without a trace in the blink of an eye.
Below the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, who could possibly contend with him?
"Back to the Wan Family!"
Wan Tianlin's face was incomparably grim.
At Dahai Mountain, the notices offering a reward for Xu Yan were all taken down overnight, as if nothing had ever happened.
At the Wan Family, this matter was handed over to Wan Tianlin himself, which could be considered a test of him by the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Wan Family.
Feeling the pressure, Wan Tianlin also began to make arrangements, starting with an investigation into Shen Kui. To his surprise, Shen Kui was missing.
"Brother Xu said he used some method; could it be that Shen Kui didn't target the Wan Family, but instead the forces behind the scenes?"
Wan Tianlin speculated in his heart.
With the Wan Family's heritage and power, gathering the treasures that Xu Yan needed would naturally pose no problem; it was just a matter of time.
At Dahai Mountain, undercurrents surged. The secretive powers within the Wan Family were conducting an inquiry into certain forces within Dahai Mountain and had even begun a thorough investigation throughout the entire Nine Mountain Realm.
Their objective was one: to root out the hidden forces!
After reaching an agreement with Wan Tianlin, Xu Yan first suspected that the forces behind the scenes were the handiwork of the Seductive Witch.
"The Seductive Witch, in the Nine Mountain Realm?"
Xu Yan pondered.
"Wait for Wan Tianlin's treasures!"
Xu Yan assessed and felt that his strength was still somewhat lacking. He decided to wait until he had broken through to the Physiognomy Realm before investigating the mastermind behind the scenes.
In the location of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow Cave, a new Heavenly Slaughter had finally arrived.
Upon seeing him, several masked people immediately tensed up. The Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter was much stronger than the previous one.
"Has the action against the Wan Family and Xu Yan already failed?"
The man wearing the Ferocious Mask with five leaf patterns asked coldly.
"The Wan Family has removed the bounty on Xu Yan, and there has been no news suggesting that Xu Yan has been captured. It seems to have failed."
A subordinate of Earth Shadow said cautiously.
"Where did it fail?"
The Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter inquired.
"There must be a traitor within our Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow!"
After a moment of silence, someone said in a low voice.
"Our Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow has never had a traitor since its inception. Now, the emergence of a traitor has led to the failure of the plan; this matter cannot be taken lightly.
"Before the next plan unfolds, an internal investigation is imperative to pull out those with disloyal hearts!"
Following the orders of the new Heavenly Slaughter, tremors began to occur among the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow members located at Dahai Mountain as they started rooting out internal traitors.
And all this was unknown to both Xu Yan and the Wan Family. Having a power as formidable as the Wan Family, they had still failed to detect the existence of such a secretive force as the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
In less than half a month, Xu Yan received a message from Wan Tianlin that the required treasures had been collected.
Meeting again at Shi Feng, Wan Tianlin recounted the Wan Family's investigation, which yielded no valuable leads.
Regarding those True King Heavenly Venerables from Thousand Layered Mountain, their identities had been clarified, and it was confirmed that they were not related to the forces behind the scenes. As for why they were looking for Xu Yan, and who the dignitary was, for the time being, that remained unknown.
Xu Yan understood in his heart; the Seductive Witch was at Thousand Layered Mountain. Part of the reason he came to the Nine Mountain Realm and headed to Thousand Layered Mountain was to collect the treasures needed to build up his foundation.
Now that the treasures had been fully assembled, the trip to Thousand Layered Mountain was no longer essential. Whether to avoid the Seductive Witch, Xu Yan had yet to decide.

chapters.title: Chapter 750 - 395 Wind Spirit Tiger of Spiritual Sovereign Mountain, Unity of Domain
chapters.content:
```
After acquiring the necessary treasures, Xu Yan found out where the True King Heavenly Venerable from the Seductive Witch Sect had come from, he then bid farewell to Wan Tianlin and left.
Wan Tianlin, in turn, confessed that the investigation by the Wan Family would continue, and that he needed to use the Blood Heart Fruit to comprehend the Cultivation Technique, which also required him to retreat for a period of time.
"I can finally continue to accumulate my foundation and break through to the Physiognomy Realm."
Xu Yan was secretly thrilled.
During the retreat, he had to be cautious to avoid being tracked down by others.
Xu Yan concealed his aura, changed his appearance, and evaded all tracking and probing; even if an Immortal Heavenly Venerable made a move, they could not trace him.
After ensuring safety, Xu Yan set up a Concealing Formation in a deserted area of Dahai Mountain, and the "Mountains and Rivers in the Sword" also enveloped the place of his retreat.
"I can now accumulate the foundation and break through the realm."
Xu Yan, excited, began to use these treasures to build up enough foundation and prepare for the transformation during the breakthrough.
Accumulating the foundation required some time, as did breaking into the Physiognomy Realm, and Xu Yan once again disappeared from Dahai Mountain.
Neither the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow nor the True King Heavenly Venerable from the Seductive Witch Sect of Thousand Layered Mountain could find any trace of him again.
Thousand Layered Mountain, where the witch's Heavenly Grotto was located.
The Heavenly Grotto at this time had changed greatly; it was decorated with lights and planted with pink, beautiful flowers, transforming the inside of the grotto.
This place was no longer a dim grotto, it seemed like a paradise on earth.
In an elegant little building, with curtains hanging down, one could faintly see a woman lazily lying on her side inside.
Long, snow-white beautiful legs were half exposed outside the curtains.
About a dozen glamorous women were attending her in the elegant building, all of them True King Heavenly Venerables.
But they were no longer the same people as before.
Outside the little building, several True King Heavenly Venerables were prostrating themselves, their eyes filled with manic adoration, immersed in the wonderful silhouette that was only partially visible.
"So, you didn't bring the person here?"
The seductive and charming voice sounded.
"Yes!"
Those prostrating trembled slightly, sweat beading on their foreheads, their eyes showing some disarray.
"What's the reason?"
"We haven't found the person yet, and he doesn't trust us."
After a pause, one of them spoke up, "Xu Yan seems to be collecting heavenly and earthly treasures, probably for an important use."
From the elegant building, a graceful figure flew out and landed in the arms of the person who had spoken.
"You managed to find some information, which is a merit on your part. She will play with you, and she will surely make you happy."
"Yes, thank you very much!"
That True King, thrilled and excited, held the beauty in his arms and left in haste, his eyes ablaze with fanaticism.
Lowering his head to look, the person in his arms was three or four points similar to the goddess who had captivated his heart and soul, which made him even more excited.
"Heavenly and earthly treasures?"
Suddenly, a seven-colored flower flew out of the little building. Its seven petals had seven colors, radiating a halo of seven hues, as if it held extraordinary and magical uses.
"Then pass the message to Xu Yan that there is a Seven Wonders Divine Flower here. If he doesn't know about the Seven Wonders Divine Flower, tell him that the flower can make up for the weakness of Martial Artists; it can strengthen the Divine Soul, purify the Martial Arts foundation, and help Martial Artists calm their minds to comprehend the mysteries of Martial Arts..."
"Yes, it will be done!"
The several True King Heavenly Venerables glanced at the Seven Wonders Divine Flower planted in the ground, feeling an infinite longing deep inside.
It was an instinct from the deepest part of a Martial Artist.
Instinct told them that if they could obtain the Seven Wonders Divine Flower, they had a very high chance of breaking through to become an Immortal Heavenly Venerable!
But, no matter how strong their desire, they did not harbor any improper thoughts.
After the several True King Heavenly Venerables left, the person in the little building lazily rolled over, muttering, "I've taken out the Seven Wonders Divine Flower, and I don't believe your disciple won't come. If your disciple comes, then you should too, right?
"Offending my Seductive Witch Sect isn't so easily dismissed; let's see how you'll handle this."
In her mind, the scene from that time emerged, especially that sword strike; it was that unexpected sword that made her slip during the defense and nearly suffer a heavy blow.
This vengeance must be avenged!
"Your disciple is quite handsome, too; I've taken some interest."
The corners of the Seductive Witch's mouth turned up slightly, revealing a seductive smile that bewitched all beings.
Meanwhile, as Xu Yan's whereabouts were elusive and the Wan Family intensified surveillance over Dahai Mountain, the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow members became more cautious in their actions.
In this period, they killed some Earth Shadow Members, suspecting them of being traitors.
This also caused some Earth Shadow Members to feel uneasy, and they became more cautious in executing their tasks.
Horizontal Peak Mountain, one of the Nine Mountains in the Nine Mountain Realm.
At this moment, at a grotto on Horizontal Peak Mountain, there stood a huge Copper Palace, suppressing this section of the grotto.
The custodian of this place was an Immortal Heavenly Venerable from Horizontal Peak Mountain.
At this time, this Immortal Heavenly Venerable was wearing a Ferocious Mask with seven leaves engraved on it.
Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter!
"My lord, how should we proceed?"
A few Heavenly Slaughter members with fewer than five leaves gathered inside the Copper Palace, respectfully asking for instructions.
"Since the Wan Family has seen through us, let's just kill Xu Yan. As long as he dies within the Nine Mountain Realm, there will be a way to incite conflict between the Qinghua state and the Nine Mountain Realm.
"As long as he dies, there will be a way to manage the aftermath, no matter what, even if Horizontal Peak Mountain takes responsibility for this matter.
"Additionally, Heavenly God Meng Chong from Qinghua state has already arrived in the Nine Mountain Realm, and we could make a move against him.
"As long as the death happens within the Nine Mountain Realm, things afterward will be much easier to handle."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 751 - 395 Spiritual Sovereign Mountain Wind Spirit Tiger, Unity of Domain_2
chapters.content:
"We only need to start a conflict with the Qinghua state. No need to mind what means we use. Additionally, send Earth Shadow to infiltrate Qinghua state."
"Qimen Institute, Alchemical Medical Institute, both are possible places to infiltrate and wait for the opportunity to act,"
Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter said in a cold voice.
"Yes, Lord!"
The spirits of everyone in the Copper Palace were lifted, and they showed signs of exhilaration.
Lord Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter was an Immortal Heavenly Venerable of Horizontal Peak Mountain and could fully represent it, taking the responsibility for any killings.
Thus, letting Horizontal Peak Mountain, whether it be Tianwu Sect of Qinghua state, Myriad Thunder Sect, or even Da Yue Country, break out in contradictions and conflicts was the goal achieved.
When his subordinates had left, and only Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter was left in the Copper Palace, he stood outside the palace door, his gaze deep as he looked towards the firmament and then towards the Heavenly Grotto where he presided.
No one knew that the original Blood Shadow of this Heavenly Grotto had long been killed. The one called Blood Shadow now was one in name only.
It was a partnership he had formed with the other party to help them ascend to the position of Blood Shadow, yet they did not possess the real strength of one.
This Heavenly Grotto would not be thrown into chaos; he could always temporarily leave his post!
"The Divine Realm should be in chaos!"
He murmured to himself.
The Divine Realm should not only face invasions from the Heavenly Grottoes but should also engage in conflicts with each other—that was the goal of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
"How can the Domain achieve unity if the Divine Realm is not in chaos, if there are no conflicts to engage in?"
With a deep and mysterious look, he had come to the Nine Mountain Realm precisely to stir up the Divine Realm. The Thirty-six Realms must engage in never-ending conflicts; only through such turmoil could he complete his mission.
"Qinghua state and Nine Mountain Realm should also descend into chaos and engage in endless conflicts."
With a single motion, he disappeared from the spot.
An Immortal Heavenly Venerable had quietly left his post.
Spiritual Sovereign Mountain, one of the nine mountains of the Nine Mountain Realm, was a domain where Spirit Beasts dwelled, with a Spirit Beast King of the Immortal Realm presiding over it.
Unlike the other eight mountains, Spiritual Sovereign Mountain Region had only one Heavenly Grotto, but the strength of this one was extremely formidable.
Therefore, aside from the Spirit Beast forces, there was also the powerful Spiritual Sovereign Gate presiding here.
In a sense, the Spirit Beast King was also a member of Spiritual Sovereign Gate, referred to as the sect's Guardian Spirit Beast, with a status of immense veneration.
Because of it, Spiritual Sovereign Mountain was named, and so was Spiritual Sovereign Gate named. The Wind Spirit Tiger was the most powerful existence of Spiritual Sovereign Gate, even stronger than the Sect Master of Spiritual Sovereign Gate.
However, those who knew this truth could be counted on one hand within the entire Nine Mountains.
The Wind Spirit Tiger would not leave the bounds of Spiritual Sovereign Mountain, but usually, there was no need for it to act against the Heavenly Grotto unless there was a danger of losing control.
Most of the time, the Wind Spirit Tiger just lay in this ancient forest.
Those who could come to this ancient forest in Spiritual Sovereign Mountain were only the Immortal Heavenly Venerables, or younger generations of the tribe valued by the Wind Spirit Tiger, who had the privilege to be here.
A figure wearing a Ferocious Mask with seven leaves inscribed on it walked into the ancient forest. Although his presence was unremarkable, each step seemed to merge with the Domain.
"Tian Shiqi? I remember that's your name."
The Wind Spirit Tiger lifted its eyelids to glance at the newcomer and said.
"It's me!"
Tian Shiqi stopped about a hundred paces away from the Wind Spirit Tiger, saying in a heavy voice.
The Wind Spirit Tiger yawned, looking rather bored: "You're here again, what do you want to say this time?"
"If the Divine Realm is not in chaos, if the Thirty-six Realms do not engage in conflict, how can you advance further? How can you break through the shackles of your bloodline and elevate your strength?"
Tian Shiqi spoke in a solemn tone.
"Keep talking."
The Wind Spirit Tiger raised one paw and extended its tongue to lick it, speaking the following words.
Tian Shiqi took a deep breath, ready to fend off an attack, and said solemnly, "Only when the Domain unites as one can the fetters be broken, and only then can you continue to ascend.
"Are you, one of the twelve kings of the Spirit Beasts in the Divine Realm, content to guard this place? Bound for life without a single advancement, unable to further refine your bloodline?"
The Wind Spirit Tiger extended sharp claws from within its paw, lifted its head, and looked at Tian Shiqi. "Unity of Domain, is that your purpose?
"Not to mention what Unity of Domain really means, do you even have the capability to achieve it?
"Do you really think you can deceive me into working for you by promising that Unity of Domain is the only way to advance my bloodline?"
As it spoke, a mighty wind began to swirl around the Wind Spirit Tiger, emanating a formidable presence without even showing anger.
Tian Shiqi said in a deep voice, "Wind Spirit Tiger, you must understand that the Divine Realm is not the core of the Domain. Our mission is to create the conditions for Unity of Domain. The genuine implementation of Unity of Domain is not something that can be accomplished by beings of our realm.
"I can assure you that your participation will not only break the shackles and benefit your bloodline as a minor advantage. Once the Domain unites, the authority of the Domain..."
He did not continue his sentence.
Contemplative, the Wind Spirit Tiger lowered the paw it had raised and after a long while said, "I will consider it!"
Tian Shiqi's gaze relaxed. Since it was under consideration, agreement was just a matter of time.
"In that case, I shall not disturb you any further. I will return."
Having said that, Tian Shiqi turned and left.
Once Tian Shiqi had gone, the Wind Spirit Tiger watched the direction of his departure, lost in thought.
"The Divine Realm is not the core of the Domain; this is no surprise. The Divine Realm, Spiritual Realm, Inner Domain... Unity of Domain, breaking the barrier? The upheavals of Ancient Times created today's structure of the Domain, and now there is an attempt to revert to the Domain of Ancient Times?
"Who can do that? With foreign enemies outside the Heavenly Grotto, today's Domain is no longer the same as it once was.
"However, Tian Shiqi's background seems complex—could there be a being above the Immortal level behind him? Could the Divine Realm still harbor such powers?"
The Wind Spirit Tiger closed its eyes, pondering whether to agree to Tian Shiqi's proposal and if it could gain the benefits it sought while also guarding against being used.
"This is the Nine Mountain Realm's Cloud Pool Mountain Region; I wonder where my senior brother is among these mountains."
Before a mountain peak shrouded in mist, Meng Chong gazed at the Divine Medicine he had just dug out from the bottom of the lake, pondering whether to meet up with his senior brother.
Having made a name for himself as a Heavenly God in the Qinghua state and having founded the Body Cultivation practice, Meng Chong left Qinghua state after reaching Perfection in the Divine Skill Realm and came to the Nine Mountain Realm in search of treasures to build a solid foundation.
The treasures he sought naturally had specific characteristics. The Nine Mountains were vast and thick, filled with Divine Medicine that focused on physical enhancement, which was the very reason he was here.
"Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path, I'm so close to comprehending it. But this final step is the toughest. I wonder if my senior brother has managed to master it.
"My fourth junior brother's Communication Talisman has been upgraded, I might as well send some new ones to senior brother for backup."
After mulling it over, Meng Chong decided to seek out his senior brother and share his insights into the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path.
"The Nine Mountain Realm is vast, governed by nine major forces. With my senior brother's Communication Talisman, there's a limit to how far messages can reach... I'll have to check the major cities in the Nine Mountain Realm to see if I can leave some messages and find senior brother."
Meng Chong made up his mind and turned to leave.
Suddenly, his expression turned serious, and with a thunderous roar, divine energy surged within him, shining with golden light as wind and thunder encircled his body, and a radiant sun appeared behind his head.
Boom!
He threw a punch that collided with a tiny, cold glint of light.
Pfft!
The imprint of his fist was pierced, and although the cold glint was weakened, it continued its deadly advance.
"Skulking cowards!"
Meng Chong snorted coldly, neither dodging nor evading, drew his sword in a flash, and slashed out. In an instant, the rocks transformed into a dominant long sword that furiously blasted forward.
Simultaneously, four figures charged towards him.
Each one possessed the strength at the peak of the True King Heavenly Venerable.
Meng Chong's eyes narrowed as he looked at the four True Kings wearing masks. It was clear they had come to assassinate him.
"A Martial Artist from Qinghua state? No, there's not a single power in Qinghua state bold enough to attack me here. If they really mobilized four True Kings at the peak, it would be easy to trace back to them, and they're not the Blood Shadows from the Netherworld..."
Meng Chong's brow furrowed. These four were definitely targeting him. He had only just arrived in the Nine Mountain Realm, never having offended any force there. Moreover, these four did not seem like bandits out to kill for treasure.

chapters.title: Chapter 752 - 396: Red Cat Hoodwinks Wind Spirit Tiger, Spiritual Sovereign Gate Master is Stunned
chapters.content:
"Who are you?"
Meng Chong, with his sword in hand, was dazzlingly radiant, appearing like a Heavenly God.
The four assassins, without a word, attacked simultaneously from four different directions.
With perfect coordination, their attack sealed off any space for Meng Chong to dodge, leaving him no choice but to withstand the assault.
Boom!
Meng Chong unleashed the Great Sun God Obscuration, surrounded by wind and thunder. In an instant, he transformed into an eighteen-zhang-tall giant, and his long sword also became an enormous blade in the blink of an eye.
Boom!
With the intent of Hidden Blade, rocks turned into blades, sweeping toward the four assassins from all directions.
Meng Chong, resembling a Heavenly God, was covered in golden armor, and divine power surged around him; however, all four assassins were at the True King Heavenly Venerable Peak, with no lesser strength.
"Heavenly God Meng Chong, so this is your strength!"
One of them sneered coldly.
"Kill him!"
The ferocious attack continued to bombard him from every angle, blocking his retreat and leaving Meng Chong with no chance to escape!
Boom!
The powerful assault hit Meng Chong, divine power raged, dissolving the terrifying force of the attack, and within the surge of divine power lay another layer of golden armor.
While the impact shook him, it did not injure Meng Chong in the slightest.
"Let's see how you will kill me!"
Meng Chong seized the Great Sun God Obscuration in his left hand, as if holding the great sun itself, and furiously charged at the nearest assassin.
In that moment, he unleashed his Divine Skills, catching the assassin in front of him and launching a frenzied attack. As for the attacks from the other three, he resisted them all with his terrifying defense.
Even though each strike shook his body and the divine power vibrated continuously, seeming like it might collapse at any moment, he ultimately withstood it all.
The assassin who was being violently attacked by Meng Chong was somewhat overwhelmed and unable to defend himself.
Although he was a True King Heavenly Venerable, as Meng Chong closed in on him, it seemed as if close-quarters combat was imminent. Faced with such a fierce attack, he was momentarily flustered.
Instinctively, he knew that once Meng Chong got close enough to engage in physical combat, even as a True King Heavenly Venerable Peak, he would undoubtedly perish.
However, to prevent Meng Chong from seizing the opportunity to escape, he could not afford to create too much distance, thus he was in a very passive position.
The other three assassins also had grim expressions. Meng Chong's terrifying defense and powerful physique far exceeded their expectations.
Boom!
The three others continued to strike frantically. Yet each horrendous attack seemed to enter rising waves, where their force dissolved into nothingness under the undulations.
Indeed, every hit caused Meng Chong's body to shake, even stagger, but they were still unable to injure him.
Boom!
Meng Chong, grasping the great sun, with his blade encompassing wind and thunder, truly displayed the might of a Heavenly God. In a split second, he lunged forward, and his giant-like figure suddenly reverted to its true size.
Caught off guard by this abrupt change, the assassin deflecting Meng Chong's attacks was too late to react. Meng Chong had already pounced upon him.
"Not good!"
A sudden sense of danger surged in his heart, and he hurriedly retreated.
Boom!
Yet Meng Chong's fist, resembling a great sun, grazed his arm, instantly breaking the bone with a loud crack!
Just as Meng Chong was about to continue his assault, his expression subtly changed. A cold gleam, long and slender, suddenly flew towards him.
An assassin, his face concealed by a Ferocious Mask adorned with five leaves, appeared out of nowhere. The slender blade in his hand thrust towards Meng Chong.
Spurt!
The slender cold gleam pierced into the divine power; even though half the force of the strike was dissipated by the immense divine power, the slender blade continued to pierce through.
Spurt!
The golden armor within the surge of divine power was punctured, leaving a small hole. Meng Chong felt a slight pain in his shoulder!
He was wounded!
Boom!
He threw the Great Sun, which exploded furiously, its blazing light flaring out and forcing the masked man back.
"I'll remember you all!"
Meng Chong snorted coldly and strode forward, like a great sun crossing the sky, vanishing from sight!
The last assassin with the Ferocious Mask, whose strength was beyond that of an ordinary True King Heavenly Venerable Peak Martial Artist, posed a real threat to Meng Chong.
The slender blade, with its impressive ability to break defenses, had actually pierced through his limitless divine power, injuring him slightly.
Although the injury was minor, it made Meng Chong realize that continuing the battle could prove dangerous, especially since he didn't know how many more would come after him.
Hence, he decisively fled!
"Chase him!"
The masked assassin, blade in hand, was the first to give chase, but Meng Chong was incredibly fast. In the blink of an eye, all they saw was a flash of light, and he was gone from the sky.
"Meng Chong has escaped, what should we do?"
"It's no wonder he's Heavenly God Meng Chong, so powerful. His physical body is as resilient as a Divine Artifact."
"The stronger and more monstrous he is, the better. The turmoil caused by his death will be greater."
"Makes sense!"
Several members of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow were discussing this with sighs of amazement.
"Continue the pursuit of Meng Chong. Any means necessary, we just need him dead!" said Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter coldly.
"Yes, my lord!"
The Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow dispersed, tracing Meng Chong's tracks and planning how to assassinate him. Since a direct confrontation failed to penetrate his defenses, they could resort to treachery in secret.
No sooner had Meng Chong entered the Nine Mountain Realm than he encountered an ambush, sustaining injuries as he fled. Meanwhile, in the Spiritual Sovereign Mountain Region, a tiger, a flood dragon, and a toad made their way through the forests and hills.
"Big brother, what should our next move be?"

chapters.title: Chapter 753 - 396 Red Cat Tricks Wind Spirit Tiger, Spiritual Sovereign Gate Master is Confused_2
chapters.content:
Yu Xiaolong looked towards Red Cat and said,
"You got all the information that old man Feng Yan provided, right? This Spiritual Sovereign Mountain is none other than the Spirit Beast Mountain, and that Spirit Beast King, the Wind Spirit Tiger, is much stronger than that old man Feng Yan.
"So, for now, let's not bring up the matters of the Demon Clan. I, the Red Cat Demon King, know when to yield and when to stand tall. Since our power doesn't match up to others, it's only natural to keep a low profile.
"The Wind Spirit Tiger, being a mighty one of my Tiger Tribe, demands that we head there to pay our respects. Be sharp, everyone,"
Red Cat remarked while walking along.
"Yes, big brother!"
Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha nodded.
How to act, how to gain the Wind Spirit Tiger's trust, and ultimately how to take over Spiritual Sovereign Mountain, followed by founding the Demon Clan and ascending to the throne of the Demon King, all depended on Red Cat's cunning plans.
On Spiritual Sovereign Mountain, a majestic roar echoed in all directions as a Splendid Giant Tiger walked solemnly across it.
Soon, the Spirit Beasts of Spiritual Sovereign Mountain were alarmed, looking at the three visiting creatures with amazement on their faces.
With his smooth talking, Red Cat quickly swayed many Spirit Beasts and secured himself a not insignificant position among them.
He even learned more about the Wind Spirit Tiger from these Spirit Beasts, and soon discovered that due to its revered status, few dared to approach it.
And indeed, it seemed that the Wind Spirit Tiger, the Spirit Beast King, quite enjoyed flattery. Upon realizing this, Red Cat immediately concocted a plan.
The moment he spoke, it was all about our Tiger Tribe...
But in just over ten days, Red Cat made his way to the old forests of Spiritual Sovereign Mountain and met with the Wind Spirit Tiger.
The Wind Spirit Tiger, lying on the ground, looked bewilderedly at Red Cat. This Spirit Beast from his own tribe seemed a bit off.
The power it exuded was somewhat different from that of other Spirit Beasts.
However, it did not ponder too long, as the mountain was home to many Spirit Beasts, and even among the Tiger Tribe, some could have unique powers due to their lineage.
Red Cat stood up on two legs and walked around with an air of swagger, wearing a thick gold chain around his neck and a treasure sword at his waist, followed by a Flood Dragon and a toad.
The Flood Dragon and the toad carried a huge, glittering golden chair and followed Red Cat step by step.
This scene baffled the Wind Spirit Tiger.
Especially Red Cat, walking on two legs with a sword at his waist, had the bearing of a warrior.
"Red Cat pays his respects to the mighty Wind Spirit, big brother of the Tiger Tribe!"
Red Cat said, bringing his front paws together as if in a salute.
Continuing to be confused, the Wind Spirit Tiger instinctively stood up, "What did you call me?"
"Our Tiger Tribe's mighty one, big brother Wind Spirit!"
As Red Cat spoke, Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha swiftly set down the chair.
"Please, big brother Wind Spirit, take your seat!"
Red Cat said with a grave face.
Before coming to sway the Wind Spirit Tiger, Red Cat already understood clearly that apart from the Wind Spirit Tiger, there were only three tigers on the entire Spiritual Sovereign Mountain, including himself.
The other two tigers seemed rather simple-minded in Red Cat's view and were easily swayed.
It was precisely for this reason that the Wind Spirit Tiger, the King of Spirit Beasts, would not hastily punish him, a fellow Tiger.
After all, there weren't many tigers around!
Eliminating one would just reduce their numbers.
Because of this, Red Cat was bold enough to make his move today.
As a culturally erudite tiger, Red Cat was confident that although his current strength was not as great as the Wind Spirit Tiger's, the latter did not have as sharp a mind.
"Big brother Wind Spirit, you have a majestic and noble bearing, unparalleled in this world. As a mighty one of our Tiger Tribe, naturally, you should be seated on this throne to fully reveal the majesty of the Tiger King and showcase your unparalleled awe—"
Red Cat went on with a barrage of compliments, and from initially being baffled, the Wind Spirit Tiger started to puff up with pride.
"Not bad, not bad, you're right!"
The more he listened, the more it seemed that this little tiger brother's words made sense.
With such a majestic and noble bearing, how could he lie down on the ground?
Wouldn't that diminish the awe of the Tiger Tribe's mighty one?
Overjoyed, the Wind Spirit Tiger approached the gleaming chair, shrank his body a bit, and lay down on it.
Seeing this, Red Cat thought to himself that indeed, the Wind Spirit Tiger was not too bright; how was lying down on this any different from lying on the ground?
"Big brother Wind Spirit, listen to me, lying down cannot showcase your awe—you should be sitting..."
Red Cat approached to instruct the Wind Spirit Tiger on how to sit majestically on the throne.
"This is a large gold chain, adorned with thirty-six glittering gemstones, wearing it can bring out your noble aura, big brother..."
"This is the Tiger Might Divine Staff, revealing the awe of our Tiger Tribe's might..."
At last, the Wind Spirit Tiger wore the big gold chain around its neck, the thirty-six gemstones gleaming, exhibiting a nouveau riche stature.
A Tiger Head Gold Staff was gripped by the paw of the Wind Spirit Tiger and planted on the ground.
At this moment, the Wind Spirit Tiger sat regally on the throne, wearing a big gold chain, with the Tiger Head Gold Staff in hand, looking majestic and awe-inspiring.
"Big brother, doesn't this fully display the grandeur and divine might of our Tiger Tribe?"
Red Cat beckoned with a paw, and Little Ha and Yu Xiaolong brought over a huge mirror, setting it upright in front of the Wind Spirit Tiger.
Upon seeing himself, the Wind Spirit Tiger was instantly overjoyed.
"Good, good, good, indeed this is how to fully showcase the divine might of this king!"
"Big brother, I think the Spirit Beasts of Spiritual Sovereign Mountain are too lax, they fail to manifest your might as the Tiger King. We must train them properly,"
Red Cat seized the opportunity to suggest.
"You make sense, I'll leave this matter to you, my wise brother,"
"Don't worry, big brother, I'll handle it perfectly!"
Red Cat said, patting his chest confidently.
Then, Red Cat selected four presentable Spirit Beasts on Spiritual Sovereign Mountain to be responsible for carrying the throne, parading the Wind Spirit Tiger around Spiritual Sovereign Mountain.
As they passed by, flocks of Spirit Beasts prostrated and cried out: "Hail to the gallant and unparalleled, invincible Wind Spirit King!"
The Wind Spirit Tiger was thrilled, feeling as though his past life was meaningless; this was the treatment a King of Spirit Beasts deserved!
"Red Cat, my wise brother, it's you who knows how to showcase the might of our Tiger Tribe."
"Oh, that's nothing, it's all thanks to your divine might, big brother. Without your unparalleled greatness, where would this heroic demeanor come from?"
Red Cat delivered another compliment.
"Good, good, good!"
The Wind Spirit Tiger was elated and immediately declared, "From today onward, Red Cat shall be the second king of Spiritual Sovereign Mountain, second only to me, the Wind Spirit King. All of you must heed Red Cat's commands..."
Red Cat successfully established a solid position on Spiritual Sovereign Mountain, ruling all the Spirit Beasts apart from the Wind Spirit Tiger.
The Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Spiritual Sovereign Gate were somewhat dumbfounded.
What had happened to the Wind Spirit Tiger, changing so suddenly?
The master of the Spiritual Sovereign Gate arrived at the ancient forest and saw the Wind Spirit Tiger sitting on a golden throne, neck adorned with a large gold chain, gemstones glittering, and a Tiger Might Divine Staff in its paw. He rubbed his eyes—was he seeing things?
This tiger, hadn't it always just lain on the ground?
How come it was now sitting upright in a chair like a human?
"The master has arrived, serve the tea!"
The Wind Spirit Tiger lifted a paw, and immediately a Spirit Beast brought over a table while another quickly brewed tea.
"Master, have a seat,"
The Wind Spirit Tiger indicated a chair and spoke.
The head of the Spiritual Sovereign Gate was completely stunned—something must be wrong with the Wind Spirit Tiger's mind.
"Wind Spirit Tiger..."
"Hmm? Master, you should call me Wind Spirit Elder, or Wind Spirit King. Don't be ignorant of the proper respects.
"As the master of Spiritual Sovereign Gate you represent our Spiritual Sovereign Mountain's facade, how can you not know protocol and lose our mountain's face?
"Don't blame me for pulling rank, I'm doing this for the good of the Spiritual Sovereign Mountain. Red Cat, my wise brother, give a copy of the etiquette manual to the master..."
Fuck!
The face of the Spiritual Sovereign Gate master twitched as he looked at the small booklet handed to him—his whole being was in disarray.
Was he really being lectured on etiquette by a Spirit Beast?
"Wind Spirit... Elder, what are you..."
The Spiritual Sovereign Gate master was uncomfortable; could it be that the Wind Spirit Tiger's mind had really gone awry?
He was the most powerful on Spiritual Sovereign Mountain!
"As a mighty figure of the Tiger Tribe, I must lead by example, teaching the younger generation manners, honor, and disgrace. What you see is just that.
"This is my wise brother Red Cat, responsible for managing all matters of our Spirit Beasts. If you have any issues, master, just speak to wise brother Red Cat.
"Seeing Red Cat should be as seeing me. I hope you understand, master..."
The Spiritual Sovereign Gate master glanced at the Splendid Ferocious Tiger standing upright, sporting a big gold chain and a long saber at its waist, his mouth twitching slightly.
Fuck!
He suspected that the Wind Spirit Tiger's behaviors were all influenced by this Splendid Tiger!
"I understand."
The master of the Spiritual Sovereign Gate couldn't stay any longer—he made his excuses and departed.
The Wind Spirit Tiger had begun to speak more elegantly, ditching his coarseness, and to him, it just didn't sound right anymore!

chapters.title: Chapter 754 - 397: The Sacred Body of Mountains and Rivers, Great Completion of Void-breaking
chapters.content:
The arrival of the Red Cat and its trickery with the Wind Spirit Tiger has caused Spiritual Sovereign Mountain to undergo changes. The spirit beasts of the mountain are receiving training, transforming into a formidable army of the Demon Clan.
The Nine Mountain Realm too stirs with undercurrents. Meng Chong's arrival has led to a series of assassination attempts, some overt, some clandestine and underhanded.
Were it not for his formidable strength, his incredibly resilient body, and his extraordinary martial arts techniques, he might have already fallen.
"Who is targeting me?"
Meng Chong had already changed his attire, donning a wig to cover his bald head, masking his most recognizable feature.
"The eldest senior brother appeared in Dahai Mountain, but his traces have vanished for some time. Is he undergoing a breakthrough in seclusion? Who exactly are these people targeting me, and what power do they represent?
"For now, I'll assume a new identity and try my luck in the Heavenly Grotto, gathering treasures. It won't be too late to seek revenge after I've made my breakthrough!"
Meng Chong had a plan for his next move.
Due to the nature of martial arts, once he made a move in the Heavenly Grotto, his traces would quickly be exposed. Therefore, he could not stay there for too long.
"The Minor Eye of the Heavenly Dao is just a bit away from being comprehended. I should spend more time on that." Meng Chong thought to himself.
Meng Chong began to conceal his presence and ventured into the Heavenly Grotto.
...
Li Xuan, as usual, sat leisurely in a chair, playing with a Jade Ruyi in one hand while holding and reading the Book of Taicang with the other.
He had already reached the seventeenth page of the Book of Taicang. Only the last page was left before he would have completed the entire book.
Now, Li Xuan's understanding of the Taicang Domain Dao Principles and the principles of Dao had reached an extremely high level.
It was also for this reason that Li Xuan was gradually perfecting the next realm beyond the Domain Realm.
The Divine Skill Martial Code was also being refined further.
The goal of the Three Thousand Divine Skills was within reach; these skills encompassed a wide range, each with its myriad uses, not limited to offense and defense.
"The path of Divine Skills is truly mystical. With the Dao principles as a reference, creating Divine Skills has become much easier," Li Xuan mused contentedly at the significant progress he had made in his martial arts endeavor.
"Xu Yan has gone to the Nine Mountain Realm. Meng Chong should be nearing his trip there as well." he thought to himself.
Of his five disciples, only Jiang Buping had yet to truly begin his training. However, the issue with the Imperishable Qi was nearing a resolution, and his entrance into the Extreme Soul Martial Arts realm was imminent.
Day after day, those around him devoted themselves to arduous cultivation, including his maid, Cai Ling'er, who had activated her bloodline and obtained the Sea Spirit Inheritance, making significant progress in her training.
Shi'er, Meng Shushu, and Zhou Ying had all made it to the later stages of the Divine Intent Realm. It had to be said that under the influence of pills and the rich spiritual energy of the Divine Realm, their cultivation speed had greatly increased.
Fang Hao's formations, as well as the Communication Talismans, had seen significant improvements, as had his mastery of the Qimen Martial Art.
Meng Chong returned briefly before departing again for the Nine Mountain Realm.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has understood the essence of the Minor Eye of the Heavenly Dao. Your Minor Eye of the Heavenly Dao has reached completion," reported the Daoist Golden Book.
A surge of elation filled Li Xuan's heart. In that moment, he felt as though his eyes could penetrate all the mysteries of the world.
A third eye seemed to emerge within his forehead, radiant and profound with spiritual light.
"So, this is the Minor Eye of the Heavenly Dao. Xu Yan indeed has not let me down!" Li Xuan exclaimed.
Having gained the Minor Eye of the Heavenly Dao, Li Xuan felt as if everything had changed. Looking at the Book of Taicang, he seemed to see the traces of Dao principles outlined. It was as if he could perceive the passage of time that the creator of those Dao principles had experienced.
With this new ability, reading the Book of Taicang became even easier. He looked up at the firmament and saw the operation of the Domain Dao Rule, the existence of the natural laws, and the Domain Origin.
He even felt as though he could see, high above the firmament, the outline of something resembling a world.
"Interesting!" Li Xuan commented, his curiosity piqued but deciding not to explore further for now.
"The Minor Eye of the Heavenly Dao is already so powerful. How much more formidable the true Eye of the Heavenly Dao must be!" Li Xuan pondered the divine power he had cultivated, realizing the challenge of mastering it completely.
"With the Minor Eye of the Heavenly Dao, I should be able to detect the hidden presence in the stone house, right?" Li Xuan speculated.
The Mysterious Stone House within the Wu Country Royal Palace harbored untold secrets, likely related to the owner of the Book of Taicang.
However, Li Xuan did not rush to the Wu Country Royal Palace to investigate.
"No rush. The Void-breaking Realm is not yet strong enough, and I have not fully mastered the Book of Taicang. The secrets of the world aren't going anywhere," he reasoned, curbing his enthusiasm.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has intuitively understood the Great Divine Power, Destiny of the Heavenly Intent, and your Destiny of the Heavenly Intent has reached completion," the Daoist Golden Book updated him again.
Xu Yan had come to understand another Divine Skill.
The Destiny of the Heavenly Intent!
This Divine Skill was one of the Great Divine Powers Li Xuan had created, a unique class of Divine Skill, and Xu Yan had actually managed to comprehend it.
"He truly is a pioneer of my martial arts undertaking," Li Xuan thought proudly, his mood lifted by the news.
With his spirits high, he went on to instruct Feng Yan, who was busy at that moment, on his cultivation of Divine Skills.
Feng Yan was overjoyed and listened intently, afraid of missing the slightest detail.
All this time, as the Immortal Heavenly Venerable residing within the Qimen Institute and Alchemical Medical Institute, he had played the role of a mere errand boy, seeking recognition, clinging to a rare opportunity.
Now, the chance had arrived!
Feng Yan was cultivating a minor Divine Skill, but as a martial artist of Taicang Martial Arts, mastering Divine Skills still posed a great challenge.

chapters.title: Chapter 755 - 397: The Sacred Body of Mountains and Rivers, Great Completion of Void-breaking_2
chapters.content:
```
But since Wu Tianan had successfully cultivated, it meant that Taicang Martial Arts could also cultivate Divine Skills.
Even if the Divine Skills cultivated were somewhat weaker than those of the Great Wilderness Martial Arts, they were still Divine Skills, capable of enhancing the strength of Taicang Martial Arts.
After giving some guidance on the Seal Rock Divine Skill, Li Xuan continued to immerse himself in his martial arts career. Whether or not Feng Yan could cultivate a Divine Skill depended entirely on his own talent.
"Since Jiang Buping has entered the threshold of Extreme Soul Martial Arts, it's a done deal. It's time to prepare for the Extreme Soul Martial Arts Divine Skills.
The cultivation methods of Extreme Soul Martial Arts naturally have their unique aspects, and even the weapons of Extreme Soul Warriors must be different.
It's time to compile the Extreme Soul Martial Codex and to compile the unique Divine Skills and other Dharma of Extreme Soul Martial Arts."
Li Xuan felt that for the sake of his martial arts career, he couldn't spare a moment. Although he seemed to be at ease, his time every day was fully scheduled.
Time slipped away in the compilation of martial arts.
"Your disciple Meng Chong encountered a siege led by a True King Heavenly Venerable and killed one at the cost of minor injuries. Your martial arts experience has improved," the Daoist Golden Book's feedback suddenly left Li Xuan taken aback.
Meng Chong encountered a siege and killed a person at the cost of minor injuries?
"What power has Meng Chong offended in the Nine Mountain Realm?"
Li Xuan was incredibly surprised.
Since the life-saving Jade Charm he gave had not been triggered, it meant that although Meng Chong had been besieged, his life wasn't in danger.
"Even the Immortal Heavenly Venerable has to preside over the Heavenly Grotto and cannot leave easily. Considering Meng Chong's defenses, True King Heavenly Venerables would find it difficult to inflict serious damage on him."
Li Xuan pondered for a moment and felt that Meng Chong's encounter seemed a bit unusual.
"Your disciple Meng Chong encountered a siege led by a True King Heavenly Venerable, killed one with a display of strength, and your martial arts experience has been enhanced," the message said.
As a result, over the following month, the Daoist Golden Book feedback on Meng Chong being besieged emerged several times.
Even one time, Meng Chong encountered an ambush, was struck by a severe poison, absorbed the poison with his golden body's acupoints, neutralized the poison, pretended to be on the verge of death, and counter-killed the attacker.
"With the toughness of Meng Chong's body, and the subtleties of his physique, ordinary severe poisons simply couldn't harm him. Moreover, he carried the detoxifying pills refined by Su Lingxiu. But to resort to such despicable tactics, what force did Meng Chong offend?"
Li Xuan couldn't help but frown.
With the situation developing like this, even the Immortal Heavenly Venerable might have to take action himself, right?
With Meng Chong's current strength, he certainly was no match for Immortal Heavenly Venerable. The Life-saving Jade Charm would necessarily be triggered.
After thinking for a while, Li Xuan inquired about the Nine Mountain Realm's powers, wishing to understand which power was skilled in using poison or in cultivating poison techniques.
To his surprise, there was no power in the Nine Mountain Realm that specialized in poison or in cultivating poison techniques.
There wasn't even a well-known martial artist who cultivated poison techniques.
Li Xuan was taken aback. Could it be that Meng Chong didn't go to the Nine Mountain Realm?
Feng Yan was an Immortal Heavenly Venerable with high status in the Nine Mountain Realm, so he was very familiar with the realm.
"Strong individuals grow amidst adversity. Meng Chong encountering such a crisis, his strength will also advance faster!"
Li Xuan thought about it. Meng Chong's crisis could also be an opportunity for him to improve himself.
With the Jade Charm in place, even if attacked by an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, he could still get through safely.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has broken through to the Physiognomy Realm, and your Void-breaking Realm has reached great accomplishment."
Xu Yan had broken through the Physiognomy Realm.
Li Xuan was overjoyed inside. His strength had finally improved.
The Void-breaking Realm had reached great accomplishment.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has broken through the Physiognomy Realm to the utmost, transformed into a Sacred Body of Mountains and Rivers, and you have obtained the Innate Mountains and Rivers Sacred Body."
Another transformation and sublimation, just as expected. This time, the transformation was into the Sacred Body of Mountains and Rivers.
"Sacred Bone, Sacred Body, flawlessly perfect, the talent has improved as well."
Li Xuan was filled with emotion.
Xu Yan's transformation this time had greatly increased both talent and strength. With the increase in talent, comprehending the Domain Martial Arts Law will be much easier.
"Mountains and Rivers Sacred Body..."
Li Xuan sensed within himself and felt as if his body was nurturing a range of mountains and rivers, as if he himself was transformed from them.
"Isn't this the embryonic form of the Martial Arts Domain?"
Li Xuan contemplated; he believed that after Xu Yan's transformation, the Sacred Body of Mountains and Rivers must have been similar, with a body like the image of mountains and rivers.
"The Domain Realm is not far off now."
Li Xuan took a breath of relief, having a hunch that Xu Yan would soon be able to fully grasp the Domain Cultivation Method.
Once he steps into the Domain Realm, it will be a tremendous transformation and enhancement.
As Xu Yan broke through to the Physiognomy Realm and sublimated to the utmost, his strength significantly increased, and the feedback continued to flood in.
```
"It's time to perfect the Martial Arts Techniques above the Domain Realm,"
Li Xuan felt that his next focus should be on the subsequent Martial Arts Techniques.
"This Red Cat is really capable,"
The Red Cat had gone to the Nine Mountain Realm some time ago, intending to recreate the Demon Clan in the Divine Realm, but with its current strength, the difficulty was considerable.
Unexpectedly, it hadn't been long since it went to the Nine Mountain Realm when, although the Demon Clan had not been established, it had already dominated the Spirit Beasts of Spiritual Sovereign Mountain.
Through the control of the Great Demon, Li Xuan could roughly grasp the situation of the Red Cat and was quite surprised that it had so quickly taken control of the Spirit Beasts of Spiritual Sovereign Mountain.
"The Wind Spirit Tiger is part of the Red Cat's clan and even a Spirit Beast King, but there is no such saying as 'two tigers cannot share one mountain,' rather due to the scarcity of tigers, tolerance towards their own kind is somewhat broader..."
Li Xuan somewhat understood how the Red Cat had hoodwinked the Wind Spirit Tiger.
"These two individuals..."
Li Xuan suddenly frowned, noticing that there were unusual individuals in both the Qimen Institute and the Alchemical Medical Institute, although they had entered with legitimate identities and were doing chores in both institutes.
But under the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Dao, Li Xuan realized at a glance that these two were spies, and highly adept ones at that.
Every move they made, every word and action, had no flaws at all.
After all, those who were arranged to enter the Qimen Institute and the Alchemical Medical Institute had all been personally vetted by Emperor Da Yue.
Being able to deceive Emperor Da Yue, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, showed how extraordinary these two were. The power behind them, capable of cultivating such spies, was certainly not simple.
"A late-stage True King Heavenly Venerable..."
Li Xuan looked towards the other people in the Qimen Institute and the Alchemical Medical Institute, including those sent by Tianwu Sect and Myriad Thunder Sect for trade and cooperation.
"Another one, from Tianwu Sect, and this person is from Myriad Thunder Sect... Are these spies from the Netherworld, or another force?"
Li Xuan was somewhat surprised, as the warriors from both Tianwu Sect and Myriad Thunder Sect who had been dispatched must be greatly trusted.
And yet such people turned out to be spies!
"They have practiced a Cultivation Technique adept at concealing their aura, designed for infiltration. This technique is deeply hidden; on the surface, they seem like warriors from Tianwu Sect and Myriad Thunder Sect, but in reality, they are from other forces..."
These spies seemed to practice the Cultivation Techniques of Tianwu Sect and Myriad Thunder Sect, but their Martial Arts foundations were not those of Tianwu Sect or Myriad Thunder Sect.
If not for Li Xuan's Eye of the Minor Heavenly Dao, it would not have been easy to detect this subtlety.
Even he found it difficult to detect, so Immortal Heavenly Venerables like the leader of Tianwu Sect would be even more incapable, unless the spies revealed themselves actively.
"Hiding deep enough, even infiltrating my area..."
Li Xuan pondered for a moment, deciding to uncover the spies' identities.
After all, they had infiltrated his disciple's territory, and as a master, he could not remain indifferent.
Calling over Shi'er, "These few individuals, go inform Feng Yan to take them down, have Emperor Da Yue inspect them closely."
Li Xuan ordered.
"Yes!"
Shi'er was stunned, then immediately nodded his head.
Upon receiving the order, Feng Yan did not ask the reasons; since the adept had commanded it, it was to be done.
Being the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, he made his move and captured those several spies.
"Lord Feng Yan, why have you seized us?"
One of the spies exclaimed anxiously and indignantly.
Su Lingxiu and Fang Hao were also astonished, wondering why Feng Yan had suddenly taken action against individuals.
"You know what you have done!"
Feng Yan sneered coldly.
The members of Earth Shadow felt a sinking feeling in their hearts; had they been exposed?
Impossible, with their skills in subterfuge, there was no way their cover could have been blown.
"I am from Tianwu Sect..."
"Shut your mouth."
Feng Yan proceeded to capture the individuals, which naturally alarmed Emperor Da Yue, as two of them had been vetted by him and assigned to handle miscellaneous tasks at the Qimen Institute and the Alchemical Medical Institute.
Cheng Zhan, representing Myriad Thunder Sect and overseeing the matter here, furrowed his brow, not understanding why Feng Yan was targeting Myriad Thunder Sect warriors.
"Brother Feng Yan, what is this about?"
Emperor Da Yue asked, frowning.
"Spies, take a good look,"
Feng Yan threw the people to Emperor Da Yue, adding, "The elder pointed them out, there can be no mistake!"
Emperor Da Yue, Cheng Zhan, and the person in charge from Tianwu Sect instantly turned pale.

chapters.title: Chapter 756 - 398 Meeting the Seductive Witch
chapters.content:
Upon hearing the word "spy," Emperor Da Yue's face changed drastically. Those sent to the Qimen Institute and Alchemical Medical Institute were highly trusted individuals.
Yet such a person turned out to be a spy—how many more spies could there be within Da Yue Country?
Even beside oneself, how many spies might be lurking?
Just the thought sent a chill through his heart.
"Your Majesty, we are not spies. We..."
Several Earth Shadow Members felt a sinking feeling in their hearts.
Their skills in infiltration were naturally extraordinary. To infiltrate to this extent, they had worked their way up step by step over many years.
Once suspected and scrutinized in detail, they definitely couldn't deceive the Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
"Whether you are or not, we will know soon!"
Emperor Da Yue's gaze was cold.
He absolutely trusted the advice of the esteemed elder.
Cheng Zhan and the head of the Tianwu Sect felt their hearts sink. One of them, a Sect Warrior stationed here, was one of the high-ranking members of the Sect.
If such a person was a spy, it was unimaginable how deeply the Sect had been infiltrated.
"Emperor Da Yue, this matter is of great importance. I must report to the Sect Master. Before that, not a single piece of information can be leaked," Cheng Zhan said gravely.
"This emperor has a grasp of the situation," nodded Emperor Da Yue.
Upon hearing this, the Earth Shadows knew they could not continue their subterfuge. In front of Emperor Da Yue and Feng Yan, both Immortal Heavenly Venerables, there was not the slightest chance of escape.
If they were subjected to a thorough investigation, the possibility of exposing their affiliated power existed.
Plop!
Suddenly, their life force abruptly weakened, their Divine Souls dissipated, and they perished on the spot, their actions decisive.
Even Emperor Da Yue, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, was too late to stop them.
Their method of self-annihilation was incredibly overbearing; once initiated, they perished instantly, their Divine Souls dissipated, making it impossible to reverse.
Apart from their Divine Souls dissipating and the ebbing of life force, their bodies quickly withered, as if dried by the wind.
All traces of their presence vanished without a trace.
Their purpose was to leave not a single clue behind!
By this point, the identity of the spies was confirmed.
Cheng Zhan and the person in charge of the Tianwu Sect could no longer sit still. They took it upon themselves to return to the Sect, where they would need to discreetly investigate each member to root out any other spies lurking within.
"Thank you for the guidance, senior!"
Emperor Da Yue respectfully bowed in the direction where Li Xuan was perceived to be.
Subsequently, he began to sweep through the Capital City of Da Yue. Before that, Emperor Da Yue and Sui Hongwu personally vetted their trusted Imperial Guards to ensure no issues. Only then did they dispatch them to secretly conduct searches.
"Master, how did you know they were spies?"
Su Lingxiu asked, her face full of curiosity.
Fang Hao also nodded, equally curious.
"Nothing can escape your teacher's eye," Li Xuan said with a smile, then added, "If you cultivate the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path, you would also be able to detect it."
"The Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path is too profound. Although I have some understanding, I'm still just a little bit short," Su Lingxiu said with a look of helplessness.
The Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path was mysterious, and she had yet to fully comprehend it.
"Let your teacher give you some more guidance," Li Xuan said with a sigh.
Now that he possessed the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path, how to cultivate it was clear in his mind, not something made up on the spot.
And so, Li Xuan instructed Su Lingxiu and Fang Hao on how to cultivate the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path.
However, he only gave guidance, not teaching exactly how to replicate it, because it was necessary for Su Lingxiu to comprehend it herself. Perhaps the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path she would eventually uncover could have its unique features.
An Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path that belonged solely to Alchemical Medical Martial Arts.
After giving instructions to Su Lingxiu and Fang Hao, the two of them went back to continue their contemplation. When they would be able to understand and cultivate it was uncertain.
Li Xuan continued to imprint the Dao Principles of the Book of Taicang on his mind, while the creation of content for the Divine Skill Martial Code was slightly reduced, freeing up more time to perfect the system of Extreme Soul Martial Arts, as well as the Martial Arts Techniques beyond the Domain Realm.
In the Nine Mountain Realm, Meng Chong emerged from a Heavenly Grotto, evading the encirclement and took refuge in a hidden spot, beginning to consolidate himself.
"They were not from the forces of the Qinghua state, nor one of the major powers of the Nine Mountain Realm. The question is, what power is targeting me?" Meng Chong wondered.
The masked people had numerous methods, insidiously ruthless, and many within the powers of the Nine Mountain Realm had the enemy's people hidden in their ranks.
After several assassinations, Meng Chong felt that next time, these masked people's power might prepare to trap him in a Heavenly Grotto.
"It's not safe to go to the Heavenly Grottos for now," Meng Chong mused, deciding to find a way to investigate the attackers' identities.
"The eldest disciple brother was last seen at Dahai Mountain. I should head there and see if I can encounter him," Meng Chong decided and, concealing himself, set off for Dahai Mountain.
...
"I've finally made the breakthrough," Xu Yan emerged from his secluded cultivation, his expression relaxed.
He broke through into the Physiognomy Realm.
Upon entering the Physiognomy Realm, his strength greatly increased.
With a mere thought, a Physiognomy emerged, with the Power of Domain Laws transforming into a landscape of mountains and rivers, within which a Golden Giant Dragon coiled.
Hum!
The Yin Yang Undying Sword manifested, seeming to envelop mountains and rivers. Xu Yan's figure disappeared into the midst of the Physiognomy, with only the powerful Physiognomy standing between heaven and earth.
"The fusion of Physiognomy and Divine Skills is truly mysterious. To harm me, one must first break through my Physiognomy. Only after breaking the Physiognomy will one truly face my original body.
"The power of Physiognomy, merged with the Principles of Heaven and Earth, in some ways, is somewhat similar to an Immortal Heavenly Venerable's fusion with heaven and earth."

chapters.title: Chapter 757 - 398 Meeting the Seductive Witch_2
chapters.content:
Xu Yan assessed his current strength, and the defense formed by Physiognomy and the Yin Yang Undying Sword was so formidable that ordinary Immortal Heavenly Venerables couldn't harm him.
"However, if I were to encounter an Immortal Heavenly Venerable as powerful as Emperor Da Yue, I would still be crushed in a single blow, but I am no longer afraid of weaker Immortal Heavenly Venerables like Sui Hongwu and Feng Yan."
Xu Yan suddenly felt a surge of confidence.
He was invincible below the Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
This was only the entrance to the Physiognomy Realm.
There were few among the Immortal Heavenly Venerables as strong as Emperor Da Yue, even in the Nine Mountain Realm.
Of course, the Immortal Heavenly Venerables who were weaker than Emperor Da Yue but stronger than Feng Yan still posed a significant danger to Xu Yan.
But now that he had advanced to this step in his realm, he truly had the confidence to escape even if he couldn't win.
"Once my Physiognomy Realm reaches Perfection, I will no longer fear an Immortal Heavenly Venerable like Emperor Da Yue, nor will I be affected by him."
Emperor Da Yue was a strong Immortal Heavenly Venerable, but certainly not the strongest, which he clearly understood himself.
"Once I enter the Void-breaking Realm, Immortal Heavenly Venerables will truly no longer be a threat to me."
Only by breaking through to the Void-breaking Realm can one truly ignore the threats of Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
The Power of Void-breaking, which belongs to the Void-breaking Realm, pierces through the domain of space, and in a sense, can precisely break through the Domain Power associated with Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
It's like having a control over the Domain Power, which in itself restrains the Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
"The Seductive Witch is in Thousand Layered Mountain, should I go have a look? With my current strength, I should be able to handle it."
Xu Yan pondered for a moment and decided to investigate the situation at Thousand Layered Mountain.
However, before heading to Thousand Layered Mountain, Xu Yan sent a message to Wan Tianlin to inquire about the progress of the investigation into the forces behind the scenes.
To Xu Yan's surprise, even the Wan Family hadn't found out the identity of the hidden forces.
"They hide deep indeed, now that I've shown myself, let's see if they continue to target me."
Xu Yan sneered to himself.
As long as they targeted him, he would have an easy time handling them by directly controlling their Divine Soul Consciousness with Destiny of the Heavenly Intent, and naturally, he would learn about the forces behind the scenes.
"However, to control and subdue Martial Artists at the late stage and peak of True King Heavenly Venerable, some weakening is needed first."
Xu Yan contemplated for a moment.
Even though he had broken through to the Physiognomy Realm and the power of Destiny of the Heavenly Intent had increased significantly, it was still difficult to hold True King Heavenly Venerables in the late stage and at the peak, as they could easily break free from the control of Destiny of the Heavenly Intent.
"Although Destiny of the Heavenly Intent is a remarkable Divine Skill, my cultivation is still not profound enough, I need to spend some time to enhance this skill further."
Divine Skills that involve controlling Divine Souls and consciousness are inherently challenging to use across realm boundaries.
"If Fifth Junior Brother were an initiate of Extreme Soul Martial Arts, with his Extreme Soul Power, using such Divine Skills would be much more formidable!"
Xu Yan thought of Jiang Ping, who cultivated the Extreme Soul Martial Arts, the ultimate path of Divine Souls, which naturally made Divine Skills and Dharma related to the Divine Soul stronger.
"Extreme Soul Martial Arts..."
Xu Yan was lost in thought, wondering if he too could reference the Extreme Soul Martial Arts Method to transform his Primordial Spirit and make it purer?
If the Primordial Spirit truly attained purity and became invulnerable to all evil, it would definitely be another transformation.
Xu Yan had some enlightenment in his heart.
"Still not found the person?"
At the boundary between Dahai Mountain and Thousand Layered Mountain, two True King Heavenly Venerables met.
"No!"
The respondent looked troubled.
That Xu Yan was truly adept at hiding; once he went into hiding, he could not be found no matter what.
Without finding the person, how could they complete the mission?
How to lure the person into the Heavenly Grotto?
To lure Xu Yan to the Heavenly Grotto, they had deliberately prepared a Seven Wonders Divine Flower.
That was a real heavenly material treasure, coveted by True King Heavenly Venerables, let alone Immortal Heavenly Venerables who would even fight to snatch it.
If they couldn't lure Xu Yan to the Heavenly Grotto, their incompetence would render them useless, and without any reward, they might even face a graveless death!
"Should we release news of the treasure? If Xu Yan discovers it, he will surely enter the Heavenly Grotto."
"The treasure is so wonderful, once news spreads, even Immortal Heavenly Venerables would enter, how could the plan proceed?"
Both True Kings were distressed.
Suddenly, one of the True King Heavenly Venerables' eyes lit up, "Is that Xu Yan?"
"Indeed, he seems to be heading to Thousand Layered Mountain, let's move quickly, don't let him spot anything off; since he has appeared, things will be easier!"
The two True Kings were overjoyed.
Without betraying any emotion, like True King Heavenly Venerables merely passing by, they conversed in low voices while continuing to move forward.
"In the Seductive Witch's Heavenly Grotto, there seems to be a suspected divine treasure; is it true?"
"Indeed, it is said to be the Seven Wonders Divine Flower, a divine object of Heaven and Earth that can enhance the Divine Soul and purify the foundation of Martial Arts. By settling the mind and concentrating the spirit, it allows one to comprehend the profound mysteries of Martial Arts. Even an Immortal Heavenly Venerable would be green with envy."
"With such a divine object, our chance to break through to become Immortal Heavenly Venerables has arrived."
"That's right, this matter is secret and must not be disclosed. This Heavenly Grotto is just a minor one, not many pay attention to it..."
The two True King Heavenly Venerables, pretending not to have noticed Xu Yan's traces, whispered as they stealthily moved on.
Unintentionally, they revealed the existence of the Seven Wonders Divine Flower treasure within the Seductive Witch's Heavenly Grotto.
"The Seductive Witch's Heavenly Grotto in Thousand Layered Mountain? Is the Seductive Witch here?"
Xu Yan moved silently, having long noticed the two True King Heavenly Venerables. He intentionally exposed a trace of his presence, wanting to see these two people's reaction.
To his surprise, they disclosed the information about the treasure, seemingly luring him to the Heavenly Grotto.
"The Seven Wonders Divine Flower..."
Xu Yan was somewhat tempted; this Seven Wonders Divine Flower clearly was a valuable item. The enhancement of the Divine Soul was secondary; what he really cared about was that the Seven Wonders Divine Flower could help a Martial Artist to experience the marvels of Martial Arts.
Even Immortal Heavenly Venerables were moved by it, clearly showing the high rank of the Seven Wonders Divine Flower, which was also of great use to him at his current stage.
The Blood Heart Fruit could make one more receptive to comprehending Cultivation Techniques in a short period, and since the Seven Wonders Divine Flower was of a higher rank than the Blood Heart Fruit, perhaps it indeed could help him grasp the essence of the Domain Martial Arts Law.
"Even if I can't fully grasp the Domain Cultivation Method, it can still help me organize my own Martial Arts, comprehend them, and even cultivate more powerful Divine Skills..."
Xu Yan was moved; he followed the two True Kings quietly from not too far behind.
The two True Kings conversed softly, exchanging covert glances, unsure whether Xu Yan had heard their "secret."
After all, Xu Yan's presence was secretive; if it weren't for a coincidental glimpse earlier, they wouldn't have been able to detect him.
The two of them used this to their advantage, letting Xu Yan think he was undetected and had accidentally overheard such a secret.
"Speak cautiously, lest someone overhears."
Towards the end of their conversation, as if suddenly vigilant, they began to look around, making it seem like they were preventing eavesdropping.
