"Don't worry, unless it's an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, who can escape our senses?"
"Makes sense!"
In secret, however, they communicated through voice transmission, "Where is Xu Yan?"
"Haven't found him. He hasn't heard our conversation, has he?"
"Impossible. We didn't notice him, so Xu Yan must have noticed us for sure."
The two harbored some trepidation. What if Xu Yan hadn't heard the secret?
Or, what if he was unmoved by it?
The two True King Heavenly Venerables were inwardly vexed but dared not stop, as they had to keep moving to avoid revealing any flaws to Xu Yan.
"Eh, why does it feel a bit off?"
Suddenly, one of the True King Heavenly Venerables spoke up with a start.
For some reason, it felt as if they had entered a new Domain.
"This is bad!"
Suddenly, his expression drastically changed.
But it was too late. Amid the rippling waves, a circle of Heaven and Earth Laws surrounded them, with Golden Dragons coiling and Mountain and River hiding them from view.
In that instant, a hand landed on the top of his head.
Hum!
In a daze, his Divine Soul stirred, an overwhelming Destiny of the Heavenly Intent left no room for resistance.
Xu Yan had finally decided to take action. The Seductive Witch posed a significant threat, but the Seven Wonders Divine Flower was too rare, and potentially a divine item from beyond the Domain.
If the Seductive Witch meant to offer it to him, how could he not accept?
It was time to meet the Seductive Witch! However, before that, some preparations were necessary, like taking control of the two True King Heavenly Venerables.
The strength of the True King Heavenly Venerables in their later stages was not weak; controlling them would require the use of some methods.
Xu Yan's Mountain and River Sword Intent blended into the environment, lying in wait for the two True King Heavenly Venerables to enter before suddenly striking, catching them off guard.
In an instant, Xu Yan controlled one of the True King Heavenly Venerables with the Destiny of the Heavenly Intent, while the other, sensing something amiss, roared angrily, his aura bursting forth, trying to break free from the constraints of the Mountain and River Sword Intent.

chapters.title: Chapter 758 - 399 Seductive Witch: This Divine Soul Taste is Too Spicy
chapters.content:
The battle ended quickly, after Xu Yan successfully controlled one person, he had the controlled True King Heavenly Venerable launch a sneak attack on another who was preparing to flee.
In just a few breaths, the True King Heavenly Venerable was injured, and even more so torn apart by Xu Yan's Sudden Wind Sword Intent that ravaged his Divine Soul.
Once the Divine Soul was injured and weakened further, Destiny of the Heavenly Intent easily took control of it.
"Speak, fully disclose everything."
After controlling two people, Xu Yan then ordered.
Compared to the Seductive Witch's charm, Destiny of the Heavenly Intent was evidently more mystical and exceptional. The two True King Heavenly Venerables could not resist the inscrutable Divine Soul manipulation.
Moreover, even though they were controlled, the charm of the Seductive Witch had not disappeared and still existed.
Even the Seductive Witch herself could not detect that the people she controlled had been taken over by Xu Yan, who now truly commanded them at his will.
This was also the intention behind Xu Yan taking control of these two people: at a critical moment, he could strike unexpectedly and cause trouble for the Seductive Witch.
The two True King Heavenly Venerables fully disclosed all the Seductive Witch's plans.
Xu Yan felt inwardly pleased, the Seven Wonders Divine Flower was actually real; the Seductive Witch had indeed spent a great deal to bait him.
Now that he had confirmed the existence of the Seven Wonders Divine Flower, he was even more determined to meet the Seductive Witch.
"That Witch's Heavenly Grotto is incapable of accommodating powers comparable to that of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, thus even if the Seductive Witch is strong, she will not reach the level of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
"However, the power of the Seductive Witch is somewhat special and should not be viewed ordinarily. Even a common Immortal Heavenly Venerable, if careless, could fall prey to her tactics."
Xu Yan pondered deeply, silently assessing the situation.
The power of the Seductive Witch was quite special, and her most terrifying aspect was the ability to devour the force of the Divine Soul.
"The Divine Soul is one thing, but my Martial Arts Primordial Spirit is not comparable to the Divine Soul. To think of devouring the Martial Arts Primordial Spirit with the Seductive Witch's power—which isn't even at the level of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable—is sheer delusion."
Xu Yan did not take the Seductive Witch's soul-devouring power seriously.
After all, devouring the Divine Soul of someone at the same level, even with the Seductive Witch's gift, was not an easy feat.
And her ability was absolutely ineffective against the Martial Arts Primordial Spirit.
"My Primordial Spirit has defensive power and I do not fear it. If I take her by surprise with the Sudden Wind Sword Intent posing as a Divine Soul, and she devours it...
Xu Yan mused thoughtfully about how to disguise the Sudden Wind Sword Intent as a Divine Soul for the Seductive Witch to ingest, which posed a challenge.
"There's always a way..."
Xu Yan deliberated for a while and came up with a plan.
"Gather all your people, one by one..."
Xu Yan looked towards the two True King Heavenly Venerables and commanded.
"Yes!"
The two True King Heavenly Venerables hurriedly answered with reverence.
In the depths of their consciousness, they were still lucid, feeling a tingling sensation on their scalps. Xu Yan's methods were far too bewildering.
Intuition told the two that the beauty in the Witch's Heavenly Grotto would probably suffer a great loss this time.
Xu Yan was not in a hurry to go to the Witch's Heavenly Grotto but took control of the True King Heavenly Venerables sent out by the Seductive Witch to search for him, one by one using Destiny of the Heavenly Intent.
These True King Heavenly Venerables had no idea that their comrades would betray them and were completely unguarded. Suddenly ambushed, they were controlled and easily subdued by Xu Yan.
After controlling them one by one, Xu Yan then proceeded to figure out the details of the Witch's Heavenly Grotto, to confirm if it truly could not accommodate external powers at the level of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
After some investigation, it was finally confirmed that the Seductive Witch's strength within the Heavenly Grotto did not reach the level of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
Her power was peculiar and tricky for Taicang Martial Artists to defend against, but that was all.
For Xu Yan, this was not a problem.
"You are in great danger now; your Divine Souls could be devoured at any moment. I have a Dharma that might just protect your Divine Souls from harm at the crucial moment."
Xu Yan said to the True King Heavenly Venerables he had controlled.
The Seductive Witch would not spare these True King Heavenly Venerables; she would eventually devour their Divine Souls.
If so, then he could plan accordingly.
Subsequently, a clump of Sudden Wind Sword Intent merged into the Divine Soul of each True King Heavenly Venerable, integrating seamlessly, indistinguishable from their own.
Since the Sudden Wind Sword Intent was designed for the Divine Soul, it could naturally blend in with it. Especially since these True King Heavenly Venerables actively blended the Sudden Wind Sword Intent into themselves, it went undetected.
Meanwhile, Xu Yan ingested a few pills, infusing them with the Sudden Wind Sword Intent and concealing them within his body.
These pills, refined by Su Lingxiu, were called False Soul Pills, carrying the aura of the Divine Soul and capable of assuming its form for deceiving others.
Of course, they also had the effect of nurturing the Primordial Spirit.
Xu Yan thought of using the Sudden Wind Sword Intent to fake a Divine Soul to fool the Seductive Witch, and the False Soul Pills would be perfect for the job.
"What strange and unusual pills, sometimes they really can come in handy," Xu Yan mused inwardly.
His junior sister had refined too many pills, with a variety of bizarre and special effects. Now the False Soul Pills would come into play.
"What will happen when the Seductive Witch ingests the Sudden Wind Sword Intent?"
Xu Yan was filled with anticipation.
Everything was ready; it was time to meet the Seductive Witch!
Thousand Layered Mountain, Witch's Heavenly Grotto.
At this moment, the Heavenly Grotto looked like a beautiful lady's boudoir, exquisitely arranged, fragrant and charming, with pink flowers regularly placed.

chapters.title: Chapter 759 - 399 Seductive Witch: This Divine Soul Taste is Too Spicy _2
chapters.content:
In front of the small building, there bloomed a radiant seven-colored flower, surrounded by a halo that lent it a sense of enigma.
"Where is the person?"
The Seductive Witch lay languidly on the elegant bed of the small building, surrounded by several beautiful maids attending to her.
Yet these maids were no longer the same people they once were.
Several True Kings knelt outside the small building, their bodies trembling slightly, exuding palpable unease.
"We have already located his tracks and are figuring out how to lure him here. I believe it won't be long before he enters."
Spoke one True King Heavenly Venerable, his voice shaking.
"I hope so, otherwise there's no need for trash to exist."
The Seductive Witch licked her luscious lips with her tongue, eyeing the several True King Heavenly Venerables as if they were delicious food.
"He's coming, Xu Yan is preparing to enter the Heavenly Grotto!"
Two True King Heavenly Venerables announced with joy, entering from outside of the Heavenly Grotto.
"Good, very good!"
The Seductive Witch's eyes shimmered with delight and a hint of chill crossed her seductive eyes.
"Didn't you say Xu Yan was on his way here to the Heavenly Grotto?"
A day later, the Seductive Witch said with some anger.
"Xu Yan is cautious and is investigating all around. We dare not get too close for fear of arousing his suspicion. I believe in the next few days he will enter the Heavenly Grotto."
Another True King Heavenly Venerable said, his voice trembling.
"It better be so!"
The Seductive Witch took a deep breath, a cold light flickering in her eyes, deep in thought.
Another day passed.
The Seductive Witch became somewhat impatient when a True King Heavenly Venerable came flying back in haste.
"Xu Yan has arrived!"
"Good, prepare to seal off all the exits from the Heavenly Grotto!"
Immediately, the Seductive Witch commanded.
A pink radiance suffused the Heavenly Grotto. The True King Heavenly Venerables, following the Seductive Witch's instructions, hid themselves within the pink light, concealing their figures.
"We mustn't let him become alarmed!"
The Seductive Witch contemplated before the pink light throughout the Grotto began to retract gradually.
At that moment, the area near the Heavenly Cave Entrance looked just like any other ordinary cave, with nothing out of the ordinary.
"Your disciple is in my hands; let's see if you come to save him, and how you'll come to his rescue!"
The Seductive Witch gritted her teeth inwardly.
Xu Yan arrived at the Heavenly Cave Entrance, with a fluctuation of aura upon him, lowering his power to that of someone just entering the Divine Skill Realm.
"The Seven Wonders Divine Flower is mine."
Xu Yan stepped into the Heavenly Grotto, pretending not to notice the concealed True King Heavenly Venerables. He moved cautiously toward the depths of the grotto.
Upon reaching the elegant building, he saw the Seven Wonders Divine Flower.
Where he was originally cautious, his speed suddenly surged, and in an instant, he reached the Seven Wonders Divine Flower and picked it with a swift hand movement.
"Kid, since you're here, don't even think about leaving!"
The Seductive Witch stepped out from the small building.
"Is it you?"
Xu Yan pretended to be startled and leaped back as if he wanted to flee far away.
"Giggle, am I that frightening? You want to run away as soon as you see me? You've got the Seven Wonders Divine Flower now; won't you stay and play with me?"
Laughed the Seductive Witch alluringly, pink light wafting out, filling the entire Heavenly Grotto with pink.
At the Heavenly Cave Entrance, the True King Heavenly Venerables began to appear and slowly moved closer, sealing off any escape routes.
"What do you want?"
Xu Yan's expression became grave, sword in hand, ready for a desperate fight, yet inwardly he breathed a sigh of relief. He had acquired the Seven Wonders Divine Flower smoothly, and from the moment he entered the Heavenly Grotto, he had feigned caution to deceive the Seductive Witch and secure the divine flower.
Everything was going well; next was to turn the tables on the Seductive Witch.
The pink light was diffuse, and the Seductive Witch's form grew even more alluring, seemingly capable of stirring primal desires.
This was especially true for vigorous young men, who were prone to lose themselves in such charms.
"What is this power of allure?"
Xu Yan was inwardly shocked.
No wonder those True King Heavenly Venerables had been ensnared; the Seductive Witch's power of charm was incredibly potent and peculiar.
"But it has no effect on me!"
On the surface, Xu Yan appeared to be struggling to resist the allure, guarding his mind, but inside he was utterly calm.
The marvel of the Wisdom Sword Realm had long shielded him from demonic obstacles, rendering all illusions ineffective against him. The Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path could see through falsehoods, and thus he could also ignore the Seductive Witch's charm power.
"Little brother, how do you find your sister?"
The Seductive Witch's eyes became even more bright and luminous, her aura fragrant and enchanting. No matter which type of woman Xu Yan fancied, in his eyes, she was that very type.
The epitome of beauty, how many in the world could resist being captivated?
Let alone a young man like Xu Yan.
"Do not think you can beguile me!"
With beads of sweat on his forehead, Xu Yan let out a low growl and slashed with his sword.
The sword light was sharp and lethal, unparalleled in its power to kill.
The Seductive Witch raised her slender fingers, flicked them with a ding, and effortlessly deflected the attack.
"Boy, truly the disciple of that detestable man, you do have some exceptional abilities. To have remained resolute up to now, I am curious to see how long you can last!"
The Seductive Witch sneered.
Xu Yan's ability to maintain his composure up until now, without completely succumbing, was indeed worthy of a peerless genius, far surpassing those True King Heavenly Venerables.
"Hmph!"
Xu Yan snorted coldly, the veins on his forehead bulging as he roared softly. Sword light swirled around him in waves, the layered Sword Intent acting like surging tides, enveloping him as he fought off the allure.
At the same time, he shifted his figure, instantly changing position, as if trying to escape.
"Once you're here, don't even think about leaving. Let your master come to save you."
The Seductive Witch took a few moments to appreciate Xu Yan's technique of shifting and changing positions.
"You can't keep me here!"
Xu Yan changed position once more, and this time, he managed to escape from the blockade of numerous True King Heavenly Venerables and headed straight for the Heavenly Cave Entrance.
"Useless fools!"
The Seductive Witch's brow rose as she looked at the assembly of True King Heavenly Venerables, thinking that these useless beings were of no value now that Xu Yan had arrived.
"Little brother, be a good boy and obey. You can't get away!"
A slender hand suddenly reached out.
Xu Yan swung his sword to strike, but the slender hand coiled around him, capturing both him and his sword.
"What a handsome little brother!"
The Seductive Witch's eyes shone brightly as she stared at Xu Yan, her gaze seemingly possessed of an enchanting allure.
Xu Yan gritted his teeth and persisted, struggling to maintain his composure, looking like he could be captivated at any moment.
"Interesting!"
The Seductive Witch's smile was blooming like a flower.
"Go and spread the word, Xu Yan is in my hands, and we'll see how his master can save him!"
The Seductive Witch pointed at one of the True King Heavenly Venerables and gave her order.
"Yes!"
The True King Heavenly Venerable hurriedly bowed and withdrew respectfully before quickly leaving the Heavenly Grotto.
The other True King Heavenly Venerables' expressions changed slightly, a sense of unease creeping into their hearts, but they were unable to struggle or resist.
"Come one by one, don't resist, okay."
The Seductive Witch spoke with a smile.
One after another, the True King Heavenly Venerables stepped forward, and with a gentle opening of her mouth, their Divine Souls were sucked out and ingested by her.
Thump!
The True King Heavenly Venerable whose Divine Soul had been taken was left as an empty shell without its Divine Soul.
Once all the Divine Souls of the True King Heavenly Venerables were absorbed by her, the Seductive Witch's delicate eyebrows furrowed slightly.
For some reason, she felt that these Divine Souls were somewhat different.
The taste of the Divine Souls seemed to have a sensation that was... almost spicy?
"You can persevere until now? That is also rare. I'll take your Divine Soul. Your Divine Soul is now with me. Let's see how your master will rescue you!
"If he wants to retrieve his disciple's Divine Soul, let's see what he has to offer in exchange.
"Little brother, remember one piece of advice, the rarer the treasure, the harder it is to get, and there's always a certain risk involved.
"Of course, that assumes you have a next time."
The Seductive Witch's smile was radiant, her delicate white hand caressing Xu Yan's cheek, she sighed, "Such a handsome little brother, I could play with this body for many years!"
With her mouth open, she performed the Divine Spirit Soul Force devouring.
At this moment, Xu Yan felt a unique force that seemed to envelop and bind his Primordial Spirit, trying to extract it from his body.
However, since he cultivated Martial Arts and not the Taicang Martial Arts, he had formed a Martial Arts Primordial Spirit. This suction force actually could not wrap around and bind his Primordial Spirit, and the power of the Spirit Pedestal could keep this suction at bay.
"Here it comes!"
But Xu Yan was already prepared, infusing the fake Divine Soul created from the combination of the decoy soul pill and the Sudden Wind Sword Intent into the suction force, allowing the Seductive Witch to absorb it into her body.
As the Seductive Witch took it in, she paused, puzzled by the formidable nature of the young man's Divine Soul.
Upon reflection, she let it go, thinking it was only natural for the disciple of such a powerful being to be special.
"What's up with this kid's Divine Soul? It's a bit too spicy. What kind of Divine Soul is this? I've devoured countless Divine Souls, but never before a spicy one!"
The Seductive Witch was somewhat baffled. The taste of his Divine Soul was too spicy!

chapters.title: Chapter 760 - 400 My master can blow you up, so can I, Xu Yan
chapters.content:
The Seductive Witch, capable of devouring Divine Souls, relishes in feasting on the souls of Martial Artists. Each time she inhaled a soul, it wasn't digested immediately but rather stored for gradual enjoyment.
However, as soon as a Divine Soul entered her mouth, she could taste its flavor, a gift unique to the Seductive Witch.
For the Seductive Witch, the process of inhaling Divine Souls was a delightful pleasure, allowing her to savor their deliciousness and feel the satisfaction of consumption.
Having consumed the souls of several True King Heavenly Venerables, she found their souls a bit spicy, yet this too was a delectable treat.
Yet, when she absorbed Xu Yan's Divine Soul, the Seductive Witch was perplexed. Why was this lad's soul so exceedingly spicy?
Moreover, Xu Yan's soul seemed overwhelmingly mighty, like a persistent wind that kept blowing in, giving an impression of being endless.
"If this lad's soul is this spicy, his master's must be utterly inedible, certainly unpalatable!"
The Seductive Witch thought to herself.
At this moment, Xu Yan was doing his best to let more of his Sudden Wind Sword Intent be absorbed into the Seductive Witch's body, hence the sensation that his vast soul was inexhaustible.
"My Sudden Wind Sword Intent, merged into the false soul pill, is something the Seductive Witch has never encountered. She won't realize it at all,"
Xu Yan thought to himself.
Of course, what he didn't know was that because of the witch's unique talent for Divine Souls, although she hadn't realized it was a false soul, she could feel that it was unreasonably spicy.
The Sudden Wind Sword Intent was ultimately a Sword Intent aimed at Divine Souls. Even though Xu Yan had made it gentle and infused it with his soul, other Martial Artists would likely not detect any difference.
But the Seductive Witch was different, hence she found the soul somewhat spicy.
Indeed, just as Xu Yan had expected, the Seductive Witch, having never encountered such a situation and underestimating it, did not suspect that the soul concealed any deadly intent.
She simply thought that as a mighty disciple, Xu Yan's refined soul differed from ordinary Martial Artists, which seemed understandable.
The Seductive Witch continued to devour Xu Yan's soul until she felt it weakening, nearly drained, and she mused that this lad's soul was worth six or seven True King Heavenly Venerables' souls.
Yet, what was his actual strength?
"Quite an extraordinary method of soul refinement."
The Seductive Witch sighed internally.
As Xu Yan lay lifeless, his eyes still wide open with shock and anger, he appeared to have been reduced to a mere empty shell.
And as his soul was drained, his empty shell instinctively collapsed, falling into the embrace of the Seductive Witch.
"Handsome boy, even as an empty shell, I'm fond of you."
With a smile on her face, the Seductive Witch finally captured the lad.
His Divine Soul was swallowed inside her, his flesh in her hands—what could his master possibly do now?
"Even though my true body can't come here, let's see what price you're willing to pay to save your disciple. If you kill me, your disciple's Divine Soul will dissipate as well."
The Seductive Witch was brimming with confidence at this moment.
Although her true body couldn't descend and her avatar was limited in strength, she wasn't a match for that person, but with her disciple inside her, if she died, his Divine Soul would fade away with her.
"I don't believe you can reassemble your disciple's scattered Divine Soul. If you truly have that power, I, the Seductive Witch, will no longer provoke you!"
Inside, she sneered.
Once a soul entered her body and perished with her power, it was utterly erased from existence, impossible to gather again even with the capacity to pierce the skies and traverse the earth.
If someone could indeed do it, she would admit defeat and would never dream of opposing them again.
Anyone capable of such a feat was beyond imagination in strength and was an enemy she could not contend with.
"Little brother, I will treasure you..."
Looking down at Xu Yan, the Seductive Witch's smile grew even more enchanting.
Thump!
Suddenly, her smile froze on her face, replaced by an expression of disbelief.
A sword had pierced into her body.
The terrifying Sword Intent ravaged through her, decimating her form.
"You..."
In a mix of shock and anger, the Seductive Witch then felt a violent power wreak havoc within her. It was as though a destructive storm had spontaneously formed inside her.
That was Xu Yan's spicy Divine Soul, which at this very moment transformed into a frightening Sword Intent!
Not only that, but even the Divine Souls of the several True King Heavenly Venerables she had consumed now turned into a storm, wreaking havoc within her.
Thump!
Sword light burst forth from the Seductive Witch's body, the internal Sword Intent seemingly sentient, wreaking immense havoc on her body from the inside out, rampaging uncontrollably.
"How have you..."
The Seductive Witch was stunned, the Xu Yan whose soul she had absorbed was now opening his eyes with a sword piercing into her.
"I have double souls!"
Xu Yan stated earnestly.
After a successful blow, Xu Yan's figure vanished instantly from her embrace, followed by a black sword light that cleaved down toward the Seductive Witch, as if to annihilate everything!
Boom!
Enraged, the Seductive Witch watched as the people in the small building collapsed, all their souls instantly returning to her.
A pink radiance bloomed, with a pink crescent-shaped blade beginning to emerge.
However, the Sword Intent inside her wrecked havoc wildly, forming into a sword that kept piercing through her body, inflicting continuous damage upon her.
"Where is your sword burrowing to!"
The Seductive Witch shouted in anger.
Roar!
Xu Yan struck with his palm, and the Golden Giant Dragon roared furiously, with a terrifying might echoing as if an enraged True Dragon sought to perish together with his enemy!

chapters.title: Chapter 761 - 400 My master can blow you up, so can I, Xu Yan_2
chapters.content:
Divine Skills, True Dragon Rage!
Before the Seductive Witch's pink crescent blade could make a move, the True Dragon Rage blasted forth, and with a 'pfft,' her body exploded into a burst of pink radiance and dissipated.
The refined small building, all of its arrangements, including the corpses of True King Heavenly Venerables, also vanished into nothing!
The body that the Seductive Witch had descended into did not possess the power of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, and with the Sudden Wind Sword Intent invading it, it had already suffered heavy damage from the start. How could it possibly have any strength left to resist?
"If my master can blow you up, I, Xu Yan, can also blow you up!"
Xu Yan said with a cold laugh.
"Xu Yan, you despicable and shameless little bastard, you deserve to die!"
An angry roar echoed in the Heavenly Grotto.
Hum!
Suddenly, a pink light emerged above the Heavenly Grotto.
Xu Yan moved, appearing below the pink light, with Sword Intent surging. Everything in the Heavenly Grotto transformed into swords, layer upon layer, setting up a Sword Array.
A pink figure was descending.
That was the Seductive Witch, descending into a new body.
Roar!
Xu Yan struck out with a palm, the Golden Dragon roared and killed its way up, taking advantage of the fact that this body had not yet fully formed, and blew it up with a direct strike!
"You shameless brat, just you wait!"
The Seductive Witch exploded with rage, always used to being the one laying traps for others. Who would have thought that today she would be outwitted by a youngster?
That was just too much to bear!
"After swallowing one of my Divine Souls, I, Xu Yan, have made an enemy of you. Sooner or later, I will beat you until you beg for mercy!"
Xu Yan said coldly.
With an expression of anger and unwillingness, it was as if he truly had twin Divine Souls and one was devoured by the Seductive Witch.
The figure of the Seductive Witch continued to materialize, trying to descend once more, only to be blasted back by Xu Yan with another palm strike as it was halfway descended and not yet fully formed.
"Nonsense about twin Divine Souls, Xu Yan, you little bastard, daring to scheme against me, both you and your master just wait, the enemy of my life from now on will be the two of you!"
The furious voice of the Seductive Witch transmitted over.
Hum!
A pink crescent blade chopped down, aiming to kill Xu Yan.
Boom!
With a single thought from Xu Yan, a torrent of ten thousand swords raged out, the Sword Array emitting a strong light, annihilating the attack!
"I, Xu Yan, have condensed an Origin Divine Soul, and I have also cultivated a Sword Path Divine Soul. This is the reason for my extraordinary natural talent on the Sword Dao. You devoured my Sword Path Divine Soul, we now have a grudge. No matter where you hide, I will find you!"
Xu Yan growled resentfully.
Of course, the matter about the fake Divine Soul couldn't be let known to the Seductive Witch, what if there was a chance to trap her again in the future?
Why did the Divine Soul that entered the Seductive Witch's body have surging Sword Intent, and why did it turn into a rampaging sword? Because that was a Sword Path Divine Soul!
This way, it all made sense.
"Your Sword Path Divine Soul?"
The Seductive Witch was doubtful but thought about the Divine Soul that indeed seemed quite special, turning into surging Sword Intent—it kind of made sense.
After all, it was a power avatar of hers that devoured the Divine Soul. Even separated by the Domain Barrier and connected to the avatar, both consciousness and sensation could be felt by the main body.
But after all, it was not the main body, so she was somewhat uncertain now.
From Xu Yan's resentful tone, as if he had suffered a great loss, she couldn't help but believe what Xu Yan said.
That Divine Soul, so potent and pungent, was originally a Sword Path Divine Soul?!
"I, Sword God Xu Yan, have condensed a Sword Path Divine Soul. Isn't that the most natural thing? Seductive Witch, your Seven Wonders Divine Flower cannot compensate for my loss. This enmity must be avenged!"
Xu Yan said coldly.
Upon hearing this, the Seductive Witch suddenly felt much better. Although she had been schemed against, and even though she had lost a power avatar, she had ultimately destroyed one of Xu Yan's Sword Path Divine Souls.
"If you want revenge, I, the Seductive Witch, am waiting for you. One day, both you and your master will fall into my hands!"
The Seductive Witch sneered.
"You're still not worthy of my master making a move!"
Xu Yan said disdainfully.
"Hmph!"
The Seductive Witch snorted coldly.
Above the Heavenly Grotto, the pink radiance began to fade, the Seductive Witch was no longer planning to descend.
After all, with Xu Yan blocking below, she was unable to descend into a stronger avatar. Trying to descend into the Heavenly Grotto once again was simply not achievable.
Xu Yan's lips curved up slightly, his trip had been very fruitful, he had obtained the Seven Wonders Divine Flower, and he had also exploded the Seductive Witch's avatar.
"Seductive Witch, I have a feeling we'll meet again," he murmured to himself.
The power of the Seductive Witch was undoubtedly immense, and Xu Yan felt that even if he were to break through to the Void-breaking Realm, he would probably still be no match for her.
"The Domain Realm is a major leap, and even though it's not quite like the Seductive Witch's true body, it won't be much less," he thought with excitement. Xu Yan was already in the Physiognomy Realm, not far from the Void-breaking Realm.
As for the Domain Realm, although he hadn't grasped it yet, with the Seven Wonders Divine Flower in hand, he should almost be able to comprehend the Domain Martial Arts Law.
With that thought, Xu Yan glanced at his own Mountain and River Sacred Body, as if struck by an epiphany.
With the body as the domain and his Mountain and River Sacred Body, seemingly capable of harboring all living things, in some sense, wasn't it also the embryonic form of the domain?
Without delaying in the Heavenly Grotto, since the Seven Wonders Divine Flower was in hand, naturally, he needed to find a place to consume it, to perceive his own martial path, to fathom the Domain Martial Arts Law, and to cultivate Divine Skills.
After coming out of the Heavenly Grotto, the True King Heavenly Venerable sent by the Seductive Witch Sect to deliver a message was waiting, and with the annihilation of the Seductive Witch's avatar, he had awoken from his bewitched state.
But, he was still controlled by the Destiny of the Heavenly Intent Divine Skill.
"You continue to hold command here," Xu Yan instructed.
"Yes!" The True King Heavenly Venerable nodded.
Just as Xu Yan was about to leave, eager to use the Seven Wonders Divine Flower, the True King Heavenly Venerable suddenly spoke, "Young Master Xu, there is something I'm not sure if I should say."
"What is it, just say it!" Xu Yan's brows raised, his first thought was whether this True King Heavenly Venerable knew about the powers instigating conflict between him and Wan Tianlin.
"During the days of your disappearance, someone had been looking for you..." The True King Heavenly Venerable pondered for a bit, then relayed some information they had learned while searching for Xu Yan.
"The person who was looking for information about you seems to have been pursued by some force, and then there was no further news. We don't know the specifics," the True King Heavenly Venerable concluded.
Xu Yan's gaze turned cold, and from the vague information from the True King Heavenly Venerable, he was certain that the person searching for him was Meng Chong!
And Meng Chong was being pursued by a mysterious force?
"I understand!" Xu Yan kept his composure and took a step forward, using Divine Skills to vanish in an instant, disappearing from the spot.
"Which power is pursuing my second junior brother? Could it be, the one instigating against the Wan Family behind the scenes?" Xu Yan speculated about the mysterious instigating force right away.
If one of the major forces of the Nine Mountain Realm was pursuing Meng Chong, the True King Heavenly Venerable would surely know, and since he knew it was some unknown force, it clearly wasn't one of the few well-known major forces in the Nine Mountain Realm.
"I wonder if Wan Tianlin has found any clues." Xu Yan could only set aside his plans to retreat and consume the Seven Wonders Divine Flower temporarily, returning to Dahai Mountain to contact Wan Tianlin to inquire about the behind-the-scenes force as well as to look for Meng Chong's whereabouts.
"If I show myself, the people behind the scenes will come after me, right?" Xu Yan thought, and after returning to Dahai Mountain, he immediately revealed his location, strolling through a city, waiting for his attackers to come knocking.
Sure enough.
He had just revealed his whereabouts when two figures appeared.
Wearing Ferocious Masks, their presence powerful, Martial Artists at the peak of the True King Heavenly Venerable.
"Are you the ones who want to fuel my hatred for the Wan Family?" Xu Yan asked indifferently.
Boom!
The two masked figures, without a word, launched a vicious assault as soon as they acted, clearly intending to put Xu Yan to death.
"Hmph!" Xu Yan snorted coldly, his Physiognomy emerged, the Power of Domain Laws descended, and in the blink of an eye, the Power of the Domain Laws turned into the vast Mountain and River Physiognomy, ensnaring the two attackers in an instant.
"Damn it, Xu Yan has gotten stronger!" The two masked figures' expressions changed.
"Perhaps, he has been hiding his true capabilities all along!" The other one's eyes were sinister.
Besides, the Martial Arts Techniques Xu Yan displayed were ones they had not seen before, this miraculous imagery of mountains and rivers had a sense of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, in harmony with the domain.
Of course, it wasn't in harmony with the domain, instead, it was the control of the Domain Laws that had formed this Physiognomy, which was somewhat different from truly being in harmony with the domain.
Even so, the two of them felt a sense of danger.

chapters.title: Chapter 762 - 401 Control and Counter-Subversion
chapters.content:
Xu Yan, this time, did not hold back his strength and unleashed the full might of his Physiognomy Realm powers, using divine physiognomy to control the forces of the local domain laws and completely seal off the area.
The Divine Skills of Mountains and Rivers within the Sword were activated, the vast mountains and rivers merged into the physiognomy, and his figure had already vanished within it, becoming undetectable.
Hum!
The Sword Intent was overwhelming, and the vegetation transformed into a flood of Sword Dao—vast and surging forward—attacking the two masked assailants.
The profound mysteries of the Wisdom Sword Realm were also revealed at this moment; every sword seemed to possess its own spiritual wisdom, each with its unique swordsmanship.
They cooperated with each other naturally, the Sword Array's coordination became more tacit, and, naturally, its power grew stronger.
Boom boom boom!
The two masked assailants were, after all, Martial Artists at the True King Heavenly Venerable Peak, powerful in their own right, with forces of domain laws surging out in their attacks as they made their move.
They even directly used a secret technique, attempting to break the seal of the physiognomy.
However, the two assassins felt a sinking feeling in their hearts as they found themselves unable to communicate with the domain laws on their own, faced with an obstruction as if a more powerful, more mysterious force, better attuned to the domain laws, had snatched away the power over the local domain laws.
"What kind of Martial Arts Techniques is this?"
The two were astonished in their hearts.
"Escape! Xu Yan is too strong, beyond our ability to contend with!"
The two assailants instantly made a decision—to flee!
"Do you think you can escape?"
Xu Yan sneered coldly.
With a slash, a black sword light, as if annihilating heaven and earth, struck towards one of them.
At the same time, eighteen Golden Giant Dragons roared as they assaulted from all directions.
A violent Sword Intent, like a fierce wind, swept into their Divine Souls. At this moment, the two assailants turned pale and frantically operated their Divine Refinement Techniques to counter the ferocious winds.
"Attack on the Divine Soul Technique!"
Their faces filled with shock at this moment.
Martial Arts secret techniques that attacked the Divine Soul were extremely rare; not all Martial Artists could master or successfully cultivate them.
Without exception, those who could successfully practice Soul Attack Secret Techniques were martial artists with more powerful Divine Souls, because ultimately such means of attack still relied on the power of their own Divine Souls.
Such martial artists were, without a doubt, top-tier existences within their realm.
Xu Yan used Mountains and Rivers within the Sword to trap one of them, directing all attacks towards the other.
He intended to capture a live specimen to investigate who they were and to which power they belonged.
A death warrior would often perish by his own hand to prevent divulging their affiliated power and purpose should he face a life-or-death crisis.
Xu Yan needed to control his opponent with the Destiny of the Heavenly Intent before the other could self-destruct.
Yet these two were True King Heavenly Venerable Peak Martial Artists, and only by weakening their Divine Souls, or by inflicting injuries upon their Divine Souls, could Xu Yan then firmly hold them using the Destiny of the Heavenly Intent Divine Skills.
"I can only capture one!"
Xu Yan understood in his heart that he only had the opportunity to capture one alive; if the situation went awry, the other would likely choose self-destruction immediately.
Capturing one was enough to achieve his goal.
The True King Heavenly Venerable being overwhelmed by Xu Yan's assault changed color dramatically, seemingly aware of Xu Yan's intentions, and as he roared angrily, his aura surged violently. A phantom emerged from within him.
This phantom exuded a cold and chilling aura.
As the cold phantom emerged, the True King Heavenly Venerable's aura weakened somewhat, clearly having paid a significant price for performing this secret technique.
Boom!
The chilling phantom suddenly exploded, releasing a cold force that merged with the earth, and in an instant, it seemed as if the ground had been flipped over.
Boom!
A dense and cold force erupted from the ground, its powerful surge breaking the lock of the physiognomy.
"Go!"
The True King who had used the secret technique took a quick breath, his form shifting as he attempted to flee.
Little did he know, this was precisely the opportunity Xu Yan was waiting for!
Hum!
An eye emerged on Xu Yan's forehead, made of luminous mist, which opened at this moment. An immense authority poured forth, casting its light upon that True King Heavenly Venerable.
The Minor Eye of the Heavenly Path!
The True King Heavenly Venerable, who was preparing to flee, felt as though he was under the Splendid Heavenly Might, as if everything was seen through, his form halting at that moment. After exerting the secret technique and weakening, he was unable to resist the gaze of this eye.
"This is bad, Xu Yan wants to capture me alive!"
The True King Heavenly Venerable's heart sank as he realized Xu Yan's intentions, now unable to successfully escape.
Just as he was about to self-destruct, under the watchful eye, his actions slowed, unable to complete his self-destruction in time.
Whoo!
A violent wind raged within his Divine Soul, stirring his soul, and the intense pain in the soul prevented him from carrying out his intent to self-destruct.
He watched helplessly as Xu Yan's palm descended, the center of his hand seemingly containing a destiny decreed by the heavens, as if it held a supreme will.
The True King Heavenly Venerable, sensing disaster was nigh, was utterly unable to defend against it.
Xu Yan's gaze was icy as he seized the opportunity, weakening the opponent's Divine Soul Consciousness, then using Destiny of the Heavenly Intent to hold fast the opponent's soul and consciousness, gaining complete control over him.
The entire process took less than a single breath to conclude.
Meanwhile, the other assailant took the chance to break out of the containment, his eyes wide with shock as he dared not delay in the slightest, escaping madly.
He must convey the latest information on Xu Yan back to Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, to devise a new plan against Xu Yan.

chapters.title: Chapter 763 - 401 Control and Counter-Subversion_2
chapters.content:
"Can you escape?"
Xu Yan sneered coldly, took a step forward, and in an instant, he disappeared from his original spot. The next moment, his sword radiance swept across like vast mountains and rivers, shrouding the assassin who was in the midst of fleeing.
"Xu Yan!"
The assassin let out a low roar, the aura on his body vanished in an instant, his Divine Soul extinguished at that moment, devoid of all life.
"Hmph!"
Xu Yan's gaze was icy cold. This assassin from the mysterious force was indeed resolute. Once he found escape impossible, he did not hesitate in the slightest and chose to die by his own hand!
Moreover, he clearly cultivated some kind of secret technique that allowed for self-destruction, which could eliminate his Divine Soul in a blink, leaving not a trace of residual consciousness, to avoid any information being extracted from him.
Boom!
The sword light fell, and the corpse dissipated into ash.
Two assassins, one was now under control, and the goal was also achieved.
Xu Yan was increasingly thankful that his decision to cultivate the "Destiny of the Heavenly Intent" Divine Skills was a very wise move.
"Take off your mask."
Xu Yan turned to the controlled assassin.
Even with a clear mind, the other party couldn't resist the will that was like the destiny of the heavens.
"Yes!"
The individual removed the mask.
What was revealed was a middle-aged face with a pallid complexion and a look devoid of any emotion, as if devoid of all feeling.
"Speak, who sent you to assassinate me, and what force is behind you?"
Xu Yan started the interrogation.
The Wan Family, as one of the top forces of the Nine Mountain Realm and the ruler over Dahai Mountain territory, couldn't even find a trace of this mysterious force, indicating how deeply it was hidden.
What exactly was this deeply-concealed force plotting?
Was it an enemy from beyond the heavens lying in wait, or a power within the Divine Realm itself?
Now, there would be an answer.
"It was Heavenly Slaughter who ordered us to assassinate you. We belong to the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow..."
This True King Heavenly Venerable spilled everything under Xu Yan's interrogation without hiding a thing.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow?"
Xu Yan was inwardly shocked, finally learning the name of this behind-the-scenes force.
"Why do you want to instigate conflict between me and the Wan Family?"
Xu Yan continued his questioning.
"To create conflict between the Qinghua state and the Nine Mountain Realm, to fulfill the supreme mission of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, and to restore the glory of the Domain..."
At the end, the True King Heavenly Venerable showed a fanatic gleam.
Xu Yan was stunned. The goal of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow was to instigate conflict between the two realms, and this "glory of the Domain" appeared to be a kind of belief.
As to what exactly "restoring the glory of the Domain" meant, the assassin couldn't explain clearly. He only knew that the task of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow was to make the Domain stronger, to restore its former glory.
To restore this glory, it was necessary to break the status quo, instigate great turmoil within the Divine Realm, and cause a vast upheaval of the Domain. Only then would there be a chance to restore its former glory.
The existence of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow was for this mission.
As Xu Yan delved deeper into his understanding, he was secretly astonished. Most of the people in Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow were madmen.
All for the supposed glory of the Domain, they would sacrifice everything!
Fearless in the face of death!
To avoid leaking the secrets of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, they would enact self-annihilation without any hesitation!
Moreover, Xu Yan also learned that due to his own actions in the past, a member of Earth Shadow had assassinated the former Heavenly Slaughter, causing some unrest within the organization.
Suspicions arose. Was there a traitor?
After all, in the fanatical organization of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, which carried out its mission with no hesitation even in the face of death, how could there be a traitor?
As a result, the first traitor emerged, leading to Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow being more cautious when assigning tasks.
"No wonder there was no assassination of the Wan Family. It turns out that it was Heavenly Slaughter that had been targeted."
Xu Yan was dumbfounded.
He had originally instructed the assassination of the order giver, thinking it was someone from the Wan Family. He never imagined that the order giver was Heavenly Slaughter, and that the person was from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
"Earth Shadow is quite impressive. It's feared that not just one person has infiltrated the Wan Family."
Members of Earth Shadow must certainly be infiltrating all these major powers in the Nine Mountain Realm, but rooting them out is not so easily done.
"Are you from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow pursuing Meng Chong?"
Xu Yan then asked.
"Yes, it is rumored that the Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter ordered Meng Chong's assassination, creating conflict and division, sparing no effort to provoke a great war."
Xu Yan's gaze turned icy. Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter, according to this assassin's words, possessed the strength of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm!
However, mere Seven-leaf strength could only be considered average amongst Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
"Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Nine Mountain Realm all reside within the Nine Mountains. Could it be that besides the Nine Mountains, an Immortal Heavenly Venerable lies in ambush?"
Xu Yan's heart tensed.
An Immortal Heavenly Venerable who could appear at any time was a huge threat to any power.
Furthermore, Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow had failed several times in their attempts to assassinate Meng Chong. What if the Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter personally took action?
Even though, with his master's Jade Talisman, there wouldn't be any danger.
But an Immortal Heavenly Venerable lurking in the shadows was undoubtedly a great hidden threat.
"An Immortal Heavenly Venerable would not find it easy to conceal themselves, unless they have cultivated a secret technique as incredible as the Dust Technique to hide their presence."
Xu Yan immediately dismissed the possibility that the other party possessed such an incredible technique to hide their presence.
Immortal Heavenly Venerables merge with the Domain, and for this reason, it is impossible for Immortal Heavenly Venerables to deceive each other. The prospect of hiding is nearly impossible.
It's not likely that an Undetected Immortal Heavenly Venerable exists within the Nine Mountain Realm. The only possibility is that one of these Immortal Heavenly Venerables is the Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter!
"Feng Yan comes from the Seven Segments Mountain, and the Seven Segments Mountain is unlike the rest of the Eight Mountains..."
Xu Yan thought of the Seven Segments Mountain where Feng Yan belonged. This mountain's forces were not a sect or a noble family, but an alliance-like force known as the Seven Segments Mountain Alliance.
The Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Seven Segments Mountain each have their own subordinates, yet they form an alliance. If one were to speculate where the Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter might be, it would undoubtedly be the Seven Segments Mountain.
"This guy Feng Yan, although he's from the Seven Segments Mountain and belongs to the Seven Segments Mountain Alliance, he's rather loose and hasn't formed his own subordinate forces..."
Xu Yan pondered.
It was precisely because Feng Yan was loose that the threat from the Heavenly Grottos of the Seven Segments Mountain wasn't significant, which is why he went to support the Qinghua state and ended up staying and not leaving.
Xu Yan recalled the introductions of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Seven Segments Mountain provided by Feng Yan; he didn't find any of them particularly suspicious.
"It may not necessarily be the Seven Segments Mountain."
Xu Yan's brows furrowed slightly. This Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter's identity was deeply concealed. Within the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow organization, hardly anyone knew their identity in the Nine Mountain Realm.
"This is a hidden threat to the Nine Mountain Realm. The Wan Family will be anxious too. They will take this matter seriously and investigate."
The Wan Family is a noble family and is being targeted by Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, so the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Wan Family could not possibly be the Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter. On the contrary, because they are being targeted, they are even more attentive to this matter.
Xu Yan continued to inquire, focusing on information regarding Meng Chong.
"All I know is that Meng Chong arrived in the Dahai Mountain region and then vanished without a trace. The search is ongoing..."
Meng Chong came to Dahai Mountain, and he too came searching for him. The Wan Family is the ruling noble family of Dahai Mountain. It was time to meet Wan Tianlin.
The intelligence from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow should also be shared with Wan Tianlin, utilizing the Wan Family's resources to conduct the search.
Especially for the Earth Shadow Members infiltrating various powers.
Thinking this, Xu Yan took the Earth Shadow member with him to the Dahai Mountain's Shi Feng and used a Communication Talisman to summon Wan Tianlin for a meeting.
Destiny of the Heavenly Intent Control is a Divine Skill that Xu Yan wouldn't disclose, and the controlled individual would not be detected for any signs of manipulation.
This person, he still had great use for!
Continue to act as an Earth Shadow member, becoming a true traitor within Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
Giving a direct order for a counter-assassination would be too low-value. Now that Xu Yan was aware of the existence of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, he naturally would not engage in such low-efficiency retaliation.
He planned to eradicate Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow entirely.
Even if he couldn't finish them off at once, he could destroy their various strongholds one by one. Xu Yan intended to exploit the value of this Earth Shadow member to the fullest.
"You know the strongholds of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, tell me their locations."
"I don't know many strongholds. Aside from the one I belong to, I only know three other contact points..."
Having received the locations of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's strongholds, Xu Yan considered how to proceed. Alone, he couldn't silently take down a stronghold.
Therefore, cooperation with Wan Tianlin was still necessary.
"You can go back. Just say that you encountered Wan Family reinforcements and only escaped by using a secret technique..."
Xu Yan instructed.
"Yes!"
"From today onwards, you are known as Yin Yi. Infiltrate Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, understand?"
"Yin Yi understands!"
Xu Yan watched as Yin Yi left, his face beaming with a bright smile. Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow excels at infiltration, don't they?
Have they ever considered being counter-infiltrated?

chapters.title: Chapter 764 - 402: Joining Forces, Brothers Reunite
chapters.content:
Wan Tianlin arrived, and accompanying him were two clan elders. The strength of these two elders was a cut above the ordinary True King Heavenly Venerable Peak Martial Artists, clearly making them one of the strongest under the Immortal Heavenly Venerable within the Wan Family.
This showed the importance the Wan Family placed on Wan Tianlin.
Xu Yan's gaze flickered slightly. Wan Tianlin's strength had broken through, and his aura had become even more condensed. It was evident that he had successfully comprehended the Wan Family's secret technique with the help of the Blood Heart Fruit.
This secret technique was evidently crucial for breaking through to the Immortal Heavenly Venerable level.
Although it was not guaranteed that one could break through to Immortal Heavenly Venerable upon mastering this secret technique, it significantly increased the chances of making such a breakthrough.
In the Wan Family, Wan Tianlin was already regarded as the future Immortal Heavenly Venerable powerhouse.
With each additional Immortal Heavenly Venerable, the Wan Family's strength would naturally rise, giving them an even greater advantage in suppressing the Heavenly Grotto.
"Brother Xu, did you gain anything?"
Wan Tianlin asked with a formal bow.
Although his strength had increased, Xu Yan still appeared the same as when they last met, with no apparent growth, but Wan Tianlin did not dare to take him lightly in his heart.
"I won't hide it from you, Brother Wan. I used some means to extract some clues from the mouth of an assassin who serves the forces behind the attack on me..."
Xu Yan nodded and spoke directly.
Wan Tianlin's eyes moved. The fact that Xu Yan had used "some means" to extract valuable information from an assassin suggested that his methods were probably not simple.
"Brother Xu, please speak!"
Wan Tianlin's demeanor was solemn as if there were a pair of sinister eyes from the mysterious force hiding in the shadows, watching the Wan Family.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, the force behind the curtain is known as Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, composed of Heavenly Slaughter and Earth Shadow members. Heavenly Slaughter, as the leader, excels in the art of killing, while Earth Shadow specializes in infiltration and assassination..."
Xu Yan did not conceal anything and told Wan Tianlin all the information about Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow without reservation.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow?"
Wan Tianlin and the two clan elders were more and more alarmed as they listened. Such a force, entirely unheard of and deeply hidden, likely had significant and sinister intentions.
"The people from the Wan Family who attacked me last time were, in fact, members of Earth Shadow. There are likely more infiltrators within the Wan Family. Additionally, it's known that in the Nine Mountain Realm, there's a Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter leading Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, whose strength is that of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable..."
Xu Yan said gravely.
"Brother Xu, is this Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter truly an Immortal Heavenly Venerable?"
Wan Tianlin and the two clan elders were seriously concerned.
This meant that an Immortal Heavenly Venerable powerhouse was scheming against the Wan Family!
Within the Nine Mountain Realm, Immortal Heavenly Venerables were rare, and they typically knew of each other.
"This is no falsehood, and it's even possible that there's more than one Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter. After all, the status of that assassin was limited; he may not know too much."
Xu Yan said earnestly.
Wan Tianlin looked grave, "Brother Xu, what exactly is Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's purpose for stirring up conflict between us?"
"To provoke conflict between Qinghua state and the Nine Mountain Realm. The goal of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow is to trigger turmoil within the Divine Realm, all for the sake of restoring some kind of 'Domain glory'..."
Xu Yan did not hold back, conveying the motives of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, which were to create discord and revive the so-called 'Domain glory', laying it all out for Wan Tianlin.
As for the means Xu Yan used to uncover these things, he naturally did not breathe a word.
Wan Tianlin did not ask either.
"This is a grave matter; I need to report to our clan's Immortal ancestors before we can decide on our next steps."
Wan Tianlin was profoundly shaken.
The insidious goals of the mysterious force Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow were truly appalling.
What sort of 'Domain glory' could they hope to revive? It was unheard of, but this indicated that they were a group of fanatically dangerous individuals.
The Thirty-six Realms of the Divine Realm were faced with the invasion of the Heavenly Grotto. The realms had an understanding not to engage in severe conflicts or attack each other. Even when one realm faced the risk of being occupied by the Heavenly Grotto, others were known to intervene and assist.
To some extent, they were like branches of the same tree.
Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow intended to provoke attacks among the Thirty-six Realms and create chaos in the Divine Realm. Should they succeed, wouldn't it play right into the hands of the Heavenly Grotto?
If a single realm of the Divine Realm, or even several realms, were to fall into the hands of the Heavenly Grotto, the consequences would be unthinkable.
"From what I've investigated, I alone might not be able to completely eradicate one of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's bases. Thus, I seek Brother Wan's assistance in this matter.
"Moreover, I'd like to ask you, Brother Wan, to help me pass on a message and search for someone..."
Xu Yan went on to state his intentions.
In addition to jointly targeting Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's base, he was of course seeking Meng Chong.
"No problem!"
Wan Tianlin readily agreed.
Dahai Mountain was the Wan Family's territory. The presence of a lurking force there was unacceptable, and it had to be rooted out no matter what.
As for passing on messages to find someone, that was even simpler.
"There's no time to lose, Brother Xu. Let's take action now."
Wan Tianlin was somewhat eager.
"Very well."
Xu Yan glanced at the two clan elders of the Wan Family, assessing their strength as sufficient to destroy a Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow base.
After all, according to Yin Yi, the strength of each base of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow varied, but none were overly powerful. The leader of Heavenly Slaughter in charge of the Dahai Mountain region might not be stronger than these two Wan Family elders.
"One of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's bases is located here..."
Xu Yan revealed the location of one base, after all, when it came to familiarity with Dahai Mountain, Wan Tianlin naturally knew best.
"So it's there!"
Wan Tianlin nodded, quickly finding the location of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow on the map of the Wan Family's Dahai Mountain region.

chapters.title: Chapter 765 - 402: Joining Forces, Brothers Reunite_2
chapters.content:
...
"The mission has failed!"
Yin Yi had already returned to his base of operations, his breath weak, clearly having used a secret technique at a great cost.
"Why did it fail?"
A figure of Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter emerged.
"Xu Yan's strength is even greater than estimated, and a powerful member of the Wan Family intervened. I managed to escape only by using a secret technique..."
Yin Yi said with a heavy voice.
"You should heal your injuries here, and once you have recovered, we will arrange a new mission."
Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter instructed.
"Yes, my lord!"
The mission had failed, but in the past, Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter wouldn't have taken it to heart, as no one could guarantee a one hundred percent success rate for missions.
However, ever since a traitor had appeared, they had to be more cautious.
Leaving Yin Yi to recover at the base, Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter and the rest of the people from the base silently departed, lying in wait elsewhere.
If their base was compromised, they would surely be attacked.
After waiting three days and no attack came, Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter breathed a sigh of relief; Yin Yi had no issues, nor had anyone followed him there.
Just as he relaxed, a two-inch-long black Spirit Bee suddenly flew over and landed on his shoulder.
Hum!
The Spirit Bee's antennae moved, transmitting a faint Divine Soul fluctuation.
Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter's expression changed dramatically—the location of one of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's secret bases had been eradicated by Xu Yan and the Wan Family!
Only one person had managed to escape with a heavy toll!
"Is there a traitor, or did the Wan Family track us down?"
Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter's gaze became thoughtful.
"Return to the branch!"
No longer able to sit idly by, Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter led his people back to the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow branch at Dahai Mountain.
He had an intuition that the Wan Family might have uncovered Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's existence, and it wouldn't be long before they began a manhunt.
Before they reached the branch, another Spirit Bee arrived.
The second base had also been annihilated, and the assailants were the same—Xu Yan and the Wan Family working together. From this base, which was stronger, two people had escaped.
"Two bases compromised at the same time, both connected!"
Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter pondered.
These Spirit Bees, unique to Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, were fast and ensured their messages were delivered secretly without interception. Given the speed of the Spirit Bees, the time between the first and the second base's destruction was short.
From this, it could be inferred that Xu Yan and Wan Tianlin had systematically targeted the second base immediately after destroying the first.
This meant they had already thoroughly understood the situation of these two bases.
The only thing that baffled Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter was why the Wan Family's participation involved only two clan elders. Shouldn't they have annihilated the base in one fell swoop without letting anyone escape?
Suddenly, his expression shifted subtly. Could the Wan Family have deliberately let some escape, then followed them to track down the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow branch at Dahai Mountain?
"Earth Shadow members excel at hiding; it's impossible for even a True King Heavenly Venerable to track them without a trace. Could it be that an Immortal Heavenly Venerable from the Wan Family personally took action?"
At the thought, Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter's heart sank.
Certainly, if an Immortal Heavenly Venerable acted, their demise was inevitable.
"Although the Heavenly Grotto at Dahai Mountain is currently stable without major upheaval, it's also impossible for an Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Wan Family to easily leave their position..."
After pondering, Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter issued an order, "Notify those who have escaped to come here to regroup."
To be cautious, instead of ordering the escapees to meet at the branch, Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter directed them to a secret location.
This place was the location of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's backup branch.
"Order Second-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter to come here and await further commands!"
After thinking it over, Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter issued another order.
If they intended to deceive people, then this backup branch must have other members of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow present.
If necessary, the sacrifice of some members was also essential.
Hum!
Two Spirit Bees immediately flew off, tasked with delivering the messages.
Meanwhile, Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter continued to lead his trusted followers back to the location of the branch at Dahai Mountain.
Just as they reached the vicinity of the branch, another Spirit Bee flew in.
Another stronghold had been wiped out.
The custodian of this stronghold was not weak, and in his desperate counterattack, two people managed to escape from the stronghold and even injured an elder of the Wan Family.
"Something's not right!"
Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter began to ponder.
Then, a flash of insight struck him, and he seemed to understand something.
"Wan Family, is this using Wan Tianlin as bait to lure the strong warriors of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow into action?"
At this moment, Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter suspected that the reason the Wan Family had not completely destroyed the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow strongholds, allowing people to escape each time, was to deliberately send a message to Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
The protection around Wan Tianlin was weak, marking it the prime opportunity to strike at Wan Tianlin and Xu Yan!
"Heh, so it is, trying to lure us to show ourselves!"
Having understood this, Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter couldn't help but let out a cold laugh. How could he fall for such a trap?
The true purpose of killing Wan Tianlin was to provoke a conflict. Now that the plan to instigate strife had been exposed, taking the risk to kill Wan Tianlin would be a loss-making venture.
"Xu Yan!"
Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter muttered to himself.
"Wan brother, looking forward to cooperating again!"
Xu Yan said with a cupped fist and a smile.
"Sure!"
Wan Tianlin's face was all smiles.
This cooperation led to the eradication of three Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow strongholds, and Xu Yan had provided the information for all three, with each stronghold intentionally allowing people to escape.
Of course, those who escaped had performed a secret technique and their strength had declined.
Xu Yan would then follow the escapees before returning shortly after, seemingly having learned the location of new strongholds from those who had fled.
Although Wan Tianlin didn't know how Xu Yan had managed this, clearly these fleeing members of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow would be of great use!
From this joint operation, Wan Tianlin also obtained part of the list of Earth Shadow Members lurking within the Wan Family.
These were provided by Xu Yan, obtained from interrogating the escapees.
Even making the tight-lipped confess, such a tactic was truly incredible and deepened Wan Tianlin's admiration for Xu Yan.
"Six of them now, Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, wait for me, Xu Yan, to wipe you out in one fell swoop!"
Xu Yan's expression was steely.
He already controlled six individuals, from Yin Yi to Yin Liu, just waiting for the right moment. Once he took over the sub-branch of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, he could then eradicate them.
"Waiting for Junior Brother to come!"
The search message for Meng Chong had already been sent out by the Wan Family.
As long as Meng Chong was in Dahai Mountain, he would surely receive this message and then come seeking.
This time, in eradicating the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow strongholds, Xu Yan had gained more information about the locations of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow holdouts, but he hadn't taken action, only destroying three strongholds.
Besides the Dahai Mountain stronghold, there was even information about strongholds in other regions like Thousand Layered Mountain.
In a certain city on Dahai Mountain, a muscular man with thick hair was leaving the city.
"Senior Brother is looking for me."
This muscular man was none other than Meng Chong.
To avoid pursuit, he wore thick false hair intentionally, and had also altered his appearance somewhat.
However, since he was tall and sturdy, those pursuing him paid special attention to any robust individual and would investigate carefully.
Nevertheless, Meng Chong's technique for suppressing his presence and altering his form was ingenious, allowing him easily to hide his identity. In times of need, he could even compress his physique, making his robust figure seem smaller.
"The treasures needed for building my foundation are almost sufficient, it's a good time to break through."
Meng Chong left the city, avoiding potential pursuers.
"Once I break through to the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body, I'll kill them one by one!"
Meng Chong's gaze was fierce.
Barely advancing to the Nine Mountain Realm, he had encountered pursuit and even faced dire straits—it was not something he was going to let go of lightly.
Once he made the breakthrough, he would fear no one below the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, and even the True King Heavenly Venerable would not be able to threaten him. Then, it would be time to demonstrate his divine power and show those assailants the ferocity of Physical Body Martial Arts.
Xu Yan, who was waiting for Meng Chong's arrival, received Meng Chong's message through the Communication Talisman. The distance between them was now within the range of the talisman.
"Junior Brother!"
Upon seeing Meng Chong wearing the false hair, Xu Yan's eyes grew even colder.
The pursuit by Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow had forced Meng Chong to wear false hair, which showed how many dangers Meng Chong had faced in these days.
"Senior Brother!"
Meng Chong was overjoyed and quickly took off the false hair and put it away neatly.

chapters.title: Chapter 766 - 766: 403
chapters.content:
Upon the reunion of the martial brothers, it was inevitable that they shared their experiences.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow dared to attempt an assassination on my junior brother, there will come a day when we exterminate them!"
Xu Yan said with a cold smile.
"So, that force is called Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, once my strength breaks through, it's time for their retribution!"
Meng Chong, touching his bald head, said through gritted teeth angrily.
"Junior brother, how is your Minor Heavenly Path Eye coming along?"
Xu Yan asked.
"I'm just a bit short!"
Meng Chong let out a sigh.
The Minor Heavenly Path Eye was too profound, and although only a little bit was needed for enlightenment, that little bit seemed like an insurmountable barrier.
Moreover, upon arriving in the Nine Mountain Realm, he had been constantly evading assassination attempts by Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, so there was no spare time to settle down and thoroughly contemplate.
"I have some Blood Heart Fruit that can aid in comprehending cultivation techniques, you can take it to contemplate the Minor Heavenly Path Eye, it should lead to a breakthrough."
Xu Yan produced three Blood Heart Fruits.
After introducing the miraculous effects of the Blood Heart Fruit, he continued, "If there are any Divine Skills you wish to cultivate, you can also use this opportunity to contemplate them."
"Thank you, Senior Brother!"
Meng Chong was overjoyed.
With the Blood Heart Fruit, he was confident that he could comprehend the Minor Heavenly Path Eye.
As for Divine Skills, Meng Chong also had a Divine Skill Technique he needed to cultivate.
The Destiny of the Heavenly Intent was a Divine Skill that was beyond Meng Chong's scope of practice. After all, he was a Physical Body Martial Artist, and such Divine Skills weren't his specialty.
Next, after setting up the Concealing Formation, Meng Chong consumed the Blood Heart Fruit to contemplate the Minor Heavenly Path Eye and to cultivate Divine Skills, as well as to accumulate his base, preparing for a breakthrough.
As for Xu Yan, he also began to organize his Martial Arts, but did not consume the Seven Wonders Divine Flower, as it would require him to retreat for a while to contemplate once taken.
Currently, Meng Chong needed to comprehend cultivation techniques and break through realms; even with the Concealing Formation for cover, it wasn't guaranteed that his tracks wouldn't be revealed, hence he needed Xu Yan to protect him.
Although the timing wasn't right to consume the Seven Wonders Divine Flower, Xu Yan didn't just stand guard as a protector, but also focused on organizing his own Martial Arts, particularly the application of several Divine Skills.
And all the while, he mulled over how to utilize Imperishable Qi.
As Meng Chong retreated for his cultivation, Xu Yan stood guard, Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, who had been consistently pursuing Meng Chong, suddenly found his tracks disappearing.
And Xu Yan's trace had once again vanished.
The Wan Family, meanwhile, was investigating internally, rooting out the hidden members of the Earth Shadow Organization. These Earth Shadow Members, upon realizing they had been exposed, self-destructed without a moment's hesitation.
This decisive action instilled a resolute fear in the hearts of the Wan Family's powerhouses.
So decisive!
They also realized the tremendous threat posed by Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
They immediately issued a bounty throughout the Dahai Mountain region, rewarding information about Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow or the killing of its members.
With the actions of the Wan Family, turmoil brewed within Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
The Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter in charge of the Dahai Mountain region became grave. Although the fake branch wasn't attacked by Wan Family powerhouses, suggesting that their initial speculation was correct...
The Wan Family had intentionally shown weakness, using Wan Tianlin as bait, hoping to lure them into revealing themselves.
Although he didn't make a move to assassinate Wan Tianlin, the movements of the Wan Family made him realize that there was a betrayer within Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow!
Otherwise, how would the Wan Family know the name Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow?
Inside the cave, Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter scanned the people seated before him with a severe gaze, his voice grave, "Why has treason occurred in the Dahai Mountain region?
"You all belong to the Dahai Mountain region, from this point on, all tasks will be reassigned, and the traitor must be found!"
All members of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow looked grave at that moment. A traitor within their ranks?
Everyone had been willing to sacrifice themselves in order to restore the glory of their domain; why would anyone defect?
Why would anyone's conviction waver?
"Lord, all members of Earth Shadow have been cultivated from a young age; each one was carefully selected and trained with steadfast beliefs, they shouldn't turn traitor..."
A person spoke somberly.
After a moment of silence, Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter realized that every member of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow organization, including himself, was trained from a young age by a senior Heavenly Slaughter, with unwavering beliefs—one wouldn't normally expect a defection, and there had never been doubts about Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's great cause.
For the restoration of the domain's glory!
But why now were there those who abandoned their convictions and betrayed?
"Some have wavered in their resolve, believing they can no longer restore the glory of the domain, and for personal gain, they've turned traitor. They are short-sighted and unaware of the grand strategy of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
"The time has come. The mission to restore the domain's glory will be fully implemented, not just within the Nine Mountain Realm..."
Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter declared sternly, his eyes revealing a hint of madness.
"Prepare those entrenched within major factions to assassinate key figures of those powers, to incite conflicts, and also to enter the Heavenly Grotto in the guise of Nine Mountain Realm powers to discuss potential collaborations.
"Finally, get ready to organize forces to take over Realm Gates, and assault the Qinghua state..."
Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter began to issue commands.
"For this operation, I will report to Lord Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter and secure permission!"
Hearing this, all Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow members' eyes flashed with excitement, revealing a wild fervor.
"Yes, Lord!"
They all replied excitedly.
"Lord, shall we continue to pursue Meng Chong and Xu Yan?"
"Kill! How can we not kill? They must be killed!"

chapters.title: Chapter 767 - 403 Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's Planning_2
chapters.content:
Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter said coldly.
At Horizontal Peak Mountain, Tian Shiqi sat at the head of the grand hall.
A figure walked in, with a mask on their face, on which seven leaves were engraved.
"My lord, I have returned!"
The comer bowed respectfully.
Tian Shiqi nodded. Although he wore a Seven-Leaf mask, his status was far from comparable to that of a Seven-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter; he was here in Nine Mountain Realm's Horizontal Peak Mountain only as a temporary replacement to preside over it.
He had another purpose for coming, which was for the Wind Spirit Tiger.
"How did it go?"
Tian Shiqi asked in a deep voice.
"Replying to my lord, everything went smoothly. The Netherworld and the Witches have all reached an understanding; the chaos in the Divine Realm can now begin," replied the person.
By the end of the sentence, the Seven-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter's eyes gleamed with fanaticism.
"Very good!"
Tian Shiqi nodded.
"My lord, Five-Leaf intends to take some actions..."
He relayed Five-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter's arrangement.
Tian Shiqi nodded and said, "The time has come. If you want to proceed, then proceed. I'm not afraid of revealing the name Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow. It is about time for Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow to appear in this world."
"Yes, my lord!"
The Seven-Leaf Heavenly Slaughter was visibly excited.
"Continue to preside over this area."
"Yes, my lord!"
After Tian Shiqi gave his orders, he stepped forward and vanished in an instant.
To Spiritual Sovereign Mountain, Tian Shiqi came.
"He has arrived!"
The Wind Spirit Tiger sat on a dazzling golden throne, its neck adorned with a large gold chain and thirty-six jewels shining brightly, exuding the temperament of a nouveau riche.
Tian Shiqi was stunned.
He blinked, looked back, and surveyed his surroundings again. This place was Spiritual Sovereign Mountain, where the Wind Spirit Tiger resided.
He hadn't gone to the wrong place.
"Are you the Wind Spirit Tiger?" Tian Shiqi asked in astonishment.
It hadn't been that long since the last time he saw the Wind Spirit Tiger, lying on the ground as a mighty Spirit Beast.
And now, upon seeing it again, the entire tiger had changed; it wasn't just sitting on the dazzling golden throne but also wore a large gold chain.
What was even more outrageous was that it held a Tiger Head Gold Staff in its paw.
It looked both like a nouveau riche and significantly more dignified.
Thud!
