With a bang, the gold staff in the Wind Spirit Tiger's hand struck the ground, and the whole earth quivered, as it said with an imposing air, "Tian Shiqi, how come you lack such manners? You should address me as His Excellency the Wind Spirit King!"
Shit!
Tian Shiqi felt troubled, looking at the Wind Spirit Tiger skeptically and wondering if the tiger had gone mad from working too hard on breaking through its bloodline shackles.
The Wind Spirit Tiger tapped the ground with its golden staff, a look of disappointment on its face, and said, "How come you, like the master of the Spiritual Sovereign Gate, have no understanding of etiquette?
"Never mind, considering our acquaintance, I will gift you a book on etiquette.
With a wave of its paw, the Wind Spirit Tiger summoned a Spirit Beast attendant, who immediately presented a small booklet to Tian Shiqi.
Tian Shiqi felt like exploding with anger. Was he being looked down upon by a Spirit Beast for not understanding etiquette?
If it weren't for the Wind Spirit Tiger's formidable strength, he would hardly be able to resist slapping the Spirit Beast that brought the booklet to death.
"No need!"
The expression under Tian Shiqi's mask was exceedingly ugly.
The Wind Spirit Tiger shook its head with a sigh, "Tian Shiqi, you do not appreciate kindness. This will lead to trouble eventually..."
Shit!
Tian Shiqi twitched at the corner of his mouth; after some time apart, how had the Wind Spirit Tiger become such a nag?
"Wind..."
Just as he was about to interrupt the Wind Spirit Tiger's nagging and get straight to the reason for his visit, he saw a Splendid Ferocious Tiger with a long sword slung around its waist, walking on two legs toward them.
"Big brother, do we have a guest?"
Red Cat rushed over as soon as he heard the commotion.
Guests of the Wind Spirit Tiger were naturally powerful beings from the Immortal Heavenly Venerable rank, and certainly deserved an audience.
"Younger brother has arrived, this is Tian Shiqi, you've seen him a few times…" said the Wind Spirit Tiger with a smiling face.
Ever since his younger brother Red Cat arrived, he, the Spirit Beast King, had truly begun to live a life befitting his title, fully demonstrating the regal dignity of the Wind Spirit King.
Red Cat sized up Tian Shiqi, thinking that this guy definitely didn't look like a good person.
Tian Shiqi also sized up Red Cat, wondering about the origin of this spirit tiger. Could the changes in the Wind Spirit Tiger be related to it?
"Wind Spirit King, have you made your decision?" Tian Shiqi asked directly.
"I have thought it through," replied the Wind Spirit Tiger. "What are the benefits? What are the perks? You can't just feed me empty promises, you need to present tangible benefits, actual advantages.
"Otherwise, would I not become a mere errand runner for you?" the Wind Spirit Tiger said with a serious expression.
Red Cat listened silently, starting to calculate in his mind. This Tian Shiqi had obviously come to propose some venture to Wind Spirit Tiger, and it was quite apparent that the latter was tempted, entertaining thoughts of cooperation.
However, because of the new concepts instilled in him by Red Cat in the recent days, his attitude had evolved. He didn't agree to the proposition outright but instead started to weigh the pros and cons.
Tian Shiqi's gaze sharpened as he looked towards the spirit beasts serving by the Wind Spirit Tiger's side but said nothing more.
With a wave of his paw, the Wind Spirit Tiger dismissed the attending spirit beasts, who then left the ancient forest.
Tian Shiqi turned his gaze to Red Cat.
"My younger brother is my confidant and can represent me, the Wind Spirit King. There are no secrets here that he should not be privy to," said the Wind Spirit Tiger in a deep voice.
Tian Shiqi nodded and spoke, "As I have said, the Divine Realm is in turmoil, the Unity of Domain is upon us. You, Wind Spirit Tiger, can also advance further, breaking free from the shackles of your bloodline. This is a real benefit.
"All you need to do is to cause a bit of chaos in the situation or eliminate a few individuals. With the strength of you, the Wind Spirit King, there is no risk to speak of; the benefits far outweigh the potential drawbacks."
Seeing that the Wind Spirit Tiger was pondering, Tian Shiqi pressed further, "Without the Unity of Domain, you will never be able to advance further. But once it occurs, you will progress and become the true king of spirit beasts, with all of them heeding your command..."
The Wind Spirit Tiger's eyes flickered, seemingly tempted.
Red Cat remained expressionless but secretly transmitted a message to the Wind Spirit Tiger.
"Big brother, don't be fooled. This guy is up to no good," Red Cat cautioned. "Leaving aside whether the Domain unification can succeed, even if it eventually does, the biggest beneficiary will certainly not be you.
"Moreover, with his strength alone, how can he ensure success against someone as formidable as you?
"Furthermore, once you make a move, you will inevitably offend many powerful beings. Although you are not afraid, should this guy fail, he can shove all blame onto you. If you face an onslaught from powerful foes, even you, with all your strength, will struggle to resist.
"As for breaking the bloodline shackles, you are already immortal. The consequences will be dire if you fail.
"Make him reveal some details—why is he so certain of success? Also, demand some tangible treasures in exchange. You can't let him get away with mere words..."
The Wind Spirit Tiger held absolute trust in Red Cat. The more he listened, the more sense it made.
"Tian Shiqi, share some details of your organization. If we are to collaborate, there should be no secrets or concealment. Also, I need to see your strength, your actions, and the outcomes of your actions.
"Otherwise, if you're too weak and I naively join in, wouldn't I end up being a mere pawn?
"Cooperation must have stipulations. If I take action, what compensation will you offer me? Don't just talk about benefits after the unification of the Domain and breaking my bloodline shackles.
"Whether the Domain unification is even feasible remains uncertain. Even if it does happen, surely I won't be the only one capable of shattering the bloodline fetters?
"Hence, tangible rewards are essential!" exclaimed the Wind Spirit Tiger.
Tian Shiqi was visibly surprised. Since when had the Wind Spirit Tiger become so shrewd?
He glanced subconsciously at the Splendid Tiger.
"Hmph! Tian Shiqi, I was merely hiding my astuteness earlier. Did you really think I've lived these long years without being able to see through your intentions?" the Wind Spirit Tiger said with a cold snort.
Of course, he couldn't admit to having been naive before!
Tian Shiqi thought about it and found some logic in it. The Wind Spirit Tiger, a formidable being and one of the twelve Spirit Beast Kings, couldn't possibly be truly simple-minded.
"We are Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, with strength that speaks for itself. Without any exaggeration, we regard the power of the entire Nine Mountain Realm with indifference.
"Since you, the Wind Spirit Tiger, wish to witness the power of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, then watch as my organization launches its operations..." Tian Shiqi revealed some hints about the forthcoming actions of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.

chapters.title: Chapter 768 - 404 Reporting, Heaven Lifting Earth Extinguishing
chapters.content:
Tian Shiqi outlined the upcoming actions of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, including instigating conflict among the forces of the Nine Mountain Realm, seizing control of Nine Mountain City, where the Realm Gate was located, and provoking war between the Nine Mountain Realm and the Qinghua state.
One of the actions included assassinations targeting Xu Yan and Meng Chong.
Red Cat had been listening without showing any emotion, but was secretly shocked by what she heard.
One of the tasks of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow was to infiltrate the Qinghua state and attempt to assassinate Su Lingxiu or Fang Hao.
It also included disrupting Pills and Formations.
For instance, by applying poison to Pills so that any Martial Artist who consumed them would be poisoned and die.
An even more critical action was to kill either Fang Hao or Su Lingxiu. If successful, whether it was Da Yue Country, Tianwu Sect, or Myriad Thunder Sect, including the entire Qinghua state, would be engulfed by a surge of emotions, and conflict with the Nine Mountain Realm would inevitably erupt.
After all, Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu were connected to the overall strength of the Qinghua state and its Martial Arts future.
In just a few short years, the Qinghua state had undergone earth-shaking changes, and its Martial Arts strength had improved significantly. Everyone recognized the benefits of Formations and Pills.
Moreover, prodigies from major powers were studying Alchemy and Formations at the Alchemical Medical Institute and Qimen Institute. If either Fang Hao or Su Lingxiu were to die, the loss would be unimaginable.
Moreover, Tian Shiqi even hinted that he wouldn't rule out a sneak attack to assassinate the powerhouse behind the scenes of Qimen Institute and Alchemical Medical Institute, namely Li Xuan!
"This Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow is truly malicious. But where do they get the confidence to do this?"
Red Cat muttered to herself in secret.
"So, the big guy Meng Chong has been targeted for assassination ever since he arrived in the Nine Mountain Realm," Red Cat marveled.
Could it be that Tian Shiqi was preparing to act personally?
Wind Spirit Tiger was also astonished. Tian Shiqi was actually this insane?
Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow was somewhat crazed in their pursuit of 'Unity of Domain'.
"Tian Shiqi, you can talk about doing it first. The immortals of the Nine Mountain Realm and Qinghua state aren't fools. And besides, if Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow becomes exposed, everyone will know it was your doing."
Tian Shiqi smiled slightly and said, "Wind Spirit King, you underestimate Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow too much, and who would truly believe that Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow could achieve this step?
"Even if they knew and were convinced it was Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's doing, wouldn't trying to suppress Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow still lead to turbulence in the Divine Realm?
"The goal would still be achieved. What do you think, Wind Spirit Tiger?"
Wind Spirit Tiger smiled and said, "Then, let us see your capabilities and whether you are worthy of cooperation."
He paused, then continued, "Don't think about targeting Spiritual Sovereign Mountain and disturbing my peace, or else don't blame me for taking action!"
Tian Shiqi smiled, "Of course!"
He mocked inwardly, noting that the brains of Spirit Beasts ultimately weren't very useful. All other forces in the Nine Mountain Realm had problems, yet Spiritual Sovereign Mountain had none to speak of. How would the other forces view this?
"Wind Spirit King, wait for the news from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow. I shall take my leave!"
Tian Shiqi bid farewell and left.
After Tian Shiqi left, Red Cat spoke up, "Big Brother, once the other forces encounter problems, our Spiritual Sovereign Mountain has to create some commotion too. We can't be completely uninvolved."
"Why?"
Wind Spirit Tiger asked in confusion.
"Because all of Nine Mountains are connected branches sharing the same root, once everyone has issues, it will put everyone at ease. It will be easier to obtain information from one another, which is greatly beneficial to us."
Red Cat said cheerfully.
She didn't bother explaining in detail to Wind Spirit Tiger. In Red Cat's view, Wind Spirit Tiger wasn't very sharp, so there was no need to waste energy explaining.
"Big Brother, don't worry. I will arrange everything properly. We will surely make a profit without suffering losses!"
Red Cat said, patting her chest.
"I trust your judgment on this, dear brother!"
Wind Spirit Tiger nodded.
He was happy to leave these troublesome matters to his clever brother while he continued to enjoy the reverence that came with being Tiger King.
Having unexpectedly learned of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's plot, which even included plans to attack Fang Hao or Su Lingxiu, even considering it's unlikely to succeed, there was still the possibility of causing damage.
Even the loss of some Pills was distressing to a tiger's heart.
Therefore, Red Cat immediately sought out Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha.
"Brother Three, you need to return to Qinghua state immediately and relay the conspiracy of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow..."
Red Cat looked towards Little Ha.
They needed to return to Qinghua state before Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow took control of the Nine Mountains Realm Gate. Otherwise, once the Realm Gate was controlled, they would be unable to return through the Realm Gate and would have to travel a long distance to get back to Qinghua state.
Time would then become critical.
"No problem!"
Little Ha nodded, shrinking into the form of a little toad with an unobtrusive aura, and swiftly departed.
Being a Mountain Devourer Toad and having cultivated the Great Demon Method, it had also developed a Demon Clan Divine Skill specializing in a technique of concealment, which did not easily attract attention.
This was why Red Cat had asked Little Ha to go back and spread the news.
Yu Xiaolong was, after all, a Flood Dragon, which was much more conspicuous. After all, Flood Dragon-kind Spirit Beasts were rare, and one of the twelve beasts of the Divine Realm was the Jiao King.
Red Cat then sought a Spiritual Sovereign Gate elder and, on behalf of Wind Spirit Tiger, instructed him to escort Yu Xiaolong to Dahai Mountain.
The purpose of going to Dahai Mountain was naturally to alert Meng Chong and Xu Yan. The range of the Communication Talisman was ultimately limited, but with Meng Chong and Xu Yan at Dahai Mountain, once the range was narrowed, it would be easier to make contact through a Communication Talisman.
After all arrangements were made, Red Cat began to deploy her plans.
Additionally, it was time to consider how to extract enough benefits from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow. Their seeking cooperation with Wind Spirit Tiger presented an opportunity.

chapters.title: Chapter 769 - 404 Reporting the News, Heaven Lifting Earth Extinguishing_2
chapters.content:
From this, it can also be known that the strength of the Wind Spirit Tiger must be at the top within the Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm.
Red Cat felt that the strength of the Wind Spirit Tiger was even stronger than Emperor Da Yue's.
"When will I be able to surpass it?"
Red Cat sighed to itself.
It was a Great Demon King, and now, because its strength was inferior to the tiger's, it could only play second fiddle, feeling quite dissatisfied.
Moreover, because its strength wasn't strong enough, the Great Demon Method couldn't yet be taught to other spirit beasts; it could only continue to lie low and develop.
…
In Da Yue Country, Tianwu Sect, Myriad Thunder Sect, and even the entire Qinghua state, there was an undercurrent surging — all beginning with the rooting out of the traitors.
All three major powers in Qinghua state were taking action, and it was precisely because of their vigilance that an Immortal Heavenly Venerable personally took charge of investigating the Sects, which led to the unearthing of some Earth Shadow Members.
But no valuable information was obtained.
These infiltrators, once they found themselves exposed, would decisively perish by their own hands.
It was for this reason that these Immortal Heavenly Venerables took the matter extremely seriously, their expressions grave, as such loyal spies hidden within the Sects must be scheming something significant.
Even among the Immortal Heavenly Venerables themselves, could there be issues?
Or could it be that all spies had been routed out?
The cleansing operation was still ongoing. Since the Heavenly Grotto was suppressed, Qinghua state held the advantage, hence these Immortal Heavenly Venerables could spare the effort.
For Li Xuan, the tumult in Da Yue Country, and even the entire Qinghua state, wasn't worth mentioning; he didn't pay much attention to it.
He was still wholeheartedly devoted to his great cause of Martial Arts.
"The seventeenth page, finally, it is memorized," he said.
Li Xuan closed the Book of Taicang and exhaled a breath of air.
The Book of Taicang had already had seventeen pages memorized, with only the last page left to completely memorize the Book of Taicang and to fully master the Dao Principles of the Taicang Domain.
To be precise, the entire core of the Taicang Domain Origin would be under his control.
Including the operation and formation of the Taicang Domain and so forth.
Li Xuan had a premonition that the Dao Principle synopsis on the eighteenth page encompassed the entire Taicang Domain Origin, even including the source of the Domain's birth.
"The master of the Book of Taicang might just be a Supreme Expert who transcends the Domain," he reflected.
Li Xuan was almost certain at this point that the master of the Book of Taicang must have transcended the Domain; otherwise, it would have been impossible to describe all the Principles and Dao Principles of the Taicang Domain.
"Such a powerful being, where has he gone? The Book of Taicang was found in the treasure trove of the Wu Country Royal Palace, and that mysterious voice in Wu Country's Mysterious Stone House..."
Li Xuan couldn't help but fall into deep thought.
The person in the Mysterious Stone House, was it the master of the Book of Taicang or a being sealed by the master of the Book of Taicang?
"Once I have completely mastered the Book of Taicang and my strength has increased a bit more, I will be able to go and have a chat with him," he planned.
With the profoundness of his Minor Heavenly Path Eye, and the mastery of the Taicang Domain Dao Principles, he wouldn't be deceived by the other's whereabouts.
As long as he found the other party, the secrets of the Taicang Domain would all be within his grasp.
"I wonder when Xu Yan will be able to perceive the Martial Arts Techniques of the Domain Realm."
Li Xuan pondered; he had already developed the Martial Arts Techniques above the Domain Realm, and he had a clear direction for the further path of Martial Arts.
"I wonder if Meng Chong is still being hunted."
Within the Spirit Pedestal, the Primordial Spirit opened its eyes and looked towards the Daoist Golden Book.
"Wu Tianan isn't bad, his strength has improved again, and Xie Tianheng is also decent..."
Through some connections with these people, Li Xuan could sense the changes in their strength.
"The Great Wilderness is also getting stronger."
More and more Great Wilderness Warriors were emerging, and the upper limit of their strength was increasing. Xu Junhe had already reached the later stages of the Divine Intent Realm; he was the number one power in the Great Wilderness and not far from the Divine Origin Realm.
"Spiritual Energy is no longer inferior to the Spiritual Realm."
After arrangements were made in the Great Wilderness, Spiritual Energy continuously improved, and over the years, the level of Spiritual Energy was not much less than that of the Spiritual Realm.
In a few more years, the Spiritual Energy of the Great Wilderness might even surpass that of the Spiritual Realm.
```
However, the Spiritual Realm will probably undergo changes as well, with Spiritual Energy also increasing to reach an equilibrium with the Great Wilderness.
"Your disciple Meng Chong has comprehended the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path; as a result, your Minor Heavenly Path Eye has been enhanced."
The feedback from the Daoist Golden Book arrived.
Meng Chong had understood the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path.
"Meng Chong's Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path differs from Xu Yan's. Now that mine has been added to his, it has become even stronger,"
The Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path that Meng Chong had perceived was different from Xu Yan's. For instance, he lacked that virtual eye in the center of his forehead, but within his two eyes, there was the added appearance of a great sun.
It possessed the power to deter demons and burn away impurities, and its might was exceedingly astonishing.
"Su Lingxiu, that girl, is still a little behind. The Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path that she comprehends will also be different. Each martial art comprehended brings its own variations,"
Li Xuan decided to call Su Lingxiu over and give her further guidance, to help her understand the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path sooner. In this way, with the convergence of the Eyes from the three martial arts, his own Minor Heavenly Path Eye would be even stronger.
After giving guidance to Su Lingxiu, Li Xuan began to delve into the eighteenth page of the Book of Taicang.
With just one look, he found it incredibly profound, as if he were witnessing an illusory domain manifesting within it, unable to memorize each and every pattern.
"The comprehensive principles of the Domain Dao, truly profound indeed. Even with my Void-breaking Realm strength, I find it extremely challenging!"
The more he struggled, the more Li Xuan marveled at the strength of the Book of Taicang's author.
"Even if I break through to the Domain Realm, I will not be a match for the author of the Book of Taicang."
From this, Li Xuan surmised that even Domain Realm strength would not compare to the author's.
"But I am not far off. A level above the Domain Realm should be similar, essentially transcending the domain; I should not be much weaker,"
Li Xuan pondered deeply.
The strength of the author of the Book of Taicang, just how strong was it actually? It was impossible to estimate because the Book of Taicang was left behind by their stroke of the pen. If composing this book was simply a flick of the hand for them, then their strength would far surpass any estimation based on the book itself.
"At most, not beyond three realms, so actually, I'm not so far from the strength of the Book of Taicang's author after all,"
Li Xuan murmured to himself.
"Xu Yan, you need to step up your game, quickly comprehend the Domain Realm so that I can pass on to you the realms above it. It's all on you whether I'll ever surpass the author of the Book of Taicang."
Li Xuan held immense confidence in his own martial arts undertaking.
"Your disciple Meng Chong has mastered the Heavenly Lifting Earth Extinguishing divine skill. Your Heavenly Lifting Earth Extinguishing has reached fruition,"
Li Xuan, immersed in memorizing the last page of the Book of Taicang, suddenly received feedback from the Daoist Golden Book.
"Hiss! Meng Chong actually deciphered this divine skill?"
Li Xuan was somewhat astonished.
Heaven Lifting Earth Extinguishing, this Great Divine Power, was one he had specifically designed for Physical Body Martial Arts, showcasing the ferocity of physical strength with overwhelming divine skill.
Upon execution, it was as if a titanic figure lifting the heavens, forcibly smashing down, carrying the authority to extinguish the earth.
This strike was the epitome of brutality.
Of course, the titanic figure that appeared during the execution of the divine skill was merely a vision of physical strength and did not truly transform into such a giant. Even so, it was extremely shocking.
Moreover, according to Li Xuan's design for this divine skill, once one's realm improves to a certain extent, one would truly transform into a Heaven Lifting Giant when using the divine skill.
He had thought Meng Chong's current realm would not permit the comprehension of this skill.
Unexpectedly, Meng Chong had comprehended this skill while still in the Divine Skill Realm.
"Could it be that being pursued has triggered his potential?"
Li Xuan thought with surprise.
No matter the reason, Meng Chong's comprehension of this divine skill added a mightily powerful skill to his arsenal.
Shortly after Meng Chong comprehended the Heaven Lifting Earth Extinguishing skill, the Daoist Golden Book provided another feedback.
"Your disciple Meng Chong has understood the divine skill Vajra Wrath Thunder Palm. Your Vajra Wrath Thunder Palm has reached fruition."
This too was a divine skill from the Divine Skill Martial Code. Although not as potent as Heaven Lifting Earth Extinguishing, it was still one of the Great Divine Powers. When executed, a Vajra Giant Hand would appear, filled with the image of thunderous rage, and strike down with tremendous force.
"Very good, very good. Both my first and second disciples are beginning to show their talent, contributing to the martial arts undertaking. Su Lingxiu, that girl, has to work hard as well.
"And Fang Hao, it's time for Qimen Martial Art to break new ground. You must enhance my Qimen Martial Art as well.
"Jiang Buping, this kid, is just a little short of becoming an Extreme Soul Warrior,"
Li Xuan felt that he had indeed worried too much over his three disciples.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 770 - 405: The Eye of the Heavenly Dao, Undercurrents Surge
chapters.content:
Li Xuan couldn't help himself, so he called over Su Lingxiu again to give her some guidance and incidentally apply some pressure on her.
And then, it was Fang Hao's turn.
In greater detail, he spent more time guiding him in the Qimen Martial Arts, broadening its scope to encourage Fang Hao to devote more time to comprehend the more expansive future path of the Qimen Martial Arts.
In the end, he gave some guidance to Jiang Buping and then let him continue his seclusion.
After finishing all this, feeling great, Li Xuan also provided guidance on Divine Skills cultivation to Cai Ling'er and incidentally to Moon Changming and Yue'er as well.
Lastly, naturally, it was time to guide Shi'er, Meng Shushu, and Zhou Ying.
By now, the three of them had already become Martial Artists of the Divine Origin Realm.
But this level of strength was still at the bottom tier in the Divine Realm.
In the end, by harnessing the ability of his demonic ancestor's true form, Li Xuan also provided guidance to Red Cat, feeling that his pet cat too should put in some effort.
After guiding Red Cat, without waiting for it to say anything, Li Xuan immediately withdrew his demonic ancestor's true form and left Red Cat's dream.
"Continue comprehending the Book of Taicang!"
Li Xuan once again focused his mind on the Book of Taicang.
Time slipped away in the comprehension of the Book of Taicang, and after several rounds of guidance, the rewards finally came.
"Your disciple Fang Hao has gained a clear understanding on the advanced path of Qimen Martial Arts, enhancing your Qimen Martial Arts to the Void-breaking Realm."
At last, the Qimen Martial Arts had advanced.
"All four Martial Arts have reached the Void-breaking Realm, my strength has grown stronger."
Li Xuan smiled broadly.
With the combination of four realms of Martial Arts, even an Immortal Heavenly Venerable could be crushed with a mere flick of a finger.
Even for powerful Immortal Heavenly Venerables like Emperor Da Yue, it would be the same.
"Have I become invincible in the Divine Realm?"
Li Xuan pondered.
Whether he was invincible in the Divine Realm was yet to be seen, but one thing was certain, he had not yet reached the invincibility across Heaven and Earth.
"I must continue to work hard."
After Fang Hao gained clarity on the path to advance in Qimen Martial Arts, Su Lingxiu also had her moment of realization.
"Your disciple Su Lingxiu has comprehended the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path, thus your Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path has been enhanced."
Under his guidance, Su Lingxiu finally achieved enlightenment of the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path.
"If it weren't for my hard work in teaching, who knows when she would have comprehended the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path. Still, my eldest disciple is amazing, managing to comprehend it without my guidance."
Li Xuan mused inwardly that among his five disciples, Xu Yan was truly the most prodigious.
He is indeed the pioneer of my Martial Arts.
Su Lingxiu's Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path, as well as the ones possessed by Meng Chong and Xu Yan, were different, belonging to the unique abilities of Alchemical Medical Warriors.
"With the three Eyes of the Minor Heavenly Path combined, your Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path has evolved into the Eye of the Heavenly Dao."
The feedback from the Daoist Golden Book continued to come.
Li Xuan was overjoyed at this unexpected gain.
The combination of the three Martial Arts' Eyes of the Minor Heavenly Path had miraculously evolved into the Eye of the Heavenly Dao!
In that instant, Li Xuan looked up at the firmament and saw everything differently.
The Eye of the Heavenly Dao sees through all things.
It also possesses even more mystical abilities.
"Heaven and Earth Laws, Domain Dao Rules, what is that..."
In that moment, Li Xuan perceived something above the Heaven and Earth Laws as if it were another domain altogether.
"Above the Divine Realm..."
Li Xuan withdrew his gaze, his heart pounding with the realization that the place close to the Dao Principles, above the Divine Realm, was the true core of Heaven and Earth, or perhaps, where the origins of Heaven and Earth reside.
"Are the powerful beings above the Immortals all there?"
Li Xuan murmured to himself.
The Taicang Domain had some issues, as if a Great Formation based on Dao Principles had separated the domains, and the central area was the core of Heaven and Earth, where the true strongest entities converged.
Just by taking such a glance, he caught a glimpse of the core secrets of Heaven and Earth. Li Xuan, while admiring the power of the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, also felt the weight of the realization.
I am still too weak.
Otherwise, why would the Eye of the Heavenly Dao reveal only such a small mystery?
"Who knows what upheaval has occurred in the Taicang Domain."
Li Xuan pondered.
To better understand the true secrets of the Taicang Domain, the little stone house in the Wu Country Royal Palace was a good pathway.
"Memorize the Book of Taicang quickly, enhance my realm as soon as possible."
Li Xuan continued looking at the general outline of the Book of Taicang, which appeared different at the moment.
Under the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, it seemed as if he could penetrate to the essence, and it no longer seemed so obscure and difficult to comprehend.
Moreover, as Li Xuan glanced at the Book of Taicang, he would look up at the Dao Principles. The operation of the Domain Dao Rules seemed to correspond with the Book of Taicang.
"This Dao Rule applies in this way, I see now!"
The more Li Xuan observed, the clearer he became on the Domain Dao Rules.
"This Dao Rule can be used in this manner, and can transmit messages across the entire domain..."
The more he observed, the more excited Li Xuan became, feeling the joy of continuous enlightenment and the upliftment of his strength.
"I already have an idea about the two realms above the Domain Realm, surpassing the origin of Heaven and Earth seems not too difficult after all."
As his understanding of the Domain Dao Rules deepened, Li Xuan became clearer on the path to transcend Heaven and Earth, and was more confident about how to achieve it.
While Li Xuan aligned the principles of the Book of Taicang with the Domain Dao Rules and memorized them one by one, Little Ha finally returned to Da Yue Country, back to Qimen Institute, and found Fang Hao.
"Little Ha, are you saying that this 'Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow' is about to target my sister-disciple and me? Possibly even our master?"
Fang Hao was greatly shocked.
He immediately sought out Su Lingxiu and told her about the conspiracy of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
"We can't take this lightly, perhaps we should inform Emperor Da Yue."
Moon Changming said gravely.
"I'll go tell master!"
Su Lingxiu hurried off to find their master.
"It's a small matter."
After hearing the news, Li Xuan said indifferently.

chapters.title: Chapter 771 - 405 Eye of the Heavenly Dao, Undercurrent Surging_2
chapters.content:
What's with this Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, they're quite bold, aren't they? Not only attempting to assassinate Meng Chong and Xu Yan, but they also dare to sneak attacks and ambush here?
Even harboring the thought of ambushing me?
Who gave them such courage?
"Master, will the eldest senior brother and the second senior brother be alright?"
Su Lingxiu said worriedly.
"It's not a big problem."
Li Xuan was unperturbed.
The life-saving Jade Charms he had given his disciples had not been activated, which meant that Meng Chong and Xu Yan, even if they were attacked, had not encountered real danger.
"Rest assured, all those cats and dogs can't deceive your master's eyes."
Li Xuan said with a smile.
The power of the Eye of the Heavenly Dao was immense; all secrets, all ill intentions, could not escape his detection.
"Then I'm relieved."
Su Lingxiu breathed a sigh of relief.
"You girl should work harder and cultivate a few more Divine Skills. It'll be good for you."
Li Xuan had the air of a strict teacher.
"Understood, Master!"
After Su Lingxiu left, Li Xuan fell into contemplation.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow wants to create instability in the Divine Realm, Unity of Domain? And there's an even more powerful figure above the immortals pulling the strings behind the scenes..."
He looked up at the firmament, deep in thought.
Under the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, in this Domain, he could see even more differences and had gained a deeper understanding.
"Inner Domain, Spiritual Realm, Divine Realm..."
Li Xuan was beginning to understand the objectives of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow. The so-called Unity of Domain was about breaking down the barriers; from that point on, the Inner Domain, Spiritual Realm, Divine Realm... would no longer be separate.
"Disruptions in the Divine Realm cannot achieve Unity of Domain. The way this world is divided, it's not that simple."
Li Xuan shook his head. Could turmoil in the Divine Realm lead to Unity of Domain?
That thought was far too naive; perhaps the turmoil was only the first step, with further actions to follow.
"Let's see how you all will stir things up, but since you've involved me, be prepared to be destroyed. I, as a hermit, do not act lightly, but when I do, I aim to kill the real mastermind."
Li Xuan looked up at the firmament once more, gauging that his current power might not be strong enough.
"I'm curious to see what kind of expert from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow thinks they can sneak attack and plot against me."
Li Xuan sneered internally.
With his disciple right under his watch, if she were to be harmed, where would that leave the reputation of himself, the hermit?
As for poisoning the pills and causing various upheavals, that was a concern for Emperor Da Yue, the heads of Tianwu Sect and Myriad Thunder Sect.
The most anxious ones were them.
"Could such a thing have actually happened?"
Emperor Da Yue's expression changed abruptly after hearing Moon Changming's account.
"Emperor Da Yue, what sort of power is Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow?"
Moon Changming asked in a grave tone.
"I have also only just heard of this power,"
Emperor Da Yue said with a solemn expression.
Different from Moon Changming, Emperor Da Yue realized upon learning about Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow and its goals that this was a deeply hidden force.
It was likely not only present in the Nine Mountain Realm, Qinghua state, but possibly spread across all thirty-six realms of the Divine Realm. Now the time had come for them to surface.
"This matter, I will resolve it. Tell Brother Fang and Miss Su, they need not worry about the dirty tricks in the shadows; we will naturally take care of them,"
Emperor Da Yue took a deep breath and said with a grave voice.
"Understood!"
Moon Changming bowed and left.
As Moon Changming departed, Emperor Da Yue immediately summoned Sui Hongwu.
"You go personally to Tianwu Sect and Myriad Thunder Sect and tell them about this matter. For now, do not alarm them; this is also a chance to root out those in hiding..."
Emperor Da Yue instructed.
"Yes, Your Majesty!"
Sui Hongwu nodded gravely.
"Feng Yan has been delayed in returning to the Nine Mountain Realm, could it possibly be related to Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow?"
Emperor Da Yue pondered then spoke.
"Impossible! Brother Feng Yan has always been rather carefree but he's also a person of detailed thoughts. He has seen his own opportunity, which is why he stayed. He's a recluse with no subordinates in the Nine Mountain Realm, Seven Segments Mountain."
Sui Hongwu shook his head and responded.
Emperor Da Yue nodded; if Feng Yan had a problem, would that senior have allowed him to stay?
Moreover, under the watchful eyes of that predecessor, Feng Yan, although an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, couldn't really do anything.
In the Qimen Institute, just after Feng Yan came back and put down some precious materials and Divine Medicine he had collected, he was bewildered to see Fang Hao and others surrounding him.
"What's wrong? What happened?"
Feng Yan felt a bit panicked under their gaze.
Were they planning to send him away?
That wouldn't make sense, though. He always worked hard, diligently cultivating Divine Skills; there was no reason for them to send him away.
Neither Moon Changming, Meng Shushu, nor Shi'er could replace him, after all, his strength was far superior to theirs.
"Brother Feng Yan, I feel like you're in a bit of danger."
Fang Hao said thoughtfully.
"Danger?"
Feng Yan was surprised. After all, he was an Immortal Heavenly Venerable and had also cultivated Divine Skills; even Emperor Da Yue wouldn't easily be able to kill him.
If he couldn't beat them, he still could manage to escape.
Feng Yan was confident that if he had had his current strength back then, he wouldn't have been left in crisis by Xuezhi Tu.
"Does the predecessor have something against me?"
That was the first thought that came to his mind.
Unless the high-ranking expert harbored discontent toward him, and could slap him to death with the palm of his hand, there would be no danger to speak of.
He constantly reviewed his recent actions in his mind; none of them should have incurred the senior's displeasure.
"Do you know what Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow is?"
Fang Hao asked in a grave tone.
"I don't know."
Feng Yan shook his head, "What is Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow?"
Fang Hao told Feng Yan about Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, and how they were plotting against him and Su Lingxiu. He finished with, "You are the strongest among us, so you will be the first they will try to eliminate or lure away. That's why you are in danger."
Feng Yan's expression became solemn, but he was not the least bit afraid, saying, "Rest assured, no matter how big the trouble, it won't lure me away, and as for anyone wanting to kill me, no one below the rank of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable could ever achieve that.
"And as for the Immortal Heavenly Venerables, sneaking past me is absolutely impossible!"
Fang Hao nodded, "Just be a little careful on your own!"
"With me, Feng Yan, here, no dogs or cats can even dream of sneaking in!"
Feng Yan's eyes widened with excitement, sensing an opportunity to prove his worth and show his own value had arrived.
The Qimen Institute and Alchemical Medical Institute were business as usual, with Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu occasionally taking the time to instruct the talents studying Formation and Alchemy.
Most of their time was devoted to their own Martial Arts cultivation.
That also held true for people like Shi'er, Meng Shushu, and Zhou Ying.
Only Feng Yan began to investigate each person in the Qimen Institute and Alchemical Medical Institute one by one, to ensure that all was secure. He personally manned the entrance, rigorously inspecting everyone entering, even those he was familiar with had to be checked by him before they could enter.
"I refuse to believe any assassin from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow can sneak past me, an Immortal Heavenly Venerable!"
Feng Yan sneered to himself.
In the Qinghua state, the three major forces had already joined hands, covertly maneuvering to take advantage of this opportunity to eradicate the lurking Earth Shadow Members.
Whether it was Formations or Pills, both were crucial to their core interests and vital to the rise of Martial Arts in the Qinghua state. Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's actions had crossed their red line.
The undercurrents surged in the outside world, but the Capital City of Da Yue Country, especially the Qimen Institute and Alchemical Medical Institute, remained as serene as before besides Feng Yan standing guard at the gateway, strictly monitoring those who entered and left. No waves were stirred.
Li Xuan remained composed as ever, continuing to delve into the Book of Taicang, racking his brains over his grand Martial Arts endeavor.
"Your disciple Meng Chong has made a breakthrough in the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body; your Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body has reached minor completion on the second layer."
Feedback from the Daoist Golden Book arrived.
Meng Chong had made a breakthrough, stepping into the Physiognomy Realm and successfully cultivating the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body.
"Your disciple Meng Chong has completely refined it, transforming into a Diamond Sacred Body, rewarding you with the Innate Indestructible Mountain-River Diamond Sacred Body."
Li Xuan felt utterly refreshed.
"Indeed, the greatest happiness in the world is the increase in strength!"
Meng Chong had broken through to the Physiognomy Realm, and Su Lingxiu was also entering the stage of accumulating essence; it wouldn't be long before she made her breakthrough.
The same was true for Fang Hao. His Qimen Martial Art was not far from the level of Physiognomy Realm.
"I have a premonition that the Domain Realm is not far off."
Li Xuan was full of anticipation; entering the Domain Realm would be a giant leap.
Truly stepping onto a path transcending the world.
"With Meng Chong's breakthrough, he should be preparing to take revenge on Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow."
Li Xuan muttered to himself.
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow probably would take action personally, and it seemed as if he might also have an opportunity to make a move?
"Hmm?"
Suddenly, Li Xuan's brows lifted, and he looked towards the sky, revealing a trace of astonishment.

chapters.title: Chapter 772 - 406 Ant Tricks, Turn to Ashes and Oblivion
chapters.content:
In the skies outside the Capital City of Da Yue Country, a figure quietly approached, seamlessly blending into the clouds, undetected even by Emperor Da Yue himself.
Because Immortal Heavenly Venerables are in harmony with Domain, possessing the ability to govern a piece of Domain, it is very difficult for an Immortal Heavenly Venerable to remain hidden and deceive other Immortals.
Let alone to silently infiltrate a Domain governed by an Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
Yet someone had done it!
"Interesting."
Li Xuan was somewhat surprised. The power behind Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow was truly deserving of its reputation, controlled by a being stronger than Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
The person in the clouds was an Immortal Heavenly Venerable—I/weaker than Emperor Da Yue, yet stronger than Sui Hongwu.
Among the Immortal Heavenly Venerables, he was not the strongest, but neither was he the weakest.
His face was covered with a murky mask, etched with seven leaves.
"Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter? No, that's not right. Little Ha mentioned the Ferocious Mask, not a murky one."
His gaze settled on the black robe worn by the individual. This garment carried a whiff of Dao Rhythm within it.
It was this reason that separated the figure from the Domain Power, remaining unnoticed by the Immortal who governed this piece of Domain.
"This garment could not have been made by an Immortal Heavenly Venerable; it has to encapsulate a thread of Dao Rhythm to work."
Li Xuan could be certain that this garment was crafted by the power behind Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, bestowed upon these Heavenly Slaughters for their missions.
Beyond the robe, this Immortal Heavenly Venerable was also highly skilled in the art of stealth.
The assassin, like a shadow within the clouds, drifted over the skies of Capital City of Da Yue Country, scoured the area, and set his sights on the Qimen Institute and the Alchemical Medical Institute.
The individual didn't strike immediately, but waited quietly, as if for the right moment.
"If he were to approach the royal palace of Da Yue Country, even with the robe's concealment, he couldn't hide from Emperor Da Yue. However, at this distance, if no Immortal Heavenly Venerable intervened, his single blow would kill everyone in the Alchemical Medical Institute and Qimen Institute."
Li Xuan watched with interest, saying nothing.
Then, looking up at the Firmament, he murmured, "I wonder how the power behind the scenes compares to mine now, with them not being in the Divine Realm."
He sneered, "Although I'm only in the Void-breaking Realm, I might not be able to kill one with a single slap, but that does not necessarily mean they are my match.
"Dare to target my disciple? When my strength increases, I'll let them know the consequences of provoking a superior!"
"Huh, this Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow is quite sly."
Suddenly, Li Xuan raised his eyebrows in surprise.
An Immortal Heavenly Venerable from the Nine Mountain Realm had come to visit Emperor Da Yue, seemingly on an urgent matter.
Feng Yan's eyebrows shot up in amazement, "Why has Ping Qiu from Broken Dawn Mountain come? What has happened?"
Broken Dawn Mountain, one of the Nine Mountains of the Nine Mountain Realm—with Ping Qiu being an Immortal Heavenly Venerable from there.
"Should we go and see?"
Feng Yan was curious.
"No, we can't leave!"
Taking a deep breath to quell his curiosity, he continued his vigilant watch.
"Brother Ping Qiu, what brings you here?"
Emperor Da Yue received Ping Qiu.
"Emperor Da Yue, something big has happened."
Ping Qiu's face was a picture of grave seriousness.
Emperor Da Yue asked curiously, "What major event has occurred? Is it turbulence in the Heavenly Grotto of the Nine Mountain Realm that needs support?"
"It's not about the Heavenly Grotto."
Ping Qiu took a deep breath, his expression solemn as he said, "Emperor Da Yue, have you heard of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow?"
Emperor Da Yue looked puzzled, "Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow? I have not heard of it."
Ping Qiu disclosed information about Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's plans, perfectly matching the intelligence Little Ha had brought back, even including some bits that Little Ha had not known.
Emperor Da Yue was taken aback, "Is this true?"
"Absolutely certain!"
Ping Qiu's expression grew even more somber as he revealed another piece of information that shocked Emperor Da Yue.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow seems to have secretly reached an agreement with the Heavenly Grotto, calm has returned to the Heavenly Grottoes of the Nine Mountain Realm, and some enemies from beyond are retreating from the Heavenly Grotto.
"Moreover, Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow will soon cause significant chaos in the Divine Realm."
Now Emperor Da Yue was truly alarmed.
Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow conspiring with the Heavenly Grotto—were they planning to collaborate internally and externally, utilizing outside forces to achieve Unity of Domain?
Following Ping Qiu's arrival and the intelligence he provided, shock waves ran through the ranks of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables. After delivering his message to Emperor Da Yue, Ping Qiu hurried off to Tianwu Sect and Myriad Thunder Sect.
"This Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow doesn't care if its plans are exposed. They only have one goal—to plunge the Divine Realm into chaos.
"Whether it's mutual slaughter or unifying to root out Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow... "
Li Xuan sighed internally; Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow was a group of fanatics.
Driven by their so-called Unity of Domain, and to restore the glory of Domain, they have become somewhat frenzied.
"Has the time still not come? What are they waiting for to strike?"
Li Xuan glanced toward the assassin hidden among the clouds.
Several days later, Ping Qiu returned, this time from Myriad Thunder Sect.
This sequence of actions dispelled the suspicion of Emperor Da Yue and others, making them believe he truly came to pass on critical knowledge.
"Quite clever indeed."
Li Xuan nodded in acknowledgment, his curiosity piqued about what the duo's next move would be.
Two Immortal Heavenly Venerables—one profoundly hidden and the other out in the open. Could they be targeting him, preparing for an ambush?

chapters.title: Chapter 773 - 406 Ant Tricks, Turn to Ashes and Oblivion_2
chapters.content:
"Could they really be coming for me?"
Li Xuan muttered, suddenly feeling excited.
"Let's see how you're going to make your move."
Li Xuan still seemed as if he hadn't noticed anything, silently waiting.
Before long, Ping Qiu and Emperor Da Yue arrived.
It was at Ping Qiu's request. After learning of the miraculous effects of the Formation and Pills, he pleaded with Emperor Da Yue to meet Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu in person to buy the Array Plates and Pills.
The purpose, of course, was to strengthen the defenses of Broken Dawn Mountain, to guard against attacks from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
Emperor Da Yue pondered for a moment but couldn't just ignore Ping Qiu's face. After all, he was an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, representing Broken Dawn Mountain with good intentions.
So, he could only personally accompany Ping Qiu.
"Ping Qiu, what are you doing here?"
Feng Yan asked with a puzzled expression.
"Feng Yan? Since you are also here, it couldn't be better. Speak well on my behalf; I'm here to purchase Array Plates and Pills, and to visit Brother Fang Hao and Miss Su Lingxiu."
Ping Qiu was slightly surprised, then said cheerfully.
He hoped Feng Yan would put in a good word for him, considering their shared bond as Undying beings from the Nine Mountain Realm, helping him to smoothly acquire the Array Plates and Pills.
"No problem, as long as you can afford the treasures."
Feng Yan nodded.
Flattery or not, these were unimportant so long as Ping Qiu could afford the treasures. He would naturally be able to buy what he needed.
Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu were only interested in the treasures for selling their Array Plates and Pills.
Neither Emperor Da Yue nor Feng Yan suspected Ping Qiu, because after all these days, it had been confirmed that Ping Qiu was unproblematic.
If he were the assailant, would he reveal the plan of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow?
"It's time to make a move."
Li Xuan glanced at the Immortal Heavenly Venerable hidden within the clouds, who had now edged a bit closer. The distance was very skillfully maintained, close enough to not be detected by Emperor Da Yue, yet capable of unleashing a devastating strike in an instant.
At a glance, one could tell he was an experienced assassin.
Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu walked out. Ping Qiu was taking out treasures to negotiate the purchase of Array Plates and Pills, as well as to understand their usage.
He had no intention of attacking.
Even being so close, he did not entertain the thought of striking.
After all, Emperor Da Yue and Feng Yan were by his side. Even if he attacked suddenly, with his strength, it wasn't certain that he would succeed in killing his target.
Besides, there was also an unknown mysterious powerhouse present.
"The alarm Formation you need is this set right here, the most suitable. It covers a wide range, and once an outsider infiltrates, it will send out an alarm, activating the Formation's power..."
Fang Hao took out a set of Array Plates, explaining their function to Ping Qiu.
Boom!
Suddenly, a terrifying presence descended, swift and unparalleled. As the presence emerged, the powerful attack had already arrived.
"Be careful!"
Ping Qiu's face changed drastically as he surged with power, launching a fierce blow as if trying to counter the incoming attack.
Upon Emperor Da Yue's shifting expression, the Halberd was instantly in action, thunderously targeting the Immortal Heavenly Venerable who had suddenly descended from the clouds.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow?!"
Emperor Da Yue's heart roared with fury. An Immortal Heavenly Venerable had infiltrated their midst, and he had failed to notice. How had the attacker achieved this?
The terrifying power of the Domain poured down at that moment. As soon as the foe struck, it was a ferocious blow, not directed at him, nor at Feng Yan, but at Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu.
The strength of this strike was exceedingly broad and concealed a deadly threat. If one could not block it completely, even a slight spread of its remnant force could annihilate beings below the True King Heavenly Venerable.
"How dare you!"
Feng Yan roared in anger as a layer of rock-like strength emerged from him. Amidst the rumbling noise, a rock-like defense opened up, shielding Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu within it.
Thud!
A cold gleam of light suddenly stabbed at his defense. With a thud, it was as if the rock had been pierced through.
Feng Yan's complexion changed as his aura surged and he threw a punch, unleashing a potent force of annihilation, rising to the heavens, targeting the assailant.
The overwhelming power of destruction had even startled Emperor Da Yue. Could it be that Feng Yan possessed such formidable martial arts?
In terms of sheer oppressive force, the punch thrown by Feng Yan was far more violent than his halberd.
This was precisely the minor Divine Skill that Feng Yan had labored arduously to cultivate, the Great Demolition Fist.
"Die!"
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable attacking him suddenly surged with a chilling aura at that moment; his presence became frenzied, and he actually used a costly secret technique in that instant.
"Join forces to block him!"
Ping Qiu roared furiously, his momentum bursting forth, eyes bloodshot with seemingly uncontainable resentment toward the attacker.
Boom!
He made his move, a powerful strike aimed at the skies. In a flash, it seemed as if he wanted to shoot up into the heavens, intercepting the assailant.
However, in the blink of an eye, Ping Qiu suddenly pivoted, seizing the moment when Feng Yan's defenses were breached to tear through that rock-like barrier and raise his hand toward Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu for a deadly slash!
This sudden turn of events caught both Emperor Da Yue and Feng Yan completely off guard.
Ping Qiu had long since earned their trust.
And just before, he seemed to be exerting his full strength to fend off their assailant.
They had not anticipated that Ping Qiu himself was the true murderer!
"Ping Qiu!"
Emperor Da Yue couldn't contain his rage, but at that moment, he was utterly unable to turn back to rescue them.
Feng Yan's complexion reddened with fury, and he roared as he allowed the attacks from above to pour down on him. His body covered in rock-like armor, he prepared to use his own flesh to shield Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu from the assault, moving at the fastest speed in his life.
"I won't die! As long as I'm not dead, it's all worth it!"
Feng Yan thought to himself, gritting his teeth.
Li Xuan's lips twitched. Feng Yan, this old rascal, was really going all out to prove himself. But in front of himself, the respected master, the notion that his disciple would need someone to physically shield them from an attack, where would that leave his own face as a master?
He had been watching silently, wanting to see how Ping Qiu would cooperate with that person and whether the attack was meant for him. But the moment the person in the sky made a move, Li Xuan discerned that the target was not him.
It was Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu.
"This is interesting! Killing my disciple would certainly enrage me, thereby provoking me to strike back, sparking great chaos in the Divine Realm?"
Li Xuan instantly understood the enemy's intention.
Moreover, he was almost certain that Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow lurked within many major powers in the Divine Realm, some of which were occupied by prestigious and undying Heavenly Venerables.
To exterminate the Undying Heavenly Venerables would, to some extent, inevitably mean becoming the enemy of all the major powers.
"Hmph!"
A light snort from Li Xuan erupted like a clap of thunder, shaking the soul of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
Ping Qiu's attack had not yet reached Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu, and before Feng Yan could harness the attack from above to boost his own speed and shield them, a thunderous and supremely dominant Vajra Giant Hand suddenly emerged.
As the Vajra Giant Hand materialized, all attacks seemed to vanish like smoke, thunder rolling as if it could destroy worlds.
With a single grasp of the Vajra Giant Hand, Ping Qiu was caught within its grip. No matter how desperately he struggled or how madly he attacked, it was all futile.
Thunderous waves clashed, and the tyrannical Vajra Giant Hand snapped shut without so much as allowing Ping Qiu's scream of agony to escape before he was reduced to ashes.
The Vajra Giant Hand reached out into the sky, and the Undying Heavenly Venerable who had launched the attack was struck with utter horror. Despite exerting all his might and using some secret techniques, he couldn't escape at all.
"Dare you play tricks before me, you ant?"
An authoritative voice rang out, and with the tightening of the Vajra Giant Hand amidst thunderous rage, the attacker was obliterated.
All attacks, all ferocious powers of the Undying Heavenly Venerable, were smoothed out at that moment.
From the start of the ambush to the treachery of Ping Qiu, it had all happened in the blink of an eye. Moon Changming and the others hadn't even had the chance to react when everything calmed under the rumbling Vajra Giant Hand.
The aftermath of the Undying Heavenly Venerable battle had not even had time to spread before it was quieted.
It was as if nothing had happened, and the onslaught of the Undying Heavenly Venerable had been nothing more than an illusion!
But Emperor Da Yue and Feng Yan were profoundly shaken.
Indeed, their senior was unfathomably powerful.
"In front of a master like him, Ping Qiu's sneak attack is merely a joke. The master had already seen through everything, merely watching as if it were a play," Emperor Da Yue sighed to himself.
Feng Yan, however, was filled with remorse, "How dull of me! I failed to detect Ping Qiu as the true assassin. Otherwise, I might have at least used my body to block his attack. Such a chance to prove myself and earn merit wasted!"

chapters.title: Chapter 774 - 407 Innate Indestructible Sacred Body, Domain Trembles
chapters.content:
Li Xuan still sat on the chair, as calm and composed as ever, as if he hadn't made a move just moments before, perfectly embodying the image of an inscrutable and profound expert.
"Carry on with what you were doing."
Li Xuan stopped Emperor Da Yue from coming over to thank him with a gesture.
He glanced down at the long robe in his hand, which belonged to the assailant who had infiltrated undetected by the Emperor Da Yue using this very garment.
With a wave of his hand, he passed the long robe to Fang Hao for him to study on his own.
"Work hard on your cultivation. You guys are still too weak."
Li Xuan sighed with a helpless expression on his face.
He must put some pressure on his disciples; they couldn't afford to become too comfortable and slack off.
"Understood, Master!"
Su Lingxiu panted heavily, resenting the attackers from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, who had dared to launch a stealth attack from the Immortal Heavenly Venerable directly against her and her fellow disciple, going too far in their affront.
"Broken Dawn Mountain, could it be an overt force affiliated with Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow?"
Emperor Da Yue was seething with rage, and this matter could not be left as it was.
Feng Yan was equally infuriated; he had intended to return to the Nine Mountain Realm to settle scores with Broken Dawn Mountain, but what if another assassin came while he was away?
If he wasn't present, wouldn't he miss out on an opportunity to prove himself?
After bowing and paying his respects to Li Xuan, Emperor Da Yue took his leave. As for what he would do next, Li Xuan no longer paid any attention.
Now that the intentions of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow were known, and Emperor Da Yue wasn't foolish, he naturally wouldn't incite conflicts between Qinghua state and Nine Mountain Realm.
Given the current situation in Qinghua state, all that was necessary was stabilization; the strength of the entire Martial Arts Realm within Qinghua state was on the rise. Precipitously instigating a major battle or conflict wasn't a wise move.
However, that didn't mean there should be no response at all.
The assassination attempt on Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu was no longer just an affair of Da Yue Country but concerned the three major powers of Qinghua state and even the entire Martial Arts Realm of Qinghua state.
Of course, for now, it was better not to spread word of this widely to avoid giving Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow an opportunity to sow unrest.
Following the attempted assassination, Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu started to seclude themselves for intensive cultivation, hoping to break through as soon as possible.
In the face of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, their strength was ultimately too weak.
The disturbance wasn't significant; just as the waves began to rise, they already settled down, leaving Da Yue Country in peace. The Alchemical Medical Institute and Qimen Institute continued to operate as usual.
Feng Yan continued to cultivate his Divine Skills while also holding down the fort.
Moon Changming and the others also started their intense cultivation.
"The Divine Realm is going to be in chaos!"
Li Xuan looked up and noticed severe fluctuations of the Heaven and Earth Laws in a certain part of the Divine Realm, a clear indication that it was being destabilized.
"Chaos is good. Heroes rise in troubled times. It's time for my disciples to make a name for themselves. It's also more favorable for Xu Yan and Meng Chong to emerge."
Li Xuan wasn't concerned about whether the Divine Realm was in turmoil or not.
That was a matter for the mighty beings of the Divine Realm to worry about. As a hermit master, he didn't concern himself with these matters.
The assault seemed to have had no significant impact, but in reality, the storm was just beginning.
The three major powers of Qinghua state began to take action, consolidating their hold over Qinghua state. Particularly at the Realm Gates, they stationed Immortal Heavenly Venerables directly.
Even Emperor Da Yue, the Sect Master of Tianwu Sect, and the Sect Master of Myriad Thunder Sect conducted thorough investigations of their respective Immortal Heavenly Venerables, ensuring none were infiltrated by Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
Two direct assaults from Immortal Heavenly Venerables, one of whom was from Broken Dawn Mountain within the Nine Mountain Realm, revealed the profound infiltration of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
However, since Qinghua state was not one of the Thirty-six Great Realms and was merely a realm connected to the Spiritual Realm, it wasn't given much importance by Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, hence the infiltration wasn't too deep.
Minor disturbances emerged throughout Qinghua state, but they had little impact, and the Martial Arts Realm of Qinghua state continued to flourish. Sword Dao martial artists and Body Cultivation martial artists started to emerge prominently.
After spending some time researching the long robe and gaining a slight understanding,
"Master, there's a certain aura contained within this robe that seems akin to the energy of Heaven and Earth Laws, but it seems far more profound. What exactly is it?" Fang Hao inquired.
Li Xuan's hand moved and he inscribed a strand of Dao Rhythm onto a Jade Talisman and said, "This is the Dao Rhythm. If you can fully comprehend it, the Communication Talismans that you refine will be able to transmit messages across the entire Domain without any distance limitations."
This strand of Dao Rhythm was part of Taicang Daoism and one that Li Xuan had been comprehending a great deal of late.
"Yes, Master! I understand!" Fang Hao replied, overjoyed.
He took the Jade Talisman and started to ponder over it.
"Little Ha, you shouldn't return for the time being. The Realm Gate of the Nine Mountains may have been compromised. Wait a little longer."
Fang Hao cautioned Little Ha.
"Quack!"
Little Ha nodded.
Li Xuan continued to study the general outline of the Book of Taicang, and the Divine Skill Martial Code was also being further perfected, progressing towards the goal of three thousand Divine Skills.
Exclusive Divine Skills of Extreme Soul Martial Arts, Martial Arts secret techniques, and Extreme Soul Weapons, among others, were also continuously being refined.
Without any unforeseen circumstances, it wouldn't be long before Jiang Buping entered the domain of Extreme Soul Martial Arts.
Since Jiang Buping was a True King Heavenly Venerable level martial artist with a natural Divine Soul and merged with Imperishable Qi, his strength after switching to Extreme Soul Martial Arts wouldn't be weaker than a True King Heavenly Venerable; it would only grow stronger.
The necessary Martial Arts Techniques of Extreme Soul Martial Arts must be as perfected as possible, and arrangements must be made accordingly.
"Your disciples Xu Yan and Meng Chong have together slain eight True King Heavenly Venerables, and your experience in Martial Arts has been enhanced," came the feedback from the Daoist Golden Book.
"Xu Yan and Meng Chong have joined forces? Seems like they are retaliating against Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow," Li Xuan mused, raising an eyebrow. With Xu Yan and Meng Chong joining forces to kill so many True King Heavenly Venerables, it was very likely an act of vengeance against Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.

chapters.title: Chapter 775 - 407 Innate Indestructible Sacred Body, Domain Turbulence_2
chapters.content:
After all, Meng Chong had just been pursued by the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, and Xu Yan had also been targeted.
"The Nine Mountain Realm is probably going to be in chaos, will the Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow personally take action?"
Li Xuan pondered.
With Xu Yan's Yin Yang Undying Sword Divine Ability, ordinary Immortal Heavenly Venerables were unable to break through his defenses with a single strike.
Moreover, with Xu Yan and Meng Chong's speed, even an Immortal Heavenly Venerable might not be able to catch up with them.
"Let's wait and see, neither Xu Yan nor Meng Chong are new to the field of Martial Arts, they know how to avoid crises and how to evade the pursuit of powerful enemies."
Li Xuan continued to immerse himself in his great cause of Martial Arts.
Even if a top Immortal Heavenly Venerable made a move, Xu Yan and Meng Chong had their own life-saving jade charms, so they wouldn't face a threat to their lives. If the charms were activated, it would be time for him to take a trip to the Nine Mountain Realm.
"Your disciple Su Lingxiu has made a breakthrough in the Physiognomy Realm, and your Void-breaking Realm has seen minor accomplishment."
Su Lingxiu finally made her breakthrough.
And as Su Lingxiu broke through, Li Xuan's Alchemical Medical Martial Arts also improved to minor accomplishment in the Void-breaking Realm.
"Your disciple Su Lingxiu has reached the pinnacle of sublimation, transforming into the Evergreen Sacred Body, and you have obtained the Innate Indestructible Sacred Body."
Su Lingxiu, too, had undergone a transformation during her breakthrough.
"My strength has become stronger again!"
Li Xuan was overjoyed in his heart.
The Innate Indestructible Sacred Body seemed to embody an eternal and indestructible essence.
"The Primordial Spirit has also undergone a change, containing a sacred charm."
Li Xuan discovered that the Spirit Pedestal contained the essence of indestructibility, and the Primordial Spirit now held a sacred charm, seemingly fearless of any evil or foul intrusion, capable of purifying all evilness and filth.
As Su Lingxiu broke through, she began to comprehend Divine Skills and continued to consolidate her cultivation in seclusion, leaving the affairs of the Alchemical Medical Institute to Yue'er and others to manage.
Those who followed Su Lingxiu, whether it was Yue'er, Zhou Ying, or Meng Shushu, had already learned how to perform alchemy.
They were more than capable of instructing the prodigies who were beginners in Alchemy.
In the time that followed, Su Lingxiu successively comprehended two Divine Skills, enhancing her own strength.
The path of Alchemical Medical had seen a greater improvement.
The Alchemical Medical Scripture updated once more, achieving yet another significant leap.
Her Alchemy had reached a divine level of mastery, Su Lingxiu could now easily gather the Power of Domain Laws and integrate it into her Alchemy.
That day, the much-anticipated pill by Emperor Da Yue and others, which could increase the chances of breaking through to the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, was finally going to be refined.
The first thing Su Lingxiu did after leaving seclusion was to refine the pill that would assist in breaking through to the Immortal Heavenly Venerable realm.
It was also a kind of pill that enhanced the Physiognomy.
Combining several precious Divine Medicines according to their different effects and harmonious proportions, then gathering the Power of Domain Laws, she started the refinement of the pill.
As the pill was about to be completed, Su Lingxiu even absorbed a wisp of the Domain's breath and integrated it into the pill.
This was the first time Su Lingxiu used the Domain's Divine Flame with the stacked Domain Divine Furnace alchemy technique, complemented by the Divine Furnace's Hundred Refinements technique, to create the pill.
There were only three pills in the batch.
Once the pills were completed, these pills, surrounded by a halo, seemed to resonate with the Domain, as mystical as the Physiognomy itself.
They were akin to the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, one with the Domain itself.
"Finally, it's a success."
Su Lingxiu revealed a smile.
She immediately swallowed one of the pills and in an instant, she felt that her recently advanced realm had improved a bit, her strength had increased, and her Martial Arts Physiognomy had become more solidified, somewhat stronger.
"Based on my calculations, this pill could increase the chances of breaking through to Immortal Heavenly Venerable by fifty percent," Su Lingxiu pondered and gave her assessment.
Such a precious pill, naturally, had to be sold at a good price.
Afterward, Su Lingxiu began another session of pill refinement; this time she increased the quantity and refined five pills.
Upon learning of this, Emperor Da Yue was overjoyed, for with the assistance of pills, it meant the potential to add more Immortal Heavenly Venerables!
For the Qinghua state, each additional Immortal Heavenly Venerable would be a tremendous boon to its strength.
Not to mention across the entire Qinghua state, Da Yue alone had many former prodigies stuck at the peak of True King Heavenly Venerable or at the half-step Immortal Heavenly Venerable and unable to break through any further.
With the aid of pills, it was inevitable that some would break through to the Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm.
Even if the strength of Immortal Heavenly Venerables who advanced with the help of pills was slightly weaker, they were still Immortal Heavenly Venerables, far superior to True Kings and half-steps to Immortality.
The Sect Masters of Tianwu Sect and Myriad Thunder Sect, upon hearing the news, personally came over.
Moreover, the three great forces very tacitly kept the news under wraps, as the lurking force of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow was still eyeing them covetously, to avoid any complications.
What followed was the negotiation of the pill price; the Divine Medicines required to refine the pills were naturally provided by the three great forces, exchanging five portions of Divine Medicines for one pill, in accordance with Su Lingxiu's terms.
```
After all, failures can occur during the refining of pills.
Emperor Da Yue and his companions wouldn't dare to haggle; they all agreed to the terms immediately.
Divine Medicine, essential for pill refinement, is rather rare and precious, inevitably meaning that it cannot be produced in large quantities over a short period of time.
Moreover, Su Lingxiu refined pills based on her mood and didn't spend all her time on alchemy.
No matter what, this transaction pleased everyone.
Shortly after Su Lingxiu's breakthrough, Fang Hao's Qimen Martial Art also improved, reaching a level comparable to the Physiognomy Realm.
"There's another disturbance in the Divine Realm."
Li Xuan suddenly looked towards a certain place in the sky where the Principles of Heaven and Earth had started fluctuating.
"Great chaos heralds a grand era; it seems there have been some changes in the heaven and earth."
Li Xuan frowned slightly.
With his Eye of the Heavenly Dao, he could detect subtle changes within the Domain, clearly resulting from the disturbances in the Divine Realm.
And these disturbances were without a doubt the work of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
"It looks like the Nine Mountain Realm is about to fall into chaos as well."
Li Xuan suddenly looked towards the Nine Mountain Realm; at such a close distance, he witnessed the turbulence of the Domain Laws, as if a great war was about to erupt.
"But these are all minor issues."
Li Xuan smiled lightly and averted his gaze, ready to continue studying the Book of Taicang. But suddenly, his expression became serious.
He looked up at the firmament, and in that instant, he saw the sky quaking. The power of the Dao Principles was triggered at this moment.
Thud!
It was as if an inaudible sound had resonated between heaven and earth.
Even Emperor Da Yue, an Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the highest caliber, failed to detect this sound, but Li Xuan heard it.
In his view, the entire Domain of the Divine Realm seemed to ripple with disturbance.
"The tumult of heaven and earth, what has happened, could it be that a Supreme Expert wishes to descend upon the Divine Realm?
"No, that's not right, if that were the case, how could it go unnoticed by everyone?"
Li Xuan's brow furrowed continuously.
The agitation in the heaven and earth of the Divine Realm disappeared in an instant, but that momentary turbulence seemed like a force was trying to breach the barrier of the Divine Realm to enter within.
"The disturbance wasn't significant; it poses no threat to me. Even if I can't shatter it with one punch, two will suffice. It's a trivial matter."
After assessing the situation, Li Xuan resumed his complacency.
No matter what happened, the force that caused that instant of turbulence in the heaven and earth wasn't strong enough to threaten him.
"This Taicang Domain keeps getting more interesting. Why do I always feel like there's a dark hand scheming something?"
Li Xuan muttered to himself.
A few days later.
Thud!
The Domain was disturbed again, and like before, Li Xuan took one glance before returning to his study of the Book of Taicang's outline.
Three days later, there was another disturbance.
Then, for half a month, all was still again, and the Divine Realm seemingly returned to a state of calm.
"The Nine Mountain Realm is on the verge of a great war, huh? Eh, what's this…"
Li Xuan looked towards the Nine Mountain Realm and suddenly noticed a foreign aura from beyond entering within it.
In the past, he might not have detected it, but now, armed with the Eye of the Heavenly Dao and familiarity with the Taicang Domain, he immediately noticed it.
"The Netherworld Blood Child, huh? Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow is willing to invite outside forces to achieve their goals."
Li Xuan sighed.
Although Xu Yan and Meng Chong were in the Nine Mountain Realm, Li Xuan wasn't the least bit worried.
Elsewhere in the Divine Realm.
Wu Tianan had become a True King Heavenly Venerable, with his strength among the top in his realm.
He had also mastered three Divine Skills.
At this moment, Wu Tianan's brows were slightly furrowed, as he couldn't help feeling that his luck had been too good lately.
Furthermore, ever since he came to the Divine Realm and successfully cultivated Divine Skills, his martial arts cultivation seemed to be progressing smoothly and swiftly.
"Why is this so?"
Wu Tianan wondered.
He looked towards the disheveled old man lying on a large stone, with his hair unkempt and beard stubbly, a hint of wariness flashing in his eyes.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 776 - 408 Imperishable and Indestructible Primordial Spirit and Imperishable Sword Intent
chapters.content:
This elder, Wu Tianan had encountered over a dozen times, and each time he met the other party, they were lying not far from him.
At first, he thought it was just a coincidence.
After several repeated encounters, Wu Tianan was certain that the other was deliberately following him.
Taking a deep breath and about to step forward to ask directly, he saw the elder suddenly sit up, look up at the firmament with a face full of surprise and disbelief.
Wu Tianan was puzzled, remaining vigilant of the other while looking towards the firmament, finding nothing out of the ordinary.
And the other did not take the opportunity to attack him when he was looking at the firmament.
"Strange."
The elder muttered to himself.
"Senior, why are you following me?"
Wu Tianan took a deep breath and asked in a deep voice.
The elder's gaze returned to Wu Tianan, and with a hearty smile, he said, "It's not that I'm following you, this is fate, young man. Why is your fortune so extraordinary?"
Before Wu Tianan could respond, the elder was already in front of him, circling around him while clicking his tongue and saying, "Impressive, truly impressive. Your martial arts are rather special, and so is your fortune. Who is your master?"
"I..."
Wu Tianan was incredibly shocked inside. The elder's strength was far beyond his own; if the other wished to kill him, he wouldn't need to lift a finger.
"Could it be the Immortal Heavenly Venerable?"
Thinking this, he opened his mouth but didn't know how to respond for a moment.
Who is his master?
His martial arts guide was not his master-disciple relation, and the relationship between him and the superior senior was not that of master and disciple either. Strictly speaking, he had no master!
"Junior does not have a master."
"Then who passed on your martial arts to you?"
The elder looked quite interested.
"Passed on by a senior expert."
"A senior expert? How does he compare to me?"
"Senior, you are incomparable."
"Interesting."
The elder laughed and said, "This robust fortune of yours, as if favored by the domain itself, was it given to you by the senior you mentioned?"
Wu Tianan was confused and shook his head, "I don't know."
He also felt that his luck seemed a bit too good, like some time ago when he witnessed a great battle erupt between two Immortal Heavenly Venerables. All the martial artists with him died.
Yet, he escaped unscathed and even found a divine artifact!
This kind of escape from danger and acquisition of treasures had happened not just once or twice. Now, as the elder inquired, Wu Tianan couldn't help but wonder if his robust fortune was related to that senior?
