Was it because he had successfully cultivated divine skills passed on by that senior, establishing a basis in martial arts with that senior, and thus received a fortune feedback?
After all, the senior was an existence supreme beyond the domain.
"Where is this high person you speak of?" The elder asked with interest.
Wu Tianan pondered for a moment before saying, "He may be in the Qinghua state, or maybe not; I'm not certain."
The elder nodded.
He took out a token and put it in Wu Tianan's hand, saying, "Here, take this. Running into you everywhere is bothersome; am I your fortune incanate or what? Your fortune is a bit preposterous."
Wu Tianan was dumbfounded. It was clearly the elder following him, yet why did he now seem to think that it was himself that the elder kept running into?
"What is this?"
Looking at the token in hand, feeling it was something extraordinary, yet he was perplexed by it.
"When the time comes to go to the Taihe Realm, you silly boy will know the use of the token."
The elder shook his head, wondering how there could be such a person with immense fortune in this world.
Truly bizarre.
"Senior, wait a moment, I'd like to ask about someone."
Wu Tianan suddenly spoke up.
"With your fortune, you'll find them soon enough; don't ask me, old man. I'm in the Divine Realm, and I don't know many people!"
The elder waved his hand and walked away, disappearing without a trace.
Wu Tianan looked helplessly and stored the token.
"The Taihe Realm, eh? The first and most powerful realm of the Divine Realm, I'll have to go there sooner or later."
He set off again on his quest to find someone.
...
"Something's not quite right with Wu Tianan."
In Qinghua state, Li Xuan suddenly felt puzzled.
It was one thing that Wu Tianan had cultivated divine skills, and more than one at that, but what intrigued him even more was that through the connection in martial arts, he astonishingly discovered that Wu Tianan's fortune seemed extremely robust.
"Could he truly be a child of fortune?"
Li Xuan was full of wonder. Was Wu Tianan really a child of fortune?
When Wu Tianan was there, he did not have the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, otherwise, he could have seen through the essence of his fortune at a glance.
"Never mind. However much of a child of fortune he is, he can't match my disciple."
Li Xuan shook his head, refocusing his attention on the Book of Taicang.
"Soon, I'll have committed the general outline of the Book of Taicang to memory."
He was not far from fully comprehending the Taicang Domain Dao Principles, which also meant that he could go to that small stone house in the Wu Country Royal Palace to encounter that mysterious individual and probe the secrets of Taicang Domain.
While Li Xuan was spending his days as usual, exploring the general outline of the Book of Taicang and continuously contributing to his martial arts venture, a piece of news arrived.
Nine Mountain City, where the Nine Mountain Realm Gate was located, had fallen. Surprisingly to Emperor Da Yue and others, it was not the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow that occupied it, but a Netherworld Blood Child had broken into the Nine Mountain Realm Gate and was confronting an Immortal Heavenly Venerable of Nine Mountain Realm.
Almost half of Nine Mountain City had collapsed, with countless casualties.
The great battle of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable went on for a very long time, still without a victor.
And the Nine Mountain Realm Gate led directly into Qinghua state, thus another Immortal Heavenly Venerable was sent to guard the Qinghua state Gate.

chapters.title: Chapter 777 - 408: The Imperishable and Indestructible Primordial Spirit and the Imperishable Sword Intent_2
chapters.content:
After all, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable confronting the Netherworld Blood Child had a certain chance of being a person from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
As Emperor Da Yue, Sect Master of Tianwu, and Sect Master of Wan Lei were discussing and preparing to go to Nine Mountains Realm to aid and defeat that Netherworld Blood Child, the Heavenly Grotto in Qinghua state once again experienced a massive invasion.
In the location of Da Yue Abyss, there was an even more powerful Netherworld Blood Child intending to descend, and Emperor Da Yue had no choice but to personally oversee the situation.
At this time, the turbulence in the Netherworld Cave was clearly to contain Qinghua state and prevent Emperor Da Yue and others from going to Nine Mountains Realm to provide support.
"Another Netherworld Blood Child, truly chaotic,"
Li Xuan, looking in the direction of Nine Mountains Realm, could not help but sigh.
"Eh, this time a Netherworld Army has appeared?"
Li Xuan glanced briefly before losing interest, it was just a force, an army of a few thousand Netherworld Warriors.
The life-saving Jade Charms of Xu Yan and Meng Chong have not been triggered so far, indicating that the two have not encountered any dangers. Given there's no danger, to rise amidst chaos and to advance in battle has become inevitable.
Chaos in Nine Mountains Realm grew more and more turbulent, with several occurrences of Immortal Heavenly Venerable battles.
...
Inside his closed-off chamber, Jiang Buping's Divine Soul appeared, while his physical body was wrapped within by the force of the Divine Soul.
At this moment, strands of Imperishable Qi were integrating into his Divine Soul, merging and assimilating with it.
As the Imperishable Qi fused, the Divine Soul underwent changes.
Already powerful, the Divine Soul, with the integration of Imperishable Qi, was becoming more and more solid, gradually indistinguishable from the physical body.
At one moment, the final strand of Imperishable Qi completely diffused into the Divine Soul, thoroughly merging with it.
A faint radiance emerged from the Divine Soul, and an aura of the Imperishable manifested upon it.
Bang!
The Divine Soul exploded into a fog-like mist, which then reformed into one piece, as intact as before, showing no signs of weakening.
With a continuously solidifying Divine Soul undergoing transformation, a powerful force of the Divine Soul surged forth, growing stronger and more condensed.
At this point, Jiang Buping's Divine Soul had already significantly distinguished itself from that of a Taicang Martial Artist, as if embodying an imperishable and indestructible will.
Bang!
The Divine Soul dispersed once more into a fog, spreading throughout the chamber, then once again coalesced back together.
"I have finally succeeded!"
Jiang Buping was overwhelmed with excitement.
Night and day of arduous cultivation, initially enduring exhaustion and listlessness, he stimulated his physical body with intense pain, swallowed medicinal pills to forcibly maintain clarity and concentration in his practice.
Now, at last, he had completely integrated the Imperishable Qi into his Divine Soul.
His Divine Soul, upon the fusion with the Imperishable Qi, had transformed, and he finally cultivated the Imperishable Spirit Soul!
He would no longer be troubled by the Imperishable Qi, no longer fear losing his Spiritual Wisdom and becoming muddled.
"This is only the first step!"
Jiang Buping calmed his excited emotions and commenced cultivation again.
He aimed to step into the Extreme Soul Martial Arts and become an Extreme Soul Warrior. The integration of Imperishable Qi and the transformation into Imperishable Spirit Soul were just the beginning.
At this time, he was not yet an Extreme Soul Warrior, and had not truly crossed the threshold into the Extreme Soul Martial Arts.
Because of the Imperishable Qi, being naturally gifted with a Divine Soul meant his starting point in the journey of the Extreme Soul Martial Arts was higher, bypassing step by step, realm by realm of arduous cultivation. He directly integrated Imperishable Qi and in one fell swoop, cultivated the Imperishable Spirit Soul.
Even so, having cultivated the Imperishable Spirit Soul, he still had not stepped over the threshold into the Extreme Soul Martial Arts.
"I have already grasped the essence of Extreme Soul Martial Arts. It won't be long before I become an Extreme Soul Warrior,"
Jiang Buping's eyes were resolute.
He had finally risen again. Those who had abandoned, insulted, and ridiculed him probably never imagined he would rise once more, once again appearing before them, right?
"I will return to the Taikun Realm,"
Jiang Buping's expression was resolute.
"Extreme Soul Martial Arts, the ultimate pinnacle of the Divine Soul, the extreme path of the Divine Soul lies in the 'ultimate'; the physical body may or may not be present, but an Extreme Soul Warrior does not abandon the body. Instead, he gradually refines the body into the Divine Soul.
"Nourishing the Divine Soul with the body, this body is no longer one of flesh and blood, but is the Body of Extreme Soul."
Jiang Buping looked at his own flesh, enveloped his body with Divine Spirit Soul Force, and began the true cultivation of Extreme Soul Martial Arts.
"Your disciple, Jiang Buping, has merged with the Imperishable Qi, transforming into an Imperishable Divine Soul. Your Primordial Spirit has transformed into an Imperishable and Undying Primordial Spirit,"
Feedback from the Daoist Golden Book arrived.
Jiang Buping finally completely merged with the Imperishable Qi, transforming into an Imperishable Divine Soul, and took a crucial step in the cultivation of Extreme Soul Martial Arts.
"This is the Imperishable and Undying Primordial Spirit, huh."
Li Xuan wore a smile on his face.
His fifth disciple also began to provide feedback, and new Martial Arts insights were about to come.
The transformation of the Primordial Spirit into something imperishable and undying also meant that his strength had increased, and even if his physical body were destroyed, his Primordial Spirit would not perish.
To completely kill him was almost impossible, the only option would be to seal him away.
Li Xuan couldn't help but think of that person in the small stone house at the Wu Country Royal Palace; was he also sealed away because he had such uniqueness, making it impossible to fully eradicate him?
"With my current Primordial Spirit, displaying the Divine Skills of Slaughter the Soul, even Martial Artists of similar strength to me will not be able to withstand it."
Li Xuan suddenly felt his confidence surge.
"The Extreme Soul Martial Arts won't take long to cultivate."
Li Xuan awaited with anticipation. What feedback would he receive once Jiang Buping succeeded in cultivating Extreme Soul Martial Arts?
This fifth door of Martial Arts was focused on the Divine Soul, could it mean that his Primordial Spirit would undergo another transformation as feedback?
Time passed as Li Xuan awaited with high hopes.
The Nine Mountains Realm was becoming more chaotic. Clashes involving the Immortal Heavenly Venerables erupted every now and then, and the various abysses in the Qinghua state were also starting to destabilize, forcing these Immortal Heavenly Venerables not to leave their Heavenly Grottoes rashly.
Emperor Da Yue had already been stationed at the Heavenly Grotto for some time, and the Capital City of Da Yue was now under the watch of Sui Hongwu.
Although the Formations greatly reduced the threat of the Netherworld invasion, the Immortal Heavenly Venerables were tied down and could not manage the chaos in the Nine Mountains Realm.
This might very well be the goal of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
As for Feng Yan, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, he pretended not to know about the turmoil in the Nine Mountains Realm. After all, he did not have any disciples or followers there, being a loner.
Therefore, he continued to sit in the Qimen Institute and Alchemical Medical Institute, diligently practicing Divine Skills and working hard.
"When the opportunity arrives, I must firmly seize it!"
Feng Yan thought resolutely, nothing could shake his firm resolve to grasp the opportunity!
His becoming an Immortal Heavenly Venerable was not only due to his own talent and efforts but also because he had the significant advantage of knowing how to seize opportunities!
Li Xuan, who was delving into the Book of Taicang, suddenly saw the Daoist Golden Book open, and feedback appeared.
"Jiang Buping has succeeded in cultivating Extreme Soul Martial Arts?"
Li Xuan's first thought was that Jiang Buping had become an Extreme Soul Warrior.
"Your disciple, Xu Yan, has cultivated Imperishable Sword Intent, and your Imperishable Sword Intent is a hundred times stronger."
Imperishable Sword Intent!
Li Xuan was overjoyed. "Xu Yan is truly the trailblazer of my Martial Arts path. He has used the Imperishable Qi to cultivate the Sword Dao. Imperishable Sword Intent is eternal and undying."
He couldn't help but marvel; Xu Yan was indeed remarkable.
Imperishable Sword Intent, continuous and unending, eternal and undying, means that the Sword Intent is more difficult to shatter, and even if a sliver of Sword Intent remains in a place, it will be hard to dissipate, even through the ages.
"With the fusion of Imperishable Sword Intent and the Yin Yang Undying Sword, the strength of this defense, with Xu Yan's current power, even ordinary Immortal Heavenly Venerables would not be able to breach it."
Li Xuan thought again of the Sudden Wind Sword Intent, which is the Sword Intent of Slaughter the Soul. Once it acquires the Imperishable characteristic and slashes into an enemy's Divine Soul, even if the enemy withstands it, the remaining Sword Intent will be difficult for them to remove.
This residual Sword Intent will constantly affect the Divine Soul, becoming an eternal injury on the Divine Soul, and once it weakens, the Sword Intent will obliterate it.
"Imperishable Sword Intent, at last, we've found how to use Imperishable Qi to enhance strength."
Li Xuan had a feeling that Xu Yan might eventually comprehend how to use the Imperishable Qi to cultivate something akin to a Primordial Spirit and even maintain his Spiritual Wisdom despite being affected by the Imperishable Qi.
Xu Yan was also listening to the methods of Extreme Soul Martial Arts. Although his talent was not in Extreme Soul Martial Arts, and he was cultivating the pure path of Martial Arts, with Xu Yan's remarkable abilities, using Extreme Soul Martial Arts as a reference to comprehend a method unaffected by Imperishable Qi was also not impossible.
"The pure path of Martial Arts, its purity allows it to encompass all Dao."
Li Xuan sighed inwardly, knowing that one day Xu Yan would forge his own unique path in Martial Arts.

chapters.title: Chapter 778 - 778: 409
chapters.content:
Li Xuan thought of Meng Chong being with Xu Yan, and since Xu Yan had cultivated the Imperishable Sword Intent, he would certainly impart it to Meng Chong. This meant that Meng Chong would also cultivate the Imperishable Sword Intent.
The Imperishable Qi was not only integrated into Sword Intent but what about Divine Skills?
He believed Xu Yan would discern more martial arts techniques that utilized Imperishable Qi.
"Imperishable Qi has its limits, it isn't truly imperishable; thus, it's merely a starting phase. In the end, one must rely on their own martial arts to truly reach an imperishable and indestructible state."
Li Xuan was very clear about this.
After all, Imperishable Qi could be refined; its requirement for the realm was exceptionally high, a level that Xu Yan and the rest were still far from reaching.
Leveraging Imperishable Qi was just a step into the beginning of an imperishable and indestructible cultivation. As the realm continuously advanced, there would come a day when one's own imperishable and indestructible state would surpass the limits of Imperishable Qi.
Half a month after Xu Yan had cultivated the Imperishable Sword Intent, he made a breakthrough.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has reached the minor accomplishment of the Physiognomy Realm, and your Power of Void-breaking's amplification has increased tenfold."
Li Xuan immediately felt invigorated, as his strength increased again. He glanced in the direction of the Nine Mountain Realm, where chaos was intensifying.
"Indeed, out of chaos comes a monster, and my disciple is a monster among monsters. During this period, he must have fought quite a bit to have such a rapid increase in strength."
Xu Yan and Meng Chong were not the types to take a beating without fighting back. Since there were enemies, they had to be eliminated.
So, during these times, they were certainly retaliating against Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
A few days later, news arrived.
A True King Heavenly Venerable from Qinghua state risked crossing the Realm Gate and entered Nine Mountain City. The Immortal Heavenly Venerable and the Netherworld Blood Child opposing each other at the Realm Gate had both left some distance away from it.
This allowed the True King Heavenly Venerable to take the opportunity to leave the Realm Gate and bring back some information from the Nine Mountain Realm.
Firstly, the Nine Mountain Realm was in chaos; the only son of the master of Horizontal Peak Mountain was killed by the Immortal Heavenly Venerable of Spiritual Sovereign Mountain. Even though there were rumors that it was a conspiracy by Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, the master of Horizontal Peak Mountain was not convinced.
A conflict broke out with Spiritual Sovereign Mountain.
Then, Thousand Layered Mountain and the Wan Family of Dahai Mountain also encountered conflict. A top genius from Thousand Layered Mountain was rumored to have been killed by a bald, burly man, who was in Dahai Mountain.
Thousand Layered Mountain demanded Dahai Mountain hand over the person, but the Wan Family testified that the murderer was not Meng Chong. In the end, they parted on bad terms, and a disagreement arose.
There were rumors that Broken Dawn Mountain killed the beloved Wind Spirit Tiger of Spiritual Sovereign Mountain and a genius from Spiritual Sovereign Gate, which sparked another conflict.
Two Netherworld Blood Children, of unknown origin, sneaked into the Nine Mountain Realm and were causing slaughter.
Even a thousand-strong Netherworld Army directly invaded Dahai Mountain, but Xu Yan and Meng Chong took action, slaughtering Netherworld Warriors and continually rooting out the subsidiaries of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
The last piece of news was that one of the Netherworld Blood Children was preparing to pursue and kill Xu Yan and Meng Chong.
In short, the current Nine Mountain Realm was tumultuous and in complete chaos, with continuous killing and battles involving Immortal Heavenly Venerables erupting every few days.
If this trend continues, it's inevitable that an Immortal Heavenly Venerable will fall sooner or later!
Once an Immortal Heavenly Venerable is killed on any side, the conflict will become utterly unmanageable. In terms of the power of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, they are constantly being besieged by various factions while continuing to create unrest.
As for which of the Nine Mountain Realm's Immortal Heavenly Venerables were from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, it was unknown. This made the situation even more chaotic, with the remaining Immortal Heavenly Venerables all being wary of each other, fearing a sneak attack.
"It's really quite a mess!"
Li Xuan sighed.
"Big Brother and Second Brother are now facing Immortal Heavenly Venerables as their opponents!"
Su Lingxiu exclaimed in shock.
Fang Hao was boiling with enthusiasm and eager to head to the Nine Mountain Realm to showcase the might of Qimen Martial Art.
"The time, it's not yet right!"
In the end, Fang Hao sighed. The management of the Qinghua state couldn't be abandoned halfway.
As for the Netherworld Blood Child preparing to hunt down Xu Yan and Meng Chong, Li Xuan wasn't worried. Up to this point, the Life-saving Jade Charm had not been triggered, indicating that the Netherworld Blood Child did not pose too great a threat to Xu Yan and Meng Chong.
He probably couldn't even trace their whereabouts.
"The turmoil in the Divine Realm is inevitable. Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, this hidden manipulator, must have been planning for quite some time. Choosing to strike at this time, there must be a reason, probably because the arrangement has matured.
"Even if they can't achieve Unity of Domain, the chaos in the Divine Realm is unstoppable."
Li Xuan contemplated to himself.
"Focus on your cultivation. Whether you can reach the peak amidst the great chaos depends on yourselves."
Li Xuan said to Fang Hao.
"Yes, Master, your disciple understands!"
Fang Hao nodded solemnly.
Since it was a time of great turmoil in the Divine Realm, and he was managing Qinghua state, he must build it into a realm that is immensely strong and unbreakable.
He already had a rough goal in his heart.
Of course, all of this required sufficient strength, so the top priority was to work hard to enhance that strength.
The chaos in the Nine Mountain Realm kept going on, even showing signs of further escalation. Occasionally, a True King Heavenly Venerable would pass through the Realm Gate and bring back news from the Nine Mountain Realm.
But some True King Heavenly Venerables also encountered danger and fell in the Nine Mountain Realm.
Various signs indicated that the Immortal Heavenly Venerable and the Blood Child positioned at the Realm Gate were deliberately allowing some True King Heavenly Venerables from Qinghua state to enter and gain intelligence on the Nine Mountain Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 779 - 409 Jiang Buping Starts, Extreme Soul Body_2
chapters.content:
```
Boom!
On this day, the long-absent turmoil of heaven and earth reappeared, and Li Xuan furrowed his brow slightly, looking towards the firmament.
"It's getting more and more interesting."
He continued to delve into the main principles of the Book of Taicang, and he was not too far from completely engraving them in his memory. His understanding of the Taicang Domain Dao Principles was also becoming increasingly clear.
He even began to gain some clarity about the very essence of the Domain itself.
"Your disciple Meng Chong has cultivated the Immutable Blade Intent, increasing your own Immutable Blade Intent a hundredfold."
As expected, Meng Chong had also cultivated the Immutable Blade Intent.
"Ah, the battle of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables, this is a fight involving several Immortal Heavenly Venerables."
Suddenly, Li Xuan looked up towards the Nine Mountains Realm; the Heaven and Earth Laws were violently trembling, clearly indicating that a battle involving the Immortal Heavenly Venerables had erupted, and it was very likely a battle between several of them.
This was the most extensive participation of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables in the chaos of the Nine Mountains Realm to date.
Shaking his head, he continued his study of the Book of Taicang, and suddenly turned his gaze towards Jiang Buping's closed-door cultivation chamber.
"It's almost time, the Extreme Soul Martial Arts are about to emerge."
Li Xuan became excited.
He put away the Book of Taicang and took out the Extreme Soul Martial Arts Manual, which had taken quite an effort to compile; it was finally about to come into play.
The Extreme Soul Martial Arts Manual recorded the methods of Extreme Soul Martial Arts, Divine Skills, and the refinement of Extreme Soul Weapons, among other things.
As soon as Jiang Buping succeeded in his cultivation and stepped into the door of Extreme Soul Martial Arts, he could pass on all the methods recorded in the manual to him.
Most importantly, the unique Extreme Soul Divine Weapon, which belonged solely to the Extreme Soul Martial Arts, was a special kind of weapon that had never appeared in the entire Taicang World.
It was different from traditional weapons.
"Ah, the weapon that slays Divine Souls, it's different from both Divine Skills and Sword Intents, and what it kills isn't just the Divine Soul but also possesses the power to annihilate the flesh.
"Divine Souls are always difficult to defend and even harder to attack, but once the Extreme Soul Divine Weapon is wielded, it can easily harm the Divine Soul just as a weapon would with the flesh.
"For a Taicang Martial Artist, a moment of carelessness can lead to their demise."
Li Xuan revealed a smile; with the emergence of the Extreme Soul Divine Weapon, for those Taicang Martial Artists who lacked defenses against Divine Souls and Divine Skills for their Divine Souls, a slight mistake would mean the death of their Divine Soul.
"The first appearance of the Extreme Soul Divine Weapon, even the Immortal Heavenly Venerables, with a moment of carelessness, will suffer great damage to their Divine Souls, and once the Divine Soul is greatly damaged...
"No, even without severe damage, just an injury to the Divine Soul is extremely dangerous for the Immortal Heavenly Venerables, especially in these chaotic times."
Li Xuan anticipated Jiang Buping wreaking havoc far and wide, displaying the might of Extreme Soul Martial Arts, striking terror into the hearts of the Warriors of the Taicang Domain.
"However, the Taicang Domain also has its share of powerful figures, and there must certainly be some methods of defending against the Divine Soul and even Supreme Treasures for such defense.
"But such Warriors are ultimately too few, and besides, under the same Realm, they are absolutely no match for Extreme Soul Martial Arts.
"Apart from relying on the advantage of a higher Realm, there are no other effective means of resistance."
Li Xuan looked towards the Nine Mountains Realm, waiting for Jiang Buping to step into the door of Extreme Soul Martial Arts and then venture out to cause a stir; the Nine Mountains Realm would be a fine place.
Brothers in arms, stirring up the storms of the Nine Mountains Realm.
Adding fuel to the fire of the Divine Realm on the verge of chaos!
Inside the cultivation chamber, Jiang Buping floated quietly; at the moment, he seemed unchanged, and there was no way to tell that he was a Divine Soul Body.
His flesh had long since merged with his Divine Soul, and now his body was no longer of flesh and blood, but rather a body of Divine Soul.
Boom!
At a certain moment, Jiang Buping felt a powerful force emerge, and he underwent a transformation.
In an instant, his body dissipated, the ultimate Divine Soul Power surged within the cultivation chamber, and in the next moment, it coalesced once again, and he recovered.
"This is Extreme Soul Martial Arts, this is the Extreme Path Divine Soul!"
Jiang Buping was exhilarated.
He felt his long-lost strength return, and now he was truly a martial artist. It seemed that even when he had previously cultivated to the level of True King Heavenly Venerable, he still couldn't be considered a real martial artist.
"I, Jiang Buping, have returned!"
At that moment, he almost couldn't resist the urge to howl.
The power of Extreme Soul Martial Arts was even stronger than at his former peak!
"I, Jiang Buping, will one day silence all the grievances in my heart."
From that moment on, he was an Extreme Soul Warrior, practicing Extreme Soul Martial Arts.
"Your disciple Jiang Buping has entered into the Extreme Soul Martial Arts that you compiled; you've gained an Extreme Soul Body, which has improved a hundredfold."
"Your Extreme Soul Body's realm has risen to be on par with Pure Martial Arts."
At the moment when Jiang Buping stepped into Extreme Soul Martial Arts, the feedback from the Daoist Golden Book came.
The Extreme Soul Body improved a hundredfold, and what's more important, the realm of the Extreme Soul Body rose to be on par with Pure Martial Arts.
The Void-breaking Realm's Extreme Soul Martial Arts!
Li Xuan was overjoyed. Once Jiang Buping entered into Extreme Soul Martial Arts, because of his high starting point and having cultivated the Imperishable Spirit Soul,
```
He had thought that the feedback from the Extreme Soul Martial Arts would not bring him to a very high realm. According to Li Xuan's estimation, it should be around the Physiognomy Realm.
Unexpectedly, the feedback from the Daoist Golden Book not only increased the power of the Extreme Soul Body a hundredfold but also elevated his realm to the same level as Pure Martial Arts.
Both reached the pinnacle of the Void-breaking Realm.
With this, all five of his Martial Arts doors were at the Void-breaking Realm.
"Powerful, I've become even more powerful!"
Li Xuan was beside himself with excitement.
Above his Spirit Pedestal, in addition to his Primordial Spirit, was the true body of the demonic ancestor, and now there was an additional Extreme Soul Body.
This Extreme Soul Body, unlike the demonic ancestor's true body, was the embodiment of his Fifth Door of Martial Arts, as if it were the Extreme Path Divine Soul that he had cultivated painstakingly.
No matter the distance, his consciousness was always connected to it, and it could also be considered his real body.
"So powerful!"
At this moment, the Extreme Soul Body swayed its arm, and Li Xuan couldn't help but exclaim at the formidable and domineering power of the Extreme Soul.
Truly worthy of the Fifth Door of Martial Arts that he had meticulously crafted.
"With all five of my Martial Arts doors unleashed, I could shatter even those above the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, not to mention the Immortal Heavenly Venerable themselves!"
At this moment, Li Xuan was filled with confidence.
Extreme Soul Martial Arts for striking at the soul and possessing an unmatched physical body, Alchemical Medical Martial Arts for endless vitality, Pure Martial Arts for overseeing everything.
Perfect, invincible!
"Without realizing it, I've become so powerful."
Li Xuan mused to himself.
Now, among his five doors of Martial Arts, Pure Martial Arts was already the strongest, followed by Extreme Soul Martial Arts, which was after all a minor realm higher than Physical Body Martial Arts.
"Each door of Martial Arts provides a hundredfold enhancement within the same realm. No disciple, no matter how they cultivate, will ever be able to catch up to their master."
Li Xuan's face beamed with a splendid smile, and he was in a great mood.
In high spirits, Li Xuan stretched out his hand and captured a thread of Dao Rhythm to refine several pills.
Even the Immortal Heavenly Venerable would covet the pills that were surrounded by Dao Rhythms.
"One for each person, comprehend it on your own."
Li Xuan tossed the pills, granting one to each person.
Su Lingxiu stared at the pill with a shocked expression. Such a miraculous pill was far beyond her ability to refine.
Feng Yan was overjoyed. His resolution to seize the opportunity and stay to work hard had paid off. Indeed, staying behind to work diligently was the wise choice.
With this pill, he was confident that he could finally make a breakthrough and had a chance to advance to a top-tier Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
Of course, assimilating this pill was rather difficult, and it wasn't merely about refining it but also about comprehending the rhythm within.
"Master, I've succeeded!"
Jiang Buping came out of seclusion, excitedly knelt down, and tearfully said.
"Good, you haven't let your master down!"
Li Xuan nodded in approval.
Su Lingxiu and Fang Hao looked at Jiang Buping in astonishment. Others might not have felt much impact, but they both sensed something extraordinary about Jiang Buping.
This body was no longer the fleshly body he had before.
This was the power of Extreme Soul Martial Arts!
"Congratulations, Fifth Junior Brother, for successfully stepping into the great gateway of Martial Arts."
"Fifth Junior Brother, I feel like you're quite powerful."
Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu said with a smile.
"Thanks to the help of Third Senior Sister and Fourth Senior Brother!"
Jiang Buping gratefully replied.
Without the assistance of his Third Senior Sister and Fourth Senior Brother in merging the Imperishable Qi, how could he have succeeded so smoothly?
"We're fellow disciples; there's no need for politeness!"
Fang Hao said with a smile.
"Fifth Junior Brother, come on, let's spar and allow your Senior Brother to witness the might of the Extreme Soul Martial Arts."
Fang Hao said, eager to try.
"This..."
Jiang Buping hesitated. In terms of strength, he believed that he was now no weaker than Fang Hao.
Moreover, the power of Extreme Soul Martial Arts was for attacking the soul. Having just become an Extreme Soul Warrior, he feared he had inadequate control; it would be unfortunate if he accidentally hurt his Fourth Senior Brother.
After all, Fourth Senior Brother was skilled in Artifact Refining and Formation Path, not direct combat.

chapters.title: Chapter 780 - 410: Using the Qinghua State as the Domain Incredible Formation
chapters.content:
Fang Hao couldn't help but feel helpless upon seeing Jiang Buping hesitating, and said, "Fifth Junior Brother, just make your move. With master here, what could possibly go wrong? Besides, you're underestimating me too much. Qimen Martial Art isn't just about Artifact Refining and Formation."
Hearing this, Jiang Buping felt it made sense and immediately nodded, "Alright, Fourth Senior Brother, please be careful!"
"Just make your move!"
Fang Hao's smile was brilliant, and in an instant, the Domain Qimen emerged, similar to the vortex of an abyss, slowly rotating around Fang Hao as its center.
Boom!
Jiang Buping raised his hand and struck out with his palm. Extreme Soul Power surged like a tidal wave, slashing out in a flash.
Boom!
The vortex churned, seemingly incapable of defending against the Extreme Soul Power, as a tremendous force appeared to target the Martial Arts Primordial Spirit directly.
Fang Hao's eyebrows twitched slightly. This power had some similarities to the Sudden Wind Sword Intent of his eldest senior brother but was even more extreme and violent.
Whoosh!
A gleam of light appeared. Fang Hao stepped forward, and the power of Qimen Martial Art transformed into a Prohibition, with the Domain Qimen surrounding him. In an instant, it became a Prohibition directed at the Divine Soul and a peculiar Formation.
Boom!
Finally, it collided with Jiang Buping's Extreme Soul Martial Arts Power, and he managed to defend against it.
"Fifth Junior Brother, your Extreme Soul Martial Arts are indeed domineering!"
Fang Hao couldn't help but exclaim.
"However, you are still not a match for your Fourth Senior Brother. You only have strength and nothing more."
Fang Hao didn't use the Qimen Armory but instead arranged a Great Formation with the power of Domain Qimen and continuously cast Prohibitions to protect his own Primordial Spirit.
Jiang Buping's expression remained unchanged as he held a Long Spear in his hand, with its gleam bursting with Extreme Soul Power, striking out incessantly.
The fight did not last long. After all, Jiang Buping had just started, and without having cultivated the Divine Skills pertaining to the Extreme Soul Martial Arts, he was naturally not a match for Fang Hao.
After all, Fang Hao's current Qimen Martial Art was comparable to the Physiognomy Realm.
Jiang Buping was also roughly at the Physiognomy Realm stage, and it was his first encounter with Qimen Martial Art, lacking sufficient understanding of it.
And his own martial skills were not yet proficient, lacking the methods of Extreme Soul Martial Arts, leaving him to be no match for Fang Hao.
"So, this is the Qimen Martial Art."
Jiang Buping didn't feel discouraged as he sighed.
"Fifth Junior Brother, your Extreme Soul Martial Arts are actually quite strong. In terms of the power to slaughter, I'm actually somewhat inferior,"
Fang Hao praised.
Qimen Martial Art was not primarily about fierce slaughter but rather about being "strange," about being versatile and having numerous methods.
"Moreover, Fifth Junior Brother, you lack a Divine Weapon for slaughtering the soul. When I have time, I will refine one for you."
A weapon targeting the Divine Soul could be refined by Fang Hao as long as he had the right materials.
His Qimen Armory possessed weapons that protected the Primordial Spirit.
Whether it was Xu Yan, Meng Chong, or Su Lingxiu, the Divine Weapons they nurtured all had the power to protect the Primordial Spirit.
"Fifth Junior Brother, I want to give it a try too!" said Su Lingxiu, eager to have a go.
"Third Senior Sister, this..."
Jiang Buping really hesitated. Third Senior Sister excelled at Alchemy and healing injuries — her combat strength seemed average, right?
Su Lingxiu frowned and huffed, "You really think I lack combat strength? I just don't like fighting, not that Alchemical Medical Martial Arts lacks the power to fight. Just make your move."
Feeling a bit frustrated, how come she gave people the impression that she only knew Alchemy and healing, but not how to fight?
She definitely possessed Divine Skills for slaughter.
"Alright then!"
Upon seeing this, Jiang Buping lunged with his spear, and his Extreme Soul Power pierced into Su Lingxiu's body in a moment.
"Senior Sister!"
Jiang Buping was shocked. How could his sister not even block this strike?
"No big deal!"
Su Lingxiu held her head high, only to see a tree not far from the courtyard crack open with a snap, its life force vanishing in an instant.
Meanwhile, Su Lingxiu was perfectly unharmed, without a scratch.
"Humph, do you really think it's that easy to injure your senior sister? Your strength is not bad, but it's still not enough to hurt me," she said with a proud air.
"Transferred the damage!"
Jiang Buping was stunned. In that moment, he deeply understood that none of his senior brothers and sisters were simple; they each had their own unique Martial Arts.
This brief sparring session made Jiang Buping feel like his Extreme Soul Martial Arts might be the weakest?
He couldn't even harm his Third Senior Sister, and he might not even be her match, while she was supposed to be the weakest in terms of strength.
Now, he had become the weakest.
"You've just started out. It's normal that you can't fully utilize your strength when you have the Extreme Soul Power but lack the Extreme Soul Martial Arts Method. Your Martial Arts thinking still remains fixed on Taicang Martial Arts, which won't work," Li Xuan finally spoke up.
"Master!"
Jiang Buping looked at his master respectfully and asked, "Does master mean that although I have successfully practiced Extreme Soul Martial Arts, I don't have the heart of it and lack the methods of Extreme Soul Martial Arts?"
"Exactly!"
Li Xuan nodded and said solemnly, "Extreme Soul Martial Arts, the extreme of slaughtering the Divine Soul, is a Martial Art of utmost slaughter. It has its own techniques, Divine Skill, as well as Martial Arts Soldier.
"You still have a long way to go. Next, you need to refine your own Extreme Soul Martial Arts Soldier, practice the Extreme Soul Martial Arts Divine Skill, the Extreme Soul Martial Arts Method.
"And the Extreme Soul Martial Arts Soldier, a weapon for slaughtering the Soul, is different from ordinary Divine Weapons. It needs to be refined by your own power..."
Li Xuan explained about the Extreme Soul Divine Weapon, which required not only the search for unique and powerful materials but also refining and nurturing with the Extreme Soul Power.

chapters.title: Chapter 781 - 410: Using the Qinghua State as the Domain Incredible Formation_2
chapters.content:
"The method of Refinement, you may consult with Fang Hao. The difference is trivial, the core of it is nothing but utilizing Extreme Soul for Refinement, finding the materials for the Divine Weapon yourself."
"An Extreme Soul Divine Weapon can be continuously improved. The longer it is nurtured, the stronger it becomes, and it can advance as your strength increases."
Jiang Buping was immensely captivated; an Extreme Soul Divine Weapon was such a profound and potent existence.
However, the required materials for Refinement were generally scarce, belonging to the kind that related to the Divine Soul, naturally rare.
"This is the Extreme Soul Martial Arts Manual. Study it carefully, especially comprehend how to Refine an Extreme Soul Divine Weapon."
Li Xuan pointed with his finger, transmitting the Extreme Soul Martial Arts Manual directly into Jiang Buping's Divine Soul.
"Yes, Master!"
Jiang Buping had only skimmed through the manual briefly when he became incredibly excited. The Extreme Soul Martial Arts Method and the Extreme Soul Martial Arts Divine Skill were both so mystical and powerful.
Let alone mastering them all, just understanding one or two would considerably enhance his strength.
Afterward, Jiang Buping began to seek guidance from Fang Hao on the basic methods of Artifact Refining; although it was refined with Extreme Soul, the Refinement method wasn't much different from conventional Artifact Refining techniques.
And in Artifact Refining, who could surpass Fang Hao?
"Refining, in fact, is also very mystical. I too, as your senior brother, have only made minor achievements in Refining. However, the method of Refining your Divine Weapon, which relies on Extreme Soul, is not something an outsider can help with, but the Refining method is also key to the strength or weakness of a Divine Weapon.
"The strength of a Divine Weapon depends on many factors. I will impart to you what's most vital, yet also most fundamental. As long as you grasp this method, you will understand how to continuously Refine and enhance your Divine Weapon..."
Fang Hao began to impart the Refinement techniques to Jiang Buping, modifying them to suit the characteristics of the Extreme Soul Divine Weapon, and tailored them to be more suitable for Jiang Buping.
Having taught Jiang Buping how to Refine artifacts, Fang Hao then helped him select materials suitable for Refining his Extreme Soul Divine Weapon.
Now, Fang Hao was in no lack of Refining materials; even the rarest materials were available to him, given that the three great forces of the Qinghua state and the various Immortal Heavenly Venerables all sought his services, offering rare materials when asking him to Refine Divine Weapons.
At this stage, Jiang Buping did not need to worry about materials, enough for him to Refine his Extreme Soul Divine Weapon. As for further nurturing and upgrading the weapon, that would be up to him.
But as long as the foundation of the Divine Weapon was there, the rest would be much simpler.
After obtaining materials for Refining the Divine Weapon, Jiang Buping resumed his closed-door cultivation, studying the Extreme Soul Martial Arts Manual and practicing the Extreme Soul Martial Arts Divine Skill, while simultaneously pondering how to Refine his own Extreme Soul Divine Weapon.
Meanwhile, Fang Hao became busy as well; with the Divine Realm about to descend into chaos, and with him managing the Qinghua state, it was time to take more action, all while preparing to enhance his power.
He practiced Qimen Martial Art, which has a unique cultivation method, and the Path of Formation was reaching a stage that called for further advancement.
"The Communication Talisman's range is ultimately too limited. However, crafting a new one, capable of transmitting across the entire Domain, across the entire Divine Realm, is not a big issue."
Fang Hao started with refining an upgraded version of the Communication Talisman.
How to extend the Communication Talisman's range?
There is only one way: to use the Heaven and Earth Laws as the foundation for transmission.
A higher level of talisman would be based on Dao Principles, but at this stage, Fang Hao could not Refine such a talisman.
Yet using the Heaven and Earth Laws as a foundation was within his capabilities now.
"Heaven and Earth Laws regulate the Domain. Even the Immortal Heavenly Venerable or even mightier beings cannot destroy them. Using these laws to transmit messages..."
The more Fang Hao thought about it, the more feasible it seemed. Among the multitude of Heaven and Earth Laws, he selected one and, using its essence, infused it into the Communication Talisman to serve as the talisman's bridge.
This way, the Communication Talisman's transmission range would inevitably expand significantly.
After successfully refining the new Communication Talisman, Fang Hao began planning for the next phase. He already had a plan.
To set up a Great Formation that would envelop the entire Qinghua state.
Or rather, to use the entire Qinghua state as the foundation of the Great Formation.
"Once a fragment of the Great Formation is established, it will be the time of a major surge in my strength, comparable to the Void-breaking Realm, right?"
Fang Hao was thrilled at the prospect.
However, to set up such a Great Formation, he would need the cooperation of the three great forces and the three Emperors of Da Yue.
"As the chaos in the Divine Realm begins, to ensure the stability of the Qinghua state, it is necessary to set up this Great Formation. And once it's complete, the Heavenly Grotto will no longer be a threat.
"Enemies from beyond the heavens, upon entering the Qinghua state, will be struck down by the Great Formation. Could a Great Formation grounded in the Qinghua state be something that warriors at the Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm can withstand?"
Fang Hao felt that Emperor Da Yue and others would likely support his decision. With the assistance of the three major powers, completing the Great Formation was merely a matter of time.
The materials required to set up the Great Formation were extremely vast, and it also concerned his own Domain Qimen. He intended to integrate Domain Qimen into the Great Formation.
Using the Qinghua state Domain as the board!
The more Fang Hao thought about it, the more excited he became. Visions of the Qinghua state transforming into his own Domain Incredible Formation filled his mind. Once successful, within the Qinghua state, he could control the Domain Qimen with a mere wave of his hand and effortlessly eliminate Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
Of course, once the Great Formation was completed, he could control the entire Qinghua state Domain. The fact that he would use the Qinghua state Domain as the board of the Incredible Formation could not be revealed to Emperor Da Yue and the others, otherwise, the Immortal Heavenly Venerables, feeling threatened, would never agree.
Even with the deterrence of his master, they would not assist sincerely, and might even intentionally create flaws.
"Each Immortal Heavenly Venerable needs to be given an Array Plate, especially Emperor Da Yue and his three people, who will certainly demand to maintain an advantage in strength. That is not difficult."
"How can I make them work harder, though?"
Fang Hao couldn't help but fall into deep thought.
It seemed to Immortal Heavenly Venerables as if they had reached the pinnacle of cultivation, but what realm lies above the Immortal Realm?
If, after setting up the Great Formation, there was an opportunity to break through the Immortal Realm, would they work even harder?
"What lies above the Immortal Realm, and how does one cultivate it?"
With these questions, Fang Hao sought out Feng Yan.
"What realm lies above the Immortal Realm?"
Feng Yan blinked and scratched his head, saying, "I don't really know. Immortals, unless killed by someone, do not have the worry of life span. As for what's beyond Immortality, I'm clueless as well."
He paused for a moment, then added; "I only have a vague concept, which could be to merge with the Domain? The true merging with the Domain, not the Immortal Realm's union with the Domain, where one commands a part of the Domain.
"After all, the union with the Domain in the Immortal Realm is not truly one with the Domain. But how to truly merge with the Domain is still too far for me to grasp. Even Emperor Da Yue has not been able to touch upon it at the moment.
"Moreover, whether the Spirit Mechanism of the Divine Realm is sufficient to support a Martial Artist merging with the Domain is also an unknown."
Fang Hao pondered, merge with the Domain?
Since Feng Yan couldn't provide a clear explanation, he had to ask his master.
Li Xuan, of course, did not know what realm lies above the Immortal Realm, but as an extraordinary expert, how could he not be aware?
Moreover, although he didn't know what realm lies above the Immortal Realm, he had a certain understanding of the cultivation above the Immortal Realm based on his knowledge of Taicang Martial Arts.
Li Xuan had also heard what Feng Yan just said. The breakthrough above the Immortal Realm is to merge with the Domain?
"Immortal Realm is united with the Domain, commanding one part of the Domain, but this kind of command is ultimately an external force form of control. However, to merge with the Domain is truly becoming one with the Domain…"
Li Xuan murmured to himself.
What is the purpose of merging with the Domain, which lies above the Immortal Realm?
Naturally, it is to condense the Dao Principles and comprehend the Rhythm of Dao. This must be the cultivation beyond the Immortal Realm.
Thinking of this, Li Xuan spoke with a smile, "Above Immortality is nothing more than comprehending Dao Principles and gathering the power of Dao Principles.
What you have to do is to use the Great Formation to harness the Rhythm of the Domain Dao Principle, enhance the Domain Lingji, so that under the Great Formation, it is easier for Immortal Heavenly Venerables to cultivate, thus giving them a chance for breakthrough."
Li Xuan did not specify what realm lies above the Immortal Realm, as he did not know either, but it did not prevent him from giving Fang Hao tips on how to make a group of Immortal Heavenly Venerables work hard.
"Rhythm of Dao Principles?"
Fang Hao pondered.
"The robe is enveloped in a wisp of the Rhythm of Dao Principles."
Li Xuan pointed out.
"Master, I understand now!"
Fang Hao's eyes lit up. He realized how to harness the Rhythm of Dao Principles—wasn't there an inducement? Although it might not be possible for a while, when the Great Formation was fully set up and finally completed, it would certainly be achievable.
Finally, he had a goal to make Emperor Da Yue and the other Immortal Heavenly Venerables work hard.

chapters.title: Chapter 782 - 411: Using the Heavenly Grotto as the Divine Furnace, Netherbone Blooddrop
chapters.content:
Fang Hao began preparations for the Domain Incredible Formation using the Qinghua state, busily conceptualizing the arrangement of the Great Formation in the Qinghua realm.
And to arrange such a Great Formation, he needed sufficient understanding of the Qinghua state.
Therefore, he was now examining the maps of the Qinghua state, treasures from the three great forces.
Beyond that, when the time came to actually deploy the formation, he would need to personally visit some key locations to comprehend and arrange them.
This was a complex process, not something that could be completed in just a year or two.
Currently, with the Heavenly Grotto in the Qinghua state in chaos and figures like Emperor Da Yue and other Immortal Heavenly Venerables unable to spare the time, arranging the Great Formation would have to wait until the Heavenly Grotto quieted down, when these Immortal Heavenly Venerables could lend their assistance.
As for when the Heavenly Grotto would settle down, Fang Hao didn't know, but it was possible to take proactive action to calm it.
Perhaps, with a move from his master?
Su Lingxiu was also plotting her Alchemical Medical Martial Arts, contemplating the arrangement of the Domain Divine Furnace to absorb the Heaven and Earth Laws using the rhythm of the Dao Principles for alchemy.
She too had found a path to enhance her strength.
Of course, setting up the Domain Divine Furnace required numerous materials and some time to complete, but once the arrangement was finished, the harvest phase would begin, and her strength would rapidly improve, making all the efforts worthwhile.
Jiang Buping was delving into the refinement of Extreme Soul Divine Weapons and the understanding of Extreme Soul Divine Skills.
"Your disciple, Jiang Buping, has grasped how to refine Extreme Soul Divine Weapons, and you have obtained an Extreme Path Soul Soldier," came the feedback from the Daoist Golden Book.
Atop the Spirit Pedestal, a Long Spear appeared, falling into the hands of the Extreme Soul Body.
The Long Spear was cold and surrounded by a sharp aura, as if a mere glance could tear one's Divine Soul apart.
"Good, not bad, with this Extreme Path Soul Soldier, the might of the Extreme Soul Martial Arts can truly be unleashed."
Li Xuan was overjoyed.
"With my current strength, even those above the Immortal Realm who merge with the Domain Martial Artist would not be able to withstand a single blow from me."
Void-breaking Realm, shattering the illusory space of heaven and earth; this Power of Void-breaking is enough to blast out those merged with the Domain.
"The Domain Realm is a major leap, surpassing the Immortal Realm by two or three Realms is no issue."
Li Xuan reassessed his Martial Arts once again.
Starting from the Divine Skill Realm, it no longer corresponded one-to-one with the Taicang Martial Arts Realms. Divine Skill Realm had already surpassed the Divine Refinement Realm, reaching the Condensation Law Realm and was even stronger than that.
Physiognomy was stronger than the Truth King Heavenly Venerables of Truth Refinement Realm, and Void-breaking Realm, with its power to shatter the illusory space of heaven and earth, was, in terms of strength, also well above the Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm.
"Taicang invincibility is getting closer and closer," Li Xuan said, full of anticipation. After Taicang invincibility, it would be time to transcend heaven and earth.
To transcend heaven and earth, should it not be enough to stand shoulder to shoulder with the owner of the Book of Taicang, or even surpass it?
"I must not become arrogant, after all, there are many Supreme Experts out there, and the owner of the Book of Taicang may not be the strongest."
Li Xuan warned himself not to get carried away.
He continued to devote himself earnestly, studying the summary of the Book of Taicang.
In the following time, as Jiang Buping began to grasp Extreme Soul Divine Skills, Li Xuan naturally received feedback, and the method of Extreme Soul Martial Arts began to be perfected.
"This battle of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables in the Nine Mountains Realm still hasn't ended, huh?"
Li Xuan glanced at the direction of the Nine Mountains Realm in his spare time and couldn't help but be astounded.
"Master, what do you think about using the Heavenly Grotto as the mouth of the Divine Furnace?" Su Lingxiu asked as she massaged her master's shoulders.
After some thought, she felt that using the Heavenly Grotto as the Domain Divine Furnace seemed to be the best choice.
The cavern of heaven and earth as the Divine Furnace perfectly fits.
The vast mouth of the Heavenly Grotto would be the mouth of the Divine Furnace, just imagine how much Pill could be produced, and how powerful those Pills would be.
"Do you think you can control such a grand Heavenly Grotto?" asked Li Xuan, raising an eyebrow.
It must be said that Su Lingxiu's idea was really good, but with her current strength, to control such a vast Heavenly Grotto and transform it into a Domain Divine Furnace was not feasible.
"I can't manage the great Heavenly Grotto for now, but a smaller one is doable; just slowly changing the Heavenly Grotto over time, all it takes is some time," Su Lingxiu said confidently.
"If you can manage it, then go ahead," Li Xuan nodded.
"Master, the Heavenly Grotto is in chaos now, it's not easy to do," Su Lingxiu giggled.
"You find Feng Yan, go to destroy a small Heavenly Grotto; with his strength, it is certainly achievable. You start practicing with a small Heavenly Grotto, Da Yue Abyss is something you should not think about for now," Li Xuan advised, shaking his head.
This girl, directly setting her sights on the Da Yue Abyss, hoped for him to strike and flatten the Da Yue Abyss to create her Domain Divine Furnace.
"I don't want to go too far away from master," Su Lingxiu said, planning ahead, "The Da Yue Abyss might be vast, but there is no need to turn the entire abyss into the Domain Divine Furnace. Just a part of it can be transformed, and then slowly cover the entire abyss."
Li Xuan listened to Su Lingxiu's plan while pondering to himself.
The Da Yue Abyss seemed indeed to be a good location, being one of the three great abysses of the Qinghua state.
If it were transformed into a Domain Divine Furnace, it would be the perfect match, though of course, this would require no small amount of time.
As Su Lingxiu said, it could be arranged bit by bit. Once successful in becoming a Domain Divine Furnace, even the Netherworld Qi would be absorbed and refined into Pill.
Any way you look at it, it seems full of advantages.
"Well then, for the advancement of my disciple's Martial Arts, I shall make a move once again," Li Xuan muttered to himself.
"Alright, once your Fifth Junior Brother leaves seclusion, I will help you flatten it," Li Xuan reluctantly agreed, putting on an act of helplessness.

chapters.title: Chapter 783 - 411: Using the Heavenly Grotto as the Divine Furnace, Netherbone Blooddrop_2
chapters.content:
```
"Thank you, Master!"
Su Lingxiu was overjoyed.
As for the Master waiting for Fifth Junior Brother to emerge from seclusion, it certainly was for direct instruction, letting Fifth Junior Brother witness the might of Extreme Soul Martial Arts and gain a deeper understanding of it.
Su Lingxiu couldn't help but look forward with great anticipation. The Master was about to take action again—an opportunity that was hard to come by.
It was also the perfect chance to witness the power of Extreme Soul Martial Arts.
In the Da Yue Abyss, bloodlight surged tumultuously. The Emperor of Da Yue and several Immortal Heavenly Venerables were utilizing a Great Formation to fend off a Netherworld Blood Child intent on stepping into the Abyss.
And a multitude of True King Heavenly Venerables were maintaining the operation of the Formation, using its might to annihilate the Blood Disciples that intended to invade.
Even so, the bloodlight still seeped in, tumbling as if it were a rolling tide of blood.
"If it weren't for the Formation's enhancement, I'm afraid the Abyss might have been lost again, and we would have had no choice but to fall back to the Entrance of the Heavenly Cave," said the Emperor of Da Yue with a sigh.
This Netherworld invasion was more intense than ever before, with more and stronger Netherworld Blood Children participating, even pushing the limits of the power the Abyss could withstand.
Even with the assistance of the Formation, Emperor Da Yue and the others still felt the pressure mounting.
This time, the Netherworld seemed to have employed a powerful Supreme Treasure of the Netherworld. Even though only part of its might had penetrated, it caused the Formation to tremble ceaselessly, and the Heaven and Earth Laws to fluctuate.
The Abyss itself was a hole in the Domain, and it seemed that the other party wanted to further expand this Domain puncture.
However, the Heaven and Earth Laws were still solid, dispelling some of the infiltrating forces, thereby ensuring the Abyss was not widened.
Boom!
Suddenly, above the Abyss, at the sealed section of the Great Formation, a deep red light emerged.
"Attack with all your might!"
A sense of crisis welled in the Emperor Da Yue's heart at the sight of this deep red light—even someone as strong as him.
The Halberd revealed its divine power, with its formidable might bolstering the Formation and surging towards the Abyss above.
The rest of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables hurriedly took action as well.
However, the deep red light did not disperse, nor did it seep into the Abyss; it seemed to be gathering strength.
The Heaven and Earth Laws at the edge of the Abyss manifested, swirling around the Domain Barrier, seemingly to prevent the intrusion of this deep red light.
Even the faintest hint of the Dao Rhythm appeared intermittently.
"What is this?" exclaimed an Immortal Heavenly Venerable in shock.
"The handiwork of a Netherworld Blood Spirit!" said the Emperor Da Yue, his face darkened, and he added with a quiet shock.
"What?"
The colors drained from the faces of the others.
"Could it be that a Netherworld Blood Spirit might enter the Abyss?"
Their hearts sank at the thought.
If a Netherworld Blood Spirit could set foot inside the Abyss, it would be beyond their capacity to defend against.
It was a being that surpassed even an Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
"The Blood Spirit can't enter the Abyss, but it has found a way to infiltrate an attack. The Formation will break, and once it does, it will be difficult for us to stave off the enemies of the Netherworld outside the Abyss.
"Moreover, the attack of the Blood Spirit poses a great threat to us. We must be cautious and cannot withstand it directly!" the Emperor Da Yue said in a solemn voice.
His expression was laden with gravity. If his guess was correct, the Da Yue Abyss would fall once again, reduced to its previous state—stationed at the Entrance to the Abyss, preventing the enemies of the Netherworld from breaking through.
Once that happened, the advantage of Da Yue Country would be lost.
Should they ask the senior experts to take action?
The Emperor Da Yue couldn't bring himself to make the request, nor did he have the face to do so.
Besides, would such senior figures condescend to intervene?
"Be careful, everyone."
Emperor Da Yue took a deep breath, knowing they could only rely on themselves.
He looked towards the True King Heavenly Venerables who were enhancing the Formation and ordered, "Withdraw from this place, set up the defensive Great Formation on the outer layer."
He was already prepared for the core area of the Abyss to be compromised.
But, if they could manage to seal the Netherworld forces within the core area of the Abyss, that was still an acceptable outcome.
"Yes!"
A group of True King Heavenly Venerables changed their expressions and promptly retreated. Outside the core region of the Abyss, they took out their Array Plates and began to establish the defensive Great Formation.
Thud!
Under the grave watch of Emperor Da Yue and the others, above the Abyss, a drop of deep red power, like blood, penetrated the Domain Barrier and fell downwards.
As this drop of deep red blood fell, in an instant, an aura of terror diffused, as if emanating from a purgatorial realm, surging forth.
"Attack with all your might!" the Emperor Da Yue's expression dramatically changed.
```
Boom!
Several Immortal Heavenly Venerables unleashed a powerful strike, reinforcing the Great Formation, in an attempt to withstand the force that resembled blood droplets.
Thud!
The deep crimson blood suddenly dispersed, turning into a scarlet glow, like the blood fires of hell, fiercely igniting.
A somber voice came from beyond the Domain Barrier.
"You mere ants also presume to resist the Netherbone Blooddrop!"
Boom!
Even though the Netherbone Blooddrop's power was halved by passing through the Domain Barrier, it was still immensely powerful. Under the sweep of the scarlet blood light, the once stable Great Formation instantly collapsed.
At the edge of the Heavenly Cave, the Heaven and Earth Laws shimmered with light, continually eroding the invading force, preventing it from further expanding within the Heavenly Cave.
"Retreat quickly!"
Emperor Da Yue's heart turned cold, knowing they couldn't hold it any longer. If they didn't retreat, they would likely be injured by this strike.
Once injured, their strength would decline, making it even harder to resist the subsequent onslaught of the Netherworld Blood Children.
The cadre of Immortal Heavenly Venerables hastily retreated. The core Formation of the Heavenly Cave had vanished, and rolling waves of blood surged inside, one blood-colored figure after another descending upon them.
Just like when the Heavenly Cave first appeared, they ultimately failed to ward off the enemy outside the Heavenly Cave.
Boom!
A blood-colored figure, mighty and strong, not the least bit weaker than Emperor Da Yue himself.
The other Blood Children were also formidable.
"Prepare for a great battle."
Emperor Da Yue took a deep breath.
The heart of the Heavenly Cave had fallen, which meant they couldn't stop the enemies from the Netherworld from breaching the cave.
Fortunately, defensive Formations still existed outside the core area of the Heavenly Cave, providing aid in defense and reducing pressure. The infiltrating force of the Blood Spirit was confined to the core area, unable to reach the periphery.
There was no need to worry about the Blood Spirit's power breaking through the Formations.
"Kill!"
Waves of blood churned, blood light pierced the sky, and endless blood-colored figures were violently assaulting.
Emperor Da Yue gripped the Halberd, and stood within the Formation, facing the strongest of the Blood Children.
The Great Formation was activated, and Immortal Heavenly Venerables, one after another, True King Heavenly Venerables, with the power of the Great Formation, resisted the attack from the Netherworld.
The Heavenly Cave once again plunged into fierce combat.
In Da Yue Country, one after another, True King Heavenly Venerables started rushing towards the Heavenly Cave, and the Array Plates refined by Fang Hao kept being brought in.
"The Da Yue Heavenly Cave has actually fallen?"
Fang Hao was incredibly astonished.
"Yes, a Netherworld Blood Spirit infiltrated its power inside, defeating the defensive Formation."
The True King Heavenly Venerable who had just returned from the Heavenly Cave, seeking the Array Plates, spoke with a grave expression.
"This is the Ten Extreme Killing Formation, take it and set it up."
Fang Hao nodded, took out several Array Plates, and handed them to the True King Heavenly Venerable.
"Many thanks, Dean Fang!"
The True King Heavenly Venerable expressed his gratitude.
As he was taking the Array Plates to head for the Da Yue Heavenly Cave, suddenly a message arrived.
The Da Yue Heavenly Cave had fallen. The Netherworld Blood Children had directly blood-refined thousands of Blood Slaves and dozens of Blood Disciples, setting up the Netherworld's lethal Great Techniques, defeating the defensive Formation.
Emperor Da Yue and the others were forced to fall back to the entrance of the Da Yue Heavenly Cave!
The situation turned dire in an instant. Upon seeing this, Fang Hao said, "I'll go with you."
Boom!
Even from the Capital City of Da Yue, one could see a faint red hue above the Heavenly Cave, showing how resolute this invasion from the Netherworld was, resorting to the blood-refinement of numerous Blood Disciples, executing lethal Great Techniques.
Eight Domain forces suddenly converged, with thunder, flames, and more appearing above the Heavenly Cave. Fang Hao, using the Domain Qimen, utilized these Domain forces to lay down a Great Formation.
"To turn this Da Yue Heavenly Cave into a Domain Divine Furnace, the difficulty is no small feat."
Su Lingxiu clicked her tongue in wonder.
"However, the greater the challenge, the larger the reward. I want this Heavenly Cave to become the Domain Divine Furnace!"
Jiang Buping emerged from the retreat.
Clutching a Long Spear in hand, an ultmate aura lingered around it, and it seemed as though the spear was forged from Divine Souls.
"What kind of Divine Weapon is this? Just by looking at it, I feel a sense of my own divine presence being torn apart."
Shi'er said in shock.
Seeing Jiang Buping coming out of retreat, Su Lingxiu was immediately overjoyed, shaking Li Xuan's arm and saying, "Master, Master, the Fifth Junior Brother has come out of retreat, it's time for you to make a move!"
"Alright then."
Li Xuan patted her hand and looking towards the Da Yue Heavenly Cave, decided it was time to take action once again.
The Fifth Door of Martial Arts had already emerged, so it was time to showcase its power.

chapters.title: Chapter 784 - 412: My Name, You Cannot Bear
chapters.content:
This time, Li Xuan intended to demonstrate the Extreme Soul Martial Arts while simultaneously teaching his fifth disciple, letting him understand just how powerful his master was.
Li Xuan sat unmoved, yet a figure emerged and manifested.
It was no different from him, but it exuded an aura of extremity with a hint more of a domineering essence.
"Now that you've entered the gate, today, your teacher will reveal a technique so you can witness what is meant by Extreme Soul Martial Arts."
The Extreme Soul Body spoke to Jiang Buping.
"Yes, Master!"
Jiang Buping's face was full of astonishment as he looked back and forth between the Extreme Soul Body and his master, still leisurely seated in the chair, unable to comprehend what exactly was happening.
Su Lingxiu's beautiful eyes widened as she scrutinized the Extreme Soul Body for a long while and realized that this did not seem to be an incarnation like a Primordial Spirit Divided Self.
It seemed to be the master himself.
"Master, what is this...?"
Li Xuan replied with a calm smile, "The methods of your teacher are beyond your comprehension. This is not a separate being; this is also part of your teacher."
Without further explanation, the Extreme Soul Body looked toward the Abyss of Da Yue and said with a smile, "Let's go."
"Yes, Master!"
Su Lingxiu was brimming with excitement and Jiang Buping was filled with eagerness – the master was about to make a move.
Shi'er and the others felt the same.
Feng Yan's face was full of anticipation as well, and he was also shocked by how unfathomable the senior expert was.
The Abyss of Da Yue, even though Fang Hao had deployed the Great Formation with the power of Domain, was still facing a fierce assault, as if it could collapse at any moment.
Below the Abyss of Da Yue, several Xuezhi were making their move; and behind the cave, there were densely packed Blood Slaves and Blood Disciples.
Boom!
All of a sudden, a strong blood light transformed into a scarlet long knife, slashing down fiercely. The blade seemed to burn with a crimson flame.
And with this one strike, the thousands of Blood Slaves and the dozen or more Blood Disciples were all Blood Refined into the power of this one blow.
"Block it!"
Along with this strike came the powerful attack of the Xuezhi.
A host of True King Heavenly Venerables hurriedly joined forces, using the might of the Formation to withstand this powerful strike.
Emperor Da Yue's face was unusually grim.
"I refuse to believe that you Netherworld Blood Slaves can continue endlessly, that you can Blood Refine at will!"
He ground his teeth in anger.
Had the Netherworld gone mad, ready to pour its power into the invasion of the Qinghua State? Otherwise, such rampant Blood Refining of Blood Slaves, do they not fear weakening the Netherworld's strength?
He couldn't help but recall the intense wars of the past.
The Netherworld had used similar Offensive Arts before, and in the end, one Martial Artist after another in the Qinghua State had resorted to burning their own secret techniques, and it was with a heavy price that they managed to repel the Netherworld.
Since then, the Netherworld had not employed such Offensive Arts anymore.
Now, employing these Offensive Arts again, were they trying to force the Martial Artists of the Qinghua State to trade lives for lives, depleting the overall strength of the Qinghua State?
He couldn't help but consider the intentions of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, suspecting that they were related.
"Have all the Netherworld forces invading the Nine Mountain Realm Grotto been redirected here to invade our Qinghua State?"
Emperor Da Yue's face was extremely unpleasant.
Currently, the Nine Mountain Realm was in turmoil, making it difficult for the Qinghua State to ask for help.
Asking for help from realms outside the Nine Mountain Realm was also difficult due to the distance and the need to cross the Nine Mountain Realm, which meant that even if they successfully sent out a call for aid, reinforcements would take quite some time to arrive.
"This time, the casualties won't be as severe."
Emperor Da Yue looked at the Great Formation, knowing the assistance it provided meant casualties would not be as high.
Immediately after, his expression changed.
He moved instantaneously to Fang Hao's side, and the Halberd thundered out to defend against the scarlet blade slashing from the cave.
This blade had been Blood Refined by dozens of Blood Disciples.
Had the Netherworld gone mad?
Even with many Blood Disciples, such wasteful tactics were unusual. And to tear the Great Formation, they spared no expense – could it be that next time they would Blood Refine the Xuezhi to unleash a devastating Great Technique?
Boom!
Under the protection of the Great Formation and the actions of Emperor Da Yue, the blow was defended.
However, the next moment Emperor Da Yue's face underwent another drastic change.
At the back of the cave, a Xuezhi was approaching, heading toward the cave entrance. As he drew closer, a blood-colored flame surrounded him, growing stronger and stronger.
All at once, the Blood Slaves around him transformed into streaks of crimson light, surging into his body.
By the time this Xuezhi reached the cave entrance, he had turned into a scarlet, chilly, and murderously intent long knife.
The leading Xuezhi grasped it with one hand, holding the scarlet long knife, his gaze sinister as he looked at both Emperor Da Yue and Fang Hao.
"Not good, Brother Fang, retreat quickly!"
Emperor Da Yue turned pale with horror.
A single Xuezhi, coupled with the Blood Refining of thousands of Blood Slaves to form this knife, was unimaginably powerful. Even he might not be able to withstand it without employing a secret technique.
The other Immortal Heavenly Venerables also changed in expression, with one stepping forward, his aura burgeoning, "Your Majesty, I will stake all my cultivation and fight him to the end!"
At this moment, there was no other choice but to fight for their lives; otherwise, the Great Formation would surely break, allowing the enemies of the Netherworld to seize the opportunity and invade the Qinghua State.
Fang Hao, too, was shocked. Had the Netherworld Blood Child gone mad?
So reckless?
In that instant, he felt somewhat helpless, his strength ultimately a bit lacking. Otherwise, why would he feel threatened by this mere blade?
With just a thought, the power of Domain surged like rolling waves, and the Power of Domain Laws descended. Luminance swirled around Fang Hao, the Qimen Armory appeared, and one Divine Weapon after another soared out.

chapters.title: Chapter 785 - 412: My Name, You Cannot Bear_2
chapters.content:
He prepared to set up the Domain Qimen Great Formation to fend off the slash from the Netherworld Blood Child.
At this moment, several figures descended.
"Master?!"
Fang Hao was startled, looked at his master, and felt puzzled. Why did his master seem somewhat different?
Li Xuan nodded, gazed down at the Heavenly Grotto, especially at the slash that the Blood Child had formed by blood refining itself, and turned back to Jiang Buping, saying, "As a teacher, I will only take action this once. How much you can learn and perceive depends entirely on you."
Jiang Buping's expression was solemn as he respectfully nodded, "Yes, Master!"
The likes of Emperor Da Yue were overjoyed upon hearing this.
The high-ranking predecessor is going to take action, and the Da Yue Abyss must be leveled!
Looking at Jiang Buping, they couldn't help but feel immensely grateful. If it hadn't been for the predecessor's desire to teach his disciple, he might not have taken action at all. They owed a lot to Jiang Buping.
The Netherworld Blood Child below in the Heavenly Grotto, holding that scarlet long knife, had a solemn look in his eyes as he stared at Li Xuan's Extreme Soul Body, sensing a strong feeling of danger.
Li Xuan raised his hand, and the Extreme Path Soul Soldier appeared in his grasp.
As soon as the Extreme Path Soul Soldier appeared, Emperor Da Yue and the others had looks of utter shock on their faces, and they hurriedly averted their gaze.
Too terrifying!
Just one glance gave them a feeling as if their Divine Soul was being torn apart.
What Divine Weapon is this?
Jiang Buping looked at the Extreme Path Soul Soldier in his master's hand and then at his own Extreme Soul Divine Weapon, and immediately felt an immense sense of disparity—far too great.
"This is the Extreme Path Soul Soldier, and you still need to strive to nurture it. Your Soul Soldier can only be considered basic."
Li Xuan gently caressed the Extreme Path Soul Soldier with one hand.
His gaze fell on the Blood Child with a heavy face and said indifferently, "You from the Netherworld like to practice Blood Refining; now I give you the opportunity, continue your blood refining, or you will have no chance left!"
"Who are you?" the Blood Child asked in a deep voice.
"My name is not something you can withstand!"
Li Xuan's gaze was indifferent, as if he was disregarding ants.
Boom!
Below the Heavenly Grotto, a group of Blood Slaves turned into streams of blood light, constantly surging into the long knife in the Blood Child's hand.
Even the remaining Blood Children became ruthless at this moment, blood refining themselves.
Rumble!
The Heaven and Earth Laws at the edge of the Heavenly Cave Entrance were trembling, and a large number of Blood Slaves in the grotto disappeared in an instant, leaving only three Blood Children.
Each one of them was holding a scarlet long knife.
Their strength had risen to the limit allowed by the Abyss.
And the killing knife forged through blood refining had become even stronger.
"Is this all?"
Li Xuan gave an indifferent smile.
His profound gaze looked into the depths of the Heavenly Grotto. As the number of Blood Disciples, Blood Slaves, and Blood Children decreased, the grotto could accommodate new Netherworld Blood Children entering.
Thus, deeper inside the Abyss, more Blood Children descended.
"Extreme Soul Martial Arts eradicates the soul and destroys the body, an unrivaled offensive prowess that primarily focuses on soul eradication and secondarily on body destruction. All techniques are based on soul destruction.
"For every creature in the world, the extinction of the soul leads to nothingness, all becomes void.
"It's difficult to defend against the Divine Soul, yet not easy to destroy, but Extreme Soul Martial Arts was born to slay the Divine Soul—Extreme Soul Path, using one's ultimate soul to annihilate the souls of all living beings."
Li Xuan explained to Jiang Buping as he raised the Extreme Path Soul Soldier and slowly thrusted the spear out.
This thrust was exceedingly slow, as if any Grandmaster Martial Artist could easily dodge it.
However, facing this spear, the three Blood Children were terrified beyond measure. They couldn't evade at all and felt a profound terror descending upon their Divine Soul.
"Kill!"
With a roar, the long knives in their hands unleashed the strongest strike of their lives.
They executed the Great Technique born from blood refining!
Jiang Buping gripped his spear tightly, his eyes wide, focusing on his master's move. This thrust appeared plain and unremarkable, yet it epitomized the consummation of Extreme Soul Martial Arts.
Emperor Da Yue and others were even more shocked.
It felt like the high-ranking predecessor's spear thrust was only performed with the power of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm, clearly suppressing his true power, solely to instruct his disciple.
Yet, the Emperor Da Yue and other Immortal Heavenly Venerables felt a sense that this thrust was unavoidable, undefendable, with an intense sense of crisis for their Divine Soul.
This thrust was not aimed at them, yet they all felt such terror.
