This showed how horrendous the terror the three Blood Children felt when facing this thrust.
A spear thrust out, slow and untroubled, yet at the instant the three Blood Children made their move, a cold and chilling glint seemed to illuminate the entrance of the Heavenly Grotto.
This bone-chilling coldness was not perceived by the flesh, but felt by the Divine Soul!
Pff!
The three Blood Children's eyes instantly became vacant, and the attacks that had just erupted also dissipated, as if their Divine Soul Consciousness had been utterly extinguished.
Li Xuan took a step forward, spear in hand, and entered the Heavenly Grotto.
As he moved, the bodily form of Xuezhi crumbled to dust and vanished, while the remaining Blood Slaves and Blood Disciples at the entrance of the Heavenly Grotto collapsed to the ground, devoid of any trace of Divine Soul Consciousness, leaving behind only empty husks.
As Li Xuan stepped in, those empty husks also turned to dust and dispersed.
Gulp!
Emperor Da Yue and the others swallowed their saliva, their hearts trembling.
Such powerful Netherworld Warriors were nearly breaking through the Heavenly Grotto's defenses, yet the elder only struck once, and all the enemies turned to dust and vanished.
What's more terrifying is that the elder seemed to have suppressed his own cultivation, merely striking with the power of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm?
A true master indeed.
"Is this Extreme Soul Martial Arts, is this Extreme Soul Divine Skill?!"
Jiang Buping murmured to himself, excited and shocked.
"Fifth Junior Brother, you must work hard in your cultivation," said Su Lingxiu as she patted Jiang Buping's shoulder with a smile, having recovered from her shock.
She then eagerly followed into the Heavenly Grotto.
"I will work hard!"
Jiang Buping clenched the spear in his hands, his expression firm, envisioning the scene of striking down an Immortal Heavenly Venerable with one thrust.
It was too shocking, too thrilling.
I, Jiang Buping, will surely make Extreme Soul Martial Arts renowned and feared throughout the Divine Realm!
"This spear strike, not bad at all," Li Xuan thought to himself.
He had indeed not used his true strength, yet this spear strike was powerful enough.
Under a single strike, Xuezhi's Divine Soul was obliterated, without a chance to resist.
The art of attacking the Divine Soul, truly domineering and powerful.
After stepping into the Heavenly Grotto, there was a rolling surge of blood ahead as Xuezhi led the Blood Disciples and Blood Slaves in an onslaught.
Li Xuan slightly raised the spear in his hand, and a cold gleam instantly exterminated Xuezhi, wiping out most of the Blood Disciples and Blood Slaves, then turned back to Jiang Buping and said, "Time for you to practice."
"Yes, Master!"
Jiang Buping, brimming with excitement, wielded the Extreme Soul Divine Weapon and charged into the fray.
Boom!
A terrifying spear light split the sky, turning into countless shining points, striking down upon its targets.
Extreme Soul Divine Skill, Star Extinguish!
Li Xuan nodded, Jiang Buping's talent was indeed monstrous, worthy of someone with a natural Divine Soul and one favored by great destiny.
He had already cultivated the Extreme Soul Divine Skill, Star Extinguish, quite well.
Thump!
One by one, figures fell under the Star Extinguish, their eyes hollow, Divine Souls wiped out.
However, their bodies remained, now devoid of all life.
This was also Jiang Buping's first time using his Divine Skill, and he couldn't yet achieve instantaneous soul obliteration and corporeal dissolution, which is why the Divine Souls perished, but the bodies didn't turn into dust.
Jiang Buping raised his hand and struck with his palm, within which lay a black abyss that instantaneously swallowed a Blood Disciple.
Within the consciousness of this Blood Disciple, it felt as if an abyss had descended, and at that moment, the Divine Soul could not resist at all and was consumed by the abyss, obliterating it instantly.
Li Xuan nodded again, this was the second Divine Skill Jiang Buping cultivated, Devouring Abyss!
So far, Jiang Buping had only mastered these two Divine Skills, but as for the subsequent Extreme Soul Divine Skills and the Extreme Soul Martial Arts Techniques, natural understanding would come as he fought throughout the Divine Realm.
"I want to practice as well!"
Fang Hao's blood was boiling as he excitedly slapped the Qimen Armory. In an instant, a legion of weapons poured forth, sweeping toward the Netherworld Warriors.
The Domain Qimen Great Formation materialized in the air immediately.
Boom!
In the heart of the Heavenly Grotto, bloodlight blossomed as three figures descended – they were three Blood Children.
Clearly, the Netherworld had noticed the upheaval in the Heavenly Grotto.
Li Xuan raised his spear slightly, and as soon as the newly arrived Blood Children touched down, they thudded to the ground, their gazes empty, their Divine Souls utterly extinguished.
"Master, leave their corpses," Su Lingxiu hastily spoke.
Turning around, she instructed Feng Yan, "Go quickly, bring back the corpses of the Blood Children."
"Alrighty!"
Feng Yan perked up immediately, finally it was his turn to shine.
He scurried over, grabbed the three corpses of the Blood Children, and started back. However, at that moment, peril suddenly descended, and he felt an intense danger looming in his heart.
Above the Heavenly Grotto, a drop of dark red blood was falling from the Domain Barrier.

chapters.title: Chapter 786 - 413: A Strike to Annihilate the Blood Spirit, The Path of the Castaway's Counterattack
chapters.content:
Feng Yan looked up to see a drop of deep red blood falling. His scalp tingled with numbness as a strong sense of crisis enveloped him, making even his breathing pause.
This droplet of blood contained a terrifying power.
Even as an Immortal Heavenly Venerable who had gained strength and cultivated Divine Skills, he still felt incapable of resisting this single droplet of blood.
Even if undying, he would still be heavily injured!
The power permeating from this droplet of blood was somewhat weakened by the Domain Barrier; otherwise, it would have been enough to kill him outright.
An existence above the Immortal Realm?
Netherworld Blood Spirit?
Feng Yan's expression drastically changed as the crisis loomed over him!
Emperor Da Yue's expression shifted, he exclaimed, "Netherbone Blooddrop, be careful!"
Li Xuan raised an eyebrow, his Long Spear struck with a booming sound, instantly shattering the Netherbone Blooddrop, turning it into a dissipated blood light.
An intervention from above the Immortal Realm?
Netherworld Blood Spirit?
With one step, Li Xuan arrived at the core of the Heavenly Grotto, looking up beyond the Domain Barrier.
At this moment, Feng Yan felt as though he had been reborn, grabbing three corpses of Xuezhi and hastily leaving.
"Who goes there?"
A cold voice came from beyond the Domain Barrier.
"My name is 'Causality,' too much for ants to bear," Li Xuan said indifferently.
The one who came to the Heavenly Grotto was of the Extreme Soul Body, which was essentially no different from the original body.
The Eye of the Heavenly Dao appeared at this moment.
What the Extreme Soul Body saw, Li Xuan saw as well, and he could also use the Eye of the Heavenly Dao on the Extreme Soul Body.
Dao Principles surrounded him, turning into a barrier with the power of the Dao Principles, preventing the entry of stronger external forces from beyond, and stopping the invasion of more powerful foreign enemies.
Is this the self-defense of the Domain?
Yet, the Domain Barrier also prevented the martial artists within the Domain from leaving it.
Li Xuan was already very familiar with the Taicang Domain, especially the Dao Principles. Under the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, he saw even more.
Chaos, darkness, and a mist of blood appeared beyond the Domain. A figure with blood-colored long whiskers and chilling eyes stood amidst the mist.
It was the Netherworld Blood Spirit who had made a move.
"That is enough," Li Xuan said with an indifferent gaze after assessing the Blood Spirit's strength. Although it was above the strength of the Immortal Realm, it was still significantly weaker than himself.
"So, is my current strength actually much stronger than a realm above the Immortal Realm, at least comparable to being nearly two realms higher?"
Even if not, the difference wouldn't be much.
Although he was in the Void-breaking Realm, his strength had been amplified a hundredfold, and he shouldn't be judged by the standards of an ordinary Void-breaking Realm.
The overlay of five types of Martial Arts and numerous Divine Skills were all beyond imagination.
"Arrogance!"
The Blood Spirit said coldly. With a lift of its hand, an even deeper red droplet of blood was gathering—a preparation for another strike.
Li Xuan smiled faintly, lifting his Long Spear and pointing it towards the outside of the Domain.
Although blocked by the Domain Barrier, with his understanding of Taicang Daoism, bypassing the Domain Barrier's interference to let this strike out was not difficult.
"In this realm, ants shall not disturb me," Li Xuan's indifferent voice also passed through.
Pfft!
This strike, seemingly effortless to Li Xuan, was in fact almost a full-powered hit of the Extreme Soul Martial Arts.
The Blood Spirit, just about to make a move, suddenly had a massive shock to its soul.
A suffocating sensation emerged, its Divine Soul trembled, and its expression drastically changed. Before it could even attempt to flee, it was already too late—it felt like its soul had been locked on.
A point of cold light emerged within the Divine Soul.
Boom!
The Blood Spirit's aura erupted, blood light shot up into the sky, and the rolling, bloodthirsty Divine Soul formed a barrier. It was a Divine Soul Defense Technique!
However, this Divine Soul Defense Technique was so fragile, just like paper, and was pierced through by the cold light in an instant.
Thud!
The Blood Spirit fell, its eyes empty and devoid of life, with its Divine Soul extinguished, no breath, no life force left.
"I'll leave your corpse intact to see who else dares to cause trouble," Li Xuan said with a faint smile.
As for offending stronger beings from the Netherworld by killing this Blood Spirit, Li Xuan did not care at all.
If stronger beings could enter the Taicang Domain and the Divine Realm, they would have done so long ago.
Like the Seductive Witch, who must hate him to death—if she could have entered, she would have already come for revenge.
"Once I break through to the Domain Realm, I will be even stronger, not fearing anything!" Li Xuan maintained his calm.
With a wave of his hand, strands of Imperishable Qi entered the Domain Barrier, forming a prohibition seal. With this seal in place, the Netherworld Blood Spirits would not be able to penetrate their power through.
The strength of the Xuezhi entering the Heavenly Grotto would also be weakened.
Su Lingxiu wanted to turn the Da Yue Abyss into a Domain Divine Furnace. If the infiltration from beyond the Domain was sealed off, the Divine Furnace would lack some substances for smelting.
Li Xuan turned around and left, putting away the Extreme Path Soul Soldier.
"All right, set up your own defenses. There will be no Netherworld invasions for a short time," he said.
Su Lingxiu's face lit up with joy, "Thank you, Master!"
"Many thanks, senior!"
Emperor Da Yue and the others hastily bowed with respect.
Li Xuan nodded and vanished from the Heavenly Grotto with just one step.
"The Heavenly Grotto has been pacified. The rest of you head to Myriad Thunder Sect and Tianwu Sect for support," Emperor Da Yue told the other Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
"Yes!"
The group of Immortal Heavenly Venerables left one after another, going to support Tianwu Sect and Myriad Thunder Sect.
The battle of the Heavenly Grotto in the Qinghua state had thus come to a conclusion in this manner.
Post-battle matters also required some time to handle.
Su Lingxiu and others returned, Fang Hao continued to devise his Great Formation, Su Lingxiu was also making preparations for the Domain Divine Furnace, and Jiang Buping was absorbing and comprehending the gains from this battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 787 - 413: One Strike to Annihilate the Blood Spirit, The Path of the Discarded Pawn's Counterattack_2
chapters.content:
The battle at the Heavenly Grotto in the Qinghua state gradually subsided, while the chaos in the Nine Mountain Realm showed no signs of calming, instead growing ever more disordered, with endless great battles raging on.
All nine major forces were entangled in the turmoil, creating utter chaos, and the Netherworld Blood Child was causing more slaughter; the entire Nine Mountain Realm had become a chaotic battlefield.
As core disciples from various major forces continued to fall one after another, even though factors from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow played a part, the major powers had blood in their eyes, and chaotic fighting ensued relentlessly.
"Another Realm is in chaos."
Li Xuan looked up towards a certain location where the fluctuation of the Heaven and Earth Laws was extremely intense, clearly indicating another great battle had erupted, another Realm was in chaos.
"With the Thirty-six Realms of the Divine Realm, how will it all end? Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow has infiltrated too deeply."
The chaos in the Divine Realm had become unstoppable.
The concept of Unity of Domain perhaps had the silent consent of some powerful beings who did not forcefully intervene, evidently they were also waiting to see, to what extent Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow could go.
On this day, Fang Hao also sought out Emperor Da Yue, Myriad Thunder Sect Master, Tianwu Sect Master, among others—the strongest and most influential Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Qinghua state—to begin his grand scheme.
"Set up a Great Formation in the Qinghua state?"
"Correct. Once the Great Formation is completed, the entire Qinghua state will be safe from worry. Not to mention the Netherworld Blood Child, even if the Netherworld Blood Spirit were to come, we could harness the power of the Great Formation, calling upon the might of the Qinghua state's Domain to annihilate it.
"As long as the Great Formation is in place, the Qinghua state is sure to remain unaffected by the great chaos, accumulating powerful strength, and the Heavenly Grotto will no longer be a threat.
"Moreover, my junior sister is using the Heavenly Grotto as the Domain Divine Furnace. Once successful, not only can she refine higher-grade pills, but she can also extract treasures from beyond the Domain and refine them into pills.
"An even more important point is that the Domain Lingji of the Qinghua state will be elevated, and it may attract the arrival of the Dao Rhythm, thus making a breakthrough in the Qinghua state possible."
As Fang Hao explained and persuaded them, Emperor Da Yue and the others were shocked, imagining the Qinghua state enshrouded by the Great Formation, the Heavenly Grotto transforming into the Divine Furnace, and the Domain Lingji surging.
And through this, they too would be able to break through the limits of the Immortal Realm.
The prospect of being able to break through the Immortal Realm right in the Qinghua state was incredibly enticing; no Immortal Heavenly Venerable could resist such temptation.
Once successful, the Qinghua state would truly be impregnable. The chaos of the Divine Realm could not reach it, and even if the Netherworld Blood Spirit descended, they could wield the might of the Qinghua state's Domain to destroy it.
However strong the Netherworld Blood Spirit was, how could it withstand the vast power of the Qinghua state's Domain?
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable was no match for the Netherworld Blood Spirit, simply because the range of the Domain they controlled was too small.
"Good, very good, we'll follow Brother Fang's arrangements!"
Emperor Da Yue said excitedly.
"Yes, we'll follow Brother Fang's lead!"
"Whatever you need, Brother Fang, just speak up; we'll surely succeed with this formation."
The Myriad Thunder Sect Master and Tianwu Sect Master also spoke excitedly.
"Good, then it's settled. Once the Great Formation is successful, no matter how much chaos there is in the Divine Realm, the Qinghua state will have no worries," Fang Hao said with elation.
Arranging a Great Formation across the entire Qinghua state is no easy task, nor can it be completed overnight. Fang Hao is going to be busy for a while, and even with the assistance of several Immortal Heavenly Venerables, he still needs to personally oversee the deployment of the actual Great Formation.
Some less important, non-core formations and refinement of formation artifacts can be left to the others at the Qimen Institute to handle.
The whole Qinghua state began bustling into action, and to prevent the news from leaking, the Realm Gate of the Qinghua state was directly closed to all outsiders.
Su Lingxiu, along with Yue'er, Zhou Ying, and Meng Shushu, was also bustling about, and in the end even Cai Ling'er was pulled in to help make preparations for setting up the Domain Divine Furnace.
"Master, I want to go to the Nine Mountain Realm," Jiang Buping declared upon exiting closed-door cultivation.
He was ready to venture out into the world, and the chaos of the Nine Mountain Realm was the perfect place for him to demonstrate his prowess, especially since his eldest and second elder brothers were also in the Nine Mountain Realm, currently clashing with the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
Together with his brothers, they would carve out a name for themselves!
"Go ahead," Li Xuan nodded and placed a Jade Talisman into Jiang Buping's body.
"Gua!"
Little Ha hopped over, also eager to return to the Nine Mountain Realm.
After all, his elder brothers were busy with the affairs of the Demon Clan; how could he remain idle?
It would be a good opportunity to join Jiang Buping on his journey to the Nine Mountain Realm; with Jiang Buping present, crossing the Realm Gate would be far less dangerous.
Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu took time out of their busy schedules to see him off.
"Here is a Communication Talisman. Throughout the entire Divine Realm, you can communicate unhindered. Also, give these to your eldest and second elder brothers when you arrive.
"This is my latest Array Plate, take it as well for your brothers," Fang Hao handed over a stack of Communication Talismans and a bunch of Array Plates to Jiang Buping.
"Take these pills with you, and also take them for your eldest and second elder brothers. You, with your Extreme Soul Martial Arts and Imperishable Spirit Soul, are not likely to be easily injured, but we can't rule out the possibility of accidents.
"Therefore, this bottle contains pills I have refined that can heal the Divine Soul and restore it. Moreover, they are specially made for you, my junior brother. I have infused them with a wisp of Imperishable Qi to enhance their effectiveness.
"The Imperishable Qi no longer poses a threat to junior brother, and with the effects of the pills, it should be enough to repair the injuries to his Imperishable Spirit Soul,"
Su Lingxiu handed over some pills to Jiang Buping.
Among them, there were pills specifically refined for Jiang Buping. Although she couldn't refine the Imperishable Qi yet, she could integrate it into the pills.
And these pills containing the Imperishable Qi were particularly suitable for Jiang Buping's Extreme Soul Martial Arts.
"Many thanks to third senior sister, fourth senior brother!"
Jiang Buping took every item carefully.
"Little Ha, take these to Red Cat."
Su Lingxiu gave Little Ha some pills intended for Red Cat and his companions.
"Quack!"
Little Ha nodded.
"Junior brother in the Qinghua state, await your glorious reputation!"
Fang Hao said with a smile.
"I will not disappoint you, senior brother,"
Jiang Buping solemnly nodded with a smile.
"Master, your disciple is leaving!"
Jiang Buping respectfully bowed to his master.
"Go, fathom the Extreme Soul Martial Arts Manual thoroughly."
Li Xuan nodded indifferently.
That day, Jiang Buping, along with Little Ha, arrived at the Qinghua state's Realm Gate, stepped into it, and entered the Nine Mountain Realm.
The discarded child of Taikun finally set foot on the path of their counterattack and ascent in this moment.
...
The Nine Mountain Realm was chaotic and riddled with endless battles.
Atop Dahai Mountain, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Wan Family was confronting the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of Thousand Layered Mountain and Horizontal Peak Mountain. A grand battle had already erupted between them.
The entire Dahai Mountain was in disarray. Netherworld Blood Disciples had infiltrated and were rampaging, slaughtering at will; and a Blood Child had entered Dahai Mountain, seemingly waiting for an opportunity to strike.
Boom!
In a location on Dahai Mountain, a giant bathed in brilliant light, wielding a huge saber and surrounded by wind and thunder, his head crowned with a blazing sun, his presence tyrannical and awe-inspiring like a Heavenly God.
"Die!"
A slash that swept wind and thunder, falling like the end of the world.
Splat!
An individual wearing a Ferocious Mask was completely annihilated under this slash, reduced to ash!
Elsewhere, layers upon layers of sword light surged, Sword Intent reflecting through the sky, a vision of inverted mountains and rivers enveloping three Ferocious Mask wearers.
Splat!
As the vision of inverted mountains and rivers manifested with a life-wielding sword strike, the dark sword light seemed to extinguish all existence; the masked individuals fell one after another under this sword.
This location was the headquarters of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow on Dahai Mountain, and the time had come for its uprooting.
After breaking through to the Physiognomy Realm, Meng Chong and Xu Yan together began exacting their revenge against Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, utilizing the Earth Shadow Members who were under the control of the Destiny of the Heavenly Intent. They located each stronghold, killing some and sparing others, until all were uprooted to this day.
And now, it was time to eradicate the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow headquarters on Dahai Mountain.
With turmoil engulfing the Nine Mountain Realm, both Horizontal Peak Mountain and Thousand Layered Mountain had strong individuals accusing Xu Yan and Meng Chong of slaying their proud descendants. Dahai Mountain of the Wan Family was under immense pressure.
Moreover, Dahai Mountain also suffered the killing of its prodigies. Although it was known that Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow was scheming behind the scenes, the chaotic situation could not be altered. The entire Nine Mountain Realm now stood with the Wan Family as the sole familial power.
Naturally, it became the prime target of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, especially since Xu Yan and Meng Chong were on Dahai Mountain.
After all, not a single Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Wan Family was a member of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, and the Shadow could not truly infiltrate the core of the Wan Family.
"Dahai Mountain, from this day forth, will no longer harbor the power of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow. This should also repay the debt for obstructing the Immortal Heavenly Venerable,"
After a great battle, Xu Yan stood with his sword, the residual Sword Intent still somewhat present.
As if it would never dissipate.
This place will become a sacred training ground for Sword Dao martial artists.
Boom!
All of a sudden, a surge of bloody light appeared, and a formidable aura enveloped everything.

chapters.title: Chapter 788 - 414 Brothers Gather, Assassinate the Immortal
chapters.content:
An aura comparable to an Immortal Heavenly Venerable stirred the domain, yet Xu Yan and Meng Chong's expressions remained unchanged, as if they had anticipated this.
"Xuezhi Mo, you've come a bit sooner this time."
Xu Yan said indifferently.
As he spoke, he and Meng Chong, who had regained his full size, vanished in an instant, fleeing into the distance.
"Let's see how long you can run!"
Xuezhi Mo's gaze was icy cold.
He pursued them again and soon lost track of Xu Yan and Meng Chong's aura, which he had expected.
Among the clouds tens of miles away, where their presence was perfectly concealed as if they were one with the clouds, Xu Yan and Meng Chong watched as Xuezhi Mo's figure disappeared.
"Xuezhi Mo is relentless, we can only shake him off temporarily unless we leave the Nine Mountain Realm."
Meng Chong said, frowning.
"No rush, we will cut him down sooner or later!"
Xu Yan said with a cold laugh.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow is really capable, allowing a Netherworld Blood Child to enter the Divine Realm, and their people are in all the major forces of the Nine Mountain Realm, including Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
"As for Red Cat, this big tiger is becoming sharper and sharper."
The situation in the Nine Mountain Realm was in utter chaos. The Spiritual Sovereign Mountain, which could have stayed out of it, was also dragged in, and the head of the Spiritual Sovereign Gate even "got hurt."
As for whether he was truly injured or it was a ruse, only he himself knew.
The Wind Spirit Tiger of the Spiritual Sovereign Mountain also exerted its power once, deterring many Immortal Heavenly Venerables. As a result, there was no great chaos on Spiritual Sovereign Mountain, but there were continuous small disturbances.
As for how this chaos was caused, only Red Cat knew.
"Could it be that Tian Shiqi has been tracking us all along?"
Meng Chong said with a solemn expression.
The power of Tian Shiqi was much stronger than that of Xuezhi Mo, and if they encountered him, escaping would not be easy.
"Perhaps."
Xu Yan exhaled and looked around, saying, "Next, we should clean up those Blood Disciples, and after that's done, leave Dahai Mountain."
He, Xu Yan, did not like to be indebted to anyone. The cooperation with the Wan Family should also come to an end.
Moreover, the pressure that the Wan Family faces now is immense. When they might no longer be able to withstand and stop targeting Immortal Heavenly Venerables for him and Meng Chong remained uncertain.
"Alright!"
Meng Chong nodded.
The two moved and began clearing out the Blood Disciples that had infiltrated Dahai Mountain.
In the Wan Family territory, Wan Tianlin looked up at the firmament with a trace of unwillingness on his face.
As the pride of the Wan Family and a hopeful seed of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables, he could only stay in the clan's territory now, constantly under the watch of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable to avoid assassination.
For Wan Tianlin's safety, he could not leave the clan's territory even for a step.
"Sometimes, I really envy Brother Xu, carefree and indifferent to the threats of the mighty."
Wan Tianlin sighed in his heart.
Xu Yan was wiping out the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow members hidden in Dahai Mountain and had even driven a portion of the Earth Shadow Members out of Dahai Mountain after killing numerous of them.
This was good news for the Wan Family, but the intrusion of Netherworld Blood Disciples, especially Xuezhi Mo's killing spree on Dahai Mountain in pursuit of Xu Yan and Meng Chong, had caused substantial losses.
And the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Wan Family couldn't spare the effort to intervene.
"To escape from Xuezhi's hands, Brother Xu and Meng Chong are truly the unparalleled geniuses of this era!"
Wan Tianlin had to admit, comparing himself as a prodigy to Xu Yan and Meng Chong, he fell short.
If he were in their situation, he would probably have been killed long ago. How could there be any chance to escape from Xuezhi Mo's pursuit?
"I hope Brother Xu can escape."
Wan Tianlin felt helpless, as there was nothing he could do in this situation.
Persuading the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of his clan to fend off those from the Thousand Layered Mountain and Horizontal Peak Mountain was already the limit of what he could achieve.
"Boom!"
With a single punch, Meng Chong blasted a Blood Disciple to smithereens.
"There are still seven Blood Disciples left."
Xu Yan said in a deep voice.
A streak of bloodlight appeared at the edge of the sky, signaling Xuezhi Mo's pursuit.
The two immediately departed.
The Blood Disciples who had infiltrated Dahai Mountain were now reduced to seven under their concerted extermination.
"Big Senior Brother, the last place has all seven Blood Disciples; it may be a trap."
Meng Chong said, rubbing his bald head.
Xu Yan sneered, "Without Xuezhi Mo, and with the war between Immortal Heavenly Venerables erupting, the aura is chaotic. An Immortal Heavenly Venerable who excels in stealth could take advantage of this to infiltrate Dahai Mountain without detection. It must be an Earth Shadow from the Immortal Realm."
"Could it be Tian Shiqi?"
"Tian Shiqi is Heavenly Slaughter, his strength is immense, and if he appeared, the Wan Family would surely detect him."
Xu Yan shook his head.
"Let's test this Immortal Realm Earth Shadow's strength and see if we can..."
A fierce light flashed in Xu Yan's eyes.
They had killed quite a few Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow members, but for them, the loss wasn't significant. If they could slay an Immortal Realm figure, that would be a substantial blow to the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
"To cut down an Immortal Realm figure and make the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow truly suffer!"
Meng Chong's eyes also gleamed with ferocity.
Having been pursued by the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow since entering the Nine Mountains, this long-held grudge wouldn't be settled by just killing a few minions.
Within a cave, seven Blood Disciples were sitting cross-legged, seemingly cultivating and absorbing the essence blood they had consumed.
Everything appeared normal.
Ten miles away, two figures silently emerged.
"No Immortal Heavenly Venerable presence?"
Meng Chong was momentarily surprised.
Xu Yan's eyes glimmered as he surveyed the surroundings, his brows lifted slightly, then he turned his gaze towards the clouds in the sky.
In that moment, Meng Chong's eyes became like two miniature suns, scanning the surroundings as well.

chapters.title: Chapter 789 - 414: Brothers Reunite, Assault on the Immortal_2
chapters.content:
Under the watch of the Minor Heavenly Path Eye, even the most powerful hiding techniques can be seen through.
Not to mention, in terms of concealing presence, who could surpass these two?
"Tsk tsk, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable actually hid himself in the dirt, how rare indeed."
Xu Yan chuckled.
His gaze fell on the muddy ground beneath the seven Blood Disciples.
It had to be said, Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow also knew that ordinary methods of hiding could not deceive the two, so they had directly hidden underground.
Even leveraging the aura of the Blood Disciples to camouflage themselves, such art of concealment, even if another Immortal Heavenly Venerable came, would probably take quite some time to discover.
They might even fall prey to a surprise attack.
However, how could they possibly deceive Xu Yan and Meng Chong? Under the watch of the Minor Heavenly Path Eye, everything was laid bare.
Even without the Minor Heavenly Path Eye, with their techniques of concealing presence, they would have been able to detect it; it could be said that the other party was too confident and had underestimated Xu Yan and Meng Chong.
"Let's pretend we haven't noticed these few Blood Disciples and go stretch our legs with Xuezhi Mo."
Xu Yan pondered for a moment before suggesting.
Let's see how long this Immortal Heavenly Venerable can keep hiding.
The two left quietly and appeared elsewhere, attracting Xuezhi Mo to chase after them, then they continued to flee, leading Xuezhi Mo away, far from where the Immortal Heavenly Venerable was hiding.
At Spiritual Sovereign Mountain, Red Cat was training the spirit beast army.
Little Ha had returned, and with him came Jiang Buping.
"Where are the First Senior Brother and Second Senior Brother?"
Jiang Buping couldn't help but be astonished by the chaos in the Nine Mountain Realm. It was the first time he had heard of such fierce infighting among the Thirty-six Realms of the Divine Domain.
From this, it could be seen how deep Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's arrangements were, that as soon as they made a move, such an intense battle erupted.
"At Dahai Mountain, that Xuezhi Mo is chasing after them."
Red Cat raised a paw and pointed in the direction of Dahai Mountain.
"I take my leave then, I am heading to Dahai Mountain."
Jiang Buping did not delay and turned to leave.
"You better be careful, Dahai Mountain is in a standoff with the Wan Family against Thousand Layered Mountain and Horizontal Peak Mountain. Try not to get involved."
Red Cat warned.
"It's a minor matter."
Jiang Buping laughed, he wasn't new to Martial Arts anymore. Having become a castaway, wandering from the Taikun Realm to the Qinghua state, he had long become experienced and shrewd.
Besides, not only had he made a full recovery now, his strength had greatly improved from his peak, his mastery of Martial Arts had become more profound, making it easy for him to navigate the chaotic Nine Mountain Realm.
At Dahai Mountain, Xu Yan and Meng Chong had led Xuezhi Mo far away, then quietly returned.
"Junior Brother, if I could hold the opponent back for a few moments, do you think you could hurt him?"
Xu Yan looked towards the spot where the Immortal Heavenly Venerable was hiding and asked.
Meng Chong pondered, "Sixty percent chance, but I'm not sure how much I could hurt him."
"The Immortal Heavenly Venerable is indeed powerful, especially wielding the power of Domain, but it's not that we absolutely can't counter him. With a sixty percent chance, we can give it a try," Xu Yan said with a fierce glint in his eyes.
"Good, let's give it a try!"
Meng Chong touched his bald head, his face full of excitement.
"To counter the Immortal Heavenly Venerable and let these Divine Realm Warriors know that Immortal Heavenly Venerables can be countered too!" Xu Yan said with a cold smile.
"Big Senior Brother, what about those seven Blood Disciples?"
Wanting to counter the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, these seven Blood Disciples were an obstacle.
"The Wan Family also wants to hunt down the lurking Blood Disciples. Let them send their experts. Since that Immortal Heavenly Venerable intends to ambush us, let's turn it around and ambush him instead," Xu Yan said cheerfully.
In terms of ambushing, he considered himself well-practiced, even more so than the Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
Meng Chong nodded.
Suddenly, Xu Yan raised an eyebrow and pulled out a Communication Talisman.
"Huh, Fifth Junior Brother has come to the Nine Mountain Realm."
Xu Yan was surprised.
He had thought the message would be from Wan Tianlin or Red Cat, but it turned out to be from Jiang Buping.
"Oh, has Fifth Junior Brother succeeded in his training?"
Meng Chong's eyes lit up.
"Fifth Junior Brother has already arrived at Dahai Mountain. He's within the Communication Talisman's range. Let's put aside the matter of countering the Immortal Heavenly Venerable for now and go meet Fifth Junior Brother."
Xu Yan communicated with Jiang Buping, arranging a place to meet, while turning around to leave.
In a certain area of Dahai Mountain, three martial brothers gathered together.
"So this is the Extreme Soul Martial Arts, the power of Slaughter the Soul, even more tyrannical than my Sudden Wind Sword Intent and also more targeted," Xu Yan exclaimed.
"I've only just begun, and I haven't cultivated many of the Extreme Soul Divine Skills," Jiang Buping shook his head and said.
In terms of strength, he was still slightly weaker than the eldest and second senior brothers, mastering too few of the Extreme Soul Martial Arts Divine Skills and having just entered the threshold.
Even under the direct teaching of their master, and having comprehended a particularly lethal Divine Skill, he had only just begun.
"Fifth Junior Brother's Extreme Soul Martial Arts are even harder for ordinary martial artists to defend against. With your current strength, catching them off guard, even an Immortal Heavenly Venerable would be wounded in their divine soul," Xu Yan said gravely.
The essence of Extreme Soul Martial Arts lay in its extremity, and it was precisely because of this that they were harder to defend against. Divine Realm Warriors who had never faced such martial arts would suffer a great disadvantage if caught off guard, even an Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
"I didn't expect the fourth junior brother to have already refined new Communication Talismans. With these, we don't have to worry about the issue of distance affecting our communication," Meng Chong said, holding a Communication Talisman, currently messaging Fang Hao.
After the three brothers caught up, Jiang Buping opened the conversation, "Eldest brother, second brother, I heard that Xuezhi Mo is after you. How about..." His eyes were eager, filled with fierce light.
"Junior brother, such thoughts are good, very good. Our three brothers joining forces to slay an immortal will certainly shake the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow," Xu Yan laughed heartily.
"Xuezhi Mo can wait for now, we're to kill another Immortal Heavenly Venerable. Fifth Junior Brother, your technique of concealing presence should also be able to deceive an Immortal Heavenly Venerable..."
Jiang Buping's arrival, with his significant strength, especially the Extreme Soul Martial Arts, Slaughter the Soul, meant that the three brothers, cooperating together, should have no problem slaying an ordinary Immortal Realm powerhouse.
The three began to discuss how to ambush and kill the Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
Before they acted, they naturally needed to lure Xuezhi Mo away again, away from the lurking place of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, to prevent Xuezhi Mo from coming to aid the Immortal Heavenly Venerable during the ambush.
The seven Blood Disciples, having grown somewhat impatient, intentionally revealed their tracks. Why hadn't Xu Yan and Meng Chong come to attack them yet?
But they dared not act rashly; this was Xuezhi Mo's command. Besides, they were underground, hidden with an Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
"Scum of Netherworld, come and die!"
Suddenly, two figures appeared, launching an attack. It was two clan elders from the Wan Family.
"Not good!"
The complexions of the seven Blood Disciples changed. Xu Yan and Meng Chong hadn't come, but the clan elders of the Wan Family had!
Boom!
The battle erupted, with the seven Blood Disciples fighting against two elders of the Wan Family. Despite the odds of seven against two, they were still no match for the Wan Family's elders and were beaten back, moving further away from the hidden Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
Several meters beneath the ground, an Immortal Heavenly Venerable wearing a cloudy mask watched the receding battle, hesitant about whether to scare away the Wan Family elders.
If he revealed his presence, the Wan Family's Immortal Realm would realize an Immortal Heavenly Venerable was hiding in Dahai Mountain, and Xu Yan and Meng Chong would also get the message, avoiding the trap.
If he took action to kill the Wan Family elders, once he made a move, his whereabouts would also be exposed.
As he hesitated, suddenly, the earth churned, Sword Intent surged, and an image of mountains and rivers appeared, unleashing a fierce sword strike that descended!
Boom!
"Xu Yan!"
In that instant, his aura exploded, the power of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable spreading in all directions, causing the landscape to crumble. A young man wielding a sword struck, with cycles of swords revolving around his body, endlessly flowing.
"It's just right that you've come. Today, I will slay you!"
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable smiled coldly.
Boom, the might of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable unleashed, but immediately his expression subtly changed. When he was about to utilize the power of the domain, he was hindered, as if another force was blocking him.
That was a visage of mountains and rivers, the descending force of the Domain Laws.
"What kind of martial arts is this?" he thought, shocked, his killing intent becoming even more severe. The more of a monster Xu Yan was, the greater the turmoil his death would create!
Boom!
With one strike, the might of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, immensely powerful, tore through the mountains and rivers' visage, striking directly at Xu Yan.
Hum!
Xu Yan's expression remained unchanged as he retreated, his Yin Yang Undying Sword continuously deflecting the force of the strike, and the Imperishable Sword Intent surged like tumultuous waves.
"Immortal Heavenly Venerable, you are but so-so!" Xu Yan smirked contemptuously, feigning a retreat.
"You won't be able to escape!" The Immortal Heavenly Venerable smiled coldly, stepping forward, executing his killing move.

chapters.title: Chapter 790 - 415: Counterattacking the Immortal Heavenly Venerable
chapters.content:
"Ao!"
The Golden Giant Dragon let out a roar, with a surge of dragon might rippling through the air as if a True Dragon was in a rage.
Immediately after, mountains and rivers descended, and eighteen Golden Giant Dragons roared within them, as ethereal figures raised their swords in hand and fiercely slashed down.
The Yin Yang Undying Sword morphed into an unending cycle, yet it turned into a vortex, binding towards the Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
At that moment, Xu Yan's gaze grew cold and focused, unleashing the Divine Skills like True Dragon Rage, Mountains and Rivers in the Sword, Subduing Dragon Palm, and Yin Yang Undying Sword in quick succession, fusing and stacking them together.
The expression of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable turned icy, shock in his heart. How come Xu Yan, who clearly wasn't an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, possessed such formidable power?
Moreover, these Martial Arts Techniques were truly powerful beyond compare, something he has never witnessed before in his life.
Even though he himself was an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, he did not dare to be careless at this moment, his aura erupting as his blade radiated with layers of light, Domain Power surging within it.
Nonetheless, in the blink of an eye, he could not blast through the visage of mountains and rivers, and he found himself in a defensive position—something inconceivable to him.
He, an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, was actually being pushed to this extent by a non-Immortal Realm Warrior?
The elder from the Wan Family, currently battling a Blood Disciple, had an utterly shocked expression. Looking back, his scalp went numb!
Immortal Heavenly Venerable!
A Immortal Heavenly Venerable had been hiding in Dahai Mountain?!
What was even more shocking was that Xu Yan was actually clashing with an Immortal Heavenly Venerable—was he tired of living?
Even though Xu Yan's strength was formidable, unrivaled among the True King Heavenly Venerables, ultimately he was nothing compared to an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, unless he himself had stepped into the realm of Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
"Has he gone mad?"
At this moment, the two Wan Family elders were horrified and bewildered, wanting to seize the chance to escape.
However, at this very moment, those seven Blood Disciples went crazy, attacking ferociously, even willing to trade their lives to prevent the two from escaping.
"Damn it!"
The complexion of the Wan Family elder changed; it was too late to escape now.
All they could do was pray that the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, considering the Wan Family's sake, would let them go, but such hope was exceedingly slim.
In the territory of the Wan Family, the presence of two Immortal Heavenly Venerables suddenly emerged, both with solemn expressions as they looked towards a specific location in Dahai Mountain.
An Immortal Heavenly Venerable had appeared in Dahai Mountain and was currently in battle.
"I'll take a look!"
One of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables from the Wan Family said solemnly.
With a movement of his body, he swiftly headed towards the battlefield.
In a certain area of Dahai Mountain, Xuezhi Mo suddenly looked up, a cold smile appearing on his lips.
"You've finally taken the bait!"
With a swift movement, he rushed towards the ambush spot.
At this moment, Xu Yan almost completely unleashed his Divine Skills, and a light emerged between his eyebrows in the shape of an eye—that was the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path.
Hum!
This eye, which had never been used before, suddenly shot out a beam of light that seemed like the grand will of the heavens, like the awe-inspiring might of something immeasurable and profound.
The light struck the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, and in just a brief instant, but the Immortal Heavenly Venerable was utterly shocked.
"What secret technique is this?"
As the light enveloped him, he felt as though he was facing the Splendid Heavenly Might, experiencing a sense of the overwhelming supreme command. Moreover, his attacks and his powerful strength both slowed down for an instant.
To be able to decelerate his abilities across realms, how immensely powerful was this secret technique?
Such a technique must come at a great cost, right?
It was at this moment, amidst a deafening boom, a terrifying silhouette emerged behind him.
Glittering with golden light, as if a Heavenly God.
Even more horrifying, atop this figure seemed to appear the image of a giant colossus, holding the sky aloft and uttering a terrifying roar, before smashing his hands down.
As if lifting the very heavens to crash down!
Divine Skill, Heaven Lifting Earth Extinguishing!
Meng Chong seized this fleeting moment to unleash a blow that was domineering and explosive in nature, revealing all his Physical Body Martial Arts Divine Skills in one strike.
Boom!
Afar, the Wan Family elder and the seven Blood Disciples involuntarily stopped their fight, watching this scene in horror.
In their minds, a name surfaced.
Heavenly God!
At this moment, they finally understood why Meng Chong was called the Heavenly God!
Boom!
The ferocious strike hit the Immortal Heavenly Venerable. Even at a time of crisis when he raised a defense, it crumbled instantly under such a brutal attack.
Splat!
With this blow, a huge crater appeared in the ground, and the Immortal Heavenly Venerable was left spewing blood, nearly kneeling.
His face was filled with disbelief; he had actually been injured!
Feeling the stabbing pain in his viscera, the chaotic breath, his killing intent surging, his breathing became heavy, and his eyes turned blood-red.
He, the mighty Immortal Heavenly Venerable, had been wounded in an attack against him!
A humiliation of the greatest shame!
"Give me..."
However, at this moment, in addition to the relentless Sword Intent, besides a golden Giant Dragon in a rage, in addition to the black sword light that obliterated all in its path of slaughter, there was also a Long Spear emitting a hint of cold light, stabbing towards him.
Before the word "die" could leave his lips, he furiously swung his blade in an attempt to destroy the Long Spear, but the spear seemed like an illusion, as if beyond the sight of the naked eye.
The cold light of the spear was already near!
At this moment, a strong sense of crisis emerged, even sensing a chill as if his soul were in peril.
His eyes widened instinctively as he suddenly realized that this spear was not visible to the naked eye, but to the Divine Soul—it was a Slaughter the Soul strike!
Splat!
Even as he operated his Divine Refinement technique at the last moment, even attempting to momentarily disengage his Divine Soul from his body to avoid the spear, all was in vain.

chapters.title: Chapter 791 - 415: Defying the Immortal Heavenly Venerable_2
chapters.content:
The icy light pierced into the Divine Soul, creating a wound that continued to expand. Where the Long Spear struck, the Divine Soul seemed to be continuously dissolving.
Intense pain from the Divine Soul struck, bloodshot spread throughout his eyes, which nearly bulged out of their sockets. Even an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, caught off guard, could not withstand such agony of the Divine Soul.
Almost instinctively, almost subconsciously, he clutched his head with both hands, emitting a piercing scream.
And no sooner had the scream escaped than he belatedly realized that he was in the midst of fierce combat, but by then it was all too late.
Boom!
The black sword light was terrifying, perhaps more than ever before, turning the space above the large pit into darkness that seemed to annihilate everything.
Its sharpness was unmatched, its annihilative intent made him shiver through and through.
The intense pain in the Divine Soul made his reactions dull, and his defenses were also slow, with only the instinct of a powerful being prompting a single line of defense.
However, this defense seemed somewhat fragile.
Splurt!
Under a single sword strike, his body was cut open, his Physical Body dissolving.
Immediately afterward, the furious True Dragon struck, as if seeking mutual destruction.
Another gleam of spear light emerged, stabbing into his Divine Soul, with specks of light scattering like extinguished stars upon it.
Boom!
Another fierce wind swept over the Divine Soul. This terrifying wind dissipated the Divine Soul and tore it apart, while on his Physical Body, it was as if a giant was wielding the sky, slamming down upon him.
Even as an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, claimed to live as long as the Domain, under such furious attacks, his Physical Body disintegrated, his Divine Soul torn apart, he too would fall!
Having succeeded with their strike, Xu Yan, Meng Chong, and Jiang Buping were all frantically attacking.
Meng Chong targeted his Physical Body, being a practitioner of Physical Body Martial Arts, he naturally understood how to obliterate an opponent's Physical Body.
And Xu Yan and Jiang Buping were assaulting his Divine Soul.
Boom!
The Domain itself seemed to shake for a moment, as if an aura co-extensive with the Domain had collapsed.
An Immortal Realm being had fallen!
The Immortal Realm members of the Wan Family, rushing to the scene, suddenly stopped in their tracks, their faces filled with shock and even fear.
The Nine Mountain Realm had been in chaos up to now, and through all the battles, no Immortal Realm being had fallen.
Yet today, an Immortal Heavenly Venerable had fallen, and at Dahai Mountain no less.
More terrifying was that they had only sensed the aura of one Immortal Heavenly Venerable, and it was precisely the aura of the one who had fallen!
Who killed him?
With no other Immortal Heavenly Venerable present, how did this one die?
Slaughtered by a True King Heavenly Venerable?
What a joke, even if all of the Wan Family's True King Heavenly Venerables joined forces, they wouldn't be enough to kill an Immortal Heavenly Venerable!
"What has happened?"
At that moment, this Immortal Heavenly Venerable from the Wan Family backed off, fearing he too would die if he went.
It was too terrifying!
An Immortal Heavenly Venerable, to have fallen like this!
After a brief hesitation, he turned and returned to the Wan Family's territory. This risk was not worth taking!
Xuezhi Mo, who was hurrying to the battlefield, suddenly halted, his face a picture of shock. The Immortal Heavenly Venerable was dead?
Who had killed him?
Xu Yan and Meng Chong?
Impossible!
No matter how strong Xu Yan and Meng Chong were, they were ultimately not Immortal Heavenly Venerables. If the two of them together could kill an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, they wouldn't have been hunted by him everywhere.
"Who killed him? There was only the aura of one Immortal Heavenly Venerable, which means it wasn't a battle between two Immortal Heavenly Venerables, so it's absolutely impossible for Xu Yan and Meng Chong!"
Xuezhi Mo pondered.
For a moment, he hesitated, wondering whether to go and find out for himself.
"Hmm, is that the Immortal Realm of the Wan Family?"
Suddenly, he noticed the retreating Immortal Heavenly Venerable from the Wan Family, and his heart skipped a beat.
"Could it be that the Wan Family used some mysterious trump card to strike and kill the opponent?"
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Wan Family was returning to their territory, heading from the site of the battle.
After all, the Wan Family was an ancient family of the Nine Mountains' Dahai Mountain, with a long heritage; naturally, they had some depth. If by chance they had come across a special Supreme Treasure, it wouldn't be impossible for them to catch the Immortal Realm being off-guard and slay him!
But why had he only sensed the aura of a single Immortal Heavenly Venerable?
He suddenly thought of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow that seemed to possess items that could block the aura of Immortal Heavenly Venerables. Could the Wan Family also have such treasures?
```
If that's the case, everything makes sense now.
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable from the Wan Family noticed Xuezhi Mo, paused for a moment, and felt a sudden shock in his heart. Could it be a powerful figure from the Netherworld who had ambushed and killed that Immortal Heavenly Venerable?
After a brief hesitation, he didn't attack Xuezhi Mo but instead hastened back to the Wan Family's territory even faster.
Seeing this, Xuezhi Mo felt even more convinced that his suspicions were correct; the elder of the Wan Family must have also paid a hefty price, which was why he dared not make a move against him and was even worried about him retaliating.
"The Wan Family wants to warn the other Immortal Heavenly Venerables that anyone lurking around Dahai Mountain with ill intentions will be mercilessly slain!"
Xuezhi Mo understood in his heart.
He had simply been overthinking earlier; how could Xu Yan and Meng Chong possibly kill an Immortal Heavenly Venerable!
He moved swiftly, continuing towards the fall site of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, but he was extremely cautious along the way, slowing down his pace for fear of being ambushed by the Wan Family.
Meanwhile, at the site of the great battle, an Immortal Heavenly Venerable was reduced to ashes under the combined force of Brother Xu Yan and the two others.
The two distant elders of the Wan Family, as well as the seven Blood Disciples, were now shaken to their core, their liver and guts trembling, their bodies shaking uncontrollably.
An Immortal Heavenly Venerable had fallen!
What's more terrifying was that this Immortal Heavenly Venerable had not perished at the hands of another Immortal Heavenly Venerable but had been killed in a cross-boundary counterattack!
This was something unheard of.
"What kind of monster is this!"
The two Wan Family elders were trembling, thinking Wan Tianlin of the Wan Family, who was already an extraordinary genius, was nothing compared to these three; he was simply trash!
The gap between geniuses was so huge.
"There are seven more Blood Disciples!"
Xu Yan's eyes were cold as he looked over.
"Kill!"
Meng Chong roared, bursting with momentum as he charged forward in an instant.
The seven Blood Disciples, who had already lost their will to fight, turned to flee, but how could they possibly escape!
In just a few moments, they were all exterminated.
"Thank you both for your assistance; otherwise, there would have been no chance to slay this Immortal Heavenly Venerable!"
Xu Yan said with hands clasped together.
"Don't mention it, don't mention it, we hardly helped at all!"
The two Wan Family elders quickly shook their heads with wry smiles on their faces.
After exchanging a few words, the Wan Family elders took their leave.
The incident was too frightening; they must report back to the Immortal Heavenly Venerable of their family as quickly as possible, and the death of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable at Dahai Mountain would certainly shock the Nine Mountain Realm.
The two couldn't remember how many long years it had been since an Immortal Heavenly Venerable had fallen.
They vaguely remembered that the last fall of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable occurred during the great chaos in the Heavenly Grotto when enemies from beyond invaded, and it was in a fierce battle that an Immortal Heavenly Venerable fell defending against the foreign enemies.
Xu Yan and his companions were now exhilarated, as countering an Immortal Heavenly Venerable was an unprecedented feat.
Jiang Buping was no exception; as a person from the Divine Realm and once a genius of a great clan, he knew what this meant even more.
"Now, it's time to kill Xuezhi Mo!"
Xu Yan said with a cold gaze.
"Xuezhi Mo's strength is nearly on par with that Immortal Heavenly Venerable; a direct confrontation might allow him to escape," Meng Chong said with a frown.
"He must be rushing here now, which gives us an opportunity. Both of you juniors should get ready," Xu Yan said with a chuckle, soon coming up with a plan to ambush Xuezhi Mo.
After that, the three of them quickly left to find a suitable location for the ambush not far away, with Meng Chong and Jiang Buping hiding according to plan.
Xu Yan, however, returned to the site of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable's fall, pretending to come over to investigate, and he wouldn't miss the chance once he encountered Xuezhi Mo.
Facing Xuezhi Mo, Xu Yan would surely have to flee, and in doing so, Xuezhi Mo would follow him to the site of the ambush, which couldn't be more perfect.
A simple plan, but would Xuezhi Mo take the bait? It depended on the news of the three countering an Immortal Heavenly Venerable being not yet spread out. Having encountered Xu Yan, why wouldn't Xuezhi Mo chase after him?
"It's right here!"
Xuezhi Mo approached the site of the great battle with extreme caution, and suddenly his expression became tense as he caught sight of a figure also cautiously probing forward.
Xu Yan!
Seeing Xu Yan acting in such a way, he must have detected the great battle here and come to investigate.
An excellent opportunity!
Xuezhi Mo's eyes lit up; this was a rare chance!
All of Xu Yan's attention was on the site of the battle ahead, unaware of his presence; there couldn't be a better time to attack!
```

chapters.title: Chapter 792 - 792: 416
chapters.content:
Blood light dazzled the eyes as an overwhelming aura suddenly enveloped the area, staining the domain in a bloody hue.
Xu Yan, who was cautiously investigating, abruptly changed in expression. The Yin Yang Undying Sword emerged, incessantly swirling as the blade's light surged forth and the Golden Giant Dragon roared.
Boom!
It seemed as though every trick had been used to block this sudden attack.
At the same time, his figure flew backward in an attempt to escape.
Pu!
At that moment, the sword light shattered, and so did the Golden Giant Dragon; all attacks were disintegrating. Xu Yan seemed to suffer a massive blow and, despite accelerating, spat out a mouthful of blood as his body was thrown back.
"Xu Yan, today is the day you die!"
Xuezhi Mo was exceedingly delighted at that moment, his figure streaking through the air as he pursued, with his Scarlet Long Knife bursting forth with fierce murderous intent in another slashing strike!
As for exploring the place of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable's demise, he chose not to pursue it any longer. If there were ambushes, his presence at this moment would have certainly provoked an attack against him.
To slaughter Xu Yan!
This was a once-in-a-millennium opportunity!
"Xuezhi Mo!"
Xu Yan's expression was incredibly somber as he madly swung his sword again and again, his retreating figure looking extremely awkward. He seemed desperately trying to flee and shake off the pursuit of Xuezhi Mo.
"If I cannot kill him this time, there will never be another chance!" Xuezhi Mo thought resolutely.
With his strength, he had only managed to entangle Xu Yan, preventing his escape, but had been unable to deliver a killing blow—what an extraordinary genius.
"What kind of Sword Dao is this? It's too powerful!"
Whether it was for the sake of their collaboration with Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow or for the Netherworld itself, such a peerless genius must die!
Otherwise, once he grew up, he would undoubtedly become a massive threat to the Netherworld!
"You can't escape!"
Xuezhi Mo was completely enveloped in blood light, with his scarlet knife's glow illuminating the sky, the aura of his power stirring the heavens and the earth.
Xu Yan was still retreating frantically, trying to escape. Sword wheels revolved around him, spinning ceaselessly, yet they seemed on the verge of collapsing as he desperately slashed out again and again.
"Where's Meng Chong? Did he flee?"
Xuezhi Mo sneered.
A surge of exhilaration at the prospect of killing an extraordinary genius welled up within him.
"Junior brother, don't worry about me, just run!" shouted Xu Yan.
In the midst of the battle, Xuezhi Mo saw a figure in the distance vanish in an instant—it was Meng Chong!
"After I kill you, Meng Chong won't last many more days either!"
Xuezhi Mo transformed into a streak of blood light, his speed explosively increasing as he moved to strike Xu Yan—his blow rupturing layers of sword light, as if the next moment would result in Xu Yan's demise!
Jiang Buping, hiding in ambush, couldn't help but admire inwardly; their senior brother truly deserved his status. His acting skills were far beyond his own!
Back then, to escape the Taikun Realm, he had feigned being a clueless fool, thinking his acting skills unmatched. Yet today, he realized that while he might be good at playing the fool, when it came to true acting, he was far from matching his senior brother.
"This is what it means to be a true Martial Artist, not just a brute!"
In that moment, he somewhat grasped the profound principles that their fourth senior brother had once mentioned, the teachings of their master—that a Martial Artist is not a brute.
The senior brother truly embodied the essence!
"Second senior brother may seem like a brute, but he too is adept at adapting to situations and deeply calculating," Jiang Buping mused with admiration, suspecting that perhaps only their third senior sister was the one with a simpler mind.
"No wonder third sister never ventured into the Martial Arts Realm. Master was probably worried about her, given her simple-mindedness!"
The figure that had fled earlier was a Divine Origin Avatar of their second senior brother. At such a distance, and amidst the heat of battle, how could Xuezhi Mo discern the truth?
Moreover, aside from being weaker, a Divine Origin Avatar was indistinguishable from the original, naturally leaving no room for suspicion.
Now, Xuezhi Mo's vigilance had waned, and there was no longer a need to fear Meng Chong's sudden attacks, since Meng Chong had already fled.
Boom!
"Xuezhi Mo, if you want to kill me, Xu Yan, you won't get off easily!"
Suddenly, Xu Yan stopped retreating, as if realizing escape was futile, prepared to fight to the death.
Hum!
The Yin Yang Undying Sword instantly grew larger, with the Mountain and River Physiognomy emerging and eighteen Golden Giant Dragons coiling around. In that instant, Xu Yan unleashed all his divine skills.
Xuezhi Mo's expression tightened, and he was secretly shocked at how powerful Xu Yan had become. Invincible below the Immortal Heavenly Venerable?!
"I admit, you're a genius, invincible below the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, but you're still far from injuring me!" Xuezhi Mo scoffed coldly, his blood energy billowing, suggesting an air of immortality that seemed one with the domain itself.
"Today, I will slay you. Taicang should not have a genius like you!"
Xuezhi Mo stepped forward, the blood light raging, and behind him emerged an intimidating trail of blood-colored blade light that stood between heaven and earth, exuding a fierce aura.
Xu Yan's gaze sharpened and he took a deep breath. A faint glow encircled him, and at that moment, he activated his Sacred Body. A vast radiance emerged from within him.
In the misty brilliance, a vision of mountains and rivers unfolded.
Xuezhi Mo was struck with awe. What kind of constitution was this?
His killing intent intensified while he pointed forward, the towering blood-colored blade light behind him slashed through the air towards Xu Yan.
A blood line appeared between the heavens and the earth, like a wound across the sky, slashing down toward Xu Yan from the firmament.
Ao!
Xu Yan struck out palm after palm, the True Dragon's Rage Divine Skill executing eighteen hits in succession. Immediately after, eighteen black sword lights appeared, their aura of annihilation vibrating the domain itself.

chapters.title: Chapter 793 - 416: Slaying Xuezhi, A Name that Shook the Nine Mountain Realm_2
chapters.content:
Layer upon layer of mountains and rivers emerged, within them, the people held swords as they cut down.
The Imperishable Sword Intent merged with the mountains and rivers, blessing them, and even a Golden Giant Dragon roared.
In that instant, Xu Yan unleashed his full power, integrating effects like Mountains and Rivers in the Sword, Supreme Heavenly Sword, True Dragon Rage, Imperishable Sword Intent, along with Martial Arts Physiognomy into his attack.
Such an array of powerful Divine Skills stacked upon each other, clashed fiercely against the strike from Xuezhi Mo in a flash, impacting each other.
Xuezhi Mo was greatly shocked. Xu Yan had actually blocked his strike?
Moreover, what he found inconceivable was that the image of the mountains and rivers, though collapsing, was looming over, and even he was on the fringe of it.
"Hmph!"
Xuezhi Mo snorted coldly, his blood-colored blade light grew even more dazzling. His aura surged as he raised his hand and slashed forward, carving through the mountains and rivers, through the Golden Giant Dragon, continuously advancing towards Xu Yan.
And in that moment, he found himself entwined by Xu Yan's attack.
Although it only entangled him for a brief one or two breaths, it already highlighted the terrifying strength of Xu Yan, who was not an Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
If they were of the same realm, Xuezhi Mo did not dare to imagine that he might be easily slain by his opponent!
The blade light was nearing Xu Yan closer and closer, blood gushing from Xu Yan's mouth, seemingly on the verge of collapse, a cold smile emerged on the corner of Xuezhi Mo's lips.
Boom!
Suddenly, an overbearingly unstoppable aura manifested behind him.
It was as if a terrifying giant, holding up the heavens, came crashing down!
"This is bad!"
Xuezhi Mo's face changed, he let out a low roar, attempting to dodge, to defend, and at that moment, a ray of light shined from Xu Yan's brow.
Already entangled by the force of Xu Yan, at the moment the light shone, Xuezhi Mo felt his strength slow down for an instant.
That brief one or two breaths were sufficient to change the outcome!
In a critical moment, he managed just in time to conjure a layer of blood-colored shield-light, desiring to withstand this strike!
Boom!
The ferociously violent attack collided with his body, his flesh cracking and collapsing, what terrified him was that the strike seemed to pinpoint the weak points of his physical body, all its power aimed at shattering it.
It was as though the one who struck possessed an unbelievable understanding of the physical body.
Spurt!
He couldn't help vomiting a mouthful of fresh blood.
"To kill..."
Xuezhi Mo's expression twisted, looking mad, and at this moment, a glint of cold light surfaced.
A Long Spear emitting a cold gleam came stabbing with an unmatched killing force.
Just as Xuezhi Mo was slightly recovering, preparing to fend off this spear thrust, he was horrified to realize that this spear was not what the eye could see, but what the Divine Soul could perceive!
It was a thrust aimed at the Divine Soul!
Hum!
In Xuezhi Mo's Divine Soul, a layer of blood film appeared, enveloping his Divine Soul—this was the only and inherited Divine Soul Defense Technique prepared for entering the Nine Mountain Realm.
Spurt!
However, the blood film was like paper, pierced by the spear into his Divine Soul, a massive wound appeared, and the place where the spear pierced seemed to be dissolving his Divine Soul.
An unprecedented severe pain surged, the intense agony of the Divine Soul caused his eyes to bulge and emit a piercing scream, all his reactionary means froze in that instant.
Even though, deep in his consciousness, a strong crisis emerged, telling himself that danger, fatal danger, was present and he must respond despite the pain.
But how could he react to such an immediate crisis with pain he had never experienced before?
Whoosh!
A violent wind blew once more across his Divine Soul, tearing at it, and in this moment, another brutal force fell once again, crashing into his already crumbling physical body, whilst his Divine Soul seemed to have lost all support.
Spurt!
In the last moment, Xuezhi Mo saw Meng Chong, looming like a giant, and a young spearsman with an eerily peculiar aura as if it countered the Divine Soul.
He saw the black blade light that Xu Yan cut down with, extinguishing everything!
In this moment, he suddenly understood.
It was Xu Yan and the other two who had slain that Immortal Heavenly Venerable; they had laid an ambush to slay him!
Regret surged in his heart, he had been careless!
But, everything was too late!
Xuezhi Mo was dead!
Turned to dust!
Meng Chong gasped for breath, having launched consecutive strikes, assassinating the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, he was mentally strained and had exerted all his strength. The Heaven Lifting Earth Extinguishing Divine Skill, indeed, had a huge toll on him.
Even Xu Yan was slightly out of breath at this moment.
Xuezhi Mo's blade strike was extremely powerful and dominant; Xu Yan had to go all out not only to block this strike but also to entangle Xuezhi Mo for a brief moment, creating an opportunity for Meng Chong to strike.
Jiang Buping's chest heaved, as he had expended a tremendous amount of his Extreme Soul Martial Arts power. Whether it was the assassination of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable or the slaying of Xuezhi Mo, he had given his all, unleashing the most powerful Divine Skills of Slaughter the Soul he had mastered to date.
It was also after the master's oral instruction and demonstration that he had come to comprehend these.
Divine Skills, Slaying the Divine!
"The Immortal Heavenly Venerable of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow has died, and Xuezhi Mo is also dead. It's time to leave Dahai Mountain,"
Xu Yan said in a heavy voice.
In the Nine Mountain Realm, the fall of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable and a Netherworld Blood Child, both killed by them, the two brothers, would cause turmoil throughout the entire Nine Mountain Realm when the news spread.
It's likely that Tian Shiqi can't sit still any longer and will have to take action personally.
With their current strength, they were definitely no match for Tian Shiqi. If they were to confront each other head-on, it wasn't certain that they could even kill an Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
This time, strongly prevailing over an Immortal Heavenly Venerable had provided a gratifying battle and some enlightenment and gains. It was time to digest these experiences.
"Let's go, to Spiritual Sovereign Mountain!"
Spiritual Sovereign Mountain, which had almost become Red Cat's territory, offered protection from Red Cat, ensuring their traces wouldn't be discovered by anyone.
The three brothers immediately set off for Spiritual Sovereign Mountain.
"Is that, the fall of Xuezhi?"
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable of Dahai Mountain sensed the fall of a being not weaker than the Immortal Realm."
Since it was not an Immortal Heavenly Venerable from the Divine Realm, it must have been Netherworld Blood Child.
How much time has passed since the fall of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, and now another Blood Child has fallen?
Who could have done it?
At this moment, Wan Family's territory was far from calm.
"You're saying, Xu Yan and Meng Chong, along with another person, joined forces and killed the Immortal Heavenly Venerable?"
Looking at the two clan elders, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Wan Family wore a face of disbelief.
"Yes, that Immortal Heavenly Venerable was killed by the three of them!"
In the expressions of the Wan Family elders, the color of shock still lingered, as if they were still in a dream.
"Such demons, truly, and thankfully, my Wan Family has a fairly good relationship with Xu Yan!"
At this moment, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Wan Family felt a tingling sensation on his scalp.
Though it was three of them joining forces, it also showed how monstrous the three individuals were, simply unimaginable.
If they were matched in the same realm, wouldn't they be easily slain?
"The fallen one, could it be Xuezhi Mo?"
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Wan Family thought of the Xuezhi Mo he had encountered on his way back to the family lands, who seemed to be heading towards the place where the Immortal Heavenly Venerable had fallen.
The standoff at Dahai Mountain's Immortal Heavenly Venerable had ended. The fall of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable in the Nine Mountain Realm was an earth-shattering event.
And immediately following that, the news came that the fallen Immortal Heavenly Venerable was from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, who had died in an attempt to assassinate Xu Yan and Meng Chong but was counter-killed instead!
Xu Yan and Meng Chong, prevailing against an Immortal Heavenly Venerable!
As the news spread, the Nine Mountain Realm was shaken, and the names of Xu Yan and Meng Chong resounded throughout!
The Immortal Heavenly Venerables of Thousand Layered Mountain and Horizontal Peak Mountain had both retreated to their territories, their hearts trembling with fear. Xu Yan and Meng Chong were already capable of killing an Immortal Heavenly Venerable?
Too terrifying!
If he were to break through to the Immortal Realm, how fearsome would that be?
On Spiritual Sovereign Mountain, Red Cat, Yu Xiaolong, and Little Ha gathered together.
"Truly worthy of being our Demon Clan Supreme Sovereign!"
Red Cat exclaimed with prideful admiration.
Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha nodded in agreement.
Horizontal Peak Mountain.
"Xu Yan and Meng Chong, they must not be left alive!"
Tian Shiqi stood up in shock.
Behind him stood a man wearing a Seven-leaf Ferocious Mask.
"My lord, Xu Yan and Meng Chong can kill even an Immortal Heavenly Venerable; none of the Heavenly Slaughter are their match. Even if I were to act, there might be danger,"
Too frightening.
If killing an Immortal Heavenly Venerable could be considered a fluke, then the subsequent killing of Xuezhi Mo signified that Xu Yan and Meng Chong's victory was due to their significant strength.
Joining forces, they could even slay an Immortal Heavenly Venerable?
This was truly terrifying!
"Both Thousand Layered Mountain and Horizontal Peak Mountain have grudges against Xu Yan and Meng Chong. Now that Heavenly Grotto is quiet, the Immortal Heavenly Venerables do not need to stand guard there all the time and should be able to move about and take action."
Tian Shiqi said with a chilling gaze.

chapters.title: Chapter 794 - 417 Leaving the Nine Mountain Realm, Wandering Alone in the Wilderness
chapters.content:
"Now that the Heavenly Grotto is tranquil and the Netherworld won't invade in force, my Horizontal Peak Mountain and your Thousand Layered Mountain, harboring grudges against brothers Xu Yan and Meng Chong, must eliminate them before they break through to the Immortal Realm. Otherwise, we both will be in danger in the future!"
Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter from Horizontal Peak Mountain, with the identity of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, came to Thousand Layered Mountain, urging the Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Thousand Layered Mountain to join hands in exterminating Xu Yan and Meng Chong.
"There might be some misunderstandings between Thousand Layered Mountain and Xu Yan; a compensation might smooth things over."
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable of Thousand Layered Mountain hesitated.
Once involved in the assassination of Xu Yan, there would be no turning back.
If the assassination succeeded, the hidden danger would be eliminated, but if Xu Yan managed to escape, the consequences would be unpredictable!
"Foolishness! A proud person like Xu Yan, who is considered a peerless genius, will hardly accept your compensation and apology. Do you, as the mighty Immortal Heavenly Venerable, plan to kneel down and beg for his forgiveness?
"If you can do that, Xu Yan might actually wipe the slate clean!"
Upon hearing this, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable of Thousand Layered Mountain's expression changed, and finally, clenching his teeth, said solemnly, "You make sense. Since we are already at odds, let's go all out and eliminate him!"
A dignified Immortal Heavenly Venerable kneeling for forgiveness?
He could not do such a thing, he could not afford to lose face!
Therefore, there was only one path to take: to join forces with the Immortal Heavenly Venerable of Horizontal Peak Mountain and exterminate Xu Yan and Meng Chong.
"Very well then, wait for my message."
Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter nodded in satisfaction and left for Horizontal Peak Mountain.
"Brother Huang, what are you doing? Apologizing to Xu Yan and Meng Chong? Have you forgotten the dignity of Horizontal Peak Mountain? Remember, you are a dignified Immortal Heavenly Venerable!"
Upon returning to Horizontal Peak Mountain, he immediately found that brother who bore grudges against Xu Yan and Meng Chong.
"Brother Ke from Thousand Layered Mountain has already sent a message, inviting Brother Huang to join forces in eliminating Xu Yan and Meng Chong, to nip the threat in the bud.
"Don't worry, Brother Huang, I will also take part in this. You are a dignified Immortal Heavenly Venerable; would you really suffer humiliation at the hands of the young Xu Yan?
"Xu Yan, who esteems himself a matchless genius, looks down on everyone. How would he possibly value your apology? The only way out is to kill him. A dead genius poses no threat."
Convinced by his junior brother, Brother Huang felt it made sense and expressed his gratitude for the junior brother's assistance.
On that very day, Horizontal Peak Mountain and Thousand Layered Mountain jointly issued a bounty for the capture of Xu Yan and Meng Chong. They even directly entered Dahai Mountain to search for Xu Yan and Meng Chong, confronting the Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Wan Family.
Only after learning that Xu Yan and Meng Chong had left Dahai Mountain did they withdraw from there.
Meanwhile, at Spiritual Sovereign Mountain, Xu Yan and his two companions found a secluded spot, set up a Formation, and began to consolidate their Martial Arts gains.
"Horizontal Peak Mountain and Thousand Layered Mountain have set their hearts against us brothers."
Xu Yan glanced at the message sent by Red Cat and chuckled coldly.
"Sooner or later, I'll take down Horizontal Peak Mountain!"
Meng Chong sneered in response.
"These Immortal Heavenly Venerables, now that they're on guard, the difficulty of assassinating them has greatly increased."
Jiang Buping sighed.
In a direct confrontation, even if the three joined forces, they couldn't kill an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, whether it was killing the Immortal Heavenly Venerable of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow or Xuezhi Mo. It all relied on catching them off guard, when they were underestimating the enemy and being careless.
Now that the news has spread, these Immortal Heavenly Venerables are on alert, and even if injured, they could have the chance to escape.
