"No need to worry about it. The Divine Realm is vast; we don't necessarily have to keep lingering in the Nine Mountain Realm."
Xu Yan said with an indifferent smile.
"Big brother is right."
Jiang Buping nodded.
The three brothers hid in a place in Spiritual Sovereign Mountain and began to consolidate what they had gained from the recent events.
The unrest in the Nine Mountain Realm continued. The Immortal Heavenly Venerables of Horizontal Peak Mountain and Thousand Layered Mountain began to search for Xu Yan and Meng Chong within the Nine Mountains, naturally finding nothing.
Instead, they sparked conflicts with other powers, igniting another battle among the Immortal Heavenly Venerables in the Nine Mountain Realm.
The turmoil within the Nine Mountain Realm meant that the once amicable relations between the major powers were gone, replaced by endless strife.
"Wind Spirit King, we, the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, have proved our strength. What do you think now?"
Tian Shiqi came to Spiritual Sovereign Mountain once again.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, your strength is just so-so. It depends on how much sincerity you can show."
Wind Spirit Tiger replied indifferently.
"Of course, there is sincerity. How about killing two persons for me, Wind Spirit King? Xu Yan and Meng Chong. If you take action personally to kill them, you will get what you desire."
Tian Shiqi said solemnly.
Wind Spirit Tiger's eyes moved as he said, "Give me the item first, otherwise, if I make a move and you give me some trash afterwards, can I still kill you?"
"Wind Spirit King, I, Tian Shiqi..."
"Enough talk. I'm not familiar with you, Tian Shiqi. If you want me to act, bring the goods. Otherwise, forget about it. And provide me with Xu Yan and Meng Chong's whereabouts.
"What, you think I should personally look for them? What kind of status do I, Wind Spirit King, hold..."
Wind Spirit Tiger sat in his chair, speaking arrogantly.
Tian Shiqi frowned, considering whether to continue seeking cooperation with Wind Spirit Tiger. However, with Wind Spirit Tiger's immense strength, being one of the twelve Spirit Beast Kings of the Divine Realm, and particularly of the feline kind, there was no one more suitable.
After a brief contemplation, he nodded and said, "Agreed!"
"Then it's settled. But let's be clear upfront, if you fail to provide the targets' whereabouts and I don't kill them, don't blame me. The item won't be returned."
Wind Spirit Tiger added sternly.
"No problem!"

chapters.title: Chapter 795 - 417 Leaving the Nine Mountain Realm, Wandering the Wilderness Alone_2
chapters.content:
Tian Shiqi nodded, confident in his own abilities. With the intelligence capabilities of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, the moment Xu Yan and Meng Chong showed even the slightest trace, they would be discovered immediately.
Once the traces of the two were found, with the power of the Wind Spirit Tiger, it would be easy to kill them.
"In that case, I will wait for your item to arrive and see if I am satisfied."
The Wind Spirit Tiger nodded in agreement.
Why not accept something that's free?
As for making a move?
The Red Cat junior brother did say, "Try your best" would suffice. After all, as the Wind Spirit King, every time he went out it was quite a grand event, so it would be normal for him to be a bit slow.
As for the escape of the targets, that would be due to the lack of preparation on Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's part, and not an issue for him, the Tiger King of the Wind Spirits.
Tian Shiqi had no idea what the Wind Spirit Tiger was thinking, so he left, contented, preparing for the next schemes and actions, laughing coldly to himself. With Xu Yan and Meng Chong dying at the hands of the Wind Spirit Tiger, a great battle would surely erupt.
How could the Wind Spirit Tiger withstand the revenge?
In the end, he would have no choice but to seek refuge with Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow and be at their beck and call.
...
"Tian Shiqi, I will remember you. Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow still refuses to give up, huh, heh!"
A flash of cold light appeared in Xu Yan's eyes.
Glancing at the message from the Red Cat, he understood the situation.
After these days of settling, Meng Chong made a breakthrough to the minor achievement stage in the Physiognomy Realm, and Xu Yan also saw not a small advancement. Although there was still some distance to the major achievement stage of the Physiognomy Realm, it no longer seemed so far off.
The use of Divine Skills had also improved significantly after battling the Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
"Fifth Junior Brother, what are your plans next?" Xu Yan looked to Jiang Buping and asked.
"I want to advance my strength more quickly, and need the insights gained from battle, as well as the Imperishable Qi for cultivating Extreme Soul Martial Arts; therefore, I plan to go to other realms and train in the Imperishable Heaven Cave," Jiang Buping thought for a moment and said.
He would return to the Taikun Realm one day, but not now. His strength was not yet sufficient to wash away the disgrace!
"What about first senior brother and second senior brother? Continue to wander in the Nine Mountain Realm?"
Xu Yan shook his head, "The Nine Mountain Realm is no longer interesting. The Divine Realm is so immense, why linger in the Nine Mountain Realm? We should travel through the Divine Domain, and comprehend the myriad things of the world."
Meng Chong touched his head and let out a hehe laugh; "I'm planning to make my way to the Da Yan Realm and look for some old acquaintances."
"Fifth Junior Brother, let's meet again in the Taikun Realm. Your eldest brother will come to Taikun Realm to help you avenge your past humiliation," Xu Yan said smilingly.
"Me too, I will surely go to the Taikun Realm. Let's make a pact to reunite in the Taikun Realm!" Meng Chong also nodded, smiling.
"Thank you, both senior brothers. Then, let's reunite in the Taikun Realm!" Jiang Buping expressed his thanks.
The Nine Mountain Realm was merely a short segment on the martial path of the three men. No matter what Tian Shiqi, Thousand Layered Mountain, or Horizontal Peak Mountain had planned, the three were no longer willing to accompany them any further.
The chaos of the Divine Realm was also the time for prodigies to make a name for themselves. In the eyes of the three men, these undying Heavenly Venerables were nothing more than grasshoppers jumping around for a moment.
Jiang Buping left. Instead of using the Realm Gate of the Nine Mountain Realm to head to the next realm, he crossed the wilderness directly into the next realm.
At the Nine Mountain Realm Gate, Xuezhi and the Immortal Heavenly Venerable were still confronting each other, and with powers like Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow actively searching for the trio, the gates were undoubtedly sealed.
For Jiang Buping, crossing the wilderness to the next realm was also a form of martial arts training, only taking more time to cross a realm and enter the next one.
"Second Senior Brother, see you in the Taikun Realm!" Xu Yan said with a smile.
"Greetings from Taikun Realm!"
Meng Chong touched his bald head and said with a smile.
The two brothers, once again parting ways, each set out on their own martial arts journey.
However, this time they both had Communication Talismans to stay in touch, no matter where in the Divine Realm they were, they could communicate and share what they had seen and heard.
In the Thirty-Six Realms of the Divine Realm, the lands connecting the realms are vast wildernesses. Aside from crossing through Realm Gates, one's only option is to traverse the vast wilderness.
Even for an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, crossing the vast wilderness requires a considerable amount of time. For this reason, transit between realms is typically done through Realm Gates, which are convenient and efficient.
The vast wilderness is empty and devoid of life, as if not even a single insect exists. Traveling through such a place can make one uneasy, instilling a sense of boundless loneliness.
There are rumors that a True King Heavenly Venerable, while crossing the wilderness, was driven mad by the desolation and loneliness and became a lunatic.
It took a long time for him to gradually recover.
The desolation of the wilderness, so stark that even the will of a steadfast martial artist can scarcely bear it, means that few dare venture into the wilderness, and almost none cross it.
It has been advised by Supreme Experts that the Principles of heaven and earth in the wilderness are imbued with loneliness and sorrow, which can affect martial artists who pass through. Those without firm resolve may end up mentally disturbed by the solitude.
In the desolate wilderness, a lone figure walked, his gaze stretching out to a horizon devoid of smoke from chimneys, vegetation, or even the sound of an insect's chirp.
"I once read about the wilderness in the archives of the Taikun Jiang Clan in Taikun Realm. It is said to be a forgotten place after a great change in heaven and earth when the Divine Realm was divided into the Thirty-Six Realms. It is also known as the Land of the Forgotten.
"The Principles of heaven and earth in the Land of the Forgotten are lonely and sorrowful. There are also rumors that the existence of the wilderness itself is to commemorate a certain being..."
Jiang Buping walked through the wilderness, communicating with his eldest and second brothers via the Communication Talisman.
"Besides bordering Qinghua state, the Nine Mountain Realm also borders Changyun Realm and Yuanping Realm. If I cross the wilderness from this side, I will reach Yuanping Realm while you and second brother are crossing the wilderness towards Changyun Realm."
The wilderness was lonely, and Jiang Buping walked alone, with a sense of desolation filling the space between heaven and earth.
"When crossing the wilderness, one cannot fly through the air. It's rumored that flying presents unknown dangers, and even an Immortal Heavenly Venerable is prone to accidents, so crossing the wilderness is done on the ground."
Jiang Buping shared the hearsay he had come across regarding the vast wilderness between the realms.
Having once been part of the Taikun Jiang Clan, he had seen many texts, including some concerning the wilderness.
"I read in a travel journal that there are dangers in the wilderness too. Someone entered an ancient tomb in the wilderness and encountered an unidentified skeleton, only to meet with disaster. Their flesh vanished, leaving them a skeletal figure.
"Moreover, they would become delirious and bloodthirsty at intervals, eventually being killed."
As Jiang Buping spoke of the travel journals he had read, he continued to communicate: "When traversing the wilderness, one must not be too curious or be led astray by any treasures seen. Just cross the wilderness directly and do not venture into strange places."
The deepening wilderness evoked an increasing sense of loneliness, as an aura of solitude seemed to permeate the very fabric of heaven and earth.
Although Jiang Buping was walking on the ground, his pace was swift. He did not gaze out at the seemingly boundless wilderness but focused on the Communication Talisman, which allowed him not to succumb to loneliness.
The more one gazed out into the wilderness, the more one was likely to feel lonely and pessimistic.
Apart from exchanging messages with his eldest and second brothers, he naturally communicated with his third senior sister and fourth senior brother who were far away in Qinghua state.
Walking alone in the wilderness, especially when night fell, the silence was profound, with not even a gentle breeze remaining. In such an environment, even martial artists might experience negative emotions.
Jiang Buping looked up at the dark wilderness and took out a moonstone whose faint silver light illuminated a small area around him.
He sat down cross-legged, "The wilderness at night has a certain chance of causing one to lose their way, so it's better to cultivate at night and continue on the journey when daylight breaks."
In the dark wilderness, only the faint light from Jiang Buping's location was visible, seeming utterly minuscule in the vast darkness.
After setting up a warning formation, Jiang Buping began to cultivate, waiting for dawn to resume his journey.
How long had passed was uncertain when suddenly a howling wind began to blow in the distance, shattering the dark silence of the wilderness.
Jiang Buping abruptly awoke, immediately put away the moonstone, and concealed his presence, blending into the dark. After a brief hesitation, he waved his hand to collect the formation and quietly moved to another spot.
Whoosh!
The sound of the howling wind rose again, getting closer, yet no wind could be felt brushing against him.
"There's a wind sound in the wilderness, and I saw a green flame leaping about, resembling a human face."
The message came through the Communication Talisman from his eldest brother.

chapters.title: Chapter 796 - 418: A Sight in the Wilderness, Majestic as a Saint
chapters.content:
Jiang Buping's heart jolted with surprise. Despite the great distance between him and his eldest senior brother, the sound of the wind could be heard, and even more stunningly, a green flame was sighted?
"Eldest senior brother, be careful and don't approach the flame."
Jiang Buping urgently warned.
"I had no intention of approaching it, but the strange fire is moving towards me. Let's stop chatting for now; I want to see what's peculiar about this flame."
Reading the message from his eldest senior brother, Jiang Buping couldn't help but feel astonished; he had never come across such a scenario in any text before.
"The sound of the wind is getting louder, and to think that two large eyes have appeared in the darkness, it's truly unconventional."
At this moment, the second senior brother also sent a message.
Jiang Buping was startled. Could it be that the entire wilderness was filled with the sound of wind and these unusual phenomena?
"The big eyes are coming this way. I'll see what's going on."
As he read the message from his second senior brother, Jiang Buping involuntarily tensed up, hastily remaining vigilant of his surroundings.
Both his eldest and second senior brothers had encountered unusual beings. Why hadn't he encountered anything?
In the dark and desolate wilderness, where the sound of the wind howled but no breath of air could be felt, Jiang Buping suddenly noticed a mass of white mist-like substance materializing in the darkness and drifting towards him.
"What is that..."
Jiang Buping's expression hardened as he sensed a chilling and sinister presence emanating from the white mist, a sense of malevolence that he had never encountered before.
"Remnant Soul!"
Practicing Extreme Soul Martial Arts, Jiang Buping was particularly sensitive to matters of the Divine Soul and hence he realized immediately that the white mist was, in fact, some unknown remnant soul.
The remnant soul fluttered, covering a wide area, filled with a dense and eerie atmosphere that made one feel a sense of grim evil at a glance.
"What has happened to the wilderness?"
Jiang Buping frowned deeply.
He didn't dodge, waiting quietly for the remnant soul to drift over. As an Extreme Soul Warrior, how could he be threatened by a mere remnant soul?
"If it harbors ill intentions, then I shall refine it."
Jiang Buping thought coldly to himself.
Whoosh!
The remnant soul drifted over him, enveloping him, and suddenly, it ceased its fluttering and began to converge towards his location.
Enshrouded by the remnant soul, the chilling and malevolent intention was particularly palpable. Ordinary True King Heavenly Venerables, if they encountered it, would likely feel terrified and, without a means to break free, might even go insane.
At this moment, Jiang Buping somewhat understood that the True King Heavenly Venerables who went mad traversing the wilderness probably encountered something similar to this mist of remnant souls.
"This is unusual. Below the level of True King Heavenly Venerable martial artists, one cannot shatter this mist of remnant souls, and might even get lost within it. How powerful must the individual who left behind such remnant souls have been while alive?"
Jiang Buping was shocked, recalling some rumors about the wilderness.
"However, encountering me is your misfortune. Refining the power of these remnant souls will also enhance my Extreme Soul Martial Arts."
Since the mist of remnant souls bore malice, Jiang Buping didn't hesitate to act.
Boom!
He raised his palm and within it, a black vortex seemed to emerge.
Extreme Soul Martial Arts Divine Skill, Swallowing Abyss!
Boom!
With a single palm strike, a dark abyss appeared amidst the mist of remnant souls, swallowing them up.
Faintly, Jiang Buping thought he could hear unsettling and strange noises from within the mist, including sinister laughter.
"Ha, you think you can affect my Divine Soul's will? Too naive," Jiang Buping shook his head.
After attempting to contact his eldest and second senior brothers without getting a response, he knitted his brows, yet he wasn't overly worried. Both brothers had extraordinary martial arts abilities; such unusual entities might threaten True King Heavenly Venerables or even Immortal Heavenly Venerables, but for his brothers, these were manageable threats.
As the mist of remnant souls dissipated, the wilderness returned to its silent solitude.
Jiang Buping set up a Formation and entered into cultivation, refining the power of the remnant soul mist.
…
The green flame flickered as if it were a twisting face, and a creepy atmosphere pervaded the surroundings.
The flame grew larger, spreading wider, eventually wrapping a swath of darkness like a vast sheet of silk.
Xu Yan was enveloped by the green flame, his Yin Yang Undying Sword continuously flowing, and his Imperishable Sword Intent surrounding him, with a faint aura of dragon might also emerging.
The green flame appeared abruptly and swiftly encompassed him.
At times, the flame looked like the amiable and steady face of a man, and at others, it resembled the sinister visage of someone wicked.
It was as if two people were entangled and struggling against one another.
"What is this?" Xu Yan frowned deeply, unable to detect any danger within the green flame.
Nonetheless, he dared not be careless, seeing as the green flame was exceedingly strange.
Hum!
A trace of Imperishable Sword Intent rippled out, stirring within the green flame; suddenly, an upheaval occurred.
The dancing green flame exploded in ferocity, and sounds of thunderous roars, clashing weapons, raging fury, and deep, sinister laughter could be heard.
Boom!
The green flame transformed, and in a daze, the scenery around him changed, no longer the pitch-dark wilderness.
Xu Yan's heart tensed as he remained alert to his surroundings, a Golden Dragon flickering within him while the Imperishable Sword Intent formed a gentle breeze encircling him.
"What is this?"
All of a sudden, Xu Yan revealed a look of shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 797 - 418: A Sight in the Wilderness, Majestic as a Saint_2
chapters.content:
As if he was in a hazy, boundless expanse, shrouded and dim, it seemed as though Imperishable Qi floated around, endless and boundless. Amongst this Imperishable Qi, a violent Spiritual Energy was mixed in.
Xu Yan saw this Spiritual Energy and felt as if he had returned to the Border Wilderness Wasteland, where the energy was violent due to the absence of Domain Lingji.
Here too, the Spiritual Energy was violent, but it was hundreds of times more intense than that of the Border Wilderness.
If the Spiritual Energy within the Domain Lingji was like gentle water, and the Spiritual Energy of the Border Wilderness like boiling water, then the violent Spiritual Energy amidst the Imperishable Qi in this murky haze was like raging molten iron!
"What place is this?"
Xu Yan understood somewhat; the green flames had come into contact with the Imperishable Sword Intent and sensed the contained Imperishable Qi, which was why such a change had occurred.
"Kill!"
A roar, ancient as if from ages past, echoed, and within the haze, dozens of incredibly powerful figures attacked a point in the murk.
A great battle erupted, a fierce battle that left Xu Yan incredibly shocked.
Even the battles of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable paled before this, as fights between mere ants!
Suddenly, a faint light appeared in the haziness, and a vague figure could be seen.
"What kind of Supreme Expert is this?"
This moment, he felt as if he was facing his master; this person gave off an inscrutable presence much like his master's did.
No!
This was somewhat different from the unfathomableness of his master. His master was mysterious and inscrutable yet seemed ordinary and commonplace, closer to the Dao.
But this person elicited a kind of worship from Martial Artists, inspired reverence in their hearts, appearing as a towering saint.
"Holy?"
Suddenly, a spark of inspiration crossed Xu Yan's mind. Holy Sword Realm, the great saints of the sword, revered and followed by all, none dared to oppose their swords.
He had always been puzzled about what the Holy Sword Realm truly was.
How could one cultivate the Holy Sword Realm!
At this moment, seeing this figure, he had some epiphany, some understanding of the stature of the holy, some idea of what it meant to have 'no sword unworshipped'!
"Holy Sword Realm!"
Xu Yan muttered to himself, a spark of insight flashing through his mind, vaguely nearing the understanding of how to cultivate the Holy Sword Realm.
It was as if only a thin barrier stood in his way, and if pierced, he would understand how to cultivate the Holy Sword Realm.
"What Realm does this powerful figure belong to?"
Xu Yan felt a profound shock. This majestic figure seen only from behind was so powerful, indeed worthy of a Martial Artist's worship.
"I am not a Taicang Martial Artist; if a Taicang Martial Artist saw this, wouldn't they lose all will to fight instantly?"
Xu Yan thought, shocked in his heart.
"I have made minor achievements in the Wisdom Sword Realm, so this figure's influence on me is limited, and it should also be limited for the Great Wilderness Warriors."
Within the murkiness, that figure stepped forward, waved a hand, shattered the murkiness, light diffused, and he moved to attack deeper within the haze.
All of a sudden, Xu Yan heard an angry roar.
"Nether Shaman!"
The scene changed before him, and what appeared was... a Domain, floating in the haze, emitting a diffuse light!
"Is this the Domain?"
In this instant, Xu Yan was shocked once more.
The scene zoomed in swiftly, the one yelling in anger looming over this Domain.
As it drew closer, the contours of the Domain became more distinct and its vastness more apparent.
The concept of Domain Martial Arts Law surfaced in Xu Yan's mind with a thundering boom.
Body as the Domain!
His own Sword Dao surfaced as well, Mountain and River Myriad Manifestations along with the Divine Skills, Mountains and Rivers in the Sword.
Epiphanies surged to his consciousness.
It felt as though, in the next moment, he would grasp the Domain Martial Arts Law.
Boom!
The battle erupted, the Domain shuddered, the fight was ferocious.
Green light waned, withering the Domain, corroding life, while another powerful force relentlessly shattered this green light.
Suddenly, with a roaring blast, a burst of light exploded, and the fight subsided gradually.
"Perished together?"
Xu Yan murmured to himself.
Now he understood that the green flames, the transforming human faces, were merely the result of two Supreme Experts who had perished together, their wills entwined and interlocked.
What he had witnessed were fragments of what these two powerful figures had seen in their own time.
"Definitely not something the Immortal Heavenly Venerable could compare to."
Xu Yan sighed internally.
Just the aftermath of these two perished experts was so powerful that the Immortal Heavenly Venerable seemed like an ant in their presence.
And that towering figure, so terrifyingly powerful.
Clearly, even such an expert would have adversaries.
"I am still too weak, the powerful in this world are beyond imagination."
Xu Yan couldn't help but marvel to himself.
However, he soon became invigorated at the thought that one day he too would become that powerful.
The murkiness disappeared, the scene vanished, and what remained was the flickering green flames.
In Xu Yan's mind, the vistas he had just witnessed surfaced, granting him enlightenment, just one step away from fully grasping the Domain Realm.
And his cultivation of the Holy Sword Realm also gained some enlightenment.
"The Seven Wonders Divine Flower should be able to help me attain complete understanding."
Xu Yan thought excitedly.
"Since I've encountered it, I can't let this opportunity pass, let it become part of my Mountain and River Myriad Manifestations."
Looking at the green flames, which were the intertwined remnants of two Supreme Experts' wills.
In an instant, Xu Yan's Mountain and River Myriad Manifestations appeared and enveloped the green flames.
He intended to refine the green flames and assimilate the scenes within them into his Mountain and River Myriad Manifestations, to become part of the grand battle scene within it.

chapters.title: Chapter 798 - 418: A Sight in the Wilderness, Majestic as a Saint_3
chapters.content:
"One of them is called Nether Shaman, and what is the other one called?"
Xu Yan remembered the name of one of the Supreme Experts and turned back to ask his master.
Mountain and River Myriad Manifestations, a gentle breeze was gently blowing the green flames, where the Imperishable Sword Intent surged, reconstructing the scenes once again.
As the darkness began to fade, the sky lightened slightly, and the green flames vanished.
Xu Yan showed a smile as in a single thought, a grand battle unfolded within the Mountain and River Myriad Manifestations.
Life thrived within it, the battle transforming into a terrifying force that slaughtered its way forward.
"Mountain and River Myriad Manifestations has grown stronger, especially this scene of the grand battle, which would even awe the Immortal Heavenly Venerable."
Xu Yan was thrilled, his strength had grown once again.
The wilderness was now fully illuminated, quiet and silent, with the loneliness of the Domain scattered across the expanse.
Xu Yan took out a Communication Talisman and replied to Jiang Buping before sending a message to his master, asking about the Supreme Expert called Nether Shaman.
"Heading over to Changyun Realm? Once there, find a place for secluded cultivation and consume the Seven Wonders Divine Flower."
Xu Yan continued on his journey.
In another part of the wilderness, Meng Chong opened his eyes, showing delight.
With just a thought, two stars emerged within his acupoints, within which seemed to be an image of the Nether Abyss, capable of drowning enemies' flesh and blood.
These were the two giant eyes he encountered, which, upon using the power of the Indestructible Stellar, he subdued and refined into his acupoints.
And the strength contained within those giant eyes had transformed into two stars whose power was like that of a deep, ghostly abyss, capable of drowning one's flesh.
"These two physical stars, once deployed, there are very few Martial Artists within the same realm who will not be affected.
Martial Artists with strength inferior to mine will find their physical bodies drowned and actions hindered under their shine, suffering from fatigue and a significant drop in combat ability."
Meng Chong was more than happy, considering this an unexpected windfall and a stroke of fortune.
"Nether Shaman? What kind of powerful being is this? Even the residual power from the destruction of the eyes has such use."
Meng Chong grew curious and took out a Communication Talisman to inquire with his master.
During the refining of the two giant eyes, he had glimpsed fragments of images that assured him of the terrifying strength of this Supreme Expert named Nether Shaman.
"On my way to Changyun Realm, might as well pass through it, traveling along the way until reaching Da Yan Realm..."
Meng Chong continued his journey.
Changyun Realm was just a pass-through for him; he had no intention of entering the Heavenly Grotto in Changyun Realm for training.
Qinghua state.
Li Xuan sighed; his disciple was fierce, having reversed-slaughtered the Immortal Heavenly Venerable and shaken the Martial Artists of the Nine Mountain Realm, right?
"Your disciple, reversed-slaughtered the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, and you've obtained Contra-slaughter!"
Contra-slaughter enabled one to definitely kill enemies whose strength did not exceed one's own by threefold in adverse situations.
"I've grown stronger, my confidence firmer!"
Li Xuan was overjoyed.
With the Communication Talisman that could communicate over any distance, Xu Yan and the other two's messages could be easily monitored. The communication between the disciples every few days was fully under Li Xuan's control.
"Crossing the wilderness?"
"This wilderness, to actually have such special occurrences, could there be danger? None of the Jade Talismans I provided were triggered; it seems there's no significant risk."
And then, Xu Yan sent a message looking for him.
"Hiss, are all those Martial Artists who have transcended the Domain? What kind of great battle broke out back then, it must be related to the calamity that befell the Taicang Domain, that towering figure, so terrifyingly powerful."
Reading the message sent by Xu Yan, which described what he saw and heard, Li Xuan felt a sense of awe.
"Nether Shaman? As a master, I don't bother to remember the names of insignificant creatures!"
Li Xuan said indifferently.

chapters.title: Chapter 799 - 799: 419
chapters.content:
Li Xuan naturally did not know what kind of existence the Nether Shaman was. After all, no matter the strength, he was already dead, so what if he called him an ant?
"A master wouldn't remember the names of ants. The few who can make a master remember their names are hardly worth mentioning," he said with a profound tone.
Li Xuan spoke earnestly.
He had to let his disciple know not to ask him if he recognized every strong person he came across.
In a master's eyes, they were all ants, and ants were not worthy of remembering!
"Who is that towering figure? My disciple, if he were alive, you would naturally know when your strength reaches that point. If he is already dead, knowing is useless to you.
"Focus on cultivating, strive to comprehend the Martial Arts Techniques of the Domain Realm as soon as possible, and then a master will impart to you new martial arts techniques.
"Just treat him as a short-term goal to surpass him as soon as possible."
Li Xuan continued to send messages with profound meaning.
"The disciple understands, and the master is relieved!"
Li Xuan nodded in satisfaction and encouraged his disciple.
"The Nether Shaman? A master never remembers the names of ants. If there's something you don't understand, ask your senior brother," he said, referring to Xu Yan.
Seeing that Meng Chong's message was also asking about the Nether Shaman, Li Xuan's mouth twitched, and he directed him to Xu Yan.
At this moment, Li Xuan couldn't help but think of someone.
The Seductive Witch!
Muttering to himself, "The Seductive Witch, could she be a strong being of the same caliber as this Nether Shaman? If that's the case, I can't beat her true form now."
Looking up at the firmament, the Seductive Witch, no matter how strong, temporarily could not come to seek revenge on him and posed no threat.
"Xu Yan is confident he will soon comprehend the Martial Arts Techniques of the Domain Realm, and I am about to break through to the Domain Realm as well, which will be a huge leap in strength, and liberation from the domain is not far off.
"Who is that figure, and with whom did he battle?
"Perhaps, only that one in the Wu Country Stone House knows something about the upheavals in the Taicang Domain.
"Once I break through to the Domain Realm and have the Book of Taicang firmly in mind, I will go and meet him and probe these hidden secrets of the domain," Li Xuan planned internally.
Understanding these realms of the supreme experts was more conducive to him inventing new martial arts techniques in the future.
"The principles of the Book of Taicang are almost completely memorized," Li Xuan exclaimed with excitement.
Once he memorized the Book of Taicang completely, he had an intuition that he could use it to control the Taicang Domain Dao Principles. Even if he could not completely control the entire Taicang Domain, he would still be able to control a part of the power of the Taicang Domain Dao Principles.
"Once I break through to the Domain Realm and have insight into the Domain Origin, even though I am not the Master of the Taicang Domain, I should be able to defend myself within the Taicang Domain against supreme experts, unless their strength is comparable to the owner of the Book of Taicang," Li Xuan suddenly felt an increase in confidence.
...
Traversing the wilderness alone, the domain silent and desolate, after walking in solitude for half a month, he finally crossed the wilderness into the Changyun Realm.
After exchanging messages with Meng Chong and Jiang Buping, Xu Yan began seeking a place to seclude himself for cultivation.
"The Changyun Realm has not yet been disturbed, and Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow probably does not know that I have left the Nine Mountain Realm. This is a good time to seclude myself to consume the Seven Wonders Divine Flower," Xu Yan thought excitedly.
"I want to surpass that figure as soon as possible!"
His master was right to set a short-term goal, to surpass that formidable individual!
"The master said it was a short-term goal, which means that in the eyes of the master, his strength is not so strong?" Xu Yan speculated.
"Indeed, it's the master who is truly an eminent being, truly invincible. The master is so recluse, probably because of loneliness due to his invincibility."
Thinking back to when he first met his master in the small village, Xu Yan now realized more than ever that his master's seclusion in the fringe village was clearly because he had been invincible for too long, with no contenders left in the world, a lack of interest, and due to loneliness.
"When will I be able to experience my master's state of loneliness from invincibility?
"Unless I surpass my master, I will never be able to experience it.
"If the master secluded himself in the small village because of his invincibility and loneliness, does it also mean that he has reached the endpoint of martial arts?
"The end of martial arts, is the master supreme?"
Xu Yan pondered with a multitude of thoughts in his heart.
"No, that's not right. The master has repeatedly said that martial arts have no end, so the master is actually still walking the path of martial arts, constantly forging a new way.
"It's because there is no one else on the path of martial arts that he walks, no one to match him.
"Everyone else has long been left behind. Walking alone, hence he feels loneliness, that's why he chose to reside in the small village!" Xu Yan came to an enlightenment, the strength of his master was unimaginable.
"This will be the place."
Near the wilderness of Changyun Realm, where mountains are lush, clouds stretch across, and human traces are rare, an ancient tree-filled valley with dense vegetation hides a cave.
Xu Yan looked around and found it perfectly suitable for seclusion to consume the Seven Wonders Divine Flower.
He immediately set up a Concealing Formation and the Mountain and River Myriad Manifestations appeared, merging into the valley.
The valley was still the same valley, but it had been transformed by the Mountain and River Myriad Manifestations.
After tidying up the cave, Xu Yan began his seclusion.
The Nine Mountains Realm.
Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow began searching for the traces of Xu Yan and Meng Chong, while the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of Horizontal Peak Mountain and Thousand Layered Mountain personally took action, searching throughout the Nine Mountains Realm.
Dahai Mountain also became one of their targets since Xu Yan and Wan Tianlin had some relations, linking him with the Wan Family.
However, the strength of the Wan Family was ultimately formidable, with top-tier Immortal Heavenly Venerables in place, so they had nothing to fear.
Time flew by swiftly.

chapters.title: Chapter 800 - 419 Enlightenment of the Domain Realm_2
chapters.content:
Xu Yan and Meng Chong, just like before, suddenly disappeared without a trace, and no matter how they were searched for, their whereabouts could not be discerned.
"Do these two have some Supreme Treasure to conceal themselves?"
Tian Shiqi frowned.
All the treasures had been sent to the Wind Spirit Tiger, and since the people had not been found, it naturally had no idea how to begin. If so, wouldn't it mean that the treasures were gratuitously given to the Wind Spirit Tiger?
Spiritual Sovereign Mountain, Tian Shiqi came once again.
"What, have you found them?"
The Wind Spirit Tiger sat on its throne, looking down at Tian Shiqi from above, which made Tian Shiqi's complexion darken; this Spirit Tiger seemed to be taking more and more pleasure in putting on airs.
"Wind Spirit King, let's change the request. Don't kill Xu Yan and Meng Chong, help me with another matter."
"Also... what do you think I, the Wind Spirit King, am? To change as you wish? If you want to change the deal, that's fine, but bring another portion of treasures, or forget it!"
As soon as the Wind Spirit Tiger spoke, what was intended to be an agreement was altered on the spot.
Tian Shiqi swept a glance at the Splendid Tiger next to the Wind Spirit Tiger; it seemed that the changes in the Wind Spirit Tiger were brought by this very tiger.
It included, too, the transformations of Spiritual Sovereign Mountain, which were also related to it.
"Wind Spirit King, twice as much is a bit too much."
Tian Shiqi shook his head and said.
"Not too much, it must be twice!"
The Wind Spirit Tiger was firm in its stance.
The younger brother is right, why exert oneself when benefits can be obtained for free?
One must prepare additional treasures to be offered in order to ask for more effort, only then will the dignity of the Wind Spirit King not be compromised!
Tian Shiqi pondered for a while and then spoke, "How about this, I can offer up twice the treasures, but the task I need your help with is not within the Nine Mountain Realm, you'll need to leave the Nine Mountain Realm..."
Before he could finish speaking, the Wind Spirit Tiger interrupted, "Leave the Nine Mountain Realm? With such a long journey, so far away, twice the amount is not enough!"
Damn!
Tian Shiqi's face darkened.
He looked at the Red Cat, contemplated for a moment, and sent a telepathic message: "I'll give you a portion of treasures, persuade the Wind Spirit King, how about that?"
The Red Cat replied discreetly; "Big brother Wind Spirit is the king of Spiritual Sovereign Mountain, how could he leave so easily? It's not possible!"
The attitude was extremely firm.
"This way, if you convince the Wind Spirit King, I'll give you a portion of treasures to help your bloodline advance, and become an Immortal Realm Spirit Beast, how about that!"
Tian Shiqi seemed to have made up his mind, willing to pay a high price to enlist the aid of the Wind Spirit King.
"Plus, rest assured, the Wind Spirit King won't be leaving the Nine Mountain Realm right away; you have enough time to ascend to immortality. Thus, even if the Wind Spirit King departs, with you in charge, Spiritual Sovereign Mountain's Spirit Beasts won't be without a Spirit Beast King to rule them!"
Upon hearing this, the Red Cat couldn't help but ponder, Tian Shiqi insisting on partnering with the Wind Spirit Tiger must have some unsaid reasons, even something that could threaten the Wind Spirit Tiger.
However, since it's not an immediate departure, naturally, there's still an opportunity.
Moreover, the treasures that would assist it in ascending to the Immortal Realm were definitely extraordinary; although it was not a Spirit Beast and cultivated using the Great Demon Method, such treasures would surely bring it a substantial enhancement.
"With the Wind Spirit Tiger gone, the time will come for me to establish the Demon Clan. I, Red Cat the Great Demon King, should make my appearance too. The scheme of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow is certainly ambitious and might even endanger the life of the Wind Spirit Tiger.
"However, no matter how you look at it, the Wind Spirit Tiger is a powerhouse of my Tiger Tribe, and now I call it big brother. If I save its life, it should, in turn, call me the king later, becoming a great general under the rule of the Great Demon King—that would be only natural."
Thinking in this way, Red Cat replied: "That's my big brother; how can I send it to danger? The price must be increased!"
The expression under Tian Shiqi's mask grew even darker. This Splendid Tiger truly knew no bounds in its greed, but a greedy tiger was easier to use.
If the Wind Spirit Tiger were to fail, there would still be this tiger to make use of.
"Agreed!"
Tian Shiqi nodded.
"Then give my big brother three portions of treasures and give me two; I fear one portion might not be enough for the breakthrough!"
The Red Cat stated this as if it were a matter of course.
Since Tian Shiqi insisted on the cooperation of the Wind Spirit Tiger, it naturally had to extract a hefty sum.
"Then so be it," Tian Shiqi agreed.
He then spoke again, "Wind Spirit King, three portions of treasures, and not a bit more."
"Good, it's a deal!"
The Wind Spirit Tiger readily agreed, quite decisively.
Tian Shiqi became increasingly convinced that the Splendid Tiger was the true decision-maker.
"When the time is right, I will deliver the treasures."
Tian Shiqi turned and left.
...
Xu Yan swallowed the Seven Wonders Divine Flower in one gulp, his entire being emanated a seven-colored aura, and he was immersed in an epiphany. The path of Martial Arts that he had traversed all this time unfolded before him.
Greater enlightenment began to dawn within.
Upon the untainted foundation of martial arts shimmered a radiant glow. Atop the Spirit Pedestal, the Primordial Spirit opened its eyes, as if beholding one scene after another.
In the hazy chaos, a realm appeared.
And within it, a towering figure that could command the reverence of any martial artist.
Submerged in these insights, Xu Yan's body was haloed in seven-colored radiance, slowly refining the Seven Wonders Divine Flower.
"My path in martial arts."
"In the Holy Sword Realm, all swords bow, none defy... I see now. I've finally grasped how to cultivate the Holy Sword Realm. The gates to the Holy Sword Realm have opened."
Xu Yan had a moment of clarity, comprehending the profound mysteries of the Holy Sword Realm; he understood completely how to cultivate it.
The path was long and arduous but he had at last found his direction.
At this moment, Xu Yan's Wisdom Sword Realm reached completion.
His aura grew stronger as well, only one step away from the grand completion of the Physiognomy Realm.
The Sacred Body of the Mountains and Rivers, too, was suffused with glowing light, its aura steadily rising.
Time passed unknowingly.
Finally, he took that step, and his aura surged dramatically.
Physiognomy Realm grand completion!
One step closer to the Void-breaking Realm.
"To embody the realm between heaven and earth, to use the physiognomy as the form of that realm, to harness the principles of one's martial arts as the laws governing that realm..."
Xu Yan was immersed in the comprehension of the Domain Martial Arts Law.
He was just one step shy from fully understanding the Domain Realm.
Now, under the influence of the Seven Wonders Divine Flower, he organized his martial arts path, from the Qi-Blood Realm all the way to the understood Void-breaking Realm, integrating every stage to present a clear path of martial arts.
The Domain Realm, too, was beginning to emerge on this martial path.
"So this is how it is. I understand now!"
After an indeterminate amount of time, Xu Yan suddenly had an epiphany. The path of martial arts expanded instantly and continued to extend, as if entering a new realm.
This was a significant leap forward on the path of martial arts.
The Domain Martial Arts Law was realized in this moment.
The seven-colored radiance enveloping him was also fading away.
Xu Yan exhaled deeply and opened his eyes, "Seductive Witch, truly a kind soul, this Seven Wonders Divine Flower is indeed an extraordinary treasure. I wonder if she has any more precious items."
At this moment, Xu Yan wanted to meet the Seductive Witch again, to inquire whether she possessed anything even more miraculous than the Seven Wonders Divine Flower.
If so, he wouldn't mind being "schemed against" by her.
"The Domain Realm, I have comprehended it."
Xu Yan was thrilled.
"I'll strive to break through to the Void-breaking Realm as soon as possible."
Now that he had achieved grand completion in the Physiognomy Realm, the Void-breaking Realm wasn't too far off. However, before the breakthrough, he needed to build up a foundation that could transform during the breakthrough.
"The Void-breaking Realm should be the final transformation, right? The Domain Realm likely cannot be transformed further, as that is no longer a realm of physical transformation."
Xu Yan had another epiphany.
The transformation upon breaking through to the Void-breaking Realm would be the last physical transformation.
The Domain Realm had surpassed the level of physical transformation.
Even if transformation were possible, it would not be physical anymore, and perhaps could no longer be achieved by simply accumulating foundations.
"Within ten years to break the void!"
Xu Yan set himself a minor goal, to break through to the Void-breaking Realm within ten years.
"If the Seductive Witch assists me, perhaps it won't even take ten years!"
Xu Yan muttered to himself.
"It seems there's a Witch Heavenly Grotto in the Changyun Realm; I wonder if there's a way to make the Seductive Witch seek me out."
Xu Yan pondered.
With her strength, the Seductive Witch must be tremendously powerful. The more powerful the individual, the more wondrous items they possess—definitely possessing items surpassing the Seven Wonders Divine Flower.
"Changyun Realm, here I come!"
Xu Yan left the cave, waved his hand to retrieve the Array Plate, and soared into the sky, heading towards a grand city within the Changyun Realm to gather information, particularly about the location of the Heavenly Grottos.
"With my current strength, even ordinary Immortal Heavenly Venerables could not trouble me."
Xu Yan's confidence surged, trusting in the Yin Yang Undying Sword that even facing a top-tier Immortal Heavenly Venerable like Emperor Da Yue, he could resist and easily escape.
One day later, a grand city rose into sight. Xu Yan entered the city, beginning to learn about the Heavenly Grottos within the Changyun Realm, looking for any chance to attract the Seductive Witch.

chapters.title: Chapter 801 - 420 Wanbao Alliance's Yan Shanhe, The Blamed Meng Chong
chapters.content:
The Changyun Realm, Baimu City, is one of the major cities in the Changyun Realm, and the headquarters of the Wanbao Alliance is located in Baimu City.
The Wanbao Alliance is the number one merchant guild in the Divine Realm, with power spanning thirty Realms, and the Changyun Realm is one of those Realms under the reach of the Wanbao Alliance's influence.
In the entire Divine Realm, whether buying or selling treasures, the first choice is always the Wanbao Alliance, and behind the Wanbao Alliance stands a union of many powerful forces, with profound heritage and unparalleled strength.
Yan Shanhe is the Alliance Hierarch of the Changyun Realm's Wanbao Alliance, a powerful figure among the very top ranks of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, but at this moment, the perennially amiable and wealth-attracting smile on his round face had vanished, replaced by a grim visage with a chilling killing intent.
"I, Yan Shanhe, have always been amiable and believed in making money through friendliness. I never offend anyone, and even if the younger generation makes mistakes, I am the first to apologize in person, never abusing my own strength to bully others.
"As the Alliance Hierarch of the Changyun Realm's Wanbao Alliance, I advocate for making money through friendliness, providing quality martial arts resources for those fighting in the Heavenly Grotto, and purchasing at high prices the resources from Martial Artists returning from the Heavenly Grotto.
"I, Yan Shanhe, only have one biological son and one true Disciple. Now that my true Disciple has been killed, could it be that I, Yan Shanhe, have always been so kind to others that they think Yan Shanhe is easy to bully?"
In the main hall, all the strong members of the Wanbao Alliance held their breath and didn't dare to even pant.
A young corpse lay quietly on the ground, his chest sliced open by a blade, nearly cut in two.
"I, Yan Shanhe, consider myself to have taught my followers well, one does not use one's position to bully others, two does not bully the weak, three bravely fight in the Heavenly Grotto to guard the Domain of our Divine Realm, and to prevent it from outside invaders.
"What sort of savage culprit would cruelly kill my Disciple, who was such a good-natured person?"
In the main hall, everyone remained silent, heads bowed.
Those familiar with Yan Shanhe called him Smiling Tiger, backstabbing scorpion behind the scenes. Friendly and wealth-attracting on the surface, yet venomously ruthless behind closed doors.
However, he never acted personally; his followers carried out the dirty work and if it ever came to light, he would decisively sacrifice the pawn, adopting a fair and just attitude, killing his followers to give the victims justice.
It was precisely because of this that Yan Shanhe had an excellent reputation outside, many Martial Artists praised him as someone who upheld the reputation of the Wanbao Alliance, impartial and fair, never protecting those who breached the Wanbao Alliance's honor!
And the powers that were attached to the Wanbao Alliance, those strong individuals naturally knew of Yan Shanhe's venom but dared not speak of it; instead, they went to great lengths to praise and extol Yan Shanhe's integrity and selflessness.
His true Disciple naturally was not a good person either.
But just like Yan Shanhe, he appeared to be a good man on the surface, how many dirty deeds he had done behind the scenes, only he knew.
Relying on his Master, Yan Shanhe, and the power of the Wanbao Alliance, who in the Changyun Realm dared to harm him? Moreover, his own strength was extremely formidable, at the peak of the True King Heavenly Venerable.
He was always accompanied by three guards, and apart from the Immortal Heavenly Venerable making a move, who could possibly kill him?
And the Immortal Heavenly Venerables would not offend Yan Shanhe just for this. As for the other True King Heavenly Venerables, they all knew better than to target him.
Moreover, Yan Ping, that person understood measures of conduct well; he knew which forces, which identities of people he could not offend. Thus, nobody expected that one day, Yan Ping would be killed!
"Speak up, who is the murderer?"
Yan Shanhe asked with a somber face.
"Alliance Hierarch, the murderer's identity is unknown, we only know he has a bald head, a robust figure, powerful sword skills, and despite our desperate resistance, the three of us could not withstand him," said a middle-aged man kneeling behind Yan Ping's corpse, his face pale, one arm gone, and spoke in a weak voice.
"Ping'er was at the peak of the Truth Refinement Realm, and the three of you have long polished your skills in the Truth Refinement Realm. The four of you joined forces and still couldn't match him. Who in the Changyun Realm, other than the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, could achieve that?
"Even if you cannot match him, you should still be able to escape; yet only you managed to escape, and with serious injuries, losing an arm on top of that. When has there ever been such strength in the Truth Refinement Realm within the Changyun Realm?" Yan Shanhe's gaze was cold as he spoke.
"Alliance Hierarch, is it possible that the Martial Artist came from outside the Realm? Within the Changyun Realm, even those with such strength would never dare to commit such an act," said a strong member of the Wanbao Alliance solemnly within the hall.
"Tell me, how did my Disciple offend him?" Yan Shanhe looked at the man with the severed arm.
"Alliance Hierarch, the Young Master was romantically involved with a beautiful woman. Little did we know that the other party..."
Yan Shanhe waved his hand, already having an idea in mind. What romantic involvement? It was nothing more than coercion or bribery, only to encounter a righteous person who took action, resulting in the loss of his life.
"That woman, deal with her. Issue a bounty for the pursuit of this person, reward those who report his whereabouts, and reward greatly those who capture and bring him to me...
"Command my orders, have the Guard of the Treasured Protector allocate twenty people, led by two Half-Step Immortal Realm individuals, to be in charge of capturing this person. I want him flayed alive!"
In the hall, the many Wanbao Alliance strong individuals hurriedly responded with respect, "Yes, Alliance Hierarch!"
"Poor my Disciple!" Yan Shanhe's round, plump face showed a mournful expression, "Imagine me, Yan Shanhe, having always been kind to others and advocating making money through friendliness, my true Disciple was tragically murdered. Give him a grand burial."
With his back turned, he stepped away and left. The people in the hall suddenly breathed a sigh of relief, as if a heavy stone had been lifted from their hearts.
Yet, Yan Shanhe's voice carried over from afar: "The guards were incompetent and suffered heavy injuries, and one even lost an arm. It would be a waste of Divine Medicine to treat such injury, just bury him!"
"Yes!"
The individuals in the hall all felt a chill in their hearts.

chapters.title: Chapter 802 - 420 Wanbao Alliance's Yan Shanhe, The Blamed Meng Chong_2
chapters.content:
Meanwhile, the man with the severed arm lay on the ground, his face ashen, utterly defeated.
Inside a secret chamber in a mansion in Baimu City.
"Was it a success?"
"Patriarch, it was successful. Yan Ping is dead, and all those involved are dead as well. Yan Shanhe has even issued a bounty to pursue Meng Chong."
"Good, that is good! Meng Chong has actually come from the Nine Mountains Realm to the Changyun Realm, which probably means Xu Yan has also left the Nine Mountains Realm. Pass this message on to Lord Tian Shiqi."
"Yes!"p>
"Patriarch, Xu Yan and Meng Chong are such peerless geniuses that there must be powerful figures behind them. If, by any chance, we provoke those behind them…"
"Foolish! What is the goal of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow? The stronger the backers of Xu Yan and Meng Chong, the better. I fear only that they will not seek revenge. As long as they do, it will be fortunate for us.
"With Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's influence spread across many major powers, once they get involved, wouldn't the Divine Realm become chaotic?"
"I see now!"
"By the way, has Song You not been killed yet? He must be killed. If he knows something and it gets out, it will be detrimental to us."
"Rest assured, Patriarch, we are already pursuing him. Song You won't live much longer, and if he knew anything, he would have leaked it by now."
"Hmm, deal with it as soon as possible!"
"Yes!"
Somewhere in the Changyun Realm, Meng Chong sauntered carelessly towards a city.
"I need to find out which special Heavenly Grottos are in the Changyun Realm, what unique treasures it holds. It's time to start searching for treasures to prepare for my breakthrough."
Meng Chong had a rough plan for his future path in martial arts.
He had traveled through many of the Thirty-six Realms of the Divine Realm, each with its unique treasures that could be collected to prepare for his transformation when breaking through to the second layer of the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body.
"I haven't understood the third layer yet, but there's no rush. I can try to find divine wonders like the Blood Heart Fruit to aid my comprehension of martial arts, perhaps then I can understand it faster."
Meng Chong thought to himself.
"According to those martial artists, if you want to buy or sell treasures or even purchase directories of cultivation techniques and treasures, you can go to the Wanbao Alliance. The Wanbao Alliance spans thirty realms of the Divine Realm and knows more about the unique treasures of each realm. It might be worthwhile to purchase a directory to get to know them."
"Once I'm in the city, I'll visit a Wanbao Alliance branch to see if there are any treasures worth buying."
Meng Chong walked boldly into the city and, after inquiring a little, headed straight for the Wanbao Alliance branch there.
"Eh?"
In a building in the city, a group of martial artists gathered when suddenly one of them gasped in doubt.
"Isn't that the person wanted by the Wanbao Alliance?"
"Bald head, sturdy build... Yes, indeed, that's the wanted man of the Wanbao Alliance, the villain who killed Young Master Yan Ping!"
"Hiss! This man has some nerve, swaggering through the streets without any concern for the Wanbao Alliance, completely disregarding Alliance Hierarch Yan Shanhe. Does he have a deep background?"
"Given that he dared to kill Young Master Yan Ping, he probably does have some backing, but the Wanbao Alliance is no ordinary power. Even if one is a peerless genius of a Great Realm, they must give an explanation. This man is too arrogant."
"Let's go and report his whereabouts to the Wanbao Alliance."
"Hold on, do you see? Isn't he going to the Wanbao Alliance Branch?"
"Hiss! Indeed, he is. Could it be he has a grudge against the Wanbao Alliance? Is he going there to wipe out this branch?"
At this thought, the group of martial artists were shocked beyond measure.
"Let's go, let's see what happens!"
The martial artists hurried toward the Wanbao Alliance branch, their faces alight with excitement, eager to witness the commotion.
Unaware that he was a wanted man, Meng Chong walked straight into the Wanbao Alliance branch.
The person in charge of the branch, referred to as the Store Manager, possessed the strength of the True King Peak, or even verging on the Half-Step Immortal Realm.
And the leader of the Treasure Protection Team would inevitably be at the Half-Step Immortal Realm, a powerful figure tempered through extended battles within the True King Heavenly Venerable Realm.
Feng Yang was entertaining a distinguished guest, ready to see the guest off when he noticed a bald, burly man walking in. Initially, he thought nothing of it.
But the next moment, a flash of realization struck him!
The main alliance in the Changyun Realm had issued a bounty, with Alliance Hierarch Yan Shanhe even deploying twenty Treasure Protection Team elites to hunt down the killer of Young Master Yan Ping.
The killer was described as a bald, burly martial artist, whose appearance perfectly matched that of the man who had just entered!
The Killer!
In that instant, Feng Yang was stunned. Was the killer launching himself willingly into the net?
He heard the killer's voice, "Give me a directory of the Divine Realm's treasures, and let me know about the treasured resources your Wanbao Alliance has collected."
```
Feng Yang sent off the honored guest and turned back to see the bald youth preparing to buy something at the counter.
The maid in charge of receiving guests had a strange look in her eyes as she noticed this person, who seemed to be the individual the Alliance Hierarch had offered a reward for—he appeared to be the murderer who killed Young Master Yan Ping.
However, she was somewhat uncertain. How could someone blatantly present themselves like this?
Could it be, they only resembled the murderer?
"Alright, dear guest, please wait a moment. If I may be so bold to ask, do you need a Divine Artifact, and what kind? Seeing how mighty you are, I assume you practice the saber technique, right? It's only with such a commanding saber technique that one can match your formidable presence!"
Meng Chong touched his head and smiled, saying, "Not bad, not bad, good eye. Knowing to use a saber truly suits my mightiness!"
No mistake about it!
This was undoubtedly the culprit!
Feng Yang roared internally, an opportunity to make a name for himself had arrived, but this individual was extremely powerful, and he was certainly no match alone, nor could he capture the man by himself.
Immediately, he transmitted a message to the Treasure Protection Team's Martial Artists and had the team leader invite the city's powerhouses to assist.
"Honored guest, may I ask for your esteemed name?"
As the maid placed a thick tome of the Divine Realm's exotic treasures onto the counter, she began to introduce which ones were available at the Wanbao Alliance Branch.
Buying time!
"I am Meng Chong,"
Meng Chong replied with a smile.
"Esteemed guest, these are the exotic treasures of our branch, all sourced from various realms of the Divine Realm. They are of extremely high grade, and naturally, their prices are also quite steep. Not just any Spirit Crystal can purchase them..."
Meng Chong skimmed through the tome while listening to the maid's introduction and spoke up, "Do you have any special exotic treasures, similar to the Blood Heart Fruit? And items for the physical body, including those poisons that severely damage the flesh and so on..."
The maid answered with a smile.
All of a sudden, Meng Chong's expression tightened—there was a killing intent!
He abruptly looked up to find several True King Heavenly Venerable Peak powerhouses from the Wanbao Alliance surrounding him, while the maid who had been explaining things quickly retreated and left.
"What does the Wanbao Alliance want to do?"
Meng Chong asked in bewilderment. He hadn't offended the Wanbao Alliance. Could this place be a branch of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow?
He looked at Feng Yang and asked with a heavy voice.
Though facing numerous opponents, mere True King Heavenly Venerables were nothing to Meng Chong's concern.
Even if one of them were at the Half-Step Immortal Realm, it was the same.
"Meng Chong, right? You dare swagger into a branch of the Wanbao Alliance after murdering the Alliance Hierarch's disciple? You've cast yourself into the net. It would be wise to surrender without resistance!"
Feng Yang coldly stated.
"What Wanbao Alliance Hierarch? I haven't killed anyone!"
Meng Chong was astonished. He had only just arrived in the Changyun Realm and happened to meet a few Martial Artists, from whom he inquired about the realm's situation before heading to this city. He hadn't killed anyone yet.
"Have you mistaken me for someone else?"
Feng Yang was furious, "Audacious criminal, don't bother with excuses, just surrender!"
"Capture him!"
With a wave of his hand, the assembled powerhouses took action immediately, sealing off all escape routes and trapping their quarry.
"I, Meng Chong, am open and upright; if I haven't killed anyone, then I haven't killed anyone. Since you refuse to be reasonable, then let my saber do the talking for you!"
Meng Chong's eyes narrowed with resolve. Although he feared he had been falsely accused, now that the Wanbao Alliance powerhouses had made their move, would he just stand there and get hit without fighting back?
Boom!
Golden light shone forth, and the light of the stars emerged. In that instant, under the starlight's reflection, the Wanbao Alliance's powerhouses felt their bodies grow heavy as if they were sinking into a quagmire.
"What kind of Martial Arts is this? No wonder he could kill Young Master Yan Ping!"
At that moment, a chill went down the spines of the Wanbao Alliance Martial Artists.
Bang!
Several members of the Treasure Protection Team unleashed secret techniques. Joining forces with a dozen True King Heavenly Venerable Peak Martial Artists, they launched a ferocious attack filled with killing intent.
Since words had failed, Meng Chong no longer held back. Since the incident had already set him at odds with the Wanbao Alliance, why hold any reservations?
"This is the Wanbao Alliance Branch, storied with numerous treasures. If I'm forced to act, then I, Meng Chong, will no longer be polite!"
With that thought, Meng Chong let out a roar and in the blink of an eye, transformed into a resplendent golden giant. With a sweep of his hand, he shattered the grand hall of the Wanbao Alliance Branch.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 803 - 421: Destroying the Old as if Pulling up Rotten Wood, Changyun Realm Trembles
chapters.content:
Boom!
The building where the Wanbao Alliance was located in the city suddenly exploded, shaking the entire city, and everyone looked up in shock to see a figure enveloped in Wind Thunder Circles, stars hanging behind him like a Heavenly God, standing majestically atop the ruins of the Wanbao Alliance Branch.
A punch was thrown, like the falling of the Great Sun, and a True King Heavenly Venerable was instantly obliterated on the spot.
Blades swept through, cutting two more True King Heavenly Venerables at the waist, their ferocity, might, and presence terrifying!
"Run for your lives!"
Those who were close by fled.
"This is the criminal wanted by the Wanbao Alliance, come together and capture him!"
A roar spread throughout the city.
It was the voice of the City Lord!
"I said, if I didn't do it, then I didn't do it. Why insist on pinning it on me? Do you think I, Meng Chong, am easy to bully?"
Before the terrified eyes of the crowd, the strong figure like a Heavenly God killed the City Lord with three punches, dispersing him into dust and smoke!
"Kill!"
The True King Heavenly Venerable in the city roared, uniting to attack the fearsome silhouette.
"Use the Combined Strike Technique!"
Someone shouted angrily, and a group of True King Heavenly Venerables began to use the Combined Strike Technique to attack Meng Chong.
They were warriors who had fought in the Heavenly Grotto, and their mastery of the Combined Strike Technique was well-practiced, so in an instant, they executed it, their energy connecting, shaking the heavens and the earth.
The Power of Domain Laws began to descend, creating a powerful offensive force.
"Whoever participates in capturing this criminal will be greatly rewarded by our Wanbao Alliance..." Feng Yang shouted loudly.
"Talk about rewards if you live to claim them, die now!" Meng Chong said as he slashed, taking the rest of the attacks on his body, focusing only on Feng Yang.
This man, the charge of the Wanbao Alliance Branch, was at the peak realm of True King Heavenly Venerable and wore protective armor, making his defense much stronger than the others.
Truly rich and powerful!
But, he was facing Meng Chong, unable to escape, and while the others wished to help, they couldn't injure Meng Chong in the slightest.
Puff!
With a flash of the blade, Feng Yang was obliterated into dust.
"Only one left!"
Meng Chong turned his blade on the leader of the Treasure Protection Team, the strongest person present.
"Do you think you can escape?"
Under Meng Chong's fierce slashes, the leader of the Treasure Protection Team was also slain.
The group of True King Heavenly Venerables there were left with faces filled with horror and despair. What kind of powerful being was this?
An Immortal Heavenly Venerable, perhaps?
But there was no trace of the aura of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, and even if it were, they wouldn't dare to withstand such powerful attacks with their flesh.
Was this still a human?
The more they fought, the more frightened, the more chilled they became.
"He's too strong, unbeatable below the rank of Immortal Heavenly Venerable!"
Those True King Heavenly Venerables whose judgment wasn't clouded by greed or ones too weak to join the battle, watched from afar, shocked.
This man, with his terrifying strength in Martial Arts, was unbeatable below the Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
Any number of True King Heavenly Venerables working together seemed to only be sending themselves to death!
Boom!
"Since you've attacked, there's no turning back. Die, all of you!"
Meng Chong's eyes revealed a ruthless light. Now that they were enemies, there was only one way to deal with them, annihilate them altogether!
Although, he too realized something was amiss, either they had mistaken him for a murderer or someone had framed him.
But that was all irrelevant now.
Since they attacked, since they didn't listen to reason, then it was time to kill!
With sufficient strength, the Wanbao Alliance would come to their senses, submit, and then they would realize he was innocent, and they had been used.
Without sufficient power, without the strength to make them bow, no matter the explanation, even if one were to hand over evidence proving they had been framed, it wouldn't matter.
To save face, to uphold the principle of their own righteousness, they would kill the framed victim even if they knew it was a setup.
All for the sake of their reputation and authority.
The difference was merely that they would retaliate against the one who set them up.
Only by compelling them with overwhelming strength would one be adopting the only correct method of defense.
Even if there was no evidence of being framed, as long as the other party submitted, they would recognize it and look into it, seeking out the truth!
Meng Chong had a deep understanding of these great powers' principles of conduct – without the strength to back it up, any defense was in vain!
With enough strength, there's no need to defend at all!
At that moment, under the startling gazes of the warriors, a great sun emerged, surrounded by dense stars, a figure like a Heavenly God stood among them, Wind Thunder Circles around, blade light sweeping across.
The True King Heavenly Venerables who had joined forces against him, under the illumination of the stellar light, seemed to sink into a swamp, their movements slowed.
Not one could escape the area of the Great Sun Stellar.
But the figure like a Heavenly God, with a blade for each, a punch for each, struck down the True King Heavenly Venerables, turning to dust. Such a terrifying sight shocked all the warriors.
True King Heavenly Venerables, among the top of the warriors, fell so easily, like grasshoppers, easily slain by someone?
Was this an Immortal Heavenly Venerable?
But without the aura of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, it must be some unknown, supremely powerful secret technique of Martial Arts that was practiced.
That's what granted the ability to crush peers so utterly.
"In my lifetime, I considered myself to have seen countless battles, witnessed many fights, but never before like today's battle!" muttered a True King Heavenly Venerable with white hair solemnly.
Even though he was a True King Heavenly Venerable who had lived to see his near end, having gone through long years, he had never witnessed a battle like the one today.

chapters.title: Chapter 804 - 421: Destroying the Old as if Pulling up Rotten Wood, Changyun Realm Trembles_2
chapters.content:
Boom!
The battle had ended, and the besiegers had all been killed!
The watching crowd of True King Heavenly Venerables, upon seeing that god-like figure, were frightened to shivers as two awe-inspiring gazes swept over them, prompting them to subconsciously retreat.
They all slightly bowed their heads, not daring to meet his gaze, indicating that they were merely onlookers.
Meng Chong reverted to his true form and searched for the treasury of stored treasures within the ruined building of the Wanbao Alliance, at the nearly devastated site of the Alliance's location.
Since stepping into the Martial Arts Realm, he had never indulged in such a massacre; there was a sense of intense satisfaction.
Boom!
With a single slice, he opened the underground treasury, and Meng Chong entered, ransacking it thoroughly.
At this moment, Meng Chong couldn't help but remember the times in the Spiritual Realm when he had looted a treasury, never imagining that, after arriving in the Divine Realm, he would once again ransack a treasury.
After looting everything, Meng Chong soared into the sky, surveyed his surroundings, and said in a deep voice, "Tell the Wanbao Alliance that I, Meng Chong, did not kill their people. Whether they believe it or not is for the Alliance to decide.
If they think I can be bullied and insist on pinning the murder on me, if they want to put a bounty on my head, then let them try and see if my blade is sharp!"
After speaking, Meng Chong disappeared in an instant.
He couldn't go to the Heavenly Grotto, lest he be trapped inside and find it difficult to fight his way out.
He felt some helplessness in his heart; how was it so similar to when he first arrived in the Nine Mountain Realm, having encountered an assassination attempt?
Suddenly, Meng Chong's brows furrowed!
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow?"
At that moment, he thought of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, suspecting that they might be behind this scheme!
"Can't get rid of your sinister presence, can I!"
Meng Chong's face darkened.
...
"Very good, very good indeed!"
In the main hall of the Wanbao Alliance in Baimu City, Yan Shanhe's plump, round face was filled with darkness and murderous intent.
His disciple had been killed!
The murderer had brazenly entered a branch of the Wanbao Alliance, and, showcasing his strength, he leveled the branch to the ground, killing all those involved in the pursuit, and plundering the treasury!
This was an unprecedented event in the history of the Wanbao Alliance and the first time anyone dared to provoke the Alliance so brazenly!
"He claims he's not the murderer? If so, he should surrender willingly, and come before me. How could I wrong him? They're all excuses! How can such criminals not be eradicated?"
Yan Shanhe's eyes were filled with lethal intent; this man was trampling on the dignity of the Wanbao Alliance, provoking the Alliance. He must die!
Otherwise, where would the Wanbao Alliance's authority stand?
Where would his, Yan Shanhe's, face be?
"Issue the order, double the bounty! Whoever captures and kills this felon will be my esteemed guest, and receive a Wanbao Command," Yan Shanhe said solemnly.
"Additionally, arrange a meeting with the major sects of the Changyun Realm. Tell them Yan Shanhe wishes to speak with them."
He looked at one person in the hall, an Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Wanbao Alliance.
"You are in charge of pursuing this felon; you must capture him and bring him back. I want to skin him alive in front of everyone, to show the warriors of the Changyun Realm that the Wanbao Alliance is not to be provoked!"
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable hurriedly responded, "Yes, Alliance Hierarch!"
"The Heavenly Grotto has been quiet lately; we can spare more manpower. Our priority is to capture and kill this man. I want to see if this felon can truly sweep through the Truth Refinement Realm warriors of the Changyun Realm!" Yan Shanhe said menacingly.
From the information available, Meng Chong's strength was extremely formidable, not a single True King Heavenly Venerable was his match. But what about fighting alone? What if they joined forces?
If ten people weren't enough, what about twenty, thirty?
He wanted to see if this man was truly invincible below the rank of Immortal Heavenly Venerable!
Even if he was indeed invincible below that rank, could he still defeat an Immortal Heavenly Venerable?
Even if he was already an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, could he be invincible among them? The foundation of the Wanbao Alliance was not something outsiders could comprehend!
The Martial Arts Realm of the Changyun Realm was in an uproar.
A branch of the Wanbao Alliance had been wiped out, the treasury plundered, and the person responsible had also slain the killer of Yan Ping. What shocked people even more was that this individual, with his own strength, had killed numerous True King Heavenly Venerables, demonstrating immense power.
"Where does this person come from? Is he from beyond our realm? When has our Changyun Realm ever had such a strong warrior?"
"He must be from outside; we have never heard of such a person in the Changyun Realm."
"Provoking the Wanbao Alliance like this, don't they know about the Wanbao Alliance's power? Or could it be that the adversary hails from the Great Realm, with a profound background that fears not the Wanbao Alliance's retaliation?"
"Impossible, even a prodigy from the Great Realm wouldn't have any reason to offend the Wanbao Alliance to such an extent, especially since the Wanbao Alliance itself is comprised of forces from the Great Realm."
"Exactly, in my opinion, they likely come from a realm that the Wanbao Alliance has yet to reach, thus being ignorant of the Wanbao Alliance's power."
Throughout the Changyun Realm, including within the Heavenly Grotto, Martial Artists were all buzzing with discussion.
That the Changyun Realm could produce such a formidable character was astonishing.
"The bounty from the Wanbao Alliance is truly tempting, should we form a team and hunt down this person?"
"The major forces have all shown their faces, those of us without solid backing should refrain from getting involved, after all, that murderer is too strong."
"What's there to fear? If one cannot overcome, could ten people, or even dozens, not be enough?"
The Changyun Realm boiled over; powerhouses from several major forces joined the fray, issuing arrest warrants.
In the cities throughout the realm, numerous Martial Artists were searching for Meng Chong's whereabouts.
There were even True King Heavenly Venerables forming teams, ready to encircle and kill Meng Chong to claim the Wanbao Alliance's generous bounty.
Apart from the bounty, even more enticing was the prospect of becoming a valued guest of Yan Shanhe, and the possession of a Wanbao Order!
Even the Immortal Heavenly Venerable was tempted.
The major forces throughout the Changyun Realm used their intelligence networks to search for Meng Chong's location, with some Immortal Heavenly Venerables ready to join the pursuit at any moment.
"This Wanbao Alliance really is wealthy!"
Meng Chong inventoried his gains, and couldn't help but marvel inwardly.
"I've already gathered fifty to sixty percent of the treasures necessary for accumulating my foundation. However, the Wanbao Alliance surely won't let things rest. Let's go into the city and see what they're up to."
Meng Chong regarded offending the Wanbao Alliance as of little concern, considering that it was they who struck first. Since that was the case, it was time to let power do the talking.
"Fifth Junior Brother, do you know about the Wanbao Alliance?"
Meng Chong sent a message to Jiang Buping, trying to probe for detailed intelligence about the Wanbao Alliance.
Being from a major clan and once a prodigy himself, Jiang Buping naturally knew more about the large forces within the Divine Realm.
"Second Senior Brother, the Wanbao Alliance is an alliance of many strong individuals and major forces, amalgamating into a merchant coalition; it seems that the Jiang Family from the Taikun Realm is also a participant.
"The Wanbao Alliance has a profound foundation, with many formidable members spread across thirty realms..."
