Jiang Buping replied with the message.
"I see, the Wanbao Alliance should not be underestimated, but it's no major problem."
Meng Chong nodded, feeling assured.
He had offended only the Changyun Realm's branch of the Wanbao Alliance—the others had not yet been offended. If the entire Wanbao Alliance came after him, he would not fear in the slightest.
If that were the case, then it was time to have a proper showdown with the Wanbao Alliance. In the future, there would be no need to painstakingly accumulate treasures; simply seizing them from the Wanbao Alliance would suffice.
"Second Senior Brother, don't be careless. The Wanbao Alliance's branches across different realms are actually interconnected and all are led by the true main alliance. As for how exactly it is led, I'm not very clear."
Jiang Buping cautioned.
"It's a minor issue. If it comes to that, I'll just don a wig and assume a new identity. Once my strength is sufficient, I'll settle accounts with the Wanbao Alliance!"
Meng Chong touched his head and chuckled as he spoke.
Upon hearing this, Jiang Buping seemed to agree. With Second Senior Brother wearing a wig and changing his appearance, who could pursue him?
Besides, their master was there; even if the Wanbao Alliance had some old monsters, there was absolutely no need to worry.
Meng Chong put away the Communication Talisman and strode confidently toward a city; he wanted to see how the Wanbao Alliance intended to deal with him. As for the matter of being framed for murder, belief or disbelief was entirely a matter of strength.
Inside a secret room in Baimu City.
"The arrangements for Meng Chong have been completed. The Wanbao Alliance is pursuing him, and no matter how he defends himself, it will be futile. Even if Yan Shanhe discovers that he is not the murderer and that he was framed, he won't be spared.
"What a fierce individual, directly destroying a branch of the Wanbao Alliance. This way, regardless of the truth, Yan Shanhe must have him executed!"
"The family head's methods are indeed brilliant!"
"What about Xu Yan? Have we discovered his whereabouts yet?"
"Family head, we have yet to find him, but we're actively searching. As soon as he appears in the Changyun Realm, we'll know immediately."
"Hm, once Xu Yan is found, report immediately to Lord Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter. He intends to take action personally."
"Understood!"
At this moment, Meng Chong had already entered the city and was walking boldly towards the Wanbao Alliance Branch there.

chapters.title: Chapter 805 - 422 Duowu Cave, Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter Incoming
chapters.content:
"Meng Chong, are you here to provoke our Wanbao Alliance?"
"I'm here to clarify something, your Alliance Hierarch's disciple wasn't killed by me, Meng Chong. I dare to act and dare to own up, and I would never deny anyone I had actually killed. Therefore, your Wanbao Alliance should give me an explanation for attacking me for no reason.
"Of course, I, Meng Chong, am magnanimous. Since the attacker has been killed by me, and your branch's treasure vault has been looted by me, consider it compensation granted to me.
"If your Alliance Hierarch is willing, let's consider this misunderstanding resolved. But if you insist on believing that I, Meng Chong, killed his disciple, then come at me all you want!"
Silence!
Inside the Wanbao Alliance Branch, including the Store Manager of this branch, a group of Treasure Protection Team members, and many Martial Artists who were here to buy and sell treasures, all watched in shock at the bald brute before them.
He was too arrogant!
"What, is there a problem?"
Meng Chong snorted coldly, "I, Meng Chong, have given you a way out, don't be unappreciative. Remember, the mistake is yours, for wrongly accusing me of killing your Alliance Hierarch's disciple, I was merely forced to defend myself."
The Store Manager and the leader of the Treasure Protection Team were shaking with anger—this was too much to bear!
Was he here to trample on the face of the Wanbao Alliance? This young man was far too arrogant. If he wasn't eliminated, where would the dignity of the Wanbao Alliance lie?
"Brat, cut the chatter and surrender. Meet our Alliance Hierarch, and if he believes you, then all will be written off," said the Store Manager coldly.
Although Meng Chong had single-handedly destroyed a branch of the Wanbao Alliance and had killed all the True King Heavenly Venerables who ambushed him,
That branch was not as important as this one, after all, it was just a small city.
"Everyone, capture this man, and our Alliance Hierarch will reward you handsomely!" the Store Manager cried out loudly.
Yan Shanhe, the Alliance Hierarch of the Wanbao Alliance, a top-tier Immortal Heavenly Venerable with a formidable reputation in the Changyun Realm, was respected by all Immortal Realm powerhouses in the entire Changyun Realm, wasn't he?
Strong figures from several major powers had relations with him.
Whether it's for the heavy reward or to curry favor with Yan Shanhe, numerous True King Heavenly Venerable powerhouses would not miss this opportunity!
Boom!
Meng Chong's gaze turned cold—he knew that the conflict with the Wanbao Alliance was irreconcilable. They had already put a bounty on him; if that was so, then it would come down to a show of strength and tactics.
While his current strength might not match that of the Wanbao Alliance Hierarch Yan Shanhe, once he made his next breakthrough, he would have the strength to shatter his opponent.
"Before you try to intervene, think carefully, whether you can withstand my blade, Meng Chong!"
Meng Chong held his blade in hand.
"Presumptuous fool, do you think you alone can sweep us all? You are not an Immortal Heavenly Venerable!"
"Kill him!"
Boom!
The battle erupted, a group of True King Heavenly Venerables instantly joined forces to attack Meng Chong.
However, Meng Chong faced those ferocious assaults without fear. The immeasurable divine might emerged, and he utilized the Heavenly Hammer Refining Skill to further temper his body.
Boom!
Despite their attacks hitting him, they could not shake him in the slightest.
"Die!"
The blade flashed, like thunder cutting through the sky. With a splutter, a True King Heavenly Venerable fell instantly!
The moment he made his move, Meng Chong knew, he was about to strike it rich!
This Wanbao Alliance Branch was larger than the one in the small city, which meant the treasures stored would inevitably be greater. Since he had already taken action, there was no need for courtesy now.
Boom!
A great sun appeared, and a figure like a Heavenly God suddenly appeared, shocking countless Martial Artists.
"I am Heavenly God Meng Chong, here to destroy a Wanbao Alliance branch!"
Meng Chong's voice boomed like thunder, spreading in all directions. With the great sun and the stars emerging, winds and thunder swept through the Domain, and with the reflections from his blade lighting up the half sky, the figure like a Heavenly God cut down one True King Heavenly Venerable after another, under the stunned gaze of the onlookers.
True King Heavenly Venerables who were originally preparing to join the great battle instantly felt chills, their faces showing terror.
This young man could only be matched by an Immortal Heavenly Venerable!
Especially that terrifying physical defense, allowing him to withstand the bombardments from the crowd, left him completely unharmed.
The Martial Artists who had planned to help the Wanbao Alliance were now considering retreat, and as one of them retreated in terror, one after another began to back away frantically.
Boom!
Meng Chong did not pay attention to these people. He swung his blade down, slicing open the Wanbao Alliance's vault, and took all the treasures and Storage Bags inside, including those carried by the leader of the Treasure Protection Team and the Store Manager, into his possession.
Boom!
A presence suddenly appeared between heaven and earth, as if a mighty being was taking control of this Domain.
The Power of Domain Laws began to descend incessantly.
An Immortal Heavenly Venerable was on his way, about to arrive.
Everyone showed a look of delight—finally, an Immortal Heavenly Venerable had appeared!
Meng Chong was as good as dead!
"Farewell!"
With a cold laugh, Meng Chong took a step forward, transforming into a great sun crossing the sky, instantly reaching the horizon.
"Where do you think you're going?"
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable roared in anger, giving chase.
The two figures vanished in the skies instantaneously, while the many Martial Artists in the city looked upon the ruins of what was once the domain of the Wanbao Alliance.
The deeply hidden vault had been thoroughly looted.
"Who is this ferocious man!"
"With two Wanbao Alliance branches consecutively destroyed, they'll probably not stand for it."
"Heavenly God Meng Chong will surely leave a notorious name in the history of the Martial Arts Realm. Even in death, he would have lived a life worth living."
"I suddenly feel less confident. An Immortal Heavenly Venerable might not be able to catch him!"
"I'm green with envy. Meng Chong has looted so many treasures, if only..."

chapters.title: Chapter 806 - 422 Duowu Cave, Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter Incoming_2
chapters.content:
The group of Martial Artists suddenly began breathing heavily.
At this moment, Meng Chong was like a walking treasure vault.
Usually, a Wanbao Alliance Branch would be guarded by a powerhouse, and the treasure vault defenses were extremely strong—unless an Immortal Heavenly Venerable made a move, they could not be breached.
And no one dared to raid the treasure vault of the Wanbao Alliance.
Yet there emerged Meng Chong, a ruthless figure who directly broke into and looted two branches' treasure vaults, sweeping away untold Martial Arts resources.
However, considering Meng Chong's strength and ferocity, the difficulty of assassinating him was even greater than that of breaching a Wanbao Alliance Branch!
...
After Xu Yan emerged from seclusion, he headed for a city within the Changyun Realm, intending to investigate the situation of the Heavenly Grotto there.
"Is the Wanbao Alliance hunting down my junior brother?"
As a result, Xu Yan discovered the Wanbao Alliance's bounty.
He immediately took out a Communication Talisman and contacted Meng Chong to understand the situation.
"Elder brother, it's just a trivial matter. Let the Wanbao Alliance try to hunt me down if they wish; there's no need for elder brother to act for the time being.
"Although I am no match for an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, they also can't threaten me. I've already shaken them off. I won't stay too long in the Changyun Realm—once I find a chance to raid a few more Wanbao Alliance branches, I'll leave the Changyun Realm."
Meng Chong replied.
His elder brother must be preparing to venture into the Heavenly Grotto. Once he got involved in this, he would not be able to go there, so Meng Chong didn't intend to have his elder brother take action.
Moreover, the Wanbao Alliance still couldn't threaten him.
As for the Changyun Realm, he was just passing through, and he had almost gathered all the treasures he needed to build his foundation.
"Junior brother, be careful. If you need help, send a message to me."
Xu Yan nodded in acknowledgment.
With the second junior brother's skills, hiding his identity, concealing himself, and avoiding assassination were not particularly difficult tasks.
"My Physiognomy Realm is now complete, and perfection is not far off. Once I reach the perfection of the Physiognomy Realm, I can kill an ordinary Immortal Realm adversary."
Xu Yan thought silently.
"I look forward to breaking through to the Void-breaking Realm soon. Once I enter the Void-breaking, I will push through and overcome the Immortals!"
Xu Yan was filled with anticipation.
At a certain place in the Changyun Realm.
"My lord, we have spotted Xu Yan."
"Good, very good. Where is he now?"
"Xu Yan has appeared in this place..."
"I will take action personally. Xu Yan's time of death has come. Let's see how powerful the people behind him are and if they can stir up the winds of change in the Divine Realm!"
A man wearing a Ferocious Mask inscribed with eight leaves coldly said.
Xu Yan, after leaving a Wanbao Alliance Branch, looked back for a moment. After a brief hesitation, he ultimately decided not to strike down this Wanbao Alliance Branch.
"Forget it, for now the Wanbao Alliance poses no threat to junior brother. If they become threatening, it won't be too late for me to take action."
In the Wanbao Alliance, Xu Yan purchased a register of the Divine Realm's heavenly materials and treasures, as well as information about the various realm's Heavenly Grottoes.
The Wanbao Alliance spread across thirty realms, which naturally included information for sale about the different Heavenly Grottoes from various realms and news from the Divine Realm.
As a commercial alliance, it had a better understanding, especially of the rare and exotic heavenly materials and treasures, and it would also sell registries of these items.
Sometimes, they even openly sought to purchase certain special and scarce treasures.
After learning this information, Xu Yan immediately went to the Wanbao Alliance to purchase the relevant information he needed.
He also inquired about news regarding Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow but found no information about them.
Xu Yan wondered whether this branch of the Wanbao Alliance was simply not senior enough to involve information about the power of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, or if Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow was indeed so well-hidden that even the Wanbao Alliance had no information?
Xu Yan leaned towards the former, believing that this branch of the Wanbao Alliance did not have the level to access intelligence on Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
"In the Changyun Realm, the most famous Heavenly Grotto is this Witch's Heavenly Grotto, also known as the Duowu Cave, which is occupied by an extraterrestrial strong being named Duowu.
"Duowu has the light of a hundred eyes, and once illuminated by it, one can become lazy, weak-bodied, dispirited, and without any fighting will, unable to exert one's full strength."
Xu Yan's attention was caught by the introduction of a Heavenly Grotto.
"Duowu? Could she be from the same place as the Seductive Witch? If I ventured to this Heavenly Grotto, I wonder if I could lure the Seductive Witch there."
Xu Yan mused to himself.
"Let's go to the Duowu Cave and see if this Duowu is as bizarrely powerful as the rumors claim."
The records about Duowu all revolved around his light of a hundred eyes, which could cause laziness, weakness, and lack of fighting spirit.
Even an Immortal Heavenly Venerable would need to be cautious when facing it. A moment's carelessness could lead to a fatal fall.
There was an Immortal Heavenly Venerable who had been exposed to the light of a hundred eyes and couldn't resist, becoming lazy and weak, unable to muster the energy to defend against an attack.
In the end, it was another Immortal Heavenly Venerable who took action and rescued him from the Heavenly Grotto.
"The Duowu Cave, besides an Immortal Realm Duowu, also has other weaker Duowus inside. However, it is unknown whether they are all his avatars or not?"
Xu Yan left the city and, after discerning the direction, set out for the Duowu Cave.
"With the completion of my Wisdom Sword Realm, Imperishable Sword Intent, Mountain and River Myriad Manifestations, and the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path, the power of the Duowu should not be able to affect me."
His Martial Arts divine subtlety was far beyond what Taicang Martial Arts could compare to, and he had many more means to contend with these strange forces.
Just after leaving the city, Xu Yan suddenly halted.
A figure floated towards him, as though he had taken control of this domain.
The newcomer was wearing a Ferocious Mask marked with eight leaves.
"Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter?"
Xu Yan's eyebrows rose.
The forces of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, with Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter being Martial Artists of Immortal Heavenly Venerable, meant that Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter belonged to an even stronger level within the Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
As for Earth Shadow, their duties included lurking and assassinating, excelling in the way of stealth and hidden kills.
The Earth Shadow under the cover of the sinister mask were considered Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
This Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter, indeed, was stronger than the ordinary Immortal Heavenly Venerables, and although weaker than a powerhouse like Emperor Da Yue, within the Immortal Heavenly Venerables, he wouldn't be too far from the peak.
According to Xu Yan's understanding of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables, Emperor Da Yue was in the later stages of the Immortal Realm, counted among the top-tier Immortal Heavenly Venerables, while Sui Hongwu was in the early stages of the same realm.
This Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter, however, was in the mid-stages of the Immortal Realm.
"You lot from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow really are like persistent ghosts," Xu Yan remarked with a cold laugh, clearly unafraid.
"Xu Yan, you are the most exceptional prodigy I have seen," the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter coldly claimed. "Today, I will stifle that brilliance of yours!"
"With you? A rat that hides your head and shows your tail?" Xu Yan sneered disdainfully.
"You've come at just the right time; let's use you to test my Martial Arts," Xu Yan scoffed with scorn.
"You are the first to belittle the Immortal Heavenly Venerables, oh prodigy, and those who belittle the Immortal shall unquestionably perish!" the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter raised his palm as he spoke.
Boom!
The Domain Power converged, as if the domain itself was held within his palm.
"Die!"
With a press of his palm, the Domain Power slammed down fiercely as if the domain itself was pressing in to suppress everything.
Hum!
With a wave of Xu Yan's hand, the Yin Yang Undying Sword flowed ceaselessly, the Mountain and River Physiognomy appeared, and the Power of Domain Laws descended. In that moment, he directly weakened the opponent's control over the Domain Power.
"What kind of Martial Arts is this?"
The Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter's eyebrows furrowed with surprise as he eyed Xu Yan's Mountain and River Physiognomy.
Not being in the Immortal Realm, yet possessing a similar ability to control the Domain Laws, even though relative to the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, this control wasn't akin to commanding the domain, it still diminished the Immortal Heavenly Venerable's dominion.
It was as if two Immortal Heavenly Venerables were contending, each vying to command the domain in battle.
"No wonder he's undefeated below the Immortal Realm, with such Martial Arts, which True King Heavenly Venerable could be his match?" contemplated the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter with a sense of awe yet also a secret thrill.
"Such an exquisite Martial Arts indicates that behind Xu Yan, there must be a Supreme Expert. To kill him, to provoke that Supreme Expert, would be to undoubtedly plunge the Divine Realm into chaos," he thought to himself, his eyes flickering with keen light. Only now did he understand why Lord Tian Shiqi insisted on killing Xu Yan and Meng Chong.
It was the most direct, most efficient method, one that could stir the currents of the Divine Realm in the shortest time!
"Your Martial Arts may be divine, but you have yet to enter the Immortal Realm; you will surely die today!" said the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter with a cold smile, a frosty divine sword in his hand.
"Die!"
Swish!
A cold light flashed across the domain, with the sword's light amassing Domain Power, and in an instant, it slashed down.
Xu Yan's eyebrows raised, and with a mocking smile, he responded, "A frog in a well dares to use a sword before me, Sword God Xu Yan?"
Hum!
The sword strike from the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter had barely entered the Yin Yang Sword Wheel before it was reflected back, the sword light becoming even sharper, as though imbued with spiritual wisdom.
"How can this be?!" exclaimed the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter, taken aback.
In the realm of Sword Dao, he was considered the best within the Changyun Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 807 - 423: Let you see why I, Xu Yan, am the Sword God.
chapters.content:
"I want to see what qualifies you to call yourself the Sword God!"
The gaze of Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter turned cold, and in an instant, his sword burst forth with a piercing cold radiance. The Power of Domain Laws infused into it, and the sword light stacked upon itself. In just a moment, the area had transformed into a Sword Light Domain.
"Let me show you what the Sword Dao of the Immortal Realm is like."
The Power of Domain Laws converged, sword light continuously emerged, completely enveloping this part of the Domain. Each strand of sword light intertwined with the Domain Laws, forming a massive Sword Net.
At this moment, Xu Yan was entirely engulfed within the Sword Net.
"With this Sky-Connecting Sword Net Technique, I have once slain an Immortal Heavenly Venerable. As for you, a mere boy, no matter how mystical your movement technique or how exquisite your escaping technique, under my Sword Net, your death is certain!"
At this moment, the eyes of Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter were filled with arrogance.
"As a warrior not of the Immortal Realm, to die under my swordsmanship should be enough for you to take pride in!"
In the eyes of Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter, Xu Yan was undoubtedly doomed to die.
No matter how intricate his movement technique or how swift his escaping technique was, now that he had fallen into his Sky-Connecting Sword Net Technique, even the most sophisticated movement technique or the fastest escaping technique could not allow him to escape from his Sword Net.
But he still dared not be careless.
Sword light continued to manifest, dense and numerous, filling the view with chilling luminance. The Domain seemed to have become a Sword Punishment Prison, capable of slicing a person into countless pieces in an instant.
Xu Yan watched the layered sword light, his eyes not filled with alarm but with excitement. Surrounded by the sword light, he seemed as if these sword lights were not targeted at him, but rather, emanating from him.
"A frog in a well, not even having stepped through the threshold of the Sword Dao, relying solely on brute force and realm to perform your moves, appearing vast and endless, appearing to have fierce swordsmanship, but in my eyes, it's nothing but a joke.
"Very well, today I will let you, this pitiable frog in a well, witness what the Sword Dao truly is, and see for yourself why I, Xu Yan, am the Sword God!"
As his voice fell, Sword Intent surfaced, mountains and rivers merged into the Domain.
"Your sword is my sword. The fierce sword light that you have painstakingly executed, now serves me. Using these countless sword lights, I will set up a Sword Array to let you, this frog in a well, have a taste."
Xu Yan took a step forward, and in a thought, all the sword light, in a flash, broke free from Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter's control. The fierce lethal sword light, which was originally aimed at Xu Yan, suddenly turned around, now enveloping Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter.
The sword light that shrouded the Domain, with Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter within it, switched direction as if it had a mind of its own in a split second, the intent to kill now aimed at Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter.
Moreover, every strand of sword light seemed to contain a terrifying Sword Intent.
This moment caused a great change in Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter's expression, his face filled with shock.
Even at this moment, he discovered that the divine sword in his hand was trembling, struggling, and, with a slight mishap, the tip of the sword bent backward, cutting his hand!
Clang!
Startled, Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter hastily threw his sword away!
Such a shocking scene made his scalp tingle!
His own sword, betraying him?
Why was this happening?
Each of those sword lights, which were the result of his own swordsmanship, had suddenly turned into his enemy's power in a mere moment?
Such strange occurrences were unheard of!
At this moment Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter's expression was one of horror, cold sweat almost breaking out from him, too bizarre and terrifying!
Hum!
The sword light was blinding, and the swordsmanship that he had executed now completely lost control, turning back to attack him, the one who had executed the sword technique.
Such an incredible thing was actually happening in front of him, an Immortal Heavenly Venerable!
At this moment, deep within Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter's heart, there was a hint of fear!
"In all of the Sword Dao, I am supreme. Even if you are an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, you do not have the right to wield a sword before me, you are not worthy!"
Xu Yan said with a cold smile.
Having reached the pinnacle of the Wisdom Sword Realm, even if his opponent was an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, as long as he had practiced swordsmanship, he could not resist Xu Yan's Sword Dao Realm.
Swoosh!
He used the might of his opponent's swordsmanship to set up a Sword Array.
Mountain and River Swordsmanship emerged, and in an instant, the sword light stacked layer upon layer. Each strand of sword light seemed to be imbued with a life of its own, each performing a different sword technique. These techniques combined with each other, forming a lethal Sword Array.
Boom!
Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter's heart turned cold as he raised his hand, the Power of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable coursing through with each palm strike, blocking the sword light that assaulted him.
The one who thought he held the winning cards found himself suddenly on the defensive.
"Since my swordsmanship can be controlled, then I shall not use sword techniques. As the mighty Immortal Heavenly Venerable, am I going to be harmed by a mere child like Xu Yan?"
Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter took a deep breath, calming his trembling heart.
After all, he was an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, and not a weak one at that. Even if he could not employ his swordsmanship, he still had other Martial Arts at his disposal.
Boom!
The commanding presence of controlling Domain Power slowly revealed itself as he regained his composure.
After all, the sword light was the strength of his swordsmanship and couldn't last forever. By now, the sword light was already seemingly dimming.
"Xu Yan, I have to admit, you are a monstrously talented and frightening, but ultimately still too weak. If you were an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, I would certainly not be your match and would be killed by you.
"But as you are now, even if you possess the uncanny ability to control my sword technique, it changes nothing, for I am not a mere Swordsman Warrior!"

chapters.title: Chapter 808 - 423: Let Me Show You Why I, Xu Yan, Am the Sword God_2
chapters.content:
The Eight-leaf Heavenly Venerable sneered.
"Is that so?"
Xu Yan smiled indifferently.
The Mountain and River Swordsmanship unfolded, and the Divine Skills of Mountains and Rivers within the Sword also emerged. At this moment, the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter was already within his Mountains and Rivers in the Sword.
With a raise of his hand, the Imperishable Sword Intent surged forth. The originally dim sword light suddenly burst forth with a blinding cold gleam once again.
The Power of Domain Laws also descended, transforming into Mountain and River Myriad Manifestations.
As the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter swung his fists, his aura was like a rainbow. With each motion, the Domain Power poured out, shattering one sword light after another, even tearing open a gap within the Mountains and Rivers in the Sword.
Occasionally, he seized the opportunity to launch a killing blow towards Xu Yan, but it was effortlessly resolved by the Yin Yang Sword Wheel. The force of this strike was instead returned to the sword light, enhancing its power.
"This man's strength is indeed powerful. With my current strength, it's simply impossible to kill him!"
Xu Yan sighed internally, admitting that the strength of the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter was formidable.
Of course, the other party also lacked the sufficiency to breach the defense of his Yin Yang Undying Sword.
"With such strength, it's perfect for honing my Sword Dao!"
As Xu Yan swung his hand, he began to refine his Sword Dao further, unleashing all his insights into the Sword Dao.
The more the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter fought, the more shocked he became. He was astounded to find that, with his own strength, he couldn't break through Xu Yan's defense. That bizarre Sword Wheel, eternal and unending, no matter how forcefully he struck, he couldn't shatter it.
And not being able to shatter that bizarre Sword Wheel meant he couldn't harm Xu Yan in the slightest.
"Why is his Martial Arts so powerful?"
At this moment, the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter even felt a tinge of envy. If he had cultivated such a powerful Martial Arts, he would likely be invincible in the Immortal Realm.
"What kind of Sword Dao is this, so wonderfully unpredictable?"
He considered himself a strong practitioner of the Sword Dao, yet only upon seeing Xu Yan's Sword Dao did he realize with shock that he seemed like an utter novice in comparison, not even having touched the threshold of the Sword Dao.
It was as if he only knew how to wield a sword, swinging it wildly without possessing either the sharpness or the versatility of a sword.
Just like a three-year-old child wielding a toy sword, playing in front of a Great Grandmaster of the true Sword Dao.
"Why does Xu Yan's Sword Dao possess an unfathomable depth, and why does each sword strike seem imbued with a distinct killing intent?"
The Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter was horrified in his heart.
At this moment, he had to face a reality, that even with his personal intervention, he could not harm Xu Yan!
"It's about time!"
Xu Yan took a deep breath.
Hum!
All the sword lights vanished in an instant, all the Sword Intent disappeared in an instant.
Even the Mountain and River Myriad Manifestations dissipated without a trace.
But it wasn't that they had disappeared, rather they merged with this Domain, becoming indistinguishable from it.
"Hmm?"
The Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter's brow raised.
In a thundering roar, terrifying visions of a great battle emerged between Heaven and Earth. Although these scenes were very blurry, they were still overwhelmingly shocking.
The Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter's pupils constricted, and almost subconsciously, his figure trembled, revealing a look of horror as he was shocked by the sudden appearance of the battle scene.
Xu Yan frowned slightly, "After all, my strength is somewhat lacking, not able to fully assimilate it for my own use, and the simulated battle is not realistic enough!"
At this moment, the great battle emerging within the Mountain and River Myriad Manifestations was the one Xu Yan had witnessed while crossing the wilderness, which he had refined into the Mountains and Rivers.
"Slash!"
The warriors in the midst of the great battle, as if lifting their hands simultaneously, gathered all their strength, raising a sword to strike down at the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter.
And with this sword, the shadow of the common people also emerged.
The Domain changed, as if entering a battlefield, and on that battlefield, there was only the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter alone, now facing a horrifying attack!
"Ahh!"
At this moment, the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter's heart was struck by fear once more, trembling as he roared out loud, raising his palm and slamming it down with force.
Although he was not purely a practitioner of the Sword Dao, he had cultivated it nevertheless. Now, facing this sword, he felt his heart of Sword Dao trembling, even feeling a sense of submission.
This was inconceivable.
"If I were a warrior who practiced only the Sword Dao, how would I defend against this sword?"
The Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter dared not imagine, if an Immortal Heavenly Venerable who cultivated the Sword Dao faced this strike, whether they would still be able to use their Sword Dao to resist?
"Sword God Xu Yan!"
At this moment, these four words emerged in his mind!
The god of the Sword Dao, truly deserving of the title!
He had to admit, Xu Yan had the qualifications to be called the Sword God!
As Xu Yan executed this strike, he only felt his divine essence crazily depleting, and the wondrous essence of the Wisdom Sword Realm was also being expended. Sword Intent surged forth unceasingly.
At a certain moment, he took a deep breath.
This strike was not going to hurt the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter.
However, beyond this strike, what he truly intended to manifest in the Mountain and River Myriad Manifestations was that majestic and saintly figure!
Right when the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter made his move, in the wake of Taicang Martial Artist's sword slash, the space behind him seemed to turn chaotic, and a hazy figure abruptly appeared.
What a majestic figure it was; even in its vague form, it still possessed a sacredness that made it unbearable to look at directly, as if it were a saint of the Martial Arts.
Boom!
In that instant, the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter felt his mind thunder and his body tremble, his Martial Artist's fighting spirit seemed to have vanished, giving rise to a heart filled with the urge to kneel in worship.
It was as if he stood before a saint of Martial Arts, before whom all would bow in homage!
"Impossible, what is this!"
"I am the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, how can I be affected, how can my will be shaken?"
The Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter roared within his heart, continuously running techniques to refine his Divine Soul, trying to shake off this saintly trance!
Hum!
Finally, his consciousness returned to clarity, snapping back from the saintly trance, only to face a piercing cold light that brought forth a bone-chilling coldness within his heart.
It was even a crisis of death!
In the critical moment, he uttered a low growl, his body twisted and he flew backwards obliquely, exerting all his strength to slap away the cold light!
Pfft!
His palm throbbed with intense pain!
A sword had pierced through his palm, and the blade did not stop there; a sharp pain followed in his shoulder.
Pfft!
Blood spurted out, but he narrowly avoided the lethal blow.
The Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter flew backward, his eyes filled with shock, seeing Xu Yan with a sword in hand, an expression of regret on his face, and his heart trembling, even feeling a sense of having survived a catastrophe.
So close!
He was just a fraction away from being slayed by Xu Yan's reversal strike!
Turning around, he fled in a frenzy, vanishing into the horizon in the blink of an eye. An Immortal Heavenly Venerable actually fled in complete disarray!
Xu Yan sighed. The power of the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter was a bit too strong; he hadn't managed to kill him!
The Mountain and River Myriad Manifestations manifested, and that majestic, saint-like figure emerged, affecting the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter's mind. Xu Yan had been waiting for this moment to decisively make his move!
However, that figure was ultimately too vague, the duration of its influence was limited, and the opponent quickly regained his senses. In a moment of peril, he dodged the deadly sword strike.
Nonetheless, the sword strike had injured the opponent!
"My power is still a little lacking. If that figure could be fully rendered, perhaps even the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, upon seeing it, would subconsciously kneel.
"Who exactly is this person? The influence they have on the Taicang Martial Artists is also a bit too great."
Xu Yan was curious in his heart.
"Even if you are an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, let's see if you can resolve my Imperishable Sword Intent. As long as you can't, sooner or later, we will know your true identity!"
Xu Yan sneered coldly.
Though the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter had escaped, a trace of Imperishable Sword Intent had also penetrated his body.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, a shadow that never dissipates, right? Sooner or later, I will annihilate you all."
Xu Yan coldly snorted in his heart.
"The expenditure was a bit too great. I need to find a place to recover and reflect on the gains of this battle."
After a moment of contemplation, Xu Yan decided to find a place to settle down and reflect.
Heading to the Duowu Cave was not something to be rushed.
The Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter returned to his own territory; acting as if nothing had happened, but his heart was heavy.
The sword wound was not a major issue, but that unknown sword force was the real cause of the weight in his heart. No matter what method he used, no secret technique was able to expunge this sword force or annihilate it completely.
He could only use the power of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable to wrap around and seal this sliver of Sword Dao power, and even he did not know whether he could keep it sealed indefinitely.
"What kind of Sword Dao power is this? This Xu Yan, he is too terrifying. Who among the Immortal Heavenly Venerables can kill him? Was it a mistake to target Xu Yan as an objective?"
At this moment, he felt that Tian Shiqi's targeting of Xu Yan might have been a mistake!

chapters.title: Chapter 809 - 424 Battle Hall, Fall Witch's Evil Eye
chapters.content:
"My lord, you summoned me?"
Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter nodded.
"Congratulations, my lord, for slaying Xu Yan and achieving a great feat in restoring the glory of the Domain!"
The newcomer said with great elation.
The corners of Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter's mouth under the mask twitched, feeling the pain intensifying in his palm and shoulder, and even the trace of Sword Dao inside his body seemed to become more unruly at the mention of Xu Yan.
"Xu Yan is not dead!"
"What?"
The newcomer looked shocked; how could Lord Heavenly Slaughter personally fail to kill Xu Yan?
After a moment's thought, he suddenly said, "My lord, did you capture Xu Yan alive? Are you planning to frame another power?"
That's right!
Lord Heavenly Slaughter did not kill Xu Yan; was it to pin the death on another faction?
"I did not capture Xu Yan."
"What?"
The newcomer was shocked again.
"My lord, has Xu Yan become so powerful that even you could not handle him when acting personally?"
Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter looked at him coldly and snorted, "What nonsense are you spouting? If I had taken action, young Xu Yan would be easily captured!"
"Then why?"
The other party was perplexed.
"After careful consideration, I felt that capturing and killing Xu Yan was too simple and not conducive to stirring up the storms in the Divine Realm. Thus, after much deliberation, I suddenly thought of a better method than personally striking to kill Xu Yan."
Upon hearing this, the newcomer heaved a sigh of relief. So that was it; he had been startled, thinking that even Lord Heavenly Slaughter could not deal with Xu Yan.
"My lord, what ingenious plan do you have?"
He wondered to himself, this Lord Heavenly Slaughter, always responsible for slaughter, wasn't adept at plotting or strategizing. How had he suddenly seen the light?
And could his plans really be reliable?
Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter's gaze held an air of deep calculation, as if concocting profound schemes with everything within his control.
"Kill Yan Ping and pin the blame on Meng Chong. At this moment, the Wanbao Alliance and Meng Chong are bitter enemies, their feud irreconcilable. No matter where Meng Chong goes, he will inevitably be hunted by the Wanbao Alliance.
"At the appropriate time, kill Meng Chong, and then the Wanbao Alliance won't be able to disassociate themselves from the act, facing retaliation from Meng Chong's powerful backers.
"Upon reflection, if Xu Yan were to meet the same fate, it would be even more valuable than if I were to kill him myself!"
The newcomer suddenly understood, but hesitated, "My lord, targeting Meng Chong by the Wanbao Alliance is one thing, but going after Xu Yan as well, could it be a bit…"
"Foolish!"
Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter glared at him, as if frustrated with his incompetence, "How can you be so foolish? Is the Wanbao Alliance the only major power in the Divine Realm?
"Is it only the Wanbao Alliance that spans all thirty realms?"
The newcomer twitched at the corner of his mouth, cursing inwardly at being scorned by someone who knew only of fighting and slaying!
"What do you imply, my lord?"
Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter's eyes gleamed as though he held all wisdom, "The Battle Hall! Assume that Xu Yan becomes an enemy of the Battle Hall. Hong Ting, a prodigy of the Battle Hall, is in Changyun Realm, and has gone to Duowu Cave to battle. Find the right opportunity, kill him, and blame Xu Yan!"
"My lord is brilliant!"
The newcomer realized his oversight and how he had forgotten about the Battle Hall.
But then he fretted, "My lord, Hong Ting is a prodigy of the Battle Hall with tremendous strength, not comparable to Yan Ping. To kill him, only the Immortal Heavenly Venerable could act; the True King Heavenly Venerable could not accomplish this. And if multiple people attack, it might easily expose the plan, failing to pin the blame on Xu Yan.
"Yet if the Immortal Heavenly Venerable were to act, it would also be easy to trace the kill back to him, similarly failing to frame Xu Yan."
Upon hearing this, Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter was momentarily taken aback. How had he overlooked this point?
"Hong Ting is going to Duowu Cave; that is the opportunity. If he is struck by the Fall Witch's Evil Eye, his strength will be greatly diminished, unable to be utilized, isn't that the chance we need?"
"My lord is wise; I will immediately make arrangements!"
Enlightened, the newcomer left excitedly to begin the preparations.
Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter exhaled. The fact that he had been defeated and forced to flee by Xu Yan could not be leaked; it would damage his dignity!
"Next, I should seclude myself and find a way to expel this trace of Sword Dao."
He thought to himself.
…
Inside Duowu Cave, a young man wielding twin axes, his body wreathed with Thunderbolt Spirit Light, appeared like a war general who had experienced many battles, his fighting spirit soaring high.
Phut!
The twin axes shrouded in lightning swiftly cleaved a red-haired, copper-eyed individual, whose cheeks were covered with red scales, in two!
Duowu!
The invader of this cave that he had killed was a Duowu, but not the immensely powerful one, rather one of the weaker ilk.
According to the limited information, these weaker Duowu were all offspring of that incomparably mighty one.
Hum!
All of a sudden, one Duowu began to glow, and eyes began to open across their forehead and torso, each releasing a strange light.
Fall Witch's Evil Eye!
Once struck by its gaze, one would become lethargic, enervated, and lose the will to fight.
"Hmph! Let's see if your Fall Witch's Evil Eye can shake my resolve to battle!"
The young man with twin axes snorted coldly, the thunderous spirit light on his body shining even brighter at this moment.
With the axes crossed in front of him, his fighting spirit unbowed, his roar seemed to carry the din of a thousand soldiers clashing.
The Will of Battle!
This was the Martial Arts of the Battle Hall, condensing the Will of Battle; the fiercer the fight, the stronger it became, rising spiritedly against adversity, and the stronger the foes, the more intense the will to fight, fearless of death!
The young man was none other than one of the Battle Hall's prodigies, Hong Ting, who possessed the Thunderbolt Spirit Body and had also condensed the Will of Battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 810 - 424 Battle Hall, Duowu Evil Eye_2
chapters.content:
This time, he came to the Changyun Realm to further hone his resolve from a hundred battles to lay the foundation for breaking into the Immortal Realm.
The Battle Hall, a unique force, spread over more than thirty Realms in the Divine Realm.
Famous for being warlike, they often lurked within the Heavenly Grottos of various realms, fighting valiantly, fearlessly facing death. The more perilous the place, the more likely it was to encounter someone from the Battle Hall.
They believed that by refining the resolve from a hundred battles in combat, once one had solidified this resolve, they become unwavering, advancing against adversities, with their combat power increasing explosively.
The strength of the Martial Artists from the Battle Hall was generally 30% stronger than other Martial Artists in the same realm.
Among the prodigies, when it came to combat, the Battle Hall's were more savage and braver, and the prodigies from other major forces would not easily spar with the Battle Hall's prodigies.
In the eyes of prodigies from other major forces, the Battle Hall's prodigies were all crazies!
Warlike crazies, who went all out in a fight as if they were insane, with an air of fighting to the death.
Once someone from the Battle Hall clashed with others, had a conflict, or even held a grudge, it was addressed directly and decisively with a battle to resolve the enmity.
A life-and-death battle, where losing meant the Battle Hall conceded inferiority and erased all enmities with a single stroke.
If the enemy lost, they naturally achieved their desire for revenge and resolved the conflict.
This direct and decisive method of resolving enmities might seem to make it easy to resolve disputes with the Battle Hall, but in reality, it was not. After all, Martial Artists from the Battle Hall were 30% stronger in the same realm.
And those who took action to resolve grudges were inevitably the best among the Battle Hall, and so far, no one had survived such a duel.
If someone was unconvinced and violated the rules of the duel, the Battle Hall would not be polite and would directly and forcefully crush them.
This straightforward style, decisive and combative like a madman, also meant that the major powers of the Divine Realm would not easily have conflicts with the Battle Hall.
And since the Battle Hall advocated for battle, they were all belligerent people, constantly waging wars in the Heavenly Grottos. As long as they were not provoked, they did not provoke others.
It was precisely because of this reason that when people from the Battle Hall appeared, the major powers welcomed them into the Heavenly Grottos, which could lessen the pressure of guarding them.
Even when a Heavenly Grotto was under a massive invasion and the situation was critical, they would seek help from the Battle Hall as a first response, and the Battle Hall's people never declined, rather they rushed to battle with high fighting spirit.
Numerous crises within the Heavenly Grottos had been quelled due to the reinforcements from the Battle Hall.
Hong Ting, being one of the prodigies of the Battle Hall who had battled through numerous Heavenly Grottos, had indeed earned considerable renown. His arrival in the Duowu Cave of Changyun Realm was naturally widespread news.
All major forces knew that Hong Ting had come here for his training.
Boom!
The Depraved Witchcraft Power's light of a hundred eyes shone upon him, but Hong Ting's fighting spirit surged, and he even roared out loud, wielding his twin axes aglow with lightning, resisting the irradiation of the light of a hundred eyes.
"Duowu indeed has some tricks up its sleeve!"
Hong Ting felt a chill in his heart as he faced a Duowu whose realm was comparable to his. The light of a hundred eyes seemed to instill a sense of laziness in his heart.
To know that with his strength, he was one of the top in his realm, especially the Battle Hall's resolve from a hundred battles, an extremely powerful form of purposeful combat technique.
Despite this, he still felt the terror of the light of a hundred eyes.
"This is a peculiar power that corrosively erodes the will and the inner thoughts of the Divine Soul!"
Hong Ting understood in his heart.
However, he was unconcerned and his fighting spirit grew even more intense, the fleeting thoughts of laziness already expelled.
"Come at me, death!"
He stepped forward, swinging his great axe, and in a flash of lightning, with a splat, he slew the Duowu.
"How could mere Depraved Witchcraft Power shake my resolve!"
Hong Ting's gaze was icy as he looked ahead at a dozen or so Duowu and strode forward to attack.
Boom!
Those dozen or so Duowu, wielding black tridents, cursed loudly as eyes opened on their chests and bellies, blasting out powerful light from a hundred eyes.
More than a dozen Duowu unleashed the light of a hundred eyes together.
"Roar!"
Hong Ting let out a roar, his eyes turning red at that moment, his fighting spirit soaring as he seemed to enter a state of battle frenzy.
"Die!"
He slashed with his twin axes, the ferocious might of the axes bearing down on the dozen or so Duowu.
Clang!
The dozen or so Duowu raised their tridents to defend, and a great battle erupted in an instant, with the light of a hundred eyes continuing to shine on Hong Ting, seeking to erode his will.
However, Hong Ting grew more ferocious and manic in battle, showing no signs of laziness or loss of fighting spirit, but rather entering a state of agitation.
"Truly deserving of being a Battle Hall prodigy, too powerful, they were able to withstand the Evil Eye's light!"
"Hong Ting's resolve from a hundred battles is so condensed, so pure, worthy of being one of the Immortal Realm aspirants of the Battle Hall!"
Inside the Heavenly Grotto, other Martial Artists exclaimed in admiration.
Because of Duowu's Evil Eye's light, none of these Martial Artists dared to face a Duowu alone; at the very least they teamed up in pairs.
But Hong Ting faced more than a dozen Duowu alone without falling behind.
"Would it provoke the avatar of the ancestor of Duowu?"
A Martial Artist voiced his concern.
"It shouldn't come to that."
Hong Ting's battle with the Duowu continued, filled with incessant roars and soaring fighting spirit, becoming increasingly wild in the fight. His frenzied demeanor made the Duowu facing him develop a sense of retreating.
This guy is a madman, too crazed, and capable of resisting the hundred eyes' light.
Splat!
Suddenly, as a Duowu began to harbor thoughts of retreat and attempted to step back, it exposed a moment of weakness. Hong Ting seized the opportunity and decapitated them with his axe!
This caused the remaining Duowu to grow frightened, defending and retreating simultaneously.

chapters.title: Chapter 811 - 424 Battle Hall, Fall Witch's Evil Eye_3
chapters.content:
Hong Ting ceased his pursuit after a while.
"Just as expected!"
His body was steaming with heat, and his skin was flushed red; he stood there full of fighting spirit, his disdainful gaze following the retreating Duowu.
"In the process of resisting the Fall Witch's Evil Eye, my martial intent was further refined, but it also drained a considerable amount of Divine Spirit Soul Force."
Hong Ting exhaled deeply, ready to leave the Heavenly Grotto to rest and recover.
Just then, a silhouette of a Duowu appeared.
This Duowu was different from the others; his hair was red, and his cheeks were smooth, lacking scales, indistinguishable from a normal person.
Hong Ting's heart tightened.
The other Martial Artists were also startled, hurriedly saying, "Brother Hong, retreat quickly!"
An avatar of the progenitor of Duowu!
Or rather, he might be the true Duowu itself.
"The Fall Witch's Evil Eye, all who see are slothful, without exception."
The Duowu watched Hong Ting with an indifferent gaze.
"The progenitor of Duowu's avatar? This incarnation of yours has not reached the Immortal Realm; you and I are merely in the same realm, what should I fear?"
Hong Ting's fighting spirit rose once again.
Even though it was the progenitor of Duowu's avatar, this incarnation was only at the level of True King Heavenly Venerable Realm, within the same realm as him. What was there to fear?
"Duowu is me, and I am Duowu. Whatever ancestor of Duowu you speak of is but your ignorance, nothing more. The rest are merely my Witch Marionettes, not even worthy to be called my descendants."
Hong Ting's heart tightened; were all those he had slain and defeated merely Witch Marionettes?
Could mere Witch Marionettes possess such strength?
"Fine, then let me, Hong Ting, experience for myself the Fall Witch's hundred evil glares!"
Hong Ting stood fearless, roaring lowly. At this moment, he was even more full of martial intent and more crazed than during the earlier battle.
"Kill! Kill! Kill!"
Hong Ting roared as he charged at the Duowu.
At that moment, a hundred eyes appeared on the Duowu's body, suddenly opening. As if with a hundred different visions and a hundred different expressions, each eye looked exceedingly strange.
There was no piercing light, only eerie eeriness.
"Kill!"
Hong Ting suddenly halted mid-charge, roaring furiously. However, to his alarm, he found his martial intent crumbling under the stare of the hundred eyes.
What was worse, the notion of sloth was growing stronger; as his fighting spirit crumbled, the idea of lying motionless on the ground, lazily doing nothing as the most content thing to do, was increasingly tempting.
"Not good!"
Hong Ting was horrified; he knew he could not withstand the hundred evil glares.
Before he could completely succumb to sloth, he was flung backward, retreating frantically.
The hundred eyes of the Duowu vanished, its gaze remaining indifferent without pursuing to kill. Instead, a slight smirk appeared on its lips, "There are many who have fallen under my hundred gazes; let's see if you can rise up again."
Turning around, it stepped away, its figure disappearing into the depths of the Heavenly Grotto.
And Hong Ting, with a face full of shock, felt his body growing weaker, the spirit nearly drained from him. Lying there, willing to do nothing, even the thought of being too lethargic to raise a hand in retaliation if attacked, became stronger and stronger!
"This hundred evil glares of the Duowu is too strange, too powerful!"
Hong Ting hurried away from the Heavenly Grotto, knowing he must find a way fast to counteract the Depraved Witchcraft Power.
At this moment, several figures flashed through his mind—once renowned prodigies, they had inexplicably become lazy, not cultivating or even bothering to defend themselves when attacked.
They had succumbed to laziness, their cultivation regressing until one day they died of sloth!
Hong Ting realized in a flash that they had been affected by the Fall Witch's hundred evil glares to become like this.
The thought of possibly ending up the same way filled his heart with fear.

chapters.title: Chapter 812 - 425: I, Xu Yan, Kill My Enemies Without Leaving Bodies Behind
chapters.content:
"As expected of the Battle Hall's proud talent, to actually retreat unscathed under the numerous evil gazes of the ancestor of Duowu!"
"Hong Ting's intent to battle must be extremely powerful to withstand the numerous evil gazes."
"It's likely related to Hong Ting's physique; I've heard he possesses a Thunderbolt Spirit Body."
The other Martial Artists in the Heavenly Grotto, watching Hong Ting retreating safely, couldn't help but gasp in amazement.
Among these Martial Artists, one person's gaze flickered, and his heart surreptitiously leaped with joy. Had the opportunity just presented itself?
"Lord Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter, could it be that you are as prescient as a god?"
Although Hong Ting retreated under the numerous evil gazes of Duowu, he must have been affected, his strength greatly reduced, making it the perfect time to strike.
Silently emerging from the Duowu Cave, he informed the already arranged assailants, finding an opportunity to take action.
...
Boom!
In a city within the Changyun Realm, a branch of the Wanbao Alliance suddenly collapsed.
Like a Heavenly God, he slashed down with his blade, creating storms and thunders, instantly splitting open the treasury, and with a wave of his hand, he swept clean the storeroom.
The many Martial Artists simply stood there, mouths agape.
Ferocious, too fierce! Who was this formidable figure that had directly looted a branch of the Wanbao Alliance?
"Meng Chong, you're looking for death!"
An angry roar echoed across the sky.
Only then did the Martial Artists come to a realization—it was Meng Chong, the formidable figure wanted by the Wanbao Alliance, known as a Heavenly God!
No wonder he was so fierce.
"I'm just short of a few treasures on hand, is it too much to ask you, Wanbao Alliance, to make up the difference?"
Meng Chong sneered coldly, his figure soaring into the sky, instantly vanishing into the distance.
"Where do you think you're going!"
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Wanbao Alliance, seeing a branch now reduced to ruins, had bloodshot eyes.
As an Immortal Heavenly Venerable responsible for pursuing and killing Meng Chong, not only had he failed to execute the man, but the latter had found an opportunity to destroy a branch, a humiliation beyond words. Where was the dignity of a mighty Immortal Heavenly Venerable?
"We'll see if you can catch up first," replied Meng Chong with scorn.
His figure suddenly sped up and in a mere instant, vanished from the sight of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
He changed his appearance, donned a wig, and from a robust tough man, he transformed into a slender tall youth.
Meng Chong was already exceedingly skilled at this.
He even changed his aura, sauntering confidently into a city, beginning to surveil the Wanbao Alliance Branch.
Since a feud had already been established, there was no need for courtesy. He was ready to execute a big score and then leave the Changyun Realm to continue his journey through the Divine Realm.
Amassing enough treasures, building up his foundation, and then transforming upon breaking through.
"Huh."
Suddenly, Meng Chong overheard a group of Martial Artists discussing.
"Hong Ting of Battle Hall is dead, killed by someone named Xu Yan."
"I've heard that too. Hong Ting, after being exposed to the numerous evil gazes in the Duowu Cave, his strength greatly reduced, was killed by Xu Yan seizing the opportunity."
"The man has some nerve to strike at the pride of the Battle Hall—remember, Hong Ting was one of the prospective seeds of the Immortal Realm in the Battle Hall and was highly valued."
"Not only that, but it is said that Hong Ting's father is one of the top Immortal Heavenly Venerables in the Battle Hall."
Hearing these discussions, Meng Chong's brows rose.
"If my senior brother were to kill someone, he would not take advantage of others' weaknesses. Moreover, senior brother never provokes others without cause. It seems then, this is another case of a frame-up by the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow."
Meng Chong's expression darkened. The Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow truly was a persistent haunt, elusive and secretly entrenched, making uprooting them no easy task.
"Battle Hall has sent a challenge, asking Xu Yan to proceed to the Duowu Cave for a battle to the death to settle the grudge."
"This really is typical of the Battle Hall."
"Heh, it's said that this time, one of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Battle Hall will make a move. Xu Yan is done for."
"Hmm, doesn't the Battle Hall always advocate fair fights in equal realms? Why is there an exception this time?"
"You don't understand. Hong Ting had a special status as a seed of the Immortal Realm. It is rumored that as long as Xu Yan can withstand ten moves from the Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Battle Hall, the grudge will be considered settled."
"That's an Immortal Heavenly Venerable from the Battle Hall. You should comprehend now; Xu Yan, unable to even withstand a single move, is undoubtedly doomed!"
"What if Xu Yan doesn't accept the challenge?"
"Heh, if he doesn't, it would be even worse. Battle Hall will then disregard protocols, and you know what happened to someone who once cowered from a challenge and didn't accept the battle; you must've heard of the outcome."
Listening to the Martial Artists' discussions, Meng Chong frowned. It seemed the Battle Hall was extremely powerful, perhaps even more so than the Wanbao Alliance?
Furthermore, Hong Ting was a candidate of the Immortal Realm in the Battle Hall, and his father was even a top Immortal Heavenly Venerable within the Battle Hall. How could the Battle Hall let this end easily?
"Time to contact my senior brother. How should we deal with this matter from the Battle Hall?"
Meng Chong took out his Communication Talisman to send a message to his senior brother.
"The Battle Hall, Hong Ting?"
Xu Yan, who had just emerged from seclusion, was preparing to head to the Duowu Cave when he saw Meng Chong's message and couldn't help being surprised.
"Junior brother, don't worry about it, it's a minor issue. To impersonate me and kill someone isn't so easy. Since the Battle Hall wants to challenge me to a battle, then let's have a good fight.
"As soon as I make a move, they will naturally realize that it wasn't me who killed the man. If they continue to press the matter despite knowing this, then they can't blame me for not showing mercy."
Xu Yan wasn't concerned about it.
The Battle Hall might be strong, but so what?
After concluding the communication with Meng Chong, Xu Yan continued towards the Duowu Cave, the place where members of the Battle Hall had arranged for the duel, also situated outside the Duowu Cave.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, persistently haunting... in that case, let's have a showdown then," Xu Yan said with a chill in his gaze.
To counter the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, the first step was to find the people from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, to control them using the "Destiny of the Heavenly Intent," and thereby progressively expand his influence within the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.

chapters.title: Chapter 813 - 425: I, Xu Yan, Kill My Enemies Without Leaving Bodies Behind - Part 2
chapters.content:
Just as in the Nine Mountain Realm's Dahai Mountain, the sect of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow was ultimately annihilated.
"Let's see what tricks your Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow has."
Xu Yan pondered for a moment. If this trip went smoothly, the Battle Hall should also take action against Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow. If the Battle Hall insisted it was him who killed their people, then he would have to resort to certain means.
"I hope the Duowu Cave does not disappoint me, and the Seductive Witch must remember to come find me!"
Xu Yan's face showed eager anticipation.
Outside the Duowu Cave, the martial artists looking towards the people of Battle Hall were extremely surprised.
Hong Ting was actually killed by someone!
The perpetrator was a prodigy named Xu Yan.
Did he take advantage of Hong Ting's vulnerability and kill him, confident in his own powerful background and unworried about Battle Hall's retaliation?
Outside the Duowu Cave, several men stood proudly, their bodies emanating a blazing fighting intent.
One of them, holding a Wolf Fang Club in his hand, his fighting spirit soaring into the sky, turned the surrounding domain into a battlefield full of lofty battle intent.
An Immortal Heavenly Venerable from Battle Hall, and not one at the early stage of the Immortal Realm.
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable stationed at Duowu Cave was now conspicuously absent, fearing being misunderstood as involved in Hong Ting's death.
"One more day. If Xu Yan does not show up, it means he has no intention of resolving this feud; then don't blame me, Battle Hall, for bullying with power," Luo Zhan said coldly.
He exuded a burgeoning aura, the Wolf Fang Club in his hand radiating a sharpness from every spike.
"Who is Xu Yan, which prodigy from which domain?"
"Never heard of him; probably not a prodigy from Changyun Realm. Maybe he's already left Changyun Realm."
"I have heard a bit about him. Xu Yan is known as the Sword God, revered alone in the world of swordsmanship!"
"Ridiculous! There are countless powerful sword practitioners, and he dares to call himself Sword God? Revered alone in the world of swordsmanship? Incredibly arrogant! In my entire life, having cultivated the Sword Dao for countless years, I would never dare to claim supremacy in swordsmanship within my realm!"
The surrounding martial artists discussed animatedly, and some information about Xu Yan also began to spread.
For instance, claims like being known as the Sword God, revered alone in the world of swordsmanship, and the like.
Without a doubt, behind these tales, was the influence of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
"Xu Yan's swordsmanship is extremely strong. It is said that Hong Ting was slain by his sword through the throat, dying on the spot!"
"He simply took advantage of someone's weakness. If Hong Ting hadn't been in Duowu Cave, exposed to the Depraved Witchcraft Power of the Hundred Eyed Glare which greatly diminished his strength, he wouldn't have been killed by him."
"Well said. Hong Ting was a prodigy from Battle Hall, refined with the battle intent of a hundred battles. Even if unmatched in his realm, he definitely wouldn't have been killed with a sword through the throat. If he decided to flee, he would have undoubtedly escaped with his life."
Time passed amid the lively discussion of the martial artists.
"The final hour!"
Luo Zhan's expression was dark and grim, and the martial artists of Battle Hall by his side were also surging with killing intent.
Whoosh!
A young man with a sword in hand descended, his appearance handsome, his gaze indifferent.
"Are you looking for me?"
Xu Yan's eyes landed on Luo Zhan, and he couldn't help but be astonished. This Immortal Heavenly Venerable of Battle Hall was a bit stronger than the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter.
Moreover, the opponent's body carried a lofty fighting spirit, as if he had just returned from a great battle on the battlefield.
"You are Xu Yan?"
Luo Zhan's gaze was icy as he looked over.
"Sword God Xu Yan, that's me," Xu Yan nodded.
"Good, it was you who killed Hong Ting, right?" Luo Zhan said, holding the Wolf Fang Club with a lofty fighting intent.
"No!"
Xu Yan shook his head.
"Denying your actions? Kid, do you really think you can bully my Battle Hall?" Luo Zhan shouted angrily.
"Was there a body left from Hong Ting's death?" Xu Yan asked.
"What, you want to argue that the wounds on the body prove you had nothing to do with it?" Luo Zhan scoffed.
"Of course not. I'm just telling you, and everyone present, that if I, Xu Yan, take action, then it's against an enemy. I adhere to one principle when dealing with enemies: annihilate them completely, never leaving behind a corpse to pollute the environment."
Xu Yan said solemnly.
Everyone: ...
Luo Zhan was somewhat bewildered. Is that your defense?
"Ridiculous!"
Luo Zhan was furious, "With just a few words, you think you can clear your name?"
Xu Yan spoke indifferently, "Then make your move. As an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, you will naturally know if I killed the person or not!"
"Fine!"
Luo Zhan didn't waste any words. With a booming sound, the Wolf Fang Club was instantly raised and smashed down with force.
This strike brought together the Domain Power, like a fierce and ferocious giant wolf with chilling fangs, fiercely bombarding Xu Yan.
Hum!
A black sword light slashed out.
Xu Yan raised his hand and struck with a sword, the Divine Skill, Supreme Heavenly Sword!
The Sword Intent capable of exterminating everything instantaneously emerged between the heavens and the earth, causing all the watching Martial Artists to retreat in shock.
Spurt!
That sword cleaved the ferocious wolf's head in two, shaking even Luo Zhan's control of the Domain Power.
At that moment, everyone was stunned as they watched the young man in the center.
Although Luo Zhan's strike wasn't his full strength, it was still a strike from an ordinary Immortal Heavenly Venerable. Yet Xu Yan, who was not an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, managed to extinguish it with a single sword?
Any True King Heavenly Venerable would have no power to resist such a strike from Luo Zhan, let alone destroy it.
After unleashing the strike, Xu Yan looked towards Luo Zhan and asked indifferently, "Well? Can your pride parry my sword strike? Does the sword wound on the corpse bear any resemblance to my sword?"
Luo Zhan focused his gaze, his heart pounding with shock. Xu Yan's sword strike, even at the peak of Hong Ting's power, couldn't be withstood, and there was no need to take advantage of Hong Ting when he was vulnerable.
Besides, the wound on Hong Ting's body, that sword mark, was too different from Xu Yan's Sword Dao.
He was an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, not a weakling, and he naturally understood the difference between the two.
Taking a deep breath, he said in a deep voice, "Indeed, the person wasn't killed by you!"
All the Martial Artists were astonished, completely shocked. Could it be that someone framed Xu Yan, seeking to instigate a conflict with the Battle Hall?
Xu Yan nodded and then said, "Blaming me and stirring up conflict with your Battle Hall, there's only one force that would do this."
"Which force?"
Luo Zhan's fury was uncontrollable. The Battle Hall had almost been manipulated, and his heart was filled with murderous intent.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow!"
Xu Yan pronounced every word distinctly.
He fixed his gaze on Luo Zhan, wanting to see if this powerful warrior of the Battle Hall had heard of the force known as Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
Luo Zhan's expression changed, then he furiously said, "Good, good, good. These cowardly figures of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow dare to reach their hands into my Battle Hall, thinking we can't find them?"
To Xu Yan's surprise, he said, "You actually know about Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow? Then that makes things easier. These skulking cowards have been haunting me persistently. This time they framed me, and it certainly won't be the last.
"I've been wanting to find these guys. Since we both have a grudge, why not join forces?"
After pondering for a moment, recalling Xu Yan's sword strike, Luo Zhan nodded, "Alright, this isn't the place to talk."
Not far from Duowu Cave, Xu Yan was surprised to find Hong Ting in a temporarily constructed hut—the rumored Battle Hall prodigy who had been fatally struck by a sword.
"Hong Ting used a secret technique to feign death and escape disaster, but he was severely injured and has been unconscious ever since," Luo Zhan said gravely.
Xu Yan began to understand; Luo Zhan brought him here also to verify once more whether he was indeed the culprit or not.
At this moment, Xu Yan pondered, sighing internally that his master's teachings were indeed profound truths.
To kill an enemy, one must utterly obliterate him, leaving no chance for escape!
Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow probably hadn't anticipated that Hong Ting would have such a secret technique to escape death, which was also related to the need to leave a body behind to frame him.
"The reason he remains unconscious is mainly due to the erosion of a strange force, making him lethargic and unwilling to wake..."
Xu Yan was astonished and asked, "Could this be Depraved Witchcraft Power?"
Luo Zhan was secretly shocked, the other party had seen through the cause at a glance, and the strength of his Sword Dao exceeded his expectations; Xu Yan's mentor must be extremely powerful.
"That's right!"
Luo Zhan nodded.
Xu Yan pondered briefly and produced a Pill, saying, "I can wake him up, but I can't do anything about his injuries."
Seeing the Depraved Witchcraft Power in Hong Ting's body, Xu Yan became inwardly alert. He took this strange power very seriously; once it infiltrated the body, it would be extremely troublesome.
This was a bizarre force that directly eroded the will, causing people to become corrupted and lazy.

chapters.title: Chapter 814 - 814: 426
chapters.content:
"Can he really be awakened?"
Luo Zhan was instantly overjoyed upon hearing this.
That sword wound had indeed dealt a heavy blow to Hong Ting, but the most troublesome issue was his unending slumber, coupled with the eroding effect of the Depraved Witchcraft Power within him.
As long as the Depraved Witchcraft Power could not be expunged, Hong Ting would never recover and was practically crippled.
"Waking him up is not a big problem, but curing him will be difficult."
Xu Yan tossed a pill to Luo Zhan and said, "This is a pill. Once it enters his body, he will wake up soon."
Luo Zhan, holding the pill in his hand, was incredibly surprised; with his keen spiritual sense, he naturally knew the pill was extraordinary.
Waving his hand, he infused the pill into Hong Ting's body. Since Xu Yan was here, the medicine was certainly not poisonous, otherwise, it would be a suicidal act.
Not long after the pill entered Hong Ting's body, accompanied by a few groans of pain, Hong Ting slowly opened his eyes.
Even his moans conveyed a sense of laziness.
"Uncle Luo!"
Hong Ting, upon seeing Luo Zhan, spoke weakly as if even calling out a name was too much effort.
"How do you feel?"
Luo Zhan was extremely delighted.
"Not very clear, I just don't want to move, don't want to think about anything..."
Hong Ting appeared listless.
Luo Zhan's expression changed again and again; his heart felt heavy since Hong Ting seemed to have been rendered useless.
Just like certain prodigies eroded by the Depraved Witchcraft Power, from now on, they would sink into despair and slowly die in their laziness.
"It was this young brother who woke you up."
Luo Zhan turned to Xu Yan and said solemnly.
"Thank you, brother!"
Hong Ting seemed to want to raise his hand but was too lazy to do so and murmured his thanks instead.
Xu Yan nodded slightly, a bit shocked in his heart. The Depraved Witchcraft Power was even more terrifying than he had anticipated.
The prodigies of the Battle Hall would surely have cultivated a battling spirit, their will tough and powerful, yet they were eroded to such a state. Ordinary martial artists would find it even harder to resist.
Seeing this, Luo Zhan understood that Xu Yan was not the killer but was indeed framed by someone else.
He took out a token and handed it to Xu Yan, saying, "Young Brother Xu, this is a Battle Token. As long as there is a place of the Battle Hall, you can use this token to seek the help of the Battle Hall, whether it's for urgently needed treasures, sheltering friends, obtaining information, and so on."
"In that case, thank you!"
Xu Yan accepted the token.
The Battle Hall's influence was extensive, and in terms of sheer power, it was even stronger than the Wanbao Alliance. Since he would be traveling in the Divine Realm, he would inevitably need their help.
After pondering for a moment, he spoke, "The injury of Brother Hong Ting can be treated by my junior sister. She should be able to cure it."
Hong Ting's injury was somewhat special. Su Lingxiu would probably be very interested, and since Luo Zhan had taken the initiative to make amends, Xu Yan decided to show him a path.
"Where is your junior sister?"
Even though Luo Zhan felt that the chances were slim, he still wanted to try his best, if only for a visit.
"My junior sister Su Lingxiu is in the Qinghua state of Da Yue Country. You can take Brother Hong Ting there for treatment and say that I directed you."
He paused, then added, "That pill was refined by my junior sister."
Upon hearing this, Luo Zhan's spirits lifted, and he saw the hope for curing Hong Ting.
"Thank you, Brother Xu!"
"It's a small matter, but regarding Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow..."
"Those despicable cowards, daring to commit such shameless deeds, will not stop here..."
Luo Zhan said, seething with anger.
Afterward, the two of them discussed how to deal with Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's actions.
...
In Baimu City, within a secret chamber.
"Foolish! What kind of dim-witted strategy was that, provoking the Battle Hall at this time? The timing was not right!"
"Master, it was an order from Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter."
"To kill Xu Yan cleanly and directly would have been much simpler. Such elaborate schemes are now exposed and, with the Battle Hall sure to retaliate, it is utterly stupid!
"According to Lord Tian Shiqi's plan, the Battle Hall was to be dealt with later, like adding the final blaze to the great chaos. Now that the Battle Hall is on alert, there will undoubtedly be complications!"
After cursing in anger, he asked in a deep voice, "Where is Eight-leaf?"
"Lord Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter has gone into seclusion, saying he has sensed the opportunity for a breakthrough and will not be emerging any time soon..."
"Send a message to Lord Tian Shiqi to send another powerful fighter to kill Xu Yan!"
"Yes!"
"Damn it, we, Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, have been exposed too early!"
The house master cursed incessantly.
Due to the incident with Hong Ting, the name Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow began to spread widely in Changyun Realm, with many martial artists speculating about this force that dared to challenge the Battle Hall.
And the Battle Hall had begun its retaliation against Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
...
The turmoil in Nine Mountain Realm did not subside with the departure of Xu Yan and Meng Chong, but instead showed signs of escalating.
Thousand Layered Mountain and Horizontal Peak Mountain were secretly discussing actions against the Wan Family.
And the Wan Family, too, had to start forming alliances with other powers to avoid being targeted collectively, with the Spiritual Sovereign Gate being their first choice.
As the chaos in Nine Mountain Realm persisted, the Heavenly Grotto occasionally trembled, and another Xuezhi emerged from it.
Joining forces with the Xuezhi at the Realm Gate, they audaciously attempted to cross the Realm Gate and enter the Qinghua state.
However, during the attempt to traverse the Realm Gate, they were intercepted by the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Qinghua state and thus failed.
In the Qinghua state, thanks to the tranquility of the Heavenly Grotto, the Immortal Heavenly Venerables could devote more time to setting up the Great Formation.
Fang Hao was extremely busy preparing for the Great Formation of Qinghua state, and to prevent the turmoil in Nine Mountain Realm from affecting Qinghua state, and moreover, to block the spread of messages from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, they controlled the dissemination of information from Qinghua state.

chapters.title: Chapter 815 - 815: 426
chapters.content:
Immediately, a great formation was arranged around the realm gate, sealing it off, and even an Immortal Heavenly Venerable would find it difficult to break through this formation with brute force.
With the formation in place, and guarded by an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, along with many True Kings and Heavenly Venerables, the safety of the realm gate was assured.
Beyond the realm gate, one could also traverse the wilderness, although it carried certain dangers and required more time.
But since the great formation needed to be set up, to extricate Qinghua state from the chaos in the Divine Realm, it was necessary to seal off the paths leading into the wilds.
Therefore, under the orders of the three major powers of Da Yue Country, numerous Martial Artists of the Condensation Law Realm and True Kings from the Truth Refinement Realm began to construct small frontier cities at set distances along the edge of the wilds.
With the formidable strength of Martial Artists, building cities was naturally simple and quick, especially with the entire Qinghua state mobilized for the effort.
