The frontier cities were interconnected by formations, and anyone crossing them would trigger an alarm, drawing the exploration of patrolling individuals.
While it was temporarily impossible to completely block the routes across the wilds, at the very least, it was possible to learn if anyone had traversed them.
In such a case, those who crossed the wilds must invariably be Martial Artists of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
Fang Hao then selected suitable sites on the territories of the three powers to set up another great formation that drew in spiritual energy and the Domain Lingji, allowing one to cultivate within the area covered by the formation, gaining more than ten days' worth of normal cultivation in a single day.
Those who wished to cultivate in the area covered by the formation had to earn merit points, which could be exchanged for entry.
The area covered by the formation was called Spirit City.
To enter Spirit City, one needed to earn merit, and naturally, countless Martial Artists participated in the great construction of Qinghua state to earn these merits.
Especially the lower-ranking Martial Artists, for whom this was the best way to earn cultivation resources.
By this time, the three major forces of Qinghua state should have discussed unifying as one, twisting the entire state into a single united front.
Emperor Da Yue, Master of Tianwu Sect, and Sect Master of Myriad Thunder Sect, as the three supreme experts representing the three powers, just needed to come to an agreement; any opposing voices were negligible.
Moreover, there were hardly any voices of opposition. As long as the benefits were distributed well, there would be no problems.
Anyone with sense knew that Qinghua state was about to undergo a tremendous transformation, and seizing this opportunity was sure to catapult one to great heights.
As the first Martial Artist who consumed a pill and broke through the long-standing bottleneck to step into the Immortal Realm appeared, the esteemed and renowned powers of Qinghua state understood that the unification of Qinghua state was inevitable.
In the future, there would be no three major powers in Qinghua state, but the entire state would fall under a single power!
The unification of Qinghua state would not be possible without the key figures Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu, and with Su Lingxiu busy setting up the Heavenly Grotto as the Domain Divine Furnace, she had no interest in these matters, meaning the key figure was solely Fang Hao.
After repeated discussions and considerations, it was finally decided.
Qinghua Sect now appeared to the world!
The three major powers were each allotted Myriad Thunder State, Tianwu State, and Da Yue State under Qinghua Sect.
Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu were the founders of Qinghua Sect, with Emperor Da Yue, Master of Tianwu Sect, and Sect Master of Myriad Thunder Sect, serving as the three founding elders of Qinghua Sect.
With the establishment of Qinghua Sect, it oversaw branches in Artifact Refining, Formation, and Alchemy among other Martial Art disciplines, with Fang Hao as the Sect Master of Qinghua Sect.
Su Lingxiu was the Pavilion Master of the Evergreen Pavilion of Qinghua Sect, her position transcendent, above the elders, equal to Fang Hao.
Of course, to some extent, as the senior sister, Su Lingxiu's status was actually above Fang Hao's.
With the establishment of Qinghua Sect, the next step was to construct a Spirit City for the sect.
Qinghua Spirit City expansion commenced from the foundations of the Capital City of Da Yue Country, including the Da Yue Abyss within its scope.
The sect residences of Tianwu Sect and Myriad Thunder Sect were also constructing Spirit Cities, albeit on a smaller scale than Qinghua Sect's, but within Qinghua state, they were still regarded as Martial Art Holy Lands.
As Qinghua Sect was established, it immediately began the extensive recruitment of geniuses, including those talented in Formation, Artifact Refining, and Alchemy.
And with the establishment of Qinghua Sect, Divine Skills were also imparted to the Immortal Heavenly Venerables; whether they could cultivate it depended on their own talents.
At this time, Feng Yan became quite proud.
After all, he had cultivated a Divine Skill, and so, even the likes of Emperor Da Yue had no choice but to seek teachings without pretension.
As for consulting with Li Xuan, the noble expert, they did not have the courage to do so, for disturbing the serenity of such a personage was not a desirable affair.
The Martial Arts Realm of Qinghua state was undergoing earth-shaking changes, with many prodigies eager to join Qinghua Sect.
And the other families and smaller sects naturally became subordinate powers to Qinghua Sect, each assigned their own tasks.
In a certain area of Qinghua state, a great formation was laid out, and the techniques for planting Divine Medicine were also passed down by Su Lingxiu.
A group of disciples from the Evergreen Pavilion began to cultivate spirit fields under Yue'er's guidance, planting Spiritual Medicine and Divine Medicine.
Fang Hao, for the sake of Qinghua Sect, was indeed tirelessly busy, with even Moon Changming and Cai Ling'er being roped in to help.
Even the less powerful Meng Shushu and Shi'er were pulled in by him.
To establish the Sword Dao within Qinghua Sect, naturally, the eldest senior brother was the authoritative figure in the Sword Dao, and Fang Hao had Xu Yan send over the introductory and foundational cultivation techniques of the Sword Dao.
For instance, cultivating Sword Momentum, then perceiving Sword Intent, and eventually achieving Sword Heart Clarity.
The complete systematic structure of the Sword Dao was truly beginning to spread within Qinghua Sect at this moment.
Fang Hao then had Meng Chong send over more comprehensive physical cultivation methods, as well as the way of the blade.
"Third Senior Sister..."
"Go find Yue'er."
Looking at the third senior sister, who was fiddling with the Domain Divine Furnace in the Heavenly Grotto, Fang Hao left helplessly. The third senior sister was indeed too lazy! As one of the founders of Qinghua Sect and the Pavilion Master of Evergreen Pavilion, she ended up doing nothing, leaving everything to Yue'er, Zhou Ying, and others.
With the establishment of Qinghua Sect, Fang Hao was filled with ambition, vowing to make Qinghua Sect the strongest sect in the world.
He then sought out the prodigies from the Spiritual Realm, who were already acquainted with each other, making them easier to utilize. Moreover, their talents were not lacking, warranting focused cultivation.
"Someone has crossed the wilderness?"
"Reporting to Sect Master, indeed someone has crossed the wilderness, triggering the formation alert, and the individual has already perished."
"Didn't we just have two breakthroughs into the Immortal Realm recently? Send them to patrol the wilderness borders. Anyone who crosses the wilderness should be captured and brought back. Those who perish must be from the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow."
"Yes, Sect Master!"
Fang Hao's eyes turned cold. The Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow truly hid deeply, and he had a major grudge against them.
"Senior Sister, refine a few more pills. We're still a bit short on the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, and we don't have enough hands!"
Fang Hao, going to Su Lingxiu with a look of troubled concern, said.
"Fourth Junior Brother, these pills are not so easy to refine. Once I finish arranging the Domain Divine Furnace, I can try to refine them," Su Lingxiu said after pondering for a moment.
"Senior Sister, how long will it take? Do you need more people to help?"
"In three days, we can begin to try to refine them," Su Lingxiu thought and answered.
The Da Yue Abyss was vast, turning the whole grotto into the Domain Divine Furnace was not yet possible, but a part of it could already be used.
"Great!"
Fang Hao was overjoyed.
Three days later, Su Lingxiu excitedly began preparations for alchemy.
This time, she was not using Divine Skills to operate the Domain Divine Furnace but using the Heavenly Grotto as a Pill Furnace, performing the Domain Divine Furnace alchemy to refine the pills.
Moreover, the Heavenly Grotto was extremely special, being a hole of Heaven and Earth. The boundary of the Heavenly Grotto was surrounded by the Laws of Domain, which could more easily draw on the Power of Domain Laws to condense into pills.
What Su Lingxiu valued even more was the desire to draw upon the breath beyond the Domain and even some of the Laws of the Netherworld to refine the pills.
"It's starting!"
Su Lingxiu stood on one side of the Heavenly Grotto, raising her hand as a stream of Domain Spirit Flame flew out, landing in the arranged Domain Divine Furnace.
Emperor Da Yue and others also watched with great excitement, as the success would mean no lack of pills.
The pills that assisted in breakthroughs to the Immortal Realm could also be produced in greater quantities.
All over Qinghua Realm, there were many large and small Heavenly Grottos. If they were all turned into Domain Divine Furnaces, there would simply be too many pills to consume.
The peculiar property of the Heavenly Grotto lay within, inherently spawning Divine and Spiritual Medicines, as well as various cultivation resources.
There was no need to worry about a shortage of alchemy materials within a thousand years, and in a hundred years, various Divine and Spiritual Medicines would be cultivated, able to provide a continuous supply, maintaining a balance.
With the strength of Qinghua Sect rising, they could also take advantage of the turmoil in the Divine Realm to expand, right?
Moreover, one could directly condense pills using the Power of Domain Laws, so there would never be a shortage of pills regardless.

chapters.title: Chapter 816 - 427: Breakthrough to the Domain Realm, Master of the Taicang Domain?
chapters.content:
Unlike his busy disciples, Li Xuan remained at ease, undisturbed by anyone, and his disciples would not ask for his assistance.
Li Xuan was gratified by this; his disciples had grown sensible, knowing to show filial piety to their master by not overworking him.
"The Qinghua Sect isn't bad either, eventually having a sect inheritance in place."
No matter what, Fang Hao had established a sect, and as this sect grew stronger, he too would reap some benefits.
Gradually, it would be time to impart the Great Wilderness Martial Arts within the Qinghua Sect, and then, there would be two systems within the sect: the Great Wilderness Martial Arts and the Taicang Martial Arts.
And as time passed, the Taicang Martial Arts would eventually enter history, with only practitioners of the Great Wilderness Martial Arts remaining in the Qinghua Sect.
As the progenitor of the Great Wilderness Martial Arts, the more people practiced it and the stronger they became, the more benefits he would gain.
"The Inner Domain has become stronger... oh, it should be called the Great Wilderness now; it won't be long before there are no more practitioners of Taicang Martial Arts in the Great Wilderness."
From the feedback of the Great Wilderness Physiognomy, Li Xuan could clearly feel the overall strength of the Great Wilderness increasing.
"The Spiritual Realm is now sandwiched between the Great Wilderness and the Qinghua Sect; it, too, should become the land of the Great Wilderness."
Li Xuan pondered for a moment.
However, these matters didn't require his concern; Fang Hao, the Sect Master of Qinghua, would naturally know what to do.
Moreover, it was not something that could be accomplished in a short time; it could only be worn down by time.
The limit of martial arts in the Spiritual Realm was, after all, quite high, and only those who were just beginning their martial arts journey could practice the Great Wilderness Martial Arts.
After all, starting from scratch and cultivating the Great Wilderness Martial Arts step by step was different from transitioning in the middle of one's cultivation.
Those who converted halfway would never have a solid foundation.
After all, prodigies are the minority, and among the countless martial artists who switch martial arts paths and still have a solid foundation, they are just few and far between.
"This girl has finally started to be diligent."
Li Xuan glanced at the location of the Da Yue Abyss where Su Lingxiu was refining pills and couldn't help but feel enormously relieved.
"The Heavenly Grottos of the Qinghua state have all been transformed into Domain Divine Furnaces, each one presided over by a master of alchemy...
"Tsk, it's no wonder the Qinghua Sect is becoming strong."
Of course, the emergence of alchemy masters was still far off; it required time for training and accumulation.
However, with the aid of pills, the cultivation of Qinghua Sect disciples would surely advance by leaps and bounds, far surpassing other sects.
As time passed, the Qinghua Sect would become stronger and stronger, with a more profound foundation.
Even if the techniques of formations, artifact refining, and alchemy were to leak out, they could still not compare to the Qinghua Sect.
"The Book of Taicang is almost completely memorized; the Divine Realm is becoming increasingly tumultuous."
Li Xuan looked up at the expanse of the sky and couldn't help but sigh deeply.
"Unity of Domain..."
He muttered to himself, looking up at the firmament thoughtfully.
"Let's see how Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow drives the Unity of Domain."
His attention returned to the Book of Taicang, "The law above the Domain Realm has already been written; I wonder when Xu Yan will be able to comprehend the Domain Martial Arts Law."
Once entering the Domain Realm and understanding the Domain Origin and Dao Principles within the Taicang Domain, even if his enemies are stronger than him, they can't do anything to him.
Unless, of course, the adversary is powerful enough to destroy the Taicang Domain in a short period.
Li Xuan even doubted whether such a fearsome being existed, and whether even the owner of the Book of Taicang could accomplish such a feat remained unknown.
After all, recording the Domain Dao Rule, depicting Domain Dao Rule and Domain Origin, and destroying the entire Domain are entirely different concepts.
Even if it could be done, it is not through sheer power but through an understanding of the Domain, cleverly unraveling the entire Domain.
"Soon, after entirely memorizing the overview of the Book of Taicang, I'll take a trip to the Wu Country Royal Palace to see what kind of existence that one is, and what connection they have with the owner of the Book of Taicang."
Li Xuan was filled with anticipation.
"This girl managed her first pill refining in the Heavenly Grotto without any issues; now, the Qinghua Sect will not lack for pills, there must be tens of thousands in this batch alone."
Li Xuan looked up to see that Su Lingxiu had successfully completed her alchemy.
"Your disciple Su Lingxiu, using the Heavenly Grotto as a furnace to refine pills, has earned you the Pill Furnace Domain Cauldron."
The Daoist Golden Book opened, golden light surged forth, and an ancient, primitive-looking cauldron with an aura of antiquity and wildness emerged above the Spirit Pedestal.
Domain Cauldron!
"What a treasure!"
Li Xuan was overjoyed.
This Domain Cauldron could even refine the Domain itself into pills.
"With the Qimen Armory, Extreme Path Soul Soldier, and now the addition of the Domain Cauldron, the number of supreme treasures in my possession has grown; it's just that I lack a sword and a blade."
Li Xuan pondered briefly; obtaining a sword and blade might not be easy, but it was not a big deal, as the sword Dao and blade path he had created did not need a specific sword or blade.
As long as his Realm increased, he could directly turn the Domain into a sword if he wished.
"Using the Dao Principles as a sword is also possible."
Li Xuan mumbled to himself.
"Only the last two Dao Principles remain; these are the core of the entire compendium of Dao Principles, and once these two are memorized, the whole Domain Dao Rule will be complete.
"And the origin of the Domain will also be fully understood."
Li Xuan looked at the last two Dao Principles on the Book of Taicang, the most changeable and the most difficult to imprint.
Even with his current Realm, focusing on them for too long made him feel dizzy, showing the profound and mysterious truth contained within these two principles.

chapters.title: Chapter 817 - 427: Breakthrough to the Domain Realm, Master of the Taicang Domain?_2
chapters.content:
"Finally engraved another Dao principle, only the last one remains."
Li Xuan was completely immersed in the memorization of the final two Dao principles, so much so that he didn't even know how much time had passed.
He finally engraved one of the last Dao principles, leaving only one remaining. Once he engraved the last Dao principle, he would fully understand the operation of Taicang Domain Dao Principles and the origin of Domain itself.
"Just one more step to go."
Li Xuan was thrilled.
To this point, his understanding of the operation of Domain Dao Principles and the insight into Domain Origin already had some vague notion.
He needed only to engrave the last Dao principle, and in an instant, he could integrate all the principles, connecting them thoroughly.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has comprehended the cultivation methods of the Holy Sword Realm, and you have broken through to the Holy Sword Realm."
Feedback from the Daoist Golden Book came suddenly.
Xu Yan had comprehended the cultivation methods of the Holy Sword Realm.
Li Xuan was immediately excited, his Sword Dao realm had once again improved.
"The Holy Sword Realm!"
Perceiving the mysteries of the Holy Sword Realm, Li Xuan sighed to himself, feeling his strength increase once more.
Any martial artist of the Sword Dao would not be able to counter his sword!
"Beyond the Holy Sword Realm, what realm should there be?"
Li Xuan couldn't help but ponder.
"Sword Dao, Sword Dao, above the Holy Sword is to touch the Sword of the Heavenly Dao, is it cultivating the true Great Sword Dao?"
Li Xuan deliberated for a moment and then had a rough idea.
"The Holy Sword Realm has been comprehended; the Domain Realm shouldn't be far off either."
Li Xuan was full of anticipation.
Just as he was about to continue delving into comprehending the Dao principle, feedback from the Daoist Golden Book came again.
However, this time it was not feedback from Xu Yan, but from Meng Chong.
"Your disciple Meng Chong has single-handedly swept through the encirclement of True King Heavenly Venerables, enhancing your martial arts experience."
Li Xuan's brows raised. Meng Chong encountered an encirclement by True King Heavenly Venerables?
What kind of force had he provoked?
Could it be Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, dispatching a large number of True King Heavenly Venerables to hunt down Meng Chong.
"This Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, they are on a death-seeking path, let them become stepping stones for the disciple."
Li Xuan shook his head, the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow could not pose a threat to his disciple, it could be seen as part of his disciples' martial arts training.
Growing through adversity, having an antagonistic force to practice against is not bad at all.
In the following time, Li Xuan received more feedback, feedback from Fang Hao setting up Great Formations, feedback from Su Lingxiu's Alchemy, feedback from Meng Chong slaying enemies.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has achieved great success in the Physiognomy Realm, enhancing your strength."
Xu Yan had broken through to the great success of Physiognomy Realm, not far from the Void-breaking Realm.
Shortly after Xu Yan's breakthrough, feedback from the Daoist Golden Book came again.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has comprehended the Martial Arts Techniques of the Domain Realm, and you've broken through to the Domain Realm!"
Li Xuan was instantly overjoyed.
The Domain Realm!
Boom!
At that moment, his strength soared, and he was undergoing a transformation.
Breaking through to the Domain Realm was a tremendous leap.
"So this is the Domain Realm!"
After the breakthrough, Li Xuan was extremely excited.
A massive change occurred within him, and his dantian and meridians seemed to have turned into mountains and rivers of the environment, with Divine Skills transformed into principles operating within his inner Domain.
His Spirit Pedestal had also transformed, seemingly as vast as the Firmament, endless and boundless.
"To be one with Domain…"
Li Xuan meditated on the breakthrough's mysteries, sensing the power and magic of the Domain Realm.
"My path in martial arts now has a clear direction."
Li Xuan muttered to himself.
With the breakthrough in the Domain Realm, the path of martial arts seemed to have suddenly opened up.
The sequence of future realms also became clearer.
"With my current strength in the Domain Realm, although I have yet to transcend Domain, it's not far off. Within this Domain, I should be invincible, shouldn't I?"
Li Xuan assessed his own strength.
The Domain Realm represented a tremendous leap, and besides, he was about to control the Taicang Domain Dao Principles. Who could threaten him within this Domain?
"But, not having transcended Domain, one can ultimately not be invincible, nor surpass the Master of the Book of Taicang."
Li Xuan was very clear in his heart that only by transcending the Domain could one truly walk the path to invincibility.
Moreover, only by transcending the Domain could one possibly surpass the owner of the Book of Taicang.
Besides, it was unknown whether the owner of the Book of Taicang was the strongest.
"Martial Arts Endless Realm, must not be complacent, for there might be even stronger individuals ahead!"
Li Xuan silently admonished himself in his heart.
He must not become arrogant just because he had broken through to the Domain Realm; he needed to continue to remain stable.
Looking up at the firmament, with his current strength at the Domain Realm, he could see much more under the scrutiny of the Eye of the Heavenly Dao.
"This is interesting."
His gaze turned to a certain part of the firmament, "Could this be the scheme of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow? Is this the Unity of Domain?"
Observing a scene in a certain part of the firmament, Li Xuan became pensive.
"Some guys are silently watching the actions of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow but choose not to stop them. Do they also want to see if the Unity of Domain can be achieved?
"Or, do they intend to take advantage of the situation after the Unity of Domain to seize benefits?"
Li Xuan smiled. Let's watch as the situation unfolds. Now he truly had the confidence. Within the Taicang Domain, let's see how the winds and clouds stir.
Looking towards the Da Yue Abyss, his gaze penetrated the Heavenly Grotto and glimpsed beyond the Domain.
That was a land of Chaos Primordial, and above it, a faint blood-red lake appeared, seemingly formed by the confluence of blood.
Along the lake's edge, outlines of mountains and rivers could be seen.
From one corner of the lake, a trail of blood light stretched out and connected with the Heavenly Grotto; that was the passageway for Netherworld Warriors to enter the Grotto.
"Quite interesting!"
At that moment, Li Xuan saw more and had some speculations.
"What kind of catastrophe once took place in this Taicang Domain? It's about time to take a stroll to the Wu Country Royal Palace."
Suddenly, Li Xuan became interested in some of the past events of the Taicang Domain.
"However, before that, it's necessary to completely comprehend the Book of Taicang."
Looking down at the Book of Taicang, with his breakthrough in realm, the final Dao Principle summary in the book also seemed much simpler now.
Time hurried by, and at a certain moment, the contours of the Taicang Domain, the rules of its operation, and its Origin Dao Principles all emerged one by one.
The entire Taicang Domain seemed to be completely within his grasp.
The overarching principles of the Book of Taicang were deeply engraved in his memory, and he had come to understand them clearly. With the last Dao Principle summary becoming clear, the Taicang Domain's principles and origins were all understood.
Clarity shone in Li Xuan's eyes. At that moment, some changes occurred within him. This was the natural enhancement of his own Martial Arts Principles after fully understanding the Taicang Domain.
It was the first time he had actively elevated his own Martial Arts without the feedback from the Daoist Golden Book.
The Domain became more perfect.
At this moment, the Daoist Golden Book in his Spirit Pedestal was shrouded in luminance.
Above the Spirit Pedestal, Li Xuan held the Daoist Golden Book in one hand while his other hand pulled out a pen from the book.
This was a pen of profound mystery, as if it contained the ultimate truths of the Domain, and harbored the infinite Dao.
Holding the pen in one hand and cradling the Daoist Golden Book in the other, a smile appeared on Li Xuan's face.
"With this book, with this pen, I shall depict my Martial Arts!"
Li Xuan murmured to himself.
With the elevation in realm, his usage of the Daoist Golden Book also improved.
"The Taicang Domain, the breach is not small indeed."
Li Xuan exclaimed.
The Heavenly Grotto was a hole in the Domain, but that was not all.
At this moment, with the comprehension of the Taicang Domain, Li Xuan came to know that the Domain had some issues, which seemed to be man-made.
Or rather, they were remnants of some great battle.
Only, the Taicang Domain was so powerful that it had the ability to heal itself, slowly recovering. Moreover, it was indeed the human effort that had patched some of the issues in the Taicang Domain.
"Did the Taicang Domain once have a master?"
Li Xuan thought staggeringly.
He had to speculate that way; understanding the Dao Principles of the Taicang Domain gave him the sense that it once had a master.
As for now, it was naturally without a master.
Li Xuan looked at the Book of Taicang in his hand and guessed in his heart.
"Is this left by the former master of the Taicang Domain? Whoever obtains this Book of Taicang, comprehends the Taicang Domain Dao Principles, understands the Taicang Domain Origin, will become the master of the Taicang Domain?"
Having comprehended the Taicang Domain Dao Principles and understanding the Domain Origin, the further one's cultivation advances, the more likely one can possess the capability to govern the Taicang Domain.
"With my current strength, I could even utilize the Dao Principles of the Taicang Domain. In a sense, I could become the master of the Taicang Domain.
"Becoming the master of the Taicang Domain means carrying some responsibilities, facing certain issues.
"But the biggest problem is that the Taicang Martial Arts is not what I cultivate. So..."
Li Xuan laughed heartily.

chapters.title: Chapter 818 - 428: The Person in the Stone Hut
chapters.content:
Li Xuan examined the Book of Taicang in his hands and couldn't help but speculate. Who could be able to write a book that depicted and described the Taicang Domain Dao Principles, that understood the origin of the Taicang Domain, and that understood the operation of the Taicang Domain?
Ordinary beings who had transcended the domain might not be able to write it, for transcending the domain didn't necessarily mean they had profound insight into the Taicang Domain.
There was only one possibility!
It had to be the Master of the Taicang Domain who understood it so thoroughly.
The Master of the Taicang Domain!
"Could it be that the Master of the Taicang Domain suffered an accident, leaving behind this Book of Taicang for future generations? Whoever obtains the Book of Taicang could become the new Master of the Taicang Domain!"
However, Li Xuan didn't understand why, if such a book existed that could make someone the Master of the Taicang Domain, no strong being had sought after or fought over it?
Or perhaps there had been a struggle, but due to some special accident, the Book of Taicang ended up in the Border Wilderness, unknown to all, and over time, gradually faded from memory?
Li Xuan raised his head to look at the Taicang Domain; he could faintly see scars from a great battle. Were these scars caused by the struggle over the Book of Taicang?
Or else, were they left by the Master of the Taicang Domain while defending against an enemy?
"The majestic figure seen by Xu Yan, could it really have been the Master of the Taicang Domain?"
Li Xuan thought to himself with astonishment.
"So, did the Master of the Taicang Domain die, or what exactly happened?"
Did the Book of Taicang appear in Wu Country in the Border Wilderness by accident, or was there some unknown connection?
Was the entity in the little stone house of the Wu Country Royal Palace related to the Book of Taicang?
Could it be that the entity is the Master of the Taicang Domain?
"That's impossible. How could the Master of the Taicang Domain be sealed within the Taicang Domain by someone?
"Could it be that they are suppressing a powerful enemy?"
Li Xuan took a deep breath, his heart slightly agitated as if he had discovered a tremendous secret.
"Huh, this Wu Tianan seems quite interesting. Truly fortunate by fate?"
Just as Li Xuan was preparing to visit Wu Country, he suddenly became surprised.
Now that his power had increased and after he had understood the Taicang Domain, he immediately noticed something unusual through the martial roots he shared with Wu Tianan.
Inside Wu Tianan, there was the destiny of the Taicang Domain, ensuring that, even if he faced powerful enemies, he could turn danger into safety and seize opportunities.
"What's the deal with this destiny?"
Li Xuan was bewildered.
"Should I go over and check it out?"
Li Xuan pondered, knowing that if he used the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, he would be able to see everything clearly in Wu Tianan.
"Forget it, it's ultimately not a bad thing for Wu Tianan.
Li Xuan glanced over at the principle related to the destiny of the domain, deep in thought.
"This is getting interesting. It looks like that little rascal Wu Tianan actually helped someone quite extraordinary back then, indeed, a person of rich destiny.
"Having met me and received my guidance, he truly does have a great destiny."
Thinking back on Wu Tianan's experiences, Li Xuan couldn't help but chuckle.
After arriving in the Divine Realm, as Wu Tianan's strength broke through, he began to touch upon the destiny of the domain, and his inherent destiny was fully activated.
Therefore, his cultivation speed was extraordinary, and he had also cultivated Divine Skills.
No wonder Wu Tianan was the first among the Taicang Martial Artists to cultivate Divine Skills.
"He's not far from the Immortal Realm."
Li Xuan looked perplexed, guessing that once Wu Tianan broke through the Immortal Realm, led by destiny, it was possible for him to break through even higher realms in the Divine Realm.
"Is Wu Tianan's pathfinder in Martial Arts over there?"
Looking up at the firmament, with his insight into the Taicang Domain, according to Wu Tianan's destiny, it seemed to have some cause and effect with this very place.
"I'll guide Wu Tianan again when I have time. It's about time to return to Wu Country to find out what's going on with that guy in the stone house. I'm curious."
Li Xuan felt a surge of excitement within.
He was about to unveil a mystery and satisfy his curiosity.
"Let Xu Yan settle down a bit before I pass on to him the Martial Arts Techniques above the Domain Realm."
A figure emerged from within Li Xuan and sat down leisurely in the chair.
This was his Extreme Soul Body.
Though it was unlikely that any mishap would occur in the Qinghua state, to be safe, Li Xuan still left his Extreme Soul Body behind. If any special situation arose, it would be able to suppress it promptly.
With the Book of Taicang put away, Li Xuan vanished from the spot in an instant.
The Extreme Soul Body, as always, sat leisurely in the chair, indistinguishable to anyone that it was another incarnation of Li Xuan practicing Martial Arts.
In the Great Wilderness, with the elevation of Spiritual Energy, the speed of cultivation had become faster, and the grade of Spiritual Medicine had also improved. After years of development, the overall strength had long surpassed that of the Inner Realm.
Moreover, in the Great Wilderness, nearly everyone practiced Martial Arts now.
The once Inner Realm Martial Arts scriptures hadn't been destroyed but had become a part of history, preserved in the Great Wilderness Martial Arts Institute and the various former Martial Arts powers.
At Sword Venerate Cliff, with Xie Tianheng and Xie Lingfeng leaving, the current masters of the Sword Venerate Cliff, Hu Hai and his son Hu Shan, had both cultivated Sword Momentum and were now recognized as the foremost practitioners of Sword Dao in the Great Wilderness.
Canglan Island, a Holy Land of the Great Wilderness, was shrouded in a Great Formation. Each year, exceptional students recommended from the Great Wilderness Martial Arts Academy would come here to cultivate for a month, accessing higher levels of Martial Arts.
The Alchemists of the Evergreen Pavilion held a revered position in the Great Wilderness and now Artifact Refiners had begun to emerge, all because of the legacy left by Xu Yan.
The entire Great Wilderness was flourishing, and although conflict was inevitable, everything was within control.

chapters.title: Chapter 819 - 428: The Person in the Small Stone House_2
chapters.content:
The Border Wilderness was still unique. Though the spiritual energy wasn't sparse, it did appear violent without the presence of Domain Lingji.
Yet occasionally, Great Wilderness Warriors came to cultivate here, experiencing the raging wash of spiritual energy.
Taicang Martial Arts could not be practiced without Domain Lingji, but Great Wilderness Martial Arts did not need it.
In the lands of the Border Wilderness, where the Northern Barbarians resided, a domineering chieftain arose, leading his vast army to invade the former Qi Country and Wu Country, intending to unify the Border Wilderness.
The people of the Northern Barbarians, dwelling in the cold and harsh lands of the Border Wilderness, were oblivious to its changes and unfamiliar with the emergence of Martial Arts. After a fierce internal chaos, unity was restored, and the mightiest ruler in a thousand years appeared in the Barbarian Court.
Having accumulated enough strength, he finally embarked on a campaign to unify all under heaven.
Upon learning this, Emperor Qi and The Emperor of Wu were overjoyed and personally took action. Just the two of them swept through the Northern Barbarian army and captured the chieftain alive.
The hearts of all Northerners crumbled. They had originally thought to annihilate Qi Country and Wu Country and seize their rich lands, only to be overthrown by two men!
The strength they displayed was like that of a Heavenly God!
Compared to the true gods of the Northern Barbarians that they worshipped, they seemed like mere ants!
The chieftain of the Northerners was dumbfounded. Anyone with slightly weaker will might have been driven mad by the shock!
After this event, the Northerners changed. They started to join the two emperors of the Great Wilderness and became subjects of the Great Wilderness, while the Barbarian Chieftain promptly and decisively knelt and took the emperors as his masters.
"The people of the Northern Barbarians have robust physiques and can endure hardships, making them suitable for practicing the Physical Body Martial Arts of the Great Wilderness!"
Thus, some exceptionally talented Northern youths were taught the Great Sun Golden Bell Shield and began practicing Great Wilderness Martial Arts.
The former Inner Realm had long been forgotten, and even the younger generation did not know that the Great Wilderness was once called the Inner Realm.
The older generation of martial artists rarely mentioned the Inner Realm, only within the historical records of the Martial Arts Academy were there some accounts about the Inner Realm before the Great Wilderness.
The martial artists who practiced Inner Realm Martial Arts were ultimately too numerous to successfully convert to practicing Great Wilderness Martial Arts, and so among the older generation of martial artists, those who practiced Inner Realm Martial Arts still made up the majority.
However, these martial artists, though not practicing Great Wilderness Martial Arts, had also integrated into the Great Wilderness, no longer calling themselves Inner Realm martial artists, and instead took pride in being Great Wilderness Warriors.
In the lands of the Border Wilderness, the Wu Country Royal Palace.
This place had become one of the two royal palaces of the Great Wilderness, where The Emperor of Wu resided for a period of time each year.
But the vast royal palace was mostly quiet and deserted, only becoming lively on the days when The Emperor of Wu returned.
Usually, it was the former eunuchs who cleaned the palace.
These eunuchs, who had stayed behind, mostly lacked Martial Arts talent when they were unable to pursue martial pursuits, could only spend the rest of their lives here.
Of course, these eunuchs did practice cultivation, but their strength was weak; it was, however, enough to sustain them with the physical vigor required to clean the palace and perform various chores.
When The Emperor of Wu returned, he would still reward them with pills.
The Great Wilderness had abolished the eunuch system, and the eunuchs serving Emperor Qi and The Emperor of Wu were all from the very first batch; there were no new eunuchs afterwards.
Deep within the palace, there was a chamber only The Emperor of Wu could enter.
In the silent palace, a small stone hut suddenly uttered a murmur, "What's going on? Why does it feel more and more wrong? The increase in spiritual energy and Domain Lingji seems to be too rapid.
"Moreover, that boy, The Emperor of Wu, has actually become a martial artist. Why is the Martial Arts he practiced different from what I know?
"Could it be that Taicang has fallen? Impossible, if it had fallen, why didn't I notice?"
This voice was filled with doubt and confusion.
If The Emperor of Wu were here, he would realize that this voice was the same mysterious voice that had been missing for a long time.
"Strange, the next time that boy, The Emperor of Wu, comes, should I try to feel him out? No, that's not right, I'm pretending to be dead now, I can't reveal myself.
"Right, I cannot reveal myself, there are too many swindlers out there, all swindlers. They deceived me into coming here and trapped me.
"I must not be fooled again, I must not be curious again, I definitely cannot be fooled. I trust no one, including Taicang!
"Yes, including Taicang, I do not trust him either, he actually deceived me and locked me up here, leaving me here to die!"
The murmuring voice grew increasingly angry, yet there was also a hint of sorrow.
"How long has it been? I can't remember, but it's been a very, very long time. I've slept and slept, and Taicang still hasn't come back, he's really dead.
"Woo woo, even he died, that's really frightening. Can this world continue to exist? Won't it be overrun? What if someone discovers me, what should I do?
"Forget it, I'll sleep it off and pretend nothing happened.
"Yes, that's it, sleep it off as if nothing has happened, woo woo... Taicang must have died miserably, it serves him right for locking me up here. If I had helped him, even if I had died, I should have been able to leave behind a single bone!"
In the small stone house, a murmuring voice echoed.
"Sleep, sleep, all will be well after a sleep, one must not be curious, that whelp of The Emperor of Wu, he must be trying to pique my curiosity on purpose, hmph, I won't be fooled!"
The voice gradually quieted down.
Li Xuan returned to the Great Wilderness, walking among it, watching the young men striving in Skin Refinement, Bone Refinement, and Viscera Refinement, diligently cultivating their Martial Arts, presenting a thriving scene.
"Not bad, in a hundred, a thousand years, the strength of the Great Wilderness Martial Arts Realm is bound to surge."
Li Xuan did not disturb anyone, striding on clouds, he made his way to the Border Wilderness.
"Let the Border Wilderness remain as such, the absence of Domain Lingji is not necessarily a bad thing."
He arrived outside the Wu Country Royal Palace.
Li Xuan looked up at the firmament, and with his strength and the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, he instantly discovered something peculiar.
"A seal? It doesn't quite seem so, it's more like using the Domain itself to bind an existence, quite special."
If it were not for his insight into the Taicang Domain, possession of the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, and his attainment of the Domain Realm, he probably would not have noticed the anomaly.
"Even a Supreme Expert who transcends the Domain wouldn't be able to detect it."
Too well-concealed!
Moreover, this kind of method is not something common powerful beings can accomplish.
Master of the Taicang Domain!
This is the handiwork of the Master of the Taicang Domain, only The Master of Taicang could achieve this step.
"What kind of powerful being is trapped here? Something even The Master of the Taicang Domain cannot deal with?"
Li Xuan was extremely surprised.
And from the way such a secretive arrangement is made, it seems as though they're afraid of someone discovering and rescuing the person confined here.
His gaze turned toward the small stone house.
As if penetrating all obstacles, he vaguely saw the ground beneath the small stone house, at a depth unknown, imbued with a hazy purple glimmer.
"This stone house..."
Li Xuan raised an eyebrow, the stone house looked utterly ordinary, yet not so ordinary, tied to the entire arrangement, also one part of the concealment of the trapped existence.
"Without entering the stone house, it's likely impossible to see through it completely."
Li Xuan pondered.
He only saw a faint purple light but could not completely discern what lay within.
"With my current strength, since the other party is bound, even if they are very strong, they can't use their power, so there is no need to worry about danger."
Li Xuan stepped towards the palace.
A mysterious aura emerged at that moment, making him appear inscrutable, enough to deceive the confined person.
Clasping the Jade Ruyi in hand and striding with an unrestrained gait, he displayed the poise of a superior being.
He pushed open the doors of the palace and entered.
The palace doors closed.
With a leisurely and easygoing demeanor, he entered the small stone house, which appeared quite ordinary and without any oddity.
Li Xuan took out a chair and sat down with a relaxed and comfortable air.
He brewed a pot of Spiritual Tea, pouring two cups of the tea.
"Little friend, come up and have a cup of tea."
Li Xuan smiled cordially.
Since he was a peerless expert, it was only natural to maintain the image of one, regardless of the other's strength, they would still seem insignificant before him!
Since the other party couldn't see through his strength, they would only assume he was profound and unfathomable.
Given these circumstances, addressing the other as "little friend" seems quite reasonable, doesn't it?
With a smile on his face, like a kind old senior, "Little friend, no need to pretend anymore, I've already seen you. Come, have a cup of tea and let's chat, just for a casual talk."

chapters.title: Chapter 820 - 429: Kid, Your Realm is Too Low
chapters.content:
The moment Li Xuan entered the small stone hut, he saw what was within the purple glow at the depths of the hut's subterranean space.
The faint purple light was misty, enclosing a tiny chamber that resembled a small room. Originally, this space should have contained other items, but they were all gone now, leaving only a bed.
Moreover, the bed was somewhat battered, as if it had been violently smashed by someone.
A teenager in a purple robe was lying on the bed, seemingly asleep.
"Kid, stop pretending to sleep. Come, have some tea and a chat with me. You never know, I might just let you out if I'm in a good mood," Li Xuan said with a radiant smile.
But inwardly, he was secretly shocked; the teenager in the purple robe was somewhat inscrutable. The other party didn't seem to be a Martial Artist but some kind of special being.
It was impossible to see through the extent of his strength, yet he was restrained, his true powers completely unexercised unless the restraints were removed.
Since he couldn't exercise his strength, Li Xuan naturally didn't need to worry.
The teenager in the purple robe lay quietly, unmoving, without a hint of response, as if he were already dead.
"Pretend to be dead, pretend to be dead. He can't see me; he can't come in, surely he can't. Don't panic, just pretend to be dead!"
The teenager in the purple robe constantly hypnotized himself inwardly.
"I am already dead, yes, I've died!"
Upon hearing Li Xuan's voice, he didn't respond at all. In his heart, he even sneered contemptuously, "This kind of trick, trying to deceive me to come out? Really thinks I'm a three-year-old child."
"However, who is this person? Why does he give me a feeling of being unfathomable? Even Taicang has never given me this impression.
"The only one that gave me this feeling was that pair of eyes, and those eyes were terrifying. It's possible that Taicang might have died at their hands.
"But this person is completely different from those eyes; surely he can't be the same person. But where does he come from? How can he possess such terrifying strength?
"One thing is certain, he isn't a Martial Artist of Taicang. If he's a foreigner, why didn't I notice?
"Even though I am confined here, if a foreign powerhouse were to enter the Taicang Domain, I should be able to sense it."
The more the teenager in the purple robe thought about it, the more puzzled he became.
This person was unfathomable; within the Taicang Domain, there shouldn't be such a terrifyingly powerful entity present, no one could surpass that of Taicang.
If he was an outsider, why hadn't he noticed?
Could it be that this person's strength was so immense that when he entered the Taicang Domain, even he couldn't detect it?
If that was truly the case, wasn't his strength far greater than the owner of that pair of eyes?
The more he thought about it, the less composed the teenager in the purple robe felt.
"He couldn't have really seen me, could he? He won't come in, right? Pretend to be dead!
"Right, pretend to be dead! As long as I am dead, he won't be interested. Surely he can't be interested in a dead person, can he?
"He's not some Netherworld old ghost; how could he possibly be interested in the dead?"
The teenager in the purple robe began to hypnotize himself again.
"I'm dead, I have already died..."
Suddenly, it seemed as if he had thought of something else.
"No, I must look uglier. Surely he can't be interested in an ugly corpse, can he?"
With that thought, the teenager in the purple robe, lying motionlessly on the bed, started to change slowly. If one could see his face, they would find it wrinkling up, becoming old and ugly.
Li Xuan's mouth twitched. What was up with the teenager in the purple robe? Why did it feel like his thoughts weren't quite like a normal person's?
Self-hypnosis?
Pretending to be dead?
He couldn't think that Li Xuan had neither seen him nor could enter his little chamber, could he?
After examining the small space where the teenager in the purple robe lay, including the violently smashed bed, he became thoughtful.
The other items in the small chamber, he surmised, had probably been destroyed by the teenager in the purple robe; the bed was smashed by him too. Perhaps considering that without a bed, he wouldn't be able to lie down and sleep, he had stopped smashing it halfway.
Lifting his foot, Li Xuan stomped on the ground, sending a surge of force downwards, causing a vibration within the small chamber.
"Kid, stop pretending to be dead. Come keep this old man company for a chat. Aren't you bored? Don't worry, I mean no harm," he said.
The small chamber shuddered slightly.
The teenager in the purple robe pretending to be dead panicked inwardly, "He's found me, what do I do? Continue pretending to be dead?"
"No, if I keep pretending to be dead and he gets angry and smashes my little house, won't I be exposed? Forget it, let's just go up and meet him.
"Don't think you can get any information out of me. Playing dumb, that I'm quite good at!"
With these thoughts in mind, he muttered, "Disturbing someone's sleep is an unethical act!"
As he spoke, he stretched lazily, yawned, and wore an expression like he was just awoken and annoyed.
With a flash of purple light, the teenager in the purple robe appeared inside the stone hut.
He could only appear within the stone hut, unable to leave it, for if the hut were gone, he would be confined to that small chamber only.
Seeing his face wrinkled and aged, making him look old and ugly, Li Xuan's expression darkened as he said, "Kid, stop pretending to be ugly!"
"Who are you calling kid? I am as old as the Domain itself!"
The teenager in the purple robe became haughty.
He restored his true appearance, a handsome face and the look of a fifteen- or sixteen-year-old, even somewhat feminine.
"As old as the Domain? Then how old is the Domain?" Li Xuan asked cheerfully.
It seemed as if he was just casually continuing the conversation, posing this question.
"As old as the Domain, this guy is a bit strange, not like any creature I know of."

chapters.title: Chapter 821 - 429: Kid, Your Realm is Too Low_2
chapters.content:
Li Xuan's heart was secretly astounded.
"A few years old? Ha, I'll tell you, this Domain from birth..."
The purple-robed youth suddenly counted off on his fingers, "How many years was it again? I can't count them all, anyways, it's been a lot, a whole lot of years!"
Yet, inside, he was exclaiming, "That was a close one, almost let it slip; good thing, good thing I'm quick-witted."
Li Xuan watched the other party counting off on his fingers, feigning ignorance and puzzlement, feeling exhausted at heart.
Such poor acting skills.
"Forget it, I won't expose him, too wary, no need to rush things; I'll hoodwink him slowly, first thing is to figure out his identity."
"He doesn't seem to be a normal creature, nor a Divine Soul, truly bizarre; since he's as old as the Domain, his strength must be enormous, surely beyond what I can match right now."
"Some tactics can't be used on him, and besides, there's no need; just slowly hoodwink him, and perhaps I could even take a disciple?"
"He looks like a youth who has not long since reached maturity, easy to hoodwink."
The purple-robed youth was still counting on his fingers when he suddenly asked, "How old are you?"
Li Xuan, bearing an aura of mystery, gazed deeply, suddenly showing a kind of vicissitude as if recalling something from long ago, and spoke leisurely, "Me? I was before the ages, beyond any reckoning of years."
The purple-robed youth listened, stunned, feeling that the other's words were profound and unfathomable.
"So amazing, really inscrutable, too mysterious, too profound."
His heart felt a small shock.
"My little friend, what's your name?"
Li Xuan asked amiably.
"I don't know, I've forgotten my name, what about you? What's your name?"
The purple-robed youth scratched his head, pretending to be utterly bewildered as if he had truly forgotten his own name.
The acting was just a bit poor.
"My name, the karma is too great; you, as a little friend, cannot bear it, it's better not to know."
Li Xuan smiled and didn't expose the other's poor acting.
"Just tell me, I can surely bear it; there's no karma I cannot bear."
The purple-robed youth looked curious.
"Come, little friend, have some tea!"
Li Xuan pushed a cup of tea to the purple-robed youth, continuing, "The Domain is very small, my karma transcends the Domain, even if you, my little friend, are as old as the Domain itself, you cannot withstand it."
The purple-robed youth looked bewildered, thoughtful.
He glanced at the tea in front of him, took a sip, and immediately made a face of distaste, "Your tea is too terrible, utterly undrinkable; how can you drink such terrible tea?"
Li Xuan's face maintained its smile while his heart was extremely helpless; the leaves brewed for this pot of Spiritual Tea were a gift from Emperor Da Yue, belonging to the highest tier of Spiritual Tea in the Qinghua state, extremely rare.
Even Emperor Da Yue himself could not afford to drink it daily; he had taken out his stored treasure to please this exalted individual.
This was the highest grade of Spiritual Tea Li Xuan had on hand, and it was being scorned!
For a peerless expert to be drinking such terrible tea was damaging to his image.
"You, my little friend, your Realm is too low; precisely because it's too low, you care about the grade of Spiritual Tea, about drinking what rare treasures from the Domain."
"At my current Realm, even an ordinary cup of water is flavorful."
"Do you know why? Because I've transcended the stage of pursuing rare treasures from the Domain – it's not tea I'm drinking, it's savoring the ways of the world, it's drinking the undefeated loneliness..."
Li Xuan spoke with an undiminished smile, starting to brag.
The purple-robed youth was stunned once more, feeling another small shock within.
"Not drinking the tea, but savoring the ways of the world? Drinking undefeated loneliness?"
The purple-robed youth, puzzled, scratched his head, feeling it all to be too mystical and involuntarily took another sip of tea, still finding it unpalatable.
"But, I still feel this tea is just terrible!"
The purple-robed youth looked morose.
"My little friend, it's because your Realm is low, you can't taste the way within it; but once you transcend beyond the material, when all the Domain and everything becomes an illusion, you won't care about the grade of tea you drink."
"Because, you are tasting the way of the world, not the tea in the cup."
Li Xuan poured himself a cup of tea, took a sip, and continued, "This sip of tea, what I taste is the greed of all living beings in the Domain, the thirst of Martial Artists, the desire to be invincible, the longing for eternity."
"This sip, what I am tasting is the storm, pouring between heaven and earth..."
The purple-robed youth blinked, his head swimming in confusion, and could not help but take another sip of tea. For some reason, this sip did not taste as bad as before.
"What did you taste in this sip of tea?"
Li Xuan asked with a smile.
"It tasted bitter, horrible!"
The purple-robed youth smacked his lips.
"Your heart is troubled, and you are ill at ease, so naturally, what you taste is bitterness,"
Li Xuan said, enigmatic as ever.
Being locked up here for who knows how many years, it would be strange if my heart wasn't heavy.
"Is that so?"
The purple-robed youth tilted his head and passed his cup forward, "Give me another cup."
Li Xuan poured him another cup of tea.
The purple-robed youth gulped it down, his entire face scrunching up, as if he had swallowed a mouthful of bitter water.
Seeing him like this, Li Xuan looked at the tea in his hand and also started to find it hard to drink.
Before this, he had been enjoying his tea, but now suddenly realized, was this tea actually garbage?
Gulping!
The purple-robed youth struggled to swallow the tea, "This is too disgusting, what kind of tea is this? If I hadn't run out of the tea I stored before, I would have let you taste what good tea is really like."
Li Xuan's face remained smiling, saying, "Young friend, with your current state of mind, even the finest of teas would be tasteless to you.
"You, your realm is too low, still fixated on the grade of the Spiritual Tea you drink. When the day comes that you transcend worldly attachments, you will no longer be stuck on this matter.
"The way of Dao is natural, close to the Dao, tasting the myriad ways of the world, everything in the world is included within it, even simple tea and plain rice can taste of the flavor of Dao..."
Li Xuan emphasized repeatedly that the other's realm was too low, which is why he was fixated on the quality of the Spiritual Tea.
The purple-robed youth blinked, contemplating, an image flashing in his mind.
He too was like this, detached and without possessions, as if all the treasures of the Domain no longer caught his eye.
All the Supreme Treasures, delicious food and drink, had been given to him.
"Taicang was like this as well? But Taicang is dead, what's even more terrifying..."
Scratching his head, the purple-robed youth looked somewhat agitated.
Seeing this, Li Xuan instantly understood that the other had thought of something and asked with a smile, "Young friend, if you have any troubles, feel free to talk about them, just like chatting about everyday life."
"Are you very powerful?"
The purple-robed youth suddenly asked seriously.
"I don't know if I count as strong, but up until now, no one has been able to withstand my slap,"
Li Xuan shook his head with a bitter smile, then added, "Being too strong is actually not a good thing. When a slap can solve all problems, there's no challenge at all, it can be quite boring!"
The purple-robed youth looked at him suspiciously, feeling as though this person might be flaunting his own strength!
Yet his expression seemed to carry the woes of being too strong, not like it was an act.
"His strength, it must be greater than Taicang's, perhaps even stronger than the one with the eyes?"
The purple-robed youth was inwardly shocked. Taicang's strength was immeasurable, and the being with the eyes seemed even more formidable than Taicang.
This is a senior figure!
Thinking thus, the purple-robed youth's expression grew a bit more respectful and he asked, "Senior, is it that the stronger a person is, the greater their greed becomes, the more they thirst to become stronger, wanting to have control over everything, to be peerless above all others?"
Li Xuan savored the tea, leisurely in his demeanor, but was secretly delighted that things were progressing, convincing himself that he could eventually coax out the answers he sought from the other's lips.
"As for me, that's not a strong person. A true strong person doesn't have a fierce desire to become stronger but returns to the ordinary, nearing the Dao, playing in the mundane world.
"For being invincible is a lonely affair. On the path of Martial Arts, there are no more peers in sight, and the heart for strength has long since faded.
"Only the weak desire to continuously grow stronger. The invincible long to figure out how not to be lonely..."
The purple-robed youth listened, perplexed, looking at Li Xuan with suspicion as though he was trying to tell him, "Get it? I am that kind of strong person!"

chapters.title: Chapter 822 - 430 Staring Directly at the Fall Witch's Evil Eye
chapters.content:
```
"As the senior has said, is it because one is not strong enough, because one is weak, that one harbors all kinds of malicious thoughts, and desires to devour various things to become stronger?"
The youth in the purple robe pondered as he spoke.
"It can be understood that way."
Li Xuan nodded.
"But what if one is already very strong, so strong as to be deemed invincible, why would they still be considered weak?"
The youth in the purple robe asked with a look of confusion, "How strong must one be to be considered strong?"
Li Xuan smiled brilliantly, the youth in the purple robe had addressed him as "senior," which was a good start; this indicated that the other party recognized his great strength!
They acknowledged him as an incredibly strong senior!
"How strong, indeed? The paths I've walked become the legends that others pursue, and before me, there were no others."
"In this way, one can feel the loneliness of being invincible."
The youth in the purple robe scratched his head, asking hesitantly, "Are you talking about yourself?"
Li Xuan smiled without answering, emanating the mystery of a sage.
In the little stone cottage, they chatted casually back and forth, with Li Xuan occasionally boasting but stopping just at the right moment, ever retaining an air of profound mystery.
The youth in the purple robe seemed to have not chatted with anyone for a long time, especially casual conversations with a powerhouse. The more they talked, the more he said, almost letting slip some secrets before catching himself in time and steering the conversation elsewhere.
Although Li Xuan didn't gain much information, he had roughly figured out that the youth in the purple robe was very powerful and somewhat special, but his mind was indeed like that of a youngster, occasionally displaying extreme curiosity.
Sometimes, he also gave the impression of one inexperienced in worldly matters. As long as the right balance was struck and he was coaxed slowly, it would be inevitable to learn the information needed.
However, it was important not to be too obvious, for the youth in the purple robe, although somewhat naive, maintained constant vigilance.
Li Xuan also gradually speculated that the youth in the purple robe was sealed here to prevent enemies from discovering him.
Whoever arranged all this was extremely powerful and very close to the youth in the purple robe.
"His age is as ancient as the Domain itself; he shares some special origin with this Domain. Even with my current realm and the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, I couldn't see through everything. The one who arranged all this is too powerful."
"Yet although I couldn't see through everything, I have some guesses, and if I'm correct, then this is out of the ordinary."
"The Master of the Taicang Domain once had his domain; only the Master of the Taicang Domain can arrange all of this."
Li Xuan thought to himself.
Leaving the little stone cottage, with an unhurried stride, Li Xuan passed through the Great Wilderness and arrived at the Spiritual Realm.
His gaze deep and distant, he looked at the Heavenly Grotto that once had been sealed, and with a casual wave of his hand, the power of Dao Principles surged forth, thoroughly repairing the Heavenly Grotto of the Spiritual Realm.
The Heavenly Grotto of the Spiritual Realm was small and easy to repair. With Li Xuan's current strength and his understanding of the Taicang Domain, naturally, it was something he could easily do.
"The Spiritual Realm hasn't changed much; merely the Loose Cultivators at the bottom layer are no longer so insignificant, and the dynamic of the major powers has not changed either."
Li Xuan walked through the Spiritual Realm. The Wanshi Alliance had already become one of the top powers in the Spiritual Realm, and the Demon Clan founded by Red Cat had become the third clan in the Spiritual Realm, other than the Human Clan and the Sea Spirit Tribe.
Crossing the Azure Sea, he returned to the Divine Realm.
"Although I didn't get much information, there has been some progress."
Li Xuan sat down on a chair, holding the Book of Taicang and began reading it. Although he had entirely memorized the Book of Taicang, he still found it fascinating to read.
"Let him stew for a while."
The smile on Li Xuan's face was radiant.
"Your disciple Jiang Buping, absorbing Imperishable Qi, cultivating the Imperishable Spirit Soul, your Extreme Soul Martial Arts has advanced to the Domain Realm."
The feedback from the Daoist Golden Book came suddenly.
Li Xuan was instantly overjoyed. The Extreme Soul Martial Arts had also advanced to the Domain Realm, and his strength had increased tremendously.
"Jiang Buping's success in using Imperishable Qi for cultivation and directly impacting the advancement of Extreme Soul Martial Arts to the Domain Realm means that now, I alone am equivalent to two beings of the Domain Realm."
Having an Extreme Soul Body at the Domain Realm meant that, should he encounter an enemy of equal strength, he could fight two against one and still prevail!
"The true form of the Demon Ancestor's advance is a bit slow; it has not yet reached the Domain Realm. Red Cat, this guy, needs to be more diligent."
If the true form of the Demon Ancestor also advanced to the Domain Realm, it meant that he could take on three adversaries of equal strength single-handedly!
"The Divine Realm has not established a Demon Clan yet, but it shouldn't be too far off."
Red Cat was still weak at that moment, lacking confidence to establish a Demon Clan in the Divine Realm.
However, once Red Cat's strength reached the Void-breaking Realm, he would have enough confidence.
"Another realm in the Divine Realm has fallen into chaos."
Li Xuan sighed. Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow was quite capable; another realm had fallen into disarray, igniting a great war.
If this trend continued, it wouldn't take long for the entire Divine Realm to engage in a massive war, and the enemies from beyond the heavens might also likely invade through the Heavenly Grotto.
"Without a strong person to intervene, it seems some people want to see if Unity of Domain would confer any benefits, or rather, is Unity of Domain actually a plot for the position of Master of Domain?"
Li Xuan suddenly realized, perhaps Unity of Domain was a scheme to vie for the position of Master of Domain.
"No matter how much they calculate, they can't foresee that without acting as Master of Domain myself, others also cannot assume the role, it will be nothing but nominal."
With the Book of Taicang in his possession, no one could surpass his understanding of the Taicang Domain.
Even if there appeared to be a so-called Master of Domain, it would be fake, without any significance.
"It's time to pass on the Martial Arts Techniques above the Domain Realm to Xu Yan."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 823 - 430 Staring Directly at the Fall Witch's Evil Eye_2
chapters.content:
Atop Li Xuan's Spirit Pedestal, his Primordial Spirit held the Daoist Golden Book, which now, as he turned its pages, bore the Domain Martial Arts Law written upon them.
"Above the Heavenly Domain, one could be considered comparable to the Master of Domain, also belonging to those who have transcended the worldly realm. Once I have transcended, the use of the Daoist Golden Book should also be elevated,"
Li Xuan thought to himself.
Although at this moment, one of his Primordial Spirit's hands grasped a pen, this pen was incredibly heavy, unable to inscribe Martial Arts Techniques onto the Daoist Golden Book!
"Even at the Domain Realm, I cannot use this pen. After breaking through one more realm, I should be able to make use of it."
The Extreme Soul Body stepped out from the Spirit Pedestal and sat down on the chair, and with one step, Li Xuan instantly vanished from the spot.
...
In the Changyun Realm, where winds surged and clouds billowed, the Battle Hall issued a challenge letter, calling out the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow!
And with the actions of the Battle Hall, the force known as Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow emerged within the Martial Arts Realm, causing many martial artists to express shock and speculation—what kind of force was this?
Boom!
In the Changyun Realm, in front of the gates of a certain Sect, Luo Zhan led ten True King Heavenly Venerables.
"Luo here has come to capture the criminals of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow and does not target your Sect. You can rest assured; Battle Hall never falsely accuses anyone. This credibility, I believe you, Sect Master, are well aware of.
"Your Sect's Second Elder, Fifth Elder, and third core disciple are all Earth Shadow Members. Those who know what's good for them will surrender quietly."
Luo Zhan's aura was surging, his battle intent fierce, directly pointing out the hidden Earth Shadows.
The stunned Sect Master and the other elders were initially taken aback, wishing to explain themselves, only to find that the individuals Luo Zhan had named had all chosen to perish by their own hand.
In that instant, they felt a chill running down their spines, chilled to the core. Those whom they had lived with within the Sect and were as familiar as could be had actually been spies of the mysterious force Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow?
What was even more chilling was that, to avoid capture and revealing information about Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, they had decisively chosen to end their own lives.
They were clearly prepared to die!
And such persons had been hidden within their Sect, even rising to the status of elders, at the core of the Sect. What kind of terrible blow could they deal if they harbored ill intentions?
It could even lead to the annihilation of the Sect!
"Detain everyone related to them!"
The enraged Sect Master commanded.
This news spread, causing an upheaval in the Changyun Realm, and all the major forces became restless.
No major force could tolerate spies lurking within its sect, so they all began to take action, scrutinizing their members to root out any lurking Earth Shadow Members.
Baimu City.
"Do we have spies within the Wanbao Alliance too? Is the death of my disciple related to this? I want thorough investigations."
By now, Yan Shanhe had also understood one thing—his disciple had not been killed by Meng Chong!
With Meng Chong's strength, once he acted, it was impossible for anyone to return alive, let alone with just an arm severed!
However, although he now knew that Meng Chong was not the culprit who killed his disciple, the enmity between them was irreconcilable.
Thus, Meng Chong had to die!
"Clever tactic, targeting my head, Yan Shanhe, and using me to kill another, right?"
Yan Shanhe's gaze was icily sharp.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, by reaching into the Wanbao Alliance, this is provocation!"
The Wanbao Alliance also began to take action.
Earth Shadow's ability to infiltrate and disguise was indeed profound, but under the personal scrutiny of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, not all Earth Shadows could escape detection.
So, within a short time, all the major forces had rooted out the sneaky Earth Shadow Members.
For a time, the force of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow in the Changyun Realm suffered significant losses, all because of one wrong move by the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter.
"Damn it!"
Tian Shiqi, currently in the Nine Mountain Realm, had his face turn dark with rage.
"Wu Rang acting wise, not moving to kill Xu Yan but instead recklessly deploying operations!"
Tian Shiqi was furious.
Wu Rang, the name of the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter in the Changyun Realm.
"What should we do now, sir?"
The Heavenly Slaughter from Horizontal Peak Mountain inquired respectfully.
Although Tian Shiqi wore the mask of a Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter, his actual status within Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow was not simple; the mask was merely a disguise for his true identity.
"I will make arrangements for this matter, and it is time for Xu Yan to die!"
Tian Shiqi said with a cold voice.
"Will you take action personally, sir?"
Tian Shiqi shook his head and stepped away.
As the Changyun Realm's major forces experienced minor turbulence due to Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, Xu Yan had already arrived at the Duowu Cave.
Hum!
With a single sword strike, all the attacking Witch Marionettes were annihilated.
"Hiss, so strong, who is he?"
"Sword God Xu Yan!"
"So it's him! His strength seems even greater than Hong Ting's!"
"The number one person below the Immortal Realm, this is what Luo Zhan said."
In the Duowu Cave, some martial artists were discussing with shock.
And Xu Yan, step by step, walked deeper into the Duowu Cave.
He was going to meet with that Duowu.
The attackers around him, although they possessed the power of the Duowu, were clearly not pure. They were either Witch Marionettes of the Duowu or slaves corrupted and assimilated by some force, not even true descendants.
"I wonder if this Duowu recognizes the Seductive Witch!"
Xu Yan pondered in his heart.
"Does the Duowu have any treasures?"
Xu Yan wanted to lure the Seductive Witch here, but he needed to measure it correctly. What if the Seductive Witch felt that it wasn't worth entering the Heavenly Grotto because she wouldn't gain enough strength to oppose him, and thus she didn't come?
"What I need to do is to let the Seductive Witch know that I am looking for treasures similar to the Seven Wonders Divine Flower, extremely desiring such treasures, willing to take risks. Then she should arrange the treasures to lure me."
Xu Yan plotted in his mind.
"Buzz!"
More than a dozen Witch Marionettes of the Duowu, their chests and bellies opening up with numerous eyes, shone their multi-eyed light upon him.
"This sinister gaze is indeed a bit strange; it can erode the will, but it's too weak."
Xu Yan shook his head; this multi-eyed sinister light could not affect him at all.
No matter the Sword Intent, the Wisdom Sword Realm, the Dragon's Might Intent, and other martial arts techniques, all could easily resist the Fall Witch's Evil Eye power.
Buzz!
A sword slashed out, black sword light annihilating all, reducing these witch marionettes to ashes in an instant.
The martial artists behind Xu Yan were now utterly astounded.
"Why do I feel that Xu Yan's strength is not inferior to the Immortal Heavenly Venerable? What martial arts cultivation technique is he practicing? It's too powerful."
"Xu Yan really kills without leaving a corpse!"
The martial artists watched as Xu Yan walked step by step deeper into the Duowu Cave.
"Could it be that Xu Yan is going to find the ancestor of the Duowu?"
"That is the real Duowu, with a hundred evil eyes extremely sinister. Even an ordinary person from the Immortal Realm cannot resist it. Isn't Xu Yan afraid of being eroded by the Evil Eye Light, turning into a waste?"
"Supreme geniuses are all so proud."
Xu Yan then killed more than a dozen witch marionettes and was not far from the core area of the Grotto.
"You're quite arrogant, kid."
A cold voice sounded.
Xu Yan held his sword calmly, looking toward the emerging figure.
"Are you the Duowu?"
"How is it that you can call upon my esteemed name?"
The Duowu gave a cold smile.
He raised his hand and pressed down with a palm.
Xu Yan chuckled coldly, the Yin Yang Undying Sword emerged, the Mountains and Rivers in the Sword displayed, directly annihilating the opponent's attack.
"I'd like to experience for myself just how powerful the Duowu's hundred-eyed sinister light really is!"
Xu Yan said arrogantly.
"To possess such strength without entering the Immortal Realm, has the Taicang Domain actually produced a genius like you? I most enjoy making geniuses fall, then I shall grant your wish!"
The Duowu was astounded.
Buzz!
Upon his chest and belly, a hundred eyes opened, their sinister gaze fixed on Xu Yan.
At this moment, Xu Yan's heart turned cold; the Duowu's Evil Eye Light was far from what those Witch Marionettes could compare to. Even he felt a bizarre power as if it would erode his will.
Buzz!
The image of mountains and rivers emerged; Xu Yan stood proudly, directly facing the Duowu's Evil Eye.
"Do you truly have a hundred eyes?"
"One, two, three..."
Xu Yan even began counting, which, seen by the Duowu, almost made him explode with rage!
"Arrogant brat!"
The Duowu's complexion turned incredibly gloomy, never before had anyone dared to so disregard his Evil Eye; this was a first!
Buzz!
On his cheeks, forehead, this moment also saw the emergence of eyes.
Each eye's gaze was different, some sad, some angry, some excited... The sinister power grew stronger, even emitting a strange light.
And Xu Yan was already enveloped by the sinister light!

chapters.title: Chapter 824 - 824: 431 is too crazy, extorting Duowu
chapters.content:
The Fall Witch's Evil Eye emitted a sinister glow, and at this moment, Xu Yan was already enveloped by the eerie light.
The group of Martial Artists trailing far behind Xu Yan frantically retreated, fearful of being touched by the Fall Witch's Evil Eye. Just a sweep of that uncanny gaze would ensure their lazy deaths with their level of power.
"Is Xu Yan finished?"
"Too careless. That's the Fall Witch after all."
The two Immortal Heavenly Venerables presiding over the Duowu Cave were now stirred and came over.
"Should we intervene?"
"It's too late!"
They had experienced the power of the Fall Witch's Evil Eye themselves; faced with the Fall Witch alone, each of them was in danger of being eroded.
Yet there was Xu Yan, within the light of the Fall Witch's Evil Eye, appearing nonchalant and unaffected. The Sudden Wind Sword Intent encircled him like a gentle breeze blowing softly.
"...seven, eight... Twenty, twenty-one..."
Xu Yan was still counting the eyes of the Fall Witch with great interest.
"You..."
The complexion of the Fall Witch changed to one of sheer shock. How could someone of a lower realm ignore the power of his evil eye?
And what was that power swirling around him?
"Who are you?"
At this moment, the eyes of the Fall Witch began to close, and the sinister light dissipated.
Continuing the assault would be futile.
A trace of wariness showed in the Fall Witch's eyes, along with a dense killing intent.
If this young one were to grow, unafraid of the evil eye's power that deterred many strong warriors, it would pose a colossal threat!
It was imperative to snuff out his life before he could grow further!
"Remember me as Sword God Xu Yan, for in the world of the Sword Dao, I am supreme!"
Xu Yan said with a smile on his face.
"Hmph! Sword God? Such an arrogant claim. Very well, let this one test your Sword Dao."
With a wave of the Fall Witch's hand, a gloomy power that seemed to corrode everything, even Spiritual Energy, was unleashed.
Xu Yan remained undaunted. The Yin Yang Undying Sword generated an endless stream of life, and the Mountain and River Myriad Manifestations emerged, commencing a battle with the Fall Witch.
Although the power of the Fall Witch was strong, even stronger than that of the Eight-leaf Heavenly Slaughter, defeating Xu Yan was an impossible task.
After a brief fight, Xu Yan vanished on the spot in an instant, and in the next moment had escaped from the battlefield, plunging into a group of Witch Marionettes nearby.
A flash of sword light and within an instant, a dozen Witch Marionettes were slain.
Enraged, the Fall Witch hastily pursued him, but after a brief exchange, Xu Yan moved again, shifting his position to continue his slaughter of the marionettes.
"The Fall Witch has met a formidable opponent!"
"Good, good, let's see if the Fall Witch can remain so arrogant!"
The Immortal Heavenly Venerables presiding over the Duowu Cave were utterly astonished at this moment.
While Xu Yan's power might not be greater than the Fall Witch's, his movement technique and speed were unexpectedly formidable, even leaving the Fall Witch helpless.
And as the Fall Witch's most potent Light of the Evil Eye proved ineffective against Xu Yan, it rendered the Fall Witch somewhat at a loss facing Xu Yan's evasive maneuvers!
"Fall Witch, do you have a Seven Wonders Divine Flower? Give me one Seven Wonders Divine Flower, or something similar, or even a more precious treasure, and I'll leave right now!"
Xu Yan stated.
"Boy, you've angered me!"
The Fall Witch's eyes glinted with ice-cold killing intent.
'Puff puff puff!'
Just as Xu Yan was about to kill more Witch Marionettes, suddenly, one after another, the marionettes exploded, transforming into a sinister force, returning to the Fall Witch's body.
"Withdraw the marionettes?"
Xu Yan raised an eyebrow and did not continue his assault. Instead, he spun around and struck with his sword, executing six sequences of the Six Paths Absolute Heavenly Sword in a single breath, the sword light obliterating everything, forcing the Fall Witch to respond cautiously.
