"Fall Witch, I'm serious. Just give me one Seven Wonders Divine Flower, or a similar heavenly and earthly treasure, and I'll leave, no longer disturbing you!"
Xu Yan said sincerely.
The Fall Witch remained silent, his form becoming misty as his speed soared in an instant, and a giant eye opened on each of his shoulders.
From the two giant eyes on his shoulders, suddenly streams of strange filaments shot out, intertwining like a spider web in all directions, aiming to trap Xu Yan within.
Whoosh!
Xu Yan arched his eyebrow. As his form shifted, he took advantage of the moment before the strange filaments intertwined and made his escape.
At this moment, the Fall Witch was incredibly malevolent.
Eyes opened one by one on his forehead and cheeks, blinking in a way that was chilling to behold.
On each shoulder, a giant eye materialized. One looked dull, the other cold and harsh. From the pupils, wisps of odd filaments flowed out.
The delicate strands wafted in mid-air, thick and numerous, extremely eerie.
Xu Yan was secretly shocked. Was this the true form of the Fall Witch?
Too uncanny!
"Fall Witch, this is where we'll stop for today. I'll come again tomorrow!"
Xu Yan retreated, quickly moving away.
"You think you can come and go as you please?"
The Fall Witch spoke coldly. With a thundering sound, a sinister light surged from his body. The filaments shooting from the eyes on his shoulders seemed to stretch infinitely, rapidly spreading towards the entrance of the Heavenly Cave, attempting to seal the exit!
"Run for it!"
The Martial Artists watching the battle were immediately filled with dread and scrambled to escape from the Heavenly Grotto.
"Act now!"
The faces of the two Immortal Heavenly Venerables stationed there changed, and they hurriedly acted to block the encroaching filaments.
Ever since the Fall Witch appeared in this Duowu Cave, they had never seen him as enraged as he was today, and they too were witnessing this state of the Fall Witch for the first time.
Boom!
The Heavenly Grotto trembled, and the power of the Heaven and Earth Laws rippled like waves.

chapters.title: Chapter 825 - 431 is too crazy, actually extorting Duowu_2
chapters.content:
```
"Not good, what is this sinister object?"
The two Immortal Heavenly Venerables were startled to find that the threads spreading from Duowu's eyes were impervious to attacks. No matter how they attacked, the threads could not be destroyed!
"Friend Xu, get out of here quickly!"
One of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables urgently advised.
"Coming!"
Xu Yan remained calm and composed, instantly arriving at the entrance of the Heavenly Grotto.
At that moment, a few threads had already crisscrossed the entrance of the Heavenly Grotto, resembling spider silk, and they were in the process of forming a web.
"Hum!"
Xu Yan raised an eyebrow, swung his sword, and with a poof, he cut through the threads, obliterating part of them.
The two Immortal Heavenly Venerables were shocked beyond measure.
"Duowu, I'm serious. Unless you give me the treasure I need, I will not let this go," Xu Yan said with a smile, looking back at Duowu.
He stepped out of the Heavenly Grotto.
Duowu watched Xu Yan leave, his face dark as night, his eyes filled with murderous intent, and a deepening sense of dread.
"What kind of Sword Dao is that? It can even destroy my Duowu threads!"
Not only was it fearless against his Evil Eye Light, but it could also cut through his Duowu threads. If Xu Yan were to grow, he would become a great threat.
You should know, these Duowu threads are a special substance, ordinary Martial Arts force cannot harm it, only Divine Spirit Soul Force could. But once the Divine Spirit Soul Force touches the Duowu threads, it would be corroded by the power of Duowu, making the Divine Soul will lazy.
This is why, those who faced his Duowu thread attacks were so wary.
Except for those with exceptionally strong Divine Souls who possessed powerful Divine Soul Secret Techniques, any strong person facing his Duowu threads would handle them with utmost caution.
And Xu Yan, with a simple wave of his hand, had cut through the Duowu threads, which meant that his Sword Dao power was immensely powerful, even capable of restraining his threads!
This child, absolutely must not be left alive!
Duowu's gaze was icy, "Taicang Domain has produced such a monstrosity, could it be that Taicang is about to have a second ruler?"
Looking at the Heavenly Grotto, he felt somewhat helpless, limited by the restrictions of this place, he could only summon a fraction of his power.
The next day, Xu Yan returned to the Duowu Cave, not uttering a word before striking and killing a batch of Witch Marionettes.
Duowu appeared in a rage, even attempting a sneak attack.
After a tangled fight, Xu Yan retreated.
"Duowu, without the Seven Wonders Divine Flower, or similar treasures, I will not cease. I'll come back tomorrow!"
Xu Yan left the Heavenly Grotto gracefully.
His goal was simple, to continuously emphasize the Seven Wonders Divine Flower to give Duowu the impression that he desired treasures of that sort.
Furthermore, to incessantly provoke Duowu, deepening his killing intent. Over time, if Duowu was acquainted with the Seductive Witch, this matter would inevitably reach her ears.
With the Seductive Witch's anger towards him, she would definitely find a way to set a trap, luring him into it.
Day after day, Xu Yan entered the Heavenly Grotto, until eventually, there were no Witch Marionettes left; Duowu had taken them all back.
In the entire Heavenly Grotto, only Duowu remained.
"Xu Yan, you've gone too far!"
Duowu roared, frantically charging over, rushing straight to the entrance of the Heavenly Grotto, startling the Immortal Heavenly Venerable stationed there who hastily acted to suppress.
Standing outside the Heavenly Grotto, Xu Yan watched Duowu rage inside with a radiant smile, "Duowu, give me the treasure I need and I'll leave right away, no longer bothering you!"
Duowu snorted coldly and turned away.
The two Immortal Heavenly Venerable looked at each other in shock. Was Xu Yan extorting Duowu?
That's just crazy!
Moreover, the two suddenly realized that it seemed Duowu was unable to leave the Heavenly Grotto?
If that was truly the case, then they wouldn't have to stand guard day and night anymore, for if Duowu couldn't leave the Heavenly Grotto, he also couldn't harm the Changyun Realm.
"Duowu, even the Seductive Witch can't leave the Heavenly Grotto, are they under some kind of restriction? Is it because they're just the force of avatars that has entered here?"
Xu Yan pondered thoughtfully.
Once again entering the Heavenly Grotto, this time Xu Yan was a bit more cautious, in case Duowu was deceitful, after all, such a strong person would have many tricks, not to be underestimated.
Unexpectedly, he found that Duowu's figure was no longer in the Heavenly Grotto.
"Duowu, where are you?"
Standing at the core of the Heavenly Grotto, Xu Yan looked up towards the entrance and called out loudly.
"What a waste!"
Xu Yan was somewhat exasperated, had Duowu really run away?
Seeing Xu Yan come out, the two Immortal Heavenly Venerables immediately tensed, closely monitoring the inside of the Heavenly Grotto, ready to counter any attack from Duowu.
"No need to be nervous, Duowu has run away, he's not in the Heavenly Grotto."
```
"Escaped?"
The two Immortal Heavenly Venerables were dumbfounded.
In the following days, Xu Yan entered the Duowu Cave every day, but did not see any sign of Duowu. It seemed that Duowu, impatient, had given up on this cave and stopped coming back.
"This Duowu is too fragile to tease."
Xu Yan was left with no choice but to acknowledge his failed plan.
"I'll make one more trip tomorrow, and if I don't see Duowu then, I'll leave the Changyun Realm."
Xu Yan made up his mind.
The next day, when Xu Yan entered the cave again, contrary to his expectations, Duowu actually appeared.
"Duowu, you dare to come?"
Xu Yan, sword in hand, looked ready to strike at any moment.
With a cold look, Duowu said, "The Seven Wonders Divine Flower is not here, but I will give you this treasure map. In the future, don't bother me again!"
He tossed over a scroll with a flick of his hand.
Xu Yan raised an eyebrow and caught the scroll, "A treasure map? Do you think I would fall for such a trick?"
Still with a cold demeanor, Duowu responded, "This is a secret location in your Domain, not only housing the Seven Wonders Divine Flower but also a stalk of Yu Zhu. It is said to be a treasure of heaven and earth, and I came upon it by chance thousands of years ago. If not for this cave's secret location being inaccessible from the outside sky, would I have given it to you so easily?"
"Really?"
"I never deceive. Here's the map, now stop bothering me."
After speaking, Duowu ignored Xu Yan and sat cross-legged at the core of the cave, closing his eyes to cultivate his spirit.
"I'll trust you this once!"
Xu Yan said, delighted.
He opened the scroll and looked at it, a satisfied smile on his face.
"Seductive Witch, was this your arrangement?"
Xu Yan was inwardly excited, his plan had succeeded.
However, this cave's secret location was bound to be extremely dangerous; it was likely that not only the Seductive Witch, but Duowu might also be lying in wait.
"Always appear with strength beyond your expectations!"
The breakthrough to the Perfection of the Physiognomy Realm would not be too far away, and the cave allowed only a certain level of strength for entrants.
Once he had achieved Perfection in the Physiognomy Realm, even the top Immortal Heavenly Venerables would not be feared, and he might even be able to defeat them.
With his numerous Martial Arts techniques, dealing with potential crises should pose no problem at all.
"Seductive Witch, don't disappoint me!"
Xu Yan left contentedly.
Opening his eyes, Duowu watched Xu Yan's departing figure, his gaze undisguised with chilling intent to kill.
"Boy, since you lust for treasures of heaven and earth, then let them be your burial items. Burying a monster from Taicang with a bit of those treasures is worth it."
Xu Yan's survival left a sense of unease in his heart.
A Taicang Martial Artist who was not affected by his Evil Eye Light and could easily annihilate his witchcraft was always a huge hidden danger, no matter how far the current strength of the other party was from his own.
But, after all, it was a potential threat.
Xu Yan came out of the cave and closely examined the opened scroll.
"Guang You Realm?"
The cave's secret location recorded on the treasure map was situated in the Guang You Realm, beneath a deep abyssal marsh, very hidden.
"The Guang You Realm is quite a distance from the Changyun Realm; on this journey, I'll try to accumulate some treasures. In two to three years, I should be able to reach the Guang You Realm. Let the Seductive Witch wait for me a bit longer."
Xu Yan estimated that on his travels through various realms, accumulating treasures and undergoing trials, it would take him two to three years to reach the Guang You Realm.
Of course, if he were to head directly to the Guang You Realm, merely traversing a few realms, it would be much quicker, but that was not in line with Xu Yan's goal of undergoing trials.
In every realm he visited, he would certainly go to the cave to undergo trials and gather unique treasures of the realms.
Packing away the treasure map, Xu Yan was about to go find Luo Zhan to get information on the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow division, but Luo Zhan had already sought him out first.
"Friend Xu, here's what you need—the concealed roster of Earth Shadows. For now, we've only confirmed these six; the rest are dead."
Luo Zhan handed a list to Xu Yan.
"Six, that should be enough."
Xu Yan took the list, ready to take revenge on Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow. By controlling these six Earth Shadows as a foundation, he planned to continuously expand the number of controlled individuals.
It was just a matter of using the method he had employed at Dahai Mountain in the Nine Mountain Realm once more, a technique with which Xu Yan was already uncommonly proficient.
"Friend Xu..."
Luo Zhan began to speak but suddenly his expression dramatically changed, his aura surged, and he grasped the Wolf Fang Club in his hands, abruptly looking up to the sky!
Two figures descended, their presence malignant, bringing Luo Zhan a strong sense of crisis.
The newcomers wore Ferocious Masks emblazoned with nine slender leaves on the visage!

chapters.title: Chapter 826 - 432: Master Arrives, A Shocked Luo Zhan
chapters.content:
Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughter!
Xu Yan's heart chilled. The appearance of two Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughter assassins indicated the serious attention he commanded and their intense determination to kill him.
"Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughter?!"
Luo Zhan's gaze turned icy, and his aura grew stronger and stronger. Even if the enemy's power surpassed his own, there was not the slightest trace of fear or retreat in him—rather, his fighting spirit soared.
"Good, very good. To kill me, Luo Zhan, you've brought two Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughter assassins. Do you think just because you've hidden yourselves well enough, my Battle Hall can't find you?"
"Try to kill me if you dare, and let's see if you can withstand the wrath of the Battle Hall after killing me!"
At this moment, Luo Zhan exhibited no intention to retreat; he was even prepared for a fight to the death, willing to make the enemy pay, even if it cost him his own life.
The desperate secret technique was already charged and ready to strike!
Martial Artists of the Battle Hall never fear battle—the stronger the enemy, the more resolute their fighting spirit!
A Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughter, with a sinister voice, said, "Luo Zhan, you overestimate yourself too much. We came here to kill Xu Yan, not you. You're not worth our effort. Step aside."
Luo Zhan's face turned instantly red, resembling the color of a liver, his breathing turned heavy, and his eyes bloodshot.
Humiliation!
This was humiliation!
The two Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughter had come for Xu Yan, not for him?
The contempt in their tone revealed that they didn't consider him worthy at all.
Luo Zhan felt as if he'd been trampled upon—a feeling that inflamed his anger. He, an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, was being belittled.
In their eyes, was he even less than Xu Yan, a Martial Artist who had not yet reached the Immortal Realm?
This was outrageous!
"Want to kill Xu Yan? Do you think you're worthy? Deal with me first!"
Luo Zhan roared.
No matter what, he would not retreat now, for if he did, Luo Zhan's face and unyielding spirit would be utterly crushed to dust!
Xu Yan looked at Luo Zhan in surprise. Facing two formidable opponents, he did not shrink back and was ready to fight for him?
"I, Xu Yan, owe no favors. There's no need to involve Luo Zhan!"
With this thought, Xu Yan tried to persuade him, "Elder Brother Luo, they aren't here for you. There's no need for you to fight. You should leave!"
"No!"
Luo Zhan said decisively, "The Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow has gone too far. Even if it means death, I, Luo Zhan, won't back down!"
Xu Yan sighed internally—Luo Zhan was indeed a man of temperament.
"Elder Brother Luo, really, there's no need. These two may not be able to do anything to me."
Xu Yan continued to persuade.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow has plotted against the Battle Hall, and we have a score to settle. Don't worry, Xu young brother, I will surely fend them off. You go first!"
Luo Zhan was determined to fight.
The Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughter's insolence was intolerable—they had completely disregarded him. If he retreated now, where would Luo Zhan's face be?
He would rather die than lose face!
"Luo Zhan, if you seek death, then so be it. Do you really think the Battle Hall can trouble us?"
One of the Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughter spoke coldly.
Boom!
A chill aura burst forth in an instant, and in just a moment, the Domain had been controlled, the Power of Domain Laws descending.
Thunderous boom!
A sinister light enveloped the area, wielding immense power to seal the Domain.
Luo Zhan growled lowly, his aura erupting, yet he was suppressed, unable to wrestle away the controlling power of this Domain.
"Very strong!"
Xu Yan's heart was chilled; these two Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughter were no weaker than Emperor Da Yue.
The cold breath permeated the Domain, and the two Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughter, working together, took control of this Domain, seemingly freezing it solid.
A powerful Domain Power converged here, forming an imprisoning area.
They intended to completely seal off this Domain to prevent his escape.
Xu Yan's expression was unchanging, Sword Intent surged around him, and the Mountain and River Physiognomy emerged, ready to tear apart this imprisoning domain and flee.
"With the sharpness of my Supreme Heavenly Sword, breaking through the imprisonment in an instant is not a big problem, enough for me to escape."
Xu Yan estimated in his mind.
"Elder Brother Luo is also resisting the enemy's power, taking away some of it. If I flee now, they won't be bent on killing Luo Zhan."
Xu Yan had a plan in mind.
If he fled, the two Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughter would surely pursue him, and Luo Zhan would be safe.
Even facing two Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughter, Xu Yan was not worried at all. Even if he couldn't escape, he still had his master's Jade Talisman, which would ensure he remained unharmed.
"Xu Yan, don't even think of escaping."
One of the Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughter, seemingly sensing Xu Yan's intentions, sneered.
With a wave of his hand, a buzzing sound, a Divine Artifact appeared and merged with the Domain. Suddenly, a dome of light fell down, enveloping this Domain within.
"Using such a Divine Artifact, you Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow really value Xu Yan highly!"
Luo Zhan felt a chill in his heart, yet he spoke with a sneer.
At this moment, despite his rage, Luo Zhan couldn't help but marvel at the lengths to which Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow had gone to kill Xu Yan.
Even a Divine Artifact capable of sealing a Domain was used.
Such artifacts are incredibly precious, and only the Immortal Heavenly Venerable could wield them. The use of such artifacts was always to imprison invaders of the Heavenly Grotto within a Domain to prevent them from spreading and slaughtering everywhere.
For Xu Yan's sake, Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow had even employed such an artifact, which signified that the forces behind them were far from simple.

chapters.title: Chapter 827 - 432: Master Descends, A Shocked Luo Zhan_2
chapters.content:
Not all major forces possess Divine Artifacts capable of sealing a domain of heaven and earth.
Only Great Realm forces have the ability and can forge such artifacts.
Powerful as Battle Hall is, they possess few of such Divine Artifacts, and each one is held by the very top few within Battle Hall.
"Xu Yan, don't even think about escaping today, stop your futile resistance."
A Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughter spoke coldly.
"Xu my friend, I will use a secret technique to stimulate the Divine Artifact in my hand, which can tear open a rift, but it will only last a moment. Seize the opportunity to escape!"
Luo Zhan took a deep breath, his expression resolute, and transmitted his voice to Xu Yan.
Xu Yan's eyebrows twitched, knowing that the secret technique Luo Zhan was going to use must come at a great price, that even if it didn't cost him his life, he would be ruined.
"Brother Luo, there's no need to go to such lengths. I, Xu Yan, have some trump cards left, and two Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughters are not enough to threaten me."
Xu Yan transmitted his voice back.
He didn't want to owe favors, for once owed, they must be repaid.
Moreover, even though the Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughter was indeed powerful and even used a Divine Artifact to seal this domain, preventing his escape, he had his master's Jade Talisman, which could easily annihilate the enemy.
The might of a Divine Artifact's seal had its limits and, faced with his master's Jade Talisman, it was no more than paper.
Boom!
A cold aura surged throughout the domain, and an intense killing intent converged as the two Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughters prepared to strike.
Even though they had already sealed the domain and were stronger than Xu Yan, they still joined forces to deliver a killing blow.
This revealed just how much they valued Xu Yan and their determination to kill him.
Luo Zhan wanted to say something when, suddenly, a figure descended.
The luminous dome sealing the domain melted away in an instant, and the domain was restored, the power wielded by the two Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughters completely dissipated.
Luo Zhan was shocked. Who was this powerful being?
The two Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughters, also shocked, turned to look at the person who had just appeared.
The newcomer appeared young, holding a Jade Ruyi, looking casual and at ease, yet mysterious and ethereal, as if not belonging to this world.
"Master!"
Xu Yan was startled and then promptly greeted with joy.
Luo Zhan was staggered. Xu Yan's master?
Indeed, with Xu Yan's exceptional talent, there must be a powerful person backing him, but now that he had seen him, he was deeply astounded.
What realm was this powerful being from?
Above the Immortal Realm?
Or perhaps, far exceeding the Immortal Realm?
To attempt an assassination on such a powerful person's disciple was simply seeking death!
"Hmm!"
Li Xuan nodded.
Using the Martial Arts connection he shared with Xu Yan, he stepped forth and displayed Divine Skills, instantly arriving where Xu Yan was.
It just so happened that Xu Yan was facing an assassination attempt.
The two Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughters, with power not inferior to Emperor Da Yue's Immortal Heavenly Venerables, even utilized a treasure to seal the domain.
This demonstrated how much they valued Xu Yan and their determined intent to kill.
"Not good, let's go!"
The two Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughters panicked at that moment.
The artifact they had used to seal the domain shattered the instant the powerful being arrived, and he hadn't even revealed a trace of his power.
Such was the terror invoked by this powerful figure!
The two Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughters moved to escape.
Li Xuan merely glanced indifferently at them while the two Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughters, just about to flee, suddenly stopped in place.
In the astonished eyes of Luo Zhan, the halted Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughters turned to ash with a gust of wind and vanished altogether.
Even the ash could not remain, utterly turning into nothing.
Gulp!
Luo Zhan felt his heart trembling, his whole body slightly shaking as he stared, his eyes full of shock.
With just a glance, two top Immortal Heavenly Venerables were utterly eliminated.
How terrifying was this figure?
And Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow dared to scheme against the disciple of such a formidable existence; did they not fear, that by provoking him, he would eradicate Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow completely?
Or, was it the purpose of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow to provoke this terrifying being?
Such a mighty existence, if truly provoked into action, no power in the Divine Realm could stand against him.
Thinking of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, who lurked within the major powers, it would inevitably drag these forces into the fray.
Between the lines, Luo Zhan seemed to understand the purpose of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
However, what he didn't understand was whether the figure behind Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow had so much confidence to contend with this horrific existence?
"Perhaps, Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow has underestimated the strength of this powerful being!"
Luo Zhan thought to himself.
Li Xuan didn't know what Luo Zhan was thinking. Seeing him stand there in shock, he paid him no mind.
With his hands clasped behind his back, he strolled leisurely away.
Those mere two Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughters, with but a glance from his Eye of the Heavenly Dao, he could utterly annihilate them.
To him, they were less significant than ants.
"Master, why have you come?"
Xu Yan asked excitedly.
"Just taking a walk, and incidentally, to impart to you the martial arts techniques beyond the Domain Realm."
Li Xuan said with a smile.
"Everything is within Master's control."
Xu Yan inwardly sighed with admiration.
He had just begun to comprehend the Domain Martial Arts Law, and his master already knew, a sign that his master grasped his cultivation like the back of his hand.
"How powerful is Master, exactly!"
Xu Yan sighed with marvel.
"Yes, Master, I will definitely practice diligently to swiftly comprehend the Martial Arts Techniques."
Xu Yan said respectfully.
Following closely behind his master, he observed his master's carefree stride—free and unrestrained—just as when they had first met in the little mountain village, his master's effortless demeanor.
"The Dao is natural; this is it!"
Xu Yan thought to himself, his master's every move was a demonstration of the philosophy of 'the Dao being natural.'
"It's too profound, with my current realm, I can't fully understand what it means for the Dao to be natural!"
Xu Yan felt ashamed in his heart.
"I am not far from the Void-breaking Realm, yet the concept of the Dao being natural is still so distant from me!"
Xu Yan reflected, realizing he had a long way to go to emulate his master's level.
"Disciple, do you have any doubts regarding martial arts?"
Li Xuan asked while walking.
With his current realm, especially after having insight into the Taicang Domain, he could clarify any martial arts doubts Xu Yan might have.
This was confidence!
He had moved past the stage of making things up and bluffing.
"Master, I do have some doubts..."
Xu Yan's heart leapt with joy at this rare opportunity, and he began to express the quandaries in his mind one by one.
Li Xuan listened in silence, occasionally nodding his head, his lips twitching slightly. He had thought that he could answer all of his disciple's queries without resorting to obscure and profound answers.
However, he had been careless!
There were questions even his current martial arts realm couldn't address properly, forcing him to resort to obscure and profound answers once more.
"...Disciple, do you understand now?"
After providing explanations, Li Xuan inquired.
Xu Yan pondered, "Master, I have gained some understanding."
"Hmm, reflect on it well. The Martial Arts Endless Realm, as one advances further, each person's comprehension of martial arts will differ.
"I don't wish for you, my disciple, to merely follow in my footsteps, but rather, I hope you can forge your own path atop the ones I have laid out."
Li Xuan once again instilled in his disciple the philosophy of pursuing his own path in martial arts.
"Yes, Master!"
Xu Yan responded respectfully.
After that, Li Xuan imparted further guidance on Xu Yan's martial arts, particularly Divine Skills, giving him an even more perfected version of the Divine Skill Martial Code.
He also passed on the Dharma of the Eye of the Heavenly Dao to Xu Yan, and as for when Xu Yan could cultivate it, Li Xuan was in no rush.
After all, he already possessed the Eye of the Heavenly Dao.
Xu Yan then started recounting his adventures in the Divine Realm, including his encounter with the Seductive Witch and treasures like the Seven Wonders Divine Flower.
Li Xuan's lips twitched; Xu Yan was quite something, probably having incurred the deep animosity of the Seductive Witch!
"It's a bit of pressure, indeed, with her strength so great. With my current Domain Realm strength, can I contend against her?"
But within the Taicang Domain, Li Xuan feared nothing, especially since the true body of the Seductive Witch couldn't enter the Taicang Domain.
Her mere avatar was of no concern.
And Xu Yan, he even had his eyes on the Seductive Witch's treasure, planning to bamboozle another treasure from her clutches.
"The treasures of such a formidable being like the Seductive Witch are certainly extraordinary. Since we've already incurred her wrath thoroughly, there's no need for courtesy."
Li Xuan muttered to himself, supporting Xu Yan's approach.
Moreover, Xu Yan's rapid comprehension of the Domain Martial Arts Law had been aided by the Seven Wonders Divine Flower.
"Disciple, I will now impart to you the martial arts techniques that surpass the Domain Realm."
Li Xuan stopped at the summit of a mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 828 - 433 Establishing One's Own Way, Establishing the Way of Domain
chapters.content:
```
Above the Domain Realm, the Martial Arts Techniques!
Xu Yan, overwhelmed with excitement, said reverently, "Thank you, Master, your disciple will surely comprehend it soon!"
"Hmm."
Li Xuan's eyes were profound, as if piercing through all things in heaven and earth.
"In the Domain Realm, the body is the domain, the Martial Arts Divine Skill is the principle, I am the Domain, the Domain is me. Have you, my disciple, gained any insights into the Domain while walking through it?
"How do you view this Domain, and how is it similar or different from the Martial Arts Domain you've comprehended?"
Upon hearing this, Xu Yan was startled and fell into deep thought.
"The body as the Domain, how is my Martial Arts Domain the same or different from the great Domain we reside in?"
As he pondered, Xu Yan gained some enlightenment.
"Taicang Martial Artists, without the Domain Realm's techniques, refine the Heaven and Earth Laws where they reside, whereas my Domain Realm involves cultivating my own Martial Arts Domain.
"I have my own Domain, and I will eventually transcend the Domain I reside in and become a Domain unto myself..."
Xu Yan's enlightenment deepened, and his understanding of the Domain Realm grew.
He then thought of Divine Skills.
Divine Skills are the principles of a martial artist's self, and since they are the principles of one's own Domain, does this mean that after the Domain Realm, one can cultivate any Divine Skill as one pleases?
If the Divine Skills born from oneself are seen as principles for Innate Warriors and the Divine Skills cultivated later belong to Acquired Warriors, does this imply that the more one cultivates and perceives Divine Skills, the more principles one's own Domain will possess?
Even focusing exclusively on one Divine Skill, making one's own Domain have only one unique principle and refining this Divine Skill or the principle of one's own Domain to the ultimate level is also extremely powerful.
"Master, this Domain operates by its own laws, while my Domain Realm ultimately lacks the laws that govern the operation of the Domain, making it a false Domain, not quite real.
"Yet my Domain has infinite possibilities, capable of continuous expansion and elevation, and one day it may be no different from the true Domain."
Xu Yan said with a bright and earnest gaze.
Li Xuan nodded with satisfaction, as Xu Yan's perception of the Domain Realm had improved, which brought some changes to his Domain Realm strength.
"The Domain has its origin and its Dao Principles; it is alive, filled with vitality, hence all things in the world exist.
"The Domain has its way; all living beings come to understand it. Those who acquire it transcend the common and step onto the path of seeking the great Way of Domain.
"In pursuing the great Way of Domain, comprehending the great Way of Domain, drawing on the Domain as the source and the force, yet also being trapped by the Domain, unable to transcend the Domain.
"The Martial Arts I pass on to you are based on the Domain as the foundation, with the Domain as the aid, ultimately to transcend the Domain, transcend all things in the world, free from all restraints, roaming freely within the great Dao.
"The great Dao is obscure and vast, rootless and trackless; for those who feel the great Dao, heaven, earth, and all realms are contained in a single thought; for those who obtain the great Dao, a single thought gives rise to life, a single thought extinguishes life..."
Li Xuan's eyes were profound, a mysterious aura swirling about him, unfathomable. As he spoke, his words were enigmatic, outlining the concept of the Dao in an abstruse and profound manner.
He further expanded and elevated the path of Martial Arts, laying the foundation for Xu Yan.
As for the great Dao?
Obscure and vast, omnipresent yet invisible, the way of comprehension depends entirely on Xu Yan.
Li Xuan believed that with this foundation set in place, Xu Yan's realm would be sufficient, and he would naturally come to comprehend it.
Xu Yan felt that his master's words were extremely profound and enigmatic. He vaguely sensed an enlightening truth washing over him, gaining a fuzzy concept of the great Dao and all things in the universe.
It seemed that even a slight insight would be of endless benefit.
Li Xuan fiddled with the Jade Ruyi in his hand, allowing Xu Yan to digest the mysterious discourse he had just provided.
"...For those who feel the great Dao, heaven, earth, and all realms are contained in a single thought; for those who obtain the great Dao, a single thought gives rise to life, a single thought extinguishes life..."
Xu Yan's heart was profoundly shaken.
What a state this was.
"Master's realm is once again beyond my imagination. What level is this? Has Master obtained the great Dao? Or is it something even stronger?"
Xu Yan sighed in admiration, no wonder Master said that ants were not worthy of his remembrance!
With Master's realm and strength, even that majestic figure I saw in the wilderness seemed minuscule in comparison.
"I'm not even in the Void-breaking Realm, too weak, even less than an ant!"
Xu Yan felt ashamed, but then he was immediately invigorated, "My modest goal is to transcend the Domain, to be on a par with and even surpass that mighty figure; the next goal is to obtain the great Dao!
"Starting now, I will try to comprehend the obscure and vast great Dao. If I can perceive even a trace, it will be of endless benefit, laying a solid foundation for obtaining the great Dao!"
Xu Yan's entire being was boiling with enthusiasm.
"Master, your disciple will definitely practice diligently, walk the world, comprehend the Dao, and one day, I will surely obtain the great Dao!"
Li Xuan nodded with a look of gratification.
"Good, I believe you can do it."
"I will not disappoint you, Master!"
Xu Yan said respectfully.
"Good, very good!"
Li Xuan was immensely satisfied.
"Next, I will teach you the Martial Arts Techniques that are above the Domain Realm, the Domain Realm has its Domain, how can it be without the Way of Domain?
"Hence, above the Domain Realm, is the Establishing Dao Realm!
"The one who Establishes Dao, establishes one's own Dao, the Dao of the Domain...!"
The Establishing Dao Realm!
This was a realm that Li Xuan had meticulously considered and established after repeated deliberation and adjustment.
It was also the beginning of the subsequent path of Martial Arts, concerning the future direction of Martial Arts.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 829 - 433 Establishing One's Own Way, Establishing the Way of Domain_2
chapters.content:
```
Once the Establishing Dao Realm is established, the subsequent path of Martial Arts is already formed.
"The Way of Domain has its Dao Principles, operating endlessly. Establishing one's own Dao, truly establishing it, a Dao belonging to oneself, establishing the Dao principles of one's own Domain...
"The Taicang Domain Dao Principles are the eventually endless operation, and also the core of the Domain Origin..."
Li Xuan began to teach Xu Yan the methods of Martial Arts Techniques in the Establishing Dao Realm.
The Establishing Dao Realm, how to establish one's own Dao?
Li Xuan already had a roughly complete method; of course, the specifics of how to establish it also depended on Xu Yan's own comprehension.
After insight into the Domain Origin and the Taicang Domain Dao Principles, Li Xuan had a rough cultivation method and direction for how to establish the Dao.
The reason why he did not simply copy the Taicang Daoism was naturally to transcend the Taicang Domain, to embark on a broader path of Martial Arts; otherwise, without stepping out of the framework of Taicang Domain Dao Principles, it would be difficult to surpass the Taicang Domain.
Li Xuan's goal was to transcend the Domain and to be stronger than the entire power of the Taicang Domain.
Although it might be possible to transcend the Taicang Domain and step out of its framework by simply copying the Taicang Domain Dao Principles, it would ultimately lack distinctiveness.
What Li Xuan needed was to reference the Taicang Domain Dao Principles and create his own methods for the Establishing Dao Realm. Given Xu Yan's monstrous comprehension and unconventional thinking, he would surely be able to grasp it.
The Establishing Dao Realm, establish one's own Dao, establish the Dao of one's own Domain.
"...Establish one's Dao, with one's Domain Dao, resonate with the mysterious and boundless Great Dao..."
After explaining the Establishing Dao Realm in detail, Li Xuan waited a moment and then once again explained it from beginning to end in detail.
Xu Yan silently memorized and pondered upon it.
The Martial Arts Techniques in the Establishing Dao Realm were profound and abstruse. Even though Xu Yan had already comprehended the Domain Martial Arts Law, the subtleties of the Establishing Dao Realm were still extremely profound for him.
So, Li Xuan silently waited for Xu Yan to digest the information for some time.
When Xu Yan had almost fully assimilated it, Li Xuan spoke again, explaining the techniques of the Establishing Dao Martial Arts once more.
He particularly emphasized the part about the Dao Principles of the Domain.
"Disciple, have you remembered it all?"
After three repetitions, Li Xuan asked.
"Master, I have remembered it!"
Xu Yan said respectfully.
"Good, very good!"
Li Xuan nodded with satisfaction.
"Establishing Dao Realm, ah, having established one's Dao, one truly begins to have the strength to create their own Dao lineage. Without establishing one's Dao, there is no qualification to pass on one's Dao lineage."
Li Xuan said, smiling.
Xu Yan was stunned. Only in the Establishing Dao Realm did one initially have the strength to create their own Dao lineage?
"I understand now, Master!"
Xu Yan said solemnly, nodding.
Without entering the Establishing Dao, one simply did not have the qualifications to create their own Dao lineage.
"So, those great powers in the Divine Realm are merely single-sided Martial Arts powers, not a lineage of Dao!"
Xu Yan came to a sudden realization.
"The Divine Realm is in chaos, the changes in the Domain have already begun, and it is a good time for the geniuses to rise. As for Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, you will handle it yourself."
Li Xuan spoke unhurriedly.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, such vermin, how could my master need to act? It would dirty Master's hands."
Xu Yan nodded. The likes of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, who merely skulked about, were not worthy of his master's intervention.
Furthermore, if he needed to bother Master with every small thing, would it not be disgraceful to his master?
Li Xuan nodded in approval and said, "You have already achieved great success in the Physiognomy Realm, and the Void-breaking Realm is not far. As for your plans to obtain treasures from the Seductive Witch, just be cautious."
"As I've said, a true Martial Artist is not a brute. The Martial Arts are manifold and Divine Skills numerous; there shall always be moments to use them."
"The path of Martial Arts is also fraught with schemes and deceptions, full of various calculations and traps..."
Li Xuan imparted some more Martial Arts wisdom to his disciple.
Although he had not roamed the Martial Arts Realm much, the vast experiences relayed back by his disciples had made him an old hand in the Martial Arts world.
The various experiences and tactics, he was not lacking at all.
He was far more astute than Xu Yan and his fellow disciples.
"Yes, Master, I will definitely keep it in mind!"
Xu Yan exclaimed, feeling honored to have such a master, who with just a bit of guidance, gave him strategies for the Martial Arts that he had never considered before.
"Well, continue to work hard."
Li Xuan nodded, raising his hand to instantly enhance Xu Yan's Life-saving Jade Charm.
```
After pondering for a moment, Li Xuan raised his hand and pointed, and a large tree instantly condensed into a small wooden sword. The sword was engraved with intricate patterns, profound and unfathomable.
This sword, though made of wood, was like the holy grail of swords. Even Xu Yan felt that he had no desire to unsheathe his sword in its presence.
The wooden sword eventually looked ordinary, unremarkable as if it were just a common wooden sword, and the aura of the holy grail of swords had also vanished.
"If you encounter the Seductive Witch, stab her with this sword."
Li Xuan handed the small wooden sword to Xu Yan.
Since his disciple was going to trap the Seductive Witch, and they had already become mortal enemies with her, surely she must hate them to death by now, so there was no need for courtesy.
This sword contained the power of the Domain Realm, as well as Li Xuan's Sword Dao intent. The purpose was not to kill the Seductive Witch's avatar but to have the avatar take this sword back to the Seductive Witch's true body.
He also wanted to trap the Seductive Witch and take the opportunity to gauge her strength.
If the Seductive Witch's strength was not enough, then she would die.
If her strength was sufficient that she would not die, once the Seductive Witch entered the Taicang Domain, he could detect her instantly.
"My holy sword intent is extremely mysterious, I don't believe you can dispel it."
Li Xuan thought silently to himself.
"My disciple, after you have stabbed the Seductive Witch with this sword, let her go, don't kill her."
Li Xuan instructed.
If Xu Yan took advantage of the moment the Seductive Witch was stabbed by the wooden sword to kill her avatar, then the plan would fail, and they wouldn't be able to trap the Seductive Witch.
"Master, why?"
Xu Yan was puzzled.
"What's the point of killing a power avatar? Your master wants to teach her a small lesson. I will have her avatar take this sword back..."
Li Xuan said with a radiant smile.
Xu Yan was momentarily stunned, somehow feeling at that moment that his master seemed somewhat scheming. This was a trap for the Seductive Witch!
Suddenly it dawned on him, no wonder his master had emphasized time and again that a true martial artist is not a brute!
"Perhaps the master has been invincible for too long, too lonely, and thus he has developed a fondness for teasing, as a pastime."
Xu Yan sighed to himself, the realm of his master was too high, and he could easily toy with a powerful entity like the Seductive Witch.
"Master, I understand!"
Xu Yan nodded his head.
The Seductive Witch was in for misfortune!
"Yes, wander the world and gain more insights."
Li Xuan left with a leisurely pace. Since he had already come out, he would have to meet Meng Chong to instruct him and transmit to him the cultivation methods of the Physical Body Martial Arts that followed the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body.
He also had to meet Jiang Buping, to give him some pointers and also to strengthen his disciple's Life-saving Jade Charm.
"With my current strength, and control over the Taicang Domain Dao Principles, within the Divine Realm, whoever activates the jade charm, I can directly mobilize the power of the Taicang Dao Principles to protect them."
Li Xuan thought, so far, no one had triggered the Life-saving Jade Charm that he had given.
At this moment, Xu Yan was brimming with excitement, "To break through to the perfection of the Physiognomy Realm soon, and then to the Void-breaking Realm. Once in the Void-breaking Realm, I can go wherever I please in the Divine Realm. And with the current chaos in the Divine Realm, it's a perfect opportunity to temper myself.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, you are also a good target. Let's see what Xu Yan is capable of!"
Returning to where he was supposed to meet Luo Zhan, Luo Zhan was still waiting.
"Brother Luo Zhan, thank you so much for this time."
Xu Yan said with a smile.
Regardless, Luo Zhan was indeed ready to take action for him, to fend off the two Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughters.
Even though, even without the arrival of his master, Luo Zhan wouldn't have needed to take action in the end, his good intentions still had to be acknowledged.
"I dare not!"
Luo Zhan hastily waved his hands.
Now that the mysterious senior had left, he felt a bit of regret but also a breath of relief.
The pressure from being in the presence of that senior was simply too great.
"Brother Luo Zhan, I now know the names on the Earth Shadow list. It won't be long before I try to get some information from them about the branches of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow. Then I will trouble the Battle Hall to take action."
Xu Yan handed a Communication Talisman to Luo Zhan, saying, "This is a Communication Talisman, you can get in touch no matter where you are in the Divine Realm, and I will pass the information on to you."
Luo Zhan looked at the Communication Talisman in his hand, shocked, "You can get in contact anywhere within the Divine Realm?"
But after a moment's thought, it was only natural for such a treasure to exist given the strength of that senior.
"Yes!"
Xu Yan nodded his head, took out another Communication Talisman, and gave it to Luo Zhan, saying, "This Communication Talisman is for you, Brother Luo Zhan, to facilitate your communication with the Battle Hall."
He then explained the use of the Communication Talisman to Luo Zhan.

chapters.title: Chapter 830 - 434: Meng Chong Advises Song You on Revenge
chapters.content:
"The Wanbao Alliance really holds me in high regard!"
Meng Chong cursed as he fled from the city, with two Immortal Heavenly Venerables hot on his heels, intent on killing him.
"I almost had it; I'll have to be more careful next time; the Wanbao Alliance is really out to get me."
Meng Chong swiftly continued his escape.
He had just been about to loot the Wanbao Alliance Branch in the city when he discovered an ambush by an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, forcing him to flee.
"Meng Chong, don't even think about escaping!"
One of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables called out with a chilling killing intent.
"You all from the Wanbao Alliance, now that you already know that it wasn't me who killed him, yet you still insist on hunting me down, if you don't want to reconcile, then don't blame me, Meng Chong, for what comes next."
Meng Chong sneered coldly, by now the Wanbao Alliance must surely know that he was not the killer.
"Meng Chong, for looting our Wanbao Alliance Branch, how can we overlook such a matter!"
"What a joke, wasn't it you, the Wanbao Alliance, who targeted me first? Who wrongly accused me first? Shouldn't there be compensation? That was the reparations for your false accusations against me!"
"Hmph!"
The two Immortal Heavenly Venerables snorted coldly, continuing their frenzied pursuit.
Meng Chong looked back, shook his head, and his speed suddenly surged, quickly shaking off the pursuers.
"The Changyun Realm is no longer safe to stay in."
Meng Chong sighed. With the Wanbao Alliance deploying two Immortal Heavenly Venerables, it was foreseeable that if they did not catch him soon, perhaps Yan Shanhe himself might take action next.
Or alternatively, they could deploy multiple Immortal Heavenly Venerables, and once he showed himself, he could easily be surrounded.
"Forget it, I've amassed quite a collection of treasures, let's leave the Changyun Realm. Once I make a breakthrough, I'll no longer fear the Wanbao Alliance's Immortal Heavenly Venerables."
Meng Chong shook his head.
After putting on a wig and altering his appearance, he prepared to leave the Changyun Realm.
"With my current disguise, I wonder if I can fool the Immortal Heavenly Venerables at the Realm Gate?"
Meng Chong muttered to himself.
"With my control over the body, they surely won't detect any changes. Meng Chong is bald while I have a head full of thick hair; no way anyone thinks I'm Meng Chong."
Meng Chong decided to head straight for the Changyun City, where the Realm Gate was located, to cross the gate and leave.
If indeed the defenses were tight and there was a risk of exposure, he would then choose to traverse the wilderness to make his escape.
With that plan in mind, Meng Chong started his journey toward the Changyun City, where the Realm Gate was situated.
Along the way, passing through several cities, the bounty on him increased yet again.
Moreover, everyone entering the cities was scrutinized carefully.
"The Wanbao Alliance really is rolling in wealth!"
Meng Chong couldn't help but exclaim.
True to being the number one commerce alliance in the Divine Realm, the bounty was so high that even he was tempted.
Not far from Changyun City, Meng Chong became cautious. The Wanbao Alliance would definitely conduct thorough searches in Changyun City to prevent his escape.
Moreover, all the powerful forces of the Changyun Realm had joined in on the search.
"You won't escape, today is the day you die!"
Suddenly, a cold voice rang out.
Then came a series of sounds of battle. A young man was fighting and fleeing at the same time, in a very sorry state, already wounded.
"Do you really have to push things to the bitter end?"
"Song You, as long as you live, you remain a threat, and we won't be at ease until you're dead."
"Don't even dream of escaping the Changyun Realm. Even if you somehow manage to flee the Changyun Realm, as long as you are within the territories of the Wanbao Alliance, we will quickly find your tracks."
Meng Chong raised an eyebrow. The Martial Artists surrounding and attacking Song You, judging by their attire, seemed to belong to one of the Wanbao Alliance's subordinate forces, and this force had warriors who had been investigating his whereabouts.
"Since it's related to the Wanbao Alliance, I might have to step in."
Meng Chong pondered.
He looked around with his eyes, saw no Immortal Heavenly Venerable hiding nor an ambush set up. This pursuit didn't seem to be a trap.
The three in the fight were all at the True King Heavenly Venerable Peak. Song You wasn't weak among True King Heavenly Venerables, but facing two against one was still too much for him.
Moreover, he was wounded, having gone through several battles, it looked like he had been ambushed more than once and didn't have time to heal.
Boom!
Meng Chong suddenly made his move, a punch thundered out, instantly blasting apart one of the assailants chasing Song You!
This unexpected development astonished the other Martial Artist who was after Song You.
And Song You himself was dumbfounded, breaking into a cold sweat, but then he became immensely excited.
The newcomer wasn't an enemy!
"Who are you, daring to interfere with our Song Family..."
The remaining Martial Artist said, retreating while speaking aggressively.
However, before he could finish, he realized that the one who took action was a bald young man, with an incredibly robust build.
He exclaimed in shock, "You, you're Meng Chong!"
His heart trembled with fear, it was Meng Chong who had intervened, a veritable god of slaughter. Apart from Immortal Heavenly Venerable powerhouses, no one could match him.
True King Heavenly Venerables were like chicks in his hands, able to be burst with a single punch.
Escape!
At this moment, how could he dare to threaten with the name of the Song Family?
This was the man who feared not even the Wanbao Alliance, much less a mere subordinate force of it.
As Meng Chong struck, he had already removed his wig, revealing his true appearance.
"Do you think you can escape?"
Another punch thundered out, blasting the other fleeing Martial Artist on the spot!
Gulp!
Song You was stunned. Those were True King Heavenly Venerable Peak martial artists, and yet Meng Chong was taking them out with single punches, one after another?
The rumors said Meng Chong alone had killed dozens of True King Heavenly Venerables surrounding him. He had thought it was an exaggeration that grew more outrageous as it spread.
Now seeing Meng Chong punching each True King Heavenly Venerable after another, it was clear that it wasn't just dozens; even hundreds of True King Heavenly Venerables could be swept away.
Wasn't this nearly on par with an Immortal Heavenly Venerable?

chapters.title: Chapter 831 - 831: 434
chapters.content:
If I had that strength, why would I worry about not being able to avenge the great wrongs done to me?
"Song You, thank you for saving my life," Brother Meng said.
Song You expressed his gratitude with a bow.
"Have you also offended the Wanbao Alliance?" Meng Chong asked with curiosity.
"Not exactly offended the Wanbao Alliance," Song You replied with a shake of his head and a bitter smile.
"Then why? The people chasing you are affiliated with the Wanbao Alliance," Meng Chong said, touching his head in confusion.
"The Song Family was not originally affiliated with the Wanbao Alliance. I am a Song Family descendant, and I was once the young family head…"
Song You's expression turned somewhat dejected as he thoroughly explained the events that had occurred.
Meng Chong was astounded by Song You's experiences, which bore some resemblance to his own past.
Song You, son of the former head of the Song Family, one of Baimu City's top families, was once revered and held in high esteem.
Then, a hundred years ago, his parents participated in suppressing the Heavenly Grotto rebellion and unexpectedly fell in the process.
The position of family head was seized, and he was expelled from the Song Family, with even secret attempts made on his life. If not for the fact that Song You was away rather than in Baimu City at the time, he might have been killed.
The death of his parents was shrouded in mystery; after all, his father was an Immortal Heavenly Venerable. How could he fall so easily?
Thus, he began to secretly investigate, even reaching out to the family elders in the hope of confiding in them, only to suspect that even the elders may have been involved.
Now, everyone in the Song Family appeared to be part of it, and the elders who supported his parents had all died in various "accidents."
It wasn't until three years ago that Song You discovered a clue.
"My parents' deaths are likely related to the masked person!" Song You said through gritted teeth.
"Masked person?" Meng Chong took out two masks, one Heavenly Slaughter Mask and one Earth Shadow Mask.
"Which mask is it?" Song You was startled, looking at Meng Chong with shock, momentarily suspecting that Meng Chong was in league with those masked people.
Pointing at the Earth Shadow Mask, he said, "This mask!"
Then, cautiously, he added, "Brother Meng, what is this...?"
"Don't worry, the owners of these masks have all been killed by me!" Meng Chong said with a grin.
Upon hearing this, Song You sighed in relief.
"I truly sympathize with your plight, and the Song Family of today is no longer the Song Family of the past..." Meng Chong said, patting Song You on the shoulder. Song You grimaced from the force, feeling as if his very frame were about to break apart.
"What do you mean, Brother Meng?" Song You's eyes gleamed. Could it be that Brother Meng was willing to help him?
"Revenge should, of course, be sought by yourself. It is only when you take your own vengeance that it is the most satisfying," Meng Chong said with a smile.
The Song Family of Baimu City, an affiliated force of the Wanbao Alliance, and the headquarters of the Wanbao Alliance in the Changyun Realm were located in Baimu City.
Various signs indicated that the death of Yan Shanhe's disciple was linked to the Song Family, and it was the Song Family that had framed him.
The Song Family had already become a hidden force of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
"I do want to take my own revenge, even if it means death. But with my current strength, I would simply be throwing my life away, unable to claim any vengeance at all!" Song You said with a look of utter dejection.
"Although I believe I have decent talent, to break through to the Immortal Realm is too difficult, nearly impossible without some great opportunity or fortune. I fear it is hopeless for me in this lifetime.
"How many more talented individuals have failed to cross into the Immortal Realm? And now, without any power to back me or any mentor to guide me, my talent isn't monstrous enough.
"Besides, the Song Family will absolutely not allow me to break through the Immortal Realm. They will surely try everything to kill me. If it weren't for Brother Meng coming to my rescue this time, I would have likely been doomed," Song You continued despairingly.
Meng Chong nodded, understanding that, although Song You appeared young, he was at least a hundred years old. With his talent, without resources or guidance, unless some great fortune came his way, he would likely never break through to the Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm.
For many True Kings and Heavenly Venerables, the Immortal Realm represented an insurmountable chasm.
Countless talents from major forces have failed to break through the Immortal Realm, unable to take that step.
Those who do break through the Immortal Realm are one in ten thousand.
"Moreover, even if I were to break through the Immortal Realm, I wouldn't be able to execute the chief culprit," Song You sighed.
The current head of the Song Family, was an Immortal Heavenly Venerable. For a usual Immortal Heavenly Venerable to kill another of their kind, was almost impossible.
"Actually, in your situation, it's not impossible to seek revenge. If you lack the strength yourself, you can borrow external power,"
Meng Chong touched his bald head and said thoughtfully.
"Brother Meng must be joking. The Song Family is a subsidiary power of the Wanbao Alliance, and they even have an Immortal Heavenly Venerable as a strongbacker. Where would I find external power? Who would be willing to offend the Wanbao Alliance and make an enemy of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable just for me?"
Song You shook his head with a bitter smile.
"I ask you, to have your revenge, are you truly ready to give up even your life?"
Meng Chong asked gravely.
"Of course! As long as I can have my vengeance, what does death matter? Given my predicament, I might be killed any day. Dying without having my revenge is even less worthwhile,"
Song You replied with a determined look in his eyes.
He had thought it through—if dying could lead to his revenge, it was worth it!
"Good, since you are so resolved, I shall offer you some advice!"
Meng Chong said solemnly.
"Advice?"
Song You was puzzled; no matter the advice, it couldn't possibly allow him to break through to the Immortal Realm, much less avenge himself on his own strength, could it?
"If you want to seek revenge, you must use external power. Ordinary external power won't be available to you, but you can borrow the power of the Wanbao Alliance,"
Meng Chong said, squinting his eyes, he began to tell Song You how he could get his revenge.
"Brother Meng, how can I use the power of the Wanbao Alliance?"
Song You was utterly confused.
"If someone were to kill the only son of Yan Shanhe, the Alliance Hierarch, even if they did not succeed but merely inflicted serious injuries, what would Yan Shanhe do?"
"He would go mad. No matter who the assailant was, they would be eradicated."
"So, you attack the only son of Yan Shanhe, using the power of the Wanbao Alliance to destroy the Song Family!"
"How could that possibly work?"
Song You was dumbfounded.
He could not fathom, even if he racked his brains, that Meng Chong's advice would be to attack Yan Shanhe's only son!
And, if he attacked Yan Shanhe's only son, wouldn't he die even quicker?
How would that relate to the Song Family?
Meng Chong sighed. Song You was too dull. How could he not know of such a method of revenge?
He had taken revenge in this very manner before.
The Wanbao Alliance might not be Wu Country, but since the Song Family was a subsidiary force, it would still be considered insubordinate. How could the Alliance not be infuriated?
Furthermore, the Song Family had only been a part of the Wanbao Alliance for a hundred years. They weren't truly trusted confidants. Plus, Song You was the son of the former head of the Song Family. There was much that could be done with this.
For instance, expelling Song You and the manhunt for him could all be an act, a ploy to exculpate the Song Family when attacking Yan Shanhe's only son.
If handled correctly, how could Yan Shanhe not suspect the Song Family was involved?
"I did hear that Yan Shanhe's only son has the potential to break through to Immortal Heavenly Venerable status. He's Yan Shanhe's Achilles' heel—anyone who touches it dies.
"You attack Yan Shanhe's only son, implicating the Song Family in the matter, making it appear as if the Song Family intentionally exiled you, faked your parents' deaths, and that an organization affiliated with your family is plotting something major. The target of the Changyun Realm is the Wanbao Alliance..."
Meng Chong meticulously advised Song You on how to implicate the Song Family and how to accidentally reveal certain secrets.
"The Song Family has only allied with the Wanbao Alliance for a hundred years. Do you think they have become a trusted core power of the Alliance? That they are completely trusted?"
Meng Chong said with a chuckle.
Song You was stunned. Could one really seek revenge like this?
Looking at Meng Chong, who appeared less than cunning or crafty, Song You was astounded. How could such an incredible strategy for revenge come from him?
"Brother Meng, you are a genius!"
Song You exclaimed, excited.
"It's settled then, this can be done, the Song Family is doomed!"
At that moment, Song You's blood boiled, and he could hardly wait to attack Yan Shanhe's only son.
However, he soon felt deflated, "Brother Meng, Yan Shanhe's only son is bound to have escorts, and they are surely not weak. I even suspect that an Immortal Heavenly Venerable may be secretly protecting him!"
After all, having dealt with someone as fierce as Meng Chong, Yan Shanhe would be afraid Meng Chong might kill his only son, and the security around the son would have greatly increased.
"That's a minor issue. I already have a grudge against the Wanbao Alliance. Distracting the Immortal Heavenly Venerable to create an opportunity for you is simple."
Meng Chong said cheerfully.
"But, my own strength is also lacking a bit."
Song You said with a grimace. Even using a secret technique, he wouldn't be able to kill Yan Shanhe's only son. To say nothing of killing, he wouldn't even be able to injure him.
"Well then, I'll just have to help you out once more."
Meng Chong sighed. Song You's strength was indeed a bit insufficient, and without external help, he couldn't accomplish this task.

chapters.title: Chapter 832 - 435: Yan Shanhe's Fury, the Song Family is Stunned
chapters.content:
Meng Chong took out several Healing Pills and handed them to Song You, explaining their uses.
"This Pill can stimulate potential and increase strength momentarily, far more efficient than using certain costly secret techniques. Of course, using this Pill also has a price, but it's much better than some techniques."
"This Pill is a major replenisher of vital energy and can instantly boost the Divine Spirit Soul Force. Naturally, this increase is time-limited. Once the pill's power is consumed, the Divine Spirit Soul Force will fall back, and you will feel drained. It will take some time to fully recover."
"The rest of the Pills, some are for healing injuries, others for nourishing the body and Divine Soul. Taken together, they can triple your strength momentarily. It won't last, but it will be enough."
"With the Healing Pills, any damage can be minimized. If you manage to escape by luck, these Pills alone will be enough to prevent any harm to your foundations..."
Meng Chong explained the effects and usages of these Pills to Song You, one by one.
As for himself, Meng Chong had no immediate use for these Pills. As for Healing Pills, they were the least of his concerns; he rarely got wounded, after all.
With his powerful physique's recovery capabilities, ordinary injuries didn't necessitate the need for Pills. Even common Immortal Heavenly Venerables couldn't injure him to a degree where he'd have to use Pills for healing.
These Pills were just precautions, and now they had found a use.
Helping Song You was driven by the similarity to his past circumstances, and secondly, it was almost certain that the Song Family was a hidden force of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
Furthermore, having a grudge against the Wanbao Alliance, seizing this opportunity for revenge against Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow was appealing.
Moreover, Meng Chong suspected that the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow power that had framed him might very well be the Song Family!
The Song Family, as an affiliated force of the Wanbao Alliance, had better control over Yan Shanhe's and his disciple's movements and more opportunities to strike.
Song You was stunned. Were there really such miraculous Pills in this world?
He didn't doubt a word Meng Chong said; his eyes were brimming with tears of excitement, his lips trembling, unable to express his gratitude.
After carefully putting away the Pills, he tearfully said, "Brother Meng's great kindness, if Song You survives by luck, I will repay this debt even if it means working like an ox or horse."
"You're overestimating it. It's just a small matter," Meng Chong responded nonchalantly.
Then, he took out an Array Plate.
"This is the Illusionary Reversal Formation. Once activated, it can conceal your presence and confound the enemy, creating more opportunities for you. However, this Array Plate isn't of high level; it can only surprise your enemy once, so you must seize the opportunity."
Meng Chong took out another Array Plate.
This Array Plate wasn't of high level either. If a True King Heavenly Venerable experienced it once, he would be alerted, and its illusionary power would have limited effect on him.
However, since the Way of the Array has never appeared in the Changyun Realm, these True King Heavenly Venerables will be fooled the first time, but you only have one chance.
After being deceived once, they naturally wouldn't be fooled again.
But faced with the unknown illusion, though they might not be deceived, they would become cautious and wouldn't dare to attack rashly. This too would provide Song You with an opportunity.
As for giving Song You a higher-level Array Plate, Meng Chong naturally wouldn't do that. After all, they weren't close, and giving Song You an old and unused Array Plate was already rather generous.
"An Array Plate?"
Song You was astonished again. What was this?
Unheard of.
He considered himself from a major force and well-experienced, yet he had never heard of such effective Pills and was now unfamiliar with this Array Plate and Formation.
"Using the Array Plate is very simple. Just do this..."
Meng Chong explained how to use the Array Plate.
"Do you understand?"
"I understand, thank you for your great kindness, Brother Meng!"
Song You said, thrilled beyond measure.
"Take this mask."
Meng Chong handed an Earth Shadow Mask to Song You, then instructed him on how to execute a plan: to seem like a long-term secret agent for the Song Family, to deceive the Wanbao Alliance, to seize the opportunity to assassinate Yan Shanhe's son and to ensure the Song Family wouldn't be implicated.
If successful, the Song Family would undoubtedly be involved, and Yan Shanhe of the Wanbao Alliance would certainly annihilate the Song Family in a thunderous rage. Thus, Song You's revenge would be served.
"Don't worry, Brother Meng, I know what to do. I will definitely succeed!"
Song You was filled with a stirring determination.
The first light of revenge had appeared.
If he could avenge the great wrong, even falling in the process would be worth it!
Song You started to make his moves, first locating Yan Shanhe's only son, Yan Long, and waiting for the right moment.
For the time being, Meng Chong decided not to leave the Changyun Realm.
Yan Shanhe's only son and the young lord of the Wanbao Alliance in the Changyun Realm, Yan Long boasted extraordinary talent, and of course, he practiced the most top-notch Cultivation Techniques, lacking neither resources for cultivation nor guidance from Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
With an eighty percent chance of breaking through to the Immortal Realm, Yan Shanhe doted on his sole son, his most cherished treasure and a line no one should cross.
All the major powers and strong individuals in the Changyun Realm knew that the one person you must never offend in the Wanbao Alliance was Yan Long!
For the safety of his only child and to ensure no accidents, Yan Shanhe personally selected a Loose Cultivator, who was just a hair's breadth away from breaking through to the Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm, bestowed upon him stronger Cultivation Techniques and resources to aid his breakthrough to the Immortal Realm.
The cost, however, was to become Yan Long's guard.

chapters.title: Chapter 833 - 435: Yan Shanhe's Fury, the Song Family is Stunned_2
chapters.content:
An Immortal Heavenly Venerable as bodyguard, even the top geniuses from major forces had no such treatment.
From this, it was evident how highly Yan Shanhe regarded Yan Long, and it also reflected the vast wealth of the Wanbao Alliance, which could afford to have an Immortal Heavenly Venerable as an attendant.
Despite the incident of Meng Chong raiding the Wanbao Alliance, not many were worried about Yan Long's safety, as he was protected by the Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
Yan Long was not in Baimu City, but was traveling around.
That day, as he just left a city, a beautiful woman joined Yan Long's side, serving him, with several guards at the True King Heavenly Venerable Peak on alert, not allowing anyone to approach.
In secret, an Immortal Heavenly Venerable was protecting him.
"Truly envious of Yan Long!"
"Worthy of being the number one young master of Changyun, wherever he goes, there are exceptional beauties willingly serving by his side!"
"Outstanding talent, noble birth, endless resources... If only I had a good father!"
"Give it up, even if your father were Yan Shanhe, he'd probably have sent you to some remote mountain corner by now!"
The martial artists in the city watched with envy and jealousy as Yan Long's group left.
Suddenly!
"Meng Chong?!"
A deep voice rang out.
"You protect the young master."
A figure burst forth with might, attacking the bald youth who appeared in midair.
"Hiss! Meng Chong actually wants to kill Yan Long? This is more serious than raiding a Wanbao Alliance Branch, Yan Shanhe will probably take action personally."
"Too reckless, he's outright disregarding Yan Shanhe."
"What exactly is Meng Chong's background? With such formidable martial arts, he is terrifying, and possibly has top experts backing him, that's why he's not afraid of Yan Shanhe."
"This isn't just a matter for Yan Shanhe, but for the entire Wanbao Alliance, given the deep connections they have with those Great Realms."
As the martial artists watched the Immortal Heavenly Venerable in pursuit of Meng Chong, they were all shocked, but Yan Long's group, who continued forward, suddenly encountered an attack.
Boom!
A figure appeared without warning, as if they had already been lying in ambush.
"Be careful, protect the young master!"
Yan Long's guards were furious, they all lashed out, but their attacks missed.
"No good!"
At that moment, they were horrified to realize that the figure was an illusion!
The real attacker was somewhere else.
Yan Long snorted coldly; his strength among True King Heavenly Venerables was naturally very formidable. As long as it wasn't an Immortal Heavenly Venerable attacking, and it wasn't a freak like Meng Chong, he was not afraid at all.
Boom!
He punched out with his hand, but suddenly, his expression changed drastically.
The attack he saw was inverted; the real attack was coming from another direction!
In the moment of crisis, he hastily pulled the woman next to him, using her to block the attack.
Pff!
To his shock, this attack, too, was a fake!
In the sudden turn of events, the unexpected attack, in the midst of crisis, it was impossible to distinguish the power of the Reversed Formation.
As a profound sense of danger loomed, Yan Long hastily twisted his body to dodge, even conjuring a protective force shield around himself. A blade pierced through the force shield, pierced his armor, and plunged into his chest.
Sss!
Blood spurted out, and in that moment, Yan Long saw the attacker, who seemed to have used a secret technique, his strength temporarily soaring.
"Young master!"
The guards were horrified, one of them suddenly stepped forward to shield Yan Long.
Pff!
The blade pierced through his body, but also blocked the truly fatal blow, as the rest of the guards hastily made their move.
Yan Long, however, took this opportunity to retreat frantically.
Song You felt a bit regretful that his strength was still slightly lacking. Even though he exploded to his limit, he couldn't kill Yan Long in one strike. Now that the opportunity was missed and he tried to strike again, it was too late.
The guards were attacking like mad.
Song You roared lowly, fighting like a madman, bearing the brunt of numerous attacks, even spitting blood but still attempting to strike at Yan Long.
"Young master, run fast!"
A guard shielded Yan Long in front, retreating wildly while another guard shouted, "Anyone who captures the assailant will be handsomely rewarded by our Wanbao Alliance!"
The crowd of martial artists, previously stunned, were now excited upon hearing this.
Several True King Heavenly Venerables flew forth.
"Enough!"
Seeing this, Song You revealed a look of regret. In the midst of the battle, the mask on his face suddenly shattered. His expression drastically changed, he waved his hand to crush the mask, and despite suffering a hit, he even ripped a sleeve to cover his face.
"Song You?"
Someone exclaimed in shock.
The former young master exiled by the Song Family, the wanted Song You?
He dared to attack Yan Long?
"I am not Song You. The attack on Yan Long is a personal vendetta between him and me!"
In Song You's eyes, panic flashed, but he soon calmed himself and fled in desperation.
"Quick, capture Song You!"
A group of Martial Artists chased frantically after him.
At this moment, many had the thought emerge in their minds: Was the Song Family planning to betray Yan Shanhe?
Song You, although expelled, who knew if it wasn't all an act?
Moreover, the mask Song You wore...
To everyone, it had never crossed their minds that someone would take revenge in this manner. Thus, their first thought was of the Song Family's cunning and deceit, suspecting them of staging this self-hurting ruse, intending to attack Yan Long and then disassociate themselves from the incident.
Boom!
The aura of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable descended.
"Young Master!"
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable who had just been pursuing Meng Chong suddenly changed color.
Fortunately, although Yan Long was seriously injured, at least his life was not at risk, nor was his foundation damaged.
"Where's Meng Chong?"
Yan Long's face was exceedingly grim, filled with murderous intent.
For the first time in his life, he had come so close to death.
It was also the first time someone had dared to attempt to assassinate him!
"It seems Meng Chong was coincidentally present. His target is the Wanbao Alliance in the city, not the Young Master!"
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable spoke with a grave voice.
"Back to Baimu City!"
Yan Long gritted his teeth and said: "Song Family!"
Song You was fleeing desperately. Thanks to the burst of strength from the pill, he finally shook off his pursuers. At this moment, he almost wanted to burst into wild laughter; his plan had succeeded.
However, he would have to face the pursuit of the Wanbao Alliance from now on.
"Run, as long as I can, until whenever I can!"
Song You didn't dare to pause for a moment and continued to flee, looking for a secluded place to heal his wounds before inquiring about the Song Family's matters.
Baimu City.
Yan Shanhe received a secretive report about the Song Family, a subordinate power.
"Song You's expulsion was just an act? The former head of the Song Family hasn't fallen?"
Yan Shanhe's brow furrowed. The fall of the former head of the Song Family was known to many, after all, the death of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable was a sensational event.
"Could it be that they used some kind of feigned death secret technique?"
However, Yan Shanhe couldn't understand the purpose of the Song Family's actions, especially since the new head of the Song Family, along with a group of clan elders, had all pledged loyalty to him.
For this, they even executed many supporters of the former head.
"Keep an eye on the Song Family in secret."
Yan Shanhe pondered deeply; the more it seemed like this, the bigger the Song Family's plot appeared.
"Yes!"
An Immortal Heavenly Venerable responded and then retreated.
Just then, a guard responsible for intelligence within the Wanbao Alliance hurried in, his expression immensely grave.
"What's the matter?"
Yan Shanhe asked softly.
"Alliance Hierarch, the Young Alliance Hierarch has been ambushed and gravely injured!"
"What!"
Yan Shanhe's eyes revealed a terrifying light, and an intense killing intent filled the air, causing the guard to collapse to the ground under the pressure.
"Who attacked my son!"
At this moment, Yan Shanhe seemed ready to tear someone apart.
"Alliance Hierarch, it was Song You!"
The guard then detailed the whole incident of the attack to Yan Shanhe.
"Good, very good, does the Song Family aspire to my position as the Alliance Hierarch? Do they really think the position of Alliance Hierarch is so easily usurped?
"The Song Family must be annihilated!"
At this moment, Yan Shanhe was seething with rage.
He finally understood that the Song Family's scheme was indeed aimed at the Wanbao Alliance of the Changyun Realm, seeking to gain greater influence.
"The Song Family is now a power supported by Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow!"
On the surface, it was the Song Family plotting for his position as Alliance Hierarch, but in reality, it was Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow manipulating everything from behind the scenes.
"Do they really think our Wanbao Alliance is so easily infiltrated?"
Yan Shanhe was livid with rage.
"Come, follow me to exterminate the Song Family!"
At this moment, Yan Shanhe's killing intent was stern, and he no longer bore the semblance of benevolence that accompanies wealth.
Boom!
Many powers in Baimu City, along with numerous strong individuals, were shocked to see Yan Shanhe leading a host of Immortal Heavenly Venerables and powerful members of the Treasure Protection Team from the Wanbao Alliance descend upon the Song Family residence, their killing intent soaring to the heavens.
The news spread swiftly— the Song Family had grand ambitions, Song You's attack on Yan Long had failed, and it had exposed the Song Family's schemes!
Everyone was stunned, and the people of the Song Family were even more shocked!
The deeds of Song You had nothing to do with us, the Song Family; we're wronged!

chapters.title: Chapter 834 - 436 Mighty Sky Limitless Indestructible Body, Outer Heavenly Spirit
chapters.content:
