The head of the Song family and a group of elders looked at Yan Shanhe, who was seething with killing intent, and the strong members of the Wanbao Alliance, and were so scared that they broke out in cold sweat.
"Alliance Hierarch, the matter of Song You has nothing to do with my Song family, we have been loyally devoted!"
The head of the Song family said in a panic.
"Ha!"
Yan Shanhe sneered coldly, "Do you still want to argue at this point? Song You is your Song family's man; the so-called expulsion is nothing but a ruse. Do you think that with this, you can extract the Song family from this affair?
"Doesn't your family know the grand ambitions you harbor?"
How could Yan Shanhe believe the words of the Song family head? Never before in the Divine Realm had there been anyone who used such a method to seek revenge through another's hand.
Besides, his only son was attacked and seriously injured, and he had just received secret intelligence, the authenticity of which had not yet been verified, nor did he have the heart to do so.
Filled with extreme anger, how could Yan Shanhe trust the defense of the Song family head?
"Kill!"
Yan Shanhe raised his hand and struck with a palm, personally taking action to suppress the head of the Song family.
The other Immortal Heavenly Venerables and the martial artists of the Wanbao Alliance all joined in, and the battle erupted in an instant.
The strength of the Song family was no match for the Wanbao Alliance, let alone the intervention of Yan Shanhe, a top Immortal Heavenly Venerable. The outcome was already destined.
Seeing that he was no match, the head of the Song family tried to flee, but he was not only facing Yan Shanhe but also the encircling Immortal Heavenly Venerables—there was no chance of escape.
The battle came to an end, and the once-mighty Song family vanished from existence.
The face of Yan Shanhe was extremely somber. In the end, the head of the Song family, an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, seeing no way out, chose to end his life decisively, giving him no chance to be captured alive.
"Alliance Hierarch, we've found some things in the Song family."
An Immortal Heavenly Venerable came forward to report.
Yan Shanhe's gaze swept over, his expression cold; indeed these were the hidden forces of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
Shortly after, a member of the Treasure Protection Team came to report findings related to the Song family's plans to attack Yan Shanhe's disciple, Yan Ping.
"Good, very good, it really is the Song family; killing my disciple wasn't enough, you even dare to contemplate attacking my son, Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, right? Very well!"
Yan Shanhe's expression was chillingly cold.
"Contact the other forces and join to eradicate the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow in the Changyun Realm, don't let a single one go!"
Yan Shanhe was burning with rage.
Initially, he didn't care much about the schemes of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow because, for the time being, there was a certain understanding between the Wanbao Alliance and the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
The Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow wouldn't target the Wanbao Alliance, and the Wanbao Alliance wouldn't target the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, nor would they provide information on it to other forces.
Now that the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow no longer abided by this understanding, the Wanbao Alliance also had to strike back!
In Baimu City, the news of the Song family being destroyed, and moreover as an important force of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow in Changyun Realm, and the Wanbao Alliance entering the fray to begin their revenge against the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, immediately sent shockwaves throughout Changyun Realm.
At this point, with both the Battle Hall and the Wanbao Alliance taking action, the rest of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow members in Changyun Realm were completely flabbergasted. Why all of a sudden, when the time was not yet ripe and some plans were still unfinished, did the Battle Hall and Wanbao Alliance successively make their move?
This Changyun Realm would soon become unbearable to stay in.
When Song You heard the news of the Song family being destroyed, tears of excitement welled up, "Father, mother, I've avenged you!"
"And Brother Meng, I will remember this kindness in my heart forever!"
Now, he was the only one left in the entire Song family.
And, he was being offered a generous bounty by the Wanbao Alliance.
"The Song family truly was a force of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow. You tried to frame me, now you know pain, don't you?"
Meng Chong, who was headed towards Changyun City, let out a cold laugh.
It was also time to leave Changyun Realm and continue traveling through the various realms of the Divine Realm.
Still a thousand miles away from Changyun City, Meng Chong was preparing to change his appearance to avoid the search, cross the Realm Gate, and depart, when suddenly a figure appeared.
"Master!"
Meng Chong was startled, then promptly paid his respects with great reverence.
"Hmm!"
Li Xuan nodded. Meng Chong had plundered the Wanbao Alliance Branch and amassed quite a collection of treasures, no longer lacking resources for his cultivation.
"Master, why are you here?"
Meng Chong asked excitedly.
"Just traveling around, stopping by to see how you all are doing."
Li Xuan walked leisurely, with Meng Chong following closely behind him.
"If you have any questions about martial arts, you can ask now."
Li Xuan said with a smile.
"Yes, thank you, Master!"
Meng Chong replied joyfully, then proceeded to seek advice from his master on questions about the Blade Path, the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body, and Divine Skills.
Li Xuan nodded. The doubts Meng Chong had were relatively simple and didn't require any cryptic answers; he could give proper guidance directly.
Li Xuan then carefully instructed Meng Chong in martial arts, especially on the third level of the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body, and finally on the realm of the Blade Path.
As for Divine Skills, most of the necessary explanations had been given; it was a matter of passing on a more complete Divine Skill Martial Code to Meng Chong.
With the Communication Talisman, they could message each other; if Meng Chong had any questions, he could discuss them with Xu Yan, making Li Xuan's life as a master quite relaxed.
While strolling leisurely and instructing Meng Chong in martial arts, they were not far from Changyun City; they could see the Changyun City Realm Gate in the distance.
"Master, I understand. I will make sure to comprehend the third level as soon as possible!"
Meng Chong said respectfully.
"Hmm."
Li Xuan nodded, then added, "Since that's the case, your teacher will pass on to you the Physical Body Martial Arts that go beyond the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body."
"Thank you, Master!"
Meng Chong said excitedly.
"Physical Body Martial Arts are about the body, and the third level of the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body can truly achieve one acupoint, one star, resembling heaven and earth. But the stars within the acupoints are after all just nascent stars.

chapters.title: Chapter 835 - 436 Mighty Sky Limitless Indestructible Body, Outer Heavenly Spirit_2
chapters.content:
```
"All stars gather, Mighty Sky Limitless, I transmit to you the Mighty Sky Limitless Indestructible Body."
Above the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body lies the Mighty Sky Limitless Indestructible Body. After repeated consideration, Li Xuan settled on this name.
All stars gather, Mighty Sky Limitless!
Meng Chong listened with excitement and a solemn expression.
Li Xuan began explaining the Mighty Sky Limitless Indestructible Body, how to strengthen the stars, how to gather the stars, and form the body of the Mighty Sky with thousands of stars.
"Mighty Sky Limitless establishes the path of the physical body, opening up the universe within the body..."
After Li Xuan explained once, he let Meng Chong digest it on his own.
Meng Chong immersed himself in the Mighty Sky Limitless Indestructible Body, digesting its mysteries and memorizing the profound Martial Arts Techniques for the physical body.
Suddenly!
Two figures flew swiftly over.
"Meng Chong, where can you run to!"
It was the two Immortal Heavenly Venerables who were after Meng Chong.
A glance from Li Xuan's indifferent eyes, and the next moment, as he continued to walk leisurely forward, the two Immortal Heavenly Venerables coming to kill Meng Chong turned to ashes and dissipated.
Gulp!
"Just one look, and the Immortal Heavenly Venerable turns to flying ashes, what realm is this capable of?"
Meng Chong marveled inwardly.
The strength of the master is truly unfathomable.
"Have you memorized everything?"
Li Xuan asked leisurely.
"Master, there are some things I couldn't remember!"
Meng Chong touched his head and said with an awkward smile.
Li Xuan nodded, then explained again.
After explaining three times in total, Meng Chong thoroughly memorized the Cultivation Technique. Li Xuan then imparted to him the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, but as for when Meng Chong might be able to cultivate it, that remained to be seen.
After all, even with the foundation laid by the Minor Heavenly Path's Eye, to cultivate the true Eye of the Heavenly Dao, with Meng Chong's current strength, was far from possible.
After transmitting the Cultivation Technique to Meng Chong, providing guidance in Martial Arts, Li Xuan naturally enhanced Meng Chong's Jade Talisman, and later imparted to him some Martial Arts experiences.
"The Divine Realm is about to become chaotic, a time when prodigies rise, if you want to gain a great reputation, this is a good opportunity."
Li Xuan said with a smile.
"Master, I will surely make my name renowned throughout the Divine Realm, let the entire Divine Realm know the name of Heavenly God Meng Chong."
Meng Chong said excitedly.
Li Xuan nodded with a smile, "I won't send you into the city."
With one step, he vanished from the spot instantly.
Meng Chong touched his head and grinned, then walked towards Changyun City, his figure and appearance changing in an instant.
The Song Family had been annihilated, and as for the Wanbao Alliance, he hadn't been at a disadvantage, it was Yan Shanhe who was hopping mad, not Meng Chong; there was no need to continue mired in the affairs of the Changyun Realm.
The Divine Realm is vast, wandering through the Realms, it's time to meet many of the powerful beings there.
With leisurely steps, Li Xuan traversed across Changyun Realm, directly crossing the wilderness to reach the Yuanping Realm, where Jiang Buping was.
Since he was out, he had to provide guidance to each of his three disciples.
"It's time for the discarded Jiang Buping to make a comeback, and as he emerges once again, he will surely draw attention, especially since he is unaffected by the Imperishable Qi.
"If the Taikun Realm Jiang Clan gets wind of this, they'll likely send strong warriors after him."
Li Xuan revealed a brilliant smile.
Jiang Buping's identity was destined to not have a smooth path, destined to rise through slaughter.
And the Extreme Soul Martial Arts is precisely about reaching the extreme in slaughter."
"Even the Immortal Heavenly Venerable won't be able to break Jiang Buping's Imperishable Spirit Soul, with Jiang Buping's rate of cultivation, it won't be long before he can kill the Immortal Heavenly Venerable."
The Extreme Soul Martial Arts threatens the soul, with Jiang Buping's current strength, should the Immortal Heavenly Venerable be slightly careless, even he could be wounded in his soul.
Of course, for Jiang Buping to defeat an Immortal Heavenly Venerable on his own, he still lacked some strength.
"The drama of the discarded rising, challenging the big clans, is about to begin."
Li Xuan proceeded carefreely, crossing the wilderness on his way to Yuanping Realm.
In a certain part of Changyun Realm, Xu Yan suppressed a True King Heavenly Venerable with a raise of his hand.
```
"From today onwards, you will be known as Shadow One, infiltrating the ranks of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow..."
Xu Yan's eyes flickered with cold light; it was time to counter-infiltrate Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
In the time that followed, Xu Yan focused on taking action against Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, gradually expanding control from one person to dozens, thoroughly mapping out many of their strongholds.
However, due to the Wanbao Alliance also hunting down Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, many strongholds were taken down by them, forcing Xu Yan to marvel at the Wanbao Alliance's impressive intelligence capabilities in uncovering so many Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow locations.
In the Nine Mountain Realm, located at Horizontal Peak Mountain.
Tian Shiqi's face was extremely somber; Changyun Realm had descended into such chaos that a long-hidden and strong branch had been annihilated.
"Could it have been caused by Wu Rang's reckless scheming?" Tian Shiqi said angrily.
"My lord, it's said that Wu Rang has been in seclusion and has not emerged for some time. It's unlikely to be related to him, right?"
"Hmmph, let him know that as a member of Heavenly Slaughter, he should not deploy tasks recklessly; his only job is to kill!" Tian Shiqi's face was still stern.
"Yes, my lord. But what should we do about the current situation in Changyun Realm?"
Tian Shiqi's eyes shone with cold light as he spoke gravely, "Since Wanbao Alliance's Yan Shanhe wants to fight, since the major powers of Changyun Realm want to fight, then let them fight. Let Changyun Realm descend into chaos."
As he said this, Tian Shiqi added coldly, "The preparations for the Spirit Crystal Mine in Changyun Realm are complete. Although I didn't want to act now, since Changyun Realm insists on chaos, then let's make our move."
"But my lord, the timing might not be right."
"If Changyun Realm is going to be chaotic, then the time has come. Whether early or late, chaos is inevitable. Pass down the order to activate that treasure."
"Yes, my lord!"
After his subordinate left, Tian Shiqi cast his gaze toward the direction of the Qinghua state, his brows furrowing tightly.
Up to now, there still wasn't any news from Qinghua state; it seemed as if the whole state was in lockdown.
Moreover, the initial operation targeting Qinghua state had ended in failure.
"Could it be a mistake to move against Xu Yan and Meng Chong?" Tian Shiqi felt a heavy heart.
The two Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughters who went to assassinate Xu Yan had disappeared without a trace, which likely meant they hadn't merely failed, but had perished!
Xu Yan did not have the strength to do this, which indicated that an even stronger force had intervened.
And according to the information available, there had been no outbreak of a mighty battle involving an Immortal Heavenly Venerable in Changyun Realm, suggesting the two Nine-leaf Heavenly Slaughters had been easily killed with a mere flick of the hand.
"A strength surpassing the Immortal? When did such a powerful being beyond the Immortal emerge in the Divine Realm?" Tian Shiqi pondered.
"Will this entity come to the Nine Mountain Realm? I must not reveal my strength just yet; it's better to lay low for the time being, especially since that matter needs to be accelerated." Thinking this, Tian Shiqi quickly left the Nine Mountain Realm.
...
Boom!
In the Yuanping Realm, there was a heavenly grotto known as the Imperishable Heaven Cave. The cave was permeated with Imperishable Qi, causing any martial artist who entered to be extremely cautious and vigilant.
If the Imperishable Qi contaminated the Divine Soul, one would lose Spiritual Wisdom.
Because of the continuous presence of Imperishable Qi throughout the year, some unique treasures had been born within the cave, which were used to refine Divine Artifacts, enhancing the artifacts' durability and resilience.
Beyond that, the cave was home to a ferocious beast, rumored to be an Outer Heavenly Spirit. It had been eroded by Imperishable Qi all year round and unable to develop Spiritual Wisdom like a Spirit Beast, indistinguishable from an ordinary wild beast.
However, this Outer Heavenly Spirit possessed an incredibly formidable body, naturally violent, yet its flesh was a precious medicine that could restore depleted vitality and could be used to concoct invaluable medication.
It also had the effect of strengthening the body, and for this reason, the martial artists of Yuanping Realm generally had more robust muscles and physical strength than those from Changyun Realm.
This was an advantage unique to realms that possessed an Imperishable Heaven Cave.
At that moment, inside the cave, a young man grasped a cold and sharp long spear shining with a hint of chill, as if the chill targeted not the flesh but the Divine Soul and consciousness.
A fearsome beast, shrouded in white flames and clad in giant scales, with a huge head crowned by a solitary massive horn, roared as it charged at the young man.
But, as the young man's long spear thrust out in the blink of an eye, the roaring stopped. The savagery in its eyes vanished instantly, and the body that had been charging forward collapsed thunderously midway.
"What kind of secret technique is this, to break through the Colossal Armored Beast's defenses so easily?"
"Yet there is not a single mark on the Colossal Armored Beast's body!"
Many martial artists in the distance were utterly shocked by this scene.
The Colossal Armored Beast was so named for its giant armor-like scales, renowned for their defensive prowess, which even a True King Heavenly Venerable would find troublesome. Penetrating the defenses of a Colossal Armored Beast was exceedingly difficult.
Yet today, the warriors witnessed someone kill a Colossal Armored Beast with a single spear thrust, causing utter astonishment.

chapters.title: Chapter 836 - 437 Hunting the Outer Heavenly Spirit, Taikun Jiang Clan
chapters.content:
The Colossal Armored Beast, among the Outer Heavenly Spirits, belongs to a category with extremely strong defenses, requiring multiple people to cooperate to hunt down successfully each time.
That's why, when the crowd of Martial Artists saw how effortlessly Jiang Buping killed the Colossal Armored Beast, they couldn't help but be greatly shocked.
"Brother Liang, coming from the Great Realm, having seen much and knowing a lot, do you know what secret technique this person used to kill the Colossal Armored Beast so easily?"
In another area, where over a dozen Martial Artists had gathered, someone asked the person in the center.
"Divine Soul Secret Technique!"
The person being asked, with a look of surprise and uncertainty, took a deep breath before speaking in a deep voice.
"Hiss! It's actually the Divine Soul Secret Technique, he directly extinguished the consciousness of the Colossal Armored Beast!"
"With such a powerful Divine Soul Secret Technique, this man must not be provoked."
"It's no wonder Brother Liang is a Martial Artist from the Taikun Realm, to have identified the intricacies at a glance."
Liang Quan had no reaction to the flattery of the people around him, instead, his gaze was fixated on the distant Jiang Buping, his heart far from calm!
Even though it was the Divine Soul Secret Technique that could strike and extinguish the consciousness of a Colossal Armored Beast in one blow, it's an extremely formidable technique, and the practitioner must have an exceedingly strong Divine Soul.
Even within the Taikun Realm, it's not certain that such a powerful Divine Soul Secret Technique exists.
"Jiang Buping? It's actually him!"
Liang Quan's heart was far from calm, recognizing the youth who had killed the Colossal Armored Beast as Jiang Buping, the disposed-of outcast of the Taikun Jiang Clan, with rumors about Jiang Buping being no secret in the Taikun Realm.
Especially him, Liang Quan, being a member of an affiliated force of the Jiang Clan, understood even more about this matter.
He'd heard some of the secrets involved as well.
"Wasn't his Divine Soul tainted with Imperishable Qi, leading to a loss of Spiritual Wisdom, and didn't he become muddleheaded? Wasn't he already missing, and according to calculations, must have fallen due to the taint of Imperishable Qi? How could he appear here?
"Moreover, where is the slightest trace of muddleheadedness in him, and his strength is even greater than before."
In that moment, Liang Quan was incredibly shocked.
Could someone recover after being tainted with Imperishable Qi?
"This matter must be reported back to the Jiang Clan, with Jiang Buping's talent, he will most likely be able to break through to the Immortal Realm. Once he breaks through, it will pose a great threat to the third youngest.
"The elders of the Jiang Clan will surely welcome him back, and to take him back into the Jiang Clan, they will be willing to offer generous treatments and various conditions."
Liang Quan thought to himself.
For a great clan, talent and strength are the most important, the more monstrous the talent, the more it can enhance the clan's strength and bring tremendous benefits to the clan.
This was also why, although Jiang Buping was of common birth and not liked by the patriarch of the Jiang Clan, he was still accepted into the Jiang Family, and given the treatment of a genius, precisely because of his talent.
And once Jiang Buping was deemed useless, having lost all value and usability, moreover at risk of embarrassing the Jiang Family, he was expelled without mercy.
If Jiang Buping breaks through the Immortal Realm, with his talent, he will invariably become a top fighter in the Immortal Realm, and those elders will take him back.
Face and such, for those undying elders, have long since not been so important; they only consider the interests of the clan!
Liang Quan didn't continue to stay in the Heavenly Grotto, but rather made an excuse to say goodbye to everyone and hurried back to the Taikun Realm.
Jiang Buping was unaware that his identity had been recognized and, after collecting the carcass of the Colossal Armored Beast, he looked towards the depths of the Heavenly Grotto.
In the depths of the Heavenly Grotto, there were two Outer Heavenly Spirits with power comparable to the Immortal Realm.
"According to what I've read in ancient texts, these Outer Heavenly Spirits live outside of the Domain, and from birth, they're tainted with Imperishable Qi, therefore unable to develop Spiritual Wisdom, yet their strength is formidable.
"Outer Heavenly Spirits with the strength of the Immortal Realm are either juvenile, or the lowest class among them; the Colossal Armored Beast I just hunted is an example of the juvenile.
"With my current strength, I wonder if I can kill an Immortal Realm Outer Heavenly Spirit?"
Jiang Buping pondered, deciding to give it a try.
Outer Heavenly Spirits, lacking Spiritual Wisdom, even if unkillable, still allow for retreat, such as using a pill to draw their attention and then taking the opportunity to escape.
Like beasts, the Outer Heavenly Spirits, led by instinct, are easily distracted and lured by food.
"Legend says that Spirit Beasts are the descendants of Outer Heavenly Spirits, having entered the Domain from outside, and as there is no Imperishable Qi in the Domain, their offspring under the nourishment of the Domain's Spirit Mechanism and nature's Spiritual Energy, from one generation to another, eventually developed Spiritual Wisdom, hence todays' Spirit Beasts."
Jiang Buping was recalling some ancient texts he had seen in the Jiang Family.
The strength of a Spirit Beast depends on its bloodline; each advancement is a transformation of bloodline. The higher the Outer Heavenly Spirit level of its ancestors, the stronger their strength, and the higher the potential limit of their bloodline.
Once they develop a bloodline returning to its roots with Spiritual Wisdom, such a Spirit Beast becomes immensely powerful.
To date, there are no such powerful Spirit Beasts in the Divine Realm.
Jiang Buping rushed directly towards the depths of the Heavenly Grotto, and without even getting close, he could hear the thunderous snoring sounds of a huge Outer Heavenly Spirit lying on the ground asleep.
"What an opportunity!"
Jiang Buping was inwardly overjoyed, quietly approached the Outer Heavenly Spirit while concealing his presence.
Ordinary Martial Artists would be detected as soon as they approached, but Jiang Buping practiced Extreme Soul Martial Arts, lacking the aura of ordinary Martial Artists and the scent of flesh and blood.
Moreover, his concealment technique was exceedingly mysterious, so this Outer Heavenly Spirit had no clue someone was approaching.

chapters.title: Chapter 837 - 437 Hunting the Outer Heavenly Spirit, Taikun Jiang Clan_2
chapters.content:
```
Zzt!
Jiang Buping suddenly made his move, thrusting his spear into the skull of an Outer Heavenly Spirit.
Roar!
The Outer Heavenly Spirit let out a terrifying roar, its eyes bulging wide in fury as it erupted with power. Instead of attacking immediately, it began to roll on the ground in agony.
"So strong, I can't even annihilate its Divine Soul!"
Jiang Buping felt a chill in his heart. Taking advantage of the Outer Heavenly Spirit's painful rolling, before it recovered and launched an attack, he thrust his spear again.
Divine Skills, Slaying the Divine!
Thud!
Another even more terrifying roar echoed as the entire Heavenly Grotto trembled. The weaker Outer Heavenly Spirits, terrified, shuddered and ran wildly in all directions.
Another powerful Outer Heavenly Spirit was also frightened, watching from a distance the one rolling on the ground, not daring to approach.
"What happened?"
The commotion here quickly alerted the Martial Artists within the Heavenly Grotto, even the Immortal Heavenly Venerable who was stationed here came to investigate.
The Outer Heavenly Spirit lifted its head, its blood-red eyes fixating deathly on Jiang Buping, ferocity unleashed, with a terrifying aura rolling over its entire body.
Jiang Buping's heart skipped a beat, realizing that although the Outer Heavenly Spirit lacked Spiritual Wisdom, its Divine Soul might have become extremely powerful due to living in the Imperishable Qi, even more resilient than the Immortal Heavenly Venerable's Divine Soul.
"Another hit, and I will shatter its Divine Soul!"
Jiang Buping took out a pill. As the Outer Heavenly Spirit was about to attack, he suddenly threw the pill to a spot not far away.
The Outer Heavenly Spirit, initially about to attack, abruptly turned its gaze to the small pill. With its keen senses, it realized the pill could alleviate its pain.
Forgetting the attack, it turned around, lowered its head, and extended its tongue to lick the pill.
Jiang Buping seized this opportunity and from above, thrust his spear once more into the skull of the Outer Heavenly Spirit.
Crack!
The Extreme Soul Divine Spear seemed to shatter something.
Thud!
The pill also dissolved at the moment Jiang Buping made his move.
Aoow!
A roar more frightening than before rose up as the Outer Heavenly Spirit released attacks in a frenzy, rolling, leaping, and running wildly.
Some of the smaller Outer Heavenly Spirits that couldn't evade in time were smashed into a bloody mess.
Jiang Buping retreated far away, waiting for the Outer Heavenly Spirit to die.
The other Martial Artists inside the Heavenly Grotto retreated frantically, except for the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, whose face was a picture of grave shock.
His gaze towards Jiang Buping had changed.
Not even the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, and yet he's hunting an Outer Heavenly Spirit of the Immortal Realm?
Was that a method of assaulting the Divine Soul?
With such a technique, few could be his match within the same realm. Once someone breaks through to the Immortal Realm, even he admits he wouldn't be able to withstand it.
"Could he be a monstrous talent from the Great Realm?"
He muttered to himself.
Only the Great Realm possessed Divine Soul Secret Techniques.
Thump!
The Outer Heavenly Spirit fell, and even though it hadn't completely perished, its consciousness was on the brink of dissipating.
Jiang Buping approached again, decisively dealing with it, storing the massive Outer Heavenly Spirit away.
"Fourth Senior Brother's Storage Ring is really useful. Ordinary Storage Bags wouldn't be able to fit such a huge Outer Heavenly Spirit."
Jiang Buping was inwardly amazed.
"It's about time to refine some Imperishable Qi as well."
Ignoring the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, Jiang Buping continued to traverse the Heavenly Grotto, casually looking for a place to extract Imperishable Qi.
The Taikun Realm, one of the three Great Realms within the Thirty-six Realms of the Divine Realm, second only to the first Great Realm, the Taihe Realm.
The Jiang Family is the dominant power of the Taikun Realm, known as the Jiang Clan, which holds great sway in the Taikun Realm. Although they haven't unified the entire Taikun Realm, they rule over half of it.
And the major forces of the entire Taikun Realm are divided into one clan, three sects, and two great families.
The one clan mentioned is none other than the Jiang Family, the Jiang Clan.
The Jiang Clan occupies half of the Taikun Realm; the other half is ruled by the three sects and two great families. Among them, one of the great families is an affiliated family of the Jiang Clan, with its current head being the grandson of a great elder from the Jiang Clan.
To the Taikun Realm, the Jiang Clan is supreme. Even if the remaining three sects and one great family were to join forces, they would not dare to oppose the Jiang Clan, maintaining a delicate balance.
They keep their own territories while avoiding conflict with the Jiang Clan, outwardly appearing harmonious to each other.
But everyone knows the ambition of the Jiang Clan, to dominate the entire Taikun Realm and become the number one clan in the Divine Realm.
```
However, the other three Sects and the great family, although not as powerful as the Jiang Clan, were not defenseless, and moreover, some major powers in the Divine Realm did not wish to see a family become overwhelmingly strong.
Therefore, this balance had been maintained until now, with an unspoken agreement formed between them.
In matters concerning the safety of the Taikun Realm and the suppression of the Heavenly Grotto, the Jiang Clan was always the leader, yet everyone firmly held on to their own territories, and the Jiang Clan did not dare resort to military force to pressurize them, fearing that it would lead to chaos in the Taikun Realm and give other Great Realm powers an excuse to intervene.
Even so, they were constantly plotting in the shadows.
For instance, forming a marriage alliance with the Yun Shang Sect among the three, thereby establishing a form of control over the entire Taikun Realm.
The daughter of the Yun Shang Sect Master, Yun Yan'er, was initially engaged to the Jiang Clan's prodigy, Jiang Buping, according to a secret agreement between the two parties, with Jiang Buping eventually to marry into the Yun Shang Sect, although this was not announced publicly.
However, Jiang Buping was unexpectedly crippled, the engagement was dissolved, and as a result, Yun Yan'er and the third son of the Jiang Clan's patriarch, Jiang Tianming, started exchanging flirtatious glances, seemingly in love.
The Jiang Clan suggested that Yun Yan'er marry Jiang Tianming.
But the Sect Master of Yun Shang had not yet agreed, still deliberating.
The reason behind this was simple, Jiang Buping was a child born out of wedlock but undeniably had monstrous talent. Marrying into the Yun Shang Sect would not disadvantage them, and both sides would have formed some sort of alliance.
However, if Yun Yan'er were to marry Jiang Tianming, the Yun Shang Sect could easily become a subordinate force of the Jiang Clan, which is why negotiations were still ongoing, with no conclusion reached yet.
Nonetheless, to outsiders, it seemed very likely that Yun Yan'er would marry Jiang Tianming. After all, the two seemed to be in perfect harmony, like a couple made in heaven, and this was likely to bring some subtle changes to the structure of the Taikun Realm.
In a certain courtyard of the Jiang Clan,
As the third son of the current patriarch of the Jiang Clan and a celebrated prodigy of the clan, Jiang Tianming resided within this courtyard.
One month ago, Jiang Tianming made a breakthrough to the Immortal Realm and had only recently emerged from seclusion.
"Tianming brother, you are the third youngest Immortal Heavenly Venerable in the history of our Taikun Realm."
Yun Yan'er leaned into Jiang Tianming's arms with a look of admiration on her face.
"Third, huh,"
Jiang Tianming looked at the beauty in his arms; this woman had a unique aura, ethereal like drifting smoke, moving his heart as well.
"Yes, indeed,"
Yun Yan'er nodded.
"That's because I eliminated someone, otherwise I wouldn't be in the top three."
Jiang Tianming said with a smile.
Yun Yan'er's expression froze as she thought of someone and then said with a laugh, "Well, that may not be certain. After all, advancing to the Immortal Realm is difficult. Even though he was the youngest True King Heavenly Venerable, whether he could have broken through to the Immortal Realm was unknown."
She said so, but she knew that Jiang Buping's advancement to the Immortal Realm would have been without issue.
"The man is already ruined, and likely dead by now, so let's not mention him."
Jiang Tianming said with a smile.
"Okay!"
Yun Yan'er nodded obediently.
"Third Young Master, a man named Liang Quan asks to see you, claiming to have a confidential matter."
A Maid came over and reported respectfully.
"Liang Quan?"
Jiang Tianming frowned, "Who is he? What confidential matter does he have?"
"Third Young Master, he is a subordinate of our family. As for the confidential matter, he says it must be reported in person and cannot be relayed."
The Maid spoke in a low voice.
Jiang Tianming's brow arched, "Tell him if he seeks to gain favor through a so-called confidential matter, if it's not something that can hold my attention, there's only one outcome for him. Let him think it over; if he still wants to see me, bring him in."
"Yes, Third Young Master!"
The Maid bowed and left.
After a while, the Maid returned with Liang Quan.
"Liang Quan pays respects to the Third Young Master!"
Liang Quan kneeled with a thud, offering his respects.
"Speak, what's this confidential matter?"
Jiang Tianming asked coolly.
Liang Quan raised his head to look at the Maid by his side.
"Hmph!"
Jiang Tianming snorted, "If your supposed confidential matter fails to capture my interest, you might as well feed it to the dogs."
After speaking, he waved his hand, and the Maid left the room.
"Rest assured, Third Young Master, this matter is of great importance. As soon as I learned of it, I rushed back to report to you!"
Liang Quan spoke respectfully and fawningly.
His eyes drifted toward Yun Yan'er in Jiang Tianming's arms, hesitating whether to speak or not.

chapters.title: Chapter 838 - 438 Enemy from the Taikun Realm
chapters.content:
Jiang Tianming's gaze turned slightly cold as he said indifferently, "If it's not about a family secret, just speak up. Yan'er is not an outsider!"
Upon hearing this, Liang Quan had a sudden realization; so this girl was Yun Yan'er.
He immediately replied with respect and flattery, "Third Young Master, please forgive me, this matter is somewhat special. But since it's Miss Yun Yan'er, there's no need for her to avoid this matter."
"Speak, what is it."
Jiang Tianming's hand moved slightly; he was already prepared to kill Liang Quan. In his view, as a mere Martial Artist from an affiliated force, one who held a slave-like status within the Jiang Clan, how could Liang Quan know anything about secret matters?
"To report to the Third Young Master, some time ago I went to Changyun Realm and encountered a person..."
Liang Quan paused, then said with a heavy voice, "Jiang Buping, I encountered Jiang Buping!"
Jiang Tianming's eyebrows raised, and Yun Yan'er's gaze also shifted over.
"Oh, he's still not dead?"
Yun Yan'er said with a light chuckle.
"If it's about this matter, it's not some secret. You're disturbing me for this..."
Jiang Tianming's gaze grew gradually colder, and a murderous intent emerged.
Liang Quan was almost breaking out in cold sweat as he hurriedly said, "Third Young Master, Jiang Buping has recovered, he is not muddleheaded, and his strength is even stronger than before!"
"What did you say?"
Yun Yan'er suddenly stood up.
"Impossible, he has already lost his spiritual wisdom!"
Jiang Tianming also stood up with a sunken face, "Liang Quan, you should know, Jiang Buping being muddleheaded and degenerated into a waste was confirmed by the clan's elders."
"Third Young Master, Miss Yun, what I said is absolutely true, I couldn't believe it when I saw him either, but it is indeed the case. He not only retained his spiritual wisdom, but his strength has also increased, and it seems he has cultivated a powerful Divine Soul Secret Technique. He killed an Outer Heavenly Spirit Colossal Armored Beast with a single strike..."
Liang Quan hurriedly reported in detail.
"Third Young Master, I am well aware this matter is not trivial, which is why I rushed back here in a hurry."
Jiang Tianming furrowed his brows, and Yun Yan'er looked solemn, attempting to speak several times.
"Has this matter been reported to anyone else?"
After a good while, Jiang Tianming asked.
"Third Young Master, I came here to report it immediately without telling anyone else!"
Liang Quan said respectfully.
"Good, very good, I appreciate someone who knows the times like you. Stay in this courtyard and follow me. You won't lack benefits."
Jiang Tianming said with satisfaction.
Liang Quan was coming to seek refuge, and he was also quite astute.
"Thank you, Third Young Master!"
Liang Quan was overjoyed.
From then on, he also became a member of the Jiang Clan's eldest young master's entourage, with a status and position much higher than the head of his own family.
"Alright, you may leave."
Jiang Tianming nodded.
"This servant takes his leave!"
Liang Quan retreated respectfully.
"Tianming, how is this possible? Could it just be someone who looks like him? After all, it's not unheard of for people in this world to resemble each other," Yun Yan'er said, unable to hold back after Liang Quan left.
"A Divine Soul stained with Imperishable Qi is bound to lose its wisdom, not to mention a True King Heavenly Venerable, even a martial artist above the Immortal Realm cannot avoid this fate if they become contaminated," Jiang Tianming replied with a heavy countenance.
"Jiang Buping's Divine Soul being tainted with Imperishable Qi is a solid fact confirmed by the elders. It was precisely for this reason that we gave up on Jiang Buping and banished him."
"Now, he has recovered? This matter is no small thing!" Jiang Tianming said with a grave expression.
Jiang Buping's Divine Soul was secretly tainted with Imperishable Qi; this was no secret, the clan's elders all knew it in their hearts. But since he had become a waste with no value, naturally there was no need to investigate.
As for Yun Yan'er, she was bound to marry into the Jiang Family, because she was the "culprit." If the Sect Master of Yun Shang Sect did not agree, the Jiang Clan would have a pretext to take action.
Having crippled an exceptional prodigy of the Jiang Family, it only made sense to offer some explanation.
Those who knew these inner workings certainly had a clear understanding, and, how could Jiang Buping himself not know who had schemed against him?
Therefore, once he rose again, he would surely come to seek an explanation.
"Tianming, what do we do now?" Yun Yan'er asked, frowning.
"Kill him, that's it!" Jiang Tianming said coldly.
"Yes, kill him. We were careless before," Yun Yan'er said, nodding in agreement jubilantly.
"This is a trivial matter. Don't say that he hasn't entered the Immortal Realm, even if he had broken through to the Immortal Realm, he is destined to die without a doubt. Don't worry about this, I will handle it," Jiang Tianming said, comforting her with a smile.
"Mhm mhm!" Yun Yan'er nodded.
"Even the Imperishable Qi can be expelled and you can recover, Jiang Buping, what kind of secret do you possess? If I could obtain it, wouldn't I..." Jiang Tianming pondered silently.
If even the Imperishable Qi could be removed and recovery was possible, what kind of opportunity or method was this? Who wouldn't be moved by it?
Yun Yan'er, too, had some thoughts in the depths of her eyes.
The Taikun Realm remained serene; it had been several hundred years since the turmoil in the Heavenly Grotto, entering a relatively calm era.
That day, two Immortal Heavenly Venerables left a certain courtyard belonging to the Jiang Clan.
Shortly after the departure of these two Immortal Heavenly Venerables, another Immortal Heavenly Venerable left the Yun Shang Sect, crossed the Realm Gate, and went on his way.
In the Yuanping Realm.
Jiang Buping had just finished his cultivation, his expression filled with excitement; he had finally integrated another strand of Imperishable Qi, his Divine Soul was strengthened, and his Extreme Soul Martial Arts had improved somewhat.
"Taikun Realm, Jiang Family, Yun Yan'er, wait for me. I, Jiang Buping, will certainly wash away all the shame. Your so-called glory is nothing but a joke in my eyes," Jiang Buping clenched his fist, his gaze icy.
"Let's hunt down that beast that's comparable to the Immortal Realm, the Outer Heavenly Spirit," he decided.

chapters.title: Chapter 839 - 438 Enemies from the Taikun Realm_2
chapters.content:
Jiang Buping was beyond excited.
With one experience under his belt, hunting down a second Immortal Realm True Spirit from beyond the heavens naturally seemed like child's play.
Boom!
As this outer Heavenly Spirit fell, the rest of the lesser outer Heavenly Spirits were frightened, hastily escaping the Heavenly Grotto and returning to the beyond.
However, Jiang Buping knew that it wouldn't be long before another outer Heavenly Spirit descended again.
For these outer Heavenly Spirits, the Heavenly Grotto was a treasure trove, far more comfortable than the world beyond. If not for the restrictions placed on the Heavenly Grotto, Heavenly Spirits beyond the Immortal Realm would probably have entered long ago.
The Yuanping Realm Martial Arts world was astir.
Someone with less than Immortal Realm strength had hunted two Immortal Realm True Spirits, and although it was through sneak attacks, it was still unprecedented.
And the fact that Jiang Buping had cultivated an immensely powerful Divine Soul Secret Technique naturally spread throughout the Yuanping Realm. Anyone capable of cultivating such a formidable Divine Soul Secret Technique must surely be a peerless genius from a Great Realm.
It was precisely for this reason that, despite some Undying Heavenly Venerables coveting the secret technique, they dared not make a move.
Jiang Buping continued his training in the Yuanping Realm. When the Heavenly Grotto again gave rise to an Immortal Realm outer Heavenly Spirit, he once more entered to hunt, spending even more time collecting and extracting the Imperishable Qi.
The name of the Spear God also spread throughout the Yuanping Realm.
There were those who wished to form good relations with Jiang Buping, casually trying to probe which Great Realm he hailed from. But Jiang Buping remained aloof, displaying an air of approachability to none. Over time, no one bothered him anymore.
"Roar!"
From within the Heavenly Grotto, heart-shaking roars echoed; the observing Martial Artists in the distance turned and fled!
Jiang Buping had finally slipped up.
"Why is this guy's Divine Soul so strong?"
Jiang Buping was extremely frustrated. For the first time, he had failed. This outer Heavenly Spirit's instinct for danger was much sharper than the previous True Spirits of the heavens.
It likely belonged to a higher order of outer Heavenly Spirits.
Instead of immediately licking his wounds with a pill, he continued to launch enraged attacks. Jiang Buping had no choice but to dodge its sharp edges.
However, this outer Heavenly Spirit kept a dead lock on him, launching attacks relentlessly, chasing after him nonstop, and not long after, another outer Heavenly Spirit joined in the pursuit.
Latterly, all the Heavenly Grotto's outer Heavenly Spirits were hunting Jiang Buping as if a beast fury had erupted.
"Run, the Spear God has faltered!"
"Damn it, it's the first time I've seen so many enraged outer Heavenly Spirits. We can't stay in the Heavenly Grotto."
"Crap! I just killed an outer Heavenly Spirit and haven't even managed to take it with me yet!"
For a moment, the numerous Martial Artists within the Heavenly Grotto frantically fled, distancing themselves from the Heavenly Grotto.
It was too terrifying.
All the outer Heavenly Spirits of the Heavenly Grotto were in a rage, killing on sight and chasing madly.
Under normal circumstances, they would only attack if one encroached upon their territory or when they wished to hunt. Never had it been like this before.
Clearly, the outer Heavenly Spirit that Jiang Buping had struck down was of a higher rank, its roar serving a lordly beast's purpose, causing all the outer Heavenly Spirits to go mad.
"We can't stay in the Heavenly Grotto for now."
Jiang Buping fled in panic. It was too terrifying; all the outer Heavenly Spirits of the Heavenly Grotto had gone mad, all heading for him with blood-red eyes.
Boom!
Blowing away an obstructing outer Heavenly Spirit with his Long Spear, Jiang Buping burst out of the Heavenly Grotto.
Upon leaving the Heavenly Grotto, Jiang Buping planned to find a place to go into seclusion and cultivate. Once things settled down a bit, he'd return to collect more Imperishable Qi.
At the location of the Yuanping Realm's Realm Gate, two figures emerged.
"May I know which realm you two gentlemen are from and what urgent matters bring you to our Yuanping Realm?"
The Undying Heavenly Venerable in charge of the Realm Gate appeared before the two.
"Taikun Realm, Jiang Clan, on a mission to capture a criminal," one of them replied indifferently.
"So you're from the Taikun Realm," the Undying Heavenly Venerable from the Yuanping Realm said, his voice gaining a note of respect. He soon withdrew, knowing that when it came to internal affairs of the Jiang Clan, it was best not to interfere.
After the two Undying Heavenly Venerables of the Jiang Clan departed, another Undying Heavenly Venerable stepped out at the Realm Gate.
"This gentleman..."
"Taikun Realm!"
The newcomer replied coldly and hurriedly left.
"A member of the Taikun Realm Jiang Clan? Has something happened with the Jiang Clan?" the Yuanping Realm's Undying Heavenly Venerable wondered.
"Better not get involved in the affairs of such a major clan," he decided.
He shook his head, no longer paying attention.
Although he had become an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, he still felt no confidence when facing a Great Realm powerhouse.
Jiang Buping was just leaving the Heavenly Grotto, communicating with his third senior sister through a Communication Talisman, when suddenly his expression became stern, and the Extreme Soul Divine Weapon appeared in his hand in an instant.
Immortal Heavenly Venerable!
And the comer bore ill will!
"Jiang Buping, you've really recovered!"
One of them said with a slightly shocked expression.
Jiang Buping looked at the two with an indifferent gaze and let out a cold laugh, "Recovered, so what? Who sent you to find me?"
"Jiang Buping, since you've recovered, just come back with us."
"Being tainted with the Imperishable Qi and still recovering, such a monster, the clan will surely cultivate you with great efforts once you return!"
The two Immortal Heavenly Venerables spoke up.
"What a joke!"
Jiang Buping sneered and said, "Do you really think I know nothing? If it were two old undying clan elders who came, I might believe they intend to bring me back to the Jiang Family, but what are you two? Even as Immortal Heavenly Venerables, you are not part of the Jiang Family's core. What right do you have to say these things?
"If my guess isn't wrong, the person who sent you must be Jiang Tianming, right?"
Jiang Buping was also somewhat surprised. He had always been in the Yuanping Realm, and he had never revealed his name or background. Yet, Jiang Tianming had found out about him so quickly.
"Jiang Buping, recognize your place. Since you refuse to come back with us willingly, don't blame us for using some methods!"
One of them said as he stepped forward, directly approaching Jiang Buping with an overpowering aura of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
He was very confident; no matter how extraordinary Jiang Buping was, he had not yet entered the Immortal Realm and could be easily subdued.
Jiang Buping's gaze turned icy; their contempt and carelessness provided an excellent opportunity to act!
Hum!
A spear thrust out fiercely, a cold gleam streaking through the air, deadly and fierce.
"Ants..."
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable scoffed with disdain. However, in the next moment, he looked horrified as a chill emerged within him.
A strong sense of danger suddenly descended!
And at that moment, to his alarm, he realized that Jiang Buping's spear seemed to be aimed not at his body but at his Divine Soul; the spear's gleam did not flicker in his sight but sprang up within his Divine Soul!
Boom!
In the crisis, he hastily activated his secret technique. The Divine Soul Force instantly condensed into a shield in front of the spear's gleam.
As an Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Great Realm Jiang Clan, he naturally cultivated the Divine Soul Secret Technique. This Divine Soul Defense Technique had blocked more than one attack.
Spurt!
However, this shield, condensed by Divine Soul Force, was like paper, easily pierced by the spear. The Long Spear penetrated his Divine Soul.
"Ahh!"
The severe pain in his Divine Soul made him scream in agony.
"You're seeking death!"
The other Immortal Heavenly Venerable's expression changed drastically as his aura burst out, and the Domain Power instantly appeared, reaching for Jiang Buping.
After a successful strike, Jiang Buping promptly retreated.
The other's Divine Soul Defense Technique was too rudimentary and trashy for him, and in a rush, how could it withstand his attack?
However, it was only this one strike; now that the opponent was prepared, wielding the power of their Domain, it would be impossible to suddenly pierce the Divine Soul again.
"Still lacking some strength, after all!"
Jiang Buping thought with a sense of helplessness.
With just a bit more strength, even an Immortal Heavenly Venerable wouldn't be able to withstand the might of his Extreme Soul Divine Weapon.
At this moment, facing two Immortal Heavenly Venerables, even though one of them had a wounded Divine Soul, he could only dodge their sharp edges.
"Catch him, his Divine Soul Secret Technique is very strong!"
The injured Immortal Heavenly Venerable, while taking Divine Medicine and enduring the excruciating pain in his Divine Soul, pursued with a chase.
"Go back and tell Jiang Tianming, clean his neck and wait for death!"
As Jiang Buping's figure flickered, he had already escaped the Domain controlled by the other party and was about to flee far away. Suddenly his expression changed, and he thrust his spear out while his body shifted, instantly dodging to the other side.
Boom!
The spot where he originally stood was slashed by a blade of light.
Another Immortal Heavenly Venerable appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 840 - 439: The Invincible Master, Defeating Enemies with a Single Glance
chapters.content:
"Yun Shang Sect!"
Jiang Buping's gaze was icy as he looked at the Immortal Heavenly Venerable who appeared.
"Ha, you really think the three of you can take me down?"
With his current strength, there was absolutely no way he could match the three Immortal Heavenly Venerables. A layer of illusion emerged, and in an instant, Jiang Buping's true body had already fled into the distance.
"Chase!"
The two Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Jiang Clan glanced at the individual from the Yun Shang Sect but said nothing, tacitly giving chase together.
"This boy must not be allowed to live. He already possesses such strength without having reached the Immortal Realm; once he breaks through, both of us will be killed by him!"
"Indeed!"
The three Immortal Heavenly Venerables pursued, but Jiang Buping's speed was so fast that he was even swifter than they, and in a mere moment, he had disappeared into the horizon.
"With just the three of us, we're probably unable to seal Jiang Buping. It looks like we'll need to borrow some strength."
"I'll go and seek help from the major powers of the Yuanping Realm, you two continue the pursuit," said the injured Immortal Heavenly Venerable gravely.
"Alright!"
The other two continued to pursue along the path of Jiang Buping's escape.
Within a large tree, Jiang Buping's form emerged, his eyes cold as he watched the two Immortal Heavenly Venerables leaving in the distance.
Using the unique characteristic of his Imperishable Spirit Soul, he had merged directly into the tree, concealing his breath and evading the search.
"I can't go to the Heavenly Grotto, I'll be trapped there unless I use my master's Jade Talisman, which I'm not able to escape from otherwise."
Jiang Buping's expression was grim.
"I can no longer stay in the Yuanping Realm either."
Since the Jiang Clan and the Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Yun Shang Sect had pursued him to the Yuanping Realm, he could only temporarily avoid their sharp edges and travel to other realms.
"Once I break through, your death day will arrive!"
Jiang Buping thought coldly to himself.
Moving swiftly, he went to where the Realm Gate of the Yuanping Realm was, preparing to flee the Yuanping Realm.
"Jiang Family's reject? You've come right to me, just perfect for taking you down!"
However, just as Jiang Buping reached the Realm Gate, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable who was protecting the area suddenly made a move, wishing to capture him.
Boom!
Jiang Buping lashed out with one strike of his Long Spear and quickly retreated.
"Jiang Tianming, hmph!"
Jiang Buping could only flee.
The major powers of the Yuanping Realm were actually offering a hefty reward for his capture and, in order to please the Taikun Jiang Clan, Immortal Heavenly Venerables personally took part in the pursuit.
"A Divine Soul Secret Technique as a reward condition?"
Jiang Buping's face darkened immensely.
For most Immortal Heavenly Venerables, a Divine Soul Secret Technique was a truly powerful secret technique; one could imagine the temptation of receiving such a technique.
Moreover, knowing that Jiang Buping was a criminal of the Jiang Clan and possessed a powerful Divine Soul Secret Technique, how could those Immortal Heavenly Venerables not be tempted?
Without the backing of a Great Realm power, they had no reservations.
"Jiang Buping, surrender yourself; you can't escape."
On the edge of the Yuanping Realm's wilderness, Jiang Buping's face looked grim.
He had been careless!
In addition to the three Immortal Heavenly Venerables from the Taikun Realm, there were also five from the Yuanping Realm, and they had now sealed off the surroundings tightly.
Jiang Buping had planned to cross the wilderness to leave the Yuanping Realm, but he was blocked at the edge of the wasteland.
Although surrounded, Jiang Buping did not panic; he was just a bit frustrated that he had carelessly failed to hide his own tracks.
"Compared to the eldest and the second senior brothers, I'm still a bit less experienced and careful," Jiang Buping silently sighed to himself, realizing he needed to be more cautious on his future path. If he could change his form and appearance, he would do so to avoid being tracked down.
"Do the nobles of the Yuanping Realm really want to get involved in this muddled mess? This is a grudge between Jiang Buping and the Taikun Realm; think carefully about the consequences before you get involved!" Jiang Buping looked coldly at the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Yuanping Realm.
"Jiang Buping, spare us the threats. You know what the consequences are today. You're in no position to threaten us with your current strength," one of the Yuanping Realm's Immortal Heavenly Venerables said indifferently.
Outside the circle of Immortal Heavenly Venerables, a group of True King Heavenly Venerables were watching the spectacle.
"Jiang Buping, ah, I know who he is now, the abandoned son of Taikun, once the youngest True King Heavenly Venerable!"
"Why would the Jiang Clan abandon such a prodigy?"
"Wasn't it said that Jiang Buping had been crippled? But looking at him now, he's invincible under the Immortal Realm. He has made history in Martial Arts by having so many Immortal Heavenly Venerables after him."
The many onlooking True King Heavenly Venerables sighed with admiration.
He must be the first True King Heavenly Venerable in history to be chased by so many Immortal Heavenly Venerables, right?
"What a pity, Jiang Buping is bound to not escape this calamity today. Who will get his Divine Soul Secret Technique, I wonder?"
"What are you thinking? That's a secret technique of the Jiang Clan; who could get it? Well, the Jiang Clan did offer a Divine Soul Secret Technique as a reward, making the trip worthwhile for those Immortal Heavenly Venerables."
"That's right. With such a powerful Divine Soul Secret Technique, who would dare covet it? The Jiang Clan would certainly strike with lightning speed."
The crowd of Martial Artists nodded in agreement.
The more potent a Divine Soul Secret Technique, the more it was a core inheritance of a Great Realm power, and anyone who dared to claim it would be thoroughly exterminated, with nowhere in the Divine Realm to hide.
This was a tacit understanding among all Great Realm powers, and there would be no shelter from other Great Realm powers.
This is also one of the reasons why no core secret technique of a Great Realm has ever emerged.
Jiang Buping, holding his Long Spear, looked directly at the encirclement of eight Immortal Heavenly Venerables with no trace of fear. With his current strength, it was almost impossible for him to break through the encirclement.
Even so, it was impossible for them to kill him either.
Even without his master's Life-saving Jade Charm, Jiang Buping was confident that, with an Imperishable Spirit Soul, he couldn't be destroyed by mere Immortal Heavenly Venerables.

chapters.title: Chapter 841 - 439: The Invincible Master, Defeating Enemies with a Single Glance_2
chapters.content:
The Imperishable Qi merged into his Divine Soul, and as long as the Imperishable Qi did not extinguish, he would not be killed. However, once he was captured, his Divine Soul Force could also be worn down by the opponent, causing the Divine Soul to weaken.
This was also the strength of the Imperishable Divine Soul, which he shouldn't have been able to cultivate at his realm. But because he was born with a Divine Soul and had been tainted with the Imperishable Qi, he could cultivate the Imperishable Divine Soul at this realm.
"It is not impossible to escape!"
Jiang Buping looked down at the ground.
"To escape in this manner, my original physical body can only dissipate, fully transitioning into a Divine Soul state. It is somewhat reluctant."
Jiang Buping sighed in his heart.
Although his physical body had long been integrated into his Divine Soul, it still existed fundamentally. And if he wanted to turn into Divine Soul Force and meld into the earth to escape, he could only completely abandon his physical body in order to diffuse his Divine Soul into the ground extensively, formlessly, and tracelessly to avoid detection.
"So be it, it was my own carelessness, and I should bear it!"
Jiang Buping made his decision and was preparing to escape using this method.
If he could avoid using the Jade Talisman given by his master, he would do so as much as possible, so as not to trouble his master. This was the greatest principle to uphold as a disciple!
"Jiang Buping, do not delude yourself with the thought of escape. Surrender without a fight and suffer less."
An Immortal Heavenly Venerable from the Taikun Realm Jiang Clan approached, his presence surging with each step.
Suddenly!
A figure drifted over.
Li Xuan looked at his fifth disciple and was somewhat speechless. To think he had been cornered by someone, how careless could he be.
"After cultivating the Extreme Soul Martial Arts, you've become a bit too confident."
Li Xuan heaved a sigh in his heart.
"Master?!"
Jiang Buping was shocked and then overjoyed.
"Hm!"
Li Xuan nodded, "When you first left the Taikun Realm, you were good at adapting and self-preservation, how come you are now surrounded by others?"
Jiang Buping, upon hearing this, was at once ashamed and embarrassed, "Master's teachings are correct, it was the disciple who was careless."
Ever since he practiced the Extreme Soul Martial Arts and his strength surpassed the peak, he grew somewhat complacent, believing that he could easily deal with an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, which resulted in his careless entrapment.
"The Teacher has repeatedly emphasized that a true Martial Artist is not a reckless brute. Do not become arrogant because of your great strength, and always bear in mind that there is always someone better, and there are heavens beyond our own.
"Throughout history, many prodigies have died from arrogance, and many strong ones have capsized in a gutter..."
Li Xuan taught with a stern face.
The surrounding Immortal Heavenly Venerables looked on with ugly expressions and eyes filled with gravity.
This person had arrived abruptly without their noticing beforehand.
Moreover, he was Jiang Buping's master?
But seeing how this person was instructing his disciple with such disregard for them, they could not help but be filled with rage.
"Sir, do you still have the mood to instruct your disciple? Jiang Buping is a criminal of our Taikun Jiang Clan, and since you are his master, you should follow us back to Taikun to face the charges..."
An Immortal Heavenly Venerable from the Taikun Realm Jiang Clan said with a cold glare.
Li Xuan looked up indifferently, "Insects, prattling!"
In the shocked gaze of the other Immortal Heavenly Venerables, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable who had spoken was reduced to ashes in an instant, without even uttering a scream!
Gulp!
At that moment, the remaining seven Immortal Heavenly Venerables felt their scalps tingle, their hearts and livers tremble, and their entire bodies shake slightly.
Was it possible that just a glance could turn an Immortal Heavenly Venerable into ash?
What terrifying existence was this, unheard of!
Even another Immortal Heavenly Venerable from the Taikun Realm of the Jiang Clan and one from the Yun Shang Sect were shocked to their cores, breaking out in a cold sweat.
What level of power must one possess to cause an Immortal Heavenly Venerable to disintegrate with a mere glance?
What was more terrifying was that the individual did not reveal any aura or suppressive presence of a powerful being, it was merely a normal and simple glance.
And the person had turned to ash.
Even Immortal Heavenly Venerables could not achieve the feat of looking at an insect on the ground and causing it to disintegrate into ash.
In that being's eyes, Immortal Heavenly Venerables were less than insects!
Jiang Buping was shocked beyond measure; this was his invincible master, who had merely glanced, and an Immortal Heavenly Venerable had turned to ash.
"To be an existence that transcends the Domain is so terrifying!"
Jiang Buping felt his blood boiling, "I, Jiang Buping, will also surely transcend the Domain and become a strong being like my master!"
An Immortal Heavenly Venerable from the Yun Shang Sect moved subtly, slowly retreating, and then suddenly turned and flew away in haste.
Too terrifying!
Jiang Buping had such a terrifying master, capturing him, seizing him, was simply impossible!
"Did I let you go?"
The indifferent voice of Li Xuan arose.
The remaining six Immortal Heavenly Venerables had just attempted to flee when they were horrified to see that the Immortal Heavenly Venerable who had just fled had disintegrated into ash.
Gulp!
At that moment, the other Immortal Heavenly Venerables were so frightened that their faces turned deathly white, their bodies trembled slightly, and with a thud, they all found their legs weakening and knelt on the ground.
"Senior, spare my life, this matter has nothing to do with me..."
One of the Yuanping Realm Immortal Heavenly Venerables pleaded with a trembling voice.
"Silence!"
Pfft!
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable who had pleaded for mercy also turned into ash and dissipated.
The remaining Immortal Heavenly Venerables, terrified, hurriedly kept their mouths tightly shut, not even daring to breathe, in fear of making any noise that might disturb this terrifying being.
They even frantically controlled the trembling of their bodies, afraid that shaking too much would incur the dissatisfaction of that dreadful existence.
Yet, the fear inside could not be suppressed; their bodies knelt on the ground, shivering uncontrollably.
Every face was covered in cold sweat, continuously streaming down!
Even though they were usually looked up to, revered, the Immortal Heavenly Venerables felt fear in the presence of such a terrifying and unknown existence; their powerful cultivation could not control their fear.
In the distance, the crowd of True King Heavenly Venerables watching the scene didn't know exactly what had happened, but they saw a figure suddenly appear beside Jiang Buping.
Immediately after, a group of Immortal Heavenly Venerables knelt down!
"Run for it!"
If even Immortal Heavenly Venerables were kneeling, it was imaginable how terrifying that existence must be.
A group of True King Heavenly Venerables, although fleeing frantically backwards, did not dare to make any noise, fearing they would be noticed.
"What is that?"
"Could it be a powerful being hidden in the wilderness has been disturbed?"
"Possible!"
The group of True King Heavenly Venerables were escaping while simultaneously sending voice transmissions to discuss with each other.
The wilderness had always been filled with rumors, including stories of Immortal Heavenly Venerables falling.
Therefore, their first thought was that an unknown being from the wilderness had been startled into action.
Shortly after, a group of True King Heavenly Venerables who were spectating had all fled.
On the edge of the wilderness, several strong individuals knelt, shaking uncontrollably, their heads hung low, not daring to look up.
"These people, how do you think they should be dealt with?"
After guiding Jiang Buping, Li Xuan looked towards the Immortal Heavenly Venerables kneeling on the ground and asked.
Jiang Buping's eyes were cold and harsh. He took a deep breath and said, "Naturally, they should all be killed!"
"Hmm!"
Li Xuan nodded in satisfaction.
Upon hearing this, the Yuanping Realm Immortal Heavenly Venerable hurriedly began to plead for mercy, his voice trembling so badly that he could hardly speak clearly.
"Spare..."
However, before he could finish speaking, a gust of wind blew past, and they all turned to ash and dissipated.
"You and the Taikun Realm will have to resolve your grudges on your own, I will not take action."
Li Xuan walked forward leisurely, with Jiang Buping closely following behind.
"Yes, Master, I shall seek justice for myself."
Jiang Buping said respectfully.
"Extreme Soul Martial Arts is a path of killing, the ultimate killing. Now, you still lack the ultimate killing intent. Train yourself more. Today, I will give you more guidance on the Extreme Soul Martial Arts and pass on more Extreme Soul Divine Skills to you. How much you can comprehend, how much you can cultivate, is all up to you."
Li Xuan transferred the further refined, newly invented Extreme Soul Martial Arts Divine Skills and the secret techniques of Extreme Soul Martial Arts to Jiang Buping one by one.
"Thank you, Master. I will diligently cultivate and strive to achieve a breakthrough soon."
Jiang Buping responded reverently.
"You have begun your journey on the Extreme Soul path, how far you can go will be up to you. Martial Arts is endless; work hard, and forge your own path in Martial Arts."
Li Xuan waved his hand and improved Jiang Buping's Jade Talisman.

chapters.title: Chapter 842 - 440: The Purple-robed Youngster: This is the Strongest Domain
chapters.content:
After instructing Jiang Buping, Li Xuan prepared to return to Qinghua state.
"Master, this is an Outer Heavenly Spirit I hunted, a gift for Third Senior Sister,"
Jiang Buping took out a Storage Ring.
"Mhm."
Li Xuan nodded, took the Storage Ring, stepped forward, and vanished in an instant.
After respectfully sending his master off, Jiang Buping took a deep breath, turned back to look towards the direction of Yuanping Realm, stepped across the wilderness, and left Yuanping Realm.
"Jiang Tianming, Yun Yan'er, wait for my return to Taikun Realm."
Once his strength broke through, it would be time to return to Taikun Realm to seek justice.
...
Li Xuan went to Nine Mountains Realm once more, giving instruction to Red Cat.
Back in Qinghua state, he handed over the Storage Ring with the Outer Heavenly Spirit to Su Lingxiu and then continued to sit leisurely in his chair.
Even though he had thoroughly memorized the Book of Taicang, it didn't hinder him from studying it from beginning to end again, continuing to comprehend the origins of the entire Domain.
As for the youth in the purple robe, Li Xuan left him hanging for now. Knowing the youth's character, he probably wouldn't have the patience for monotony.
"The secrets of the Domain are not urgent; let's take it slowly. Being too hasty might arouse his suspicion."
Li Xuan muttered to himself.
Qinghua state was undergoing major construction, with Spirit Cities being established one after another. On the edges of the wilderness, Formation Arrays were continuously set up, strengthening the barrier of the Formations.
Fang Hao was extremely busy, and so was Su Lingxiu, who was continuously transforming Da Yue Abyss into the Domain Divine Furnace.
At the same time, she also needed to find time to instruct a group of Qinghua Sect disciples in Alchemy.
The Qinghua Sect was flourishing, be it Artifact Refining, Alchemy, or the Formation Path; many prodigies were emerging.
Even including Sword Dao and Physical Body Martial Arts, prodigies were appearing.
That day, Qinghua state finally welcomed two outsiders who crossed the Realm Gate from Nine Mountains Realm.
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable overseeing the Realm Gate softens the blockade and allowed them to enter Qinghua state only after learning they were directed by Xu Yan.
Besides, upon entering Qinghua state, an Immortal Heavenly Venerable accompanied them throughout their journey, not allowing them to wander and directed them straight to the Alchemical Medical Institute.
Luo Zhan felt that Qinghua state seemed to be undergoing some significant transformation.
However, his visit was to seek treatment for Hong Ting, so he followed the arrangements of the accompanying Immortal Heavenly Venerable obediently.
Yet, upon arrival at the former Capital City of Da Yue Country, which was now the grand city of Qinghua Sect's headquarters, he was still immensely shocked.
"I've never seen such a grand city, never seen a place where Spiritual Energy and Domain Lingji are so active."
Luo Zhan was profoundly astounded.
"This is the Alchemical Medical Institute. However, the head of the institute, Su Lingxiu, is not here; you can wait for a moment."
"Thank you!"
Luo Zhan expressed his gratitude.
Cradling the lethargic, spiritless Hong Ting, he waited in the consulting room of the Alchemical Medical Institute.
All that he saw before him made him feel as though his eyes were being opened to new wonders.
Yue'er came over with a diagnostic Divine Artifact and asked, "Are you the seeker recommended by Young Master Xu?"
"Yes, I am."
Even though she was just a young girl and her strength didn't seem strong, Luo Zhan didn't put on any airs of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
Yue'er nodded, used the diagnostic Divine Artifact on Hong Ting, and inquired about how he got injured.
Upon learning that it was due to the erosion of Depraved Witchcraft Power, Yue'er's eyes lit up instantly, as injuries to the Divine Soul and will were extremely rare.
Moreover, Su Lingxiu was always interested in peculiar and complicated conditions.
Such injuries were usually undetectable by common diagnostic Divine Artifacts, let alone offering a treatment plan.
And indeed, the diagnostic Divine Artifact was unable to provide a concrete treatment plan, merely suggesting a pill recipe that could stimulate the Divine Soul, allowing temporary alertness but incapable of curing.
"Please wait."
Yue'er excitedly went to find Su Lingxiu.
Upon hearing the news, Su Lingxiu rushed back, excited. She had already heard about the power of the Fall Witch's Evil Eye from Xu Yan and now had the perfect opportunity to research how the Fall Witch's Evil Eye could erode the will of the Divine Soul.
"Hong Ting, right? Big Brother has already told me about you."
After briefly examining Hong Ting's condition, Su Lingxiu's eyes sparkled as she said to Luo Zhan, "This injury isn't hard to treat. It needs a purification of the Divine Soul, the removal of the Depraved Witchcraft Power. And the best method to expel the Depraved Witchcraft Power is to perform surgery on the Divine Soul!"
Upon hearing this, Luo Zhan's joy knew no bounds, as Hong Ting could finally be saved.
"No problem, thank you, miss!"
Luo Zhan nodded joyously.
As for something like surgery on the Divine Soul, it was beyond his understanding, but as long as it could cure Hong Ting, the method didn't matter at all.
"Okay, since you have no objections, go ahead and sign this consent form for treatment. He will be recovered in three days,"
Su Lingxiu declared, brimming with delight.
Yue'er handed over a consent form, and Luo Zhan, without reading through it carefully, signed it right away.
He thought to himself, "This Alchemical Medical Institute truly has rigorous treatment procedures and fully respects its patients. Indeed impressive!"
With excitement, Su Lingxiu and Yue'er wheeled Hong Ting away, while Meng Shushu took responsibility for entertaining Luo Zhan.
In the treatment room of the Alchemical Medical Institute belonging solely to Su Lingxiu, Hong Ting had already entered a state of deep slumber.
"Let's see how this Depraved Witchcraft Power erodes the will of the Divine Soul."
Su Lingxiu was thrilled. She extracted Hong Ting's Divine Soul and laid it on an artifact platform that could bear Divine Souls. Her divine essence transformed into needles and scalpels as she began to operate.
Yue'er assisted by her side.
"So, this is the power of Depraved Witchcraft, I see. By placing a seal at the core of the Divine Soul's will, one can easily resist the erosion of Depraved Witchcraft Power."

chapters.title: Chapter 843 - 440: The Purple-robed Youngster: This is the Strongest Domain_2
chapters.content:
Su Lingxiu separated the Depraved Witchcraft Power from within the Divine Soul and stored it in a special vessel.
"Since I have a connection with the eldest senior brother, let me help him,"
said Su Lingxiu, who, with some Divine Medicine, turned it into delicate threads and infused them into the Divine Soul, forming a rune.
With this rune, Hong Ting will possess immense resistance against the power of the Fall Witch's Evil Eye.
"I have already perceived the pathway through which the Fall Witch's Evil Eye erodes the will of the Divine Soul; just need to block this vulnerability, and with his strength, even if he encounters an Immortal Realm Depraved Witch, he will be able to resist the light of the Evil Eye,"
Su Lingxiu said excitedly.
Understanding the pathway of erosion by the Fall Witch's Evil Eye allows for targeted defenses to be devised, and even the creation of methods to counteract the Fall Witch's Evil Eye.
After a period of research and treatment, the Divine Soul was returned to Hong Ting's body.
"All is well now; he is cured and will have great resistance to the force of the Fall Witch's Evil Eye in the future,"
Su Lingxiu said with a smile.
"Thank you, Miss Su!"
Luo Zhan was overjoyed.
"I'll wake him up now,"
Su Lingxiu produced a long thin needle and pricked Hong Ting's head, and after a while, Hong Ting opened his eyes.
He looked somewhat bewildered at first, but then jumped up and showed a look of excitement.
Gone was any hint of lethargy.
The spirited will to fight, characteristic of a Martial Artist from the Battle Hall, re-emerged, and at that moment, tears welled up in Hong Ting's eyes.
I almost became a cripple!
"Thank you, miss, for saving my life!"
He bowed respectfully to Su Lingxiu.
"It was just a small effort,"
Su Lingxiu waved her hand dismissively.
"To the miss, it may have been just a small effort, but to Hong Ting, it is as if he has been reborn; should the miss ever have any commands, Hong Ting would not hesitate to go through fire and water in this life!"
Hong Ting expressed his gratitude with a solemn look.
"Here is your consultation fee!"
Luo Zhan produced a Storage Bag.
"That's settled then; I have other matters to attend to,"
Yue'er took the consultation fee and Su Lingxiu waved her hand before hastily returning to the Da Yue Abyss.
Luo Zhan and Hong Ting had originally planned to stroll around the Qinghua state to see what changes were taking place,
but Emperor Da Yue personally entertained them, preventing them from visiting other areas and, in the end, sent both men directly to the Realm Gate to leave.
Luo Zhan had no choice but to accept this, however, he understood that there must be some plotting happening within the Qinghua state.
After seeing off Luo Zhan and Hong Ting, Emperor Da Yue and other Immortal Heavenly Venerables threw themselves frantically into the construction of the Qinghua Sect, preparing for the arrangement of the Qinghua Great Formation.
Time flew rapidly, and the Qinghua Great Formation continued to improve, while people in the Qinghua state kept breaking through to the Immortal Realm with the help of pills.
The three of Emperor Da Yue had advanced their power even further and had finally cultivated a Divine Skill recently.
Meanwhile, the Divine Realm was becoming increasingly chaotic, with realms erupting into turmoil one after another and even large-scale battles occurring between two realms.
The unrest in the Nine Mountain Realm continued unabated, yet it did not spread to the Qinghua state.
The fame of Xu Yan and Meng Chong also gradually spread throughout the Divine Realm.
Xu Yan's retaliation against Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow ensured that wherever he went, he destroyed one Earth Shadow stronghold after another, slaughtering numerous Earth Shadow Members hiding within other powers, thus offending a host of forces.
For these powers, Xu Yan's actions were seen as provocations, regardless of whether they believed the slain individuals to be Earth Shadow Members; even if the identities of the dead were acknowledged, these matters should have been dealt with by the powers themselves, rather than Xu Yan executing them directly.
This amounted to disregarding these significant powers, and it was for this reason Xu Yan often faced joint assassination attempts by many forces.
