Meng Chong had offended the Wanbao Alliance and was now being pursued throughout the Divine Realm by the alliance; since they were already enemies, there was no longer any need for courtesy.
Therefore, Meng Chong directly looted the branches of the Wanbao Alliance, naturally inciting the fury of the Alliance which dispatched Immortal Heavenly Venerables to hunt down Meng Chong everywhere.
Jiang Buping was also being hunted by the Taikun Jiang Clan and the Yun Shang Sect, but as he kept a lower profile, his fame was not as loud as Xu Yan and Meng Chong, at least for the time being.
Xu Yan had achieved perfection in the Physiognomy Realm and was just one step away from the Void-breaking Realm.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has slain an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, and your Martial Arts experience has increased,"
Li Xuan read without much reaction from the feedback in the Daoist Golden Book.
Now, Xu Yan had the power to kill an ordinary Immortal Heavenly Venerable on his own, and the feedback from the Daoist Golden Book was only in terms of Martial Arts experience.
"The realm and power are far greater than my disciple's, hence the feedback is decreasing,"
Li Xuan mused to himself.
Meng Chong and Su Lingxiu had also reached great accomplishments in the Physiognomy Realm, and Fang Hao's realm was not far behind.
Jiang Buping's strength was also comparable.
"It's time for a trip to the Great Wilderness,"
Li Xuan revealed a smile.
Extreme Soul Body calmly sat in the chair, while Li Xuan had already arrived in the Great Wilderness, outside the Wu Country Royal Palace.
His gaze penetrated the barriers, looking towards that small stone cottage.
The youth in the purple robe sat in the cottage, scratching his ears and cheeks, a face full of impatience, his hair all ruffled and messy.
"Where is everyone? Why hasn't anyone come yet? Could it be that he really just came to idle chatter with me?"
The youth in the purple robe was thoroughly disheartened.
Unsure of how many ages had passed, finally, a powerhouse who he could converse with had come along, and now after one visit, there was no follow-up?
As for The Emperor of Wu and others, in his eyes, they were but ants, offering no topics of interest to relieve his boredom.
"This person too, as long as there is no malice, I am still willing to chat with him about some things."
The youth in the purple robe was deeply frustrated.
Just as he was about to go back to sleep, suddenly a figure stepped into the small stone cottage.
"You've finally come!"
The youth in the purple robe said with overwhelming joy.
Upon speaking, he suddenly realized he seemed too excited, and immediately his expression turned cool, becoming distant.
"What have you come for now?"
He appeared as if he didn't wish to see anyone.
Inside, Li Xuan chuckled, turned around, and made as if to leave, "Then shall I go?"
"No, no, wait, since you're here, have a seat and let's chat,"
The youth in the purple robe hurriedly spoke.
"Let's chat then."
Li Xuan appeared somewhat reluctant.
After sitting down, he brewed a pot of tea.
This was truly plain tea; he poured a cup for the youth in the purple robe, saying, "Come, have some tea."
"Why do you like to drink this kind of..."
The youth in the purple robe grimaced, intending to say 'trash', but fearing that the other party would leave unhappy, he could only pick up the cup and down it in one gulp, looking miserable.
Upon tasting the tea, his entire face wrinkled in distaste.
"Indeed, a youngster, both your state of mind and cultivation are too poor,"
Li Xuan shook his head in lament, lightly sipping the tea. Even though he also found it bitter, he showed an expression of enjoyment.
The youth in the purple robe said, "You, your realm must really be high, you can even find such an awful drink so tasty."
"This is the Dao," like I said, "What I am savoring isn't the tea, it's invincibility, it's loneliness, it's the Dao..."
Li Xuan spoke cryptically and beguilingly.
"Young man, what do you think of this domain?"
Li Xuan asked playfully to start the conversation.
"It's nice, what about it?"
The youth in the purple robe asked, puzzled.
"This domain, actually, is too weak, too fragile, don't you think so? Moreover, this domain is missing something, it seems incomplete to me."
Li Xuan critiqued the domain.
"How can it be weak? This domain, is the strongest there is,"
The youth in the purple robe argued defiantly.
Li Xuan smiled inwardly, understanding from the youth's words that there were more domains than this one and that the Taicang Domain was the strongest.
"As for what you mentioned about something missing, maybe you're right,"
The youth in the purple robe suddenly seemed a bit despondent, as if thinking of something.
"Oh? So you, a mere youth, also know what this place lacks?"
Li Xuan asked, feigning surprise.
"Of course, I am..."
The youth in the purple robe suddenly stopped speaking, shifting the topic: "Actually, I am quite strong, so of course I know."
"No, no, no, you do not know. What you know is only superficial, not the same thing that I said is missing,"
Li Xuan shook his head.
"Impossible, no one knows better than I what this domain lacks. I am..."
The youth in the purple robe rebutted.
"You are too weak; you have not grasped the essence of the domain, nor do you understand its evolution, and you do not know how to make the domain continuously strong..."
Li Xuan shook his head.
"Never mind, you wouldn't understand even if I explained,"
The youth in the purple robe glared, still unconvinced, "You might be very strong, but when it comes to this domain, there is no way you understand it better than I do. I am..."

chapters.title: Chapter 844 - 441 My name is Tian Zi, it's time to trick the Seductive Witch.
chapters.content:
The purple-robed youth was speaking but halted mid-sentence, scratching his head and looking utterly distressed, finally saying somewhat irritably, "Anyway, you just need to know that I am very familiar with this Domain, very familiar, that's all, since, after all, I am...that what identity."
Li Xuan's smile was radiant, "Whatever you are, I naturally know. Since I've said that with regards to this Domain, you only grasp the surface and not what's missing, I have my reasons."
Surprised, the purple-robed youth asked, "You know me?"
"Naturally!"
Li Xuan nodded.
"Then tell me, what am I?"
The purple-robed youth was now interested.
Li Xuan raised his hand, pointing upwards to the sky, then downwards to the ground, and finally pointing at the purple-robed youth, smiling without speaking.
The purple-robed youth was confused.
"What do you mean by that?"
Li Xuan sighed and said, "You, young friend, are truly simple-minded, unable to understand even this."
The purple-robed youth scratched his head, his frustration showing, "Your pointing here and there, who knows what it means? Can't you just say it outright?"
Li Xuan chuckled and said, "I've already spoken plainly, but unfortunately, you're too dull-witted, think about it yourself."
The purple-robed youth looked at him skeptically, then seemed to ponder something.
"Why do all these powerful guys have this problem? They never speak directly, always preferring to be circuitous!"
He couldn't help but think of Taicang.
Li Xuan sipped his tea, maintaining a mysterious air and a look that suggested he had foreseen everything.
Actually, while Li Xuan knew that the purple-robed youth was not a creature of this Domain or even a creature at all, he was unable to ascertain the youth's exact identity.
Even though Li Xuan had reached the Domain Realm and had cultivated the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, he was still limited in understanding certain aspects and thus could not fully comprehend what the purple-robed youth was.
Of course, this was also because the one who had sealed the youth here was too powerful. With Li Xuan's current strength, even if he used the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, he couldn't fully penetrate the veil and see the youth's true nature.
However, Li Xuan did know that there must be a connection between the purple-robed youth and the owner of the Book of Taicang.
In the small stone house, Li Xuan and the purple-robed youth chatted leisurely, their conversation stretching from the Domain to Ancient Times, and then beyond the Domain.
The purple-robed youth clearly knew many secrets of the Domain, but whenever he approached a crucial point, he would hastily shut his mouth and refuse to continue.
Li Xuan didn't mind, appearing as if he had already seen through everything. Whether the purple-robed youth spoke or not was inconsequential to him.
"I should be going; who knows when I'll come again to chat with you, young friend."
Li Xuan stood up and spoke.
The purple-robed youth wore a conflicted look, wanting to say something but hesitating to speak.
"Young friend, no need to see me out."
Li Xuan waved his hand and left gracefully.
"This... elder, when will you come back again?"
The purple-robed youth spoke hesitantly.
"Whether I come or not, what difference does it make? I just came to chat with you, young friend, since you're confined here. Now that we have nothing left to discuss, it's naturally the end."
Li Xuanle laughed merrily, "After all, we're not familiar, are we?"
The purple-robed youth scratched his head and said, "Next time, next time you come, we'll talk about deeper things. Oh right, my name is Tian Zi."
A smile appeared on Li Xuan's face, "Tian Zi? Good, I'll remember that."
With a single step, he vanished from sight.
This visit, although he did not learn any profound secrets of the Domain from Tian Zi, had yielded some useful information.
Such as his name.
And that there isn't just one Domain, and the one Li Xuan resides in is the strongest of them all.
Of course, whether this is true still needs to be verified.
After all, Tian Zi was in the Taicang Domain and would naturally speak for it.
"The Netherworld, is it another Domain?"
Li Xuan murmured to himself.
He thought of the enemies beyond the Heavenly Grotto, which were probably creatures from another Domain, intending to invade the Taicang Domain.
If this was the case, could Taicang Domain really be the strongest?
Of course, this wasn't necessarily true; perhaps Taicang Domain was once the strongest, but some catastrophe led to its decline?
The exact secrets of the Domain would require further investigation to determine.
"Seductive Witch, a powerful being from another Domain?"
Li Xuan wondered.
Xu Yan had achieved Perfection in the Physiognomy Realm and was preparing to break into the Void-breaking Realm, and was likely now on his way to the trap set by the Seductive Witch.
"Hopefully the item that the Seductive Witch produces will be of some use."
Li Xuan was filled with anticipation.
Back in the Qinghua state, Li Xuan couldn't help but reflect. Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu were in their accumulation phase and were about to experience a significant increase in strength.
Once the Qinghua Great Formation was fully arranged, Fang Hao could make use of it to break through at once, and his subsequent path of cultivation would be much smoother.
It was the same for Su Lingxiu. Once the Domain Divine Furnace was completely forged, she could use it to rapidly enhance her Alchemical Medical Martial Arts.
"Your disciple Meng Chong has gained insight into the third layer of the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body, and you have broken through to the third layer of the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body."
The Daoist Golden Book opened, with golden light surging forth.
Li Xuan's heart rejoiced. It hadn't been easy, but Meng Chong had finally grasped the third layer of the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body.
"Even the Physical Body Martial Arts have broken through to the Domain Realm, becoming stronger once again."
Li Xuan was in high spirits.
"Su Lingxiu, that girl, should also spend some time pondering the Domain Cultivation Method, so that early enlightenment can help her break through my Alchemical Medical Martial Arts."
Li Xuan mused to himself that he needed to find time to guide Su Lingxiu, so she wouldn't neglect the Domain Cultivation Method in favor of focusing solely on the Domain Divine Furnace.

chapters.title: Chapter 845 - 441 My name is Tian Zi, it's time to trick the Seductive Witch_2
chapters.content:
...
The Guang You Realm was a place of broad vistas, where mountains were rarely seen, and although one could gaze far into the distance, there was an underlying sense of deep solitude—the name itself was inspired by this characteristic.
"Seductive Witch, can't wait any longer, can you? Here I come to trick you," Xu Yan finally stepped into the Guang You Realm.
Along the way, seeking revenge against Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow had delayed him quite a bit, and now he was about to make his breakthrough into the Void-breaking Realm; it was time to claim the treasures from the Seductive Witch.
Presumably, the Seductive Witch was already getting impatient.
Fortunately, he always took time to visit the wizard and demon caves in various realms, keeping the Seductive Witch updated on his search for the treasure troves, thus stringing along her patience.
"Wizard and demon caves are all interconnected, and the Seductive Witch must be a powerful being among them."
Now, some pieces of information could already be linked together.
"The Guang You Realm has a relatively smaller population, and fewer Heavenly Grottoes, only a handful, so the martial artists here are mostly idle," said Xu Yan as he traversed the Guang You Realm, heading towards a hidden Heavenly Grotto.
"There are some uncharted lands within the Guang You Realm that rarely see the footprints of martial artists, and there have been no invasions by enemies of Heavenly Grottos. This hidden grotto evidently has some restrictions that prevent invasion from outside the realm."
Xu Yan examined the treasure map and fell into thought.
"Aside from Duowu, are there other powerful beings aiding the Seductive Witch in this Heavenly Grotto?"
There's a limit to the power that Heavenly Grottos can bear, so the number of assistants the Seductive Witch can seek is also limited.
If the upper limit of this particular Heavenly Grotto is relatively high, then apart from Duowu, there must be other strong beings lurking.
"But, these are all trifling matters. My current strength is not what it used to be," Xu Yan was not worried.
Besides, he had a little wooden sword his master had given him, enough to deal with any unexpected ambush.
"This is the place," finally, Xu Yan arrived at the location indicated on the treasure map.
Amazed, he peered through the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path, "No wonder no one has discovered this Heavenly Grotto; it's hidden so well and covered by Earth Spirit Qi, that even Immortal Heavenly Venerables in control of this Domain, if not meticulous, would fail to find it!"
Xu Yan didn't rush in; instead, he made some noise first because arriving and entering directly would easily alert the Seductive Witch.
He needed to create the impression that after much exploration and the use of numerous Dharmas, he had finally found a way to enter, in order to lull the Seductive Witch into a false sense of security and not reveal his ability to see through illusions.
...
Inside a hidden grotto underground, a blazing aura filled the entire space, with the glow of flames permeating all around, but the center of the grotto was surprisingly cool, completely devoid of the scorching heat.
In the center of a pool of water, there grew a piece of Yu Zhu, about a foot long and as thick as a thumb, with just one leaf at its tip.
The Yu Zhu was crystal clear, seemingly containing mysterious patterns within, as if it held some ultimate truth, with the Dao Principles lingered about it.
Apart from the Yu Zhu in the pool, there were several Seven Wonders Divine Flowers and other unknown treasures.
A ravishingly beautiful woman, unmatched in charm, dressed in a pink gown, each movement she made was fraught with overwhelming Charm Power.
"Xu Yan, little bastard, why haven't you arrived yet?" the Seductive Witch gritted her teeth, growing impatient.
She had put quite a bit of thought into getting her revenge and teaching Xu Yan what happens to those who offend her, the Seductive Witch.
To ensure Xu Yan fell into the trap, she had deliberately arranged some treasures here.
The Seven Wonders Divine Flower and the other treasures might be something else, but the Yu Zhu in the pool was a real Heavenly Material and Earthly Treasure. Not to mention the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, even warriors beyond that realm would covet it upon seeing it.
It was a treasure that could aid in comprehending the Domain Dao Principles.
The mysterious patterns inside the Yu Zhu seemed to endow it with the ultimate truth, akin to the Dao Principles of the Domain.
The hollow within the Yu Zhu appeared to be a minor Domain in itself, and the patterns were the laws that governed this Domain.
It was precisely this uniqueness that made the Yu Zhu extremely precious.
"Seductive Witch, how much do you hate that kid, to even bring out this bamboo!" a voice called out.
A burly man, whose hair and beard seemed to be ablaze like flames, materialized.
"Although this bamboo is precious, it's of little use to you and me; it's simply one of the descendants of a treasured bamboo lineage," the Seductive Witch said unconcerned.
Then, grinding her teeth, she said, "Without sufficiently precious treasures, that bastard might not risk coming in!"
"Alright, just don't go back on what you promised me, Seductive Witch," the man nodded in affirmation.
"Flame Demon, you can rest assured that as long as you help me capture this brat, I will definitely keep my promise to you," the Seductive Witch declared solemnly.
"Hey, to capture this kid, you agreed even to this, showing how much you truly hate him. Rest assured, once I, Flame Demon, make my move, if he enters, there's no way he'll escape."
The Flame Demon chuckled.
He transformed into a blazing flame, then disappeared on the spot, as if he had dispersed into the entire Heavenly Cave.
"Xu Yan, you naive little boy, treasures aren't so easy to get. Once you enter, let's see how you can escape the palm of my hand."
The Seductive Witch clenched her teeth in hatred.
Apart from hating Xu Yan, she hated Li Xuan even more.
After all, Xu Yan was his disciple, taught by that bastard!
"Your disciple has fallen into my hands, let's see what you can do!"
The Seductive Witch's gaze was cold and fierce.
Thud!
All of a sudden, there was a disturbance outside the Heavenly Grotto.
"Seductive Witch, the kid has shown up."
The voice of the Flame Demon came through.
"Finally, he's come."
The Seductive Witch let out a sigh of relief; she'd been worried Xu Yan wouldn't come.
"Duowu, it's time to enter and distract Xu Yan a bit."
The Seductive Witch's figure vanished as she hid.
A moment later, Duowu's figure entered the Heavenly Grotto and lurked not far from the pool.
However, his hiding was intentional, leaving an obvious flaw for Xu Yan to spot as soon as he got close.
"Hey, good boy, being able to resist my Fall Witch's Evil Eye, I absolutely cannot let you grow up."
Duowu sneered to himself.
Inside the Heavenly Grotto, with the Seductive Witch and the Flame Demon lurking, and with him added to the mix, if Xu Yan entered, there was no way he would escape.
In order to deal with Xu Yan, Duowu knew that the Seductive Witch had paid a price to bring a decent artifact with her.
Thud!
Outside the Heavenly Grotto, the disturbance continued; Xu Yan was searching for a way in.
Eventually, after half a day, the noise stopped.
The figure of the Seductive Witch appeared, speaking to Duowu, "The map you gave, didn't it tell him how to get in?"
Duowu's mouth twitched, "I was afraid it was too obvious, so..."
Now the Seductive Witch was getting anxious; what if Xu Yan couldn't find the way in?
Thankfully, an hour later, noises started coming through again; Xu Yan hadn't given up.
"Xu Yan you little rascal, you've got to find the way in."
The Seductive Witch was a bundle of nerves, afraid that Xu Yan might suddenly give up.
To her dismay, the sounds eventually died away again.
"Flame Demon, create a disturbance to guide Xu Yan to the way in."
The Seductive Witch couldn't sit still and spoke up.
"Fine, Duowu, your work is really unreliable!"
The Flame Demon commented helplessly.
Duowu's face flushed with embarrassment, cursing inwardly, Xu Yan looked clever enough, so how could he not find even a single way in?
Poof!
A scorching breath burst forth through the entrance of the Heavenly Grotto as if Xu Yan's continued searching had finally activated the aura of the grotto.
"This is interesting, I thought it was just Duowu, but it seems there's another, in charge of sealing the Heavenly Grotto?
"Using flames to seal the Heavenly Grotto, trying to trap me completely without giving me a chance to flee?"
Xu Yan noticed the disturbance created by the Flame Demon.
"The strength is only so-so, not exceeding the Immortal Realm; they think they can trap me with this?"
Xu Yan pondered for a moment, then in an instant, the distant jungle turned into a myriad of Longswords flying and overlapping each other, transforming into a short sword that landed in his sleeve.
"Just trapping you for a moment will be enough."
Xu Yan had a plan, and an Array Plate appeared in his hand, which, by surprise, would be enough to confuse Duowu for a moment.
And in that moment, it was enough time for him to trick the Seductive Witch and get the artifact.
Pretending again to create a disturbance, he at last found the Dharma to enter, his face revealing a delighted smile, yet he entered the Heavenly Grotto cautiously and carefully.

chapters.title: Chapter 846 - 846: Got it at 442, the infuriated Seductive Witch
chapters.content:
This part of the Heavenly Cave was extremely hot, as if situated in a furnace; however, the heat was just within the endurance limit of a True King Heavenly Venerable martial artist.
Xu Yan was extremely cautious along the way. Upon his arrival at the entrance of the Heavenly Cave, he did not step in immediately but instead raised his hand and shot a sword into the cave as if to probe for danger.
There was no movement within the Heavenly Cave; it seemed as if there really wasn't any danger.
The Seductive Witch had already concealed her form, silently watching Xu Yan's actions, her heart raised in suspense, fearing that Xu Yan would not enter the Heavenly Cave.
"Kid, come on in, once you do, don't even think about getting out!"
The Seductive Witch sneered inwardly.
Finally, Xu Yan set foot into the Heavenly Cave step by step, carefully surveying his surroundings and gradually drew close to the pool.
"Once he discovers Duowu and makes a move to defend himself, and when Duowu unleashes the power of her evil eyes, that will be the moment to capture this kid."
The Seductive Witch believed she had been very cautious; even though Xu Yan had already entered the Heavenly Cave, she did not appear.
According to the established plan, to ensure foolproof success, Xu Yan could be captured.
To capture Xu Yan, she had paid a certain price, temporarily evading the seal of the Taicang Domain, and brought a treasure inside.
The purpose was to prevent Xu Yan's master from giving him some powerful artifact that could sustain him until his master's rescue.
Therefore, it was crucial to ensure that Xu Yan could be firmly controlled before the other party arrived to save the disciple.
If not because her true body could not descend, the Seductive Witch would not have gone to such lengths to have an avatar bring a treasure.
Xu Yan pretended to be very cautious, as if he had neither noticed the presence of the Seductive Witch nor the silhouette of the Flame Demon.
"Seductive Witch, Duowu, and who is that other powerful being? Enveloped in flames, he's incredibly strong, and this power of flame is extraordinary."
Xu Yan was inwardly astonished.
The scorching aura of the Heavenly Cave originated from that fire attribute powerhouse, whose strength was very formidable and unique.
"Responsible for sealing off the Heavenly Cave, huh? What a pity that with your strength, you can't trap me."
Under the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path, neither the Seductive Witch nor the Flame Demon could hide.
"What is this treasure? The Seductive Witch really is kind!"
Finally, when he saw the treasure prepared by the Seductive Witch, Xu Yan was overjoyed.
The Yu Zhu in the pool looked extraordinary.
He showed a delighted expression, but he continued to be careful, moving forward cautiously, while the Mountains and Rivers in the Sword quietly emerged, enveloping the area.
The Duowu, who was not hidden very deeply, should have been detected by now; Duowu was ready to strike as soon as Xu Yan noticed her.
However, it seemed as if Xu Yan's attention was entirely captivated by the Yu Zhu, unaware of her concealment, leaving her momentarily baffled and hesitating whether to make a move.
"This is the moment!"
Xu Yan took a deep breath; the hesitation of the enemy was exactly what he needed.
Whoosh!
In an instant, Xu Yan's figure disappeared from where he stood. A shadow seemed to rush toward the Yu Zhu, but that was just an illusion.
Xu Yan's real body, through a swift movement technique, appeared in an instant at the hiding place of the Seductive Witch.
The Seductive Witch and the other two were deceived by the illusion rushing towards the Yu Zhu for a moment, and in that split second, Xu Yan had already made his move!
"Oh no!"
The Seductive Witch, caught in shock and anger, thought, 'What a sly kid!'
A streak of pink light had barely begun to shine before her treasure was ready for action, and then she saw Xu Yan stab out with a wooden sword in his hand.
Whoosh!
She had no time to react as the wooden sword penetrated into her body.
"Ah!"
The Seductive Witch let out a scream. Just as she prepared to use the treasure, in an instant, it fell, and Xu Yan took the opportunity to catch it.
Boom!
In that instant, an Array Plate was activated, bringing down a Great Formation around Duowu.
Immediately after, a myriad of swords flew out from Xu Yan's sleeves, forming a Sword Array that enveloped the Flame Demon.
With a single contraction of the Mountains and Rivers in the Sword, in a fleeting moment, everything including the pool, the Yu Zhu within it, and the treasures around the pool were all secured by Xu Yan.
From the initial move to emptying the Cave of its treasures, it was all done in a flash, and only now did Duowu barely burst out of the Great Formation.
The Flame Demon transformed into a terrifying giant of flames, burning through the thousands of swords and breaking out.
The Seductive Witch, however, let out a scream of agony as a sword within her, seemed intent on annihilating her.
"Seductive Witch, thanks for the generous gift!"
Xu Yan smiled brilliantly, swinging the Longsword in his hand, unleashing the annihilative Sword Intent, seemingly determined to utterly destroy the Seductive Witch.
"You're going to die by my hands again, avatar!"
The Seductive Witch transformed into a streak of pink light, retreating frantically, "Xu Yan, you should die, and I will kill you!"
When had she ever repeatedly suffered such losses?
And to suffer a significant loss at the hands of a young, seemingly weaker boy; she just couldn't swallow her pride!
"Better make sure you can escape first!"
Xu Yan threatened to finish off the Seductive Witch completely.
"Hmph!"
The Seductive Witch snorted coldly, knowing well that her avatar was no match for Xu Yan and she had to return to summon another avatar.
"Duowu, Flame Demon, keep him busy for me. I'll be right back"!
After speaking, the Seductive Witch transformed into a streak of pink light and vanished instantly from the Heavenly Cave.
Xu Yan revealed a smile; the Seductive Witch had delivered the master's sword back, and his mission was complete!
"Duowu, Flame Demon? Heh, do you two really think you can stop me?"
In a single thought from Xu Yan, all the vegetation and pebbles in the Heavenly Cave transformed into Swords of Slaughter, numbering so many that they could not be counted.

chapters.title: Chapter 847 - 442: Success, the Enraged Seductive Witch_2
chapters.content:
"Slay!"
Xu Yan stood proudly, numerous Swords of Slaughter, each with its own unique Sword Intent, fiercely distinct, like countless raindrops, shooting towards the Flame Demon and Duowu.
At the same time, with a wave of Xu Yan's hand, Mountain and River Myriad Manifestations unfolded, and amidst a thunderous rumble, a vague and majestic figure suddenly appeared within the mountains and rivers.
Immediately thereafter, two powerful figures began battling, the heavens splitting and the earth shattering, striking terror into the hearts of all.
Duowu and the Flame Demon felt chilled to the core, as they were but embodiments of strength, and their power was ultimately limited.
"Are you the disciple of Taicang?"
Suddenly, the Flame Demon asked in a deep voice.
Within the Mountain and River Myriad Manifestations, as the two strong men fought, one figure appeared vague, but after all, it was an old acquaintance, an arch-nemesis, naturally recognizable.
Xu Yan's eyebrows raised slightly, Taicang?
The powerful being who perished together with the Nether Shaman?
"No, Taicang is dead, you cannot possibly be Taicang's disciple, and your Martial Arts are also different from Taicang's!"
The Flame Demon then immediately shook his head as he spoke.
"But regardless of whether you are Taicang's successor, as a prodigy like you, you must die!"
Boom!
As he spoke, the Flame Demon's entire being transformed into flames.
Like a human-shaped bonfire, blazing fiercely, the terrifying power of the flames rampaged in all directions, transforming into a barrage of powerful attacks, closing in on Xu Yan.
"Today, you can't escape!"
The Flam Demon's cold voice sounded.
The flames coiled like a python, like a vast net, completely sealing off Xu Yan's escape in every direction, continuously wrapping around him.
Duowu's hundred eyes opened wide, the Evil Eye Light reflecting, while he brandished a black rod in his hand, a malevolent power permeating the air, striking toward Xu Yan.
"Do you think you can stop me?"
Xu Yan let out a cold laugh. Neither the Flame Demon nor Duowu had strength that surpassed the Immortal Realm, and although he had not yet broken through to the Void-breaking Realm, he was more than capable of handling the two of them.
As for the Charm Slave, having taken away his master's Precious Sword, there was no chance for her to descend again.
"You want to trap me here and wait for the Charm Slave to descend. Sadly, your calculations are doomed to fail. The Charm Slave can't come; my master is giving him a lesson right now," Xu Yan chuckled.
Hu!
Sword light shimmered, mountains and rivers came to life, and a Golden Giant Dragon soared among them, its dragon might rippling through the air as it let out a dragon's roar.
"Flame Demon, your strength is not bad. Once your consciousness is erased, this power of fire will indeed be quite the treasure," Xu Yan looked toward the encroaching net of flames, saying with a light chuckle.
"Heh, you're still incapable of erasing this sliver of my consciousness!" the Flame Demon scoffed with disdain.
Although this avatar of his was not strong, he was after all a Supreme Expert. Even a sliver of his consciousness was not something Xu Yan could erase.
Even with his practice of the Divine Soul Secret Technique, it was impossible. This sliver of his consciousness was far beyond the Divine Soul of an Immortal Realm Warrior.
"Is that so? Let's see about that!" Xu Yan smiled.
A violent wind suddenly arose, blowing wildly towards the net of flames, this wind directly striking the sliver of Flame Demon's consciousness.
To his horror, this gale carried within it the Imperishable Essence.
"This is..."
He could hardly believe it. Could the opponent's killing technique be cultivated from Imperishable Qi?
"That's right, this is Sword Intent cultivated from Imperishable Qi, and this particular Sword Intent is meant to Slaughter the Soul," Xu Yan said with a cheerful laugh.
The Flame Demon's avatar was different from the avatars of Duowu and Charm Slave. Although both of their avatars were embodiments of strength, their power was inherently different, and once the consciousness was obliterated, the power would dissipate.
However, it seemed that the Flame Demon's avatar encapsulated a sliver of his origin power, which meant that even if the consciousness was extinguished, it would still exist, potentially becoming a kind of treasure.
This was related to the Flame Demon's tremendous strength, even to his very essence.
Xu Yan also suspected that in order to seal off the Heavenly Grotto and trap him here, an ordinary strength avatar could not achieve this; thus, a sliver of origin power was used for reinforcement.
Boom!
In an instant, the Imperishable Sword Intent merged with the flames, even touching the Flame Demon's sliver of consciousness.
"Charm Slave, I won't last much longer!"
The Flame Demon's complexion changed drastically, his gaze toward Xu Yan filled with icy murderous intent.
This young man must die; otherwise, he would become a great threat in the future!
In the Taicang Domain, the emergence of such a monstrous talent was absolutely intolerable!
"Duowu, you're useless!"
He then glared at Duowu furiously, as that man had failed to threaten Xu Yan in the slightest.
Duowu was extremely frustrated, for Xu Yan was not afraid of his Evil Eye Light, which greatly reduced his killing power, and his other techniques were even less of a threat to Xu Yan.
"Stop calling, the Seductive Witch won't be able to come!"
Xu Yan's smile shone brightly.
Now, the Seductive Witch is probably enduring agony.
Flame Demon felt a shock in his heart. Could it be that the Seductive Witch was actually taught a lesson?
Who is Xu Yan's master?
In his mind, several figures emerged, but none matched.
Moreover, with the Seductive Witch's strength, she would have been disciplined by any one of those figures.
"Who is your master?"
Flame Demon felt that this strand of his consciousness couldn't hold on much longer.
He had been negligent, not expecting the opponent's attack to contain Imperishable Qi.
"The name of my master carries too great a consequence; you couldn't bear it."
Xu Yan said arrogantly.
"Ridiculous, is there any cause and effect in this world that I, Flame Demon, can't bear? As strong as... "
In the end, Flame Demon closed his mouth.
"What, you suddenly found that there are supreme experts that you can't bear?"
Xu Yan sneered scornfully.
"Heh, it's not that I can't bear it, it's simply better not to mention some people!"
Flame Demon let out a cold laugh.
"Slice!"
All of a sudden, Xu Yan's figure blurred and disappeared from the spot, appearing in front of Duowu the next moment as a black sword light slashed down.
Pfft!
Duowu's gaze was cold and fierce as he swung his black staff, stirring up swathes of gloomy energy as if trying to erode Xu Yan's attack.
However, at the instant Xu Yan's sword came slashing down, he smacked his hand, and with a roar, the Golden Giant Dragon burst forth.
True Dragon Rage!
Pfft!
Duowu was sent flying backward, his hundreds of eyes dimmed, and he exclaimed in horror, "How have you grown so much stronger?"
What kind of monster is this? In the Changyun Realm, Xu Yan's strength was nowhere near as powerful as it is now.
How much time has actually passed?
His strength has nearly doubled!
At this rate, in less than a hundred years, the other's strength will match his original self!
This child must die!
Flame Demon was also startled. Was this kid hiding his incompetence all along?
"Years have passed, shouldn't getting stronger be the natural course of things?"
Xu Yan swung his sword to slice, one sword after another, moving between spaces, completely ignoring Flame Demon's fiery attacks.
"Kid, this sliver of my consciousness is doomed to disappear, and since that's the case, I won't let you off easily. Let's see how you..."
Flame Demon's gaze turned frosty, preparing to self-destruct this clone and turn it into a powerful attack. Even if he couldn't kill Xu Yan, he would surely deal him a severe blow.
Just then, a voice filled with rage, almost to the point of madness, roared, "Xu Yan, you and your master should die! Just you wait!"
"Ahhh, damn it, daring to plot against me, you all wait, I will dismember you and your master a thousand times.
"No, I will turn you and your master into my Charm Slaves and torture you day and night to relieve the hatred in my heart!"
The roaring voice contained not a hint of seductiveness, nor a trace of gentleness, only anger, madness, and hatred.
The Heavenly Grotto was shaking; the Domain Dao Rule forces at this moment were all stirred up, turned into thunder flashing against the Domain Barrier, as if ready to obliterate anyone daring to step inside with the power of the Domain!
Flame Demon and Duowu were dumbfounded.
That was the voice of the Seductive Witch. What had she encountered?
The two of them were very familiar with the Seductive Witch and had never seen her so enraged, so out of control. Even when she was once furiously cursed for being shameless, she had never been so angry.
Now, she seemed to have lost her reason, furiously roaring, wishing she could kill her way into the world.
Flame Demon, who was ready to self-destruct his clone, couldn't help but pause, looking up at the world beyond, where a faint pink light lingered.
"A good opportunity!"
Xu Yan, not distracted by the Seductive Witch's breakdown, seized the moment of Flame Demon's distraction and instantly appeared before him, thrusting the Precious Sword into the core of his fiery consciousness.
Pfft!
In the midst of slaughter, he instantly shattered that strand of Flame Demon's consciousness.
"How could you... "
Flame Demon was astonished, wondering how Xu Yan had pinpointed the exact location of his conscious core.
Before he could finish speaking, his consciousness had already dissipated.

chapters.title: Chapter 848 - 443 Xu Yan Breakthrough, Innate Taoist Body
chapters.content:
The Flame Demon's consciousness was annihilated and transformed into a huge net of flames that had been sealing off all directions; at this moment, it spontaneously converged into a single bright red flame, emanating an intense heat.
Xu Yan reached out his hand, and with a single gesture, he drew the flame into his mouth and then gently tapped with his finger, laying down one prohibition after another, sealing the flame.
Although he was not a Qimen Martial Artist, Xu Yan was familiar with these prohibitions and knew how to seal treasures.
After all, the art of sealing was not too profound; it was not too difficult to learn, so whether it was Xu Yan, Meng Chong, or Su Lingxiu, they had all learned the art of sealing.
Once the prohibitions were applied, the flame became gentle and no longer emitted the intense heat, looking just like a bright red flower.
Seeing this scene, Duowu's expression changed again and again. This flame, after all, contained a strand of the Flame Demon's origin fire. What method exactly had Xu Yan used to subdue the flame?
He had thought that even if the Flame Demon's consciousness dissipated, Xu Yan would still need to go through a lot of trouble to subdue this strand of fire. He didn't expect that he would so easily subdue the Flame Demon's origin fire.
The Seductive Witch was in trouble and couldn't spare any effort; the Flame Demon had been defeated; only the injured Duowu was left, no longer a match for Xu Yan on his own.
"Xu Yan, I hope you truly rise because if not, one day you will surely die!"
Duowu said coldly.
With a bang, he destroyed this embodiment of himself.
Thus, the avatars of the three great powerhouses had all arrived and were defeated. The Seductive Witch seemed to have been plotted against and suffered a great loss.
But, whether it was Duowu or the Flame Demon, they both took note of Xu Yan. If the opportunity arose, they would surely kill Xu Yan!
"Sooner or later I will meet your true selves."
Xu Yan dismissed Duowu's threat indifferently.
"Void-breaking, Domain, Establishing Dao, once I break through to the Establishing Dao Realm, I should be able to handle them, right?"
Xu Yan muttered to himself.
"It's about time to break through."
Now that the treasure was in hand, it was time to start preparing for the breakthrough into the Void-breaking Realm.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, wait for me. Once I break through the Void-breaking Realm, we'll play at leisure."
Xu Yan smiled coldly.
Once stepping into Void-breaking, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable would pose no threat to him, even if he faced a siege.
The Power of Void-breaking easily broke through the Immortal Heavenly Venerable's Domain Power.
This breakthrough would be no small leap.
Xu Yan emerged from the Heavenly Grotto, looking out over the vast and deep Guang You Realm, deciding to find a place to retreat and prepare for breaking into the Void-breaking Realm.
It was also time to sort through this time's gains.
Especially that piece of Yu Zhu — it looked extraordinary, and perhaps it could assist his comprehension of the Establishing Dao Realm.
Xu Yan immediately left in search of a suitable place for seclusion.
...
In the Qinghua state, Li Xuan hadn't gone to seek Tian Zi for a while, wanting to gain more secrets of the Domain from Tian Zi, but there was no rush.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has cleverly used your sword to successfully plot against a Supreme Expert, and as a result, you have gained the "Thousand Mechanisms Bait.""
The feedback from the Daoist Golden Book came suddenly.
Li Xuan was overjoyed.
He had managed to ambush the Seductive Witch.
"Thousand Mechanisms Bait, huh, that could come in handy."
The Thousand Mechanisms Bait was a special Divine Skill that allowed for controlling a force that had invaded an enemy's body from an endless distance, and even control the strand of force to grow and hide away.
If the enemy's strength was not much greater, they would not be able to remove the power of the Thousand Mechanisms Bait.
If one were to fight an enemy, and both parties were of comparable strength, as long as the enemy was wounded by oneself, the Thousand Mechanisms Bait could be used to continuously invade the enemy, ensuring their injuries could never fully heal.
Of course, it was also possible to quietly plot against an enemy. Once an enemy was ambushed, even with just a minor injury, one could employ the Thousand Mechanisms Bait to continuously damage the enemy's body and deepen their wounds.
Anyone caught by the Thousand Mechanisms Bait, without the strength to suppress and remove its power instantly by an absolute margin, would be like a maggot to the bone, never able to get rid of it.
"Good, good, let's try out this Thousand Mechanisms Bait."
Li Xuan smiled.
With a slight concentration of his mind, he immediately sensed the power of his wooden sword.
"Ss, the Seductive Witch is so powerful!"
In that instant, Li Xuan marveled.
The strength of the Seductive Witch was greater than his current level.
"Although stronger than I am now, my sword isn't so easy to get rid of, and now with the Thousand Mechanisms Bait, the Seductive Witch will never be able to purge this sword."
Li Xuanle chuckled.
With a thought, he flicked his fingers slightly a few times, and a mysterious aura emerged, seemingly reaching some place across an infinite distance.
Clang!
A sword cry resounded within the Seductive Witch's body, that sword instantly moved around within her, and it began to refine and absorb foreign powers, bolstering the strength of this sword.
Boom!
"The strength of the Seductive Witch isn't bad at all!"
Li Xuan felt the immense power suppressing his sword and once again marveled.
"However, you're completely unfamiliar with my Sword Dao, and completely unfamiliar. It's a pipe dream to think you can remove it."
Li Xuan's fingers danced, intuitively sensing that as the sword faced the Seductive Witch's power, it suddenly dispersed, as if formless and traceless, avoiding the Witch's power and reconvening into a sword in some part of her body again.
"Even though I've finished reading the Book of Taicang, I won't be bored from now on."
Li Xuan was spirited, battling remotely with the powerful Seductive Witch was really interesting.
Moreover, the battlefield for this struggle was inside the body of the Seductive Witch, which made it even more intriguing.
"Hmm, the fluctuations in the Seductive Witch's aura are intense — is she so angry she's going crazy?"

chapters.title: Chapter 849 - 443 Xu Yan Breakthrough, Innate Taoist Body_2
chapters.content:
Li Xuan raised his eyebrows.
The Seductive Witch's strength was indeed formidable. Had it not been for the Qianji Yin that could control that sword, with her power and means, the Seductive Witch could have removed that sword given some time.
Of course, this would not be a short period of time.
Although the power of that one sword was not enough to pose a lethal threat to her, the constant disturbance inside her body meant the Seductive Witch had to allocate a thread of her consciousness to control the sword, preventing it from growing stronger.
This meant that her strength would be discounted, and she would be at a disadvantage when facing former enemies.
"This Qianji Yin technique is really quite interesting."
Li Xuan found it quite enjoyable.
He controlled that sword, playing a game of hide and seek within the Seductive Witch's body.
"The Seductive Witch's strength is roughly at the Establishing Dao Realm level."
Li Xuan had made a judgement about the Seductive Witch's power; it was about the level of the Establishing Dao Realm, but not his own Establishing Dao Realm, rather that of the Great Wilderness Warriors.
After all, Li Xuan's strength was a hundredfold that of Xu Yan at the same realm; upon entering the Establishing Dao Realm, he could crush the Seductive Witch.
"The Establishing Dao Realm is much stronger than the Domain Realm."
Li Xuan reflected internally.
The further one went, the greater the difference in strength at each realm became.
"The Seductive Witch, indeed, belongs outside of this Domain, not within this Taicang Domain."
Li Xuan used the Qianji Yin to sense the sword and confirmed that the Seductive Witch was not inside the Taicang Domain but outside it, although the distance to the Taicang Domain was closing.
"Furious to the point of madness? But it's no use, you can't enter the Taicang Domain, and even if you could, you wouldn't be able to find me, I'm not afraid at all."
Li Xuan remained composed, continuing to tantalize the Seductive Witch with the Qianji Yin.
"Huh, who is the Seductive Witch fighting with?"
Suddenly, Li Xuan sensed that the fluctuations within the Seductive Witch's aura were fierce and uncontrollable, as if she were engaged in a battle.
However, the battle quieted down soon after, and the Seductive Witch was moving away from the Taicang Domain.
"Interesting!"
Li Xuan looked up at the firmament, realizing that there were beings within the Taicang Domain not inferior to the Seductive Witch; presumably, they had thwarted her attempt to enter the Domain.
"This sword should be hidden away for now; there's no need to tease the Seductive Witch continuously, just occasionally pop up to provoke her."
Li Xuan murmured to himself.
Thump!
Suddenly, a roar echoed between heaven and earth.
"It's becoming more chaotic."
Li Xuan sighed, sensing that the Divine Realm was truly entering an era of great disorder. Certain powerhouses, unwilling to accept their current standing and tacitly allowing the actions of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, sought perhaps to claim the title of first under heaven?
Or maybe they aimed to seize the exalted position of Master of Domain?
"To sit and watch the rise and fall of tumult."
Li Xuan shook his head and sighed.
"Xu Yan is about to make his breakthrough, right?"
Successfully tricking the Seductive Witch meant that Xu Yan had acquired the treasure and it was time for his breakthrough to the Void-breaking Realm.
"Your disciple Su Lingxiu has gained enlightenment of the Alchemical Medical Martial Arts Domain Martial Arts Law, and your Alchemical Medical Martial Arts has broken through to the Domain."
Feedback emerged from the Daoist Golden Book.
The Alchemical Medical Martial Arts had also broken through to the Domain.
"My strength has grown stronger."
Li Xuan was overjoyed; happy as he was, his fingers danced, casting the Qianji Yin, again stirring the sword within the body of the Seductive Witch.
Time hurried by, and three years passed in the blink of an eye.
For the strong, three years were like a snap of the fingers.
The Qinghua Sect was experiencing constant change and growth. In just these few short years, numerous Immortal Heavenly Venerables had emerged. Apart from a smaller number of top-tier Immortal Heavenly Venerables, the Qinghua Sect could be ranked among the top ten in the Divine Realm solely based on the quantity of Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
Of course, it still wasn't quite there regarding overall strength.
The Qinghua Great Formation had increasingly improved, and once it was perfected, the number of top-tier Immortal Heavenly Venerable Martial Artists would begin to rise.
Emperor Da Yue and the other two even had a chance to break beyond the Immortal Realm.
The Da Yue Abyss had nearly been transformed into a Domain Divine Furnace, with the daily Pill refinement numbers being enormous.
Moreover, the methods for cultivating Spiritual Medicine and Divine Medicine were becoming more perfected, so much so that with the enhancement of Formations, they had artificially grown a field of lower-grade Divine Medicine.
All the Martial Artists below the True King Heavenly Venerable in the entire Qinghua Sect had seen an explosive increase. With the aid of Pills, the speed of cultivation for Martial Artists was getting faster, bottlenecks easier to break through, and the time spent at each realm substantially shortened.
Of course, to prevent reliance solely on Pills for advancement, which could lead to inadequate strength, the Sect's Elder Hall distributed Pill guidelines.
Martial Artists had to undergo trials and consolidate themselves for a certain period after making a breakthrough, and the Sect regularly checked whether their Martial Arts foundations were solid and whether their strength was substantial.
If the foundation was found to be weak or the strength was insubstantial, they would have their cultivation resources reduced, even their Sect status lowered.
These series of rules issued by the Sect prevented the problem of Martial Artists having insubstantial strength.
The number of martial artists below the rank of True King Heavenly Venerable in the Qinghua Sect is exploding, and with the Heavenly Grotto being relatively peaceful, there lacks a place for their tempering.
To address this, Spirit Cities everywhere started organizing fighting platforms, enhancing the martial artists' tempering, as well as actively provoking Netherworld, initiating battles.
"Shi'er has broken through too."
Li Xuan sighed, knowing that Shi'er was not too far from the Divine Skill Realm.
Of course, that barrier is ultimately difficult to overcome, and it's not something that can be broken through in a short period of time.
Meng Shushu and Zhou Ying, on the other hand, had broken through earlier.
The two were consolidating themselves, preparing for the breakthrough into the Divine Skill Realm.
Cai Ling'er had already become a True King Heavenly Venerable. After the activation of her bloodline and receiving the Sea Spirit Emperor's inheritance, her cultivation speed soared rapidly.
Moon Changming is preparing to break through to the realm of True King Heavenly Venerable, and Yue'er is also starting to prepare for her breakthrough.
It's worth mentioning that Yue'er, serving as an assistant to Su Lingxiu, has a profound understanding of the Divine Soul. Her Divine Spirit Soul Force is much stronger than Moon Changming's.
In terms of strength, Yue'er is even slightly more powerful than Moon Changming.
Of course, when it comes to combat experience, she is not as seasoned as Moon Changming; in a real life-and-death struggle, Yue'er is likely to be defeated.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has broken through the Void-breaking Realm, and your Domain Realm breakthrough has made minor progress."
The Daoist Golden Book opens, and a surge of golden light emerges.
After three years of consolidation, Xu Yan finally broke through the Void-breaking Realm.
Once entering the Void-breaking, one can traverse the Divine Realm at will.
Of course, with the chaos in the Divine Realm nowadays, there may be powers above the Immortal Realm lurking. Even so, with the power of the Void-breaking Realm, Xu Yan no longer has anything to fear.
"Finally, a breakthrough!"
Li Xuan was overjoyed, as the Domain Realm had seen minor progress.
"Your disciple Xu Yan, having fully sublimated, has transformed into a Mountain and River Dao Body, and you've obtained an Innate Taoist Body."
Boom!
At that moment, Li Xuan felt a complete transformation within himself; the natural essence of the Dao permeated his muscles and bones, coiling within him like the principles of Dao themselves.
Within his body, it was as if the Dao principles had emerged spontaneously. Though he was not in the Establishing Dao Realm, he had begun to grasp the underlying meaning of establishing Dao.
"Strength has improved again!"
Li Xuan was ecstatic about his Innate Taoist Body.
"With my current strength, I won't be much weaker than the Seductive Witch!"
Li Xuan was thrilled.
With the Innate Taoist Body and minor progress in the Domain Realm, his strength was nearly on par with the Seductive Witch.
"This transformation of Xu Yan means he cannot maximize his potential during a breakthrough into the Domain Realm."
Li Xuan lamented.
Whether the Mountain and River Dao Body can transform again isn't something that can be achieved by the accumulation prior to the breakthrough.
"However, given Xu Yan's monstrous talent, he still has a chance."
Li Xuan was full of confidence.
The Mountain and River Dao Body was already very strong, sufficient to put Xu Yan's strength far beyond that of ordinary martial artists.
"I wonder how my Innate Taoist Body will enhance when Meng Chong and Su Lingxiu undergo their transformations and breakthroughs."
Li Xuan was filled with anticipation.
With Xu Yan's breakthrough into the Void-breaking Realm, the resulting enhancements kept coming, including improvements in Divine Skills, Sword Intent, and the Mountain and River Myriad Manifestations, and so on.
All of these contributed to his strength leaping forward continuously.
"Finally, it's time to wreak havoc."
Li Xuan was filled with anticipation.
Following Xu Yan's breakthrough, he would certainly seek revenge on Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow. It would be effortless for him to slay Immortal Heavenly Venerables, and his fame would surely spread throughout the Divine Realm.
"Meng Chong is also close to breaking through, within these two or three years."
Li Xuan looked towards the location of the Da Yue Abyss, where Su Lingxiu's preparations were almost complete, and she was close to her breakthrough as well.
The disciples had all begun their significant power enhancements.
"This Domain has also started showing some changes."
Li Xuan looked towards the firmament. With his understanding of the Taicang Domain, he could easily perceive the subtle changes in the world.
First on the level of luck, then on the level of Dao principles, and also in the changes to the Domain's very origin.
"It's also time to find an opportunity to have Tian Zi reveal his secrets. Time waits for no one, and it's time to make some careful plans for this Domain."
Li Xuan pondered.
But before that, it was essential to understand exactly what Tian Zi was.
Suddenly, Li Xuan looked towards a certain part of the Divine Realm, a life-saving Jade Charm he had given out was being triggered.

chapters.title: Chapter 850 - 444 Taimiao God Sect, Earthly Yuntian Heavenly Grotto
chapters.content:
```
The Life-saving Jade Charm, aside from my disciples, only a scarce few possess.
And these few, they are all closely related, with some deep connections.
Since I gave out the Life-saving Jade Charms until now, no one has fallen into crisis and activated the charm, this is the first time.
"It's not Xu Yan, nor is it Meng Chong, and likewise not Jiang Buping."
Li Xuan was a bit surprised; his three disciples were all adventuring in the Divine Realm, each facing powerful forces, and were more likely to encounter crises.
Unexpectedly, the first to trigger the Life-saving Jade Charm wasn't a disciple.
It was Du Yuying!
"This is the intended disciple-in-law, what kind of crisis has she encountered? She's a disciple of the Taimiao God Sect, and the Taimiao God Sect is located in the Taimiao Realm, monopolizing a domain, one of the Great Realms in the Divine Realm."
Li Xuan was somewhat astonished.
Looking up in the direction where the Life-saving Jade Charm was activated, with the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, he felt the power belonging to him that had been roused from the charm.
With a slight gesture of his hand, he manipulated the Domain Dao Rule for a split second, and the power of the Domain Dao Rule descended instantly, augmenting the charm's power, elevating it to the level of the Domain Realm in the blink of an eye.
With his understanding of the Taicang Domain and his mastery over the Domain Dao Rule, even across great distances, he could easily mobilize the power of the Domain Dao Rule for augmentation.
After all, it was his Jade Talisman, imbued with his power, and located within the Divine Realm, and with his current strength, manipulating the Domain Dao Rule to augment it was a piece of cake.
"Even if besieged by a group of Immortal Heavenly Venerables, they could be easily annihilated."
Li Xuan smiled faintly.
The power of the Jade Talisman started to recede, returning into Du Yuying's body, the crisis evidently resolved.
...
In a certain part of the Divine Realm, an unkempt old man was lying on a large rock.
All of a sudden, he leaped to his feet.
Looking up towards the firmament, his brow furrowed tightly in a mix of shock and uncertainty.
"Who is manipulating the Domain Power? Who possesses such ability?"
At this moment, he was somewhat surprised.
"Who has secretly come to the Divine Realm?"
His brow furrowed deeply, familiar figures flashed through his mind, but not a single one related to the recent mobilization of Domain Power.
"Something's not right. Mobilizing Domain Power so covertly, unless it were I, others would likely be unable to detect it, and there are only a handful of people capable of this feat, but they..."
The old man frowned in deep thought.
"Could it be, someone survived?"
He was very puzzled, but the ones who could do this and render him unable to trace the origin of the Domain Power, apart from a scarce few, were none other.
And those few had already disappeared for a very long time.
"Could it be him?"
Suddenly, as if thinking of someone, he then shook his head: "Impossible, if it were him, he would never be so low-key, and furthermore, he can't come out."
The perplexed old man's expression grew more solemn; an unknown existence was hidden between heaven and earth, whether it was good or bad remained uncertain.
"Heavenly Slaughter and Earth Shadow, those two bastards, are quite good at stirring trouble. Let's see what they can churn up, just don't let it backfire on them."
Suddenly recalling something, he sneered.
Lying back down on the rock, "Forget it, if the sky were to fall, then let it fall. Better not to worry."
He exhaled, continuing to snore heavily in sleep.
Divine Realm, Taimiao Realm.
"Great-granny, are you alright?"
Du Yuying helped up Xin Mengrou, who was pale and grievously injured.
"Cough, I'm fine."
Xin Mengrou took a deep breath, looking towards the vanished enemy, her heart once again filled with shock.
"Great-granny, what do we do now?"
Du Yuying asked with some concern.
Indeed, in a critical moment, she had triggered the Life-saving Jade Charm given to her by an elder, effortlessly killing the enemy, but the aftermath would no doubt be troublesome.
Among the enemies, there was an elder from the Taimiao God Sect.
"Return to the sect. If anyone asks, say you were saved by a mysterious elder. Do not mention the charm."
Xin Mengrou inhaled deeply and said.
The scene just now was too shocking.
That figure, like a Supreme Sovereign of heaven and earth, wielded domain authority with a wave of the hand, with Immortal Heavenly Venerables being as ants, wiped out with a sweep, turned to ash, leaving no trace.
Even the top Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
"Great-granny, I understand."
Du Yuying nodded.
Yet in her eyes remained a tinge of worry; the internal strife within the Taimiao Sect was coming to the surface.
And great-granny, she cultivated the Taimiao Illusionary Path and had, from this Dao, developed her own understanding and insights.
All thanks to the guidance of the elder before.
As a result, when this matter was leaked, another faction within the Taimiao Sect aimed to suppress the Taimiao Illusionary Path, hence the recent attack.
If not for this time, she wished to descend the mountain to inquire about Xu Yan's news, and by coming out with great-granny, she might well have prevented an assassination.
"Hmph, a bunch of despicable old men, fearing that I might become the master of the Taimiao Illusionary Path, just you all wait!"
Xin Mengrou sneered.
This escape from death also signified her rise.
Now, she was about to make dreams into reality, and once she broke through, within her rank, she would have an overwhelming advantage.
Besides her, Yun Miaomiao also cultivated the Taimiao Illusionary Path, albeit a different kind. If she succeeds, her strength would be extremely powerful as well.
"Great-granny, should we find an opportunity to pay our respects to the elder?"
Du Yuying asked with some anticipation.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 851 - 444 Taimiao God Sect, Earthly Yuntian Grotto_2
chapters.content:
Xin Mengrou looked at her, her face helpless as she said, "Xu Yan, that kid, is not by the elder's side right now, you won't see anyone if you go."
Du Yuying's face turned red, "Great-Grandmother what are you saying, my point is, if you seek the elder for guidance, you can surely make a breakthrough much faster."
"Enough, I know the little thoughts you and Miaomiao have. The two of you, with such weak strength, if you don't diligently cultivate, you'll only hold Xu Yan back."
"However, no matter how you cultivate, you're destined to hold Xu Yan back, that kid is simply terrifying," Xin Mengrou sighed.
Xu Yan had already made a name for himself in the Divine Realm, single-handedly slaying many Immortal Heavenly Venerables and taking on the powerful force of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
There was also Meng Chong, equally audacious, pursued by the Wanbao Alliance with a bounty on his head, yet still at large, even occasionally raiding Wanbao Alliance branches.
True to being disciples of the elder, they were unbelievably strong.
"There's likely to be a big upheaval in the Divine Realm, better improve your strength as quickly as possible," Xin Mengrou said.
Xin Mengrou and Du Yuying, concealing their auras, hurried back to the Taimiao God Sect.
Half an hour after the two of them left, a figure appeared.
The person wore a green long dress, her figure as ethereal as a dream, checking her surroundings, her expression grew solemn.
"Not a single survivor!"
Three Immortal Heavenly Venerables, one of whom was a top-tier Immortal Heavenly Venerable, had all failed.
And more, they were killed within a short period.
"Who is secretly protecting Xin Mengrou? Someone above the Immortal Realm? Could it be, Xin Mengrou's Illusionary Path has drawn attention?" the woman in green mused to herself, full of doubts.
With a swift movement, she disappeared from her original spot.
Within a secret area of the Taimiao God Sect.
"They failed?"
The person seated with her back to the woman in green seemed almost unreal, like a mere shadow, but this shadow gave off a feeling of reality.
"Yes, they're all dead," the woman in green nodded and confirmed.
"The news of Xin Mengrou's assassination attempt will soon spread, and one of them was even an elder of the sect."
"Take this opportunity to clean up the Earth Shadow within the sect; they've really stretched their hands too far."
"Now that Xin Mengrou has escaped this disaster, her rise is inevitable. Hand over the person behind the scenes, and tell those elders of the Taimiao Sect."
"Both major Cultivation Techniques of Taimiao come from the same origin; whoever attacks each other from now on bears the consequences."
The woman in green nodded, "Yes, I understand."
Then, puzzled, she asked, "If you knew someone was out to kill Xin Mengrou, why not take action to save her?"
"Every top Taimiao expert has their own fate and fortune. If not enough to overcome such a tribulation, then naturally they cannot become a top expert. It's a test."
"Whether the ones who saved Xin Mengrou had been watching over her for a long time, or are some other persons, it all implies she has adequate fate and fortune to become a top expert."
The woman in green didn't fully understand why such a test was necessary, for if she died, wouldn't the sect lose a prodigy?
However, she didn't continue to question and respectfully took her leave.
As the woman in green departed, the shadow-like figure trembled slightly, murmuring to itself.
"Who could it be? Just with an object of trust, they possess such terrifying strength; what kind of method could this be?"
She thought of that figure.
Seeming like a Supreme Sovereign of heaven and earth, even with her profound Cultivation Technique and well-concealed presence, she had been detected by that figure.
Should she hold any malicious intent, she would be blasted away with a single palm strike!
"What kind of background could Xin Mengrou's junior have, to be protected by such a terrifying existence?"
That day, the Taimiao Realm was rocked by turmoil, a great war to eliminate internal traitors broke out.
As one of the powerful forces in the Divine Realm, the strength of the Taimiao Realm was undoubtedly immense; as the strong made their moves, in just a short time, Immortal Heavenly Venerables fell, slain on the spot.
Moreover, during this disturbance, the Taimiao God Sect drew upon a Supreme Treasure to direct smite a top-tier Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
They also spread the news; the Taimiao God Sect was purging the moles of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow!
Even the Taimiao God Sect, deeply infiltrated by Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow to such an extent, made other Great Realm powers dare not be careless.
Suddenly, the Divine Realm became more turbulent, and chaos in the Great Realms began to unfold, growing more and more disordered.
And Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, too, was instigating conflict and igniting wars everywhere.
Di Yun Realm.
Due to the persistent mists and clouds that shrouded the ground, hence its name.
In a certain part of the Di Yun Realm, enveloped by dense clouds and fog, a huge Heavenly Grotto appeared, now visible then invisible within the clouds.
Four men wearing Heavenly Slaughter Masks sat at the four corners of the grotto, as powerful forces continuously surged into a pillar before them.
The pillar, wrapped in Dao rhymes, was thrust into the edge of the Heavenly Grotto, and as the power of the four masked men flowed into it, it emanated ripples after ripples, slowly prying open the mouth of the grotto.
A silhouette arrived abruptly.
"How long will it take to complete?"
Tian Shiqi asked in a deep voice.
"You don't need to worry about things here; when the time is right, we will naturally inform you!"
One of the men replied gravely.
Boom!
Suddenly, there was a tremor below the Heavenly Grotto, and a pink figure appeared, now hidden, now visible.
Tian Shiqi's expression subtly changed.
"What's going on?"
One of them replied helplessly, "It's the incarnation of the Seductive Witch; she insists on entering the Divine Realm from here, saying she needs to find someone named Xu Yan to avenge her grudge!"
Tian Shiqi was surprised. How had Xu Yan provoked the Seductive Witch?
"You four good-for-nothings, after so much time how have you only slightly enlarged the Heavenly Grotto?"
The angry voice of the Seductive Witch came through.
"Seductive Witch senior, we have done our best. Please be patient. If you come in now, it will only spoil everything."
"Hmph, then bring Xu Yan here, or I might not be able to wait any longer."
"How could Xu Yan possibly come here? Besides, this place mustn't be revealed."
The four men wearing Heavenly Slaughter Masks were frowning and speaking with concern.
A thought struck Tian Shiqi, and he spoke in a deep voice, "Seductive Witch senior, Xu Yan cannot come here, but we could lure him to another Heavenly Grotto!"
The Seductive Witch said coldly, "An ordinary grotto can barely accommodate beings of the Immortal Realm. How could such limited power pose any threat to Xu Yan?"
Tian Shiqi pondered for a while, then spoke, "I heard senior Seductive Witch has a secret technique to cultivate a treasure that can cause living beings to lose their way. I have a plan and to ensure its infallibility, I would like to request one of these treasures from senior.
"In exchange, I know of a Heavenly Grotto that can accommodate beings of the Heavenly Union Realm, above the Immortal Realm. I'll find a way to lure Xu Yan there, how about it?"
The Seductive Witch was tempted, "Really?"
"Of course, I wouldn't dare deceive senior. But to lure Xu Yan, we'll need some things..."
Tian Shiqi hinted.
"Don't bother yourself with that; you just need to get Xu Yan there, and as for the treasure you want, I can give it to you. Come back here in three days.
"Also, if you dare deceive me, I'll take it up directly with that bastard Heavenly Slaughter!"
After the Seductive Witch finished speaking, the pink figure left.
Tian Shiqi clicked his tongue. From what he knew of Seductive Witch, this powerful witch had always been smiling and seductive, with a sweet, alluring voice.
Now, speaking like this and calling herself "old mother," it was clear that Xu Yan had irked her significantly.
"Just what did Xu Yan do to make the Seductive Witch lose her composure like this?"
Tian Shiqi was utterly amazed in his heart.
But fortunately, it was exactly because of this that he could obtain that kind of treasure from the Seductive Witch, ensuring that the next phase of the plan would be foolproof.
"Seventeen, who is Xu Yan?"
One of the men wearing a Heavenly Slaughter Mask asked in surprise.
"A freak, with powerful figures backing him up," Tian Shiqi replied, unwilling to say more, and turned to leave.
Meanwhile, the Heavenly Grotto in the Di Yun Realm was still slowly expanding, its aura suppressed within, not leaking out.
"Xu Yan, I must capture you!"
The Seductive Witch was filled with resentment. The sword inside her, although seemingly fragile, was exceptionally tricky and seemed to possess a mind of its own, as if controlled by someone else.
Despite her exhaustive efforts, she could neither eradicate it nor expel it from her body.
Although the sword was currently not a great threat to her, having a sword inside her body wouldn't let anyone rest easy; it had to be removed to find peace.
Especially in battle against an enemy, should the sword start moving unpredictably, it would inevitably affect her strength, and thus might put her in dangerous situations.
There was no other choice but to capture Xu Yan and have his master remove the sword in exchange.

chapters.title: Chapter 852 - 445 Just Talking About the Way, and Suddenly Become the Taoist Ancestor
chapters.content:
Xu Yan naturally did not know that the Seductive Witch was plotting how to capture him.
After breaking through to the Void-breaking Realm and transforming into the Mountain and River Dao Body, his strength had surged greatly, filling Xu Yan with confidence.
"With my current strength, Destiny of the Heavenly Intent is enough to control an ordinary Immortal Heavenly Venerable. It's time to prepare for exploring the lair of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow."
Xu Yan's eyes were cold and sharp.
He took out a Communication Talisman and contacted Luo Zhan to inquire whether there were any traces of the Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter.
"This Jade Bamboo from the Seductive Witch is indeed a treasure. It seems to contain some Principle, giving me some enlightenment."
Looking at the Jade Bamboo in his hand, Xu Yan was extremely excited.
The Jade Bamboo contained a certain Dao rhythm, and those mysterious patterns were like some Principle, which made Xu Yan think of the Dao Principles that govern the Domain.
"It could help me realize the Establishing Dao Realm sooner."
The Establishing Dao Realm was profoundly complex. After all, one had to establish one's own Dao in this Domain. After his breakthrough, and having transformed into the Mountain and River Dao Body, Xu Yan had some insights regarding the Establishing Dao Realm.
There was a vague concept in his heart, as if he was about to understand how to establish his own Dao and the Way of the Domain.
Now that he was not far from the enlightenment of the Establishing Dao Realm, and with this piece of Jade Bamboo, Xu Yan believed he could significantly shorten the time needed for his understanding.
"Let's set out from here and continue to traverse the Divine Realm, all the way to the Taikun Realm, to meet with my Fifth Junior Brother."
Xu Yan looked forward, took a step, and with a thunderous noise, the space of Heaven and Earth shattered around him. He crossed the void directly, spanning tens of thousands of miles in an instant.
"So this is breaking through the void of Heaven and Earth!"
Xu Yan was thrilled.
"However, I am still a bit weak. The noise when crossing the void of Heaven and Earth is a bit too loud. Once I can break through the void silently, the Void-breaking Realm will reach its completion."
Traversing by shattering the void of Heaven and Earth is a capability of the Void-breaking Realm, using the Heaven and Earth Laws as a spear and the Power of Void-breaking to pierce through the Domain's void.
It is also because of this ability of the Void-breaking Realm that, in a certain sense, it has the potential to counter the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, wielding the Domain Power.
"From today onwards, the Divine Realm is mine to traverse, and the Immortal Heavenly Venerable can be vanquished with a mere wave of my hand!"
Xu Yan was brimming with confidence.
"The next goal is the Domain Realm, striving to perfect the Void-breaking within ten years and break through to the Domain Realm as soon as possible."
Xu Yan set the next goal for himself.
"I am drawing closer to transcending the Domain, and I am also not far from my initial hundred-year goal."
"Taking another step closer to matching or surpassing that towering figure."
Xu Yan did not forget the small goal he had set at the beginning, to transcend the Domain within a hundred years, as well as the aim he had set years ago, to match or surpass that lofty figure.
That towering figure, whose strength is far from an ordinary transcendent of Domain, especially since in the great battle, both the Nether Shaman and the ancient mountains who perished, had already transcended the Domain.
"Martial Arts have no end, I will step by step chase after my master's footsteps!"
Xu Yan's blood boiled with fighting spirit.
"The name of the Sword God should also resound through the Divine Realm!"
"Starting with slaying an Immortal Heavenly Venerable from the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow."
Xu Yan embarked on the journey to kill a Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter.
...
As Xu Yan made his breakthrough, Li Xuan was also exceedingly excited. His great cause of Martial Arts was about to advance further.
With his mood lifted, his fingers involuntarily began to move, performing the Thousand Mechanism Guide, manipulating the sword within the Seductive Witch's body.
"Hisss, the Seductive Witch's aura is fluctuating wildly. Is she going to go mad from rage?"
Li Xuan couldn't help but be astonished.
"Getting angry is useless. You can't enter the Domain, find me, or remove the sword."
Li Xuan's smile was radiant.
After tormenting the Seductive Witch for a while, Li Xuan then imparted guidance on Martial Arts to Shi'er and the others.
"Su Lingxiu and Fang Hao are also about to break through."
Li Xuan's face was filled with anticipation.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has slain an Immortal Realm Warrior with a single sword strike, and your experience in Martial Arts has been enhanced."
Feedback from the Daoist Golden Book arrived.
"Immortal Heavenly Venerables are no longer regarded with importance, huh? Killing an Immortal Heavenly Venerable only contributes to Martial Arts experience."
Li Xuan shook his head helplessly.
As Xu Yan's strength increased, slaying True King Heavenly Venerables yielded no feedback anymore.
Killing an Immortal Heavenly Venerable only resulted in feedback of Martial Arts experience.
"Xu Yan is going to wreak havoc on all sides."
From the moment Xu Yan broke through the Void-breaking Realm, his name was destined to shake the Divine Realm.
"Meng Chong is also about to break through. Let's see how the Wanbao Alliance copes after his breakthrough."
The Wanbao Alliance's relentless hunt pressured Meng Chong greatly, as the slightest reveal of his whereabouts would soon attract Immortal Heavenly Venerables to pursue him.
He even encountered ambushes by Immortal Heavenly Venerables several times, barely escaping their pursuit.
As of now, Meng Chong did not dare to approach the Heavenly Grotto, for fear of being trapped there.
Despite Meng Chong's skillful ability to change appearance and conceal his aura, the moment he performed Martial Arts, he would inevitably leave traces, exposing himself.
His practice of Physical Body Martial Arts set him apart from the warriors of the Divine Realm significantly, and despite his deliberate imitation of other Martial Arts, he could still be recognized.
And clearly, the Wanbao Alliance was also becoming desperate. They were searching for Meng Chong's method of flight and intending to trap him in a location, to join forces and suppress him.
"Once Meng Chong breaks through, he's going to make a huge impact."
Li Xuan sighed.
Aside from Meng Chong, Jiang Buping was much more low-key, avoiding the pursuit of the Taikun Realm as much as possible, and when he did reveal himself, he easily found a place to hide.
Jiang Buping was well aware of the strength of the Taikun Realm, and before making a breakthrough, he remained extremely cautious, fearing being cornered.

chapters.title: Chapter 853 - 445 Just Talking About the Way, and Suddenly Become the Taoist Ancestor_2
chapters.content:
```
"This Book of Taicang, could indeed be considered the first supreme treasure of the Taicang Domain."
Li Xuan looked at the Book of Taicang in his hand. Whoever mastered the Book of Taicang, whoever comprehended it, would become the Master of the Taicang Domain.
Without a doubt, it was the first supreme treasure of the Taicang Domain.
"I have my own martial arts. This Book of Taicang can only serve as a reference. Now that I have mastered and comprehended the origin of the Taicang Domain, I should make use of it."
With this thought, Li Xuan had some plans in mind.
