The Qinghua Sect was established by Fang Hao. Since that was the case, it would be appropriate to provide guidance to Emperor Da Yue and others.
With his understanding of the origin of the Taicang Domain and his insights into martial arts, guiding Emperor Da Yue and the rest was more than sufficient.
Cai Ling'er was now his maid, cultivating the heritage of the Sea Spirit Tribe, which also belonged to Taicang. Li Xuan took some time to provide focused guidance, especially on the principles of Heaven and Earth Laws and the Way of Domain.
With his guidance, Cai Ling'er's breakthrough to the Immortal Realm would have no bottlenecks, and as long as her cultivation was sufficient, it would naturally lead to a smooth breakthrough.
Next were Moon Changming and Yue'er.
With his guidance, the martial path ahead for the grandfather and granddaughter duo would be smooth, and at least breaking through above the Immortal Realm would be no problem.
As for higher realms, that would depend on the talent and perception of each of them.
One day, a message reached the ears of the elders of Qinghua Sect.
The mysterious and unfathomable senior, the master of Sect Master Fang Hao, would preach in three days.
Although not quite understanding what preaching entailed, since it was from a senior, it surely meant a great opportunity.
Thus, all the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Qinghua Sect hurriedly returned, fearing they would miss the sermon.
A group of Immortal Heavenly Venerables stood respectfully on the square, waiting for the senior to preach, with everyone fully focused and not daring to be the least bit distracted.
"It's time to show off again."
Looking at the group of respectful and solemn Immortal Heavenly Venerables, he couldn't help but nod.
"Qinghua Sect has gained so many Immortal Realm warriors."
Li Xuan sighed, the aid of pills was indeed powerful.
There were many warriors in the Qinghua state stuck below the Immortal Realm; after all, they were accumulated over many long years. Although they had not made the breakthrough, their constant refinement of their martial arts had made their foundations extremely solid.
Moreover, those who had cultivated to this step, which one of them had not once been a champion of their region?
Alas, the Immortal Realm was still like an insurmountable gap, always difficult to cross. The emergence of the pills was like adding a chain bridge over the chasm, allowing some to cross it.
It was for this reason that the number of Immortal Heavenly Venerables had surged in a short amount of time.
Sitting in his chair, Li Xuan held the Jade Ruyi, and the Great Wilderness Physiognomy manifested, resembling the scenes from the primordial times at the beginning of the desolate era.
Li Xuan's figure was no longer visible; all that could be seen was that primordial, indescribable physiognomy.
The air of mystery only made the scene more unfathomable, as if even the Domain itself shrunk in insignificance.
"We meet the senior!"
A group of Immortal Heavenly Venerables were greatly shocked, bowing reverently and devoutly to the ground.
"I see that many of you have wasted time in your martial arts and are confused about the path ahead. Today, I shall speak to you about the Way of Domain.
"How much you can comprehend and understand depends on each of your own fortunes and perceptions."
The voice entered their ears, seemingly coming from the vast expanse of ancient space-time, or perhaps the voice of the Domain, even seeming to contain the sound of the ultimate Dao.
The group of Immortal Heavenly Venerables bowed even lower, their reverence and solemnity deepening.
"Many thanks, senior!"
Li Xuan slowly spoke, directly converting the Domain Dao Rule into sound, spreading it downwards, and began his first sermon.
To the group of Immortal Heavenly Venerables listening, it felt profound and inscrutable, as if it were the voice of the Domain, incomprehensible, yet imparting a sense of sudden clarity.
Certain doubts about martial arts were instantaneously enlightened.
Some cultivation techniques that were unsuccessful or not yet comprehended were also understood in this moment.
Even the Divine Skills that had been painstakingly cultivated without any progress suddenly gained enlightenment, as if the direction for cultivation had been located.
Time passed, the sermon had already ended, and Li Xuan returned to his own courtyard, leisurely sipping tea and tasting the spirit cakes made by Cai Ling'er.
The group of Immortal Heavenly Venerables was still bowing to the ground, immersed in the profoundness of the sermon, not yet recovering.
At a certain moment, someone's aura fluctuated, and they made a breakthrough!
After a short while, three powerful auras emerged in succession.
It was Emperor Da Yue and his two companions.
At that moment, Emperor Da Yue and the other two opened their eyes, excitement visible on their faces, for they had finally made a breakthrough!
Their Immortal Realms were now perfected!
The three had been stuck at the late peak stage of the Immortal Realm for quite some time, never able to reach perfection.
```
Today, during a preaching session, I suddenly gained enlightenment and broke through the bottleneck—achieving perfection in the Immortal Realm!
I've genuinely advanced to the pinnacle of the Martial Path in the Divine Realm.
Of course, once the Great Formation of the Qinghua Sect is complete, perfection in the Immortal Realm may not necessarily represent the peak. Instead, further breakthroughs can be pursued.
The many Immortal Heavenly Venerables all made gains, and as for how much each gained, that is something only they themselves would know.
For them, this was a great opportunity!
"So this is what preaching the Dao is like!"
Emperor Da Yue and the other two exchanged glances, reaching an unspoken understanding.
The concept of preaching they heard for the first time brought them immense benefits. Such is the work of a true master.
And this master happens to be the venerable teacher of Fang Hao, the founding Sect Master of the Qinghua Sect—the first person to preach the Dao could rightly be referred to as a Taoist Ancestor, couldn't he?
The Qinghua Taoist Ancestor!
"We give thanks to the Taoist Ancestor for his preaching!"
In an instant, Emperor Da Yue and the others kowtowed and shouted loudly.
Following that, the rest of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables also kowtowed and shouted in high spirits.
Their voices were resounding and spread far and wide.
Li Xuan was startled. He had just whimsically decided to preach about the Way of Domain. How did he suddenly come to be revered as a Taoist Ancestor?
He knew that in the Taicang Domain, there was no such concept as a Taoist Ancestor.
Even before him, there was no notion of preaching the Dao.
Suddenly, the Daoist Golden Book opened, and golden light poured forth.
Li Xuan was overjoyed. Could it be that this preaching also triggered a response?
"For enlightening Sect Warriors with your preaching and being honored as a Taoist Ancestor, you have obtained the Taoist Ancestor Halo."
The Taoist Ancestor Halo!
Li Xuan was thrilled. What an unexpected reward.
An aura mysterious and profound appeared behind his head, enveloping him in a haze of brilliant light, as if it were reflecting the great Dao, as if the great Dao were enshrouded within it.
"Wonderful, truly wonderful!"
Li Xuan was extremely excited.
With this Taoist Ancestor Halo, deceiving and intimidating others had become as easy as flipping a hand.
Even those stronger than him would kneel in awe upon seeing him.
Moreover, the use of the Taoist Ancestor Halo was not limited to just showing off.
"The Qinghua Sect was founded by Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu and belongs to my disciples. Naturally, I've also become an old ancestor of the sect. Therefore, this preaching session that enhanced the strength of the sect's elders naturally brought me feedback as well."
Li Xuan understood in his heart.
Who could have thought that a whimsical preaching session could yield such enormous rewards?
The Taoist Ancestor Halo was retracted, and the Daoist Golden Book actually provided feedback again.
"For being honored as the Qinghua Taoist Ancestor, you have obtained the Qinghua Meditation Mat."
Looking at the meditation mat, Li Xuan couldn't help but marvel—it was yet another tool for displaying his prestige.
The Qinghua Meditation Mat, woven and intertwined with Dao Principles, was permeated with the charm of the Dao. Moreover, sitting on this meditation mat to preach would allow listeners to focus better and enhance their comprehension.
"From now on, I am not only the Great Wilderness Taoist Ancestor but also the Qinghua Taoist Ancestor..."
Li Xuan was brimming with excitement.
"I must break through to the Establishing Dao Realm as soon as possible. That is the true beginning for a Taoist Ancestor, for without entering Establishing Dao, how can one command over the Dao?"
Li Xuan mumbled to himself.
After all, according to his own standards, only after Establishing Dao does one qualify to establish a legacy of the Dao.
Without such a legacy, the title of Taoist Ancestor feels rather empty.
"The Establishing Dao Realm is just the beginning. I aim to become a true Taoist Ancestor!"
Li Xuan suddenly became filled with passionate determination.
"I cannot slack off. Starting now, I must devote my whole being to the grand enterprise of Martial Arts. It's time to create the realms beyond the Establishing Dao Realm."
"I am the Ancestor of Martial Arts, a being who stands shoulder to shoulder with the great Dao, a true Taoist Ancestor!"
Li Xuan looked towards the Daoist Golden Book, ready to ponder its profound uses, to contribute bricks and mortar to his great enterprise of Martial Arts.
To struggle towards becoming the undeniable Ancestor of Martial Arts!
After Emperor Da Yue and the other Immortal Heavenly Venerables finished their three prostrations and nine kowtows, they respectfully left, each of them visibly invigorated, feeling that their Martial Path ahead was vast and wide.

chapters.title: Chapter 854 - 446 Consecutive Breakthroughs, Red Cat's Ambition
chapters.content:
After Li Xuan lectured on the Dao, the strength of Qinghua Sect began to increase substantially, with many Immortal Heavenly Venerables obtaining significant gains.
Some profound Cultivation Techniques were fully comprehended and successfully cultivated.
The number of Immortal Heavenly Venerables who had cultivated Divine Skills also increased considerably, signifying a massive enhancement in the upper echelon strength of Qinghua Sect in a short period.
Feng Yan worked even more diligently, praising his own wise decision. It was precisely because of his wise decision back then that he could seize this opportunity.
Indeed, only by following a great person can one find the greatest opportunities.
Look at those fools in the Nine Mountain Realm, constantly fighting without progression, unaware of the great opportunity next to them.
Pah, they deserve it!
A bunch of simple-minded wastes!
Feng Yan looked towards the direction of the Nine Mountain Realm and despised them vehemently.
"I, Feng Yan, elder of Qinghua Sect, the most capable assistant to Sect Master Fang Hao and Pavilion Master Su Lingxiu, work efficiently and am deeply trusted!"
Feng Yan walked with an air of pride.
"Feng Yan, go fetch me tens of thousands of Jin of Red Blood Gold."
Su Lingxiu's voice came through.
"Alright, I'm on it right away!"
Feng Yan instantly scampered off, as if afraid someone else might snatch the task from him.
On a whim, Li Xuan lectured on the Dao and, after receiving the title of Qinghua Taoist Ancestor and the Taoist Ancestor Halo, he immersed himself completely in the grand undertaking of Martial Arts.
Even the frequency of using Qian Ji Yin to toy with the Seductive Witch greatly diminished.
Most of his time was spent on drafting Martial Arts Techniques, working with the Daoist Golden Book to establish Martial Arts beyond the Establishing Dao Realm, thus perfecting the entire Martial Arts system.
Time flew by swiftly, and for Li Xuan, who was immersed in the great undertaking of Martial Arts, five years passed in the blink of an eye.
As his realm ascended and his power grew, the concept of time grew increasingly dull for him.
The deeper into the Martial Arts Realm one goes, the more profound it becomes, requiring more theories and Cultivation Techniques to craft. Thankfully, with the Daoist Golden Book at hand, otherwise, it would be difficult to create consistent and self-contained Martial Arts Techniques from scratch.
The direction of Martial Arts post-Establishing Dao Realm was roughly confirmed. Nevertheless, it was not an easy task to develop subsequent Martial Arts Realms and Techniques.
After all, the later stages touched upon more esoteric issues and had to maintain inherent strength. Therefore, Li Xuan had to repeatedly ponder, add and delete until satisfied.
"For my grand undertaking in Martial Arts, for the honor of being a Taoist Ancestor, it's all worth it."
Li Xuan thought to himself.
It was just a matter of drafting, and it wasn't as though he had to endure the hardship of cultivation, so it wasn't really laborious.
"Your disciple Meng Chong has broken through the second layer of the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body; your Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body has reached minor completion in the third layer."
The feedback from the Daoist Golden Book emerged.
Meng Chong had broken through, stepping into the Void-breaking Realm.
"Finally, he has made a breakthrough."
Li Xuan nodded.
"Your disciple Meng Chong has reached the peak of refinement and transformed into a Vajra Dao Body; you have obtained the Innate Indestructible Dao Body."
The feedback of Meng Chong's transformation into the Dao Body upgraded the Innate Dao Body to the Innate Indestructible Dao Body.
"What kind of Dao Body will I gain after Su Lingxiu, that girl, transforms? I already have the Innate Indestructible Dao Body now."
Li Xuan was curious about what kind of Dao Body he would receive after Su Lingxiu's breakthrough and what feedback the Daoist Golden Book would provide.
He looked towards the Da Yue Abyss, now called the Da Yue Divine Furnace, which Su Lingxiu had completely transformed into a Domain Divine Furnace.
Any creatures from the Netherworld who stepped into it would be refined into pure blood essence, and it was also drawing breaths from outside the heavens to melt and refine.
At this moment, Su Lingxiu was preparing for her breakthrough inside the Da Yue Divine Furnace.
"Meng Chong has made a breakthrough; it's going to be lively again."
Li Xuan was full of anticipation.
After Xu Yan broke through, he began a great slaughter in all directions, with the number of fallen Immortal Heavenly Venerables at his hand exceeding that of his two hands.
His fame spread throughout the Divine Realm, and even Immortal Heavenly Venerables shuddered at the name Sword God Xu Yan.
Having been hunted by the Wanbao Alliance and encountering dangers numerous times, Meng Chong was not going to let go easily after this breakthrough. He would inevitably make the Wanbao Alliance turn pale with fear and bow its head in submission.
"Jiang Buping is also nearing his breakthrough."
Once Jiang Buping breaks through, there will be another Killing God in the Divine Realm.
"Continue my grand undertaking in Martial Arts."
Li Xuan resumed his immersion in the grand undertaking of Martial Arts.
A year later, Su Lingxiu made her breakthrough into the Void-breaking Realm.
"Your disciple Su Lingxiu has broken through the Void-breaking Realm, with her Alchemical Medical Martial Arts reaching minor completion in the Domain Realm."
Li Xuan began to look forward, wondering what kind of boost he would get when Su Lingxiu transformed into the Dao Body.
"Your disciple Su Lingxiu has reached the peak of refinement and transformed into the Evergreen Dao Body; you have obtained the Innate Great Dao Body."
At that moment, Li Xuan felt himself grow even stronger, and due to the Innate Great Dao Body, it seemed as if the breath of the Great Dao was born within him.
Although he had not reached the Establishing Dao Realm, it was as if the foundation of the Dao had already been established in his own Domain.
"Another upgrade to the Dao Body."
Li Xuan was inwardly ecstatic.
"With my current strength, I should be no weaker than the Seductive Witch, perhaps even stronger."
Li Xuan's confidence soared.
With the Innate Great Dao Body and his Domain Realm at minor completion, along with many powerful Martial Arts Divine Skills, suppressing the Seductive Witch would pose no problem.
"Even if the Seductive Witch were to enter this Domain now, I could slap her flying out of it."
Li Xuan was invigorated.
"Indeed, the greatest joy comes from the enhancement of strength."
As Su Lingxiu broke through, another year passed, and Xu Yan achieved minor completion in the Void-breaking Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 855 - 446 Consecutive Breakthroughs, Red Cat's Ambition_2
chapters.content:
And on this day, with a thunderous boom, a burst of azure light surged through Qinghua state, illuminating the entire firmament. In an instant, the whole Qinghua state seemed to have entered a wondrous space.
The Qinghua Great Formation was completed on this day.
The entire Qinghua state was within the formation, appearing as if it had formed an independent space.
"Spiritual energy has amplified by more than double, and it's still increasing,"
"Our Qinghua Sect will surely become the number one sect in the Divine Realm,"
"The spiritual energy is still increasing. I feel my bottleneck loosening. I'm going to enter seclusion for a breakthrough,"
"Have you felt the Domain Lingji becoming more active?"
"Yes, I have the same feeling. The upper limit of the Immortal Realm seems to be breaking!"
"That's wonderful. Finally, in the Divine Realm, we can break through the upper limit of the Immortal Realm,"
Inside Qinghua Sect, a group of Martial Artists was brimming with excitement, chattering amongst themselves.
And the Immortal Heavenly Venerables were overjoyed, as the upper limit of Domain Lingji broke and became more lively.
Moreover, it was slowly and continuously improving, which meant that the Immortal Realm was no longer the limit in the Divine Realm.
No, to put it accurately, the Immortal Realm was no longer the limit within Qinghua Sect!
"Fang Hao is about to make a breakthrough,"
Li Xuan looked up to see at the heart of the Qinghua Great Formation, where Fang Hao was surrounded by a mist of light.
Domain Qimen patterns were emerging, and the entire flow of the Domain was converging upon him, pouring into his body.
This breakthrough would also be a significant transformation for Fang Hao.
The Qimen Martial Art would reach even higher levels.
As Fang Hao made his breakthrough, Li Xuan's Qimen Martial Art also advanced, reaching the Domain Realm level.
With this, all five Martial Arts had ascended to the Domain Realm.
Not long after Fang Hao's breakthrough, Jiang Buping also made his.
Roar!
On this day, the Domain roared once again, resounding for a long time. However, due to the Qinghua Sect's Great Formation, only the Immortal Heavenly Venerables felt it, not the other Martial Artists.
"Sect Master, the Divine Realm—and perhaps the whole Domain—may soon undergo significant changes. We at Qinghua Sect must also prepare our response,"
Emperor Da Yue spoke in a grave tone.
Fang Hao nodded, saying, "Continue to strengthen the Qinghua Great Formation. Now that I've broken through, I will personally oversee the crucial points. With this formation, we can handle any upheaval."
After his breakthrough, Fang Hao was full of confidence.
Now, he was undisputedly the strongest in Qinghua Sect. Although his senior martial sister was also powerful, Fang Hao was confident that she, who was not skilled in combat, would likely be no match for him.
And as for Emperor Da Yue and the other two, they were no longer his equals.
Following this, the Qinghua Sect began another round of preparations, especially concerning the Heavenly Grotto.
Su Lingxiu also took action, turning each Heavenly Grotto into a Domain Divine Furnace and dispatching Sect Alchemists to preside over the furnaces for alchemy.
Thus, Qinghua Sect was not short on pills, and their strength began to enter a phase of rapid advancement, particularly as the prodigies from each region received focused cultivation.
Time flew, and two years had passed.
This day, unexpectedly, Red Cat ran back.
"Meow meow!"
Red Cat rubbed against Li Xuan's legs.
"What, have you made progress with your strength and are ready to establish the Demon Clan?"
Li Xuan tapped its head with the Jade Ruyi in his hand.
"Meow!"
Red Cat nodded.
Upon breaking into the Void-breaking Realm, Red Cat had grown more confident in its strength. Currently, it was even stronger than the Wind Spirit Tiger and naturally wouldn't continue playing the loyal subordinate.
Moreover, Little Ha and Yu Xiaolong were also close to breaking through.
The foundation of the Demon Clan was imminent; however, the task promised to Tian Shiqi was drawing near, and the Wind Spirit Tiger was about to leave.
No matter what, Red Cat genuinely reciprocated the kindness shown by the Wind Spirit Tiger, which also trusted it completely. Therefore, Red Cat's return was to ensure the Wind Spirit Tiger's safety.
The Wind Spirit Tiger might be naïve and overly confident, but Red Cat knew well enough that there might be a threat to its life upon its departure.
"You big cat, you do have some loyalty,"
Li Xuan smiled.
With a flick of his hand, he gave Red Cat a Jade Talisman, "All right, off you go to do your thing."
Overjoyed, Red Cat put on another show of its adorable behavior before running off to find Su Lingxiu.
"Ah, Red Cat, you've returned!"
Su Lingxiu was delighted.
"Meow meow."
Looking at Red Cat acting cute, Li Xuan's mouth twitched. Why had he captured such a tiger in the beginning?
It didn't look like a tiger at all.
"The Wind Spirit Tiger, one of the twelve Spirit Beast monarchs. This Red Cat is quite ambitious. Does it intend to gather the twelve under its command and unite the Spirit Beasts of the Divine Realm?"
Li Xuan laughed. It was good for Red Cat to have great ambition, as the stronger the Demon Clan became, the stronger his own Demon Ancestor true form would grow.
"This Red Cat has cultivated its Great Demon Ability quite well. I'll give it some pointers later."
As Red Cat's strength increased, its Great Demon Martial Arts would naturally become more perfected, and Red Cat would gain a deeper understanding of it.
"It's time to thoroughly perfect the Path of the Great Demon."
Li Xuan pondered.
Since Red Cat wished to establish a Demon Clan and become the Great Demon King, it needed some means of dominion, so it was time to perfect it.
"Demon Clan bloodline intimidation, irreversible insubordination, or something like the Demon King's seal, could all be perfected. Any Spirit Beast that has cultivated Great Demon Martial Arts would be intimidated by Red Cat, the Demon King..."
Li Xuan had an idea in mind and began perfecting it by opening the Daoist Golden Book.
With Red Cat's recent return, it had brought back a large cache of Divine Medicine among various other treasures. Su Lingxiu refined pills for it, creating formulations that were better suited to the Demon Clan.
Fang Hao was helpless and could only find time to craft some Divine Artifacts for Red Cat, all catered to the Demon Clan.
"Red Cat, are you arming the Demon Clan now?"
Fang Hao said with a wry smile.
Thumping its chest proudly, Red Cat was prepared to seize the opportunity to unite the Nine Mountain Realm.
Once Red Cat obtained what it needed and prepared to return to the Nine Mountain Realm, it came to say goodbye to Li Xuan, its master.
"Since you are intent on establishing a Demon Clan and the Path of the Great Demon, ponder deeply upon it. This will assist you in ruling over the Demon Clan."
Li Xuan raised his hand and imparted the more perfected Great Demon Martial Arts into Red Cat's Divine Soul.
"Meow meow!"
Red Cat was beside itself with excitement.
Back in the Nine Mountain Realm, Red Cat had returned.
"Big brother, Tian Shiqi is about to come for you. This journey is bound to be dangerous. I've fortuitously obtained a Supreme Treasure, which will surely save your life in a crisis."
Red Cat stuffed the Jade Talisman into Wind Spirit Tiger's possession.
"Younger brother!"
Wind Spirit Tiger was deeply touched. "Don't worry, with my strength, how could Tian Shiqi ambush me? Younger brother, take this Supreme Treasure back."
Red Cat inwardly scorned Wind Spirit Tiger's naivety— only someone as simple as you would count money for your scammer.
As for Tian Shiqi, that guy's strength was definitely superior to Wind Spirit Tiger's, especially since Red Cat had sensed it after his breakthrough into the Void-breaking Realm.
And it was much stronger. Even after its own breakthrough, Red Cat was no match for Tian Shiqi.
"Big brother, I am very safe here and won't face any issues. On the contrary, there are unknown dangers on your trip. I'll only be at ease if you take this Supreme Treasure with you."
In just a few words, Red Cat convinced Wind Spirit Tiger.
Afterward, Red Cat gave Wind Spirit Tiger some more advice, telling him to be smart, especially when it came to seizing the chance to extract treasures from Tian Shiqi.
Red Cat was certain that Wind Spirit Tiger's mission was extremely crucial, and Tian Shiqi would tolerate the extortion en route.
"By saving Wind Spirit Tiger once, when I return, I won't have to be the big brother anymore. I'll reserve an elder position for you in the Demon Clan, honoring our friendship," Red Cat muttered to itself.
"Younger brother, I understand. I'll take as many opportunities as possible to extract treasures from Tian Shiqi before reaching our destination. If he won't give them to me, I simply won't leave. I got it!"
Wind Spirit Tiger patted its chest, indicating it understood.
Six months later, Tian Shiqi arrived.
"Congratulations to King Red Cat!"
Tian Shiqi looked at the Splendid Ferocious Tiger with slight surprise. Why did this tiger feel somewhat different after its breakthrough?
But he didn't dwell on it, since it was not uncommon for Spirit Beasts to have unusual auras due to their bloodlines and even more so when awakening bloodline inheritances.
"Wind Spirit King, let's go. The mission depends on you."
"Sure thing, sure thing!"
Wind Spirit Tiger stood up, then added, "We don't know when we will return from this journey. My younger brother, having just broken through, needs to hold the fort at Spiritual Sovereign Mountain and won't have the leisure to look for treasure resources. What do you think, Tian Shiqi?"
Tian Shiqi's mouth twitched. Even Red Cat was taken aback—had Wind Spirit Tiger finally become astute?
"A trifle, nothing more."
Tian Shiqi certainly wasn't going to complicate matters at this juncture over mere treasures.
Casually, he handed over a Storage Bag of treasures to Red Cat.
Wind Spirit Tiger nodded in satisfaction. Indeed, the younger brother was right. Throughout the journey, it had to keep extracting a good deal from Tian Shiqi.
After Tian Shiqi and Wind Spirit Tiger left, Red Cat began convening the Spirit Beasts to establish the Demon Clan!

chapters.title: Chapter 856 - 447 The Might of the Heavenly God, Da Yan Dynasty
chapters.content:
At the summit of a mountain in the Zhongming Realm, Xu Yan stood proudly.
A figure descended from the sky and landed on the summit, offering a respectful salute, his face adorned with a Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter Mask.
"Where is the headquarters of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow in the Zhongming Realm?"
Xu Yan asked coldly.
"The Zhongming Realm has three branches, I can only learn the location of one of them, the other two are unknowable."
This member of the Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter presented a map.
Xu Yan took the map, glanced at it, and couldn't help but sink into contemplation.
With the pieces he currently controlled, infiltrating the ranks of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, he still had not been able to locate the whereabouts of their headquarters.
Not to mention, he had yet to learn the true mission of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
Each member of Heavenly Slaughter had their own appointed tasks, and it was impossible to have knowledge of tasks that were not their own.
If they looked into information beyond their assigned missions, it would raise the alertness of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow. There had been a pawn who, for this reason, was executed.
In the contest with Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow up to now, the other party had also learned that there were traitors within their ranks, and had strengthened their mechanisms against leaks.
"Tian Shiqi."
Xu Yan murmured to himself.
So far, the strongest known member of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, even the one who deployed their missions, was Tian Shiqi.
According to the information from Red Cat, Tian Shiqi's power was beyond the Immortal Realm, which meant that Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow had an expert hidden beyond the Immortal Realm.
"For the Turbulent Divine Realm, for the Unity of Domain."
Xu Yan mused thoughtfully.
All that Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow planned was for the Unity of Domain, and behind this, there must be a Supreme Expert supporting them.
"Continue to infiltrate, wait for further orders."
After Xu Yan gave his command, the Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter disappeared instantly.
"It's time to go visit the Great Realms, like Taimiao Realm, Taikun Realm, or Taihe Realm!"
Only by visiting these Great Realms could he learn more of the Divine Realm's secrets.
Among them, the Taihe Realm was the first and strongest realm of the Divine Realm, involving the pathway to breaking through the limits of the Immortal Realm.
"The second junior brother has gone to the Da Yan Realm, there might well be a great battle with the Wanbao Alliance. Will the Alliance have experts beyond the Immortal Realm?"
Xu Yan pondered for a while, there had never been experts beyond the Immortal Realm in the Divine Realm, but now with the Divine Realm in turmoil and people plotting for the Unity of Domain, it was not impossible for such experts to appear in the Divine Realm.
"Should I go to the Azure Sea Sphere first, or to the Taimiao Realm? Forget it, let's go to the Azure Sea Sphere. I wonder how Brother Xie is doing."
In the end, Xu Yan decided to visit the Azure Sea Sphere first.
He stepped forward, his figure entering the void of Domain, and in the next moment, when he emerged from the void, he was already tens of thousands of miles away.
...
In the wilderness, Meng Chong sat cross-legged, waiting quietly.
"The Wanbao Alliance really has some nerve, sending over a dozen Immortal Heavenly Venerables to kill me, today I'll be waiting for them to come."
This time, he intended to engage in a massacre.
Having been hunted for so long, he was already seething with anger, and now that his strength had broken through, it was time to reveal his divine might and let the Wanbao Alliance understand the power of Heavenly God Meng Chong.
If the Wanbao Alliance would not yield or admit their mistakes, convinced that they could bully others with their power, then he would simply overpower them until they submitted.
This wilderness would be the burial ground for his pursuers!
Let these Immortal Heavenly Venerables witness the violence of Physical Body Martial Arts!
Whoosh whoosh!
More than a dozen figures approached from all directions, quickly surrounding Meng Chong.
"Meng Chong, today will be your end!"
The leading person said with a cold gaze.
Finally, they had trapped Meng Chong in this wilderness, completely surrounding him, this time Meng Chong had no chance of escape.
It was somewhat odd that Meng Chong did not flee, as if he was specifically waiting for their arrival, but they did not give it much thought; after all, even if Meng Chong had broken through to the Immortal Realm, he would not be able to withstand their group of more than a dozen people.
"My end?"
Meng Chong grinned and stood up, looking coldly at the dozen or so Immortal Heavenly Venerables, "Today, is the day of your demise. Since you, Wanbao Alliance, insist on bullying with your power and refuse to admit your mistakes, I will fight until you acknowledge them!"
"Arrogant!"
The leading Wanbao Alliance expert sneered.
Boom!
Their aura erupted, the combined might of more than a dozen Immortal Heavenly Venerables intertwining, shaking the Domain. They held firm control over this region of space.
This part of the Domain seemed to have a solidifying force, sealing off the space, giving ordinary Immortal Heavenly Venerables a sense of being stuck in a quagmire when faced with this formidable force of Domain control.
"Arrogant? You've yet to see the true extent of arrogance. Today, you shall witness the might of a Heavenly God!"
Meng Chong sneered.
Boom!
Golden light burst forth as immeasurable divine waves emerged, an image of the sun appeared behind his head, and stars manifested around his body. In an instant, Meng Chong transformed into a giant resembling a small mountain.
The group of Immortal Heavenly Venerables from the Wanbao Alliance were instantly shaken at heart, the scene was too impactful.
"What kind of Martial Arts has this fellow cultivated?"
They all had this thought in their minds.
At that moment, they finally understood why Meng Chong was known as "Heavenly God."
The scene before them was truly like the descent of a Heavenly God!
"Take my punch!"
Meng Chong snorted coldly, his giant fist like a massive sun, suddenly blasted towards the leading Wanbao Alliance expert.
Boom!
As Meng Chong's punch was thrown, the Domain they controlled was instantly shattered, the Domain trembled, and the Heaven and Earth Laws manifested.
An enormous fist, in the blink of an eye, passed through the void of Domain and appeared in front of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable.

chapters.title: Chapter 857 - 447 The Might of the Heavenly God, Da Yan Dynasty_2
chapters.content:
"Not good!"
At that moment, as Meng Chong made his move, the expressions of the Wanbao Alliance elites dramatically changed.
They finally understood why Meng Chong hadn't fled.
He was deliberately waiting for their arrival.
"Attack together!"
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable went mad as he tried to counterattack, but the power of that punch made him feel an intense crisis, and he madly retreated backward.
"Think you can escape?"
Meng Chong scoffed contemptuously. A meridian in his body shone with the light of the stars. In an instant, the group of Immortal Heavenly Venerables felt as if they were trapped in a quagmire. Whether it was their speed or strength, everything slowed down.
The faces of the Wanbao Alliance powerhouses filled with horror, their hearts sinking.
At this critical moment of life and death, they let out furious roars, their aura surging, unleashing powerful secret techniques.
To be able to cultivate to the level of Immortal Heavenly Venerable, one is naturally extraordinary, and when the moment for decisiveness arrived, they were utterly unambiguous.
"Trifling tricks."
Meng Chong sneered coldly.
Boom!
His already enormous body grew even taller in the next moment, like a Heavenly God descending to earth, awe-inspiring, with a Sun hanging behind his head and stars densely scattered around him. Holding wind and thunder in his palms, his every move caused heaven and earth to shatter!
Bang!
An Immortal Heavenly Venerable, despite exhausting his full strength, couldn't resist and exploded into a burst of blood, like a blood-red firework, scattering into ash after detonating in mid-air.
The many furious attacks that poured onto Meng Chong's huge body couldn't move him an inch, nor could they breach his defenses.
Not even a tremble shook Meng Chong's body because of this.
Seeing this scene, the Wanbao Alliance powerhouses were filled with despair.
What kind of formidable enemy was this, and what terrifying cultivation technique was he practicing?
Some even regretted in their hearts for pursuing Meng Chong, for not letting go of him to death, for the so-called dignity and face of the Wanbao Alliance, they relentlessly hunted him down.
Above the desolate wilderness, a shocking battle erupted.
A giant akin to a Heavenly God made the group of Immortal Heavenly Venerables spill blood, exploding one after another.
Some thought of escaping, but they were restrained by a sinister force, as if mired in a swamp, moving sluggishly, utterly unable to flee.
"Die!"
Meng Chong crossed his arms, directly hugging an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, and with a mighty effort, instantly turned him to ash!
This violent scene astounded the remaining Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
Some begged for mercy!
"Cowards, spines made of jelly, die!"
With a punch from Meng Chong, the person begging for mercy was instantly annihilated.
"Aargh!"
One of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables let out a fear-stricken roar, and then his body collapsed, his Divine Soul springing forth and instantly fleeing away.
He actually abandoned his physical body to escape.
Once his Divine Soul fled, he discovered to his surprise that the swamp-like force had disappeared, meaning that the bizarre power seemed to target only the physical body!
"Do you think you can escape?"
Meng Chong let out a cold laugh. His eyes blazed like the sun as he stared fiercely at the escaping Divine Soul.
Whoosh!
Before the shocked eyes of the remaining Immortal Heavenly Venerables, that Divine Soul was instantly obliterated into nothingness!
A killing technique for the Divine Soul?!
Moreover, this technique was so powerful that it annulled the Divine Soul into nothingness!
By now, the remaining ones knew there was no chance of escape left.
"Meng Chong, I'm going all out against you!"
Everyone roared, expending all their cultivated powers, unleashing mutually destructive Dharmas, and launching their strongest attacks ever.
Boom!
Under such violent assault, Meng Chong's figure shook a few times, stepping back half a step!
But that was all!
Bang!
With Meng Chong's punch, like the blazing sun smashing down, all remaining Immortal Heavenly Venerables were reduced to ash and disappeared!
"Thrilling!"
Meng Chong was extremely excited. This was the kind of ferocious battle that Physical Body Martial Arts was meant to have.
"Let's see if you Wanbao Alliance will still come after me, I'll kill every one of you that does!"
Meng Chong gave a cold smile.
He contained his aura, looked up at the depths of the wilderness, and strode forward, crossing the wilds to head toward the next domain.
"Heading there is one of the Divine Realm's Great Realms, the Da Yan Realm."
The Da Yan Realm is one of the Great Realms of the Divine Realm, and unlike other domains, the Da Yan Realm is ruled by the Da Yan Dynasty!
It is also the first Dynasty of the Divine Realm!
The Da Yan Dynasty's Royal Family, the Zhou Family, is also the ruling Dynasty of the Great Zhou State in the Spiritual Realm.
Within the Da Yan Realm lies a Heavenly Grotto, which is one of the top ten Heavenly Grottos in the Divine Realm, oppressed by the Da Yan Dynasty.
"I wonder how Zi Yun is doing now," Meng Chong muttered to himself.
Heading to the Da Yan Dynasty, he planned to meet some old acquaintances.
"After seeing the old friends, continue all the way to the Taikun Realm," he thought.
After Jiang Buping had made his breakthrough, he would surely go to the Taikun Realm to seek justice and settle a grudge. As his senior brother, Meng Chong naturally had to show support!
The Da Yan Dynasty, Dongyang County, Dongyang Martial Arts Academy.
The Da Yan Realm, being the territory ruled by the Da Yan Dynasty, meant that any force within the Dynasty was under its jurisdiction. Almost all had an official background from the Dynasty, otherwise, they couldn't stand.
The Dongyang Martial Arts Academy was a royal academy, a place where the Dynasty cultivated martial arts prodigies.
Throughout the territories of the Da Yan Dynasty, martial arts academies were established. Any prodigy could enter the academy, and if local officials recommended an exceptional prodigy to the academy, they would be rewarded as contributing merit!
The series of policies displayed by the Da Yan Dynasty, emphasizing the cultivation of prodigies, meant that nearly ninety-nine percent of all prodigies within the entire Da Yan Realm were recruited into the Dynasty, serving the Royal Family.
Even if a prodigy was wronged or persecuted, as long as their talent was monstrous, the academy would stand up to help them seek justice.
There was a prodigy of humble origin who, despite being persecuted by local official powers, escaped and took part in the academy's examination. Discovered as someone with monstrous talent, he rose rapidly under the protection of the academy, and eventually avenged his grievances.
There was also a prodigy whose enemies, fearing he would receive the academy's protection, killed him on his way there. When this act was disclosed, the Dynasty struck like thunder, obliterating the attacking force under the crime of persecuting a prodigy of the Dynasty.
The series of events that had happened made it so that once the Da Yan Dynasty discovered an exceptional prodigy, they would competitively recommend them to the academy in order to receive rewards and merit from the Dynasty.
There was also a prodigy who was arrogant and rude, taking advantage of his superior talent to act wantonly, but in the end, he was publicly beheaded by the Dynasty!
This served as a warning to prodigies that while the Dynasty might allow those with monstrous talents to do certain outlandish things, there was a limit. If anyone was unrestrained and harmed the heavens and the earth, such a rebellious heart would be put to death!
Dongyang County was one of the major counties of the Dynasty.
And the Dongyang Martial Arts Academy was a rather famous academy within the Dynasty, which gained particular prominence since it was designated to admit and cultivate prodigies from the Spiritual Realm. Since then, all the deans of Dongyang Martial Arts Academy have come from the Spiritual Realm.
In the Dongyang Martial Arts Academy, more than half of the teachers were from the Spiritual Realm, and even a portion of the students came from there.
Among the many prodigies from the Spiritual Realm, there was one whose fame was widespread, and he was the biggest supporter for all martial artists coming from the Spiritual Realm at Dongyang Martial Arts Academy.
That was the Da Yan Dynasty's high official, Marquis of Dongyang, Xiang Zhen!
"I've finally broken through!"
In a closed cultivation chamber of the Dongyang Martial Arts Academy, a beautiful woman in purple robes opened her eyes.
"The Truth Refinement Realm!"
Zi Yun exhaled deeply.
Since arriving at the Dongyang Martial Arts Academy, she had been diligently practicing day and night, and finally today, she had broken through to the Truth Refinement Realm.
She walked out of the closed chamber.
"I wonder what level Meng Chong has reached by now."
She missed Meng Chong greatly after not seeing him for such a long time.
"Sister Zi Yun, congratulations on your breakthrough," a senior sister of Dongyang Martial Arts Academy said with a smile.
"It was just luck, pure luck!" Zi Yun said modestly.
"By the way, Sister Zi Yun, while you were in seclusion, a major event took place in the Divine Realm."
"Oh? What happened?"
Zi Yun didn't pay much attention to major events in the Divine Realm.
"You know about the Wanbao Alliance, right?"
"Yes, the number one merchant alliance in the Divine Realm, incredibly powerful."
Zi Yun nodded.
"The Wanbao Alliance was pursuing someone, and despite their efforts, they couldn't catch them. Instead, that person looted several of their branches..."
The senior sister spoke of the event with excitement.
"Yes, yes, I've heard about it too, that person was too fierce,"
Gradually, the nearby students of Dongyang Martial Arts Academy gathered around.
Some of these students were from the Spiritual Realm, having arrived just a bit earlier than Zi Yun's batch.
That included the senior sister, who was once a county princess in the Great Zhou State of the Spiritual Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 858 - 448: This Guy is a Fierce One
chapters.content:
A group of people gathered together, enthusiastically discussing the affairs of the Wanbao Alliance, like how many Immortal Heavenly Venerables were chasing their target but all failed to catch him, who not only escaped but also seized the opportunity to loot a branch and so on.
Zi Yun, having been in closed-door cultivation and generally indifferent to the affairs of the Divine Realm, knew nothing about this.
After listening for a while, she got the gist of the incident.
It was nothing more than that the pursued person was initially framed for killing the disciple of the Alliance Hierarch of the Changyun Realm, which triggered a series of conflicts. The Wanbao Alliance lost face and naturally refused to let the matter rest. Moreover, the pursued person's affiliated forces had never come forward to negotiate and resolve the misunderstanding with the Wanbao Alliance.
This led the Wanbao Alliance to confirm that the other party was likely a Loose Cultivator who, by sheer luck, had gained the inheritance of a powerful cultivator, which endowed them with such strength.
Zi Yun found it boring and was about to leave when she heard someone exclaim in admiration, "Heavenly God Meng Chong is truly a monstrous talent, the first to remain unharmed under the pursuit of the Wanbao Alliance!"
Meng Chong?!
Zi Yun was immediately thrilled. The person Wanbao Alliance was after was Meng Chong?
"This brother, the Meng Chong you speak of, what does he look like, and why is he so powerful?"
Zi Yun suppressed the excitement in her heart and asked hurriedly.
Even though the person pursued by the Wanbao Alliance was bound to be the Meng Chong she knew, such a formidable monster, also named Meng Chong, and who was not afraid of the Wanbao Alliance at all, it was impossible there would be a second person.
But still, Zi Yun could not help wanting to confirm it once more.
"Rumor has it, this Meng Chong is bald, well-built, and has practiced an unknown but powerful Cultivation Technique. He can become like a giant, resembling a Heavenly God, hence the name..."
The Martial Artist from the Dongyang Martial Academy went on incessantly, his eyes full of longing.
Which Martial Artist does not dream of becoming strong?
"It is indeed Meng Chong!"
Zi Yun was excited in her heart.
"My Meng Chong—having only arrived in the Divine Realm not even thirty years ago, has already begun to shake the world!"
Zi Yun felt a surge of pride.
She indeed had an exceptional eye for talent, falling for someone so powerful.
A group of people was enthusiastically discussing Meng Chong, and after a while, another female Martial Artist, with a face full of admiration, started speaking, "Meng Chong is strong, but he is not without peers. Moreover, that person is handsome and unrivaled in the Sword Dao..."
Zi Yun knew immediately whom this senior sister was referring to.
Senior Brother Xu Yan!
Apart from Senior Brother Xu Yan, there would be no second person.
As expected, the crowd began discussing Xu Yan, who had slain the Immortal Heavenly Venerable of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow. Alone with a single sword, he had once carved his way through a Heavenly Grotto, slaying strong beings comparable to Immortal Heavenly Venerables within it.
One of the Heavenly Grotto strong beings even resembled the existence of a top Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
Zi Yun no longer felt bored and joined the conversation, mostly inquiring about Meng Chong. However, as the talk went on, she became somewhat puzzled.
What about Su Lingxiu?
Why hasn't she gained a reputation?
On second thought, Su Lingxiu preferred quiet and didn't show off, staying by her elder's side all this time. Given the vastness of the Divine Realm, it wasn't strange her name hadn't spread.
But what about Fang Hao? Why hadn't he made a name for himself?
"Could it be that Fang Hao also dislikes showing off?"
Although she was puzzled, she wasn't too concerned. Zi Yun's thoughts were entirely focused on Meng Chong.
As the crowd dispersed, Zi Yun returned to her dwelling, feeling an itch in her heart, wishing she could go out and find Meng Chong. Yet, reflecting on her current strength, she realized she was still too weak.
"Meng Chong will come to find me, won't he? It's been so many years."
Zi Yun propped her chin on her hands as she sat in front of the window, staring blankly at the distant sky, too distracted to cultivate.
...
"Worthy of the Great Realm, the Spiritual Energy here is richer, and the Domain Lingji is relatively more active. The strength of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables in the Great Realm is comparatively stronger, and their inheritance is more powerful."
As Meng Chong stepped into the Da Yan Realm, he couldn't help but sigh.
"I wonder where Zi Yun is."
Meng Chong scratched his head. The Da Yan Realm was so vast, finding someone wouldn't be easy.
"The prodigies who come from the Spiritual Realm are settled in certain locations. It should be relatively easy to find out about them—I'll ask the governor of this place in the Da Yan Dynasty."
Now with his strong abilities and full of confidence, Meng Chong went straight to inquire with the local governor.
Even though the Da Yan Dynasty was very powerful, Meng Chong didn't take them seriously. If it really came to a fight, although he was alone and it might be difficult to fight through the entire Dynasty, slaying dozens of Immortal Heavenly Venerables would not be much of a challenge.
The head of a province in the Da Yan Dynasty was bound to be an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, with strength among the higher echelon of their peers.
Bordered by wilderness, Bian Nan Province was a border province of the Da Yan Dynasty. The governor Du Yuan, who had been in charge of Bian Nan Province for over a thousand years, was in the late stages of the Immortal Realm and not far from Perfection.
As the head of a province, his duties involved not just preventing control loss in the Heavenly Grottoes of Bian Nan and suppressing them, but also guarding against disturbances in the area.
Especially now, with the Divine Realm in turmoil and Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow causing trouble everywhere, even the mighty Da Yan Dynasty had seen some traitors, all with the shadow of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow behind them.
However, as the Da Yan Dynasty was at its peak with a formidable strength and numerous powerful cultivators, there were only minor chaos that could not shake the Dynasty at all.
Bian Nan bordered the wilderness, and naturally, there was a need for vigilance and protection against powerful beings crossing the wilderness.
But the wilderness was sparse, and even with people watching, it was not guaranteed to completely control those who crossed the wilderness.

chapters.title: Chapter 859 - 448 This is a Fierce Person, Part 2
chapters.content:
```
If a Heavenly Venerable entered, they wouldn't have much impact, but if an Immortal Heavenly Venerable crossed the wilderness, unless they remained hidden without taking action, even the slightest movement would expose their tracks.
Once their tracks were exposed, and especially if they did not enter the Da Yan Realm through a Realm Gate, they would have to explain their presence in the Da Yan Realm and their intentions.
They would either be expelled or—killed!
With the current turbulent situation, the Da Yan Dynasty showed no mercy, and they had the confidence to act so decisively.
At this moment, within the Prefecture Governor's Mansion at the southern border, Du Yuan was examining a new piece of intelligence.
This was a report that had just been delivered and not yet spread around.
"Sixteen Immortal Heavenly Venerables from the Wanbao Alliance pursued Meng Chong and since then, no news of them?"
Upon reading this, Du Yuan couldn't help but feel shocked.
After all, losing sixteen Immortal Heavenly Venerables would be a heavy loss for the mighty Wanbao Alliance.
Moreover, among these sixteen, there was a late-stage Immortal Realm powerhouse leading them.
"Killed by Meng Chong?"
Du Yuan found it hard to believe.
The Wanbao Alliance's pursuit of Meng Chong had stirred up the Divine Realm for many years now.
Meng Chong had been fleeing all this time, and his methods of escape were extraordinarily mysterious; he could conceal and restrain his own aura, making it hard for Immortal Heavenly Venerables to track him.
"Could it be, a powerful backer of Meng Chong has made a move?"
Du Yuan pondered, unwilling to believe that this was Meng Chong's doing alone.
Even if Meng Chong had broken through to the Immortal Realm while being pursued, he wouldn't be able to slay sixteen Immortal Heavenly Venerables alone, right?
One of them was even a late-stage Immortal Realm powerhouse.
Furthermore, the Treasure Protection Team experts of the Wanbao Alliance were skilled in the Combined Strike Technique; together, they could even force the top Immortal Heavenly Venerables to flee, let alone have the power to kill sixteen of them.
"After investigating, the Wanbao Alliance traced the last whereabouts of the sixteen strongholds to the edge of the wilderness, where traces of a great battle were discovered. Judging by the remnant battle fluctuations, it was Meng Chong's doing!"
By the end of the report, Du Yuan was astounded.
Was it truly Meng Chong, who alone slew sixteen Immortal Heavenly Venerables? What terrifying strength he must possess—could he already be comparable to a being above the Immortal Realm?
"From information we have, Meng Chong's cultivated Martial Arts are extremely unique and powerful, which might have something to do with his formidable cultivation techniques."
Du Yuan took a deep breath.
"How will the Wanbao Alliance respond? Will they swallow their pride and negotiate peace with Meng Chong, or, unable to contain their anger, will they invite a Supreme Expert to descend?"
Du Yuan grew curious.
"Our Da Yan Royal Family seems to be one of the hidden founders behind the Wanbao Alliance. Will they also take part in this action?"
Du Yuan grew curious again.
The forces behind the Wanbao Alliance were complex, with several Great Realms involved, which is why the alliance could become the number one merchant group in the Divine Realm.
However, the extent of participation from each Great Realm varied. While the Da Yan Royal Family was involved, they didn't seem too deeply ingrained in the Wanbao Alliance. They weren't heard to have sent any Immortal Heavenly Venerables in the pursuit of Meng Chong.
"In my opinion, it's best to avoid provoking Meng Chong if possible, else it will inevitably bring great losses to Da Yan."
Du Yuan thought to himself.
While Da Yan was powerful, signs were showing that Meng Chong's escape abilities were extraordinary. After so many attempts, the Wanbao Alliance had not managed to kill him.
The recent great battle was evidently a trap set by Meng Chong, who deliberately lured the Wanbao Alliance's experts so that he could slay them all at once.
Such a fierce person, if provoked by any power, would lead to immense losses, and perhaps even the risk of annihilation.
Du Yuan stepped out of the study, stood in the garden of the Prefecture Governor's Mansion, and looked up at the firmament, "Is this world truly going to change?"
All signs indicated that some beings, unsatisfied with the current state of the world, desired to make a change or sought to gain something from it.
"Immortal Heavenly Venerables, seemingly high above and possessing eternal life alongside the domain, are just as unable to control their own life and death under the great forces of the world."
Du Yuan sighed to himself.
Not long ago, the sixteen Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Wanbao Alliance were squashed like grasshoppers.
Never before had the Immortal Heavenly Venerables seemed so frail!
"Are you the Prefecture Governor?"
Suddenly, a voice sounded from behind!
Du Yuan was startled, his expression changing drastically as his aura surged. Whirling around, his hand was holding a massive seal.
This seal radiated with light, illuminating the sky above the Prefecture Governor's Mansion. In an instant, his power was augmented by the domain, and his strength was elevated at that moment.
This was the Prefecture Governor's Seal, a Divine Artifact.
It enhanced the holder's ability to control the domain and could send messages to strong individuals within the prefecture. In times of crisis, it could also be used to call for immediate assistance. The seals of nearby prefectures would sense the plea, prompting swift aid.
Furthermore, if a Prefecture Governor fell and the seal shattered, it would imprint the attacker's visage, and the central authority of the Da Yan Dynasty would be alerted, prompting a swift response.
Each Prefecture Governor's Seal was a core element in the operation of the Da Yan Dynasty, as well as central to the dynasty's control over the Da Yan Realm.
```
At that moment, Du Yuan immediately activated his Prefecture Governor's Seal, but he didn't send out a distress signal, after all, if the other party had wanted to ambush him, they would have made their move already.
His heart was trembling at this moment.
As an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, it was the first time someone had managed to get close to him without his knowledge!
"How is this possible, could it be a stronger existence beyond the Immortal Realm?"
Du Yuan thought to himself in shock.
He turned around and instantly saw the person who spoke.
It was a burly young man with a shiny, bald head that reflected the light.
Upon seeing this person, a name immediately surfaced in Du Yuan's mind.
Heavenly God Meng Chong!
Meng Chong touched his bald head, looked at Du Yuan, who was on high alert and whose face had turned somewhat pale from fright, and apologized with an embarrassed smile, "Sorry, sorry, that was a bit presumptuous of me. I didn't mean to scare you!"
Du Yuan:...
You damn well did scare me, but could you not put it so bluntly?
After all, I'm the head of a prefecture, a dignified Immortal Heavenly Venerable. I have a reputation to uphold!
"Meng Chong?"
Du Yuan asked with a cough.
"Indeed!"
Meng Chong nodded.
Du Yuan couldn't help but feel nervous, recalling whether he had offended Meng Chong in any way. After confirming that he had not provoked the other party, he finally breathed a sigh of relief.
This one, he's a fearsome man.
He put away the Prefecture Governor's Seal and retracted his aura, showing a smiling face, "So it's Brother Meng, I've long admired your esteemed name!"
"You're too kind!"
Meng Chong replied with a bow.
"Come, come, please have a seat, Brother Meng!"
Du Yuan hurriedly entertained Meng Chong, sitting down with him in the pavilion in the garden.
He personally brewed a pot of Spiritual Tea to serve him.
"Brother Meng, there's something I'm not sure whether I should ask?"
There was a burning curiosity in Du Yuan's heart, and he couldn't resist asking.
He wanted to confirm whether the sixteen Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Wanbao Alliance had been killed by Meng Chong alone.
"What is it? Just ask,"
Meng Chong had a rough idea of what the other party wanted to inquire about.
After slaughtering more than a dozen Immortal Heavenly Venerables from the Wanbao Alliance, he had intentionally left behind some traces of the great battle, naturally to tell the Wanbao Alliance that it was he who had done it and that they should carefully consider their next move!
"It's like this, I happened to come across some information, that sixteen Immortal Heavenly Venerables from the Wanbao Alliance were slain and I was unsure if..."
Du Yuan cautiously broached the subject.
"I killed them!"
Meng Chong nodded, "That Wanbao Alliance is relentless, clearly, it was the doing of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, yet they insisted on blaming me. Do they really think I'm that patient? To dare to surround and attempt to kill me, as if I'm just killing chickens or something silly like that!"
Gulp!
Du Yuan swallowed nervously, his heart still trembling; indeed, it was Meng Chong, this fearsome man, who had done the slaughtering!
"Brother Meng's divine might is awesome, truly worthy of the name of Heavenly God!"
Du Yuan said with an admiring look.
"It's all empty fame, just empty fame!"
Meng Chong waved his hand dismissively, feigning modesty.
"Brother Meng, what brings you to me, is there something I can do for you?"
Du Yuan's demeanor was very humble.
After all, this was a fearsome man who could kill Immortal Heavenly Venerables as easily as squashing chicks. He must not offend him.
If, in a fit of anger, he casually snuffed out my life, wouldn't that be unfortunate?
"It's nothing major. My purpose in coming here is to inquire about a certain matter..."
Meng Chong came to find Du Yuan to investigate where the Martial Artists who came from the Spiritual Realm had gone to. Once he knew their direction, it would be much easier to track down Zi Yun's whereabouts.
To directly inquire about Zi Yun's whereabouts would risk drawing the attention of the Wanbao Alliance and entangling Zi Yun in the situation. Besides the Wanbao Alliance, the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow would likely cause trouble in secret.

chapters.title: Chapter 860 - 449: Spiritual Realm Martial Artist, Princess of Da Yan
chapters.content:
After hearing the purpose of Meng Chong's visit, Du Yuan couldn't help but feel puzzled. Seeking a Martial Artist from the Spiritual Realm?
The Spiritual Realm of Da Zhou State, a power under the Da Yan Dynasty, sends Spirit Body Prodigies to the Da Yan Dynasty from time to time.
In the Divine Realm, Spirit Body Prodigies are also among the top talent.
It is said that due to certain factors, although the Spiritual Energy in the Spiritual Realm is sparse and the Domain Lingji is not very active, limiting the Martial Arts potential, it still produces Spirit Body Prodigies.
The rumors say this is also where the name of the Spiritual Realm comes from.
As for the secrets within, Du Yuan had no way of knowing, but there were Prodigies from the Spiritual Realm who had broken through to become Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
The strongest among them, who was also the greatest support for the Martial Artists from the Spiritual Realm, was the Marquis of Dongyang, an individual of unmatched strength and among the top in the ranks of Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
Rumor has it that the Marquis of Dongyang, Xiang Zhen, possesses a Thunder Spirit Body, making his offensive power extremely formidable and overwhelmingly forceful.
Meng Chong was actually seeking out the Prodigies from the Spiritual Realm. Could it be that he had a grudge against the Marquis of Dongyang?
As this thought crossed his mind, Du Yuan's heart skipped a beat.
He carefully asked, "Brother Meng, if I may be so bold, do you have a grudge against the Marquis of Dongyang?"
"Who is the Marquis of Dongyang?"
Meng Chong's eyebrows twitched.
"The Marquis of Dongyang, Xiang Zhen."
Fearing that Meng Chong didn't know of Marquis of Dongyang, Du Yuan added quickly.
"Don't know him, never met!"
Meng Chong shook his head.
Upon hearing this, Du Yuan breathed a slight sigh of relief and asked again, "Then may I inquire what business you have with the Martial Artists from the Spiritual Realm, Brother Meng?"
"You ask too many questions. Just tell me where they are, that's all I need."
Meng Chong said with dissatisfaction.
After a pause, he added, "Don't worry, I'm not going there to kill anyone."
He hurried to clarify, lest Du Yuan misunderstood and created unnecessary conflict.
Once Du Yuan heard this, he let out a sigh of relief. As long as Meng Chong wasn't going there to kill, things would be much easier to handle.
"The Martial Artists from the Spiritual Realm mostly gather in Dongyang County. The Dongyang Martial Institute is responsible for recruiting Prodigies from the Spiritual Realm. Brother Meng, you could go to Dongyang County."
"In that case, thank you!"
Meng Chong, having obtained the information he wanted, did not linger and bid farewell with a cupped-hand salute.
Watching Meng Chong's figure disappear, Du Yuan pondered for a moment, feeling somewhat uneasy.
"If Meng Chong is indeed looking for trouble with the Martial Artists from the Spiritual Realm and the information is provided by me, if the Marquis of Dongyang finds out, wouldn't he let it go easily? I am certain to encounter misfortune."
Therefore, Du Yuan decided to pass the information to the Marquis of Dongyang, Xiang Zhen.
Moreover, the matter of Meng Chong should also be reported to the emperor of Da Yan, after all, such a fierce person coming to the Da Yan Realm could easily cause a major incident if one is not careful.
Furthermore, the Da Yan Royal Family is also one of the covert powers behind the Wanbao Alliance, it is essential to report to the emperor of Da Yan. Meng Chong alone has slain sixteen Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Wanbao Alliance. If one were to act against Meng Chong, one would have to carefully consider if it's worth it.
After all, the current losses of the Wanbao Alliance have not yet implicated the Da Yan Dynasty.
To provoke Meng Chong for no reason would be unwise.
Dongyang County, far from the southern border county, and Meng Chong was not in a hurry to get to Dongyang County; instead, he enjoyed the scenery and attractions of the Da Yan Dynasty along the way.
He even went to one of the Wanbao Alliance shops in a certain prefecture city of the Da Yan Dynasty to purchase some treasures, intending to give them as gifts to Zi Yun.
He picked out the ones that looked nice.
As for things like the Spirit Crystals needed for purchases, they were all looted from the Wanbao Alliance, and the marks on them hadn't even been wiped off.
So arrogant, so presumptuous; he was blatantly disregarding the Wanbao Alliance, this was a direct slap in the face!
Going too far!
"Mister Meng, what if I offer you a 40% discount? How does that sound?"
The Shopkeeper of the Wanbao Alliance screamed internally, yet his face displayed a smile reserved for esteemed guests.
This was a dangerous man, after all. Mistreat him, and he might even loot the place.
"This branch of the Wanbao Alliance belongs to the Da Yan Royal Family. It is somewhat different from those in other realms," the Shopkeeper hastily added another sentence.
Fearing that Meng Chong was ignorant of the difference, and might loot this Wanbao Alliance as well.
"Oh, so this is the Wanbao Alliance of Da Yan? Well then, that's fine, very good!"
Meng Chong wore an expression of regret.
The Shopkeeper trembled with fear, wondering if Meng Chong had really had the intention to loot just moments ago.
Lucky for him that he was quick-witted enough to clarify the relationship with the Wanbao Alliance of other realms.
Dongyang County.
The Prefecture Governor of Dongyang, the Dean of the Dongyang Martial Institute, and several other Immortal Heavenly Venerables of Dongyang County suddenly gathered in the Prefecture Governor's Mansion.
The illustrious Marquis of Dongyang, Xiang Zhen, had quietly returned to Dongyang County that day.
"Marquis, for what matter have you summoned us?" asked the Dean of the Dongyang Martial Institute, puzzled.
The broad-shouldered middle-aged man sitting at the top, imposing without anger, now had a serious expression and spoke gravely, "This person, Heavenly God Meng Chong, are you all aware of him?"
The strong ones such as the Prefecture Governor of Dongyang were startled, not understanding why Xiang Zhen was suddenly bringing up Meng Chong.
Soon, the Dean of the Dongyang Martial Institute, with a shocked expression, said, "Marquis, could it be that His Majesty wishes to be involved in the Wanbao Alliance's operations?"
The Wanbao Alliance's covert powers of the Great Realms included the Da Yan Royal Family. Could it be that this time, the Da Yan Royal Family intended to take action against Meng Chong?
"No!"
Xiang Zhen shook his head.
He continued with a grave face, "You may not be aware, but when the Wanbao Alliance's sixteen Immortal Heavenly Venerables surrounded Meng Chong, all of them were slain by him. Meng Chong's strength is formidable, to say the least.
"Neither His Majesty nor the Royal Family intend to provoke Meng Chong. Moreover, there hasn't been a final decision on whether the Wanbao Alliance will continue to seek revenge."
Xiang Zhen took a deep breath and said, "I'm here because Meng Chong has been inquiring about the Prodigies from the Spiritual Realm. Although he has no past conflicts with us from the Spiritual Realm, we must remain vigilant."

chapters.title: Chapter 861 - 449: Spiritual Realm Martial Artist, Princess of Da Yan_2
chapters.content:
Upon these words, all the strong ones present were startled.
Meng Chong alone, had slain sixteen of the Wanbao Alliance's Immortal Heavenly Venerables?
The headmaster of the Dongyang Martial Institute's face changed dramatically as he exclaimed in shock, "Does the Marquis mean that, someone from our Spiritual Realm may have offended Meng Chong, and he has come for revenge?"
If that were truly the case, it would be a disaster for those hailing from the Spiritual Realm.
With Meng Chong's strength, not even a joint effort of these Immortal Heavenly Venerables could likely withstand him.
"It may not necessarily be the case, perhaps his enemies aren't from us in the Great Zhou, but from other Spiritual Realms?"
Xiang Zhen shook his head.
Being the strongest among the Martial Artists born in the Spiritual Realm and the mainstay of the Spiritual Realm Faction, Xiang Zhen must make decisive decisions at critical moments.
"If indeed there are any among us who have enmity with Meng Chong, I only hope this matter does not escalate and drag the innocent into it."
The others nodded solemnly.
This was a matter of necessity; after all, even if they were to join forces, they would not be able to withstand a powerful enemy, and naturally, they had no reason to stand up for any one individual.
Otherwise, once involved, it would be a disaster for all the Martial Artists of the Spiritual Realm Faction in the Da Yan Realm.
Even more so, they might be thoroughly suppressed as a result.
After all, those hailing from the Spiritual Realm in the Da Yan Realm didn't lack adversaries.
Their ability to establish themselves was always related to their long-standing alignment with the Royal Family of the Da Yan Dynasty, being like a blade in the hands of the Royal Family. As long as they did not make a significant blunder and become abandoned by the Royal Family, they could maintain their footing with security.
"Do not spread word of this matter. Should Meng Chong arrive in Dongyang County, inform me immediately,"
Xiang Zhen ordered in a deep voice.
"Yes, Marquis!"
Everyone nodded in agreement.
Within Dongyang County, undercurrents surged. Various other powers within the Da Yan Realm sent people, especially the adversarial factions to the Spiritual Realm Faction.
Indeed, some had even made plans to persuade the Royal Family of the Da Yan Dynasty to abandon the Spiritual Realm Faction.
As usual, the Dongyang Martial Institute carried on.
For the students of Dongyang, these matters were beyond their reach. However, some with backgrounds, or those from the previous batches of Spiritual Realm Geniuses, had begun to sense something unusual.
"Will Meng Chong come to find me?"
Zi Yun had lost the heart to cultivate.
Sitting by the window and staring at the sky, she was restless and troubled.
What she feared most now was that Meng Chong had forgotten her.
"The big guy looks carefree, but he's actually very meticulous and values relationships. He wouldn't have forgotten about me, right? But when will he come to see me?"
Zi Yun sighed.
"Zi Yun junior sister, why have you not been diligently cultivating these past few days? Are you troubled by something?"
A senior sister with a good relationship came over and asked with curiosity.
"Ping senior sister, it's nothing. I'm just tired and want to rest for a while,"
Zi Yun shook her head.
"You can't fool me. You look lovesick. Who have you fallen for? Tell your senior sister,"
Ping senior sister teased with a sly smile.
"Ping senior sister, stop asking. Even if I did like someone, you wouldn't know him,"
Zi Yun replied with a roll of her eyes.
"Alas, I've also fallen for someone,"
Ping senior sister mimicked her, resting her chin in her hands and gazing wistfully towards the sky.
"Eh, senior sister, you've fallen for someone? Who is it?"
Zi Yun suddenly perked up with interest.
"It's Sword God Xu Yan!"
Ping senior sister had a dreamy look on her face.
"How can there be such a genius in this world, handsome and suave, peerless in the Sword Dao... when will I get to see him..."
Zi Yun held her forehead and said, "Ping senior sister, don't daydream, you won't have a chance."
If Yun Miaomiao and Du Yuying knew of Ping senior sister's thoughts, they'd probably beat her half to death.
"Ping senior sister, you've never even seen Xu Yan. How do you know he's handsome and suave?"
Zi Yun asked curiously.
"Who said I haven't seen him?"
Ping senior sister took out a scroll and slowly unrolled it, revealing an image of a young man holding a sword, extraordinarily handsome.
"Eh, where did you get this portrait from?"
Zi Yun was astonished.
The young man in the painting was indeed Xu Yan.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, in their pursuit of the Sword God Xu Yan, have offered quite a few portraits, and this is a replica I've made..."
Zi Yun suddenly realized, that's how it was.
"Sister Zi Yun, quite a few people from the capital have come to the Prefecture City recently, there might be something big happening, let's go have a look."
Sister Ping put away the portrait and spoke.
"Alright."
Zi Yun thought, since she had nothing better to do, it might be good to stroll around the Prefecture City.
The two left the Dongyang Martial Institute and arrived at the Prefecture City.
Just as they reached the city gate, they saw the County Governor leading a team of guards in formation outside the city, slowly approaching was a luxurious beast carriage, pulled by two Outer Heavenly Spirits.
"Eh, that seems to be someone from the Royal Family."
Sister Ping exclaimed in surprise.
"Why would someone from the Royal Family come to Dongyang County?"
Zi Yun didn't understand and asked curiously, "Sister Ping, how do you know they are from the Royal Family?"
Sister Ping explained, "The creatures pulling the carriage are Outer Heavenly Spirits, and in the entire Da Yan Realm, the subdued Outer Heavenly Spirits can be counted on one's fingers. Moreover, only people from the Royal Family are qualified to ride in such a carriage, and even within the Royal Family, there aren't many who hold the privilege to be carried by True Spirits."
Following that, Sister Ping explained the Outer Heavenly Spirits and the rules regarding Royal Family carriages, and so on.
These Outer Heavenly Spirits are all captured in the Heavenly Grotto, and because they lack Spiritual Wisdom and are fierce in nature, subduing them to obey and be driven is extremely difficult, requiring specialized animal-taming Martial Artists and a long time to tame them.
"According to rumors, not all Outer Heavenly Spirits can be subdued, and the Colossal Armored Beast has the highest chance of being tamed. Even so, it would take at least a hundred years to tame one," Sister Ping said with a sigh.
Only the Royal Family had the vast resources and manpower required to tame an Outer Heavenly Spirit.
The arrival of the True Spirit carriage caused a stir among the people of the Prefecture City, leaving them all secretly astonished, speculating about which high-ranking member of the Royal Family had come to Dongyang County.
No Martial Artist dared to offend the majesty of the Da Yan Royal Family, all promptly cleared the main street, lining up on both sides, curious onlookers gazing.
Zi Yun and Sister Ping stood at the side of the street, looking on with curiosity.
The carriage slowly approached, and everyone was curious about who was sitting inside.
The Colossal Armored Beasts pulling the carriage made a clattering noise; the golden curtain shielded the carriage windows, and just as the beast carriage drove by, it suddenly stopped.
A delicate jade hand lifted the curtain of the carriage window, revealing the face of a woman with incomparable beauty, her bright eyes seeming to carry an air of majesty.
Zi Yun's heart skipped a beat, and she hurriedly lowered her eyes slightly, not knowing why, but she felt as though the woman in the carriage was looking at her.
"What is your name?"
The beauty in the carriage asked.
Her voice was clear but emotionless, it was impossible to discern happiness or anger.
In that moment, everyone turned to look at Zi Yun, while Sister Ping became nervous as well.
"My name is Zi Yun!"
Zi Yun's palms were sweaty, uncertain why she was being singled out.
"You have a remarkable presence and are beautiful. I am in need of a personal servant girl by my side; come and be mine. You will be taught how to serve well."
The woman finished speaking and let down the curtain.
"Ah?"
Zi Yun was startled. Become a servant girl?
She refused!
In the Inner Domain, she had been a princess of her own nation, always served by others, never serving anyone.
In the Spiritual Realm, she was a dignified Great Zhou Princess, accustomed to being served, never to serve.
Even since arriving in the Divine Realm, she had mostly been focused on arduous cultivation, never serving others.
Now being asked to serve as a servant girl was utterly unthinkable.
"Your favor is appreciated, but I'm afraid I am out of reach. I'm used to my freedom, I'm sorry!"
Zi Yun took a deep breath and spoke.
"Presumptuous! How dare you question the Princess's words?"
Suddenly, an angry rebuke sounded.
An old woman following by the beast carriage, spoke coldly.
Princess?
All present were immediately shocked.
Sister Ping went pale.
Although Zi Yun did not know much about the Princess, she was aware of the lofty status the other held, and by rejecting her offer, trouble seemed imminent.
However, she had no regrets; worse came to worst, she would escape!
With the Jade Talisman from her elder, surely she would not fail to flee.
"Zi Yun, apologize quickly! That is Princess Zhou Qingshuang, known for her cold heart and decisive nature. In the Royal Family, aside from His Majesty, she is the most dangerous to provoke!" Sister Ping hurriedly communicated through voice transmission.
Upon hearing this, Zi Yun grew even more nervous, clenching her fists. She wouldn't apologize and serve as a servant girl, even if the other party was the Great Zhou Princess. She scanned her surroundings, preparing to find a chance to run away.

chapters.title: Chapter 862 - 450: Old Friends Reunite, The Prestige of the Heavenly God
chapters.content:
In Dongyang County City, everyone's eyes were focused on Zi Yun, and many were envious. To become the personal maid of the Princess was an immense honor, and she rejected it?
What a great opportunity.
Once one became the personal maid of the Princess, everyone would have to show them more respect, even the Immortal Heavenly Venerable would have to acknowledge them, as this represented the Princess herself.
The Princess of Da Yan was known as the person not to provoke, second only to the Emperor of Da Yan himself.
