She was the youngest daughter of the previous Emperor of Da Yan, and also the most favored. She was a full-blooded sister to the current Emperor and was equally beloved by him.
Moreover, the Princess's nature was as cold as frost; she was decisive in killing and extremely protective of her own. Of course, whoever defied her would not end up in good straits.
Zi Yun was looking for an opportunity to escape; however, in the city, under the watchful eyes of many and amidst numerous strong figures, it was nearly impossible for her to flee with her current strength.
Unless she used the Jade Talisman.
But Zi Yun was unwilling to use the ancestral Jade Talisman for such a trivial matter, especially since it was unpredictable what using it might provoke.
"Hm? You still didn't come over to thank the Princess?"
The old crone beside the beast carriage called out with a sinking face.
She exuded an aura, revealing herself as an Immortal Realm powerhouse.
Just as Zi Yun clenched her teeth, preparing to escape directly, and if the other party made a move, to activate the Jade Talisman, a figure hurried over, respectfully cupping his fists towards the beast carriage, "Your Highness Princess, please forgive her. Zi Yun has not long arrived in Da Yan, and has been concentrating on cultivation behind closed doors, ignorant about many things in Da Yan.
If there has been any offense, please allow me to apologize on behalf of Zi Yun!"
The person who had arrived was the headmaster of the Dongyang Martial Academy.
"Oh, is that so? Then teach her properly. I like this girl and want to keep her by my side to serve me. Bring her to me in three days."
The Princess Zhou Qingshuang's cold voice rang out.
The headmaster of the Dongyang Martial Academy was not a weak Immortal Heavenly Venerable. Moreover, he was an important figure in the Spiritual Realm Faction, and since Zi Yun came from the Spiritual Realm, having her by his side would benefit the people of the Spiritual Realm Faction.
Thus, in her eyes, even if Zi Yun didn't wish to serve, she would obediently comply under the pressure of the various strong individuals from the Spiritual Realm Faction.
"Zi Yun, quickly thank the Princess for her appreciation!"
The headmaster of the Dongyang Martial Academy heaved a sigh of relief.
The Spiritual Realm Faction was currently in a turbulent time, and they couldn't afford to offend the Princess, or else their situation would become even more difficult.
Since the Princess had come to Dongyang County, it was clear she represented the Royal Family, and the decision to support or abandon the Spiritual Realm Faction lay in her hands.
And since the Princess had taken a liking to Zi Yun, it was also a stroke of good fortune for the Spiritual Realm Faction.
Zi Yun wasn't well-informed about the matters of the Spiritual Realm Faction, so she didn't understand the headmaster's thoughts. She had no habit or intention of serving others.
The people in this world who could command her service were few, and surely the Princess was not included among them.
"Headmaster, I..."
Just as Zi Yun was about to say something, her eyes suddenly lit up, and at the city gate, behind the Princess's beast carriage, she saw a burly figure approaching.
Though his head was not bare, his burly figure, his handsome features, and the familiar aura were all too recognizable to her, the one she had missed day and night.
Meng Chong!
Meng Chong wearing a wig!
Zi Yun didn't care for the Princess's rights anymore; she transformed into a beam of purple light and flew toward him.
The headmaster of Dongyang Martial Academy's expression froze, then turned grave. Zi Yun's action was a great disrespect.
Within the beast carriage, a cold aura surged for a moment.
The old crone, with a cold expression and a low snort, turned to look at the figure of Zi Yun flying away, "Such disrespect, ignoring the presence of the Princess!"
She raised her hand, reaching out towards the figure of Zi Yun, creating a massive claw in the air to grab her. The careless figure behind her on the street was also enveloped within its grasp.
The Princess had not yet departed, and yet this person dared to stroll so brazenly in the center of the street, showing no respect!
...
Meng Chong had come to Dongyang County City after leisurely touring around the countryside and mountains.
By now, his name was widely known; his muscular build and his bald head would make anyone who saw him think of Meng Chong immediately.
Hence, to avoid being disturbed, Meng Chong simply wore a wig. Although his face didn't change, few recognized him with the wig on.
Unless it was someone familiar with him, most wouldn't associate a man with "thick hair" with Heavenly God Meng Chong.
Upon entering Dongyang County City, the pedestrians parted to both sides of the street, leaving the center empty. Meng Chong didn't think much of it and just strode boldly down the middle of the street.
Even if the Emperor of Da Yan himself were present, he wouldn't step aside. He would walk his own path, for that is the privilege of the powerful!
Suddenly, a purple figure came flying towards him.
"This girl's eyes are pretty sharp, recognizing me from so far away?"
Meng Chong muttered to himself.
Immediately following Zi Yun's leap, a giant palm print descended from the sky towards him.
"Big guy, I've missed you so much!"
Zi Yun was overflowing with excitement, and she clung to Meng Chong.
As for the attack from the old crone, she ignored it, believing that there would be no problem with Meng Chong there.
Meng Chong was somewhat helpless and let Zi Yun hang onto him as he threw a punch with his free hand.
"Get lost!"
Boom!
With the fist, wind and thunder erupted, as if a terrible storm and thunder were obliterating the palm print, and without losing momentum, the fist headed straight for the old crone.

chapters.title: Chapter 863 - 450: Old Friends Reunite, The Prestige of the Heavenly God_2
chapters.content:
Naturally, it also struck towards that particular beast-drawn carriage!
"How presumptuous!"
At that moment, the old woman's face drastically changed.
Was the opponent actually an Immortal Heavenly Venerable?
Before the opponent made a move, she had completely failed to notice it.
The head of Dongyang Martial Arts Academy also had a drastic change in expression and hastily made a move, joining forces with the old woman to resist this storm and thunder.
Boom!
The martial artists spectating were all shocked— who was this person, daring to attack the Princess right in the street?!
This was a provocation against the Da Yan Dynasty!
Boom!
The old woman and the head of Dongyang Martial Arts Academy staggered, retreating a few steps before they managed to block this punch.
Meng Chong raised an eyebrow; these two had considerable strength. His punch just now, although casual, couldn't be so easily caught by an ordinary Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
With one step, he crossed the distance in an instant and arrived before the beast-drawn carriage.
The head of the Dongyang Martial Arts Academy and the old woman hurriedly blocked the front of the carriage, their eyes filled with grave seriousness, as powerful auras crazily rushed over from all directions of Dongyang County City.
These were the Marquis of Dongyang and the Prefect of Dongyang County among many other Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
Meng Chong, with one arm around Zi Yun's slender waist, waved his other hand, and a giant blade thrust into the ground. He said in a cold voice, "Upon my arrival, I was attacked by your people. Shouldn't there be an explanation for this?"
The giant blade stuck in the ground, with storm and thunder swirling, emitting an awe-inspiring might.
The martial artists watching retreated frantically; this was a battle between the mighty, and should they be affected, death was certain!
Whoosh, whoosh!
At this moment, a succession of powerful figures arrived. The Marquis of Dongyang and the Prefect of Dongyang County stood in front of the carriage with solemn expressions, while the others surrounded them from all sides, trapping Meng Chong in the center.
At this moment, the gathered powerhouses were somewhat confused, not understanding what exactly had happened.
This stalwart young man, holding a beauty in his arms and looking fierce, demanded an explanation, and the person he was seeking was none other than the Princess of the Da Yan!
Zi Yun, clung onto Meng Chong, felt both thrilled and excited; this was indeed her beloved man— so domineering, so imperious!
He was just too impressive!
Meng Chong was even stronger than the rumors suggested; clearly, he had made a breakthrough and was filled with confidence!
Xiang Zhen, the Marquis of Dongyang, was the strongest among those present. Amidst his aura, faint thunder could be seen flickering, ready to unleash at any moment. However, his face bore a grave look as if he was secretly communicating with someone.
"Your Excellency..."
Xiang Zhen was about to speak while cupping his fists.
"The person inside the carriage speaks, but it was your people who struck first. Give an explanation, or this matter won't end. Even if the Emperor of Da Yan himself were to come, it would be the same!"
Meng Chong, however, spoke coldly.
The fierce warriors present were enraged; such disrespect towards the Emperor of Da Yan was a challenge to the Dynasty, a trampling of their dignity as powerful beings.
"If Your Excellency wants an explanation, perhaps start by giving your name?"
A cool voice came from inside the carriage.
Subsequently, Princess Zhou Qingshuang emerged, beautiful yet aloof, her eyes as chilly as frost, seemingly void of any emotion.
"Huh?"
Meng Chong's eyebrows raised in surprise as he gave the Princess a few thoughtful looks.
Zi Yun suddenly became nervous—Meng Chong couldn't possibly have taken a fancy to the Princess, could he?
Scared, she gripped Meng Chong's garment tightly, clearly anxious.
"Fair enough, I am Meng Chong!"
Meng Chong lowered his head to glance at Zi Yun, his face full of helplessness.
Meng Chong?!
All were taken aback; the strong of Dongyang County had gathered precisely because of Meng Chong, hadn't they?
"You are Heavenly God Meng Chong?"
The head of Dongyang Martial Arts Academy exclaimed.
Looking at Zi Yun clinging to Meng Chong, he couldn't help but entertain an absurd thought—had Meng Chong come to Dongyang County to find Zi Yun?
Just looking at the two of them, one could tell they were as close as could be!
"That's right!"
Meng Chong removed his disguise and put it away, exposing his shiny bald head.
The Immortal Heavenly Venerables present suddenly felt an immense pressure. This man alone had slain sixteen Immortal Heavenly Venerables— a peerless dangerous figure.
Even if they joined forces, could they truly match him?
Although the strong ones present believed their strength to surpass those sixteen Immortal Heavenly Venerables, what of it?
Zhou Qingshuang's cool expression changed as she stared at Meng Chong for a long while before speaking, "Regarding the attack just now, it was a misunderstanding, and I apologize!"
All the strong ones remained silent. The Princess was actually apologizing?
But they all breathed a sigh of relief inwardly, as long as there was no fighting, it was a good thing.
Facing the ferocious Meng Chong, which one of the strong ones didn't feel pressured?
"A misunderstanding?"
Meng Chong's eyebrows rose.
He reached out to pick Zi Yun off himself and asked, "Tell me, what happened?"
Zi Yun looked at the Princess and muttered, "She wanted to make me a maidservant, and I, of course, refused. I was planning to find a chance to escape when I saw you and ran over to you..."
After Meng Chong heard the reasons, he raised his hand, and a large knife fell into his palm, "You have a problem picking out maidservants on the street, and it had to be Zi Yun. Look at the mess you've made; shouldn't you give some sort of explanation?"
"I, Meng Chong, live by the philosophy 'If no one offends me, I offend no one; but if someone offends me, they become my enemy.' Dealing with enemies, there has always been only one solution—turning the ashes of the enemy to dust!"
He was publicly threatening the Princess. The strong ones present were all so infuriated that their faces turned livid, but not one spoke, fearing that the wrong words could bring disaster.
Zhou Qingshuang's expression returned to being cool, "Does Brother Meng think the Da Yan Dynasty is just average? Confident that you can come and go as you please?"
"Heh, not to mention the Da Yan Dynasty, I can roam the entire Divine Realm freely. As for the strength of your Da Yan Dynasty, I. Meng Chong, have no desire to know. Even if your Da Yan Dynasty has the Undying above the Immortal Realm, they can't do anything to me."
Meng Chong carried the large knife on his shoulder, looking at her arrogantly.
"If that's the case, what kind of explanation would you want, Brother Meng?"
Zhou Qingshuang pondered for a moment before asking.
Meng Chong touched his head and looked at Zi Yun, "What explanation do you want?"
"Ah?"
Zi Yun was startled, "I don't, I don't need any explanation. If you think an explanation is needed, then it's up to you to decide."
She really hadn't thought about it since she hadn't been forced to become a maidservant, so she naturally didn't need to seek an explanation, right?
However, since Meng Chong put it that way, Zi Yun let him decide.
Meng Chong touched his head, pondered for a moment, and said, "Forget it, since I haven't lost out, there's no need to ask for any explanation from you. After all, you don't have anything I value. If I were lacking something, I'd just go directly to the Wanbao Alliance!"
The people present twitched their mouths upon hearing this.
Lacking something, so he would just go loot the Wanbao Alliance, right?
Definitely audacious!
"Then thank you, Brother Meng, for your magnanimity. I wonder what business Brother Meng has in Dongyang? I would be glad to offer you the hospitality of the host."
Zhou Qingshuang said with a smile.
Yet her smile still seemed cold.
"It's nothing important, and I don't need your hospitality."
Meng Chong glanced at Zhou Qingshuang and grinned, "You woman have ill intentions; you're probably eyeing my body. I advise you to give it up; the issue with your body can't be resolved by merely drawing on physical vitality."
His words took all the strong ones by surprise.
Zhou Qingshuang's eyebrows furrowed as she looked at Meng Chong with a light laugh, "Where is Brother Meng getting this? I've long admired your reputation and simply wish to make your acquaintance."
Zi Yun at this point was staring at Zhou Qingshuang with a guarded face. The Princess coveted Meng Chong's body?
In her heart, she cursed, this Princess seemed so aloof on the surface but was so shameless inside. She truly hadn't expected it!
Meng Chong laughed, "You can't hide it from my eyes. Forget it, I don't want to talk with you anymore. Anyway, whatever method you're thinking of, it won't resolve your body's issues."
Being unfamiliar with the other party, Meng Chong naturally had no inclination to offer advice. Now that he had found Zi Yun, he had no intention of lingering any longer.
Zhou Qingshuang's complexion shifted slightly, her beautiful eyebrows knitting together tightly as if pondering something.
Meanwhile, Meng Chong turned and strode away, with Zi Yun clinging closely to him. "Meng Chong, did you come specifically to find me?"
"Not really, I'm just traversing the Divine Realm and passing through Da Yan."
"Meng Chong, how strong are you now?"
"I'm okay, I guess. Immortal Heavenly Venerables are like giant locusts in my eyes. To put it this way, not a single Immortal Heavenly Venerable is a match for me. Among martial artists at this level, only Senior Brother Xu can defeat me."
"Senior Brother Xu is still the strongest then."
Zi Yun exclaimed in admiration.
"Of course, Senior Brother Xu has always been the strongest. I still fall a bit short, but Fifth Junior Brother is also very strong; he probably isn't any weaker than me."
"Fifth Junior Brother? Has the senior taken another disciple?"
"Yeah!"
As the two slowly walked away, their conversation, though quiet, was crystal clear to these strong ones, who all felt a shock to their core.
The Senior Brother Xu Zi Yun mentioned, could it be Sword God Xu Yan?

chapters.title: Chapter 864 - 451 Battle of the Azure Sea Sphere, Ten Directions Annihilation Sword
chapters.content:
The Princess watched Meng Chong's departing figure, her expression still cold. However, deep in her eyes, there was a touch of complexity before she returned to her carriage.
The convoy continued onward.
But among the entourage, one person did not follow the caravan but instead chased after Meng Chong and Zi Yun in the direction they had left.
Ping Sister, in the crowd, was completely stunned.
That was Heavenly God Meng Chong, and Zi Yun had such a close relationship with him.
The moment Meng Chong appeared, how domineering and powerful he was, forcing the Princess to lower her head, and making all the Immortal Heavenly Venerables dare not even breathe.
The name of the Heavenly God was terrifying!
Meng Chong and Zi Yun had already left Dongyang County City, and a respectful voice came from behind, "Young Master Meng, please wait a moment!"
Zi Yun turned to look and saw that the person was a follower from the Princess's entourage. She couldn't help but become alert, remembering that Meng Chong had said the Princess was coveting something about his body.
"What is it?"
Meng Chong asked, raising his eyebrows.
"Her Highness the Princess, wishes to have a private meeting with Young Master Meng,"
The follower said respectfully.
"No way!"
Zi Yun jumped up and said.
"A private meeting? What does she want to do? Planning to exclude me? Absolutely not!"
The corners of the follower's mouth twitched as he said, "If Young Master Meng has no objections, Miss Zi Yun is naturally also welcome to join."
Zi Yun looked up at Meng Chong, extremely anxious.
Meng Chong rubbed his head and asked, "When? And where?"
"Tonight!"
The follower said the address and then left respectfully.
"Meng Chong, are you going to see her?"
Zi Yun twiddled the corners of her clothing.
"What's there to be afraid of? Let's go see her tonight. That woman has run into some problems with her cultivation, let's see if she has any treasures worth my advice to offer," Meng Chong said with a smirk, then added, "You'll come with me tonight to see her, maybe we can get some benefits."
Upon hearing this, Zi Yun immediately relaxed, and then asked curiously, "What kind of problems has she encountered in her cultivation?"
"You'll find out tonight. For now, tell me about your experiences over the years."
"I spent most of my time diligently cultivating..."
Zi Yun recounted her experiences, which weren't much to tell. After all, since arriving at Dongyang Martial Academy, most of her time had been spent in cultivation.
"Meng Chong, come on, tell me, how did you offend the Wanbao Alliance, and how did you manage to slaughter so many?"
After talking about her own experiences, Zi Yun hung on Meng Chong, asking excitedly and curiously.
"That's a long story..."
Meng Chong started from the Qinghua state and talked all the way to how he was framed by Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, how the Wanbao Alliance hunted him down, and how, after his breakthrough, he slew all the Wanbao Alliance pursuers that came for him.
...
In the Azure Sea Sphere, beyond the wilderness lies the boundless sea, with the roaring waves and occasional shocks breaking on the shore.
The myriad islands are like stars scattered across the Azure Sea, with the islands being the dwellings of the Human Clan, and the sea being the domain of the Sea Spirit Tribe. There is an understanding between them, living in harmony.
Some humans even intermarry with the Sea Spirits, and in the Azure Sea Sphere, people with Sea Spirit blood are not uncommon.
Yuntian Island is the largest island in the Azure Sea and also the most powerful force, dominating the vast Azure Sea.
The many islands of the Azure Sea are each home to either a Sect or a noble family, but stronger islands dominate the weaker ones, while Yuntian Island dominates all the islands.
Yuntian Island is not solely occupied by the Human Clan but is co-governed by both the Human Clan and the Sea Spirit Tribe, with the establishment of the Azure Sea Elder Council. Each elder is an Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
The Elder Council is also responsible for cultivating the prodigies of the Azure Sea, mediating conflicts between the various forces of the Azure Sea, and as long as the Elder Council makes a decision, no one in the entire Azure Sea can defy it, nor does anyone dare to.
This means that it is the collective decision of all the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the entire Azure Sea Sphere; there is no force or individual bold enough to challenge the will of all the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the entire Azure Sea Sphere!
On the sea, large ships sail, heading to Yuntian Island or trading between various islands. The routes are almost fixed and are also the safest.
Within the Azure Sea, apart from the Sea Spirits, there are naturally sea beasts, but their strength is ultimately limited. There has never been a sea beast that surpassed a True King Heavenly Venerable, and all are suppressed by the Sea Spirits.
However, the Azure Sea is not safe.
Because of the existence of the Heavenly Grottoes.
Within the Azure Sea Sphere, there are three major Heavenly Grottoes, with the largest one located in the Azure Sea, ten thousand li away from Yuntian Island, resembling a giant black abyss.
Besides the seven major Heavenly Grottoes, there are also other smaller ones, but they are not enough to pose a threat.
However, over the long years, with each disturbance of the Heavenly Grottoes, no one knows how many Outer Heavenly Spirits or enemies from beyond have escaped and are hidden within the vast Azure Sea.
Even though Immortal Heavenly Venerables join forces to patrol the Azure Sea periodically, it is still impossible to ensure that all hidden external enemies can be completely rooted out and exterminated.
Therefore, apart from the established sea routes, large ships will not lightly venture into unfamiliar waters unless there is an Immortal Heavenly Venerable powerhouse on board.
The Realm Gate of the Azure Sea Sphere is not located on Yuntian Island but on a small island among the seventeen large islands surrounding it, centered on Yuntian Island.
The Realm Gate is a considerable distance from Yuntian Island and other islands. Even for an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, it would take two quarters of an hour to reach it from Yuntian Island.
However, the Realm Gate is guarded by dozens of True King Heavenly Venerable Peak powerhouses dispatched by the Elder Council, along with an Immortal Heavenly Venerable keeping watch. They rotate every ten years.
The travel between the Azure Sea Sphere and other realms is not too frequent; people only cross the Realm Gate every few days.

chapters.title: Chapter 865 - 451: Battle of the Azure Sea Sphere, Ten Directions Annihilation Sword _2
chapters.content:
As for the martial artists of the Azure Sea Sphere, relatively fewer ventured out to traverse other realms.
On this day, one after another, figures crossed over the Realm Gate of the Azure Sea Sphere. All the comers were Immortal Heavenly Venerables clad in black robes, enveloped in a special aura that masked the might of their status as Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Azure Sea Sphere, who was stationed at the Realm Gate, cast a glance at the crowd and then his gaze rested on one of them, his expression slightly complex.
At last, he sighed and said, "The favor of saving my life back then has now been repaid. You have but a quarter of an hour; otherwise, people from Yuntian Island will inevitably arrive."
"A quarter of an hour is enough!"
The person nodded.
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Azure Sea Sphere waved his hand, and, carrying several True King Heavenly Venerables who had already fallen unconscious, instantly vanished from the spot to stop at a small island closest to the Realm Gate.
His gaze surveyed the sea area where the Realm Gate was located, a slight frown creasing his brow.
"Who is being ambushed? With twenty Immortal Heavenly Venerables joining hands, it's indeed a fine strategy. Could it be an ambush for those stronger than the Immortal Realm? But since when does the Divine Realm have such strong individuals arriving?"
He was filled with uncertainty.
At the same time, a chill ran through him, "What force is Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, exactly? To dispatch twenty Immortal Heavenly Venerables all at once is truly mighty. Moreover, many of them are strangers to me."
At this moment, he seemed to think of something.
"Could it be that they come from the Taihe Realm?"
He pondered with furrowed brows, his gaze growing heavy.
"If the Heavenly Ladder of the Taihe Realm were to appear, we would surely sense it, but there has been no sign. Could it have been during the last appearance that they entered the Divine Realm,"
The more he thought, the more he believed the hidden strength of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow in the Divine Realm to be extremely formidable.
He stood on the small island, silently gazing at the location of the Realm Gate, knowing that once a great battle erupted, the powerhouses of Yuntian Island would sense it and arrive immediately.
The others only had a quarter of an hour.
For twenty Immortal Heavenly Venerables to make their move, a quarter of an hour was indeed enough.
Outside the small island where the Realm Gate was situated, twenty Immortal Heavenly Venerables had completely surrounded the area.
In the sea and among the clouds, hidden figures lurked.
Furthermore, four Immortal Heavenly Venerables had placed a Divine Artifact each at the four seas. Once activated, these could amplify the power of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables, entrap this Domain, and seal the people within, limiting their strength to only fifty percent.
And, it also cut off any possibility of escape.
"If we can capture them alive, do so. If it's not feasible, go all out and kill him!" said the leader in a firm voice.
"Understood!"
All the Immortal Heavenly Venerables nodded in unison.
They concealed their forms, not revealing any aura, so that even if other Immortal Heavenly Venerables arrived, they would be unable to detect in an instant that this place was already surrounded.
At this moment, twenty Immortal Heavenly Venerables had laid a net of heaven and earth, readying to encircle and kill their enemy.
The moment the enemy crossed over the Realm Gate, they would fall into the encirclement.
"Crossing the Realm Gate will lead to the Azure Sea Sphere. I wonder how Brother Xie is faring," Xu Yan mused as he looked at the Realm Gate.
The Seductive Witch's Yu Zhu is indeed a treasure. My understanding of the Establishing Dao Realm has deepened, and I am not far from fully grasping it," he thought to himself.
The Yu Zhu contained mysterious patterns, resembling certain rules or perhaps similar to Dao principles. If the hollow inside the Yu Zhu were seen as a Domain, then the mysterious patterns would be the principles governing it.
It was precisely because of such uniqueness, and because the Yu Zhu itself was a special treasure, that Xu Yan often observed and contemplated the Dao rhyme within it, greatly aiding his comprehension of the Establishing Dao Realm.
He had been targeted by Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's actions and had noticed that they seemed to be luring him somewhere. However, Xu Yan had no intention of paying attention and simply killed them.
"Since Fifth Junior Brother is also not very familiar with the Azure Sea Sphere, I will have to investigate on Yuntian Island once I arrive there," thought Xu Yan as he walked towards the Realm Gate, while communicating.
"Second Senior Brother, you said Princess of the Da Yan Realm is practicing a certain icy Cultivation Technique and ran into some problems? The cold has invaded her Divine Soul, making her cold as ice, and she wishes to engage in a spiritual union with vigorous men to dissolve the chill?
You traded a bottle of Divine Soul pill for some of her treasures? As long as it isn't a loss. But those pills, they can't cure her condition..." Meng Chong's voice came through the transmission, sharing news of the Da Yan Realm including the Princess's situation, and the factions of martial artists in the Spiritual Realm.
After ending the communication, Xu Yan also arrived in front of the Realm Gate.
"Azure Sea Sphere, here I come. How strong have you become, Brother Xie?" said Xu Yan as he stepped into the Realm Gate.
In the Azure Sea Sphere, Xu Yan emerged from the Realm Gate and looked up to see the Azure Sea, boundless and vast.
"Hmm?"
He then revealed a radiant smile.
"Nicely done! I thought Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow was nothing much, but this time they have brought so many strong individuals beyond my expectation. It's a pity there is no one above the Immortal Realm, and Tian Shiqi himself did not take action," Xu Yan was somewhat disappointed.
```
He walked into the Azure Sea unfazed and fearless.
"Come at me, why bother with such secrecy?"
Whoosh!
Twenty silhouettes emerged, their auras stirring heaven and earth, and divine artifacts burst into light all around, connecting with each other, forming a giant net that covered the area where Xu Yan stood.
Boom!
At that moment, it seemed as if heaven and earth had solidified.
Twenty Immortal Heavenly Venerables' presences interlinked, their auras blending, jointly controlling that part of the world. Coupled with the confining divine artifacts, even a top Immortal Heavenly Venerable, once trapped, would perish right there and then.
"Xu Yan, surrender without a struggle,"
Said the leader coldly.
"With just you?"
Xu Yan let out a disdainful smile.
Hum!
Sword light emerged, the sword now clasped in his palm.
"I have always wanted to know, how many Immortal Heavenly Venerables my current strength can handle. Today seems like a good day to find out!"
The leader's eyes turned frosty as he said in a deep voice, "Attack, we must finish him within a quarter of an hour!"
"A quarter of an hour? That's more than enough!"
Xu Yan responded with a cold laugh.
With a single step, there came a thunderous boom, and the space in the previously solidified heaven and earth shook violently, as if a great dragon had broken free from its shackles, and the solidified world splintered apart.
In an instant, all the Immortal Heavenly Venerables were horrified.
"All out, kill him!"
Bellowed the leader.
Crash! Crash! Crash!
As Xu Yan moved, the giant net formed by divine artifacts started to crumble, and the solidifying power of heaven and earth dissipated.
Boom!
The waves of the Azure Sea surged wildly as a wave rolled towards him.
Xu Yan reached out and with a grasp said, "Azure Sea surging waves, become my sword!"
Boom!
The rolling waves suddenly transformed into a sword thousands of feet long, cutting through the sky and slashing down fiercely.
Around the Azure Sea, columns of water soared to the sky, turning into massive swords standing between heaven and earth, each emanating a fierce killing Sword Intent.
The Sword Intent of each massive sword was unique yet interwoven with the others.
Boom!
Even the small island behind Xu Yan, where the Realm Gate stood, turned into a massive sword at this moment, erected between heaven and earth.
The Azure Sea Sphere's Realm Gate now hung suspended over the sea.
The hearts of the group from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow sank.
What terrifying means was this, what Sword Dao?
Had Xu Yan become so terribly powerful?
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable from the Azure Sea Sphere, far away, was now completely stunned, feeling a numbness on his scalp and his heart trembling with fear.
Who exactly are Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow dealing with?
At this moment, all he could see from the sea where the Realm Gate stood were massive swords, exuding a powerful killing intent. Despite the vast distance, they still made his heart skip a beat.
"What Sword Dao is this?"
Too terrifying!
"A quarter of an hour? Will those lying in ambush be the ones dying within a quarter of an hour?"
Muttering to himself, the more he thought, the more terrified he became. Twenty Immortal Heavenly Venerables, could they really not withstand it?
Were the minds of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's Immortal Heavenly Venerables damaged? To attack such a terrifyingly powerful being, confident that a quarter of an hour would be sufficient?
Indeed, it was sufficient!
But it was they who would be annihilated within a quarter of an hour, not the other way around!
Thinking shocked thoughts, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Azure Sea Sphere now heard a clear voice spreading throughout.
"Today, I shall test on you my most recently comprehended Ten Directions Annihilation Sword!"
As the voice fell, within the sea where the Realm Gate was located, the interweaving swords flooded that piece of heaven and earth with light, the intent of annihilation surged in all directions, and even from afar, there was a sense of being in the midst of a great cataclysm, facing imminent destruction!
```

chapters.title: Chapter 866 - 452 completely annihilates, shocking all the powerhouses
chapters.content:
Above the Azure Sea, the rolling torrents had all transformed into sword light, with the skies above and the sea below, filled with surging sword tides, and the intent of killing and annihilation covering this entire domain.
Giant swords tumbled, the Azure Sea roared, and the colors of heaven and earth faded.
Even the Realm Gate was shaking now, as if at the next moment it would collapse under the impact of the Sword Array.
Gao Xueming's pupils shook with shock as he watched the great battle in the distant seas, his heart trembling. He had never thought that he, an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, would one day be shaken to the core by a battle!
What sort of terrifying Sword Dao was this!
He just stared blankly at the distant battle, at the giant swords rolling ceaselessly, as if crushing heaven and earth, the intent to kill causing the colors of the world to change.
The ten-thousand-mile Azure Sea seemed to be suppressed!
Apart from the tumultuous battlefield, the Azure Sea beyond seemed unable to muster even a single wave.
At some moment, the wind calmed and the waves stilled, everything returning to tranquility.
"Half a moment!"
Gao Xueming murmured to himself.
Half a moment, and the battle was over?
Twenty Immortal Heavenly Venerables, including one at the Perfection of Immortal Realm, and several in the late stages of the Immortal Realm, all fell!
They couldn't even last a moment?
At the location of the Realm Gate, the small island had long since vanished, only the Realm Gate itself was left hanging over the sea.
Xu Yan's expression was calm; a mere twenty Immortal Heavenly Venerables, even with one at the Perfection of Immortal Realm, were nothing much after all.
"Not far from the grand achievement in the Void-breaking Realm, Immortal Heavenly Venerables are nothing to me!"
At this moment, Xu Yan was already a top powerhouse in the Divine Realm.
This attempt of assassination by Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, for Xu Yan, was just a minor affair. It took less than half a moment for him to slay all his enemies.
"The Ten Directions Annihilation Sword is fierce and decisive; with this Sword Array, even if I encounter dozens of Immortal Heavenly Venerables attacking together, I won't be afraid!"
Xu Yan tested the Ten Directions Annihilation Sword that he had comprehended, and he was satisfied with the results.
With a single step, he vanished in an instant.
Gao Xueming saw a figure streaking through the distance, a handsome young man who, in the span of half a moment, had slain twenty Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
Suddenly, Gao Xueming's expression froze, his heart tensing up, as if he had lost all sense.
Merely a calm gaze, just a moment of eye contact, had Gao Xueming instantly tense up, his whole person becoming somewhat stupefied, daring not to make any moves.
Fearful that any carelessness might provoke a misunderstanding and earn him a fatal strike from the sword!
Once weak, he had faced powerful beings, not daring to breathe too heavily, feeling as insignificant as an ant.
Ever since he had broken through to the Immortal Realm, becoming one of the most revered powerhouses in the Divine Realm, he had never again felt the plight of his weaker days.
But that one glance from the youth made him feel as if he had returned to his weaker days, with that tension, trepidation, and the feeling of being as small as an ant.
The young man's look was handsome and extraordinary; he was either an ancient fiend or a monstrous genius!
Regardless of which, Gao Xueming knew neither were entities he could afford to provoke or offend.
Xu Yan glanced at Gao Xueming, noting the lack of malice or murderous intent, unrelated to the people of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, and thus he paid him no more attention and disappeared in a flash.
...
On Yuntian Island, most of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables from the Azure Sea Sphere, including those from the Sea Spirit Tribe, resided here.
The whereabouts of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables were mostly fixed, taking turns to guard the Heavenly Grotto and cloistered in meditation on the island, rarely would an Immortal Heavenly Venerable leave the island, to inspect the entirety of the Azure Sea Sphere.
But on this day, as usual Yuntian Island suddenly surged with the breath of many Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
All on the island were astounded and looked up.
"What happened?"
"Could it be, there's been major turmoil in the Heavenly Grotto again?"
Out of nowhere, all the Immortal Heavenly Venerables on the island erupted with powerful auras and soared into the skies, looking in a certain direction.
Such a grand deployment made the martial artists on the island first think of turmoil in the Heavenly Grotto, and it must be extremely significant to have aroused all the island's Immortal Heavenly Venerables into action.
"What exactly happened at the site of the Realm Gate?"
The Immortal Heavenly Venerables on Yuntian Island looked solemn and puzzled at this moment.
Just now, they had all sensed a powerful fluctuation of battle near the location of the Realm Gate, a battle of Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
And such fierce fluctuations seemed like a great battle involving dozens of Immortal Heavenly Venerables had erupted.
But how could that be!
It had been so many years since the Divine Realm witnessed such an intense battle of Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
"Let's go, head to the Realm Gate!"
One by one, the Immortal Heavenly Venerables quickly left, but four remained to guard Yuntian Island in case the absence left vulnerabilities for enemies to exploit.
The breath of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables stirred the Domain, sitting in vigil in all directions of Yuntian Island, preventing any enemy attacks.
In a small courtyard on Yuntian Island, Xie Tianheng looked up at the distant figure, his face filled with envy.
"So that's an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, too strong, I still have a long way to go!"
Xie Tianheng sighed wistfully.
To his side, Fu Tianhai's expression was somewhat unpleasant. After arriving in the Divine Realm, although he had diligently cultivated, to his chagrin, he found himself outpaced by his son-in-law Xie Tianheng—a matter quite distressing to him.
What made him even more uncomfortable was that rascal Xie Tianheng would, every now and then, offer to 'advise' him on cultivation, his demeanor unbearably arrogant!
After letting out his sigh, Xie Tianheng turned to look at his father-in-law, "Father-in-law, how far are you from the Truth Refinement Realm? You're a bit slow aren't you!"
Fu Tianhai snorted coldly and walked away with a dark face.

chapters.title: Chapter 867 - 452: Completely Killing Everyone, Shocking the Powerful Figures_2
chapters.content:
Xie Tianheng was instantly full of pride. During their time in the Spiritual Realm, this old man had been so arrogant and looked down on his son-in-law. Now he sees how formidable his son-in-law is, doesn't he?
"My strength is still lacking, even though I've broken through to the Truth Refinement Realm. But within the ranks of True King Heavenly Venerables, I am not considered top-notch,"
Xie Tianheng sighed a bit.
Even though his Sword Dao was powerful, he'd grasped Sword Intent and even cultivated a Sword Arts Divine Skill. Nevertheless, with all this, he barely compared to the combat power of a late-stage True King Heavenly Venerable.
To outsiders, he was already regarded as a strong figure among the True King Heavenly Venerables, and he had a bit of a reputation. Yet for the ever-ambitious Xie Tianheng, it still wasn't enough.
"The Immortal Heavenly Venerable realm is still too far off. I'm only at the early stage of the Truth Refinement Realm. I'm afraid it will take a hundred years before I can break through to the Immortal Heavenly Venerable,"
At this moment, Xie Tianheng thought of pills.
"If I had pills to aid me, the breakthrough would certainly come faster."
He was somewhat tempted. Should he make a trip back to the Qinghua state?
All of a sudden, a faint sound of a sword's cry rang out, and Xie Tianheng immediately felt elated.
"Has Feng'er made a breakthrough?"
Looking towards the source of the sword's cry, a beam of sword light flew out from a small courtyard in a secluded cultivation area, with a Physiognomy that was faintly visible. The Physiognomy was a torrential sword wave, with the intent to kill barely perceivable.
Immediately after, the Physiognomy disappeared, revealing Xie Lingfeng's figure.
Xie Lingfeng had finally broken through to the Physiognomy Realm.
"Feng'er, now that you've had a breakthrough, let's find a place and have a spar,"
Xie Tianheng spoke.
On Yuntian Island, or rather, the entire Azure Sea Sphere, the only one who met his standard in the Sword Dao was his own son, Xie Lingfeng.
In the entire Azure Sea Sphere, besides father and son, no one else could be considered a Sword Dao Martial Artist.
Xie Lingfeng glanced at his father and, after a moment of silence, said, "Dad, there's no need. You're no match for me!"
Xie Tianheng's face darkened.
"Do you really think your dad is like those worthless Sword Dao Martial Artists? Do you think you can defeat me just because I created three Divine Skills when I broke through to Divine Skills, and now with my breakthrough to the Physiognomy Realm, my strength has greatly increased. Dad, you should just give up, you're not my opponent."
Xie Lingfeng's mouth twitched a bit, his father was indeed a bit too arrogant, "Now, the Martial Arts I practice has completely transitioned to the Great Wilderness Martial Arts. How can you compete against me within the same realm?"
"In terms of grasping the Sword Dao, Sword Intent, and Divine Skills, you're no match for me!"
Xie Tianheng was at a loss for words, unable to speak.
...
The group of Immortal Heavenly Venerables from Yuntian Island rushed towards the Realm Gate, and before they could get close, they saw that the small island where the Realm Gate was located had vanished, with the gateway hanging over the sea.
The great battle was over!
Such a massive battle concluded in less than a quarter of an hour?
What exactly happened?
The powerhouses were all puzzled, and they immediately thought of Gao Xueming who had been stationed at the Realm Gate.
"Where's Gao Xueming?"
"Where is he?"
Suddenly, the powerhouses discovered Gao Xueming standing in a daze on a small island, as if scared by something.
And this is an Immortal Heavenly Venerable!
And on the island, those True King Heavenly Venerables who were sitting in at the Realm Gate were all unconscious, not waking up.
"Gao Xueming, what has happened?"
A powerful, ruddy-faced elder holding an Azure Staff spoke with a grave voice.
The elder was the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe, extremely powerful, and one of the strongest in the Azure Sea Sphere.
Gao Xueming took a deep breath, coming back to his senses, and looking at the group of Immortal Heavenly Venerables, he said solemnly, "A powerful being, one that must not be provoked, has come to the Azure Sea Sphere. So formidable that all the Immortal Realms in the Azure Sea Sphere united might not be a match for him!"
Upon hearing this, the powerhouses were all shocked.
"A powerhouse above the Immortal Realm? Impossible, such powerhouses seldom descend, and moreover, if such a being descended, we would surely know."
One of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables shook his head.
"It might not necessarily be from above the Immortal Realm, but his strength is indeed crushing that of the Immortal Realm,"
Gao Xueming sighed.
"Tell us, what happened?"
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe frowned and asked.
"It's a simple matter to explain..."
Gao Xueming briefly recounted the events.
However, he omitted the part about him willingly cooperating with the other party and ceding the Realm Gate. Instead, he portrayed it as if he had been forced to strike the True King Heavenly Venerables unconscious and retreat to this place.
All of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow people had been wiped out, and the one to whom he had owed a favor had also died. Now, with nobody left to prove the truth, wasn't it up to him to say whatever he wanted?
Even if the truth is revealed, what then?
He merely owed someone a debt of gratitude for saving his life, which he repaid, and that settled the matter, hardly a significant event.
After all, the person who was attacked was immensely powerful and killed all ambushing assailants in one fell swoop.
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe and others were utterly shocked after hearing this.
"Twenty Immortal Heavenly Venerables joined forces and were annihilated within half a quarter of an hour?"
All the strong figures appeared incredulous.
"That's right!"
Gao Xueming nodded.
"The opponent looked like a young man, and I even suspect that he is not old, not an old monster!"
He chuckled bitterly; just one glance from the opponent was enough to scare him stiff, unable to move the slightest bit!
"Are you sure they were twenty Immortal Heavenly Venerables?"
A powerful figure could not help but ask.
"Could there be any doubt?"
Gao Xueming spoke with a grave expression.
Everyone fell silent.
They all trembled slightly in their hearts; twenty Immortal Heavenly Venerables, who were experts in joint attacks and had used a Divine Artifact to solidify the Domain, were wiped out in less than a quarter of an hour?
"Let's go, check the battlefield!"
The Sea Spirit Tribe's Great Elder said in a deep voice.
Outside the Realm Gate in the offshore waters, the battle had already calmed. The small island had vanished without a trace, but as the mighty figures stood above the seascape where the battlefield had been, their faces involuntarily changed.
Traces of sharp, piercing energies still lingered between heaven and earth.
Being in their midst, one felt an impending sense of annihilation.
"What kind of technique is this!"
An Immortal Heavenly Venerable muttered in shock.
Even with their Immortal Realm strength, they felt a sense of annihilation. If a Martial Artist of the Divine Refinement Realm were to step into this battlefield, they would probably be killed instantly by the remaining Qi!
Such terrifying intent to kill was not something these Immortal Heavenly Venerables could achieve!
Although the battlefield's murderous intent was slowly dissipating, the fact that it could linger for so long after the great battle ended, with such substantial lethal power, indicated that the person who made the move was beyond their capability to contend with.
Xu Yan had only used the Ten Directions Annihilation Sword and had not employed the Imperishable Sword Intent; otherwise, the Sword Intent here would not have disappeared and would have become a Holy Land for Sword Dao Martial Artists to comprehend.
"This person must not be provoked; I hope he bears no ill will,"
sighed the Sea Spirit Tribe's Great Elder.
He looked at Gao Xueming and said, "Since you have seen him, reveal his appearance so that we don't offend him by mistake!"
The rest of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables nodded in agreement.
They had to be extremely cautious with such a terrifying individual; they absolutely could not afford to offend him.
Gao Xueming gestured with his hand, and the power of the Domain converged, shaping an image of Xu Yan. Although it could only resemble seventy to eighty percent, it would be enough to recognize him and avoid offending him.
After memorizing his appearance, the powerful figures began to discuss how to handle the situation going forward.
The Sea Spirit Tribe's Great Elder reached out, and a small island in the distance was transferred to the base of the Realm Gate, placing the gateway back atop a small island.
After leaving one person to guard the Realm Gate, Gao Xueming and the rest returned to Yuntian Island. As for the slumbering True King Heavenly Venerables, they were awakened to continue their watch over the Realm Gate.
All these True King Heavenly Venerables were utterly baffled; how had the island of the Realm Gate changed after they slept?
However, they all understood in their hearts that something must have occurred; otherwise, why would they, the esteemed True King Heavenly Venerables, fall into a deep, unwakeable slumber?
But such matters were too profound, not something these weaker figures could comprehend.
Meanwhile, Xu Yan, after slaying the attackers of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, set off for Yuntian Island. However, as he was not familiar with the Azure Sea Sphere, his direction was somewhat off.
Sailing across the waves, Xu Yan took out a Flying Boat and navigated over the sea, sitting on the Flying Boat, gazing at the vast ocean.
"With Brother Xie's talent, he should be close to breaking through to the Physiognomy Realm, right?"
Xu Yan wondered inwardly.
Xie Lingfeng's talent was not lacking, and with the aid of pills to accelerate his cultivation, he should be close to breaking through to the Physiognomy Realm now.
"Once Brother Xie breaks through the Physiognomy Realm, he won't be considered weak even among True King Heavenly Venerables."
After assessing Xie Lingfeng's strength, Xu Yan had a good measure in his heart.
"I wonder how many Divine Skills Brother Xie has manifested?"
Xu Yan was curious.
"Eh?"
Suddenly, Xu Yan wore a look of surprise and looked towards a desolate island in the distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 868 - 453 The Tortoise Named Cang Hai, Comprehending the Establishing Dao Realm
chapters.content:
Xu Yan looked ahead at a desolate island with an expression of amazement on his face.
The island was moving slowly.
It seemed like a floating island, but it was completely barren without a single grass or tree.
The island was not small with a diameter of more than ten miles, floating and moving slowly on the sea.
The Azure Sea, with its myriad islands, refers to islands where the Human Clan martial arts forces reside, not that the Azure Sea Sphere has only ten thousand islands.
In the vast sea of the Azure Sea Sphere, no one knows exactly how many islands there are.
An island of ten miles in diameter is considered insignificant in the Azure Sea Sphere, just a small island that is easily overlooked.
What caught Xu Yan's attention was not the island itself, nor the fact that it moved, but that this island was, in fact, not a real island at all.
It was actually a huge black turtle in disguise.
Even though the giant turtle tried its best to conceal its aura and blend into the sea, disguising itself as an island, it still couldn't deceive Xu Yan.
"It's not a native turtle!"
Xu Yan immediately became interested.
The aura on this giant turtle was clearly not of a Divine Realm Spirit Beast or an Azure Sea Sphere sea creature, but a being from beyond this Domain.
He thought of some rumors about the Heavenly Grotto in the Azure Sea Sphere; creatures had escaped from the Heavenly Grotto and lurked in the vast sea. Every time the Immortal Heavenly Venerable patrolled the entire sphere, he would discover some hidden outsiders.
With the giant turtle's disguise, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable would absolutely not be able to detect it!
"This turtle is interesting, I wonder if it hides foreign artifacts!"
Xu Yan's eyes brightened.
He was quite interested in artifacts from beyond the sky.
After all, the Seven Wonders Divine Flower appeared to be a foreign artifact, and the Yu Zhu in his hand was also a treasure from beyond the sky.
The Seductive Witch was an entity from outside this Domain; naturally, her treasures couldn't be from within the Taicang Domain.
Thinking this, Xu Yan retracted his Flying Boat and soared into the sky, flying towards the giant turtle.
As soon as Xu Yan revealed himself, the originally slowly-moving giant turtle suddenly stopped moving.
Thud!
Xu Yan landed on the back of the giant turtle, causing the mud and rocks that camouflaged it as an island to burst and fly away, revealing a patch of dark black shell.
Thud, thud, thud!
Xu Yan lifted his foot and stomped on the shell, making a thudding sound, and even when he stepped down, a black halo would ripple out.
"Hey, this island is really strange!"
Xu Yan kept stomping while pretending to talk to himself.
The mud and rocks continued to fly off, exposing an ever-widening section of the turtle's back, the dark black shell seemingly containing some kind of profound pattern, thick and solid, absolutely impenetrable.
"This shell has such strong defenses!"
Xu Yan was secretly astonished.
His footsteps seemed casual, but the force of each could have easily trampled an ordinary Immortal Heavenly Venerable to death, yet the turtle shell was completely unscathed and unaffected.
Let alone cracks, there wasn't even much vibration felt in the entire shell.
Boom!
The sea water surged, and a turtle head popped out from beneath the water, turning back to look at Xu Yan on its back, "Stop stomping, if you keep it up, I'm going to die!"
This young man, clearly aware of its presence, was still putting on an act!
The giant turtle felt somewhat helpless; it had been careless not to notice someone so close, or else it would not have been exposed.
Xu Yan drew his sword and said, "Stomping definitely won't kill you, but I want to try if a sword can break your shell!"
"Young man, just say what you want directly. I really can't bear this kind of torment, and I have no ill will or hostility here, I've never hurt a person!"
The giant turtle said with a touch of headache.
"Since you're so straightforward, old Turtle Brother, then I won't be shy!"
Xu Yan said with a smile.
Meanwhile, he sized up the giant turtle, its strength in the Immortal Realm, and yet its true strength was probably stronger than that of an ordinary perfect Immortal Realm.
In fact, Xu Yan suspected that no Immortal Realm being could breach its defenses.
On the head of the giant turtle, there was a slab of blue scales with delicate lines resembling waves, and at a glance, it was as if one could see waves surging.
Xu Yan's intuition told him that this giant turtle was no ordinary creature.
"Lately, my martial arts cultivation has been difficult, and I've hit a bottleneck in my understanding. I'm a bit tight on treasures right now; what do you say, Turtle Brother?"
Xu Yan said cheerfully.
The giant turtle, feeling very helpless, spat out a Storage Bag and said, "Young friend, take these things. This is my entire collection."
Xu Yan reached out to catch the Storage Bag in his palm, looked inside, and as he put it away, he said, "Old Turtle Brother, are you trying to brush off a beggar? Such a small collection of goods, and they're all common treasures in the Divine Realm, just gathered in the Azure Sea Sphere, which originally belong to the Divine Realm.
"You, an outsider, are occupying the treasures of the Divine Realm, which is already improper, and you dare to think you can brush off Xu Yan with these?"
Sword Intent surged around him, and instantly, giant swords rose from the sea waves, encircling the area, with even more giant swords suspended in midair, completely enveloping the giant turtle within.
The intent of desolate killing and slaughter churned between heaven and earth.
The giant turtle raised its head to look at the giant swords formed by the sea waves, its eyes revealing a look of shock.
"Young friend, let's talk this over nicely, just tell me, what do you want?"
The giant turtle said with a sigh.
"Let's talk, let's talk. I, Xu Yan, have quite an interest in treasures from beyond, I wonder what Turtle Brother..."
Xu Yan said with a grin.
The giant turtle fell silent for a moment, then said in a deep voice, "Young friend, I have an item that I can give you, but I need to make a trade with you. How about it?"
Xu Yan raised his eyebrows, "That depends on whether your item is worth it."

chapters.title: Chapter 869 - 453 The Tortoise Named Cang Hai, Comprehending the Establishing Dao Realm_2
chapters.content:
"You won't be disappointed, young friend."
The colossal turtle spoke, opened its mouth, and exhaled a small turtle shell. The shell was of a pale azure color, shrouded in a faint luminescence. Although it did not reveal a powerful aura, Xu Yan instantly recognized the extraordinariness of this shell.
Inside the shell, it seemed as if it contained its own universe.
"This is the Prime Tortoise Carapace, a chance acquisition of mine, and it can be considered a supreme treasure. What do you think, young friend?"
The colossal turtle said in a deep voice.
"Indeed, this Prime Tortoise Carapace is extraordinary."
Xu Yan nodded, indicating his approval.
"Speak then, what kind of deal do you want?"
The colossal turtle said in a deep voice, "My deal is simple. When you, young friend, become powerful, help me capture a cluster of Domain Rhythms!"
Xu Yan raised an eyebrow. Capture a cluster of Domain Rhythms?
To capture the Rhythms of Domain, as of now, he was not capable of doing so.
Unless he broke through to the Domain Realm, then it might be possible.
The Rhythms of Domain are profoundly mysterious, not as easy to capture as the rhythm of Dao principles. It involves the fundamental rhythms of the Way of Domain itself.
"The Rhythms of Domain are indeed precious, and capturing them is no easy feat."
Xu Yan did not immediately agree.
"This Prime Tortoise Carapace is much more valuable than a cluster of Domain Rhythms. It contains some mysterious power, even the way of the Prime Tortoise itself.
"However, after all, I am the one seeking your help, young friend. So, if one day you help me capture a cluster of Domain Rhythms, I will additionally bestow upon you a major secret. This secret holds a great opportunity, which of course, comes with certain risks," said the colossal turtle after pondering for a moment.
"What kind of great opportunity?"
Xu Yan was somewhat curious.
The great opportunity mentioned by the turtle must lie beyond the Domain, and it would be some time before he had the strength to explore it.
"An opportunity much greater than this Prime Tortoise Carapace, a truly great opportunity," said the colossal turtle in a deep voice.
"With such a great opportunity, why don't you seek it yourself?"
Xu Yan tapped on the turtle's back with his foot.
"I do not have the strength, and that place also fills me with dread... This matter is too profound. When you, young friend, are strong enough, I will naturally tell you all about it.
"Furthermore, if you young friend can obtain this great opportunity, I will follow you for the rest of my life," the colossal turtle said with a sigh.
Xu Yan's brow furrowed. The turtle was not lying; when it spoke of that opportunity, a flicker of fear unconsciously surfaced in the depths of its eyes.
"Alright, I agree!"
Xu Yan nodded after a moment of contemplation.
Since it was a great opportunity, he would seek it once he became powerful enough.
"In that case, thank you, young friend!"
The colossal turtle breathed a sigh of relief.
Xu Yan waved his hand, and the Prime Tortoise Carapace fell into his palm.
Without examining it closely, he put it away immediately, then asked, "Old turtle brother, how shall I address you?"
"Cang Hai," replied the colossal turtle after a moment of thought.
"Azure Sea Turtle?"
Xu Yan muttered to himself; he had never heard of this turtle before.
He then tossed a Communication Talisman to the Azure Sea Turtle, saying, "Keep this talisman. If I manage to capture the Rhythms of Domain, I will naturally contact you. If there are any questions, I will also use this to contact you."
The Azure Sea Turtle was taken aback, looking at the talisman, and asked, "How far can it transmit?"
"My junior brother said that within the Domain, communication is possible anywhere, though it hasn't been tested. But within the Divine Realm, communication is surely possible," Xu Yan replied.
Having said that, Xu Yan rose into the air and vanished into the Domain in an instant.
The Azure Sea Turtle stared at the talisman, somewhat dazed, murmuring to itself, "Since when did things like this exist in the Taicang Domain? Why do I feel that this person's Martial Arts do not belong to Taicang Martial Arts?
"Strange indeed, how can there be Martial Arts that aren't Taicang's in the Taicang Domain? Moreover, when it comes to Martial Arts, Taicang is supreme; no one would abandon the strong for the weak.
"No, his Martial Arts are stronger than Taicang Martial Arts!
"Has something changed in the Taicang Domain? Could it be that Taicang is not dead and has developed stronger Martial Arts?"
At this thought, the Azure Sea Turtle was startled, then shook its head, "Impossible, Taicang cannot be alive."
```
Looking up at the firmament, he sighed and his figure slowly vanished into the sea.
After leaving the Azure Sea Turtle behind, Xu Yan took out his flying boat and drifted on the sea, while sitting inside the flying boat, he took out the Prime Tortoise Carapace.
"Azure Sea Turtle, how powerful you must have once been!"
Xu Yan wondered curiously to himself.
He didn't directly attempt to seize it by force but made a trade with the Azure Sea Turtle instead, and one of the most important reasons was that the turtle, seemingly at the Immortal Realm, could potentially unleash an incredible level of strength in a life-or-death situation, impossible to estimate.
Of course, if that were the case, the Azure Sea Turtle would likely pay a heavy price, and perhaps never recover thereafter.
It was for this reason that the turtle wasn't willing to fall out with him.
Another factor was that the Azure Sea Turtle sensed Xu Yan's extraordinary potential. Considering him a monstrous talent of the domain, it decided to make a trade and foster a good relationship.
Xu Yan looked at the Prime Tortoise Carapace, his face full of pleasant surprise.
Inside the shell was a small space, akin to a mini-domain, filled with spiritual energy that absorbed the spiritual energy from around the domain, providing an area for martial artists to engage in dedicated cultivation.
"No wonder it couldn't be stored inside a storage ring."
Xu Yan was delighted, for the Prime Tortoise Carapace indeed was a supreme treasure.
"With its own mini-domain and self-contained rules, perhaps it's possible to contemplate the Establishing Dao Realm inside."
Thinking this, Xu Yan released a surge of Divine Origin Power, which poured into the Prime Tortoise Carapace, starting the process of bonding with it and nurturing it within his body.
As the Prime Tortoise Carapace was nurtured by the Divine Origin Power, its dense glow grew brighter, and on its back, patterns flashed like the flowing of Dao Principles.
The flying boat drifted on the vast ocean, and Xu Yan, immersed in the process of bonding and nurturing the Prime Tortoise Carapace, was unaware of where the boat might be drifting.
As time passed, finally Xu Yan's mind connected with the Prime Tortoise Carapace.
With just a thought, he could see the mini-domain inside the carapace.
"I finally did it!"
A joyful expression spread across Xu Yan's face.
With a single gesture, the luminescent mist around the Prime Tortoise Carapace intensified, and Xu Yan's figure instantly vanished from the spot, leaving only a small tortoise shell inside the flying boat.
"This is the space within the Prime Tortoise Carapace?"
Xu Yan looked up at his surroundings, his face showing shock.
Only upon truly entering the mini-domain within the Prime Tortoise Carapace did he deeply feel the marvel of this small domain.
The spiritual energy was thick, condensing into a light mist.
Moreover, because he had bonded with and nurtured the Prime Tortoise Carapace, Xu Yan could clearly feel that this small space had its own set of rules, akin to the Domain Dao Rule.
"This is like a small domain, and the Prime Tortoise Carapace itself forms Dao Principles, orchestrating this mini-domain..."
In that instant, Xu Yan's mind became clearer, and the Martial Arts Techniques of the Establishing Dao Realm appeared one by one.
"What kind of power did the Prime Tortoise possess in its lifetime?"
Xu Yan was astounded.
The shell contained its own mini-domain, with rules in motion—were these rules possibly the realizations from the Prime Tortoise's cultivation?
"The strength of the Azure Sea Turtle, probably isn't inferior to that of the Prime Tortoise."
Xu Yan clicked his tongue in amazement.
Yet such a powerful Azure Sea Turtle had been reduced to such a state—what kind of catastrophe had it encountered?
"Even such immense strength can fall, can be reduced to this. I'm only in the Void-breaking Realm; I must be even more careful and guard against arrogance and complacency!"
Xu Yan cautioned himself inwardly.
He then remembered the towering figure he saw when crossing the wilderness.
Was the owner of that towering figure still alive?
Or perhaps, has he also fallen?
What terrible adversary did he encounter?
"Only master is truly invincible!"
Xu Yan sighed inwardly.
"This place is perfect for contemplating the Establishing Dao Realm. Once I merge the Prime Tortoise Carapace into my Mountains and Rivers, it will help me understand the Establishing Dao Realm even better, and lay the foundation for my breakthrough into the Domain Realm."
Xu Yan sat cross-legged within the Prime Tortoise's domain, his Primordial Spirit sensing the rules of the domain, and began comprehending the Establishing Dao Realm.
With a thought, a Yu Zhu appeared and floated before him.
"Yu Zhu, Prime Tortoise's domain, with this as my aid, I should be able to understand the Establishing Dao Realm quickly, while also laying the groundwork for my breakthrough into the Domain Realm."
Xu Yan pondered silently.
A flying boat, drifting aimlessly in the sea, had long since diverged from any known route in the Azure Sea Sphere.
Inside the boat, there was only a small tortoise shell, and this shell, no longer radiating the misty luminescence, seemed to have grown a layer of moss, making it look like an ordinary tortoise shell, left behind after the death of the creature within.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 870 - 454 Undercurrents Surge, The Pawn's Edge
chapters.content:
The Azure Sea Sphere was as peaceful as always, with no ripples of disturbance; the many Immortal Heavenly Venerables on Yuntian Island, whose hearts had been suspended in worry, gradually relaxed.
The monstrous being who single-handedly slew twenty Immortal Heavenly Venerables might have just come to the Azure Sea Sphere for leisure, not to cause trouble.
As for Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, for the time being, there was no activity.
They neither sent powerful beings to investigate nor declared any retaliation; it was as if those who died were not their own.
This caused the Immortal Heavenly Venerables on Yuntian Island to wonder, could it be that Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow had turned cowardly?
Knew they couldn't contend with that person?
After these days of understanding, the Immortal Heavenly Venerables also learned who the person was that killed the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's powerhouses!
Sword God Xu Yan!
Apart from him, there was no second candidate.
Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow had always been targeting him, and Xu Yan was also attacking Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's people, eradicating many of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's branches, and had slain quite a number of Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
Looking across the Divine Realm, only another was on par with him, Heavenly God Meng Chong.
Of course, if one were to discuss combat achievements, Xu Yan was clearly stronger and more ferocious.
In a certain part of the Azure Sea Sphere, a blood-red colossal shadow flashed by, pausing outside an island, as a pair of faint, crimson eyes observed the people on the island.
After a good while, the blood-red eyes shifted towards another section of the sea.
There, was the location of a Heavenly Grotto.
"If I were to devour the Martial Artists on this island, then enter the Heavenly Grotto, could I escape?"
"No, I cannot let short-term greed ruin the great plan. Continue to lie low; the moment to act is not far off."
The huge blood-red shadow submerged into the depths of the sea and headed towards a certain location.
There, was the great Heavenly Grotto of the Azure Sea Sphere.
"As long as I take over this Heavenly Grotto, we will have a foothold within the Azure Sea Sphere, and the rest will be much easier to handle."
The blood-red shadow lurked outside that colossal Heavenly Grotto, hiding beneath the sea floor, concealing its form and quietly waiting for the right time to strike.
It was not long before two sea spirits patrolled past, failing to detect the powerful presence hidden under the sea.
...
In the Di Yun Realm, a massive Heavenly Grotto had further expanded.
Boom!
Inside the Heavenly Grotto, pink light flickered, and the voice of the Seductive Witch was heard.
"Didn't you agree to lure Xu Yan there?"
A strong being outside the Heavenly Grotto helplessly spoke, "According to Tian Shiqi's message, that Xu Yan isn't taking the bait and seems to have become cautious. My Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow personally launched an attack to capture him, only to fail.
"We lost more than twenty beings of the Immortal Realm, and we're only a step away from the plan. Predecessor, please wait a bit longer. We can't afford to create a disturbance now."
The Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow strong being felt quite helpless.
The Seductive Witch didn't know what had provoked her, insisting on capturing that Xu Yan.
The expansion of the Di Yun Realm's Heavenly Grotto continued, and the final step was near. If the Seductive Witch caused any disturbance and attracted the attention of mighty beings, all their efforts would be wasted.
"Hmph!"
The Seductive Witch snorted coldly and finally departed.
The strong being of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow breathed a sigh of relief.
The Dragon Mountain Realm was named for its dragon-like mountains.
There were also rumors that at the highest peak of Dragon Mountain Realm, one could sense the presence of True Dragon Qi if fortune favored them.
Some claimed that a True Dragon had once fallen here, and affected by the True Dragon Qi, the mountains took the shape of dragons.
Even the existence of True Dragon blood was rumored.
The many legends of the Dragon Mountain Realm were all related to True Dragons, and there's no doubt that the strongest realm of spirit beasts in the Divine Realm was the Dragon Mountain Realm. Powerful spirit beasts always liked to search for treasures related to True Dragons in the Dragon Mountain Realm.
The Dragon Abyss, situated at the True Dragon Peak of the Dragon Mountain Realm, was shaped like a real dragon, rumored to be the place where a true dragon had fallen. The current master of Dragon Abyss was a green Flood Dragon.
The green Flood Dragon was extremely powerful, one of the twelve kings of Spirit Beasts in the Divine Realm, residing in Dragon Abyss to find the chance of True Dragon fate and seize the opportunity to transform into a True Dragon.
One man and one tiger approached the True Dragon Peak.
"Tian Shiqi, you aren't thinking of having this king fight that long worm, are you? That long worm is not weak; fighting it will be exhausting. It could very well be the death of a tiger. You must compensate me well, or I'm not doing this!"
The Wind Spirit Tiger complained loudly.
Tian Shiqi's face under the mask was grim. This Wind Spirit Tiger was too much, dragging its feet and coming up with all sorts of excuses to demand treasures. It even threatened not to move if not given what it wanted!
All along the way, it had extorted countless treasures.
But, for the greater plan, Tian Shiqi had to bear with it.
"When you die, I'll keep your tiger skin to cover my chair!" Tian Shiqi thought viciously.
"Rest assured, I am not asking you to fight the green Flood Dragon, and moreover, it has already left this place."
Tian Shiqi said indifferently.
"The long worm left? How is this possible, wasn't it looking for the True Dragon fate here?"
The Wind Spirit Tiger was utterly shocked.
"If there were really a True Dragon fate, it would have found it long ago. The green Flood Dragon left because it was lured away by another treasure."
Tian Shiqi spoke calmly.
The Wind Spirit Tiger glanced at Tian Shiqi, understanding in its heart that the green Flood Dragon had been led away by someone from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
"Then what do you need me to do here?"
The Wind Spirit Tiger was full of surprise.
"To stimulate your bloodline. With your bloodline as the catalyst, we will draw out an object."
Tian Shiqi stopped above the Dragon Abyss and said.
"Related to my bloodline?"
The Wind Spirit Tiger was astonished.
"There's some association."
By this point, to gain the trust of the Wind Spirit Tiger and proceed with his own plan, Tian Shiqi had to reveal some information.
Of course, all this wasn't the truth, but it was indeed based on real events.

chapters.title: Chapter 871 - 454: Undercurrents Stir, The Pawn's Edge_2
chapters.content:
"Tell me, what's going on?"
The Wind Spirit Tiger immediately became interested.
For Spirit Beasts, the strength of their power is determined by the limit of their bloodline.
Each advancement in bloodline signifies an increase in strength, and once the limit of the bloodline is reached, further progress becomes impossible.
Human Clan martial artists can continuously enhance themselves through Martial Arts cultivation, theoretically having no limit, relying entirely on their talent and spiritual wisdom.
But this is not the case for Spirit Beasts, as their limit lies in the ancestral bloodline.
Reaching the ancestral bloodline means reaching the limit; a breakthrough is impossible.
Thus, the strength of a Spirit Beast's rank is related to the rank of its Spirit Beast ancestors; those with stronger ancestors possess naturally higher ranks.
The ancestors of the Spirit Beasts all originate from Outer Heavenly Spirits, and even they vary in strength.
The first Spirit Beasts are known as True Spirits, differentiated from the Outer Heavenly Spirits by the omission of "Outer."
True Spirits possess spiritual wisdom, understanding how to cultivate Offensive Arts or possess innate abilities.
Outer Heavenly Spirits, on the other hand, lack spiritual wisdom, indistinguishable from wild beasts, fighting and defending purely on instinct, unable to flexibly use their abilities.
The ultimate wish of all Spirit Beasts is to become a True Spirit!
Upon hearing it concerned his own bloodline, the Wind Spirit Tiger naturally became excited.
"Wind Spirit Tiger, you possess the bloodline of the True Spirit Heavenly Tiger, and although extremely diluted, there still exists a hint of it, and all tiger-type Spirit Beasts in the world are descendants of the Heavenly Tiger.
"You are the first tiger in the Divine Realm, your bloodline purer than any other tiger. You are here to stimulate that trace of Heavenly Tiger bloodline in your body and attract a certain treasure to descend," said Tian Shiqi casually.
The Wind Spirit Tiger didn't notice the change in Tian Shiqi's tone but widened its eyes and nodded vigorously, saying with joy, "I've always suspected that I might have the legendary Heavenly Tiger bloodline, and it turns out to be true."
"Of course, it's true. Awakening your bloodline also benefits you, freeing you from the shackles of your bloodline, allowing you to advance further. Therefore, this cooperation benefits both of us..."
Tian Shiqi glanced at the Wind Spirit Tiger and silently nodded. Since the Wind Spirit Tiger had not detected anything amiss, there was no need for force; it just needed to cooperate obediently.
By the time it realized there was a problem, it would be too late to escape.
Standing atop Dragon Abyss, Tian Shiqi half-truthfully explained the plan and the subsequent steps for collaboration to the Wind Spirit Tiger.
Meanwhile, he looked up to the Firmament.
He mumbled to himself, "In the Dragon Mountain Realm, whether a True Dragon has ever fallen is unknown, but soon, a True Dragon will fall."
...
Li Xuan, engrossed in his Martial Arts undertakings, looked up to the sky, then all around the Divine Realm, and muttered, "Undercurrents are surging, a big storm is coming."
He shook his head, not paying further mind and not intervening.
With several disciples making breakthroughs, he too gained much, with a consequent increase in strength. Especially Meng Chong and Xu Yan— one slayed numerous Immortal Heavenly Venerables, leading to significant feedback.
"I wonder when Xu Yan will be able to comprehend and grasp the Establishing Dao Realm," Li Xuan said expectantly.
Entering Establishing Dao, he would indeed be more confident.
With his Innate Great Dao Body and various Divine Skills, even the former Master of the Taicang Domain might not defeat him.
"Establishing Dao Realm isn't secure enough, having a foundation beyond the Establishing Dao Realm would give me even more confidence," Li Xuan thought as he continued his grand Martial Arts endeavors.
And so the Qinghua Sect thrived, changing day by day. With the successful setup and continuous strengthening of the Qinghua Great Formation, cultivation speeds increased and difficulties diminished.
More and more martial artists were breaking through to the Immortal Realm.
After all, with a long time of accumulation, there were many martial artists who had been honing themselves in the Truth Refinement Realm Perfection for a long time. Now that the Domain Lingji became more active and with the assistance of Pills aiding breakthroughs, almost every few days a new Immortal Realm Warrior emerged.
"At this rate, the Qinghua Sect will be filled with warriors of the Immortal Realm," Li Xuan sighed inwardly. In a short time, the strength of the Qinghua state had become incomparable to that of the past.
"It's just that most are at the early stages of the Immortal Realm and still need time to accumulate," he considered.
These concerns were not for Li Xuan to deal with.
Although he bore the title of Qinghua Taoist Ancestor, he did not focus on the affairs of the Qinghua Sect, which were for Sect Master Fang Hao to handle.
Formation, prohibition, artifact refining, and alchemy practitioners were becoming increasingly common, and the Qinghua Sect's Martial Arts system was gradually starting to change.
