The new genius recruits were all taught the Great Wilderness Martial Arts instead of the Taicang Martial Arts.
It was said that this was the method passed down by the Qinghua Taoist Ancestor.
"I haven't gone looking for Tian Zi for a long time, that guy must be getting impatient. Next time I see him, I must coax everything I need to know out of him."
Li Xuan thought smugly to himself, with the support of the Taoist Ancestor Halo, it was much easier to deceive Tian Zi.
"The Immortal Heavenly Venerables have increased in number, I should find the time to speak of the Dao again."
Li Xuan had made plans in his heart.
Speaking of the Dao again should also yield some gains, such as a more impressive Taoist Ancestor Halo.
"Your disciple Jiang Buping has slain an Immortal Heavenly Venerable with a single spear thrust, and your experience in Extreme Soul Martial Arts has increased."
Feedback from the Daoist Golden Book came in.
Jiang Buping had also begun to kill Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
"The discarded piece is rising."
Li Xuan looked up in a certain direction, revealing a smile.
Jiang Buping had begun to show his edge, and there would soon be one more formidable character in the Divine Realm.
And this individual was a discarded piece of the Taikun Jiang Clan.
Sure enough, half a month later, Cai Ling'er, full of interest, shared the latest news from the Divine Realm with him, which included Jiang Buping's exploits.
By now, the tale of Jiang Buping, the discarded member of the Taikun Clan, had spread throughout the Divine Realm.
Once a genius of his generation, who had been unexpectedly crippled and expelled by his own family, was now powerfully arising and naturally became the hottest topic in the Martial Arts Realm of the Divine Realm.
Many martial artists were waiting for the reaction of the Taikun Jiang Clan and the Yun Shang Sect.
Jiang Buping's brilliance shone through, and various signs suggested that his former incapacitation was the result of a covert plot. Now, in his resurgence, he was bound to demand an explanation from the Taikun Jiang Clan.
In the following period, the news about Xu Yan considerably decreased. Xu Yan gradually faded from sight, and no further messages about him slaying Immortal Heavenly Venerables came forth.
Meng Chong in the Da Yan Realm also had no significant movements; after all, the Wanbao Alliance was no longer pursuing him, or perhaps they were holding back a major move. During this period, the messages about Meng Chong slaying powerful beings also markedly decreased.
The eyes of the Divine Realm's Martial Arts Realm focused on Jiang Buping.
News kept updating, such as the Yun Shang Sect deploying three Immortal Heavenly Venerables to ambush Jiang Buping, all of whom were killed in the attempt!
For instance, the Jiang Clan sent an elder to Jiang Buping, claiming that the clan was willing to accept him again, raising his status within the clan to sit among the elders, and so on.
Jiang Buping flatly refused.
Eventually, that elder from the Jiang Clan was killed by a single spear thrust from Jiang Buping, leaving only his corpse to be returned to the Taikun Jiang Clan.
What exactly happened during the negotiation process was unknown to outsiders.
Without a doubt, Jiang Buping's actions were a provocation towards the Jiang Clan.
Moreover, as of now, many powerhouses had come to realize that Jiang Buping had cultivated an extremely powerful Divine Soul Secret Technique.
Not long after, a piece of news spread throughout the Divine Realm and instantly shook it!
Jiang Buping's initial fall into being a cripple was due to his Divine Soul being tainted with Imperishable Qi. Now, he had not only retained his Spiritual Wisdom but had become even stronger, cultivating a powerful Divine Soul Secret Technique.
Within this, there must be secrets and possibly fortunes hidden within the Domain, even opportunities!
As everyone knows, once tainted with Imperishable Qi, one inevitably loses their Spiritual Wisdom. Not to mention an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, even stronger beings cannot avoid it.
How strong one must be to resist the erosion of Imperishable Qi is beyond their knowledge.
Yet, Jiang Buping had broken this ancient common understanding, which left many powerhouses in shock and also gave rise to greed; if they could obtain such secrets, wouldn't it be a great opportunity?
A hunting operation aimed at Jiang Buping quietly unfolded with many powerful beings participating.
"Extreme Soul Martial Arts is, after all, a path of slaughter and ultimate pursuit. The Divine Soul techniques of Taicang Martial Artists are too weak. Immortal Realm Warriors finding it too difficult to hunt Jiang Buping... it's simply too difficult."
After learning this news, Li Xuan shook his head with a smile. Extreme Soul Martial Arts was a complete dimensional blow to Taicang Martial Artists; their defenses against Divine Souls were as fragile as paper-mache.
As long as they could not defend against the Divine Soul, no number of people would suffice to hunt Jiang Buping.
Moreover, Jiang Buping had already cultivated the Imperishable Divine Soul. There was no power in the Immortal Realm that could erase the Imperishable Divine Soul; if Jiang Buping wanted to escape, no one could stop him.
Extreme Soul Martial Arts was about to demonstrate its might on a grand scale.

chapters.title: Chapter 872 - 455: The Power of Extreme Soul, The Beginning of Slaughter
chapters.content:
Da Yan Realm, Meng Chong stayed in the Dongyang Martial Arts Academy, guiding Zi Yun in her cultivation and doing nothing much else.
With his fearsome reputation, ordinary powerhouses did not dare to strike up a conversation with him.
"Has the Wanbao Alliance chickened out?"
Meng Chong felt somewhat disappointed; it had been so long, and the Wanbao Alliance still hadn't come to seek revenge.
"Even Fifth Junior Brother has become famous in the Divine Realm," Meng Chong said.
Of the five siblings, only the third sister and fourth brother had yet to make a name for themselves in the Divine Realm.
However, in the Qinghua state, they were known to everyone, and they were the founders of the Qinghua Sect.
"Surely it won't be long before third sister and fourth brother become famous not just in the Divine Realm but throughout all of heaven and earth!"
Whether it was Fang Hao's Formation, Artifact Refining, or Su Lingxiu's Alchemy, it was destined to rock heaven and earth, altering the Martial Arts Realm.
Currently, Su Lingxiu and Fang Hao were merely managing their affairs in the Qinghua state, but once the Qinghua Sect made its presence known in the Divine Realm, it would undoubtedly shock countless powerhouses.
"Young Master Meng, the pills have been consumed. May I purchase some more?"
Zhou Qingshuang arrived, her expression as cool and aloof as ever.
Meng Chong glanced at her and said, "The problem with your Divine Soul must be addressed with a pill specifically designed for it. The pills I have, though effective, are insufficient for a complete cure. Taking more is of no use to you."
He also needed to keep some pills on hand for emergencies and couldn't possibly sell them all to Zhou Qingshuang.
"May I know where I might obtain such pills?"
Zhou Qingshuang asked with eager anticipation.
The pills truly worked miracles, far surpassing any Divine Medicine available in the Martial Arts Realm of the Divine Realm.
"My sister made them."
Meng Chong paused, then continued, "My sister has been quite busy lately. She doesn't like to be disturbed, so for now, I won't tell you where she is. When she has time to meet people, I will let you know."
Zhou Qingshuang's face showed disappointment, but she did not dare to insist.
"When my sister is free, she will surely be willing to see you. She is very interested in peculiar and complicated diseases," Meng Chong added.
He spoke the truth. When he had informed Su Lingxiu about Zhou Qingshuang's condition, Su Lingxiu had been very curious. She was simply too busy with the Domain Divine Furnace to care at the moment.
"Thank you very much!" Zhou Qingshuang expressed her gratitude.
"It's nothing," Meng Chong replied with a cheerful laugh.
Zi Yun, on the other hand, kept a wary eye on Zhou Qingshuang the whole time, looking at her as if watching a thief; Zhou Qingshuang remained cold and detached, showing no sign of embarrassment.
Presumably, she felt no embarrassment; otherwise, she wouldn't continue to chat idly with Meng Chong under the pretext of seeking advice on Martial Arts.
Zhou Qingshuang's attendant, an old woman, hurried over with an expression of having something to say but hesitating to speak.
"What is it? Just speak up. Young Master Meng isn't a stranger," said Zhou Qingshuang.
"As this concerns a secret of the Royal Family, I think Meng Chong and I should not hear it. After all, we are outsiders, so let's avoid this topic," Zi Yun said hastily, pulling Meng Chong to leave upon hearing this.
What not a stranger, this Princess has ulterior motives!
Zi Yun thought to herself.
Meng Chong, not one to gossip, had to excuse himself nonetheless when courtesy demanded it. He prepared to leave with Zi Yun.
Seeing the Princess's urging gaze, the old woman quickly spoke up: "Princess, the outcast of the Taikun Realm Jiang Clan, Jiang Buping, his Divine Soul has been tainted with Imperishable Qi. Not only has he not lost his mind, but his strength has also become incredibly powerful. I fear he might have a way to solve your troubles."
For the first time, a look of surprise crossed Zhou Qingshuang's usually composed face. As her emotions fluctuated, her Divine Spirit Soul Force also began to stir, and strands of icy breath faintly permeated the air.
Meng Chong, who had been about to leave, stopped in his tracks and turned to look.
"Are you saying that Jiang Buping's Divine Soul has been tainted with Imperishable Qi, and not only did he not lose his mind, but his power increased?" Zhou Qingshuang was astounded.
"Yes, Princess. This news has already spread throughout the Divine Realm. Moreover, some major forces are planning to join together to steal Jiang Buping's secret. Some have even approached Da Yan; this could be an opportunity for you, Princess," the old woman said earnestly.
"Tell me more about it," Zhou Qingshuang ordered after noticing Meng Chong's interest.
"Certainly, Princess!" the old woman began to relay Jiang Buping's story in detail, including his powerful Divine Soul Secret Technique and the major forces ready to band together to seize his secret.
"This is no ordinary matter. If we really want to resolve the issue with my Divine Soul, we can only go to him with valuable gifts, not coercion!" Zhou Qingshuang said, furrowing her brow.
"Princess, what do you mean?" the old woman inquired.
"If Jiang Buping possesses such strength, he will definitely not be overcome even by a coalition of the strong. And if he escapes, those forces who acted will wait for his retaliation," Zhou Qingshuang deduced after hearing Jiang Buping's story, thinking of Meng Chong and the Sword God Xu Yan. Could such formidable beings easily be slain?
Listening nearby, Meng Chong's eyes sparkled with a cold light. Some major forces in the Divine Realm were planning to target his Fifth Junior Brother?
This was courting death!
"Young Master Meng, what do you think?" Zhou Qingshuang turned to Meng Chong.
Unless Meng Chong was willing to take action, there was probably no hope.
Meng Chong scoffed, "A bunch of chickens and dogs also want to kill my junior brother? The Martial Arts my junior brother practices, Slaughter Spirit, regards the Divine Soul defense techniques of the Divine Realm as nothing but paper mache!"
Zhou Qingshuang and the old woman were left with expressions of shock.
Jiang Buping is Meng Chong's junior brother?

chapters.title: Chapter 873 - 455: The Power of the Extreme Soul, The Beginning of Slaughter_2
chapters.content:
And Xu Yan, the senior brother of Meng Chong, was one of the three fierce figures rising in the Divine Realm, a fellow disciple?
"So it is Young Master Meng's junior brother, no wonder he is so powerful,"
Zhou Qingshuang sighed.
Curiosity flashed in her eyes, "I heard that the pride of the Taikun Jiang Clan had been defeated before, how did he rise again? How can his Divine Soul, tainted with Imperishable Qi, recover?"
With curiosity in her heart, Zhou Qingshuang casually asked the question, not expecting Meng Chong to answer, as it involved secrets after all.
Yet Meng Chong just smiled and said, "Just mere Imperishable Qi. The Martial Arts that my master taught my junior brother directly integrated the Imperishable Qi into the transformation of the Divine Soul. You wish to obtain the solution from my junior brother, but that's impossible. You cannot practice it; only my junior sister can solve your problem."
Zhou Qingshuang and the elderly woman were shocked once again. Just who was Meng Chong's master, capable of solving the problem of Imperishable Qi?
How could they offend a disciple of such a powerful individual?
"Thank you for enlightening me, Young Master Meng. Qingshuang has urgent matters and must excuse herself for now,"
Zhou Qingshuang hurried away with the elderly woman.
She had to prevent Da Yan from getting involved; otherwise, the consequences would be unpredictable.
That fearsome Meng Chong was still in Da Yan, and if they went to encircle and kill his junior brother, would Meng Chong simply let it go?
Although Da Yan was strong, they also had to weigh the grave consequences should Meng Chong take action.
Meng Chong smiled, retrieved a Communication Talisman, and contacted Jiang Buping.
"Junior brother, do you need your senior brother to make a move?"
"Thanks, Second Senior Brother. My Extreme Soul Martial Arts is just perfect for showing its sharp edges this time. Even if I can't win, I can still escape,"
"Since that's the case, I will wait for you in the Taikun Realm!"
Meng Chong put away the Communication Talisman.
He had been in Da Yan for a while now, and it was about time to leave, continuing to travel the Divine Realm, waiting for the Wanbao Alliance to come seeking revenge.
"Meng Chong, are you leaving?"
Zi Yun looked reluctant.
"If you do not wish to stay in Da Yan, then go to the Qinghua state,"
Meng Chong said as he stroked her hair, "Go with Zhou Qingshuang. You have master's Jade Talisman, so you don't have to worry about safety."
"I understand!"
Zi Yun nodded.
...
"Jiang Tianming, Yun Yan'er, are you scared, thus spreading the news to the outside, hoping to remove me with the hands of the many strong ones in the Divine Realm?"
Jiang Buping listened to the discussions of the surrounding Martial Artists, all focusing on him. His Divine Soul had been tainted with Imperishable Qi, yet he did not lose his intellect, and had recovered even stronger.
The various powers of the Divine Realm and many strong beings were already tempted, wanting to seize this so-called secret.
Apart from Jiang Tianming and Yun Yan'er, no one else would have spread this news.
As for the Taikun Jiang Clan, they would rather keep the secret to themselves than leak it out.
"Let's see how many who know nothing of death come to me seeking some secret technique,"
Jiang Buping sneered coldly.
He crossed the Realm Gate and left, heading towards the next realm, his destination, the Taikun Realm!
Realm by realm, he traveled until he finally arrived at the Taikun Realm to get an explanation.
As for Jiang Tianming and Yun Yan'er, whether they would escape or not, Jiang Buping was not concerned; the Divine Realm was so vast, where could they flee to?
With his strength breakthrough, Immortal Heavenly Venerables seemed almost like chickens and dogs in Jiang Buping's eyes, even if they had practiced Divine Soul Defense Techniques, they were no match for him.
For a Taicang Martial Artist, Extreme Soul Martial Arts had an absolute advantage like dimensionality reduction within the same realm.
Since the Divine Soul is hard to harm and defend, once one specializes in Slaughtering the Soul with Taicang Martial Arts, the defense against Divine Soul is nearly powerless.
"Jiang Buping?"
As Jiang Buping stepped out of the Realm Gate, he saw several powerful figures standing in all directions, their auras intertwining, the Domain being controlled, with a formidable pressure sealing off the area.
Each was a top Immortal Heavenly Venerable and carried Divine Artifacts to defend the Divine Soul.
"We won't make it hard for you. Just pass us a copy of the technique unaffected by the Imperishable Qi, and we will promise to root for you when you go to the Taikun Realm to demand an explanation one day!"
One Immortal Heavenly Venerable spoke in a deep voice.
Jiang Buping showed a disdainful smile, "Are you worthy?"
"Jiang Buping, your Divine Soul Secret Technique may be strong, but don't you think that by yourself, you can withstand several of us? We have also practiced Divine Soul Secret Techniques and have Divine Artifacts to protect our souls. Even if our Divine Soul Techniques are not as strong as yours, it is absolutely impossible for you to defeat us!"
Boom!
The auras of several Immortal Heavenly Venerables exploded, a faint glow surrounding their heads, defending their Divine Souls from attack.
"You chickens and dogs also dare to threaten me?"
Jiang Buping's expression was cold, the Extreme Soul Divine Spear in his hand.
"Mere Immortal Heavenly Venerables, you dare to encircle and kill me; who gave you the courage? Today, I will let all of you know, what I, Jiang Buping, cultivated is not some Divine Soul Secret Technique, it's the Extreme Soul Martial Arts!"
At that moment, an extreme intent to slaughter emerged from Jiang Buping.
The long spear in his hand radiated a sharp coldness, yet this edge targeted only the divine soul, the consciousness.
In the distance, several Immortal Heavenly Venerables and numerous True King Heavenly Venerables were observing the battle.
The news that several top Immortal Heavenly Venerables had surrounded and were attacking Jiang Buping had already spread; thus, there were many powerful beings present to witness the fight.
"So strong!"
As Jiang Buping revealed his edge, even though they were afar, those True King Heavenly Venerables felt a chill in their divine souls the moment they saw that long spear.
"Extreme Soul Martial Arts? What cultivation technique is this, and why have I never heard of it?"
"Could this be the reason Jiang Buping is unaffected by the Imperishable Qi?"
The observing Immortal Heavenly Venerables looked extremely solemn at this moment.
The sharpness revealed by Jiang Buping at this moment gave them a feeling as if a single thrust from his spear could annihilate their divine souls!
"Stubborn fools!"
The several top Immortal Heavenly Venerables who were attempting to slay Jiang Buping also looked tense, sensing a strong feeling of crisis and daring not to be the slightest bit careless.
Boom!
With a wave of his hand, the Domain shone with dazzling light, and a burst of sharpness appeared out of nowhere in the sky, radiating a cold aura.
"Jiang Buping, let's see how you fend off this strike from us!"
This surge of sharpness was a Divine Soul offensive art jointly launched by several Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
"A trifling skill of no consequence!"
Jiang Buping looked upon it with disdain, pointing his long spear which then burst forth with stellar radiance.
Hum!
Divine Skills, Star Extinguish!
And that burst of sharpness in the sky also shot forth immediately, piercing into Jiang Buping's body.
The several Immortal Heavenly Venerables who had attacked showed expressions of joy. Could Jiang Buping really not withstand their strike?
"No good!"
However, dread filled the eyes of one of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables, and he burst forth with a blinding light. Layers of glowing shields enveloped him.
A small mirror-like Divine Artifact floated on the center of his brow.
Divine Soul Defense Artifact.
In that instant, he saw points of starlight appear, giving his divine soul a feeling of annihilation. In a panic, he desperately activated the defense artifact while also employing a Divine Soul secret technique.
"Quick, assist me!"
The rest of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables, their faces changing dramatically, also took action. Pouring out their strength, they reinforced the defenses of that Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
Crack!
The mirror on the forehead shattered, a long spear radiating starlight pierced through as if from the void, breaking through the consecutive defenses and stabbing into the adversary's divine soul.
Hum!
The spear's light bloomed, tearing a huge hole in the divine soul, which rapidly spread. The divine soul dissolved in a brief period!
Ah!
A harrowing scream echoed through the Domain.
All who heard it were horrified by the agony that could elicit such a piercing shriek.
And the one who screamed turned out to be a top Immortal Heavenly Venerable!
All defenses, under that one thrust of the spear, were as if made of paper, utterly ineffectual!
Thud!
A corpse fell from the sky, its divine soul extinguished, leaving only an empty husk behind.
"How are you unscathed?"
The remaining attackers were now thoroughly shaken, staring at Jiang Buping in astonishment.
Their combined Divine Soul secret technique had clearly pierced Jiang Buping's body, so why had no injuries appeared on him?
"Your so-called Divine Soul Offensive Arts are nothing more than mosquito bites to me!"
Jiang Buping scoffed coldly.
"One down, now it's your turn!"
He looked towards one of the attackers and thrust his spear without hesitation.
Divine Skills, Slaying the Divine!
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable could only see a long spear with a sharp edge coming at his divine soul, an intense sense of impending death rising within him.
Roar!
He roared, utilizing a secret technique in his life-and-death crisis.
Essence blood burned as a layer of blood enveloped his divine soul, which at this moment became more powerful and foreboding.
The other attackers did not join forces to defend this time; instead, they frantically hurled their attacks at Jiang Buping!

chapters.title: Chapter 874 - 456: A Fearsome Reputation Spreads, The Transactions of the Wanbao Alliance
chapters.content:
Jiang Buping's figure vanished in an instant, leaving behind only a fearsome long spear with a sharp edge, bursting forth with terrifying cold light in the midst of the battlefield.
From a distance, the spectators could only hear the top Immortal Heavenly Venerables roaring in anger, bursting forth with formidable auras.
However, amidst this fierce battle, occasional shrill screams would rise, and a corpse would fall from the sky.
The battle had not lasted long when, with one final wretched scream, only one figure stood proudly in the air above the battlefield, holding a long spear, its sharpness unmatched.
The few Immortal Heavenly Venerables watching the battle trembled violently, their faces were extremely pale.
Among those who had launched the assassination attempt on Jiang Buping were their acquaintances, and some were even their elders. But now, all the attackers were dead.
It seemed like a one-sided slaughter.
Several top Immortal Heavenly Venerables had joined forces and used defensive Divine Artifacts, yet they were still so easily defeated.
The True King Heavenly Venerables were even more horrified, with cold sweat dripping from their foreheads, unaware of it, and did not even dare to move their bodies for fear of causing a misunderstanding and being killed by a single spear thrust.
They even feared that Jiang Buping, in a fit of rage, would kill all the spectators!
One man, one spear, a killing prowess unmatched!
At that moment, they thought of the other two, Xu Yan and Meng Chong.
Those two fierce individuals killed Immortal Heavenly Venerables as if they were swatting locusts, and now there was another one.
The forsaken child of Taikun, Jiang Buping!
How has the Divine Realm suddenly produced three such monsters?
The grand heroes of the past Great Realms were nothing compared to these three— not even worthy to carry their shoes!
Jiang Buping waved his hand, and all the corpses turned to flying ash and disappeared.
"Those who covet the so-called secret techniques of mine, Jiang Buping, will have to see if they have the fate to obtain them. I, Jiang Buping, await you!"
Jiang Buping said coldly.
"Jiang Tianming and Yun Yan'er, wait for me to ascend to the Taikun Realm. Whatever tricks you have, just bring them on!"
After speaking, Jiang Buping stepped away.
This assassination attempt was not the first, and it most certainly would not be the last.
As always, when Jiang Buping arrived in a realm, he would surely enter the Heavenly Grotto, either to collect Imperishable Qi or to temper his Extreme Soul Martial Arts, gathering various treasures.
The forsaken child of Taikun, Jiang Buping, gained a notorious reputation far and wide.
Within a Heavenly Grotto, Jiang Buping, alone with his spear, slaughtered Imperishable True Spirits and collected Imperishable Qi.
In just a few days, the powerful Imperishable True Spirits of this Heavenly Grotto were all killed by Jiang Buping, who cleaned out the grotto by himself.
Having cleared this grotto, Jiang Buping then moved on to the next one.
In a Witch Demon Heavenly Grotto, Jiang Buping killed the Witch Demon Incarnation and, after plundering the treasures, departed.
Outside the realm gate was an expanse of Domain, with chains crisscrossing and sealing off all directions, these chains were formed from the power of Domain Laws.
Behind each chain stood a figure, holding the chain, their energy merged with it.
Beyond the chains, there were layers of light forming barriers standing in all directions, with more figures standing behind each barrier.
Besides, there were sharp beams of light, shimmering in and out of sight, with various powerful Martial Arts energies interweaving.
This place had become a Deathmatch Battlefield!
In total, more than twenty Immortal Heavenly Venerables were each attending to their respective tasks, and behind the Immortal Heavenly Venerables were hundreds of True King Heavenly Venerable Peak Martial Artists.
Their strength and energy were integrated into the Domain Laws, strengthening the chains and fortifying the barriers of light.
In the center of the deathmatch zone stood a figure holding a long spear.
"Jiang Buping, I give you a chance, hand over the secret technique!"
With a cold gaze, Jiang Buping lifted his spear and sneered, "With just you? If it was a powerful Great Slaughter Formation you set up, I might have retreated, but with this rubbish technique, you delude yourselves into thinking you can stop me?"
"Jiang Buping, if you seek death, then we shall oblige!"
Boom!
The chains formed from the power of Domain Laws suddenly entwined from all around, attempting to bind Jiang Buping!
The layers of light forming barriers then shone brightly, a defensive measure against Jiang Buping's Divine Soul killing technique!
Hmph!
Jiang Buping snorted coldly, his figure suddenly dissolving and merging directly into the power of Domain Laws.
All the Immortal Heavenly Venerables were startled. What had happened?
Had Jiang Buping fallen?
"Retreat quickly!"
Suddenly, one of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables holding a chain shouted with a greatly changed expression.
But it was too late!
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable next to him was killed by a spear glow that sprung out from the chain!
Without even uttering a scream, his Divine Soul was completely extinguished!
At that moment, all the powerhouses were terribly alarmed.
Jiang Buping had merged into the power of Domain Laws?
"Quick, seal him, kill him!" shouted an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, furiously.
Boom!
The chains of Domain Laws suddenly vibrated, turning into a killing force.
All the Immortal Heavenly Venerables attacked frantically, pouring out their strength, trying to annihilate Jiang Buping within the Domain Law Chains.
Although they did not understand how Jiang Buping had managed to merge with the Domain Law Chains and remain unaffected, this was an opportunity to eradicate him!
Hum!
The power of Domain Laws, which was originally just chains, suddenly turned into intense killing intent.
Swish!

chapters.title: Chapter 875 - 456: A Fearsome Reputation Spreads, The Transactions of the Wanbao Alliance_2
chapters.content:
However, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable who had been killed, with his Divine Soul annihilated, suddenly attacked the Immortal Heavenly Venerable beside him.
"You?"
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable looked hugely surprised, subconsciously believing the other had betrayed them.
At that moment, within his Divine Spirit Soul Force, he saw a lance of light!
Pfft!
In his astonished gaze, his Divine Soul was completely obliterated.
And the body that made the move turned to ash and dissipated immediately after.
"What's going on?"
The rest of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables were immediately filled with panic and confusion.
Before they could understand what was happening, the just killed Immortal Heavenly Venerable suddenly surged up, attacking another Immortal Heavenly Venerable!
Pfft!
Another one was struck and annihilated in a single blow!
"It's Jiang Buping!"
At this moment, the surviving Immortal Heavenly Venerables finally realized in horror!
Jiang Buping had actually taken over the killed Immortal Heavenly Venerable's body!
How did he do that?
At this moment, everyone thought of the spear that had shot out from the Domain Law Chains, striking down their companion!
It was at that exact moment that Jiang Buping had taken over the other's body!
What kind of technique was this?
Could it be that Jiang Buping had no physical body?
Yet, no matter how you looked at it, Jiang Buping was not a mere Divine Soul form; if he had no physical body, only a Divine Soul left, where would he find the strength?
How could he cultivate strength, how could he survive on the brutal battlefield?
Boom!
As the remaining Immortal Heavenly Venerables looked on with terrified expressions, the Domain Law Chains appeared once more, sealing towards the Immortal Heavenly Venerable who had his body taken over.
Bang!
Suddenly, the body of that Immortal Heavenly Venerable turned to ash and dissipated!
Hum!
Yet the lance of light followed the Domain Law Chains, bursting forth.
Jiang Buping's figure appeared once again in the eyes of the crowd.
"With just you, you think you can trap me? You think you can kill me?"
Jiang Buping said with a cold smile, his spear piercing out, as he continued to unleash the Extreme Soul Martial Arts Divine Skill.
A moment ago, he had merged into the Domain Law Chains and ambushed the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, using the enemy's body as a cover to strike at the others, employing one of the Divine Skills of the Extreme Soul Martial Arts.
The battle continued.
This was a massacre, a horrific slaughter!
And in the distance from the great battle, two people watched silently, their expressions both excited and somewhat pained.
"So strong, it's worth it even if we have to spend a fortune on treasures for Jiang Buping!"
One of them said in a heavy voice.
"Let's choose him then, hopefully, he will agree!"
"He must be cultivating with a focus on his Divine Soul. That treasure should be able to move him."
"But that treasure, though related to the Divine Soul, cannot be melded or used. If he discovers this, will he agree?"
"Jiang Buping's Divine Soul techniques must be incredibly powerful, and he might be able to use that treasure. For a monster like him, no powerful treasure will be easily rejected, even if it's hard to utilize; he will try."
"Makes sense, let's settle on Jiang Buping."
After this exchange, they silently observed, waiting for the battle to end.
The battle had no suspense. Even though the attacker used many treasures and laid meticulous plans, even resorting to desperate secret techniques in the end, the outcome could not be changed.
Only when the last person, terrified, turned tail to flee and was eliminated with a single spear thrust, did the great battle come to an end.
All involved in the ambush were annihilated, vanished into smoke and ash!
Yet another great battle came to a close, and Jiang Buping's expression remained calm, but he knew this wouldn't be the last battle.
With the end of this battle, the attackers to come would surely be stronger, more prepared. Only by instilling terror in the hearts of many powerful figures, shattering spirits, and making any who covet fear, would this be over.
His journey towards the Taikun Realm was doomed to be a path paved with slaughter.
"Extreme Soul Martial Arts is, after all, a path of slaughter. Since that is so, let's hone ourselves in slaughter and grow stronger through it."
Jiang Buping's gaze was calm.
Looking up towards a certain area, his figure shifted and he vanished from the spot in an instant. The next moment, he had already made his way to the two Immortal Heavenly Venerables who were watching the battle.
"Jiang, my friend, please hold off on attacking. We mean no harm!"
The two powerful watchers were nearly breaking out in cold sweat, as they had not expected Jiang Buping to have discovered them.
"Oh, no ill intentions?"
Jiang Buping's eyebrows raised slightly.
"Since you have no ill intentions, you may leave."
Indeed, these two were merely onlookers and he had not detected any malice from them.
Since they were not enemies, he, Jiang Buping, was not one to engage in indiscriminate killing either.
"Friend Jiang, we have come here wishing to propose a trade with you. What do you think?"
One of them spoke up.
"A trade?"
Jiang Buping's expression turned cold; with a disdainful smile, he said, "Do you really think I possess any secret techniques? Extreme Soul Martial Arts is not something you people can cultivate."
"You misunderstand, friend. We have not come for the so-called secret techniques but for another trade."
"Not interested!"
Jiang Buping shook his head. Since they were not here to foolishly trade for so-called secret techniques, there was nothing else worth discussing. And if they were here for that, he would have killed them with a single strike!
"Hold on, my friend, please wait. The treasure involved in the trade will surely satisfy you," one of them pleaded.
Jiang Buping paused in his movements, turned his head to look, and with a smile said, "What treasure might satisfy me? Speak up, and tell me, who are you two exactly?"
"That can certainly be discussed!"
The two Immortal Heavenly Venerables sighed with relief.
The speaking one said, "Without hiding anything from you, we are elders of the Wanbao Alliance. I am Hong Yi, and this is Hong Er."
Elders of the Wanbao Alliance? Wasn't that the force opposing his second senior brother?
"So you are the elders of the Wanbao Alliance. In that case, tell me, what trade do you have in mind? With what treasure do you propose to trade?"
Jiang Buping had some guesses in mind already.
"This time, our Wanbao Alliance is willing to offer a treasured Divine Spirit Soul Artifact in exchange for your assistance for just one occasion," said Hong Yi solemnly.
"A Divine Spirit Soul Artifact? Ordinary Divine Soul artifacts hardly catch my eye."
Jiang Buping became even more certain of his guesses.
"I am of course aware of this, but this Divine Soul artifact is extremely special. Even with our Divine Spirit Soul Force, we cannot refine it. However, merely by cultivating near the Divine Soul artifact over a long period, one can augment their Divine Spirit Soul Force.
"This Divine Soul artifact was obtained after slaying an Outer Heavenly Spirit within the Heavenly Grotto. It is said to be the soul crystal of the Outer Heavenly Spirit, yet it does not contain Imperishable Qi..."
Hong Yi began to elaborate on the Divine Soul artifact.
On hearing this, Jiang Buping was immediately intrigued. Immortal Heavenly Venerables could not utilise it, but as an Extreme Soul Warrior, he could even cultivate with Imperishable Qi, so why not a Divine Soul artifact?
Furthermore, according to what Hong Yi had revealed, this Divine Soul artifact was quite unique, possessing characteristics similar to a special kind of metal. If he could refine it into his Extreme Soul Divine Weapon, it would likely enhance its power.
"...My friend, what do you think? Of course, in addition to this Divine Soul artifact, the Wanbao Alliance is also prepared to offer a batch of treasures and, should you have any conditions, you are welcome to put them forth."
Hong Yi asked somewhat nervously.
"The terms are decent, and the Divine Soul artifact does intrigue me, but who do you want me to deal with?" Jiang Buping pondered before asking.
Upon hearing this, Hong Yi was overjoyed and said, "Our Wanbao Alliance would like to ask for your help on just one occasion, to deal with Heavenly God Meng Chong!"
Jiang Buping's expression remained unchanged; his guess had been confirmed. The Wanbao Alliance had not sought revenge until now, obviously wary of his second senior brother's strength. Now that they had witnessed his power, they had made this decision.
However, the Wanbao Alliance did not know that Meng Chong was his second senior brother, and they were fellow disciples.
"Heavenly God Meng Chong is a powerful adversary indeed, a formidable opponent. Let me think it over."
Jiang Buping did not outright reject the offer immediately.
He took out his Communication Talisman to contact his second senior brother.
"Second Senior Brother, the Wanbao Alliance has approached me, requesting my help to take you on. They are willing to trade a Divine Spirit Soul Artifact..."
"Great news! Fifth Junior Brother, accept the offer. Get the Divine Spirit Soul Artifact first, and we'll talk later."
"But Second Senior Brother, if I agree to do it yet don't turn on them afterward, wouldn't that be somewhat..."
"That's a minor issue. When the time comes, we'll just have a little spar; you can agree to help but make no guarantee of victory. If someone is bringing treasures to our doorstep, why turn them down? After our spar, I'll use it as a pretext to extort something from the Wanbao Alliance. It's a win-win!"
Jiang Buping read the message on the Communication Talisman, picturing his second senior brother's rugged appearance, hardly able to believe that someone who looked so rough around the edges could be so cunning.
Pocketing the Communication Talisman and turning to the anxiously waiting Hong Yi and Hong Er, he said solemnly, "I can lend a hand, but I cannot guarantee victory. After all, you are well aware of a Heavenly God's reputation. I can only promise to do my best.
"Of course, the Divine Soul artifact must be delivered to me first. Perhaps it will enhance my strength a bit!"

chapters.title: Chapter 876 - 457: Crisis of the Azure Sea Sphere
chapters.content:
Hong Yi and Hong Er were overjoyed and eagerly nodded, "No problem, I will personally deliver the Divine Soul treasure to our young friend in three days!"
As long as Jiang Buping was willing to take action, after all, with the edge that Jiang Buping had shown, he seemed even more formidable than Heavenly God Meng Chong.
Even if he couldn't win, as long as he injured Meng Chong and weakened his strength, the opportunity for the Wanbao Alliance would emerge.
Two great powers clashing would inevitably lead to huge exhaustion.
And once exhausted, no matter how strong, they wouldn't be able to withstand the attacks of the masses.
That's precisely why Hong Yi agreed so readily.
"Alright, then it's settled. I've made it clear beforehand, I don't guarantee victory, I only promise I'll make one move," Jiang Buping emphasized.
"One move from our young friend is more than enough!"
Hong Yi replied with a smile and a nod.
"Then I shall wait for your Divine Soul treasure!"
Jiang Buping turned and left, stepping through the Realm Gate, entering the next realm.
As Jiang Buping's fame for slaying several Immortal Heavenly Venerables spread far and wide, a call for his persecution began to resonate in the Divine Realm. Rumors were spread that he was a ferocious individual who, if not killed, would bring chaos to the Divine Realm, among other accusations.
The momentum for Jiang Buping's persecution grew stronger, and obviously, there were major forces behind it, fueling the flames.
"Jiang Buping has been an unexpected delight," Tian Shiqi remarked with surprise upon hearing the reports in Dragon Mountain Realm.
"Very well, let's use Jiang Buping to further stir chaos in the Divine Realm," Tian Shiqi decided.
The agents of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow infiltrated within the major forces began to push this agenda forward. For a time, Jiang Buping almost became a villain that everyone wanted to kill.
Nevertheless, Jiang Buping remained unfazed by this.
Having acquired the Divine Soul treasure from the Wanbao Alliance, he began to use it. As for the matter of sparring with his second senior brother, there was no rush.
Upon reaching the Taikun Realm and meeting his second senior brother, a pretense would suffice.
There was not much the Wanbao Alliance could do but wait.
Jiang Buping's fame had spread throughout the Divine Realm. By now, no Immortal Heavenly Venerable dared to confront him in battle alone.
Despite this, Jiang Buping still faced numerous assassination attempts. Unable to confront him openly, enemies resorted to underhanded tactics.
Thus, wherever Jiang Buping went, he encountered various assassination attempts.
Jiang Buping made no secret of his intention to head to the Taikun Realm, continuously putting mental pressure on Jiang Tianming and Yun Yan'er.
Time passed, and the signs of turmoil within the Divine Realm grew increasingly evident, as though a hidden hand was pushing the situation forward.
Among the Thirty-six Realms, several had already erupted into major wars of conquest, and a number of Heavenly Grottoes had fallen, with creatures from the Netherworld, Witch Demons, and Outer Heavenly Spirits infiltrating into the Divine Realm.
Then one day, news spread that Heavenly God Meng Chong alone, with a single blade, had pacified two warring realms, slain several Xuezhi, Witch Demons, and Outer Heavenly Spirits who had invaded the Divine Realm.
He cut down dozens of Immortal Heavenly Venerables fueling the turmoil and, following his previous victories over the pursuers from the Wanbao Alliance, Meng Chong once again displayed his prowess.
Some well-informed powerful figures from major forces were anticipating a battle between Meng Chong and Jiang Buping.
What surprised many major forces was that the Da Yan Dynasty had no actions at all, neither against Jiang Buping nor any that involved Meng Chong or Jiang Buping.
They maintained an attitude of indifference.
The discord within the Divine Realm had long since spread to the Azure Sea Sphere; the Immortal Heavenly Venerables on Yuntian Island breathed a sigh of relief. Xu Yan had vanished without a trace upon entering the Azure Sea Sphere.
As long as he wasn't causing trouble, they weren't concerned about Xu Yan's intentions.
On the vast Azure Sea, a solitary boat drifted aimlessly, its location lost to the vastness of the ocean. Even sea creatures that leaped out, trying to land on the Flying Boat, triggered its Formation and were instantly obliterated.
Even a sea spirit who discovered the Flying Boat and coveted its beauty, thinking it ownerless, tried to claim it only to trigger the Formation and be killed on the spot.
The disappearance of an insignificant sea spirit in the vast ocean naturally went unnoticed.
The massive ocean had many rulers of the seas that vanished each year while patrolling the waters.
They either fell to stronger sea beasts or encountered hidden dangers.
In short, the disappearance of an insignificant sea spirit caused no ripples whatsoever.
Inside the Flying Boat, a tortoise shell seemed enveloped by moss, unremarkable and devoid of any mystical fluctuations or the aura of treasure.
Xu Yan had lost track of how long he had stayed in the small domain within the Prime Tortoise Carapace.
His Primordial Spirit's power surfaced, enveloping the small domain of the Prime Tortoise Carapace, delicately sorting through the rules contained within.
His understanding of Establishing Dao became clearer and clearer.
It seemed that he was only half a step away from full enlightenment in the Establishing Dao Realm, and he was about to take that half step.
The Yu Zhu exuded radiance in front of Xu Yan, its surface etched with intricate mystic patterns like the rules of the Domain, circulating as Spiritual Energy flowed into the Yu Zhu, adding to its mystical aura.
The turmoil in the Divine Realm did not concern Xu Yan, nor was he aware of Jiang Buping's predicaments.
At this moment, he was fully invested in comprehending the Establishing Dao Realm.
On Yuntian Island, Xie Lingfeng continued his arduous cultivation, delving into the Sword Dao.
The fame of Xu Yan and Meng Chong had already reached Yuntian Island.
"Worthy indeed are Brother Xu and Brother Meng," he remarked.

chapters.title: Chapter 877 - 457: Crisis in the Azure Sea Sphere_2
chapters.content:
Xie Lingfeng couldn't help but sigh.
Xu Yan quickly became famous in the Inner Domain after entering from the Border Wilderness, sweeping through undefeated.
Upon entering the Spiritual Realm, it was more of the same, rising swiftly and overwhelming all opponents, his reputation spreading throughout the Spiritual Realm, with no one able to rival him!
Now, after merely a few years in the Divine Realm, he has already become notoriously fierce, slaying the Immortal Heavenly Venerable as easily as swatting a grasshopper!
"I have a chance too!"
Xie Lingfeng's fighting spirit soared.
As long as he broke through to the Void-breaking Realm, with the might of his Sword Dao, slaying the Immortal Heavenly Venerable wouldn't be too difficult.
Admittedly, he couldn't do it as Xu Yan and Meng Chong did, killing the Immortal Heavenly Venerable as if squashing grasshoppers, but to kill the Immortal Heavenly Venerable shouldn't be too hard.
As long as he broke through to the Void-breaking Realm, even when facing top Immortal Heavenly Venerables, he could achieve victory.
The difficulty had indeed increased, but it was enough to make him proud.
If his strength were raised to the initial or full completion of the Void-breaking Realm, killing top Immortal Heavenly Venerables would become very easy.
"Void-breaking is too hard."
Xie Lingfeng sighed. It was already a rare feat that he managed to break through the Physiognomy Realm in such a short time.
Thinking about breaking through the Void-breaking Realm, it wasn't something that could be done in a short period.
"Twenty years or maybe thirty years?"
At his level of strength, two or three decades were considered short.
"Find an opportunity to return to the Qinghua state, consult Xu Yan, and perhaps I can break through sooner."
This was what Xie Lingfeng thought.
He continued his arduous cultivation.
Coming to the Azure Sea Sphere's Yuntian Island, his talent wasn't lacking, and with his outstanding swordsmanship, naturally, he also received some favorable treatment.
The Heavenly Grotto was relatively calm with no major disturbances. Apart from the occasional venture into the Heavenly Grotto for trials, most of his time was spent in secluded hard cultivation.
Xie Tianheng was also in hard cultivation, feeling somewhat gloomy in his heart as his son surpassed him, although he had anticipated it. But when the day came so quickly, all he could do to resolve his gloominess was immerse himself further in cultivation.
In hard cultivation, his sense of time was vague, to the point where he didn't even know how long he had been cultivating.
One day.
Boom!
The sound like thunderous waves echoed, and Yuntian Island trembled slightly. All the Martial Artists in secluded cultivation were startled back to reality.
"Something big has happened!"
At that moment, all those in secluded cultivation rushed out of their places of retreat.
Their first thought was that there might be chaos in the Heavenly Grotto!
Xie Lingfeng also tensed up and came out of his cultivation chamber.
"Dad, what's happened?"
Xie Tianheng looked tense and gazed into the distance without answering.
Xie Lingfeng followed his gaze and saw in the far-off sky, a blood-red surge that rose up like a huge funnel or a blood-colored vortex.
Even separated by a vast distance, they could still feel the terrifying aura.
"What is that?"
Everyone was shocked.
Suddenly, beneath the blood-colored vortex, as if it were a giant maw, a massive blood-colored shadow could be seen faintly moving through the waves.
"Not good, that's Little Heng Island!"
Suddenly, a Martial Artist exclaimed.
Little Heng Island was one of the large islands in the Azure Sea Sphere, adjacent to a Heavenly Grotto with an Immortal Heavenly Venerable stationed there.
Beneath that blood-red vortex was precisely where Little Heng Island was located.
Boom!
Powerful auras radiated from the direction of Little Heng Island, and immediately chains appeared in the sky, forged by the Power of Domain Laws.
Following closely, the voice of the Sea Spirit Tribe's Great Elder was heard!
"All Martial Artists above the Truth Refinement Realm, seal off a hundred thousand miles of sea territory, and kill the blood-colored sea beasts!"
As the Sea Spirit Tribe's Great Elder's voice sounded, Yuntian Island's Island Master descended from the sky, entering the Elder's Hall on Yuntian Island.
Immediately, a radiant light spread out, enveloping the entire Yuntian Island.
Boom!
Yuntian Island's Island Master, with the power of a Divine Artifact, took control of this part of the Domain.
"All Martial Artists above the Truth Refinement Realm, head to Little Heng Island to assist in suppression, no errors allowed!"
The grave voice of Yuntian Island's Island Master rang out.
In an instant, numerous Martial Artists flew towards Little Heng Island.
Yuntian Island's Island Master had returned to take charge of Yuntian Island, to prevent any accidents!
"Dad, let's go!"
Xie Lingfeng spoke with an extremely solemn expression.
"The Azure Sea Sphere is facing a great crisis!"
"It's also time for me to reveal my supreme Sword Dao!"
Xie Tianheng nodded and said.
"Be careful, don't take it lightly!"
Fu Yun cautioned with a worried face.
"No big deal, I have the Jade Talisman from my senior, I won't die!"
Xie Tianheng patted his chest and claimed.
Xie Lingfeng took a step forward, transforming into a streak of sword light, soaring towards the direction of Yuntian Island.
Yuntian Island had already vanished, and all the creatures on the island had perished.
But the Heavenly Grotto looked like a gaping blood basin, spewing out surging blood qi, turning the whole sea area as if into a blood sea.
And a blood-colored beast, large as a crocodile, opened its huge mouth, swallowing Yuntian Island, and within it could be seen an Immortal Heavenly Venerable being devoured.
Boom!
"Netherworld Blood Crocodile!"
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe's expression was extremely solemn.
At this moment, he realized that something was wrong.
This Heavenly Grotto was actually under control, and clearly, there was a being beyond the Immortal Realm who had acted, forcibly enlarging the Heavenly Grotto and allowing Netherworld Qi to seep in, wishing to turn this sea area into a Netherworld Blood Sea.
"A Netherworld Blood Crocodile lying hidden in Azure Sea, and we were completely unaware; how did it manage that?"
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe, together with a group of powerful Sea Spirit Tribe members, wielded their Divine Artifacts and summoned the power of the Azure Sea, pressing down continuously.
But the Netherworld Blood Crocodile could not be slain and even directed the Netherworld Qi towards the Firmament, shifting the Power of Domain Laws and causing turbulence within the Domain.
One after another, blood-colored figures surged out from the Heavenly Grotto, which resembled a huge gaping mouth, turning into a tide of beasts, rushing in all directions.
The blood sea was surging, and this sea area seemed to be polluted, making the Sea Spirits within this filthy sea extremely uncomfortable.
It was as if a person with an obsession for cleanliness was thrown into a pit of muddy water, feeling extremely unpleasant.
Swish!
A streak of sword light fell, instantly slaying a Netherworld beast.
"Without the Blood Disciples, the Xuezhi entering, all are Netherworld beasts; are they preparing to use the Netherworld beasts to invade the Azure Sea?"
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe had a heavy expression.
Rumble!
Another sound like thunder rang out, and the entire water of the Azure Sea trembled, causing the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe's heart to sink as another Heavenly Grotto started to stir.
"Silent and unnoticed, Yuntian Island has fallen, this Heavenly Grotto is being infringed, who is orchestrating this behind the scenes?"
At a certain moment, the image of Xu Yan, who entered the Azure Sea Sphere but disappeared without a trace, emerged in his mind.
He then shook his head, "It can't be Xu Yan."
The only course of action for now was to find a way to suppress the Netherworld Blood Crocodile back into the Heavenly Grotto and to wipe out all the Netherworld beasts that had invaded the Azure Sea.
However, the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe did not notice that as the Netherworld blood qi soared to the sky, it reached the Firmament. At the very top of the Firmament, there appeared to be a faint light as if it were absorbing the Netherworld blood qi, or perhaps signaling something.
Xie Lingfeng was hunting Netherworld beasts while also honing his Sword Dao.
At a certain moment, he looked up at the Firmament and his expression turned to one of shock.
Unbeknownst when, at the end of the blood light in the Firmament, there seemed to be an eye that had appeared.
However, when he focused his gaze again, the eye seemed to have disappeared, or perhaps the eye just now was simply an illusion formed by the murky blood light.
The Azure Sea began to churn with waves lifting high, shaking the entire ocean. Islands were swept over by the giant waves, and houses were destroyed by the tumultuous water.
Many Martial Artists rose into the air, guarding all sides, and even more attempted to hold back the giant waves outside the islands.
Rumble!
The Netherworld blood qi began to condense, turning into a pillar of blood light several zhang in diameter, shooting straight into the Firmament, as if erecting a pillar of blood between Heaven and Earth.
Faintly, the Domain Laws vibrated.
Even more mysterious and unfathomable Domain Power was being incited.
Crack!
At a certain moment, the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe looked up in confusion, not sure if it was an illusion, but he had just vaguely heard a cracking sound coming from somewhere in the Firmament.
"The Firmament can't possibly be cracking."
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe continued with a solemn expression, leading a group of Sea Spirit Tribe's Immortal Heavenly Venerables to jointly suppress the blood-colored giant crocodile.
The Blood Crocodile looked up at the Firmament, as if seeing something in its eyes.
"About time, this body of the Blood Crocodile is also approaching its bearing limit."
It then immediately looked towards a certain direction, where Yuntian Island was located.
"Using up the last bit of strength, let's destroy that island, and this place will become the gateway for Netherworld to enter Taicang."
A more powerful surge of blood light emerged from the body of the giant crocodile, and a powerful aura was about to burst forth.

chapters.title: Chapter 878 - 458: Netherworld Blood King, Your Slayer Sword God Xu Yan
chapters.content:
Above the great sea of the Azure Sea Sphere, a small boat pitched in the surging waves, a layer of radiant light emerged on the flying boat, formations, and prohibitions had been triggered.
"I have finally understood!"
Xu Yan, within the Prime Tortoise Carapace, had a smile on his face at this moment.
Establishing Dao Realm, he had understood it at this moment.
"To establish the Way of Domain, to establish one's own way, so that's how it is!"
"No wonder Master said, without entering the Establishing Dao Realm, one is not qualified to pass on the Dao, and only when one reaches the Establishing Dao Realm does one have the qualification to establish the Dao. Only by establishing one's own way, one's own Way of Domain, can one understand what Dao truly is, and only then is one qualified to transmit the Dao!"
At that moment, Xu Yan's aura surged, and nature's spiritual energy poured in wildly.
With the enlightenment of the Establishing Dao Realm, his strength also made a breakthrough.
Void-breaking Realm complete.
"My Mountain and River Dao Body is nearly at the point of Establishing Dao. For me, breaking through to the Domain Realm, breaking through to the Establishing Dao Realm, there is no bottleneck, no difficulty!"
Xu Yan revealed an excited smile.
For him, there would be no bottleneck in the Establishing Dao Realm.
He was a Taoist Body, Establishing Dao was not difficult!
"Now that I have understood the Establishing Dao Realm, it's time to find Brother Xie. I wonder how much time has passed during this closed-door contemplation."
With a flicker of his form, Xu Yan left the small world within the Prime Tortoise Carapace.
"Hmm?"
As soon as he came out, Xu Yan furrowed his brows. What had happened in the Azure Sea Sphere?
The waves surged, the breakers rolled, the flying boat pitched, and even the defensive formation and prohibitions had been passively triggered to keep the flying boat from being sunk.
Within the Prime Tortoise Carapace, Xu Yan had not sensed the commotion outside, and since the Prime Tortoise Carapace was unaffected by external fluctuations, he was unaware of the current situation in the Azure Sea Sphere.
Now, emerging from the Prime Tortoise Carapace and perceiving the rolling surges, he couldn't help but be astonished.
"The Heavenly Cave in chaos?"
Instantly, Xu Yan thought of the turbulence within the Azure Sea Sphere's Heavenly Cave.
With a thought, the Prime Tortoise Carapace merged into his body, nestled within the Mountain and River Myriad Manifestations inside him.
The Prime Tortoise Carapace, besides having a small world, was also a defense-oriented supreme treasure.
Of course, using the Prime Tortoise Carapace for defense was somewhat unsightly, like wearing a tortoise shell!
The terrifying waves rose dozens of feet high, the nature's spiritual energy became intense, and the Power of Domain Laws swirled in the space between heaven and earth.
Looking into the distance, a blood light shot straight into the firmament, like a blood-colored pillar.
"Netherworld invasion?"
Xu Yan's eyebrows shot up.
The situation in the Azure Sea Sphere was extremely turbulent, with even the Heaven and Earth Laws becoming restless due to the incursion of the Netherworld's aura.
"Why do I get the feeling that this is some kind of signal?"
Xu Yan frowned as he stared at the blood light in the distance.
"Since I've encountered it, then I might as well quell it."
That blood light was clearly from the Netherworld and gave him the impression that it was some kind of signal. Xu Yan couldn't help but think of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
Back in the Nine Mountain Realm, the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow had colluded with the Netherworld.
Therefore, for this great chaos in the Azure Sea Sphere, the blood light signal could also be related to the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
No matter what, since he had encountered it, Xu Yan would not stand by and watch.
With one step, his figure vanished on the spot, directly employing his Divine Skills to rush toward where the blood light was emanating from.
At this moment, that huge crocodile was radiating blood-colored light, leaping into the air, opening its vast jaws to spew forth a beam of Blood Refining light, sweeping in all directions.
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe and other powerhouses were on one hand resisting the Netherworld Blood Crocodile, and on the other, attempting to suppress the blood light gushing from the Heavenly Cave!
For a time, the situation appeared extremely passive.
Boom!
Just then, blood light bloomed within the cave, and a figure was making its way out.
A top-tier Xuezhi!
Bang!
As this Xuezhi entered the Azure Sea Sphere, the aura of this world became even more chaotic, the sea water turned thoroughly blood-red, bubbling as if boiling, with a scent of blood spreading all around.
"Not good!"
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe's expression changed.
"I will kill him!"
An Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Sea Spirit Tribe, wielding a Sea Trident, rode on the water to strike, heading straight for the Xuezhi.
"Sea Spirit?"
The Xuezhi licked his lips, revealing a sinister smile, "The taste of the Sea Spirit, it is said to be very good. Today, I shall have a taste!"
Swoosh!
Blood-red knife light surged from his body, accompanied by blood-colored flames that blazed fiercely. He stood before the entrance to the Heavenly Grotto, which was as crimson as Xue Yu, tides of blood energy flowing into his body.
With one slash, he parted the blood-red seawater, shattered the Sea Spirit's control over the domain, and the powerful Sea Spirit, with a changed expression, raised the trident to defend, only to be sent flying, spitting blood.
"Your strength has exceeded that of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable?"
The Sea Spirit powerhouse's expression changed greatly.
"It's just that you are too weak!"
The Xuezhi shook his head, mockingly said, "Since the Sea Spirit Emperor's disappearance, the Sea Spirit Tribe has been getting weaker and weaker, it seems that even the shackles of the Immortal Realm are too hard for you to break through!"
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe's expression darkened as he said coldly, "You cannot be a Xuezhi, who are you?"
A mere Xuezhi wouldn't know the Sea Spirit Tribe's secrets.
"I am Xuewang Li!"
Xuewang!
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe was shocked.
Ordinary Divine Realm Warriors may not know what Xuewang means, but as the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe, he knew many of the Sea Spirit Tribe's secrets passed down.
He had far more understanding of the Netherworld than other powerhouses.
Aside from Blood Disciples, Xuezhi, and Blood Spirits, in the Netherworld, there were also Xuewang!
Xuewang's strength was much greater than that of Blood Spirits, and in the whole Netherworld, there were only a handful addressed as Xuewang.
"Xuewang incarnation!"
At this moment, the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe's expression grew heavy.
This place's Heavenly Cave, although expanded, Xuewang's true form still could not descend here, and besides, Xuewang's strength was much greater than this.

chapters.title: Chapter 879 - 458: Netherworld Blood King, Your Slayer Sword God Xu Yan_2
chapters.content:
Xuewang Li arrived as an incarnation, yet the strength of this separate entity had surpassed even the upper limit of an Immortal Heavenly Venerable, further enhanced by his martial experience as the Xuewang, his power was undoubtedly stronger within the same realm.
The Azure Sea Sphere, unmatched!
It would require a combined effort of many to stand a chance, but at this moment, all the major Heavenly Grottos within the Azure Sea Sphere were in turmoil, unable to spare any powerful beings to surround and kill the incarnation of Xuewang Li.
The hearts of the Sea Spirit Tribe sank as they considered whether to abandon this sea area and the suppression of this Heavenly Grotto, to stabilize the situation within the Azure Sea Sphere, and wait for help from the Great Realm.
"Which Xuewang are you?"
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe suddenly felt a jolt in his heart and, looking towards the Netherworld Blood Crocodile, asked in a stern voice.
This Netherworld Blood Crocodile was clearly out of the ordinary, likely another Xuewang using its body to invade the Azure Sea Sphere.
"Xuewang Ju!"
The giant crocodile's cold eyes glanced at him as it spoke in a deep voice.
Boom!
Suddenly, Xuewang Ju soared into the sky, its colossal body resembling a terrifying monster, waves of blood rolling and a layer of horrific blood-colored flames erupting.
On the body of the giant crocodile, the image of a strong man with a ferocious face, clothed in blood armor, appeared.
"The Sea Spirit Tribe has indeed declined!"
The cold eyes of Xuewang Ju looked towards the sea area as it suddenly opened its massive jaws, ferociously pouncing on a location where the Sea Spirit Tribe was hunting Netherworld beasts.
"You dare!"
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe roared angrily, waving his staff; the mighty power of the great sea surged forth, causing his body to swell in an instant.
The Sea Spirit Body was fully revealed, and a curved blade of blue light, like the crescent moon in the sky, slashed towards Xuewang Ju!
Boom!
The body of Xuewang Ju, its tail lashing violently, released a sinister blade light that collided with the blue curved blade.
Crack!
The blue curved blade, under the attack, showed lines of fractures.
But this obstruction allowed the targeted Sea Spirits to escape frantically.
"Li, keep them busy. With this incarnation, I'll destroy that island!"
Xuewang Ju said with a sinister smile.
"Alright!"
Xuewang Li, who had just swallowed a Sea Spirit and was savoring the flavor, agreed.
Hum!
Blood-colored light transformed into chains, which instantly entwined around the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe and the other Immortal Heavenly Venerables.
"With this power of my incarnation, I can hold them for five breaths!"
Xuewang Li said with a laugh.
After all, it was only an incarnation with limited strength, so being able to hold these Sea Spirit Tribe Immortal Heavenly Venerables for five breaths was already the limit.
"That will suffice!"
Xuewang Ju nodded.
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe looked horrified; Xuewang Ju was going to destroy Yuntian Island?!
Yuntian Island had a certain significance within the Azure Sea Sphere, located within the Azure Sea. If destroyed, the Azure Sea Sphere would experience disturbances, especially the Heavenly Grottos closest to Yuntian Island, which would lose their suppression and expand continuously.
The master of Yuntian Island alone could not resist Xuewang Ju, especially since Xuewang Ju was seemingly ready to sacrifice this incarnation to destroy the island!
The giant crocodile skimmed across the sea at an incredible speed, swallowing any Sea Spirit that blocked its path.
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe growled lowly as the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Sea Spirit Tribe revealed their true Sea Spirit forms, ensconced in pale blue radiance, merging into the sea, engaging in a powerful secret technique to break free from Xuewang Li's binding!
"All, evacuate from this sea area, immediately!"
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe ordered aloud.
This sea area was lost; Yuntian Island was the paramount concern. Only by stabilizing the situation and waiting for reinforcements from the Great Realm could they repel the incarnation of Xuewang Li.
Xie Lingfeng, who was hunting Netherworld beasts to refine his Sword Dao, suddenly felt a shock in his heart. He saw a giant crocodile flying swiftly across the sea, rapidly approaching and devouring every Sea Spirit or Human Clan martial artist in its path.
The crocodile was headed towards Yuntian Island!
And the voice of the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe was already carrying from afar.
"This is bad!"
Startled, Xie Lingfeng's figure moved, readying to flee.
"Meet your end!"
The eyes of Xuewang Ju were icy cold. This human martial artist's mastery of the Sword Dao was extraordinary, surely a rare talent, and he decided to take care of him like a trivial matter!
"There's no escape!"
Xie Lingfeng's heart sank, but he did not panic.
Thanks to his mentor's life-saving jade charm, his life wasn't threatened.
Yet, he felt some shame for relying on his mentor's protection instead of his own strength to resolve the crisis.
If he couldn't escape, then he would fight with all his might!
His physiognomy settled, Sword Intent surged out. As Xie Lingfeng lifted his sword with both hands, layers of sword light appeared behind him, with waves of swords rushing like thousands of rivers, their roaring sound even overpowering the thunderous noise of the ocean.
At this moment, all the martial artists nearby turned to look.
"What is that?"
"Who has made this move? What Sword Dao is this?"
All the Martial Artists were shocked and immensely shaken in their astonishment.
They had never seen such Sword Dao before, yet, although it was strong, it was far from being able to withstand that giant crocodile!
Was a genius about to fall?!
Xie Tianheng looked up, stunned for a moment, feeling both reassured and somewhat helpless; he had been surpassed after all.
"In terms of Sword Dao, I may not necessarily lose, but it's Taicang Martial Arts that falls short!"
His heart sighed endlessly, the Great Wilderness Martial Arts were indeed much stronger than Taicang Martial Arts.
Hum!
Xie Lingfeng executed a sword strike.
This was his all-out effort, the vast sea parted with one strike, and the sharp sword light was aimed at the giant crocodile that was hurtling towards him.
"An ant trying to shake a tree!"
Xuewang Ju sneered coldly, the murderous intent in his eyes deepening.
He didn't even bother to defend, but collided head-on, the sword light shattering, and the giant crocodile, with its bloodied maw wide open.
Xie Lingfeng drew a deep breath, feeling somewhat powerless. His all-out sword strike was so easily disregarded.
"Power, still too weak. If Brother Xu faced this giant crocodile, perhaps one sword strike would have killed it, right?"
Thinking this, he was about to trigger the Jade Talisman; having to use the Jade Talisman meant naturally leveling the entire sea area in one go!
Hum!
At that moment, a black sword light descended from the sky, carrying the intent of annihilating everything in the Domain, stirring between heaven and earth.
This sword was aimed at the giant crocodile.
But at that moment, Xie Lingfeng felt as if the sword in his hand was somewhat beyond his control.
As if the sword in his hand was no longer his own!
Xuewang Ju roared, the entire body of the crocodile standing upright, its tail propped up on the sea surface, mouth wide open, spewing forth a powerful blood light.
The figure of Xuewang Ju appeared as a phantom on the body of the crocodile.
"Who is this?"
This sword was too world-shocking, and he could feel a strong crisis even before it had struck him.
"Sword God Xu Yan!"
A clear voice sounded.
Pfft!
Under one sword, the crocodile's body was cleaved open, gradually dissolving into ash!
"Xu Yan?! Very well, this king will remember you!"
Xuewang Ju said coldly.
"Hmph!"
Xu Yan snorted coldly, the sword light reverberated, and in an instant, the Divided Soul of Xuewang Ju was thoroughly annihilated!
"Brother Xu!"
Xie Lingfeng was extremely excited.
Indeed, Brother Xu was as invincible as ever.
One sword had slain the giant crocodile!
"Brother Xie, long time no see!"
Xu Yan, smiling, then looked towards the Heavenly Grotto ahead, where a lean man had entangled all the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Sea Spirit Tribe, and this sea area was almost turning into the Netherworld Sea.
"After I level this Heavenly Grotto, we shall catch up properly!"
"Yes!"
Xie Lingfeng was excited, his face full of anticipation.
Xu Yan stepped forward, and with a thunderous roar, the waves surged to the skies, forming a giant sword, the overwhelming waves like Sword Intent, sweeping out, turning the Netherworld beasts in the sea into ash in an instant.
The Martial Artists of the Azure Sea Sphere were all astonished. What terrifying power was this?
What Sword Dao is this?
Xu Yan once again executed the Ten Directions Annihilation Sword, instantly sweeping across the sea and descending upon the location of the Heavenly Grotto.
The Sea Spirit Tribe's Great Elders and others had pale faces, but were incredibly excited.
The Sword God has arrived; the Azure Sea Sphere is saved!
"Who are you?"
Xuewang Li's gaze was dark and fierce.
"I am the Netherworld Blood King. If you dare to meddle in this matter, you make an enemy of me, Xuewang Li!"
The Netherworld Blood King's infamous name was such that ordinary Supreme Experts would not dare to offend him.
"Remember this, your slayer is Sword God Xu Yan. If we're enemies, then you shall be reduced to dust!"
Xu Yan said with an indifferent look in his eyes.
Boom!
The Ten Directions Annihilation Sword arrived in an instant, covering the Heavenly Grotto and sweeping Xuewang Li within it.

chapters.title: Chapter 880 - 459 Dragon Abyss Jade Platform, Critical Point
chapters.content:
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe and others had already fled far away the moment Xu Yan made his move, fearing they might be affected.
At this moment, from a distance, they saw the terror of the Ten Directions Annihilation Sword. In an instant, Xuewang Li's avatar had perished, and the Heavenly Grotto had been flattened; that streak of blood light had already vanished.
They were shocked to their cores, recalling the aura left behind at the Realm Gate's location in the sea area, and only now, seeing it with their own eyes, did they understand how terrifying Xu Yan's sword could be.
What Gao Xueming had said was not an exaggeration, but rather insufficient to describe the might of this Sword Dao!
Sword God Xu Yan, truly unparalleled in the world!
With one sword, he had leveled a sea area, slain the avatar of Xuewang, and suppressed the Heavenly Grotto.
Moreover, the residual power of the Sword Dao was such that even the Immortal Heavenly Venerable would feel a sense of danger upon drawing near.
Boom!
All of a sudden, from a distant land, came a rumbling sound.
The facial expression of the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe changed; other great grottoes in the Azure Sea Sphere were in turmoil and threatened to fall at any moment.
He looked toward Xu Yan and, gritting his teeth, flew up to Xu Yan's side.
"I, the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe, beseech Sword God Young Master Xu, please help quell the crisis of the grottoes plaguing the Azure Sea Sphere. Our Sea Spirit Tribe is willing to open our treasure vault to Young Master Xu, allowing you to select any treasures you need!"
"I can choose any treasure?"
Xu Yan couldn't help but regard the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe with new respect.
"Yes, whatever treasures Young Master Xu needs!"
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe said solemnly.
He then added, "While our Sea Spirit Tribe may have declined, we still possess artifacts from Ancient Times that may catch Young Master Xu's eye."
Xu Yan couldn't help but think of Cai Ling'er, his master's maid, a member of the Sea Spirit Tribe with the Sea Spirit Emperor's Bloodline. Moreover, under his master's guidance, she had activated her bloodline and acquired the Sea Spirit Inheritance.
In the treasury of the Sea Spirit Tribe, containing artifacts from Ancient Times, perhaps there was something that would interest his master?
After all, with these Sea Spirit treasures, his master would also have suitable gifts for his maid.
"Master's realm is so high that almost nothing can catch his eye, but some small trinkets can still be used as rewards for others."
With this thought, Xu Yan nodded and said, "Agreed, I promise you!"
"Many thanks to Young Master Xu!"
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe was overjoyed.
For him, the decline of the Sea Spirit Tribe meant that those ancient objects might not be entirely beneficial for them.
With the turmoil in the Divine Realm and the situation being so unpredictable, it was only a matter of time before a powerful being would covet these items. Therefore, it was better to offer them to win over Xu Yan.
If a friendship could be forged, Xu Yan might lend a hand should the Sea Spirit Tribe face difficulties in the future.
With Xu Yan's might, as long as he stepped in, any crisis facing the Sea Spirit Tribe would surely be easily resolved.
"The crisis in the Azure Sea Sphere is yet to be resolved, what do you think, Young Master Xu?"
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe said, looking hopeful.
"Alright, I will go and pacify the troubled grottoes right now!"
Xu Yan nodded, communicated with Xie Lingfeng to meet again at Yuntian Island, and then disappeared in an instant with the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe, heading to the nearest tumultuous Heavenly Grotto.
"The crisis in the Azure Sea Sphere has been averted!"
Xie Tianheng came beside his son and let out a breath of relief.
So powerful!
After many years, Xu Yan's fame had spread throughout the Divine Realm, and now, seeing it for themselves, they finally understood the full extent of Xu Yan's strength.
To slay an Immortal Heavenly Venerable was as easy as swatting a fly.
"Let's return to Yuntian Island and wait for Brother Xu!"
Xie Lingfeng said joyfully.
The crisis in the Azure Sea Sphere had come suddenly but was also suppressed in a brief period.
The name of Sword God Xu Yan echoed throughout the Azure Sea Sphere. With his power alone, he had quelled the grotto turmoil, and after this event, it would be a long time before the Heavenly Grottoes of the Azure Sea Sphere could stir up trouble again.
On Yuntian Island, in a small courtyard, Xu Yan and Xie Lingfeng were reunited, while in a certain sea area of the Azure Sea Sphere, a one mile radius Heavenly Grotto mouth on the seabed was emitting a dark aura.
A giant turtle lay on top of the Heavenly Grotto mouth, completely covering it.
Thump, thump, thump!
Sounds of pounding came from within the grotto, but the giant turtle seemed unperturbed and instead raised its head to look at the firmament.
"Such a monstrous talent!"
The crisis in the Azure Sea Sphere had been so swiftly resolved.
"This child might be able to take that step, and with the Prime Tortoise Carapace I gave him, even if he encounters a crisis, he should be able to avoid it and not fall prematurely.
"If he can take that step one day, then I haven't misjudged him. With that opportunity obtained, he would certainly be able to put up a fight."
The Azure Sea Turtle's eyes were full of expectation.
"But can the Taicang Domain endure until he takes that step?"
Immediately afterward, the Azure Sea Turtle fell into deep thought once again.
Thump, thump!
Feeling the pounding from underneath the grotto, the Azure Sea Turtle moved its body slightly and poked its head into the grotto. After a while, it raised its head again and resumed its position above the grotto mouth.
"Those Imperishable True Spirits are still a bit weak, a bit too low in hierarchy; if one of those with a high-ranking bloodline could come in, devouring one would allow some recovery."
The Azure Sea Turtle looked somewhat helpless.
"This place is not too bad, I'll continue to hide out here. It's an easy life, occasionally eating a few Imperishable True Spirits. I won't wander around recklessly, lest some folks discover me. Given my current condition, it wouldn't be easy to deal with."
With injuries yet to heal and strength not even a fraction of its peak, the Azure Sea Turtle was indeed quite helpless.
"Hopefully, young Xu Yan can bring me some good news sooner rather than later."
The Azure Sea Turtle withdrew its head, its shell merging with the seabed mud. In a moment, this place turned into a small undersea hill, indistinguishable as the disguise of a giant turtle.
