chapters.title: Chapter 881 - 459 Dragon Abyss Jade Platform, Critical Point_2
chapters.content:
This is the ideal hiding place, the Azure Sea Turtle decided that unless Xu Yan absorbed the Rhythms of Domain to find it, it would no longer venture outside.
The current situation in the Divine Realm is unclear, and the Taicang Domain is at a particular juncture where the slightest carelessness in revealing oneself could easily bring disaster.
The crisis in the Azure Sea Sphere was resolved quickly, so the distress signals were never sent out. The outside world is unaware of the crisis that the Azure Sea Sphere had faced.
But some people, as if they had received a signal, began to take action.
On a mountain peak beside Dragon Abyss in the Dragon Mountain Realm, the Wind Spirit Tiger was sitting on a chair, dozing off while waiting for a message from Tian Shiqi.
At a certain moment, Tian Shiqi, who had been away for a while to make some arrangements, returned.
"Wind Spirit King, the time has come," Tian Shiqi said with a sigh.
"What should we do?" asked the Wind Spirit Tiger, instantly perking up.
Tian Shiqi raised his hand, and a Jade Platform rose from the depths of Dragon Abyss, engraved with certain patterns and shrouded in some sort of rhythm.
In the vagueness, one could even feel a chilling authority emanating from the Jade Platform.
"What is this?" exclaimed the Wind Spirit Tiger, surprised.
That chilling power felt all too familiar to it—it was tiger power and even stronger than its own. The bloodline of the Spirit Beast that left behind this power was higher in rank, and in terms of bloodline grade and strength, it surpassed the Wind Spirit Tiger.
"Heavenly Tiger residual power, it will help you activate your bloodline and break through your bloodline's shackles. Lie down on the Jade Platform and wait for the power of the Heavenly Tiger to stimulate your bloodline, fully activating your Heavenly Tiger bloodline," said Tian Shiqi calmly.
Glancing at the Jade Platform and then at Tian Shiqi, the Wind Spirit Tiger said with a serious tone, "Tian Shiqi, you have such good intentions helping me activate my bloodline? There won't be any deceit in this, will there?"
Tian Shiqi smiled, "Of course not, I'm not making you work for free. As I said, we're utilizing your Heavenly Tiger bloodline to summon the power of the Heavenly Tiger, attracting a certain treasure to descend.
"What I need is that treasure, and you can obtain a bloodline upgrade. It's a matter of each getting what we need, of course, you must not covet that treasure, otherwise!" When he reached this point, Tian Shiqi's gaze fixed on the tiger ominously.
The Wind Spirit Tiger immediately felt relieved on hearing this; the treasure must be extraordinary, which was why Tian Shiqi was willing to help it elevate its bloodline in exchange for attracting the treasure's descent.
This makes perfect sense!
"No problem, I, the Wind Spirit Tiger, am not a greedy creature," said the Wind Spirit Tiger, patting its chest with a paw.
"That's best!" Tian Shiqi nodded.
"Then off I go!" said the Wind Spirit Tiger, unable to wait any longer as it soared into the air, landing instantly on the Jade Platform above Dragon Abyss.
Boom!
Just as it landed on the Jade Platform, its aura couldn't help but burst forth, tiger power formidable, its massive tiger body standing on the Jade Platform, letting out an involuntary tiger roar!
Tian Shiqi revealed a smile, lifted a hand, and mist rose from Dragon Abyss, with white chains descending from the firmament.
"Wind Spirit Tiger, practice on the Jade Platform. When the time comes, the treasure will surely descend!" Tian Shiqi declared in a deep voice.
"Understood!" came the voice of the Wind Spirit Tiger.
At that moment, on the Jade Platform, the Wind Spirit Tiger's eyes widened as it saw a fist-sized brownish-red liquid inside the platform, which radiated chilling power.
In an instant, a deep desire for this liquid surged within its heart!
"Heavenly Tiger Essence Blood? And it's of the True Spirit Level!" exclaimed the Wind Spirit Tiger in delight.
This truly was a great opportunity!
It lay on the Jade Platform, inhaling and exhaling the tiger power, continuously stimulating its bloodline. As time passed, the Heavenly Tiger Essence Blood inside the platform slowly took on the shape of a tiger.
It was also rising to the surface as if it wanted to break free from the platform and enter into the tiger's body.
"What a great opportunity! By devouring this drop of essence blood, I can break the shackles of my bloodline and might even be able to advance to the True Spirit Level!" the Wind Spirit Tiger thought as it lay on the platform, constantly watching that drop of essence blood, continuously stimulating its own bloodline and power, oblivious to everything outside the platform.
It even failed to notice that it couldn't leave the Jade Platform anymore, nor could it see the true scenery outside the platform.
Above Dragon Abyss, the tiger's might grew ever stronger, to the point that the faint image of a colossal tiger seemed to emerge. The chains were tightening slowly, as if pulling something to descend.
Tian Shiqi silently watched. A streak of light shot across the sky, and a fist-sized command bird landed on his shoulder.
This was a message bird, and not an ordinary one. Its speed was incredibly fast, seemingly surpassing the level of spirit beasts.
However, even if such a bird reached the True Spirit level, it was only known for its speed and swift message delivery; its strength in other areas was not particularly notable.
It was purely a True Spirit with great speed, suitable for delivering messages.
"It's Xu Yan again!"
After reading the message, Tian Shiqi frowned slightly. The plan in the Azure Sea Sphere had failed because Xu Yan had intervened, nullifying all the crises.
He even killed the avatars of Xuewang Ju and Xuewang Li, effectively offending the two great Xuewangs of Netherworld to death.
"Netherworld failed themselves; they can't blame us for that."
Tian Shiqi smiled. Netherworld had done what it should have; as for their failure to secure a corner of the Azure Sea Sphere, that was their own problem.
After pondering a moment, Tian Shiqi left a message, and the message bird quickly departed.
"The arrival is imminent; the Earth Yuntian Heavenly Grotto must be prepared as well."
Tian Shiqi looked towards a certain place and snorted coldly, then suddenly vanished from the spot.
Outside Dragon Abyss, an Immortal Heavenly Venerable frowned, a look of astonishment and doubt in his eyes.
"What's going on with Dragon Abyss? This pressure is extremely strong, something seems amiss. What are those chains pulling at?"
The more he thought about it, the more alarmed he became.
Just as he was about to leave, suddenly a hand reached for him.
"Not good!"
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable's expression drastically changed, and he burst forth with all his might, unleashing his trump secret techniques.
However, the hand merely closed, and he was killed!
Tian Shiqi's figure emerged.
"The matters of Dragon Abyss must not be leaked. For the next period, I must preside over this place until the pulling is successful. As for the other tasks of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, they are not that important anymore."
His form disappeared into the clouds above, and he began his silent vigil. A few days later, an Immortal Realm spirit beast came to investigate Dragon Abyss and was killed with a single blow.
The Divine Realm was currently at a certain juncture, with unrest continuing.
The Heavenly Grotto became peaceful, with few disturbances occurring. Many of the powerhouses who originally presided over the Heavenly Grotto were now free to act.
All signs indicated that the situation in the Divine Realm was unusual, as if it were at a tipping point.
In Wind River Realm., Jiang Buping entered a Heavenly Grotto suffused with Imperishable Qi.
"Jiang Buping has entered the Heavenly Grotto!"
"Get ready to make your move. Success or failure depends on this."
Several Immortal Heavenly Venerables said in low voices.
"Yun Shang Sect's elders and Taikun Jiang Clan's patriarchs, we will share the secret techniques of Jiang Buping. You all have no objections, right?"
"No objections. Just incapacitate the man and let us take him back to Taikun Realm. If necessary, bringing back a corpse will also suffice."
"Then it's settled!"
Outside the Heavenly Cave Entrance, it was already emptied of people, and even the large city not far from the entrance had been abandoned.
Powerful figures emerged at the entrance, each conjuring up Divine Artifacts in their hands, tacitly setting up a blockade at the Heavenly Cave Entrance.
"Jiang Buping is going to be trapped in the Heavenly Grotto; he's been too careless!"
"Not careless, but too confident, thinking he's invincible in the world!"
"This time, Jiang Buping is surely doomed."
Martial Artists with access to information sighed and lamented.
"Should we give Jiang Buping a hand?"
Hong Er asked in a deep voice.
"No need. If Jiang Buping cannot overcome this obstacle, it means he lacks the strength to contend with Meng Chong."
Hong Yi shook his head.
Meng Chong was even more terrifying than expected, with a single man and blade piercing through two Realms, suppressing the unrest, storming into the Heavenly Grotto, and killing all the enemies from the Immortal Realm. He was incredibly ferocious.
Those who received the news watched silently, anticipating the upcoming world-shocking battle. Would Jiang Buping single-handedly sweep away numerous powerhouses, or would he fall at this hurdle?

chapters.title: Chapter 882 - 460 Taihe, Taikun, Taimiao
chapters.content:
Within the Heavenly Grotto, Jiang Buping seemed oblivious, as if unaware that he was being blocked inside, and was collecting Imperishable Qi.
"It's almost enough."
Looking at the collected Imperishable Qi, Jiang Buping continued his killing spree within the Heavenly Grotto.
"It's time to strengthen myself."
Jiang Buping sat down in a certain part of the Heavenly Grotto, the Array Plate flew out, and after setting up the Formation, he took out the Divine Soul secret treasure from the Wanbao Alliance.
"It just so happens to be perfect for refining into the Extreme Soul Divine Weapon."
As for the strong fighters outside the Heavenly Grotto, Jiang Buping was indifferent; this time, after his enhancement, he would fight his way out of the Heavenly Grotto, slay the besieging mighty warriors, and strike terror into the enemy's hearts.
"After this slaughter, it's time to head to the Taikun Realm."
Some scores need to be settled.
Jiang Buping silently thought to himself.
Three days later, Jiang Buping, holding the Extreme Soul Divine Weapon, stepped towards the entrance of the Heavenly Grotto, and a great battle erupted.
A single man with a spear made numerous strong fighters tremble in fear!
...
The Taihe Realm, the first and most powerful of the Divine Realm's Great Realms.
The Taihe Divine Sect, the foremost sect of the Divine Realm, has a long heritage and has existed ever since the emergence of the Divine Realm.
It dominated the Taihe Realm and, in times of great crisis within the Divine Realm, it emerged to mediate between all sides, to resist foreign enemies, and to protect the safety of the Divine Realm.
The path to break through the upper limit of the Immortal Realm also lies within the Taihe Realm.
The Taihe Realm contains the first Heavenly Grotto of the Divine Realm, which is the strongest and most dangerous grotto, housing Netherworld, Witches, Outer Heavenly Spirits, and other foreign enemies.
Inside the Taihe Divine Temple, a gathering of strong warriors from the Taihe Sect convened.
At the forefront of the Divine Temple, a faintly glowing figure sat in the main seat, its features unclear, and one couldn't discern its power.
At this moment, the Taihe Sect Master stood respectfully in the Divine Temple.
"Divine Envoy, the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow is causing chaos in the Divine Realm, and they've colluded with outside enemies; shall we gather forces from throughout the Divine Realm to annihilate the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow?" the Taihe Sect Master asked respectfully.
The figure on the main seat responded with a calm voice, "The Domain has reached a moment when change is necessary. Whatever the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow sets out to do, let them, but they must not succeed in bringing chaos to the Divine Realm.
"The Domain can be unified, but it must remain the Taicang Domain and not the domain of outsiders; this is a matter of principle.
"When necessary, the Heavenly Ladder will be opened, and naturally, someone will handle these matters."
The Taihe Sect Master respectfully inquired, "Divine Envoy, do we now stand by and watch the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow proceed?"
"The Domain must inevitably change. If the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow seeks to promote this change, then let them be, but whether they can reap benefits from their actions will depend on whether they have the capabilities.
"You need only open the Heavenly Ladder at the crucial moment," the Divine Envoy spoke calmly.
"Understood!"
The Taihe Sect Master respectfully nodded.
He then continued, "A strong warrior has emerged in the Divine Realm, slaying Immortal Realm Warriors like chicks; could there be other mighty figures at play?"
"Oh, slaying Immortal Realm warriors as handling chicks? Other than Heavenly Slaughter's people, are there warriors from the Heavenly Union Realm or Divine Venerate Realm descending, or someone else scheming?" the Divine Envoy exclaimed with some surprise.
"Reporting to the Divine Envoy, based on the information we have, they do not seem to be warriors from above the Immortal Realm, yet they are seemingly not of the Immortal Realm, as if the Martial Arts they practice are peculiarly powerful," a Taihe Sect elder spoke up.
"You're too weak to break through their disguises, which is why you mistakenly believe they are not above the Immortal Realm," the Divine Envoy dismissed.
"There are certain secret techniques that can conceal one's self and even disguise the aura of one's Martial Arts, leading to misunderstandings, and no one is better at these techniques than..."
The Divine Envoy suddenly paused, deciding not to continue.
The Taihe Sect Master and others, upon hearing this, came to an enlightened realization: so that was it.
If the Divine Envoy said it, it wouldn't be wrong.
Next, the Divine Envoy assigned some tasks and became briefed on the current situation in the Divine Realm.
"Divine Envoy, now that the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow has gone into hiding, and warriors from the Heavenly Union Realm or even the Divine Venerate Realm are in the Divine Realm, won't they pose a threat to us? What if they strike against our Sect, won't we be unable to resist?" the Taihe Sect Master expressed his concerns.
Warriors above the Immortal Realm should not appear in the Divine Realm.
Furthermore, warriors above the Immortal Realm would not remain in the Divine Realm anyway.
"Rest assured, Heavenly Slaughter would not dare, and moreover, if they truly make a move, simply open the Heavenly Ladder, and naturally, someone will eradicate them!" the Divine Envoy said nonchalantly, not seeing Heavenly Slaughter as a threat.
"Divine Envoy, can the Domain truly become unified?" the Taihe Sect Master couldn't help but ask.
"Whether it can be unified is not yet known, but the pattern of the Domain is ultimately due for change," the Divine Envoy finished speaking, and the faint light began to fade.
"Should anything unforeseen occur, open the Heavenly Ladder," the Divine Envoy said as his figure disappeared, leaving behind this final instruction.
"As you command!"
The Taihe Sect Master and others respectfully agreed.
With this visit from a Divided Soul of the Divine Envoy, some confusion had been resolved, and they now knew what the Taihe Sect was to do next.
"There should not be any Earth Shadow lurking in our Taihe Sect, but to ensure against any possibility, you all start taking action, keep an eye on the movements within the Divine Realm, and once any unexpected changes occur, open the Heavenly Ladder!" the Taihe Sect Master said to the gathered elders, speaking with a grave tone.
"Yes, Sect Master!"
The Taihe Sect began preparations for the upheaval in the Divine Realm and the impending changes of the Domain.
In the Taikun Realm, within the Jiang Clan.
Inside the Jiang Clan Ancestral Hall, the current clan head and several great elders stood respectfully within the main hall.
A faint light appeared on the ancestral statue where offerings were made, and at that moment, the statue's eyes opened, as though the sculpture had come to life.

chapters.title: Chapter 883 - 460 Taihe, Taikun, Taimiao_2
chapters.content:
"We welcome the Ancestor!"
The Jiang Clan Leader and the Great Elders, each of them kneeling on the ground.
A majestic voice came from the statue, "The Domain is about to undergo some changes, once the Heavenly Ladder appears, there will be people descending into the Divine Realm, prepare yourselves."
"Yes, Ancestor!"
The Jiang Clan Leader and others said, their expressions filled with excitement.
"Now, what is the current situation in the Divine Realm, report everything."
"Yes, Ancestor!"
The Jiang Clan Leader and the Great Elders began to recount the changes in the Divine Realm, including the turmoil and the machinations of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow behind the scenes.
In the end, the Jiang Clan Leader said, "Reporting to the Ancestor, our Jiang Family has a rebellious junior, named Jiang Buping, who once had his Divine Soul tainted by Imperishable Qi. For some unknown reason, he did not lose his mind and has since recovered. His strength is far superior to others in the same realm, for he slays Immortal Realm Warriors with ease..."
"Oh, is that so?"
The voice from the statue sounded slightly surprised, then continued, "In that case, there might be a Supreme Sovereign hidden in the Divine Realm who resolved the Imperishable Qi for him, but why target the offspring of our Jiang Clan?
"According to what you say, Jiang Buping is exceedingly talented and attracted attention, which is somewhat understandable. You should handle this matter on your own, and as for the Supreme Sovereign behind him..."
Pausing for a moment, the statue's voice continued, "Supreme Sovereigns should not be offended lightly. Once the Heavenly Ladder opens, there will naturally be someone to speak with them. Before that happens, weigh your actions carefully."
The Jiang Clan Leader and others showed a trace of alarm. Even the Ancestor did not wish to rashly offend this so-called Supreme Sovereign?
But it seemed not that they could not offend, but rather they should judge based on the situation.
"Yes, Ancestor!"
The Jiang Clan Leader and others said respectfully.
"Ancestor, what is a Supreme Sovereign?"
The Great Elder of the Jiang Clan couldn't help but ask.
"The Supreme Sovereign Realm of Martial Arts," the voice from the statue stated flatly.
Then, it added another sentence, "Above the Immortal Realm is Heavenly Union, and above that is Divine Venerate. The realm for Divine Venerates in Martial Arts is the Divine Venerate Realm, and above Divine Venerate Realm lies the Supreme Sovereign Realm."
The Jiang Clan Leader and others were profoundly shocked. They only knew that above the Immortal Realm was the Heavenly Union Realm, but the realms beyond that had been unknowable to them.
In the past, the Ancestors never spoke of this, instructing them to simply focus on their cultivation, and when the time came, they would ascend the Heavenly Ladder and leave the Divine Realm.
Today, the Ancestor had actually answered this question. It must be that the Domain was about to undergo significant changes for them to reveal the answer.
"Heavenly Union is easy to achieve, Divine Venerate is difficult to climb, and Supreme Sovereign is even rarer, one in tens of thousands. As for what is above a Supreme Sovereign, there is no need for you to know. The entire Domain can count them on one's fingers."
After the voice from the statue finished speaking, it said: "That will suffice, make your decisions carefully, do not act rashly!"
"Yes, Ancestor!"
The glow of the statue disappeared, and the opened eyes closed. The trace of consciousness that had descended was gone.
The Jiang Clan Leader and others exchanged glances, all wearing grave expressions; they realized they needed to be cautious in dealing with Jiang Buping.
"What was the result of the attempt to kill Jiang Buping?"
The Jiang Clan Leader regained the dignity of the leader of the clan and asked in a deep voice.
"No news has come back yet!"
The Great Elder shook his head.
Looking to the Clan Leader, he said solemnly, "Jiang Buping will surely come to the Taikun Realm to demand an explanation. Jiang Tianming is undoubtedly a marked man. Do you, Clan Leader, intend to use all the clan's power to protect Jiang Tianming?"
The other Elders, too, watched the Clan Leader in silence.
Jiang Tianming, the Clan Leader's third son, was greatly favored and exceedingly talented.
However, now Jiang Buping's displayed talent surpassed even that, and Jiang Buping was also this Clan Leader's son, albeit born of a concubine and originally not shown favor.
It was only because of his extraordinary talent that the Elders decided to bring him back to the family, offering him the treatment of a genius. Who knew Jiang Tianming along with Yun Yan'er would plot against Jiang Buping behind his back.
The Great Elder personally investigated and, finding Jiang Buping broken, said no more, allowing him to be expelled.
Now, the Taikun outcast had risen dramatically, humiliating the Jiang Clan. Countless powers and mighty beings throughout the Divine Realm were waiting to ridicule them.
The rumour that Jiang Buping had been tainted by Imperishable Qi yet came out unscathed was spread by Jiang Tianming and Yun Yan'er. Without the tacit approval or even encouragement of this Clan Leader, it would have been impossible to reach this point.
Furthermore, several Elders and experts from the Yun Shang Sect were involved in the attempted killing of Jiang Buping this time.
Clearly, Jiang Tianming was scared and sought outside forces, attempting to have Jiang Buping killed.
And the Clan Leader was obviously protecting Jiang Tianming, hence adopted an acquiescent attitude.
The Jiang Clan Leader looked at the Great Elder and others. Use all the clan's power to protect Jiang Tianming?
"We'll discuss it once there's an outcome to the battle."
The Jiang Clan Leader said indifferently.
"The Divine Realm is in chaos, and the Domain has undergone great changes. How can our Jiang Clan continue its legacy?" I hope the clan leader will think thrice!"
After the Great Elder spoke, he took large strides and left.
Within the Royal Family of the Da Yan Dynasty in the Da Yan Realm, the Emperor of Da Yan and several royal powerhouses were also awaiting instructions.
In the Taimiao Realm, within the Taimiao God Sect, an internal struggle had come to an end, with several elders of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm successively falling.
At this moment, in a small garden at the core of the back mountain of the Taimiao God Sect, several present-day sect leaders entered this small garden.
Xin Mengrou was also among this group of people.
With her strength, she normally did not qualify to enter here, but because the Cultivation Technique she practiced was so special, she held an extraordinary status and thus was exceptionally allowed to come here.
"This is?"
Upon seeing the colorful and enchanting small courtyard, Xin Mengrou's heart trembled.
For a moment, she couldn't distinguish whether this was real or illusion.
After entering the small courtyard and under the Sect Master's leadership, they came to the base of an elegant pavilion.
"Greetings to the Upper Sect's envoy!"
The Taimiao Sect Master bowed respectfully.
The elegant pavilion, whose doors had been tightly shut, opened.
Upon entering the pavilion, Xin Mengrou glanced around hurriedly and noticed that inside the pavilion, there was only one seated statue.
The statue of the pure white and unearthly beautiful woman seemed both real and imaginary, exuding an elusive yet tangibly existing strange sensation.
The Taimiao Sect Master was the first to prostrate himself before the statue.
Seeing this, Xin Mengrou also hastily bowed down.
The statue's eyes seemed to come alive, looking over, and for some reason, Xin Mengrou felt that the statue's gaze seemed to be watching her.
"The strife of Taimiao is over. Whether it's the Illusionary Path or the Supreme Sovereign Path, they are all ultimately the Way of Taimiao. From today onward, there will be no infighting, and as people of the same sect, you should unite and defend against external enemies together."
The statue's voice came, cold and clear.
"Yes!"
The Taimiao Sect Master and the others hastened to respond with a stern expression.
Then, the Taimiao Sect Master reported on the matters of the Divine Realm and the issue of infiltration by the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, finally introducing the current situation of the Taimiao Illusionary Path.
"Heavenly Slaughter's reach is too extended, eliminate them."
The statue's voice was cold, showing no emotion.
"Yes!"
Next, the statue's gaze fell upon Xin Mengrou.
"The Taimiao Sect of the Divine Realm hasn't had such a talented cultivator of the Illusionary Path for a very long time. You are very impressive. From today, you shall take charge of the Taimiao Illusionary Path."
Xin Mengrou was startled, and hurriedly said respectfully, "Disciple's strength is insignificant, I am not worthy of..."
"You will seclude yourself here for some time, and I will guide you a little. You will be able to break through to the Immortal Realm soon. The Illusionary Path, after all, differs slightly from the normal Martial Arts Cultivation."
"Yes, thank you, envoy!"
Xin Mengrou was inwardly delighted and replied respectfully.
The Taimiao Sect Master and the others were all surprised. especially the current head of the Taimiao Illusionary Path who was even more astonished.
Could it be that Xin Mengrou's talent was even more extraordinary than she had anticipated, thus making her be favored by the envoy and directly appointed as the head of the Illusionary Path?
However, with Xin Mengrou taking charge of the Illusionary Path, especially as appointed by the envoy who was also prepared to personally instruct her, it was undoubtedly great news for the declining Illusionary Path.
Once the Taimiao Sect Master and others had left and only Xin Mengrou remained in the pavilion, a woman's phantom stepped out from the statue.
She was like a dream, extremely unreal, yet irresistibly mesmerizing.
Xin Mengrou did not dare look too much, standing with her head bowed respectfully.
"The Illusionary Path you practice is slightly different. Do you have any other insights?"
The woman asked curiously.
"A senior once gave me some guidance, hence the slight insights," Xin Mengrou replied respectfully.
"Is that so? What is the name of the senior you speak of?"
"I do not know!"
"I shall meet this senior you speak of if there is a chance, to see who they are that could guide my Illusionary Path."
Xin Mengrou bowed her head, her heart pounding fiercely. Could this woman be the founder of the Taimiao Illusionary Path, the Ancestor of Taimiao?

chapters.title: Chapter 884 - 461: Demon Clan of the Divine Realm, Name of the Spear Demon
chapters.content:
The Divine Realm Great Realm forces, each with their own foundation, each with their own background, all learned some information during this major change of the Domain, finding ways to continue growing stronger and pass down their legacies amidst the turmoil of the Divine Realm.
And at a certain moment, the entire Divine Realm's attention was focused on the Wind River Realm, where a rare, large-scale battle in the history of the Divine Realm was unfolding.
As the Wind River Realm drew the gaze of most powerhouses in the Divine Realm, no one noticed the subtle changes happening quietly in the Di Yun Realm.
The clouds above the land grew thicker, and in the center of the Di Yun Realm, they were even more substantial, as if an invisible force was gathering them, preventing them from dissipating.
Above the Dragon Abyss in the Dragon Mountain Realm, the Firmament was covered by thick dark clouds, silver-white chains descending from the Firmament.
The phantom of a Splendid Giant Tiger gradually solidified, raising its head to gaze at the Firmament, with a silent roar, its awe-inspiring might rippling in all directions.
Tian Shiqi silently watched, and he had once again, distanced himself from where the Dragon Abyss lay.
At the moment, the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Dragon Mountain Realm had all run off to the Wind River Realm to enjoy the spectacle, and as for the Spirit Beasts of the Immortal Realm, they had long since dared not approach this place, and feeling uneasy, had quietly left the Dragon Mountain Realm.
Even Spirit Beasts with only Truth Refinement Realm strength could feel terror in their hearts, as if a great disaster was impending, and had either gone into hiding or fled from the Dragon Mountain Realm.
However, the Realm Gate of the Dragon Mountain Realm was now controlled by the strong ones from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, so these Spirit Beasts could only cross the wilderness to leave.
The anomaly of the Dragon Mountain Realm has yet to attract attention, nor have any powerhouses come to investigate.
"Wind Spirit Tiger, what a pity!"
Tian Shiqi gave a faint smile.
With the death of the Wind Spirit Tiger, the already scarce tiger-type Spirit Beasts lacked a strong presence even more.
As for that Splendid Ferocious Tiger in the Nine Mountains Realm, its bloodline was ultimately inferior to the Wind Spirit Tiger's, its strength had peaked, and it was not possible for it to advance further.
The Wind Spirit Tiger wanted to devour that drop of Heavenly Tiger Essence Blood, but it didn't know that it was already trapped on the Jade Platform, a sacrificial lamb, the catalyst for invoking the might of the Heavenly Tiger.
It seemed to stimulate the Heavenly Tiger bloodline in its body, but in fact, its energy would be consumed during the process.
Even if the Wind Spirit Tiger, by some stroke of luck, were to barely escape with its life, it was impossible for it to break through its bondage, the essence blood was not something it could obtain.
Moreover, how could the Wind Spirit Tiger with its strength survive?
The Nine Mountains Realm had always been in turmoil, and now the Wan Family was facing a great crisis.
Horizontal Peak Mountain, Thousand Layered Mountain, and Cloud Pool Mountain have unexpectedly joined forces, preparing to invade Dahai Mountain and expel the Wan Family. In this current upheaval, the Wan Family, being of the same lineage, could better unify to confront external threats.
After a series of purging internal dangers, the Wan Family was now solid as a rock; every member of the Wan Family understood that once the family collapsed, everything they owned would be lost.
Even surrendering or betraying wouldn't end well for them.
Rather than being someone else's slave, it was better to fight to the death to protect their interests!
After all, as long as the ancestors of the Immortal Realm were around, the Wan Family wouldn't fall!
However, three days ago, an Immortal Heavenly Venerable from the Wan Family was ambushed and severely wounded, almost losing their combat effectiveness.
And the two Immortal Heavenly Venerables who went to their rescue also suffered significant harm, significantly diminishing their strength.
This put the Wan Family's crisis right at hand; they had to seek help.
Horizontal Peak Mountain, Thousand Layered Mountain, and Cloud Pool Mountain were gradually pressing in, and the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the three mountains were burgeoning with momentum, constantly pressuring Dahai Mountain.
That day, a Splendid Ferocious Tiger, majestic and authoritative, strode into the ancestral shrine of the Wan Family.
"Old Wan, your Wan Family is in a tough spot now, what have you decided?"
Red Cat looked at the elderly ancestor of the Wan Family and asked.
"Red Cat Demon King, my Wan Family agrees to your terms!"
The corner of the Wan Family ancestor's mouth twitched as he looked at the upright-walking tiger, carrying a treasured sword, feeling somewhat awkward.
Spiritual Sovereign Mountain, the king of the Demon Clan, Red Cat!
While indeed a Splendid Ferocious Tiger, it was named Red Cat, and no one knew what the Great Demon King was thinking to have chosen such a name.
The Nine Mountains Realm, Spiritual Sovereign Mountain, now belonged to the Demon Clan.
And the founder of the Demon Clan was this very Splendid Ferocious Tiger, claiming itself the Great Demon King, with the Second Demon King and Third Demon King under its command. Moreover, this Red Cat Great Demon King, was extremely powerful.
The Wan Family ancestor was no match!
Spiritual Sovereign Mountain, now a domain of the Demon Clan, had seen the Immortal Heavenly Venerable of the Spiritual Sovereign Gate silently move away from the Spiritual Sovereign Mountain and had reached some kind of cooperation with the Demon Clan.
Now, Red Cat Great Demon King was ready to formally emerge, aiming to unify the Nine Mountains Realm, establish it as a territory of the Demon Clan, and invite Divine Realm Spirit Beasts to join.
And Dahai Mountain would remain the land of the Human Clan of the Nine Mountains Realm, not just the domain of the Wan Family alone. Red Cat would intervene, solve the problems with Horizontal Peak Mountain, Thousand Layered Mountain, and Cloud Pool Mountain, and end the chaos of the Nine Mountains Realm.
One cannot deny that this great tiger truly has great ambition, aiming to quell the chaos of the Nine Mountains Realm and establish a foundation for the Demon Clan in the Divine Realm.
"I knew it, Old Wan, you're a wise man, it's not in vain that our Demon Clan Supreme Sovereign had cooperated with your Wan Family!"
Red Cat nodded in satisfaction.
But the elder of the Wan Family was baffled, "Demon Clan Supreme Sovereign, you've had a deal with my Wan Family?"
"Of course! With your Wan Tianlin of the Wan Family, there were some good relations, and considering this connection, I, Red Cat the Great Demon King, support your Wan Family as the ruling power of Dahai Mountain. As for what comes afterward, it depends on whether your Wan Family has the capacity to continue ruling."

chapters.title: Chapter 885 - 461: Demon Clan of the Divine Realm, Name of the Spear Demon_2
chapters.content:
Red Cat nodded and said.
The old ancestor of the Wan Family looked confused. The Demon Clan Supreme has some sort of relationship with Wan Tianlin?
Suddenly, two figures emerged in his mind.
Xu Yan and Meng Chong!
"Is it Meng Chong?"
After all, with his towering stature and the way he wielded martial arts, he resembled a little giant. Meng Chong was more fitting of the title of the Demon Clan Supreme.
"It's the two Venerables!"
Red Cat spoke indifferently.
The old ancestor of the Wan Family continued to be baffled. Xu Yan is the Demon Clan Supreme?
"Xu Yan, is he not human? He isn't a spirit beast, right?"
Red Cat looked at him with disdain, saying, "Who told you that our Demon Clan Supreme has to be a spirit beast?"
After all, if the elder of the Demon Clan is human, the Demon Clan Supreme is human, what's so strange about that?
Red Cat turned and walked away, saying, "Start acting in three days, and these three pills will be gifted to your Wan Family. Three days are enough for three of your people to fully recover."
The time has finally come for me, Red Cat, Great Demon King, to be renowned throughout the Divine Realm.
At this moment, Red Cat's confidence had soared with the enhancement of his Great Demon martial arts and the Demon Clan Divine Skills, so much so that killing an Immortal Heavenly Venerable with one swipe of his paw was not much of a challenge.
Although Tian Shiqi was powerful, he was still no match for him, but he too had his own trump card and wasn't the least bit frightened!
Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha had also made breakthroughs, and to kill an Immortal Heavenly Venerable would be no issue at all.
The Nine Mountain Realm, in its chaotic state, was due for unification to establish the roots of the Demon Clan.
Three days later, the Nine Mountain Realm faced its greatest upheaval as a Splendid Ferocious Tiger, standing upright with a precious blade in hand, charged into the realm of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of Horizontal Peak Mountain and Thousand Layered Mountain.
A Flood Dragon coiled in mid-air, spewing terrifying light beams, suppressing the Immortal Heavenly Venerable of Cloud Pool Mountain.
A Mountain Devourer Toad, large as a hill, opened its gargantuan maw as if a dark abyss materialized, swallowing the Immortal Heavenly Venerable into its depths, and in the blink of an eye, was reduced to ashes.
That was the Mountain Devourer Toad!
The powerful beings of the Nine Mountain Realm were all stunned.
Damn, the Mountain Devourer Toad could be this powerful? Looking at the Storage Bags they carried, they suddenly felt terrible.
Could they still breed Mountain Devourer Toads in the future?
Could they still use Mountain Devourer Toads to make Storage Bags?
This is terrifying!
The leader of Spiritual Sovereign Gate watched calmly, having already experienced it; he completely lay low, no longer struggling. From then on, the Nine Mountain Realm would be a domain of the Demon Clan.
The long-troubled Nine Mountain Realm underwent a tremendous change as the Demon Clan was established!
On that very day, the Great Demon King Red Cat, fighting alone against several Immortal Heavenly Venerables, cut them down with overwhelming force!
He even exposed the strongholds of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow in Horizontal Peak Mountain and Cloud Pool Mountain, and the long-hidden Seven-leaf Heavenly Slaughter, executing them all.
The Wan Family, the Master of Spiritual Sovereign Gate, and other Immortal Heavenly Venerables also took action, eradicating the remnants of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, after all, Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow was behind the turmoil in the Nine Mountain Realm.
Red Cat used the might of the Great Demon King to intimidate the Nine Mountain Realm and even entered the Heavenly Grotto, pacifying the Heavenly Grotto of the Nine Mountain Realm and executing many Netherworld Blood Children.
From then on, the disturbances in the Nine Mountain Realm came to an end, and what was different now was that the Nine Mountain Realm had become a realm of the Demon Clan.
Many powerful beings of the Nine Mountain Realm began to leave, except the Wan Family's Dahai Mountain, which remained as the residential place for the Human Clan, with the remaining eight mountains completely under the Demon Clan's control.
The existence of Dahai Mountain then became a channel for trade and exchange.
Meanwhile, the news of the Great Demon King Red Cat establishing the Demon Clan and inviting Divine Realm spirit beasts to come to the Nine Mountain Realm also spread throughout the Divine Realm.
With the news, the spirits outside the Nine Mountain Realm began flocking to the realm. The might of the Demon Clan started to converge, and amidst these troubled times in the Divine Realm, no major powers had the spare strength to target this newly-established Demon Clan.
Of course, there were those who thought the Demon Clan was merely a new power of spirit beasts and not very strong.
As for the cultivation methods of the Demon Clan allowing spirit beasts to disregard their bloodline constraints and cultivate to improve themselves like the Human Clan, that was not credible, and it must be an act of deceit by the Demon King Red Cat.
Many were watching to see if the immortal realm spirit beasts who went to the Nine Mountain Realm would willingly submit and become subordinates of the three Great Demon Kings, or if they would join forces to compel the Demon Kings to hand over the Dharma.
With the founding of the Demon Clan, there was another earth-shaking event in the Divine Realm, the great battle in the Wind River Realm has finally come to an end.
A young man with a deadly cold Long Spear in hand walked out of the Heavenly Grotto and entered the encirclement of strong adversaries, striking one with each thrust, slaughtering Immortal Heavenly Venerables as though he were swatting grasshoppers.
No matter how powerful the Divine Soul Secret Techniques these strong ones had cultivated, or the defensive Divine Artifacts they employed, none could withstand that chilling spear thrust; with each thrust, Divine Souls were extinguished!
There were no exceptions!
Jiang Buping's spear had grown even more formidable and unstoppable. It appeared to be a spear specially designed for assaulting Divine Souls, as if his entire mastery of Martial Arts was centered on Slaughter the Soul.
He struck fear into the group of powerful beings, until these strong ones crumbled. As the great battle entered its later stages, one after another, they fled in panic, no longer daring to continue the fight.
However, Jiang Buping, with his murderous intent as sharp as ever, was not yet ready to cease. Now that he had acted, they were his enemies, and there was only one way to treat enemies: death!
Not a single strong one who had taken action managed to escape the Wind River Realm, all were caught by Jiang Buping and slain one by one!
The Divine Realm was shaken, countless great forces, countless strong ones were horrified.
The name of the Spear Demon spread across the Divine Realm!
This was a harbinger of death, his massacre more terrifying than even Sword God Xu Yan or Heavenly God Meng Chong.
And this was not unexpected, as Jiang Buping's ability to ignore the Imperishable Qi hinted at a great secret, a grand opportunity, naturally stirring the hearts of countless forces, countless strong ones.
Especially with the covert encouragement of some vested interests, the number of powerful beings setting out to hunt down Jiang Buping naturally increased, and so did the severity of Jiang Buping's slaughter.
The Spear Demon Jiang Buping, at the mere mention of his name, hearts would turn cold!
With the battle in the Wind River Realm over, Jiang Buping had announced his next move: he was heading to the Taikun Realm to demand an explanation!
Instantly, many powerful beings turned their gazes toward the Taikun Realm, and many more hurried there to see the outcome for themselves.
Could it be that the Taikun Jiang Clan, with its heritage of countless ages, was about to be annihilated?
In the Taikun Realm, within the Jiang Clan's grand hall.
All the clan elders were silent, as the head elder turned to the clan leader and said in an even tone, "Clan leader, do you think we should use the power of the entire clan to save Jiang Tianming and kill Jiang Buping?"
The Clan leader of the Jiang Clan remained silent.
He knew that although the head elder seemed to await his command, if he truly gave the order, he would face rebellion from the head elder's faction, forcing him to abdicate his position.
"Clan leader, this matter concerns the rise and fall of our Jiang Clan, as clan leader, you must make a decision. How should we deal with the current situation?"
One of the clan elders spoke solemnly.
The Jiang Clan's clan leader looked at the head elder with an indifferent expression, then at the other clan elders, and spoke calmly, "The grudges between Buping and Tianming are for them to resolve themselves. I will not intervene or interfere. As for matters concerning Tianming, those who take part, their lives and deaths are in Buping's hands, and I will not appeal for mercy!"
The head elder and the others were taken aback.
Tianming's act of fratricide, he alone should bear the consequences, even I, as his father, must be fair to a certain extent!"
The clan leader of the Jiang Clan's face was calm, yet showed a tinge of sorrow, "It's all due to my lack of guidance, this is a private affair of my family, unrelated to the Jiang Clan, so there's no need for you to get involved.
"Buping seeks an explanation, then let him have his explanation!"
The head elder and the others were all silent, only then realizing that Jiang Buping was the son of their clan leader. Although previously, he wasn't favored and even persecuted, the clan leader hadn't shown much concern.
But now, things were different.
Jiang Buping had become unimaginably powerful, and there were suspicions of a Supreme Sovereign backing him. Thus, it seemed inevitable to abandon Jiang Tianming and mend relations with Jiang Buping.
As for those in the Jiang Clan who were involved, so what if they were killed? The clan could shoulder such minor losses!
In the Taikun Realm, within a small courtyard of the Jiang Clan.
Jiang Tianming's eyes were bloodshot, and he was in a state of frenzy, with Yun Yan'er beside him, covering her face, showing a look of grievance.
"Tianming, who would have thought he would survive, what do we do now?"
"What to do, how would I know? My father has already washed his hands off this matter, how am I supposed to confront Jiang Buping, that bastard? What about your Yun Shang Sect, are you also severing ties? What do you suggest we do?"
Jiang Tianming roared.
"What if, we run away?"
Yun Yan'er said softly.
"Run? The Divine Realm might be vast, but where do you think I can escape to?"
Jiang Tianming looked almost crazed.

chapters.title: Chapter 886 - 462 Blood Extremity Remnant Soul, Gathering Storms at Taikun
chapters.content:
"What do you think we should do now? Kneel and beg Jiang Buping for forgiveness?"
Yun Yan'er's demeanor also became slightly crazed.
"If it weren't for your instigation, why would I have dealt Jiang Buping a dirty blow? But because you were wary of the clan elders blaming you for being too ruthless towards your own people and hindering your path to the leadership of the Jiang Clan, you didn't kill Jiang Buping directly. Now see what's happened, he is coming to kill us!"
Yun Yan'er shouted, his eyes red.
Jiang Tianming's breathing became heavy and his eyes revealed a chilling light, but after a while, he took a deep breath and said, "This Divine Realm isn't only home to Jiang Buping's mighty presence. The Immortal Realm isn't the end; there certainly is a way. Calm down and just wait for my news."
"That bastard Jiang Buping thinks he can kill me? He's still too green!"
In the Taikun Realm, a figure walked slowly through the wilderness.
Night was falling, and in the quiet wilderness, the darkness felt oppressive—the kind of oppression that fills one with fear and tension as they walk through the desolate silence of the wilderness.
In the wilderness, there was a pile of stones that resembled a solitary grave.
Jiang Tianming stood still before the pile of rocks, took a deep breath, clenched his teeth, and his gaze showed a mix of resoluteness and viciousness.
Moving a large stone from the top of the pile, the mottled boulder that had eroded over the years still retained an inexplicable presence.
As he moved stone after stone, a hole was finally revealed.
Jiang Tianming stepped into the opening, then placed a stone back to block the entrance as he moved forward in the darkness. Within a few steps, he arrived at a slightly more spacious area.
Here, at the center of the stone pile, was a cold, chilling aura. Even as an Immortal Realm Warrior, he felt a slight chill.
"You're finally here, boy."
In the darkness, a faint brownish-red light emerged—a leaping flame that sprouted from the ground and slowly took on a human shape.
"I'm not content; I've got to kill him. Whatever your conditions are, I'll agree to them all. I have only one request—I want to kill him!" Jiang Tianming growled.
"An enemy? And one that even your Jiang Family can't help you against? Excellent, excellent," the brownish-red figure said with a nod.
"You can help me, right?" Jiang Tianming asked eagerly.
"Of course!"
"Do you know how strong he is?"
"If someone like him could make you so out of sorts, and even the Jiang Family won't intervene. Is he from the Heavenly Union Realm?" the brownish-red flame guessed.
"He should still be in the Immortal Realm, but he's too strong, terrifyingly so. To him, killing those from the Immortal Realm is like slaughtering chickens."
Jiang Tianming lost his composure a bit.
"Oh, is that so?" The person in the brownish-red color seemed a bit surprised.
"Tell me, what exactly happened?"
A deep breath in, and Jiang Tianming detailed Jiang Buping's accomplishments, including the Slaughter the Divine Soul.
"Interesting, very interesting!" The brownish-red person showed a hint of surprise after listening.
"Can you help me?" Jiang Tianming asked hopefully.
"Certainly!"
"But you seem to be just a Remnant Soul, while that bastard Jiang Buping is best at destroying souls..." Jiang Tianming suddenly said with diminishing confidence.
"Haha, not all souls are equal. Even if his Divine Soul Secret Technique is strong, it relies on his own Divine Spirit Soul Force, which ultimately has a limit. A mere Immortal Realm, no matter how strong the soul, can't threaten me.
"Besides, am I simply a mere soul?" The brownish-red person smiled radiantly.
"That's good to hear!" Jiang Tianming breathed a sigh of relief.
"Tell me your conditions. I will meet them!" Jiang Tianming said earnestly.
"First, you need to unbind some of my power," the brownish-red person said, "Do this next...
"The subsequent conditions will surely involve your Jiang Family, but that's for when you grow powerful. Now gather these items for me..."
Following that, the brownish-red person handed Jiang Tianming a list.
"Fine, I'll bring the items tomorrow!" Jiang Tianming looked at the list and said solemnly.
"Agreed," nodded the brownish-red figure.
Jiang Tianming turned to leave; he had to prepare everything quickly, for Jiang Buping would soon be arriving at the Taikun Realm.
After Jiang Tianming had left, the brownish-red figure's eyes sparkled with excitement and he murmured, "Taikun, you never thought I'd still be alive, did you?
"Jiang Feng, let your descendants help me revive, and we can slowly settle our score!"
The next day, under another bleak night sky, Jiang Tianming returned.
"I've prepared everything!"
Jiang Tianming produced a Storage Bag.
"Good, put all the items into the Great Ding..."
Following the brownish-red figure's instructions, Jiang Tianming complied.
"Enter the ding, and I will infuse you with my power, borrowing your body to emerge."
Hearing this, Jiang Tianming hesitated for a moment.
"Don't worry, I won't take over your body. I swear it!"
Seeing his hesitation, the brownish-red figure immediately swore an oath.
"By borrowing my body, you can really help me kill that bastard Jiang Buping?"
Jiang Tianming asked in a grave voice.
"Of course, I can elevate your strength to the Heavenly Union Realm!"
"Impossible, the Divine Realm's limit is the Immortal Realm..."
"Kid, you know too little about the Domain. You're too weak. Besides, it's not your own breakthrough but my power you'll be relying on. The limits don't apply to you."
After some negotiation, Jiang Tianming took a deep breath and stepped into the Great Ding.
"Jiang Buping, you forced my hand; you must die!"

chapters.title: Chapter 887 - 462 Blood Extremity Remnant Soul, Gathering Storms at Taikun_2
chapters.content:
Jiang Tianming's eyes were ferociously intense as he spoke.
Whoosh!
More brownish-red flames surged from the ground, enveloping the Great Ding and beginning to drill into Jiang Tianming's body.
"Ah!"
Jiang Tianming's forehead bulged with veins, blood-red vessels emerged all over his body, and a faint brownish-red glow surrounded him, giving him a ferocious and terrifying appearance.
"Kid, just bear with it. It's going to hurt a bit at the start, but once I have fully entered you, you'll experience the joy of being powerful!"
"Senior, how may I address you?"
"Heh heh, telling you now makes no difference, you young pup surely haven't heard of me before, I am Blood Extreme!"
Blood Extreme!
Jiang Tianming couldn't help but think of the Netherworld Blood Child and asked in a deep voice, "Senior, are you a Netherworld expert?"
"Hehe, you could say that!"
Blood Extreme let out a sinister laugh.
Boom!
Jiang Tianming felt like his body was about to explode, swollen with discomfort yet also filled with a violent sense of power.
At a certain moment!
His Divine Soul swayed, his consciousness went a bit fuzzy, and after who knows how long, he suddenly found that there was an extra figure next to his Divine Soul in the sea of consciousness.
It was a brown-robed man with a shady appearance, but his eyes had a bloodthirsty gleam, as if craving for fresh blood.
All over his body, one could vaguely see the circulation of bloody qi.
"Blood Extreme Senior?"
Jiang Tianming's Divine Soul sidestepped a little, expressing his surprise.
"Hehe, kid, it's me!"
Blood Extreme's smile was radiant, finally coming forth.
"It's been a long time since I've been active. Boy, lend me your body for a few days."
Jiang Tianming had no chance to protest, but in an instant, he realized that he had lost control over his physical body; however, his sensory consciousness remained normal.
It was just that the actions of his body were not under his control, which made him feel somewhat uncomfortable.
At this moment, Jiang Tianming felt as if he had boarded a thief's ship.
"It's all because of that bastard Jiang Buping!"
Jiang Tianming attributed everything to Jiang Buping.
"As long as I can kill that bastard, it's all worth it!"
Jiang Tianming thought madly to himself.
A figure walked out of the rubble, left the wilderness, and returned to the small courtyard.
"Tianming, Jiang Buping will soon arrive in Taikun Realm, we should hurry and escape while we can!"
Yun Yan'er came up anxiously.
"Escape?"
"Hehe, cough cough, there's no need to run. That bastard Jiang Buping is nothing to fear. The me today is no longer the me of before!"
Jiang Tianming reached out his hand to seize her, and in Yun Yan'er's astonished gaze, rip, her clothes were torn off.
Then, he hoisted Yun Yan'er up and threw her into a room.
"What are you doing?"
Jiang Tianming's Divine Soul roared.
"Kid, I'm just borrowing your body. What are you nervous about? This is your body, you can feel it too. Let me teach you youngsters some tricks..."
"You, you, you..."
Jiang Tianming's Divine Soul was utterly infuriated and shouted, "We had an agreement; you promised me..."
"You young man, why all the fuss? I already told you this is your body. I'm merely tagging along for the sensation, the real enjoyment is yours!"
Fuck!
Jiang Tianming's Divine Soul was livid.
After a long while, Yun Yan'er lay nestled in Jiang Tianming's embrace, puzzled as to why Tianming had developed so many new tricks in just a few days...
In the Taikun Realm, in the great city where the Realm Gate is located, experts gathered, waiting for Jiang Buping's arrival.
An unwanted child's counterattack, the quest for justice, it was so thrilling that the name of Spear Demon had echoed through the Divine Realm, known to all.
The story of Jiang Buping's past ordeal had spread far and wide: born into a great clan but undervalued as a concubine's child, then targeted because of his exceptional talent and finally sidelined, reduced to a crippled state, exiled, and now rising powerfully to return. What a grand drama it was!
All over the Divine Realm, any Immortal Realm expert who could move was rushing to Taikun Realm, waiting for the grand battle, waiting for the Jiang Clan to fall.
The intents of these experts were clear; the Jiang Clan had a long inheritance, and perhaps this time, they may get a chance to loot something substantial.
"Such a lively scene!"
Wu Tianan stepped out of the Realm Gate and couldn't help but exclaim.
He had reached the Immortal Realm.
Even Wu Tianan himself felt a bit dazed; his cultivation had been going too smoothly, and his fortune had been exceptionally good, continuously acquiring treasures.
"Huh, senior?"
Suddenly, Wu Tianan saw the unkempt elder he had encountered before.
"Oh, it's you!"
The elder glanced at Wu Tianan, his eyes brightening slightly yet filled with some confusion at the young man's extraordinarily peculiar luck.
"It's me, senior, are you here to enjoy the spectacle too?"
"Something like that."
As the two of them were chatting casually, the noisy sounds of the large city instantly hushed, only to be followed by an even more fervent wave of discussion.
"Meng Chong!"
"It's Heavenly God Meng Chong, he's actually come!"
"What do you think, is Jiang Buping stronger, or is Meng Chong the better one?"
"Hard to say, they are both freaks of nature."
"I think Jiang Buping is stronger, Slaughter the Soul ah, it's too hard to resist."
"That may not be the case, the title of Heavenly God is not so simple."
Meng Chong's here?
Wu Tianan was startled, followed the voice, and indeed saw Meng Chong's figure striding toward the outskirts of the large city.
Meng Chong suddenly paused, turned his head to look at Wu Tianan, nodded in acknowledgment, as if to greet him.
It was unexpected to encounter an acquaintance in the Taikun Realm.
"Wu Tianan has actually reached the Immortal Realm!"
Meng Chong was somewhat surprised in his heart, Wu Tianan's cultivation speed was rather too fast.
None of the Spiritual Realm Experts who came with Wu Tianan had broken through to the Immortal Realm, and many hadn't even entered the Truth Refinement Realm.
In an instant, Wu Tianan had left everyone far behind.
"Wu kid, you know him?"
The elder asked with some surprise.
"Right."
Wu Tianan nodded.
"That big fellow, he's got a huge reputation, a formidable young man indeed."
The elder heaved a sigh of admiration.
"Naturally!"
Wu Tianan nodded in agreement.
"This Divine Realm, it's truly getting more and more interesting."
The elder said with a laugh, then waved his hand and bade farewell to Wu Tianan.
The large city suddenly quieted down again, Jiang Buping stepped into the Taikun Realm with a cold expression, but his eyes held some memories, some complexities.
Without lingering, he left the large city directly, striding toward the Jiang Clan, today's visit was to demand an explanation, to kill some people, anyone who obstructed would be slain!
Boom!
As Jiang Buping steadily advanced towards the Jiang Clan Ancestral Land, his momentum grew stronger and stronger, without any intention of concealing it.
"So strong!"
All the experts who had come to the Taikun Realm were startled in their hearts.
"Jiang Buping has arrived!"
Outside the Jiang Clan Ancestral Land, a group of Jiang Clan Experts all made their appearance, everyone's gaze turned to the clan leader, the father of Jiang Buping.
That aura, fierce and penetrating, pierced through the Firmament, even across vast distances, one could still feel that mighty and soul-trembling breath.
"Jiang! Tian! Ming!"
Jiang Buping's solemn voice came, each syllable echoing clearly.
"Where is Jiang Tianming?"
The Great Elder asked in a deep voice.
"Don't know!"
The other elders shook their heads.
"He wouldn't have fled, right?"
An elder voiced his worries.
Just then, a voice came from a distance, "Jiang Buping, you bastard, you also dare to dream of killing me, I'm right here waiting for you!"
Everyone was shocked.
"Jiang Tianming's strength, why is it so strong, it seems to have surpassed the Immortal Realm already."
"Could it be that the Jiang Clan has tapped into some legacy, allowing him to temporarily break through his limits?"
The Great Elder and others were also shocked, and even the Jiang Clan leader was filled with doubt and uncertainty.
Jiang Buping paused his steps, looked up towards where Jiang Tianming was, his eyes filled with resolute killing intent, the Extreme Soul Divine Weapon in his hand, with one step crossed the distance and arrived at Jiang Tianming's location.
"Whose game it will be, is now hard to predict!"
"Who would have thought, Jiang Tianming turned out to be such a monstrous talent?"
"What exactly did he use to break the limits in the Divine Realm?"
The multitude of strong experts rushed over, watching from afar the two figures exuding powerful auras confronting each other, a great battle on the verge of breaking out!
A fight that attracted the attention of the masses was about to begin.
Meng Chong stood in the air, his eyes like the blazing sun, gazing at Jiang Tianming, his brows slightly furrowed.
"A Remnant Soul of a Netherworld Expert? If it were any other trick, it would be fine, but mere Remnant Souls, even if they are from powerful beings, are fated to be obliterated under the Fifth Junior Brother's Extreme Soul Martial Arts."
Meng Chong looked at the Jiang Clan Experts, ready to intervene at any moment, holding back all the Jiang Clan Experts outside.

chapters.title: Chapter 888 - 463: Blood Prison Killing Aspect, One Spear Annihilates the Enemy
chapters.content:
Among the powerful beings watching the battle, an unkempt old man, whose appearance did not draw any attention, was now muttering and cursing under his breath.
"Blood Extremity Remnant Soul? Taikun really is a waste; he couldn't even finish off Blood Extreme properly, and now someone has managed to resurrect him. Going after Jiang Feng's descendant, no good intentions there, for sure."
"Taikun's successor is also a waste. Jiang Feng seemed promising, but he turned out to be blind to what's right in front of him, not even aware of Blood Extreme lurking around..."
The old man cursed and mumbled, but soon he looked at Jiang Buping with a puzzled face.
"What is it about this young man that's so unusual? What cultivation technique is that? Divine Soul Secret Technique? Doesn't seem like it. Strange!"
He scratched his head and then stroked his beard, "A cultivation technique even I can't figure out is definitely not of Taicang Martial Arts. Yet, he's not from beyond our Domain either, nor does he seem like someone from that damned Divine Temple..."
The more the old man watched, the more he felt that layers of mystery shrouded the situation, and something about the Divine Realm seemed off.
He then slightly raised his head to look at a certain burly figure.
"How odd, the martial arts of this lad are bizarre as well. Such formidable physical strength, terrifying to the extreme, even able to transform into a giant, certainly not of Taicang Martial Arts.
"However, it's also not from that damned Divine Temple. It can't possibly be from them... How strange, could it actually be..."
Suddenly thinking of a certain possibility, he then shook his head in denial, "Impossible, if they were alive, there would have been some movement by now, and that guy from the Divine Temple wouldn't be this quiet..."
The old man glanced at Jiang Buping and then at Meng Chong, "These two lads, could they have some connection? Fellow disciples?"
Upon such a thought, the old man couldn't help but be surprised.
"Odd indeed, nevermind, overthinking it won't do any good. Let's see how that bastard Heavenly Slaughter stirs trouble. Even if the world falls apart, so be it; I can't be bothered with these troubles anymore."
In the end, the old man shook his head and didn't dwell on it any further.
On the battlefield, two powerful auras collided, causing turmoil in the heavens and earth. Even the Immortal Heavenly Venerable felt a chill of fear at the fierce momentum.
"Jiang Buping, you bastard, dare to rebel against your superiors. Do you even qualify? To think of killing me, do you qualify?"
Jiang Tianming had a fierce expression, holding a long knife with a red-gleaming blade.
Jiang Buping's eyes were cold, but he sneered with disdain, "Jiang Tianming, do you think, relying on a remnant soul, you can withstand me?
"Today between you and me, it will be settled. I, Jiang Buping, came here to kill you, to kill her, to kill certain people. Whoever stands in my way shall perish!"
Remnant Soul?
At Jiang Buping's words, everyone was taken aback. No wonder Jiang Tianming had become so powerful; it turned out he was relying on a remnant soul?
And if a remnant soul could be this powerful, how strong would the original entity be?
Jiang Tianming was momentarily startled, feeling a sudden panic inside. Had Jiang Buping actually discovered it?
How did he find out?
"Blood Extreme senior, how did this bastard know?"
Jiang Tianming looked towards the Blood Extreme Divine Soul within him.
"This boy is not ordinary. You alone probably can't handle this; give your body to me, otherwise, your death is certain!"
Blood Extreme appeared extremely serious at this moment.
"Even you are not confident of killing this bastard?"
Jiang Tianming's expression grew more ferocious.
"His martial arts are not right; they seem designed to slaughter the soul. Even I have to be cautious. If you don't want to die, you should know what to do."
Blood Extreme's expression was chilly.
"Fine, I will listen to you, just to kill this bastard!"
Jiang Tianming said through gritted teeth.
Boom!
At this moment, a faint blood-colored light emerged from Jiang Tianming, and an even more formidable aura erupted. The blade of the long knife in his hand radiated a crimson cold light.
"Take my blade!"
Jiang Tianming suddenly made the first move, his crimson blade light cutting across the sky in a manner that surpassed the understanding of the other Immortal Heavenly Venerables, aiming to slay Jiang Buping.
With the strike, the onlookers seemed to see a turbulent sea of blood, a Blood-colored Purgatory, and within this purgatory, a streak of crimson blade light shot forth.
Jiang Buping remained expressionless as he thrust out his spear. The cold light converged into one point, and to the onlookers, it looked like a spear light piercing through the sea of blood, opening a path through the Blood-colored Purgatory, aiming straight for the end of that blade light.
Divine Skills, Slaying the Divine!
Blood Extreme was shocked at this moment. Dodging and weaving, rings of blood-colored light that resembled quagmires appeared, surrounding his Remnant Soul.
This was a defensive technique.
At the same time, he slashed out with his knife. The Blood Sea Purgatory roared, like the cries of resentful spirits, or countless vengeful souls rushing out with the blade to attack Jiang Buping.
"Since when does the Taicang Domain have a cultivation technique that specializes in slaying souls? Something's not right; it's not as simple as a technique, but seems like a completely different martial path oriented towards eradicating souls..."
"Could this child be the future ruler of the Taicang Domain, otherwise why would he be so monstrous?"
The more Blood Extreme fought, the more shocked he was. His Divine Soul was constantly on edge, feeling that even a slight misstep might result in being pierced through by the spear.
What was more terrifying was that the path of slaying souls was exceedingly sharp, and even with all his methods, he felt almost defenseless.
And Jiang Tianming's Divine Soul was already trembling, his complexion pale with fear, his soul's face covered in terror and regret, his fighting spirit gone, leaving only boundless fear and remorse.
The scruffy old man watched the great battle unfolding with growing astonishment. The martial arts displayed by Jiang Buping exceeded his understanding, as if it were an entirely new path of martial arts.

chapters.title: Chapter 889 - 463: Blood Prison Killing Aspect, One Spear Annihilates the Enemy_2
chapters.content:
It was as if there existed a form of Martial Arts unknown to the world.
"Strange, who taught this lad his Martial Arts?"
The elder was curious in his heart.
Meng Chong looked toward the fierce battle, fixing his gaze on the Remnant Soul for a long moment, his brow slightly furrowed.
"This Remnant Soul is very strong, far surpassing the Immortal Realm, and it's a Netherworld Remnant Soul, the remnant of a Netherworld powerhouse that once invaded the Divine Realm?"
That Remnant Soul, under the onslaught of Jiang Buping's Extreme Soul Martial Arts Divine Skill, managed to hold on until now – a truly rare feat.
"Jiang Tianming is about to crumble."
Meng Chong chuckled gleefully.
The battle grew more intense, and it was only now that the watching powerhouses realized why the Spear Demon Jiang Buping was so powerful. Amidst the siege of numerous Immortal Heavenly Venerables, with a single man and a spear, he had annihilated all enemies.
No Immortal Heavenly Venerable could withstand that overwhelmingly powerful strike of the Slaughter Spirit!
"What kind of Divine Soul Secret Technique is this, to be so tremendously powerful!"
"I'm afraid it's not as simple as just a Divine Soul Secret Technique!"
Boom!
Jiang Buping thrust his spear, cold light burst forth, transforming into myriad tiny specks that enveloped Jiang Tianming's body. These specks of cold light, as if irresistible, penetrated into Jiang Tianming's flesh.
Assaults like a Blood-colored Purgatory swept in, yet Jiang Buping's expression remained unchanged; with a swing of his spear and a thunderous noise, he tore open a gap in the Blood-colored Purgatory and escaped its grasp with a flicker.
"Ah!"
Suddenly, Jiang Tianming let out a scream of agony.
A Divine Soul, half emerging from the physical body, displayed nothing but shock and panic, pleading, "Jiang Buping, I was wrong, I dare not, I beg you to spare me!"
"Stop attacking, if you spare me, I will do anything, Yun Yan'er is yours, everything is yours, please, spare me, I won't dare again!"
Jiang Tianming's Divine Soul was turbulent, his emotions had collapsed, gone was his past arrogance and the confident posture of having everything under control.
"You deserve this!"
Jiang Buping let out a cold smile and thrust his spear again.
Hum!
Clumps of light, akin to a blood marsh, appeared in front of Jiang Tianming's body. Another voice sounded, "Boy, handle this Divine Soul as you see fit. I'll take this physical body. Let's call it even from here, you've had your revenge, there's no need to continue fighting!"
"I'll destroy both his soul and his body, you have no right to bargain!"
Jiang Buping responded with a cold smile.
"Boy, do you really think I can't do anything to you? It's just that I can't bear to destroy this Remnant Soul!"
Blood Extreme spoke furiously.
"Whatever you have planned, just bring it on!"
Jiang Buping remained unmoved.
"Very well, you ignorant fool, do you really think I'm easy to bully?"
Blood Extreme roared in anger.
At that moment, Jiang Tianming's body burst with a blood-red light.
A vortex resembling a purgatory appeared on Jiang Tianming, and then it began to devour his Divine Soul, constantly pulling it in.
"Ah!"
Jiang Tianming let out a scream of pain, but at that moment, he unleashed his Divine Spirit Soul Force.
"How dare you break your promise?"
Jiang Tianming seethed with rage.
"Boy, your life is forfeit. Sacrifice your Divine Soul to me, and I can avenge you, otherwise your death will be in vain, face the reality," Blood Extreme spoke calmly.
"Your time is running out, think carefully. If you willingly sacrifice your Divine Soul, you can still retain a trace of consciousness and see me slay your enemy!"
Jiang Tianming struggled, "Can you really kill that bastard?"
"There's a seventy percent chance."
"Only seventy percent?"
"Your Divine Soul is too weak, and there aren't enough of them; otherwise, it would have been more than seventy percent."
The eyes on Jiang Tianming's Divine Soul went blood-red with insanity at that moment, glaring at Jiang Buping with bitter hatred and suddenly he cried out, "Yun Yan'er, come here!"
Yun Yan'er hesitated for a moment before flying over.
"Tianming,"
Jiang Tianming looked at Blood Extreme and said, "How about with her included?"
"Hahaha, very well, very well, I, Blood Extreme, will grant you both this boon: to entwine your Divine Souls and stir up your resentment..."
Laughing heartily, Blood Extreme raised his hand and the Blood-colored Purgatory swept toward Yun Yan'er.
"What are you going to do?"
Yun Yan'er's expression changed drastically, and she moved to flee, but in an instant, she was enveloped by the Blood-colored Purgatory.
"Jiang Buping, I beg you, save me! It's my fault, I didn't mean to, it was him, he made me do it!"
Suddenly, Yun Yan'er pleaded with Jiang Buping for help.
"Yun'er, you bitch, how dare you seek help from that bastard?"
Jiang Tianming roared furiously.
"It's all your fault, Jiang Tianming! Had you listened to me, you wouldn't have ended up like this!"
Yun Yan'er too screamed in anger.
For a time, the sound of resentful cursing filled the air, and by the end, all the fury and all the grudges pointed at Jiang Buping, with two sinister gazes within the Blood-colored Purgatory seemingly ready to tear him to pieces!
Jiang Buping remained calm, silently watching, not even attempting to stop Blood Extreme from using this secret technique, not stopping him from blood refining Jiang Tianming and Yun Yan'er.
Boom!
The Blood-colored Purgatory flowed into Jiang Tianming's body, and amidst the tumultuous bloodlight, the figure of a blood-colored monstrosity emerged, filled with resentment, sinister energy, and the aura of Slaughter Spirit stirring the Domain.
Three heads; the center one was blood-red, with vague features and blood-red eyes that seemed to emit the thunderous sounds of surging waves, as if blood torrents were violently churning.
The head on the left was ethereal, Jiang Tianming's remaining consciousness made manifest.
The head on the right was formed from the remaining consciousness of Yun Yan'er.
"Die, die, die... kill, kill, kill... bastard, little bastard..."
The voices of resentful spirits from Jiang Tianming and Yun Yan'er echoed between heaven and earth, making the hairs on the onlookers stand on end and stirring fear in their hearts, even prompting an instinctive retreat.
"What is that?"
"Don't know, but it seems like a technique from the Netherworld."
"Very strong, can Jiang Buping withstand it?"
At this moment, everyone felt a wave of shock.
If Jiang Buping should fall, this monstrosity might very well go on to voraciously consume the essence of martial artists, using blood refining in the Taikun Realm.
"It's been ages since I've used Blood Prison Killing Aspect; while it pales in comparison to its former glory, to kill you, it is more than enough!"
The sinister laughter of Blood Extreme resounded.
Then, he took a step forward, and in an instant, the Domain where the battlefield lay was engulfed in blood-red color, with waves of blood materializing out of thin air, engulfing Jiang Buping in a heartbeat.
Boom!
The waves rose violently, the Domain seemingly affected by a force of stasis, with a terrifying corrosive air spreading throughout the battlefield.
Swish!
One after another, figures resembling Blood Extreme emerged, and the voices of Jiang Tianming and Yun Yan'er, filled with resentful spirits, continually sounded, permeating the battlefield with their intent.
The slovenly old man took half a step forward.
"Blood Prison Killing Aspect, one of the Netherworld's three great Blood Path techniques of destruction. Since Taikun got killed by Blood Extreme, we've not seen it; never would have guessed that Taikun was a waste, Blood Extreme wasn't dead at all, and now it's being used again.
"Although much weaker now, that brat Jiang Buping won't be able to resist."
Hum!
Suddenly, within that Blood Prison, a cold light burst forth, a supremely sharp killing intent seemingly tearing the Blood Prison apart.
Even at a great distance, all of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables felt an involuntary sense of dread in their Divine Souls, as if they were under intense threat.
Subconsciously, they stepped back, their expressions solemn.
"If you weren't but a Remnant Soul wielding this technique, with my current strength, I might have hesitated, but for a mere Remnant Soul to threaten me is sheer folly!"
Jiang Buping's voice echoed within the Blood Prison.
"No matter how powerful you once were, now you're but a Remnant Soul. A mere Remnant Soul dares threaten me, who gave you the courage?
"Today, by making an enemy of me, Jiang Buping, you're doomed to not even have a tiny soul fragment survive!"
"Arrogant!"
Anger surged in Blood Extreme's voice.
The Blood Prison became even more astonishing, but at that moment, a cold light streaked through it and was gone in a flash.
Hum!
In that instant, the Blood Prison stagnated, then began to collapse, with all the resentment, the intent to kill, and the sinister vibes disappearing.
At last, everyone saw Jiang Buping, spear in hand, thrust it into the central head of the blood-colored monstrosity, which began to show cracks all over its body, even emitting blood-colored smoke, and was dissolving away.

chapters.title: Chapter 890 - 464: Resentment Settled, the Sky Collapses and the Dragon Falls
chapters.content:
Blood Extreme looked at Jiang Buping with an incredulous expression, even as his Remnant Soul was dissolving, it seemed as if he felt nothing at all.
The ethereal heads formed by the lingering regrets of Jiang Tianming and Yun Yan'er were filled with unwillingness and pain, and within their eyes, there was boundless fear.
They opened their mouths as if wanting to say something, but could no longer speak.
Thud!
The two ethereal heads burst like bubbles and disappeared.
Jiang Tianming and Yun Yan'er had completely perished!
Blood Extreme's lips trembled, "What Cultivation Technique is this?"
In his consciousness, there was still only that spear thrust from just before, indescribable, beyond words, a thrust that, once unleashed, pierced his Remnant Soul.
The ultimate power of slaughter was dissolving his Remnant Soul.
It was as if any Divine Soul couldn't escape or resist that spear thrust.
Blood Extreme thought that although he was a Remnant Soul, he was once a mighty existence; how could he be harmed by a mere warrior of the Immortal Realm, even of the Heavenly Union Realm?
Even if they cultivated an immensely strong technique for slaughtering souls, due to their lower realm, they should not be able to damage this one Remnant Soul of his.
Yet, he had misjudged everything.
And in this final moment, he suddenly realized that the slaughter technique Jiang Buping used with that spear thrust completely surpassed his understanding. It was no longer just a simple secret technique for slaughtering Divine Souls, or a mere Cultivation Technique for Slaughter the Soul.
How could such a monstrous genius emerge in the Taicang Domain?
And this path of slaughter, enormously powerful, capable of creating such a formidable method of slaughter, and also being within the Taicang Domain, there should not be a second person able to accomplish this.
But, hadn't he already died?
Jiang Buping indifferently said, "You're not worthy to know!"
Thud!
Blood Extreme dissipated into bloody mist, his one Remnant Soul extinguished.
In the Taikun Realm, amidst the wilderness, within that pile of rocks, brownish-red flames emerged, revealing the face of Blood Extreme.
"Dead?!"
He looked astonished, his one Remnant Soul was not weak; even a Heavenly Union Realm Warrior couldn't resist it, and shouldn't be able to kill it.
Yet it had perished!
"Jiang Buping, huh?"
Muttering to himself, Blood Extreme disappeared underground.
All the strong warriors fell silent, a powerful Netherworld warrior's Remnant Soul had vanished into thin air.
