Great Elders of the Jiang Clan and others had complex expressions, the grudge between Jiang Buping and Jiang Tianming had ended in this moment, and along with it, perhaps, was the end of all ties between Jiang Buping and the Jiang Clan.
Members of the Wanbao Alliance, like Hong Yi and Hong Er, were delighted at this moment; the stronger Jiang Buping was, the better, as it meant a higher chance of defeating Meng Chong.
Even if they ultimately couldn't defeat Meng Chong, as long as they injured him, or even made him expend a great amount of energy, their chance in the Wanbao Alliance would come!
Jiang Buping pointed his Long Spear and coldly looked towards the Yun Shang Sect, "I'm going to kill the Sect Master of Yun Shang Sect. Does anyone object, does anyone want to stop me?"
The powerful warriors of Yun Shang Sect fell silent at this moment and began to step back, leaving the Sect Master of Yun Shang Sect alone in his original spot.
Jiang Buping had become invincible!
"A moment of folly, the bitter fruit of one's own doing, there's no need for your hand!"
The Sect Master of Yun Shang Sect gave a despondent smile.
Thud!
His body dissolved, his Divine Soul extinguished, he perished on his own!
Jiang Buping's cold gaze still fixed on the Yun Shang Sect, and just then, the Great Elder of Yun Shang Sect, with a stern expression, reached out and grasped, capturing several figures.
"The former Sect Master made a great mistake, bringing difficulty to our Sect. All of you, his confidants, in order to protect the inheritance of Yun Shang Sect, today I shall purge the remnants of the former Sect Master!"
As the Great Elder of Yun Shang Sect spoke, the other elders tacitly acted, and in no time at all, all within Yun Shang Sect related to the former Sect Master, Yun Yan'er, and others, were slain.
"The remnants of the Yun Family have been executed. We humbly ask for your mercy, Master Jiang, and spare our Yun Shang Sect once!"
The Great Elder of Yun Shang Sect and others spoke respectfully yet fearfully.
Jiang Buping indifferently shifted his gaze away, the people in Yun Shang Sect who deserved to be killed were all dead, and those who remained no longer had any enmity with him; the matter of Yun Shang Sect was thus concluded.
He walked towards the Jiang Clan camp.
At this moment, many in the Jiang Clan looked pale and trembled all over.
"Buping, you..."
The Great Elder opened his mouth as if to say something, but Jiang Buping coldly said, "I have no ties with the Jiang Family anymore!"
His gaze passed directly over the Clan Chief of the Jiang Clan and turned cold as he looked at several of the elders, his gaze freezing over.
Woosh!
With a spear thrust, in an instant, an elder let out a blood-curdling scream, his flesh collapsing and his Divine Soul dissolving bit by bit.
The other elders, frightened to a pale white, hastily moved away from the one who was struck.
Boom!
Suddenly, several elders used their most powerful secret techniques, attempting to flee.
Jiang Buping, however, was calm, one spear thrust after another, with screams following each thrust, causing everyone to feel a chill.
Those were screams of agony from the pain of the Divine Soul.
The several elders of the Jiang Clan, their flesh collapsing, Divine Souls dissolving, yet were unable to die immediately.
This was Jiang Buping's revenge, making them suffer the torture of the soul before death!
At this moment, the outcast had retaliated, grievances settled, and the bitterness in his heart was vented out.
Jiang Buping coldly glanced at the people of the Jiang Clan one more time, then turned and left, with no one daring to detain him, nor did anyone dare to speak.
The warriors who had come from various Realms now felt a slight regret, as the Jiang Clan hadn't engaged in a clan-wide battle against Jiang Buping, and Jiang Buping hadn't flattened the Jiang Clan.
Despite a slight disappointment, they did not regret coming, for they witnessed such a terrifying battle and saw with their own eyes the Spear Demon's path of slaughter!

chapters.title: Chapter 891 - 464 Grudges Resolved, Sky Falls, Dragon Plummets_2
chapters.content:
The crowd gathered in Taikun Realm, and the battle of the discarded child's counterattack, which had captivated a multitude of watchers, had now concluded. It would surely spread throughout the Divine Realm and become a prominent chapter in the history of Martial Arts in the Divine Realm, a story to be relished by many.
At this moment, Jiang Buping looked up towards a certain direction.
"Come, let's have a battle."
"Good!"
The crowd of powerful beings was momentarily taken aback before they became excited.
Spear Demon versus Heavenly God?!
The strong from the Wanbao Alliance were even more thrilled, having finally waited for this battle. Whether they could slay their formidable enemy today was the question!
Boom!
As Meng Chong stepped out, golden light blossomed, resembling a Heavenly God. Holding a great saber, he stirred up wind and thunder, changing the color of the sky and earth.
In Taikun Realm, all the strong beings were excitedly watching the battle between the Spear Demon and the Heavenly God, yet they were unaware that in the distant Dragon Mountain Realm, a tumultuous event that would shake the Divine Realm was descending!
Above Dragon Abyss, dark clouds blanketed the sky, lightning flickered, and the silver chains, glowing with a stream of brilliance, began to solidify the phantom of the Splendid Giant Tiger.
A formidable divine presence surged towards the firmament.
Roar!
The tiger's roar shook the firmament, and a vast majestic force swept across the domain.
Boom!
The thunder flashed, the silver chains pulled taut, and the heavy dark clouds continued to spread downward, within which one could vaguely see a world of its own.
Ao!
Suddenly, after a thunderous explosion, a roar was faintly heard. With that roar, the domain lost its color, and the phantom of the Splendid Giant Tiger, as if stimulated by something, also began to roar.
Atop the Jade Platform in Dragon Abyss, the Wind Spirit Tiger suddenly realized something was amiss.
Its strength uncontrollably stirred, blood boiling, it looked up, and its pupils abruptly constricted, revealing a look of shock.
"Tian Shiqi, what is this?"
The Wind Spirit Tiger howled.
No one responded.
In that moment, the Wind Spirit Tiger realized that something was wrong. Why did it feel like it was being sacrificed?
However, as it gazed toward the Heavenly Tiger Essence Blood about to emerge, it couldn't bear to leave.
Roar!
With a roar, its momentum burst forth, and in an instant, it transformed into a giant tiger, unleashing all its might at that moment.
Boom!
Thunder rumbled, the clouds descended, the chains cracking.
The Spirit Beasts of the Dragon Mountain Realm had already prostrated themselves on the ground, daring not to move in the slightest.
And the Martial Artists of Dragon Mountain Realm had a sense of impending doom, a feeling of crisis descending.
"What's happening?"
"I don't know, but my instincts tell me there might be a great danger."
"No good, Dragon Mountain Realm isn't safe, we need to leave!"
Some keen Martial Artists hurriedly moved towards the Realm Gate, preparing to exit the Dragon Mountain Realm.
Boom!
"Almost there!"
Tian Shiqi looked towards Dragon Abyss from afar, holding a pink pearl in his hand.
"Add a touch of flame, create a larger disturbance."
He raised his hand and shot the pink pearl onto a chain. Immediately, a layer of pink light traveled along the chain upwards into the depths of the clouds.
Ao!
A roar came from within the clouds, thunder tumultuous, the winds and clouds changing, the dark clouds growing even denser. But within the clouds, the scene resembling a small domain gradually became clearer.
Roar!
A Splendid Giant Tiger was also roaring.
In a moment, on the Jade Platform of Dragon Abyss, a drop of Heavenly Tiger Essence Blood finally surfaced, transforming into a small Splendid Heavenly Tiger.
The Wind Spirit Tiger was overjoyed inside, and with a swift gulp, it swallowed the essence blood.
Just as it swallowed the essence blood, a booming sound resonated within its consciousness, staggering it until it saw stars.
At a certain moment, it felt as if it had lost control of its body.
Moreover, an overwhelming divine presence emerged within it, stimulating its bloodline, purifying its bloodline. Although this should have been a cause for excitement, at that moment, the Wind Spirit Tiger was far from happy.
A strong sense of crisis emerged in its mind, and it was unable to flee even if it wanted to.
Roar!
The Heavenly Tiger roared up to the sky, assuming an attack stance, as if it had encountered a formidable enemy, as if its fighting spirit had been ignited.
The Wind Spirit Tiger's Divine Soul was trembling.
It felt a great sense of doom, for this drop of Heavenly Tiger Essence Blood continued to be consumed, along with its spirit and essence. Even though the process had purified its bloodline, if it continued like this, death was certain!
Moreover, the Wind Spirit Tiger sensed within the thick clouds above the Firmament—an immense terror lying in wait, staring at it, or rather, its roar had enraged that great terror.
No!
It wasn't it—it was the aura of the Heavenly Tiger that had enraged the terror within the clouds!
Boom!
The clouds had already pressed down above the Dragon Abyss, the chains making a clicking noise, as if they could break at any moment.
At a certain moment, the phantom image of the Heavenly Tiger merged with the Wind Spirit Tiger, transforming into a powerful Heavenly Tiger with a posture of attack, roaring into the sky.
A surge of Heavenly Tiger energy swirled around its body, slamming against the Firmament.
Roar!
A bellow that resounded through the Domain emerged, bringing a terrifying pressure that could make all beasts bow and all creatures of the Domain tremble.
As if the roaring entity was born with divine might.
The Wind Spirit Tiger's Divine Soul trembled, but it couldn't control itself.
The Heavenly Tiger and the being within the clouds roared at each other, further inciting rage. The clouds descended, thunder roared, and the storm surged. At a certain moment, a crackling sound erupted.
Immediately afterward, the Wind Spirit Tiger was horrified to see that the sky had burst!
The chains broke at the moment the clouds exploded, and as the thunder tumbled, the sky had burst!
It resembled a small Domain or perhaps a special space, which suddenly collapsed, and with it went the Firmament.
As the Firmament collapsed, like a funnel, an even more torrential Spiritual Energy poured forth, and the Domain Lingji became extremely active in an instant.
A mysterious charm also emerged within this part of the Domain above the Dragon Abyss.
The Wind Spirit Tiger saw above the Firmament—the even more vast Domain beyond the Divine Realm. Even though only a corner was visible, it was enough to captivate the soul.
This was the place that, according to legend, one could only ascend to when the Heavenly Ladder was opened.
At a certain moment, two words emerged within the consciousness of the Wind Spirit Tiger's Divine Soul, as if coming from the bloodline inheritance of the Heavenly Tiger.
Dao Realm!
Before the Wind Spirit Tiger could understand why the sky had collapsed, something even more terrifying happened!
As the Firmament crumbled and the clouds dispersed, amidst the rolling thunder and pervasive bone-chilling cold, there were flakes of snow, falling like thunderbolts.
Amongst the thunder and snowflakes, an object plummeted below!
Roar!
The Heavenly Tiger roared, unleashing a horrific attack. The giant maw spat out a wind capable of destroying heaven and earth, and under the control of the Heavenly Tiger's will, the body of the Wind Spirit Tiger fiercely pounced forward.
"Ahhh!"
The Divine Soul of the Wind Spirit Tiger let out a panicked scream.
As the sky collapsed, what fell was none other than a True Dragon!
A True Dragon that only existed in legends—that had never been seen before!
The sky collapses and the dragon falls!
A battle between dragon and tiger, huh? What worth does it, the Wind Spirit Tiger, have to fight a True Dragon?
"Tian Shiqi, I fucked your ****!"
The Wind Spirit Tiger cursed aloud.
Roar!
A dragon's roar reverberated through the Domain, the cold and majestic dragon's might stirring between heaven and earth. A jade white, several hundred zhang long dragon looked down, its dragon aura stirring the storm and colliding with the Heavenly Tiger's energy.
In the midst of the thunderous roars above the Firmament, the crack in the corner of the Dao Realm seemed to be slowly healing.
The cold was bone-chilling, the snowflakes thunderous. A dragon claw reached down, tore through the will of the Heavenly Tiger, annihilated its aura, and reached directly toward the Wind Spirit Tiger.
After the will of the Heavenly Tiger was extinguished, the Wind Spirit Tiger abruptly regained control of its body. However, at that moment, it felt an overwhelming weakness, as if it had almost exhausted all its essence blood.
Even though its blood had been purified, and the remaining essence blood was replaced with the more refined Heavenly Tiger blood, the Wind Spirit Tiger couldn't feel any joy.
Not to mention whether its consumed essence blood could recover, the current crisis was impossible to overcome!
It was a True Dragon, after all!
Its strength was greatly diminished due to weakness; it couldn't withstand this strike even at the peak of its powers!
"Tian Shiqi, I fought with your mother for eighteen rounds; you're a bastard!"
The Wind Spirit Tiger roared in despair and anger.
As the dragon claw reached down, it saw the jade white, flawless eyes of the True Dragon were actually blood red, extremely irritable as if it had lost its reason, as if rage had taken control of its sanity.
At that moment, the scalp of the Wind Spirit Tiger tingled. Tian Shiqi and his gang of bastards even dared to scheme against a True Dragon!
The crisis of death loomed, and suddenly, it noticed a Jade Talisman within its Divine Soul, a life-saving treasure given by its younger brother Red Cat.
There was no time to think, in a panic it activated the Jade Talisman!

chapters.title: Chapter 892 - 465 The Calamity of the True Dragon, The Great Catastrophe of the Divine Realm
chapters.content:
Dragon Abyss, rumored to be formed from the fall of a True Dragon, its authenticity undebatable.
But on this day, a flawless Jade White True Dragon plummeted down from the collapsing firmament.
Within the Dragon Mountain Realm, all Spirit Beasts shuddered and prostrated on the ground, daring not to make the slightest sound.
Every Martial Artist, at this very moment, felt as though they heard a majestic and awe-inspiring chant that pressured the domain, an inexplicable fear emerging from the depths of their hearts.
Almost subconsciously, they couldn't help but look towards the direction of Dragon Abyss.
"Did that Flood Dragon find some True Dragon treasure and transform into a True Dragon?"
A Martial Artist expressed in amazement and doubt.
"Impossible, even if it did find True Dragon treasure, it may not necessarily transform into a True Dragon. What strength does it have?"
"Surely it can't be that a True Dragon has descended into this world?"
Some Martial Artists, keen on crisis, had already madly fled toward the Realm Gate, escaping the Dragon Mountain Realm.
Outside Dragon Abyss, Tian Shiqi, who had been stationed there all along, had already sped away when the roar of dragons and tigers began and the dark clouds started to dissipate.
"I've finally succeeded, next, just wait for the Heavenly Ladder of the Taihe Realm to open!"
"The chaos of the True Dragon, the calamity of the Divine Realm, if not now, when will the Heavenly Ladder open?"
"Hurry and leave, or with my strength, I would be targeted by the True Dragon first thing; pity the Wind Spirit Tiger, though it got its wish and enhanced its bloodline, I never said it could still be alive after that!"
"The task of the Heavenly Venerable is finally completed at the most critical step. Next, it's time for the Dao Realm to descend and fuse with the Divine Realm, the initial step towards Unity of Domain.
"When Unity of Domain occurs, the Heavenly Venerable will surely take the lead."
"It's no wonder the Heavenly Venerable is so clever; they managed to trap a True Dragon above this tiny space in Dragon Abyss, and then opened a crack between the Divine Realm and the Dao Realm, allowing the energy of the Dao Realm to pour down."
Tian Shiqi inwardly admired the wisdom and meticulous planning of the Heavenly Venerable.
"Xu Yan, Meng Chong, or even Jiang Buping, they are all unworthy of concern. Let them contribute to the Unity of Domain during the chaos of the True Dragon and the calamity of the Divine Realm."
Tian Shiqi thought coldly.
Whoosh!
Arriving at the Realm Gate, he didn't hurry to leave but silently looked towards the direction of Dragon Abyss.
At a certain moment, feeling the tremble of Domain, the distant dragon's chant came, and he revealed a smile before stepping through the Realm Gate and leaving.
In the sky above Dragon Abyss, the Jade White True Dragon hundreds of feet long, with thunder and snow swirling around it, had bloodshot eyes and a dragon's might stirring the domain, its concealed killing intent completely unrestrained.
And below the True Dragon was the trembling Wind Spirit Tiger, its paw ready to crush and tear apart the Wind Spirit Tiger!
At the critical moment of life and death, the Wind Spirit Tiger saw that Jade Talisman!
This Jade Talisman was specially obtained by Red Cat from Li Xuan for the Wind Spirit Tiger, intended solely to save the life of the Wind Spirit Tiger, and it was because of this that the Talisman emerged silently at the most critical moment, allowing the Wind Spirit Tiger to notice it.
If the Wind Spirit Tiger didn't activate the Jade Talisman, at the last moment, the Talisman would have activated itself.
After all, its purpose was to save the Wind Spirit Tiger from crisis.
Hum!
The Jade Talisman was activated, in an instant, the Wind Spirit Tiger felt an immense force acting upon it, and before it could even react, the entire tiger, with incredible speed, escaped from under the dragon's claw in a flash.
Whoosh!
The speed was so fast that the Wind Spirit Tiger couldn't even perceive its existence, let alone know how far it had fled.
Yet inside, it was overwhelmed with excitement.
Tears couldn't be restrained from flowing out.
It survived, it survived under the claw of the True Dragon.
At this moment, it wanted to roar to the heavens; it had actually escaped from the claw of a True Dragon, something unbelievable.
After all, that was a True Dragon, and one far stronger than itself; it had managed to escape, and throughout the ages, there might not be a second tiger able to accomplish this.
"Dearest brother, it's you who saved my life, such a precious life-saving treasure, and you were willing to give it to me, such gratitude, such kindness, is beyond repayment!"
The Wind Spirit Tiger was deeply moved.
The Jade Talisman shone brightly, carrying it across the sky, and the Wind Spirit Tiger didn't even know how far it had escaped or when it would be able to stop.
Above Dragon Abyss, the flawless Jade White True Dragon, swooping down with one paw, caught nothing but air, its crimson eyes filling with rage.
Roar!
With a roar, the True Dragon circled, its chilling dragon's might stirring the space between heaven and earth, as delicate snowflakes began to fall.
Boom!
Dragon Abyss collapsed, the mountains collapsed!
The Roar of the True Dragon swept out with the snowstorm, as a Jade White True Dragon, leaving Dragon Abyss, swept through Dragon Mountain Realm, causing countless Spirit Beasts to crouch in terror; even Spirit Beasts of the Immortal Realm trembled from the chill deep within their blood and soul.
"All should die!"
Within the dragon's might, a furious thought reverberated.
"Is that... a True Dragon?!"
In a great city within Dragon Mountain Realm, everyone watched the stirring winds and chilling cold spread across the domain as a hundred-zhang long Jade White True Dragon coiled and roared in the sky.
"Run for it!"
At a certain moment, someone cried out, and everyone soared into the air, fleeing in all directions.
Regardless of the True Dragon's intentions, none of them could withstand the surging dragon's might and the churning of the clouds.
"Where's the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, hurry and stop it!"
Someone yelled aloud.
The Martial Artist fleeing at the forefront had an extremely dark expression, cursing inwardly; what good was being of the Immortal Realm? Was it not just delivering oneself to death?
"All should die! Kill! Kill! Kill!"
The thoughts vibrating with dragon's might came crashing down, filled with ruthlessness.
"Quick, hide underground!"
Before the True Dragon arrived, a multitude of True King Heavenly Venerables flying in escape vomited blood and fell from mid-air, their Divine Souls shaken by the dragon's might, their flesh unable to bear it.

chapters.title: Chapter 893 - 465: True Dragon Disaster, Divine Realm Great Calamity_2
chapters.content:
Moreover, the speed of the True Dragon was so fast that there was no way they could escape it.
Boom!
The Martial Artist fleeing in front saw that the people who had fallen to the ground had luckily not died, and the True Dragon did not pursue them to kill them, so he quickly came down from mid-air and lay on the ground, not daring to move.
Boom!
It felt as if a heavy mountain was pressuring down on them, even rolling over them. Feeling the terrifying Dragon Might above, the people lying on the ground were all trembling with fear; some even wetted themselves from fear.
As the Dragon Might moved away, everyone breathed a sigh of relief; the True Dragon had not killed the people lying on the ground.
Could it be that the True Dragon thought they had submitted and thus disdained to kill them?
In any case, they had escaped with their lives.
"The True Dragon is too terrifying!"
"How could there be a True Dragon here?"
"Quick, hide! The Divine Realm is going to be chaotic!"
The Martial Artists hurriedly scattered in all directions to find places to hide.
The escaping Immortal Heavenly Venerable, seeing the True Dragon pursuing to kill, hastily descended to the ground and lay down like the other Martial Artists.
Dignity and pride mattered not at all now, especially when faced with the legendary True Dragon!
However!
The True Dragon did not spare him; its dragon claw reached down.
Boom!
Seeing there was no escape, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable could only burst forth in a rage.
"True Dragon, I have no grievances with you, why do you strike to kill me? I have already submitted!"
"Die! You all should die, all of you should die!"
What answered him was the frenzied will of the True Dragon.
The heart of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable sank. The True Dragon seemed to have lost its reason, becoming extremely irritable, and it targeted Martial Artists above the Immortal Realm?
Spurt!
The dragon claw tore through all his defenses, and the bone-chilling coldness wrapped around the claw, piercing into his Divine Soul.
Crack!
With one strike of its claw, an Immortal Heavenly Venerable was instantly shattered to dust, his Divine Soul completely extinguished!
The path of the True Dragon turned thunder to ice and snow, with bone-chilling coldness, its Dragon Might vast and wild, ravaging the Dragon Mountain Realm. In just a few days, all the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Dragon Mountain Realm had fallen!
The Spirit Beasts of the Immortal Realm either fled or successfully hid from the calamity, with all others being torn apart!
The True Dragon roared, its Dragon Might vast and wild, and the big city at the Realm Gate of the Dragon Mountain Realm was already deserted, with a Jade White True Dragon hundreds of yards long destroying the city and roaring as it entered the Realm Gate.
The Taihe Realm was thrown into chaos, with numerous Immortal Heavenly Venerables joining forces in an attempt to hunt down the True Dragon. But in the end, all of them fell, none surviving.
The three Immortal Realm Heavenly Venerables from the Battle Hall, having refined their fighting will to the extreme and pushed it to its limits, sought to confront the Dragon Might, to temper their will, and even to fight the True Dragon.
But after only one encounter, they were hunted down!
Wherever the True Dragon went, the strong perished, and great cities collapsed, leaving ruins everywhere.
The news was spreading at a rapid pace to all realms of the Divine Realm, with everyone who heard it shocked and disbelieving. The True Dragon has descended into the Divine Realm?
And it's slaughtering the mighty of the Divine Realm?
The calamity of the True Dragon, a great disaster for the Divine Realm!
The strong from all major powers, upon hearing the news, were immediately horrified.
In the Taikun Realm, the battle between the Spear Demon and the Heavenly God was nearing its end. The observing powerhouses were all shocked. Was this still the Immortal Realm?
How could an Immortal Realm Warrior possess such terrifying power?
And what kind of dreadful Martial Arts was that?
The Heavenly God turned into a giant, swords creating wind and thunder, stars twinkling, the wild and domineering physical strength managing to withstand the Slaughter the Soul technique of the Spear Demon.
This battle, it was clear to everyone that the Spear Demon was slightly at a disadvantage.
"Exhilarating!"
Meng Chong laughed heartily.
Jiang Buping sheathed his spear with a smile, "This battle is over; the transaction with the Wanbao Alliance is complete!"
From afar, the strong of the Wanbao Alliance felt a sense of foreboding.
Especially Hong Yi and Hong Er, who intuitively felt they had been tricked.
The battle between Jiang Buping and Meng Chong seemed fierce, as if both were giving their all, yet there wasn't a sense of a fight to the death.
It was more like a sparring match!
"Could these two know each other?"
At this moment, the strong of the Wanbao Alliance couldn't help but entertain this thought.
The moment this thought surfaced, I immediately felt a great sense of foreboding.
"Wanbao Alliance, you've been chasing me for such a long time, can you give me an explanation now?"
Boom!
Meng Chong's aura was like a rainbow, instantly appearing in front of a group of strong warriors from the Wanbao Alliance.
The rest of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables near the Wanbao Alliance's mighty warriors were frightened into hastily keeping their distance, afraid of being mistaken for members of the Wanbao Alliance.
"It was our Wanbao Alliance who was in the wrong first, it was our Wanbao Alliance that was not right, Young Master Meng please let's talk it out, let's talk it out, we are willing to compensate and apologize!"
Hong Yi and other strong warriors from the Wanbao Alliance decisively cowered.
They had to cower; the might of a Heavenly God was too ferocious.
"Willing to compensate and apologize, that's easy to talk about."
Meng Chong gave a wide grin.
The other strong warriors looked at the Wanbao Alliance with strange expressions. Having been plundered by Meng Chong at many branches, the Wanbao Alliance was now bowing their heads in acknowledgment of their faults and compensating with apologies, their deterrence greatly diminished in an instant.
Moreover, this time they would inevitably have to pay a hefty price to appease Meng Chong's wrath.
The storm in the Taikun Realm had ended, and as for how the Wanbao Alliance compensated Meng Chong, outsiders did not know. They only knew that the mighty warriors of the Wanbao Alliance were as uncomfortable as if their homes had been raided.
Warriors from the external realms began to leave one after another, and at this moment, a message that shook the Divine Realm arrived!
In the Dragon Mountain Realm, a True Dragon descended, causing disaster in the Divine Realm!
In the Taihe Realm, almost all the Immortal Heavenly Venerables fell!
The calamity of the True Dragon was sweeping across the entire Divine Realm. Everywhere it passed was left in ruins, and there were rumors that this True Dragon had fallen into a rage and had lost its sanity.
What shocked the mighty warriors even more was the fact that martial artists below the True King Heavenly Venerable, if they could avoid the True Dragon and prostrate on the ground, were not killed by its aftershocks and could escape this disaster.
Yet the Immortal Heavenly Venerables had no means of escape, regardless of whether they surrendered or submitted prostrate, they were all annihilated by the True Dragon!
A major disaster descended upon the Divine Realm!
Not only that, under the ravages of the True Dragon, even the Heavenly Grotto had been trampled flat, and all the creatures from beyond the heavens were annihilated, the True Dragon stirring the winds and clouds of the Domain, causing the energy of the Divine Realm to become turbulent.
"How did the True Dragon come to be?"
"This is a bad sign, how can we resist such a powerful True Dragon?"
"That's a True Dragon, and it has lost its reason, knowing only of rage and slaughter. What do we do now?"
"It's said that the True Dragon is heading toward the Great Realm!"
As the message continued to spread, all the mighty warriors were astonished.
Following that, a message came from the Taihe Realm: The mighty warriors of the Great Realm of the Divine Realm were all gathering in the Taihe Realm to discuss the suppression of the True Dragon.
"True Dragon, second brother, should we go and meet the True Dragon?"
Jiang Buping said with eagerness.
Meng Chong's expression was grave, "The arrival of the True Dragon doesn't seem right; there is likely a conspiracy hidden behind it. Let's wait and see how the Divine Realm responds."
Jiang Buping nodded. The True Dragon had always been the stuff of rumors, and now, a True Dragon had fallen into the Divine Realm, raging and losing its sanity, slaughtering everywhere.
Even more eerie was the fact that it was only killing warriors above the Immortal Realm, which was very targeted.
Clearly, someone was planning something.
"The first senior brother is in the Azure Sea Sphere and couldn't make it in time. With the emergence of this calamity of the True Dragon, the first senior brother should be coming from the Azure Sea Sphere very quickly."
Meng Chong thought of the first senior brother's Subduing Dragon Palm.
The first senior brother would probably want to test the might of the Subduing Dragon Palm to see if it could subdue the dragon.
"Let's go, let's head to the Taihe Realm to see how they deal with the disaster of the True Dragon!"
Meng Chong and Jiang Buping vanished from their spot in the blink of an eye.
"Senior, how strong is a True Dragon?"
Wu Tianan, with a shocked expression, approached a slovenly old man to ask.
The slovenly old man had an odd look in his eyes and chuckled after hearing the question: "That's hard to say. Young dragons are relatively weak, and the strength among True Dragons varies greatly. Of course, generally speaking, the strength of True Dragons is among the top tiers of all beings.
"True Dragons are born with tremendous might and naturally possess the True Dragon Technique. Even the weakest adult True Dragon would not be inferior to a Divine Venerable Realm.
"And the strong True Dragons, their strength is of the very highest echelon, beyond measure."
Wu Tianan was shaken by what he heard and then asked, "Senior, what is a Divine Venerable Realm?"
"Above the Immortal Realm is the Heavenly Union Realm, and above the Heavenly Union Realm is the Divine Venerate Realm. A Divine Venerate Martial Artist is like a god of heaven and earth, far beyond what an Immortal Realm Warrior could imagine."
The slovenly old man said cheerfully.
He looked at Wu Tianan, the more he looked, the more he found something unusual, that strong destiny of his, he did not doubt that Wu Tianan would be able to escape alive if he encountered the True Dragon.
"How strange, why does this destiny feel as though it is favored by the Domain?"
The old man was full of doubts. There were now three individuals whom he could not see through: Jiang Buping, Meng Chong, and Wu Tianan.
For Jiang Buping and Meng Chong, what he could not fathom was their unfathomable Martial Arts, and for Wu Tianan, it was that unusual destiny, which yet seemed vaguely familiar.

chapters.title: Chapter 894 - 466 Xiang Long's Opportunity Arrives, The Sea Spirit Treasure Vault
chapters.content:
Wu Tianan's gaze towards the elder changed somewhat; he knew his own fate was rather peculiar, and upon meeting the elder, he instinctively drew close, cozying up to him.
There had to be a reason for it.
Now, listening to the elder speak of the realms above the Immortal Realm, he realized that the elder's strength must be extremely formidable. Could he be a warrior from the Divine Venerate Realm?
"So it turns out Senior is a powerful being from the Divine Venerate, my disrespect!"
Wu Tianan said respectfully.
"Divine Venerate, huh, haha!"
The elder laughed.
"May I inquire how Senior should be addressed?"
Wu Tianan asked respectfully and curiously.
"This old man wanders everywhere, carefree and leisurely, just call me Old Xiaoyao."
The elder said after a moment's thought.
"So it is Senior Xiaoyao!"
Wu Tianan's respect deepened.
"I wonder, Senior Xiaoyao, what are your thoughts on this True Dragon calamity?"
Old Xiaoyao, seeming to be a warrior from the Divine Venerate Realm or perhaps even stronger, might he be able to suppress that True Dragon?
"The calamity of the True Dragon? Maybe so. This matter is not for this old man to interfere with; naturally, someone else will worry about it."
Old Xiaoyao chuckled.
Wu Tianan was very curious about the rumored True Dragons and couldn't help but continue to inquire about them.
In the end, Old Xiaoyao said, "The one that fell into the Divine Realm is but a young dragon, not yet of age. It is a Jade Snow True Dragon, but its bloodline is extraordinary. Some folks are so fond of scheming, a careless move that loses control might just annoy that old dragon, and then there will be quite a spectacle to watch!"
Old Xiaoyao chuckled merrily, looking as if he was watching a play unfold.
"Jade Snow True Dragon? Not yet of age?"
Wu Tianan mulled over the elder's words, gathering that the elder knew quite a bit about True Dragons, and it was clear that the True Spirit in the Divine Realm was calculatedly brought down.
Its extraordinary bloodline must be the descendant of the "old dragon" mentioned by Old Xiaoyao. That old dragon must be incredibly fearsome in strength.
"Kid, just enjoy the show. Although your destiny is not bad, your strength is far too weak. Once you encounter those people, you won't be able to escape, and your fate might easily draw their attention."
Old Xiaoyao warned him.
"Thank you for the warning, Senior."
Wu Tianan's heart chilled, but he was not overly worried, thinking the worst-case scenario would be to return to the Qinghua state and stay by senior's side.
"Since entering the Divine Realm, I have been looking for my mentor in Martial Arts but to no avail; I wonder if Senior could be..."
Wu Tianan hadn't forgotten the person he was looking for.
As he spoke, he took out a scroll.
"With your fate, you will surely find some information sooner or later. The people I know are definitely beyond your reach."
Old Xiaoyao waved his hand dismissively and turned to leave, saying, "I'm off to enjoy the show, we'll meet again if destiny allows it!"
Wu Tianan felt helpless but thought there was sense in Old Xiaoyao's words. How could he possibly reach those known by someone of such great strength?
"Where on earth could Sister be? Has she met with misfortune?"
Wu Tianan felt a tightness in his heart.
Remembering the scene of their first meeting, his sister had been seriously injured and was being pursued. Could it be that she failed to escape the crisis and perished?
Even if she had perished, there should still be information to be found, such as the forces that had pursued her.
"Enough, I'll head to the Taihe Realm to see how the Divine Realm is dealing with this great calamity."
Wu Tianan set out for the Taihe Realm.
...
In the Di Yun Realm, the ground was covered in dense and heavy clouds, thicker than ever before.
The Heavenly Grotto had become increasingly enormous, and clouds swirled around its entrance, like a vortex in motion, as if brewing something or suppressing something.
The figure of Tian Shiqi emerged, arriving at the front of the Heavenly Grotto.
"Is it done?"
The warriors of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow stationed at the Heavenly Grotto asked in a deep voice.
"It is done, the True Dragon has fallen, the great disaster of the Divine Realm has begun, the Heavenly Ladder of the Taihe Realm is about to open."
Tian Shiqi nodded.
"Will the opening of the Dao Domain Ladder bring the descent of Divine Venerates or even the Supreme Sovereign?"
Another warrior asked curiously.
"Do you think they have a chance to descend?"
"Makes sense!"
Tian Shiqi looked towards the mouth of the Heavenly Grotto and said sternly, "How are you all progressing with the mission from our lord? Everything must be ready before the ladder opens!"
"Rest assured, we can trigger it at any time," the warrior guarding the Heavenly Grotto chuckled.
"However, if we can offer the blood sacrifice of martial artists, the power will be even stronger, and we can stir the rules of heaven and earth even more. Maybe we can shake down the Dao Realm and unite with the Divine Realm."
One of the Heavenly Slaughters said in a deep voice.
"There is no shortage of strong warriors in this Di Yun Realm, and by now some must have noticed some anomalies here. It's a good time to clear the area. I will make a move and collect some martial artist blood."
Upon hearing this, Tian Shiqi nodded indifferently.
He then looked out towards the thick mists outside the Heavenly Grotto where a warrior was cautiously approaching.
"These past few days, many inquiring warriors have come. We've thrown them all into the Heavenly Grotto for sacrifice."
One of the Heavenly Slaughters said with a laugh.
Tian Shiqi moved instantly, vanishing in a blink.
The calamity of the True Dragon had drawn the attention of the entire Divine Realm, and many strong warriors of the Di Yun Realm had departed to discuss the calamity.
In those days, the great powers of the Di Yun Realm sensed something unusual in the central region and sent warriors to investigate, all of whom disappeared.
All signs indicated that there was some sort of situation occurring in the central region of the Di Yun Realm.
And on this day, a massacre took place in the Di Yun Realm, unknown to all, with no one able to get the news out.
In the Azure Sea Sphere, the Azure Sea Turtle lifted its head and looked up at the Firmament, a trace of solemnity on its face.
"I must find a better place to hide. The Taicang Domain is indeed about to change. If those folks find out I'm hiding here, that would be troublesome."

chapters.title: Chapter 895 - 466 Xiang Long's Opportunity Arrives, The Sea Spirit Treasure Vault_2
chapters.content:
Gurgling a few times, the massive body gradually shrank and melded with the seafloor, completely covered by the silt, not showing the slightest hint of life.
Azure Sea Turtle's Turtle Breath is its technique for hiding and preserving its life!
It was also the key to its escape from that great catastrophe long ago.
Xu Yan had emerged from seclusion on Yuntian Island, quelled the chaos in the Azure Sea Sphere's Heavenly Grotto, and reunited with Xie Lingfeng, whom he guided in cultivation. Time flew by, and he could no longer make it to the Taikun Realm, so he had to cancel the trip there.
Besides, with Jiang Buping's strength, taking revenge was a breeze, especially since his second junior brother Meng Chong was already in the Taikun Realm, more than capable of suppressing any unforeseen events.
Therefore, Xu Yan stayed on Yuntian Island, guiding Xie Lingfeng in cultivation and also imparting his knowledge of Sword Dao to Xie Tianheng.
Today, an elder from the great Sea Spirit Tribe came to visit, fulfilling the promise and allowing Xu Yan to select treasures from the Sea Spirit Clan Treasure Vault.
Naturally, the Sea Spirit Clan Treasure Vault was at the bottom of the sea.
However, Xu Yan was not at all afraid of any deception, for even underwater, he could go about unchallenged.
If the Sea Spirit Tribe thought they could have an advantage and suppress him underwater, they were courting their own destruction.
On his way to the Sea Spirit Clan Treasure Vault, Xu Yan was startled when he saw the messages from Meng Chong and Jiang Buping but then became excited.
A True Dragon had fallen into the Divine Realm?
And this True Dragon was wreaking havoc in the Divine Realm, invincible?
"I've been practicing the Subduing Dragon Palm all this time and, although I've killed countless enemies, demonstrating its might, the real strength of the Subduing Dragon Palm lies in subduing dragons!
"Dragons have always been part of legends; there are no True Dragons in the Inner Domain or the Spiritual Realm, and previously none had appeared in the Divine Realm.
"Now the opportunity has come; it's time to test the might of a True Dragon.
"Only by truly subduing a dragon can I break through the limitations of the Subduing Dragon Palm, truly understand its essence, and become even more powerful!"
Xu Yan was exhilarated.
To further advance the Subduing Dragon Palm, mere contemplation and battling enemies were not enough. Only by fighting a True Dragon and truly subduing it could he comprehend its essence!
"My master said to subdue a dragon with a dragon. Now it's time to see how the dragon might of my Subduing Dragon Palm compares with that of a real dragon. This opportunity will also allow me to cultivate the true might of a dragon, an even more magnificent Subduing Dragon Palm!"
Moreover, Xu Yan felt that only by truly battling a dragon and honing his skills with a True Dragon could he elevate the Subduing Dragon Palm to an incredible Divine Skill.
"Young Master Xu, this is our Sea Spirit Palace," said the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe, pointing to a splendid underwater palace complex ahead.
"The scenery in the sea is indeed varied and vibrant. Your Sea Spirit Palace is beautifully built," Xu Yan remarked, unable to help but praise.
"These are but small tricks. Our Sea Spirit Palace is actually quite average. It is said that the True Dragon Spirit Palace is even more splendid and vast," the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe sighed.
"Oh? How much do you know about True Dragons?" Xu Yan suddenly became interested.
The news of the True Dragon disaster had not yet reached the Azure Sea Sphere, mainly because there were no Communication Talismans to transmit messages. Relaying messages through other channels was bound to take some time.
"Actually, to say that our Sea Spirit Tribe is the supreme ruler of the seas is not entirely correct. As long as True Dragons exist, we are never the supreme rulers. True Dragons are born to rule the seas, and our tribe once belonged to the True Dragon Lineage..."
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe began to explain with a hint of lament.
The Sea Spirit Tribe belonged to one of the True Spirits within the True Dragon Lineage, serving the True Dragons in ruling the seas. However, the True Dragons had long since disappeared from the Divine Realm, and with the great changes of the Domain, many of the old secrets had become untraceable.
In the present day, the Sea Spirit Tribe had become the sovereign of the seas, though they no longer possessed their former strength.
Although the Sea Spirit Palace was underwater, the area within was a water-free zone.
A force of sea manipulation kept the waters at bay outside the Sea Spirit Palace, a natural ability of the Sea Spirit Tribe.
Guided by the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe, Xu Yan entered the Sea Spirit Palace, heading towards the treasury.
Many members of the Sea Spirit Tribe who were watching along the way, including beautiful women whose soft gazes indicated that as long as Xu Yan nodded, they would willingly embrace him.
Xu Yan saw an acquaintance, Haibo'er from the Spiritual Realm, this girl from the Sea Spirit Tribe was a top prodigy there, having sparred with him before.
In the Divine Realm of the Sea Spirit Tribe, her talent was not low, and she had just barely broken through to the Truth Refinement Realm. Her rate of cultivation was not slow.
Yet, the gap between them was inevitably widening.
Xu Yan nodded to Haibo'er as a greeting, for they were acquaintances, and it was only natural to acknowledge her upon meeting.
Haibo'er's face blushed, yet she revealed a look of joy. She bowed in response, but in the depths of her eyes, there was a complexity. After coming to the Divine Realm, she had been practising hard with the hope that one day, she could spar with Xu Yan again.
The gap between them had become as vast as a chasm, not only failing to narrow but growing ever wider.
Her current strength, in the eyes of those in the Immortal Realm, was as insignificant as an ant, easily crushed with a wave of the hand, and those in the Immortal Realm, in the eyes of Xu Yan, were as easily erased.
Even the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe had to treat him with the utmost respect.
"Young friend, our junior, indeed possesses stunning beauty and a gentle demeanor. Since you..."
Seeing this situation, the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe said joyously.
"It's just an old acquaintance saying hello."
Xu Yan said indifferently.
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe was taken aback. An old acquaintance?
He took note of this and decided to ask the junior of the Sea Spirit Tribe how they knew Xu Yan later.
Since there was a connection with Xu Yan, they must cultivate this junior well.
"This is the Sea Spirit Clan Treasure Vault."
Arriving in front of a palace that looked inconspicuous, even somewhat aged, the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe said.
"Greetings, Great Elder. This must be Sword God Xu Yan!"
An elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe appeared from where he was concealed and said respectfully.
"Indeed, this is our young friend, Sword God Xu Yan."
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe nodded.
Xu Yan glanced at the Sea Spirit Tribe elder and nodded his head, acknowledging the greeting.
This elder, who was in charge of the Treasure Vault, was not a whit weaker than the Great Elder.
"Our Sea Spirit Tribe has an ancient heritage, and though we have declined, due to some reasons, we have retained some ancient objects; our foundation still holds some depth. All these ancient objects are stored here."
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe opened the Treasure Vault, leading Xu Yan inside, while expressing his sentiments.
"This old palace is specifically designed to store precious treasures, to deceive the eyes and ears of others."
In this area, there were many old palaces, and ordinary people would probably never imagine that the Sea Spirit Tribe's core treasures were stored inside.
"Young friend, please feel free to take anything you fancy."
The Great Elder gestured invitingly.
"Since that is the case, I will not stand on ceremony."
Xu Yan nodded his head.
Inside the Sea Spirit Clan Treasure Vault, there were many precious treasured items, all of exceptional value, including some that were suffused with Daoist charm.
However, after obtaining the Prime Tortoise Carapace, ordinary treasures no longer caught Xu Yan's eye.
Moreover, even though the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe had promised that he could choose any treasure he liked, Xu Yan was not a greedy man and thus only planned to select a few items that caught his fancy.
"Eh? What is this?"
Xu Yan noticed an incredibly beautiful snowy garment, unsure of the material it was made from. It was so dazzling that he was moved.
"It is rumored that this was a garment of an Ancient Emperor of our Sea Spirit Tribe, a treasure. A strong female from the Taihe Realm once wished to buy this garment, but it was refused."
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe elucidated.
"Too bad there's only one piece."
Xu Yan shook his head.
At first, he wanted to take the garment for someone else, but upon reconsideration, giving it to Du Yuying or Yun Miaomiao seemed somewhat inappropriate.
If that was the case, then he would give it to neither!
"There's another one here."
Upon hearing this, the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe quickly opened a jade box on the Jade Platform under the garment, saying, "There are two in total. Since you like them, young friend, please take them!"
Anxious as if the jade box in his hands was a hot potato, the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe, overjoyed, packed the garments into the jade box and handed it to Xu Yan.
It was as if the jade box were burning his hands.
"These two garments have been coveted by someone. Due to various reasons, they were not obtained, but the individual likely still holds interest. Accepting them might attract some trouble, so please think thrice before taking them, young friend."
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe sighed as he spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 896 - 467: Stone Jar and Bamboo Slips, I am Off to Subdue the Dragon
chapters.content:
If the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe withheld information and tried to divert disaster elsewhere, Xu Yan's good impression of the Sea Spirit Tribe would evaporate. However, since the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe honestly clarified the pros and cons, Xu Yan was indifferent to the hot potato.
For the Sea Spirit Tribe, these two garments could bring crisis, but to Xu Yan, they were practically insignificant.
No matter who coveted them or how powerful they were, Xu Yan didn't care.
Since they suited his taste and could make good gifts, there was no reason not to accept them.
"To me, it's no trouble, so I'll take it."
Xu Yan accepted the jade box.
"A word of caution, Friend Xu, the one coveting this item may now be of the Divine Venerate Realm."
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe said solemnly.
"Divine Venerate Realm? No matter!"
Xu Yan chuckled, unconcerned.
"If Friend Xu has such confidence, then I am relieved."
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe breathed a sigh of relief.
Xu Yan continued to browse the treasury leisurely, seeking treasures that caught his eye.
After picking and choosing, and taking a few treasures, Xu Yan reckoned that he had found items for everyone he wanted to gift and there were no particularly alluring treasures left, so he prepared to leave.
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe interjected, "Friend Xu, why not take a look at those ancient relics? They are said to be extremely ancient."
"What's so special about these ancient relics?"
Xu Yan asked out of curiosity.
"I can't quite say!"
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe shook his head and led Xu Yan to a corner of the treasury, rhythmically tapping on the walls, and suddenly, an entrance appeared on the floor of the treasury corner.
"Friend Xu, follow me!"
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe entered the underground passage.
Xu Yan raised an eyebrow; this hidden treasure chamber was quite secret, likely elusive to the common strong.
Following the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe into the underground passage, they arrived in a modest treasure chamber spanning only a few zhang.
Upon entering the treasure chamber, one could immediately sense an ancient essence.
And even feel the sensation of time having settled.
There weren't many ancient objects in the treasure chamber.
Merely around a dozen, among which the most eye-catching was a shimmering, azure pearl.
Besides that, the other items seemed very old but possessed that feeling of time's sediment.
In the entire secret treasure chamber, the most attention-grabbing object was undoubtedly the azure pearl, yet Xu Yan's gaze did not linger on it and instead turned to another item.
It was a stone jar, but not an ordinary one; patterned with age, the pot's worn body seemed unremarkable beyond the feeling of history imbued within it.
However, Xu Yan saw that the jar emitted a faint charm, sealing whatever was inside to prevent it from decaying over time.
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe was taken aback, having assumed that Xu Yan would first examine the azure pearl, since among his ancient objects, it looked the most extraordinary.
Unexpectedly, Xu Yan's attention first went to a stone jar.
"This stone jar is quite special, I have tried to open it to see what is inside, but could never manage to, and due to my strength, I also can't damage the jar..."
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe started to explain.
"Does this stone jar have a history?"
Xu Yan asked curiously.
"Legend has it, it was treasured by our tribe's Ancient Emperor. The specifics, unfortunately, are unknown, but there are a few sporadic mentions in our ancient texts that this jar was gifted to our Ancient Emperor by some powerful entity…"
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe recounted.
He then added, "Considering that our tribe once belonged to the True Spirit of the True Dragon Lineage, it's surmised that it might have something to do with True Dragons."
Xu Yan picked up the stone jar and said, "This item, I'll take it."
"As long as Friend Xu likes it, that's what matters!"
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe expressed joyfully.
His biggest concern was Xu Yan's disinterest, but as long as Xu Yan liked it and accepted the Sea Spirit Tribe's treasures, there'd be a connection and common history between them.
Should the Sea Spirit Tribe face a dire calamity one day, considering this connection, Xu Yan might give assistance.
Xu Yan stored the stone jar away. Although he couldn't see the full picture of what was inside, he had some guesses which would be perfect to give to his master.
Next, Xu Yan glanced at the azure pearl.
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe introduced it, "This object is known as the Azure Sea Pearl, rumored to also have been left by our tribe's Ancient Emperor. I do not know its specific use but it surely contains some profound secrets."
Upon hearing this, Xu Yan's heart stirred, Azure Sea Pearl?
That giant turtle was called the Azure Sea Turtle; could this pearl have originated from the same place as the Azure Sea Turtle?
Azure Sea?
Was there a place called Azure Sea within this Domain?
But, the Azure Sea Turtle came from beyond the heavens, not a strong entity of this domain.
"Could it be, the Azure Sea lies beyond this Domain?"
Xu Yan thought curiously.
"Great Elder, do you know of a place called Azure Sea within this Domain?"
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe shook his head, "I have never heard of it, the seas of this Domain have always been called the Azure Sea. The Divine Realm's Azure Sea Sphere and the Spiritual Realm's Azure Sea are all parts of the Domain's vast Azure Sea.
"The transformations of the Domain have divided it into its current states; the legends say that in ancient times, the Azure Sea was vast, beyond what the Azure Sea Sphere can compare to."
Xu Yan nodded, reached out, and the Azure Sea Pearl fell into his hand. Since it was related to the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe, he decided to take it and would give it to his master as well.
After pocketing the Azure Sea Pearl, Xu Yan reviewed the rest of the ancient relics.
The remaining ancient objects were rather ordinary; although some had their intriguing features, Xu Yan didn't find them particularly appealing.

chapters.title: Chapter 897 - 467: Stone Jar and Bamboo Slips, I am Off to Subdue the Dragon_2
chapters.content:
Ever since acquiring the Prime Tortoise Carapace artifact, Xu Yan's perspective had elevated dramatically, making ordinary treasures unworthy of his attention.
Moreover, having enhanced his strength to this level, ordinary treasures were no longer effective for him.
"Eh, what's this?"
Suddenly, Xu Yan discovered among the ancient items one particular object—a bamboo slip. However, the bamboo used for this slip was far from ordinary and seemed to bear some resemblance to the Yu Zhu in his possession.
It appeared to be of the same type, the only difference being that the bamboo used in this bamboo slip was of a much higher quality than that of the Yu Zhu he held in his hand.
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe recalled and said, "This bamboo slip, according to fragments left by powerful figures of our clan in the past, is inscribed with various bizarre stories or some hidden knowledge, but it is never mentioned to contain any Cultivation Technique or secret technique."
Xu Yan picked up the bamboo slip, and using the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path, he saw a hazy aura obstructing the content of the slip. However, he could still vaguely discern some of the characters written on it.
"The person who wrote this bamboo slip must have been extremely powerful. Even with my current strength and the Eye of the Minor Heavenly Path, I cannot fully comprehend its content," Xu Yan couldn't help feeling amazed.
"This bamboo slip seems to possess a force that shields it. After our tribe's Supreme Expert perished, no one has been able to see its contents again.
"Furthermore, this bamboo slip itself is a Supreme Treasure. The rumors say it is crafted from a segment of an extraordinaryYu Zhu, and it is said that the hollows within this Yu Zhu are as vast as the Domain itself."
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe continued to elaborate.
Xu Yan nodded, almost certain that the bamboo used for the slip and the Yu Zhu he carried were of the same kind.
"It would be perfect as a gift for my master. The bizarre stories contained within will provide him with entertainment to pass the time," Xu Yan thought to himself, and he kept the bamboo slip.
"All right, I will take these three items then," Xu Yan said with a smile after pocketing the bamboo slip.
"Friend Xu, won't you take a look at the others?"
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe was taken aback.
He had been prepared for Xu Yan to sweep away all the ancient items.
"No need!"
Xu Yan turned and walked away.
"Today, for taking three ancient objects from your Sea Spirit Tribe, I will aid your tribe up to three times within my capabilities in the future!" Xu Yan declared solemnly.
"Many thanks, Young Master Xu!"
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe conspicuously bowed his thanks.
"It's all right, your Sea Spirit Tribe still has strong backing," Xu Yan said with a smile.
Cai Ling'er originated from the Sea Spirit Tribe and possessed the Sea Spirit Emperor's Bloodline. Currently following his master, if the Sea Spirit Tribe faced difficulties, how could she ignore it?
As a maid to his master, anyone wishing to target her would have to consider whether they could withstand a slap from his master.
"Yes, indeed!"
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe was overjoyed, believing that Xu Yan himself was the backing he referred to.
On leaving the Sea Spirit Palace, the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe personally escorted Xu Yan back to Yuntian Island.
At that moment, Yuntian Island was already in turmoil.
News of the True Dragon calamity had reached Yuntian Island.
Xie Lingfeng looked at his father in shock. "Father, a True Dragon, there's actually a True Dragon!"
"The legendary True Dragon has appeared in the Divine Realm, and it's not good news for the Azure Sea Sphere!" Xie Tianheng exclaimed with a sigh.
In the Divine Realm ocean, only the Azure Sea Sphere remains where the True Dragon will eventually descend and rule the Azure Sea.
Furthermore, the rampaging True Dragon seemed to have lost its sanity, becoming extremely violent and slaughtering Martial Artists above the Immortal Heavenly Venerable level everywhere it went.
And because of this disturbance, numerous Martial Artists below the Truth Refinement Realm also suffered countless deaths and injuries!
The strength of the True Dragon was destined to sweep across the Divine Realm.
"Brother Xu is about to leave the Azure Sea Sphere," Xie Lingfeng said with a sigh.
"Why?"
Xie Tianheng was startled, then suddenly realized, "Right, with Xu Yan's extraordinary talent, how could he not witness the True Dragon? After all, it is a being of legend."
Then, wearing a regretful expression, he said, "If only I were not so weak, I would have rushed to witness it myself, for it is a True Dragon after all!"
However, Xie Lingfeng just shook his head with a bitter smile, "Brother Xu isn't going to be just an onlooker."
He knew that Xu Yan possessed the Subduing Dragon Palm, a technique named for its purpose—to subdue dragons. Now that a True Dragon had appeared and was causing chaos everywhere, how could Xu Yan refrain from taking action?
Hearing this, Xie Tianheng nodded and said, "Indeed, with Xu Yan's strength, he surely wants to spar with the True Dragon, and even if he can't match it, with the help of his senior's Jade Talisman, he won't be in danger."
Xie Lingfeng chuckled, knowing that Xu Yan wasn't just going to spar; he was going to subdue the dragon!
With the True Dragon's emergence, Yuntian Island was abuzz, and many showed worried expressions. It was inevitable that one day the True Dragon would descend upon the Azure Sea Sphere.
The strong members of the Sea Spirit Tribe also wore solemn expressions on their faces.
Once, they were the True Spirits of the True Dragon lineage, responsible for patrolling the vast seas. However, as time changed and circumstances shifted, the Sea Spirit Tribe had weakened, far from the glory of their past.
Moreover, they are now the overlords of the Azure Sea and certainly don't want a new master to suddenly appear, relegating them to mere attendants.
Besides, this True Dragon had lost its sense and become wild and violent.
"This matter is not something we can resolve. We can only hope that those in the Taihe Realm will have a strategy to deal with it," said the Yuntian Island Master in a deep voice.
"The only strategy, I'm afraid, is to open the Heavenly Ladder," the Second Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe worriedly said.
Once the Heavenly Ladder is opened, will those who once coveted the treasures of the Sea Spirit Tribe seize the opportunity to descend upon the Divine Realm?
The Yuntian Island Master fell silent. The opening of the Dao Domain Ladder might be a good thing for Great Realm powers with significant backing. For those without, it's not necessarily so.
In fact, they may not even have the chance to ascend the Ladder and break through the barriers of their cultivation.
There are many restrictions and secrets involved.
Xu Yan and the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe returned to Yuntian Island, and upon hearing about the issue with the True Dragon, the Great Elder's countenance turned extremely grave, and he hastily headed to the great hall of Yuntian Island.
"Brother Xie, I've come to say goodbye," Xu Yan said with a smile upon returning to Xie Lingfeng's residence.
"I had anticipated as much," Xie Lingfeng smiled back.
"When we meet again, I will surely have reached the Void-breaking Realm!" Xie Lingfeng confidently declared.
"With your talent, Brother Xie, breaking into the Void-breaking won't take too long," Xu Yan nodded his head. Xie Lingfeng's talent was not lacking, and with his guidance, Xie Lingfeng had already understood the key to breaking into the Void-breaking Realm.
With the additional pills Xu Yan had left behind, Xie Lingfeng's cultivation speed would undoubtedly not be slow. Furthermore, because of his connection, he would be able to obtain even more resources for cultivation on Yuntian Island.
"Do you have confidence, Brother Xu?" Xie Lingfeng asked gravely.
Subduing a Dragon!
Throughout history, such a feat had not been heard of, and Xu Yan was probably the first.
Of course, the more ancient times were beyond investigation, but at least in recorded history, there had been no tales of subduing a dragon.
"Based on the information we have, this is a young dragon, not too powerful. Even though it easily crushed the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, my Subduing Dragon Palm is, after all, meant for subduing dragons. I should have some assurance," Xu Yan pondered and then said.
Xie Tianheng and Fu Yun standing nearby were stunned.
Xu Yan, going to subdue a dragon?
"Then I will wait on Yuntian Island for the news of Brother Xu subduing the dragon!" Xie Lingfeng said solemnly.
"Good!" Xu Yan nodded with a smile.
Following that, Xu Yan went to bid farewell to the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe and the Yuntian Island Master.
"Friend Xu, are you leaving the Azure Sea Sphere already?" the Yuntian Island Master and the others said reluctantly.
With Xu Yan present, the entire Azure Sea Sphere felt like it had a backbone. Now that Xu Yan was leaving, they suddenly felt uneasy.
"I have urgent matters to attend to; for now, I bid farewell," Xu Yan nodded and said.
"If there is anything Friend Xu requires, we on Yuntian Island are willing to offer our modest assistance to repay the favor you bestowed upon us," the Yuntian Island Master said sincerely.
"This matter is not something you can assist with," Xu Yan replied.
"Even though we are aware of our modest strength, we still count among the strong in the Divine Realm. There must be something within our reach that we can do for Friend Xu; please don't hesitate to ask!"
"Your kindness is well received, but truly, this matter is not something you can assist with. Even though the Immortal Heavenly Venerable may seem insignificant in my eyes, in the Divine Realm, he cannot be underestimated. So many Immortal Heavenly Venerables like us, even facing a Great Realm, could not be taken lightly.
"There are so few in the Divine Realm as strong as Friend Xu, ultimately just two or three people. How could we not be of help? You need not be polite. After all, we can give our utmost effort to assist Friend Xu. Even if we can only cheer on the sidelines, it would boost your momentum!" the Yuntian Island Master said gravely.
The other strong members of the Azure Sea Sphere nodded in agreement, expressing that even if they could only cheer from the sidelines, so many Immortal Heavenly Venerables could still boost Xu Yan's momentum!
Xu Yan said with a bow, "Your good intentions are appreciated, but I am on a quest to subdue the dragon!"

chapters.title: Chapter 898 - 468 Establishing Dao, Beyond the Domain
chapters.content:
Silence!
All the strong ones who had been clamoring, even if they couldn't lend Xu Yan their strength, hoping to wave flags and cheer to boost Xu Yan's momentum, instantly became stupefied.
What did Xu Yan just say?
He's going to subdue a True Dragon?!
Gulp!
The master of Yuntian Island swallowed a mouthful of saliva and said with a forced smile, "With Friend Xu's peerless might, naturally, there's no need for us weaklings to wave flags and cheer. We won't disturb Friend Xu and cause any trouble!"
The calamity of the True Dragons, the great catastrophe in the Divine Realm, countless Immortal Heavenly Venerables have perished.
None who encountered a True Dragon could escape!
The speed of a True Dragon was far beyond what these Immortal Heavenly Venerables could match.
Now, the Taihe Realm had summoned strong ones to gather, and no countermeasure had been announced yet, and Xu Yan was already preparing to subdue the dragon?
That's the rumored True Dragon!
"I told you, you can't help,"
Xu Yan said with a smile, nodding.
"Right, right, it's our presumption!"
The master of Yuntian Island and the others hastily nodded in agreement.
Xu Yan was going to subdue a dragon, and they would go there to wave flags and cheer?
That was simply courting death!
If Xu Yan could instantly suppress the True Dragon, that would be one thing, otherwise, in the True Dragon's fury, they would undoubtedly die!
"If that's the case, Xu shall take his leave!"
Xu Yan said, cupping his hands.
"We bid farewell to Friend Xu!"
The master of Yuntian Island and the others hurriedly returned the gesture.
Xu Yan stepped out and vanished from the spot in the blink of an eye.
...
Storms surge in the Divine Realm, the disciple's might shakes the Divine Realm—all these were ordinary matters to Li Xuan, and he hardly paid attention to them anymore.
He was fully immersed in his great Martial Arts endeavor.
He had made no small gains in both the creation of the subsequent Martial Arts and the organization of them.
What realm should be above the Establishing Dao Realm, the direction of cultivation, and all had already been determined.
Meng Chong and Xu Yan would occasionally bring feedback, but most of it was experience in Martial Arts.
The Qinghua Sect was also flourishing, and the strength of Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu was rising rapidly.
Even the three from Emperor Da Yue had begun preparing to break through the shackles of the Immortal Realm.
Red Cat's strength was also greatly increasing, and it was preparing to establish the Demon Clan in the Divine Realm, put an end to the chaos in the Nine Mountain Realm, and designate the Nine Mountain Realm as the domain of the Divine Realm's Demon Clan.
Shi'er, Meng Shushu, and Zhou Ying all made substantial progress, and with the aid of pills in their cultivation, they were one step closer to the Divine Skill Realm.
They wouldn't be far from Divine Skills.
Moon Changming and Yue'er had also greatly improved their strength. Although there was still some gap from the Immortal Realm, it wasn't too far.
This was the benefit of having sufficient pill assistance in Qinghua state, and even specially refined pills made for them.
"Wu Tianan, that guy, truly has good fortune,"
Li Xuan looked up at a certain place and couldn't help but sigh.
Wu Tianan had already broken through to the Immortal Realm.
He glanced at Cai Ling'er, who was brewing tea for him and serving up Spiritual Cake. Since the activation of her bloodline and her inheritance from the Sea Spirit Tribe, Cai Ling'er's strength improved by leaps and bounds.
Now, she wasn't far from the Immortal Realm either.
"How is your practice of Divine Skills going? Any questions?"
Li Xuan asked with a smile while enjoying the Spiritual Tea.
In delight, Cai Ling'er expressed all her questions about her cultivation.
Li Xuan gave her some guidance. Understanding dawned upon her, and she went off to seclude herself for deeper contemplation.
Time flies swiftly.
One day, the Daoist Golden Book radiated golden light.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has created the Ten Directions Annihilation Sword, annihilating the besieging Immortal Heavenly Venerables, and you've obtained the Breathless Silence Sword!"
Li Xuan was startled.
Feedback had finally arrived—a sword for him.
Looking at the sword in his Primordial Spirit's hand, Li Xuan was thrilled.
The Breathless Silence Sword, formless and silent, carries the might of the Annihilation Dao and can sever Martial Artists' Dao!
This is a sword capable of severing Dao.
"To sever Dao!"
Li Xuan exclaimed.
It was clear that those slain by this sword were all exceedingly powerful beings.
Far beyond Immortal Realm could compare.
"Master of Domain, huh,"
Li Xuan smiled, for this sword to sever a Master of Domain, to annihilate their Dao was, in fact, nothing extraordinary.
Of course, this also required sufficient strength.
"My strength has grown stronger again!"
With this sword, Li Xuan was confident that if the Seductive Witch came to seek revenge now, a single stroke would be enough to slay her.
It was that domineering and powerful.
"Excellent, truly excellent. Worthy to be the pioneer of my Martial Arts,"
Li Xuan was extremely pleased.
The eldest disciple never disappointed.
Li Xuan continued to pour most of his thoughts into his Martial Arts endeavor, paying little attention to external affairs.
No matter how the Divine Realm was in turmoil, it could not affect him.
If necessary, he could easily correct the disordered Domain.
Having thoroughly understood the Domain Origin and the Dao Principles of the Taicang Domain, in a sense, he was already the Master of the Taicang Domain.
The only difference was that he did not cultivate the Taicang Martial Arts.
Time flies swiftly. For Li Xuan, immersed in his Martial Arts endeavor, the passage of time was barely noticeable.
It was as if he had merely taken a nap.
One day, the Daoist Golden Book flipped open, and golden light surged out.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has comprehended the Martial Arts Techniques of the Establishing Dao Realm, and you have broken through the Establishing Dao Realm!"
Li Xuan was immediately thrilled.
The Establishing Dao Realm had finally arrived!
Boom!
With entry into Establishing Dao came a vast leap. As one progresses, the gap between each realm grows larger.
The Domain Realm is far stronger than the Void-breaking Realm. Even a minor breakthrough within the Domain Realm can bring a massive increase in strength.
The leap from the Domain Realm to the Establishing Dao Realm is like crossing a chasm, and the power difference between them is unimaginable.

chapters.title: Chapter 899 - 468: The Dao Establisher Surpasses the Domain_2
chapters.content:
Li Xuan at this moment, had once been in the breakthrough and profound mysteries of the Establishing Dao Realm.
Dao Principles emerged between heaven and earth, operating according to their own laws, establishing the Way of Domain as well as his own way.
"This is the Establishing Dao Realm!"
Li Xuan sighed endlessly, his self-created Martial Arts were mysterious and powerful, far surpassing Taicang Martial Arts. The further he reached in the realm, the less it could compare.
"This is the power of Dao Principles, the power of rules, and even closer to the power of the great Dao!
"Vague and elusive, the great Dao seems not far, yet what exactly is the great Dao?
"These all need to be slowly comprehended, step by step in cultivation, ascending to the great Dao, walking without end..."
At this moment, Li Xuan truly felt a surge in confidence.
"Transcendent of heaven and earth, I am now one who has transcended heaven and earth!"
In the Establishing Dao Realm, establishing his own way and the Way of Domain, Li Xuan had now truly transcended heaven and earth.
Those who establish Dao transcend heaven and earth!
Taicang Domain could no longer bind him.
"A formidable being like the Seductive Witch can be obliterated with a wave of the hand."
Li Xuan's smile brightened.
From this moment on, he truly possessed the initial might of a Taoist Ancestor.
And not just in name alone.
Above the Spirit Pedestal, the Primordial Spirit had already undergone transformation, and even the Extreme Soul Body had changed due to his establishment of Dao.
Even the Alchemical Medical Martial Arts had naturally improved.
After all, the cultivation of Alchemical Medical Martial Arts and Pure Martial Arts was almost the same, traveling in the same direction. Now that the Dao was established, it was natural that Alchemical Medical Martial Arts also advanced.
Li Xuan's Primordial Spirit, holding the Daoist Golden Book, saw some changes in the use of the book as he established his Dao.
"Since I have established my way, all is my way, then let's establish the Dao together."
Li Xuan's Primordial Spirit shone brightly, the Daoist Golden Book in his hands opening, with golden light emerging forth.
Boom!
At this moment, Qimen Martial Art advanced to the Establishing Dao Realm.
Extreme Soul Martial Arts also advanced to the Establishing Dao Realm.
But Physical Body Martial Arts had not progressed further; to advance Physical Body Martial Arts, Meng Chong still needed to comprehend the Mighty Sky Limitless Indestructible Body.
"Not bad at all!"
Li Xuan was very satisfied with this.
The elevation of strength was indeed exhilarating.
"Now, only Meng Chong's Mighty Sky Limitless Indestructible Body is left, but I suppose Meng Chong is close to enlightenment, no?"
Li Xuan thought to himself.
Of the five schools of Martial Arts, four had now reached the Establishing Dao Realm.
And as his strength continued to rise, the true body of the Demon Ancestor also continued to improve. Whenever he established the Way of the Demon Clan, his Demon Ancestor true body would also reach the Establishing Dao Realm.
However, this challenge would not be too difficult; he just needed to give some guidance to Red Cat.
"Heaven and earth can also be in my hands!"
Li Xuan looked up at the firmament, everything was in plain view; he could see clearly and also perceived some powerful beings.
However, at that moment, he no longer cared.
Inside the Taicang Domain, there was no threat!
"Establishing Dao is not the end, it is just establishing Dao, setting up the way of one's own heaven and earth, and one's own way, that's all. This is just the beginning stage of a strong being.
"Perspective should be broader. Being invincible within heaven and earth does not mean truly invincible. What lies beyond heaven and earth is still unknown.
"Besides, what catastrophe once occurred in Taicang Domain, and what secrets heaven and earth hold, still need to be understood."
After his excitement, Li Xuan returned to tranquility.
He played with the Jade Ruyi in his hand and sat on the chair, as usual, leisurely and carefree.
"This Jade Ruyi, from when I hadn't yet entered the world of Martial Artists to now reaching the Establishing Dao Realm, has been imbued with the rhythm of my Martial Arts and has now become a Supreme Treasure."
Li Xuan looked at the Jade Ruyi in his hand and was taken aback.
It was a gift from Xu Yan when he became his disciple; originally there was a pair of Jade Ruyi, but he had only ever used this one.
Now, as he broke through to the Establishing Dao Realm, the Jade Ruyi in his hand also became a Supreme Treasure from constant handling over the years.
"Going by this, as my strength continues to improve, this Jade Ruyi will inevitably become an unfathomable Supreme Treasure. Even this chair will become a Supreme Treasure."
Li Xuan couldn't help but sigh, the possessions of a strong being, no matter how ordinary they once might have been, would become Supreme Treasures.
"Once I truly become invincible and lonesome, seeing the Jade Ruyi is as good as seeing me," this is the Ruyi of this Taoist Ancestor!"
Li Xuan was in an excellent mood at this moment.
Thus, with a wave of his hand, the Rhythms of Domain enveloped Shi'er, Meng Shushu, and Zhou Ying.
A voice like the sound of Dao itself directly entered the three people's Primordial Spirits, guiding their cultivation.
Under the shelter of the Rhythms of Domain, Shi'er and the others saw rapid increases in their strength. The principles of Martial Art that they couldn't understand at first were now instantly clear to them.
One foot had already stepped into the Realm of Divine Skills.
Breaking into the Divine Skill Realm was just a matter of half a month now.
Li Xuan, in high spirits, waved the Jade Ruyi in his hand. "This Taoist Ancestor will speak of Dao once more, allowing the Martial Artists of the Qinghua Sect to listen to the sound of the Taoist Ancestor."
The news that the Taoist Ancestor was about to expound Dao spread instantaneously within the Qinghua Sect. Powerhouses who were outside all hurriedly returned, and the skilled prodigies of various places flocked over as well.
"The Master is going to teach Dao again?"
Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu were both astounded.
"It must be something that has made Master very happy," Su Lingxiu said with a smile.
