On the day of teaching Dao, all the strong practitioners and prodigies of the Qinghua Sect, as well as all the Martial Artists at the Sect's headquarters, respectfully sat cross-legged on the ground, waiting for the Taoist Ancestor to start his teaching.
Li Xuan sat on his chair, with a mysterious aura, the Great Wilderness Physiognomy, and the Taoist Ancestor Halo all emerging and becoming visible, ineffable and inscrutable, with the true form no longer visible.
"We pay our respects to the Taoist Ancestor!"
All the Martial Artists of the Qinghua Sect bowed and saluted.
That figure, ineffable and impossible to look directly at, gave the impression that one glance would reveal infinite wonders of the Domain and endless Martial Arts.
Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu were both shaken to their core.
Is this the true form of their Master?
Or perhaps, was it just one-billionth of a fraction revealed?
This teaching of Dao was different than the last. It was a true teaching of Dao because Li Xuan had reached the Establishing Dao Realm, discussing the way of Martial Artists.
It was the Path of Cultivation as well as that of the self. Everyone heard something different, confirming their own cultivation. How much they comprehended and what they gained depended on their own talent and insight.
Those who cultivated the Sword Dao gained enlightenment as if a door to the Sword Dao had opened for them.
Alchemists suddenly understood the previously unfathomable Alchemy methods.
It was the same for those who practiced Artifact Refining and Formation.
And the Martial Artists who cultivated the Taicang Martial Arts felt as if they understood their bottlenecks and broke some kind of fetters. Their Martial Arts seemed merely improved, without any evident change, yet it appeared to have become somewhat different.
As Li Xuan spoke Dao, the strength of the Qinghua Sect naturally received another substantial boost.
Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu were also immersed in it, seemingly having a lot of their own Martial Dao enlightened, as if they saw the foundation of Establishing Dao.
With a roar!
A surge of momentum suddenly emerged but did not affect anyone.
Li Xuan glanced at Cai Ling'er next to him; the girl had broken through to the Immortal Realm.
Subsequently, within the Qinghua Sect, three powerful presences emerged in succession, breaking through the shackles of the Immortal Realm and stepping into a new Realm as if merging with the Domain itself.
The Heavenly Union Realm!
Li Xuan had a smile on his face, the Emperor Da Yue and the other two seemed to have broken through to the Heavenly Union Realm, but this Heavenly Union Realm was a bit different from the other Heavenly Union Realms.
The Heavenly Union Realm cultivated with Divine Skills was stronger by a notch.
Within Qinghua Sect, those prodigies all gained something, including many who broke through their realms.
The Immortal Heavenly Venerables also gained a lot; those who had not cultivated Divine Skills finally did so this time.
There were even True King Heavenly Venerables who, without the aid of Pills, broke through to the Immortal Realm.
Of course, there were those with lesser talents who listened but were confused and bewildered, finding it very mystical but unable to comprehend and could only stare blankly, almost appearing dull.
Different talents and insights naturally yield different gains.
Some were enlightened on the path of Martial Arts, striding forward boldly, rising to become Supreme Experts.
There were also those who gained very little and remained mired in difficulty, ultimately returning to the dust.
After the teaching ended, everyone was still immersed and couldn't snap out of it.
Their Divine Souls still echoed with mysterious sounds.
And Li Xuan, looking up towards the Great Wilderness with a smile, said, "Tian Zi, this Taoist Ancestor will come to chat with you now, to discuss the secrets of the Domain."
His figure instantly disappeared from the spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 900 - 469 Spirit of the Taicang Domain
chapters.content:
Border Wilderness, Wu Country Royal Palace, inside a small stone house.
Tian Zi scratched his messy hair and looked expectantly towards the outside of the stone house, but then he hung his head in disappointment.
"He's really not coming back, is he? Without him, how bored I am."
Being alone for a long time had become a habit, but suddenly, being pulled out of solitude by someone made it unbearable to be lonely again.
Tian Zi was not naturally a patient person; it was the situation that forced him to stay put and get used to it.
And the arrival of Li Xuan had broken his routine, making it difficult to stay patient any longer.
"If only I knew, I would have said something valuable."
Tian Zi felt some regret.
Finally, someone came along who was incredibly strong and seemed agreeable without malicious intent, but due to his own caution, the conversation stalled, and now the person didn't come anymore.
"Sigh, Taicang tricked me into coming here and locked me up, only to die himself. Isn't this tormenting me?"
Tian Zi sighed.
"Taicang might have died, but insisting on preserving this Domain, protecting others, really has made me suffer. What should I do now?
"This Domain has started to have some problems as well. Taicang's painstaking efforts are ultimately unappreciated."
Reflecting on this, Tian Zi started to blame Taicang and felt immense distress.
"That guy must be very strong, stronger than Taicang? Even stronger than that terrifying person?"
Tian Zi furrowed his brows in thought.
"Next time he comes, I'll speak of some things and see how he reacts, whether he knows something."
Tian Zi was recalling something.
"Besides Taicang and that terrifying person, where else could there be such formidable beings? If they really existed, Taicang would surely know of them, and so would that terrifying person.
"But he's not disguised as that terrifying person, nor is he one of those other six. Could it be that his strength is truly so great that even Taicang and that terrifying person are unaware of it?"
The more he thought about it, the more Tian Zi found it incomprehensible.
"That terrifying person, although very strong, was still discovered by Taicang, not just by Taicang, but also by those other six, yet he has never been mentioned before.
"Taicang never mentioned him, nor did those six; it's really strange. If his strength is so great that he has become invincibly lonely, he probably wouldn't care about the Domain.
"He wouldn't be coveting the Domain like that terrifying person, would he?"
Tian Zi mused, contemplating what things he should or shouldn't say when he saw Li Xuan again.
He even thought about how he might cautiously probe whether the other party was indeed invincibly lonely.
"If he truly is so strong, he should know about the battle between Taicang and that terrifying person, right?"
A thought suddenly struck Tian Zi, and he pondered whether he could test this out.
"Right, if he comes again, I'll test whether he knows about the battle between Taicang and that terrifying person. Such a mighty battle, if he doesn't know of it, then he must not be from the same era as Taicang, but a newcomer.
"If he is a newcomer, no matter how strong he is, could he truly surpass Taicang?
"If he truly surpasses Taicang, that would only mean that this newcomer is too monstrously talented, but that seems nearly impossible!"
The more Tian Zi thought about it, the more he felt he was clever, quickly grasping the crux of the matter.
Waiting left and right, but not seeing Li Xuan come, Tian Zi's hair got messier, and he became increasingly agitated.
The only bed left in his space was smashed to vent his frustration.
After smashing it, he regretted it.
"It's over, I can't even lie down comfortably anymore. This was a bed made by Taicang for me!"
Tian Zi almost wanted to cry without tears.
"He's not really never coming back, is he?"
Deflated, Tian Zi slumped down inside the small stone house, looking utterly dejected.
He didn't even know how long he had been sitting there.
Just then.
"Tian Zi, little friend, what's happened to you?"
Upon hearing this voice, Tian Zi was immediately overcome with emotion, tears filling his eyes. Finally, he had come.
"How come you..."
As Tian Zi lifted his head, his body trembled, his heart shaken, his eyes widened, and he stood up abruptly, becoming instinctively reserved.
"You, you..."
Li Xuan, enveloped in the Taoist Ancestor Halo, stepped into the stone house, quite pleased with Tian Zi's reaction.
"Little friend Tian Zi, there's no need to make a fuss."
Li Xuan said as he arranged a table and brewed a pot of tea.
"Come, let's have tea!"
The Taoist Ancestor Halo gradually disappeared, and he returned to looking quite ordinary.
The more ordinary he appeared, the less composed Tian Zi became, growing even more reserved.
All the thoughts he had prepared about how to probe were forgotten.
He picked up a cup of tea and gulped it down to calm his nerves!
If it had been any other time, he would have refused the tea, or if he had drunk it, he would have complained it was trash. But now, after drinking a cup, Tian Zi seemed unaware of the bad taste and poured himself two more, drinking them down one after another.
To steady his shock!
"Tea should not be drunk this way, but never mind, you as a little friend, do not understand the etiquette."
Li Xuan shook his head and said.
Tian Zi gradually recovered from his surprise and, scratching his head with curiosity, asked, "Senior, what was that just now?"
That scene he had just witnessed was the most shocking of his life.
"Oh, it was just a trace of my true essence's power."
Li Xuan said with a casual smile.
Inside, however, he was delighted. He had surely bamboozled Tian Zi, hadn't he?

chapters.title: Chapter 901 - 469 Spirit of the Taicang Domain_2
chapters.content:
```
Of course, Li Xuan had already reached the Establishing Dao Realm in four out of the five martial arts disciplines he practiced, with the only exception being Physical Body Martial Arts. With such strength, he truly did not need to worry about Tian Zi.
Tian Zi's heart was once again filled with shock; just a sliver of his true form's power was already so unfathomably deep. Just how formidable was his real strength?
"Elder, are you really very, very strong?"
Tian Zi couldn't help but ask again.
"In your eyes, what is the state of being strong? In my heart, there is no concept of strength, for everything I have seen is weak and feeble, including this Domain."
Li Xuan shook his head as he spoke.
Tian Zi was momentarily stupefied. Even the Taicang Domain was weak in his eyes; how could he not be strong?
Even that terrifying person wouldn't dare to underestimate the Taicang Domain.
If the Taicang Domain wasn't strong, it would not still exist to this day.
Yet in his eyes, such a mighty Domain was so feeble?
Taking a deep breath, Tian Zi decided to probe him.
The battle between Taicang and that terrifying person was earth-shattering and resonated for a lengthy period. If he knew of this battle, it meant he was from the same era as Taicang and the others.
If not, then he was a later generation, but could his strength really be so unbelievably immense?
"While I was trapped here, a battle erupted. I do not remember how long ago it was, only that it stirred the Domain for tens of thousands of years and was not short-lived even beyond the heavens."
"Elder, do you know of this battle, and what was the outcome?"
Tian Zi stared at Li Xuan with wide-open eyes.
"You've learned to test me? What is Tian Zi planning to reveal? That battle must have been the origin of the shift in the Domain back then."
Li Xuan was slightly surprised in his heart, but his face remained calm and composed.
He naturally didn't know of that battle and hadn't seen it, and he was clueless about the outcome.
However, as a peerless master with unfathomable depths...
Li Xuan had already crafted for himself a mysterious and prestigious identity.
Especially after reaching the Establishing Dao Realm, his insight into the world beyond the Domain had prepared him somewhat.
Moreover, since he wanted to learn the secrets of the Domain from Tian Zi, he naturally needed a good reason, without diminishing the image of him being an enigmatic master.
So, Tian Zi's question was hardly a challenge for Li Xuan.
"The battle you mentioned, well, that happened quite some time ago. A bunch of little guys causing a ruckus indeed stirred things up, even woke me from my sleep."
"Kids fighting, that's quite normal. This Taoist Ancestor has seen too many of them, and there have been more intense fights than the one you mentioned."
"So, this Taoist Ancestor simply found a different spot and went back to sleep."
"As for the outcome, this Taoist Ancestor couldn't be bothered to find out. In the fights I've seen, that one was just a small affair, not worth mentioning."
Li Xuan nodded, speaking nonchalantly as if narrating a story about a group of kids brawling.
Tian Zi was completely dumbfounded.
Such a fierce battle was just kids fighting in his account?
Why was there a sense that he was exaggerating?
Shocked yet curious, Tian Zi pressed, "You say you've seen more than one such battle?"
Li Xuan nodded and replied, "Of course, the battle you mentioned was just a minor skirmish."
"Who exactly are you, then? Do you know Taicang?"
Tian Zi couldn't restrain himself from asking.
Moved by the question, Li Xuan thought of Taicang.
The owner of the Book of Taicang?
The Master of the Domain?
"Taicang?"
Li Xuan pretended to recollect before nodding, "I've heard of a little fellow named Taicang. Quite talented!"
That's it?
Tian Zi was even more astounded by the mention of Taicang, and to Li Xuan, Taicang was just a talented kid!
"Taicang has lived for a very, very long time. He existed before the Domain. If you call Taicang a little fellow, then how long have you lived?"
Tian Zi was unsettled now, discarding certain secrets he shouldn't have spoken about.
Li Xuan was inwardly shaken. Was Taicang really that formidable?
```
```
Could it be before the Domain itself?
"No, the Taicang Domain, could it have been created by him?"
Li Xuan was astonished. If that were true, Taicang's strength would naturally surpass his current Establishing Dao Realm.
Tian Zi had already begun to loosen up, and now was the perfect time to coax him and probe for secrets.
Li Xuan sipped his tea, his gaze deep. The Taoist Ancestor Halo and the mysterious aura, along with the Great Wilderness Physiognomy, all began vaguely to surface as if he were recalling the past, and his true form involuntarily revealed itself bit by bit.
In Tian Zi's heart, there was some doubt whether Li Xuan was boasting, but at this moment, upon seeing the Taoist Ancestor Halo, the mysterious aura, and the Great Wilderness Physiognomy again, all skepticism instantly vanished like smoke!
This person must be an unimaginably terrifying existence.
This faint and indiscernible true form was far beyond what Taicang could compare with, and even Taicang with that terrifying individual did not possess such arcane profundity.
"How long has this Taoist Ancestor lived?"
Li Xuan sighed and exclaimed, "I don't know how long it has been. When I established my Dao, the Dao had not yet been born, time did not exist, the void was barren, and even Chaos itself did not exist..."
It was just a bit of exaggeration, naturally inflating the story quite a bit.
Li Xuan was confident in his ability to boast.
Tian Zi listened, stunned and scratching his head, as the whole person became dumbfounded.
"...I have seen so many powerful beings, also guided many, and I have created many Paths of Cultivation.
"I have traveled far on the Dao.
"Some call me the Ancestor of Martial Arts, others the Prime Divine Demon of Chaos, and still others the Ancestor of the Dao... Of course, now there are also those who call me the Great Wilderness Martial Ancestor.
"Of course, my favorite title is still that of the Taoist Ancestor."
After such a round of bragging, Li Xuan felt quite refreshed inside.
Tian Zi was completely bewildered. Was this person so powerful as to be unimaginable?
He had established his Dao before the Dao itself was born, before time existed?
Both a Divine Demon of Chaos and an Ancestor of the Dao, it sounded terrifying to hear.
"...I have seen too many beings perish, so many that eventually, I simply found a place to sleep, not looking, not caring, not asking,
"Those youngsters, too greedy, constantly fighting. It became somewhat annoying, so now I have woken up to see this Domain, I just came in for a little stroll.
"Youngster, you have experienced too little, you don't know what it's like to be invincibly lonely."
Li Xuan let out a sigh, as if he had lived too long, seen too much, and had become numb to it all, now merely seeking some amusement to pass the time.
"Just as I said, this Domain is too weak, lacking something. It's an incomplete Domain, it only has its rules, and even this powerful Domain in your eyes is just so-so."
Li Xuan's gaze seemed to be recalling something, "So many eons ago, there was a being wielding a giant axe, who split the heavens and earth, creating a vast Domain.
"That Domain consisted of three Realms, had Reincarnation, and was far superior to this one.
"Regrettably, even the mightiest Domains cannot withstand turmoil, and in the end, became a mess, and probably have vanished into the river of time by now."
Tian Zi swallowed, his face a mask of shock. There had been Domains before Taicang?
And moreover, infinitely more powerful ones?
Such a powerful Domain, too, has disappeared into the river of time.
Exactly how long has this senior lived?
It's too terrifying.
Even Tian Zi at this moment felt a tingling sensation on his scalp.
"Senior, does that mean you knew my identity all along?"
Tian Zi cautiously inquired.
At this point, he somewhat believed that Li Xuan already knew his identity.
"Would I lie to a youngster like you?"
Li Xuan said with a feigned surprise and a smile.
At that moment, the Primordial Spirit's hand opened the Daoist Golden Book, shining upon Tian Zi and displaying his information on the pages, line by line.
"Spirit of the Taicang Domain, Origin of the Domain, transformed by the Open Heaven Purple Light..."
The Spirit of the Taicang Domain!
Li Xuan, while having had some suspicions that Tian Zi was no ordinary being and probably had a deep connection with the Taicang Domain, had not imagined that he would be the Spirit of the Taicang Domain.
Now, he also understood why Tian Zi was trapped in this place.
The one who trapped him here must be the Master of the Taicang Domain, Taicang!

chapters.title: Chapter 902 - 470 The Legend of Taicang, the Origin of the Domain
chapters.content:
Li Xuan raised his hand, pointed at Tian Zi, then at the sky, and then at the land, and said with a smile, "You, the spirit of the Domain, transformed by the Purple Light!"
Upon hearing this, Tian Zi was shocked, and his doubts about Li Xuan's power dissipated, even feeling a sense of relief.
Since he knew his identity and had done nothing, it was clear he had no malicious intentions.
The identity of him being the spirit of the Domain was known to only a very few.
And him being the transformation of the Purple Light was known to even fewer.
"So the elder really did know, I was overthinking it."
Tian Zi said with a bitter smile.
"Looks like you, my young friend, have a story to tell, why not share it?"
Li Xuan took the opportunity to speak with a smile.
Tian Zi remained silent for a while, then raised his hand, pointed at the sky, and said, "Beyond the Domain lies the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, does the elder call it Chaos?"
Li Xuan smiled and nodded then shook his head, "Yes and no!"
Beyond the Domain lay a state of Chaos, filled with Imperishable Qi, and Li Xuan's first thought was Chaos, which is why he mentioned it.
However, Tian Zi's question obviously did not refer to it as Chaos.
Li Xuan naturally wouldn't contradict what he had said, but he also wouldn't completely deny the terms used by Tian Zi, thus giving a seemingly profound answer.
Some things should not be set in stone, as that leaves no room for maneuvering; Li Xuan was already adept at this.
Tian Zi did not ask why it was both yes and no but his expression became much more serious and his tone complex and reminiscent as he said, "Beyond the sky lies the Chaotic Imperishable, which Taicang and others call the Land of Imperishable, also known as the Land of Chaotic Imperishable. Formerly, the strong beings within this Domain all called the area beyond the sky the Land of Imperishable…
"The Land of Imperishable seems to exist eternally, inhabited by True Spirits, but like wild beasts, though they possess great power and even innate abilities, they use them crudely, not following the Path of Cultivation, relying solely on natural growth.
"No one knows when the beings of the Land of Imperishable were born or how ancient they are. Even Taicang is unable to trace back and see the past.
"Of course, you must know, elder; were it the earlier me, I would have curiously pestered the elder to explain clearly, but now, I no longer have such curiosity."
As he spoke, Tian Zi's expression seemed a bit forlorn.
Li Xuan listened silently, also feeling a bit sentimental; before the Domain, there was Chaotic Imperishable, which wasn't much different from the Chaos he knew.
He poured a cup of tea for Tian Zi, considering himself a listener.
Once Tian Zi started talking about the past, he couldn't stop, and everything came spilling out.
As expected, after taking a sip of tea, Tian Zi continued.
"Taicang was born in the Land of Imperishable. According to Taicang, he didn't know how he came into being or what kind of being he was, initially muddleheaded, like those Imperishable True Spirits, with unopened Spiritual Wisdom."
"Of course, at that time, the Land of Imperishable teemed with True Spirits, where the weak were prey to the strong, and weak True Spirits were always at risk of being eaten."
"Taicang said he saw the bloody battles of True Spirits, and for some reason, his Spiritual Wisdom gradually awakened, and he grew increasingly clever, and his form slowly changed to its current human appearance."
"Observing the battles of various True Spirits, both strong and weak, he gradually figured out how to dodge, how to evade, and how to efficiently hunt True Spirits..."
Tian Zi continued narrating slowly.
The protagonist of this story is called Taicang.
And from Tian Zi's narration, his relationship with Taicang seemed very close, and these events clearly weren't experienced by Tian Zi himself but were told to him by Taicang.
Li Xuan thought of Tian Zi's origins; a spirit of the Taicang Domain transformed by the Open Heaven Purple Light, his birth clearly connected to Taicang.
Even, it was Taicang who created him.
"The Land of Imperishable is vast; Taicang said he didn't know its size, he led a nomadic life there, wandering in danger. At that time, he had no sense of the passage of time, drifting endlessly, and because he possessed Spiritual Wisdom, he faced other True Spirits with pride.
"Later on, Taicang even stopped considering himself the same as those True Spirits, feeling he was a unique being."
"Not knowing how long he traveled, Taicang saw a supremely powerful True Spirit that was already ancient and seemed close to death."
"Taicang observed this True Spirit until it aged and died, its corpse discovered and devoured by other True Spirits."
"Taicang said that scene deeply shocked him; even if a being isn't killed, it will age and die, though he didn't know how long that True Spirit had lived, it eventually died."
"It was from that moment that Taicang felt he should pursue something..."
At this point, Tian Zi paused and looked at Li Xuan.
"Elder, do you know what Taicang pursued?"
Li Xuan nodded slightly; he had already guessed some.
"You say Taicang is a very talented young friend; Taicang's talent is second to none that I know of."
Tian Zi exhaled and said gravely, "Taicang, he is the first cultivator from the Land of Imperishable, exceptionally gifted, who pioneered the Path of Cultivation."
"Taicang cultivated, in the Land of Imperishable, absorbing the fierce Spiritual Energy for cultivation, continuously exploring and improving."
"Thus, not knowing how many eons had passed, Taicang became powerful, able to easily hunt those powerful True Spirits he once couldn't face."
"As his cultivation deepened and grew stronger, the range Taicang roamed in the Land of Imperishable also grew wider, able to hunt increasingly powerful True Spirits."

chapters.title: Chapter 903 - 470 The Legend of Taicang, the Origin of the Domain_2
chapters.content:
"Until one day, he encountered a True Spirit that also possessed Spiritual Wisdom..."
Tian Zi was narrating about Taicang, from the birth of Taicang to the rise of Taicang, all these deeds, naturally, were all previously told to Tian Zi by Taicang.
Li Xuan silently listened, and the more he listened, the more he marveled, Taicang truly was a legend.
Since Taicang met the first True Spirit with Spiritual Wisdom, the Land of Imperishable began to see some changes; creatures with Spiritual Wisdom became increasingly numerous.
And these creatures with Spiritual Wisdom, their strength kept increasing; these strong ones were all influenced by Taicang, for instance, by preferring to transform into human forms.
For instance, they also figured out their own Cultivation Methods from the Cultivation Methods of Taicang.
The Path of Cultivation of creatures in the Land of Imperishable, if traced to its source, seemed to begin with Taicang, all were influenced by Taicang.
Taicang assisted many creatures in cultivation, and it was because of this that a group of followers surrounded him.
From the beginning, Taicang and others were not the strongest in the Land of Imperishable, but gradually, they climbed to the pinnacle where very, very few True Spirits could battle against them.
Aside from Taicang, the Land of Imperishable also saw some exceptionally talented creatures emerge.
"The Land of Imperishable is Chaotic Imperishable, without Domain, even without a concept of Domain; Taicang and the others, all exist in the Land of Imperishable, wandering in the Land of Imperishable.
"Not knowing how many eons had passed, Taicang grew tired of the aimless wandering, also tired of having no fixed abode, thus, he settled down in a place within the Land of Imperishable.
"He called it home, spending most of his time pondering over the Path of Cultivation, occasionally going out to travel, collecting some materials for research.
"Other creatures did much the same, finding a place to settle down, occasionally traveling about, and coexisting peacefully with each other.
"After all, in the entire Land of Imperishable, only they possessed wisdom; even if conflicts erupted, they would exercise restraint, and even have stronger, more respected individuals step forward to resolve conflicts.
"For instance, Taicang would preside over justice, impartial and unprejudiced, settling some conflicts."
Tian Zi sighed, and said, "Originally, if such days could continue, it might not be so bad, but how could the affairs of the world proceed so smoothly.
"Chaotic Imperishable, dull and turbid, with intelligent people naturally wanting to pursue more, wanting to change the environment of their own lives.
"Thus, Taicang collected materials, forged some treasures, shone light, and then the Chaotic Imperishable Land saw brightness, even various colors of light.
"A group of people chased the beauty within, conflicts thus stimulated, gradually forming several small groups, but these did not affect Taicang.
"Taicang was proud, he was also the strongest, the creatures following him were naturally the most numerous, other small groups, although they had their own factions, still respected Taicang.
"If large conflicts erupted, they still would ask Taicang to preside over justice and mediation..."
With Tian Zi's narration, Li Xuan couldn't help but feel awe, Taicang truly was formidable.
And speaking up to this point, still no mention of Domain affairs, even less of Domain upheavals, meaning that though Taicang forged glowing treasures, in the Chaotic Imperishable Land, brilliant glows could be seen, but still no existence of Domain.
Tian Zi continued narrating, somewhat long-windedly, much of the time talking about Taicang's daily life, occasionally mediates conflicts, even suppresses challengers to his strength.
Occasionally, Tian Zi showed a look of loneliness, even mocking at times, Taicang was too full of himself.
But Li Xuan could see that Tian Zi's feelings for Taicang, were extremely deep.
After all, in some sense, Taicang created him.
"Taicang became stronger and stronger, looking across the entire Land of Imperishable, even the mightiest True Spirits were no match for him, at that time, Taicang could be said to be the foremost among the mighty of the Land of Imperishable.
"Of course, aside from Taicang, there were six other fellows, also exceptionally strong, far surpassing other creatures.
"However, they were still much weaker than Taicang and because of the differences in creatures and Cultivation Methods, they also formed their own factions.
"Even occasionally sparking minor conflicts, but those were minor issues."
At this point, Tian Zi paused.
Li Xuan didn't urge him on; he continued silently sipping his tea, fully taking the role of a listener.
"Senior, you should know how the Domain came to be?"
Tian Zi's expression became solemn.
The emergence of the Domain was linked to his own birth.
"In the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, only the dwellings of Taicang and others shone brightly, naturally attracting some Imperishable True Spirits. Some True Spirits were hunted, while others were raised and tamed to become mounts."
"Until one day, at the edge of the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, a purple light appeared."
"Whether the purple light originally appeared from the edge of the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, was hard to ascertain, but for Taicang and the others, it felt as though it emerged from the edge."
"The purple light bathed the Chaos, as if cleaving the Land of Imperishable into two halves, extending across the entire Land of Imperishable; it was the first time the Land of Chaotic Imperishable was illuminated by light."
"Of course, this was the first time Taicang and his companions had seen such a phenomenon. As for before their birth, whether it had appeared or not, was unknown."
"The appearance of the purple light made Taicang and the others realize it was a great opportunity."
"True Spirits, not yet endowed with Spiritual Wisdom, were frightened by the purple light and roared as they fled beyond it, while Taicang and his companions rushed toward it..."
Li Xuan's heart was stirred with excitement.
The appearance of the purple light also meant that the Domain was about to be born.
"Everyone was vying for the purple light, and Taicang, being the strongest, obtained the most and the most brilliant part of it."
"Everyone received a chance with the purple light, but how to utilize it remained unknown."
"However, Taicang used the purple light to carve out a vast Domain within the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, thus further elevating himself."
"The other six fellows, following Taicang's example, used the purple light to create their own Domains, while the rest, mere followers of the seven, carved out their own places within the Domain."
"I am a part of that purple light; when Taicang was creating his Domain, some of the purple light remained, and he placed this portion within the Domain to nurture it, giving birth to me."
"Among the Seven Great Domain, Taicang is revered as the most perfect, vast Domain."
Tian Zi spoke thus, his eyes reddening as if he would cry at any moment.
Li Xuan's heart throbbed—among the Seven Great Domain, Taicang reigned supreme!
There were seven Domains, and the Taicang Domain was the strongest and most vast.
Besides the Taicang Domain, there were six other Domains.
Li Xuan thought of the Netherworld, the Witch... these were probably two of the other six Domains.
"Senior says that the Taicang Domain lacks something and is too weak, but in truth, the Taicang Domain is the strongest and most perfect."
"The rules of the Domain operate smoothly, the Principles of Heaven and Earth are perfected, the Spiritual Energy is gentle, the Domain Lingji is active, and the mountains, rivers, and lakes are all present; it's incomparable to the other six Domains."
"Taicang's strength is undisputedly the foremost; he has always been the leader."
"Since the creation of the Domain, it initially remained in a phase of growth, and after a long period of development, it finally reached its peak and the Domain was completely formed."
"True Spirits from the Imperishable Land outside the Domain entered and gradually developed Spiritual Wisdom, thus divided True Spirits into Domain True Spirits and Imperishable True Spirits."
"In fact, the name True Spirit, after the birth of the Domain, specifically referred to those with Spiritual Wisdom, while Imperishable True Spirits referred to those without Spiritual Wisdom, meaning the unenlightened True Spirits."
"The Human Clan also originated here, preferring humanoid forms influenced by Taicang."
"Taicang taught Martial Arts, and cultivators appeared in the Domain. The Seven Great Domain interacted and learned from each other, and each of the Domains sought suitable cultivation spots for themselves."
"Everything was harmonious and flourishing. The seven of Taicang served as the Masters of the Seven Great Domain, with Taicang revered by all cultivators."
"The Domain now had time, recorded in years, but since the creation of the Domain, countless years have passed, and I no longer remember."
"Until one day, the seven from Taicang gathered, looking deep into the Imperishable Land, as if they had discovered something..."

chapters.title: Chapter 904 - 471: Taicang is Dead, the Great Wilderness Shall Rise
chapters.content:
Li Xuan, upon hearing this, knew that Tian Zi was about to reveal the reasons for the cosmic crisis, as well as the fate of Taicang.
Could such a legendary figure really have fallen?
Li Xuan thought of the scenes Xu Yan had witnessed crossing the Great Wilderness and that towering figure. Could that towering figure possibly be Taicang?
If someone as powerful as Taicang had fallen, then how formidable must their enemy be.
Moreover, it was very likely that all seven from Taicang had joined forces against this being and yet were still defeated?
"Taicang and the others discovered a powerful presence emerging from deep within the Land of Imperishable, approaching the Domain, but then it suddenly halted in a certain area of the Land of Imperishable.
"Initially, Taicang and his group thought it was a powerful Imperishable True Spirit hidden within the Land of Imperishable and didn't take it too seriously.
"Thus, after an unknown number of eons, one day, an extremely powerful breath surged from outside the Imperishable Land. Taicang immediately prepared to investigate.
"However, an unexpected crisis occurred."
At this point, Tian Zi's expression became extremely solemn, and he said in a heavy voice, "The Fen Yun Domain perished, everything in the Domain was devoured and plundered. The master of Fen Yun Domain, Fen Yun, also disappeared, seemingly fallen!
"You must realize that Fen Yun was one of the Seven Great Domain Masters, incredibly powerful. Inside the Fen Yun Domain were also many strong beings, and yet it perished.
"This event greatly shocked the remaining six from Taicang, and they realized the seriousness of the situation. So, they went to search for that powerful presence.
"But that presence was avoiding them."
Li Xuan listened with a stunned heart. The Fen Yun Domain, one of The Seven Great Domain, just like that, it perished?
The master of the Fen Yun Domain died just like that?
"Or, could the perishment of the Fen Yun Domain be a conspiracy?"
Li Xuan mused to himself.
Tian Zi continued to speak.
After the six from Taicang tracked without success and were concerned about the safety of the Domain, they could only return to their respective Domains. However, they became more cautious. If any one of them fell into crisis, they would immediately provide support.
After an indeterminable amount of time, Witch Demon, whose strength was second only to Taicang, encountered a powerful enemy, suffered heavy injuries, and nearly perished.
But Witch Demon managed to find the remains of Fen Yun and the perpetrator.
Sometime later, within the Land of Imperishable, a Divine Temple appeared, called the Imperishable Temple, as though it had wandered there from somewhere within the Land of Imperishable.
The end of the Fen Yun Domain was related to the strong beings of the Imperishable Temple.
Their goal was to invade and devour The Seven Great Domain.
The existence of Imperishable Temple was so strong that not even Taicang was ensured to be able to contend with it.
As the situation unfolded, the crisis within the Domain became more and more urgent, and, after making extensive preparations, Taicang and the others launched an attack on the Imperishable Temple.
"Taicang knew that he might not survive this battle, and he was concerned that the Taicang Domain would be invaded and perish, so he left behind contingencies.
"Those bastards from Taicang, they tricked me into coming here, gave me good food and fun, and yet they locked me up, fearing that I'd be discovered.
"Taicang Domain is very special, because I am the Spirit of the Realm. In order to invade the Domain, they must annihilate me; otherwise, invading and causing the Domain to perish is extremely difficult.
"The battle was too tragic. Even though I did not participate, I know that Taicang died; he truly died."
At the end, Tian Zi couldn't help but start crying.
Li Xuan fell silent too. Even someone as strong as Taicang had died.
Just how powerful was the being from Imperishable Temple to be so fearsome?
"Can't be arrogant, can't get ahead of myself. My current strength is still not as great as Taicang, not to mention the beings from Imperishable Temple. If I were to encounter them, it would undoubtedly mean certain death.
"Even though I've transcended the Domain, I will continue to lie low in Taicang Domain, until my strength surpasses Taicang and those from Imperishable Temple."
Li Xuan became more vigilant in his heart.
However, despite Taicang's long-ago fall, the Taicang Domain remained safe and sound. Although some changes had occurred, it had not suffered devastating damage.
This showed that Taicang truly was remarkable. The beings from Imperishable Temple probably also had a difficult time in that battle.
Tian Zi wiped her tears, cursing, "Taicang was a real bastard, locking me up for so long in order to protect the living beings of this Domain.
"He also said he would be back soon, lied to me, saying that person was not his match, but in the end, he actually died.
"I'll never believe again that Taicang is invincible. He was too useless. If the Domain's gone, it's gone. Why struggle to death?"
At this moment, Tian Zi was filled with grievances towards Taicang.
"If I had the strength, I would change this Domain; Taicang's dead, so the Domain is no longer his!"
Tian Zi said angrily.
Then, she continued rambling on about some details of the battle and the changes in the Taicang Domain.
In that battle, the strong beings who followed Taicang suffered heavy casualties. Of the other five Great Domains, it is known that the Wicth Demon Domain and Netherworld Domain still exist. Whether Witch Demon and Netherworld have fallen remains unknown for the moment.
However, according to Tian Zi's speculations, it's highly likely that they have perished.
Now, Witch Demon and Netherworld are attempting to invade the Taicang Domain. There is a chance that the remaining powerful beings from these two Domains might have sided with the Imperishable Temple.
Of course, as for the specifics, Tian Zi was unable to know the details due to being locked up here.
"After that battle, the Taicang Domain was unstable for a long time, and some changes had occurred. For instance, my current location lies in the Border Wilderness, the Border Wilderness Wasteland of Taicang, where the Domain Lingji no longer exists, and the Spiritual Energy has become violent.

chapters.title: Chapter 905 - 471: Taicang is Dead, Great Wilderness Shall Rise_2
chapters.content:
"I also know why Taicang did this, Border Wilderness lacks Spirit Mechanism and looks seriously damaged, diverting attention so no one finds me here..."
Tian Zi sighed in dismay but spoke angrily, "But Taicang was too harsh, everything they left me is gone, not even a bed remains now, how will I live my days now."
Then, Tian Zi looked eagerly at Li Xuan, asking, "Senior, do you think it's possible?"
Li Xuan smiled in surprise, "This might actually be a good thing for you. Since you are already hidden, why expose yourself?
"Letting you out is naturally easy for me, but think about it—do you really want to expose yourself after being hidden for such a long time?"
Even with Taicang being so powerful, it is dead now, although the Taicang Domain still appears safe.
But what if Tian Zi were exposed? Would it attract the powerful beings from the Imperishable Temple?
Li Xuan was unsure if he could wield the entirety of the Domain Power within the Taicang Domain to confront those powerful beings from the Imperishable Temple.
After all, even with his current Establishing Dao Realm, armed with multiple Divine Skills, the Breathless Silence Sword in hand, and harnessing the power of the Taicang Domain, he couldn't guarantee victory over the powerful beings of Taicang.
Thus, it was impossible for Tian Zi to be completely free for now, but a plan could still be arranged.
"What can I do if I'm not content? I don't want to be locked up here for another moment, Taicang is really a bastard, dying just like that and leaving me to suffer alone here,"
Tian Zi harbored a deep grudge.
"Of course, I also know that the one I should hate the most is that terrifying guy, but that terrifying guy is too strong, I can't defeat him, otherwise, I would have killed him.
"If not for him, why would I, Tian Zi, have suffered so much here for so many years?"
Speaking of the powerful being from the Imperishable Temple, Tian Zi was clearly filled with hatred.
After all, he was created by Taicang, who in a sense was his father.
"Those followers of Taicang, all of them are useless. After all these years, hasn't one of them broken through the limit and reached the level Taicang once was?"
Tian Zi spoke angrily again, and then began to curse.
"The changes in Taicang Domain, Border Wilderness, Inner Domain, Spiritual Realm, these set-ups are nothing but for cultivating a new Master of Domain. Those guys, they take no action or have their own schemes...
"The core of Taicang Domain used to be, now turned into the Dao Realm of the Three Hundred Realms, these Realm Masters, they are all bastards..."
The more Tian Zi cursed, the angrier he became, rambling on and intermittently lamenting his own tragic life.
Li Xuan remained silent; Tian Zi was clearly wallowing in self-pity.
"Dao Realm Three Hundred Realms, 300 Realm Masters? Now, there aren't even that many left,"
Li Xuan thought to himself.
Dao Realm Three Hundred Realms, each Realm, is like a minor heaven and earth.
Undoubtedly, these three hundred realms were once the Minor Heaven and Earth Masters, established by the strong followers of Taicang.
Li Xuan had also come to understand the martial prowess of the Taicang Domain.
"Heavenly Union, Divine Venerate, Supreme Sovereign, Realm Master... now, the Realm Master is the strongest in Taicang Domain, but Taicang's seven were the Masters of Domain.
"Realm Master, formerly known as Minor Heaven and Earth Master.
"Taicang was the strongest among the Domain Masters, while the being from the Imperishable Temple surpasses even the Domain Masters,"
Li Xuan assessed internally.
"My martial arts, the Domain Realm roughly matches the Divine Venerate and Supreme Sovereign. With the Domain Realm's Great Accomplishment, I possess the power of a Supreme Sovereign. Establishing Dao Realm equates to a Realm Master."
"Between a Supreme Sovereign and a Realm Master lies a chasm, and the difference in strength between the Domain Realm and Establishing Dao Realm is also vast.
"If I were to reach Great Achievement or even Perfection in Establishing Dao Realm, could I kill Taicang?"
Li Xuan asked himself, even if he achieved perfection in Establishing Dao, he likely won't be able to kill Taicang, but he should not be weaker than Taicang. Among the other six Domain Masters, he should be able to kill the one with weaker powers?
Of course, there's also a significant difference between the strengths of Realm Masters.
And Taicang alone could dominate the other six, highlighting the extent of Taicang's strength.
"Only above Establishing Dao Realm would one have the power to kill Taicang and not fear the powerful beings from the Imperishable Temple..."
At this moment, Li Xuan had a clear understanding.
Ordinarily, the Establishing Dao Realm is comparable to a Realm Master, or perhaps a bit stronger, but he was not just any ordinary Establishing Dao, hence his exceptional strength within this Realm.
"However, that doesn't mean there's no other way; before breaking beyond Establishing Dao Realm, I can continue to enhance my strength."
Thinking this, Li Xuan looked towards Tian Zi, who was cursing and occasionally lamenting his misery, and said with a smile, "Young friend, you are the spirit of Taicang Domain, do you want to elevate Taicang Domain?
"Do you want to make those coveting it incapable of striking at the Domain?"
Tian Zi suddenly became spirited.
"Senior, I think, I dream of it!"
Li Xuan stood up, walked out of the small stone hut, and Tian Zi subconsciously followed, even walking out of the palace that covered the small stone hut.
At that moment, Tian Zi was shaken, and the shackles on him were partly unlocked!
Li Xuan looked up at the firmament and said with a smile, "As I said, this domain lacks something. It's too weak, but you can make up for the missing part."
"If I fill in what's missing, will I die?"
Tian Zi couldn't help but shrink his neck.
"No, you won't."
Li Xuan, with a brilliant smile, patted Tian Zi on the shoulder and said, "I came to travel in the Taicang Domain and was moved to take a few disciples, who are growing up."
"And the Martial Arts I impart is called Great Wilderness Martial Arts, and the Inner Domain is now the Great Wilderness."
"The things missing in this domain still need to be made up for. Taicang has perished, and now only you can accomplish this."
Tian Zi asked with a puzzled look, "Senior, you keep saying that this domain is missing something. What is it missing?"
Li Xuan turned back and looked at him, uttering two words: "Heavenly Dao!"
Heavenly Dao!
Tian Zi became bewildered and murmured to himself, "Heavenly Dao?"
"Exactly, Heavenly Dao!"
Li Xuan nodded and said, "The Taicang Domain, with its Dao Principles, appears perfectly orderly and operates smoothly, but ultimately lacks the Way of Heaven. If the Heavenly Dao were present, controlling the sun and moon, the domain would keep growing stronger and expanding, maintaining the balance of the domain... "
Li Xuan began instilling in Tian Zi the concept of Heavenly Dao he had conceived.
"You, being a spirit of the domain, are perfectly suited to merge with the domain and embody the Heavenly Dao, although you should not control the entire Taicang Domain at the beginning."
"Since Taicang has perished, this domain is no longer the Taicang Domain indeed, and can conceal your own self, letting you abandon the causes and effects of the past..."
Li Xuan went on to elaborate on how powerful the Heavenly Dao can be, how it operates the domain, how it is revered by the living beings of the domain, how it strengthens itself, and how it allows the domain to continue growing stronger.
The more Tian Zi listened, the brighter his eyes became, excitedly he said, "Senior, I want to be this Heavenly Dao, please teach me!"
"Oh, you want to be the Heavenly Dao? Which Heavenly Dao do you want to be?"
Li Xuan asked with a smile.
Tian Zi, with a solemn expression, said seriously, "Taicang has perished, the Great Wilderness must rise, I am the Great Wilderness Heavenly Dao!"
Li Xuan inwardly nodded, Tian Zi was indeed clever.
"It's good that you have such a resolve. Since that is the case, I, as the Taoist Ancestor, will impart to you the method of the Heavenly Dao and teach you how to become the Heavenly Dao. Of course, if you are too foolish to grasp it, it will only show that you are not destined for the Heavenly Dao."
Li Xuan nodded and said.
"Don't worry, Taoist Ancestor, I am very talented."
Tian Zi boasted, patting his chest.
"Let's hope so."
Li Xuan did not bring up the matter of taking disciples, as Tian Zi's real strength, within the Taicang Domain, was stronger by a fraction than those Realm Masters, since he is a spirit of the domain.
"Taoist Ancestor, you impart to me the method of the Heavenly Dao. From now on, I will be the Great Wilderness Heavenly Dao, and you, Taoist Ancestor, are the Great Wilderness Martial Ancestor. Does that make me your... disciple?"
Tian Zi scratched his head and carefully asked.
"As you wish!"
Li Xuan gave a resigned smile.
"Then let it be settled. I, Tian Zi, am henceforth a Dao disciple under the Taoist Ancestor!"
Tian Zi said joyfully.
Li Xuan smiled and shook his head, Tian Zi was indeed quick-witted.
"As a spirit of the domain aspiring to be the Heavenly Dao, it is significantly simpler for you, the method of the Heavenly Dao is also simple, starting with the Taicang's Domain Dao Principles as a foundation, but you should not walk entirely in the way of the Taicang Domain Dao Principles..."
A book appeared in Li Xuan's hand.
It was the Book of Taicang!
Tian Zi startled, his expression suddenly turned somewhat melancholic, he sighed and said, "Taicang indeed had a contingency plan, wanting his successors to travel his path anew, to become the new master of the Taicang Domain, to protect the Taicang Domain!"

chapters.title: Chapter 906 - 472 Your Disciple Has Subdued a True Dragon
chapters.content:
Gazing at the Book of Taicang, Tian Zi sighed with emotion and said, "If my guess is not wrong, the Book of Taicang should be in the Border Wilderness, and not too far from me."
Li Xuan smiled and replied, "You are quite perceptive; indeed, the book is not far from you."
"Taoist Ancestor, with the Book of Taicang in your hands, you are now the Master of the Taicang Domain."
Tian Zi flipped through the Book of Taicang as he spoke.
"This Domain..."
Li Xuan shook his head.
"Surely, a Taoist Ancestor like you would not be interested in it, but I wonder if anyone has ever obtained the Book of Taicang."
Tian Zi asked with curiosity.
"The book is actually quite dull. Living in seclusion as I do, why would I care about such things? It was merely by chance that I took on a disciple, and it was my second disciple who found it..."
Li Xuan pointed to the Dao Principles of the Book of Taicang and said, "To become the Heavenly Dao, the first thing you need to do is to operate the Dao Principles, to integrate these principles into one..."
Next, Li Xuan began to impart to Tian Zi the laws of the Heavenly Dao from the Dao Principles depicted in the Book of Taicang, teaching him how to operate the Dao Principles, how to modify them, and how to unify them.
To become the Heavenly Dao, there was another crucial step. Tian Zi had to transform into Dao Principles, using himself as the core to integrate and operate the Domain Dao Rules.
As a spirit of the Domain, it was not difficult for Tian Zi to transform into Dao Principles, and he would not lose his self-consciousness. However, he would ultimately have to give up his current body.
This meant he would have to disperse his body, and the process of dissipating it was somewhat painful.
"The Heavenly Dao is formless. As the Heavenly Dao, who could find you? You would be omnipresent, operating the Domain, strengthening it with the Heavenly Dao Rules, continuing to expand the Domain. The stronger the Domain becomes, the stronger you will be..."
Li Xuan felt excited about his concept of the Heavenly Dao.
If successful, the Great Wilderness Domain would continuously grow stronger, and there might even be a chance to break through the entire Land of Imperishable, turning it into part of the Domain.
"So I won't have a body in the future?"
Tian Zi looked somewhat downcast.
"If you are to be the Heavenly Dao, why would you care about a body? The Domain itself would be your body. You could become any creature; within the Domain, every grass and tree, all living beings, could become your body.
"Of course, as the Heavenly Dao, you must follow the rules. Otherwise, chaos in the Domain would not be good for the Heavenly Dao either..."
Li Xuan stated solemnly.
"I understand!"
Tian Zi nodded seriously, "To those bastards who have been watching me, you will never be able to find me again. One day, I will let you taste the majesty of the Splendid Heavenly Path!"
"I shall release some of your shackles; start on the path of the Heavenly Dao from the Great Wilderness."
Li Xuan raised his hand and removed some of Tian Zi's restraints, allowing him to move freely within the Great Wilderness.
"Once you successfully become the Heavenly Dao of the Great Wilderness, then you can extend to the Spiritual Realm, the Divine Realm, and eventually the entire Domain..."
Tian Zi was excited, clenching his fists, "I will definitely succeed. I am going to be the Heavenly Dao. Taicang has perished, and from now on, this is the Great Wilderness Domain, the Domain of Tian Zi!"
"Ah, the pain... I'm going all out, all out. Wait for me, you guys. The pain I endure today is all because of you, and that terrifying person, one day, I will let you taste my Splendid Heavenly Path's majesty..."
Tian Zi screamed, cursing and babbling as his body gradually dissipated, eventually turning into a purple light.
At a certain moment, the purple light merged into the Domain, and in a trance, seemed to become a Dao Principle; however, this Dao Principle was somewhat different from the rest.
That day, the Martial Artists of the Great Wilderness looked up in confusion, not knowing why, but feeling that the sky seemed different.
They couldn't quite put their finger on what was different.
Could it be imbued with the might of heaven?
"Hahaha, I am finally free, I can finally be carefree..."
A voice that no one could hear rose in the Great Wilderness Domain. Tian Zi, looking at every grass and tree in the Great Wilderness, at every cultivator, was thrilled and found it extremely amusing.
"Right, I am the Heavenly Dao. I need to have dignity, I need to have rules..."
Tian Zi took a deep breath and began to establish the Heavenly Dao Rules, taking the first step to becoming the Heavenly Dao.
Li Xuan had already taught him how to set up what rules and what the Heavenly Dao Rules should be, so all Tian Zi needed to do was to follow suit.
Li Xuan, looking up at the sky of the Great Wilderness, showed a radiant smile, watching Tian Zi undergoing transformation into the Heavenly Dao and couldn't help but feel anticipation.
"The Heavenly Dao... Taicang has no Heavenly Dao, but the Great Wilderness does. Those who covet the Great Wilderness will have to bear the majesty of the Heavenly Dao."
The strength of the Great Wilderness had improved swiftly, but its foundation was still weak. Although the Spiritual Energy had increased significantly, due to the short time, the accumulation was insufficient, and there was a lack of heavenly and earthly treasures.
Now that Tian Zi had become the Heavenly Dao of the Great Wilderness, his first task was to rapidly enhance the strength of the Great Wilderness, to allow the emergence of heavenly and earthly treasures, and even to expand the territory of the Great Wilderness.
How the Heavenly Dao could strengthen the Domain, how to establish the Heavenly Dao Rules, and what kind of rules would both benefit the Heavenly Dao and promote the growth and more efficient cultivation of Martial Artists in the Domain, Li Xuan had passed all this information to Tian Zi.
And now, Tian Zi was becoming the new Heavenly Dao, undergoing transformation, and establishing the Heavenly Dao Rules. This required time and process.
But soon, Tian Zi will become the Heavenly Dao of this piece of the Great Wilderness Domain. Once he masters the operation of the Heavenly Dao Rules and enhances the strength of the Great Wilderness, he will gradually expand, eventually incorporating the entire Domain.
In the future, there will only be the Great Wilderness Domain, without the Taicang Domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 907 - 472 Your Disciple Has Subdued a True Dragon_2
chapters.content:
Taicang has perished, the Great Wilderness shall rise!
After Tian Zi shouted these words, the fate of the Taicang Domain was sealed.
"This domain, after all, is related to me."
Li Xuan sighed with a sense of loss.
"Those guys in the Dao Realm think too much, wanting to vie for the position of Master of Domain. They're simply deluding themselves. Just wait for later to face the majesty of the Splendid Heavenly Path."
Li Xuan chuckled to himself.
Tian Zi has been locked up for such a long time, those Realm Masters have been living so carefree. How could Tian Zi endure that?
He certainly wouldn't spare those Realm Masters from trouble.
The Great Wilderness is undergoing changes, silent and unnoticeable. The Martial Artists of the Great Wilderness can't even detect what is different from before.
After all, changes in the Domain have always been there since spiritual energy in the Great Wilderness increased.
"It's about to become a nascent Heavenly Dao."
Li Xuan awaited with anticipation.
The remaining shackles on Tian Zi would be removed without his help; as Tian Zi became the Heavenly Dao, he would be able to slowly unshackle himself along with the expansion of the Heavenly Dao.
Li Xuan awaited feedback from the Daoist Golden Book. The Heavenly Dao was his creation, his new concept for this domain, and it would surely bring him substantial feedback.
"This should further improve my strength."
Li Xuan was secretly excited.
Nothing is more satisfying than the improvement of one's strength.
Li Xuan couldn't care less about the changes in the Divine Realm. He was instructing Tian Zi on how to transform into the Heavenly Dao, how to properly manage the Heavenly Dao, and how to establish the Heavenly Dao Rules.
These rules are the foundation of the Domain's operation and the source of the Heavenly Dao's strength. They also need to adhere to the fundamental principle of "Supreme Impartiality," treating all creatures of the Domain fairly and impartially.
Of course, Tian Zi, as the Heavenly Dao, inevitably has his preferences. Therefore, the Heavenly Dao Rules will also impose some restrictions on him to prevent reckless actions.
If one were to act beyond these rules, they would receive a warning.
Once the Heavenly Dao Rules are established, Tian Zi's Origin consciousness can exist outside of these rules, allowing them to operate on their own. Without the influence of Tian Zi's Origin consciousness, the Heavenly Dao Rules will naturally be impartial.
However, this does not mean Tian Zi has become detached from the Heavenly Dao or that he cannot control the Heavenly Dao Rules. Instead, his Origin consciousness exists in a state that does not interfere with the Heavenly Dao Rules.
When necessary, Tian Zi can directly control the power of the Heavenly Dao Rules to act, such as when facing a formidable enemy.
Li Xuan advised Tian Zi in this way, considering that Tian Zi, with his youthful character, might act solely on preference, which would deviate from the intended concept of the Heavenly Dao.
The Origin consciousness does not interfere with the Heavenly Dao Rules, and if Tian Zi wants to grant someone an opportunity, he will use his own power of the Heavenly Dao, not under the grant of the Heavenly Dao Rules.
There is ultimately a difference between the two.
In this way, this not only ensures the impartiality of the Heavenly Dao Rules but also grants Tian Zi a certain degree of freedom.
Becoming the Heavenly Dao is not something that can be achieved overnight. Although the Great Wilderness is not vast, and Tian Zi is a spirit of the Domain, the Heavenly Dao is a new path after all.
But the hardest part is the beginning. Once Tian Zi becomes the Heavenly Dao of the Great Wilderness, he will have taken an important step. After becoming familiar with the fundamentals of the Heavenly Dao, he can then prepare to run the entire Domain.
Time flies, and as Li Xuan joyfully established the Heavenly Dao for the Domain, he looked forward to the feedback from the Daoist Golden Book. As for the situation in the Divine Realm, he didn't bother to pay attention.
One day, Li Xuan stood in the village he had crossed into. The once houses were now covered with vines, and the large tree had grown even more lush.
"Fate is indescribably wonderful!"
At this moment, even Li Xuan couldn't help but exclaim.
Had Xu Yan not sought out an expert and succeeded in cultivating the random Cultivation Technique he had made up, he might have been stuck in the small village, dying alone, or looking for an opportunity to leave the village for a small town.
Because of Xu Yan's arrival and his success in cultivating the random Cultivation Technique, he finally embarked on the path of an expert and strove for the cause of Martial Arts.
Now, this Domain, in a sense, was already within his control. He was, in a sense, the Master of Domain.
Within the Taicang Domain, he was invincible!
And soon, the Taicang Domain would also become the Great Wilderness Domain.
The Great Wilderness Heavenly Path is his Taoist lineage.
"I, the Taoist Ancestor, am here to impart the Dao!"
Li Xuan's smile was radiant.
Just then, the Daoist Golden Book opened, and golden light surged forth.
Moreover, this time the golden light surged out as if it had transformed into a golden path.
Li Xuan was overjoyed. Had the feedback from the Heavenly Dao arrived?
Suddenly, he was puzzled again. Tian Zi was still a little short of becoming the Heavenly Dao. Could the Daoist Golden Book be giving feedback in advance?
"Your disciple Xu Yan has subdued a True Dragon, you have obtained the Subduing Dragon Path!"
Subduing Dragon!!!
Li Xuan was utterly bewildered. What had happened in the Divine Realm? In such a short time, without his attention, how had his eldest disciple managed to subdue a dragon?
Where did the dragon come from?
The Subduing Dragon Palm, could it really have subdued a dragon?
Xu Yan relied on it to subdue a True Dragon!
"My eldest disciple is truly capable!"
Li Xuan could not help but exclaim in his heart.
Boom!
A golden light, like the Dao itself, enveloped his Primordial Spirit in an instant, gradually merging into it.
The Way of the Subduing Dragon!
At this moment, Li Xuan was comprehending the Way of the Subduing Dragon.
This was the Dao, the true meaning of Dao, the Way of the Subduing Dragon, closely related to the Subduing Dragon principles he had expounded in the past.
To subdue the dragon was also to control the dragon!
The great Dao of the dragon!
"Subduing Dragon, so it is. Am I not only the Ancestral Monster now but soon to become the Ancestral Dragon as well?"
Li Xuan snapped out of his introspection, his mouth twitching, unable to help but sigh.
Only now did he look up toward where the Divine Realm was located.
This glance revealed that in just a brief time, the Divine Realm had been turned upside down, the situation dramatically changed. A certain realm within the Dao Realm was falling, connecting with the Divine Realm and becoming a region that linked the Divine Realm with the Dao Realm.
The Unity of Domain of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow was being enacted at this very moment.
"It's getting more and more interesting. This is a plot to seize the position of the Master of the Domain, hoping to break through the shackles of the Realm Master and become the Master of the Domain.
"Unfortunately, they've taken the wrong path. Other domains might succeed in seizing the Domain Authority by doing this, but the Taicang Domain won't work.
"Taicang is truly formidable!"
At this moment, Li Xuan had to admire the might of Taicang.
As the leader of the Seven Great Domain Masters, its strength overawed the other six Domain Masters.
And yet, mighty Taicang had fallen.
The strength of the beings in the Imperishable Temple within the Land of Imperishable must be terrifying indeed.
"My disciple has subdued a dragon, though I do not know what kind of dragon he has subdued."
Li Xuan smiled radiantly.
Given Xu Yan's current strength, although the Subduing Dragon Palm is, in a sense, based on subduing dragons, if the True Dragon is too powerful, it would not be subdued.
"A True Dragon from the Heavenly Union Realm?"
Li Xuan already had a conjecture.
"This is a juvenile dragon, not yet mature."
True Dragons, originally the most elite among True Spirits, one of the Seven Great Domain Masters, commanded all True Spirits.
"A mature True Dragon is no weaker than a Divine Venerate Martial Artist. Xu Yan's current strength is not yet capable of subduing a mature True Dragon; therefore, he must have subdued a juvenile dragon.
"The juvenile dragon ambushed by Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow must have no ordinary background. This is likely to provoke the Dragon Realm to act, utilizing the True Dragon Qi to assault the Divine Realm and further connect the Dao Realm with the Divine Realm, forming a kind of Unity of Domain in some sense.
"And perhaps, to steal part of the True Dragon Qi from the Dragon Realm, introducing it into their own domain..."
Li Xuan immediately understood the underlying intentions.
"Things are getting interesting."
The True Dragon Realm was moved into the Taicang Domain before the great changes in the Domain, along with many other True Spirits, and now all belong to the True Dragon Realm.
The domain that once housed many True Spirits including True Dragons, likely perished in that battle; even if it did not perish, it must have fallen into the hands of the Imperishable Temple.
The Domain Master of the True Spirit Domain has likely perished as well.
After all, Tian Zi was locked within the Domain, unaware of the specifics of the great battle, nor did he know the outcome of the other domains.
Li Xuan glanced at Tian Zi; in just a few days, he would undergo a transformation into the Heavenly Dao.
The Great Wilderness will truly begin to rise.
"Tian Zi, your Taoist Ancestor is off to watch."
Li Xuan waved his hand and stepped forward, instantly disappearing from the spot.
As for the changes between the Divine Realm and the Dao Realm, Tian Zi naturally sensed them. After all, he was a spirit of the Domain, and even though he was locked up, he could still detect some changes in the Domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 908 - 473: Dao Domain Ladder, True Dragon Great Tribulation
chapters.content:
"Freedom is so wonderful, having great strength is so wonderful."
Tian Zi's face was filled with envy.
"If I had half the strength of my Taoist Ancestor predecessor, I wouldn't be in such a sorry state, I don't know how carefree I would be!"
He immediately became invigorated.
"However, as long as I become the Heavenly Dao, and control the entire Domain, then the whole Domain is my body. Although my body would be a bit larger, I should still be able to go anywhere, right?
"A Heavenly Dao, wandering around everywhere, that's quite reasonable, isn't it?"
The more Tian Zi thought about it, the more excited he became.
All of these were things the Taoist Ancestor predecessor had said, and he found them to be very reasonable, which is why becoming the Heavenly Dao was his only choice.
Only by becoming the Heavenly Dao, could one be more relaxed. To become stronger, one did not need to try hard oneself, just let the creatures within the Domain strive for you.
"The vast and boundless Imperishable Land lies beyond the heavens, this Domain is so minor within it. Taicang roaming the Imperishable Land, with the entire Domain, roaming the Imperishable Land.
"Moreover, the creatures of the Domain, searching for treasures and cultivating in the Imperishable Land, as they grow stronger, I become even mightier.
"Imperishable Temple, hmph, just wait, I'll show you how formidable this Heavenly Dao is!"
Tian Zi was full of anticipation for the future.
"Hehe, let those guys work hard, to think that they can obtain the Domain Authority? Have they asked me, the spirit of the Domain... no, the Heavenly Dao?"
"Someday, I'll show you the Majesty of the Heavenly Path, you'll learn to revere the Heavenly Dao, just as you once revered Taicang... no, you'll revere me even more than Taicang!"
Tian Zi was delightfully dreaming about making those guys experience the Majesty of the Heavenly Path after becoming the Heavenly Dao.
In a single step, Li Xuan had already returned to the Qinghua state.
"The Divine Realm is truly tumultuous."
Back in the Divine Realm, Li Xuan couldn't help but sigh.
"There's still no shortage of ambitious fellas."
Li Xuan chuckled.
Tian Zi was the spirit of the Taicang Domain, and him becoming the Heavenly Dao wouldn't be rejected by the Domain Origin, which allowed for a very smooth transition, whereas those Realm Masters who coveted the Domain Authority were simply deluding themselves with wishful thinking.
...
The Divine Realm ever since the fall of the True Dragon and its ravaging of all directions, the strong forces of the major powers began to convene at the Taihe Realm.
"This True Dragon, it must be an immature True Dragon with limited strength. If we join forces, we should have a chance to suppress it!"
"Absolutely, by employing numerous Divine Artifacts and setting up an ambush Great Formation, suppressing this True Dragon shouldn't be a problem!"
A group of Divine Realm strongmen were enthusiastically discussing on the Taihe Divine Temple.
"Do you truly all have this confidence?"
The Taihe Sect Master asked with a grave expression.
"An immature True Dragon that has lost its sanity, pooling the power of our Divine Realm, can't we suppress it?"
"Meng Chong and Jiang Buping are so strong that no ordinary Immortal Heavenly Venerable can compare. If those two participate..."
"No way!"
As soon as someone suggested Meng Chong and Jiang Buping's participation, it was immediately opposed.
The intentions of the strongmen were somewhat aligned with each other.
After all, it was a True Dragon, and an immature one at that. If it could be suppressed, wouldn't there be some great opportunity to gain from it?
After some discussion, the strongmen from the Taihe Realm, Da Yan Realm, Taikun Realm, Taimiao Realm, Battle Hall, Wanbao Alliance, and many other powers, together with the Immortal Heavenly Venerables from various realms, formed the Dragon Suppressing Alliance!
Without delay, the major powers mobilized their foundations, joined by numerous Immortal Heavenly Venerables, they headed out in force towards the land ravaged by the True Dragon to prepare for the ambush.
Inside the Taihe Divine Temple, the Taihe Sect Master's face was extremely solemn.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow have gone too far, daring to plot against the falling of the True Dragon into the Divine Realm. What are they planning to do? Start a war with the True Dragons?"
"Sect Master, this matter is of great importance, beyond what we can handle. Let's open the Dao Domain Ladder."
The Great Elder of the Taihe Sect said in a deep voice.
"I had the same thought, but opening the Heavenly Ladder takes some time."
The Taihe Sect Master said gravely.
"Hopefully, they can hold off the True Dragon for a while, to buy us time to open the Heavenly Ladder."
The Great Elder of the Taihe Sect sighed.
The major powers mobilized their foundations and convened the various Realm's Immortal Heavenly Venerables to form an alliance to suppress the True Dragon—all of it was pushed from behind by the Taihe Sect.
The purpose was clear; it was to delay the True Dragon from causing havoc in the Taihe Realm, to ensure the seamless opening of the Heavenly Ladder.
The falling True Dragon in the Divine Realm, although immature, possessed the might of the Heavenly Union Realm, and was not something a group of Immortal Heavenly Venerables could resist by joining hands.
Born with overwhelming prowess, True Dragons stirred the wind and clouds of the Domain, the dragon's aura exciting the Domain, capable of employing powerful True Dragon Techniques.
"Get ready to open the island's Heavenly Ladder."
The Taihe Sect Master said solemnly.
This situation was beyond their ability to solve; they had no choice but to seek guidance from the Upper Sect of the Dao Realm.
"I wonder if the Great Elders know about the plot of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow against the True Dragon."
The Taihe Sect Master sighed inwardly, the current situation seemed like the machinations of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow were beyond the Great Elders' control.
The Taihe Realm was abuzz.
The converging strongmen heading off again, eager to participate in the battle to suppress the True Dragon.
Meng Chong and Jiang Buping had also arrived at the Taihe Realm, watching the excited powerhouses from various realms, they were momentarily at a loss for words.
"They can't possibly naïvely think that they can suppress a True Dragon with their numerical advantage, can they?"
Jiang Buping said with a puzzled face.
Furthermore, no one had sought the help of him and his fellow powerful second senior brother.
This made the matter seem rather unusual.
Meng Chong chuckled lightly and said, "The news has come out, it's an immature True Dragon. Since it's immature, and has lost its sanity, that means there is a possibility it could be hunted."

chapters.title: Chapter 909 - 473 Dao Domain Ladder, True Dragon Great Tribulation_2
chapters.content:
"True Dragon, that is a massive opportunity, a Supreme Treasure indeed. It's precisely because of this that they think they can suppress the True Dragon."
Jiang Buping suddenly understood. No wonder they didn't ask him and his second senior brother to take action. They were afraid that the two of them, with their powerful strength, would monopolize the hunt for the True Dragon.
Or at least take away a large portion of it.
"Moreover, behind all of this, there is also the influence of the Great Realm on the other Immortal Heavenly Venerables."
Meng Chong looked at the Communication Talisman, which contained secrets told to him by Zhou Qingshuang.
A force like the Da Yan Dynasty naturally knew that the Immortal Heavenly Venerables weren't enough to suppress the True Dragon, but they needed to slow down the True Dragon's rampaging pace.
That's why they initiated this operation.
"Fifth Junior Brother, do you think Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow is luring the True Dragon into the Divine Realm just to sow chaos there?"
Meng Chong pondered.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow colluding with outsiders is an irrefutable fact. Moreover, the purpose is for the Unity of Domain; the fall of the True Dragon into the Divine Realm is just one part of it. Could the next step be to lead those outsiders here?"
Jiang Buping also had his doubts.
"Let's go see how these people hunt the True Dragon."
Meng Chong was intrigued.
"Second Senior Brother, should we make a move?"
"Let's wait and see. If it's feasible, a bout with the True Dragon is not undesirable, but with our current strength, I fear we are not yet a match for this True Dragon.
"Our Eldest Senior Brother is soon to arrive from the Azure Sea Sphere. Let's see if he can subdue the Dragon."
Meng Chong and Jiang Buping were preparing to leave the Taihe Realm to observe the strong forces from various powers laying in ambush for the True Dragon.
En route, they encountered Wu Tianan who had sought them out.
"Dean Wu, what's this about?"
Meng Chong asked in surprise.
"The Taihe Realm might be facing a great event. This Token in my hand suddenly resonated, as if it's a kind of summons or qualification to go somewhere, but I'm not sure if it's a blessing or a curse."
A Token appeared in Wu Tianan's hand.
At this moment, the Token was emitting a faint glow.
"Dean Wu, where did you get this Token from?"
Meng Chong asked, bewildered.
"It was a gift from a senior; he had said that upon arriving in the Taihe Realm, the purpose of this Token would become known."
Wu Tianan recounted his encounter with Old Man Xiao.
"In that case, I will accompany Dean Wu on this journey."
Meng Chong nodded his head.
He was also very curious about this Token.
Thus, the three of them followed the guidance of the Token and traveled forth, eventually arriving at a location within the Taihe Sect.
This was a high platform, pale green throughout, made of an unknown stone material, and at this moment, faint ripples spread across the top of the platform.
Below the high platform, the Taihe Sect Master and others, each holding a Divine Artifact, inserted into the platform, channeled their Divine Soul Force uninterruptedly through the Divine Artifacts into the platform.
Boom!
The ripples on the platform grew more intense, and between the undulations, it seemed as if a staircase was descending from the Firmament.
The arrival of Meng Chong and the others caught the attention of the Taihe Sect Master and his group, causing their hearts to tighten and their vigilance to rise.
"What is this?"
Wu Tianan was astonished.
The summoning force transmitted from the Token came from that staircase, elusive and faint.
"It seems to be a passageway similar to the Spiritual Realm's Divine Bridge."
Meng Chong said calmly.
The three of them silently observed without intervening or interfering.
Waiting for the staircase to form.
At this moment, Meng Chong and Jiang Buping were also communicating, trying to understand exactly what this staircase was.
"The Dao Domain Ladder? I see."
Meng Chong suddenly looked forward to it.
Now, he was nearly invincible in the Divine Realm.
With the arrival of the Dao Domain Ladder, was it time for him to venture into the Dao Realm?
Boom!
The Dao Domain Ladder became clearer by the moment, and even the end of the ladder was stirring with powerful auras, not just one.
Clearly, the backers of these major powers like the Taihe Sect had already received the message about the True Dragon and were preparing to descend into the Divine Realm through the Dao Domain Ladder.
At the same time, in a location within the Divine Realm.
Roar!
The Roar of the True Dragon was bone-chillingly cold, transforming the surrounding thousand miles into a frozen expanse, as if covered by thick ice and snow.
But this ice and snow seemed to contain a certain oppressive force.
The flawless, pure white True Dragon twirled in the mid-air, its crimson eyes looking down at the surroundings, already in a state of frenzy.
The light pillars that stood between heaven and earth were like chains, sealing both domain and the Jade Snow True Dragon within.
Behind each chain, there were hundreds of Immortal Heavenly Venerables!
The Immortal Heavenly Venerables who had joined the fray were far too weak, and they made up nearly half of all the Immortal Heavenly Venerables from the Divine Realm.
The power of at least half of the Divine Realm had converged here.
