If even this could not subdue the True Dragon, it would mean that the Divine Realm no longer had the strength to resist.
Around the circling True Dragon, ice and snow spread, and this ice and snow were emitting lightning, containing tremendous power.
In the midst of circling, between heaven and earth, a breath surged, seeming to condense into a dragon shape; domain howled, immense Dragon Might oppressed sentient beings.
All the Immortal Heavenly Venerables felt a terrifying dominance at this moment, their minds and spirits surfacing with emotions of facing great terror.
Even as mighty as they were, they couldn't suppress the fear in their spirits.
Rustle!
The chains, reinforced by many Immortal Heavenly Venerables, were like a huge net, constantly tightening, attempting to trap the True Dragon within.
Seeing the net of chains getting smaller and smaller, as if about to successfully bind the True Dragon, all the Immortal Heavenly Venerables' faces showed excitement.
In a certain part of the sky, Old Man Xiao was silently watching.
"The great calamity of the Divine Realm, so many Immortal Heavenly Venerables will die at once, some people are indeed ruthless," murmured Old Man Xiao, shaking his head.
"But what does it have to do with me? Let's just watch how they struggle," he said, clearly not intending to intervene.
Roar!
The net created by chains, ever shrinking and drawing closer to the True Dragon, and at that moment, the True Dragon let out an extremely angry roar.
It seemed as if its rage was triggered by some memories.
Boom!
In an instant, the body of the True Dragon grew larger once again, a white, icy Dragon Breath enveloped the True Dragon, the sky in an instant grew dark with clouds, and thunder flashed.
Ice and lightning shone, between heaven and earth, the atmosphere was filled with suppression.
As if a great terror was emerging.
All the Immortal Heavenly Venerables' hearts skipped a beat involuntarily.
However, at this point, there was no possibility of retreat, otherwise certain death was the only outcome.
"Give it your all, victory or defeat hinges on this moment!" a powerful voice from the Great Realm resounded.
Boom!
All the Immortal Heavenly Venerables erupted with all their might.
"You, all, die for, me!" the True Dragon's pupils grew increasingly crimson, the violent aura intensified, and it spat out each word.
Roar!
Accompanied by a dragon chant, the True Dragon clawed out, the icy lightning tore through the sky, instantly breaking one of the chains.
Immediately after, it opened its dragon mouth.
A chilly radiance emerged in its mouth, and the nature's spiritual energy became turbulent. The dark clouds in the sky spun like a vortex and continuously sank lower.
A canopy of dark clouds, thunder raging, chilling to the bone, snowflake-like lightning, carrying the force of icy cold, cascaded down from the clouds above, as if a cataclysm had arrived.
All the Immortal Heavenly Venerables' faces turned pale, their minds filled with an uncontrollable sense of panic, a feeling of imminent disaster grew stronger.
The snowflake-like lightning contained a terrifying power of icy coldness.
What kind of True Dragon was this, and how terrifying were its True Dragon Techniques!
Among the powerhouses from the Great Realm, several quietly started to retreat, then turned and fled.
With an enraged dragon chant, this entire area had been covered by dark clouds, a white, icy breath exhaled from the dragon's mouth.
Blinding light filled the sky, and the battlefield was engulfed in icy coldness, as if heaven and earth had been frozen and shattered!
"Run for your lives!" the voice cried out in horror.
Immediately, there was an even more intense turmoil between heaven and earth, the True Dragon roared, clouds churned, thunder exploded, ice spread for miles, everything shattered under the Dragon Might.
Within a hundred miles, life ceased to exist, only the furious True Dragon twirled in mid-air.
It immediately rushed in a particular direction.
In distant lands, some Immortal Heavenly Venerables who had not participated in suppressing the True Dragon were shaking all over at this moment.
Such was the terror of the True Dragon's might!
"The Divine Realm is doomed!"
This True Dragon had clearly lost control, and after this battle, its rage and murderous intent were even more intense. If no Supreme Expert came to subdue this True Dragon, all of them, the Immortal Heavenly Venerables, would be annihilated by it.
The Divine Realm would suffer massive losses in the True Dragon calamity, with its powerful falling in droves.

chapters.title: Chapter 910 - 474: Turmoil in the Divine Realm, Crisis of Taimiao
chapters.content:
The Immortal Heavenly Venerables who participated in the encirclement and suppression of the True Dragon, apart from a few mighties from each Great Realm who silently escaped early on and thus survived, the rest of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables were completely annihilated.
The news spread, and the Divine Realm was shaken!
Countless mighty beings felt uneasy, even the forces of the Great Realms felt a strong sense of crisis.
What was even more terrifying was that, with the fall of numerous mighty beings of the Divine Realm, the Heavenly Grottoes in various places all erupted at this moment, launching attacks on the Divine Realm.
Netherworld Blood Child, witches, Imperishable True Spirits, and others flooded out of the Divine Realm, causing great turmoil.
In a short time, the Divine Realm entered a true great catastrophe.
"So they were wiped out just like that!"
In the Taihe Realm, Meng Chong and Jiang Buping were both astounded.
This True Dragon's strength was truly unparalleled; even if the two of them joined forces, they would not be its match.
And from the existing information, this True Dragon was indeed strong, but if the two of them encountered it, it was not as if they had no power to escape.
Boom!
The stairs above the firmament became clearer and clearer, sweat beaded on the foreheads of the Taihe Sect Master and others. At this moment, over a dozen elders rushed to the Taihe Sect to join in activating the Heavenly Ladder.
These elders, who had been in intense seclusion, were now forced to emerge due to the approaching crisis.
Di Yun Realm.
Tian Shiqi and the other four members of the Heavenly Slaughter watched the firmament. From this moment on, ripples could be seen spreading across the distant sky.
A cluster of radiance was emerging.
That was a sign of the Dao Domain Ladder opening.
"Quickly, get ready!"
Tian Shiqi said in a deep voice.
"Don't worry, everything is ready!"
In the Di Yun Abyss, thick clouds were swirling, nature's spiritual energy was being sucked into the Heavenly Grotto, and even the Heaven and Earth Laws seemed to flicker in and out at this moment.
As the clouds were drawn into the Heavenly Grotto, looking down from above, one would discover a massive Black Cave emerging at the central land of Di Yun Realm.
This was an enormous Heavenly Grotto, accumulating a powerful aura that seemed ready to burst forth at any moment, shooting straight into the sky!
A layer of faint radiance covered the Heavenly Grotto, sealing up all the accumulated powers within, preventing any of them from leaking out.
"Run for your lives!"
In some place of the Divine Realm, in front of a large city, an Immortal Heavenly Venerable seeing the rolling blood-light in the distance, turned pale with fear and roared crazily.
With the Divine Realm greatly weakened by the True Dragon catastrophe, it no longer had enough strength to suppress the Heavenly Grottoes.
Moreover, these extraterrestrial foes had obviously been prepared, just waiting for this moment.
In the Qinghua state, what was initially a tranquil Heavenly Grotto was now experiencing turmoil.
But, whether it was the Da Yue Abyss or the other three Great Abysses, they were all transformed into a Domain Divine Furnace by Su Lingxiu, and with the Qinghua Great Formation laid down, the Martial Artists from the Netherworld were suppressed as soon as they stepped into the Heavenly Grotto.
Moreover, nowadays, it's no exaggeration to say that Qinghua state possessed the number one strength in the Divine Realm.
After all, the three people of Emperor Da Yue have reached the Heavenly Union Realm as Martial Artists.
Apart from lacking the background of the Great Realms, and not having the backing of an Upper Sect in the Dao Realm, in terms of strength alone within the Divine Realm, Qinghua Sect was now the first.
"Something is wrong with Qinghua state!"
Inside the Da Yue Abyss, a murmuring voice drifted in from beyond the sky.
Those who originally planned to invade Qinghua state found that upon entering, they died, which led to a large number of Netherworld beasts being sent in. Yet, as these beasts entered, they were all refined into Blood Beads.
Qinghua state remained serene without even a ripple, even deliberately letting some Heavenly Grottoes be open, allowing the Netherworld Blood Child, the Blood Disciples, and the Netherworld beasts to enter, using them to temper the disciples of the Sect.
They had turned these Heavenly Grottoes into places for tempering.
The Nine Mountain Realm, adjacent to the Qinghua state, had already become the territory of the Demon Clan. With Red Cat establishing the Demon Clan and summoning the Divine Realm's Spirit Beasts, naturally, Immortal Realm Spirit Beasts came as well.
As for their initial intentions, whether they were ill-intentioned or not, this no longer mattered. Now they were all submissive under the might of Red Cat, the Demon King, and were completely controlled.
Becoming a member of the generals within the Divine Realm's Demon Clan.
"Today is the day my Demon Clan will rise to power, and the time to amass treasures for the Demon Clan, devour the blood qi of the Netherworld, and strengthen the bodies of my Demon Clan."
Red Cat stood proudly, holding a large saber in his hand.
He had already passed down the laws of the Demon Clan, granting these Spirit Beasts the opportunity to break away from the shackles of their bloodlines and, like Martial Artists, continuously cultivate and advance.
They naturally had absolute faith in the Great Demon King.
Boom!
The Demon Clan's army was on the move, and astonishingly, this army formed a Great Formation, unleashing immensely powerful strength.
Red Cat was very pleased with this, as it was the fruit of his hard work.
Of course, Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha also had their share of hard labor.
The Demon Clan Battle Array was something they got from Fang Hao. After his diligent comprehension and adjustments, it was made even more suited to the battle needs of the Demon Clan.
In Dahai Mountain, Wan Tianlin couldn't help but sigh; in just a short time, the master of Nine Mountains Realm had changed.
Even though Dahai Mountain seemed to belong to the Wan Family's domain and to the Human Clan, in reality, it was just a place for exchange, trade, and communication.
The turmoil in Nine Mountains Realm was trifling.
"The True Dragon is too strong; once I, Red Cat, become powerful, I will no longer fear any so-called True Dragon."
There was arrogance in Red Cat's bones.
Yu Xiaolong, however, was full of longing; after all, it was a Flood Dragon, and if it could transform into a True Dragon, its strength would be even greater.
"Great King, that True Dragon is of the same origin as us. One day, we must subjugate them and incorporate them into our Demon Clan ranks. I am willing to serve you, my king, and command the True Dragon Demon Clan!"
Yu Xiaolong flattered.

chapters.title: Chapter 911 - 474 Turmoil in the Divine Realm, The Crisis of Taimiao_2
chapters.content:
Red Cat glanced at it and coughed dryly, "Although I know you really want to transform into a True Dragon, I really can't help you right now, but you can seek your master, our Demon Clan Supreme Sovereign!"
Yu Xiaolong was startled, find Xu Yan?
Suddenly, it remembered that when it first encountered Xu Yan, it was suppressed by his Dragon Might.
"You mean, my Demon Clan Supreme Sovereign, my master, Sword God Xu Yan, can get True Dragon blood essence for me?"
Yu Xiaolong asked excitedly.
"Should be possible, I suppose? After all, he has the Subduing Dragon Palm, meant for subduing dragons."
Red Cat said uncertainly.
After all, that was a True Dragon, incomparably powerful; it had destroyed half of the experts in the Divine Realm in just one battle.
The Taimiao Realm is one of the major realms of the Divine Realm, and the Taimiao God Sect is a major power with a long heritage and profound background in the Divine Realm.
However, as the disaster of the True Dragon continued to spread, the True Dragon was now heading towards the Taimiao Realm, and once the True Dragon entered the Taimiao Realm, even the Taimiao God Sect would not be able to resist.
At this moment, in the grand hall of the Taimiao God Sect, the strong of the sect were gathering.
"Let's avoid this, go to the Taihe Realm."
The Sect Master of Taimiao God Sect sighed helplessly.
"The Taihe Sect should be opening the Dao Domain Ladder right now. The matter of the True Dragon will naturally be dealt by the Dao Domain."
"Apart from those in the Immortal Realm, the other Martial Artists should stay at their Sects. From the current situation, the True Dragon only pursues those in the Immortal Realm. Once we leave the Taimiao Realm, the True Dragon naturally won't ravage the Taimiao Realm for long."
The Sect Master of Taimiao Sect said with a heavy expression.
Just then, a beautiful figure walked in.
As she walked, the environment around her seemed dreamlike, both real and unreal, unable to be distinguished.
Xin Mengrou!
At this moment, Xin Mengrou had already broken through to the Immortal Realm.
"Mengrou, you've broken through?"
The Taimiao Sect Master said, surprised.
"Yes."
Xin Mengrou nodded.
With her breakthrough, from now on, she would be the overseer of the Illusionary Path of the Taimiao God Sect.
"The catastrophe of the True Dragon is imminent. We need to avoid its edge, so let's go to the Taihe Realm for now."
The Taimiao Sect Master said.
"Agreed!"
Xin Mengrou naturally had no objections.
So the strong of the Taimiao God Sect started to prepare to leave the Taimiao Realm and seek temporary shelter in the Taihe Realm, waiting for the opening of the Dao Domain Ladder.
"Grand Ancestral Mother, Great-Grandmother, have you broken through?"
Yun Miaomiao and Du Yuying said with overflowing joy.
"You two also strive to break through to the Immortal Realm soon. That kid Xu Yan is getting stronger and stronger."
Xin Mengrou sighed.
Yun Miaomiao and Du Yuying immediately wore serious expressions and nodded earnestly.
"Let's go, we'll head to the Taihe Realm for shelter. Although you have the seniors' Jade Talismans, you still can't be careless. Behind the calamity of the True Dragon is something complicated; try not to cause trouble for your elders."
Xin Mengrou reminded.
"We will follow everything that Great-Grandmother, Grand Ancestral Mother commands!"
Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao nodded.
The strong of the Taimiao God Sect immediately set off for the Taihe Realm, but before they could reach the Realm Gate, the True Dragon had already descended upon the Taimiao Realm.
Its speed was beyond expectation.
"This is bad, let's hurry through the wilderness!"
The people of Taimiao God Sect turned pale.
Given the speed of the True Dragon, it was likely aiming for the Taihe Realm as well!
The strong of Taimiao God Sect fled desperately. Xin Mengrou took Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao along, their speed no slower than the others.
Before they could cross the wilderness, a chilling might was already surging towards them from behind.
Everyone from Taimiao Sect turned to look back, their faces changing dramatically.
Dark clouds rolled, and lightning flashed as a spotless white dragon shadow, hidden within the dark clouds, appeared intermittently. Even from a great distance, they could feel the icy chill within the clouds.
Snowflakes fell from the dark clouds, and wherever they passed, the earth was frozen, vegetation turned to dust, presenting a vision of world-ending calamity.
"We can't escape!"
The faces of the Taimiao Realm's strong were pale; the True Dragon was clearly charging directly at them.
On one side of the dark clouds, Old Man Xiao walked leisurely, closely following the True Dragon, yet the True Dragon did not notice his presence.
In that moment, Old Man Xiao frowned as he looked toward the strong of Taimiao Sect, his brows knitting tightly in contemplation.
"The people of Taimiao... should I save them? If I do, it would surely expose me. Taimiao, since being caught in the contradiction between the Illusionary Path and Supreme Sovereign Path, has split into two factions, with conflicts never ceasing..."
At a certain moment, Old Man Xiao's gaze fell upon one person.
"Huh, this woman's approach to Illusionary Path is somewhat special, and why does she have Taimiao's secret technique? Did Taimiao personally teach her Illusionary Path? Since that's the case, I will save these three."
In that moment, Old Man Xiao made up his mind.
The others from the Taimiao Sect, it mattered not if they died, but he would save these three, as if it were for the sake of his ties with Taimiao.
Moreover, saving the three women would likely not expose him.
While the Sect Master of Taimiao and the others kept fleeing in madness, whether they split up or not, with the speed of the True Dragon, they would each be hunted down. Rather than fleeing helplessly, it might be better to prepare for a desperate fight, maybe it would bring some chance of survival.
Xin Mengrou's brow furrowed, hesitating whether to use the secret technique of the Illusionary Path to temporarily bewilder the True Dragon, to grab a chance to escape.
But she was not too sure she could confuse the True Dragon.
After all, the strength of the True Dragon behind them was much stronger than hers.
"All, die!"
The tyrannical voice of the True Dragon reached their ears.
Dark clouds engulfed the sky, making the world dark, with a pervasive sense of icy coldness.
"We can't escape, prepare for battle."
The Taimiao Sect Master was solemn and somewhat desperate.

chapters.title: Chapter 912 - 474: Turmoil in the Divine Realm, Crisis of Taimiao_3
chapters.content:
Before the True Dragon had arrived, its Dragon Might stirred the domain, feeling like a mountain pressing down upon one's heart, unbearably uncomfortable.
Yun Miaomiao and Du Yuying's faces turned pale, being the weakest among them. Even with Xin Mengrou's protection, facing the might of the True Dragon, they still felt terrified!
"Ancestor, I should use the predecessor's Jade Talisman."
Yun Miaomiao spoke up.
Xin Mengrou's beautiful brows furrowed. Although she knew that the predecessor was incredibly powerful, the Dragon Tribulation had many implications and could cause a lot of trouble if one got involved.
Unless absolutely necessary, she was reluctant to trouble the predecessor and was afraid of diminishing the predecessor's favorable impression of her.
"You must think this through, once the Jade Talisman is used, it is very likely to kill this True Dragon, but there are many complications behind a True Dragon, and the trouble is not insignificant.
"By attracting such huge trouble for that predecessor, would your Young Master Xu feel somewhat discontent?"
At Xin Mengrou's words, Yun Miaomiao and Du Yuying immediately hesitated.
Xin Mengrou inwardly sighed with a wry smile, knowing that when it involved Xu Yan, these two girls would be extra cautious, fearing even the slightest bit of his dissatisfaction.
Ao!
Dark clouds rolled, lightning flashed, and a bone-chilling coldness filled the air. A dragon's roar echoed through the domain.
Yun Miaomiao and Du Yuying looked even paler, their delicate bodies trembling slightly as they exchanged glances, still unable to make that decision.
The mighty ones of Taimiao Divine Sect looked on with despair. From a closer distance, they could feel the might of the True Dragon even more.
"My Taimiao God Sect bears no grudge against True Dragons, why do you pursue and kill us?"
The Sect Master of Taimiao Divine Sect couldn't help but speak out.
"Die! All must die, exterminate all of you!"
However, what came back was the response of a True Dragon, who had lost its reason, filled with chilling murderous intent.
Hu!
Nature's spiritual energy swept in, the dark clouds descended, and pieces of lightning like snowflakes exuded a bone-chilling coldness, rolling in.
At this moment, there was no escape for the mighty ones of the Taimiao Divine Sect.
At the fringe of the wilderness, from a distant place, a group of martial artists from the Taimiao Realm watched in despair towards the dark clouds, wondering if the Taimiao elders would be annihilated by the True Dragon.
If so, how could the Taimiao Divine Sect continue to stand in the Divine Realm?
Unless a power from the Dao Realm presided over them.
"Make your move, that's the only way!"
The Sect Master of Taimiao said in a deep voice.
As her voice fell, an incredibly dominating aura surged from her body, and her delicate figure suddenly burst forth with a haughty and disdainful presence.
She practiced the Tai Miao Supreme Path!
One by one, Taimiao's mighty ones released their momentum, all exuding an aura of looking down upon the world with supreme arrogance, a stark contrast to their delicate exterior.
And Xin Mengrou and others emanated a sense of etherealness; in an instant, it was as if in a dreamlike state, spreading around them as if dreams could become reality, and dreams themselves were already real.
Tai Miao Illusionary Path!
Xin Mengrou glanced at the two girls, who were still hesitating, and smiled bitterly in her heart. Even at this critical moment, they were still indecisive for fear of displeasing Xu Yan.
"Die!"
At this moment, it seemed that the eruptions of Taimiao's mighty ones had provoked the True Dragon as an angry voice came through.
Boom!
The dark clouds churned, lightning thundered, and the coldness seemed intent on freezing the entire domain. The True Dragon plunged down from the clouds and attacked directly.
In this moment, facing the might of the True Dragon, the hearts of Taimiao's mighty ones trembled, and the haughty aura they carried seemed on the verge of collapse.
However, just then, a dragon's roar sounded, and a Golden Giant Dragon appeared suddenly, ripping through the dark clouds and charging at the jade-like flawless True Dragon!

chapters.title: Chapter 913 - 475 Xu Yan Subdues the Dragon, Shocking the World
chapters.content:
Dark clouds tumbled, Dragon Might vast and mighty, crimson dragon eyes filled with violence and murderous intent, the True Dragon swooping down to kill.
The Sect Master of the Taimiao Sect and others, despite exerting their full strength, felt their own momentum nearly collapse under the overwhelming Dragon Might, their eyes filled with despair and helplessness.
They had thought that by joining forces, they would have some power to resist.
However, at this moment, facing the might of the True Dragon, they felt so powerless, so aware of their own fragility and insignificance.
A heart trembled, a face turned pale, the crisis of death had already descended.
Yun Miaomiao and Du Yuying were still hesitating, unsure of what to do, their hearts filled with tension. Once they truly faced a life and death crisis, even if they didn't actively trigger the Jade Talisman, it would activate to protect them.
And the final result, would the True Dragon be killed as well?
To cause trouble for their senior, could this possibly make Xu Yan unhappy?
It was at this moment, a dragon's roar sounded.
This dragon's roar echoed through the Domain, a clear, resonant sound that carried the essence of masculinity and authority.
It differed from the sound of the True Dragon that had just roared, with certain distinctions.
But, undoubtedly, this dragon's roar was equally heart-shaking, also echoing through the Domain, stirring the winds and clouds, Dragon Might awe-inspiring.
Another vast presence arrived abruptly.
This was an immense Dragon Might, yet it differed from the might of the Jade White True Dragon.
The Golden Giant Dragon appeared suddenly, bursting through the heavy dark clouds, its virile and ferocious aura even dissipating the icy chill!
The originally swooping Jade White True Dragon abruptly raised its head to look at the suddenly appearing Golden Giant Dragon. Even in its mindless state, it seemed somewhat bewildered.
Ao!
Then, a roar rang out, a sound of anger and confusion, and perhaps an indescribable shock?!
The members of the Taimiao Sect were stunned at this moment.
Where did this second True Dragon come from?
"Quick, retreat!"
The Sect Master of the Taimiao Sect called out in a panic.
The Taimiao Sect's experts hurriedly reined in their aura, frantically backing away.
Ao!
The Jade Snow True Dragon gave another roar, its head lowered to look at the fleeing Taimiao Sect experts, and with another dive, it came to kill again.
The Taimiao Sect's experts only then realized, the Golden True Dragon that had just appeared had already burst and dissipated!
"What is going on?"
As they saw the True Dragon coming to kill again, despair once again surfaced on everyone's faces.
Only Yun Miaomiao and Du Yuying were overjoyed, their faces flushed with excitement, looking around eagerly to find that graceful and handsome figure.
Ao!
Suddenly, the Golden Giant Dragon burst through the dark clouds again, rushed toward the Jade White True Dragon, and issued an authoritative roar.
The True Dragon that was about to attack the Taimiao Sect's experts again halted its movement, let out an angry growl, and swiftly swung its claw. Icy cold to the bone, lightning flashing, winds and clouds swirling, a vicious attack, it struck towards the Golden True Dragon!
The Golden Giant Dragon spiraled, spewing a beam of light from its mouth, its claw swinging out as well, in a powerful and domineering strike, meeting the oncoming attack.
Pu!
However, as soon as the attacks touched, the claw of the Golden Giant Dragon shattered instantly, and then dispersed.
At this moment, the Taimiao Sect's experts realized that the Golden Giant Dragon was not a real True Dragon, but rather a powerful form of Martial Arts in the shape of a dragon.
However, they were puzzled as to why this dragon-shaped attack was so similar to a true dragon, and surpassed their understanding of Martial Arts.
Ao!
At this moment, the True Dragon's crimson gaze turned towards the exterior of the dark clouds, emitting an angry roar.
The Taimiao Sect's experts frantically fled from within the clouds.
And after they came out, they finally saw the person who had intervened from outside the clouds.
It was a handsome young man, surrounded by a rotating sword wheel, his aura extremely powerful, and with an edge like that of an invincible divine sword.
The moment they saw the young man, a name flashed through the minds of the Taimiao Sect's experts!
Sword God Xu Yan!
At this moment, Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao were excited beyond measure, their gazes intensely focused on that figure.
Boom!
The Domain shook, the flawless Jade White True Dragon spiraled out from the clouds, its erect head glaring fiercely at that figure.
Whoosh!
The dark clouds whirled like a vortex, continuously rotating, yet also contracting. In the end, the clouds disappeared, leaving only a flawless Jade White True Dragon circling midair.
However, at this moment, the might of the True Dragon was even more substantial, even more furious.
The aura of the True Dragon also seemed stronger, as if it had been completely provoked.
"Who is that?"
The Sect Master of the Taimiao Sect turned her gaze towards Old Man Xiao nearby, pondering in her heart.
This person, could he have been watching the battle all this time, ready to watch them be slaughtered by the True Dragon?
Old Man Xiao was bewildered at this moment. From the moment Xu Yan's figure appeared in the Domain, raising his hand to send forth a Golden Dragon into the clouds, he had been dumbstruck.
What kind of Martial Arts was that?
To send out a True Dragon?
If it was merely a dragon-shaped palm force, it wouldn't be anything special; any strong cultivator with decent control over their power could shape their palm force into a dragon.
But such dragon-shaped palm force wouldn't enhance the power and was actually less effective because of its flashy nature, failing to unleash the cultivator's true strength.
But the Golden Dragon unleashed by this youth was not a mere dragon-shaped palm force but seemed like an actual True Dragon!
Those commanding eyes, that vast Dragon Might, that dragon form and essence, while different from a True Dragon, undoubtedly belonged to the ranks of True Dragons.

chapters.title: Chapter 914 - 475: Xu Yan Subdues Xiang Long, Shocking the World_2
chapters.content:
```
"What is going on with this Divine Realm, why are there so many monsters emerging?"
Old Man Xiao muttered to himself.
Wu Tianan could also be considered half a monster, his destiny was simply outrageous.
As for Meng Chong and Jiang Buping, they were monsters among monsters, making him wonder if the Domain was about to get stronger.
"Could this young man have come here to subdue the dragon?"
Old Man Xiao was astounded.
Indeed, Xu Yan's strength was formidable, especially the biting chill of his Sword Dao's might, which was unbelievable.
He slew the Immortal Heavenly Venerable as if he were slaughtering a small chicken, yet no matter how one looked at it, his strength seemed weaker than that of the True Dragon.
"The Jade Snow True Dragon, it must be that old dragon's treasured descendent, a prodigy among true dragons with a special True Dragon's Power that makes it stronger than an average True Dragon.
"This young man, wanting to overcome the strong with the weak, to suppress this True Dragon, is probably wishful thinking!"
Old Man Xiao did not have high hopes for Xu Yan.
At this moment, Xu Yan's expression was extremely grave, but his fighting spirit was soaring.
"Worthy of being a True Dragon, its strength is indeed overwhelming. Only upon witnessing a True Dragon with my own eyes can I fully appreciate the vastness of Dragon Might, which holds great significance for my Subduing Dragon Palm."
By this point, Xu Yan had realized the differences and similarities between his Subduing Dragon Palm's Dragon Might, the dragon's will, and the True Dragon's qualities, yet they also had similarities.
"My Subduing Dragon Palm is about to achieve Great Achievement—it is, after all, a palm used for subduing. Even though I am weaker than her, the Subduing Dragon Palm can indeed subdue; it is the palm for subduing a dragon.
"Master said that the Subduing Dragon Palm conquers dragons with a dragon, so I must let the Subduing Dragon Palm evolve and elevate, letting it mimic, even learn from, the True Dragon's combat technique, and use the True Dragon Technique to subdue the True Dragon!"
Xu Yan was enlightened at this moment.
He felt he had truly grasped the essence of the Subduing Dragon Palm.
"My Subduing Dragon Palm, once it subdues this dragon, will truly reach Great Achievement, even Perfection!"
This was about the Martial Arts of the Subduing Dragon Palm reaching Great Achievement or Perfection, not just a particular level of the palm technique reaching Great Achievement or Perfection.
After personally encountering a True Dragon and taking action, Xu Yan's Subduing Dragon Palm had already advanced to the ninth level.
At this moment, the strong members of the Taimiao Sect were no longer preparing to flee but were observing from a distance instead.
"What Realm is Sword God Xu Yan actually in? Why is he so powerful when he is neither in the Immortal Realm nor the Heavenly Union Realm?"
While the Sect Master of the Taimiao Sect and the others were puzzled, their hearts were also shocked beyond measure.
Only upon seeing with their own eyes could they understand that Xu Yan was even more powerful than the rumors.
The respect of the world's Sword Dao, the name of the Sword God, is indeed well-deserved!
At this moment, Xu Yan was like an extraordinary divine sword, his edge fully revealed. Such might of the Sword Dao surpassed their understanding, never seen or heard before!
Not just the Immortal Heavenly Venerable of Taimiao Sect, even Old Man Xiao was shocked in his heart.
"Is this Sword Dao?"
Such a piercing and sharp Sword Dao, was something he had never seen in his life.
Ao!
The Roar of the True Dragon echoed, the Jade White and flawless True Dragon, its crimson eyes set on Xu Yan, its malice growing more and more intense.
"Die! Die!"
Boom!
The True Dragon suddenly attacked Xu Yan, lifting a claw, and as it swung forward, a bone-chilling thunder as if freezing the very void of the heavens and earth, struck down at Xu Yan in an instant.
Hum!
A resonance of sword cry arose, a colossal sword light standing erect all around, the intent of obliteration imminent, as in a flash, the sword light transformed into a Sword Array, enveloping the True Dragon.
Crackle!
A layer of silver-white light emerged on the Jade Snow True Dragon, its scales as if covered with a layer of solid ice, a claw lifted and swept, creating ripples and gathering storm clouds to form a powerful defense.
Boom!
In just a short time, the Sword Array had already shattered, the True Dragon diving out, its tail sweeping, a piercingly cold bolt of lightning like a sharp blade slashed diagonally outwards.
Pfft!
The Yin Yang Undying Sword, endlessly cycling and in dissolution, Xu Yan's expression grew stern as the might of this True Dragon Technique, was so formidable that even his Yin Yang Undying Sword was nearly unable to withstand it.
The True Dragon followed up with a dive, ready to use its formidable True Dragon body to slay its enemy.
Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao's hearts were suspended, unwaveringly fixed on the scene, each attack of the True Dragon tightened their spirits.
Swish!
Xu Yan's figure shifted positions in an instant, once again unleashing a sword strike.
Ao!
This was the first time the True Dragon encountered an enemy it could not crush, and it became even more irritable, its killing intent growing more potent.
Boom!
```
Xu Yan was battling the True Dragon, observing its attacks and understanding the True Dragon Technique. As the battle became fiercer, Xu Yan felt immense pressure.
If not for relying on quick position changes and swift speed, he probably would have been defeated.
"It is true, the True Dragon is incredibly strong; with my current realm, defeating the True Dragon is indeed too difficult."
"However, my method to subdue the dragon is not the Sword Dao, but the Subduing Dragon Palm!"
Xu Yan felt it was almost time, the moment to use the Subduing Dragon Palm had arrived.
"Once Xu Yan cannot hold on, we must escape immediately!"
The Taimiao Sect Master said gravely at that moment.
The balance of power on the battlefield had become quite clear, with Xu Yan at a disadvantage.
The other strong members of the Taimiao Sect nodded in agreement.
Now was not the time to flee; they could hardly resist the urge to witness the Sword God battling the True Dragon.
"Whew, I thought this young man would be able to subdue the dragon; you gave me quite a scare."
Old Man Xiao also sighed at this moment.
Xu Yan, after all, could not overcome the True Dragon.
After all, the True Dragon's strength was superior to his, and to fight against the stronger, especially against a True Dragon, to have battled for such a long time was already enough to shock the world.
Just then, Xu Yan, whose Sword Dao's might illuminated the domain, suddenly ceased the display of his Sword Dao's power.
"Not good, run quickly!"
The Taimiao Sect Master's expression changed drastically.
Yet, just as they made their move, another overwhelming Dragon Might suddenly emerged, majestic, vigorous, and authoritative.
It seemed as if this Dragon Might was more genuine.
"Today, I, Xu Yan, shall subdue the dragon!"
The strong members of the Taimiao Sect, who had just been ready to flee, now looked toward the battlefield in astonishment.
Xu Yan's body surged with immense Dragon Might, growing stronger, and giving off a feeling of absolute authenticity, dominance, and awe-inspiring authority.
It was as if his Dragon Might was the true Dragon Might.
Old Man Xiao was also stunned, even reflexively rubbing his eyes, looking closely at Xu Yan over and over again, making sure this was a person, not an actual True Dragon.
Ao!
Golden Dragons coiled around Xu Yan; he raised his hand and smacked, unleashing a roaring Golden Dragon that charged at the Jade White True Dragon, raising its claws and striking the moment it launched its attack.
If not seen with their own eyes that this Golden Dragon sprang from Xu Yan's own hand, anyone might mistake it for a real True Dragon!
Ao!
The Jade Snow True Dragon let out a roar of surprise and growing irritability, charging fiercely at the Golden Dragon. The two dragons clashed together, but in the blink of an eye, the Golden Giant Dragon was torn to shreds.
Xu Yan's expression did not change; he smacked down another palm.
"Just right, I'll use this True Dragon to refine my Subduing Dragon Palm!"
The Golden Giant Dragon charged at the Jade White True Dragon; the two dragons engaged in battle once again, but in a short while, the Golden Giant Dragon was shredded again.
But immediately after, another Golden Giant Dragon appeared, battling the Jade White True Dragon. At this moment, Old Man Xiao was shocked to discover that this Golden Giant Dragon seemed more agile and had even mimicked the True Dragon's combat style.
Boom!
As expected, the Golden Giant Dragon was once again obliterated, but a new Golden Giant Dragon appeared to fight time after time.
After many continuous battles, even the Taimiao Sect Master and others noticed that as the Golden Giant Dragon fought more times, its way of battling resembled that of a True Dragon more and more.
Not only did the close-quarters combat look similar, but even the True Dragon Technique shared about seventy to eighty percent similarity.
Gulping!
"What kind of Martial Arts is this?"
Looking towards the young figure in the midst of the battlefield, everyone was shaking with shock.
The great battle here had attracted more and more Martial Artists, even an Immortal Heavenly Venerable from outside the Taimiao Realm rushed over, all to witness the epic battle of the True Dragon.
The news of Sword God Xu Yan subduing a dragon in the Taimiao Realm spread like a wild wind, shocking everyone.
"To subdue a dragon with a dragon, that's what it is; not only subduing its body but also its heart; attacking not just its physique but also its will... I have finally come to understand today."
"This True Dragon has lost its sense of reason, deprived of rationality, so it's rather difficult to strike at its heart, after all, it has already lost its reasoning and is out of its mind."
"But, I can subdue its physique, its will!"
Xu Yan was exceedingly excited at that moment.
"Die! Die! All of you, die!"
The Jade Snow True Dragon became more and more irascible and enraged, its eyes turning increasingly bloodshot.
Roaring, it shattered the Golden Giant Dragon and charged towards Xu Yan.
At that moment, with hands clapped together and a solemn expression, Xu Yan declared, "If one dragon can't subdue you, then two, three..."

chapters.title: Chapter 915 - 476: Collapse of the Heavenly Ladder, Great Changes in the Divine Realm
chapters.content:
In the eyes of the astonished martial artists of Taimiao Sect, Xu Yan released palm strike after palm strike, and within an instant, eighteen golden giant dragons burst forth.
They charged toward the incoming Jade Snow True Dragon.
Eighteen golden giant dragons, attacking from all directions, wrapped themselves around the Jade Snow True Dragon, and in just a moment, the pale white True Dragon was engulfed by the golden giants.
Immediately after, the furious roar of the Jade Snow True Dragon and its intense, savage dragon might erupted, along with the terrifying techniques of the True Dragon, unleashing their power in a reckless frenzy.
However, the eighteen golden giant dragons, entwining from all sides, were now tangled with the Jade Snow True Dragon, rolling and coiling in midair.
Boom!
As one golden giant dragon collapsed, Xu Yan created another to replenish its place.
Old Man Xiao watched, dumbfounded, as the Jade Snow True Dragon was wrapped up and, to some extent, the ensnarement shamed the creature.
Nineteen dragons entangled together, eighteen of which were golden, tumbling over each other while the pale white True Dragon struggled and roared in frenzy.
Yet, it was never able to break free from the binds of the eighteen golden giant dragons; the scene resembled the eighteen dragons assaulting a delicate jade dragon.
"What a sin!"
Old Man Xiao was stunned as he sighed.
Xu Yan continuously replenished the depleted golden giant dragons, sweat beads forming on his forehead. Subduing this True Dragon was a lot of pressure, even for him.
The consumption was massive, but to Xu Yan, such expenditure was of little consequence.
"It won't do to keep this up, this dragon has clearly lost its senses, becoming extremely violent. Its mind is filled with anger and hatred."
Xu Yan furrowed his brow.
This True Dragon had clearly been the victim of a plot, deliberately lured into the Divine Realm to create chaos and turmoil.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, huh."
Aside from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, there was no other force involved.
Daring to scheme against a True Dragon meant that the forces behind Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow were formidable indeed to have offended a True Dragon.
"If the True Dragon is killed, it may cause some trouble, and that would play right into Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's hands. I refuse to give them what they want."
As Xu Yan pondered this, he contemplated how to awaken the True Dragon that had lost its reason.
At that moment, Xu Yan's expression tightened slightly; the dragon entangled in midair opened its mouth wide.
Nature's spiritual energy crazily spiraled into its mouth, its pale body radiating a hazy light, as though a white mist enveloped the dragon's form.
Bang!
One after another, the golden giant dragons shattered, and Xu Yan's expression grew solemn. He then struck out palm after palm to restore the broken golden dragons.
"Is this the dragon's breath? A True Dragon's exhalation?"
Xu Yan's frown deepened.
The exhalation of the Jade Snow True Dragon seemed not to target him but was a passive response.
Boom!
Suddenly, the Domain shook slightly with a faint rumbling, and the Firmament above shimmered with radiance.
"The Dao Domain Ladder has opened!"
The Sect Master of Taimiao exclaimed joyfully.
The opening of the Dao Domain Ladder meant that the powerhouses of the Dao Realm were about to descend into the Divine Realm, and the calamity of the True Dragon was about to end.
Although, judging by the current situation, even without the arrival of Dao Realm powerhouses, the calamity of the True Dragon would have ended. However, the significance of the Dao Domain Ladder's opening was different.
Old Man Xiao looked up at the sky, his expression indifferent but his lips curling into a mocking smile.
"Let's see how you all struggle, scheme, and plot against each other!"
He sneered inwardly.
In the Di Yun Realm, the mist that permeated the ground had already dispersed.
The entrance to the massive Heavenly Grotto, as if brimming for a long time, was on the verge of releasing its immense pressure.
The shield sealing the entrance to the Heavenly Grotto was now cracked.
The Heavenly Slaughter powerhouse seated at the grotto clenched his fists, his face red as he struggled to maintain it.
Tian Shiqi looked nervous; at that moment, a spirit bird flew by bringing a message.
"Not good!"
Tian Shiqi's expression changed drastically the instant he saw the message.
"Xu Yan, you dare to sabotage my grand plans!"
He was starting to get restless.
Xu Yan was subduing a dragon in Taimiao Realm!
While it hadn't yet been reported that Xu Yan had subdued the dragon, the ongoing fierce battle with the True Dragon had its momentum abruptly halted.
And if Xu Yan's intervention suppressed the True Dragon, preventing the Taihe Realm from opening the Dao Domain Ladder, how would their plan succeed?
At this moment, Tian Shiqi was a mix of panic and rage with a chilling intent to kill.
Boom!
But just then, as light sparkled in the Firmament, he finally breathed a sigh of relief. The Dao Domain Ladder had opened.
"Get ready!"
Tian Shiqi spoke with a grave tone.
"Tian Shiqi, watch for the right moment, and as soon as it comes, inform us to remove the seal!"
A Heavenly Slaughter powerhouse spoke with difficulty.
Tian Shiqi nodded, focusing intently on the Firmament, waiting for the perfect opportunity.
In Taihe Realm, at the location of the Dao Domain Ladder.
"Big brother is subduing a dragon; I really want to go see," Meng Chong said with a look of regret.
Jiang Buping nodded, but as the two were waiting for the Dao Domain Ladder to descend, they were unable to be in two places at once and could only miss the opportunity to witness their big brother subdue the dragon.
However, if the big brother did subdue the dragon, they would still have a chance to witness the True Dragon.
Boom!
The steps in the Firmament became clearer, and a Tao-like rhyme enveloped them. Then, at the end of the steps, the outline of a small realm appeared, faint and indistinct.
Finally, a step descended!
The Dao Domain Ladder has opened!

chapters.title: Chapter 916 - 476: Collapse of the Heavenly Ladder, Great Changes in the Divine Realm_2
chapters.content:
The token in Wu Tianan's hand provided guidance, simply by stepping onto the Heavenly Ladder, he could leave the Divine Realm and head to the Dao Realm.
With this token, one could ascend the Heavenly Ladder and enter the Dao Realm.
"Dean Wu, please go ahead."
Meng Chong said to Wu Tianan.
Wu Tianan hesitated and said, "My strength is meager, the Dao Realm must be very powerful; it would be better if I gave you this token."
Meng Chong shook his head and said, "If I want to go to the Dao Realm, I will do so naturally. Nothing can stop us. Dean Wu, since you have this token, you must be qualified. You should have a place to stay once you reach the Dao Realm."
"Very well, in that case, I will go to the Dao Realm!"
Wu Tianan thought of the person he was searching for, having no leads in the Divine Realm; he could only try his luck in the Dao Realm.
"Meng Chong, Jiang Buping, the Dao Domain Ladder is opening; I hope you two won't..."
At this moment, the Taihe Sect Master spoke in a grave voice.
"If Dean Wu is to ascend the Heavenly Ladder, if you try to stop him, I won't show mercy."
Meng Chong interrupted.
"What happened?"
A voice came from above the Dao Domain Ladder.
Meng Chong and Jiang Buping's expressions grew serious; the speaker was extremely powerful.
"Divine Envoy, a True Dragon has fallen in the Divine Realm and is causing chaos everywhere. It's a major catastrophe in the Divine Realm!"
The Taihe Sect Master said respectfully.
"What?"
An astonished voice came from above the ladder.
Suddenly, the Heavenly Ladder shook, and several figures were descending from above.
All at once, Meng Chong and Jiang Buping's faces drastically changed.
"Fall back!"
Meng Chong grabbed Wu Tianan, and in an instant, they vanished from the spot, fleeing far away within moments.
Jiang Buping did the same. Wu Tianan had not yet recovered and was about to ask what had happened when the earth and heavens began to tremble.
The firmament exploded, the Heaven and Earth Laws emerged but instantly collapsed. Then, the Power of the Dao Principles surged forth.
A terrifying aura burst forth from somewhere within the Divine Realm, charging towards the firmament and the Dao Domain Ladder!
Vaguely, it seemed a vast dragon qi had merged with this terrifying aura, a faint dragon's roar seemingly echoing through heaven and earth.
Boom!
The firmament exploded, and under the impact of this terrifying burst of light, the Dao Domain Ladder instantly collapsed!
The earth shook and the entire Divine Realm trembled.
With the explosion of the Dao Domain Ladder, a large rift opened in the firmament, and a strong aura poured down from it, vaguely visible as a small realm falling.
The sudden change stunned everyone, and the Taihe Sect Master and others, even unable to flee, were engulfed by the collapsing force of the Dao Domain Ladder and instantly obliterated.
"Run for it!"
The Taihe Sect was in chaos, and the remaining Immortal Heavenly Venerables each roared.
"Go!"
Meng Chong and Jiang Buping were terrified; that surge of terrifying aura was too horrifying, and it seemed particularly unique.
It contained traces of the Netherworld, witches, and Imperishable True Spirits. It seemed like a gathering of extraterrestrial qi which erupted in an instant, assaulting the firmament.
Indistinctly, Meng Chong heard several screams coming from above the Heavenly Ladder.
The Heaven and Earth Laws seemed already disturbed, and a slow manifestation of the principle force started, with the collapse of the Dao Domain Ladder only marking the beginning of a chain reaction.
Meng Chong, Jiang Buping, and Wu Tianan all fled in an instant.
A force from the Dao Realm struck down at the location of the Heavenly Ladder, sweeping through with its rule force amid roaring and trembling, like a small realm falling from the heavens, crashing towards the Taihe Realm.
This was undoubtedly a major catastrophe for the Taihe Realm.
Many experts could only manage to take their closest descendants with them; the weaker martial artists had to leave their fate to the heavens.
It was the beginning of a great escape for warriors of the Taihe Realm.
The trembling continued, not only in the Taihe Realm but throughout the Divine Realm as well. And with the tremors, the Realm Gates collapsed, leaving only wilderness connecting the realms.
This allowed escaping from the Taihe Realm to require much more time.
However, with the collapse of the Realm Gates, the connection between the realms changed somewhat, making crossing the wilderness easier, with many restrictions lifted.
Boom!
The collapse of the Dao Domain Ladder shook the Divine Realm, especially the Great Realm forces, who were terrified.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, so ruthless?"
"With the ladder collapsed, what are we to do?"
"It's over, is our path completely blocked?"
Many strong individuals felt their scalps go numb, regretting those who merely watched as Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow ran amok.
At the location of the Dao Domain Ladder's collapse, the small realm continued falling with a rumbling sound, and the Domain Dao Rule also surfaced momentarily, seemingly impacted by the extraterrestrial qi, emerging involuntarily to maintain the operation of the domain.
And a force of Principle was also pulling that minor Domain as it plummeted into the Taihe Realm, bridging the connection between the Divine Realm and the Dao Realm.
Di Yun Realm.
A massive Heavenly Grotto erupted with a terrifying aura, striking the Firmament and thundering towards the Dao Domain Ladder.
After the explosion, this Heavenly Grotto began to shrink.
Domain Dao Rules surged forth, striving to restore this part of the Heavenly Grotto, blocking the further assault of the external Qi on the Domain.
"Success!"
Tian Shiqi revealed a smile.
The most critical step had finally been completed.
The subsequent tasks were no longer something he could participate in with his current strength.
"Where is Xu Yan!"
Suddenly, within the Heavenly Grotto, a cold voice tinged with a hint of seduction echoed.
A pink light flickered in and out, seeming to want to enter the Domain.
Seductive Witch!
Tian Shiqi's lips twitched; he did not understand how exactly Xu Yan had managed to offend such a Supreme Expert.
"Xu Yan is in Xiang Long!"
Tian Shiqi responded.
Boom!
The Heavenly Grotto inside continued to tremble. The Seductive Witch tried to seize the opportunity to enter the Domain, yet the Heavenly Grotto was already healing and recovering, and the Domain Dao Rules kept emerging, making it impossible for her to enter.
"Damn it!"
The Seductive Witch looked frustrated.
"Bring Xu Yan to me, and there will be a great reward!"
Finally, the Seductive Witch could only reluctantly promise a hefty reward.
"The Domain is unifying. When the time comes, you can come in and settle the account with him personally," Tian Shiqi pondered aloud.
"Hmph!"
The Seductive Witch snorted coldly and eventually had to withdraw reluctantly.
The tremors in the Divine Realm continued, the Firmament's brilliance shone brightly, and a Spirit Qi Storm swept over the Divine Realm above the Firmament, making the Domain Lingji seems more active and temperamental at this moment.
The sudden change shocked all the powerful beings in the Divine Realm.
Taimiao Realm.
The Sect Master of the Taimiao Sect and the others were stunned.
The Dao Domain Ladder has collapsed, and is the Taihe Realm going to be destroyed?
Old Man Xiao also wore a look of surprise, murmuring, "Could it be the Earth Shadow Realm? Earth Shadow has died, consumed by Heavenly Slaughter, causing the Earth Shadow Realm to fall seems reasonable.
"But who would have guessed, the force pulling the Earth Shadow Realm to fall was related to True Dragon Qi. Could it be that the treasure stolen by the True Dragon Clan originally was snatched by Earth Shadow and finally acquired by Heavenly Slaughter?
"Or perhaps, that treasure merged into the Earth Shadow Realm, which is why Heavenly Slaughter chose the Earth Shadow Realm?"
In the Dao Domain Three Hundred Realms, not every realm has a Realm Master present, and even if there are Realm Masters in the domains, they are not the original founders of the domain.
During the original battle, several Minor Heaven and Earth Masters had fallen or vanished.
Heavenly Slaughter was not the original Realm Master, but his strength was extreme, belonging to the second generation of Realm Masters, and the Heavenly Slaughter Realm he occupies was not initially his.
"His ambitions are indeed not small!"
Old Man Xiao chuckled merrily.
His gaze shifted towards the battlefield of Xu Yan and the Jade Snow True Dragon, where the great battle had already concluded.
After the True Dragon exhaled that True Dragon Qi, it became weakened, entangled by eighteen Golden Dragons, unable to move in the slightest, not even able to struggle a bit.
Xu Yan has subdued the dragon!
A True Dragon, just like that, subdued!
"You bastard, let me go!"
Suddenly, the voice of a girl, almost crying, rang out.
"You scoundrel, shameless villain, filthy bastard, release me now, let me go!"
Old Man Xiao's lips twitched, and he couldn't help but let out another sigh, "What a sin!"
Then he exclaimed again, "Heavenly Slaughter, you've really got some nerve, to actually plot against that old dragon's precious granddaughter!"
Xu Yan looked up at the Firmament, his expression extremely solemn. The Divine Realm was undergoing a major change; the Dao Domain Ladder had collapsed. Could it be unifying into one Domain?
Instantly, he turned his gaze towards the True Dragon subdued by him, displaying a look of surprise and disbelief.
"A female dragon?"
"How do you speak?"
The True Dragon was so angered it nearly cried!

chapters.title: Chapter 917 - 477: Ao Yuxue, the Name of My Master's Karma
chapters.content:
Xu Yan hesitated for a moment before waving his hand, retracting the Subduing Dragon Palm Force that was coiled around the True Dragon, one after another, until the eighteen Golden Giant Dragons were circling around him.
When he looked at the Jade White True Dragon again, her crimson eyes had vanished, and she had regained her senses and rationality.
At this moment, the Jade White True Dragon seemed somewhat frail, glaring at Xu Yan with her eyes deep with shock and anger, and even more so with confusion and disbelief.
"You..."
Wanting to say something but eventually closing her mouth, she turned to leave.
Ao!
However, a Golden Giant Dragon came coiling around and instantly wrapped up with her.
The Jade White True Dragon struggled, cursing, "You're shameless, a bastard, a seducer, what do you want to do!"
"You are a dragon subdued by me. Who gave you permission to leave without my consent?"
Xu Yan raised his hand, and the Golden Giant Dragon wound around the Jade White True Dragon, dragging her back to him.
"Let me go, you... you're shameless, you... you..."
The Jade White True Dragon struggled, but at this time, her strength had weakened considerably. She was no match for it, and the Golden Giant Dragon dragged her continuously toward Xu Yan.
The warriors watching the battle were stunned by the spectacle, and upon seeing the two dragons entwined, they couldn't help but twitch at the corners of their mouths.
No wonder the Jade White True Dragon was almost crying; the position they were entwined in was indeed somewhat less than decorous!
"You caused such a disaster in the Divine Realm and think to just walk away? Now that you are subdued by me, surrender," Xu Yan said, lifting his hand and casting another Golden Giant Dragon that coiled around her.
"It was you who ambushed me, and I haven't even settled the score with you yet. And now you want to pin the chaos on me? Wishful thinking!" The Jade White True Dragon, indignant and struggling, retorted.
Then she started to feel wronged, her voice carrying a whine, "You people are so despicable, bullying me because I'm young and ignorant. You, this bastard, are also humiliating me like this, I... I..."
By this point, the Golden Giant Dragon had already dragged the Jade White True Dragon over, and it seemed like she was sobbing, having given up on struggling.
Seeing the True Dragon subdued, many of the powerful beings present suddenly became excited.
And yet the trembling of the Domain continued unabated. Everyone realized that a major change in the Divine Realm had begun, and all of this was related to this True Dragon.
Shua!
A figure appeared in a flash, saying, "Friend Xu, this dragon has committed heinous crimes and brought chaos to the Divine Realm. In my opinion, its skin should be peeled, and its tendons extracted for us to share its flesh!"
By the end, the person's eyes were somewhat frenzied.
On hearing this, the Jade White True Dragon let out a terrified scream, "Dare you? Do you dare? My grandfather will not let you off!"
However, she was powerless to struggle, and her eyes were filled with despair.
With the first Martial Artist speaking out, other watching Immortal Heavenly Venerables stepped forward in agitation, saying, "Indeed, this dragon has committed heinous crimes. To placate our resentment, its skin and tendons should be peeled and extracted, and we should divide and consume its flesh!"
"Friend Xu, you must not spare this True Dragon!"
"Yes, the evil deeds of this dragon are unforgivable!"
"We beseech Young Master Xu to punish this dragon harshly, to peel its skin and extract its tendons, to eat its flesh and drink its blood!"
In that instant, the crowd boiled with rage, desiring to flay and dismember the True Dragon, consume its flesh and blood, all in the name of justice for the Divine Realm. They also showered praises on Xu Yan, suggesting a statue be erected in his honor, calling him the savior of the Divine Realm's great calamity, and so on.
Old Man Xiao's eyes narrowed slightly as he silently watched, without uttering a word.
However, the Sect Master of the Taimiao Sect and others seemed contemplative. A few elders appeared tempted but were restrained by a look from the Sect Master of the Taimiao Sect.
"These people, they want to eat the dragon!" Du Yuying said with a cold expression.
"Furthermore, they wish to coerce Young Master Xu under the guise of righteousness and seek to sway him with praise, hoping that in his moment of adulation, he will agree to their demands!" Yun Miaomiao also remarked with a cold countenance.
Xu Yan's expression remained unchanged as he looked at the Jade White True Dragon and said, "You see, they all want to eat you. Even if I let you go in your current state, could you survive?"
"What do you want?" the Jade White True Dragon asked, her voice trembling and her eyes full of despair.
In her mind, with so many strong warriors surging forward, driven by the righteousness of the Divine Realm and the clamor for justice on behalf of its victims, not to mention the enticement of eternal fame through a statue, Xu Yan would surely agree to their demands.
She was as good as dead!
"If you want to live, open your heart and mind," Xu Yan said indifferently.
"By opening my heart and mind, can you really protect me?" the Jade White True Dragon asked doubtfully.
"Of course. A bunch of mere mortals, do they think they can threaten me?" Xu Yan replied with a faint smile.
"Fine!" The True Dragon hesitated for a moment, then nodded.
With no other choice and reasoning that whatever methods Xu Yan used could surely be undone once her grandfather appeared, she complied.
Xu Yan raised his hand, and a seal entered the True Dragon's spirit—a small Golden Giant Dragon. This was the Subduing Dragon Seal that came with his complete mastery of the Subduing Dragon Palm.
Once the True Dragon had the seal imprinted on her spirit, she was fully subdued!
The True Dragon only felt as though a small Golden Dragon was coiling around her spirit, emitting a kind of awe-inspiring authority that prevented her from any acts of defiance.
She felt a sinking feeling in her heart.
"What cultivation technique is this, it's terrifying! And the Golden Dragons he manifested are almost indistinguishable from a True Dragon, seemingly the perfect counter to my species!" she thought, her confidence in removing the Golden Dragon Seal from her spirit dwindling.
By now, the voices of the impassioned crowd were growing louder and louder, as more Immortal Heavenly Venerables who heard about the situation rushed over and joined in, their eyes fervent as they stared at the flawless Jade White True Dragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 918 - 477 Ao Yuxue, The Name of My Master and the Great Karma_2
chapters.content:
Xu Yan had imprinted the Subduing Dragon Seal, then with a wave of his hand, the Subduing Dragon Palm Force dissipated and the True Dragon regained its freedom.
"Young Master Xu..."
A group of Immortal Heavenly Venerables, their eyes filled with frenzy, wanted to say something more.
"Silence! All of you shut up!"
A voice like thunder boomed.
Immediately, sword lights rose from all directions, filling the air with an aura of annihilation, as if in an instant, it could obliterate all the mighty ones present.
"How Xu acts is not for you to point fingers and make comments!"
Xu Yan's gaze was cold, his Sword Intent soaring to the skies.
The surging voices immediately fell silent.
"Young Master Xu, this True Dragon has caused such a catastrophe, killing too many, how can you just let her go? Where is the dignity and honor of our Human Clan? Do you, Young Master Xu, intend to disregard our Human Clan's dignity and honor..."
An Immortal Heavenly Venerable began speaking with righteous indignation, yet also with immense sorrow.
Spurt!
A sword light fell, and before his words were finished, he was directly turned to ash and dissipated.
"Your dignity, what does it have to do with me, Xu Yan? Oh, do you represent the Human Clan now? Always ready to attack and devour, do you think I, being young, Xu Yan, am unaware of your intentions?
"Or perhaps, do you think my sword isn't sharp enough?!"
Xu Yan stepped forward, his sword light soaring, the Ten Directions Annihilation Sword illuminating all around, the atmosphere charged with the intent of obliteration, as if whoever dared to disagree would be reduced to ashes!
At that moment, the rowdy crowd of Martial Artists instantly felt a chill in their hearts, shock apparent on their faces, as they suddenly realized, Sword God Xu Yan was indeed a fearsome man!
He must not be provoked!
Definitely must not be provoked!
"Dare not! Dare not!"
"The True Dragon has been subdued by Young Master Xu, naturally it is entirely up to Young Master Xu to deal with!"
"Yes, yes, we have no objections, not a single objection!"
A group of Immortal Heavenly Venerables immediately cowered.
From a distance, Yun Miaomiao and Du Yuying were utterly fascinated, truly worthy of being Young Master Xu Yan, ever so domineering, always looking down on all peers!
"Hmph!"
Xu Yan snorted lightly, the sword light vanished, and he looked up towards the firmament, the tremors in the Divine Realm continued, and the Domain Lingji became even more active but appeared somewhat agitated.
"Unity of Domain, eh?"
Xu Yan pondered in his heart.
Turning back to look at the True Dragon, he asked, "What is your name?"
"Ao, Ao Yuxue!"
A crisp youthful voice replied.
After Ao Yuxue spoke, she transformed into a human form, a girl in a snow-white dress, exquisitely beautiful, with two small horns about an inch long on her head.
After transforming into human form, Ao Yuxue looked extremely pale, her breath weak, showing signs of severe exhaustion.
"You..."
In her eyes, fear still lingered as she looked at Xu Yan, wanting to say something but momentarily unsure how to begin.
"Seeing your condition, you've suffered a massive loss, almost harmed to your origin, haven't you?"
Xu Yan pondered aloud.
"Mm."
Ao Yuxue responded softly.
At this moment, she didn't dare display even a hint of Dragon Might, the proud True Dragon too had bowed her head.
It was simply too unbelievable for Xu Yan, that Golden Giant Dragon, just like a real True Dragon, yet able to suppress her.
"Within the same realm, my True Dragon Clan is definitely restrained by this cultivation technique!"
Ao Yuxue was immensely shocked inside.
She was stronger than Xu Yan, yet she was subdued too, even though not everyone who cultivated this technique could be as powerful as Xu Yan.
But it was almost certain, when competing in the same realm, True Dragon Clan could likely be at a disadvantage.
Ao Yuxue's heart grew heavy as she thought of her own experience, feeling as if a huge conspiracy was targeting the True Dragon Clan.
She was subdued, could the rest of the True Dragon Clan also be subdued?
Even her grandfather...
The more she thought, the more terrified Ao Yuxue became.
"Then you should rest here for now."
Xu Yan raised his hand, and a small turtle carapace emerged, precisely the Prime Tortoise Carapace.
Seeing it, Ao Yuxue was startled again, her eyes instinctively widening.
"This is?"
Old Man Xiao's eyes widened at this moment, staring at the Prime Tortoise Carapace in Xu Yan's hand, his face filled with shock.
It contained a space akin to a minor heaven and earth, a true Treasure of Heaven and Earth, and such treasures could only be possessed by the Supreme Experts among the Minor Heaven and Earth Masters.
To put it bluntly, only those powerful beings who had originally seized the purple light and opened up their minor heavens and earths could possess such supreme treasures.
"This tortoise is?"
Old Man Xiao furrowed his brow, the tortoise shell in Xu Yan's hands feeling strangely familiar to him.
"Prime Tortoise?"
Suddenly, he thought of a powerful True Spirit.
Startled in his heart, he immediately realized something.
"No wonder it contains a minor heaven and earth, it turns out to be the Prime Tortoise Carapace, it seems that the Prime Tortoise has indeed perished."
However, he was very curious as to why the Prime Tortoise Carapace, following its demise, would be in Xu Yan's hands.
"Could it be that the person behind Xu Yan is related to the Land of Imperishable?"
Old Man Xiao frowned again.
Ao Yuxue had already transformed into a streak of white light and entered the inside of the Prime Tortoise Carapace.
Xu Yan put away the Prime Tortoise Carapace and looked towards the immortally venerable beings of varying expressions around him, his demeanor relaxed, not in the least fearful of these people trying to seize the treasure.
Immediately, his gaze landed on Old Man Xiao, and his expression grew solemn.
"This person is very strong, a Dao Realm expert?"
Although Old Man Xiao was well hidden, appearing to be just an ordinary Immortal Heavenly Venerable, he could not fool Xu Yan's eyes.
"Apart from my master, this person is the strongest I have ever seen."
Of course, if including that towering figure, this person still would not compare.
Still, he was ultimately the strongest among those Xu Yan had personally seen, and Xu Yan secretly assessed that this person's strength was probably greater than that of Duowu and the Flame Demon.
As for the strength of the Seductive Witch, Xu Yan found it hard to assess, after all, the power of the Seductive Witch was somewhat special, and if this person could not withstand her seduction, even great strength would be of no use.
"What an accomplished youth, to have subdued a True Dragon at such a young age, unprecedented throughout the ages."
Old Man Xiao suddenly burst out laughing.
With a stride, he approached Xu Yan.
"Who are you?"
Xu Yan said warily to himself.
"You may call me Old Man Xiao."
Old Man Xiao, stroking his beard, wore a kind face.
Yet inside, he was secretly shocked that Xu Yan had noticed his abnormality, something he had never encountered before.
If Xu Yan's strength had been equal to or greater than his own, and had seen through him, Old Man Xiao would have found it normal. However, Xu Yan's actual strength was far inferior to his.
And he had still seen through him in a glance?
"Young friend, who is your master? Perhaps, old me and your master are acquaintances."
Old Man Xiao asked with a chuckle.
He was very curious about who could have nurtured someone as monstrously talented as Xu Yan.
Yet Xu Yan shook his head and said, "My master couldn't possibly be an acquaintance of yours."
"Oh, why not? I, the old man, have roamed the heavens and the earth, knowing countless Supreme Experts."
Old Man Xiao raised an eyebrow.
"Because you're too weak. My master never remembers the names of the weak, so I'm sure you're not an acquaintance of my master's!"
Xu Yan said earnestly.
Old Man Xiao's smile stiffened, and his hand stroking his beard paused, "I, the old man, am too weak? Young man, do you know what my actual strength is?
"Not to exaggerate, but across the entire Domain, very few can stand shoulder to shoulder with me!"
At this moment, Old Man Xiao straightened his back and spoke proudly.
"You said it yourself, across the entire Domain, very few can stand shoulder to shoulder with you, but the entire Domain, in my master's eyes, is as insignificant as dust. There are none who can stand shoulder to shoulder with my master, so I'm sure you're not an acquaintance of my master's!"
Xu Yan said seriously.
Old Man Xiao's face twitched, and it turned dark, "Alright! Alright! Alright! The old man has to ask, what then is your master's name, to view the Domain as insignificant as dust?"
Xu Yan sighed and said, "Senior, you shouldn't inquire about my master. The name of my master carries too great a karmic consequence, which you cannot bear!"
Damn!
Old Man Xiao almost cursed out loud. Even as mighty as Taicang, his name carried no unbearable karmic consequences. There exists no name in this world, including within the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, that one cannot endure.
"It doesn't matter! Just say it, old man. If I can't endure the karmic consequences and die, I deserve it, and don't blame you!"
Old Man Xiao took a deep breath and said with a dark face.
Xu Yan was silent for a moment, then said helplessly, "Senior, it matters not if you perish, but the name of my master has such great karmic consequences that even the Domain cannot bear it. This cannot lead to a great calamity in the Domain because of you!"
Old Man Xiao was dumbfounded, one couldn't boast like this, a single name that even the Taicang Domain could not bear, one that could lead to a great calamity in the Domain?!

chapters.title: Chapter 919 - 919: 478
chapters.content:
"Hey, since you are unwilling to tell me your master's name, then tell me where your master is, and I'll pay a visit myself!"
Old Man Xiao took a deep breath and said.
He wanted to see who it was that was so shameless as to declare a name that even the Taicang Domain couldn't bear!
"My master might still be in the Qinghua state."
Xu Yan thought for a moment and said.
This old man was extremely powerful and had shown up here. The matter of Ao Yuxue being plotted against might very well have something to do with him.
Now that the Divine Realm was unstable, with great changes looming in the Domain, the person behind the scenes might even be him.
Of course, Xu Yan was not afraid. No matter how strong this person was, in front of his master, he was no more than an ant.
"The Qinghua state it is, Old Man Xiao will remember that."
Old Man Xiao nodded.
In his heart, he couldn't help but recall, Wu Tianan had mentioned the Qinghua state before; could it be the same person?
Even more so, were Meng Chong and Jiang Buping, these two fiendish talents, actually under the tutelage of the same master?
Thinking about this possibility sent a shiver through Old Man Xiao's heart.
Although the other party might simply be bluffing, to train such monstrous talents, their strength must be unimaginably powerful.
"Is the tumult in the Divine Realm and the collapse of the Dao Realms related to you?"
Xu Yan thought for a while and asked seriously.
Old Man Xiao laughed and said, "If Old Man Xiao were to say it's related to me, what would you do? And if I said it's not related to me, what then?"
Xu Yan spoke earnestly, "As far as I know, all of this is being plotted by the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow. If it is related to you, then you must be one of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's men."
"I, Xu Yan, have a grievance with the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow. If you are one of their people, we naturally have a personal vendetta!"
Old Man Xiao froze for a moment, then burst out laughing and said, "Aren't you afraid that Old Man Xiao will strike you down?"
"Even if you tried, you wouldn't be able to kill me!"
Xu Yan shook his head and said.
Old Man Xiao was stunned. Xu Yan's expression didn't seem to be lying, but rather he was very confident, which made Old Man Xiao remember that mysterious master of Xu Yan's.
"Interesting, I'm becoming more and more curious about your master!"
Looking up at the sky, he smiled and said, "Young man, you're quite outstanding, having subdued Ao Yuxue. Her status within the True Dragon Clan is not simple. Your troubles won't be small."
"Besides the True Dragon Clan, Heavenly Slaughter, that scoundrel, is very shameless. Be careful that he doesn't come after you himself for the Subduing Dragon Technique."
"In short, you will be targeted by quite a few powerful beings. Although the Dao Domain's Three Hundred Realms don't have three hundred realm masters, there are plenty of Supreme Sovereign Warriors, and the powers in each realm of the Dao Domain are even more complex."
"The beings from outside this Domain, who now reside within it, you by subduing the dragon have offended not only the True Dragon Clan but all True Spirits."
"Even the Netherworld and witches will have people targeting you!"
Xu Yan didn't care and said, "They are just stepping stones. Anyone who wishes to be an enemy of Xu Yan and covet my possessions must be prepared to be reduced to ashes."
"As for the Subduing Dragon Technique, it's not something just anyone can cultivate. As for bullying the weak, that's even less of an issue, no one is bigger than my master!"
Old Man Xiao felt like he couldn't continue the conversation.
This was just too arrogant, too confident, especially his confidence in his master, as if there was no one in the world that could stand in his eyes.
"Young man, you still have time to strengthen yourself, but not much. With the collapse of the Dao Domain Ladder and the Earth Shadow Realm pulling it down, plunging into the Divine Realm, it will become the place where the Dao Realm and the Divine Realm converge."
"Once the plunge is complete, and the Dao Principles of the Domain stabilize, those from the Dao Realm will descend upon the Divine Realm, including those from Heavenly Union Realm, Divine Venerate Realm, and even the Supreme Sovereign Realm."
"Of course, surely there will be powerful beings from the True Dragon Clan descending."
Old Man Xiao pondered for a while and reminded.
Xu Yan nodded and said, "That's good too, I can also venture out in the Dao Realm. The Divine Realm is getting dull now, too weak compared to the Immortal Heavenly Venerable!"
Towards the end, Xu Yan sighed and looking at the crowd of Immortal Heavenly Venerables, said disinterestedly, "So weak, it's hardly fun to kill them!"
Damn!
Old Man Xiao was somewhat dumbfounded.
This young man was unbearably arrogant!
"How much do you know about the powerful beings outside the Domain?"
Xu Yan suddenly asked.
"Some," Old Man Xiao replied, confused about why Xu Yan was asking about the strong beings outside the Domain.
Could his master come from outside the Domain?
No!
That was impossible. Beings from outside the Domain wouldn't be able to enter easily, and if they did attempt to come in, a powerful being like himself would have sensed it instantly.
Since the great battle of the past, the Dao Rules of the Taicang Domain had been adjusted, and outsiders could no longer enter the Domain without notice.
The stronger the being, the less able they were to hide.
"Do you know the Seductive Witch?"
Xu Yan's expression suddenly became more animated as he asked.
Upon hearing this, Old Man Xiao's expression slightly changed, and he looked at Xu Yan in surprise, "Young man, don't tell me you've been charmed by that sly woman? Take Old Man Xiao's advice, that woman is nothing but a facade, and once you fall for her, the consequences are unimaginable!"
Xu Yan was amazed; this old man was so wary of the Seductive Witch?
"You're thinking too much. The Seductive Witch's mere charms can't affect me. It's just that she hates me to death now, so if we meet again, she will surely seek revenge, so I want to find out in advance."
Old Man Xiao was shocked. The Seductive Witch hated Xu Yan to death?
"How did you offend her?"
Xu Yan chuckled, "It's nothing much, just tricked her a few times. Speaking of which, the Seductive Witch is quite nice. She gave me the Seven Wonders Divine Flower, and also a stalk of Yu Zhu."
As he spoke, Xu Yan took out the Yu Zhu.
Old Man Xiao was a bit confused and for a moment, couldn't really understand whether the Seductive Witch hated or cared for Xu Yan.

chapters.title: Chapter 920 - 478 Reunion with an Old Friend, The Beginning of Great Changes_2
chapters.content:
"This is Qingling Jade Bamboo, even though it's a young plant, it's incredibly precious. The Seductive Witch actually was willing to take one to give to you?"
Xu Yan chuckled, "That's why I said, the Seductive Witch is actually quite nice."
Old Man Xiao clicked his tongue but still reminded, "Try not to provoke the Seductive Witch, she's not one to be trifled with. She survived that catastrophe back then, which shows how powerful she is.
"The Seductive Witch is a Supreme Expert from the Witch Demon Domain, with the power to devour Divine Souls. She's extremely troublesome, even I would have to be careful when dealing with her..."
Speaking of this, Old Man Xiao suddenly stopped.
