The Seductive Witch, who knows what madness she's been struck with lately, has become extremely irritable, a complete opposite of her usual seductive and charming demeanor.
Moreover, she once attempted to break into the Taicang Domain.
"Such irritability from the Seductive Witch, it wouldn't have anything to do with this young man, would it?"
Old Man Xiao muttered to himself.
"A minor issue, nothing threatening."
Xu Yan said unconcernedly.
Old Man Xiao was speechless, his curiosity about Xu Yan's master grew increasingly strong.
"In a few days, I also have to return to see my master. If you're not in a hurry, you can come with me."
Xu Yan considered for a moment before speaking.
"Okay!"
Old Man Xiao nodded.
Only then did Xu Yan turn his gaze towards the Taimiao Sect, those two familiar feminine figures.
"Long time no see!"
In one step, he arrived in front of the two ladies.
"Young Master Xu!"
Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao were overjoyed, their faces blushed red, almost unable to hold back from throwing themselves directly into Xu Yan's arms.
The Sect Master of the Taimiao Sect and others had looks of astonishment. They glanced at Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao, then at Xin Mengrou. Since Xu Yan had old acquaintances with these two ladies, he must obviously be familiar with Xin Mengrou as well.
"Senior Xin, long time no see!"
Xu Yan was somewhat surprised as he glanced at Xin Mengrou.
She had already achieved a breakthrough to the Immortal Realm, a speed beyond imagination.
Many of those who entered the Divine Realm with him back then hadn't yet broken through the Truth Refinement Realm, let alone the Immortal Realm.
Up to now, among the experts from the Spiritual Realm, only three had broken through to the Immortal Realm.
Wu Tianan, Cailinger, and Xin Mengrou.
Cailinger, possessing the Sea Spirit Emperor's Bloodline which she had already activated, and being under the tutelage of her own master, her rapid breakthrough to the Immortal Realm was within reason.
Wu Tianan also seemed to have some special circumstances.
As for Xin Mengrou, her rapid progress was unexpected. Presumably, she also had some fortunate encounter that allowed her to break through so swiftly.
Moon Changming and Yue'er were also only a small step away from the Immortal Realm and could make their breakthrough soon afterwards.
"Young Master Xu is too kind."
Xin Mengrou, full of admiration, said, "From the Spiritual Realm to the Divine Realm, Young Master Xu has persistently pushed forward, invincible at every turn!"
In the Spiritual Realm, Xu Yan's rise was unimaginably fast. He went from being well-known in the Spiritual Realm to dominating it in just a short time, single-handedly suppressing Spiritual Realm Experts.
After arriving in the Divine Realm, it was the same story. He went from being renowned to subduing a True Dragon in a short amount of time, a period which for Martial Artists, wouldn't even suffice for breaking through a minor realm.
Yet, Xu Yan had already become invincible in the Divine Realm!
Truly a monster, the rightful successor of that predecessor.
"Senior Xin flatters me, the path of Martial Arts is long and arduous, I am still far from being invincible," Xu Yan shook his head.
"Among those who came from the Spiritual Realm, it's only the predecessor and Dean Wu who are the strongest, having broken through to the Immortal Realm so rapidly!"
Xin Mengrou was taken aback by his words.
"Dean Wu has broken through to the Immortal Realm?"
Her rapid breakthrough to the Immortal Realm, besides her talent on the Illusionary Path, was also aided by the guidance of the Taimiao Ancestor and a great opportunity she received, enabling such a swift advancement.
All of this was thanks to the predecessor's guidance which helped her take an unusual half-step forward on the Illusionary Path.
"Yes, Dean Wu has broken through to the Immortal Realm some time ago," Xu Yan nodded.
Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao, standing to the side, secretly shot a glance at Xin Mengrou. Why was their great-grandmother (ancestral mistress) talking so much? They hadn't even caught up with Young Master Xu yet!
"Alright, you young people can chat. These two young ladies have been talking about you every single day!"
Xin Mengrou said with a smile.
"Thank you, Young Master Xu, for coming to our aid!"
The Taimiao Sect Master took the opportunity to speak, a look of gratitude on his face.
"This is not the place for reminiscing. Young Master Xu, if you don't disdain it, would you consider moving to the Taimiao Sect?"
The Taimiao Sect Master continued.
Meanwhile, he surreptitiously gestured to Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao.
"In that case, very well!"
Xu Yan nodded.
...
"The eldest senior brother has descended to the Dragon Abyss, currently in the Taimiao Realm. Let's go, to the Taimiao Realm!"
Meng Chong and Jiang Buping said excitedly.
"Dean Wu, let's go together."
"Very well!"
Wu Tianan thought for a moment. The Divine Realm was not peaceful, and there had been no trace of his sister, so it was not the time to venture into the Dao Realm. It might be better to go to the Taimiao Realm together.
"The eldest senior brother sent a message saying that Senior Xin Mengrou has also broken through to the Immortal Realm."
Meng Chong said with a sigh.
"Oh, Mengrou, that girl, has she really broken through?"
Wu Tianan was somewhat surprised.
Xin Mengrou's talent was naturally strong, and the cultivation of the Tai Miao Illusionary Path was extremely special. However, it should not have allowed her to break through to the Immortal Realm so quickly.
It seemed she must have found some opportunities within the Taimiao Sect.
Meng Chong and the others set off for the Taimiao Realm, while many Immortal Heavenly Venerables in the Divine Realm were hurrying towards the Taihe Realm instead.
The unrest in the Divine Realm originated from the Taihe Realm, due to the collapse of the Dao Domain Ladder.
The Taihe Realm was in constant turmoil. The experts of the Taihe Sect were at a loss, with the Taihe Sect Master and several elders having perished in the collapse of the Heavenly Ladder. The Taihe Sect now faced a headless situation.
But in the end, as the foremost sect in the Divine Realm, with profound heritage and under the jurisdiction of the Taihe Realm of the Dao Domain, a few remaining elders quickly took joint control over the Taihe Sect, stabilizing the situation and waiting for the Divine Envoy from the Taihe Realm to arrive.
Boom!
In the location of the Dao Domain Ladder, a small domain fell, incessant roars echoed, Heavenly Dao principles emerged, spiritual energy turned violent, and even the Domain Lingji became harsh.
Boom!
The Taihe Realm quaked with movements of the earth and mountains, buildings collapsed, rivers and mountains boiled, the tumult unceasing.
The tremors spread throughout the Divine Realm, even the more remote Qinghua state and Nine Mountains Realm were affected by the shaking.
Even the Immortal Heavenly Venerables felt panic, their expressions grave, with a sense of crisis as if a world-ending calamity was approaching.
The weaker martial artists, especially those below the Divine Refinement Realm, were desperate, lacking the power to withstand these crises, they could only leave their fate to the heavens.
Moreover, weaker martial artists might get injured amidst the shaking if not careful, and thus sought safer places to the best of their abilities.
Fortunately, the powerful beings unleashed their imposing aura, calming the frightened populace as they awaited the end of the tremors.
As time passed, the Earth's tremors persisted, yet no other great disasters occurred, gradually alleviating the panic.
Once the uneasy sentiments eased, inquiries began as to what exactly happened in the Divine Realm and why the world was in such turmoil.
For the weaker beings, there were virtually no means to gain insight into the grand scheme of the world or the secrets of the Domain, so despite such extensive unrest in the Divine Realm, they remained clueless about the actual changes that had occurred.
Within the Divine Realm, martial artists from beyond the heavens continued their ravages. With the Divine Realm's strength severely damaged and insufficient power holding the Heavenly Grotto, many Heavenly Grottos fell, becoming bases for the outsiders.
The entire Divine Realm was in utter chaos, with killings seen everywhere, and the Netherworld Blood Child carrying out blood sacrifices in the cities.
"My worthy brother has established the Demon Clan?"
The Wind Spirit Tiger, having escaped death by the skin of its teeth and survived under the claws of the True Dragon, was now resting in a hiding place. After a period of recuperation, it had finally recovered much of its strength.
Moreover, through the misfortune, its bloodline had been purified, and it unexpectedly gained the might of the Heavenly Tiger.
Just emerging from its hiding place, it learned of the Red Cat establishing the Demon Clan, calling upon the Spirit Beasts of the Divine Realm to gather in the Nine Mountains Realm and create the Demon Clan together!
"Back to the Nine Mountains Realm!"
The Wind Spirit Tiger was now immensely excited.
Had it not been for the Jade Talisman's rescue, it would have been a dead tiger!
"Tian Shiqi, you wait and see!"
Now, how could the Wind Spirit Tiger not realize that it had been set up by Tian Shiqi? It began with its triggering of the Heavenly Tiger's might in the Dragon Abyss and summoning the True Dragon, which sparked the vast changes in the Divine Realm; all part of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's conspiracy!
Even if the Wind Spirit Tiger was a bit slow to catch on, it had realized that Tian Shiqi was not as simple as he appeared on the surface, with a strength that surely surpassed its own.
The Wind Spirit Tiger rushed frantically towards the Nine Mountains Realm. Along the way, it encountered some Immortal Realm Spirit Beasts also heading to the Nine Mountains Realm.
It even saw hundreds of Spirit Beasts comparable to True King Heavenly Venerables, striding grandly towards the Nine Mountains Realm, heading to offer allegiance to the Great Demon King Red Cat!
With great changes unfolding in the Divine Realm and the world in upheaval, these Spirit Beasts needed to band together to face the coming crises, and the Demon Clan of the Nine Mountains Realm was undoubtedly the best choice.
After all, rumors were that the clan's cultivation techniques allowed one to transcend the limitations of their bloodline, enabling them to refine and elevate their strength like martial artists!

chapters.title: Chapter 921 - 479: Heavenly Dao Seal, The Nascent Great Wilderness Heavenly Path
chapters.content:
The Nine Mountain Realm has already become the territory of the Demon Clan.
Spirit beasts from various realms of the Divine Realm kept arriving, and among them, the number of spirit beasts from the Immortal Realm increased. Of course, there were those with different intentions and the unyielding ones were not few either.
Boom!
Like a small mountain, the Mountain Devourer Toad squatted on the ground and looked indifferently towards two Immortal Realm spirit beasts not far away.
Little Ha's body surged with demonic energy as it opened its mouth wide, unleashing a terrifying suction force that emerged instantly.
In front of it, a vortex appeared, ripples emanating, as if space itself was warping.
Boom!
In just an instant, the two Immortal Realm spirit beasts were suppressed by Little Ha.
"Greetings to the Third Demon King!"
At this moment, even the two Immortal Realm spirit beasts had no choice but to submit.
Atop Spiritual Sovereign Mountain, a huge golden hall stood firm, with Red Cat sitting on a shimmering golden chair, its neck adorned with a large gold chain, looking majestic.
A tiger paw gripped a great saber, gazing down at the spirit beasts arrayed left and right below.
"From today onward, any who come to join us must not dare offend my authority. Otherwise, they will be severely punished, and for a hundred years, they shall not dream of obtaining the Great Demon Method!"
"All of you are my Demon Clan's generals. As Heavenly Grotto is a bit tumultuous lately, from today on, patrol the Nine Mountain Realm for me and suppress any unrest!"
"Yes, Your Majesty!"
A group of Demon Generals responded respectfully.
Yu Xiaolong also sat on a chair, and at this moment, it had already taken on the form of a Flood Dragon. Although it hadn't transformed into a True Dragon yet, its aura was incredibly strong.
The might of the Flood Dragon was quite intimidating to the other spirit beasts.
Moreover, having cultivated the Great Demon Method, Yu Xiaolong's demonic might was profound, naturally making its deterrence even stronger.
Compared to it, Little Ha seemed slightly less intimidating.
After all, its true form was the Mountain Devourer Toad, which among spirit beasts, was considered the lowest tier and used as material for making Storage Bags.
Even though Little Ha was not an ordinary Mountain Devourer Toad, many spirit beasts still looked down upon it. Therefore, the spirit beasts who came to join the Nine Mountain Realm, if they felt discontent or wanted to cause trouble, would target it first.
Red Cat, imposing and formidable, didn't seem easy to provoke; Yu Xiaolong was a Flood Dragon, equally not to be trifled with. Hence, their attention naturally fell on Little Ha.
Little Ha returned and sat in the third chair.
Red Cat revealed a glacially sharp claw from its tiger paw and tapped the hilt of its saber, speaking in a deep voice, "Third brother, you're being too merciful. Next time someone challenges you, kill them directly to let those useless creatures know that our authority as the Three Demon Kings must not be violated!"
Little Ha nodded its head, indicating it understood.
With a wave of Red Cat's hand, the Demon Generals below dispersed, leading their Demon Soldiers to patrol the Nine Mountain Realm and suppress all unrest.
These Demon Generals were all from the Immortal Realm, and having been imparted the Great Demon Method, they were also under Red Cat's control.
As the Great Demon Method progressed, Red Cat's variegated fur blazed like flames, and its aura grew ever stronger. Even Yu Xiaolong, the Flood Dragon, felt the immense tiger's might.
"Boss, you wouldn't happen to have Heavenly Tiger blood in you, would you?"
Yu Xiaolong couldn't help asking.
"Perhaps,"
Red Cat said nonchalantly, feeling that although its strength had increased and its bloodline had undergone several transformations, even if it were a Heavenly Tiger bloodline, it was no longer the same as a pure Heavenly Tiger bloodline.
"My elder brother should be returning soon. What position should I give him?"
The position of Demon King is not something the Wind Spirit Tiger can dream of.
"Perhaps a Demon Marshal. Its strength is certainly up to the task, especially since it's one of the twelve great Spirit Beast Kings of the Divine Realm, and it most likely gained some rewards this time."
Yu Xiaolong thought for a moment and then said.
"But I'm worried it might be reluctant at heart."
Red Cat smiled faintly and said, "There's nothing to be reluctant about. We won't mistreat him. Everything depends on strength. Besides, I also saved its life this time."
"As long as you're clear on that."
Yu Xiaolong didn't continue the conversation. The matter of the Wind Spirit Tiger would be handled by Red Cat.
"Now that Xu Yan has descended upon the Flood Dragons, I should have the chance to transform into a True Dragon!"
Yu Xiaolong said excitedly.
...
Azure Sea Sphere.
The Azure Sea churned with waves, and some small islands were submerged amidst the raging seas.
The news of Xu Yan descending upon the Flood Dragons had spread, shocking the likes of the Yuntian Island Lord.
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe felt secretly thrilled, proud of his decision to befriend Xu Yan as it was the most correct decision he had made in his life.
The Azure Sea Sphere was relatively calm. After all, the Heavenly Grotto was suppressed by Xu Yan once, so there were no major upheavals now.
The Azure Sea Turtle raised its head to survey the Firmament, then concealed itself even deeper.
"I hope I won't expose myself before I recover."
It sighed inwardly, knowing the consequences would be unpredictable once exposed.
"Xu Yan descended upon the Flood Dragons, directly offending the True Dragon Clan,"
The Azure Sea Turtle muttered to itself.
"But did that old dragon die? It moved from the True Spirit Domain to Taicang. That old dragon might have perished with Taicang. Now, who is in charge of the True Dragon Clan?"
In its mind, several dragons emerged.
"Forget it. I won't bother with this."
The Azure Sea Turtle continued to hide its presence.
...
In the Qinghua state, with the collapse of the Dao Domain Ladder, tremors were felt.
However, after Fang Hao mobilized the might of Domain and organized the leylines, setting up a Great Formation, the trembling of the Qinghua state subsided and stabilized.
It was as if the Divine Realm, no matter how tumultuous, could not affect this place.
"Master, what's happening in the Divine Realm?"
Su Lingxiu asked curiously.
Since returning from the Great Wilderness, Li Xuan just continued to sit leisurely in his chair, watching the vicissitudes of the world.
"It's merely a realm from the Dao Domain falling into the Divine Realm,"

chapters.title: Chapter 922 - 479: Heavenly Dao Seal, The Nascent Great Wilderness Heavenly Path_2
chapters.content:
"So that's how it is, it seems that the Divine Realm is about to undergo a massive change."
Su Lingxiu immediately became very excited and said, "Big senior brother has subdued a True Dragon, a creature from legends, which I have never seen before! When big senior brother returns, I really must study this True Dragon closely!"
"You should focus on your cultivation. With one realm in the Dao Realm collapsing, some folks from that realm will surely descend upon us. With your current strength, even self-preservation will be difficult!"
Li Xuan said, shaking his head helplessly.
"Master, I understand. I've almost finished setting things up. I should soon reach perfection in the Void-breaking Realm and then break through to the Domain Realm!"
Su Lingxiu, grinning, said, "I have you as my master, who could bully me!"
"The path of Martial Arts ultimately has to be walked alone."
Li Xuan shook his head.
"I understand, Master."
Su Lingxiu nodded her small head.
Li Xuan looked up at the firmament as if seeing through everything. In the Dao Realm's Three Hundred Realms, there are countless strong individuals. Realm Master level strong ones were plentiful, but for the current him, Realm Master level strong ones were nowhere near enough.
"Have all the Seven Great Domain Masters perished?"
Li Xuan was very curious. As powerful as Taicang had perished, the remaining six must have as well, right?
The first to fall had been the Master of the Fen Yun Domain.
"The strong ones of the Imperishable Temple are quite formidable."
Li Xuan couldn't help but sigh, the strong ones of the Imperishable Temple were indeed immensely powerful.
However, it had been so long since Taicang's fall, yet the Taicang Domain was still safe and sound. It was evident that Taicang had made some preparations. Even if he could not match the strong ones of the Imperishable Temple, he would not be much weaker.
Otherwise, he would not have left the Book of Taicang, intending to nurture a new Master of Domain for the Taicang Domain.
"Could it be that there was a traitor? Otherwise, why has the Book of Taicang remained undiscovered?"
Li Xuan pondered inwardly.
However, none of these matters were of much importance to him. Now at the Establishing Dao Realm, though his strength was not yet on par with the strong ones of the Imperishable Temple, if a real crisis came, he could definitely escape.
"The Land of Chaotic Imperishable, isn't that just Chaos, or is it slightly different? However, it is unknown whether this Land of Imperishable has any borders."
At this moment, Li Xuan developed a strong curiosity about the Land beyond the heavens that was Imperishable.
"Once Tian Zi becomes the Heavenly Dao, my strength will also improve, and I will be even more confident. Once Tian Zi can operate the entire Domain, this Domain will also undergo a transformation."
The Taicang Domain was about to become history.
In the future, this will be the Great Wilderness Domain.
As for the schemes of some Realm Masters, Li Xuan was too lazy to bother, let alone Tian Zi would naturally take care of them.
"Xu Yan is also close to breaking through to the Domain Realm."
The great changes in the Domain also created an opportunity for rapid rise.
After Xu Yan subdued the dragon, he was only one step away from reaching Perfection in the Void-breaking Realm, and once he achieved Perfection, he could begin preparing to break through to the Domain Realm.
"This Divine Realm surely hides some figures."
Li Xuan looked towards a certain place in the Divine Realm, contemplatively.
"People of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow? Those few might indeed be the ones from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, responsible for this task, but this one..."
With Li Xuan's current strength, and his mastery of the Taicang Domain, strong ones hiding within the Divine Realm couldn't possibly deceive him.
Under the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, everything was laid bare.
"A Minor Heaven and Earth Master? Interesting!"
Hidden within the Divine Realm was a Minor Heaven and Earth Master, who was currently a Realm Master level strong one, and whose strength was among the top among Realm Masters.
"Could it be Heavenly Slaughter?"
Li Xuan looked up at the firmament and then immediately dismissed the thought.
"Never mind, I won't bother with him."
The figure was hiding in the Divine Realm, and even amidst the upheaval caused by the True Dragon, he had not acted, suggesting a stance of watching the situation unfold. Li Xuan was also too lazy to concern himself with the figure.
"Tian Zi should almost have transformed into the Heavenly Dao, right?"
Counting the time, the final step of Tian Zi transforming into the Heavenly Dao should have been completed.
Li Xuan focused his consciousness on the Daoist Golden Book. Since his breakthrough to the Establishing Dao Realm, the usage of the Daoist Golden Book had increased, especially after gaining the Way of the Subdued Dragon, which had given him more insight into how to wield the Daoist Golden Book.
"The Daoist Golden Book, with my current strength, is still not something I can wield at will."
Li Xuan sighed wistfully.
"Currently, on the Daoist Golden Book, I am authoring a Cultivation Technique for Martial Arts. Once my strength reaches a certain realm and I can utilize the Daoist Golden Book more, what I will author will be the Dao itself!"
Li Xuan realized in his heart.
"Your disciple Tian Zi has transformed into the Heavenly Path of the Great Wilderness, and you have obtained the Heavenly Dao Seal!"
Suddenly, the Daoist Golden Book opened, and golden light surged forth.
A seal, containing immense majesty and mysterious unpredictability, flew out from the Daoist Golden Book and landed in the hands of Primordial Spirit.
Heavenly Dao Seal!
"My strength has become stronger again."
Li Xuan was tremendously excited.
Looking at the Heavenly Dao Seal in his hand, this seal wasn't crafted from any material but was transformed from the rules of Heavenly Dao and possessed tremendous power of the Heavenly Dao.
With this seal in hand, the Heavenly Dao was entirely under control, and when deployed, it possessed the power to create heavens and earth.
Moreover, the Heavenly Dao Seal would strengthen as his power increased and would continue to ascend with the elevation of the heaven and earth operated by the Heavenly Dao. The power of the Heavenly Dao rules would grow ever stronger.
"With my current strength, holding the Heavenly Dao Seal, it is enough to open up a new heaven and earth in the Land of Imperishable."
Li Xuan was delighted in his heart.
With the Heavenly Dao Seal in hand, he already possessed the power to create heavens and earth!
"However, it is still not strong enough. The heaven and earth that are opened are not as powerful as the Taicang Domain, but after all, it is only a nascent Heavenly Dao with tremendous potential for improvement!"
With the Heavenly Dao Seal in hand, even if he did not deploy the Great Wilderness Physiognomy or the Taoist Ancestor Halo, simply by the might of the Heavenly Dao Seal alone, he could bring shock that was irrefutable in the face of the Splendid Heavenly Might to a Realm Master.
"Suppressing a Realm Master is a piece of cake. Even the once formidable Minor Heaven and Earth Masters could easily be suppressed!"
Li Xuan found that the Heavenly Dao Seal operated the Way of Domain, and a Realm Master's domain belonged to a minor heaven and earth. It could even be said to be incomplete and flawed, needing to rely on the greater heaven and earth to exist.
In front of the Heavenly Dao Seal, it would be easily suppressed, as effortless as a robust father suppressing a frail three-year-old child.
The Great Wilderness, Tian Zi's body had completely dissipated.
However, above the sky, clouds suddenly gathered and transformed into a human figure.
Like a cloud giant, overlooking the earth.
"Mommy, look, there's a person in the sky!"
In the Great Wilderness somewhere, a five- or six-year-old boy suddenly pointed upward at the sky where the clouds had formed into a person and shouted loudly.
Upon hearing this, the boy's mother looked up and saw nothing but a cloud shaped like a person, yet a tender smile appeared on her face, filled with affection, as she said, "That's a very, very powerful being transformed, Yun'er. When you grow up, you can also become such a mighty figure."
"Yes, definitely. I want to be as famous as the Sword God!"
The little boy seriously nodded.
Suddenly, he knelt on the ground and kowtowed to the cloud above, "Mighty grandfather, bless Yun'er so that he may join the Holy Land of Canglan Island and cultivate the supreme Martial Arts!"
In a trance, the name "Heavenly Dao" suddenly appeared in the boy's consciousness, and he kowtowed and said, "Grandfather Heavenly Dao, bless Yun'er to join the Holy Land of Canglan Island!"
In that moment, in his mother's astonished eyes, the boy was suffused with a radiant glow, his physique transforming and Spiritual Energy entering his body.
In that instant, some hidden ailments were completely healed, and his talent transformed.
The woman knelt on the ground, crying tears of joy: "The Heavenly Lord has opened his eyes at last, pitying us, mother and son!"
Somehow, the words "Heavenly Lord" slipped out, a title she had never used before.
"Wonderful! It's just wonderful! The way of the Heavenly Dao is indeed marvelous!"
Tian Zi was overjoyed.
The boy was the first to kowtow to him, so naturally, he was destined to receive the Heavenly Dao's care.
"Great Wilderness boasts a place for you, train hard for me, your Heavenly Dao grandfather."
Tian Zi, newly embodying the Heavenly Dao, embarked on his heavenly path.
"The Great Wilderness has weakened a bit, the cultivation speed has slowed down, and turning to cultivate the Great Wilderness Martial Arts is not smooth enough. Now that there is the Heavenly Dao, reverence to the Heavenly Dao can enhance the comprehension of Martial Arts and speed up cultivation!"
It was time to enhance the strength of the Great Wilderness.
Tian Zi's gaze fell on Canglan Island, the holy land of the Great Wilderness, a place mentioned by a Taoist Ancestor as central, a place the Taoist Ancestor had stayed, naturally making it a holy land.
In a trance, Xu Junhe developed the concept of the Heavenly Dao, letting Great Wilderness Warriors revere the Heavenly Dao, making the path of Martial Arts more smooth!
"Who are you?"
On Canglan Island, Xu Junhe, seeing a stone transformed into a young man, was utterly astonished.

chapters.title: Chapter 923 - 480: The Great Wilderness has the Heavenly Dao, Turmoil in Xiang Long
chapters.content:
A stone abruptly turned into a human; this was beyond Xu Junhe's comprehension, even though he was not far from the Divine Skill Realm. He could hardly imagine what kind of method this was.
Following his shock, he could not help but remain vigilant.
"Do not panic, I am the Great Wilderness Heavenly Path, guided by the Taoist Ancestor!"
Tian Zi tried to look solemn.
The Great Wilderness Heavenly Path?!
Xu Junhe's heart trembled. Although he did not know what exactly the Great Wilderness Heavenly Path entailed, he felt a sense of relief, as the other party seemed to be under the guidance of a predecessor to become the Heavenly Path.
"So it's the Great Wilderness Heavenly Path!"
Xu Junhe bowed solemnly in respect.
In his mind, the concept of Heavenly Path emerged, and his admiration for the predecessor's methods deepened.
"I am the Great Wilderness Heavenly Path, and seeing the weakness of the Great Wilderness, I need you from Canglan Island to do some things!"
Tian Zi said deliberately.
"How should we proceed?"
"Revere the Heavenly Path! Those who perceive the Heavenly Path will greatly enhance their cultivation speed, making it easier to have sudden insights into Martial Arts, and cultivation becomes easier..."
Upon hearing this, Xu Junhe nodded and said, "No problem!"
These were trifles; since this person was guided by a predecessor and became the Great Wilderness Heavenly Path, he was now one of their own.
Moreover, this Heavenly Path was somewhat unfathomable!
"This Canglan Island is somewhat small, a sacred land should look like a sacred land."
Tian Zi walked across Canglan Island.
"Indeed it is small, but this island has its unique attributes."
Xu Junhe said helplessly.
"Small issues, all these are minor in the eyes of my Heavenly Path."
Tian Zi chuckled.
At that moment, Xu Junhe was astonished to find Canglan Island expanding; it suddenly transformed into a vast island, and the section of the Cang River where Canglan Island was located became a huge lake with endless blue waves.
The Cang River remained the Cang River, the only difference being that the section around Canglan Island had become a large lake, while downstream, the river continued flowing out from the other end of the lake.
This change had happened in a mere moment.
The people on Canglan Island, in a moment of bewilderment, were horrified to find that Canglan Island had entirely changed.
The ships sailing on the Cang River, and the martial artists amidst them, suddenly found themselves on a strange river. Looking up, the once-familiar sacred site of Canglan Island had vanished without a trace.
"Look, how did the downstream turn into a large lake? We were clearly at the Cang River section of Canglan Island just a moment ago, what in the world happened?"
"Could it be that we have arrived in the Spiritual Realm?"
"Impossible, I am on the Cang River, not crossing the Spiritual Realm Gate. How could I be in the Spiritual Realm?"
"Where has the Holy Island gone?"
The numerous martial artists on the boats were tremendously shocked.
"Let's go check it out!"
Several Grandmaster Martial Artists leaped into the air, flying towards the original location of Canglan Island.
Traveling along, they skimmed over the rippling vast lake, eventually spotting a small black dot at the center of the lake.
As they approached, they realized it appeared to be Canglan Island!
However, it had undergone significant changes compared to the Canglan Island they remembered.
The island's mountain peaks now towered high, the once small islet had transformed into a giant island.
Yet, the outline of the island faintly revealed the semblance of Canglan Island.
On Canglan Island, Xu Junhe was hosting Tian Zi, his heart still deeply shocked; this was the power of Heavenly Dao, able to change the heavens and earth in an instant!
That day, with the immense transformation of Canglan Island, also marked the beginning of a major evolution in the Great Wilderness.
Soon after, the sacred site of Canglan Island, together with the Great Wilderness Martial Arts Academy and the Great Wilderness Cabinet, passed down the concept of revering the Heavenly Dao. Martial Artists would contemplate the Heavenly Dao, aiding them in breaking through their cultivation bottlenecks.
The power of the Great Wilderness visibly surged.
Tian Zi was exceedingly delighted.
"The Heavenly Dao method of the Taoist Ancestor is indeed profound and powerful! I can grow stronger just by lying down; these shackles on me won't last long before they are completely removed.
"What Taicang couldn't do, I, Tian Zi, can achieve. All those people, and even those from the Imperishable Temple watching me in secret, just you wait!"
This was his Domain!
"Taicang has perished, the Great Wilderness must stand; I am the Great Wilderness Heavenly Path, those who defy my majestic authority will be severely punished!"
Tian Zi thought excitedly.
The Great Wilderness was entering a stage of explosive power increase; the grade of Spiritual Medicine was continuously improving, and more heavenly and earthly treasures appeared, making cultivation for martial artists faster as well.
In just a short time, martial artists cultivating and pondering the Heavenly Dao had deeply embedded this practice in their hearts.
The Great Wilderness now recognized the Heavenly Dao.
"All quite adept at causing a stir, but this Domain is not yours; just you wait to kneel down and call me Grandfather Heavenly Dao!"
Tian Zi looked towards the location of the Divine Realm, sneering inwardly.
No matter what plots those people had, they ultimately knew too little about Taicang. As long as he, the spirit of this Domain, was present, no one could seize the Domain Authority and become the Master of the Taicang Domain.
Even if they obtained the Book of Taicang, becoming the Master of the Domain was not so simple.
Moreover, even though the Book of Taicang left by Taicang could cultivate a person to become the new Master of the Taicang Domain, it also required his approval; otherwise, as the spirit of the Domain, he could counterbalance the other party.
"The Spiritual Realm should also have some arrangements made in advance."
Tian Zi muttered to himself.
Currently, the range of the Great Wilderness was only the Inner Domain, which was the smallest.
With the rapidly increasing power of the Great Wilderness, once an appropriate moment arrived, he would spread the rules of the Heavenly Dao to the Spiritual Realm, then to the Divine Realm, and finally to the entire Domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 924 - 480: The Great Wilderness has the Heavenly Dao, Turmoil in Xiang Long_2
chapters.content:
...
In the Divine Realm, the shaking of the Domain persisted.
The Qinghua Sect remained unaffected, but Emperor Da Yue and others also felt some pressure and were desperately cultivating, striving to enhance their power as much as possible.
Fang Hao was also improving the Qinghua Sect's Great Formation, and Su Lingxiu was using the Domain Divine Furnace to enhance her cultivation.
Within the Nine Mountain Realm, the Demon Clan's presence was vast, and more Immortal Realm Spirit Beasts from various places in the Divine Realm were converging.
Red Cat looked at the Wind Spirit Tiger and said, "The position of the Demon King of the Demon Clan is decided. You don't have the title of Demon King, but I won't mistreat you. You will serve as one of the Demon Marshals of the Demon Clan, and I will assign you twelve Demon Generals!"
"No, my brother..."
The Wind Spirit Tiger felt uncomfortable.
"How audacious!"
As soon as it began to speak, a roar came.
"The honor of the Demon King is not something you can call 'brother.' Are you offending our Great Demon King? What should be your punishment?"
A few Spirit Beasts that had early on pledged allegiance to Red Cat and whose wits were particularly sharp, now jumped out to reprimand the Wind Spirit Tiger.
The face of the Wind Spirit Tiger darkened.
However, at this moment, the rest of the Demon Generals were overflowing with energy, as if they were ready to subdue it any moment.
At that instant, the Wind Spirit Tiger felt an overwhelming increase in the sense of crisis. If so many Demon Generals were to strike, it would stand no chance. By now, the Wind Spirit Tiger also understood it could no longer continue to play the role of big brother.
The entire Divine Realm was currently unstable, with a major change already upon it. Moreover, having narrowly escaped with its life from the Dragon Abyss, the news, once spread, would surely catch Tian Shiqi's attention.
It was only within the Demon Clan that it could find a place to stay.
Red Cat was strong!
So strong that it caused the Wind Spirit Tiger's heart to pound. That chilling tiger might had truly gained the air of a Tiger King. None of the tigers among the Spirit Beasts of the world could defy Red Cat's Tiger King might.
Moreover, Red Cat was not only the king of the Tiger Tribe but also the founder of the Demon Clan, the Great King!
Looking at Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha, all three Great Demon Kings were stronger than it; it indeed had no place among them.
The laws of the Demon Clan were what the Wind Spirit Tiger urgently needed. It had to become stronger to face the impending crisis and even take revenge on Tian Shiqi!
"I pay my respects to the Great Demon King!"
At that moment, the Wind Spirit Tiger submitted.
"Good, good! Between you and me, there's no need for such formalities. From today on, you are the Wind Demon Marshal!"
Red Cat said joyfully.
"Yes, thank you, Great King!"
The Wind Spirit Tiger responded solemnly.
Red Cat came down and said, "I've heard there are twelve Spirit Beast Kings in the Divine Realm, but now only you are here. Where are the other eleven Spirit Beast Kings?"
The twelve Spirit Beast Kings were the strongest among the Spirit Beasts of the Divine Realm.
Red Cat wanted to gather the twelve Demon Marquises!
"The Flood Dragon that was originally in the Dragon Abyss has been deceived by Tian Shiqi and led to an unknown location. As for the other Beast Kings, they each have their own territory, and they are very proud. As for their current whereabouts, I'm not sure either," said the Wind Spirit Tiger with a shake of its head.
"Then spread the news. The position of the Demon Marshal of the Demon Clan awaits them—first come, first served!" Red Cat said with a casual smile.
Inside the Taimiao Divine Sect, in that pavilion, Xin Mengrou bowed respectfully before the statue.
"Heavenly Slaughter is quite ambitious, but believing he can seize the Domain Authority is too presumptuous."
A dreamlike female voice came from the statue.
"You've cultivated well. When the Dao Realm and the Divine Realm are connected, you should come to the Taimiao World of the Dao Realm." Xin Mengrou replied respectfully, "Yes, Ancestor!"
"The subduing of the True Dragon is no small matter. The True Dragon Clan has profound resources. The disappearance of the young dragon caused quite a stir, and the Subduing Dragon Technique is considered a great disgrace to the True Dragon Clan."
"The True Dragons will surely seek revenge. In addition to the True Dragon Clan, other forces from various realms will probably covet the Subduing Dragon Technique.
"Especially be wary of Heavenly Slaughter. This person is ambitious and shameless in his actions. He is likely to take the initiative to seize the Subduing Dragon Technique. If he has a backing, find protection as soon as possible. The affairs of the Divine Realm have already been transmitted to the Dao Realm."
The voice from the statue was cold and consistently emotionless, and it sounded as if from a dream.
Xin Mengrou was puzzled. The Dao Domain Ladder was broken; how could the various realms of the Dao Realm have learned of Xu Yan's subduing of the dragon so quickly?
"Ancestor, the Ladder is broken. How has the matter of the Subduing Dragon been transmitted to the Dao Realm?" Xin Mengrou asked in confusion.
"Taihe, Da Yan, Taikun, and others have their own means of communication with the Dao Realm. Naturally, they would relay the affairs of the Divine Realm over," the statue explained.
Xin Mengrou suddenly understood. No wonder the Ancestor was curiously asking about the Subduing Dragon; some major powers had already transmitted the news through special channels to the various realms of the Dao Realm.
"There must be Divine Venerate Realm Warriors in the Divine Realm, otherwise, it would not have been possible to do this. Be careful. Heavenly Slaughter is likely to have someone act on his behalf," the statue reminded her.
"Thank you for the warning, Ancestor!" Xin Mengrou felt a shock in her heart. Although that senior was immensely powerful and might have given Xu Yan some means of protection, the necessary precautions had to be taken.
"Go!"
"Yes!"
Xin Mengrou immediately went to find Xu Yan and informed him that the matter of the Subduing Dragon had spread throughout the Dao Realm and could trigger a crisis.
"A Divine Venerate Warrior?" Xu Yan mused. He thought of Tian Shiqi.
"It's of no concern, a minor matter. Besides, that old man's strength is even stronger," he said casually.
Xin Mengrou was taken aback.
Outside the Taimiao Divine Sect, Meng Chong, Jiang Buping, and Wu Tianan rushed over.
"Xin girl, long time no see."
Wu Tianan felt a sense of emotion as he looked at Xin Mengrou. The little girl from back then had actually reached such a stage, even surpassing him.
"Dean Wu, still not falling behind, I see."
Xin Mengrou smiled happily. The knots in her heart from the past had long been untied. The reunion with old acquaintances was a joyous occasion.
"Dean Wu, did you find the person you were looking for?"
Xin Mengrou asked curiously.
Wu Tianan shook his head somewhat dejectedly.
Everyone gathered at the Taimiao Divine Sect, and both Meng Chong and Jiang Buping curiously asked, "Eldest Senior Brother, where is the true dragon?"
"Right here!"
With a wave of Xu Yan's hand, Ao Yuxue, who was inside the Prime Tortoise Carapace, was moved out by him.
Seeing the beautiful girl with two small horns on her head, both Meng Chong and Jiang Buping were taken aback, walking around her and said incredulously, "She's the true dragon?"
Xu Yan nodded, "Yes, indeed, she's a female dragon, and still a juvenile at that!"
Ao Yuxue stomped her feet in frustration, "Can you stop calling me a female dragon?"
"Then, little dragoness?"
Xu Yan thought for a moment and said.
"You, you..."
Ao Yuxue's eyes reddened, nearly bursting into tears.
"It's Dragon Maiden, do you understand? We in the True Dragon Clan are not like those spirit beasts; we can't just be called female this, mother that!"
She corrected him indignantly.
"Eldest Senior Brother, is this what true dragons look like?"
Meng Chong rubbed his head, somewhat puzzled.
"The legends don't describe true dragons like this."
Jiang Buping also nodded, "I've seen scarce mentions in the ancient records of the Jiang Family; true dragons aren't people with little horns!"
Xu Yan raised his hand and pinched one of Ao Yuxue's small horns, saying, "She has transformed into human form."
Then he instructed Ao Yuxue, "Restore your true dragon form quickly, so my junior brothers can see what a true dragon looks like."
Ao Yuxue's face flushed red, full of grief and indignation. What did they think she was, a display piece?
"I won't!"
She stubbornly shook her head.
"Humph!"
Xu Yan snorted softly and said, "You are the dragon I have subdued. Do you dare to defy me?"
Feeling the little golden dragon on her spirit stirring, Ao Yuxue immediately grew fearful and said, "I'll just restore my true form, what's with the fierceness!"
Woof!
With a dragon's roar, the pure white immaculate true dragon soared into the sky, circling in midair.
"So this is the true dragon!"
Meng Chong and Jiang Buping exclaimed in admiration.
"Eldest Senior Brother, does Yu Xiaolong have a chance to transform into a dragon too?"
Meng Chong suddenly thought of Yu Xiaolong, the Flood Dragon.
"Should be possible, I guess?"
Xu Yan was not entirely sure either.
"Are you satisfied now?"
Ao Yuxue descended from midair and reverted to human form.
However, her complexion was paler than before, clearly indicating that her previous injuries were not light.
"I need to go back and recuperate!"
Xu Yan withdrew the Prime Tortoise Carapace, taking Ao Yuxue back.
"Let's return to the Qinghua state; it's time to go into seclusion to consolidate our gains."
Xu Yan spoke up.
"Yes, with the great changes in the Divine Realm, the powers of the Dao Domain will soon descend. It's time to consolidate and quickly improve our strength."
Meng Chong nodded in agreement.
"Dean Wu, shall we go together?"
Xu Yan looked at Wu Tianan and smiled.
"Sure!"
Wu Tianan nodded.
"Young Master Xu, we would also like to pay respects to our elders and see Sister Lingxiu again."
Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao spoke up.
"And what about Elder Xin?"
Xu Yan turned to Xin Mengrou.
"Wait for me a moment; I need to bid farewell to the Ancestral Master. I too wish to consult the elders about some of the puzzles in Martial Arts!"
Xin Mengrou thought for a while and then said.

chapters.title: Chapter 925 - 925: 481st visit to Qinghua state, the plan of day 17
chapters.content:
Every move of Xu Yan was closely watched. Outside the Taimiao Divine Sect, the Immortal Heavenly Venerables from various major forces were secretly paying attention. The arrival of Meng Chong and Jiang Buping was immediately noticed by the strong figures of these forces.
They initially thought a battle of the geniuses would erupt, but it remained calm, leading the strong figures of various forces to make a shocking guess—that Xu Yan, Meng Chong, and Jiang Buping actually knew each other.
Moreover, it was highly likely that they came from the same sect.
Thinking of this, they were deeply shocked. What kind of powerful figure could have cultivated such monsters, and not just one, but three?
Old Man Xiao did not leave, waiting to go with Xu Yan to meet that mysterious individual.
The appearance of Meng Chong and Jiang Buping confirmed his suspicions.
"Exactly who could have cultivated such monsters, and moreover, Xu Yan, Meng Chong, and Jiang Buping seem to be practicing different forms of Martial Arts?"
Old Man Xiao was very shocked in his heart.
According to his knowledge, there seemed to be only one person who had the ability to train Xu Yan and the two others.
Taicang!
However, Taicang was already dead!
But if not Taicang, who else could possibly have such capability?
"The Imperishable Temple?"
Old Man Xiao furrowed his brows lightly.
Yet he felt the possibility was not high, as if the Imperishable Temple could do this, they would have already invaded the Taicang Domain long ago.
"No need to hurry, it won't be long before I can meet him"
Old Man Xiao thought to himself.
That day, Xu Yan and his group came out from the Taimiao Divine Sect.
"Let's go."
Xu Yan looked at Old Man Xiao and said with a smile.
"Alright!"
Old Man Xiao nodded, secretly looking forward to it, even starting to ponder how to test Xu Yan's master.
The group left Taimiao Realm and headed towards Qinghua state.
"We are attracting too much attention!"
Meng Chong frowned slightly as he spoke.
Wherever they went, strong figures from various forces appeared, checking where the people were headed, and not even bothering to hide their tracks or intentions.
These strong figures also knew, even if they wanted to hide, they couldn't deceive Xu Yan and the others; moreover, any misunderstanding could result in them being slain with a single sword strike.
Thus, they directly revealed their tracks, clearly showing their intentions.
Buzz!
Suddenly, sword light emerged from all directions, every blade of grass and every tree turned into sharp swords, Xu Yan's voice resonated everywhere.
"Follow any further, and I shall show no mercy!"
As the sword light appeared, strong figures from the various forces changed their expressions instantly, quickly fleeing far away.
After that, no strong figures from the major forces appeared again.
After all, they were afraid to die!
Old Man Xiao sighed inwardly, thinking that this young man was truly domineering.
Moreover, his Sword Dao was so profound that even he had never heard of it; it already surpassed his understanding of the Sword Dao.
"Everything in the world can be turned into a sword? What kind of Sword Dao is this? Is this still Sword Dao?"
Old Man Xiao felt a chill in his heart.
If Xu Yan were at the same realm as he, Old Man Xiao felt he would not stand a chance against such a profound Sword Dao, probably unable to withstand many strikes.
At this moment, he understood why Xu Yan could slay Immortal Heavenly Venerables as if he was swatting little grasshoppers.
Indeed, the Immortal Heavenly Venerables had no way to defend against such a Sword Dao.
...
In the Di Yun Realm, the massive Heavenly Grotto had disappeared.
The power of the Domain Dao Rule had also vanished, yet the group of Tian Shiqi still had not left, with news from various major divine realms continuously arriving.
Xu Yan subduing the True Dragon, collapses of the Dao Domain Ladder, chaos in the Heavenly Grotto, blood sacrifices by Netherworld Warriors, overwhelming arrogance of the Witches, and so forth.
And the turmoil of the Domain was still ongoing.
The Dao Realm had fallen, merging and connecting with the Divine Realm, allowing the Dao Realm and the Divine Realm to unite.
The Spiritual Energy of the Dao Realm and the Dao Rhythm were spreading from this fallen Realm.
The limits of the Immortal Realm would soon be broken.
Warriors from the Dao Realm would also descend, not lacking Supreme Sovereign Warriors.
"Shiqi, who exactly is Xu Yan, and who is behind him? He even subdued a True Dragon!"
One of the Heavenly Slaughter masked men said solemnly.
Tian Shiqi spoke solemnly, "Xu Yan hails from the Qinghua state, holding a revered position there, his mastery of the Sword Dao is unprecedented, truly a great demon."
"As for the powerful figure behind him, that remains unknown."
"That was a True Dragon! According to you, Xu Yan's realm should be inferior to that of the True Dragon, but he subdued it, using something other than Sword Dao, which means he has mastered the technique to subdue True Dragons."
Another Heavenly Slaughter masked man said with shocked eyes.
Winning against the stronger and subduing a True Dragon, this was unprecedented, the first time in history!
Xu Yan, truly the foremost person to subdue a True Dragon in history!
"His demonic level far exceeds my imagination!"
Tian Shiqi also said with a solemn face.
"The Supreme Sovereign has sent a message, we must obtain the Subduing Dragon Technique!"
Tian Shiqi said solemnly.
"The Supreme Sovereign has sent a message?"
The four Heavenly Slaughter masked men's eyes were excited.
"Yes, the time for achievement has come, if we obtain the Subduing Dragon Technique, the Supreme Sovereign can dominate the True Dragon Clan, significant achievers, Supreme Sovereign is in sight!"
Tian Shiqi said with excitement.
"Good! Good! Shiqi, where is Xu Yan? We will go capture him now, waiting for the Supreme Sovereign's arrival!"
The Heavenly Slaughter masked men were overjoyed.
"Xu Yan has likely already returned to the Qinghua state, if you want to capture him, you'll have to go to Qinghua state."
Tian Shiqi suddenly sounded somewhat regretful, "This opportunity to achieve greatness can only be given to you, the Supreme Sovereign has another task for me!"
The four Heavenly Slaughter masked men were ecstatic, yet they comforted him, "Shiqi, since the Supreme Sovereign has given you another important task, it seems this task is as significant as obtaining the Subduing Dragon Technique."

chapters.title: Chapter 926 - 481: Return to Qinghua State, Tian 17's Planning_2
chapters.content:
Tian Shiqi smiled and nodded, "That's only natural. This mission must be important, or else why don't we swap tasks, I'll go to the Qinghua state, and you can go welcome the descent of the Heavenly Envoy into the Divine Realm?"
The four Heavenly Slaughter masked figures hurriedly shook their heads, "That won't do, since our respected superior has entrusted it to you, if we overstep our boundaries, we might displease him. The four of us brothers will go to the Qinghua state to capture Xu Yan."
Tian Shiqi's eyes flashed with a hint of regret, but then he pretended to be solemn, "You're right, a task assigned by our superior should never be transferred to someone else."
"Yes, yes!"
The four Heavenly Slaughter masked figures kept nodding their heads.
"In that case, I wish the four brothers success. When you ascend to become Supreme Sovereigns one day, don't forget about me, Tian Shiqi."
Tian Shiqi's tone became respectful.
"Oh, there's no need to be so formal between us!"
The four figures were visibly happy.
"Since the task from our superior is urgent, let's part ways for now."
"Okay!"
The four Heavenly Slaughter masked figures, with faces full of excitement, instantly vanished, heading directly for the Qinghua state.
Tian Shiqi's smile faded as he silently watched the four depart.
"Hopefully, you'll be able to return alive."
To capture Xu Yan and obtain the Subduing Dragon Technique seemed like a mission with rich rewards, but that presupposed one survived to claim them.
No news had come from the Qinghua state anymore, and it appeared that all the members of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow had vanished.
Moreover, it wasn't ruled out that they had betrayed them.
"With Xu Yan being such a monstrosity, could the people behind him be weak? If you four fail, it's only reasonable that I didn't lend a hand. After all, gathering intelligence and maintaining the big picture is essential. Our superior would only praise my adaptability and understanding of what matters most. He would entrust me with even more important tasks."
"If by some fluke you four do succeed, then don't blame me for being ruthless. Such a great achievement isn't something you can claim."
Tian Shiqi displayed a sinister smile.
The Qinghua state was too dangerous. He had to play it safe.
He had not taken action personally out of caution. Tian Shiqi was clear about his role; he was a schemer behind the scenes, an executor, not a front-line charger, or a risk-taker who would sacrifice himself.
The four Heavenly Slaughter masked figures headed straight for the Qinghua state.
"Those backing Xu Yan, no matter how strong, are merely at the Divine Venerate Realm. If there were a Supreme Sovereign in the Divine Realm, wouldn't our superior know of it?
"The four of us brothers working together are more than enough to kill the opponent, yet we still need to be cautious."
The eldest of the four said in a deep voice.
"We have Divine Artifacts granted by our superior. Any common Divine Venerate can be slain, and with our combined strength, even a top Divine Venerate can be vanquished. Capturing Xu Yan will be as easy as flipping a palm!"
"Exactly!"
The four brimmed with confidence.
The Qinghua state, seemingly a tranquil domain outside of the world. While the Domain stirred with chaos, the Qinghua state remained peaceful and undisturbed.
It was untouched by any tremor of Domain and the turmoil of the Divine Realm, an image of serenity and prosperity. Furthermore, the Domain Lingji was exceedingly active.
"This is the Qinghua state?"
The moment Zhou Qingshuang stepped into the Qinghua state, she was stunned.
Zi Yun was also surprised; the Qinghua state had changed so much!
"That's right, this is the Qinghua state!"
Zi Yun smiled and nodded.
"Princess, something's off about the Qinghua state!"
An old crone following Zhou Qingshuang spoke with a grave expression.
The Domain Lingji was too active. It seemed that within the Qinghua state, the limits of the Immortal Realm had already been broken.
"Let's go, Sister Lingxiu can cure you!"
Zi Yun said with a smile.
Returning to the Qinghua state and about to meet her elders and Su Lingxiu, Zi Yun was overjoyed.
She had decided, she would not leave again. Nowhere was better than being by Su Lingxiu's side.
"Meng Chong is also going to come back soon!"
Thinking of this, Zi Yun's smile grew even more radiant.
The great changes to the Domain echoed through the Divine Realm. The journey of Zi Yun and Zhou Qingshuang from the Da Yan Realm was also fraught with setbacks.
Fortunately, Zhou Qingshuang and the old crone were, after all, Immortal Heavenly Venerates, capable of handling it.
While Xu Yan, Meng Chong, and Jiang Buping could kill Immortal Heavenly Venerates as easily as squashing grasshoppers, the Immortal Heavenly Venerates were still among the pinnacle existences of the Divine Realm.
Zhou Qingshuang's strength was formidable even among the Immortal Heavenly Venerates, and her status as Princess of Da Yan was sufficient to deter many powerful beings.
"Zi Yun is back."
Zi Yun had sent a message before her return.
"And she's brought along a patient."
Su Lingxiu was filled with anticipation; she was very interested in odd and difficult diseases.
"Lingxiu, Yue'er!"
Zi Yun's figure came flying in.
"Sister Zi Yun!"
Yue'er's face was full of happiness, "Sister Zi Yun, your strength has fallen behind!"
Zi Yun sighed and said, "There's no helping it, Da Yan is ultimately not the Evergreen Pavilion."
Next, Zi Yun introduced Zhou Qingshuang, "This is the Princess of Da Yan!"
"This is the Alchemical Medical Fairy, Su Lingxiu!"
Zhou Qingshuang and her servant were greatly shocked at this moment.
Although Su Lingxiu had a friendly aura, gentle and serene with an ethereal quality, her formidable strength was indeed terrifying to both the master and servant.
"Truly worthy of being Meng Chong's junior sister, with her strength, killing an Immortal Heavenly Venerable is indeed as easy as slaughtering a chicken!"
Zhou Qingshuang exclaimed in amazement.
"Qingshuang pays respect to Fairy Su!"
Zhou Qingshuang did not dare to act with the airs of the Princess of Da Yan, and said respectfully.
"No need for such formalities. Your situation has already been discussed with me by your second senior brother. Since you're here, let's not delay, I'll give you a check-up!"
Su Lingxiu said excitedly, eager to try.
"Okay!"
Zhou Qingshuang nodded.
Better to be at ease upon arrival; if Su Lingxiu truly had any ill intentions, Zhou Qingshuang's strength was in no position to resist.
Su Lingxiu and Yue'er conducted a check-up on Zhou Qingshuang and treated her illness.
Zi Yun, meanwhile, made her way to the back courtyard.
"Zi Yun pays respects to the senior!"
She respectfully knelt down and saluted.
Li Xuan revealed a smile and nodded, "No need for such formalities!"
"Thank you, Senior!"
After respectfully saluting, Zi Yun stood up.
"Senior, is Taicang Martial Arts truly lacking in prospects?"
After hesitating for a bit, Zi Yun couldn't help but ask.
Li Xuan's smile remained unchanged as he said, "The pinnacle of Taicang Martial Arts is Taicang himself, but that doesn't mean there is no room for further improvement. It's just that Taicang has died without making any further progress.
"Taicang did possess real strength, but for you, it's still too distant. Do not aim too high without foundation, just focus on your cultivation.
"If you wish to explore the path ahead, the prerequisite is that you have already reached Taicang's level!"
"Zi Yun understands!"
Zi Yun responded respectfully.
"Mm, keep up with your cultivation."
Li Xuan nodded.
With a slight flick of his finger, the Jade Talisman on Zi Yun's body was instantly elevated by him.
As Zi Yun returned, the Alchemical Medical Institute became much livelier. Zhou Qingshuang and her servant were exceedingly shocked after witnessing the art of alchemy medicine.
And the spiritual illness that plagued Zhou Qingshuang had also been cured.
Although the illness was cured, the long-term effects kept Zhou Qingshuang as cold as ever.
Zhou Qingshuang, even after her illness was cured, did not return to the Da Yan Realm. Instead, she took up residence next to the Alchemical Medical Institute, bringing out many Divine Medicines and treasures to purchase pills and so on.
Furthermore, she dispatched an old woman back to the Da Yan Realm to fetch more Divine Medicines and other treasures.
Upon seeing this, Feng Yan couldn't help but be astonished. This woman was indeed willing to spend, and was decisive, using wealth to pave her way to form good relations with Su Lingxiu and others.
Even he had received valuable treasures from Zhou Qingshuang!
"Who would have thought I'd encounter someone who understands how to seize opportunities just like I do!"
Feng Yan mused to himself.
However, no matter how deliberate Zhou Qingshuang was, she was doomed to not integrate as thoroughly as he had. After all, he began diligently running errands for Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu when their strengths were not yet formidable, worked hard and flawlessly handled his tasks to seize this great opportunity.
Xu Yan and his group had already stepped into the Nine Mountain Realm.
In the land of Dahai Mountain, Xu Yan met with the old acquaintance, Wan Tianlin, for a small gathering.
"Brother Xu's name is now resonating throughout the Divine Realm!"
Wan Tianlin exclaimed in admiration.
He was only half a step away from the Immortal Realm and was confident he could break through within half a year.
But what of it after breaking through to the Immortal Realm?
Xu Yan had already slain countless top combatants of the Immortal Realm, even subduing a True Dragon.
"Those Immortal Heavenly Venerables were too weak, which is why I inadvertently amassed these unwarranted accolades. They're not worth mentioning!"
Xu Yan waved his hand dismissively.
For a moment, Wan Tianlin didn't know how to respond.

chapters.title: Chapter 927 - 482: The Disciple Returns, Old Man Xiao's Astonishment
chapters.content:
Xu Yan and Wan Tianlin parted ways after their brief gathering, and he was ready to continue his journey, cross the Realm Gate, and return to the Qinghua state.
Having been on adventures outside for such a long time, he found himself missing his master.
"These members of the Demon Clan..."
Old Man Xiao's brow furrowed as he looked towards the various locations of the Nine Mountain Realm, especially in the direction of Spiritual Sovereign Mountain.
Those spirit beasts seemed different now, with a special aura emanating from them—one he had never seen before. It must be the demonic aura of the Demon Clan.
No matter how he looked at it, something felt off.
How had this Demon Clan suddenly appeared within the Taicang Domain?
When he first heard the name 'Demon Clan,' he thought it was just a new name for spirit beasts, creating a power bloc of their own.
But what he saw now was far from that simple.
The Demon Clan had transcended the category of ordinary spirit beasts. The rumored ability to ignore the bloodlines of spirit beasts, akin to martial artists continuously cultivating and advancing, was not a fallacy?
With that thought, Old Man Xiao grew increasingly restless.
The Demon Clan always seemed like a huge potential threat, likely influenced by the Land of Imperishable, preparing to invade the Taicang Domain.
"Ah, the Demon Clan, founded by Red Cat, who would have thought this big cat would really make the clan thrive," Xu Yan said with a smile.
"You know about the Demon Clan?" Old Man Xiao asked in surprise.
"And who exactly is this Red Cat?"
Xu Yan chuckled, "Red Cat, huh? My master has raised a tiger, which can also be considered a fat cat. My junior sister fed it a lot of pills, and it also grasped the Great Demon Martial Arts passed down by my master.
"Speaking of which, I'm also a Supreme Sovereign of the Demon Clan."
Red Cat, a very time-aware tiger, a very cunning big cat, and one that was exceedingly beloved by its mother, was a 'cultured' tiger. It learned literacy and recognition of words from its mother.
Old Man Xiao's eyes widened, his heart far from calm.
That Xu Yan, Meng Chong, and Jiang Buping, three monstrous talents, were disciples of the same master was one thing; but even the founding of the Demon Clan was connected to Xu Yan's master!
The founder of the Demon Clan turned out to be a pet raised by Xu Yan's master?!
For some reason, Old Man Xiao now felt that within the Taicang Domain, there was an invisible hand manipulating everything, driving the changes of the Taicang Domain.
Or perhaps guiding the changes of the Taicang Domain.
And this invisible hand seemed to be Xu Yan's master!
With this in mind, Old Man Xiao couldn't wait to meet and see just who Xu Yan's mysterious master was.
"Let's see who you are, who's plotting all this here," Old Man Xiao thought to himself.
Xu Yan made his master out to be incredibly powerful, yet Old Man Xiao was skeptical. He did not think Xu Yan was spouting lies, but rather, Xu Yan's master was being inscrutable and deceiving Xu Yan, the youngster.
In Old Man Xiao's view, Xu Yan was also a victim!
"I'm acquainted with the Seven Great Domain Masters, and even if you are a mighty one from the Imperishable Temple, you still wouldn't have such a terrifying power to do this," he scoffed internally.
Xu Yan's master bragging too much—struggling to bear the consequences of a name?
What a joke!
"Let's go, back to Qinghua state!" Xu Yan said and chose not to look for Red Cat but instead headed straight back to Qinghua state.
Upon entering the Realm Gate and stepping into the long-missed Qinghua state, Xu Yan and his companions couldn't help but sigh; the Qinghua state had changed so much. The spiritual energy had become thicker, and the Domain Lingji was more active.
Moreover, the entire Qinghua state had undergone a transformation.
The great city where the Realm Gate was located had been layered with Great Formations, expanded several times in size. Without permission, outsiders couldn't cross the Realm Gate to enter.
It was the same even for the Immortal Heavenly Venerables!
"The formation arts of my fourth junior brother have indeed improved greatly; this Great Formation can easily obliterate Immortal Heavenly Venerables!" Xu Yan exclaimed.
"Indeed!" Meng Chong nodded.
"Sword God Xu Yan has returned!"
"And Heavenly God Meng Chong!"
"That must be Spear Demon Jiang Buping!"
The martial artists within the great city immediately roared to life.
Sword God Xu Yan, Heavenly God Meng Chong, and Spear Demon Jiang Buping all had formidable reputations and deep connections with Qinghua Sect.
They were all disciples of Qinghua Taoist Ancestor!
But at that moment, Old Man Xiao's eyes were wide open, his face filled with disbelief.
"Is this the Qinghua state?"
Among the Thirty-six Realms of the Divine Realm, the Qinghua state was considered a remote place bordering the Spiritual Realm. Its spiritual energy and Domain Lingji were somewhat weaker than other realms.
However, the current Qinghua state had a concentration of spiritual energy and activity of Domain Lingji that surpassed the other thirty-six realms. What shocked him more was that Qinghua state seemed to have broken through the upper limits of the Immortal Realm!
"What Dharma is this?" he wondered, feeling the Great Formation at the Realm Gate, his face a mix of shock and bewilderment. This was another method he had never seen before.
"No, how come Qinghua state seems like it's within an independent domain?" Old Man Xiao was once again astounded.
It was as if an invisible power, no, a force of some principle, was enveloping the Qinghua state, making it seem independent from the domain.
It was most evident that the other realms of the Divine Realm were in turbulence, but Qinghua state was stable, not feeling the slightest tremor of the domain.
"It's a Great Formation, set up by my fourth junior brother," Xu Yan explained.
"A Great Formation?" Old Man Xiao was shocked and confused.
"Yes, formations. My fourth junior brother practices Qimen Martial Art, which includes Qimen configurations, formations, artifact refining, and prohibitions!" Xu Yan explained as they made their way.
The more Old Man Xiao heard, the more astounded he became, prompting him to ask, "All of these were taught by your master?"

chapters.title: Chapter 928 - 482: The Disciple Returns, Old Man Xiao's Astonishment_2
chapters.content:
"Of course!"
Xu Yan nodded respectfully.
"I cultivate Pure Martial Arts, my second junior brother cultivates Physical Body Martial Arts, my third junior sister cultivates Alchemical Medical Martial Arts, my fourth junior brother cultivates Qimen Martial Art, and my fifth junior brother cultivates Extreme Soul Martial Arts.
"Red Cat, this pet, cultivates Great Demon Martial Arts, all taught by my master.
"Each type of Martial Arts is distinct, and these Martial Arts of ours are known as Great Wilderness Martial Arts. Of course, this name was not coined by my master but merely recognized by him.
"My master's realm had already approached Dao; every action, seemingly ordinary, yet contains profound Dao principles.
"If you can comprehend even a bit, it will be a tremendous opportunity for you!"
Old Man Xiao felt a tingling in his scalp, Xu Yan's master was so formidable, each disciple cultivated a different type of Martial Arts, each one profoundly powerful, truly monstrous.
His heart began to waver, yet he quickly steadied his thoughts, "Impossible, how could there be such powerhouses in this world? Even the one from the Imperishable Temple couldn't achieve this.
"But indeed, the Martial Arts of Xu Yan, Meng Chong, and the others are profoundly mystical, such that I have neither heard of nor seen before."
Old Man Xiao couldn't help but ask again, "How do you cultivate your Sword Dao?"
The Sword Dao of Xu Yan was truly mysterious and beyond his understanding of Martial Arts.
"Of course, it was taught by my master."
Xu Yan, with a reminiscent look, said, "My Sword Dao and the Subduing Dragon Palm were both taught by my master. To me, the Sword Dao practitioners in the Taicang Domain haven't even entered the threshold of Sword Dao!"
"How so?"
Old Man Xiao felt somewhat uneasy.
After all, he considered himself a practitioner of Sword Dao, although not solely devoted to it, one of his supreme Martial Arts techniques included Sword Dao.
"Do you know what Sword Heart Clarity is? Do you understand the Heart Sword Realm? Do you grasp the essence of Sword Intent?"
Xu Yan looked proudly.
Although Old Man Xiao was currently stronger than him, in terms of Sword Dao, he was inferior.
Next, Xu Yan explained what Sword Heart Clarity entailed, leaving Old Man Xiao baffled and feeling the profound mysteries.
"How can one achieve Sword Heart Clarity?"
He eventually couldn't help but ask.
Xu Yan pondered for a moment, then spoke, "To realize Sword Heart Clarity, the primary requirement is to cultivate your state of mind, as long as you can reach a state where 'no women occupy your heart,' you will be able to grasp the Sword Heart Clarity."
For he had initially tempered his state of mind with this very concept.
"No women in the heart?"
Old Man Xiao was stunned.
"Are you sure?"
Looking at Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao, Old Man Xiao expressed his skepticism about Xu Yan's statement.
This young fellow, could he be fooling him?
Xu Yan looked earnest and said, "Indeed!"
His gaze fixed on Old Man Xiao, he solemnly added, "My master said, 'When no women occupy the heart, cultivation is like divine'; this state is profound. It means both no women in the heart and not exactly no women in the heart—a state of mind you wouldn't understand!"
Old Man Xiao listened and was thoroughly perplexed, murmuring to himself, "I really don't understand."
He couldn't help but ask, "With such a strong Sword Dao, have you then achieved 'no women in the heart'?"
Xu Yan nodded affirmatively, "Of course! I have long since freed myself of any women in my heart, having thoroughly penetrated this state of mind!"
Old Man Xiao glanced again at Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao, two stunning beauties, and couldn't help but retort, "This you call having no women in the heart?"
Xu Yan glanced at him disdainfully, "You lack insight, you are destined not to enter the threshold of Sword Dao!"
"I lack insight?"
Old Man Xiao scratched his beard, huffily said, "Then you explain, with no women in your heart, what's this all about?"
Xu Yan sighed, "You truly are foolish, 'no women in the heart' doesn't mean no women by your side!"
Old Man Xiao was dumbstruck, could it really be interpreted that way?
"The state of mind, ah, you simply won't understand the profound subtlety of it. However, that you've cultivated to this strength is also commendable!"
Xu Yan shook his head in sympathy.
Old Man Xiao was completely flustered!
...
"The disciples are coming back."
Li Xuan smiled, his disciples were coming back, and they were all about to break through their realms.
This meant that he could teach them Martial Arts Techniques above the Establishing Dao Realm.
"Breaking through above the Establishing Dao Realm gives one real confidence."
Li Xuan looked up at the Firmament, his gaze piercing through the Domain, landing on the Chaotic Imperishable Land beyond.
"The powerful ones from the Imperishable Temple indeed possess great strength, but once I ascend above the Establishing Dao Realm, I should be able to surpass them."
According to his assessment, once above the Establishing Dao Realm, his strength would certainly surpass that of Taicang.
Although Taicang had perished, the Taicang Domain still existed, indicating that the opponent, even if stronger than Taicang, only had limited additional strength, or perhaps Taicang had used some method to severely wound the opponent.
"A Realm Master, indeed intriguing,"
Li Xuan sat leisurely in the chair, waiting for his disciples to return, including the old man Xiao, a Realm Master-Level figure.
With his current strength, suppressing a Realm Master was a breeze.
"There's no need for the Taoist Ancestor Halo, let's try the Heavenly Dao Seal instead, and let you experience what the Heavenly Dao is!"
Li Xuan muttered to himself.
Cai Ling'er was serving at his side.
"Master, I have returned!"
Xu Yan said respectfully and joyfully.
"Greetings, Master!"
Meng Chong and Jiang Buping followed Xu Yan to greet their master.
"Hmm."
Li Xuan nodded, his smile gentle.
Besides Xie Tianheng and his son Xie Lingfeng, all the other old acquaintances had arrived.
This included Xin Mengrou, who was relatively unfamiliar.
Wu Tianan was indeed remarkable, possessing extraordinary fortune, but Li Xuan did not say anything as this unusual fortune was related to Wu Tianan's guide in Martial Arts.
"Greetings, senior!"
Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao greeted him excitedly.
"Greetings, senior!"
Wu Tianan and Xin Mengrou also respectfully greeted him.
"Big Senior Brother, Second Senior Brother... Fifth Junior Brother!"
Su Lingxiu rushed over.
"Third Junior Sister!"
Immediately after, Fang Hao also hurried over.
The siblings gathered, filled with joy.
Zi Yun also hurried over, clinging excitedly to Meng Chong.
The courtyard was brimming with the joy of a long-awaited reunion, while at this moment, Old Man Xiao stared at Li Xuan, his eyebrows gradually knitting together, his expression filled with doubt and astonishment.
This person looked plain and ordinary, like a common man, exuding no aura of a strong cultivator, sitting there leisurely with a stunningly beautiful Sea Spirit Tribe woman attending to him.
Because of this, Old Man Xiao was even more astonished.
The master of Xu Yan and others couldn't possibly be a normal person; he must be powerful, likely not weaker than himself.
And with his strength, he couldn't see through him, implying that this man's strength might very well be stronger than his!
What shocked Old Man Xiao even more was that he did not know this person!
There was not a single strong cultivator in the Taicang Domain whom he did not recognize, whom he had not seen before!
Yet, this man was so unfamiliar!
If the man came from outside this Domain, how could he have entered the Taicang Domain so silently?
Moreover, why had the Taicang Domain shown no signs whatsoever?
All these signs were extraordinary!
He couldn't see through him, not one bit!
Taking a deep breath, Old Man Xiao's expression became grave as he stepped forward, revealing his aura.
Xu Yan and the others immediately looked over, startled by the commotion in the courtyard.
"I am Xiaoyao. May I ask who you are..."
Old Man Xiao spoke with a solemn expression.
Li Xuan, with a smile still on his face, twirled the Jade Ruyi in his hand, "Young man, do not be rash. Peace and calm, with neither alarm nor anger, undisturbed by externalities, that is the cultivation a Martial Artist should have..."
His tone was calm, with a hint of teaching a child.
Old Man Xiao's face darkened instantly, his aura becoming even stronger.
"I, Old Man Xiao, am no longer a young man, and for you to treat me this way..."
Before he could finish, a hand was placed on his shoulder.
It gently patted his shoulder twice.
"Little friend, be calm and not impetuous. Although you have made yourself look like an old man, it doesn't mean you are old. In my eyes, this Domain is but a newborn infant, let alone you?"
Old Man Xiao's mind was in turmoil!
How had that hand come, he hadn't noticed at all, and what was more terrifying was that his accumulated aura dissipated the moment the palm touched his shoulder.
Furthermore, a vast, unfathomable, and indescribable Splendid Heavenly Might gently landed on him, almost as if on his Divine Soul.
It gently landed, but for him, it felt like the ant faced the Splendid Heavenly Might!

chapters.title: Chapter 929 - 483: You may call me Taoist Ancestor
chapters.content:
Li Xuan gently patted Old Man Xiao's shoulder, his tone still warm, as if soothing a restless child, so natural and casual.
But for Old Man Xiao, at this moment, he felt as insignificant as an ant in the face of the Splendid Heavenly Might!
Even Taicang had never made him feel like this!
And Taicang is the foremost among The Seven Great Domain, with unimaginable strength.
Not just Taicang, even that one from the Imperishable Temple couldn't evoke such a feeling in him!
The person before him, his strength surpassed both Taicang and that one from the Imperishable Temple.
Such a powerful being, where did he come from?
The Land of Imperishable?
Does it have something to do with the Imperishable Temple?
Old Man Xiao's heart was filled with shock and bewilderment, his eyes wide open, looking at the man sitting in the chair, relaxed and even nibbling on a piece of cake.
The impression he gave off was like that of a spoiled young master with beautiful attendants at their beck and call!
But at this moment, Old Man Xiao's heart trembled, Xu Yan's words echoing in his mind, and for the moment, he somewhat believed that what Xu Yan said was true!
It was not mere boasting!
Xu Yan and the others watched as Old Man Xiao's vitality surged, his strength immensely powerful, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable seemed like an ant before him.
They were amazed at Old Man Xiao's strength, yet in the blink of an eye, the powerful aura dissipated.
Old Man Xiao didn't even finish his words and there was no follow-up.
Immediately after, they saw Old Man Xiao standing still, his body trembling slightly, his legs shaking as if he'd been scared witless!
Xu Yan couldn't help but click his tongue and muttered, "Master didn't do much to him, how come he's shaking? Old Man Xiao's courage seems a bit too small!"
Meng Chong and the others nodded in agreement!
