The Master's tone was gentle, he revealed no powerful aura, still relaxed and casual, simply smoothed out his own vitality, and yet that frightened him like this?
"This old man, strong as he is, just has too small a heart!"
Su Lingxiu said, shaking her head.
At this moment, Old Man Xiao had no mind to pay attention to the discussions of Xu Yan and the others, his heart trembling, forcing himself to calm down, but after a long while, he could not control the shock in his spirit.
The higher the realm, the broader the knowledge, the more one could comprehend the terror of it all!
"You, who are you?"
Old Man Xiao asked with a trembling voice.
"Little friend, be polite, do not panic, just keep a normal state of mind!"
Li Xuan still spoke in a warm tone.
All of a sudden, Old Man Xiao felt his shoulder being gently patted twice more.
He still couldn't perceive how the other party had patted him on the shoulder, and what was more terrifying was that his trembling heart gradually calmed down.
It was as if those two pats soothed the panic and unease in his heart.
Too terrifying!
What kind of strong being could do this!
Although Old Man Xiao's body was no longer shaking, and his spirit had calmed down, he still stood there in a daze, unsure of how to face the situation.
Li Xuan's face still bore a warm smile, calming Old Man Xiao's uneasy emotions with merely the use of his Divine Skills. With his strength, how could Old Man Xiao possibly resist the influence of his Divine Skills?
Taicang couldn't do it, because Taicang's Martial Arts were not up to the task!
He didn't possess Divine Skills as mysteriously and profoundly as his!
"You, are you a senior from the Land of Imperishable?"
Old Man Xiao's voice unconsciously became more respectful.
"Yes, and no."
Li Xuan said, smiling and shaking his head.
"May I ask how the senior should be addressed?"
Old Man Xiao mustered his courage and asked.
"My name bears too great a cause and effect, little friend, you cannot bear it."
Li Xuan replied with a light smile, the Taoist Ancestor Halo flickering into existence around him.
"If you must have a name to call me by, then you may refer to me as the Taoist Ancestor."
Taoist Ancestor!
Old Man Xiao felt as if thunderclaps were resonating in his mind, his spirit shaken, unable to calm down for a long time!
At that moment, he thought of something Taicang once said.
In the Chaotic Imperishable, as the Domain was opened, all things within the world, are subject to the untouchable, supreme laws of existence, with life and death and all mysterious and unpredictable powers contained within.
Just like his cultivation of Martial Arts, which all came from his comprehension of the profound, gaining tremendous fortune, and thus wisdom was born amidst the Chaos.
Having gone through endless years, he barely touched upon this path and has yet to stand upon it firmly or travel far!
What Taicang once spoke of was that invisible yet omnipresent, mysterious yet untouchable path.
Old Man Xiao's heart was filled with inexplicable astonishment; Taicang had yet to tread upon that path, yet the man before him professed himself the Taoist Ancestor!
What unfathomable existence was this!
Old Man Xiao was completely stunned, originally curious about Xu Yan's Master, wondering who it was that had plotted something, to have taught such a monstrous disciple.
But now, upon meeting him, he was profoundly shocked!
Taoist Ancestor?!
Old Man Xiao at this moment, felt somewhat out of his wits, as if his spirit had suffered a great impact, his mind buzzing with the words "Taoist Ancestor."
Looking at Li Xuan, the mystery beyond mystery, the unfathomable depth, one glance seemed to reveal the infinite paths of the world, the thought to question this dissolved before it could even arise.
At this instant, Old Man Xiao envisioned a figure in his mind.
Elegant and towering, gentle yet majestic, as if all things in the world were within his control, the world's Martial Arts seemed to be the traces he had left behind.
Taicang!
Though Taicang has perished, he allowed the Taicang Domain to prevail for long years till now, and that one from the Imperishable Temple has not appeared to seize the Taicang Domain.
In Old Man Xiao's heart, even though Taicang was defeated, he still surpassed that one from the Imperishable Temple.
It was just that Taicang lacked time.

chapters.title: Chapter 930 - 483: You May Call Me the Taoist Ancestor_2
chapters.content:
In that primordial chaos, how could a shadow, dark and invisible, compare to Taicang?
However, today, the invincibility of Taicang, the grandeur of Taicang, had received a strong shock in his heart!
He had seen someone, an existence far stronger than Taicang, and by a significant margin.
As if all the paths in this world were but footprints he had tread, and he was proclaimed the Taoist Ancestor!
Old Man Xiao momentarily found it difficult to bear this tremendous shock, feeling his beliefs crumble, his entire being in a daze.
"I want to be alone for a while!"
Old Man Xiao, in a daze, turned and left.
Xu Yan looked on in surprise, about to call Old Man Xiao back to ask him what was wrong.
But Li Xuan waved his hand and said, "Let this young friend have some quiet time alone."
Watching Old Man Xiao leave, Li Xuan smiled, reined in the Taoist Ancestor Halo, and reverted to his ordinary and plain appearance.
He understood Old Man Xiao's situation—he had encountered someone who was stronger, more imposing, and more unfathomable than the one in his beliefs and was momentarily unable to accept it.
Moreover, that person in his beliefs had a profound connection with him.
"As for Taicang,"
Li Xuan mused inwardly, although Taicang had died, his strength still became a martial artist's belief.
He looked up at the firmament. This domain was created by Taicang.
And Tian Zi was the remaining purple radiance from the creation of the world.
"If he hadn't created Tian Zi, Taicang might have been even stronger."
Li Xuan thought silently.
That streak of purple light held great creation.
The Seven Great Domain Masters each benefitted from the purple light's creation, creating their own domains, and the Minor Heaven and Earth Masters also obtained some purple light, though much less.
Because they benefitted from the purple light, they were able to create minor heavens and earths, hence they were called Minor Heaven and Earth Masters.
The three hundred realms of the Dao Domain were the minor heavens and earths of the past.
Those who came after, who did not benefit from the purple light, could only be called Realm Masters, not Minor Heaven and Earth Masters; there were some differences between the two after all.
Old Man Xiao was not a Minor Heaven and Earth Master, but a Realm Master.
He should be considered a martial artist who began training after people like Taicang, with Taicang essentially acting as his master.
"He's quite strong."
Li Xuan acknowledged Old Man Xiao's strength—he may not have benefitted from the purple light, but his strength was not weaker than that of a Minor Heaven and Earth Master, and was even stronger than some weaker Minor Heaven and Earth Masters.
"Too deeply influenced by Taicang."
Li Xuan wasn't worried that Old Man Xiao would become decadent from this; anyone who had cultivated to this realm would have an unwavering will. It was just the sudden shock that he found difficult to accept.
After some quiet time, he would naturally recover, and besides, Li Xuan's divine skills could continue to affect him, ensuring that no real issue arose in his mind.
With Old Man Xiao gone, there were no outsiders left, only familiar faces remained.
Su Lingxiu excitedly tugged on Xu Yan's sleeve, "Big Senior Brother, where's the dragon, the True Dragon?"
Fang Hao and the others also looked forward with anticipation.
"Right here!"
Xu Yan laughed heartily, retrieved the Prime Tortoise Carapace, and shifted Ao Yuxue out.
Ao Yuxue was in the midst of healing and recovery when she was suddenly brought forth, looking extremely aggrieved.
"Is this a True Dragon?"
Su Lingxiu looked on with surprise.
Her small hand touched the little horn on Ao Yuxue's head, her face full of curiosity.
Ao Yuxue's face flushed red, but she dared not show anger.
"Show your true form, let my junior brother and sisters have a look!"
Xu Yan commanded.
"You're bullying me too much—I'm not a monkey!"
Ao Yuxue protested with aggrievement.
"How about this, you show your true form, and my junior sister will treat your wounds."
Xu Yan thought for a moment and then said.
"This is the last time!"
Ao Yuxue knew she had no choice.
Ao!
The pristine True Dragon appeared in an instant, with its might pervading the air.
Even though Ao Yuxue restrained her aura, the might of the True Dragon still surged powerfully, fully exhibiting the majesty of the True Dragon.
"So this is a True Dragon!"
Su Lingxiu and the others exclaimed in amazement.
"Big Brother, can Yu Xiaolong, this Flood Dragon, transform into a dragon?"
Su Lingxiu thought of her Senior Brother's pet, Yu Xiaolong.
"Whether it can or cannot, I'm not certain either!"
Xu Yan shook his head.
Su Lingxiu reached out to touch Ao Yuxue's dragon body, her eyes shining brightly, which made Ao Yuxue feel somewhat panicked. The look in Su Lingxiu's eyes was as if she wanted to dissect her!
"What's your name?"
"Ao Yuxue!"
"Sister Yu Xue, how about we make a deal?"
Su Lingxiu said excitedly.
Ao Yuxue's heart tightened, and she instinctively felt that this deal probably wasn't going to be good.
"No, I won't do it!"
She hastily shook her head.
Then, she transformed back into her human form and even instinctively hid behind Xu Yan.
Xu Yan and the others all looked puzzled; Su Lingxiu wanted to study the body of a True Dragon, much like how she had studied the Sea Spirit Tribe before.
Su Lingxiu was somewhat disappointed, but not discouraged. Ao Yuxue would be staying here from now on; there would be many opportunities, and as long as the benefits were alluring enough, she was sure to agree.
After all, there was no danger involved.
Just like with Cai Ling'er before.
"These pills, take them, recover a bit. I see you've taken significant losses!"
Su Lingxiu handed a bottle of pills to Ao Yuxue.
Ao Yuxue hesitated for a moment before accepting them. Her sharp instinct told her that these pills would greatly benefit her recovery. She was overjoyed and also stunned by the miraculous effects of the pills.
After all, she knew that with her current losses, even if she returned to her clan, she would need to use many treasures and take a long time to recover.
Having seen a True Dragon, everyone grew curious about why Ao Yuxue fell into the Divine Realm and lost her sanity, causing chaos everywhere.
"Ever since I subdued you, I haven't asked you—how did you fall into the Divine Realm, and why did you cause such slaughter?"
Xu Yan asked solemnly.
The calamity of the True Dragon had caused quite a disturbance in the Divine Realm.
Although this was all part of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's conspiracy, Ao Yuxue was also a victim, yet she had indeed caused significant chaos.
Ao Yuxue said angrily, "Isn't it because of you despicable and shameless people, deceiving a young and ignorant me, trapping me in some unknown place, until I felt the aura of the Heavenly Tiger and unconsciously unleashed my Dragon Might."
"The energies of the dragon and tiger interwove, and somehow I fell down here, and that place was strange. I... I don't know, I was influenced."
"In my consciousness, I only had thoughts of killing and causing chaos, nothing else.
"If it wasn't for my subconscious feeling that it is wrong to kill the weak, and coupled with my Dragon Race's character, which granted me some control, I wouldn't have massacred indiscriminately, only targeting warriors above the Immortal Realm..."
The more Ao Yuxue spoke, the angrier and more wronged she felt, "You people, if you want to kill each other, kill each other, but why bring harm to me, and then try to pin the blame on me, it's too much to bully a dragon!"
"Who deceived you? How did they deceive you?"
Xu Yan mused for a moment before asking.
Ao Yuxue caused chaos and slaughter in the Divine Realm, killing many, but indeed she had not targeted warriors below the Immortal Realm; most were collateral damage.
Originally, it was thought that Ao Yuxue targeted only those of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable rank by choice, but it turned out that in her loss of sanity, due to the inherent pride of the True Dragon Clan, she disdained to strike against the weak. Thus, she controlled the extent of her havoc, killing only the strong.
"I left the Dragon Realm to have fun, and I encountered a few people in trouble. They pleaded for my help, and I softened my heart to help them. Who knew they would deceive me into a place I couldn't escape from..."
Ao Yuxue spoke, and could not help but let her Dragon Might ripple out, her anger flushing her face.
Xu Yan suddenly realized and asked, "Those people, were they Immortal Realm Warriors?"
"Yes!"
Ao Yuxue nodded!
This made sense of why Ao Yuxue harbored such a grudge against warriors of the Immortal Realm.
As Ao Yuxue recounted her experiences, Xu Yan and the others roughly understood the process. Ao Yuxue had been trapped for a long time, which wore down her patience and will, making her become irritable.
That place was special, and its atmosphere constantly infiltrated Ao Yuxue's body, coordinating with the collapse of the Dao Domain Ladder to drag down a whole realm from the Dao Domain.
Ao Yuxue, as a young dragon, had not experienced hardships before, and when faced with such a situation, how could she stand it? Naturally, she became ensnared, her will collapsed, and it was easy for her to be influenced and lose her sanity.
Her wariness was also insufficient, as before this incident, Ao Yuxue had been like a dragon in a greenhouse, having not faced malice or grievous harm!

chapters.title: Chapter 931 - 484: With a Light Snort, the Divine Venerate Disappears into Ashes and Smoke
chapters.content:
Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow targeted Ao Yuxue, choosing her to become the chess piece for the Unity of Domain. Aside from needing the True Dragon Qi as a primer, it's likely related to Ao Yuxue's identity as well.
"In the True Dragon Clan, your status is quite ordinary, isn't it?"
Xu Yan mused thoughtfully.
"My, my grandfather is the Master of the Dragon Realm, and I'm quite special. I'm the only Jade Snow True Dragon, Thunderbolt Ice Cold..."
Ao Yuxue hesitated before speaking.
Xu Yan and the others suddenly understood. No wonder they chose Ao Yuxue. Furthermore, Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow must have other profound intentions, needing to leverage Ao Yuxue to borrow strength from the Dragon Realm, even perhaps to plot something.
However, plans can't keep up with changes. Ao Yuxue was subdued by Xu Yan!
This implied that Xu Yan had disrupted the calculations of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow and would inevitably be targeted by the powerhouses of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, and equally, he had offended the True Dragon Clan.
In the eyes of the True Dragon Clan, this was a tremendously shameful disgrace!
"Why were you able to transform into a human?"
Xu Yan voiced his inner doubts.
The other Spirit Beasts and True Spirits seemed incapable of taking human form, so why could Ao Yuxue do it?
Or rather, why could the True Dragon Clan?
"It's the innate talent of my True Dragon Clan!"
Ao Yuxue boasted proudly.
"Master, why can the True Dragon Clan transform into human form?"
With questions, naturally one seeks answers from their master.
Thus, Xu Yan asked curiously.
"That little dragon seized a strand of purple light and left it behind for the Dragon Race, conferring the ability to transform into human form."
Li Xuan explained with a smile.
The True Dragon Clan's ability to transform into humans was not a mystery to Li Xuan. It was simply that the founder of the True Dragon Clan had used a strand of purple light on their own bloodline, allowing their descendants the ability to take human form.
The very first creature with intelligence that Taicang encountered was a True Dragon. Taicang's strength and the mysteries of Martial Arts caused a profound impact on that being.
This perhaps was also a reason why the True Dragon Clan's founder created the ability for transformation into human form.
"So that's how it is!"
Xu Yan and the others suddenly understood.
Ao Yuxue looked at Li Xuan, her face full of curiosity. Could this teacher of Xu Yan be very powerful indeed?
The "little dragon" he mentioned, could it be the ancestor who founded the True Dragon Clan?
"Would you like to go in and recuperate?"
Xu Yan took out the Prime Tortoise Carapace.
"I don't want to!"
Ao Yuxue shook her head!
Although it was like a Minor Heaven and Earth inside the Prime Tortoise Carapace, it was ultimately a closed space. Being inside was akin to imprisonment.
"Then find a place to stay yourself. Without permission, you cannot leave the Alchemical Medical Institute!"
Xu Yan nodded.
"I understand!"
Ao Yuxue walked away, understanding her situation.
Wu Tianan, Xin Mengrou, and Du Yuying, also respectfully took their leave.
At last, only the teacher and six disciples remained.
The five disciples reunited, which made Li Xuan feel greatly relieved. His efforts in creating Martial Arts were not in vain, as his disciples had finally become accomplished.
Especially his eldest disciple, Xu Yan, still continued to pave the way for the great undertaking of Martial Arts. He was now only half a step away from achieving perfection in the Void-breaking stage.
Not far from entering the Domain Realm.
Once in the Domain Realm, with Xu Yan's Divine Skills and Sword Dao, even encountering a Divine Venerate Realm Warrior, he would not be afraid.
If he made a breakthrough to Great Achievement in the Domain Realm, even a Supreme Sovereign Realm Warrior would not be a threat.
"The Establishing Dao Realm won't be too far away either."
Li Xuan was greatly relieved. Once one enters Establishing Dao, they are beings transcendent of the Heaven and Earth.
Xu Yan, Meng Chong, and Jiang Buping were sharing their experiences traveling through the Divine Realm.
"Master, this is what I found for you in the Sea Spirit Clan Treasure Vault."
Xu Yan took out the treasures he selected from the Sea Spirit Clan Treasure Vault.
A stone jar and a jade slip.
When Li Xuan saw them, his heart warmed even more, "I shall accept them."
With a gesture, the stone jar and jade slip landed in his palm.
The stone jar contained emerald leaves with veins like Prinicples and meaning lingering within.
"This tea leaf is quite good, far beyond what I currently drink as Spiritual Tea. This jar of tea leaves, even Tian Zi wouldn't consider it trash, would he?"
Li Xuan mused to himself.
The stone jar was forged from special materials not found within Heaven and Earth. Only in the Land of Imperishable could such material be found.
The person who made the stone jar was, at the least, a Minor Heaven and Earth Master.
Li Xuan saw through the substance of the stone jar in one glance.
The jade slip was even more extraordinary. The bamboo used to make the slip was more precious than the material of the stone jar.
"I have finished reading the Book of Taicang. It's just the right time to check out this jade slip to see what wonders and events it records."
Li Xuan revealed a satisfied smile.
Next, Xu Yan took out one precious gift after another, all for his junior brothers and sisters, each meticulously selected by him.
Meng Chong and Jiang Buping felt somewhat embarrassed.
"Master, although I took advantage of the Wanbao Alliance, the treasures I got are quite ordinary, far inferior to those of elder brother..."
Meng Chong spoke while taking out those treasures.
Jiang Buping did the same.
Li Xuan shook his head and smiled, "As for your teacher, such treasures are of no use. Keep them for yourselves. This jar of tea and the records in the jade slip will serve well to pass the time for your teacher."
"Master, your disciple understands!"
Meng Chong and Jiang Buping nodded solemnly.
With the master's realm, what treasures could catch his eye?
A jar of Spiritual Tea and a bamboo slip were just perfect for the leisurely Master to pass the time. Next time they came across such items, they should select some to take back and offer to the Master.
Indeed, the eldest senior brother was the one who understood the Master best. No wonder his strength had always been outrageously good, because he had perceived even more of the Dao from the Master!
Xu Yan, Meng Chong, and Jiang Buping, each shared their experiences in venturing through the Divine Realm, while Fang Hao and Su Lingxiu listened with envy, wishing they too could venture out and experience it for themselves.

chapters.title: Chapter 932 - 484: With a Light Snort, the Divine Venerate Disappears into Ashes and Smoke_2
chapters.content:
"Qinghua Sect has already stepped onto the right track, it will surely grow stronger and stronger. I, as the Sect Master of Qinghua Sect, shall also become renowned throughout the world during this era of great changes,"
Fang Hao said, full of anticipation.
"Humph, once the pills are promoted, who would dare not look up to me, the Alchemical Medical Fairy?"
Su Lingxiu's face lit up with excitement.
The mentor and disciple enjoyed their reunion, and ultimately, they couldn't avoid discussing matters of martial arts.
Li Xuan had reached the Establishing Dao Realm, a true powerhouse, so giving instruction to the disciple in martial arts and Divine Skills was naturally no problem.
The Divine Skill Martial Code was almost perfected, with nearly all three thousand Great Divine Powers documented.
With the disciple present, it was the perfect time to give guidance on martial arts.
Xu Yan and four others had respectful expressions and successively asked about their doubts concerning martial arts, and Li Xuan gave guidance to each of them.
Emperor Da Yue's imperial capital had been renamed to Qinghua Spirit City, serving as the headquarters of the Qinghua Sect.
After a major expansion, Qinghua City had long surpassed what the former Emperor Da Yue's imperial city used to be. The original Da Yue Abyss had been incorporated into the city, becoming a crucial location for the Alchemical Medical lineage.
Old Man Xiao, in a wandering daze, walked through Qinghua City and unknowingly arrived at the location of the Da Yue Abyss.
"What is this?"
Old Man Xiao's face showed a look of shock.
This place should have been a Heavenly Grotto, but now it seemed to have turned into a furnace.
What shocked him even more was that inside the Heavenly Grotto, it seemed as though several mini-furnaces had been set up, with Martial Artists investing Spiritual Medicine and Divine Medicine into them, refining something.
This method of refinement was something he had never seen before.
Seeing the pills that were refined, Old Man Xiao was astounded. This method of pill making was far superior to any existing pharmaceutical methods known in Taicang.
Using ingredients of the same grade and refining them according to a certain pattern seemed to induce a transformation, the effectiveness of which was more than tenfold the pills produced by the existing pill-making methods of Taicang.
Subconsciously, Old Man Xiao moved closer to one of the pill-refining furnaces, silently observing. With his strength, the Alchemy Martial Artists of the Evergreen Pavilion naturally failed to notice anything odd.
Suddenly, Old Man Xiao turned his attention towards the core of the Heavenly Grotto and was once again shocked.
That place, originally an entrance for enemies from beyond, which should have been the gateway for the Netherworld Domain to invade, had actually become a site that gathered otherworldly essences and the Qi of the Netherworld Domain, and furthermore, the Power of Domain Laws descended from above.
They were actually using Domain Laws to integrate the otherworldly essence and the Qi of the Netherworld Domain to refine some sort of pill!
And such a pill, with its potent effects, could assist warriors from the Immortal Realm and even the Heavenly Union Realm in their cultivation.
"What a marvelous technique!"
At that moment, Old Man Xiao couldn't help but exclaim in admiration.
His previously fluttering spirits gradually calmed down.
"Taoist Ancestor?!"
Mutters of this title to himself, Old Man Xiao deeply felt its strength and profound meaning at this moment.
"Although Teacher Taicang was strong, he ultimately met his demise. Not having fully explored the Chaotic Imperishable Land, it's not strange that mightier beings might exist,"
With that thought, Old Man Xiao came to a resolution.
That Taicang was no match for the Taoist Ancestor was not unacceptable.
The Land of Imperishable, boundless and vast, who could know what exists might lurk within?
Just like the Imperishable Temple, it too emerged from some corner of the Land of Imperishable, drawing close to The Seven Great Domain.
"Perhaps, I should seek counsel from the Taoist Ancestor about the path ahead?"
Old Man Xiao pondered to himself.
He was already a Realm Master, and in terms of strength, some weaker Minor Heaven and Earth Masters were no match for him.
Of course, since those Minor Heaven and Earth Masters had once obtained the Open Heaven Purple Light, even if they were weaker than him, the difference wasn't significant, plus they had incredibly strong self-preservation abilities, making them difficult to kill.
What he lacked was that very Open Heaven Purple Light.
Without this Open Heaven Purple Light, Old Man Xiao felt he had reached a peak in his journey.
As for becoming the Master of the Taicang Domain, that wasn't so easy to achieve. The plots of Heavenly Slaughter and some others were doomed to come to naught.
Old Man Xiao exited from the Heavenly Grotto, looking in the direction of Li Xuan and hesitated whether to go see him right away to seek guidance regarding his martial arts future.
Suddenly, Old Man Xiao's expression froze as he turned to look in a particular direction.
Four figures traversed the wilderness, heading straight for Qinghua City and, in the blink of an eye, it seemed as if they had locked onto their target, heading directly for the Alchemical Medical Institute.
"Lackeys of Heavenly Slaughter?"
Old Man Xiao's expression darkened, sensing that his opportunity had arrived.
It was the perfect time to annihilate Heavenly Slaughter's lackeys, to show zeal for the Taoist Ancestor, gain the Taoist Ancestor's favor, and thus, naturally seek counsel from him.
With this in mind, Old Man Xiao was secretly delighted.
"Heavenly Slaughter, your lackeys arrived at the perfect time,"
Old Man Xiao thought excitedly, his face revealing a faint smile.
Taking a step forward, his aura unnoticeable, he rushed over in an instant, intending to annihilate Heavenly Slaughter's lackeys with the force of a thunderbolt, to demonstrate his zeal for the Taoist Ancestor and leave a good impression.
Inside the Alchemical Medical Institute, Li Xuan was instructing his apprentice in the martial arts.
Xu Yan and his four companions were immersed in their master's explanation of the martial arts, finding enlightenment in moments of confusion, and even understanding some of the previously unclear Divine Skill Techniques through his guidance.
Especially regarding innate Divine Skills, how to make them stronger, and how to unleash their unique Divine Skill Power, they had reaped no small benefits.
Suddenly!
Four powerful auras surged forth, shocking all the martial artists in Qinghua City.
Emperor Da Yue's figure emerged, his face filled with horror as he looked towards the four unexpected figures. Even though he had broken through to the Heavenly Union Realm, he felt as insignificant as an ant under this pressure.
"What is this?"
Emperor Da Yue's expression was one of shock. From where did such mighty martial artists come?
Could they have descended from the Dao Realm?
But the fallen realm had not yet merged with the Divine Realm, and the tremors of the Divine Realm's Domain continued unabated, so warriors of the Dao Realm should not be able to descend.
"The Divine Realm, hiding such strong beings?"
Emperor Da Yue quickly realized that these four strong figures were heading straight for the Alchemical Medical Institute with a very clear target!
At this moment, he felt somewhat ashamed.
"Qinghua Sect is too weak. When facing a strong enemy, we need the Taoist Ancestor himself to take action."
These four people heading for the Alchemical Medical Institute were clearly targeting Xu Yan and his companions, who had recently returned and earned tremendous fame, and were now staying at the residence of the Taoist Ancestor.
"Divine Venerate warriors?"
Xu Yan and the others looked up.
The aura of these four individuals was extraordinarily powerful, well beyond what warriors of the Heavenly Union Realm should possess, clearly indicating that they were Divine Venerate Realm warriors.
People from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow!
"Are they coming for me?"
Xu Yan immediately understood that they were targeting him, for the Subduing Dragon Technique.
Ao Yuxue, who had been recuperating, walked out of her room.
Wu Tianan, Xin Mengrou, and the others did the same.
"Xu Yan..."
One of the four Divine Venerate warriors fixed his gaze on Xu Yan and spoke coldly.
Li Xuan looked up indifferently, as if his instruction in martial arts to his apprentice had been interrupted, a trace of displeasure in his heart.
"Here comes my chance!"
Old Man Xiao was thrilled beyond words.
Heavenly Slaughter was such a good guy, sending him such a perfect opportunity.
He was about to unleash his aura and suppress the four individuals, vehemently rebuke them for daring to disturb the peace of the Taoist Ancestor, and then wipe them out with a thunderous move!
But before he could unleash his aura, he heard a light snort.
"Humph!"
A light snort. The sound wasn't loud, nor was it directed at Old Man Xiao.
But Old Man Xiao felt his scalp tingle, his eyes widened in terror, and cold sweat almost broke out.
With just a light dissatisfied snort from the Taoist Ancestor, the four arrogantly powerful Divine Venerate warriors turned to ash and dissipated in an instant.
As if all traces of their existence in the world had been erased!
Gulp!
Old Man Xiao swallowed hard, too shocked to speak. He was full of regret, lamenting that he had been too slow to act!
He missed such a great opportunity!
He dared not stay floating in the air any longer; if the Taoist Ancestor found him floating there and annoying, a light hum from him would turn him into ash, too.
He hastily landed on the ground and respectfully bent over in shame, saying, "Xiaoyao is slow and failed to promptly expel the disturber for the Taoist Ancestor. I am ashamed!"
Li Xuan's smile was warm as he said, "Young friend, there's no need for shame."
Hearing this, Old Man Xiao felt even more embarrassed, and he bent even lower.
Wu Tianan, Xin Mengrou, and the others also came over.
Four Divine Venerate warriors, fierce and immensely powerful, yet they were no more significant than ants in the presence of their senior!
Their senior truly was unfathomable, the genuine invincible being.
The Taoist Ancestor!
In that moment, this title sprang to their minds!
They felt even more profoundly the significance encompassed by this title!

chapters.title: Chapter 933 - 485: Wu Tianan's Fortune, Taimiao's Bewilderment
chapters.content:
```
"Since you've all come, let me explain some of the doubts in Martial Arts today," Li Xuan said with a gentle smile as he glanced at everyone.
"Thank you, senior!" The crowd was overjoyed.
Emperor Da Yue had just arrived with Wu Tianan and others. His heart was even more excited now, for he had once again grasped an opportunity!
Cai Ling'er was serving by Li Xuan's side. Being a maid, she naturally didn't have questions about cultivation at this time, as she had plenty of opportunities to ask.
Such are the benefits of being a personal maid!
Cai Ling'er felt wise about her decision.
No one was happier than Old Man Xiao—he had the chance to consult with a Taoist Ancestor!
Of course, he didn't step forward to ask first. He decided to wait until the end to consult with the Taoist Ancestor about his doubts in Martial Arts.
After all, he had the highest realm and the strongest power among those seeking advice.
Ao Yuxue tiptoed over and stood coquettishly behind Xu Yan, curiously sizing up Xu Yan's master.
So strong!
She felt her grandfather might not be a match at all.
In this way, she could no longer escape Xu Yan's control, becoming a dragon truly subdued by him.
Ao Yuxue wondered if she should take this opportunity to ask some questions.
What should she ask?
Her True Dragon Clan, possessing its own True Dragon Technique, had it from birth, unlike Martial Artists who cultivate. Even if they cultivated, the way of the True Dragon Clan's strength was different from the Human Clan's.
"Should I ask how not to be subdued by the Subduing Dragon Technique?"
Ao Yuxue thought this question might not garner an answer if she asked it.
After all, the Subduing Dragon Technique was taught by Xu Yan's master, and she was asking his master how not to be subdued?
"So, what should I seize this opportunity to ask?" Ao Yuxue pondered with knitted brows.
Li Xuan smiled and asked, "Who has a question about Martial Arts?"
"I am the weakest here; let me ask our senior first," Moon Changming stepped forward and said respectfully.
Li Xuan nodded. Moon Changming was about to break through to the Immortal Realm, and his doubts about Martial Arts were easily answerable.
Among those present, only Old Man Xiao's doubts carried a hint of complexity, but for Li Xuan, they were likewise easily addressed.
The higher the realm, the more mystical the guidance needed to be, letting them enlighten themselves!
That was Li Xuan's philosophy!
After guiding Moon Changming, it was Feng Yan's turn.
Feng Yan's doubts were about Divine Skills; after Li Xuan's guidance, the Divine Skills that Feng Yan had been unable to break through suddenly advanced, and he was exceptionally excited.
Emperor Da Yue also promptly presented his confusions, which Li Xuan addressed one by one.
Among the crowd, Zi Yun, Du Yuying, and Yun Miaomiao, the three women, did not raise any doubts, which didn't surprise Li Xuan—they were saving their questions for their beloved.
Finally, Wu Tianan spoke up.
"Senior, I feel my destiny is somewhat unusual and I am quite puzzled about it," Wu Tianan asked respectfully.
Old Man Xiao immediately perked up. He too was curious about Wu Tianan's destiny, suspecting it might be related to the Taoist Ancestor, as Wu Tianan had received guidance from him.
Li Xuan smiled and said, "You possess the fortune of this Domain, and are protected by the fortune of this Domain. Naturally, you can turn dangers into safety and cultivate with ease."
Carrying the fortune of the Domain?
Protected by the fortune of the Domain?
Everyone present was astonished. Why was Wu Tianan so favored by the Domain?
Shouldn't Xu Yan and the others be more favored by the Domain?
After all, they were the true monstrous talents of the Domain.
"Senior, what does this mean?" Wu Tianan was also confused and said, "In the Inner Domain and the Spiritual Realm, although I've turned dangers into opportunities, I never felt such a strong destiny; otherwise, the Martial Arts Institute wouldn't have fallen."
"Only after entering the Divine Realm did the destiny within you truly become stimulated, and your Martial Arts also improved. Naturally, you now have this destiny. In a certain sense, you can be called a child of destiny.
"Now that the Domain faces great changes, it's also your chance to rise. The Supreme Sovereign Realm is not an extravagant hope for you," Li Xuan explained with a smile.
Everyone was amazed. With the senior saying this, it meant that Wu Tianan's cultivation to the Supreme Sovereign Realm was practically guaranteed.
"Breaking through the shackles of the Supreme Sovereign and achieving Realm Master or even becoming a Minor Heaven and Earth master, you also have a fair chance. Of course, this does not depend on you alone," Li Xuan added.
Old Man Xiao's face was struck with shock. Could Wu Tianan possibly become a Realm Master, or even a Minor Heaven and Earth Master?
Was it because of his Domain fortune?
In the Taicang Domain, the Supreme Sovereign Realm was truly at the top, and there weren't many Realm Masters.
To break through the Realm Master Realm and even become a Minor Heaven and Earth Master wasn't so simple. Without immense opportunities or monstrous talents, it's impossible to break through.
And while Wu Tianan's talent was not bad, it wasn't monstrous.
In fact, if it weren't for carrying the Domain fortune, and considering his talent alone, Wu Tianan probably could only cultivate up to the Divine Venerate Realm.
Old Man Xiao almost couldn't resist asking why Wu Tianan had a fair chance of breaking through to become a Realm Master, or even a Minor Heaven and Earth Master.
But he held back in the end, not wanting to leave a bad impression on the Taoist Ancestor.
Therefore, even if he was as curious as a cat scratching at his heart, he had to silently endure it.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 934 - 485: Wu Tianan's Fortune, Taimiao's Bewilderment_2
chapters.content:
"Senior, where does my destiny come from?"
Wu Tianan himself was quite astonished and had an incredulous look on his face.
Li Xuanle chuckled and said, "Your Martial Arts mentor!"
Upon hearing this, everyone became curious.
Old Man Xiao also knew that Wu Tianan had been seeking someone, his Martial Arts mentor. He had thought about asking him, but Old Man Xiao felt that the person Wu Tianan was looking for could hardly be someone he knew.
Therefore, he did not pay it much attention.
Now, he suddenly had a strong premonition that the person Wu Tianan was looking for might be someone in the Dao Realm!
Who could it possibly be, possessing such capability?
In Old Man Xiao's mind, some figures appeared, none possessing the ability to grant Wu Tianan the destiny of Domain.
"Could it be him?"
At a certain moment, Old Man Xiao thought of that individual who was locked up somewhere by Teacher Taicang.
Apart from him, there seemed to be no second person with such capability.
Xu Yan and a few others knew that Wu Tianan's Martial Arts mentor was a woman whom Wu Tianan had been continuously searching for. They had never imagined that his Martial Arts mentor could have such capabilities?
If so powerful, why had she been injured and fallen to the Inner Domain in the first place?
"Is it Sister?"
Wu Tianan was taken aback and astonished, then immediately said hurriedly, "Senior, do you know where my sister is?"
Upon hearing this, Old Man Xiao became puzzled again.
Wu Tianan's Martial Arts mentor was a woman, and obviously, it could not be that fellow.
"Who could it be?"
In his mind, images of various strong women appeared, yet none possessed this ability.
Li Xuan looked up, pointed at the firmament, and smiled, "When the time comes, you will naturally meet her!"
Wu Tianan was shocked, his Martial Arts mentor, and sister, was actually in the Dao Realm?
Old Man Xiao felt as if his heart was being scratched by a cat's paw, he racked his brain but could not think of anyone who fit the description of Wu Tianan's Martial Arts mentor, who had the power to bless him with the destiny of Domain.
Wanting to speak, yet feeling it impolite to interrupt and possibly displease the Taoist Ancestor, he was quite uncomfortable holding it in.
Li Xuan looked over, chuckled, and said, "Speak what you want to say."
Old Man Xiao was really uncomfortable holding it in.
"Thank you, Senior."
Old Man Xiao was extremely excited and said, "I am somewhat puzzled. Within this Domain, and being a female Martial Artist, I do not know of anyone with such power. I would ask senior to clarify."
Li Xuan nodded and said, "It is reasonable for you to be puzzled because his destiny of Domain was granted by a certain Supreme Treasure, not because the granter herself held such capability."
Upon hearing this, Old Man Xiao was stunned for a moment, then immediately two figures appeared in his mind.
The only entities capable of bestowing others with the destiny of Domain are Supreme Treasures that only a Master of Domain can forge, undoubtedly, anyone possessing such a treasure must have a close relationship with Teacher Taicang.
Among the many female Martial Artists, currently, only two had this possibility.
"Could it be her?"
Old Man Xiao was deep in thought.
"I understand now!"
Old Man Xiao respectfully bowed and said.
Wu Tianan felt as if his heart was being scratched by a cat's paw. Old Man Xiao came from the Dao Realm, could he know his sister?
However, now was not the time to inquire; he could only suppress the urge in his heart for the moment.
Li Xuan resolved Wu Tianan's perplexity and gave him guidance on Martial Arts Cultivation, especially the Divine Skill Technique.
After guiding Wu Tianan, Xin Mengrou respectfully bowed and said, "Please give me some guidance as well, Senior."
Li Xuan smiled and nodded.
Xin Mengrou was cultivating the Illusionary Path, initially his rather mysterious guidance had given her some insights, but now Xin Mengrou had clearly received more detailed guidance and acquired a more complete understanding of the Illusionary Path Technique.
But there were still some problems.
The art that seems true yet illusory is similar to an illusion technique yet transcends beyond, embarking on a unique Illusionary Path.
Li Xuan was no longer the person he had been initially, for in that instant, he perceived the core of the issue with just a glance.
"The enemy is an illusion, oneself is an illusion, a thought births illusion, a thought annihilates illusion; transform the enemy into an illusion, and when the illusion perishes, the enemy naturally perishes too; transform oneself into an illusion, as unreal as a dream, untouched by the enemy's intrusions..."
Li Xuan smiled lightly and began to speak in his profound and meaningful manner, offering guidance before pointing out some deficiencies in her Illusionary Path and ways to remedy and enhance it.
"Thank you, senior, for enlightening me!"
Xin Mengrou was incredibly excited.
Soon after, she hesitated as if she still had something to say.
"If you have any doubts, feel free to speak!"
Li Xuan said with a smile.
"Senior, only under the guidance of the Tai Miao Taoist Ancestor did the junior truly step into the Illusionary Path, but the Tai Miao Taoist Ancestor too had some troubles, once asking the junior to consult with the senior on a few matters..."
Xin Mengrou spoke respectfully.
"If you have any questions, just speak up."
Li Xuan nodded.
Tai Miao?
One of Taicang's followers, a Minor Heaven and Earth Master, her power is not comparable to that of an ordinary Realm Master.
Old Man Xiao seemed thoughtful. Tai Miao had been caught in internal contradictions and conflicts, causing continuous strife within the Tai Miao Realm, even leading to fratricide.
Could it be that she had emerged from her internal contradictions?
"Yes, senior!"
Xin Mengrou took a deep breath and said, "The Tai Miao Taoist Ancestor cultivates two major cultivation techniques, one called Taiwan Miao Illusionary Path and the other Tai Miao Supreme Path; the Illusionary Path is elusive and intangible, while the Supreme Path is domineering and overlooks the world.
However, ever since a certain great battle, the ancestor has been caught in the conflict between the two..."
Tai Miao cultivates both the Illusionary Path and the Supreme Path, where one is mystical and elusive, hard to grasp, and the other is domineering, unparalleled, proudly manifesting the majesty of the Supreme!
The differences in their martial paths have thrown her into internal conflict; in short, she had fallen into a martial conflict and could even be described as caught in devilment!
Of course, all of this was related to the great battle she encountered, creating this mental knot, even becoming a heart demon.
That battle, evidently, was the fight previously between Taicang and the strong ones from the Imperishable Temple.
"The ancestor said that in the battle, she felt powerless, unable to save her friend or even offer minor help. She thought that if the Illusionary Path had been strong enough, perhaps it could have assisted her friend then.
"But, the ancestor also felt that the Supreme Path, with its unparalleled killing power, was stronger. If the Supreme Path had been stronger, it might have helped her friend withstand numerous attacks..."
Xin Mengrou spoke softly.
This was the essence of Tai Miao's contradiction and her mental knot.
That battle had plunged her into internal conflict; she felt that if the Illusionary Path had been stronger, she could have bewildered the enemy, providing her friend with an opportunity to counterattack or even escape.
Yet at the same time, she also felt that if the Supreme Path had been strong enough, with its unparalleled combat power, it could have directly shielded her friend from more attacks, joining forces with her friend, and perhaps they could have achieved final victory.
It was for these reasons that she fell into the contradiction between the Illusionary Path and the Supreme Path.
This was both a conflict of her martial path and a mental knot, and that friend, it was likely Taicang.
Li Xuan thought silently to himself.
Old Man Xiao listened silently, his expression quite complex.
"Senior, this is the problem of the ancestor. Please enlighten us."
After Xin Mengrou finished narrating, she bowed respectfully.
The reason Tai Miao sought consultation was as Xin Mengrou mentioned, due to the profound senior who had once given her some guidance, allowing her Illusionary Path to take a different, small step forward, making it her own unique Illusionary Path.
It was for this reason that Tai Miao had her ask for some advice on her behalf.
The root cause was still Tai Miao's long-standing confusion and unresolved mental knot. Although her internal conflict had lessened, beginning to smooth over the contradictions between the Illusionary Path and the Supreme Path, the issue still remained unresolved.
With her strength, having Xin Mengrou seek guidance on her behalf was somewhat akin to a desperate attempt in trying something out of a despairing situation.
Li Xuan did not immediately answer, but turned to Old Man Xiao and asked, "Do you have anything you want to say?"
Old Man Xiao sighed, saying, "Senior, Tai Miao's contradiction originated from that battle, but the root cause still lies with Master Taicang."
After a pause, Old Man Xiao continued, "The Illusionary Path and the Supreme Path were both taught by Master Taicang. That is Tai Miao's path, and her feelings for Master Taicang run very deep..."
Old Man Xiao sighed wistfully, bowing respectfully, "She has been caught in her internal contradictions for a very long time, and I hope the Taoist Ancestor senior can resolve her confusion."

chapters.title: Chapter 935 - 486: Asking the Taoist Ancestor for Guidance
chapters.content:
Tai Miao Illusionary Path and Supreme Sovereign Path, one illusory and one real, can also be viewed as one soft and one hard, seemingly independent of each other, yet they should be one and the same.
"The Illusionary Path and the Supreme Sovereign Path both originate from Taicang, so it seems that Taicang has come up with new ideas for Martial Arts,"
Li Xuan had to admit that Taicang was indeed formidable.
However, since Tai Miao was caught in the contradiction between the Illusionary Path and Supreme Sovereign Path, it was clear that Taicang only had a new idea but had not perfected it, possibly due to other reasons, and had perished before it could be perfected.
Looking towards Xin Mengrou, Li Xuan smiled and said, "Why bother with self-contradiction? Be it Illusionary or Supreme, they are ultimately just methods of cultivating Martial Arts.
"The Illusionary Path and the Supreme Sovereign Path can exist independently as one and naturally can also merge into one."
"Illusionary is illusory, Supreme is real; illusory is soft, real is hard; soft is Yin, hard is Yang, this is the eternal cycle of Yin Yang..."
After attributing the concept of Yin Yang to the Illusionary Path and Supreme Sovereign Path, Li Xuan looked around at the attendees and declared, "The path of Yin Yang conforms to the natural order, solitary Yin does not thrive, sole Yang does not give birth, Yin Yang is intrinsic to nature, thus facilitating endless life.
Yet in this nature, Yin and Yang are in disorder, and reincarnation lacks its path..."
Old Man Xiao and the others listened reverently, engrossed in the explanation of the grand Yin Yang philosophy by a Taoist Ancestor.
If they could grasp even a fraction of it, it would be a great opportunity!
After elaborating on the path of Yin and Yang, Li Xuan smiled again and said, "The path of Yin and Yang may seem too profound for you, but knowing the concept of Yin and Yang will ultimately be beneficial."
Finally, turning to Xin Mengrou, he said, "If you wish to unify Illusionary with Supreme in terms of Yin and Yang, the distance is too vast, and it won't be comprehended in a short time.
"Tell that young girl, the heart is Supreme, the intent is Illusionary; having both the intent of Supreme and the heart of Illusionary..."
Xin Mengrou muttered to herself, "The heart is Supreme, the intent is Illusionary? Having both the intent of Supreme and the heart of Illusionary..."
In a trance, she seemed to realize something but was still somewhat unclear.
"Thank you, senior, for clearing my confusion!"
Xin Mengrou respectfully bowed.
Old Man Xiao marveled internally, worthy of being a Taoist Ancestor, in just a few words, he elucidated profound principles and directed Tai Miao through its conflict.
"Tai Miao, if it integrates Illusionary with Supreme, its strength would advance further."
Old Man Xiao sighed with emotion.
Now, it was his turn to ask something. What doubt should he inquire about?
Old Man Xiao pondered, as the recent exposition on the path of Yin and Yang had cleared some of his doubts about the universe, leaving him questionless.
However, he still hadn't found his path forward.
Taking a deep breath, Old Man Xiao was about to respectfully speak and seek guidance from the Taoist Ancestor when he saw Ao Yuxue, looking timid, step out from behind Xu Yan.
"Senior, may I ask a question?"
Ao Yuxue asked timidly.
Li Xuan smiled joyfully, Ao Yuxue transformed into human form, pretty and charming, quite likable indeed.
"What would you like to ask?"
Li Xuan asked with a smile.
This girl, she wouldn't be asking how not to be subdued, would she?
Or, how to break free from the control of the Subduing Dragon Seal?
Ao Yuxue, feeling nervous, clenched her clothes at the corner and glanced at Xu Yan before timidly saying, "He used a Martial Arts technique called Subduing Dragon Palm to overcome the stronger by being weaker and subdued me. I want to ask, can I also practice the Subduing Dragon Palm?"
Li Xuan was taken aback, never expecting Ao Yuxue to ask such a question.
Xu Yan and the others were also stunned.
Subduing Dragon Palm was one of Xu Yan's exclusive skills.
Besides the Sword Dao, it was his strongest Martial Art. Even though it fundamentally targeted the subduing of dragons, the power of the Subduing Dragon Palm was immensely strong.
And here was Ao Yuxue, a True Dragon, asking if she could practice Subduing Dragon Palm?
This technique was meant to subdue True Dragons, and here you are, a True Dragon, wanting to practice it?
Ao Yuxue felt the astonished and incredulous stares of everyone, growing even more nervous, her cheeks blushing slightly, her hands still clutching the fabric of her clothes, looking timid and weak.
After contemplating for a long while, she finally figured out what she wanted to inquire about.
"Subduing Dragon Palm, a palm technique to subdue us, True Dragons. If I were to practice it, as a True Dragon, wouldn't it make me invincible within the True Dragon Clan?"
The more she thought about it, the more excited Ao Yuxue became, immediately deciding to ask this question.
Li Xuan looked bemused, wondering how this girl's thought process worked.
Glancing at Xu Yan and then at Ao Yuxue, he couldn't help but chuckle and said, "Why do you have this idea?"
Ao Yuxue glanced again at Xu Yan, saw no signs of anger on his face, and felt slightly relieved before timidly saying, "Junior thinks that since the Subduing Dragon Palm can subdue dragons, if I, this True Dragon, also master it, wouldn't I be invincible within the True Dragon Clan? Could I suppress all the dissident True Dragons?"
Ao Yuxue's cheeks were blushing as she clutched her clothes, her eyes full of hope as she said, "Senior, I am a True Dragon; can I also practice the Subduing Dragon Palm?"
This question had never crossed Li Xuan's mind.
Initially, the Subduing Dragon Palm was all made up; he hadn't thought so deeply about it.
He too pondered for a moment whether a True Dragon could practice the Subduing Dragon Palm?
After a brief pause, he had his answer.
After all, he had acquired the way of the Subduing Dragon, and like a mighty dragon, it coiled within his Primordial Spirit.
Thus, Li Xuan said with a smile, "The Subduing Dragon Palm is a technique for subduing dragons by a dragon. A True Dragon, theoretically, can practice it, especially since you, a True Dragon, can transform into human form, naturally you can practice."
"However, being able to practice doesn't necessarily mean you will succeed in mastering it, understand its insights, or be able to execute it."

chapters.title: Chapter 936 - 486: Asking the Taoist Ancestor for Guidance_2
chapters.content:
"Everything ultimately depends on talent and perception."
Ao Yuxue's eyes expressed joy as she nodded and said, "Thank you, senior, I understand now."
Li Xuan had thought that the young girl would take the opportunity to ask him to teach her the Subduing Dragon Palm's cultivation methods. However, she did not do so, but timidly retreated behind Xu Yan.
"Interesting!"
Li Xuan was amused. Clearly, the girl had become much shrewder after experiencing a vicious beating once.
Looking at her expression, she probably wanted to ask Xu Yan for guidance on the cultivation methods of Subduing Dragon Palm. Whether Xu Yan would teach her or not was something Li Xuan would not interfere with.
The disciple had already grown strong, and being no longer a newcomer in martial arts, it was time for independence; as a mentor, Li Xuan would not interfere.
Everyone looked at Ao Yuxue with odd expressions, for the question she asked exceeded everyone's expectations.
Old Man Xiao wore a strange expression. Could this young girl be considering becoming the chief of the True Dragon Clan?
Could it be that she intended to force her grandfather, Ao Lie, to abdicate?
As this was a matter internal to the True Dragon Clan, Old Man Xiao naturally cared little for it.
He excitedly and respectfully bowed, saying, "Taoist Ancestor, junior has a doubt in the martial arts and deeply hopes for your guidance!"
Li Xuan nodded and said, "Speak freely!"
As for what Old Man Xiao intended to inquire, Li Xuan had already made a guess.
Old Man Xiao was a Realm Master with formidable strength, but he was not a Minor Heaven and Earth Master, and his power had also peaked.
A Minor Heaven and Earth Master is achieved through the creation granted by the purple light.
Old Man Xiao, having cultivated to this point, had theoretically reached his limit, unless, like the early Taicang and others, he obtained creation from the purple light which could push him further, to become a Master of Domain.
However, it seemed that there was only one such strand of purple light, having appeared just once.
In the long lives of Taicang and his peers, they had experienced this only once, seeing that singular strand of purple light.
"Senior, in my cultivation up to now, I see no path ahead. Not just me, other Realm Masters feel the same. To break through these bonds, to reach the state that Taicang teacher and the others achieved, seems impossible now.
"The seven people of Taicang, in the Chaotic Imperishable Land, got the purple light which started heaven and earth, becoming Masters of Domain.
"If this junior wants to advance further, is it only possible by finding that mysterious purple light?"
Old Man Xiao asked respectfully.
The rest listened silently; this was a secret of the cosmos, touching upon the mysteries of the existence of this world.
Xu Yan, hearing Old Man Xiao's question, thought deeply, somewhat understanding the fundamental difference between the martial arts taught by his master and the Taicang Domain Martial Arts.
Old Man Xiao, having cultivated to his current state, found it difficult to advance further; to put it accurately, there was no road ahead!
"The master repeatedly emphasized, 'Martial Arts Endless Realm, since it's endless, how can there be no path ahead?' Therefore, Taicang Martial Arts is flawed, and when I previously called it a pseudo-martial art, it wasn't entirely unreasonable.
"According to Old Man Xiao, opening heaven and earth by obtaining the purple light—he has no purple light, thus his cultivation stagnated, and he sees no path ahead.
"But the martial arts my master has passed on to me are without such restrictions, the path ahead always exists. It all depends on talent and effort, one can only continue moving forward."
Xu Yan thought of the Domain Realm, embodying heaven and earth; isn't that what it means to create heaven and earth?
With this thought, Xu Yan knew that once he broke through to the Domain Realm, he would completely leave the Taicang Martial Arts behind, which is why even a minor advancement within the Domain Realm brings such tremendous increase in strength.
The full accomplishment of the Domain Realm is already comparable to the Supreme Sovereign Realm of Taicang Martial Arts.
From the Domain Realm onward, the two paths became incomparable. While the path of Taicang Martial Arts was nearing its end, the journey of the Domain Realm was just the true beginning of the martial arts path.
After all, only the Establishing Dao Realm qualifies one to establish and pass on the Dao, which is the real enlightenment in martial arts!
Xu Yan thought of this, feeling secretly thrilled. He was not far from the Domain Realm, and he was bound to break through within three to five years. Once he achieved the Domain Realm, he would truly be firmly established on the path of martial arts.
Li Xuan's aura of the Taoist Ancestor shimmered faintly around him, as if the great Dao was looming, his voice calm yet echoing like the sound of the great Dao.
Old Man Xiao's question was something Li Xuan had anticipated.
"The road of Taicang, explored from chaos and blessed by the purple light, thus opened the heaven and earth. You, the successors, all view Taicang as the peak, so how can you surpass Taicang?"
"Martial Arts Endless Realm, how could the path ahead be cut off?"
"You think the path ahead is cut off merely because you lack talent and insight, and thus you are confused."
"Of course, that's not the key point. The key point is that the Taicang Martial Arts did not continue, and naturally, you could see no path ahead."
Old Man Xiao looked desolate; he understood what the Taoist Ancestor meant. Since Taicang had died, the Taicang Martial Arts had not continued to advance, and thus, they, these people, naturally could not break through their shackles.
Taicang was the peak of this Martial Arts, and those who came after would have to surpass that peak unless their talent and intellect exceeded Taicang.
But, who could do that?
Li Xuan continued, "Purple light is not the only one, the Master of Domain is not the only way to advance. The Master of Domain, although quite powerful, is also bound by the domain."
"To have oneself as the domain, the heart as the domain, the self as the domain, one can transcend the worldly domain and become independent, unbounded..."
Li Xuan spoke mystically, then added, "Of course, for you, walking this path is almost impossible now, as your foundations are already set, deeply influenced by Taicang."
"However, it is not impossible to continue breaking through, not impossible to find a path ahead!"
Upon hearing this, Old Man Xiao became extremely excited and said reverently, "Please, Taoist Ancestor, enlighten me!"
Li Xuan, twirling the Jade Ruyi in his hand, looked up at the firmament, "Be it the domain or the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, all things in the world follow the Great Dao, and the domain should have the Heavenly Dao to be complete. A domain without Establishing Dao is ultimately rootless, ultimately frail and unsupported, ultimately like a bubble."
"Your path ahead lies in comprehending the Way of Domain, in cultivating the Heavenly Dao!"
Old Man Xiao was struck in his heart, yet confused again. Comprehending the Way of Domain, cultivating the Heavenly Dao?
"Senior, we practice the Taicang Martial Arts, and the Taicang Domain was pioneered by our teacher Taicang. At our level, we have already comprehended the Way of Domain; how then can we comprehend the Way of Domain anew?"
Li Xuan smiled slightly and said, "The Way of Domain I speak of is not the Way of Domain you have comprehended. The Way of Domain you know is illusory, like a mere bubble."
"Look at this tree, born of the domain. What is its Dao? Since you have comprehended the Way of Domain, this tree, born of the domain, you should be able to control this tree with that comprehension."
"Can you then turn this tree into a sword, a knife, a spear?"
Old Man Xiao furrowed his brow in thought and hesitantly said, "That seems not difficult?"
"Then try it,"
Li Xuan said, smiling.
"Alright!"
Old Man Xiao, not understanding the deep meaning of the Taoist Ancestor, took a deep breath, reached out his hand, and in an instant the tree was uprooted and in a flash, he refined it into a sword.
"Senior, how is this?"
Li Xuan shook his head and said, "The sword in your hand has form but no Dao."
Turning to his chief disciple, Xu Yan, he said, "Disciple, turn that tree into a sword."
"Yes, Master!"
Xu Yan nodded, and with a mere thought, another tree in an instant transformed into a fierce Precious Sword, sharp and clearly displaying the life force and characteristics of the original tree.
Old Man Xiao stood dumbfounded on the spot, knowing Xu Yan's Sword Dao was mystical, and only now truly realized how terrifying this mystical Sword Dao was.
Looking at the sword in his hand and then at the sword in Xu Yan's hand, he began to feel dejected, threw down his sword, and prostrated himself on the ground saying, "Please, Taoist Ancestor, enlighten me!"
Li Xuan smiled warmly, Taoist Ancestor Halo swirling with the charm of the Great Dao, his voice resonating like the sound of the Great Dao, and gently sounded.
"This domain is incomplete; how can you comprehend the true Way of the Domain? And entering the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, yet losing yourself, you cannot find the path ahead."
"Only by comprehending the Heavenly Dao, cultivating the Heavenly Dao, can you have a path ahead."
Old Man Xiao's heart was deeply moved, the meaning in the Taoist Ancestor's words was very clear—Taicang Domain without the Heavenly Dao, and without the Heavenly Dao, naturally, the domain is incomplete!
He wanted to advance further, the only way was to understand the Heavenly Dao, cultivate the Heavenly Dao, and this premise was, the Taicang Domain must have the Heavenly Dao.
"Senior, where is the Heavenly Dao, how can I comprehend it?"
Old Man Xiao asked reverently and respectfully.
Behind the Taoist Ancestor Halo, Li Xuan's smile was radiant, the timing was almost right, it was about time to let Old Man Xiao, this Realm Master, assist, to make Tian Zi run the entire domain faster, to let Martial Artists all comprehend and cultivate the Heavenly Dao.

chapters.title: Chapter 937 - 487: The Origins of the Masters of the Six Great Domains
chapters.content:
```
Taicang ultimately became a part of history, and the future Domain shall belong to the Great Wilderness Domain.
Just as Tian Zi said, with Taicang gone, Great Wilderness must rise. Now that the Heavenly Dao has been established, it naturally needs to be continuously strengthened, allowing the Great Wilderness Domain to grow ever stronger.
Those followers of Taicang, like Old Man Xiao, held deep affection for Taicang. It would take them some time to accept the transformation from Taicang to Great Wilderness.
However, Tian Zi's identity was extraordinary after all, closer to Taicang, and by cultivating the Heavenly Dao, one could forge a path forward, constantly grow stronger, and even have the opportunity to avenge Taicang.
In this way, people like Old Man Xiao would have no objections.
After all, Taicang had already fallen. What did it matter if the Domain changed its name if one could avenge Taicang?
Of course, whether Old Man Xiao and the others accepted the change from Taicang to Great Wilderness did not actually affect much. They were merely the strongest in this Domain and also the ones most likely to break through.
Once they begun to comprehend the Heavenly Dao and cultivated it, their enhancement of the Heavenly Dao would be swift, and they would be able to elevate the Heavenly Dao significantly in the shortest amount of time.
And the stronger the Heavenly Dao, the stronger the Heavenly Dao Seal would naturally become, and so would Li Xuan's strength.
All of this related to the improvement of strength. That's why Li Xuan took the opportunity to give Old Man Xiao an understanding of the Heavenly Dao, laying the foundation for the cultivation of the Heavenly Dao.
This was guidance from the Taoist Ancestor, which he certainly would not doubt.
And once Old Man Xiao began to cultivate the Heavenly Dao and made a breakthrough in his power, the other Realm Masters would inevitably be envious and throw themselves into comprehending and cultivating the Heavenly Dao.
"The Heavenly Dao is not far off now. The Heavenly Dao of this Domain is already emerging."
Li Xuan smiled warmly.
"The Heavenly Dao has been born?"
Old Man Xiao was shocked and couldn't help but carefully sense the Heaven and Earth Laws, the Domain Dao Rule, all within his perception. There was nothing out of the ordinary, nor did he detect the existence of the Heavenly Dao.
"How could you sense it when the Heavenly Dao has just emerged and is not yet operating throughout the Domain?"
Li Xuan shook his head.
With a flick of his finger, a wisp of Heavenly Dao energy floated in front of Old Man Xiao. He said, "Seeing me is also your fortune. Contemplate this wisp of Heavenly Dao energy. When the Heavenly Dao begins its operation, you will have some basic understanding of it, which will make it much easier for you to cultivate the Heavenly Dao in the future."
"Thank you, Taoist Ancestor!"
Old Man Xiao was extremely excited.
He could feel the profoundness of this wisp of Heavenly Dao energy, something he had never seen or comprehended before. This wisp of Heavenly Dao energy, vaguely, seemed to have some similarity to the Domain Dao Rule.
But it was more profound than the Domain Dao Rule, as if it contained the infinite wonder of Heaven and Earth, along with deep and unfathomable rules.
He accepted the Heavenly Dao energy reverently, "Taoist Ancestor, may I seek out the location of the Heavenly Dao?"
Li Xuan smiled and said, "When your heart resonates, you may then seek it."
"Yes, thank you for the guidance, Taoist Ancestor!"
Old Man Xiao bowed respectfully.
Li Xuan nodded, and with that, the Taoist Ancestor's enlightenment session came to an end.
Emperor Da Yue and the others left one after another, and Old Man Xiao also respectfully retreated. Wu Tianan hurriedly followed him; he wanted to ask Old Man Xiao about his sister who was guiding him on the path of Martial Arts.
In the courtyard, only the six disciples remained.
"Today, your master will talk to you about this Domain and about all things in this world."
The Taoist Ancestor Halo spread from Li Xuan, enveloping Xu Yan and the other five.
He wanted to use the mystique of the Taoist Ancestor Halo to instruct the disciples, imparting a deeper understanding and reinforcing the concept of the Dao, laying the foundation for their future Martial Arts cultivation.
Especially Xu Yan, who was not far from the Domain Realm, and the Establishing Dao Realm was also within sight. The next Realm, once he made a breakthrough into the Domain Realm, should also be passed on to him.
Moreover, Meng Chong had not yet fully comprehended the Mighty Sky Limitless Body, so this was also an opportunity for him to soon gain enlightenment.
Li Xuan was imparting Dao to his disciples, while the others were preparing for seclusion, reflecting on their recent gains.
Wu Tianan, who had been constantly thinking about his sister guiding him in Martial Arts, put off his seclusion and reflection to eagerly approach Old Man Xiao.
"Elder, do you know my sister from the Dao Realm?"
Wu Tianan looked hopeful.
"What is your sister's name?"
Although Old Man Xiao was busy finding a place to contemplate the Heavenly Dao energy, he was also curious about Wu Tianan's guide in Martial Arts and wanted to confirm whether it was the person he had in mind.
"I don't know my sister's actual name."
Wu Tianan was a bit embarrassed.
However, he took out a painting scroll and said, "This is my sister."
As he spoke, he unfurled the painting.
Old Man Xiao glanced at it and sighed inwardly; it was indeed the person he had speculated.
"It turns out to be her. You will naturally meet her when the opportune time comes," Old Man Xiao nodded.
"Elder, since you know my sister, could you possibly..."
Wu Tianan was overjoyed.
"Fate will bring you together; there's no need to rush. The old man is off to seclusion!"
After saying that, Old Man Xiao disappeared on the spot.
Wu Tianan looked helpless and couldn't help muttering, "The old man puts on airs just because he's got a bit of power. No wonder there's no path forward in Martial Arts!"
Looking up at the Firmament, Wu Tianan took a deep breath, his eyes resolute. He had to double his effort in cultivation to strengthen himself as soon as possible.
To go to the Dao Realm and find his sister!
After Li Xuan finished teaching Dao, he let his disciples go to contemplate on their own.
The Qinghua state was perfectly stable without feeling any tremors in the Domain. And with the return of Xu Yan and Meng Chong, both Sword Cultivators and Body Cultivators triggered a fervent wave of cultivation.
Xu Yan had already begun preparing for his breakthrough into the Domain Realm.
Leaving behind the Extreme Soul Body, Li Xuan's true self visited Great Wilderness, teaching Tian Zi about the concept of the Heavenly Dao and how to make the best use of people like Old Man Xiao. He also needed to give Tian Zi some reminders.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 938 - 487: The Origins of the Masters of the Six Great Domains_2
chapters.content:
Otherwise, with Tian Zi's youthful impetuousness, he was likely to act recklessly, leading to missed opportunities for swiftly advancing the way of the Heavenly Dao.
"Xiaoyao? That guy is still not dead."
Tian Zi huffed as he spoke.
"Even though he knew I was trapped in there, he never came to find me, not to mention bringing me any good stuff, utterly detestable!"
Tian Zi grumbled angrily.
Then Tian Zi became excited again and said, "I am the Heavenly Dao, those guys from Xiaoyao can no longer make progress, since they want to comprehend me, this Heavenly Dao, it's truly marvelous.
"To comprehend the Heavenly Dao, to cultivate the Heavenly Dao, it can't be so easy, you must give up something in exchange."
Tian Zi was already contemplating how to torment those people in the future.
"The Heavenly Dao is impartial, the rules of the Heavenly Dao govern the world and should not be lightly interfered with, the Heavenly Dao must maintain its dignity to benefit the Domain.
"However, whatever you intend to do, as long as it doesn't violate the rules of the Heavenly Dao, there is no harm in it."
Li Xuan had long anticipated that Tian Zi's youthful nature would be unable to resist meddling.
Thus, when he allowed Tian Zi to become one with the Heavenly Dao, he left some leeway, so Tian Zi could act independently without interfering with the rules of the Heavenly Dao.
"Taoist Ancestor, I understand!"
Tian Zi nodded as he spoke.
Although his temperament was capricious, and he had a young man's heart, he was not without a sense of what was important, and he understood what was beneficial for himself.
"So Xiaoyao is still alive, out of the disciples taught by Taicang, who else is there besides Xiaoyao?"
Tian Zi exclaimed with a sigh of nostalgia.
"Xiaoyao, one of the Taicang Seven Heroes, was one of the seven people with the greatest talents born at the beginning of the Taicang Domain, each of them personally taught by Taicang, and could be considered Taicang's disciples."
"They were known as the Taicang Seven Heroes, with such formidable strength that even some Minor Heaven and Earth Masters who followed Taicang were no match for them; all they lacked was perhaps just the opportunity to Open Heaven Purple Light."
The Taicang Seven Heroes were one of the seven individuals with the greatest talents born in the Taicang Domain, not like Taicang and others who were born in the Land of Imperishable.
Li Xuan had a clear picture in his mind; Wu Tianan's Martial Arts guide was also one of the Taicang Seven Heroes.
He took out a table and chairs, a teapot and tea cups, and then Li Xuan brought out a stone jar, from which he took several tea leaves to begin brewing tea.
The tea inside the stone jar was extraordinary; just a few leaves exuded a vibrant, permeating aura of Dao rhyme.
"What is this?"
Tian Zi was momentarily startled, then beamed with delight, "Taoist Ancestor, you have such good stuff, how come you only took it out now?"
Li Xuan chuckled and said, "What good stuff? In the eyes of this Taoist Ancestor, this tea is no different from the tea we used to drink, but once you achieve Great Achievement in the Heavenly Dao and truly comprehend the meaning of the Heavenly Dao, when all living beings appear as one in your eyes, perhaps then you will understand the realm I speak of."
Tian Zi pouted and said, "I feel like I'll never reach that realm."
Immediately after, he excitedly watched the tea that was brewed from the leaves. With a mix of nostalgia and a touch of melancholy, he said, "Qing Yu tea, I haven't had it in such a long time."
"This tea was presented to me by my disciple, who said it was taken from the Sea Spirit Clan Treasure Vault."
Li Xuan poured a cup of tea and savored it slowly as he spoke.
Tian Zi, the spirit of the Taicang Domain, once lingered by Taicang's side for countless years; if anyone knew Taicang or this Domain the best, it was undoubtedly Tian Zi.
Li Xuan's visit was to further understand Taicang as well as the other Domain Masters.
"That must have been intended for that wench, the Sea Spirit Emperor."
Tian Zi sneered, then continued, "Qing Yu tea is grown by the Master of the Qingling Realm, the number of people qualified to drink Qing Yu tea could be counted on one hand..."
Once he started talking, Tian Zi became unstoppable in his narration.
He talked about the relationships and conflicts between Taicang and the other six Domain Masters.
"The Master of the Qingling Realm was originally a piece of Jade Bamboo, Qingling Jade Bamboo, born in the Land of Imperishable, inexplicably gaining spiritual wisdom and continuously growing stronger, even hunting True Spirits to enhance itself."
"She and Taicang had a profound relationship, and Qing Yu was particularly cared for by Taicang, who once stood up for Qing Yu to suppress that guy from the Netherworld."
```
"According to what I know, Qing Yu became the Master of Domain because of Taicang's assistance, who helped her seize enough Open Heaven Purple Light."
"I even suspect that Qing Yu's ability to transform was also influenced by Taicang..."
Tian Zi rambled on.
Li Xuan was quite surprised, the Master of the Qingling Realm was actually a bamboo?
The Jade Bamboo Xu Yan received from the Seductive Witch must be the Qingling Jade Bamboo, although it was unknown which generation of its root system it belonged to.
As Tian Zi continued her tale, Li Xuan gained a more detailed understanding of the Seven Great Domain Masters.
The Seven Great Domain Masters are Taicang, Witch Demon, Netherworld, Ao Hong, Hong Ze, Fen Yun, and Qing Yu, each with their extraordinary origins.
The Witch Demon opened the Wicth Demon Domain and was once the strongest of the True Spirits in the Land of Imperishable, the first witch-demon to gain wisdom.
In her strongest following, there were seven witches and twelve demons, and the Seductive Witch was one of the seven witches.
"No wonder the Seductive Witch is so powerful."
Li Xuan reflected inwardly.
Netherworld was a fierce and bloodthirsty person, fond of devouring blood, practicing the Blood Demon Path; Netherworld and Taicang's relationship was the worst.
Similarly, the relationship between Netherworld and Qing Yu was also extremely bad, almost enemy-like.
And because of Qing Yu, Netherworld once angered Taicang and was suppressed single-handedly by Taicang for ten thousand years as punishment!
Ao Hong was considered the ancestor of the True Dragons and was the first intelligent True Spirit that Taicang encountered while traveling in the Land of Imperishable, also with tremendous strength.
Ao Hong, the Master of the True Spirit Realm, was regarded as the supreme leader of the True Spirits. However, among the True Spirits, Heavenly Tiger always disagreed, believing that it was due to bad luck that he obtained less Open Heaven Purple Light than Ao Hong and thus lost to him.
A fierce battle between the dragon and tiger erupted, but Heavenly Tiger was suppressed. Despite his unwillingness, he had to submit.
"Taicang once said that Ao Hong saved some Purple Light, allowing True Dragons to transform into humans, and it seemed to be used for other purposes as well. That's why Ao Hong's strength is only slightly weaker than Witch Demon."
Tian Zi pondered and said.
"Hong Ze is the Water Spirit of the Land of Imperishable, which is why the Hong Ze Domain has far more seas and lakes than land, a Holy Land for practicing the Martial Arts of Water.
"Fen Yun is the Fire Spirit of the Land of Imperishable, and the Fen Yun Domain is scorching with many volcanoes, a Holy Land for practicing the Martial Arts of Fire.
"Qing Yu is the Qingling Jade Bamboo, so the Qingling Domain is the spiritual realm of plants and trees, full of lush vegetation, towering mountains, deep forests, and lands rich in Divine Medicine."
Tian Zi explained about the other six domains, concluding with a sigh, "Once, the martial artists of the Seven Great Domains, despite their contradictions, interacted with each other.
"For instance, those practicing the Martial Arts of Water would always go to the Hong Ze Domain for seclusion and arduous cultivation, and anyone looking for rare Divine Medicine would head to the Qingling Domain..."
With the emergence of the Imperishable Temple, all this changed.
A great battle occurred, and the Seven Great Domains were defeated, and even the mighty Taicang fell. It seemed that only Witch Demon and Netherworld remained among the other domains.
