However, the domains of Witch Demon and Netherworld also appeared ravaged, and the strong ones from these two domains were all thinking of invading the Taicang Domain.
"Imperishable Temple."
Li Xuan grew curious, wondering where exactly the Imperishable Temple came from?
The Land of Imperishable is boundless and vast; did it always wander the Land of Imperishable and by chance come across the area where the Seven Great Domains were located, coveting the hearts of the domains?
Taicang and the others roamed the Land of Imperishable for a long time but had never encountered the Imperishable Temple, indicating the vastness of the Land of Imperishable.
The strength of the mighty ones from the Imperishable Temple surpassed Taicang; did this mean that they were born before Taicang, possessing wisdom earlier than him?
Tian Zi continued to ramble, seemingly eager to spill all the words she had never said over the countless years.
After discussing the masters of the other six domains, she began to speak of Taicang's followers.
Among them, Taimiao was one of Taicang's followers and one who admired him.
"That woman Taimiao, she used to be jealous of me because of Taicang's favoritism towards me. It infuriated me!"
Tian Zi cursed under her breath, "He looked at me oddly, as if he saw me as Taicang's plaything. That look of jealousy, honestly, that woman is unreasonable..."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 939 - 488 Heavenly Slaughter, A New Storm is Brewing
chapters.content:
Li Xuan looked puzzled. Between Tian Zi and Taimiao, there turned out to be such an enmity.
Taimiao mistakenly thought that Tian Zi was Taicang's male favorite?
No wonder Tian Zi was so angry, cursing incessantly whenever he thought of it.
"This woman Taimiao, with talents inferior to Qing Yu, strength less than Qing Yu, losing to her, and yet blames me, it drives me mad!"
Tian Zi swallowed a mouthful of tea and continued ranting, narrating how Taimiao would fawn over others, how she was cold and aloof in front of others, yet acted like a demure damsel in front of Taicang, and so on.
It was apparent that Tian Zi held a deep grudge against Taimiao.
...
In the Divine Realm, somewhere.
Tian Shiqi walked silently through the forest, soundless, as if waiting for something.
"It should be about time."
According to the timing, those four Heavenly Slaughter Warriors had already entered the Qinghua state. If successful, they would have captured Xu Yan by now.
Tian Shiqi was waiting. If the four had failed and were all annihilated, the Qinghua state would be off-limits to him; he had to stay away and report only to the Supreme Sovereign.
If the four had successfully captured Xu Yan, then it would be his turn to act. The great merit of capturing Xu Yan to steal the Subduing Dragon Technique could only be his!
"It seems they have failed!"
As time passed, Tian Shiqi's expression grew more serious.
Four Divine Venerate Realm warriors had taken action and still failed; could it be that behind Xu Yan was a Supreme Sovereign, or even a Realm Master?
If so, this meant that aside from the Supreme Sovereign, there were other Supreme Experts scheming something in the shadows.
Tian Shiqi wondered, if a Supreme Sovereign or even a Realm Master were hidden in the Divine Realm, why had the Supreme Sovereign not perceived it?
Had the other experts also failed to notice?
"It was wise of me not to go to the Qinghua state back then."
Tian Shiqi felt somewhat relieved.
Not venturing personally to investigate after losing contact with the Qinghua state was indeed a wise move.
"Let's wait a bit longer."
Tian Shiqi continued to wait, needing definite news.
A few days later, a spirit bird arrived.
"They truly failed!"
Tian Shiqi exhaled, issuing an order that no members of the Divine Realm's Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow group should approach the Qinghua state.
"It's time to report to the Supreme Sovereign!"
He went to a hidden location, carving out a cave within the mountain.
With a solemn and dignified expression, he took out a statue, placing it on a stone table. He kneeled respectfully before the table, and his Divine Spirit Soul Force surged out, entering a pearl at the statue's brow.
Hum!
The statue emitted a faint glow, with ripple-like fluctuations. At one moment, the statue's eyes lit up.
"Seventeen, how did it go?"
The voice was somewhat gruff.
"Supreme Sovereign, it seems Xu Yan has a Supreme Sovereign or even a Realm Master behind him, and the Qinghua state's situation is unclear..."
Tian Shiqi respectfully reported.
He informed the Heavenly Slaughter about the failure of the four trying to capture Xu Yan.
"A Realm Master?"
Heavenly Slaughter's voice grew heavy.
Then there was a long silence as if contemplating something.
"If it indeed is a Realm Master, there is only one among the many Realm Masters who is most likely."
Heavenly Slaughter's voice rang out again.
"You need not worry about the matter in the Qinghua state. After the Earth Shadow Realm fully integrates with the Taihe Realm, someone will naturally handle it."
"Yes, Supreme Sovereign!"
Tian Shiqi respectfully responded.
Then, he detailed the current situation in the Divine Realm, including the chaos with the Netherworld and witches wreaking havoc, the significant drop in the Divine Realm's power, and the instability causing the inability to jointly address the turmoil of the Netherworld and witches.
After reporting the Divine Realm's situation, Tian Shiqi respectfully said, "Please instruct, Supreme Sovereign!"
Heavenly Slaughter's voice carried a chill, saying, "The Netherworld and witches, they've overstepped their bounds. This realm is ultimately not their world. We can collaborate, but they must not overreach.
"Calm the chaos of the Netherworld and witches. They should stay within the Heavenly Grotto or nearby."
"Yes, Supreme Sovereign!"
Tian Shiqi respectfully agreed.
"You have performed your task well, and a substantial reward awaits. Once the Divine Realm and Dao Realm are united, you may return."
"Thank you, Supreme Sovereign!"
Tian Shiqi was overjoyed.
"Report any other developments at any time!"
"Yes!"
The glow of the statue began to fade, and the lit eyes dimmed.
Tian Shiqi respectfully put away the statue, looking somewhat weary, and stuffed a piece of Divine Medicine into his mouth.
Although the statue served as a bridge for contacting the Dao Realm, each use required a significant amount of Divine Spirit Soul Force.
"Supressing the Netherworld and witches, driving them back to the Heavenly Grotto, what exactly is the Supreme Sovereign's agreement with them?"
Tian Shiqi pondered.
However, he need only complete the tasks given by the Supreme Sovereign. Since the Supreme Sovereign ordered the Netherworld and witch warriors to be driven back to the Heavenly Grotto, he didn't need to know the reasons, just to carry out his duties and complete the task!
"Should I take action personally?"
Tian Shiqi hesitated.
If he took action personally, wouldn't that expose the presence of a Divine Venerate Realm expert in the Divine Realm?
"Although the Earth Shadow Realm has not yet fully descended, the air from the Dao Realm has already poured down, and the upper limit of the Immortal Realm has been opened. Since that's the case, let a few Heavenly Slaughters break through to the Heavenly Union Realm and then suppress the chaos of the Netherworld and witches."
Thinking this, Tian Shiqi began to act.
With the power of Heavenly Union Realm Warriors, they should be able to end the turmoil of the Netherworld and witches, especially since until now, the highest level of power entering the Divine Realm from the Heavenly Grotto was still the Immortal Realm.
Taihe Realm is one of the 37 realms of the Divine Realm where the most severe shaking occurs, and the falling of the Earth Shadow Realm is currently connecting with it.

chapters.title: Chapter 940 - 488 Heavenly Slaughter, A New Storm is Brewing_2
chapters.content:
A powerful Spirit Qi Storm surged in from the Earth Shadow Realm.
Now, the Taihe Sect no longer had the capability to handle the current chaos in the Divine Realm, and among the thirty-seven realms of the Divine Realm, only Taimiao, Da Yan, and a few other realms had not yet suffered the ravages of the Netherworld and the Witches.
All the Immortal Heavenly Venerables had now gathered in the Taihe Realm.
"Those bastards from the Netherworld and the Witches are ravaging our Divine Realm. Are we just going to stand by and do nothing?"
Among the many Immortal Heavenly Venerables, a burly man wielding a giant axe shouted angrily.
"Our strength in the Divine Realm has greatly declined, almost to the point of being severely wounded. How can we resist the upheaval in the Heavenly Grotto? The only plan for now is to wait for the Dao Realm powerhouses to arrive and quell this chaos."
An Immortal Heavenly Venerable sighed.
"Nonsense, as long as we join forces to sweep through, how can we allow the Netherworld and the Witches to be rampant?"
The burly man shouted angrily.
"How can we sweep through? Are the strengths of the Netherworld and the Witches truly weakened? Unless Xu Yan, Meng Chong, and Jiang Buping make a move!"
Another Immortal Heavenly Venerable said solemnly.
At these words, everyone fell silent.
Xu Yan and his two peers possessed the strength to overwhelm the Immortal Heavenly Venerables, but no one dared to force the trio to act, and it seemed that the powerhouses from the Netherworld and the Witches had no intention of provoking them either.
Whoosh!
A wave of Spirit Qi Storm blew over, and suddenly, someone rose into the air and darted toward the falling location of the Earth Shadow Realm.
"My lords, the bottleneck of the Immortal Realm may have been broken. We could now break through to the Heavenly Union Realm. With a breakthrough to the Heavenly Union Realm, what could those bastards from the Netherworld and the Witches amount to?"
Upon hearing this, a crowd of Immortal Heavenly Venerables became exceedingly excited.
"Indeed, with a realm of the Dao Realm falling, the Divine Realm and the Dao Realm are unified. The bottleneck limit is naturally shattered, and we can break through in the Divine Realm!"
Another Immortal Heavenly Venerable darted toward the direction of the Earth Shadow Realm.
The burly man with the giant axe frowned. The previous two, weren't they powerhouses of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow?
Although he did not know their plot, it was true that what those two had said, the upper limit of the Immortal Realm's bottleneck, had been broken, and breaking through in the Divine Realm was now possible.
The Earth Shadow Realm had not completely collapsed yet, but the Spirit Qi and Dao charm from the Dao Realm had already cascaded down, and the place of fall was where the Domain Dao Rules emerged and the Dao charm was pervasive, making it the ideal place for a breakthrough.
Immediately, his figure moved, and he too darted toward the dropping direction of the Earth Shadow Realm.
Upon hearing this, the other Immortal Heavenly Venerables showed delighted expressions, and upon careful sensing, they indeed found that the Domain Lingji had become more active.
This also meant that not long after, the Taihe Realm would possess the conditions to break through the upper limit of the Immortal Realm.
"Let's go!"
Dozens of Immortal Heavenly Venerables subsequently headed toward the falling site of the Earth Shadow Realm.
Although the upper limit of the bottleneck of the Immortal Realm had been broken, not all Immortal Heavenly Venerables possessed the strength to break through.
The weakest among them must be in the state of Perfection of the Immortal Realm and have touched on the bottleneck of the Heavenly Union Realm, even having some breakthrough insights; otherwise, breakthrough would be impossible.
The trembling of the Divine Realm continued, and the chaos stirred by the Netherworld and the Witches also ravaged everywhere. Gradually, some Immortal Heavenly Venerables joined hands to form an alliance to combat the chaos of the Netherworld and the Witches.
The battles became more and more intense, and the casualties of the Divine Realm Warriors grew increasingly severe.
"Kill!"
The warriors of the Battle Hall, a top force of the Divine Realm, charged into the armies of the Netherworld Warriors with soaring fighting spirit, their clashing resounding and blood qi shaking the area for hundreds of miles.
The warriors of the Battle Hall, known for their formidable combat strength, constantly honed their will to fight in the Heavenly Grotto, refining the battle intent, making them familiar foes to the warriors of the Netherworld and the Witches.
After a major battle, the Netherworld suffered heavy casualties, and the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Battle Hall, fearless in death, fought ferociously, each taking on two Blood Disciples alone.
Spurt! Spurt!
Suddenly, in the midst of the battle, the form of the Blood Disciples abruptly stiffened for a moment, and in that instant, they were slain by the powerhouses of the Battle Hall!
As the Blood Disciples fell, the remaining Netherworld Blood Disciples were naturally massacred one-sidedly.
Tian Shiqi silently lurked in the distance, quietly observing the battle, with the fall of the two Blood Disciples a moment ago being his covert action.
He acted very discreetly, and even the Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Battle Hall could not detect him.
"It should be about time!"
Tian Shiqi looked toward the direction of the Taihe Realm.
According to the estimate of time, the first Martial Artist to break through the Heavenly Union Realm was about to appear.
This Martial Artist was none other than the Immortal Heavenly Venerable of Heavenly Slaughter, who had already reached perfection in the Immortal Realm and had comprehended the Heavenly Union Realm, lacking only the breakthrough environment.
Near the domain of the Earth Shadow Realm, a momentum surged up and became one with the domain.
Heavenly Union Realm!
"Today, I have broken through the Heavenly Union Realm and am going to suppress the Netherworld and the Witches!"
As he spoke, the Martial Artist who had just broken through the Heavenly Union Realm vanished in an instant, heading straight beyond the Taihe Realm.
As the news of the first Martial Artist breaking through the Heavenly Union Realm spread, more warriors lingering in the Immortal Realm rushed to attempt their breakthroughs, including the formidable ones from the Da Yan Dynasty and even the Sect Master of the Taimiao Sect.
Who wouldn't want to break through ahead of time and enhance their own strength in this turbulent domain?
Naturally, powerful individuals from the Taikun Realm also arrived.
Among these powerhouses, there were no shortages of those who had past grievances with Xu Yan, Meng Chong, and Jiang Buping.
With the Heavenly Union Realm Warriors taking action, the chaos caused by the Netherworld and the Witches gradually got suppressed and was pushed back into the Heavenly Grotto, and order in the Divine Realm began to return.
However, the vibration of the domain continued unabated. As time passed, everyone became accustomed to the vibration of the domain and, finally, could find peace and quiet to cultivate amidst these disturbances.
The Domain Lingji of the Taihe Realm became more and more active, Spiritual Energy was surging, and the essence of Dao was spreading. The number of warriors breaking through the Heavenly Union Realm increased.
As their strength grew, so did their confidence, and they also began to act more recklessly.
Especially when suppressing the Netherworld and the Witches, having an overwhelming advantage meant that the Immortal Heavenly Venerable seemed as weak as a tiny grasshopper to them.
"My Wanbao Alliance has suffered such a great humiliation, how can we let this go? Meng Chong must pay for this!"
"Well said!"
Several Heavenly Union Realm Warriors of the Wanbao Alliance gathered together, speaking with a cold expression.
"I thought we would have to wait for a Divine Envoy from the Dao Realm to come down to seek revenge for the humiliation suffered by my Wanbao Alliance, but now we can take action ourselves without troubling the Divine Envoy!"
The speaker was Yan Shanhe!
The conflict between Meng Chong and the Wanbao Alliance started with him, so he was most eager to see Meng Chong suppressed; otherwise, if Meng Chong held a grudge and came after him, he would undoubtedly die!
Now that he had broken through the Heavenly Union Realm and his confidence was greatly boosted, it was time to join the other Heavenly Union Realm Warriors of the Wanbao Alliance to seek revenge on Meng Chong.
"Xu Yan, you have gone too far in bullying us; how can we not retaliate against such humiliation?"
"Exactly! Xu Yan, who looks down on everyone, also needs to have his arrogance cut down a notch!"
Elsewhere, more than a dozen Heavenly Union Realm Warriors gathered together.
Each one of them had a cold and angry expression, as if they had suffered a great injustice!
All these warriors, without exception, were targeting Xu Yan.
In the past when Xu Yan subdued the True Dragon, they clamored to share in the True Dragon's body, only to be forcibly suppressed by Xu Yan, scaring them so badly they hardly dared to breathe. Now that their strength had increased and their confidence had returned, looking back, they saw it as a great disgrace and all thought of seeking revenge!
However, given Xu Yan's formidable strength, they lacked confidence to confront him alone, so they gathered together, preparing to confront Xu Yan collectively for an explanation!
In the Taihe Realm, near a spot where the Earth Shadow Realm fell, a young man sat cross-legged on the ground, his aura pulsing as he displayed the full prowess of the Immortal Realm.
"Boy, if you want to become stronger, taking the usual path won't work. Even if you break through to the Heavenly Union Realm, you're likely not a match for Jiang Buping. Before you attempt to break through to the Heavenly Union Realm, you need to undergo Blood Refining."
A sinister voice echoed within the young man's consciousness.
"How do I undergo Blood Refining? As long as it avenges Yun Yan'er, even if it means death, I am willing to take the risk!"
Thinking of Yun Yan'er, the young man's breathing grew heavy, and his eyes reddened.
That pearl of the Yun Shang Sect, the unparalleled goddess in his heart, had been killed by Jiang Buping!
Jiang Buping deserves death!
Does he not know that Yan'er had stopped scolding him, and had started speaking more gently to him, which meant that he would soon gain her favor?
He finally had a chance to gain Yan'er's approval, and even win her heart!
But then, Jiang Buping killed her!
The desire to kill wreaked havoc on his mind, his eyes bloodshot as if ready to devour someone.
"Boy, if you just do as I, the Blood Extreme Ancestor, tell you, you can have your revenge without dying, and there might even be a slight chance to bring that little lady back to life."
The enticing voice reverberated in the young man's Divine Soul.

chapters.title: Chapter 941 - 489 Preparing to Breakthrough to Domain Realm, Dragon Realm's Master Ao Lie
chapters.content:
The Divine Realm, as the upper limit of the Immortal Realm was unlocked and strength enhanced, gave some Martial Artists the confidence, naturally leading to the sprouting of certain ideas.
In a Netherworld Cave within the Divine Realm, the Netherworld Blood Children and Blood Disciples that originally occupied the Heavenly Grotto had all disappeared, not having exited the Grotto to return to the Netherworld, but were refined through Blood Refining!
At the central location within the Heavenly Grotto, there remained a dried-up Blood Pool, pervading with the blood qi of the Netherworld.
The Martial Artists who witnessed this scene, who considered themselves as powerful beings of the Netherworld, were not particularly concerned about the slaughter of their subordinates to enhance their strength through Blood Refining.
One Netherworld Cave after another was subjected to Blood Refining, and while it did catch the attention of some Martial Artists, they were merely cautious of potentially more powerful beings descending from the Netherworld, nothing more.
"Lad, how is this secret technique of mine, Blood Extreme Ancestor? With this technique in hand, how could Jiang Buping's Divine Soul Secret Technique hold any advantage?"
"Next, what you need to do is to hunt the Immortal Heavenly Venerables, refine their immortal essence blood, prepare for the breakthrough to the Heavenly Union Realm, and use the bones of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables to forge Blood Demon Weapons..."
The sinister voice of Blood Extreme echoed.
The young man began his hunt for Immortal Heavenly Venerables and embarked on his path of revenge.
...
The turmoil in the Divine Realm, the dark undercurrents swirling within, had no effect on the Qinghua state, and naturally did not affect Xu Yan and the others.
"It's time to prepare to break through to the Domain Realm!"
Xu Yan exhaled deeply with excitement; the Domain Realm was now within sight.
Half a month ago, he had already achieved Perfection in the Void-breaking Realm.
After some consolidation, he planned to break through to the Domain Realm in one go before emerging from seclusion.
"Once entering the Domain Realm, not even Divine Venerates will be feared, and once I've achieved great success in the Domain Realm, slaying Supreme Sovereign Warriors will also be commonplace."
The Domain Realm, although not yet at the very pinnacle of the Taicang Domain, was only a step away.
In the entire Taicang Domain, there weren't even a hundred experts in the Realm Master Realm.
"Once in the Domain, Establishing Dao isn't far behind."
Xu Yan's heart surged with excitement; for those who Establish Dao, they transcend the domain, and his goal of transcending the domain within a hundred years was now almost within reach.
He was about to activate the Formation to shut out all disturbances from the outside world, entering a deep period of secluded cultivation.
Ao!
Suddenly, a roar echoed, followed by a series of piteous screams.
Xu Yan frowned and as he stepped out of his seclusion chamber, he saw Ao Yuxue holding a stick and beating a green Flood Dragon!
"Master, save me!"
Yu Xiaolong frantically asked for help.
"What's going on?"
Xu Yan asked with a furrowed brow.
Ao Yuxue hit Yu Xiaolong's head to the ground with another thwack of her stick, fuming, "This worthless Flood Dragon wants to transform into a True Dragon. Look at yourself for once!"
Shi'er came over and explained, "Yu Xiaolong wanted to find you after coming back from the Nine Mountain Realm, but you were in seclusion. It couldn't help the urge to transform into a True Dragon and provoked her."
Xu Yan came to an understanding and turned to Yu Xiaolong with curiosity, "You can transform into a True Dragon? How do you transform?"
Yu Xiaolong nodded eagerly, "Definitely! I'm a Flood Dragon; Flood Dragons can naturally transform into True Dragons. All I need is True Dragon Blood, and I should be able to transform."
"Is that so!"
Xu Yan became pensive.
Upon hearing this, Ao Yuxue became angry, flipped Yu Xiaolong over with a swing of her stick, and then tugging at Xu Yan's sleeve, she timidly said, "He's just a garbage Flood Dragon. Even if he transforms into a True Dragon, he'll be a garbage True Dragon. Besides, he can't even take human form. If you have a garbage True Dragon with you, it'll be embarrassing."
"You already have me, the most outstanding among True Dragons!"
Yu Xiaolong, dizzy from the pounding, quickly interjected, "Master, if I transform into a True Dragon, I'll definitely be even more awe-inspiring. Having me as your mount when you travel will be more imposing. Whether I can take human form, that's not important. What matters is being awe-inspiring!"
"Shut up!"
Ao Yuxue's Dragon Might overwhelmed Yu Xiaolong, who immediately went limp on the ground, the entire Flood Dragon gone soft.
Xu Yan pondered for a moment. It's just True Dragon Blood; if Yu Xiaolong truly transformed into a True Dragon, it would be a good thing.
Moreover, since it was cultivating the Great Demon Method, its strength would definitely be even stronger after transforming into a True Dragon.
"It's just a few drops of blood. Give it to Xiaolong."
Thus Xu Yan spoke.
"I won't!"
Ao Yuxue stubbornly resisted, and as if afraid that Xu Yan would force her to give blood, she quickly added another sentence, "I'd rather make a trade with Su Lingxiu if I have to!"
Xu Yan was somewhat speechless. In her heart, Ao Yuxue truly carried a sense of pride, preferring to make a trade with Su Lingxiu rather than give a drop of True Dragon Blood to Yu Xiaolong.
It was evident how low Yu Xiaolong was in her estimation.
The reason behind this, Xu Yan had no interest in probing. Besides, with Ao Yuxue so resolved, he couldn't really press her down and extract her blood, could he?
Plus, if he were to do such a thing, the girl Ao Yuxue would definitely seek help from her Junior Sister Su Lingxiu.
"Fine, figure it out yourself," Xu Yan said, shaking his head.
"Master, no, it's just a drop of blood!"
Yu Xiaolong wailed.
"Shut up!"
Dragon Might from Ao Yuxue again suppressed Yu Xiaolong, pinning him firmly to the ground.
Seeing this, Xu Yan couldn't help but click his tongue. A Flood Dragon, no matter how powerful, would be suppressed by a True Dragon, showing just how strong the bloodline suppression of True Dragons over Flood Dragons was.
This was why Yu Xiaolong was obsessed with transforming into a True Dragon; even being a garbage True Dragon was much better than a Flood Dragon, at least it wouldn't be restrained so completely.
Given that it was cultivating the Great Demon Method, once it transformed into a True Dragon, it would certainly be able to suppress other True Dragons within the same realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 942 - 489 Preparing to Breakthrough to Domain Realm, Dragon Realm's Master Ao Lie_2
chapters.content:
```
"Enough, you'll have to find a way to make the transaction with her yourself, I'm entering closed-door cultivation, don't disturb me anymore."
Xu Yan shook his head but also reminded Yu Xiaolong, suggesting he could make a deal with Ao Yuxue to obtain True Dragon blood.
Upon hearing this, Ao Yuxue immediately breathed a sigh of relief, her eyes sparkling with joy as she watched Xu Yan return to his cultivation room. Seeing Yu Xiaolong's look of despair, she couldn't help but feel smug.
Meanwhile, Su Lingxiu was feeling quite frustrated; she had been ready to come out to save Ao Yuxue, and take the opportunity to make a deal with her, but her senior brother wouldn't give her the chance.
Xu Yan returned to his cultivation chamber, listening to the mournful howls of Yu Xiaolong outside, and shook his head. Forcing Ao Yuxue to bleed was now impossible.
If he really did that, Su Lingxiu would rush over to make a transaction with Ao Yuxue, and Yu Xiaolong's wish would ultimately remain unfulfilled.
With that in mind, he simply decided to do nothing.
Activating the Formation, Xu Yan began his breakthrough into Domain Realm.
"Once you enter the Domain Realm, only then do you understand the mysteries of the Domain."
Xu Yan thought excitedly.
...
Dao Realm, the core of Taicang Domain, was in ancient times the central land of Heaven and Earth, also known as the Domain Origin Continent.
Before the great battle with the Imperishable Temple, Taicang elevated the Origin Continent, turning it into the "Upper World," and as it was closest to the Dao Principles, it hence came to be known as the Dao Realm.
In the Dao Realm's Three Hundred Realms, each Realm is governed by a Minor Heaven and Earth Master, relying on the Taicang Domain as a foundation to carve out their own little heavens and earths.
The ancient war left Taicang fallen, and many of the original Minor Heaven and Earth Masters also perished. As a result, the Three Hundred Realms are mostly occupied by later generations of strong beings.
However, among the Three Hundred Realms, besides those carved out by the followers of Taicang, a small portion were brought by strong beings from other Domains as a contingency plan, relocating their small heavens and earths to Taicang.
The True Dragon Realm, for example, was a small heaven and earth that the True Dragon Clan from True Spirit Domain relocated to Taicang. Rumors suggested the True Dragon Realm was originally a little heaven and earth created by a powerful True Spirit, who had since perished. The True Dragon Clan, diversifying to minimize risks, moved a portion of its members from this Realm to Taicang Domain.
Many years have passed since that war, with few surviving Minor Heaven and Earth Masters, who deeply avoid speaking of the events of that great battle.
As the older generation of Minor Heaven and Earth Masters retreated, a second generation of strong beings rose in Taicang Domain, reaching the power of Minor Heaven and Earth Masters, but since they did not carve out their own small heavens and earths independently, they were instead referred to as Realm Masters.
Although there might not be a significant difference in strength between the two, this distinction communicated the message that Minor Heaven and Earth Masters were ancient Supreme Experts, while Realm Masters were the new generation of Supreme Experts.
Not every one of the Three Hundred Realms in the Dao Realm has Realm Master Realm Experts.
Forces without Realm Master Realm Experts often affiliate themselves with those who have such experts, forming a tacit balance among the various Realms of the Dao Realm, where competition happens within certain boundaries, especially among the Realm Masters themselves.
As the strongest beings of their respective Realms, Dao Realm Masters also bear the responsibility of repelling intruding strong beings.
No matter what, their Domain is vital to their interests. Every time a foreign strong being enters, they suffer a loss, and on this matter, there's an understanding among these Realm Masters.
However, since the birth of Realm Masters, there have been those who perished, some participated in that ancient war and fell. Even after the war, some Realm Masters died in accidents.
For instance, some died in the Land of Imperishable while seeking treasures, ambushed and killed.
The last time a Realm Master fell was a thousand years ago. The Realm Master did not die at the hands of enemies, but was killed by another Realm Master of Taicang Domain.
This caused great shock, instilling a sense of crisis in the weaker Realm Masters!
The fallen Realm Master was the Earth Shadow Realm Master!
The one who killed the Earth Shadow Realm Master was none other than Heavenly Slaughter, who was then the most illustrious of the third-generation Realm Master Realm Experts in Taicang Domain, renowned for his might.
The fall of Earth Shadow Realm Master instilled fear in many Realm Masters towards Heavenly Slaughter, whose ambition only grew after defeating the Earth Shadow Realm Master, further intimidating the weaker Realm Masters.
Heavenly Slaughter even secretly reached agreements with certain Realm Masters, forming an alliance.
What's more, Heavenly Slaughter occasionally interacted with strong beings from the Netherworld and the Witch Demon Domain. His ambition was clear, aspiring to unify the Domain, aiming to become the co-ruler of Taicang Domain.
```
The strong domains within the Dao Realm were all silent, not interfering with the actions of Heavenly Slaughter as if they were cautious or were simply observing its actions, wanting to seize the final benefits at the last moment.
The Taihe Realm, Taikun Realm, Taimiao Realm, and a few other strong domains that still had Minor Heaven and Earth Masters did not take any action, as if tacitly allowing Heavenly Slaughter's actions.
And at the forefront, the True Dragon Realm among other True Spirit Realms, also took no action, because including the True Dragon Realm, they were originally experts from the True Spirit Domain, not native experts from the Taicang Domain.
It was precisely because of this reason that the experts from the True Dragon Realm and other True Spirit strong realms were watching without interfering, fearing that it would provoke the native experts of Taicang.
The collapse of the Dao Domain Ladder caused the now masterless Earth Shadow Realm to fall into the Divine Realm, soon to become the connector between the Divine Realm and the Dao Realm, in a sense, unifying the two.
Clearly, this was the work of Heavenly Slaughter.
As the Earth Shadow Realm fell into the Divine Realm, not long after, a prodigy named Xu Yan in the Divine Realm had even tamed a dragon!
The tamed True Dragon was soon known to be the missing young princess of the True Dragon Realm, Ao Yuxue, the granddaughter of the True Dragon Realm's Master, Ao Lie, and his most beloved one.
Ao Yuxue's disappearance had already caused quite a stir in the Dao Realm when it occurred.
Although the True Dragons were outsiders, the progenitor of the True Dragons had a deep bond with Taicang, or else he would not have allowed part of the True Dragons to seek refuge in Taicang.
Moreover, the True Dragon Realm was extremely powerful, especially the True Dragon Realm's Master Ao Lie, who was rumored to be the youngest son of the True Dragon progenitor and was stronger than many Minor Heaven and Earth Masters.
Ao Lie himself left the True Dragon Realm to search for Ao Yuxue, even entering the Land of Imperishable, and beat a Blood Lord from the Netherworld and a Great Demon from the Witch Demon Domain into severe injuries and retreat.
However, Ao Yuxue ended up falling into the Divine Realm and was subdued by a prodigy there.
Moreover, from the messages received, Xu Yan's own strength was originally slightly weaker than Ao Yuxue's, but with the Subduing Dragon Technique, he managed to subdue her.
When this news arrived, the Dao Realm was shaken.
Although Xu Yan was not in the Dao Realm, his name had already spread across all realms of the Dao Domain.
The True Dragon Clan was enraged, and Ao Lie once again came out of the True Dragon Realm, wanting to go to the Divine Realm personally, to tear Xu Yan to pieces, yet due to the collapse of the Heavenly Ladder and the unstable fall of the Earth Shadow Realm, with the emergence of Dao Principles to stabilize the Domain, even with his strength, he could not force his way into the Divine Realm.
However, Ao Lie sought out Heavenly Slaughter.
It was widely known that Heavenly Slaughter was making some deployment in the Divine Realm, and Ao Yuxue's disappearance and fall into the Divine Realm could very likely be its doing.
Ao Lie led the strong experts of the True Dragon Clan, along with many True Spirit experts, towards the Heavenly Slaughter Realm.
A grand battle was about to erupt.
"Dragon Realm's Master, I know why you've come, but things are not as you think," said Heavenly Slaughter, tall in stature but with an air of refined elegance. His voice, rough and robust, was mismatched with his elegance, giving the impression of a brute feigning refinement.
"Heavenly Slaughter, you think I'm unaware of what's happened in the Divine Realm? Today, if you can't provide a reasonable explanation, I'll annihilate your Heavenly Slaughter Realm!"
The colossal figure of Ao Lie, the crimson dragon, spiraled, exuding immense Dragon Might, his eyes sharp and frigid, ready to act at a word and stomp out the Heavenly Slaughter Realm.
At this moment, Ao Lie exposed his True Dragon form, clearly prepared for a titanic battle!
The various Realm Masters of the Dao Realm appeared one after another, watching from afar.
"Dragon Realm's Master, you are a senior, with immense strength. Even I, Heavenly Slaughter, would not dare to affront you, and I wouldn't stoop to using schemes against a junior, no matter how shameless I am.
"Of course, I, Heavenly Slaughter, do not deny that your granddaughter's fall into the Divine Realm is indeed related to me, but I did it out of necessity, truly only to save your granddaughter," sighed Heavenly Slaughter.
"As long as you admit it's related to you, all your reasons, however eloquent, are useless. Today, I will see for myself just how capable you, Heavenly Slaughter, are to dare provoke me!"
Ao Lie raised one of his dragon claws, and the fiery red lightning fire surged, indicating a battle was imminent!

chapters.title: Chapter 943 - 490: Battle of the Supreme Sovereign, Earth Shadow Realm Master
chapters.content:
The battle was on the brink of erupting, but Heavenly Slaughter showed no intention of taking action. Instead, he continued, "Realm Master of the Dragon Realm, you should know what this is, right?"
As Heavenly Slaughter spoke, he lifted his hand, revealing a petal in his palm that glowed with a pink light, as if it could bewitch the heart and make one lose themselves in its allure.
"This is?"
Ao Lie's gaze sharpened as he said solemnly, "What does this have to do with my granddaughter being deceived by you and falling into the Divine Realm?"
Heavenly Slaughter sighed and said, "Realm Master of the Dragon Realm, you have misunderstood. Since you recognize what this is, I will tell you the reason behind it.
"I discovered by chance the whereabouts of your granddaughter. Her heart and mind had been enchanted, and it was this very thing that bewitched her.
"The situation was urgent at that time, and I didn't have the chance to inform you, the Realm Master of the Dragon Realm. Nonetheless, I couldn't bear to see the younger generation of the True Dragon Clan fall into crisis, especially since she is your granddaughter.
"Whether it was to owe the Realm Master of the Dragon Realm a favor or to thwart the enemy's scheme, I had to take action.
"However, that space was rather unique. Saving her and bringing her back to the Dao Realm was extremely difficult and complex, with a high likelihood of enemy obstruction.
"In desperation, I could only have your granddaughter fall into the Divine Realm. In my opinion, with your granddaughter's strength, she would certainly be safe in the Divine Realm..."
Upon hearing this, Ao Lie sneered and said, "Heavenly Slaughter, the collapse of the Dao Domain Ladder is related to you. Is my granddaughter's fall into the Divine Realm connected to this event?
"Provide evidence. This alone is not enough to convince me!"
Heavenly Slaughter gave a heavy sigh and said, "I know you would doubt this, Realm Master of the Dragon Realm. My words are true. Yes, the collapse of the Dao Domain Ladder is related to my plans, but my plan was only for the Unity of Domain – which other Realm Masters in the Dao Realm are not aware of?
"But, Realm Master, you must understand that not everything goes according to plan; unexpected events occur. Your granddaughter's fall into the Divine Realm merely hastened the collapse of the Dao Domain Ladder, a result of delayed communication with my subordinates in the Divine Realm.
"I had already ordered my subordinates in the Divine Realm to look after your granddaughter and not harm her, but then there was Xu Yan..."
At the end, Heavenly Slaughter's face showed a helpless expression.
"Realm Master of the Dragon Realm, frankly speaking, because your granddaughter was brought down by Xu Yan, I was worried that you would misunderstand and think this was my doing, which is why I did not visit you sooner.
"But since the Realm Master of the Dragon Realm has come today, let's make everything clear. As for the evidence you want, I do have some, albeit limited, but it should suffice to prove that I, Heavenly Slaughter, am not the one calculating against your granddaughter!"
With those words, Heavenly Slaughter waved his hand and unfolded a scroll. The scroll shimmered with ripples and soon showed an image of a certain space bathed in a pink glow, where a temptress-like figure with peerless charm flickered in and out of view.
Not far in front of the irresistible figure was an immaculate white True Dragon, raging with anger!
"This is what I hastily reflected into the painting in the heat of the moment. I believe it can serve as evidence," he said.
Heavenly Slaughter threw the painting scroll towards Ao Lie.
At this moment, Ao Lie had transformed into human form, with short dragon horns on his head and orange-red whiskers, his eyes full of raging anger.
After looking over the painting scroll again and again, he burst into a tirade, "That Seductive Witch, this licentious woman dares to plot against my granddaughter, offending the dragons too gravely. Does she really think I, Ao Lie, cannot deal with her?"
Heavenly Slaughter said gravely, "Realm Master of the Dragon Realm, do not underestimate her. The Seductive Witch is powerful, especially her Charm Power, which is indeed difficult to guard against!"
"That licentious Seductive Witch counts for nothing. Charm Power is only effective against the useless," Ao Lie said coldly.
Then he added, "Heavenly Slaughter, this was all a misunderstanding. I, Ao Lie, am not an unreasonable dragon. This will serve as an apology for the misunderstanding."
Ao Lie said, waving his hand and presenting a box.
"Your help in saving my granddaughter will be repaid by me, Ao Lie, one day!"
After finishing his words, Ao Lie led a mighty group away and returned to the Dragon Realm.
Heavenly Slaughter watched the True Dragon Clan depart and his mouth curved slightly. He turned to return to the Heavenly Slaughter Realm, musing inwardly, "Seductive Witch, don't blame me for sending a formidable enemy your way. It's really that you're somewhat tricky to deal with."
On the way back to the Dragon Realm, Ao Ming, father of Ao Yuxue, looked at his own father and asked, "Father, that Seductive Witch calculating against Yu Xue, is too much of an affront to our True Dragon Clan, a blatant disrespect. When will you act to suppress her?"
Ao Lie looked a bit uncomfortable, with a slight evasion in his eyes he spoke, "That licentious woman is not easy to deal with. There is something so insidious about her that whenever I see her, I feel agitated and fiery, which severely affects my ability to perform. The matter of vengeance will be set aside for now. Let's wait for Yu Xue to come back and clarify things before deciding!"
Ao Ming: ???
Looking at his old father, his eyes became somewhat strange. Could it be that his father was unable to resist the Charm Power of the Seductive Witch, hence the hesitation in taking action?
Thus, a major battle was averted.
Many Realm Masters were waiting for Ao Lie to leave the Taicang Domain to settle accounts with the Seductive Witch.
However, there was no movement from the True Dragon Realm; Ao Lie made no arrogant and tyrannical march beyond the Domain to attack the abode of the Seductive Witch.
"Does the old dragon not trust my words? With what I know of him, he shouldn't be so slow to grasp things!"
Heavenly Slaughter frowned with a puzzled look on his face.
In the Dao Realm, below the Earth Shadow Realm, where it had fallen, a gathering of powerful beings comes together, waiting for the Earth Shadow Realm to stabilize before descending into the Divine Realm.
"Unity of Domain, a major change. If one were to be in the Divine Realm, could one obtain some of the Domain's fortune and break through one's own limits?"

chapters.title: Chapter 944 - 490: Battle of the Supreme Sovereign, Earth Shadow Realm Master Part 2
chapters.content:
"Training in the Dao Realm is difficult. Even if one seizes some opportunities from the domain, they can't improve much. It's a matter of talent not being up to par!"
A group of Martial Artists stood at the edge of the falling Earth Shadow Realm, looking at a realm falling into decay, visible within were dense spiritual mists and Dao Principles emerging, permeating the area with their essence.
The Martial Artists preparing to enter the Divine Realm were primarily from the Heavenly Union Realm, mostly intending, amid the great changes between the Dao Realm and Divine Realm, to seek further advancement, to break through to the Divine Venerate Realm.
Among them, there were also Divine Venerate Martial Artists, and these warriors had been assigned tasks by various realms and had descended into the Divine Realm on these missions.
"What is that?"
A few Divine Venerate Martial Artists saw a figure flickering past and couldn't help but fix their gaze.
"Supreme Sovereign!"
"Is even the Supreme Sovereign entering the Divine Realm? Could it be that the Divine Realm truly holds great opportunities?"
"It's probably because of Xu Yan's Subduing Dragon Technique, which is quite tempting."
"Why would a Divine Realm Warrior possess such a powerful Subduing Dragon Technique?"
"Perhaps it's because of the great changes in the domain that such a monster has arisen."
The Martial Artists discussed quietly among themselves.
All the Martial Artists were waiting to enter the Earth Shadow Realm, to pass through it to the Divine Realm, either to seek the breakthrough opportunity of merging the Dao and Divine Realms or on mission-driven descents, with various purposes.
As time passed, the vibrations of the falling Earth Shadow Realm gradually lessened, and the entrance to the Earth Shadow Realm was not far off.
Suddenly, a strong aura approached from afar.
A group of Heavenly Union Realm Martial Artists, and even Divine Venerate Martial Artists, all changed their expressions.
"It's the Taihe Realm!"
Two powerfully-auraed artists came from afar and stood before the Earth Shadow Realm, silently observing it.
It's the Taihe Realm's Supreme Sovereign Martial Artists!
In the Three Hundred Realms of the Dao Realm, the Taihe Realm is extremely strong, recognized as a major realm, and the founder of the Taihe Realm, Taihe, is rumored to still be alive, albeit not having shown himself for a long time.
Any Martial Artist with some background knows that Taihe is one of the ancient Minor Heaven and Earth Masters and ranks among the forefront of such rulers.
Moreover, he has a deep relationship with the Master of the Taicang Domain. This is also why the first realm in the Divine Realm is the Taihe Realm, and why the Dao Domain Ladder is set up there.
The Taihe Realm is the Taihe Realm's presence in the Divine Realm. The Earth Shadow Realm falling first impacted the Taihe Realm, and the contemporary Sect Master of the Taihe Sect under Taihe Realm perished when the Dao Domain Ladder collapsed.
As the Taihe Realm's Supreme Sovereign descended, many warriors tightened their nerves. Was the Taihe Realm about to demonstrate its power?
From afar, another powerful aura emerged.
Another Supreme Sovereign Warrior descended.
"This is Taikun Realm's Supreme Sovereign."
The Taikun Realm, also a major realm, though it is rumored that its founder, Taikun, has fallen without a trace.
Even so, the current Taikun Realm Master is a true successor of Taikun and also a Realm Master Realm expert, ranked among the strongest third generation of the Taicang Realm.
Although not as famous as Lord Heavenly Slaughter, no one dares to underestimate the current Taikun Realm Master, Jiang Feng!
As time progressed, more and more Supreme Sovereigns appeared.
Suddenly, two supremely dominant auras approached from afar, their powerful Supreme Sovereign presences utterly unreserved, displaying their arrogance and dominance.
The Martial Artists all changed their expressions, looking toward the newcomers.
"It's the Heavenly Slaughter Realm's Supreme Sovereign!"
The Heavenly Slaughter Realm stirs the winds and clouds in the Dao Realm, and the current great changes in the domain are also related to the Heavenly Slaughter Realm.
And the Heavenly Slaughter Realm Master, who has slain the Earth Shadow Realm Master, is notoriously fierce, and many weaker Realm Masters are extremely wary of him.
As the Heavenly Slaughter Realm's Supreme Sovereign descended, the Taihe Realm's Supreme Sovereign, who had been silently waiting for the Earth Shadow Realm to stabilize, suddenly spoke coldly: "The collapse of the Dao Realm Ladder caused by the Heavenly Slaughter Realm led to the fall of our Sect Master and heavy losses in the Taihe Realm. Shouldn't there be an explanation?"
"What explanation do you want from the Taihe Realm? If you're not as skilled, you should just accept defeat. If you disagree, then prove it with actions!"
The Heavenly Slaughter Realm's Supreme Sovereign said coldly.
The Martial Artists below the Divine Venerate Realm, hearing this, changed their expressions, hastening to retreat, distancing themselves from the area where the Supreme Sovereigns were.
The Heavenly Slaughter Realm was as domineering and arrogant as ever.
Boom!
The Taihe Realm's Supreme Sovereign's aura surged, he said coldly, "Don't think, Heavenly Slaughter Realm, that you are invincible! Do you truly think my Taihe Realm is easy to bully?"
"Enough talk. If you disagree, then prove it with actions!"
The Heavenly Slaughter Realm's Supreme Sovereign sneered.
"Good, good, good!"
The Supreme Sovereign of the Taihe Realm took a step forward, and with a raise of his hand, he launched a powerful strike directly at his opponent.
The battle of the supreme had thus erupted!
Boom!
The great battle between the two Supreme Sovereigns was far fiercer than the noise of the entire Earth Shadow Realm falling, and the battle intensified more and more, causing even the other Supreme Sovereign Warriors to involuntarily retreat a distance.
"So powerful!"
It was anticipated that the Supreme Sovereign of the Taihe Realm would be potent, after all, it was a major domain in the Dao Realm, and Taihe was even an ancient Minor Heaven and Earth Master.
However, the strength of Heavenly Slaughter Realm's Supreme Sovereign surprised everyone; clashing with the Taihe Realm's Supreme Sovereign, he showed no signs of being outmatched, which explained his arrogance.
How powerful must Lord Heavenly Slaughter himself be then?
Could he already contend with Taihe?
"If Taihe wants a resolution through conflict, then let's bring our proof to the fight!"
Another Supreme Sovereign from the Heavenly Slaughter Realm even took the initiative to challenge another Supreme Sovereign of the Taihe Realm.
"Then let's battle!"
As it concerned the honor of the Taihe Realm, retreat was naturally impossible.
Boom, once both parties made their move, it was with ferociously decisive blows.
At the crumbling edge of the Earth Shadow Realm, the battle of the Supreme erupted. Spiritual energy tumbled, the Heaven and Earth Laws stirred, and the power of the Dao Principles sporadically surged forth.
The winds roared, ripples spread, and the fierce battle drew everyone's attention.
Yet, unnoticed by anyone, a figure akin to a shadow, silent and seemingly glued to the ground, seized this opportunity to sneak into the still-agitated Earth Shadow Realm.
Boom!
Inside the Earth Shadow Realm, the power of the Dao Principles surged, the Minor Heaven and Earth Laws emerged, seemingly trying to suppress the intruder.
The shadow-like figure merely revealed a sliver of the Principle's power, and the domain's laws calmed down, allowing the figure to continue moving deeper into the Earth Shadow Realm.
The Earth Shadow Realm, filled with dense mists and constant tremors, was extremely dangerous at this time—even Supreme Sovereigns entering could easily perish.
Even though Supreme Sovereigns were powerful, they were ultimately not Minor Heaven and Earth Masters and could not withstand the suppression of a Minor Heaven and Earth.
And although Realm Master Realm experts could withstand the tremors of the Earth Shadow Realm, as the realm was falling and involved the Taicang Domain Dao Principles, even the strongest Realm Master could not withstand the Taicang Domain Dao Principles. Thus, even someone as strong as Ao Lie dared not forcefully descend into the Divine Realm at this time.
Deeper within the Earth Shadow Realm, the area resembled a deep abyss, enshrouded by thick mists emitting a cold, chilly air, silent and profound.
The shadow-like figure paused, took out a silver pearl, and with a pop, crushed it. The shattered pearl emitted a cloud of gray mist, which instantly entered the cold, profound depths of the abyss.
After a while, a voice came from the abyss.
"Has it begun already?"
"Realm Master, it has begun, but there has been an unexpected turn of events,"
The voice from the abyss, with a hint of surprise, said, "Unexpected? Who interfered prematurely—was it Taihe, or perhaps Taimiao, or even Xiaoyao?"
"It's none of them; there was an unexpected issue in the Divine Realm."
The shadow-like figure began to explain.
"Subduing Dragon? The Subduing Dragon Technique?"
The voice from the abyss expressed great surprise.
"Exactly, hence Lord Heavenly Slaughter ordered me to descend early to seize the Subduing Dragon Technique. If the Subduing Dragon Technique is obtained, the True Dragon Clan will also be within our control,"
The shadow-like voice respectfully said.
"I'm letting Yin Jue take action in person because the person behind Xu Yan is not weak. Given this, I will smooth out the Earth Shadow Realm laws to help you pass smoothly."
"The person behind Xu Yan could likely be a Supreme Sovereign Warrior, and among the Supreme, he is exceptionally strong. Lord Heavenly Slaughter's intent is for me not to engage directly in combat, so I ask the Realm Master for the True Spirit of the Mist Beast."
Yin Jue said gravely.
"Could the opponent be a Realm Master then? Otherwise, why the need for the Mist Beast True Spirit?"
The person in the abyss questioned.
"Lord Heavenly Slaughter's judgment suggests the possibility of it being a Realm Master isn't high, but it can't be entirely ruled out. For caution's sake, if it indeed turns out to be a Realm Master, even possibly an unfamiliar one, having the Mist Beast True Spirit gives me a slim chance to escape. Even if I can't escape and the Mist Beast True Spirit is killed, you, Realm Master, will be notified in time."
"Lord Heavenly Slaughter's meaning is, if it really is a Realm Master, especially an unfamiliar one, then it would only be up to you, Realm Master, to personally take action to eliminate the opponent!"
Yin Jue conveyed the orders of Heavenly Slaughter.

chapters.title: Chapter 945 - 491 Actions of Various Factions in the Dao Realm
chapters.content:
"Realm Master, could anyone truly kill that easily?"
The voice from the abyss was somewhat heavy, then it continued, "Back then, when I attacked Yu Yao and severely wounded her, who would have expected her to have an ace up her sleeve? She escaped into the Spiritual Realm and saved her life. By now, she must have returned to the Dao Realm, and her injuries might even be healed."
"Initially, to prevent this matter from spreading, Yu Yao's ancient hands had to feign death until now. If I leave this place, she might sense my presence."
Yin Jue's expression changed slightly as he said solemnly, "Realm Master, can't you eliminate that slight trace of presence?"
"Yes!"
The Earth Shadow Realm Master's voice conveyed a sense of helplessness, "That wisp of presence is no ordinary matter. Despite expending much effort, I have always been unable to eliminate it. I can only use this place to conceal myself, and once I leave, Yu Yao will surely know I am still alive."
"Given the current situation, Yu Yao might guess that I am the one who went to attack the Divine Realm. She might reveal my whereabouts to them."
"Once they are on guard, after all, as a Realm Master, it would not be easy for me to launch an attack!"
Yin Jue said solemnly, "Realm Master, allow me to report this to Lord Heavenly Slaughter and see how to proceed!"
After finishing, he took out a statue, placed it on the ground, and the Divine Soul Force madly surged into it.
Even though he was a Supreme Sovereign Realm Warrior, being in the Earth Shadow Realm and at this moment as the Earth Shadow Realm was falling, affected by the Domain Dao Rule, trying to communicate with Heavenly Slaughter consumed an extremely large amount of energy.
In just a short while, his face turned pale, showing the immense consumption of the Divine Soul Force.
Finally, the statue's eyes lit up, "Yin Jue, what is the urgent matter?"
The voice of Heavenly Slaughter came.
The voice of the Earth Shadow Realm Master came, "If I make a move, Yu Yao is likely to disclose my information, and once I am exposed, it will be difficult to launch an attack."
"Wait for my message, and act when the timing is right. I will handle Yu Yao."
Heavenly Slaughter replied after pondering for a long while.
"In that case, if the opponent truly is a Realm Master, I shall make my move!"
The Earth Shadow Realm Master nodded.
The statue's eyes dimmed, and Yin Jue hurriedly withdrew the Divine Soul Force, feeling a sense of weakness.
"Take the Mist Beast True Spirit with you."
The voice of the Earth Shadow Realm Master came through with a cluster of clouds fluttering out from the abyss.
Mist Beast True Spirit!
"Thank you, Realm Master!"
Yin Jue respectfully bowed.
In an instant, the Mist Beast True Spirit enveloped Yin Jue like a cloud, merging into a silhouette that was like mist.
"Go!"
After the Earth Shadow Realm Master spoke, silence fell completely.
The Mist Beast True Spirit is a special True Spirit, its body like a cloud that can disperse. If attacked, it can drift away like a cloud, making it difficult to be completely eradicated, and it can mitigate up to seventy to eighty percent of the attack's force.
It also possesses a special ability, which is to hide its presence and conceal its tracks!
Covered by the Mist Beast True Spirit, Yin Jue quietly traversed the Earth Shadow Realm, heading towards the Divine Realm.
Meanwhile, in the Dao Realm, the Supreme Sovereign battle had already concluded.
The Supreme Sovereign of the Heavenly Slaughter Realm, admitting a slight defeat, chose to stop on his own accord.
Their purpose had been achieved.
The Yu Yao Realm, among the Three Hundred Realms in the Dao Realm, was not well-known, and no warriors from Yu Yao Realm were seen walking in the Dao Realm; to many warriors in the Dao Realm, the Yu Yao Realm was considered an empty realm.
But this realm was sealed, inaccessible to outsiders, even the Supreme Sovereigns.
As for whether other Realm Masters had ever entered it, that remained unknown.
In the cold Yu Yao Realm, from a lonely small house, a gentle cough was heard. A woman with a stunningly beautiful face and a cold demeanor walked out of the house.
Her pale jade face showed a delicate frailty, her eyebrows slightly furrowed, her bright eyes seemingly piercing through the Yu Yao Realm, gazing towards the Dao Realm.
The woman quietly watched and seemed to be sensing something.
"She truly isn't dead!"
She then looked towards a certain place, "Heavenly Slaughter?"
After a long silence, the woman turned back into the small house.
Inside the cottage, aside from a pale jade platform, there was nothing else.
The woman lay on the jade platform, strands of white Domain Rhythms encircling her, nourishing her, and within these white Domain Rhythms, a faint purple occasionally appeared.
"Just a little more to fully recover. If not for the Domain luck bestowed by my mentor, how could I have escaped that time?"
The woman thought to herself.
Involuntarily, the image of a little boy appeared in her mind; the boy gradually grew into a youth... It had been a very long time since they had parted.
"Tian Nan..."
The woman murmured, her lips inadvertently curling into a slight smile.
Before the Earth Shadow Realm, the falling Earth Shadow Realm was about to stabilize, and the shaking had already lessened.
Divine Venerate Realm and Supreme Sovereign Realm Warriors were about to pass through the Earth Shadow Realm, entering into the Divine Realm.
Suddenly!
All the warriors' expressions tightened.
A figure abruptly descended.
Heavenly Slaughter!
"We've seen the Heavenly Slaughter Realm Master!"
The warriors hastily bowed.
Even the Supreme Sovereigns from the Taihe Realm and Taikun Realm bowed to show respect for the Realm Master.
In the Dao Realm, the Realm Master was supreme, and warriors below the Realm Master Realm had to bow upon seeing them; it had become an unwritten rule of the Dao Realm.
Even warriors from a hostile realm had to bow upon seeing them, and in a way, once the respect was shown, the Realm Master could not bully the weaker ones, targeting those below other Realm Masters.
This was also the origin of the unwritten rule that required bowing upon encountering a Realm Master.
Heavenly Slaughter nodded and looked towards the Earth Shadow Realm, "The heart of the Earth Shadow Realm Master is not good, preferring to act in the shadows, stealth attacks, and plots are all his doings. My killing him cleanses the Dao Realm of some filth, but the Earth Shadow Realm now belongs to my Heavenly Slaughter Realm. You may use the Earth Shadow Realm as a channel to the Divine Realm, but you must not investigate the items of the Earth Shadow Realm, do you understand?"

chapters.title: Chapter 946 - 491 Actions of Various Factions in the Dao Realm_2
chapters.content:
"We understand!"
The martial artists' hearts turned cold.
Heavenly Slaughter had come to warn the martial artists and all the realms: the Earth Shadow Realm belonged to him, Heavenly Slaughter, and although he would lend it out for everyone to enter the Divine Realm, none were to search for the items within the Earth Shadow Realm, as they all belonged to the Heavenly Slaughter Realm.
"Good that you understand,"
Heavenly Slaughter nodded.
With the arrival of Heavenly Slaughter, all the martial artists steadied their breaths and tensed, silently waiting for the moment they could enter the Earth Shadow Realm to proceed to the Divine Realm. They did not even dare to communicate with each other through secret transmissions.
The tremors from the Earth Shadow Realm were growing weaker, and the moment to enter was drawing nearer.
Suddenly, all martial artists' faces changed.
A figure floated over.
"Heavenly Slaughter, are you heading to the Divine Realm?"
The newcomer had an unassuming presence, lacking the domination of a supreme expert, with more of a low profile instead.
"Greetings to Realm Master Jiang Feng!"
The martial artists promptly paid their respects.
The Supreme Sovereign of the Taikun Realm relaxed at heart and hurriedly went to meet him.
"Jiang Feng, what a rare visitor. You've actually deigned to leave the Taikun Realm,"
Heavenly Slaughter said with an indifferent smile.
"With such a commotion created by you, Heavenly Slaughter, how can anyone in the Dao Realm not be alarmed?" Jiang Feng said with a slight smile.
Heavenly Slaughter laughed lightly, knowing that none of these realm masters were simple beings—they had always been observing and hoping to partake when the critical moment arrived.
"Do you, Jiang Feng, intend to go to the Divine Realm?"
Jiang Feng shook his head, "Of course not. But within the Taihe Realm of the Divine Realm, there are some matters that need to be dealt with."
Heavenly Slaughter nodded and said nothing further.
Jiang Feng walked forward, arriving at the entrance to the Earth Shadow Realm. He looked into the Earth Shadow Realm and sighed, "Back then, Earth Shadow was quite illustrious, first among realm masters in terms of lurking and concealment, particularly skilled in stealth and assassination. He was also modest, never conflicting with others."
"If my memory serves right, he once laid ambush in the Land of Imperishable, striking a heavy blow to a giant demon from the Witch Demon Domain,"
"It's hard to believe that Earth Shadow has perished."
Heavenly Slaughter's expression was indifferent as he replied, "Earth Shadow was only apparently modest. Who knows how many filthy deeds he committed in secret. You, Jiang Feng, have been in isolation for so long, it's natural you know little of this. I killed him simply to prevent such a person from disturbing the Dao Realm."
"Could it be that you, Jiang Feng, had an amicable relationship with Earth Shadow and want to stand up for him?"
Jiang Feng shook his head, "Heavenly Slaughter, I had no relations with him, nor the intention to stand up for him. I am just curious, is Earth Shadow truly dead?"
Heavenly Slaughter frowned, "Jiang Feng, what do you mean by this?"
"Nothing much. It's just that Earth Shadow was adept at concealment, deceiving enemies, and exceptional at feigning death to hide. Therefore, some part of me disbelieves that he has indeed fallen," Jiang Feng said with a faint smile.
Heavenly Slaughter scoffed, "If Earth Shadow could truly fake his death under my hand and escape with his life, I, Heavenly Slaughter, would admit defeat. How about that?"
Jiang Feng laughed and withdrew his gaze from the Earth Shadow Realm.
At that moment, the sound of a dragon's roar filled the air.
A crimson true dragon soared over, its dragon might vast and powerful. Following closely behind the true dragon were four True Spirits.
As the true dragon drew closer and suddenly became aware of the two realm masters, Heavenly Slaughter and Jiang Feng, it quickly retracted its dragon might and transformed into a human shape.
"Greetings to the two realm masters!"
Ao Ming hastily paid his respects. To reveal dragon might in front of realm masters was a provocation.
If the realm masters became angry, while they might not kill him, a severe lesson was inevitable. After all, offending the dignity of a realm master was a grave taboo in the Dao Realm.
Even if his father was Ao Lie, the Master of the Dragon Realm, he would not escape being reprimanded.
"Considering the relationship with the Dragon Realm's Master, I'll overlook your rudeness this time," Jiang Feng said with a smile.
Heavenly Slaughter looked at Ao Ming and the four True Spirits he led. Clearly, they were headed for the Divine Realm, most likely seeking Xu Yan.
After all, Princess Ao Yuxue of the Dragon Realm had been subdued by someone, which was a great disgrace for the True Dragon Race.
And Ao Ming was the father of Ao Yuxue.
"Where has the Dragon Realm's Master been recently?"
Heavenly Slaughter pondered for a moment before asking.
There was a hint of embarrassment in the depths of Ao Ming's eyes. He understood what Heavenly Slaughter meant. It was no more than a suspicion as to why his father had not sought revenge on the Seductive Witch, finding it somewhat unbelievable.
After all, his daughter had been harmed by the Seductive Witch, and given his father's nature, he would surely be furious and forcefully march to where the Seductive Witch was, to demand an explanation. That was the image people had of the Dragon Realm's Master.
And yet, his most beloved granddaughter had been harmed, and there had been no action taken. It all seemed too abnormal.
Of course, Ao Ming could not directly state the reason, so he said solemnly, "My father is in seclusion, cultivating a secret technique of our True Dragon Clan, intending to utterly annihilate that seductive bitch in one fell swoop!"
After pausing for a moment, he added, "The Heavenly Slaughter Realm Master also knows that as one of the seven witches of the Witch Demon clan, the Seductive Witch is powerful. Even if my father could defeat her, it would be extremely difficult to kill her. That is why he is in seclusion, cultivating the secret technique—inaction until decisive, fatal action against the Seductive Witch is possible!"
Heavenly Slaughter suddenly understood and said, "So that's how it is!"
Yet deep within his eyes, there was skepticism. Could Ao Lie, this dragon, actually stay calm?
The martial artists present, upon seeing Ao Ming's arrival, couldn't help but shift their eyes. Many of them harbored intentions towards the Subduing Dragon Technique.
With the arrival of the True Dragon Clan in the Divine Realm, their chances were dwindling, unless they were to directly vie with the True Dragon Clan, which would mean outright offending them.
And involving the Subduing Dragon Technique meant that it was no longer just about the True Dragon Clan but the entire True Spirit Tribes. Without sufficient strength or backing, one would undoubtedly die.
Upon his arrival, Ao Ming displayed his Dragon Might to deter those with ulterior motives, but he hadn't anticipated that a Realm Master would be present.
The tremors from the Earth Shadow Realm were getting weaker, signifying it was about to completely fall into the Divine Realm, merging with it, marking the beginning of the unification with the Dao Realm.
The upper limit of Martial Arts within the Divine Realm would be utterly shattered, gradually becoming like that of the Dao Realm.
This marked a change in the Domain since the great alteration of heaven and earth, returning to the original pattern of the Domain's beginning.
And with the change of heaven and earth, there surely were some opportunities.
For Realm Masters, what attracted them was the Domain Authority, vying for the possible authority of the Master of Domain, to become the new lord of the Taicang Domain!
Boom!
At a certain moment, a thunderous crashing sound came from within the Earth Shadow Realm.
The shaking became violent all of a sudden but then quickly subsided.
"Divine Venerate and Heavenly Union realms can now head to the Divine Realm. Supreme Sovereigns need to wait a little longer," Heavenly Slaughter suddenly said.
"Yes, thank you, Heavenly Slaughter Realm Master!"
A Divine Venerate martial artist said with joy before instantly entering the Earth Shadow Realm.
Seeing this, others swiftly entered the Earth Shadow Realm, heading to the Divine Realm.
Ao Ming grew anxious, as he and the four True Spirits he led were all Supreme Sovereign Realm, meaning they could not yet enter the Earth Shadow Realm to arrive in the Divine Realm.
"Once the tremors weaken further, you can enter. Entering now could easily provoke an assault from the Earth Shadow Realm's principles," Heavenly Slaughter finished speaking then turned and left.
Jiang Feng smiled and also turned to leave.
Once the Realm Masters left, Ao Ming instantly resumed his True Dragon form, with tremendous Dragon Might, issuing a dragon's roar. The four True Spirits he led also erupted with might, letting out roars of their own.
Ao Ming's gaze towards the other Supreme Sovereigns carried a strong warning.
The other Supreme Sovereigns stayed silent, quietly waiting for the chance to head to the Divine Realm.
...
In the Divine Realm, the shaking of the Domain had started to subside.
Martial artists breaking through to the Heavenly Union realm were becoming more numerous, and somewhere in the Taihe Realm, a young man was slitting the throat of another who had just broken through to the Heavenly Union realm not long before, letting the blood pour over him.
"Jiang Buping, your end is coming. Yan'er, I will definitely revive you!"
His eyes bloodshot, the young man's expression was ferocious and twisted.
"You are close to becoming the invincible one in the Heavenly Union realm, kid, at this time, you must stay calm," the voice of Blood Extreme echoed in the young man's Divine Soul.
In the Qinghua state, three years had passed since Xu Yan's seclusion.
The undercurrents in the outside world hardly affected Qinghua state, and Emperor Da Yue and his two companions had become martial artists in the mid-stage of the Heavenly Union realm.
Meng Chong, Su Lingxiu, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping were also intensely cultivating, and their strengths had significantly increased.

chapters.title: Chapter 947 - 492: Mighty Sky Limitless, Xu Yan Breaks Through to the Domain Realm
chapters.content:
"Xu Yan is about to break through."
After returning from the Great Wilderness, Li Xuan revealed a look of relief.
Xu Yan is about to break through to the Heaven and Earth Realm.
"With Xu Yan's Sword Dao, various Divine Skills, and his Taoist Body, although his strength is not as supreme upon entering the Heaven and Earth Realm, he is still capable of slaying a Divine Venerate."
Li Xuan had a rough estimation of Xu Yan's strength after his breakthrough.
After all, Xu Yan is not an ordinary martial artist, but a true prodigy. With his powerful Sword Dao and various Divine Skills, slaying a Divine Venerate is within his reach.
And with the Yin Yang Undying Sword Divine Ability, ordinary Supreme Sovereigns would find it difficult to injure Xu Yan.
Once Xu Yan makes a minor achievement in the Heaven and Earth Realm, even Supreme Sovereigns will no longer be a threat to him. Once he reaches a great achievement in the realm, he will have the power to slay Supreme Sovereigns.
Upon complete perfection of the Heaven and Earth Realm, crushing Supreme Sovereigns and sweeping through the invincible will be a matter of course.
"Wu Tianan is quite interesting!"
Li Xuan glanced at Wu Tianan, who was in closed-door cultivation. Ever since learning that his own martial arts guide was in the Dao Realm, Wu Tianan had felt his own insignificance.
He was now desperately cultivating and had changed his past style of conduct by actively coming forward to ask for advice on martial arts questions.
"He has reached the Heavenly Union Realm, pretty quick indeed!"
Li Xuan sighed, Wu Tianan indeed had the fortune of a son of destiny.
The more the heaven and earth undergo change, the faster his cultivation speed becomes.
Li Xuan looked up at the Dao Realm, "Interesting. Is this the legacy left by Taicang, to cultivate a new Master of Domain?"
Wu Tianan's martial arts guide has a deep connection with Taicang; otherwise, he wouldn't have received such generosity from Taicang.
Li Xuan reached out and grabbed, and a Divine Artifact flew over from Fang Hao's Qimen Institute. With a casual wipe, the Divine Artifact turned thin, like a piece of paper.
Next, he waved his hand, and patterns began to emerge on the paper. In just an instant, all the patterns of the Heaven and Earth Laws from the Book of Taicang were imprinted on the paper.
He waved his hand again, and the paper landed in Wu Tianan's hands.
"Contemplate it well."
"Thank you, senior!"
Wu Tianan was incredibly excited.
The Book of Taicang was now of little use, no longer able to turn someone into the Master of Domain, especially since the current heaven and earth was no longer Taicang, but the Great Wilderness.
Since the appearance of the Heavenly Dao, the heaven and earth had already changed.
The Book of Taicang was merely a powerful heaven and earth scripture, unable to make one the Master of Domain.
Since it was a legacy left by Taicang, and Wu Tianan had become a son of destiny with a deep connection to Li Xuan himself, he decided to guide Wu Tianan with the Book of Taicang.
The strength of the Great Wilderness had seen immense improvement. Xu Junhe had broken through to the Divine Skill Realm, and there were more martial artists in the Divine Origin Realm.
The Heavenly Dao Rules had already spread into the Spiritual Realm. Tian Zi was transforming the Spiritual Realm to make all beings and martial artists within aware of the Heavenly Dao.
They understand to contemplate and cultivate the Heavenly Dao.
Tian Zi had shed most of the shackles on him.
Martial artists of the Spiritual Realm, below the Grandmaster level, began to convert to cultivate the Great Wilderness Martial Arts, while those above Grandmaster level had their martial foundations not purely based on Taicang Martial Arts due to their comprehension of the Heavenly Dao.
But neither did they practice Great Wilderness Martial Arts. If they found a balance between the two and contemplated the Heavenly Dao, they could enhance their strength without the limitations of the heaven and earth.
The Divine Refinement Realm was no longer the ceiling.
Condensation Law Heavenly Venerable would also be born in the Spiritual Realm, which meant that the martial artists of the Spiritual Realm would also sincerely comprehend the Heavenly Dao. This was an unstoppable trend that would rapidly change the martial arts concepts of those in the Spiritual Realm in a short span of time.
These changes were unknown to the Realm Masters in the Dao Realm, who were still pondering how to obtain more Domain Authority, even dreaming of becoming the new Master of Domain.
Tian Zi, being the spirit of the heaven and earth, wielded Domain Authority second only to Taicang.
Now, having become the Heavenly Dao, once he operates the entire Domain, even if Taicang were to be reborn, he would not be able to control this Domain after its transformation.
For Li Xuan, he was an onlooker to the currents in the world. He would either not take action, or when he did, it would erase his enemies in the blink of an eye.
"The threat from the Imperishable Temple has yet to emerge, so the Taoist Ancestor still has time to grow stronger. After further breakthroughs, even the Imperishable Temple can be wiped out with a single slap!"
Li Xuan muttered to himself.
If he couldn't eradicate his enemies with a single slap, it would affect his image as the unparalleled Taoist Ancestor.
"Your disciple Meng Chong has comprehended the Mighty Sky Limitless Indestructible Body, and you have broken through to the Mighty Sky Limitless Indestructible Body!"
The Daoist Golden Book opened, and golden light surged forth.
Meng Chong finally comprehended the Mighty Sky Limitless Indestructible Body, and his Physical Body Martial Arts were also elevated to the level of the Establishing Dao Realm.
"The feeling of becoming stronger is indeed exhilarating!"
Li Xuan was in high spirits.
"Ao!"
Suddenly, a dragon's roar echoed.
Many martial artists looked up to see a blue-backed, white-bodied True Dragon rising into the air. It let out a dragon's cry and circling in the sky.
"Hahaha, I've become a dragon, I've finally transformed into a True Dragon!"
An excited, thrilled voice bellowed.
Yu Xiaolong felt his own strength and circled in the sky, his head instinctively turning towards the direction of the Nine Mountains, wondering if contending for the position of Great Demon King was a possibility?
Ao!
He excitedly let out one roar after another, with Dragon Might stirring and spiraling in mid-air.
"Shut it!"
Suddenly, a cold snort came, startling Yu Xiaolong so much that his dragon body shivered.
"What's going on? I've already become a dragon; why am I still suppressed by her?"
Yu Xiaolong wore a puzzled expression.
He shrank his body and descended, looking perplexedly at Ao Yuxue who walked out of the house.

chapters.title: Chapter 948 - 492 Mighty Sky Limitless, Xu Yan Breaks Through to the Domain Realm_2
chapters.content:
As Ao Yuxue had said, he had transformed into a True Dragon, but he still couldn't shapeshift.
"Off you go, you mongrel dragon!"
Ao Yuxue waved her hand to shoo him away.
Yu Xiaolong left, feeling depressed. He resolved to continue consolidating his realm, and once it was fully consolidated, he could return to the Nine Mountain Realm and attempt to contend for the position of Great Demon King.
Li Xuan watched Yu Xiaolong and couldn't help shaking his head; he was indeed clever, using the Great Demon Method to exchange a drop of True Dragon blood from Ao Yuxue, which led to his transformation into a True Dragon.
However, ultimately he was not a born True Dragon but rather one whose bloodline had evolved later in life, hence he had lost some of the special abilities of True Dragons, such as the ability to transform into human form.
Moreover, he would still be suppressed by Ao Yuxue.
"Challenge Red Cat for the Great Demon King position? That's just asking for a beating!"
