Li Xuan shook his head; Yu Xiaolong had indeed become much stronger after transforming into a True Dragon and had a significant deterrence over spirit beasts. Nonetheless, to contend with Red Cat, he was still far from an equal match.
Red Cat's strength had improved a lot. As the top Great Demon, he possessed some special abilities, and if Yu Xiaolong challenged Red Cat, he was bound to be beaten quite miserably.
"Xin Mengrou returned to the Taimiao Realm, huh? With my guidance, she should have been able to integrate the Illusionary Path with the Supreme Sovereign Path, right?"
Li Xuan looked up towards a certain area of the Dao Realm.
"Xiaoyao is indeed extraordinary, no wonder he's known as the leader of the Taicang Seven Heroes."
Li Xuan then glanced towards where Old Man Xiao was in seclusion.
Old Man Xiao was pondering the Heavenly Dao and had made some achievements.
However, he was still very far from breaking through his limitations and paving the way forward, but he had ultimately seen hope.
This meant that understanding the Heavenly Dao and cultivating it was the correct path.
One could imagine how excited Old Man Xiao was.
The Taicang Seven Heroes were once the renowned prodigies of the Taicang Domain and had received Taicang's personal guidance. Although Taicang never formally took them as disciples, they could nonetheless be regarded as Taicang's students.
Old Man Xiao was the leader of the Taicang Seven Heroes, the foremost among the second generation of strong individuals. Now, of the Taicang Seven Heroes, aside from Old Man Xiao, only one other remained within the Taicang Domain.
The whereabouts of the other five, whether dead or alive, were unknown, and Li Xuan naturally did not concern himself with these matters.
"Warriors will soon arrive in the Dao Realm."
Li Xuan looked towards the location of the Taihe Realm. The tremors from the fall of the Earth Shadow Realm were starting to weaken, indicating that warriors from the Dao Realm were about to descend, including True Dragons.
Xu Yan's descent had caused quite a stir.
Li Xuan was not bothered by this. Even if the True Dragon Realm Master himself were to come, Li Xuan could easily handle him; after all, he possessed the Xiang Long Dao.
Xiang Long, to him, was but a casual gesture.
Ao Yuxue shuffled over, looking timid and hesitant to speak.
Li Xuan smiled wryly, "If you have any questions, just ask!"
"Thank you, Taoist Ancestor!"
Ao Yuxue was overjoyed and somewhat excited.
"I have some doubts about the Great Demon Technique; I've always been unable to grasp it fully and would like to ask the Taoist Ancestor for some guidance."
Ao Yuxue looked at him with hopeful eyes.
"What are the doubts?"
Li Xuan smiled warmly.
"Well, I am a True Dragon, and the Great Demon Technique is indeed suitable for me, but I always seem to hit a bottleneck when I practice, unable to integrate it..."
Ao Yuxue explained the problems she encountered.
The True Dragon Clan had their own techniques, some of which, classified as natural abilities, were born from bloodline.
As Ao Yuxue was a Jade Snow True Dragon, her technique was frosty thunder, extraordinarily unique—her innate True Dragon ability.
Besides the innate abilities, the True Dragon Clan also had techniques that could be cultivated, created by the ancestor of True Dragons, Ao Hong. After all, Ao Hong was the first intelligent being Taicang encountered; naturally, they exchanged thoughts, and thus began the creation of the True Dragon Techniques for their clan.
Yet the True Dragon Techniques were not like those of martial artists that could be practiced to advance through realms; the strength of a True Dragon was tied to their bloodline. The higher the quality of the bloodline, the stronger the dragon, and True Dragon Techniques were more akin to combat or defensive techniques.
They were similar to martial artists' martial skills and secret techniques, whereas the Great Demon Method was something that could be practiced and improved, unrestricted by bloodline. As long as one had enough talent, insight, or even diligence, building up strength over time, they could continuously grow stronger.
This was why Ao Yuxue was willing to exchange a drop of True Dragon blood for the Great Demon Method from Yu Xiaolong.
As for Ao Yuxue's doubts, Li Xuan did know some of the reasons. It was simply that Ao Yuxue was too powerful, even stronger than the present Red Cat.
The Great Demon Technique, as perceived by Red Cat, had a clear direction of cultivation but was still bound by some limitations, making it difficult to surpass Red Cat's current realm.
After all, even Red Cat had not yet cultivated the more profound Great Demon Technique.
Moreover, Ao Yuxue was a True Dragon, and to cultivate the Great Demon Method, it required time to settle down; it couldn't be achieved in one fell swoop.
"Settle down, don't rush to achieve success, from beginning to end, thoroughly comprehend the Great Demon Method, like the Great Demon patterns, start with the first one and slowly integrate it into yourself."
"Once you have thoroughly comprehended its mysteries, you will naturally be able to combine and understand it as one. In practising a technique, avoid impatience," Li Xuan said with a smile.
"I understand!"
Ao Yuxue pondered for a moment, then nodded respectfully.
"Since you wish to cultivate the Great Demon Martial Arts, you should start from the beginning, polish the Great Demon foundation, and once enough has settled, the time will be ripe for a breakthrough.
"The Law of Great Demon Martial Arts, whether for True Spirits or Spirit Beasts, the Great Demon Technique they cultivate are all unique.
"Being a True Dragon, once you comprehend the Great Demon Martial Arts, you may try to integrate your innate skills into the Great Demon Martial Arts, and you will naturally cultivate, a Divine Ability unique to you," Li Xuan instructed Ao Yuxue.
"Many thanks, Taoist Ancestor!"
Overjoyed, Ao Yuxue respectfully retreated and then entered closed-door cultivation to ponder the Great Demon Martial Arts.
"It's about to happen!"
Li Xuan looked towards Xu Yan's closed-door cultivation spot full of anticipation.
"Huh, there seems to be a somewhat capable fellow arriving, and what is that by his side? A True Spirit? This True Spirit is quite interesting."
Li Xuan suddenly directed his gaze towards the Taihe Realm.
Just now, an unfamiliar powerhouse had stepped into the Divine Realm.
Coming from the Earth Shadow Realm, the Earth Shadow Realm was still trembling. Theoretically, it should be impossible to pass through the Earth Shadow Realm and descend into the Divine Realm.
Yet the individual had arrived ahead of time, clearly possessing some special method that allowed them to smoothly transit through the Earth Shadow Realm without being obstructed by its Principles.
"Skilled in stealth and hiding, accompanied by a special True Spirit, these must be people from the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, and their strength is not weak. Could they be targeting me?" Li Xuan pondered thoughtfully.
The strength of the newcomer, though far from matching Old Man Xiao's, was evident in their skill at hidden movement and stealth, coupled with the aid of a special True Spirit, clearly specializing in sneak attacks and assassination.
"Let alone a mere warrior from the Supreme Sovereign Realm, even if a Realm Master came, I would slap them to death!" Li Xuan chuckled, not in the slightest bit concerned.
All of a sudden, an energy surged forth, ripples spread through the Domain, Laws of Heaven and Earth emerged, Dao Principles appeared, and the Rhythms of Domain filled the air.
Old Man Xiao, who had been contemplating the energy of the Heavenly Dao, instantly appeared in the courtyard, looking in surprise towards the source of the disturbance.
"A breakthrough is occurring."
Li Xuan watched in silence as Xu Yan was on the verge of breaking through into the Domain Realm.
Using his body as a Domain, the act of breaking through caused an extraordinary phenomenon in Heaven and Earth, as if the Domain Dao Rule sensed the emergence of a new Domain.
Yet it could not discern where the new Domain lay or why a new Domain was being born, hence the appearance of the extraordinary phenomena, and that was all.
If the Heavenly Dao were present, it would have locked onto Xu Yan's existence the instant it occurred; however, at present, there were only passive signs of such phenomena, and their scope was limited.
The phenomena did not last long before they returned to calm, as if the Domain Dao Rule had lost its sensation.
Old Man Xiao was astounded and couldn't help but ask respectfully, "Taoist Ancestor, what was that just now?"
"It was merely some extraordinary phenomena caused by the breakthrough. This Domain is incomplete, lacking the Heavenly Dao, hence such an occurrence," Li Xuan casually explained.
"I see!"
With an epiphany, Old Man Xiao was internally shocked at the thought of how powerful Xu Yan would become after this breakthrough.
Capable of slaying a Divine Venerate?
"May I ask, Taoist Ancestor, what realm Xu Yan has broken through to?" Old Man Xiao asked curiously.
"The Domain Realm!"
Li Xuan said indifferently.
Old Man Xiao was momentarily stunned, the name 'Domain Realm' echoing in his mind as he faintly began to understand the extraordinary nature of this realm.
"The breakthrough succeeded!"
Li Xuan beamed with joy; Xu Yan had broken through to the Domain Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 949 - 493: Minor Achievement in Establishing Dao, The Might of the Great Demon King
chapters.content:
In the secluded room, Xu Yan finally took that step, as if pushing open a great door, entering a new domain.
Amidst the booming sound, his entire being was undergoing ascension and transformation.
The Mountain and River Taoist Body shimmered with radiance, a domain was born within his body, Divine Skills transformed into the Laws of Heaven and Earth, and the boundless power of the domain surged forth.
The Spirit Pedestal transformed into something akin to the firmament, with the Primordial Spirit perched above the domain, yet seemingly merged into it.
I am the domain, and the domain is me.
With my body as the domain, with Divine Skills as the principles!
Xu Yan sensed the changes of the breakthrough, the mysteries of the domain, the true essence of the principles, numerous insights flooding his mind, feeling as if only now had he truly embarked on the path of Martial Arts.
"I am one step closer to transcending the domain, one step closer to standing shoulder to shoulder with him."
Xu Yan thought excitedly.
In the wilderness, he saw that towering figure, immensely powerful, whom he could only look up to; now, he was getting closer and closer to that figure's level.
Xu Yan also knew the identity of that towering figure.
Taicang!
The Master of the Taicang Domain, also the founder of this domain, but he had already perished.
"Taicang was only stronger than me, but not strong enough, which is why he perished. Whereas I, Xu Yan, will surpass him, becoming invincible, second only to my master!"
Xu Yan's blood boiled with excitement, his heart surging with waves, setting a Martial Arts goal, a goal he would strive for all his life.
As for surpassing his master, Xu Yan had no longer any extravagant hopes, that was an unscalable peak; being able to match 50% of his master's strength at the same level was enough to make him proud.
Since he can't surpass his master, then he'll be the greatest second to his master!
Xu Yan was immersed in the enlightenment of breaking through the Domain Realm, also solidifying the realm after the breakthrough.
With the breakthrough to the Domain Realm, the Wisdom Sword Realm was also perfected this moment.
The Holy Sword Realm was within reach.
Various Divine Skills were also being enhanced and breaking through, while the Yin Yang Undying Sword has now transformed into the Yin Yang Embrace, perpetually living within the domain, its defensive and offensive powers vastly improved and transformed.
"With my current strength, to subdue Ao Yuxue again, I could do it with a wave of my hand, and if I encounter a mature True Dragon, I could subdue it too, and it wouldn't take much effort."
Xu Yan assessed his current strength internally.
The Subduing Dragon Palm, using the subduing of dragons as its principle, while a mature True Dragon's weakest was at Divine Venerate Realm, but with Xu Yan's current strength, subduing a Divine Venerate Realm True Dragon was not difficult anymore.
"A Supreme Sovereign Realm True Dragon does surpass my strength, but with the Subduing Dragon Palm, I can still contend against it, though I can't subdue it, I can still handle it."
Xu Yan made a rough judgment of his Subduing Dragon's Power.
If an ordinary Martial Artist practiced the Subduing Dragon Palm, naturally, they couldn't easily subdue dragons, nor could they achieve victory over a stronger opponent, subduing a True Dragon.
However, Xu Yan was not an ordinary Martial Artist; when he employed the Subduing Dragon Palm, he possessed the power to overcome the strong and subdue True Dragons.
Especially after his breakthrough to the Domain Realm, his Divine Skills were enhanced, casting eighteen True Dragons endowed with Divine Skill to engage a Supreme Sovereign Realm True Dragon, there should be no problem.
He might not subdue it, but he could withstand the threat of the True Dragon.
As for consumption, Xu Yan after breaking through to the Domain Realm, was least afraid of fighting a war of attrition.
"However, even among Supreme Sovereign Realm True Dragons, there are different levels of strength, with my current strength, facing a Supreme Sovereign Realm True Dragon, it's still somewhat difficult."
Xu Yan understood that among Martial Artists of the same realm there are strengths and weaknesses, and sometimes the differences can be very great, and the True Dragons are naturally no exception; within the same realm, the strengths are not the same.
Even so, Xu Yan was confident, even if he couldn't defeat them, he could easily escape.
After breaking through to the Domain Realm, his Vanishing Thought Divine Ability grew stronger, he could leave if he wanted to, mere Supreme Sovereigns couldn't stop him, they couldn't even track his whereabouts, let alone pursue him.
"Let's see how many True Dragons will come."
Xu Yan muttered to himself.
If Ao Yuxue's grandfather comes personally, he surely couldn't contend with him, but with his master there, he wasn't worried at all, even having an opportunity to witness how his master subdued dragons.
As Xu Yan broke through, feedback from the Daoist Golden Book also followed.
"Your disciple Xu Yan, practicing the Martial Arts techniques you compiled and breaking through to the Domain Realm, your Establishing Dao Realm has achieved a Minor Achievement, amplifying the Domain a hundredfold!"
Li Xuan was in a great mood, the feeling of power enhancement was the greatest joy in the world.
The Establishing Dao Realm achieved a Minor Achievement.
Even though it was only a minor breakthrough in the realm, the strength enhancement it brought was enormous.
"Your disciple's Wisdom Sword Realm is perfected, your Holy Sword Realm has achieved a Minor Achievement!"
The Daoist Golden Book continued to give feedback.
"How are your insights into the Heavenly Dao?"
Li Xuan, in a good mood, felt like giving some guidance to Old Man Xiao.
"I have made some gains!"
Old Man Xiao, hearing this, immediately got excited.
"Heavenly Dao, indeed the path for us!"
"Do you have any doubts?"
Li Xuan asked with a smile.
Old Man Xiao, hearing this, excitedly and respectfully said, "I have some doubts, please, Taoist Ancestor, enlighten me."
"Speak!"
Li Xuan nodded.
Old Man Xiao eagerly recounted his insights and doubts about the Heavenly Dao, requesting guidance.
Li Xuan gave some advice, and Old Man Xiao immediately felt an enlightenment, respectfully thanked him, and hastily returned to his seclusion to comprehend the energy of the Heavenly Dao.
"It's time to prepare the next level of Martial Arts Techniques."
Li Xuan exhaled.
The realm above Establishing Dao Realm had actually already been compiled, but Li Xuan was not satisfied with just that, he continuously refined, striving to perfect it while maintaining its power.

chapters.title: Chapter 950 - 493: Minor Achievement in Establishing Dao, The Majesty of the Great Demon King_2
chapters.content:
Xu Yan had recently broken through the Domain Realm, and Meng Chong, Su Lingxiu, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping all began preparing for their breakthroughs.
Of course, it would take some time for the four to achieve their breakthroughs.
Fang Hao continued to set up and strengthen the Qinghua Sect Great Formation, constantly refining his Domain Qimen Realm and transforming it into the Qimen Principle to construct the Qimen Domain.
This was a lengthy process. Using the Qinghua state as his training ground, Fang Hao continued to set up and reinforce the formation. As he traveled, he laid down the Qimen Grand Formation, reflecting on himself and building the Qimen Domain.
Su Lingxiu's Alchemical Medical Martial Arts had broken through to the Domain Realm. The alchemical medical domain she constructed was both vibrant with life and ablaze with fire. She used the Domain Divine Furnace as her training ground to enhance her own laws of the domain.
Meng Chong practiced Physical Body Martial Arts, and his physical domain was naturally different, especially unique in its display of physical strength and dominance.
Jiang Buping was quite unique. Extreme Soul Martial Arts was the path of the ultimate divine soul, which bore no theories of the domain.
However, the Domain Realm of Extreme Soul Martial Arts also had its uniqueness, undergoing further transformation, rendering the divine soul as solid as the domain, leaving no trace of the divine soul's physical form.
Li Xuan looked up at the Nine Mountain Realm where a battle was currently erupting, extremely fierce, and far surpassing the power of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
"Yu Xiaolong always fails to recognize his own limits!"
Li Xuan shook his head. Red Cat, after all, was the top Great Demon of the Great Demon Martial Arts and being the pet of a Taoist Ancestor like himself, the position of Great Demon King was not for others to disturb.
Yu Xiaolong was purely asking for trouble!
In the Nine Mountain Realm, a Splendid Giant Tiger erupted with immense Demon's Might. Above its head, a halo of demonic aura even lingered.
Opposite the Splendid Giant Tiger was a True Dragon with a green back and white belly, also rolling in demonic aura and bursting with dragon might.
"You're itching for a fight, thinking that just because you've become a True Dragon, you can challenge my position as Great Demon King?"
Red Cat scoffed.
Back on Canglan Island, he had been able to suppress Yu Xiaolong, and now he could do so even more!
Yu Xiaolong suddenly regretted it. He realized that Red Cat's Great Demon's Might was somewhat terrifying, and there was a vague aura that suppressed him.
"Impulsive, weren't you?"
Despite having made his stance clear, he could only proceed with the battle to determine a winner.
"The position of Great Demon King was originally judged by strength, and now I feel stronger than you. Why can't I be the Great Demon King?"
Yu Xiaolong said calmly.
"I, Red Cat, indeed said that the position of Great Demon King was based on strength. Back then, I was stronger than you and Little Ha, so naturally, I was the boss.
"However, since you think that becoming a long dragon means you can overpower me and contest the position of boss, I'm not necessarily opposed."
"But you must bear the consequences of failure!"
Red Cat scoffed again.
Ao!
Yu Xiaolong let out a dragon's roar. The rest of the watching Demon Marquises and Demon Generals all trembled, feeling a suppression from their bloodline and divine soul.
"How powerful!"
The Wind Spirit Tiger was incredibly shocked.
When it first met Yu Xiaolong, its strength was far inferior to its own. In just this short period, it had been far outstripped.
The Wind Spirit Tiger couldn't help but look at Red Cat, somewhat worried that Red Cat wouldn't withstand the attack and the position of Great Demon King would change hands.
However, Red Cat was of the same clan and they had a better relationship, so naturally, it hoped that Red Cat would win.
Roar!
Red Cat let out a tiger's roar. In this moment, his tiger might was vast, and unlike ordinary tiger might, it contained a boundless Great Demon's Might.
As if the fierce intent of an unparalleled Great Demon was revealed at this moment.
"Today, I'll use you to test my new Divine Skills!"
Red Cat chuckled, his tiger body shook, and amidst a burst of light, three identical figures of Red Cat emerged.
Each figure of Red Cat rolled in demonic aura, their Great Demon's Might vast, and each displayed different Great Demon Abilities.
Boom!
The battle erupted instantly. In just a short time, Yu Xiaolong was smashed to the ground.
"How did you get stronger again, why aren't you suppressed by my Dragon Might?"
Yu Xiaolong looked frustrated.
"Merely Dragon Might, how could it suppress me!"
Red Cat scoffed and said, "Don't forget, I'm a big cat raised by a Taoist Ancestor, and also the Great Demon King, not just any ordinary Spirit Beast or True Spirit!"
Yu Xiaolong's heart sank, regretting even more. How could he forget that Red Cat, this guy, was raised by his own master.
That was a Taoist Ancestor!
Boom!
The battle continued, and Yu Xiaolong was repeatedly smashed to the ground.
"I give up, I give up. I'm no longer contending for the position of Great Demon King!"
Yu Xiaolong hurriedly conceded.
"Concede? I'm not stopping until I've had my fill of beating you up!"
Red Cat sneered maliciously as he pounced on Yu Xiaolong, launching a brutal beating.
Once everything had calmed down, Yu Xiaolong lay collapsed on the ground, feeling as if all his bones were about to shatter, his face a picture of tearless despair.
"Great King's divine might!"
Wind Spirit Tiger roared excitedly.
The rest of the Demon Marshals and Generals also erupted in earth-shaking roars, "Great King's divine might!"
Red Cat sat on a golden, gleaming chair, his face full of satisfaction, proud of the Demon Clan he had established.
"As of today, our Demon Clan has twelve Demon Marquises, and I hope you all soon enhance your strength and steady your feet amidst these major changes in the world!"
Red Cat looked down at the Demon Marshals below him.
"Yes, Great King!"
Red Cat looked up towards the Qinghua State, muttering to himself, "It's time to return. I've been away too long; what if my master has forgotten me?"
Currently, the Divine Realm was in turmoil, the world was changing, and as the Dao Realm merged with the Divine Realm, the Demon Clan would inevitably face challenges.
He must return and please his master, as having a powerful patron was essential for the continuous strengthening of the Demon Clan.
Just as he was about to delegate responsibilities to the Demon Generals and Marshals to guard their territories and make a trip back to Qinghua State, Red Cat suddenly looked to the left.
Little Ha also quickly looked up.
Yu Xiaolong, still limp on the ground, also raised his head.
"Demon Clan? These spirit beasts, all gathered here, seem indeed a bit different. They might actually be useful."
Two figures floated over.
Upon seeing them, Wind Spirit Tiger and the others instantly tensed, shock flashing through them.
Heavenly Union Realm Warriors!
"Wanbao Alliance?"
Wind Spirit Tiger said in a deep voice.
"Wind Spirit Tiger? One of the twelve Spirit Beast Kings? Submit to me. I have been looking for a mount to ride; you will do, otherwise, die!" said one of the Heavenly Union Realm Warriors, surprised for a moment before speaking sternly.
"No, wait, is that a True Dragon on the ground? Since when did another True Dragon arrive in the Divine Realm?"
Another Wanbao Alliance strongman exclaimed in surprise.
"It is a True Dragon, and it doesn't seem too strong? Capture him!"
The two Wanbao Alliance Heavenly Union Realm Warriors' eyes gleamed with excitement.
"You two dare to trespass into my Demon Clan's territory and disregard me, the king? You owe me an explanation, or don't even think about leaving!"
Red Cat stood up from his chair and said coldly.
These two warriors from the Wanbao Alliance completely ignored him, an affront that Red Cat, the Great Demon King, could hardly tolerate.
"Wanbao Alliance warriors, and from the Heavenly Union Realm? Could they be here for Meng Chong?"
Red Cat wondered internally.
Wanbao Alliance's arch enemy, undoubtedly, was Meng Chong.
Now that they've likely broken through the limit of the Immortal Realm, they probably think they're strong enough to seek revenge on Meng Chong.
"You call yourself the Great Demon King? Xu Yan Xiang Long, today I shall subdue the Demon King and also make a statement in the Divine Realm!"
One of the Heavenly Union Realm Warriors laughed heartily.
Feeling stronger, more confident, and bolder, his arrogance soared.
Moreover, within the Divine Realm, so far, only those in the Taihe Realm can break through the limit of the Immortal Realm. The Nine Mountains Realm still can't.
Therefore, in his view, no matter how strong this Great Demon King might be, he is merely a monstrosity within the Immortal Realm; there's no way he could possess Heavenly Union Realm strength.
"Seeking death!"
Red Cat roared furiously.
With a swipe of his tiger claw and unsheathing of his great sword, he slashed violently.
"Having cultivated the Blade Path until now, today is indeed an opportunity to prove its mettle!"
With one strike from Red Cat, the complexions of the two Wanbao Alliance strongmen drastically changed as they frantically joined forces to fend off the attack.
"How could you..."
The two were furiously astonished; the Great Demon King's strength was so formidable, it was beyond what should be possible for the Immortal Realm.
Moreover, he was a spirit beast, so how could he possibly cultivate sword techniques?
And this sword technique was extremely domineering and powerful!
"Frogs at the bottom of a well, how could you know this king's strength? Today I shall slay a Heavenly Union Realm Warrior to demonstrate the might of the Demon King!"
Red Cat sneered coldly.
As his great sword cleaved through, demonic energy surged tumultuously and furiously. Within just a few exchanges, a head soared into the air.

chapters.title: Chapter 951 - 494: Go to Qinghua State, Find Xu Yan to Regain Honor!
chapters.content:
A Heavenly Union Realm Warrior fell right there.
Another Wanbao Alliance Martial Artist, looking terrified, turned around to flee.
"Where do you think you're going!"
With a cold chuckle, Red Cat moved and blocked the other's path.
Seeing no escape, the Wanbao Alliance powerhouse clenched his teeth, steeled his heart, and let out a furious roar, as if he was about to fight Red Cat to the death, but suddenly he dove downward, unleashing a powerful aura. His attack was aimed at Yu Xiaolong on the ground.
Yu Xiaolong: ???
Red Cat was also stunned. What was this guy doing? Wasn't he supposed to be fighting with him? Why was he attacking Yu Xiaolong instead?
Did he know that Yu Xiaolong was the Second Demon King and was trying to take this opportunity to kill the Second Demon King, so he had a cushion to die on?
Howl!
Yu Xiaolong, feeling the urge to cry, let out a dragon's cry. His body instantly shrank, turned into a streak of blue light, and vanished from the spot in an instant.
In haste, and having just been severely beaten by Red Cat, he couldn't withstand such a powerful strike and could only dodge.
"You can't hide!"
The Wanbao Alliance Martial Artist, with blood-red eyes, directly used a secret technique that greatly harmed his essence, and in an instant, he attacked Yu Xiaolong again.
"Even if I die, I will take the Demon Clan down with me along with the fall of the True Dragon!"
The Wanbao Alliance Martial Artist screamed wildly.
Yu Xiaolong almost spat out blood from frustration. Although he was a True Dragon, he had no relations with the True Dragon Clan. Even if he died, the True Dragon Clan wouldn't spare him a second glance, let alone avenge him!
Unfortunately, the Wanbao Alliance Martial Artist didn't know this.
All he knew was that he was undoubtedly going to die that day.
And this True Dragon had clearly been injured, most certainly by the Demon Clan. Why would the True Dragon Clan let this slide if a True Dragon fell in the Demon Clan's territory?
They would surely seek revenge. With this, although he would die, the True Dragon would avenge him.
This news getting out would ensure he left a significant mark in the history of Martial Arts, becoming one of its legends.
In this moment of life and death, the Wanbao Alliance Martial Artist had a burst of inspiration, his mind clearer than ever. Instead of fighting the Great Demon King and being killed in the end, it was better to take a different path. Even in death, he'd have the True Dragon avenge him. He wouldn't die in vain!
"Block him quickly!"
Yu Xiaolong turned pale. What kind of maniac was this!
Gua!
Little Ha opened his mouth, and in an instant, a wave of demonic energy enveloped Yu Xiaolong, pulling him away, dodging the fatal strike.
The Wanbao Alliance Martial Artist wanted to erupt again, but Red Cat no longer gave him the chance.
A furious blade light descended instantly, overwhelming him within it.
As the blade light faded, the warrior did not fall, but lay on the ground full of wounds, completely powerless to resist or flee.
"Die!"
Having regained his composure, Yu Xiaolong lifted his claw, ready to finish the man.
Snap!
Instead, Red Cat slapped him to the ground with a tiger's claw.
"He can't die yet!"
Yu Xiaolong felt extremely frustrated. He had thought that keeping the foe alive was so he could personally deal with him, but that wasn't the case!
"Why not?"
Red Cat chuckled and said, "These two guys are from Wanbao Alliance and appeared here. Guess who they were targeting?"
Yu Xiaolong was taken aback, then realized that the Wanbao Alliance powerhouse had broken through and felt confident again, so he was probably seeking revenge on Meng Chong!
"Long live the King!"
The Demon Marshals and Demon Generals cheered, with Wind Spirit Tiger shouting the loudest.
Red Cat was quite pleased. To become a Demon Marshal or General, one needed a clever mind. This batch of Demon Marshals and Generals was up to par.
Red Cat was even more satisfied with Wind Spirit Tiger's performance, worthy of having received his guidance, much more clever than before.
"I need to return for a while. You two hold steady and take charge of the Demon Clan!"
Red Cat said to Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha.
"Gua!"
Little Ha yelled, indicating he wanted to go back too.
"Then let's go together."
Red Cat nodded, then proceeded to arrange matters for the Demon Clan, leaving Yu Xiaolong, the Second Demon King, to continue overseeing the Demon Clan.
Taihe Realm.
Boom!
Following a violent tremor, the Dao Realm emerged, and the spiritual energy surged, causing a Spirit Qi Storm to gush out from the fallen Earth Shadow Realm, sweeping towards the entire Divine Realm.
The Heaven and Earth Laws appeared, and the Power of Principles grew stronger, spreading across other thirty-seven Realms of the Divine Realm along with the Dao Realm.
The Divine Realm was merging with the Dao Realm.
The entire Domain started to change.
As this Spirit Qi Storm went on, spreading the Dao Realm across the Divine Realm, all Realms except the Taihe Realm had their Martial Arts upper limits shattered.
And some Martial Artists at a bottleneck would break through in this moment of intensified spiritual energy and emerging Dao Realm, stepping into new Realms.
The Divine Realm would also witness the emergence of several Immortal Heavenly Venerable Martial Artists in a short period of time.
Many warriors stuck before Immortal Realm, who had been honing their skills in Truth Refinement Realm for ages, would also break through their constraints and achieve Immortality amid these great changes!
The Divine Realm was entering a new era, and a group of Heavenly Union Realm Warriors had already convened, discussing a journey to Qinghua Realm to seek vengeance against Xu Yan for the humiliation.
In a deeply secluded forest, Tian Shiqi was hiding, extremely cautious, afraid that someone from Qinghua Realm might come to kill him.
Suddenly, a shadow-like figure appeared out of a hazy fog, silently appearing before him.
"My lord!"
Suddenly, Tian Shiqi's expression tightened as he hastily bowed respectfully.
Yin Jue appeared like a shadow, capable of disappearing at any moment, his voice elusive, making it impossible to determine where it was coming from.

chapters.title: Chapter 952 - 494: Going to Qinghua State, Find Xu Yan to Avenge the Humiliation!_2
chapters.content:
"Where is Xu Yan, and what is the situation?"
Tian Shiqi replied respectfully, "My lord, Xu Yan is in the Qinghua state, and he has brought that True Dragon back to the Qinghua state as well. As for the specifics, it remains unknown for now. The Qinghua state is sealed, and no information can be transmitted out."
"The Qinghua state?"
Yin Jue muttered to himself and then said, "I need to make a trip to the Qinghua state, but I can't go there directly. You need to create some disturbances."
If there indeed were Realm Master Realm experts within the Qinghua state, even with the help of the True Spirit of the Fog Beast, he still risked exposing himself. This was why disturbances needed to be created to blend in better.
"Yes, my lord, I know what to do."
Tian Shiqi pondered for a moment and then had an idea.
"In the Divine Realm, an Immortal Heavenly Venerable has broken through the limits and entered the Heavenly Union Realm. Many of them hold grudges against Xu Yan and intend to seek revenge for the shame he once brought upon them. If we give them a push from behind and have them join forces to invade the Qinghua state and challenge Xu Yan, it would create an opportunity for my lord," Tian Shiqi said.
Yin Jue nodded, "Let it be so. Seventeen, your ability to handle matters is still passable, or Lord Heavenly Slaughter wouldn't have sent you to the Divine Realm to take charge of this important matter."
"You flatter me, my lord."
Tian Shiqi spoke modestly.
"The stability of the Earth Shadow Realm won't last long; we must complete this before the rest of the powers' Martial Artists enter the Divine Realm. Act quickly."
After Yin Jue finished speaking, his figure disappeared without a trace as if he had never appeared.
Tian Shiqi sighed inwardly. Such a mysterious and superb technique of concealment was possessed by only two or three individuals in the entire Earth Shadow, aside from the enigmatic Earth Shadow Realm Master.
"It's Lord Yin Jue!"
Tian Shiqi concluded in his mind.
The fact that Lord Yin Jue had been sent showed the importance attached to the person behind Xu Yan.
"It's time to act."
Tian Shiqi began making arrangements.
In a certain place within the Divine Realm, several Heavenly Union Realm Warriors gathered.
"Gentlemen, have you considered it thoroughly? Do you really want to seek out Xu Yan to wipe away the humiliation?" one Martial Artist asked gravely.
"Of course, we do!" another said coldly. "Do you willingly accept such disgrace? Don't you want to break the chains in our hearts and rid ourselves of Xu Yan's influence?"
"Now that the Divine Realm and Dao Realm are merging, we all have a chance to reach higher realms. The Divine Venerate Realm is not unattainable."
"But, if we don't remove the influence Xu Yan has on our minds, it will surely have a significant impact on our cultivation. Are you content to remain trapped in the Heavenly Union Realm forever?"
"Just like before, in the Immortal Realm, when we couldn't advance an inch, we could only wait desperately for the opening of the Heavenly Ladder to have the opportunity to enter the Dao Realm."
"Whether it's to avenge our past shame or to break through our mental barriers, we cannot back down any longer!"
The more he spoke, the angrier he became, his face turning red and his breathing becoming heavy.
Upon hearing this, the other several Heavenly Union Realm Warriors also began breathing heavily, the scene from the Taimiao Realm playing out in their minds.
Xu Yan alone had scolded the many Immortal Heavenly Venerables and suppressed them so heavily that they hardly dared to breathe, all the while forcing smiles upon their faces.
Since breaking through the Immortal Realm, which one of them hadn't been superior, holding sway over the world? When had they ever been subjected to such humiliation?
It was unbelievable that the scene from back then hadn't impacted their minds.
"You're right. Whether it's for revenge or to break through mental barriers, we must seek out Xu Yan for an explanation. Otherwise, we will never step out of his shadow for the rest of our lives!"
Someone immediately agreed.
It was as if an invisible hand was stirring all this, one after another Heavenly Union Realm Warrior gathered, all for the sake of seeking justice from Xu Yan.
As more and more people gathered, everyone's courage grew. Their strength had already changed significantly. Could they still be afraid of Xu Yan?
Moreover, they had all been at the peak of the Immortal Realm for many years, merely restricted by the limits of martial arts in the Divine Realm, unable to break through. Only after the limit was lifted were they able to advance so swiftly.
Xu Yan was so young with such monstrous strength, it was unthinkable. There was absolutely no way his strength could have surged so significantly again in just a few short years.
Furthermore, at the beginning of the great change in the Divine Realm, Xu Yan had returned to the Qinghua state, and it was uncertain whether the Qinghua state could surpass the limits of the Immortal Realm now.
"These people alone don't make enough of an impact."
Tian Shiqi pondered, "We should bring the Wanbao Alliance into this as well, Meng Chong is also in the Qinghua state."
With this thought, Tian Shiqi began to maneuver behind the scenes.
Not long after, when the Heavenly Union Realm Warriors discussed the date to join forces and go to the Qinghua state to seek revenge against Xu Yan, the experts of the Wanbao Alliance actually offered a high price, inviting a group of Heavenly Union Realm Warriors to cheer for the Wanbao Alliance after arriving in the Qinghua state!
Naturally, the warriors readily agreed, as suppressing Xu Yan and Meng Chong was just a matter of convenience.
As the group of Heavenly Union Realm Experts prepared to head to Qinghua state in a grand manner, the news spread, and many Immortal Heavenly Venerables also joined in.
Behind this, Tian Shiqi's manipulation was unsurprisingly involved, knowing that both Xu Yan and Meng Chong had offended many powers in their revenge against Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
Now that an opportunity had arisen, how could they not join in?
Soon after, the Upper Sect from the Taikun Realm also had strong warriors joining in, targeting Jiang Buping!
Initially forced to submit to Jiang Buping's strength, the newly appointed Sect Master and several elders have now broken through to the Heavenly Union Realm, and it was time to settle past humiliations!
"The Jiang Family has taken no action at all."
Tian Shiqi was somewhat surprised.
After a moment's thought, it seemed only natural.
After all, the Jiang Family was from the Taikun Realm under Realm Master Jiang Feng in the Divine Realm, and Jiang Buping was a descendant of Jiang Feng; the Jiang Family would not act rashly now and needed someone from the Dao Realm to arrive before deciding.
After all, Jiang Buping was an exceptional talent rarely seen in the Jiang Family of the Taikun Realm and would surely be favored by the elders of the Jiang Family in the Taikun Realm.
At this time, targeting Jiang Buping would inevitably provoke the ire of the elders of the Jiang Family in the Taikun Realm.
"Let's go to the Qinghua state to find Xu Yan and wash away our shame!"
The formidable procession, akin to a campaign against a heinous criminal, headed towards the Qinghua state in a grand manner, creating momentum and applying pressure all along the way.
In the crowd, a young man with a long saber on his back marched silently, his eyes occasionally glancing forward, emitting a crimson light filled with brutality.
The long saber on his back was wrapped in leather, tightly sealed, with not even the handle exposed.
The accompanying warriors found the young man's actions of carrying the saber rather strange, wondering why it was not kept in a Storage Bag, but in the Martial Arts Realm, there were plenty who had odd habits, and simply carrying a saber was nothing unusual.
"Boy, find an opportunity to hunt down Immortal Heavenly Venerables, refine the Blood Prison Demon Blade, the more you blood refine, the stronger the blade becomes. With this blade, you can resist Jiang Buping's Divine Soul Secret Technique; this is one of the extremely powerful secret techniques of the Blood Demon Path!"
A voice echoed in the young man's Divine Soul.
"Don't worry, ancestor, I know."
The young man replied.
"Hmm, you can achieve great things, not like that useless boy from the Jiang Family!"
Blood Extreme said approvingly.
Thinking of Jiang Tianming, he felt a pang at the loss of a part of his Divine Soul, which had perished because of this.
In some sense, that Jiang Buping was his nemesis as well!
The grand procession of experts, and the Immortal Heavenly Venerables who gathered along the way, kept increasing in number. While most were there to watch the commotion, their sheer number made the scene even more impressive than the hunt for the True Dragon.
"You!"
An Immortal Heavenly Venerable had just left the group to take care of some matters before continuing to enjoy the spectacle when suddenly a crimson and translucent long saber pierced his chest.
Vital blood was draining, and a mist of blood arose, as if in an instant, his blood started to boil.
Puff!
An Immortal Heavenly Venerable fell on the spot. The youth withdrew his blade, dealt with the dried-up corpse, then wrapped the crimson and translucent long saber back in leather, sealing it tightly once more.
The disappearance of a few Immortal Heavenly Venerables within the group that sought revenge on Xu Yan didn't raise any suspicion, as it was reasonable for some not to continue following.
"What is this?"
Yin Jue, hiding within the group, glanced at the young man, his brow furrowing slightly.
"The Netherworld Blood Demon Path, is it a maneuver by one of the Blood Lords or perhaps the Blood Master?"
Yin Jue studied the young man thoughtfully for a long while, "A Blood Demon Substitute seed, which Blood Master has infiltrated and intends to cultivate a substitute in the Divine Realm?"
Since it was a Blood Master manipulating from behind the scenes, Yin Jue had no intention of intervening. His mission was to hunt down Xu Yan's master, and the infiltration of the Netherworld would naturally be dealt with by other experts.

chapters.title: Chapter 953 - 495: Sword God Rides the Dragon, a Band of Frolicking Clowns
chapters.content:
Divine Realm, a majestic troop of powerful beings, surged toward the Qinghua state like a force stirring up storm clouds. As the Earth Shadow Realm fell, a Spirit Qi Storm emerged, carrying the essence of Dao throughout the Divine Realm. They set off toward the Qinghua state, moving as if they bore the great trend of heaven and earth.
The realm gates between the various realms of the Divine Realm vanished amidst the great changes, swept by the essence of Dao, leaving no gates between realms.
The wilderness, too, became normal, connecting all realms together, unifying the Thirty-six Realms.
Traveling from the Nine Mountains Realm to the Qinghua state, one could first see the anomaly of the Qinghua state, almost like it was an independent domain unto itself.
It was due to the coverage of the Qinghua Great Formation over the entire Qinghua state. Although the realm gates no longer existed, entrance to the Qinghua state still had to be through its portals.
Unless one forcibly broke through the Qinghua Great Formation.
As the momentum grew ever more massive, the entire Martial Arts Realm was shaken. Even warriors below the Immortal Realm were abuzz with discussion, all watching the outcome of this battle.
The mighty army of powerful beings took on a name, the Vengeance Alliance!
They even shouted a slogan: Slay the Sword God, capture the True Dragon, and avenge our former disgrace!
When the news reached the Qinghua state, everyone fell silent.
"Is this because their strength has improved, and they think they're capable now?"
Li Xuan couldn't help but sigh; the cultivation of these warriors' mental state was lacking. Could they get so arrogant so easily?
His disciples, in terms of strength, in terms of cultivation speed, crushed these people, yet remained steady and stable, not showing the slightest bit of arrogance.
"Truly, I, as a Taoist Ancestor, have taught them well."
Li Xuan sighed to himself.
As for the overwhelming Vengeance Alliance army, it was nothing but a farce. Once Xu Yan took action, they would realize what real power was.
"It infuriates me! Young Master Xu is such a good person, where did he wrong them? To think they want to join forces to attack Young Master Xu!"
"If only I weren't a bit less powerful, I would have wiped them out myself!"
Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao were indignant.
"That's not right. My family's Meng Chong is also very fierce, why isn't there a campaign to take him down?"
Zi Yun sounded puzzled.
Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao gave her a look.
Soon after, news came that another slogan was spreading within the Vengeance Alliance: The Wanbao Alliance is here to subdue the Heavenly God and avenge our past disgrace!
"I knew it, Meng Chong is also fierce. How could there be no one wanting to take revenge on him? Sure enough, the Wanbao Alliance has stepped forward."
Zi Yun spoke as if a burden had been lifted, as if it would be abnormal if no one sought to retaliate against Meng Chong.
"What do we do now? That Vengeance Alliance has an overwhelming momentum, with numerous warriors."
Du Yuying frowned.
"For Senior Brother Xu, this is but a trifle."
Zi Yun said with a smile.
"But Young Master Xu is in seclusion. It wouldn't be right to emerge just because of this, would it?"
Yun Miaomiao knit her brows.
"How about asking Elder Xiao to take action?"
Yue'er came over and suggested.
The Vengeance Alliance contained numerous warriors from the Heavenly Union Realm, and with the current strength of the Qinghua Sect, they were incapable of resisting. Aside from Xu Yan and a few others, only Old Man Xiao could stand against so many powerful beings.
Obviously, such a minor matter wouldn't warrant the intervention of a Taoist Ancestor.
"Meow meow!"
Red Cat had returned. Since Su Lingxiu was in seclusion and unavailable, it could only continue to curry favor with its master.
"You big cat, instead of staying within your Demon Clan, why have you run back here?"
Li Xuan looked at Red Cat rubbing against his leg and was speechless.
A Great Demon King acting like a chubby cat trying to act cute.
But it had to be said, Red Cat was exceptionally shrewd, knowing exactly whom to please and how to bring joy.
"Meow meow!"
Red Cat acted cute and then drew out a bunch of various Divine Medicines and Spirit Fruits. These delicacies included rare ingredients suitable for making things like Spirit Cakes.
It handed them all over to Cai Ling'er in one go.
"You big cat, you're so thoughtful."
Li Xuan chuckled. Red Cat was clearly there to secure its backing.
The Vengeance Alliance army had entered the Nine Mountains Realm. Although the Demon Clan was not weak and Yu Xiaolong was powerful, facing so many Heavenly Union Realm warriors, they had to keep a low profile.
The Twelve Demon Marquises and a host of Demon Generals all kept a low profile, not daring to display any hint of their demon might, even finding places to hide temporarily.
"I should hide too. If they discover this True Dragon, they will surely chase me down to kill me."
Yu Xiaolong was thoroughly dejected.
He shrank his form and hid himself away.
Seeing the so-called Demon Clan cowering and hiding, not daring to show a trace of power, the Vengeance Alliance warriors grew even more emboldened, with the attitude of suppressing the world and sweeping away all invincibles.
"The Qinghua state is not far now!"
A Heavenly Union Realm Warrior exclaimed spiritedly, as if holding the world in his hands.
But the memory of having to nod and smile submissively in the face of Xu Yan's might, and the eagerness to suck up to him, only made them feel more humiliated, strengthening their resolve to wash away their past disgrace!
"Friends, follow me to press down on the Qinghua state and intimidate that young Xu Yan!"
With a grand gesture, his voice thundered like a tempest.
"Slay the Sword God, capture the True Dragon, avenge our former disgrace, young Xu Yan come out and face your death!"
The throng of Heavenly Union Realm warriors, red-faced, began to roar as well, their voice like thunder shaking the heavens and earth, travelling far and wide.
While the mighty ones headed for the Qinghua state, their booming voices aimed to shock Xu Yan into submission.
Dahai Mountain.
The mighty of the Wan Family were all cowering, fearing being recognized as having ties with Xu Yan and attracting a catastrophe!
"Brother Xu, truly an exceptional prodigy!"

chapters.title: Chapter 954 - 495: Sword God Riding a Dragon Appears, A Group of Jumping Clowns_2
chapters.content:
Wan Tianlin couldn't help but sigh.
Being able to provoke such numerous strong characters to hunt him down, throughout the ages, who else could accomplish this?
Only Xu Yan!
"Alright, I'll make a trip!"
Old Man Xiao had also received the news and decided to make a trip, to deter the newcomers.
Owing a great favor to the Taoist Ancestor for his guidance, it was only right to do a small favor in return.
"No need!"
Xu Yan's voice rang out.
"Young Master Xu, have you broken through?"
Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao were overjoyed.
"Yes!"
Xu Yan nodded.
"Just a bunch of annoying flies, no need to disturb Master's peace, I will go to the Nine Mountain Realm and suppress them."
Xu Yan let out a cold laugh.
Meng Chong also emerged from seclusion, rubbing his head, and revealed a fierce smile, "The Wanbao Alliance has grown bold again, huh? Thinking that just by breaking through to the Heavenly Union Realm, they can seek revenge against me?"
Su Lingxiu emerged from seclusion as well, excitement coloring her face as she awaited the drama.
"Meow meow!"
Red Cat ran over.
"Ah, Red Cat you're back!"
Su Lingxiu was thrilled and reached out to rub Red Cat's chubby head.
Quack!
Little Ha let out a soft call and jumped onto Fang Hao's shoulder.
Xu Yan was ready to take action, and Wu Tianan, Moon Changming among others, had emerged from their seclusion, all with faces full of anticipation.
Emperor Da Yue, Feng Yan, and other powerful members of the Qinghua Sect were also in high spirits.
The Nine Mountain Realm, with the alliance intent on revenge, marched grandly towards the Qinghua state, with a momentum as unstoppable as a rainbow, stirring the heavens and the earth, and even the vibrations of the world itself were weakened by this mighty force.
The roars of "slay the Sword God, capture the True Dragon, and avenge our past humiliation" thundered like raging thunder, carrying an unstoppable force impelling them towards the Qinghua state.
Suddenly, a dragon's roar echoed from the horizon.
The Dragon Might was vast, gathering wind and clouds, scattering the great forces rushing forward under its vigorous surge.
The warriors of the alliance focused their gaze, and saw in the Qinghua state's horizon, a pure white True Dragon appearing, advancing against the force they had unleashed.
Atop the head of the True Dragon, a handsome young man stood proudly.
Sword God Xu Yan!
Ao Yuxue regretted at that moment, thinking she should have kept Yu Xiaolong, the mixed breed dragon, in Qinghua state so Xu Yan would have chosen to ride it to the Nine Mountain Realm rather than choosing her.
However, what infuriated her more were those from the revenging alliance. Had they not kept shouting "slay the Sword God, capture the True Dragon," Xu Yan wouldn't have thought to make his entrance in this manner.
The warriors of the alliance fell silent in an instant, the power of the True Dragon, the power of Xu Yan, truly facing them now, instinctively made their hearts skip a beat.
Looking at the young man standing proudly on the head of the True Dragon, for a moment, the grand procession fell silent.
From the dragon-defeating young man to today's dragon-riding young man, history had never seen such a prodigy in the Martial Arts!
On the edge of the Qinghua state, the young man stood on the dragon's head, facing the crowd of warriors proudly, letting the storm surge around him with a thunderous presence, yet his expression remained unchanged.
The Qinghua Great Formation had been temporarily withdrawn by Fang Hao, so the warriors of the alliance had not noticed anything special about the Qinghua state.
However, Yin Jue furrowed his brows, gazing into the Qinghua state and showing a look of surprise.
The Qinghua state seemed somewhat amiss.
"Xu Yan, you humiliated us greatly in those days, today we've come to wash away our humiliation. You have two choices: either kneel and apologize, offering up the True Dragon, or be slain by us!"
A leader, temporarily chosen from among the alliance, stepped forward and shouted sternly.
As he spoke, with a thunderous roar, his aura burst forth, unmistakably revealing the mighty presence of a Heavenly Union Realm Warrior.
"Xu Yan, even though you might defeat me, do you think you can defeat all of us?"
As his words ended, the warriors of the alliance burst forth with their auras, truly changing the color of the heavens and the earth, their immense forces stirring the domain.
This part of the domain, as if completely merged with the warriors, was entirely under their control.
Although Ao Yuxue was a True Dragon and stronger than anyone from the alliance, facing so many Heavenly Union Realm warriors, she too felt intense pressure.
If they really had to fight, even though she was a True Dragon, she could only avoid the sharp edges, because once she was surrounded, it would be extremely dangerous.
Xu Yan sneered with contempt, "A bunch of clowns who jump up, thinking they are competent just because their strength has improved? I, Xu Yan, will not bully you—I give you two choices."
'One, kneel on the ground and kowtow in apology for three days and nights, and I will spare your lives; two, you will be reduced to ashes!'
'Insolent boy!'
The Alliance Hierarch was furious and said coldly, "Which of us has not cultivated for lengthy years, and which has not been honed in the Immortal Realm for over a thousand years? Now that we have broken through today, our deep foundation and strong strength, can you, a little boy, even fathom?"
"Together, even if it is the Divine Venerate Realm, we can still fight. Xu Yan, are you perhaps a Divine Venerate?"
Xu Yan smiled coldly, "Practicing for a long time doesn't mean you are formidable, it just means you are rubbish, needing such a long time to cultivate to this level of strength."
'A bunch of garbage, and you dare to be arrogant?'
The Emperor Da Yue and a few others felt somewhat embarrassed; they too had cultivated for a long time to achieve their current strength and, compared to Xu Yan, they indeed seemed like rubbish.
However, their expressions did not change, still complacent, the "rubbish" Xu Yan referred to wasn't them but those fellows in front of them.
They themselves had cultivated Divine Skills, how could they not be stronger than those fellows before them!
'Very well, insolent boy, today I must slay you!'
The Alliance Hierarch and a group of Heavenly Union Realm Warriors were so angry their faces turned green, as if someone had revealed their embarrassing secrets.
'Who will slay this boy, Xu Yan!'
The Alliance Hierarch turned back and asked the powerful fighters.
Silence!
For a moment, the crowd fell silent, the warriors exchanged looks, and not one dared step forward to fight.
After all, the scene of Xu Yan's 'Dragon Might', especially that immense sword light, deterred them from harboring any other thoughts, casting a significant shadow in their hearts.
Coming here, each and everyone had a burst of momentum, as if ready for a big battle with Xu Yan for three hundred rounds, but when the moment came to face him alone, their confidence waned.
The face of the Alliance Hierarch darkened; it was too embarrassing, a real disgrace!
Old disgraces not yet avenged, and now new disgraces added!
'Leader, you are acknowledged as the strongest among us; it is right for you to fight first!'
One Heavenly Union Realm Warrior said earnestly.
'I am the Leader, the strongest; how can I fight first?'
The Alliance Hierarch retorted glaring.
The onlookers from the Qinghua Sect inwardly sighed, Xu Yan's fearsome power was so strong that not a single person dared to fight him.
Even though they had broken through to the Heavenly Union Realm, when they truly faced Xu Yan, they all cowered.
Xu Yan sneered, "Come at me all at once."
Upon hearing this, the warriors of the Wanbao Alliance became furious, their faces flushed red, and one Heavenly Union Realm Warrior burst forth, "Let me see what strength the Sword God possesses!"
As he spoke, his aura surged, and he immediately charged at Xu Yan.
He unleashed a tremendously powerful killing move from the start. The air around condensed into a huge fist, smashing toward the True Dragon Xu Yan's head.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The moment he made his move, it was like a frenzy, one punch after another, each punch stronger than the last, and he even used a secret technique, going so far as to burn his own essence blood.
The ferocious punch, booming and echoing, covered a broad area, completely engulfing Xu Yan, seemingly trying to block all his paths of retreat completely.
'Good!'
The Alliance Hierarch roared excitedly.
The others also roared, glad that someone was finally willing to test the waters. This was a good thing, and this warrior was truly brave to wager his life from the start, showing deep enmity toward Xu Yan!
Xu Yan's expression remained unchanged; without even moving a hand, sword light emerged out of nowhere with his thought, wave after wave, dense as raindrops drifting down.
Each strand of sword light contained a killing intent of the Sword Intent.
Pff! Pff!
Every punch was chopped away, while the endless sword light continued to pour forth.
'Who has confused this man's mind, who is manipulating behind the scenes?'
Xu Yan looked into the crowd but saw no trace related to the Seductive Witch.
With such mind-confusing power, Xu Yan immediately thought of the Seductive Witch, who also possessed that strength.
Yin Jue, during the burst of the Alliance warriors, the stirring of the heavenly and earthly elements, quietly left the crowd, concealed to the other side, gradually approaching Qinghua Realm, looking for his target.
Suddenly, Yin Jue's gaze sharpened; he had spotted someone!

chapters.title: Chapter 955 - 496: The Might of the Domain, The Avenger Comes
chapters.content:
"It's him!"
Yin Jue felt surprised, yet not very surprised, as he had already speculated it might be him.
"Indeed, only he would have the means to cultivate such an extraordinary genius. What is he planning? Should I retreat now, report back to Lord Heavenly Slaughter, or take a risk?"
Yin Jue found himself in a dilemma.
He turned to look at Xu Yan, who was standing on the True Dragon's head; at this moment, the Heavenly Union Realm Warrior who had acted was already reduced to ashes.
"Or perhaps, I should kill his disciple?"
Yin Jue pondered.
Killing Xu Yan, he was confident he had a ten out of ten certainty.
His gaze towards the Qinghua state, Yin Jue made a decision.
"Go to Qinghua state to see what exactly he's planning there, get a clear picture, and if the Realm Master makes a move, then it'll be more assured."
Thinking this, Yin Jue concealed his tracks and slowly increased his distance, avoiding detection.
Now that he was here, he decided to enter Qinghua state from another location.
As for Xu Yan, there was no need to kill him immediately; he could wait until after understanding the situation in Qinghua state before finding an opportunity to kill him.
Under the assistance of the True Spirit Beast, Yin Jue silently moved, slowly leaving to find a suitable entry point into Qinghua state.
Xu Yan coldly looked towards the Snow Shame Alliance, "Attack together, or you stand no chance!"
The members of the Snow Shame Alliance were shocked, wondering why Xu Yan was so strong, as he had just killed a Heavenly Union Realm Warrior who had used a secret technique, which was a life-threatening one that burst out with tremendous strength?
"Attack, strike together!"
There was no turning back now.
The leader of the Snow Shame Alliance spoke in a solemn voice.
Boom!
One after another, Heavenly Union Realm Warriors stepped forward, their momentum surging, their vital energy linking. At this moment, they formed an allied force, as if they were the very domain they stood in.
It seemed only by shattering this domain could they defeat them!
"Xu Yan, although you are powerful, as we join together, we also fear you not!"
The leader of the Snow Shame Alliance had a resolute look, prepared to go all out.
"Oh, let's have you witness today, what's called the might of the domain."
Xu Yan smiled faintly.
He raised his hand, and with a booming sound, the domain shook, an awe-inspiring might suddenly descended, accompanied by what seemed to be another domain.
The might of the heavens surged, thunder roaring, all things transformed into fierce sword lights. In an instant, sword light enveloped the domain, and the intent of obliteration covered all directions.
"We of the Wanbao Alliance did not come targeting you, Young Master Xu, please don't misunderstand!"
Suddenly, some Heavenly Union Realm Warriors from the Wanbao Alliance, wiping the cold sweat from their foreheads, stepped back.
"Oh, if not targeting me, perhaps you came to enjoy the spectacle?"
Xu Yan's expression was indifferent.
"We, indeed, came to present treasures to Young Master Meng!"
Hong Yi wiped the cold sweat off his forehead, his mind sparking with a quick thought.
"Yes, yes, we came to present treasures to Young Master Meng!"
The rest of the Wanbao Alliance warriors hastily nodded in agreement.
In the rush of distancing themselves from other warriors, their forms swiftly retreated. At this moment, the notion of vengeance was far from their minds; a warrior of Taihe Realm felt as trivial as a grasshopper, simply charging to their deaths.
"You of the Wanbao Alliance are as timid as mice!"
The leader of the Snow Shame Alliance and others glared furiously.
"What timid as mice, our Wanbao Alliance has always held great admiration for Xu Yan's conquering, rescuing the Divine Realm from peril, hence the contempt for your deeds!
"To come along with you was only meant to assist Young Master Xu at the critical moment. Did you really think our Wanbao Alliance would side with you?
"Young Master Xu's divine might overshadows the world. He naturally doesn't need us to intervene, and now is the perfect moment to delineate our stance from you and reveal the truth!"
Hong Yi spoke righteously.
The leader of the Snow Shame Alliance and others almost spewed blood, the Wanbao Alliance's bastards, simply turncoats!
Su Lingxiu and the others were stunned.
The warriors of the Wanbao Alliance were so timely in their understanding?
Meng Chong touched his head, stepping forward, and sneered: "I have heard that you from the Wanbao Alliance came to suppress the Heavenly Gods and cleanse past shames!"
"It's absolutely not the case, that's not what our Wanbao Alliance spread. It's the despicable lot from Snow Shame Alliance, borrowing the name of our Wanbao Alliance, trying to drag our Wanbao Alliance into the water, Young Master Meng, please see clearly!"
Hong Yi and other Wanbao Alliance warriors saw Meng Chong with each step taken, heightening by ten feet. In mere moments, he transformed into a giant, like a heavenly god, his presence terrifying.
At this point, Meng Chong was incomparably stronger than when he had been in the Taikun Realm.
Hong Yi and others' hearts trembled, on one hand condemning the Snow Shame Alliance's despicable and shameful tactics, misusing the name of the Wanbao Alliance, intending to frame and doom the Wanbao Alliance by using Meng Chong's hand, truly despicable.
Meanwhile, they flattered Meng Chong incessantly, with cold sweat dripping from their foreheads. They hurriedly took out treasures.
"Young Master Meng, Hero Meng, every word we speak is from the heart. We indeed came here to deliver treasures!"
Hong Yi hastily took out an ancient relic.
"This is an ancient relic accidentally discovered by our Wanbao Alliance in the Divine Realm. This item seems to possess mysteries, but with our low cultivation and shallow insight, we ultimately couldn't fathom its mysteries. Therefore, we specially came to present it to Young Master Meng!"
"Yes, yes, we all came to deliver treasures."
The rest of the Wanbao Alliance warriors nodded repeatedly, hurriedly taking out their cherished treasures.
True to the Wanbao Alliance's top warriors, the treasures they held were all extraordinary, including ancient relics. As for the mysteries of these relics, it's unknown, but they definitely had some special qualities.
"Since you came to deliver treasures, then I will accept them!"
Meng Chong nodded his head, acknowledging that those from the Wanbao Alliance were indeed sensible.

chapters.title: Chapter 956 - 496: The Might of the Domain, The Avenger Arrives_2
chapters.content:
"Thank you, Young Master Meng!"
Hong Yi and the others were filled with gratitude, so moved that tears almost streamed down their faces.
On the other hand, the Alliance Hierarchs of the Shame-Vanquishing Alliance wore expressions of grim determination, showing the resolve to fight to the death. At this point, they couldn't retreat as the Wanbao Alliance had.
The slogans of slaying the Sword God and capturing the True Dragon had been chanted until every Divine Realm Warrior knew them, while the slogans of the Wanbao Alliance had only been shouted briefly and were considered merely incidental.
Besides, the Wanbao Alliance could pin all of this on them, but they could not do the same.
Xu Yan was a man of great ferocity. Since he had offered two paths and they had not cherished them, now their only option was a desperate fight, where perhaps there was a fraction of a chance for victory.
"Kill!"
The warriors of the Shame-Vanquishing Alliance roared in unison, attacking together. Their powerful strikes shook the heavens and the earth, sending ripples across all directions, as a deep humming sound resonated throughout the Domain.
Between heaven and earth, a gigantic, ferocious mouth appeared, swallowing everything in its path as if it sought to devour both the heavens and earth along with Xu Yan.
"Should we retreat?"
Ao Yuxue felt her heart pounding with fear.
This strike was too powerful. She couldn't withstand it; her only option was to dodge its edge.
After all, she was not yet of age, a mere young dragon, whose strength was merely at the Heavenly Union Realm.
"Trivial tricks," Xu Yan said, his expression unchanged as he simply pointed forward. Suddenly, heavenly might transformed into a sword, silent and seemingly effortless, yet it was as if it had been born from the heavens and earth itself.
The sword lightly sliced through the ferocious mouth, then gently, like a mild breeze, brushed past the warriors of the Shame-Vanquishing Alliance.
"This is the power of the Domain Realm, huh? This sword could slay a Divine Venerate!"
Old Man Xiao was inwardly shocked, unable to help but silently sigh.
Xu Yan's sword seemed ordinary, as gentle as a mild breeze, but the mystery within the stroke was such that even a Divine Venerate Realm Warrior would find it difficult to withstand!
The outcome of the battle was naturally without surprise. Just as Xu Yan had said, these Heavenly Union Realm warriors were merely jesters.
Old Man Xiao turned and left.
Everyone was silently watching at this moment, even Ao Yuxue could not help but widen her eyes, fixating on the group of Heavenly Union Realm warriors.
Peace had returned to the Domain, the heavenly might had dissipated, and the overwhelming aura had vanished.
At this moment, everyone was silently watching.
Even those Immortal Heavenly Venerables who had followed to spectate, or sought an opportunity to strike, were silent, their eyes filled with a touch of confusion.
Why had those Supreme Realm elites suddenly quieted down?
"Let's go!" Xu Yan spoke up.
"Ah, oh, right!"
Ao Yuxue, startled at first, immediately turned her dragon form around, ready to head back to the Qinghua state and eager to get Xu Yan off her head.
But in that moment, as she turned, something seemed to be triggered, as if a gentle breeze had risen, the silently quiet warriors of the Shame-Vanquishing Alliance suddenly turned into ashes and dissipated!
Gulp!
Hong Yi and the other Wanbao Alliance powerhouses dripped with cold sweat, their hearts trembling, feeling grateful for their own cunning.
The many Immortal Heavenly Venerables who had followed were soaked through at this moment, their clothes saturated with cold sweat, lips quivering, and their hearts shivering with fear.
"Rather provoke a True Dragon than a Sword God," someone murmured.
Xu Yan, riding the True Dragon, headed back to the Qinghua state, and Su Lingxiu and the others also prepared to return. As for those Immortal Heavenly Venerables, they were too frightened to dare enter the Qinghua state without permission.
However, just then, a figure stepped out from the crowd.
"Jiang Buping, come out and meet your death!"
The voice was cold and filled with hatred, reaching for the skies.
The people who were about to return to the Qinghua state suddenly stopped in their tracks and turned back to look.
A young man emerged from the crowd, his eyes fierce, filled with murderous intent. As he walked forward, he began to unsheathe a long blade from behind his back.
The leather-wrapped long blade began to emit a chilly aura, sinister, brutal, and bloodthirsty, as it emerged from the blade.
```
"Have you lost your mind? Didn't you see Xu Yan's strength? With your current power, you're not his match at all. Retreat quickly, and seek revenge after you've grown stronger!"
Blood Extreme was extremely agitated.
This avatar seed had yet to be fully cultivated and could not yet serve as his substitute body. He had originally thought that with his means and the Blood Prison Blade, he'd have enough power to kill Jiang Buping and avenge himself.
However, the strength displayed by Xu Yan was completely beyond expectation.
Moreover, it seemed that Jiang Buping and Xu Yan were from the same sect. If Jiang Buping was defeated, would Xu Yan not step in to help?
If Xu Yan made a move, the avatar seed would undoubtedly die.
And his remnant soul was also in danger of perishing.
Although he had been exceptionally cautious, keeping a strand of remnant soul hidden away, that strand was very weak and nearly depleted, making the prospect of its recovery almost indefinitely remote.
It could only struggle to remain barely alive, which was why Blood Extreme was so anxious.
"As long as I can kill Jiang Buping, it's good enough. With my current strength, I can definitely kill him!"
The young man's voice was close to frantic, unable to suppress the hatred in his heart, as if he was beginning to lose his reason.
"Even if you really kill Jiang Buping, you won't survive. Xu Yan will kill you!"
Blood Extreme cursed inwardly, wondering how all the people he found ended up being such fools!
"As long as I can avenge Yun Yan'er, what does death matter? I'm not afraid to die!"
The madness and uncontrollable hatred reflected in the young man's eyes.
Fuck!
Blood Extreme cursed internally. Yun Yan'er was dead, and during her life, she never so much as glanced at him properly, treating him only as a servant, yet he was willing to risk his life for her?
What kind of reasoning was that?
The hatred in the young man's eyes grew stronger, his eyes bloodshot with anger. "It's all Jiang Buping's fault. Ever since Yun Yan'er became engaged to Jiang Buping, she started to show me disdain.
"It's all because of Jiang Buping. If not for him, Yun Yan'er would have been with me long ago!"
Blood Extreme felt this guy was hopeless, starting to delude himself. He cursed his own shortsightedness for choosing such a person.
He had originally thought he could utilize someone filled with hatred to inspire madness and ruthlessness, cultivating an avatar seed more suitable for him.
Instead, he was completely consumed by illogical hatred, willing to forsake his life for so-called revenge!
"This won't do, I have to find a way to avoid this disaster!"
Blood Extreme's gaze became somber. With his current state, forcibly taking control of this body would be difficult, and would face fierce resistance. Furthermore, since the avatar seed had not yet finished cultivating, completely seizing this body would make it extremely difficult for his remnant soul to recover its strength.
"Just give me some more time to finish cultivating the seed. Why must it come to this?"
Blood Extreme felt helpless.
If the avatar seed had been finished, he wouldn't need to let it act recklessly. He could just take over the body and meld with the divine soul; but the time was not yet ripe.
"Since you insist on revenge at this moment, I will lend you a helping hand. When the crucial moment comes, remember to do as I tell you. Only then can you avenge your grudge and survive!"
Blood Extreme spoke earnestly.
"As long as I can get revenge, what does dying matter? This life is not worth cherishing, I will give it my all!"
Yet the young man was resolute.
Blood Extreme nearly cursed out loud but held back, speaking gravely, "Don't you want to live and seize the slim chance of resurrecting Yun Yan'er?"
The fanaticism paused in the young man's eyes, replaced by a longing.
"Yes, I want to resurrect Yun Yan'er. I will definitely listen to you, senior. As long as Jiang Buping is dead, I will follow your commands, no matter how slim the hope. I will do everything I can to resurrect Yun Yan'er!"
Blood Extreme felt a sigh of relief internally and said with relief, "Good, good, it's not a waste of my guidance. As long as you keep this belief, not only will you achieve your great revenge, but you will definitely be able to resurrect Yun Yan'er!"
"Activate the Blood Prison Blade, fully ignite it, stir the heavens and earth, harness the power of the Blood Prison Demon Abyss, challenge Jiang Buping to a duel, a one-on-one battle; stay away from Xu Yan, otherwise, you can't kill Jiang Buping.
"The battle of the prodigies, a one-on-one duel, use this reason. Jiang Buping will accept the challenge. Don't reveal your full strength, or if Jiang Buping sees your power is too great, he'll refuse the duel, and you will lose your chance!"
Blood Extreme began to instruct.
He was also scheming how to escape. Whether he could kill Jiang Buping or not, this avatar seed was doomed to die.
Either he would die at the hands of Jiang Buping or at the hands of Xu Yan.
Therefore, Blood Extreme started planning his escape and how to select the next avatar seed so he could recover his strength and rise again.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 957 - 497: Blood Master Remnant Soul, Capture Plan
chapters.content:
Jiang Buping frowned as he looked at the young man, his eyes showing a hint of confusion. The hatred in the man seemed to surge like a tempest, as if he held an unshareable vendetta against Jiang, yet despite wracking his brain, Jiang couldn't recall any enmity between them.
"A member of the Jiang Family?"
The first thought that came to mind was naturally the Jiang Family.
Jiang Buping immediately denied it, as there were no enemies left in the Jiang Family who might seek revenge for Jiang Tianming.
"A powerful figure from the Netherworld? The same as Jiang Tianming, could it be that all actions against me are orchestrated by him from behind the scenes?
"Have I ever wronged the Netherworld so grievously for them to target me like this?"
Jiang Buping's eyes flashed, and he immediately furrowed his brows. Within the young man's Divine Soul, a Remnant Soul lurked, the same as Jiang Tianming's.
Jiang Tianming targeted him, relying on the owner of that Remnant Soul; now, this person, overflowing with hatred and seemingly sharing an irreconcilable enmity, also harbored a Remnant Soul within his Divine Soul.
This made Jiang Buping think more deeply, how could such coincidences exist in the world?
Especially when both instances targeted him, and the perpetrator in each had the other's Remnant Soul within them.
At this thought, Jiang Buping's expression turned cold and his eyes filled with rage. Today, he was determined to expose the person behind this and demand an explanation for their targeted hostility.
What grudge do they truly hold against me!
Blood Extreme was unaware of Jiang Buping's current thoughts; otherwise, he would certainly cry foul. This was not his personal vendetta, but just an unfortunate encounter that happened to involve him.
He, Blood Extreme, was merely taking advantage of the situation to seek a chance for recovery!
Boom!
At this moment, the young man had drawn a blood-red, translucent long sword. Its aura soared to the heavens, turning the world blood-red where the sword cast its light, with the image of the Blood Prison Demon Abyss emerging between.
In the Blood Prison, the young man seemed to appear and disappear intermittently, his form sinister and malevolent as the aura of slaughter whirled around, hissing ominously.
The cohort of Immortal Heavenly Venerables were all shocked, hastily retreating.
Too terrifying!
Especially those who had just been standing next to the young man, now their faces were covered in cold sweat, overwhelmed by the fear of the aftermath.
Having such a malevolent person standing beside them was truly perilous.
And a few of the Immortal Heavenly Venerables, recalling the sudden disappearances of their peers along the way and seeing the dreadful visage of the Blood Prison Demon Abyss, turned pale, feeling fortunate that they had narrowly escaped a disaster.
The aura of the Blood Prison stirred the wind and clouds, as if transforming this part of the world into a segment of the Blood Prison, with a demon brandishing a sword standing within.
"Who are you, and what great vendetta do you have with me, Jiang Buping?"
Jiang Buping's expression was cold, as the Extreme Soul Divine Spear appeared in his hand.
The young man's power was indeed formidable, but his own strength was no longer comparable to his previous inferior state in the Taikun Realm.
Jiang Buping seemed to be questioning the young man but indeed was addressing Blood Extreme. Blood Extreme, ignorant of this, believed he could fully conceal himself by inducing the Blood Prison Demon Abyss and the Netherworld Blood Qi eruption.
