Unlike last time, Jiang Buping would not discover him.
Yet, Blood Extreme didn't know Jiang Buping had already sensed his presence.
"It's the Remnant Soul from last time."
Meng Chong said somewhat surprised.
The battle in the Taikun Realm had completely obliterated the Remnant Soul, yet today it reappeared, identical to the previous one, indicating they originated from the same powerful entity.
This implied that the Remnant Soul they had initially defeated was only a part of it.
It was even possible that the current Remnant Soul wasn't all that the deceased had left behind.
Meng Chong's suspicions were similar to Jiang Buping's, suspecting that this Remnant Soul was manipulating everything from behind the scenes, targeting Jiang Buping.
However, both he and Jiang Buping were puzzled, as a Remnant Soul of such a Supreme Expert shouldn't logically bear any grudge against Jiang Buping.
"A Netherworld Remnant Soul, and stronger than Xuewang!"
Xu Yan pondered for a moment, "Could it be the Remnant Soul of a Blood Lord?"
A Netherworld Blood Lord, a Supreme Expert of the Realm Master Realm. Within the Taicang Domain, exists a Blood Lord Remnant Soul that survived a great battle, clinging on to life?
"A Blood Lord Remnant Soul?"
Su Lingxiu's eyes lit up.
The Remnant Soul of a Realm Master Realm expert; if captured, it warranted thorough research to possibly understand what made a Divine Soul of a Realm Master Realm expert so unique and powerful compared to those of inferior Martial Artists.
Moreover, being from another Domain made it even more worthy of investigation, heightening Su Lingxiu's interest.
"Senior Brother, how powerful is this Remnant Soul, and can we capture it?"
Su Lingxiu asked excitedly.
Xu Yan pondered for a moment, saying, "That depends on the Fifth Junior Brother. With his current strengths, he is more than capable of utterly annihilating that Divine Soul.
"Of course, if it is indeed a Blood Lord Remnant Soul, it might possess some unusual secret techniques. While annihilation is feasible, capturing it will be more challenging."
A Netherworld Blood Lord, a Supreme Expert of the Realm Master Realm, was known for decisive actions and extraordinary measures, making eradication relatively simpler than capturing.
Such powerful figures would hardly suffer the indignity of falling into weaker hands; they would likely obliterate themselves in critical moments.
Moreover, if there were any other surviving Remnant Souls elsewhere, they would certainly not allow this segment to fall into enemy hands, opting for a more decisive and straightforward self-destruction.

chapters.title: Chapter 958 - 497: Blood Master Remnant Soul, Capture Plan_2
chapters.content:
"As long as there's an opportunity to capture it, that's enough!"
Su Lingxiu's eyes sparkled brightly as she took out some vessels, preparing for the capture of the Blood Master Remnant Soul, which naturally required Jiang Buping's assistance.
In terms of understanding the Divine Soul and dealing with Divine Soul secret techniques, Jiang Buping was naturally number one.
He practiced the Extreme Soul Martial Arts, and Jiang Buping's essence was that of an extreme Divine Soul, not a fleshly body.
"Fourth Junior Brother, you prepare the Formation and the Prohibition to capture this Remnant Soul, but do not let it self-destruct,"
Su Lingxiu said to Fang Hao.
"Senior Sister, rest assured. I can utilize the God-Forbidding Formation anytime, but this is a Blood Master after all. There may be some methods it can use to temporarily break free from the seals,"
Fang Hao said while a small circular disc appeared in his hand.
"Big Senior Brother, Second Senior Brother, remember to take action,"
Su Lingxiu said to Xu Yan and Meng Chong.
"Alright!"
Meng Chong said as he scratched his head.
Xu Yan said with a smile, "The Blood Master is an old fox; it will surely be on guard. However, it is just a Remnant Soul and it has to face Fifth Junior Brother. The chances of us successfully capturing it are still very high."
With a thought, silently, this section of the Domain had undergone some changes. The surroundings had already been sealed by an invisible Sword Intent.
This Sword Intent, without the slightest edge, had completely blended into the Domain, into the Spiritual Energy, and into every blade of grass. Under the upheaval of the Blood Prison Demon Abyss, no one could perceive it.
Even if it was the Blood Extreme's Remnant Soul, it was the same. Being just a Remnant Soul housed in a young body, how could it detect anything unusual?
"Fifth Junior Brother, do not destroy the Remnant Soul. I want to capture it for research,"
Su Lingxiu communicated to Jiang Buping.
"Okay!"
Jiang Buping nodded. He too wanted to know why the opponent was targeting him specifically and what past grievances they had.
"Jiang Buping, my hatred for you is deep as the ocean, we are irreconcilable enemies. Do you dare to fight!"
The youth roared murderously.
"Why wouldn't I dare? If you seek death, I, Jiang Buping, will oblige you!"
Jiang Buping said indifferently, stepping forward with the Extreme Soul Divine Spear in hand.
"But I am curious, what grievances do I, Jiang Buping, have with you? How are we irreconcilable enemies?"
The youth held the Scarlet Long Knife, his aura growing increasingly fierce and a smell of blood began to permeate, gradually around the youth the image of rolling blood waves emerged.
He stood as if amidst the turbulent waves of a Blood Sea, with the Blood Prison Demon Abyss above his head, turning the Domain where he stood into a part of the Blood Prison.
"Do you remember Yun Yan'er?"
The youth's expression was ferocious, filled with pain and hatred.
"Yun Yan'er?"
Jiang Buping raised an eyebrow, "You're not here because of her, are you? I'm curious, though. Yun Yan'er, this woman, has been mingling with Jiang Tianming. I've never heard of her having another man, nor have I heard of her being fond of someone else."
"It's all your fault!"
The youth's face became ferocious and crazed, "Yan'er was with me originally, but then your Jiang Family decided on a marriage alliance, making her your fiancée. Later, Jiang Tianming interfered, which made Yan'er distant from me!
"If not for you, Jiang Buping, with my devoted care, Yan'er would have seen my worth one day and recognized my goodness.
"Even killing Jiang Tianming would have been okay, but Yan'er was kind and beautiful. How could you bear to kill her? If you hadn't, under my care, she would have realized my goodness..."
Jiang Buping was momentarily stunned. Looking at the youth's crazed expression and the irrational demeanor, he couldn't help but sigh inwardly, "Is this what Master called 'a licking dog'? The extreme kind?"
Xu Yan and the others also wore expressions of astonishment. So, this was a madman.
The Remnant Soul was using this madman to boost his strength, targeting Jiang Buping through this madman's actions. The Remnant Soul thought it could deceive everyone and manipulate from behind the scenes without being detected.
Little did it know, its existence had already been seen through.
Blood Extreme frowned. For some reason, he had a vague feeling of impending disaster as if some crisis awaited him.
"No one should have discovered me. I've already stimulated the Blood Prison Demon Abyss, enough to disguise my presence, but why do I feel a sense of crisis?"
Blood Extreme dared not be careless.
He was a Blood Master, a renowned figure in the Path of the Blood Demon, well-experienced in life-and-death battles and highly sensitive to danger. This sudden sense of crisis certainly had its reasons.
However, Blood Extreme was completely unable to discern the origin of this crisis, and moreover, this crisis differed somewhat from the life-and-death crises he had faced before.
"Caution is paramount!"
Blood Extreme's expression was solemn, and at the same time, he cursed inwardly, why had he chosen such a bastard!
"Jiang Buping, meet your death!"
The youth, wielding a knife, charged forward as waves of blood surged tumultuously, the Blood Prison Demon Abyss devouring everything, the world tinted a blood-red color, with a scarlet long knife exploding with a sinister aura.
This sinister aura seemed capable of eroding the Divine Soul, corrupting the Divine Spirit Soul Force, capable both of slaughtering the Soul and resisting, confusing the attacks of Divine Soul secret techniques.
"It's indeed targeted at me!"
Jiang Buping's gaze was coldly sharp, emitting a chilling brilliance.
Jiang Tianming did not possess such secret techniques, and under his Extreme Soul Martial Arts, was easily slain.
The opponent had learned from the last encounter, mistakenly believing that he cultivated an immensely powerful Divine Soul Secret Technique, hence they imparted to this person the means to target Divine Soul Secret Techniques, wishing to restrain him with this.
"Unfortunately, you are mistaken, I do not cultivate the Divine Soul Secret Technique!"
Jiang Buping, with an Extreme Soul Divine Weapon in hand, in a split second, the extreme edge emerged, a crushing Extreme Soul pressure suddenly descended!
Even the distant Immortal Heavenly Venerables, in an instant, seemed to perceive a fiercely radiant Divine Spear!
What astonished them was that this Divine Spear was not seen with the eyes, but the Divine Soul, and the Divine Soul felt an extreme pressure.
It seemed as if merely touching the Divine Spear would annihilate the soul!
"Retreat quickly!"
The group of Immortal Heavenly Venerables retreated in shock.
What kind of maneuver was this, what kind of Divine Soul Secret Technique, to be so terrifying.
Thud!
The long spear released star radiance, pierced through the rolling waves of blood, penetrated the Blood Prison Demon Abyss, and tore open a sharply radiant gash in the blood-red domain.
The lance's gleam was cold, seemingly unstoppable.
"This is bad! I lend you the power of my Divine Spirit Soul Force to withstand this spear, he can only strike once; if you withstand it, you can seize this opportunity to counter-kill him!"
Blood Extreme's expression drastically changed; at this moment, he somewhat understood that what Jiang Buping had unleashed seemed not merely a Divine Soul Secret Technique!
It appeared to be a Martial Art that even he had never heard of!
At this time, Blood Extreme knew he had to escape decisively, a moment's delay would mean certain death!
Being but a Remnant Soul, facing this seemingly soul-slaughtering Martial Art, he was extremely passive and endangered, even though he was once a Blood Lord. His Remnant Soul, far beyond any ordinary Martial Artist, could not withstand it!
The youth also felt the crisis at this moment, but his eyes turned even crazier, without any intent to retreat. As soon as Blood Extreme spoke, he immediately agreed.
In an instant, a strong Divine Spirit Soul Force filled his consciousness, and he felt empowered, no longer feeling an acute crisis from this lance's gleam.
"Burn!"
However, at this moment, Blood Extreme's Divine Soul burst forth a torrent of blood-colored flames, the overpowering blood-hued radiance coalesced in an instant, fighting the Blood Prison Demon Abyss.
Boom!
The youth felt as if all the blood in his body was boiling, burning; his physical body seemed to be melting, yet he felt overwhelmingly strong.
"You must burn blood and part of the Divine Soul to drastically increase your strength, to slay Jiang Buping, your chance for revenge is in this moment!"
Blood Extreme said gravely.
As long as he could take his revenge, the youth didn't care at all, so without any resistance, his Divine Soul burned under the influence of Blood Extreme's secret technique.
There was no pain, only exhilaration and excitement, as if his greatest vengeance was being fulfilled!
Boom!
The Scarlet Long Knife, at this moment, became thinner, the air around it bursting with a more sinister and powerful breath.
"The time is now!"
Blood Extreme violently spurred the secret technique, the youth's body melted and fused with the Scarlet Long Knife, the burning Divine Soul, at this moment, seemed to become the source of power for this strike!
Swipe!
The thin blade of blood, as if tearing through the sky, amidst the gathering waves of blood, in a chorus of resentful and piercing screams, slashed towards Jiang Buping, towards the cold gleam of the spear.

chapters.title: Chapter 959 - 498: The Realm Master Still Has Some Strength
chapters.content:
The thin Blood Blade, malevolent and powerful, emitted a wail of resentment and agony that resonated from within and spread a chilling aura between heaven and earth.
The group of Immortal Heavenly Venerables who had retreated far away felt their scalps tingle and chills run down their spines.
The Blood Extreme Remnant Soul wavered a bit and then, silently, merged into the atmospheric blood light. Taking advantage of the distraction caused by the Blood Blade and Jiang Buping being blocked by it, he immediately fled.
This had been his plan all along—to instantly burn his young flesh and Divine Soul, merge into the Blood Prison Blade, and unleash a powerful strike.
And he used this to conceal his own tracks, successfully escaping in the process.
Blood Extreme was confident—this was one of his life-saving secret techniques. Under these circumstances, no one could detect the whereabouts of his Remnant Soul, allowing him to safely escape.
Boom!
Jiang Buping thrust his spear, colliding with the Blood Blade.
"Die, die, Jiang Buping, you die for me!"
The young man's resentful and mournful screams continuously emanated from the Blood Blade but gradually weakened.
"Hmph!"
Jiang Buping snorted coldly, his spear light flourishing, as the Blood Blade shattered. The malevolence and the young man's burning Divine Soul both dissolved in that moment.
"You think you can escape?"
Jiang Buping looked towards the fleeing Blood Extreme Remnant Soul.
Hum!
Suddenly, the world transformed, mountains and rivers materialized, and the Blood Extreme Remnant Soul was amidst them.
"Not good!"
At that moment, Blood Extreme's expression dramatically changed.
Thunderous Roar!
Also, at that moment, a violent aura burst forth, bright with golden light, shining upon him and making his Remnant Soul stagger.
"Get inside!"
A crisp and melodious female voice rang out.
Several jars and bottles suddenly appeared, surrounding him.
"You!"
Blood Extreme was furious, as Xu Yan and others had clearly already discovered his presence earlier and had set everything up waiting for him in order to capture him alive!
"You mere mortals, thinking to capture me, delusional!"
Blood Extreme was also decisive; he knew if he were captured, the consequences would be unpredictable, and his other part of the Remnant Soul might be discovered and completely annihilated.
Boom!
He was about to destroy his own Remnant Soul.
"Hum!"
Suddenly, a radiance enveloped him, solidifying his Remnant Soul momentarily and interrupting his self-destruction.
"Seal!"
Immediately following, a series of fine green needles pierced into his Remnant Soul, solidifying its power, which was then thoroughly sealed away.
"What kind of technique is this?"
Blood Extreme was horrified.
He had been outplayed!
"Come inside!"
Blood Extreme saw the beautiful girl in the green long dress, her face full of excitement. The look in her eyes seemed a bit off to him, giving him the chills!
"Into my jar!"
A clear jar, the likes of which he had never seen before, made from unknown materials and by unknown methods, but Blood Extreme knew that once he was inside, he would never be able to escape.
He struggled with all his might to activate his Remnant Soul; however, the green, fine needles restrained his Divine Soul, preventing him from breaking free for the moment.
Then another beam of light descended, and his Remnant Soul became stagnant again.
He could only watch helplessly as he was placed inside the jar!
Su Lingxiu was overjoyed, placing several seals on the jar and happily said, "This is a Soul Concealing Jar. Inside, even self-destruction is not possible, only the dispersal of the soul into a mass. I can easily restore the soul body, and the consciousness will not vanish."
Jiang Buping came over and stared at Blood Extreme inside the jar, saying, "Sister, once we get back, let's thoroughly interrogate him to understand what grievances he has with me, Jiang Buping, to target me like this!"
"Don't worry, brother. Sister promises to pry open his mouth and get the answers."
Su Lingxiu clenched her little fists and promised.
This storm, or maybe more fittingly called a farce, thus concluded. Everyone who had come from Qinghua state to watch felt their trip was worthwhile, having gained significantly.
Except for Ao Yuxue, Xu Yan was still standing on her head.
And those who followed the alliance for vindication, as well as the ecstatic Wanbao Alliance warriors, tearfully overwhelmed, also felt their journey was not in vain.
They felt a sense of eye-opening wonder; so mystical can Martial Arts be, so powerful can the powerful be.
The farce now over, Xu Yan and others returned to Qinghua state, those who needed to seclude themselves did so, and those poised to breakthrough did just that, knowing well that before long, warriors from the Dao Realm would arrive.
Divine Venerate Realm and even Supreme Sovereign Realm warriors, not to exclude the possibility of Realm Master Realm warriors.
Warriors from the True Dragon Clan would inevitably arrive, but Xu Yan was not very concerned about it.
He was already in the Domain Realm.
Nearing the Establishment Dao Realm, a step closer to transcending the heavens and earth.
Once in the Establishment Dao Realm, Xu Yan naturally could suppress a Realm Master, like Old Man Xiao.
After returning to Qinghua state, Emperor Da Yue and the others dispersed to handle their respective affairs, as there were not a few matters to manage for the vast Qinghua Sect.
Fang Hao, the Sect Master, was now in the phase of secluded breakthrough, having set aside all sect affairs, leaving them to Emperor Da Yue and the others.
"So this is the Blood Master Remnant Soul, indeed extraordinary to look at."
Su Lingxiu gazed at Blood Extreme inside the jar, her face alight with excitement.
"Blood Master, such a powerful being, to end up in such a predicament."
Yue'er couldn't help but remark.
She had only recently broken through to the Immortal Realm, far too detached from the Realm Master Realm warriors, even clueless about how long it might take to break through to the Realm Master Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 960 - 498: The Realm Master Does Have Some Strength_2
chapters.content:
Whether one can break through to the Realm Master Realm is an uncertainty.
And such a powerful being has ended up with only a Remnant Soul left, indeed, apart from the predecessors, no one can truly be invincible.
In Qinghua state, Yin Jue was exploring cautiously. As he delved deeper into Qinghua state, he grew more and more alarmed, his face filled with shock.
"Something's amiss, Qinghua state may not be a small domain, but it resembles one. The vibrations of the Divine Realm's domain can't affect this place at all.
"It seems there is some unique power that isolates Qinghua state from the other thirty-five realms.
"This place has broken the upper limit of the Immortal Realm, and with the Spirit Qi Storms and Dao Rhythms sweeping in, the limit will continue to rise and ultimately become akin to the Dao Realm.
"How was this achieved, what exactly is Xiaoyao scheming? Could he have found a way to become the Master of Domain?"
The more Yin Jue thought, the more terrified he became. Thinking of Xiaoyao's identity, he grew increasingly suspicious that the other party was plotting for the authority of the Domain.
"Qinghua Sect? So he founded a sect, with the headquarters located there."
In secret, Yin Jue gleaned information from the conversations among martial artists and learned about Qinghua Sect and the location of its headquarters.
"Qinghua Taoist Ancestor? Xiaoyao's ambition is not small indeed!"
Yin Jue sneered inwardly. Xiaoyao might be strong, but he's not necessarily capable of defeating Lord Heavenly Slaughter—and yet he dares to call himself a Taoist Ancestor!
"Let's go take a look at the Qinghua Sect headquarters."
Yin Jue immediately decided to explore the Qinghua Sect headquarters, especially the pills and formations the martial artists were talking about.
"With the assistance of the True Spirit of the Mist Beast to hide myself, as long as I do not approach Xiaoyao, even if he is a Realm Master, he won't discover my presence."
Yin Jue felt confident within himself.
His own art of stealth and hiding was one of the top among the Supreme Sovereign Warriors, and from a certain distance, some weaker Realm Masters would not be able to detect his presence.
Now with the help of the True Spirit of the Mist Beast, Yin Jue was confident that as long as he kept his distance and was cautious, he could surely remain undiscovered.
After all, Xiaoyao would certainly not be on guard, never having anticipated that someone would infiltrate their ranks.
Although Yin Jue was extremely powerful and could easily capture an Immortal Heavenly Venerable in silence, obtaining the information he desired, he did not do so.
Any oversight might unexpectedly expose him.
It wasn't just the Immortal Realm Warriors; even those with weaker power, Yin Jue had no intention of capturing and interrogating them. A competent infiltrator is one who eliminates all possibilities of exposure.
Therefore, Yin Jue quietly eavesdropped on the martial artists' discussions and, after obtaining useful information, began heading towards Qinghua Spirit City.
Along the way, he remained vigilant, concealed his tracks, and showed not a trace.
"Earth Shadow Supreme Sovereign? This art of hiding and infiltration is quite impressive."
Li Xuan was not the least bit interested in the farce initiated by the League for Revenge; instead, he was intrigued by Yin Jue, who had infiltrated into Qinghua state.
"What is this True Spirit? It is rather unique, capable of hiding itself and transforming into mist. If it were nighttime, it would be even harder to detect.
"Is this guy coming for me? With this art of concealment, does he think he can attempt a sneak attack?"
Li Xuan pondered to himself.
He had thought that the other party would capture an Immortal Heavenly Venerable or some other martial artist to interrogate for the information they wanted, but the other party did not do so.
This showed that the other party was extremely cautious and would not do anything before achieving his goal, anything that might cause exposure or raise alarm.
Old Man Xiao had already returned to Qinghua City still seemingly in shock, marveling at Xu Yan's martial arts strength and the mysteries of the Domain Realm. He planned to continue his retreat to meditate on the Heavenly Dao's energy and find his way forward at the earliest.
He had been stuck at the Realm Master Realm for far too long, and if he was unable to advance further and carve out a way forward, he would not have the power to challenge the Imperishable Temple.
Xu Yan and the others had come back as well, focusing intently on the Blood Extreme in the jar, discussing the uniqueness and potency of the Blood Lord's Divine Soul.
Yin Jue had also infiltrated to the outskirts of Qinghua City.
"What is this?"
Old Man Xiao suddenly halted, looking at the jar in Su Lingxiu's hands with an expression of disbelief and astonishment.
"The Blood Lord from Netherworld?"
Moreover, why does this Blood Lord look somewhat familiar?
From a distance, Yin Jue also saw the jar in Su Lingxiu's hands, his expression momentarily stunned, and a shock ran through his heart. Was the jar containing the Blood Master Remnant Soul from the Netherworld?
That was a Realm Master level powerhouse, yet, captured and confined in a jar?
This scene was too shocking.
Xu Yan, whose attention was originally all on Blood Extreme within the jar, suddenly paused, his gaze sharply turning towards a certain location outside of Qinghua Spirit City.
At that moment, Old Man Xiao, still in his state of shock, also abruptly turned his gaze in that direction.
"Damn it!"
Yin Jue realized he had been exposed.
The previous scene was too shocking; the True Spirit of the Mist Beast had fluctuated slightly, and such a small fluctuation, how could it escape the detection of Realm Master level experts, especially those at the pinnacle of Realm Masters?
"Get out here!"
Old Man Xiao's expression turned cold, even feeling somewhat humiliated. Someone had infiltrated the outskirts of Qinghua City without him noticing!
He lifted his hand and made a grabbing motion, and in an instant, space and time seemed to freeze. A giant hand traversed the void, reaching out directly.
It was as if that entire patch of space-time was being grasped and pulled toward him.
When a Realm Master Realm expert made a move, it was indeed powerfully extraordinary.
Xu Yan inwardly exclaimed. Old Man Xiao's grasp was truly formidable, and even he, having just broken through to the Domain Realm, would find it extremely difficult to escape from it.
A clump of mist billowed, and a phantasmal beast exploded outward, scattering like clouds in an attempt to disperse with the strike.
At the same time, it let out a sound, dull with a hint of a sinister shriek.
Within the mist, another figure emerged, its aura dark yet extremely powerful. In a split second, it exerted all its strength, unleashing its most potent attack.
"A Supreme Sovereign Realm warrior?"
Xu Yan's eyebrows raised. The hidden person was extremely strong, and with his initial Domain Realm strength, he was certainly no match for them.
"Person from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, huh,"
The identity of the opponent was now clear. Someone so adept at the arts of stealth and concealment must be an Earth Shadow member from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, especially since they had infiltrated Qinghua state.
"Xiaoyao!"
Yin Jue spoke in a low, deep voice.
Pfft!
One spirit pearl after another exploded, and the cloud of mist from the dispersed mist beast was now completely enveloped, unable to escape the Domain space held within Old Man Xiao's grasp.
Pfft!
A hand shattered that patch of Domain space directly, revealing a fragmented void which, under the miasma of Heavenly Dao principles, gradually healed back to normal.
And with that, the mist beast's True Spirit and Yin Jue had utterly perished.
Old Man Xiao's brow furrowed, and he said with a cold voice, "That was decisive, to self-destruct like that!"
"Sorry about that, I was careless for a moment, and failed to capture the person alive."
Old Man Xiao looked at Xu Yan and the others with an apologetic face.
"It's a small matter. Whether alive or not, it doesn't really matter with Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's people,"
Xu Yan shook his head.
"So this is the strength of the Realm Master Realm, quite impressive."
Su Lingxiu couldn't help but express her admiration.
The corner of Old Man Xiao's mouth twitched. What kind of comment was that? It sounded as though he didn't hold Realm Master Realm warriors in high regard.
But then he thought, this was a disciple of the Taoist Ancestor, whose perspective was naturally high. Perhaps it wasn't surprising that a Taoist Ancestor's disciple wouldn't hold Realm Master Realm warriors in high regard?
Old Man Xiao could only comfort himself in such a manner.
Du Yuying, Yun Miaomiao, Zi Yun, Yue'er, and others all nodded their heads, saying, "So Realm Masters are this powerful. If I could become a Realm Master, that would be quite an achievement."
Old Man Xiao didn't really want to talk anymore. Their words seemed to suggest that becoming a Realm Master was easy, almost as if it was a level they were just barely willing to accept.
How many mighty warriors long for nothing more than to reach the Supreme Sovereign Realm in their lifetime.
"They are all disciples under the Taoist Ancestor, with high expectations. One cannot measure them by ordinary standards!"
Old Man Xiao consoled himself.
He quickly changed the subject, looking at the jar in Su Lingxiu's hand, he asked with astonishment, "Is this the Blood Master Remnant Soul from the Netherworld?"
"Yes!"
Su Lingxiu answered excitedly, "A Realm Master Level Divine Soul, even though it's a Remnant Soul, it's still very much worth studying."
"It's Blood Extreme! He actually isn't dead!"
Old Man Xiao finally saw clearly, the Remnant Soul was actually Blood Extreme!
"You know him?"
Xu Yan and the others were quite surprised.
"Indeed, I know him!"
Old Man Xiao nodded.
As they spoke, the group returned to Qinghua Spirit City, arriving at Su Lingxiu's Alchemical Medical Institute, where they placed the jar containing Blood Extreme's Remnant Soul on the table.

chapters.title: Chapter 961 - 499: The high level of the Taoist Ancestor is unparalleled throughout the ages.
chapters.content:
"Old Man Xiao, since you know him, do you know why he harbors a grudge against me, targeting me specifically?"
Jiang Buping asked curiously.
"Blood Extreme has a grudge against you?"
Old Man Xiao was stunned, "That cannot be! Blood Extreme is rumored to have fallen a long time ago; you are so young, how could he possibly hold a grudge against you?"
"From Jiang Tianming to the one just now, all had his shadow, and the secret techniques he imparted all aim to restrain me, how could this be a coincidence?"
Jiang Buping shared the sequence of events and his speculations.
"Oh, really? Is that so?"
Old Man Xiao raised his eyebrows, quite surprised, and after pondering for a while, he asked, "Are you a descendant of the Taikun Jiang Family?"
Jiang Buping nodded.
"If that's the case, I have some speculations. Blood Extreme was killed by Taikun, and Taikun's successor, Jiang Feng, is your ancestor. Could his targeting you be an act of revenge against Jiang Feng?"
But Old Man Xiao felt this reason was far-fetched.
"The prodigy of the Jiang Family isn't me, plus I have fallen out with the Jiang Family, shouldn't he be supporting me rather? This doesn't make sense."
Jiang Buping furrowed his brows.
"Perhaps he discovered that your talent is too monstrous and wants to strangle the monstrous successor of Jiang Feng to take revenge on him, hence he targets you?"
Old Man Xiao continued speculating.
"Is that so?"
Jiang Buping frowned, feeling it wasn't very likely, and the fact no one else knew about the special nature of his Divine Soul, could this Blood Lord possibly see through the uniqueness of his Divine Soul?
"Just ask him directly, why bother guessing?"
Su Lingxiu's delicate white finger tapped on the jar, the Blood Extreme imprisoned in the jar could now move.
Blood Extreme was decisive, and once he realized he could move, his immediate action was to self-destruct!
Poof!
The jar turned blood-red in an instant; in that split second, Blood Extreme's figure was gone, leaving only a dense cloud of blood mist.
"You can't die in the Soul Concealing Jar!"
Su Lingxiu's slender white finger tapped the jar again, and the blood mist that formed Blood Extreme gradually condensed back into his figure.
At this moment, Blood Extreme's face was full of shock; everything he had experienced was entirely beyond his comprehension and imagination. Having his Remnant Soul imprisoned and not being able to self-destruct, he could understand.
However, even after the prohibition on his Remnant Soul was lifted and he had self-destructed, he still couldn't die but was condensed back together.
Even though he had been a Realm Master Realm Expert, he had never heard of such a technique; he was so terrified that his Divine Soul trembled.
"Impossible, absolutely impossible!"
Blood Extreme roared lowly, and with a bang, a surge of dense blood spread within the jar, shaking the jar.
"I told you, you can't die in the Soul Concealing Jar!"
Su Lingxiu's delicate white finger tapped the jar again; the exploded blood within the jar once again solidified, and Blood Extreme's figure reappeared.
"What is this? How can you prevent me from self-destructing?"
Blood Extreme was visibly shaken.
Old Man Xiao was also stunned, staring at the Soul Concealing Jar without blinking. This jar not only imprisoned Blood Extreme's Remnant Soul but also prevented him from self-destructing.
To know, Blood Extreme was a Realm Master, correctly speaking, actually a Minor Heaven and Earth Master, one of the earliest followers of the Netherworld.
He once captured a strand of purple light, and because of this, Blood Extreme was actually stronger than the usual Realm Masters, notoriously difficult to kill.
And his Divine Soul was even stronger.
But such a powerful being was now locked in a clear jar, displayed like an exhibit, unable to self-destruct.
Su Lingxiu giggled, "I am an Alchemical Medical Warrior, and how to heal and preserve Divine Souls, these are my specialties. This Soul Concealing Jar is created by combining the Refinement techniques of my fourth junior brother, various prohibitions, including my Domain Divine Furnace and my Divine Skills, all these elements fused together."
"It took me quite a while to refine this Soul Concealing Jar, and it has a special property: besides imprisoning Divine Souls, it keeps the soul intact and consciousness unable to leave the jar."
"As long as your Divine Soul is in the jar, and your consciousness cannot leave it, no matter how you try to self-destruct or explode, unless you can shatter the jar, your soul and consciousness will ultimately pervade within it."
"And I can easily re-condense the dispersed Divine Soul and consciousness. Can you understand? This is too profound, you wouldn't understand. You just need to know that now, unless you can shatter the jar, no matter how you try to perish, you can't die!"
Blood Extreme instinctively swallowed a gulp of saliva. He looked at the clear jar, disbelieving, at such an extraordinary method that could create such an artifact.
At this moment, upon closer sensing, he realized the uniqueness and wonder of this jar.
When needed, it can isolate his consciousness, blocking all perception of the outside world.
Yet it could also lift the prohibition, allowing him inside the jar to perceive everything outside, but still unable to break the jar.
"I, Blood Extreme, admit defeat, kill or mutilate as you wish, but to lock me in a jar like this, to humiliate me so, how is this the act of a noble man?"
Blood Extreme glared defiantly.
Su Lingxiu blinked her bright eyes and stretched out a pale white finger, poking the body of the jar; Blood Extreme immediately felt a faint force, as if a little finger, poking on his soul body.
"Are you blind? Where am I a noble man?"

chapters.title: Chapter 962 - 499: The High Level of the Taoist Ancestor Is Unparalleled Throughout the Ages_2
chapters.content:
Blood Extreme's face turned black, and upon seeing Old Man Xiao, he gritted his teeth and said, "Xiaoyao brat, if you want to kill me, then kill me, how dare you humiliate me like this?"
"Let your disciple kill me, I, Blood Extreme, admit defeat!"
Subconsciously, he assumed that Su Lingxiu was Old Man Xiao's disciple, and that this Soul Concealing Jar must undoubtedly be a concoction of Old Man Xiao's.
As the leader of the Taicang Seven Heroes, with exceptional talent, and one of the most valued by Taicang, it was within reason for him to have such a method.
"You flatter me too much, what merits or abilities do I possess to have taught such an excellent disciple?"
Old Man Xiao shook his head.
Blood Extreme was stunned. Xu Yan and the others, they're not Old Man Xiao's disciples?
"Then whose disciples are they? Let their master come, kill me or carve me up as you please, we are both beings of the same level, there is no need for such humiliation!"
Blood Extreme then said angrily.
Old Man Xiao looked at Blood Extreme with a disdainful gaze and said, "Stop flattering yourself, you think you're on the same level as the senior? What are you worth? Not to speak of you alone, even the Netherworld Domain doesn't have the qualifications to stand on the same level as the senior!"
Blood Extreme was momentarily stunned, then his pupils shrank as if he had realized something, and he exclaimed, "Is it Senior Taicang? He didn't perish?"
In this world, the only ones who, in a certain sense, can't stand on the same level as the Netherworld Domain's Master are only two individuals.
One is a powerhouse from the Imperishable Temple.
The other is Taicang!
And the words of Xiaoyao clearly couldn't be referring to the one from the Imperishable Temple. Thus, apart from Taicang, there could be no second person.
Moreover, only Taicang had the capability to teach someone so monstrously talented.
From this, it could be seen that Taicang had devised new and marvelous methods of Martial Arts!
But, could it be that in that battle, Taicang did not fall, but rather stood on equal footing with that individual from the Imperishable Temple?
Thinking thus, Blood Extreme felt somewhat enlightened. No wonder the Taicang Domain, although it had suffered a rift in the heavens and earth, was not greatly affected. The entire domain was intact, and the one from the Imperishable Temple had not taken the opportunity to invade the Taicang Domain.
Could it be that Taicang was not dead?!
"Since it's Senior Taicang, I, Blood Extreme, am convinced. I am willing to apologize and admit my wrongs, kill me or carve me up as you please, Senior Taicang would not humiliate me like this."
As he said this, Blood Extreme looked towards Su Lingxiu and said in a deep voice, "Young lady, if you want to kill, then kill me, such torture tarnishes your master's dignity!"
Su Lingxiu wore an odd expression, and couldn't help but marvel inwardly, Taicang was truly legendary, Blood Extreme, such a powerful being, thought of Taicang first.
"Master is really too low-key!"
She sighed inwardly, but then denied it, "It's not that my master is too low-key, but rather he is too powerful. There are not many in the world who are qualified to know about my master, and hence my master seems low-key."
Old Man Xiao had a somewhat sad expression and sighed, "Blood Extreme, you're mistaken. Although I also dearly wish that Teacher Taicang were still alive, he has indeed perished.
"The senior I speak of, even Teacher Taicang did not have the qualifications to stand on the same level."
Blood Extreme was stunned for a moment and then angrily said, "Xiaoyao brat, what do you mean by that? How could there be someone in this world who Taicang isn't qualified to stand on the same level with?
"Even that individual from the Imperishable Temple does not have the right to say that. Could it be that the senior you speak of is that individual from the Imperishable Temple?
"You, a member of the Taicang Seven Heroes, have actually defected to the Imperishable Temple?"
Old Man Xiao appeared indifferent and even somewhat complacent. Blood Extreme, being older than him and from the same era as Taicang, did not know of the Taoist Ancestor, yet he himself was fortunate to have been guided by the Taoist Ancestor!
Thinking this, Old Man Xiao suddenly felt a sense of superiority, his gaze looking down at Blood Extreme as if he were viewing a country bumpkin.
"Xiaoyao brat, what is that look in your eyes?"
Blood Extreme was furious; as an ancient being from the same era as Taicang, to be looked at by Old Man Xiao with such eyes was intolerable!
"Blood Extreme, you're in vain as an ancient Minor Heaven and Earth Master, not even having heard of the Taoist Ancestor, no wonder you've ended up like this, too ignorant and uninformed! The height of the Taoist Ancestor's level is unparalleled, the progenitor of the Great Dao through all of time!"
Old Man Xiao shook his head and sighed.
Blood Extreme was infuriated, truly infuriated. With a bang, the jar exploded into a cloud of blood mist once again, the tremor massive, shaking the jar, and even faint cracking sounds being heard as if it might burst apart the next moment.
Su Lingxiu hastily pointed a finger, steadying the jar, and gave Old Man Xiao a glare, "Don't provoke him anymore; if he really blows up the jar, I will have lost an object of study."
```
"Yes, yes, I won't see him anymore," Old Man Xiao said with an apologetic smile, and immediately left to seclude himself and comprehend the Heavenly Dao.
"I need to find Master to help stabilize the jar!" Su Lingxiu, holding the jar, excitedly approached Li Xuan.
"Master, Master, help me stabilize this jar."
Li Xuan glanced at the jar containing Blood Extreme, a rather nice Remnant Soul that would become one of Su Lingxiu's treasured collections, intended for studying the Divine Soul of a Minor Heaven and Earth Master.
With a raise of his hand, strands of profound meaning appeared, transforming into an arcane Rune, and in an instant, it entered the jar.
The jar trembled slightly and was instantaneously transformed. Not to mention that Blood Extreme was just a Remnant Soul, even a complete Divine Soul, once confined here, would not be able to escape.
"Thank you, Master!"
Su Lingxiu was overjoyed.
Blood Extreme also reconsolidated itself. Hearing Su Lingxiu's words, it abruptly looked up, and its entire being became stunned.
What kind of existence was this?
In its eyes, it seemed to see the vastness of the ancient Great Wilderness before the chaos, as if it was a scene from before or at the dawn of time.
It was as if it saw the mysterious Dao that it had come across during its travels in the Land of Imperishable, and all these Daos entwined together, as if he was the incarnation of Dao.
It even saw a wondrous light that even the purple light struggled to reach.
Gulp!
At that moment, it finally understood that what Xiaoyao had said was true; such an existence, even Taicang, had no right to stand on the same level.
Just as it was about to speak, Su Lingxiu had already moved it, placing it back on its original table.
Blood Extreme's look towards Su Lingxiu and the others changed; no wonder they were so monstrously gifted, no wonder they could forge such miraculously extraordinary treasures.
"You..."
But Jiang Buping had already interrupted it, asking coldly, "Blood Extreme, is it? An old relic of the Netherworld, I ask you, why target me?
"Jiang Buping, I have neither enmity nor grievances with you, right?"
Blood Extreme was stunned, its face showing disbelief, then it desperately pleaded innocence: "It's a misunderstanding, I didn't target you!"
If it were not for Jiang Buping, who was the disciple of such an unfathomable being, it would not have bothered to defend itself. But realizing that Jiang Buping was the disciple of such a terrifying powerhouse, it dared not bear these accusations.
It had to defend itself!
Moreover, it truly was innocent. The individuals who sought it out just happened to have a grudge against Jiang Buping, and it was merely going with the flow.
Its fundamental goal was to restore itself and rise again—to take revenge against Jiang Feng!
"Misunderstanding?"
Jiang Buping sneered, "When Jiang Tianming targeted me, and I sought revenge from him, you were in his Divine Soul. Now this one, seeking revenge for Yun Yan'er, and you are again in his Divine Soul.
"Furthermore, both Jiang Tianming and the one from earlier practiced the Martial Arts secret technique that you taught, and even this time, he passed on his method to resist the Divine Soul Secret Technique.
"All these coincidences, are they really just coincidences?"
Blood Extreme was dumbfounded, but indeed, all this was coincidental!
"Yes, coincidental, it's all coincidental!"
Blood Extreme, on the verge of tears, hurriedly continued: "You have to believe me, it really is a coincidence! Truly, I didn't deceive you. Jiang Tianming came to me, I helped him become stronger to oppose you, his enemy.
"Think about it, I'm just a Remnant Soul now. I had the chance to make a comeback, even the chance to recover, and moreover, I could use this opportunity to take revenge on that little bastard Jiang Feng. Why wouldn't I?"
"So, it's all coincidental!"
Blood Extreme hastily added, "As for this one, he insists on seeking revenge on you. How can I stop him? If I don't satisfy him, how am I to cultivate him as a body double seed?
"The more insane he becomes, the better for me. I never imagined you would be so formidable!"
Jiang Buping, with a frown, intuitively felt that Blood Extreme seemed to be telling the truth. It all really was coincidental!
```

chapters.title: Chapter 963 - 500: Taimiao Transmits a Message, Spiritual Realm Enters the Great Wilderness
chapters.content:
"He did not lie!"
Xu Yan nodded and said.
Blood Extremity was just a Remnant Soul and was trapped in the Soul Concealing Jar, and whether he lied or not, he couldn't escape the scrutiny of Xu Yan's Minor Heavenly Eye.
Since Blood Extremity spoke the truth, Jiang Buping immediately lost interest in interrogating him, turned around to leave, and closed off for cultivation, in preparation for a breakthrough.
Meng Chong also continued to cultivate; he strove for an early breakthrough.
And Xu Yan, he continued to cultivate, aiming to delve further into the mysteries of the Domain Realm and various Divine Skills, to further solidify his strength in the Domain Realm.
Fang Hao also went back to seclude himself, leaving the affairs of the Qinghua Sect to be managed by Emperor Da Yue and a few others.
Su Lingxiu and Yue'er, bustling with enthusiasm, carried the jar into the seclusion chamber, ready to research the mysteries of the Blood Extremity's Remnant Soul and explore what was special about the Minor Heaven and Earth Master's Divine Soul, to see if they could find a shortcut to early advancement of the Divine Soul to Realm Master Level.
Yue'er was even more excited about this. If the research succeeded, it meant that once she broke through to the Supreme Sovereign Realm, she could take a shortcut to elevate her Divine Soul to the Realm Master Realm, thereby making a breakthrough to the Realm Master Realm a matter of course.
Just as currently, her Divine Soul's strength was much stronger than that of the Taicang Martial Artists of the same realm, thanks to being Su Lingxiu's assistant, gaining a deeper understanding of Divine Souls, and having Pill that enhanced Divine Souls to aid her cultivation.
Blood Extremity felt very panicked at this moment; he somehow felt that the gazes of these two young ladies were terrifying, as if they were going to do something horrible to him!
"Ladies, let's talk this over, let's talk this over, whatever you need me to do, just say the word, I will definitely cooperate!"
Blood Extremity chickened out!
"Whether you cooperate or not, it doesn't matter, you can't resist anyway!"
Su Lingxiu said with a smile.
"Right, you better not try any form of resistance, otherwise if a problem occurs, or some cruel accident happens, don't blame us.
"You just need to cooperate nicely, and I assure you it won't be painful, we are quite skilled in this research!"
Yue'er added.
Blood Extremity listened and grew more anxious; an ominous feeling overwhelmed him.
Bang!
The door of the seclusion chamber closed, causing Blood Extremity's heart to tremble.
A formation lit up, and inside the chamber, on a Jade Platform, some bottles and jars were placed, which caught Blood Extremity's eye, and he instinctively swallowed.
Inside the jars were stored Imperishable True Spirits, and he even saw some Divine Souls and some bodies that had lost their Divine Souls, leaving only corpses.
On the Jade Platform, there were some objects and lines he could not understand, including some unusual looking apparatus.
He even saw a small, sharp knife that amazinglcontained infinite vitality, an utterly inconceivable sight.
Thump!
The jar was placed on the Jade Platform, a recess appeared, swallowing half of the jar, followed by some lines affixing themselves to the jar.
Blood Extremity felt something unusual happening inside the jar, as if some special power, or some unspeakable Power of Principles, was infiltrating the jar, gradually enshrouding his Remnant Soul.
"Don't resist, don't move erratically, oh, because if an accident occurs, if intense pain emerges, then it's just you reaping what you've sown, unless, as a proud Realm Master Realm expert, you enjoy experiencing unfathomable pain of the Remnant Soul; if so, you might as well resist a little.
"Actually, I hope you do resist, so I can then study the unusual responses of a Divine Soul under extreme pain, especially a Realm Master Realm Divine Soul.
"Perhaps I could discover an Alchemical Medical technique or even a Pill that can overlook the agony of the Divine Soul."
Su Lingxiu said, busy at work, eyes squinting.
Gulp!
The Remnant Soul of Blood Extremity trembled, never before had he felt that such beautiful, peerless young ladies looked so terrifying, so heart-shaking!
Too terrifying!
"I won't resist, I absolutely won't resist!"
Blood Extremity realized, since there was no escape and since he was under the apprenticeship of such terrifying beings, he might as well fully give in, perhaps by doing so he would chance upon an opportunity to recover.
...
In the Earth Shadow Realm, deep within the abyss, dense fog suddenly surged, and the tremors of the entire Earth Shadow Realm intensified momentarily.
A pair of eyes vaguely emerged within the fog, looking towards a certain place in the Divine Realm.
"Xiaoyao, is it really you? If so, let me try your strength, the leader of the Taicang Seven Heroes."
The gaze of the Earth Shadow Realm Master grew intense.
The Fog Beast True Spirit and Yin Jue had both died.
But, according to the agreement, if the mastermind was confirmed to be one of the suspected few, then the responding treasure would be shattered accordingly.
These sensing treasures were all stored within the Divine Soul, and with a single thought, they could be shattered, thus even if they were instantly killed, they could still timely send out the shattered sensing treasure.
Besides, aside from Yin Jue, the Fog Beast True Spirit was the same.
Now, the identity of the mastermind was very clear—Xiaoyao, the leader of the Taicang Seven Heroes!
"The time is almost up, and I, Earth Shadow, should also leave here."
The Earth Shadow Realm Master fell silent, needing to make some preparations before departing.
Boom!
The Earth Shadow Realm eventually connected with the Divine Realm, and at this moment, the Divine Venerate Martial Artists of the Dao Realm also began entering the Earth Shadow Realm, heading towards the Divine Realm.
A Dao emanated from the initial integration of the Dao Realm with the Divine Realm, causing an emergence of changes between Heaven and Earth, which surged out from the Earth Shadow Realm into the Divine Realm at this moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 964 - 500: Taimiao Transmits a Message, Spiritual Realm Enters the Great Wilderness_2
chapters.content:
The limits of the Martial Arts in the Divine Realm were constantly being raised, and they were even gradually returning to the state before the Great War between Heaven and Earth, where there were no limitations imposed on Martial Arts.
And this was just the first step. In the following time, this change would gradually spread to the Spiritual Realm and the Inner Domain, eventually leading to the Unity of Domain, restoring the state of Heaven and Earth before the Great War.
Of course, this was a lengthy process that could not be accomplished in a short period.
But, as the Divine Realm was the starting point for the Unity of Domain, it would inevitably bring about some significant changes. Within these changes of Heaven and Earth, one might gain some insights, some opportunities, and thus break through the bottlenecks of Martial Arts.
This was also one of the reasons why many Divine Venerate Realm Warriors from the Dao Realm entered the Divine Realm.
The Supreme Sovereign Realm was a major bottleneck. Countless Divine Venerate Martial Artists were trapped below the Supreme Sovereign without making any progress. Naturally, these Martial Artists were eager to seize any possible chance for breakthroughs.
Divine Venerates descended to the Divine Realm not only to seek opportunities and gain insights from Heaven and Earth to break their own shackles but also for the powerhouses of the Divine Realm's major forces, who came to stabilize their territories in the Divine Realm.
In the Taimiao Realm, within the Taimiao God Sect.
Xin Mengrou's aura became even more illusionary, yet there was a sense of reality to it. It seemed to deviate slightly from the original Illusionary Path, as if she was close to forging her own unique path.
In front of the statue, Xin Mengrou was silently cultivating. After returning, she reported the guidance of the Taoist Ancestor to the Taimiao God Sect one by one.
Resolving the confusion of the Taimiao God Sect was all that Xin Mengrou could do. Whether the sect master could gain insight was not her concern; she still had a long way to go.
Half a month after she relayed the Taoist Ancestor's solutions to the Taimiao God Sect, the sect master unexpectedly took her as a disciple, which greatly surprised Xin Mengrou.
And because of this, Xin Mengrou's status within the Taimiao God Sect surged dramatically.
A direct disciple of the Grandmaster was the most revered status within the Taimiao God Sect and extraordinarily esteemed even in the Taimiao World of the Dao Realm.
Taimiao was an ancient Minor Heaven and Earth Master. Her strength was unfathomable, and no one knew how far she had advanced, but it was almost certain that she was one of the strongest Minor Heaven and Earth Masters below the Seven Great Domain Masters.
Now that Xin Mengrou had become one of Taimiao's direct disciples, her status was extraordinary in the Dao Realm as well, even if her current strength was still weak. Even Supreme Sovereign Realm Warriors would not dare to rely on their status and offend her lightly.
Taimiao had not taken any disciples for a very long time, and her sudden acceptance of a disciple indicated the special place this disciple held in her heart.
From this event of becoming a direct disciple, Xin Mengrou speculated that her master, Taimiao, must have had some insight from the Taoist Ancestor's guidance and was likely to step out of her predicament.
One day, the statue suddenly opened its eyes.
"Master!"
Xin Mengrou hastily saluted.
"That's right, you've developed your own understanding of the Illusionary Path."
Taimiao's voice came through.
"Disciple has received some personal insights from the guidance of the Taoist Ancestor."
Xin Mengrou respectfully said.
"The Divine Venerates of the Dao Realm have already descended to the Divine Realm. Ao Ming of the True Dragon Clan, leading the four Supreme True Spirits, is also preparing to head to the Divine Realm, and Heavenly Slaughter is making some moves..."
Taimiao informed Xin Mengrou of the news from the Dao Realm, as well as the movements of various Realms and the descent of Divine Venerates to the Divine Realm, with a simple purpose: to let Xin Mengrou pass this message to Xu Yan and the others.
Although Xu Yan, as a disciple of the Taoist Ancestor, naturally did not fear these developments, being able to pass on the message in advance was also considered a friendly gesture.
After Taimiao conveyed the message and gave further guidance to Xin Mengrou, the statue fell silent again.
Xin Mengrou took out a Communication Talisman and relayed the information she had learned to Wu Tianan for him to pass on.
Boom!
The Dao rhymes surging in from the Taihe Realm and the great changes in Heaven and Earth swept across the thirty-five Realms. Qinghua state was also slightly trembling. Fang Hao was using this momentum of Heaven and Earth to further enhance the Qinghua Great Formation.
He was therefore very busy.
Within the Nine Mountain Realm, Red Cat had already returned. The three Great Demon Kings gathered, with the twelve Demon Marquises under their command exuding heavy demon energy, announcing to all that the Nine Mountains were the territory of the Demon Clan.
Officially seizing the Nine Mountain Realm as the territory of the Demon Clan.
Leading the Demon Clan's army personally, they pacified the Heavenly Grottoes of the Nine Mountain Realm, transforming these grottoes into lairs of the Demon Clan for different demon species to dwell.
The Twelve Demon Marquises also began to break through in strength, their demon energy rolling powerfully, already far from the mere spirit beasts they once were, having greatly increased in power.
Having cultivated the Great Demon Ability, their strength was not weaker than that of Heavenly Union Realm Warriors, and perhaps even stronger.
What excited these Demon Marquises the most was that their increase in power would not be restricted by their bloodline, they wouldn't stop advancing simply because they reached the limit of their bloodline.
One day, Red Cat led the Twelve Demon Marquises into the Changyun Realm, their demon energy billowing as they directly carved out a swath of territory at the border with Changyun Realm, establishing it as a buffer zone.
This naturally led to conflicts with the major forces of Changyun Realm, and it was during this conflict that the strong warriors of the Divine Realm were shocked to find that the strength of the Demon Clan had become so powerful.
Especially the Great Demon King, whose overwhelming demon might easily suppressed three Heavenly Union Realm Warriors.
Eventually, a large area of Changyun Realm bordering Nine Mountains became the buffer zone, and the Wan Family of the Great Wilderness's Dahai Mountain also migrated there, leaving Dahai Mountain behind.
The Wan Family had no objections to this, as the expansive area of Changyun Realm was broader than Dahai Mountain. Moreover, as the buffer zone with the Demon Clan, they continued to maintain good relations with the Demon Clan.

chapters.title: Chapter 965 - 500: Taimiao Transmits a Message, Spiritual Realm Enters the Great Wilderness_3
chapters.content:
The Nine Mountain Realm had completely become the territory of the Demon Clan.
The layout of the Divine Realm had changed, and the changes had been ongoing, while the Spiritual Realm, too, had been subtly transforming.
Everyone knew the Heavenly Dao, comprehended the Heavenly Dao, and cultivated the Heavenly Dao.
With the supreme concept of the Heavenly Dao in mind, by comprehending the Heavenly Dao, they would break through their own constraints, and their Martial Arts would have no limits!
At last, a Martial Artist comprehended the Heavenly Dao, achieved enlightenment overnight, broke through the shackles of Martial Arts, and stepped into the realm of Condensing Law. This news spread, and the Spiritual Realm Martial Arts World was shaken.
From then on, from the very start of their Martial Arts journey, including the older generation of Martial Artists, who were stuck in the Divine Refinement Realm and could not break through, all began to comprehend the Heavenly Dao, and all cherished the Heavenly Dao in their hearts.
Even when Sects recruited disciples, they set up an incense table, burned incense to revere the Heavenly Dao, and respectfully invited the Heavenly Dao to witness the recruitment ceremony.
Moreover, some Martial Artists, when making transactions, to earn mutual trust, swore oaths on the Heavenly Dao.
Until someone, having violated the Heavenly Dao oath, suffered the punishment of the Heavenly Dao, everyone knew that violating the Heavenly Dao oath would bring divine condemnation!
In this way, as long as an oath on the Heavenly Dao was sworn, it was enough to be trusted.
In just a few years, the entire atmosphere of the Spiritual Realm's Martial Arts World had changed; it was no longer in its initial form and was incompatible with the Divine Realm.
Furthermore, concepts such as the Beginning of the Heavenly Dao and the Great Wilderness Domain had spread throughout the Spiritual Realm and deeply entered people's hearts, gradually leading them to identify themselves as Great Wilderness Warriors.
One day, the Gate to the Spiritual Realm opened.
No!
It had not just opened, but the Spiritual Realm and the Inner Domain had merged together completely, without any barriers left.
The Great Wilderness had expanded!
Warriors of the Spiritual Realm, stepping into what they once thought of as the barren Inner Domain, were utterly shocked, was the Inner Domain actually the origin place of the Heavenly Dao?
And the Holy Land of the Heavenly Dao, Canglan Island, was right in the barren Inner Domain!
Some experts from the Spiritual Realm, overly excited, went to Canglan Island, wishing to enter the Holy Land to better comprehend the Heavenly Dao but were directly sent flying back to the Spiritual Realm by Xu Junhe.
Xu Junhe and a few others, who were already in the Divine Skills Realm, took action and shocked the experts of the Spiritual Realm.
Claiming to follow the orthodoxy of the Great Wilderness, the Inner Realm Martial Arts World engaged in a duel with the Spiritual Realm Martial Arts World, and the result was a big victory for the Inner Realm Martial Arts World. From then on, the Spiritual Realm also came under the jurisdiction of the Great Wilderness, restrained by the Holy Land of Canglan Island.
Moreover, the Spiritual Realm began to establish the Great Wilderness Martial Arts Academy, teaching the orthodox Great Wilderness Martial Arts.
The Inner Domain and the Spiritual Realm had both become part of the Great Wilderness, and the Heavenly Dao of Tian Zi had also reaped great gains.
"This is indeed the Heavenly Dao!"
The Dharma Body of Tian Zi's Heavenly Dao manifested on Canglan Island, feeling utterly amazed and turning his gaze towards the location of the Divine Realm, knowing that before long, he would extend the reach of the Heavenly Dao towards the Divine Realm.
But before that happened, he needed to operate the now established Great Wilderness Heavenly Path, to completely perfect the operation of the rules of the Heavenly Dao.
"The shackles on me are not many left, and once my Heavenly Dao operates across the entire Domain, what will it be like?"
Tian Zi looked forward to this in his heart.
"Taoist Ancestor said, 'Xiaoyao that fellow, in comprehending the aura of the Heavenly Dao, if he thus finds a way forward, it would have great significance for my Heavenly Dao, for this Domain.'"
"The other Realm Masters are the nutrients of the Heavenly Dao, which can swiftly enhance this Domain, making it broader."
"What Taicang could not do, I, Tian Zi, can achieve, and one day, in the name of the Heavenly Dao, I will punish the Imperishable Temple!"
Tian Zi grew more and more excited, envisioning the day when he, with the majesty of the Splendid Heavenly Path, would punish the Imperishable Temple.

chapters.title: Chapter 966 - 501: Return to Canglan Island, Atop the Path of Establishing Dao
chapters.content:
```
The Taihe Realm, near where the Earth Shadow Realm fell, has now been dotted with stone huts. Each hut houses a martial artist devoted to ascetic practice.
In order to occupy a more advantageous territory for cultivation, numerous battles have erupted, and to secure a place here, one's strength must be at least at the peak of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm and among the best of them.
Only those with the cultivation of Heavenly Union Realm could possibly secure a spot in the vicinity closest to where the Earth Shadow Realm fell.
This was an opportunity, so all martial artists were grasping at cultivation, seeking to understand and benefit from the profound changes occurring in the domain.
Martial artists who had been stuck in the long years of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm had a resolute look in their eyes, determined to seize this chance to break their shackles.
Such a tremendous opportunity, if missed, would leave one uncertain of when they might have the chance to break through to the Heavenly Union Realm again.
Even if one could travel to the Dao Realm, due to innate limitations, a breakthrough might still be uncertain, only by seizing this opportunity from the great changes could one have a better chance of breaking through.
In front of a stone hut, a great battle was erupting.
Two martial artists at the peak of the Immortal Heavenly Venerable Realm were fighting fiercely for the right to this place.
The other martial artists were indifferent, with no one stepping in to mediate.
As for the powerful Immortal Heavenly Venerables from the major forces, they each had their own domains, which outsiders could not take from them, nor dare to attempt.
Besides, those Immortal Heavenly Venerables from the major powers had Heavenly Union Realm powerhouses backing them up.
After all, the martial artists who initially broke through to the Heavenly Union Realm were those Immortal Heavenly Venerables from the great powers.
Boom!
The battles were not just happening in one place, and the Immortal Heavenly Venerables involved were either powerful figures from smaller forces or Loose Cultivators.
Thump!
Suddenly, a tremendously powerful aura surged forth from within the Earth Shadow Realm, and all the martial artists in closed-door cultivation opened their eyes in shock and walked out of their stone huts.
Martial artists who were fighting had their expressions change drastically; they hurriedly ceased the fight and retreated, looking in the direction of the Earth Shadow Realm.
A figure emerged from within the Earth Shadow Realm.
Their aura was incredibly mighty, like a god of heaven and earth, shaking the Domain Lingji, stirring the nature's spiritual energy around them.
The Heaven and Earth Laws wrapped around them, exuding an impressive divine might.
A Divine Venerate Realm warrior!
At this moment, everyone held their breath, and upon seeing the newcomer, they realized instantly that this was one of the legendary Divine Venerate Realm warriors!
The Divine Venerate who walked out of the Earth Shadow Realm glanced at the other martial artists, who hurriedly averted their gazes, not daring to make eye contact.
"All of you, scram!"
The Divine Venerate spoke coldly.
The Immortal Heavenly Venerable martial artists, upon hearing this, retreated one after another and fled far away.
However, the Heavenly Union Realm powerhouses who were closest to the Earth Shadow Realm did not move but were frowning slightly.
"Did you not hear what I said?"
The Divine Venerate martial artist's gaze turned colder as a powerful oppressive aura bore down upon them.
Crack!
The group of Heavenly Union Realm martial artists immediately turned red in the face as if a great mountain weighed upon them. Their bodies trembled, nearly forcing them to kneel on the ground.
Just then, several more powerful auras spread from within the Earth Shadow Realm.
An icy voice sounded, "By what right do you strut about in my Taihe Realm's territory?"
"Does the subordinate dynasty of my Da Yan Realm take orders from you?"
As the voice spread, the martial artists of the Taihe Sect breathed a sigh of relief; the Upper Sect powerhouses had finally arrived!
The martial artists of the Da Yan Dynasty also relaxed.
The warriors who dared stay behind in the face of the Divine Venerate's scolding were all those with powerful backers in the Dao Realm.
This Divine Venerate warrior seemed to lack significant backing, which is why they were undaunted!
Hearing these words, the expression of the Divine Venerate martial artist changed repeatedly. Hastily concealing their aura, they chuckled nervously, saying, "I was merely curious about the will of Divine Realm warriors, testing it out, so to speak. I didn't expect anything less from the subordinates of a great power; truly extraordinary."
After speaking, they sheepishly dove into an empty stone hut, revealing their identity as a warrior in search of an opportunity for breakthrough.
One after another, figures emerged from the Earth Shadow Realm, each emitting a strong presence, all of them Divine Venerate Realm warriors.
Soon after, some Heavenly Union Realm martial artists also came out.
With the arrival of Divine Venerates, Divine Venerates of various realms began to gather their affiliated Sects to learn about the situation in the Divine Realm and start making arrangements.
Most of these Divine Venerate powerhouses had come with a mission in mind.
Some Divine Venerate warriors did not linger near the Earth Shadow Realm upon entering the Divine Realm but left directly.
"It's getting lively again,"
Li Xuan looked up towards the Taihe Realm and couldn't help but sigh. One after another, Divine Venerates arrived and it wouldn't be long before Supreme Sovereign Realm warriors would also descend.
It was indeed getting lively, and among these powerhouses, there were many who were coming for Xu Yan.
Moreover, the True Dragon Clan was preparing to come to the Divine Realm to redeem their honor and restore the dignity of the True Dragon Clan.
The tremors of the Divine Realm were weakening, and the merging of the Dao Realm with the Divine Realm would not be too far off.
On this day, Xu Yan emerged from seclusion.
He had achieved complete enlightenment of the mysteries of the Domain Realm, enhanced his Divine Skills, and even cultivated some powerful new ones.
His Subduing Dragon Palm had seen significant improvements and was now a palm strike of Divine Skills.
The True Dragon Rage had also been greatly enhanced, and the defensive unending vitality of the Yin Yang Undying Sword had grown stronger.
With the foundation Xu Yan had now, and with the Supreme Treasure, the Prime Tortoise Carapace in hand, even if he encountered Supreme Sovereign Realm warriors, even if he couldn't prevail, he could still retreat unharmed.
It would not be easy for a Supreme Sovereign Realm warrior to breach Xu Yan's defenses.
"Master, I would like to visit Canglan Island,"
```

chapters.title: Chapter 967 - 501: Return to Canglan Island, Above Establishing Dao_2
chapters.content:
Xu Yan said respectfully.
From the Inner Domain to the Spiritual Realm, and then to the Divine Realm, it had been a long time since he had parted with his parents, and Xu Yan was starting to miss them.
"Hmm, go ahead,"
Li Xuan nodded.
"Don't worry about the safety of the Great Wilderness; the young friend Tian Zi will take care of Canglan Island."
"Thank you, Master!"
Xu Yan was overjoyed.
Looking up in the direction of the Taihe Realm, Xu Yan's heart was almost bursting with eagerness; he wanted to venture into the Dao Realm.
However, before that, he needed to return to see his parents and provide some guidance on their cultivation.
"Young Master Xu, we also haven't returned to the Inner Domain for a long time, and we would like to go back,"
Upon hearing this, Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao said, excitement showing in their expressions.
"Alright, let's go back together,"
Xu Yan nodded.
Both women were now Immortal Realm Warriors and had cultivated Divine Skills, making their strength much greater than the average Immortal Realm.
Moreover, due to the cultivation of Divine Skills, their Martial Arts actually held some differences from Taicang Martial Arts.
With Xu Yan's current strength, he was capable of traversing the space of Heaven and Earth without needing to descend to the Spiritual Realm via the Divine Bridge and then return to Canglan Island from there.
With a single step, Xu Yan, accompanied by the two women, instantly crossed the space of Heaven and Earth, leaving the Divine Realm and arriving in the Spiritual Realm.
A glance revealed some changes in the Spiritual Realm and he also sensed that the current Spiritual Realm was completely different from the initial one.
The Heaven and Earth Laws had already altered, and above this Heaven and Earth, there existed supreme Heavenly Dao Rules.
"Heavenly Dao,"
Xu Yan murmured thoughtfully to himself.
"The Spiritual Realm seems a bit unusual, even more majestic with its Heavenly might than the Divine Realm..."
Du Yuying said with a frown.
"Because the Spiritual Realm now has the existence of Heavenly Dao, it has the shape of Heaven and Earth, or rather, a more complete Heaven and Earth.
"The Heaven and Earth have become stronger because of the Heavenly Dao, and Martial Artists that comprehend the Heavenly Dao have no limits in their cultivation. Even a Realm Master can find a path forward through their perception of the Heavenly Dao.
"You have cultivated Taicang Martial Arts, but you can also comprehend the Heavenly Dao, making it easier to reach the Realm Master Realm.
"In the future, a Martial Artist's cultivation will emphasize enlightenment; those with superior enlightenment who can comprehend the mysteries of the Heavenly Dao will certainly encounter great opportunities."
Xu Yan explained.
"Heavenly Dao?" murmured Du Yuying and the other woman to themselves.
"Guided by the Master, this Heaven and Earth has become more perfect,"
Xu Yan, taking the two women with him, stepped out and disappeared instantly from the spot.
On Canglan Island, the figures of Xu Yan and the others materialized. The Canglan Island of today was no longer the tiny island of the past.
It had truly become a magnificent Holy Land of the Great Wilderness.
"Tian Zi?"
On Canglan Island, a purple-robed youth greeted him cheerfully.
"It's me!"
Tian Zi looked at Xu Yan, the senior disciple of the Taoist Ancestor, and couldn't help but be impressed that he was indeed worthy of being a disciple of the Taoist Ancestor.
Indeed, he was extraordinary, and his methods of cultivation were truly profound; even Tian Zi, in all his might as the Heavenly Dao, could not fully comprehend its mysteries.
With Xu Yan's return to Canglan Island, his parents, Xu Junhe and his wife, were naturally overjoyed, and the island buzzed with activity.
Mother Xu took Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao by the hands, liking them more and more the longer she looked.
Meanwhile, Xu Yan and Tian Zi were playing chess.
"You are the first person to play chess with me as Heavenly Dao,"
Tian Zi said cheerfully.
"To other Martial Artists, you, Heavenly Dao, are naturally supreme, but that has nothing to do with me; my Dao is not your Heavenly Dao,"
Xu Yan said with a light smile.
"True,"
Tian Zi nodded.
Although in terms of strength, Tian Zi was superior to Xu Yan, Xu Yan's cultivation was unrelated to his Heavenly Dao.
The Taoist Ancestor's five disciples cultivated Martial Arts that had nothing to do with his Heavenly Dao, or perhaps his Heavenly Dao was just one of the many paths taught by the Taoist Ancestor.
"Taicang is no more; now it's the Great Wilderness. This Heaven and Earth is the Great Wilderness Domain, and I am the Heavenly Dao of the Great Wilderness Domain, bearing the duty of ensuring its operation and strengthening."
"I have a feeling that the fellows from the Imperishable Temple might be making a move soon, so I also need to set the Heaven and Earth in motion as quickly as possible, to strengthen the entire Domain."
"Only in this way, can we resist the schemes of the Imperishable Temple."
As the two played chess and chatted leisurely, Tian Zi eventually brought up the schemes of the Imperishable Temple.
"The Netherworld and Witch Realms still exist, and they both aim to invade the Great Wilderness. Since that's the case, as the Heavenly Dao, you can assimilate these two Realms, and thus you can enhance the Domain more quickly," Xu Yan said with a smile.
"That's exactly what I've been thinking."
Tian Zi was thrilled, "Although the Netherworld and Witch Realm may already be in ruins, if they were to be merged with the Great Wilderness, they could still bring about some improvements. And these Minor Heaven and Earth Masters, only by cultivating the Heavenly Dao can they have a future.
"Xu Yan, help me think this over. Since we're cultivating the Heavenly Dao, both the Realm Masters and the Minor Heaven and Earth Masters should change their names."
"You decide for yourself, it's your matter," Xu Yan replied.
After placing a piece, Xu Yan stood up and said, "You lose!"
Tian Zi was stunned, staring at the chessboard for a long time, scratching his head in disbelief. How could he, the mighty Heavenly Dao, actually lose at chess?!
Walking in the Great Wilderness, Xu Yan arrived at the small mountain village where he first met his master, marveling at the strange fate that led him to his master!
After staying on Canglan Island for a month, Xu Yan taught his parents about Martial Arts, and also gave guidance to others on the island on their Martial Arts Cultivation.
Those who could reside on Canglan Island included not only old acquaintances but also the chosen prodigies from the Great Wilderness, who had passed through numerous selections to come to this Holy Land for cultivation.
These prodigies included the very best from the Spiritual Realm.
After all, the Spiritual Realm had already been integrated into the Great Wilderness.
The name of Sword God Xu Yan was as thunder in the ears in the Great Wilderness; which prodigy had not heard of it?
He was a lofty peak in the hearts of countless Great Wilderness prodigies, all aspiring to take Sword God as their example, seeking to reach the summit of Martial Arts.
A month later, Xu Yan was ready to return to the Divine Realm.
However, Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao had no immediate plans to return to the Divine Realm and chose to stay on Canglan Island to continue accompanying Mother Xu.
"Master, I'm back!" Xu Yan said respectfully.
"Hmm."
Li Xuan nodded his head.
Holding the Jade Ruyi, with a step, he was already above the clouds, overlooking the Divine Realm.
Xu Yan followed closely behind, silently trailing after him.
"Apprentice, what do you think of this Divine Realm?" Li Xuan asked with a smile, pointing to the mountains, rivers, and all living beings.
Xu Yan pondered for a moment and replied, "It's vibrant with life, flourishing in all its forms."
Li Xuan nodded, "The Domain is vibrant, flourishing with all forms of life. Creatures live here, exploring the mysteries of Heaven and Earth. But how did all things in this world come about?"
Xu Yan was taken aback.
Li Xuan raised his hand and grasped, drawing in the Rhythms of Domain, which condensed into a mass. Within the rhythms seemed to be contained some profound mystery, as if it was the origin of all things in Heaven and Earth.
"By establishing the Way of Domain, thus Heaven and Earth have a principle. Since Heaven and Earth have this principle, by operating it, all things are born..."
Li Xuan explained the mysteries of the Establishing Dao Realm, and Xu Yan listened respectfully, having already contemplated the laws of Establishing Dao Realm.
Once the Complete Heaven and Earth Realm was achieved, one could begin to establish the Way of Heaven and Earth, their own way, and break through to the Establishing Dao Realm.
Those who Establish Dao transcend Heaven and Earth!
"And yet, establishing Dao is just the beginning. With one's own way and the Way of Domain, one ponders the infinite and boundless Heavenly Dao. Yet, as the Domain is void, even after establishing Dao, how does one comprehend the boundless Heavenly Dao, to understand the intentions of the great way?"
"Taicang's downfall, his failure, lay in his external pursuit of Heaven and Earth without understanding his own way. All creatures thrive but the mysteries of their Creation are unknown."
"Neither does he interact with the boundless Heavenly Dao, to understand its intentions, to access the creation of the great way..."
Xu Yan listened reverently, his heart stirring with excitement.
He knew his master was about to teach him the Cultivation Methods beyond the Establishing Dao Realm.
