If the Establishing Dao Realm already transcended Heaven and Earth, then what power lay beyond it? Surely it must surpass Taicang!
Li Xuan came to a halt, overlooking the landscapes below and gazing toward the fall of the Earth Shadow Realm as if he saw through everything.
"Today, I will pass on to you the cultivation methods beyond the Establishing Dao Realm," Li Xuan said with a solemn expression.
"Yes, Master!" Xu Yan replied, both reverent and excited. What kind of realm lies beyond the Establishing Dao Realm?
It must be even more mysterious and elusive to comprehend.
But Xu Yan was confident that he could understand it and that it wouldn't take too long.
He was already of the Complete Heaven and Earth Realm, and the Establishing Dao Realm had also been elucidated. On the path of Martial Arts, he was no longer the clueless youth first stepping into Martial Arts.

chapters.title: Chapter 968 - 502: Creation of Heaven and Earth, Sea Spirit Tribe Seeks Help
chapters.content:
Above the Establishing Dao Realm, Li Xuan had pondered deeply on how to cultivate, as this was not merely about advancing to another realm but concerned the entire path of cultivation ahead.
Each realm serves as the foundation for the next, so when forming a realm, one must first establish a general idea and direction for the next realm to ensure a seamless transition and a smooth cultivation path.
After all, the time of recklessly making things up as he went along was long past.
Having transcended the Domain, he belonged to the ranks of true strong practitioners, a true master of Martial Arts, so each subsequent realm's creation and the creation of Cultivation Methods had to be logical and evidenced.
Everything must fit in with cultivation and seamlessly connect the realms, only then can one smoothly comprehend and cultivate.
Otherwise, if one gets stuck at a realm, unable to comprehend or continue cultivating, wouldn't that block one's path of Martial Arts?
Therefore, Li Xuan devoted a great deal of effort to the cultivation beyond the Establishing Dao Realm, ensuring not only that realms connect but also that his power remained formidable as ever.
"Above Establishing Dao lies Creation!"
Creation Realm!
Luminous and intermittent, the Taoist Ancestor Halo surrounded Li Xuan, his gaze deep, "Creating Heaven and Earth, to illuminate all living beings, to sense and connect with the Great Dao!"
Xu Yan was deeply shaken, "Above Establishing Dao lies Creation," but what is meant by Creation?
Looking down at the mountains, rivers, and every grass and tree, every insect and bird, he seemed to have a slight epiphany about what Creation was.
Yet, he didn't understand how to Create Heaven and Earth.
Li Xuan continued, "Creation conjures everything from the Void, creating all things, understanding Heaven and Earth, and bringing forth wisdom…
"Everything in the world originates from Creation, and Creation itself comes from the profound and vast Dao. Only by creating one's own realm and way can one resonate with the Great Dao and understand its will…"
Above Establishing Dao, indeed, lies Creation.
After establishing one's own Dao and the Way of Domain, the path ahead is that of Creation.
Creating one's own Heaven and Earth, illuminating all living beings, and sensing the profound and vast Dao.
After much reflection, this was the cultivation path Li Xuan had settled on, which not only connected smoothly with the Establishing Dao Realm but also maintained his awe and power.
In creating the Creation Realm, Li Xuan had spent much thought, and even with the help of the Daoist Golden Book, it still took exhaustive effort to perfect this realm.
Moreover, Li Xuan felt that the Creation Realm was an extremely profound realm that seemed to align with the Daoist Golden Book.
After all, isn't the feedback from the Daoist Golden Book also a form of creation?
Concerning the realm above the Creation Realm, Li Xuan had also conceptualized and was in the process of perfecting it.
"Creation Realm, ah, once I enter the Creation Realm, powerful beings like Taicang could be dispelled with a wave of my hand, and the Imperishable Temple would no longer be a threat, right?"
Li Xuan thought excitedly.
The Creation Realm is an extremely profound realm, capable of creating everything from the Void.
Seven people from Taicang, with the aid of mysterious purple light, had created their own domain.
But if he were to breakthrough to the Creation Realm, he could create a Heaven and Earth in the Land of Imperishable without the need for any treasures.
Such formidable power, how could Taicang compare?
Even that individual from the Imperishable Temple could not compare, so after breaking through to the Creation Realm, Li Xuan felt truly confident.
"With the power of Creation, I am truly worthy of the title Taoist Ancestor!"
Li Xuan thought to himself in his heart.
The Creation Realm is a profound realm, its Cultivation Methods extremely esoteric, relying entirely on personal enlightenment, yet Li Xuan was confident in Xu Yan.
After explaining the theory of the Creation Realm and its Cultivation Methods, Li Xuan let Xu Yan continue to silently contemplate.
While explaining the Creation Realm, the Taoist Ancestor Halo diffused a radiance enveloping Xu Yan, enhancing the power of teaching and the listener's comprehension.
This was another excellent use of the Taoist Ancestor Halo, apart from showing off.
"The subtleties of Creation cannot be grasped in a mere moment; my disciple, you must remember this well."
Li Xuan reiterated the Creation Realm once more.
Then he inquired if Xu Yan had any areas he hadn't understood, emphasizing the explanation further.
Even a prodigy like Xu Yan needed Li Xuan to explain repeatedly several times before he fully grasped it.
As for when he might comprehend the subtleties of Creation, Li Xuan could not predict.
"Disciple, you must remember the key points of the Creation Realm; understanding these key points is to comprehend the subtleties of Creation."
Li Xuan said solemnly.
"Master, I will not disappoint your expectations and will surely comprehend the keys to Creation,"
Xu Yan replied respectfully.
"Good, listen carefully."
Li Xuan held the Jade Ruyi, placed it behind him, and slightly raised his head to gaze at the firmament, the Taoist Ancestor Halo pervasive, fully exhibiting the demeanor of a Taoist Ancestor.
"From the Void, life starts with a single qi, creating Yin and Yang from this qi; with Yin and Yang combined everything is born, a single thought could sustain the Domain… reflect well on these keys of Creation."
After finishing, Li Xuan disappeared from the spot, returning to the courtyard to sit leisurely on a chair.
"Creation Realm, I've finally passed it on to Xu Yan, hoping he comprehends it soon,"
Li Xuan sighed inwardly.
Unconsciously, he had gone from fabricating Cultivation Methods to becoming a true Taoist Ancestor.
"Meng Chong, Su Lingxiu, Fang Hao, Jiang Buping, I must also find time to guide them; being a master isn't so easy after all,"
Li Xuan sighed again.
For his disciples' cultivation, he, as their master, had indeed exerted much effort.
"But all is still worth it."

chapters.title: Chapter 969 - 502: Creation of Heaven and Earth, Sea Spirit Tribe Seeks Help_2
chapters.content:
Li Xuan, in great spirits, gave guidance to Shi'er and Meng Shushu on their cultivation, and also instructed Cai Ling'er on her practice.
Ever since awakening the royal bloodline of the Sea Spirit Tribe and receiving the inheritance of the Sea Spirit Tribe's royalty, and under the guidance of Li Xuan, Cai Ling'er's cultivation speed had accelerated greatly.
Now, she had already reached the Heavenly Union Realm.
"Becoming a Realm Master should not be a problem,"
Li Xuan made this judgment.
As for the strength beyond a Realm Master, that would depend on Cai Ling'er's fortune.
However, staying by his side, a Taoist Ancestor, breaking through the shackles of the Realm Master Realm was not impossible.
Of course, it would require a longer time.
Surpassing the Sea Spirit Tribe's royalty also would not be a problem.
"This girl has really seized a great opportunity!"
Li Xuan inwardly exclaimed. Opportunities all lie in a single thought, and yet Cai Ling'er had grasped the chance, choosing to stay by his side as a maid.
This was the greatest opportunity of her life.
"Feng Yan, that guy, also knows how to seize an opportunity,"
Li Xuan chuckled to himself.
He liked such clever people, who could see the path ahead clearly and grasp opportunities.
"However, Blood Extreme, this nearly useless Minor Heaven and Earth Master, should he also seize the opportunity now?"
Li Xuan's face showed an odd expression.
Blood Extreme had utterly submitted, cooperating completely with Su Lingxiu's research, and had even resolved to endure the extreme pain of his Divine Soul, allowing Su Lingxiu to observe the changes in the Divine Soul under severe agony…
"Ruthless person!"
Li Xuan sighed with admiration. Such a ruthless person surely can't miss out on seizing the opportunity.
Being able to stay by Su Lingxiu's side was also a form of fortune.
After all, Su Lingxiu's future would definitely surpass that of Taicang, and she is also the disciple of a Taoist Ancestor like him.
Xu Yan was seated cross-legged above the clouds, deeply perceiving the profundity of the Creation Realm cultivation technique, the deeper he delved, the more he marveled at its profound mysteries.
"Creation of Heaven and Earth, to resonate with the great Dao… Creation is indeed too difficult,"
Xu Yan couldn't help but sigh.
Understanding the Creation Realm was not something that could be achieved overnight.
"The Dao Realm is the heart of Heaven and Earth, also its origin. I should visit the Dao Realm to understand the origins of the Taicang Heaven and Earth, how all living beings were born,"
Xu Yan had come up with an idea.
The Dao Realm, before the great battles of Heaven and Earth, before Heaven and Earth were segmented into different regions, belonged to the origins.
The heart of Heaven and Earth.
"Just right, I'm prepared to go to the Dao Realm, it's easier to comprehend the Creation Realm there, and with the current changes in Heaven and Earth, I might also gain some insights,"
Xu Yan returned from the clouds, ready to head for the Dao Realm.
It was at this moment, the Communication Talisman delivered a message from the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe.
"The Divine Venerate threatens the Sea Spirit Tribe, wanting to seize the Sea Spirit Tribe's Supreme Treasure?"
Xu Yan raised an eyebrow, this was a distress message from the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe.
The Supreme Treasure of the Sea Spirit Tribe had been partly taken away by him, and among those treasures was the item coveted by this Divine Venerate.
Now, the other party had approached the Sea Spirit Tribe precisely for this treasure.
When the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe first mentioned this, Xu Yan did not care, so he took the treasure away.
Now, with the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe asking for help, Xu Yan naturally could not just sit idly by.
Moreover, he had once made a promise to the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe.
"Perfect, I've just broken through the Domain Realm, I'll try that Divine Venerate's might. The Divine Venerates coming from the Dao Realm are targeting me anyway, might as well meet them."
Xu Yan smiled.
He replied to the message from the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe, telling him to remain calm and to stand firm, assuring him that he would soon be there.
In the Azure Sea Sphere, within the palace of the Sea Spirit Tribe,
a beautiful woman with a cold and haughty demeanor, her eyes filled with lethal intent, glared at the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe and others.
"Very well, your Sea Spirit Tribe truly hasn't taken my words to heart, daring to give away the treasure?"
The faces of the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe and others were filled with fear.
Though they had broken through to the Heavenly Union Realm, they had no power to resist against a Divine Venerate Realm Warrior.
If the opponent were to act in anger, annihilating the Sea Spirit Tribe would be effortless.
The weakened Sea Spirit Tribe, having no Divine Venerate Realm warriors any longer, basically could not confront the person before them.
Although the Sea Spirit Tribe once belonged to the lineage of the True Dragon Clan, they had long since lost contact with it and there were hardly any connections left, thus they couldn't leverage the deterrence of the True Dragon Clan anymore.
"My lord, the treasure has always been safeguarded by our Sea Spirit Tribe, but to resolve the crisis in the Azure Sea Sphere and to express our gratitude to Xu Yan, Young Master Xu, our tribe promised him the choice of a treasure. The treasure he fancied was then taken away by him."
"The old man did warn Young Master Xu, but Young Master Xu said he would handle it, so..."
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe spoke with sincere fear and trepidation.
After receiving Xu Yan's response, the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe did his best to stabilize the other party to avoid them annihilating the Sea Spirit Tribe in a fit of rage.
Therefore, he could only delay as much as possible, waiting for Xu Yan to arrive.
"Oh, Xu Yan? That dragon-subduing youth?"
The haughty woman raised an eyebrow as she spoke.
"Yes, yes!"
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe hurriedly responded.
"Hmph, do you really think that by subduing a young dragon, you consider yourself invincible? Daring to snatch the treasure of my palace, how can I let him off easily? Tell Xu Yan to come see me, otherwise, he won't only offend the True Dragon Clan, but also offend me from the Yunluo Realm!"
The haughty woman spoke coldly.
"My lord, someone has already notified Xu Yan."
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe said respectfully, bowing his head low.
"Good, at least your Sea Spirit Tribe knows the score!"
The haughty woman's expression relaxed slightly.
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe heaved a sigh of relief internally, managing to stall the other party until Xu Yan could arrive.
Somewhere in the Azure Sea Sphere, deep beneath the sea.
The Azure Sea Turtle slightly lifted its head, its eyes filled with helplessness, "The Divine Venerate has come, the Supreme Sovereign isn't far behind, right? Maybe even the Minor Heaven and Earth Master? I mustn't expose myself, even to acquaintances, as ill intentions are too easily bred."
"When will Xu Yan bring the Rhythms of Domain to help me recover?"
The Azure Sea Turtle felt impatient at heart; its power was not yet restored, and enormous changes had also occurred in the Taicang Domain, with a crisis possibly imminent.
"Before Xu Yan brings the Rhythms of Domain, it's best to play dead."
The Azure Sea Turtle felt extremely helpless, sinking back into silence, completely motionless and even undetectable in terms of any signs of life.
On Yuntian Island, Xie Lingfeng emerged from seclusion, now not far from reaching the Void-breaking Realm.
"Dad, we should head back to the Qinghua state."
Xie Lingfeng said.
"Yes, it's time to return to the Qinghua state."
Xie Tianheng nodded.
The Divine Realm was turbulent, the Domain had transformed drastically, and the Azure Sea Sphere was no longer safe.
Yuntian Island was no longer suitable for ascetic practice, and it was time to return to the Qinghua state, to meet old friends and possibly seek guidance from elders.
"It's said that a Divine Venerate has descended upon the Sea Spirit Tribe for some treasure, putting the Sea Spirit Tribe in jeopardy of extinction."
Fu Yun heaved a sigh.
"Brother Xu should be arriving in the Azure Sea Sphere soon."
Upon hearing this, Xie Lingfeng's eyebrows arched.
Facing such a crisis, the Sea Spirit Tribe would inevitably seek help from Xu Yan, as Xie Lingfeng knew about Xu Yan's previous promises to the Sea Spirit Tribe.
Above the sea where the Sea Spirit Palace was located, Xu Yan appeared, looking towards the seabed and the grounds of the Sea Spirit Tribe, instantly locking onto that Divine Venerate Warrior.
With a move, he entered the sea, the water automatically parting to form a waterless path.
Xu Yan walked step by step towards the Sea Spirit Palace.
"So young yet so brash."
Inside the Sea Spirit Palace, the haughty woman looked outside, scoffing coldly.
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe immediately breathed a sigh of relief; Xu Yan had finally arrived and, since Xu Yan dared to come, it meant he was no longer fearful of Divine Venerate Warriors.
His heart greatly stirred, marveling at how in such a short time, Xu Yan's strength had improved significantly, no longer fearing even Divine Venerate Warriors.
Xu Yan strode into the palace of the Sea Spirit Palace, his gaze swept over the Great Elder and others of the Sea Spirit Tribe, fortunately, they hadn't suffered torture or severe injuries.
"The treasure of the Sea Spirit Tribe, I, Xu Yan, took it away, you are too late."
Looking at the haughty woman, Xu Yan said indifferently.
"Dragon-subduing youth Xu Yan? Do not think that by subduing a young dragon, you can disregard a Divine Venerate."
The haughty woman's cold gaze scrutinized Xu Yan, lifting a pale hand, a chilly intent emerging with a sudden surge of powerful aura, the might of the Divine Venerate clearly displayed at this moment.
Crack, crack!
The palace of the Sea Spirit Palace made sounds as if it couldn't bear the pressure, the next moment it was about to collapse, and the powerful Divine Venerate's might was also about to sweep through the surroundings.

chapters.title: Chapter 970 - 503: Slaying the Divine Venerate, Shock of Heaven 17
chapters.content:
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe's expression changed dramatically, feeling as if a mountain was pressing down on him, about to crush him into slag!
And once the Divine Venerate's Might swept out, the whole territory of the Sea Spirit Tribe would be completely annihilated, with almost all the Sea Spirits within being massacred.
Even he could not avoid it!
The other party was intent on annihilating the Sea Spirit Tribe!
Although the Great Elder had instructed some Sea Spirits to leave the tribal land and hide elsewhere, it would still be extremely difficult for the Sea Spirit Tribe to gain a foothold in the Divine Realm if their homeland were destroyed.
They might even be enslaved, merely struggling to survive in the world!
"Hmph!"
Xu Yan let out a cold snort, and a landscape of mountains and rivers materialized, instantly enveloping the Divine Venerate's Might bearing down on them.
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe and several others hurriedly moved away, simultaneously instructing the tribe members to quickly leave the area.
It didn't matter if their homeland was destroyed; as long as their people were alive, they could rebuild.
"The treasure has nothing to do with you; could it be that you intend to seize it by force? Since the treasure is in my hands, Xu Yan, no one can snatch it away from me!"
Xu Yan said with a cold smile.
"Worthy of being the Dragon Subduing youth, indeed you have some skills, no wonder you are so arrogant!"
The haughty woman revealed a look of surprise.
"It is said that you possess the Subduing Dragon Technique? I shall give you an opportunity, tell me the Subduing Dragon Technique, and I shall let today's incident pass. However, those two treasures must be handed over.
"To tell you the truth, they are the Realm Master's favorite items. You should know the consequences of taking the Realm Master's treasures."
Xu Yan raised an eyebrow, somewhat surprised. Those two treasures were actually some Realm Master's favorite items?
"Is your Realm Master a woman?"
Xu Yan's thoughts turned swiftly as if he had realized something.
Those two garments were likely possessions of the Sea Spirit Emperor, women's attire. Since the Realm Master fancied them, she was clearly a woman and possibly acquainted with the Sea Spirit Emperor. Given the haughty woman's attitude towards the Sea Spirit Tribe, it was very likely she had a grudge against the Sea Spirit Emperor.
"How dare you inquire about the Realm Master? Xu Yan, I give you three breaths to consider. Hand over the Subduing Dragon Technique and the treasures!"
The haughty woman produced a cold, crescent-like blade from her hand.
"Ha, Realm Master's honor? Which Realm Master dares covet what belongs to me, Xu Yan, and moreover, you, this piece of trash, even dare to covet the Subduing Dragon Technique?"
Xu Yan pointed with his hand, and the sword light surged forth, accompanied by an overwhelming might that suddenly appeared.
In the blink of an eye, the mountains and rivers shifted, and before the haughty woman could react, they had already moved from the Sea Spirit Palace to the sea surface above.
"You?"
The haughty woman's expression changed, for what kind of technique was this? She barely had time to react before she was transported here.
Boom!
The seawater surged towards the sky, transforming into numerous giant swords, as the chilling sword light illuminated heaven and earth. An aura of annihilation and death filled the space between.
"Who is the Realm Master that covets the treasure of me, Xu Yan?"
Xu Yan asked with a cold gaze.
"Xu Yan, do you dare to kill me? I am the personal maid of the Yunluo Realm Master!"
The haughty woman's expression changed dramatically.
The sword light was chilling, and the aura of annihilation caused her to shudder in fear, bringing on an unprecedented sense of crisis.
"What Sword Dao is this? Could this be his Subduing Dragon Technique?"
The haughty woman thought with consternation.
"Yunluo Realm Master, huh? I, Xu Yan, will remember that."
Xu Yan nodded. The coveting of the two treasures was a significant threat. When necessary, he would not hesitate to kill!
After all, he had already gifted away both treasures.
"Today, I, Xu Yan, in the Azure Sea Sphere, shall slay a Divine Venerate!"
With a point of his hand, Xu Yan unleashed a fierce sword light that enveloped everything in an instant.
"Xu Yan, if you dare to kill me, the Realm Master will not spare you!"
The haughty woman's expression shifted dramatically as she roared furiously, her crescent blade radiating a strong cold light.
The Divine Venerate's aura erupted, stirring between heaven and earth. At that moment, she fought back with all her might.
However, before the Ten Directions Annihilation Sword, the haughty woman's desperate efforts were to no avail. In the end, she was completely annihilated by a single sword strike!
The first Divine Venerate to fall in the Divine Realm!
A Divine Venerate from the Yunluo Realm!
"Thank you, Young Master Xu, for your rescue!"
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe and the others expressed their gratitude respectfully.
"It's nothing."
Xu Yan waved his hand and turned to leave, saying, "My promise to your Sea Spirit Tribe still stands."
"Farewell, Young Master Xu!"
The Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe was overwhelmed with excitement, thankful for his own wisdom in aligning with Xu Yan, a powerful protector.
"A Divine Venerate has fallen?"
The Azure Sea Turtle, which had been feigning death, couldn't help but lift its head and look in the direction of the Sea Spirit Tribe, its eyes showing a look of astonishment.
"That Sword Intent... it was Xu Yan!"
At that moment, the Azure Sea Turtle's heart trembled. It had indeed not been mistaken; Xu Yan truly was a monstrous talent.
It hadn't been long, and he had already slain a Divine Venerate!
"If this trend continues, wouldn't it mean that in not too long even a Minor Heaven and Earth Master could be slain?"
Thinking this, the Azure Sea Turtle couldn't help but get excited.
"It was a wise move to gift him the Prime Tortoise Carapace. The time for my recovery is at hand, and that great opportunity may indeed be attainable by Xu Yan. Following such a strong individual would also be a great fortune!"
The Azure Sea Turtle mused on its astuteness in recognizing potential.
"Continue feigning death; wait for Xu Yan to grow stronger."
The Azure Sea Turtle resumed its act of death.
On Yuntian Island, Xu Yan and Xie Lingfeng reunited, while the news of the Divine Venerate's fall had spread throughout the Divine Realm.
The news that the Dragon Subduing youth had slain a Divine Venerate in the Azure Sea Sphere spread across the entire Divine Realm, stunning all Martial Artists.

chapters.title: Chapter 971 - 971: 503
chapters.content:
This was even more shocking than Xu Yan's initial Subduing Dragon feat.
A Divine Venerate Martial Artist, just arrived in the Divine Realm and now he was slain by Xu Yan?
You must know, the descending Divine Venerate's strength was far superior to that of the young dragon.
In this short time, Xu Yan's strength had increased substantially, an unprecedented rate of improvement.
Somewhere in the Divine Realm, at this moment, Tian Shiqi felt his scalp go numb!
The death of Yin Jue Supreme Sovereign hadn't made him feel such terror.
After all, Yin Jue died at the hands of a Realm Master, which wasn't something to make a fuss about. A mere Supreme Sovereign, no matter how strong his art of concealment, wouldn't be able to withstand the Realm Master's might.
But the news of Xu Yan killing a Divine Venerate sent chills down Tian Shiqi's spine.
No one knew better than him how Xu Yan rose step by step, his monstrousness had exceeded all imagination.
Back in the Nine Mountain Realm, Xu Yan's strength was not yet comparable to the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, but now, he had actually killed a Divine Venerate!
How much time had passed?
For most Martial Artists above the Divine Refinement Realm, such a period of time wouldn't even be enough to break through a minor realm.
And Xu Yan? From being less powerful than the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, he had grown to kill a Divine Venerate!
This rate of cultivation, this rate of increase in strength, was no longer describable as monstrous.
"After a decade, or several decades, won't Xu Yan be capable of killing a Realm Master?"
Tian Shiqi couldn't help but murmur to himself.
The more he thought about it, the more his scalp tingled, and his heart trembled. If Xu Yan knew that he had once targeted him, his fate would be hard to predict.
"No, I can't let him continue to grow, otherwise, after a decade, or several decades, wouldn't even Lord Heavenly Slaughter be no match for him?"
The thought made Tian Shiqi restless.
"One Divine Venerate is no match, what about three? Or five or six?"
Tian Shiqi's eyes flickered. Even at the risk of angering the Realm Master powerhouses behind Xu Yan, he must strangle Xu Yan in the cradle.
Otherwise, the consequences would be unpredictable.
"The Divine Venerates who descended to the Divine Realm this time were not just one or two. Among them are many Loose Cultivators and some weaker Realm Divine Venerates. Xu Yan's Subduing Dragon Technique, his powerful Martial Arts, even the secret techniques to break through limitations, they're all very tempting..."
Tian Shiqi plotted in his heart.
It was impossible for him to make a move himself, he absolutely couldn't afford to do it personally, it was too dangerous.
But, he could incite and entice other Divine Venerate strongmen to make a move, especially those troubled by Martial Arts bottlenecks and unable to break through for a glimmer of progress, they would surely be willing to take the risk.
Moreover, the joint efforts of several Divine Venerates didn't count as a risk, and these Divine Venerate Martial Artists would definitely be willing to gamble.
"Among these descending Divine Venerates, there are several who have been desperately seeking an opportunity to break through, having been stuck in the late stages of Divine Venerate for a long time, and there's even one who's nearly going mad in his attempts to break through to the Supreme Sovereign Realm. They can all be utilized to good effect."
Tian Shiqi's mind conjured the list of certain Divine Venerate Martial Artists who had descended to the Divine Realm this time.
It's not easy to manipulate Great Realm Divine Venerates, but those Loose Cultivator Divine Venerates and those from smaller realms, especially those who have been persistently pursuing the opportunity to break through, are easier to use and more willing to give it their all.
"I mustn't personally step forward for this matter. Since Divine Venerates have also come from the Heavenly Slaughter Realm this time, let Number Seventy-Six take care of these things."
Soon, Tian Shiqi had decided on the candidate.
Inciting Divine Venerates to besiege Xu Yan was far too dangerous, and Tian Shiqi wouldn't dare let anyone know that he was the one plotting this.
Therefore, a scapegoat was necessary.
Even if they failed to kill Xu Yan in the end and the matter leaked out, Xu Yan wouldn't target him first, but would put the blame on the heads of Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
"I am just a minion; I must make myself appear to be an insignificant minion, so that if one day Lord Heavenly Slaughter is killed, I, as this minion, won't be easily targeted..."
Tian Shiqi muttered to himself while plotting how to lower his role and status in the eyes of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow.
But that would be the external impression; to Lord Heavenly Slaughter, he must still appear as a subordinate worthy of cultivation.
Achieving this goal wasn't easy; he needed to appear insignificant to others yet capable and valuable to Lord Heavenly Slaughter.
Though difficult to accomplish both, Tian Shiqi knew that for safety and the sake of his own life, it must be done.
```
"What if... if Lord Heavenly Slaughter were to be defeated, could I at the critical moment switch allegiances to Xu Yan, backstab Lord Heavenly Slaughter, and save my own life? And in doing so, be seen as turning from darkness to light and thus valued?"
Tian Shiqi was pondering over the various potential problems he might encounter in the future and how he could preserve his life.
"I'll focus on completing this task first, whether I can kill Xu Yan or not."
Tian Shiqi began to take action, "Seventy-six is simple-minded, with just a little setup, he'll go and do it, and it'll keep me out of the picture. Even if he's exposed by Xu Yan, he'll have no idea it was me plotting against him."
In the God Domain, the news of Xu Yan, the renowned Subduing Dragon youth in the Dao Realm, slaying a Divine Venerate in the Azure Sea Sphere, swept through like a storm, not long after, five Divine Venerates gathered together in a certain place.
"We've all come for Xu Yan, to break through our own bottlenecks. Since we're going to work together, we should agree on the terms beforehand to avoid disputes and preserve harmony later on," said a white-haired Divine Venerate with a mask concealing his face.
"Of course!"
The other four Divine Venerate Warriors, also wearing masks, did not reveal their true faces.
"Rumor has it that Xu Yan's Subduing Dragon Technique can not only subdue dragons but is also an immensely powerful Martial Art that can break through the shackles of the Divine Venerate Realm. I've come for this very technique, and I believe it's the same for you all," another Divine Venerate Warrior said.
"Then it's settled, we will each copy what we learn from Xu Yan's technique, and if there are treasures that catch our eyes, we will divide them equally. If there aren't enough treasures to go around, then they'll go to whoever is stronger, contributes more, agree?" the White-haired Divine Venerate proposed the terms of distribution.
"So be it!"
Having settled their discussions, the five Divine Venerate Warriors, with great understanding amongst themselves, promptly set off towards the Azure Sea Sphere.
Soon after the five Divine Venerates left, a figure emerged silently, masking his face with a mask of dark clouds.
"Tian Shiqi is such a waste, not knowing how to seize the opportunity. Once I get the Subduing Dragon Technique and present it to our superior, Tian Shiqi's position shall be mine."
With a shift, the figure stealthily followed the five Divine Venerate Warriors.
"Five Divine Venerates, plus Seventy-six, can Xu Yan still match them?"
In a distant place, Tian Shiqi considered quietly.
"If the Divine Venerates are not enough, then we'll have to wait for a Supreme Sovereign to arrive. But regarding the matter of Xu Yan, I can't get too involved. I need to leave myself a way out."
Tian Shiqi was calculating in his heart.
In the Azure Sea Sphere, Xu Yan's slaying of a Divine Venerate shook the Divine Realm, and strong figures like the Yuntian Island Master and elders of the Sea Spirit Tribe paid their respects to Xu Yan, eager to forge even a slight connection.
"Brother Xu, let's meet again in the Qinghua state!"
That day, Xie Lingfeng said farewell to Xu Yan and set off for the Qinghua state.
"Alright!"
Xu Yan nodded.
Xie Lingfeng and his family left Yuntian Island and embarked on their journey to the Qinghua state.
After bidding farewell to the Yuntian Island Master, and the Great Elder of the Sea Spirit Tribe, Xu Yan left Yuntian Island and was preparing to contact the Azure Sea Turtle.
Now that he was in the Domain Realm, absorbing the Rhythms of Domain was no difficulty for him.
Moreover, Xu Yan also wanted to learn more about the Taicang Domain and the Imperishable Land beyond the heavens from the Azure Sea Turtle.
Perhaps, he could even seize the great opportunity mentioned by the Azure Sea Turtle, which might let him comprehend the mysteries of the Creation Realm.
Walking above the Azure Sea, Xu Yan suddenly paused, his calm demeanor tinged with a hint of mockery, "Do even Divine Venerate Realm Warriors need to skulk about and hide their faces nowadays?"
Five figures converged around him, their auras formidable, each one's strength not falling short of the Divine Venerate from the Yunluo Realm, and perhaps even stronger.
"Are you Xu Yan?" asked the white-haired Divine Venerate in a deep voice.
"Yes, I am!" replied Xu Yan, his expression calm, "Are you here for the Subduing Dragon Technique too?"
"Since you're already aware of our purpose, hand over the Subduing Dragon Technique, and we will not make things difficult for you," the White-haired Divine Venerate said with a hardened gaze, emitting a threatening presence.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 972 - 504: Fighting Five Alone, Another Divine Venerate Slain
chapters.content:
Xu Yan looked down on them proudly, a sneer of scorn spreading across his lips, "Even if I were to teach you the Subduing Dragon Technique, do you think you waste materials could cultivate it successfully? Moreover, do you even deserve it?"
His eyes were full of disdain and contempt as if he were looking at a group of trash.
The five Divine Venerates immediately exploded with rage, their aura burst forth, the heaven and earth's winds and clouds changed color, and the turbulent Azure Sea calmed down at this moment.
As if an invisible oppressive force was preventing the surface of the sea from stirring a single ripple.
Xu Yan's expression remained unchanged, as if oblivious, he said to himself, "I've heard that in the Dao Realm some Divine Venerates have been unable to increase their strength for a long time, perpetually unable to break through their bottleneck. Therefore, they come to the Divine Realm, hoping to use these changes in heaven and earth to find an opportunity for breakthrough.
"You five wouldn't happen to be among those Divine Venerates, would you? Especially you!"
His gaze landed on the White-haired Divine Venerate, Xu Yan mocked, "Your hair white as frost, so proud of being an elder who has lived longer, yet you are still stuck and unable to break through the Divine Venerate bottleneck for who knows how many years?
"If you can't even break through the Divine Venerate Realm, how dare you covet the Subduing Dragon Technique? You're so useless, even if you obtained the Subduing Dragon Technique, could you understand it? Could you comprehend it?"
The White-haired Divine Venerate's eyes turned blood-red in an instant, his breath heavy, his aura violent, and the words "old trash" seemed to be echoing in his mind!
In his youth, he was praised as a once-in-a-millennium prodigy with the posture of a Supreme Sovereign, rising powerfully all the way, only to find himself stagnating in the Divine Venerate Realm, making no further progress.
No matter how hard he cultivated, no matter how much he sought to comprehend, even seeking guidance from the Supreme Sovereigns, he still could not break through!
Whenever he recalled those past praises, the once-in-a-millennium prodigy, the posture of a Supreme Sovereign, it all felt like slaps in his face, becoming a demon in his heart.
How could the White-haired Divine Venerate endure such mockery? He roared furiously, "Xu Yan, you little brat, today this old man will tear you to pieces!!!"
"Attack, kill this arrogant brat!"
The White-haired Divine Venerate's aura surged, a crimson light emerging from him, transforming into a massive hammer and bursting forth.
The other four Divine Venerates, also aggravated by Xu Yan's contemptuous gaze, followed suit as soon as the White-haired Divine Venerate made his move.
The five Divine Venerates joined forces and attacked Xu Yan from all directions.
Roar!
Suddenly, a dragon cry resounded, Dragon Might vast as if an enraged True Dragon had descended, its raging Dragon Might arriving.
"If you like the Subduing Dragon Technique so much, then die by the Subduing Dragon Technique!"
Xu Yan sneered coldly, raised his hand, and struck out with his palm.
True Dragon Rage!
He directly unleashed the Divine Skill True Dragon Rage, a Golden Giant Dragon roared, thunder and dark clouds appearing instantly, the True Dragon's eyes seemingly filled with extreme fury.
Wind, rain, and thunder, coming with the dragon's cry, the Dragon Might of the True Dragon swept across heaven and earth, the True Dragon sweeping all directions.
"What is this?"
The expressions of the five Divine Venerates changed drastically, feeling as if they were facing an enraged True Dragon.
Dragon Might vast, thunder accompanying the True Dragon, the raging True Dragon's Power made their scalps tingle!
Is this the Subduing Dragon Technique?!
The five Divine Venerates were incredulous, this was clearly a True Dragon, as if already furious to the extreme, ready to perish alongside its enemies!
Boom!
Under the strike of True Dragon Rage, the five Divine Venerates staggered back, their aura in disarray, especially the White-haired Divine Venerate, who spat out blood.
At this moment, they looked at the young man with a look of shock in their eyes. What kind of Martial Arts was this?
So powerful and inconceivable, completely beyond their understanding!
Xu Yan stepped forward, and with a resounding crash, a surge of waves rose up, transforming into a biting giant sword, five giant swords standing upon the surface of the sea.
"Today, as I cut you down, remember the name, Sword God Xu Yan!"
Xu Yan smiled coldly, pointed with his hand, and the giant swords crashed down decisively.
The Divine Venerate Martial Artists were not weak, and once they realized Xu Yan's strength was far beyond their expectations, they dared not take him lightly and immediately resorted to their ultimate techniques.
Boom!
The fierce battle erupted, the Azure Sea rolled with huge waves, the wind and clouds surged, the intense battle rippling for miles.
With every motion of Xu Yan's hand, the rolling waves transformed into one sword after another, pouring out furiously, like a mighty river of ten thousand swords.
Each sword emitted different Sword Intents—some freezing to the bone, some scorching like fire, some as gentle as a soft breeze, but no matter what kind of Sword Intent, all contained sharp offensive power.
Even more so, each sword seemed to possess its own Spiritual Wisdom, wielding different Offensive Arts.
Against five, Xu Yan still moved with ease, while the five Divine Venerates roared repeatedly, constantly exerting various secret techniques, yet still being suppressed.
"Merely Divine Venerates, daring to seek out me, Xu Yan, who gave you the courage?"
Xu Yan's gaze was indifferent.
Divine Venerates no longer caught his eye!
Now, even if his strength was not equal to a Supreme Sovereign, crushing Divine Venerates was no problem at all.
He was no ordinary Martial Artist at the Domain Realm. Even as a newcomer to the Domain Realm, he was not someone that a Divine Venerate could compare with.
Boom!
The battle continued, and the surging sword waves converged from all directions, enveloping the five Divine Venerates within, the tightening circle constricting them ever closer.
Xu Yan even held one hand behind his back, moving a single hand, the sword waves roared forth, cutting and slashing away.
At one moment, Xu Yan stamped his foot, and with a thundering sound, the surface of the sea caved in, forming a huge depression.
Suddenly, a giant vortex appeared, the vortex raging, like numerous swords forming a Sword Dao vortex, the intense intent to kill sweeping downwards, as if to engulf this entire sea region within the Sword Dao vortex.

chapters.title: Chapter 973 - 504: One Against Five, Another Divine Venerate Slain
chapters.content:
"Oh, you think you can ambush me too?"
Xu Yan looked down with contempt at the shocked figure beneath the vortex of the Sword Dao.
A person from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow!
This was a Divine Venerate Realm Earth Shadow member.
Seventy-six, wearing a mask of dark clouds, never would have imagined that he would be exposed, never would have thought that Xu Yan would detect him.
At this moment, as he looked at the swirling vortex around him, the intent to kill stimulated him, and a strong sense of crisis loomed, as if in the next instant he would be torn apart by the vortex.
"How did he discover me?"
A sinking feeling overcame Seventy-six.
He was confident that with his own art of stealth and concealment, and with Xu Yan engaged in battle with five Divine Venerates, under such intense commotion, it was absolutely impossible to discover his presence.
Yet, it seemed that Xu Yan had long since detected him, waiting for him to approach stealthily before suddenly striking, trapping him within this vortex of the Sword Dao.
"Xu Yan, you can't stop me,"
Seventy-six burst forth with a surge of cold energy, and with a thunderous boom, a blinding icy light erupted from his body, blasting towards the Sword Dao vortex that enveloped him.
Boom!
However, to his horror, such a powerful attack did not break through the vortex; instead, as the vortex spun, the attack was sucked in, rotating along with it.
At one moment, his attack, improbably, burst forth from the vortex and struck at him instead!
"What kind of martial arts technique is this?"
Seventy-six's face paled in alarm, and he hurriedly made another move, this time directly using a secret technique.
Puff!
Amongst the billowing grey smoke, Seventy-six's figure seemed to become ethereal, almost blending into the water, his whereabouts uncertain amidst the flitting shadows.
Cold and concealed strikes emerged from hiding, forming into a massive blade that crashed down toward the vortex.
Xu Yan's expression remained indifferent, as he clapped his hand, and with a roar, a Golden Dragon suddenly appeared in the midst of the Sword Dao vortex, spiraling along with the vortex's twirl, while the tumultuous power of the sea water was all being gathered at this moment.
True Dragon Water Command!
"You?"
Seventy-six's face showed horror, and at that moment, he felt a chill on his scalp, surrounded as if by an invisible pressure constantly condensing around him, feeling as though a great mountain weighed upon him.
The Golden Dragon, carrying the vortex in its coils, not only tightened its grip during its spiraling, but the space Seventy-six occupied became smaller and smaller, and the solidifying force upon him grew stronger.
It seemed, in the next moment, he would be crushed to death!
But, no matter how he used his secret techniques, he was still unable to break free, and even the most powerful of attacks seemed to dissipate into the vast waters of the Azure Sea.
Seventy-six knew that to break this situation, he had to defeat that Golden Dragon; otherwise, all his attacks would be dissolved into nothingness by the Golden Dragon's command over the waters of the Azure Sea.
And his strength was not enough to surpass the limits of the Golden Dragon Water Command and break its power to dissolve attacks.
"Kill!"
Seventy-six roared, his figure disappearing in an instant, and in the next moment, gripping a grey short blade in his hand, he appeared in front of the Golden Dragon. The short blade flashed with a grey light and vanished from Seventy-six's hand, and the next moment, with a puff, it pierced into the Golden Dragon's head.
Bang!
The Golden Dragon's head exploded, and the short blade also shattered in that strike, but that hit finally had an effect!
Seventy-six's face lit up with surprise; this was Earth Shadow's strongest strike, usually used to instantly ambush a target stronger than himself.
The short blade was also a specially made Divine Artifact, capable of unleashing a burst of strength beyond the limits of his own power.
With the Golden Dragon broken, the chance to escape was right before his eyes.
As for killing Xu Yan, Seventy-six knew himself well at this moment; Xu Yan's strength was not something a Divine Venerate Martial Artist could contend with.
It was just the right moment to escape, but then with a roar, another Golden Giant Dragon descended, continuing to carry the vortex in its coils and began to spiral once again.
"How is this possible!"
Seventy-six stood there, his eyes vacant.
Before he could recover, another Golden Giant Dragon descended, with two dragons intertwining and spiraling, the space constricted even more, trapping him thoroughly in the vortex.
At this moment, Seventy-six had a look of utter despair in his eyes!
"It's time to end this!"
Xu Yan's gaze became silent, and his figure moved, vanishing instantly from his spot, and in the next instant, he appeared in front of the White-haired Divine Venerate.
A sword fell!
Divine Skills, Supreme Heavenly Sword!
The White-haired Divine Venerate's eyes showed a look of fear, without even a sliver of resistance, he turned to ash and dissipated in an instant!
The remaining four Divine Venerates were terrified at this moment!
"Xu Yan, we admit defeat, let's call it quits!"
Someone said with a trembling voice.
"Anyone who is an enemy of mine, Xu Yan, has no chance of leaving alive!"
Xu Yan scoffed coldly.
```
Swish!
Another sword fell!
No matter how the four Divine Venerates erupted with secret techniques or employed their last-ditch life-saving measures, it was all to no avail; Xu Yan dispatched each with a single stroke, leaving none alive.
At the end, only Seventy-Six, the Divine Venerate Martial Artist from Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, remained.
"Do you wish to die, or do you wish to live?"
Xu Yan asked coldly.
Seventy-Six swallowed and said, "You're willing to spare my life?"
"Of course, it all depends on whether you understand the situation and whether you're smart enough!"
Xu Yan said with a slight smile.
"I surrender, I am willing to be your ox and horse, Young Master Xu!"
Seventy-Six decisively caved in.
With the threat of death hanging over his head, he felt his mind working faster than it ever had before.
"Very well, since you want to live, then open your mind. Show the slightest resistance, and don't blame me if you die."
Xu Yan nodded and instructed.
"Okay, I won't resist at all!"
Now it was a matter of do or die.
And after complying, whether or not he would face death, all he could do was take a chance.
Xu Yan took control of Seventy-Six with the Destiny of the Heavenly Intent. Being a member of the Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow of the Divine Venerate Realm, Seventy-Six was far more useful than those Immortal Heavenly Venerates.
He could be quite useful.
After taking control of Seventy-Six, Xu Yan assigned him some tasks, such as gathering other Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow Members that Xu Yan covertly controlled.
"Draw me the maps of the Dao Realm, Earth Shadow Realm, and the Heavenly Slaughter Realm as you know them."
Xu Yan instructed.
"Yes, yes!"
Seventy-Six nodded respectfully.
He drew maps of everything he knew about the Dao Realm, the Heavenly Slaughter Realm, and even the Earth Shadow Realm.
Taking the maps, Xu Yan glanced over them and instructed, "Find an opportunity to return to the Dao Realm, return to the Heavenly Slaughter Realm, and await orders."
He gave Seventy-Six a Communication Talisman and warned, "Be careful not to expose yourself."
"Yes, Master!"
Seventy-Six responded respectfully.
"Go!"
Xu Yan waved his hand dismissively.
Seventy-Six vanished from the spot as if he had never been there.
Xu Yan looked at the maps drawn by Seventy-Six. "In the Dao Realm of the Three Hundred Realms, each Realm is the same, and besides the Three Hundred Realms, there's also the expansive territory of the Dao Realm itself, with regions even Divine Venerates have not yet explored.
"With his identity as a Divine Venerate, his knowledge of the Heavenly Slaughter Realm is hardly extensive, but it's enough. The hidden places of the Heavenly Slaughter Realm should contain some treasures."
The Heavenly Slaughter was brimming with grand ambition and wild dreams, scheming for the Domain Authority of the Taicang Domain, desiring to become the new Master of Domain. Yet in the Dao Realm, there were still those ancient Minor Heaven and Earth Masters.
For example, Taimiao was among them.
In such a situation, for the Heavenly Slaughter to dare to scheme for the Domain Authority of Taicang shows they must have some level of confidence.
"The Divine Realm no longer holds any treasures that catch my eye; it's time to roam the Dao Realm. Emptying the treasures of the Heavenly Slaughter Realm should be sufficient for me to rapidly cultivate to the Establishing Dao Realm."
Xu Yan already had a plan in mind.
He wouldn't just wait in the Divine Realm for someone to come to him, but instead he planned to infiltrate into the Dao Realm. This was both to seek out the opportunity to comprehend the Creation Realm and to elevate his strength as quickly as possible, hoping to break through to the Establishing Dao Realm at the earliest opportunity.
"It's time to chat with the Azure Sea Turtle about that opportunity, exactly where it lies."
Xu Yan hadn't forgotten the deal with the Azure Sea Turtle. That great opportunity might just aid in his endeavor to reach the Creation Realm.
He raised his palm, and a cluster of Rhythms of Domain materialized within it.
"Old Turtle, I'm here to fulfill our previous deal."
Xu Yan took out a Communication Talisman and sent a message to the Azure Sea Turtle.
"Truly? Come quickly to this place, but be careful not to reveal your tracks."
The delighted voice of the Azure Sea Turtle came through.
"Worry not; if I, Xu Yan, wish to conceal myself, even a Realm Master might not be able to find me."
Xu Yan said with a confident chuckle.
With one step, he vanished instantly, and in no time at all, he arrived at the hiding place of the Azure Sea Turtle.
"You old turtle sure know how to hide."
Xu Yan couldn't help but exclaim; the Azure Sea Turtle's art of concealment was the most profound he had ever seen. Unless he employed the Minor Heavenly Eye to scrutinize intensely, he would not be able to detect the turtle.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 974 - 505: Mysterious Great Opportunity, Infiltrating the Dao Realm
chapters.content:
"It's just a minor life-saving technique,"
said the Azure Sea Turtle, lifting its head.
"You're being modest, old turtle. If I hadn't carefully investigated, I wouldn't have been able to detect your presence, and even a Realm Master might find it difficult, right?"
Xu Yan's face showed admiration.
Yet the Azure Sea Turtle's heart skipped a beat. Xu Yan could see through its Turtle Breath Technique?
How was that possible?
Though it was not at its peak due to injuries, the Turtle Breath Technique it used was hardly weaker than at its peak.
Especially when hidden under the sea bed, covered by mud, even a Realm Master couldn't detect any anomalies.
"You could discover me?"
The Azure Sea Turtle was somewhat startled.
"Of course!"
Xu Yan nodded, pointing to his eyes, "With your hiding skills, you temporarily can't deceive my eyes. Of course, if I hadn't carefully investigated, I wouldn't have detected you either."
The Azure Sea Turtle stared into Xu Yan's eyes for a long while, secretly shocked. Back then, it was only by this technique that it managed to escape from that calamity.
The being that caused that catastrophe was immensely powerful, beyond imagination. It had escaped death by such means, and now Xu Yan could actually discover it, which was unbelievable.
"This is the Rhythms of Domain you need!"
Xu Yan raised his hand, throwing a cluster of Rhythms of Domain over.
The Azure Sea Turtle was overjoyed, opening its mouth to swallow the cluster of Rhythms of Domain, "A bit too little, can you get me more?"
"With this cluster of Rhythms of Domain, you should be able to recover quite a bit. Just absorb Rhythms of Domain by yourself,"
said Xu Yan, shaking his head.
"Friend Xu, what you don't know is that the Taicang Domain is undergoing major changes. If I absorb Rhythms of Domain, it would easily expose me,"
sighed the Azure Sea Turtle.
"But you're different. Even if discovered, it wouldn't matter much to you, as it's normal behavior for the powerful. Isn't it?"
The Azure Sea Turtle stared eagerly at him.
"It's not impossible, but we had a deal initially, what about that great opportunity?"
Xu Yan pondered for a moment and nodded.
"That great opportunity..."
The Azure Sea Turtle hesitated for a long while, "With your current strength, Friend Xu, you cannot reach the place of that great opportunity. Moreover, to be honest, after such a long passage of time, whether some changes have occurred to that opportunity is also unknown.
"The location of that great opportunity cannot be described in a few words or shown on a map, I must lead the way. But I'm seriously injured and temporarily unable to go."
Xu Yan frowned, "Are you saying the opportunity is in the Land of Imperishable?"
The Azure Sea Turtle nodded, "Yes, in the Land of Imperishable. And I'm almost certain that the opportunity has moved from its original location, but I would know its tracks. With your current strength, it's too dangerous for you to enter the Land of Imperishable and seek the opportunity."
"What strength is needed to go for this opportunity?"
Xu Yan asked thoughtfully.
"At the very least, one has to be a Minor Heaven and Earth Master, and among them, one of the strongest, otherwise you do not possess the strength to seize the opportunity,"
said the Azure Sea Turtle after a moment of thought.
"I am very curious about this great opportunity you speak of. You've also received the Rhythms of Domain, so shouldn't you tell me now?"
Xu Yan was very curious about the great opportunity mentioned by the Azure Sea Turtle.
The Azure Sea Turtle was silent for a long time before saying, "Friend Xu, this matter involves a lot. While my strength hasn't recovered to its peak and your strength isn't strong enough, I dare not reveal too much.
"But I can reveal a little information to you—securing this opportunity has a great chance of making someone a Master of Domain!"
Upon hearing this, Xu Yan instantly understood—the opportunity must be related to the Seven Great Domain Masters.
"Taicang or which one?"
The Azure Sea Turtle was surprised for a moment, then it suddenly understood. Xu Yan, being so exceptional, must have an extraordinary heritage behind him. Knowing about the Seven Great Domain Masters was only natural.
"Not Taicang,"
the Azure Sea Turtle said gravely, "Since you know about Taicang, you must also know about the Imperishable Temple. To be honest, this opportunity involves the Imperishable Temple, and there could be potential conflict with the Imperishable Temple. So you must think carefully about whether to take this opportunity!
"Of course, my promise still stands. If you can handle this opportunity successfully and seize it, I, old turtle, am willing to follow you."
The great opportunity involved the Imperishable Temple; no wonder the Azure Sea Turtle was so cautious. Moreover, achieving the opportunity had the potential to make someone a Master of Domain. Once leaked, those Minor Heaven and Earth Masters and those Realm Masters who had survived might go mad.
The dangers involved were clearly understood by Xu Yan, which was why the Azure Sea Turtle emphasized that his current strength was insufficient to pursue the great opportunity.
Moreover, the great opportunity had specific requirements regarding strength.
"The Imperishable Temple, I see. You take care and heal up. Once my strength is enough, I'll come back for you,"
said Xu Yan and took a step, vanishing instantly from the spot.
"I hope it can really be successful,"
sighed the Azure Sea Turtle internally. Although Xu Yan appeared exceptionally capable, the thought of the Imperishable Temple somewhat shook his confidence.
Even someone as strong as Taicang had fallen!
"Even if Xu Yan is as strong as Taicang, he might not be able to contend with the Imperishable Temple, and there's not much time left. The Imperishable Temple will likely take action soon,"
the Azure Sea Turtle looked up at the firmament, his eyes filled with worry.
Xu Yan had once again made a name for himself in the Divine Realm, single-handedly defeating five Divine Venerate Realm fighters. As the news spread, various Divine Venerates who were originally scheming to acquire the Subduing Dragon Technique, immediately dismissed the idea.

chapters.title: Chapter 975 - 505: Mysterious Great Opportunity, Sneaking Into the Dao Realm_2
chapters.content:
```
"What is Xu Yan's actual strength? Has he already broken through to the Divine Venerate Realm, or even touched the threshold of the Supreme Sovereign Realm?"
"You all, don't let greed cloud your judgment. I've said it long before, Xu Yan's anomaly, how could his legacy be simple? Behind him, there must be a Realm Master Realm expert, or even highly likely, an ancient Minor Heaven and Earth Master!"
"That's right, once the Subduing Dragon Technique is revealed, it will surely offend the entire True Dragon Clan. How could Xu Yan not know? Yet he did it anyway, which means he is confident, he has a powerful backing!"
"Go back to your closed-door cultivation. With the unification of the Dao and Divine Realms, the great changes in the world might bring about opportunities for breakthroughs. The Subduing Dragon Technique is not something we can covet; it's something only the great realms are qualified to be involved in."
Many Divine Venerate Martial Artists harbored caution and no longer mentioned the idea of joining forces to seize the Subduing Dragon Technique.
"Seventy-Six actually survived!"
Tian Shiqi was quite surprised.
"With his intelligence, he shouldn't have been able to survive, and Xu Yan shouldn't be able to miss him. Could it be that he noticed something wrong beforehand and didn't get close to Xu Yan?"
Tian Shiqi was full of doubts in his heart.
But he didn't dare to inquire further, for fear of exposing himself and the use of Seventy-Six from behind, so he could only suppress his questions.
"Xu Yan is an adversary I can't afford unless I reach the Supreme Sovereign status, I can't get involved anymore."
Tian Shiqi had his calculations in mind.
In the Dao Realm, Ao Ming was burning with anxiety, wishing he could immediately descend to the Divine Realm, rescue his daughter, tear Xu Yan to pieces, and wash away the humiliation of the True Dragon Clan.
However, he wasn't yet capable of passing through the Earth Shadow Realm to enter the Divine Realm and could only wait anxiously.
In the Taihe Realm, the Taikun Realm, the Heavenly Slaughter Realm, and other strong realms, there were Supreme Sovereigns waiting, and each Supreme Sovereign had their own task.
The changes in the Taicang Domain were beyond the control of these Supreme Sovereigns; it was a game played by the Realm Master Realm experts.
Thud!
A dull sound echoed from the Earth Shadow Realm, and the vibrations of the Earth Shadow Realm began to weaken, now meeting the conditions to pass through the Earth Shadow Realm.
Roar!
Ao Ming let out a dragon's roar, his huge dragon eyes sweeping over the Supreme Sovereigns present, and then led four True Spirits into the Earth Shadow Realm, heading towards the Divine Realm.
"Let's go!"
The Supreme Sovereign from the Taikun Realm smiled and stepped into the Earth Shadow Realm.
One after another, the Supreme Sovereign Warriors entered the Earth Shadow Realm and descended into the Divine Realm.
"Such a powerful True Dragon, with my current strength, I probably cannot subdue it. At least a minor achievement above the Domain Realm's level is required."
In a certain part of the Earth Shadow Realm, Xu Yan was silent as if he did not exist within the Earth Shadow Realm, in a state resembling 'existing within the domain, unknown to the domain.'
After reaching the Domain Realm, Xu Yan's technique of concealing presence and form had achieved great proficiency, bringing about the profound state of 'existing within the domain, unknown to the domain.'
This was also why Xu Yan, knowing that there were forces from different realms paying attention to him, still dared to set foot in the Dao Realm.
Watching Ao Ming, leading four True Spirits, march off in a grand manner, he assessed in his mind that with his current strength, it would be incredibly difficult to subdue that True Dragon, almost impossible to achieve.
The gap in strength between them was just too great.
"That True Dragon must be coming for me, but I'm no longer in the Divine Realm, not interested in entangling with him."
Xu Yan withdrew his gaze and continued walking.
He seemed nonexistent in the Earth Shadow Realm, moving silently, and even the principles of the Earth Shadow Realm failed to detect his presence.
One powerful aura after another kept arriving from the direction of the Dao Realm, passing through the Earth Shadow Realm. None of these Supreme Sovereigns stayed in the Earth Shadow Realm nor did they show any intent to explore.
"Something is not right over there!"
Suddenly, Xu Yan looked towards a certain place in the Earth Shadow Realm. Despite the great distance, under the gaze of the Minor Heavenly Eye, Xu Yan still noticed some abnormalities.
"There's a strong presence there!"
Xu Yan was secretly shocked. In that place, a strong presence was lurking, and even he could not see through the details of this strong presence.
He could only vaguely sense that the other party was hidden within.
"Realm Master Realm!"
```
```
Xu Yan dared not be careless, nor did he have any intention of going to explore; he became even more concealed and distanced himself from that particular location.
A Realm Master was hidden within, and his identity was self-evident.
The Earth Shadow Realm Master!
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, huh? Rumor has it that the Earth Shadow Realm Master was killed by Heavenly Slaughter, and the Earth Shadow Realm fell under Heavenly Slaughter's control. It seems this was a blind, a ruse to hide the Earth Shadow Realm Master, the scheme is grand indeed."
Xu Yan sighed to himself.
Naturally, the power of the Earth Shadow Realm Master was not weak, and since he was hidden within the Earth Shadow Realm, theoretically, he would be the first to detect any outsiders entering the realm.
Because of this, Xu Yan dared not be careless in the slightest, nor did he intend to go exploring. Realm Master Realm warriors were ultimately mighty.
Moreover, the Earth Shadow Realm Master was proficient in the art of concealment, and within his own turf, the Earth Shadow Realm, Xu Yan could not guarantee that his own approach would not expose him.
As a Supreme Sovereign of the Dao Realm headed towards the Divine Realm, Xu Yan, on the other hand, moved from the Divine Realm towards the Dao Realm, finally arriving at the boundary where the Earth Shadow Realm connected with the Dao Realm.
Xu Yan did not immediately leave the Earth Shadow Realm but silently waited at its entrance, his eyes scanning the outside of the Earth Shadow Realm and surveying the surroundings.
"Heavenly Slaughter is not present, nor any Realm Master Realm experts."
Xu Yan still did not emerge from the Earth Shadow Realm, continuing to wait in silence.
Eventually, from the direction of the Divine Realm in the Earth Shadow Realm, several presences emerged, with many warriors coming from the Divine Realm back into the Dao Realm.
Among these people was the seventy-sixth.
Of course, part of the warriors returning to the Dao Realm did so after being persuaded by the seventy-sixth to come back from the Divine Realm.
A group of people left the Earth Shadow Realm and returned to the Dao Realm.
And Xu Yan, quietly and without a sound, followed this group of people into the Dao Realm.
"So this is the Dao Realm!"
Upon entering the Dao Realm, Xu Yan couldn't help but exclaim.
It was truly the origin of the Taicang Domain, where both nature's spiritual energy and the Domain Lingji were far beyond that of the Divine Realm.
What made the Dao Realm even more unique, apart from the rich nature's spiritual energy, was the presence of the Rhythms of Domain. While weaker beings could not sense or utilize them,
Cultivating in places infused with the Rhythms of Domain, whether in terms of innate talent or comprehension, would see improvement, making Martial Arts bottlenecks weaker and naturally raising the upper limit of Martial Arts.
The same innate talent, cultivated in the Dao Realm, would progress faster, the mastery of Martial Arts would come more easily, and the ultimate limit one could achieve would also be higher.
"No wonder, in ancient times in the Taicang Domain, martial artists would eventually travel to the great origin, the core of the Domain; it is truly different."
Xu Yan sighed.
After briefly discerning the direction, he did not head towards the Heavenly Slaughter Realm but towards his first destination.
It was a spot reputed in ancient times to be a renowned training ground for cultivating. Up to the present, aside from a few exceptional places in the entire Dao Realm, it had become indistinguishable from the rest.
Therefore, that particular training ground no longer held the once irresistible allure for martial artists.
Xu Yan speculated that this spot must be one of the origins of the Domain, the core. Even though some changes had occurred, there would still likely be unusual aspects to it.
He came to the Dao Realm to comprehend the Creation Realm.
The closer one gets to the origin of the Domain, the more likely one can grasp the profound mysteries of the creation of the Domain.
Xu Yan traveled within the Dao Realm towards that training ground, passing through a large city, observing the bustling of martial artists and marveling, the Dao Realm was indeed the core of the Domain.
In the Dao Realm, the Immortal Heavenly Venerable was as common as a Condensation Law Realm warrior in the Divine Realm, easily found and ranked among the weaker ones, without the reverence they received in the Divine Realm.
Xu Yan did not linger in the city. After picking up some information about the Dao Realm, he continued on his way to the training ground.
"I, Xu Yan, seem to have quite a reputation in the Dao Realm."
Naturally, the buzz among the city's warriors involved the fall of the Earth Shadow Realm into the Divine Realm and the impending unification with the Dao Realm, along with the potential opportunities it might bring.
There were also speculations about what the major powerful realms were scheming.
As for Xu Yan, the Subduing Dragon youth, he was also one of the hot topics.
Especially since the news of Ao Ming of the True Dragon Realm leading the four True Spirits into the Divine Realm had spread, the warriors of the Dao Realm were speculating about the fate awaiting this dragon-subduing youth.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 976 - 506: Supreme Sovereign Descends, The Test of Heavenly Slaughter
chapters.content:
The martial artists of the Dao Realm were discussing how the Xiang Long youth would end up, and Xu Yan, the person in question, had already arrived at that treasured land.
"Indeed, it is one of the places of the Domain Origin, only obscured by the Dao Principles, its peculiarities currently veiled."
Under the Minor Heavenly Eye, Xu Yan had already discerned the core of this place.
"Sense the Domain Origin, and thereby comprehend the Creation Realm."
Xu Yan immediately began making arrangements to enter the treasured land, to sense the Domain Origin and comprehend the Creation Realm. As for Ao Ming's arrival in the Divine Realm and the arrival of various Supreme Sovereigns in the Divine Realm, Xu Yan hardly took them to heart.
"This is the place!"
Upon entering the treasured land, in a moment's thought, mountains, rivers, and the domain materialized, merging with the treasured land as if they became one with this Domain.
With everything ready, Xu Yan used his own Domain to resonate with the Origin of this Domain, to comprehend the Creation Realm through it.
While Xu Yan was in the Dao Realm, sensing the Domain Origin and comprehending the Creation Realm, the Divine Realm was once again stirred up.
Ao!
As a dragon's cry resounded, many martial artists near the Earth Shadow Realm were suddenly terrified and hastily retreated, distancing themselves from the Earth Shadow Realm.
Dragon Might swept in, the Taihe Realm suddenly erupted with wind and thunder, clouds whirled, and lightning twinkled, as a True Dragon emerged from the Earth Shadow Realm, soaring among the clouds.
Following the True Dragon, four powerful True Spirits also surged with a daunting aura, accompanying on either side behind the True Dragon.
"True Dragon!"
The Divine Venerate martial artists were subtly thrilled; the True Dragon had arrived, clearly targeting Xu Yan.
They all wanted to see how the Xiang Long youth would face this perilous situation.
"Where is that child Xu Yan?"
Ao Ming soared in the clouds, his eyes glaring down, bellowing angrily.
No one responded!
Boom!
At that moment, one after another figure with immense aura appeared from within the Earth Shadow Realm, bearing the air of Supreme Sovereigns.
Supreme Sovereign Realm Warriors!
The elders of the Taihe Sect were extraordinarily excited, all kneeling on the ground.
"Greetings to the ancestor of the Upper Sect!"
Finally, someone from the Upper Sect had arrived, and it was a Supreme Sovereign Realm ancestor!
"The Taihe Realm is under the jurisdiction of the Taihe Realm. The matters of the Earth Shadow Realm will be discussed later. I hope you all will not violate the rules," the Supreme Sovereign of the Taihe Realm said solemnly.
"Fair enough, I'll not disturb you further," laughed the Supreme Sovereign of Taikun Realm jovially as he vanished from the Taihe Realm.
The other Supreme Sovereigns also departed, heading towards their respective Divine Realm forces and carrying out the Divine Realm's missions.
"Xu Yan, come out!"
Ao Ming glared around, bellowing angrily.
An elder of the Taihe Realm couldn't help but speak up: "Esteemed True Dragon senior, Xu Yan is not in the Taihe Realm. If you wish to find him, you should go to the Qinghua state!"
"Qinghua state, very well!"
Ao Ming roared, leading the four great True Spirits, heading straight for the Qinghua state.
The Divine Venerate martial artists were immediately invigorated, all setting off to follow, eager to see how the True Dragon would suppress the Xiang Long youth!
In the Qinghua state, Li Xuan was leisurely enjoying himself, holding a bamboo scroll Xu Yan had brought back from the Sea Spirit Tribe, engrossed in the bizarre accounts recorded on it.
"So the Master of the Qingling Realm loves Taihe, and the Sea Spirit Emperor also admires Taihe. That's pretty normal, Taihe is indeed remarkable."
The bamboo scroll described many events, including quite a few gossip-worthy topics.
"Things are about to get lively."
Li Xuan looked towards the Taihe Realm; Supreme Sovereigns had arrived in the Divine Realm.
Moreover, someone from the True Dragon Clan had also arrived.
However, Xu Yan wasn't in the Divine Realm, having already gone to the Dao Realm.
News that Supreme Sovereigns had arrived in the Divine Realm and that the True Dragon Clan had a True Dragon descend, leading the four great True Spirits to the Qinghua state, was known to Su Lingxiu and others.
Ao Yuxue couldn't sit still anymore.
Previously, she had hoped that her grandfather or father would come to rescue her from her misery and take their revenge.
Now, she was worried that her grandfather and father had offended the mysterious and unfathomable Taoist Ancestor.
Even Xiaoyao, the Realm Master, was extremely respectful and dared not be the slightest bit presumptuous.
Moreover, not long ago, a Supreme Sovereign had perished. If her father angered the Taoist Ancestor, the consequences would be dire, and even the entire True Dragon Clan might suffer.
Before, she thought this place was a sea of bitterness; now, she only saw it as a land of fortune. The Great Demon Method was too profound; once she mastered it, her power would surely surpass all True Dragons.
Becoming the True Dragon Empress was not impossible.
Regardless, she couldn't let her father come to the Qinghua state, to disturb the Taoist Ancestor.
Moreover, Xu Yan was a true disciple of the Taoist Ancestor; how could he be opposed?
Ao Yuxue hurriedly left, transforming into a Jade White True Dragon, directly flying into the Nine Mountain Realm, instantly finding Yu Xiaolong.
"Come with me!"
Yu Xiaolong, bewildered, instinctively said, "This Demon King still has important matters..."
Smack!
A dragon claw struck down, sending Yu Xiaolong crashing to the ground.
"How dare you disobey my order when it concerns your master?"
Ao Yuxue glared at him.
Upon hearing this, Yu Xiaolong could only helplessly follow, asking, "What's the matter?"
"Let's see my father!"
Ao Yuxue stated sternly.
"What?"
Yu Xiaolong was taken aback!
Smack!
Ao Yuxue slapped his head again, causing stars to flash before his eyes.
"Listen well; Xu Yan subdued a dragon—that was you, not me. That's just a rumor, a falsehood. Do you understand?"
Ao Yuxue spoke with a serious expression.
"I understand!"
Yu Xiaolong sighed. Suddenly, he somewhat regretted transforming into a True Dragon!
Ao Yuxue's father was clearly coming for Xu Yan, but Ao Yuxue, fearing that the True Dragon Clan might offend the Taoist Ancestor and worrying about being disliked by Xu Yan, hence wanted to deny the subjugation.

chapters.title: Chapter 977 - 506: Supreme Sovereign Descends, The Test of Heavenly Slaughter_2
chapters.content:
And as for the rumors of Subduing the Dragon, this dragon subjugated, could only be the scapegoat.
"Will I be in danger?"
Yu Xiaolong asked worriedly.
What if, Ao Yuxue's father deemed him a disgrace to the Dragon Might and decided to strike him down?
"Don't worry, I am here, how could I possibly let Young Master Xu lose his mount."
Ao Yuxue assured.
"Let's get this straight, I am blessed by the Taoist Ancestor, if your father attacks me and I get killed, it's not my fault."
Yu Xiaolong thought for a moment, then reminded.
Upon hearing this, Ao Yuxue looked at Yu Xiaolong with envy for a long while, pondering how she could receive blessing from the esteemed Taoist Ancestor.
"Xu Yan, you scoundrel, die! Yu Xue, daddy's here!"
Rumbling thunder, surging Dragon Might, Ao Ming advanced with a rainbow-like momentum from the Taihe Realm toward Qinghua state, without concealing his trace or restraining his aura.
Everything that lives shuddered beneath the Dragon Might as he passed.
"This is a True Dragon, divine might that mustn't be looked upon directly!"
Many Martial Artists could not help but prostrate on the ground, only in such a manner could they endure the overwhelming Dragon Might.
"Aow!"
A dragon's cry echoed, and within the tempest of wind and thunder, Ao Ming's massive form was revealed.
"Yu Xue, are you alright?"
Seeing his precious daughter coming to greet him, Ao Ming was instantly overjoyed.
"Dad, I'm fine!"
Ao Yuxue's eyes reddened, she had endured much injustice since she was ambushed and fell into the Divine Realm.
"What rabble of a dragon is this!"
Ao Ming suddenly roared, lifting his dragon claw, and reached out to grasp Yu Xiaolong.
"Dad, stop!"
Ao Yuxue hurriedly blocked in front of Yu Xiaolong.
"Yu Xue, this rabble of a dragon is no good, it's a disgrace, listen to daddy, don't mingle with the rabble!"
Ao Ming became somewhat urgent.
Yu Xiaolong's face darkened, increasingly regretting his transformation into a True Dragon, now being called rabble, undermining his dignity as the Demon King!
"Dad, this rabble was originally a Flood Dragon, who only became a dragon after receiving dragon's blood, he's just my errand runner now, I brought him here to explain something to you."
Ao Yuxue hurriedly explained the origin of this "rabble" dragon.
"So that's how it is!"
Ao Ming breathed a sigh of relief, looked at Yu Xiaolong once more, and finally relaxed, saying, "So it was a little Flood Dragon that transformed into a dragon, you indeed have good fortune."
Yu Xiaolong, with a darkened face, chose to remain silent.
He now understood, whether as a Flood Dragon or having transformed into a True Dragon, he could not catch the eye of a True Dragon like Ao Ming.
"Just you wait, one day, I'll let you long worms witness the might of the Demon King."
Yu Xiaolong thought to himself in a shadowy tone.
"Yu Xue, where is that scoundrel Xu Yan, I want to tear him to pieces!"
Ao Ming had not forgotten his main agenda.
"Dad, listen to me, it's all a misunderstanding!"
Ao Yuxue quickly interjected.
"Misunderstanding? What misunderstanding? The whole Dao Realm knows, 'Subduing Dragon Youngster Xu Yan, subjugated our True Dragon Realm princess,' if I don't tear him apart, where is the face of our True Dragon Clan?"
Ao Ming said indignantly.
"Dad, the matter of Subduing the Dragon is not as the rumors describe, there's been a misunderstanding!"
Ao Yuxue started lying.
"Young Master Xu subdued this rabble of a dragon, not me, that's a slanderous rumor aimed to defame our True Dragon Clan!"
Ao Yuxue said, burning with anger, "It's all Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow's forces behind the defamation!"
The mastermind behind her fall into the Divine Realm was Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, so to her, all the blame laid upon Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow, her enemies!
Ao Ming felt something was off upon hearing this.
"Young Master Xu?"
That's what she called an enemy, so affectionately?
"Yu Xue, tell me specifically, what exactly happened!"
Ao Ming always felt there was something fishy about this incident.
The affair of Subduing the Dragon spread far and wide, and the Subduing Dragon Technique garnered the covetousness of some; could it really all be just a misunderstanding?
Ao Yuxue was already prepared with her story, so she explained the whole process full of lies. In short, the dragon that was subdued had nothing to do with her; the one Xu Yan subdued was merely a common dragon.
Moreover, there was no Subduing Dragon Technique, and Xu Yan had suppressed the common dragon with his own strength.
