In summary, the entire incident was fake, a rumor concocted by Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow to stir up conflict—which must not be believed at any cost.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow is truly despicable, father, we can't let them off!"
In the end, Ao Yuxue spoke with anger brimming within her.
As for how long the lie could be kept secret, she thought it was best to keep it hidden for as long as possible, knowing the consequences were unpredictable if her father sought revenge against Xu Yan.
"Something's not right, the Heavenly Slaughter Realm Master said... he let you fall into the Divine Realm to save you..."
Ao Ming was somewhat puzzled, feeling like his mind wasn't up to the task; the matter was way too complex, wasn't it?
His daughter would certainly not lie to him.
Could it be that the Heavenly Slaughter Realm Master was the one who lied?
However, what kind of person was the Heavenly Slaughter Realm Master to tell such a lie?
When Ao Yuxue intercepted Ao Ming, stopping him from continuing his journey to the Qinghua state, another uninvited guest arrived at Qinghua state.
The visitor, wearing the Heavenly Slaughter Mask, bore a powerful aura like that of a Supreme Sovereign of Heaven and Earth.
A Supreme being from the Heavenly Slaughter Realm!
Apart from the Supreme being from the Heavenly Slaughter Realm, outside the Qinghua state, there were several other Supreme Sovereign Realm Warriors from different Realms, watching from a distance.
Upon entering the Qinghua state, the Supreme being from the Heavenly Slaughter Realm felt a jolt in his heart; something was unusual about Qinghua state, as if it had undergone some special arrangement.
He headed straight for Qinghua City.
"Heavenly Nine from the Heavenly Slaughter Realm requests an audience with the Realm Master Xiaoyao."
Upon reaching the outskirts of Qinghua City, Heavenly Nine spoke respectfully.
Li Xuan was still focused on the bamboo slips with bizarre news and incidents, not even lifting his head—any mere Supreme Sovereign Realm Martial Artist could be wiped out with a single glance from him.
Moreover, the other party was here to look for Old Man Xiao.
Meng Chong, Su Lingxiu, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping all emerged from their seclusion to look at the figure outside Qinghua City.
"Supreme Sovereign Realm?"
They silently marveled at the thought; although the Taicang Martial Arts were weak, a warrior at the Supreme Sovereign Realm still possessed extremely formidable strength.
Emperor Da Yue and others wore envious expressions; when would they be able to step into the realm of the Supreme Sovereign?
They were all very confident about breaking through to the Supreme Sovereign Realm, after all, they had been guided by the Taoist Ancestor and had listened to his teachings. Stepping into the Supreme Sovereignty was just a matter of time.
Old Man Xiao came out of seclusion, approached Heavenly Nine, and asked with a frown, "Did Heavenly Slaughter send you?"
"Yes, Lord Heavenly Slaughter sent me to find the Realm Master Xiaoyao,"
Heavenly Nine nodded in confirmation.
"Whatever Heavenly Slaughter has to say, just say it,"
Old Man Xiao's expression was indifferent.
Who in the entire Dao Realm didn't know about Heavenly Slaughter's wild ambitions?
But he couldn't be bothered with these matters nor the schemes of others; Domain Authority wasn't something just anyone could wield.
"Lord Heavenly Slaughter wishes to collaborate with Realm Master Xiaoyao on a grand matter of the Domain. He proposes to split the authority, but in return, Realm Master Xiaoyao, you must share the Subduing Dragon Technique."
"Of course, as compensation, Lord Heavenly Slaughter will provide Realm Master Xiaoyao with a secret piece of information..."
Heavenly Nine's lips barely moved, not utilizing sound transmission, but the volume was contained just between them, inaudible to bystanders.
"Looking for Old Man Xiao to cooperate, to split the Domain Authority in half—Heavenly Slaughter sure knows how to draw a pie in the sky,"
Li Xuan chuckled to himself internally.
Others might be tempted, but Old Man Xiao wouldn't be because he was one of the Taicang Seven Heroes, a disciple of Taicang who knew much more of the Domain's secrets than others.
For instance, the existence of Tian Zi.
And also, that Domain Authority can't just emerge and be grabbed opportunistically through Unity of Domain.
Others couldn't hear what Heavenly Nine was saying, but it couldn't be kept from Li Xuan; even sound transmission couldn't fool him now.
"However, this is a test, isn't it? If Old Man Xiao agrees to cooperate, so be it, but if not, Heavenly Slaughter will make a move, right?"
Li Xuan was somewhat curious about where Heavenly Slaughter got the confidence he could overpower Old Man Xiao.
Snap!
Suddenly, Old Man Xiao raised his hand, and the authority of a Realm Master burst forth in an instant, sending Heavenly Nine flying away with one strike.
"Go back and tell Heavenly Slaughter that he isn't qualified to talk about cooperation with me. Don't even think of testing me; if you have any tricks up your sleeve, just bring them on. I, Xiaoyao, may be accustomed to an idle life, but that doesn't mean I fear anyone!"
Old Man Xiao's eyes were cold as he waved his hand, and the top-tier Supreme, Heavenly Nine, was flung away, spitting blood and heavily injured on the spot.
"Tell Heavenly Slaughter that this Domain does not belong to him to covet; he lacks the strength to do so. No matter how much he plots, it will end up being an effort in vain. I've said my piece; take it to heart!"
After speaking, Old Man Xiao waved his hand again, and a Heaven and Earth Law descended, instantly binding Heavenly Nine.
Whoosh!
The Heaven and Earth Law whipped like a long lash, flinging Heavenly Nine uncontrollably and throwing him out of Qinghua state.

chapters.title: Chapter 978 - 507: Seizing the Opportunity, The Return of the Blood Demon
chapters.content:
Outside the Qinghua state, the Supreme Sovereign Realm Warriors, who were originally watching from a distance, suddenly changed expressions and hastily retreated in panic.
Realm Master!
Inside the Qinghua state, there's actually a Realm Master Realm Expert.
A Realm Master has been hidden in the Divine Realm, this was no longer something they could dabble in. As expected, Xu Yan had a Realm Master Realm Expert backing him.
A figure flew backwards from within the Qinghua state, spewing blood from his mouth, clearly having sustained non-negligible injuries!
Heavenly Nine!
Boom!
Heavenly Nine smashed to the ground, struggling for a while before managing to stand up, then looked towards the direction of Qinghua state, remaining silent.
"Heavenly Nine, which Realm Master is in the Qinghua state?"
One of the Supreme Sovereigns asked in a heavy voice.
Heavenly Nine glanced at him and coughed, "Xiaoyao Realm Master!"
Upon hearing this, the expressions of the other Supreme Sovereigns changed dramatically, followed by a realization.
No wonder Xu Yan dared to use the Subduing Dragon Technique without fearing the True Dragon Clan, it turned out he was a disciple of the Xiaoyao Realm Master!
Although Xiaoyao Realm Master's name isn't prominent nowadays, anyone who knows of him is aware of the prestige the Xiaoyao Realm Master once had.
The first person among the second generation of powerhouses in the Taicang Domain.
Famed as the leader of the Taicang Seven Heroes, this speaks volumes about his strength and talent.
Plus, it's only his identity that would not fear offending the True Dragon Clan. After all, the Xiaoyao Realm Master, in a sense, is a disciple of Taicang!
The news of a Realm Master present in the Qinghua state spread immediately among the Divine Realm's Supreme Sovereigns. Those who originally had designs on seizing the Subduing Dragon Technique, all changed expressions, abandoning the idea.
But there were Supreme Sovereigns unfamiliar with the Xiaoyao Realm Master, inquisitively probing, "Xiaoyao Realm Master? Why have I never heard of him, must be a weak Realm Master, right?"
"Weak Realm Master? Since the Ancient Times Divine Domain Battle, the Xiaoyao Realm Master has been in seclusion until now. You newcomers are unaware of his notoriety," someone retorted.
"Let me put it this way, in terms of strength, Xiaoyao Realm Master stands shoulder to shoulder with the Minor Heaven and Earth Masters of ancient times, and he is known as the first person among the second generation of powerhouses of this heaven and earth.
"With Xiaoyao at the forefront of the Taicang Seven Heroes!"
Hearing the explanation from the older generation of Supreme Sovereigns, the others with puzzled faces suddenly shuddered inside, realizing how deep the waters of this domain were.
As Supreme Sovereigns, they even had limited knowledge about such a strong figure.
As the news of the Qinghua state Realm Master spread, Ao Ming naturally also got wind of it, and his face changed drastically.
"Yu Xue, Xu Yan is a disciple of the Xiaoyao Realm Master?"
Ao Ming said in a deep voice.
"No!"
Ao Yuxue shook her head.
"Yu Xue, since you are unharmed, come back to the True Dragon Realm with your father now. Your grandfather will deal with this matter!"
Ao Ming pondered and then spoke.
He always felt that Ao Yuxue's words seemed to deliberately protect Xu Yan, and there was probably more to it than meets the eye.
However, with the Xiaoyao Realm Master being in the Qinghua state and the matter involving a Realm Master, it was not something he could resolve.
Therefore, Ao Ming decided to return to the Dao Realm. This issue could only be managed by his own father.
"Dad, I'm not going back. I want to grasp opportunities in the Divine Realm!"
Ao Yuxue shook her head.
"What opportunities can there be in the Divine Realm? Even if the Dao Realm and Divine Realm merge and the domain changes greatly, these opportunities are irrelevant to our True Dragon Clan."
Ao Ming frowned more, feeling that there was something off about his daughter's attitude.
"Dad, if I miss this chance, I'll never be able to seize it again. You have to believe me; I know what I'm doing," Ao Yuxue said with determination.
"Dad, please go back and tell Grandfather that Heavenly Slaughter is not a good person; be careful of being used by him!"
After giving her warning, Ao Yuxue turned and headed back to Qinghua state.
Yu Xiaolong had long wanted to leave and hurriedly followed.
Ao Ming frowned, hesitating whether to use force to bring his daughter back to the Dao Realm, but that could likely upset her.
Moreover, he feared that, if there really was an opportunity, he would cause her to miss it because of him, and that would be harming his daughter.
"Enough, since Yu Xue is safe and wishes to remain in the Divine Realm, there should be no problems. As for the matter of Subduing the Dragon, it must be thoroughly understood.
"If true, even if it is the Xiaoyao Realm Master, he must give an explanation to our True Dragon Realm!"
Eventually, Ao Ming dismissed the idea of forcibly taking Ao Yuxue back to the True Dragon Realm.
However, the matter of Subduing the Dragon had to be made clear, it couldn't be let go just because Ao Yuxue defended Xu Yan.
Even if the person behind it was the renowned leader of the Taicang Seven Heroes, Xiaoyao, they still had to give an explanation.
Of course, he had no power to demand an explanation from a Realm Master, so he had to report this matter to his own father.
"Go, spread out in various places of the Divine Realm, and enquire about the Subduing Dragon matter," Ao Ming commanded the four True Spirits sternly.
Ao Yuxue, upon returning to Qinghua state, finally let out a sigh of relief; she was also worried that her father would take action, forcibly taking her back to the True Dragon Realm.
Thankfully, her father did not end up doing so.
After returning to Qinghua state, Ao Yuxue transformed into her human shape and came to the courtyard timidly, bowing respectfully, "Yu Xue pays respect to the Taoist Ancestor!"
Li Xuanle chuckled, "Clever girl, just speak your mind."
"Taoist Ancestor, I still have some doubts about the Great Demon Method..."
Li Xuan explained with a smile and offered some pointers on the Great Demon Ability Ao Yuxue was pondering.
How to integrate it with her True Dragon Technique, to transform the True Dragon Technique into a True Dragon Divine Skill.
After that, Ao Yuxue would visit every now and then to seek advice on various cultivation issues or the Way of Domain. As she did this more frequently, she gradually became less reserved.
"Since your visit is destined, this Jade Talisman is for you."
Li Xuan smiled as he bestowed a Jade Talisman to Ao Yuxue, which was something she had long yearned for.

chapters.title: Chapter 979 - 507: Seize the Opportunity, Blood Demon Returns_2
chapters.content:
"Thank you, Taoist Ancestor!"
Ao Yuxue was overjoyed, having finally received the Taoist Ancestor's protection.
In Su Lingxiu's secret chamber, Blood Extreme was hesitatingly struggling, never making the final decision.
"Yue'er, how is it?"
After this period of research on the Divine Soul of Blood Extreme, significant gains had been made, even the Remnant Soul of a Minor Heaven and Earth Master had its particularities.
Though the Realm Master Realm Experts and the Minor Heaven and Earth Master were in the same realm, the biggest difference between them was that streak of Purple Light!
The Minor Heaven and Earth Master had gained the opportunity of that Purple Light, opening up a minor heaven and earth.
However, the Realm Master lacked the opportunity of the Purple Light; although their realm was equivalent to that of the Minor Heaven and Earth Master, they couldn't open up a minor heaven and earth, inevitably being at a disadvantage when fighting within the Minor Heaven and Earth Master's domain.
The Minor Heaven and Earth Master, due to gaining the opportunity of the Purple Light, possessed special foundations, making them harder to kill and less likely to fall.
However, with the great war in the past, many a Minor Heaven and Earth Master fell, and their minor heavens and earths became masterless, gradually occupied by subsequent Realm Masters.
These Realm Masters also gradually took complete control over the minor heavens and earths, thus, the largest difference from the Minor Heaven and Earth Masters was just that streak of Open Heaven Purple Light.
Blood Extreme was a Minor Heaven and Earth Master and even a strong figure of the Netherworld Domain, hence his Divine Soul was naturally different from that of the Realm Masters.
"Not bad, I feel my divine soul has improved somewhat,"
Yue'er said jubilantly.
Following the study of Blood Extreme's Divine Soul, Su Lingxiu developed a new pill that could nourish the divine soul.
Her ultimate goal was to refine a pill similar in miraculous effect to the Open Heaven Purple Light on the Divine Soul, which, once successful, would be a monumental achievement, greatly aiding martial artists in breaking through to the Realm Master Realm.
For the Great Wilderness Warriors, it could enhance the likelihood of advancing to the Domain Realm or even the Establishing Dao Realm, and also strengthen the Martial Arts Primordial Spirit, especially when cultivating Divine Skills related to the Primordial Spirit, providing significant assistance.
"Still too weak, the Open Heaven Purple Light is very mysterious, alas, Blood Extreme is just a remnant soul, unable to comprehend its essence,"
Su Lingxiu sighed.
Blood Extreme finally made a decision, revealing a flattering smile, "Pavilion Master, I have a secret to tell you!"
"What secret?"
Su Lingxiu asked curiously.
"It's like this, I still have a part of my divine soul outside, that part, though weak, is the very core..."
Blood Extreme said with a flattering expression.
"Where is that part of your divine soul? Are you sure you want to tell me, once I capture your remaining Remnant Soul, you will never be able to escape."
Su Lingxiu was quite surprised that Blood Extreme would betray his own other part of the divine soul.
"I've realized that only with you, Pavilion Master, do I have a chance to recover, and moreover, those Supreme Sovereigns arriving from the Taikun Realm are surely targeting me.
"Back then, Jiang Feng had grand schemes and did not kill me, wasn't it just to exploit me? Now that the time is ripe, he has started his move."
Blood Extreme sighed.
It was a move of desperation, better to curry favor with Su Lingxiu than to benefit the Taikun Realm.
This girl has a kind heart, who knows, she might help him recover if she happens to be in a good mood one day?
Besides, following the Taoist Ancestor's true teachings, he couldn't go wrong, this might be an opportunity.
"Where is that part of your divine soul?"
Su Lingxiu seemed to think of something.
"In the Taikun Realm..."
Blood Extreme detailed the location of that part of the Divine Soul to Su Lingxiu.
"That core part of the divine soul, obtained when I seized the Open Heaven Purple Light, contains part of the transformed essence of the divine soul. Jiang Feng's motive is probably just this,"
Blood Extreme blurted out all his secrets.
"With the Supreme Sovereigns having arrived in the Divine Realm for some time, your divine soul might have already been taken."
Su Lingxiu frowned slightly.
Indeed, as she suspected, Blood Extreme's part of the divine soul was related to the Open Heaven Purple Light.
"My part of the divine soul, benefited by the Open Heaven Purple Light, is not something a mere Supreme Sovereign can easily probe, unless Jiang Feng personally comes. If Jiang Feng comes personally, I would utterly self-destruct, not giving him the chance."
"He sealed me back then just because he feared my self-destruction, wouldn't that thwart his plans?
"His sending of the Supreme Sovereign, unable to forcibly seize it, must surely be scheming slowly. If that strand of divine soul perished or was seized, I would feel it."
Blood Extreme said this with a look of disdain for Jiang Feng.
"I see. However, I can't retrieve your divine soul for the time being; I am about to enter closed-door cultivation to break through. Once I finish, I will personally go to the Taikun Realm."
Su Lingxiu nodded.
Jiang Feng plotted to extract the Origin of the Blood Extreme's Divine Soul, possibly with the intent to refine the Open Heaven Purple Light from it. Even a faint trace of it would be considered a supreme treasure.
As for whether this was the case, he would know once he saw that Divine Soul of Blood Extreme.
"I hope it is as I have speculated."
Su Lingxiu was secretly excited in her heart. If it was indeed so, she would have the opportunity to imitate and create pills with the wondrous effects of the Open Heaven Purple Light. Even with just 10 to 20 percent of its wondrousness, it would be a treasure of the world.
"Pavilion Master, what about me?"
Blood Extreme wore a pleasing smile.
"Take this."
Su Lingxiu thought for a moment, then took out several pills and integrated them into a jar.
This was a soul-nourishing pill that also fostered the soul, even effective for a Divine Soul at the level of a Realm Master.
"Thank you, Pavilion Master!"
Blood Extreme said excitedly.
Su Lingxiu left the secret chamber and entered the seclusion chamber, preparing to break through to the Domain Realm.
"Master, I am going to seclude myself for a breakthrough."
Su Lingxiu, clutching Li Xuan's shoulder, said excitedly.
"Hmm, go ahead."
Li Xuan nodded.
It was indeed time for Su Lingxiu to make a breakthrough.
Suddenly, Li Xuan looked up towards the Great Wilderness, showing a look of surprise.
"What is it, Master?"
Su Lingxiu asked, puzzled.
"Just some interesting matters."
Li Xuan chuckled.
Su Lingxiu did not ask further, but after consulting a few questions about advancing to the Domain Realm, she began her formal seclusion.
"The Imperishable Temple is also making moves, huh? Xu Yan really needs to grasp the Creation Realm soon, to be more confident."
Li Xuan muttered to himself.
The Great Wilderness, once the Inner Domain.
In that Celestial Tomb, the notorious Blood Demon was buried by Xin Mengrou herself.
The coffin, inscribed with "Born with humbleness, also buried in the wilderness," was now trembling. Initially, the tremor was faint, but as time passed, it grew increasingly intense.
At one moment, with a 'bang,' the coffin was flung open, and a pair of hands reached out from within it.
A figure sat up in the coffin, his pale face devoid of any color, and his skin seemed somewhat shriveled. His eyelids quivered as he slowly opened them.
They were a pair of blood-red eyes. As the eyes opened, as if out of nowhere, a surge of blood energy rushed into his body, and a flush of color appeared on his pale face.
The shriveled skin became smooth, and the dull hair turned shiny.
From being full of dead energy, he slowly became vibrant and full of vitality!
The man stepped out of the coffin, his gaze resting on the small characters on the coffin lid.
"Born with humbleness, also buried in the wilderness? Interesting, how interesting, buried in the wilderness is good, good indeed, they didn't cremate me; this is ultimately a remembrance of past affection."
His gaze swept over the tomb, a slight smile curling his lips, then he burst out laughing, "Hahaha, I have finally succeeded, finally arrived in Taicang, this must be the Inner Domain of Taicang!"
"Who am I again, what status do I hold?"
He pondered with a bowed head as if recalling, "Blood Spirit Child? Blood Demon? Right, the Blood Demon, I like the sound of Blood Demon better, hahaha, I, the Blood Demon, have returned, let this world begin to tremble."
The Blood Demon laughed wildly, his gaze seeming to pierce through the tomb chamber, seeing beyond the grand tomb.
"Inner Domain, Spiritual Realm, Divine Realm... Let's start from the Inner Domain. Those who once knew me, the Blood Demon, are they still alive?"
He patted the dust off his clothes, rubbed his face, and his smile was brilliant and his eyes held a cold glint.
"This body is truly marvelous, this young fellow was indeed extraordinary. Since I've taken over your body, then I should fulfill your wish, right?"
"The young woman who buried you had a good relationship with you. Once I am done using your body, I'll bury her with you, that would be paying you the proper respects!"
The Blood Demon muttered to himself, taking long strides as he walked out of the tomb.

chapters.title: Chapter 980 - 508 What Inner Domain, this is the Great Wilderness
chapters.content:
The Great Wilderness had long ceased to be the original Inner Domain. The gate to the Spiritual Realm had vanished, and the Spiritual and Inner Domains had merged, both now part of the Great Wilderness.
Tian Zi, the Heavenly Dao, had continuously operated the Domain of the Great Wilderness, lifting the Principles of the Great Wilderness, reducing the difficulty of cultivation, and granting opportunities to gifted prodigies with exceptional comprehension.
Therefore, under the operation of the Heavenly Dao, as Martial Artists of the Great Wilderness became enlightened about the Heavenly Path, their cultivation bottlenecks weakened. Within a short period, the overall strength of the Great Wilderness had vastly improved.
The Divine Refinement Realm was no longer unusual, and warriors in the Condensation Law Realm had also appeared.
On Canglan Island, other than Xu Junhe, who was in the Divine Skill Realm, Kou Ruozhi had also broken through to the Divine Skill Realm, as well as Bai Yunkong, Pang Yu, and the Pavilion Master of the Heavenly Treasure, who had all made the breakthrough.
Bai Yunkong and others, who had changed their cultivation path, originally practiced a blend of Taicang and Great Wilderness Martial Arts. After the emergence of the Heavenly Dao, they gradually fully transitioned to the Great Wilderness Martial Arts.
Although there were still some differences compared to pure Great Wilderness Martial Arts, they had ultimately completely departed from Taicang Martial Arts and become Great Wilderness Warriors.
Apart from the Divine Skill Realm, there were even more warriors in the Divine Origin Realm and the Divine Intent Realm.
The earliest batch of prodigies in the Great Wilderness had gradually grown up.
Now in the entire Great Wilderness, there were no longer any pure Taicang Martial Artists. Even those in the Condensation Law Realm had significant differences from the Taicang Martial Artists of the same Realm.
Although not belonging to the Great Wilderness Martial Arts, they had also partially departed from Taicang Martial Arts and leaned toward the Great Wilderness Martial Arts.
If their talent and comprehension were sufficient, with the improvement of strength, they had the chance to cultivate Divine Skills.
While operating the Domain, Tian Zi was steadily progressing the Heavenly Dao as planned, including the Heavenly Dao Divine Skills, which were gradually being arranged.
He was allowing some warriors with exceptional comprehension who sensed the Heavenly Dao to cultivate Divine Skills from within the Heavenly Dao, and these Divine Skills were precisely the Heavenly Dao Divine Skills.
People like Xu Junhe, who were originally in the Divine Skill Realm and had developed their own Divine Skills, were now also cultivating and sensing the Heavenly Dao Divine Skills, naturally enhancing their strength.
The power of Divine Skills enticed many Martial Artists.
Xu Junhe, with the might of his Divine Skill, had directly subdued a warrior in the Condensation Law Realm, demonstrating the formidable nature of Divine Skills and causing the strong and prodigies of the Great Wilderness to crave comprehending the Heavenly Dao and cultivating the Heavenly Dao Divine Skills.
The Great Wilderness region no longer resembled the Taicang Domain at all.
Under the Heavenly Dao, nothing could hide. The return of the Blood Demon was naturally not concealed from Tian Zi.
"Blood Demon?"
Tian Zi showed a pensive expression.
A foreign Blood Soul had abruptly descended into a corpse and resurrected.
Moreover, this corpse seemed to have some origins with this Blood Soul, intentionally nurtured by the master of the Blood Soul specifically for this moment.
"The initial opportunity and rise of the Blood Spirit Child were all thanks to this being. Blood Demon, huh?"
Tian Zi, thoughtful, said, "The guy from Netherworld, the ancestor of the Blood Path. Could the Blood Demon be Netherworld? But it doesn't seem like it."
This Blood Soul did not possess the aura of Netherworld.
Netherworld, one of the Seven Great Domain Masters, was extremely strong, and Tian Zi was no stranger to him, since Taicang had once dealt with Netherworld for a time.
"Could the Blood Demon be a minor Master of Domain of Netherworld?"
Tian Zi was full of doubts, but considering this Blood Soul, it seemed the opponent was not as simple as just a minor Master of Domain.
"Someone from the Imperishable Temple, with some origins linked to Netherworld?"
Tian Zi suddenly paused, remembering something. Although Netherworld was known as the ancestor of the Blood Path, Netherworld Martial Arts were usually referred to as the Blood Demon Path.
And this Blood Soul's master claimed to be the Blood Demon. Could Netherworld's cultivation methods have originated from him?
"Has Netherworld betrayed and joined the Imperishable Temple?"
Tian Zi pondered deeply, feeling a sense of urgency.
This Blood Soul's entry into the Taicang Domain undoubtedly had a purpose, suggesting that the Imperishable Temple had begun to act.
"Has that guy recovered from his injuries, or has he freed himself from the influence Taicang imposed on him, ready to start devouring the Taicang Domain?"
With this thought, Tian Zi became somewhat anxious.
He had not yet operated the entire Domain. The Heavenly Dao was not yet fully perfected, integrating the entire Domain within it. If the Imperishable Temple began to act, how could he have enough strength to resist?
Rely on the Taoist Ancestor?
Tian Zi immediately shook his head. Relying on everything from the Taoist Ancestor made him appear too incapable. What he wanted was to punish those bastards in the name of the Heavenly Dao!
"Stall him!"
Tian Zi immediately had an idea.
"I am the Heavenly Dao. With this Blood Soul descending, its strength is only in the Divine Refinement Realm, deceiving him won't be difficult."
The current strength of the Blood Demon was only in the Divine Refinement Realm, naturally stronger than ordinary warriors of the Divine Refinement Realm; this strength was exactly at the upper limit of the Spiritual Realm's Martial Arts.
And in the Inner Domain, it was undoubtedly invincible, possessing overpowering strength.
This was probably why the Blood Demon wanted to use this as a starting point, using the Inner Domain and the Spiritual Realm to layout its plans, gradually enhancing its power, and eventually entering the Divine Realm to fully integrate into this Domain without being rejected by it.
Perhaps even using this slight advancement in cultivation to understand the Domain Origin fully, preparing to devour the Domain from within?
Regardless, the current strength of the Blood Demon was the same as when it had perished.
"Where is the real Blood Demon?"
Tian Zi looked towards the Land of Chaotic Imperishable but did not discover the figure of the Blood Demon.
"Sooner or later, I'll show you what the Majesty of the Heavenly Path is."
Tian Zi smirked inwardly.
Looking at the Blood Demon emerging from the great tomb, his lips curled up in a mischievous smile, "You want to come to the Taicang Domain, but this is the Great Wilderness. Let's see if you're confused!"

chapters.title: Chapter 981 - 508: What Inner Domain, this is the Great Wilderness_2
chapters.content:
Blood Demon stepped out of the great tomb, his lips curling into a sinister smile, "I, Blood Demon have returned, I, Blood Spirit Child, have returned; tremble before me."
Suddenly, he looked puzzled, looked up at the sky, and then around him.
"What's going on? Why is the spiritual energy here so dense?"
Blood Demon looked around with a confused face, his gaze sweeping across the area, and soon he spotted a top-grade Spiritual Medicine growing not far away.
"This...this is the Inner Domain, the spiritual energy shouldn't be this dense, nor should it be possible for a top-grade Spiritual Medicine to grow here, what exactly is going on?"
Blood Demon furrowed his brows, his expression uncertain of fear, "Could it be that the Taicang Domain has undergone some changes? Impossible, how could such drastic changes occur in such a short time?"
The Taicang Domain was divided into four major areas; this belonged to a modification of the domain's rules. No matter how much the Inner Domain changed, it couldn't possibly change so drastically all of a sudden.
After all, it involved too many things, such as adjusting the domain's rules and so on.
"Could it be that a Master of Domain has appeared in Taicang? No, Taicang still looks the same, and there is no state of a Master of Domain."
Blood Demon's mind was full of doubts.
With a shift in his figure, he stepped out and instantly disappeared from the area of the great tomb; he needed to find someone to understand what changes had occurred in the Inner Domain, and why the nature's spiritual energy had become so dense.
Moreover, Blood Demon had a troubling thought; with such dense spiritual energy, could it be that the Martial Arts limit of the Inner Domain had been broken?
Could Divine Refinement Celestial Martial Artists have appeared?
If that was the case, with his current strength, he might not be invincible in the Inner Domain anymore, and some plans would have to be changed.
Suddenly, Blood Demon saw a Martial Artist harvesting Spiritual Medicine, whose strength was only at the Great Grandmaster Realm.
With a shift in his figure, he immediately arrived in front of the other.
The aura of a Divine Refinement Celestial was undeniable, displaying the poise of a superior, fully embodying the dignity of the strong.
He thought the other would be greatly shocked, bowing his head in worship and calling out 'Senior,' but the Martial Artist harvesting Spiritual Medicine just looked up at him.
"Do you need something?"
The tone was calm, without any awe of a superior.
Blood Demon was a bit flustered; this reaction was completely different from what he had expected. His expression darkened, and his aura surged as he asked, "Young man, where in the Inner Domain is this?"
The aura was like a mountain, subtly suppressing downward, expecting the other to kneel on the ground with a thud, answering respectfully and trembling.
However, the other's expression was just slightly displeased, neither kneeling nor trembling as he spoke, but instead frowning and saying, "Inner Domain? What Inner Domain?"
This made Blood Demon even more bewildered, "This isn't the Inner Domain, could it be the Spiritual Realm then?"
The Herb Collector looked at him puzzledly, then raised his hand and smacked his head with a slap, making Blood Demon stagger, almost falling to the ground.
At this moment, his mind was overwhelmed; the other didn't look strong, so why was he far stronger than himself?
This strike caught him completely off guard.
Although this body's own strength wasn't strong, which was why he had a Divine Refinement Realm cultivation, this cultivation level was already the limit in the Spiritual Realm.
In the Inner Domain, it would be akin to a divine existence.
Yet, just after coming out of the great tomb, he encountered a Herb Collector who was stronger than him?
Given his special Blood Soul, which was perceptive and adaptive and far surpassed others at the same cultivation level, rendering him invincible in his Realm, the Herb Collector's effortless smack indicated strength far exceeding his by a Great Realm.
Blood Demon was shocked inside; even if the spiritual energy of the Inner Domain became denser, it shouldn't be possible in such a short time to have a stronger presence than a Divine Refinement Celestial!
Could it be that he had miscalculated the time, and actually, a very long period had passed in the Inner Domain, thus producing Martial Artists beyond the Divine Refinement Realm?
In his ears, the voice of the Herb Collector came, "Have you become foolish from secluded cultivation? Lost your mind due to obsession? What Inner Domain, Spiritual Realm? This place is the Great Wilderness!"
The Great Wilderness?
Blood Demon was shocked and lifted his head, "The Great Wilderness? This is clearly the Inner Domain!"
The name Great Wilderness was unfamiliar to him.
Smack!
Another hit on his head, and the Herb Collector shook his head with a sigh, "You really have cultivated some problem; has your consciousness become chaotic? There is no such thing as an Inner Domain. Since ancient times, this place has always been the Great Wilderness; it has never changed!"
Blood Demon's mind was a bit scrambled; he had just come out of the great tomb, and randomly encountered a Herb Collector who was stronger than him, but this here wasn't the Inner Domain?
The Great Wilderness, what place was that? He had never heard of a region called the Great Wilderness in the Taicang Domain.
"No, this should be the Inner Domain, I... when I was in seclusion, this place was the Inner Domain."
He intended to say, the burial place of this body was in the Inner Domain.
However, upon further thought, if people discover that he was once the Blood Demon, with his current power, it would be quite dangerous, so he changed to saying he was in retreat.
"There's no mistake, this is the Taicang Domain, located in the Inner Domain. Do you know about the Taicang Domain?"
A gleam appeared in the Blood Demon's eyes. Since the other's power surpassed the Divine Refinement Realm, surely he must know the name of the Taicang Domain?
The Herb Collector sized him up, sighed, and said, "You really have issues with your cultivation, talking about the Inner Domain, the Spiritual Realm, and even the Taicang Domain."
"Listen carefully, this is the Great Wilderness Domain, not the Taicang Domain."
The Blood Demon couldn't help but show shock on his face. The Great Wilderness Domain?
In the Seven Great Domains, there was no Great Wilderness Domain. Could it be that the Taicang Domain was renamed?
Yes, that must be it!
And if the Domain was renamed, had a new Master of Domain emerged?
How could that be possible, a new Master of Domain in the Taicang Domain without any commotion?
"Great Wilderness Domain? No, this is the Taicang Domain. The Great Wilderness Domain was renamed later."
The Blood Demon stated firmly.
"Oh, you fool!"
The Herb Collector sighed, "You've even forgotten the name Great Wilderness. As a warrior of the Great Wilderness, how can you not know its origins? You've forgotten everything."
"What origins?"
The Blood Demon forced himself to calm down.
The Herb Collector looked up at the firmament, and as the Blood Demon watched in astonishment, the Herb Collector's body radiated an enigmatic and solemn light.
"At the dawn of time, in the Chaotic Imperishable, the Taoist Ancestor took pity on the sentient beings who found it hard to survive in Chaos. With a single thought, he opened the Great Wilderness to allow beings to reside, cultivate, and explore there. Initially, the Domain was a savage expanse where beings, through hardship, would strengthen themselves. That is why the Domain was named the Great Wilderness."
"The Great Wilderness Domain was created at the dawn of time by the Taoist Ancestor with a single thought, who then enlightened the Heavenly Dao to operate the Domain. The Heavenly Dao is supremely fair, and the sentient beings revere it. That is the origin of the Great Wilderness."
The Blood Demon was completely stunned.
This did not match any of the Domains he knew.
At the dawn of time, the Taoist Ancestor created the Great Wilderness for the beings to inhabit?
Who was the Taoist Ancestor?
What kind of existence was he to be called the Taoist Ancestor?
He had never heard the name of the Taoist Ancestor before, and even the concept of the Taoist Ancestor was unfamiliar to him prior to this.
What is the Heavenly Dao?
All of this was vastly different from his understanding of the Domains.
"This isn't the Taicang?"
The Blood Demon looked incredulous.
He looked down at his body — this was clearly the body of the Blood Spirit Child, and that tomb was indeed the tomb of the Blood Spirit Child.
"You kid, I've told you, this is the Great Wilderness!"
The Herb Collector slapped his head again and then sighed, "Well, since we've met by fate, I'll treat you. Come with me, I'll treat your cultivation deviation since your symptoms, though your consciousness is upside down and chaotic, are still salvageable!"
"No, this is definitely the Taicang Domain, inside the Inner Domain."
The Blood Demon took a deep breath, with a determined look, "I emerged from that great tomb, how could there be a mistake?"
"Here, there's no such tomb. These so-called tombs are all products of your disordered consciousness."
The Herb Collector sighed helplessly.
"Impossible!"
The Blood Demon moved swiftly, disappearing in an instant. He wanted to return to the great tomb to check again!
"Great Wilderness? How could that be, among the Seven Great Domains, there is no Great Wilderness Domain, and not even an eighth Domain in the Land of Imperishable..."
Suddenly, his heart skipped a beat.
How vast is the Land of Imperishable exactly, nobody knows, he didn't know, no one has ever traversed the entire Land of Imperishable. Could there be a Domain called the Great Wilderness within the Land of Imperishable?
"Impossible, absolutely impossible, I came from the Taicang, how could it be some unfamiliar Domain!"
The Blood Demon shook his head, negating his own thoughts.

chapters.title: Chapter 982 - 509: The Shock of Blood Demon, The Great Deceiver Tian Zi
chapters.content:
```
"The tomb?"
Upon arriving at the site of the grand tomb, the Blood Demon was shocked. Where had such a massive tomb gone?
Looking around, there was a faint ripple lingering in the air, a kind of unknown aura whirling about, an unfathomable power undulating.
All of this, even he had some trouble seeing through.
Although the strength of his physical body was only at the Divine Refinement Realm, his Divine Soul was not the original one belonging to the body; it was a Divided Soul specifically split from his main self for orchestrating all of this.
And the knowledge of this Divided Soul was the same as that of his main self.
However, even someone as powerful as him couldn't discern what force was at play in the fluctuations around the tomb. It had exceeded the range of his cognition.
All of this left the Blood Demon immensely shocked.
The Great Wilderness!
At this moment, the name of the Great Wilderness Domain resounded in his mind once again, forcing him to doubt whether he had descended into an alien world.
However, what he couldn't understand was that this body was clearly that of the Blood Spirit Child, a physical form he once meticulously nurtured, and there was no mistake that the Blood Spirit Child belonged to the Taicang Domain.
"Just as I expected!"
The Herb Collector also arrived beside him and let out a sigh.
The Blood Demon looked at him puzzled.
The Herb Collector glanced towards where the tomb was supposed to be and shook his head, saying, "Young man, you are ignorant of the immensity of heaven and earth, meditating here and closing yourself off, no wonder you've succumbed to delusion, your consciousness muddled, speaking nonsense."
"Is there something special about this place?"
Aware that he might have arrived in a strange world, the Blood Demon's tone became somewhat more respectful unconsciously.
"This place!"
With a heavy sigh, the Herb Collector said, "In the ancient times of the Great Wilderness Domain, there was a tragic figure who, unable to bear the loss of his beloved, was always lost in the memories of past times, succumbing to self-hypnosis, he created a unique Cultivation Technique called the Heart Resonance Divine Art..."
"He once cultivated here, immersed in the past, hence this place has retained the Dao charm of his cultivation, affecting anyone who enters. They either succumb to confusion or become trapped in the dreams within their hearts, genuinely believing they have become what they dream of."
"For example, someone whose lifelong wish was to be with the person they admired; under this influence, they believe they are together, spending all day embracing a piece of wood as though they were holding the person they admire."
"There was someone who, unable to obtain the love they desired, came here willingly to plunge themselves into the illusion of being passionately in love with that person, to the point of treating a spiritual dog as their beloved, spending their days in a delusion of romance. It was too painful to watch, too painful! In the end, they also perished within the illusion!"
The Herb Collector narrated the peculiar and eerie nature of this place with a look of lamentation.
The Blood Demon listened, his scalp tingling, eyes filled with horror.
"Could it be that I'm under this influence? Is that why I believe I arrived in the Taicang Inner Domain and inhabited the corpse of the Blood Spirit Child? In reality, this is not the Blood Spirit Child's corpse, nor is this the place of the great tomb, and all this is due to the influence of that mysterious power?"
The more the Blood Demon thought, the more his scalp tingled. What sort of formidable power could be affecting him?
Although the strength of this Divided Soul wasn't strong, it must be understood that even the main self of the Blood Soul was very powerful.
No ordinary Divided Soul could compare, and even so, affected, it attests to the terrifying strength of that powerful being.
"Although you've been affected, succumbed to delusion, and your consciousness is muddled, there is still hope for you. Since we've met, come back with me, and I shall save you!"
The Herb Collector looked at him with pity and said.
"What level was that powerful being at?"
The Blood Demon swallowed hard and asked.
"Young man, mind your manners. You should realize by now that something is wrong with you and behave more politely!"
The Herb Collector spoke seriously.
"Yes, elder... I dare to ask, what level was that powerful being at?"
The Blood Demon said, forcing himself through the discomfort.
As mighty an existence as he was, he was now addressing this person as an elder, but in order to understand the world he had found himself in, he endured it.
The Blood Demon's heart pounded fiercely, both shocked and excited. Outside of The Seven Great Domain, there was another Domain?
The Great Wilderness Domain!
And he had inadvertently arrived in an unknown Domain that seemed to have greater power than the Taicang Domain?
Taoist Ancestor, what kind of person was that?
At this moment, the Blood Demon had already cast aside his grandiose schemes, focusing only on understanding the Great Wilderness Domain, perhaps to gain some unexpected opportunities?
Especially, what was the strength of that Taoist Ancestor?
This place, under the influence of that powerful being, was so peculiar that even he was affected. Could the strength of that powerful being surpass that of his main self?
How many such powerful beings were in the Great Wilderness Domain?
"Establishing Dao Realm!"
The Herb Collector said solemnly.
Upon hearing this, any lingering doubts within the Blood Demon vanished. This truly wasn't the Taicang Domain!
Establishing Dao Realm, what was that level?
He had never heard of it before, it was neither among the Taicang Martial Arts nor any other Martial Arts Realm he knew of.
"How strong is the Establishing Dao Realm?"
The Blood Demon couldn't help asking.
"Young man, don't be so ambitious. The Establishing Dao Realm is far too distant from you. It is a level where one can establish and rule with their Dao, a profound state of being one with the Dao."
"Just like this place, it is merely the Dao charm left behind by one who has established Dao. It's been three hundred and sixty billion years, and it still has such a remarkable influence. You can estimate for yourself how powerful the Establishing Dao practitioner is."

chapters.title: Chapter 983 - 509: The Shock of Blood Demon, The Great Deceiver Tian Zi_2
chapters.content:
The Herb Collector pointed at the place where the great tomb originally stood and spoke.
The Blood Demon swallowed nervously as a storm surged within his heart. Had the influence of that powerful being really persisted for 360 billion years?
After such an unimaginably long time, the terrifying influence was still present. What kind of horrifying strength was that?
"360 billion years? What era is that? I hadn't even been born yet. The Seven Great Domains didn't even exist. Perhaps even that one had not been born either?"
The Blood Demon thought in shock.
"Young man, come with me to my herb lodge, and I will treat you,"
said the Herb Collector.
"Yes, thank you, senior!"
At that moment, the Blood Demon only wanted to understand the Great Wilderness Domain and to explore whether there was a chance here, perhaps a method that could advance his true self further.
His heart was filled with excitement. What an enormous opportunity! By some unanticipated fortune, this Blood Soul had descended into an unknown yet powerful domain.
"Senior, are there many Establishing Dao Realm powerhouses in this domain"
he asked curiously as he followed the Herb Collector.
"There is a rumor that there are three thousand Establishing Dao practitioners in the world, which seems like a lot. But in this vast, boundless Great Wilderness, they are rather few,"
the Blood Demon was shocked again.
Three thousand Establishing Dao practitioners?
This Great Wilderness Domain really has an outrageous strength indeed.
"Senior, are there existences stronger than Establishing Dao?"
the Blood Demon asked excitedly.
"Of course, Establishing Dao is merely the qualification to establish a Dao lineage only. Above Establishing Dao, there are even stronger beings..."
The Herb Collector turned back and tapped his head, "Young man, don't aim too high too soon. Take it step by step, cultivate earnestly."
"Yes, yes!"
agreed the Blood Demon as he nodded.
Following the Herb Collector closely, they finally arrived before a small hill where there was a modest courtyard with a simple thatched hut that looked quite unassuming.
"Something is not right!"
The Blood Demon furrowed his brow slightly. The hut looked ordinary, but somehow, he felt it was not as normal as it appeared.
"Senior, what realm are you in?"
he could not help asking.
"Me?"
the Herb Collector turned back to look at him, smiled faintly, and replied, "My realm is not high, just a very ordinary realm."
The Blood Demon was astonished internally, "He must certainly be a powerhouse!"
The Herb Collector pushed open the wicket gate, "Come in."
The Blood Demon walked into the courtyard, feeling increasingly that both the courtyard and the thatched hut were a bit off, seemingly ordinary yet giving him an indescribable feeling.
"Could this Herb Collector also be an Establishing Dao Realm powerhouse?"
he thought in shock.
"An opportunity? Could this be my chance?"
He looked around the small courtyard and noticed a small pond with a singular, pristine white lotus blooming in it.
"What is this treasure?"
He did not know why, but at first glance, he realized that this pristine white lotus was extraordinary, something he had never encountered before.
He instinctively approached the pond and upon looking down, his eyes involuntarily widened with astonishment.
What did he see?!
He could not help but raise his hand to rub his eyes and looked again with widened eyes — it was not an illusion!
In the pond, there were actually two Golden Dragons!
Those were True Dragons!
Although these two Golden Dragons appeared to be only three feet in length and their presence seemed unremarkable, he could vaguely sense the formidable power contained within them.
"Not weaker than Ao Hong!"
At that moment, the Blood Demon was immensely stunned. The strength of these two Golden Dragons was comparable to Ao Hong, the Master of the True Spirit Domain!
"Such powerful Golden Dragons, just kept in a pond?"
At that moment, the Blood Demon was not only shocked but also slightly excited, almost unable to contain his excitement at the prospect of a huge opportunity.
The Herb Collector was indeed a fearsome powerhouse!
"Establishing Dao Realm, definitely an Establishing Dao Realm powerhouse, no, possibly even above that!"
As he was feeling exhilarated, the Herb Collector called, "Come here!"
"Yes, Senior!"
Blood Demon approached respectfully.
He called out "senior" with genuine pleasure and respect.
"Sit down."
Herb Collector sat on a simple bamboo chair and gestured for Blood Demon to sit as well.
Blood Demon sat down on the bamboo chair, feeling another shock in his heart.
"This chair..."
The seemingly ordinary bamboo chair actually felt extraordinarily unique, giving him the impression that it was made from Principle!
"Stretch out your hand!"
Herb Collector commanded.
"Yes, senior!"
Blood Demon stretched out his hand and placed it on the table.
He wondered why such a powerful Herb Collector needed to take his pulse, using this common medical technique?
"Could it be that the influence of that powerful being was so great that Herb Collector is using this method to examine the root of his ailment? Or is it perhaps this is the Herb Collector's way of healing?"
Blood Demon couldn't figure it out but felt that Herb Collector was profoundly unfathomable.
Herb Collector's fingers touched his wrist, and in that instant, Blood Demon felt a wave of unknown and profound significance flow through his body, making his Divine Soul seem almost transparent.
Herb Collector furrowed his brow and mused, "Strange indeed, even if you were influenced, it should not be like this. Why does your Divine Soul feel foreign, as if it were a stranger's soul?"
Upon hearing this, Blood Demon's heart skipped a beat.
"Darn, if he finds out that I came by Soul Lodging, wouldn't he kill me?"
Blood Demon immediately grew anxious, realizing that arriving unexpectedly in this Great Wilderness Domain was a huge opportunity, perhaps one to increase his power.
How could such a great opportunity be missed?
Thoughts whirled rapidly in his mind, and he swiftly came up with an idea, cautiously saying, "Senior, could it be related to my soul having wandered out of my body? I vaguely remember that during my meditation, my Divine Soul was out of my body for a long time, only recently returning to my physical body."
Upon hearing this, Herb Collector realized, "That makes sense."
He withdrew his hand from taking the pulse, but his brow furrowed again, saying, "This is quite troublesome, your Divine Soul has been influenced by his Dao, becoming isolated from your body. If you cannot reintegrate your Divine Soul with your body as one, your cultivation will no longer advance.
"Let's do this, though your consciousness is confused and somewhat inverted and your memory also has issues, your mental faculty is still intact. Let's first address the issue of the separation between your Divine Soul and your body."
Blood Demon breathed a sigh of relief, saying, "Thank you, senior."
"This period, you must cooperate well with the treatment, otherwise, curing it will be too difficult."
Herb Collector cautioned.
"Yes, senior, I will certainly follow your instructions!"
Blood Demon cautiously asked, "Senior, if I am cured, can I continue to cultivate? I feel like I've forgotten how to continue cultivating, forgotten the cultivation methods."
Herb Collector thought it over, and after a long pause, he sighed, "Since we've met, it must be fate. After you recover, I will pass on a cultivation technique to you. This technique could allow you to Establish Dao, and even beyond Establishing Dao, there's still hope!"
Upon hearing this, Blood Demon was overjoyed and hurriedly bowed respectfully, saying, "Thank you, senior!"
"Now, I need to go prepare some medicine. You rest here and do not wander around!"
After speaking, Herb Collector picked up his herb basket and left.
"Opportunity! Great opportunity!"
Blood Demon was immensely excited.
Unable to resist, he went to the edge of the pool again, looking at the two Golden Dragons with a heart still shaken by their presence, these dragons, comparable to Ao Hong, were being kept like pets in the water pool.
The strength of the Herb Collector was indeed terrifying!
...
"This Tian Zi really knows how to bluster."
Li Xuan watched everything unfold.
All that Blood Demon saw and was aware of were arrangements set by the Heavenly Dao Rules. Although Blood Demon was strong, as a Blood Soul his power was not strong, and the Heavenly Dao exceeded his understanding, hence he was easily deceived.
The strength of the Blood Soul was unable to see through the arrangements of the Heavenly Dao Rules, especially since he had also interfered slightly.
"Taoist Ancestor, I've confused him thoroughly. It's so much fun!"
The Herb Collector, transformed by Tian Zi, came to Li Xuan, speaking excitedly.
"You handle it yourself."
Li Xuan smiled and shook his head, noting Tian Zi's playfulness.
"Taoist Ancestor, give me some more advice on how to continue fooling him?"
Tian Zi looked at him eagerly.
The arrangement of the thatched cottage, the two Golden Dragons, and more were all based on Li Xuan's advice, and indeed, they had deceived Blood Demon.
Tian Zi, familiar with si...

chapters.title: Chapter 984 - 510: Excited Blood Demon, Broken Domain
chapters.content:
"You are familiar with those people from Taicang, so just continue to deceive him by using this as a reference for strength. What's the point of seeking my advice for your childish fun?"
As a Taoist Ancestor, Li Xuan naturally couldn't instruct Tian Zi on how to trick people; doing so would tarnish his image as a Taoist Ancestor.
However, he still provided Tian Zi with some ideas.
Deceiving the Blood Demon was to delay the actions of the Imperishable Temple and buy more time.
"You should be wary, he is summoning more Blood Souls."
Li Xuan issued the reminder.
"Don't worry, I am Heavenly Dao, not just anyone can summon Blood Souls at will."
Tian Zi chuckled.
The Dao Principles of the Taicang Domain are very powerful. The Blood Demon had smuggled a weak Blood Soul into it, and that was why he succeeded.
If his true self tried to summon more Blood Souls, it wouldn't be so easy.
The true strength of the Blood Demon's avatar certainly wasn't comparable to that of Taicang.
"Aren't you supposed to be curing him? Reach out to my third disciple then, but she's currently in closed-door cultivation aiming for a breakthrough. Once she's done, let her give you some advice."
After speaking, Li Xuan disappeared from the spot.
Su Lingxiu would undoubtedly be very interested in the Blood Demon and eager to study him.
A light went off in Tian Zi's eyes as he suddenly came up with an idea. Unable to think of many tricks alone, he realized he could seek others' advice.
So, he directly went to Canglan Island and found Xu Junhe.
It just so happened that Kou Ruozhi was also there.
Having interacted with Tian Zi often, Xu Junhe knew that while this incarnation of Heavenly Dao had a youthful nature and was quite playful, he nonetheless did not interfere with the Heavenly Dao Rules and managed to remain impartial.
Now, having trapped an external strong figure, Tian Zi wanted to toy with him and asked for ideas. Xu Junhe naturally wouldn't refuse and proposed a few ideas after a moment's thought.
Then, looking at Kou Ruozhi, he said, "Kou Ruozhi, you are rather cunning and have many bad ideas, why not share some?"
Kou Ruozhi's mouth twitched. How was it that he was considered cunning, and Xu Junhe was not?
With Kou Ruozhi's involvement, Tian Zi immediately became excited. Having people suggest ideas was truly different.
"Understood, I know what to do now."
Tian Zi immediately left, transformed into the appearance of a Herb Collector, and returned to his hut with a basket on his back.
Meanwhile, the Blood Demon was still at the poolside, staring at the two Golden Dragons.
"Those are Little Gold Dragons; I've had them for some time now. Once you recover and need to cultivate, I'll catch a few more from outside, kill them, and stew them for your nourishment."
Upon hearing this, the Blood Demon's heart thrummed with excitement and fear. True Dragons as powerful as Ao Hong were casually caught and made into stew?
However, the thought of having an opportunity to eat dragon meat comparable to Ao Hong's excited him immensely; his eyes almost burst with bloodlight.
"Senior, are there many dragons in the Great Wilderness?"
"Not many, there should be hundreds of thousands of them. Like these two, with excellent qualities, they are rare. But, there are still quite a few with power like these two.
"Of course, making dragon stew cannot be done ostentatiously as some of the old dragons are very strong, though they guard a place and can't come out temporarily."
Tian Zi bluffed on the fly.
The Blood Demon was inwardly shocked and became more resolved to stay and seize this great opportunity.
As for the mission from the Taicang Domain?
That wasn't important. What mattered was seizing this opportunity, since overtaking Taicang wouldn't allow him to advance further.
But, this opportunity could indeed enable him to progress even further.
"If I cultivate to the Establishing Dao Realm, I will surely surpass Taicang, and even surpass that one!"
Thinking of this, the Blood Demon almost knelt down to kowtow and beg to become a disciple.
But since the Herb Collector did not intend to take him as a disciple, he had to restrain himself and wait until he was "cured" and the Herb Collector imparted the Cultivation Technique to him, then find an opportunity to become a disciple!
Tian Zi placed a Great Ding in the courtyard. This Great Ding was transformed from the Heavenly Dao Rules, and naturally, the Blood Demon could not see through it. He just felt that this Ding was truly extraordinary, a Supreme Treasure he had never seen before!
Under the Great Ding, flames roared fiercely as Tian Zi threw some "herbs" into the Ding. These herbs looked extraordinary, naturally all were transformations from the Heavenly Dao Rules.
Thus, each time Tian Zi threw in a type of herb, the Blood Demon's heart trembled. These herbs were beyond his knowledge, far more mystical than any Divine Medicine he had ever encountered.
The medicinal liquid in the Great Ding boiled, emitting no scent but possessed an indescribable charm swirling within it.
"Alright, get into the Great Ding,"
Tian Zi looked solemnly at the Blood Demon, "Your illness is quite severe, deeply influenced by that one's Dao melody, from flesh to Divine Soul, It calls for strong medication to cure, but once cured, you will also turn misfortune into a blessing and thus transform yourself.
"However, all this is predicated on your ability to endure it. You should know this process is extremely painful and arduous, not just physically but also spiritually."
Upon hearing this, the Blood Demon understood, "If I endure this, a transformation will occur, my natural talents will greatly improve, I'd succeed in cultivating to the Establishing Dao Realm, and even surpass it.
"This is a great opportunity; I must seize it. What kind of entity is the Blood Demon? A little pain, how could I not bear it!"
The herbs in the Great Ding were extraordinarily mystical; even a fool would know that the liquid in this Ding was precious. As for the pain it entailed, the Blood Demon didn't care at all.
To him, what was a bit of pain? He wasn't new to Martial Arts; what kind of pain couldn't he endure?

chapters.title: Chapter 985 - 510: Excited Blood Demon, Broken Domain_2
chapters.content:
"Senior, rest assured, I will definitely not disappoint you. Even if I were to endure a thousand cuts and slices, I can bear this pain for the sake of curing the disease and becoming a Supreme Expert, I will definitely be able to carry this burden!"
The Blood Demon solemnly assured.
"Good, very good!"
Tian Zi expressed his gratification, which further solidified the Blood Demon's resolve. This was a test from the Herb Collector, and once he passed it, he would be taught Martial Arts and taken as an apprentice!
"Enter!"
Tian Zi said solemnly.
"Yes, Senior!"
The Blood Demon, without any hesitation, stripped off his clothes and decisively jumped into the Great Ding.
"Hiss!"
As soon as he entered the Great Ding, the Blood Demon's whole body trembled, nearly bouncing out. Still, he gritted his teeth and endured!
Pain!
It was too painful!
His entire body felt ablaze, as if he were suffering a thousand cuts, or as if thunderous flames were striking and burning him, affecting not just his physical body but his Divine Soul as well.
"Hold on!"
The Blood Demon took a deep breath and kept gritting his teeth.
"Not bad, not bad. You have this will; this disease can be cured, and you will undergo a transformation!"
Tian Zi's eyes showed relief, but he was secretly overjoyed, thinking how he would torment him!
"Indeed, this is a test!"
The Blood Demon grew even more resolute. No matter what, he had to endure it; this was a great opportunity!
He looked down at the medicinal liquid in the Great Ding, a mix of colors that was somewhat hair-raising to behold.
"You need to endure in the Great Ding for eighty-one days; only then will the first step of the treatment be completed, and your physique will undergo some transformations..."
Tian Zi, while adding herbs into the Great Ding, solemnly spoke.
He gave the Blood Demon an analogy: endure it, and he would reap great rewards, a transformation in aptitude, and the ability to cultivate to the Establishing Dao Realm, perhaps even above Establishing Dao.
In short, it was about continually painting the cake, making the cake a bit bigger.
The Blood Demon's scalp tingled, endure for eighty-one days?
"Persist, I must persist. How could I, the Blood Demon, not endure it!"
The Blood Demon silently cheered himself on.
Tian Zi gestured with his hands, causing layers of radiance to emerge from the Great Ding, completely enveloping the Blood Demon, "I am going to seal the ding now. Don't struggle; the pain will intensify day by day. I will temporarily seal the Great Ding, so you just endure it.
"If you truly can't bear it, you can scream out loud, even thrash about, as long as you don't come out of the Great Ding. If you are worried about enduring it but still want to keep going, tell me to directly seal the ding, and then you will not be able to jump out."
Pain intensifying day by day?
The Blood Demon felt somewhat uncertain. Could he really endure it till the end?
With a grit of his teeth, he firmly said, "Senior, seal the ding, please. I will either cure the disease and survive this process, or I would rather die here!"
"Good, good!"
Tian Zi showed a gratified expression again.
"Just endure it. I will go find a few more precious herbs, and perhaps catch a True Dragon to aid your transformation."
Upon hearing this, the Blood Demon was utterly delighted; he had gambled right and earned the Herb Collector's approval.
Tian Zi sealed the Great Ding completely.
"Blood Demon, endure well inside there; this is just the beginning..."
Tian Zi's lips curved into a smile, although it wasn't the Blood Demon's true self being tormented, it was hardly a difference.
"Can I use this Blood Soul to trick the Blood Demon a bit?"
Tian Zi began to ponder the feasibility.
Three days later, agonizing screams sounded from within the Great Ding; the Blood Demon was thrashing about and screaming. He even regretted a bit, what on earth was this medicinal liquid?
Both his physical body and Divine Soul were enduring torture. Even if this Blood Soul wasn't very powerful, its resilience and ability to bear pain were far superior to ordinary Martial Artists.
Such torture could not be endured.
"This Blood Demon, truly tragic!"
Li Xuan sighed inwardly.
"However, the strength of this Blood Demon is indeed strong, Master of Domain ah, another expert outside of the Seven Great Domain, how many in the Imperishable Temple can compare to the Master of Domain?"
Li Xuan looked up at the firmament, beyond the Domain was a chaotic imperishable land with no visible end.
The location of the Imperishable Temple within the Land of Imperishable was unknown, its distance from the Taicang Domain was immensely far.
Suddenly, Li Xuan saw a faint red hue in a certain part of the Land of Imperishable and could not help but be astonished.
"What is that place?"
Netherworld Domain?!
"What is happening in the Netherworld Domain? Are those Blood Lords in a great battle?"
It was somewhat distant, and even with Li Xuan's Eye of the Heavenly Dao, within the Taicang Domain, he could not see the specific situation clearly.
"The pathways connecting the edge of the Taicang Domain, intended for entry into the Heavenly Grotto of the Netherworld Dao Principles, have all been severed. Have they completely given up preparing to invade the Taicang Domain?"
Li Xuan slightly furrowed his brows, feeling that something was amiss.
The Divine Grotto of the Divine Realm was attacked from outside, and one of the invaders was the Netherworld, but now the Netherworld had cut off the pathways that spread outside the Grotto. It seemed they had completely given up invading the Taicang.
"Is there internal strife in the Netherworld, or has something else happened?"
Li Xuan suddenly narrowed his eyes, "Is it the action of the Imperishable Temple? Have the Blood Lords of the Netherworld Domain allied with the Imperishable Temple?"
Just now, he faintly saw a breath that surpassed the Realm Master Realm, comparable to that of the Master of Domain.
Correctly speaking, it was a Master of Domain who had stepped into the Netherworld!
...
In the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, hazy and chaotic, filled with Imperishable Qi, the spiritual energy was extremely violent. Looking across, the chaotic horizons were endless, and no creature had ever walked out of the Land of Imperishable.
Yet, within the Land of Imperishable, there was a huge, enchantingly bright sphere, the surface of which had some small holes.
This sphere in the Land of Imperishable stood out remarkably, resembling a beautiful gem in the dark.
The violent spiritual energy of the Land of Imperishable gathered and enveloped the sphere, and that layer of dazzling brilliance was a scene formed by the reflection of spiritual energy.
Taicang Domain!
This magnificent gem within the Land of Imperishable is none other than the Taicang Domain, where Dao Principles operate, forming a Domain Barrier. Spiritual energy converges and surrounds it, forming the shape of a large sphere.
In a distant place from the Taicang Domain, there is another Domain with a dark red color, resembling a broken sphere. Although spiritual energy gathers, the Dao Principles of this Domain are also continuously deteriorating.
This Domain, lacking the magnificence of the Taicang Domain and much smaller than it, gives off a more sinister feeling, as if it is a place of the Blood Sea Netherworld.
Netherworld Domain!
Moreover, it is the Netherworld Domain that has already partially collapsed.
From the collapse of the Netherworld Domain, one can perceive how fierce the initial battle was.
Within the ruined Netherworld Domain, there remain Netherworld Warriors who survived the initial battle, including a few Minor Heaven and Earth Masters.
The broken Domain cannot endure for long, so the Blood Lords of the Netherworld wish to enter the Taicang Domain to secure a place for themselves. For the Realm Master of the Taicang Domain, this means sharing their resources in the Taicang Domain, which they naturally would not share.
Therefore, the struggle never stopped, but forever unable to achieve as desired, ultimately, the Netherworld's strength was inferior to that of the Taicang Domain.
On the other side of the Taicang Domain, there is another broken Domain, the Witch Demon Domain.
In terms of devastation, the Witch Demon Domain fares a bit better than the Netherworld Domain, but its Domain Dao Principles are also depleting. In time, the Witch Demon Domain will inevitably become a desolate Domain.
Strong entities from both the Netherworld and the Witch Demon wish to enter the Taicang Domain to secure a place, but neither has achieved their desire.
Apart from the two great Domains, in the Imperishable Land surrounding the Taicang Domain, there are numerous Imperishable True Spirits radiating intense desire to enter it.
The magnificent Domain holds a strong attraction for the Imperishable True Spirits.
But these Imperishable True Spirits, repelled by the Dao Principles of the Domain, cannot enter the Domain itself; however, the Taicang Domain has a Heavenly Grotto, and some Imperishable True Spirits enter through it, bypassing the obstruction of the Dao Principles.
Only that those entering the Heavenly Grotto are limited by strength; the stronger Imperishable True Spirits cannot enter.
The three Domains, standing at certain intervals from each other in the Land of Imperishable, exhibit some form of interconnectedness.
In the beginning, among the Seven Great Domain, Taicang led, and the Taicang Domain also belonged among the Seven Great Domain.
But now, only three Domains remain, the rest of the four Domains are gone without a trace.

chapters.title: Chapter 986 - 511: Changes in the Netherworld Domain
chapters.content:
Experts from the Netherworld Domain and Witch Demon Domain have long yearned to enter the Taicang Domain, where they have been engaged in conflict with the experts of the Taicang Domain for many years.
Over time, the advantage of the Taicang Domain has grown, and the number of its experts has increased.
After all, although the Taicang Domain has some holes, it is ultimately a complete domain, with unchanged Domain Dao Rules that can sustain the cultivation of martial artists, continuously bringing forth new experts.
It may not be easy for an expert of the Realm Master Realm to emerge, but the Supreme Sovereign Realm experts are plentiful.
In contrast, in the Netherworld Domain and Witch Demon Domain, it has been a long time since a Supreme Sovereign Realm expert emerged. The existing experts are those from ancient times.
The experts from the Netherworld and Witch Demon had also once joined forces to launch an assault on the Taicang Domain, aiming to force the realm masters of the Taicang Domain to yield. The result was a major battle, where the Taicang Domain, thanks to its advantage in the number of realm masters, repelled the joint assault from the Netherworld and Witch Demon.
Now, the great strife among the three great domains has ceased, and experts from each occasionally contact each other, but the Taicang Domain has never yielded, nor has it made room for them to settle.
Recently, the Netherworld Domain's reach toward the Taicang Domain through the Dao Rule passageway connecting the holes had been withdrawn, seemingly abandoning the idea of letting the Netherworld Warriors enter the Taicang Domain.
Boom!
In the Netherworld Domain, a sudden tremor occurred; a part of the domain that had previously cracked suddenly cracked further.
The tremor rippled outwards, resonating throughout the Land of Imperishable.
The Witch Demon Domain, being the closest to the Netherworld, was the first to sense the disturbance, and one expert after another emerged, standing outside their domain.
Seductive Witch, Duowu, Li Witch, Flame Demon, Giant Demon, Tyrant Demon, and Scarlet Demon, the seven witches and twelve demons of the Witch Demon Domain who still existed, appeared one after another, looking towards the location of the Netherworld Domain.
"What has happened, why has the Netherworld Domain cracked further?"
The Giant Demon spoke in a deep voice.
The Seductive Witch furrowed her brows. At this moment, there was no trace of seductiveness about her, only a solemn and fearful expression.
"Was it the Imperishable Temple making a move? The Netherworld Domain, despite its decrepitude, is not something we can crack; only the Master of Domain has such power!"
The Seductive Witch spoke gravely.
"Is the Netherworld finished then? Next, will it be our Witch Demon Domain?"
The color drained from Duowu and others' faces.
At this moment, the seven of them turned their gaze towards the Taicang Domain, thinking that resisting the Imperishable Temple would only be possible with the support of the Taicang Domain!
"Could those from the Netherworld have already perished?"
The Flame Demon frowned as he looked toward the Netherworld.
"I don't know!"
The Seductive Witch shook her head.
"Could they have surrendered to the Imperishable Temple?"
The Li Witch asked tentatively.
"Even if they surrendered, it would only ensure their survival for a short while, and the way the Imperishable Temple operates, as you and I well know, won't embrace us; they will certainly seize the Qi of Heaven and Earth from us!"
The Seductive Witch sighed.
If surrendering to the Imperishable Temple could fend off the crisis, who would desperately hold on to their domain? Essentially, the Imperishable Temple aims to annex domains to accomplish a specific purpose, and in their eyes, the minor heaven and earth masters and the creatures of their domains constitute mere nourishment!
Thud!
Suddenly, another corner of the Netherworld Domain broke off, and even from a great distance, a faint aura could be sensed emerging.
"Master of Domain!"
The countenance of all seven from the Seductive Witch group grew stern; a true Master of Domain had made a move.
The Imperishable Temple, silent for so long, had finally recovered from the previous great war and was beginning its action, and its first move was that of a Master of Domain.
"Shall we send support to the Netherworld Domain?"
The Li Witch asked in a deep voice.
"It's too late,"
The Seductive Witch sighed, "Even united, we might not withstand a single Master of Domain. While leveraging the power of the Witch Demon Domain might offer temporary resistance, moving the entire domain would take too much time. It's too late."
"Let's turn to Taikun and Taihe, at this point, if Taicang wants to survive, the only option is to accept us and together fight against the Imperishable Temple!"
The Tyrant Demon spoke coldly.
"Exactly, at this point, that's the only path available, and the Witch Demon Domain will also align with Taicang!"
The seven from the Seductive Witch made their decision and returned to within their domain.
Hum!
The Dao Principles of the Witch Demon Domain extended towards the holes of the Taicang Domain, and at this moment began to retract; the vast Witch Demon Domain was slowly moving closer to the Taicang Domain.
Taicang, Dao Realm, True Dragon Realm.
Ao Ming had returned, narrating the details of the Subduing Dragon event, including the powerful beings behind Xu Yan.
"Xiaoyao?"
Ao Lie's fiery red beard trembled as he spoke angrily, "He thinks it's still the old days? The Taicang Seven Heroes are dead or gone, leaving just him and Yu Yao, alone and audacious?"
"To delve into the Subduing Dragon Technique, what is he planning?"
"This is excessive provocation, does he really think I, Ao Lie, am easily bullied?"
Ao Lie, unable to contain his rage, the dragon might surged, and his dragon horns emitted a sharp glint.
"That flirtatious witch, I, Ao Lie, do not wish to bother with her, but this bastard Xiaoyao, I cannot let this go. I must confront him and see what abilities this leader of the Taicang Seven Heroes has!"
Ao Lie stood up furiously as he spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 987 - 511: Changes in the Netherworld Domain_2
chapters.content:
Just then, a voice came through.
"Brother Ao Lie, Heavenly Slaughter requests an audience!"
Ao Lie's eyebrows raised, signaling Ao Ming to go and receive him, as he sat upright on his throne, waiting for Heavenly Slaughter's arrival.
"Brother Heavenly Slaughter, what brings you here?"
After Heavenly Slaughter had entered, Ao Lie directly asked.
"It's concerning Xiaoyao!"
Heavenly Slaughter's eyes were intense, "Xiaoyao has gone too far, resisting the Netherworld and Witches time and again. It's one thing for him not to contribute, but to plot for Domain Authority in the Divine Realm, targeting the True Dragon Realm specifically. This cannot be ignored."
Upon hearing this, Ao Lie immediately asked, "What's your opinion, Heavenly Slaughter?"
"I am willing to lend a hand to Brother Ao Lie, to suppress Xiaoyao. This time, I have already contacted some Realm Masters; they will not interfere."
"You must know, Brother Ao Lie, that as one of the Seven Heroes of Taicang, Yu Yao will not stand idly by if we target Xiaoyao. I will hold back Yu Yao."
Heavenly Slaughter's gaze was cold.
"Do you have a grudge with Xiaoyao?"
Ao Lie was utterly surprised.
"Sort of. What do you think, Brother Ao Lie?"
Heavenly Slaughter was noncommittal.
Ao Lie pondered for a moment. Heavenly Slaughter's plotting for Domain Authority was no secret among the masters of the Dao Realm.
Yet, the Domain Authority was not so easily obtained. From where did Heavenly Slaughter get such confidence? Many Realm Masters were watching and even ready to grab a share, definitely not allowing Heavenly Slaughter to rise alone.
Among the ancient Minor Heaven and Earth Masters, Taihe, Taikun, Taimiao had made no moves or statements, seemingly acquiescing to what Heavenly Slaughter was doing.
