"This cooperative move against Xiaoyao might be unworkable, yet in the Taicang Domain, our lineage from the True Spirit has secured a place thanks to the care of Elder Taicang; this, in any case, must be safeguarded and never be subjected to anyone else..."
Ao Lie slowly began.
"Brother Ao Lie, rest assured, my coming here is to assist you against Xiaoyao and to demonstrate the sincerity of our partnership."
"After the success, twenty percent for Brother Ao Lie. With this twenty percent, your position within the True Spirit lineage will be secure."
Heavenly Slaughter said with a smile.
"Twenty percent?"
Ao Lie laughed heartily, "Alright, it's settled then. Xiaoyao has offended us too severely; it cannot go unchallenged, lest he really thinks we True Dragons are easy to bully!"
"Brother Ao Lie, just wait for my word, and at that time, we'll descend together into the Divine Realm, giving Xiaoyao no place to escape!"
Heavenly Slaughter said with a smile.
"Good, I'll wait for your good news!"
Ao Lie nodded happily.
"With that, I shall make my preparations, farewell!"
"Take care, tomorrow, see off our Uncle Heavenly Slaughter!"
After seeing off Heavenly Slaughter, Ao Ming returned and, puzzled, said, "Father, are you really going to ally with Heavenly Slaughter?"
"Xiaoyao has offended us too severely; teaching him a lesson is necessary. Moreover, since Heavenly Slaughter dares to aim for the Domain Authority, he naturally has his own confidence."
"If the cooperation goes well and we get twenty percent of the authority, our True Dragon Clan can continue to maintain our current position."
Ao Lie's gaze was deep as he said, "It has been too long since the Battle for Heaven and Earth; the Imperishable Temple might make a move soon. Heavenly Slaughter's ambition isn't checked by Taihe, Taikun, which clearly shows they too want to see if Heavenly Slaughter can indeed achieve it."
Ao Ming pondered and said, "But dad, since Xiaoyao is the foremost among the Taicang Seven Heroes, if we kill him..."
"Who said anything about killing him?"
Ao Lie said with a light laugh, "Is Xiaoyao so easy to kill? If he truly faces a crisis, would Taihe, Taimiao, Taikun just sit by and watch? Regardless, in a sense, Xiaoyao is a disciple of Elder Taicang!"
Ao Ming suddenly understood, yet again worried, "Dad, what if Heavenly Slaughter decides to kill him?"
Ao Lie spoke meaningfully, "Xiaoyao is regarded as the premier individual of the second generation in Taicang Domain, and though Heavenly Slaughter isn't called the best of the third generation, he's nearly there. The conflict between the second and third generations might be about the Domain Authority. The competition between those two has nothing to do with us; I, Ao Lie, just need to make a statement and perhaps obtain some Domain Authority, that's all."
Ao Ming suddenly understood; for the True Dragon Clan, what mattered was making a statement. The outcome of the struggle between the Domain Master Xiaoyao and Heavenly Slaughter didn't concern them.
In the Dao Realm, Heavenly Slaughter walked in silence, arriving at the Yu Yao Realm, watching silently.
Boom!
The Yu Yao Realm trembled slightly, with the Principle forces stirring; bursts of the Power of Principles emerged, transforming into a graceful silhouette.
"Heavenly Slaughter?"
Yu Yao looked at Heavenly Slaughter with a serious gaze, feeling an intense pressure from him at that moment.
"A Domain without a Master of Domain cannot withstand the Imperishable Temple. Do you understand, Realm Master Yu Yao?"
Heavenly Slaughter spoke in a deep voice,
"You wish to become the Master of the Domain, but you are far from ready!"
Yu Yao sneered.
Heavenly Slaughter was silent, turned, and left. Yu Yao's delicate eyebrows furrowed, and the Power of Principles gradually receded; the Yu Yao Realm once again fell into silence.
"It is time!"
Heavenly Slaughter's eyes were cold and fierce, and nobody could stop him from becoming the Master of the Domain!
"Since you knew that I had something to do with the ambush initially, there is no need for pretense any longer—let's see how you can support Xiaoyao!"
Heavenly Slaughter stepped toward the Earth Shadow Realm. It was time to act.
Suddenly, Heavenly Slaughter looked up sharply beyond the Domain. His figure blurred, and he vanished in an instant.
In the Dao Realm, numerous Realm Masters appeared, gathering outside the Domain.
"What is that?"
Jiang Feng looked toward the location of the Netherworld Domain, displaying a shocked expression.
"Master of the Domain!"
Heavenly Slaughter uttered four words!
Everyone felt a sinking sensation in their hearts—the Imperishable Temple had begun to take action.
"What is the Witch Demon Domain planning to do?"
The Yunluo Realm Master looked toward the Dao Principles spreading from the Witch Demon Domain, which were trying to draw it closer.
Boom!
"Seductive Witch, Duowu, Tyrant Demon, are you trying to start a war?"
Jiang Feng's aura surged as he spoke in a stern voice.
"Brother Jiang Feng..."
The seductive voice of the Seductive Witch came forth, causing some weaker Realm Masters to panic, hastily refocusing their minds and averting their eyes, fearing they might be influenced.
"Hmph!"
Jiang Feng let out a cold snort, "Put away your charm; it doesn't work on me, Jiang Feng!"
"True villian!"
The Seductive Witch said bitterly.
"Gentlemen, the Imperishable Temple has made its move. If we do not join forces, how long can Taicang Domain last? At this moment, continuing to fight will lead to no good outcome for anyone!"
The Tyrant Demon spoke somberly.
"Taicang Domain, you cannot rely on the Domain Dao Rules. Even if you enter Taicang Domain, your aid is limited. You should continue to coordinate with my Witch Demon Domain from your camp; there is no need to enter my Taicang!"
Another Realm Master spoke.
"Taicang, why must you be so ruthless? We too are Minor Heaven and Earth Masters. We might not withstand the Master of the Domain or the Minor Heaven and Earth Masters of the Imperishable Temple, but still, we can manage. Netherworld is likely beyond salvation. If my Witch Demon falls, how long can you Taicang hold out?"
The Seductive Witch put away her seductive demeanor and spoke earnestly.
Rumbling!
At that moment, a violent tremor came from the Netherworld Domain, and a swathe of blood light shone on the Unchanging Lands.
Everyone's expression changed drastically; the Dao Principles of the Netherworld Domain were fully activated, and it was nearly self-destructing to take down its enemies with it!
The spilling blood light blossomed like a sun emerging in the chaotic Unchanging Lands. Despite the distance, the collective forces still felt the terrifying power erupting from the Netherworld Domain.
Just when everyone thought the Netherworld Domain would explode the next moment, the blood light unexpectedly began to contract, as if it were being absorbed, and was suppressed.
"Swallowing the Domain?"
Heavenly Slaughter focused his gaze as everyone felt a heavy heart.
The one who acted, could it be that person from the Imperishable Temple, otherwise, who could possess such terrifying power?
Only that one could possibly have the power to devour a Domain!
Taicang Domain, though not yet broken, how long could it last?
For a moment, everyone was heavy-hearted, enveloped by a strong sense of crisis, and even Heavenly Slaughter began to reconsider his plans against Xiaoyao.
After all, the true crisis came from outside the Domain, and if they could not overcome it, everything would be in vain!
"Even devouring a Domain requires time to digest; it won't be able to swallow another Domain shortly. We should be safe from it for a while,"
Ao Lie said in a solemn voice, looking toward Heavenly Slaughter.
Heavenly Slaughter took a deep breath and said with a resolute gaze, "Gentlemen, now that the crisis is upon us, a Domain cannot be without a master for a day. I, Heavenly Slaughter, am confident in my ability to control much of the Domain Authority. I hope you all can unite and confront this crisis together!"

chapters.title: Chapter 988 - 512: Appearance of the Netherworld, Meng Chong Breaks Through
chapters.content:
Heavenly Slaughter's words silenced all the Realm Masters. Although a crisis was looming, the notion of supporting Heavenly Slaughter to become the new Master of Domain, reigning over them, was ultimately hard to accept.
"Heavenly Slaughter, how certain are you that you can wield the Domain Authority?"
A Realm Master asked in a deep voice.
"I, Heavenly Slaughter, am not only the strongest of the third generation in the Taicang Domain, but I also participated in the original battle for the Domain. Naturally, I gained some opportunities. Since I dare to vie for the Domain Authority, it is because I am confident."
At this moment, Heavenly Slaughter's aura erupted, displaying his formidable strength.
His gaze turned to Jiang Feng, "Jiang Feng, do you acknowledge that I, Heavenly Slaughter, am the foremost of the third generation?"
Jiang Feng's gaze was deep and his aura subdued; he remained silent, seemingly conceding Heavenly Slaughter's status as the foremost of the third generation.
"Today, I, Heavenly Slaughter, will make it clear. I will contend for the Domain Authority, and I shall not settle for less than sixty percent. Those who disagree can challenge me; it will be decided by our abilities!
"But, having planned for so long, if anyone thinks they can take my authority, don't blame me for being ruthless. With the crisis upon us, there's no need for pretense."
Heavenly Slaughter's gaze swept over the Realm Masters, laying his intentions bare.
"Then let it be decided by our abilities."
A Realm Master chuckled dryly.
No one was willing to give up; in the end, it would indeed come down to their abilities.
"Something's not right, be careful."
Suddenly, Jiang Feng's expression changed dramatically.
Everyone looked towards the direction of the Netherworld Domain, where five powerful auras were rapidly approaching, like a rolling surge of blood, formidable and startling.
...
The Netherworld Domain, more devastated than the Witch Demon Domain, was the weakest of the three remaining domains.
In the Netherworld Domain, five Blood Lords who had survived the previous great war were Minor Heaven and Earth Masters who had once followed the Realm Master of the Netherworld Domain.
In recent days, the Netherworld Domain had become unstable; the Netherworld Blood Sea was often turbulent, and the Dao Principles occasionally shook.
Compelled by necessity, the five Blood Lords had to retract the Dao Principles that had spread into the Taicang Domain, halting the incursions of the Netherworld Warriors into the Heavenly Grotto of the Taicang Domain, at least temporarily.
"What's happening?"
The Lord of Underworld Blood stood above the Blood Sea, his brows furrowed as he spoke.
"Perhaps, it's related to the imminent great depletion of the Domain Dao Rule,"
The Prison Blood Lord sighed.
"The Taicang Domain is too domineering. Let's contact the Witch Demon again and strike against Taicang together to force them to cede a place for us!"
Blood Frenzy said indignantly.
The surviving Blood Lords in the Netherworld Domain were led by the Lord of Underworld Blood and the Prison Blood Lord, whose names derived from the Netherworld and were personally bestowed by the Realm Master of the Netherworld. Both were once the powerful lieutenants of the Netherworld!
Suddenly, all the Blood Lords' expressions changed drastically, and they looked up beyond the Netherworld Domain.
A figure approached, wearing a mask and a blood-colored cape that billowed like waves. A grey palace was embroidered on the black robe he wore.
He walked towards the Netherworld Domain, his cape stirring up blood-red tumultuous waves as if to engulf the Domain. His powerful presence gradually revealed itself.
The Master of Domain!
The Masters of Underworld and Prison Blood, shocked and flustered, hurriedly submerged into the Blood Sea and said in a deep voice, "Quick, let's jointly activate the Netherworld Domain Dao Rule!"
The other Blood Lords took their places in various locations within the Netherworld, and as the rumbling sounds rose, the Netherworld Domain Dao Rule materialized, ready to face the intruder.
The towering figure grew closer to the Netherworld Domain, and his voice resounded, "Don't resist in vain. Surrender!"
"Even if you are the Master of Domain, invading it will not be easy. Surrendering equals death; fighting might still give us a chance to live. You expect us to surrender without a fight, to effortlessly take over the Domain through deception? Wishful thinking!"
The Lord of Underworld Blood spoke coldly.
"Why be obstinately ignorant? If you surrender, I, the Xue Yu Protector, guarantee your survival!"
"If you want to fight, then fight. There's no need for idle talk!"
The Prison Blood Lord remained resolutely steadfast.
Xue Yu was silent for a moment before gradually raising his hand. With a thunderous boom, a huge blood-colored palm reached out from the Land of Imperishable and struck the Netherworld Domain.
Boom!
The Netherworld Domain shook, its Dao Rule surfacing to conjure a powerful defense, attempting to withstand the blow.
"It seems the Netherworld has decayed to this extent. It no longer has the necessity to exist!"
Xue Yu sighed somewhat.
Thunderous rumblings!
In the shocked eyes of the Blood Lords of the Netherworld, the Power of the Dao Principles surged and receded, incapable of withstanding the strike.
Thump!
A part of the Domain crumbled, and countless died or were injured instantaneously within the whole Netherworld Domain.
"How is this possible!"
The Blood Lords were horrified. Why did the Netherworld Domain's Dao Principles dissipate?
Boom!
Xue Yu struck down with another palm, stepping closer to the Netherworld Domain.
The Domain shattered further.
Raging furiously, the Blood Lords unleashed all their strength, jointly propelling the Dao Rule into a fierce attack.
Yet, under the softening touch of the Heavenly Dao, their Dao Rule lost its aggressive force, and the remaining attacks of the five Blood Lords were easily neutralized by the adversary.
The gap between the Minor Heaven and Earth Masters and the Master of Domain was, in the end, quite substantial.
Xue Yu walked step by step into the Domain, entering the Netherworld Domain. Regardless of how the Blood Lords stimulated the Netherworld Domain Dao Rule or launched their attacks, they were unable to stop the foe's advancement.
"It's you, isn't it, the Most Honored? Are you going to destroy the Netherworld?"
Suddenly, the Lord of Underworld Blood and Prison Blood Lord stopped resisting and shared a bitter smile, while the other three Blood Lords fell into silence.
The only one who could smooth over the Netherworld Domain Dao Rule, unaffected by its attacks, aside from the founder of the Netherworld Domain, was none other than Netherworld himself!
"The Netherworld is dead. There is only the Xue Yu Protector of the Imperishable Temple!"

chapters.title: Chapter 989 - 512: The Netherworld Appears, Meng Chong Breaks Through_2
chapters.content:
The Xue Yu's form halted, his voice cold as he spoke.
"Supreme Sovereign, you've actually pledged allegiance to the Imperishable Temple!"
Lord of Underworld Blood and Prison Blood Lord were, for a moment, unable to accept the reality before them. The Supreme Sovereign of the past had been so defiant, so unyielding.
No one had anticipated that he would yield to the Imperishable Temple.
"There is no pledging allegiance. It's merely a mutual need, and I'm giving you a chance to return under my command."
Xue Yu's gaze fell on Lord of Underworld Blood and Prison Blood Lord as he spoke.
The two Blood Lords fell silent, looking up at the Netherworld Domain, fearful and uneasy, while the wailing Netherworld Warriors, their Blood King, Blood Spirit, Xuezhi, and others followed them.
"What about them? Supreme Sovereign, you created the Netherworld Domain, and all beings within this domain exist because of you. Could it be..."
Xue Yu coldly said, "Since I created this domain, and everything in it exists because of it, their lives and deaths are at my discretion. As a tribute to our past bond, I am giving you twelve spots to choose your followers."
Lord of Underworld Blood wanted to say more, but Xue Yu coldly interjected, "The Netherworld is dead, and naturally, the Netherworld Domain shouldn't exist either. Do you understand that I am now the Protector of the Imperishable Temple's Xue Yu?"
All five Blood Lords remained silent, struggling internally. Resisting was simply a futile demise.
"We wish to follow you, Supreme Sovereign!"
In the end, all five Blood Lords bowed their heads. The Netherworld Domain was originally created by the Netherworld; since he had already given it up, what point was there in persisting?
"Very well, go and have a match with the Witch Demon and Taicang. I am going to devour this domain."
Xue Yu's tone became gentle.
"Yes, Supreme Sovereign!"
The five Blood Lords chose their confidants to continue following them, and the rest perished along with the domain.
Boom!
Xue Yu's form erupted with rolling bloody qi, transforming into a Blood Path that resonated with the Dao Principles of the Domain. The crumbling domain emitted a bloody glow, as if about to burst.
Streams of the Power of the Domain Dao Principles converged, and numerous Dao Principles entered Xue Yu's body, while all living beings of the entire domain turned into torrents of fresh blood amidst their wails.
With a masked face, Xue Yu's expression was unseen, but his eyes slowly closed. This domain, originally his own, was now being destroyed by his own hands.
Gathering all from the domain to strengthen oneself, empower oneself—this was the method he rediscovered to strengthen himself, also from the Imperishable Temple.
Transforming the created domain into power for oneself, was akin to gathering scattered forces from outside, returning them to oneself.
This process required time, not achievable in just a day or two.
Outside the Taicang Domain, Heavenly Slaughter, the Seductive Witch, and others were watching the five Blood Lords confronting one another, their energies interweaving over the Unchanging Lands.
At this moment, whether it was the Taicang Domain or Witch Demon Domain, both understood that the person devouring the Netherworld Domain was none other than the Netherworld!
Unimaginable, the defiant Netherworld had actually surrendered to the Imperishable Temple.
The Netherworld had always been defiant and unyielding, universally recognized as someone who would rather die than bow down.
Previously suppressed by Taicang for a period, even if he was wrong, he stubbornly refused to admit it.
Yet, such a person had surrendered to the Imperishable Temple, and what baffled them even more was why the Imperishable Temple would accept the Netherworld?
This was vastly different from what they knew of the Imperishable Temple.
Moreover, the Netherworld had surrendered—was it after a defeat or at the beginning or even before the great battle?
What exactly happened during that grand battle of Domain Masters?
Taicang, such a powerful existence, had actually fallen!
This was something all Minor Heaven and Earth Masters could not accept; at that moment, everyone's faith collapsed, and many Minor Heaven and Earth Masters were dispirited and caught by the powerful ones of the Imperishable Temple.
When the great battle began, Taicang displayed an invincible momentum, instantly suppressing a Master of Heaven and Earth level of the Imperishable Temple.
He demonstrated strength far surpassing other Domain Masters, yet he ultimately lost!
At this moment, Ao Lie, the Seductive Witch, and others could not help but suspect that Netherworld's intrigue had played a part in Taicang's fall!
Outside the Domain, three factions faced each other off, yet none made a move.
"So it's the Netherworld."
Li Xuan, observing the standoff outside the Domain and the changes in the Netherworld Domain, also guessed the identity of the aggressor.
"The Netherworld has surrendered to the Imperishable Temple, and Taicang's death, could it be related to this?"
Perhaps initially during the great battle, Netherworld's betrayal of Taicang led to Taicang's fall.
Of course, this is just speculation.
It's also possible that after Taicang fell, Netherworld felt despair and surrendered.
"What's the connection between Blood Demon and Netherworld?"
Li Xuan couldn't help but wonder.
The Blood Demon wasn't one of the Blood Lords of the Netherworld; his actual strength was comparable to a Master of Domain, and Netherworld's martial arts were also known as the Netherworld Blood Demon Path.
"He doesn't pose a threat to the Taicang Domain yet; there's still time to enhance strength."
Li Xuan exhaled.
The Blood Demon, who had originally infiltrated the Taicang Domain to devise plans, had been tricked by Tian Zi and was currently being tortured, believing he had found a great opportunity.
The Blood Soul and the Blood Demon's true form must have some connections, so the Blood Demon was probably thinking about how to enhance his power and shift his focus away from the Taicang Domain.
This also bought more time for the Taicang Domain.
"Meng Chong is about to break through. Once all my five Daoist Martial Arts reach the Establishing Dao Realm, and my strength significantly increases, my foundation will be even stronger than the original Taicang!"
Li Xuan looked towards where Meng Chong was in seclusion. The breakthrough was not far off.
In the Great Wilderness, Tian Zi was deceiving and tormenting the Blood Demon, letting him believe that this was a test for him, an opportunity to enhance his talents, and that he should endure any great hardship with determination!
Outside the Domain, the standoff continued. The plan originally aimed at Old Man Xiao had to be postponed.
Xu Yan, in a treasure land within the Dao Realm, was perceiving the Origin Aura of the Domain from close by, both cultivating and aiming to understand the Creation Realm.
The Supreme Sovereigns of the Divine Realm each had their tasks, but none dared to step foot into the Qinghua state.
In the Nine Mountain Realm, the Demon Clan was becoming more powerful. Red Cat, the Great Demon King, was growing more prestigious, and the name of the Demon Clan was fully recognized.
Time passed quickly.
Ao Yuxue finally realized that she could cultivate the Great Demon Method. Her strength was increasing, and she was about to master True Dragon Divine Skills, which filled her with joy.
Her relationship with Cai Ling'er was extremely good now. Every time she saw Cai Ling'er, she affectionately called her "sister."
Wu Tianan had already achieved Great Accomplishment in the Heavenly Union Realm and had started to comprehend the Heaven and Earth Laws, and was now beginning to understand the Heavenly Dao Principles. The Domain's fortune was aiding his comprehension significantly.
Old Man Xiao was contemplating the Essence of Heavenly Dao, feeling that he had made substantial progress, moving one step further on his path.
Boom!
That day, the Divine Bridge connecting the Spiritual Realm to the Divine Realm was gradually opened, and the barrier between the two realms started weakening and disappearing.
In the Azure Sea of the Spiritual Realm, the Spiritual Energy was no longer inferior to that of the Divine Realm.
The Heavenly Dao began spreading toward the Divine Realm. Tian Zi was also accelerating the operation of the Heavenly Dao, aiming to run the entire Domain sooner.
That day, Meng Chong broke through.
"Your disciple Meng Chong has broken through to the third level of the Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Body, and your Mighty Sky Limitless Indestructible Body has reached Minor Achievement,"
the feedback from the Daoist Golden Book came.
"I've grown stronger again!"
Li Xuan was overjoyed, his Physical Body Martial Arts had also reached Minor Achievement in Establishing Dao.
With the attainment in the Establishing Dao Realm, a breakthrough at even a minor level represented a significant enhancement in strength. The breakthrough of two Daoist Martial Arts to Minor Achievement in Establishing Dao made Li Xuan even more confident.
In the seclusion room, Meng Chong was surrounded by the Great Sun and Stars. Every single acupoint seemed to transform into a star, densely packed with stars rotating.
"This is the Domain Realm of Physical Body Martial Arts!"
Meng Chong opened his eyes, feeling the immense strength of his body, almost as if his body had become a Domain itself.
"With my current strength, I can easily burst a Divine Venerate Realm Warrior with one punch!"
Meng Chong continued to cultivate, stabilizing himself, enhancing his divine skills, practicing more divine skills, and organizing his martial arts in preparation for the Mighty Sky Limitless Indestructible Body.
The Mighty Sky Limitless had reached the Establishing Dao Realm, establishing the Dao of the Physical Body.
"I should also venture into the Dao Realm now. There should be no power or strong being in the Divine Realm who dares to challenge me anymore."
Meng Chong muttered to himself.
Now that he was powerful, it was time to venture into the Dao Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 990 - 513: Son of the Realm Master, Exploding with One Punch
chapters.content:
Meng Chong broke through and continued cultivating amid the Qinghua state bottleneck, doing what needed to be cultivated and handling affairs that needed attention.
The winds of the Divine Realm had no influence here.
Naturally, they influenced Li Xuan even less as he still studied the bamboo scroll, which was filled with many strange and curated anecdotes. Every day, he would read slowly, and it would take a lot of time.
He treated it as a way to pass the time.
"Is this a diary, the diary of the Sea Spirit Emperor?"
Li Xuan murmured to himself, the events described on the bamboo scroll were like someone had chronicled their experiences and observations, just like a diary.
Although the bamboo scroll was in possession of the Sea Spirit Tribe, it was not necessarily written by the Sea Spirit Emperor, as there was little information about the Sea Spirit Tribe recorded on it.
One day, an unexpected message arrived: a Divine Realm Martial Artist challenged Meng Chong outside the Nine Mountain Realm!
The news of the challenge spread throughout the Divine Realm, causing a sensation.
The name Heavenly God Meng Chong was once again widely known in the Divine Realm, even drawing the attention of some Supreme Sovereigns.
"Is this Divine Venerate of the Wanbao Alliance seeking his own death?"
Meng Shushu was stunned.
The Wanbao Alliance, which had been cowardly for so long, were surprisingly not cowardly this time and directly challenged Meng Chong. Did they want to recover their dignity?
Was this because a Divine Venerate Realm Warrior from the Dao Realm came to their aid, so they felt more confident?
Xu Yan had just killed a Divine Venerate not long ago; did they not know about Meng Chong's relationship with Xu Yan?
Meng Chong, coming out from his seclusion chamber, also looked surprised.
"Wanbao Alliance's Hong Yi and a few others are quite shrewd. How come they are being foolish this time?"
Last time, the Wanbao Alliance had been cowardly and very aware of the circumstances, so he did not trouble Hong Yi and the others.
However, how long had it been, and now a Divine Venerate was challenging him?
The Divine Venerate outside the Nine Mountain Realm issued the challenge, boasting about luring Meng Chong to his death.
Originally, this Divine Venerate planned to challenge him at the border between Qinghua state and Nine Mountain Realm, but Red Cat blocked his way, demanding a toll to enter the Nine Mountain Realm.
The Divine Venerate, having no choice, decided to challenge outside the Nine Mountain Realm instead because he realized he could not defeat the Great Demon King with his power.
"This comes at a perfect time to stretch my limbs!"
Meng Chong sneered.
With someone delivering themselves to death, how could he not oblige?
Meng Chong immediately set out for the battleground. Zi Yun was thrilled, as she would see Meng Chong displaying his divine might again.
Meng Shushu, Shi'er, Feng Yan, and others, including Emperor Da Yue, excitedly went to witness the battle of a Divine Venerate—an opportunity they wouldn't miss.
Upon reaching the Nine Mountain Realm, Red Cat scampered over to greet them and even brought someone with him.
It was surprisingly Hong Yi from the Wanbao Alliance.
Meng Chong was astonished, "Hong Yi, I thought your Wanbao Alliance was quite perceptive. What happened this time?"
He was indeed surprised since, after the humiliation the Wanbao Alliance suffered last time and knowing that he and Xu Yan were from the same sect, they should have known better than to let a mere Divine Venerate seek revenge against him.
Hong Yi looked wronged and said, "Mister Meng, this is a misunderstanding, and it has nothing to do with us. We came here to explain, hoping you won't implicate us."
Meng Chong was puzzled. A misunderstanding?
"Could it be, that Divine Venerate isn't from your Wanbao Alliance?"
Hong Yi sighed and said, "He is our backer from the Dao Realm, indeed, but his character is a bit poor. After hearing about Mister Meng, he insisted on seeking an explanation from you..."
Following Hong Yi's explanation, Meng Chong and the others finally understood. That Divine Venerate was too domineering and disdainful of everyone; he treated Hong Yi and his fellow warriors like slaves.
Rumors had it that this Divine Venerate had an extraordinary background, being the son of the Wan Tao Realm's Realm Master, one of the Three Hundred Realms, which nurtured his arrogant nature, even disregarding the Supreme Sovereigns.
Of course, because he was the Realm Master's son, those Supreme Sovereigns did not dare to harm him.
Hong Yi and other Wanbao Alliance warriors, who were abused at will, were deeply resentful. When the opportunity came for this Divine Venerate to seek revenge on behalf of the Wanbao Alliance, nobody reminded him that Meng Chong and Xu Yan were from the same sect.
This was why they issued the challenge now.
Worried about causing Meng Chong a misunderstanding, Hong Yi came to explain and clear the air.
"Mister Meng, his identity is extraordinary—after all, he is the son of a Realm Master. And because of his special status, his strength is no trivial matter. The Supreme Sovereigns dare not treat him lightly, so he came to the Divine Realm purely to have fun. If he dies, it might provoke retaliation from the Realm Master."
Hong Yi spoke gravely.
"The son of a Realm Master, huh? To kill or not to kill him depends on his attitude. If he is seeking death, I shall oblige him. As for his father, ha!"
At the end, Meng Chong scoffed contemptuously.
No matter how powerful the Realm Master is, he is but an ant in his master's eyes. Besides, the Wan Tao Realm Master's strength is only mediocre among the Realm Masters. Old Man Xiao could easily suppress him.
"The son of a Realm Master? If that's the case, he must hate me dearly and surely wants revenge, right?"
Red Cat said in surprise.
After all, Red Cat had blocked his entry into the Nine Mountain Realm, hadn't held back in insulting him, and even after a fight, the opponent had suffered a slight loss.
Given his nature and being the son of a Realm Master, he was surely not one to swallow his pride and must be thinking about how to get revenge.
Naturally, Red Cat was not worried. After all, its master was a Taoist Ancestor. In terms of background and patrons, the opponent was nothing!

chapters.title: Chapter 991 - 513: Son of the Realm Master, Exploding with One Punch - Part 2
chapters.content:
The boundary between Nine Mountain Realm and Changyun Realm was a convergence point for many powerful beings, the weakest among them being the Immortal Heavenly Venerable, and all were top-tier within that category.
Those below the Immortal Realm had no qualification to watch the battle.
Among the spectators, naturally there were Heavenly Union Realm Warriors and Divine Venerate Realm Warriors from the Dao Realm, while the Supreme Sovereign Realm Warriors, who all had their own tasks, did not come to join the crowd.
"Isn't that Wan Jie?"
"Yes, that's him, the son of the Wan Tao Realm Master, spoiled and arrogant. The Wan Tao Realm is the backbone of the Divine Realm Wanbao Alliance. This time Wan Jie came to the Divine Realm after hearing about the one claimed to be the Heavenly God, Meng Chong, to reclaim the prestige for the Wanbao Alliance."
"Heavenly God Meng Chong, I've heard of him too. Initially famous throughout the Divine Realm, he forced the Wanbao Alliance to bow down."
The group of Divine Venerate Martial Artists from the Dao Realm discussed animatedly.
"This time, Wan Jie is probably going to be unlucky."
Some reveled in schadenfreude.
"How so?"
"It is said, Meng Chong and Xu Yan are from the same sect. How could Meng Chong's strength be weak? Wan Jie is merely a Divine Venerate, he will surely lose this time."
"I see!"
However, someone disagreed: "That might not necessarily be the case. Wan Jie does have a Realm Master as a father, which makes him different from other Divine Venerates. Would Meng Chong dare to kill a Realm Master's son?"
At these words, the others showed expressions of envy.
"A Realm Master!"
That was the very peak of strength in the whole Domain. Even the weakest Realm Master was high above, not someone that those below the status of Realm Master dared offend.
Moreover, being Realm Masters themselves, they all tried to avoid conflicts with one another as much as possible. Even if Meng Chong had a Realm Master Realm Experts backing him, he wouldn't dare to make a deadly enemy out of a Realm Master, as this would break the unspoken agreement among Realm Masters.
"Wan Jie can be this arrogant, dominating and bullying in the Dao Realm, just because he relies on his Realm Master father. This time I do hope Meng Chong gives him a good beating."
A Divine Venerate Martial Artist sneered, clearly harboring some animosity towards Wan Jie, evidently disliking his attitude for a long time.
"Exactly, to beat up Wan Jie would be to vent some anger. Seeing him getting beaten up makes me feel pleased!"
Another Martial Artist echoed.
As for killing Wan Jie, they held no hope; after all, this is a son of a Realm Master, a person of revered status, backed by a powerful support!
"Meng Chong is here!"
Among the crowd of spectators, Zhou Qingshuang, a prince from the Da Yan Dynasty and a Martial Artist from the Da Yan Realm spoke softly.
Bright eyes turned toward the towering figure and the purple-dressed woman holding Meng Chong's arm, sheer envy shining through.
Beside Zhou Qingshuang, a Divine Venerate from the Da Yan Realm raised her eyebrow and said, "Meng Chong's physical body gives me a feeling of utmost potency."
Beyond that, it was hard to discern Meng Chong's actual strength.
"Are you that 'Heavenly God Meng Chong'?"
Wan Jie stood on a high dais made from giant stones, looking down with an arrogant demeanor.
"I hear you are the son of the Wan Tao Realm Master?"
Meng Chong rubbed his head. So, this Wan Jie was as arrogant as rumored, a disdainful look in his eyes.
Hearing this, Wan Jie's expression became even more arrogant and wild, "What, scared now? Here's the deal, send that girl by your side up here, kowtow to me three times, and from now on run errands by my side, then I'll spare your life!"
The might of a Realm Master, in this Domain, besides other Realm Masters, no one dared to offend.
This was also where Wan Jie's confidence lay, the root of his arrogance—despite others having a Realm Master as a supporter, they wouldn't dare strike against him.
After all, his status was that of a Realm Master's son. Between different realms of the Dao Domain, there were certain unwritten rules.
For instance, the true descendants of a Realm Master were inviolable. Even if there were conflicts between descendants of Realm Masters, they could not result in life or death.
In Wan Jie's view, even if Meng Chong was a Martial Artist from the Divine Realm, anomalous or not, how could it compare to his noble status as a Realm Master's son?
Besides, Meng Chong at most had the strength of the Heavenly Union Realm. Even if he were a Divine Venerate, how would that matter? He was the son of a Realm Master, inherently stronger than your average Divine Venerate.
When Meng Chong asked if he was the son of a Realm Master, Wan Jie immediately thought Meng Chong was cowering and wanted to yield.
Thus, arrogant and haughty, according to his usual style, Wan Jie prepared to humiliate him further, to teach him what consequences one must face for offending a Realm Master's son!
Zi Yun exploded with anger on hearing this, leaping up and shouting, "Meng Chong, beat him to death! How dare he covet this lady, strike him dead!"
Meng Chong touched his head, showing a fierce smile. Just a mere Realm Master's son dared to be more arrogant than him, a bearer of the Taoist Ancestor's true teachings; not beating him would undermine his own reputation as a Heavenly God.
"If you seek death, I will grant it!"
Meng Chong stepped forward, his formidable aura gradually emerging.
However, he did not transform into a golden giant nor did he display any great momentum.
"Make your move now, or you won't even have the chance!"
Meng Chong stood on the high platform, sneering.
"Arrogant!"
Wan Jie was furious, "I'd like to see what makes you qualified to call yourself a Heavenly God!"
Boom!
At that moment, Wan Jie's momentum erupted, a long sabre in hand.
The sabre was surrounded by the essence of the Dao, principles entwining around it. It was a Divine Artifact, no longer comparable to ordinary ones, blessed by a Realm Master Realm Expert.
This was Wan Jie's trump card, and also the confidence behind his ability to surpass many Divine Venerates and slay them.
"Worthy of being the Realm Master's son, that Artifact is incomparable to any in our possession!"
The watching Divine Venerate Martial Artists couldn't help but envy and exclaim.
"Can Meng Chong win?"
As Wan Jie wielded a sabre blessed by a Realm Master, their confidence in Meng Chong couldn't help but waver.
"Playing with knives before me?"
Meng Chong scoffed with disdain, "I won't bully you. If I can't burst you with one punch, I'll spare your life!"
"Die!"
Wan Jie was furious and slashed with his sabre.
Although he was reckless, as soon as he made his move, he went all out, daring not to be careless.
Meng Chong's ferocious aura brought him a faint sense of pressure.
With one slash, the blade's brightness seemed to envelop a small domain, brutally striking down. The very space shook, as if it would be split by this one slash.
The watching Heavenly Union Realm and below warriors immediately felt their breath catch, shocked, all of them backing away a distance.
Even the Divine Venerate Martial Artists had a solemn look, secretly estimating if they could withstand this slash!
The ultimate conclusion was that they couldn't withstand it. They would surely be severely injured under this slash!
Thud!
At this moment, it was as if time froze. The watching warriors seemed to see a great sun appearing between heaven and earth.
One could see Meng Chong punching out, like a great sun erupting, its might pressing down on everyone like a giant mountain.
In their eyes was the supremely dominant great sun that seemed as if it could obliterate everything.
At this time, not only did the Heavenly Union Realm and below warriors hastily retreat in panic, even the Divine Venerate Realm Martial Artists were terrified, all of them backing away a distance.
One punch out, like the image of a great sun ending the world.
Boom!
The might of Wan Jie's slash, under the great sun, shattered like paper. To think that one punch could be this powerful.
"My father is the Realm..."
Wan Jie's expression was full of horror, his breathing nearly stopped, the crisis of death looming, his body and Divine Soul feeling as if they would be crushed.
Any resistance, any attack, couldn't shake this punch.
One punch, like the great sun ending the world!
At that moment, he desperately started to speak, wanting to remind his opponent that he was the Realm Master's son and that even in a conflict, life and death shouldn't be seen!
Boom!
But this punch, without any pause, directly struck him.
Puff!
All the Divine Venerate Martial Artists' hearts trembled, their bodies shaking uncontrollably. Wan Jie was burst by one punch, reduced to ash, his Divine Soul wiped out!
That was the Realm Master's son!
What lingered in their minds was that punch, like the great sun ending the world.
At this moment, they couldn't help but recall Meng Chong's nickname, Heavenly God!
A punch from the Heavenly God, directly bursting a Divine Venerate. Such savage power, perhaps not even a Supreme Sovereign could do it?
Even more horrifying to the group of Divine Venerates was that Wan Jie was the son of a Realm Master! Meng Chong didn't hesitate for even a moment, not even blinking an eye, he just burst him directly, reduced to ash, not even leaving a corpse for the Wan Tao Realm Master to claim.
This must be the first ever to utterly disregard the Realm Master's authority and humiliate a Realm Master like this!

chapters.title: Chapter 992 - 514: This is the Evergreen Fairy, a Disciple of the Taoist Ancestor
chapters.content:
Meng Chong dusted off the dirt from his body, turned around, and walked away, carrying himself as if he hadn't just blown up the son of a Realm Master but a mere grasshopper!
The Divine Venerates swallowed hard, cold sweat appearing on their foreheads. This was a seriously dangerous man, someone they absolutely could not afford to offend!
He had not hesitated for even a moment to burst the Realm Master's son with one punch, and for those without powerful backers, he would be even less likely to blink an eyelid before killing.
"Meng Chong killed the son of the Wan Tao Realm Master, and didn't leave even his bones behind. It won't be long before a Realm Master descends in wrath. Can he withstand it?"
The Divine Venerate next to Zhou Qingshuang said with a grave expression.
"He should be fine, right?"
Zhou Qingshuang said with some worry.
Since Meng Chong dared to kill, he must have the confidence, right?
In her mind, she envisioned Meng Chong's mysterious master. At the very least, he was a Realm Master, or even surpassed one?
"Let's go, we're heading back!"
Meng Chong waved his hand nonchalantly and made his exit.
The news of Wan Jie being punched to death quickly spread throughout the Divine Realm. The name of Heavenly God Meng Chong once again shook the Divine Realm.
The warriors who had come from the Dao Realm were all shocked to hear about it.
The murder of a Realm Master's son was perhaps unprecedented in history!
And to leave no remains, not even a corpse for the Wan Tao Realm Master, that was outright disrespect for a Realm Master.
At that moment, all the warriors of the Supreme Sovereign Realm were utterly horrified.
Xiaoyao Realm Master indeed had the strength to not fear the Wan Tao Realm Master, but his indulgence in letting his disciple kill the Realm Master's son and annihilate his body, undoubtedly broke the bottom line among Realm Masters.
Could it be that he was not afraid of igniting a great war among Realm Masters?
"This Domain is headed for chaos!"
A Supreme Sovereign Warrior muttered to himself.
In the Taikun Realm, a Supreme Venerate from Taikun walked across what once was a wilderness, seemingly in search of something.
Outside the Taicang Domain, a standoff continued, while Heavenly Slaughter was conversing and negotiating secretly with the Seductive Witch.
The Great Wilderness.
The Blood Demon no longer knew how many days he had been inside the Great Ding, nor how many torturous treatments he had endured.
But he clenched his teeth and persevered.
"With such a great opportunity in front of me, what does mere pain amount to!"
The Blood Demon persisted stubbornly.
Thud!
The lid of the Great Ding opened, and the Herb Collector appeared.
"Not bad, not bad. Every real powerhouse is someone with a resilient will. Without it, how can one Establish Dao?"
Seeing the satisfaction in the Herb Collector's eyes, the Blood Demon was excited. His perseverance was indeed correct; the Herb Collector was testing him and laying a solid foundation for him.
It might even be the foundation for Establishing Dao!
"The first phase of the treatment has ended, and you must have felt the integration of your flesh and Divine Soul by now."
"Yes, Senior!"
The Blood Demon nodded.
"Come out then. We are about to start the second phase of the treatment!"
The Blood Demon stepped out of the Great Ding only to see a person-sized barrel appear in the yard.
"Get in."
Tian Zi instructed.
Without a word, the Blood Demon jumped straight into the barrel.
"The treatment that follows will be very painful. If you can endure it, you'll gain even more fortune, and it's not impossible to be above Establishing Dao."
Tian Zi continued to lead the Blood Demon on with promises.
Upon hearing this, the Blood Demon became as excited as if he had been injected with chicken blood. To be above Establishing Dao! Once he had such strength, no one, whether from Taicang or the Imperishable Divine Temple, would be his match!
"Senior, I will definitely persevere!"
The Blood Demon solemnly declared.
"Good!"
Tian Zi's face beamed with satisfaction. Then, he started to throw various creatures into the barrel: insects, snakes, and all sorts of creepy-crawlies, one after the other.
The Blood Demon couldn't help but swallow hard. Even he felt his scalp tingle.
"This is the Myriad Spirits Return to Dragon Method. Once you endure, you will obtain a Sacred Body of Myriad Spirits!"
Tian Zi lured him with more promises.
Upon hearing this, the Blood Demon became excited and no longer found the bugs disgusting or frightening.
Although he didn't know what a Sacred Body of Myriad Spirits was, the name alone told him it was extraordinary.
Finally, Tian Zi took out a True Dragon that was black in color. No longer than a foot, yet its aura was extremely powerful.
After dropping the black True Dragon into the barrel, Tian Zi said seriously, "Alright, I'm going to seal the Myriad Spirits Barrel now. You still have time to regret this. Once it starts, it can't be stopped, and the agony of having myriad spirits invade your body is beyond human endurance."
"Junior will not have regrets!"
The Blood Demon's gaze was firm.
That was a True Dragon we're talking about, to be thrown into the barrel, indicating the chance for great fortune once the ordeal was endured!
"Good, I have not misjudged you!"
Tian Zi's face showed relief, and then he sealed the barrel. After patting the barrel, a sneer emerged on his face.
Screams of agony came from inside the barrel.
"Scream, scream, you're in for it."
Tian Zi looked up at the sky and chuckled. It wouldn't be long before the Heavenly Dao operated the entire Domain.
Once he could run the entire Domain, his Majesty of the Heavenly Path would not be much less than Taicang's, giving him some confidence against the Imperishable Divine Temple.
And it was just the beginning.
"The Blood Demon is powerful. If I can exploit this Blood Soul to trick him, or even control him, it could play an unexpected role. But to deceive a Master of Domain is too difficult."
Tian Zi felt that he needed some advice from the Taoist Ancestor.
Meng Chong returned to the Qinghua Sect to continue his cultivation, comprehending Divine Skills and the Blade Path. He didn't immediately set out for the Dao Realm.
After all, there was an expert in the Realm Master Realm in Dao Realm who wished nothing more than to flay him alive. Even if he were to go to the Dao Realm, he must do so discreetly.

chapters.title: Chapter 993 - 514: This is the Evergreen Fairy, a Disciple of the Taoist Ancestor_2
chapters.content:
Time flew by, and Su Lingxiu made her breakthrough to the Domain Realm.
"Your disciple Su Lingxiu has broken through to the Domain Realm, and your Alchemical Medical Martial Arts Establishing Dao Realm has reached Minor Achievement."
Li Xuan was in high spirits, as his Alchemical Medical Martial Arts had also improved.
Following Su Lingxiu's breakthrough, Fang Hao and Jiang Buping also succeeded one after another, and thus the power of all five Martial Arts schools was enhanced.
"With my current strength, suppressing Taicang should be no difficulty."
Li Xuan felt a newfound confidence welling up inside him.
Of course, just how much more powerful the mighty ones of the Imperishable Temple were in comparison to Taicang remained an unknown quantity.
Only after breaking through to the Creation Realm could one truly be without fear!
"I wonder how far Xu Yan has progressed in his contemplation?"
Li Xuan looked up towards the Dao Realm where Xu Yan was comprehending the Origin of Domain, using it to discern the Creation Realm.
"I'm not far from reaching Minor Achievement in the Domain Realm!"
While Xu Yan was comprehending the Origin of Domain, besides helping him understand the Creation Realm, it was also greatly beneficial for his cultivation within the Domain Realm.
It was precisely for this reason that Xu Yan was so close to achieving Minor Achievement in the Domain Realm.
After consolidating her Realm, Su Lingxiu hurried out of seclusion, as she had an important errand to run: to capture the core Divine Soul of Blood Extreme.
"That core Divine Soul of yours, it hasn't encountered any problems, has it?"
Su Lingxiu asked as she looked towards the jar containing Blood Extreme.
"No problems, it's been well hidden."
Blood Extreme nodded in response.
"Alright, I'll bring back that part of your Divine Soul."
Su Lingxiu was brimming with excitement as she prepared to set out for the Taikun Realm.
"Go find Tian Zi, there's something there that might interest you,"
Li Xuan, however, stopped Su Lingxiu.
This particular Blood Soul of Blood Demon was quite unique, and Tian Zi wanted to use it to trick the Blood Demon's true self.
However, he hadn't figured out how to do it without alerting Blood Demon, and Li Xuan didn't give him any directions but left the matter to Su Lingxiu.
Su Lingxiu, as an Alchemical Medical Warrior who also studied various Divine Souls, would find this an excellent practice for handling this particular Blood Soul.
"Master, what is it? I still need to go find the part of Blood Extreme's Divine Soul."
Su Lingxiu asked with confusion.
"A Blood Soul residing within the corpse of Blood Spirit Child..."
Li Xuan briefly explained the situation with Blood Demon.
Upon hearing this, Su Lingxiu indeed became even more excited, "I'll go find him right away!"
She hastily headed towards the Great Wilderness to locate Tian Zi.
When Blood Demon emerged from the barrel, he saw a spirited young girl whose presence made the vegetation around her thrive more vigorously, and some buds that were waiting to bloom bloomed in an instant.
Even more shockingly, a withered plant began to sprout new shoots.
"Why does she have an aura that seems to endow all things with life?"
Blood Demon was greatly astounded by this affinity with plants and the vibrant breath of life wherever she went, something he had never seen before.
From the Herb Collector's demeanour, this young girl surely was someone extraordinary.
"You, young man, have quite good fortune,"
the Herb Collector remarked looking at him.
"This is the Evergreen Fairy, come quickly to pay your respects; she is a disciple of the Taoist Ancestor."
The Herb Collector introduced her.
Blood Demon was taken aback, the girl before him was a disciple of the Taoist Ancestor?
The Taoist Ancestor was an existence of unimaginable power, someone who created the Great Wilderness Domain with a mere thought.
And the strength of the Great Wilderness Domain far surpassed that of the seven Taicang Domains.
If the young girl was a disciple of the Taoist Ancestor, her status was incredibly high and her strength unsurpassably formidable. No wonder everything came to life as she passed by, and flowers bloomed!
At this moment, it was also finally confirmed—the Herb Collector was not simple.
"Greetings, Evergreen Fairy!"
This was a great opportunity; if there was a chance to become a disciple of the Taoist Ancestor...
Blood Demon's heart raced with excitement, and although kneeling before a young girl as a gesture initiated by the Herb Collector might demean his dignity as Blood Demon, faced with such an immense opportunity, he did not hesitate to kneel.
"Hmm!"
Su Lingxiu, with her cool and detached demeanor, harbored excitement in the depths of her eyes. This soul of the Blood Demon seemed to be of great research value.
With a wave of her hand, a jade platform fell to the ground, adorned with various gadgets on top, all for the purpose of soul research.
The Blood Demon once again widened his eyes in amazement; he had never before seen such a jade platform and gadgets.
"Lie down on it."
Su Lingxiu maintained her cool and detached persona.
Tian Zi explained to the Blood Demon on the side, "Hurry up and lie down. It's a great opportunity for the Evergreen Fairy herself to make a move. Don't resist, understand?"
His expression turned serious as he spoke.
"Yes, yes, senior!"
Suppressing the excitement in his heart, the Blood Demon quickly lay on the jade platform.
Hum!
Lines of restraints bound him to the jade platform; these lines seemed to be the power of some Principle.
Next, he saw the Evergreen Fairy approach the platform, pulling out tiny tubes he had never seen before, one of which attached to his forehead.
"In a moment, you'll feel drowsy. Don't fight it. When you wake up, everything will have changed."
No sooner had the Evergreen Fairy's words faded than the Blood Demon began to feel fatigued, and then he fell into a deep sleep, losing consciousness.
Lingxiu was thrilled, her fine long needles piercing into the soul of the Blood Demon. Tian Zi assisted excitedly at her side.
"How is it, have you found anything?"
She asked eagerly.
"This Blood Soul is quite special. If necessary, it can be connected to the consciousness of the original being and can directly return to the Divine Soul of the original.
"So, to trick the Blood Demon effectively, we must make our move on the Blood Soul and have the Blood Demon take the Blood Soul back into himself.
"However, to deceive the Blood Demon, we must consider the matter further to ensure a foolproof plan."
As Su Lingxiu dissected the Blood Soul, she spoke.
"Although it can be connected to the consciousness of the original being, this connection is quite tenuous, capable only of transmitting sights, sounds, and some thoughts. The original being cannot see through the Blood Soul to spot these arrangements, so there's no need to worry too much.
"Currently, the Blood Demon must be under the impression that his Blood Soul has entered a new Domain, and he thinks it's a great opportunity.
"From my recent dissection, it seems that the Blood Soul just shared news and consciousness with the original a few days ago.
"Figure out a way to have the Blood Demon send more Divine Spirit Soul Force over here. I'll capture some for research..."
Su Lingxiu suggested to Tian Zi on how to coax more Divine Spirit Soul Force out of the Blood Demon to enhance the Blood Soul.
Of course, this enhancement must not be too significant. As for capturing Divine Spirit Soul Force for research, some loss during transmission of the Divine Spirit Soul Force is normal, and the Blood Demon won't be suspicious.
"This particular Blood Soul seems to be a child soul of the Blood Demon, capable of drawing Divine Spirit Soul Force down. To cultivate this Blood Soul, the Blood Demon must have put in quite a lot of effort and time.
"When he sends Divine Spirit Soul Force to strengthen the Blood Soul, use the Power of Heavenly Dao to obstruct it somewhat, making the Blood Demon realize that sending it is very strenuous, and the distance is incredibly far, so he cannot pinpoint the location..."
Su Lingxiu restored the Blood Soul while infusing it with some pills and endowed the Blood Soul with some Evergreen vitality.
Then, she made some minor alterations to the Blood Soul's head, causing it to appear as if two small horns were protruding.
"Next, this is what you'll tell him..."
Su Lingxiu said with a cunning smile.
"Brilliant, brilliant! How could I not have thought of that?"
Tian Zi nodded repeatedly, brimming with excitement.
"All right, I'll be going now. When he wakes up, you tell him this and set a time for when I'll return."
Su Lingxiu collected the jade platform, leaving the Blood Demon lying on the ground, and passed a jar to Tian Zi, designed to hold the Divine Spirit Soul Force of the Blood Demon.
Tian Zi stood still, appearing contemplative, waiting for the Blood Demon to awaken.
Soon enough, the Blood Demon woke up, finding his Blood Soul seemingly different. Without time to inspect it closely, he scrambled up from the ground.
"Senior, where is the Evergreen Fairy?"
"Alas!"
The Herb Collector heaved a sigh, "You lack enough fortune, yet there's still a chance."
"Senior, what happened?"
The Blood Demon became anxious.
"Your Divine Soul is ultimately lacking somewhat, and it did not meet the Evergreen Fairy's standards. However, if you can strengthen your Divine Soul in a month to meet the requirements, there might still be a chance."
Tian Zi pondered for a moment and explained to the Blood Demon, while painting the picture a little bigger; only a big enough temptation could induce the Blood Demon to send his Divine Spirit Soul Force.

chapters.title: Chapter 994 - 515 I Take Pride in Being a Disciple of Daozu, Burying a Divine Venerate
chapters.content:
Blood Demon was completely shocked after hearing the reason, the appearance of Evergreen Fairy was actually such a grand opportunity waiting for him.
However, because his Divine Spirit Soul Force had not yet met the requirements, he was about to miss it.
But it was not completely without chance, as long as within a month, if his Divine Spirit Soul Force was enhanced to the required conditions, he could still grasp this opportunity!
"At this point, I will not hide it from you, because you were influenced by that one, not only did you enter into demonic madness and your consciousness became chaotic, but your Divine Spirit Soul Force also underwent some changes.
"I have also been looking for a suitable candidate, and you have this chance, do you understand?"
Tian Zi sighed.
"Senior, I understand!"
Blood Demon nodded seriously.
"Take this bottle of pills, consume one every three days, if within a month, your Divine Spirit Soul Force meets the requirements, the opportunity can still be seized!"
Tian Zi's expression was serious as he handed a bottle of pills to Blood Demon.
"Yes, Senior, I will definitely not disappoint you!"
Blood Demon solemnly promised.
"Good, after a month, Evergreen Fairy will come again, seize it well!"
After Tian Zi finished speaking, he pointed at the Great Ding and said, "If you have the perseverance and determination, endure inside the Great Ding to facilitate your rapid improvement."
He wouldn't make it easy for Blood Demon!
"Yes, Senior!"
Blood Demon jumped into the Great Ding without hesitation.
Tian Zi covered the Great Ding and then burst out into a malicious grin as he turned and left.
Blood Demon endured the excruciating pain akin to being diced with thousands of knives, yet his heart burnt with fervor, "I must seize this opportunity. Enhancing the Divine Spirit Soul Force is not difficult for me, this Blood Soul really weakened somewhat, it should be strengthened too."
Daoist Ancestor had passed down a Great Technique, to be transmitted to those predestined, hence the Disciples of Daozu were all searching for the destined ones to pass this Great Technique.
Practicing this Great Technique posed some requirements for the Divine Spirit Soul Force.
Once one practiced this Great Technique, it meant becoming a Disciple of Daozu, and this technique's strength could allow one to cultivate directly up to Establishing Dao Realm without any bottlenecks.
Above the Establishing Dao Realm, there was no endpoint.
What a grand opportunity this was for Blood Demon, how could he miss it, he would do everything possible to seize hold of it.
This was his only chance to surpass Taicang, to transcend the Divine Venerate of Imperishable Temple.
Once he became a powerful figure of the Establishing Dao Realm, even more than that, the Divine Venerate of Imperishable Temple would have to kneel down and pay homage to him.
At this moment, Blood Demon envisioned the day when he would be sitting high in the Imperishable Temple, with that supreme being groveling below, knocking his head in flattery before him.
"Just wait, once I, Blood Demon, rise, I will show you ignorant fools the power of Daozu's disciples!"
At this moment, Blood Demon deemed the powerful ones of the Imperishable Temple as nothing more than ignorant frogs!
At this moment, Blood Demon was convinced that he would definitely become a disciple of Daozu!
I take pride in being a Disciple of Daozu!!
...
Far away from Taicang Domain, in the remote Land of Chaotic Imperishable, an ancient and majestic palace silently stood.
Around the front and back, and to each side of this temple, a giant ferocious beast was crouching, their aura fierce, and the malevolence in their eyes looked out in all directions.
The True Spirits of the Imperishable Temple, and these four True Spirits were even stronger than the Minor Heaven and Earth Masters.
The temple was ancient and majestic, standing quietly in the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, with a faint aura of Principle circulating around it.
Within tens of thousands of miles of the temple, no True Spirits were visible, no Imperishable True Spirits dared to approach within ten thousand miles of the temple.
At the moment, the temple was slowly moving, stirring up the Imperishable Qi, and the violent Spiritual Energy swirled violently into the temple.
In one part of the temple, a blood pool bubbled, and the blood within rippled as the bubbles burst.
Gurgle!
The blood of the blood pool began to retract, and a figure with a fierce face, fangs at the corners of its mouth, and a sinister gaze emerged from below the blood pool.
The blood flowed into its body, and the fierce countenance gradually vanished, transforming into that of a middle-aged man.
At the moment, the man's sinister eyes displayed excitement and zeal.
"Daozu? A great opportunity indeed, must seize it, and no need to bother with the affairs of Taicang Domain."
Blood Demon, exhilarated while receiving the consciousness of Blood Soul, was all excited.
Originally planning for a long time, growing countless years of Blood Soul, relying on the initial seed to descend into Taicang in order to capture some of Taicang's Domain Origin at the final moment, while also seeking the backups set up by Taicang to prevent the direct explosion of Taicang Domain at the last moment and failing Imperishable Temple's schemes.
However, an accident occurred, and Blood Soul unexpectedly descended into an unknown Domain, inhabiting someone's body.
This Domain, its strength beyond imagination.
That Daozu was even unimaginably strong, he couldn't even find words to describe Daozu's strength.
Even more coincidentally, he met an unusual Herb Collector and had the chance to become a disciple of Daozu, practicing that Great Technique.
In front of Daozu, the ones from Imperishable Temple were less than ants.
No matter what, such an opportunity must not be missed!
"Enhance the Divine Spirit Soul Force, huh?"
Blood Demon took a deep breath, the blood in the blood pool had all entered his body, he gently closed his eyes, connecting with Blood Soul.
With Blood Soul as the guide, the Divine Spirit Soul Force should be able to descend over there!
Through the connection, even the pain endured by Blood Soul felt intimately real to Blood Demon, but this did not make him doubt; instead, he believed even more firmly that this was a test, a test from the strong to the weak upon initiation!

chapters.title: Chapter 995 - 515 I Take Pride in Being a Disciple of Daozu, Burying a Divine Venerate_2
chapters.content:
```
Just like him, when selecting disciples, conditions are set, and it is only after passing the thresholds he has established that one can become his disciple.
"Strong individuals all share commonalities."
Blood Demon took a deep breath and began to operate the secret technique, using the child soul as a guide to transfer the Divine Soul Force.
Let alone the Great Wilderness Domain, which lay far away, unknowable in its location, even transferring Divine Soul Force to the Taicang Domain was not easy, and the pressure borne by the Divine Soul was substantial.
Therefore, each transfer of Divine Soul Force was necessarily limited.
"But that's enough!"
Blood Demon believed firmly that, by transferring Divine Soul Force every day and enhancing the child soul's strength, he would surely meet the required standard within the agreed time.
Hum!
A ripple of bloodlight shimmered, setting off ripples, as a strand of Divine Soul Force, guided by the child soul, was transferred.
In that moment, Blood Demon felt immense pressure; the strand of Divine Soul Force weakened continuously after being sent, and even ultimately lost connection with him, only to be confirmed successful when the child soul finally received it.
But, through the connection with the child soul, less than one-tenth of the transmitted Divine Soul Force was received.
"Great Wilderness Domain, where exactly are you, that the transmission of Divine Soul Force is so incredibly depleted?"
Blood Demon lamented in his heart.
That the child soul had received only one-tenth of the Divine Soul Force.
"Continue!"
Undeterred, Blood Demon knew that even though the child soul only received a tenth of the force each time, slowly accumulating it would be enough to enhance the child soul to meet the requirements.
"It can only be strengthened by three times at the most; otherwise, the origin of the child soul won't withstand it, and it's also easy to leak, potentially exposed to prying."
Thought Blood Demon silently, but even an enhancement by three times was enough to meet the conditions.
Far away within the Imperishable Temple, as Blood Demon was transferring Divine Soul Force, Su Lingxiu had already returned to Qinghua City.
After briefing her master about her plans and how she outwitted Blood Demon, she said, "Master, I want to go and capture that part of Blood Extreme's Remnant Soul to see if I can create a pill mimicking the Open Heaven Purple Light."
"Go, then!"
Li Xuan nodded but added with a reminder, "Illusions can sometimes be very useful, able to confuse one's perception, consciousness, and thought."
Su Lingxiu paused for a moment, deep in thought, "But what kind of illusion could possibly perplex Blood Demon?"
Li Xuan smiled cryptically, "Combine the inside with the outside, and you can naturally transform perception and consciousness."
A flash of insight struck Su Lingxiu's mind; excitedly she said, "Thank you, Master, I've got some ideas now; I'll discuss a feasible plan with Tian Zi."
Li Xuan nodded, then looked up at the firmament. Blood Demon was transferring Divine Soul Force over, using Blood Soul as a guide and circumventing the Dao Principles of the Taicang Domain, but he could not ultimately escape detection.
Of course, he couldn't escape the notice of Tian Zi either.
Su Lingxiu bid her master farewell and prepared to set off for the Taikun Realm. This was her first time leaving Qinghua State since coming to the Divine Realm.
"Senior Sister, are you going to the Taikun Realm?"
After his breakthrough, upon hearing that Su Lingxiu was heading for the Taikun Realm to capture the remaining Remnant Soul of Blood Extreme, Jiang Buping came to her.
"I'm familiar with the Taikun Realm; let me accompany you, Senior Sister."
"Then I'll trouble you, Junior Brother."
Su Lingxiu was delighted and nodded.
After saying farewell to her master, Su Lingxiu and Jiang Buping immediately set off for the Taikun Realm to capture the remaining Remnant Soul of Blood Extreme.
They passed through the Nine Mountains Realm.
Red Cat came prancing up, eager to please, offering various Divine Medicines it had gathered.
"Red Cat, you are quite impressive now."
Su Lingxiu ruffled Red Cat's head.
"Here, take this!"
She gave Red Cat a few bottles of pills, saying, "It should enhance the strength of your Demon Soldiers and Demon Generals."
Crossing the Nine Mountains Realm, they continued on their way to the Taikun Realm. Along the journey, Jiang Buping couldn't help but marvel at how much the Divine Realm had changed; it was no longer as it was at the beginning.
Back when he first traveled through the Divine Realm, encountering an Immortal Heavenly Venerable was no small feat; now, even warriors of the Heavenly Union Realm were commonly met, and those of the Immortal Realm were even more widespread.
```
Every martial artist with ambition was actively seizing this transformative period of the world to seek opportunities and enhance their strength as much as possible.
Taikun Realm, one of the major domains in the Divine Realm, had not been entirely ruled by the Jiang Family of Taikun. However, with the arrival of the Supreme Sovereign of the Taikun Realm from the Dao Domain, all forces within the Taikun Realm had now attached themselves to the Jiang Family!
Su Lingxiu and Jiang Buping arrived in the Taikun Realm and began searching for that part of the Remnant Soul according to the location given by Blood Extreme.
The place where Blood Extreme was initially confined was a wilderness within the Taikun Realm, but the original wilderness had changed with the transformation of the world.
The wilderness was no longer desolate but now sprouted grass and trees, among which Spiritual Medicine started to grow.
As they reached the former wilderness, more lower-level martial artists from the Taikun Realm began to come searching for Spiritual Medicine, and the desolate place gradually buzzed with activity.
They even built a small city.
"It should be in this direction, even with changes, it won't be too drastic. Blood Extreme's Remnant Soul is deeply hidden and might have already broken free from the seals," Su Lingxiu said, looking into the distance.
"That Supreme Sovereign from the Jiang Family has not found Blood Extreme's Remnant Soul to this day, which means that the Remnant Soul has escaped its bonds and is hiding," Jiang Buping said with a smile, "Senior Sister needn't worry, finding it is not difficult as long as the Remnant Soul is still here. It will just take a little more time. With my ability, it can't hide from me."
Su Lingxiu giggled, "Little Brother, you underestimate your Senior Sister. Although I rarely contend with others, these eyes are very powerful. Blood Extreme's Remnant Soul can't escape the observation of my Minor Heavenly Eye."
The two continued on their way, occasionally encountering martial artists who were gathering Spiritual Medicine.
"That's a Divine Venerate Realm Warrior,"
Su Lingxiu noted, observing a warrior who flew past in the distance.
"It seems that the Supreme Sovereign from the Jiang Family is in a hurry and has started enlisting Divine Venerate Warriors to search for Blood Extreme,"
They continued onward, drawing ever closer to Blood Extreme's hiding place.
Suddenly, a figure descended.
The newcomer was a Divine Venerate Realm Warrior, holding a folding fan in his hand, dressed in white from head to toe, with a youthful, handsome face devoid of whiskers, giving an impression of excessive indulgence.
At that moment, the Divine Venerate's eyes widened in astonishment as he gazed intently at Su Lingxiu, his expression growing increasingly joyful as he gulped.
"I am the White-clothed Divine Venerate from the Dao Realm. Would you care to join me and return to the Dao Realm by my side?"
The White-clothed Divine Venerate's demeanor was quite frivolous, his eyes fixed on Su Lingxiu without blinking.
Su Lingxiu's expression darkened, "Beat it!"
"What a fiery temperament, I like it, I really like it," the White-clothed Divine Venerate enthused, "In my travels across the Dao Realm, I have met many beautiful women, but none compare to you.
Your aura is like the natural grace of plants, like the dew of early morning, pure and flawless. Simply delightful, truly the finest I've seen in my life. Since we're fated to meet, you might as well accompany me..."
The White-clothed Divine Venerate snapped his fan shut, his face still beaming with joy as he scrutinized Su Lingxiu more intently, his Adam's apple bobbing continuously.
However, before he could finish his thought, Su Lingxiu had already picked up a shovel and charged at him.
"Granny hasn't buried anyone in a long time. Today, I'll bury a Divine Venerate to scratch that itch!"
Clang!
Before the White-clothed Divine Venerate could react, his head was struck by a shovel, and he crashed to the ground, his head buzzing and Divine Soul trembling.
"You..."
The White-clothed Divine Venerate was shocked, having stumbled upon an unexpected challenge!
Clang! Su Lingxiu struck another blow with her shovel onto the Divine Venerate's head and then began to dig rapidly on the ground with her hands fluttering swiftly, astonishing Jiang Buping by her dexterity and speed.
"Think being a Divine Venerate is great? Today I'll bury you!"
Su Lingxiu lifted the dazed White-clothed Divine Venerate and threw him into the large pit.
At that moment, as the White-clothed Divine Venerate shook his head, trying to regain his senses, he raised his head only to be met with a descending shovel.
He considered resisting, but his Divine Soul was in turmoil, rendering him powerless.
Clang! Clang! Clang!
As Su Lingxiu shoveled dirt and continued to hit the White-clothed Divine Venerate, with every handful of soil, he screamed in agony as portions of his Divine Soul seemed to peel off and dissolve into the earth with the falling dirt!
In panic, he wished to beg for mercy, but there was no chance at all.
The shovel clanged relentlessly while clods of earth rained down, stripping away his Divine Soul continuously. Reduced to screams, he couldn't utter any other sound.

chapters.title: Chapter 996 - 516: The Main Soul of Blood Extreme, The Scheme of Heavenly Slaughter
chapters.content:
Jiang Buping watched his usually graceful and gentle senior sister, who had now transformed into a fierce witch, swinging a shovel, smashing at the White-clothed Divine Venerate while burying him with soil.
Unable to stop his face from breaking into a cold sweat, he realized he had been wrong!
His sister was not as gentle and refined as she appeared on the surface. When she became ferocious, she was not the slightest bit inferior to him!
"Of all people to provoke, it had to be my senior sister!"
Jiang Buping watched the White-clothed Divine Venerate's pitiful screams and shook his head with a sigh.
"Is this a unique burial technique created by my sister?"
Watching Su Lingxiu's special way of burying someone, it wasn't simply interring them into the earth. Instead, she was scattering a person's Divine Soul and vitality, sprinkling them across the dirt.
Once the vitality and the Divine Soul were completely dissipated, only an empty shell would remain, which would soon decay and ultimately turn into dust.
"I will teach you not to be frivolous, to stop being so full of yourself. Did you really think this lady had no temper?"
Su Lingxiu continued to beat and bury the body, her movements skilled and her speed extremely fast.
The screams of the White-clothed Divine Venerate grew weaker, his skin slackened, an image of decrepitude, like a candle flickering in the wind.
At this moment, the gaze of the White-clothed Divine Venerate was filled with despair and fear, looking up at the girl covering him with soil as if she were a peerless witch. Where was that aura of natural beauty and unblemished purity?
He regretted why he had fixated on this girl, but when he first saw her, her peerless beauty and unique temperament had deeply attracted him!
Thump!
Darkness enveloped him as the soil completely covered his head.
His vitality was slipping away, and his feeble Divine Soul was dissipating.
Su Lingxiu finished filling the large pit, jumped up, and stomped on the soil a few times, then dusted off her hands, her face filled with the excitement of having done something she enjoyed.
"Junior brother, let's go!"
With the shovel tucked away, Su Lingxiu continued on their way in a great mood.
"Coming!"
Jiang Buping hurried to catch up. The soil where the Divine Venerate was buried became rich with life. In just a moment, fresh green grass sprouted and was rapidly growing.
Soon after, that area had transformed into Spiritual Medicine, and was continuing to evolve.
The buried Divine Venerate was not only dead, but in a short time, even his bones had turned into nutrients for these Spiritual Medicines.
In not much time, this spot would grow a batch of Divine Medicine, among which would not be lacking those that could nourish the Divine Soul.
"This is the place."
Having arrived at the location Blood Extreme mentioned, Su Lingxiu looked down and said with a smile, "Blood Extreme, that guy, is really cunning and quite good at hiding, just staying here without leaving. The Supreme Sovereign of the Jiang Family hasn't even noticed him."
This was where Jiang Feng had imprisoned Blood Extremity Remnant Soul.
And though Blood Extreme wasn't in the original spot where he was confined, he hadn't left, instead burrowing underneath the original spot and hiding inside a rock.
This rock, concealed by thick soil, cloaked its uniqueness. Even with thick soil separating them, even a Supreme Sovereign wouldn't notice the stone's peculiarity.
Blood Extreme's Remnant Soul was hiding within the stone, using the stone's unique properties to mask the Remnant Soul, and that was why the Supreme Sovereign of the Jiang Family couldn't detect it.
However, this couldn't fool Su Lingxiu and Jiang Buping.
"To be cautious and avoid him destroying himself, we should still use some techniques," Su Lingxiu said.
A cluster of fine green needles appeared in Su Lingxiu's hand, full of vitality and yet capable of integrating into all things without leaving a trace.
With a wave of her hand, the fine needles instantly disappeared underground, piercing into the soil around the stone, unnoticed by the Blood Extreme Remnant Soul inside.
"Sister, I'll just restrain his Divine Soul directly; once I do, even if he wanted to self-destruct, he wouldn't be able to," Jiang Buping said.
"Junior brother, just watch Sister's technique!"
Su Lingxiu produced a jar and opened the lid, turning it upside down.
Hum!
The fine needles that had pierced around the stone lost their vitality in an instant, and at the same moment, the stone had already entered the jar.
"This is another use of my Life and Death Inverse Divine Skills, junior brother, what do you think?" Su Lingxiu said, tilting her head back in pride.
"Sister's Divine Skills are indeed extraordinary!" Jiang Buping exclaimed.
At that moment, the stone in the jar stirred, and a hint of cautious blood light peeked out.
"Blood Extreme, you've been caught. Just stay put," Su Lingxiu said cheerfully.
Thump!
