Blood light surged out from the stone, revealing Blood Extreme's appearance, but unlike the other parts of the Remnant Soul, this one faintly contained a trace of purple.
"You…"
Blood Extreme looked shocked, his deep hiding place having been discovered.
"How is that other part of my Divine Soul?" he asked with a grave expression.
The part of the Divine Soul he had separated from, although stronger than this fragment in soul force, was not the core. The core was indeed this part of the soul.
Having sensed that his other part was captured, he was aware, but he did not know the method the captor used to prevent the soul from self-destructing.
Even later on, his connection to that part of the soul felt severed, as if it had disappeared.
This relieved him because although the loss of that soul part was devastating and damaged his essence, at least this part of the Remnant Soul was preserved.
However, without any awareness, he had been caught and was now inside this jar, having a premonition that he couldn't self-destruct!
This greatly alarmed Blood Extreme.
"Doing well indeed, and soon you'll be able to get back that part of your Divine Soul," Su Lingxiu replied with a giggle.
Looking at Blood Extreme inside the jar, everything was as expected: the core of Blood Extreme's soul was also affected by the Open Heaven Purple Light.

chapters.title: Chapter 997 - 516: The Main Soul of Blood Extreme, The Scheme of Heavenly Slaughter_2
chapters.content:
```
Therefore, if this part of the Divine Soul were to disappear, Blood Extreme in the other jar would sense it and even be affected.
"Stop resisting. Maybe this is your opportunity,"
Having achieved her objective in Taikun Realm, Su Lingxiu couldn't wait to return, especially since the Blood Demon's Divine Soul was waiting for her.
After capturing the core of Blood Extreme's Divine Soul, an idea suddenly struck Su Lingxiu on how to deceive Blood Demon—a scheme she believed Blood Extreme would be quite eager to partake in.
Back in Qinghua state, Su Lingxiu immediately entered the secret chamber and placed the two jars together.
"You're finally here,"
Seeing the core of the Divine Soul captured, the remaining Remnant Soul became excited.
As for Blood Extreme, his heart sank; the part of the Remnant Soul he had split away seemed to have developed a consciousness beyond his original intent.
In a sense, he had been betrayed by the other part of his Divine Soul.
Instead of fusing the two parts of Blood Extreme instantly, Su Lingxiu started to study the core Divine Soul of Blood Extreme, particularly the part associated with Open Heaven Purple Light.
She even wanted to attempt extracting a wisp of Open Heaven Purple Light.
After several days of research, Su Lingxiu found it impossible to extract the Open Heaven Purple Light. Even if she refined this part of Blood Extreme's Divine Soul, she couldn't obtain the Open Heaven Purple Light. However, she could grasp some of its essence, which might be what Jiang Feng needed.
Su Lingxiu had no intention to refine Blood Extreme's Divine Soul. Instead, using it as a reference and with Heaven and Earth Laws and Rhythms of Domain as the main ingredients, she created a Pill that contained some essence of Open Heaven Purple Light.
After completing her research, Su Lingxiu hurried to the Great Wilderness, whereas Tian Zi had already begun to capture the Divine Spirit Soul Force sent by Blood Demon.
Inside the Soul Concealing Jar, a mass of blood light had accumulated. This was the Divine Spirit Soul Force of a Master of Heaven and Earth Realm, far beyond the capability of minor Heaven and Earth Master like Blood Extreme.
"How's it going?"
Su Lingxiu asked excitedly.
"Almost there. The Blood Soul is nearing its limit. That guy Blood Demon should be about to stop transmitting the Divine Spirit Soul Force soon,"
Tian Zi was also brimming with excitement.
While Su Lingxiu and Tian Zi were plotting against Blood Demon, outside the Domain, the situation had already changed.
The five Blood Lords of the Netherworld Domain suddenly retreated, ending the confrontation.
The Seductive Witch and her six companions also withdrew.
Ao Lie, Jiang Feng, and others exchanged a look with Heavenly Slaughter and remained silent.
Heavenly Slaughter and the Seductive Witch had come to an agreement in secret; everyone understood it to some extent, but the exact terms of their deal remained unknown.
"Heavenly Slaughter, the interests of Taicang Domain must not be compromised. We won't back down,"
One Realm Master said in a firm voice.
Heavenly Slaughter smiled and replied, "Everyone, a crisis is upon us. The Seductive Witch and her companions are strong, and although Witch Demon Domain is weakened, it still possesses fighting strength. Should the need arise, pouring all of the Witch Demon Domain's power might just alter the course of battle,"
Continuing with a solemn expression, Heavenly Slaughter said, "I understand no one wants to be subservient to others, but if the Domain ceases to be, what's the point? In the Dao Realm of the Three Hundred Realms, I, Heavenly Slaughter, occupy several Realms. I will offer two of my Realms for a collaboration with Witch Demon, without harming your interests."
Jiang Feng and others fell silent. Although Heavenly Slaughter offered his territories to Seductive Witch and her people, it ultimately changed the power structure of Taicang Domain.
"I've agreed to let the Witch Demon Domain's power erupt instantly at a critical moment, to block the enemy."
"Without their own Domain, they need a place to settle. Is giving away two of my Realms too much?"
"If you think Heavenly Slaughter will gain more support because of this, feel free to offer your territories in exchange with Witch Demon,"
Heavenly Slaughter said, looking at the Realm Masters.
"If Witch Demon's group has such dedication, it is only right to provide them a place to reside,"
Jiang Feng said with a smile, then turned and left.
Ao Lie said nothing and also departed.
Seeing this, the other Realm Masters tacitly acceded to what Heavenly Slaughter had done; after all, if Heavenly Slaughter gained the support of the seven people of Seductive Witch and became too powerful, they could join forces to counterbalance him.
All Realm Masters returned to Dao Realm.
Heavenly Slaughter chuckled and strode towards the distant Witch Demon Domain, ready to discuss some details.
The Seductive Witch seemed in a hurry to enter Taicang Domain—was there someone there she detested to the bone?
"Xiaoyao, you have gained another enemy,"
Heavenly Slaughter thought to himself.
"Heavenly Slaughter, since we have reached an agreement, we will definitely support you. There's no time to delay; we should enter Taicang Domain now."
As soon as Heavenly Slaughter arrived at Witch Demon Domain, the Seductive Witch spoke firmly.
"Anytime is fine, but my condition needs to change,"
Heavenly Slaughter said gravely, looking at Witch Demon Domain.
"Are you going back on your word?"
```
The Seductive Witch's faces suddenly darkened.
"No!"
Heavenly Slaughter shook his head and said, "My goal is to become the Master of the Taicang Domain. Even if I cannot completely control all the authority of the Taicang Domain, I must control more than seventy percent. Only then will I have enough confidence to face the impending crisis."
The Flame Demon's eyebrows furrowed as he said, "The Taicang Domain is quite special; are you sure you have the ability to become its Master?"
"I have an eighty percent chance of success. I was originally planning to scheme slowly, but there is no time left now. I have to use another method to control the Domain Authority. As long as you are willing to make a move and restrain some people for me, that's enough."
"Additionally, the Witch Demon Domain is not for resisting external enemies but for crashing into the Taicang Domain at the necessary moment!"
By the end of his statement, Heavenly Slaughter's expression had become solemn.
The Seductive Witches' expressions changed.
"Heavenly Slaughter, have you gone mad?"
Force Demon cried out in shock.
"Only with Unity of Domain can one control the Domain Authority. I, Heavenly Slaughter, have this ability."
The crashing of the Witch Demon Domain into the Taicang Domain is no trivial matter. A single misstep could even lead to the destruction of the Taicang Domain. If that were to happen, it would be even more difficult to deal with the impending crisis.
"Heavenly Slaughter, this matter is of great importance. We need to confirm that you truly have this ability before we can assist you. Moreover, the conditions for our help need to be renegotiated."
The Seductive Witch said with a stern expression.
Heavenly Slaughter raised his hand, and in his palm, a purple pearl was exuding a unique aura of Dao Rhythms. Light flowed within the pearl and Dao Principles circled around it, resembling a miniaturized Domain landscape.
"What is this?"
The Seductive Witches all focused intently, as the purple pearl was no ordinary object, and it seemed to have an unusual connection with the Taicang Domain.
"This is my reliance. Do you understand now?"
Heavenly Slaughter said, putting away the pearl.
"So that's how it is. Did you obtain the contingency of the Taicang predecessor?"
Duowu said with a hint of envy.
"Since that's the case, let's proceed as you've said. However, besides the Minor Heaven and Earth, we need to establish that the Taicang Domain can accommodate our Witch Demon clan!"
The Seductive Witch said with a deep voice, "The Taicang Domain shall have a place for the Witch Demons!"
Heavenly Slaughter nodded and said, "As the Master of Domain, naturally I won't reject the Witch Demons. This is also beneficial to strengthen the Domain. I agree!"
"If that's the case, then let's do as you say."
The Seductive Witches nodded in agreement.
"Now, let's begin the arrangement. Draw the Witch Demon Domain close to the Taicang, and wait for my manipulation."
Heavenly Slaughter said with a smile.
"No problem!"
The Seductive Witches nodded and agreed.
Heavenly Slaughter began to set up in the Witch Demon Domain, and the Seductive Witches started preparing to shift to the Taicang Domain.
To enter the Taicang Domain, one must have a Domain token for guidance, or else such a large number of Witch Demons would be repelled by the Taicang Daoism.
After the Battle of Domain, Taicang's Dao Principles were altered to prevent the invasion of enemies from beyond.
This was not something that could be accomplished overnight.
"Heavenly Slaughter, where is Xu Yan?"
The Seductive Witch found Heavenly Slaughter, who was arranging things, and asked with a barely concealed murderous aura.
Heavenly Slaughter raised an eyebrow, "Do you have a feud with him?"
"Yes, I have deep hatred for him and his disciple!"
The Seductive Witch said through gritted teeth; at this moment, there was not a trace of seductive charm about her, only a fierce rage.
"If you want to take revenge on Xiaoyao and his disciple, you can wait a while longer. I also have some matters to discuss with him," Heavenly Slaughter said with a smile.
"Xiaoyao? Xu Yan's master is Xiaoyao?"
The Seductive Witch said in surprise.
"Yes!"
Heavenly Slaughter nodded.
"Xiaoyao, wait for me!"
The Seductive Witch grimaced. This bastard was somewhat capable. The sword that had invaded her body hadn't been expelled yet, and up to now, it didn't seem to act up or lose its effect—perhaps she had suppressed it.

chapters.title: Chapter 998 - 517: Taikun and Taihe, the Battle of the Realm Master
chapters.content:
Outside the Domain, the Witch Demon Domain began to move closer to the Taicang Domain, and all the Realm Masters of the Dao Realm were merely watching silently.
Since an agreement had been reached, it was natural to move closer to the Taicang Domain to utilize the full power of the Witch Demon Domain to resist the enemy at a critical moment.
Xu Yan looked up beyond the Domain. Due to the restrictions of the Domain Dao Rule, aside from Realm Master Realm experts, other Martial Artists in the Taicang Domain could not transcend the Domain and enter the Land of Imperishable.
Thus, Xu Yan could not leave the Taicang Domain to enter the Land of Imperishable either.
"Witch Demon? The Seductive Witch isn't planning to enter Taicang, is she?"
Xu Yan muttered to himself.
Honestly, the Seductive Witch had helped him a bit by giving him some treasures.
"I wonder where that piece of Jade Bamboo from the Seductive Witch is."
Xu Yan continued to mutter to himself. The tiny branch of Jade Bamboo alone was already extraordinary; a complete piece of Jade Bamboo would be even more so, definitely a Supreme Treasure.
Moreover, that Jade Bamboo seemed to be related to one of the Seven Great Domain Masters, the Master of the Qingling Realm, and was also known as the Qingling Jade Bamboo!
Xu Yan continued to perceive the Domain Origin, although his comprehension in the Creation Realm seemed to have hit a bottleneck.
But his understanding of the Domain Realm was about to achieve minor achievement.
As time passed, the Seductive Witch and others began to enter the Taicang Domain, and for a moment, the Dao Realm became lively.
The two divisions of Heavenly Slaughter were enough to settle the Martial Artists from the Witch Demon Domain, as the beings from the Witch Demon Domain were not numerous to begin with.
The broken Domain's Dao Principles were decaying, and too many newly born beings would further deplete the Domain's resources; the Seductive Witch and others had long been deliberately suppressing their numbers.
But it was precisely because of this that the Witch and Demon beings of the Witch Demon Domain had a somewhat higher base strength, having cultivated for a longer period.
The two divisions of Heavenly Slaughter were divided into two, one being the Demon Realm and the other the Witch Realm, and in a sense, also served to distinguish the Witch and Demon beings of the Witch Demon Realm.
"It's quite lively."
Li Xuan silently watched the creatures of the Witch Demon Domain moving to the Taicang Domain, without intervening.
Tian Zi also revealed a smile. The more powerhouses and beings there were in the Taicang Domain, the more beneficial it was for him as the Heavenly Dao.
"If we were to devour the Witch Demon Domain and incorporate it into Taicang, the Taicang Domain could quickly advance further."
Tian Zi muttered in his heart.
He felt a bit regretful that he temporarily had no way to incorporate the Witch Demon Domain even though he had commandeered the entire Domain, becoming the complete Heavenly Dao of the Taicang Domain; he still needed some assistance to incorporate the Witch Demon Domain.
"Blood Demon, quite interesting."
Tian Zi shifted his attention back to Blood Demon.
Taikun Realm.
In front of a mottled stone platform, Jiang Feng stood quietly.
"Master, the Seductive Witch and others have already entered Taicang."
A somewhat weary voice came from the stone platform.
"Has the situation reached this stage? Feng'er, if Taicang cannot be preserved, take that hand and escape into the Land of Imperishable, following the direction I gave you, try to survive as long as you can."
The weary voice sighed.
"Yes, Master!"
Jiang Feng nodded his head, fell silent for a moment, then added, "Master, Blood Extreme's Remnant Soul might have disappeared."
"If it's gone, then it's gone."
Taikun said indifferently.
"But Blood Extreme's Divine Soul still contains a hint of Open Heaven Purple Light essence, perhaps it could help Master escape his old injuries?"
Jiang Feng said, somewhat reluctantly.
"Difficult! Simply a hint of Open Heaven Purple Light essence is not enough to help your master recover. Don't worry about it anymore, wait for the grand battle to commence, and your master will help you escape."
Taikun said with a smile.
Sadness appeared in Jiang Feng's eyes. He remained silent for a long time before saying, "Master, what about Heavenly Slaughter? Is he really able to obtain Domain Authority?"
After a long silence, Taikun's voice finally emerged from the stone platform. "I don't know where he gets his confidence from. While Heavenly Slaughter can't do it, Big Brother Taicang indeed left this opportune condition for the Master of Domain. However, it hasn't appeared yet and likely encountered some mishap."
"Moreover, that guy Tian Zi is still not dead. It's not so easy to gain his approval."
"Actually, since Big Brother Taicang died, there has been no hope for this Domain. It has survived so long solely because of Big Brother Taicang.
"Even if another Taicang Domain Master emerges, it won't be able to withstand."
Jiang Feng was silent.
The stone platform shook a bit, and a scroll flew out.
"After such a long period of sedimentation and organization, I've barely drawn this map. This is the Land of Imperishable that your Master once traversed, includes your Master's birthplace."
"Once you enter the Land of Imperishable, follow it to explore the Land of Imperishable, return to your Master's birthplace, and according to the method your Master told you, try to find where Big Brother Taicang was born. Perhaps you will find some opportunities."
"If indeed you find some opportunities and you become powerful enough, think about taking revenge, otherwise give up the thought of vengeance."
Taikun seemed to be making his final arrangements as he rambled on.
"Master!"
Jiang Feng choked up.
He came from humble beginnings, orphaned in his youth, and then fortuitously met his master, who was wandering the Domain. From then on, he embarked on the path of a strong being, eventually becoming a Realm Master in charge of the Taikun Realm!
"Go, prepare for the impending crisis. Taihe probably has a similar arrangement for Cang Lie. You can join Cang Lie, at least having a fellow to support each other."
Taikun's voice became even more weary.
Jiang Feng nodded, about to turn and leave, when suddenly he thought of something and added, "Master, Heavenly Slaughter has joined forces with Ao Lie, apparently targeting Xiaoyao, the Realm Master, who is scheming something in the Divine Realm. Should we intervene to help Xiaoyao?"

chapters.title: Chapter 999 - 517: Taikun and Taihe, Battle of the Realm Masters_2
chapters.content:
```
"Xiaoyao? Isn't he supposed to be lazy and carefree, indifferent to life and death, what is he scheming now? Feng'er, you need not worry about it, Xiaoyao will naturally have someone to assist him, and besides, Xiaoyao isn't someone that people like Heavenly Slaughter can kill."
Taikun expressed his doubts.
"Yes, Master!"
Jiang Feng nodded and turned to leave.
Inside the stone platform, the aged Taikun, his face deeply wrinkled as if vitality was scarce, was surrounded by a gray aura that constantly eroded him.
As an ancient Minor Heaven and Earth Master, one of the earliest followers of Taicang, he had received the Open Heaven Purple Light, ranking among the top of all Minor Heaven and Earth Masters.
He had been a key participant in that war, even killing an expert at the Minor Heaven and Earth Master level from the Imperishable Temple.
In the ultimate battle, he saw with his own eyes and at the last moment, he charged into the fray wanting to fight to the death, yet he was affected by the aura of one from the Imperishable Temple and ended up in such a state.
Had it not been for that final push that ejected him from the battlefield, he most likely would have perished.
"Big brother Taicang, even if the Domain crumbles, I will not let your memory be forgotten."
Taikun murmured to himself.
In the Taihe Realm, also a great Dao Realm, the Taihe Realm is not governed by the ancient Minor Heaven and Earth Master Taihe, but by his direct disciple, Cang Lie.
Cang Lie, once called the eighth hero of Taicang by some Minor Heaven and Earth Masters, was rumored to have received guidance from Taicang.
"Master!"
At the base of a hill, Cang Lie respectfully saluted.
"Since the crisis has arrived and the Taicang Domain has reached its end, resistance is impossible. They haven't witnessed the ultimate battle, they can't understand."
Taihe's voice came from the hill.
"Once the crisis arrives, take that bone and flee to the Land of Imperishable."
A scroll flew out from the hill.
"This is drawn by your master, depicting the Land of Imperishable I once traveled, including my birthplace. I hope you can find it and not get lost in the Land of Imperishable."
"Most likely, Taikun has made similar arrangements. You can also join Jiang Feng; it's better to have company. Look for big brother Taicang's birthplace, perhaps there's a chance."
"If by chance, you become a Master of Heaven and Earth, able to create a Domain, don't forget Taicang, for that is your root!"
Taihe spoke solemnly.
"Yes, Master, your disciple will never forget Taicang!"
Cang Lie said respectfully.
In the Taimiao World, amidst the brilliant colors of myriad flowers, there seemed to stand a towering figure.
In a moment.
A soft sigh echoed, and the towering figure vanished.
A graceful figure emerged from the flowers in all their vibrancy, and as she passed, the flowers shattered like a fantasy. When she looked back upon leaving the area of vivid blossoms, they had already vanished, revealing their true state.
It was a place of ruins.
The ethereal woman, at a moment fierce as though a peerless sovereign.
"Master!"
Two figures rushed over and prostrated themselves, their voices full of surprise.
"Get up; you've had a hard time."
Taimiao looked at her two disciples—one with a haughty and domineering demeanor, the other seductive and dreamlike—the very students she tutored, one in the Illusionary Path and the other in the Supreme Sovereign Path.
Because of her dilemma, the two disciples had begun to oppose each other.
"Are Taikun and Taihe still around?"
Taimiao asked gently.
"Master, we haven't heard from them. Years ago, it was rumored that they had fallen. Now the Taikun Realm is governed by Jiang Feng, and the Taihe Realm by Cang Lie."
Taimiao was silent for a long time, lost in memories of the past years or perhaps mourning the friends once known.
In the Heavenly Slaughter Realm, the Seductive Witch arrived.
"Heavenly Slaughter, when are we going to settle the score with Xiaoyao? I can't wait any longer!"
"Soon, the preparations are already in motion. You must understand, Xiaoyao is after all the chief of the Taicang Seven Heroes. If we strike, it must be absolutely foolproof."
Heavenly Slaughter spoke with gravity.
"Waiting for your word!"
The Seductive Witch turned and left.
In the Earth Shadow Realm, from the depths of the abyss, a figure emerged silently, enveloped in mist and shadow.
His eyes turned towards the location of the Divine Realm, and with a step, he vanished without a trace, so stealthily that even ordinary Realm Masters couldn't detect him.
The Earth Shadow Realm Master stepped into the Divine Realm that day.
In the Yu Yao Realm.
"Cough, cough!"
A few light coughs sounded; the Yu Yao Realm Master suddenly opened his eyes and looked towards a certain place.
"Earth Shadow, you've finally shown yourself!"
With one step, she arrived outside the Yu Yao Realm.
"The Divine Realm, is it targeting Xiaoyao?"
Yu Yao let out a cold laugh, about to head to the Divine Realm when her expression suddenly changed, and she looked up.
Two masked men had blocked her way.
```
"Yu Yao Realm Master, better rest quietly and heal your wounds,"
someone said in a deep voice.
"Taicang, since when did you two join?"
Yu Yao's face darkened; these were two unfamiliar Realm Masters.
Although they were only minor Realm Masters, they were still Realm Masters after all.
"You two alone are not enough to stop me!"
Yu Yao Realm Master waved her hand, and a white light emerged, a slender blade shining with a sharp intent, cutting through the air in an instant.
Boom!
The battle of the Realm Masters erupted!
In the True Dragon Realm, a dragon's roar sounded as Ao Lie rushed straight for the Divine Realm.
Now that the Earth Shadow Realm and the Divine Realm had completely merged, and the Dao Realm and the Divine Realm were unifying, even experts from the Realm Master Realm could descend upon the Divine Realm.
The Dao Realm was instantly abuzz, with All Realm Masters stepping out to look toward the site of the great battle, some with solemn expressions, others silent.
"Yu Yao Realm Master, those other two, are they from Heavenly Slaughter? Unfamiliar Realm Masters; Heavenly Slaughter has kept a deep secret."
One Realm Master said with a cold laugh.
"Is this directed at Xiaoyao Realm Master?"
A Realm Master stepped forward, ready to descend upon the Divine Realm, only to be locked in by a force.
"Why bother with other people's affairs? It's best just to watch the games of the strong,"
another Realm Master said with a smile.
The rest of the Realm Masters fell silent at this moment and looked toward Taikun and the Taihe Realm.
What surprised them was that both Taihe and Taikun remained still and seemed not to intervene in the matter.
"Meng Chong, you dare to kill my son, and the followers of Xiaoyao should die!"
Suddenly, a roar came.
A Realm Master full of killing intent followed, descending toward the Divine Realm.
"That's Wan Tao Realm Master."
The news that Wan Tao Realm Master's son had been killed and his body destroyed had already spread, and these Realm Masters had all heard about it.
Xiaoyao's indulgence of his disciple, killing the son of a Realm Master, indeed broke the rules between them.
The battle between Realm Masters continued, and although Yu Yao Realm Master, one of the Taicang Seven Heroes, had yet to recover from her injuries, she still managed to fight against two other Realm Masters without falling behind.
However, she was also being held back.
In the Heavenly Slaughter Realm, a figure emerged, emitting a powerful aura that intimidated many strong beings.
It was indeed Heavenly Slaughter!
All the Realm Masters had a shiver run down their backs, as Heavenly Slaughter's strength was even greater than expected!
Heavenly Slaughter glanced in the direction of the Yu Yao Realm, then began walking step by step toward the Earth Shadow Realm, it was also time for a visit to the Divine Realm.
"The Seductive Witch is going to make a move?"
Seeing the figure of the Seductive Witch appear, a Realm Master's face changed as he spoke.
"It is said that the Seductive Witch holds a grudge against Xiaoyao!"
Following the Seductive Witch, Duowu, Li Witch, Flame Demon, Giant Demon, Tyrant Demon, and Scarlet Demon also stepped out one after another.
Boom!
Suddenly, everyone was startled and turned their eyes to the Taimiao World.
A figure emerged from the Taimiao World, ethereal and dreamlike, yet conveying an overwhelming sense of dominance.
The figure gave a cold laugh, raised a hand, and the Power of the Dao Principles surged forth, falling into his grasp. With a wave of his hand, he struck!
Boom!
The unrivaled blow descended in an instant upon one of the Realm Masters fighting against Yu Yao Realm Master.
His expression turned to panic as he hurriedly blocked; yet even with his efforts, he was blasted thousands of miles away.
Taking advantage of the situation, Yu Yao flickered, transforming into a beam of white light that instantly fleeted from the battlefield.
Heavenly Slaughter paused, watching Taimiao with a grave expression.
The rest of the Realm Masters looked on with grim expressions. Taimiao, the ancient Minor Heaven and Earth Master, had actually emerged from the Taimiao World. Was this an attempt to aid Xiaoyao Realm Master?
With one move, Taimiao's formidable strength was revealed.
"Stop her!"
Heavenly Slaughter said in a deep voice.
Duowu, Tyrant Demon, and Scarlet Demon stepped out, revealing their true forms in an instant.
Tyrant Demon had fierce horns and wide eyes with a nose like a broad snout, whiskers like steel needles, and a row of bone spurs on his back, emitting a low rumble.
Duowu opened her hundred eyes, reflecting the Domain.
The Scarlet Demon was engulfed in red, wrapped in a scarlet Demon Qi, and held a crimson Halberd in his hand.
"Taimiao, was there really a need for you to intervene?"
Scarlet Demon asked with a buzzing voice.
Taimiao remained coldly silent, evidently fearless, and launched an attack directly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1000 - 518: Xu Yan Gathers Treasures, The Grand Play is About to Begin
chapters.content:
Dao Realm, a great war erupted, and Taimiao alone battled Duowu, Scarlet Demon, and Tyrant Demon, yet he still did not show any signs of falling behind.
The moment Flame Demon's figure moved, ready to intercept Yu Yao, who would have thought, a flash of white light burst from Yu Yao, allowing her to cross the barrier between the Dao Realm and the Divine Realm without going through Earth Shadow Realm, directly descending into the Divine Realm.
Upon seeing this scene, Heavenly Slaughter also understood why Earth Shadow had failed back then, it was precisely at the critical moment, Yu Yao escaped from the Dao Realm.
"Taicang Disciple!"
Heavenly Slaughter murmured to himself.
Gaining such a hard-to-contain power, Yu Yao must have received a treasure from Taicang that allowed her to escape from the Dao Realm.
Heavenly Slaughter continued to advance, and the Seductive Witch became even more fiercely murderous, her eyes and brows showing no sign of seduction, only the intent to kill!
All Realm Masters kept their eyes on Taihe and Taikun Realm, yet there was no sign of activity from these two realms.
Jiang Feng did not come out, nor did Cang Lie.
The All Realm Masters were puzzled, were they really just going to watch Heavenly Slaughter grow unopposed, not joining hands to aid Xiaoyao Realm Master?
"Let's also go to the Divine Realm and see. Xiaoyao Realm Master is extremely powerful. We surely cannot afford to damage our vitality with internal strife at this time of crisis, right?"
One Realm Master suggested with a sigh.
"Let's go and see."
Among these Realm Masters, many had already secretly reached an agreement with Heavenly Slaughter, unknown to each other, all being mutually wary.
The battle between Taimiao, Duowu, Tyrant Demon, and Scarlet Demon continued, only that they had all started to exercise more restraint.
In the Dao Realm, in a certain treasure land, Xu Yan exhaled deeply, finally breaking through to the Minor Achievement of the Domain Realm.
"With my current strength, I fear no Supreme Sovereign."
Apart from Realm Master Realm Experts, or being heavily surrounded by Supreme Sovereign Warriors, he could now roam unimpeded.
Suddenly, Xu Yan sensed some fluctuations from a great battle.
"Such intense tremors, could it be a Realm Master's battle?"
Excited at the thought, Xu Yan left his seclusion silently.
"It really is a Realm Master's battle, but what has happened?"
Xu Yan concealed himself somewhere, quietly observing.
"They've all left!"
Seeing Heavenly Slaughter leave and also noticing the figures of the Seductive Witch and Flame Demon, it seemed they were all heading to the Divine Realm.
"Could they be after Master?"
Xu Yan's eyebrows shot up.
"Heavenly Slaughter has left, and so has the Seductive Witch. Has her Yu Zhu already arrived in Taicang?"
Since Heavenly Slaughter had departed and no Realm Master was presiding, he had no need for caution.
"Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow is Heavenly Slaughter's force. The previous targeting of me could also be counted on Heavenly Slaughter's head. It seems reasonable for me to move some treasures from the Heavenly Slaughter Realm, right? Consider it your protection fee, Heavenly Slaughter."
Xu Yan mumbled to himself.
Ah, the Heavenly Slaughter Realm, surely full of treasures. With none of the Supreme Sovereigns capable of hinderance and believing in the security of the realm's principles, Xu Yan was confident that his presence would go undetected in the Heavenly Slaughter Realm.
He then took out a Communication Talisman, contacted No. 73, and inquired about the situation in Heavenly Slaughter Realm as well as the whereabouts of its precious treasures.
In the Dao Realm, the Heavenly Slaughter Realm, majestic and full of strong warriors, commanded respect. Heavenly Slaughter had covertly subdued many weaker Realm Masters. Apart from a few large realms such as Taikun and Taihe, the other Realm Masters did not dare to confront Heavenly Slaughter directly.
Although Heavenly Slaughter had descended into the Divine Realm, and there was no Realm Master presiding in the Heavenly Slaughter Realm, those Supreme Sovereigns there were unconcerned.
With the strength of the Heavenly Slaughter Realm, there was no Supreme Sovereign daring enough to provoke them.
Other Realm Masters, valuing their status, naturally would not take this opportunity to make a move against the Heavenly Slaughter Realm. Moreover, the deterrence of Heavenly Slaughter was powerful; weaker Realm Masters dared not offend him, and stronger Realm Masters would not engage in such demeaning actions.
Moreover, there were unspoken rules among Realm Masters.
Therefore, within the Heavenly Slaughter Realm, those Supreme Sovereigns that should be cultivating in seclusion did so, those that should be handling affairs did just that, or waited for orders from Heavenly Slaughter.
No one knew that an uninvited guest had already entered the Heavenly Slaughter Realm.
Even No. 73, a Divine Venerate, did not know Xu Yan had already come in. He simply thought Xu Yan wanted to understand the internal situation of the Heavenly Slaughter Realm to prepare for future actions.
It was entirely unexpected that Xu Yan would enter the Heavenly Slaughter Realm at this moment.
"This is the place."
At a certain location in the Heavenly Slaughter Realm, Xu Yan's figure emerged, his face showing excitement.
"Heavenly Slaughter really is wealthy!"
He internally exclaimed, indeed befitting of a renowned and mighty Realm Master in the Dao Realm. The Heavenly Slaughter Realm was truly rich, with numerous Divine Medicines and an astonishing quantity of heavenly materials and earthly treasures.
In a moment, it seemed as if nothing in that place in the Heavenly Slaughter Realm had changed, still appearing as it always had, yet those heavenly materials and earthly treasures had already been swept clean by Xu Yan.
With the power of the Domain Realm, Xu Yan replicated the scene before him, then revealed it in this place, but it was a sham, not the real thing.
If not carefully scrutinized, it would definitely go undetected that the heavenly materials and earthly treasures here had disappeared.
Of course, it definitely could not deceive a Realm Master, and if Supreme Sovereign Warriors were a little more careful, they would also notice the flaws. But given the current situation in the Heavenly Slaughter Realm, those Supreme Sovereigns had never imagined that someone would come to scour for heavenly materials and earthly treasures.
Therefore, even if they came here, they would only glance and not take a closer look, thus overlooking and missing the discrepancy.
"It can be maintained for some time, but that's enough."
Xu Yan continued on to the next treasure spot, for with the nuances of the Domain Realm, replicating natural landscapes and revealing them couldn't last long as the power would slowly fade.
Furthermore, Xu Yan didn't intend to keep this replica of the natural landscape appearing for an extended period.

chapters.title: Chapter 1001 - 518: Xu Yan Gathers Treasures, The Grand Play is About to Begin_2
chapters.content:
Heavenly Slaughter Realm, a great thief entered, but the Supreme Sovereigns of the Heavenly Slaughter Realm remained clueless.
"Heavenly Slaughter is really wealthy, consider this your life-saving fee then," said the thief.
Xu Yan's heart was brimming with excitement.
"This is the place, once I've scoured here, I'll swing by the Seductive Witch's territory to see if the Qingling Jade Bamboo is there."
In a treasure vault of the Heavenly Slaughter Realm, this was the place where many Supreme Treasures of the Heavenly Slaughter Realm were stored, with a Supreme Sovereign Realm powerhouse in charge.
Without making a sound, Xu Yan had arrived behind the Supreme Sovereign in charge.
"Hum!"
All of a sudden, as if the mountains and rivers enveloped the earth, the surroundings were sealed without a ripple, and a sword thrust into the body of the Supreme Sovereign!
"You!"
The Supreme Sovereign turned pale with shock, his face etched with disbelief.
Someone had infiltrated to his back without his notice, something not even an Earth Shadow Supreme Sovereign could accomplish.
Only the Earth Shadow Realm Master would have such capability, but would the Earth Shadow Realm Master resort to such means to assassinate him, a Supreme Sovereign?
Moreover, the Earth Shadow Realm Master was not an enemy!
"There's another one!"
Xu Yan's gaze shifted to a certain spot, as the treasure vault was not only guarded by one Supreme Sovereign but another was secretly present—an Earth Shadow Supreme Sovereign, adept at concealment and hiding.
To a regular Supreme Sovereign Warrior, coming here might not reveal his presence.
"Hum!"
Xu Yan repeated his maneuver, easily dealing with this Supreme Sovereign, then effortlessly broke the vault's seals and entered the vault.
The Prime Tortoise Carapace emerged, and swept everything inside the vault with it, as Xu Yan promptly retreated.
The theft from the Heavenly Slaughter Realm wouldn't stay hidden for long, and he needed to obtain the Seductive Witch's Qingling Jade Bamboo before the news spread.
Silently leaving the Heavenly Slaughter Realm, he soon arrived at the Seductive Witch's dwelling realm.
"This Witch Realm is quite vast," Xu Yan marveled, wondering what kind of deal Heavenly Slaughter had struck with the Seductive Witch.
Upon entering the Witch Realm, "Over there lies Duowu's territory, here belongs to another, and the Seductive Witch's territory is in that direction."
Xu Yan did not go to Duowu's or Li Witch's territories but headed straight to the Seductive Witch's domain.
Pink flowers surrounded the area, and beautiful women were cultivating various Divine Medicines.
"These are the Seven Wonders Divine Flowers, quite a lot have been planted," remarked Xu Yan upon spotting a field of the Seven Wonders Divine Flowers.
He proceeded cautiously and arrived at a secluded valley where a jade-white pavilion tinged with pink stood within the vale.
The arrangement in the valley was enchanting at first glance.
The pavilion seemed to possess a natural Charm Power; any man arriving here would feel compelled to enter, falling under its spell and losing themselves within.
"The Seductive Witch resides here, bestowing upon the pavilion a natural Charm Power," Xu Yan mused, acknowledging the Seductive Witch's formidable charm, yet knowing it had no effect on him.
"This is... Qingling Jade Bamboo!"
After entering the valley, Xu Yan saw in the back of the pavilion a more than three-zhang-high bamboo, jade-white and flawless, its leaves tinged with a hint of green, its patterns profound as if embodying the Domain Dao Rule.
This bamboo grew in the crevice of a rock, not an ordinary one, as it contained a certain resonance within and constantly accumulated nature's spiritual energy and the essence of the earth.
The rock was placed in a pool, which was itself a treasure; the water in it was nature's spiritual energy liquefied.
"The small piece of Jade Bamboo I possess came from this very Qingling Jade Bamboo!"
Around where the Qingling Jade Bamboo was growing in the rock crevice, there were three short, tender offshoots, seemingly sprouted not long ago.
Additionally, in the pool, there were five other smaller Jade Bamboos growing, apparently transplanted there by the Seductive Witch, identical to the one Xu Yan held in his hands.
Clearly, there were originally six transplanted into the pool, with one now in Xu Yan's possession.
"Is the Seductive Witch cultivating this Qingling Jade Bamboo to advance further with its help in the future?" Xu Yan began to comprehend the Seductive Witch's intentions.
"I wonder if the Qingling Jade Bamboo could assist me in understanding the Creation Realm? Let's dig it up and see, but I have to be careful not to alert her subordinates."
Inside the pavilion, a Supreme Sovereign Realm warrior of the Witch Realm resided.
"Even if it can't help with understanding of the Creation Realm, what unexpected mysteries might it reveal if transplanted into my Domain?" Xu Yan pondered.
```
Moving silently towards the Qingling Jade Bamboo, intending to move it, the only option was to store it in the small domain within the Prime Tortoise Carapace.
"The Witch Realm Domain's laws haven't yet fallen under the control of the Seductive Witch, so even if the Domain's laws discover me, they won't alert the Seductive Witch and won't affect my actions; I just need to deceive those Supreme Sovereigns."
As long as the Jade Bamboo was in hand, even if those Supreme Sovereigns realized, he could withdraw calmly!
Xu Yan approached the Qingling Jade Bamboo, slowly releasing the Domain's power, replicating the scene of the Jade Bamboo and covering its original location.
With a wave of his hand, he directly moved the treasure that was the pool into the space within the Prime Tortoise Carapace.
Buzz!
Suddenly, the pool vibrated, sending out ripples, and a pink light emerged for an instant.
"That damn Seductive Witch, she actually had such an anti-theft measure!"
Xu Yan was somewhat helpless; now he was exposed.
"Who's there!"
Boom!
In the Jade Tower, a Supreme Sovereign Warrior arrived.
Xu Yan didn't pretend any longer. As he retracted the Prime Tortoise Carapace, he laughed heartily and said, "Sword God Xu Yan, I bid you farewell!"
Those several Witch Realm Supreme Sovereigns were stunned at that moment; the treasure of the Seductive Witch had disappeared, stolen!
"You're courting death, hand it over now!"
The Supreme Sovereigns, outraged and shocked, were about to surround him.
But Xu Yan took a step and vanished on the spot, traceless and formless.
Divine Skills, One Thought Traceless!
"I must escape quickly. The Seductive Witch is surely rushing back now; I can't let her corner me!" Xu Yan muttered to himself.
Using his Divine Skills, before the Witch Realm powerhouses could seal off the exit, he had already escaped from the Witch Realm first. Then he concealed his form and aura, heading straight for the Earth Shadow Realm.
The theft in the Heavenly Slaughter Realm would also soon be exposed. It was no longer safe to stay in the Dao Realm; he had to return to the Divine Realm, back to the Qinghua state.
In the Dao Realm, the battle between Taimiao and Duowu continued, but both had reduced the intensity of their fight. The three Duowu aimed to delay Taimiao, and Taimiao understood this as well.
At this moment, Xu Yan had no interest in watching the battle. With the Vanishing Thought Divine Ability, he quickly entered the Earth Shadow Realm. Taking the art of hiding to the extreme, he concealed himself somewhere within the Earth Shadow Realm, waiting for the opportunity to return to the Divine Realm.
...
"Witch Demon Domain, being so close to the Taicang Domain, could it be thinking of breaking into Taicang?"
Li Xuan looked up beyond the Domain, pondering to himself.
"If that's true, it's not necessarily a bad thing."
After thinking for a while, he then gave Tian Zi some guidance. Once the Witch Demon Domain truly collides with Taicang, how to seize the opportunity to envelop the entire Domain with the Heavenly Dao and fully activate the Taicang Domain.
By then, the Heavenly Dao would be perfected.
Tian Zi was not far from fully breaking free of his shackles, and the Heavenly Dao Rules were about to reach the Divine Realm.
Su Lingxiu was making progress in her research of the core Divine Soul of Blood Extreme, beginning the refinement of pills.
Progress was also made in deceiving the Blood Demon, and everything was developing according to plan.
One day, Li Xuan was engrossed in the records on the bamboo slips when he suddenly looked up towards the Taihe Realm, raising his eyebrows, "A Realm Master has come, sneaking and hiding—is it the Earth Shadow Realm Master?"
A Realm Master had come to the Divine Realm, and without showing any trace, it was clear there was an intention to sneak attack.
"Targeting me? No, it should be Old Man Xiao."
Li Xuan pondered for a moment. The Supreme Sovereigns from the outside worlds mistook Old Man Xiao for Xu Yan's master, the man behind the scenes, so they must be targeting Old Man Xiao.
Old Man Xiao, engrossed in comprehending the Heavenly Dao Qi, didn't care or pay any attention to being targeted.
"Huh, a battle between Realm Masters."
Li Xuan looked up at the Dao Realm, "Wu Tianan's Martial Arts guide eh? Things are getting interesting; is the big show about to begin?"
Heavenly Slaughter was about to take action.
"That dragon is also coming to the Divine Realm."
Li Xuan glanced at where Old Man Xiao was in seclusion. The characters from the Dao Realm were all targeting Old Man Xiao, who would undoubtedly feel wronged if he knew.
"Even Taimiao has made a move, is that the Seductive Witch? I almost forgot about her, and that Sword Intent is still inside her. It's been a while since I've used Sword Intent to torment her."
Li Xuan looked bemused; did the Seductive Witch also misunderstand and think Xu Yan's master was Old Man Xiao, hence she cooperated with Heavenly Slaughter to come to the Divine Realm for revenge?
All of a sudden, the Daoist Golden Book opened, and a surge of golden light blossomed.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1002 - 519: Xu Yan Again, The Nearly Insane Seductive Witch
chapters.content:
The response from the Daoist Golden Book came suddenly, and Li Xuan was somewhat surprised, yet it was also within his expectations.
"My good disciple, Xu Yan has had a breakthrough, huh."
Just as expected.
"Your disciple Xu Yan, has made a minor achievement in the Domain Realm, while you have achieved a great accomplishment in the Establishing Dao Realm!"
My strength has increased again.
Great accomplishment in the Establishing Dao Realm.
"With my current strength, the Imperishable Temple should no longer pose a threat to me, but if a confrontation arises, I cannot maintain the invincibility and might of a Taoist Ancestor, unable to squash an enemy with a single slap."
To maintain the image and invincibility of a Taoist Ancestor, I must break through to the Creation Realm, to truly have solid confidence.
An invincible Taoist Ancestor, battling an enemy for dozens of rounds, that image would be tarnished, indeed. It must be that no matter how strong the enemy, in front of this Taoist Ancestor, they would be slain with a single slap.
Only then can I solidify the supreme and invincible image of a Taoist Ancestor.
"Quite the commotion."
Li Xuan, looking at the Heavenly Slaughter, Seductive Witch, and others descending upon the Divine Realm, couldn't help but sigh, Old Man Xiao truly deserved being the leader of the Taicang Seven Heroes, capable of drawing the attention of so many powerful figures.
"Earth Shadow has reached the Nine Mountain Realm and gone into hiding. Is he waiting for the right moment?"
Li Xuan's gaze shifted towards the Nine Mountain Realm. Red Cat failed to detect Earth Shadow's arrival, and Earth Shadow had no intention of making a move. True to a master of stealth and surprise attacks, he would not do anything that might risk revealing even a hint of his presence.
Even for ants that could be blown away with a single breath, he would not take that breath, prudence taken to the extreme.
"A qualified assassin!"
Li Xuan expressed his appreciation.
A white light swooped down from the Firmament, descending directly towards the Qinghua state.
And on this day, Wu Tianan finally broke through to the Divine Venerate Realm, becoming a Divine Venerate Realm Warrior.
After his breakthrough to the Divine Venerate Realm, his cultivation speed slowed down, and it would be impossible for him to break through to the Supreme Sovereign Realm in the short term.
"The luck of heaven and earth, ah."
Li Xuan sighed, Taicang held his disciple Yu Yao in high regard and favor, going so far as to bestow upon her such a supreme treasure, a treasure of heaven and earth's destiny, no less.
In the Great Wilderness, Tian Zi gazed toward the Divine Realm.
Muttering: "That Yu Yao girl, I knew it, Taicang gave that thing to her, heh, if Taimiao found out, she'd probably be heartbroken again, wouldn't she?"
Remembering Taimiao's grief-stricken appearance, Tian Zi couldn't help but take malicious pleasure in the misfortune.
Old Man Xiao, in secluded cultivation, suddenly frowned, retracted the energy of the Heavenly Dao, and emerged, his aura surging as a graceful figure approached rapidly.
"Xiaoyao, Heavenly Slaughter, Ao Lie—they're all coming for revenge. What on earth did you do to make them so angry? You better hide beyond the heavens for now."
Upon seeing Old Man Xiao, Yu Yao sighed and spoke.
Old Man Xiao was puzzled, "What do you mean? As Old Man Xiao, I've long stopped meddling in affairs and wandered everywhere. When did I make enemies with them?"
He then spoke angrily: "What, do they think Old Man Xiao is easy to bully after not taking action for so long? Good, good, good, I'd like to see what skills Heavenly Slaughter has!"
After speaking, he frowned again and said, "You seem to be seriously injured, how did that happen?"
Yu Yao's brows knit with a sigh: "Due to an oversight, I suffered an ambush, and I have not fully recovered from my injuries despite healing until now!"
Old Man Xiao pondered; he remembered what Wu Tianan had said, about how Yu Yao fled to the Inner Domain and coincidentally encountered Wu Tianan, leading him onto the path of martial arts.
"Who was it that made the move?"
"Earth Shadow, but the person behind the scenes might be Heavenly Slaughter, perhaps he learned of the treasure my teacher gifted me and wanted to seize it," Yu Yao said coldly.
She then solemnly added: "Xiaoyao, this matter is no trivial issue. Besides Heavenly Slaughter, Ao Lie, Seductive Witch, and others from the Witch Demon Domain, have all gotten involved. How can you fend them off alone?
"It would be better to return to the Dao Realm before they arrive, and seek out Taimiao and the others. Only then can we suppress the likes of Heavenly Slaughter."
Old Man Xiao's brows furrowed, "I can understand why Heavenly Slaughter would target me, but what's the deal with Ao Lie and the Seductive Witch? Particularly Ao Lie, I do not have any grudges with him, and we even had a past acquaintance."
Yu Yao frowned: "You really don't know? Your disciple Xu Yan has slain a dragon!"
Old Man Xiao's mouth twitched, what kind of fortune or ability did he have to qualify as Xu Yan's master?
"Then there's no need to bother with them. They are but clowns, and they've already reached the Divine Realm!"
Old Man Xiao appeared completely unconcerned.
Even looking forward to seeing Heavenly Slaughter and the others squashed with a single slap!
Boom!
In the Taihe Realm, a powerful momentum emerged, the authority of the Realm Master vast and mighty. Despite the distance, the authority of the Realm Master still spread far and wide.
This was a show of intimidation, a warning to Old Man Xiao.
"Xiaoyao, come forth for an audience!"
The voice traveled through the laws of heaven and earth.
Old Man Xiao directly chose to ignore it and looked at Yu Yao, "You have not yet recovered from your injuries..."
At this moment, the entire Qinghua Sect was stirred, with practitioners coming out from their cultivation, including Wu Tianan.
Wu Tianan had just emerged from his seclusion chamber when he saw the silhouetted figure he had longed for, thinking it was an illusion. He instinctively rubbed his eyes, and then his eyes began to tear up.
"Sister!"
He rushed forward and hugged Yu Yao tightly.
Old Man Xiao's mouth twitched, embarrassed to watch as Wu Tianan, a grown man, acted like a child.
And just how old was Yu Yao?
And how old was Wu Tianan?
Thinking these thoughts, Old Man Xiao looked amused, not having expected Yu Yao to be such a person!
"Tian Nan!"
Yu Yao, too, was surprised, and her eyes immediately softened.

chapters.title: Chapter 1003 - 519: Xu Yan Again, the Nearly Insane Seductive Witch_2
chapters.content:
"You've finally grown to this stage too!"
His tone was gentle and filled with relief.
Wu Tianan, overwhelmed with emotion, held Yu Yao's hand and rambled on about his experiences over the years and his longing.
"What a sour stench!"
Li Xuan sighed inwardly, looked at Wu Tianan and then at Yu Yao, "A woman over thirty holding a gold brick, how much older is Yu Yao than Wu Tianan?"
He didn't know how much older she was, but Wu Tianan had embarked on the path of martial arts because of her, and now he was a Divine Venerate Realm Warrior!
"Xiaoyao, the leader of the Taicang Seven Heroes, when did you become so timid?"
The voice of Heavenly Slaughter echoed.
Old Man Xiao continued to ignore it, but this voice finally interrupted Wu Tianan's incessant chatter, and he suddenly realized that his sister's wounds had not healed!
At that moment, Wu Tianan became restless, seeing Su Lingxiu, he anxiously pleaded, "Miss Lingxiu, Tianan asks you to treat my sister's injuries."
"Dean Wu, you're too polite!"
Su Lingxiu's face lit up with excitement, the pill she had just refined could finally be put to use, and its effectiveness would be known by testing it on this Realm Master Realm Expert.
At this moment, Yu Yao realized that the people in the courtyard seemed somewhat unusual, especially Xiaoyao's attitude, which subtly seemed off.
Taihe Realm.
Heavenly Slaughter, the Seductive Witch, Ao Lie, among other powerful figures, gathered.
"Let's just go directly, that bastard Xiaoyao must be hiding!"
The Realm Master of Wan Tao Realm couldn't wait to seek revenge for his son, speaking in a deep voice.
"After all, he's the leader of the Taicang Seven Heroes, let's start with courtesy and then move to coercion. If he doesn't come, it will be just the right time to suppress his momentum."
Heavenly Slaughter smiled slightly.
"Three strikes and you're out, let's call him one more time. If he doesn't show, we'll go over. Let's see if Xiaoyao dares face us."
The Seductive Witch couldn't wait any longer, she was desperate to tear Xiaoyao into pieces, but of course, that was contingent on forcing him to extract that sword from his body.
She looked at Heavenly Slaughter and urged, "Call him for the third time now!"
"Alright!"
Heavenly Slaughter nodded, his voice carried by the Heaven and Earth Laws, echoed, "Xiaoyao..."
Just as he finished speaking, the Seductive Witch, with a sudden explosive force, her killing intent chilling, and a pink light illuminating the world.
Heavenly Slaughter, startled by the sudden turn of events, instinctively prepared for defense, fearful the Seductive Witch might suddenly attack him.
"Who! Who dug up my Yu Zhu, damn it!"
The Seductive Witch's face twisted ferociously, her killing intent overwhelming.
With a move, she transformed into a streak of pink light, shooting straight towards the Dao Realm.
Heavenly Slaughter and the others were all stunned, what had just happened?
The Flame Demon, the Li Witch, and the Giant Demon were also taken aback, then had a sudden realization and their expressions changed—had the Seductive Witch's treasure been stolen?
Who would dare?
That was the apple of the Seductive Witch's eye, anyone who touched it would face her relentless pursuit, a pursuit to the death!
Heavenly Slaughter frowned, sending an inquiring look towards the Flame Demon, but before he could answer, Heavenly Slaughter also changed his expression dramatically, suddenly looking towards the Dao Realm.
The Heavenly Slaughter Realm had been robbed!
"Xu Yan, you and I will fight to the death!"
The voice of the Seductive Witch, filled with killing intent and anger, faintly carried over!
Xu Yan!!!
All the strong ones present were stunned. Why Xu Yan again? What had he done?
Did the damn seductive witch botch her charm, and actually get taken advantage of?
All the powerful figures looked at each other, only Heavenly Slaughter's expression was extremely grim as he coldly said, "Good, very good, Xiaoyao Realm Master, I didn't expect you to stoop so low!"
"Xu Yan in the Dao Realm? Perfect, let's capture him and see what that bastard Xiaoyao can do!"
Ao Lie, upon hearing this, his eyes lit up, and he immediately turned and headed towards the Dao Realm.
The other Realm Masters hesitated briefly, then also turned back to the Dao Realm, intensely curious about Xu Yan—where DID he get the courage to directly offend a Realm Master?
And to steal the treasure of the Seductive Witch?
The Witch Realm is guarded by Supreme Sovereign Realm experts, and not just a few. If Xu Yan could steal the Seductive Witch's treasure, could their treasures also be stolen?
Thinking so, one after another became restless.
The Flame Demon, the Li Witch, and the Giant Demon also changed their expressions drastically and hurried back to the Dao Realm.
"Xiaoyao, excellent, excellent!"
Heavenly Slaughter said in a cold voice.
"You all, guard this place, and do not let anyone come out from the Earth Shadow Realm!"
Heavenly Slaughter said in a deep voice.
A group of Supreme Sovereigns shivered in their hearts and respectfully said, "Yes!"
All the Supreme Sovereigns who followed the Realm Masters had gathered, sealing the passage from the Earth Shadow Realm into the Taihe Realm, with Ao Ming leading the four True Spirits among them.
The Realm Masters, having just descended into the Divine Realm, were now hastily returning to the Dao Realm.
"What has big brother done now?"
Meng Chong asked, touching his head in bewilderment.
The chilling voice of the Seductive Witch, transmitted through the Heaven and Earth Laws, resonated throughout the Divine Realm, and the name Xu Yan once again astonished many martial artists.
"It's still Brother Xu who can create a greater renown!"
Xie Lingfeng exclaimed with a sigh.
It had been a long time since he returned to the Qinghua state, and he was not far from the Void-breaking Realm now.
However, Xu Yan had already begun offending Realm Master Realm experts.
The gap between them had not narrowed but instead was growing wider.
"It's a minor matter."
Li Xuan said with a light smile, brushing it off as Xu Yan merely taking away some treasures from the Seductive Witch, a trivial matter.
Yu Yao looked at Old Man Xiao and then at Meng Chong and the others, her face full of confusion. She intuitively felt that everything here was not schemed by Xiaoyao.
Xu Yan might not even be his disciple.
Wu Tianan begged the young girl in front of him for healing. Yu Yao didn't think much of it as her injuries were not ordinary. Initially fleeing to the Inner Domain, she was so weak that she almost couldn't withstand a Grandmaster of the Inner Domain, relying on Wu Tianan to evade the pursuit of the Inner Domain Grandmaster.
Even after such a prolonged period of recuperation, she still hadn't recovered completely, and it was uncertain whether she would ever fully recover.
However, since it was Wu Tianan's kind gesture, she did not refuse.
"You have injured your Origin, and also suffered backlash from the Power of the Dao Principles, shattering your foundations, but you have been able to recover to this extent thanks to the treasures on you and the nourishment of the power of a Realm..."
Su Lingxiu said after examining Yu Yao's injuries.
Upon hearing this, Yu Yao was greatly surprised, as Su Lingxiu could accurately assess her injuries, which truly showed her exceptional abilities.
"You were injured so severely? Why didn't you look for me back then?"
Old Man Xiao said with a surprised expression.
"Such a troublesome matter, why bother you with it?"
Yu Yao sighed, as in the Taicang Seven Heroes, now only she and Xiaoyao remained, and their teacher had also perished.
Old Man Xiao sighed, his expression becoming complex and somewhat sorrowful.
Upon hearing this, Wu Tianan became anxious, "Miss Lingxiu, is there a way to treat this?"
If all else failed, he would have to seek help from the Taoist Ancestor.
"It shouldn't be a big problem, I have recently refined a pill that might be able to heal."
Su Lingxiu took out a light purple pill.
Upon seeing it, both Yu Yao and Old Man Xiao were startled, as the pill was evidently not simple, seemingly containing some mysterious essence.
"You should take it and see how effective it is."
Su Lingxiu handed the pill to Yu Yao.
"This is too precious."
Yu Yao's expression turned solemn.
"Don't worry, this is just the first phase of the pill's refinement. There might be room for further improvements, so consider yourself a tester, just take it.
In a cunning tone, Su Lingxiu added, "If you feel like you owe me, just give me some compensation. I don't need treasures, but I am interested in researching the Minor Heaven and Earth Master."
Yu Yao didn't think twice and immediately nodded in agreement, "Okay, that's fine!"
Wu Tianan opened his mouth and couldn't resist scratching his hair, knowing that Su Lingxiu's research was quite special, and couldn't help saying, "Miss Lingxiu, please be careful."
Su Lingxiu giggled, "Dean Wu, you can rest assured, there won't be any problems."
After taking the pill, Yu Yao's face showed a look of shock, as her injuries were healing. Although it was impossible for a full recovery in a short period of time, the miraculous effect of this pill could even heal the damage to her source as Minor Heaven and Earth Master, which showed its precious value, undoubtedly a Supreme Treasure!
"Xu Yan, where can you run to, I will have you cut into a thousand pieces!"
Suddenly, the almost frenzied voice of the Seductive Witch faintly resounded from the Heaven and Earth Laws.

chapters.title: Chapter 1004 - 520: The Taoist Ancestor Descends, the Seductive Witch Attacks
chapters.content:
Earth Shadow Realm, Xu Yan's aura was concealed, merging with the Earth Shadow Realm as if he were one with it, even the Heaven and Earth Laws of the realm failed to detect his presence.
Indeed, he achieved the state of being within Heaven and Earth, yet Heaven and Earth knew him not!
"He's actually targeting Old Man Xiao?"
Hearing the voice of Heavenly Slaughter that echoed from the Divine Realm, Xu Yan was a bit surprised.
What on earth had Old Man Xiao done to offend so many people, including the Seductive Witch chasing after him?
"No wonder he was one of the Taicang Seven Heroes back then, he really knows how to make enemies."
Xu Yan sighed to himself.
Little did he know that Old Man Xiao was receiving such treatment partly because of his own doing.
"Sss, the Seductive Witch has gone mad, better hide well or I'll be discovered."
Xu Yan muttered to himself upon hearing the murderous, almost insane, roar of the Seductive Witch.
Boom!
A pink glow, with overwhelming momentum, shot from the Divine Realm, causing the Heaven and Earth Laws of the Earth Shadow Realm to tremble.
The Seductive Witch, with murderous intent, was heading straight for the Dao Realm.
Xu Yan reined in his presence and continued to hide as one Realm Master after another returned from the Divine Realm, and he also saw Ao Lie.
"So this is Ao Yuxue's grandfather, the Realm Master of the True Dragon Realm, that old dragon? Indeed powerful."
Xu Yan admired inwardly, knowing that even in his Complete Domain Realm, he couldn't subdue that old dragon.
After all, Ao Lie, the old dragon, whether in experience or in dealing with crises, was far beyond what Ao Yuxue, the young dragon, could compare to.
"Heavenly Slaughter is really strong!"
Although he had never seen Heavenly Slaughter, Xu Yan recognized at a glance which of the strong ones was him.
The strength and aura of Heavenly Slaughter were both tremendously powerful and unique.
The company of Realm Masters passed through the Earth Shadow Realm and headed back to the Dao Realm, and only then did Xu Yan move, returning to the Divine Realm.
Having thoroughly offended the Seductive Witch, and with his current strength no match for her, only by returning to Qinghua Sect could he be truly safe.
Xu Yan naturally wouldn't give up on treasures like Qingling Jade Bamboo, and since he had already made an enemy of the Seductive Witch, he didn't mind taking another Supreme Treasure from her.
Thunderous roar!
Suddenly, a surging aura emerged behind him and the laws of the Earth Shadow Realm trembled as a powerful presence arrived.
The Seductive Witch returned after leaving, obviously having learned from the Witch Realm experts that he had fled the Dao Realm and was now searching fiercely for him.
Apart from the Seductive Witch, Ao Lie, Heavenly Slaughter, and Flame Demon, among others, were also taking action, searching at an incredible speed suitable for Realm Master Realm Experts.
As the Divine Realm was within sight, Xu Yan no longer hid and directly executed the Vanishing Thought Divine Ability, disappearing into the Divine Realm in a blink of an eye!
"Xu Yan!"
In a moment, the Seductive Witch sensed his presence.
Heavenly Slaughter's gaze turned icy as he slightly moved his finger, causing the Heaven and Earth Laws of the Earth Shadow Realm to suddenly turn into chains, attempting to bind Xu Yan who was escaping.
"Where do you think you're going!"
A group of Realm Masters descended once more towards the Divine Realm.
"Roar!"
Ao Lie revealed his true form instantly, a massive red dragon, emitting a dragon cry, and in an instant surpassed the Seductive Witch, chasing after Xu Yan to kill him.
"Block Xu Yan!"
Ao Lie roared excitedly, "You want to subdue dragons, do you? Now let you see that the might of a true dragon cannot be defied!"
In the Taihe Realm, a host of Supreme Sovereign experts burst with momentum, ready to take action at any moment.
"This old dragon is quite fast."
Xu Yan muttered to himself.
The Heaven and Earth Laws of the Earth Shadow Realm were attempting to bind him, but for the moment, they couldn't lock onto Xu Yan's trail.
"I won't play with you anymore."
Xu Yan laughed heartily, activating his divine skill; in an instant, his figure vanished, passing through the Earth Shadow Realm and stepping into the Taihe Realm.
"Xu Yan, you won't get away!"
A Supreme Sovereign roared.
Xu Yan swung out his palm in retaliation.
Roar!
A ferocious dragon's roar erupted, and thunder and lightning boomed with violent Dragon Might, signaling the explosive anger of a true dragon, as if ready to perish together with the enemy!
Divine Skill, True Dragon Rage!
The sudden appearance of the Golden Giant Dragon, with its powerful Dragon Might, startled the group of strong beings ready to block Xu Yan, wondering where this True Dragon had come from.
Ao Ming was also greatly surprised, and immediately realized with shock that this might be Xu Yan's Subduing Dragon Technique!
Boom!
The Golden Giant Dragon exploded, obstructing two Supreme Sovereign Warriors on the path, instantly blasting them away, as Xu Yan's figure vanished from the spot in a flash.
After breaking through the encirclement, Xu Yan didn't dare to delay and executed the One Thought Traceless divine ability at its utmost speed.
"Xu Yan!"
Ao Lie's eyes were filled with an icy gleam. That was the Subduing Dragon Technique?
It truly existed, but how on earth could it be cultivated to be nearly identical to them, the True Dragons?
He hurried straight for Qinghua City.
Following Ao Lie were the Seductive Witch, the Li Witch, and other Realm Masters who had rushed back from the Dao Realm while Heavenly Slaughter was a bit slower, maintaining a leisurely pace.
In secret, he was communicating with Earth Shadow.
In the Nine Mountain Realm, Red Cat, Yu Xiaolong, and Little Ha sensed that something big was about to happen.
They ordered the Wind Spirit Tiger and other demon marshals and generals to find a hole to hide in before they frantically returned to the Qinghua Realm, only there could they be safe.
Inside Qinghua City, Li Xuan remained carefree and content.
With his current strength, no matter what Xu Yan caused, Li Xuan could easily control the situation; for him, Xu Yan wasn't creating trouble but was undergoing trials, all for his future in the Martial Arts!
"This old dragon, his strength is truly remarkable!"
Li Xuan observed Ao Lie who was heading straight for Qinghua City.
"My grandfather is coming."
Ao Yuxue looked worried at this moment.
Timidly approaching Li Xuan, "Taoist Ancestor, can you, please not kill my grandfather!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1005 - 520: The Taoist Ancestor Descends, the Seductive Witch Attacks - Part 2
chapters.content:
She was truly frightened!
Li Xuan smiled warmly, "As a Taoist Ancestor, am I someone who delights in slaughter?"
Red Cat, Yu Xiaolong, and Little Ha had returned; they were all waiting to watch the excitement unfold.
Whoosh!
Xu Yan hurried back, "Master, I seem to have offended quite a few Realm Masters!"
Upon returning, Xu Yan spoke somewhat embarrassedly.
"It's a minor issue."
Li Xuan remained unperturbed as ever.
"Master, that old dragon has arrived."
Xu Yan looked towards the sky, where a swath of fiery red thunderclouds was rolling in, enveloped in an immense Dragon Might, with a giant dragon speeding towards them.
The Qinghua Great Formation had already been withdrawn at this moment; otherwise, it wouldn't withstand the impact of a powerful being such as Ao Lie and would suffer some degree of damage.
"Xiaoyao, I, Ao Lie, have no quarrel with you, yet you conspired against the True Dragon Clan like this. Since this is the case, don't blame me, Ao Lie, for being ruthless. Come out and meet your end, and let's see what you, the foremost of the Taicang Seven Heroes, are capable of, daring to plot against the True Dragon Clan!"
Ao Lie's angry voice transmitted through the air.
The enormous body of the True Dragon, accompanied by the fiery red thunderclouds, swiftly approached, locking onto Old Man Xiao from afar.
At this moment, Old Man Xiao was numb.
This has nothing to do with me!
I am the head of the Taicang Seven Heroes, praised by all for my exceptional talent, but damn it, I really haven't been monstrous enough to invent the Subduing Dragon Technique!
You're giving me too much credit, Xiaoyao!
At this moment, Li Xuan looked at Xu Yan and slowly said, "The Subduing Dragon Palm, you have cultivated it into Divine Skills, to cultivate the way of the Subduing Dragon, you still have a long way to go.
"Today, you'll witness what the way of the Subduing Dragon truly is, the ultimate realm of Subduing Dragon."
Upon hearing these words, Xu Yan and the others were all stirred up, excited to see their master take action again.
Old Man Xiao and the rest were even more thrilled, having the chance to witness the Taoist Ancestor in action—an immense honor and a tremendous opportunity indeed.
Ao Yuxue too was excited, her face flushing with anticipation, though when she thought about her grandfather being subdued, she grew somewhat concerned.
But then she thought, "Since the Taoist Ancestor has said he is not a person who delights in killing, he definitely won't kill Grandpa. In that case, it might be a good thing for Grandpa to be subdued by the Taoist Ancestor!"
With this in mind, Ao Yuxue's concerns immediately vanished, and her eyes widened in anticipation, eager to see how the Taoist Ancestor would subdue the dragon!
Li Xuan, unruffled, let Ao Lie's Dragon Might surge and rush towards him while he continued to speak, "The way of the Subduing Dragon is already at the level of the Dao, the ultimate goal of cultivation is to ascend to the great Dao.
"After the Holy Sword Realm comes the Sword Dao Realm, with the Dao as the sword and the sword as the Dao, this realm can only be comprehended through one's own talents.
"Once understood, you then carve out your own Dao, just like in the Establishing Dao Realm, establishing your own Dao. Sword Dao too is the same, establishing the way of the sword, your own sword Dao, opening up the grand way of the sword."
Xu Yan listened respectfully, with flashes of enlightenment sparkling in his mind, using the sword as the Dao, Dao as the sword, establishing the way of the sword...
Li Xuan turned to Meng Chong, Su Lingxiu, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping, "Blade Path is the same, ultimately, Martial Arts converge to the same end, all are about ascending to the great Dao."
Old Man Xiao and the others were also stirred up inside; these were pointers from the Taoist Ancestor himself.
Yu Yao was greatly astonished but seemed to have some realizations, yet it was too profound, and she couldn't fully comprehend its significance for a while.
But she knew for sure that the real powerhouse here, Xu Yan's master, was the young man sitting in the chair, served by a beautiful sea spirit by his side.
"Xiaoyao, come on, let's battle!"
At that moment, Ao Lie was almost upon Qinghua City, his Dragon Might rippling outwards. The martial artists of Qinghua City couldn't help but tremble, though fear was absent from their faces; the trembling was an uncontrollable reaction to the Dragon Might.
Because with the Taoist Ancestor present, they feared nothing!
"Watch closely."
Li Xuan said with a light chuckle.
Everyone's eyes widened in excitement, waiting for the Taoist Ancestor to subdue the dragon.
Ao Yuxue was no different, her fingers tapping against each other, her face flushed, and her head raised, eager to see how the Taoist Ancestor would subdue her grandfather!
Li Xuan lifted his hand and gently waved, and to everyone's astonishment, auspicious purple clouds descended from the firmament, and a purple-golden dragon, upon the clouds, approached, its large eyes emanating supreme majesty.
As the Purple-Golden Dragon descended, there was no overwhelming Dragon Might felt, yet there was an aura of inviolable dignity and benign vastness.
Ao Lie was stunned; he felt all his scales rising on end, with his dragon whiskers trembling. Within the auspicious purple clouds, the body of the purple-golden dragon appeared both hidden and visible, manifesting a thousand zhang in front of his head.
Its massive dragon head, with eyes vast and majestic, coldly stared at him.
"Fiend, how dare you be so impudent!"
A voice of utmost majesty resounded.
Ao Lie swallowed hard; he suddenly realized that the purple-golden dragon had nine claws—the Nine-Clawed Purple-Golden Dragon!
He looked at his own claws; he had only five, while the purple-golden dragon had nine. What was more terrifying was that the Dragon Might felt like it originated from the bloodline, soul-deep, suppressing him.
The Dragon Might was unfathomable, yet it carried a sense of vast benevolence.
Thud!
Ao Lie knelt on the spot, "Ao Lie pays respects to the Ancestral Dragon, pays respects to the ancestor!"
"This is the highest realm of Subduing Dragon, to subdue the dragon as a dragon, to become the forefather of the True Dragons!"
Xu Yan muttered to himself, he had an epiphany, so this was the way of the Subduing Dragon Technique.
Old Man Xiao and Yu Yao were stunned, staring at the Purple-Golden Dragon, completely bewildered. Could the subjugation by the Taoist Ancestor be so forthright and simple?
"Where does this dragon come from?"
In her befuddlement, Yu Yao couldn't help but voice her doubts.
The others upon hearing this also showed looks of puzzlement.
"The Dao! The great Dao!"
Li Xuan spoke profoundly and inscrutably, in the manner of the Taoist Ancestor.
"Xiaoyao, come meet your death quickly!"
The voice of the Seductive Witch, full of murderous intent, came through, and a pink light was rapidly approaching.
Old Man Xiao's mouth twitched, and he simply couldn't be bothered to reply.
"Go, suppress her."
The majestic voice of the Purple-Golden Dragon rose again.
"Yes, ancestor!"
Ao Lie let out a roar and charged directly at the Seductive Witch.
"Seductive Witch, you brazen hag, I'm going to suppress you!"
"Ao Lie, you..."
The Seductive Witch was furious and astonished. Had Ao Lie actually betrayed their cause?
Behind her, the voice of the Giant Demon came through, "Ao Lie might have been subdued!"
"Die!"
Ao Lie roared, striking wildly. With the ancestor present, there was no need to fear the Charm Power of the seductive hag.
"I'll block him!"
The Giant Demon let out a low growl, revealing his true form. His massive body was enshrouded in demonic qi, his arms covered in frightening scale armor, with a single black horn on his forehead.
With a thunderous boom, the Giant Demon blocked Ao Lie's attack.
"Subduing Dragon, Dragon Control, so this is how it works!"
Seeing this scene, Xu Yan once again had a moment of realization.
The Purple-Golden Dragon had already disappeared, and Li Xuan continued to look unruffled, his face bearing a kind smile, watching the approaching Seductive Witch.
"Xiaoyao, you deserve to die!"
The Seductive Witch struck, first setting her sights on Old Man Xiao. Pink light wafted out, petals emerged, and a unique power surged forth.
"Seductive Witch, this is not the place for you to act recklessly!"
Old Man Xiao said sternly.
In his words was the implication that in the presence of the Taoist Ancestor, the Seductive Witch had no place to be wild, but in her ears, it was Xiaoyao's arrogance, as if he was scolding her, and his tone seemed like that of reprimanding a junior!
The Seductive Witch was even more infuriated. The pink petals turned into a vortex, filled with seductive and devouring powers, hurtling towards her target.
Old Man Xiao was incensed. He had always been laid-back, not bothering with the affairs of the Domain. But now, one after another, they sought to stomp over his head, completely disregarding the head of the Taicang Seven Heroes!
How would he live up to the renown of Taicang Seven Heroes if he did not display his might today?
"Seductive Witch!"
At that moment, Old Man Xiao's aura was formidable. He confronted her head-on, and with a raise of his hand, he unleashed an overwhelming might, instantly blasting open the pink vortex with a huge fist imprint.
Boom!
Old Man Xiao and the Seductive Witch erupted into a fierce battle, with strong shockwaves occasionally reverberating down, but as they neared Qinghua City, all traces of the shockwaves vanished into nothingness.
In the distance, Ao Lie and the Giant Demon battled fiercely, while above Qinghua City, Xiaoyao and the Seductive Witch fought, neither gaining the upper hand for the moment.
After all, the Seductive Witch was a formidable being of the Witch Demon Domain, one of the Minor Heaven and Earth Masters, much stronger than an ordinary Realm Master.
But Old Man Xiao was no less extraordinary. As the head of the Taicang Seven Heroes, having received guidance from Taicang, his strength was greater than that of the usual Minor Heaven and Earth Master.
"Seductive Witch, let me help you!"
Boom!
The Li Witch rushed over, and in a blink, revealed her true form. Her muscles bulged, steaming heat swirled around her, transforming into a small giant, displaying her savage strength.
Yu Yao waved her hand, a wisp of white cold light shot forth, intercepting the Li Witch.

chapters.title: Chapter 1006 - 521: The Might of the Taoist Ancestor, The Frenzy of Heavenly Slaughter
chapters.content:
Although Yu Yao's injuries had not yet healed, after all, she was one of the Taicang Seven Heroes, and she could manage to hold off Li Witch.
However, Yu Yao was extremely vigilant, guarding against Earth Shadow.
Earth Shadow wasn't too far from here, especially since she had marked him with a Supreme Treasure.
