Although she could not pinpoint Earth Shadow's exact location, she knew that he was always lurking in the dark, ready to strike at any moment.
Yu Yao dared not underestimate Earth Shadow, as she had been ambushed by him once before, almost leading to her demise.
"Xiaoyao, be careful of Earth Shadow!"
While holding off Li Witch, Yu Yao conveyed this message to Old Man Xiao.
"The strength of a Realm Master is indeed formidable!"
Meng Chong touched his head and exclaimed in amazement.
But Wu Tianan seemed anxious, watching the battle between Yu Yao and Li Witch. At this moment, he just hated his own lack of strength, unable to lend a hand.
Boom!
The aura of several Realm Masters resonated from the Nine Mountain Realm.
"Big brother, are all these Realm Masters heading for you?"
Su Lingxiu couldn't help but blurt out.
"Impossible, right?"
Xu Yan said somewhat uncertainly, "I just raided the Heavenly Slaughter Realm, took the Seductive Witch's treasures, that's all; I didn't offend the other Realm Masters. Could they be wary of me because of that, wanting to make a move?"
Raiding Heavenly Slaughter Realm or stealing the Seductive Witch's Qingling Jade Bamboo didn't cause any guilt for Xu Yan.
After all, Heavenly Slaughter and Earth Shadow had targeted him multiple times; surely some compensation was in order?
Taking a bit from Heavenly Slaughter Realm seemed reasonable, as it was like paying blood money.
As for the Seductive Witch, since she regarded him as an enemy, there was no need for pleasantries.
"Xiaoyao!"
The voice of Heavenly Slaughter came through, his presence like a surging river, seeming to want to join the battle.
Li Xuan looked at Heavenly Slaughter, then at Earth Shadow hiding not far away, raising an eyebrow, "This Heavenly Slaughter indeed has some capabilities. No wonder he's so ambitious, wanting to seize the Domain Authority to become the Master of Domain!"
Among the Realm Masters, one said in a deep voice, "Senior Xiaoyao!"
This was one of the newer Realm Masters, clearly acquainted with Old Man Xiao, even having received guidance from him.
Although they weren't the strongest among the Realm Masters, they were still Realm Masters, not weak by any measure.
At this moment, these Realm Masters stepped forward, ready to join the battle.
However, just then, a few auras locked onto them, causing their expressions to change drastically as they stared at those few Realm Masters.
"Have you already sided with Heavenly Slaughter?"
Those Realm Masters didn't reply, only saying indifferently, "Why bother meddling in others' affairs? This is the older generation's matter. We, the younger generation, shouldn't interfere recklessly."
Heavenly Slaughter's gaze was stern, observing the battle between Old Man Xiao and Seductive Witch without any intention of intervening, while also contemplating the battle between Ao Lie and Giant Demon with a reflective expression.
The strength of Ao Lie was undoubtedly not weaker than Xiaoyao. Could the Subduing Dragon Technique really be so terrifying that it subdued Ao Lie in such a short time?
For some reason, Heavenly Slaughter felt that Ao Lie didn't seem to be subdued in the way they subconsciously perceived, as no matter how you looked at it, Ao Lie showed no anomaly.
It was as if he had received a command that made him suddenly aggressive.
"Xiaoyao, today it's either you die, or I perish!"
The Seductive Witch fought more and more fiercely, utterly crazed, very different from her usual seductive demeanor.
Initially, she had been covertly on guard, worried about the sword within her acting up at a critical moment, yet it never did.
She doubted that Xiaoyao, in the heat of battle, could not afford to distract himself to control the sword against her.
Thus, there was no need to hold back.
Unleashing her full strength, the Seductive Witch continuously attacked Old Man Xiao, displaying the formidable power of Witch Demon Domain's Seven Witches Twelve Demons.
The Realm Masters of Taicang Domain watched with grave expressions, as the ancient Minor Heaven and Earth Master, the Seductive Witch, had strength surpassing these Realm Masters.
Moreover, the power of the Seductive Witch was extremely strange; even in the midst of the fierce battle, she perpetually possessed a special charm power.
Such charm made the spectators, if not vigilantly guarding their minds, develop a feeling of pity, a burning desire to help the Seductive Witch, even to fight on her behalf!
The pressure on those who faced her directly was unimaginable.
"Even if three joined hands, they might not be able to withstand the Seductive Witch!"
One of the Realm Masters said in shock.
Among the Seven Witches Twelve Demons, the Seductive Witch was exceptionally unique and most difficult to contend with. Although her strength did not seem particularly strong, the constant seduction stirring the mind was the hardest to defend against.
"Scared, are you?"
Old Man Xiao was also beside himself with annoyance.
Boom!
At this moment, his aura surged forth, a magnificent authority emerging as insights about the Heavenly Dao flickered through his mind.
Boom!
A mighty force burst forth from within him, his body shrouded in the faint rhythm of Heavenly and Earthly Dao, his hands unleashing powerful and domineering punches.
"As expected of the leader of the Taicang Seven Heroes!"
The Realm Masters inwardly exclaimed.
The Seductive Witch was strong, yet Old Man Xiao resisted her charm power, his overwhelming punches surging forward, with the Seductive Witch seemingly falling into disadvantage.
"Heavenly Slaughter!"
The Seductive Witch angrily exclaimed.
Heavenly Slaughter didn't intervene; did he rely on his status to avoid joining the attack?
"No hurry, the result will be clear soon."
Heavenly Slaughter let out a slight smile as Earth Shadow began to move closer to the battlefield slowly.
If he were to make a move, it must be a fatal blow.
After all, this was the leader of the Taicang Seven Heroes, whose teacher was Taicang. If they couldn't deliver a fatal blow, it was possible for him to escape.

chapters.title: Chapter 1007 - 521: The Might of the Taoist Ancestor, The Frenzy of Heavenly Slaughter_2
chapters.content:
Just like Yu Yao before, he merely escaped with his life.
"Meng Chong, give me your life!"
Suddenly, a Realm Master full of murderous intent charged directly at Meng Chong.
It was the Wan Tao Realm Master!
"It's the Wan Tao Realm Master!"
Realm Masters who had been favored by Old Man Xiao changed their expression, for the Wan Tao Realm Master was seeking vengeance for his son!
Though they had never seen Meng Chong, he was too easy to recognize—bald, with a burly physique. In that small courtyard, only one person matched the description.
"How disgraceful to strike at the younger generation!"
Some Realm Masters angrily voiced their disdain and were about to intervene, but they were locked in by a force, preventing them from taking action without being blocked!
"Xiaoyao broke the rules first, so you can't blame Wan Tao!"
A Realm Master said with a sly smile.
Xiaoyao was battling the Seductive Witch and couldn't spare any effort to save his disciple!
"Dare to kill my son, I will tear you apart bit by bit, and have you die in agony!"
The eyes of the Wan Tao Realm Master turned bloodshot with rolling waves of killing intent. He advanced toward Meng Chong one step at a time, his formidable aura attempting to crush Meng Chong's spirit and force him to kneel and beg for mercy in fear and helplessness.
Letting him know the meaning of despair!
But Meng Chong simply raised his hand and touched his head, seemingly unconcerned. For some reason, the Wan Tao Realm Master began to doubt his own vision.
The look in Meng Chong's eyes, why did it seem like he was looking at a dead man?
Impossible!
It must be that Meng Chong was so terrified, so desperate, that he appeared disoriented!
In the courtyard, everyone watched the Wan Tao Realm Master, looking at him like they were watching a dead man, their faces revealing excitement.
Finally, they could witness the Taoist Ancestor in action once more!
"Meng Chong, you killed my son, leaving his body without a trace. I, as a Realm Master, will not only crush your bones and scatter your ashes but will also torture you bit by bit, making you endure agony, regret, desperation..."
The Wan Tao Realm Master grimaced with a ghastly smile.
"Enough with your clamor!"
Suddenly, a faint hum sounded.
"Threatening my disciple in the presence of this Taoist Ancestor, who gave you the audacity?"
Wan Tao was stunned, not yet coming to his senses, when suddenly his neck tightened. He didn't realize when a hand had grasped his neck.
"You!"
At that moment, the Wan Tao Realm Master was utterly shocked, casting a glance towards the young man sitting casually in the chair, utterly inconspicuous.
That glance, it would be his last.
Puff!
Li Xuan raised his hand and gripped, and the Wan Tao Realm Master, who had just been full of murderous intent, was crushed by that single hand!
No trace of the body remained!
A Realm Master Realm Expert, in a mere instant, turned to ash and dissipated.
It was as if he hadn't even had a chance to resist, as fragile as a mere ant, so easily crushed!
Boom!
The Domain shook momentarily, and in a particular realm of the Dao Realm, the Heaven and Earth Laws reset, now lacking a controller!
Gulp!
At this moment, all Realm Masters were horrifiedly staring at the young man in the chair, with a thrill of horror emerging in their hearts.
Ever since becoming a Realm Master, they had never again experienced the sensations of shock and fear.
At this very moment, the feelings of shock and fear, like floodwaters breaking through a dam, surged forth, causing every heart to tremble.
This was a Realm Master Realm Expert!
Even though the Wan Tao Realm Master was not among the top in the group of Realm Masters, he was, after all, a Realm Master.
If he could crush the Wan Tao Realm Master with one hand, then he could crush them as well!
What tremendous entity was this?
Master of the Domain?
There is no known Master of Domain in the Taicang Realm, nor did he bear any characteristics of a Master of the Taicang Domain.
The Giant Demon frantically retreated, terrified, no longer daring to continue the fight.
Even the frenzied Seductive Witch, at this moment, was terrified, hastily retreating, staying far away from the courtyard.
Even Earth Shadow, who was readying to act, silently distanced himself from the courtyard at this moment, daring not to make another move.
Ao Lie and the Tyrant Demon also stopped their actions.
The Heavenly Slaughter looked terrified, his gaze firmly fixed on the young man sitting in the chair, holding a Jade Ruyi, looking at ease and content.
"Who are you?"
Heavenly Slaughter asked solemnly.
Yu Yao looked shocked, standing beside Wu Tianan, staring at Li Xuan without blinking, oblivious even to Wu Tianan's concerned checks for any injuries on her.
Old Man Xiao swallowed a mouthful of saliva and said, "The Taoist Ancestor either does nothing or, when he acts, it's with a swift slap, as if squashing an ant."
Ao Yuxue timidly moved behind Xu Yan, grabbing the corner of his robe with her small hand, secretly relieved in her heart that the senior Taoist Ancestor had not squashed Grandpa with a slap!
Indeed, the senior Taoist Ancestor was not a bloodthirsty person.
As long as one did not offend the senior Taoist Ancestor!
"Senior Taoist Ancestor, by taking care of me, the junior, did not slap Grandpa to death, so it was I who saved Grandpa!"
Ao Yuxue thought to herself.
Old Man Xiao managed to calm his shocked emotions and immediately glared at Heavenly Slaughter, saying, "How dare you, Heavenly Slaughter, not thank the senior Taoist Ancestor for sparing your life!"
"Taoist Ancestor?"
Heavenly Slaughter's eyes were malevolent, a hint of madness emerging in the depths of his eyes.
He had planned for so many years and was about to succeed when suddenly a "Taoist Ancestor" appeared, ruining all his plans.
How could Heavenly Slaughter bear this!
Mad thoughts continually surged, filling his mind.
"I, Heavenly Slaughter, consider myself talented and gifted, second to none in the world, lamenting only that I was born at the wrong time; otherwise, I would be a Master of Domain, and undoubtedly the strongest one at that!
"Since I was born at the wrong time and missed the opportunity, then I shall create my own opportunity, and no one can stop me!"
By the end, Heavenly Slaughter suddenly vanished from the spot and charged straight toward the firmament, his palms fiercely striking the barriers between the Divine Realm and the Dao Realm.
"Submit to me!"
Heavenly Slaughter roared madly.
Amidst the rumbling, the Domain itself was slightly trembling, as if something was entering the Domain.
All the Realm Masters looked up in shock, their expressions suddenly changing dramatically.
"Heavenly Slaughter, have you gone mad?"
"You're going to destroy the Domain!"
Many Realm Masters became restless.
The Seductive Witch and a few others seemed to realize something, their expressions also changing.
"Heavenly Slaughter, are you planning to direct the entire Witch Demon Domain into here?"
The Li Witch couldn't help but exclaim in horror.
It was true that the agreement with Heavenly Slaughter was to bring the Witch Demon Domain into Taicang, but not the entire Witch Demon Domain directly.
It was supposed to be phased, slowly.
If directly brought in, Taicang would undoubtedly suffer significant turmoil, resulting in countless deaths and even causing some damage to Taicang.
"Should we stop it?"
The Giant Demon asked, feeling a bit uneasy.
Heavenly Slaughter was too mad!
"Why stop him?"
The Seductive Witch also bore a crazed look, "If we don't take a risk, how can we stand a chance against them, how can we establish ourselves in the Domain?"
"Let's act together, lend Heavenly Slaughter a hand, and accelerate the merging of the Witch Demon Domain!"
The Seductive Witch rose into the air.
The Li Witch and Giant Demon hesitated for a moment, then gritting their teeth, they rose into the air as well; there was no turning back now, they must give it their all.
"This is madness, utter madness!"
Yu Yao's expression greatly changed.
The other Realm Masters were also thoroughly startled; as long as they avoided the center of the domain collision, they could ultimately withstand the aftermath and survive.
But the slightest miscalculation, and Taicang Domain would face a tremendous disaster.
The Domain was about to be completely transformed, the Dao Realm and Divine Realm would no longer exist, possibly reverting to the Domain's very primal state.
And that is, being struck, the turbulence unceasing; it was definitely the greatest calamity faced since the ancient Domain wars!
Dao Realm.
Taimiao's expression was horrified, suddenly looking up, then immediately turning to Duowu and the others, "Have you all lost your minds?"
The three Duowus' faces also pale; how could it be now, enticing the Witch Demon Domain to crash into Taicang?
Moreover, such a fierce crash into Taicang Domain would inevitably trigger turmoil and even lead to a great disaster!
While the Witch Demon Domain was indeed broken and inferior to Taicang Domain, it was after all a Domain, containing tremendous Domain Power.
With such an impact, Taicang Domain would inevitably suffer a major cataclysm with countless deaths, and Taicang Domain would also be affected, even sustaining greater damage.
This was different from the initial plan!
"Has Heavenly Slaughter lost his mind?"
One of the Duowus exclaimed in horror.
"Should we stop it?"
The Tyrant Demon asked solemnly.
Just then, the voice of the Seductive Witch spread out, "Act now, let's all act together, draw in the Domain, this is our only chance!"
Upon hearing this, the three Duowus were immediately shocked, realizing something extraordinary was occurring in the Divine Realm; otherwise, they would not resort to such a risky move!

chapters.title: Chapter 1008 - 522: End-of-the-World Catastrophe? The Identities of Heavenly Slaughter and Earth Shadow
chapters.content:
Boom!
Outside the Taicang Domain, which had already been close, the Wicth Demon Domain began to move slowly, continually approaching the Taicang Domain.
And the speed of approach was getting faster and faster until it was almost like a giant stone falling, smashing towards the Taicang Domain.
Boom!
The Imperishable Qi of the Land of Imperishable and the Violent Spiritual Energy emitted a roaring sound, stirring up a storm that swept in all directions.
The sound of vibration spread through the Land of Imperishable, with the storm shaking everything around it.
The already crumbling and shrinking Netherworld Domain, with its Dao Principles being absorbed and its red halo already somewhat dimmed, suddenly revealed several figures, all of whom were horrified as they looked in the direction of the Taicang Domain.
"What's going on?"
The Wicth Demon Domain was crashing into the Taicang Domain, and once it collided with the Taicang Domain, it would trigger a major disaster, and the situation of the Taicang Domain would also undergo a huge transformation as a result.
Some of the measures left by Taicang would probably disappear under this impact.
Of course, the damaged Wicth Demon Domain was not capable of destroying the Taicang Domain, but it was highly likely to cause significant damage to the Taicang Domain.
Even a huge flaw could appear within the Dao Principles, which would take a long time to recover from.
"Have the Seductive Witches gone mad? Could it be, out of despair, Taicang did not agree to their terms, and thus they wish to perish together?"
The Lord of Underworld Blood exclaimed in shock.
"Something's not right, even if the Seductive Witches wanted to do this, they couldn't accomplish it. There must be some problem inside the Taicang Domain itself. Besides the active approach of the Wicth Demon Domain, it's also related to the Taicang Domain's own attraction; otherwise it wouldn't be like this."
The Prison Blood Lord's expression was extremely grave.
The sudden change caught them off guard.
After this collision, how would the Taicang Domain still withstand the Imperishable Temple? How would it resist the invasion of the Master of the Domain?
Boom!
The figure of Netherworld emerged, frowning slightly as he looked towards the Taicang Domain.
From this distant vantage point, inside the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, a magnificent Treasure Bead quietly hovered.
At this moment, a damaged, black and red stone with some mottled patterns, like a broken stone, was smashing towards the magnificent Treasure Bead.
It seemed as if, in the next moment, this beautiful Treasure Bead would crack and fracture upon impact with the small stone.
Though the small stone was but a fraction of the size of the magnificent Treasure Bead, this collision was enough to cause significant damage to the beautiful Treasure Bead.
Frowning, Netherworld watched in silence, a complex expression flashing in his eyes as he thought of that impressive figure.
Is it finally time for his traces to be erased?
Immediately afterward, he turned to look towards a certain part of the Chaotic Imperishable land, where a Divine Temple was slowly moving closer.
The one inside the Divine Temple, had he become even stronger?
...
"Taoist Ancestor, Senior!"
Old Man Xiao's face was filled with shock; Heavenly Slaughter had actually gone this mad. If the Wicth Demon Domain collided into the Taicang Domain, the consequences would be unimaginable.
At this moment, there was no stopping it.
Even if Heavenly Slaughter and the Seductive Witches were slain, they could not stop the Wicth Demon Domain from crashing into the Taicang. Now, only the Taoist Ancestor, Senior, could avert this calamity with his intervention!
Li Xuan looked up at the Firmament, still composed and said indifferently, "Just watch!"
Upon hearing this, Old Man Xiao immediately felt at ease. Everything was under the Taoist Ancestor Senior's control; he just had to watch.
Everyone looked up to the heavens above, where a huge dark shadow was approaching the Taicang Domain. As the shadow drew nearer, they could even feel a terrifying pressure.
They saw the storm that was sweeping through the space beyond the Domain!
In the Divine Realm, Martial Artists above the Condensation Law Realm were now staring up at the Firmament in horror, although they couldn't see clearly or make out anything, they felt a terrifying crisis looming!
The Immortal Heavenly Venerables all looked horrified.
"A calamity of the Domain, the great calamity of world's end?"
At this moment, all the Immortal Heavenly Venerables trembled uncontrollably, their hearts involuntarily filled with fear.
Dao Realm.
Jiang Feng and Cang Lie appeared, instantly arriving next to Taimiao.
"Uncle Taimiao, what is this?"
Looking at the scene outside the Domain, both of them were stunned. Had Heavenly Slaughter actually plotted something like this, had he gone mad?
Wasn't he aiming to become the Master of the Domain? How could he fulfill that role if the Taicang Domain was damaged?
They had never anticipated such a crisis.
"Where is your master? Is he dead?"
Taimiao frowned elegantly, looking outside the Domain, and asked in a deep voice.
"Not yet!"
Cang Lie and Jiang Feng shook their heads.
"Each of you come up with your own plans, and try not to be implicated. The damage to the Domain this time is bound to be significant, and your plans might need to be accelerated," Taimiao said calmly.
Unless the Master of the Domain intervened, no one could stop the impact of the Wicth Demon Domain.
Jiang Feng and Cang Lie were somewhat surprised that Taimiao knew about their plan.
On second thought, since Taimiao and their master belonged to the same era and were both followers of Taicang Senior, it made sense that she would be aware.
In the Dao Realm, Supreme Sovereigns and Divine Venerates were looking for ways to avoid this massive disaster, while Martial Artists below the Heavenly Union Realm turned pale and fled frantically towards the Divine Realm.
When the Wicth Demon Domain collided, the Dao Realm would undoubtedly bear the brunt.
Great Wilderness.
Tian Zi looked up at the Firmament, his eyes somewhat excited, "The opportunity has come, I, Tian Zi... no, the Heavenly Dao, shall take the stage!"
To avoid this impact affecting his plan to scheme against the Blood Demon, Tian Zi used the Power of Heavenly Dao to strengthen the scene where the Blood Demon was, shielding the Blood Demon from sensing the true situation outside.

chapters.title: Chapter 1009 - 1009: 522
chapters.content:
With a single movement, he arrived at the boundary between the Spiritual Realm and the Divine Realm.
The Heavenly Dao Rules were in motion, and Tian Zi was silently waiting, waiting for Heavenly Slaughter's move.
Since Heavenly Slaughter dared to do this, dared to take the risk, he must have had some confidence, ensuring that such actions wouldn't damage the Taicang Domain.
As for the countless deaths and injuries, that was not within Heavenly Slaughter's consideration. As long as he became the Master of Domain, the death of some weaklings was worthwhile.
This was Heavenly Slaughter's thought.
However, as Tian Zi personified the Heavenly Dao and was also a spirit of the Domain, he naturally would not allow such a thing to happen. So he was waiting for an opportunity, to use this chance to strengthen the Domain of Taicang, and the operation of the Heavenly Dao throughout the Domain.
Boom!
The Witch Demon Domain plunged down, approaching the Taicang Domain. Seen from a distance at the Land of Imperishable, the magnificent Treasure Bead of the Taicang Domain had signs of turbulence.
At the same time, a radiant glow began to suffuse.
The Taicang Domain Dao Principles were touched and began to form a barrier, striving to block the incursion of the Witch Demon Domain.
The Seductive Witch and her six companions felt their scalps tingle, and upon regaining some composure, began to feel some regret, having been too impulsive.
Actually going crazy along with Heavenly Slaughter!
However, thinking of the figure in the small courtyard, mysterious and terrifying, they had no choice but to act in this way. Only by doing so did they have a chance to strike.
"Heavenly Slaughter, such an attack won't harm the other side!"
The Seductive Witch said in a deep voice.
Heavenly Slaughter's eyes were frantic, but his expression was calm and collected as he quietly gazed outside the Firmament, saying nothing.
Thunderous booms!
At a certain moment, the barrier between the Dao Realm and the Divine Realm collapsed in an instant. The Dao Principles surged forth, gathering outside the Domain, striving to block the incursion of the Witch Demon Domain.
Thunderous booms!
The Domain was changing.
"Taicang has recovered!"
The Seductive Witch's expression flickered for a moment.
In the past, she frequently visited the Taicang Domain, seducing many of Taicang's proud elites, and was very familiar with the Taicang of Ancient Times.
Unity of Domain at last!
The Taicang Domain no longer had segregated areas but had reverted to the state of Ancient Times. The Dao Realm would also return, to the central land of Taicang Domain, the appearance of the Origin Land.
The Dao Realm's Three Hundred Realms were all in upheaval, with the Heaven and Earth Laws of the Three Hundred Realms surging out, beckoned by the Taicang Domain Dao Principles.
The Dao Realm, the Divine Realm in great chaos, even Martial Artists below the Condensation Law Realm, when looking up at the Firmament, could see a gigantic shadow crashing into the Domain.
An apocalyptic calamity, indeed!
Yet, what everyone overlooked was that the Spiritual Realm and Inner Domain were unusually calm, totally unaffected. The Martial Artists of these two places could not at all feel the coming of the apocalyptic havoc.
"Almost time, now is the moment!"
Heavenly Slaughter murmured to himself.
Whoosh!
Suddenly, a figure appeared out of nowhere, likened to a wisp of cloud or melting into the Domain itself, silent and traceless.
"It's Earth Shadow!"
A Realm Master exclaimed in shock, losing color.
"Wasn't Earth Shadow supposed to be dead? How is he still alive?"
"Heavenly Slaughter and Earth Shadow must have secretly allied!"
All Realm Masters felt a chill in their hearts, realizing that Heavenly Slaughter's concealment ran deep, now more wary of him than ever.
The Realm Masters who had sided with Heavenly Slaughter were also taken aback, unaware that Earth Shadow was still alive!
"Back then, it was Earth Shadow who ambushed me!"
Yu Yao said with a cold expression.
Old Man Xiao appeared pensive. "Earth Shadow seems to have changed somehow, but I can't pinpoint exactly how."
Li Xuan looked at Old Man Xiao with surprise. As the foremost among the Taicang Seven Heroes, the most powerful of the second generation in the Taicang Domain, he indeed had some extraordinary insight. Although he hadn't pinpointed the specific issue with Earth Shadow, he had sensed something was amiss.
Xu Yan's eyes were fixed on Earth Shadow, exploring thoughts as well.
"Master, could it be that Earth Shadow and Heavenly Slaughter are the same person?" Xu Yan ventured after some thought.
Old Man Xiao and Yu Yao were both startled. How could Heavenly Slaughter and Earth Shadow be the same person?
"Impossible, Heavenly Slaughter and Earth Shadow were contemporaries, not the same person. Earth Shadow too was a formidable figure of his time with a prominent reputation," Old Man Xiao shook his head and said.
"He is both the same person and not the same person."
Li Xuan chuckled, "This Heavenly Slaughter, indeed has some talent, he has more ideas, more initiative than you, the leader of the Taicang Seven Heroes."
Old Man Xiao was startled, could it be that Heavenly Slaughter had actually received such affirmation from the Taoist Ancestor?
"Senior, what's the deal with Earth Shadow?"
Old Man Xiao asked in confusion.
"Domain has Yin Yang, and when Yin and Yang unite, they create everything. Humans too are divided into Yin and Yang, men are Yang, women are Yin; males are Yang, females are Yin, this is the most fundamental understanding of Yin Yang.
"Heavenly Slaughter is Yang, Earth Shadow is Yin, they are both the same person and not the same person, they have different thoughts and consciousness, they cultivate different cultivation techniques, and their abilities are different too.
"However, Heavenly Slaughter is the dominant one, with Earth Shadow being subordinate. To put it simply, Heavenly Slaughter has two personalities, but his main personality is the real dominant one; he's aware of his own issues.
"Therefore, after gaining a certain level of strength, he separated one of his personalities, and the separated personality resided within the original Divine Soul and body of Earth Shadow, slowly devouring the initial Earth Shadow and replacing it..."
Li Xuan explained smilingly.
In his heart, he marveled—Heavenly Slaughter really was extraordinary, having once possessed dual personas, and being extremely pioneering and brave enough to explore, he had managed to separate the weaker personality using some method, which had then possessed the original Earth Shadow.
This separated persona lived as Earth Shadow, cultivated as Earth Shadow, but was still controlled by his main persona, and in some sense, Earth Shadow was also a somewhat independent state.
Heavenly Slaughter and Earth Shadow, originally one, now seemed to coexist as Yin and Yang, both independent and yet united.
Old Man Xiao and the others were all stunned, unable to believe that Heavenly Slaughter and Earth Shadow were one and the same.
Earth Shadow was another persona separated out by Heavenly Slaughter!
In that instant, Old Man Xiao found himself admiring Heavenly Slaughter, no wonder the Taoist Ancestor said that Heavenly Slaughter had more ideas, more innovative spirit.
Old Man Xiao questioned himself—if he had dual personas, he probably would have gone mad, or might have met an untimely death during a breakthrough due to conflicts between his personas.
That Heavenly Slaughter had actually separated another persona and managed to let this persona live under another identity, and even cultivated up to the Realm Master Realm!
This talent was truly terrifying; no wonder Heavenly Slaughter dared to seize Domain Authority, aspiring to become the Master of Domain.
"Perhaps, he also feels he was born at the wrong time," thought Old Man Xiao.
The monstrosity that was Heavenly Slaughter, being such an explorer by nature, would have been more likely to gain the appreciation of Teacher Taicang.
Alas, he ultimately missed the best era.
"Senior, when did Heavenly Slaughter separate his other persona?"
Old Man Xiao asked curiously.
"Divine Refinement." Li Xuan smiled and said.
Heavenly Slaughter, during the Divine Refinement Realm, had killed the real Earth Shadow and replaced him using his own separated persona, what a tactic!
"This Heavenly Slaughter, is truly formidable," Xu Yan couldn't help but sigh in admiration.
Li Xuan laughed heartily, no matter how formidable Heavenly Slaughter might be, he's still no match for my good disciple like you.
Making up cultivation techniques on the fly and still managing to cultivate them, who could be more monstrous than you?!
The Witch Demon Domain was about to collide with the Taicang Domain, and at that moment, a purple pearl appeared in Heavenly Slaughter's hands.
A wisp of purple light emerged and enshrouded both him and Earth Shadow; at one moment, from within Heavenly Slaughter's body, an entity walked out.
This entity seemed somewhat ethereal, somewhat unreal, but it was indeed Heavenly Slaughter himself, and it had walked out of his body.
This entity wasn't a Divine Soul; it seemed like an illusory body formed through some unknown secret technique.
"Yin Body?"
Old Man Xiao, recalling what the Taoist Ancestor had previously mentioned about Yin and Yang, murmured to himself.
"That way of calling it isn't wrong!"
Li Xuan smiled.
The Yin Body of Heavenly Slaughter instantly merged into the body of Earth Shadow.
"The treasure in the hands of Heavenly Slaughter seems to be?"
Yu Yao furrowed her brows, speaking with a serious tone.
"It's the Heavenly Purple Pearl!"
Old Man Xiao sighed, reminiscing about that somewhat mischievous, highly curious, and very playful youth who used to be around Teacher Taicang.
This pearl belonged to that individual!
"How did the Heavenly Purple Pearl end up in Heavenly Slaughter's hands?"
Yu Yao said in shock.
"Could it be that Tian Zi is dead?"
Old Man Xiao laughed and said, "He's not dead, but I know Teacher Taicang has locked him up."
Looking at the Heavenly Purple Pearl in Heavenly Slaughter's hand, "Perhaps, the Heavenly Purple Pearl was lost somewhere and ended up with Heavenly Slaughter, he too is fortunate!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1010 - 523: Integration of Domain, Division of Yin Yang
chapters.content:
The Heavenly Purple Pearl was indeed a Supreme Treasure, said to be a condensed form of the Open Heaven Purple Light.
Heavenly Slaughter had obtained this treasure; no wonder he was so confident, aspiring to become the Master of Domain.
Normally, with Heavenly Slaughter's means and the Heavenly Purple Pearl, his chances of seizing the Domain Authority and ascending as the Master of Domain were very high.
Even if he couldn't fully control the Domain, he could at least obtain more than seventy percent of the Domain Authority, making him the strongest in the Taicang Domain.
Unfortunately, Heavenly Slaughter ultimately had a limited understanding of the Taicang Domain.
The Taicang Domain was different from the other Six Great Domains, not only because Taicang had made some arrangements, but more importantly because of Tian Zi's presence.
Old Man Xiao and Taimiao, among others, were aware of the uniqueness of the Taicang Domain and thus had never considered acquiring the Domain Authority.
As for Taicang leaving some measures for his successors to become the new Masters of the Domain, the conditions were too harsh, requiring Tian Zi's approval, and one could not become the true Master of Domain due to Tian Zi's existence.
He was the spirit of the Domain, possessing tremendous authority over the Domain.
Although Old Man Xiao and Yu Yao did not know that Tian Zi was the spirit of the Domain, they understood his special status, almost as if he were the son of Teacher Taicang.
Taicang was quite indulgent towards Tian Zi.
Boom!
The Heavenly Purple Pearl radiated purple light, and Heavenly Slaughter's aura grew stronger, exuding a special charm.
At one moment, Earth Shadow burst like mist, merging into the Domain and into the Domain Dao Principles.
Heavenly Slaughter was excited, the Heavenly Purple Pearl shrouded in purple light as he and Earth Shadow achieved a state of unity.
Boom!
The Domain Dao Principles seemed to come under control, the Power of Principles surged toward the Witch Demon Domain, pulling and causing it to fall.
Heavenly Slaughter, wanting to use the power of the Witch Demon Domain, controlled more of the Domain Dao Principles with the aid of the Heavenly Purple Pearl without facing any resistance, for it could resolve the crisis.
This was also Heavenly Slaughter's opportunity, although hasty and bound to cause a major catastrophe in the Domain, resulting in countless deaths and injuries.
However, becoming the Master of Domain made it all worthwhile, giving him the confidence to confront that mysterious powerhouse!
The Domain shook, Principles emerged, and looking up, it seemed as if one could see the Domain surrounded by rules, being controlled by a force.
The Heavenly Purple Pearl emitted purple light, steeped in Dao charm, as Earth Shadow dispersed into the Domain Dao Principles.
Boom!
The Witch Demon Domain had already touched Taicang Domain's barrier, the entire Domain shaking as Taicang Dao Principles burst forth in light, aiming to shatter the Witch Demon Domain.
Meanwhile, the Witch Demon Domain, as if provoked, its principles surged violently, seemingly about to overflow and release a mighty striking force.
Hum!
Taicang Domain Dao Principles unleashed a faint purple haze, the Power of Principles converging to form a giant blade.
Heavenly Slaughter's momentum grew ever stronger, as if the Domain Authority was merging into his Divine Soul.
"Strike it for me!"
Heavenly Slaughter roared, willing to shatter the Witch Demon Domain using the Taicang Domain Dao Principles, reducing the damage even if the Witch Demon Domain fell into Taicang Domain.
But, just as the Taicang Dao Principles transformed into a giant blade to strike at the Witch Demon Domain, Heavenly Slaughter was shocked to find that the Domain Dao Principles had quickly undergone some change.
Moreover, they were gradually slipping from his control.
Boom!
The Witch Demon Domain collided within Taicang's barrier, about to impact with Taicang Domain. In that moment, a tremendous might surged forth.
Taicang Domain seemed different now.
The principles appeared changed, and in a haze, it seemed as if the Domain was no longer in the same state as before.
Boom!
"Impossible!"
Heavenly Slaughter was horrified, having completely lost control over the Domain Dao Principles, and what terrified him more was losing the connection to Earth Shadow.
It seemed to have perished!
The Domain Authority that had already merged into his Divine Soul had vanished, and the familiar Domain Dao Principles had become unfamiliar.
They no longer seemed like Dao Principles, but rather rules stronger and more difficult to perceive than the Domain Dao Principles,
imbued with the supreme Splendid Heavenly Might.
Thud!
The Witch Demon Domain had collided, seeming to smash into a giant vortex or perhaps a giant mouth.
At this moment, it seemed not as if the Witch Demon Domain was striking Taicang Domain, but rather as if Taicang Domain were swallowing the Witch Demon Domain.
All Realm Masters were stunned, even feeling a bit frightened.
The Domain Dao Principles had become unfamiliar, unapproachable, radiating a Splendid Heavenly Might that implied punishment for defiance!
"I still have a chance!"
Heavenly Slaughter refused to give up as he looked at the Heavenly Purple Pearl.
His aura surged, power pouring into the Heavenly Purple Pearl, ready to activate this Supreme Treasure and reclaim the Domain Authority that rightfully belonged to him.
The light of the Heavenly Purple Pearl grew brighter, with eighty percent of Heavenly Slaughter's tremendous power already invested, consuming a vast amount.
But now the powerful force contained within the Heavenly Purple Pearl was strong enough to break the current deadlock and create an opportunity for him.
Just as Heavenly Slaughter was about to activate the Heavenly Purple Pearl and exert his full power, another shocking event occurred.
The Heavenly Purple Pearl went out of control, slipping from his grasp and turning into a purple light that ascended into the Firmament.
In this scene, Heavenly Slaughter felt as though the Heavenly Purple Pearl had exploited his powerful energy and then left him, a sense of profound sadness.

chapters.title: Chapter 1011 - 523: Integration of Domain, Division of Yin Yang_2
chapters.content:
The Wicth Demon Domain kept falling, and the Taicang Domain was also changing. The Dao Realm was no longer above the Divine Realm, and the Three Hundred Realms were also changing, losing the status of minor domains and completely merging with the Taicang Domain.
Although the Wicth Demon Domain was broken, it still contained powerful forces.
The momentum of the collision was unstoppable; even though the Taicang Domain was absorbing and eroding the Wicth Demon Domain, it was not something that could resolve the crisis in such a short time.
"We can't control it anymore, it's going to crash into us!"
In the vagueness, all Realm Masters seemed to hear a frustrated voice.
In the courtyard, everyone watched this scene, sensing the changes in the Domain. Old Man Xiao, however, had a face full of astonishment and shock.
Heavenly Dao!
He sensed the existence of the Heavenly Dao. The original Taicang Daoism had transformed into the Heavenly Dao; the Domain had already changed.
"The Heavenly Dao is born; from now on, the Domain has the Heavenly Dao!"
Old Man Xiao murmured to himself.
Yu Yao was puzzled, what is the Heavenly Dao?
What is the Heavenly Dao, but now was not the time to ask these questions.
It seemed as though the Taicang Domain was absorbing the Wicth Demon Domain, but the force of the collision was too great. It was still going to crash into the Taicang Domain, which would cause no small disaster.
"Domain collision, Domain fusion, Yin Yang mutual generation, is not necessarily a bad thing."
Li Xuan smiled slightly and with a flick of his hand, the Taicang Domain suddenly changed. The wilderness of the Thirty-six Realms of the Divine Realm merged together in an instant and appeared where the Wicth Demon Domain was falling.
In the wilderness, the few living creatures that were there were moved out.
As the Wicth Demon Domain crashed in, it wouldn't cause any living creatures to be reduced to miseries.
No one understood the Taicang Domain and the Heavenly Dao better than Li Xuan. Although he was not the Master of Domain, his control over this Domain, even if Taicang returned, would be greatly admired.
Boom!
The Wicth Demon Domain crashed into the ground, constantly breaking apart and wasting away during the collision. The Dao Principles of the Wicth Demon Domain were continuously being devoured and absorbed.
The Taicang Domain shook, purple light surged, as if Yin Yang were generating each other, as if new creatures were being born, and one could also see the differences between all things in both domains.
This was an unprecedented sight: Domain collision, Domain fusion, Yin Yang mutual generation, the Wicth Demon Domain kept falling; the Domain was undergoing changes.
The Heavenly Dao was operating, digesting everything, seemingly using the Wicth Demon Domain to create the Yin Realm.
Yin Yang of all creatures, each unique, Yin Yang cycle, seemed like reincarnation!
Xu Yan watched the fusion of the Domain, the mutual generation of Yin Yang, the differences of all creatures, the phenomena of new creatures being born, as if it was the creation of the Domain.
At that moment, a flash of insight occurred in his mind, the various enlightenments of the Creation Realm constantly emerged in his mind.
He sat down cross-legged and quietly began to ponder.
Old Man Xiao, watching this scene and sensing the Heavenly Dao, also had some insights between the lines.
He immediately sat down cross-legged, seizing this opportunity to comprehend these mysteries.
With the fusion of the Domain and the division of Yin Yang, which was unprecedented, any martial artist with talent and understanding was contemplating at this moment.
Li Xuan looked at Xu Yan, his heart filled with excitement. Was he finally going to comprehend the Creation Realm? He was not far from breaking through to the Creation Realm himself.
The Wicth Demon Domain crashing in, the great change of the Domain, the division of Yin Yang, was not a process that could be completed overnight or end overnight.
The Domain continued to be turbulent, and many martial artists, including those Realm Masters, were in contemplation.
This was a great opportunity.
Even the original locations of the Dao Realm, Taikun and Taihe couldn't help but sense this scene and were immersed in it.
In a trance, they felt as if they were seeing the Open Heaven Purple Light.
Although far inferior to the Open Heaven Purple Light, it was the next most mysterious sight they had seen in their lives.
The Taicang Domain was undergoing tremendous changes, the power of the entire Domain was elevating.
The Domain was also expanding, merging the broken Wicth Demon Domain, Dao Principles that didn't belong to the Taicang Domain were being incorporated.
The Heavenly Dao was operating, dividing Yin Yang, transforming the Domain, and new creatures began to emerge.
The Great Wilderness also vibrated slightly but soon settled down. At this moment, all the warriors of the Great Wilderness had a feeling that the Great Wilderness Domain had expanded.
Even more, they felt like the first-generation Great Wilderness Warriors, favored by the Domain, with their cultivation speed increased, comprehending Martial Arts became easier, and the price for deploying powerful secret techniques was reduced.
The nature's spiritual energy was elevated, the rank of Spiritual Medicines was enhanced, and strange, new categories of Spiritual Medicines were born.
Li Xuan silently observed the changes in the Domain, watching his disciple and the others in enlightenment, watching Tian Zi, busy with his work, with an expectant smile on his face.
The integration of worlds, the division of Yin and Yang, the birth of life, everything was so mystical, this was the true location of the Dao, and its true essence.
"Creation Realm, not far now,"
muttered Li Xuan to himself.
Xu Yan would gain enlightenment on the law of the Creation Realm during this period of perception.
"Yin and Yang, reincarnation... This Domain, it's more interesting."
Li Xuan watched the changes in the Domain.
The Witch Demon Domain fell, transformed into the Yin Realm, and merged with the Taicang Domain, becoming a new Domain.
Great Wilderness!
The Great Wilderness Domain was divided into Yin and Yang, and the order of reincarnation would gradually be born and established.
Although, it was a long process, it would eventually be completed.
Looking up beyond the world, the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, the violent Spiritual Energy and Imperishable Qi were being swept into the Domain, turning into milder Spiritual Energy, becoming Yin Qi of the Yin Realm.
The Three Hundred Realms of the Dao Realm had already changed beyond recognition, no longer little domains, they seemed to have become secret realms within the Domain.
"Cave Heavens, the Three Hundred Cave Heavens of the Great Wilderness, for the capable to dwell in."
Li Xuan smiled, defining the Three Hundred Realms clearly.
The Great Wilderness Three Hundred Cave Heavens!
"Perhaps, in the future, there will be more Cave Heavens, about three hundred and sixty would be just right."
The changes in the world persisted, and Tian Zi was so busy that he had no time to distract himself by tricking the Blood Demon. In order not to let the Blood Demon detect anything unusual, Tian Zi tricked the Blood Demon into undergoing a transformation, sealing his senses, letting him immerse in some kind of "closed-death retreat".
The Azure Sea Sphere, now, had transformed into a boundless ocean, connected with the original Spiritual Realm's Azure Sea.
And the vastness of the Azure Sea was already beyond its initial form,
even more magnificent and expansive than in ancient times of the Taicang Domain.
The Azure Sea Turtle carefully poked its head out of the sea, looking towards the Firmament, beyond the Domain.
Its eyes were filled with shock; the Taicang Domain was constantly changing, becoming unfamiliar to it.
Just recovering from the fusion of the Domain, the division of Yin and Yang, the shock in the eyes of the Azure Sea Turtle could not be calmed for a long time.
The scene of the Domain's fusion seemed like the time when Hong Ze opened the world, only this seemed even more mysterious and more profound than when Hong Ze did.
"Why is there such a change? The Witch Demon Domain crashed into Taicang, merged into it, how did it do so?
"Why do I feel that the Domain Dao Rule seems a bit off, giving me a sense of the Splendid Heavenly Might that's irreversible?"
The eyes of the Azure Sea Turtle were solemn and puzzled.
"Is it Taicang's layout and contingency?"
The Azure Sea Turtle mused.
"Forget it, thinking too much is of no help, I'll continue to hide, waiting for the right moment, then find Xu Yan. This change seems to be related to Xu Yan,"
The Azure Sea Turtle submerged back into the depths of the Azure Sea, concealing itself once more.
The Seductive Witch's murderous and crazed roar had been heard by the Azure Sea Turtle, and not long after, such a great change in the world occurred. It refused to believe it was unrelated to Xu Yan.
As time passed, the vibrations of the world slowly weakened, and the new structure of the world was about to stabilize.
This is the Great Wilderness Domain; the Great Wilderness has its Heavenly Path!
"That exhausted me!"
Tian Zi showed a look of weariness, yet his eyes were extremely excited.
The Heavenly Path was already operating the entire world, and just as he had envisioned, the Domain was divided into Yin and Yang.
This was a beginning, the beginning of a transformation, and the beginning of the Heavenly Path reaching the Land of Imperishable.
"Taicang, your world, from now on, is mine. This is the Great Wilderness Domain. Those bastards from the Imperishable Temple who dare covet my Domain must die!
"I am the Heavenly Path, supreme and unparalleled, I will show those who defy the Heavenly Path, what the Majesty of the Heavenly Path is.
"I will let the Imperishable Temple feel the dignity of the Heavenly Path, let them suffer the punishment of the Heavenly Path, I will avenge you!"
Tian Zi said to himself in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 1012 - 524: Punished into the Yin Realm, A New Domain
chapters.content:
The Witch Demon Domain had disappeared, but not completely vanished as one might expect. Instead, it merged with the Taicang Domain in an unexpected way.
The Taicang Domain, too, was no longer what it once was but had transformed into a new domain, the Great Wilderness Domain.
The Great Wilderness was divided into Yin and Yang, and the part that was once the Witch Demon Domain became the Great Wilderness Netherworld.
The Heavenly Dao operated, Yin Yang reincarnation took its course, and a new domain order was born.
This process was slow, not something that could be accomplished overnight. Time hurried by, and in the blink of an eye, ten years had passed.
For the powerful, ten years was no more than a flick of a finger.
All Realm Masters, immersed in the changes of the domain and the division of Yin and Yang, began to awaken from their comprehension one after another, their hearts greatly shaken. Sensing a somewhat unfamiliar domain, they found themselves at a loss for a time.
What alarmed them even more was that there seemed to be a supremely exalted rule within the domain, a rule that was no longer the original Domain Dao Principles. Such supreme rules could not be defied, even by them.
This meant that these Realm Master Realm Experts could no longer be truly supreme, for above them loomed inviolable supreme rules.
However, this supreme rule seemed inherently fair and not targeted at them. Comprehending the supreme rule seemed to even enhance their strength.
It was a very contradictory state of being. On one hand, they were no longer supreme and unconstrained, while on the other, it seemed that there was a path forward in Martial Arts, and they could continue to improve.
"Where have the Three Hundred Realms gone?"
A Realm Master murmured doubtfully.
"I have seen some special places that seem to be the transformation of the Three Hundred Realms."
The awakening Realm Masters were exchanging information with each other.
At this moment, the once-familiar Taicang Domain had become strange, and what was more terrifying was that there existed a Supreme Expert who, with a mere pinch, could obliterate a Realm Master, which restrained them from any disrespectful actions.
They were afraid that any carelessness might offend that mysterious powerful being.
Although the Wan Tao Realm Master was not among the top experts, nor was he weak, he turned to ashes with just a light pinch.
Surely only the Master of Domain could achieve something like this.
"What about Heavenly Slaughter and Earth Shadow?"
Another Realm Master asked doubtfully.
All the Realm Masters carefully began their search and saw those still immersed in comprehension, like Ao Lie and Xiaoyao Realm Master, among others.
But Heavenly Slaughter Earth Shadow as well as the Seductive Witch's seven, had all disappeared.
"Could it be that Heavenly Slaughter, Earth Shadow, and the others are dead?"
"Have you noticed that there seems to be a special place in the domain, which seems to be the transformation of the Witch Demon Domain?"
"Could it be that they are there?"
The Realm Masters quietly conversed among themselves.
At that moment, a majestic voice reached the ears of all the Realm Masters.
"The Great Wilderness Domain is divided into Yin and Yang to establish reincarnation; Heavenly Slaughter and Earth Shadow have defied the Heavenly Dao, so as punishment they shall enter the Netherworld to construct the Yin Realm, and atone for their sins!"
The powerful beings were shocked.
The Heavenly Dao!
Their gaze turned towards the location of the Netherworld, which was dark and gloomy, chilling to the soul.
A desolate Netherworld, eerily silent and vast, profoundly frightening. Even Realm Master Realm Experts, if they stayed too long in the Netherworld, might find their spirits unable to bear it.
Heavenly Slaughter and Earth Shadow were being punished with hard labor in the Netherworld—an immense torture.
They knew that even a force like Heavenly Slaughter could not resist such punishment.
The voice of the Heavenly Dao reached their ears once more.
"Seductive Witch, Duowu, Li Witch, Flame Demon, Giant Demon, Tyrant Demon, and Scarlet Demon, originating from the Witch Demon Domain, and with the Netherworld transformed from that domain, are henceforth punished to enter the Netherworld, maintain the order of the Netherworld, and those who redeem themselves may find a foothold therein."
The Seductive Witch and the other six were banished into the Netherworld as well.
"Creatures of the Witch Demon, hereinafter enter the Netherworld, to enrich the essence of the Netherworld's beings, to become one of the Netherworld's spirits."
The creatures of the Witch Demon Domain were exiled into the Netherworld.
The Realm Masters who had sided with Heavenly Slaughter now displayed a look of great apprehension.
Feeling concerned that they too might be punished to enter the Netherworld, a place that seemed far from benign.
Inside the Netherworld, Heavenly Slaughter wore an expression of unwillingness and dejection. A silhouette emerged from his body, and stood in silence—it was Earth Shadow!
They had failed!
After all manner of planning, believing victory was in their grasp, and the title of Master of Domain was theirs alone, the end result was failure.
The Taicang Domain as well became a thing of the past.
Now, the new domain was the Great Wilderness Domain!
Heavenly Slaughter looked up unwillingly, "Imperishable Temple, if only I were born at a different time, I would not have faced such failure!"
Heavenly Slaughter was proud.
He believed that being born at the wrong time, missing out on too many opportunities, missing the right time to rise, and not having enough time, led to his downfall.
Heavenly Slaughter subconsciously believed that the changes in the domain, Taicang becoming part of history, were the doing of the Imperishable Temple.
A figure appeared before Heavenly Slaughter, a youth wearing a purple robe trying hard to appear dignified, but he couldn't quite hide his whimsical and playful nature.
"What does this have to do with the Imperishable Temple? From the moment you aspired to seize the Domain Authority, you were destined to fail."
Tian Zi said with a smile.
Heavenly Slaughter is a talent indeed, and the Great Wilderness needs such talent, especially when facing the threat of the Imperishable Temple. A strong expert like Heavenly Slaughter must not be killed.
Moreover, as the Netherworld is newly established and in need of significant construction, such laborious tasks should be left to Heavenly Slaughter as punishment.
The necessary punishment was indispensable.

chapters.title: Chapter 1013 - 524: Punished into the Yin Realm, A New Domain_2
chapters.content:
He's made to sell his labor to me!
The more Great Wilderness experts, the greater the feedback to the Heavenly Dao, the stronger I can become, and then I will have a chance to stand against that one from the Imperishable Temple, to let the Imperishable Temple feel what is known as the Majesty of the Heavenly Path.
Therefore, these experts should not be easily wiped out unless they commit heinous crimes; after all, these experts are the nourishment that strengthens the Heavenly Dao.
Realm Master Realm experts, being just one step further away, are in the end not too far. Once they comprehend the Heavenly Dao, new paths will open up for them.
This is the fastest and most rapid way to enhance the Heavenly Dao in the shortest time.
Otherwise, to cultivate new experts at the Realm Master Level would take quite a lot of time. Now, Tian Zi urgently needs to enhance the Heavenly Dao every second.
Thus, he only punishes Heavenly Slaughter and the others, instead of erasing them; if they perform well, they might even be rewarded. After all, the Yin Realm needs strong beings to maintain order.
"Who are you?"
Heavenly Slaughter asked in a deep voice.
At that moment, he felt that the young man before him was extremely terrifying, possessing an awe-inspiring majesty that felt like the very Heavenly Dao!
Tian Zi smiled radiantly, holding in his hand a purple pearl.
"This is the Heavenly Purple Pearl, a toy given to me by Taicang. My name is Tian Zi, and of course, now you can also call me the Heavenly Dao!"
Heavenly Slaughter's pupils shrunk; he finally understood why the Heavenly Purple Pearl had gone out of control—it was because it had been reclaimed by its master.
"You have always been in Taicang; how come I didn't know about you?"
Heavenly Slaughter said, full of unwillingness.
He felt that he had been outmaneuvered by Tian Zi in the shadows.
"It's very normal for you not to know about me. Xiaoyao and Yu Yao know about me. If you knew about me, then you wouldn't have vainly and foolishly thought about seizing the Domain Authority.
"I, Tian Zi, was born along with the Domain, the second master of this Domain, the first being Taicang, of course."
Speaking of Taicang, Tian Zi became sentimental for a moment before continuing, "But, Taicang is the past now, and the present is the Great Wilderness; the Great Wilderness Domain is mine, and I am the Heavenly Dao of the Great Wilderness.
"I'll give you a chance: work hard in the Yin Realm. If you do well, maybe I'll entrust the management of the Yin Realm to you in the future, and grant you the identity of the Yin Realm's controller."
Heavenly Slaughter fell silent. His pride told him he'd rather perish than accept such humiliation and to do such labor.
However, reason told him this might be an opportunity.
The Yin Realm was newly established, and its future was uncertain. If built well, it might become a significant existence within the Great Wilderness Domain.
Looking at the eerie and desolate Yin Realm, it was definitely not a good place, at least not for him at the moment. If he agreed to it now, he would suffer for it later.
But, he had no choice. Heavenly Slaughter even wondered if he wanted to die, he probably couldn't, being firmly controlled by the Heavenly Dao.
The choice was simple: willingly accept punishment and build the Yin Realm for redemption, or be forced to accept punishment and do the same. The treatments and outcomes between the two were worlds apart.
"It's too dark here."
Heavenly Slaughter exhaled, sighing as he spoke.
"The Yin Realm will have light too."
Tian Zi chuckled, "But, the Yin Realm is the Yin Realm for a reason—it naturally won't be basked in brilliant sunlight, so there's always some difference."
"I will do my utmost to build the Yin Realm, but the threat of the Imperishable Temple will come very soon."
Heavenly Slaughter sighed, feeling a mix of unwillingness, helplessness, but also a sense of relief.
"I just knew it. You, Heavenly Slaughter, are a wise man," Tian Zi said, smiling happily. Experts like Heavenly Slaughter are rare in the Great Wilderness Domain; as a talent lover, I naturally wouldn't recklessly kill the talents of the Domain.
In a certain area of the Yin Realm, the Seductive Witch and her companions sat in dejection, looking at the Yin Realm with places that felt familiar—they were, after all, transformed from the Witch Demon Domain.
But now, they have been punished here.
Leaving the Yin Realm wasn't something they could achieve.
In unison, they couldn't defy the Heavenly Dao Rules, yet those very rules had the power to erase them.
"I have seen you!"
The Seductive Witch had a complex expression and gritted her teeth as she saw Tian Zi appear.
Tian Zi replied cheerfully, "You seductress, of course, you've seen me before. You even tried to charm me in the past."
Old acquaintances!
After all, the Seductive Witch was an ancient Minor Heaven and Earth Master, one of the followers of Witch Demon, and she had not seldom visited the Taicang Realm to play tricks with her Charm Power.
Once, she had tried to seduce Tian Zi, but being the spirit of the Domain, naturally, Tian Zi wasn't someone she could seduce. The result, of course, was her failure.
"You're still alive!"
The Seductive Witch looked at Tian Zi with angry and complex eyes.
"As long as the Domain hasn't disappeared, I'm definitely still alive."
Tian Zi smiled brilliantly.
"You have a grudge against Xu Yan, but Xu Yan is a magnanimous person. Since you're offering the Qingling Jade Bamboo as compensation, he's not holding it against you anymore, so I won't make things difficult for you either."
As soon as the Seductive Witch heard this, she jumped up in anger, "Xu Yan..."
Then, she sat down dejectedly.
The master of Xu Yan wasn't Xiaoyao; it was that terrifying existence.
And the sword within her was also planted by that one, merely as a lesson to her. She should feel lucky that she wasn't killed.
The Qingling Jade Bamboo was taken away by Xu Yan; perhaps that was a good thing, after all?
"He, Xu Yan, took away so many treasures from me; I've always been at a loss. He should look after me a little for the sake of the treasures I handed over!"
The Seductive Witch said through gritted teeth.
Tian Zi was stunned, how did this woman's face become so thick?
He scratched his head, "I don't care about your grievances with Xu Yan. I am here to notify you that from now on, witches and demons will be creatures of the Yin Realm. You will reside in the Yin Realm. As for the future path of cultivation in the Yin Realm, it will be gradually supplemented for you.
"The Yin Realm is vast with broad prospects. You should seize the opportunity. Out of old acquaintance, I've said all I needed to say."
The Seductive Witch frowned and said, "This place is so gloomy and the environment is harsh. I accept that you've relegated us here, but what wrong have the creatures of the Witch Demon Domain done?"
Tian Zi thought for a moment and said, "The rules of the Yin Realm are related to the Dao Principles of the Witch Demon Domain, transformed from it, and most suitable for you witches and demons. This place is a treasure land for you.
"I, Tian Zi, won't deceive you. This place may seem gloomy, but it's a key part of the cycle of reincarnation and will be extremely important for the Domain in the future. Heavenly Slaughter has a better mind than you; since you've cooperated with Heavenly Slaughter, just keep working with them."
The Seductive Witch wanted to say more, but Heavenly Slaughter waved his hand impatiently, "I have a lot of things to take care of; that's all for now."
Where the Taicang Realm used to be, now lies the ancient Great Wilderness continent.
Tian Zi's figure emerged.
"It's indeed you!"
Taimiao sighed.
"Humph, the Taicang Domain has become history, and now this place is the Great Wilderness!"
Tian Zi raised his head and said.
"What are you trying to do? Are you trying to erase the traces of Taicang's existence?"
Taimiao said angrily.
"Taicang has perished, and the Great Wilderness must rise; this Domain belongs to me."
In that moment, Tian Zi's expression was solemn, gone was any hint of his mischievous demeanor.
"Now, I am the master of this Domain, my word is law!
"Taicang couldn't resist the Imperishable Temple, but the Great Wilderness can. I will make the Imperishable Temple taste the majesty of the Heavenly Path. The vengeance against Taicang, I will certainly avenge!"
Taimiao opened his mouth and then suddenly fell silent.
This Domain belonged to Tian Zi; only he was qualified to inherit the Taicang Domain.
"I'm here to inform you, not to seek your opinion. From now on, this place is the Great Wilderness, and your realms are the Great Wilderness Cave Heavens. I won't take those back, but the Cave Heavens without a master, I need to reclaim.
"From now on, only the capable can become the masters of the Cave Heavens!"
After saying this, Tian Zi looked up beyond the Domain and hummed, "Wait and see, sooner or later, I'll show you what the majesty of the Heavenly Path is."
Then, looking at Taimiao, he said, "You have received guidance, so contemplate well; perhaps, you can find a new path. Understanding the Heavenly Dao is the only way forward for you."
Having said that, Tian Zi disappeared from the spot. He, as the Heavenly Dao, was too busy now.
A new Domain, new rules, everything seemed to be starting over. He had to continue perfecting the Heavenly Dao and enhancing it.
With the incorporation of the Witch Demon Domain, the Domain was divided into Yin and Yang, and the power of the Heavenly Dao increased. The entire Domain was expanding.
By absorbing the Chaos Primordial Land and turning it into a part of the Great Wilderness Domain—though the process was slow—the Domain was gradually growing. This was the first time since the Taicang Domain was established that the Domain began to expand.

chapters.title: Chapter 1014 - 525: The Witch Appears, Breaking Through the Creation Realm
chapters.content:
The Land of Imperishable, what was once the Netherworld Domain, had vanished.
Now, in the Land of Imperishable, only one Domain remained, resplendent like a magnificent gem embedded amidst the Chaos.
The gaze of the Netherworld lingered toward that distant Domain.
"What's going on?"
When the Witch Demon Domain collided into Taicang, the anticipated clash of Domain Powers and the severe turbulence of the Taicang Domain, even to the extent of creating massive Domain fissures, did not occur.
Instead, the Taicang Domain seemed to have devoured the Witch Demon Domain, expanding even further, and the Taicang Domain Dao Principles appeared to have grown stronger.
In the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, that splendid gem seemed suffused with a layer of radiance, which was slowly growing stronger, illuminating the Land of Imperishable.
Roar!
An Imperishable True Spirit roared, desiring to enter the Domain, yet halted frantically in its tracks, seemingly in awe of that resplendent Domain.
This had never happened before.
"Taicang's contingency plan, did you really prepare to this extent?"
The Netherworld muttered to itself.
In his mind emerged the figure of a grand man, calm yet domineering, not bullying by force yet irresistibly imposing, and even in downfall, he had laid such plans, truly unimaginable.
Years had passed, and even though Taicang had perished, his Domain still existed, the Imperishable Temple that one, had never encroached upon the Taicang Domain after Taicang's fall.
"How did you end up defeated?"
The Netherworld murmured in his heart, still unable to imagine that the one who ended up defeated was Taicang!
"The time is almost upon us."
The Netherworld looked toward a certain location in the Land of Imperishable, then turned and led five Blood Lords away. No matter what arrangements Taicang had made, what contingencies he had left behind, the ultimate outcome was already predetermined.
At the moment of Taicang's fall, it was already destined.
...
In a certain area of the Land of Imperishable, a True Spirit, as massive as a mountain, lay quietly, long bereft of any life force.
This True Spirit, with a back like mountain ranges, limbs robust, the head already gone, only the mountain-sized, fiercely armored corpse remained.
And around this True Spirit, low roars echoed from time to time; within the Chaos, massive eyes could be seen, gleaming with a faint cold light.
Here, was a True Spirit territory.
Each Imperishable True Spirit here had a powerful aura, no weaker than a Minor Heaven and Earth Master, clustered around the mountain-like True Spirit corpse.
The mountain-like True Spirit corpse was once an immensely powerful True Spirit, but had fallen ages ago.
Its massive and sturdy body had, by now, seemingly transformed into a real mountain.
Even among the fiercely armored scales, tiny, pale-red grasses sprouted, as if giving this mountain, transformed from a True Spirit, some semblance of life.
A weaker True Spirit approached the mountain, lowering its head to nibble the pale-red grass, which was one of the food sources for this group of juvenile True Spirits.
Thud!
All of a sudden, the True Spirit Corpse Mountain made a muffled sound, the juvenile True Spirit, startled, cried out and ran back to the True Spirit Horde.
Roar!
A low roar sounded. The leader of the True Spirit Horde looked toward the Corpse Mountain and let out a deep growl.
The Corpse Mountain did not make any further movements, and the leader's eyes slowly lost the cautionary light and continued to rest on the ground.
In the Land of Imperishable, amid boundless Chaos, no one knew how many Imperishable True Spirits existed, nor how many previously powerful True Spirits had fallen and their bodies become great mountains.
This True Spirit Corpse Mountain, within the Land of Imperishable, did not stand out and was even rather ordinary.
Yet, the interior of this True Spirit Corpse Mountain had long been hollowed out, cleared to create a hidden sanctuary.
Furthermore, this mountain, transformed from a True Spirit, had a special characteristic, gathering and concealing aura, unnoticed by others.
"The Witch Demon Domain is gone."
Inside the Corpse Mountain, in the dimness, a pair of eyes opened.
The man seated cross-legged in the secret chamber, with pronounced brow and gigantic eyes, hair like bizarre insects, fierce and terrifying, and a robust body, carried an air of majestic authority.
However, his eyes were a bit dim at this time, his complexion pale, his aura evidently weak.
Even his hair, like bizarre insects, seemed devoid of vitality.
Witch Demon!
He was the Master of the Witch Demon Domain, one of the Seven Great Domain Masters!
This was his true form as Witch Demon!
Witch Demon's eyes gazed at a certain point, silent for a long time, eventually heaving a sigh.
"Has the Imperishable Temple begun to make their move? I haven't recovered yet."
With a sigh, the insect-like hairs gradually returned to normal, the pronounced brow and giant eyes also disappeared, replaced by the image of a powerful man.
Transformed into a human form, his hair was not insect-like, but appeared dry and devoid of any shine.
"I can't continue like this. It's time to take a risk, I must recover swiftly."
Witch Demon's eyes grew gradually colder.
"Even if I die, Witch Demon, I will make the Imperishable Temple pay the price."
Witch Demon stood up and slowly walked out of the hidden True Spirit Corpse Mountain, looking towards the group of Imperishable True Spirits outside.
Boom!
Suddenly, the True Spirit Corpse Mountain exploded, and a fierce, terrifying figure appeared, its immense body towering in the Land of Imperishable, hair fluttering like myriad insects, gigantic arms, claws sharp as blades.
Roar!
The True Spirits let out a growling cry, but this sound revealed a color of fear.

chapters.title: Chapter 1015 - 525: The Witch Appears, Breaking Through the Creation Realm_2
chapters.content:
"Devouring you all should hasten my recovery somewhat,"
The witch-demon gazed at the group of True Spirits with a grave look. Ever since awakening his Spiritual Wisdom and creating his own Domain, he had not swallowed True Spirits alive.
That was the behavior of his pre-awakened state when capturing food.
Now, he could no longer afford to care about that. He had to recover as quickly as possible, even if such an act would reveal his whereabouts.
If he continued to hide, there was no telling when he would fully recover, and moreover, he didn't have the time to stay hidden and heal slowly.
Boom!
The witch-demon, with his powerful aura, cast out his hair-like strange tentacles, and in a blink swept a True Spirit toward him, his tentacle-like hair devouring the True Spirit.
The True Spirits in the Land of Imperishable all looked towards a certain place, showing fear in their eyes as a terrifying aura emerged there.
The figures of two beings traversing the Land of Imperishable suddenly looked up, their gaze directed at a certain spot.
"It's the witch-demon's aura; he has finally revealed himself,"
"This time, he can't escape even if he sprouted wings!"
The two figures vanished in an instant from their spots, heading straight towards the location where the witch-demon revealed his presence.
After devouring a group of True Spirits, the witch-demon's aura receded, and he quickly fled far away. He hadn't recovered completely, and if caught, he would still be in some danger.
Shortly after the witch-demon left, the two figures arrived.
"He won't get far. Since he's risking exposure to devour True Spirits, it shows that not only has his injury not healed, but it might even be more severe. We'll split up and pursue him. He won't escape,"
The two figures separated and began to track the witch-demon.
"Die!"
In a part of the Land of Imperishable, a True Spirit was instantly torn apart, entwined by the tentacle-like hair, and devoured completely.
After devouring another True Spirit, the witch-demon continued to flee far away.
In an ancient drifting Divine Temple, a voice rose up. It was not loud, yet it carried an air of absolute authority, imposing, beyond doubt or defiance.
"The witch-demon has shown himself; Blood Demon, you go kill him."
"Yes."
The Blood Demon responded reverently.
A streak of blood shot out from the Imperishable Temple, speeding towards a certain area of the Land of Imperishable, moving so swiftly that it quickly left the Imperishable Temple behind.
Once the Blood Demon left the Imperishable Temple, a shadow of darkness fell over his eyes.
"How could I, Blood Demon, blessed with such a great opportunity, associate with you worthless beings? I am a disciple of the Taoist Ancestor! I will tolerate you for now, but once I break through to the Establishing Dao Realm, no, even beyond that, I will make you pay."
"The Master of the Imperishable Temple must be me!"
The Blood Demon sneered to himself.
Hunting the witch-demon?
The Blood Demon had no interest in that; he only pretended to obey because his strength was not yet sufficient to defy them.
"To think that the witch-demon is actually not dead, that is quite remarkable,"
The Blood Demon inwardly exclaimed.
In that battle, he had fought against the witch-demon whose strength was even greater than his own.
"Taicang!"
In that battle, the witch-demon was severely injured, and at the last moment, it was that domineering and towering figure who threw a punch, opening a path for the witch-demon's escape.
But, Taicang died!
"If Taicang were not dead, could his strength have surpassed mine by now?"
The Blood Demon murmured to himself.
That one from the Imperishable Temple was undoubtedly extremely powerful, yet if Taicang had more time, the outcome was uncertain.
The Blood Demon turned into a streak of blood, vanishing in a blink, leaving the Imperishable Temple far behind, and also the Taicang Domain. He pretended to pursue the witch-demon, but in reality, he sought a place to seclude himself and practice diligently, awaiting the feedback from his subsoul, waiting to become a Supreme Expert beyond the Establishing Dao Realm.
Once he made a breakthrough, he would immediately return to the Imperishable Temple, pull down the one in charge, and stomp them fiercely, declaring, "I, the Blood Demon, am the true Master of the Imperishable Temple!"
In the Land of Imperishable, though everything was in Chaos, the Blood Demon sensed a bright future ahead of him.
...
In the Great Wilderness Domain, after experiencing significant changes, stability was gradually returning, and the division of Yin and Yang was becoming firmly established.
All Realm Masters were returning to their respective Cave Heavens.
The appearance of the Heavenly Dao brought them both joy and quiet concern.
They were delighted that sensing the Heavenly Dao could lead to continued improvement, even carving out a path forward, with a chance to elevate their strength to that of a true Master of Domain.
Yet, their concern lay in being under the Heavenly Dao; should they accidentally transgress, might they not face divine retribution?
This is a true celestial retribution, one that even they, the Realm Masters, cannot withstand.
Just like a few days ago, the Yunluo Realm Master violated the Heavenly Dao and suffered its retribution, struck by the lightning of heavenly punishment for three full days and nights.
The Yunluo Realm Master, with snow-white skin and an exceptionally beautiful appearance, was directly turned into charred ash—although she didn't die, it was quite a tragic sight.
Besides, the crisis of the Imperishable Temple has not been lifted with the emergence of the Great Wilderness Heavenly Path; it remains a sharp blade hanging over their heads.
The Great Wilderness is divided into five continents: the east, south, west, north, and the central ancient continent of the Great Wilderness.
The ancient continent is where the Dao Realm is located.
Beyond the five continents, there is also a Yin Realm, and to enter the Yin Realm, one needs sufficient strength and a special method of entry.
One's Divine Soul can sneak in, but if the physical body wants to enter the Yin Realm, a higher realm is needed.
The Yin Realm is under massive construction, and it is rumored that the passage of Yin Yang Reincarnation is being built.
All Realm Masters do not know exactly what Yin Yang Reincarnation is, but they know it is extremely powerful, mysterious, and incomprehensible.
The expansion of the entire Domain continues steadily, with nature's spiritual energy growing rich, making Martial Arts cultivation easier and faster.
The Great Wilderness is developing rapidly.
Li Xuan looks towards Xu Yan in seclusion, his heart full of anticipation. This is the longest Xu Yan has ever been in seclusion, and he is about to grasp the Creation Realm.
"Once into Creation, everything will be different."
Li Xuan has a premonition that once he steps into the Creation Realm, his mastery over the Daoist Golden Book will also see a tremendous improvement.
At a certain moment, between the surges of auras emanating from Xu Yan, images of the Domain's mountains and rivers emerge, as if forming a Domain of their own.
"Xu Yan is about to make a breakthrough and reach Major Achievement in the Domain Realm."
Li Xuan sighs. The greatest beneficiaries of this division of Yin and Yang in the Domain are without a doubt his own disciples; of course, Red Cat has also gained a lot.
The big cat is also in seclusion.
"Your disciple Xu Yan, has comprehended the Creation Realm, while you break through to the Creation Realm."
