The pages of the Daoist Golden Book turn, and golden light surges forth. This time, the golden light surged, resembling the scene of all things being born and the opening of heaven and earth.
Li Xuan immerses himself in the mysteries of the Creation Realm, feeling the power and profundity of the Creation Realm.
A thought creates Heaven and Earth, a thought brings all beings to life, a thought unfolds Heaven and Earth...
"This is the Creation Realm!"
Li Xuan opens his eyes, feeling the changes within himself, his heart brimming with excitement.
The strength of the Creation Realm is truly beyond imagination.
"Now, I am definitely invincible, far surpassing Taicang from before, and even that one from the Imperishable Temple is not my match."
Only by truly breaking through to the Creation Realm can one truly know how powerful and mysterious it is.
"I am Daozu, with the Power of Creation, truly worthy of the title Daozu!"
The title of Daozu, truly deserved!
If he is not Daozu, who else is worthy of the title Daozu?
"Your disciple Xu Yan, has broken through to Major Achievement in the Domain Realm, your Power of Creation has increased a hundredfold."
Feedback from the Daoist Golden Book comes once again.
"I've grown even stronger!"
Li Xuan is thoroughly delighted, in high spirits.
Feeling good, he can't help but offer guidance to those perplexed in the Martial Arts.
So, with a single point of his hand, he guides Wu Tianan, Xie Lingfeng, and others, opening up their paths in Martial Arts.
In the time that follows, Meng Chong, Su Lingxiu, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping all break through to Minor Achievement in the Domain Realm, and Li Xuan's other four Martial Arts skills are elevated once more.
Wu Tianan, Xie Lingfeng, and others begin to break through in succession.
The Great Wilderness Domain gradually gets back on the right track, and Tian Zi, the embodiment of the Heavenly Dao, finally finds some leisure time. The entire Domain now operates on its own according to the Heavenly Dao.
Old Man Xiao is sensing the Heavenly Dao, and vaguely senses something about the future path of Martial Arts; his strength undergoes some changes.
"Reincarnation is so difficult to construct!"
Tian Zi sighs with a distressed face.
The power of the Heavenly Dao Rules is still a bit weak; his understanding of Reincarnation is still insufficient, and he can't complete the construction of Reincarnation in the short term.
"Once Yin and Yang have been divided, to establish Reincarnation, how could it not be difficult?"
Li Xuan smiles, "Just watch."
Upon hearing this, Tian Zi immediately gets excited. The revered Daozu is about to make a move to help him construct the Reincarnation of the Great Wilderness.
Finally, he will be able to witness the mysteries of Reincarnation as told by Daozu.

chapters.title: Chapter 1016 - 526: Establishing Reincarnation, Plotting Against Blood Demon
chapters.content:
In the Great Wilderness Domain, where Yin and Yang are divided, and the Reincarnation Order is established, this is one of the rules of the Heavenly Dao. Since it is a new domain, naturally, there must be new rules and orders.
The existence of the Yin Realm is one aspect, and reincarnation is the core of the Yin Realm's existence.
Tian Zi's understanding of reincarnation, after all, is still limited; thus, he has not yet constructed the Heavenly Dao rules for reincarnation.
After Li Xuan broke through to the Creation Realm, he was able to establish the Reincarnation Order within the Great Wilderness Domain. Moreover, he also possessed the Heavenly Dao Seal, so establishing the Heavenly Dao rules for reincarnation was not difficult for him.
Li Xuan did not use the Heavenly Dao Seal to create reincarnation; instead, he prepared to utilize the Daoist Golden Book to establish a powerful reincarnation.
After breaking through to the Creation Realm, his mastery of the Daoist Golden Book had reached new heights.
Li Xuan's Primordial Spirit held the Daoist Golden Book, which was now open. Using his fingers as a brush and the Power of Creation as ink, he began to outline on the Daoist Golden Book.
He infused the concept of reincarnation into it as he outlined.
"The consumption is quite large!"
Li Xuan sighed internally. Even in the Creation Realm, setting up the reincarnation rules through the Daoist Golden Book still felt immensely taxing, bearing a heavy burden.
"The Creation Realm is not the end; the Martial Arts Endless Realm, indeed."
Li Xuan muttered to himself.
It was time he rethink the cultivation beyond the Creation Realm. He felt that the subsequent journey in martial arts should not be about compiling one realm after another.
Too many realms make it difficult to keep compiling, and at this level of cultivation, it had become challenging to divide the levels into realms.
It was time for a change, a way to keep enhancing strength while maintaining the usual power without the need to compile one realm after another, eliminating the complex issues of realm transitions.
As Li Xuan pondered, his Primordial Spirit's fingers continuously traced on the Daoist Golden Book, finally completing the sketch of the reincarnation rules, the consumption was indeed enormous.
As the rules of reincarnation were finalized, the Daoist Golden Book displayed the following message:
"Heavenly Dao Samsara, Yin Yang Cycle, the cycle of life and death, initial state, can be improved, reincarnation enhances with the Domain, theoretically no upper limit..."
Seeing the message on the Daoist Golden Book, Li Xuan was thrilled.
As his power and realm continued to increase, his use of the Daoist Golden Book improved, and he believed that before long, whatever Divine Skills or powerful Martial Arts he desired could directly be compiled from the Daoist Golden Book.
"Watch closely, this is reincarnation; comprehend it well and ascend," Li Xuan said.
Li Xuan looked at the excited and expectant Tian Zi, smiled slightly, and with a Taoist Ancestor Halo flickering faintly, he pointed, and the reincarnation rules sketched on the Daoist Golden Book were infused into the Domain.
Boom!
Suddenly, a change occurred in the Yin Realm, as if a channel looping back and forth between Yin and Yang had appeared, cycling endlessly within the domain, alternating between life and death.
Heavenly Slaughter watched the spectacle, utterly stunned.
"This is reincarnation!"
In a moment of epiphany about reincarnation, Tian Zi suddenly understood what he had not before.
From then on, the Heavenly Dao truly featured reincarnation.
"Two realms of Yin and Yang, the cycle of life and death..."
Tian Zi's form disappeared; in the state of the Heavenly Dao, he was perfecting the Heavenly Dao's reincarnation, comprehending the mysteries and truths of reincarnation.
"Your disciple comprehends reincarnation; you attain the Yin Yang Dao!"
The feedback from the Daoist Golden Book came.
Yin Yang Dao!
Li Xuan revealed a smile, looking at the Yin Yang Dao on the Daoist Golden Book, his power had increased somewhat, and he knew how to use the Daoist Golden Book efficiently and how to effectively obtain feedback from it.
"With the Daoist Golden Book, compile the Martial Arts directly, making it much easier to comprehend and thus enhance power in a short time."
Li Xuan thought happily.
Seeing the presented Martial Arts, Xu Yan, being extraordinarily talented, would comprehend them faster and more easily, thus enhancing his strength in an even shorter time.
"Meng Chong's Physical Body Martial Arts should also be compiled again, Mighty Sky Limitless Indestructible Body is not the end; even stronger Physical Body Martial Arts need to be compiled."
"Directly with the Daoist Golden Book, compile the Martial Arts to be presented, thus Meng Chong can comprehend them more easily and more quickly."
Li Xuan had already figured out how to use the Daoist Golden Book to obtain feedback more rapidly.
The expansion of the Great Wilderness Domain had not stopped but continued steadily, and all Realm Masters were starting to comprehend the Heavenly Dao, wishing to enhance their strength.
As more cultivators comprehend and practice the Heavenly Dao, the Heavenly Dao itself improves, and the Domain expands while absorbing the Land of Imperishable.
The establishment of reincarnation in the Yin Realm also brought some differences to the Domain.
For instance, when martial artists perished, their Divine Souls were directly taken into the Yin Realm, entering into reincarnation, and then reincarnating as new life forms.
There were also beings born at the intersection of Yin and Yang, even giving rise to new species of life; the entire domain was constantly changing.
Heavenly Slaughter was constructing the Yin Realm, and Seductive Witch, among others, led the Witch creatures to take root in the Yin Realm, shocked by the reincarnating Remnant Souls they observed.
This operation of the Domain, this functioning of the Heavenly Dao, had already surpassed their inherent understanding of the Domain.
Beings perishing between Heaven and Earth were not completely disappearing but could enter reincarnation and be reborn?
Although the rebirth brought about a new life form, in a sense, it was not an absolute end.

chapters.title: Chapter 1017 - 526 Establishing Reincarnation, Scheming Against Blood Demon_2
chapters.content:
```
If there is a way to retain consciousness and enter reincarnation, wouldn't it be possible to live a second life?
"Reincarnation!"
The Seductive Witch and others murmured to themselves, suddenly realizing at this moment that establishing a foothold in the Yin Realm might indeed be a stroke of fortune.
The Great Wilderness Domain is still fragile, with reincarnation only in its initial construction; the rules of the Heavenly Dao are not yet strong enough, and it faces threats from the Imperishable Temple.
The Qinghua Sect has already moved to the central part of the Great Wilderness, entering a Cave Heaven known as Qinghua Cave Heaven.
The original Inner Domain and Spiritual Realm are now the Eastern Domain of the Great Wilderness, which is also the land where the Martial Arts of the Great Wilderness flourish.
All the new Martial Artists in the Domain have begun to practice the Martial Arts of the Great Wilderness, and pure Taicang Martial Arts are rapidly dwindling.
Even those who once practiced Taicang Martial Arts, after comprehending the rules of the Heavenly Dao, have partially moved away from the category of Taicang Martial Arts and drawn closer to those of the Great Wilderness, becoming a hybrid of the two.
Xu Yan looked up at the Firmament, "I want to see what lies beyond the Domain."
With his current strength, aside from those Realm Masters, no one is his opponent, and he is very curious about the Land of Chaotic Imperishable that lies outside the Domain.
It is an endless Land of Chaotic Imperishable, home to countless Imperishable True Spirits, as well as various unknowns.
The powerful Imperishable Temple is also located somewhere in the Land of Imperishable.
In the times of the Taicang Domain, due to the arrangements of Taicang, those who were not Realm Master level experts could not leave the Domain Barrier to enter the Land of Imperishable.
Now it's the Great Wilderness Domain, and while the rules of the Heavenly Dao have also set up a barrier, the weak cannot enter the Land of Imperishable.
But for someone of his strength, there are no restrictions.
Xu Yan is not like other Martial Artists, constrained by the rules of the Heavenly Dao; he is free and does not need to comprehend the Heavenly Dao.
If he wants to go beyond the Domain, Tian Zi will open a portal for him.
"I also want to venture outside the Domain."
Meng Chong said, scratching his head.
He practices the Martial Arts of the Physical Body, and the Land of Imperishable, with its many True Spirits, is perfect for tempering his physique.
"Fellow senior brothers, I share this sentiment too,"
Jiang Buping said with a smile.
"Let's wait a little longer. Once we leave for outside the Domain, who knows when we'll be able to return,"
Xu Yan exhaled and said.
Meng Chong and Jiang Buping both nodded in agreement.
The Land of Imperishable is still very dangerous, with Minor Heaven and Earth Master level Imperishable True Spirits not being few in number, and even the presence of powerful True Spirits on the level of Masters of Heaven and Earth.
Hence, they must boost their strength as much as possible.
Xu Yan returned to Canglan Island to spend some quality time with his parents before heading outside the Domain.
Meng Chong and Jiang Buping plunged into austere cultivation once more to enhance their strengths as much as possible for their journey in the Land of Imperishable.
"It's also time to step out of the Domain,"
Li Xuan had anticipated his disciples' desires and supported them.
Only by venturing out of the Domain into the Land of Imperishable can one acquire more practice and insights.
Taicang and other Seven Great Domain Masters were born in the Land of Imperishable, and the phenomenon of Open Heaven Purple Light also appeared there. All these factors imply that the Land of Imperishable harbors many unknowns and opportunities for Creation.
Even individuals as powerful as Taicang have not been able to traverse the entire Land of Imperishable, and the origin of the Imperishable Temple remains a mystery.
Where within the Land of Imperishable is the Great Wilderness Domain located?
All these are mysteries that need to be explored one by one.
"It's also time to codify the subsequent Martial Arts. Perhaps Xu Yan will be able to comprehend them early on during his trials in the Land of Imperishable?"
Li Xuan once again devoted himself to the grand pursuit of Martial Arts.
The first thing Su Lingxiu did after emerging from seclusion was to thoroughly research the Divine Soul of Blood Extreme and refine a Pill with a hint of the miraculous properties of Open Heaven Purple Light.
She also cultivated special Divine Skills unique to Alchemical Medical Martial Arts, and combining her own Divine Skills, she created a unique secret technique.
After taking her Pill, Yu Yao's injuries had healed.
Wu Tianan was endlessly grateful. In return for the gift of the Pill, Yu Yao gritted her teeth and agreed to let Su Lingxiu investigate the physical body and Divine Soul of a Realm Master level expert.
Su Lingxiu did not forget to continue researching the Blood Demon Soul Seed, and together with Tian Zi, they beguiled and deluded the Blood Demon into creating the illusion that he had practiced a Great Technique transmitted by the Taoist Ancestor and was making rapid progress in strength.
"Very good, very good. You have an exceptional talent and match perfectly with practicing this Great Technique. You must be the fated person that Master mentioned."
```
Su Lingxiu praised the Blood Demon as she took a long, thin, green needle out of the Blood Demon's head.
"Next, the Great Technique you need to cultivate is this Dharma. Once you've successfully cultivated it, you can integrate it as one, incorporate all your avatars into your body, and then break through yourself..."
Su Lingxiu charmed the Blood Demon with a smile on her face.
"Yes, yes, I will definitely work hard and will not let Uncle Master down!"
The Blood Demon nodded excitedly.
Su Lingxiu nodded satisfactorily and passed a secret technique to the Blood Demon, ordering him to practice diligently, while Tian Zi used the rules of the Heavenly Dao to create an illusion for the Blood Demon.
The Blood Demon, being a Master of Domain, was incredibly strong, and also a powerhouse of the Imperishable Temple, making it not easy to deceive him. Simply using various secret techniques to tamper with his Divine Soul Seedling was not enough.
Once the Soul Seedling returned, and the Blood Demon's true self noticed any abnormalities, he would immediately realize that what was so-called the Great Wilderness Domain was actually within the Taicang Domain.
Upon realizing the deception, the Blood Demon would definitely be furious and take action against the Taicang Domain.
Therefore, in order to trick the Blood Demon, and even control him, or at least make him unable to act and weaken the power of the Imperishable Temple, it was necessary to find another way.
And Blood Extreme was the candidate that Su Lingxiu had in mind.
Blood Extreme had already pledged his loyalty to her, and he was extremely aware of the times, a person who dared to seize opportunities and was willing to fight.
He was also extremely harsh on himself.
Just to please Su Lingxiu, to blend in, and to be accepted, he voluntarily allowed Su Lingxiu to observe the changes in his Divine Soul under extreme pain.
"Blood Extreme, there's an opportunity in front of you now, but it comes with certain risks and uncertainties. However, if you succeed, you'll become a Master of Domain. Do you dare to take the risk?"
Su Lingxiu looked at Blood Extreme inside the jar and spoke.
Upon hearing this, Blood Extreme was instantly excited. His choice had indeed been wise; here was his chance to become a Master of Domain.
As for the risks and uncertainties, he ignored them completely.
What opportunity could possibly come without danger?
"Dare, I must take the risk!"
Blood Extreme hastily nodded his head.
"Good, having such determination is enough. However, during this period, you'll need to endure some pain and cultivate some secret techniques. Otherwise, it will be difficult for you to seize the power of a Master of Domain."
Su Lingxiu looked approvingly at him as if to say she hadn't misjudged him.
"What does minor pain count for? I, Blood Extreme, won't even frown at it," Blood Extreme boasted confidently.
"I'm glad you think this way, but don't be complacent. The person you'll need to deal with is a real Master of Domain..."
Su Lingxiu became serious.
Upon hearing this, Blood Extreme's expression turned solemn. "Pavilion Master, which Master of Domain are you referring to?"
"The Blood Demon, a powerhouse of the Imperishable Temple!"
Su Lingxiu stared at Blood Extreme, "Do you understand who he is?"
Blood Extreme was startled, his expression thoughtful, "Netherworld Blood Demon Path, I've heard it mentioned in the Netherworld. It's not unique to one person, and it seems to be related to another, is that Blood Demon?"
"If the Blood Demon is indeed a powerhouse of the Imperishable Temple, isn't the Netherworld..."
Blood Extreme's expression turned to shock as he said, "Could it be that the Netherworld has betrayed us?"
Su Lingxiu laughed and replied, "Netherworld is your elder brother, right? If he has betrayed us to join the Imperishable Temple, would you also follow him?"
Upon hearing this, Blood Extreme immediately shook his head, "I, Blood Extreme, would never join the Imperishable..."
He paused, then chuckled, "Becoming a Master of Domain, standing on equal footing with the Netherworld, how could I follow him? He's not worthy!"
To follow a disciple of the Taoist Ancestor and to become a member of the Taoist Ancestor's lineage held far greater prospects than following the Netherworld.
"I thought you were a sensible person," Su Lingxiu nodded, and then began explaining the matter of the Blood Demon's Soul Seed and how to seize the Blood Demon's power and control him.
This process was naturally very arduous, and Blood Extreme's Divine Soul would also undergo some modifications.
"I'll refine your Divine Soul into a Soul Seed and implant it into the Blood Demon's Soul Seed. Don't worry, your consciousness and memory will be preserved. You'll just grow gradually through the Soul Seedling, little by little taking over completely.
"When the Blood Demon retrieves his Soul Seedling, you'll be able to erode his Divine Soul and fight for dominance. Since you're not a Master of Domain, to ensure you have the strength to compete, I will enable your Divine Soul to transform. I will also teach you some techniques..."
Su Lingxiu started explaining the plan to Blood Extreme.

chapters.title: Chapter 1018 - 527: Crisis Approaches, They Appear One After Another
chapters.content:
Blood Extreme, having listened to the plan, was thoroughly excited, wanting to become the Master of Domain seemed surprisingly simple—just take over and it was done.
Such a Dharma could only be conceived by a disciple of the Taoist Ancestor.
"Pavilion Master, from now on, I am the Blood Demon, a powerhouse from the Imperishable Temple!"
Blood Extreme declared, thumping his chest.
"As long as you understand!"
Su Lingxiu nodded in satisfaction.
Once Blood Extreme successfully replaced the Blood Demon, backstabbing the strong from the Imperishable Temple during the great battle in the Great Wilderness, it would definitely have an unexpected effect.
As for whether Blood Extreme would betray them after replacing the Blood Demon, Su Lingxiu believed Blood Extreme was a smart person, and he knew how to choose.
The ability to let him replace the Blood Demon naturally allowed them to obliterate him just as easily, which Blood Extreme must be very clear about in his mind.
"The process of becoming a Soul Seed is quite painful and takes some time, and I need to modify your Divine Soul to make it easier to replace the Blood Demon."
Su Lingxiu said while starting to prepare.
To ensure the plan went smoothly, they needed to ask their master for help, as the Blood Demon was after all the Master of Domain.
In a certain part of the Land of Imperishable, inside a large mountain.
This mountain naturally was the transformation of a fallen True Spirit; the Blood Demon's true self was hidden inside this mountain.
As for hunting the Witch, he was too lazy to leg it.
"Soon, I'll break through. I can sense the strength of the sub-souls,"
The Blood Demon was ecstatic.
Through the connection with the sub-souls, he realized that the sub-souls had grown much stronger, having cultivated various powerful Divine Skill Techniques.
Now, the sub-souls had nearly the same strength as his own.
"I must find a way. Once the sub-soul grows stronger, to pull it back and strengthen myself is necessary."
The Blood Demon thought to himself.
He also worried about the possibility of the sub-soul going out of control, even though the probability was extremely small, it was better to be cautious.
His mind was immersed, starting to communicate with the sub-soul.
At a certain moment, he acquired a Dharma from the sub-soul, the integration technique, which could consolidate all his cultivated avatars back into himself.
The various Divine Skill Secret Techniques and cultivation levels practiced by the avatars would all be consolidated back.
"Just what I needed,"
The Blood Demon began to cultivate, and as he practiced the integration technique, he found that his connection with the sub-soul got stronger.
It seemed that at any moment, he could pull the sub-soul back.
Moreover, even if the sub-soul's strength was stronger than his own essence, because it was the sub-soul, it could not resist his pull, nor could it withstand the integration technique.
"No wonder it is a technique passed down by the Taoist Ancestor."
The Blood Demon sighed.
What he did not know was that while he was cultivating the integration secret technique, Tian Zi had slightly weakened the Heavenly Dao Rules' shielding of the sub-soul for the Blood Demon, creating the illusion that the connection with his sub-soul got stronger and that it could integrate at any time.
These were all part of the plan, using the sub-soul to sense, the Blood Demon could ultimately not detect the existence of the Heavenly Dao, unable to see through the illusion created by the Power of Heavenly Dao.
Moreover, since the Heavenly Dao governed the entire Domain and, after Reincarnation was established, the Heavenly Dao had strengthened considerably, the Power of Principles had become even more profound and unpredictable.
The Blood Demon could not see through it anymore.
"No hurry, once the sub-soul breaks through Establishing Dao, immediately pull it back, integrate into one, acquiring the sub-soul's cultivated Great Techniques and strength, I'll surpass that one from the Imperishable Temple in one step."
The Blood Demon was bursting with excitement.
It wouldn't be long before he could take over.
"Witch, you should escape a bit further, don't get killed so quickly. Once I take over, I can accept you as a subordinate. I'm not that person; I don't need to devour the Domain..."
The Blood Demon mumbled to himself.
The Blood Pool appeared beneath him, the form of the Blood Demon gradually disappearing as he merged into the Blood Pool, leaving only the Blood Pool in the mountain, bubbling and steaming.
Not long after, one True Spirit after another, as if smelling the scent of blood, walked in, excited upon seeing the Blood Pool.
Running to the edge of the Blood Pool, they bent down to drink the essence of the blood, and at that moment, a bloodied hand extended out, grabbing a True Spirit and pulling it into the Blood Pool.
Splashing!
The True Spirit in the Blood Pool, let out a short shriek and then disappeared inside it, the blood of the Blood Pool seeming to boil more vigorously, producing more steamy bubbles.
In a certain part of the Land of Imperishable, the strong arm of a Witch thrust into the body of a True Spirit. The True Spirit struggled, its body gradually drying up, the flesh vanishing until only a thick skin remained.
"That was quick!"
The Witch turned his head to look in a certain direction, snorted coldly, and his figure swiftly vanished.
Shortly after his departure, a figure immediately arrived, looking towards the direction the Witch had escaped to, chasing after him again.
...
Thwap!
A sound of a long whip cracking echoed in the Land of Imperishable, accompanied by the sound of the whip were continuous screams.
In the Chaotic Imperishable Land, a figure holding a long whip was herding a group of Imperishable True Spirits, driving them towards a certain place.
This figure, wrapped in three strange insects that appeared to be floating tentacles, had a row of saw-like spines standing upright in the middle of its head.
Mists swirled around him, obscuring his face, as he wielded the whip, like a herdsman, driving a group of Imperishable True Spirits.
This group of Imperishable True Spirits included those with strength comparable to the Realm Master Realm, yet even so, under his herding, they dared not resist in the least.
The massive troupe of True Spirits was running through the Land of Imperishable, the sound of the whip cracking occasionally. At last, in the distant part of the Chaos Land, a magnificent gem could be seen.

chapters.title: Chapter 1019 - 527 Crisis Approaches, They Show Themselves_2
chapters.content:
"Taicang, your domain should also vanish now,"
The figure lifted his head, looking towards the magnificent jewel in the distant lands, his eyes emitting a faint, pale green light.
Crack!
With the sound of a whip, a horde of Imperishable True Spirits roared mightily as they stampeded toward the splendid jewel.
The Great Wilderness Domain had once again returned to tranquility.
The mighty ones had gradually grown accustomed to the new order of the domain, to the division between the Yin and Yang of the domain.
Li Xuan devoted himself entirely to the great undertaking of Martial Arts, paying little attention to everything else in the Great Wilderness Domain.
Xu Yan returned to Canglan Island to accompany his parents and guide the cultivation of family members.
Meng Chong was in seclusion and arduous cultivation, Jiang Buping was in seclusion and arduous cultivation, and Sect Master Fang Hao was dealing with internal sect matters when not also in seclusion and arduous cultivation.
Su Lingxiu and Tian Zi were plotting to trap the Blood Demon.
The Divine Soul of Blood Extreme had been refined into a Soul Seed and smoothly integrated into the Blood Demon's subsidiary spirit.
It was quietly eroding the subsidiary spirit, continuously growing in strength in secret, preparing to seize control of the Blood Demon's power.
Plotting against a Master of Domain was no easy feat, Su Lingxiu sought out her master, helping to strengthen the Soul Seed and having it cultivate a Divine Soul type of Divine Skill to increase the chances of seizing the Blood Demon's strength.
Wu Tianan had already broken through to the Supreme Sovereign Realm and went to visit Yu Yao's Cave Heaven with her; Li Xuan could only sigh at the good fortune of Wu Tianan, this young man, for he now had an entire Cave Heaven to himself.
Old Man Xiao was immersed in comprehending the Heavenly Dao, feeling that his strength had somewhat improved and believing he could indeed forge a new path.
Xie Tianheng had returned with his wife Fu Yun to Sword Venerate Cliff to continue with his Sword Dao sect affairs.
Xie Lingfeng, on the other hand, had gone back to Canglan Island.
Meng Shushu and Shi'er also ran back to Canglan Island; it was only on this familiar soil that they felt they could better utilize their martial skills.
After all, their strength in the east of the Great Wilderness, once known as the Inner Domain, was still very formidable.
Everyone had their own goals and things they wished to do; the domain had regained tranquility as if, after enduring turbulence, it had entered a phase of recuperation and healing.
In the Azure Sea, amidst the roaring waves, a large turtle surfaced, looking up at the Firmament, absorbing the Rhythms of Domain to nourish itself.
The Azure Sea Turtle found that, after the domain had changed, it seemed to be safe from danger?
The Realm Masters no longer targeted it deliberately; it did not need to worry about being exposed anymore.
"The Great Wilderness is wonderful!"
The Azure Sea Turtle thought contentedly.
In the True Dragon Cave Heaven, a massive sculpture was finally completed.
This was a sculpture of a Nine-Clawed Purple-Golden Dragon, constructed with exceedingly rare materials, located in the core area of the True Dragon Cave Heaven.
"Pay respects!"
Ao Lie led a multitude of True Dragons to prostrate on the ground, bowing their heads to the Purple-Golden Dragon.
"Worship the Ancestral Dragon!"
The multitude of True Dragons bowed their heads one after another.
Ao Ming did not understand why, after his father returned, he insisted on constructing a Dragon Ancestral Hall to worship the Ancestral Dragon.
What puzzled him even more was that the ancestor of the True Dragon Clan was his grandfather Ao Hong, who looked nothing like this statue, nor did he have nine claws.
His grandfather was a Five-Clawed Azure Dragon.
Yet, his father insisted that this was the ancestor of the True Dragon Clan, the Nine-Clawed Purple-Golden Dragon!
And he did so with absolute certainty, even claiming that if grandfather Ao Hong were to return, he too must worship the ancestral dragon!
The rest of the True Dragons were also puzzled, but as Ao Lie was the clan chief of the True Dragons and currently the most powerful and senior among them,
they believed if he said so, it must be true; perhaps it was related to the secret history of the Dragon Race?
With all the True Dragons having paid their homage, Ao Lie's expression was one of extreme satisfaction, and he relaxed his entire dragon body.
"My True Dragon Clan also has a powerful backer; our Ancestral Dragon is the real Supreme Expert."
Ao Yuxue did not return to the True Dragon Clan but accompanied Xu Yan to Canglan Island; Ao Lie was very supportive of his beloved granddaughter's decision.
Indeed, worthy of being the granddaughter he doted on, as astute and keen as himself in grasping opportunities!
Blindly acknowledging ancestors was a disgraceful thing, but if the acknowledged ancestor was exceedingly powerful, then it was no longer disgraceful but an honor.
Therefore, this Nine-Clawed Purple-Golden Dragon was now the ancient ancestor of the True Dragon Clan!
Even if his father Ao Hong were to miraculously return alive, that would not change the result.
Such a robust and mighty support must be firmly embraced.
As long as they held tight to this support, there was no need to worry about the True Dragon Clan being threatened or eradicated by the Imperishable Temple.
"From this day forward, the elders in the clan shall reside in the Dragon Ancestral Hall, dragons of the clan must often worship the Ancestral Dragon, and the outstanding youth must be trained there; an annual grand ceremony must be held to worship the Ancestral Dragon, understand!"
Ao Lie said with a solemn face.
"Yes!"
The multitude of True Dragons nodded their heads in agreement.
Boom!
Suddenly, all the Realm Masters in the Great Wilderness Domain looked up beyond Heaven and Earth, their faces changing drastically.
Whoosh!
Figure after figure appeared in an instant on the edge of Heaven and Earth, looking towards the Land of Imperishable with extremely solemn expressions.
Even Heavenly Slaughter, who had been responsible for heavy labor construction work in the Yin Realm, came out.
The figures of the seven Seductive Witches also appeared one after another.
Outside of Heaven and Earth, it seemed as if a storm was sweeping in, with deafening roars; a horde of Imperishable True Spirits was howling as they charged towards Heaven and Earth.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
"What is this?"
Ao Lie looked at the group of Imperishable True Spirits, his eyes narrowed, and a terrifying figure emerged in his mind.
"It's him!"
"Who?"
A Realm Master asked, confused.
"Muxiao!"
Ao Lie said in a deep voice.
The Realm Masters were puzzled; who was Muxiao?
But the Seductive Witches and some of the older generation of powerhouses had extremely solemn expressions.
"Muxiao, a strong figure from the Imperishable Temple, has the ability to control Imperishable True Spirits. He once led the Imperishable True Spirits to invade the True Spirit Domain, and the Heavenly Tiger, chief of the Heavenly Tiger clan, perished in that battle, with the clan nearly destroyed.
"Ultimately, it was the master of True Spirits, Ao Hong, who dispersed the Imperishable True Spirits with his powerful Dragon Might, breaking his control over the True Spirit Force."
An old voice arose.
Everyone turned towards the voice, seeing an elderly figure that seemed to emanate a sense of decline, as though he had not much life left.
Moreover, his body seemed to be wrapped in a peculiar aura, giving off an ominous feeling.
"Taihe, you've already come to this!"
After a start, Taimiao sighed.
Taihe!
Upon hearing this, the powerful beings present were taken aback. This famously ancient Minor Heaven and Earth Master, whom they had only heard about but never met, had aged to such an extent.
Moreover, it seemed he was enveloped by some strange aura, enduring torture at all times.
"I owe my life to elder brother's help."
Taihe sighed.
Taimiao looked sad; Taihe's 'elder brother' was, of course, Taicang.
"So few of the past friends remain."
Another elderly voice rang out.
The people turned to look, and saw another aged person.
Taikun!
"Seductive Witch, Flame Demon... we meet again."
Taikun chuckled.
The expressions of the seven Seductive Witches were complex, filled with reminiscence and sorrow.
Among the many powerful beings, only Taihe, Taikun, and Taimiao belonged to their generation; Xiaoyao, Yu Yao, and others were from the younger generation.
As Taikun appeared, three more figures emerged. Although they looked aged, they did not have the same sense of decline as Taihe and Taikun.
These three, all ancient Minor Heaven and Earth Masters, had been in hiding.
"Master!"
Cang Lie and Jiang Feng looked towards their master and then at the charging horde of Imperishable True Spirits, their expressions filled with sorrow.
The crisis had arrived.
With the appearance of their master, it meant that they, the two disciples, would have to escape into the vast Land of Imperishable and flee this world.
"Muxiao..."
Taihe looked at the approaching True Spirit Horde, then at Ao Lie, shaking his head with a sigh, "You young dragon, are still too weak to deter these True Spirits and break his control over the True Spirit Force.
"Back then, Heavenly Tiger could have managed it, but Muxiao was slightly more powerful, and Heavenly Tiger ultimately lost."
Ao Lie sighed and asked, "Is Muxiao the Master of Domain?"
"You could say that. In actuality, 'Master of Domain' is just our way of speaking. The strong figures of the Imperishable Temple don't use this term, as they don't have a Domain of their own to be called a Master of Domain.
"But in terms of power, they are at this level. Although they are weaker than a true Master of Domain, they still belong to the level of Master of Domain."
Taihe nodded his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 1020 - 1020: 528
chapters.content:
A Master of Domain level expert commanded a horde of True Spirits to attack, causing everyone's expression to drastically change.
The group of True Spirits was not lacking in Realm Master level strength, and once they breached the Domain, they would surely cause tremendous catastrophe.
Moreover, there was also a Master of Domain level expert present.
"Prepare yourselves."
Taihe looked towards Cang Lie and Jiang Feng.
"There's no need to panic, the current Domain operates under the Heavenly Dao, they can't break through," Old Man Xiaoyao thought for a moment and said.
Moreover, wouldn't the Taoist Ancestor sitting within the Domain watch idly as a calamity descended?
"Don't be too happy..."
Taikun began to speak in a deep voice, but his expression suddenly changed, "Retreat quickly!"
Whoosh!
From the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, a whip crossed an immense distance and fiercely lashed out, seemingly wanting to tear open a crack in the Domain Barrier so that the Imperishable True Spirits could enter the Domain.
This whip was unimaginably powerful, making all the Realm Masters' scalps tingle as they frantically retreated back into the Domain.
At this moment, they could only hope that the rules of the Heavenly Dao could block this strike!
"The Master of Domain is so powerful!"
A Realm Master murmured to himself, astonished.
Boom!
The rules of the Heavenly Dao appeared, forming a barrier that collided with the strike, raising a fierce storm in the Land of Imperishable, but it ultimately blocked the attack.
"Taihe, do you have any tricks left?"
A voice echoed through the air.
"Do you really think I, Tian Zi, am easy to bully?"
A purple-robed youth appeared, Tian Zi glared angrily at the attacking Imperishable True Spirits.
He turned back to look at Taihe and the others.
"You old immortals, kill those True Spirits for me, they will scatter their essence across the Domain and become precious materials for Martial Artists to cultivate," Taihe and the others sighed and said, "Tian Zi, if you have a chance, you should try to escape the Domain and enter the Land of Imperishable, otherwise staying inside the Domain will definitely lead to your death.
"Heavenly Dao or Taihe Daoism, in the end, cannot withstand the Imperishable Temple."
Upon hearing this, Tian Zi became furious, "Shut up, if it weren't for the fact you are old and a familiar face, I'd let you experience the power of the Heavenly Dao!"
Taihe shook his head, being one of the earliest followers of Taihe, he naturally knew Tian Zi's identity.
"The True Spirits are too numerous, the assault too great, all of you hold them off for me, leave that person to me, I want him to taste the majesty of the Heavenly Dao," Tian Zi said with a cold expression.
"No problem!"
Xiaoyao nodded.
Heavenly Slaughter, Seductive Witch, and several others also agreed, the rest of the Realm Masters naturally had to obey, now they could only live or die with the Domain.
Boom!
The immense whip lashed out again.
Purple light surged around Tian Zi, and thunder rumbled as a huge bolt of lightning emerged, striking the whip.
"Taihe has fallen so long and still has such tricks up his sleeve, indeed impressive!" Muxiao said with a hint of admiration in his voice.
"Come on, taste my Tian Zi's prowess!"
Tian Zi sneered, with swirling purple light, the power of the Heavenly Dao appeared, and he gripped a rule of the Heavenly Dao in his hand.
Boom!
The Imperishable True Spirits already rushed forward, charging towards the Domain Barrier.
"Strike now!"
Old Man Xiao commanded in a deep voice.
Boom!
The Realm Master Realm Experts all struck out, sweeping away the weaker Imperishable True Spirits, but soon, under Muxiao's command, the True Spirits comparable to Realm Master level directly targeted them, igniting a fierce battle.
As for the rest of the Imperishable True Spirits, although weaker, their sheer numbers created an incredibly powerful force.
"All Supreme Sovereign Realm Warriors, come and hunt the Imperishable True Spirits!"
An array of Supreme Sovereigns excitedly and nervously ascended to the edge of the Domain.
This was their first time stepping out of the Domain and into the Land of Imperishable.
After all, before this, due to the existence of the Taihe Domain Barrier, they were unable to leave the Domain.
Boom!
Outside the Domain, a fierce battle erupted, and the figure of Muxiao also appeared, wielding a long whip, aiming to kill the explosive Dragon Might intimidating True Spirits, Ao Lie.
Boom!
Tian Zi, holding the lightning, struck out, completely blocking the opponent's attack.
"Your opponent is me!"
Muxiao looked at Tian Zi, then glanced at the Domain, feeling somewhat puzzled, always feeling that the Taihe Domain seemed somewhat unusual.
Especially Tian Zi, whose strength seemed not weaker than a Master of Domain, fully capable of blocking him, and he had a feeling that if he stepped into the Domain, he might be suppressed!
"Quite lively.
Li Xuan looked up towards the battle outside the Domain, which continued, as numerous True Spirits fell, but also Supreme Sovereign Realm Warriors were severely injured and retreated back into the Domain.
The Imperishable True Spirits were too numerous, this was Muxiao's meticulous preparation, clearly taking a considerable amount of time to bring such a large horde of True Spirits.
"It's time for Fang Hao to make a grand show of skills," Fang Hao said excitedly.
Such a huge horde of True Spirits was the perfect time for deploying the Qimen Martial Arts, setting up the Great Slaughter Formation, and encircling and killing a massive number of True Spirits.
It was also time to let the name of Qinghua Sect Master, Qimen Fang Hao, thunder across the Domain.
Fang Hao ascended step by step towards the outside of the Domain.
Nine Mountains, Demon Clan territory.
The Great Wilderness Nine Mountains belonged to the Demon Clan territory, which was already a well-known fact among Martial Artists above the Immortal Heavenly Venerable.
"Our Demon Clan's chance has come, devour True Spirits, strengthen ourselves, they are our food, the best nourishment for our Demon Clan!"
Red Cat spoke in a deep voice.
"All Demon Marshals, follow me to the outside of the Domain, to battle!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1021 - 528: Battle Beyond the Heavens, The Formation Shows Its Might_2
chapters.content:
Red Cat sat on the throne, several Great Demons lifting the throne, rushing straight outside the Domain.
Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha both had helpless expressions; even at this time, Red Cat still did not forget to flaunt the majesty of his status as the Great Demon King.
Outside the Great Wilderness Domain, the battle had become extremely fierce, but there were too many Imperishable True Spirits, individuals like Old Man Xiao, Taimiao, Heavenly Slaughter, Taihe, and Taikun, each of them facing off against two Imperishable True Spirits.
Some weaker Realm Masters could only battle a single Imperishable True Spirit, barely holding off those at the Realm Master Level.
However, the number of Imperishable True Spirits below the Realm Master Level was vast, and the Supreme Sovereign Realm Warriors were finding it difficult to resist, with some True Spirits reaching the Domain Barrier, triggering the obstruction of the Heavenly Dao Rules.
As a result, this was bound to have a certain impact on the Power of Heavenly Dao used by Tian Zi.
Moreover, the Power of Heavenly Dao Rules spreading outside the Domain inherently could not exert the true power of the Heavenly Dao.
Tian Zi, wielding thunderbolts, was only just managing to hold off Muxiao, entangling him to prevent him from targeting individuals like Old Man Xiao and others.
Muxiao was unhurried in his actions, continuously striking but not approaching the Domain any closer, similarly entangling Tian Zi, preventing him from freeing up more power to target True Spirits rushing toward the Domain.
Boom!
More and more True Spirits were charging towards the Domain; eventually, even the Divine Venerate Realm Warriors within the Great Wilderness Domain had no choice but to act, intercepting a greater number of powerful True Spirits at the front of the Domain Barrier.
They dared not venture too far from the Domain Barrier, lest they encountered a Supreme Sovereign Level True Spirit and found it impossible to retreat to the safety of the Domain.
On the side of the Great Wilderness Domain, under such a massive assault of True Spirits, the situation seemed extremely passive and even began to show signs of defeat. Once forced to fall back inside the Domain, they would be in a very disadvantageous position.
"Old Turtle, if you keep playing dead, you'll really die!"
Tian Zi said looking towards a certain place in Azure Sea.
Azure Sea Turtle had a look of helplessness but had no choice but to act.
Boom!
The giant turtle rose into the air and moved outside the Domain, its colossal body like a mountain, and also like a giant shield.
"My strength has not yet recovered; I can only assist in defense."
Azure Sea Turtle said helplessly.
"Azure Sea Turtle? You actually survived?"
Taihe said with a look of astonishment.
"Fortunately, just a little faster."
Azure Sea Turtle said with an embarrassed smile.
Taihe's eyebrows raised slightly. If it was said that the Azure Sea Turtle survived a calamity due to its strong defenses, he would be somewhat convinced. But if it was said it survived by outspeeding the calamity, he would never believe it.
This turtle's survival likely had other reasons.
Taihe didn't continue probing. Surviving that catastrophe, for whatever reason, indeed spelled good fortune.
Azure Sea Turtle's massive body resisted the assault of the Imperishable True Spirits, with a host of Supreme Sovereign Warriors using Azure Sea Turtle as a shield, continuously attacking the incoming True Spirits.
Even so, there were still too many True Spirits, and the Great Wilderness Domain continued to show signs of defeat, the Supreme Sovereign Realm Warriors managing to stabilize the situation for a moment, but the Divine Venerate Realm Warriors were beginning to falter.
The Divine Venerate Level True Spirits, although not particularly strong, were too numerous, their combined momentum terrifying, and they also diverted a portion of the Power of Heavenly Dao Rules.
"We can't hold on much longer!"
A warrior wailed.
Boom!
All at once, within the Domain, radiance illuminated, streaks of light soaring like shooting stars, descending in all directions, and in an instant, the scene of slaughter emerged, hundreds of True Spirits being obliterated on the spot.
A young man approached step by step, slapping on the Weapon Box, a myriad of flows soaring out, while the Formation Weapon in his hand whirled and scattered in all directions.
In but a moment, one after another, Great Formations activated.
"Qinghua Sect, Qimen's Fang Hao!"
Fang Hao said indifferently.
Raising his head to glance at Muxiao, he then steadily walked into the midst of the True Spirit Horde, his Array Plate flying out from his hand.
"Fellow warriors, follow me in operating the Great Formation, and annihilate the True Spirits!"
The warriors reacted with excitement and astonishment at the unfathomable and unbelievable Formation Path.
Following Fang Hao's arrival and the deployment of the Great Formation, the pressure on the warriors was instantaneously reduced, and the force of the True Spirits' assault was weakened by the first barrier of the Great Formation.
With every flick of Fang Hao's hand, the Qimen Great Formation unleashed a torrent of myriad weapons from the Weapon Box, slaughtering the peerless, cutting down the True Spirits wherever they passed.
It was almost like a single person was slaughtering a horde of True Spirits.
Muxiao's gaze turned cold as he looked at Fang Hao, then shifted towards the Domain, his heart shaking.
"Taicang, truly skillful strategies, to have such an arrangement."
This Formation Path was indeed inconceivable, the Spiritual Energy being manipulated in an instant, and the Transforming Energy of the Land of Imperishable channeled into forces of slaughter.
"Hmph!"
Muxiao snorted coldly, his figure moving, ready to kill Fang Hao.
"Your opponent is me!"
Tian Zi's face showed dissatisfaction. Did he appear so weak?
To battle against him, yet dare to be distracted, seeking to deal with others?
With that thought, Tian Zi also grew angry.
Boom!
The domain trembled, the mysterious power of the Heavenly Dao Rules manifested, with purple thunder instantly surging forth. Under Tian Zi's control, it thundered towards Muxiao.
Boom!
Muxiao dared not be careless, bursting with an aura as he resisted the attack of the purple thunder. His body emitted a dark and ominous energy. For the moment, under Tian Zi's assault, he could not extricate himself and escape.
"This is not the power of Taicang Daoism; has Taicang altered the Domain Dao Rule, or even improved it?"
Muxiao furrowed his brows.
After having been dead for such an extensive period of time, Taicang could still leave behind such an arrangement?
Muxiao swung his whip, producing thunder-like cracking sounds. As the whip's echo spread, the Land of Imperishable was once again besieged by a horde of Imperishable True Spirits.
Boom!
This time, the impact shook the domain. Clearly, Muxiao had prepared for a long time; otherwise, he would not have been able to summon such a vast number of True Spirits or gather such a formidable horde.
The pressure on the warriors increased dramatically, even though Fang Hao made his move, even though he had deployed a Great Formation, significantly weakening the first wave of the True Spirits' impact.
Nevertheless, the situation continued to deteriorate.
"Who will replace me to block these two True Spirits? I'll go and intimidate the rest."
Ao Lie, while battling two powerful True Spirits, spoke up.
He wanted to use the might of the True Dragon to intimidate the weaker True Spirits and break Muxiao's power over them.
However, the other Realm Masters had no strength to spare, to take his place in fending off the two True Spirits.
Roar!
Just then, a tiger's roar sounded.
All eyes turned, and within the domain, a group of Spirit Beasts was carrying a chair gleaming with golden light, upon which sat a Splendid Giant Tiger.
The Splendid Giant Tiger, holding a large saber, had fierce eyes that exuded authority, silently watching those True Spirits.
"What is this?"
"The Great Demon King of the Demon Clan?"
All the warriors were startled. Wasn't this Splendid Giant Tiger the Great Demon King of the Nine Mountains of the Great Wilderness?
It was rumored that the Great Demon King had a formidable background, hence no Realm Master Level expert dared to act against him, letting him gather Spirit Beasts and establish the Demon Clan.
"A pack of brainless beasts, watch how I, Red Cat, the Great Demon King, tame them!"
Red Cat stood up from the chair, large saber in hand, exuding a vast Demon's Might.
Roar!
After a roar that echoed like a mountain, he transformed into a massive tiger, his demonic aura billowing. The Great Demon's Might shook the surrounding area, and in a mere moment, a part of the rushing True Spirits trembled and prostrated before him.
This scene left all onlookers astonished.
Although the True Spirits that submitted were not particularly strong, barely at Divine Venerate Level strength, this was the first time they had been subdued and broken free from Muxiao's control by the Great Demon King's might!
This suggested that the might of the Demon Clan was capable of taming True Spirits.
Red Cat stood proudly, his saber sweeping through the air, the Great Demon's Might stirring violently as he displayed a Great Demon Ability. In an instant, demonic energy billowed, and the demonic wind surged.
The originally charging True Spirits came to a halt, slowly retreating backwards.
"Haha, foolish beasts, how can they defy the might of the Great Demon King!"
Red Cat was ecstatic.
Finally, he could demonstrate his might, showcasing to these powerful beings the strength and commanding presence of the Great Demon King.
Roar!
Yu Xiaolong also rushed over. Although it had the body of a True Dragon, unlike Ao Lie and others from the True Dragon Clan, its dragon might was more akin to an overwhelming demonic might.
Moreover, its entire body was enshrouded in demonic energy.
Croak!
Little Ha grew to the size of a mountain, equally shrouded in demonic energy. He opened his massive mouth to exhale, revealing a vortex that pulled in True Spirits, shredding them with the spatial forces contained within!
At this moment, warriors were shocked to discover that the three Great Demon Kings of the Nine Mountains were each exceedingly extraordinary, their Demon Clan Divine Skills even more potent and inconceivable than the might of those True Spirits led by the True Dragon Clan.

chapters.title: Chapter 1022 - 529: Striking in Succession, Muxiao's Shock
chapters.content:
Muxiao looked toward Red Cat, his eyes growing cold and lethal intentions continuously emerging.
Demon Clan?
This was a measure left behind by Taicang, specifically aimed at him.
The so-called might of the Demon Clan actually intimidated the True Spirits, causing those driven by him to gradually break free from his control, showing some subservience to the Demon Clan.
This tiger must not be spared!
He couldn't help but recall that battle long ago when a similar Splendid Giant Tiger had roared and charged at him, its formidable might as a Heavenly Tiger intimidating the True Spirits he commanded.
Although he had emerged victorious in that battle, the losses were substantial.
"You, must die!"
Muxiao spoke coldly.
Boom!
He wanted to kill Red Cat but was entangled by Tian Zi, who was overjoyed at the moment.
"Red Cat, well done! These Imperishable True Spirits are a great supplement for your Demon Clan, quickly subdue them, capture them, and strengthen the Demon Clan!"
Red Cat raised its head and said, "Haha, this food delivered to my Demon Clan, I naturally must accept it!"
Boom!
The might of the demon surged. Even though True Spirits of the Supreme Sovereign level could not yet be intimidated and subdued, those of the Divine Venerate level shivered under its demonic might, unable to exert their strength, making them easy prey.
Whoosh!
Red Cat lifted a paw, demonic light blooming, a giant Demon Seal emerged, casting demonic seals into the heads of the True Spirits.
Plop!
The True Spirits targeted by the Demon Seals actually prostrated themselves, seemingly subdued.
Red Cat was thrilled, what an unexpected delight.
Suddenly, it felt an intense murderous intent. Looking up, Muxiao's eyes were a ghastly green, and the bone spikes on his head emitted a chilling light.
That horrifying murderous intent targeted him like thousands of steel needles.
Red Cat instinctively shrank its head, for Muxiao was of Master of Domain level strength, able to kill it as easily as crushing a small grasshopper.
But it straightened its back almost immediately, glaring back fiercely, brandishing its blade arrogantly at Muxiao, and said with contempt, "What are you staring at, you ugly thing, how dare you glare at me?"
It considered itself a tiger raised by the Taoist Ancestor, trivial Muxiao was nothing!
Muxiao's eyes grew greener with anger, his murderous intent surging. However, Tian Zi gave him no opportunity.
"Red Cat, well done, keep going!"
Tian Zi was ecstatic.
"No problem!"
Red Cat, bursting with energy, continued to cast the Demon Seal, while Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha sealed the prostrated True Spirits and threw them into the Domain.
Although Red Cat had subdued some True Spirits, the number of Imperishable True Spirits summoned by Muxiao was too great, and the side of the Great Wilderness Domain was still at a disadvantage.
From time to time, True Spirits charged toward the Domain Barrier, triggering strikes by the Heavenly Dao Rules.
"Transforming True Spirits into demons? Not a bad idea!"
Li Xuan, observing the changes outside the Domain, was slightly surprised.
The Demon Clan could subdue True Spirits so easily?
That indeed was a pleasant surprise.
"It's been a while since I took action. Since it's so lively outside, I might as well join in and use this opportunity to hone my martial arts," Meng Chong said, touching his head and hurriedly heading outside the Domain.
"I'll join the fun too!"
Jiang Buping grabbed his spear and also rushed to the battlefield outside the Domain.
Seeing that his second senior brother and fifth junior brother had also gone, I might as well join in the fun, soothe those warriors, and help them recover from their injuries," Su Lingxiu said, excitedly taking Yue'er and Zhou Ying with her.
Of course, she was not going to fight.
She was there to heal and save people, helping the warriors regain their strength was also an opportunity to let these Domain warriors witness the mysteries of the Alchemical Medical Martial Arts.
After a fierce battle, including warriors of the Supreme Sovereign Realm, many were seriously injured and healing within the Domain Barrier, unable to continue fighting.
Even a Realm Master was injured and severely depleted but had no choice but to grit his teeth and persist.
After all, once a Realm Master retreated, the unhampered Realm Master level True Spirits would cause a tremendous impact, potentially causing an immediate defeat in the battle.
In the midst of the battle, the warriors suddenly saw, from within the Domain, the emergence of a figure like a Heavenly God.
A giant hundreds of zhang tall, his body radiant with golden light, as if clad in armor, or like rolling golden waves surrounding him.
"It's Heavenly God Meng Chong, he has become so powerful!"
The appearance of Meng Chong immediately elicited exclamations.
Muxiao's expression changed again, looking at Meng Chong with doubt.
"What kind of martial arts is this? Did Taicang leave such powerful martial arts within the Domain?"
He was somewhat shocked. "If Taicang had not died and lived to this day, how strong would his strength be?"
With this thought, Muxiao couldn't help but admire Taicang. If Taicang were alive today, his strength might very well be beyond the reach of the Imperishable Temple.
"Die!"
Meng Chong punched out, directly exploding a True Spirit!
Such a domineering and fierce scene took Muxiao by surprise, this physical strength was even more fearsome than the Imperishable True Spirits!
Meng Chong directly entered the fray among the True Spirits, and Divine Venerate level True Spirits couldn't withstand even one of his punches. At that moment, unleashing his full strength, he freely demonstrated the might of the Physical Body Martial Arts.
As Meng Chong took action, all the warriors, even those Realm Masters in the midst of the battle, were deeply shocked. This physical strength, this brutal power, was indeed terrifying!
If they were of the same realm, they too might not be able to withstand his ferocious punch.

chapters.title: Chapter 1023 - 529: Taking Action One After Another, Muxiao's Shock_2
chapters.content:
Hum!
Just then, another figure appeared, holding a sharp Long Spear. As the spear emerged, a host of Divine Venerate Realm Warriors suddenly felt their Divine Souls tremble.
Even though the spear was not aimed at them, a mere glance made them feel discomfort in their Divine Souls!
"Is this... Martial Arts targeting the Divine Soul Consciousness?"
Muxiao was shocked once again.
At this moment, he looked towards the Great Wilderness Domain, his eyes revealing a hint of apprehension.
The changes in this Domain exceeded expectations!
When Jiang Buping made his move, although he lacked Meng Chong's wild ferocity, his strides and the bloom of spear light instantly obliterated the consciousness of several Imperishable True Spirits, leaving only their bodies.
"I'll help you recover!"
Just then, a burst of azure light shone forth, and a beautiful young girl stepped forward, leaving behind endless vitality wherever she passed.
With a flick of her slender hand, azure needle glints emerged and pierced into an injured warrior's body, instantly healing his wounds and even restoring his expended energy.
At the same time, various Pills dispersed.
Soon afterward, several more azure needles and Pills fell upon a Realm Master who had been seriously depleted. Within moments, the Realm Master's depleted energy was restored, reviving him as if fully healed, driving the True Spirit he was battling into a steady retreat.
What shocked the warriors even more was that wherever the girl passed, the True Spirits' vitality was extinguished, seemingly transferred to the injured, allowing them to recover instantly.
More terrifying was that the girl condensed a Pill Furnace out of thin air, harvested the True Spirits' vitality and essence blood, and refined them into Pills.
The warriors, who had been severely injured and powerless to fight, were now howling and eagerly rejoined the battlefield, sparing no thought for their own safety and showing no fear of getting injured again.
"A severed arm is but a minor injury!"
A warrior's arm had been severed, but with a wave of the girl's hand, a Pill fell into his mouth, transferring the vitality of a True Spirit into his body.
In no time at all, the warrior with the severed arm miraculously grew a new arm.
This miraculous scene left all the warriors in utter shock, including Old Man Xiao, Taimiao, and Yu Yao, who were greatly astounded.
They knew Su Lingxiu was extraordinary with her Alchemical Medical techniques, profoundly mysterious, yet they could never have imagined she'd reach such miraculous extents.
"Truly worthy of being the Taoist Ancestor's true lineage!"
Old Man Xiao sighed.
He couldn't help but recall that battle long ago. If Su Lingxiu had been present in that fight, and if her strength had been comparable to a Master of Domain, the outcome might have been different.
It wasn't just Old Man Xiao who thought this way; Taimiao, Taihe, Taikun, Seductive Witch, and others shared the same thought. If Su Lingxiu, an alchemist of such prowess, had been there during that battle, the outcome might have been different.
The former Master of the Qing Ling Domain, whose true form was the Qingling Jade Bamboo, could aid in recovery but couldn't achieve what Su Lingxiu did, and there were also restrictions.
Moreover, the Master of the Qing Ling Domain had to contend with formidable enemies herself and did not refine Pills. She used her abilities to heal and restore others, which resulted in significant personal loss.
Su Lingxiu was different. Her Pills were profound and could be refined on the battlefield, or even prepared beforehand, allowing warriors to use them for treatment and replenishment during intense battles.
What was even more shocking was Su Lingxiu's ability to strip vitality and reverse life and death.
Directly transferring the Imperishable True Spirit's vitality to aid the injured, such an ability had surpassed everyone's understanding.
The appearance of Red Cat brought out Muxiao's fierce murderous intent, sensing the potential threat, but Su Lingxiu's arrival weighed even heavier on his heart.
Compared to Red Cat, the threat of Su Lingxiu was evidently greater, a critical menace!
"This woman must die!"
Muxiao thought coldly.
"What kind of contingency has Taicang prepared? If time is allowed for growth, and a new Master of Domain emerges, it will become even harder to conquer the Taicang Domain."
Muxiao proceeded with his battle against Tian Zi without showing any outward signs.
The bone spikes on his head, however, emitted a faint glow as if summoning something or transmitting a message.
Muxiao knew he couldn't break away from Tian Zi to kill Su Lingxiu, so he had to resort to another hidden move.
As long as Su Lingxiu lived, he could not rest easy!
Those warriors who had already been demoralized and lost combat ability suddenly saw their morale and fighting spirit soar with Su Lingxiu's arrival. The injured who had retreated from the battlefield rejoined the fight against True Spirits.
Especially those Realm Masters, who had already been greatly depleted and could not have lasted much longer, were revitalized under Su Lingxiu's intervention, becoming more vigorous and forcing the combating True Spirits into a continuous retreat.
As this give and take continued, the driven Imperishable True Spirits no longer possessed their initial berserk impact.
Muxiao again looked at Meng Chong and Jiang Buping; these two were also extraordinarily fiendish, seemingly not strong yet possessing an overwhelming momentum when they struck.
"They must all die!"
Muxiao thought coldly.
"This time, scouting the Taicang Domain was a very wise decision, as it provided early insights into some of Taicang's arrangements and backups."
Muxiao pondered silently.
Spikes on his head continued to emit light, even causing invisible fluctuations to vibrate.
"Exhilarating!"
Meng Chong punched a True Spirit to explosion, exhaled deeply, his blood boiling with excitement.
This was the essence of Physical Body Martial Arts combat.
Never had he experienced such a thrilling and intense battle; this attack fully showcased the ferocity and dominance of Physical Body Martial Arts.
Although there were many True Spirits, Meng Chong felt no fear being surrounded, his every move killed another True Spirit, and he even ignored the attacks from the True Spirits.
True Spirits pounced on him, but couldn't inflict any injuries, instead, they were directly exploded by him.
An Imperishable True Spirit comparable to a Supreme Sovereign level charged at him.
"Be careful!"
A Supreme Sovereign Warrior's face changed as he spoke.
Meng Chong roared, and a massive shadow of lifting heaven appeared over him, transforming him instantaneously into a giant who grabbed the firmament and smashed it down ferociously.
Divine Skills, Heaven Lifting Earth Extinguishing!
Boom!
Such a shocking and wild scene once again stunned many warriors.
"What kind of fierce Martial Arts is this!"
With one strike, that True Spirit was smashed to death!
Muxiao's pupils shrank, horrified as he watched Meng Chong, although Meng Chong was still far from matching his power.
However, that strike was extremely terrifying; even he felt the immense lethality it contained.
"If he were at the same level as me, that strike would have been enough to kill me completely!"
Muxiao thought with a shock.
If Meng Chong's strength were almost equal to his, Muxiao knew he couldn't withstand such a brutal attack, and would be directly smashed into ash!
"This boy must not be left alive!"
Muxiao couldn't help but look toward the Taicang Domain again, wondering how such monstrous beings kept emerging. If Taicang weren't to perish, how terrifying would this domain's strength become?
"Were these powerful Dharma methods researched by Taicang before his death?"
Muxiao's heart grew heavy.
If Taicang had not perished earlier, his current strength might have surpassed that figure in the Imperishable Temple!
"I can no longer afford to give the Taicang Domain any more time to grow."
Muxiao felt that he must accelerate his efforts, lest there still be other monsters within the domain who haven't shown their hands.
Once these monsters break through to Master of Heaven and Earth level strength, for the Imperishable Temple, they would definitely pose a huge challenge and threat.
Just from Meng Chong's strike just now, if he were already at Master of Heaven and Earth level, the power wielded, except for the one from the Imperishable Temple, none of the other Supreme Beings of the same level could withstand it.
"Fortunately, I came to scout this time. Since these geniuses have appeared, they shouldn't think of returning to the domain and must be eradicated here."
Thinking this made Muxiao feel slightly relieved.
His long whip swung continuously, making snapping sounds, those Imperishable True Spirits, as if being driven, became increasingly fierce and violent, issuing roars, the momentum of their assault on the domain skyrocketing instantly.
In the Land of Imperishable, an endless stream of Imperishable True Spirits still rushed over, joining the assault on the domain. Apart from the True Spirits driven by Muxiao, some, inherently desiring to enter the domain, sensed an opportunity and joined the fray.
"There are just too many Imperishable True Spirits; how long do we need to keep killing them?"
Su Lingxiu frowned as she spoke.
"No matter how many True Spirits he drives, they're ultimately limited. Just keep killing, I refuse to believe his driven True Spirits can be endless and inexhaustible!"
Meng Chong said with a cold laugh.

chapters.title: Chapter 1024 - 530: The Great Dao Is My Sword, Heaven and Earth Lord-Level True Spirit
chapters.content:
"Second Senior Brother, not everyone is like you, capable of fighting continuously without ever growing tired,"
Su Lingxiu gave Meng Chong a glance as she spoke.
Meng Chong looked around at the other Martial Artists. Although they had been given pills by Su Lingxiu to replenish their energy, the long battle had still left many of them with a look of fatigue on their faces.
And yet, the Imperishable True Spirits kept charging, showing no signs of retreat.
These Imperishable True Spirits, after all, had no Spiritual Wisdom, only the instincts of beasts. Driven by Muxiao, the instinctual fear and reticence of the creatures had been greatly diminished.
And so, even after many had been slain, they showed no intention of retreating.
Unless the force driving the True Spirits by Muxiao was broken.
However, Muxiao was a being of the Master of Heaven and Earth Realm, and neither Red Cat nor Ao Lie were strong enough; they could only break Muxiao's controlling force over the True Spirits within a certain range.
"If we truly can't hold out, at worst we can retreat within the Heavenly Dao Rules and depend on them for defense, after all, we should be able to withstand this assault,"
Meng Chong thought aloud after a moment.
Su Lingxiu nodded at these words. Even if they couldn't withstand this onslaught, they still had their master to fall back on. This could be seen as a part of their training.
"Second Senior Brother, Third Senior Sister, I have a premonition that he seems to be preparing something,"
After extinguishing an Imperishable True Spirit with his spear, Jiang Buping came over and said somberly.
Su Lingxiu looked toward Muxiao, her delicate eyebrows raised, "Perhaps he wants to target me?"
"Third Junior Sister, be careful,"
Meng Chong cautioned.
"It's just a small matter, we have Master here,"
Su Lingxiu said unconcernedly.
Upon hearing this, both Meng Chong and Jiang Buping couldn't help but nod. Their master was within the Domain and should have been paying constant attention. No crisis could have eluded their master.
Besides, they each had a Jade Talisman from their master, sufficient to handle any potential dangers.
"When will Eldest Senior Brother make his move?"
With a flick of his finger, Fang Hao activated the Great Slaughter Formation, aiding his fellow Martial Artists in resisting wave after wave of the assault.
"Eldest Senior Brother is here!"
Su Lingxiu joyfully looked toward a specific direction.
Muxiao, who was currently entangled with Tian Zi, suddenly furrowed his brows, his face slightly darkening as he turned to look toward the young and handsome lad that was walking out from the Domain.
With each step the youth took out of the Domain, he gave off the impression of an unparalleled divine sword.
"Another one!"
Muxiao was shocked in his heart. Just how many trump cards had Taicang left behind that he was able to cultivate such exceptional talents? He wondered if there were even stronger prodigies within the Domain.
"If this person is of the Master of Heaven and Earth level..."
As Muxiao thought this, his expression turned grave. He had a feeling that if the young man were of the same realm as he, he certainly wouldn't be a match for him.
Hum!
As Xu Yan stepped into the Land of Imperishable, he looked at the True Spirit Horde, his heart surged with emotions. Although he hadn't reached the Establishing Dao Realm, he too had stepped out of the Domain.
He could be considered as having transcended the Domain!
With a raised hand, his Sword Intent flowed like a long river within the Land of Imperishable. The rampant Spiritual Energy and the pervasive Imperishable Qi all merged into this Sword Intent at this moment.
This was the ultimate sharp and destructive Sword Intent, like a surging wave it enveloped all in its path. The True Spirits trembled, and the ones that had been charging now issued low roars as they retreated backward.
Some of the weaker True Spirits turned and fled, hiding deeper into the Land of Imperishable.
"It's Sword God Xu Yan!"
The Seductive Witch, who was battling two Realm Master Level True Spirits, turned her head toward Xu Yan, her expression extremely complex.
From the first time she met Xu Yan to being duped by him in the Heavenly Grotto, not much time had passed, yet Xu Yan's strength had already grown to this extent.
Especially the terrifying Sword Intent which directly intimidated the Imperishable True Spirits, it was even more formidable than the deterrence of Red Cat and Ao Lie.
"Perhaps in ten years, or even less, his strength will surpass mine!"
The Seductive Witch thought silently to herself.
That Yu Zhu, there was no way to take it back any longer.
Perhaps, it was a good thing after all, using a Supreme Treasure to resolve the animosity between them.
No, that's not right!
Upon further reflection, the Seductive Witch realized Xu Yan never held any grudges against her, it was she who bore grudges against him. She had always been at a disadvantage, Xu Yan had never suffered at her hands.
Thinking this, the Seductive Witch felt somewhat upset.
Xu Yan walked step by step toward the True Spirit Horde. Aside from the Realm Master Level True Spirits, the rest couldn't threaten him in any way.
Instead, with his powerful Sword Intent, he intimidated these True Spirits.
At this level of power, even weaker Realm Masters couldn't trouble him in the slightest.
Hum!
As Xu Yan traversed the Chaos of the Land of Imperishable, the area he passed through surprisingly revealed a landscape of mountains and rivers, as if a piece of landscape had been carved out within the Chaos itself.
Such a scene shocked everyone.
"This... Impossible!"
Muxiao was astounded.
Even though he could tell that the landscape was merely the manifestation of some power, not an actual landscape, this spectacle signified that if such power continued to grow stronger, it would certainly be able to carve out a true landscape within the Land of Imperishable.
This was beyond imagination!
The Seven Great Domain was established with the Open Heaven Purple Light. Apart from that, no other power has ever been known to carve out a Domain within the Land of Imperishable.
At least, as far as he knew, he had never heard of any power besides the Open Heaven Purple Light that could create a Domain within the Land of Imperishable. But the scene before him was telling him that someone had cultivated a miraculous power that could carve out a Domain in the Land of Imperishable.

chapters.title: Chapter 1025 - 530: The Great Dao Is My Sword, Heaven and Earth Lord-Level True Spirit_2
chapters.content:
What kind of powerful and wonderful strength is this.
It had already completely surpassed his understanding, even Muxiao felt a trace of fear in his heart!
"Taicang has already researched such miraculous power?"
Muxiao thought in shock, if in that battle back then Taicang hadn't died, or if he had launched his attack too late, how could the Imperishable Temple have stood a chance against Taicang?
"Could this person be the biggest trump card that Taicang left behind?"
Muxiao looked at Xu Yan, a strong murderous intent surging in his heart, stronger than the one towards Su Lingxiu and the others.
"He must die!"
Muxiao's eyes were filled with a cold light, his murderous intent not the slightest bit concealed.
"At all costs, he must be killed, others can be spared, but he must die!"
As long as Xu Yan could be killed, even if he couldn't kill Su Lingxiu and the others, he would find it worthwhile.
Among these people, the biggest threat was Xu Yan!
Boom!
Just at this moment, the Domain formed by Xu Yan's exhibition suddenly transformed into a Sword Domain. Violent Spiritual Energy poured into it madly, surrounded by Imperishable Qi.
Sword Intent, as if it had condensed into substance, turned into a vast, mighty flow of swords.
Within the sword flow, various Sword Intents converged, even containing certain supreme artistic conceptions.
True Spirits that came into contact with the sword flow were instantly annihilated.
With each step Xu Yan took, the sword flow grew longer and wider, and the Sword Intent more numerous—scorching, icy, sharp, gentle...
All the different Sword Intents, converging into the sword flow, formidable and spreading continuously.
Moreover, this sword flow continued to solidify; under the bombardment of Violent Spiritual Energy, it surged like waves, and with the whirling of Imperishable Qi, it seemed eternally undying.
With a single step, Xu Yan seemed to have entered a new realm, transcending shackles, and in an instant, the sword flow, the Sword Intent, all underwent a transformation, as if imbued with a holy significance.
All the sword-wielding Martial Artists discovered at this moment that their swords had slipped from their control, all turning towards Xu Yan, their tips bending in deference, as if in reverent worship!
Holy Sword Realm!
Li Xuan looked up at the firmament, watching Xu Yan breaking through the Holy Sword Realm, a gratified smile on his face.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has broken through to the Holy Sword Realm, your Holy Sword Realm has reached Great Achievement."
Xu Yan continued walking, the sword flow becoming wider and mightier. Suddenly, Xu Yan stopped, looking back at the path he had walked.
He looked at the vast sword flow crossing the Land of Imperishable, with the Domain transforming into a sword, countless Sword Intents merging and fusing together, seemingly following various rules.
At that moment, Xu Yan had an epiphany, as if he had seen a grand Dao of the Sword.
"So, this is what the Sword Dao Realm is like, I finally understand how to step into the Sword Dao Realm; the sword as Dao, the Dao as sword, that's how it is!"
Xu Yan had his enlightenment, the direction of the Dao of the Sword laid out before him. All he needed was to walk step by step, entering the path of the Sword Dao.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has realized the Sword Dao Realm, you have broken through the Sword Dao Realm."
The gratified smile on Li Xuan's face deepened.
"You have gained the Dao of the Sword!"
Watching the Dao of the Sword, Li Xuan's smile was radiant, finally stepping into the Dao Realm, his strength improving once again.
"Who can stand against my sword?"
