"My sword is the Dao, the Dao is my sword, with such a sword, who in the Land of Imperishable can withstand?"
At this moment, Li Xuan was brimming with confidence.
In the Creation Realm with the Tao Sword, once he took action, Li Xuan couldn't think of anyone who could resist.
The one from the Imperishable Temple?
"Worthy of being the true transmission of the Taoist Ancestor!"
Li Xuan thought to himself delightedly.
"Almost time, for the Taoist Ancestor to make a move again."
In the Land of Imperishable, there was a True Spirit drawing near, and its target was Xu Yan.
Initially, this True Spirit's target was Su Lingxiu, followed by Red Cat, then Meng Chong and the three others.
Now, the target of this True Spirit was Xu Yan, willing to give everything just to kill him; Su Lingxiu and the others could be temporarily spared.
This clearly showed how much Muxiao dreaded Xu Yan.
"A Heaven and Earth Lord-Level True Spirit comparable to the Domain Master, could it be the one that has always accompanied Muxiao from the start?"
Li Xuan speculated thoughtfully.
As Xu Yan made his move in the battle beyond the heavens, the assault of the Imperishable True Spirits began to weaken continuously.
Especially since Xu Yan had broken through to the Holy Sword Realm, with sweeping Sword Intent that flowed endlessly, the Violent Spiritual Energy and Imperishable Qi of the Land of Imperishable morphed into Sword Intent, merging into the sword streams.
The sword streams spread, stirring in all directions.
Wherever they passed, Imperishable True Spirits were slain, and even more of them let out low growls, fleeing in all directions.
Xu Yan's Sword Intent covered an extremely wide range, instantly causing the True Spirits within a certain area either to be annihilated or to retreat into the depths of the Land of Imperishable with trembling growls, breaking free from Muxiao's driving force.
With this, the pressure on the warriors decreased dramatically in an instant.
Even the Martial Artists at the Realm Master Realm were revitalized and began to press down on the True Spirits in battle.
Where Xu Yan stood, vast sword streams flowed. He stepped forward, and wherever he went, True Spirits crumbled, covering an increasingly wider area, and it wouldn't be long before the crisis of the True Spirit assault would be resolved.
Boom!
With a lift of his hand, Xu Yan caused piercing sword lights to suddenly rise in the Land of Imperishable, standing in the chaos of the Land of Imperishable, emanating a chilling sharpness.
These sword lights, all condensed from Imperishable Qi and Violent Spiritual Energy, each radiated a type of Sword Intent, whether sharp, gentle, blazing, or ice-cold...
And where these sword lights stood, it was as if they formed a landscape of mountains and rivers, a sword-shaped landscape of heavens and earth.
It was as if each sword light contained within it a small domain, and between the hazy layers, one could see the scenes of heaven and earth within the sword lights.
This sight once again shocked all the warriors.
The murderous intent in Muxiao's heart grew even colder.
He lashed his long whip, and with the sound of cracking, as the sound of the whip resounded, True Spirits howled and surged from all around, rushing towards Xu Yan like a tide.
Even more so, these True Spirits no longer targeted the Domain but shifted their aim, charging straight at Xu Yan!
Xu Yan's eyes were calm, not taking it seriously, and with a lift of his hand, "Ten Directions Annihilation!"
Hum!
The sword lights burst into a fierce glow, and in an instant, covered the charging True Spirits.
The intent of annihilation erupted in an instant; in the Land of Imperishable, a blinding light flashed, and wherever the light covered, everything seemed to be annihilated.
Roar!
The roars of countless True Spirits rang out, with various violent powers erupting, True Spirits pouring out their forces, trying to resist the smothering force.
Boom!
Sword lights shattered, the glow dimmed, the violent force of the True Spirits was bursting continuously.
Xu Yan's expression remained unchanged, and with a wave of his hand, sword lights emerged incessantly, the violent Spiritual Energy and pervasive Imperishable Qi constantly turned into sword lights.
The Ten Directions Annihilation Sword was continuously executed, and later on, Xu Yan's raised hand almost merged with the Chaos Primordial Land as he unleashed the Heaven-defying Sword.
The black sword light was nearly invisible in the midst of chaos.
Only that terrifying intent, to annihilate everything with sharpness and slaughter, shocked those in all directions.
With one strike, one after another, Imperishable True Spirits were obliterated.
But there were simply too many Imperishable True Spirits; they couldn't be entirely killed off in a short while and kept on surging towards Xu Yan.
"Kill, to relieve Sword God of the pressure!"
A warrior roared and took action to restrain the True Spirits rushing toward Xu Yan.
"Senior brother's Sword Dao is truly powerful!"
Meng Chong let out a sigh of admiration. With a wave of his hand, the sword light bloomed dominantly, and his overwhelming Sword Intent surged forth.
Hum!
As Meng Chong unleashed his cut, in a moment, numerous True Spirits were obliterated in the sword light; Meng Chong was also contemplating the Dao of the sword at this moment.
Swish!
Suddenly, everyone's expression changed, as among the True Spirits charging at Xu Yan, one moved extraordinarily fast to kill Xu Yan, and the aura of this True Spirit was extremely terrifying.
A Heaven and Earth Lord-Level Imperishable True Spirit!
Old Man Xiao, Heavenly Slaughter, Taihe, Taikun, and the others all had drastic changes in their expressions, never expecting Muxiao to command a Heaven and Earth Lord-Level Imperishable True Spirit!
Perhaps it was not a mere act of commandment; this True Spirit seemed to have an unusual relationship with him. He could command such a vast horde of True Spirits, which probably had something to do with this particular one.
With long red bone spurs, its head appeared to grow a blade, its four claws were blood-red, its whole body covered in scales, with a slender tail ending in a bone spur like a spear blade.
This fierce True Spirit, incredibly swift, charged at Xu Yan, unveiling its wild power in an instant. It was an all-out strike intended to leave no room for Xu Yan to escape.
At the same time, Muxiao unleashed a powerful attack, wildly attacking Tian Zi, aiming to restrain Tian Zi from rescuing!

chapters.title: Chapter 1026 - 531: Li Xuan Makes a Move, That is the Taoist Ancestor
chapters.content:
"Big Brother!"
Even though she knew that Li Xuan had Master's Jade Talisman on him, meaning his life wouldn't be in danger, the sudden appearance of this True Spirit and unexpected turn of events still made Su Lingxiu cry out in alarm.
The others were even more shocked and dismayed.
"Not good, retreat quickly!"
Taihe, Taimiao, and a few other powerful beings cried out, even wanting to join forces to block this Heaven and Earth Lord-Level True Spirit, but it was already too late.
This True Spirit was not only at the Master of Heaven and Earth level, but it also lurked among the attacking group of True Spirits, only revealing itself and launching an attack once it got close to Xu Yan's Sword Array.
Ever since Xu Yan had appeared, the Seductive Witch's attention had been almost entirely on him; after all, she had suffered several losses at his hands, and even her Supreme Treasure had been stolen by him.
Yet, she was helpless against Xu Yan!
Even she didn't understand why she subconsciously drew closer to Xu Yan, leading the two Imperishable True Spirits she was restraining toward him as well.
Was she approaching Xu Yan seeking an opportunity for revenge?
The Seductive Witch questioned herself, certain she didn't harbor such a thought, but if it wasn't for revenge, why would she subconsciously draw near to Xu Yan?
She couldn't figure it out for a while, but she did it unconsciously nevertheless.
When a Heaven and Earth Lord-Level True Spirit suddenly attacked Xu Yan, the Seductive Witch's expression changed, and almost instinctively, she enveloped one of the True Spirits, which she had already subdued and which had lost the power to resist, in a pink light. With a flick of her wrist, she hurled this True Spirit toward the abruptly appearing one.
At the same time, she waved her other hand, sending a pink ribbon-like Divine Artifact flying toward Xu Yan, intending to ensnare him and pull him out of danger.
Although the Seductive Witch had acted instinctively, she was ultimately facing a Heaven and Earth Lord-Level True Spirit and was too late. The True Spirit she had thrown had not yet reached the other one, and the Divine Artifact, which had just been deployed, had not yet entwined Xu Yan. The fearsome attack of the True Spirit had already descended!
Just as everyone was horrified and some Martial Artists instinctively closed their eyes, unwilling to witness the scene, a hand stretched out from within the Domain.
This hand appeared silently and unnoticeably, a seemingly ordinary hand that didn't exude any sense of powerful aura or strength.
However, it was this hand that grabbed the Heaven and Earth Lord-Level True Spirit.
Then, with a gentle squeeze, there was a soft 'pop', and the Heaven and Earth Lord-Level True Spirit disintegrated into dust within an instant!
As easily and casually as if it had squashed an ant!
This scene, however, shocked everyone.
Old Man Xiao, Taihe, Taikun, Taimiao, the Seductive Witch, and others experienced a moment of bewilderment. There had been a time when a powerful Imperishable True Spirit, also comparable to the Master of Heaven and Earth level, came to the outskirts of the Taicang Domain.
This True Spirit sought to enter the Domain and take it over.
Likewise, a hand extended from within the Domain and killed the True Spirit with one strike!
That was their first time witnessing Taicang intervene, obliterate a True Spirit of comparable level to the Master of Heaven and Earth, and from that moment on, Taicang became invincible and unfathomable in their minds.
They finally understood why Taicang alone could subdue the Witches, the Netherworld, Ao Hong, and the other six beings—why even the haughty beings like the Netherworld and the Witches dared not defy Taicang!
And today, it was the same—a hand reached out from within the Domain.
Yet it was more shocking and unfathomable than when Taicang had acted!
Taicang's strike was an unmatched display of dominance!
But this hand simply stretched out gently and effortlessly pinched a Heaven and Earth Lord-Level True Spirit to death, as casually as if it crushed an ant.
"Taoist Ancestor!"
Old Man Xiao was excited inside.
Upon this intervention, the gap between Taicang and the Taoist Ancestor was apparent, and it seemed quite significant.
This hand, extended out, burst a Heaven and Earth Lord-Level True Spirit, and the remaining True Spirits immediately trembled with fear, with not a few dying from sheer terror.
The Realm Master Level True Spirits were growling and shaking, actually crouching to the ground.
"It's Master!"
Su Lingxiu exclaimed excitedly.
The Seductive Witch instinctively withdrew her ribbon-like Divine Artifact, her face showing a hint of embarrassment. She quickly glanced around and saw that no one else had noticed her intervention; only then did she sigh in relief, acting as though nothing had happened, and even showing a shocked expression like everyone else.
Muxiao felt a chill throughout his body, overwhelmed with fright.
Too terrifying!
"Taicang?"
Was that Taicang?
No!
Impossible, Taicang is already dead!
But if not Taicang, who could possess such dreadful power to crush his True Spirit with a single hand?
That was a Heaven and Earth Lord-Level True Spirit hardly any weaker than himself!
"Could it be, this is the contingency Taicang left behind, a new Master of Heaven and Earth has emerged in Taicang Domain?"
Even so, having such terrifying strength was impossible.
If the one who acted was the Master of Heaven and Earth, then what was Tian Zi?
No matter how you looked at it, Tian Zi was the true master of this Domain!
He controlled the Domain Dao Principles; besides him, how could there be another Master of Heaven and Earth?
Muxiao knew that the Taicang Domain had slipped from control and had become an unknown entity.
The one who had acted must be no less powerful than Taicang, perhaps even stronger!
But how could that be possible? Taicang's strength was already beyond comprehension, so why would there be someone on par with him or even stronger?

chapters.title: Chapter 1027 - 1027: 531 Chapter: Li Xuan Makes a Move, That's the Taoist Ancestor_2
chapters.content:
Muxiao grew more and more terrified. This mission was doomed to fail; he had to return immediately to the Imperishable Temple to report everything.
The plan had changed, and they needed to adjust their actions.
Even more so, it would require that individual to take personal action to achieve their goal!
With this thought, Muxiao's whip in hand suddenly shattered, turning into a terrible force that blasted open Tian Zi's seal. His figure flickered, and in an instant, he fled far away.
"Since you've come, why the hurry to leave? With such raging anger, why not come here and sweep the floors at this Taoist Ancestor's place to wear off that anger a bit."
A faint voice sounded.
Muxiao's expression drastically changed, and before he could react, he suddenly felt a tightness around his body, grasped firmly by a hand!
Like a grasshopper in the grip of a hand, his bones felt like they could break at any moment, and he was unable to muster any strength instantaneously.
His life was not in his own hands!
Muxiao's mind was filled with fear at the realization of such horrifying strength; he didn't even have the chance to flee, let alone resist.
His life or death was at the mercy of the other's thoughts.
With just a slightly firmer grasp of that hand, Muxiao had no doubt that he would dissipate into ash, just like his True Spirit.
Held in the grip of a hand, his senses had already been lost.
Outside of the Domain, everyone only saw a hand reach out and pinch to death a Master of Heaven and Earth level True Spirit.
Then they saw Muxiao break through Tian Zi's blockade and hurriedly flee into the distance.
The faint voice sounded from within the Domain as the hand reached out and captured the fleeing Muxiao, pulling him back inside the Domain.
The crisis Muxiao caused in the Domain by sending the True Spirit was thus resolved!
The crowd of Martial Artists, including those Realm Masters, all felt a sense of daze.
While at first they believed the individual who burst a Realm Master with a single hand provided a powerful shock to them, they thought it was just one Master of Domain at most.
They had not thought they would reach the Master of Heaven and Earth Realm, only that they were infinitely close.
It was unexpected but understandable that such a strong being existed within the Domain.
However, the scene just now made them realize that the individual was not as simple as a Master of Domain; in that individual's eyes, even Masters of Domain were like ants!
"Taoist Ancestor!"
At this moment, Old Man Xiao felt all the more how great a fortune it was to have been guided by the Taoist Ancestor in the past.
Taimiao was also in a daze. Her Tai Miao Illusionary Path and the Supreme Sovereign Path were beginning to merge, and it was all thanks to the guidance of that individual.
She had not expected that individual's strength to be so incredibly beyond imagination.
"Even Taicang seems not his match!"
Taimiao thought with a sense of astonishment in her heart.
Taihe, Taikun, and a few other ancient Minor Heaven and Earth Masters were completely stunned.
They had thought the changes in Taicang Domain were driven by the joint efforts of Tian Zi and that individual. With Tian Zi's status and the individual's great strength, it was not surprising they could accomplish it.
However, they did not believe they could withstand the Imperishable Temple.
After all, only those who had participated in that fierce great war knew the strength of the Imperishable Temple.
At their peak, both Taihe and Taikun neared the strength of the Master of Heaven and Earth Realm.
The strength of Masters of Domain varies greatly: Taicang is in a league of his own, followed by the Witch, Netherworld, Ao Hong, and then Fen Yun, Hong Ze, and Qing Ling.
Those who opened their own Domain and those without one had different strengths as Masters of Domain.
For example, Muxiao, though a strong Master of Heaven and Earth Realm, was on the weaker side, even less so than Qing Ling.
The strength of the six great Masters of Domain like the Witch was considerably stronger than those of the Imperishable Temple.
In his heyday, the Witch could fight against three Masters of Domain from the Imperishable Temple alone.
Taihe and Taikun, when united, could also hold back a Master of Domain from the Imperishable Temple, which spoke of their strength during their prime.
After all, they were among the earliest to follow Taicang and had once claimed the Creation's purple light.
In theory, they also had the chance to ascend to the strength of the Master of Heaven and Earth level, but the Imperishable Temple's attack came too swiftly, not giving them time to improve.
Taihe, Taikun, and others often speculated that if the Imperishable Temple had arrived thousands or even tens of thousands of years later, Taicang might have made a breakthrough and entered a new echelon.
By then, if the Imperishable Temple were to strike again, the victor would surely have been Taicang!
The scene just now, with that hand stretching out of the Domain to effortlessly crush a Master of Heaven and Earth level True Spirit and easily capture Muxiao on the return, made Taihe and Taikun realize that individual's strength was extremely terrifying.
They even fantasized, could it be Brother Taicang?
Was he still alive?!
However, the two immediately fell into gloom, for Taicang had died!
"Who is he?"
Taihe and Taikun looked at each other, puzzled in their hearts.
With such terrifying strength, apart from Taicang, only that one from the Imperishable Temple could be the one, but clearly, he wouldn't be in Taicang Domain.
Otherwise, why would Muxiao need to use a True Spirit to attack the Domain?
"Master caught Muxiao and took him back; I'm going to dissect him and do some research!"
Su Lingxiu was very excited and hurried back to the Domain.
The rest of the Martial Artists broke out in a cold sweat upon hearing this.
Dissect Muxiao?
That was a Master of Heaven and Earth level strong warrior.
"This girl is not to be messed with, we must never provoke her!"
All the Realm Masters thought to themselves silently.
The girl looked gentle on the outside but was somewhat ruthless at heart. It was terrifying that she wanted to dissect and study even a Master of Heaven and Earth!
The great battle outside the Domain had ended, and naturally, the Realm Masters would take care of cleaning up the battlefield, Meng Chong, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping also returned to within the Domain immediately.
Xu Yan also turned to leave, but before he did, he glanced at the Seductive Witch.
The Seductive Witch's face turned red subconsciously, and her gaze became evasive, "Did Xu Yan notice that I made a move?"
"Impossible, with such a crisis facing him, how could he be distracted? He definitely didn't notice that I made a move."
Taking comfort in that thought, the Seductive Witch breathed a sigh of relief. But then another thought struck her, and she began to panic, "Oh no, that bastard Xu Yan wouldn't be thinking of looting treasures from me again, would he? The treasures I have left are few, what if he really asks for them? Do I give them to him or not?"
In a moment, the Seductive Witch's expression changed, completely flustered, sneakily glancing at Xu Yan, her demeanor exuding allure as if she was seducing someone.
"The Seductive Witch, she's not still hung up on her Yu Zhu, is she?"
Xu Yan walked away, and there was no way he was going to return the Yu Zhu to the Seductive Witch; he had already planted it in his own Domain.
Seeing Xu Yan leave, the Seductive Witch finally relaxed completely.
"Seductive Witch, you haven't fallen for that kid Xu Yan, have you?"
The Li Witch asked incredulously.
The way the Seductive Witch had just sneakily glanced at Xu Yan was indeed like a young girl stealthily looking at her crush, throwing him shy flirtatious looks.
"Get lost!"
The Seductive Witch glared at him and shouted angrily.
The Li Witch really dared to think! She fell for Xu Yan??
"Seductive Witch, I think it's quite good. If you really hook up with Xu Yan, that would be amazing, having such a powerful and tremendous backer."
The Li Witch spoke with a tempting tone.
"Bullshit!"
The Seductive Witch retorted angrily: "I have my dignity; I've lived for how many years? And how old is Xu Yan? I'm not that little girl Yu Yao, who could actually stoop to eating grass tenderer than tens or even hundreds of thousands of years old. She can do it!"
"Seductive Witch!"
Yu Yao exploded with anger, staring fiercely.
The Seductive Witch glanced at her sideways, "What, did I say something wrong?"
"You're dead!"
Yu Yao attacked in a rage, coming at her to kill.
The Seductive Witch was not the least bit intimidated, "Afraid of you? Dare to do it but not let others talk about it?"
The Li Witch was covered in cold sweat, his eyes desperately seeking help as he looked towards the Flame Demon and Duowu.
However, Duowu and the Flame Demon kept their distance, not wanting to get involved in this mess.
Swish!
Finally, someone intervened to separate Yu Yao and the Seductive Witch.
"Age is not a barrier; there's nothing to be ashamed of," Taimiao said with a light chuckle.
"Heh!"
The Seductive Witch laughed and turned to leave.
Yu Yao snorted coldly and glared at the Seductive Witch but did not continue to attack.
"Taimiao, who is that?"
Taihe and Taikun approached solemnly.
"That is the Taoist Ancestor!"
Taimiao said with a respectful expression.
"The injuries on your bodies and the energy entangling you, you may seek the Taoist Ancestor for healing. Only the Taoist Ancestor can save you."
Taimiao looked at the two with a solemn expression.
"Of course, the Taoist Ancestor is not easily seen, but you can seek out Su Lingxiu. I feel she might be very interested in the peculiar injuries and conditions on your bodies," Taimiao advised.

chapters.title: Chapter 1028 - 532: Teachings from the Taoist Ancestor
chapters.content:
Taoist Ancestor?
Once Taihe and Taikun heard this, their minds shook. What kind of existence was this?
However, Taimiao's guidance to find Su Lingxiu to heal their wounds stirred a thought in their hearts.
If their injuries could be healed, they would not need to constantly seal themselves, enduring the torment of erosion.
But thinking of Su Lingxiu's excited demeanor, shouting about dissecting Muxiao, they felt a bit uneasy. The girl wouldn't dissect them too, would she?
Taimiao seemed to sense their doubts and said, "Don't worry, that young girl is kind-hearted. She won't take your lives. To heal your injuries, how can you do so without making some sacrifices?"
Then, looking towards a certain spot in the Land of Imperishable with a cold gaze, he said solemnly, "With the Taoist Ancestor within the Domain, the schemes of the Imperishable Temple are doomed to fail."
Taihe and Taikun nodded.
The might of the Taoist Ancestor was beyond imagination and enough to protect the Domain.
"That's good!"
Taihe nodded.
If the Domain could be preserved, their disciple would not have to take that path of escape.
The figure of Tian Zi appeared, looking at the two and said with a curl of his lip, "Two old fellows, it's truly a wonder you're alive. If you want to advance further, then deeply comprehend my Heavenly Dao."
"What exactly is your Heavenly Dao?"
Taimiao asked with curiosity.
"Taimiao, you little lady, I'm not telling you!"
Tian Zi said with a look of proud coquettishness.
Taimiao glared at him annoyed, "Why are you so stingy? Taicang is gone now, and you're still dwelling on the past. I gave you so many delicacies and toys back then, and you don't remember any of it, do you?"
Tian Zi scratched his head, "Alright then, I, Tian Zi, am magnanimous and won't bicker with you, little lady."
After a pause, he said with triumph, "The Heavenly Dao is the great Dao of the Domain. Only with the Heavenly Dao can a Domain be perfect. This is what the Taoist Ancestor told me.
"My Heavenly Dao can elevate without limit, and as you cultivate and comprehend the Heavenly Dao, you too can become more powerful. Considering the old acquaintance, I can offer you a little preferential treatment.
"However, this preferential treatment I'm giving you is not bestowed by the Heavenly Dao. The Heavenly Dao is impartial and beyond question.
"As the Heavenly Dao grows stronger, you grow stronger, and as more and more powerhouses emerge in the Domain, it will continue to grow and become stronger..."
Upon hearing this, the hearts of the three from Taimiao were greatly shaken.
If it was as Tian Zi said, wouldn't the Heavenly Dao continue to grow stronger, and with it, the Domain as well, with their path of cultivation essentially endless?
The stronger the Heavenly Dao, the stronger the Domain, and the stronger they would be.
They, being at the pinnacle of the Domain's power, would potentially always remain at the pinnacle, and with time, it might not be impossible to surpass Taicang.
"It can truly elevate without limit?"
Taihe said with a look of disbelief.
"In theory, that's the case. Maybe only after turning the entire Land of Imperishable into the Domain will it stop elevating?
"But who knows, the Land of Imperishable seems boundless. When that time comes, we'll have to ask the Taoist Ancestor again."
Tian Zi shrugged.
The entire Land of Imperishable transforming into the Domain?
The trio of Taihe could scarcely imagine; before the Domain emerged, they had all followed Taicang to explore the Land of Imperishable.
The Land of Imperishable seemed limitless, and during their long journeys, they had never stepped out of the Land of Imperishable. It even felt to them as though after such long explorations, they had only been active within a small area of the Land of Imperishable.
Otherwise, where did the Imperishable Temple come from?
It must come from beyond the areas they had explored in the Land of Imperishable.
Besides the Imperishable Temple, whether there were other formidable existences or forces, or even other Realms, in the Land of Imperishable, was an unknown.
That streak of Open Heaven Purple Light might not be the first ever in the history of the Land of Imperishable!
"Fine, then we'll take advantage of your light, Tian Zi, to comprehend the Heavenly Dao, break our shackles, and elevate our power. Of course, provided that we truly have a chance to recover," Taikun nodded and said.
"Don't worry, you've survived this long without dying. With Lingxiu taking action, and given some time, you'll be healed," said Tian Zi cheerily as he walked off.
Taihe and Taikun were very powerful. They both comprehended the Heavenly Dao and cultivated it, which could bring faster elevation to the Heavenly Dao. After all, both had followed Taicang for a long time, their knowledge and experiences far surpassing others.
In the small courtyard of the Qinghua Sect,
Li Xuan held a teacup, leisurely drinking tea, one hand playing with the Jade Ruyi, content and comfortable.
Cai Ling'er stood by his side, serving him. Her beautiful eyes, filled with curiosity, turned to the suddenly captured figure.
A row of spikes stood on its head, it had long and curved eyebrows, large eyes glowing with a faint green, and it seemed to be wearing a black leather suit that looked sleek and shiny.
But that was not a leather suit; it was the creature's skin that was naturally so.
This was an ugly humanoid creature from the Land of Imperishable, not any species or being from within the Domain.
Cai Ling'er had just witnessed the Taoist Ancestor take action, reaching upwards with a grab, and then capturing this creature.
A being that the Taoist Ancestor had taken action to capture must be powerful. Though the Taoist Ancestor had easily caught it, the creature's strength was undoubtedly beyond the Realm Master Realm.
Master of Heaven and Earth level!
Cai Ling'er's heart shook. The Master of Heaven and Earth level powerhouses were casually captured by the Taoist Ancestor, whose strength was truly unfathomable!

chapters.title: Chapter 1029 - 532: Teachings from the Taoist Ancestor_2
chapters.content:
And to think that I, of all people, would have such fortune, such incredible fate, to become a maiden in the service of a Taoist Ancestor!
Muxiao was somewhat dazed, grasped by a hand and in the blink of an eye, found himself within this small courtyard. The grey air that enshrouded him had dissipated, revealing his true form.
What shocked him even more was that his powerful strength seemed to have vanished, not a trace could he sense.
Yet, he could still feel his own power, which meant that his strength was merely restrained.
How the other party restrained his power, he could not perceive even the slightest clue!
In the small courtyard, mundane and ordinary, a youth sat leisurely under a large tree, enjoying his tea and pastries with ease.
A breathtakingly beautiful woman was serving at his side, the youth's maid.
But the youth seemed so ordinary, without the slightest aura of strength, as though he was just a commoner, a scion of nobility enjoying the service of his maiden.
The stunningly beautiful woman did possess some strength, but it was not formidable; Muxiao could extinguish her with a single breath.
Muxiao's eyes widened as he stared at the youth, knowing that the person who took action must be the one seated so leisurely in the chair.
The more ordinary he seemed, the more it indicated that his strength was beyond measure, far surpassing Muxiao's perceptive capabilities.
"Who are you?"
Muxiao finally could not hold back and asked.
The youth was not Taicang, yet he was within the Taicang Domain. Could he be the heir of Taicang?
The heir of Taicang surpassing Taicang himself in such a short amount of time?
This was beyond belief for him.
Not much time had passed since the great battle, since the fall of Taicang.
Of course, what Muxiao considered not much time was in relation to his own long lifespan, in comparison to the long epochs that Taicang spent creating the Domain.
Even if the other party had started cultivating before Taicang's fall, the fact that he had surpassed Taicang in strength in less than a thousandth of Taicang's time was simply inconceivable.
How could such a monstrous existence be present in this world?
Taicang himself was monstrous enough, but it also took him a very long time to reach this level of strength.
As soon as Muxiao's words fell, he saw a figure that he had ignored a moment ago leap out from beside the big tree, berating him, "How dare you, having seen the Taoist Ancestor, you still do not kneel and kowtow in greeting?"
The Taoist Ancestor?!
Muxiao's mind buzzed, and although it was the first time he heard this title, he felt it signified an unfathomable existence with such high cultivation and powerful strength that he wasn't even qualified to look up to him!
While his heart was in shock, he looked at the youth and his eyes widened even further.
At that moment, what did he see?
An enigmatic radiance flickered around the youth, with a backdrop that seemed like the primal chaos from ancient times, the ages yet to be born, and the unseen chaos that wasn't revealed. It appeared as if he existed before time, beyond the Imperishable Chaos.
What kind of existence was this?
Muxiao's heart trembled violently, and even his legs started to quiver slightly. Even that being from the Imperishable Temple paled in comparison to the youth before him.
The Taoist Ancestor!!!
This title echoed in his mind, and a sense of reverence and an unstoppable emotion were slowly growing in his heart.
Feng Yan was brimming with excitement, and it was finally his turn to strut his stuff.
Furthermore, his opponent was a Master of Heaven and Earth level being.
He strode forward, raised his hand, and with a thud, forced Muxiao to kneel down. He reprimanded, "Having seen the Taoist Ancestor is such a fortunate opportunity; you dare to be insolent. Kneel properly and await the Taoist Ancestor's decree!"
After speaking, Feng Yan pulled out a whip, standing by Muxiao's side like a guard ready to execute punishment at any moment, prepared to lash down the whip the instant he displayed any disrespect.
At that moment, a surge of violent aura erupted within Muxiao, his eyes glowing greener and stronger, his breathing growing heavier, and his already fierce face looked even more terrifying.
Could it be that he, who regarded others as nothing but ants, was being forced to kneel on the ground?
With a murderous rage burgeoning within, Muxiao raised his head, his green eyes staring at Feng Yan.
"Hmm?"
Just then, a light grunt rang out like thunder in his mind, blasting away all the violent aura and the craziness of a murderous intent, leaving not a trace behind in that moment.
Shocked to the core, Muxiao abruptly turned to look at the young man sitting in the chair ahead.
"Born in Chaos, roaming in the Imperishable, without the enlightenment of Heaven and Earth, filled with violent auras and clouded by rage, possessing Spiritual Wisdom yet still barbaric, uneducated. From now on, you shall remain here, sweeping the floors, carrying the water, to dissolve your violent nature, remove the savageness, and heed the education,"
Li Xuan's gaze settled on him as he spoke slowly.
As a Taoist Ancestor, constant fighting and killing tarnished the image of such a stature. Thus, when it was time to educate, education must be administered to these barbarians!
Snap!
Feng Yan lashed out with his whip, his voice grave, "Won't you thank the Taoist Ancestor!"
"You!"
Muxiao, inwardly shocked by the Taoist Ancestor's might and unable to muster any resistance or anger, yet infuriated by Feng Yan's audacity to use the Taoist Ancestor's authority to humiliate him!
"Truly barbaric and uneducated, lacking appreciation for such great kindness from the Taoist Ancestor, indeed, you are impolite!"
Feng Yan glared back furiously and swung his whip again.
"Kneel, give thanks to the Taoist Ancestor, then pick up the broom, clear your mind, and sweep the floor—that's also sweeping away the malice in your heart!"
Muxiao exploded with rage.
He was about to leap up and fight Feng Yan to the death.
However, he felt as if there were an immense mountain pressing down on him, unable to leap up at all.
Snap, snap, snap!
Feng Yan lashed him several times in quick succession, lamenting in frustration, "You uneducated wretch, the Taoist Ancestor means well for you, leaving behind such a great opportunity, and yet you're ungrateful?
"Truly foolish beyond instruction, solely fixated on fighting and killing, thinking that my whipping you is an insult when I'm actually doing this for your own good!"
Muxiao continued to glare at him, overwhelmed by the audacity—whipping him and claiming it's for his own good?
Su Lingxiu and the others, having just returned, all wore bizarre expressions—why did these words sound so familiar?
Instinctively, they turned to look at Red Cat.
Once upon a time, Shi'er had spoken to Red Cat in much the same manner...
Feng Yan, having spent much time with Shi'er, has picked up some of Shi'er's habits.
"Master!"
Filled with excitement, Su Lingxiu came to her master's side, kneading his shoulders while watching Muxiao being reprimanded.
"Master, he's a Master of Heaven and Earth level being from the Land of Imperishable, and he possesses such rare Spiritual Wisdom. I want to dissect him for research; what do you think?"
Li Xuan's mouth twitched. Su Lingxiu, this girl, wanted to dissect any new and curious being she saw; she had picked up these tendencies when he first taught her the Art of Dissection on a Martial Artist's corpse.
Initially glaring at Feng Yan with snarling rage, Muxiao was suddenly petrified, looking in shock at Su Lingxiu, who was cooing and fawning. It was hard to believe that such a gentle and beautiful girl could speak such brutal words.
Feng Yan sighed from the side, "Now do you see that I was trying to do you good? If you had knelt and shown gratitude earlier, I would have taken you down to sweep the floor and none of this would have happened!"
Of course, even if Muxiao had obediently been sweeping the floor, the fate of being dissected was inescapable.
But this cruel truth couldn't possibly be revealed to Muxiao; the point now was to let him know that Feng Yan had truly meant well for him before.
In his panic, Muxiao glanced at Feng Yan. For a moment, he actually felt that this ant who whipped him might truly have had his best interests at heart.
Su Lingxiu, who was kneading her master's shoulders, reassured, "Master, don't worry. I just want to dissect him a bit for research, not to kill him. He's so powerful, with such strong vitality, he won't die.
"My skills in the Art of Dissection have become quite profound. I can assure there will be no accidents, and he will still be able to receive more of the master's education."
The more Muxiao heard, the more his heart pounded with fear—could he survive even after being dissected?
Could it be, being conscious while someone dissected and rummaged through his body for research?
The mere thought made Muxiao involuntarily shudder.
"If you're going to kill, then kill. Such humiliation belies the stature of the powerful!"
Muxiao exclaimed angrily, not realizing that his voice trembled slightly as he spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 1030 - 533: The Enlightenment Xu Yan Understood, the Opportunity Bestowed by the Taoist Ancestor
chapters.content:
Smack!
Just as Muxiao's voice fell, Feng Yan lashed him hard with his whip.
"Presumptuous!"
Feng Yan struck Muxiao with another whip and scolded furiously, "The Taoist Ancestor is compassionate and teaches all living beings. Although you are barbaric, the Taoist Ancestor harbors compassion and has educated you. Would he kill you? Would he humiliate you?
"You are just an uneducated savage who does not recognize the Taoist Ancestor's compassionate heart. All of this is for your own good!"
Li Xuan, watching Feng Yan disciplining Muxiao, couldn't help but sigh. Feng Yan really had learned quite a lot from Shi'er.
Xu Yan and the others also wore looks of strange amusement.
They couldn't help but glance at Red Cat again.
Red Cat rolled its eyes. That bastard Shi'er had gotten plenty of reprimands from him already, and he had long since returned the favor for the beatings he had received!
Muxiao, at the moment, felt bewildered. The Taoist Ancestor was looking out for him as well?
He glanced at Su Lingxiu and then looked up at Feng Yan, his mind a mess. How had he, such a mighty being, turned out like this after being captured?
"Master, just let me dissect him a bit."
Su Lingxiu shook her master's arm as she spoke.
"One must not act rashly and should respect the wishes of others, even if they posses no power to resist or threaten."
Li Xuan said with a serene smile.
"Alright, Master!"
Su Lingxiu nodded her head.
She understood that Muxiao had been restrained by her master, stripped of the power to resist and to threaten, and that she could take action herself whenever she wanted to conduct her research.
At that moment though, Muxiao let out a breath of relief.
Feng Yan, standing to one side and in a 'spare the rod and spoil the child' tone, said, "I've told you, the Taoist Ancestor means well by you — aren't you going to be grateful?!"
Dubiously, Muxiao contemplated that, even though the Taoist Ancestor was incredibly powerful, bowing his head in thanks was still difficult to stomach.
Feng Yan whipped down again, feigning concern in a 'it's for your own good' manner and transmitted to Muxiao, "Do you want to be dissected? The Taoist Ancestor is reasonable, but the true lineage of the Taoist Ancestor isn't so easy-going!"
Upon hearing this, Muxiao instantly shivered.
Dignity and pride were no longer important.
Moreover, the might of the Taoist Ancestor was even more terrifying than that of the Imperishable Temple, so kneeling to him was not a disgrace!
Thus, he bowed his head respectfully and thanked, "Thank you for the teaching, Taoist Ancestor!"
"Hmm!"
Li Xuan showed a gratified smile.
With a wave of his hand, a broom appeared in front of Muxiao.
"Clean the floor with a calm heart, remove the malignant qi, comprehend the emotions of the mortal world. Go now."
Although Muxiao was very reluctant, he knew that he had no room to resist at that moment.
He also lacked the stubbornness and the courage to refuse it all.
So, he picked up the broom.
"Thank you, Taoist Ancestor!"
The broom felt heavy in his hands as if weighed down; this was no ordinary broom. With his power now sealed, sweeping with this broom was quite laborious.
"Come with me."
Feng Yan led Muxiao away to assign him the task of sweeping.
Muxiao was only too eager to leave, now fearful whenever he saw Su Lingxiu, worried he might be captured for dissection.
"The broom feels heavy, doesn't it? This is the Taoist Ancestor teaching you. It's refining you. Once your malignant qi has dissipated and you've understood the morals of human society, you will be able to progress further.
"Remember, the Taoist Ancestor is merciful. Even to a savage and violent person like you, he has given the opportunity to be enlightened..."
Feng Yan lectured to Muxiao.
Muxiao felt a bit dazed. Had he been hurting himself, only for it to be for his own good in the end?
Was the breadth of the Taoist Ancestor's heart really like the Land of Imperishable, boundless and vast?!
Xu Yan looked at his master with admiration and sighed inwardly, "When will I ever reach the same realm as Master? To beat an enemy, and instead of hatred, the enemy feels gratitude. This realm is too high!"
Tian Zi, seeing Muxiao under Feng Yan's supervision, sweeping the yard in earnest, scratched his head, utterly confused, "Aren't we going to kill him?"
Before Li Xuan could speak, Xu Yan already said earnestly, "Tian Zi, remember, Master is the Taoist Ancestor, he's beyond the realm of fighting and killing. When Master takes action, it's merely a form of instruction.
"Just like before, when he annihilated enemies with a wave of his hand, it was to teach us that one should not be soft-hearted towards enemies, nor should one rely on one's status. To strike is to obliterate the enemy.
"Now Master is teaching us that as our realm advances, we must change our cultivation of the heart. We shouldn't be mindlessly violent. We need to understand how to enlighten others.
"Especially you as Heavenly Dao, you should even more understand the concept of enlightenment. This path of enlightenment has many nuances, think more, understand more, to grasp the meaning of enlightenment!"
Meng Chong, Su Lingxiu, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping vigorously nodded, "Big brother is right!"
The big brother was most in touch with Master's profound intentions. Since he explained it this way, it must be utterly correct.
Tian Zi was completely baffled.
Is that really how it is?
Why did he always feel that the 'enlightenment' Xu Yan talked about wasn't quite the same as the 'enlightenment' he understood, as if it had some additional meanings?
Li Xuan inwardly marveled—not in vain was he his foremost disciple and the pioneer in the great undertaking of martial arts—he truly grasped my sentiments!
Feeling this way, Li Xuan showed a gratified smile once more.
Seeing this, Xu Yan was filled with joy, convinced he had once again grasped the deep meaning of his master!
"Enlightenment, huh? I got it!"
Tian Zi muttered to himself as he scratched his head.
Fearing Tian Zi might misunderstand, Xu Yan added, "Enlightenment has profound implications. Some enemies are incorrigible, and for such enemies, the best way to enlighten them is to send them into reincarnation!"
Tian Zi looked at Xu Yan and nodded fervently, "I understand now, enlightenment also involves discerning the method, different enemies require different approaches to enlightenment!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1031 - 533: The Enlightenment Xu Yan Understood, the Opportunity Bestowed by the Taoist Ancestor_2
chapters.content:
Xu Yan nodded, "It's good that you understand!"
A sudden attack ended with a Heaven and Earth Lord-Level True Spirit annihilated, Muxiao captured, and the punishment at Qinghua Sect of sweeping the grounds concluded.
After this battle, the Great Wilderness Domain entered a period of strength growth, with numerous Imperishable True Spirits cast into the Domain, nourishing it and transforming into heavenly treasures and earthly treasures for cultivating martial artists.
The Yin Realm also began to turn with the collapse of Imperishable True Spirits and their Divine Souls drawn into reincarnation.
The Heavenly Dao operated more and more perfectly within the Domain, with its rules becoming increasingly powerful.
A sense of urgency fell upon all Realm Masters, who began to meditate to comprehend the Heavenly Dao and sought to enhance their power as swiftly as possible.
Many martial artists gained from this battle, and the names of Fang Hao from Qinghua Sect and Su Lingxiu from Evergreen Pavilion spread among the strong.
Alchemical Medical Warriors and Qimen Martial Artists had also become widely recognized.
Many powerful individuals wished to send their juniors to Qinghua Sect to cultivate Qimen Martial Art or Alchemical Medical Martial Arts.
The Qimen Institute and the Alchemical Medical Institute at Qinghua Sect began to buzz with activity.
Of course, to enter the Qimen Institute and Alchemical Medical Institute one had to pass through a strict selection process; only those with extraordinary talents were admitted.
The newly admitted disciples naturally did not need Su Lingxiu to teach them personally; they were taught by the Alchemical Medical Warriors and Alchemists from the Alchemical Medical Institute.
Although the warriors of the Alchemical Medical Institute were not very strong, they were numerous. Although there were few who had perfected the Alchemical Medical Martial Art, there were quite a few Alchemists.
The affairs of the Alchemical Medical Institute, unless they were of significant importance, would not reach Su Lingxiu. They were handled by Yue'er and Zhou Ying.
Zi Yun also occasionally took part, and the operation of the entire Alchemical Medical Institute was now well-established.
Fang Hao was the Sect Master of Qinghua Sect, so naturally, he was not in charge of the affairs of the Qimen Institute, and moreover, as the Sect Master, he had few responsibilities to handle.
The Qimen Institute was managed by people like Moon Changming and Feng Yan. Artisan Warriors and Formation Masters had already raised some disciples who were able to continue teaching the newcomers.
Unless a disciple with exceptional innate talent was recruited, Fang Hao would personally provide guidance, but so far, no one worthy of his personal instruction had appeared.
Sword Dao and Blade Path were also being taught, and more people were practicing Sword Dao, mainly influenced by Xu Yan.
Martial Artists practicing Physical Body Martial Arts also started to increase, especially those from the Body Cultivation lineage, all pondering how to cultivate the pure Martial Arts.
With the high entry threshold to Qinghua Sect, many powerful figures realized that the Great Wilderness Martial Arts Academy also taught these martial arts.
Consequently, they began to send their ineligible juniors to the Great Wilderness Martial Arts Academy for further study.
The juniors of these strong individuals, proud and arrogant, arrived at the Great Wilderness Martial Arts Academy feeling superior, believing the other students were beneath them.
In the end, they inevitably faced punishment. The Great Wilderness Martial Arts Academy would not indulge such individuals, expelling anyone who violated the academy rules severely, without leniency.
There was a junior of a powerful individual who was expelled and driven out of the academy for severely injuring a student and damaging their martial arts foundation.
The powerful individual became furious due to this and even caused a scene at the Great Wilderness Academy, after all, in his eyes, the academy was ultimately too weak.
He overpowered several of the academy's strong members in a single move, even severely injuring Bai Yunkong, and the matter escalated to Canglan Island where Xu Yan executed the troublemaker on the spot with a single sword strike!
Following this incident, the Great Wilderness Martial Arts Academy revised its rules, raising the criteria for admitting students, especially those from powerful backgrounds, with significantly higher entry requirements and imposing hefty tuition fees!
As for those of humble origin or even those from lowly backgrounds with talent, the threshold remained very low. The higher the talent, the lower the admission criteria, up to the point of no threshold at all.
For the offspring of the powerful, besides the talent requirement, paying tuition became an inevitable rule!
After this event, no one dared to underestimate the Great Wilderness Martial Arts Academy or violate its rules.
The Great Wilderness Academy had the backing of Sword God Xu Yan!
Sword God Xu Yan, a formidable and ruthless person, would not consider one's status or background when taking lives; after all, there was no one in the world with a stronger background than his own.
The direct lineage of the Taoist Ancestor!
The Domain was slowly expanding, and the Way of Heaven was also leveling up, though extremely slowly, but elevation was indeed occurring.
The overall strength of the Domain was also incessantly rising.
The Domain had entered a new phase, as if it was on the verge of a transformation period.
Li Xuan remained as carefree as ever, watching the clouds scud across the sky, with only Cai Ling'er, his maid, attending to him, leading a life akin to that of a young master from a noble family.
While some leisurely passed their time, others were naturally busy.
Tian Zi was incredibly busy, having to continue deceiving the Blood Demon while thinking hard about how to upgrade and perfect realms like the Yin Realm and Samsara and so on.
Moreover, Tian Zi had to personally step in to guide Yu Yao, Taimiao, Heavenly Slaughter, and others on how to comprehend the Way of Heaven.
Besides Tian Zi, Su Lingxiu was also caught up in busyness, on one hand strengthening the Blood Extreme Soul Seed and instructing in the art of cultivating the Soul Seed in preparation for seizing the strength of the Blood Demon, and on the other hand, continuing to conspire with Tian Zi to deceive the Blood Demon.
She was also committed to treating Taihe and Taikun, showing immense interest in their injuries, which were worthy of in-depth research.
Especially the particular aura that had tainted the insides of the two, which was said to hail from that being at the Imperishable Temple, and it was due to the influence of that being that they ended up in such a condition.
All this immensely piqued Su Lingxiu's interest, and thus, no matter how busy, she found the time to delve into the unique wounds and illnesses of the two and the odd aura that entwined them.
Taihe and Taikun were overjoyed that a hope for healing truly existed and thus were very cooperative with the treatment, even going so far as to willingly agree to being dissected by Su Lingxiu to thoroughly investigate the root of their injuries without the slightest hesitation.
Due to her busyness, Su Lingxiu really could not spare the time, so the task of dissecting Muxiao had to be temporarily set aside.
And Muxiao, dressed in coarse linens and holding a broom, appeared like an old man, responsible for sweeping the courtyard daily and the surrounding area under the arrangements of Feng Yan.
At first, Muxiao was always anxious, fearing that Su Lingxiu might suddenly appear and cart him off for dissection, since he now had no power to resist a warrior like Su Lingxiu.
But as Su Lingxiu never showed up, he gradually relaxed.
"Now you know I was doing this for your own good, right? If it weren't for me, you would have been dissected long ago," Feng Yan said, patting his shoulder.
Muxiao nodded, somewhat believing that Feng Yan truly meant well.
"Keep up with your sweeping, once in the morning, once midday, and once in the evening every day. Don't be lazy, don't think the broom is too heavy, and don't consider it too strenuous."
"You were very powerful once and must have suffered a great deal. This kind of suffering is nothing to you; just stabilize your state of mind,"
"This is not the Taoist Ancestor's punishment for you, but an opportunity bestowed upon you. What you are sweeping is not the ground, but your own path of cultivation..."
Feng Yan spoke earnestly, his expression solemn and reverent when mentioning the Taoist Ancestor, admonishing Muxiao that this was an opportunity given by the Taoist Ancestor, not a punishment...
Feng Yan indoctrinated Muxiao with tales of the Taoist Ancestor's greatness, his compassion, his teachings to the world, and how he valued the struggle of cultivation, thus gave instruction and opportunity to him, urging to grasp it and be grateful!
Initially, Muxiao was skeptical of Feng Yan's words. Was sweeping really an opportunity from the Taoist Ancestor?
But as Feng Yan indoctrinated him daily with the idea that the Taoist Ancestor was looking out for his best interests, Muxiao gradually started to feel that perhaps the Taoist Ancestor really did have his best interests in mind.
Day in and day out, he swept; whenever tired, he rested. Gradually, he grew to like the tranquility and not having to run about for the Imperishable Temple or execute various tasks.
As if in a trance, Feng Yan's words resounded in his mind again, this was an opportunity from the Taoist Ancestor, this was for his benefit...
"No, how could it be for my good to capture me and restrain my powers?"
Muxiao shook his head, clenched his teeth, and steadfastly maintained his belief that he was imprisoned, not granted any opportunity.
Several days went by without seeing Feng Yan, who hadn't assigned him any sweeping tasks, but Muxiao still swept every day, punctually.
He was just a bit puzzled; where had Feng Yan gone? Suddenly unused to the absence of Feng Yan's chatter, he actually felt a bit awkward without it.
It was not until this day that he found out Feng Yan had gone to tend to other matters, and on this day, a newcomer arrived, tasked with assigning him to sweep the ground.
This person, named Shi'er, had a power far inferior to that of Feng Yan.

chapters.title: Chapter 1032 - 534 Gratitude to the Taoist Ancestor, Blood Demon's Beautiful Aspirations
chapters.content:
Feng Yan was busy with the affairs of Qimen Institute and couldn't spare the time to instill the philosophy in Muxiao. After learning that Muxiao was a Master of Heaven and Earth Realm powerhouse, Shi'er hastily came from Canglan Island.
As for the idea of instilling the "for his own good" concept, Shi'er considered himself quite experienced. Although he had stumbled in his initial attempt with Red Cat, he was certain that he would not fail this time.
After all, Red Cat was a demon who had cultivated to be rational, which was why he had failed.
But Muxiao was different.
Even though Muxiao was a powerhouse, he had been intimidated by the majesty of the Taoist Ancestor. The Taoist Ancestor's power was mighty and unfathomable, deeply ingrained in his Divine Soul.
And the Taoist Ancestor didn't kill him, but merely punished him by making him sweep to rid himself of malicious energy, thus creating room to be taught the "for his own good."
Besides, although Muxiao was powerful, he was now restrained in his abilities and was no longer a powerhouse; his judgment, the acuteness of his Divine Soul, etc., were not in the state of a strong being.
With his hands clasped behind his back and a stern expression on his face, Shi'er watched Muxiao sweep, watched as he gathered the fallen leaves into a pile.
The broom was heavy, and with his strength restrained, Muxiao was completely worn out after one round of sweeping, sweat beads forming on his forehead.
This was inconceivable in the past.
Nonetheless, Muxiao had gotten used to it. After he had finished, he put down the broom, preparing to rest a bit. Once he had recovered his strength, he would gather the leaves and carry them away.
He didn't know why there were so many leaves to sweep every day, but all he could do was repeat the sweeping each day. It was somewhat monotonous, but it was much better than being taken away to be dissected.
Whoosh!
However, he saw Shi'er, who with a wave of his hand, scattered the swept-up leaves in all directions, covering the ground once again.
"You!"
Muxiao immediately became furious.
"Hmm?"
Shi'er glared at him, "Why, do you want to complain? Do you think I'm being unfair to you? Later, if you don't sweep the floor clean, there will be punishment!"
Snap!
Shi'er pulled out a whip.
Muxiao trembled with fury, and in this moment, his old man's visage, in this scene, made it seem like Shi'er the scoundrel was bullying an old man!
For the next several days, Muxiao was repeatedly tormented. He harbored endless resentment towards Shi'er and even received a few lashes from the whip because of his resentful glances.
At this time, Muxiao began to miss Feng Yan. Compared to him, Feng Yan truly seemed like a good person!
With the heavy broom in hand, Muxiao swept the leaves into a pile, his eyes coldly observing Shi'er, waiting for Shi'er to scatter the leaves again, forcing him to sweep once more as a form of humiliation.
To his surprise, Shi'er didn't do so today.
"Aren't you curious why I am not making things difficult for you today?"
Shi'er said with a grave face.
Muxiao paused, then subconsciously nodded.
"I am teaching you!"
Shi'er stood with his hands clasped behind his back, his head raised slightly as he looked toward the Firmament.
Inside, he was filled with satisfaction. Even having taught a Master of Heaven and Earth level, what a glorious tale it was.
"You must feel now that Feng Yan is a good person, right?"
Muxiao stared at Shi'er, puzzled about what this detestable man really wanted to say.
Shi'er lowered his head to look at him and said solemnly, "I am pointing out to you, to make you understand the great opportunity the Taoist Ancestor has given you, and you should be grateful!"
Without waiting for Muxiao to speak, Shi'er continued, "Feng Yan was strict with you, but did not make things difficult for you, while I, not only harsh but also making things difficult for you, who do you think is treating you better?
"Of course, Feng Yan is better to you. You must miss Feng Yan now, and that is the lesson I want to teach you, to let you understand the truth.
"Were you restricted at the Imperishable Temple, always busy with affairs, always striving to achieve certain goals?
"Think again about the difference between being at the Taoist Ancestor's place and being at the Imperishable Temple.
"Consider again, what kind of being the Taoist Ancestor is. Any strong being in his place would have killed you, for instance, would the powerhouses of the Imperishable Temple have killed you?
"But the Taoist Ancestor didn't kill you; instead, he instructed you to sweep the floor and rid yourself of malicious energy. Once the malice was gone, your mindset would improve, elevating your very being, and you would be close to a breakthrough.
"Sweeping the floor is to cleanse the dust in your heart, sweep away the impure thoughts within your Divine Soul. By purifying yourself, moving one step further toward enlightenment, think about the kind of opportunity that is?
"This is a great opportunity bestowed upon you by the Taoist Ancestor. You must seize it, be thankful for it. Countless powerful beings long for the Taoist Ancestor's guidance yet cannot attain it. How fortunate you are.
"I, Shi'er, cannot bear to see you miss the opportunity given by the Taoist Ancestor. Thus, I've taken this approach to enlighten you, to bring you to full realization, so that you won't miss this chance. The Taoist Ancestor has been earnestly kind, and I am doing this for your own good!"
Shi'er spoke with solemnity, his weighty words causing Muxiao to be stunned, and upon reflection, it seemed indeed to be the case.
The situation and mindset he was in with Feng Yan were completely different from the ones with Shi'er.
Wasn't it the same when he was at the Imperishable Temple, compared to his time in the courtyard of the Taoist Ancestor? The situation and mindset were also different.
How powerful the Taoist Ancestor was, he could have crushed Muxiao like an ant, yet he didn't kill him.
And if it were someone from the Imperishable Temple, if he dared to offend, he would probably have been suppressed and suffered severe punishment by now.
"The Taoist Ancestor is teaching me?!"
Muxiao drifted into his thoughts.
Shi'er spoke in a heavy voice, "Although the broom is heavy, it is to sharpen your will and to let you relax after labor. Can you feel how comfortable it is to relax after being worn out..."
Muxiao paused, realizing it was indeed the case. After the exhaustion, finally being able to rest, his whole being felt relaxed and comfortable.

chapters.title: Chapter 1033 - 534 Gratitude to the Taoist Ancestor, Blood Demon's Beautiful Aspirations_2
chapters.content:
```
"Could it be?"
Muxiao's voice was filled with disbelief.
"Indeed, this is one of the teachings of Taoist Ancestor, to let you comprehend the various aspects of humanity, to lay the foundation for your breakthrough."
"You must be grateful to Taoist Ancestor, grateful for his teachings!"
Shi'er nodded seriously.
Muxiao turned to look at the courtyard, as if he could see the mysterious Taoist Ancestor teaching him, guiding him?
Did he have the chance to break through his shackles and enhance his strength?
"Kneel down and give thanks, listen to me, you won't be wrong, I'm doing this for your own good!"
Shi'er switched to telepathic communication to remind him.
Muxiao knelt towards the small courtyard, "Muxiao, thanks to the Taoist Ancestor for his teachings of grace!"
Shi'er nodded in satisfaction.
Li Xuan sighed in his heart. Shi'er, this guy, also knew how to bluff now, skillfully bamboozling Muxiao.
Of course, this was also because Muxiao's strength had been confined by him, ultimately losing the sensitivity and senses of a strong individual, which made it easy to deceive him.
But no matter what, Muxiao was now completely taken in by the two of them, Shi'er and Feng Yan. He would soon wholeheartedly be grateful to him, the Taoist Ancestor, and revere the Taoist Ancestor from his Divine Soul and to his very bones, ready to punish anyone who disrespected the Taoist Ancestor at a moment's notice!
"Focus on sweeping the ground, calm your mind, reflect on yourself, and settle your own self."
Li Xuan's voice was like the sound of the Dao, penetrating directly into the Divine Soul.
"Yes, Taoist Ancestor!"
Muxiao bowed respectfully before standing up and taking the initiative to disperse the fallen leaves, resuming his sweeping at a steady pace.
From then on, Muxiao became respectful towards Shi'er, almost obedient to every word, never showing any contempt for Shi'er's weaker strength.
"A sweeper before the gates of the Taoist Ancestor, a Master of Heaven and Earth level powerhouse, that is what befits the courtyard of me, the Taoist Ancestor."
Li Xuan muttered to himself.
He glanced at Cai Ling'er, thinking even the maid was weak. How could the maid of the Taoist Ancestor be weak?
With that thought, Li Xuan instructed Cai Ling'er in her cultivation, urging her to quickly increase her strength.
...
"It's almost ready."
Su Lingxiu looked at the cultivating Blood Demon, her expression brimming with excitement.
"The Soul Seed of Blood Extreme is finally ready to contend with the Divine Soul of the Blood Demon for dominance?"
Tian Zi stroked his chin and spoke.
"Even if it cannot replace the Blood Demon, it can still stand against him. Even if the Blood Demon is willing, he will not be able to target the Great Wilderness Domain anymore, as he will be occupied with dealing with Blood Extreme."
After thinking it over, Su Lingxiu spoke with full confidence.
"What if the Blood Demon seeks help from the Imperishable Temple?"
Tian Zi voiced his concern.
If the truth of the Great Wilderness was exposed, the Blood Demon would undoubtedly seek vengeance, and the Imperishable Temple would discover the changes in the Great Wilderness Domain and act prematurely.
As such, the Great Wilderness Domain would lose the opportunity to grow in secret.
"Don't worry, I've asked my master to add some safeguards to Blood Extreme. Once the Soul is drawn back, Blood Extreme will take over, and in the beginning, the Blood Demon will not discover the truth. He will only mistake it for an issue with his offspring's Soul, thinking it wants to betray him and take his place."
"Moreover, to keep the secret, the Blood Demon won't seek help from anyone. He might even find a secluded place to deal with the issue of his offspring's Soul by himself."
"By the time he realizes the problem and learns the truth, it will be too late for him to seek help. He wouldn't dare to, anyway."
Su Lingxiu smiled, having already arranged everything.
"If that's the case, then let's begin."
Upon hearing this, Tian Zi nodded. Since Taoist Ancestor had made sure Blood Extreme would not fail, the plan would surely succeed uninterrupted.
Blood Extreme, stealthily replacing the Blood Demon.
"Now, the Blood Demon's Soul Seed is only half a step away from the Establishing Dao Realm, and once that half step is taken, the Soul Seed will undergo a transformation and may exist independently from the Blood Demon."
```
```
"So, the Blood Demon must attract his Soul Seed back before its breakthrough, fuse with it as one, and then break through beyond the Establishing Dao Realm,"
"Creating an opportunity for the Blood Demon to draw his Soul Seed back."
Tian Zi chuckled, as the Power of Heavenly Dao began to set up.
Neither the Soul Seed of the Blood Demon nor the Blood Demon itself realized that all of this was fake, an illusion created by the Heavenly Dao.
In the consciousness of the Blood Demon Soul Seed, he had already cultivated the Great Technique of the Daoist Ancestor, and his power had broken through to the Establishing Dao Realm, making him more powerful than the Master of Domain.
Now, he was only half a step away from transcending the Establishing Dao.
As if a consciousness in the dark was telling him that once he made the breakthrough, he would gain autonomy, and naturally, the Blood Demon itself was also aware of this consciousness.
Blood Extreme, lying dormant and biding its time within the Blood Demon Soul Seed, was now extremely excited; the opportunity had finally come.
He was about to compete with a Master of Heaven and Earth for control, to seize everything from a Master of Heaven and Earth and take his place!
Even the thought of it was thrilling!
Indeed, his choice back then was so wise, or else he would have never had this kind of opportunity!
Somewhere in the remote Land of Imperishable, within a mountain formed from the fallen True Spirit, a Blood Pool bubbled up, and at a certain moment, the figure of the Blood Demon emerged.
His brows furrowed, showing a solemn countenance.
"Once the Soul Seed breaks through, it will become an autonomous entity, an independent individual, severing its connection with me, and may even turn against me to try to kill me."
Thinking of this, the Blood Demon became restless.
At the same time, he was astounded by the mysteries and strength beyond the Establishing Dao Realm, that could allow a Soul Seed to become an independent entity separate from him.
"No, I must attract the Soul Seed back before it breaks through, fuse with it, gain everything from it, and then break through in one fell swoop; once I make the breakthrough, I can return to the Imperishable Temple and take its place," he thought.
The Blood Demon's eyes gleamed with excitement.
The thought of substituting and becoming the master of the Imperishable Temple got him extremely excited.
That high and mighty existence, trampled beneath him, crawling before him, becoming his subordinate, with their identities reversed, the exhilarating feeling of rising up made the Blood Demon so excited that even the Blood Pool began to boil.
"Witch, once I substitute and become the master of the Imperishable Temple, there's no need for you to run anymore. I am not that one; I don't need to devour the Domain, and in fact, I wish for a Domain to exist."
"I am a disciple of Daozu, not some narrow-minded, frog-in-a-well that you can compare with!"
At this moment, the Blood Demon's pride surged.
He was a disciple of Daozu!
How could he be put in the same category as those who don't even know about the Great Wilderness Domain.
"The Soul Seed is me, and fusing with it will not change my identity. I will still be a disciple of Daozu, and that is the recognition I should get," he thought.
Without further hesitation, the Blood Demon sat down cross-legged, the Blood Pool rolled and bubbled, red mist constantly emerged, enveloping the area around the Blood Pool.
The figure of the Blood Demon disappeared into the dense blood mist, and at a certain moment, a bubbling sound emerged, as if bubbles were surfacing.
The Blood Demon began to operate the secret technique to merge with his Soul Seed, attracting it back. After all, it was his Soul Seed, and attracting it should naturally not be a problem.
However, to his shock, the Blood Demon found that he encountered significant resistance; the Soul Seed seemed to be resisting his attraction and fusion.
"Not yet broken through, and the Soul Seed already has such resistant consciousness; once it breaks through, it will not only become an independent existence but will certainly find a way to reverse and devour me," he thought.
With this in mind, the Blood Demon crazily circulated his secret technique, needing to draw back the Soul Seed, or he would suffer backlash.
As the secret technique was activated, the resistance of the Soul Seed began to weaken.
The Blood Demon sighed with relief; as long as it was attracted back, even though the Soul Seed might be slightly stronger, it could not resist, for, from its very core, it was under his control and suppression.
Finally, the Soul Seed slowly began to return; although the process was somewhat stagnant and slow, it was indeed coming back.
Attracting the Soul Seed was a slow process, which also meant that the Great Wilderness Domain was extremely far from this place; otherwise, it would not require such a long time.
Amidst the process of attracting the Soul Seed, the Blood Demon's face showed excitement, already envisioning the increase in strength, the breakthrough of constraints, returning to the Imperishable Temple, and sitting proudly on the throne after merging with the Soul Seed.
After an indeterminate amount of time, at a certain moment, the Soul Seed appeared as if breaking free from the mire and in an instant, it was attracted back.
This made the Blood Demon speculate that the area where the Great Wilderness Domain was located must have some special characteristics; it was only after the Soul Seed left that special area that it returned instantly.
Boom!
As the Soul Seed returned to the body, bloodlight blossomed, and mysterious runes emerged from within the Soul Seed, exciting the Blood Demon who instantly moved his Divine Soul, preparing to merge with the Soul Seed.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1034 - 535: Blood Extreme Fights Blood Demon, Above Creation
chapters.content:
Because the Soul Seed had shown resistance previously, the Blood Demon had already prepared to use certain methods to forcibly suppress the Soul Seed during the fusion process, in order to complete the fusion and obtain its strength and gains.
However, to his surprise, the process of fusing the Soul Seed went very smoothly without any resistance. The only thing that puzzled him was why the Soul Seed seemed to be taking root in the Divine Soul?
It gave him the impression that although the Soul Seed had merged, it had not dissipated; instead, it coexisted with the main soul in some way.
Vaguely, the Blood Demon felt something was amiss, but he could not discern the reason for his unease.
As the Soul Seed fused, those mysterious runes also entered into the Divine Soul. The great techniques cultivated by the Soul Seed were not manifested as expected.
Instead, it felt as though the Soul Seed was not much stronger than when he had planned to send it into the Taicang Domain. There was just a slight difference, and that was it.
"Something is wrong!"
At that moment, the Blood Demon became suspicious; his instincts told him something was off with the Soul Seed!
It seemed the strength of the Soul Seed he had perceived was merely an illusion.
Even the so-called Great Wilderness Domain and the mysterious Taoist Ancestor appeared to be illusions.
"Heh heh heh..."
Just then, an evil laugh echoed within his Divine Soul.
This laughter came so unexpectedly that it made him shudder subconsciously, and what frightened him more was that this laughter was even more sinister than his own!
Boom!
In an instant, the Soul Seed that had merged into the Divine Soul suddenly emerged, like maggots gnawing at the bone, taking over almost half of his Divine Soul in a blink of an eye!
Moreover, this spreading momentum did not stop and seemed set on devouring his Divine Soul, turning the tables and seizing everything from him!
"You dare rebel!"
The Blood Demon was enraged. At this moment, he realized that the Soul Seed hadn't been weak; it had been deceiving him, taking this opportunity to become the master, trying to replace him and become the true Blood Demon!
Boom!
The Blood Demon immediately employed a secret technique to suppress the Soul Seed.
Although the Soul Seed was rebellious and wanted to backfire, and might be strong, the Blood Demon was confident he could suppress it.
After all, the Soul Seed was an aspect of him that he had nurtured himself; its origin was under his control and suppression, aiming to turn the tables was absolutely impossible.
Moreover, the Soul Seed had returned to the Divine Soul, which meant that the battle was taking place on his home ground, leaving the Soul Seed with no power to resist.
Unexpectedly, the secret technique used to suppress the Soul Seed failed!
It was as if this was not his Soul Seed, but a Soul Seed of a formidable outsider, wishing to devour him and replace him!
"Heh heh heh, I have already freed myself from your influence. I am autonomous!"
Blood Extreme, following Su Lingxiu's plan, had not revealed himself immediately, but masqueraded as the Soul Seed.
As the Blood Demon led the Soul Seed to return, Tian Zi deliberately slowed down the speed of the Soul Seed's retraction under the Heavenly Dao Rules, creating the impression of an extremely remote distance. In the meantime, Blood Extreme suddenly attacked, completely devouring the original Soul Seed of the Blood Demon and replaced it.
The Blood Demon's complexion drastically changed. In this short period, he nearly lost control of half of his Divine Soul. He immediately employed a secret technique to deal with the infiltrating foreign Divine Soul as if it were the Soul Seed.
"How did you break free of my control? You're supposed to be me!"
The Blood Demon was furious.
"Heh heh, Taoist Ancestor's Great Technique is not something you can fathom. I gained this opportunity, and I won't be cheap with you. I am an independent entity. I want to be my own person!"
Blood Extreme confused the Blood Demon while furiously devouring his Divine Soul.
The two began to struggle.
With Blood Extreme's strength, he should have had no chance against the Blood Demon, but after Su Lingxiu refined him into a Soul Seed and he underwent transformation, he was no longer an ordinary Divine Soul.
Having devoured the Blood Demon's Soul Seed, which originated from the same source as the Blood Demon, Blood Extreme was neither restricted by the Blood Demon's secret techniques nor actively rejected by the Blood Demon's Divine Soul as an invader.
Additionally, since the Blood Demon had actively merged, he missed the best opportunity to suppress him. Blood Extreme took advantage of this and grew stronger, putting the Blood Demon in a passive situation.
Moreover, the runes on the Divine Soul of Blood Extreme were transformed from a thread of Li Xuan's Power of Creation, which ensured that Blood Extreme could not be annihilated.
Thus, even though the Blood Demon was powerful, he found himself in a tough fight.
Blood Extreme also marveled, acknowledging the Master of Domain as indeed formidable, but he was not discouraged. As long as his Divine Soul could not be annihilated, he could slowly wear down his opponent.
The ultimate victor would undoubtedly be him.
Replacing him, becoming the Master of Domain!
"Heh heh, stop resisting. You are me, and I am you. I gained the Taoist Ancestor's opportunity, which is equivalent to you gaining it. Let me be the real you."
Blood Extreme spoke while fighting the Blood Demon, continuing to confuse him.
The longer his true nature remained unnoticed, the more advantageous it was. It was also vital that the Blood Demon could not seek help from the powers of the Imperishable Temple before he could learn the truth.
Otherwise, if external forces intervened, there was a chance of failure, and the changes within the Taicang Domain would be exposed.
"A Soul Seed is just a Soul Seed, even if you obtained some opportunities, thinking of overturning the master is wishful thinking!"
The Blood Demon scoffed, his entire being sinking into the Blood Pool, beginning to operate a secret technique and utilizing various powerful methods to suppress the Soul Seed.
This battle of Divine Souls would not be resolved in just a day or two, but the Blood Demon was confident that eventually, he would successfully devour the Soul Seed and obtain all its powers!

chapters.title: Chapter 1035 - 535: Blood Extreme Fights Blood Demon, Above Creation_2
chapters.content:
```
"Heh heh, stop your futile resistance."
Blood Extreme laughed wildly, having already taken control of half of the Blood Demon's body. At this moment, Blood Extreme discovered that the Blood Demon was actually not inside the Imperishable Temple.
This place, could it be within a mountain somewhere in the Land of Imperishable?
Given this situation, there was no need to worry about being exposed; an intense fight ensued with the Blood Demon. Thanks to his preemptive advantage and the Blood Demon's miscalculation of the situation, Blood Extreme controlled half of his adversary's body, and the fight was evenly matched for the time being.
The Blood Demon constantly employed various secret techniques, unceasingly suppressing Blood Extreme. Gradually, he realized that this Remnant Soul seemed not quite right, as if it was no longer truly part of himself.
At the thought of such a possibility, the Blood Demon was filled with horror. Had he been plotted against?!
...
