"Whether it can succeed depends on Blood Extreme himself now. I believe Blood Extreme will firmly grasp this opportunity."
The arrangements against the Blood Demon were finally completed.
Whether it would succeed was up to Blood Extreme now, but Su Lingxiu believed that the probability of Blood Extreme's success was not small. Even if he could not completely replace the Blood Demon, he could at least share control of the body with him.
After all, Blood Extreme's Divine Soul had been refined by her, born from the Soul Seed, and had become intact. It was no longer a Remnant Soul, and moreover, Blood Extreme had once received the Purple Light's creation.
Moreover, that strand of power from her Master could ensure that Blood Extreme's Divine Soul would not be annihilated, giving him an advantage. How could Blood Extreme possibly fail with such benefits? The worst outcome would be sharing power with the Blood Demon.
With the matter of the Blood Demon put to rest, Su Lingxiu finally had the time to dissect Muxiao and research the uniqueness of this Imperishable land's strong being.
However, Su Lingxiu did not start immediately; after all, Muxiao was right there. There was no need to rush, for it was a Master of Heaven and Earth level being, a non-Domain creature, which inevitably had many differences.
Before dissecting and researching, in order to ensure that no accidents would occur, some preparations were needed.
Next on her agenda was researching the injuries on Taihe and Taikun, treating the strange afflictions of the two. Su Lingxiu was very interested in the injuries related to the Imperishable Temple.
After resolving the issue with the Blood Demon, Tian Zi continued to be immersed in his Heavenly Dao undertakings, striving to rapidly enhance his Domain strength. He manifested the Heavenly Dao for Old Man Xiao and others to comprehend.
The first to comprehend the Heavenly Dao, Old Man Xiao, had already reaped substantial benefits, started to step onto the path of Heavenly Dao, loosened his bottleneck, and gained some strength.
Heavenly Slaughter of the Yin Realm continued to build the Yin Realm, and with the establishment and initiation of Reincarnation, almost in control of the Yin Realm, also gained some insights.
The Seductive Witch and the Witch Demon clan lived within the Yin Realm. The aura of the Yin Realm gradually became suitable for them, becoming the Yin Realm species of the Great Wilderness Domain.
The Great Wilderness Domain was developing steadily. Given time, Masters of Heaven and Earth level beings would inevitably appear.
Of course, beings comparable to Taicang and the other Seven Great Domain Masters would not emerge so easily, requiring not only time accumulation but also extraordinary talents of the cultivators.
Especially Taicang, whose strength among the Masters of Heaven and Earth was a notch above, even as if he had almost stepped beyond the Master of Heaven and Earth level.
Xu Yan returned from Canglan Island to Qinghua Sect, prepared to explore the Land of Imperishable.
The opportunity mentioned by the Azure Sea Turtle, he always remembered. Now it was about time to head to the Land of Imperishable.
There was no longer a place in the Great Wilderness Domain to temper himself.
Only by entering the Land of Imperishable, to seek the limitless Land of Imperishable, was the way forward.
Taicang and the other six, before they opened up their own domains, traveled through the Land of Imperishable for countless years. It was also during that time that their strength improved.
It was also while exploring the Land of Imperishable that they created their own paths of cultivation.
"Master, I would like to go to the Land of Imperishable."
Xu Yan said respectfully.
Li Xuan nodded, already aware of Xu Yan's thoughts.
"Master!"
Meng Chong, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping also said excitedly.
Among the five disciples, aside from the homebody Su Lingxiu, including Fang Hao, they all wanted to venture out.
Especially Fang Hao, who had always been busy with affairs of the Qinghua Sect, busy with cultivation. Since arriving in the Divine Realm, he had never left Qinghua state.
Only when Muxiao commanded the Imperishable True Spirit to assault the Domain did he first leave the Qinghua Sect to demonstrate his prowess and become renowned throughout the world.
Now, the affairs of the Qinghua Sect no longer required his attention. Everything was operating according to the sect's rules, and it was time for him to venture out as well.
```
Land of Imperishable, boundless and infinite, must contain many treasures.
"As for the Land of Imperishable, I shall not elaborate, the path is under your feet, go and explore for yourself, for it is the unknown that brings joy,"
Li Xuan said with a smile.
He did not understand the Land of Imperishable either, and naturally, he could not explain it to his disciples, after all, the Land of Imperishable lay beyond the Domain, fabricating stories would not do.
"Yes, Master!"
Xu Yan and the others nodded excitedly.
Li Xuan stood up, the Jade Ruyi in his hand spinning, as he looked up beyond the Domain and slowly said, "You have all attained your own paths in cultivation by now, Up next is the Martial Arts path that I shall teach you, so you can thoroughly understand it while exploring the Land of Imperishable."
It was also time to pass on the cultivation methods beyond the Creation Realm.
Moreover, although this teaching was also made up, it was not fabricated verbally, but through the Daoist Golden Book, presenting the Martial Arts Realm that he had concocted.
Such a direct and visual method was even more conducive to his disciples' comprehension.
Su Lingxiu also ran over excitedly; although she temporarily had no intention of exploring the Land of Imperishable, there must be many unknown treasures in the Land of Imperishable, many things worth studying.
For example, some special Imperishable True Spirits.
Hence, she wanted to ask her fellow disciples to gather some for her to bring back.
"Yes, Master!"
Xu Yan and the other four nodded fervently.
Li Xuan waved his hand, and golden light suffused the air as if a book had opened, its pages revealing the profound principles of Martial Arts.
"Above Creation lies Primordial, the intent of the Great Path, Primordial Chaos Domain, to understand the Great Path, to practice the Great Path..."
Li Xuan's voice echoed slowly, the page gradually revealing the mysteries of the Primordial Realm and the process of the Primordial Great Path.
Above Creation, the Primordial Great Path!
As Li Xuan explained, the realm of Primordial unfolded before them, suffused with golden light and the meaning of the Great Path swirling around, Xu Yan and the others were all immersed in the profound Primordial Great Path.
After an unknown amount of time, the mysteries of the Primordial Realm were engraved into their Divine Souls.
At this moment, Xu Yan's aura fluctuated, and he unexpectedly broke through to the Complete Domain Realm.
And Meng Chong, Su Lingxiu, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping also successively broke through to the Great Achievement of the Domain Realm.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has broken through to the Complete Domain Realm, and your Creation Realm has reached Minor Achievement,"
Li Xuan said, beaming, his strength had grown stronger once again.
As the realm of Primordial was demonstrated, Su Lingxiu also gained insight into the mysteries of the Creation Realm.
"Your disciple Su Lingxiu has comprehended the Creation Realm, your Alchemical Medical Martial Arts have broken through to the Creation Realm,"
Two Martial Arts pathways were elevated to the Creation Realm, their strength further increased.
"Martial Arts, though different in practice, all lead back to the Great Path, Physical Body Martial Arts, Qimen Martial Art, Extreme Soul Martial Arts, are also such, differing only in the process and emphasis, but ultimately all tread the path of the Great Path..."
Li Xuan started to focus on instructing Meng Chong, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping, whose Martial Arts were more specialized. After all, the Cultivation Methods of Alchemical Medical differed not so greatly from Pure Martial Arts.
Having comprehended a realm, Xu Yan, under the guidance of Li Xuan, would make it just a matter of time for Su Lingxiu to gain insight.
Whereas Meng Chong, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping each practiced distinct Martial Arts with strong specializations, especially Fang Hao whose Qimen Martial Art, involving Formations, Artifact Refining, and Prohibitions, was particularly unique.
The core of Qimen Martial Art lies in its "unpredictability," relying on strategy and the grand situation.
"Physical Body Martial Arts, at this stage, becomes the Eternal Path Indestructible Body, all paths are mine, imperishable by all, the body limitless, spacetime all within oneself, ultimately to tread upon the Great Path, using it as the road..."
Li Xuan smiled as the Daoist Golden Book unfolded, revealing the Eternal Path Indestructible Body.
"Eternal not only in name but in practice, there is no endpoint, all different paths lead to the same destination..."
Engulfed in comprehension, Meng Chong realized the magnitude and immense power of the Eternal Path Indestructible Body, Mighty Sky Limitless was actually a part of the Eternal Path Indestructible.
The Great Sun Indestructible Golden Body, Great Sun Stellar Indestructible Golden Body, all practices of the physical body are, in fact, part of the Eternal Path, all for the forging of the Eternal Path Indestructible Body.

chapters.title: Chapter 1036 - 536: The Path Never Ends, Entering the Land of Imperishable
chapters.content:
At a certain moment, Meng Chong had something of an epiphany, transcending the Mighty Sky Limitless Indestructible Body and touching upon the Eternal Path Indestructible Body.
"Your disciple Meng Chong has grasped parts of the Eternal Path Indestructible Body, and your Physical Body Martial Arts have broken through to the Creation Realm."
Li Xuan's smile was brilliant, as his Physical Body Martial Arts, too, had broken through to the Creation Realm, and his strength had grown stronger.
Once Meng Chong had committed the Eternal Path Indestructible Body to memory, Li Xuan began to instruct Fang Hao in the Qimen Martial Art, once again using the Daoist Golden Book to display its essence.
Empowered by the Dao and forming arrays with the Dao, the profound mystery entranced Fang Hao, who fell into a state of enlightenment.
"Your disciple Fang Hao has realized the mysteries of Qimen and Creation, and your Qimen Martial Art has broken through to the Creation Realm."
The Qimen Martial Art had also made a breakthrough to the Creation Realm.
Of the five Martial Arts, four had now broken through to the Creation Realm.
"The stronger my power becomes, the greater my joy. Only by increasing my strength can I attain true happiness."
Li Xuan's warm smile appeared as the Taoist Ancestor Halo emerged, and the Daoist Golden Book turned to a new page, revealing the profound mysteries of the Extreme Soul Martial Arts.
Similarly, Jiang Buping also came to realize the mysteries of Extreme Soul and Creation, and the Extreme Soul Martial Arts had made its breakthrough to the Creation Realm as well.
From then on, all five Martial Arts had broken through to the Creation Realm.
After his disciples recovered from their state of enlightenment, Li Xuan did not stop teaching Martial Arts, but continued his instruction.
At this stage of Martial Arts, it was no longer suitable to continue to invent one realm after another. Li Xuan already knew how to further strengthen Martial Arts without fabricating additional realms.
"As I have said, all Martial Arts ultimately converge, all serving the purpose of following the Dao as the path."
At these words, Li Xuan's expression turned solemn.
Xu Yan and the other four disciples quickly bowed respectfully, eager to listen to their master's teachings.
"As I have always said, Martial Arts have no end. Even I, on the path of Martial Arts, have no peers left to walk with, yet I have not reached the end of the Martial path. Perhaps it is never-ending; I just keep advancing..."
Li Xuan sighed as he spoke.
"Master is so lonely. Perhaps only Master understands the solitude of the invincible, seeking an opponent to match against but finding none. On the path of Martial Arts, when Master looks back, there's not even a single person to see his back, how could he not feel lonely."
Hearing this, Xu Yan couldn't help but sigh deeply. He knew he would never experience his master's feeling of invincible loneliness, that solitary journey down the Martial path.
After all, no matter how hard he cultivated, his Master, Li Xuan, was always ahead; he could never quite understand this "loneliness and solitude."
"Master took me as his disciple, not just due to fate, but also because of loneliness and boredom!"
Xu Yan understood the reason why his master had decided to take disciples.
It was out of boredom, looking for some amusement.
He would never be able to comprehend his master's mindset; if one cannot even see the master's back on the path of Martial Arts, how can one experience that state of mind?
But perhaps it is not necessarily so. Although he can't see his master's back, there might come a day when he looks back and can't see his peers either, and maybe then he would possess a similar feeling?
Xu Yan thought to himself.
Li Xuan looked at his five disciples with a solemn face and said firmly, "In the Primordial Domain, the great Dao is understood, and once the great Dao is understood, one walks the great Dao. Therefore, the Primordial state is all for the purpose of practicing the Dao."
"Above Primordial lies practicing the Dao, walking on the great Dao, with the great Dao beneath one's feet, making it the path—this is practicing the Dao."
"Practicing the Dao knows no bounds, realms, or end. How far one can go depends on one's own enlightenment, on how one applies the Dao."
"With each step forward as if elevating one's realm, yet the Dao is infinite, boundless. Once you start practicing the Dao, you have graduated as my disciples. The path ahead will rely entirely on yourselves, on how you choose to proceed."
Above Primordial lies practicing the Dao!
This was the path of Martial Arts that Li Xuan had deliberated over and ultimately settled on—practicing the Dao was limitless, without realms, just a path to be followed endlessly.
Once his disciples stepped into practicing the Dao, each step they took would return a hundredfold, and he would no longer need to rack his brains over how to invent new realms.
Eventually, they could become stronger simply by lying down, without exerting any effort or inventing any Cultivation Techniques.
Once successful in entering the practice of the Dao, Li Xuan was confident that with his disciples' talents, they could explore Martial Arts on their own and continue practicing the Dao.
They would have truly graduated.
And his great endeavor in Martial Arts would be successful, his teaching complete!
Of course, practicing the Dao is extremely difficult. One must not only succeed in entering the practice but must also comprehend how to step onto the great Dao and how to walk it.
The Primordial Realm is the foundation for practicing the Dao, as well as its gateway. Stepping through this gate is merely seeing the great Dao; however, seeing it doesn't guarantee one can step onto or walk upon it.
But as long as one sees the great Dao and comprehends the Method of Practicing Dao, Li Xuan could breakthrough and practice the Dao. Once he entered into the practice, even without the feedback from his disciples, he believed he could continue on.
The application of the Daoist Golden Book would also be elevated further, to the point where the Daoist Golden Book itself might become the source of the Dao!
"Practicing the Dao, the Wayfarer is eternal, the path is endless without limits!"
Li Xuan spoke solemnly, as he waved his hand, and a golden light diffused as if the Dao itself was manifesting, a solitary figure walking at ease on the great Dao. With each step, he progressed, yet there was never an end in sight, appearing lonely but at the same time contented and unrestrained.
Xu Yan and the other four disciples were deeply shaken and immersed in the vision of practicing the Dao, unable to snap back to reality for a long time. This scene deeply etched into their minds.
It seemed as though the fundamentals of practicing the Dao and the profound mysteries of the great Dao were all displayed within this view. If they could grasp even a fraction of it, they would undoubtedly be able to walk the great Dao in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 1037 - 536: The Path Never Ends, Entering the Land of Imperishable_2
chapters.content:
Li Xuan withdrew the imagery of the Daoist Golden Book and exhaled, sitting back in his chair. Everything that needed to be taught to his disciple had already been taught.
From now on, it was truly up to the disciple to comprehend.
"Following the Dao, what would happen if one could step into it? Could one transcend the Land of Imperishable?" Li Xuan reflected inwardly.
The Land of Imperishable was vast and chaotic. Was it about breaking open the Land of Imperishable to create a new Domain, or was there more beyond the chaos?
All of this was unknown.
Li Xuan felt, if he truly began to follow the Dao, perhaps he should explore whether the Chaotic Imperishable Land had boundaries, how the Land of Imperishable existed.
However, these were still far off for him.
The disciples were all immersed in enlightenment, and Li Xuan looked up at the Great Wilderness Domain. The Heavenly Dao continued to slowly strengthen, and the Domain slowly devoured the chaos, transforming it into a corner of the Domain.
This process was very slow, but as long as the overall strength of the Domain continued to increase, the Heavenly Dao would also grow, and the expansion of the Domain would not stop.
"The Heavenly Dao, perhaps one day it might replace the Chaotic Imperishable?" Li Xuan mused silently.
Looking at the Daoist Golden Book, Li Xuan's face bore a smile; after all, the Heavenly Dao was still within the great Dao, and his Heavenly Dao Seal had grown stronger due to the ascent of the Heavenly Dao.
The disciples remained submerged in their comprehension, unable to awaken for some time, and Li Xuan sat leisurely in his chair, waiting for them to awaken.
Outside the courtyard, the sweeping Muxiao was profoundly shaken. Although he had not seen the happenings within, the faintly emerging golden light and the profound mysteries that were beyond scrutiny far exceeded his understanding.
At this moment, Muxiao felt even more fortunate than ever, to have not been casually crushed to death and to have remained in this small courtyard, sweeping leaves.
"This is a tremendous opportunity!"
As this thought emerged, it could no longer be suppressed. Muxiao felt unprecedentedly fortunate, knowing what a great chance it was to sweep here.
"What a great grace from the Taoist Ancestor."
Muxiao's eyes grew moist.
"To sweep for the Taoist Ancestor is an immense opportunity!"
Holding the heavy broom, Muxiao slowly swept the ground, his heart extraordinarily calm, without impatience, without annoyance, as if all the malice had been swept away with the fallen leaves.
He seemed like an old man, sweeping the ground with piety and respect.
Shi'er also came back to his senses and, seeing Muxiao's change, said, "If the Taoist Ancestor gives a teaching someday, that would be an even greater opportunity for you!"
Muxiao paused in his sweeping, a look of joy and anticipation on his face.
"When will the Taoist Ancestor teach? Can I listen too?"
Shi'er smiled, "When the Taoist Ancestor will teach, no one knows. As for whether you can listen, now that you're here, would we really cover your ears?"
"Being here when the Taoist Ancestor teaches is a matter of fate. Since it's fate, naturally you can listen."
Upon hearing this, Muxiao nodded eagerly, determined to sweep diligently, never leaving, certain he could await the opportunity to hear the Taoist Ancestor teach!
Time passed, and Xu Yan awoke from his enlightenment.
The figure walking the Dao in his mind seemed to slowly fade away, gradually disappearing.
He was astounded; so this was the convergence of the divergent paths of Martial Arts, all ultimately following the Dao, using the Dao as the path, the Dao being infinite, without end.
There must be few cultivators who could reach this step.
"I will certainly be able to step into the path of the Dao."
Xu Yan thought resolutely.
Now, he was complete in the Domain Realm, just one step away from the Establishing Dao Realm. Walking in the Land of Imperishable, perceiving the Chaotic Imperishable, he believed he could accumulate more insights and establish his own Dao.
After Establishing the Dao comes the Creation Realm, and after that, the Primordial.
There are three realms before reaching the Dao.
Xu Yan also knew that these three realms would be increasingly difficult to break through, requiring longer periods of cultivation and accumulation.
"Master, how far have you followed the Dao?" Xu Yan asked with curiosity.
Li Xuan smiled mysteriously, "How far? I don't know. When I look back, it's vast and desolate. Looking ahead, it's endless. I just keep walking, and the scenery of the Dao along the way is also enchanting."
Xu Yan nodded thoughtfully.
"Disciple, following the Dao is hard! It's as difficult as reaching the blue sky from the mortal dust. But following the Dao is also easy, as easy as sailing down the stream. Everything depends on comprehension, on the heart, on one's own Dao," Li Xuan said seriously.
```
"Yes, Disciple understands!"
```
```
Xu Yan nodded respectfully.
```
```
All that could be taught had been imparted; the path ahead would now be determined by the disciple.
```
```
In the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, there ultimately existed some unknown dangers, not to mention the presence of a huge potential enemy, the Imperishable Temple, and the individual from that temple possessed formidable strength.
```
```
Of course, Li Xuan of the Creation Realm in all five branches of Martial Arts was brimming with confidence. Despite the possibility that the individual from the Imperishable Temple, after killing Taicang and over such an extended period, had become even more powerful, he was confident that he could suppress the adversary.
```
```
The disciple was set to explore the Land of Imperishable, and naturally, ensuring his safety was paramount; it concerned the grand undertaking of his Martial Arts and was crucial to his potential to step into the Establishing Dao Realm.
```
```
Therefore, before the disciple departed for the Land of Imperishable, Li Xuan enhanced the disciple's Life-saving Jade Charm, confident that even the individual from the Imperishable Temple would not be able to harm his disciple.
```
```
In addition, the Land of Chaotic Imperishable was boundless and vast, and delving too deep made it easy to lose one's way and become unable to find the path home.
```
```
Thus, Li Xuan personally took action, refining a Sensing Bead to enable the sensing of the Domain's direction, ensuring that one would not lose their way and be unable to find their way back.
```
```
Xu Yan, Meng Chong, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping, after bidding farewell to the others, left Qinghua Sect to prepare for their journey to the Land of Chaotic Imperishable.
```
```
On the journey to explore the unknown Land of Imperishable, having a guide naturally would be best.
```
```
"Old Turtle, it's time to head into that great opportunity."
```
```
Atop the Azure Sea, Xu Yan said to the Azure Sea Turtle.
```
```
"Going now? It's very dangerous."
```
```
The Azure Sea Turtle expressed its concern.
```
```
"My strength has already made a breakthrough, enough to face many dangers. Besides, when has the Land of Chaotic Imperishable ever been without peril?"
```
```
Xu Yan said unconcernedly.
```
```
Seeing Xu Yan's determination, the Azure Sea Turtle nodded and said, "Alright, I'll accompany you on this trip. But it's been too long; the great opportunity might not be in the same place. However, it should not be too difficult to locate."
```
```
As it spoke, the Azure Sea Turtle rose from the Azure Sea, appearing like a vast island.
```
```
After taking flight, the massive body of the Azure Sea Turtle began to shrink until it was about ten feet in size, whereupon Xu Yan, along with Meng Chong and the others, landed on its shell.
```
```
"Let's go, you are familiar with the Land of Imperishable, perfect to explain it to us!"
```
```
The Azure Sea Turtle was a bit confused. Were they treating it as a steed?
```
```
It hadn't even offered its allegiance yet!
```
```
The Azure Sea Turtle thought about shaking them off its back, but then it considered this: they were all inheritors of the Taoist Ancestor's teachings, whom it could not afford to offend.
```
```
And could it be that as a result, it had now become a member of the Taoist Ancestor's lineage?
```
```
If so, that was a gain!
```
```
With this thought, the Azure Sea Turtle no longer resisted. Carrying Xu Yan and the others, it headed for the area beyond the Domain.
```
```
"The Land of Chaotic Imperishable is boundless and infinite, with each region differing from the next, and moreover, it changes with time. Only those who have personally experienced it can understand the uniqueness of the Land of Imperishable, which words fail to adequately describe."
```
```
The Azure Sea Turtle introduced the Land of Imperishable.
```
```
"Is that the Azure Sea Turtle?"
```
```
"Isn't that Sword God Xu Yan, Heavenly God Meng Chong, Qimen Fang Hao, and Spear Devil Jiang Buping? Are they headed to the Land of Imperishable?"
```
```
A Realm Master who noticed Xu Yan and the others spoke with surprise.
```
```
"They must be going to the Land of Imperishable for training. After all, they are the direct disciples of that individual, not to be viewed with common standards!"
```
```
"Indeed!"
```
```
All Realm Masters withdrew their gaze, envy was unavailing!
```
```
With a thunderous roar, the Azure Sea Turtle, carrying Xu Yan and the four, burst through the Domain Barrier and entered the Land of Imperishable. Looking back, the Domain was majestic and vast, appearing like a dazzling jewel amidst the Chaos of Imperishable.
```
```
In a moment of clarity, they vaguely understood why the Imperishable Temple aimed to consume the Domain.
```
```
They also realized why the Imperishable True Spirits were eager to enter the Domain—it was like a beacon of light in the darkness, attracting creatures from the shadows.
```
```
"Of the Seven Great Domains, only one remains."
```
```
The Azure Sea Turtle lamented with a sigh.
```
```
Looking up at where the Netherworld and the witches once resided, not a trace was left; the other Domains had long since vanished.
```
```
In times past, looking up, one could see seven distinct and splendid jewels existing within the Chaos of Imperishable.
```
```
Among them, Taicang was the most magnificent and alluring, also the largest.
```
```
Now, Taicang too had become a part of history, replaced by the Great Wilderness. And due to the presence of Heavenly Dao, the Great Wilderness appeared even more splendid and spectacular than during the time of Taicang.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1038 - 537: The Secret of the Great Domain War, The Catastrophe of Hong Ze Domain
chapters.content:
Four people and a turtle left the Domain, entering the Land of Imperishable, casting their eyes far into the distance, boundless and Chaotic Imperishable.
The Violent Spiritual Energy in the Land of Imperishable filled the air with Imperishable Qi, and only creatures of the Divine Venerate Realm or above could walk there and avoid being harmed by the violent Spiritual Energy and Imperishable Qi.
It was precisely because of the violent nature of the Spiritual Energy that the True Spirits of the Land of Imperishable were irritable and had thick skins, making them easily provoked.
In the midst of the violent Spiritual Energy, the presence of Imperishable Qi also meant that the True Spirits of the Land of Imperishable could not possess Spiritual Wisdom and had only ordinary animal consciousness.
The Azure Sea Turtle, feeling the Violent Spiritual Energy of the Land of Imperishable, became somewhat nostalgic, having not entered the Land of Imperishable for a very long time.
It was born in the Land of Imperishable and, by a stroke of fate, had developed Spiritual Wisdom and had once received the Creation of Purple Light.
However, with the emergence of the Imperishable Temple, great tribulation had arrived, and everything had changed.
"Old Turtle, where is this great opportunity you spoke of, and what is it exactly?"
Xu Yan stood on the turtle's back, gazing into the distant Chaos.
"A great opportunity indeed!"
The Azure Sea Turtle sighed, looked in a certain direction, fell silent for a while, then moved swiftly towards that direction.
"The great opportunity is a Domain, though it is now a dead Domain, but it is an intact Domain nonetheless. Wouldn't you say that's a great opportunity? Even if you disdain using this Domain to become the Master of Domain, the Domain itself is a great opportunity!"
The Azure Sea Turtle said in a deep voice.
Xu Yan and his companions were stunned, a dead but intact Domain?
Whether it was a great opportunity or not was another matter, but such a Domain was indeed a Supreme Treasure.
"This Domain you speak of, which Domain is it? One of the Seven Great Domains?"
Xu Yan asked inquisitively, "Since it's a Domain, why didn't you claim it? Perhaps it could have helped you become the Master of Domain?"
The Azure Sea Turtle sighed again, and a look of fear appeared in its eyes. Despite the passage of many long years, the memory of that scene still brought an uncontrollable fear to its heart.
"I escaped from that Domain, barely alive by sheer luck. Besides, even if I wanted to, I couldn't. Moreover, I have a mental block regarding that Domain, how could I possibly claim it?"
Meng Chong scratched his head, curiously said, "What exactly happened that has left you with such a lasting mental block and still feeling fear after all this time?"
He couldn't help but murmur, "You, old turtle, seem to be quite faint-hearted."
The Azure Sea Turtle gave a wry smile, "You haven't experienced it, you don't know that kind of terror..."
Pausing for a moment, the Azure Sea Turtle felt that they would never understand such fear, after all, they were backed by that extremely terrifying being.
With such a terrifying master, how could they experience that despair and fear?
"Old Turtle, tell us in detail, what exactly is it? Where is this Domain, is it one of the Seven Great Domains?"
Xu Yan sat cross-legged on the turtle's back, asking with keen interest.
"It is one of the Seven Great Domains."
The Azure Sea Turtle, reminiscing about the past, "The Prime Tortoise Carapace I gave you, do you know its origin? It fell during that great calamity, and it was my dear friend..."
Xu Yan and his companions sat on the turtle's back, listening to the Azure Sea Turtle recount the great calamity and the life-and-death crisis it had experienced.
"Prime Tortoise and I were both one of the overlords of the Hong Ze Domain, having followed Hong Ze for many years. Hong Ze is a True Spirit of Water, he cultivates the Way of the Water, so in ancient times, the other Six Great Domains, anyone who cultivated any secret technique or Martial Arts related to water, would seek opportunities to come to Hong Ze Domain for cultivation.
"Hong Ze Domain is a Domain of Water, with over eighty percent being vast waters, the remaining land being islands in these expanses of water. I am the Azure Sea Turtle, ruling over the region of Cang Hai within Hong Ze.
"The appearance of the Imperishable Temple brought an unimaginable calamity, with Fen Yun being the first to suffer. In fact, before the incident in Fen Yun Domain, the Seven Great Domain Masters had once joined forces and reached an agreement with the Imperishable Temple.
"Who would have thought that the Imperishable Temple would suddenly betray us, and among the Seven Great Domains, there emerged a traitor..."
The Azure Sea Turtle carried Xu Yan and his companions towards the direction where the Hong Ze Domain was once located, beginning to recount the battle of the Ancient Domains.
"Someone from the Fen Yun Domain was seduced by the Imperishable Temple, secretly betraying us, which is why the Fen Yun Domain suddenly encountered trouble, and Taicang and the others failed to notice in time."
"As for how the Imperishable Temple struck, why the Fen Yun Domain suddenly vanished, how Fen Yun fell, it's all unknown, until the Witch discovered the remains of Fen Yun and confirmed it was the Imperishable Temple's doing, Taicang decided to fight, otherwise they would be defeated one by one."
"Much more detail about that battle, I do not know, presumably those who did, fell in the great war, of course maybe Taihe and Taikun know more."
Xu Yan and his companions listened silently, they were aware of the general course of that ancient war, but since Tian Zi was not a participant, his understanding was not detailed enough, and some details might be skewed.
With the recounting by the Azure Sea Turtle, Xu Yan and his companions learned more about the details of that ancient battle.
Following the death of Fen Yun, Taicang and the others united, began preparations against the Imperishable Temple, the Six Great Domains started to move, drawing closer together, forming defensive and offensive formations.
The Imperishable Temple stopped hiding, revealed its power, and began preparations for the great battle, from the initial minor conflicts to the final battle, there was a period of time."

chapters.title: Chapter 1039 - 537 The Secret of the Great War of the Domain, The Calamity of Hong Ze Domain_2
chapters.content:
Before the final battle, a Master of Heaven and Earth level power emerged from the Imperishable Temple, letting the six from Taicang know that within the Imperishable Temple, there existed beings who had not yet explored their own Domains but possessed the strength of a Master of Heaven and Earth.
Although their strength was weaker than theirs, they were still at the Master of Heaven and Earth level.
The Minor Heaven and Earth Masters of the Six Great Domains were unable to contend with the Master of Heaven and Earth level opponents on their own, and the gap between their strengths began to show gradually.
It was also through constant conflict and battle that they gradually came to understand more about the Imperishable Temple, which had been wandering in the Land of Imperishable for an exceedingly long period.
It came from the unexplored Land of Imperishable that Taicang and the others had never set foot in. Due to the long passage of time, the Imperishable Temple had gathered many strong characters.
And their purpose was to invade Domains, devour the life within, and claim the opportunities therein, to achieve some end.
It was also for this reason that the masters of the Six Great Domains knew that as Masters of Domains, they would not be accepted by the Imperishable Temple; even surrender would be futile, surely leading to death.
The traitors from the Fen Yun Domain had already been partitioned and devoured. Within the Six Great Domains, there might be hidden traitors, but after this event, they knew that aligning with the Imperishable Temple would also be undoubtedly fatal.
"Even so, some still sought refuge in the Imperishable Temple. During the great battle, they turned against the Domain. Of course, they probably had no way out by then, only able to fight in a desperate gamble, most likely secretly controlled by the Imperishable Temple, with no choice but to do so,"
sighed the Azure Sea Turtle.
Xu Yan nodded. He remembered the scene he saw in the wilderness, the battle between the ancient mountain and the Nether Shaman. The Nether Shaman obviously pledged allegiance to the Imperishable Temple or was controlled by it.
"Muxiao showed up before the great battle, in a fight, using True Spirits to strike at the Domain. The Heavenly Tiger from the True Spirit Domain, extremely strong, led the tiger clan to meet Muxiao in battle. The tiger's might was vast, intimidating those True Spirits, but they ultimately failed."
The Azure Sea Turtle recalled the scene, sighing, "The strength of the Heavenly Tiger had actually just touched the edge of the Master of Heaven and Earth Realm, but in the end, it was still a bit short, and Ao Hong and two other Masters of Heaven and Earth were locked in confrontation, unable to provide timely help..."
Fang Hao curiously asked, "Red Cat, it wouldn't have the bloodline of the Heavenly Tiger, would it?"
Meng Chong scratched his head and said, "When Master captured Red Cat, it was just an ordinary tiger... No, perhaps Master saw that Red Cat was different from ordinary tigers, which is why he captured it."
"Red Cat Great Demon King? It indeed has Heavenly Tiger bloodline, but being a Great Demon King's, it feels different from the might of the Heavenly Tiger,"
remarked the Azure Sea Turtle with some confusion.
"Red Cat practices the Path of the Great Demon. Even with the bloodline of the Heavenly Tiger, it would not evolve toward becoming a Heavenly Tiger,"
Xu Yan said with a smile.
Red Cat chose the Path of the Great Demon, not the bloodline advancement of a Spirit Beast, eventually to transform into a True Spirit.
"Old Turtle, continue,"
Xu Yan prompted the Azure Sea Turtle to keep telling the story of the great Domain war that took place.
When Muxiao attacked the Domain, it was Ao Hong who finally stepped in, displaying the might of the True Spirit Master with overwhelming Dragon Might, breaking Muxiao's control over the True Spirit Force.
"Muxiao was rescued, and that was the last major conflict before the great battle,"
continued the Azure Sea Turtle.
As the Heavenly Tiger fell, the powers of the Six Great Domains realized they were at a disadvantage against the threat of the Imperishable Temple. Even if the Masters of the Six Great Domains could each fight two Masters of the Imperishable Temple, they couldn't stabilize the situation.
It was necessary for several stronger Minor Heaven and Earth Masters to band together to stall the remaining Masters of Heaven and Earth, but how long could they delay the overwhelmingly powerful opponents?
The initial plan of the Six Great Domains was to keep delaying, to prevent a true great war from breaking out.
"Now, in retrospect, stalling for time was to buy more time for Taicang to become stronger, but the Imperishable Temple did not keep delaying,"
said the Azure Sea Turtle with a somber expression.
"That day, sixteen Masters of Heaven and Earth from the Imperishable Temple, leading the strong members of the Temple, joined forces to attack. The great war was imminent, for those were sixteen Masters of Heaven and Earth.
"Even if the six from Taicang could handle two each, the rest were not within the capacity of us Minor Masters of Heaven and Earth. Although we could rely on the power of the Dao Principles of the Domain to resist the Masters of Heaven and Earth, at that time, we were all prepared to die!"
"It was also at the beginning of the great war that we found out how much Taicang had surpassed the other six Masters of Domain,"
"Facing the assault of sixteen Masters of Domain, six from Taicang's side came out of their own Domains to meet the battle."
"While the five from Wicth Demon held off ten Masters of Domain, Taicang boldly made a move, erupting with incredible strength. In a short span of time, he directly slew four Masters of Domain!"
At this point, the Azure Sea Turtle seemed somewhat exhilarated.
"Do you know what a scene that was, what confidence it instilled in us, what belief? Our victory was beyond doubt, Taicang's strength was unimaginable."
"It was at that moment that a figure appeared in the Imperishable Temple. Taicang only managed to severely injure the remaining two Masters of Domain before he had to intervene to block the other party."
"The war intensified into a fever pitch, with the controlled betrayers also taking action. There were battles both within and beyond the Domain."
"We all knew that the key to victory lay with Taicang and that one other, and Wicth Demon was also extremely powerful. During the battle, he even killed a Master of Domain, then immediately took control of the Wicth Demon Domain. In an instant, he unleashed its power and cut down the remaining Master of Domain. Wielding the power of the Wicth Demon Domain, he charged the Imperishable Temple, wanting to join forces with Taicang against that one..."
Xu Yan's mind conjured the image of the towering figure he had seen while wandering the wilderness.
Taicang!
"The battle grew even more fierce, and at this time, the gap between those who had created their own Domains and those who had not became apparent."
"Hong Ze brought rolling waves, sweeping across the Land of Imperishable, forcing the two Masters of Domain from the Imperishable Temple into constant retreat. We were gaining the advantage in the battle of the Masters of Domain, and we all believed that the victors would undoubtedly be us."
"Even if that one from the Imperishable Temple was a bit stronger, the six of us together would surely defeat him."
"Who could have imagined that we would be the ones to fall in the end?"
The Azure Sea Turtle said this with a mixture of unwillingness and despair.
"How did Taicang die, and how did you end up defeated?"
Xu Yan couldn't help but ask.
"I don't know!"
The Azure Sea Turtle shook its head.
"To this day, we still do not know why we were defeated, nor how Taicang fell."
The Azure Sea Turtle gave a bitter smile and said, "Hong Ze, with the vast waters of his Domain, swept across the Land of Imperishable towards the Imperishable Temple, while the Hong Ze Domain itself began to shift. Then another Master of Domain appeared, attacking the Hong Ze Domain."
"Although this Master of Domain was weaker, after all, it was not someone that I, Prime Tortoise, and the others could resist. We had no choice but to rely on the Dao Principles of the Hong Ze Domain to fend them off, preventing them from entering the Domain."
"As this battle went on, the Hong Ze Domain drifted further and further from the main battlefield, and I no longer knew how the situation on the battlefield was changing."
Speaking up to this point, the Azure Sea Turtle paused, an unmistakable fear appearing in its eyes.
Xu Yan knew that what followed was the catastrophe of the Hong Ze Domain, which became a desolate Domain. The Azure Sea Turtle was incredibly fortunate to have survived, but that very survival caused the Azure Sea Turtle to fear every time it remembered the event.
"We don't know how much time passed, continuously fending off that Master of Domain's attacks. The longer it lasted, the more we felt the advantage was on our side, believing that Hong Ze would quickly return to slay that Master of Domain."
"The ultimate victory of the great war would surely be ours."
"But, we were all wrong; the ones who were defeated were us. Hong Ze did indeed return, but he was dragged back by the neck."
The voice of the Azure Sea Turtle trembled, the fear in its eyes deepening.
"It was that one from the Imperishable Temple, dragging Hong Ze back, who directly smashed Hong Ze into the Domain, transforming into raging waters. He devoured the life force of the Domain, devoured everything within the Domain, and Hong Ze was swallowed along with the Domain by him."
"That was too horrifying. I hid deep within the soil of the Azure Sea, frantically executing my innate Turtle Breath technique. Even so, I felt the Domain dying, countless creatures perishing, Hong Ze was dead, Prime Tortoise although had activated a secret technique, was also dead."
"I felt myself about to die as well, nearly unable to hold on any longer. Then, that one from Imperishable Temple suddenly left, and from a distant part of the Domain, noise from the great war could be heard..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1040 - 538: Experiences in Walking the Land of Imperishable
chapters.content:
The Azure Sea Turtle's voice trembled, and its gaze was filled with fear as it looked at Xu Yan and the others, "I often think, how fortunate I've been, how lucky. The entire Domain had fallen silent, Hong Ze had perished, but I survived.
"The Prime Tortoise was so close, just a little more and it could have lived on, but in the end, it couldn't hold on and only left behind that carapace. When I left, I took the Prime Tortoise Carapace with me.
"Every time I look at the Prime Tortoise Carapace, I feel fortunate that I am the only one in the entire Domain that survived."
At this moment, Xu Yan and company began to understand the Azure Sea Turtle's fear, that scene was indeed too horrific and had a great impact on the Azure Sea Turtle's spirit.
The Prime Tortoise Carapace still contained a small Domain space, which meant that everything about the Prime Tortoise hadn't been completely devoured, so the Prime Tortoise Carapace still retained the small Domain laws.
The Azure Sea Turtle was indeed lucky. If the Prime Tortoise could have held on a little longer, perhaps it too would have remained.
This was also due to the fact that the Prime Tortoise's strength was not as great as the Azure Sea Turtle's, let alone matching the natural ability of the Azure Sea Turtle's Turtle Mysterious Breath, thus it didn't make it.
"I guess when Hong Ze died, Taicang had not yet fallen, and the Master of the Imperishable Temple retreated to battle against Taicang. He might have discovered that inside the Hong Ze Domain, I had not perished.
"But to him, this bit of remaining vital Spiritual Energy of mine is negligible. After all, the entire Domain had fallen silent. It wouldn't matter if this tiny part of mine was gone," the Azure Sea Turtle speculated.
"What does the one from the Imperishable Temple look like, what's his name?" Jiang Buping asked curiously.
"I don't know!"
Who would have thought, the Azure Sea Turtle shook its head and said.
"You don't know? Didn't you see him?" Fang Hao asked in surprise.
"Couldn't see his true face, only saw a terrifying figure, indescribable, hard to describe. That day, the Domain seemed to be shrouded in darkness, as if it were a giant mouth, enveloping the world, sucking it in..."
Fear in the eyes of the Azure Sea Turtle, and a bitter smile on its face.
Xu Yan and the others were amazed; the individual from the Imperishable Temple was somewhat of a mystery, even Taihe and Taikun, who participated in the great battle, hadn't described his appearance.
Moreover, the strange aura on Taihe and Taikun's bodies came from that person. Su Lingxiu, in her research, had not yet fully understood the peculiarity of that aura.
It seemed that once one was touched by it, it would cling like a malignant parasite, difficult to purge, and it had an ominous quality as if it could erode a being's luck, very special indeed.
"Frankly, I was fortunate to escape with my life. My whole body had gone soft; I was trembling and couldn't stand, and I also left a mess behind. But I don't feel ashamed at all, not in the least. It was too terrifying.
"I even didn't know how long I had been limp, only that the battle had ended and that there had been no movement in the Chaos Primordial Land for a very long time.
"The Domain was deathly silent, everything was gone. It took me a long time to slowly stand up again, to drag my severely wounded body away from the silent Hong Ze Domain, away from that fearful place.
"Indeed, I could have stayed in the Hong Ze Domain, even tried to heal my wounds, and then possibly attempt to ascend to the Master of Domain level using the Hong Ze Domain as a foundation.
"But you also know, the Hong Ze Domain had become a barrier in my heart, a shadow that filled me with constant fear, an uncontrollable kind of fear, so I could only flee."
After pouring out his heart, the Azure Sea Turtle seemed to feel as though a weight had been lifted, and its spirit felt much relieved at this moment.
It had held these thoughts inside for far too long, always wanting to confide in someone, but there had never been the right person. He had also been afraid to talk about it for a long time, even scared to recall it.
Before this, the Azure Sea Turtle had even locked away this part of its memory, wanting to forget it completely.
Listening to the Azure Sea Turtle's outpouring, Xu Yan and the others couldn't help but sigh at how fortunate this old turtle was to have survived that calamity.
Even after many years had passed, the memory of that catastrophe still filled the Azure Sea Turtle with fear.
The individual from the Imperishable Temple truly was terrifying, having directly devoured Hong Ze and everything in the Hong Ze Domain.
"After leaving the silent Hong Ze Domain, I headed towards the Taicang Domain to confirm the final outcome of that great war. When I saw that the Taicang Domain still existed, that Netherworld, the Witch Demon Domain, although damaged, still stood and hadn't completely collapsed, I was ecstatic.
"I had thought that the Six Great Domains had won in the end, but then I found out that Taicang had fallen!"
At this point, the Azure Sea Turtle expressed helplessness and sorrow, even still struggling to believe it.
Taicang, such a mighty existence, capable of slaying Master of Domain level beings with a wave of the hand, and the fact that I had managed to survive was also related to Taicang, and yet it was defeated!
"My wounds were severe, and even though my Turtle Mysterious Breath is powerful, I couldn't stay in the Land of Imperishable forever, without any chance of recovery. So I waited for an opportunity to sneak into the Taicang Domain.
"It was only upon entering the Taicang Domain that I found it had changed, and there were still disputes between it and the Netherworld, and the Witch Demon Domain. Being an outsider, it wouldn't have been good if I had been discovered, so I hid.
"I also wondered, since Taicang had lost, why did the Taicang Domain still persist? It seemed like the Imperishable Temple had retreated. What exactly happened during that great battle? Could it be that the one from the Imperishable Temple was severely injured?
"But I didn't dare ask anyone, even people I once knew. After all, times have changed, and for those Realm Masters, I am of great value, a treasure."

chapters.title: Chapter 1041 - 538: Experiences in Walking the Land of Imperishable_2
chapters.content:
In the end, the Azure Sea Turtle gave a self-deprecating smile.
"The great battle from long ago, and the many mysteries it held, how did Taicang fall, and just how strong was that individual from the Imperishable Temple? Since they managed to kill Taicang, why did they not absorb the Taicang Domain?"
And now that the Taicang Domain still exists, could it be that the individual from the Imperishable Temple was seriously injured, unable to strike against the Taicang Domain again?
If that's the case, the individual from the Imperishable Temple might not be much stronger than Taicang was.
But only those who participated in the final battle know the truth. Even Taihe and Taikun don't know what exactly happened, as they were at the periphery of the battle's core.
And everyone else has perished.
"What's the deal with Netherworld? Wasn't it said that he, as a Master of Domain, couldn't possibly side with the Imperishable Temple, so how did he successfully join them without being absorbed?"
Xu Yan said with uncertainty.
According to the Azure Sea Turtle's words, creatures of the Domain, especially the Masters of Domain, could not join the Imperishable Temple due to irreconcilable conflicts with it.
To side with the Imperishable Temple ultimately meant to be absorbed by it.
Yet Netherworld emerged as a member of the Imperishable Temple and appeared to absorb the Netherworld Domain he created and left with five Blood Lords.
"Netherworld..."
The Azure Sea Turtle pondered, "Among the Seven Great Domain Masters, Netherworld was one who delighted in slaughter. As you know, the people of Netherworld practice the Blood Path, once cultivating by absorbing the essence blood of Martial Artists. It's rumored that the Netherworld came to life by absorbing the blood of Imperishable True Spirits, and upon fortifying itself with the blood of Imperishable True Spirits, it developed Spiritual Wisdom and began to use blood for cultivation."
"The Netherworld Blood Sea was filled with the blood of countless True Spirits. He established the Netherworld Domain and slaughtered numerous Imperishable True Spirits. Perhaps he was accepted by the Imperishable Temple because his cultivation methods allowed him to absorb essence blood?"
"Exactly how, we can't know, but Netherworld himself has always been proud and unsubmissive. He was once suppressed by Taicang for a while but never once bowed his head. Him choosing to side with the Imperishable Temple is indeed unexpected."
The Azure Sea Turtle sighed.
"Is it possible that Taicang's fall was due to Netherworld's betrayal?"
Fang Hao mused thoughtfully.
Among the Six Great Domain Masters, to date, it's confirmed that only Netherworld is still alive and has joined the Imperishable Temple. There's reason to believe that betraying and striking at Taicang during the battle would align with his interests.
Moreover, Taicang once suppressed Netherworld, and there was some animosity between the two. It's possible Netherworld would stab Taicang in the back.
"I don't know!"
The Azure Sea Turtle shook its head.
"I once heard the Hong Ze Boss saying, Netherworld was direct and straightforward, never hiding his likes or dislikes towards others, nor his hatred. Although suppressed by Taicang, he never seemed to resent Taicang, as there was always a reason for everything.
"Of course, this doesn't mean Netherworld couldn't commit betrayal. It's just hard to believe."
The four of them and the turtle moved towards a certain place through the vast Chaotic Imperishable.
Looking back in the direction of the Great Wilderness Domain, they only saw a small magnificent Treasure Bead amidst the chaos.
As even the Great Wilderness Domain disappeared from sight, Xu Yan and the others felt a surge of excitement, looking ahead into the boundless Chaotic Imperishable Land.
The old war that led to Taicang's fall was long past history, and their curiosity about this part of history couldn't amount to the feelings and regrets of those who had lived through it themselves.
"Old Turtle, where is the Hong Ze Domain, and how much farther is it?"
One of the once Seven Great Domain and now a dead world, Xu Yan and his companions were quite curious.
"After such a long passage of time, the Hong Ze Domain is no longer in its original place, but it is generally in this direction. If we keep searching, we should be able to find it," the Azure Sea Turtle explained, "Domains within the Land of Imperishable don't remain stationary. They're slowly moved by the exploding Spiritual Energy and Imperishable Qi, and although the movement is extremely slow, they don't stay in one place forever."
"Having lost their Dao Principles and becoming dead worlds makes them move even faster. However, they generally won't drift too far off course. Even if not in the original spot, as long as we know the general direction of a Domain, it's quite easy to find."
Xu Yan and the others nodded, not in a rush, since entering the Land of Imperishable was not solely for the Hong Ze Domain.
The boundless Land of Imperishable held too many unknowns, too many places worth exploring.
"Eh, why does that mountain have such an odd shape? Could it be a True Spirit?"
Fang Hao exclaimed in surprise.
Ahead in their field of vision, they had come upon a mountain, shaped like some kind of beast lying on its back.
"Mountains in the Land of Imperishable are all transformed from True Spirits after their death. Moreover, based on the mountain's strength and size, one can deduce the True Spirit's power when it was alive."
The Cang Hai Turtle began to explain, "The more powerful the True Spirit, the more likely it will transform into a mountain under the influence of Imperishable Qi instead of decaying."
"Generally, the area around a mountain is the territory of a certain True Spirit. If there is a chain of mountains, it signifies the region of a very powerful True Spirit's clan."
"That mountain has been there for a long time and there's no trace of a True Spirit's presence. Either a solitary True Spirit died and was transformed here, or the clan was annihilated or migrated elsewhere."
"I see!"
Xu Yan and the others suddenly understood.
"Let's go and take a look inside the mountain, maybe we'll find something useful."
Fang Hao said excitedly.
The Cang Hai Turtle had no objections and carried the four of them to the mountain.
"Judging by the scale and strength of this mountain, the True Spirit's power in life must have been at the Minor Heaven and Earth Master level, not weak at all."
The Cang Hai Turtle observed the mountain and spoke.
"How can one determine a True Spirit's power when it was alive?"
Xu Yan asked curiously.
"It's quite simple. Look at the size of the mountain, its strength, and whether there are other things born on the mountain..."
The Cang Hai Turtle patted the mountain, producing a dull sound, and continued to explain.
"Mountains in the Land of Imperishable are generally hollow on the inside. Of course, there are ones that are not hollow, but such mountains are rare. If one needs to evade a True Spirit's pursuit, they can hide their aura and take refuge within the mountain."
"Of course, the True Spirits of the Land of Imperishable are not very intelligent. If they don't sense an aura, they will quickly leave instead of entering the mountain to search."
"However, if one encounters the pursuers from the Imperishable Temple, they need to be more cautious. They also know that mountains are places to hide. To rely on a mountain for cover, one needs to pick the right one."
"Additionally, the mountain may be the den of certain True Spirits. Once inside, one is at risk of being attacked. The Land of Imperishable houses all kinds of True Spirits, some of which possess special abilities."
"No one knows exactly how many kinds of True Spirits there are in the Land of Imperishable. Even the Seven Great Domain Masters, who once compiled a register of Imperishable True Spirits, lamented that they likely recorded less than one percent..."
After all, as a True Spirit of the Land of Imperishable, the Cang Hai Turtle had roamed the Land of Imperishable for countless years and was extremely knowledgeable about it.
Masters like Old Man Xiao knew far less about the Land of Imperishable than the Cang Hai Turtle did.
Xu Yan and the group listened intently, for these were valuable experiences for navigating the Land of Imperishable.
"There's no True Spirit inside this mountain. To discern if a True Spirit is within, one can look for signs. Typically, True Spirits leave behind excreta, but some like to conceal themselves and don't leave any traces, so one needs to be careful."
"Of course, the entrances to the mountains are sometimes well hidden, and sometimes one can spot an opening at a glance. If you're careful at the entrance, you can usually determine if it leads to a True Spirit's den."
"Apart from some extremely special True Spirits where no traces can be seen, as long as Divine Spirit Soul Force probes, any presence can be detected. These Imperishable True Spirits, having almost no intelligence, will reveal themselves upon sensing the Divine Spirit Soul Force..."
The Cang Hai Turtle was imparting experience to Xu Yan and his companions.
Fang Hao was also inspecting the mountain, searching for materials that could be of use. One purpose of his journey into the Land of Imperishable was to collect materials that didn't exist in the outer domain.
The four men and one turtle entered the interior of the mountain. Fang Hao spotted a piece of pale red stone and couldn't hide his delight.
"This is a good find, excellent material for Artifact Refining."
Fang Hao said as he waved to collect the large stone, "Once purified, it's enough to refine a Divine Artifact imbued with fiery power."
This stone, evidently, was the transformed heart of a True Spirit.

chapters.title: Chapter 1042 - 539: Searching for Hong Ze Domain, A Powerful Finger Bone
chapters.content:
Four people and one turtle left the mountain, continuing their journey to find the Hong Ze Domain. Fang Hao sat on the turtle's back, refining the big rock.
"I have a plan, collect materials from the Land of Imperishable, refine a Flying Boat, suitable for flying in the Land of Imperishable, and equipped with abilities like stealth, defense, and exploration."
Fang Hao excitedly spoke about his plan.
"Good, that's a great idea!"
The Azure Sea Turtle agreed immediately.
After all, once the Flying Boat was crafted, there was no need for it to carry them anymore; they could just use the Flying Boat to travel.
"The Land of Imperishable lacks nothing; it is far beyond what the Domain can compare to, all sorts of rare items are present."
The Azure Sea Turtle excitedly explained to Fang Hao about the various rare materials hidden within the Land of Imperishable.
During the following journey, the Azure Sea Turtle actively looked for mountains along the way and places where treasures might exist, aiming to help Fang Hao collect all the necessary materials for refining the Flying Boat as soon as possible.
A roar!
From ahead, a horde of Imperishable True Spirits was coming, having sensed the presence of the four and the turtle, and was actually charging towards them.
"Our aura is very different from that of the Imperishable True Spirits. Because of the big difference, some True Spirits might attack us, even considering us as some kind of delicious food."
The Azure Sea Turtle explained.
The horde of True Spirits that charged at them wasn't very strong; the one leading them didn't even possess the strength of a Realm Master Level.
"In the Land of Imperishable, the quantity of weaker True Spirits is the largest, and these True Spirits are usually the food of the stronger True Spirits."
The Azure Sea Turtle ignored the approaching horde of True Spirits, did not dodge or evade, and instead directly confronted them.
"The blood and Divine Soul of these True Spirits are corroded by the Imperishable Qi, be a bit careful when eating it, don't let the Imperishable Qi contaminate your Divine Soul, otherwise it would be quite uncomfortable and take time to separate the Imperishable Qi."
The Azure Sea Turtle warned.
For those with strength beyond the Supreme Sovereign Realm, even though they cannot refine the Imperishable Qi, a casual touch wouldn't leave them confused, but it would still affect them and require the separation of the Imperishable Qi.
Of course, if one were to be eroded by a large amount of Imperishable Qi all at once, even warriors of the Supreme Sovereign Realm couldn't avoid becoming confused, but such situations were ultimately unlikely.
For Xu Yan and the others, the Imperishable Qi posed no threat at all; they could incorporate it into their Sword Intent or even use it to practice some Divine Skills.
"I wonder if True Spirit meat tastes good."
Xu Yan said with a smile.
"I can use my Great Ding now."
Fang Hao took out a big Ding and placed it on the turtle's back.
"My fellows, there's no need for you to take action, let your junior brother handle this, guaranteeing the integrity of the True Spirit's body."
Jiang Buping stood up smiling, his hands wielding the Extreme Soul Divine Spear, hurling it intensely towards the horde of True Spirits.
Boom!
The aura of the Extreme Soul instantly surged, and in a moment, the charging True Spirits fell down with a thud, lifeless.
The True Spirits behind immediately let out terrified roars, stopped in their tracks, and then scattered in all directions.
The Azure Sea Turtle swallowed, looking at the spear with a secretly shocked heart.
That's terrifying!
With one throw of the spear, the might instantly vanquished the Divine Soul Consciousness of the True Spirits, incredibly frightening.
Jiang Buping beckoned with his hand, and the Soul Spear returned, dragging along the ten-odd True Spirits whose Divine Soul Consciousness had been destroyed.
"Fifth Junior Brother's Extreme Soul Martial Arts, the killing power is astonishing!"
Fang Hao exclaimed.
Xu Yan and Meng Chong nodded, in terms of slaughtering Divine Souls, Jiang Buping was the strongest.
Even Xu Yan's attacking Divine Soul Sword Intent and Divine Skills were not as fierce and ultimate as those of Jiang Buping, after all, Extreme Soul Martial Arts represented the extreme of killing Divine Souls.
It is the ultimate path of the Divine Soul.
"These True Spirits indeed have great uses, let's keep a portion for our senior sister, and we'll eat the rest."
Fang Hao said cheerfully, collecting two of the True Spirit bodies; he would later return them to the Great Wilderness to give to Su Lingxiu.
Then, Xu Yan raised his hand and in an instant, sliced open the True Spirits, cutting them into pieces, all of which were thrown into Fang Hao's big Ding.
"Try my craftsmanship, I will stew the deliciousness with the method of artifact refinement."
Fang Hao said excitedly, as flames blazed under the Ding, beginning the cooking process, and for seasoning, he chose some Spiritual Medicine to throw into the Ding, even pouring in a bottle of Pill.
"The Pill refined by our junior sister has a great flavor, suited for blending with True Spirit meat and it also enhances the aroma!"
Soon, an aroma wafted out.
The Azure Sea Turtle swallowed, looking back at its shell where the Ding sat steaming, its fragrant scent billowing out, rich and overwhelming.
"Here, old turtle, this True Spirit meat really tastes amazing!"
The meat in the Ding was well-cooked, and Xu Yan scooped up a large piece of True Spirit meat, handing it to the Azure Sea Turtle.
"In my whole life, this is the first time I've eaten such delicious True Spirit meat!"
The Azure Sea Turtle remarked.
The four people and one turtle, while enjoying their meal, continued on their journey to find the Hong Ze Domain.
The Land of Imperishable was boundlessly chaotic; walking in the Land of Imperishable, they didn't even know how much time had passed.
After all, in the Land of Imperishable, there were no day and night, everything looked chaotic, solely relying on their own senses to judge the passage of time.
In a certain mountain, Fang Hao was collecting materials, while Xu Yan and the others circled this mountain, admiring the strength of this particular True Spirit in life.
Based on the experience taught by the Azure Sea Turtle, they could determine this was a True Spirit of the Master of Domain level.
"The Land of Imperishable is not lacking in strong True Spirits of the Master of Domain level."
Xu Yan sighed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1043 - 539: Searching for Hong Ze Domain, A Powerful Finger Bone_2
chapters.content:
Then, he asked with some confusion, "Why are there only seven Masters of Domain in the Seven Great Domains?"
The seven from Taicang were powerful and had hunted many True Spirits, including some comparable to the Master of Heaven and Earth level.
But aside from the seven Taicang individuals, including the Heavenly Tiger, none had reached the level of Master of Domain, despite all being intelligent beings with access to Cultivation Methods.
"In the Land of Imperishable, True Spirits of the Master of Heaven and Earth level are not so commonly found. This True Spirit was probably slain here by one of the seven from Taicang. Moreover, although we have gained intelligence and Cultivation Methods, compared to those powerful True Spirits, we are still quite young."
"Moreover, we have received the purple light of Creation, which opened up a Minor Heavenly Domain, transforming our own nature as living beings. We need time to break free from these fetters, and what we lack is time, not the ability to break through to the Master of Heaven and Earth Realm."
The Azure Sea Turtle sighed and explained, "When a Domain is opened, everything requires time to grow. We are no different. Moreover, the title Master of Domain is designated after the opening of a Domain, and even among Masters of Domain, there can be significant differences in strength."
"Only those who have opened a Domain are true Masters of Domain. Their strength is considerably more powerful than those True Spirits who are merely at the Master of Heaven and Earth level."
After thinking for a moment, the Azure Sea Turtle added, "Actually, before we gained intelligence, our strength was already comparable to that of Masters of Domain's True Spirits. But after we gained intelligence, things changed somewhat, as we were no longer mere beasts without intellect."
"To us, the moment we gained intelligence felt like the true moment of our birth, like newborn infants. Everything needed growth, and perhaps this is the price to pay for acquiring intelligence."
Xu Yan expressed his astonishment, "So you mean, after you gained intelligence, your strength weakened, and you need to train to become stronger?"
The Azure Sea Turtle shook his head and said, "Maybe, maybe not, I am not sure. After all, our memories from before we gained intelligence are very vague. It is only a feeling that we used to be very strong, nothing more."
"Of course, whether it's an illusion or not is also unknown. Perhaps Taicang would know, since some followed him before we gained intelligence. Whether there was any change in strength then, only Taicang knows."
After exploring the mountain, the four and one turtle continued their journey, moving further away from the Great Wilderness Domain and deeper into the Land of Imperishable, encountering True Spirits more frequently.
Because the aura of the party was distinctly different from that of Imperishable True Spirits, they invariably attracted the attention of these True Spirits, leading to inevitable hunts.
Xu Yan and his companions used this as an opportunity to hone their Martial Arts and refine their Divine Skills.
Once, they encountered a horde of True Spirits led by several Realm Master Level True Spirits, and could only engage briefly before escaping the horde.
"Old turtle, how much farther to Hong Ze Domain?"
Meng Chong looked out over the vast Chaos, scratching his head as he asked.
"We are nearly where Hong Ze Domain was originally located."
The Azure Sea Turtle said solemnly.
One day later, Xu Yan and his companions noted that the Land of Imperishable seemed darker and the Spiritual Energy more fierce ahead.
The Azure Sea Turtle slowed down, breathed out, and suppressed the rising fear inside him as he said solemnly, "Hong Ze Domain was originally right there!"
Looking around now, not to mention a vast Domain, there was not even a small mound, indicating that Hong Ze Domain had indeed drifted from this place.
"If we continue forward, we should find Hong Ze Domain. The drifting pattern of Domains is somewhat regular. I predict that Hong Ze Domain will continue in the original drifting direction."
The speed of the Azure Sea Turtle increased.
Xu Yan and his companions looked forward with anticipation, about to see one of the Seven Great Domains, Hong Ze Domain. Although it was a silent and dead Domain, it was a complete Domain.
Even a silent and dead Domain is a Supreme Treasure, holding significant meaning for their comprehension at the Domain Realm level.
Perhaps, they could even derive some enlightenment from this dead Domain and achieve a rapid breakthrough in strength because of it.
Another day later, looking out, they still saw only vast Chaos, with no trace of the Domain.
Even the Azure Sea Turtle was puzzled.
"This shouldn't be right. Hong Ze Domain has become silent and lost control; its drifting speed should not be fast."
"Is it possible that Hong Ze Domain was taken away by the Imperishable Temple?"
Fang Hao said solemnly.
"It's unlikely."
The Azure Sea Turtle shook his head, "The Imperishable Temple has no interest in a dead Domain; they do not care about it."
After a moment of contemplation, he said, "Perhaps there was some unforeseen event that caused Hong Ze Domain to drift faster or deviate from its original direction."
The Azure Sea Turtle looked around and slightly adjusted the direction of their travel, "Based on my calculations, Hong Ze Domain shouldn't have strayed too far; it's just a matter of spending a bit more time looking for it."
Xu Yan nodded. Entering the Land of Imperishable was meant for exploration and training; finding Hong Ze Domain was not their sole purpose.
Four people and a turtle continued their search for the Hong Ze Domain, another day later.
"There's something off about that mountain, it seems like there's a fire burning inside."
Xu Yan suddenly exclaimed in surprise.
Meng Chong and the other two also looked in the direction he indicated, toward a distant, towering mountain on the left front, which resembled some kind of beast lying there.
From the scale of the mountain, it was clearly a True Spirit on the level of a Master of Domain, and among the powerful ones at that level.
"Let's go and take a look!"
The Azure Sea Turtle immediately headed towards the mountain, and as they got closer, Xu Yan was astounded to see, through his Minor Heavenly Eye, a twilight-like glow inside the mountain, and the closer they got, the more intense the feeling of heat became.
"Why is it hot here? Could it be that this True Spirit had the power of fire and, even after death, its energy of origin hasn't completely dissipated?"
The Azure Sea Turtle looked puzzled, "But from the look of this mountain, this True Spirit has been dead for a long time, and it seems it was killed. How could there still be remaining energy of origin?"
"Let's go in and find out."
Xu Yan moved in a flash and instantly arrived on the mountain.
Meng Chong and the others followed closely behind.
"Inside the mountain, there seems to be some kind of flame, could be a treasure. This flame might help with Artifact Refining, let's see what treasure it is."
Fang Hao was exhilarated.
"This intense heat feels somewhat familiar to me."
The Azure Sea Turtle looked uncertain.
"Have you encountered it before?"
Fang Hao asked with a raised eyebrow.
"Not encountered, but this fire's aura..."
The Azure Sea Turtle found an entrance to the mountain's interior and hurriedly entered, wanting to confirm its speculation.
Xu Yan and the others quickly followed behind.
"Old Turtle, tell us, what's special about this fire's aura?"
Xu Yan asked curiously.
Upon entering the interior, they were met with a sight like a red dawn's light, and the air was intensely hotter.
As they ventured deeper, the walls of the passage were incredibly smooth, as if they had been scorched by flames.
Boom!
A terrifying wave of heat surged forward, and even though the four were not weak, they still felt a scorching sensation.
The inside of the mountain was a vast cave, its walls smooth as porcelain, illuminated by a red dawn-like light.
The red dawn light and the intense heat emanated from a bone about a foot long in the center of the cave, which seemed to be a finger bone!
The red finger bone, stuck in the center of the cave, emitted an intense heat without any visible flames.
And the cave inside this massive mountain seemed to have been burned out by this finger bone.
Xu Yan looked back towards the entrance, from its position, it seemed to be where the deceased True Spirit's mouth was located.
The finger bone was either fired into it from the True Spirit's mouth or was bitten off and swallowed by the True Spirit.
But the powerful flame contained within the finger bone directly incinerated the True Spirit's internal organs, which was the cause of its demise.
A single severed finger had slain a True Spirit of the Master of Domain level; the owner of this finger must have been terrifyingly powerful.
Xu Yan and his brothers exchanged glances, all harboring a guess that left them profoundly shocked by the violent battle that must have taken place here.
Of course, it's also possible that the battle didn't occur here, but that the True Spirit, seriously wounded, fled the battlefield and ultimately fell here!

chapters.title: Chapter 1044 - 540: Fen Yun's Remains, Encounter with Blood Frenzy
chapters.content:
The Azure Sea Turtle stared at the phalanx bone, lost in thought for a long time, and finally sighed. No wonder there was a familiar feeling, its guess had indeed come true.
"This is Fen Yun's skeleton!"
The Azure Sea Turtle said somberly, "Fen Yun was said to be a Fire Spirit, and in terms of understanding and strength of the fire element, there was none stronger than him. Although he and Hong Ze had no enmity, they would argue and clash every time they met.
"However, it was just that, intense disputes were merely settled by a test of skills, not deep-seated hatred. In fact, they were rather on good terms. According to Taicang, water and fire are incompatible by nature. One being a Fire Spirit and the other a Water Spirit, it was destined to be so."
Fen Yun, the master of the Fen Yun Domain and one of the Seven Great Domain Masters, was the first to fall.
Moreover, how he fell is probably something only the other six Domain Masters know.
Of course, not even all the six Domain Masters might know the true circumstances of Fen Yun's downfall.
"Now, it seems that Fen Yun was ambushed. This True Spirit was one of those who ambushed him, and it is very likely that it was a True Spirit from the Imperishable Temple."
The Azure Sea Turtle sighed.
"As one of the Seven Great Domain Masters, Fen Yun's fire combat power was extremely strong, and his fire was incredibly fierce. The Imperishable Temple's decision to target Fen Yun first, was it perhaps due to this?"
The Azure Sea Turtle speculated.
"This is not where Fen Yun fell. If a great battle had erupted here, Taicang and the others would have surely sensed it and come to aid immediately."
The Azure Sea Turtle said with some regret, "Where exactly Fen Yun was killed, and how he was killed, are probably only known to the Witch and Taicang."
Fen Yun's remains were first discovered by the Witch, and he must have informed Taicang, but whether he would tell Netherworld, Ao Hong, Hong Ze, and Qing Ling was uncertain.
"Just a phalanx bone, yet not an ordinary treasure, I will take this bone. It will be quite useful. Our conflict with the Imperishable Temple is irreconcilable, and we will eventually battle them. Using his phalanx to kill some of them from the Imperishable Temple would also avenge him somewhat. Fen Yun surely wouldn't object," Fang Hao said, sighing as he stepped forward to collect the phalanx.
The phalanx of Fen Yun, containing the Law of Fire, was indeed a Supreme Treasure of Fire.
"Using his phalanx to kill the enemies of the Imperishable Temple, Fen Yun would definitely not object. Rather, he would be pleased to see it happen," the Azure Sea Turtle said with a smile.
Fang Hao waved his hand, and a prohibition fell, about to seal and retrieve the phalanx.
Suddenly, with a booming sound, the phalanx burst into flames.
The flames were fierce, and one could faintly sense an underlying fury, seemingly the remnants of the rage Fen Yun felt before his demise.
"Prohibit!"
