Fang Hao raised his eyebrows, pointed his finger, and a prohibition fell, blocking the flames.
Boom!
But the prohibition was shattered by the phalanx's explosive, furious flames. That sense of anger grew stronger, almost as if determined to perish together!
"Though it's not a Remnant Soul, it's indeed a sort of obsession. Fen Yun's death was filled with such rage and unwillingness to accept his fate, perhaps because he experienced betrayal," said Jiang Buping, sighing.
He pointed with his hand, and the Extreme Soul Power brushed over, gradually calming the rage within the phalanx.
"Fourth brother, I have soothed the angry spirit in this phalanx. The method is simple, seek revenge for him," Jiang Buping said with a smile.
"I understand now. Having this sense of anger is actually a good thing. Once we battle those from the Imperishable Temple, this anger can evoke even greater power," Fang Hao nodded and waved his hand to retrieve the phalanx.
The anger within the phalanx could make the flames more furious, enhancing their power by thirty percent.
"Let's go."
This giant mountain transformed by the fallen True Spirit held only Fen Yun's phalanx. Now that the phalanx had been taken, it was time to continue searching for the location of the Hong Ze Domain.
The four brothers and the turtle resumed their journey. Fang Hao began to refine the collected materials, pondering how to create the Flying Boat.
Over the next two days, they encountered several groups of True Spirits. After hunting them, they continued on their way, but still did not find the location of the Hong Ze Domain.
"Could it be that the Hong Ze Domain was really taken away?"
The Azure Sea Turtle couldn't help but waver.
"The probability that it was taken is not small, but we came to the Land of Imperishable to explore, to be trained, so let's keep exploring," Xu Yan was not particularly disappointed about this.
The Azure Sea Turtle looked around and said pensively, "Perhaps, we have deviated in our exploration direction. The Hong Ze Domain has shifted beyond my expectations. Let's explore for another day; if fruitless, we'll change direction."
Suddenly, a streak of blood light abruptly appeared, arriving in an instant.
"Watch out!"
The Azure Sea Turtle's expression changed, and with a great roar, a layer of azure light emerged, rolling like waves to form a defense.
Xu Yan and the other three brothers looked towards the blood light. The comer was a Minor Heaven and Earth Master, with surging blood energy and formidable strength.
One of the Blood Lords from the Netherworld Domain.
"Blood Frenzy?"
The Azure Sea Turtle said sharply.
Blood Frenzy looked at the Azure Sea Turtle, then at Xu Yan and the others, mulling, and slowly raised his hand, a Blood Blade materializing in his palm.
"Azure Sea Turtle, you're still alive," Blood Frenzy said, somewhat surprised, then looking at Xu Yan and the brothers, he spoke coldly, "Which of you four is Xu Yan? Which is Meng Chong? I've heard about the prodigies from the Taicang Domain."
Meng Chong touched his head, beaming, "I didn't expect my name, Meng Chong, to have reached the Netherworld Domain."

chapters.title: Chapter 1045 - 540: Fen Yun's Remains, Encounter with Blood Frenzy_2
chapters.content:
Blood Frenzy evidently did not come with good intentions. With Meng Chong's current strength, he naturally was no match for a Minor Heaven and Earth Master.
However, Azure Sea Turtle was also of Minor Heaven and Earth Master's strength. The four of them together with the turtle were also not afraid of Blood Frenzy.
"You are Meng Chong, then you must be Xu Yan," Blood Frenzy said coldly as he looked at Xu Yan.
"Since we've met, I guess you are just unlucky. It's time for you to face this death fate!" Blood Frenzy said, his killing intent chilling.
"Don't hope that Azure Sea Turtle can save you; his defense is passable, but his attack and speed are somewhat lacking. All four of you will fall here in the Land of Imperishable today," Blood Frenzy said as he raised his hand and the blood light reflected in the Land of Imperishable. A giant Blood Blade appeared in front of him, emitting a cold murderous intent.
Azure Sea Turtle looked solemn and transmitted his voice, "Blood Frenzy's strength is strong. Although I have recovered from my injuries, I have ultimately not returned to my peak condition. Moreover, he is right; I am good at defense but weak in attack and speed."
"Blood Frenzy's appearance here, I guess, is also directed at Hong Ze Domain. This indicates that Hong Ze Domain has not been taken by the Imperishable Temple. He must have guessed we are here for the Hong Ze Domain."
"I will try my best to withstand his attacks and look for an opportunity to escape."
Yet Xu Yan said indifferently, "Old Turtle, it's fine that you are strong at defense. You just focus on defending; we will handle the offense. Since Blood Frenzy has encountered us, it seems his luck has run out."
Azure Sea Turtle was startled and looked at Xu Yan in amazement, "You want to kill him? You can already slay a Minor Heaven and Earth Master?"
How much time has passed? Xu Yan's strength has already grown this much?
"Not quite there yet, but it would be difficult for a Minor Heaven and Earth Master to hurt me. You just focus on defending confidently. Your speed may be slow, but we are not. We can always hide within your defense, and let us brothers handle the attacks. It's a good opportunity to test the Minor Heaven and Earth Master's strength and sharpen ourselves," Xu Yan said.
Now Xu Yan had already reached the Complete Heaven and Earth Realm, although he could not slay a Minor Heaven and Earth Master, it was also difficult for one to breach the defense of his Yin Yang Undying Sword.
And Meng Chong, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping had all achieved Great Achievement in the Domain Realm, being defended by Azure Sea Turtle, they naturally were also not afraid of Blood Frenzy's threats.
The four brothers, blending the arts of four different Martial Arts styles, slaying Blood Frenzy was not impossible.
Xu Yan attacked with powerful Sword Dao, Meng Chong targeted Blood Frenzy's physical body, Jiang Buping aimed at Blood Frenzy's Divine Soul, while Fang Hao used Formation to restrain, block, disturb, and confuse the opponent, searching for weaknesses.
"The be careful!" Azure Sea Turtle nodded his head.
Since Xu Yan and his brothers chose to fight, it was evident they were somewhat confident.
Boom!
With a movement of Blood Frenzy's hand, a giant Blood Blade had already struck down, and his figure moved instantly to the side of the Azure Sea Turtle, striking again, trying to bypass Azure Sea Turtle and directly attack Xu Yan and the others.
"Blood Frenzy, talk after you break through my defense!" Azure Sea Turtle roared as his shell burst into dazzling blue light and his body instantly transformed into the size of a small mountain, resembling a massive shield.
Xu Yan and his brothers hid behind Azure Sea Turtle, watching Blood Frenzy, ready to erupt.
"I might not be able to break your defense, but you naïve old turtle, thinking you can protect them, is wishful thinking!" Blood Frenzy sneered.
Suddenly, multiples of Blood Shadow appeared; his figure darted around, attacking continuously, looking for gaps to close in, avoiding Azure Sea Turtle's defense, directing his attacks at Xu Yan and the others.
However, what he didn't expect was that though Azure Sea Turtle's speed was slower than his, Xu Yan and his brothers were not slower at all. They always moved behind the protection of Azure Sea Turtle's defense before he could get close, evading his attacks.
"Interesting, but how long can you hide!" Blood Frenzy said unconcerned. Even he had heard of the prodigies of the Taicang Domain; having this ability was within expectation.
"Hide?" Xu Yan scoffed with disdain.
Whoom!
Momentarily, the Land of Imperishable lit up with sword light, the intense Spiritual Energy, and Imperishable Qi condensed into multiple swords, each carrying the ultimate Sword of Slaughter Intent.
Xu Yan, surrounded by the Yin Yang Undying Sword, endlessly circulating, stood directly outside Azure Sea Turtle's defense, facing Blood Frenzy.
Thunderous boom!
Meng Chong also transformed into a golden giant at that moment, his golden Armor resplendent and majestic, truly like a Heavenly God.
The violent power of his physical body surged ceaselessly.
Fang Hao slapped the Weapon Box, several Divine Artifacts shooting out and scattering across the battlefield. Stepping forward, the Qimen Grand Formation also emerged at this moment, taking the battlefield as its domain.
In the Land of Imperishable, this area suddenly formed a great momentum, converging like a deep, muddy pond.
Hum!
Jiang Buping's body radiated a faint glow, as if enveloped by a layer of Soul Armor, clutching an Extreme Path Soul Soldier in his hand, continuously concentrating an ultimate killing power.
Blood Frenzy slightly narrowed his eyes in shock, truly understanding why the Blood Kings and Xuezhi were so astonished by Xu Yan and Meng Chong's strong Martial Arts when he saw the four of them display their skills.
"What Martial Arts is this?"
Blood Frenzy was gravely concerned, whether it was Xu Yan's Sword Dao, Meng Chong's Heavenly God-like presence, Fang Hao's Qimen Grand Formation, or Jiang Buping's Extreme Soul Martial Arts had all exceeded Blood Frenzy's understanding—these were Martial Arts he had never heard of before.
"A legacy of Taicang?"
At this moment, Blood Frenzy's intent to kill Xu Yan and the others grew even more intense.
"Xu Yan, Meng Chong, and the other two must certainly be Taicang's backup, seeds prepared for future revenge!"
Mere observation of Xu Yan and the others' exhibited Martial Arts led Blood Frenzy to believe that none of them, once breaking through to the Realm Master Realm, would be his match.
This showed just how powerful the Martial Arts practiced by Xu Yan and his companions were.
Does that mean that any of them, once becoming the Master of Domain, would have a power possibly comparable to, or even stronger than, the initial Taicang?
The equivalent of four Taicangs working together—how could the Imperishable Temple stand against them?
"And you think you can resist?"
Although Blood Frenzy was shocked internally, his mouth wore a sneer of disdain.
"Slash!"
As Blood Frenzy spoke, a massive Blood Blade rapidly struck out, slashing towards Xu Yan.
At the same time, multiple Blood Shadows transformed into rolling blood waves, powerful auras surging, with numerous Blood Blades emerging within the waves, exuding chilling killing intent, attacking from all directions.
"Careful!"
The Azure Sea Turtle called out a warning, and blue light surged on its shell, transforming into rolling Azure Sea waves, forming a shield that deflected the incoming Blood Blades.
Hum!
Xu Yan raised his hand, and currents of Sword Dao and Sword Intent converged, forming a massive, cold sword light which seemed to carry a sacred meaning.
The sharp intent to kill faded away, and from this sword, no killing intent could be felt, only a sacred aura as if it were not a Sword of Slaughter but a holy Precious Sword.
"Old turtle, get closer to him!"
Xu Yan said firmly.
"Getting too close makes it easy for him to spot a flaw."
The Azure Sea Turtle hesitated.
"Don't worry, give him this opportunity; let's see if he can withstand our combined attack, brethren. Find the right moment to switch from defense to offense and restrain him for a moment."
Xu Yan spoke nonchalantly.
"Alright!"
The Azure Sea Turtle thought for a moment. Xu Yan and his companions were the true inheritors of that legacy; how could they not have a lifesaving card up their sleeve?
Thus, the Azure Sea Turtle began to move closer under the barrage of attacks from Blood Frenzy.
Blood Frenzy sneered, slowing his attacks to let the Azure Sea Turtle come closer, looking at Xu Yan and the others with a glint of mockery in his eyes.
Young and brash, thinking that by joining forces, they could harm or even kill me?
That's too naive!
He was, after all, the Minor Heaven and Earth Master—was it that easy to kill him?
If the opponents were recklessly attacking him, it also provided him an opportunity; if they were seeking their own demise, then he would oblige them!
Blood Frenzy knew exactly what the others were thinking, but he paid it no mind, instead plotting based on their plan.
Xu Yan's gaze was calm, not concealing their intentions at all, which let Blood Frenzy see an opportunity—it would be seen who would have the last laugh.
"Arrogance, underestimating the enemy, comes with a price."
Xu Yan thought coldly to himself; Blood Frenzy, relying on his strength as the Minor Heaven and Earth Master, and the Azure Sea Turtle, adept in defense but not in offense, thought he could dismiss their collective attack, thinking he could easily fend it off and even find a chance to strike—unbeknownst to him, even though he was the Minor Heaven and Earth Master, he could not withstand the combined strike of the four.

chapters.title: Chapter 1046 - 541: Severely Injuring the Minor Heaven and Earth Master, Blood Prison Domain
chapters.content:
As the two sides drew closer, the Azure Sea Turtle felt its heart rise up, its expression solemn as it stared intently at Blood Frenzy, ready to withstand injuries if necessary to block him.
The Minor Heaven and Earth Master is not so easy to kill.
Besides, how could Blood Frenzy not have some powerful moves to use in a life-and-death crisis?
Xu Yan never underestimated his enemies, especially since Blood Frenzy was a Minor Heaven and Earth Master, but the Azure Sea Turtle's defenses were extremely strong. Being also of Minor Heaven and Earth Master strength, it would be enough to restrain Blood Frenzy at the critical moment.
The moment Blood Frenzy was restrained would be the best opportunity to slay him.
As for Blood Frenzy facing a life-and-death crisis and employing a powerful secret technique, Xu Yan had anticipated this, and the Prime Tortoise Carapace was already prepared.
He could replace the Azure Sea Turtle, with the Prime Tortoise Carapace and his Yin Yang Undying Sword, enough to withstand Blood Frenzy's attack!
Apart from the Prime Tortoise Carapace, Fang Hao had prepared too, instantly setting up eighteen layers of a Great Formation in a moment, with the Burn Cloud Finger Bone as its core. Since Burn Cloud was the Master of Domain, using its finger bone as the core of the formation would enhance and suppress Blood Frenzy's attack.
With such multiple defenses, even if Blood Frenzy employed a powerful secret technique, he would not be able to injure the four brothers.
Blood Frenzy, being a Minor Heaven and Earth Master, was confident and arrogant, underestimating the killing power of Xu Yan's group, and naturally, he would face a life-and-death crisis.
Blood Frenzy's lips curled in a cold smile, his eyes fierce with killing intent; in his sleeve, a small, three-inch-long, crimson Blood Blade was already clasped in his palm.
Waiting for the moment, when a flaw in the Azure Sea Turtle's defenses slightly showed, it would be the time to deal a fatal blow to Xu Yan.
"So full of youthful vigor, too proud and underestimating the Minor Heaven and Earth Master. Thinking you are completely safe under the protection of the Azure Sea Turtle? With your strength, even if I don't defend myself, I'll only suffer a minor injury, but killing all four of you, that would be worth it," Blood Frenzy coldly thought to himself.
Having been through countless battles and injuries more than once or twice, it's just another minor injury which would soon heal. But using a small injury to kill Xu Yan and his companions was worth it.
After all, the geniuses of Taicang Domain deserved such a cost!
Boom!
The colossal body of the Azure Sea Turtle began to shrink, a blue light rippling around it, clashing with Blood Frenzy's waves of blood, which started to recede, seemingly unable to withstand the impact from the Azure Sea Turtle.
But both sides knew the moment to determine victory or defeat, life or death, was about to arrive.
Hum!
A sword light with a holy aura slowly rose, hovered not far in front of Xu Yan, with its tip pointing at Blood Frenzy, ready to attack.
Fang Hao exhaled, and the Divine Artifacts scattered around the battlefield gradually emerged, the grand moment in the Land of Imperishable about to erupt with the Qimen Grand Formation and the Great Defense and Slaughter Formations ready to trigger at any time.
Meng Chong's body inflated slightly, and behind his head, a great sun slowly rose.
The Extreme Path Soul Soldier in Jiang Buping's hand had a sharp aura that gradually vanished, as if it had completely converged onto the soul soldier, and the weapon began to seem somewhat ethereal.
Boom!
Finally, the two sides closed in.
Suddenly, the Azure Sea Turtle opened its mouth, spitting out a brilliant blue light, striking at Blood Frenzy in an instant, and at that moment, a weak spot appeared in its defenses.
Xu Yan raised his hand and the sword light fiercely fell.
Divine Skills, Heaven-defying Sword!
This sword, now executed in the Holy Sword Realm, bore a Sword Intent that annihilated heaven and earth, far surpassing it had before.
Boom!
The formation instantly descended, covering Blood Frenzy. Beneath Fang Hao's feet, it seemed as if mysterious patterns were emerging, and the battlefield turned into a strange configuration.
Meng Chong raised his hand, but did not attack immediately.
Blood Frenzy snickered coldly, the tiny Blood Blade in his hand shot out from the blood wave, like a point of crimson light, instantly piercing through the Chaotic Imperishable Land.
At the same time, a strong blood light surged from Blood Frenzy, his aura reaching its peak; with a wave of his hand, the blood wave swept out like a whirlpool, instantly enveloping the Azure Sea Turtle.
He intended to hold the Azure Sea Turtle for just a moment; without its protection, slaying Xu Yan and his companions would be effortless!
Blood Frenzy also transformed into a Blood Shadow in an instant, ready to rush forward.
This series of moves had been well prepared by Blood Frenzy, but to his astonishment, that little Blood Blade had actually been dodged by Xu Yan!
On the spot, only a shadow of Xu Yan was left.
And in that instant, the Boom of the Great Formation was triggered; as Blood Frenzy, ready to strike, suddenly felt his whole body stiffen, as if bound by chains.
Under his feet, it felt as though a swamp was churning, making him feel as if the area he was in were spinning.
"What is this technique!"
At this moment, Blood Frenzy's expression grew tense. Though he could burst through these bindings in an instant, this method was something he had never seen before.
At the same time, Xu Yan struck with his sword.
Hum!
As the sword came down, Blood Frenzy felt his scalp tingle, an intense sense of crisis emerged, and he was shocked in his heart, "How could Xu Yan possibly threaten me!"
He was a Minor Heaven and Earth Master, and logically, it was almost impossible for someone from another realm to injure him; even if he stood still, it would be difficult for those in the Supreme Sovereign Realm to hurt him.
After all, the Domain Laws of a Small Heaven and Earth Master were not something a Supreme Sovereign Realm Warrior could break through.
However, Xu Yan's sword could break through the Domain Laws shielding him, and the intent to annihilate made him feel a life-and-death level threat.
This shock was substantial, and at this moment, Blood Frenzy realized he had long underestimated Xu Yan!

chapters.title: Chapter 1047 - 541: Severely Injure the Minor Heaven and Earth Master, Blood Prison Domain_2
chapters.content:
But, although Blood Frenzy was surprised, he was not disordered, having experienced countless battles and survived many crises.
Hum!
The Blood Blade, missing its target, burst back in an instant and shot toward Xu Yan again, who raised his hand to strike, and a viscous force, like blood, manifested in front of him.
But at that moment, he was shocked to see the Azure Sea Turtle shift its position, unexpectedly blocking behind Xu Yan, and intercepted the strike of the Blood Blade.
At the same time, a deep blue light, like the waves of the Azure Sea, crashed toward him, restraining half of his power.
Hum!
Suddenly, a huge figure shimmering with golden light appeared beside him; Meng Chong, in an instant, had reached his side, and his strike, poised and ready, hammered down.
Divine Skill, Heaven Lifting Earth Extinguishing!
Meng Chong's all-out strike was incredibly fierce, as if holding up the heavens, violently smashing down.
This was a powerful Divine Skill of Physical Body Martial Arts.
Hum!
As Meng Chong made his move, Blood Frenzy felt a chill appear—a Long Spear suddenly materialized in front of his eyes!
Not right!
This Slaughter Spear was not seen by the eyes, but sensed by the Divine Soul!
Divine Soul attack!
At this moment, an intense life-or-death crisis overwhelmed him; Blood Frenzy realized he had been careless, never expecting that Xu Yan and his companions could unleash such terrifying destructive power and could penetrate the Minor Heaven and Earth Laws protecting him!
Boom!
A torrent of extreme blood light surged from Blood Frenzy; a series of cracking sounds followed, and the Great Formation that Fang Hao used to bind him instantly collapsed.
Even the Qimen Grand Formation had broken at one corner.
Fang Hao's face paled slightly, having already exhausted his strength by shifting the positions of the Azure Sea Turtle and Meng Chong with the Qimen Grand Formation. Now, the Qimen's Great Formation was nearly unable to hold.
However, with a point of his hand, the Qimen Grand Formation transformed the area's Imperishable Land into a Prohibition in an instant, landing upon the surging blood light.
The blood light paused for a moment, but in that moment, it was a matter of life and death!
Puff!
A sharp Long Spear pierced into Blood Frenzy's Divine Soul, and a sword split open his body; ferocious power smashed his flesh!
"Ah!"
Blood Frenzy let out a scream of agony!
"You must die!"
The furious essence burst forth within the blood light, like viscous blood, forming into a terrifying giant mouth, spewing countless strands of blood, spreading in all directions, enveloping from every side.
"Quick, get out! This is the Blood Prison Domain!"
The Azure Sea Turtle's expression changed, it stood on its hind legs, rising up fully, and its forelimbs lashed out—the deep blue light blasted toward the enclosing blood strands.
The screams of Blood Frenzy continued, the intense pain from the Divine Soul unbearable even for him.
At that moment, Blood Frenzy, severely wounded, his physical body destroyed, and his Divine Soul pierced, the injuries spreading, directly unleashed his reservoir technique using his own Minor Heaven and Earth Laws!
"Azure Sea Turtle, get out of here!"
Blood Frenzy roared in anger.
If he could refine and devour Xu Yan and the other three, his injuries might recover somewhat, but as for the Azure Sea Turtle, he was aware that he couldn't harm it!
But, Blood Frenzy was confident that the Azure Sea Turtle, with its attack power, would be unable to break through his Blood Prison Domain, and once his Blood Prison Domain fully enveloped, it would naturally exclude the Azure Sea Turtle!
The blood strands gathering from all directions, like a spider web, unless one could break the enclosing blood strands, would inevitably be entangled and cocooned, ready for Blood Frenzy to devour and refine.
However, these blood strands, being the Minor Heaven and Earth Laws of Blood Frenzy, a Minor Heaven and Earth Master, were not easy to break; the Blood Prison Domain was a powerful secret technique of a Netherworld Minor Heaven and Earth Master.
Like the Blood Sea Purgatory, those who entered were undoubtedly condemned to death.
Even the mightiest of peers would perish if carelessly entrapped and refined into vital essence.
The Azure Sea Turtle, with its strong defense, was naturally unafraid, but Blood Frenzy's target was not the Azure Sea Turtle; hence, he was confident he could refine Xu Yan and the others, using their essence to heal his injuries.
This battle, Blood Frenzy admitted he had been careless, surprised by the devastating injuries inflicted and also shocked by the strong Martial Arts of Xu Yan and his companions, which had completely exceeded his expectations.
Xu Yan's expression remained unchanged as the Prime Tortoise Carapace emerged, instantly forming a small domain-like defense that enveloped Meng Chong, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping within.
All four of them were within the protection of the Prime Tortoise Carapace as the body of the Azure Sea Turtle enlarged once again, and it spoke in a deep voice, "Enter my Azure Sea Domain, exhaust him to death!"
Blood Frenzy was severely injured and absolutely couldn't last much longer. The Azure Sea Turtle was confident that with its defense, it could exhaust him to death.
"Old Turtle, later, infuse your power into my sword,"
Xu Yan, however, appeared indifferent as a sword appeared in front of him.
Looking at this sword, Xu Yan felt deeply moved. Since breaking through to the Heart Sword Realm, he had seldom used the sword in his hand, always converting objects into swords or using his own power as the sword.
Today, he finally drew his sword again!
Hum!
The sword light gently rippled, a sacred significance enveloped the sword, making it appear to have a holy essence.
The rippling sword light, in an instant, seemed to contain a mountain-river domain.
Xu Yan held the sword, aiming its tip at the mass of blood light that was still emitting low roars and screams—Blood Frenzy. He didn't use this sword to break open the Blood Prison Domain, but to strike down Blood Frenzy!
With the death of Blood Frenzy, the Blood Prison Domain would naturally collapse on its own!
The Minor Heaven and Earth Master was not so easy to kill. If other Realm Masters had suffered such an attack, they probably would have perished, yet Blood Frenzy was still capable of using such ultimate secret techniques.
However, the four brothers, Xu Yan, were not ordinary Taicang Martial Artists; their practice of Martial Arts was powerful, further, they were Domain Realm Martial Artists and possessed Domain Power, which means that they could use their Domain Power to eradicate the original source of the Minor Heaven and Earth Master!
This was also where Xu Yan's confidence in killing Blood Frenzy lay.
Boom!
The sword in Xu Yan's hand seemed to hold a mountain-river domain; with his left hand, he slapped, and a golden dragon roared as it merged into the sword, vaguely visible was the World within the Sword as if there were Golden Dragons coiling inside.
Above, the Golden Dragon roared, and below, the populace wielded the sword; thunder emerged from all four corners of the Domain, and a gentle breeze blew. This seemed not just a sword but a Domain in itself.
Meng Chong raised his hand, and a punch cast a sun, which directly merged into the sword, and in an instant, a sun appeared in the World within the Sword.
Not only that, but Meng Chong also infused the overpowering Sword Intent into the sword.
Jiang Buping gathered a spear in his hand, condensing it from Extreme Path Soul Force, which he also infused into the sword, causing some changes in the World within the Sword.
Fang Hao waved his hand, and invisible Great Formation, Qimen Grand Formation, and Prohibition all entered the sword, the Domain within the sword had a major power convergence, as if the entire Domain was a great enigma.
The sword trembled, as if it could shatter at any moment.
"It's your turn, Old Turtle!"
Xu Yan looked at the Azure Sea Turtle and said.
The Azure Sea Turtle's face showed a shocked expression. What kind of Sword Dao was this? Xu Yan was actually assembling the powers of Meng Chong, Fang Hao, Jiang Buping, and his, concentrating them within this sword.
How did Xu Yan manage to include such diverse powers without dispersion, and be able to merge and activate them in an instant?
Looking at the sword in Xu Yan's hand, it seemed to see a small domain, as if this were not a sword, but a Domain, and yet again, like the World within the Sword.
To envelop the powers from all sides within a Domain, then transformed into a slaughtering sword?
The Azure Sea Turtle was internally shocked. He looked at the wave of blood that had now enveloped him, forming a surge of blood around, in the low roars and screams of Blood Frenzy, there was even a hint of easiness.
Blood Frenzy was doomed to die!
The Azure Sea Turtle knew that Blood Frenzy, as a Minor Heaven and Earth Master, could not withstand this sword.
Already heavily injured, how could he resist this sword?
Mind you, this sword also gathered his, the Minor Heaven and Earth Master's power, plus the powerful Martial Arts of Xu Yan, Meng Chong, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping, enough to eradicate the origin of Blood Frenzy!
The deep blue light, like the waves of the Azure Sea, surged into the sword, and the World within the Sword witnessed a vast expanse of waves, tumultuous and rolling.
Hum!
The sword trembled, even making slight creaking noises, this sword was almost unable to bear it.
"That's enough!"
Xu Yan said in a firm voice.
The Azure Sea Turtle stopped continuing to input power, not blinking an eye as he stared at the sword in Xu Yan's hand, at this moment he even felt a slight threat from this sword.
Knowing that with such a strong defense, he could feel a threat, how could the heavily injured Blood Frenzy possibly withstand it?
"Today, Xu Yan slays the Minor Heaven and Earth Master, Blood Frenzy, here!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1048 - 542: Counter-Attack the Minor Heaven and Earth Master, The Imperishable Flying Boat
chapters.content:
Xu Yan raised his sword, and a vast Sword Intent suddenly surged from him, transforming into the image of mountains and rivers within the domain, merging into the sword.
In that instant, Xu Yan stood still, yet he seemed to have transformed into a peerless divine sword, towering arrogantly within Blood Prison, scorning Blood Prison.
The Blood Frenzy, who had been howling in agony to lessen the pain on his Divine Soul, suddenly fell silent, and in this moment amid the surging blood waves, a face emerged.
Shock appeared on the face, and even fear began to surface.
"What Sword Dao is this, how could you possibly wield such a powerful Sword Dao!"
Blood Frenzy cried out in alarm.
This sword was enough to break through his Blood Prison Domain, meaning that he was severely injured, while Xu Yan and his companions could retreat safely!
And from Xu Yan's stance, this sword was not meant to break his Blood Prison Domain, but to kill him!
Blood Frenzy's eyes showed fright; he knew he, being severely wounded, simply could not block this sword!
Normally, a Supreme Sovereign Realm Warrior would not be able to threaten a Minor Heaven and Earth Master.
However, Blood Frenzy knew that Xu Yan and his companions should not be viewed with common sense; their Martial Arts had long surpassed what he knew and exceeded all imagination.
Escape!
He must escape!
At this moment, Blood Frenzy no longer harbored any thoughts of killing Xu Yan; he only thought of escaping, hoping he could manage with the strength of a Minor Heaven and Earth Master?
However, just as he was about to flee, Xu Yan's sword had already come slashing down.
An indescribable sword, as if what was slashed was not a sword but a domain itself, and as if this sword had encompassed the entire area where he was.
Xu Yan swung his sword down.
Divine Skill, World within the Sword!
The Divine Skill he had acquired when breaking the Divine Realm had evolved from Mountains and Rivers in the Sword to World within the Sword.
This sword, displaying his Divine Skill, embraced the powers of Meng Chong, Fang Hao, Jiang Buping, and the Azure Sea Turtle, integrating together their varied strengths—like a domain containing all four seasons, wind, rain, thunder, lightning, and different creatures, all coexisting within the domain.
Xu Yan's sword was the same, incorporating various forces within a single strike.
Besides the Divine Skill of World within the Sword containing and merging different forces, it was also related to Xu Yan's Pure Martial Arts; being pure and unadulterated allowed him to encompass various powers without interference.
With a single swing, the sword instantly struck towards Blood Frenzy.
The sword in Xu Yan's hand also shattered at this moment.
Casually discarding the shattered sword, Xu Yan's gaze was indifferent, as if the sword he swung was nothing more than ordinary.
Ah!
After a brief scream, Blood Prison collapsed, a unique aura emerged on the Imperishable Lands, swept away by the Violent Spiritual Energy, completely vanishing.
The Azure Sea Turtle was momentarily stunned; although it knew that Blood Frenzy could not withstand this sword, it still found it unbelievable that Blood Frenzy was actually slain by a single sword.
Xu Yan, not even a Minor Heaven and Earth Master, had actually killed a Minor Heaven and Earth Master?
Though the killing of Blood Frenzy was a collaborative effort, and Blood Frenzy's own carelessness contributed, the fatal blow was struck by Xu Yan.
Even if the sword did not rely on Xu Yan's own power, it was still unimaginable.
No one had ever been able to contain others' powers and deliver such a deadly, fierce strike; this might be the first time in history!
Blood Frenzy might also be the first Minor Heaven and Earth Master to be killed in such a manner.
"Finally, Blood Frenzy has been killed."
Fang Hao was exceedingly excited.
A Minor Heaven and Earth Master had actually been slain by their joint efforts.
"What was that aura?"
Xu Yan was somewhat surprised, as when Blood Frenzy fell, a unique aura appeared, swept away by the violent Spiritual Energy of the Unchanging Lands, completely disappearing as if it dissipated into the Unchanging Lands.
"That is unique to the fall of a Minor Heaven and Earth Master, possibly related to that purple light from before, it seems that Minor Heaven and Earth Masters who acquired the purple light, when they fall, all have this unique aura returning to the Unchanging Lands."
The Azure Sea Turtle explained.
"So that's how it is!"
Xu Yan nodded. Minor Heaven and Earth Masters who had acquired the purple light Creation, upon their fall, all had a unique aura returning to the Unchanging Lands, as if by destiny all came from the Unchanging Lands and should also return to it.
"The way of destiny? Much eventually returns to the way?" Xu Yan pondered.
"Let's go, continue searching for the Hong Ze Domain; Blood Frenzy's appearance here might also be for the Hong Ze Domain."
The Azure Sea Turtle spoke solemnly.
"I need to craft a Flying Boat; it must be fast enough that even if we encounter a True Spirit Horde, or even a Minor Heaven and Earth Master like Blood Frenzy, we can still escape."
Fang Hao spoke solemnly.
The speed of the Azure Sea Turtle was ultimately a bit slow.
"Right, let's craft the Flying Boat; just say whatever materials you need, and if we are short, let's take some time to find them. There's no lack of various materials in the Unchanging Lands."
The Azure Sea Turtle nodded vigorously.
With the Flying Boat crafted, he could also take a break, rather than acting as a mount.
Over the next few days, they continued searching for the Hong Ze Domain, and Fang Hao began the refinement of the Flying Boat, using all sorts of materials found from the Unchanging Lands.
The first Flying Boat from the Unchanging Lands was focused on having enough speed. As for the driving force to propel the Flying Boat, it utilized a Formation to condense and absorb the Violent Spiritual Energy from the Transforming Energy, even incorporating the Imperishable Qi, applied to the Flying Boat through prohibiting Runes.
The materials from the Unchanging Lands, further bolstered by Imperishable Qi, naturally made the Flying Boat extremely sturdy, needing not worry about breaking apart due to high speeds.

chapters.title: Chapter 1049 - 542: Counter-Attack the Minor Heaven and Earth Master, The Imperishable Flying Boat_2
chapters.content:
```
Fang Hao was refining a flying boat beyond this domain for the first time; he was extremely excited, putting a great deal of thought into it, and proceeding with every step of the refinement with the utmost care.
The Hong Ze Domain was still not found, and the Azure Sea Turtle had already started heading in a different direction, continuing its search.
Besides the previous encounter with the Blood Frenzy, they hadn't come across any other Minor Heaven and Earth Masters or anyone from the Imperishable Temple.
"Perhaps the Blood Frenzy did not come specifically for the Hong Ze Domain, but it just so happened to appear in this region and ran into us by chance?"
The Azure Sea Turtle was puzzled.
Boom!
A tremor came from the turtle's back, and as the Azure Sea Turtle turned to look, above Fang Hao's palm, a small, pale grey flying boat was taking shape.
The Imperishable Flying Boat was finally about to be refined; the Azure Sea Turtle was thrilled, as it would no longer have to carry people on its back.
Another day passed.
"It's done!"
Fang Hao's voice rang out with excitement.
A small, pale grey flying boat was floating in front of Fang Hao.
With a wave of his hand, the flying boat instantly enlarged, transforming into a ten-zhang-long flying boat, suspended over the Land of Imperishable.
The pale grey flying boat, amidst the chaos, was not easy to detect, possessing superior concealment capabilities.
"Let's go, onto the flying boat."
Xu Yan said with a smile.
The Azure Sea Turtle was overjoyed, its body instantly shrinking to a mere half-zhang in size, and it even stood on its hind limbs as it stepped onto the flying boat.
"Next, I'll activate the flying boat."
Fang Hao took out a spirit crystal; activating the formation for the first time required a spirit crystal, as it was particularly suited for the task.
Hum!
As the formation was activated, the flying boat emitted a faint grey glow, and the surrounding violent spiritual energy rushed crazily toward it, pouring into the formation of the flying boat.
The prohibitions drawn with Imperishable Qi slightly lit up at this moment, ensuring the flying boat was steady and would not fall apart.
"For the first activation, accumulating the wild spiritual energy, considering it's the first time refining, it's better to be conservative to avoid the failure of the flying boat being unable to fly. Once the accumulation of spiritual energy is complete, we can control the flying boat."
"This time I've crafted an Array Plate for controlling the flying boat, which allows control via the Array Plate, making it simple and convenient, and anyone can operate it."
"Furthermore, I've equipped the flying boat with an Acceleration Formation, a certain degree of Concealing Formation, as well as a Confusion and Reversal Formation. The most crucial thing is that I've installed a Teleportation Array on the flying boat, which can instantly cover a distance, along with a Movement Formation..."
Fang Hao took out an Array Plate and began to explain the setup of this flying boat.
The biggest feature of this flying boat was its speed; particularly when the Teleportation Formation was triggered, the flying boat could span distances, instantly teleporting away from its original location—an exceptional ability for escape.
Of course, teleporting once would consume half of the accumulated spiritual energy, and after teleportation, it would need to re-accumulate spiritual energy. The process of accumulating energy naturally made the flying boat a bit conspicuous, making it easy to be tracked down.
"Of course, there are still many areas in which the flying boat could be improved, but for now, it's sufficient. As we use it, we'll discover any shortcomings and make adjustments and improvements accordingly."
Fang Hao tossed the Array Plate to the Azure Sea Turtle, saying, "Old Turtle, since you seem quite interested, I'll leave the flying boat to your control. You're familiar with how to explore the Hong Ze Domain."
"Great, great, great, I won't stand on ceremony then!"
The Azure Sea Turtle was exhilarated.
Taking the Array Plate, it manipulated it slightly, and the flying boat instantly activated, shooting out with a swish, its speed surpassing the Azure Sea Turtle's expectations.
Moreover, during flight, the flying boat was very quiet, much more so than when the turtle was moving.
The grey flying boat was inconspicuous amidst the chaos.
"With this flying boat, exploring the Hong Ze Domain will be much faster, and we can venture further afield."
The Azure Sea Turtle said excitedly as it controlled the flying boat.
"Be careful, ahead there's a True Spirit Horde, and the leader is a True Spirit comparable to a Realm Master Level."
The Azure Sea Turtle prepared to steer the flying boat clear of the True Spirit Horde.
"Go straight through them, hunt the True Spirits, and let's see how the speed of that Realm Master Level True Spirit compares, whether it can catch up to the flying boat or not."
Fang Hao, however, was excited.
```
"Alright, be careful."
The Azure Sea Turtle did not object to this; even Blood Frenzy, a Minor Heaven and Earth Master, had been killed, so a Realm Master Level True Spirit posed no threat at all.
Roar!
The Flying Boat charged into the horde of True Spirits at extreme speed, its sword light flaring up, slashing and killing several True Spirits in an instant.
Meng Chong threw a punch, shining like a sun in the chaos, which exploded into the horde of True Spirits.
Jiang Buping's Long Spear touched down, extinguishing the True Spirits' Divine Souls, leaving only their intact bodies, which he collected.
Fang Hao's Weapon Box released Divine Artifacts, sweeping away with a punch.
The True Spirit leader roared in anger, charging fiercely at them and spitting out a powerful green light from its mouth.
Whoosh!
The Flying Boat nimbly dodged the attack, and at the same time, its speed burst, instantly fleeing far away.
The True Spirit roared as it pursued, and worthy of being a Realm Master Level creature, its speed was not slow.
"Old Turtle, a bit faster, let's test the ultimate speed of the Flying Boat!"
Fang Hao said to the True Spirit that was chasing them.
"No problem!"
The Azure Sea Turtle raised a hand and pointed, directly elevating the Flying Boat's speed to its fastest. Aside from not using Teleportation and Movement, it was now the fastest speed the boat could go.
Whoosh!
The speed of the Flying Boat suddenly surged, turning into a streak of grey light, shooting forth in an instant. The Runes drawn on the boat with Imperishable Qi now subtly shimmered, bolstering its stability.
As the speed increased, the distance between the Flying Boat and the True Spirits grew larger and larger, until finally, it completely shook off the pursuing True Spirit.
"This Imperishable Flying Boat isn't too bad in terms of speed, but it's not enough. I'll adjust and improve it to make it faster and more concealed."
Fang Hao said, taking out materials and converging Imperishable Qi to start improving the Flying Boat.
"On our journey thus far, there have been treasures everywhere we passed. It's all up to ourselves to explore, and it's been somewhat tiring. Setting up a perception Formation on the Flying Boat to actively search for treasures, and within a certain range, actively absorb treasures will make things much easier."
Fang Hao was very excited. The Land of Imperishable truly was a treasure land. For a Qimen Martial Artist and an Artifact Refining practitioner like him, it was like entering a never-ending Treasure Mountain.
There were numerous treasures of various kinds, which he could study and refine to create more Divine Artifacts.
During the following journey, Fang Hao improved the Flying Boat, added exploration Formations, absorption Formations, and increased the storage space.
He stored the absorbed treasures into the storage space of the Flying Boat.
At the same time, he further fortified the Flying Boat, enhancing its defensive power, and dispersing any incoming attacks.
As the improvements to the Flying Boat were completed, treasures started to be collected wherever it went, one after another, densely packed.
"There are too many treasures; let's not bother with the ordinary ones."
After collecting a large heap of various materials, Fang Hao excluded the common, plentiful materials from the range of the Formation's absorption.
The Hong Ze Domain was nowhere to be seen, but Xu Yan and the others did not take it to heart. Fang Hao was categorizing treasures, delving into Artifact Refining and Formations.
Xu Yan, Meng Chong, and Jiang Buping were seated cross-legged on the Flying Boat, perceiving the Land of Imperishable and contemplating their own Martial Arts.
The Land of Imperishable was in a state of chaos, vastly different from the Domain, hence cultivating and contemplating Martial Arts in the Land of Imperishable brought new insights.
Especially for Xu Yan, who was not far from the Establishing Dao Realm. Now, by perceiving the Land of Imperishable with his own Domain, and resonating with the Land of Imperishable, it seemed he comprehended something about the Will of the Earth and even had the feeling of Establishing Dao in chaos and becoming the Master of Heaven and Earth.
It was as if he had a vague inspiration, a sense of the Great Dao, a perception of the Primordial Chaos Domain during the resonance with the chaos, like a layer of tissue paper separating him from clearly comprehending the ways of the Primordial Chaos Domain.
But at least, he had an initial insight. Xu Yan believed that once he broke through to the Establishing Dao Realm and his Martial Arts progressed further, he would surely be able to understand how to use the Will of the Great Dao of the Primordial Chaos Domain.
The Azure Sea Turtle controlled the Flying Boat, continuously moving forward, his brow furrowed. Had the Hong Ze Domain disappeared?
Up ahead was a large mountain, and judging by the scale of the mountain, it was a Master of Heaven and Earth level True Spirit that had transformed. Moreover, this mountain seemed quite ancient, with the fallen True Spirit's age being very far from the present.
And what's more, this mountain had drifted over from some unknown place.
The Flying Boat flew past the mountain, and some of the treasures within the mountain were detected and absorbed by the Formation.
But just then, the Azure Sea Turtle's expression changed, "Be careful!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1050 - 543: Origin Water, Hong Ze’s Remains
chapters.content:
The Flying Boat passed by the great mountain as the Formation detected a treasure, pulling the treasure from atop the mountain. Naturally, the process of obtaining the treasure was not without disturbance.
Suddenly, the Azure Sea Turtle discovered a group of Martial Artists flying out from both sides of the mountain, each one making a move to block the path of the Flying Boat.
Among those who acted was a Realm Master Level expert!
Who were cultivating, including Fang Hao, who was immersed in Artifact Refining and Formations, all burst forth with their aura and raised their hands to block the attacks.
Looking up, all four had a solemn expression.
"People from the Imperishable Temple?"
Xu Yan said, somewhat surprised.
Aside from the Imperishable Temple, he could think of no other forces in the vicinity.
Moreover, this team was led by three Realm Master Level experts, with the rest possessing Supreme Realm strength.
"They've come for the Hong Ze Domain!"
The Azure Sea Turtle said gravely.
The presence of the Imperishable Temple's team in this region was solely due to their interest in the Hong Ze Domain, with no other objectives.
"Creatures of the Domain!"
Feeling the aura aboard the Flying Boat, a member of the Imperishable Temple sounded somewhat excited.
"Act, capture them, and there will be grand rewards!"
A Realm Master Level expert commanded with a wave of his hand.
"Three Realm Masters, this could be troublesome; even joining forces, we can't hold them off!"
Fang Hao furrowed his brow and said.
While these three Realm Masters weren't as strong as Blood Frenzy, they nonetheless comprised three individuals; with their current strength, cutting them down together was impossible.
If there were only one Realm Master, they would surely be able to cut him down, but facing three Realm Masters, they could only avoid their sharp edge.
"We can't kill the Realm Masters, everyone else is easy!"
Xu Yan said with a cold smile.
The folks from the Imperishable Temple, upon realizing they were beings of the Domain, immediately sought to capture them, showing the nature of their irreconcilable conflict with the Imperishable Temple.
"Let's go, avoid the Realm Masters!"
With a gesture, Xu Yan's sword light instantly appeared.
On the Azure Sea Turtle's body, a deep blue light blossomed, enveloping the Flying Boat. With its defensive capabilities, it was enough to withstand the attacks of three Realm Masters and keep the Flying Boat unharmed.
Once Xu Yan made his move, Meng Chong and the others also took action, their targets naturally being the Imperishable Temple beings other than the three Realm Masters.
Boom!
The beings of the Imperishable Temple, with strength comparable to the Supreme Realm, couldn't withstand the attacks from Xu Yan and the others. In just a moment, several were slain.
"Presumptuous!"
A leading Realm Master of the Imperishable Temple bellowed in rage, suddenly launching an attack.
Hum!
The Azure Sea Turtle, while controlling the Flying Boat, swiftly dodged the enemy, covering the whole Flying Boat with its defenses to block the attack.
After Fang Hao's improvements, the Flying Boat's speed had considerably increased, and it had become much more agile. Amidst the encirclement by the Imperishable Temple, it dashed and battled relentlessly, always evading the three Realm Master Level experts.
Wherever the Flying Boat went, another member of the Imperishable Temple fell!
Boom!
Suddenly, the three Realm Masters of the Imperishable Temple joined forces to unleash an attack, creating a dark light ring that closed in from all directions, intending to trap the Flying Boat within.
"Escape now!"
Xu Yan's expression hardened as he said.
The ring of light deployed by the Imperishable Temple was based on Imperishable Qi, refined into existence. Once trapped, it would be hard to break free in a short period of time.
Whoosh!
The Flying Boat suddenly activated the Movement Formation. Before the light ring could fully enclose them, the boat shook and escaped through a gap in the closing ring in an instant.
"The Imperishable Temple, residing within the Land of Imperishable and having cultivated powerful Dharmas from the Imperishable Qi."
Xu Yan raised his eyebrows as he spoke.
"The great battle back then also revealed that the Offensive Arts of the Imperishable Temple carried the characteristics of Imperishable Qi, though they weren't particularly formidable. That joint sealing technique we just saw may be a new secret technique of the Imperishable Temple?"
The Azure Sea Turtle nodded in agreement.
"Since that's the case, let them witness the skills of Xu Yan as well."
Turning his head to look back, a group from the Imperishable Temple was pursuing them. Xu Yan smiled slightly, gestured with his hand, and the surrounding Imperishable Qi formed into invisible Sword Intent in an instant.
Threads of Imperishable Qi, like sword filaments, permeated the Land of Imperishable, silent and unintimidating, with the Sword Intent hidden yet profound.
"Let's go, avoid them!"
Having done this, Xu Yan then spoke with a smile.
"Alright!"
Every time the Azure Sea Turtle witnessed Xu Yan making a move, he was astounded by the miraculous nature of his Sword Dao.
The Flying Boat accelerated, and at that moment, the group from the Imperishable Temple had already entered the range of Xu Yan's Sword Intent.
Ah! Ah!
Suddenly, screams erupted. The invisible killing force of the Imperishable Sword Intent, hidden yet exceedingly sharp, decimated the pursuers in mere moments, slaying about sixty to seventy percent of them!
"Retreat!"
The three Imperishable Temple Realm Masters halted promptly, looking uncertainly at the hidden killing force, feeling a chill in their hearts. What kind of Sword Dao technique was this?
The Flying Boat rapidly flew through the Chaos, with the Azure Sea Turtle somewhat excitedly saying, "The Hong Ze Domain must be in this Imperishable area; otherwise, the Imperishable Temple wouldn't have sent people to search for it."
"But it's unknown how many people the Imperishable Temple has dispatched. If there are too many experts, even if we find the Hong Ze Domain, we can't secure it."
Meng Chong rubbed his head and frowned as he said.
"That's indeed the case."
The Azure Sea Turtle looked somewhat anxious, "But I hope we can find the Hong Ze Domain first; only then will we have a chance."
The speed of the Flying Boat significantly increased while it discontinued the treasure detection and gathering Formations, focusing all attention on searching for the Hong Ze Domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1051 - 543: Origin Water, Hong Ze's Remains_2
chapters.content:
"The Imperishable Temple is encroaching upon the Domain, and I seem to understand the reason now. As the Domain opened, it devoured the Imperishable Qi, smoothing out the violent Spiritual Energy; the more the Domain expanded, the more it inevitably broke through the Chaos, devouring the Imperishable Qi to form the Domain Barrier, and the power of the Imperishable Temple is related to the Imperishable Qi."
"Even so, that one from the Imperishable Temple wants to rely on encroaching upon the Domain to undergo some transformation, to elevate himself."
Xu Yan said thoughtfully.
"That was also our guess in the beginning, hence the war was inevitable, it's just that in the end, the Six Great Domain were defeated."
The Azure Sea Turtle sighed.
The Land of Chaotic Imperishable is vast and boundless, even making it impossible to discern directions, luckily, the Azure Sea Turtle had once lived in the Land of Imperishable for long years, and this vast area of the Great Wilderness Domain was relatively more familiar.
Since encountering the team of the Imperishable Temple, there had been no further encounters with their squad over the next few days.
"Where exactly has the Hong Ze Domain drifted to?"
The Azure Sea Turtle looked helpless, as the Flying Boat had now traveled extremely far from the Great Wilderness Domain, having left the area where it was located.
At this moment, they had entered the relatively unknown Land of Imperishable.
However, the journey to explore the Hong Ze Domain did not stop, and the Flying Boat continued flying. Xu Yan, Meng Chong, and Jiang Buping continued their cultivation, comprehending the Land of Imperishable and their own Martial Arts.
Fang Hao also continued his Artifact Refining and Formation, as well as the research on the Qimen Grand Formation of the Land of Imperishable.
It seemed none were deeply concerned about exploring the Hong Ze Domain.
At one point, the Flying Boat suddenly stopped.
"Old Turtle, did you find something?"
Xu Yan opened his eyes.
"There, something is not right!"
The Azure Sea Turtle looked towards the front left, his voice somewhat grave.
Xu Yan and the others looked up, in the far distance to the front left, a large mountain was faintly visible, and this mountain was extraordinarily huge and incredibly solid, showing also the traces of eroded years.
An ancient mountain also meant it was a transformation from an ancient Imperishable True Spirit after death.
The strength of this True Spirit was of the Master of Heaven and Earth level, and among those, it belonged to the ranks of the strong.
"What have you discovered?"
Xu Yan asked, furrowing his brows.
The distance was too far, and the Land of Imperishable was chaotic, even his Minor Heavenly Eye couldn't see what was special inside that mountain.
"The scent of water!"
The voice of the Azure Sea Turtle trembled slightly, piloting the Flying Boat to approach the mountain, to prevent the possibility of a powerful True Spirit inside the mountain or a potent force from the Imperishable Temple, they approached slowly and cautiously.
As the Flying Boat drew nearer, Xu Yan also saw something special in the mountain.
"Inside the mountain."
Xu Yan mused.
"The scent of the Origin Water."
At that moment, the Azure Sea Turtle was both excited and somewhat astonished.
"There's no True Spirit in the mountain, nor people from the Imperishable Temple, let's hurry over."
Xu Yan said in a deep voice.
The Azure Sea Turtle, being a True Spirit of water, was exceptionally sensitive to the scent of water, and the fact that he could sense it from such a distance showed the extraordinariness of this water.
Swoosh!
The Flying Boat approached the mountain, going directly through an entrance into the interior of the mountain.
The ancient mountain already showed signs of erosion from the ages, indicating that this mountain had been there for an extremely long time.
The four men and one turtle exited the Flying Boat and stood in front of a pool of water inside the mountain.
The Azure Sea Turtle looked excited yet somewhat melancholic.
"It is indeed the Origin Water!"
The surface of the water was still, clear like dewdrops, as if the entire pool contained only a single droplet.
"This is the Origin Water?"
Xu Yan was amazed, this water was indeed extraordinary, as if one drop could transform into vast rivers.
"Yes, this is the Origin Water, only seen someone nurture it!"
The Azure Sea Turtle said gravely.
That person was naturally the Master of the Hong Ze Domain.
"The Hong Ze Cang Hai, its source is this Origin Water!"
The Azure Sea Turtle looked nostalgic.
"Is this Origin Water here related to Hong Ze?"
Fang Hao took out a large jar, ready to collect the Origin Water.
"Apart from Hong Ze, there was no one else, initially when he had perished, he was devoured by someone from the Imperishable Temple, and it is likely that fragments of his remains and power had scattered about, hence the emergence of a pool of Origin Water here."
The Azure Sea Turtle sighed sorrowfully.
A hint of faint fear inevitably surfaced in his eyes, that scene from the past had left a deep psychological scar.
"Old Turtle, is this water of much use to you, can it enhance your strength?"
Fang Hao asked while collecting water.
"It's too little, it's of no use to me anymore, it's just nostalgic,"
The Azure Sea Turtle shook his head.
With his current strength, wanting to advance further and become a Master of Heaven and Earth level power, this bit of Origin Water was far from enough.
Moreover, he was already the turtle of the Great Wilderness, and had also realized the Heavenly Dao, thus paving his own way forward.
Furthermore, receiving guidance from Master Xu Yan would be a true great opportunity.
"If that's the case, then I'll take it all. This Origin Water, my senior sister would definitely like it, it's very useful,"
Fang Hao said as he took out another jar and began to collect the Origin Water.
Origin Water was somewhat special. Storage devices like Storage Bags were incapable of containing Origin Water, but Fang Hao had refined a unique storage device for special treasures, so there was no issue in storing the Origin Water.
"There are the bones of Hong Ze in the pond!"
Xu Yan said solemnly.
As the Origin Water was collected into the jar, the bottom of the pond revealed a pale blue fragment that seemed to be part of a rib.
The bone shard was emitting droplets of water, and this entire pool of Origin Water had formed over many years from this shard.
Looking at the bone shard, the Azure Sea Turtle was overwhelmed with sorrow.
He had followed Hong Ze for many long years. Hong Ze was his elder brother, and naturally, their emotional bond was deep.
The Azure Sea Turtle took the bone shard, examined it for a long time, sighed, and handed it to Fang Hao.
"Old Turtle, aren't you keeping it to commemorate him?"
Fang Hao asked, puzzled.
"I'm afraid!"
The Azure Sea Turtle said with a bitter smile.
Fang Hao was taken aback, then understood, collecting the bone shard into one of the jars.
Having the bone shard of Hong Ze would always remind the Azure Sea Turtle of the great calamity of the Hong Ze Domain, making him unable to control his inner fear, hence although he wanted very much to keep the remains of Hong Ze for remembrance, he ultimately abandoned the idea.
Fang Hao felt amazed that the Azure Sea Turtle had not been scared to death back then, it was indeed a miracle.
"Since Hong Ze's bones appeared in this place, the Hong Ze Domain must not be far away, it should be around here!"
The Azure Sea Turtle said solemnly.
Exiting the mountain, they released the Flying Boat, and standing atop it, the Azure Sea Turtle began to deduce the possible direction that the Hong Ze Domain might have drifted.
Fang Hao, on the other hand, activated the Flying Boat's treasure-exploring formation, searching for treasures within the great mountain, and drawing them over.
To his surprise, he managed to retrieve a small tree.
"This tree should be useful, can be used for pill refinement, I'll take it back for my senior sister,"
Fang Hao collected the small tree.
"Based on my deduction, this great mountain, because it contains the bones of Hong Ze, will be somewhat influenced by the Hong Ze Domain, even if the Hong Ze Domain has become desolate,"
"Due to being influenced by the Hong Ze Domain, the direction this mountain drifted is not far from the Hong Ze Domain, and after my observation and judgment, the Hong Ze Domain would very likely be in this direction,"
The Azure Sea Turtle said somewhat excitedly, pointing in a direction.
"Let's go, we should be able to find the Hong Ze Domain soon."
The Azure Sea Turtle controlled the Flying Boat, speeding ahead.
The Flying Boat was extremely fast, quickly leaving the great mountain far behind. Xu Yan and the others were also thrilled, finally able to see another Domain besides the Great Wilderness.
Even if it was a desolate Domain, its significance was extraordinary.
Standing on the Flying Boat, they looked far into the distance, progressing along the way, and also encountered a few small mountains, but none had anything special.
The Flying Boat moved on for roughly a day and a night, yet still did not see any trace of the Domain, making the Azure Sea Turtle feel quite dejected.
"That can't be right, according to my calculations, there should be no mistake!"
"What does a desolate Domain look like?"
Xu Yan suddenly asked.
"A desolate Domain, devoid of radiance, bleak and empty, even seemingly permeated with a sense of death,"
The Azure Sea Turtle responded gravely.
"Look, is that the Hong Ze Domain?"
Xu Yan raised his hand, pointing toward the far front.

chapters.title: Chapter 1052 - 544 Battle of the Master of Hong Ze Domain
chapters.content:
The Azure Sea Turtle looked in the direction of Xu Yan's pointing finger. There was a vast expanse of darkness ahead, as if a gigantic object stood within the Land of Imperishable. Even from a great distance, one glance seemed to convey the dead silence of that patch of darkness.
"That's right, it's the Hong Ze Domain!"
The Azure Sea Turtle said excitedly.
A dead silent domain, murky and empty, where even the sense of death lingered. From afar, it was just a large swath of darkness, eclipsing even Chaos itself.
"Be cautious, there may be some unexpected events inside the Hong Ze Domain."
Jiang Buping said solemnly.
"Right, be careful, especially of the strong ones from the Imperishable Temple."
The Azure Sea Turtle nodded vigorously.
The speed of the Flying Boat slowed, and it activated the Concealing Formation, silently and stealthily approaching the dark expanse.
As they drew closer, the outline of a vast Domain gradually became visible.
But this Domain, unlike the Great Wilderness that shone like a pearl amidst Chaos, was grey and desolate, more lifeless than the mountains formed from the dead True Spirits, more desolate.
Xu Yan's eyes gleamed mistily as he silently observed the distant Domain, probing for any hidden dangers.
Meng Chong, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping did the same.
The Flying Boat continued to slow down, occasionally ducking into small mountains along the way to take brief cover, then slowly moving closer again. The closer they got to the Hong Ze Domain, the more intense the sense of dead silence and desolation became.
In this region, there were no Imperishable True Spirits.
It seemed as though even the Imperishable True Spirits were unwilling to approach this dead silent Domain, unable to withstand its desolate silence.
"This dead silent Domain, amidst its sorrow, seems to harbor an ominous presence," Xu Yan murmured.
The Azure Sea Turtle's voice trembled faintly, "Do we still need to approach it? After all, we've never experienced the death of a Domain before. What changes occur after a Domain's silence are unknown. What if there really is something ominous?"
"Old Turtle, if you're scared, just wait for us here. With this Domain dead, what's there to be scared of an ominous presence? The unknown is all the more worth exploring!"
Meng Chong patted the head of the Azure Sea Turtle and said.
"Just a little fear to overcome, that's all!"
The Azure Sea Turtle said with an embarrassed smile.
"Then stop shaking. If we get attacked, I doubt you'd be able to respond, let alone control the Flying Boat!"
Fang Hao shook his head and said.
"I'm excited, not scared!"
The Azure Sea Turtle stubbornly retorted.
"Then get excited at your own pace."
Fang Hao chuckled.
As the Flying Boat drew closer to the Hong Ze Domain, the dead silence and desolation rushed over like a tide, as though a gloomy aura surrounded the Domain.
The four disciples of Xu Yan silently watched the Domain ahead, observing its uneven surface that lacked any sign of life, not a single plant on the ground.
It seemed as if the entire Domain was shrouded in an ominous aura.
In front of the Hong Ze Domain, there was a mountain. This mountain did not seem to have been transformed from a dead True Spirit but was rather separated from a mountain within the Hong Ze Domain, hence it had always accompanied it.
"Let's stop on that mountain for a moment!" Xu Yan said authoritatively.
The dead silent Domain, as though it had an ominous aura lingering, and the people of the Imperishable Temple were also searching for the Hong Ze Domain. Prudence was essential.
Xu Yan had observed the mountain, finding it equally desolate but devoid of any hidden dangers or traces of the Imperishable Temple's formidable figures lying in ambush.
"Oh, oh!"
The voice of the Azure Sea Turtle trembled even more, controlling the Array Plate of the Flying Boat with a slight shake in its movements.
Xu Yan glanced at the turtle, which had been terrified in the past. Now that it was getting close to the Hong Ze Domain again, it couldn't control its trembling.
He finally understood why the Azure Sea Turtle had forsaken the opportunity lying within the Hong Ze Domain.
It was simply that the turtle was too scared. The Hong Ze Domain had become the source of its fear. Unable to control that terror, even the greatest opportunities could turn into disasters.
The Flying Boat slowly approached the mountain, getting ever closer. Xu Yan and the others kept their focus on the Hong Ze Domain ahead.
Suddenly, boom!
A sound like muffled thunder erupted, and the Azure Sea Turtle controlling the Flying Boat recoiled into its shell in fright.
Thud!
The Azure Sea Turtle landed on the deck of the Flying Boat. In an instant, it appeared to lose all vitality, turning into an ordinary dead turtle with only its shell!
The Array Plate of the Flying Boat also fell down.
Xu Yan and the others: ...
Fang Hao picked up the Array Plate, looking at the Azure Sea Turtle feigning death with Turtle Breath, he was at a loss for words.
This fright was too great!
"What was that noise just now?"
Meng Chong touched his head, perplexed.
"It seems like a battle!"
Xu Yan said gravely, the thunderous sound having traveled from an extremely distant place.
Moreover, just from the booming noise, one could feel the battle must be extremely intense, and the combatants were undoubtedly at the Master of Heaven and Earth level.
"Could it be two True Spirits fighting?"
Jiang Buping asked in surprise.
A clash between True Spirits was not an uncommon event.
Boom!
Another sound came, continuous, as if some powerful Offensive Arts were clashing.
"This doesn't seem like a fight between True Spirits!"
Xu Yan said solemnly.
A True Spirit's battle would be accompanied by roaring, but apart from the sound of combat, no roars could be heard.
Moreover, judging from the boom, it seemed more likely to be a fight between mighty beings, utilizing powerful secret techniques.

chapters.title: Chapter 1053 - 544 Battle of the Master of Hong Ze Domain_2
chapters.content:
""Old turtle, stop playing dead, come out!"
Xu Yan kicked the turtle shell and said.
After a long while, a head finally emerged from the shell.
"What happened?"
The Azure Sea Turtle's eyes whirled around, ready to retreat into its shell and play dead at any moment.
"In the Land of Imperishable, there's a battle among the powerful!"
Xu Yan said in a deep voice.
By then, the Flying Boat had reached the mountain and was embedded within it, concealing its real body.
"A battle among the powerful?"
Puzzled, the Azure Sea Turtle listened for a while to the gradually fading sounds, confirming that they were coming from a very distant place before coming out of its shell and resuming its original form.
"Cough, this is a life-saving trick, you all are too slow to react. In the Land of Imperishable, as soon as one senses any unusual change, the first action is to hide oneself and retract all aura; it's all about experience!"
The Azure Sea Turtle said solemnly.
Xu Yan couldn't be bothered with him. This turtle was not only cowardly but also incessantly in denial, always needing to find an excuse to cover its cowardice.
"Alright, old turtle, we know what we heard. That sound was clearly a battle among the powerful, and it must be someone at the Master of Heaven and Earth level. Besides the Imperishable Temple in the Land of Imperishable and the formerly known Seven Great Domain Masters, are there any other Domain Master level beings?"
Xu Yan asked while patting the head of the Azure Sea Turtle.
Talking about serious matters, the Azure Sea Turtle became solemn.
"Apart from the Imperishable True Spirits of the Master of Heaven and Earth level, among the cultivators, only the original Seven Great Domain Masters and some strong individuals from the Imperishable Temple are known. Beyond them, no other Domain Master level beings have been heard of!"
By then, the distant sounds of battle had already ceased.
"Could it be a mistake, perhaps it was a True Spirit of the Master of Heaven and Earth level fighting?"
The Azure Sea Turtle wondered.
After all, as far as is currently known among the cultivators who are Domain Masters, aside from The Seven Great Domains, only the Imperishable Temple remains.
However, of the known Seven Great Domain Masters, only Netherworld remains alive, and he had already pledged allegiance to the Imperishable Temple.
Thus, only the Imperishable Temple could have Domain Master level beings.
"A fight of True Spirits would surely be accompanied by roars, after all, the True Spirits of the Land of Imperishable may have tremendous strength, but they are unintelligent animals. However, the sounds we heard just now were decidedly offensive arts erupting, certainly not True Spirits!"
Xu Yan said in a deep voice.
Boom!
Just then, another violent sound came, growing ever more intense, as if the battle were escalating, the offensive arts becoming ever more potent.
The Azure Sea Turtle swallowed, astonished, "What's going on, it really is a battle among Master of Heaven and Earth level beings! Could it be that Netherworld has fallen out with the strong individuals of the Imperishable Temple?"
His thoughts went first to Netherworld, given that of the know Seven Great Domain Masters, only he had survived.
"Netherworld has already pledged to the Imperishable Temple, to defect again? That seems unlikely, could it be that he does not fear that certain individual from the Imperishable Temple?"
Xu Yan shook his head and said.
Netherworld, having pledged to the Imperishable Temple, must have his reasons; besides, considering how powerful that individual is, Netherworld is clearly no match for him. Since he had chosen to surrender rather than fight to the death during the great battle, how could he possibly betray the Imperishable Temple and seek his own destruction.
Unless, Netherworld was confident he could stand against that individual.
But clearly, Netherworld couldn't possibly have that kind of strength.
The Azure Sea Turtle excitedly said: "Could there be infighting within the Imperishable Temple? If so, that would be great!"
Upon hearing this, Fang Hao couldn't help but stroke his chin, "Could it be Blood Demon? Weren't elder sister and Tian Zi scheming against Blood Demon? Could it be that Blood Extreme succeeded and replaced Blood Demon? But because of this, a battle erupted?"
Jiang Buping shook his head smiling, "Even if Blood Extreme could succeed, it wouldn't be possible in such a short time. Moreover, if he had indeed succeeded, according to the plan, it's unlikely for Blood Extreme to have been exposed. He would continue to operate under Blood Demon's identity within the Imperishable Temple. Besides, if he really was exposed, how could Blood Extreme have sustained such a prolonged resistance?"
"Makes sense!"
Fang Hao nodded, almost ruling out the possibility for Blood Extreme.
After all, once Blood Demon was replaced and exposed, that individual from the Imperishable Temple would have dealt with him personally, making it impossible for such a long battle to occur.
The distant battle continued unabated, the sounds intermittent but increasingly fierce as the conflict intensified.
"Is it possible that not all of the Seven Great Domain Masters have died?"
Xu Yan pondered for a moment and then said.
"Are you implying?"
The Azure Sea Turtle was startled but then shook its head, "Unless one sought refuge with the Imperishable Temple, how could they not die? Even Taicang has perished!"
As powerful as Taicang was, he had died. Meng Chong survived because he had aligned himself with the Imperishable Temple, and his acceptance by the Imperishable Temple probably had other reasons.
As for the others, they likely had no such opportunity.
Even if one sought refuge with the Imperishable Temple, it would not be possible to betray them and thus cause a great battle.
"Perhaps in the Land of Imperishable, a force other than the Imperishable Temple has emerged. This was the battle between the Imperishable Temple and the opposing power. The Taicang Domain was able to exist for so long, perhaps because the Imperishable Temple had an enemy and could not afford to focus solely on the Taicang Domain,"
Meng Chong speculated, scratching his head.
"Perhaps that's possible!"
Upon hearing this, the Azure Sea Turtle's eyes brightened, and it nodded vigorously.
That would make sense. The Imperishable Temple needed to handle a formidable enemy, hence they could not afford to invade the Taicang Domain, allowing it to persist until now.
This possibility was substantial, given that the Seven Great Domains were established over eons before the Imperishable Temple abruptly appeared.
The Land of Imperishable is boundless and may not only be home to the Imperishable Temple's power!
The Seven Great Domains can be considered as a new force in the Land of Imperishable, whereas the Imperishable Temple is an ancient power, targeting the Seven Great Domains because of their uniqueness, to invade and occupy them.
"That makes sense. The Land of Imperishable is vast and boundless, filled with many unknowns. Moreover, does the Land of Imperishable have any bounds? What lies beyond the Land of Imperishable?"
Xu Yan said with a face full of curiosity.
Boom!
Suddenly, a loud roar sounded out, and even faintly, one could feel the Violent Spiritual Energy of the Land of Imperishable, brushing past the mountains like a breeze amidst the roar.
Ah!
Following the roar, a scream emerged, filled with disbelief.
The battle was decided, and one of the parties had fallen!
"Hide well, if they are fighting over the Hong Ze Domain, they might be hurrying back now,"
Xu Yan said solemnly.
Upon hearing this, the Azure Sea Turtle immediately retracted into its shell, employing the Turtle Breath technique to feign death.
Xu Yan and his companions also hid their aura, and the Flying Boat completely burrowed into the mountains, using them as cover.
In a location extremely far from the Hong Ze Domain, a Witch gasped heavily, his eyes shining with a blood-red light, cold and bloodthirsty.
His claws were embedded in a person's body, who by then had no breath left, and all flesh around the body was withering.
All the essence of the body was being consumed by the Witch.
"With you, a mere False Master of Heaven and Earth, trying to hunt me down? If it weren't for my injuries not being healed, just for your kind alone, I could kill three!"
The Witch snorted coldly.
"But, thanks to your body's essence, it has helped me recover faster. Now let's see how many False Masters the Imperishable Temple will send to hunt me down!"
The Witch's gaze was icy.
In the Imperishable Temple, those truly at the Master of Heaven and Earth level were not many; most so-called Masters of Heaven and Earth were actually False Masters of Heaven and Earth.
Though stronger than Minor Heaven and Earth Masters, their own Principles were weaker than those of the true Masters of Heaven and Earth.
"To kill one False Master of Heaven and Earth was this taxing, truly detestable!"
The Witch threw away the withered corpse, looked over the vast Chaos Primordial Land, and his eyes gradually hardened.
"Endless Chaos, I want to see if the Imperishable Temple can keep chasing me indefinitely. As long as I live, there will come a day when I will strike back. In my life, the Witch, I have lost to only one person, not some old freak of the Imperishable Temple, who only relies on longer cultivation time!"
The Witch thought coldly in his heart.
"This place is not safe to stay for long. If a Master of Heaven and Earth from the Imperishable Temple comes, given my current injuries, I am certainly no match!"
With one step, the Witch vanished from the spot, blending into the boundless Chaos, leaving only the aftermath of the battle lingering in the area, which did not calm down for a long time.

chapters.title: Chapter 1054 - 545 Walking Through the Domain, Comprehending the Domain
chapters.content:
Xu Yan and his three martial arts brothers, along with the Azure Sea Turtle pretending to be dead inside its shell, hid in the mountains for two days.
"Wasn't it a fight for the control of the Hong Ze Domain?"
Xu Yan looked towards the Hong Ze Domain and didn't spot any traces of powerful beings; the surrounding Chaos was also desolate and empty.
"Let's go, to the Hong Ze Domain!"
Assured that no powerful beings were nearby, and that the unknown battle had not erupted for the sake of the Hong Ze Domain, Xu Yan no longer chose to hide.
