Meng Chong, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping also emerged from the Flying Boat.
"Old turtle, you just stay here for now. The moment you notice someone approaching, transmit a message to us immediately!"
Xu Yan kicked the turtle shell and said.
The Azure Sea Turtle poked its head out, nodded and said, "No problem, I will be vigilant and send a message at the first sign of someone approaching!"
The Azure Sea Turtle looked relieved.
The Hong Ze Domain, to him, was a source of fear, he couldn't control the emotion of dread just by the sight of it.
If he were to step into the Hong Ze Domain, he probably would have collapsed on the spot and could only crawl slowly, just as he did when he fled the Hong Ze Domain, which took a very long time.
If not for the overwhelming fear and the lengthy time it took to escape, his injuries wouldn't have been so severe.
Xu Yan and his martial arts brothers slowly approached the Hong Ze Domain. Although no danger was detected, they didn't dare to be careless.
"The Hong Ze Domain has become desolate; the Domain seems to be shrouded in an ominous aura, or perhaps the notion of death. Be careful, there might be some unknown dangers,"
Xu Yan used a sound transmission to communicate with the three others.
"In this part of the Hong Ze Domain, not even a True Spirit can be found. Either the desolation of the Hong Ze Domain has scared them away from this region, or there's a powerful True Spirit lurking within the Hong Ze Domain,"
Jiang Buping said gravely.
"We can't rule out that possibility. With my Minor Heavenly Eye, I can't peer into the entire Domain. If something's lurking deep underground, it would go undetected,"
Xu Yan nodded and replied.
The four martial arts brothers hid their presences and quietly neared the Hong Ze Domain. The closer they got, the more they felt a dark, gloomy aura assaulting them.
This sensation of desolation and silence seemed to subtly impact their minds.
"If other Supreme Sovereign Realm Warriors were to enter, it probably wouldn't take long before they would be affected and start experiencing issues with their mind,"
Meng Chong said seriously.
"The desolate Domain, after all, is the first—so far, the first. What could happen here remains unknown; it's even possible for something strange to emerge,"
Fang Hao continued with annoyance, "Had I known, I would have consulted our master before coming out."
"The unknown holds the value of exploration. Master didn't tell us because he naturally wants us to explore on our own,"
Xu Yan said with a smile.
"Big brother is right!"
Fang Hao was momentarily startled, then nodded in sudden realization.
Finally, the martial arts brothers arrived outside the Hong Ze Domain. They didn't immediately enter but silently observed the situation within the Domain.
A normal Domain would have Domain Dao Rules present, forming a Domain Barrier where Spiritual Energy and Imperishable Qi converge, enveloping the Domain like a giant sphere of Spiritual Energy.
The desolate Hong Ze Domain lacked these Dao Principles and Domain Barrier. There was also no sphere of Spiritual Energy wrapped around the Domain.
Although there was no sphere of Spiritual Energy, the Violent Spiritual Energy still surrounded the Domain, as the Imperishable Domain's Violent Spiritual Energy was omnipresent.
Looking down upon the Domain, the land was uneven and especially noticeable were the large depressed areas that seemed to be the territory of the Cang Hai in the Hong Ze Domain.
The Hong Ze Domain was a water Domain, with water occupying more than ninety percent. Slightly sunken areas were once lakes and seas.
The entire Domain was intact, but the ground was covered with mottled cracks and broken peaks, even faint remains of the aftermath of battles could be seen.
The landscape was desolate and silent, devoid of any signs of life.
"Let's go, enter the Domain and experience this desolation. We might also learn about the Domain, or even whether we can bring life back to it. After all, this is a Domain opened by Hong Ze, and we could perhaps comprehend how it's similar or different from our own Domain,"
Xu Yan said in a deep voice.
"Sister is skilled in Alchemical Medical Martial Arts. If anyone has methods to restore life, sister is much more capable. Perhaps we could research how to save this Domain,"
Meng Chong said with a smile.
"With sister's skills, even if reviving the life of the entire Domain is not possible, imbuing a part of the Domain with life, promoting the growth of vegetation, should be achievable,"
Fang Hao affirmed.
As they spoke the four finally stepped onto the land of the Hong Ze Domain, feeling the desolation and stillness. Looking around, they saw no signs of life.
Even the Violent Spiritual Energy that swirled around the Domain seemed to lack Spiritual Charm, feeling more imbued with a notion of death.
The four martial arts brothers walked on the Hong Ze Domain, and although long years had passed, traces of the great battle still remained visible.
Like the shattered boulders, which seemed to originate from a nearby mountain that had collapsed.
"Could this dark aura inside the Hong Ze Domain be related to the resident of the Imperishable Temple?"
Xu Yan suddenly mused.
Taihe and Taikun's injuries were entwined with a gloomy aura. It seemed to carry an ominous sensation.
This aura on the two of them, indeed came from the master of the Imperishable Temple!
According to the Azure Sea Turtle, it was within the Domain that Hong Ze was killed by the master of the Imperishable Temple, who directly devoured him, along with all the life and Spiritual Charm of the entire Domain, leaving nothing behind.

chapters.title: Chapter 1055 - 545 Walking in the Domain, Perceiving the Domain_2
chapters.content:
The gloomy aura enveloping the Hong Ze Domain, could it be the remnant essence of the Imperishable Temple's master from that time?
"If it truly is the remnant essence of the Imperishable Temple's master, this person was somewhat sinister and, moreover, tremendously powerful. The lingering essence hasn't dissipated even now and continues to affect the dead and desolate world!"
Jiang Buping spoke in a deep voice.
After all, the Hong Ze Domain is located in the Land of Imperishable and has already become desolate. It constantly endures the fierce onslaught of Spiritual Energy and Imperishable Qi from the Land of Imperishable, so any lingering essence would usually dissipate quickly.
Yet to remain until now, affecting the dead and desolate world, one can imagine how terrifying it is!
"This gloomy essence is different from that on Taihe and Taikun. The changes in the Hong Ze Domain, the emergence of certain airs from the dead world, combined with the other's residual essence, have formed what we see today."
Xu Yan said while pondering.
Looking into the vast dead world, Xu Yan said in a low voice, "Even though the world is dead, it is intact. Perhaps we can find traces of Hong Ze's creation of this world and also comprehend the structure of this world and its marvelous aspects."
"Let's explore separately. The world is so vast, everyone should find their own place of enlightenment. Though the world seems dead and somewhat unusual, no danger has been found yet. Moreover, should there truly be an irresistible danger, we still have Master's Jade Talisman."
Meng Chong looked around and spoke.
"Second senior brother is right!"
Fang Hao and Jiang Buping both nodded in agreement.
"Be cautious, all three junior brothers. Try to keep your aura concealed as much as possible. Although we have Master's Jade Talisman, which ensures we won't necessarily face a life-and-death crisis, the necessary prudence must still be maintained. Don't be complacent just because of Master's protection and underestimate the situation," Xu Yan said solemnly.
"Don't worry, senior brother, we understand!"
The three brothers, Meng Chong, said earnestly.
"That mountain range is plentiful; I will go over there then," Fang Hao pointed toward left front and said with a smile.
"Since fourth brother is heading that way, then I will explore this way," Jiang Buping also picked his own direction to explore.
The four brothers separated, each exploring in different directions.
Watching his three junior brothers leave, Xu Yan continued forward, stepping slowly, the invisible Sword Intent blending with the Domain around him, silently, as if the Sword Intent itself was part of the Domain.
The Sword Intent transformed into mountains and rivers, merging with the dead land, as though embodying the dead land itself with the mountains and rivers of Sword Intent appearing somewhat desolate.
Xu Yan walked slowly, exploring the Domain while also comprehending the Domain and the ever-changing landscape of Sword Intent.
Gradually, within the Sword Intent, it seemed as if there arose an essence of death, as though this was the Sword Intent of death, the significance of death.
Where it passed became even more desolate.
Immersed in his comprehension, Xu Yan walked step by step through the Domain, understanding the Domain and his own Sword Intent.
"Creation Realm is the creation of heaven and earth. If I were in the Creation Realm, I could transform this dead and desolate world, making it blossom with new life again..." Xu Yan thought to himself.
The Domain is vast, and Xu Yan didn't walk quickly, seeming to measure the Domain with his steps, understanding the differences of each region.
While he had traversed different quarters in the Taicang Domain and walked through the Domain, that was not the same as traversing and understanding the entire Domain.
Besides, because of the existence of Dao Principles and the multitude of life forms, the Taicang Domain had been overly complex, preventing the comprehension of the essence of the Domain.
Now, however, walking in the Hong Ze Domain, a world devoid of life and starkly desolate, he was truly understanding the Domain, seeking its essential nature.
Even though this Domain had died, it was, due to the absence of the bustling chaos and the presence of life forms, easier and more revealing in understanding the fundamental structure of the Domain.
From the structure of the Domain, it seemed possible to derive the evolution of Dao Principles, calculating the rules of the Domain Dao Rule.
The more he walked in the Hong Ze Domain, deeper his understanding became, with the Sword Intent continuously spreading, as if the areas he traversed, spanning hundreds of miles, were all Xu Yan's own Domain.
Sword Intent was silent and unnoticeable, yet it interacted deeply within the Domain.
"So this is what the Domain is like."
In Xu Yan's mind, a vision of the Domain Dao Rule's pattern emerged, though it was crude and only a part of the Domain rules.
He had slowly discerned it step by step from the traces of the Domain.
These Domain rules were integrating into his own Domain. Xu Yan, who had already reached the Complete Heaven and Earth Realm, saw his strength slowly enhance at that moment, progressing into Establishing Dao.
Establishing Dao, Establishing one's own Dao, Establishing the Domain's Dao.
Xu Yan felt the opportunity for his breakthrough had arrived.
Walking in the deadly quiet Hong Ze Domain, he seemed to be measuring the Domain and pondering its structure, having forgotten the passage of time, unaware of how much time had passed.
At a certain moment, Xu Yan stopped. The image of mountains and rivers emerged, and Sword Intent formed a small domain, unveiled plainly before him.
Then, Xu Yan sat cross-legged in the midst of this Sword Intent Domain, which around him for a hundred miles radius, formed a new small domain.
Moreover, this domain was continuously changing—sometimes a gentle breeze blew, sometimes the masses frolicked, and sometimes a Golden Dragon circled...
In the vast Domain, Xu Yan's mere hundred-mile radius of Sword Intent appeared utterly insignificant, causing no stir; the Domain remained deathly still.
Meng Chong was also walking in the dead silence of the Hong Ze Domain, walking on the desolate earth, seeing nothing but desolation everywhere.
With every step he took, he gradually became a part of the Domain.
He practiced Physical Body Martial Arts; his physical body itself was a Domain, with acupoints being the mountains, lakes, and oceans within the Domain...
But the acupoints were also like stars, reflecting the Domain's lakes, oceans, and mountains...
Meng Chong was also reflecting, exploring the essence and structure of the Domain to reflect it onto his Physical Body Domain.
He didn't know how far he had walked, or how much area he had explored, or how long it had been.
At a certain moment, Meng Chong took a step that resonated with the Domain, the trembling of his muscles mirroring the trembling of the Domain.
Boom!
The Domain around Meng Chong for nearly a hundred miles rippled slightly, as if it was the twitching of muscles, or perhaps the trembling of the Domain itself.
At that moment, Meng Chong didn't even realize the rippling of the Domain; he only felt his muscles slightly vibrating.
With every step he took, his muscles subtly vibrated, each slight tremor under his control.
His control over his physical body had reached an extremely subtle degree.
In this unique state, Meng Chong moved forward, his muscles delicately trembling with each step, and he could control this trembling, even the minutest muscle tremor under his command.
However, Meng Chong did not realize that with each step he took, it wasn't just his muscles that vibrated, but also the Domain around him.
In such a wondrous state, Meng Chong had no time to contemplate potential threats; he had to keep his presence concealed and avoid making any disturbances.
Even if Meng Chong became aware, he wouldn't restrain himself, for how could he miss an opportunity for enlightenment?
As for potential dangers, with his master's Jade Talisman, he naturally didn't worry; in enlightenment, he would not hesitate to use the Jade Talisman to avert any crisis.
Meng Chong's physical body resonated with the Domain, insights emerging in his mind, and he vaguely comprehended much, gaining a deeper understanding of the Physical Body Domain.
The breakthrough to the Complete Physical Body Martial Arts Heaven and Earth Realm was not far away.
Fang Hao walked upon the Domain, with insights from Qimen Martial Art, sensing the earth's pulses and the terrain, the veins of the Domain.
He pondered how to use the Domain's veins and terrain to construct the Domain Qimen, while further perfecting his own Qimen Domain.
With his own Qimen Domain, setting up the Domain Qimen, life and death hung in the balance of a single thought.
Jiang Buping walked until suddenly, he dispersed, merging into the Domain; he was an Extreme Soul martial artist, and at that moment, he seemed to lodge his soul in the Domain, feeling the Domain's potential "Soul".
Walking within the Domain, merging with the Domain, the ultimate in Soul, how to let the Soul's Domain become more ultimate, more Imperishable, indestructible, immortal; the Domain may die, but the soul remains!

chapters.title: Chapter 1056 - 546 Yu Ting
chapters.content:
The desolate Hong Ze Domain, where four shadows walked the land, feeling the essence of the domain; as their auras unfolded without restraint, life seemed to once again stir within this silent world.
In the mountains beyond the Hong Ze Domain, the Azure Sea Turtle was waiting for Xu Yan and the others to return, all the while remaining vigilant and ready to send a message at any moment.
This region, under the influence of the Hong Ze Domain, was shrouded in darkness amidst the chaos, even more silent and void of any True Spirit presence.
"Staying here is a bit discomforting."
The Azure Sea Turtle sighed.
Yet, gazing at the Hong Ze Domain, its heart was still trembling, though the feeling of fear had subsided a bit since the beginning.
"I must overcome this fear!"
The Azure Sea Turtle gritted its teeth, staring at the Hong Ze Domain, hoping to confront and vanquish the deep-seated dread within its heart.
Even if it couldn't completely eradicate the inner shadows, diminishing its fear would still be a significant step forward.
Time slipped by, and the Azure Sea Turtle's spirits gradually lifted; as it kept watching, it grew accustomed to it, and the fear inside started to weaken continuously.
"How much time has passed?"
The Azure Sea Turtle pondered whether Xu Yan and the others had been in the Hong Ze Domain for half a month already?
"In the blink of an eye, so much time has gone by? Why haven't they returned yet? Could something have happened?"
The Azure Sea Turtle took out a Communication Talisman, preparing to send a message but then thought, "If they are in the midst of comprehending something, wouldn't my message be a disturbance? Besides, Xu Yan and the others are disciples of 'that' person, they shouldn't be in any danger."
'That' person could effortlessly crush True Spirits as powerful as the Master of Domain with a pinch; in terms of strength, he was certainly no less than the one from the Divine Transformation Temple, perhaps even stronger.
"Continue to wait then; if they've really found an opportunity, they won't be able to return in a short time."
With that thought, the Azure Sea Turtle continued its effort to overcome its inner fears.
In a certain part of the Land of Imperishable, a vast True Spirit galloped, carrying three figures on its back.
These three figures, unlike ordinary Martial Artists, had less of the Aura of Spiritual Grace and more a sense of bleakness, as if they never lived within the Domain.
The three dressed in gray robes with the outline of a palace embroidered on their chests.
"What's the use of a dead and silent domain? Why bother looking for it?" one of them voiced their confusion.
"Just complete the mission, the relevance of a dead and silent domain is a matter for those above us," another shook their head.
The third spoke solemnly, "Those four men and a turtle we encountered are beings of the Domain; they must have come for this silent domain as well. If we can find the silent Hong Ze Domain, we can capture them too."
The first to speak was puzzled, "The Taicang Domain could actually have people leaving the Domain, and still have the leisure to seek out the silent Hong Ze Domain?"
Since they were beings from a Domain, there can't be another apart from the Taicang Domain.
When they took on the mission to find the silent Hong Ze Domain, they had learned that the Netherworld Domain had been refined by the Xue Yu Protector, albeit that Domain was originally his own.
As for the Witch Demon Domain, it had vanished, colliding into the Taicang Domain and seemingly causing no small disaster there.
In such circumstances, could Martial Artists from the Taicang Domain actually afford the luxury of searching for the silent Hong Ze Domain?
"Perhaps the collision with the Witch Demon Domain created a significant problem in the Taicang Domain, and they want to find the silent Hong Ze Domain to fill this gap?" the third one speculated with a laugh.
"That makes sense!"
The three rode the True Spirit, continuing their search for the Hong Ze Domain within the Land of Imperishable.
As for the Taicang Domain, that was a matter for those above; they had only to follow orders and act.
...
Boom!
A mountain trembled, a terrifying presence seeping from within, causing the True Spirits nearby to shudder, turn tail and run, distancing themselves from that mountain.
At this moment, the mountain exuded an aura that sent them quaking with fear.
The herd of True Spirits fled with cries of terror, and even mighty True Spirits trampled and collided with the weaker ones during their flight; in a short span of time, more than a dozen frail True Spirits were trampled or struck dead.
"Who are you?"
"Heh, heh, you're only noticing now? Too late!"
"The Great Wilderness Domain is fake? The soul I summoned, was actually from the Taicang Domain, not facing any accidents?!"
"The Great Wilderness is not fake!"
"Don't deceive me further, the Great Wilderness is fake, the Taoist Ancestor is fake!"
"Heh, heh, as I said, the Great Wilderness isn't fake, the Taicang is history now, it's called the Great Wilderness Domain; and of course, the Taoist Ancestor is real. How could you fathom his power? You can't annihilate me because the Taoist Ancestor has bestowed a strand of opportunity upon me!"
"Fine, very well, you dare to scheme against me, covet my power, let's see what you're capable of!"
"Heh, heh, what I'm capable of, aren't you aware of that by now?"
Inside the mountain, after a prolonged struggle, Blood Demon finally realized the soul he had called back was not his offspring!
No, to be precise, this soul had undergone a mishap and been stolen by someone else.
The opponent, furthermore, intended to usurp his power and replace him!
At that moment, Blood Demon realized unknown changes had taken place in the Taicang Domain.
"I want to see how you plan to replace me!"
Blood Demon was uncontrollably furious but had to admit, he could do nothing against his adversary.

chapters.title: Chapter 1057 - 546: Yu Ting_2
chapters.content:
From the beginning, a judgment error had led to a missed opportunity, and having half of his body stolen by his opponent meant he could no longer suppress the other.
Especially since this subordinate soul was very peculiar, having a similar origin to his own, it was not rejected by his principles and was beyond his control. Some secret techniques were ineffective against it.
The mysterious "Taoist Ancestor"'s power was truly strong and unfathomable.
He was, after all, the Master of Domain!
"Just because I can't deal with you, doesn't mean no one can!"
Blood Demon's body surged with blood light, the Blood Pool disappeared, and he prepared to return to the Imperishable Temple to request that someone suppress the unknown Divine Soul within him.
"Heh heh, someone who can't make decisions,"
Blood Extreme let out a sinister laugh as Blood Demon stepped forward with one foot, but the other foot did the opposite, stepping backward, which resulted in Blood Demon doing the splits on the ground.
"Heh heh!"
Blood Extreme laughed wildly, controlling the hand he controlled and raising it, fiercely slapping the other hand that Blood Demon controlled, as if he wanted to break it.
After all, the body wasn't his own, so he didn't feel any heartache at all!
"You're out of line!"
Blood Demon jumped up in rage, his body swirling with blood light, re-entering the struggle for control over his body, causing him to tumble and roll around in the mountains as though he was fighting himself.
"You've already lost your chance, and now we both govern the body. You can't drive me out, and I can't devour you for the time being. Next, we should talk and reach some agreements."
Blood Extreme was very happy.
Although he hadn't succeeded in completely replacing Blood Demon or taking full control of his power and body, he had occupied half, which was still a half success.
Moreover, the advantage was on his side. The longer time dragged on, the more it benefited him.
He was secretly carrying out the "Soul Seeding" plan. Once Soul Seeding was complete, even if Blood Demon sought external help, he couldn't be stripped away, unless he was willing to give up half his Divine Soul, half his power, and half his body.
Obviously, Blood Demon was reluctant to give up half of his power, which meant he would stop thinking about seeking external help and should sit down and talk properly.
In the future, power could be alternately controlled, taking turns being the master.
Effectively, Blood Demon's body and Divine Soul had two consciousnesses, each independent and able to control the body, and neither could do anything to the other.
Blood Extreme was temporarily satisfied with this situation. Although he wasn't the complete Master of Domain, he could still take turns being the Master of Domain, which was worth it.
Moreover, he still had a chance, such as if Imperishable Temple went to war with the Great Wilderness, he could take advantage of external forces to completely replace Blood Demon.
But before that, he needed to stabilize Blood Demon.
"Think again!"
Blood Demon exclaimed angrily.
"Since that's the case, let's continue doing splits."
Blood Extreme controlled half of the body and squared off against Blood Demon. For a time, Blood Demon's body adopted various strange positions, even contorting wildly.
"Heh heh, this is your body, and if you don't cherish it, I certainly won't feel any heartache!"
Blood Extreme laughed maliciously.
Blood Demon was about to go mad. What was this nonsense? It was infuriating.
"Don't you feel uncomfortable?"
Blood Demon ground his teeth as he spoke.
"Not uncomfortable at all, what is this pain to me? Don't tell me, the mighty Blood Demon, that you can't even bear this little pain?"
Blood Extreme spoke disdainfully.
This so-called pain was nothing compared to the pain of the Divine Soul that Su Lingxiu had inflicted on him in his previous self-imposed study and creation of Divine Soul suffering.
Moreover, his Divine Soul had been refined to endure stronger torment, consciously fully aware during refinement.
Su Lingxiu's deep research into the Divine Soul had reduced his sensation of pain, so this slight torment was insignificant to Blood Extreme!
Blood Demon was speechless for a moment but then became furious and said, "You're forcing my hand!"
His eyes revealed a crazed look, and a blood-red flame emerged in his Divine Soul, enveloping it entirely.
"You're going this hard?"
Blood Extreme was a bit surprised.
"I'm putting everything on the line!"
Blood Demon roared, the blood-red flames blazing. In a blink, Blood Demon's face contorted and twisted horribly as he endured excruciating agony, even emitting a scream of pain in the end.
He, the great Master of Domain, was pushed to this extent!
Soul Burning!
He would use this method to burn Blood Extreme out, to drive him away, even if it meant his Divine Soul was damaged and he suffered brutal torture, he would spare no effort!
"Hiss, it's a bit spicy, I feel like my whole body is covered in chili water, I've got this fiery sensation!"
However, Blood Extreme remained as calm as ever, his face unDistorted, and he did not scream out in pain, merely noting the spicy sensation!
Blood Demon's mental state almost collapsed!
"How can you be unharmed?"
Blood Demon couldn't believe it.
He had even self-immolated his Divine Soul, yet he still couldn't expel the other party, and it seemed that the greater damage was on himself.
Could it be that he doesn't feel the agony of the Divine Soul?
"This little thing, it's nothing, just Soul Burning. I advise you to stop, as it's a waste of the Divine Soul. If it causes your strength to decline, that would be unfortunate. Also, don't think about using this method to drive me out; it's useless. I have the protection of a sliver of the Taoist Ancestor's power. How could the Master of Domain do anything to me?"
Blood Extreme felt pained by Blood Demon's actions, as if the depletion from the Soul Burning was draining his own power.
Blood Demon couldn't continue with the Soul Burning, and now he was completely out of options.
Even the last, desperate measure had been employed, only to result in, he himself, suffering the agony of Soul Burning for nothing!
"Who is this Taoist Ancestor?"
At this moment, Blood Demon's expression became solemn, that mysterious Taoist Ancestor must be incredibly powerful.
"Is it someone from Yu Ting?"
Blood Demon's expression was profoundly grave.
Blood Extreme was taken aback, Yu Ting?
"The Land of Imperishable, apart from the Imperishable Temple, is there another force? Moreover, one that has some hostile relations with the Imperishable Temple?"
Blood Extreme was secretly delighted, having gained an unexpected piece of information.
Yu Ting!
"Yu Ting, what is that? Merely Yu Ting, they're not even worthy to lick the Taoist Ancestor's boots!"
Blood Extreme spoke with confusion and disdain.
Blood Demon's gaze turned fierce, "Apart from Yu Ting, there can't be another existence with such strength!"
Taking a deep breath, Blood Demon calmed himself and said in a deep voice, "Tell me, what does Yu Ting want to do?"
"You know about Yu Ting? Then you tell me, you should know not everyone is qualified to negotiate terms."
Blood Extreme took the opportunity, speaking thoughtfully.
Blood Demon stared at him and after a long pause, said, "I don't know much about Yu Ting, you're from Taicang, it's not possible for you to know about Yu Ting. Let's talk, the presence of Yu Ting in Taicang might not be a good thing!"
"Okay, let's talk."
Blood Extreme pondered for a moment and then nodded.
Yu Ting, a mysterious force that even Blood Demon didn't understand, but perhaps Taicang has survived to this day maybe because of the one from the Imperishable Temple, who delayed things by battling with Yu Ting?
"Is the Taoist Ancestor from Yu Ting?"
Blood Extreme also felt puzzled, but the Taoist Ancestor obviously meant no harm to the Great Wilderness Domain, and regarding Taicang turning into the Great Wilderness, although the domain had changed, the Great Wilderness Heavenly Path was the legitimate successor of Taicang.
The Taoist Ancestor was clearly elevating the Great Wilderness Domain, saving Taicang in the face of crisis, so it seemed unrelated to Yu Ting.
"I need to find an opportunity to send a message back to the Pavilion Master about this mysterious power, Yu Ting."
Blood Extreme muttered to himself.
Apart from the mysterious Taoist Ancestor, including Taihe, Taikun, Ao Lie, and the Seductive Witch, none knew about Yu Ting's existence, even the original seven people of Taicang clearly didn't know.
"Apart from the Imperishable Temple and Yu Ting, are there other powers?"
The more Blood Extreme thought, the deeper he felt the waters of the boundless Land of Imperishable were.
The Seven Great Domain seemed powerful and long-established, but compared to the Imperishable Temple and Yu Ting, they appeared too immature.
No wonder his defeat wasn't unjust!
Blood Extreme sighed internally.
"State your purpose."
Blood Demon said sternly.
"My purpose is simple, to replace you!"
Blood Extreme said, rolling his eyes.
Blood Demon gritted his teeth and said sternly, "Wanting to replace me? Impossible, forget about it."
"So, now we should talk. There's no distinction between us anymore, continuously fighting and twisting our bodies isn't worth it."
Blood Extreme chuckled and said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1058 - 547: Breakthrough in Establishing Dao, Enlightening the Primordial
chapters.content:
Blood Extreme and Blood Demon were in the midst of negotiations, the frustrated Blood Demon's hatred for Yu Ting was skyrocketing. How could he have ended up in such a state if not for Yu Ting's schemes?
For Blood Extreme, occupying half of Blood Demon's body and power was already a considerable success, not to mention he had also learned from the Blood Demon about another force beyond the Imperishable Temple.
Yu Ting!
...
In the Hong Ze Domain, Xu Yan was enveloped in a new domain, this minor heaven and earth seemed to be giving birth to certain domain operational principles.
"It's time to break through!"
Xu Yan murmured to himself.
The opportunity to break through to the Establishing Dao Realm had arrived.
In the silent domain, unexpectedly, there were no lurking dangers.
Xu Yan began his breakthrough to the Establishing Dao Realm, a massive leap, with one step into the Establishing Dao Realm, slaying a Minor Heaven and Earth Master would no longer be an issue.
To establish Dao is to establish one's own way and the Way of Domain.
Xu Yan had already understood how to establish his Dao, after perceiving the structure of the Hong Ze Domain, as well as the operational principles of domain, he now had even more ideas about the Way of Domain.
On this day, in a corner of the silent domain, long-absent Dao Principle fluctuations appeared, revealing the Spiritual Charm of domain. Although these fluctuations did not originate from the silent domain itself, they also added color to this corner of the domain, driving away death and ominousness.
Xu Yan was in the process of establishing Dao, while on the other side, Meng Chong, with his physical body resonating with the domain, was shaking this corner of the domain, making this part of the domain seem as if it had come to life, vibrating and moving with the tremors resonating with Meng Chong's muscle twitches.
Meng Chong, who had achieved Great Achievement in the Domain Realm, seemed to have gained feedback from the silent Hong Ze Domain, and his Domain Realm was moving towards Perfection.
Fang Hao and Jiang Buping also had their own gains and were improving in strength.
The silent domain also held value for enlightenment and opportunities, although these opportunities were not for everyone to obtain, nor could everyone perceive the domain here.
The Azure Sea Turtle, who was staring at the distant Hong Ze Domain, trying hard to overcome its inner fears, suddenly became puzzled, wondering if it was an illusion, as it seemed to have just caught a flash of color at one point in the domain.
It was as if a glimmer of light had emerged on the silent domain, though it was but a brief flicker.
"What has happened, is there an enemy in the Hong Ze Domain?"
The Azure Sea Turtle was full of doubt.
It focused its senses but could not feel any battle fluctuations coming from within the Hong Ze Domain.
"Strange, if there's no battle, then what's going on?"
The Azure Sea Turtle was full of doubt.
"Could it be that Xu Yan is up to something?"
At this moment, even the fear in its heart seemed to be unconsciously diminishing, as it stared unblinkingly at the Hong Ze Domain, afraid of missing something.
Not knowing how long it had been watching, when the Azure Sea Turtle was pleasantly surprised to find that its inner fear had become very weak, it suddenly saw again that a certain point in the Hong Ze Domain seemed to have changed.
It was like putting a dot with the tip of a pen on a huge black stone.
"What's going on? Is the silent domain beginning to show signs of life?"
The Azure Sea Turtle was shocked.
At a certain moment, the change in that point of the Hong Ze Domain disappeared and did not reappear for a long time. The Azure Sea Turtle took out a Communication Talisman, wanting to inquire about it.
"What if they've found a treasure and are in the process of retrieving it? Wouldn't my message be a disturbance at this time?"
With this thought, the Azure Sea Turtle hesitated.
At that moment, the Azure Sea Turtle's expression suddenly changed, as a roar filled with fear came from afar, though distant, it was already approaching the region where the Hong Ze Domain was located.
The roar was clearly the True Spirit's reaction to the silence of the Hong Ze Domain, causing it to give out a roar in fear. Passersby True Spirits would have long avoided it instead of approaching.
This roar obviously indicated that the True Spirit was forced to approach, unable to bear the fear it felt.
Someone was drawing near!
It must be people from the Imperishable Temple, the Azure Sea Turtle thought of those three Realm Master Level strong beings from the Imperishable Temple!
"They've found their way here so quickly?"
The Azure Sea Turtle decisively sent a message to Xu Yan and the others.
Xu Yan's aura surged, the Will of the Earth emerged, and at this moment, his domain had already established a Dao!
Establishing Dao Realm!
After breaking through to the Establishing Dao Realm, Xu Yan's Will of the Earth continued to surge, integrating into the silent domain. As his own Will of the Earth and Way of Domain merged into the silent Hong Ze Domain, Xu Yan sensed some differences in the Hong Ze Domain.
The domain was silent yet still resonated with the Land of Imperishable, as if it was one with the Land of Imperishable, integrated into it.
Xu Yan carefully perceived it, while his own Will of the Earth and Way of Domain also merged into the silent domain, making this area of the domain seem as if it had come back to life.
Using the silent domain to resonate with the Land of Imperishable, and with the Hong Ze Domain as a bridge, Xu Yan comprehended the Land of Imperishable, even blending into it.
At this moment, the laws of the Primordial Realm emerged in Xu Yan's mind, as did the scene when his master had imparted the Primordial Realm to him.
The Intention of the Great Path, the Primordial Chaos Domain!
This instant, Xu Yan achieved enlightenment.
"Although I am not in the Creation Realm and have not yet comprehended the Intention of the Great Path, I now know how to Primordialize, for the Primordial Great Path is just so!"
At this moment, Xu Yan's mind was like a clear mirror, using the Hong Ze Domain as a bridge, resonating with the Land of Imperishable. In the vagueness, he seemed to have touched the enigmatic Great Path.

chapters.title: Chapter 1059 - 547: Breakthrough in Establishing Dao, Enlightening the Primordial_2
chapters.content:
And my own sense of the Way of Domain integrated with the dead Hong Ze Domain, caused life to stir within this region of Domain. Could this not also be Primordial?
Only, the Domain of this region is not Primordial due to the Intent of the Great Path, but rather to my own Way of Domain!
And Xu Yan sensed it as well. The mingling of the Hong Ze Domain with the Land of Imperishable was also some form of Primordial. Using the Hong Ze Domain as a bridge, he finally, at this moment, understood the Law of Primordial.
"So that's how it is, I have finally understood the profound mysteries of the Law of Primordial, the Primordial Great Path, advancing the Great Path. This is the stairway to cultivation, this is pushing open the door that steps onto the Great Path!"
In Xu Yan's mind emerged the scene and the Cultivation Technique of the Primordial Realm imparted by his master, his heart clear as a mirror, fully comprehending it now.
Boom!
At a certain moment, his Way of Domain that merged with the Hong Ze Domain instantly returned. At this instant, the returning Way of Domain seemed to have gained something extra, which was a bit of the Will of the Domain drawn from the Hong Ze Domain after integration.
In the still Domain, Will of the Domain still existed.
But such Will of the Domain is vague and rootless, fleeting and drifting, carrying with it the aura of death.
For Xu Yan, the Will of the Dead Domain absorbed added some elements of the Dao Principles of death to his own Domain, and where there is life in the Domain, there naturally is death.
"Yin Yang, reincarnation, so that's how it is!"
A smile crossed Xu Yan's face.
At this moment, his Domain was truly complete with the entirety of life and death, the cycle of Yin Yang, the endless loops of reincarnation.
"My strength has grown again. If I use the Sword of Death to kill a Minor Heaven and Earth Master, wouldn't it be easy?"
Xu Yan raised his hand, and a sword appeared in his palm.
A sword of greyish-white, without any sharp Sword Intent or edge. Yet upon close scrutiny, it was as if death itself was seen!
This was a Sword of Death!
On touch, death is certain, extinguishing the spark of life!
"When will there be a chance to test my Sword of Death? If my strength is formidable enough, to silence the Domain with one sword strike would be an ordinary affair."
Xu Yan was brimming with excitement.
At last, he had perceived a new sword, the Sword of Death!
"The Hong Ze Domain shows no anomalies?"
The sword in Xu Yan's hand disappeared as he surveyed the four directions of the Domain, somewhat astonished.
This Domain seemed to carry a sense of ominousness—as if there might be some potential dangers or unknown peculiarities.
Surprisingly, against all expectations, there was no danger at all.
The Minor Heavenly Eye gazed upon the Domain: vast dead silence, no signs of life, nor any dangers. Xu Yan's gaze then turned to the ground below; if there was anything hidden in the Domain, it could only be deep underground.
"I have found the Hong Ze Domain and gained some rewards, furthermore, I have broken through to the Establishing Dao Realm, but how should this Domain be dealt with?"
Xu Yan found himself in a dilemma.
A dead Domain also holds great value and, although desolate, there is a possibility for it to regain vitality.
Neither his Prime Tortoise Carapace nor the Storage Divine Artifact refined by Fang Hao could contain this vast Domain.
"Perhaps, find a way to draw it back to the Great Wilderness?"
The Imperishable Temple was also searching for the Hong Ze Domain; they must have some scheme in mind. If the Domain were simply abandoned here, it would sooner or later fall into the hands of the Imperishable Temple.
And if he were to draw it back to the Great Wilderness, it would take an inconsiderable amount of time, given how very, very far the Hong Ze Domain was from the Great Wilderness.
Moreover, Xu Yan's journey into the Land of Imperishable was not only for the Hong Ze Domain itself, it was to venture through the Land of Imperishable, traverse it, and comprehend the Martial Arts.
"Drawing the Hong Ze Domain back to the Great Wilderness would inevitably create a great commotion along the way, making it easy for the Imperishable Temple to detect!"
Xu Yan frowned, momentarily at a loss for how to handle this Domain.
Destroying it would, after all, be a pity!
"Enough, let's see how my junior brothers are doing, and then consult with the Azure Sea Turtle on how to deal with this Domain."
Xu Yan did not linger on the issue any longer and began searching for Meng Chong and the other two.
The Domain was vast; since Meng Chong and the other two had each gone in different directions, they were naturally extremely distant from one another.
Xu Yan was not in a hurry. As he walked through the air, he looked for Meng Chong and the other two while observing the Domain, as somewhere within the Domain, there might be something.
```
"Eh, what's this?"
Suddenly, Xu Yan discovered a pitch-black entrance below, one that was impossible to see the bottom of at a glance.
"Was it formed during the great battle, or did some special True Spirit burrow into the heart of the domain?"
Xu Yan hovered above the entrance, pushing his Minor Heavenly Eye to its limits, peering into the abyss. All he saw was darkness; the cave was swirling with violent Spiritual Energy and Imperishable Qi. It seemed that the Spiritual Energy was converging into the entrance and accumulating inside.
Just as he was about to investigate further, a message from the Communication Talisman suddenly arrived.
He took out the Communication Talisman and his eyebrows immediately raised. Someone was coming?
The Imperishable Temple?
"Perfect timing!"
Xu Yan showed a delighted expression. Having just broken through to the Establishing Dao Realm and mastered the Sword of Death, enemies had now delivered themselves to his doorstep to sharpen his Sword Dao.
It was an excellent opportunity to test the might of the Establishing Dao Realm and the power of the Sword of Death.
As for the cave, Xu Yan decided not to explore it for now. The cave was here to stay and wouldn't disappear.
He stepped out and left the Hong Ze Domain.
Shortly after he left the domain, Meng Chong and the other two also emerged.
Upon seeing them, Xu Yan noticed that all three junior brothers had made their breakthroughs.
"Big Senior Brother, have you broken through to the Establishing Dao Realm?"
Meng Chong, touching his head, asked excitedly.
"Yes!"
Xu Yan nodded and said with a smile, "Let's go meet the Azure Sea Turtle, and I will explain the Establishing Dao Realm to you. Then we'll confront our enemies. I hope it's a Minor Heaven and Earth Master so I can test out my new sword."
The four disciples immediately returned to the mountain to meet up with the Azure Sea Turtle.
On the way, Xu Yan explained the Establishing Dao Realm to his three junior brothers and also delved into the Law of Primordial.
Although the four of them practiced different Martial Arts, they shared a common goal. The Law of Primordial had commonalities that would help them gain insight and clarify their own understanding of this law.
After Xu Yan and the others left the Domain, a faint white light illuminated the deep recesses of the cave they had abandoned. The feeble light brightened the darkness but did not reach the surface of the domain.
The desolate domain remained just as silent.
The light gradually faded, and the cave returned to pitch darkness. At that moment, a head emerged from the dark hole.
This was a massive head that took up one-third of the entrance.
The head was pure white and flawless, feeling neither fleshy nor bloody, as if it were made of jade. It shone with a pearly luminescence yet did not reflect any light, blending seamlessly into the desolation of the domain.
The head tilted back to reveal a face that gazed outward from the domain.
The immaculate visage had delicate features as if sculpted, and its eyes opened to reveal pitch-black pupils that, while lustrous, held no particular expression or emotion.
The bright eyes were calm and still, appearing sculpted and vividly lifelike, yet utterly devoid of sentiment or soul.
The face watched the world beyond for a long time, seemingly in thought, but neither the face nor the eyes betrayed any sign of contemplation.
At some point, it seemed to make a decision.
The head rose further up, followed by the shoulders coming into view at the entrance, then the chest, the waist, until a complete figure emerged from the hole.
This was a Jade Person, with skin pure and spotless. The clothes on its body seemed sculpted as well, yet they conveyed a sense of softness.
Standing like a small giant at the entrance, the Jade Person silently watched the world outside, again seemingly in deep thought.
Then, after a moment, the Jade Person turned and left the entrance.
As it walked away, it left behind no traces, nor did it leave behind any aura.
With every step taken, the figure was dozens of miles away in an instant, walking step by step until it reached the foot of a towering mountain.
The peak of this mountain had disappeared, having been destroyed in a great battle. Despite this, the mountain still stood tall. The Jade Person walked step by step towards the mountain until its whole body disappeared within it.
Before being fully enveloped by the mountain, the Jade Person's head rotated 180 degrees, its face now directly on its back, then looked up, gazing out at the world beyond.
Then the head turned back around and fully entered the mountain. The entrance where it had passed sealed up, and the Jade Person vanished completely within the mountain, indistinguishable from the ordinary stones that filled its interior.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1060 - 548: Slay with a Single Sword, Sharpen Martial Arts Divine Skill
chapters.content:
Xu Yan did not know about the changes in the Hong Ze Domain after his departure, nor was he aware of the mysterious Jade Person's existence, who had already moved to another location and continued to remain hidden.
"Old Turtle, are you certain someone is approaching?"
Back on the Flying Boat, Xu Yan turned to the Azure Sea Turtle.
"It's practically certain."
The Azure Sea Turtle looked towards the direction of the sound and voiced its judgment.
"That being said, someone is indeed getting closer. If it's people from the Imperishable Temple, that would be perfect. I hope it's the three that we encountered earlier."
Xu Yan nodded at hearing this.
"What happened in the Hong Ze Domain?"
The Azure Sea Turtle couldn't help but ask, driven by curiosity.
"Nothing happened!"
Xu Yan shook his head.
Meng Chong and the other two nodded along as well.
"That's not right, I noticed that something unusual was happening inside the Hong Ze Domain."
The Azure Sea Turtle expressed doubt.
"What did you discover?"
Xu Yan asked in surprise.
This old turtle, having been terrified by what it saw in the Hong Ze Domain, dared to keep watching it and, as a result, noticed something amiss?
The Azure Sea Turtle shared its findings, solemnly stating, "I thought you might have encountered enemies!"
Xu Yan let out a laugh and said, "I thought it was something serious. It turns out that was just a bit of commotion caused by my breakthrough!"
The Azure Sea Turtle was taken aback upon hearing this, "You broke through?"
"Yes!"
Xu Yan nodded.
Gulp!
The Azure Sea Turtle swallowed hard and carefully asked, "What's your current strength?"
Xu Yan chuckled and said, "Slaying you, this old turtle, shouldn't pose too much of a problem!"
The Azure Sea Turtle was incredibly shocked.
Thinking back to when it first met Xu Yan, what was his strength then? How long had it been, and he was already capable of slaying a Minor Heaven and Earth Master?
With the speed of his strength increasing like this, he believed it wouldn't be long before Xu Yan could stand shoulder to shoulder with Taicang, and then leave him behind, surpassing the former Taicang!
When it comes to monstrous talent, it's still Xu Yan!
"So, if the people coming are the three from the Imperishable Temple, we won't have anything to fear, right?"
The Azure Sea Turtle said excitedly.
"Of course, I can use them to temper my Sword Dao!"
Meng Chong grinned and said, "Our strength has also broken through. The three of us together, I wonder if we can stand against a Realm Master."
The Azure Sea Turtle inwardly sighed, fearing that Meng Chong and the others might surpass it before long.
Thinking of its own long life, only to find others surpassing it after merely decades or a century of cultivation, it couldn't help feeling like an absolute waste.
That Open Heaven Purple Light, that's all the Creation it got!
Of course, the Azure Sea Turtle also knew that the rapid increase in strength of Xu Yan and the others, such monstrous growth, all depended on the powerful Martial Arts taught by their master and his excellent guidance.
"Taoist Ancestor, ah!"
The Azure Sea Turtle inwardly exclaimed with a sigh, and then felt a bit jubilant. Was it not also a disciple of the Taoist Ancestor now?
Upon this thought, the Azure Sea Turtle felt gratified about its past decision to give the Prime Tortoise Carapace to Xu Yan.
"They're here!"
Xu Yan's eyes brightened as he looked into the distance.
The Azure Sea Turtle and Meng Chong's trio followed the sound and faintly sensed three figures slowly getting closer.
The True Spirit, probably out of extreme fear, would rather die than approach, so these three had forsaken the True Spirit and were being very cautious.
"Should we ambush them, or strike directly?"
The Azure Sea Turtle inquired.
"Let's just strike directly, it's a good opportunity to temper my Sword Dao."
Xu Yan said with a resolute voice.
"Good, Meng Chong and I should be able to hold off two of them!"
The Azure Sea Turtle nodded.
"There's no need for such trouble. I will go all out with one sword strike to kill one, and for the remaining two, I'll use one to temper my Sword Dao, and you can deal with the other with my disciples."
Xu Yan spoke, then turned to Meng Chong and the others, "A weak Realm Master's strength is just right, suitable for you disciples to temper your Martial Arts. You can unleash the Martial Arts Divine Skill to your heart's content without worrying about the opponent not being able to withstand it, and they don't have the power to threaten you. They're perfect for practice."
Meng Chong grinned, clenching his fist, "Big Senior Brother's words are sound!"
Fang Hao and Jiang Buping also nodded with smiling faces.
"That's settled then. After killing these three, we'll discuss how to deal with the Hong Ze Domain."
Having said that, Xu Yan took a step forward and, without concealing his aura, directly advanced towards them.
"They are creatures of the Domain!"
As Xu Yan revealed himself, the three Realm Masters from the Imperishable Temple were immediately filled with joy.
"It's one of the four who fled. They also came for the Hong Ze Domain. We can't let them escape this time!"
One of them said gravely, and with a swift movement, he charged toward Xu Yan with incredible speed.
"Surrender without resistance!"
He said with a cold gaze.
The Azure Sea Turtle and Meng Chong's trio also appeared, confronting the other two Realm Masters from the Imperishable Temple. The Azure Sea Turtle manifested its huge frame, the deep blue light roiling like surging waves.
"This time, let's see where you can run!"
The remaining two Realm Masters from the Imperishable Temple advanced instead of retreating, facing off against the Azure Sea Turtle and Meng Chong's trio.
"Remember, he who kills you is Sword God Xu Yan!"
Xu Yan looked at the Realm Master rushing towards him, his eyes resolute, and lifted his hand, summoning a grey-white sword into existence.
This grey-white sword lacked sharpness, nor did it stir with Sword Intent, appearing somewhat desolate and deep, seemingly ordinary and without much power.
Sword of Death!
This was a concept Xu Yan had comprehended, representing the meaning and power of death within the Domain.
Shua!
Xu Yan raised his hand and delivered a sword strike without reservation, the strongest he could manage at his current realm.
The grey-white sword vanished in an instant, and in the next moment, it had already struck towards the Realm Master from the Imperishable Temple charging at him. The Realm Master's face was filled with terror as a dark aura surged around him, and he swung a curved blade in attack.

chapters.title: Chapter 1061 - 548: Slay with a Single Sword, Sharpen Martial Arts Divine Skill - Part 2
chapters.content:
But, to his horror, the gray-white sword seemed formless, almost an illusion, condensed from intent. When he struck, trying to block the gray-white sword, it passed through his curved blade and slashed downward.
Realizing something was amiss and wanting to change his defense against this eerie gray-white sword, it was already too late. He could only bellow, as a powerful force surged around him, forming a strong defense.
He used a secret technique to its fullest, even burning his own origin to form a powerful defense.
As the gray-white sword approached, he felt the presence of death.
Thud!
The gray-white sword, piercing through the defense, struck his body.
Death descended!
At that moment, the Realm Master's expression was one of terror, feeling as if his life force was being eroded, his physical body withering, and his Divine Soul ceasing to exist, overwhelmed by the terrifying sense of death.
"You!"
He looked towards Xu Yan in aghast, but after Xu Yan had swung his sword, he didn't even glance at him; instead, he moved directly towards one of the other two Realm Masters.
Thud!
The Realm Master from the Imperishable Temple, his life force extinguished, his body withered, his Divine Soul already dead and silenced, turned into a corpse that seemed long dead, in an instant!
A sword had claimed a life!
Buzz!
Xu Yan had already intercepted one of the remaining two, the World within the Sword emerged, enveloping the opponent directly.
"Come let me sharpen my Sword Dao!"
The Realm Master looked horrified, "You, how is it possible!"
A single stroke had killed his companion, not weaker than himself; to kill him must also be effortless, right?
At that moment, his heart trembled, wishing to flee.
"Run, you can't escape. Going all out might give you a chance to survive!"
Xu Yan said with a faint smile.
"I'll fight you!"
The Realm Master, realizing he seemed to be trapped within a domain and knowing escape was almost impossible, resolved to fight desperately!
"That's right!"
Xu Yan let out a merry laugh.
Boom!
Sword Intent emerged, Xu Yan began, from start to finish, to use his opponent to sharpen the Sword Dao, validating the new Sword Dao Technique, proving whether his insights were correct.
Xu Yan and that Realm Master fought fiercely, the World within the Sword vibrating, yet it never broke, and the aftershocks of the battle could not radiate out from the World within the Sword.
Meanwhile, the Azure Sea Turtle was ready to act at any moment, guarding against the Imperishable Temple person's lethal moves while also being vigilant about any escape attempts.
Three Realm Masters, one instantly fallen, another caught in a dire fight, the situation looked bleak, hence this one would surely think about escaping.
Meng Chong did not transform into a giant but simply wore the Golden Armor, looking like a muscular giant clad in golden armor, majestic, unleashing various Martial Arts Divine Skills at will.
Fang Hao immediately set up the Qimen Grand Formation, moving within it, leveraging the influence of Qimen to bind and disturb the opponent, then launching countless Divine Weapons from the Qimen Armory like a torrential flood.
The Formation combined with the Qimen Grand Formation, timing every step with an unpredictable Formation, making his figure elusive, even using a puppet's body to confuse the opponent and lure away the opponent's lethal hits.
Jiang Buping held the Extreme Path Soul Soldier, freely using Divine Skills to sharpen his own Martial Arts, continually attacking the opponent's Divine Soul.
The three teamed up, battling fiercely with the Realm Master from the Imperishable Temple; although they couldn't defeat him, they freely used Martial Arts Divine Skills, gathering invaluable experience.
The Realm Master was terrified, striking madly; yet, despite having the upper hand, he was unable to break the combined effort of his opponents and could not inflict damage on the enemy.
The great battle erupted in the Imperishable Land, the booming sounds spreading across the region, breaking the silence of the area.
While the noise couldn't match the battle of a Domain Master, it was still exceptionally fierce, reaching far distances.
This Martial Arts training lasted three days.
The two Realm Masters from the Imperishable Temple, more than once, wanted to flee but couldn't disengage and had to keep fighting desperately.
"That's enough!"
Xu Yan looked at his opponent and showed a smile; this session of Martial Arts training was about to end.
Buzz!
A sword swung out.
The Realm Master was breathless, but his eyes were cold and fierce, with a hint of madness added.
Boom!
He raised his hand to strike, a dark aura surging around him, gathering a powerful force that wrapped around the incoming sword!
Hiss!
As his sword collided with another, while the sword was shattering and he was about to catch his breath to strike at Xu Yan again, something shocking happened.
Out of the shattered sword burst a golden True Dragon!
It seemed as though its rest had been disturbed, so the infuriated True Dragon let out a terrifying roar and violently slammed its way forward.
The furious Golden Dragon, seemingly determined to perish together with its enemy, unleashed its mighty Dragon Might, the unparalleled force of the True Dragon, all in that single strike.
Boom!
The True Dragon blasted through his defenses, and with a sudden explosion, the terrifying Dragon Might and the power of the True Dragon tore apart his physical body and Divine Soul, sending intense agony through him.
Ah!
A piercing scream rang out, followed by his body exploding, swept away to ashes under the relentless Dragon Might.
Divine Skill, True Dragon's Rage!
"Divine Skills within Divine Skills, one set after another, impossible to guard against—there's still room to explore in the application of these Divine Skills!"
Xu Yan smirked, his Sword Arts Divine Skill concealing the True Dragon's Rage Divine Skill. When the sword arts were broken, the True Dragon's Rage followed immediately, catching him off guard.
After dealing with his opponent, Xu Yan turned to look at the fight involving Meng Chong and the other two.
At this moment, the remaining Realm Master, filled with fear, was trying to break out of the encirclement and escape using a secret technique.
Too terrifying!
Not long ago, these four had been the ones fleeing for their lives from their pursuers—how much time had passed for them to now possess the strength to slay them?
Either they had deliberately concealed their abilities before, or their strength had significantly increased in a very short time.
He leaned toward the latter.
Perhaps, something supreme had been born in the Hong Ze Domain that significantly enhanced their power.
"Junior brother, you could try layering Divine Skills!"
Xu Yan said with a smile.
The Azure Sea Turtle and that Imperishable Temple Realm Master didn't know what layering Divine Skills meant, but Meng Chong and the other two immediately understood and began honing the technique of layered Divine Skills.
Hum!
Taking advantage of the moment when the three were not skilled in layering Divine Skills, the Realm Master from the Imperishable Temple found a gap and tried to escape.
"Go back!"
With a single strike of his sword, Xu Yan directly forced the opponent back.
The Azure Sea Turtle swallowed saliva, feeling that with his strong defense, he might be able to withstand a dozen or twenty blows from Xu Yan without being slain by a single sword strike.
"If even my defense cannot withstand it, in the Minor Heaven and Earth Master ranks, who else can stand up to Xu Yan?"
The Azure Sea Turtle marveled internally.
"Taihe, Taikun, and Taimiao, huh? Although they are stronger, they definitely can't defeat Xu Yan, nobody can deal with Xu Yan now. Although not the first among Minor Heaven and Earth Masters, he is definitely among the top, and his killing power is stronger against weaker martial artists."
The more the Azure Sea Turtle thought, the more he was amazed at the speed of Xu Yan's growth.
Moreover, Xu Yan's Martial Arts killing force was unimaginably powerful.
For powerhouses like Taihe and Taikun, slaying weaker Realm Masters would also take some time and a fierce battle.
However, Xu Yan could slay a person in just a few moves, and was not afraid of being surrounded.
Mainly because Xu Yan's Martial Arts were mysteriously effective, his combat capabilities far surpassed Taihe and the others.
What's more, Xu Yan's Martial Arts seemed to have a certain overwhelming effect even against those, including Taicang Martial Arts practitioners, making it far more difficult for the slightly weaker to defend against Xu Yan's attacks compared to those of the same level who cultivated Taicang Martial Arts.
"Die!"
Meng Chong, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping layered Divine Skills, and the three's Divine Skills intertwined with each other as they struck the Realm Master.
Restriction, confinement, Slaughter the Physical Body, Slaughter the Soul—a multifaceted burst of Divine Skills, each layer erupting one after another, with the succeeding one unexpectedly more forceful than the previous.
Boom!
Under this attack, the Realm Master was seriously injured.
"He's still not dead!"
Meng Chong was momentarily surprised, then roared as a giant heavenly shadow emerged behind him.
Divine Skill, Heaven Lifting Earth Extinguishing!
Boom!
This Divine Skill carried not only the violent force of Heaven Lifting Earth Extinguishing but was also secretly layered with Jiang Buping's Extreme Soul Divine Skill, Fang Hao's Confinement Divine Skill, and Meng Chong's own Great Sun God Obscuration Divine Skill!

chapters.title: Chapter 1062 - 1062: 549
chapters.content:
The battle ended, and this part of the Land of Imperishable once again returned to silence.
The Azure Sea Turtle was shocked in its heart. Three Realm Master Realm powerhouses from the Imperishable Temple had been beheaded just like that, and this time, it hadn't really made a move. It only slightly weakened that one's fierce killing moves when Meng Chong and the others were honing their martial arts, nothing more.
If Blood Frenzy had encountered the four brothers Xu Yan now, there would have been no need for its help; they would have been slain.
The rate at which Xu Yan and the three others improved their strength was astonishing.
"How should we deal with the Hong Ze Domain?"
Xu Yan looked towards the lifeless domain in the distance and said.
"The domain is too large and special. It can't be taken into a storage divine artifact."
Fang Hao said with some helplessness.
With his current strength, he was unable to refine storage equipment that could accommodate such a vast domain.
Moreover, domains are special. The storage space refined couldn't store domains; it could only be stored by the domain, even if it was a lifeless one.
"Leaving the Hong Ze Domain here, it will sooner or later fall into the hands of the Imperishable Temple. If we destroy it, it will take quite some time, and it's a pity to destroy it anyway."
Meng Chong touched his head, pondering, "How about we attract it back? If it could merge into the Great Wilderness Domain, be transformed by the Heavenly Dao, and revitalized, the Great Wilderness Domain would become even stronger."
The Great Wilderness Domain had already merged with the remnants of the Wicth Demon Domain, and the entire domain had grown considerably. Moreover, the structure of the Yin Yang Reincarnation had been established, and the power of Heavenly Dao had also improved significantly.
If it could devour the Hong Ze Domain and make it a part of the Great Wilderness Domain, it could bring a considerable improvement to the Great Wilderness Domain in a short time.
Besides, the Hong Ze Domain is a complete domain, although it has already become desolate.
"Attracting it back, the journey is long, there may be some dangers, and I don't plan on returning to the Great Wilderness right now. I intend to continue exploring the Land of Imperishable."
Xu Yan said, feeling helpless.
"Old Turtle, what do you think?"
Xu Yan looked at the Azure Sea Turtle and asked.
"I have no suggestions. However you want to handle it, I'll just cooperate," it said with a sheepish smile.
Although it had overcome many fears, it still did not dare to enter the Hong Ze Domain and could only watch from a distance.
"How about I and the Fourth Junior Brother, Fifth Junior Brother, attract the Hong Ze Domain back, and take our gains back to our younger sister, while you and Old Turtle continue to explore the Land of Imperishable?"
Meng Chong looked at Fang Hao and Jiang Buping, "What do you think, my two junior brothers?"
"Let's do as Second Senior Brother suggests. We're still accumulating for our breakthrough, and attracting the Hong Ze Domain back is a good opportunity. When the Hong Ze Domain merges with the Great Wilderness, we might gain something and continue to comprehend the Domain."
Fang Hao and Jiang Buping nodded, agreeing to Meng Chong's proposal.
"Let Old Turtle go back with you. Attracting the domain will make quite a commotion and might draw the attention of the Imperishable Temple. Old Turtle, after all, has more experience traveling through the Land of Imperishable and is less likely to go in the wrong direction."
After thinking about it, Xu Yan decided to let the Azure Sea Turtle accompany Meng Chong and the others back. With the turtle's experience, they could avoid some unnecessary trouble.
"I'd better follow you. The Land of Imperishable is muddled and full of the unknown, and you, alone, are more likely to end up in danger..."
The Azure Sea Turtle felt that Xu Yan, on his own without its guidance and experience, was likely to enter dangerous areas.
The likelihood of Meng Chong and the others getting lost while attracting the domain back was slim, as they were retracing their steps and had the Sensing Bead from the Great Wilderness Domain. As for the disturbance caused by attracting the domain, it was unavoidable.
Even with its assistance, they could not avoid drawing attention.
Given the Hong Ze Domain's vastness and sense of desolation, there was no need to worry about True Spirit attacks along the way, as True Spirits would avoid it from afar.
The only concern was the Imperishable Temple.
"Old Turtle, no need. I've got the experience I need, and being on my own makes it easier to avoid trouble," said Xu Yan, shaking his head.
"The Land of Imperishable is not that simple. The experiences I've shared are just some basics. I could definitely help you avoid potential dangers."
The Azure Sea Turtle insisted.
Xu Yan sighed and said, "Old Turtle, to be honest, following me, you could become a burden!"
The Azure Sea Turtle was momentarily taken aback. The implication of not wanting it to follow was that it could become a burden?
"Impossible!"
The Azure Sea Turtle refused to accept this, "I, the Azure Sea Turtle, have rich experience in traversing the Land of Imperishable. How could I be a burden? Moreover, with my strong defense and the Turtle Breath Technique, I will certainly not be a burden!"
"What about speed? When fleeing, will I have to carry you? And your Turtle Breath, to me, is just so-so. It can't fool my eyes. There are certainly not a few who can see through your Turtle Breath. You know, I might face beings at the level of Masters of Heaven and Earth going forward."
"I'm confident I can evade the scrutiny of Masters of Heaven and Earth level. Can you?"
Xu Yan patted the Azure Sea Turtle's head, "You go with my junior brothers. Attracting the Hong Ze Domain back will count as a great contribution, and you might ask my master for a Life-saving Jade Charm.
The Azure Sea Turtle wanted to say more but ultimately deflated.
It had to admit, facing a Master of Heaven and Earth level powerhouse, it really could become a burden.
At once, the Azure Sea Turtle's spirits lifted. A Life-saving Jade Charm?
"Alright, no problem. I will definitely attract the Hong Ze Domain back!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1063 - 549: Drawing the Domain Back_2
chapters.content:
For the Life-saving Jade Charm, for the sake of achieving this great feat, I must go all out.
With the protection of the Ancestor's Jade Token, even if I encounter the Master of Domain in the future, I won't have to be afraid.
"That's decided, then."
Xu Yan looked toward the Hong Ze Domain and thought of the deep pit, saying, "I'm going to check out the Hong Ze Domain. I discovered a deep pit there and want to investigate whether it might be hiding something."
"Big brother, I'll go with you."
Meng Chong spoke up.
"I'll go too."
Jiang Buping followed suit.
"I'm crafting a Flying Boat that draws upon the power of Heaven and Earth, so I won't go!"
Fang Hao shook his head as he refused.
Moving something as vast as the Domain using only one's strength was clearly impossible; one could exhaust themselves to death, so it was naturally necessary to rely on external forces.
The Hong Ze Domain was already dead silent, devoid of Domain Dao Rules, making it relatively easier to draw upon. It was like pulling a great mountain, only this mountain was as vast as the Domain itself.
"That's good too!"
Xu Yan and the other two headed back to the Hong Ze Domain, while Fang Hao began crafting the Flying Boat that would draw upon the power of Heaven and Earth. This would take some time, and although he had accumulated quite a few materials, it still wasn't enough.
"Old turtle, you're familiar with the Land of Imperishable, go gather various metals, various materials, and come back. Does the Land of Imperishable also have Spirit Crystals?"
As Fang Hao pondered over the refinement of the Flying Boat, he asked.
"Spirit Crystals do exist, though they are quite rare, mostly found within the mountains formed after the fall of True Spirits. These True Spirits, because of their ability to absorb Spiritual Energy, cause the mountains they transform into to also accumulate Spiritual Energy. Over a long period of time, it will turn into Spirit Crystals."
"However, the Spirit Crystals of the Land of Imperishable are not as mild as those in the Domain. Instead, they possess explosive properties, and the Spiritual Energy can easily detonate once triggered."
The Azure Sea Turtle explained.
"No matter, and such Spirit Crystals may even allow the Flying Boat to burst into extreme speed in an instant. Go and collect some."
"Alright!"
The Azure Sea Turtle nodded and immediately turned to leave, searching for the Spirit Crystals of the Land of Imperishable and collecting various materials.
Xu Yan, Meng Chong, and Jiang Buping returned to the Hong Ze Domain and arrived at the entrance of the pit, looking down into the unfathomable darkness.
"Be careful, there might be something lurking!"
Xu Yan said as a figure walked out from him and directly entered the deep pit.
The underground cavern was filled with unknown dangers; naturally, Xu Yan wouldn't personally explore it, so he sent a replica of himself instead.
Meng Chong and Jiang Buping also sent replicas of themselves into the cavern.
"Eh, there's actually nothing?"
Xu Yan was incredulous.
Through the replica, he could explore everything within the cavern, but to his surprise, there was nothing at the bottom of the pit. It seemed as if this cavern had been formed by the strike of a powerful being during a great battle.
"Big brother, should we carefully explore the entire Domain?"
Meng Chong asked.
"There's no need to explore; if there really is something, it will definitely be disturbed when we draw upon the Domain."
Xu Yan shook his head.
The process of drawing upon the Domain would cause great disturbance. If anything was hidden within the Domain, it would surely be disturbed, come out to investigate, and even attack to prevent the drawing upon the Domain.
"What if it doesn't come out when we draw upon the Domain?"
Xu Yan smiled and said, "That would be even better. Once it's drawn back, it would no longer be able to escape. With master there, what could possibly go wrong?"
Meng Chong and Jiang Buping nodded, understanding that once the Domain was drawn back, any hidden threats would cease to exist and couldn't possibly threaten the Great Wilderness Domain.
The master was in the Great Wilderness; how could anything be hidden from the master's sight?
Xu Yan and the others left the Hong Ze Domain and separately searched for the various materials needed for the crafting of the Flying Boat.
Half a month later, a massive Flying Boat was crafted.
But this Flying Boat, compared to the Hong Ze Domain, still appeared very small; however, to draw upon a dead Domain, it was sufficient.
"It's almost ready, let's try it."
Fang Hao was excited; this was the largest Flying Boat he had ever crafted, and he had used a completely new method of crafting, applying all kinds of Formations and Prohibitions.
At the tail of the Flying Boat, three long chains, resembling the Heaven and Earth Laws, were where Fang Hao had imbued the Mysterious Gates Heavenly Earthly Rule, incorporating the Mysterious Gates Grand Momentum and various Formations and Prohibitions.
Xu Yan, Meng Chong, and Jiang Buping all added their own enhancements to the three chains.
Even a Minor Heaven and Earth Master would need some time to sever these three chains.
"Next is to set it up within the Domain!"
Fang Hao arrived at the Hong Ze Domain, found the right position, and began the setup.
Stepping on the earth, the Qimen Grand Formation emerged, gathering the momentum of the lifeless Domain, Prohibitions, Seal Formations, and so on, as one formation after another was laid out.
In three locations of the Hong Ze Domain, formations were arranged; here, the chains of the Flying Boat were to hook onto the Domain, ensuring that when pulling the Domain, it would not come loose.
"It's ready, let's try next if we can pull the Domain!"
Back on the huge Flying Boat, Fang Hao was thrilled.
The Azure Sea Turtle was also excited; this was an unprecedented feat, pulling a whole Domain!
Hum!
The Flying Boat's three chains stretched out towards the Hong Ze Domain and precisely pierced into the locations of the three Great Formations that had been set up.
Boom!
Each chain drove deeply into the Domain, the formations activated, the momentum from the lifeless Domain was gathered, and tightly locked the chains in place.
As the three chains pierced into the Domain, a pair of eyes appeared on the mountain where the mysterious Jade Person was hiding, but these eyes looked just like two stones, unremarkable.
The eyes gazed at the Flying Boat outside the Domain, watching motionlessly for a long time, as if pondering something.
After quite a while, the eyes disappeared, and there was no further movement.
Hum!
The Flying Boat started, the chains tensed, and the Hong Ze Domain shook slightly.
"Can it really pull the Domain?"
The Azure Sea Turtle was very nervous.
"There should be no problem, I have calculated it, we can definitely pull the Domain."
Fang Hao was both nervous and excited.
Xu Yan, Meng Chong, and Jiang Buping were also watching with excited faces; no one would want to miss such a momentous event.
"Oh, right, I almost forgot!"
Fang Hao slapped his forehead, took out several glowing pearls, which hovered around the Flying Boat, with some pearls shooting out and hovering far away from the Flying Boat.
"Eldest brother, take some of the Memory Capturing Pearls to the back of the Hong Ze Domain!"
Fang Hao handed several Memory Capturing Pearls to Xu Yan.
The Memory Capturing Pearl was a treasure developed by Fang Hao that could record images.
Pulling the Domain was such a magnificent feat, such an unprecedented scene, naturally, it had to be recorded.
"Alright!"
Xu Yan was also excited, holding the Memory Capturing Pearls, he moved and vanished on the spot in an instant.
After arranging all the Memory Capturing Pearls, Xu Yan returned to the Flying Boat.
Near and far, Memory Capturing Pearls were placed in all directions, ready to capture the scene from every angle.
"Begin!"
Fang Hao, overcome with excitement, waved his hand to start controlling the Flying Boat.
Hum!
The Flying Boat trembled, the chains tensed, and the distant Hong Ze Domain was also quivering.
Whoosh!
At one moment, a powerful burst of force shot out from the tail of the Flying Boat, forming a crimson trail of flames; the huge Flying Boat began to move slowly.
"It's moving, it's moving!"
The Azure Sea Turtle had long forgotten its fear and was shouting excitedly as it fixed its gaze on the Hong Ze Domain.
The silent and gloomy vast Domain slowly started to move, pulled by the Flying Boat, embarking on its journey.
Boom!
The movement of the Domain was enormous, with the ominous and lifeless air spreading out like a storm in all directions.
Far away, several cries of terror from beasts could be heard as True Spirits got frightened and fled in panic.
After pulling the Domain, the speed of the Flying Boat began to increase, and the movement speed of the Domain also gradually quickened.
However, due to the vast size of the Domain being pulled, no matter how fast it went, it could not be very fast.
"We did it!"
Fang Hao was ecstatic.
Xu Yan moved, disappeared from his spot, and retrieved the Memory Capturing Pearls.
In the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, a colossal Flying Boat was pulling a Domain, traveling slowly. Everywhere it passed, it shook the Land of Imperishable, and the mountains formed from the corpses of True Spirits were directly shattered; broken mountain fragments scattered within the Domain.
Given the vastness of such a Domain, it was naturally impossible to avoid some larger mountains in its path, hence wherever the Domain went, all mountains were destroyed, creating no small disturbance.
Meanwhile, the horde of True Spirits had long fled, their shrieking voices occasionally rising within the Land of Imperishable.

chapters.title: Chapter 1064 - 550: Unchanging Divine Master
chapters.content:
