The massive Flying Boat, pulling along the Domain, moved through the Chaos. Its speed was not fast; with such pace, dragging the Domain back to the Great Wilderness would take no small amount of time.
Moreover, along the way, the disturbance it caused was significant, startling True Spirits into frantic flight, shattering one mountain after another.
"The commotion is a bit too large. If there are powerhouses from the Imperishable Temple nearby, they will surely arrive at the first opportunity!"
The Azure Sea Turtle voiced its concerns with some worry.
"If they are Realm Master Level powerhouses, I am not afraid; My Flying Boat can withstand them. Of course, if there are too many, it will indeed be troublesome. But there's no need to worry too much; if worse comes to worst, we'll just use Master's Jade Talisman,"
Fang Hao said with a smile.
Leaving the Great Wilderness and venturing into the Land of Imperishable to pull back a Domain was enough to shock all powerhouses in the Great Wilderness.
"That's indeed true!"
Hearing this, the Azure Sea Turtle immediately felt reassured.
Having already pulled the Domain back, it was natural to use some life-saving measures in case of danger, to ensure the successful return of the Domain.
"Big brother, you can leave it here,"
Meng Chong spoke up.
"Alright, my three junior brothers, I am going to explore the boundless Land of Imperishable,"
Xu Yan nodded in agreement.
"Looking forward to big brother's fame echoing through the Land of Imperishable,"
"In the Land of Imperishable, where few people roam, how can fame spread? This journey is for comprehending Martial Arts, to break through the Creation Realm soon and advance on the path!"
Xu Yan laughed heartily.
His figure shifted and disappeared from the Flying Boat.
"I will scout around. If there are enemies from the Imperishable Temple, I will slay them!"
Xu Yan's voice echoed from afar.
Meng Chong and the others sighed in admiration; upon their big brother's return, his strength was sure to have increased greatly, and it would be difficult for them to catch up to his pace.
The Azure Sea Turtle's face was full of emotion; once Xu Yan entered the Land of Imperishable, his strength would increase even more rapidly. It was well-known that the Land of Imperishable was boundless and filled with too many mysteries and treasures.
The massive Flying Boat, pulling along the Domain, headed towards the Great Wilderness.
At that moment, Xu Yan fully exhibited the Vanishing Thought Divine Ability, his figure flickering between places, instantly vanishing from one spot to materialize in another distant location.
In a short time, Xu Yan had scouted tens of thousands of miles around the path of the Domain, finding no enemies from the Imperishable Temple. Instead, he had come across a Realm Master Level True Spirit adept at lurking and had casually slain it.
"Where is the Imperishable Temple?"
Xu Yan scanned the murky surroundings.
Then, he looked towards where the Great Wilderness lay.
"I hope that the great battle with the Imperishable Temple does not come too soon. Once I am in the Creation Realm, I must battle that individual to see who is stronger!"
Xu Yan muttered to himself.
However, Xu Yan knew that the great battle with the Imperishable Temple would not be far off, and this brief amount of time might not be enough for him to break through to the Creation Realm.
"Perfect Realm of Establishing Dao is a Great Achievement and sufficient enough. To slay a Master of Heaven and Earth should be possible,"
Xu Yan silently assessed.
With each minor advancement within the Establishing Dao Realm, strength leaps tremendously.
Having reached Great Achievement or Perfection, one should possess the strength to slay a Master of Heaven and Earth. Beings like Muxiao, a Master of Heaven and Earth, would undoubtedly be slayable.
"The Land of Imperishable is boundless; I can exhibit my full strength to my heart's content,"
Xu Yan's figure disappeared from the spot, directly utilizing the One Thought Traceless Divine Ability to traverse through the Land of Imperishable.
"With my speed, even if I encounter a Master of Heaven and Earth, I can easily escape,"
Xu Yan was brimming with confidence.
...
In a certain part of the Land of Imperishable, an ancient palace was slowly moving.
In front of the palace, two gigantic True Spirits lay, munching on their prey—which happened to be two minor Heaven and Earth Master level True Spirits that had initially lain there.
These were two Heaven and Earth Master level True Spirits.
The massive and ancient palace had a door open, and at any given moment, a figure would rush in, entering the palace.
After a while, another figure flew in and entered the palace.
Figures continuously dashed in from all directions, and each of them, even the weakest, were at the Realm Master Level.
Whoosh!
At a certain moment, a towering figure landed in front of the palace. This person had a head as large as a cooking pot, arms that reached below the knees, and a ferocious face with a bulging lump on the forehead.
A Master of Heaven and Earth level powerhouse!
The massive ancient hall inside had other structures, courtyards, and other palaces of various sizes.
And within the largest palace, dozens of people had gathered at this moment.
Those standing at the front were all Master of Heaven and Earth level powerhouses.
"Xue Yu, do you have the nerve to stand here?"
The intimidating figure with the large head and lump on the forehead looked at Xue Yu, who was standing at the forefront, and spoke coldly.
"Move behind me; that's my spot."
Xue Yu's expression unchanged, he looked at the other with an indifferent gaze, "My name is Blood Prison, and Xue Yu is dead. You and I are both protectors; it's first come, first served for standing spots. If you don't want to stand behind me, then stand to the side."
"Blood Prison? Hahaha, one of the Seven Great Domain Masters and you've even given up your name, how laughable! What right do you have to speak in front of me?"
Xue Yu maintained an indifferent expression. "Whether I have a right is not for you to decide, Dousan!"
"Hmph!"
Dousan huffed with a cold snort, his aura swirling, "Everyone says the Seven Great Domain Masters are a cut above us. I, Dousan, would really like to experience that for myself."
Xue Yu chuckled lightly, "You know whether we are a cut above. Weren't you involved in the siege of Fen Yun as well? What was Fen Yun's strength like? Let me tell you the truth; my strength is slightly greater than Fen Yun's."

chapters.title: Chapter 1065 - 550: Unchanging Divine Master_2
chapters.content:
"Hmph!"
Dousan snorted coldly, "Fen Yun is dead, do you want to die as well?"
"That depends on whether you have the ability or not," Netherworld replied with a cold laugh.
"Where is the Blood Demon?"
Dousan suddenly looked around, "If it weren't for him protecting you and having the Divine Master accept you, you would have died a long time ago!"
"The Blood Demon has other assignments," a seductive figure approached, wearing a dark-colored long dress, her face exuding an indescribable allure, but behind her swayed a scorpion tail.
The dark scorpion tail had a red mark on it, as if it was left by a burn.
Netherworld glanced at the newcomer, his eyes sweeping over the red mark on her scorpion tail. It was a trace left by Fen Yun from the past.
One of the powerhouses who participated in the encirclement and suppression of Fen Yun.
"Night Princess, you're back as well?"
Dousan was somewhat surprised.
"A major event is nearing, how could I not return?" Night Princess smiled faintly, her gaze sweeping the surroundings and she asked curiously, "Where is Muxiao?"
"His task is to prompt the True Spirits to take over Taicang prematurely, he might be in Taicang," Dousan shook his head.
Netherworld stood silently; although he had joined the Imperishable Temple, he was unfamiliar with these powerhouses and had no dealings or even some conflicts with them.
During the previous battle between the Six Great Domains and the Imperishable Temple, he had also killed many people from the Imperishable Temple, including some subordinates of these individuals.
One by one, people entered the grand hall, the weakest among them were at the Realm Master level, and powerhouses at the Master of Domain level also appeared gradually.
Although these Masters of the Domain were much weaker than Netherworld, they were still Masters of the Domain, incomparable to ordinary Masters of the Domain.
Among the Masters of the Domain from the Imperishable Temple, Dousan and Night Princess were among the most powerful, and Netherworld felt that Dousan's strength might not be much weaker than his own.
Moreover, he sensed some unique aura emanating from Dousan.
It was similar to the peculiarities brought about by the Open Heaven Purple Light Creation.
"Dousan and the others must have received some opportunities to surpass other Masters of the Domain and achieve such strength!" Netherworld thought silently.
The Seven Great Domain Masters were stronger because of the Open Heaven Purple Light, and they opened up their own Domains, which especially gave them an advantage in combat within the Domains, making them even stronger.
Dousan and Night Princess had such powerful abilities, naturally also related to opportunities similar to the Open Heaven Purple Light.
As time passed, more and more powerhouses from the Imperishable Temple gathered, and Netherworld became increasingly astonished as some Masters of the Domain he had not seen during the Great Battle appeared.
The strength and heritage of the Imperishable Temple were beyond imagination.
"No wonder we lost!" Netherworld sighed internally.
The foundation of the Seven Great Domains was indeed much weaker, and the Minor Masters of Heaven and Earth following them had not broken through their restrictions. If they had tens of thousands more years, the outcome would be completely different.
By that time, among the Minor Masters of Heaven and Earth, there would also be those who broke through the restrictions and stepped into the ranks of the Masters of Heaven and Earth, and their strength would also be stronger.
Especially Taicang, given tens of thousands more years, how could it be weaker than that one from the Imperishable Temple?
Bang!
Finally, the doors of the grand hall closed. Those who needed to return had returned, and those who hadn't either had tasks that prevented them from coming back or had already fallen.
"Some familiar faces are missing." Dousan looked at the ranks of the Masters of Heaven and Earth; some old faces had disappeared.
Of course, in the ranks of the Masters of Heaven and Earth, there were also some new faces; these were the newly advanced.
Among the Minor Masters of Heaven and Earth, some had been replaced, either promoted or already dead.
"Is the Divine Master summoning us this time for the Taicang Domain or because of Yu Ting?" Night Princess asked in a deep voice.
"Judging by the time, the Taicang Domain should have disappeared by now," Dousan glanced at Netherworld and said.
Taicang!
All the Masters of Domains who had participated in that battle tightened their expressions. That majestic figure was deeply imprinted on their minds, even though their opponent had lost.
But that strike, which directly annihilated a Master of Domain, still lingered.
If not for the Divine Master's personal intervention, the Imperishable Temple would have surely been defeated!
"The Taicang Domain, it's indeed time for it to disappear, having devoured the Qi of Heaven and Earth, there should be a result now."
Another Master of Domain spoke in a deep voice.
Qi of Heaven and Earth!
This was the reason the Imperishable Temple targeted the Seven Great Domains, and what the Unchanging Divine Master needed, because the Qi of Heaven and Earth had broken through the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, possessing special characteristics.
Netherworld sighed in his heart. Taicang was the first to open up a Domain; they six had followed suit. Opening a Domain was no trivial matter, and the Qi of Heaven and Earth seemed to possess a special use for breaking into the Imperishable land.
This was why the Imperishable Temple had taken action against the Seven Great Domains.
"My Qi of Heaven and Earth has peeled off on its own. Now, I can no longer be considered a pure Master of Domain."
Netherworld mulled over this in his heart.
Initially, being accepted as Undying, he also paid a great price.
It was his unique Qi of Heaven and Earth as a Master of Domain that he had stripped away to give to the lord of the Imperishable Temple.
Exactly because of this, his strength had not improved much over the years.
Suddenly, an eerie and cold Qi emerged within the great hall, and a humanoid figure descended onto a chair above the hall.
Everyone within the great hall adopted a reverent and awestruck expression, bowing down to the ground.
"We greet the Divine Master!"
Netherworld also bowed down, looking towards the chair where the humanoid figure sat, though his face was invisible, and his fleshly body inscrutable, his heart subconsciously tightened.
Lord of the Imperishable Temple!
How strong he was, no one knew, but all the Realm Master Level powerhouses did not dare defy or disrespect him, indicating the terror of his power.
Even someone as strong as Taicang had been defeated by him.
"The Next Era is approaching soon. Missing this opportunity, we would have to wait one Yuan. The Qi of Taicang Domain should also be nearly ready for extraction. Yu Ting is also preparing for the next era. The focus hereafter should be on dealing with Yu Ting and extracting the Qi of Taicang Domain..."
The Unchanging Divine Master spoke in a deep voice.
Dousan, Night Princess, and a few others looked incredibly solemn, yet their eyes revealed excitement and anticipation.
However, others including Netherworld, who were newly risen Masters of Domain, were somewhat puzzled.
Next Era?
What does that mean?
The Unchanging Divine Master continued to issue commands, all revolving around Taicang and Yu Ting, preparing for the arrival of the next era. The most important task was to guard against Yu Ting.
"Although Yu Ting has not intervened or done anything, there have always been frictions between us. Moreover, with the upcoming arrival of the Next Era, they might cause some disruptions. We must be extremely cautious."
"Also, the Witch has appeared and is being pursued. If we can devour the Witch, our chances of success in the Next Era will be greater..."
The Unchanging Divine Master paused briefly, then continued, "Muxiao is commanding the True Spirit Horde which has now entered Taicang, sufficient to enhance the Qi of Taicang and modify Taicang a bit. This will take some time, so there is no rush for Taicang; proceed at the established pace towards Taicang."
"Yu Ting is the primary focus of our defenses, apart from the three True Spirits."
At this point, the voice of the Unchanging Divine Master grew more solemn, "Those three True Spirits, having survived through long ages, even if they haven't developed intelligence like us, must have acquired a certain Spiritual Wisdom, having transcended their beastly nature. With their strength as Kings of True Spirits capable of commanding a vast horde of True Spirits, they must not be underestimated!"
Netherworld listened silently; his heart was shockingly amazed that the Witch was still alive.
And within the Land of Imperishable, there lay three ancient True Spirits whom even the Unchanging Divine Master had to handle with care.
"The Land of Imperishable holds too many secrets; I am actually still a young man, compared to these old beings, I know too little."
At this moment, Netherworld deeply realized that they, the Masters of the Seven Great Domains, were actually the youngsters, belonging to a new force. Losing to the Imperishable Temple was not at all unjust.
"Could it really be that there are only these few strong beings in the Imperishable Temple? Apart from Dousan, Night Princess, and a few elderly, the rest are new. Could it be that the old ones have all died? It's absolutely impossible! Maybe they are all preparing for the Next Era and haven't returned."
Netherworld thought resolutely in his heart.
The strength of the Imperishable Temple was beyond imagination, and Yu Ting, being cautious of the same, must also be no weaker than the Imperishable Temple.
"In the Land of Imperishable, besides the Imperishable Temple and Yu Ting, are there other forces?"
Netherworld pondered curiously.
"Does the Unchanging Divine Master know how vast the Land of Imperishable is? Does he know whether the Land of Imperishable has any borders?"
At this moment, Netherworld's mind was filled with curiosity.

chapters.title: Chapter 1066 - 551: The Divine Temple's Mission, Jade Beauty
chapters.content:
Netherworld looked up at the Unchanging Divine Master seated high above and then glanced at the rest of the people in the great hall, "Is the Unchanging Divine Master not from the Human Clan? Therefore, the powerhouses of the Imperishable Temple, regardless of their original forms, all transform into human shapes."
The Seven Great Domain, including the masters of these Six Great Domain, are in human form because they are influenced by Taicang, without exception, all transform into human bodies, rarely revealing their true forms.
Even the lord of the True Spirit Domain, Ao Hong, a True Dragon, also takes on a human shape, although with dragon horns on his head, it is ultimately a human form.
Moreover, young True Dragon Clan members can also transform into human form, this is due to Ao Hong's use of the Open Heaven Purple Light to pass down the entire Dragon Race's heritage in the form of bloodline succession.
Taicang is human, and Netherworld and his peers have always believed that Taicang was the first person of the Land of Imperishable.
Now, Netherworld suddenly discovers, perhaps the Unchanging Divine Master is also human!
He is the first person of the Land of Imperishable!
Otherwise, why would the powerhouses of the Imperishable Temple, without exception, take on human forms?
Even though some features are peculiar, like the scorpion tail of Night Princess, they are still in human form, human-shaped.
Taicang influenced them, the Unchanging Divine Master influenced the Imperishable Temple, influencing people like Night Princess was also inevitable.
The Unchanging Divine Master is carrying out arrangements in the Imperishable Temple for the Next Era. Dousan, Night Princess, and others are all listening respectfully.
Netherworld had many doubts in his mind, but he knew his position, as he ultimately aligned himself with them and was once an enemy. Blood Demon was not within the Divine Temple, and he had no real relationships with the others, so even though he had countless questions, he dared not ask them.
Finally, the Unchanging Divine Master finished speaking.
Among the masters of Domain in the great hall, there were also those full of questions. At this moment, someone asked out loud.
"Divine Master, what does the Next Era mean?"
Netherworld's spirits lifted - finally, he was about to get an answer.
The Unchanging Divine Master spoke slowly, "Era, the measurement of years in the Land of Imperishable is the only method to measure time here. The Next Era means entering the next epoch within the Land of Imperishable."
Some who did not understand the implication of the Next Era were suddenly enlightened - so the Land of Imperishable also had epochs. But how to determine when the Next Era is approaching?
Netherworld also pondered this.
"Divine Master, how do we know when the Next Era is coming? The Land of Imperishable has always been murky and unclear, unlike the Domain where the night and day are distinct, and the number of days is clear, enabling one to know how many days and years have passed."
The master of Domain who had just asked, again spoke up doubtfully.
Before the appearance of the Seven Great Domain, they knew no count of years, months, and days in the Domain. Time in the Land of Imperishable was measured by the lifespan of certain True Spirits as a reference for how much time had passed.
When venturing out, one would carry a True Spirit along, and when this True Spirit died, it was used to judge how much time had passed. The True Spirits used for this time measurement were not strong, had short lifespans, but were numerous.
This was once a common method of calculating time in the Imperishable Temple, like agreeing to return to the Imperishable Temple after a certain number of True Spirits had died, until the appearance of the Seven Great Domain, when they learned about the years, months, and days of the Domain, and thereby counted time.
In the Land of Imperishable, time passed was also referenced against years, months, and days.
Therefore, when the Unchanging Divine Master said there was a method of time measurement in the Land of Imperishable, it was inevitably puzzling.
The voice of the Unchanging Divine Master deepened slightly, "In the Land of Imperishable, every once in a while, a beam of light would pierce the Chaos, and from this beam of light as the beginning, to the appearance of the next beam of light, marks an Era;
"When the next beam of light appears, it will be the Next Era."
Upon hearing this, Netherworld abruptly lifted his head, staring in shock at the Unchanging Divine Master.
In his mind's eye, the vision of that Open Heaven Purple Light emerged, the first time they witnessed a beam of light piercing the Chaos Primordial Land.
From that beam of light, a new epoch in the Land of Imperishable began.
This meant, they have not yet spanned a full Era since the creation of their world!
Since the Unchanging Divine Master knew of this method of measuring epochs, it meant he had lived through at least two epochs.
A veritable ancient relic!
Had the Unchanging Divine Master also acquired Open Heaven Purple Light? Perhaps more than once?
No wonder his power was unfathomably deep.
Dousan and Night Princess were not much weaker than him; had they also acquired the Open Heaven Purple Light, after all, they had existed through at least one Era!
"Open Heaven Purple Light?"
Netherworld asked in shock.
The Unchanging Divine Master looked at Netherworld. "Soon after that purple light, you all created the Domain. How exactly did Taicang create the Domain?"
Netherworld was startled - he had assumed the Unchanging Divine Master should know how the Domain was created, but now it seemed he did not!
"Purple light!"
Netherworld stated gravely, "Taicang created the Domain with it, and all our Domain creations were with Taicang's assistance. I do not fully understand the specific manner of creation."
The Unchanging Divine Master did not show whether he believed what was said, and he did not continue to inquire about the creation of the Domain, and instead commented, "That beam of light is not fixed; it might be white, red, or green. This Era's light is purple, what color the light will be in the Next Era, however, remains unknown."
Netherworld was shocked. The Unchanging Divine Master had existed for more than four Eras—no wonder his strength was so formidable.
"Could it be that each beam of light has different uses for living beings?"
Netherworld wondered to himself.
However, he did not voice this question. For some reason, he had a premonition that the Unchanging Divine Master and his followers had perhaps not captured the purple light.

chapters.title: Chapter 1067 - 551 The Task of the Divine Temple, Jade Beauty _2
chapters.content:
At the beginning, when the purple light was captured, it was Taicang who had initiated and taught the means, only thus were they able to capture the purple light, and finally, with the purple light, they opened up the Domain and became the Master of Domain.
Every certain period, a ray of light would streak across the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, since the purple light of this era had such a great opportunity, then the light of the next era would surely also have its wonders.
Netherworld was secretly excited in his heart, despite not knowing why the Unchanging Divine Master was extracting the Qi of Heaven and Earth, what he intended to accomplish with the opening of the next era, but he could find an opportunity to capture the light of the next era.
A great opportunity was soon arriving.
Perhaps he had a chance to break free from the Imperishable Temple, escape the control of the Unchanging Divine Master, or even kill the Unchanging Divine Master in return?
"Prepare for the tasks of the next era, there must be no mistakes, if you miss this era, you'll have to wait another era, and among you, not necessarily anyone can wait until the next era,"
the Unchanging Divine Master said, looking towards Netherworld, he continued, "Your task is to prevent the people of Yu Ting from approaching the Taicang Domain, with your strength."
Saying so, he drew with his hand, outlining a certain location in the Land of Imperishable, and ordered, "You will guard this place to stop the people of Yu Ting."
"Yes, Divine Master!"
Netherworld respectfully replied, asking, "How do I distinguish the people of Yu Ting?"
He had never seen the people of Yu Ting, even the mysterious force of Yu Ting he knew very little about.
"The people of Yu Ting are easy to recognize. If they are as white as jade from head to toe, they are the people of Yu Ting,"
explained the Unchanging Divine Master.
"I understand. I will definitely stop the people of Yu Ting from approaching,"
Netherworld nodded.
"If you are no match, then retreat and send a message back, and I will handle it myself,"
the Unchanging Divine Master thought for a moment and then said.
"Thank you, Divine Master!"
Netherworld said respectfully.
"Each carry out your tasks and await orders,"
said the Unchanging Divine Master, and like a gust of wind, he vanished in an instant.
Netherworld did not communicate with Dousan and the others, he immediately left the great hall, left the Divine Temple, and with a move of his figure, he headed straight for his designated location.
"Yu Ting!"
To make even the Unchanging Divine Master take such caution, their strength must be no less than that of the temple.
"It's time to contact Blood Demon."
Netherworld pondered inwardly with some secrecy; he knew too little, but Blood Demon was one of the Elders of the Imperishable Temple and surely knew many secrets and should have more understanding of Yu Ting.
Somewhere in the Land of Imperishable, within the chaos, there was a faint glimmer moving. At the center of the faint light was a youth, as if enveloped by heaven and earth, or rather as if heaven and earth existed because of him.
Xu Yan took one step at a time, his Sword Intent transformed into mountains and rivers of Domain, covering all directions, using his own Domain to comprehend the Land of Imperishable.
Mountains and rivers of Domain, with a flickering light emerged, displaying a Domain landscape in the midst of chaos, as if a small Domain was about to be opened.
And this Domain, not slow in speed, was moving through chaos.
Howl!
The roar of the Imperishable True Spirit rose, nearby True Spirits rushed over, attracted by the Images of Heaven and Earth, the light of Domain.
Xu Yan made no move.
His walk in the Land of Imperishable was for comprehension, to reflect upon his own Martial Arts, to explore the Land of Imperishable, and the Imperishable True Spirits that entered his Images of Heaven and Earth, allowing him to dissect the innate abilities of True Spirits, even to take their abilities and replicate them within his Domain, becoming one with the Domain Dao Rule.
The Way of Domain was established, encompassing all laws and growing strong, also a method of cultivation.
The cultivation of Establishing Dao was inherently difficult, the speed destined not to be fast. One must constantly comprehend their own Dao, strengthen their own Dao, and also need to expand the Way of Domain.
Entering Establishing Dao was only laying a foundation, which needed to be constantly expanded upon, constantly built upon, for Establishing Dao to reach Perfection.
Perfection of the Way meant Creation, Creation of Heaven and Earth.
Therefore, the True Spirits entering the Images of Heaven and Earth was part of the comprehension, and also taking what was useful to build upon the foundation of Establishing Dao.
Howl!
The Imperishable True Spirit entered into the mountains and rivers of Domain, appearing very excited, galloping about, even gleefully showing off its abilities, and moving along with the Images of Heaven and Earth.
Roar!
Within the mountains and rivers of Domain, a Golden Dragon surfaced and swooped down, engaging in battle with the entered True Spirits, provoking them to use their abilities.
Every time the entered True Spirits used their powers, and once these were replicated, the Golden Giant Dragon would either devour the True Spirit or drive it out of the mountains and rivers of Domain.
"Not all True Spirits are useful," at least only those at the Realm Master Level have value for replication.
Xu Yan began to sift through the True Spirits approaching him, disregarding those not above the Realm Master Level.
Mountains and rivers of the Domain shimmered faintly, moving through the Chaos, which naturally drew attention very easily; however, Xu Yan didn't care, for his journey was meant for training—how could one train by sneaking around?
The Land of Imperishable was boundless with countless True Spirits. Naturally, the variety of True Spirits was also beyond counting. The great mountains formed from the fallen True Spirits occasionally nurtured plants—all of which were rare treasures.
Xu Yan's gain was immense.
Time hurried by, and Xu Yan had been adventuring alone in the Land of Imperishable for three years already.
"The junior brothers should have already drawn Hong Ze Domain back, right?"
Xu Yan looked back toward the general direction where the Great Wilderness Domain lay.
"This mountain is extremely ancient, nearly eroded by time and about to completely vanish."
Looking at the mountain beneath his feet, its structure had become unstable, loose, as if it would disintegrate like sand and vanish completely at any moment.
This mountain was the largest and most ancient one Xu Yan had encountered in the Land of Imperishable.
It meant that the True Spirit that had transformed into this mountain possessed the strongest power he had ever seen.
Xu Yan sat cross-legged at the peak of the mountain. Mountains and rivers of the Domain unfurled slowly around him as the center until it covered the entire mountain; this mountain on the verge of collapse suddenly turned into a small world of its own.
Two figures were flying through the Land of Imperishable, seemingly searching for something.
"Where have the people of Yu Ting hidden?"
One of them frowned and spoke.
"They couldn't have gotten far!"
The other person scanned the surroundings, pondering, "It's very likely that they are hiding in the nearby mountains!"
"Collapse any mountain we encounter!"
The two of them spoke while rapidly flying and scanning the surroundings, and when they passed a small mountain, they directly destroyed it.
"Nothing here, move on!"
Boom!
Another mountain was shattered, but still no trace of their quarry, so the two continued their search.
Within the ruined mountain, a large rock flew out with the collapsing debris, moving away from the two. Only after their figures had disappeared did a head poke out of the mountainside.
Originally grey like the stone, the head gradually regained a jade-white color, as flawless as an exquisite piece of jade.
A figure emerged from the stone.
Clothed in snow-white, like flawless jade, with a curvaceous figure and delicate, smooth features, her originally jade-white eyes slowly revealed black pupils.
Like a jade sculpture of a beauty, seemingly without flesh and blood.
The Jade Person looked in the direction where the two pursuers had gone then, after a momentary contemplation, escaped toward another direction—a faint white figure moving through the Chaos.
As the jade-sculpted figure became more lifelike, she still maintained her skin as white as jade without a trace of blood, yet it did not appear ghastly.
She was a beauty like jade, polished and flawless.
The Jade Beauty's speed increased as she plunged into the vast Chaos, and suddenly, she came to a halt, turning her head to a faint light not far away.
She blinked her eyes, seemingly confused—why was there such a light in the Land of Imperishable?
After a brief hesitation, she headed toward the light.
As she drew near, a look of astonishment appeared in her eyes. Was this place a small Domain?
She stopped, observing for a long time before slowly approaching the small Domain.
Standing outside the small Domain, the Jade Person regarded it thoughtfully—it seemed both illusory and real.
It was not an illusion, yet there was a feeling that it was not a true Domain.
The Jade Person's thinking seemed somewhat slow; at one point, she reached out and grabbed a floating rock from afar, drawing it toward her.
Throwing the rock into the Domain,
Thud!
The rock landed on the ground with a dull sound.
The Jade Person blinked again, returning to contemplation—this Domain was real, yet why did it also feel as if it were not a real Domain?
Puzzled and unable to figure it out, after a brief hesitation, she stepped into the Domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1068 - 552: I am Xu Yan, sending two to their death
chapters.content:
Xu Yan was sorting through the Domain Dao Rule, trying to perceive if he could gain something from this ancient mountain when suddenly he opened his eyes and looked beyond the mountain.
A figure was approaching.
What surprised him was the woman getting closer; she appeared abnormal.
Like jade, as if transformed from beautiful jade itself.
Her exquisitely beautiful face seemed to have been meticulously sculpted, every detail perfect, as if a master jade carver had spent countless efforts to craft it.
She looked like a normal person but also not quite normal.
"Someone from the Imperishable Temple? It doesn't seem so!"
Xu Yan was puzzled inside. The people from the Imperishable Temple had a gloomy aura, lacking a robust vitality, making them easy to distinguish.
But this woman did not carry that aura of the Imperishable Temple.
And neither did she have the aura of any Domain creatures.
"Could it be, a special True Spirit?"
Xu Yan couldn't help but suspect that although this woman appeared human, she might be a special True Spirit from the Land of Imperishable.
After all, there were many kinds of True Spirits, and some unique, special True Spirits did exist.
"Imperishable True Spirits have no Spiritual Wisdom, but this woman has Spiritual Wisdom, she is not an Imperishable True Spirit. Could it be that there is an Imperishable True Spirit who has developed Spiritual Wisdom, and I just happened to meet her?"
Curiosity consumed Xu Yan.
Although the woman possessed Spiritual Wisdom, she gave an impression of being somewhat slow in thinking, as if she had just awakened her Spiritual Wisdom.
However, Xu Yan wondered, are Imperishable True Spirits this beautiful?
And also, specifically human!
Upon seeing the woman, the phrase "a beauty like jade" surfaced in Xu Yan's mind; she seemed like a finely carved statue of beautiful jade.
"Could it be, apart from the Great Wilderness Domain and outside the Imperishable Temple, there are other people?"
Using the Minor Heavenly Eye, Xu Yan was surprised to see flawless white light, as if gazing upon unblemished beautiful jade, yet unable to perceive its true nature.
Even the Minor Heavenly Eye couldn't see through its essence, which astonished Xu Yan.
The woman's power was only at the Realm Master Level, whereas he had already reached the Establishing Dao Realm. Generally, Masters of the Domain with ordinary power couldn't escape his Minor Heavenly Eye.
Despite her being only of Realm Master Level, he couldn't perceive her essence.
The woman, emanating pure and flawless white light, concealed her nature, rendering the Minor Heavenly Eye unable to fathom it.
"Something isn't right."
Xu Yan frowned lightly.
"I must see what or who she truly is, or even if she is a person at all!"
Xu Yan sat meditating on the mountain, blending in as if he became an inconspicuous stone, silently observing the woman.
"Enter my Domain, and I shall know your nature."
Xu Yan watched as the woman stepped into his Domain's mountains and rivers.
In that instant, Xu Yan was somewhat shocked. The moment the woman stepped into the mountains and rivers of the Domain, it was as though a flawless beam of white light entered, adding a touch of beauty to the landscape.
"Something isn't right!"
Xu Yan increasingly felt that the woman was extraordinary. The moment she stepped into the Domain's mountains and rivers, it seemed as though beautiful jade appeared within his Domain.
"She doesn't seem like a human."
At this moment, Xu Yan concluded that the woman was not a person in the conventional sense; although she appeared human and identical to other humans, she lacked that tactile sense of flesh and blood.
"But, she isn't entirely not human either."
Xu Yan was at a loss.
Silently observing the woman, the Way of Domain was sensing her, striving to discern her essence, trying to capture some traces of her aura or even to replicate her capabilities.
But, under the sensing of the Way of Domain, he still saw nothing but pure, flawless jade light.
The woman carefully walked around the minor Domain, her eyes revealing some confusion—though the confusion appeared somewhat slowly, giving a sense of dullness.
She looked around and couldn't help but pick up a stone from the ground, squeezing it. It was indeed a real stone, not fake, but somehow, this Domain gave her an unreal feeling.
Slowly exploring within the minor Domain, she seemed to be searching for something, cautious and somewhat naive, appearing slow or perhaps clumsy in her thoughts at times.
Xu Yan was also puzzled. He couldn't see through the woman, even though she had entered into his Images of Heaven and Earth; he was still unable to discern her.
It seemed she possessed some form of powerful Dao Principle that prevented all prying, a mysterious Rule far beyond what a Minor Heaven and Earth Master possessed.
"Strange, is she a human or a True Spirit? The Land of Imperishable truly hides too many unknowns."
Xu Yan sighed inwardly.
The woman wasn't strong, yet she possessed some Rule far beyond the level of power she should have, which was in itself suspicious.
"Was this bestowed upon her by a powerful being for her protection?"
Xu Yan pondered.
Could it be the woman bore a treasure similar to a Master's Jade Talisman?
However, the Rule within her gave him a feeling that it was not granted by external forces but rather intrinsic to the woman.
"Let's test her. As soon as she displays her power, try to imprint it within the Images of Heaven and Earth."
With that thought, Xu Yan's mind flickered, and suddenly the ground beneath the mountain cracked open; a hundred-zhang-long golden True Dragon, with overwhelming Dragon Might, soared up, its piercing eyes looming over the woman.
The woman suddenly stopped in her tracks, and her exquisitely beautiful face slowly showed a hint of astonishment.
Blinking, surprised and puzzled, she looked at the golden True Dragon and after a long while, barely opened her mouth, uttering a crisp and moving voice, "True Dragon?"
Xu Yan watched every move of the woman, feeling an indescribable oddity. That slowness, that dullness, as if a dim-minded person, always a beat slow in reaction.

chapters.title: Chapter 1069 - 552: I am Xu Yan, sending two of you to your death_2
chapters.content:
```
She seemed half-witted, dully and sluggishly reacting.
However, although her reactions were slow, and she appeared dim-witted, her expression was that of a normal person's state. Such abnormality was extremely bizarre.
Ao!
The Golden Dragon let out a roar, looking down from on high, gazing upon the woman.
"Why have you come to my Domain?"
The Golden Dragon emitted an authoritative voice.
"This is your Domain? Something isn't right!"
The woman's response still seemed somewhat tardy.
"Little girl, what do you know of the Domain, to recklessly speak of my Domain as being amiss? Do you not know that there is differentiation within the Domain?"
"Wrong is wrong!"
The woman's response was always a beat too slow.
"How dare you say my Domain is amiss? Since you have come to my Domain, leave something behind."
The Golden Dragon dived down, lifting its dragon claw, and reached towards the woman.
The strike was not fast, given that the woman's slow reactions likely meant that she could not respond in time.
However, when facing the attack, the woman's reaction did not show the slightest hint of slowness.
Swoosh!
In the blink of an eye, she vanished on the spot, and the next moment, she appeared above the Golden Dragon's head, stomping down toward its head!
Xu Yan wore a look of surprise, as the woman's combat response was not slow at all but extraordinarily sharp, even more so than a typical Realm Master.
Ao!
The Golden Dragon tumbled into the air, its dragon claw swiftly grasping at the woman's descending foot, while its dragon tail swept across at the same time.
In a flash, the woman disappeared again, and the next moment, a pale hand emerged, shrouded in a faint jade-white light.
The light harbored a strong force, causing ripples in the Domain at that moment, as if it could melt the Domain Dao Rule, as if it could meld all powers.
"This force is rather special, it can be confirmed that she is definitely not from the Imperishable Temple, nor is it the True Spirit Force."
Xu Yan raised an eyebrow.
The Golden Dragon roared, its Dragon Might vast, as thunder surged, starting a fierce battle with the woman.
Xu Yan, as the Golden Dragon, fought with the woman while simultaneously sensing her power, trying to replicate her Principle, transforming it into the Domain Dao Rule, enhancing the Way of the Domain.
To his surprise, the woman's power was very special, giving off a pristine and flawless feeling, yet mighty, possessing a strong melting force, and it was unclear how it was cultivated.
"Very wrong indeed!"
As the battle grew more intense, Xu Yan felt increasingly that something was off about the woman, the origin of her power seemed unusual, as if not deliberately cultivated.
It was as if her body naturally birthed the power.
Boom!
The Images of Heaven and Earth trembled, the woman's attacks grew sharper, and even the Golden Dragon found itself at a disadvantage.
Moreover, the woman seemed to be probing the entire Domain, moving around while battling the Golden Dragon, seemingly trying to find the discrepancy in the Domain.
"Merely with the Golden Dragon, I cannot defeat her."
After a moment of contemplation, Xu Yan let out a roar and another True Dragon appeared in the Domain, a flawless Jade Snow True Dragon.
Poof!
As soon as the Jade Snow True Dragon appeared, it exuded a chill, a surge of Frost Thunder emerged, flanking the Golden Dragon, they both battled the woman.
This second True Dragon was naturally created by Xu Yan using Ao Yuxue as a template, mimicking Ao Yuxue's True Dragon's Power.
"If I enhance my strength any further, I would expose my existence."
Xu Yan did not continue to increase his power, only using the two True Dragons to entangle the woman.
"Wrong!"
The woman kept saying slowly as she fought with the True Dragons.
Then her dress fluttered, stunningly beautiful without equal. As she moved her hands, two clusters of jade-white light formed into long ribbons, coiling towards the two True Dragons.
Her bright black eyes also gradually turned jade-white, a trace of silver-white light shining through them like moonlight, illuminating all directions.
Under the illumination of the silver-white brilliance, the two True Dragons seemed as if they were melting, bound by the ribbons in an instant.
```
Her eyes shimmered with a silver radiance, illuminating the expanse of the Domain, while the hiss of energy resounded, and the power of Domain manifested around her. The ancient mountains beneath her feet became vaguely visible.
"I knew it, something is off with this Domain!"
The woman tilted her head, glanced at the two True Dragons, then looked down at her feet, somewhat dazed and slow to speak.
"Purification power? Purifies everything, powers that do not belong to oneself, and yet, it's not true purification."
Xu Yan was astonished at this moment.
The misty silver-white radiance in the woman's eyes seemingly possessed some "Purification" power, capable of purifying all that wasn't hers, this form of "Purification" acted like it was dissolving foreign substances.
Xu Yan had not yet revealed himself, and for the moment, the woman had not detected him, but she sensed something amiss with the Images of Heaven and Earth, though she had not yet fully grasped its essence.
The two True Dragons, however, could not be saved, after all, they were merely two streams of force transformed by the Subduing Dragon Palm, and not very strong at that, so it was within expectations that they could not withstand the woman's power.
The Way of Domain was sensing the woman, the Domain was copying her current state, including the forces she wielded, and even if it couldn't replicate them entirely, to simulate the woman's powers at this moment was not too difficult.
"Her power is somewhat mysterious, much more intricate than those of the True Spirits, and will require more time to replicate and transform into the power of the Dao Principles of the Domain."
Xu Yan felt a surge of excitement, he had a premonition that if he could fully replicate the woman's power and transform it into one of the Domain Dao Rules, he would break through to the Minor Achievement of the Establishing Dao Realm.
The woman bound the two True Dragons, her sluggish and clumsy demeanor, as she scrutinized the True Dragons, also extended her probing to the Domain.
Outside of the Domain, within the Chaos, suddenly two figures emerged.
"People from the Imperishable Temple."
Xu Yan looked at the two individuals, recognizing them immediately as coming from the Imperishable Temple.
"How can there be a Domain here?"
"She's inside the Domain!"
The two people from the Imperishable Temple wore faces of surprise and soon spotted the woman they had been pursuing.
"Came to kill the woman?"
Xu Yan was taken aback.
Whoosh!
The two from the Imperishable Temple instantly entered the Domain, surrounding the woman from the left and right.
At this moment, the woman's delicate eyebrows furrowed, "Are you really not going to give up the chase?"
The two from the Imperishable Temple did not answer and attacked straight away, their hands unleashing dark grey energies sweeping forward, gray whips appearing, entwining towards the woman.
Pure and flawless, the woman contrasted sharply against the people of the Imperishable Temple who wielded Grey Dark Energy, like pollution overwhelming a beautiful piece of jade.
Hum!
A bright white light radiated from the woman's body, and in her hands appeared a slender blade, thin as a willow leaf. She discarded the two True Dragons and turned to attack the two from the Imperishable Temple.
The two True Dragons burrowed into the earth and disappeared. Inside the Domain, the woman and the two from the Imperishable Temple joined in battle. As the fight intensified, her eyes, carved like jade, shone with an increasingly dense silvery-white brilliance, casting light over the battlefield.
The Grey Dark Energy began to dissolve, but occasionally, the woman's silver-white luminosity dimmed. The fight grew more fierce, and as it continued, the woman seemed to be on the verge of falling into a disadvantage.
Xu Yan was overjoyed. The Way of Domain was replicating the battle, analyzing the powers of both sides—an exceptional opportunity to further understand the Path of Cultivation of the Imperishable Temple.
"She's not their match."
Xu Yan watched the woman being overpowered, the silver-white radiance in her eyes dimming, and amidst the battle, everything seemed to become sluggish and dull.
It wouldn't be long now until she was defeated.
And the two from the Imperishable Temple seemed to have no intention of killing the woman, only seeking to capture her.
"Enemies of the Imperishable Temple may not necessarily become friends, but to vex the Imperishable Temple and thwart their schemes would be a pleasure."
Xu Yan smiled slightly, standing up. As he stood, the battling parties both noticed him.
"You!"
The two from the Imperishable Temple changed their expressions, surprised to see Xu Yan.
A being of the Domain?
The emergence of a Domain here was abnormal enough, but now there was a Domain creature with prowess that seemed formidable.
"I am Xu Yan, and I shall send the two of you from the Imperishable Temple to your deaths!"
Xu Yan's smile shone brilliantly.
The expressions of the two from the Imperishable Temple changed, preparing to disengage from the woman to deal with the threat from Xu Yan, but suddenly, the Domain disappeared.
What remained was the fierce Sword Intent, enveloping them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1070 - 553: Unexpected Reward, Establishing Dao Minor Achievement
chapters.content:
Domain vanished, revealing the ancient appearance of the great mountains. The woman slightly tilted her head, looking at Xu Yan with a thoughtful expression. Her slow and clumsy manner gave her a naive and endearing vibe.
The two from the Imperishable Temple, however, were shocked.
The Domain had disappeared, but not truly vanished; it had transformed into terrifying Sword Intent that enveloped the two of them.
At this moment, they felt as if they were in a fiercely lethal Sword Domain.
The Domain wasn't large, just big enough to cover the two of them, but it was incredibly fierce, with an aura of death enveloping them.
Ah!
With a loud roar, the two from the Imperishable Temple immediately used a secret technique. A strong aura surged, and two ferocious faces appeared, opening their huge mouths as if they wanted to devour and annihilate the Sword Intent enveloping them.
Puff!
Xu Yan raised his hand and with a thunderous sound, the powerful Sword Intent wiped out everything. Despite the two men's desperate resistance, they couldn't change their fate of turning to ash.
The battle was over in just a moment.
The two Realm Master Level powerhouses from the Imperishable Temple turned to ash and dissipated.
The Sword Intent had disappeared, but the aura of annihilation still lingered where the two had perished. The great mountains were turning into sand-like substance and dissipating into the Chaos, as if undergoing annihilation.
After killing the people from the Imperishable Temple, Xu Yan looked towards the woman.
Now, the woman had returned to her usual appearance. Her pupils were pitch-black and bright, attentively examining him, her face slowly revealing a curious expression.
Apart from fighting, every action, every gesture, and the expressions on the woman's face all seemed slow and clumsy, adorably naïve in a baffling way.
"My name is Xu Yan; how may I address the lady?"
Xu Yan revealed a warm smile.
"Xu Yan?"
The woman slightly tilted her head, seemingly pondering, "I am called... Ming Yu."
"So, you are Miss Ming Yu. Meeting here in the vast Land of Imperishable is also a kind of fate," Xu Yan said with a smile.
Ming Yu, with her slow demeanor, pondered, "Fate?"
She seemed to be contemplating what the word "fate" meant, and after a long pause, continued, "If meeting is fate, can you protect me, escort me part of the way?"
Ming Yu's slow manner was extremely weird—it didn't seem normal, but she also didn't appear foolish, exuding a kind of inexplicable strangeness that intensely piqued Xu Yan's curiosity about her identity.
"Fate has its considerations; escorting you some way isn't a problem, but our current connection isn't enough for a long journey. We'll need to add a bit more value to our fate, such as a reward," Xu Yan said with a smile.
Though curious about Ming Yu, since she suggested it, escorting her some way certainly wasn't a problem. Perhaps he might figure out exactly who—or what—she was.
Moreover, Ming Yu's enemies were from the Imperishable Temple. Disrupting their plans and annoying them was something Xu Yan was quite happy to do.
But he couldn't just agree outright; he had to get something from Ming Yu, perhaps a surprising gain.
Ming Yu blinked, her slow thoughts seemingly processing Xu Yan's words.
After a long while, Ming Yu seemed to understand.
"A reward? Sure, but what kind of reward do you need?"
Xu Yan, secretly delighted, still smiled and said, "Ordinary things are of no use to me. Something special, beneficial to Domain, or even rare plants, can be a reward."
In the Land of Imperishable, every plant was precious, their value higher than Divine Medicine, and some even contained attributes of deceased True Spirits.
Ming Yu was thinking again, taking a long time to contemplate what kind of reward would be appropriate.
Xu Yan was puzzled why Ming Yu was extremely agile in combat, not needing to think between offense and defense without any slowness, but why simple communication appeared so slow?
"I don't have much in the way of rewards."
Ming Yu finally spoke, "I don't know what you like, but if it's a plant, I have one. I don't know if you'd like it."
"Why not let me see it?"
"Okay!"
Ming Yu nodded.
She reached into the sleeve of her left hand, pulling something out.
Unable to suppress his curiosity, Xu Yan asked, "Excuse me for asking, Miss Ming Yu, but are you human?"
Ming Yu paused her hand, blinking at Xu Yan, with a naive and confused look, "Human?"
Her mind seemed to freeze, deep in thought.
The corners of Xu Yan's mouth involuntarily twitched. Ming Yu was too odd, seemingly not very intelligent, or perhaps slightly eccentric.
"Oh, you mean human? I am human!"
After a long ponder, Ming Yu finally showed a look of realization as if she had finally understood what Xu Yan meant by "human," and nodded solemnly to affirm that she was indeed human.
After a pause, Ming Yu added, "I am a woman!"
Xu Yan couldn't help but say, "I am a man!"
Ming Yu blinked, staring at him for a long while, as if her mind was slow on the uptake again.
"So you are a man, nice to meet you!"
Ming Yu revealed a sweet smile.
Xu Yan:...
"This is my reward; do you like it?"
Ming Yu pulled her hand out of her sleeve, holding a vibrant green bamboo, about three feet long, rich with the aura of life, misting around the bamboo. As soon as she brought it out, the area within several feet freshened up, and the violent Spiritual Energy calmed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1071 - 553: Unexpected Reward, Establishing Dao Minor Achievement_2
chapters.content:
Xu Yan looked at the bamboo in Ming Yu's hand, his eyes widened in astonishment, and his gaze toward her slightly changed.
The bamboo in Ming Yu's hand was all too familiar to Xu Yan; he had planted one in the Domain, which he had dug up from the Seductive Witch, the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo.
What astonished Xu Yan was that the bamboo in Ming Yu's hand was of a higher grade compared to the one he had planted in the Domain—it seemed to be a fully grown Qing Ling Jade Bamboo, not a young shoot.
However, the bamboo Ming Yu held was just a section, not the whole plant.
The source of Qing Ling Jade Bamboo was the Master of the Qing Ling Realm; whether it was the young shoots obtained by the Seductive Witch, they all came from the Master of the Qing Ling Realm.
Xu Yan reached out to take the bamboo from Ming Yu's hand, examined it carefully for a moment, and was almost certain that this piece of bamboo came from the main body of the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo!
"Where did you get this bamboo?" Xu Yan couldn't help but ask.
Of the Seven Great Domain Masters, only Netherworld was known to be alive, while the weakest among them, the Master of the Qing Ling Realm, had likely long since perished.
Could this piece of bamboo be her remains?
"It came from my home," Ming Yu replied.
"Do you have one of these bamboos planted at your home?" Xu Yan asked curiously.
Could it be, besides the Master of the Qing Ling Realm, there existed a second Qing Ling Jade Bamboo in the Land of Imperishable?
"Not really sure," Ming Yu shook her head.
"Alright, I'll accept this bamboo as payment for escorting you!"
Determined, Xu Yan decided to visit Ming Yu's home to explore the origins of the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo.
"Thank you very much!" Ming Yu was overjoyed.
"Since that's settled, shall we set off now?" Xu Yan pondered for a moment, then waved his hand and a Flying Boat appeared.
Since he was escorting Ming Yu, traveling by Flying Boat was the wisest decision; this Flying Boat was naturally refined by Fang Hao to wander through the Land of Imperishable.
"What's this?" Ming Yu blinked, staring at the Flying Boat for a long while.
"A Flying Boat, a means of transportation," Xu Yan did not explain too much.
He boarded the Flying Boat and said, "Miss Ming Yu, come aboard."
"Alright!" Ming Yu nodded, and after boarding the Flying Boat, her bright eyes slowly filled with curiosity as she carefully examined the Flying Boat.
"Miss Ming Yu, where should we head?" Xu Yan asked.
"From here, go in this direction," Ming Yu pointed in a certain direction.
"Alright!" Xu Yan nodded, and the Flying Boat sped off in the direction Ming Yu had indicated.
...
Somewhere in the Land of Imperishable, Netherworld sat cross-legged atop a mountain, which served as his station to prevent the strong from Yu Ting from crossing this area and approaching Taicang.
At a certain moment, a palm-sized, dark gray bird flew swiftly toward the mountain, arriving in an instant.
"What's the matter?" Netherworld glanced at the small bird and asked in a deep voice.
This was a Communication True Spirit from the Imperishable Temple; each Master of Heaven and Earth level had one for messaging. These spirits were not particularly strong but were incredibly fast and small, making them hard to detect when flying through Chaos.
"From someone in Yu Ting, the presence of Qing Ling Jade Bamboo was detected; they were trying to kill her but seemed to have failed. Keep an eye out," the bird spoke.
"The presence of Qing Ling Jade Bamboo?" Netherworld frowned, "Are you certain?"
"Certain!"
"I understand," Netherworld took a deep breath.
"Capture alive."
After saying that, the bird flapped its wings and flew away, instantly disappearing into the vast expanse of the Land of Imperishable.
Netherworld's gaze was directed towards the vast Land of Imperishable, his expression calm, yet his eyes revealed a complex emotion.
After a long while, he raised his hand, and strands of the Dao Principles of Domain emerged, a breath rippled out, and immediately disappeared into the vast Land of Imperishable.
Netherworld squinted his eyes slightly, seemingly sensing something.
"I have gained nothing!"
After a long while, Netherworld appeared thoughtful.
"Is Qing Yu still alive? If she is, why can't I sense her?"
The Witch was still alive but severely wounded, with strong beings from the Imperishable Temple chasing her. With the Witch's abilities, she could avoid their senses, severing some special connections between the Seven Great Domain Masters.
But, not Qing Yu!
She lacked the strength to do so, unable to evade his detection.
However, when he used the connection between the Seven Great Domain Masters, he again came up with nothing.
"Is it because the distance is too great, or has Qing Yu now acquired the ability to sever the special connection of the Seven Great Domain Masters to avoid my detection?"
Netherworld's brows furrowed.
In his mind, unbidden, emerged the image of that graceful figure in a blue-green gown, her beauty unmatched, complicating his emotions further.
"How could Qing Yu have survived?"
Netherworld was puzzled. Among the seven, Qing Yu was the weakest. Although she had great vitality, excelling in healing wounds and could reduce fatal injuries, it was still unlikely for her to survive a fierce battle.
Moreover, as Qing Yu's true form was the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo, which possessed limitless vitality making her the most vital among the Seven Great Domains, the Unchanging Divine Master would definitely not let her escape.
"Was it the people of Yu Ting who rescued her?"
Since the aura of Qing Ling Jade Bamboo appeared on the Jade Person of Yu Ting, it was probably not unrelated to Yu Ting.
"Or did Taicang send her away from the battlefield?"
Netherworld's expression grew even more complex, and involuntarily, the imposing figure surfaced again in his mind. Netherworld never submitted to anyone, not even the Unchanging Divine Master, whose strength he acknowledged but did not respect.
Only Taicang he truly respected!
"Ah!"
A long sigh.
The Flying Boat flew at high speed over the Land of Imperishable. After some time interacting, Xu Yan gained a deeper understanding of Ming Yu. Although this girl seemed slow and clumsy, she was actually quite clever.
Xu Yan found an opportunity to discuss Martial Arts with Ming Yu, to his surprise, she had quite an insight and managed to understand about fifty to sixty percent of what he explained about Martial Arts.
This was more talented than any other Minor Heaven and Earth Master.
As they interacted, Xu Yan also gained a more direct understanding of Ming Yu's power. The Way of the Domain was giving birth to new Dao Principles, stemming from copying Ming Yu's power.
The opportunity to break through to Minor Achievement in Establishing Dao Realm was coming soon.
"Flying Boats are so much fun!"
Ming Yu, controlling the Flying Boat, smiled happily.
"Then you control the Flying Boat, I need to organize my own Martial Arts," Xu Yan said with a smile.
"Okay, okay, I won't disturb you!"
Ming Yu nodded her head.
"If there's an attack, I'll take action. If you're in danger, you can also call me."
Xu Yan instructed her, then he retired to a secret chamber in the Flying Boat to prepare for the breakthrough to Minor Achievement in Establishing Dao Realm.
Ming Yu, holding the Array Plate, her eyes filled with curiosity, her pupils gradually turning jade white, a faint silvery-white radiance emerged and shone upon the Array Plate.
The patterns of the Formation on the Array Plate gradually appeared in her eyes, profound and complex, then suddenly, the silvery-white glow in Ming Yu's eyes seemed to freeze.
Her jade-white eyes returned to pitch-black pupils, but her mind seemed to have crashed, unable to recover for a long time, standing there blankly.
"Facing the unfamiliar, without explanation, and the complex, impossible to understand, leading to slow thinking or even a halt in thought, this is not just a lack of Spiritual Wisdom or a problem with the mind," Xu Yan mused.
Ming Yu had tried to understand the Array Plate more than once, but every time, because of the profound Formation patterns, her thoughts would stall and it would take a long time to recover.
"Maybe I should know what she really is."
Xu Yan had a guess in his mind.
Holding the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo in his hand, laying across his knees, sensing the unique Spiritual Charm of Qing Ling Jade Bamboo, his mind was clear and serene, making the organization of his Martial Arts clearer.
The Way of the Domain was evolving and enhancing, and his own Dao was becoming clearer, the Minor Achievement in Establishing Dao Realm was right in front of him.
As time passed, Ming Yu once again fell into a thought halt while exploring the patterns of the Array Plate, while Xu Yan's aura gradually strengthened, and at a certain moment, it seemed as if he had crossed a threshold.
Minor Achievement in Establishing Dao Realm.
"I've broken through, with my current strength, I am invincible among the Minor Heaven and Earth Masters, and can even contend with the weaker Masters of Heaven and Earth," Xu Yan was overjoyed. Being able to break through to Minor Achievement in Establishing Dao Realm in such a short time, he had Ming Yu to thank.
"Great Achievement in Establishing Dao Realm, then I can face the Masters of Heaven and Earth without fear, Perfection of the Way, although not as powerful as the original Taicang, won't be far behind!"
Xu Yan was thrilled, the goal he had set for himself, to stand shoulder to shoulder with Taicang, was now not far off.

chapters.title: Chapter 1072 - 554: Exchange, Encounter the Netherworld
chapters.content:
"Ming Yu, the formation within the Array Plate is so mysterious and profound. Without my explanation, you won't understand it. If you're interested, how about we make an exchange?"
Xu Yan held the Array Plate and smiled at Ming Yu as she came back from her trance.
"An exchange?"
Ming Yu pondered, "How do we exchange? What do we exchange with?"
"I will explain the formations in the Array Plate to you, and you explain your own Principles to me. How does that sound?"
Xu Yan felt that obtaining the Principles from Ming Yu could greatly assist him in achieving the Great Achievement of Establishing the Path.
Ming Yu's power was extremely special; she herself was a unique entity.
"My Principles?"
Ming Yu fell deep into thought, apparently weighing the pros and cons, and took a long time to respond, seemingly stuck in her thoughts.
Xu Yan was not in a hurry and quietly waited for Ming Yu to gather her thoughts.
"We can try!"
Ming Yu nodded her head in agreement.
"Then let's begin."
Xu Yan was overjoyed.
With a wave of his hand, he took out two pieces of paper. These were no ordinary papers but papers that could bear the depiction of Principles.
Xu Yan drew several formation patterns on one of the papers and said, "This is one component of a formation."
He indicated for Ming Yu to also draw a part of her own Principles.
Silver-white radiance flickered in Ming Yu's eyes. She raised a hand and on the other piece of paper, drew several patterns of the Principles. Xu Yan recognized at a glance that these belonged to one of the Principles within her.
If he could have Ming Yu transfer all of her Principles onto paper, he could confirm whether his guess was correct.
In the ensuing journey, Xu Yan drew and explained part of the formation patterns to Ming Yu, and she also drew parts of her own Principles and explained them to Xu Yan.
Back and forth they went, and the papers now bore a complete formation.
Xu Yan handed the formation paper to Ming Yu, and the paper with Ming Yu's drawn Principles, he took for himself before taking out two more papers and they continued their exchange.
The Formation within the Array Plate was not a simple single formation, and it included numerous complicated patterns. Using just two or three formation patterns for Ming Yu's entire set of Principles was extremely worthwhile.
"Let's continue. This formation is more central and relatively more complex."
Xu Yan took out two more papers while smiling.
Ming Yu blinked, staring at him for a long while, as if mulling over something.
"I feel like I'm at a loss."
Xu Yan grinned brightly, "How could that be, Miss Ming Yu? You are the one who benefits. A normal exchange would be one formation for one full set of Principles, which would be fair. But I used three formations to only exchange for a part of your Principles; you have gained more either way."
Ming Yu sank into thought again.
Xu Yan took out several treasures and placed one in front of Ming Yu, saying, "Look, let me explain this to you."
He placed one of the treasures in front of Ming Yu, "Under normal circumstances, if I gave you one treasure, you should give me one as well, but you have only given me a part."
Speaking, he broke off a piece from the treasure in front of Ming Yu and placed it before himself, then took another treasure and placed it in front of her.
"Here, I give you another treasure, and you only exchange a part of it."
He broke off another part from Ming Yu's treasure, put it before himself and continued, "See, you already got two full treasures from me, while I only received a part of your treasure. Isn't it true that you benefited?"
Ming Yu blinked, looking at the two complete treasures in front of her and the incomplete ones in front of Xu Yan.
Indeed, she had gained.
"Why would you let me profit?"
Ming Yu didn't understand.
"Meeting is fate. I, Xu Yan, value sincere friendships. I know relatively more about formations, so it's right for me to let you benefit since we are friends."
Xu Yan spoke earnestly.
"Friends?!"
Ming Yu smiled, "Thank you, Xu Yan. You are truly a friend worth cherishing!"
"So, shall we continue?"
Xu Yan said with a smile.
"Yes, let's continue!"
Ming Yu nodded.
Then, they continued to exchange.
Eventually, Xu Yan used five formations from within the Array Plate to exchange for he Principles on Ming Yu, though Xu Yan was a bit surprised to find that Ming Yu's Principles seemed incomplete.
"Ming Yu, did you miss any Principles?"
"No, I've drawn all the Principles I possess for you."
Ming Yu raised her hand and gestured from her neck downwards, indicating that she had completed drawing all her Principles.
Xu Yan looked towards Ming Yu's head.
He finally understood why it was incomplete.
"What about the Principles on your head?"
Xu Yan pointed to his head and asked.
"Head?"
Ming Yu fell into thought again, "How do I draw that?"
Xu Yan paused, then suggested, "It's simple, just depict it with Divine Soul."
"Divine Soul?"
Ming Yu blinked, seemingly lost in thought again. Xu Yan observed her eyes gradually turning jade white, her dark pupils disappearing as silver-white radiance wafted through them.
"What's happening?"
Xu Yan was startled as Ming Yu seemed to fall into some kind of chaotic state. He didn't understand why the mention of Divine Soul had triggered this.
"Something's amiss!"
Xu Yan frowned, activated the Minor Heavenly Eye, but still, what he saw was just pure and flawless brightness, unable to discern the root cause.
"Ming Yu?"
Xu Yan called out.
Ming Yu seemed mentally stuck, not responding for a long while. Just as Xu Yan was pondering whether to intervene, Ming Yu finally spoke.
"Bamboo!"
Xu Yan took out the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo and placed it into Ming Yu's hands. The Jade Bamboo radiated vigorous vitality and mysterious patterns emerged on it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1073 - 554: Exchange, Encounter in the Netherworld_2
chapters.content:
It was the Heaven and Earth Laws, the violently imperishable qi turned gentle after being absorbed by the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo, making the life energy of the bamboo even more vibrant.
A faint azure light wafted up from the bamboo, illuminating Ming Yu, who now seemed to possess a bit more vitality, a bit more of a living person's appearance.
Seated cross-legged atop a mountain, Netherworld abruptly opened his eyes and turned his gaze toward a certain place.
"The aura of Qing Ling Jade Bamboo."
His figure moved, vanishing in an instant.
Xu Yan looked at Ming Yu, who held the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo in her hand and was recovering from a state of spiritual chaos, and grew pensive.
Under the rich life energy of the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo, Ming Yu seemed to "come alive," even though she was already a living person, but for some reason, at this moment, she appeared even more so.
It seemed that the previous Ming Yu was not truly alive in the full sense.
Xu Yan's curiosity intensified, finding Ming Yu to be exceedingly strange, and her descent into chaos was due to the mention of the Divine Soul—Ming Yu had pondered the meaning of the Divine Soul and thus fell into such confusion.
And the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo could help her recover from this chaos.
Perhaps this was why Ming Yu always carried the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo with her.
Ming Yu blinked, nearly back to her usual self. Xu Yan thought for a moment and then said, "Miss Ming Yu, use the power of your Divine Soul to depict your own principles or examine your own Divine Soul to portray the principles within it."
"Divine Soul?"
Ming Yu fell into thought but seemed to get stuck again; the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo in her hand once again exuded a rich life energy and a faint azure gleam.
Xu Yan observed Ming Yu's current state, and after a long while, with the aid of the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo, she gradually recovered, blinking, seemingly having forgotten what Xu Yan had just said.
"This is the Divine Soul, Ming Yu, separate a thread of your Divine Soul and imprint it on paper, and the Principle will form naturally."
This time, not only did Xu Yan mention the Divine Soul, he also separated a thread of Primordial Spirit and imprinted it on a piece of paper. In an instant, the paper seemed to come alive with the silhouette of a person upon it.
Moreover, the Divine Soul on the paper began to speak, "Just like this."
Ming Yu looked at Xu Yan's Primordial Spirit, blinked her eyes, and her pitch-black pupils gradually turned jade white. A silver-white radiance emerged.
Above her head, a fluctuation similar to the Divine Soul appeared, "Divine Soul?"
Ming Yu murmured but then she got stuck again, this time as if her brain had completely crashed, unable to recover even under the envelopment of the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo's life energy for a long time.
It seemed that Ming Yu's mind, because of pondering the Divine Soul or wanting to imitate Xu Yan and separate a thread of her Divine Soul, had ended up in an incomprehensible state, her thoughts trapped in a dead end, unable to escape.
"Ming Yu?"
Xu Yan softly called out, but Ming Yu showed no response, and he saw that in her now jade white eyes, that silver-white light was swirling as if dazed.
"Could it really be as I suspect?"
Xu Yan was somewhat surprised.
Ming Yu's current condition did not seem like that of someone with normal spiritual wisdom, and it was increasingly aligning with his speculation.
"Couldn't she possibly recover?"
Xu Yan looked at Ming Yu's eyes with the silver-white radiance still circling, as if her thoughts had come to a complete halt, unable to sort themselves out or find a way through.
Even with the help of the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo, it seemed to be of little use.
"If she truly can't recover, this will be troublesome."
Xu Yan scratched his head, wondering how he was supposed to escort her back without even knowing the destination.
If he couldn't return Ming Yu, he wouldn't be able to investigate the source of the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo.
"Let's wait a bit longer, if she truly can't recover, I'll have to try something."
Xu Yan mumbled to himself.
If all else failed, he would have to try actively awakening Ming Yu himself.
Suddenly, Xu Yan's expression changed, and he looked up at a certain place, as a figure approached rapidly.
Master of Domain!
Xu Yan moved swiftly, immediately stowing away the Flying Boat and with a wave of his hand, his power enveloped Ming Yu and they instantly distanced themselves from the other party.
"Hm?"
Netherworld looked stunned, "Who are you?"
His gaze landed on the piece of bamboo in Ming Yu's hand, a familiar aura emanating from it—this was the original bamboo of Qing Yu!
"Yu Ting?"
Upon another glance at Ming Yu, Netherworld's brows furrowed slightly—could it be that Qing Yu was really rescued by someone from Yu Ting back then?
Or perhaps, the remains were obtained by Yu Ting?
"Who might you be?"
Xu Yan faced him with a look of caution, yet he was not at all afraid.
He had some guesses in mind.
"Divine Temple, Xue Yu Protector!"
Netherworld spoke in a cold voice.
"Which one from the Taicang Domain are you?"
As a being born of the Domain and not from Yu Ting, Xu Yan was with people from Yu Ting at this moment, which led Netherworld to wonder if the Taicang Domain had already formed some sort of alliance with Yu Ting?
Or could it be that the Taicang Domain sought refuge with Yu Ting to gain their protection against the Imperishable Temple?
"If the Taicang Domain has sought refuge with Yu Ting, why is there no news of it?"
Netherworld was puzzled.
With the capabilities of the Imperishable Temple, if a powerful entity from Yu Ting approached the Taicang Domain, they would most certainly notice; sidestepping the Imperishable Temple to subdue the Taicang Domain in secret seemed highly unlikely.
"Taicang is dead, no more is there a Taicang Domain in this world, I am the Great Wilderness Sword God, Xu Yan!"
Xu Yan stated calmly.
In such circumstances, to encounter Netherworld, one of the former Seven Great Domain Masters!
"The Great Wilderness?"
Netherworld frowned, the Taicang Domain had changed its name? Could it be that a new Domain Master had emerged?
"Taicang or the Great Wilderness, leave her behind, and I'll pretend I haven't seen you!"
Netherworld pointed at Ming Yu as he spoke.
Xu Yan smiled faintly, "Although you are a Domain Master, thinking you can keep me is overly confident. I, Xu Yan, am never threatened by anyone, not even you, Netherworld.
Netherworld laughed, "So arrogant! When did the Taicang Domain produce such a presumptuous youngster, more arrogant even than Xiaoyao from the past."
"I, Xu Yan, am never arrogant, I speak only through my own strength."
Xu Yan maintained his distance from Netherworld, making it so that Netherworld couldn't get close, nor did he immediately escape.
"Speaking through strength? Then let me weigh up the power of this junior!"
With a light laugh, Netherworld raised his hand to reach out.
Swoosh!
In an instant, a torrent of blood burst forth in the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, as if a blood-colored purgatory had descended, turning a nearby mountain into dust on the spot.
The Blood-colored Purgatory nearly sealed all of Xu Yan's escape routes in the blink of an eye; once completely sealed, Xu Yan would be trapped within his Xue Yu.
Swoosh!
Xu Yan's eyebrows raised; Netherworld, one of the Seven Great Domain Masters, possessed strength far surpassing that of other Domain Masters like Muxiao.
With a simple handgesture, he appeared to turn this entire Land of Imperishable into a purgatory; within this purgatory, life and death were entirely under his control—unless the purgatory were broken.
Xu Yan felt that with his current strength, he could not break the Blood-colored Purgatory unless he achieved Great Accomplishment in his Establishing Dao Realm; only then, if trapped, could he escape by using his master's Jade Talisman.
However, as swift as Netherworld's attack was, and the sudden emergence of the Blood-colored Purgatory, to turn the whole Land of Chaotic Imperishable into a Blood-colored Purgatory was not something that could be completed in a single thought.
For other Minor Heaven and Earth Masters, seizing this fleeting moment to escape from the Blood-colored Purgatory would be impossible, but for Xu Yan, it was not a great difficulty.
Therefore, in the instant the Blood-colored Purgatory was about to seal, Xu Yan vanished from the spot and escaped through the gap before it was completely closed off.
Netherworld was taken aback, "Such a swift movement technique. No wonder you are so confident!"
With a step forward and a press of his hand, the Blood-colored Purgatory turned into a streak of blood-light chasing after Xu Yan. Before it could reach him, the blood-light transformed into countless threads, like a spider's web, aiming to bind Xu Yan.
Swoosh!
Only an afterimage remained, while Xu Yan once again dangerously dodged through the gaps between the threads.
"A superb movement technique. With it, the Minor Heaven and Earth Master is almost invincible."
Netherworld sighed, yet he remained unhurried as he stepped out and pointed again, with a hum, blood-lights illuminated all around.
