Xu Yan was surrounded by the blood-lights that grew brighter and brighter, with the glow reflecting from all directions. As the blood-lights connected, leaving not a single gap.
"Let's see how you escape this time!"
Netherworld spoke with a nonchalant expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 1074 - 555: Shock in the Netherworld, Exchange of Intelligence
chapters.content:
"You may be a Master of Domain, but your power is too dispersed and far-flung, much too weak. Other Minor Heaven and Earth Masters might be trapped by you, but you can't trap me."
"With my sword, creating an opening is more than sufficient."
Xu Yan was not flustered at all. In an instant, he appeared in front of the approaching blood light, and the Heaven-defying Sword Intent emerged with him.
Divine Skills, Heaven-defying Sword!
With a single slash, the blood light, like a layer of blood film, was instantly cleaved open. Xu Yan seized the opportunity to escape as the light began to heal.
"How fierce, how overbearing that sword is!"
Muxiao became serious.
It was precisely because of the ferociousness of this sword, which also possessed an immensely powerful annihilating force, that it could create a fissure for escape through a tap.
In the Taicang Domain, there has never been such a powerful Sword Dao.
"No wonder you are so confident. You indeed have the right to be, as those worthless Domain Masters of the Divine Temple naturally can't do anything to you. Pity you've met me!"
Muxiao's expression grew a shade more serious.
"That same phrase, leave her, and I can pretend I never met you."
Xu Yan's expression was solemn. He dared not be careless, as after all, Muxiao was one of the Seven Great Domain Masters, an opener of worlds and a true Master of Domain.
Like Muxiao, those Masters of Domain from Imperishable Temple could be called False Masters of Heaven and Earth.
"You, Muxiao, have such strength. You alone could suppress your Taicang, which is mighty indeed. But you've lost. How powerful must the Lord of the Imperishable Temple be?"
Xu Yan sighed, but then chuckled lightly, "If it were Taicang, with my current strength, I'm afraid there would be no chance to escape. But you, Muxiao, are still lacking."
Muxiao's face darkened instantly, "If you insist on courting death, I can oblige you!"
"Hey, catch me if you can."
Xu Yan chuckled, wrapping Ming Yu and instantly disappeared from the spot.
Divine Skills, One Thought Traceless!
Muxiao's expression hardened, and he too disappeared instantly. Although Xu Yan had fled without a trace, leaving no clues, Muxiao, as a Master of Domain, was naturally able to pursue the direction in which Xu Yan had escaped.
Xu Yan, using the Vanishing Thought Divine Ability, fled into the Land of Imperishable. And behind him, Muxiao was closely pursuing him.
"Muxiao, I'm curious, how did you come to pledge allegiance to the Imperishable Temple, and why would they accept you, a Master of Domain?"
As Xu Yan fled, he inquired curiously.
Muxiao didn't answer, only his expression darkened further as his speed suddenly increased, a faint blood light swirling around him.
"You can't catch up with me."
Xu Yan seemed indifferent, his speed also suddenly increased, maintaining the distance beyond Muxiao's reach.
"That great battle back then, how did Taicang fall, how did you survive? Why would that figure from the Imperishable Temple shelter you?"
Xu Yan continued to ask.
Muxiao's speed increased even more, but he found that Xu Yan also accelerated, maintaining a safe interval between them.
It meant that Xu Yan hadn't used his full strength.
"I notice that the Qi of Heaven and Earth on you seems to have disappeared; you are no longer a pure Master of Domain. Have you depleted your Domain Qi, or was it taken from you?"
Xu Yan asked nonchalantly as he fled.
Muxiao's expression grew increasingly dark.
Suddenly, a burst of blood-colored light surged around Muxiao, his figure momentarily vanishing, and in the Land of Imperishable, slight ripples emerged from every direction. Fierce Spiritual Energy and Imperishable Qi seemed to solidify in an instant.
At the same time, Xu Yan's figure also disappeared from the spot and reappeared in another location, only to vanish again immediately, and a surge of Domain Power roiled through the Land of Imperishable.
Whoosh!
Fierce Spiritual Energy and Imperishable Qi transformed into a landscape of mountains and rivers within the Domain which were incomparably fierce, bursting with an intense Sword Light that lit up the Land of Imperishable.
That slight ripple, under the illumination of the Sword Light, slightly stalled for a moment!
When Muxiao and Xu Yan's figures reappeared, the distance between the two remained unchanged.
But now, the look they exchanged was laden with a few more degrees of solemnity.
"This isn't Taicang Martial Arts!"
Muxiao said gravely.
"I never said I practiced Taicang Martial Arts!"
Xu Yan smiled.
At that moment, Muxiao had nearly blocked all routes, making Xu Yan have to admit that Muxiao's strength was truly formidable.
This was the first individual who had almost made it impossible for him to escape.
Muxiao frowned continuously, an expression of puzzlement emerging in his eyes, "If it isn't Taicang Martial Arts, could it be..."
Suddenly, he paused, then shook his head, "Impossible, you can't cultivate it. Did Taicang leave some kind of contingency?"
At this moment, Muxiao realized that some unknown change must have occurred in the Taicang Domain, a change that had slipped beyond the control of the Imperishable Temple.
Because of this, Xu Yan emerged as such a monstrous figure.
Even though he was weaker, he could still escape despite Muxiao's repeated attacks, showing the depth and talent of his martial arts.
"Why do you think this is a contingency left by Taicang?"
Xu Yan smiled slightly, "Muxiao, you can't keep me here. Since we've met by chance, why not exchange information? I'll tell you about changes in the Taicang Domain, and you tell me secrets of The Imperishable Temple. Neither of us loses."

chapters.title: Chapter 1075 - 555 Shock in the Netherworld, Exchange of Intelligence_2
chapters.content:
Netherworld sneered, "What changes are there in the Taicang Domain? I will go there myself, and everything will be crystal clear. Why should I exchange information with you? And do you really think I can't handle you?"
"Netherworld, I know you have not used your full strength, but do you think I don't have any trump cards? Since I dare face you, I naturally have confidence. As for your personal visit to Taicang, do you dare?"
"Are you sure there is no one in Taicang who can suppress you?"
Xu Yan's smile was brilliant; encountering Netherworld was a good thing.
Moreover, looking at Netherworld's demeanor, it seemed that he was not wholly invested in the interests of the Imperishable Temple.
"Netherworld, perhaps you could gain some information that you desire, which might help you escape your current predicament, or even more advanced knowledge?"
"I, Xu Yan, have cultivated for less than a hundred years and have already achieved such strength. And I am confident that surpassing you, Netherworld, is not a difficult task."
"Think it over. An information exchange between us will be mutually beneficial, each getting what we need."
Xu Yan's body glimmered with a hazy light, revealing his true age.
Netherworld's expression was one of shock, filled with disbelief.
Xu Yan, less than a hundred years old? To have such strength after less than a century of cultivation was beyond monstrous. At this moment, Netherworld believed Xu Yan's claim of being able to surpass him!
Taking a deep breath, Netherworld came to a stop, not continuing the pursuit. It was unnecessary!
He believed that Xu Yan had the confidence, and most certainly the trump cards, to escape from him. Continuing the chase would only be a fruitless endeavor.
Xu Yan also stopped moving but kept a certain distance from Netherworld, ready to respond to any attack.
"Then let's exchange information. Is there a new Master of Domain in the Taicang Domain?"
Netherworld's voice was grave.
"As I said earlier, Taicang has become history. Now it is the Great Wilderness. There is no Master of Domain in the Great Wilderness, but there is Heavenly Dao!"
Xu Yan's answer was unexpected for Netherworld. At that moment, he seriously considered the possibility that Taicang had indeed become history. Although the Domain remained the same, it was no longer the Taicang Domain.
From Xu Yan's answer, Netherworld sensed an issue: the Great Wilderness had no Master of Domain, but it did have Heavenly Dao!
What is Heavenly Dao?
"What is Heavenly Dao? What exactly do you mean by Heavenly Dao?"
Netherworld asked solemnly, a sense of intuition telling him that Heavenly Dao was extremely important, fundamentally changing the existence of the Domain, turning Taicang into history, and ushering in a new Domain.
"It's your turn to answer my question."
Xu Yan did not address the issue of Heavenly Dao but instead replied with a smile.
"Speak!"
Netherworld inhaled deeply. Although Xu Yan's strength was less than his, significantly less, at this moment, Netherworld could not afford to underestimate him, and he certainly didn't act with the arrogance of a Master of Domain.
"Where is the Imperishable Temple?"
Xu Yan pondered before asking.
"The Imperishable Temple has no fixed location; it always wanders the Land of Imperishable, and now it is slowly approaching the... Great Wilderness Domain,"
Netherworld said somberly.
Xu Yan nodded, "When will the Imperishable Temple come close to the Great Wilderness to make a move?"
"It will not approach the Great Wilderness for the time being; it needs to wait for the right moment. Only when the time comes will it make a move on the Great Wilderness. As for when that will be, I am not very certain."
Netherworld did not conceal the truth. After answering, he asked, "Muxiao used True Spirits to enter the Great Wilderness Domain, to enhance the Qi of Heaven and Earth in the Great Wilderness. Has Muxiao failed?"
At this moment, Netherworld suddenly recalled that Muxiao's premature action against the Great Wilderness was to control the Domain and enhance its Qi, as well as to lay preparations for absorbing the Domain in the next Era.
Since Xu Yan had appeared here and possessed such remarkable strength, and since the "Heavenly Dao" had emerged in the Great Wilderness, it was highly likely that Muxiao had failed.
Netherworld then thought of the Witch Demon Domain which had collided with the Great Wilderness. Could it be that it failed to cause any damage to the Great Wilderness?
Was there more to the story?
"Witch Demon Domain collided with the Great Wilderness, didn't it cause any turmoil? Is there more to the story?"
"You're asking two questions now."
Xu Yan said with a smile, "Muxiao certainly failed, but he didn't die. As for the Witch Demon Domain, it has merged with the Great Wilderness, becoming the Yin Realm of the Great Wilderness. The Seductive Witch and her ilk are now part of the Great Wilderness."
At this moment, the Netherworld became even more curious about the changes in the Taicang Domain.
Yin Realm?
What was this, and what kind of changes had the Taicang Domain undergone since becoming part of the Great Wilderness?
Muxiao indeed failed, but why didn't he die?
"What is the Yin Realm?"
The Netherworld asked impatiently.
"It is my turn to ask now."
Xu Yan's smile was radiant.
"Ask away!"
Though burning with curiosity, the Netherworld could only resigningly respond.
"How strong is the Unchanging Divine Master? Why were you accepted by the Imperishable Temple? I've heard that all living beings in the Domain are devoured by the Imperishable Temple."
Xu Yan asked curiously.
The Netherworld had been accepted, and he suspected that during the great battle, the Netherworld might have betrayed them. Perhaps it was his backstabbing that led to Taicang's defeat.
Since learning that the Netherworld was alive and had become a powerhouse of the Imperishable Temple, he wasn't the only one with this suspicion.
"I don't know."
The Netherworld shook his head, his expression grave, "I don't even know what he looks like specifically. As to how strong he is, I can't say, but I do know that it wouldn't be difficult for him to kill me."
He then sighed, a hint of helplessness in his demeanor, "You must have noticed, I am the Master of Domain, but the Qi of Heaven and Earth has disappeared."
"This is the price. My Qi of Heaven and Earth was completely extracted, and only then was I accepted by the Imperishable Temple. Someone must have interceded on my behalf for me to seek refuge with the Imperishable Temple."
Without waiting for Xu Yan to ask, he followed up with a self-mocking laugh, "You must suspect that during the great war, I betrayed Taicang, right?"
Xu Yan nodded, "I am not the only one with this doubt."
The Netherworld fell silent for a while, his expression tinged with sadness, "Taicang was undoubtedly a good elder brother. Everyone knows that he suppressed me, but I have never resented him. After all, the fault was mine. I, the Netherworld, am defiant, but I only submitted to Taicang."
"Being suppressed was actually because there were issues with my cultivation. My cultivation of the Blood Demon Path went awry, affecting my sanity."
"Taicang suppressed me to help me resolve this problem. Since then, my Blood Demon Path has truly been perfected, and I no longer have to worry about it affecting my reason."
Xu Yan was taken aback, not expecting there to be such a story behind the Netherworld's suppression.
Originally, the Netherworld faced suppression because his cultivation had gone wrong, which affected his sanity, and that's why he attacked the Master of the Qing Ling Realm, and why Taicang suppressed him—to help him solve the problem.
"Which of us six did not submit to Taicang? Witch Demon was even more arrogant and defiant than I was, but he wouldn't dare to show any disrespect before Taicang. Our paths of cultivation have all been guided by Taicang."
"I have wondered more than once why we were defeated in the end. Only recently have I realized that our defeat was deserved."
The Netherworld seemed touched by a deep-seated matter in his heart and began to speak without waiting for Xu Yan's inquiries.
"That battle back then was even more brutal than you could imagine."
The Netherworld recalled, "The battles involving Minor Heaven and Earth Masters were fierce, but it was really the fight among us six that determined victory. The number of Masters of Domain of the Imperishable Temple far exceeded the expectations of those Minor Heaven and Earth Masters, even though they are False Masters of Heaven and Earth..."
Xu Yan couldn't help but ask, "Why call them False Masters of Heaven and Earth?"
The Netherworld laughed and explained, "They do not have their own Domains, but they possess Dao Principles similar to those held by true Masters of Domain and have stepped into the same realm level. Isn't that what a False Master of Heaven and Earth is?"
"Actually, before us, the fighters of this power level at the Imperishable Temple were not defined that way. Instead, they were known as being at the Guardian Realm, meaning they had the strength to become protectors of the Imperishable Temple."
"Only after the appearance of us seven Masters of Domain did this level of power come to be defined as such, but since they haven't created their own Domains, they can also be called False Masters of Heaven and Earth."
"The Masters of Domain of the Imperishable Temple are weaker than us but stronger than the Minor Heaven and Earth Masters. Now, they should perhaps be called Realm Masters."
"Before the war with the Imperishable Temple, we had a period of interaction and mutual probing. This definition of realm strength emerged during that time."

chapters.title: Chapter 1076 - 556: The Battle at the Beginning, Learning of Yu Ting
chapters.content:
Xu Yan suddenly realized upon hearing the explanation of the Netherworld, that the definition of the Master of Domain came from this, and now, the Minor Heaven and Earth Master, also known as the Realm Master.
However, to distinguish, those who have opened a Minor Heaven now are called Minor Heaven and Earth Masters, while those who have not opened a Heaven but possess this strength and have stepped into this realm are called Realm Masters.
The Imperishable Temple does not have a Minor Heaven and Earth Master but only Realm Master Level powerhouses because no one in the Imperishable Temple has opened a Minor Heaven.
"Minor Heaven and Earth Master, whose essence is still the Principle, integrates the Heaven and Earth Laws into oneself, and as the Principle almost transforms into Dao Principles, that is the top powerhouse of the Minor Heaven and Earth Master."
"Master of Domain takes in Domain Dao Rule into oneself, whose essence is not Principle but Dao Principle. The initial path of Establishing Dao Realm isn't strong enough or perfect enough, so beginners and those at Minor Achievement in Establishing Dao Realm are stronger than Minor Heaven and Earth Master but weaker than Master of Domain.
"After the Great Achievement of Establishing the Path, the established path is almost perfect, thus possesses the strength of Master of Domain. As the inclusion of Dao Principles of Establishing Dao differs from that of the Master of Domain, Establishing Dao is stronger.
"Moreover, Establishing Dao is not the end, while the Master of Domain has yet to find the way forward."
Xu Yan understood it clearly in his heart.
The Netherworld sighed deeply, then continued, "The battle back then was extremely brutal; it was the first time we had fought so desperately in our lives. I took the Blood Demon Path to its extreme, Blood Refining two False Masters of Heaven and Earth. By this secret technique, my strength temporarily surged.
"Witch, Ao Hong, Hong Ze, even the usually gentle Qing Yu, also used powerful secret techniques. Qing Yu, not skilled in combat but in healing and reducing injuries, also killed a False Master of Heaven and Earth and held back three.
"The power of Taicang was unbelievable; we even suspected whether he had surpassed the realm above Master of Domain, but Taicang said he hadn't broken through yet.
"That was also the first time we saw the true strength of Taicang; no average False Master of Heaven and Earth could withstand three punches from him, even the top powerhouses among them were not much weaker than us, and were slain by Taicang in an extremely short time.
"We thought we could crush the Imperishable Temple effortlessly, scaring every False Master of Heaven and Earth there.
"Until the Unchanging Divine Master made his move, Taicang was already overwhelmed and fell into disadvantage right from the start.
"We knew it couldn't go on like this, so Witch and I, with all our might, even if it meant burning our origin, tried to get Hong Ze off the battlefield, so that he could return with the Domain to help us escape the predicament.
"By that point, it was not possible without giving it our all. I, Witch, and Ao Hong, were determined to join the great battle with our own Domains, even if burning them would not benefit the Imperishable Temple."
At this point, the Netherworld's eyes reddened, revealing how fierce that battle had been.
They were willing to perish with the entire Domain, even if they were defeated to not cheapen the Imperishable Temple.
Obviously, they had failed.
Hong Ze returned to the Domain, hadn't carried the Domain back and was annihilated.
Xu Yan recalled the scene described by the Azure Sea Turtle, feeling a bit puzzled. Since Hong Ze died by the hands of the Unchanging Divine Master, was Taicang unable to hold off the Unchanging Divine Master, allowing him the chance to break away from the battlefield and consume Hong Ze?
"Hong Ze never came back, and we were about to fall, until a shadow descended, and it all ended. I heard Taicang's roar.
"I saw Witch being blown away, his origin shattered, along with his Witch Demon Domain being wrecked. Ao Hong was nearly severed in two, I only heard Qing Yu cry out 'Brother Taicang', then silence.
"I was severely injured; I saw a hand grab my shoulder, throwing me out of the battlefield, but immediately a shadow enveloped everything, I wanted to give my all, but..."
The Netherworld paused for a long time, eventually ending with a helpless sigh.
"We lost, Taicang died, I don't know the details of his battle with the Unchanging Divine Master, but in the end, we were defeated."
Xu Yan was astounded; that battle had been even more brutal than what Azure Sea Turtle and Taihe had described.
"Hong Ze died, and was devoured when he returned to the Domain."
Xu Yan thought and then spoke.
The Netherworld nodded, "When Hong Ze didn't return, we knew. At the moment he fell, we all sensed it."
Xu Yan curiously asked, "How did you then end up joining the Imperishable Temple?"
The Netherworld laughed, "I've said too much, while you've said too little. Since we're exchanging information, why keep things hidden? I mean you no harm; after all, I still have some fondness for Taicang Domain."
Xu Yan nodded; from the beginning, the Netherworld only aimed to keep Ming Yu and Qing Ling Jade Bamboo and not target him, which showed some sentimentality.
"Great Wilderness divides Yin and Yang, Heavenly Dao has reincarnation, the Yin Realm is the destination for the souls of Great Wilderness, and the site of reincarnation."
The Netherworld froze, his eyes gradually widening, his breathing becoming somewhat heavier—after all, being a Master of Domain who had opened a Domain of his own.
With just Xu Yan's brief introduction, he grasped the incredible aspects involved.
"The destination for souls, Heavenly Dao reincarnation?"
The Netherworld was stunned; the changes in the Great Wilderness were unimaginable, completely beyond his expectations.

chapters.title: Chapter 1077 - 556: The Battle at the Beginning, Learning of Yu Ting_2
chapters.content:
"If the Heavenly Dao were powerful enough and if Reincarnation were perfected," Xu Yan continued, "even a strong being like yourself, upon perishing, could have your Divine Soul enter the cycle, be reborn, and experience a new life. If you possessed the Reincarnation Secret Art, you might even retain the memories of your past life and be reborn anew. However, the current Great Wilderness Heavenly Path is not capable of such a feat, and can only reincarnate weaker beings."
Xu Yan added.
He then smiled and said, "What do you think, is this information valuable enough for you? Whether you understand its implications is not something I should explain to you."
"I have always been curious; after the defeat, why didn't the Unchanging Divine Master directly devour the Taicang Domain?"
This had been a mystery all along, which even Taihe and his counterparts didn't understand. They only speculated that the Unchanging Divine Master might have also been heavily injured, and therefore had temporarily spared the Taicang Domain.
There were even guesses about the involvement of another force.
The Netherworld's face showed disbelief at the inexplicable changes in the Taicang Domain. Why would such a transformation occur?
No wonder it was said that Taicang was history.
The Great Wilderness Domain!
The Netherworld etched this name deeply into his memory. He had a premonition that the Unchanging Divine Master's scheme was likely to fail.
Dreams of devouring the Great Wilderness and extracting the Qi of Heaven and Earth from it were probably just wishful thinking.
Naturally, these pieces of information were not going to be reported to the Unchanging Divine Master; it was as if he knew nothing.
"The Unchanging Divine Master didn't devour Taicang because the timing wasn't right. He is waiting for the right moment, and that moment might come soon.
"He intends to swallow Taicang Domain when the Next Era begins, to extract everything from Taicang to achieve some purpose."
By now, there was no point in hiding any longer.
The Netherworld even hoped that the Imperishable Temple would fail, to give the Great Wilderness an early warning, which would also be a good thing.
"At the beginning of the Next Era?" Xu Yan asked, puzzled, "What do you mean?"
Since they had already discussed these secrets, the Netherworld saw no need to hide any further.
"I only recently learned of these secrets myself and realized that our defeat wasn't unjustified," the Netherworld said solemnly. "Since you come from Taicang, you should know about the opening of the Domain. Initially, in the Land of Imperishable, a purple light streaked across the Chaos, and Taicang led us to seize it. Besides using a portion to transform ourselves, the majority of the purple light was used in the Creation of the Domain.
"The counting of years in the Land of Imperishable is based on this light, starting from when this purple light emerged until the next light appears. The duration between them is known as one Primordial Era.
"When the next light moves across the Chaos, it will mark the beginning of the Next Era and the end of this one. The Unchanging Divine Master sparing the Taicang Domain might be in preparation for the onset of the Next Era, to consume and extract its essence to achieve some purposes."
Xu Yan showed a look of surprise, learning of such a secret. The purple light was not unique, but would appear periodically after certain ages, each time streaking across the Chaos.
"I understand now. The Seven Great Domains have existed for less than a Primordial Era, while the Imperishable Temple has existed for at least two Primordial Ages, so you feel that our defeat was justified.
"Even the Unchanging Divine Master might have received the Creation of the purple light, more than once."
The Seven Great Domains were a new force. Facing an ancient existence like the Imperishable Temple, with its profound background, indeed, the defeat wasn't unjustified.
The Netherworld nodded and added, "The next light might not necessarily be purple. According to the Unchanging Divine Master, each light is different in color, and I suspect each contains its own mysteries."
He sighed and continued, "How to obtain this light is also particular. Initially, Taicang passed on the Dharma to us, and I suspect the Unchanging Divine Master might not know how to attain it, but of course, that's only my guess.
"What the Unchanging Divine Master wants to do at the dawn of the Next Era, his purpose, or whether it's to break through his own limits, I don't know. He is very mysterious; I've never seen his true face."
Xu Yan nodded in realization, "So that's how it is!"
With a smile, the Netherworld said, "I've told you so much; it's your turn to share something."
"No problem."
Xu Yan chuckled and replied, "You might be interested in Reincarnation. I will explain it to you, albeit in a rudimentary way, for what I know is not much."
"Go ahead."
The Netherworld nodded in agreement.
Xu Yan briefly explained Reincarnation, and the two exchanged questions and doubts about certain issues.
"You seem to be avoiding, not wishing to answer how you came to join the Imperishable Temple," Xu Yan remarked.
At last, Xu Yan once again brought up the matter of seeking refuge in Netherworld.
Netherworld fell silent for a moment, then said, "When I was born, I had a twin brother. As I began to develop Spiritual Wisdom and roamed the Land of Imperishable, he had just started to come into his own wisdom. Back then, our strength was not formidable, but because we possessed Spiritual Wisdom, we knew how to set traps and avoid dangerous areas in advance.
"Once, when I was devouring True Spirit Blood, I suddenly got the inspiration to use True Spirit Blood to strengthen myself, and I began to ponder how to enhance myself with it.
"My brother and I spent quite some time on this and had some gains, but an accident happened. I was contaminated by the blood of a True Spirit; although my consciousness was clear, I appeared breathless on the surface, as if dead.
"For my rescue, my brother set out to collect True Spirit Blood. However, there was an accident. When he returned, he gave me a Purifying Blood Tree. He said he had encountered a being of immense power. He didn't want to be enslaved, he was going to escape, and he couldn't let that figure discover me.
"With that escape, my brother disappeared without a trace. You must have guessed, that being is the Unchanging Divine Master."
Netherworld's expression was incredibly complex.
"I originally thought the powerful being he mentioned was some terrifying True Spirit. After I recovered, I have been searching for my brother without any success, and later I encountered Taicang.
"It wasn't until the great battle with the Imperishable Temple that I learned he was an elder of the Imperishable Temple. He pleaded with the Unchanging Divine Master and saved my life."
Xu Yan fell silent. He knew who Netherworld's brother was.
Blood Demon!
The Netherworld Blood Demon Path was derived from the names of Netherworld and Blood Demon.
"The current situation of Blood Demon may not be good. I wonder if Blood Extreme has succeeded. If he has, Blood Extreme, a follower of Netherworld, has actually become Netherworld's brother?
"No, Netherworld must be going insane," Xu Yan muttered to himself.
Netherworld and Blood Demon clearly had deep feelings, and Blood Demon must have paid a great price to save Netherworld. This could be guessed from Netherworld's helpless and complex expression.
"So that's how it is!" Xu Yan nodded, not mentioning the matter of Blood Demon. As to whether Blood Demon would be replaced, that would depend on whether his fortune was profound enough.
"The Unchanging Divine Master is very powerful, very mysterious; I have never seen his true face. Even my brother, who is now an elder of the Imperishable Temple, has never seen his true face.
"My brother's Martial Arts were also guided by the Unchanging Divine Master. He is a very terrifying enemy. I know the Heavenly Dao of the Great Wilderness may not be weak, but it cannot match the Unchanging Divine Master who has grown for far too many ages.
"However, seeking Yu Ting as an ally is one approach, but Yu Ting must also be cautious and may not be free from the desire to devour the Qi of Heaven and Earth," Netherworld reflected and reminded.
"Yu Ting?" Xu Yan was taken aback. What was Yu Ting?
"Hmm? Are you not seeking Yu Ting as an ally?" Netherworld was stunned.
"My Great Wilderness does not need to rely on outsiders. What is Yu Ting? I've never heard of it," Xu Yan frowned.
The greatest support for the Great Wilderness was naturally his master; there was no need to seek outsiders.
Netherworld was taken aback and pointed at Ming Yu, "She is from Yu Ting. You are with her, yet you don't know Yu Ting?"
Xu Yan's spirit was suddenly uplifted as he realized that besides the Great Wilderness and the Imperishable Temple, there was actually a third power.
Ming Yu, from Yu Ting!
No wonder Ming Yu was neither a creature of the Domain nor a person from the Imperishable Temple.
"I just happened to meet her. She offered me compensation to escort her part of the way. Also, I was curious about the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo, so I agreed to her request," Xu Yan said with curiosity, "Tell me about this Yu Ting."
Netherworld wore a look of surprise, "Yu Ting is a power in the Land of Imperishable, no weaker than the Imperishable Temple, very mysterious. Even the Unchanging Divine Master takes it seriously.
"About Yu Ting, actually, I don't know much either. But the fact that it warrants such caution from the Unchanging Divine Master shows its tremendous strength. And the real motive of Yu Ting is unknown.
"The opening of the Next Era is approaching, and the Imperishable Temple has begun to prepare for Yu Ting's interference in the affairs of the Taicang Domain. I was also ordered to prevent the powerful ones of Yu Ting from entering the region of the Taicang Domain..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1078 - 557: Netherworld's Reminder, Knowledge Exchange
chapters.content:
Yu Ting!
Another formidable force outside the Imperishable Temple!
Xu Yan looked at Ming Yu, then at the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo in Ming Yu's hand, and curiously asked, "That battle back then, did Yu Ting also participate? Why is the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo here at Yu Ting?"
Netherworld had a solemn expression, "This is also something I have been puzzled about. I do not know how Qing Yu had fallen exactly, and why her remains ended up at Yu Ting."
He paused, then added, "If Qing Yu had died at the hands of the Imperishable Temple, her remains wouldn't have this vitality. Perhaps there was someone strong from Yu Ting who secretly took away Qing Yu's remains."
Xu Yan thought for a moment and said, "Is there a possibility that she isn't dead?"
Netherworld was startled, and after a long while, he said, "I haven't sensed her presence, but since it's at Yu Ting, perhaps it has evaded my detection. I hope she really is alive."
Xu Yan looked at Ming Yu and smiled, "On this trip, I will most likely enter Yu Ting. Maybe I can find out if she truly is alive. I'm quite curious. If there's a chance, would you defect from the Imperishable Temple?"
Netherworld was silent for a long time, "I don't know. Now that I have joined the Imperishable Temple, can I really turn back? I just won't participate in actions against the Taicang Domain. The Next Era is about to begin, and that's an opportunity.
"If I can..."
Netherworld didn't continue.
Xu Yan, however, understood. Netherworld, after all, was one of the Seven Great Domain Masters. Even though the Seven Great Domain Masters argue and have conflicts among themselves, they traveled the Land of Imperishable together, obtained the opportunity of the purple light, and together established Domains.
The relationships between them were inevitably deep.
Originally, as the Seven Great Domain flourished, it would certainly become an extremely powerful entity in the Land of Imperishable, possibly even becoming the center of the Land of Imperishable.
All of this, ruined by the hands of the Imperishable Temple.
To say there were no feelings of unwillingness or resentment would obviously be impossible.
But such was the reality: the proud Netherworld had bowed his head. Could he rise proudly again?
If, at the dawn of the Next Era, he seized that opportunity of the beam of light, greatly enhanced his power, and surpassed the Unchanging Divine Master, then Netherworld naturally wouldn't consent to submitting to the Unchanging Divine Master.
But all of this was unknown.
Moreover, Netherworld knew well the strength of the Imperishable Temple. To gain the power to defect from the Imperishable Temple would likely be difficult.
The powerful figures of the Imperishable Temple would surely be cautious of him.
"Hopefully, we won't have a day where we are enemies, otherwise you will die at my hands,"
Xu Yan said with a smile.
Netherworld was taken aback, then chuckled, seemingly not feeling that Xu Yan was being arrogantly boastful. A youngster under a hundred years old, already possessing such strength,
surpassing himself was not impossible.
"I, Netherworld, will not participate in actions against the Great Wilderness, so naturally, I will not be your enemy."
Initially, he had absorbed the Netherworld Domain merely taking back what belonged to him.
"I have killed Blood Frenzy,"
Xu Yan said with a radiant smile.
Netherworld was taken aback, shook his head and said, "Killed, then killed; although Blood Frenzy followed me, he was not one of my closest followers. Better left unsaid…"
But after a pause, Netherworld said in a solemn tone, "If you encounter Lord of Underworld Blood and Prison Blood Lord, I hope you can show some mercy. Of course, I will also tell them not to strike at you, but I fear they may encounter you before I can instruct them."
Xu Yan responded with a radiant smile, "I never show mercy to an enemy, but since you, Netherworld, have spoken, I will give you some face, depending on how much your word is worth."
Lord of Underworld Blood and Prison Blood Lord, named after Netherworld, were evidently his true confidants.
Netherworld smiled, waved his hand, and a scroll flew out, "This is a map of the Land of Imperishable where I have roamed with the Imperishable Temple over the years; it includes some special locations that might interest you, with some of my insights marked on it."
Xu Yan gestured, and the scroll landed in his hand. He smiled, "Fair enough, I will show mercy."
Getting him to show mercy, of course, required something in return.
"Farewell!"
Xu Yan waved his hand, ready to continue escorting Ming Yu back to Yu Ting.
"Although I do not know what confidence the Great Wilderness has to contend with the Imperishable Temple, I need to remind you, the Unchanging Divine Master has lived for at least four eras, the strength is unpredictable.
"Moreover, how many Domain Masters there are in the Imperishable Temple, or even how many old followers who have followed the Unchanging Divine Master to this day, is also hard to predict.
"If the Great Wilderness truly withstands the Imperishable Temple, and if Yu Ting also has plots, they will likely join forces. The opening of the Next Era, both the Temple and Yu Ting probably have some plans in it.
"The Witch is still alive; if you can find him, you will have added a great force. However, the Imperishable Temple already has a powerful figure hunting him."
Netherworld suddenly spoke up to remind.
"The Witch is still alive?"
Xu Yan showed a look of surprise.
"Yes, but severely injured, how much he has recovered is unknown."
Netherworld nodded.
"Taicang is dead, yet the Witch could survive; the Unchanging Divine Master did not strike at him?"
Xu Yan was astounded.
As strong as Taicang was dead, and unlike Netherworld who had a brother in the Imperishable Temple who could beg the Unchanging Divine Master for his life, it seemed unlikely that the Witch could have escaped from the Unchanging Divine Master's clutches.
"It was when Taicang fell, he sent him out of the battleground."
Netherworld actually felt surprised as well.
"At the time of Taicang's fall, to be able to send someone out of the battleground, the gap between him and the Unchanging Divine Master isn't very big."

chapters.title: Chapter 1079 - 557 Reminder from the Netherworld, Knowledge Exchange_2
chapters.content:
If Taicang's power had been vastly inferior, there would have been no ability to send anyone out of the battlefield.
"Back then, Taicang was only half a step away from the breakthrough to Master of Domain. Perhaps in the last moment, he gave his all and took that step, which gave him the ability to do so."
"Though the Unchanging Divine Master is powerful, I only acknowledge Taicang. It's just that time was not on our side, otherwise, the outcome would have been uncertain."
Netherworld sighed and turned to disappear in an instant.
"Taicang is indeed remarkable; no wonder the master said that Taicang was a very talented young friend."
Xu Yan muttered to himself, even his master praised him, which showed Taicang's gifted talent.
The Witch may still be alive, but it was unknown where. Naturally, Xu Yan would not deliberately search for him, especially in the vast Land of Imperishable, where to even begin looking?
"Yu Ting, interesting!"
Xu Yan looked at Ming Yu and noticed the revolving silver-white light in her eyes was slowing down, which meant she was starting to recover.
He took out the Flying Boat, placed Ming Yu upon it, and examined the map given by Netherworld, while the Flying Boat continued to follow the direction Ming Yu was heading.
Having reviewed the map from Netherworld, Xu Yan temporarily had no intention to explore and instead turned to Ming Yu, whose eyes no longer had the circling light.
But her pupils had not yet returned to pitch black; she was still in a crashed state.
"People from Yu Ting are truly strange. It's just that I don't know if my guess is correct or not."
Xu Yan looked at Ming Yu thoughtfully.
"Divine Soul? That feels somewhat familiar to me."
Ming Yu blinked and tilted her head slightly, lost in thought.
"The Divine Soul, where consciousness resides, if the Divine Soul perishes, the body is nothing more than an empty shell..."
Xu Yan explained the Divine Soul to Ming Yu.
"The Divine Soul perishes, the body is nothing more than an empty shell..."
Ming Yu echoed in a dull and clumsy manner, as if her thoughts were about to stall again; her pitch-dark pupils even began to turn white.
In a certain moment, as if she had thought of something, she brought up a question.
"What if the shell is gone, what about the Divine Soul?"
Xu Yan's smile was radiant as he said, "Miss Ming Yu, knowledge is precious. Although we are friends, this involves too profound knowledge; you can't freeload, you know!"
Ming Yu blinked, seemingly pondering the meaning of Xu Yan's words.
His slow and silly appearance made Xu Yan's mouth twitch slightly, but Ming Yu seemed to grasp the essence from his words.
"Freeload? I won't sell myself!"
Ming Yu shook her head, her expression resolute.
Xu Yan: ...
This level of comprehension, Xu Yan was baffled; after pondering for so long, she came to this conclusion?
Was this really what he meant?
But then again, Ming Yu's brain was not to be viewed normally; a misunderstanding was within reason.
"Miss Ming Yu, what I mean is that knowledge, especially that revolving around the Divine Soul, is precious and should not be gained for nothing; I don't mean you have to sell your body."
Xu Yan helplessly explained.
Ming Yu tilted her head, thinking for a while, "Then how can I acquire your knowledge?"
"It's simple, knowledge for knowledge; that's fair."
Xu Yan's smile was radiant.
"How do we exchange?"
"Just like exchanging formations for principles, only this time the knowledge we exchange is more extensive. Before that, I want to know where you come from, Miss Ming Yu. Is it the place I think it is?"
Ming Yu blinked, "Me? I come from Yu Ting."
"So you are indeed from Yu Ting. I've heard of Yu Ting long ago and know little about it; so let's exchange an introduction to Yu Ting for it, how about that?"
This was precisely Xu Yan's aim.
Ming Yu thought about it, and after a while, nodded, "Okay, I will introduce Yu Ting to you, and you explain to me what happens to the Divine Soul without a body."
"Deal!"
Xu Yan nodded.
"Miss Ming Yu, let me start the explanation, and after I have finished, you can introduce Yu Ting."
"Mhm!"
Ming Yu nodded her head, blinking her eyes, her face full of anticipation.
"When living beings are weak, though they also possess a Divine Soul, it's extremely frail and vague, and only by cultivating to a certain realm can one condense the Divine Soul, transforming the intangible into tangible..."
Xu Yan did not directly tell Ming Yu what would become of a Divine Soul that had lost its physical body.
Instead, he started from the beginning, explaining to Ming Yu about the knowledge of the Divine Soul, also to confirm a speculation.
"The martial arts one cultivates are different, and the Divine Souls they condense are also not the same. Generally speaking, when the Divine Soul is gathered, one must open the Divine Soul Sea of Consciousness. There are martial arts that open the Spirit Pedestal... The Divine Soul Sea of Consciousness is located within the mind."
Xu Yan raised his hand and pointed to his head.
Then, he saw Ming Yu blinking her eyes, and gradually, her pitch-black pupils disappeared, turning into a jade-white color, with rings of silver radiance spinning.
"Indeed, Ming Yu doesn't have a consciousness regarding the Divine Soul, but she vaguely feels something. Once it touches upon the Divine Soul, she gets somewhat overwhelmed, or rather, in her consciousness, the Divine Soul is too profound..."
Xu Yan saw Ming Yu's brain freeze again, and the speculation in his heart became more and more confirmed.
This time, Ming Yu's brain crash was shorter than the last, and after recovering, she tilted her head slightly, blinking and looking at Xu Yan in thought.
It seemed that she had forgotten some of the things Xu Yan said and hadn't remembered them.
"Miss Ming Yu, it's your turn to introduce Yu Ting."
Xu Yan said with a smile.
"But I don't remember much of the knowledge you talked about."
Ming Yu looked somewhat dejected.
"Profound knowledge is not something one can remember in one or two attempts. You just have to remember it more times. The more profound the knowledge, the greater its value, and naturally, the more effort it requires. Since we have already reached a knowledge exchange agreement, we can't just call it off because it's not remembered.
"If you introduce Yu Ting's knowledge and I don't remember it, I will still keep asking you to introduce it, and we will continue to exchange knowledge, until I remember it.
"You are the same, if you feel you need me to continue explaining, then let's continue exchanging knowledge until you remember it."
Xu Yan spoke earnestly.
Inside, he was secretly pleased. It was good that she couldn't remember because it meant that Ming Yu would have to bring out even more to exchange, allowing him to ask for more information about Yu Ting.
"That makes sense!"
Ming Yu nodded.
"What do you want to know about Yu Ting?"
After pondering for a while, Xu Yan spoke, "Although I have heard the name of Yu Ting, I know very little about it. Miss Ming Yu, where is Yu Ting located? What's your strength like in Yu Ting?"
Ming Yu tilted her head slightly, thinking, "Yu Ting doesn't have a fixed location; it's always wandering. Normally, there is a direction it wanders in, and it only changes direction after a certain period of time.
"I'm not strong in Yu Ting. If I were strong, I wouldn't need your escort."
Xu Yan immediately understood that similarly to the Imperishable Temple, Yu Ting also didn't have a fixed location, but was always roaming in the Land of Imperishable.
Ming Yu, with her Realm Master Level strength, wasn't considered strong in Yu Ting, which could be inferred from her tone that Realm Master Level strength was very common in Yu Ting, indicating the great strength of Yu Ting.
"It's my turn now."
After finishing, Ming Yu happily began to speak.
Xu Yan gave a wry smile, at this moment Ming Yu unexpectedly became lively and clever.
"Shall I go over what I just said again?"
Ming Yu tilted her head slightly and then nodded, "Mhm!"
The slight tilt of her head always represented that Ming Yu was thinking, Xu Yan had already grasped some of her tendencies.
The disappearance of the pitch-black pupils and the emergence of jade-white color meant Ming Yu was either entering a state of battle, or she was in a state of deep thinking and sorting things out.
The presence of spinning silver-white radiance in her eyes meant that Ming Yu's thoughts had stuck.
Xu Yan repeated the explanation about the Divine Soul, and after Ming Yu listened, her pitch-black pupils disappeared, and the silver-white radiance began spinning, but this time for much shorter.
"It's your turn!"
Ming Yu, having recovered but looking a bit dejected, lifted her hand to scratch her hair, her expression sullen.
"Miss Ming Yu, what's wrong?"
For the first time, Xu Yan saw Ming Yu in such a state and couldn't help but curiously ask.
"I feel like I'm being slow."
Ming Yu looked discouraged.
Xu Yan's lips twitched; this was no longer a matter of being slow.
He smiled and comforted her, "Profound knowledge is always difficult to grasp; failing to remember and understand clearly even after one, two, three, four times, or even five or six attempts, is normal."

chapters.title: Chapter 1080 - 558: Entering Yu Ting
chapters.content:
Ming Yu blinked, "Really?"
"Of course!" Xu Yan affirmed.
"Then you ask. What do you want to know?"
Ming Yu became cheerful.
"How many Masters of the Domain-level powerhouses are there in the Jade Court, like you, Miss Ming Yu? How large is the Jade Court, and how does its scenery compare to the Domain?" Xu Yan asked with a smile.
Ming Yu tilted her head, blinked at him, and after a moment, replied, "Master of the Domain strength?"
Lifting her hand and counting with her fingers, ten fingers counted, she continued, "More than my fingers, how many exactly, I don't know. The strength like mine, basically, all are, I also don't know how many there are."
"The Jade Court is very beautiful, pure and flawless, with sky-high pavilions and buildings, much more beautiful than the Domain..."
Xu Yan was secretly amazed, the Jade Court had at least more than ten Masters of the Domain-level powerhouses, and the people of the Jade Court, all possess Realm Master-level strength, and there was no one below the Realm Master level.
"It's my turn." After Ming Yu finished answering, she said happily.
Xu Yan explained the Divine Soul issue again.
Throughout the rest of the journey, Xu Yan exchanged information about the Divine Soul to learn about the Jade Court, and every part of the Divine Soul explanation left Ming Yu stuck in her thoughts.
This allowed Xu Yan to ask even more about the Jade Court.
As Ming Yu introduced more, Xu Yan's understanding of the Jade Court grew.
The Jade Court has three owners, the Three Masters of the Jade Court, each one incredibly mysterious and immensely powerful.
Moreover, the whereabouts of the Three Masters are unpredictable, and whether they are in the Jade Court or not is unknown to anyone.
There are not many people in the Jade Court; according to Ming Yu, there are probably less than a thousand, but even the weakest in strength are at the Realm Master level.
To Xu Yan's surprise, although Ming Yu is not strong, her status in the Jade Court is quite high, even higher than that of an average Master of the Domain.
This piece of Qing Ling Jade Bamboo is also unique to Ming Yu; other Jade People do not have it.
The Jade Court is true to its name, as immaculate as a beautiful jade, in the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, it is like a beautiful scene, and like a piece of untainted beautiful jade, wandering in the filth.
As they continued with the "knowledge exchange," the more they delved into the core phase, the harder it was for Ming Yu to understand, often getting stuck in thought, and even after recovering, she would forget everything completely.
This also allowed Xu Yan to inquire about deeper information concerning the Jade Court.
At last, Xu Yan obtained a partial map of the Jade Court and a rough image of the Three Masters of the Jade Court, and even learned about the strength issue of the Jade People.
The strength of the Jade People seems to be determined at birth, with no specific Cultivation Methods, and even the art of combat and various powerful secret techniques seem to be innate.
Even some powerful secret techniques, if not innate, were suddenly mastered, learned as if one had slept and woke up knowing new secret techniques.
Combat experience also gradually grows, and after each battle, it quickly accumulates, and they will absolutely not repeat the same mistakes next time.
In the end, concerning the information about the Jade Court, everything that could be said was said, and Ming Yu still did not fully understand everything about the Divine Soul.
Xu Yan could only ask other questions.
For instance, who were Ming Yu's parents, and how old she was now, etc.
However, when asked about her parents, Ming Yu thought about it and got stuck, and eventually naively answered, "I don't have parents."
As for the question of age, Ming Yu couldn't answer either.
Xu Yan pondered for a moment and asked, "Miss Ming Yu, have you ever seen a purple light streaking across the Chaos?"
"Purple light?" Ming Yu looked puzzled, "What does purple light look like?"
Xu Yan raised his hand, and a streak of purple light emerged, "This is the purple light."
"So, this is purple light; I have seen it!" Ming Yu nodded and said.
Xu Yan was shocked. Had this girl, Ming Yu, been alive for at least one Primordial and above?
But why was her strength so weak?
"I remember it was a long, long time ago, not sure how long exactly, but there was once, when the Three Masters said a Primordial was about to arrive again, and we could enjoy the beauty of the beginning of the Primordial, so I waited outside the Jade Court, and finally, I saw the purple light streak by, very beautiful."
Ming Yu tilted her head as she recalled.
"Has your strength always been like this, without any change?" Xu Yan curiously asked.
"No, I have gotten stronger than before, not by much, but I can get stronger, it seems like I'm the only one in the Jade Court who can." Ming Yu showed a face full of pride.
"Besides seeing the purple light, have you seen any other lights?" Xu Yan thought for a moment and asked again.
"I don't know, it's been too long, who can remember!" Ming Yu shook her head.
"Let me explain the Divine Soul again." Since all the information about the Jade Court had been asked, and Ming Yu didn't know about the deeper aspects of the Jade Court, Xu Yan prepared to explain the Divine Soul in the simplest and most concise way, answering Ming Yu's question about what happens when the body is gone, and how the Divine Soul is affected.
"No, no, I need a moment. Such profound issues can't be understood in a moment, and besides, I feel like I might not have a Divine Soul."
"No, that's not right, my Divine Soul is not like what you described." Ming Yu shook her head.
"I am about to return to the Jade Court, you've worked hard in escorting me, I invite you to come to my house as a guest."
"Good, I'd be delighted to!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1081 - 558: Entering Yu Ting_2
chapters.content:
Xu Yan nodded in agreement.
Yu Ting ah, we're finally about to arrive. Will I be able to see the Three Masters of the Jade Court, and what attitude will they have towards me, a being from the Domain?
"Ming Yu, why are you alone, so far away from the Jade Court?"
Xu Yan was curious. Ming Yu's strength wasn't strong, moving away from the Jade Court and approaching the area of the Great Wilderness, or rather, the area near the Imperishable Temple. What exactly was she doing?
With Ming Yu's status in the Jade Court, she shouldn't need to be running errands.
"I went to observe the Domain."
Ming Yu didn't hide anything and said, "The Three Masters told me to go have a look at the Domain but not to enter, just to observe from afar. They said if I didn't look now, I might never get the chance again. So, I went to observe the Domain."
"Who knew the guys from the Divine Temple would go crazy and actually try to capture me? They were really awful."
Observe the Domain!
Which Domain? Naturally, the Great Wilderness!
Moreover, what was the intention behind the Three Masters of the Jade Court asking Ming Yu to observe the Domain?
They also said, if she didn't look now, she might never see it again—is it because the Unchanging Divine Master wants to devour the Domain, or is the Jade Court itself also planning to strike at the Domain?
Xu Yan thought for a moment. If the Jade Court was planning to strike at the Great Wilderness, why urge Ming Yu to observe the Domain now?
They could see it before striking.
Thus, the Three Masters knew that the Imperishable Temple was going to devour the Great Wilderness, and even knew what the purpose of the Unchanging Divine Master was.
Among the Three Masters of the Jade Court, Ming Yu was most familiar with the Third Master. She mentioned the Second and First Masters rarely, but the Third Master many times, and every time, it was the Third Master asking Ming Yu to do something.
"Ming Yu, did you see the Domain? Why didn't you enter the Domain?"
Xu Yan asked, puzzled.
"I saw it."
Ming Yu tilted her head, "Entering the Domain might not be good, the Third Master told me to just take a look from afar, so I didn't go in. The Domain is very beautiful, like a bright pearl."
As she spoke, Ming Yu blinked her eyes at him, "Xu Yan, how did you create your small Domain? It looks just like a real Domain. Are you from that Domain?"
Xu Yan nodded, "Yes, I come from that Domain, the Great Wilderness Domain. My small Domain looks real because I used that mountain."
"Great Wilderness? Wasn't the Domain called Taicang?"
Ming Yu looked puzzled.
"Taicang is the old name, it has become history. The current Domain is called the Great Wilderness. You can enter the Great Wilderness; the scenery there is far beyond what The Land of Chaotic Imperishable can offer."
"The Domain's all living beings, local customs, human interactions, the warmth and cold of society, all are worth your visit,"
Xu Yan said with a smile.
"Then... if I get a chance, you take me there. You host me; I'll visit. How about that?"
Ming Yu's eyes brightened, her face full of hopeful expression.
"Okay!"
Xu Yan nodded.
"Xu Yan, you are really too kind!"
Ming Yu was very happy, "I will treat you well in the Jade Court, and you don't need to be polite with me."
"Then, thank you!"
Xu Yan's smile was radiant.
"Look, that's the Jade Court!"
Ming Yu pointed with her hand, her smile clear and beautiful.
Xu Yan looked up and saw a faint jade-white glow emerge amid the Chaos, like a jade disc adorning that chaotic land.
The Jade Court, true to its name, was flawless white, seemingly constructed from a colossal piece of beautiful jade, stepping into it felt like entering a world of jade.
The houses, gardens, pavilions, and towers were carved as if from fine jade.
The Jade Court was vast, like a small domain on its own. Entering the gate of the Jade Court stood two enormous Jade Persons.
The burly, enormous Jade Persons, like jade sculptures, held spears and stood guard, their eyes lacked dark pupils and appeared sculpted, emitting a faint silver glow.
As the Flying Boat approached, the Jade Persons with spears assumed a defensive posture.
"Xu Yan, follow me. I'll talk to them; they won't make it difficult for you."
Ming Yu disembarked from the Flying Boat.
Xu Yan stowed the Flying Boat and followed behind Ming Yu, his gaze curiously turning towards the Jade Person holding a spear in a defensive posture, his heart secretly taken aback.
A Master of Heaven and Earth level powerhouse!
Ming Yu, donning a happy smile, led Xu Yan to the entrance of Yu Ting and waved her hand, "Yu Da, Yu Er, this is my friend, not an outsider!"
The two Jade People looked at Xu Yan, then Ming Yu, thought for a moment, and put away their spears.
"Xu Yan, let's go."
Ming Yu stepped joyously into the gates of Yu Ting.
Xu Yan took a deep breath and followed closely behind, only then truly realizing the extraordinary status and identity Ming Yu held within Yu Ting.
Even Jade People of the Master of Heaven and Earth level obeyed her commands.
As they passed the two Jade People, Xu Yan carefully examined them, his heart slightly trembling as his gaze landed on a dim white light.
Yet, compared to looking at Ming Yu, he saw something much more.
Moreover, although these two Jade People were powerful, their quick thinking was inferior to Ming Yu's, lacking a certain "human" essence.
Stepping into Yu Ting, all that met his eyes was beautiful jade, even the sparse vegetation had a jade-like quality.
"Yu Ting itself is a Supreme Treasure!"
This thought reverberated shockingly in Xu Yan's mind, surpassing even the Hong Ze Domain.
"Yu Ting is quite large, and you're unfamiliar since it's your first visit, so there are some places you can't go yet. Let us first head to the courtyard where I live, and once you're familiar, you can explore more."
Ming Yu said with a smile.
"Thank you, Miss Ming Yu!"
Xu Yan followed Ming Yu deeper into Yu Ting. Along the way, they occasionally encountered other Jade People, and as Ming Yu had described, the weakest among them possessed Realm Master level strength, and noticing more about these Jade People, Xu Yan observed some disparities.
Although, it wasn't clear whether they were the same during combat, but in non-combat situations, these Jade People indeed had significant differences.
Aside from some behaviors, especially in terms of thinking, each Jade Person had their differences, and their ways of thinking seemed varied too.
Though they were beings with Spiritual Wisdom, they appeared slow, some looking downright foolish.
For instance, Xu Yan saw a Jade Person watering an unknown tree. Midway, the person lay down to lick the water off the tree roots, then continued watering while licking, which looked quite abnormal.
Similarly, he saw another Jade Person practicing Fist Techniques, which seemed ordinary and didn't match his strength, but as he shouted with each punch, he got stuck in a move and froze completely.
"I thought Ming Yu was somewhat slow, but compared to these Jade People, she's practically a genius!"
Xu Yan thought with amazement.
Every corner of Yu Ting was abnormal, yet such abnormal beings were highly guarded by the Imperishable Divine Temple, not to be underestimated.
"We shouldn't judge by appearances, these Jade People may look slow and dull, but in battle, they're anything but."
Xu Yan grew intensely interested in the Three Masters of the Jade Court.
Surely, the Three Masters of Yu Ting couldn't all resemble these slow and dull Jade People?
"Here we are, this is where I live."
Finally, under Ming Yu's guidance, they arrived at an elegant little courtyard.
Everything in the courtyard was flawlessly white jade, even a small pagoda within it; in the center of the courtyard, a small pond had several fish swimming about.
Just as flawless, the fish seemed carved out of beautiful jade.
Looking around the courtyard, Xu Yan felt more convinced of his suspicions.
"Sister Ming, you're back!"
From the pagoda, a young maid scurried out, appearing about fifteen or sixteen, delicate and cute, her bright eyes curiously gazing at Xu Yan.
"Xiao Jie, this is a friend I made outside, Xu Yan!"
Ming Yu introduced him, "This is... Xiao Jie, who takes care of me."
Xu Yan gave a warm smile, nodding, "Hello, Miss Xiao Jie!"
So Ming Yu even had a maid attending her.
Looking about fifteen or sixteen, Xiao Jie this maid also possessed Realm Master level strength, though slightly weaker than Ming Yu.
"Hello, Xu Yan... brother?!"
Xiao Jie tilted her head, blinking as she looked at Xu Yan.
It seemed she was pondering, trying to figure out how best to address Xu Yan, considering she called Ming Yu sister, and Xu Yan being Ming Yu's friend, naturally should be called brother?

chapters.title: Chapter 1082 - 559: Yu Ting's Doll, Astonishing Guess
chapters.content:
"Xiao Jie, hurry and bring out all the delicious food. I want to give Xu Yan a very warm welcome!"
Ming Yu commanded joyfully.
"Yes, Sister Ming!"
Xiao Jie scurried off.
"Xu Yan, come, stay with me here. I will take good care of you!"
Ming Yu led Xu Yan into the loft.
The loft, carved out of beautiful jade, was pleasing to the eye, yet seemed a bit monotonous.
However, Xu Yan didn't mind; he wasn't here to admire the scenery.
Soon after sitting down, Xiao Jie returned with things in hand, placing them on the table one by one.
Xu Yan was stunned.
Was this what Ming Yu considered delicious food?
While the foods differed in appearance, they all seemed to be made of jade, just that they possessed more Spiritual Charm than ordinary jade and some contained special Principles within.
"This is my favorite. Xu Yan, you should try it."
Ming Yu picked up a jade in the shape of a small bird and placed it on Xu Yan's plate, eagerly anticipating Xu Yan's praise of its deliciousness.
"How am I supposed to eat this?"
Xu Yan muttered to himself.
He tossed the Jade Bird into his mouth as if he had eaten it, but in reality, he used the Domain Dao Rule to transfer it into the Prime Tortoise Carapace's minor Domain.
"How does it taste? Is it good?"
Ming Yu asked excitedly.
"This is the first time I've eaten such a unique and special food. It's excellent!"
Xu Yan said with a smile.
"I knew it, you would definitely like it."
Ming Yu was overjoyed.
Xu Yan diverted part of his attention to the minor Domain within the Prime Tortoise Carapace, where the "food" he had eaten was melting, as if being digested.
Ming Yu also began to eat. She picked up a Jade Bird, took a bite, and her eyes squinted in delight, clearly savoring it.
Xu Yan's mouth twitched. After arriving in Yu Ting, he found the place increasingly strange.
Under Ming Yu's hospitable insistence, the "delicacies" on the table were quickly finished. Ming Yu ate with great pleasure, and Xu Yan also pretended to be satisfied, claiming it was the first time in his life that he had eaten such particular and delicious food.
Within the minor Domain of the Prime Tortoise Carapace, the eaten "food" was dissolving, slowly turning into a clump of Spiritual Charm, floating up as if wanting to merge into the Domain's Principles.
Xu Yan didn't let this clump of Spiritual Charm merge into the Principles of the Prime Tortoise Carapace's minor Domain. Instead, he isolated it, analyzing whether this clump of charm would cause an invasive situation if merged into the Domain's Principles.
"This seems to be some sort of Principle, a Principle formed from Spiritual Charm which can make up for certain aspects or enhance others, but the regularity and operational state of this Principle differs greatly from what I've known thus far."
Xu Yan sensed the Spiritual Charm that the "food" had melted into and concluded it was some sort of Principle, but his understanding of its laws was very different.
Whether it was Taicang Martial Arts Principles or those belonging to the Masters of the minor Domains or the Imperishable Temple Principles, this was completely different.
After all, once cultivation reaches this level, even though the refined Principles are different, there are still commonalities, but the Principles of these "foods" were greatly distinct.
It was as if these were not Principles for self-cultivation but a different form of Principles that exist within oneself.
Gradually, Xu Yan released the contained Principles of the Spiritual Charm into the minor Domain of the Prime Tortoise Carapace.
"The Principles of the Prime Tortoise Carapace have been supplemented somewhat; they're just like food, which becomes one's own upon digestion."
Xu Yan was astonished.
Immediately, he allowed the entire clump of Spiritual Charm to merge into the Principles of the Prime Tortoise Carapace, making them marginally closer to Perfection.
The Prime Tortoise had fallen, and although the carapace remained, and its minor Domain didn't collapse, the Principles of the Prime Tortoise had suffered damage. Therefore, the Principles of the Prime Tortoise Carapace were somewhat lacking.
After digesting the "food," however, it could replenish the missing Principles.
After the meal, Ming Yu took Xu Yan for a walk in her yard, introducing him to her little garden, and arranged a place for him to stay.
"Ming Yu, I wonder if I could meet the three elders of Yu Ting?"
After staying a day in Ming Yu's yard, Xu Yan asked.
"The three Masters seem to be away. Once they return, I will ask for you."
Ming Yu shook her head.
"Then, thank you."
Xu Yan felt somewhat disappointed. He was very curious about the three masters of Yu Ting, wondering what kind of beings they were, how strong they really were.
They must be stronger than Taicang from back then if they could make the Unchanging Divine Master take them so seriously.
"Is this type of bamboo grown in Yu Ting?"
Xu Yan inquired, taking out the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo.
One of his reasons for coming was to see if the Master of the Qing Ling Realm was in Yu Ting.
"I'll ask someone where the bamboo grows."
Ming Yu thought about it and said, "Xiao Jie, take good care of Xu Yan. I'll go and see where the bamboo is."
After instructing Xiao Jie, Ming Yu left to look for the bamboo.
"Brother Xu Yan."
It seemed she was very happy to have a guest in the little courtyard, a new friend.
"Xiao Jie, how about I teach you about Formations?"
Xu Yan proposed after some thought.
"Formation? What is that?"
Xiao Jie asked curiously.
Xu Yan took out an Array Plate and activated the Formation. Flashes of wind and thunder as well as layers of dense fog appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 1083 - 559 Yu Ting Dolls, Shocking Guess_2
chapters.content:
"This is the formation."
Xiao Jie subconsciously activated her own power and entered a state of combat, then blinked her eyes as if pondering something.
"I want to learn, I want to learn!"
"Come, Xiao Jie, let me explain the basics of formations to you."
Xu Yan, with a smile on his face, took out a piece of paper.
"Mm-hmm!"
Xiao Jie restrained her power and widened her eyes, curiously watching the paper in front of her.
Xu Yan's finger traced over the paper, and one by one, formation patterns emerged—these were the most basic formation patterns.
In the Way of the Array, although not as proficient as Fang Hao except for some profound and unique formations, Xu Yan was familiar with various basic formations and could lay them out with a wave of his hand.
After all, Xu Yan practiced the Sword Array, mastering various basic formations naturally without difficulty.
"This is the Reversal Formation, it can cause those within the formation to reverse directions, reverse attacks, and so on..."
Xu Yan, while drawing the formation patterns, started to explain.
Xiao Jie, not as quick-witted as Ming Yu, easily became stuck mentally with such profound formation patterns.
And this was Xu Yan's purpose.
He wanted to verify a speculation, and Xiao Jie was the perfect subject because of her weak strength and low status as Ming Yu's maid.
Moreover, with the Minor Heavenly Eye, Xu Yan could see some hints about Xiao Jie, although he could not glimpse the whole picture, he did see some outlines.
Xiao Jie listened carefully, then her eyes emitted a silver-white brilliance, spinning in circles as if stuck in deep thought.
However, Xiao Jie quickly recovered, blinking and saying, "Brother Xu Yan, this formation is really hard to understand."
Xu Yan, seeing this, became contemplative. As long as it did not affect the Divine Soul, getting mentally stuck was quickly recoverable, and it seemed Xiao Jie's thinking was particularly simple. Because of its simplicity, even if it got stuck, it was easier to recover.
Directly deleting the incomprehensible segment from her thoughts, she recovered.
Xu Yan repeated the explanation that had caused Xiao Jie's mental block, and indeed, she became stuck again.
"Xiao Jie, try copying it to see, this way you might understand it better."
Once Xiao Jie recovered, Xu Yan took out another piece of paper.
"I'll try."
Xiao Jie, excited, raised her hand and started to mimic on the paper, but just as she began, her thoughts stalled.
Once she recovered, she blinked and began to copy again but got stuck once more.
"It's so difficult!"
Xiao Jie was very interested in formations, but was somewhat frustrated because it was too difficult.
"Xiao Jie, let me help you with copying, give me your hand!"
Xu Yan said with a smile, extending his hand.
"Okay, okay!"
Xiao Jie extended her hand.
Xu Yan held Xiao Jie's hand, "For the formation patterns, this stroke goes like this..."
After drawing two strokes of the formation patterns, Xiao Jie entered a state of crash, but with Xu Yan holding her hand and drawing the patterns, she showed no resistance and no consciousness, like a puppet.
Xu Yan carefully let a wisp of the Way of Domain spread out, entering Xiao Jie's palm. In that moment, using it as a bridge, the Minor Heavenly Eye saw the special characteristics of the power within Xiao Jie.
Puppet Principle surrounded Xiao Jie, forming a special operational way, even including Xiao Jie's consciousness, which was formed by a certain Puppet Principle, operating in a specific pattern.
Whenever the problem requiring thought was too arcane, exceeding the thinking produced by the operation of the Puppet Principles, it would stall, requiring time to alleviate before it could operate again.
"It is really so!"
His speculation having been confirmed, Xu Yan felt somewhat shocked.
"No wonder these Puppet Principles are so special. If I could comprehend them for a while and establish them in my Way of Domain, achieving Great Accomplishment in Establishing Dao is imminent."
Xu Yan was secretly excited in his heart, Yu Ting was his precious place for swiftly advancing to Great Accomplishment in Establishing Dao.
But the premise was having the opportunity to comprehend these Puppet Principles.
"The three masters of Yu Ting, what exactly are they? Could they also be Jade People? If so, who is the real creator of Yu Ting?"
The more Xu Yan thought, the more he was shocked.
From meeting Ming Yu, he felt she was a bit strange, especially when thinking, giving off a sluggish vibe.
As he got to know more about Ming Yu, especially after exchanging her Puppet Principles for his formations, Xu Yan felt that Ming Yu did not seem like a creature in the true sense.
Upon arriving at Yu Ting, the sight of those Jade People only intensified his suspicion—it was exactly as he had speculated.
Now, his speculation had finally been confirmed.
Puppet!
Whether it was Ming Yu or Xiao Jie, they were actually a type of puppet!
Or rather, a Jade Puppet!
Their bodies were carved from some unknown and mysterious jade.
All the Jade People of Yu Ting were a type of puppet, possessing a certain degree of autonomous consciousness and thought.
Though they were puppets, they were significantly different from the general perception of puppets.
This was what shocked Xu Yan, a single puppet possessing such formidable strength, having a degree of independent thought and consciousness was utterly inconceivable.
Each Jade Person functioned according to a certain Puppet Principle, including their thought process, which was also governed by Puppet Principle.
This Puppet Principle was extremely unique and profound, enabling the puppets to act as if they possessed spiritual wisdom, especially apparent in battle where they bore no resemblance to puppets at all.
"The puppets crafted by Fourth Junior Brother, although capable of battle, ultimately lack spiritual wisdom and thought, and these puppets rely on Spirit Crystals for combat strength, while these Jade People fight like true Martial Artists, without depending on Spirit Crystals…"
That the Jade People could achieve all this was due to the Puppet Principle, this unusual and eerie Puppet Principle endowed them with such capabilities.
Moreover, creating puppets with strength exceeding the Realm Master Level was extremely difficult, unless the puppet was imbued with the Puppet Principle, something beyond Fang Hao's current capabilities.
"These puppets are very unusual, seemingly not crafted, and the Puppet Principle is also very special; to say they are puppets is not entirely accurate."
Xu Yan released Xiao Jie's hand, falling into deep contemplation.
Yu Ting was too bizarre and terrifying.
If the three masters of Yu Ting were also a type of puppet, then who was the creator of Yu Ting, and how terrifying was their strength?
"Is there anything special about Ming Yu among these Jade Puppets that her status is so high?"
Xu Yan thought about Ming Yu's status in Yu Ting.
Her strength wasn't remarkable, far inferior to those Master of Heaven and Earth level Jade Puppets, yet her status was much higher than theirs.
It seemed that besides the three masters of Yu Ting, Ming Yu had the highest status.
"Ming Yu, more human-like than the other Jade Puppets, possessing the spiritual wisdom and thought of a human, and her strength can improve; could she be a type of cultivatable Jade Puppet?"
Xu Yan murmured thoughtfully.
"Brother Xu Yan?"
Xiao Jie had recovered, blinking her eyes.
"Xiao Jie, the Formation is rather profound, you might not understand it immediately; I need to teach you slowly, we can't rush this."
Xu Yan said with a smiling face.
Since they were Jade Puppets, even if they had thoughts, these thoughts were quite basic, generated by the Puppet Principle, allowing one to slowly unravel the workings of the Puppet Principle and grasp the method in which thoughts are produced.
"Uh-huh, thank you, Brother Xu Yan!"
Xiao Jie nodded her little head, her face full of happiness.
"Xiao Jie, let's play chess, I'll teach you."
Xu Yan then took out a chessboard.
"Chess?"
Xiao Jie blinked.
"Yes, chess, it's a lot of fun."
Xu Yan began teaching Xiao Jie how to play.
"The Creation of Heaven and Earth nurtures all things; the Jade Puppets of Yu Ting, possessing spiritual wisdom and thought, could they also be endowed by some sort of Power of Creation? Could the creator of Yu Ting have strength at least comparable to the Creation Realm?"
Xu Yan speculated internally.
The people of Yu Ting, though Jade Puppets, had already transcended the limitations of ordinary puppets, having acquired individuality; those of the Master of Heaven and Earth level manipulated the Dao Principles, owning their own Dao.
To endow a Jade Puppet with Dao Principles, aside from having power similar to the Creation Realm, it would be impossible otherwise.
"Martial Arts converge from different paths to the same end, ultimately moving towards the Dao, everything exists within the Dao…"
The creator of Yu Ting must have perceived the Dao, at least a powerhouse comparable to the Creation Realm!
"If Fourth Junior Brother breaks through to the Creation Realm, he should also be able to craft similar puppets, endowing them with certain consciousness and spiritual wisdom."
But if the three masters of Yu Ting were also Jade Puppets, and their strength surpassed the Master of Heaven and Earth Level, then the creator of Yu Ting must have transcended even the Creation Realm, could they be comparable to the Primordial, or even an existing Dao practitioner?!
At this thought, Xu Yan's heart jolted; could he possibly have the chance to meet a second Dao practitioner, apart from his master?

chapters.title: Chapter 1084 - 560: Master of the Qing Ling Realm
chapters.content:
Teaching a jade puppet to play chess was an extremely patience-testing task, especially since this puppet would crash when encountering a difficult problem and would take quite a while to recover.
Xu Yan, however, was full of enthusiasm and not the least bit impatient; he taught with great attention to detail.
A game of chess had yet to start, and Xiao Jie still hadn't fully learned the rules and methods of playing chess when Ming Yu returned.
Through teaching Xiao Jie to play, Xu Yan found that jade puppets encountered significantly more difficulty and more frequent cognitive stalling when learning entirely new and unfamiliar knowledge.
However, when it came to knowledge about battle, the puppets were quick to respond and less likely to experience such stalling.
"Playing chess?"
Ming Yu was delighted and directly took Xiao Jie's place, asking Xu Yan to teach her to play chess.
Xu Yan was more than willing and took this as an opportunity to test whether Ming Yu's thoughts were more adaptable to unfamiliar knowledge than Xiao Jie's.
Sure enough, although occasionally experiencing moments of cognitive stalling, Ming Yu rarely did so, and she recovered quickly, absorbing the rules and methods of chess rapidly.
"Ming Yu belongs to a higher class of jade puppets, with strong growth potential, which is why she is valued by the Three Masters of the Jade Court and holds a higher status than other jade puppets,"
Xu Yan also pondered with some doubt what the intent was behind the Three Masters of the Jade Court sending Ming Yu to explore the Domain. Could it be they intended for Ming Yu to transform into a creature of the Domain?
