Ming Yu joyfully played chess with Xu Yan. Although she had learned how to play chess, one couldn't expect much of her chess skills.
"Xu Yan, I found the bamboo."
Ming Yu excitedly announced during the game.
"I am quite curious about this bamboo, if possible, take me to see it."
Xu Yan perked up; Qing Yu indeed existed within the Jade Court.
After the battle that led to Taicang's fall, Xu Yan was very curious about how Qing Yu had come to the Jade Court, especially since Qing Yu was a Master of Domain with the power to create his own realm.
Gaining Qing Yu's Domain Dao Rule would greatly assist one's cultivation in the Establishing Dao Realm.
After all, the Establishing Dao Realm is about establishing one's Dao and perfecting the Way of Domain, elevating one's own Dao.
"No problem."
Ming Yu readily agreed, her eyes not blinking an instant as she stared at the chessboard, pondering her next move.
It was evident that Ming Yu had a great passion for playing chess.
Or rather, Ming Yu had a deep interest in any new or mysterious knowledge.
"This aids in the enhancement of Ming Yu's consciousness, contributes to the agility of her mind, and is an intrinsic part of Ming Yu's subconscious," Xu Yan thought to himself.
Half a month into his stay at the Jade Court, Xu Yan played chess daily with Ming Yu, who treated him with great hospitality. To Ming Yu, sharing her favorite delicacies was the best way to entertain.
Xu Yan "ate" various "culinary delights" every day and, as a result, the principles of the Prime Tortoise Carapace became increasingly complete and strengthened.
Xu Yan also gained some understanding of this special type of "food," which served to amend puppet principles, meant to compensate and continuously perfect them.
And for this reason, it also had the property of supplementing other Principles.
One day, Ming Yu finally remembered she had yet to take Xu Yan to see the bamboo.
"Xu Yan, let me take you to see the bamboo," Ming Yu said, reluctantly having just finished a game.
"Then, thank you!"
Xu Yan hadn't pressed the issue, allowing Ming Yu to bring it up on her own, and to foster Ming Yu's interest in chess.
Led by Ming Yu, they passed through a long path in the Jade Court, by several courtyards, where every Jade Person living there existed at the Master of Heaven and Earth level.
Even more so, Xu Yan spotted a Jade Person whose strength was no less than a Master of Heaven and Earth level from the Netherworld.
"The creator of the Jade Court, the creator of these jade puppets, possesses a strength second only to my master among those I know. I wonder how he compares to the Unchanging Divine Master? From what information I have, the Unchanging Divine Master is likely no match for the creator of the Jade Court."
Xu Yan couldn't help but inwardly marvel.
Of course, it was hard to judge the Unchanging Divine Master's strength, and if the creators of the Jade Court were indeed the three owners, then their estimated power would have to be lowered a notch.
If those three owners of the Jade Court were also jade puppets, then the creator's strength would be on yet another level.
It could be that of a Wanderer!
Of course, without seeing the Three Masters of the Jade Court, all of this was speculation. Regardless, the strength of the Jade Court was formidable, beyond anything in the Great Wilderness.
"Other than my master, no one in the Great Wilderness can rival the Jade Court," Xu Yan sighed. Even the Great Wilderness Heavenly Path could not match the Jade Court.
"Having merged with the Hong Ze Domain, the Great Wilderness will inevitably be stronger, but still no match for the Jade Court, unless Taihe, Taikun, and Old Man Xiao, all break through the Master of Heaven and Earth Realm and reach the level where the power of the Heavenly Dao surpasses the Master of Heaven and Earth level."
The Great Wilderness has tremendous potential, for the Heavenly Dao can ascend to the level of Wanderer, continuously growing stronger like a Wanderer, becoming the strongest road beneath the Grand Dao.
But in the end, it has had too little time to grow. After tens of thousands of years, even Primordial Ages, it's inevitable that the Heavenly Dao will surpass both the Imperishable Temple and the Jade Court.
Ming Yu, with her mind full of chess, asked about chess-related matters and inquired about the art of the game all along the way.
Patiently explaining, Xu Yan finally arrived at a high-walled courtyard, where the immaculate white jade walls rose up to a hundred zhang high, and the flawless surface was wrapped in a faint halo, seemingly brimming with vitality.

chapters.title: Chapter 1085 - 560: Master of the Qing Ling Realm_2
chapters.content:
This feature was not present in other structures or courtyards of the Jade Court.
The Qing Ling Jade Bamboo resided within this grand courtyard.
"The bamboo is inside!"
Ming Yu pushed open the courtyard gate, leading Xu Yan inside.
Upon entering, they were greeted by a breath of fresh air, a rich vitality. The Spiritual Energy was gentle and moist, a faint sweet fragrance permeated their divine souls, involuntarily invigorating their spirits.
At the center of the courtyard stood a bamboo nearly a hundred feet tall, verdant as jade, like a peerless treasure in the world, its emerald translucent leaves shimmering faintly. Though it was but a lone bamboo, it was flourishing, with branches spreading as if opening up a Minor Heavenly Path.
The presence of this single bamboo filled the courtyard with endless vitality, its fresh aura bringing tranquility to the spirit, as if one were in a serene and beautiful miniature world.
Qing Ling Jade Bamboo!
Xu Yan took out the piece of bamboo given to him by Ming Yu; at this moment, it connected with the bamboo in the courtyard as if they were flesh and blood.
This piece was once a branch of the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo.
"Xu Yan, doesn't the bamboo look beautiful?"
Ming Yu walked toward the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo.
Xu Yan followed closely. The Qing Ling Jade Bamboo was planted in the center of the courtyard, surrounded by various divine objects.
Each of these divine objects was an exceedingly precious and rare treasure, at the level of Minor Heaven and Earth Master, each having given birth to Dao Principles.
They could be considered Heaven and Earth Divine Objects.
If they had Spiritual Wisdom, their power could rival that of a Realm Master.
At this moment, the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo stood like a Supreme Treasure, quietly growing. Although it was alive, it had no consciousness and was imperceptible to even the slightest trace of a Divine Soul.
"Has the Divine Soul dissipated, leaving only the physical form?"
Xu Yan unleashed his Minor Heavenly Eye, but all he could see was a misty white brilliance and a faint verdant hue; beyond that, nothing more.
"Was her Divine Soul obliterated in the great battle, or was it the doing of the Jade Court? Or could her consciousness still exist, only to be imprisoned?"
The closer Xu Yan approached the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo, the more intense was the bamboo's rich vitality.
"Such robust vitality; only my junior sister's Evergreen Dao Body could surpass it."
The Master of the Qing Ling Realm was not skilled in combat but was teeming with life, capable of reducing harm, healing others, and restoring their expended energy.
In that battle long ago, she had healed the Netherworld and Witch, helping both of them recover their lost energy.
Even riskier, she might have approached the battle between Taicang and the Imperishable Divine Master, intending to burn her Origin, to replenish Taicang and heal his wounds.
Of course, even the Netherworld was unclear about the specifics of that battle between Taicang and the Imperishable Divine Master, nor what Qing Yu had encountered.
"Xu Yan, the bamboo has always grown here, do you want it? Shall we cut a branch?"
Ming Yu suggested with a blink of her eyes.
"This bamboo is too precious; cutting a branch would mar its beauty, and I have no intention of doing so. It's just that this bamboo is very special, suitable for my contemplation."
Xu Yan shook his head.
"Oh, then shall we go back to playing chess?"
Ming Yu was intent on playing chess.
Xu Yan smiled wryly, "Ming Yu, you can go back and play chess with Xiao Jie. It could help refine your chess skills, otherwise, you'll never be able to beat me."
He paused then said, "I want to contemplate here for a while, to perfect some insights."
Ming Yu blinked, tilting her head as she looked at him, seemingly pondering something. It took a while before she said, "Okay, I'll go back and play chess with Xiao Jie."
"Mm!"
Xu Yan heaved a sigh of relief internally. Ming Yu had surprisingly allowed him to stay, giving him the perfect opportunity to investigate whether Qing Yu was now just a shell of a body.
"Xu Yan, you can't stay here too long, though, about a day's time at most. Then you must leave and wait three days before you can come here again."
Ming Yu suddenly reminded him again.
Xu Yan was momentarily stunned but did not ask for the reason. Since he could come again next time, he just wouldn't stay too long this visit.
"Alright, I got it!"
"Then I'll go back to playing chess with Xiao Jie."
After saying this, Ming Yu hurried back excitedly.
Xu Yan stretched out his hand to touch the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo, feeling its rich vitality, yet he didn't sense any presence of consciousness.
"If it is in slumber, or if its consciousness has been confined, is it possible to awaken it?"
Xu Yan hesitated. If it was merely asleep, it would be no big deal to awaken it, and nothing serious would ensue, but if the consciousness was confined, touching the confining powers would surely attract the attention of the Three Masters of the Jade Court.
In the end, Xu Yan dared not take the risk. Even though the Jade Talisman from his master ensured he needn't fear the Three Masters of the Jade Court, and could retreat based on it, there might be implications for Ming Yu.
"I'll cultivate here, reaching Establishing Dao Great Accomplishment as soon as possible, and I can also communicate with other Jade People. The Puppet Principle is indeed very unique and worth pondering."
Xu Yan immediately sat down cross-legged in front of Qing Ling Jade Bamboo and began to cultivate, feeling as if he were cultivating within the Domain, with the Spiritual Energy being gentle and mellow.
After locating the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo, Xu Yan spent some time playing chess and teaching Ming Yu, stopping by the courtyard of Qing Ling Jade Bamboo every few days to cultivate and deliberately allowing his cultivating aura to permeate the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo, to test whether the consciousness of the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo still existed.
Furthermore, Xu Yan had Ming Yu introduce him to other Jade People for communication. Before long, he was already familiar with several of the Jade People living nearby Ming Yu's courtyard.
Xu Yan discovered that, although these Jade People possessed the strength of the Master of Heaven and Earth level, their thinking was still dull and they would encounter mental blocks when pondering profound issues.
As he had guessed, the Jade Puppets of the Master of Heaven and Earth level operated Dao Principles, with a stronger consciousness for combat and crisis response.
Although their cognitive agility seemed not to have improved significantly, their sensitivity to danger had increased a lot.
As he unraveled the secrets of the Jade Puppets and learned how they operated, Xu Yan's Establishing Dao Realm also continued to advance, and he was on the brink of reaching the Great Achievement of Establishing Dao Realm.
"Yu Ting is truly a treasure trove!"
Xu Yan exclaimed, noting that Ming Yu's chess skills had improved significantly, as had her cognitive agility.
One day, Ming Yu took the initiative to inquire about the knowledge of the Divine Soul, seeking to complete the part she hadn't learned last time.
Xu Yan was of course extremely willing to teach. He had a strong interest in Ming Yu's thinking principles. In the last knowledge exchange, most of Ming Yu's principles had been outlined, with only the thought-related principles missing.
Or rather, the set of principles that simulate the Divine Soul.
Predictably, Ming Yu crashed again, and Xu Yan was already accustomed to it.
Time flew, and it had been two years since Xu Yan came to Yu Ting. He had almost visited every corner of Yu Ting and met at least once with every Jade Person.
However, he had never seen the Three Masters of the Jade Court. And Xu Yan always felt something odd about Yu Ting, though he could not pinpoint what it was.
These Jade People seemingly had no guard up against him, an outsider.
Such a defenseless Yu Ting should ostensibly be easy to infiltrate and conquer. However, the Imperishable Temple was extraordinarily cautious and attentive to Yu Ting, which indicated that Yu Ting was not as simple as it appeared on the surface.
Ming Yu was still probing the secret of the Divine Soul, and it appeared that a barrier was preventing Ming Yu from grasping it.
Though she had yet to understand the Divine Soul or how to comprehend it, her Spiritual Wisdom and thinking were getting closer to that of a normal person.
Ming Yu's progress was promoted bit by bit by Xu Yan, and he was increasingly aware of the difference between her and the other Jade People.
The other Jade People didn't seem to have the room for improvement or progression.
When discussing the Divine Soul, they showed no special sensation, seemingly having no feeling or inclination to ponder about the Divine Soul.
Once Xu Yan mentioned the Divine Soul, the other Jade People would blink, and then forget about it.
"Is Ming Yu's status so high because she is special and capable of continuous improvement?"
Xu Yan reflected thoughtfully.
He even suspected that the Three Masters of the Jade Court were secretly paying attention, allowing him to stay in Yu Ting, perhaps to have him facilitate Ming Yu's improvement and transformation?
"Ming Yu, how about I teach you how to cultivate?"
Xu Yan said with a smile.
"Cultivate?"
Ming Yu tilted her head and then nodded excitedly, "Yes, yes!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1086 - 561: Establishing Dao Great Accomplishment, Awakening Qing Yu
chapters.content:
"Teaching Ming Yu how to cultivate was a decision Xu Yan made after much thought; however, what he taught was only a simple method of cultivation, not the complete martial arts.
Moreover, a complete martial arts, given Ming Yu's intelligence, was beyond what she could learn at the moment.
Even a simple method of cultivation was extremely profound for Ming Yu, and it would take her a long time to master.
The cultivation methods Xu Yan taught started with the simple inhalation and exhalation of Spiritual Energy, and even so, Ming Yu couldn't understand it for a while.
After nearly half a month of patient instruction, Ming Yu finally understood how to guide the Spiritual Energy into her body and how to operate her own principles.
"What a strange feeling, I feel like I've become more active."
Ming Yu said excitedly.
For some reason, she grew fond of this sensation of cultivation, although it did not help her strength.
After all, at her level of strength, simple cultivation methods could not improve her power.
Xu Yan thoughtfully observed that as Ming Yu breathed in and out the Spiritual Energy, her Puppet Principle was operating, and parts of that principle seemed to be turning into meridians.
"If she cultivates from the simple methods to the point of condensing the divine soul, what changes might Ming Yu undergo?"
Xu Yan couldn't help but be curious.
"Ming Yu, the way of cultivation is about persistence, and with constant effort, there will surely be gains. Once you become proficient in cultivation, I will then teach you the methods of Divine Refinement."
Xu Yan said with a smile.
"Mm-hmm, I will definitely practice diligently, practice hard!"
Ming Yu nodded her head.
"It's time for my own breakthrough."
Having taught Ming Yu, Xu Yan headed to the courtyard where the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo was located.
Sitting cross-legged next to the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo, he began his breakthrough toward the Great Achievement of Establishing Dao Realm.
The Images of Heaven and Earth emerged from Xu Yan, and in an instant, the small courtyard seemed to transform into a miniature domain.
The Qing Ling Jade Bamboo stood within the domain, the Way of Domain appeared, and the entire Domain seemed to be growing stronger.
Xu Yan did not conceal his breakthrough; he even intentionally covered the entire courtyard with the Way of Domain, enveloping the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo.
The courtyard had become a mini domain, the Qi of Heaven and Earth, the Spiritual Charm of Heaven and Earth surged, and even the scenery within the domain changed constantly.
At one moment, the scene of the domain changed, becoming the likeness of the Taicang Realm, albeit a scaled-down version.
"Has the Divine Soul perished? Has consciousness completely vanished?"
As Xu Yan reached the Great Achievement of Establishing Dao Realm, he kept a close eye on the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo, even with his simulated scenery of the Taicang Realm, he was unable to awaken any possible consciousness in Qing Yu.
Even if her soul was bound, if there were any stirrings, signs should appear, and Xu Yan would detect them immediately.
However, the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo seemed to be just a bamboo without consciousness, showing no changes.
Xu Yan pondered briefly, as the Qi of Heaven and Earth slowly flowed over the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo, even touching the Way of Domain upon it.
"Since the Three Masters of the Jade Court haven't come out to stop me, they must either truly not be in Yu Ting or don't care about me awakening Qing Yu?"
Xu Yan mused.
"Whether it will be successful or not, this attempt will tell. If there is still no sign, then Qing Yu's Divine Soul must have perished."
The Images of Heaven and Earth were that of the Taicang Realm, and at one moment, a towering figure gradually emerged.
This towering figure appeared, causing a slight ripple in the Images of Heaven and Earth, as if he had a significant connection to the domain.
This towering figure was the same one Xu Yan had seen when he traversed the Great Wilderness in the past.
Taicang!
The towering figure Xu Yan had seen was confirmed to be Taicang!
If even the appearance of Taicang's figure didn't elicit any reaction from the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo, it could be nearly confirmed that her Divine Soul had perished, leaving only her physical shell.
As Taicang's figure emerged within the Dao Realm, the branches and leaves of the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo suddenly began to tremble slightly.
"The Divine Soul has not perished, consciousness still exists!"
Xu Yan felt secret joy in his heart while remaining vigilant for any movement from Yu Ting. Now that Qing Yu had been awakened, would the Three Masters of the Jade Court be stirred?
Yet, Yu Ting remained as calm as ever.
The branches and leaves of the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo trembled more and more intensely, until, at a certain moment, a gentle voice rang out, "Brother Taicang!"
The voice was tender, filled with deep affection and nostalgia.
The Images of Heaven and Earth began to fade, along with the figure of Taicang.
"Brother Taicang!"
The tender voice suddenly cried out in sorrow.
The Images of Heaven and Earth vanished, the courtyard returned to normal, and Xu Yan stood before the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo, watching the trembling bamboo leaves, sensing her consciousness slowly emerging.
Shasha!
The bamboo leaves trembled; the bamboo stems swayed, and a delicate and beautiful face appeared on the bamboo, looking somewhat ethereal and tinged with sadness.
"Who are you?"
Qing Yu looked at Xu Yan in surprise and uncertainty.
"My name is Xu Yan, I come from the once Taicang Domain."
Xu Yan said with a smile.
"The once Taicang Domain?"
The sadness on Qing Yu's face deepened, "Has the Taicang Domain also vanished?"
"The Taicang Domain has become part of history, but the Domain has not disappeared, it still exists, and has even grown stronger."
"What do you mean?"
Qing Yu frowned, "If Taicang has become history, why does the Domain still exist? And since you belong to the Taicang Domain, why are you here? Have you defected to the Divine Temple? No, that's not right, the Divine Temple would not allow a creature of the Domain to exist..."
Xu Yan explained, "Taicang has indeed become history, but the Domain has not disappeared; the Domain now is the Great Wilderness."
Qing Yu was taken aback, then somewhat angrily said, "If the Domain is still there, why call it the Great Wilderness? Has there emerged a new Master of Domain? Even if there is a new Master of Domain, that should still be the Master of the Taicang Domain, how could it be called the Great Wilderness? Where is Tian Zi?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1087 - 561 Establishing Dao Great Accomplishment, Awakening Qing Yu_2
chapters.content:
The one closest to Taicang knew all too well about Tian Zi's identity, even aware of some arrangements that Taicang had left behind.
"Great Wilderness Heavenly Path is Tian Zi; he inherited Taicang."
Xu Yan said with a light smile, "Tian Zi has the authority to decide the fate of the Taicang Domain, and now the Domain has changed from Taicang's time. A new Heavenly Dao has been established in the new Domain, naturally starting anew."
Qing Yu's brows furrowed, "How could Tian Zi..."
She then sighed, "Since it is Tian Zi, let it be. Let him do whatever he pleases; he's used to frolicking."
Not dwelling on the renaming of the Taicang Domain, still furrowing her brows, she looked at Xu Yan, curious, "How did you come here? Didn't the Imperishable Temple take action against the Taicang Domain?"
"Actually, I came here for you. As for the Imperishable Temple, they are about to make their move. Let's talk—I'm curious about some things."
Xu Yan pondered briefly, then asked, "I heard from Netherworld that you should have perished in the great battle initially; why are you here?"
Qing Yu was startled, "Netherworld, is he still alive?"
"Both Witch and he are alive, though the latter is severely injured and being pursued. Netherworld, on the other hand, is doing rather well; he is now one of the protectors of the Imperishable Temple."
Xu Yan wanted to see Qing Yu's reaction to this.
Qing Yu was completely stunned, murmuring, "Why, why did they survive, but my brother Taicang died?"
What followed was a grieving silence.
"Calm yourself. I will come to you again in three days."
Xu Yan checked the time; he had almost reached his limit of staying in the courtyard and had to leave; he could only return after three days.
Although he didn't know the reason for this time restriction or what would happen if he exceeded it, Xu Yan wasn't keen on taking the risk.
After all, it was something Ming Yu had warned about; there must be a reason.
Qing Yu did not respond, still immersed in her sorrow.
Xu Yan turned and left.
"Brother Taicang."
Qing Yu murmured to herself.
A Jade Person came in, carrying a jade bucket and poured the water in it over the bamboo roots.
After watering, the Jade Person placed a hand on the bamboo roots. A wisp of silvery light emerged from the palm, enveloping the roots.
The eyes of the Jade Person turned lively and looked up at Qing Yu's face, "Do you remember the past?"
Qing Yu looked down at the Jade Person, her expression bewildered, a vague memory surfacing in her mind, but not very clear.
"Sigh, as expected, you've forgotten!"
The Jade Person sighed, withdrew the hand, and as the hand was withdrawn, the lively-eyed Jade Person became somewhat dull.
But his aura had gotten stronger, and the Puppet Path Law displayed some changes.
Carrying the empty bucket, the Jade Person turned and left.
This scene felt so familiar; Qing Yu shook her head and said, "Who are you? Why do I feel so familiar with you?"
The Jade Person paused, seeming to ponder something, and after a long while said, "When you remember, I'll tell you!"
Having said that, he left without looking back.
Qing Yu was stunned; if she could remember, would she still need to ask?
"Why does this feel so familiar?"
She frowned; the scene was very familiar, but her memory was very vague; she couldn't remember when she had seen it before.
"When did I come here?"
Qing Yu tried hard to recall; in that battle, she had given her all, even burning her origin to assist brother Taicang.
All she remembered was that Taicang's entire body was cracking, and her own origin was nearly exhausted. At that moment, Taicang suddenly grabbed her and sent her away from the battlefield, letting her escape!
With that last glance, she saw Taicang's body crumble, the Dao Principles of the Domain disintegrate, and his essence extinguish.
Overwhelmed by grief, she lost consciousness.
She didn't know how much time had passed; in a daze, she found herself back in her original form, in this courtyard, seemingly being watered by someone.
It was that Jade Person, but the vaguely familiar scene was not what had been witnessed at that time, it seemed like something even more ancient.
Since that moment of regained consciousness, he had remained in deep slumber until just now when he had finally awakened.
"Where is this?"
Qing Yu, only now realizing her surroundings, began to inspect the courtyard, trying to figure out where she was.
But she found that she was unable to see beyond the yard.
Having successfully awakened Qing Yu's consciousness, Xu Yan was filled with anticipation for what was to come.
Qing Yu, one of the Seven Great Domain Masters, who had opened up the Domain, if she could obtain her Domain Dao Rule, it would enhance his own Establishing Dao perception. He believed he could soon reach the Perfection of the Way.
This was also one of the reasons why Xu Yan had always wanted to awaken Qing Yu, to obtain the complete Way of Domain, which could accelerate the pace of his own Perfection.
"I believe she won't refuse."
Xu Yan said with a smile.
The affection Qing Yu had for Taicang was incredibly deep. For Taicang, she could give up everything, naturally not minding presenting her Way of Domain for others to comprehend fully.
For the Domain Masters, their own Dao was the core of cores. Once known by others, they could find flaws to exploit, leading them to potentially catastrophic defeat.
Neither Netherworld beings nor Witches would ever fully reveal their Way of Domain to others, only Qing Yu might do so.
Ming Yu was starting to enjoy the feeling of cultivation, even though cultivating did not increase her strength. However, she enjoyed the process of cultivation.
Xu Yan, watching Ming Yu cultivate, couldn't help but feel thoughtful, always feeling like Ming Yu enjoyed the process, perhaps she once had such habits, but lost them for some reasons and now had only just reclaimed them.
Three days later, Xu Yan came to the courtyard again.
"Let's have a chat."
Xu Yan said, smiling.
Qing Yu looked at the young man before her, feeling the aura of the Domain's living beings on him, and couldn't help but feel a bit dazed, "What do you want to talk about?"
"About things we both want to know."
Xu Yan said with a smile.
Qing Yu hesitated briefly, then asked, "Where is this?"
Xu Yan was stunned, asking in surprise, "You don't know?"
Qing Yu shook her head, "I don't know. Although I had some vague consciousness, this is the only time I've really been awake."
Xu Yan was truly surprised and explained, "This place is Yu Ting."
"Yu Ting?"
Qing Yu frowned, obviously hearing this name for the first time.
"Another power outside the Divine Transformation Temple, and very special, but I won't go into details. You just need to know that Yu Ting's strength is not inferior to that of the Divine Transformation Temple."
Xu Yan didn't elaborate much about Yu Ting.
"I see."
Qing Yu did not continue to question but instead asked, "What do you want to know?"
Xu Yan pondered for a moment, then said, "I've talked with Netherworld, he mentioned the ancient battle, but I am still curious, how exactly did Taicang lose the battle with the Unchanging Divine Master? Did Netherworld stab him in the back?"
A sad expression surfaced on Qing Yu's face, "Netherworld did not betray anyone. It was just that the Unchanging Divine Master was too strong. At the last moment, Brother Taicang seemed to have encountered some issue and ultimately chose to use his remaining energy to send me out of the battlefield…"
Listening to Qing Yu's words, that battle, as described by Netherworld, wasn't much different. The only difference was that Qing Yu herself had approached the battle between Taicang and the Unchanging Divine Master, sacrificing her own origin to heal Taicang and restore his strength, thus she saw more.
At the final moment, Taicang seemed to have taken a step that transcended the Master of Domain, but something happened suddenly, and he ultimately chose to use his remaining energy to save her from the battlefield.
Of course, it wasn't just her, but included Witches, Ao Hong, and Netherworld, except Netherworld did not have time to escape.
"I don't know what the Unchanging Divine Master looks like, only Brother Taicang has seen his true face,"
Qing Yu said bitterly.
"Taicang Domain, tell me about it,"
Having calmed her emotions, Qing Yu asked softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1088 - 562 Qing Yu's Way of Domain, The Mysteries of Yu Ting
chapters.content:
After the great battle, the Taicang Domain had split into the Inner Domain, Spiritual Realm, Divine Realm, and Dao Realm, with an additional Border Wilderness Wasteland in the Inner Domain, a place where the Domain Spirit Spark had vanished...
Xu Yan described the current state of the Taicang Domain to Qing Yu, and how after the previous great battle, those who had survived, reciting how Tian Zi had transformed into Heavenly Dao, Taicang had changed into the Great Wilderness, Witch Demon Domain had merged into the Great Wilderness, divided Yin Yang, and established Reincarnation...
Qing Yu was stunned, the changes in this domain had completely exceeded her imagination.
"Heavenly Dao, Yin Yang Reincarnation..."
Qing Yu murmured to herself. The Great Wilderness was stronger than the old Taicang, it seemed the domain had been perfected, especially the existence of Heavenly Dao, which was simply unbelievable.
"Of course, the current Great Wilderness also faces the threat from the Imperishable Temple, and soon the Imperishable Temple will act against the Great Wilderness, especially since the Next Era is about to begin."
Xu Yan looked somber and explained to Qing Yu the meaning of the Next Era.
"Now, the Great Wilderness is fully preparing to cope with the Imperishable Temple. I have been traveling in the Land of Imperishable to enhance my strength so that I can suppress the Imperishable Temple when the great battle arrives.
"Tian Zi actually wants to avenge Taicang, but with his current power of Heavenly Dao, he probably can't do it, especially since there isn't enough time.
"I sought you out to comprehend your Way of Domain to perfect my own Dao, and achieve Perfection of the Way soon."
Xu Yan did not conceal his purpose and spoke outright.
"Can you kill the Unchanging Divine Master?"
Qing Yu gave a bitter smile, saying, "Even if you comprehend my Way of Domain and enhance your strength with it, you're still no match for the Unchanging Divine Master. He's very powerful!"
"But at least there's a chance, depending on whether you're willing to reveal your Way of Domain for me to comprehend. I need the complete Way of Domain to quickly comprehend and perfect my own Dao.
"Perfection of the Way is not the end; the sooner I break through to Perfection of the Way, the sooner I can break through the Creation Realm. Maybe I can achieve the Creation Realm before the Imperishable Temple acts against us?
"Once I enter the Creation Realm, I'm confident I can handle the Unchanging Divine Master."
Xu Yan spoke with a solemn expression.
Qing Yu pondered for a long while before asking, "The Martial Arts you cultivate seem unrelated to Taicang."
"Not hiding anything from you, it indeed has nothing to do with Taicang, but that's not important. You only need to know that we both have a common enemy, and that is the Imperishable Temple.
"I was born in Taicang Domain, and as a being of this domain, my conflict with the Imperishable Temple is irreconcilable. Therefore, the type of Martial Arts I cultivate is not important as long as it can counter the Imperishable Temple."
Xu Yan nodded honestly.
Qing Yu then asked, "What realm is the Creation Realm?"
"It surpasses the Master of Domain."
Xu Yan chuckled and added, "And besides, the Creation Realm is not the end, you only need to know that I have a chance to defeat the Unchanging Divine Master."
"Okay, then I'll assist you."
Qing Yu nodded seriously.
"Thank you!"
Xu Yan bowed with a smile: "You will feel wise about this decision."
"As long as I can avenge big brother Taicang, I'm willing to give everything!"
Qing Yu exclaimed bitterly.
"I'll come every three days, stay for about a day, and now it's almost time; I'll come again next time."
Xu Yan calculated the time, realizing it was time to leave.
"Then we'll start in three days."
Qing Yu nodded.
Not long after Xu Yan left, a Jade Person came in carrying a bucket and watered the bamboo roots, then placed a hand on the bamboo.
Qing Yu silently felt the water pouring on the root, like sweet spring, moisturizing her origin, enabling her nearly depleted origin to recover bit by bit.
Now, her nearly depleted origin had recovered about seventy to eighty percent.
"What kind of water is this?"
Qing Yu was shocked internally. She was a Master of Domain, and even then, a battle had nearly depleted her origin, and yet it could be recovered, showing the extraordinary nature of this water.
"Why do I feel so familiar with this water? It seems very familiar to me."
Qing Yu furrowed her brows.
This familiarity was not since her arrival at the Jade Court but from a very, very long time ago, which had become somewhat blurred.
"Who are you? Why do I feel so familiar, are you the Master of the Jade Court?"
The Jade Person withdrew their hand, showing a rare smile, "It's right for you to feel familiar. As for me, I'm just an old man of the Jade Court."
Taking up the empty bucket, turning around to leave, they spoke, "This Jade Court has seen generations come and go, only I have always remained unchanged, oh, and also Ming Yu, who stirs things up from time to time, then forgets herself and starts over. Now she's preparing to stir herself up again."
As the Jade Person was about to leave the courtyard, Qing Yu asked, "What's your name?"
"Me?"
The Jade Person paused their steps, seemingly pondering, and after a long moment finally said slowly, "I am called Ah Yi."
Qing Yu frowned, not knowing why, but this name again gave her a feeling of familiarity, though she could not recall where she had heard it.
With one foot already stepping out of the courtyard, Qing Yu couldn't help but ask again, "Can I leave Jade Court?"
"Why leave? Isn't it nice to be peaceful here?"
Ah Yi sighed and walked away.
Qing Yu frowned, convinced that she had seen Ah Yi before but wondering why she couldn't remember.
Three days later, Xu Yan arrived as promised.
"Xu Yan, do you know Ah Yi?"
The first thing Qing Yu did upon seeing Xu Yan was to ask about Ah Yi.

chapters.title: Chapter 1089 - 562 Qing Yu's Way of Domain, The Mystery of Yu Ting_2
chapters.content:
"Ah Yi?"
Xu Yan was surprised, "Who is Ah Yi?"
"You don't know either?"
Qing Yu frowned and explained the matter concerning Ah Yi.
"I see, this Ah Yi must be the first Jade Puppet created by Yu Ting."
Xu Yan understood in his heart, but he knew he couldn't reveal this.
If it was known that he had seen through Yu Ting's occupants as puppets, he might no longer be able to stay in Yu Ting.
"The strength of Yu Ting is formidable and mysterious. Since they mean you no harm, there is no need to probe too deeply."
Xu Yan considered for a moment before speaking.
"What about Ming Yu? Do you know that Ah Yi said Yu Ting has been through several generations of people, but only he and Ming Yu have always been there? And that Ming Yu torments herself every so often, forgets herself because of it, and then starts anew."
Upon hearing this, Xu Yan was extremely astonished.
"Generation after generation, does that mean the Jade Puppets die off periodically, or are they remade?"
Ming Yu too was not simple, tormenting herself now and then, ultimately forgetting herself and then starting all over. What was going on with that?
At this moment, Xu Yan felt that Yu Ting had too many secrets, especially the creator of Yu Ting, who was incredibly mysterious and whose power was a riddle.
"I'm familiar with Ming Yu. I'll ask her about it when I get the chance."
Xu Yan mused as he spoke.
"Now, let the perception of my Way of Domain begin."
Qing Yu did not continue to inquire and with a flicker of blue light, an apparition of Domain emerged.
Xu Yan sat cross-legged, and an Image of Heaven and Earth emanated from him, directly enveloping Qing Yu's illusion of Domain, a scene that astonished Qing Yu greatly.
"Is this... could it be that he has a Domain of his own?"
The Image of Heaven and Earth from Xu Yan gave her an incredibly realistic sensation.
From that day on, Xu Yan would meditate on Qing Yu's Way of Domain every three days, at the same time guiding Ming Yu in her cultivation, interacting with other Jade People, and contemplating the Puppet Path Law.
Time hurried by and after a while, Xu Yan didn't even know how long he had been in Yu Ting.
It seemed that the longer one stayed in Yu Ting, the less one could sense the passage of time and become insensitive to it.
With the meditation on Qing Yu's Way of Domain, Xu Yan gained significant insights, slowly completing his own path.
He was approaching Perfection of Establishing Dao Realm.
He also made no small progress in the Puppet Path Law. Xu Yan gazed at his own Domain, where the shadows of life in the mountains and rivers slowly became almost tangible, embodying a form, like a puppet.
However, these puppets were somewhat nimble and could rise with a sword, exhibiting even greater power when wielding it than the shadows of life.
Eventually, Ming Yu slowly reached the stage of condensing the soul in her cultivation.
Furthermore, Ming Yu's strength was changing, and she was very close to the level of Master of Heaven and Earth.
Xu Yan returned from Qing Yu's courtyard and saw Ming Yu sitting cross-legged, eyes swirling with radiance, and he couldn't help but fall into thought.
Three days had passed since she began delving into the refinement of the soul, and Ming Yu had fallen into this stagnant state.
"If Ming Yu could penetrate the Divine Soul and comprehend its significance, might there be some changes, or might she recall some of her past?"
Xu Yan pondered, and within Ming Yu's Puppet Principle, there seemed to be a barrier that prevented her from understanding the meaning of the soul.
It also appeared as though the Puppet Principle had restrained something within Ming Yu.
"The other Jade Puppets don't encounter issues because of the Divine Soul, and they directly skip pondering its meaning, but Ming Yu is exceptionally sensitive to the Divine Soul.
"Could Ah Yi be the same as Ming Yu?"
Among the myriad Jade Puppets of Yu Ting, only Ming Yu and that mysterious Ah Yi were the most unique.
However, Ah Yi had always avoided meeting with him.
"I'm about to break through to Perfection of Establishing Dao Realm, and when I do, could Ming Yu gain something if she were to observe?"
By invoking his own intent to Establish Dao, triggering Ming Yu's latent path, perhaps there would be unexpected gains.
Xu Yan made up his mind, deciding that during his breakthrough to the Perfection of Establishing Dao Realm, he would let Ming Yu also perceive the essence of Establishing Dao Perfection.
"It's about time to return to the Great Wilderness."
After achieving Perfection of the Way, it would be time to go back to the Great Wilderness. This trip to Yu Ting had been extraordinarily rewarding, surpassing expectations by attaining Perfection of the Way in such a short time.
Moreover, the Imperishable Temple should be making a move against the Great Wilderness soon, with the Next Era about to begin.
Some Jade Persons from Yu Ting had gone missing, seemingly leaving Yu Ting, no doubt in connection with the opening of the Next Era.
"The opening of the Next Era is the dawn of a new epoch, and it seems some changes will occur. Yu Ting is also making preparations."
This Era began with the emergence of Domain, with Taicang's seven people establishing their own Domain.
And now, with the opening of the Next Era imminent, what color will that light be? And what Creation will that light conceal?
"I must grasp this light; it might be my chance to break through Primordial and gain a clear understanding of the Way."
Xu Yan was confident. He was not far from the Creation Realm. The light that would appear at the start of the Next Era was his chance to rapidly break through Primordial or to understand the Way. He must return to the Great Wilderness before the opening of the Next Era to await its commencement.
"Cultivating the Divine Soul is just too difficult."
Ming Yu came back to her senses again, scratched her head, and wore an expression full of trouble.
"Even though the Divine Soul is difficult to cultivate, spending more time on it should allow for its condensation. I'm about to break through, and you can feel it when I do. Perhaps you'll gain something."
Xu Yan said with a smile.
"You're breaking through again? Xu Yan, your cultivation speed is truly fast."
Ming Yu's face was filled with surprise.
"Your strength has increased quite a bit."
"Oh right, I have grown stronger."
Upon hearing this, Ming Yu immediately beamed with joy.
That day, Xu Yan had fully replicated and mastered Qing Yu's Way of Domain, thereby perfecting his own path.
He was only a half-step away from the Dao Realm Perfection.
"Your Way of Domain is lacking and incomplete, which is why you are not as strong. You can try to perfect these few areas and fill the deficiencies."
With a wave of his hand, Xu Yan simulated Qing Yu's Way of Domain, pointing out the flaws.
Qing Yu was shockingly surprised. "How could you so easily spot my weaknesses? And even more than Taicang did."
Xu Yan chuckled and said, "My Martial Arts are naturally stronger than Taicang's. I Establish the Dao, both my own and that of Domain, and my insight into Dao Principles is sure to be stronger than Taicang's, never weaker!"
This was Xu Yan's confidence at that moment; even Taicang couldn't match his understanding of the Dao!
Having achieved Perfection of the Way, his strength wouldn't be weaker than Taicang's at the start, perhaps even stronger.
"The deficiencies of the Way of Domain are not so easily remedied, but thank you for your guidance," Qing Yu sighed.
"Three days from now, I shall break through to Establishing Dao Realm Perfection. You can try to sense my aura of Establishing Dao then. Ming Yu will be there too; you might both gain something.
"After the breakthrough, I will return to the Great Wilderness. The great battle with the Imperishable Temple should be approaching, and the Next Era will soon begin as well. Would you like to come back with me?"
After all, as a Master of Domain, Qing Yu's return to the Great Wilderness could greatly strengthen it.
"Can I really leave? Right now, I can't take on human form and can only exist in my original state," Qing Yu said helplessly.
"After my breakthrough, I can transplant you into the small Domain of the Prime Tortoise, and I'll take you back to the Great Wilderness. If you're willing, you can also ask Tian Zi for help, to become Heavenly Bamboo. As the Heavenly Dao grows stronger, so will you," Xu Yan suggested thoughtfully.
"Ah Yi might not let me leave," Qing Yu said hesitantly yet tempted.
"If you're willing, how could he confine you? It's for you to think about."
Xu Yan didn't insist further. Whether to go to the Great Wilderness or not was for Qing Yu to decide.
Back at Ming Yu's residence, Ming Yu had just recovered from a state of shutdown, her face full of joy, "Xu Yan, I feel I'm close to condensing my Divine Soul. I have a premonition—it's quite profound!"
"In three days, I'll break through, and with the essence of my Establishing Dao that you sense during my breakthrough, perhaps you can condense your Divine Soul in one go."
Xu Yan was also expectant; if Ming Yu managed to condense her Divine Soul, what changes might occur.

chapters.title: Chapter 1090 - 563: Ming Yu's Memory, Escaping from Yu Ting
chapters.content:
In the courtyard where Qing Yu resided, Xu Yan sat cross-legged, with strands of Dao Intent emanating from him without any concealment.
"Is the Master of the Jade Court really absent from the Jade Court? What attitude do they hold towards an outsider like me, or do they secretly harbor any intentions?"
Having been in the Jade Court for quite some time, Xu Yan had yet to meet any of the three masters of the Jade Court. He was curious why they allowed him to roam freely in the Jade Court and even contemplate the secrets of the Jade Puppet; what were they thinking?
Could it really be that they did not care and were not afraid of him mastering the secrets of the Jade Puppet?
As he broke through to the Dao Realm Perfect, Xu Yan did not hide anything. The Intent of Establishing Dao surged forth, and the Images of Heaven and Earth also appeared, enveloping the entire courtyard.
Apart from Qing Yu, Ming Yu was also beside him, blinking as she watched.
Perfection of the Way was just a natural progression. During his breakthrough, Xu Yan also took the opportunity to sense the Great Obscure Dao and to resonate his Dao with it.
At one moment, a profound feeling surfaced in his heart—his Dao seemed to touch the invisible Dao of the world, the laws governing the operations of everything in the world.
It seemed that he touched some law in operation within the Land of Imperishable, as if he saw that the Land of Imperishable was constantly expanding and operating in a certain manner.
Even without moving, he would invisibly shift from his original position due to the operation of the Land of Imperishable.
"Have I touched the Great Obscure Dao?"
A profound Dao Intent surged from Xu Yan's body. The Way of Domain seemed to undergo some changes, continuously becoming more perfect and smooth, as if the Dao had become whole without any weaknesses or flaws.
The Way had reached its perfect state!
Besides Perfection of the Way, it seemed that a trace of Dao Intent was resonating with the Land of Imperishable, sensing some obscure law, sensing the constant changes of the Land of Imperishable.
Qing Yu was suddenly struck with an enlightenment. At this moment, she gained a deeper understanding of the weakness in her own Way of Domain and almost subconsciously mended a weak spot.
Within the Dao Intent, Ming Yu's Divine Soul seemed to suddenly understand the law of condensation, as if it sensed some obscure rule.
The circuits in her mind were buzzing, the Jade Puppet Principle was manifesting, concerning her consciousness and thoughts. The Jade Puppet Principle seemed to be melting, as if becoming her Divine Soul.
At one moment, Ming Yu shook her head, and some unfamiliar images surfaced in her consciousness—these seemed to be extremely ancient memories.
"I think I have a Divine Soul."
Ming Yu murmured.
In her consciousness, she saw layers upon layers of dense networks, as if some rule was operating her Divine Soul, sealing her Divine Soul, and merging with her Divine Soul.
Because of these dense rules, her Divine Soul was merged with her body, allowing her to live!
Some extremely ancient memories emerged, but most of the memories were blurry. Among these memories, some names were extremely profound, as if they were the most important of all her memories.
Xu Yan had already achieved Dao Realm Perfection. At this moment, he watched Ming Yu's unusual behavior, his Dao Intent continuing to envelop her as he silently waited.
Qing Yu also curiously watched Ming Yu.
For some reason, she suddenly felt that Ming Yu seemed familiar, as if she had seen her a long time ago.
"If I had seen her, I couldn't possibly forget!"
Qing Yu frowned.
Ming Yu shook her head and opened her eyes. Her gaze was confused, seemingly a little lost, but her eyes seemed more human, more genuine, unlike a mere puppet.
"Ming Yu, what's wrong?"
Xu Yan asked softly.
"Xu Yan, I think I have a Divine Soul."
Ming Yu whispered softly.
A jolt went through Xu Yan's heart—could it be that Ming Yu was once alive and was then refined into a puppet while still alive?
Could all the puppets in the Jade Court have once been alive?
If so, where did these people come from? Could it be that the Land of Imperishable has a third power, and the Divine Souls of these puppets come from this third entity?
"What do you remember?"
Xu Yan breathed deeply and asked.
Ming Yu blinked, falling into thought as she tried hard to recall, murmured after a long while, "I have a Divine Soul, and there seems to be some issue, am I alive because of this body? I should be alive?
"I remember, a very long time ago, I and Ah Yi used to carry water to water the bamboo? Back then, the bamboo wasn't this big..."
Xu Yan was quite surprised and turned to look at Qing Yu. If Ming Yu's memory was correct, before Qing Yu developed Spiritual Wisdom, Ming Yu and Ah Yi had watered her, and perhaps Qing Yu's development of Spiritual Wisdom was related to this.
The water Ah Yi gave to Qing Yu was no ordinary water.
Qing Yu was also stunned; did she feel that Ming Yu was familiar because she had seen Ming Yu when she first developed her Spiritual Wisdom?
"Taihao, Exquisite Jade Mountain, The Seventh... what are these? I remember these."
Ming Yu tilted her head, recalling as she spoke.
"Uh?"
Xu Yan had not expected such a revelation, awakening some memories in Ming Yu.
"Taihao, Exquisite Jade Mountain, The Seventh? Ming Yu, is Taihao a name of the Domain?"
Xu Yan was beside himself with excitement, it seemed a great secret was about to be revealed from Ming Yu's mouth.
"Ah?"
Ming Yu blinked, "I don't know, I just remember this Taihao, and..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1091 - 563: Ming Yu's Memory, Escaping from Yu Ting_2
chapters.content:
Suddenly, the Jade Court trembled ever so slightly.
Amid the vagueness, it was as if a breath was awakening.
Xu Yan's expression changed; this breath was extremely terrifying. Even though he had reached the Perfection of the Establishing Dao Realm, he still felt a sense of powerlessness in the face of this breath.
Ming Yu's awakening seemed to have disturbed some presence in the Jade Court.
Could it be the Master of the Jade Court?
At this moment, Ming Yu's face changed. "This is bad, we're in trouble, run! If we're caught, we'll forget everything again!"
"Ming Yu, who is that?"
Xu Yan asked with a heavy heart.
"I don't know, but it's trouble! If we're caught, we'll be locked up, and after being locked up, we'll forget things."
Ming Yu was extremely anxious. "Xu Yan, you better run! If you're caught, it'll be trouble. At worst, I'll just be locked up."
At that moment, Xu Yan remembered what Ah Yi had said: Ming Yu would stir up trouble every so often, forgetting herself in the process, and then starting all over again.
Clearly, Ming Yu must have remembered something too, then got locked up, forgetting her past, and starting anew!
"Qing Yu, shall we go together?"
Xu Yan took out the Prime Tortoise Carapace and looked at Qing Yu.
"Okay!"
Qing Yu nodded.
Xu Yan's Domain Power surged out, instantly moving Qing Yu into the Domain within the Prime Tortoise Carapace. Now, Qing Yu was just a bamboo in its true form, which could temporarily be transplanted into the Domain inside the Prime Tortoise Carapace.
"Ming Yu, let's go!"
Wrapping Ming Yu in his Domain Power, Xu Yan hurriedly left the courtyard, heading straight for the outside of the Jade Court.
"Xu Yan, it won't work, go by yourself. If I follow you, I'll bring you disaster. That guy is terrifying."
Ming Yu shook her head.
"We are friends, and your ability to remember and stir up this trouble is related to me. How could I abandon you!"
Xu Yan spoke solemnly.
Ming Yu harbored a great secret, and her mentions of "Taihao," "Exquisite Jade Mountain," and "The Seventh" involved deep secrets. Xu Yan was also very curious about this.
"But, Xu Yan, you can't beat him. He's too terrifying."
Ming Yu was still worried.
"If we can't beat him, we'll just flee back to the Great Wilderness."
Xu Yan accelerated, taking Ming Yu with him as he rushed towards the outside of the Jade Court.
That breath was reviving, growing stronger and stronger. Even at the Perfection of Establishing Dao Realm, Xu Yan felt a sense of trepidation.
Too powerful.
Was this the creator of the Jade Court?
The other party seemed to be in a deep sleep, and it was because Ming Yu had recovered some of her memory and uttered the words "Taihao" that she had triggered the other's revival.
"The one reviving isn't one of the Three Masters of the Jade Court? Could it be that the Three Masters of the Jade Court are actually Jade Puppets?"
Xu Yan was inwardly shocked. If his guess was true, did the strength of the creator of the Jade Court compare to the Primordial or even to a Dao Practitioner?
If the one reviving was among the Three Masters of the Jade Court, Ming Yu would not be unaware.
"I wonder if Master knows who the creator of the Jade Court is."
Xu Yan thought quietly.
Taking Ming Yu away from the Jade Court, there was only the path back to the Great Wilderness; only his master could contend with this entity.
The breath behind them was growing stronger, and a wave of intention pulsed.
Swoosh!
The exit to the Jade Court was in sight, but just then, at the exit of the Jade Court, a Jade Person appeared, wielding a long spear, bursting with momentum.
"Halt!"
A Jade Person at the Master of Domain level!
Xu Yan did not slow his pace, raising his hand to strike out with a palm.
Aow!
The Golden Giant Dragon roared, Dragon Might surged violently like an enraged True Dragon, ready to perish with the enemy!
Divine Skills, True Dragon Rage!
The Divine Skill that Xu Yan, at the Perfection of the Establishing Dao Realm, had displayed was not something this Jade Person could withstand. Among Masters of Domain, strengths still varied.
Powerful as Taicang, slaying an ordinary Master of Domain was nothing but a minor effort.
And now, Xu Yan was confident that his strength was not inferior to Taicang's from before; thus, with a single palm strike, the Jade Person's spear broke, he was sent flying backward, his body cracking, resembling a jade sculpture about to shatter.
Xu Yan's figure streaked out, escaping from the Jade Court.
Boom!
An invisible fluctuation, centered on the Jade Court, rippled out. The Land of Imperishable stirred up a storm, and even a powerful force descended upon this area of the Land of Imperishable.
"Xu Yan, you're escaping by yourself, you've caused quite a bit of trouble, huh? I was just imprisoned for a while, you could have come to find me later."
Ming Yu said with a worried expression.
Xu Yan took a deep breath and replied, "Ming Yu, once you go back, you'll no longer recognize me, you'll forget about me."
"Is that so? I'll forget some things? How can I forget you? You're my only friend!"
Upon hearing this, Ming Yu became distressed.
"Don't worry, I can take you with me."
Xu Yan looked back and noticed that something seemed to have changed in the Jade Court. A sacred and flawless radiance faintly emerged from above the Jade Court, forming a humanoid shadow.
As this shadow appeared, the entire Land of Imperishable, amid the shaking, somehow felt the violent Spiritual Energy soften.
Moreover, a sacred aura seemed to have descended amidst the Chaotic Imperishable.
Xu Yan employed the One Thought Traceless Divine Ability, his figure instantly vanishing from the spot. At this moment, he dared not hold back, pushing the ability to its extreme.
With his Establishing Dao Realm Perfection strength, when executing this divine skill, his speed was beyond imagination; he had quickly left the region where the Jade Court was located.
Even so, Xu Yan still felt tense, sensing that he might still be within the influence of that shadow.
"What kind of power is this? Even if I break through to the Creation Realm, I'm no match. Perhaps only at the Great Accomplishment of Creation Realm, or even the Perfection of Creation Realm, might I be able to contend?"
Xu Yan internally assessed the power that the shadow had shown.
This was merely what he could sense; the true extent of the other party's power was unknowable.
"Why bother with such frequent troubles when you can't return?"
Suddenly, a thought intruded.
Xu Yan tensed up and couldn't resist looking back, but he couldn't see the Jade Court or the shadow anymore. Across such a vast distance, the other party could send their thoughts barreling in—such power truly was terrifying.
In that moment, Xu Yan was prepared to use his master's Jade Talisman to deal with the danger.
"Humph, I'll cause trouble if I want to!"
Ming Yu, of course, heard this thought and responded defiantly.
However, Xu Yan noticed an important message conveyed by this thought, stating that Ming Yu couldn't return no matter how much she struggled.
Return where?
Could it be referring to the third force in the Land of Imperishable?
"The Land of Imperishable is boundless, with too many unknown secrets."
Xu Yan sighed to himself.
He continued to flee at full speed, desperately.
Hum!
Suddenly, within the chaos, a pristine white light illuminated a region of chaos.
Thump!
Several figures crossed vast distances and arrived in an instant.
The Jade Persons from the Jade Court!
Xu Yan's face tensed up, knowing that if the one who had sent these Jade Puppets could arrive personally in an instant.
But they had sent Jade Persons instead, without moving themselves. Was it because they were confident in their status? Or was there another reason they couldn't leave the Jade Court too far?
Xu Yan leaned toward the latter.
"Stay behind!"
The Jade Persons surrounded him from all directions, the jade-white light illuminating the Land of Imperishable. Moreover, the lights from each of them interconnected, trapping Xu Yan within this circle of light.
"So strong!"
Each of the eight Jade Persons was incredibly strong, and their powers merged with each other, forming a state akin to a Combined Assault Technique. Xu Yan dared not be careless.
One-on-one, Xu Yan was confident he could slay any Jade Person, but facing the combined might of eight, the pressure greatly increased. What's more, if he forcefully slew a Jade Person and that individual personally descended upon him?
It was merely speculation that the other party couldn't leave the Jade Court too far.
Although he had his master's Jade Talisman, he still needed to be cautious, especially when facing such an unknown powerful being; it was better to be careful.
Xu Yan moved, charging directly at one of the Jade Persons, and slashed out with his hand.
The Sword Intent, capable of annihilating everything, instantly struck the encircling circle of light.
Puff!
The circle was slashed open, but it was quickly healing. One of the Jade Persons had already slapped down with a palm, its silver-white imprint seemingly wanting to "purify" everything.

chapters.title: Chapter 1092 - 564: Powerful Yu Ting, Great Accomplishment of Creation Realm
chapters.content:
In the boundless Land of Chaotic Imperishable, a circle of pure white light shone, like a firefly appearing in an endless, dim wasteland.
The imprint of the Jade Person seemed to purify everything, even the Imperishable Qi dispersed under its influence, as if it were being assimilated into the imprint itself.
Facing this strike, Xu Yan was not at all panicked; he continued at the same speed and slashed with his sword at the healing gap in the circle of light, enlarging the breach with a rip.
At the same time, with a wave of his hand, the Golden Dragon roared, and in an instant, eighteen Golden Giant Dragons burst forth. Three Golden Dragons met the imprint head-on, while the rest attacked the eight Jade Persons.
Boom!
The intense collision reverberated across the Imperishable Land, and the violent Spiritual Energy swept out like a storm in all directions. Xu Yan's figure had already escaped from the encircling light.
After breaking free from the enclosure, Xu Yan did not stop; he employed the Vanishing Thought Divine Ability, disappearing from the spot in an instant.
It was not out of fear of the encirclement by the eight Jade Persons but because one individual from Yu Ting was overwhelmingly powerful. For prudence, escaping was the best strategy.
Even if it became necessary to use his master's Jade Talisman, should he accidentally kill that individual, there might still be other formidable beings in Yu Ting, potentially leading to perilous situations.
"Where are you going!"
The voice of the Jade Person resounded, and eight beams of silver light chased after Xu Yan through the Chaos.
"Xu Yan, you are so amazing!"
Ming Yu exclaimed in shock.
"Average, average, I can't compare to that one from Yu Ting."
Xu Yan sighed.
"If I were powerful enough, I wouldn't need to run; I would just take down Yu Ting."
Hearing this, Ming Yu nodded thoughtfully. "Makes sense, still not powerful enough."
Utilizing his Divine Skills, Xu Yan swiftly moved through the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, heading towards the Great Wilderness. However, this place was far too distant from the region of the Great Wilderness; it would take more than a short time to get back there.
Looking back, he could still see the dominating silver-white light shooting towards him through the Chaos.
"The speed is terrifying!"
Xu Yan secretly tensed up. With his current strength at the Perfection of Establishing Dao Realm, employing the One Thought Traceless Divine Ability allowed him to outspeed any Master of Heaven and Earth, leaving them far behind without even a glimpse of his shadow.
Yet, these eight Jade Persons were also extremely fast. Although he was still increasing the distance between them, it would still take a bit more time to completely shake off the pursuit of the eight Jade Persons.
"Once I'm far enough from Yu Ting that their power can't reach, I'll be free to strike like thunder."
Xu Yan thought to himself.
The strength of these eight Jade Persons was even greater than that of the Netherworld.
Of course, since the Netherworld had lost the Qi of Heaven and Earth, it was somewhat impacted, and its strength had not advanced from the time of the great battle; otherwise, it would undoubtedly be stronger than these eight Jade Persons.
"Eight Jade Puppets possessing such immense strength, how strong then must the Imperishable Temple be? How many Masters of Heaven and Earth level does it hold?"
Xu Yan believed the Netherworld's speculation was correct; there must be some ancient Masters of Heaven and Earth level powerhouses hidden in the shadows, preparing for the Next Era.
Otherwise, based solely on known factors, the Imperishable Temple wouldn't compare to Yu Ting.
But the Imperishable Temple, while cautiously dealing with Yu Ting, did not show any fear at all, indicating the immense strength of the Imperishable Temple.
"Could it be that the strength of the Unchanging Divine Master is not inferior to that one from Yu Ting?"
Xu Yan pondered solemnly.
Or perhaps, the Unchanging Divine Master didn't know about that sleeping individual from Yu Ting, but only knew of the existence of the three rulers of Yu Ting?
However, one thing was certain, the strength of the Unchanging Divine Master had already surpassed the Master of Heaven and Earth level!
"Ming Yu, what place is Taihao? Can you remember?"
As Xu Yan watched the eight beams of silver light gradually disappearing, and that individual from Yu Ting not making another move, he couldn't help but ask.
"I don't know."
Ming Yu blinked, tilting their head in thought.
"How about Exquisite Jade Mountain?"
"I don't know!"
"What is 'The Seventh'?"
"I don't know!"
Xu Yan:...
How could you not know anything, Ming Yu's brain really isn't up to much.
"Ming Yu, have you remembered anything else?"
"Still thinking, it's a bit blurry."
Ming Yu expressed troublingly.
"No hurry, take your time, there will come a day you remember, just start with your own Divine Soul."
Xu Yan mused for a moment.
"Right, the Divine Soul."
Ming Yu nodded happily.
Seeming to remember something, Ming Yu said, "Xu Yan, you need to run faster; the third master may soon come looking for me; the third master is very powerful."
Among Yu Ting's three rulers, the third master had the best relationship with Ming Yu and seemed to value Ming Yu the most. Xu Yan was quite curious about the strength of these three.
"Ming Yu, what kind of strength does the third master have, and how does that one compare?"
Ming Yu tilted their head, pondering for quite a while before saying, "I don't know, but the third master is really, really strong, and so is Ah Yi; Ah Yi is also very strong."
Xu Yan took a deep breath, asking, "Stronger than me?"
If they were stronger than him, this meant that all three rulers of Yu Ting surpassed the Master of Heaven and Earth level, and Ah Yi also surpassed the Master of Heaven and Earth level.
Such strength in Yu Ting was likely more formidable than the Imperishable Temple, right?
Could it be that the Imperishable Temple had more than one individual who had surpassed the Master of Heaven and Earth level?
"I don't know how strong you are exactly."
Ming Yu thought for a moment before saying, "Ah Yi might be about the same as you? Probably not weaker than you."
Xu Yan understood then; Ah Yi had such strength, and the three rulers of Yu Ting must indeed exceed the Master of Heaven and Earth level.

chapters.title: Chapter 1093 - 564: Powerful Yu Ting, Great Accomplishment of Creation Realm_2
chapters.content:
Looking back, the eight silver beams were no longer visible, but Xu Yan did not relax because of this, continuing to flee rapidly, hurrying back to the Great Wilderness.
Only by returning to the Great Wilderness, with his master's support, would he truly be safe.
...
Great Wilderness.
In the courtyard of the Qinghua Sect, Li Xuan was as carefree and contented as ever.
Out of his five disciples, only Su Lingxiu remained, and even Su Lingxiu did not constantly stay within the domain, often venturing into the Land of Imperishable, but never straying too far.
Tian Zi was also busy strengthening the Heavenly Dao, even personally guiding Old Man Xiao and others on how to comprehend the Heavenly Dao and how to merge their own insights with it.
He was swamped with the task of guiding Heavenly Slaughter and the Seductive Witch along with other witch demons in the Yin Realm, all for the Yin Yang Reincarnation.
All the powerful beings of the Great Wilderness knew that a great battle was imminent, and they needed to urgently enhance their strength.
"When will the Great Wilderness produce a few Martial Artists with the strength of Masters of Domain, even the weakest would be fine," Tian Zi sighed, feeling somewhat anxious.
"Since we're cultivating the Heavenly Dao, instead of calling it Masters of Domain, it would be more appropriate to call it the Heavenly Domain," Li Xuan said with a smile.
"That makes sense!" Tian Zi nodded.
Cultivating the Heavenly Dao, even if their strength was comparable to that of the Masters of Domain, they were no longer Masters of Domain; thus, calling it the Heavenly Domain was most fitting.
"The domain is still not strong enough," Tian Zi said helplessly, before going back to the task of strengthening the Heavenly Dao.
Although the Great Wilderness was slowly growing stronger, the pace was not fast; unless several practitioners broke through to the Heavenly Domain, only then would there be a significant increase in the strength of the domain.
However, achieving a breakthrough into the Heavenly Domain was not so easy.
Old Man Xiao, being one of the first to comprehend the Heavenly Dao and one of the most talented, was still some distance away from breaking through; the others were even further behind.
As for Taihe, Taikun, and Taimiao, although they were Minor Heaven and Earth Masters and extremely strong, their understanding of the Heavenly Dao was still shallow. Moreover, as Minor Heaven and Earth Masters with their own Heaven and Earth Laws, they had their own paths to enhancement. Turning to the path of the Heavenly Dao required more thought, and they had no chance of making a breakthrough in the short term.
"Unless there's another surge in the domain, another emergence of domain creation, then we could use it to break through to the Heavenly Domain. And this would require the absorption of another Domain," Tian Zi sighed.
"It's a pity that that bastard Netherworld swallowed his own Netherworld Domain; how good it would have been if it had been given to me," Tian Zi fumed at the thought.
"Meow meow!"
Red Cat had returned.
Once a Great Demon King, now it was like an obedient big cat, rubbing against Li Xuan's leg.
"You big cat, if you want to go to the Land of Imperishable, then go ahead," Li Xuan said wryly with a smile, stroking Red Cat's chubby head.
Delighted, Red Cat went to bid farewell to Su Lingxiu and, together with Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha, entered the Land of Imperishable.
The Land of Imperishable was filled with countless True Spirits, all of which were resources for Great Demons like them to enhance their strength.
"I wonder how my senior brothers are doing now, whether they have encountered anyone from the Imperishable Temple," Su Lingxiu was starting to miss the senior brothers.
"And Blood Extreme, has he succeeded yet? Why is there still no message?" Su Lingxiu furrowed her brows.
It had been such a long time, yet there was no message from Blood Extreme; could it be that progress was not going smoothly?
Otherwise, according to the agreement, it was about time for a message to be sent back.
Not having received a message until now clearly showed some constraints, still being in a standoff with the Blood Demon.
"I hope Blood Extreme can gain the upper hand; if he's dead, then so much planning will all be for naught."
```
Ambushing the Blood Demon was merely an effort made in good faith; success depended entirely on Blood Extreme's own means and whether he could seize the opportunity.
In the Great Wilderness, the mighty were occupied with enhancing their strength to confront the impending crisis of the Imperishable Temple. With fewer conflicts among them, the world naturally settled into quietude.
By now, all the Realm Masters had reached an implicit understanding to face the impending disaster together. Only after surviving this crisis could they compete for the resources of Heaven and Earth.
Even more, they might combine their strength to advance the Domain and, consequently, themselves.
For the weaker ones, they remained blissfully unaware of the crisis the Domain faced, going about their daily activities and making vows to the Heavenly Dao as usual.
Every generation had its share of proud talents who rose to prominence in this grand era.
The Great Wilderness Martial Arts Academy, Qinghua Holy Sect, Three Hundred Cave Heavens, and more were names passed down among these prodigies, each carrying grand ambitions in their valiant hearts.
Sword God Xu Yan, Heavenly God Meng Chong, Alchemical Medical Fairy Su Lingxiu, Qinghua Sect Master Fang Hao, and Spear Demon Jiang Buping had become the pinnacles in the hearts of these prodigies.
For those cultivating the Sword Dao, their pinnacle was naturally Sword God Xu Yan.
And for those devoted to the Blade Path or the bodily cultivation, their pinnacle was naturally Meng Chong.
This was an era brimming with exceptional talents. According to ancient figures like Taihe and Taikun, only the times shortly after the opening of Heaven and Earth, during Old Man Xiao's generation, witnessed such a phenomenon.
What the Great Wilderness lacked was time; with enough of it, what was there to fear from the threat of the Imperishable Temple?
Yet Taihe and others knew that time was not on the side of the Great Wilderness, just as it hadn't favored The Seven Great Domain in the past.
Otherwise, why would The Seven Great Domain have fallen?
Now, their only option was to strive their utmost, to increase their own strength as much as possible before the crisis struck, relying on the power of the Heavenly Dao to resist being devoured by the Imperishable Temple.
Muxiao discovered that his state of mind seemed to have become much more tranquil, finding a sense of relief in every occasion of sweeping the floors.
Each time he silently swept and saw the Qinghua Sect disciples discussing Martial Arts or even sparring—seemingly weak in his eyes—he felt a cozy pleasure, like someone sitting above the fray, watching the world's turmoil.
"Sweeping away hostility, it seems I've nearly accomplished it. My heart is calming, and my state of mind is changing."
Muxiao found himself enjoying this quiet life, free from the hustle of completing tasks, from commanding True Spirits, and from constant busyness.
Instead, merely sweeping peacefully, settling himself down, observing the daily lives of Qinghua Sect's disciples, witnessing the myriad states of humanity.
"The height of the Taoist Ancestor's realm is beyond imagination."
The more he reflected, the more astounded Muxiao became by the Taoist Ancestor's realm.
Sitting there, sipping tea, enjoying pastries, reading books, he appeared at ease—as if all the turmoil of the world were mere play or fleeting clouds in his eyes.
"This Muxiao is about to become a master sweeper."
Li Xuan chuckled to himself. Muxiao's strength was akin to a hidden Supreme Expert within the Qinghua Sect.
"Sweeping away hostility, huh? Muxiao is indeed teachable."
Li Xuan wasn't surprised; how could one not be transformed if brought to sweep floors by the Taoist Ancestor himself?
Time hurried by, and under Li Xuan's guidance, Cai Ling'er had broken through to the Supreme Sovereign Realm, while Yue'er, Zi Yun, and others had all made significant advances in strength.
Ao Yuxue, the True Dragon, had also undergone some transformation. After practicing the Great Demon Method, she had cultivated the True Dragon Divine Skill, greatly enhancing her strength.
One day, Li Xuan took a moment to instruct Xie Lingfeng, and the Daoist Golden Book suddenly opened, pouring forth golden light and revealing images of the Dao.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has broken through to the Establishing Dao Realm by practicing the Martial Arts you created, while you have achieved the Great Accomplishment of Creation Realm."
Li Xuan was immensely pleased.
How long had it been since he ventured into the Land of Imperishable to see such a breakthrough to the Establishing Dao Realm? Truly worthy of being the pioneer of his Martial Arts.
"Great Accomplishment of Creation Realm, the feeling of strength growth is truly wonderful. With my current strength, a single finger could squash Taicang from before."
Li Xuan sighed with nostalgia. Great Accomplishment in Creation Realm signified immense strength, presumably invincible now. Whether it was Taicang or that entity from the Imperishable Temple, both could be easily suppressed.
"Only, I wonder if there are even stronger beings in the Land of Imperishable."
The Land of Imperishable stretched vast and infinite; could the entity from the Imperishable Temple really be the strongest?
Regardless, Li Xuan was confident that with his current strength, he could dominate the Land of Imperishable.
He was even stronger than the entity from the Imperishable Temple, easily capable of suppressing the entire Temple alone. How could he not traverse the Land of Imperishable with ease?
Suddenly, the Daoist Golden Book opened once again.
And this time, the golden light emerging from the book seemed to blend with the Dao itself, casting an even more unfathomable aura.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1094 - 565: The Primordial Realm, The Master Has Made a Move
chapters.content:
Li Xuan watched the surge of golden light from the Daoist Golden Book, unable to suppress his excitement. There was something so mysterious and unfathomable about it, as if it represented the fusion of all Daoist laws combined. He began to suspect something.
It was precisely because of this that, with his current strength and state of mind, he couldn't help but get excited.
"My top disciple, Xu Yan, has comprehended it so quickly?"
As his excitement subsided, Li Xuan's admiration for Xu Yan, who was such a prodigy, grew even further.
The golden light that seemed to blend with the Dao surged out from the Daoist Golden Book, turning into arcane and enigmatic runes that integrated with Li Xuan himself.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has comprehended the Law of Primordial, and you've broken through to the Primordial Realm."
As he had guessed, Xu Yan had indeed grasped what it meant to merge with the primordial.
Boom!
At this moment, Li Xuan felt as if he was undergoing a transformation. Once he entered the Primordial Realm, his strength was incomparably greater than that of the Creation Realm. Li Xuan could crush his former self from just a moment ago as easily as crushing an ant.
In just a short period, his power had drastically changed.
"Stable! I'm invincible now!"
Joy surged in Li Xuan's heart.
If reaching the Great Achievement of the Creation Realm wasn't secure enough, the Primordial Realm should undoubtedly make him truly invincible.
"This is Primordial."
Li Xuan marveled, finding the Martial Arts he had devised truly formidable.
Looking at the Daoist Golden Book, its usage ascended to a new level as he broke through to the Primordial Realm.
His Primordial Spirit held the Daoist Golden Book with a warm smile, gently turning the pages to the section on Physical Body Martial Arts, and with a small touch, a surge of golden light emerged.
Physical Body Martial Arts, elevated to the Primordial Realm.
Next were Alchemical Medical Martial Arts, Qimen Martial Arts, Extreme Soul Martial Arts, and finally, with another flip, even Great Demon Martial Arts was enhanced.
Now, his Ancestral Demon True Body also possessed the strength of the Primordial Realm.
Once in the Primordial, breaking through with just one Martial Art would allow the use of the Daoist Golden Book to lift all other Martial Arts to the same level.
In an instant, the Great Wilderness Domain lay before Li Xuan's eyes, seeing all living beings within the Domain as though the vast expanse was nothing but dust.
"The Great Wilderness has great potential."
Li Xuan inwardly sighed since the presence of the Heavenly Dao meant that the potential of the Great Wilderness was nearly infinite, capable of continuously consuming the Land of Imperishable. Eventually, it could replace it.
Looking up at the Land of Imperishable, the vast expanse of Chaotic Imperishable clarity came into his view, and he could see the changes occurring in the Land of Chaotic Imperishable.
The violent Spiritual Energy, the Imperishable Qi, all flowed, and the entire Land of Imperishable operated according to some rule, continuously expanding.
Such operations and expansion were on such a grand scale that even Masters of Domain found themselves unable to perceive them.
