"This is interesting, the Land of Imperishable is boundless and continuously expanding, constantly functioning under some law."
Li Xuan mused thoughtfully, as if he glimpsed the hidden Dao.
Everything resides within the Dao.
Profound and more profound, it is only by walking the Dao that one can see through it all.
"What lies beyond the Land of Imperishable?"
Even with his current strength, Li Xuan couldn't see the boundaries of the Chaotic Imperishable Land. It still appeared boundless at a glance.
"The rules of the Land of Imperishable are unique and powerful. If one wants to leave this land and venture beyond, only by walking the Dao is it possible."
Even in his Primordial Realm, he was unable to transcend the Land of Imperishable and look beyond to see what lay outside.
In some sense, the Land of Imperishable, with its chaotic expanse, was like a vast, enormous prison.
The domains developed within it were like delightful little gardens built in a dark and gloomy cage.
"There are indeed many Imperishable True Spirits, of many kinds and in great numbers."
Li Xuan saw Red Cat, Yu Xiaolong, and Little Ha consuming True Spirits and cultivating the Great Demon Method.
"Oh? That's quite interesting."
Suddenly, Li Xuan was taken aback.
"Xu Yan is not here, has he gone on to venture alone?"
In the boundless chaos, he spotted a massive Flying Boat, towing behind it a lifeless Domain.
Meng Chong, Fang Hao, Jiang Buping, and the Azure Sea Turtle were on the Flying Boat, slowly drawing the Domain towards the Great Wilderness.
True Spirits fled along their path, repelled by the lifeless aura of the Domain.
"This Great Wilderness is about to experience another major uplift."
A complete, albeit lifeless, Domain could help the Great Wilderness grow and improve significantly and quickly.
Given the current strength of the Great Wilderness and the perfection of the Heavenly Dao Rules, absorbing a lifeless Domain presented no difficulty.
Furthermore, the Great Wilderness was divided into Yin and Yang, and currently, the Yin Realm was somewhat too small. After all, the Witch Demon Domain was originally smaller than the Taicang Domain and had suffered some damage, making it much smaller.
As it stood, the balance of Yin Yang in the Great Wilderness was inadequate.
This lifeless Domain could be just the thing to expand the Yin Realm, also better facilitating the interface between Yin Yang, as well as the Path of Reincarnation.
The Heavenly Dao would thus welcome a significant enhancement.
"After this integration, the power of the rules of the Heavenly Dao, even if not surpassing the level of Masters of Heaven and Earth, won't be far behind."
Moreover, this absorption of a lifeless Domain also represented a grand opportunity to comprehend the Heavenly Dao, possibly leading to the emergence of Martial Artists in the Heavenly Domain within the Great Wilderness in a short time.
Someone like Old Man Xiao was very likely to break through to the Heavenly Domain during this event.
"Is that the Master of Domain from the Imperishable Temple? There indeed are many powerful beings in the Imperishable Temple."
Li Xuan looked towards a figure not far from the Flying Boat, flying rapidly closer, attempting to intercept Meng Chong and the others to snatch away the lifeless Domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1095 - 565: The Primordial Realm, The Master Has Made a Move_2
chapters.content:
"Since you've seen it, how can I let you bully the weak."
Li Xuan gave a slight smile, a flash of light in his eyes, then he shifted his gaze, looking towards other parts of the Land of Imperishable.
The massive Flying Boat, pulling the Domain along, smashed through mountains as it passed, with numerous True Spirits howling and fleeing in terror, avoiding it from afar—a significant commotion indeed.
"The commotion is quite big, if there are powerful beings from the Imperishable Temple nearby, they will surely come to attack."
The Azure Sea Turtle wore an anxious look.
"The commotion is indeed not small, but the attack from the Imperishable Temple isn't something we need to worry about too much."
Meng Chong frowned slightly and said, "What I'm worried about is if a Master of Domain-Level True Spirit is attracted over, that would be troublesome."
Fang Hao nodded and said, "Right, powerful Imperishable True Spirits, if too many come, it could exhaust the Jade Talisman, and we are still quite a distance from the Great Wilderness."
The Azure Sea Turtle looked towards the Domain trailing behind the Flying Boat and shook its head, "Don't worry, even the Master of Domain-Level True Spirits won't come close. The aura of deathly stillness in the Domain will make these True Spirits avoid it; they fear this aura of stillness."
Fang Hao said in surprise, "Even the Master of Domain-Level True Spirits fear it?"
"They shy away from such an aura of death, fearing to be enveloped by it. After all, True Spirits don't possess high levels of Spiritual Wisdom and will avoid the aura of death when they detect it instead of pondering over it, let alone approaching to investigate the commotion."
The Azure Sea Turtle explained.
"If that's the case, then we can be at ease. The powerful beings of the Imperishable Temple are not to be feared. I don't believe they can send ten or eight Masters of Domain our way."
Upon hearing this, Fang Hao immediately felt relieved.
"Ten or eight Masters of Domain are indeed unlikely; even if the Imperishable Temple had that many powerful beings, they wouldn't dispatch so many just for this Domain."
The Azure Sea Turtle shook its head.
The vast Domain, towed by the Flying Boat, was slowly moving along when a face again emerged from within one of the mountains.
Its eyes looked towards the Flying Boat dragging the Domain, a thoughtful expression on its face, then it glanced beyond the Domain, seemingly trying to determine where the Domain was being pulled.
After a long while, the face once again vanished into the mountain.
"Old Turtle, the Flying Boat is in your hands now, we're going to cultivate."
Fang Hao handed the Array Plate to the Azure Sea Turtle.
"No problem!"
The Azure Sea Turtle patted its chest in assurance.
After entrusting the Azure Sea Turtle with piloting the Flying Boat, Meng Chong and the others began to focus on cultivating, sorting through their recent gains, striving to break through to the Establishing Dao Realm as soon as possible.
Bringing the Domain back to the Great Wilderness would take time, and not a day of cultivation could be spared.
After an unknown period had passed, suddenly, Meng Chong and his two companions opened their eyes and moved in an instant to the side of the Azure Sea Turtle, their expressions grave as they looked outside the Flying Boat.
"A Master of Domain!"
The Azure Sea Turtle also looked and could not help but exclaim in surprise.
That powerful figure seemed astonished, looking at the Flying Boat and then the Domain trailing behind it.
All at once, it made a move, flying toward the Flying Boat.
Meng Chong's expression hardened. Facing a Master of Domain-Level opponent, the three together had no power to resist and would have to resort to the Jade Talisman.
Just as he prepared to use the Jade Talisman, he was shocked to see that the Master of Domain, who had been flying towards them, suddenly and silently, dissipated into nothing, not even leaving a trace of ash behind.
No signs of powerful attacks, no signs of strong fluctuations, not even a resistance from the Master of Domain—it simply melted away while flying in, leaving not even a speck of ash behind.
Gulp!
The Azure Sea Turtle swallowed nervously, trembling all over and half retreating into its shell, leaving only its eyes to look outside.
"How did it disappear? Is it dead?"
It was terrifying.
A Master of Domain, no matter how weak, was still a Master of Domain-Level being. To just disappear without a sound, to dissolve without a trace?
Without a hint of resistance or any sign of how the enemy had fallen.
At that moment, looking into the boundless Land of Imperishable, it seemed as if a great horror was lurking in the shadows, peering out from the darkness.
"Dead?!"
Meng Chong's eyes were flickering with light, scanning the surroundings; the Master of Domain was indeed dead!
Not a trace of its presence remained.
"How exactly did it die?"
Both Fang Hao and Jiang Buping were equally vigilant, wondering what kind of terrifying existence could cause a Master of Domain to silently fall, without even leaving a trace of ash.
The most frightening part was that they hadn't sensed any fluctuation, no detection of any powerful beings making a move.
Even as the Master of Domain was disintegrating, he could still sense that the power fluctuations of the other were real.
"Too terrifying, could there be some unknown force there?"
The Azure Sea Turtle tucked in its head, trembling as it spoke.
Fang Hao looked at him with an expression that said "speechless." This old turtle's courage was really too little.
After pondering for a moment, he waved his hand, and a puppet shot out and arrived at the place where the Master of Domain had disappeared.
The puppet wasn't very powerful, but it had the strength of the Divine Venerate Realm. Now, the puppet was bursting with power, scanning the surroundings.
However, the puppet wasn't attacked, nor did it dissolve into nothingness. Clearly, the disappearance of the Master of Domain had nothing to do with the Land of Imperishable.
"I know what's going on," said Meng Chong, pondering.
"Second Senior Brother, what is it?" asked Fang Hao, bringing back the puppet and asking with curiosity.
The Azure Sea Turtle stretched out its head, its giant turtle eyes staring intently at Meng Chong.
"Of course, it was Master. Who else besides Master has that kind of ability?" Meng Chong said with a smile.
"That makes sense!"
Upon hearing this, Fang Hao and Jiang Buping immediately understood and nodded in agreement.
The Master of Domain had been coming for them, and suddenly, he died without leaving a trace. Other than their master, no one else could have acted.
And only their master would possess such unfathomable strength.
"That's impossible, right? We are still very, very far from the Great Wilderness," the Azure Sea Turtle said, looking towards the direction of the Great Wilderness with some disbelief.
"What do you know? My master's power is beyond your imagination. To a weakling like you, of course, the distance seems immense, but to my master, it is but a step away," Fang Hao looked down on the Azure Sea Turtle.
The Azure Sea Turtle looked bewildered. Could there really be such a terrifying existence in this world?
Although he knew that Xu Yan's master was incredibly powerful, this was too unbelievable!
"So it seems, it must have been the senior who took action!"
Other than that senior, indeed no other powerful being would act, nor would any other have such inconceivable strength.
Even the one from the Imperishable Temple couldn't possibly do it.
In the Hong Ze Domain, a head peeked out from a mountain peak at this moment, looking towards the Land of Imperishable.
The spot it looked at was exactly where the Master of Domain from the Imperishable Temple had vanished.
The Jade Person's eyes showed both shock and confusion, as though she couldn't understand how that powerful being could suddenly disappear without a trace.
Deep in thought, the Jade Person, because she was thinking too hard, forgot to retract her head back into the mountain and simply stared straight at the Land of Imperishable.
It seemed that the disappearance of the Master of Domain was too enigmatic, and the Jade Person appeared to be somewhat stuck in her thoughts.
Meng Chong, along with the three others and the turtle, were all extremely excited. Their master had acted, causing a Master of Domain with ill intentions to die leaving not even ashes behind. Their journey was sure to be extraordinarily smooth, no longer needing to worry about powerful opponents attacking.
None of the three humans and the turtle looked towards the silent Hong Ze Domain, otherwise, they would see a head on a high mountain, staring straight at the Land of Imperishable.
"Old turtle, you continue to control the Flying Boat, towing the Domain; we're going to cultivate," Meng Chong said, patting the Azure Sea Turtle.
"Sure, no problem, leave it to me!"
The Azure Sea Turtle was thrilled, exceedingly glad for having made friends with Xu Yan in the past.
From then on, he also had an immensely fearsome backing.
From then on, the Flying Boat, towing the Domain, continued advancing towards the Great Wilderness, and the head on the mountain finally began to move.
It slowly retracted into the mountain.
Inside the mountain, the Jade Person who had merged with the mountain itself as if she were a piece of the mountain stone still had a look of doubt in her eyes.
She mumbled to herself softly: "What's going on? Suddenly gone, killed? Impossible, there were no signs of the attack being felt.
"Could it be that guy's secret technique, appearing dead but actually hiding? Could he have slipped into the Domain?"
Thinking this, the Jade Person walked out from the mountain, her body continually shrinking, until she became the size of a normal person, and began investigating the silent Domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1096 - 566: Guidance from the Taoist Ancestor, Message from Blood Extreme
chapters.content:
The Master of the Domain was naturally extremely powerful, but for Li Xuan in the Primordial Realm, he could make him disappear without a sound with just a glance.
What seemed a far distance, to Li Xuan, was like ants within sight, mere ants under his Eye of the Heavenly Dao.
"The Imperishable Temple is quite far from the Great Wilderness."
Li Xuan looked towards the Land of Imperishable and did not find the Imperishable Temple within his sight, indicating that the temple was still extremely far from the Great Wilderness, already beyond his visual range.
"The Land of Imperishable is so vast and boundless, existing who knows how many eons, could there only be the Imperishable Temple as a power?"
Li Xuan pondered, logically, there should be more than one power like the Imperishable Temple.
"Could it be, the powers that appeared in the past, were all extinguished by the Imperishable Temple like The Seven Great Domain?"
This possibility still existed.
"Within the Imperishable True Spirits, there must be extremely powerful ones, and some with high Spiritual Wisdom, although rare, they certainly exist."
Li Xuan was certain, since the Unchanging Divine Master, Taicang, and others could develop wisdom, among the numerous types of Imperishable True Spirits, there must also be some that developed Spiritual Wisdom.
You see, like the True Dragons of today's Great Wilderness, they were formerly Imperishable True Spirits that distinguished themselves due to developing Spiritual Wisdom.
So it must be that there are also True Spirits who have developed Spiritual Wisdom but have not chosen to establish their own Domain and still live in the Land of Imperishable.
"After settling matters with the Imperishable Temple, it is also time to roam the Land of Imperishable and wander around. I have already taught all the Martial Arts, and it only remains for Xu Yan to comprehend how to follow the path.
"Once he begins his path, I should also look beyond the Land of Imperishable to see what it looks like."
Li Xuan had made up his mind.
He couldn't possibly stay in the Great Wilderness forever, as the Domain was too insignificant to him.
The vast and boundless Land of Imperishable was worth exploring, and he was also curious about what laid beyond the Land of Imperishable.
On this day, a dragon came to the Qinghua Sect, prostrating itself on the ground, exclaiming, "Ao Lie pays respects to our Ancestor, seeking guidance from the Ancestor!"
Everyone was stunned, the master of the True Dragon Cave Heaven, Ao Lie, had actually come to Qinghua Sect to pay respects to an ancestor?
Since when was an ancestor of the True Dragon Clan at Qinghua Sect?
"Grandfather, what are you doing here? There's no ancestor here!"
Ao Yuxue hurried over, trying to lift Ao Lie, but Ao Lie glared at her, "What do you know? The ancestor of our True Dragon Clan is quietly residing in Qinghua Sect!"
"Grandfather, that's not the True Dragon Clan's ancestor!"
Ao Yuxue became anxious; it was a True Dragon spontaneously created by Taoist Ancestor, not their True Dragon Clan's ancestor.
The True Dragon Clan's ancestor was the True Spirit Domain Master, her great grandfather Ao Hong!
"You're too young to know the secrets of our True Dragon Clan. We have a mysterious ancestor passed down orally by each generation's clan head. I never imagined our incredibly powerful ancestor would be so low-profile, living secretly here!"
Ao Lie declared confidently.
"Ao Lie seeks the guidance of the ancestor, praying for instruction on where our True Dragon Clan should head next, how to break through our shackles! Please, Ancestor, show mercy and guide your unworthy descendant!"
Ao Lie earnestly started kowtowing.
Ao Yuxue was flustered, turning her gaze toward the direction of a small courtyard; that was their ancestor, Taoist Ancestor, not their True Dragon Clan's ancestor. Was her grandfather becoming senile?
"Could it be?"
Ao Yuxue glanced at her grandfather, blushing with embarrassment; her grandfather was shamelessly trying to assign an ancestor to the True Dragon Clan overhead.
If her great grandfather knew about this, he would be absolutely furious!
"Grandfather, if great grandfather knew about this..."
Ao Lie glared at her again, "It was your great grandfather who said we in the True Dragon Clan have an incredibly powerful ancestor!"
Ao Yuxue opened her mouth but couldn't find words, stomping her foot and turning away.
"Taoist Ancestor..."
Upon reaching the small courtyard, Ao Yuxue, lowering her head, her face blushed with shame.
Li Xuan chuckled silently, Ao Lie really did have thick skin yet was also very opportunistic and knew how to seize chances.
"Opportunity is always there for those who know how to seize it."
Li Xuan smiled merrily and waved his hand, a radiant light fell upon Ao Lie, who was prostrated on the ground seeking to meet the "ancestor."
"Go back."
Ao Lie was overjoyed, fervently kowtowing nine times, "Thank you, Ancestor!"
Excited, he turned and left, returning to the True Dragon Cave Heaven.
That radiance, filled with the aura of the Heavenly Dao, Ao Lie was confident that he would soon become a True Dragon of the Heavenly Domain, comparable to his father!
Even perhaps, he could become stronger, surpassing his own father and, one day, stand shoulder to shoulder with Taicang!
Ao Yuxue blinked, looking back in the direction her grandfather had left, her expression slightly embarrassed, and she bowed in thanks, "Thank you, Taoist Ancestor, for granting my grandfather this opportunity!"
"All is karmic destiny!"
Li Xuan spoke warmly, smiling.
At his level, he had gained deeper understanding of the word "karma," finally realizing why the wise always value the word so much.
Karma reaches one, but it requires one's own effort to seize it.
Like Ao Yuxue, although she was demoted by Xu Yan, she had seized her karma. Ao Lie also did so; initially addressing him as his ancestor too was seizing his karmic opportunity, thereby creating a slight connection with him, the Taoist Ancestor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1097 - 566: Guidance from the Taoist Ancestor, Message from Blood Extreme_2
chapters.content:
Ao Yuxue had a close relationship with Su Lingxiu and had also won the heart of Xu Yan's mother. Besides, the girl was indeed adorable.
Many Realm Masters yearned for the guidance of a Taoist Ancestor as soon as Ao Lie sought it out, and they were quite moved. Ultimately, however, they sighed in resignation for they knew it important to be aware of one's own limitations; to forcibly seek such a chance would only invite displeasure.
Taihe and Taikun, due to their peculiar illnesses, received treatment from Su Lingxiu. Although they didn't get direct guidance from the Taoist Ancestor, they now had a connection to the true transmission of the Tao and that was a fortunate opportunity in itself.
Furthermore, as confidants of Taicang and part of the older generation that followed him, they also received care from Tian Zi and so were content.
"Taimiao, seeks an audience with the senior!"
Outside the courtyard, Taimiao spoke respectfully.
"Come in."
Li Xuan was not surprised by Taimiao's arrival; the other Realm Masters wouldn't dare to come, nor would he see them. Taimiao, however, had some connections and it was expected he would come seeking guidance.
Previously, he had asked for enlightenment through Xin Mengrou.
Taimiao glanced at Muxiao, who was quietly sweeping in the courtyard, and couldn't help but marvel at the elder's unfathomable nature. Here was a Master of Domain, humbly sweeping and completely content.
Seeing Muxiao's demeanor—so at peace compared to his former violence—truly seemed as if his entire being had been cleansed of its malevolence!
"Greetings, senior!"
Upon entering the courtyard, Taimiao respectfully saluted.
"Hm!"
Li Xuan nodded.
"Speak of any doubts you have."
"Yes!"
Taimiao spoke with reverence, "Junior's Taimiao Illusionary Path and Taimiao Supreme Sovereign Path have merged with the guidance of the senior. I have overcome my inner barriers, but now I find myself puzzled—should I continue on the Illusionary Sovereign Path, or fully comprehend the Heavenly Dao and pursue the path of the Heavenly Dao?"
Li Xuan smiled and said, "The Heavenly Dao is the supreme path. Though not the profound and unfathomable Great Dao, it is second only to it, and yet it is linked to the Great Dao. Every path pursued by Martial Artists of this world is contained within the Heavenly Dao.
"Your Illusionary Sovereign Path is also within the domain of the Heavenly Dao, unable to surpass nor compare to the Heavenly Dao.
"You comprehending the Heavenly Dao and cultivating your own Illusionary Sovereign Path will allow you to go farther and never lose your way.
"The Heavenly Dao is not merely a Martial Path, it is not a single way of Martial Arts. Rather, it is the supreme way of the Domain, whether it be Taicang Martial Arts or Supreme Illusionary Path, all of the Martial Paths and Cultivation Techniques are encompassed by the Heavenly Dao."
Taimiao was taken aback, suddenly realizing that his understanding of the Heavenly Dao had been flawed, mistaking it for just another, albeit more powerful, Martial Path.
In reality, the Heavenly Dao was not just another path of Martial Arts, but the supreme way of the Domain, surpassing all Martial Arts and encompassing all within it.
"Thank you for the guidance, senior. Junior understands now!"
Taimiao saluted respectfully.
"Hm!"
Li Xuan flicked his finger, and a strand of brilliant light entered Taimiao's body. "Reflect on this well. Given your current state, breaking through to the Heavenly Domain should not be far off."
"Yes, thank you for this opportunity, senior!"
Taimiao was thrilled; it was an understanding of the Heavenly Dao.
"Should I take some time to explain the Dao again?"
After Taimiao left, Li Xuan began to ponder.
As a Taoist Ancestor, expounding the Dao was natural, and doing so could yield benefits and could also strengthen the martial forces of the Great Wilderness.
Looking up towards the Land of Imperishable, the massive Flying Boat pulling the Domain slowly towards them, Li Xuan made a decision.
"After the Great Wilderness assimilates this Domain, then I'll expound the Dao. It will allow some people to take this chance to break through to the Heavenly Domain."
Having made his decision, Li Xuan leisurely sipped his tea while offering some pointers to his maid Cai Ling'er's cultivation.
"The Jade Court?"
Su Lingxiu raised her eyebrows, as Blood Extreme finally sent a message back, bringing with it an unexpected discovery.
The Jade Court was another force outside of the Imperishable Temple and its strength was not inferior to that of the Imperishable Temple.
Su Lingxiu found Taihe and Taikun—the two among the oldest of the generation and confidants of Taicang who had luckily survived the great war—to be more knowledgeable than the others.
"The Jade Court?"
Taihe was stunned, finding it somewhat incredulous, "Aside from the Imperishable Temple, there's another force?"
"We're hearing of this for the first time as well."
Taikun also showed a surprised expression.
"Neither of you knows of the Jade Court?"
Su Lingxiu was taken aback.
"We do not know; we have never heard of it. Even Taicang elder brother never mentioned it; most likely not even he knew of it, otherwise, he surely would have spoken of it."
Taihe spoke in a heavy voice,
"If we had known back then that there was another power beyond the Imperishable Temple, we would have sought out this power to balance the threat of the Imperishable Temple."
Taikun said with a grave expression,
"Is there a possibility that not only the Imperishable Temple took action back then, but the Jade Court was also involved?"
Su Lingxiu thought for a moment and asked,
"The likelihood isn't high."
Taihe pondered for a bit and said, "The aura of those from the Imperishable Temple is quite recognizable, and since the Jade Court is another faction, their aura should be distinct from the people of the Imperishable Temple."
Su Lingxiu thought that made sense. Since both Taihe and Taikun were unaware of the Jade Court's existence, she would have to ask her master.
"Master, Master, do you know about the Jade Court? Blood Extreme transmitted a message that in addition to the Imperishable Temple, there's also a power called the Jade Court."
Li Xuan was startled. There was another power besides the Imperishable Temple?
The Jade Court!
If there is a second, could there be a third, a fourth?
What is the strength of the Jade Court?
"Is my strength at the Primordial Realm not enough to be invincible?"
Li Xuan muttered to himself.
"No matter how strong the Jade Court is, it should be similar to the Imperishable Temple, right? Even if it's twice as strong, what of it? I'm already at the Primordial Realm and fear nothing."
Li Xuan thought again; with his current strength, there could be no opponents left. He could kill the Master of Domain with just a glance, and even the formidable Taicang of the past could not withstand his gaze!
Li Xuan naturally did not know what kind of power the Jade Court was, but as a Taoist Ancestor, how could he remain completely ignorant?
"The Jade Court, huh."
Li Xuan said with a smile, "Since you're curious, work hard on your cultivation. Once you reach the right level of strength, you will naturally understand. Why ask so much? All the unknowns in this world are merely a matter of strength. With sufficient power, the so-called unknowns, the so-called secrets, are all trivial."
Li Xuan had long been clear on how to answer such questions.
"It's again a matter of insufficient strength!"
Su Lingxiu was frustrated and nodded her head, "I understand, Master. I'll definitely work hard on my cultivation and strive to break through to the Establishing Dao Realm, the Creation Realm, the Primordial Realm, and even further along the path."
"I'm glad you think this way," said Li Xuan with a smile.
Since the master wouldn't say more, Su Lingxiu had no choice but to find a way to get more information from Blood Extreme.
Su Lingxiu hurried away, but Shi'er overheard her question and was also extremely curious. How did another Jade Court suddenly pop up?
Seeing Muxiao sweeping the floor, Shi'er had an idea. Since Muxiao was a power from the Imperishable Temple, he must know about the Jade Court, right?
"Muxiao, I have a question for you."
Shi'er cleared his throat and said.
"Ask away!"
Muxiao continued sweeping the floor, nodding his head in response.
To Muxiao, Shi'er might not be strong, but as someone close to the Taoist Ancestor, who had also given him guidance on seizing opportunities, Muxiao was grateful.
"Do you know about the Jade Court?"
Shi'er asked curiously.
Muxiao paused in sweeping, looked at Shi'er in surprise, and nodded, "I know!"
Shi'er was overjoyed and said, "Tell me, what is it like, the Jade Court?"
"The Jade Court is very powerful, but my knowledge about them isn't extensive. I only know that the people from the Jade Court are a bit strange. They have jade-white bodies, which makes them easily recognizable..."
Muxiao shared what he knew about the Jade Court.
"So that's how it is!"
Shi'er finally understood and asked again, "How does the Jade Court's strength compare to the Imperishable Temple?"
"I don't know."
Muxiao shook his head, "The Jade Court is very strong, but how it compares to the Divine Temple, I don't know. It should not be weaker than the Temple, right? The strong ones in the Temple are very cautious about the Jade Court!"
"That means the Jade Court is not weaker than the Divine Temple."
Shi'er was astonished.
"That's hard to say. If the Master of the Jade Court is not as strong as the Divine Master, then naturally it would be inferior to the Divine Temple. As to how powerful the Jade Court is, I do not know; I have never crossed hands with any of their powerful individuals."
Muxiao pondered for a moment and said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1098 - 567: Returning with the Pull of the Domain, Shocking the Great Wilderness
chapters.content:
Shi'er's conversation with Muxiao was crystal clear to Li Xuan, giving him some insight into Yu Ting.
"Although Yu Ting has suddenly emerged, their strength is just so-so. I'm still invincible."
Li Xuan's heart relaxed; with his current strength, he had truly attained the supreme power of a Taoist Ancestor.
Looking up at the Land of Imperishable, it stretched boundless and he saw neither the Imperishable Temple nor Yu Ting, meaning both were extremely far from the Great Wilderness Domain.
At this moment, Su Lingxiu went to Canglan Island to find Tian Zi, "Tian Zi, do you know about Yu Ting?"
After all, Tian Zi was Taicang's "son" and had much closer relations than Taihe or Taikun. If Taicang had any last words or secrets, he might tell Tian Zi.
"Yu Ting? I don't know."
Tian Zi was startled, "What is Yu Ting?"
Su Lingxiu was full of frustration, "How do you also not know? Blood Extreme sent a message; he learned from Blood Demon about another force beyond the Imperishable Temple, called Yu Ting."
Tian Zi looked surprised, "There's another force? Ask Taihe and Taikun then, those two old fellows should know more than me."
"I asked them already, it's their first time hearing it."
Su Lingxiu shook her head.
"Send a message to Blood Extreme then, let him inquire about some news of Yu Ting."
Tian Zi scratched his head as he spoke.
"Communicating with Blood Extreme is complicated, and he can't reply immediately since the method we've established to communicate with him is quite special."
Su Lingxiu said helplessly.
"Miss, have you forgotten Muxiao? Isn't he a strong warrior of the Imperishable Temple? Just ask him."
Zhou Ying reminded from the side.
"Oh right, how could I forget him? I still haven't dissected him."
Su Lingxiu's eyes lit up; how could she have forgotten about Muxiao?
"Thank you Aunt Zhou for reminding me, I will go find him now."
"Let's go together!"
Tian Zi was also very curious. He directly utilized the Power of Heavenly Dao, taking Su Lingxiu with him, and in an instant, they arrived at Qinghua Sect.
He was the Heavenly Dao; anywhere within the Great Wilderness Domain could be reached in a thought.
"Muxiao, stop sweeping for a moment!"
Su Lingxiu excitedly put Muxiao's broom to the side as she spoke.
No sooner had Shi'er finished introducing Yu Ting and left, than Su Lingxiu and Tian Zi suddenly appeared. Su Lingxiu's excited manner made Muxiao's skin crawl.
He knew she had long wanted to dissect him, and thought he had dodged the bullet, only to realize it was still coming.
"Can you make me lose consciousness? So I won't be aware of being dissected, just let me sleep through it, okay?"
Muxiao's voice trembled slightly.
Being conscious while being dissected was too horrifying, even he couldn't bear it.
Su Lingxiu was taken aback, then delightedly said, "Since you've agreed, it's settled then. Don't worry, you won't feel a thing, after a sleep, when you wake up, it would be as if nothing had happened.
"But, there's no rush on this. We came to ask if you know about Yu Ting?"
Muxiao was startled, "You came to ask about Yu Ting?"
"Yes!"
Su Lingxiu nodded.
Muxiao wished he could slap himself, and with a pained expression, he said, "About that dissection, you see..."
"You've agreed already; going back on your word isn't allowed, you know that as a disciple of a Taoist Ancestor..."
Su Lingxiu's expression turned serious.
"No take-backs, no take-backs!"
Muxiao quickly waved his hands.
"That's good. A disciple of a Taoist Ancestor must never go back on their word!"
"Yes, yes!"
Muxiao nodded.
"Now, I'm already recognized as a disciple of a Taoist Ancestor? Even if I'm dissected, it's worth it!"
Muxiao consoled himself internally.
Regardless of what Muxiao was thinking, Su Lingxiu excitedly continued to inquire about Yu Ting.
Muxiao shared everything he knew about Yu Ting, "Yu Ting is quite mysterious, my understanding is limited."
After Su Lingxiu and Tian Zi gained a basic understanding of Yu Ting, they no longer bothered Muxiao with his sweeping.
"I'll come find you in a few days."
Su Lingxiu said smilingly as she left.
Muxiao's face immediately contorted in bitterness.
Time hurried by; in the Great Wilderness Domain everything was as it always was, with the powerful striving in their cultivation, sensing the Heavenly Dao. Meanwhile, the mysterious force of Yu Ting became known to all Realm Master Level powers.
Naturally, some Realm Masters proposed an attempt to find Yu Ting, to balance the threat of the Imperishable Temple, but in the vast Land of Imperishable, they knew not where to search.
Moreover, Yu Ting's view of the Domain was an unknown variable – what if they too coveted the Domain and sought to consume it?
"He's about to come back."
Li Xuan glanced, as Meng Chong and the others were drawing the Domain back towards the area of the Great Wilderness.
Red Cat, Yu Xiaolong, and Little Ha had sensed the movement of the Domain being pulled and were about to meet up with Meng Chong and the others.
"This Domain is quite interesting."
Li Xuan smiled as he looked towards a huge mountain peak in the lifeless Domain.
Su Lingxiu had broken through to Great Achievement in the Domain Realm; the Daoist Golden Book gave no feedback, which Li Xuan found unsurprising since he had already reached the Primordial Realm. A breakthrough in Domain Realm was no longer enough to provoke a response.
On this day, a rumbling sound came from beyond the Domain, as if a huge beast was storming towards them from the Land of Imperishable, stirring up a massive storm.
All powerhouses of the Great Wilderness changed their expressions, emerging from their seclusion to look up at the Land of Imperishable. Was the Imperishable Temple attacking?

chapters.title: Chapter 1099 - 567 Return by Drawing Domain, Shocking the Great Wilderness_2
chapters.content:
Muxiao, who was sweeping the floor, paused and looked up somewhat puzzled. According to the agreed time, it was not yet the time for the Divine Temple to make its move.
With his strength, he faintly discerned within the Chaos a huge shadow that was slowly approaching.
The distance was too far for his current strength to make out what that tremendous black shadow really was.
The Realm Masters of the Great Wilderness had gathered outside the Heaven and Earth, though they did not leave the range covered by the Heavenly Dao. They watched warily toward the depths of the Land of Imperishable.
The rumbling sound continued. Although the source of the sound was invisible, it was certain that a huge colossal entity was approaching the Great Wilderness.
Moreover, a violent Spiritual Energy was sensed, stirring into a storm that was slowly spreading.
"Imperishable Temple attacking?"
Taihe frowned deeply.
"I feel it might be a powerful True Spirit approaching Heaven and Earth,"
Taikun speculated.
Tian Zi's figure appeared, looking toward the source of the sound; with the Majesty of the Heavenly Path's induction, he only felt a huge black shadow getting closer. The shadow was much larger than the Witch Demon Domain had been.
After all, the Witch Demon Domain had been broken in the end.
He sent forth a Dharma Body into the small courtyard, "Taoist Ancestor, what is that?"
Tian Zi could only seek counsel from the Taoist Ancestor to resolve his doubts.
Su Lingxiu also ran back, "Master, what is that? Could it be a huge True Spirit?"
Cai Ling'er also showed full curiosity.
Li Xuan gave a slight smile, "It's not a bad thing. For the Great Wilderness, it's even better news—it means we can enhance quickly again."
"Master, what exactly is it? Could it be a Supreme Treasure? Just tell us straight."
Su Lingxiu was massaging her master's shoulders, filled with curiosity.
"Your second senior brother and the others are back."
Li Xuan smiled helplessly.
"Is it the second senior brother and the others?"
Su Lingxiu's hands paused, and she immediately overflowed with joy.
"I'll go welcome the second senior brother and the others."
Su Lingxiu hurried off. Since the second senior brother and the others had returned, they must have brought back a lot of treasures from the Land of Imperishable for her to study.
Upon hearing this, Tian Zi was also reassured, but he still asked, "Why is there such a commotion?"
"Just prepare for the Great Wilderness's enhancement; you'll be busy again."
Li Xuan chuckled.
"Could they have brought back a Heaven and Earth for me?"
Tian Zi scratched his head.
Li Xuan just smiled.
Tian Zi was stunned, "It really is a Heaven and Earth? Where did this Heaven and Earth come from? No, I must get ready."
His figure vanished as he began to prepare to integrate this new Heaven and Earth.
Su Lingxiu reached the outside of Heaven and Earth, looking toward the direction from which the commotion came, excitedly saying, "Don't worry, it's my second senior brother and the others coming back."
Directly she headed toward the direction of the commotion.
"Is it Meng Chong and the others?"
Wu Tianan was in disbelief; the commotion was a bit too large. Could it be that Meng Chong and the others had achieved a tremendous increase in strength and caught a powerful True Spirit, causing such a disturbance?
"Sister, let's go have a look too."
Wu Tianan looked toward Yu Yao beside him.
"Okay!"
Yu Yao waved her hand, her power sweeping up Wu Tianan, and with a movement, they headed toward the commotion.
"Let's go; we should take a look too."
Half of the powerful beings amongst the crowds were incredibly curious about what could cause such a massive disturbance.
"We're almost back to the Great Wilderness."
Meng Chong and the two others had finished their cultivation, looking toward the Great Wilderness with excitement on their faces.
After such a long time of attraction, they had finally drawn the Hong Ze Domain back, and all three were only half a step away from reaching the Domain Realm Perfection.
Once they reached Heaven and Earth Perfection, they could start breaking through to the Establishing Dao Realm.
Looking back at the huge Heaven and Earth behind the Flying Boat, a sense of full achievement welled up within them.
"Let's stop at a distance from the Heaven and Earth, start slowing down now to avoid crashing directly into the Great Wilderness. How to handle this Heaven and Earth and integrate it into the Great Wilderness will still need preparation,"
Fang Hao spoke as he controlled the Flying Boat to decelerate, allowing the speed to gradually slow down.
However, the movement of the Hong Ze Domain could not be stopped; it would just be much slower and would still be slowly approaching the Great Wilderness.
But there was enough time to prepare, figuring out how to integrate and handle this desolate Heaven and Earth.
"The Great Wilderness is truly beautiful; no wonder the Imperishable Temple wants to devour Heaven and Earth. Here in the Land of Imperishable, Heaven and Earth is a real treasure indeed."
Looking at the distant gem-like Heaven and Earth, Jiang Buping exclaimed.
With the attraction of Heaven and Earth slowing down, the commotion also gradually began to subside, and the storm brought by the movement of Heaven and Earth began to calm down.
"Junior Sister is coming."
Meng Chong said with a smile.
A figure dashed straight toward the Flying Boat.
"Second Senior Brother, Fourth Junior Brother, Fifth Junior Brother..."
Su Lingxiu was overjoyed, the Flying Boat was just too vast, having been refined by Fang Hao in the Land of Imperishable using extraordinary materials.
With just this one Flying Boat, they could stand against hundreds of Martial Artists at the Supreme Realm, and even hold their own against one or two Realm Masters.
"Third Junior Sister."
"Senior Sister!"
Meng Chong and the others all wore smiling faces.
"This Flying Boat is so vast, you guys must have had a huge haul this time, to have refined such an enormous Flying Boat and caused such a stir," said Su Lingxiu as she looked at the massive craft, her face filled with astonishment.
"Senior Sister, you guessed wrong. The commotion wasn't caused by this Flying Boat," Fang Hao said with a smile.
"Not the Flying Boat? Then what was it?" Su Lingxiu was full of curiosity.
The Master had said that it was Second Senior Brother and the others who had returned, without mentioning the Eldest Senior Brother. Clearly, the Eldest Senior Brother had not come back but had ventured alone into the Land of Imperishable.
The disturbance clearly could not have been created by the Eldest Senior Brother.
Smiling, Fang Hao raised his hand and pointed behind the Flying Boat, "Senior Sister, look!"
Su Lingxiu turned to look and was momentarily stunned.
She blinked and then took a closer look, her eyes widening in shock.
"Is that, is that... a Domain?"
"Right!" Fang Hao nodded.
"Junior Sister, what do you think of this Domain? We put in a lot of effort and a lot of time to pull it back," said Meng Chong, rubbing his head and chuckling.
"Where did you guys find this Domain? If I had known, I would have come out with you," said Su Lingxiu with excitement and regret.
"It was me, I led them there!" the Azure Sea Turtle jumped out and claimed credit.
"But this Domain, it seems like?" Su Lingxiu immediately noticed that something was not normal about it.
"A desolate Domain," Jiang Buping pointed toward the Hong Ze Domain and said, "This is the Hong Ze Domain, but it has become desolate, devoid of any life force, and even contains a sense of death. However, there are no dangers within the Domain, and even though it is desolate, it is intact."
"I see! Tian Zi is going to be busy again. It will take some thought to restore life to a desolate Domain," Su Lingxiu said with a smile.
Just as they were talking, Yu Yao arrived with Wu Tianan.
"This Flying Boat is too vast," Wu Tianan exclaimed.
The Azure Sea Turtle glanced at Yu Yao and then at Wu Tianan, thinking of the reason why Yu Yao had a falling out with the Seductive Witch, and couldn't help but grin, chuckling.
"Where is Xu Yan?" Wu Tianan looked around and did not see Xu Yan, asking curiously.
Could it be that Xu Yan had caused the huge disturbance?
"Eldest Senior Brother has ventured into the Land of Imperishable and has not come back," Meng Chong explained.
"Then this disturbance is..." Wu Tianan was puzzled.
Meng Chong raised his hand and pointed behind the Flying Boat, and Yu Yao and Wu Tianan looked over, both of them momentarily startled.
Wu Tianan was somewhat confused; what was that pitch-black mass, and why did its outline seem somewhat familiar?
Yu Yao, however, was utterly shocked, "Is this a Domain? A complete Domain? No, this Domain, why is it devoid of life?"
On closer inspection and looking toward the Azure Sea Turtle, she asked, "Could this be the Hong Ze Domain?"
The Azure Sea Turtle nodded.
All the Realm Masters arrived one after another, all astonished by the enormity of the Flying Boat and, soon after, learned that the immense Flying Boat had come to pull a Domain.
They were all utterly shocked on the spot.
"I'm going to take a look!"
Many Realm Masters were excited, astonished, and curious as they headed toward the Hong Ze Domain. As they approached the Hong Ze Domain, they felt an even stronger sense of death, as if something ominous were present.
Meng Chong, the three Martial Artists, and the turtle had pulled back a Domain, leaving the strong of the Great Wilderness utterly shocked, while Taihe, Taikun, and others felt somewhat wistful.
The Hong Ze Domain had indeed fallen silent completely, the apocalyptic event it had faced was truly terrifying.
No wonder the Azure Sea Turtle had become more timid; it had been frightened by the events at that time. They also marveled at the deep fortune of the Azure Sea Turtle, to have escaped a calamity and to have become a disciple of the Taoist Ancestor.
Even as a mere gatekeeper turtle, that was still a gatekeeper for the Taoist Ancestor's household, a revered position indeed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1100 - 568 Swallowing the Hong Ze Domain, the Bizarre Jade Person
chapters.content:
"Master, we're back!"
In the Great Wilderness, Meng Chong and the others respectfully greeted their master with a salute.
"Um."
Li Xuan nodded and said, "Not bad, you're not far from achieving Domain Realm Perfection."
"Meng Chong!"
Zi Yun flew into his arms, excitedly clinging to him.
Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao also arrived, and seeing that Xu Yan was not there, they couldn't help feeling a bit disappointed.
"Where is Brother Xu Yan?"
Ao Yuyue asked curiously.
"The eldest disciple has gone alone to the Land of Imperishable, he won't be back so soon."
Fang Hao explained.
As acquaintances gathered, Meng Chong and his companions started recounting the events of their journey.
"The Imperishable Temple is also searching for the Hong Ze Domain, it seems they are preparing to take action against the Great Wilderness soon."
Old Man Xiao spoke in a somber tone.
"Master, is it you who annihilated the Master of Domain at the Imperishable Temple?"
Fang Hao couldn't help seeking confirmation.
Li Xuan smiled, and Fang Hao understood—it was indeed the Master!
On the Hong Ze Domain, a group of powerful beings from the Great Wilderness discussed what to do with the domain.
"How should we utilize the Hong Ze Domain?"
"A desolate domain, absorbed into the Great Wilderness, will drain a portion of the Great Wilderness's vitality and weaken its life force for a short period. This isn't good, given that we're about to face the Imperishable Temple."
"Perhaps we could fragment the Hong Ze Domain and integrate it in stages?"
"A fragmented domain is vastly different from an intact one."
The strong ones deliberated, unaware that on a certain mountain peak, a head peeked out, watching them discuss the handling of the domain.
Then, those eyes stared intently at the Great Wilderness Domain, contemplating something.
After a long while, apparently having decided what to do, the head retracted.
Tian Zi gathered all the strong beings from the Great Wilderness at Qinghua Sect to prepare for the absorption of the Hong Ze Domain.
"As for how to handle the Hong Ze Domain, I already have a plan. Since it is a desolate domain, it's perfect for connecting Yin and Yang. Part of it will become the Yin Realm, while another part will form the border between Yin and Yang.
"Strengthening the Yin and Yang of the Great Wilderness and perfecting the cycle of reincarnation—as for the desolation, I will wash it away with the Heavenly Dao, turning it into the power of Heavenly Dao's rules, so it won't affect the Great Wilderness.
"As for absorbing the Hong Ze Domain, you will need to exert more effort. Of course, the rewards will be enormous. The fusion of Yin and Yang, the cycle of reincarnation, and the manifestation of Heavenly Dao are all opportunities for you.
"It depends on your talents and enlightenment, whether you can seize this chance and make a rapid breakthrough to the Heavenly Domain."
Upon hearing Tian Zi's words, the crowd of strong ones became excited—Heavenly Domain, a realm of strength comparable to that of the Master of Domain.
Even the weakest Master of Domain was a being they now looked up to with respect.
"Just tell us what to do, and we will give it our all!"
"For the Great Wilderness, for the Heavenly Dao, for the eternal Domain, everything is worth it!"
All the Realm Masters excitedly exclaimed.
Tian Zi nodded in satisfaction and then added, "Once reincarnation is perfected, when fighting the Imperishable Temple, each of you can leave a strand of Divine Soul in the Domain. If your divine form perishes, you can be reborn through reincarnation. With your Martial Arts insights and experience, you'll be able to quickly recover your strength and even have a chance to mend the current flaws in your Martial Arts."
Hearing this, the Realm Masters' breaths became heavier with excitement. They understood what this meant.
This was equivalent to them gaining an extra life, as well as a chance to rectify their Martial Arts shortcomings. Even as Realm Master Level powerhouses, if they looked back, they would see imperfections in their Martial Arts Cultivation.
If they could start over, with their current Martial Arts insights, they could surely rectify some imperfections, enhancing their strength and allowing them to go further.
"Of course, all this is predicated on the Great Wilderness and the Heavenly Dao still existing!"
Tian Zi spoke emphatically.
"For the Great Wilderness, we'll fight with all our might!"
"That's right, we'd rather perish with our enemy than live without honor!"
The group of strong ones spoke solemnly.
As for the demise of the Great Wilderness and the Heavenly Dao, how could that ever happen? They'd just fight with everything they had, and later they would all be heralds of the Heavenly Dao. After surviving the threat of the Divine Temple, the stronger Heavenly Dao would benefit them as well.
"Very good!"
Tian Zi wore a smile and began assigning tasks to the Realm Masters to prepare for absorbing the Hong Ze Domain.
The Flying Boat that had been towing the domain had withdrawn, but the Hong Ze Domain was still slowly approaching the Great Wilderness Domain. Once it reached a certain distance, it would be captured by the Heavenly Dao rules and start the process of integration into the Great Wilderness.
But before that, some preliminary preparations were needed, so the Realm Masters of the Great Wilderness each had tasks and were busy at work.
Even the powerful Supreme Sovereign Realm beings of the various Cave Heavens needed to make arrangements, such as going to various places in the Great Wilderness. A Supreme Sovereign would oversee a certain area to prevent any fluctuations from causing significant turbulence and casualties.
Everything proceeded in an orderly fashion, with no one noticing that occasionally, a stone head would peek out from a mountain peak in the Hong Ze Domain, observing everything.
Su Lingxiu took some time to visit the Hong Ze Domain, researching how to revitalize a desolate domain. Domains, too, could be treated, and this had a significant benefit for her research in Alchemical Medical Martial Arts.
Finally, the day of domain integration arrived; the Hong Ze Domain was very close to the Great Wilderness, nearing the edge of the Heavenly Dao's rules.
Even though the Hong Ze Domain was much smaller than the Great Wilderness, as it approached, many Martial Artists across various regions of the Great Wilderness saw a huge dark shadow descending in the Firmament.

chapters.title: Chapter 1101 - 568 Devouring Hong Ze Domain, The Strange Jade Person_2
chapters.content:
Fortunately, the Supreme Sovereigns from various regions had already placated the Martial Artists, and the Great Wilderness Cabinet had issued an announcement. This was a moment for the Domain to elevate, and a celestial opportunity was approaching. It urged numerous Martial Artists to seize the chance during the Domain's elevation, break through their bottlenecks, and contemplate Heavenly Dao.
Therefore, the Martial Artists, who were originally in disputes and even hostile to each other, were now busy waiting for the Domain's elevation and the opportunity to comprehend the Heavenly Dao.
Boom!
The Hong Ze Domain was captured by the rules of Heavenly Dao, washing over it, and a Spirit Qi Storm arose in the Land of Imperishable, like a giant funnel, sucking in the Spiritual Energy of the region.
Spiritual Energy swept in continuously, pouring into the Hong Ze Domain, and Imperishable Qi surged incessantly. Changes began to appear in the Hong Ze Domain.
Under the washing of Heavenly Dao, the sense of dead silence was slowly devoured by Heavenly Dao, strengthening a specific rule of Heavenly Dao.
Whoosh!
The Hong Ze Domain kept descending, and the Yin Realm appeared in the Great Wilderness Domain, manifesting a giant Yin Yang Vortex. Various Realm Masters were desperately invoking their own power, controlling everything.
Boom!
The Yin Yang Vortex had touched the Hong Ze Domain, resembling a giant maw, slowly swallowing this Domain. The Yin Realm was in turmoil, Reincarnation appeared, and the rules of Heavenly Dao glimmered with brilliance.
As the strong individuals activated their power according to their tasks, they took this opportunity to perceive the Heavenly Dao. They integrated a strand of Divine Soul Consciousness into Heavenly Dao, directly experiencing Heavenly Dao.
This was an opportunity bestowed by Heaven.
Since the Heavenly Dao is utterly impartial, even if Tian Zi gave special favors, it would not present such a direct display of the rules of Heavenly Dao. After all, Tian Zi would not let the Heavenly Dao lose its fundamental impartiality.
So, this direct display of the rules of Heavenly Dao, allowing direct understanding of Heavenly Dao, was an opportunity that came once in a thousand years.
"We're almost there!"
Everyone was thrilled. The dead-silent Hong Ze Domain, one-half mingled with the aura of the Yin Realm, gradually becoming a part of the Yin Realm; the other half at the boundary between Yin and Yang, close to the Yin Realm side where the aura was stronger, and on the side near the Yang Realm, the aura of the Yin Realm gradually weakened, merging with the Yang Realm.
This was a step-by-step process, facilitating adaptation when crossing from Yin to Yang without the sudden extreme shifts likely unbearable for the weaker beings.
Moreover, the boundary between Yin and Yang also facilitated the understanding of Yin and Yang, cultivating the Way of Yin Yang Reincarnation.
This was all preparation to enhance the Martial Arts of the Great Wilderness with the Law of Yin Yang in the future.
The Hong Ze Domain continued to descend, with the Yin Yang Vortex swallowing the Domain. The rules of Heavenly Dao also kept strengthening, repeatedly washing over the Hong Ze Domain. The entire Great Wilderness was slowly growing stronger.
The Spiritual Energy in the Land of Imperishable roared tumultuously, continuously sweeping through. The fierce Spiritual Energy entered the rules of Heavenly Dao, slowly becoming gentle and soft.
The Domain's Spiritual Energy was enhancing, Heavenly Dao's rules were strengthening, and the continuous influx of Imperishable Qi also made the entire Domain increasingly robust.
At one moment, with a thud, something unexpected occurred inside the Hong Ze Domain—a hand emerged, projecting a foreign power.
This hand, reaching into the Yin Yang Vortex, seemed to be vying for control of the Domain.
"Hmm?"
The sudden change took everyone aback.
Even more shocking was that the aura emanating from this hand was unmistakably that of a Master of Heaven and Earth, and one even more powerful than Muxiao.
How could they defend against a Master of Heaven and Earth making a move at this critical moment?
The rules of Heavenly Dao continued the merger of Heaven and Earth, simply unable to extract more power to deal with this suddenly appearing Master of Heaven and Earth.
That hand, reaching into the Yin Yang Vortex, seemed to be probing into the Great Wilderness, seeking to take control of the Domain and eventually bring the Domain under its grasp.
Clearly, this had been planned for a long time, choosing this moment to make a move.
"An expert from Imperishable Temple?"
Every strong individual was in shock.
"No, this aura is different from those of Imperishable Temple!"
Taihe spoke gravely.
"What?"
Meng Chong, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping were all astounded, puzzled how a being of Master of Heaven and Earth level was hidden in the Hong Ze Domain without their notice.
The Azure Sea Turtle was also stunned; at this moment, its heart was trembling. If this Master of Heaven and Earth suddenly made a move, it would undoubtedly die in secrecy!
After all, in the Land of Imperishable, it did not have the protection of a Jade Talisman from a Taoist Ancestor. If the Master of Heaven and Earth made a sudden move, not even Meng Chong and the others could come to the rescue in time.
"It's someone from Yu Ting!"
That hand, immaculate and seemingly carved from jade, was clearly that of a strong individual from Yu Ting!
"Little fellow, you have thought so long and only now figured out how to make a move; you are a bit slow."
Li Xuan said with a slight smile.
With a gesture of his hand, everyone saw a hand appear above the Hong Ze Domain, reaching towards the individual making the move. The person trying to resist seemed unable to make any resistance at all.
That person, originally as large as a jade sculpture, kept shrinking in the grasp until reaching normal human size, then was plucked from the Hong Ze Domain.
Whoosh!
A group of powerful beings instantly breathed a sigh of relief, as the Taoist Ancestor had intervened once again.
With the Taoist Ancestor present, there were no crises that could exist, and in the battle against the Imperishable Temple, the victorious side would definitely be ours!
In the small courtyard of the Qinghua Sect,
a person as white as jade was captured and brought over.
"Is this a powerful being from Yu Ting?"
Muxiao could not help but enter the yard, examining the Jade Person.
The Jade Person's eyes sparkled with a silver-white radiance, staring leisurely at Li Xuan who was seated, the voice slightly sluggish yet conveying a heavy tone.
"Who are you!"
Then, after seemingly contemplating, added, "In the Domain, there shouldn't be someone as powerful as you!"
Li Xuan did not respond—after all, what was there to say to a Jade Puppet, even if this puppet had developed some self-awareness.
But a jade puppet was still a jade puppet.
"Yu Ting, really interesting!"
Li Xuan suddenly became curious about Yu Ting, astonished that a jade puppet could possess self-awareness and formidable strength.
The creator of this Jade Puppet must be immensely powerful, and what method did he use to grant such capabilities and awareness to a jade puppet?
And why a jade puppet? Could it be that only puppets made of jade could possess such strength?
"Being able to create a Master of Heaven and Earth level Jade Puppet, this person must be above the Master of Heaven and Earth and possess a certain Power of Creation."
Although Yu Ting was strong, Li Xuan did not take it seriously as he was at the Primordial Realm.
With his strength and methods, creating a puppet with strength exceeding the Master of Heaven and Earth was not much of a challenge.
The mysteries of creation were already within his grasp; he was indeed a Taoist Ancestor in every sense of the word!
"Why won't you answer?"
The Jade Person furrowed its brows, its eyes flashing continuously with silver-white radiance, seeming to think rapidly, and then blurted out, "Are you feeling guilty?"
Meng Chong and others wore strange expressions. This Jade Person seemed odd, and how did it conclude that their master was feeling guilty?
The mind of the Jade Person apparently was not very sharp.
"Are you wary of my Yu Ting?"
The Jade Person continued speaking of the conclusions it reached through deep thinking.
Li Xuan picked up a cup of tea and leisurely sipped on it, paying no mind at all.
"You are somewhat arrogant!"
The Jade Person continued to draw its own conclusions.
"Your strength is great, but my Yu Ting is also strong, release me now!"
The Jade Person emanated silver-white radiance but was unable to break free, so it spoke again.
Seeing that Li Xuan was silent, the Jade Person continued to ponder, the silver-white light in its eyes forming ripple-like circles, then it arrived at what it believed to be a conclusion.
"I understand now, you captured me to threaten Yu Ting? Or perhaps, to negotiate with Yu Ting!"
At this point, the Jade Person felt it had grasped Li Xuan's ultimate intent.
"Impossible, my Yu Ting never succumbs to threats, nor do we yield!"
The Jade Person revealed a mocking expression.
"If you dare, kill me and await the thunderous wrath of my Yu Ting!"
The Jade Person turned haughty.
Everyone in the courtyard sported strange looks—what was wrong with this Jade Person's brain?
"Master, won't you kill him? Are you not angry?"
Su Lingxiu asked, unable to contain her curiosity.
Li Xuan responded with a smile, "Why be angry with a jade puppet? Let it say whatever it wants."
Everyone was taken aback.
"Master, what did you say? This is a jade puppet?"
Fang Hao looked incredulous.

chapters.title: Chapter 1102 - 569 Taoist Ancestor Lectures, Domain Ascends
chapters.content:
"Yes, this is a Jade Puppet," Li Xuan nodded.
Everyone was shocked beyond measure, and they all gathered around the Jade Person, scrutinizing it closely.
"Can this really be a Jade Puppet? It's inconceivable!"
"Who could have crafted such a puppet, with such terrifying strength, a Master of Heaven and Earth level!"
"Could it be that all the people of Yu Ting are Jade Puppets?"
People were amazed without end, no wonder they had found the Jade Person a bit strange—now they understood, it was a Jade Puppet.
"The strong ones of Yu Ting, they are Jade Puppets?"
Muxiao's eyes widened, staring unblinkingly at the Jade Person.
Amidst his shock, Fang Hao was even more excited, reaching out to touch the Jade Puppet's head, examining it closely as if he had discovered a treasure of unprecedented rarity.
"Get away from me, don't touch me!"
The Jade Person glared at Fang Hao and shouted angrily.
"Incredible, it even has emotions; this is nothing like any puppet or automaton."
Fang Hao was full of admiration.
His hand moved over the Jade Puppet, examining it intently, his gaze transfixed as if he were enchanted by a peerless beauty.
"Stop, get away from me, don't touch me!"
The Jade Person was furious, shouting aloud.
But he couldn't move, no matter how enraged he was, it was to no avail.
"Incredible, incredible, its refinement is far more exquisite and powerful than my puppets."
Fang Hao praised with envy.
"The creator of this Jade Puppet must be a Puppet Master, definitely an Artifact Refining expert!"
Hearing Fang Hao say this, the others nodded in agreement, finding it utterly incredible.
"Master, how can one refine a Jade Puppet like this?"
Fang Hao looked at his master, asking excitedly.
"This Jade Puppet isn't refined, but sculpted, and as for how it became a Jade Puppet, able to have thought, consciousness, and emotions, it all lies in the Dao Principles of this Jade Puppet. Such principles grant it..."
Li Xuan explained with a smile and then continued, "If you want to refine a puppet comparable to this Jade Puppet, it's not difficult. Break through to the Creation Realm, and you can animate a Creation Puppet to have thoughts, consciousness, emotions just like this Jade Puppet. If your craftsmanship of Creation is strong enough, it will be even more agile and not at all sluggish."
"The Creation Realm!"
Fang Hao's face was filled with longing, but the Creation Realm was too far a goal; he hadn't even Established his Dao yet.
"Master, let me study this Jade Puppet for a while. Perhaps it'll inspire me to improve my puppet refinement techniques."
Fang Hao's face was full of hope.
"Very well."
With a gesture from Li Xuan, a ray of light entered the Jade Puppet's body. "There you go. No matter how much you manipulate it, no accidents will occur, nor will it pose a threat to you."
"Thank you, Master!"
Fang Hao was overjoyed, picked up the Jade Puppet, and hurried off to study it.
With the Jade Person captured, the Hong Ze Domain was no longer disturbed, and everything proceeded smoothly.
The Domain was growing, the Heavenly Dao Rules presenting themselves, and the Yin Yang Reincarnation becoming evident, as though the universe was at the dawn of creation, ushering in a new era.
"Contemplate on your own nature, especially those of you who have reached the Domain Realm,"
Li Xuan reminded.
"Yes, Master!"
Meng Chong, Su Lingxiu, Jiang Buping all nodded respectfully.
Even Fang Hao, after taking the Jade Puppet back, returned to sense the changes in the Domain.
BOOM!
The Hong Ze Domain fully merged with the Great Wilderness, the Yin Realm expanded, the Yin Yang border appeared, and the Heavenly Dao continuously strengthened as the entire Domain grew.
The Spirit Qi Storm of the Land of Imperishable continued to roll in, the Imperishable Qi surged fiercely, making the Domain ever more solid and the space more robust.
The Heavenly Dao was elevating, and some martial artists with exceptional talents were breaking through bottlenecks in this Domain Creation, enhancing their strength.
Even those with extreme comprehension, while still weak, grasped the Heavenly Dao. Below the Immortal Realm, there were no more bottlenecks on the Martial Arts path.
All Realm Masters seized the moment, comprehending the Heavenly Dao and directly experiencing it.
Old Man Xiao's body radiated a magnificent and majestic aura, his presence ascending and transforming as he stepped off the Taicang Martial Arts path and onto a new one, pioneering a path forward.
Taihe, Taikun, and other Minor Heaven and Earth Masters also contemplated the Heavenly Dao, slowly converting their own Domain Principles into Heavenly Dao Laws, seeking to break through to the Heavenly Domain.
"It's time for a sermon. This time, I will speak on the Way of Domain, the Heavenly Dao. The Great Wilderness is due for some beings to reach the Heavenly Domain."
Li Xuan held the Jade Ruyi, ready to preach.
"Yin and Yang delineate, establishing reincarnation, you all have many doubts about the Way of Domain. Today, I shall elucidate the Way of Domain, the Heavenly Dao for you."
Li Xuan's voice, like the sound of the Dao itself, reached every Realm Master Level strong person's ears.
A multitude of powerful beings were instantly overjoyed.
"Many thanks to the Taoist Ancestor!"
Outside the courtyard, Muxiao put down the broom, knelt in reverence towards the inside, his heart bursting with excitement, the Taoist Ancestor's sermon was finally here!
The Domain was rising, undergoing transformation, and at this moment, it seemed as if an even more profound aura enveloped the heavens and earth.
The Taoist Ancestor Halo!
In Li Xuan's eyes, the Great Wilderness was but a speck of dust, all living beings visible at a glance, as the voices like those of the Dao reached all Realm Masters.
Martial Artists below the Supreme Sovereign Realm, although they couldn't hear Li Xuan's preaching, still perceived supreme and profound sounds in their minds, resolving all doubts and bottlenecks in Martial Arts, all were enlightened in this moment.
This sermon lasted three days.
As the preaching ended, the Heavenly Dao grew stronger, and the entire Domain experienced a slight elevation.
All the strong ones were immersed in the sound of the Dao, immersed in contemplation, and many of their confusions gradually unraveled.

chapters.title: Chapter 1103 - 569 Taoist Ancestor Preaches, Domain Ascends_2
chapters.content:
The comprehension of Heavenly Dao was becoming increasingly clear, as the path ahead in the martial arts unfurled in his mind.
"The strength of the Great Wilderness is about to see a significant enhancement."
Li Xuan wore a smile on his face.
The Heavenly Dao Seal had seen a vast improvement, and naturally, his Taoist Ancestor Halo and Taoist Ancestor Image had also been greatly enhanced.
The higher one's perception, the greater the harvest, the deeper the comprehension.
At a certain moment, in a corner of the world, a powerful presence appeared as if parallel to heaven itself, as if it wielded an undeniable, imperious majesty of heaven and earth.
Heavenly Domain!
The Power of Heavenly Dao emerged from within, the Power of Heavenly Dao Laws merged into his existing Principles.
The aura kept strengthening, and at one point, it seemed to break through shackles, stepping into a new world, like pushing open a wide door to enter the expansive domain behind it.
Old Man Xiao had made a breakthrough into the Heavenly Domain.
As Old Man Xiao broke through, the Heavenly Dao of the Great Wilderness was once again significantly enhanced, the Heavenly Dao Rules becoming all the more perfect and powerful.
According to Li Xuan's setting, as the martial artists within the domain grew stronger, the Heavenly Dao would also elevate in turn, with more complete rules, and the Power of Principles would grow stronger.
The more practitioners in the Heavenly Domain, the stronger the Heavenly Dao becomes, almost without limit.
However, the martial artists within this world, no matter what, could not surpass the Heavenly Dao, nor could they go against the Heavenly Dao Rules, although to a certain extent, they could utilize the Power of Heavenly Dao Rules for their own use.
Even if all the strong practitioners in the Heavenly Domain joined forces, they would not be able to defy the Heavenly Dao; they would always remain within the Heavenly Dao.
Because the first generation of Heavenly Domain practitioners had special destinies, they possessed certain superiority, a stronger imperishable characteristic, capable of borrowing more Power from Heavenly Dao Rules.
This was considered a form of care from Tian Zi for these old acquaintances.
The Land of Imperishable was vast and boundless, no matter how the Great Wilderness improved, it seemed it could not replace the Land of Imperishable, even if it were to replace it, who knows how many long years it would take.
The martial artists within the world, flourishing together with the Heavenly Dao, all struggled for the sake of the Great Wilderness, and with the interests of heaven and earth in mind, they were all interconnected, which is why there was no occurrence of defying the Heavenly Dao.
Of course, even if they wanted to defy, they couldn't.
"I've grown stronger again, my current strength, has it surpassed Taicang?"
Tian Zi was thrilled.
However, even if stronger than Taicang, he was still unable to confront the Unchanging Divine Master; he must continue to enhance, to grow even stronger.
After Old Man Xiao's breakthrough into the Heavenly Domain, he did not end his cultivation but continued his comprehension and cultivation, particularly on the practice and understanding of Heavenly Dao Divine Skill.
This was a once-in-a-millennium opportunity, missing it, one wouldn't know when such a chance would come again.
Shortly after Old Man Xiao's breakthrough, another aura emerged, dreamy yet domineering—Taimiao had made a breakthrough into the Heavenly Domain.
Li Xuan wasn't surprised by this, naturally, Taimiao, having received his guidance and imbued with the intent of Heavenly Dao from him, had a more solid understanding of the Heavenly Dao.
With the second individual entering the Heavenly Domain, the Heavenly Dao of the Great Wilderness was once again elevated, and Tian Zi was laughing out loud with his mouth wide open, overwhelmed by excitement.
Following Taimiao, Ao Lie also broke through into the Heavenly Domain, a giant dragon coiling around, like a dragon of Heavenly Dao, Dragon Might and Majesty of the Heavenly Path erupting in all directions.
The Great Wilderness Domain kept getting stronger, the Yin Yang grew more stable, and the Samsara Path became ever more complete, but the ascension of the domain was not yet finished.
As time flowed during the ascendancy of the domain, the fourth to step into the Heavenly Domain was Heavenly Slaughter.
"The talent of Heavenly Slaughter is truly remarkable."
Li Xuan wasn't surprised, precisely because Heavenly Slaughter had exceptional talent and unique methods, that Tian Zi had arranged for him to construct the Yin Realm, destined to be one of the stewards of the Yin Realm later on.
Once they completely absorbed the Hong Ze Domain, the Great Wilderness began to settle down, and the rules manifested by the Heavenly Dao gradually receded. Following Heavenly Slaughter, the others who successively broke into the Heavenly Domain were Yu Yao, Taihe, Taikun, Seductive Witch, and Flame Demon.
Yu Yao, blessed with the fortune and destiny given by Taicang, though Taicang became history, the fortune still belonged to this world, and Tian Zi did not take it back, which was also a form of care for Yu Yao.
After all, his relationship with Yu Yao was quite good.
And due to the connection with Wu Tianan, Yu Yao was also related to Li Xuan, the Taoist Ancestor, to some extent, which meant she was a disciple of the Taoist Ancestor in a way.
So naturally, she received the intent of Heavenly Dao conferred by Li Xuan and thus, she too, made a breakthrough into the Heavenly Domain during this opportunity.
Wu Tianan had also gained a significant upgrade, making a breakthrough into the Realm Master Realm.
Taihe and Taikun were seasoned Minor Heaven and Earth Masters from an older generation. With sufficient experience and notable talent, having once been blessed by the creation of Tian Zi, they too had managed to break through to the Heavenly Domain.
The Seductive Witch and Flame Demon were also ancient Minor Heaven and Earth Masters. As one of the powerful rulers of the Yin Realm and favored by the fortune of Yin Realm, they were extraordinarily talented, which led them to a breakthrough this time.
Although the other Realm Masters had not broken through yet, their strength had significantly improved. Figures like Cang Lie and Jiang Feng had already reached the cusp of the Heavenly Domain.
Xie Tianheng broke through to the Supreme Sovereign Realm, and Xin Mengrou also reached the Supreme Sovereign Realm.
Xie Lingfeng broke through to the Domain Realm.
Everyone's strength had experienced a considerable boost. Meng Chong, Su Lingxiu, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping had all broken through to Domain Realm Perfection.
The overall strength of the Great Wilderness had more than doubled since the Taicang era. The Heavenly Dao Rules had also greatly improved, filling Tian Zi with unparalleled excitement.
He felt that his current Dharma Body was stronger by one-third than Taicang's in the past, and the power of the Heavenly Dao Rules had even surpassed that of Taicang.
In other words, if he used the power of the Heavenly Dao Rules, he could suppress the former Taicang.
"With my current strength, it's still not enough to contend with the Unchanging Divine Master. After all these years, he must be even stronger. Moreover, the true extent of the Unchanging Divine Master's strength remains unknown."
Tian Zi knew he needed to continue striving.
Fortunately, the Great Wilderness had finally produced a force comparable to the level of a Master of Heaven and Earth. Although their strength was lesser than the Seven Great Domain Masters of the past, they were at least slightly stronger than figures like Muxiao from the Imperishable Temple.
Outside the courtyard, Muxiao remained prostrate on the ground, his aura fluctuating as if he was experiencing some insight, possibly undergoing transformation or improving his strength.
The Great Wilderness had returned to its former days; the mightiest beings continued with their cultivation. The Supreme Sovereigns who ruled over various regions were gradually returning to their Cave Heavens, ushering the entire Martial Arts of the Domain into a flourishing era.
With each day, despite being subtle, the growth of Domain was significant and held extraordinary meaning.
"Oh, time, I hope the Imperishable Temple does not make a move too soon!"
Tian Zi sighed.
As long as there was enough time for the Great Wilderness to develop, there would inevitably come a day when it could surpass the Imperishable Temple.
"You need not worry. With the Taoist Ancestor as our elder, the Imperishable Temple poses no threat,"
Taihe offered reassuring words.
"What do you know? This is the Great Wilderness, or rather, it's our Taicang's vendetta with the Imperishable Temple. Shouldn't we resolve it ourselves? Don't you wish to take revenge? Must we always rely on the Taoist Ancestor? Can't we have some ambition?
"The Taoist Ancestor—what an existence he is. For him to deal with the Imperishable Temple would be like bullying the weak. Plus, how could the Unchanging Divine Master submit to that?
"Show some spirit. Don't rely on the Taoist Ancestor for everything. This Domain is ours. Can you expect the Taoist Ancestor to hide here forever?"
Tian Zi glared at Taihe and the others, chiding them as if they were disappointing iron not forged into steel.
"You're right!"
Taihe's face became solemn.
"Tian Zi is correct. The Taoist Ancestor won't stay hidden in the Great Wilderness forever. Once Xu Yan and the others complete their training, the Taoist Ancestor might well leave,"
Old Man Xiao nodded.
"Show some ambition..."
Tian Zi shook his head, saying, "I can't rely too much on you all. I'd rather pin my hopes on Xu Yan and the rest. They too are from our world and will naturally act on behalf of the Great Wilderness. When Xu Yan returns, his strength will undoubtedly be immense. To him, killing weaklings like you would be as simple as slicing through air."
Old Man Xiao and the others' mouths twitched, but they had no retort. Even after breaking through to the Heavenly Domain and becoming comparable to the Master of Heaven and Earth, they knew Xu Yan's impending return would outmatch their power.
With Xu Yan's formidable strength, it was indeed possible for him to slay them with a single sword strike.
"Our fight with the Imperishable Temple will certainly not end in defeat like the last time,"
Old Man Xiao stated earnestly.
"Are you so sure?"
Tian Zi ran his fingers through his hair, saying, "Unless the Taoist Ancestor intervenes, I truly don't have much confidence."
"I have faith in Xu Yan!"
Old Man Xiao said with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1104 - 570: Primordial Great Achievement, What Kind of Mess Has Xu Yan Gotten Into?
chapters.content:
"If we had enough time, I would naturally believe in Xu Yan, but I'm afraid we don't have enough time. Before Xu Yan becomes strong enough, the Imperishable Temple may already strike," Tian Zi sighed.
"No matter what, when a life-and-death crisis truly arrives, even if the Taoist Ancestor doesn't bully the weak by directly suppressing the Imperishable Temple, he will still strive to obtain sufficient time for Xu Yan to grow stronger," Old Man Xiao mused.
"You all need to try harder. After living for so long, you're still relying on Xu Yan. Aren't you ashamed of yourselves? Can you please be less useless!" Tian Zi cursed.
