Old Man Xiao and the others had dark expressions on their faces but could not retort. Indeed, compared to Xu Yan, they did seem somewhat incapable.
"Everyone, get ready to face the battle against the Imperishable Temple. I have a feeling that their assault is not too far off," Tian Zi sighed and then disappeared from the spot.
Old Man Xiao and the others had grave expressions as they chose to enter seclusion and cultivate bitterly, looking to enhance their strength as much as possible before the great battle arrived.
Fang Hao was delving into the research of Jade Puppets, refining different types of Puppets every day, using formations to replace the role of the Puppet Principle, creating puppets that were nearly identical to Jade Persons.
Even Su Lingxiu began to immerse herself in arduous cultivation.
The entire Great Wilderness Domain had entered an atmosphere of diligent cultivation, with the strong entering seclusion and the weak also striving to cultivate, leading to a decrease in the conflicts among martial artists.
Li Xuan, as always, was leisurely and carefree. Every once in a while, he would observe the Land of Imperishable beyond the Domain, spending more time immersed in the Daoist Golden Book, learning to utilize more of its Dharma.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has made a Minor Achievement in the Establishing Dao Realm, and your Power of Primordial has increased," came the feedback from the Daoist Golden Book.
"A breakthrough in a minor realm can't even allow me to achieve a Minor Achievement in the Primordial Realm," Li Xuan sighed. By this calculation, if Xu Yan made a Great Accomplishment in the Establishing Dao Realm, he should be able to reach a Minor Achievement in Primordial Realm. If Xu Yan achieved Perfection of the Way, could he possibly reach Primordial Great Achievement?
After all, Perfection of the Way differs from minor stage improvements like entering and making minor achievements; Perfection has a significant meaning in a realm, indicating that the realm has been mastered completely.
As time passed, Fang Hao continued to delve into the Jade Puppets, while Meng Chong and Jiang Buping left the Domain to venture into the Land of Imperishable. The two did not travel together but explored separately.
Red Cat also led Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha back into the Land of Imperishable again, hoping to subdue some True Spirits and transform them into members of the Demon Clan.
Muxiao was still sweeping, but he now did so with an increasingly calm and even demeanor, his presence barely noticeable, as he slowly swept with his broom like an ordinary old man.
His strength had increased, not just at the level of an average Domain Master but at least at the upper levels, having found a way to further enhance his own path.
His violent aura had long been swept away. He seemed like an old senior, watching the disciples of Qinghua Sect, their struggles, their fiery advancement.
Although Li Xuan had lifted the prohibitions on him, he still held that broom and could still seal his own power by choice, sweeping the ground just as usual.
The back mountain courtyard of the Qinghua Sect was forbidden territory. Aside from a few individuals, no one could set foot there, yet there were rumors within the Sect that it was the dwelling place of an old ancestor of Qinghua Sect.
Of course, this ancestor referred to in the stories of the disciples was none other than Fang Hao, the founder of the Sect.
Now the Qinghua Sect was led by a new Sect Master, and the old generation of elders, including Emperor Da Yue, had subsequently retired, ascending to become Supreme Elders.
Emperor Da Yue and the others had also made breakthroughs into the Divine Venerate Realm. Although they were not top fighters in the Great Wilderness, they were amongst the strongest within Qinghua Sect.
Besides the Cave Heavens, Qinghua Sect was the strongest in the entire Great Wilderness, and they also possessed a Cave Heaven called Qinghua Cave Heaven, located within the back mountain. Its foundations were not yet sufficient, however, and it lacked a Supreme Sovereign realm figure among the overt powers.
But every Cave Heaven knew that Qinghua Sect was indeed the number one power in Great Wilderness.
The Great Wilderness Martial Arts Academy was also incredibly strong, with more and more powerful individuals, and naturally, backed by the Holy Land of Canglan Island, no one dared to create trouble.
Canglan Island and Qinghua Sect had deep connections, with Sword God Xu Yan at the helm of Canglan Island, an existence unmatched throughout the entire Great Wilderness.
In Li Xuan's courtyard in the back mountain of Qinghua Sect, a new, massive pond had been constructed that at a glance appeared as if it was a vast, turbulent sea.
The Azure Sea Turtle lounged comfortably in the pond, the entire turtle appearing content.
For the half-step Heavenly Dao realm Azure Sea Turtle, turning a small pond into an ocean was just a minor technique; after all, it was a True Spirit of water and a Minor Heaven and Earth Master, owning its own minor heaven and earth domain.
Outside the courtyard, Muxiao was sweeping, while the Azure Sea Turtle lay in the pond, casually chatting with him. Of course, mostly the Azure Sea Turtle was boasting about its wisdom, having joined the Taoist Ancestor early on.
It had also received a protective Jade Talisman from the Taoist Ancestor, which, with this talisman, meant having an additional life and not fearing threats from certain powerful beings.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has made a Great Accomplishment in the Establishing Dao Realm, and you have made a Minor Achievement in the Primordial Realm," Li Xuan read from the feedback of the Daoist Golden Book, feeling extremely pleased.
Had Xu Yan found some treasure? He had advanced to Establishing Dao Great Accomplishment so quickly. It shouldn't be too long before he could achieve Establishing Dao Realm Perfection.
After making the Minor Achievement in the Primordial Realm, Li Xuan looked up toward the Land of Imperishable; his vision reached even further distances. In the boundless and chaotic Land of Imperishable, where True Spirits were innumerable, he saw Red Cat, Yu Xiaolong, and Little Ha, exuding monstrous might among a horde of True Spirits, subjugating these True Spirits.

chapters.title: Chapter 1105 - 570: Primordial Great Achievement, What Blunder Did Xu Yan Make? _2
chapters.content:
Following this, Li Xuan saw Meng Chong in a mountain, breaking through to the Establishing Dao Realm.
Fang Hao and Jiang Buping's figures were also in his sight, but he did not see Xu Yan's figure, nor did he see the Imperishable Temple.
"According to this situation, it will be a while before the Imperishable Temple attacks."
Li Xuan withdrew his gaze, knowing that since he couldn't see the Imperishable Temple within his field of vision, it must be extremely far from the Great Wilderness.
Time swiftly passed, and on this day, feedback from the Daoist Golden Book arrived again.
"Your disciple Meng Chong has broken through to the Establishing Dao Realm, and your Physical Body Martial Arts have been enhanced, achieving Minor Achievement in the Primordial Realm."
Meng Chong had broken through.
"Su Lingxiu, Fang Hao, Jiang Buping are also about to break through."
Feeling very pleased, Li Xuan then gave some more guidance to Cai Ling'er, his maid in cultivation.
Now Cai Ling'er's strength had also broken through to the Supreme Sovereign Realm and was not far from the Realm Master Realm.
In the time that followed, Su Lingxiu, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping successively broke through to the Establishing Dao Realm, and Li Xuan's five schools of Martial Arts all advanced to Minor Achievement in the Primordial Realm.
Every so often, Li Xuan observed the Land of Imperishable; Meng Chong and the three others, along with Red Cat, were all within his field of vision.
The Imperishable Temple was still nowhere to be seen, nor were there any other significant figures from that temple.
"Your disciple Xu Yan has perfected the Establishing Dao Realm; you have reached the Great Achievement in the Primordial Realm."
Xu Yan had perfected the Establishing Dao Realm, and Li Xuan, with a touch to his Primordial Spirit, used the Daoist Golden Book to elevate the other four schools of his Martial Arts to Great Achievement in the Primordial Realm.
After breaking through, he usually observed the Land of Imperishable, his range of sight even farther than before; Meng Chong and the three others, along with Red Cat, naturally remained within his view, but Xu Yan's figure was still missing, and there was no trace of the Imperishable Temple. However, this time, he made a new discovery.
"This is a Master of Domain from the Imperishable Temple, stationed here to prevent anyone from approaching this area of the Great Wilderness."
Li Xuan saw on a mountain, a Master of Domain stationed, radiating a powerful aura, a figure from the Imperishable Temple.
"Are they on guard against strong players outside the Imperishable Temple? The Jade Court? Or perhaps other forces?"
No other forces' strong players were to be found apart from these.
"From this, it looks like the Imperishable Temple's attack is imminent."
Li Xuan had figured it out.
That day, Li Xuan suddenly furrowed his brows, looking towards the Land of Imperishable. He did not discover any new strong players, nor did he see traces of the Imperishable Temple or Xu Yan's figure.
"Something's not right!"
Li Xuan fell into deep thought; he was at the Great Achievement of the Primordial Realm and felt as if there was some malice or perhaps hostility within the Land of Imperishable.
It seemed like for some reason, it involved him.
"Did Xu Yan stir up some trouble? It seems like he's offended more than one force, more than one powerful figure."
Li Xuan quickly understood what was happening.
Because of Xu Yan!
The cause and effect of this hostility arose due to Xu Yan, and being his mentor, anyone Xu Yan offended would naturally involve him.
"A strong player beyond a Master of Domain, an Unchanging Divine Master, and not just one, including the Jade Court?"
The corner of Li Xuan's mouth twitched; he was curious as to how Xu Yan, all at once, had managed to involve so many powerful figures and offend more than one force.
Offending the Imperishable Temple was within reason since the Imperishable Temple targeted the living beings of Heaven and Earth and was a major enemy in the Great Wilderness, but besides that, how did he manage to offend other forces?
"Even including the Jade Court does not add up; Xu Yan has offended, at least, three Masters of Domain or higher-level figures."
In the Land of Imperishable, aside from the known Divine Temple and Jade Court, was there a third powerful force?
"My Jade Talisman is more than enough to ensure Xu Yan's safety, so there's no need to worry."
As Li Xuan pondered, though Xu Yan had offended a number of forces and powerful figures, being Xu Yan's strong backup, he felt no panic.
How would a strong player beyond a Master of Domain matter? When in the Creation Realm, he could obliterate them with a flick of his fingers, not to mention now that he was in the Great Achievement of the Primordial Realm.
"If my guess is correct, Xu Yan is now fleeing back to the Great Wilderness."
After causing such a huge disaster and offending such powerful beings, Xu Yan, with his current strength, couldn't possibly confront them; naturally, he had to flee back to the Great Wilderness.
"So how did Xu Yan manage to offend, besides the Imperishable Temple, the other two powerful forces?"
Li Xuan was very curious.
...
Xu Yan, along with Ming Yu, escaped from the Jade Court and evaded assassination by the Eight Great Jade Persons, heading continuously back toward the Great Wilderness.
One day, Xu Yan suddenly halted and looked up in a certain direction.
Faintly, the sound of an angry dragon's roar came through, filled with rage and unwillingness.
"A dragon's roar? Are there still True Dragons in the Land of Imperishable? Judging by the emotion in this roar of anger and unwillingness, this True Dragon is surely not just a spiritless primitive one. Could it be?"
Xu Yan wondered thoughtfully, had he encountered Ao Hong, the Master of the True Spirit Domain?
The Witch had not died, so had Ao Hong survived that battle too?
After all, at the end of the great battle, Taicang had exhausted his last strength to send Qing Yu, the Witch, and others out of the battlefield. Perhaps Ao Hong had also escaped a calamity?
He took out the Prime Tortoise Carapace and asked, "Did you hear the dragon's roar? Is it Ao Hong's voice?"
Inside the Prime Tortoise Carapace, Qing Yu moved a bamboo branch, listening intently. At a moment, the faint roar of a dragon emerged again.
"The voice sounds like it could be Ao Hong!"
Qing Yu exclaimed in surprise and astonishment.
"If it's Ao Hong, then let's go see. He seems to be facing a formidable opponent."
Xu Yan looked at Ming Yu and said, "Ming Yu, enter the Prime Tortoise Carapace and meditate in peace. You may remember more things this way."
"Okay, Xu Yan. Be careful. If you truly cannot escape, just surrender me. I'll be fine."
Ming Yu nodded.
"Don't worry, I'm confident I can escape back to the Great Wilderness. Once back there, with my master present, even the Master of the Jade Court can't do anything."
Xu Yan proclaimed confidently.
His master was invincible!
Ming Yu entered the small world within the Prime Tortoise Carapace. Perhaps Qing Yu could help her recall more information, or maybe assist Qing Yu in understanding things from before his spiritual wisdom was born.
After storing the Prime Tortoise Carapace, Xu Yan quickly headed toward the direction from whence the dragon's roar had come.
In a region of the Land of Imperishable stood continuous, massive peaks, each transformed from a deceased Master of Heaven and Earth level True Spirit, and being hundreds of mountains signifies the death of hundreds of such True Spirits.
This chain of mountains was artificially made, linking together hundreds of peaks.
Each peak had its uniqueness, signifying that the transformed True Spirits from the mountains each possessed different capabilities, and some characteristics remained after their death, now being activated.
In the center of these hundreds of mountains cracked open a deep abyss, like a vast cage. At this moment, within the abyss, a massive figure thrashed about, emitting furious roars.
The cyan True Dragon emitted a powerful Dragon Might; however, its body was pierced by numerous chains, which were connected deep into the mountains.
These chains, formed from powerful True Spirit Force and containing some kind of Power of Dao Principles, tightly imprisoned the cyan True Dragon in the abyss.
The Prison Dragon Abyss!
On the mountain peaks above the Prison Dragon Abyss lay four potent True Spirits. One of the spirits, with a head resembling a giant lion and crimson mane, had a single red horn in the middle of its head, sturdy limbs, claws like an eagle, and a long tail with sharp bone spikes gleaming coldly at each end.
Unlike the other three True Spirits, this one possessed spiritual intelligence. At the moment, it lay on the peak, and in front of it was a large chunk of dragon flesh, freshly cut from the cyan dragon below.
Before this True Spirit sat a person clad in a gray robe, currently roasting the dragon flesh over a fire.
"Chi Ni Prince, we've known each other for a long time. You should know this True Dragon is special. Before the start of the Next Era, if you hand it over to me, you'll be well-prepared for the era's onset, and surely, King Chi Ni, your predecessor, would be pleased too."
The person in the gray robe said laughingly as he roasted the dragon meat.
"You people at the Imperishable Temple know what you're doing, and while trapped here, this dragon has its uses, like this meat is pretty tasty. Giving it all to you doesn't seem fair. Then I won't have dragon meat to eat."
The True Spirit known as Little Chi Ni shook its head.

chapters.title: Chapter 1106 - 571: Prison Dragon Abyss Ao Hong, One Sword Without Heaven
chapters.content:
The man in the gray robe pondered for a moment and said, "Catching Ao Hong was a great effort on my part, I deserve half of this dragon. Since you know what the Imperishable Divine Temple is up to, I suspect that King Chi Ni, your senior, must be planning some action as well. Why not collaborate then?"
"As for dragon flesh, the True Dragons aren't extinct. If I remember correctly, Ao Hong still has descendants living. If raised properly, they will provide plenty to eat."
King Chi Ni Jr. pondered before finally speaking, "You must compensate, there must be compensation, or there's nothing to discuss!"
The man in the gray robe breathed a sigh of relief and said, "Agreed!"
He then brought the roasted dragon meat over to King Chi Ni Jr. and said, "The meat is ready!"
King Chi Ni Jr., thrilled, took a bite and mumbled with his mouth full, "This meat, indeed, tastes better roasted."
"Of course!"
A hint of disdain flashed at the bottom of the gray-robed man's eyes.
He stood up and walked over to the Prison Dragon Abyss, looking down. Ao Hong was bound within the abyss; however much he struggled, he could not break the chains.
"Ao Hong, stop wasting your energy. You won't escape. Before the start of the Next Era, you will die, and the Taicang Domain will vanish completely. Everything from your domain will be utilized for the beginning of the Next Era," said the man in the gray robe with a cold smile.
"Aoow!" Ao Hong let out an angry roar, his eyes shining with fierce Dragon Might, but there was a sense of helplessness and sorrow.
After eating the meat, King Chi Ni Jr. also stuck his head out and looked at Ao Hong.
Upon seeing King Chi Ni Jr., Ao Hong was furious, "Damn it, I, Ao Hong, am also a True Spirit, part of the True Spirit lineage. Yet for the sake of the Imperishable Divine Temple, you harm your own kind. You're a True Spirit that will never become the King of True Spirits!"
"Shut up!" King Chi Ni Jr. was furious, his mane fluttering like a burning flame. "What kind of True Spirit are you? You've betrayed the Imperishable True Spirits. You're a Domain True Spirit, not one of us."
"Short-sighted fool, what do you know? I want to see King Chi Ni," Ao Hong shouted angrily.
Only by seeing King Chi Ni did he possibly stand a chance to be liberated or even, if necessary, pledge allegiance to King Chi Ni. Only then could he continue to grow stronger and seek his vengeance.
"You're not worthy of seeing my father!" King Chi Ni Jr. lifted his head, pride and arrogance painted across his face.
"Ao Hong, give up any foolish hopes of deceiving Master Chi Ni Jr.," sneered the man in the gray robe. "How could someone as brilliant and perceptive as Master Chi Ni Jr. fall for your tricks?"
King Chi Ni Jr. appeared quite pleased with himself.
Ao Hong felt helpless. Although King Chi Ni Jr. was not like other Imperishable True Spirits, which only had beastly nature without Spiritual Wisdom, the Spiritual Wisdom of King Chi Ni Jr. was average at best. Yet he was easily flattered into arrogance by a few words from the man in the gray robe, always thinking himself clever and astute.
He regretted not flattering King Chi Ni Jr. from the beginning, realizing how gullible he was and how easily swayed by flattery—perhaps then he would have avoided such a dire situation.
But Ao Hong had no choice. By his proud and noble nature as a True Dragon, he had been smart and independent since birth, a Master of Domain who opened up his own world. When he first met King Chi Ni Jr., he naturally couldn't stoop to such bootlicking and fawning behavior, especially not knowing its true power and background.
The man in the gray robe was more familiar with King Chi Ni Jr. and aware of his background. By flattering and allying with King Chi Ni Jr. from the start, he managed to imprison him here.
"Despicable and shameless! All of you from the Imperishable Divine Temple are abominable!"
Ao Hong roared and cursed in anger.
The man in the gray robe was not angered but merely smiled and said, "Go ahead and curse. The louder you curse, the more vitality you have. It's a good thing; those half-dead are less useful."
Angered, Ao Hong's eyes reddened, and he let out a series of dragon cries, struggling continually. The chains clinked loudly and shone brightly, locking him firmly within the abyss.
"Are you the Domain True Spirit Master Ao Hong?" Suddenly, a voice rang out.
Startled, both Ao Hong and the man in the gray robe turned their attention, as did three other True Spirits that were lying nearby, suddenly roaring out.
Somehow, a handsome young man had appeared in front of the Prison Dragon Abyss.
The man in the gray robe's expression tightened. The young man had appeared unexpectedly, and he had not noticed him in advance. The youth was extremely strong, a Master of Heaven and Earth level powerhouse!
Ao Hong looked up, taken aback. Was this a being from the Domain?
Where had this Domain being come from?
Now, only the Taicang Domain remained in the whole of the Land of Chaotic Imperishable. So how could such a powerful being emerge from there? And why here?
Even if Taicang left a contingency, allowing for a new Master of Domain to emerge in the Taicang Domain, it was impossible for him to appear here just yet. Could it be that Taicang had perished, and this new Master of Domain was seeking refuge, thus arriving at this place?
If so, the Unchanging Divine Master must be hot on his heels. A Master of Heaven and Earth level power definitely could not escape the pursuit of the Unchanging Divine Master.
Hence Ao Hong was puzzled and astonished.
"Who are you?"
"I am Sword God Xu Yan!" Xu Yan spoke calmly, completely unfazed by the four Master of Heaven and Earth level True Spirits or the man in the gray robe. Now that he had arrived, the man in the gray robe was as good as dead.
Those from the Imperishable Divine Temple were meant to be killed on sight!
"Sword God Xu Yan?" Ao Hong was taken aback, asking hesitantly, "Are you from the Taicang Domain?"
"Yes, and no," Xu Yan nodded then shook his head.
The gray-robed man stared at Xu Yan, visibly shocked, and then an ecstatic look spread across his face—an unexpected gain indeed, another Master of Domain level being?
Meanwhile, King Chi Ni Jr., seeing Xu Yan, carried on talking to Ao Hong as if nobody else mattered, completely disregarding it, the owner of Prison Dragon Abyss, and immediately became furious, letting out a low growl.

chapters.title: Chapter 1107 - 571: Prison Dragon Abyss Ao Hong, One Sword Without Heaven_2
chapters.content:
As the red creature let out a low growl, one of the three True Spirits roared with a bursting aura and fiercely pounced toward Xu Yan.
"Be careful!"
Ao Hong couldn't help but exclaim, reminding him.
Xu Yan's expression remained unchanged, and with a raise of his hand, he slashed out with his sword. The sword light was like a streak of cold gleam, shining amidst the mountains and striking the incoming True Spirit.
Boom!
The True Spirit instantly fell to the ground, causing the mountain itself to tremble.
Slain with one sword strike!
The red creature was taken aback; the person in the gray robe also froze for a moment, and Ao Hong had an incredulous look on his face. Such strength reminded him of Taicang.
Apart from Taicang, there was no other being in the Domain with such mighty power. Even at his prime, he would not have been able to kill that True Spirit with such ease and nonchalance.
"Roar!"
The red creature's mane fluttered like burning flames, red smoke billowing from its nostrils, and its eyes burning with a crimson rage, livid with fury.
"You dare kill my underling!"
"Act together, capture him. Since he came to save Ao Hong, he might as well join Ao Hong."
The person in the gray robe said with a cold laugh.
In his hand appeared a curved gray blade, its aura surging, and his powerful strength was indubitably revealed.
The large body of the red creature erupted with the might of a True Spirit, while the other two True Spirits growled and encircled their prey.
From within Prison Dragon Abyss, Ao Hong's expression changed. "Escape quickly, you're no match for them!"
Even though Xu Yan's strength exceeded his expectations, both the red creature and the person in the gray robe were extremely powerful, not your usual Masters of Domain. How could Xu Yan stand a chance alone?
"After I deal with them, I'll free you."
Xu Yan said calmly, unfazed.
He turned to look at the person in the gray robe, chuckled coldly, and said, "People of the Divine Transformation Temple, I'm rather curious why you keep targeting the beings of the Domain?"
The person in the gray robe didn't answer but stepped closer. "Once you're imprisoned with Ao Hong, you'll understand when the Next Era begins."
Xu Yan glanced at the red creature, mildly curious, "Imperishable True Spirits are not supposed to possess Spiritual Wisdom, how did you develop it? Although it appears to be quite basic, it's still somewhat unexpected."
"You dare insult me, the son of the red creature? You're courting death!"
Boom!
The red creature, enraged beyond measure, swept its tail. A buzzing sound resonated, and it seemed as though a whip shadow appeared in mid-air, viciously striking down.
The other two True Spirits roared and belched out a stream of powerful crimson light, blasting towards Xu Yan.
At this moment, the person in the gray robe made his move too. With a wave of his hand, chains flew from his sleeve, forming a giant net that draped towards Xu Yan.
"Insect tricks!"
Xu Yan's expression was indifferent, and sword light surged out from within him. In an instant, it seemed as if a Domain had enveloped from above.
He raised his hand and slapped.
Aow!
The Golden Dragon roared furiously as it blasted out.
Dragon Might surged, the roar of the dragon filled with boundless fury.
Below Prison Dragon Abyss, Ao Hong was stunned. A True Dragon?
Where did this True Dragon come from?
"No, that's not right! What Dharma is this?"
He was immediately shocked to discover that this Golden Giant Dragon, which was released from a single slap of Xu Yan's hand, was like a real True Dragon, possessing powerful Dragon Might.
Moreover, this Golden Giant Dragon was filled with wild rage, seemingly determined to perish together with its foes, as if exhausting all its power and igniting everything in a final, devastating strike!
Both the red creature and the person in the gray robe were also startled, with the red creature instinctively exclaiming, "Are you a True Dragon?"
The Golden Dragon roared and charged forth, directly confronting the True Spirits that had released their True Spirit Force. With thunderous booms, the Golden Giant Dragon blasted the attacks and struck the two True Spirits, sending them flying.
Hum!
Immediately afterwards, sword light emerged, and the aura of annihilation arose.
"Go all out!"
The grey-robed figure's expression drastically changed. Xu Yan's strength had surpassed his expectations, even giving him the sensation of facing Taicang,
and it was even more ferocious than Taicang by threefold!
Roar!
The red cub also sensed danger and suddenly enlarged its body. The red light enveloped it as it spat out a beam of red light toward Xu Yan, and at the same time, its tail shot up high, its sharp bone spurs glowing with a chilling light.
With a wave of the grey-robed figure's hand, streaks of obscure power swept out like a storm, transforming into countless curved blades that came rolling forward.
Hum!
A streak of sword light suddenly slashed out, tearing through the storm of blades, while Xu Yan's form instantly vanished from the spot, easily avoiding the red cub's strike.
The next moment, he reappeared in front of the grey-robed figure, thrusting out a sword. The domain unfolded within the sword, and the area around the grey-robed figure seemed to transform into a domain in an instant.
Within this domain, another sword light that annihilated everything descended!
Divine Skills, World within the Sword combined with the Supreme Heavenly Sword!
The grey-robed figure's complexion turned to one of horror as a sense of intense crisis surged within him. Murky power continuously emerged from him, and at the same time, a grey orb appeared. With a bang, the orb burst open, enveloping him like a net – but instead of encapsulating Xu Yan, it encased the grey-robed figure himself.
The massive net enshrouded him as if he was protected by a strong layer of Dao Principles.
Xu Yan raised an eyebrow. This grey orb was a condensation of the Power of Principles, not the power of the grey-robed figure. Clearly, it was a defensive artifact given to the grey-robed figure by the Unchanging Divine Master.
With a cold snort, strong as the orb's principles might be, they had not surpassed the range of the Master of Domain. How could they block his sword strike?
After shielding himself with the Dao Principles, the grey-robed figure breathed a slight sigh of relief. He raised his curved blade, power surging around his body, gathering upon the blade. He aimed to strike a lethal blow against Xu Yan or severely injure him the instant the defending principles held off Xu Yan's thrust.
Meanwhile, the red cub, having missed its strike, was furious. Its raised tail lashed down violently, the sharp bone spurs shooting down like cold flashes of light.
Boom!
The World within the Sword trembled, cracks appeared in the domain, but Xu Yan's expression was unchanged as his sword already struck upon the massive web-like Power of Principles surrounding the grey-robed figure.
Hum!
With one strike, the sword instantly severed the net-like Power of Principles. The fierce sword light cut through the defense toward the grey-robed figure.
The sword intent, which seemed capable of annihilating everything, threatened to obliterate the grey-robed figure. This powerful strike shocked him, and his curved blade was brought down instantly, striking against Xu Yan's sword.
Boom!
The Supreme Heavenly Sword and the grey-robed figure's blow collided, unleashing a powerful surge of energy. Amid the thundering noise, the mountain peak instantly collapsed by more than half.
The World within the Sword shattered at that moment, and the red cub's strike was already upon him.
Xu Yan moved, and instantly vanished from the spot. With a thunderous sound, the red cub's tail struck emptiness, emitting an angry roar as its red light flared up like flames, lunging directly at Xu Yan.
Ah!
Suddenly, the grey-robed figure let out a pained scream, instinctively covering his head.
Even though he had blocked the residual force of the Supreme Heavenly Sword, Xu Yan's hidden Sudden Wind Sword Intent had sliced into his Divine Soul, causing soul damage that made him cry out in agony.
The red cub's lunge paused, and it looked toward the grey-robed figure in shock. Its strength was not inferior to its own, yet it had been injured, and the cub had not perceived how the grey-robed figure had been hurt.
The grey-robed figure growled, his face contorted, but he knew that a real crisis had arrived. Without hesitation, he took out another orb that exploded with a bang, transforming into a grey shield that encased him.
Boom!
Strong power surged from the grey-robed figure, with grey images reminiscent of skulls appearing around him.
But Xu Yan slashed down with another sword strike.
This strike was silent and void of any fierce sword intent, seeming like an ordinary strike. However, the intense sense of impending death engulfed the grey-robed figure.
"Let's see how my Sword Arts Divine Skill fares against you!" Xu Yan said indifferently.
Divine Skills, One Sword Without Heaven!
Roar!
"Red cub, quickly join in!" the grey-robed figure cried out in horror, exerting all his strength and burning his Origin in a frenzied attempt to block this sword strike.
The red cub, too, was scared and opened its mouth to emit a massive beam of red light, which bombarded down.

chapters.title: Chapter 1108 - 572: Slaying with a Single Sword, My Master Taoist Ancestor
chapters.content:
A sword slashed down, seemingly ordinary, a common sword, yet everything within its swipe was cleaved into nothingness.
Gurgle!
The red light beam that the little Chi Ni had spat out had just descended and was already disappearing, dissolving into nothingness; this scene caused it to be terrified and pale.
The man in the grey robe showed a face full of shock and despair; he couldn't block it, he simply couldn't!
Even more, he couldn't figure out how to defend against such a terrifying sword. Neither the gray shield nor the horrific attack he unleashed by burning his origin could withstand this sword; they were all turning to nothingness!
"The Divine Master will avenge me!"
The man in the grey robe yelled in fear and unwillingness.
A breath emerged from his body; it was the essence of burning a strand of his origin. Casting out a breath, before the sword could fully cut down, this breath slipped into the Chaos, vanishing without a trace, sending a message to the Unchanging Divine Master.
Xu Yan didn't stop him; what difference would it make if the Unchanging Divine Master knew?
He wanted all the mighties of the Imperishable Temple to remember his name and tremble at the mention of 'Sword God Xu Yan'!
That breath was nothing more than the imprint of the Unchanging Divine Master within the man in the grey robe, a mark used to send a certain message to the Unchanging Divine Master. Xu Yan destroyed this mark and let the enemy deliver the message to the Unchanging Divine Master.
Gurgle!
The grey-robed man's body disintegrated, slowly turning into nothingness, not even leaving a wisp of ash behind.
"Who exactly are you? There can't be such a strong person in Taicang!"
The man in the grey robe said with unwillingness and disbelief.
"Sword God Xu Yan, from the Great Wilderness Domain. Before Great Wilderness, there was Taicang."
Xu Yan calmly spoke.
The area where the grey-robed man was, turned into nothingness, as if such a person had never existed, nor had there been an eruption of mighty power.
Everything returned to calm.
Xu Yan turned to look at the little Chi Ni, who by then was stunned, retracting the red beam from its mouth.
"This True Spirit is quite interesting; it has given birth to Spiritual Wisdom and its Divine Soul is probably somewhat unique. My junior sister might be interested, but I have no interest in capturing something alive."
Xu Yan said and, with a sword strike, the Domain descended.
Currently being pursued by Yu Ting, Xu Yan had no interest in taking the trouble to capture the little Chi Ni alive, especially since its strength was too formidable for the small world within the Prime Tortoise Carapace to contain.
If that's the case, the only option was to turn it into a corpse to bring back. However, preserving its Divine Soul, so it wouldn't be completely extinguished, posed no difficulty for Xu Yan.
"My father is King Chi Ni, an ancient Imperishable True Spirit; you can't kill me, or else my father won't spare you!"
The little Chi Ni panicked.
Xu Yan showed no sign of stopping, making the little Chi Ni even more frantic as it roared, "My father is a being that surpasses the Masters of Domain, surpasses many, many strong beings. If you kill me, you certainly won't escape; the Domain you belong to won't withstand my father's wrath. Stop immediately; you can't kill me. As long as you let me go, we'll let bygones be bygones and you can take Ao Hong!"
"So what? I, Xu Yan, never bow to threats, nor do I fear them. When it comes to backers, no one can compare to me!"
Xu Yan said with a cold smile.
"You..."
The little Chi Ni, overwhelmed with shock and rage, roared, "I'll fight you with all I've got!"
The battle subsided, the little Chi Ni was dead, its body intact, and most of its Divine Soul preserved, but its consciousness was completely extinguished.
Xu Yan raised his hand, drawing the corpse of the little Chi Ni into the Prime Tortoise Carapace, to the astonishment of Qing Yu. She sensed a strength emanating from the little Chi Ni that was even more powerful than her at her peak.
Such a strong True Spirit had actually been slain by Xu Yan.
Ming Yu tilted her head, staring at the corpse of the little Chi Ni, pondering, as if she had seen this type of True Spirit somewhere before.
The other two True Spirits, blown away and severely injured by a single strike, were eradicated by Xu Yan, who also stored their corpses inside the Prime Tortoise Carapace.
"Qing Yu, that's Ao Hong trapped in the Prison Dragon Abyss, right?"
Xu Yan looked towards Ao Hong, who was locked in Prison Dragon Abyss, and asked.
A bamboo branch from Qing Yu stretched out from within the Prime Tortoise Carapace and looked towards the imprisoned Ao Hong, responding, "Yes, it's him. I never expected him to be alive; my Taicang elder brother..."
Netherworld was alive, the Witch was alive, Ao Hong was alive, and even she, the weakest, was alive, yet Taicang, the strongest among them, was dead.
Three out of the Seven Great Domain Masters had died: Taicang, Fen Yun, and Hong Ze.
Ao Hong was stunned. Both the man in the grey robe and the little Chi Ni were extremely powerful beings, neither weaker than him; otherwise, they wouldn't have been captured and imprisoned here.
He had expected a fierce battle, and ultimately Xu Yan would be defeated and flee, leaving him still trapped here, unable to escape.
But he never could have imagined how quickly things unfolded: the grey-robed man was dead, and so was the little Chi Ni. Such strength, feared only Taicang, could manage.
Was there such a powerful being in the Taicang Domain? Impossible!
Even if the Taicang Domain had a new Master of Domain emerging, they absolutely couldn't possess such strength. Could it be that Taicang's contingency plan left behind was so terrifying?
"Qing Yu?"
Suddenly, Ao Hong came back to his senses, looking at the bamboo branch extending from the Prime Tortoise Carapace in astonishment.
"How come you..."
Qing Yu, how had she reverted to her original form? Since she had not resumed human shape, there must have been some problem, as Qing Yu would never appear in her original form; she had always preferred to take her human likeness.
"It's me!"
Qing Yu sighed, finding solace in seeing an old friend.

chapters.title: Chapter 1109 - 572: Slaying with a Single Sword, My Master Taoist Ancestor_2
chapters.content:
Xu Yan swung his sword, cleaving through the chains that bound Ao Hong's dragon body, and with a single stroke, severed and obliterated them. Overcome with excitement, Ao Hong let out a satisfied dragon's roar, soared into the sky, and transformed into a tall and handsome middle-aged man clad in a green robe, sporting two small dragon horns atop his head.
"Ao Hong thanks you for the rescue!"
Ao Hong expressed his gratitude.
"It's nothing."
Xu Yan waved his hand.
"Ao Hong, how did you end up trapped here?"
Qing Yu asked, puzzled.
Ao Hong sighed, his expression filled with helplessness and desolation.
"During the great battle, I was nearly split in two. It was Brother Taicang who sent me out of the battlefield to escape..."
In that great battle, Ao Hong, who had been grievously wounded, had used the True Dragon Secret Art to ignite the almost-severed part of his dragon body, turning it into a force for escape and hastily fleeing into the boundless Land of Imperishable before the Master of the Imperishable Temple Domain, who was there to intercept him, could arrive.
Because his injuries were so severe, and his dragon body was partially severed, the burning part could not sustain him for a long escape. Once exhausted, he would be in extreme danger, easily slain by the pursuing warriors of the Imperishable Temple. Desperate, Ao Hong clenched his teeth and persisted, fleeing as far as he could.
As fate would have it, his life was not meant to end there. Just as he was about to be depleted and enter a state of severe weakness, he encountered two Heaven and Earth Lord-Level True Spirits. After a fierce battle, they nearly died together, barely clinging to life.
There and then, Ao Hong devoured these two True Spirits to replenish himself and heal his wounds, yet he dared not linger and continued his flight. Having consumed two Heaven and Earth Lord-Level True Spirits, his injuries had been restored, and his strength somewhat increased.
He fled and devoured True Spirits, fortuitously coming across another injured and weakened Heaven and Earth Lord-Level True Spirit. After a battle, he exhausted it to death, and after devouring that True Spirit, the severed part of his dragon body also recovered.
Ao Hong felt that his life was not meant to end and even began to harbor hopes for revenge. He prepared to cultivate in hiding, improve his strength, and once he made a breakthrough, he planned to seek vengeance against the Imperishable Temple.
However, not long after regaining his strength, he encountered King Chi Ni's son, who demanded that Ao Hong become his follower. The proud Ao Hong would never agree. Before they could start fighting, a man in grey robes came in pursuit and, after deceiving King Chi Ni, they joined forces and captured Ao Hong.
"King Chi Ni's son... had I not been trapped by a force from King Chi Ni himself, it would have been easy to escape."
Ao Hong sighed and added, "Had I known how powerful and easily deceived King Chi Ni's son was, and his formidable background, I would have flattered him from the start."
"How strong is King Chi Ni? How does he compare to the Unchanging Divine Master?"
Xu Yan was filled with curiosity.
This Land of Imperishable indeed held too many secrets. In such a short time, yet another immensely powerful True Spirit with Spiritual Wisdom had emerged.
"King Chi Ni is an ancient True Spirit, having lived through countless ages. How strong he is compared to the Unchanging Divine Master, I can't say, as I've never seen him. Over the years, I've only gathered some information from King Chi Ni's son, the man in grey robes, and some other True Spirits.
"This is an Imperishable True Spirit with Spiritual Wisdom. It is said to have its own unique Art of the True Spirit, ruling over a vast domain of the Chaos Primordial Land, with numerous Heaven and Earth Lord-Level True Spirits under its command. No one knows how many Heaven and Earth Lord-Level True Spirits there are in the boundless Land of Imperishable. One can only imagine how powerful King Chi Ni's forces might be."
Ao Hong's expression was grave, "Friend Xu, you've killed the son of King Chi Ni, and he will surely seek vengeance. This matter started because of me, and I..."
Xu Yan interrupted him, "King Chi Ni's son was killed by me. You don't need to shoulder the concern. If King Chi Ni wants to come after me, then let him come."
"Friend Xu, you are very strong, no weaker than Brother Taicang was back then, but King Chi Ni is, after all..."
Ao Hong still wore an expression of deep concern.
"If this King Chi Ni, an old antique True Spirit, intends to bully the less powerful... If he dares to do so, my master is not a gentle and soft-hearted person either."
Xu Yan remained unconcerned.
How could the mighty King Chi Ni be anything but an ant, easily squished by a slap from his master?
Ao Hong swallowed hard. Xu Yan was already so powerful; just how formidable must his master be for him to take the threat of King Chi Ni so lightly?
"May I inquire, who is your esteemed master?"
"My master is the Taoist Ancestor!"
Xu Yan replied solemnly.
"Taoist Ancestor?!"
Ao Hong and Qing Yu both felt a shock in their hearts, knowing from the name alone how immensely powerful it was.
"Although Friend Xu is protected by a predecessor Taoist Ancestor, it was after all because of saving me that this matter was triggered. I, Ao Hong, cannot just stand idly by, especially since the threat of the Imperishable Temple is still present, and they are even about to start taking action. I must do something."
Ao Hong took a deep breath and spoke earnestly.
"How is the Taicang Domain now?"
Then he asked about the current state of the Taicang Domain.
"The Taicang Domain is now history, it is now the Great Wilderness Domain..."
Xu Yan gave a brief introduction of the Great Wilderness Domain.
"Whether it's Taicang or the Great Wilderness, it is ultimately the same Domain, and Tian Zi is the most qualified to inherit it. No matter what, I, Ao Hong, will do my utmost to avert the crisis of this Domain."
Ao Hong's eyes flashed coldly as he spoke, "The grudge against the Imperishable Temple cannot be left unsettled, and the Unchanging Divine Master will not let this rest. I have heard that, in the Land of Imperishable, aside from King Chi Ni, there are two other Kings of True Spirits. I wish to find the other two Kings of True Spirits to stand against the Imperishable Temple.
"Although I have created a Domain, I am after all born of a True Spirit. I should have a chance at success. Friend Xu, let's part ways here. I will return before the Imperishable Temple launches its attack on the Great Wilderness."
"Alright, until we meet again!"
Xu Yan nodded his head.
Following him would be inconvenient for Ao Hong, since he was currently being pursued by the Jade Court. Since Ao Hong planned to seek out the other two Kings of True Spirits, whether he succeeds or not, he was also making an effort for the Great Wilderness.
"Ao!"
Ao Hong transformed into his True Dragon form, a cyan-colored giant dragon coiling in the Chaos Primordial Land, he said in a deep voice, "The Next Era is about to begin. The Unchanging Divine Master wishes to devour the Domain, or rather, to sacrifice the Domain to achieve a certain goal. The other Kings of True Spirits, having crossed more than one Primordial Age, likely have their own schemes, and must be handled with caution. My greatest concern is that the Kings of True Spirits might also be coveting the Great Wilderness Domain."
Qing Yu spoke up, "Ao Hong, the Witch is not dead either, he's being chased by the Imperishable Temple. If you can find him, perhaps you can lend him a hand."
Ao Hong was startled, then nodded and said, "I understand!"
Ao!
With a dragon's roar, Ao Hong disappeared into the vast Land of Imperishable.
"We should also leave."
Xu Yan put away the Prime Tortoise Carapace and looked towards a certain place in the Chaos Primordial Land, under his Minor Heavenly Eye, he could faintly see eight streaks of silver-white light shooting towards him.
"They're fast to track us down here."
Xu Yan said indifferently, the strength of the Jade Court was indeed not simple, especially that of the mysterious Master of the Jade Court.
His figure moved and vanished in an instant.
A huge, ancient palace, its gates tightly shut, with two Heaven and Earth Lord-Level True Spirits lying in front, snoring as if asleep.
No one could approach the core sanctuary of the Divine Temple, and no one dared to try. Moreover, there was a layer of force protecting the core sanctuary, and even a Master of Heaven and Earth would not be able to break through.
The core sanctuary was a palace shaped like a large bell placed on the ground, made of gray-black stone, which looked quite unremarkable.
At this moment, within the bell-like palace, a figure stood silently in the center. On the floor of the palace, a radiant mist portrayed a landscape of mountains and rivers which shifted under his feet, offering a variety of sceneries, colors of mountains, and thousands of rivers.
Above, in the top of the palace, stars speckled the sky, sun and moon rose and fell.
Above were the sun, moon, and stars, below were the mountains and rivers; standing amidst them, it felt as though one were in the midst of the universe.
This figure watched the celestial bodies at the top of the palace quietly, and after a long while, he murmured to himself: "It's not enough, it's still lacking a bit. Is the Taicang Domain sufficient? It should be. This time, I must succeed. Taicang, oh Taicang, you truly surprise me. You have actually created a Domain, greatly increasing my chances to escape from here. This opening of the Next Era, I will surely be successful."

chapters.title: Chapter 1110 - 573: King Chi Ni, Coexisting as One
chapters.content:
Stars adorned the palace where the sun and moon rose and fell, and the Unchanging Divine Master gazed at the mountains and rivers below his feet, looking up at the sun, moon, and stars above. In a trance, it seemed he had returned to that place.
The image appeared in his mind, a figure gifted and clear about his debts and grievances. He could not help but sigh, "Taicang, you can let go, but I cannot. I must annihilate those who pursue me; otherwise, there will be no outlet for this rage of mine. I am unwilling, and my rage must be vented upon my pursuers!"
The Unchanging Divine Master's eyes were sharp, filled with resentment and bitterness, "Taicang, I know, given time, your Domain would surely become more powerful, even more splendid, but what of it? Ultimately, one cannot escape, ultimately, there is no return. I refuse to accept exile; they all deserve to die. Therefore, everything you possess must now serve me!"
"Taicang, oh Taicang... proclaimed as the greatest prodigy since ancient times, you indeed live up to your name, but… alas!"
The Unchanging Divine Master sighed, but his gaze grew even more resolute, a hint of brutal and fierce determination hidden deep within his eyes.
Suddenly, his expression changed.
"Dead!"
His gaze grew intense, seemingly sensing something. At a certain moment, his eyes flashed coldly, showing a trace of incredulity.
"Sword God Xu Yan? Great Wilderness Domain?"
He then became excited, "Good, very good! I worried that the Taicang Domain alone would not be enough to aid my success. I had not expected another monstrosity to emerge. Is this a backup plan left by you, Taicang? Hahaha, how wonderful the Great Wilderness is, the stronger this Domain, the better, helping me succeed; no one can stop me!"
At this point, the Unchanging Divine Master's eyes became vicious, "Yu Ting and the Three Great True Spirit Kings alike, dare to ruin my plans, spare me not for initiating a massacre, I will kill all of you!"
"Hahaha, good! Very good! I like prodigies; I relish such monstrosities, the more, the better, haha, just wait, I shall return, and those who exiled me will tremble!"
The Unchanging Divine Master burst into wild laughter.
Then, he raised his hand, a wisp of aura appeared at his fingertips, transmitting a certain message; after transmitting the message, he continued to gaze at the sun, moon, and stars atop the palace.
Somewhere in the Land of Imperishable, on a massive mountain, lay a colossal True Spirit, its breath like a storm swirling around the mountain, with dozens of True Spirits of various kinds lying around, each of their power undoubtedly at the Master of Domain level, and evinced top-tier strength among those.
These True Spirits lay there obediently; each breath of the massive True Spirit atop the mountain created a Spirit Qi Storm that made the bodies of those lying around tremble, clearly holding utmost reverence for the mountain's massive True Spirit.
King Chi Ni had lived for endless centuries and no longer fancied conflict or fought for territories, preferring instead to lie here and sleep.
The Land of Imperishable was boundless, and despite having lived through long ages, he had never traversed its entirety and had long lost any desire to explore or entertain thoughts of leaving the Land of Imperishable.
The only thing capable of grabbing his attention, the only thing he cared about, was the light at the beginning of the One Primordial.
Like him, there were two other True Spirits, all well-acquainted with each other; they had fought before, but as they lived longer, their desire to fight diminished, especially after gaining Spiritual Wisdom, they would cease their battles once a point was made, rather than fight to the death.
Now, they lacked even the will to compete; occasionally encountering one another, they would simply nod and greet, and as for territories, there was no need to contend over them in the vast, boundless Land of Imperishable.
Moreover, they met only by coincidence after long periods, apart from the other two True Spirits, there was also a beautiful white courtyard he once desired to claim but ultimately decided to abandon.
Dwelling in the courtyard were beings of immense power, where battling could result in uncertain victories; it was not worth the risk.
Aside from Yu Ting, he had also encountered a temple, housing formidable beings as well, and no conflicts arose there.
Each One Primordial opening, there were some quiet rivalries between them, even if not engaging personally; each would still have their subordinates carry out tasks.
The Divine Temple was undertaking a plan, King Chi Ni was aware, and rumors from the Land of Imperishable spoke of someone who had once opened a Domain, but by the time the news reached him, that Domain had already been devoured by the Divine Temple.
He had never seen what Domain looked like, but the rumors described it as extremely splendid. True Spirits who had seen the Domain longed to enter but were unable to.
These tidbits, reaching his ears, signaled that the Domain no longer existed, and with the approach of the next One Primordial, he gradually drifted towards the region where the Domain had once appeared.
Presumably, the other two True Spirits and Yu Ting were also nearing that area.
King Chi Ni laid comfortably on the mountain, trying his best to imagine what the Domain looked like and pondering the color of the light at the next One Primordial opening.
In his memory, nothing was more beautiful than the light at the beginning of the next One Primordial.
That seemed to be the only exquisite scene in the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, albeit brief, yet it could be etched in the mind, forever remembered.
Even True Spirits without Spiritual Wisdom, upon seeing this light, would forever remember it in their minds, never forgetting it until death, and even some True Spirits, upon their death turning into mountains, the luminescence shimmering therein stemmed from their recollection of that light.
Suddenly, King Chi Ni opened his eyes wide and let out an angry low roar.

chapters.title: Chapter 1111 - 573 King Chi Ni, Coexistence as One_2
chapters.content:
```
"Roar!"
The terrifying roar shook the Land of Imperishable, and all the True Spirits trembled in terror, their eyes filled with fear as they looked towards King Chi Ni standing up from the mountain peak.
"My child, you dared to kill my child!"
King Chi Ni was unmatched in his anger, his most beloved son, Chi Ni Junior, had died!
In his life, he had many sons, but Chi Ni Junior was his favorite and the one with the highest Spiritual Wisdom. Hence, he doted on him immensely, bestowing a power upon this son.
The purpose was to let him deter the many True Spirits and command them. Before Chi Ni Junior could strengthen his power to the Master of Domain level, he dominated True Spirits of that level with this very aura.
Now, his son was dead!
This filled King Chi Ni with incomparable anger, an intense aura bursting forth that brought about a storm in the Land of Imperishable.
"Who killed my child!"
King Chi Ni's eyes were blood-red, Chi Ni Junior was not weak, and he was King Chi Ni's son, carrying his aura. No True Spirit would dare to affront him, let alone kill him.
"Divine Temple or Yu Ting?"
King Chi Ni's nostrils expelled red mist. His mane moved like blazing flames, and his powerful aura whipped up a Spirit Qi Storm, petrifying the surrounding True Spirits. They lowered their heads, hardly daring to breathe, lest the fury engulf them.
The other two Great True Spirit Kings wouldn't have laid a hand on him, after all, they had their descendants and an unspoken pact between them. Even if provoked, they would at most discipline as elders, never going as far as killing.
Thus, the most likely suspect was from the Divine Temple or Yu Ting. King Chi Ni was now shaking with unbridled fury, he began to operate a True Spirit secret technique, seeking the murderer through bloodline connections.
At a certain moment, a message from Chi Ni Junior just before his death transmitted through the bloodline.
"Sword God Xu Yan?!"
King Chi Ni's eyes emitted a chilling light as he roared, "Damn it!"
Roar!
The wild rage scared several True Spirits into wetting themselves on the spot.
"Father, why are you angry?"
From afar, a Chi Ni that was much smaller in size than King Chi Ni rushed over, its voice somewhat dull with inquiry.
This was one of King Chi Ni's sons. Although endowed with Spiritual Wisdom, it was not as bright as Chi Ni Junior and significantly inferior, though its strength was by no means weak, even stronger than Chi Ni Junior's.
After all, this Chi Ni had lived longer, and its strength was greater.
"Chi Eighteen Ni, your brother has been killed!"
King Chi Ni said in a fit of rage.
"What? Who dares kill my brother?"
Chi Eighteen Ni's face was filled with shock.
King Chi Ni's sons were named by their order; Chi Ni Junior was the youngest and most favored, hence his name. This son was the eighteenth, thus named Chi Eighteen Ni!
"Sword God Xu Yan, convey my command, find him for me, I want to devour him alive!"
King Chi Ni bellowed.
"Yes, Father!"
Chi Eighteen Ni nodded in a panic and hurried off to send the royal decree of the True Spirit King.
"Go, find Sword God Xu Yan for me!"
King Chi Ni ordered the True Spirits crouched all around, a radiant light emerging to simulate Xu Yan's rough appearance.
Roar! Roar!
The multitude of True Spirits roared, storming into The Land of Chaotic Imperishable, spreading King Chi Ni's command far and wide. Although True Spirits were not intelligent, animal to animal, there still existed methods of transmitting information.
A massive horde of True Spirits began to move differently, especially those with Realm Master Level strength or above, who could comprehend the conveyed message more clearly: they were to find a person!
After all, King Chi Ni was an ancient True Spirit of immense power, ruling over the True Spirits for long years. To most, King Chi Ni's supremacy had been passed down through bloodlines generation after generation.
Now, this command from the king in their bloodline's heritage was something these True Spirits would devoutly follow.
Somewhere in the Land of Imperishable, Blood Demon walked with a somber face.
"Hehe, tomorrow's the day I take over the body, oh, such powerful strength is delightful!"
Inside Blood Demon, the voice of Blood Extreme could be heard.
"Shut up! It's my time now; don't disturb me!"
Blood Demon snapped.
After an intense struggle and a long negotiation, a temporary agreement had been reached: each would control the body and power for three days, taking turns.
This situation was greatly frustrating for Blood Demon, for it was his own body and power, and yet he had to share it with someone else!
As for Blood Extreme, he was thrilled. Although he had not succeeded in fully taking over Blood Demon, he also hadn't failed. It was a partial success, and with time on his side, there would surely be opportunities to completely replace Blood Demon.
```
As for whether the Blood Demon was also plotting something, Blood Extreme didn't care. As long as the Unchanging Divine Master didn't offer his assistance, he was confident that he wouldn't be stripped away.
"Isn't it boring to be alone? You and I share this body, so more interaction and fostering some affection are good things."
Blood Extreme chuckled.
"Are you going to find the Witch?"
The Blood Demon's face was cold. He had thought that he could rise to power, with his strength skyrocketing to eventually pull down the Unchanging Divine Master and make him kneel before him, swearing allegiance to himself, with Blood Demon taking his place.
But he had been miserably duped!
It was time to carry out the mission of the Unchanging Divine Master, otherwise, once the Divine Master found out that Blood Demon hadn't pursued the Witch, the consequences were too dire to contemplate.
"Do you really want to rescue the Witch?"
The Blood Demon coldly stated.
"Hee hee, the Witch was your older brother's best friend. And now you want to kill him? Did your brother really betray everyone back then?"
By now, Blood Extreme had learned more information.
The Blood Demon was the Netherworld's younger brother!
Moreover, he knew a big secret about the Blood Demon; the guy had rebellious inclinations. If not for his lack of power, he would have backstabbed the Unchanging Divine Master!
The Blood Demon's face darkened: "You were once a follower of my older brother. What are you doing now? Don't think I don't know that you defected to the Divine Temple before being killed!"
Blood Extreme chuckled, "I won't deny it. I was deceived by your Divine Temple. In the end, I couldn't control myself, and thus I was suppressed.
"You're just another guy harboring rebellion..."
"Shut up!"
The Blood Demon suddenly roared in anger and said resentfully, "Do you want to die? Things like that must not be spoken! These thoughts must be sealed away by yourself, otherwise, if the Divine Master notices, you'll die a terrible death!"
Blood Extreme clicked his tongue incessantly; it was clear that the Blood Demon feared the Unchanging Divine Master down to his bones.
"What's there to fear? If you take refuge under the Taoist Ancestor, what can the Unchanging Divine Master do to you?"
Blood Extreme took a casual stance.
"Humph, you cannot fathom how strong the Divine Masters are. That Taoist Ancestor probably comes from Yu Ting; do you really think their strength exceeds that of the Divine Temple?"
By now, Blood Demon no longer believed Blood Extreme's gibberish.
"Suit yourself."
Blood Extreme no longer pressed the issue. Blood Demon had been duped once and wouldn't believe it again. Moreover, the Unchanging Divine Master's power was, in Blood Demon's eyes, nearly invincible.
"Did your older brother, Netherworld, really betray everyone?"
Blood Extreme raised the question again.
Blood Demon, his face darkening, walked briskly while searching for the Witch's trail.
"If you don't answer, that means he did. So, Taicang's defeat was due to Netherworld's betrayal?"
Blood Extreme spoke with a tone derisive of Netherworld.
"Talk nonsense!"
Blood Demon was furious but then sighed, "I begged the Divine Master to show mercy, and that's the only reason my older brother survived, but it came with a price."
"What price?"
Blood Extreme was immensely curious.
The Blood Demon didn't respond, allowing Blood Extreme to bluster on without saying another word.
"Boring!"
Blood Extreme shook his head and stopped asking.
"Something's not right!"
Suddenly, the roars of True Spirits came from afar, along with the sight of True Spirits rushing past, but they paused for a while at a distance, staring at the Blood Demon for a long time before continuing on their way.
"What's the matter?"
Blood Extreme was puzzled; he couldn't see any issue.
"These True Spirits are acting strangely!"
The Blood Demon spoke with a heavy voice.
"What's strange about them?"
Blood Extreme still hadn't noticed anything amiss, but he didn't doubt the Blood Demon's judgment. After all, the Blood Demon was one of the Elders of the Divine Transformation Temple, having traveled the Land of Imperishable with the temple and possessing far more experience and knowledge than him.
"These True Spirits seem to be looking for something!"
The Blood Demon furrowed his brow, "Only the Three Great True Spirit Kings could consciously make True Spirits search for something. Has some major incident occurred in the Land of Imperishable, or is it something targeting the Divine Temple?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1112 - 574: The Person Hunted by the King of True Spirits
chapters.content:
"Three Great True Spirit Kings?"
Blood Extreme was filled with curiosity; it was the first time he had learned that there were Three Great True Spirit Kings in the Land of Imperishable, and from Blood Demon's attitude, it was evident that these Three Great True Spirit Kings were extremely powerful.
"Tell me about the Three Great True Spirit Kings."
Blood Extreme cleared his throat and spoke.
Now, every so often, he would send some information to Su Lingxiu. Information as significant as about the True Spirit Kings was especially crucial; this was an opportunity to earn merit.
Blood Demon didn't answer but continued walking forward, albeit with added caution.
"Blood Extreme, let's discuss this. I will continue to lead, and once we have ascertained the intentions of these True Spirits, then I will hand over control to you. How about that?"
"No!"
Blood Extreme refused and even began to control what had originally been his half of the body.
"Do you want to die?"
Blood Demon, unable to contain his anger, said, "The situation is unclear; with your experience, you definitely can't handle sudden accidents. If you're not careful, you will undoubtedly die; this is no joke. After this matter, I can give back the time under your control!"
"Then tell me, what's the deal with the True Spirit Kings?"
Blood Extreme stopped controlling half of his body and asked.
Reluctantly, Blood Demon knew that Blood Extreme, every so often, would send some information through some form of Divine Soul method, and he couldn't stop him. Therefore, he didn't want Blood Extreme to know too much, but obviously, if he didn't tell him about the True Spirit Kings, Blood Extreme would never agree.
"Fine, I'll tell you. In the Land of Imperishable, there exist three ancient True Spirits. Exactly how many Primordial Ages they have lived is unknown to anyone, even the Divine Masters do not know. The Three Great True Spirit Kings are extremely powerful and unlike others... These Three Great True Spirit Kings have opened their Spiritual Wisdom and possess the Art of the True Spirit..."
After introducing the True Spirit Kings, Blood Demon said with a serious tone, "Imperishable True Spirits lack spiritual wisdom, but creatures still seek things. Their bloodlines all contain knowledge about the existence of the Three Great True Spirit Kings. Only with a command from the Three Great True Spirit Kings will these mindless True Spirits consciously search for things."
Finally obtaining the answer he wanted, Blood Extreme no longer controlled his half of the body and smilingly said, "Alright, I will let you lead for a few more days. After all, we coexist in one body; there's little distinction between you and me, and preserving our lives is crucial!"
Blood Demon seethed with resentment; damn it, this body and power are mine!
Momentarily enticed by the ambition to overthrow and rise above, he thought he would be able to bring down the Unchanging Divine Master, but it ended up being a disaster for himself.
"To find out what these True Spirits are looking for, we only have a chance by finding a True Spirit at the Master of Domain level."
Blood Demon sped up, tracing the Witch's tracks while looking for a True Spirit at the Master of Domain level.
Throughout their journey, the True Spirits they encountered would all observe him for a moment, seemingly confirming whether he was the one they were searching for.
"It can almost be certain that these True Spirits are looking for a humanoid creature, possibly searching for the Witch?"
Blood Demon pondered thoughtfully.
Boom!
In a certain area of the Land of Imperishable, atop a mountain, the Witch ferociously killed a True Spirit at the Master of Domain level and started to crazily devour it, suddenly turning around with a cold snort, devouring and escaping at the same time.
"Once I refine this True Spirit, your death is imminent!"
Having been pursued for such a long time, the Witch's killing intent surged. Now that his injuries had almost healed and he was about to restore his peak condition by refining this True Spirit, his long healing process was finally coming to an end.
"Imperishable Temple, just wait for me. As long as I live, the ultimate death will be yours!"
Confident, what the Witch lacked was only time for cultivation. As long as he lived, he would one day surpass the Unchanging Divine Master.
"Breaking through above the Master of Domain level is not too far off for me, the Witch."
With a cold glare, the Witch looked behind; the pursuer had been distanced, and it wouldn't be long before he could shake them off.
Suddenly!
The Witch frowned, suddenly looking at a rushing group of True Spirits. "Something's wrong!"
These True Spirits, rushing swiftly, but upon seeing him, suddenly stopped and stared at him for a long time before continuing on their way.
"Do these True Spirits feel like they're searching for something? Could it be that the Imperishable Temple is using True Spirits to track me?"
The Witch's heart grew wary.
If the Imperishable Temple could deploy True Spirits to track his whereabouts, he wouldn't be able to hide for long, soon to be tracked and, feared worst, ambushed.
The Witch continued his escape, his aura growing stronger, his injuries gradually completely healed, and with the restoration of his strength, his confidence too returned.
Besides the Unchanging Divine Master, he did not fear any of the Imperishable Temple's powerhouses!
Thundering!
Suddenly, several True Spirits at the Realm Master level came rushing towards him, stopping not far from him, staring at him intently for a while, then turning their heads to continue ahead.
"Am I not their target?"
The Witch frowned, the mindless Imperishable True Spirits were actually searching for something, as if they had received some command, a scene he had never before encountered.
"Does Imperishable Temple have such capabilities?"
The Witch secretly panicked. Before the great battle, strong figures from the Imperishable Temple had used True Spirits to strike the Domain, but conveying commands to True Spirits, having them consciously carry them out, was entirely a different concept.
"Has something big happened in the Land of Imperishable?"
With furrowed brows, the Witch decided to capture a True Spirit and investigate exactly what had happened and what these True Spirits were searching for.

chapters.title: Chapter 1113 - 574: The Person Hunted by the King of True Spirits_2
chapters.content:
"I've finally recovered completely!"
The Witch, who had been continuously evading, stopped on a mountain peak and relaxed. Her severe injuries had completely healed, restoring her strength to its peak.
But that was still far from enough because, with her current strength, she was no match for the Imperishable Temple. So she had to keep avoiding the Imperishable Temple's assassins while continuing to train hard to enhance her strength. Only by breaking through and surpassing the Lord of the Domain level would she have the confidence to confront the Imperishable Temple.
"The Imperishable Land is becoming more and more unstable. Realm-Master Level True Spirits are appearing in increasing numbers and seem to be converging from all over the Imperishable Land. Could they be targeting the Taicang Domain?"
During her time of evasion, the Witch noticed that something was amiss in the Imperishable Land. Imperishable True Spirits were roaming everywhere, seemingly searching for something. The originally hostile True Spirit tribes encountered each other but did not engage in battle. Instead, they each chose a direction and continued moving.
All signs indicated that these True Spirits seemed to have received orders, and were executing some task. What kind of mighty entity could make mindless True Spirits consciously execute tasks?
"The only ones capable of this must be the True Spirit Kings, but are there any Kings of all True Spirits in the Imperishable Land?"
The Witch frowned with deep contemplation.
In any True Spirit tribe, only the tribe's King could command the True Spirits. But this disturbance among the True Spirits was not limited to any single tribe; it involved all True Spirits.
This made the Witch suspect that there might exist a True Spirit King among the countless True Spirits of the Imperishable Land, one who ruled over all other True Spirits!
"Hunt down a Heaven and Earth Lord-Level True Spirit and gather relevant intelligence!"
Now that her injuries were healed and her strength restored, the Witch relaxed and no longer felt the urgency of being pursued. The ordinary Lords from the Imperishable Temple couldn't frighten her or pose a threat to her recovered strength.
Finally, the Witch encountered a Heaven and Earth Lord-Level True Spirit. The True Spirit stopped in its tracks and scrutinized the Witch, seemingly confirming whether she was the target it sought.
The Witch didn't rush to attack. Instead, she let the True Spirit observe her, wondering if she was the target these True Spirits were searching for.
After a prolonged inspection, it seemed that the True Spirit determined she was not the target and turned to leave. That's when the Witch made her move.
Having ample experience in extracting desired information from True Spirits, the Witch had done this more than a couple of times before the creation of the Domain.
Roar!
The True Spirit roared in anger, showing signs of fury, but though it was a Heaven and Earth Lord-Level True Spirit, it was quite outmatched by the Witch in terms of strength.
The battle ended shortly, and from this True Spirit's consciousness, the Witch obtained the information about the target these True Spirits were searching for.
"Who is this?"
The Witch observed the projection of the person the True Spirits were searching for and was extremely surprised.
This person appeared young and handsome.
"A Human, from Taicang perhaps? There's actually a True Spirit King in the Imperishable Land—how did this individual offend the True Spirit King?"
The Witch was shocked as she extracted information about the True Spirit King from this True Spirit, which inherited this unspeakable command through bloodline inheritance.
"The Three Great True Spirit Kings."
The Witch's expression turned solemn. They had wandered the Imperishable Land until the creation of the Domain, never knowing that there existed three ancient True Spirit Kings there.
Before awakening their Spiritual Wisdom, they had also been True Spirits, yet their bloodline inheritance bore no information about the three Great True Spirit Kings.
Ao Hong, the True Spirit Domain Lord, also had no inherited information about the three Great True Spirit Kings. Even his followers, who had transformed into Domain True Spirits, had no knowledge of this matter, indicating that something was amiss.
"Could it be that the inheritance information about the True Spirit Kings disappeared because of the awakening of the Spiritual Wisdom?"
The Witch speculated thoughtfully.
"Offending a True Spirit King and causing the True Spirits to search for him—this person is no ordinary individual!"
The Witch admired the impressive qualities of the handsome young man.
"Is he coming?"
Suddenly, the Witch turned back abruptly, spotting a figure speedily pursuing her—it was a Domain Lord from the Imperishable Temple.
She revealed a fierce grin, "You dare pursue me with this level of strength?"
Boom!
Far from fleeing, the Witch directly confronted her pursuer, even blocking the escape route, fearing that the pursuer might flee!
"Who is this person?"
The Blood Demon had ultimately found the target the True Spirits were seeking and, looking at the projected image, was taken aback.
"Incredible!"
Blood Extreme couldn't help but admire, "Truly worthy of being the Taoist Ancestor's disciple! Arriving in the Imperishable Land, he actually caused a True Spirit upheaval, insanely powerful."
"Do you know him?"
The Blood Demon asked with a frown.
"Sword God Xu Yan, the foremost disciple of the Taoist Ancestor!"
Blood Extreme continued with admiration, adding, "Blood Demon, you must treat him with respect when you meet him, otherwise it's very easy to find yourself dead!"
"What's his strength?"
The Blood Demon asked gravely.
"That must be very strong, look at all these True Spirits searching for him, ordered by the King of True Spirits. Could a weakling provoke the King of True Spirits to anger?"
Blood Demon found the logic sound.
After all, for the True Spirits of the Land of Imperishable to take such drastic action was a first in their lives—how could a weakling cause such turmoil?
"Offending the King of True Spirits, even Yu Ting might not withstand it!"
Blood Demon sneered.
"Yu Ting is Yu Ting, how can it compare to the Taoist Ancestor? How many times have I told you, the Taoist Ancestor is supreme, not some commoner of Yu Ting."
Blood Extreme corrected him.
He had become a disciple of the Taoist Ancestor and naturally wanted to uphold his glory.
"Heh!"
Blood Demon chuckled lightly, convinced that this so-called Taoist Ancestor must be from Yu Ting!
Boom!
Suddenly, vibrations from a huge battle roared from afar.
"A battle of the Master of Domain level."
Blood Demon moved swiftly towards the battleground. As he drew closer, his brow raised, "It's the Witch, battling the pursuers from the Imperishable Temple. Found him!"
"Do you really intend to kill the Witch?"
Blood Extreme asked, surprised.
"The task of the Divine Master cannot be ignored!"
Blood Demon did not answer directly.
Boom!
A burst of blinding blood light erupted from him, and in an instant, terrifying torrents of blood wave surged around him, sweeping everything away.
"All these True Spirits are coming for me, I didn't expect the King of True Spirits to have such ability. Truly an ancient old fellow."
Elsewhere, Xu Yan waved his hand, slaying the True Spirits.
Since every True Spirit that encountered him died, his whereabouts were not obtained by King Chi Ni.
"Xu Yan, be careful. The King of True Spirits is very powerful."
Ming Yu's voice came from the Prime Tortoise Carapace.
"Ming Yu, did you remember something again?"
Xu Yan asked curiously.
Ming Yu's thoughts seemed to become more active, and some memories came flooding back.
"I remember, King Chi Ni once coveted Yu Ting. Although it was only a brief clash, it was extremely terrifying."
Ming Yu tilted his head and considered.
"A minor matter. Once we return to the Great Wilderness, all threats will cease to exist."
Xu Yan said confidently.
What seemed like provoking powerful enemies, were but ants in his master's eyes; thus, posing no threat.
Boom!
"A Master of Domain level battle, interesting, let's go take a look."
Xu Yan abruptly turned to the source of the tumultuous battle sounds, and immediately headed towards the battleground.
Swoosh!
A stream of white jade light flew toward him. It was a Jade Person from Yu Ting, seemingly also heading to the battleground. However, upon spotting Xu Yan, it turned to attack him instead.
"Have these Jade Puppets received the message?"
Xu Yan raised his brow. The Jade Puppet attacking him wasn't one of the eight sent after him; clearly, it was a Jade Puppet executing tasks for Yu Ting elsewhere that had received the message to pursue him and attacked upon sight.
Boom!
Xu Yan raised his hand and a sword descended from the heavens, instantly trapping the Jade Puppet within the Domain. Then, he struck the Puppet's head with his palm.
A glow filled with divine energy, Divine Skills "Destiny of the Heavenly Intent"!
Bang!
A muffled sound emerged from the Jade Puppet's head. Xu Yan was momentarily surprised, as Destiny of the Heavenly Intent failed to control the consciousness of the Jade Puppet.
