He quickly realized the problem—the consciousness and cognition of the Jade Puppet were generated by some Puppet Path Law, not the normal mental consciousness of a living being.
Since he couldn't control it, Xu Yan proceeded to erase the consciousness of the Jade Puppet, so that this puppet, while powerful, had no consciousness to control anything.

chapters.title: Chapter 1114 - 575: Encounter with the Witch, the Rebellious Blood Demon
chapters.content:
Xu Yan looked at the Jade Puppet that had lost its autonomy. The Puppet Path Law that enabled consciousness and thought had been impacted by the Destiny of the Heavenly Intent and thus fell into chaos.
"If a Divine Soul occupies it, it can take control of this Jade Puppet and obtain strength at the Master of Heaven and Earth level."
However, to replace the Jade Puppet and acquire its power, the requirements for the Divine Soul were not low.
At the very least, it had to be a Divine Soul comparable to the Master of Heaven and Earth level; otherwise, it would be impossible to control the Puppet Path Law and take over the power possessed by the Jade Puppet.
And a Master of Heaven and Earth would naturally not abandon their own body to occupy this Jade Puppet, unless they had lost their own body and had no other choice but to make such a decision.
Xu Yan put away the Jade Puppet and continued towards the battlefield. As he approached, he raised an eyebrow, sensing a familiar aura.
"The Netherworld?"
"No, could it be the Blood Demon?"
Different from the Netherworld's aura but with similarities, Xu Yan immediately thought of the Blood Demon, the brother of the Netherworld.
"Has Blood Extreme replaced the Blood Demon?"
Xu Yan concealed his presence and silently drew closer to the battlefield.
"One is the Imperishable Temple's Master of Domain, and the other must be the Witch, right?"
The Blood Demon and another Master of Domain were joining forces against the Witch, and the battle was extremely fierce.
Boom!
A roaring Blood Sea surged, turning thousands of miles of the Land of Imperishable into a crimson color.
The Witch's expression was cold and fierce, his aura wild and harsh as he tore through the surging blood waves, but neither side could gain the upper hand for a while.
"Who are you?"
The Witch stared at the Blood Demon with a penetrating gaze.
The Blood Demon's expression was solemn; with a wave of his hand, the blood waves surged, and he continuously unleashed Blood Path secret techniques. Together with another, they fought on par with the Witch.
Internally, he lamented the Witch's strength, truly formidable, deserving of being the second strongest among the Seven Great Domain Masters; even his own brother, the Netherworld, admitted that he was slightly inferior.
"Your aura bears resemblance to the Netherworld, and you also cultivate the Blood Path. What is your relationship to the Netherworld?"
The Witch glared and demanded angrily.
"The Blood Demon Elder and the Xue Yu Protector are siblings, and the Xue Yu Protector is the former Netherworld Domain Master."
The slightly weaker Imperishable Temple Master of Domain, bearing injuries, scoffed coldly.
The Witch roared, his aura intensifying, "The Netherworld has actually surrendered?"
"Witch, only the wise can recognize the situation. Can you even imagine the strength of a Divine Master? Taicang is indeed very strong, but let me tell you the truth, even if Taicang surpasses the Master of Domain level, he would still be no match for the Divine Master."
"At the beginning, when the Divine Temple made a move against The Seven Great Domain, do you think they deployed their full strength? To tell you the truth, the Netherworld is my elder brother. I pleaded with the Divine Master for a long time to save him, and only then was he shown mercy."
The Blood Demon spoke with a solemn gaze.
"The Seven Great Domain will eventually become history. Taicang Domain won't be an exception. This is an inescapable fate for all of you; Witch, you won't escape it either. Even if you escape from my hands this time, you will be captured by the Divine Temple before the Next Era begins."
However, the Witch suddenly burst into maniacal laughter, "So what? I, Witch, have never yielded in my life. I thought the Netherworld was like me, proud, never bowing, never conceding, preferring death to submission. I never imagined that he would kneel!"
His laughter turned desolate.
The Seven Great Domain Masters, led by Taicang, once roamed the Land of Imperishable together and seized the Creation to forge their own Domain.
How could there not be deep feelings among them? Among those six, who didn't respect Taicang?
The Witch, who had never been submissive in his life, who would rather die than bow down, had always acknowledged Taicang as the eldest brother in his bones.
Just as proud was the Netherworld, and to think that the proud Netherworld would break, would kneel!
At that moment, the Witch felt desolation and loneliness, as only he remained among the Seven Great Domain Masters.
"You're talking nonsense!"
The Blood Demon roared furiously, the Blood Sea rising in tumultuous waves, his anger reaching the skies.
"Hahaha, Blood Demon is it? I won't kill you today, but he must die!"
The Witch suddenly became fierce.
His gaze turned towards that wounded Divine Master from the Imperishable Temple, his aura swirling around him as he said murderously, "Even if The Seven Great Domain completely disappear, even if Taicang Domain cannot escape destruction, so what? I, Witch, even in death, will not bow to your Divine Temple!"
Boom!
A powerful killing move hurtled directly towards that Divine Master from the Imperishable Temple, willing to suffer damage just to eliminate his target!
The Blood Demon's attack paused abruptly, "Hehe, do you really intend to kill him?"
Blood Extreme's voice sounded, and the Blood Demon looked extremely grim.
"Blood Demon Elder, save me!"
The Master of Domain's expression changed drastically.
Suddenly, a sword light slashed through, cleaving the surging Blood Sea with a boom. The expression of the Blood Demon turned to shock as the divided blood waves abruptly coalesced back around him, the blinding blood light enveloping him completely.
Spurt!
The Master of Domain from the Imperishable Temple was also slain by the sword light, turning into ashes and dissipating!
The Witch's expression also changed dramatically; this sword was too powerful, even for him, it posed extreme danger.
"It's you!"
"It's you!"
Both the Witch and the Blood Demon turned towards the source of the sword light, exclaiming in shock.
"Do you recognize me?"
Xu Yan raised an eyebrow, somewhat surprised.
Before the Witch and Blood Demon could reply, an excited voice burst from the Blood Demon's mouth.
"Hahahaha, Blood Demon, you're finished!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1115 - 575: Encounter with the Witch, the Rebellious Blood Demon_2
chapters.content:
Blood Extreme's excited voice arose, and the face of the Blood Demon drastically changed as his heart sank to the bottom of the valley.
"Young Master Xu, it's me, Blood Extreme!"
Blood Extreme's Divine Soul emerged a bit from the head of the Blood Demon.
Xu Yan raised an eyebrow, suddenly getting an idea.
He took out the Prime Tortoise Carapace, "You two catch up, I'll have a chat with the Blood Demon!"
A bamboo stick extended out of the Prime Tortoise Carapace, and Qing Yu's voice rang out, "Witch, long time no see!"
The Prime Tortoise Carapace floated in front of the Witch.
The Witch's face was a mix of shock and disbelief, "Qing Yu, how could you?"
"It's a long story..."
Qing Yu and the Witch caught up, sharing their experiences after the great battle and simultaneously exchanging some information about the time of the battle.
On the other side, the Blood Demon was frantically trying to fight for control, struggling fiercely with Blood Extreme, even preparing to burn his own Origin, determined not to give Blood Extreme any advantage, even if it meant death.
"Blood Extreme, have you failed to replace him?"
Xu Yan watched the struggle between Blood Extreme and the Blood Demon, his thoughts racing, considering that if Blood Extreme hadn't succeeded, there was no point in continuing the fight.
"Master Xu, please help me so that I can replace this damn Blood Demon."
Blood Extreme pleaded sycophantically.
"Delusion! Even if I die, I won't make it easy for you!"
Blood Demon angrily retorted.
"Since you failed to replace the Blood Demon, there's no need to continue. I have a better plan!"
Xu Yan mused.
Upon hearing this, Blood Extreme grew anxious, "Master Xu, with just a little boost from you, I could be successful!"
Originally preparing to burn his Origin, even if he couldn't die together with Blood Extreme, as long as he burned half of his controlled Origin, even if Blood Extreme replaced him, his power would be significantly reduced, possibly even falling below the level of a Master of Heaven and Earth.
Moreover, with a loss of more than half of his Origin, it was impossible for Blood Extreme to advance further; he'd die before that happened.
However, upon hearing Xu Yan suggesting Blood Extreme cease attempting to replace him, the Blood Demon, who was ready to burn his Origin, stopped, looking at Xu Yan with some surprise.
"There's no need; if you replace the Blood Demon, your power will just be mediocre. Moreover, you won't get past the trial of Netherworld – others might not notice, but the Netherworld will."
Xu Yan shook his head.
"But, I this..."
Blood Extreme looked unwilling.
Yet, he dared not disobey Xu Yan's command.
"You and the Blood Demon, are too deeply entangled; breaking free will take some effort, although it's not a big problem, just..."
Xu Yan looked at the Blood Demon, pondering, "Blood Demon, how will you thank me?"
The Blood Demon thought for a moment, "Do you know my elder brother?"
"Seen him!"
Xu Yan was noncommittal.
"What do you want me to do?"
Blood Demon asked directly.
"You are an Elder of the Imperishable Temple, and in a sense, you represent the Imperishable Temple. How about you, in the capacity of an Elder of the Imperishable Temple, obstruct the people from Yu Ting?"
Xu Yan suggested with a smile.
The Blood Demon was startled, surprised, "Isn't the Taoist Ancestor from Yu Ting?"
He always thought that the Taoist Ancestor came from Yu Ting, that he was betrayed by Yu Ting; but now, Xu Yan was directing him to act as an Elder of the Imperishable Temple to target the people of Yu Ting, obviously intending to provoke a conflict between the Divine Temple and Yu Ting.
"Heh, Yu Ting is not worthy."
Xu Yan replied with a scornful smile.
"Fine, I can agree to that!"
Blood Demon, without any choice, promptly nodded in agreement.
"Master Xu, what about me?"
Blood Extreme, with a gloomy expression, "This guy Blood Demon has a rebellious streak, you have to be wary of him!"
"Shut up!"
Blood Demon bellowed.
But Xu Yan just laughed, "It's precisely because he has a rebellious streak against the Imperishable Temple that I chose him."
Blood Demon was speechless.
He cursed inwardly; how did everyone know about my rebellious nature?
If the Unchanging Divine Master found out, I'd be done for!
Xu Yan produced a Jade Puppet, "Blood Extreme, you can occupy this Jade Person; it too possesses the power of a Master of Heaven and Earth, and who knows, perhaps it has more potential!"
"Jade Person!"
Blood Demon was taken aback, "This is a Jade Person from Yu Ting, and Xu Yan actually killed it. From this, it's clear that Xu Yan holds a grudge against Yu Ting!"
Upon hearing this, Blood Extreme immediately became excited, "Master Xu, wait a moment, I'll separate myself straight away."
Blood Demon was relieved, but then he flew into a rage: "Blood Extreme, you actually dared to encroach on my Divine Spirit Soul Force!"
"Blood Demon, don't be so stingy. What does it matter if you let me have some Divine Spirit Soul Force?"
Blood Extreme chuckled maliciously.
Blood Demon clenched his teeth and had no choice but to accept it. As long as that tick-like fellow Blood Extreme left, losing a bit of Divine Spirit Soul Force didn't amount to much.
"I'll give you a hand!"
Xu Yan lifted his hand, and the Images of Heaven and Earth appeared. Instantly, Blood Demon was enveloped within, and Sword Intent directly invaded Blood Demon's body, separating Blood Extreme's soul out.
Blood Extreme's soul had undergone special refinement and had already undergone a transformation. Like a parasite, it resided within Blood Demon's soul for some time. To separate it completely would require no short amount of time, and Xu Yan didn't have that much time to wait.
Blood Demon was terrified inside. Xu Yan's strength was terrifying. Even though he wanted to resist, he was unable to do so and simply had to accept Xu Yan's help.
Pfft!
Finally, Blood Extreme's soul was separated out.
"This Jade Person is a bit special. You need to occupy it and control the Dao Principles inside..."
Xu Yan pointed his finger and transferred the knowledge of how to occupy the Jade Puppet and how to take over the running Dao Principles into Blood Extreme's soul.
"Yes, Master Xu, I understand!"
Blood Extreme exclaimed excitedly.
"Go in."
Xu Yan withdrew the Images of Heaven and Earth from Blood Demon and enveloped the Jade Puppet with it. Blood Extreme's soul followed his Images of Heaven and Earth, entering into the Jade Puppet.
Boom!
The Jade Puppet burst forth with silver-white light, and the Dao Principles became faintly visible. The puppets' eyes shone with brilliance and, after a while, turned slightly blood-red.
"Master Xu, I have succeeded!"
Blood Extreme's voice came through, his excitement unabated. He now felt the true strength he possessed, akin to taking over Blood Demon's body and all its power.
The strength of a Master of Heaven and Earth!
"Good, get used to it on your own."
Xu Yan nodded in satisfaction.
He checked Blood Extreme's state inside the Jade Puppet. Now, Blood Extreme's soul had fully replaced the puppet's original consciousness and was operating all of its Dao Principles, controlling the power it had.
After pondering for a moment, Xu Yan spoke again: "Integrate your own principle thoroughly, refine this body completely for your own use."
He transmitted the Law of Refinement into Blood Extreme's soul.
"Yes, Master Xu!"
Blood Extreme was thrilled. His past choice had been wise; he had finally become a power at the Master of Heaven and Earth level.
"Get familiar with it a bit."
Xu Yan withdrew the Images of Heaven and Earth.
"Blood Demon, come, let's have a contest. Now I belong to Yu Ting, and you belong to the Imperishable Temple!"
Blood Extreme clenched his fist and, with a ferocious smile, looked at Blood Demon.
"Alright, I want to test and see what strength you actually possess."
Blood Demon was also curious what strength Blood Extreme had achieved after taking over the Jade Person, and how Xu Yan managed to let Blood Extreme replace the Jade Person so effortlessly.
Rumble!
Blood Extreme and Blood Demon clashed. Because Blood Extreme was initially controlling the Jade Puppet and was still unfamiliar with the use of its power and operation of its Dao Principles, Blood Demon initially had the upper hand.
Xu Yan watched their fight for a while and, after confirming that Blood Extreme had fully taken over the Jade Puppet and his soul had integrated with its Dao Principles, turned to look at the Witch and Qing Yu catching up on old times.
The Witch had learned of the cause and effect from Qing Yu, and now looked at Xu Yan with utter shock. The Taicang Domain had produced such a monstrous talent.
And that mysterious Taoist Ancestor, what sort of existence was he?
"Will you continue to wander, or return to the Great Wilderness to participate in the battle of the Imperishable Temple?"
Xu Yan asked the Witch.
"I'll go back to the Great Wilderness."
The Witch said solemnly, "Since my Domain has fused with the Great Wilderness, I should go back to see it anyway. Furthermore, how could I be absent from the battle with the Imperishable Temple?"
"If that's the case, then go back to the Great Wilderness. You cannot travel with me."
Xu Yan nodded.
"Why? You're being hunted by the King of True Spirits. If I were with you, I could..."
The Witch raised an eyebrow as he spoke.
Xu Yan cut him off, "I'm not just being hunted by King Chi Ni, but also Yu Ting is after me. You're too slow. If we encounter them, I'll have to save you."
He all but said directly that having the Witch accompany him would be a burden!
The corner of the Witch's mouth twitched, wanting to retort but lacking the strength to do so. He sighed. He, one of the Seven Great Domain Masters, was now considered too weak!

chapters.title: Chapter 1116 - 576: Shocked Blood Demon, Black Chi King
chapters.content:
"So be it," the Witch sighed reluctantly, glancing over at the ongoing battle between the Blood Demon and Blood Extreme. He pondered, "Do you really believe the Blood Demon will do as you say?"
Xu Yan chuckled, "I do believe it. The Blood Demon is inherently rebellious. Moreover, the Netherworld is responsible for the Imperishable Temple's task of stopping Yu Ting."
Speaking of the Netherworld, the Witch's expression turned complex.
"The next era won't be far off. The great battle will arrive soon, and the Three Great True Spirit Kings won't sit idly by."
As Xu Yan said this, he turned to look back. Within the Chaos, eight streaks of silver light were hurtling their way.
"The strong ones from Yu Ting are here. I'll take my leave first."
Xu Yan raised his hand to put away the Prime Tortoise Carapace and looked towards the Blood Demon Path, "Blood Demon, you know what to do."
"Understood!"
The Blood Demon responded.
Xu Yan stepped forward and vanished in an instant.
The Witch eyed the eight streaks of silver light flying towards him, his expression shifting slightly. None of these Jade Persons were weaker than him.
Some were even stronger.
Not lingering any longer, his figure flickered, and he was instantly gone from the spot. After discerning the direction, he headed straight for the Great Wilderness Domain.
Boom!
The eight streaks of silver light shot toward him, and one of the Jade Persons, gazing at the Blood Demon fighting fiercely with Blood Extreme, sparked with luminescence in their eyes and suddenly attacked the Blood Demon.
"Yu Ting, you wish to interfere with the affairs of my Divine Temple?"
The Blood Demon bellowed.
"It is you who are obstructing us."
The Jade Person's voice was dull.
The Blood Demon roared continuously, attacking frantically, forcing Blood Extreme to retreat repeatedly as they engaged in battle.
He felt a chill in his heart; this Jade Person's strength was formidable, even stronger than the Witch.
Blood Extreme's gaze flashed, and soon he joined the fray, teaming up to tackle the Blood Demon. Seeing this, the Blood Demon howled with rage.
"Do you from Yu Ting intend to become enemies with my Divine Temple? Must you disrupt our Divine Temple's plans?"
Every sentence from the Blood Demon was about the Divine Temple.
The Jade Person was silent, continuing the assault. Together with Blood Extreme, the Blood Demon was no match, being driven back step by step, roaring furiously, but desperately trying to fend them off.
In the midst of battle, the Blood Demon stealthily noted the other six Jade Persons hot on Xu Yan's trail, moving with astonishing speed. He breathed a sigh of relief; if another Jade Person were to join, he might not even have a chance to flee.
"Very well, you really think my Divine Temple is so easily bullied?"
The Blood Demon deliberately exposed a weakness, getting struck by Blood Extreme, then retreated and fled into the distance.
Having repelled the Blood Demon, that Jade Person faced Blood Extreme, "Continue the mission!"
Then transformed into a streak of silver light, pursuing Xu Yan.
Blood Extreme thoughtfully mused, "This Jade Person is unusual, and they haven't noticed that I'm no longer the original Jade Person. As for the mission..."
There was no mission information regarding this Jade Person. Taking over this body had brought him no memories; it seemed as if the Jade Person was a blank slate, which was out of the ordinary. All beings he possessed always offered some of their memories.
This Jade Person, however, had not a trace of memory left.
"This is not a normal being!"
The Blood Demon concluded.
He did not stay put, his figure moving swiftly toward the Great Wilderness. He had to return to the Great Wilderness, the only safe haven.
The Land of Imperishable would surely become more unstable.
The Blood Demon fled "in disgrace," covering tens of thousands of leagues before he finally stopped atop a mountain peak.
He pondered for a moment, then sat down cross-legged, generating an aura to convey the message he wanted to send.
"I've done all I can. Must not let the Divine Master learn of this."
After sending the message, the Blood Demon muttered to himself,
"The Taoist Ancestor, he's not from Yu Ting."
The Blood Demon contemplated. Whether the Great Wilderness or the Imperishable Temple won the battle, it wouldn't affect him.
If the Great Wilderness won, they wouldn't make an enemy of him given what he had done for Xu Yan. He could still live carefree.
If the temple won, he would still be a faithful follower of the Divine Master, one of the Elders.
"It's time to contact my big brother. I mustn't work too hard for the temple."
The Blood Demon grumbled inwardly. He feared his brother Netherworld, being simple-minded, and as a protector for the temple, might genuinely commit to the task.
A trace of blood light emerged from within the Blood Demon's Divine Soul. He used a secret technique, guided by blood, to send a message to the Netherworld.
This was a technique developed between the brothers after reuniting and draining the Qi of Heaven and Earth from the Netherworld Domain. Their blood ties were now unimpeded, allowing them to craft this blood-guided message-sending technique.
After being duped by Blood Extreme, the Blood Demon had wanted to use this technique to seek Netherworld's help. However, hindered by Blood Extreme controlling half of his Divine Soul, using the secret technique would be obstructed by Blood Extreme. Several covert attempts failed, and he gave up on the idea.
Buzz!
As the blood guided the way, that sense of blood kinship emerged, and without hesitation, the Blood Demon sent the message.
"May I survive this tumultuous situation unscathed!"
After relaying the message, the Blood Demon's expression was incredibly grave.
Thunderous noise!
Suddenly, a storm seemed to arise before him. A powerful presence surged, accompanied by the roars of beasts.
The Blood Demon's face changed drastically. He turned into a streak of blood and was about to flee.
Suddenly, an energy locked onto him—if he dared to flee, he would be killed on the spot!
At this moment, the Blood Demon broke out in cold sweat, standing still, not daring to move an inch.

chapters.title: Chapter 1117 - 576: Shocked Blood Demon, Black Chi King_2
chapters.content:
A colossal mountain, borne by over a dozen Domain True Spirits of Master of Domain level, was moving towards this direction.
Lying atop the massive mountain was a terrifying True Spirit, its aura, elusive yet oppressive like a mountain itself, weighed upon him—the kind of terror only felt in the presence of the Unchanging Divine Master!
"King Chi Ni!"
At that moment, Blood Demon recognized the fearsome True Spirit atop the mountain—it was King Chi Ni, one of the Three Great True Spirit Kings mentioned by the Unchanging Divine Master.
And it was the one Xu Yan had offended!
"Temple Elder Blood Demon, at your service, King Chi Ni!"
Blood Demon dared not delay, hastily paying respects.
At this moment, he could only leverage his rank as a Temple Elder to prevent King Chi Ni from directing his rage towards Xu Yan of the Human Clan.
Otherwise, if King Chi Ni saw him in human form and killed him in a fit of rage, it would be a grave injustice!
Sure enough, as soon as he declared his position as a Temple Elder, the locking aura targeting him immediately disappeared.
"Have you seen this man?"
In front of King Chi Ni, an image of Xu Yan appeared.
"Esteemed predecessor, I have not!"
Blood Demon respectfully replied.
"Find this man's whereabouts, rewarding handsomely!"
King Chi Ni stated gravely.
"Yes, yes, if I may ask, Senior, what grave crime has this man committed to disturb your esteemed self?"
Blood Demon inquired cautiously.
Xu Yan had offended King Chi Ni, but how exactly remained unknown to him.
"This person killed my son, Chi Ni Jr.!"
King Chi Ni did not conceal it, stating coldly.
Blood Demon swallowed, inwardly shocked; Xu Yan had killed King Chi Ni's son, no wonder the True Spirit King's Order was issued, and all True Spirits were searching for him.
"This man truly deserves death! If I happen to find any clues, I will immediately report to King Chi Ni!"
Blood Demon immediately displayed a look of indignation.
RUMBLE!
The dozen True Spirits carrying the mountain departed until they vanished from sight, allowing Blood Demon to finally breathe a sigh of relief, feeling almost entirely drenched.
"I hope what I just said didn't reach Xu Yan's ears; otherwise, I might be in trouble."
Blood Demon pondered—the True Spirits had no Spiritual Wisdom, so they probably couldn't relay what he just said, and with this thought, he felt relieved.
"King Chi Ni, an ancient and immensely powerful True Spirit, has arrived, and the direction they headed was precisely that of the Great Wilderness, likely planning to intervene in matters of the Domain. Since Xu Yan is from the Great Wilderness, his actions would be justifiable. Yet, I wonder, what are the other two Great True Spirit Kings planning?"
The Three Great True Spirit Kings were ancient True Spirits who had lived countless Primordial Ages—if the three banded together, even the Divine Master might be unable to escape trouble.
Blood Demon again executed a secret technique, a wisp of aura emerging to send a message to the Unchanging Divine Master.
After transmitting the message, Blood Demon was contemplating his next move when suddenly, his expression drastically changed. Amidst the Chaos, he could faintly discern an immaculate, jade-white courtyard hurtling towards him.
Yu Ting!
He instantly moved, hastily fleeing while saying, "Temple Elder Blood Demon, dare not to disturb the Yu Ting!"
He hurriedly identified himself, lest he be slain by the Yu Ting, which would be a grave injustice.
"What on earth did Xu Yan do to be pursued even by Yu Ting!"
Blood Demon was shocked inside, even the mysterious Taoist Ancestor could not withstand the simultaneous aggression of the Unchanging Divine Master, King Chi Ni, and the Three Masters of the Jade Court.
Xu Yan had stumbled into a major mess.
"My elder brother was tasked with hindering Yu Ting, but now that the Three Masters of the Jade Court have personally taken action, we can't continue like this."
With this thought, Blood Demon urgently contacted his elder brother, advising him to retreat.
He also sent another message to the Unchanging Divine Master, informing him of Yu Ting's movements.
Having found a large mountain, he took refuge inside, waiting for orders from the Unchanging Divine Master.
...
Somewhere in the Land of Imperishable, Ao Hong was flying fast. He knew that King Chi Ni was searching for Xu Yan, which made him anxious and worried at the same time—what if the other two Great True Spirit Kings joined forces with King Chi Ni? That would be terrible!
"Xu Yan's master, the Taoist Ancestor—could he possibly handle three Great True Spirit Kings and an Unchanging Divine Master on his own? It seems there are also powerful beings from the Jade Court involved."
With this thought, Ao Hong gasped. Why did it seem like Xu Yan had offended the strongest in the entire Land of Imperishable?
Having caused such a big mess, could his master really withstand it?
"These True Spirits aren't looking for Xu Yan; they have reached another area where a True Spirit King currently resides."
Ao Hong's eyes lit up.
Then his heart sank again. The three Great True Spirit Kings were so close to each other, and this area led to the Great Wilderness Domain—could it be that they were all heading towards the Great Wilderness Domain?
"Ao!"
Ao Hong let out a dragon's roar that reverberated throughout the Land of Imperishable, hoping to attract the attention of this True Spirit King. Having gained self-awareness, wouldn't aligning himself with the True Spirit King garner some attention?
At that moment, from a distant land, a roar echoed through the air like thunder. The True Spirit that made the roar was incredibly powerful; Ao Hong even felt it was stronger than him.
He immediately followed the sound and saw a massive moving mountain with about a dozen enormous True Spirits carrying it.
As Ao Hong approached, a powerful aura swept over him, terrifyingly intense yet with a hint of familiarity, making his body tense.
Then, Ao Hong saw a head rise from the great mountain, and he was stunned when he saw the two heads in that moment.
When the mountain came closer, he saw the full appearance of the True Spirit on the mountain; Ao Hong was again shocked. The True Spirit on the mountain had a dragon-like body, black on the back and red on the belly, with black fins and a short, dense ring of red mane around its neck. Its head was not unlike his dragon head.
Ao Hong was dumbfounded. One of the Three Great True Spirit Kings, a True Dragon?
Although it differed from him, the overall shape was also dragon-like, so it must be categorized under the True Dragon Lineage. Yet Ao Hong himself was an ancestor of True Dragons.
At that moment, Ao Hong realized, besides King Chi Ni, the other two Great True Spirit Kings—Black Chi King and Gargantuan Gluttonous King—might be here, and the dragon-like True Spirit in front of him must be the Black Chi King!
Ao Hong looked at his own body and then at Black Chi King, starting to wonder if he could be a descendant of Black Chi King?
They both had dragon shapes.
And the Black Chi King, being an old True Spirit, even if not a direct descendant, must have some of its bloodline?
But then came another issue—if he were a descendant of Black Chi King, how could Chi Ni dare to humiliate him by cutting his flesh to eat? Wasn't that equivalent to insulting Black Chi King?
"Your aura..."
At that moment, Black Chi King spoke.
"It is rumored that there was once a 'Domain' in the Land of Imperishable. Although I have never seen the 'Domain', your aura is different from the chaotic state of the Imperishable Land, having a clearer essence. You must be a Domain True Spirit."
Ao Hong marveled inside, worthy of an ancient True Spirit to have seen through him so quickly, while he also wondered why Black Chi King, knowing about The Seven Great Domains, had never tried to take over the 'Domain'.
He was sure that the Three Great True Spirit Kings were extremely far from their Domain in the Land of Imperishable, and probably the matters of The Seven Great Domains had reached them through True Spirit transmission after the Imperishable Temple had already annexed them.
Therefore, when Black Chi King mentioned the Land of Imperishable once having a 'Domain', it meant he knew about the Imperishable Temple's annexation.
"Hiding nothing from Senior Black Chi King, I indeed am a Domain True Spirit and also the Master of the Domain among The Seven Great Domain True Spirits, Ao Hong!"
Ao Hong spoke respectfully.
"The Temple annexed the Domain; your survival is a bit unexpected, but perhaps they intentionally let you live, to be used when the Next Era begins."
Black Chi King thought and said.
Ao Hong shivered inside; he felt that Black Chi King might know many secrets, including the purpose behind the Temple.
"You came to seek me out; do you want to rely on me to avoid the Temple?"
Black Chi King asked.
"Concealing nothing from Senior, Junior indeed intends to do so. Moreover, Junior has also offended King Chi Ni, so..."
Ao Hong said cautiously.
"Chi Ni, huh? Tell me, how did you offend it?"
Black Chi King nodded.
Ao Hong thought for a while and briefly recounted how he was captured by the robed figures and Chi Ni, and how Xu Yan had come to rescue him, slaying Chi Ni.
"I see."
Black Chi King nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 1118 - 577: Time Changes, The Next Era is About to Arrive
chapters.content:
Ao Hong sighed in relief when he saw the Black Chi King had no intention to side with or assist King Chi Ni.
If the Black Chi King had intervened, the situation in the Great Wilderness would have become perilous for Xu Yan's enigmatic master, who single-handedly faced such fearsome adversaries. How could he compete?
"Senior Black Chi King, what do you think?"
Ao Hong asked cautiously.
The Black Chi King fell into a contemplative silence for a long while before saying, "The Next Era is drawing near, and its commencement this time will be earlier than usual. Generally speaking, every seven Primordial Ages, the start of the Next Age advances, each time earlier than the last.
"This time, it will advance again. The Divine Temple's figure has likely noticed and, being intent on seizing Domain, naturally targets you as the Master of Domain…"
Ao Hong was startled by this revelation. The Black Chi King's awareness that the timing for the Next Era advanced every seven Primordial Ages meant he had lived for many more than a dozen such ages.
How had he managed to survive until now, and just how powerful was he?
Could King Chi Ni be the same?
From Black Chi King's words, it seemed he held some reservation about the Unchanging Divine Master, hesitating whether to protect Ao Hong. Ao Hong couldn't help feeling alarmed—had the Unchanging Divine Master not used his full strength in the grand battle of old?
Or was it that Taicang's power, greater than they had witnessed, had managed to withstand Unchanging Divine Master for such an extended period?
"Stay by my side," the Black Chi King finally spoke. "I will speak to him at the Divine Temple. In the worst case, it's only a matter of stripping you of the Qi of Heaven and Earth; it won't cost you your life. As for everything else, I'll decide based on how things evolve."
Ao Hong was somewhat disappointed, not receiving the aid he hoped from Black Chi King—merely a promise to spare his life and, if necessary, even to strip him of the Qi of Heaven and Earth.
"Thank you!"
Ao Hong responded respectfully.
After hesitating, he couldn't help but ask, "Senior, is the power of the Unchanging Divine Master truly that terrifying?"
"He is not simple—his strength formidable. I do not fear him, but I also prefer not to make him an enemy. An outcast like him, deep in his obsessions, will go mad if anyone thwarts his plans. Besides, I am curious to see if his plan will succeed.
"So, stripping you of the Qi of Heaven and Earth is merely to see if he genuinely can succeed, and of course, if we can do without your Qi of Heaven and Earth, there is no need to strip it from you."
The Black Chi King chuckled, then added, "Speaking of which, you are also a descendant of my bloodline, but since you have opened up Domain, you have freed yourself from the shackles of my lineage."
Ao Hong paused, thought for a moment, and asked, "Related to that streak of purple light?"
"It's related to Domain!"
Ao Hong thought of Taicang, the initiation of Domain being Taicang's creation and teachings. Upon establishing Domain, indeed everything had changed, evolving and transcending.
It was for that reason the shackles of Black Chi King's lineage were broken, and he started the True Dragon Clan.
"Senior, what is the plan of the Unchanging Divine Master?"
Ao Hong inquired curiously.
The invasion of Domain by the Unchanging Divine Master was clearly for some plan, and what exactly did his exile imply?
The Black Chi King smiled and said, "You will know soon enough, why ask more?"
Boom!
The True Spirit carrying the mountain continued forward, and Ao Hong came to the top of the mountain. In front of Black Chi King, he felt like nothing more than a tiny worm.
"Senior, are you heading to the Great Wilderness Domain?"
Ao Hong couldn't resist asking.
"Suppose so."
Black Chi King smiled and replied, "The Next Era is about to begin, and with the Divine Temple's figure's plan underway, such a grand event must not be missed. Chi Ni and Giant Glutton will also attend."
Although Ao Hong didn't know what precise plan the Unchanging Divine Master had, the fact that it drew the attention of the Three Great True Spirit Kings suggested it was no small matter. Could Xu Yan's master withstand this?
He was not very confident.
"Senior, how long has the Land of Imperishable existed?"
Ao Hong curiously asked.
It was a rare opportunity to inquire from this ancient being.
"I don't know!"
The Black Chi King shook his head. "Nobody knows how many ages the Land of Imperishable has existed."
Ao Hong wanted to ask the Black Chi King how many Primordial Ages he had lived through, but he swallowed his words, deciding some secrets were best kept unasked.
Instead, he asked, "Senior, does the Land of Imperishable have boundaries?"
"Yes and no!"
Black Chi King paused a moment before responding.
Ao Hong was puzzled by this answer.
Seeing this, the Black Chi King pondered briefly and added, "Chaotic Imperishable is not unchanging; today's boundary is gone tomorrow. It appears to have borders, yet it doesn't. Even I can't decipher the rules."
"What lies beyond the Land of Imperishable, Senior, have you seen it?"
Curious, Ao Hong asked.
"Even if I saw the boundary today, I can't leave. Beyond Chaotic Imperishable..."
The Black Chi King shook his head and did not continue.
Seeing this, Ao Hong didn't pursue further questioning.
Somewhere in the Land of Imperishable, a crunching sound echoed as a True Spirit with a sheep's body and tiger's claws, whose head was bigger than its body and had sharp teeth, opened and closed its huge mouth, chewing on its food—a True Spirit with Master of Domain-level strength.
In front of this True Spirit, several other True Spirits of Master of Domain level cowered, trembling with fear, yet dared not make any attempt to flee.

chapters.title: Chapter 1119 - 577: The Passing of Time, The Next Epoch is Approaching - Part 2
chapters.content:
```
Gulp!
After swallowing the food in his mouth, the True Spirit glanced at the few True Spirits lying in front of it, seemingly selecting which one might taste better.
At a certain moment, its massive jaws opened, and one of the True Spirits was sucked into its mouth, the chewing sounds resumed, and it chewed while moving forward. Meanwhile, the other True Spirits, though terrified, dared not flee or remain in place. Trembling, they followed close by the True Spirit.
Gargantuan Gluttonous King!
One of the three ancient True Spirits.
And the direction in which the Gargantuan Gluttonous King marched was the same as the Black Chi King, both heading towards the Great Wilderness Domain.
In the Imperishable Temple, the Divine Master still lingered within that palace, looking up at the sun, moon, and stars, seemingly reminiscing about something.
At a certain moment, he frowned.
"The opening of the Next Era is imminent?"
The Unchanging Divine Master furrowed his brow, as if pondering something, and after a long while, he muttered to himself, "Since it's going to be earlier than expected, thankfully, the preparations are nearly complete. It's time to begin."
Immediately, an aura surged from his body, seemingly conveying a message. Once the message was sent, his gaze shifted from within the Divine Temple to a certain area in the Land of Imperishable.
And that place was precisely where the Great Wilderness lay.
"Let's begin, accelerate the pace, and head to the Taicang region."
After a pause, the Unchanging Divine Master spoke solemnly, "Send a message to King Chi Ni, do not interfere with my temple's plans, or it will be an endless fight!"
"Yes, Divine Master!"
Within the Imperishable Temple, a voice replied.
"And Yu Ting, tell those three that if they meddle in my temple's affairs, it will be an endless fight!"
"Yes, Divine Master!"
That day, two dim figures left the Imperishable Temple to convey messages to King Chi Ni and Yu Ting.
Boom!
Xu Yan struck down a Lord of Heaven and Earth-Level True Spirit that stood in his way and suddenly furrowed his brow, looking deeply into the Land of Imperishable as if sensing something.
"Is the opening of the Next Era approaching?"
At this moment, for some reason, he felt a sense of the passage of time and immediately realized that the opening of the Next Era was nearing.
"Xu Yan, I feel it, that light is about to appear."
At this time, Ming Yu also spoke up.
"Also, I remember some things. I was supposed to have died but somehow did not die completely, and then I was cast out..."
Xu Yan raised an eyebrow, "What do you mean?"
"It's like, I think I was killed before, but I wasn't killed completely, and then I was exiled... I only vaguely remember these things, I don't know the specifics yet."
"By the way, I think I was from the Exquisite Jade Mountain of Taihao. Where Taihao went, I forget."
Ming Yu cocked her head, pondering.
"Taihao!"
Xu Yan suddenly thought, do Taihao and Taicang have any connection?
"Is Taihao a Domain?"
Xu Yan asked thoughtfully.
"I don't know!"
Ming Yu shook her head.
"Do you know where Taihao is or if it still exists?"
"I don't know!"
Xu Yan was exasperated. Ming Yu's memories were fragmented, recalling only certain key words but not the details.
"Could it be that Taihao and Taicang have a connection? Taihe, Taikun... their names originated from Taicang, belonging to the first followers of Taicang."
Xu Yan mused.
"I must hurry back to the Great Wilderness!"
With the opening of the Next Era imminent and Xu Yan feeling a sense of urgency with powerful beings tracking him, it had to be King Chi Ni and Yu Ting!
Swoosh!
```
Xu Yan reigned in his aura, so even if those True Spirits saw him, they were unable to recognize him as their target. His speed suddenly increased significantly as he headed toward the Great Wilderness.
In the Great Wilderness, Li Xuan looked up toward the Land of Imperishable and sighed, "My disciple has stirred up some formidable folks this time; fortunately, as a teacher, I'm no longer what I once was."
Having reached the Great Achievement of the Primordial Realm had given him sufficient confidence.
"The feeling of epochs transitioning, seems we're entering the Next Era."
Suddenly, Li Xuan sensed something and turned his attention to the Land of Imperishable as if seeing the patterns of rules turning; the moment had arrived for the changing of epochs, for the update of rules.
"So, that's how it is!"
Li Xuan understood that the Unchanging Divine Master aimed to seize this transition moment for some arrangement, which is why the Imperishable Temple was preparing to strike against the Great Wilderness soon.
"Senior Taoist Ancestor, I feel some changes. The transition of epochs is happening within the Land of Imperishable," Tian Zi said with a grave expression.
"Just another era," Li Xuan responded nonchalantly, as if he had already experienced countless such transitions.
"The Imperishable Temple is about to make its move?"
Tian Zi's expression grew solemn. Although the Power of Heavenly Dao had improved greatly, it was still insufficient.
"Almost time."
Li Xuan nodded.
Tian Zi's figure vanished as he gathered the mighty beings of the Great Wilderness, began assigning tasks, and started preparations for the imminent great battle.
Meng Chong sat cross-legged on top of a mountain. His muscles were trembling; each tremor shook the Land of Imperishable, stirring up small storms.
At a certain moment, with a resounding boom, his body seemed to break through some threshold, his aura becoming fierce and exuding an unshakeable presence.
He had broken through!
Elsewhere in the Land of Imperishable, Jiang Buping sat cross-legged, surrounded by an aura of utmost extremity, yet it seemed somewhat gentle.
A True Spirit ran wildly toward him, and the moment it entered the range of this extreme aura, it fell with a thud, lifeless and without a scratch, its Divine Soul extinguished.
And around Jiang Buping, more than a dozen True Spirits lay dead, all with their Divine Souls annihilated.
Boom!
Imperishable Qi and the violent Spiritual Energy swept up into a storm, the Land of Imperishable consolidated into a force, shaking thousands of miles around, an overall situation emerged from the Land of Imperishable.
Fang Hao stepped on Qimen, creating and dissolving Formations with a single thought, constantly changing and transitioning. Any True Spirits that intruded were turned to ash in an instant, becoming part of the grand pattern, further reinforcing its strength.
Roar!
The sound of a tiger's roar echoed in the distance. Demonic energy churned up storms; many True Spirits bowed low. Red Cat transformed into a mountain, its tiger aura vast, its demonic might peerless.
Not far from it was a True Dragon with a green back and white belly, spiraling and roaring with equal demonic ferocity, and on the other side, a Mountain Devourer Toad the size of a mountain, squatting there!
"They're all about to break through."
Li Xuan watched these scenes with satisfaction, as his disciples were growing stronger and improving. However, their power was still somewhat lacking for the looming great battle; their ability to face the stronger beings was limited.
Yet, anyone below the level of Master of Heaven and Earth, they could now sweep aside.
As for those at the level of Master of Heaven and Earth, Xu Yan could now sweep them aside; for those stronger than that, aside from him, their teacher, none could prevail.
"Still not strong enough!"
Li Xuan sighed.
The Power of Heavenly Dao in the Great Wilderness had significantly improved; the perfection of Yin Yang Reincarnation had ushered the Domain into a new starting point, making the Heavenly Dao even more profound and mysterious.
The current power of Heavenly Dao Rules had actually surpassed the Master of Heaven and Earth level.
Harnessing the Power of Heavenly Dao, Tian Zi could indeed confront a being who surpassed the level of Master of Heaven and Earth, but this was only within the bounds of the Heavenly Dao, and the beings he could confront were limited to those who had not greatly surpassed the Master of Heaven and Earth level.
Ultimately, there wasn't enough time. If there were a few thousand, even ten thousand years for improvement, the Heavenly Dao would have been capable of suppressing ordinary beings above the Master of Heaven and Earth level.
"Eh, is this the Imperishable Temple's arrangement?"
Abruptly, Li Xuan spotted a distant figure in the Land of Imperishable, a gray silhouette appeared, moving a mountain. The silhouette brought the mountain and placed it thereforth.
This mountain, far from ordinary, was filled with the Qi of Heaven and Earth and assembled from a variety of True Spirits.
"Similar to a base for a Formation, to prepare this mountain must have taken a long time. It's not just one kind of True Spirit embedded within to harness the mountain's strength, nor from a single era, and they're all Heaven and Earth Lord-Level True Spirits."
Li Xuan saw through the mountain at a glance and guessed that the Unchanging Divine Master had once made an arrangement, though it had not achieved its purpose. The emergence of the Domain had given him the key to success.
That key was to infuse the Qi of Heaven and Earth and to use it as a bridge, with the Great Wilderness as the crucial component, using the entire Domain of the Great Wilderness as the driving force to activate this arrangement, to achieve his objective.

chapters.title: Chapter 1120 - 578: The Arrangement of the Imperishable Temple
chapters.content:
Seeing that mountain at that moment, Li Xuan finally understood what the Imperishable Divine Temple was doing, what the purpose of the Unchanging Divine Master was.
"With this alone, it's still not enough, just another failure."
Li Xuan shook his head, it was clearly impossible for the Unchanging Divine Master to succeed with this.
"The foundation of the Imperishable Divine Temple is indeed unexpected; the strength of the Unchanging Divine Master is probably much stronger than I originally estimated."
The strength of the grey-clad person who relocated the mountain had already surpassed the Master of Heaven and Earth level. From this, it was evident that the strength of the Unchanging Divine Master must be much stronger.
Despite this, in Li Xuan's eyes, the Unchanging Divine Master still counted for nothing. His achievement in the Primordial Realm Great Achievement gave him enough confidence. There was not a second person in the entire Land of Imperishable who wielded power like his.
"Another mountain."
Following the emergence of the first mountain, soon another mountain was relocated and positioned in that spot, just like the first mountain, with a grey-clad person in charge, and the mountain itself was infused with the Qi of Heaven and Earth.
The Qi of Heaven and Earth that was extracted was all used to infuse inside this mountain.
"Eight mountains."
In the end, a total of eight mountains surrounded the Great Wilderness in the middle.
Soon after, behind the eight mountains, sixteen smaller mountains were arranged at certain positions, and the grey-robed figures stationed on those mountains were all powerhouses among the Masters of Heaven and Earth.
"Too crude!"
Li Xuan couldn't help shaking his head upon seeing this.
The Unchanging Divine Master did not understand formations; this arrangement was merely based on some of the rules of the Land of Imperishable that he had grasped, and ultimately seemed somewhat crude.
But it was also remarkable.
"Taking advantage of the dawn of the Next Era, harnessing that one ray of light to achieve his goal, is a good idea sadly, it falls just a little short."
Li Xuan shook his head; the Unchanging Divine Master's scheming was doomed to failure.
Even if he did not intervene to prevent it, and the Unchanging Divine Master successfully completed his plan, swallowing the Qi of the Great Wilderness Domain, he still couldn't achieve his goal.
"Something's not quite right!"
Having made a breakthrough, Meng Chong furrowed his brows, sensing an abnormal change in the Land of Imperishable.
"Junior brother, let's return to the Great Wilderness!"
He immediately transmitted a message to Fang Hao and Jiang Buping; it was time to head back to the Great Wilderness.
"I feel something big is about to happen. There's some danger in the Land of Imperishable, back to the Great Wilderness!"
Red Cat looked towards the depths of the Land of Imperishable with an uneasy feeling and immediately returned to the Great Wilderness with Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha.
"Xu Yan!"
Two grey-robed figures blocked the way, obviously having waited there for a long time deliberately.
"People from the Imperishable Divine Temple."
Xu Yan raised his eyebrows, the other party blocking his way clearly knew he was about to return to the Great Wilderness and had been waiting in advance, which meant that the Imperishable Divine Temple was ready to strike at the Great Wilderness.
"Come with us to the Divine Temple. Perhaps the Divine Master will appreciate your talent, not take your life, and will spare you to serve the Divine Master."
One of the grey-robed persons said.
"Heh, your temple is not worthy!"
Xu Yan was not intimidated at all, although the two grey-robed figures were extremely powerful, no less than the eight Jade Persons of Yu Ting, they were still only at the Master of Heaven and Earth level and could not threaten him.
"Don't be stubborn!"
The other grey-robed figure surged with a breath, and soon a glimmer of light emerged, like a tiny star. As this light appeared, the auras of the two grey-robed figures connected, and their strength suddenly increased greatly.
Xu Yan raised his eyebrows, then let out a cold laugh, saying, "Let's see if you have the ability!"
Images of Heaven and Earth appeared, but instead of spreading out, they enveloped Xu Yan as if his body were the Domain itself, or as if the Domain protected him.
Reaching out towards the distance, a mountain there suddenly transformed into a giant sword flying towards him. This massive sword continued to condense, shrinking as it went, and True Spirits burst forth and were absorbed into the sword, giving it a semblance of life.
Boom!
The entire process took only an instant. A sword, three feet long with flowing radiance, bearing a sacred intent, landed in Xu Yan's hand.
Holy Sword Realm!
Holding this sword, Xu Yan did not emit an overwhelmingly sharp aura or an extreme killing intent; instead, it exuded a sacred feel, as if all the swords under the heavens had to bow, to look up to it.
"Block this one sword of mine before you spout such wild words again!"
Xu Yan had no time to tangle with the grey-robed figures; stronger pursuers were behind him. Although the distance was extremely remote, if he was delayed for too long, they could catch up.
The two grey-robed figures had a gravely solemn expression. The scene of Xu Yan making his move shocked them greatly. What Sword Dao was this?
Even Taicang did not have such methods!
Xu Yan took a step and swung his sword!
One Sword Without Heaven!
The grey-robed figures also made a move. However, facing this sword, they felt despair. All attacks, all defenses seemed to become nothingness under this sword.
How terrifying was this Sword Dao!
It far exceeded their Martial Arts comprehension, fundamentally impossible to defend against.
That glimmer of light, akin to a tiny star, shined brightly, but under this sword, it only persisted for a moment before dimming.
Spurt!
Xu Yan continued forward, and behind him, where the grey-robed figures had been, was now nothingness, as if there had never been any interceptors.
The sword in his hand dimmed a little, yet did not shatter. Xu Yan held it in his hand, and continued forward.
Boom!
In front of King Chi Ni, a grey silhouette appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 1121 - 578: The Arrangement of the Imperishable Temple_2
chapters.content:
"King Chi Ni, the Divine Master's plan is at a critical moment, there must be no interference, or it will be an unending conflict!"
King Chi Ni's eyes emitted a cold and piercing light, and a terrifying aura vibrated throughout the Land of Imperishable.
"Your Divine Temple, you want to threaten me?"
"You know, the Divine Master has prepared for this moment, for far too long, and once disrupted, you know what the Divine Master would do. If you see this as a threat, so be it; though you, King Chi Ni, are powerful, I presume you wouldn't want to make an enemy of the Divine Master over a death feud."
The gray figure spoke indifferently.
"I am seeking revenge for my son. Whoever stands in my way becomes my enemy. I, Chi Ni, have lived through long ages, and I want to see, with such a death feud, what can my enemy really do to me!"
King Chi Ni roared.
"The person you seek revenge on, Xu Yan, is also the target of the Divine Master. He will die, essentially avenging you, King Chi Ni. Plus, you probably have an inkling of the Divine Master's plan—don't you want to see what it is all about, or perhaps take advantage of it?"
The gray figure continued calmly.
"Hah, if you want me not to interfere, you can. Your Imperishable Divine Temple needs the Qi of Heaven and Earth. After extracting the Qi, hand over the person to me to deal with. Otherwise, I will have to intervene and seek revenge myself. If this disrupts your Divine Temple's plan, I can only say sorry, but if this leads to making an unending enemy, I am prepared for it!"
King Chi Ni stated coldly.
"After extracting the Qi of Heaven and Earth and handing Xu Yan over to you, that would be possible. However, if during the extraction Xu Yan is sacrificed, there's nothing I can do. Although you may not personally get your revenge, your nemesis would still be dead. If that's the case, I hope, King Chi Ni, you could bear with it a little."
The gray figure pondered briefly before replying.
"Not being able to avenge personally leaves me no outlet for my anger."
King Chi Ni said gravely.
"If things go successfully, the Divine Temple will compensate you somehow, King Chi Ni."
"Fair enough!"
"King Chi Ni, if it becomes critical, block the Jade Court for a while, and the Divine Master will reward you!"
"Hah, the Jade Court is not easy to provoke, it depends on the rewards of your Divine Temple."
"If all goes smoothly, the rewards after the fact will not disappoint you, King Chi Ni."
With those words, the gray figure vanished into the distance.
On the other hand, before Jade Court, a gray figure appeared.
"Master of the Jade Court, the Divine Master's plan is at a critical moment; please do not interfere!"
"What has the Divine Temple's plan got to do with me? The Jade Court only wishes to find someone and capture them, that's all."
"Xu Yan has some uses, of course, and as for the person from Jade Court, our Divine Temple can capture them on your behalf and return them to the Jade Court, I hope the Master of the Jade Court can concede this much to avoid disrupting the Divine Master's plan."
"What if I refuse and decide to intervene personally?"
"If so, once the plan is disrupted, it becomes a matter of life and death, and you, Master of the Jade Court, should know making an irreconcilable enemy out of the Divine Master is something you should thoroughly consider."
"Hah, a fight to the death!"
The Master of Jade Court laughed lightly.
"Master of the Jade Court, you surely would want to see the Divine Master's plan too, and perhaps gain something from it—you wouldn't want the Divine Master's plan to fail, right?"
"That makes some sense... As long as your Divine Temple does not harm Ming Yu, everything else is negotiable, otherwise do not blame me."
"Understood."
The gray figure nodded and added, "Master of Jade Court, if King Chi Ni interferes, stop him, and the Divine Temple will surely reward you."
"It depends on whether your Divine Temple can offer enough to make me act."
"We absolutely won't disappoint you, Master of the Jade Court."
With that, the gray figure disappeared instantly.
The Jade Court remained still in its location when suddenly, a soft whisper resonated, "Exile, wishing to return, seems rather presumptuous! Ah Yi, you too are half an exile, have you thought about returning, do you think you can return?"
"It's pretty good here..."
Ah Yi's voice sounded.
In the Great Wilderness Domain, Meng Chong, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping gradually returned, and the Red Cat with the three Great Demons also returned to the Great Wilderness, the entire Great Wilderness prepared for a great battle.
At this moment, any being of Realm Master Realm and above felt something unusual, though within Heaven and Earth, they could also feel that the Land of Imperishable was gradually showing signs of epochal change.
The violent Spiritual Energy had somehow become slightly gentler; Li Xuan didn't know if it was an illusion, but the Land of Chaotic Imperishable seemed to have become somewhat brighter.
Li Xuan remained comfortable and at ease, unaffected by the passing of the years or the impending start of the Next Era, nor by the looming outbreak of a great war.
It was a scene of calm and ease.
Fang Hao had returned and became busier. He was setting up Formations and refining powerful Divine Artifacts in preparation for the great battle.
"Fang Hao, how many Masters of Domain can this Great Formation withstand?" Tian Zi asked seriously.
"With the aid of Heavenly Dao, resisting seven or eight Masters of Domain shouldn't be a problem," Fang Hao confidently replied.
"What if I use the Power of Heavenly Dao to deal with foes surpassing the Masters of Domain and reduce the assistance from the Power of Heavenly Dao, how many Masters of Domain level opponents can it withstand?" Tian Zi pondered and inquired again.
Fang Hao contemplated briefly. "With me personally overseeing the Great Formation, even with reduced aid from Heavenly Dao, it can withstand three or four without a problem. Including Second Senior Brother and Fifth Junior Brother participating, we can resist five or six, that's also feasible."
At this point, Fang Hao patted Tian Zi on the shoulder and said, "What truly decides the outcome isn't us. With Master around, rest assured, the Great Wilderness is stable. This war is merely the beginning of the Great Wilderness's strong rise and the true transformation of the Domain."
"I know, but I want to avenge Taicang by myself!" Tian Zi spoke gravely.
"Even if you can't avenge him this time, there will be other opportunities. The Heavenly Dao will only grow stronger and will eventually surpass the Unchanging Divine Master."
Tian Zi nodded.
"So, the arrangement is complete, huh."
Li Xuan looked towards the Land of Imperishable, centered around the Great Wilderness Domain, with nine massive mountains surrounding it, and beyond these nine, another smaller circle of mountains encircled, with the Great Wilderness at the center.
Each mountain, having weathered through the ages, was crafted from many powerful True Spirits and was infused with the Qi of Heaven and Earth.
"We are just missing that Divine Temple. Once it descends, we can truly begin," Li Xuan thought to himself.
The distance between each mountain was vast, yet they were arranged in specific positions. Once the Divine Temple descended, some connection would occur between these mountains, forming something akin to a Great Formation.
It was too rudimentary, making Li Xuan shake his head.
After Xu Yan had slain two robed figures, he hadn't encountered any more ambushes on his way. Clearly, the Imperishable Temple hadn't expected him to slay the robed figures so effortlessly and hadn't yet dispatched stronger foes to block him.
"Xu Yan, I feel like there is something I've lost over there," Ming Yu suddenly spoke up.
"Something you've lost?" Xu Yan was surprised.
"Mm-hmm, I suppose. I faintly feel it now, like I've lost it a long, long time ago, but I can't quite remember what it is," Ming Yu said, slightly distressed.
"Then let's go find what you've lost!"
After a brief reflection, Xu Yan decided to search for what Ming Yu had lost. Although it would delay their return to the Great Wilderness, with the protection of Master's Jade Talisman, even if they encountered strong foes, they would remain unharmed.
The item that made Ming Yu feel its loss must be very important and might help Ming Yu recall more memories.
He immediately concealed his form, blending seamlessly with the Land of Imperishable, and vanished in an instant towards the direction sensed by Ming Yu.
Elsewhere, the Witch was frantically traveling.
"This is... the Next Era is about to begin."
With a graven expression, the Witch felt the passing of epochs—a feeling he had experienced once before. Soon, a purple light would streak across the Land of Chaotic Imperishable.
Now, as this sensation appeared again, it signaled that the Next Era was about to commence, with a light sweeping over the Land of Chaotic Imperishable; this was a monumental opportunity for Creation.
As long as he could capture more of this light, he could greatly enhance his strength in a short time, and in the future, he would have a chance to defeat the Unchanging Divine Master.
He aimed to rush to the Great Wilderness to participate in the upcoming great battle, curious to see how the Great Wilderness Domain differed from the original Domain and if he could gain some insights.
The Witch also had another goal: to visit the mysterious master of Xu Yan and gauge his strength, perhaps gaining some guidance!

chapters.title: Chapter 1122 - 579: The Exquisite Jade Token, a Taihao Divine Object
chapters.content:
Xu Yan concealed his form, merging entirely into the Chaos, fleeing in the direction sensed by Ming Yu, effortlessly evading numerous True Spirits along the way, including those at the Master of Heaven and Earth level, none of whom managed to detect his presence.
"Ming Yu, are you sure it's this direction?"
"Yes, I feel we're getting closer."
Ming Yu affirmed.
"Ming Yu, have you remembered what it is?"
"I don't know, but I feel it's very important to me, as if... as if..."
Ming Yu cocked her head, pondering for a while before continuing, "It's like someone tried to take this thing from me but didn't succeed. I also don't know why it was lost."
"Was it someone from Taihao who tried to take your item?"
"It should be from the Exquisite Jade Mountain..."
Ming Yu said thoughtfully, "I vaguely recall that I have been looking for this item many times before..."
Xu Yan couldn't help but speculate: was the Master of the Jade Court trying to prevent Ming Yu from finding this item? Does that mean if Ming Yu finds it, she could possibly recover her memories, or even escape her Jade Puppet form?
Although Ming Yu was a divine being in a Jade Puppet, she possessed a Divine Soul inside her, which had become somewhat puppet-like; she herself couldn't feel her Divine Soul, but it was precisely because she had a Divine Soul, rather than being a pure Jade Puppet, that she had fallen into a sort of crashing state when she heard about the Divine Soul.
Blood Extreme was in a similar situation, occupying a Jade Puppet's body, controlling the power of the puppet, but Blood Extreme's Divine Soul had not become puppet-like, which was the main difference.
"Ming Yu, how much further to the lost item?"
Xu Yan looked up, staring into the unending expanse of Chaos, not even a single mountain in sight.
"I don't know, but I feel... a bit closer."
Ming Yu blinked her eyes as she spoke.
Xu Yan was at a loss; Ming Yu's way of thinking was, after all, not like that of a normal person. Sometimes she was slow to respond, even crashing, so he could only continue in the direction they were heading.
Finally, within the Chaos, he saw a mountain ahead. This mountain was somewhat unique, not great in size, but from experience, Xu Yan judged the True Spirit that became this mountain to be at least of Master of Heaven and Earth level strength.
Moreover, this mountain was extremely ancient, its bulk largely dissipated, which was why it appeared small, its special feature being that part of the mountain had turned to jade, as if it was in the midst of transforming into jade.
This was the first time Xu Yan had seen a mountain turning to jade. Judging from the jadified parts, it seemed to be the True Spirit's abdomen, which meant that Ming Yu's lost item had been swallowed by this True Spirit.
And perhaps, the death of this True Spirit was also related to its ingestion of Ming Yu's lost item.
"Xu Yan, Xu Yan, it's right ahead, I can feel it."
At this time, Ming Yu called out excitedly.
Xu Yan, while remaining vigilant of his surroundings, approached the mountain. The Minor Heavenly Eye scanned the area; no danger or powerful hidden True Spirit was detected.
Taking out the Prime Tortoise Carapace, Ming Yu emerged and looked at the small mountain, her excitement palpable.
"I found it, I finally found it, how wonderful!"
Ming Yu was thrilled and agitated; at this moment, she seemed more vibrant with the essence of life, her demeanor more that of an innocent young girl.
"Let's go!"
Xu Yan, taking Ming Yu with him, instantly arrived on the mountain.
"This is the place; it's inside, I can sense it."
Ming Yu looked down at the ground beneath her feet.
"Let's go inside and look!"
Xu Yan waved his hand, and the mountain slowly cracked open, deepening further as they descended along the opening. The deeper they went into the mountain, the more it took on a jadestone-like appearance.
"The aura here no longer has the Imperishable Qi, nor does it feel Chaotic; rather, there's a kind of..."
Xu Yan was inwardly astounded.
Could Ming Yu's lost item be a Treasure of Heaven and Earth? Otherwise, why was the aura within the mountain free of the Chaos, exuding a fresher breath?
"There! Over there!"
Ming Yu pointed towards the lower side of the mountain.
Xu Yan's gaze followed, and he saw a cluster of misty radiance, embodying a vast and refreshing ethos, which confirmed it was not a treasure of The Land of Chaotic Imperishable. Yet, it was slightly different from other Treasures of Heaven and Earth, seeming to have an additional ethos while also lacking some Heaven and Earth ethos.
Crack!
With a wave of his hand, Xu Yan split the mountain open, and finally, in a small pit inside the jadified mountain, a quaint little seal appeared.
That was Ming Yu's lost item!
The moment he saw the seal, Xu Yan sensed its extraordinariness, enveloped by an ethos as if from a Treasure of Heaven and Earth.
"That's it!"
Ming Yu darted over excitedly and reached out for the small seal. As the tiny seal fell into Ming Yu's palm, a white light burst forth instantaneously.
Pristine and immaculate light shot out from Ming Yu's hand, stirring in all directions, the pure white light illuminating the entire expanse of tens of thousands of miles of The Land of Chaotic Imperishable centered around the mountain.
The violent Spiritual Energy suddenly became gentle; the Imperishable Qi softened as well. The Land of Imperishable, seemingly out of nowhere, began to show signs of life, as if a tiny domain was being born.
"I remember now; this is my Exquisite Jade Token, yes, the Exquisite Jade Token!"
Ming Yu was overjoyed, seemingly oblivious to the changes in The Land of Imperishable as reflected by the pure white light.
Hum!
The Exquisite Jade Token plunged directly into Ming Yu's brow, into her Divine Soul. In a flash, a white light engulfed Ming Yu's body. Her eyes shimmered with silver light, and as if characters were flitting through her eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 1123 - 579: The Exquisite Jade Token, a Taihao Divine Object_2
chapters.content:
Ming Yu had entered a certain state, as if she was receiving the message from the Exquisite Jade Token, or as if she was delving into her memories.
"Not good!"
Xu Yan frowned, the pristine white light emitted by the Exquisite Jade Token had likely triggered some change, and they must leave immediately, returning to the Great Wilderness would be safe.
With a wave of his hand, he stowed Ming Yu inside the Prime Tortoise Carapace, not daring to hesitate, he concealed his form and took to his utmost speed, heading straight for the Great Wilderness.
However, due to his search for the Exquisite Jade Token, he was extremely far from the Great Wilderness, and it would take even more time to return. This duration was sufficient for the Imperishable Temple and Yu Ting to dispatch powerful beings to intercept him.
But the Land of Imperishable was truly boundless. Xu Yan was confident in his ability to evade detection with his hiding skills. However, should the Three Masters of the Jade Court personally take action, or a being greater than the Master of Domain emerge, he would have to be cautious, possibly even needing to use the Jade Talisman given by his master.
After Xu Yan left, the pervasive, flawless white light in the area began to fade, the chaotic imperishable state gradually returning to normal, albeit slowly.
At that moment, a grey figure descended.
"The light of Taihao, this is a Taihao Divine Object. How come there is a Taihao Divine Object in the Land of Imperishable? Which exile was lucky enough to carry a Taihao Divine Object?"
The grey figure pondered for a while, seemingly coming to a realization, "Could it be Yu Ting?"
The figure vanished in an instant, and shortly after its departure, a Jade Person appeared in the same location.
"Ming Yu, you actually found the Exquisite Jade Token? You actually carried the Exquisite Jade Token with you into exile here? Ah, reminiscing might not be such a good thing after all. Isn't it better to be carefree and happy? Isn't that what you wished for too?"
Ah Yi sighed, then quickly made his way towards the Great Wilderness.
Yu Ting abruptly stopped in place, the silhouette surfacing and looking in the direction of a part of the Land of Imperishable, where Ming Yu had taken the Exquisite Jade Token.
"The Taihao Divine Object, Ming Yu, ah!"
A soft sigh, and then his gaze shifted elsewhere, "With the Taihao Divine Object appearing in the Land of Imperishable, the Divine Master must be thrilled. For that Taihao Divine Object, he'd probably do anything, it certainly could increase his chances of success."
Continuing on his journey, Yu Ting accelerated his pace.
Boom!
King Chi Ni suddenly stood up from the mountain peak, a terrifying aura swirling around him as he looked towards a certain place with piercing eyes, "Taihao Divine Object!"
Boom!
A reddish light surged around him, the frightening aura causing a True Spirit to instantaneously burst and die, leaving the others trembling in terror.
"This Taihao Divine Object is somewhat extraordinary."
King Chi Ni muttered to himself, before immediately withdrawing his aura, allowing the trembling True Spirits to recover and continue carrying the mountain peak onwards.
"What is that? I feel something unusual, as if it's a Treasure of Heaven and Earth, but it seems different."
Ao Hong expressed his doubt.
"It's a Taihao Divine Object!"
Black Chi King spoke in a deep voice.
"A Taihao Divine Object?"
Ao Hong looked confused, "What is that?"
Black Chi King didn't answer but appeared to be deep in thought. After a while, he said, "The Taihao Divine Object should not appear in the Land of Imperishable. It once..."
He paused, not continuing, then said, "With the Taihao Divine Object's appearance, the situation will change again. That one from the Divine Temple will surely do everything in his power to obtain it. Of course, with the Taihao Divine Object, perhaps he won't covet your Qi of Heaven and Earth anymore."
Ao Hong swallowed nervously, a feeling telling him that the Black Chi King was extremely ancient and knew many secrets. The fact that the Taihao Divine Object shouldn't appear in the Land of Imperishable—did this mean it came from beyond the Land of Imperishable?
What was Taihao, the name of a Domain?
Beyond the Land of Imperishable, was there a Domain? And what about Taicang, was it related to this?
"There are too many things in this world that we cannot comprehend. Not just you, even I do not understand, nor know the root of it all."
Black Chi King sighed.
```
"Taihao Divine Object?"
The Gargantuan Gluttonous King, having eaten half of a True Spirit, spat it back out, looked towards the place where the Exquisite Jade Token had appeared, eyes filled with excitement.
"This thing should be tasty, right? I've never tried it before, I'll know once I eat it."
It was so excited, and with that excitement, it felt like eating, so it opened its huge mouth and swallowed the remaining True Spirit, chewing it up.
Its figure moved as if to go towards the place where the Exquisite Jade Token appeared, but then it stopped abruptly, looking in a certain direction, "It's no longer over there, but it will probably go there; best to continue in that direction."
So it continued toward the Great Wilderness.
"How could this be possible, an Taihao Divine Object in the Land of Imperishable, which Exile has carried a Taihao Divine Object without being plundered?
"Could it be someone recently exiled, impossible, absolutely impossible, if there were any Exiles, I would surely be able to sense them; I must get this object, with it, I can definitely succeed!"
The Unchanging Divine Master's face was filled with disbelief, followed by uncontrollable excitement.
"Taihao Divine Object, I must have it, whoever dares to snatch it, I'll kill without mercy!"
The Unchanging Divine Master was filled with murderous intent at this moment.
Boom!
The pace of the Imperishable Temple suddenly sped up, heading towards the Great Wilderness. At the same time, a figure emerged from the Imperishable Temple like a swirling cloud of sinister air, entering the Land of Imperishable to search for the Taihao Divine Object!
"I'm finally back!"
Blood Extreme looked ahead at the beautiful Treasure Bead amidst the chaos, suddenly filled with excitement. After rushing on his journey, he had finally reached the Great Wilderness.
As for the other eight Jade People, they were all in pursuit of Xu Yan, and Xu Yan did not seem to be heading straight back to the Great Wilderness; it was unknown where he had gone.
"Although I have not replaced the Blood Demon, I have become the Master of Domain. This body, though a bit strange, is ultimately powerful; it's a great opportunity."
Blood Extreme thought this and headed straight for the Great Wilderness.
At the same time, a Witch arrived at the outskirts of the Land of Imperishable, outside of the Great Wilderness, gazing at the magnificent Treasure Bead, somewhat mystified.
Things were different. It was no longer the look of Taicang Domain, and more than that, the Domain was bigger and stronger than before; this was the Great Wilderness!
He could sense it; his own broken Witch Demon Domain was in the Great Wilderness ahead, but the Witch Demon Domain had merged into the Great Wilderness, becoming a part of it, and the Dao Principles of the Witch Demon Domain had been assimilated.
"There's another Domain."
The Witch muttered to himself, it was the Hong Ze Domain. Although Hong Ze was dead and his Domain had long been desolate with no Dao Principles, it was after all a Domain created by Hong Ze, which he was naturally familiar with.
The Seven Great Domain, now one was lost, Taicang Domain existed but had ultimately become history. Now what existed was the Great Wilderness Domain, but the Great Wilderness Heavenly Path was Tian Zi, a perfect continuation of Taicang, ultimately retaining traces of Taicang.
"There are still some old friends around."
The Witch took his steps towards the Great Wilderness.
In the Great Wilderness, Li Xuan suddenly became pensive, looking up towards the Land of Imperishable with a thoughtful expression.
"A Supreme Treasure? Treasure of Heaven and Earth? Yet different, from outside the Land of Imperishable?"
"The more intriguing it becomes, and this treasure seems to have some connection to Xu Yan, is this whole situation getting bigger and bigger, it feels like all the Supreme Experts of the Land of Imperishable will come after it?
"But these are minor issues, with me, the Taoist Ancestor here, who can bully my disciple with their power?"
Li Xuan wasn't worried at all and looked at the mountain range arranged by the Imperishable Temple; one of the nine figures in grey, after a moment of contemplation, had a plan.
"It's time to find out more, otherwise, as the Taoist Ancestor, being completely ignorant of these things isn't right; it would be good to find someone to ask."
With that in mind, Li Xuan immediately headed towards the Land of Imperishable, and what he left behind in the courtyard was his Extreme Soul Body, which was no different from his original except that the Martial Arts of the Extreme Soul Body was the Extreme Soul Martial Arts.
Li Xuan had already reached one of the nine mountains, took out a table and chairs, brewed a pot of tea, and said to the figure in grey, "Sit!"
The figure in grey, shocked, looked at Li Xuan who had suddenly appeared, ready to erupt into action, but in an instant, fell into a certain state and obediently sat down in front of Li Xuan.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1124 - 580: The Exile, Xu Yan Returns
chapters.content:
