The man in gray was very powerful, surpassing the Master of Domain level, but in Li Xuan's eyes, he was still as weak as an ant, easily able to control the other's Divine Soul Consciousness.
"What's your name."
Li Xuan leisurely sipped his tea and asked.
"Shen Qi!"
"Ranked Seventh?"
"Yes, under the Divine Master, ranked seventh."
"How many people are there in total, and to what rank does it extend?"
"Thirteen, a total of thirteen people."
Li Xuan nodded, ranging from Shen Yi to Shen Thirteen; these were the confidants of the Unchanging Divine Master, thirteen powerful beings who had surpassed the Master of Heaven and Earth level.
However, the other protectors and Elders of the Imperishable Temple were not core members. The real executors of the plan were these thirteen individuals.
"Tell me, where do you come from."
Li Xuan continued to inquire.
Shen Qi pondered, as if recalling, "We are all Taihao Exiles, banished here in The Land of Chaotic Imperishable, where darkness pervades... The Divine Master is also an Exile, but he is different; he's too powerful. In the Land of Imperishable, he gathered us Exiles, enabling us to survive..."
As Shen Qi narrated, Li Xuan gained a clear understanding of the Unchanging Divine Master and also learned something about the world outside the Land of Imperishable.
Those from the Imperishable Temple were all Exiles, but apart from Shen Yi to Shen Thirteen, most of the rest who were Masters of Domain had died once, with their Remnant Souls clinging to their True Spirits to be reborn in the Land of Imperishable, transforming again into human form, except their memories from before had mostly been lost.
But not all Masters of Domain were Exiles from Taihao; among them were native beings of the Land of Imperishable that had developed Spiritual Wisdom, but their Cultivation Methods were also instructed by the Unchanging Divine Master.
As the questioning went on, Li Xuan learned more and more, a smile appearing on his lips. He, the Taoist Ancestor, could continue to deceive, and no one would find any flaws.
"The Unchanging Divine Master... or rather, the Indestructible Divine Master is quite a character. Things are really getting more interesting, but the idea that he can succeed just like this, or take revenge, is still too presumptuous."
Li Xuan shook his head in secret.
The title of Indestructible Divine Master was his alias in Taihao. Of course, in the Land of Imperishable, it was also possible to call him the Unchanging Divine Master, but in front of himself, a Taoist Ancestor, talk of being undying was senseless—one wave of his hand and he could be annihilated.
"With my current strength, not only am I invincible in the Land of Imperishable, but also outside of it. When the Next Era begins, I should be able to step into the Method of Practicing Dao.
"Xu Yan has already enlightened the Primordial; how far the Method of Practicing Dao is, should not be too distant. When the Next Era begins, and that light appears, it will be an opportunity."
Li Xuan was filled with anticipation.
Once he stepped into the Dao, everything in this world would be beneath his gaze; he would be a true Taoist Ancestor.
Glancing towards the mountains outside, "Blood Extreme, this guy, has had good fortune, his Divine Soul has undergone Refinement and is no longer an ordinary Divine Soul, otherwise, how could he Control the Jade Puppet?"
Then, he looked in another direction, "This is the Witch, not bad, the strength is decent, and the Qi of Heaven and Earth is not dissipated. As long as he's Undying, breaking through above Master of Domain will be no issue."
Blood Extreme and Witch had returned.
The Unchanging Divine Master was also about to make his entrance.
"It's a pity for Taicang."
Li Xuan shook his head. He had a deeper understanding of that battle and Taicang's fall, although it was because the Unchanging Divine Master was more powerful, but it also had a great deal to do with his own origins.
Having asked everything he wanted to know, Li Xuan folded up the chair, and his figure instantly disappeared from the spot, returning to the courtyard.
Shen Qi blinked in confusion, looking around with a furrowed brow. Why did it feel as though he had experienced something, yet there was no memory of it?
"Is it the influence of the Qi of Heaven and Earth?"
Shen Qi shook his head, not thinking too much about it. After all, with his strength, who could silently make him enter a certain state without leaving any trace of memory?
"The Taihao Divine Object has also appeared; this time, we will certainly succeed. The next Era is coming soon; we shall return, and all shall tremble in wait."
Shen Qi's eyes were filled with excitement, as if he saw his enemies kneeling and trembling before him.
"People from Yu Ting!"
Tian Zi appeared and directly restrained Blood Extreme, the Heavenly Dao Rules rippling as if aiming to disassemble this Jade Puppet to explore why the Yu Ting's Jade Puppet was so extraordinary.
"Lord Tian Zi, it's me, I'm Blood Extreme!"
Blood Extreme's face went even paler as he hastily spoke.
"Blood Extreme?"
Tian Zi frowned and asked, "Weren't you going to replace the Blood Demon?"
"I didn't succeed. I met Master Xu; he gave me this body, and now I'm substituting this body, with strength at Master of Heaven and Earth level."
Blood Extreme hurriedly explained.
"Then go back."
Tian Zi released the restraint.
"Yes, yes, thank you, Lord Tian Zi!"
Blood Extreme quickly returned to the Great Wilderness to find Su Lingxiu; after all, his real master was Su Lingxiu.
"Witch!"
Tian Zi's figure appeared in another part of the Great Wilderness, looking at the approaching figure with a complicated expression.
"Little Tian Zi ah!"
The Witch sighed with emotion, looking at the now-changed Tian Zi, it was hard to imagine.
Once the unruly Tian Zi now also had a steady temperament, and moreover, exuded a majestic presence even stronger than his own; perhaps that was the Majesty of the Heavenly Path.
"Do you still remember when you were in my Domain, causing chaos, the Seductive Witch almost died of anger because of you..."
The Witch sighed, "You've grown up now. If Big Brother Taicang knew, he'd be comforted."
After all, in a certain sense, Tian Zi was Taicang's son.
He was created by Taicang; though not a son of blood, he was born because of Taicang.

chapters.title: Chapter 1125 - 580 Exile, Xu Yan Returns_2
chapters.content:
"Taicang, and you, Qing Yu that woman... you all tricked me there, locked me up..."
Tian Zi gritted his teeth in anger as he spoke.
The Witch Demon gave a bitter smile, "We had no choice but to act thus. How would there be a Domain like today's if we hadn't locked you up? What would you have done if not confined, don't you know in your heart?"
Tian Zi was momentarily at a loss for words. Given his temperament back then, if he had realized the battle was turning against them and Taicang was in danger, he would certainly have dragged the entire Taicang Domain into helping Taicang.
He was a spirit of the Domain, capable of such an action.
That was also why Taicang had restrained him—to prevent him from doing just that.
"Your Domain is gone, sparing nothing; is this Taicang Domain truly so important to Taicang?"
Tian Zi angrily said.
"It's not that the Domain is important to Brother Taicang, but rather the myriad creatures, the people of the Domain. Taicang was ultimately not as heartless as us; he is different because he is Taicang!"
The Witch Demon sighed.
Tian Zi fell silent.
"What have you come back for?"
After a long pause, Tian Zi finally spoke.
"To take a look at this Domain, and also at my broken Domain," replied the Witch Demon with a smile.
"Do you want to take back your broken Domain?"
"What use would that be, merging into this Domain, which is quite fine. You would also treat the Seductive Witch and the others well, that's enough. Just don't forget what you once stole from the Seductive Witch."
The Witch Demon said cheerfully.
"Humph!"
Tian Zi scoffed several times, "Now that you have seen it, you should go, the farther the better."
"Why must I? Since I have returned, naturally I intend to battle with the Imperishable Temple. Besides, if this Domain falls, escaping would only delay my capture, so I might as well fight here."
The Witch Demon looked up towards the depths of the Land of Imperishable, "Of the Seven Great Domain Masters, now only myself, Ao Hong and Qing Yu are left. But Qing Yu has returned to her original form and cannot yet recover, while Netherworld..."
Speaking of Netherworld, the Witch Demon paused, sighed, "He is no longer a Master of Domain, everything of the Domain has been stripped from him, otherwise his power wouldn't have dropped so."
Tian Zi stared at him for a long while and said, "Did you encounter Xu Yan!"
"How did you know?" asked the Witch Demon, surprised.
"If you hadn't encountered Xu Yan, how could you know so much, have learned these things?"
Tian Zi looked at him with disdain.
"Where is Xu Yan, why hasn't he returned?"
Tian Zi was puzzled, since the Witch Demon had come to the Great Wilderness, logically Xu Yan should have returned as well?
"Hasn't he returned?"
The Witch Demon was a bit surprised and said, "He is being pursued by Yu Ting, and since he is faster than me, he should have returned by now. If he hasn't, something unexpected might have occurred."
"Maybe he's just delayed by something else, but an encounter with danger, that's definitely not possible."
Tian Zi turned and headed back into the Domain, "Come if you want to, it's also good to see those who follow you. In this battle at Imperishable Temple, don't push too hard, since your power is just so-so, struggle or not, it won't change anything."
The Witch Demon's face darkened, so he was being reproached for weak strength?
This Tian Zi, getting too arrogant!
However, Tian Zi indeed now had the grounds to look down on him; truly speaking, within the Great Wilderness Heavenly Path, he was no match for Tian Zi.
"Now this Great Wilderness Domain is truly profound. The Heavenly Dao, the Yin Yang Reincarnation, compared to the Domain we originally created, ours was quite crude, like only a frame had been constructed. If the Domain we initially created had been like this, our strength would have been much stronger and may not have lost to the Divine Temple."
The Witch Demon stepped into the Great Wilderness, expressing his feelings of marvel.
"This is all thanks to the guidance of the Taoist Ancestor, it's definitely different. It's already quite incredible that Taicang could create a Domain."
"Could I pay a visit to this senior Taoist Ancestor?"
"This depends on whether you have the opportunity," Tian Zi thought for a moment and said, "The Taoist Ancestor rarely meets outsiders, but since you've encountered Xu Yan, he is likely to meet with you."
"That's great, that's great!"
Witch Demon let out a sigh of relief.
This trip to the Great Wilderness, aside from participating in the great battle, had another purpose—to visit the master of Xu Yan, the enigmatic Taoist Ancestor.
Hoping to receive some guidance!
"The Seductive Witch and the others are in the Yin Realm, go see your old friends first."
Tian Zi took Witch Demon to the border between Yin and Yang.
"Alright!"
Witch Demon nodded and slowly walked towards the Yin Realm, feeling the differences at the border of Yin and Yang, and becoming increasingly astonished by the mystique of the Great Wilderness' Domain; even he could not fully comprehend it.
Boom!
As Witch Demon arrived, the Yin Realm trembled slightly. After all, this was the Witch Demon Domain he once opened. His arrival was bound to cause some reactions.
"Brother Witch Demon!"
Seductive Witch appeared, her excitement palpable at the sight of this figure.
"It's Seductive Witch!"
Witch Demon looked at Seductive Witch, Duowu, Flame Demon, and the seven others, sighing emotionally. They were once his followers and the pillars of the Witch Demon lineage he had established.
After a major battle, only these seven old friends remained.
In the Yin Realm, Witch Demon and the seven Seductive Witches reminisced.
Li Xuan was leisurely drinking tea brewed by Cai Ling'er, guiding her cultivation while observing the changes in the Land of Imperishable. The Master of Domain level True Spirits began to gather at the sight that met his gaze.
In the Land of Imperishable, Xu Yan was heading back to the Great Wilderness. He used his "One Thought Traceless" Divine Ability to its extreme, feeling a vague sense of crisis. Inside the Prime Tortoise Carapace, Ming Yu remained in a certain state, her body glowing faintly, with characters flashing continuously in her eyes.
Some essence of the Exquisite Jade Token, that even the Prime Tortoise Carapace couldn't completely conceal, meant that some Supreme Experts could track his whereabouts using it.
"Is Ming Yu recovering her lost memories?"
Xu Yan's figure almost fused with Chaos. Even though he could avoid the Master of Heaven and Earth level True Spirits, he still couldn't completely conceal his whereabouts and was easily traceable.
"Are these Master of Heaven and Earth level True Spirits gathering here because King Chi Ni is coming?"
Along the way, Xu Yan noticed that Master of Heaven and Earth level True Spirits were continuously converging towards the Great Wilderness. Even the normally hostile True Spirit Tribes maintained restraint, not erupting into conflict.
All these signs clearly indicated that these True Spirits had received orders from the King of True Spirits, who dared not defy their bloodline.
"Hmm, what is that?"
Suddenly, Xu Yan saw a massive mountain ahead, which was unusual, seemingly not transformed just from a single True Spirit. Instead, it seemed to be made from several True Spirits, containing the Origin powers of these True Spirits.
It was evident that this mountain was artificially created, keeping the True Spirit Origin intact; moreover, it seemed to contain Qi of Heaven and Earth.
On top of the mountain sat two strong figures, both at the Master of Domain level, with remarkable strength.
Clearly, these mountains, arrangements of the Imperishable Temple, were consuming Qi of Heaven and Earth to inject into the mountains, and there were certainly more than one of these mountains.
"A kind of Great Formation? What is the purpose of the Unchanging Divine Master?"
Xu Yan wondered.
He had no intent to destroy this mountain, as doing so would alert the other mountains and even attract more powerful opponents to intercept.
Xu Yan avoided this mountain and continued on his journey. Sure enough, further on, he saw another similar mountain, manned by two figures, Netherworld and Blood Demon.
In the mist of Chaos, a tiny but magnificent Treasure Bead appeared, extremely distant yet finally bringing the Great Wilderness Domain into view. Xu Yan finally breathed a sigh of relief as he made his return.
"What's that?"
Suddenly, Xu Yan's heart tightened as he saw to the left a mountain larger than the previous ones. The mountain was composed of even more types of True Spirits, each carefully selected, gathering their Origins within the mountain.
Inside the mountain was an even larger Qi of Heaven and Earth!
The figures guarding the mountain were beyond the Master of Domain level, and Xu Yan was secretly startled by the unexpected profound depth of the Imperishable Temple!

chapters.title: Chapter 1126 - 581: Outside the Land of Imperishable, Taihao 33 Heavens
chapters.content:
"Xu Yan has returned, that Taihao Divine Object, indeed it's related to him."
Li Xuan looked towards the Land of Imperishable, where Xu Yan was hurriedly returning to the Great Wilderness.
"Ah, the Taihao Divine Object!"
The man in gray on the mountain suddenly stood up in shock, looked towards the area Xu Yan was passing, and then his gaze shifted to the Great Wilderness.
"The destination of the Taihao Divine Object is the Taicang Domain, good, good, going to Taicang is excellent, no need to search everywhere now."
The man in gray was extremely agitated.
"Send a message to the Divine Master!"
Instantly, an essence appeared on his body, sending a message to the Unchanging Divine Master that the Taihao Divine Object had appeared.
The Great Wilderness was now close at hand, Xu Yan's face flush with excitement, having roamed the Land of Imperishable for so long, he was finally returning, this was the longest he had been away from his master and adventured outside.
Suddenly, Xu Yan's expression changed, and he hurriedly moved Ming Yu out of the Prime Tortoise Carapace.
At that moment, Ming Yu's essence surged, elevating to the Master of Heaven and Earth level, and there were some changes in her aura. Her Puppet Principle did not transform into the Puppet Path Law but became another type of Dao Principle.
Ming Yu looked more like a person now, not simply a Jade Puppet.
However, Ming Yu was still in a certain state and unable to contain her aura. The small Domain within the Prime Tortoise Carapace could not support her presence there.
At this moment, with the appearance of Ming Yu, the Taihao intention of the Exquisite Jade Token was directly revealed in the Land of Imperishable without any concealment.
Fortunately, they were now not far from the Great Wilderness.
Xu Yan, wrapping his power around Ming Yu, continued towards the Great Wilderness, the beautiful Treasure Bead in his eyes gradually becoming a vast Domain.
"The Great Wilderness has strengthened a lot, it has grown significantly!"
Xu Yan, witnessing this scene, could not help but exclaim.
This return marked an almost sea-changing transformation in the Great Wilderness.
Boom!
Outside the Great Wilderness, Tian Zi and the Witch appeared, followed by Meng Chong, Su Lingxiu, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping, as well as Old Man Xiao and other Heavenly Domain powerhouses who appeared one after another.
They all sensed something approaching, similar to a Domain yet slightly different—a kind of powerful Treasure of Heaven and Earth.
"What Treasure is that?"
"It must be the return of our senior brother."
Meng Chong spoke.
In a moment, a figure suddenly appeared.
"It's our senior brother!"
Su Lingxiu, overwhelmed with excitement, quickly moved forward to greet him.
"Senior brother, what is this?"
Looking at Ming Yu, Su Lingxiu asked in surprise, "Is it a Jade Puppet from Yu Ting?"
Blood Extreme had obtained a Jade Puppet body and had studied it; now seeing Ming Yu, she became intensely curious about the aura emanating from Ming Yu, which was similar to the Treasure of Heaven and Earth they had sensed.
"Yes, but also no!"
Xu Yan was also uncertain now whether Ming Yu still counted as a Jade Puppet.
"What treasure does she have on her that makes her so special?"
Tian Zi asked curiously.
"The Exquisite Jade Token!"
Xu Yan shook his head, "As for the specifics, I'm not clear."
Carrying Ming Yu, he did not linger and hurriedly returned to the Great Wilderness; the Witch followed behind. It was a good opportunity to meet Xu Yan's mysterious master.
"Master, your disciple has returned!"
Xu Yan, looking at his master, was thrilled, set down Ming Yu, and respectfully bowed.
"Ah, very good!"
Li Xuan revealed a gratified smile.
After a brief catch-up, Xu Yan looked at Ming Yu and asked, "Master, what's going on with Ming Yu?"
Li Xuan smiled and said, "She just found herself, no need to bother about it."
"The Exquisite Jade Token, what treasure is that?"
Xu Yan was also very curious about the Exquisite Jade Token.
Li Xuan raised a finger, smiling, "It's just something from Taihao."
Taihao!
The first time Xu Yan heard this name was in Yu Ting when Ming Yu mentioned it, and because of this name, the mysterious existence of Yu Ting was awakened.
"Master, who is Taihao?"
Xu Yan was immensely curious.
As his disciple had already grown powerful, and the arrangements of the Imperishable Temple were about to be revealed, knowing what Taihao was, Li Xuan saw no need for unnecessary mystery.
"Taihao, ah."
Li Xuan raised his hand upward, "Beyond this Chaotic Imperishable, there is a Taihao Domain, considered as a Domain outside the Land of Imperishable, but unlike Domains like the Great Wilderness."
"The Taihao Thirty-Three Heavens, each Heaven surrounded by its own sun, moon, and stars, which are different from the sun, moon, and stars of the Great Wilderness..."
These things about the Taihao Realm and the Thirty-three Heavens, Li Xuan learned from Shen Qi.
While Taicang creating a Domain is quite different from the Taihao Realm, given time, the Taicang Domain will ultimately surpass the Taihao Realm and become a true Domain.
The Taihao Thirty-Three Heavens, each surrounded by its own sun, moon, and stars, and outside the Thirty-three Heavens lies the Chaotic Imperishable Land, termed by Taihao as the Land of Exile, also known as the Land of No Return.
Anyone who enters the Land of Imperishable cannot return!
Xu Yan and the others were shocked and curious; outside the Land of Imperishable, there was actually a Taihao Domain. What kind of Domain was it, and how did it compare to the Great Wilderness?
"Master, Master, are you from the Taihao Realm?"
Su Lingxiu asked curiously.
Everyone showed a curious look. The Taoist Ancestor was profoundly mysterious, and his strength was unimaginable. Could he be from the Taihao Realm?
Li Xuan just smiled, "Taihao, it's just a small place. I am not from there. Now, everything in this world is after the era of the teacher."
Whether it's the Imperishable Land or Taihao, both came after the teacher. This Taoist Ancestor is invincible; he existed before anything else in this world.
Li Xuan didn't even blink as he started to brag.

chapters.title: Chapter 1127 - 581 - Outside the Land of Imperishable, Taihao 33 Heavens_2
chapters.content:
Everyone was utterly shocked, and the witches were even more stunned.
Could it mean that he existed even before the Land of Imperishable was born?
Was it possible that he created everything in the world?
"Master, did you create this Land of Imperishable and all that Taihao stuff?" Su Lingxiu blinked, both excited and curious.
"As your teacher, I do not partake in such amusements." Li Xuan shook his head. "Those who practice Dao simply follow their path, without aspiring to these distractions, which are merely ways to find amusement in this world."
"Master, when can I go to the Taihao Realm? Are there many strong beings there, and what is their level of strength?" Xu Yan asked excitedly.
He had already ventured through the Land of Imperishable, which was quite ordinary, so the Taihao Realm must be even more interesting.
Li Xuan smiled faintly, "To reach the Taihao Realm, you must first transcend the Land of Imperishable, and with your current strength, that's not possible. Even breaking through to the Primordial Realm wouldn't suffice; without practicing Dao, you will always face limitations."
He silently added to himself, "As your teacher, I can't reach Taihao either, only after practicing Dao can one transcend the Land of Imperishable and go to the Taihao Realm."
Of course, Li Xuan wasn't in a hurry, given that the Next Era was about to begin, and practicing Dao would not be too far off.
"Even the Primordial Realm can't transcend the Land of Imperishable and travel to the Taihao Realm?" Xu Yan was beyond shocked. The Primordial Realm was still a distant goal for him, and he could imagine just how incredibly powerful it must be, yet it was still unable to transcend the Land of Imperishable; only practicing Dao could achieve that.
"Master, I will certainly grasp the Method of Practicing Dao soon, understand how to practice the Grand Dao, transcend the Land of Imperishable as soon as possible, and head to the Taihao Realm to meet the chosen ones there!" Xu Yan declared, his blood boiling with fervor.
"You are right, eldest senior brother!" Meng Chong and the other three nodded excitedly.
The others felt excited, yet somewhat deflated, realizing they might not have the chance to transcend the Land of Imperishable and go to the Taihao Realm.
"My disciple, if you practiced Dao, transcended the Land of Imperishable, and went to the Taihao Realm, what 'chosen ones'? You could easily suppress those little fellows in Taihao with just one hand," Li Xuan said with a wry smile.
The Unchanging Divine Master was very powerful, known as the Indestructible Divine Master in the Taihao Realm because of his immense strength. The strong ones there could no longer kill him, and in the end, they could only exile him to this Land of Imperishable.
Now, the Unchanging Divine Master, in terms of strength, was much more powerful than when he was in the Taihao Realm.
If Xu Yan practiced Dao, he would be invincible in the Taihao Realm; he'd be unbeatable there even without practicing Dao, as long as he made a Minor Achievement above the Creation Realm.
Xu Yan was taken aback, "The Taihao Realm is that weak?"
Li Xuan smiled, "The Taihao Realm may lie outside the Land of Imperishable, but it isn't necessarily stronger. This place is considered a forbidden zone to the Taihao Realm, also known as the Land of No Return."
"Well, the Taihao is too distant for you; knowing about it is useless. Focus on your cultivation. With great strength, where can't you go?" Li Xuan did not continue discussing the Taihao Realm.
"So does that mean I will never be able to go to Taihao, unable to leave the Land of Imperishable?" Tian Zi said, feeling somewhat frustrated.
"The Heavenly Dao is boundless; as long as one is powerful enough, one can break through the Chaotic Imperishable and the vast expanse of the Great Wilderness. It is unimaginable. If the Chaotic Imperishable no longer exists, then why can't one leave the Land of Imperishable?"
Li Xuan said with a smile.
Upon hearing this, Tian Zi's blood boiled with excitement, then he felt deflated, "But to break through the Chaotic Imperishable and have the Great Wilderness replace the Land of Imperishable, who knows how many long years that will take?"
The Land of Imperishable is endless, and the growth of the Heavenly Dao might not be able to keep up with the changes of the Land of Imperishable.
"If you wish to go to Taihao, you don't necessarily have to break through the Land of Imperishable. Once the Heavenly Dao has ascended, you can move the Great Wilderness. By following the operational rules of the Land of Imperishable, you can reach the place that connects to Taihao. The spread of the Heavenly Dao Rules will allow you to leave the Land of Imperishable, and then you can follow these Heavenly Dao Rules to leave the Land of Imperishable."
Li Xuan thought for a moment and then said.
"Is that really possible?"
Tian Zi's eyes lit up upon hearing this, and Old Man Xiao and the others were also thrilled. They were all strong practitioners of the Great Wilderness Dao of Heaven Realm. Once the Heavenly Dao Rules spread beyond the Land of Imperishable, they too could follow the Power of Principles and leave the Land of Imperishable.
"Of course it's possible. Besides, the Heavenly Dao is close to the Great Dao, making it easier to leave the Land of Imperishable without being blocked by the rules of its operation. Of course, the Heavenly Dao also needs to be powerful enough, but for you, this shouldn't be too difficult. It's just a matter of spending a bit more time."
Li Xuan nodded as he spoke.
"It's time to prepare for battle!"
Tian Zi said, his blood boiling with excitement.
Old Man Xiao and the others also departed, each with their blood boiling, ready to face the great battle. The return of Xu Yan meant that the Imperishable Temple's assault was not far off.
Although they knew that they could not contend with the Imperishable Temple with their own strength, with a Taoist Ancestor like Li Xuan present, they could certainly ensure the Great Wilderness remained unharmed. All they needed to do was give it their all and fight their own opponents. Moreover, this was also an opportunity to hone themselves and elevate their Heavenly Dao.
The Witch did not leave but instead respectfully bowed and said, "Witch pays respect to the Taoist Ancestor!"
Li Xuan toyed with the Jade Ruyi in his hand, which was originally a piece of ordinary fine jade gifted by Xu Yan, but it had now transformed into a Dao Instrument while being nurtured by his Dao Intent.
"If you have any doubts, feel free to ask!"
Li Xuan said with a warm smile.
This one of the Seven Great Domain Masters was still very powerful, among the top of the Master of Heaven and Earth level, and his own Qi of Heaven and Earth had not dissipated, meaning he still had significant potential.
"Many thanks to the Taoist Ancestor!"
Witch was overwhelmed with excitement and, after some thought, asked, "I, the Witch, was born with Spiritual Wisdom out of confusion, devouring the flesh and blood of True Spirits to grow stronger. Gradually, I explored the Cultivation Methods, able to continuously strengthen myself by absorbing the essence of True Spirit's flesh and blood and Origin.
"Before the opening of the Domain, I was already at the Master of Heaven and Earth level. When that purple light appeared, I received the Creation of the purple light and transformed myself, but it seemed as if my strength was starting from scratch in a brief time. The power cultivated was different from before the opening of the Domain.
"Undoubtedly it was stronger and seemed like it could continue to elevate indefinitely. Alas, the path of cultivation requires constant exploration, consuming time. Only before the great war did I have a clear understanding of the path ahead. Yet, after defeat in the great battle, I must start exploring from scratch again.
"My Domain is ultimately lost. Taicang previously gave me much guidance on my Path of Cultivation, as well as the method to open a Domain. In the great battle, Taicang's strength was far beyond what I could compare. I feel that Taicang might have already surpassed the Master of Heaven and Earth level at that time.
"Of course, Taicang said he did not break through above the Master of Heaven and Earth. Over the years, I pondered Taicang's strength back then, speculating that Taicang's Realm as Master of Heaven and Earth was different from ours. Just as the Domain Dao Rules of Taicang Domain differed significantly from our Domains.
"It's like Taicang Domain was a fully constructed and solid Domain, whereas our Domains had only the framework. May I ask, Senior, is there a qualitative difference between Domains, even among those at the Master of Heaven and Earth level?"
Hearing Witch's doubts, Li Xuan wasn't surprised. As his strength increased, especially after breaking through the Primordial Realm, he realized that though Taihao was a powerful Master of Heaven and Earth Realm, his Realm was different from other Masters of Heaven and Earth.
Taihao's Realm as a Master of Heaven and Earth was unique. Just by looking at the operation of the Heaven and Earth Laws and the Domain Dao Rules of Taihao Domain, one could see that Taihao's Domain was more perfected, with stronger Creation for all living beings. Although weaker than the Great Wilderness Heavenly Path, it was only second to the Heavenly Dao of Domain.
"Xu Yan has achieved Perfection in the Establishing Dao Realm and has the power to sweep through the Master of Heaven and Earth Realm, but that doesn't necessarily mean he is more powerful than Taihao was back then. Moreover, Taihao did eventually break through the Master of Heaven and Earth Realm, yet for some reasons, he was destined not to win.
"How does this Great Wilderness compare with Taihao? It is based on the Taihao Domain. And how does it compare with your Domain before?
"Different Domains possess different characteristics, and the paths of cultivation you and Taihao follow differ, which is inevitable. Even practitioners who follow the Dao travel different paths within the Great Dao."
Li Xuan said with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1128 - 582: In the Eyes of the Master, There Are No Strong Ones
chapters.content:
Practicing the Dao!
Witch once again heard this name and couldn't help but ask, "Taoist Ancestor, what does practicing the Dao mean?"
Li Xuan replied with a mysterious tone, "Practicing the Dao, practicing the Dao, is to follow the great Dao, to use the great Dao as the path. The great Dao is boundless, profound and yet more profound, inexpressible in simple words, beyond direct observation, dark and vast. Only those who are enlightened can walk its path. By practicing the Dao, one can transcend all earthly restraints. For you, this is far too remote."
"With enough strength and insight, one can comprehend and become enlightened to the great Dao."
Witch understood that practicing the Dao was still far too distant for him. He should focus on the present, to resolve his current perplexities.
Thus, he spoke respectfully, "Ancestor, my path forward seems deficient since the Domain has vanished. To cultivate as I did before seems lacking. I earnestly request your guidance."
Witch naturally knew how to cultivate. Although something was missing, it wasn't as if there was no path ahead. However, since he had the opportunity to consult such a high being, he naturally wanted to seize the chance for the Taoist Ancestor to enlighten him.
"The Domain is in your heart, the Domain is in your Dao. Cultivate your own Domain with your Dao, and that will suffice. Why be puzzled? If you are confused, you may reflect on the Heavenly Dao, use it as a reference, and cultivate your own path."
Li Xuan provided guidance.
Startled, Witch respectfully and excitedly bowed, "Thank you, Taoist Ancestor, for enlightening me!"
He knew now how to continue his cultivation. Besides, with the Great Wilderness Heavenly Path to reflect upon, he could gradually perfect his own path. What suits him is indeed the best.
Li Xuan smiled and nodded.
Xu Yan took out the Prime Tortoise Carapace, moved Qing Yu and a Yu Zhu plant appeared. In an instant, the courtyard was filled with a refreshing aura.
Tian Zi came to the courtyard again, and looking at Qing Yu's original form, she scratched her head, "Sister Qing Yu, why have you turned back into a bamboo?"
"Call me Aunt Qing Yu!"
Qing Yu corrected.
Tian Zi rolled her eyes, "Taicang is dead, you've no chance, I'm not calling you aunt."
Speaking of Taicang, Qing Yu became sad again, but then smiled lightly and said, "Even if Big Brother Taicang is no more, I'm still your elder."
Tian Zi murmured under her breath but did not deny Qing Yu's words.
"Qing Yu, greeting the Taoist Ancestor!"
The bamboo bowed as if to perform a ritual.
Li Xuan, lifting the Jade Ruyi, cast a glow on Qing Yu, saying, "To arrive here is also your good fortune."
Amidst the shimmering azure light, the Yu Zhu disappeared, to be replaced by a woman in a green dress, refined and beautiful. Su Lingxiu looked at her, blinking, as the aura surrounding Qing Yu was somewhat similar to hers, both brimming with vibrant life.
"Sister Qing Yu, you seem very suitable for cultivating the Alchemical Medical Dao."
Su Lingxiu couldn't help but speak.
Li Xuan nodded his head; indeed, Qing Yu was suitable for cultivating the Alchemical Medical Dao. Of course, her own path was already set, but still, there was no problem in studying medical techniques and learning alchemy.
"Thank you, Taoist Ancestor!"
Qing Yu thanked him excitedly.
"Mm."
Li Xuan nodded and said, "You all can catch up."
Tian Zi led Qing Yu and Witch away; with Qing Yu's return, naturally, it was time to catch up. Only Xu Yan, his five disciples, and Red Cat were left in the courtyard.
"Master, I've offended some powerful beings."
Xu Yan glanced at Ming Yu beside him and said, scratching his head.
"Oh, who are they?"
Li Xuan asked, nonchalantly.
"The Master of the Jade Court, the Unchanging Divine Master, and one of the Three Great True Spirit Kings, King Chi Ni. I killed its son, and now they might be hunting me. A large group of true spirits at Master of Heaven and Earth level are converging, probably all targeting me.
"Master, the Master of the Jade Court seems terrifying. Even with my Perfection of the Way, I have no chance at all."
Xu Yan sighed.
With his Perfection of the Way, he could sweep across all beings of Master of Heaven and Earth level. But that person from Yu Ting was far too powerful, making him feel as insignificant as an ant.
Meng Chong and the other three were shocked yet not surprised. Their eldest senior brother's brilliance couldn't be concealed; offending powerful beings was only too natural.
Li Xuan didn't speak but sipped his tea, causing Xu Yan to become somewhat anxious. Could it be that Master thought he was too prone to trouble?
"It's all trivial matters."
Finally, the Master spoke, and Xu Yan felt relieved.
"In the eyes of your master, there are no powerful beings."
Li Xuan continued.
Xu Yan was immediately thrilled; indeed, his master was the strongest. No matter how powerful others were, in his master's eyes, they couldn't even be called powerful.
"You've already achieved your Perfection of the Way, and the Creation Realm is near. After some tempering, you should break through. I will set out the rules for this matter. Bullying is not allowed. Whether it's the Unchanging Divine Master or the Master of the Jade Court, or even King Chi Ni, I will make them follow the rules.
"As for the rest, can you handle it with confidence?"
Li Xuan added.
"Master, your disciple is confident!"
Xu Yan responded excitedly upon hearing this.
This was a chance for him to temper himself given by his master. As long as beings like King Chi Ni didn't intervene, what was there for him to fear?
Besides the Unchanging Divine Master, the Imperishable Temple did have other powerful beings who surpassed the Master of Heaven and Earth level. Yet, Xu Yan was not afraid. Even if he couldn't defeat them, in a one-on-one scenario, he could protect himself.
After some tempering, to break through to the Creation Realm, he could fight gloriously once more!
"Confidence is good. I will set out the rules, and once the rules are established, it's up to you. Before the opening of the Next Era, whether you can withstand the impacts, you have comprehended Primordial, the Method of Practicing Dao, and should reflect on it properly. How to practice the Dao, find your own Method of Practicing the Dao."

chapters.title: Chapter 1129 - 582: In the Eyes of the Master, There Are No Strong Ones_2
chapters.content:
Li Xuan nodded and said,
"Yes, Master!"
Xu Yan said respectfully.
"The four of you have achieved minor accomplishment in Establishing Dao, but it's not enough. Today, as your master, I will guide you further so you can achieve great accomplishment in Establishing Dao quickly."
Li Xuan looked at Meng Chong and the others as he spoke.
Only with great accomplishment in Establishing Dao can one possess the strength to suppress those at the Master of Heaven and Earth level.
"Yes, Master!"
Meng Chong and the others said respectfully.
"Meow meow."
Red Cat trotted over, rubbing against Li Xuan's calf, gazing at him with eager eyes.
"Alright, you're not far from the Master of Heaven and Earth level. I'll instruct you, and how much you can gain will depend on you."
Li Xuan ruffled the chubby head of Red Cat.
Red Cat, thrilled, nestled its chubby head against Li Xuan's calf, acting adorable.
Xu Yan and the others were speechless. This Great Demon King, Red Cat, now really regarded itself as a chubby, adorable kitten!
With a wave of his hand, Li Xuan unfolded the Daoist Golden Book. Golden light shrouded the area, revealing the sceneries of Establishing Dao, Creation, Primordial, and Practicing Dao. Also showcased was the Martial Arts of the five, along with Red Cat's Great Demon Method.
The current Li Xuan no longer needed to pass on teachings orally or compile Cultivation Techniques. He used the Daoist Golden Book to directly present Martial Arts, showing the process of Martial Arts Cultivation, for a more intuitive comprehension.
Xu Yan focused on comprehending Practicing Dao, entering a state of deep contemplation, with scenes of Practicing Dao continuously emerging, as though an invisible Dao appeared in his mind.
He seemed to be on the verge of grasping the Method of Practicing Dao yet always fell slightly short.
Meng Chong and the others were also immersed, contemplating their own Martial Arts.
Red Cat lay on the ground, demonic aura roiling, its aura changing. It was becoming more clear about the Great Demon Method, and it was on the verge of a breakthrough.
After instructing his disciples, Li Xuan put away the Daoist Golden Book and glanced at Ming Yu, who was still receiving enlightenment from the past and understanding oneself, then he looked outside the courtyard at Blood Extreme.
"Interesting, how did the Master of the Jade Court manage to gain such great fortune? It must be related to Taihao."
Looking up at the Land of Imperishable, more and more Heaven and Earth Lord-Level True Spirits gathered, but the True Spirits were gradually dividing into three factions, indicating that the Three Great True Spirit Kings were all coming to the Great Wilderness.
In addition, numerous Jade Puppets appeared, each at the Master of Heaven and Earth level. However, these puppets did not immediately come to the Great Wilderness but stood still somewhere, waiting for the descent of the Jade Court.
Then, the Master of Heaven and Earth level powerhouses from the Imperishable Temple also emerged one by one.
"The changing of the eras is becoming more and more apparent, the Next Era is not far off."
Li Xuan wore an expectant look.
With the arrival of the Next Era, once that beam of light appeared, he should break through Practicing Dao. Once he entered Practicing Dao, he could transcend the Land of Chaotic Imperishable and visit the Taihao Thirty-Three Heavens.
"Truly about to be invincibly lonely."
Li Xuan sighed. Now, he was already invincibly lonely, and it was hard to imagine just how powerful, how invincibly lonely he would be after Practicing Dao.
As time passed, the opening of the Next Era drew closer, and all the powerhouses of the Great Wilderness were preparing for the upcoming battle.
Meng Chong, Su Lingxiu, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping finally achieved Establishing Dao Great Accomplishment, and although Xu Yan had not yet broken through the Creation Realm, he also took half a step, vaguely grasping the intention of Creation.
The Creation of Heaven and Earth, after all, could not be completed overnight. It could not be broken through in a short period. It required time to hone, constant contemplation of the intention of Creation.
But the Creation Realm was, after all, not far away.
Xu Yan was reuniting with his parents, guiding Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao in their cultivation. Meng Chong was also instructing Zi Yun in her cultivation; Su Lingxiu was refining pills, even those that could rapidly restore the Master of Heaven and Earth. Fang Hao continued to set up the Great Formation.
In the Great Wilderness Domain, there were others who broke through to the Heavenly Domain before the great battle, namely Jiang Feng and Cang Lie, raising the standing of the Heavenly Dao once again.
Roar!
A terrifying roar faintly echoed from the Land of Imperishable, and though the sound was no longer strong, the fact that it traveled from the extremely distant Land of Imperishable indicated monstrous strength, beyond what a Master of Domain-level True Spirit could achieve.
"Is that one of the Three Great True Spirit Kings, King Chi Ni? Indeed, it's not weak."
Li Xuan looked up towards the outside of the Land of Imperishable; King Chi Ni had already appeared, surrounded by numerous Master of Domain-level True Spirits, all prostrating on the ground.
As King Chi Ni's gaze turned toward the Great Wilderness, ready to attack, it suddenly halted in its tracks.
The Jade Court had appeared.
"The Jade Court, interesting. It looks like my guess was correct."
Upon seeing the Jade Court, Li Xuan's face broke into a smile.
"In terms of strength, the Jade Court is more powerful than King Chi Ni."
"Is that the Gargantuan Gluttonous King?"
Li Xuan saw another powerful True Spirit, which was chewing on a True Spirit itself—one of the Three Great True Spirit Kings, the Gargantuan Gluttonous King.
"That dragon, is it Ao Hong?"
Li Xuan saw a pale azure True Dragon heading towards the Great Wilderness; behind it was a huge mountain with a black and red dragon-shaped True Spirit coiled upon it.
One of the Three Great True Spirit Kings, the Black Chi King.
"This Black Chi King is the strongest and also the most ancient. It has a certain connection with the Land of Imperishable and may be one of the first batch of True Spirits born there. Moreover, it is the only one that has survived to this day."
Li Xuan was a bit surprised upon seeing the Black Chi King.
The Black Chi King was highly formidable, the oldest living, and its being bore the sediment of the lengthy years, revealing a connection to the Land of Imperishable.
"Interesting, the first batch of True Spirits born from the Land of Imperishable was inevitably formidable. The Black Chi King, in particular, is remarkable. It is likely the first to develop Spiritual Wisdom, and the first thing it did after gaining wisdom was to hunt down the other True Spirits, devouring them all and assimilating their origin, also usurping the special connection that the first batch of True Spirits should have had with the Land of Imperishable."
The Black Chi King was a truly ancient True Spirit and the most powerful one. As for why it allowed the Gargantuan Gluttonous King and King Chi Ni to exist and did not devour them at the dawn of their spiritual awakening, it was about maintaining a certain balance. If the Land of Imperishable had only one spiritually awakened True Spirit, it would face restrictions from the rules of the Land of Imperishable.
"Ao Hong shares its bloodline, but after initiating the Domain, becoming a Domain True Spirit, that bloodline connection was severed, which makes it rather interesting now. Ao Hong's awakening to spiritual wisdom is probably related to the Black Chi King."
Li Xuan found this more and more fascinating.
He glanced up at Qing Yu; this bamboo's awakening to spiritual wisdom could not be separated from the Jade Court.
"The Black Chi King and the Jade Court have enabled Ao Hong and Qing Yu to awaken to spiritual wisdom, which suggests they have noticed some sort of change in the Land of Imperishable, or perhaps, some special condition has arisen in the Taihao Realm?"
Li Xuan mused.
With the Three Great True Spirit Kings and the Jade Court present, only the Imperishable Temple had yet to appear. Li Xuan was very curious how the Unchanging Divine Master would handle it if the Jade Court and the Three Great True Spirit Kings were to intervene.
"They all know the Unchanging Divine Master's schemes; they may also want to see if they can succeed, if they can gain something from it. The Black Chi King and the Jade Court, do they want to see if something has happened in Taihao?"
Li Xuan suddenly became curious.
Ao Hong was approaching the Great Wilderness, but King Chi Ni turned its gaze on him, its aura sharp and formidable, making him shudder all over; in an instant, it felt like a massive mountain was pressing down on him.
"So powerful!"
Ao Hong's heart was chilled.
"The death of my son cannot escape your involvement; join him in burial," King Chi Ni said coldly.
"Chi Ni, I've never tasted this kind of True Spirit, give it to me, I want to taste!"
The Gargantuan Gluttonous King looked voracious.
Ao Hong was almost sweating profusely, turning his head with difficulty towards the Black Chi King, seeking rescue with his eyes. Now, only the Black Chi King could save him, but he worried whether the Black Chi King would confront King Chi Ni and the Gargantuan Gluttonous King for his sake.
"Enough!"
At that moment, the Black Chi King raised its head, looking at King Chi Ni and the Gargantuan Gluttonous King. Its voice was indifferent, then it said, "Don't you think he resembles me? As for your son's death, seek out the killer. And you, don't you want to taste me too?"
Following the Black Chi King's words, the Gargantuan Gluttonous King immediately shut its mouth. "Not tasting, not tasting anymore."

chapters.title: Chapter 1130 - 583: The Unchanging Divine Master Appears, Ao Hong Pays Respect to the Ancestor
chapters.content:
Gargantuan Gluttonous King seemed to be quite wary of Black Chi King, his mouth tightly shut as he no longer looked towards Ao Hong.
King Chi Ni's eyes widened as he glared at Black Chi King, his voice deep and imposing, "The death of my son relates to him, how can we let this go!"
Black Chi King lifted his head slightly, his demeanor condescending as he looked down upon King Chi Ni, "Your son imprisoned him, cut his flesh to eat, don't you think you owe an explanation too?"
King Chi Ni's mane around his neck shook, resembling flames burning, as he slowly stood up, his aura immensely powerful. "Is he your son? Clearly not, I did not sense any blood relation with you, Black Chi, are you overstepping your bounds?"
Black Chi King sneered, "Blood relation? He opened up Heaven and Earth, became a Domain True Spirit, naturally the blood connection was severed, but that does not deny that he is my descendant."
Then, Black Chi King lifted his head slightly higher, revealing half of his body, looking down upon King Chi Ni, "If you dispute this, feel free to try!"
At that moment, both True Spirit Kings were on the brink of conflict, ready to unleash a battle at any second. The surrounding True Spirits all prostrated themselves on the ground, trembling in fear, with the more timorous even wetting themselves.
Gargantuan Gluttonous King slowly moved backward, making space while indicating his non-involvement.
Yu Ting, along with a group of Jade Puppets, also retreated a distance back, eager to watch the potential conflict unfold.
At this moment, the mountainous burden on Ao Hong had disappeared. He breathed a sigh of relief, hastily heading towards the Great Wilderness. As for whether Black Chi King and King Chi Ni would go to war, he didn't care. Since Black Chi King was willing to intervene on his behalf, it meant Black Chi King was not afraid of King Chi Ni in the slightest.
"Fine, fine, then let's try it!"
King Chi Ni roared in anger.
Boom!
Auras erupted, terrifying power stirred up a storm. On the Land of Imperishable, one could see a powerful fluctuation rippling outwards.
On the big mountains arranged by the Imperishable Temple at the periphery, all the powerful beings of the Imperishable Temple's faces changed instantly. Such powerful fluctuations were not something they could resist; they might even destroy the mountains or shift their arranged positions.
And if the two True Spirit Kings went to war, the aftershocks would certainly destroy these arrangements!
Just then, a temple descended.
Whoosh!
Simultaneously, a shadowy figure appeared, a powerful aura swirling about him, albeit with a sinister and terrifying air.
"Divine Master!"
All the strong ones from the Imperishable Temple sighed in relief, quickly bowing respectfully.
"Black Chi King, King Chi Ni, take your fight away from here."
The Unchanging Divine Master spoke indifferently.
King Chi Ni's eyes suddenly flickered with wariness, "Black Chi King, let's drop this matter, but the one who killed my son, I must kill him. If you interfere again, don't blame me for not showing mercy!"
Black Chi King's head lowered as he continued to lay on the mountain peak, speaking indifferently: "The person you want to kill has nothing to do with me. As long as you don't kill my descendants, I naturally won't intervene."
His gaze shifted towards the Unchanging Divine Master, his eyes reflecting contemplation.
King Chi Ni sharply turned towards the Great Wilderness, coldly stating, "The murderer of my son is in this Domain, and I must root him out, no one is to stop me!"
With that, he took a step towards the Great Wilderness.
The Unchanging Divine Master's figure blocked his path, "King Chi Ni, the time is not right, why the haste?"
"Are you going to stop me?"
King Chi Ni was furious.
The Unchanging Divine Master remained calm, "No, just that the time is not right. If you, King Chi Ni, charge into the Domain now, it will disrupt some of my arrangements. Surely you wouldn't want my arrangements to fail, right? Just as we had earlier agreed, your enemy will not survive for long."
"My patience is limited. I will abstain from acting for now, but once the time comes, I will surely avenge my son!"
King Chi Ni snorted coldly.
"Rest assured, the time will soon come."
The Unchanging Divine Master spoke calmly.
Then, he turned to Black Chi King, his gaze lingering slightly on him, spoke softly: "Black Chi King, I will not kill your descendant, nor will I take his Qi of Heaven and Earth, but you must not intervene. Taihao Divine Object must not be coveted, how about that?"
Black Chi King pondered for a moment, then nodded, saying, "I just came to see if you could succeed."
"That's best."
The Unchanging Divine Master then looked at Gargantuan Gluttonous King, who spoke before being addressed, "I'm here for the excitement, and I want to taste what the beings of Heaven and Earth taste like. Give me some to try, and we're good."
The Unchanging Divine Master nodded and said no more.
Then, he looked towards Yu Ting, the sinister aura becoming even colder.
"What will Yu Ting do?"
Three Jade Persons emerged from Yu Ting. Unlike the Jade Puppets, which often suffered from slow thought processes, these three were indistinguishable from ordinary people.
The one in the middle spoke, "Take back the people of my Yu Ting. We will not interfere with your temple's matters, but you also must not covet the people of Yu Ting."
The Unchanging Divine Master appeared contemplative before asking after a while, "What connection does that Taihao Divine Object have with your people of Yu Ting?"
"That belongs to her!"
The Unchanging Divine Master's aura fluctuated slightly, his voice grave: "The Taihao Divine Object is too important to me. Moreover, since she left Yu Ting, she obviously had her reasons. I will try to persuade her to surrender the Taihao Divine Object to complete this plan. She will probably agree. If so, you must not interfere!"
Toward the end, the Unchanging Divine Master's gaze grew sharp.
"You won't convince her. I must take Ming Yu back to Yu Ting. Whether your plan succeeds is your concern. As for the Taihao Divine Object..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1131 - 583: The Unchanging Divine Master Appears, Ao Hong Pays Respect to the Ancestor_2
chapters.content:
Yu Ting hesitated for a moment, "See Ming Yu first, then decide."
The Unchanging Divine Master stared at Yu Ting for a long time, "The person, I might let be, but the Taihao Divine Object, I am determined to have. If Yu Ting is unwilling, we can test our true skill; my patience is limited!"
"I, Yu Ting, do not succumb to threats, even from a madman. The Taihao Divine Object may not even be useful; think as you wish."
Yu Ting smiled calmly.
"You obviously know what that Taihao Divine Object is, so speak."
The Unchanging Divine Master pondered for a moment and asked.
"The Exquisite Jade Token!"
"It's her!"
The Unchanging Divine Master's face was filled with surprise.
The Great Wilderness.
Li Xuan watched with great interest; King Chi Ni and Black Chi King's battle was about to erupt. The Imperishable Temple descended; seeing the Unchanging Divine Master at that moment, he couldn't help but be surprised.
"This is the Unchanging Divine Master who devoured the Hong Ze Domain."
The shadow-like Unchanging Divine Master was undoubtedly strong, not inferior to King Chi Ni. However, what surprised Li Xuan was not the Unchanging Divine Master's power, but the temple.
"I underestimated the Unchanging Divine Master a bit. No wonder he's full of confidence, unafraid of the Three Great True Spirit Kings or Yu Ting. However, he seems to lack understanding of Black Chi King and Yu Ting, which is why he's so confident. If Black Chi King and Yu Ting decide to interfere, he wouldn't be able to hold them back."
Li Xuan smiled playfully; Black Chi King and Yu Ting were definitely the most deeply hidden old figures and also the oldest existences, with extremely extraordinary origins.
"The Unchanging Divine Master is indeed extraordinary; no wonder he's famed as 'Undying,' truly remarkable. Even Taicang, if not dead from before, would require considerable time to surpass him."
The shadow-like Unchanging Divine Master was not his real body; the true Unchanging Divine Master remained inside the temple, yet to appear. Although Li Xuan's gaze couldn't penetrate the temple to see the master's real form, it still couldn't hide from him.
"The current power of the Great Wilderness, given the present Heavenly Dao, wouldn't avoid being devoured and sacrificed, but since this Daoist Ancestor is here, I cannot let you fulfill your desires. The regulations of this Daoist Ancestor are not ones you can violate."
Li Xuan muttered internally.
It was about time to show a bit of the Daoist Ancestor's might, set some rules, requiring these powerhouses to abide, suppressing their dissent!
"We'll see who will become the target for the Daoist Ancestor to establish the rules and authority."
To set rules and suppress the powerful into compliance naturally required showcasing the strength of rule-setting, and for establishing authority, Li Xuan targeted the shadow form of the Unchanging Divine Master.
Ao Hong gazed upon the Great Wilderness, sighing internally at the substantial changes, never imagining that the Taicang Domain had grown so enormously.
"Ao Hong!"
The figure of the Witch Demon appeared outside the Domain.
"Witch Demon!"
Ao Hong transformed into human shape, looking at the Witch Demon in great emotion.
"Ao Hong, you've come too!"
Qing Yu also appeared.
"Qing Yu, you have recovered!"
When the three met, they were filled with a myriad of emotions. Of the Seven Great Domain Masters, only the three of them were left, and their eldest brother Taicang had long since fallen.
As for the Netherworld, it was no longer a Master of the Domain, nor could it return to gather with them.
In the Land of Imperishable, on a great mountain, the Netherworld gazed upon Ao Hong's figure, with a complex and emotional expression, eyes filled with a hint of melancholy.
"Eldest brother!"
The Blood Demon opened his mouth but didn't know how to comfort.
"Fate brings together and separates, such is life, the choice between life and death has been made, no need for regret. You don't need to console me; this is my own choice. When the Next Era begins, when that light appears, remember to seize it, for it is an opportunity."
The Netherworld spoke calmly.
"Eldest brother, do you have something to do?"
The Blood Demon asked in a deep voice.
"Perhaps, but it's uncertain!"
The Netherworld replied ambiguously.
"Eldest brother, the one within the Great Wilderness Domain, his strength is unclear; we may not need to take risks."
The Blood Demon thought for a moment and said.
"The Three Great True Spirit Kings, plus Yu Ting and the Divine Master, what do you think?"
The Netherworld shook his head as he spoke.
The Blood Demon opened his mouth then fell silent.
Even though the one in the Great Wilderness was as powerful as a Divine Master, this time, it was not just the Divine Master alone, but all the Three Great True Spirit Kings and Yu Ting. It seemed they all wanted to see the Divine Master's plan and might not hesitate to assist if needed.
Xu Yan had offended both Yu Ting and King Chi Ni, and those two were bound to act.
"It's about to start."
The Netherworld suddenly spoke.
The mountain seemed to be pulled by an unseen force, slowly moving towards the Great Wilderness Domain, while the converging True Spirits also began to steadily advance towards the Great Wilderness.
In the Great Wilderness, Ao Hong's return naturally led to a reunion of old friends, each filled with nostalgia and emotion.
"Father!"
Ao Lie was filled with excitement, seeing his father was still alive.
"It's Lie'er!"
Ao Hong was somewhat surprised, as Ao Lie's power was quite strong, nearly equaling his own, yet not quite a Master of the Domain—the aura was rather unusual.
"What's this?"
"Father, I have broken through to the Heavenly Domain, forging a new path; I am a Heavenly Path True Dragon."
Ao Lie spoke excitedly.
Then, as if realizing something, he became both excited and animated, "Father, I've found the old ancestor, come quickly to pay respects to the ancestor!"
"What?"
Ao Hong was bewildered, looking beyond the Domain. If speaking of an ancestor, it would surely be the Black Chi King.
"When did you meet the Black Chi King ancestor? He resides in the Land of Imperishable, you want to go..."
"Father, wrong, wrong, the Black Chi King is not the true ancestor. The one I found is the true ancestor of our True Dragon Clan!"
Ao Lie spoke solemnly.
Ao Hong was utterly baffled, a true ancestor?
The origin of the True Dragon Clan started with him, and he was originally a descendant of the Black Chi King, so if speaking of an ancestor, it naturally would be the Black Chi King. How is there now a true ancestor?
"What's going on? There's no true ancestor, the True Dragon Clan..."
Ao Hong frowned as he spoke.
"Father, you don't understand; how can you comprehend the might of the True Dragon Clan, or know the supremacy of the True Dragon Clan ancestor? Hurry and pay respects to the ancestor; it's without error, seeking the ancestor's protection!"
Ao Lie, without further ado, dragged Ao Hong to the outside of Li Xuan's courtyard.
Li Xuan's mouth twitched; Ao Lie, this little dragon, truly cunning, directly pulling his father to recognize him as the ancestor, indeed knows how to seek a powerful backer!
"Ao Lie pays respect to the ancestor, greets the ancestor!"
Ao Lie knelt with a thud, courteously kowtowing.
Ao Hong felt all out of sorts, this brat didn't kneel to his own father, but now kneels to some ancestor?
Doesn't the True Dragon Clan have an ancestor; isn't this clearer to your father than you?
"Father, kneel, quick! Pay respect to the ancestor!"
Ao Lie was a bit anxious, thinking his father was unbearably obstinate, not knowing how to seek powerful backing!
"No, Lie'er, let me tell you..."
Ao Hong's face turned black; if not for Ao Lie's increased strength—unable to suppress him with one hand—he would restrain him and give him a severe beating.
"Father, quickly greet the ancestor, how unfilial you are!"
Ao Lie said displeased as he tugged his sleeve.
Damn it!
It's you, this rebellious son, who is unfilial!
Ao Hong's face turned green with anger, just about to become furious and teach this rebellious son a lesson, when suddenly he heard Witch Demon's voice.
He froze, and in the moment of that distraction, was pulled down by Ao Lie, kneeling with a thud.
"Please, ancestor, forgive my father's disrespect; he suffered torment from enemies, his mind has more or less been impaired, slow to react, I hope ancestor will understand!"
Ao Lie spoke respectfully.
Ao Hong opened his mouth but didn't know what to say for a moment, still startled by Witch Demon's words, not having fully recovered.
Suddenly!
A Nine-Clawed Purple-Golden Dragon suddenly appeared, looking down from above.
At that moment, Ao Hong's heart skipped a beat, feeling thoroughly suppressed; whether in lineage or Divine Soul, a sense of reverence and trembling arose.
"Pay respect to the ancestor!"
Ao Lie kowtowed even more diligently.
Ao Hong was shocked beyond measure, wondering if this was indeed the ancestor of the True Dragon Clan. Compared to the Black Chi King, this Nine-Clawed Purple-Golden Dragon truly resembled the ancestor of the True Dragon Clan!
Moreover, the divine might was extraordinary, the aura unfathomable, clearly stronger and more awe-inspiring than the Black Chi King!
"Thud!"
Ao Hong lowered his head, kowtowing to the ground.
"Ao Hong, pays respect to the ancestor!"
Finally understanding, with such an ancestor, who wouldn't show reverence, especially amidst such surrounding crises.

chapters.title: Chapter 1132 - 584 Arrangement Complete, About to Make a Move
chapters.content:
```
"Ao Hong paid his respects to the Ancestor, 'The Ancestor's divine might is invincible, eternal and immortal, the Ancestor's brilliance shines upon the Chaotic Imperishable, the Domain is honored by the Ancestor's presence...'"
Ao Hong kowtowed with a series of compliments flowing from his mouth.
Ao Lie suddenly raised his head and looked at his father, somewhat dumbfounded.
Slap!
Ao Hong slapped Ao Lie's head, pressing it to the ground, scolding, "You unfilial son, how dare you look around while paying respects to the Ancestor!"
Ao Lie was utterly discomposed!
Ao Yuxue heard her great-grandfather had returned and excitedly prepared to meet the great-grandfather she had never seen, but upon seeing him, she realized he was even more shameless than her grandfather, and couldn't help but cover her face; it was so embarrassing for the True Dragon Clan!
Where had the face of our True Dragon Clan gone?
Li Xuan finally understood why Ao Lie's skin was so thick, why he was so adept at flattering, and why he paid respects to the Ancestor without hesitation, respectfully and sincerely. It all made sense, it was like father like son, truly a family tradition!
Even the Witch Demons in the distance were in turmoil, never expecting that their old friend Ao Hong could be so shameless!
"Rise!"
The Nine-Clawed Purple-Golden Dragon spoke, then its dragon claw tapped once, a purple light entered Ao Hong's body, and it disappeared from the spot.
Ao Hong trembled all over and immediately felt thrilled; it was instructing him on how to continue advancing, how to forge ahead, and there was a powerful force protecting him.
The might of divinity and the majestic force of Dragon Might were unimaginably strong; Ao Hong felt that if he triggered this force, he could even casually swat away the Black Chi King.
"Ao Hong thanks the Ancestor for the gift, the Ancestor's divine might is invincible, the first of all ages..."
A string of compliments followed frantically.
Ao Lie felt a bit embarrassed listening to it, inwardly sighing that he was still no match for his father!
"You unfilial son, why are you in a daze, hurry up and thank the Ancestor!"
Ao Hong slapped his head again, scolding.
Ao Lie: ...
After Ao Hong and Ao Lie left, the courtyard returned to tranquility, Muxiao continued to sweep the ground slowly with a broom, for him, this was his cultivation.
The Azure Sea Turtle remained in the pond, the energy within it undulating, slowly rising as it was about to step into the Heavenly Domain, to become a Heavenly Domain-level Azure Sea Turtle.
"It's about to begin!"
Li Xuan looked up towards the Land of Imperishable, at this moment those towering mountains were linked in their aura, forming a pattern that seemed like a Great Formation, and it had already been triggered.
Under the guidance of the nine giant mountains, those towering mountains were slowly approaching, drawing near the Great Wilderness Domain. As the mountains moved closer, a certain power fluctuation formed and was rippling through.
The Great Wilderness seemed to be in a cage.
The nine giant mountains were also moving slowly, approaching the Great Wilderness, though at a slower pace, the resulting waves were even more intense.
Boom!
The sound of rumbling erupted outside the Domain, the faint rumbling sound reached them, but at that moment, those stronger than the Realm Master in the Great Wilderness felt the sign of an impending storm.
The Heavenly Dao Rules unfolded the Majesty of the Heavenly Path, dispelling the waves outside the Domain, from the perspective of the Land of Imperishable, the Great Wilderness was radiating brilliance, and an enormous force had formed a barrier.
"Divine Master, the Taicang Domain seems unusual, the changes are too great, didn't Muxiao enter Taicang?"
Dousan looked towards the Great Wilderness Domain, frowning as he spoke.
The Unchanging Divine Master said nothing, staring at the Great Wilderness for a long while, being like a shadow, his expression was unreadable, and no one knew what he was thinking.
"Divine Master, should I investigate?"
Dousan spoke respectfully again.
"The stronger the Domain, the better; what one fears most is a weak Domain, which is insufficient to complete the plan. Whether Muxiao succeeds or fails doesn't matter; letting Muxiao enter the Domain was merely to lay the groundwork early, to boost the Qi of Domain as much as possible.
"As it turns out, it's not needed at all; this Domain is strong, much stronger than before. Taicang's methods are quite adept, but thinking this alone could protect this Domain is perhaps too naive."
The Unchanging Divine Master spoke indifferently.
The mountains continued to descend, the aura connecting, setting off a wave of fluctuations, slowly approaching the Great Wilderness, though it would take some time to completely form the cage, to encase the Great Wilderness at its core, and at the commencement of the Next Era, extract the Qi of Domain in an instant to complete the arrangement.
Dousan pondered for a while, then said, "Divine Master, could there be a problem with the Netherworld brothers? Should I replace them?"
"No need!"
The Unchanging Divine Master looked at the mountain where the Netherworld brothers were located and said, "It doesn't impact the plan; whatever the Netherworld wishes to do is insignificant."
"Divine Master, I discovered that the Netherworld seems to have hidden Qi of Domain, it appears to be secretly hoarded from the Netherworld Domain; although he used a secret technique to conceal it, I accidentally discovered it."
Dousan continued to report.
The Unchanging Divine Master pondered for a bit, then said, "You go to the Divine Temple to take charge, take action when necessary, ignore other tasks."
Hearing this, Dousan was secretly pleased, and respectfully said, "Yes, Divine Master!"
He then returned to the Divine Temple, his gaze resting on the peak where the Netherworld brothers were, a flash of killing intent passing through his eyes.
"Taicang, I hope it won't come to using you."
The Divine Master thought quietly.
In the Great Wilderness, all the strong were preparing for the impending battle, and as time progressed, the fluctuations outside the Domain grew increasingly fierce and formed an encircling trend.
Until, within the Domain, those nine giant mountains were visible, emitting a powerful aura, and certain rules enclosed and locked down this Domain.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1133 - 584 Arrangement Complete, About to Make a Move_2
chapters.content:
"""
At this moment, the Great Wilderness seemed imprisoned, as the Heavenly Dao Rules emerged to defend against the incoming vibrations. Looking up, it was as if two waves of water were colliding with each other.
Xu Yan had returned from Canglan Island and saw that Ming Yu still hadn't woken up. Yet, the aura of the Taihao Divine Object on her body grew increasingly intense, making her seem more like a living person.
It seemed she was transforming from a Jade Puppet into a true living being.
"It's about time to make a move!" Xu Yan murmured to himself.
Outside the Domain, Tian Zi's figure appeared. Looking at the nine great mountains, he frowned slightly, "What Formation is this?"
Fang Hao appeared by his side, shaking his head, saying, "This doesn't quite count as a Formation; though it has some capabilities of a Formation, it's rather crude. It's probably because the Unchanging Divine Master doesn't understand Formations."
"However, these arrangements of his, although crude, are not simple. For instance, these great mountains are unusual, containing a variety of True Spirit Origin powers, infused with the Qi of the Domain."
"In my observation, these arrangements are intended to, at the final moment, take the Great Wilderness as the core, instantly extract the Qi of the Great Wilderness Domain, and swallow the entire Domain, transforming it into a single force to achieve some purpose, though it's unclear what that purpose is."
The figure of the Witch Demon appeared, looking extremely solemn, and said, "Should we intervene now to stop it? Otherwise, if the arrangements are completed and really activated, will unexpected things happen in the Great Wilderness?"
Fang Hao chuckled lightly and said, "My Qimen Martial Art was passed down from my master. In terms of the Formation Path, who in the world could surpass my master? The Unchanging Divine Master's crude arrangements are nothing but child's play in my master's eyes. Since my master has set the rules, no one can defy them!"
The Witch Demon felt it made sense upon hearing this. Since even the Daoist Ancestor was indifferent, it was apparent that these arrangements could be easily dissolved, ensuring the Great Wilderness wouldn't be harmed.
"My invincible old ancestor has yet to act. How can we withstand so many strong entities, with Domain Lord-Level True Spirits numbering at least in the hundreds, along with the mighty ones from Yu Ting and the Divine Temple? How many people do we have in the Great Wilderness?" Ao Hong also came outside the Domain, speaking with a heavy expression.
The Witch Demon and others all looked peculiarly at Ao Hong. When it came to flattery, no one could match him. Once he opened his mouth, he was already flattering his ancestor, not caring about any appearances.
Ao Lie looked on with admiration, realizing he was still too young compared to his father.
The strong ones from the Great Wilderness arrived one after another, each showing an extremely serious expression, for the great battle was soon to erupt. Although they had left a strand of their Divine Soul in the Great Wilderness, allowing them to reincarnate if their Divine Soul perished and come back stronger after reforging.
Yet, ultimately, there were uncertain factors, and unless absolutely necessary, none actually wished to reincarnate and start over; rather, to grow stronger from their current state.
Buzz!
The nine great mountains were gradually closing in, waves rippling out, colliding with the Heavenly Dao Rules, stirring small storms within the Land of Imperishable.
Until, when the peaks behind the nine mountains came into view, the entire arrangement was almost complete, and the Great Wilderness Domain had been entirely encircled in the center, becoming the core of the arrangement.
The Divine Temple, Yu Ting, and the Three Great True Spirit Kings all appeared in sight.
A shadow-like figure emerged, eerie and terrifying, its aura frightening. Seeing this figure, the Witch Demon and Ao Hong were both extremely solemn. Even after so many years had passed, seeing this figure still made them feel like a mountain pressed on their chest.
"So strong!" Tian Zi said with a heavy expression.
"How long will it take you to reach the power of the Unchanging Divine Master?" the Witch Demon asked curiously.
"I don't know!" Tian Zi shook his head and then added, "The rise in Heavenly Dao cannot be accurately estimated. It may happen faster, or it may be slower."
He then looked towards these nine great mountains, speaking in a serious tone, "The strong entities on those mountains, their power has surpassed the Master of Domain level. Did they appear in the battle back then?"
Both the Witch Demon and Ao Hong shook their heads, sighing, "If these nine individuals had attacked back then, we wouldn't have had even a slightest chance to escape."
"Did they attack us back then to create these great mountains?"
Qing Yu's expression was extremely cold, eyes full of hatred.
"Leaving the Taicang Domain untouched back then was to wait for this moment, to wait for the Next Era to begin, while other Domains were used to create these great mountains, as the production needed time. Perhaps after the war back then, something happened, so remnants of my Witch Demon Domain and Netherworld Domain remained."
The Witch Demon nodded in agreement.
On this side of the Great Wilderness, Tian Zi and others looked at the nine great mountains and those like the Unchanging Divine Master, while the Unchanging Divine Master and others also gazed towards the Great Wilderness Domain and Tian Zi and his group.
The Unchanging Divine Master stared at the Great Wilderness Domain for a long time, saying nothing, lost in thought.
The King Chi Ni spoke, "This Domain is somewhat different from my expectations. That rule's power isn't simple, and there are many Domain beings with acceptable power."
Looking at the Unchanging Divine Master, he asked curiously, "Are the other six Domains like this too?"
"The present Domain is no longer the Taicang Domain of the past. It has changed a lot; the Domain rules are different too. I am wondering if this is Taicang's contingency plan, but could Taicang really leave such a setup? If not by Taicang, who else could have managed this?"
The Unchanging Divine Master spoke in a deep voice.
"Do you suspect there's another strong one involved?" King Chi Ni was astounded.
"Not certain." The Unchanging Divine Master shook his head and said, "Creating a Domain within the Chaotic Imperishable, Taicang was the first. In terms of understanding the Domain and how to grow and develop it, I think no one can surpass him. If not by Taicang, who else could do it?"
Saying this, he turned his gaze to the three masters of Yu Ting, "Could Yu Ting accomplish it? After the war, our Divine Temple has always watched Yu Ting, yet they never had the opportunity to do it unnoticed."
"Our understanding of the Domain is not as good as your Divine Temple. If your Divine Temple couldn't do it, we certainly couldn't. You needn't suspect Yu Ting."
One of Yu Ting's masters chuckled and shook his head.
The Unchanging Divine Master moved his gaze, next looking at the Black Chi King, then shifted it again, speaking in a grave tone, "As far as I know, Taicang should not have such a powerful contingency. And the one linked with the Domain rules, having a connection with Taicang, should still be a contingency left by Taicang."
At this, the Unchanging Divine Master paused, then continued in a heavy voice, "If it was indeed not by Taicang and was done by another strong one, where does he come from, and what is his power?"
Hearing this, Yu Ting, the King Chi Ni, the Black Chi King, and the Gargantuan Gluttonous King were all stunned. If indeed it was another strong one, as the Unchanging Divine Master mentioned, where did he originate?
How many ages has he existed for, and why were they never aware?
"No matter if it's a contingency left by Taicang or another strong one, it doesn't change the outcome. No one can stop me. Whoever stands in my way, shall die!"
The Unchanging Divine Master said with a murderous intent.
The great mountains continued approaching the Great Wilderness Domain, while the sensation of time altering within the Land of Imperishable grew ever more intense, as the opening of the Next Era drew nearer and nearer.
Thud!
At a certain moment, the nine great mountains, along with the peaks behind them, reached their designated positions, forming intertwined energies. The True Spirit Origins within the mountains resonated with each other, establishing some sort of rule. Waves surged forth, with the Great Wilderness Domain at the rule's core.
It seemed that, at the next moment, the rule would trigger, swallowing the Great Wilderness Domain and incorporating it into this rule.
