This part of the Land of Imperishable rippled visibly, like ripples in a lake, as the power of the Heavenly Dao Rules in the Great Wilderness Domain also undulated, making the Domain seem as if it were trapped in waves.
"How much longer will it be? I can hardly hold back. I want to avenge my child!" the King Chi Ni urged impatiently.
"King Chi Ni, no need to fret, it will happen soon. We're about to make our move!" The Unchanging Divine Master stared at the Domain, his voice carrying a hint of excitement as the long-awaited setups were finally about to yield results.
"We're about to make our move. Now the Domain is within the Formation. Once initiated, the Domain will be devoured and transformed into a vast Qi of Domain, enhancing the rule's force of the Great Formation." Fang Hao spoke solemnly, in a deep voice.
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 1134 - 585 Taoist Ancestor Establishes a Rule Today
chapters.content:
Sure, here is the translation of the text you provided:
Everyone couldn't help but feel a chill in their hearts upon hearing this. At this moment, the Great Wilderness Domain truly seemed to be trapped in a cage, as if life and death were no longer in control. However, the thought of the Daoist Ancestor brought them calmness.
"Is there any way to avoid being devoured?"
Tian Zi asked in a deep voice.
"Breaking this Great Formation is both difficult and not difficult. After all, the formation of the Imperishable Temple is extremely crude, with too many flaws and weak points. It's nothing more than a forceful combination utilizing immense power, that's all."
"If you want to break this Great Formation, there are many methods. However, precisely because of the immense power of the Imperishable Temple, it becomes very difficult with the current strength of the Great Wilderness."
"Even so, it is possible to seize a sliver of life from it."
Fang Hao spoke, pointing to a specific spot between two mountains, "Once the Imperishable Temple activates the Great Formation, focus all your strength and attack this point, and you can open a breach, thus creating an opportunity to escape."
Everyone looked at the position Fang Hao pointed to and silently memorized it. Although it could only open a breach and not completely break the Great Formation, and merely offered a chance to escape rather than a complete escape, it was enough.
This also demonstrated that the arrangements of the Imperishable Temple, in Fang Hao's eyes, were indeed incredibly crude, relying solely on absolute power to hold the advantage. If the power disparity between the two sides wasn't so vast, breaking the formation would be much easier.
Time passed as both sides stared at each other, and eventually, the feeling of the passage of time, an ancient and weathered sensation, appeared in the Land of Imperishable. Behind the Three Great True Spirit Kings, a few True Spirits suddenly wobbled and fell to the ground, dead!
The Black Chi King took a glance back but didn't pay any more attention. Every time the Next Era was about to begin, with the passage of time and the emergence of antiquity, some True Spirits would die at this moment.
This was a rule of the Land of Imperishable, unavoidable.
The King Chi Ni didn't even turn his head, while the Gargantuan Gluttonous King looked at the newly dead True Spirit, muttered a few words, opened his mouth, and sucked the True Spirit in, chewing as he said, "If it's edible, don't waste it!"
Other True Spirits had fear hidden in their eyes, their bodies trembling slightly as if at this moment, they truly felt the erosion of time on them, realizing that life had an end.
The gray-robed people atop the nine great mountains stood up and looked at the Great Wilderness Domain. Their auras surged as they prepared to activate the rules. To achieve the best effect, they needed to arrange the Domain, especially to eliminate the powerful beings within it, burying them in the Domain.
The gray-robed individuals on the other peaks also stood up, except for the Netherworld and Blood Demon, who were not required to take action. The Unchanging Divine Master had permitted the Netherworld not to act against the Taicang Domain.
The Netherworld turned to look at a certain Divine Temple, lost in thought.
"Brother, are you really going to do this?"
The Blood Demon said with a complex expression.
"Seeking peace of mind."
The Netherworld said calmly.
The Blood Demon fell silent.
"It's time to act."
Xu Yan looked outside the Domain and stepped out, followed closely by Jiang Buping.
Li Xuan stretched lazily and beckoned to summon the Red Cat.
The Red Cat immediately understood, and its body instantly grew to the size of a mountain, as Shi'er started to busy himself, moving the tables and other things onto the Red Cat's back.
"Master, are you going to make a move?"
Su Lingxiu asked excitedly.
"I'm setting some rules."
Li Xuan said with a smile.
The Daoist Ancestor was about to act, and everyone was thrilled.
Xie Lingfeng, Xie Tianheng, Moon Changming, Yue'er, Meng Shushu, Du Yuying, Yun Miaomiao, Zi Yun, Xin Mengrou, and other old friends eagerly wanted to board the Red Cat to watch the excitement outside the Domain.
The Red Cat glared with its big eyes, looking dissatisfied, as not everyone was allowed to climb onto its back.
"You can ride the Flying Boat of the Fourth Junior Brother, no need to sit on the Red Cat."
Su Lingxiu said with a cheerful tone.
"Yes, sit on the Flying Boat!"
In the end, only Yue'er, Du Yuying, Yun Miaomiao, Zi Yun, Meng Shushu, and Xie Lingfeng got on the Red Cat's back. They were the ones the Red Cat was more familiar with, and each had close relations with Xu Yan, Meng Chong, or Su Lingxiu, while the others were glared back by its big eyes and had to take the Flying Boat.
Fang Hao guided the vast Flying Boat returning from the Hong Ze Domain, an enormous, expensive endeavor each time it was powered. However, to witness the Daoist Ancestor's grandeur and the historical change of the Domain, no expense was spared.
More people boarded the Flying Boat, including Emperor Da Yue, Feng Yan, Azure Sea Turtle, and many others.
Muxiao, the sweeper, hesitated for a moment and with his broom approached the Red Cat. He felt he needed to face the Unchanging Divine Master directly, with no more chains on his heart, truly breaking away from the Imperishable Temple, and also declaring to the Unchanging Divine Master.
Muxiao was relieved to see the Daoist Ancestor had no objection, gripping the broom tighter, feeling somewhat nervous inside.
Li Xuan sat leisurely in a chair, with Cai Ling'er, the maid, attending nearby. She was making Spirit Cake and brewing tea, and her culinary skills had improved, making delicious Spirit Cake.
He beckoned to bring Ming Yu onto the Red Cat's back, as Ming Yu's awakening was close.
The Red Cat roared, soared into the sky, and headed beyond the Domain.
"Master, I'm going ahead."
Su Lingxiu couldn't contain her excitement, rushing ahead to the outside of the Domain, where she took out bottles of Pills in front of the powerful figures above the Realm Master level.

chapters.title: Chapter 1135 - 585 Taoist Ancestor Establishes a Rule Today_2
chapters.content:
```
"These pills can heal injuries and restore energy. Take them."
"Thank you, Evergreen Fairy!"
All the warriors expressed their gratitude excitedly.
The wonders of the Alchemical Medical arts had long been known to them, and she was the true successor of the Daoist Ancestor, the founder of the Evergreen Pavilion and one of the founders of the Qinghua Sect, as well as the propagator of the Pill arts.
Now, all the Cave Heavens' warriors referred to Su Lingxiu as the "Evergreen Fairy."
Then, Su Lingxiu took out some more pills and handed them to the Heavenly Domain level individuals, including Old Man Xiao and Ao Hong, as well as the Witch Demon. As for Qing Yu, she didn't need them for the moment.
"These are Domain Pills, not easy to refine."
Su Lingxiu looked toward the Land of Imperishable, at those Domain Lord-Level True Spirits, and said with a smile, "A single Domain Lord-Level True Spirit can be refined into several bottles of Domain Pills. If you had these pills helping you, your strength would undoubtedly increase faster!"
Upon hearing this, Old Man Xiao and the others were instantly moved, looking at that group of True Spirits as if seeing a trove of rare treasures.
"I still have an even stronger True Spirit that hasn't been refined into pills yet."
As Su Lingxiu spoke, she brought out a True Spirit.
It was none other than the Red Little Chi!
The Red Little Chi had already been dissected, and Su Lingxiu had conducted a detailed study of this corpse, now preparing to refine it into pills.
Ao Hong, seeing the corpse of the Red Little Chi and then looking up at the silhouette of King Chi Ni in the distance, felt his scalp tingle, thinking King Chi Ni might lose his mind.
Meanwhile, the Red Cat had arrived beyond the Domain, and Li Xuan leisurely sipped tea. Behind the Red Cat was the downsized Flying Boat, where the others were watching the beyond-Domain scene from the Flying Boat.
The Flying Boat had activated a protective shield so that even those without Realm Master-level strength wouldn't be affected by the Land of Imperishable.
From a distance, as the Red Cat and the Flying Boat appeared, they drew the attention of the Unchanging Divine Master and others. They were all staring at the Red Cat and the Flying Boat, then their gazes fell on Li Xuan.
This handsome young man didn't emit the aura of a strong warrior, nor did he exude any sharpness. He wasn't even connected to the Great Wilderness Domain's rules, yet his appearance clearly caused everyone to seem at ease.
"Is that the mysterious Daoist Ancestor?"
Blood Demon looked at the figure on the Red Cat and saw Xu Yan beside the Splendid Giant Tiger, realizing that this must be Xu Yan's master, the mysterious Daoist Ancestor.
"Brother, can you tell how powerful he is? How does he compare to the Divine Master?"
Blood Demon asked curiously.
"I can't tell!"
Netherworld's brows furrowed, eyes fixed.
"Facing so many strong warriors, yet still relaxed, he must be very confident in his strength. Could it be that this mysterious Daoist Ancestor is confident he can single-handedly fight the Divine Master, the Jade Court, and the Three Great True Spirit Kings?"
Blood Demon wondered aloud.
"Moreover, the setup is complete, and the rules have been manifested, surrounding the Domain. It could be devoured at any moment. Why didn't he act early, only leisurely appearing now? Does he really think he can break the Divine Master's setup?"
Blood Demon couldn't help but feel anticipation.
"Who are you?"
The Unchanging Divine Master spoke in a deep voice.
At this moment, his expression grew solemn. The young man on the Splendid Ferocious Tiger was clearly the backbone of all Domain warriors, and even the boy connected to the Domain's rules treated him as the mainstay.
However, the young man emitted no aura connected to the Domain. This meant that, he wasn't the Master of the Taicang Domain, yet was the core for everyone—a worst-case scenario.
A stranger, a strong warrior, had entered the Taicang Domain without his knowledge or awareness, and given the significant changes in the Taicang Domain today, it was clearly the work of this person.
Simultaneously, the Unchanging Divine Master also noticed Muxiao beside the Red Cat, and evidently, Muxiao had submitted to this mysterious warrior.
From the young man's appearance, the Witch Demon, Ao Hong, and Qing Yu all became respectful. All signs indicated that the person before them was a warrior surpassing the Master of Domain Realm.
Jade Court and the Three Great True Spirit Kings all had grave expressions. When had such a strong warrior appeared in the Land of Imperishable? They were unaware, had never seen him before.
The Black Chi King raised his head, eyes full of confusion, questioning why there was a warrior even he didn't know. Could this be another Exile?
Yet any Exile entering the Land of Imperishable should have been detected by him. Why had he never sensed this person's presence?
Li Xuan toyed with the Jade Ruyi in his hand, looked serenely, and said with a smile, "You may call me the Daoist Ancestor."
"Daoist Ancestor?!"
The Unchanging Divine Master was taken aback, looking toward the Jade Court and the Three Great True Spirit Kings. The Three Masters of the Jade Court looked toward the Black Chi King, silently inquiring among themselves.
The Black Chi King shook his head, indicating he had never heard the name Daoist Ancestor.
"How arrogant to call yourself the Daoist Ancestor!"
The Unchanging Divine Master said coldly.
"A strong warrior isn't arrogant; only the weak are."
Li Xuan continued to smile.
"Do you intend to interfere with the matters of my Divine Temple? Are you here to protect this Taicang Domain?"
The Unchanging Divine Master's aura surged, shadows expanding, the chilling energy spreading, revealing a powerful momentum.
Li Xuan chuckled softly and said, "This Domain, called the Great Wilderness, operates according to the Heavenly Dao, maintains the Yin Yang, and establishes reincarnation. It's a pity to destroy it. I understand your setup wasn't easy, so today, I'll establish a rule."
At this, Li Xuan tapped the Jade Ruyi in his hand, making a halo appear. He set up a battlefield akin to an arena in the area beyond the Domain and before the Nine Great Mountains.
"The Great Wilderness on one side, you all on the other. The Masters of Domain will battle here. If you win, I will not interfere with whatever you want to do, even if it means devouring this Domain; but if you lose, then it ends here. You shall not scheme for this Domain any longer."
Then, Li Xuan slightly intensified his tone, "Of course, no bullying the small with the big. Those above the Master of Domain level shall not take action. This is the rule!"
The Unchanging Divine Master was taken aback, looking at the Three Masters of the Jade Court, then at the Three Great True Spirit Kings, seemingly trying to gauge their reactions.
"Interesting. In all the long years I've lived, this is the first time I've encountered someone setting rules before me."
The Black Chi King lifted his head, eyes full of amusement.
"Eat! I, the Giant Gluttonous King, am also encountering this for the first time, so I might as well eat him to see why he's so conceited!"
The Gargantuan Gluttonous King shook his massive head and said.
King Chi Ni sneered, "Divine Master, what do you think?"
The expressions of the Three Masters of the Jade Court didn't change, but a look of derision appeared on their faces.
The Unchanging Divine Master laughed out loud, then coldly said, "What if we don't follow your so-called rules?"
Li Xuan didn't get angry, still smiling as he replied, "If you don't, then I don't mind stretching my muscles a bit, to make those who break the rules understand how to follow them!"
"Good, good, quite arrogant. Then let's see how you'll make us follow your rules!"
The eyes within the shadowy form of the Unchanging Divine Master suddenly turned blood-red, and a terrifyingly eerie aura became stronger, reminiscent of a world-ending fiend.
Li Xuan continued to smile as he toyed with the Jade Ruyi in one hand, sipping his tea with the other, unbothered by the Unchanging Divine Master.
The Witch Demon, Ao Hong, and Qing Yu, among others, instinctively tightened their grips, looking at the Unchanging Divine Master. Despite the great distance, that terrifyingly eerie aura still made them feel suffocated.
The memory of that battle with the Unchanging Divine Master resurfaced, making their breathing involuntarily heavier.
Muxiao, beside the Red Cat, was also extremely tense, but he gritted his teeth, staring directly at the Unchanging Divine Master, attempting to overcome the respect and fear in his heart!
He was now a disciple of the Daoist Ancestor. In his eyes, the Unchanging Divine Master should be trivial, and he shouldn't feel any nervousness or fear!
Xu Yan and his four fellow disciples were, however, excited and even hoped the Unchanging Divine Master would make a move so they could once again witness their master's invincible divine power.
Tian Zi watched the Unchanging Divine Master, tense yet expectant, even preparing to ask Li Xuan to spare the Unchanging Divine Master and hand him over to her to personally refine with the Majesty of the Heavenly Path as vengeance for Taicang.
Everyone on the Flying Boat was brimming with excitement, their eyes glued to the Unchanging Divine Master, not nervous or frightened but yearning for him to act, so they could once again witness the Daoist Ancestor's unrivaled divine power!
To witness the Daoist Ancestor in action was a great opportunity. Years later, they could boast to their juniors about seeing the Daoist Ancestor fight!
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1136 - 586: The Invincible Taoist Ancestor, Crushing King Chi Ni with Just One Hand
chapters.content:
```
On the mountaintop, the Netherworld and the Blood Demon both stood up, looking at the mysterious Daoist Ancestor with astonished expressions, realizing that Xu Yan's master must be very powerful, no weaker than the Unchanging Divine Master, hence the confidence.
But they never expected that he would directly set rules for the Unchanging Divine Master, Yu Ting, and the Three Great True Spirit Kings, which instantly offended all the supreme experts.
Was it because he was confident in his own strength, that he was so arrogant?
Could it be that Xu Yan's master, that mysterious Daoist Ancestor, believed he could single-handedly oppose the Unchanging Divine Master and several supreme experts?
"I kind of understand why Xu Yan is so arrogant, so confident now."
The Netherworld sighed and said.
It's all taught by his master!
The Blood Demon nodded, no wonder Xu Yan not only offended Yu Ting but also offended King Chi Ni, yet remained utterly unshaken, even indifferent, all because of his master!
"The Divine Master is about to make a move!"
The Blood Demon said with an expectant look.
Whether the Daoist Ancestor was truly strong enough to disregard all supreme experts would naturally be revealed once the Unchanging Divine Master made a move.
The aura of the Unchanging Divine Master was formidable, and the eyes in the shadows were scarlet and evil. A claw shrouded in a sinister gray aura slowly emerged, the massive claw resembling a demon's claw. From a distance, the gray aura swirling around it, the sinister and terrifying claw was large enough to easily crush the Great Wilderness Domain in its grasp.
The Witch Demon, Ao Hong, and Qing Yu all had grave expressions. They had seen this claw before in a battle far away; when this claw appeared, Hong Ze and the Hong Ze Domain perished!
Just a glance from afar back then had made their hearts quiver in fear, and now facing this claw directly made them truly appreciate the terror and evil of it.
It was unimaginable how despairing Hong Ze must have been when facing this claw!
The Azure Sea Turtle's body trembled, its limbs retracted into its shell, its head also shrank into the shell, but seemingly thinking of something, it forced itself to overcome the fear and peeked its head halfway out to stare at the claw.
Xu Yan and the four others were shocked by the might of the Unchanging Divine Master. Even Su Lingxiu, who was about to use Chi Xiao Ni in alchemy, halted her actions and stared at the claw.
Li Xuan's expression remained unchanged as he continued to leisurely sip his tea, as if that claw was nothing more than an ant raising its foot, not worth a glance.
"Little guy, you'd better think it through. Not following the rules will lead to severe punishment."
Li Xuan said with a faint smile.
He was already prepared to crush this body of the Unchanging Divine Master with one hand, intimidating Yu Ting and the Three Great True Spirit Kings, while scaring the real Unchanging Divine Master out.
"Dad, Dad, that's little brother, that's Xiao Ni, he's been dissected!"
At this moment, an urgent and angry voice sounded.
Chi Eighteen Ni arrived next to King Chi Ni, angrily pointing at the corpse of Chi Xiao Ni, which Su Lingxiu was about to handle.
King Chi Ni diverted his gaze from Li Xuan, looking towards the direction Chi Eighteen Ni pointed. Instantly, he saw his beloved son having his heart taken out from the dissected wound, seemingly ready to be thrown into a nearby great ding.
In an instant, King Chi Ni's eyes turned blood-red, his aura exploded, emitting terrifying roars, "How dare you ants humiliate my son, give me your lives!"
The now enraged King Chi Ni was enveloped in a red flame as he rushed towards the Great Wilderness.
The Unchanging Divine Master had not yet made a move, but King Chi Ni was already furious, and the terrifying aura shook the mountain peak arranged by the Unchanging Divine Master, causing it to tremble slightly.
"King Chi Ni, restrain your aura!"
The Unchanging Divine Master, who was originally about to act, changed his expression, the massive claw spreading into a shadow to block the powerful aura of King Chi Ni in front of the arranged mountain.
"Restrain be damned, I want to tear her apart alive, I want to destroy them!"
King Chi Ni roared, his red mane shaking like red flames, his nostrils spewing red smoke, his whole body shining with a red glow.
At this moment, King Chi Ni had already unleashed his full power, entering an uncontrollable rage, unrestrainable by anyone.
The Unchanging Divine Master's expression changed, he could only turn and remind: "King Chi Ni, don't damage my Domain Divine Mountain, otherwise the plan fails, I won't let it slide!"
Unable to prevent King Chi Ni from acting, he could only advise King Chi Ni to control himself and not destroy his set-up Domain Divine Mountain, or else this plan would fail.
Conveniently, King Chi Ni could also test that self-proclaimed Daoist Ancestor's boasted strength.
Although furious, King Chi Ni had not entirely lost his mind. He knew that damaging the Unchanging Divine Master's Domain Divine Mountain would certainly lead to the plan's failure, and the Unchanging Divine Master would not let it go, even if not fearing the Unchanging Divine Master, it did not want to be constantly watched by an equally powerful being, making it easy to get hurt if careless.
Therefore, King Chi Ni restrained the aura surging in all directions, instead gathering it onto himself as he rushed towards the Great Wilderness.
"Kill my son, and humiliate my son like this, even in front of me, you all deserve to die, I won't let you die easily, I'm going to slowly torture you to death!"
King Chi Ni's scarlet eyes glared with killing intent, staring firmly at Su Lingxiu and Xu Yan, the one preparing to dissect Chi Xiao Ni's body and extract the heart for concoction, and the one who killed Chi Xiao Ni.
The real culprit, in fact, was that Daoist Ancestor. Without his arrogant backing, how dare Xu Yan kill his son?
Therefore, in King Chi Ni's eyes, everyone outside the domain had to die, and the culprit Xu Yan and the woman dissecting Chi Xiao Ni, it wanted to capture them, slowly torture them to death, to quell the hatred in its heart!
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1137 - 586: The Invincible Taoist Ancestor, Crushing King Chi Ni with Just One Hand - Part 2
chapters.content:
```
The terrifying aura of King Chi Ni surged, causing the entire domain to tremble slightly. The Heavenly Dao Rules rippled like water waves, seemingly about to shatter in the next moment.
"How terrifying! This is the strength of the Three Great True Spirit Kings!"
The Witch Demon spoke in shock.
Ao Hong swallowed hard. If King Chi Ni was this formidable, wouldn't the Black Chi King be even more terrifying?
He had a gut feeling that the Black Chi King was definitely stronger than King Chi Ni.
"Master, it's so scary, it's targeting me!"
Su Lingxiu shrank her neck, glanced at Red Kitten's corpse, then at the blood-red, murderous eyes of King Chi Ni. She couldn't help but pick up Red Kitten and the Great Ding, sitting beside her master on Red Cat's back to find solace.
Li Xuan's mouth twitched; he hadn't expected the Unchanging Divine Master to remain passive while King Chi Ni became enraged instead.
Watching as the imposing King Chi Ni approached, his presence weighing heavily on the Heavenly Dao Rules, Li Xuan said, "King Chi Ni, this Daoist Ancestor is a reasonable person. If you wish to seek revenge, you may. If a Master of Domain-level opponent can defeat my disciple, this Daoist Ancestor will accept it.
"But if you wish to bully the weak—that is a breach of conduct. You better consider the consequences!"
"Haha, I, King Chi Ni, have dominated the Land of Imperishable for countless years. Only I set the rules. No one has ever dictated them to me. I want to see what qualifications such a pitiful Daoist Ancestor has to establish rules!"
King Chi Ni laughed madly, his voice chilling, his murderous intent surging. "I will tear you to pieces, feed you to the True Spirits, and slowly torture your disciples, letting them die in despair!"
Hearing this, the Gargantuan Gluttonous King couldn't help but step forward, muttering, "Feeding the True Spirits would be such a waste. Just let me have a taste. I'm curious about the flavor."
It slowly moved towards the Great Wilderness, seemingly waiting for the opportunity to seize the victims from King Chi Ni and have them for itself.
It seemed convinced that King Chi Ni would inevitably defeat the opposition.
Li Xuan's smile faded. He snorted lightly, saying, "It seems this Daoist Ancestor has been too gentle, too forgiving towards you little creatures. Today, I'll let you know that the rules set by this Daoist Ancestor must not be defied!"
Roar!
Upon hearing this, King Chi Ni was even more furious. His body grew massive, charging forward. The terrifying power made it seem as if the Land of Imperishable cracked with tiny fissures, crimson light illuminating the chaos.
The Great Wilderness Domain appeared like a tiny pellet of mud in front of King Chi Ni, utterly vulnerable.
At this moment, the powerful beings in the Great Wilderness Domain felt as if a great mountain was pressing on their minds, filling them with a suffocating sensation close to death. They couldn't muster even the slightest will to resist.
"So strong!"
Xu Yan was shocked, realizing the sheer strength of King Chi Ni. Unless he reached the Great Accomplishment of Creation Realm, he was no match!
And if King Chi Ni was this powerful, the other two True Spirit Kings wouldn't be weaker; the Black Chi King would be even stronger.
This was the kind of terrifying presence he had only sensed in that mysterious figure of the Jade Court, and Xu Yan had a premonition that the one in the Jade Court was even stronger than King Chi Ni.
However, what puzzled him was that he couldn't sense that figure's presence from the Jade Court.
The Great Wilderness seemed so fragile before King Chi Ni, and Tian Zi felt like he was about to fracture, as if the Heavenly Dao might collapse at any moment.
"I am still too weak. The Unchanging Divine Master won't be weaker than King Chi Ni. When will I have enough strength to kill him?"
Tian Zi felt a sense of powerlessness.
The Red Cat's eyes showed fear, instinctively wanting to retreat, but remembering something, it steadied its mind, standing firm and unmoving.
Muxiao was visibly astonished, looking at the advancing King Chi Ni. He couldn't help but glance at the Daoist Ancestor atop the Red Cat's back.
The Daoist Ancestor remained calm, sitting leisurely, though his smile faded, replaced by an indifferent look. He lifted a hand.
As the Daoist Ancestor lifted his hand, the terrifying aura of King Chi Ni charging forward disappeared instantly. Everyone felt calm and relieved, the suffocating feeling dissipating entirely.
Li Xuan watched as King Chi Ni charged at him, still sitting comfortably in his chair, playing with the Jade Ruyi in one hand while lifting the other. As he raised his hand, mysterious auras, the Great Wilderness Physiognomy, and the Daoist Ancestor Halo manifested, profound and unfathomable.
With a simple forward grasp, a giant hand appeared out of nowhere, reaching toward King Chi Ni. As it grabbed, the Land of Chaotic Imperishable seemed to shatter like glass, revealing a void.
Roar!
King Chi Ni was shocked and terrified, feeling the threat of death for the first time. He roared crazily, his aura exploding to the extreme, burning his very origin to unleash all his power.
He spat out a terrifying crimson beam, trying to resist the grasp, but it was futile. In an instant, his entire body tightened, unable to struggle before being crushed with a bang.
One of the Three Great True Spirit Kings, the immensely powerful King Chi Ni, was crushed like a tiny ant by Li Xuan with a single hand. The area surrounding King Chi Ni became a void.
Fierce Spiritual Energy and Imperishable Qi surged madly, repairing the void, while King Chi Ni left not even ashes, completely obliterated.
Silence!
Everyone was stunned by this scene. With a light grasp, one of the Three Great True Spirit Kings, King Chi Ni, was crushed on the spot, leaving no trace.
Even more terrifying was that the area turned into a void, only slowly recovering after a long while.
"The Daoist Ancestor is invincible!"
At this moment, all the powerful beings in the Great Wilderness murmured in awe and reverence.
Boom!
The Unchanging Divine Master, the Jade Court, and the Black Chi King were all dumbfounded, their faces incredulous. Although they believed they were stronger than King Chi Ni, they couldn't possibly crush him so effortlessly.
Originally stepping forward, preparing to seize people from King Chi Ni and taste them, the Gargantuan Gluttonous King's tail tucked in fear.
It hurriedly retreated, lying down with its eyes full of terror, worried that the mysterious Daoist Ancestor might hear its muttering and crush it as well. Therefore, it lay down, admitting defeat, and showing submission.
Boom!
In an instant, the Divine Temple emitted a brilliant light, and a figure flew out, landing beside the shadow-like form of the Unchanging Divine Master, his expression unprecedentedly solemn, staring intently at Li Xuan on the Red Cat's back.
He was the true Unchanging Divine Master. At this moment, the Unchanging Divine Master radiated brilliance, his aura more powerful than the shadow form beside him.
With the appearance of the true Unchanging Divine Master, the Gargantuan Gluttonous King was startled. How could another strong figure appear, even stronger than the Unchanging Divine Master? Or rather, this was the true Unchanging Divine Master?
Thinking of this, the Gargantuan Gluttonous King moved away from the Unchanging Divine Master.
Black Chi King didn't seem surprised by this, but even it couldn't maintain its composure, hovering up from the mountaintop, its aura subtly showing, eyes extremely serious.
Boom!
The Three Masters of the Jade Court fused into one at this moment, becoming a single entity. Additionally, those Jade Persons turned into light and merged into the Jade Court.
Immediately, the Jade Court began transforming, as if an invisible rule and force were pulling it, drawing all Jade Puppets back in, symbolizing the return of all their powers to the Jade Court.
Even the one being formed by the fusion of the three Masters of the Jade Court merged into the Jade Court, which was undergoing a transformation.
With Li Xuan's intervention, crushing King Chi Ni with a single hand shocked all the powerful beings. The Unchanging Divine Master couldn't sit still, the Black Chi King couldn't remain calm, and the Jade Court was no exception.
However, as the Jade Court recalled all its Jade Puppets, concentrating its entire power, within the domain, a Jade Puppet occupied by Blood Extreme felt immense fear. He sensed he was about to be devoured and dissolved by a mysterious rule's power.
"Daoist Ancestor, save me!"
Blood Extreme cried out in terror.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1138 - 587: The Divine Master Bows, Battling by the Rules
chapters.content:
```
Li Xuan sat leisurely in the chair, toying with the Jade Ruyi and sipping Spiritual Tea. He had long anticipated the appearance of the Unchanging Divine Master and the transformation of Yu Ting.
Besides the Blood Extreme, the Jade Puppet Fang Hao used for research was also beginning to melt and return to Yu Ting under the influence of a certain rule power.
Li Xuan raised a hand and pointed. The Blood Extreme's body changed, the rule power and influence vanished, and the Jade Puppet's body ceased to be that of a puppet but transformed into a living being.
The power of the Master of Domain that the Jade Puppet possessed completely belonged to the Blood Extreme now.
"Many thanks, Daoist Ancestor!"
The Blood Extreme was thrilled and kowtowed respectfully.
Regarding the Jade Puppet that Fang Hao used for research, Li Xuan did not stop it, allowing it to melt and return to Yu Ting.
Ming Yu had also undergone some changes, a faint jade light emanating from her body as she floated up, wanting to fly towards Yu Ting under the pull of rule power.
"Master!"
Xu Yan was startled and hurriedly looked to his master. After all, once Ming Yu returned to Yu Ting, she would lose her memory again and be unable to find herself.
Li Xuan raised a hand and pointed, severing the rule linking to Ming Yu, which completely freed her from control.
"What is that?"
The Witch Demon, Ao Hong, Qing Yu, and Tian Zi stared at the Unchanging Divine Master with faces full of shock. Was he the real master of the Divine Temple?
"That form was only his shadow form; this is his true form."
Li Xuan explained with a smile.
Upon hearing this, the Witch Demon and others couldn't help but show bitter expressions. The Unchanging Divine Master was so powerful, yet he had never directly struck before?
Yu Ting was undergoing changes. At one point, the entire Yu Ting transformed into a colossal, flawless jade-white Jade Person, exuding a sacred aura.
Then this Jade Person slowly began to shrink until it was no different from an ordinary person.
"This aura!"
Xu Yan sighed. The terrifying aura he felt in Yu Ting was from this person, but now their aura was even stronger than before.
The Unchanging Divine Master seemed to be quite surprised by the changes in Yu Ting, which went beyond expectations, but the Black Chi King seemed to have known.
The Gargantuan Gluttonous King was on the verge of tears, moving his body to distance himself from Yu Ting. He only came to eat something good, something he hadn't eaten before, but almost got scared to death. Now he didn't dare leave. If he did, attention would focus on him.
"Who are you?"
At this moment, the Unchanging Divine Master spoke with extreme solemnity.
That shadow form gradually melded into his body, completely unifying, and his aura strengthened once more.
"You may call me Daoist Ancestor."
Li Xuan said with a smile.
"Where are you from? Taihao?"
The Unchanging Divine Master stared intently at Li Xuan, contemplating whether to immediately activate rule power to swallow the Great Wilderness Domain.
But remembering how easily the other crushed King Chi Ni's terrifying strength, he realized breaking his design might be effortless for him.
"I existed before the chaos and void, when Taihao was not present. At that time, it was nothingness."
Li Xuan boasted as he spoke.
The Unchanging Divine Master, Yu Ting, and the Black Chi King were all utterly shocked. They wished to question it, but lacked the strength. The person sat leisurely, a mere hand raised, and King Chi Ni turned to nothingness.
How could such terrifying power be doubted?
From where would they question it?
Never in life had they seen or heard of such a terrifying existence.
"Young ones, since I, Daoist Ancestor, set the rules, must you not obey them? Now, are you willing to follow?"
Li Xuan said with a light laugh.
"Since you are a senior, why trouble me? I, the Indestructible, in this life, only seek to regain my justice!"
The Unchanging Divine Master, or rather, the Indestructible Divine Master, showed a grave expression. Yet his tone softened.
He had no choice!
Although he claimed to be indestructible in Taihao, with none able to destroy him, living up to his title, the person before them exceeded his comprehension, overwhelmingly powerful.
Faced with such terror, the so-called "indestructible" was a mere joke.
Li Xuan continued to smile, "As I have traveled and taught in this domain, how innocent are the beings of this world. But I have given you a chance; abide by the rules, and if you win, the path is yours."
The Indestructible Divine Master's expression shifted. He looked at Yu Ting, then at the Black Chi King, ignoring the Gargantuan Gluttonous King, and glanced towards the Great Wilderness, silently assessing.
Now there was only one way: abide by the rules to claim victory.
Nothing else could be done. King Chi Ni was a perfect example of the outcome of breaking rules.
In this moment, the Indestructible Divine Master felt helpless, yet had to bow, accept this reality.
His life had never bowed, even when hunted, bound, or exiled to the Land of Imperishable, never once bowing.
But now, he had to bow, humor himself at the discovery that not bowing was because he'd not met a terrifyingly stronger being!
"If we win, truly you won't interfere?"
Li Xuan nodded, "Naturally, why would I, Daoist Ancestor, deceive small beings like you?"
"Fine, then we go by your rules!"
The Indestructible Divine Master spoke through gritted teeth.
Li Xuan looked at Xu Yan and the others, smiling, "It's up to you. To protect this domain, rely on yourselves and unite. I established this rule and won't break it. If you lose, I won't intervene."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1139 - 587: The Divine Master Bows, Battling by the Rules_2
chapters.content:
巫魔 and the others felt a chill in their hearts; their earlier ease was gone as they looked toward the Imperishable Temple, where many powerful beings were amassed. How many among them could match such might?
"Yes, Daoist Ancestor!"
They all responded respectfully.
Luckily, there was Xu Yan, Meng Chong, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping. Whether or not Su Lingxiu took action did not matter; she could heal them and restore their energy.
And Xu Yan's strength was unrivaled within the Domain, ensuring victory in this battle!
"Finally, a chance for a good fight!"
Meng Chong rubbed his head and took a step forward, his body suddenly becoming enormous and radiant, like a Heavenly God, with a fierce aura that shook the surroundings.
"I am Meng Chong, come and fight! No need for one-on-one, come at me all at once!"
The Indestructible Divine Master's expression tensed, secretly in awe. What kind of martial arts was this, so ferocious that even a mere physical body surpassed a Divine Artifact in strength?
Since the opponent's physical body was so powerful, the Indestructible Divine Master couldn't help but look toward Yu Ting and the Black Chi King. It was clear this battle involved more than just the Divine Temple.
Yu Ting and the Black Chi King needed to participate.
From Yu Ting's side, a Jade Person stepped forward, almost crossing into the power level above a Master of Domain level.
The Black Chi King appeared somewhat resigned, turning back to watch as a True Spirit leaped out, also at the peak of Master of Domain level.
A Jade Puppet and a True Spirit joined the battle.
"Good timing!"
Meng Chong clenched his fists and charged forward, purely engaging with his body.
Boom!
Upon engagement, Meng Chong didn't dodge but landed a punch that sent the Jade Person flying, cracks spreading across its body as if it might shatter any moment.
Yet Meng Chong directly stood firm against the True Spirit's attack, merely retreating a bit, his body unharmed. Such a terrifying physique made the Indestructible Divine Master's eyebrows twitch.
The cracks on the Jade Person gradually healed, and it charged again, this time more agile, avoiding direct confrontation while seeking Meng Chong's weak spots.
Meng Chong ignored the Jade Person, focusing on battling the True Spirit, engaging in close-quarters combat, unfazed by the True Spirit's strikes, grabs, and bites upon him.
"Die!"
With a sudden motion, Meng Chong wrapped his arms around the True Spirit's neck and applied force, breaking its neck. He then punched a massive wound into its body.
He then hurled the True Spirit's body toward the Great Wilderness, tossing it to Su Lingxiu.
Boom!
Meng Chong sustained some injuries, especially from the Jade Person's frenzied attacks, but these wounds visibly healed, and his fierce aura surged anew.
"You should die too!"
Meng Chong glared at the Jade Person and struck.
The Jade Person intended to rely on agility to counter Meng Chong's attacks, but unexpectedly, Meng Chong's movement was even more agile. Before long, it was forced into direct combat with him.
Seeing the intense battle, the Witch Demon could no longer hold back and let loose a furious roar, charging out.
"If you want to kill me, Witch Demon, then come on. Let your Divine Temple's weaklings understand what a true Master of Domain is!"
The Witch Demon's aura erupted.
A gray-robed figure emerged to meet the Witch Demon, and the battle was about to ignite.
The Indestructible Divine Master looked tense, glaring at the battlefield—this involved his long years of planning and could not afford to fail.
"Big Brother, that Daoist Ancestor is terrifying!"
The Blood Demon still looked completely shaken.
The Netherworld was equally astounded, the Daoist Ancestor's strength utterly beyond imagination, making even dominant figures like the Divine Master submit!
Faced with such a frightening being, there was no choice but to yield!
"When the battle fully begins, you should join in. Capitalize on your connections with Xu Yan and seize the chance to head for the Great Wilderness."
The Netherworld spoke solemnly.
"What about you, Big Brother?"
The Blood Demon frowned.
"I have other important matters to attend to, don't worry about me."
The Netherworld glanced at a Divine Temple.
"Big Brother, it's too dangerous; let's go to the Great Wilderness together."
The Blood Demon pleaded anxiously.
"I seek only peace of mind. If I'm at peace, what does it matter if I die? If it weren't for your plea back then, I'd be long dead. Living this long is worth it."
The Netherworld looked earnestly at the Blood Demon, "Listen to me, go to the Great Wilderness, don't worry about me. If I succeed, I will naturally go to the Great Wilderness as well."
The Blood Demon opened his mouth but, seeing his brother's determined eyes, finally nodded helplessly.
The battle raged on the battlefield, with Meng Chong overwhelming the Jade Person, causing it to crack all over. However, it kept regenerating, seemingly endless and indestructible.
The Witch Demon apparently held back for long, now venting his inner rage. The battle was extraordinarily fierce. Although the gray-robed person from the Divine Temple was not weaker in strength, he was being pressed by the Witch Demon.
The Indestructible Divine Master watched the battlefield with deadly focus, ignoring the Witch Demon and instead focusing on Meng Chong, who was dominating the Jade Person. If not for the Jade Person's special properties, it might have already been destroyed.
Yet, even so, the time needed for the Jade Person to repair its cracked body grew longer. Clearly, it wouldn't last much longer.
The Indestructible Divine Master looked toward the Master of the Jade Court, with a thoughtful expression, seemingly realizing something but not entirely certain.
"I'll step in too."
Jiang Buping, holding a Long Spear, took each step forward with mounting momentum, a powerful intent to slaughter the soul surged.
"What is this?"
Seeing this, the Indestructible Divine Master's brows furrowed. This martial art seemed focused on the Divine Soul, while that ferocious bald youth focused on the physical body.
One who focused on the physical body and one on the Divine Soul, could they be targeted specifically for attack?
Thinking this, the Indestructible Divine Master looked at the Master of the Jade Court and spoke solemnly, "You should have noticed."
The Master of the Jade Court nodded.
"Then let's give it a try."
The Indestructible Divine Master pondered for a moment as a powerful individual emerged from the Divine Temple, holding a Divine Artifact glowing a crimson hue. Besides them, a True Spirit also stepped forward, moving together to attack Jiang Buping.
The rules set by the mysterious Daoist Ancestor did not prohibit overwhelming with numbers. Since Jade Puppets and True Spirits were allowed to battle the bald youth together, this situation naturally did not break the rules.
"Kill!"
The gray-robed person wielding the crimson Divine Artifact launched a sharp attack straight at Jiang Buping, and so did the True Spirit aimed. Whether it was the gray-robed person or the True Spirit, their attacks focused on Jiang Buping's physical body.
Jiang Buping, however, merely sneered. In the understanding of the Indestructible Divine Master and his allies, since his main practice targeted the Divine Soul, his physical body must be relatively weaker. They assumed they'd found his weakness and launched a targeted assault, unaware that his Extreme Soul Martial Arts didn't differentiate between body and Divine Soul—or rather, his body was indeed part of his Divine Soul.
A star-like glow emanated, Jiang Buping's spear pierced forth, unleashing his Extreme Soul Martial Arts, a force of ultimate slaughters the soul erupted at that moment, stars glimmering within the True Spirit's Divine Soul.
Since True Spirits lacked Spiritual Wisdom, naturally, there was no concept of the Divine Soul in their consciousness. Yet, they still felt an intense sense of crisis, roaring while invoking the True Spirit Force to resist the attack.
The gray-robed person felt the spear's terrifying sharpness from Jiang Buping, and even though it wasn't aimed at him directly, there was an implicit sting in his Divine Soul. Gritting his teeth, he seized the moment Jiang Buping attacked the True Spirit to launch a fully strength-based strike.
Crimson light flared, the force to erode flesh surged, enveloping Jiang Buping.
Yet, in his shocked eyes, Jiang Buping's flesh showed no sign of erosion, as if this flesh-targeting force was utterly ineffective—or the impact was minimal.
"How is this possible!"
The gray-robed person turned pale with astonishment.
The Indestructible Divine Master's expression changed too. How could someone practicing martial arts focused on the Divine Soul have such an extraordinary flesh—could it be that he had no weak points?
Meanwhile, the Jade Person battling Meng Chong was all cracked, ready to fall apart at any moment.
"This Jade Puppet of yours is unique, maintained by force—I wonder how long you can sustain this!"
Meng Chong chuckled at the Jade Puppet.
In an ordinary battle, that Jade Puppet might have been vanquished, yet the Jade Puppets of Yu Ting were unique, linked to the Master of the Jade Court, thereby capable of rapid regeneration.
However, in the end, the Jade Puppet was only Master of Domain level; even swift recovery had limits. After repeated hits, it would eventually fail to maintain itself and collapse completely.
But against other Masters of Domain, Jade Puppets had an absolute advantage. After all, there was no other Master of Domain capable of repeatedly defeating opponents, eventually succumbing to counterattacks.
Unfortunately, the Jade Puppet's opponent was Meng Chong, and no matter how strong the recovery ability was, it couldn't withstand such high-intensity, rapid strikes.

chapters.title: Chapter 1140 - 588: Ming Yu Awakens, Taihao Divine Jade
chapters.content:
```
Boom!
Meng Chong's punch struck the Jade Puppet. In an instant, the Jade Puppet shattered, like a jade sculpture being broken. But just as it crumbled, all the pieces seemed to melt instantly, converging into a beam of silver light, shooting toward Meng Chong.
This was clearly a premeditated move by the Jade Puppet. By using shattering as a price, it lowered Meng Chong's guard, unleashing this attack in a flash.
Boom!
The silver light hit Meng Chong. Unlike typical attacks, this beam of silver light was obviously aimed at the Divine Soul. It was a powerful attack to slaughter the soul.
"Heh!"
Meng Chong chuckled, thinking that since his physical body was strong, they misjudged his weakness to be in his Divine Soul. Did they really think they could break through his soul's defenses with a powerful Offensive Art?
Buzz!
Golden waves rolled off Meng Chong's body, creating ripples. The silver light shot at him but merely stirred ripples. Under the Infinite Divine Wave, it was instantly dissolved and eliminated.
"Come again if you dare!"
Meng Chong rubbed his head, raised his hand, and grasped a great saber. His aura became increasingly fierce.
The Indestructible Divine Master and the Master of the Jade Court both stiffened, staring at Meng Chong and Jiang Buping with deep trepidation. What kind of Martial Arts was this? His physical body was overwhelmingly powerful, and his soul's defense was equally strong.
How could someone who primarily cultivated the Divine Soul Force have such an unbelievable physical body?
This exceeded their understanding of Martial Arts. Shocked, they couldn't help but frown.
The mysterious Daoist Ancestor had set such a rule, evidently confident of victory.
The Indestructible Divine Master wore a grim expression, his eyes filled with bitterness. He had thought that this arrangement could be effortlessly completed, but had not anticipated encountering such a terrifying presence.
In facing this being, he felt deeply powerless and had no choice but to lower his head.
Yet, he was utterly unwilling to accept this failure. He refused to be exiled here; he wanted revenge!
"Black Chi King, release the True Spirits."
The Indestructible Divine Master turned to the Black Chi King and said.
The Black Chi King hesitated slightly, wondering if offending that Daoist Ancestor could bring trouble upon himself.
Ancient as he was, he was deeply shocked that such a terrifying strongman existed in the world and he had never known.
"With things as they are, how long are you going to avoid this? Don't you want to see if my arrangement will succeed? Don't you want to seize that slim chance?"
The Indestructible Divine Master spoke in a deep voice.
"Alright then!"
The Black Chi King exhaled a breath, and behind him, one by one, True Spirits emerged. These True Spirits were all at the peak of the Master of Domain level, and each True Spirit Force was unique. Together, they encompassed almost all forms of attack, whether against the Divine Soul or the physical body.
"I'll join in too!"
Fang Hao patted the Weapon Box, unleashing a torrent of Divine Artifacts. He stepped into the battlefield, and with one stomp, the Qimen Grand Formation appeared, followed by the deployment of a Great Formation, directly enveloping part of the True Spirits.
"What kind of Martial Arts is this again?"
The Indestructible Divine Master looked even more somber.
Another strongman had emerged from the Great Wilderness with such unbelievable tactics.
Roar!
Ao Hong let out a dragon roar and joined the fight as well, looking down on the Indestructible Divine Master with disdain, coldly saying, "Come, Divine Temple, let's fight."
A gray-robed man walked out with a grim face, engaging in battle with Ao Hong.
Xu Yan did not take action, and Su Lingxiu had no intention of doing so, for she never liked fighting—it was more interesting watching from the side.
Instead, the Red Cat wanted to engage, but since it was now a mount, it could only watch helplessly.
For Xu Yan, the current battle was merely a test by the Indestructible Divine Master to gauge the strength of the Great Wilderness. The real battle had yet to begin.
After all, the established rule was that the strong should not bully the weak, but there was no rule against many against few. In terms of the number of Master of Domain-level experts, the Indestructible Divine Master clearly held a significant advantage.
The Indestructible Divine Master waited, biding his time for a decisive assault to crush the Master of Domain-level experts from the Great Wilderness.
Ming Yu's radiance was fading, and her jade-like texture was gradually disappearing as she began transforming into a real being.
"Ming Yu is about to awaken."
Xu Yan was filled with anticipation. Once Ming Yu awakened, she should regain her memories and learn more, including some details about Taihao.
The battle between the two sides continued. Old Man Xiao and others also gradually entered the fray. Though they were of the Heavenly Domain, their strength was somewhat lacking when facing powerful Master of Domain; after all, they weren't far into the Heavenly Domain.
But they still held their ground. Especially when displaying the Heavenly Dao Divine Skills, they could even force the enemy back a bit.
At this point, it wasn't the time to risk everything, so if they were at a disadvantage, they would retreat, heal, and gather experience.
With healing and recovery Pill, the Great Wilderness's strongmen quickly returned to the battlefield. As the battles increased, they grew stronger in combat, especially in their use of the Heavenly Dao Divine Skills, which became more adept and insightful.
Ming Yu's eyelids fluttered, then slowly opened her eyes. The usual innocent gaze was gone, replaced with maturity, sadness, and newfound richness of emotion.
She was no longer a simple-minded Jade Puppet but a real person with complete thoughts and feelings.
The Master of the Jade Court seemed to feel something, glanced over, and sighed softly, lost in thought.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1141 - 588: Ming Yu Awakens, Taihao Divine Jade_2
chapters.content:
"Did you remember everything, Ming Yu?"
Xu Yan asked curiously.
"It's Xu Yan!"
Ming Yu looked at him with a smile. In that moment, the innocent and naive Ming Yu seemed to have returned.
"It's me!"
Xu Yan nodded, his face full of curiosity. "Ming Yu, what did you remember? I know about Taihao; have you heard of the Land of Imperishable? If it's convenient, could you tell me about it?"
Ming Yu tilted her head slightly, looking at him as if she was pondering. Her demeanor was just like when they first met, the way Ming Yu contemplated.
"Alright!"
Ming Yu nodded, showing a slightly naive smile.
The sadness deep in her eyes seemed to have been suppressed. It was as if sadness could no longer affect her; she was now as naive and innocent as when she was a Jade Puppet.
Li Xuan glanced at Ming Yu and said nothing. Letting go of one's past self and choosing another self was also a kind of liberation. Memories of the past were like clouds of smoke, like a mirage, merely topics to talk about in leisure.
Could this realization not be a good thing?
Perhaps this was a new beginning in another form.
Ming Yu made her choice. Upon seeing Xu Yan, she recalled various things with him and finally chose to be her current self rather than her former self!
Her former self was already gone!
Xu Yan was overjoyed. He took out tables and chairs, placed them on the Red Cat's back, and let Ming Yu sit down, whereas Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao sat on either side of Xu Yan, eagerly taking out Spirit Cakes and making tea, showing great hospitality.
Ming Yu's smile was radiant. She tilted her head slightly, looking at Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao with curiosity.
"This is Miss Du Yuying, and this is Miss Yun Miaomiao!"
Xu Yan began to introduce them.
Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao quickly spoke up, "Greetings, Senior Ming Yu!"
Ming Yu hesitated, then said with a sly smile, "Don't call me 'Senior'; I've been reborn—I'm not older than you!"
"Then should we just call you Ming Yu?"
Du Yuying thought for a moment and said.
"Yes, just call me Ming Yu!"
Ming Yu tilted her head, thought for a moment, and nodded.
"Ming Yu, quickly tell us about Taihao and the Exquisite Jade Mountain."
Xu Yan eagerly said.
"Alright!"
Ming Yu nodded, just like before, slightly tilting her head as if she was thinking and recalling, with a kind of naive and sluggish appearance. "The Taihao Realm is outside the Land of Imperishable. Taihao is divided into Thirty-Three Heavens. The stronger one is, the higher the Heaven they reside in; one needs to reach a certain level of strength to ascend to higher Heavens..."
The Thirty-Three Heavens of Taihao were extremely vast, surpassing the current Great Wilderness Domain. The Thirty-Three Heavens were as splendid as this Domain, but unlike the sun, moon, and stars of the Great Wilderness Domain, which were formed by Dao Principles, the sun, moon, and stars of Taihao truly existed and contained powerful celestial forces.
Supreme Experts would even pluck stars for the refinement of Divine Weapons, and such strong individuals invariably resided among the Thirty-Three Heavens, ranking as top experts of Taihao.
For practitioners of Taihao, their lifelong pursuit was to ascend to a higher Heaven, seeking a higher Martial Arts, and becoming stronger beings. For those at the lower levels, after striving to climb and finally reaching the Heavens, they were shocked to find that there was yet another Heaven above them.
And those Supreme Experts who resided in the Thirty-Three Heavens of Taihao almost reached the pinnacle of cultivation, their strength nearly reaching a plateau. Beyond the Thirty-Three Heavens was the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, and the first Supreme Experts to venture there never returned.
As understanding of the Land of Imperishable deepened, the strong came to view it as a forbidden zone; once entered, there was no return, hence also called the Land of No Return. From some point in time, the strong of various forces in Taihao began to exile enemies or those difficult to kill into the Land of Imperishable.
Those exiled from Taihao were called Exiles. Over the long years, in Ming Yu's memory, no Exile ever returned to Taihao.
As Ming Yu introduced them, Xu Yan and the others gained more details about the Taihao Realm, becoming deeply interested in it and eager to explore the Martial Arts of Taihao.
"Ming Yu, how about the experts of Taihao? What about their Martial Arts?"
Xu Yan asked curiously.
"With your strength, you've already reached the peak of Taihao. A Master of Domain level strength is considered top-tier in Taihao; even though stronger individuals exist, they are few and far between. The strength of the Land of Imperishable actually surpasses that of Taihao."
Ming Yu laughed and said, "As for Martial Arts, I can only say it's not as wondrous as your Martial Arts."
Xu Yan nodded, showing no surprise, as his Martial Arts were taught by his master, who was a Daoist Ancestor!
"This is my Exquisite Jade Token. You can take a look; I hope it offers you some inspiration."
As she spoke, Ming Yu extended her hand in front of Xu Yan, and on her palm was the delicate Exquisite Jade Token.
"This is your heritage; as an outsider, I shouldn't look at it."
Xu Yan shook his head and said.
"The heritage of the Exquisite Jade Mountain can be viewed; I permit it. It is, after all, mine."
Ming Yu moved the Exquisite Jade Token closer to Xu Yan.
"In that case, I won't be polite."
Xu Yan reached out, pressed on the Exquisite Jade Token, and began to examine the martial heritage it contained, which came from Taihao.
"So, as I said, it's not as wondrous as your Martial Arts."
After Xu Yan withdrew his hand, Ming Yu put away the Exquisite Jade Token and spoke.
Xu Yan nodded. The inheritance of the Exquisite Jade Token contained martial arts that had their own wonders compared with Taicang Martial Arts, yet it was no match for Great Wilderness Martial Arts.
"The Exquisite Jade Token is the Supreme Treasure of the Exquisite Jade Mountain in Taihao—an elite sect in the Thirty-Three Heavens of Taihao, with a long-standing tradition and formidable strength. Every day, its subordinate sects carry on its heritage..."
Before Xu Yan could ask, Ming Yu began to recount the origins of the Exquisite Jade Token.
"The Exquisite Jade Token is one of the Taihao Divine Objects. Each Taihao Divine Object possesses its unique mystique, and only forces with these Divine Objects can be considered top-tier forces, also known as Divine Sects.
"The miracle of the Exquisite Jade Token is that it can pass its heritage directly to the next person or allow the bearer of the Exquisite Jade Token to recover their own memories and strength.
"And in Taihao, I was the seventh Sect Master of Exquisite Jade Mountain and also the seventh bearer of the Exquisite Jade Token. Thus, by finding the Exquisite Jade Token, I recovered my own memories."
As Ming Yu continued to recount, she did not mention why she ended up in the Land of Imperishable or how she became a Jade Puppet, clearly not wishing to revisit those topics.
Xu Yan did not inquire either, continuing to listen to Ming Yu's story.
"The entire Taihao possesses limited Divine Items, and nearly all are renowned throughout Taihao. Those who acquire a Divine Item can, barring untimely death, surely become a dominant figure and one of the top experts in the Thirty-Three Heavens. However, most Divine Items are claimed, so who knows where the unclaimed Divine Items are?
"And the greatest Divine Item in all of Taihao, or perhaps this world, is the legendary Taihao Divine Jade. But the whereabouts and even the existence of the Taihao Divine Jade have always been a mystery!"
At this point, her gaze turned toward the distance of the Land of Imperishable, her eyes filled with some speculation and doubt.
"I seem to know where the Taihao Divine Jade is, but I'm not certain, and it greatly differs from the legend!"
Ming Yu sighed and said.
"Is the Taihao Divine Jade really that wonderful?"
Xu Yan asked, a bit curious.
"All the Divine Items in the world combined do not compare to the Taihao Divine Jade. As for what mystique the Taihao Divine Jade holds, it's impossible to deduce, but there has always been a rumor that whoever obtains the Taihao Divine Jade will be invincible, capable of ruling the Taihao Realm!"
Ming Yu blinked, pondering for a moment, and said.
Xu Yan couldn't help but grow curious. Was the Taihao Divine Jade truly so extraordinary?
The Exquisite Jade Token was a Taihao Divine Object, and it ranked among the top Divine Objects. Still, in Xu Yan's view, although it had its wonders, it wasn't stronger than the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo nor stronger than his Prime Tortoise Carapace, nourished by the Way of Domain.
And yet, the Taihao Divine Jade was said to be unmatched by all the Divine Objects combined, and those who possessed it could become invincible, the ruler of Taihao?!
Since Ming Yu was unsure of the Taihao Divine Jade's existence, Xu Yan couldn't resist asking his master, "Master, is the Taihao Divine Jade very powerful? Could possessing it enable someone to rule Taihao?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1142 - 589: Ming Yu's Past, The Beginning of the Great Battle
chapters.content:
Li Xuan sat leisurely in his chair, sipping Spiritual Tea, eating Spirit Cake, and watching the combat on the battlefield, taking it as mere entertainment. The stronger one's strength, the higher the Realm, the more their state of mind tended towards the mundane.
To the strong, the battles of the weak were not worth a glance.
But for Li Xuan, who had reached the state of Returning to Nature, he watched the battles with keen interest through the eyes of an ordinary person. At this moment, he sighed, remembering his own past when he had carelessly misinformed Xu Yan about the Daoist ways being natural and about returning to their origins, about a state of mind almost akin to the Dao itself – it turned out there was such a thing.
Li Xuan felt that he had truly achieved that state of mind now, truly being above worldly affairs, traveling through the mundane world, with joy like that of an ordinary person.
"Perhaps this is because the loneliest of invincible beings devise their own ways to entertain themselves out of boredom,"
Li Xuan mumbled to himself.
Hearing Xu Yan's query, Li Xuan tossed another piece of Spirit Cake into his mouth and said, "So-so, of course, to the weak, it would surely be strong, but to me, it's not even comparable to my Jade Ruyi."
Xu Yan inwardly sighed, regretting asking his master about strength. In his master's eyes, nothing was considered strong; all could be dealt with a single slap.
Even King Chi Ni was crushed with just one hand.
Ming Yu looked curiously at Li Xuan, this was Xu Yan's master? That carefree and unrestrained demeanor, could he really be a Supreme Expert?
But the more he appeared so, the more Ming Yu believed that his strength must be terrifying. Even though he seemed casual and like an ordinary person, showing no aura of a strong being.
"Ming Yu pays respect to the senior!"
Ming Yu greeted with a bow.
"Hm, no need for such formalities!"
Li Xuan nodded, continuing to observe the great clash on the battlefield.
Ming Yu hesitated but ultimately did not voice her question, yet Xu Yan seemed to know what she wanted to ask and inquired; "Master, do you know where the Taihao Divine Jade is?"
Li Xuan lifted his teacup and took a sip of the Spiritual Tea, then pointed with his chin and said, "Isn't that it."
Xu Yan was stunned, following the gaze, and landing on the figure of the Master of the Jade Court, he was utterly shocked, "Master, are you saying that the Master of the Jade Court is the Taihao Divine Jade?"
"Correct!"
Li Xuan nodded.
Ming Yu was both surprised and not. She had her suspicions, but it was hard to believe - the legendary Taihao Divine Jade, known to possess Spiritual Wisdom, and its strength, truly terrifying.
"The Taihao Divine Jade, it not only has Spiritual Wisdom, but such enormous strength!"
Xu Yan was deeply shocked. No wonder it was said that whoever obtained the Taihao Divine Jade could become invincible and could rule over the Taihao; such rumors were evidently grounded.
"Those Jade Puppets…"
Xu Yan thought of the Jade Puppets of Yu Ting and Ming Yu's Jade Puppet body.
"Master, were the Jade Puppets created by the Taihao Divine Jade?"
Li Xuan smiled and said, "Not exactly 'created'; it is just a power of the Taihao Divine Jade. The Dao Principles of the Jade Puppets are derived from it. All the Jade Puppets are merely developments of his essence, likely out of loneliness, creating companions for himself."
He glanced at Ming Yu and continued; "Some of the Jade Puppets have Divine Souls, but these souls have become Jade Puppetized, those souls are the strong beings of Taihao who originally entered the Land of Imperishable."
Xu Yan also thought of something. Ming Yu had tried numerous times to regain her memory, always to lose it and start afresh. Could the Taihao Divine Jade not erase this behavior of Ming Yu, or did it choose not to deliberately?
"Ming Yu's Divine Soul…"
Li Xuan knew his apprentice wanted to ask something and spoke up; "This young lady's Divine Soul is quite whole, and she has a destiny with that piece of jade, so she's been indulged a bit, in a sense, letting her live a little more joyfully."
Ming Yu, upon hearing this, cocked her head, recalling some hidden memories, and said; "Speaking of which, each time I am about to find the Exquisite Jade Token, I would be taken back, and upon waking up, I start anew, happily."
"When the Domain appeared, I was also allowed to catch a glimpse of it, perhaps due to the Taihao, since the Domain shares similarities with Taihao."
"But I don't know when I became fated with the Taihao Divine Jade."
Then, Ming Yu seemed to find something in her memories; her expression changed slightly, "On my first day in the Taihao Realm, in the lowest layer, I sensed something unusual. That aura affected some cultivators, and I, using the Exquisite Jade Mountain Secret Technique, purged that unusual aura."
"When I was betrayed and critically wounded, on the brink of death, I sensed that unusual aura again, as if many cultivators were under its effect."
"I don't know what it was, but that aura gave an unpleasant feeling. I felt like I was about to die, and those people were preparing to seize the Exquisite Jade Token."
"As if a voice in the depths of my mind urged me to flee to the Land of No Return, the great battle wasn't far from that place. I don't understand how, but I was suddenly determined, even risking death, not letting them succeed, and I exploded myself, sending a wisp of my Divine Soul with the Exquisite Jade Token into the Land of Imperishable."
"Given my nature, faced with betrayal, faced with that situation, I would only become totally disillusioned, losing such a resolute thought. I don't understand why I became so resolute at that time."
Ming Yu opened up her hidden memories once more, uncovering some unusual aspects, and though they seemed complete, upon reflection, they were still somewhat incomplete.
For instance, how she became resolute enough to explode herself, and with a wisp of her Divine Soul carrying the Exquisite Jade Token to escape into the Land of Imperishable – that part of the memory was missing.

chapters.title: Chapter 1143 - 589: Ming Yu's Past, The Beginning of the Great Battle_2
chapters.content:
```
And, at the base of Taihao, what exactly was that unusual aura? There was no detailed memory of it.
These various signs, besides the fact that her strand of Divine Soul was incomplete, leading to gaps in memory, perhaps another reason was that the Exquisite Jade Token had been tampered with by someone, making it impossible for Ming Yu to recall detailed memories even after retrieving the Exquisite Jade Token.
And the only one capable of tampering with the Exquisite Jade Token, this Taihao Divine Object, was the Master of the Jade Court, Taihao Divine Jade!
What Ming Yu couldn't understand was why he would do this.
However, Li Xuan caught a crucial piece of information from Ming Yu's words. Had she sensed an unusual aura at the base of the Taihao Realm?
How unusual?
"This Taihao Realm seems to have some issues as well."
Thinking of this, Li Xuan glanced at the Black Chi King and the Master of the Jade Court. These two were ancient, one had certain connections with the Land of Imperishable's rules, being among the first batch of True Spirits in the Land of Imperishable, and had devoured the other True Spirits to monopolize the initial Creation of the Land of Imperishable.
The other was the Taihao Divine Jade, deeply associated with Taihao, yet hiding within the Land of Imperishable, clearly with a purpose.
These two were likely secretly assisting the Indestructible Divine Master, wanting to use the Indestructible Divine Master's hand to observe the changes in Taihao, to peek at what was happening in Taihao.
Clearly, they had noticed some unusual changes in the Taihao Realm.
Ming Yu also realized that something might have changed in the Taihao Realm. She began searching through her memories for answers, recounting her experiences in the Taihao Realm, the influence of the Exquisite Jade Mountain, and even her past betrayals and schemes.
Xu Yan and the others silently listened, as Ming Yu spoke, their understanding of the Taihao Realm deepened, and they gained more insight into the Exquisite Jade Mountain, even touching on some of its secret matters.
Ming Yu seemed to be using her narration to constantly trigger her memory, to keep recalling, hoping to find some clues, to find answers.
As time passed in Ming Yu's recounting, the battles on the battlefield continued without stopping. Meng Chong, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping had never left the battlefield, continuously fighting, as if they would never tire, as if they had endless resources, while the Indestructible Divine Master grew more grave.
Su Lingxiu also went to the battlefield to gain some battle experience. Through this series of battles, the strength of the Great Wilderness's experts had also improved, but the Indestructible Divine Master also learned about the strength of the Great Wilderness.
At this moment, he felt slightly reassured, confident in defeating the Great Wilderness and invading it!
Even though the Great Wilderness hadn't gone all out, neither had he, not to mention the True Spirits behind the Jade Court and Black Chi King.
The only thing that made the Indestructible Divine Master doubt was whether the mysterious Daoist Ancestor would truly adhere to the rules and not intervene. If the person destroyed the rules and intervened, he would be powerless.
Facing such a terrifying existence, he could do nothing but harbor impotent rage, nothing but bury his resentment deeply within.
"You are so powerful, an ancient predecessor, you should be trustworthy, right?"
The Indestructible Divine Master mumbled to himself, as if self-comforting.
The feeling of time's passing grew increasingly strong, and the Land of Chaotic Imperishable even exuded a sense of vicissitude, seemingly indicating that an era was about to end, and a new era was about to begin.
Ming Yu eventually finished telling everything she could, yet she hadn't found the answer she sought, falling silent as she looked toward the distant Master of the Jade Court. Perhaps only he knew the answer.
Then, as if thinking of something, she looked at the leisurely Li Xuan and spoke, "Senior..."
Li Xuan naturally knew what she wanted to ask, but he didn't know either, so he waved his hand and said, "The past is like a cloud of smoke, why dwell on it? For now, those things are of no use to you. If you truly want to know, once your strength reaches a certain level, everything will become clear naturally. Why ask more?"
"Senior is right!"
Ming Yu blinked her eyes a few times, showing a smile and nodding.
She then sealed those memories away again, forgetting her former self, to become a new Ming Yu!
The battles on the battlefield continued, as Tian Zi silently watched, not taking action. Only when a true great battle arrived would he intervene, for the Heavenly Dao was the greatest shield against attacks.
The chaotic state of the Land of Imperishable gradually faded, the cycle of time pressed on, and the Next Era was about to arrive.
"Daoist Ancestor, the rules you set, do they still hold?"
The Indestructible Divine Master asked in a deep, resonant voice.
"Naturally!"
Li Xuan nodded with a smile, but he added, "The Great Wilderness Heavenly Path is the root of the Domain. The Majesty of the Heavenly Path's strength depends on the Domain, to be honest with you, it has surpassed the Master of Domain level."
Saying this, he glanced at Xu Yan and smilingly said, "I'll allow you to use someone above the Master of Domain level, but not exceeding the Majesty of the Heavenly Path as a limit."
"Good!"
Upon hearing this, the Indestructible Divine Master felt a surge of reassurance.
"Daoist Ancestor Senior, if someone above the Master of Domain level intervenes, how can we win?"
Tian Zi couldn't help but feel a bit frustrated as he spoke.
"I will stop the opponent. I need to seize this opportunity to break through to the Creation Realm."
Xu Yan, however, spoke calmly.
He knew, this was his master's way of setting up an opponent for him, allowing him to further hone himself for the breakthrough to the Creation Realm.
"I will help you too,"
Ming Yu looked at Tian Zi solemnly and said, "It would be such a pity if the Domain was destroyed!"
"Thank you!"
Tian Zi felt slightly relieved, knowing that Ming Yu's strength was formidable.
"The time has come, it's time to act. Master of the Jade Court, you should contribute too, Black Chi King, those True Spirits should be deployed as well."
The Indestructible Divine Master looked at the Master of the Jade Court and the Black Chi King and spoke in a deep voice.
The Master of the Jade Court pondered, seemingly weighing something, before finally speaking, "Alright."
The Black Chi King shook his head and said, "If all these True Spirits die, the True Spirit strength of the Land of Imperishable will experience a significant decline. Moreover, with each new era, some True Spirits perish; I won't deploy them all, but will dispatch eighty percent, giving it our all."
The Indestructible Divine Master frowned, wanting to say more, but the Black Chi King continued, "Eighty percent is plenty. If eighty percent cannot secure victory, sending the remaining twenty percent would just be throwing them to their death. Of course, if the situation truly requires just a bit more strength to secure victory, I'll send the remainder."
"That will work."
Having said this, the Black Chi King was not pressed further by the Indestructible Divine Master. As for the Gargantuan Gluttonous King, he ignored it entirely, for the timid and gluttonous Gargantuan Gluttonous King had been too frightened by King Chi Ni's demise to muster any courage to partake.
"Make your move. Whether we succeed depends on this attempt."
The Indestructible Divine Master spoke solemnly to the group of gray-robed figures.
Led by a figure surpassing the Master of Domain level, the elite of the Imperishable Temple stepped forth, their energies linking up, creating a powerful presence that shook the Land of Imperishable, moving forward like an advancing army, pressing toward the Great Wilderness.
Buzz!
The Heavenly Dao Rules manifested, and the Majesty of the Heavenly Path flowed grandly.
Behind the Master of the Jade Court, one by one, Jade Puppets appeared, their Divine Souls and thoughts operating based on those of the Taihao Realm's exiles.
Roar!
Behind the Black Chi King, True Spirits roared as they stepped forward, resembling a beast tide, beginning their approach toward the Great Wilderness.
"Everyone, the future of the Great Wilderness, whether it continues to grow strong or one day shall the Heavenly Path tear through Chaos, and on that day, reach Taihao Realm, even swallow Taihao Realm, depends on this battle."
Tian Zi looked at the Great Wilderness's experts and spoke solemnly.
"Understood, it's a fight to the death, but with pills to restore our injuries and replenish our resources, victory will surely be ours."
Taikun spoke with a deep voice.
Another great battle loomed, and this time, it was more intense than the previous one.
"Ah, this old turtle shall also make a move!"
The Azure Sea Turtle sighed but knew that they, the strong ones, could not avoid this battle.
Emanating a blue luminescence, in an instant, a gigantic turtle appeared in mid-air. The Azure Sea Turtle looked at Old Man Xiao and Yu Yao, saying, "I'll handle the defense, act as your shield, but if the attack is too intense, you'll need to share some of the burden."
"Alright!"
Old Man Xiao and the others nodded.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1144 - 590 The War Begins
chapters.content:
Meng Chong, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping also returned from the battlefield to the Great Wilderness to prepare for the real battle ahead.
"I taught you the Great Formation, and you've all mastered it by now, right? A mere connection of Qi, what's that? Let the Divine Temple see what true formations are."
Fang Hao looked at the group of Realm Master Realm experts and said.
"We will not disappoint Sect Master Fang. Let them see how we set up formations to withstand attacks from the Master of Domain!"
The group of Realm Masters said solemnly.
They all left a wisp of their Divine Soul in the Great Wilderness. As long as the Great Wilderness was not destroyed, they could reincarnate and rise again. They believed that with the merit from protecting the domain this time, they would gain the Heavenly Dao's protection.
