Upon rebirth, they could quickly regain their strength and potential, and even become stronger.
Boom!
"Fight!"
The Witch Demon let out a cold laugh, battle intent surging. Ao Hong directly transformed into his True Dragon form, and Ao Lie also revealed his True Dragon body. Besides them, there was another True Dragon, that being Yu Xiaolong.
A toad as giant as a mountain stood outside the domain, its size not inferior to the Azure Sea Turtle.
The Red Cat looked up longingly at Li Xuan, wanting to join the battle. It was a Great Demon King; how could it miss the great war?
Li Xuan chuckled, "Alright, if you want to join in, go ahead."
Since the Red Cat wanted to act, he let it be.
Thus, Li Xuan, Cai Ling'er, and a few others moved onto the Flying Boat, leisurely watching the battlefield, anticipating the battles to come.
Boom!
The battle began. True Spirits surged forward with overwhelming momentum. Among the True Spirits, gray and jade-white figures flickered and launched attacks.
The leading gray-clad figure exuded an incredibly powerful aura, slicing through chaos with a cold beam aimed at the Great Wilderness.
"Hmph!"
Tian Zi let out a cold snort, and with a roar, the majesty of the Heavenly Path manifested. With a wave of his hand, purple lightning erupted, scattering the attack.
Having exchanged blows, both sides gauged each other's strength.
Tian Zi looked slightly grave as he turned to Xu Yan.
"Not a big deal!"
Xu Yan chuckled lightly, taking a step forward. In an instant, overwhelming Sword Light appeared, and Sword Intent filled the battlefield. The Imperishable Qi and violent Spiritual Energy transformed into countless Sword Rays.
Roar!
With a dragon's roar, eighteen Golden Giant Dragons emerged, roaring and coiling in the battlefield. Witnessing this scene left Ao Hong and his father somewhat hurt and depressed.
Buzz!
Images of Domain emerged, with Yin and Yang Sword Light swirling, eternal and unending.
The gray-clad attacker froze momentarily, gazing at Xu Yan with suspicion. Such formidable strength! Although weaker than himself, for some reason, he had a gut feeling that he couldn't breach the opponent's defense.
"Your opponent is me!"
Xu Yan said with a radiant smile.
Before they could exchange blows, the eighteen Golden Giant Dragons crashed into the advancing True Spirit Horde. In an instant, like a crushing force, they swiftly annihilated eighteen True Spirits and engulfed them, returning to the Great Wilderness.
Su Lingxiu raised her hands and directly refined alchemy in the void.
Qing Yu revealed its true form, the Qing Ling Jade Bamboo standing tall among chaos, providing vitality to aid strong warriors in recovering from injuries.
The Indestructible Divine Master looked at Xu Yan, frowning deeply.
This individual's strength was enough to sweep across the Master of Domain Realm. What shocked him even more was that Xu Yan's realm appeared not to have surpassed the domain of the Master of Domain. Yet the formidable killing power was beyond what a Master of Domain could possess.
At that moment, he thought of Taicang.
But except for the last moment when Taicang took a step forward, before that, Taicang's power and ruthless ferocity were not as remarkable as Xu Yan's.
"Is this the confidence of the Daoist Ancestor?"
The Indestructible Divine Master mused inwardly.
"Xu Yan, the guy who led Ming Yu astray, is truly remarkable!"
The Master of the Jade Court sighed.
Boom!
Xu Yan clashed with the gray-clad figure. The gray-clad figure dared not delay. If he didn't suppress Xu Yan soon, the charging True Spirits might suffer great damage.
Roar!
A roar erupted, and the Red Cat transformed into a Splendid Giant Tiger, standing on its hind legs, sword in hand, demon energy surging, and demon majesty overwhelming. It directly charged into the True Spirit ranks.
At this moment, the Black Chi King's expression changed slightly. That overwhelming presence seemed to intimidate the True Spirits slightly. Facing the Splendid Giant Tiger, they lost their usual ferocity and gained a touch of fear.
Caw!
Following closely, the mountain-sized Mountain Devourer Toad also exuded rolling demon energy and demon majesty.
And that True Dragon with a green back and white belly emitted demon majesty, with demon energy rolling, differing from Ao Hong and his father's True Dragon Qi.
From the start of the exchange, Xu Yan fell into a disadvantage. Even though he exerted his full strength, even wielding his nurtured Precious Sword, he was still suppressed. However, the gray-clad figure could not breach Xu Yan's Yin Yang Undying Sword defense and was tightly bound.
On the battlefield, the Realm Masters formed a Great Formation, unleashing battle power far exceeding the Realm Master Level, astonishingly withstanding several attacks from the Masters of Domain. This also left the Indestructible Divine Master in awe.
"What Dharma is that, truly so profound!"
The Azure Sea Turtle, like a giant shield, assisted in the defense of Old Man Xiao, Yu Yao, Cang Lie, and Jiang Feng. Even with its powerful defense, it struggled to withstand the bombardment.
"Quick, the left side, block the left side!"
"The middle, the middle, quickly help block it!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1145 - 590 The Great Battle Begins_2
chapters.content:
Azure Sea Turtle kept calling.
Boom!
Meng Chong transformed into a giant, even larger than during the previous battle, truly like a Heavenly God descending. He wielded a large blade, wind and thunder roared around him, as he charged into the True Spirit horde alone, slashing wherever the blade flashed, decimating True Spirits.
Several Jade Puppets surrounded Meng Chong to block his attacks, making the battle fiercer than ever.
Jiang Buping held the Divine Spear, and his figure seemed to diffuse at that moment. Whenever a cold light burst forth, a True Spirit Divine Soul would be annihilated.
Fang Hao stepped forward, opening the Weapon Box. The momentum of the Land of Imperishable, the Domain Incredible Formation, and the Great Slaughter Formation were unleashed at that moment. A torrent of ten thousand weapons charged toward the True Spirit horde, halting its momentum in only a short time.
At this moment, the battle was exceptionally fierce. The strong warriors of the Great Wilderness were continuously injured, yet they were unafraid, consuming pills to recover their energy. Green light descended, reviving them in an instant.
With Su Lingxiu and Qing Yu providing logistical support, even though there were fewer strong warriors, they withstood the first wave of the assault, especially Meng Chong. His formidable physical body feared no attack, and he single-handedly restrained over a dozen Master of Domain level experts with various Divine Skills.
The Indestructible Divine Master's expression turned grim. The strength of the Great Wilderness was unexpected, especially Xu Yan and Meng Chong. They were almost crushing in the Master of Domain level.
Nonetheless, some True Spirits managed to reach the Great Wilderness. However, they could not breach the Heavenly Barrier amidst the purple thunder.
The battle continued fiercely. The strong warriors of the Divine Temple were driven to madness. Some True Spirits revealed their fierce nature, burning their origin to unleash violent power.
Boom!
The Witch Demon was sent flying backward, coughing up blood incessantly. A beam of green light descended, stabilizing his aura and healing his wounds. A consumed pill quickly restored his energy. Roaring in anger, he charged back into the fray.
Bang!
Ao Hong was entangled and bitten by several True Spirits. With a furious roar, he unleashed the True Dragon Technique frantically, sparing no energy to severely wound the True Spirits and break free. However, he was riddled with injuries. A beam of green light descended, and after swallowing a pill, he was brimming with fighting spirit once more, rejoining the battle.
In the battlefield, Jiang Buping stood as the sharp edge of the slaughter. His Extreme Soul Martial Arts specialized in killing Divine Souls. Whether True Spirits or strong warriors of the Divine Temple, their Divine Soul defenses were relatively weak when facing him.
Even the True Spirits with natural powers related to Divine Souls were passive when confronting Jiang Buping, watching their Divine Souls torn asunder and retreating with howls of anguish.
The Indestructible Divine Master was extremely grim. Xu Yan was held back, and the most lethal was surprisingly this Divine Soul Warrior. He had to be stopped!
Thinking of this, he involuntarily glanced at the Master of the Jade Court.
The Master of the Jade Court shook his head, powerless to act, unable to surpass the Master of Domain, unable to resist such methods against Divine Souls.
A shadow walked out from the Indestructible Divine Master's body. It was his shadow self.
However, this shadow self was clearly not complete, just a part of it, but it was at the peak of the Master of Domain level, nearly breaking through to the Master of Domain.
Yet, it remained within the allowed bounds.
Whoosh!
The shadow self joined the battle, heading straight towards Jiang Buping.
The Great Wilderness kept facing assaults, but none could break through the Heavenly Barrier. As the battle raged on, Xu Yan and Jiang Buping were held back, and Meng Chong was also restrained, with Fang Hao resisting part of it.
The remaining attacks were too much for the rest of the strong warriors of the Great Wilderness to withstand!
Numerically, they were at a disadvantage.
Boom!
A beam of light returned to the Great Wilderness. One of the Realm Masters forming the Great Formation had fallen.
With the first Realm Master's fall, the power of the Great Formation declined. Then the second Realm Master fell.
They were not Masters of Domain, and even relying on the Great Formation's power to resist some Masters of Domain, they couldn't last long in such a grand battle.
Yet, no Realm Master retreated, persisting on. They all understood that retreat could lead to unpredictable consequences. But dying in battle, as long as the Great Wilderness remained unvanquished, they were the heroes of the Domain, sheltered by the Heavenly Dao's merit, and would return in a new life, stronger and traversing further.
Having no choice left, they chose to fight to the death!
Ming Yu focused intently on Xu Yan's battle. Sword Intent crisscrossed, as if the heavens and earth were overturned, and all beings appeared and vanished at times. Yet, even with all his might, he was still suppressed by the gray-robed person.
However, the gray-robed person could not break Xu Yan's defenses either, merely holding the upper hand but unable to achieve true victory. It was imaginable how frustrated the gray-robed person was at that moment.
"I should make my move as well."
Ming Yu looked at the Great Wilderness. At this moment, the Domain of the Great Wilderness was mighty with the majesty of the Heavenly Path. Purple thunder spread out to resist the incoming True Spirits and strong warriors of the Divine Temple.
Silver-white light surged from Ming Yu's body, holding a delicate Jade Seal in her hand. She stepped forward gracefully, like a stunning beauty emerging from moonlight.
Buzz!
A surge of aura not belonging to the Land of Imperishable, vast and clear, broke through Chaos, forming a pathway seemingly paved with moonlight, stretching towards the battlefield.
The might of the Taihao Divine Object!
This scene drew the attention of both warring sides, each casting their gaze upon Ming Yu.
Swish!
Ming Yu directly confronted a gray-robed person. The moonlight-like radiance shone down, and the delicate Exquisite Jade Token emitted beams of light, transforming into numerous small mountains, bombing down densely.
"Taihao Divine Object!"
The gray-robed person's expression shifted slightly, scrambling to fend off the attack, but in the face of Ming Yu's assault, he quickly fell into a disadvantage. In moments, he was struck by a small mountain, severely injured, sent flying away on the spot.
Additionally, a beam of moonlight seemed to invade his body, causing a faint silver-white glow to emanate from within, as his aura continued to weaken.
Alarmed, he hurriedly retreated.
Ming Yu did not pursue, instead targeting another gray-robed person.
"Ming Yu, was it necessary?"
The Master of the Jade Court sighed lightly.
"The Exquisite Jade Token, living up to its name."
The Indestructible Divine Master's expression slightly darkened. He looked at the Master of the Jade Court and asked, "Which generation from the Exquisite Jade Mountain is she from?"
"The seventh wielder of the Exquisite Jade Token."
Behind the Master of the Jade Court, a Jade Person stepped forward, also shrouded in silver-white glow, immediately flying out to intercept Ming Yu.
The battle persisted, growing ever more intense. Such high-intensity warfare, apart from Meng Chong, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping, was almost too much for the others to bear.
"Come back, adopt a defensive strategy."
Tian Zi noted solemnly.
Relying on the majesty of the Heavenly Path for support, and with Fang Hao's Great Formation activated, it was sufficient to guard the Great Wilderness.
By holding the Great Wilderness until the Next Era opened, they would achieve victory.
Hearing this, Witch Demon and others could only retreat, returning to the range extended by the Heavenly Path, continuing to resist the assault.
Yet, Meng Chong, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping did not retreat, continuing their battle at the front, holding off part of the strong warriors.
Li Xuan watched Xu Yan. Although continually suppressed by the gray-robed person and nearly injured several times, Xu Yan gradually stabilized the situation through continuous combat, rendering escape impossible for the gray-robed person.
"The Creation Realm."
Xu Yan was just a step away from the Creation Realm, but that step wasn't easily crossed.
After all, it was the breakthrough into a Great Realm, and the Creation Realm was so profound and mighty.
Thinking of this, Li Xuan's voice reached Xu Yan's ear: "Creating Domain, Creating Beings, Creating Self. Use one's Dao to transform the root of Creation, gather the essence of Domain, and sense the Creation of the Great Obscure Dao, with the intention of the Great Dao, become Creation..."
Like the sound of the Great Dao, it entered Xu Yan's ear in the heat of battle, giving him insight.
After providing guidance, Li Xuan continued to leisurely observe the battle.
Yu Xiaolong and Little Ha also retreated within the range of the Heavenly Path's extension, assisting in defense. Meanwhile, Red Cat remained in combat, at one point leading several True Spirits back to become part of the Great Wilderness's defensive strength.
Seeing this, the Black Chi King was both surprised and puzzled. Red Cat could cause those True Spirits to break free from the will of their bloodline and no longer follow his commands, instead turning to support the Great Wilderness. This Splendid Tiger was indeed extraordinary.
The Indestructible Divine Master watched quietly, his expression calm, no anxiety in sight, as though victory was within reach. Even though the Great Wilderness remained securely defended, with no signs of being breached, he showed no impatience at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 1146 - 591: Offense and Defense, the Netherworld's Schemes
chapters.content:
```
"Let's all make our move."
The Indestructible Divine Master said coldly.
The Divine Temple suddenly moved, drawing closer to the Great Wilderness Domain, and several figures emerged from within, joining the battlefield one after another.
Tian Zi saw this, and her brow furrowed slightly. There were still Masters of the Domain within the Divine Temple who hadn't acted, and behind the Black Chi King, there was also a group of True Spirits yet to join the battle.
Looking at Xu Yan, the battle continued. Although he managed to stall the gray-cloaked individual, Xu Yan was also unable to strike, which meant that the Great Wilderness lost a formidable force capable of crushing the enemy.
Although Meng Chong was incredibly powerful, able to eliminate ordinary Masters of the Domain with just a few punches, his prowess in slaughter and his overwhelming force against the enemy was ultimately inferior to Xu Yan.
Furthermore, Meng Chong was currently engaged in continuous combat with several Jade Persons and True Spirits, unable to spare himself.
Jiang Buping's Slaughter the Soul was extraordinarily fierce, yet he was entangled by the two shadow bodies of the Indestructible Divine Master and three True Spirits.
Fang Hao held off some of the strong opponents, but the rest was left to them.
"The Heavenly Dao surpassed the Masters of the Domain, but it could not withstand the bombardment of so many Masters of the Domain. However, with the help of Witch Demons and others, it was still defensible. If more powerful forces joined, it might become hard to bear. They must activate the Great Formation."
Tian Zi silently calculated.
The strong of the Great Wilderness were ultimately too few.
All those Realm Masters had died in battle, reincarnated.
Tian Zi looked at Su Lingxiu. As fellow true disciples of Daoist Ancestor, she practiced the Alchemical Medical Martial Arts, seemingly not adept at fighting, but that was relative to Xu Yan and the others.
"Lingxiu, if necessary, you must step in."
Tian Zi said as she approached Su Lingxiu.
"Alright, if it really can't hold, I'll step in. Don't worry, I'm quite powerful."
Su Lingxiu thought for a moment and said.
"Daoist Ancestor, I feel under great pressure!"
Tian Zi complained to Li Xuan.
"What pressure could there be? The Next Era is not far from commencing."
Li Xuan said with a smile.
"What do you mean?"
Tian Zi was taken aback.
"The commencement of the Next Era will happen sooner. They haven't realized it yet."
Li Xuan looked at the Indestructible Divine Master, who seemed confident of victory, and said with a slight smile.
"You mean?"
Tian Zi's eyes lit up as she looked at the Indestructible Divine Master. Clearly, the other party was calculating time, preparing to launch the most powerful strike at the crucial moment to break through the Great Wilderness Heavenly Path's defense.
However, the Indestructible Divine Master did not know the commencement of the Next Era had been moved up, and they had not realized it; it might come even before the time he estimated.
Thus, the Indestructible Divine Master would miss the timing, which meant the Great Wilderness would be preserved.
"I understand."
Tian Zi turned and went to find Muxiao.
"Muxiao, you need to make your move."
"Isn't... that not good?"
Muxiao said, taken aback.
"You are now part of the Great Wilderness, a disciple of Daoist Ancestor. Why shouldn't you act?"
Tian Zi said solemnly.
Now, she didn't want to miss out on any fighting strength.
Muxiao glanced at the distant Indestructible Divine Master, nodded, and said, "Alright, then I'll make my move!"
With a step, Muxiao appeared on the battlefield in an instant, sweeping the air with a broom, a force of sweeping power burst forth, sending a gray-robed man flying.
"Muxiao!"
The strong of the Divine Temple were shocked and filled with anger.
"You traitor!"
Muxiao's strength, not considered strong among the Masters of the Domain within the Divine Temple, only excelled in commanding True Spirits. They hadn't anticipated that the traitorous Muxiao's strength had grown so significantly, reaching the peak realm of the Masters of the Domain.
Moreover, his power seemed to have transformed.
The sweeping force appeared to wipe out all attacks, as well as the enemy's strength and life.
"I have swept away the wrath in my heart, and I am no longer who I was. With the mercy of Daoist Ancestor, I have achieved transcendence. How can it be betrayal? Rather, it's you. Don't let your wrath be so great; the world is so beautiful, yet you want to destroy it. Such a poisonous mind cannot be!"
Muxiao said calmly, swinging the broom, fighting alone against two gray-robed individuals without falling behind.
In the distance, the Indestructible Divine Master's eyes were dark, his heart filled with anger, but also shocked by the significant enhancement of Muxiao's strength.
Ao Hong and Witch Demon were differently shocked. Muxiao's strength was not formidable. To kill him was not difficult. However, the current strength of Muxiao had become so powerful that they felt a pressure.
"Muxiao was guided by my invincible ancestor. To have such a creation, it's truly a joy and celebration!"
Ao Hong exclaimed.
"Ao Hong, I didn't expect your face to be so thick!"
Witch Demon sighed.
"This is not thick-skinned; this is called seizing the opportunity!"
Ao Hong laughed.
"You should also make your move."
On the mountaintop, Netherworld stared at the Divine Temple for a long time before speaking to Blood Demon.
"Big brother, do you have confidence?"
Blood Demon asked worriedly.
"Rest assured."
Netherworld nodded.
"In that case, I will go!"
Blood Demon took a deep breath, transforming into a streak of blood light, shooting toward the Great Wilderness.
"Blood Extreme, come fight, our grievances should be settled!"
Blood Demon roared.
Upon hearing this, Blood Extreme raised an eyebrow. Blood Demon, this guy, had a rebellious nature. Having seen the power of the Daoist Ancestor, even the Indestructible Divine Master bowed his head. Was he now seeking allegiance?
Or was he trying to convey some information?
After all, they had once shared a body, had shared the Divine Soul. Blood Extreme understood Blood Demon better, so he immediately sneered, "Then let's settle it, who's afraid of whom!"
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1147 - 591 Attack and Defense, Netherworld's Planning_2
chapters.content:
```
Blood Extreme transformed into a ray of light, charging toward the Blood Demon, and the two clashed with a thunderous battle. The moment they engaged, waves of blood surged violently as if they were fighting to the death.
But because they were familiar with each other, no matter how intense the battle became, they always knew their limits and kept it under control.
"Blood Demon, are you here to join us?"
"What are you talking about? How is it called joining? My brother is the Netherworld, one of the Seven Great Domains, and a brother to Taicang. Naturally, I, Blood Demon, belong to the Taicang side, merely acting as a double agent within the Divine Temple."
Blood Demon said righteously.
Blood Extreme rolled his eyes; Blood Demon was indeed shameless.
"You don't openly declare your stance but instead challenge me—do you have information? Your brother, the Netherworld, hasn't come. Is he being restrained by the Divine Master and unable to come?"
Blood Extreme curiously asked.
"My brother is attempting something extremely dangerous."
Blood Demon sighed with some worry.
"What dangerous thing? Could it be, he plans to ambush the Divine Master? I don't mean to look down on your brother, my former follower, but while his strength isn't weak, facing the Divine Master would be a different story. The Divine Master could slap him to death, right?"
Blood Extreme said in surprise.
"What nonsense! How could my brother ambush the Divine Master? Isn't that courting death?"
Blood Demon said solemnly and heavily, "Do you know where Taicang's corpse went after he died?"
Blood Extreme was taken aback by these words. They all knew Taicang had fallen, but no one ever mentioned his body. Perhaps, they all believed Taicang's body no longer existed.
"Could it be, your brother wants to find Taicang's body?"
Blood Extreme was utterly surprised.
"It's not about finding Taicang's body; rather, he wants to steal Taicang's remains and bury them back in the Taicang Domain."
Blood Demon sighed again and said, "The Taicang's Corpse is in the Divine Temple. You know how dangerous that is."
"So what do you want me to do?"
Blood Extreme looked toward the Divine Temple and asked deeply.
"Tell Tian Zi, tell the Witch Demon, let them assist as much as possible, and prepare to receive Taicang's remains."
Blood Demon said in a deep voice.
Since his brother dared to take the risk, evidently, he had some assurance.
"Alright!"
Blood Extreme nodded.
Boom!
Amid the fierce battle, Blood Extreme was blasted away with a punch, spewing blood from his mouth, and "embarrassingly" retreated back into the Great Wilderness Heavenly Path.
Blood Demon laughed wildly, blood waves surging and joining the battlefield, attacking the Heavenly Path defenses alongside the Night Princess.
After hearing Blood Extreme's report, Tian Zi became excited, and soon Qing Yu, Witch Demon, and other elders all knew of the Netherworld's intention to bring back Taicang's remains.
"Then let's lend a hand!"
Tian Zi took a deep breath, surrounded by purple lightning. Step by step, he walked out of the Heavenly Path, with auras growing increasingly powerful. With a wave of his hand, the purple lightning slew a True Spirit.
Immediately, a vortex swirled before Tian Zi, with Yin Yang Reincarnation, endless and eternal. All incoming attacks seemed to spin around and were diverted elsewhere.
The Indestructible Divine Master raised an eyebrow, looking at that young man, his expression changing slightly. He murmured to himself, "Tian Zi!"
Tian Zi stood outside the Heavenly Path, gazing coldly at the distant Indestructible Divine Master but said nothing, just staring quietly.
On that peak, the Netherworld stood up, looking toward the Divine Temple, estimating how long it would take to enter the temple and bring out Taicang's remains before the Indestructible Divine Master could intervene.
The Gargantuan Gluttonous King, initially lying afar, raised its head at this moment, looking at the Indestructible Divine Master with a somewhat conflicted expression. Then it glanced towards the direction of the Great Wilderness.
After a while, as if making a decision, it slowly moved its body, inching closer to the Indestructible Divine Master. Its demeanor remained timid, yet with a touch of furtiveness.
Black Chi King gave the Gargantuan Gluttonous King a sidelong glance, puzzled about what the Gargantuan Gluttonous King intended, joining the Great Wilderness and attacking the Indestructible Divine Master?
Although that mysterious Daoist Ancestor was strong, to ally with them and become a steed didn't fit the Gargantuan Gluttonous King's character, for it enjoyed freedom. How could it be willing to be commanded?
"Threatened? Or made some deal?"
Black Chi King pondered silently.
The Indestructible Divine Master had been watching the Great Wilderness fight, seemingly unaware of the Gargantuan Gluttonous King's subtle moves. Black Chi King hesitated about whether to warn, but then dismissed the thought.
The Indestructible Divine Master surely had a plan; perhaps all this was part of his arrangement.
The Master of the Jade Court remained composed, seemingly unaware of the Gargantuan Gluttonous King's subtle moves, watching the battlefield intently, focusing on Ming Yu's fight.
The Gargantuan Gluttonous King continued moving its body inch by inch, glancing at Black Chi King, noticing it had no intention to warn the Indestructible Divine Master. It felt slightly assured.
It kept moving its body, getting closer and closer to the Indestructible Divine Master. Approaching further would alert the Indestructible Divine Master, but the current distance should suffice.
Thus, the Gargantuan Gluttonous King remained lying down, facing the Indestructible Divine Master, slowly opening its mouth. To avoid detection, it opened its mouth extremely slowly, gradually opening wider.
When its giant mouth fully opened, revealing its white teeth, it began to wait, seemingly waiting for a chance.
The Netherworld moved, leaving the peak and shooting towards the Divine Temple, incredibly fast. Although the temple was some distance from the Indestructible Divine Master and relatively close to his own peak, and its entrance faced the Great Wilderness, not the Indestructible Divine Master,
It couldn't escape the Indestructible Divine Master's notice. The Netherworld knew he couldn't hide it from the Indestructible Divine Master, and time was short; he had to retrieve Taicang's remains in the briefest moment.
"Xue Yu, what are you doing?"
The Indestructible Divine Master's expression turned cold.
Roar!
At that moment, a giant mouth, accompanied by terrifying force, aimed to devour him!
Suddenly encountering an attack, the Indestructible Divine Master's expression changed, and he swiftly dodged out of the giant mouth's enclosure, turning to strike back with a palm.
Within his palm, the sun, moon, and stars appeared, transforming into a powerful attack aimed at the Gargantuan Gluttonous King.
"Gargantuan Gluttonous King, what are you doing?"
The Indestructible Divine Master roared in anger.
"Tasting you to see if you're delicious!"
The Gargantuan Gluttonous King quivered, pouncing again, terrifying power shaking the Land of Imperishable. In an instant, the Indestructible Divine Master and the Gargantuan Gluttonous King engaged in battle.
This sudden change shocked the Divine Temple's strong ones. The Gargantuan Gluttonous King actually attacked the Divine Master?
The Divine Temple's powerful ones on the battlefield couldn't help but look back. Blood Demon was equally shocked. Could his brother have secretly contacted the Gargantuan Gluttonous King for help?
How did he manage that?
Or did the Great Wilderness secretly contact the Gargantuan Gluttonous King?
But judging by the Gargantuan Gluttonous King's action, it was clearly premeditated, not a decision made in a short time. So it was highly likely his brother contacted them secretly.
Blood Demon knew it was time to act. He had already made clear his defection from the Divine Temple.
Casting a glance at the Night Princess fighting alongside him, Blood Demon felt murderous intent surge but held back, waiting for an opportunity to cooperate and instantly slay her with Blood Refining.
The Night Princess and Dousan had deep conflicts with his brother, targeting him more than once. Today, she must die!
Blood Extreme suddenly abandoned his opponent nearby and charged over, yelling, "Blood Demon, come, fight again!"
"As if I'm afraid of you!"
Blood Demon snorted coldly, then messaged the Night Princess, "I know his weak spot. Later, you attack and help me kill him!"
"Alright!"
The Night Princess didn't think much, not expecting Blood Demon to dare betray the Divine Temple so boldly.
Boom!
As soon as Blood Demon and Blood Extreme clashed, they fought intensely. At some moment, the Night Princess seemed to find an opening, darting into the Blood Sea, and fiercely attacked Blood Extreme.
Just then, a hand suddenly pierced through her body from behind, and Blood Extreme took the opportunity to strike, piercing her from the front. In that instant, both Blood Demon and Blood Extreme's attacks converged on her.
The Night Princess looked incredulously, "Blood Demon, you!"
Fear gripped her heart, wanting to escape, but it was too late. Unprepared, Blood Demon critically injured her, her defense collapsing instantly, Blood Extreme's attack also piercing into her.
Boom!
Rolling Blood Sea engulfed her, terrifying Blood Refining power devouring her life force and blood essence. As her consciousness faded into boundless darkness, she overheard Blood Demon and Blood Extreme arguing.
"Blood Demon, leave some for me. I also cultivate the Blood Dao."
"You're not even a flesh-and-blood body anymore, what do you need blood essence for!"
"Rubbish! The Daoist Ancestor's Creation, I am no longer a Jade Puppet!"
The Night Princess, utterly enraged, spewed her life's last blood.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1148 - 592: Taicang's Corpse
chapters.content:
The Night Princess fell, and the remaining Divine Temple powerhouses were furious, roaring, "Blood Demon, you traitor!"
"You deserve to die!"
"Dare to sabotage the Divine Master's grand plan, you will die for sure!"
Blood Demon sneered, and with a surge of blood waves attacked, speaking in a deep voice, "I, Blood Demon, was forced into the Divine Temple by the Divine Master. Though he guided me, he also separated me from my brother for countless years. I once begged humbly to save my brother. He thought himself merciful, yet he deprived my brother of the Qi of Domain."
"I, Blood Demon, have always remembered this debt!"
In the distance, the Indestructible Divine Master seemed unprepared for the Gargantuan Gluttonous King's intervention, and found himself passive in haste, unable to repel the Gargantuan Gluttonous King or free himself.
"Gargantuan Gluttonous King, are you determined for an eternal fight with me!"
The Indestructible Divine Master roared.
The Gargantuan Gluttonous King did not speak, continuously attacking, binding the Indestructible Divine Master, yet counting time in his heart. Once the time came, it intended to retreat.
Inside the Divine Temple, with the Master of Domain having taken action, the entire temple felt empty, and there was no obstruction along the way.
Very quickly, the Netherworld reached the depths of the Divine Temple, near the core grand hall, under a large tree.
Just as he was about to retrieve Taicang's Corpse from beneath the tree, an attack came suddenly.
"I always knew you, Netherworld, would betray!"
Dousan sneered.
"You killed my brother back then, and killed my subordinates. Today you are doomed."
Dousan's aura erupted, killing intent fierce.
Netherworld looked at Dousan, his expression indifferent, as a scarlet spear emerged in his hand, seemingly forged from endless essence blood, tremendously fierce.
"Dousan, you shouldn't stop me. Haven't you always defied me, thinking your strength superior? Today I will show you why you are nothing but a False Master of Domain!"
Netherworld spoke coldly.
"Ridiculous! Master of Domain is merely a division of realm and strength. Do you think that by having opened the Domain, you can reign over us?"
Dousan laughed disdainfully.
Boom!
Netherworld raised his spear and thrust it, a beam of blood light instantaneously arrived in front of Dousan. Dousan's expression changed, yet he did not panic, directly deploying a secret technique to counterattack.
Bang!
Their powers collided, a ripple of blood color spread out, and in an instant, their battlefield seemed to turn into a bloody domain. Dousan, horrified, found his blood boiling uncontrollably as if it was being drawn out!
"You..."
"I am called Netherworld, prison is confinement, is torment, is brutality, this is my domain. I am the ancestor of the Blood Path. I refine True Spirit Essence Blood, strengthening myself, and as long as you are a living being, with blood and flesh, within my domain, you will be affected by my Blood Path's power."
Netherworld's spear pierced out, blood waves surged, transforming the area into an unending blood prison, and Dousan was horrified to find his blood increasingly out of control, as if it would soon flee, and his strength weakened at that moment.
"Before this battle, I was once suppressed by Taicang. He passed on to me that which would help resolve my flaws, enlightening me on the Blood Dao. Today, let this Dao slay you, the obstructer!"
Netherworld knew he had little time, so from the start, he used his trump card.
The spear thrust forward, crossing space, aimed at Dousan.
Puff!
Blood erupted from Dousan's body in jets, uncontrollably devoured by the spear, as death loomed closer. Dousan roared angrily, "Trying to kill me, foolish!"
Boom!
He directly burned his Origin, performing a secret technique.
Blood-colored light surged from Netherworld, his hands waving mightily, and with a thunderous sound, the region resembling a blood-colored domain instantly shrank, and the imprisoning force of the prison surged abruptly.
Under this instant surge of imprisoning force, Dousan's form stiffened, a critical lapse for someone poised on the edge of life and death.
Swish!
The spear pierced into Dousan's body, and in a moment, his form shriveled, he roared and struggled, but Netherworld gave him no chance. The blood-colored region transformed into a new spear, grasped by Netherworld, stabbed into Dousan's head.
"If you dare to risk it, why should I, Netherworld, not?"
Netherworld's expression was indifferent, with a flick of his hand, Dousan's body exploded with a bang, leaving no blood, merely broken remains like a desiccated corpse.
Boom!
Netherworld dared not delay, arrived under the large tree, waved his hand, toppling the tree, revealing a small basement beneath, into which he jumped.
In the basement lay a stone coffin, Netherworld's expression showed some sadness as he waved to open it, inside lay a skeleton.
Though there was only white bone left, with no trace of flesh, even so, from the remaining aura on the bones, Netherworld could confirm that this was indeed Taicang's Corpse!
"Brother Taicang!"
Netherworld closed the stone coffin, lifted it, and fled the Divine Temple maniacally.
Swish!
As he emerged from the Divine Temple, Netherworld unleashed his fastest speed, heading toward the Great Wilderness Domain. At that moment, the Indestructible Divine Master let out a roar.
"Netherworld, how dare you betray me, how dare you steal Taicang's Corpse!"
He attempted to pursue Netherworld, raising his hand for an attack intending to slay him, yet it was blocked by the Gargantuan Gluttonous King.
In that instant of delay, Netherworld had already escaped the battlefield's bounds. Even if the Indestructible Divine Master wanted to pursue, he dared not set foot, for the mysterious Daoist Ancestor's power intimidated him into not daring to breach protocol.

chapters.title: Chapter 1149 - 592: Taicang's Corpse_2
chapters.content:
"Block the Netherworld for me, take back Taicang's corpse!"
Indestructible Divine Master angrily commanded.
Those who were originally attacking the Heavenly Dao, trying to break through the defenses, all had changes in their expressions upon hearing the command and turned back to intercept the Netherworld.
A gray-clothed man, who was currently fighting Xu Yan, changed his expression, wishing to break free and go to block the Netherworld.
"You should focus on battling me."
Xu Yan said with a cold laugh.
Whoosh!
At this moment, the sword light filled the air, transforming into a realm of swords, vaguely within it, the realm of swords, a spiraling Golden Giant Dragon, seemed to have acquired true life, the Dragon Might was vast, and it attacked fiercely.
The gray-clothed man's face changed drastically, not daring to be careless in the slightest, he could only continue his attack, suppressing Xu Yan.
"Thinking of intercepting, wishful thinking!"
The Witch Demon, Ao Hong, and others all roared in anger, exerting all their efforts, tightly entangling the many strong Divine Temple warriors.
At this moment, Qing Yu also made a move, Su Lingxiu appeared with a shovel in her hands, and tiny cold glimmers floated around her. As she struck, in an instant, a gray-robed man was terrified and pale, feeling his life force being stripped away!
Poof!
In just a moment, he was smacked to death with one shovel by Su Lingxiu.
"So strong!"
The Witch Demon and others were stunned in their hearts, this girl seemed quiet and not fond of fighting, but when she made her move, it was extremely ruthless, worthy of being from the same school as Xu Yan and the others!
The number of Divine Temple warriors was still considerable, some broke away from the battlefield, charging toward the Netherworld, intending to intercept and retrieve Taicang's corpse!
Boom!
At this moment, the entire Great Wilderness Domain began to shake, enormous thunderbolts, the rolling Majesty of the Heavenly Path, like a long whip, split the chaos, striking at the gray-robed men who intercepted the Netherworld.
The terrifying power of the thunderbolts startled the gray-robed men into hastily dodging, avoiding the strike. Tian Zi's figure appeared at the end of the thunder.
With this strike, more than half of the Power of Heavenly Dao was mobilized, at this moment, the defense of the Great Wilderness Domain's Heavenly Path showed flaws and weaknesses, a few True Spirits broke in.
Boom!
At this moment, the great formation deployed by Fang Hao was passively activated, the entire domain was in turmoil, blocking the few True Spirits from continuing to enter.
To retrieve Taicang's corpse, Tian Zi and others didn't hesitate to take risks, while the Great Wilderness Domain, filled with rolling thunderclouds, and surging spiritual energy, spawned whirlwinds.
The Azure Sea raged with tumultuous tidal waves, an apocalyptic scene, terrifying every Martial Artist within the domain, their faces turning ashen.
And those Martial Artists aware of the war of the domains, their expressions were solemn, could the Great Wilderness Domain be about to fail in its defense?
At this moment, each of the Supreme Sovereigns soared into the sky, although they couldn't go to battle, they crazily exerted their strength at this moment, merging their power into the domain, trying their best to stabilize it.
"For me!"
Tian Zi looked at the stone coffin grasped by the Netherworld.
"Catch it!"
The Netherworld handed the stone coffin to Tian Zi, then made a move, striking the approaching Divine Temple warriors, escorting Tian Zi back to the Great Wilderness.
Encircled by purple lightning, the stone coffin was wrapped up and returned to the Great Wilderness in an instant.
"Damn, Netherworld, you deserve to die!"
Indestructible Divine Master broke free from the Gargantuan Gluttonous King, looking furious, intending to charge into the battlefield, but stopped at the edge, his face showing trepidation.
The Netherworld didn't speak, instead entering the Great Wilderness Heavenly Path, participating in the defense of the Great Wilderness.
"Break through this domain's defense for me!"
Indestructible Divine Master roared with anger.
The many warriors of the Divine Temple once again rushed into the Great Wilderness Domain, attacking frantically, putting the Witch Demon and others under enormous pressure. Fortunately, Tian Zi already returned, and the Heavenly Dao was restored, forming a strong defense.
Coupled with the great formation deployed by Fang Hao, although the domain rocked under the attack, it managed to hold, showing no signs of breaking. However, the Witch Demon and other strong warriors were feeling the exhaustion, realizing that prolonged battle would bode ill.
Boom!
The stone coffin opened, revealing a skeletal corpse within. Despite the passage of eons, and the absence of flesh, it was still unmistakably Taicang's corpse.
With Taicang's corpse returned, the entire domain seemed to resonate with a sense of desolation.
The foundation of the Great Wilderness ultimately stemmed from the Taicang Domain. The return of Taicang, the pioneer of its creation, inevitably triggered some reaction from the domain.
"Big brother Taicang!"
Qing Yu's expression was filled with grief.
"Two finger bones are missing!"
Tian Zi murmured softly.
"The finger bones are here!"
Jiang Feng and Cang Lie each handed over a finger bone.
While resisting attacks, Taikun and Taihe explained, "Back then, when we both were on the verge of perishing, it was big brother Taicang who sent us away using these two finger bones. It was these bones that suppressed a trace of the Divine Master's aura, allowing us to survive until now.
"We thought the domain could not be saved, so Cang Lie and Jiang Feng, taking the finger bones, fled into the Land of Imperishable, seeking the place where we were originally born, hoping for some fortune to enhance our strength and evade the chase of the Divine Temple, leaving a root for the domain."
This was Taikun and Taihe's initial thought; hence no matter how Heavenly Slaughter conspired or caused trouble, they didn't show up or interfere because, in their view, the Taicang Domain couldn't be preserved. Even if a new Master of Domain emerged, it would be to no avail.
Moreover, Heavenly Slaughter couldn't possibly become the Master of Domain, after all, the two knew of Tian Zi's existence. So from the beginning, it was all about preparing for Cang Lie and Jiang Feng's escape from the domain, into the vast Land of Imperishable.
"Buried in the domain, considered returned."
With a wave of his hand, Tian Zi closed the stone coffin, burying Taicang's corpse at the center of the domain, at the core of the domain, which was the origin of its creation.
Indestructible Divine Master was raging, glaring viciously at the Gargantuan Gluttonous King, "You seek death!"
The Gargantuan Gluttonous King shifted its body backward, muttering something, though looking sheepish, it nevertheless didn't regret its actions.
Indestructible Divine Master was furious but helpless. The power of the Gargantuan Gluttonous King wasn't weak. Should he truly engage in an endless struggle with it?
"After this, I'll settle the score with you!"
After leaving a harsh remark, Indestructible Divine Master looked gloomily at the Great Wilderness Domain, commanding the warriors of the Divine Temple, regardless of the cost, to breach the Great Wilderness Domain.
For a moment, the Great Wilderness Heavenly Path was in turmoil, on the verge of collapse, seemingly unable to last much longer. The Witch Demon and others couldn't help but wear worried expressions, nearing their limits.
Even within the Heavenly Path, aided by its protection and rejuvenated by pills, the number of strong opponents remained overwhelming.
Li Xuan continued sitting leisurely, watching as the Netherworld stole back Taicang's corpse, watching Indestructible Divine Master in rage, and couldn't help but smile. Indestructible Divine Master was preparing for a second plan.
Given the Netherworld's power, if Indestructible Divine Master hadn't intended it, how could it have stolen Taicang's corpse? It was all within Indestructible Divine Master's scheme.
Including the Gargantuan Gluttonous King, it was also calculated.
"Quite the means, but no matter how you plot, it will come to naught!"
Li Xuan sighed inwardly.
He thought of a saying, that human plans can't surpass the divine. Indestructible Divine Master faced this situation; no matter how much he plotted, how ingenious his methods, even if Li Xuan didn't interfere, he would inevitably fail.
Because, time had run out.
The Next Era was about to begin, which Indestructible Divine Master, for all his schemes, had not anticipated. Otherwise, with his methods, he could indeed breach the Great Wilderness Domain.
After all, Taicang profoundly affected the domain, even though a Heavenly Dao was established, its rules stemmed from Taicang Daoism. What's more, Taicang's corpse was buried at the core of the domain, the origin place of its creation.
Li Xuan neither warned him nor interfered because it was unnecessary. Indestructible Divine Master's schemes would ultimately fail, and with the imminent arrival of the Next Era, by the time he realized it, he wouldn't be able, in such a short span, to break the domain and offer it as a sacrifice. Tian Zi could resist for some time, maintaining an unbroken Heavenly Dao.
That time would be enough to support them until the Next Era arrived.
Moreover, Xu Yan grew more courageous in battle, transitioning from being oppressed to gradually counterattacking once or twice, and was beginning to stabilize the situation. The Power of Creation within the domain was in the process of birth, truly stepping one foot into the Creation Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 1150 - 593: The Change of Taicang's Corpse, Xu Yan Breaks Through to the Creation Realm
chapters.content:
```
The battle for offense and defense continued. Su Lingxiu had no choice but to step in. As the battle intensified, no one noticed the subtle changes emerging at the core of the Great Wilderness Domain.
Even Tian Zi, being fully focused on managing the battle, used all of the Heavenly Dao Rules for defense, and therefore did not notice these subtle changes. Moreover, these subtle changes blended with the Domain and were inherently difficult to detect.
Xu Yan slashed one sword after another, and at a certain moment, the Golden Dragon roared as if it had come to life completely. It seemed that all creatures within the Domain gained thought and acquired life.
It was as if they were receiving Creation and becoming true life forms, or perhaps acquiring another form of life.
Boom!
The man in gray continued to attack but to no avail, as Xu Yan's defenses were too strong. Yet at this moment, he was not anxious at all, watching as the Great Wilderness swayed, on the verge of being breached.
Moreover, the burial of Taicang's corpse was proceeding smoothly in the Great Wilderness; this plan was actually coming into effect.
The Indestructible Divine Master appeared anxious but was in fact very calm. Deep in his eyes was a gleam of victorious joy, and he secretly glanced at Li Xuan. This mysterious Daoist Ancestor seemed unaware and gave no warning to the Great Wilderness side.
Now, the Indestructible Divine Master only hoped that this mysterious Daoist Ancestor would indeed stick to his words and not interfere or break the rules he had set.
"Netherworld, how did you get the Gargantuan Gluttonous King to help?"
Ao Hong asked curiously while fending off attacks, panting.
The others also cast curious glances. The Gargantuan Gluttonous King was extraordinarily powerful. How did Netherworld get him to lend a hand? What qualifications did Netherworld have to enlist the Gargantuan Gluttonous King?
"The Gargantuan Gluttonous King is greedy, willing to take a little risk for food. I accidentally acquired a Divine Fruit. Initially, I didn't know what it was, but later I learned it was nurtured by a Taihao Divine Object, containing the essence of Taihao. I used it as a trade to get the Gargantuan Gluttonous King to assist."
"And stalling the Divine Master is a small risk for the Gargantuan Gluttonous King, so he's willing to make the trade."
Netherworld did not conceal this information.
The Witch Demon furrowed his brow slightly, not quite sure why but feeling something unusual about this matter. It wasn't that he distrusted Netherworld but rather that the way Netherworld coincidentally obtained a Divine Fruit nurtured by a Taihao Divine Object seemed too convenient.
And conveniently, Netherworld also knew about the Gargantuan Gluttonous King's gluttonous nature and managed to connect with him secretly. Everything seemed a little too smooth.
However, Taicang's corpse was indeed real and not a fake, so could it be truly just a coincidence?
The battle was intense, and the Divine Temple's assault was getting stronger. The Witch Demon didn't ponder further. The return of Taicang's bones was enough.
Li Xuan remained unfazed, seemingly indifferent to whether the Great Wilderness was breached or not. Tian Zi, however, appeared somewhat anxious as the Witch Demon and others were all wounded, and the attacks on the Heavenly Dao were overpowering, unable to hold on for much longer.
"Daoist Ancestor, we're about to reach our limit."
Tian Zi expressed helplessly.
"Don't worry, the Next Era is about to arrive, so get ready."
Li Xuan said with a smile.
Upon hearing this, Tian Zi felt a weight lift from his heart and continued to operate the Heavenly Dao, repelling the attacks.
"Black Chi King, Master of the Jade Court, you should exert more effort too; the Great Wilderness is on the brink of breaking."
The Indestructible Divine Master looked at the Black Chi King and Master of the Jade Court and spoke solemnly.
The Black Chi King gazed at the Great Wilderness, pondered for a moment, and was about to have the remaining True Spirits join in to finally break through the defenses of the Great Wilderness. At this time, his expression subtly changed.
He suddenly looked around at the Land of Chaotic Imperishable.
"It's too late!"
He murmured to himself, a trace of anxiety appearing in his eyes. It was too fast, and even he hadn't noticed in advance, which was clearly unusual.
After all, each era had a regular rhythm, operated according to rules that governed its emergence. But this time, it clearly exceeded the original rhythm and operated outside the rule framework. Or perhaps the rules of the Land of Imperishable had changed.
The Master of the Jade Court's expression also changed slightly. He looked at the Black Chi King, and their eyes met, both seeing the anxiety in each other's eyes and their concern over losing control of the rules of the Land of Imperishable.
The Gargantuan Gluttonous King also looked up, glanced around with a confused expression, and then appeared joyful, finally seeing the beautiful light.
"What's too late?"
The Indestructible Divine Master felt a foreboding sense.
"The era is about to begin!"
The Black Chi King said in a deep voice.
"How is this possible!"
The Indestructible Divine Master's expression changed drastically. "Based on the time calculation, the beginning of the Next Era is still a ways off!"
This was enough time for him to finish his arrangements and break through the Great Wilderness, which was why he was in no hurry, feeling entirely confident. To avoid procrastination leading to unexpected events, he had been calculating the timing carefully.
Breaking the Great Wilderness and initiating the setup, followed by the beginning of the Next Era, was a process and timeline he had meticulously planned.
Now, the premature beginning of the Next Era meant that his setup couldn't be accurately completed.
He looked toward the Land of Chaotic Imperishable, and at a particular moment, his expression transformed dramatically. The Next Era was indeed about to begin, and that ray of light was about to emerge, illuminating the Chaos and beginning the Next Era.
"Why is it happening like this?"
The Indestructible Divine Master realized that this was probably due to some unknown variables!
He suddenly looked toward the mysterious Daoist Ancestor. Clearly, the other party had long known about the early arrival of the Next Era, so he hadn't been rushed or worried about the Great Wilderness being breached!
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1151 - 593: The Transformation of Taicang's Corpse, Xu Yan Breaks Through to the Creation Realm_2
chapters.content:
```
"I can't lose!"
The Indestructible Divine Master roared, and in an instant, his figure vanished from the original spot, reappearing at the edge of the battlefield.
He still dared not step onto the battlefield or defy the rules of the Daoist Ancestor. He wasn't confident he could withstand a casual strike from the opponent, as that one was too terrifying.
Boom!
The Divine Temple suddenly descended above the Indestructible Divine Master, instantly transforming into armor that covered his body. The armor shone with the brilliance of the sun, moon, and stars, dazzlingly radiant.
"This is the Taihao Divine Object, the Indestructible Divine Armor!"
Ming Yu's expression changed, shocked beyond belief.
Meng Chong, who was pressing the Jade Person and True Spirit, couldn't help but have a faint change in expression as he looked at the Indestructible Divine Master cloaked in armor, exuding divine majesty and an incomparably powerful aura. He immediately performed Divine Skills, Heaven Lifting Earth Extinguishing, its violent power smashing the True Spirit and shattering the Jade Person. With a swift movement, he retreated to the Great Wilderness.
Fang Hao also pointed a finger, collapsing a Great Slaughter Formation and a Qimen Grand Formation. The terrifying power annihilated a third of the battling enemies, and he too retreated to the Great Wilderness.
Jiang Buping did the same, assisting Tian Zi in the defense after returning to the Great Wilderness.
"Does the Indestructible Divine Armor have anything special?"
Su Lingxiu asked curiously.
"Besides the legendary Taihao Divine Jade, the top-ranking Taihao Divine Object is the Indestructible Divine Armor. It is said that those who possess it are undying and immortal. Throughout the ages, the master of the Indestructible Divine Armor has always been the Indestructible Divine Master. Who would have thought he was exiled too?"
Ming Yu explained.
With a face full of sighs, lamenting that someone as strong as the Indestructible Divine Master had become an exile, she suddenly understood why the Divine Master did all this.
To return to Taihao!
To escape the Chaotic Imperishable, he refused to accept exile!
"The next era has begun!"
Ming Yu suddenly said again.
Witch Demon, Ao Hong, Netherworld, Qing Yu, and others all looked up towards the depths of chaos. Their tense minds finally relaxed, and they looked forward to the appearance of that light.
Chaos had faded, and a faint green hue appeared within it, giving the entire Land of Chaotic Imperishable a sense of time passing and a new era about to be born.
Some True Spirits aged at that moment, transforming into mountains.
"Divine Master!"
The gray-robed figures atop the nine mountains cried out in unyielding grief.
The next era unexpectedly began earlier than anticipated.
"I won't lose!"
The Indestructible Divine Master had an incomparably powerful aura, the Indestructible Divine Armor shining brightly, its light reflecting in chaos.
"Attack them all!"
The Indestructible Divine Master said in a deep voice.
"Yes!"
The originally paused gray-robed figures launched a fierce attack again, and the slightly relaxed Witch Demon and others had to face the battle again, though they struggled to resist.
Boom!
The Great Wilderness's purple lightning went wild, and Tian Zi's figure completely vanished into the Heavenly Dao, mobilizing all the power of the Heavenly Dao to perform a final defense.
"Divine Master, admit defeat!"
Tian Zi said coldly.
"I won't lose, you must be Tian Zi, you cannot stop me."
The Indestructible Divine Master raised his hand, seemingly issuing a signal.
Boom!
Suddenly, the Great Wilderness shook, the Heavenly Dao Rules trembled, and Tian Zi reappeared, his expression drastically changing as he sharply looked into the Domain.
A skeleton of ancient bones emerged from the domain's core, carrying the core origin force of the domain, causing the domain to tremble, with the Heavenly Dao Rules quaking and the skeleton opening the Domain Barrier.
"You tampered with Taicang's Corpse!"
Tian Zi said in shocked anger.
"Did you plan everything, offering me that Divine Fruit in secret?"
Netherworld's face changed drastically at this moment, suddenly realizing he had always been a pawn in the Indestructible Divine Master's schemes. No wonder the plans went so smoothly!
The Indestructible Divine Master coldly smiled, "I didn't intend to use this plan, but to prevent any unexpected occurrences and ensure nothing went wrong, I had to do this."
He looked at Li Xuan, speaking in a deep voice, "Daoist Ancestor, you are a senior, you wouldn't break your word, right?"
Li Xuan smiled, "This Daoist Ancestor isn't one to break promises. But let me remind you, no matter how meticulously planned, it all will eventually become void. Do you think your schemes are unknown to this Daoist Ancestor? You don't have the time to complete them."
He paused, shook his head, and sighed, "Do you think this can transcend the Land of Imperishable and return to Taihao? Even if you sacrifice this domain, it will be in vain."
"Impossible, absolutely impossible, with such meticulous planning, with the Qi of Domain, how could I fail? It must lead us back to Taihao!"
The Indestructible Divine Master's expression was resolute as he spoke.
Boom!
The Great Wilderness trembled, the Heavenly Dao shook, and Tian Zi's expression changed drastically, "Quickly, make your move, hold them off, just a bit longer!"
Taicang's Corpse, carrying the core origin of the domain, was seizing the power of the Heavenly Dao, which ought to be a part of the Taicang Daoism. If it weren't for him embodying the Heavenly Dao, the Great Wilderness Domain Dao Rule would have been entirely overrun by the skeleton.
Even so, Tian Zi felt tremendous pressure, as flaws appeared in the Heavenly Dao, revealing weak spots, and even slowly opening a portal.
In the end, Taicang was the creator of this domain, and even though he had perished, the Corpse still held significant influence. Not to mention, the Indestructible Divine Master had intricately set up arrangements on the Corpse.
Witch Demon and others attacked madly, resisting the onslaught.
"Hurry, suppress Taicang's remains!"
Fang Hao said in a deep voice.
"We can't break free!"
Everyone showed helpless expressions.
A slight green light started to emerge; the light of the next era was a green light.
The Indestructible Divine Master wore a calm expression, waiting. The nine mountains roared, releasing a powerful source force, creating immense visible rules that interconnected.
At that moment, the peaks behind the nine mountains also triggered the Indestructible Divine Master's arrangements, activating at this moment, with the Great Wilderness as the core, marked as the sacrificial target.
Boom!
The Great Wilderness shook, as if the Qi of Domain was about to pour out, the Heavenly Dao seemed to split open a gap, and the core origin force of the domain, the Qi of Domain, surged from Taicang's Corpse, attempting to leave the realm.
At this moment, everyone felt a sense of despair; had they failed to defend the Great Wilderness in the end?
Beg the Daoist Ancestor to intervene?
Would the Daoist Ancestor break his promises and violate his own established rules?
Fang Hao said in a deep voice, "Now, only by breaking the Indestructible Divine Master's arrangements can we have a chance to escape his grasp!"
"But we must concentrate our strength, attack one point, and as soon as we pull away strength, the defense will collapse completely!"
Tian Zi said helplessly.
"Hold on a little longer, stabilize the situation, that light is coming!"
Witch Demon shouted.
Li Xuan remained unfazed, seemingly unaffected by the Great Wilderness's crisis, as if it didn't exist. Du Yuying, Yun Miaomiao, and others grew anxious.
"Sir, what do you think..."
Cai Ling'er couldn't help but show worry.
Even the highly defensible Azure Sea Turtle was struggling, its shell cracking. Another moment of support, and its defense would be breached.
"Creation Realm, huh!"
Li Xuan smiled, as if the Great Wilderness's crisis didn't concern him.
Cai Ling'er was taken aback, suddenly looking at Xu Yan. The previously overwhelmed Xu Yan suddenly unleashed a sword strike, slicing through chaos as if cutting a domain. Mountains and rivers appeared, lives wielded swords, and under a single strike, gray-robed figures vomited blood and flew backward.
Boom!
Xu Yan's momentum surged, breaking through constraints in an instant, stepping into a new world. The Images of Domain no longer appeared desolate but instead had a lifelike quality.
Roar!
Golden Giant Dragons roared out, each appearing to have independent thought, like truly living True Dragons!
"How is this possible!"
The gray-robed figure's face changed dramatically, bellowing and charging once more at Xu Yan. He knew, if entangled with Xu Yan, once he returned to defense, the Great Wilderness might turn the tide.
Boom!
Xu Yan had stepped into the Creation Realm, even though he just entered and his strength hadn't solidified yet, it was slowly improving. The marvels of the Creation Realm manifested, realizing the wonders of Creation, he calmly looked at the reckless gray-robed figure charging at him and struck out with a sword.
This sword cleaved chaos; where the sword reached, it seemingly opened a small domain, trapping the gray-robed figure within, unable to break free immediately.
A massive breach appeared in the Great Wilderness Heavenly Path, with the Qi of Domain starting to pour out. Tian Zi exerted himself to his limit, unable to suppress it, and Netherworld's eyes turned blood red, his body radiating bloody energy, roaring, "Since it's my mistake, I should bear the consequences!"
Rolling waves of blood flooded towards the breach, intending to burn his essence to block the Qi of Domain from leaking.
Buzz!
Suddenly, the Land of Chaotic Imperishable lit up with a green light...
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1152 - 594: Behave! Behave!
chapters.content:
Within the Great Wilderness Domain, turmoil reigned, a scene of apocalypse unfolded. The weak trembled in fear, while even the strong showed drastic changes in expression. A group of Supreme Sovereigns, Divine Venerates, and other powerful beings roared as they rushed toward the skeleton, attempting to destroy it, to stop it.
Yet it was as if an invisible barrier blocked them outside, unable to approach. It seemed as though their strength was being extracted.
The Domain appeared to be losing life, Spiritual Energy grew violent, surging outwards from the Domain. Looking up, they saw a massive breach and beyond it, a Chaotic Imperishable expanse.
Despair welled up in everyone's hearts.
Beyond the Domain, the Netherworld transformed into billowing waves of blood, attempting to fill the breach, willing to burn its origin to hold on. At this moment, a green light shone upon the Chaos.
In that instant, it was like a light breaking through the darkness.
"Quick, seize that light!"
The Netherworld bellowed.
"Tian Zi, quickly seize this light, enhance the Heavenly Dao, strengthen the Domain!"
The Netherworld, transformed into raging blood waves, enveloped the Heavenly Dao Rules, trying to seize that light and obtain the Creation within it.
At this time, within the Chaos, the old era faded, a new era was born. A green light shone through, cleaving the Chaos, the Next Era began.
In an instant, the Indestructible Divine Master stumbled a few steps, a face full of reluctance and anger, muttering under his breath, "Why so soon!"
Too late!
Ultimately too late!
The Qi of the Great Wilderness Domain had just begun to surge, not yet sacrificed, but the Next Era had already commenced, everything was too late. All the arrangements, years of planning, in this moment became void.
The Black Chi King revealed a complex expression and sighed, "Another Era is upon us!"
The opening of this Era was unlike any before, signifying not only the arrival of a new epoch but also that change was coming.
Boom!
At this moment, all the gray-clad people showed expressions of dejection and reluctance. Even the Divine Temple strongmen attacking the Great Wilderness had ceased their assault, for there was no more point in continuing!
Everything was too late!
Prolonged planning came to naught!
The green light pierced the Chaos, like an avenue, spanning across the Land of Imperishable, a new era was being birthed.
Boom!
The Witch Demon and others soared into the sky, reaching for this light, attempting, like last time, to glean the Creation within it.
The Last Era's opening was marked by a purple light, yet this Era was a green light, perhaps different Creations lay within!
The Black Chi King soared and landed into the green light, basking in its illumination. The Master of the Jade Court also withdrew all Jade Persons, entering the green light with her form.
The Gargantuan Gluttonous King did the same!
The Indestructible Divine Armor on the Indestructible Divine Master detached from him, seemingly drawn towards the green light, entering it of its own accord, while he clutched his head with both hands, crouching where he stood, filled with pain and unwillingness.
He let out a howl, pouring out infinite anger, infinite unwillingness, all negative emotions spilling forth.
"So beautiful," Su Lingxiu murmured.
The Heavenly Dao permeated as the green light passed through it, seemingly bringing change, yet perhaps everything remained as before. The Witch Demon and others absorbed the green light into their bodies.
Meng Chong, Su Lingxiu, Fang Hao, Jiang Buping, and others also stepped into the green light. A massive Flying Boat, under control, also entered into the green light.
Many powerful figures bathed in the green light, Xu Yan strode forward, stepping onto the green light. Gazing at each form, he, for a moment, glimpsed in his mind scenes of his master teaching the Method of Practicing Dao, journeyed along the Daoist path, endlessly.
This scene had a reflection of the Practicing Dao phenomenon.
Some enlightenment surged in his heart. He sat cross-legged, the green light entered his body, seemingly disappearing without a trace. Vaguely, it seemed he sensed the presence of the Dao, as if glimpsing the vast and unfathomable Dao.
Practicing Dao! Practicing Dao!
The green light was diminishing, a new epoch had begun, the era was being reborn, Chaos was descending again.
"So, this is how one can practice Dao!"
Xu Yan, in this moment, comprehended the Method of Practicing Dao, understanding how to tread the Daoist path.
His aura strengthened. Even though he initially entered the Creation Realm, the green light suffused the Domain, sensing the vast and unfathomable Dao, and Creation self-generated, his power ascended again.
A Minor Achievement in the Creation Realm!
Xu Yan remained immersed in comprehending the Dao, Daoist intent concentrated around him, infinite Creation, life endlessly renewed. After breaking through Minor Achievement in the Creation Realm, he did not stop.
A sudden enlightenment of the Dao, creation of the Domain.
Li Xuan sat serenely, watching the green light, observing the changing epochs, and the onset of a new era. He did not seize any of the green light, as, for him, the green light held no use anymore.
Watching those within the green light, watching the Great Wilderness Domain, a smile appeared on his face. With the emergence of the green light, he also glimpsed some essence of the Land of Imperishable, seeing through the fundamental nature of epoch transitions.
The Indestructible Divine Master's plan failed, collapsing in front of him. He couldn't accept this result, his long ages of perseverance, planning, and arrangements, all turned to naught.
The blow was considerable!
After all, for these arrangements, for this moment, he had paid too much.
The Daoist Golden Book at this moment radiated golden light, the entire book seemed as though it was about to unravel, Daoist insights permeating it, profound and immeasurable.
"Your disciple Xu Yan, comprehended the Method of Practicing Dao, you broke through to the Practicing Dao Realm, and practiced within it, journeying along the Dao."
Boom!
Li Xuan felt himself infinitely elevated, at some moment, his steps fell upon an endless, boundless, and unfathomable Dao.

chapters.title: Chapter 1153 - 594 Walk the Path! Walk the Path! _2
chapters.content:
```
The infinite mysteries of the Dao were understood in this moment. In an instant, it was as if everything in the world was revealed. Everything lay beneath his feet, beneath the Dao.
With a wave of the hand, the years could be changed, everything created, walking along the Dao, endless and unbounded, without any more restraints in the world!
Walk the Dao! Walk the Dao!
Li Xuan only felt calm, without excitement, as if he naturally walked above the Dao, and nothing was worth being excited about.
With each step, his power increased, the power of the Dao increased, and more of the Dao's mysteries were within reach.
Li Xuan wore a gentle smile, the Daoist Ancestor Halo surrounded him as he held a book more profound and unfathomable than even the Dao, walking forward one step at a time.
As he traveled farther, he gradually felt weary, a fatigue like that of an ordinary person who, after walking long distances, could no longer maintain physical strength.
"You've walked ten miles on the Dao."
Information from the Daoist Golden Book appeared.
Li Xuan stopped, not continuing further. Although he could rest and continue, he chose not to.
"Relying on myself is too exhausting, I'm not suited for harsh cultivation."
Li Xuan smiled, opting to rely on his apprentices instead.
Now he had walked ten miles on the Dao, no longer threatened by anything in the world, and there was no need to laboriously continue; when his apprentices walked the Dao, he would naturally receive a hundredfold increase.
The mysterious glow had disappeared, chaos returned, and everyone felt a sense of loneliness, as if they had fallen from light back into darkness.
The Great Wilderness Heavenly Path had recovered, but Taicang's remains still floated above the Domain, devoid of the Indestructible Divine Master's control, seemingly unable to continue breaking through the Domain Origin.
Everything was already over.
"What kind of creation was that mysterious glow?"
Witch Demon looked at Ao Hong with a bit of confusion.
"I don't know!"
Ao Hong also shook his head, puzzled.
There seemed to be changes, yet it seemed like nothing had changed. However, they had indeed acquired the mysterious glow.
Unlike the previous time when they obtained the purple glow, this time they were clueless, unable to grasp what changes the mysterious glow had brought.
"My Qi of Domain has recovered, and it seems my potential has been unlocked?"
Netherworld pondered softly.
"Mysterious glow, a creation to cherish, I broke through."
Meng Chong exclaimed with a sigh.
He had achieved Dao Realm Perfection, just half a step from breaking through to the Creation Realm.
"So did I!"
Su Lingxiu said joyfully.
Fang Hao and Jiang Buping also nodded one after another, then looked at Xu Yan.
"Half a step away from achieving the Great Accomplishment of Creation."
Xu Yan wore a smile.
For him, the greatest gain wasn't the increase in strength but his enlightenment in the Method of Practicing Dao, sensing the ethereal presence of the Dao.
Witch Demon and others blinked, wondering why there was little change in their strength. The only change was the elimination of battle injuries and fatigue.
They sighed inwardly, feeling this was likely the main difference between themselves and the true disciples of the Daoist Ancestor.
"Heavenly Dao, more Creation."
Tian Zi pondered for a moment before speaking.
"Ah! Why! Why!"
Suddenly, a nearly broken shout rang out.
Everyone looked and saw the Indestructible Divine Master, with hands on his head, kneeling, letting out a painful and broken wail, his aura stirring all around, causing storms in the Land of Imperishable.
Not far from the Indestructible Divine Master, Black Chi King and Master of the Jade Court stood silently, pondering something unknown.
The True Spirits had long since vanished into the chaos.
The Gargantuan Gluttonous King did not leave but shifted his body, moving away from the Indestructible Divine Master, fearing retribution.
"Divine Master!"
A group of powerful figures from the Divine Temple, all with faces full of sorrow, knelt before the Indestructible Divine Master, weeping bitterly!
"Ah! Why!"
The Indestructible Divine Master continued to howl in anguish.
"Has he gone mad?"
Su Lingxiu looked at the howling Indestructible Divine Master in surprise.
"He deserves it!"
Tian Zi stated coldly.
"Who told him to covet the Domain, who told him to kill even Taicang, and desecrate Taicang's very remains!"
As she spoke, Tian Zi became increasingly hateful.
"Exactly, he deserves it!"
Witch Demon and others nodded in agreement.
The Indestructible Divine Master was their enemy, no matter how pitiful he appeared at the moment, they felt no sympathy, only excitement.
Ming Yu watched silently, a hint of lament and sigh in her eyes. After all, the Indestructible Divine Master was renowned in Taihao. She, a mere holder of Exquisite Jade Mountain, was far inferior.
For such a formidable being to fall to this state, how could one not lament and sigh.
Everyone watched the Indestructible Divine Master, who, at this moment, was on the verge of collapse, imagining the tremendous mental blow he suffered from this failure.
As the Indestructible Divine Master howled madly, his aura erupted, holding back nothing, which astounded everyone with his might.
"My current strength is slightly inferior too!"
Xu Yan couldn't help but sigh.
He had one foot into the Great Accomplishment of Creation Realm, yet even so, his strength was slightly inferior to the Indestructible Divine Master. From this, one could discern the mighty strength of the Indestructible Divine Master.
As such, Black Chi King and Master of the Jade Court were not weaker by any margin.
In contrast, the Gargantuan Gluttonous King was a notch weaker.
The true pinnacle powerhouses in the Land of Imperishable were Black Chi King and Master of the Jade Court. Although the Indestructible Divine Master was also in the Land of Imperishable, he hailed from the Taihao Realm.
"Ming Yu, how many powerhouses like the Indestructible Divine Master are there in the Taihao Realm?"
Xu Yan curiously asked.
Ming Yu shook her head: "There shouldn't be anyone of such strength in the Taihao Realm. The Indestructible Divine Master is likely so powerful because of breakthroughs and advancements in the Land of Imperishable."
Hearing this, Xu Yan couldn't help but think of that light. The Indestructible Divine Master had been exiled to the Land of Imperishable for long ages, surely more than once receiving the creation of light during the epochal transitions.
However, now he had nearly reached the limit, as there was an upper limit to that creation of light.
After his howling and venting, the Indestructible Divine Master seemed to regain his composure. The Indestructible Divine Armor once again enveloped him. He slowly stood up, his eyes blood-red, stepping towards the Great Wilderness.
"He's unwilling to accept defeat, is he planning to act personally?"
Tian Zi said with furrowed brows.
"If so, then let me have a try!"
Xu Yan said eagerly.
Behind the Indestructible Divine Master was a group of Divine Temple strongmen, the remaining ones being the exiles of Taihao. Black Chi King and Master of the Jade Court exchanged glances and slowly followed behind.
The Gargantuan Gluttonous King hesitated for a moment but slowly followed, appearing ready to flee if things went awry.
Finally, the Indestructible Divine Master stopped outside the Great Wilderness.
His breaths were heavy, eyes blood-red, his face twisted at times. He stared at Tian Zi and others, looked at the Great Wilderness, looked at Taicang's remains, and lastly, his gaze fell on Li Xuan.
But Li Xuan paid no heed to the Indestructible Divine Master. After stepping onto the Dao, everything in the world was at his feet, the edge of Imperishable, and even the Taihao Realm in his gaze.
"The Taihao Realm, the Land of Imperishable, so that's how it is."
Li Xuan sighed inwardly.
The Land of Imperishable was in operation, with shifting boundaries. However, by following the rules of the Land of Imperishable, one could reach the boundary connecting with the Taihao Realm.
The Taihao Realm was far larger than the Great Wilderness Domain but significantly smaller than the Land of Imperishable, since the Land of Imperishable, to some extent, was slowly expanding.
The Land of Imperishable was expanding, while the Taihao Realm moved along its boundaries, mutually dependent. In some sense, the Taihao Realm was yang, and the Land of Imperishable was yin.
However, the yin exceeded the yang, resulting in a kind of imbalance, bringing about some issues.
The cause of the yin and yang imbalance was instantly seen by Li Xuan. At the bottom of Taihao, there lay a massive cage imprisoning a powerful being.
And this powerful being, consuming the Taihao Realm, also slowly drew some power from the Land of Imperishable, intending to break free.
This powerful existence was the source of all the upheavals, the unknown aura Ming Yu sensed earlier came from here.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1154 - 595: The Past and Present Life of Taicang
chapters.content:
```
