"His strength was indeed quite formidable!"
Li Xuan looked at the powerful entity and sighed inwardly. He finally understood why the strength ceiling in the Taihao Realm was so low. The Master of Domain level was already at the top, all because this powerful force was suppressed.
"Who suppressed and sealed him there?"
Li Xuan couldn't help but be curious.
Such a formidable entity required equally strong power to suppress and seal him, otherwise how could one suppress the other?
However, throughout the Land of Imperishable, across the Taihao Thirty-Three Heavens, there was no such mighty figure.
Even the Indestructible Divine Master was far less powerful than the one being imprisoned.
"Did he die?"
Li Xuan pondered, wondering if the one who suppressed such a formidable being exhausted himself, sealing him away, and consequently died.
These events happened in ancient times, unknown to the Indestructible Divine Master and others, including the Black Chi King and the Master of the Jade Court. Otherwise, they wouldn't have thought of using the arrangements of the Indestructible Divine Master to peep into the Taihao Realm.
Though unaware of this powerful being, he sensed something unusual, which was rare.
"Taihao was in quite a mess!"
Li Xuan looked toward the Taihao Thirty-three Heavens, which were in utter chaos, devoid of order, like the end of a dynasty where people were living in misery, with killings everywhere, and the weak were in a dire situation, always at risk of losing their lives.
Yet, there were resilient ones striving valiantly.
All this chaos originated from the suppressed one who wanted to break free, to emerge from the cage.
"A new era was about to arrive, a change was needed."
Li Xuan thought to himself.
This new era was the Heavenly Dao!
The Heavenly Dao he pioneered, this chaos, should be handled by Xu Yan and others.
Li Xuan had no intention of intervening. After practicing the Dao, his mindset became different. He viewed the world with calm indifference and followed his heart and fate.
"You were the Daoist Ancestor, a senior to me. In my indestructible life, I never bowed my head, nor did I bully the weak. I never oppressed others with my power, yet I was exiled!
"I was unwilling, I was angry, I sought justice, I wanted revenge. I dared to ask the Daoist Ancestor, should I seek revenge?"
The Indestructible Divine Master breathed heavily, his eyes bloodshot as he stared at Li Xuan and said in a deep voice.
Li Xuan looked at the Indestructible Divine Master, nodded, and said, "Your quest for revenge was reasonable!"
"Since the Daoist Ancestor also felt my revenge was reasonable, why did you stop me?"
The Indestructible Divine Master said in a deep voice.
"Indestructible Divine Master, your revenge was reasonable, my revenge as Tian Zi was also reasonable. The Daoist Ancestor imparted the way in the Great Wilderness, having a bond with it, and set the rules for this matter impartially. What else do you have to say?"
Before Li Xuan could speak, Tian Zi expressed angrily.
The Indestructible Divine Master looked at him and suddenly laughed, "You thought it was reasonable? Did you know that without me, none of everything you've had would exist, including you, Tian Zi?"
"What did you mean?"
Tian Zi frowned.
"Indestructible Divine Master, everything we owned had nothing to do with you? What did this domain have to do with you? Without you, how would our seven domains be left with only this one? How would Taicang, Fen Yun, and Hong Ze be dead?"
The Witch Demon said bitterly.
"What did it have to do with me?"
The Indestructible Divine Master sneered, "Taicang was originally the Taihao's greatest genius throughout history, with unparalleled talent and extraordinary gifts. But so what? He encountered betrayal by his beloved, died with a broken heart, fell into the Land of Imperishable, and I collected his remains and buried them in this Land of Imperishable. I even slew dozens of True Spirits, taking their Origins and burying them with him!"
As soon as these words came out, everyone's faces changed, displaying disbelief.
"Impossible!"
The Witch Demon shouted angrily, "Indestructible Divine Master, stop spreading lies. Don't think that because Brother Taicang was dead and couldn't testify, you could talk nonsense!"
"Exactly! Indestructible Divine Master, despite your loss, there was no need to concoct such stories!"
Ao Hong also shouted in anger.
Xu Yan and others immediately perked up, sensing that this seemed to involve some secrets. As for the matter of Taicang, let's keep listening.
"Concoct such stories?"
The Indestructible Divine Master sneered, "Taicang came from Taihao, this was a fact, and I buried his remains too."
"Indestructible Divine Master, not only you came from Taihao."
Tian Zi said solemnly, looking at Ming Yu, "Miss Ming Yu, you also came from Taihao. Could you know Taicang?"
Ming Yu blinked her eyes and shook her head, "I don't know him, never heard of him!"
The Witch Demon sneered, "Indestructible Divine Master, do you have anything else to say?"
The Indestructible Divine Master glanced at Ming Yu and chuckled softly, "Exquisite Jade Mountain, the seventh sect master, Exquisite Jade Token's seventh holder, always rumored to be focused only on her practice and uninvolved in Taihao's disputes, naïve-minded. It's no wonder she didn't know. Besides, the Exquisite Jade Mountain began experiencing unrest before Taicang became famous. It was rumored she had already fallen!"
Li Xuan remained silent, as the truth of the Indestructible Divine Master's words wasn't important. Moreover, the Indestructible Divine Master didn't need to lie, and from his speech, it was evident that Ming Yu had fallen into the Land of Imperishable earlier than him.
"I indeed didn't pay much attention to external matters..."
Ming Yu blinked her eyes, speaking somewhat innocently.
"So what? Indestructible Divine Master, your words were not credible!"
Tian Zi snorted coldly.
"Exactly! Even if you buried Taicang, what did any of this have to do with us?"
The Netherworld said coldly.
"What did it have to do with me?"
The Indestructible Divine Master said angrily, "Taicang's resurrection was entirely due to me, due to those dozens of True Spirit Origins..."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1155 - 595: Taicang's Past and Present Life_2
chapters.content:
```
As the Indestructible Divine Master recounted, the faces of the Witch Demon and others turned grim. When Taicang was born, it did not possess spiritual wisdom; it awakened its intelligence later, steadily rising through exploration.
The rebirth of Taicang surprised the Indestructible Divine Master. He did not interfere but let Taicang develop on its own. Perhaps due to the True Spirit Origin, Taicang was born without spiritual wisdom, akin to a true spirit.
The Indestructible Divine Master had hoped to enlist Taicang's help in planning a return to the Taihao Realm for revenge, as Taicang's brilliance was unprecedented, making it the greatest prodigy of the Taihao Realm throughout history.
However, Taicang's lack of spiritual wisdom brought him some disappointment, and when Taicang did awaken its wisdom, it was devoid of past memories, a completely new life form, causing further disappointment and lessening his attention.
"...Taicang is ultimately Taicang. It was unimaginable that it would create a domain; the appearance of a domain gave me hope for success. Sacrificing the domain, using the Qi of Domain as a bridge at the opening of the Next Era, would break through the Imperishable barrier and return to the Taihao Realm."
At this point, the Indestructible Divine Master sneered and said, "Taicang was born because of me. Without me, where would all this have come from, where would the domain have come from? Isn't the domain created with Taicang's guidance and assistance?"
The faces of the Witch Demon and others shifted.
"So what? All this was done by Taicang alone."
Tian Zi retorted defiantly.
"Ha, not only Taicang, but Fen Yun and Hong Ze are also related to me. It is reasonable for me to reclaim everything I bestowed upon them!"
The Indestructible Divine Master sneered.
"Impossible!"
The Witch Demon said angrily, "Fen Yun is a Fire Spirit, Hong Ze a Water Spirit. How could they be related to you?"
"Fen Yun was a Remnant Soul from Taihao, an Exile who had lost his self and was nearing dissolution. I discovered him, seized the True Spirit Origin and a Fire Spirit, and fused them with him, burying them in a place within the Land of Imperishable. Only thus did he obtain this creation to become a new life form.
"Hong Ze was the same. I found a drop of Origin Water and merged it with him, giving rise to a new birth. However, neither Fen Yun nor Hong Ze had memories, initially akin to true spirits, without spiritual wisdom, which only awakened later."
The Indestructible Divine Master snorted coldly.
"We were all Exiles. Without the Divine Master, we would have perished long ago. How could we have advanced our strength, how could we have this opportunity for revenge?"
"Indeed, without the Divine Master, we would not be here today!"
The strong ones behind the Indestructible Divine Master all spoke up.
"Ha, are you going to say that I, the Witch Demon, exist only because of you, that I awakened spiritual wisdom because of you, and I too am an Exile?"
The Witch Demon sneered.
The Indestructible Divine Master looked at him, "You, the Netherworld, Ao Hong, Qing Yu, have nothing to do with me. You are not Exiles; you are Origin Lifeforms from the Land of Imperishable. As for why you awakened spiritual wisdom, I think it might be related to a light at the opening of the Last Era or possibly due to changes in certain rules."
At this point, the Indestructible Divine Master was also somewhat puzzled, "I also do not understand why the Land of Imperishable would give birth to lifeforms with spiritual wisdom."
The Black Chi King spoke, "Ao Hong is related to me; I arranged it. As for the awakening of spiritual wisdom, it was because of Taicang's appearance that the Land of Imperishable gave birth to intelligent life, causing a balance and repair of the rules in the Land of Imperishable, thus producing life forms that awakened spiritual wisdom."
Ao Hong did not deny it. He was indeed related to the Black Chi King. Ever since he encountered the Black Chi King, he suspected that his awakening of spiritual wisdom might be the handiwork of the Black Chi King.
"Qing Yu was the Spirit Bamboo I planted."
The Master of the Jade Court spoke up at this time.
Witch Demon and others were somewhat disoriented, realizing that it was only the Witch Demon and Netherworld who were truly wild and had awakened spiritual wisdom without intervention.
From behind the Master of the Jade Court walked out a Jade Person, it was Ah Yi.
Upon seeing Ah Yi, Qing Yu seemed to see a figure in a trance, carrying a bucket of water to water the bamboo.
"Ahem, actually, the Netherworld brother was my doing."
Gargantuan Gluttonous King spoke seriously at this moment.
The Indestructible Divine Master glanced at it, doubting whether the Gargantuan Gluttonous King had the intelligence to make such arrangements, but he did not expose it.
The corners of the mouths of Netherworld and Blood Demon twitched; they had dark faces and did not speak.
"What's the matter? If King Chi Ni weren't dead, would it claim that I, the Witch Demon, was its arrangement?"
The Witch Demon sneered coldly.
"Indestructible Divine Master, even if what you say is true, what of it? Taicang, whom you buried, was reborn by accident. Moreover, you said so yourself, Taicang had no past memories, and everything was figured out by himself from scratch.
"Strengthening himself, establishing Martial Arts Cultivation methods, creating this domain were all Taicang's accomplishments alone, what does it have to do with you?
"Besides, you killed Taicang; what else are you dissatisfied with? Your failure is destined. You have no right to question our success."
Tian Zi sneered, even if everything the Indestructible Divine Master said was true, so what?
"Haha!"
The Indestructible Divine Master laughed, his eyes even redder with blood, "Did you know that in the initial great battle, Taicang, at the very last moment, reached the ultimate sublimation, broke through his shackles, and greatly enhanced his strength, almost not inferior to me, yet he died!
"Because, at that moment, he awakened his past memories. He realized that it was I who buried him, it was I who brought him rebirth, and he wanted to return everything to me!
"I tried to persuade him to join me in conquering the Taihao Realm, but he said today's Taicang was not yesterday's Taicang, all is like smoke, without attachment, and has been let go!
"He may let go, but I, the Indestructible, cannot let go. I am determined to fight back; Taicang, mindful of the multitude in this world, begged me to spare them. I needed the Qi of Domain, and I openly stated that I would not destroy this realm at that time, but before the Next Era opens, the Taicang Domain won't exist.
"He pleaded with me not to kill you, Tian Zi, not to kill the powerful beings surviving in the Land of Imperishable; I agreed not to kill you, Tian Zi, nor his close associates, but the rest would perish!
"Taicang wanted to return everything to me, and with the Witch Demon and a few others unrelated to me, in the end, he exerted all his strength to send you, the Witch Demon, out of the battlefield.
"I did not pursue you, for your use should be now. Alas... Alas..."
The Indestructible Divine Master was filled with sorrow and defiance.
"Taicang was reborn because of me; how can I not reclaim what was mine? What's wrong with it? I didn't intend to use Taicang's corpse for this final arrangement, but to ensure that nothing went wrong, I did so.
"I assumed it was to guard against Yu Ting and the Black Chi King, never expecting..."
The Indestructible Divine Master's emotions seemed on the verge of collapsing.
He had assumed the ones with the power to interfere with and destroy his arrangements were the Master of the Jade Court and the Black Chi King because he ultimately discovered Qing Yu and Ao Hong were related to those two.
Therefore, he tampered with Taicang's corpse, setting up another arrangement to ensure infallibility, only to find that the Black Chi King and the Master of the Jade Court did not strike, yet a more terrifying presence emerged, the mysterious Daoist Ancestor!
"Tian Zi, you claim your revenge is reasonable. Now, do you feel it is more reasonable for me, the Indestructible, to take this domain for myself? Taicang wanted to return everything to me; even though you are a domain lifeform created by Taicang, you are also part of what Taicang intended to return.
"Considering Taicang struggled; seeing his tragic end, I agreed not to kill you, yet now it seems my not killing you is my fault!"
The Indestructible Divine Master appeared soulless, his entire vitality seemingly drained, with blood tearing from his eyes.
All the Witch Demon and others were silent.
Xu Yan and his group were looking at each other, this secret was too convoluted, and they came to understand the Indestructible Divine Master's collapse.
"Impossible, I don't believe it!"
Tian Zi burst forth, shouting, "I don't believe it; you have no evidence, Taicang is dead, you can say whatever you want, and besides, Taicang's life was taken by you, this domain does not belong to you.
"Moreover, Indestructible Divine Master, even if you destroy this realm, you cannot return to Taihao; you cannot cross the Land of Imperishable back to the Taihao Realm, give up, accept the reality, being too persistent isn't a good thing!"
Tian Zi shouted, displaying the rebellious nature of years past.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1156 - 596: White Bone Rebirth, Taicang Returns
chapters.content:
```
The Indestructible Divine Master ignored the clamoring Tian Zi, gripping his head with both hands, looked at Li Xuan, and gasped, "You are the senior, you are the Daoist Ancestor, and I, the Indestructible, take back my own arrangements, what is wrong with that?"
"Even if I truly can't return to the Taihao, that's my problem. If I fail like this, I can accept it. It's nothing more than planning again, arranging again, that's all. How could I, the Indestructible, be discouraged by a mere setback?"
"Before this, I also failed twice. This failure, I am unwilling to accept, unwilling! You are the senior, you are the Daoist Ancestor, why make things difficult for a junior like me, make it hard for a weakling like me?"
Though the Indestructible Divine Master appeared nearly on the verge of breakdown, with an abundance of unwillingness and immense inner rage, he dared not vent his anger at Li Xuan. Instead, he spoke with a face full of pain.
The power of the Daoist Ancestor, marked indelibly in his bones at the moment King Chi Ni was crushed to nothingness, was so deep that no matter how unwilling, how angry, he dared not look angry, dared not lose his temper, and could only, in pain, continue to torment himself!
Li Xuan cast his gaze over, "This Daoist Ancestor always went with the flow, traveled across this Domain, preached in this Domain, how could I let it be destroyed? What of your unwillingness? Such is the plight of the weak."
The Indestructible Divine Master cradled his head, crouched down, and painfully said, "Is it my fault that I, the Indestructible, am too weak? Can the strong truly do as they wish?"
Once, he never thought he would say such words.
"Indeed, a true strong one can do as they please!"
Li Xuan nodded and then added, "But this Daoist Ancestor has always gone with the flow and never did as they pleased."
The Indestructible Divine Master looked up at him, "If that's the case, then I, the Indestructible, beg you, let me return to the Taihao Realm, could that be possible?"
Li Xuan sighed; the Indestructible's obsession ran deep, unwilling to cease without revenge. If he were in the same position, he would be the same!
Taicang, ultimately reborn, even if awakened with memories of a past life, they were like transient clouds to him, for Taicang's experiences in this life were real. In some sense, Taicang was not the Taicang of old. The memories of a past life did not have a deep, soul-carving impact, so he let them go lightly.
But the Indestructible and others couldn't!
"The Taihao Realm, your enemies, might not even be there anymore."
Li Xuan smiled gently and continued, "Returning now might not be the best thing for you."
The Indestructible Divine Master's expression collapsed again. Hugging his head in agony, he let out a painful low growl, exerting considerable effort to suppress his inner rage and unwillingness.
"Daoist Ancestor, don't believe him. Taicang is unrelated to him; he's only trying to win your sympathy."
Tian Zi had no sympathy for the Indestructible Divine Master.
Even if it was true, so what? Taicang was already dead. In some sense, the Indestructible Divine Master was the enemy who killed his father. No amount of reasoning would be accepted by Tian Zi.
Li Xuan shook his head and said, "Going back now is not the right time. When the time comes, you will naturally be able to return."
The barrier of the Land of Imperishable was weakening. The one being suppressed would also appear; a great malevolence full of cruelty and bloodthirsty intent.
The Taihao would vanish, and so would the Land of Imperishable. In the end, either only the suppressed would remain, or the Heavenly Dao would take its place.
For Li Xuan, it was naturally ideal for the Heavenly Dao to take over, yet he wouldn't interfere anymore. Everything lay within the great Dao; he was merely a spectator. In his current Realm, his state of mind was already transcendent, unaffected by worldly calamities.
The Indestructible Divine Master could also be seen as a forerunner of a new era.
The changes in the rules of the Land of Imperishable, with life forms gaining Spiritual Wisdom, were somewhat related to the one suppressed. It was a kind of self-correction by the rules of the Land of Imperishable, to continue suppressing that entity.
"Daoist Ancestor, I have a question to ask!"
The Black Chi King said respectfully.
"Speak!"
"May I ask, Daoist Ancestor, have the rules of the Land of Imperishable changed?"
This was the question the Black Chi King always wanted to explore, the answer some arrangements sought.
"They have!"
Li Xuan nodded.
"What kind of change? What impact will it have on the Land of Imperishable?"
The Black Chi King's heart trembled.
Li Xuan smiled gently and said, "To you, it is a great calamity!"
The Master of the Jade Court could no longer sit still and couldn't help but ask, "Why is it so? What kind of great calamity?"
"An apocalyptic catastrophe!"
Li Xuan smiled softly.
The Black Chi King and the Master of the Jade Court trembled violently inside and wanted to inquire further, but the Indestructible Divine Master lost control of his emotions and roared out.
"Ah, ah, ah, you are the senior, why is it like this? Why? Taicang is my arrangement, all this is mine; all grievances are between Taicang and them.
"Taicang was about to give all this back to me, so why stop me? Why take everything that should be mine!"
Watching the breakdown of the Indestructible Divine Master, the Witch Demon and others exchanged glances, finally understanding the depth of the Indestructible Divine Master's obsession and the severity of this blow to him.
Even someone as strong as him had broken down, and because of the Daoist Ancestor's strength, he couldn't vent his anger at the Daoist Ancestor. He could only suppress it, and without an outlet, he ultimately couldn't bear it and broke down.
"Serves you right!"
Tian Zi was full of schadenfreude.
Seeing the father-killing enemy in such distress, he was quite pleased.
"Divine Master!"
"Divine Master, we still have a chance; we can rearrange everything!"
The followers behind the Indestructible Divine Master wore expressions of pain, constantly persuading, trying to console him, yet none dared speak a word of disrespect to Li Xuan.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1157 - 596: White Bone Rebirth, Taicang Returns_2
chapters.content:
"Enough, the grudges between you little ones shall be resolved by yourselves."
Li Xuan shook his head as he spoke.
He looked at Taicang's corpse within the Great Wilderness Domain, and with a wave of his hand, the corpse flew over.
"Since Taicang resurrected because of you, and you claim to repay it, this Daoist Ancestor shall let Taicang settle the grievances with you."
Li Xuan spoke calmly.
The Indestructible Divine Master raised his head, "Taicang is already dead..."
But Li Xuan smiled serenely, "For you all, life and death are irreversible, but in this Daoist Ancestor's eyes, life and death are merely a thought away, death can be life, and life can be death, life and death are reversible, only the Daoist Ancestor is irreversible!"
Everyone was struck in their hearts upon hearing this, life and death reversible, only the Daoist Ancestor irreversible, such arrogance!
Everyone was simultaneously puzzled, could Taicang possibly still be saved?
All that was left was a heap of bones, and besides, Taicang's origin, everything about Taicang, had already dissipated completely.
Back then, Taicang could resurrect at least because his remnants were still there, nurtured by many True Spirit Origins, or perhaps Taicang himself was extraordinary, which allowed the remnants to give birth to life anew.
Even so, the reborn Taicang was already a new person, not the original Taicang, which was why when Taicang awakened the memories of his past life, he was so calm and easily let go.
It was only because the memories of his past life were negligible compared to his life in the Land of Imperishable, he seemed just an observer who looked at those memories and let them go.
Qing Yu was full of excitement, could it be that big brother Taicang could really come back to life?
Everyone gazed at Taicang's corpse, even the Indestructible Divine Master stopped his roars, quietly watching, his expression complex, filled with both expectation and fear of eventual disappointment.
Li Xuan looked at Taicang's corpse, devoid of flesh and blood, the Divine Soul long dissipated, completely fallen, even if by some chance, some Supreme Treasure caused the skeleton to gain consciousness, it would not be Taicang, nor would there be any possibility of awakening past life memories again.
However, in Li Xuan's eyes, none of this mattered; he had already practiced the Dao, stood upon the Great Dao, and all worldly matters, all creations, were within the Dao.
Life was thus, death was thus; since it once existed in the world, it would not truly disappear, let alone Taicang's bones still remaining.
Raising his hand to point, silently, without brilliant light, without divine phenomena, it seemed just such an ordinary point, yet at this moment, everyone felt an indescribable, ineffable, transcendent meaning, beyond anything in the world, mysterious and profound.
Li Xuan used this point to directly apply a Divine Skill.
White Bone Rebirth!
With his current power of practicing the Dao, this Divine Skill's application was nothing extraordinary, reviving a skeleton with ease, no matter how strong the owner of the bones was in life.
Under the shocked gazes of everyone, Taicang's skeleton manifested flesh, slowly the bones vanished, and a flesh and blood body appeared; it was an elegant yet imperious man.
"Taicang!"
"Big brother Taicang!"
"How is this possible!"
Everyone was shocked by this scene, the Indestructible Divine Master widened his eyes, filled with disbelief, and a sliver of relief emerged in his heart, grateful he hadn't lost all reason and vented his anger on the Daoist Ancestor, or else he would have turned to nothingness, disappearing completely like King Chi Ni.
Also relieved that he still held a sliver of hope to return to the Taihao Realm for revenge; only by preserving his life did he have the opportunity, his conviction suppressed himself, not daring to have any offense towards the Daoist Ancestor.
Buzz!
Li Xuan waved his hand, withdrawing it, and at this moment, Taicang's body surged with a powerful aura, this aura stronger than the level of Master of Domain.
The Indestructible Divine Master breathed heavily, not only had Taicang resurrected, but the resurrected Taicang also possessed powers at his peak before his fall!
Boom!
Taicang suddenly opened his eyes, standing up abruptly, his eyes filled with majesty, and with one glance, he saw the Indestructible Divine Master, his gaze darkened, "Indestructible Divine Master, what I owe you, I, Taicang..."
He suddenly paused, a look of puzzlement appearing on Taicang's face, his brow furrowing, "Wasn't I already dead?"
"Big brother Taicang!"
An overjoyed Qing Yu suddenly leapt into Taicang's embrace.
Tian Zi pouted, scratched his head, and rushed over to grab Taicang's hand, "Taicang, your survival is all due to the Daoist Ancestor's mercy, quickly, come and thank the Daoist Ancestor!"
Qing Yu, hearing this, came back to his senses from his excitement, nodding vigorously, "Yes, yes, big brother Taicang, you should thank the Daoist Ancestor!"
At this moment, Taicang only felt a bit dazed, having clearly died, yet suddenly resurrected, stronger than at the peak before his fall.
The Indestructible Divine Master was not far away, Qing Yu and Tian Zi were both present, he remembered locking Tian Zi up, finally asking the Indestructible Divine Master not to trouble Tian Zi, to which the Indestructible Divine Master agreed.
What was happening now?
Who was the Daoist Ancestor?
Taicang took a deep breath, though unclear about what occurred after his death, one thing was certain, the Daoist Ancestor saved him, brought him back to life.
So, he respectfully bowed to Li Xuan in gratitude, "Taicang, thanks to the Daoist Ancestor for his great kindness!"
"No need for formalities, resolve the grudges between yourselves."
Li Xuan waved his hand.
Seeing everyone's shocked expressions, filled with infinite awe for him as the Daoist Ancestor's supreme, made him feel utterly comfortable.
"Let me give you all a bit more shock from the Daoist Ancestor."
Li Xuan muttered in his heart.
The Daoist Ancestor Halo appeared, and with a wave of his hand, a long river emerged, time flowing within, and everyone watching was amazed, could this be the River of Time?
Could it directly manifest before them?
The Daoist Ancestor!
At this moment, everyone more profoundly understood the significance behind this title and what it represented.
Li Xuan reached his hand into the long river, as everyone felt a momentary bewilderment, as if time itself had reversed, yet seemingly there was no change.
Then, they saw two figures being thrown out from the river.
The moment they saw these two figures, Taicang and the others, including the Indestructible Divine Master, were rendered speechless with shock.
Fen Yun and Hong Ze!
The Indestructible Divine Master was no longer despondent, he didn't even dare to despair now, cold sweat covering his forehead, his heart trembling.
Fen Yun was already dead, his Origin and Qi of Domain entirely taken.
Hong Ze had been personally killed by him, yet here they were, resurrected once more!
Watching the Daoist Ancestor, who acted as if he had done something trivial, everyone was stunned and numb!
Supreme!
This was truly supreme!
Daoist Ancestor! Daoist Ancestor!
"Master's strength is beyond imagination!"
Xu Yan sighed, feeling immensely fortunate to have such profound fortunes, meeting his master and becoming the first disciple of his master!
Meng Chong patted his bald head, also feeling incredibly fortunate.
The word "fate," is ineffably wonderful.
Having done all this, Li Xuan looked at the Indestructible Divine Master, chuckling lightly, "Little one, if you feel dissatisfied, unwilling, then let's fight once more."
The Indestructible Divine Master's body trembled, hurriedly bowing his head, "I dare not; I, the Indestructible, concede!"
He had no choice but to concede!
The Daoist Ancestor's might could not be questioned!
Li Xuan looked towards the Taihao Realm, speaking calmly, "The great calamity of this world approaches, and I establish a Heavenly Dao to leave a Creation for this world and an opportunity for a new era; whether you grasp it, it depends on yourselves, whether this world is broken to be established anew or falls into extinction, it is also up to you.
"I have seen the rise and fall of this world countless times, and will not interfere too much, but I have left Creation for you all, whether you grasp it, whether you start a new era, is all up to you."
Looking at Xu Yan and the other disciples, he smiled, "What I should pass on to you, I've already passed, from now on, you have to rely on yourselves. The Dao is underfoot, and your master awaits the day you practice the Dao."
"Yes, Master!"
Xu Yan and the five respectfully bowed.
Master was about to leave!
Though their hearts were full of reluctance, Xu Yan and the five knew that the Master was moving on to another place, continuing his freedom, having seen countless worldly transformations, which were but clouds passing by for the Master.

chapters.title: Chapter 1158 - 597: Chaos in Taihao, Watching the World's Ups and Downs
chapters.content:
Taihao's Thirty-three Layer Heaven, each ascent to a new heaven was a dramatic transformation, until the Thirty-three Heavens, standing at the peak of the Taihao Realm.
Countless powerful beings dwelt in the Thirty-three Heavens, numerous ancient Sects that commanded fear throughout Taihao had established themselves there, and those powers called Divine Sects all possessed Taihao Divine Objects as their anchors.
But now, whether it was the First Layer Heaven or the Thirty-three Heavens, chaos reigned, and slaughter was omnipresent, resembling a dynasty's apocalypse, incessantly plagued by strife.
Roaming the Taihao Realm, regardless of which layer of heaven, one could see slaughter everywhere, corpses lying around, and even streams dyed red with blood.
The chaotic Taihao Realm also witnessed an era of power struggles, with heroes roaring angrily against this chaotic world, ambitious and bold, wishing to restore peace to the realm.
There were also those who took advantage of this chaotic age to carve out their own territories, enslaving the common populace with their formidable powers, and reveling in the thrill of slaughter.
More abundant were the cries of the weak, struggling to survive in this chaotic world, living day to day in fear, never knowing when they might suddenly fall dead.
Some were numb, living each day as it came, finding joy in every fleeting moment.
Looking across the Thirty-three Layer Heaven, it seemed impossible to find a haven of peace, not even the vast mountains or deserted areas, which harbored people escaping the chaos and powers gathering strength in hopes of rising again, were free from the slaughter over resources.
At one village, smoke still curled from cooking fires the previous day, today it was littered with corpses, no survivors to be found, and fierce beasts, drawn by the stench of blood, were gnawing on dismembered bodies and licking up dried blood.
Yesterday, bustling towns teeming with people had become eerily silent by today, and not a single corpse was to be found in the empty towns.
A robust man wearing a hat, carrying a long saber, and armed with a spear, walked into the deserted town, observing its desolate emptiness, but the fruit in the stores remained fresh.
The meat at the butchers was not yet spoiled, but the people were gone.
"Another slaughter by the New World Sect's felons!"
The robust man muttered angrily, his words filled with rage.
The New World Sect, a power disturbing the peace and tormenting the populace, preached about creating a new world, their doctrine being to exterminate all the filth of the old world to welcome the lord of the new, establishing a pure new age.
The chaotic world was inseparable from the New World Sect, who seemed to have suddenly emerged from nowhere, quickly gaining power, and overnight, some powerful Sects were destroyed.
Now, order collapsed, war was ubiquitous, cultivation seemed solely for the purpose of slaughtering the weak, as only through killing could one feel the pleasure of growing stronger, the whole world appeared mad.
The powerful preyed on the weak, forming groups to expand their territories, to enslave more of the weak, treating ordinary people like livestock, abusing and trampling them without restraint.
The robust man crossed the town and continued on, gripping his spear even tighter, his eyes filled with determination. This world was sick, deeply to the bone, and to cure its illness, one must split open the bones, remove the diseased marrow, and let fresh blood flow through the world.
As the sun set, the long shadows cast by the descending light stretched the robust man's figure, and on the desolate path, he walked alone, with only himself remaining in the world.
"Ah!"
Suddenly, a shriek pierced the air. The robust man looked toward the source of the cry and, taking a step, his body shot forward, rushing towards the sound.
On the road, a group dressed in white was attacking a carriage, a middle-aged man, along with two guards, desperately fending off the attackers.
On the ground, an old man and two guards lay dead in pools of blood.
"New World Sect, I have already given up my foundation and withdrawn from Lin City, do you still need to eradicate us completely?"
The middle-aged man roared angrily.
"If you cannot integrate into the new world, then you must vanish. Sinful beings do not deserve to live in the new world!"
A person in white spoke coldly.
Boom!
The carriage exploded, and a beautiful woman, clutching a child of three or four, faced a slashing saber with a look of despair. She hugged the child tightly, shielding him with her body.
Puff!
Blood spurted out, and the child's scream was abruptly silenced as a long saber pierced through the woman's back and also stabbed through the child she held.
"Beasts of the New World Sect!"
The middle-aged man's eyes red with fury, charged towards the men in white. Just then, a clear voice called out, "Father!"
A young girl in green clothes flew into action, her sword thrusting swiftly through the throat of one of the men in white.
Landing, the girl saw her mother and brother killed, her eyes turned blood red, and with her sword, she attacked the men in white, but at that moment, the middle-aged man regained some composure, came beside his daughter, and said, "Qing'er, go quickly, don't worry about father!"
"Go? Once you are here, don't think about escaping. It's perfect, the whole family, neat and clean. This little girl, suitable for relieving stress after a big battle!"
A sinister laugh sounded as a gaunt, ghost-like figure appeared instantly, and with a wave of his hand, chilling power surged everywhere.
Puff!
"Qing'er, be careful!"
The middle-aged man's face turned pale with shock, blocking in front of his daughter, and received the blow directly, his face turning deathly white as blood within him seemed to freeze.
"Qing'er, go!"
The middle-aged man roared, using his last strength, he shoved his daughter away from the encirclement, but he was too late to dodge, and two long sabers pierced through his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 1159 - 597: Chaos in Taihao, Watching the World's Ups and Downs_2
chapters.content:
"Dad!"
The girl let out a bone-chilling wail.
With a swish,
the people in white crowded around again, the gaunt figure sneering, "Don't resist anymore, you filthy person, you can't escape."
"I'll fight you with everything I've got!"
The girl gritted her teeth and charged at the people in white with her sword but, being outnumbered and despite her strength, she didn't stand much chance. Within moments, her shoulder was slashed, revealing a large expanse of her snowy white skin.
"Good, good, the little girl is indeed perfect for venting after a battle!"
The crowd in white burst out with sinister laughter.
Boom!
Suddenly, a long spear shot out, instantly piercing through one of the people in white. A burly figure descended, gripped the spear and shook it, causing the corpse to explode, then with a flash of cold light, another spear thrust pierced through another person in white.
"It's you, Zhao Changtian!"
The gaunt person in white, his expression drastically changed, clapped his hands together and quickly retreated, his chilling power seemingly freezing the surroundings.
With a swish,
Zhao Changtian's expression was cold. His spear thrust out, and one white-clad person after another was killed. Immediately, he moved, reaching the fleeing gaunt white-clothed person in an instant and speared him to death.
Back at the battlefield, the girl knelt before the corpses of her parents, her eyes empty, with tears endlessly flowing. Zhao Changtian silently stood next to her.
As night fell, the girl still hadn't moved, her tears continuously streaming. Zhao Changtian spoke, "Girl, the dead cannot be resurrected, but you must be strong. Living is the only way to get revenge. Those who killed your parents are from the New World Sect. Only by annihilating the New World Sect will your revenge be complete!"
The girl looked up at Zhao Changtian, her eyes gradually lighting up with fighting spirit, "Yes, the New World Sect must be annihilated; only then can I have my revenge. I must train hard; I must become stronger!"
The girl, having buried her parents, followed Zhao Changtian, "Brother Zhao, where are you heading next?"
"We're taking down a New World Sect stronghold."
"I'm coming with you."
"It's dangerous, you should find a safe..."
"Is Brother Zhao saying I'm too weak?"
"Not at all..."
"Good, I'm coming with you, I'll follow you from now on, together we will eradicate the New World Sect, and restore peace to the world."
"Alright then."
...
"Leader of the New World Sect, today is the day you die, the New World Sect ends today!"
Zhao Changtian and Lin Qing'er stood side by side, looking coldly at the New World Sect leader who was spitting up blood.
After ten years, the time had finally come to wipe out the New World Sect.
"Ha ha ha, do you think by killing me, the New World Sect will perish? My New World Sect was established by the heavens, hailing from above. If I die, the heavens will recreate the New World Sect until all you filthy beings are utterly annihilated!"
The leader of the New World Sect laughed crazily.
"Heavens? Then I, Zhao Changtian, will ascend to the heavens and annihilate the New World Sect once more!"
Zhao Changtian said coldly.
On the Thirteenth Heaven, a great battle erupted. Zhao Changtian, alone with his long spear, killed one New World Sect powerhouse after another, but his face grew increasingly pale.
"Huang Qin, I treated you like a brother, yet you betray me and join the New World Sect!"
Zhao Changtian looked angrily at a person among the crowd in white.
"Brother Zhao, you are defying the heavens, the New World Sect is not something you can eradicate. I simply made a wise decision, I am now a person of the New World, too."
Huang Qin spoke with a relaxed tone.
"Brother Zhao, rest assured and go ahead, I will take good care of your wife and nephew, making sure they are happy every day."
"You won't die a good death!"
Zhao Changtian roared, his body radiated with light, a powerful aura shaking the surroundings, his long spear sweeping across, instantaneously slaying numerous men in white. Then, he hurled his long spear.
"Qing'er, get out fast, Huang Qin is from the New World Sect!"
The long spear transformed into a streak of light and vanished into the sky.
Huang Qin's face darkened, while at the moment, Zhao Changtian drew his long blade and charged directly at Huang Qin. However, already gravely injured, after killing a few powerful individuals from the New World Sect, he couldn't hold on anymore.
Boom!
Zhao Changtian self-detonated.
A legendary figure fell, having fought from the First Layer Heaven to the Thirteenth Layer Heaven, a massive threat to the New World Sect perished today!
"Command passed, high reward for Lin Qing'er, search through the Thirteen Heavens, must find the person. Starting today, the Dangshi Army is removed from the Thirteenth Heaven!"
Huang Qin declared with a chilling intent.
In the Taihao Realm's First Layer Heaven, order had just been restored for a few decades, and now it plunged back into chaos and slaughter, with the New World Sect descending once more, stronger and more ruthless in their methods of killing.
Heavy rain poured down, in the dense forest, murder lingered everywhere. Inside a cave, Lin Qing'er, with a cold gaze, bit her lip tightly, looking at her six-year-old son with reluctance and sorrow.
"Huang Qin!"
Lin Qing'er whispered hatefully.
"Ping'er, crawl out of here through this small hole behind you, leave this dense forest, find a place to hide, and live well on your own, okay?"
Lin Qing'er said softly, her eyes full of reluctance.
"Mother, I will!"
Zhao Taiping nodded, turned, and ran towards the small hole in the cave, but then he ran back, gripping a long spear tightly.
Taking one last look at his mother, he dragged the long spear into the small hole, continually climbing forward. After an unknown amount of time, the mountain shook, and he heard his mother, Lin Qing'er's rage-filled yell.
Crawling out of the small hole, Zhao Taiping looked back, carrying the spear taller than himself, and continuously ran forward. Although he was only six, he was already a Second Realm Martial Artist and ran swiftly.
"Huang Qin, you won't die a good death!"
Suddenly, a poignant scream from his mother echoed behind him followed by a dull thud, and then all went silent.
Tears flowing, Zhao Taiping kept his lips tightly sealed, fleeing swiftly. At one point, he began leaping onto trees, running atop the trees, eventually finding a secret small cave, curled up and crawled inside, constantly erasing his climbing traces with a branch.
Boom!
The heavy rain poured, all tracks vanished in the rain, a group of men in white searched the forest, digging three feet into the ground, determined to find him.
They searched everywhere within a hundred miles but eventually found no one. Huang Qin's face was clouded with darkness.
Zhao Taiping kept crawling, not knowing how long or how far he had crawled. The small cave seemed endless. He dared not turn back, only gritting his teeth and moving forward.
Hungry and tired, in complete darkness, Zhao Taiping gritted his teeth, dragging the long spear, determined to keep moving forward. If he hadn't been a Second Realm Martial Artist, he would likely have succumbed by now.
But in the narrow and dark cave, seeing neither the end nor light, even the slightly weak-willed would despair and go mad.
The six-year-old Zhao Taiping, clenching his teeth, determinedly crawled forward, not knowing how far he had come until the cave grew slightly bigger, allowing him to walk upright. Tears once again flowed unchecked, feeling intense pain in his knees and elbows. Touching them, he found sticky, worn skin from the crawling.
Gritting his teeth, Zhao Taiping continued moving forward, holding onto the belief that he would either exit the cave or die within it!
Finally, a hint of light appeared ahead. Zhao Taiping showed excitement, supporting his long spear, he sprinted forward, emerging from the cave. He plucked some fruits to stave off hunger, briefly treated his wounds on both knees and elbows, then continued fleeing through the vast mountains.
"Master, why don't we stay in the Thirty-Three Heavens?"
In a small valley, reminiscent of a paradise, a quaint courtyard with elegant wooden cabins, a lush large tree, bluish jade stone pathways, rockeries, small bridges over streams, and flowers in vibrant purples.
Li Xuan sat leisurely in a chair, with Cai Ling'er attending him, asking in confusion.
"The sky does not reveal the depth of Dao, where can one not cultivate, not practice the Dao? This First Layer Heaven, just right, suitable for watching the world's ups and downs."
Li Xuan said with a light laugh.
From the Land of Imperishable, arriving at the Taihao Realm, having traveled the Thirty-Three Heavens for a hundred years, witnessing the rise and fall of powerful beings, chaos, and slaughter persisted, he did not intervene, merely a bystander.
Finally, arriving at this small valley, set up like a tranquil paradise, leisurely watching the events of the world, waiting for the catastrophe that would end everything, waiting for Xu Yan and others, from the Land of Imperishable to the Taihao Realm, waiting for the change of Heavenly Dao, waiting for Xu Yan to practice the Dao.

chapters.title: Chapter 1160 - 598: The One Born to Face Calamity, The War Slaughter Martial Way
chapters.content:
Li Xuan sat leisurely under the big tree, fiddling with the Jade Ruyi in his hand, sipping the Taihao Realm's finest Spiritual Tea. He felt at ease, the chaos and slaughter in the Taihao Realm having no effect on him, nor did he interfere.
After reviving Taicang and pulling Fen Yun and Hong Ze out from amidst the years, he shocked everyone. Even the Immortal Divine Lord dared not collapse with a roar.
As for whether Taicang and the Immortal Divine Lord would continue to battle, Li Xuan no longer cared. However, it was likely both sides would cease fighting.
The Immortal Divine Lord wanted to return to the Taihao Realm. There was only one path he could take, which was to make the Heavenly Dao continue to grow stronger, so that the Heavenly Dao Rules would eventually extend out of the Land of Imperishable. Only then could he return to the Taihao Realm.
With the Immortal Divine Lord's tenacity and determination, to return to the Taihao Realm and seek revenge, he would certainly be willing to do anything. He would surely spare no effort and find every possible way to strengthen the Heavenly Dao as quickly as possible.
As for Xu Yan's five disciples, they had learned all that needed to be taught. Xu Yan had already comprehended the Method of Practicing Dao, only lacking the time to cultivate. He had reached the Creation Realm, just a step away from the Great Achievement of Creation Realm.
Meng Chong, Su Lingxiu, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping were just half a step from the Creation Realm. It wouldn't be long before they could break through to the Creation Realm.
As for comprehending the Primordial and Practicing Dao, with Xu Yan as their senior brother guiding them, they would also achieve enlightenment and ultimately practice the Dao.
Of course, the further one progressed in cultivation, the more time it consumed, requiring time to settle. Xu Yan's rapid breakthrough was not only due to his exceptional talent but also because of his opportunities.
The Land of Imperishable had opened a new era, and that green light was the greatest opportunity. Xu Yan could no longer make such rapid breakthroughs as before and also needed time to settle.
Before leaving the Land of Imperishable, Li Xuan gave some advice on the matter of the Great Calamity, but didn't elaborate, leaving Xu Yan and the others to explore and respond to this calamity on their own.
The ebb and flow of the world, for Li Xuan practicing the Dao, was like clouds and smoke. The one who was suppressed was indeed powerful, but not enough to pose any threat to him.
A practitioner of the Dao stood upon the great Dao, transcending the world, truly eternally invincible.
Coming to the Taihao Realm, Li Xuan naturally couldn't come alone. After all, he was accustomed to a life of being attended to. How could he be without attendants upon arriving in the Taihao Realm?
Therefore, coming to the Taihao Realm, he brought along the maid, Cai Ling'er.
Besides Cai Ling'er, his pet and mount, the Red Cat, also came along, as well as Muxiao and Shi'er.
After all, subordinates were required to handle certain matters. Muxiao continued as usual, sweeping the fallen leaves in the courtyard.
As for Shi'er, he was a servant responsible for trimming the plants, building houses, collecting some things outside, and the like.
For a hundred years in the Taihao Realm, traveling through the Thirty-three Heavens, seeing all the chaos and slaughter, his heart remained unperturbed, not interfering. All this turmoil originated from the one who was suppressed.
During this hundred years, Li Xuan had spare time to walk on the great Dao. By now, he had walked a hundred miles on the Dao, and only the mysteries and scenery of the Dao could intrigue him.
After walking a hundred miles on the Dao, Li Xuan lay back down, for walking the Dao was indeed difficult. Each distance covered left him exhausted, so he prepared to wait for Xu Yan to practice the Dao, waiting for feedback from his disciples' practice.
In a hundred years, Muxiao's strength had broken through, surpassing the Master of Domain level, truly at the top in the Taihao Realm, save for a few. None could match him.
And those few were strong due to their association with the one who was suppressed.
The maid, Cai Ling'er, who served him, the Daoist Ancestor, was graced by Dao Intent, her strength rapidly ascended, reaching the Master of Domain level.
As for the weakest Shi'er, following by his side, his talent, enhanced by Dao Intent, had undergone transformation and improvement, now becoming a Martial Artist who was just entering the Domain Realm.
A hundred years was but a mere flick of the finger for Li Xuan.
"Sir, the Taihao Realm is too chaotic. There is slaughter everywhere. When will it end? Must we wait for the Heavenly Dao to replace Taihao for it to be over?" Cai Ling'er lamented.
"Great calamities, they are naturally thus." Li Xuan said with a light laugh.
"Will the Taihao Realm still produce heroic villains? That one who killed all the way from the First Layer Heaven to the Thirteen Layer Heaven counts as a heroic villain, right? But it's a pity he stopped at the Thirteen Heavens. Will Taihao appear, flattening the entire Taihao Realm, restoring a clear and bright Taihao Realm's pride?" Cai Ling'er asked curiously.
"A chaotic world yields prodigies. There will inevitably be prodigies born and heroes born in response to the calamity. Whether they can restore the Taihao Realm's clarity is difficult, for the source of this great calamity is still suppressed below." Li Xuan shook his head.
According to the normal trajectory of development, even if a prodigy born in response to the calamity emerged in the Taihao Realm, it couldn't change this great calamity, for no matter how talented, no matter how cultivated, one couldn't surpass the one suppressed below.
Unless that one was repressed again or thoroughly annihilated, the outcome couldn't change.
Back then, Taicang was hailed as the greatest pride from ancient times in the Taihao Realm, yet in the end, he still fell, and Taicang was a remarkably extraordinary pride.
"Is it that only the Heavenly Dao can change all of this?" Cai Ling'er was bursting with curiosity.
"The Heavenly Dao is the creation left by the Daoist Ancestor, also giving this world a chance for another great creation."

chapters.title: Chapter 1161 - 598: The Person Born to Face the Tribulation, War Slaughter Martial Way_2
chapters.content:
```
"Then it depends on Xu Yan and the others. I, the Daoist Ancestor, will not interfere too much. The Heavenly Dao is boundless, Taihao has vanished, the Land of Imperishable is destroyed, and the great calamity dissipates; that is the era of the Heavenly Dao. Otherwise, the world will sink into oblivion, and after long years, a new creation will emerge. Such is the cycle of things."
Li Xuan smiled and spoke.
Cai Ling'er nodded. Since the Daoist Ancestor had said he would not interfere too much, it didn't mean he wouldn't interfere at all. Therefore, the final result would undoubtedly herald the great era of the Heavenly Dao.
Moreover, Xu Yan was exceptionally talented; he must have already walked the path before the coming of the great calamity. If he had walked the path, then wouldn't the suppressed one be easily wiped out with a wave of his hand?
Furthermore, as the Heavenly Dao continued to rise, it could also match the power of those who walked the path and suppress that one.
The Heavenly Dao was not only being strengthened by Tian Zi's schemes; even the Indestructible Divine Master, Taicang, and others would find ways to elevate the Heavenly Dao. This was a significant opportunity.
"Sir, are there any outstanding talents in the Taihao Realm who catch your eye?"
"Fate, it all depends on fate. Those destined will naturally catch my eye."
Cai Ling'er pondered. Perhaps in the Taihao Realm, the Daoist Ancestor would take on a disciple?
The sixth disciple under the Daoist Ancestor?
It all depended on who had the blessing of fortune.
"Red Cat, since you've come to Taihao, don't you want to establish the Taihao Demon Clan?"
In the creek, Shi'er held a brush in his hand, brushing the Red Cat's body, and spoke with a helpless expression.
"I, the Demon King, have no interest in that for now. The Great Wilderness Demon Clan is enough; creating another demon clan is pointless. Brush properly, and on my back, put a bit more strength!"
The Red Cat lay comfortably in the creek.
Damn!
Shi'er cursed silently. That bastard Red Cat still held a grudge from when he had whipped it!
"Don't complain; brushing the Daoist Ancestor's cat is your duty."
The Red Cat yawned and said.
"You're a tiger, not a cat!"
Shi'er replied with a dark expression.
"Tigers are also called big cats, so I am also a cat, meow meow!"
Damn!
Shi'er was left speechless.
"Brush under my armpit!"
The Red Cat rolled over, belly up, lifting its forelegs.
"Hey, someone's coming."
Shi'er suddenly spoke.
The Red Cat looked up towards the entrance of the valley. A small figure was running towards the valley, his clothes tattered, bloodstains faintly visible on his elbow, dragging a long spear in his hand.
"This little guy is quite something. Such a young age, and his strength is comparable to someone who has just entered the Qi-Blood Realm. Not bad at all. From his looks, he seems to be fleeing for his life."
Shi'er said in surprise.
"Could this be someone with deep fortune? Hey, does his long spear look familiar?"
The Red Cat stood up from the creek.
"It's the weapon of the Dangshi Army's leader."
Shi'er nodded. The leader of the Dangshi Army, Zhao Changtian, was a legendary figure within the Taihao Realm's Thirteen Layer Heaven, a hero of his generation.
Starting from the First Layer Heaven, he founded the Dangshi Army, vowing to wipe out chaos and injustice across the world. They fought their way to the Thirteen Layer Heaven and caught a glimpse from afar during their travels through the Taihao Realm.
Although they never ventured into it, they still had some impression of the Dangshi Army and Zhao Changtian, and his wife, Lin Qing'er.
"The Dangshi Army is finished, what a pity!"
Shi'er lamented.
The appearance of Zhao Changtian's weapon in the hands of the young boy, while he was fleeing, was self-evident. Zhao Changtian had been defeated, and this one was likely Zhao Changtian's heir.
"This little guy managed to escape pursuit and even come here. Tsk tsk, he's truly blessed."
The Red Cat leapt over.
Zhao Taiping ran desperately, ducking and hiding, fleeing aimlessly, never daring to stop for fear of being discovered and hunted down.
He didn't know how far he had escaped. When he was hungry, he picked fruit to eat, and when he couldn't stay awake any longer, he found a small cave to hide and rest for a while before continuing to flee.
Day and night, traversing mountains and ridges, he didn't know exactly how far he had run; was it hundreds or thousands of miles?
That day, he reached a small valley. Just as he stepped into it, he felt refreshed and couldn't help but wonder if it was an illusion. The aura in the small valley felt fresher, and the Spiritual Energy seemed denser, as if cultivating here would yield faster results.
"Is this place safe?"
Thinking of his deceased mother and being without family, living alone, and with enemies searching for him, his eyes welled up with tears. However, he gritted his teeth and wasn't defeated by adversity.
"Father, Mother, I will definitely avenge you."
Zhao Taiping's gaze was firm.
He looked around the small valley. It seemed secluded, desolate, and uninhabited, with beautiful scenery, suitable for hiding and cultivation.
"Set up here, cultivate and improve my strength. One day, I will surely kill Huang Qin!"
Zhao Taiping continued to walk deeper into the valley, intending to explore it and set up a place to reside and practice Martial Arts diligently, hoping to gain enough strength to avenge his parents soon.
Suddenly!
A gust of wind blew, a Splendid Ferocious Tiger appeared, majestic with bloodthirsty eyes.
Zhao Taiping was startled, hurriedly holding the spear in his hand, gripping it tightly, pointing the sharp spearhead towards the tiger, and unleashed his full momentum, suppressing his inner fear.
As the tiger drew closer step by step, Zhao Taiping let out a low growl, holding the spear, and thrust it towards the tiger's throat!
The spear shot out like a dragon, a flash of cold light, and landed on the tiger's throat. Zhao Taiping had no time to celebrate; then, his face turned pale with fright.
It couldn't penetrate!
In a panic, he withdrew the spear and retreated, letting out a low growl, using all his strength to stab again, this time targeting the tiger's eyes!
Yet, to his horror, the spearhead still couldn't pierce as it touched the tiger's eye, and the tiger took a step forward. A force transmitted through the long spear, knocking him to the ground.
Zhao Taiping's small face was filled with despair. Was he to be buried in this tiger's belly? What kind of tiger was this, why couldn't he pierce it?
The long spear left by his father wasn't an ordinary weapon!
"Red Cat, don't frighten him too much!"
Shi'er walked over with a helpless expression.
"I'm just testing the little guy's courage."
The Red Cat raised its head and said.
Zhao Taiping looked at Shi'er, then at the Red Cat. His vision turned black, and he fainted.
"Look, you scared him."
Shi'er picked up Zhao Taiping, flicked the long spear with his toes, and held it in his hand. "Let's see what the Daoist Ancestor says."
Li Xuan looked at Zhao Taiping, smiling. He was a young boy with deep fortune, surviving a great calamity and finding his way to his secluded place.
Could this be fate?
Just like in the past, when Xu Yan, in search of a master, stumbled into the small village.
Since there's a connection and his talent is not bad, being the orphan of a hero carrying deep blood feuds, in this chaotic Taihao Realm, he is someone born for this calamity.
Then, in Taihao, take on a disciple.
The sixth disciple.
"Zhao Taiping, pay respects to Master!"
Zhao Taiping respectfully bowed to become a disciple.
"You are my sixth disciple, your five senior siblings each cultivate a Martial Arts path. Today, I will teach you the War Slaughter Martial Way. Cultivate War Qi, gather killing intent, and fight without end!"
For Li Xuan of today, creating a Martial Arts path was as easy as waving a hand, without expecting the new martial path to bring him feedback. After all, having walked the path, he had long transcended all this.
Ultimately, all Martial Arts paths lead to the same destination; it's just a matter of walking the path.
Zhao Taiping cultivated the War Slaughter Martial Way, focusing on War Qi and gathering killing intent, a martial art centered on battle and killing, perfectly suited for the current Taihao Realm.
Only by fighting, only by killing, from the First Layer Heaven, battling to the Thirty-Three Layer Heaven!
"Thank you, Master!"
Zhao Tianping was filled with excitement.
"Father, Mother, I will avenge you!"
Zhao Taiping's gaze was resolute.
Time passed, and in the blink of an eye, twenty years had gone by.
The once little boy, Zhao Taiping, had grown into a handsome young man. Twenty years of diligent cultivation, and he now possessed the power of the Divine Skill Realm.
On this day, it was time for Zhao Taiping to leave the mountain gate and venture outside, to avenge his father. With his current power in the Divine Skill Realm, not to mention the Thirteen Layer Heaven, he was strong enough to fight to the Twenty Layer Heaven.
The War Slaughter Martial Way must show its edge, must grow in battle, cultivate in battle, and rise in battle.
That day, Zhao Taiping held his long spear, walking out of the valley, alone with his spear, sweeping across the First Layer Heaven, annihilating the New World Sect, then ascending to the Second Layer Heaven, likewise sweeping across the New World Sect with an invincible stance.
The return of Zhao Taiping, the sole heir of Zhao Changtian, leader of the Dangshi Army, began with a vengeance for his father, sweeping across the New World Sect. From the remnants of the Dangshi Army who hadn't been killed and were hiding, figures began to emerge and gather together.
The Taihao Realm had entered the era of Zhao Taiping!
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1162 - 599: Cataclysm, Major Epoch of the Heavenly Dao
chapters.content:
The Taihao Realm, cloaked in chaos and darkness, found a glimmer of dawn because of Zhao Taiping's extraordinary emergence. In a world filled with slaughter, he stopped killing with killing, starting from the First Layer Heaven, climbing up over mountains of corpses and seas of blood.
First Layer Heaven, the New World Sect was annihilated!
Bandits, demons, butchers, annihilated!
Wherever Zhao Taiping's Long Spear reached, no one could escape. He moved up killing even more ferociously than his parents had in their time, with more decisive, fiercer slaughter, and he did so alone, facing countless enemies.
Ignoring the remnants of his parents' old subordinates and the remaining warriors of the Dangshi Army, he did not reorganize the so-called Dangshi Army; instead, with a spear in hand alone, he eradicated all enemies and leveled all slaughter.
Some called Zhao Taiping the Supreme Hero, others the Supreme Demon, but he cared for neither praise nor slander; such is the path of the strong.
First Layer Heaven, levelled; Second Layer Heaven, levelled.
He continued his journey of slaughter all the way to the Thirteen Layer Heaven where he directly attacked his enemy Huang Qin's stronghold, avenging his parents.
Time passed, a thousand years had elapsed, and the Taihao Realm remained as chaotic and murderous as ever. Less than a hundred years after Zhao Taiping had leveled the First Layer Heaven, chaos descended once again, marking everywhere with slaughter.
Over those thousand years, Zhao Taiping had risen amidst constant pursuit and encirclement by enemies, his reputation formidable, eventually reaching the Thirty-three Heavens.
The name War Demon Zhao Taiping echoed through the Taihao Realm; no one knew who his master was, only that his martial arts were incomparably powerful, growing stronger with each battle, and crushing peers without rival.
Boom!
The Taihao Realm shook slightly, marking the third such tremor; these tremors were not of any individual Layer of Heaven, but rather the entire Taihao Thirty-Three Heavens shook.
After being decimated by Zhao Taiping, the New World Sect had been rekindled stronger, with more powerful warriors, even including some from what were once Divine Sects, now behind the scenes of the New World Sect, many renowned warriors had joined its ranks.
In this tremor of the Taihao Realm, Zhao Taiping found himself under siege, alone, facing many warriors from various Divine Sects, New World Sect warriors among them.
Even some ancient warriors previously known only from legend had appeared this time, solely to kill Zhao Taiping.
"Master, should we help Taiping?"
In a small valley, Li Xuan remained as ever, relaxed and observing the world's fluctuations.
Cai Ling'er's strength had already surpassed that of the Master of Domain; Muxiao's powers were no lesser than King Chi Ni, and Red Cat's strength was also comparable to the former King Chi Ni.
Even Shi'er's strength had achieved Establishing Dao Great Accomplishment.
"His path is his own to walk."
Li Xuan shook his head.
"But Taiping can't withstand so many powerful enemies."
Cai Ling'er furrowed her delicate brows.
Even now, as Zhao Taiping had reached the early stage of the Creation Realm, there were several old figures in the Taihao Realm whose strength was not inferior to his, perhaps even stronger.
With so many powerful enemies united, Zhao Taiping could not resist; he was already pushed to the edge of the Taihao Realm, near the border of the Land of Imperishable.
Their intentions were clear: either kill Zhao Taiping or force him into the Land of Imperishable to banish him!
Boom!
The Taihao Realm shook again, each tremor signifying that the suppressed figure moved closer to breaking free.
"He can enter the Land of Imperishable."
Li Xuan smiled, "For him, it's not a bad thing."
"Indeed, he and his brothers can gather in the Land of Imperishable."
Cai Ling'er asked curiously, "Master, how is the Great Wilderness doing? How strong has Heavenly Dao become?"
How is the Great Wilderness?
How strong is Heavenly Dao now?
Muxiao, Shi'er, and Red Cat all looked over curiously.
"How the Great Wilderness is? Naturally, it's utterly transformative; Imperishable, Taicang both extraordinary figures who know how to manage and grow quickly."
Li Xuan laughed heartily.
With a wave of his hand, an image appeared, depicting the current state of the Great Wilderness Domain.
Cai Ling'er, Muxiao, Shi'er, and Red Cat looked on, impressed beyond words; the vastness of the Great Wilderness Domain had already surpassed the current Taihao Realm.
Moreover, it was continually growing stronger, constantly breaking through the Chaotic Imperishable, the Heavenly Dao immensely powerful, spreading far and wide, already encompassing a vast part of the Land of Imperishable.
"My Demon Clan, quite glorious indeed!"
Red Cat was exceedingly excited inside.
"Eh, is the Great Wilderness moving?"
Cai Ling'er exclaimed in surprise.
"Yes, following the rules of the Land of Imperishable, approaching Taihao; Imperishable, that little fellow, somewhat impatient, wishing to return to Taihao for revenge."
Li Xuan smiled.
The battles of the Thirty-three Heavens continued, Zhao Taiping, although heavily scarred, remained devastatingly fierce, chilling many powerful beings to their cores, more determined than ever to either kill him or exile him to the Land of Imperishable.
Boom!
The Taihao Realm shook once more, this time the duration of the shaking lasted much longer; numerous places in the First Layer Heaven had the ground cracking, mountains collapsing.
With this tremor, as if an unruly aura accompanied by a sinister presence spread out, surged upwards to the Thirty-three Heavens, and blasted into the Land of Imperishable, stirring up a storm even within the Imperishable Land.
"Is this the prelude to the Cataclysmic Tribulation?"
Inside the Great Wilderness Domain, numerous warriors had stern expressions, a storm sweeping in, its force considerable.
"Friend Xu, is this the Cataclysmic Tribulation?"
The Indestructible Divine Master turned to Xu Yan, extremely courteous, daring not show any disrespect. After all, Xu Yan was now the strongest being in the entire Land of Imperishable.

chapters.title: Chapter 1163 - 599: Cataclysm, Major Epoch of the Heavenly Dao_2
chapters.content:
He, joining forces with Taicang, Black Chi King, Master of the Jade Court, and Gargantuan Gluttonous King, wasn't enough to withstand even one hand from Xu Yan.
"A very strong presence, filled with brutality and bloodlust, is about to break free."
Xu Yan said calmly.
Xu Yan had already achieved Minor Achievement in the Primordial Realm, and Great Achievement wasn't far off.
Meng Chong, Su Lingxiu, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping had all perfected the Creation realm and were about to step into the Primordial Realm.
The power of the Heavenly Dao Rules was also rising rapidly, nearly reaching the strength of the Primordial Realm.
"You all need to put more effort into it, with the current might of Heavenly Dao, we can't face the apocalypse, and I can't be sure that I can deal with that one either."
Xu Yan expressed with a more solemn tone.
Hearing this, the Indestructible Divine Master's expression became slightly heavier, "Don't worry, we will elevate the Heavenly Dao as quickly as possible and break open the Land of Imperishable."
After saying this, he immediately left the Great Wilderness, arriving outside the coverage of the Heavenly Dao, his aura erupted, and with a thunderous noise, his strong power broke through the Chaotic Imperishable, and a small domain was created.
With the creation of the small domain, the Heavenly Dao Rules spread to it, swallowing the new territory and thus expanding the Great Wilderness.
The method of creating domains was taught by Taicang. The Indestructible Divine Master and a few other powerful figures capable of domain creation would create domains periodically, allowing the Great Wilderness to consume them, thus swiftly enhancing the Great Wilderness and elevating the Heavenly Dao.
As for the grudges with Taicang, they had already been set aside.
Black Chi King, Master of the Jade Court, and Gargantuan Gluttonous King also came to the Great Wilderness, joining the cause to face the apocalyptic threat, especially the Black Chi King. He felt connected to the rules of the Land of Imperishable and, as the calamity approached, he could feel the terror of the apocalypse more keenly.
"It won't be long before the cataclysm descends, the Heavenly Dao is not strong enough!"
The Black Chi King looked extremely serious.
He turned to Taicang and said, "Taicang, you should become the Heavenly Dao, with your abilities, you would surely grasp the intricacies of the Heavenly Dao Creation more readily and thus enhance the Heavenly Dao quickly."
After all, Tian Zi was not on par with Taicang and was a bit more playful. Since the Great Wilderness Domain originated from Taicang Domain, Taicang could expedite the growth of the Heavenly Dao.
"Tian Zi is the Heavenly Dao. He is the spirit of the Domain incarnate, the perfect fit."
Taicang said indifferently.
"Taicang, I think Black Loach has a point, why don't you also become the Heavenly Dao?"
Tian Zi scratched his head and spoke.
The face of Black Chi King turned dark, but he was helpless against Tian Zi. Now, Tian Zi's strength was even stronger than his. And Taicang, this guy, had also surpassed him in strength.
"This is the Great Wilderness, not Taicang, Tian Zi, remember this is your Domain, you are the Heavenly Dao!"
Taicang spoke seriously.
"Alright, I am the Heavenly Dao!"
Tian Zi nodded his head.
Boom!
On this day, the entire Land of Imperishable started to quake slightly, like a calm lake surface disturbed by a thrown stone. Countless True Spirits screamed in terror, seething with agitation, and a wave of beasts charged towards the Great Wilderness.
Even Black Chi King and Gargantuan Gluttonous King could not completely suppress these restless True Spirits. The part of the Great Wilderness that was closing in on the edge of Taihao, following the rules of the Land of Imperishable, wavered slightly as well.
"Even the Land of Imperishable has begun to tremble, the great calamity is nearing."
Everyone's expressions turned grave.
"The rules of the Land of Imperishable are chaotic; they seem on the verge of collapse."
Black Chi King said with seriousness.
"This is a good opportunity, an opportunity to break the Land of Imperishable and elevate the Heavenly Dao, the era of the Heavenly Dao should begin."
Xu Yan reminded them.
Upon hearing this, Taicang and others began to busy themselves. During the tremors of the Land of Imperishable, the Great Wilderness was consuming the Land of Imperishable, growing continuously as the Heavenly Dao spread like wildfire.
Boom!
Zhao Taiping, covered with wounds, fell into Chaos. He killed a True Spirit with his spear and looked around at the boundless Chaotic Imperishable, while trying to return to Taihao, he encountered an invisible barrier.
"Land of No Return!"
Zhao Taiping looked visibly more grave but didn't worry. Holding his Long Spear, he found a place to heal his wounds. Once recovered, he began wandering through the Land of Imperishable.
Boom!
The tremors grew, and a storm whipped up within the Land of Imperishable; True Spirits raged, galloping in all directions.
"Is the apocalyptic calamity about to begin?"
Zhao Taiping muttered to himself and continued to wander in the Land of Imperishable, practicing Martial Arts and strengthening himself.
He didn't know how long he wandered when suddenly, in the distant Chaos, he spotted a Treasure Bead shining brilliantly, piquing his curiosity, and he immediately headed towards it.
In Taihao Realm, with Zhao Taiping forced into the Land of Imperishable, the strong beings of the Thirty-three Heavens breathed a sigh of relief. But then the slaughter resumed, anyone who opposed the New World Sect was to be executed without exception.
Boom!
In another tremor, the First Layer Heaven of Taihao Realm collapsed, the sun and moon fell, the apocalyptic calamity had arrived, and living beings suffered miserably. Only a small valley remained unaffected.
"Teacher, has the apocalyptic calamity arrived?"
Cai Ling'er asked curiously.
"It has begun, I suppose."
Li Xuan nodded.
A century later, in a massive tremor, the Second Layer Heaven collapsed, plummeting downward. Even the New World Sect, proponents of a new epoch, found it hard to remain composed, sensing something amiss. This was not a new world but the end of it!
Thus, this group started to endeavor to save the world!
They sought to suppress the darkness. Even the mighty beings of the Thirty-three Heavens realized the peril. If this continued, the entire Taihao Realm might collapse, and despite their strength, survival was not guaranteed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1164 - 599: Apocalypse, Great Era of the Heavenly Dao_3
chapters.content:
No one knew when the news began to spread in the Taihao Realm that a terrifying Destructive Demon had been suppressed below it. People erected statues and worshipped the demon, hoping to pledge loyalty to survive the apocalypse.
The already chaotic Taihao Realm became increasingly tumultuous.
"It's a bit too soon!"
Li Xuan looked towards the Great Wilderness. The Heavenly Dao was not yet sufficient to assimilate the Taihao Realm, nor to handle the apocalyptic calamity. It still needed more time to grow, so that guy couldn't come out yet.
Li Xuan, sitting leisurely in his chair, stamped his foot on the ground. Henceforth, for a thousand years, the Taihao Realm calmed down. The New World Sect then started shouting about initiating a new era, and many powerhouses breathed a sigh of relief.
Only below the Taihao Realm was a supremely powerful being full of bloodthirst and brutality, furiously roaring in anger, continuously bombarding the seal, trying to break free. He had been bombarding it for a thousand years, and, for some reason, one day, the barrier he could once shake became utterly immovable.
It was as if a dark hand had secretly tightened the already loosened seal.
Boom!
One day, the Taihao Realm was shaken again, and with the tremor came the faint sound of an evil laugh, an utterly malevolent sound that made one's hair stand on end.
Thus, the many powerhouses of the Taihao Realm panicked again, splitting into two factions. One believed in breaking the old to establish the new, arguing that the inception of a new era required discarding the outdated.
The other believed that with the emergence of the great demon, everyone would die inevitably — there would be no new world. Thus, the two factions fought endlessly, one wanting to suppress the demon, the other wanting to free and join the demon.
Boom!
In a massive quake, the Thirty-three Heavens of the Taihao Realm developed cracks, and it seemed as if the entire realm would collapse. Many powerhouses regretted having banished Zhao Taiping to the Land of Imperishable.
Amid the fighting and chaos, black mists rolled, and a tyrannical aura enveloped the entire realm. A horrifying will appeared in the Taihao Realm, replacing the sun, moon, and stars.
Looking up, one would see a pair of bloodthirsty eyes overlooking all beings, and even the Land of Imperishable was in turmoil. The barrier separating Taihao from the Land of Imperishable thunderously collapsed.
The apocalyptic calamity had arrived.
Simultaneously, a majestic air surged from the Chaos, and the formidable Heavenly might descended. Looking ahead, the Chaos was nowhere to be seen, replaced by a boundless Domain swallowing up the Chaos and assimilating the laws of the Taihao Realm.
Heavenly Dao Great Era!
Those bloodthirsty eyes looked towards the Great Wilderness and roared, "All shall die, all must perish, kill, kill, kill!"
At the same time, a voice came from that vast domain.
"I, the Indestructible Divine Master, have returned today!"
Inside the Taihao Realm, several people's expressions changed wildly, their faces filled with disbelief.
"How is it possible, the Indestructible Divine Master is still alive?"
"Impossible, how can he still be alive."
Then, a laughing voice followed, "I, Zhao Taiping, am also back, do you all remember me?"
At this, the powerhouses of the Taihao Realm turned pale with shock.
"And me, Taicang!"
A sigh sounded.
