Then, one voice after another rang out, with the powerhouses of the Taihao Realm showing immense terror in their eyes, though some also showed excitement and joy.
"The filthy and chaotic Taihao should disappear. From now on, only the Great Wilderness exists, where all beings should know the utmost fairness of the Heavenly Dao, and recognize the virtue of the Heavenly Dao."
Boom!
The majesty of the Splendid Heavenly Path descended, and the Indestructible Divine Master, leading his subordinates, stormed into the Taihao Realm, seeking revenge!
"How dare you, this is mine!"
A terrifying roar sounded.
Boom! The Taihao Realm collapsed and exploded, as a horrifying figure descended.

chapters.title: Chapter 1165 - 600: The Tao is Me, I am the Tao (Grand Finale)
chapters.content:
```
The Taihao Realm collapsed, and at that moment, the Land of Imperishable shook violently. The Imperishable Qi swept in, pouring into the location of the collapsing Taihao Realm, shrouded in Chaos, accompanied by a terrifying aura filled with brutality and bloodlust.
The Indestructible Divine Master and others were all aghast, feeling the descent of a terrifying aura, and hurriedly escaped the collapsing Taihao Realm back into the Great Wilderness.
The exploding Taihao Realm stirred up a terrifying storm, the massive impact shaking in all directions. The Thirty-three Heavens shattered into countless pieces, with numerous living beings within these massive fragments in terror.
The Great Wilderness Domain also descended upon the location of the Taihao Realm at this moment, sweeping the shattered fragments of the Taihao Realm into the Azure Sea of the Great Wilderness, transforming them into islands.
The Indestructible Divine Master and others even ordered Tian Zi to sweep their enemies from the shattered Taihao Realm and imprison them, to continue their revenge.
Boom!
The Taihao Realm exploded, and the Chaotic Imperishable Qi swept in. A terrifying figure descended, his entire being wrapped in a brutal aura, eyes glowing a sinister red like a portentous creature.
This figure, his aura immensely powerful beyond imagination, collapsed the entire Taihao Realm. More terrifying was that the aura of the Land of Imperishable was being continuously consumed into his body, the Imperishable Qi converging within.
Violent spiritual energy was also being consumed. The Great Wilderness Domain was indeed enormous, far surpassing the Taihao Realm, but even it seemed somewhat fragile in the face of such a terrifying entity.
"What kind of powerhouse is this?"
King Chi Ni turned pale with fear. "The Land of Imperishable is doomed!"
The Land of Imperishable was shrinking, disappearing, its rules being devoured by the other.
Tian Zi shouted, "Quick, take action, seize the Land of Imperishable!"
Boom!
The majesty of the Heavenly Path swept over, simultaneously swallowing the broken Taihao Realm and shattering the Chaos, incorporating it into the Great Wilderness Domain. This was a struggle against that powerful entity.
"Courting death!"
That terrifying figure revealed a ferocious look, glanced at the Great Wilderness, snorted coldly, and with a wave of his hand, unleashed an attack.
With just a casual strike, the Indestructible Divine Master and others turned pale with dread. It was incredibly powerful, unbelievably strong, only matched by the intervention of a Daoist Ancestor.
Such a powerful blow could absolutely annihilate the former King Chi Ni!
Could this be a terrifying entity comparable to a Daoist Ancestor?
This was the apocalypse!
With the collapse of Taihao, even the Land of Imperishable could not escape.
Boom!
Purple thunder raged and crashed out fiercely, colliding with that attack. The Great Wilderness Domain trembled, and under this attack, it drifted backward.
The Indestructible Divine Master and others visibly changed, pouring all their strength into a frenzied effort to bolster the majesty of the Heavenly Path.
Bang!
A majestic figure appeared in the Great Wilderness, raised his hand, and the majestic power fell into his hand. He suddenly struck out a palm, colliding with the second strike of that powerful figure.
Taicang!
At this moment, Taicang replaced Tian Zi, taking command of the Heavenly Dao, using the power of the Heavenly Dao, and combining it with his and the Indestructible Divine Master's strength to battle that terrifying entity.
That terrifying figure was consuming everything, Imperishable Qi and violent spiritual energy constantly entering his body, his aura growing stronger.
"Xu Yan, take action now!"
Tian Zi took the opportunity to devour the Land of Imperishable, strengthening the Great Wilderness, while watching as that figure grew stronger, shouted anxiously.
"Very strong!"
Xu Yan's expression was extremely grave. Even though he had reached Primordial Realm Perfection, just one step away from the Dao, he felt immense pressure.
Boom!
At that moment, that terrifying figure raised his hand and punched. The power of this punch far exceeded the previous strike, beyond the defense of the Heavenly Dao Rules. The Great Wilderness would inevitably be blasted away by this punch.
Swish!
A sword light slashed out, cut through the punch. With a roaring sound, powerful forces shook all around, the Great Wilderness still jarred and drifting backward.
"Quick, swallow the Taihao Realm."
Tian Zi continued to control the Great Wilderness, approaching the shattered Taihao Realm. Even if shattered, the fragments of the Taihao Realm were like small worlds. Devouring them, the Great Wilderness would grow stronger.
In the Great Wilderness Domain, Tian Zi was responsible for controlling the swallowing of the Taihao Realm, Taicang for resisting attacks, and the Indestructible Divine Master and others were exerting all their strength to bolster the Heavenly Dao.
"Hmm?"
That figure was somewhat surprised, his punch actually chopped away?
Next, another palm came down, this palm even stronger. Its massive hand engulfed the Great Wilderness Domain, and if hit, the Great Wilderness would be slapped away like a ball, with cracks appearing.
Xu Yan stepped forward, in an instant arriving outside the Great Wilderness.
Powerful Sword Intent surged in all directions, clearing away the Chaotic Imperishable Qi instantly. Even the nearby Taihao fragments turned to dust.
"I am the Sword God Xu Yan, how should I address you?"
Xu Yan stepped forward step by step, sword light cutting out, extinguishing the hand, and walked toward that terrifying figure, his aura growing stronger.
"Sword God Xu Yan?"
That figure sneered, "I've never heard that there's a powerhouse like you in the world. Since you wish to obstruct me, then prepare to die!"
Boom!
The terrifying figure's aura became increasingly ominous, that aura of brutality and ill-omen even stronger. At a certain moment, a roar sounded, and True Spirits in the Land of Imperishable suddenly stood up, twisting their bodies into monstrous forms that were neither human nor beast, their auras continuously strengthening.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1166 - 600 Dao is Me, I am the Dao (Grand Finale)_2
chapters.content:
```
Boom!
As if on command, the monsters that had transformed from True Spirits, neither human nor beast, swirled with an aura of brutality and bloodthirst, pouncing towards Xu Yan.
And that figure took a step forward, drawing closer to the Land of Imperishable while simultaneously, with a wave of his hand, absorbing the radiant energy spilled from the collapse of the Taihao Realm.
Swoosh!
Xu Yan unleashed a sword strike, instantly annihilating the pouncing beasts, and moved swiftly to attack that terrifying figure.
"Today, I shall use you to sharpen myself, to step onto the Path!"
Xu Yan said solemnly.
The figure looked at Xu Yan and laughed coldly, "No matter how you came into being or why you possess such strength, it will not stop me from turning all this into nothingness, for this world should cease to exist!"
In an instant, the figure manifested eighteen arms, each emitting a light, and powerful forces struck at Xu Yan.
Meanwhile, the monsters were launching an assault on the Great Wilderness, intending to devour it.
Boom!
A figure like a Heavenly God emerged from the Great Wilderness; Meng Chong raised his hand, and like a great sun in the sky, he struck down, immediately blowing up a True Spirit.
Following closely behind were Fang Hao and Jiang Buping taking action as well.
Su Lingxiu remained within the Domain, guarding against any other possible dangers. Though Zhao Taiping had not yet broken through to the Primordial Realm, he too lent his strength. His War Slaughter Martial Way grew stronger the more he fought and, in the midst of this great battle, he sought to break through to the Primordial Realm.
Boom!
Xu Yan battled fiercely against the terrifying figure while Meng Chong and the others fought the monsters. The horrific battle raged in all directions, and even the Land of Imperishable was continuously collapsing, revealing a void.
And the Heavenly Dao was taking this opportunity to devour the Land of Imperishable, steadily strengthening the Domain—this was the perfect chance for it to replace the Land of Imperishable and the Taihao Realm.
In the midst of this terrifying battle, the fragments of the Taihao Realm had long been erased. The remaining rules of what once was the Taihao Realm had already been devoured.
Only the Majesty of the Heavenly Path rippled in the area where the Taihao Realm once resided, and the battle between Xu Yan and the terrifying figure grew more and more intense.
Strong as Xu Yan was, he was still unable to contend with the opponent, sometimes even finding himself at a disadvantage.
The invincible, matchless Sword Dao was unable to inflict significant harm; the opponent seemed to be an existence that was undying and indestructible, a terror that could not be slain.
"Who is he?"
The Indestructible Divine Master looked shocked and turned to the Black Chi King and the Master of the Jade Court.
These two were among the oldest beings.
The Black Chi King, the only surviving ancient being from the first generation of creatures in the Land of Imperishable, knew many secrets. And the Master of the Jade Court was linked to the Taihao Divine Jade, rumored to have an origin connected to the birth of the Taihao Realm.
"A malicious thought."
The Master of the Jade Court pondered for a while before speaking gravely.
"Malicious thought?"
The Indestructible Divine Master and others were taken aback.
"Taicang, what's wrong with you?"
Suddenly, Tian Zi asked in confusion.
Everyone looked and noticed that Taicang's condition was off, as if he were affected by something, his face contorting as he seemed to forcefully suppress something.
"Ha ha, you can't kill me, I am undying and indestructible. Even Hao cannot kill me, how could you? Even if the Taihao Realm suppresses me, even if Chaos weakens me, you still cannot kill me. Now that I have escaped my confinement, this world should disappear!"
The figure laughed wildly.
Xu Yan's face was extremely solemn; for the first time, he felt handicapped and unable to kill his enemy, even though he now had achieved Perfection in the Primordial Realm.
"He has truly reached the zenith, not even the Heavenly Path can erase him!"
Xu Yan thought solemnly.
Under the Domain, the most supreme existence cannot be destroyed even by one who has reached Perfection in the Primordial Realm. Worse yet, the opponent is devouring this world; the Taihao Realm has already disappeared, and the Land of Imperishable is also collapsing.
It is hard to imagine how terrifying his strength will become once he devours the Land of Imperishable completely. The next step will surely be to devour the Heavenly Dao. After that, only he will remain.
The ultimate disaster of annihilation!
At this moment, Xu Yan truly understood what the ultimate disaster of annihilation was: to erase everything in the world, leaving only one in the void!
As the battle continued, Xu Yan increasingly felt the terrifying malicious intent within that figure, filled with brutality and destruction, with endless malice.
This was a body of malice.
"I'm okay!"
Taicang took a deep breath and said with a serious countenance.
The Black Chi King and the Master of the Jade Court watched him, their thoughts unknown.
The battle raged on, the Land of Imperishable continuing to be devoured. That terrifying figure had devoured eighty percent of it, and the Great Wilderness had devoured twenty percent. However, because the Land of Imperishable was so vast, and even though its expansion had stopped with the shattering of the rules, it remained almost boundless and could not be devoured in a short time.
In the midst of the horrific battlefield, there was an inconspicuous small hill with a little courtyard in the valley. Li Xuan sat there leisurely while Cai Ling'er and others watched the battle anxiously.
No matter how intense the fight, it failed to reach them, and even that terrifying existence had not discovered this insignificant hill.
"Sir, who is this person?"
Cai Ling'er asked in astonishment.
Too strong, too terrifying. This was the first time they saw Xu Yan seemingly helpless against such a powerful opponent.
"A malicious thought manifest, or you could say, a demonic thought."
"Whose malicious thought?"
Cai Ling'er was incredibly curious, "And what about him? Why doesn't he show himself and erase his own malice?"
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1167 - 600 - The Way is Me, I am the Way (Grand Finale)_3
chapters.content:
Li Xuan smiled and said, "Because evil thoughts took control, that person is already dead. Even if he sealed the evil thoughts, this Taihao Realm is still related to him."
Cai Ling'er seemed deep in thought, "Is Taicang related to Taihao?"
Taicang would open up the Domain. You must know that the Black Chi King and the Master of the Jade Court, these stronger beings, have not opened up the Domain in the Land of Imperishable. Only Taicang did.
"Related yet unrelated. Taicang is Taicang, and Taihao is Taihao, just two flowers from the same root. The remnants of Taihao nurtured this flower, Taicang, but it is not Taihao."
Li Xuan smiled slightly.
Walking a hundred miles of the Dao, nothing could be hidden from him, as he had already seen through everything.
"Sir, are you not going to intervene? Xu Yan seems unable to kill the opponent."
Cai Ling'er asked.
"Xu Yan just needs to walk the path. This era should come to an end, as it will be the era of the Heavenly Dao."
Li Xuan looked at the boundless void and smiled. He was waiting for Xu Yan to walk the path, waiting for the true era of the Heavenly Dao.
Boom!
The battle continued. It was a long-lasting fight.
Time seemed to have vanished. Only within the Great Wilderness Domain did time flow. Outside it, time left no trace, as if it had turned into the void.
Everything returned to the void. The long battle made the Land of Imperishable's boundaries visible to the naked eye, about to disappear completely, swallowed by the void.
That figure grew increasingly strong, undying and imperishable. Xu Yan's aura also grew stronger, with one foot seemingly stepping onto the Dao, just half a step away from walking it.
Despite the prolonged battle, Xu Yan remained full of fighting spirit.
The Great Wilderness grew larger. In the void, a vast Domain appeared. The Heavenly Dao Rules surged, devouring the remnants of the Land of Imperishable while trying to carve out the void.
Meng Chong had already achieved Primordial Realm Great Achievement.
Su Lingxiu, Fang Hao, and Jiang Buping had all reached Primordial Realm Minor Achievement, just a step away from Great Achievement.
Zhao Taiping had broken through the Primordial Realm.
All the monstrous creatures were eradicated, their eyes fixed on that terrifying figure before them.
"Senior Brother, we're here to help you!"
"Haha, wonderful, wonderful. If I devour you, devour all of this, I shall be the only one!"
That terrifying figure laughed wildly.
"A piece of void, with only you left, what joy or meaning is there?"
Xu Yan sneered coldly.
"There's meaning, there is meaning, I like it!"
The terrifying figure emanated infinite evil thoughts, while devouring the remnants of the Land of Imperishable, and battled Xu Yan, simultaneously splitting some power to fight Meng Chong and others.
Boom!
At a certain moment, the Land of Imperishable disappeared.
Upon its disappearance, only the Great Wilderness remained in the void. At this moment, the terrifying figure laughed maniacally, rushing towards the Great Wilderness.
Boom!
Xu Yan slashed with a sword, the Sword Domain descended, even the void was split open, as if a Domain was carved out.
Boom!
Yet the terrifying figure did not dodge, directly smashing the Sword Domain, approaching the Great Wilderness. The Majesty of the Heavenly Path surged, purple thunder blearing down.
"Haha, I like humans. Evil thoughts are good. As long as there are evil thoughts, they are mine."
As the words fell, in the Great Wilderness Domain, there was an abrupt change, killing erupted suddenly as if countless people turned into great evildoers, becoming bloodthirsty.
Boom!
The Majesty of the Heavenly Path surged, trying to cleanse these corroding evil thoughts, but they seemed endless, difficult to purge. At this moment, everyone's expression changed, realizing the terror of this annihilating evil thought.
Xu Yan gripped the sword with both hands, taking a deep breath. At some moment, in the void, a grand sword appeared, and a figure walked atop it.
Mysterious and unfathomable Daoist intent appeared in the void, as Xu Yan took one step after another towards the Dao.
At this moment, the annihilating evil thought's expression changed.
"What is this power of yours? What is happening?"
Xu Yan did not answer, for he was about to walk the path. Only by walking it could he extinguish this terrifying existence.
As long as the evil thought was not destroyed, he could not die!
Truly nearly undying and immortal, yet not beyond being completely obliterated. The Heavenly Dao was not Taihao, capable of cleansing the other's evil thought erosion, but the evil thoughts of creatures within the Great Wilderness were outside its scope.
There were no creatures or evil thoughts in the void. If he obliterated it, it would truly be annihilated. To destroy this terrifying existence, the only way was to walk the path!
"Die!"
It seemed that the annihilating evil thought realized something as well. Its aura became even more terrifying, a violent force, wanting to suppress Xu Yan, desiring to break Xu Yan's ascent.
"Kill!"
Meng Chong and the others roared angrily, the Majesty of the Heavenly Path also howling, attempting to thwart the annihilating evil thought.
Splat!
But their strength was still somewhat lacking. In an instant, they all spat blood, flying backward, even the Great Wilderness Domain oscillated, drifting before stopping its momentum after a long while.
"You will not break through!"
The annihilating evil thought laughed wildly, as if stopping Xu Yan was the greatest evil in the world, causing its evil intents to swell instantly, becoming even more gruesome and terrifying.
Xu Yan broke into a sweat as he was about to ascend the Dao, stand upon it, and step into the path.
Yet the annihilating evil thought's hindrance made it difficult to continue. If this attempt to walk the path failed, the next time would be much harder and require more time.
"Haha, you will not succeed, you will not succeed!"
As if blocking a Supreme Expert's breakthrough, the evil thought grew even stronger, as the aura of the annihilating evil thought slowly heightened at this moment.
"Sir!"
Cai Ling'er turned to Li Xuan.
Li Xuan clicked his tongue twice. If this master did not intervene, Xu Yan would fail in walking the path this time. If so, there was no choice but to make a move again.
"You're doomed. You cannot succeed!"
The evil thought's corporeal form laughed wildly, even approaching Xu Yan, eyes filled with satisfaction after venting its evil thought. Xu Yan gritted his teeth and continued to ascend the Dao, not giving up until the last moment, though ascending it was becoming harder.
Suddenly!
A hand pressed on the head of the annihilating evil thought.
"Stay calm!"
"Uh..."
The wildly laughing annihilating evil thought suddenly froze, unable to struggle, roar, or stop Xu Yan. It couldn't do anything at all!
A new emotion sprouted in its heart, one it never had before. It didn't know what this emotion was, but it felt extremely uncomfortable.
"This emotion is called fear."
That voice echoed in its consciousness.
Fear!
This was fear? Was it actually fearing?
The annihilating evil thought opened its mouth, attempting to roar and expel fear but found itself unable, making the fear grow stronger.
Xu Yan was thrilled, his master had intervened!
Simultaneously, his heart was filled with shame. At this step of walking the path, he still needed his master's intervention, he felt utterly useless!
"It's the Daoist Ancestor!"
In the Great Wilderness Domain, although Li Xuan's figure was unseen, it was known that it was the Daoist Ancestor's intervention, making everyone feel ashamed. The apocalyptic disaster still required the Daoist Ancestor to take action.
Boom!
Suddenly, Xu Yan felt infinite profundity, the ultimate truth of the world, surfacing in his mind. From a lofty view, the world appeared so small, so rudimentary.
He walked on an immense and boundless path, filled with endless creation, yet seemingly invisible, taking a step forward, then another. Though he only walked ten feet, it felt like bearing a mountain on his back, trudging a few steps with a sense of exhaustion.
"Walking the path is difficult, truly difficult!"
Xu Yan sighed in his heart, looking up but seeing no figure, unable to see his master's figure.
"Evil thoughts like yours should disappear completely."
Xu Yan gazed at the annihilating evil thought, raising his sword. It was now the Dao Sword. With a gentle slash, the annihilating evil thought let out a screech before scattering and vanishing into the void.
Boom!
The Heavenly Dao, relieved of the annihilating evil thought's suppression, suddenly expanded, its radiance reflecting in the void, creating sun, moon, and stars within it. The Great Wilderness Domain continued to grow and expand, endlessly sustaining.
"Your disciple Xu Yan walked the path, your walking the path increased a hundredfold."
The Daoist Golden Book opened, feeding back information.
Li Xuan smiled.
Suddenly, the Daoist Golden Book transformed, emanating golden light, like an endless path cradled in his hands.
Li Xuan's smile was gentle as he gazed into the infinite void. With a thought, countless stars appeared outside the Great Wilderness. He stretched lazily and stood up.
"Time to go!"
With a step forward, he walked through the void. Looking back, the path he walked was the Dao.
The Dao is me, and I am the Dao!

chapters.title: Chapter 1168 - 1168: Spinoff: Taihao and the Apocalypse Evil Thought
chapters.content:
The void was indescribable, without years, the passage of time, or any living beings—everything was a blank nothingness, impossible to express.
In that void, profound beyond profound, formless, incorporeal, silent, resembling nothing yet surpassing the concept of nothing, it emerged within and dominated above nothingness until a beam of golden light illuminated the void, like an endless path extending over it.
When the golden light vanished, returning to formlessness, it seemed that dust had been added to the void; it was no longer pure nothingness, but had gained substance.
The dust gathered together, eventually forming a small piece of land. It was unclear if years had yet begun, but on this small land, due to the significance beyond nothingness, a tiny sapling sprouted. As the sapling grew, it gradually became a lush, massive tree.
In the midst of the void, the lush, massive tree grew solitarily, and after numerous uncounted years, a fruit suddenly appeared on the tree and, upon ripening, fell.
Thump!
For the first time, a sound occurred in the void.
The fruit's shell cracked open to reveal a core resembling a human, shrouded in a glowing mist, which landed and slowly grew, eventually opening its eyes—the first creature was born.
The human-shaped creature grew, and although it didn't understand years, it occasionally sat under the tree as if contemplative, observing something, looking into the void beyond the tree.
With insight, the human-shaped creature seemed to gain understanding, their power within grew stronger, along with greater and more mystical abilities. Sometimes, they would leave the vicinity of the tree, walking in the void.
After an unfathomable span of time, a sense of loneliness emerged. Looking up at the tree, which once felt majestic but now appeared ordinary to them, it seemed they grew more powerful, stronger than the tree itself.
During one introspective moment, the creature mumbled, "Boundless and supreme, 'heaven' above all, I should have a name, let's call it 'Hao.'"
Hao gazed into the void, towards the tree beside him, and pondered the deep, ineffable mysteries as if seeing their own birth and the void no longer being void.
"I, Hao, should perhaps create something. Using the tree as a foundation, why not create all living beings and the Domain?!"
Hao, inspired by the tree, broke off a branch and walked into the void, slashing with all their might.
Boom!
The void trembled and sounded. Hao revealed a smile, swinging the branch and chopping into the void; at a certain moment, light flickered in the void, thunder roared, and it was split open.
"Hahaha, yes, yes, indeed, this is thunder, correctly named, I, Hao, won't be alone anymore."
From then on, Hao chopped into the void daily. The area affected by their slashing grew ever larger, filled with incessant thunder, as if it were a domain saturated with thunder.
"No, this isn't enough!"
Hao fell into deep thought. What was the significance of just having thunder?
They sat under the tree, attuning themselves to the profound, indescribable Dao, and finally found inspiration, then resumed chopping.
After countless years of chopping, the void around the tree had disappeared, replaced by a sea of thunder, rumbling and flashing with varied colors. Hao looked upon this scene with anticipation.
Now, Hao had become much stronger and could easily split the void, creating realms of thunder.
"With the tree as a foundation, I shall carve out a Realm, bring forth the world, and give birth to All Living Beings!"
Excited, Hao embarked on their endeavor to carve out a Realm using the tree as a base, to create a world and birth myriad beings.
Eventually, after Hao tirelessly labored for unmeasured years, a vast world was born. The thunder of creation roared, splitting the void, and the Aura of Spiritual Grace emerged. The split void also released the solid Imperishable Qi.
As the thunder waned, the Imperishable Qi sank and formed the land, while the Aura of Spiritual Grace floated, creating the sky. Thus, Domain was born; Hao ran excitedly through it, while the initial breach in the void bathed in colors, filled with a blend of light.
After an undefined number of years, at the original location, the diffuse glow seemed to spill out, and a beam of light shone through the world—a purple light.
"Let this mark the passage of years, in a cycle that returns to the beginning, one light for an era, one light for the years," Hao murmured excitedly.
The land existed, but All Living Beings were not yet born. Hao sat in contemplation, eyes closed, attuning to the profound mystery to find the way to bring forth life.
After countless years passed and Hao opened their eyes, they saw the Domain had drifted from its original place, seeming loose and ready to disperse before long. They fretted until, at one moment, they saw that mighty tree, still firmly rooted and even more immense, and immediately had an idea.
Thus, Hao used the tree to support the Domain, its roots as land and canopy as sky. A truly vast Domain emerged, and the tree's pervasive energy brought vitality. Delicate green sprouts grew across the land.

chapters.title: Chapter 1169 - 1169: Extra Story: Taihao and the Apocalypse Evil Thoughts_2
chapters.content:
```
"From now on, let's call this tree the Domain Tree or the Creation Tree."
Hao resided on the tree canopy, which was the highest part of the Domain. He had a mysterious feeling of being above everything, looking down upon the vast earth and watching the tender buds flourish.
After another period of seclusion, when Hao awoke, the dense forests covered the ground, myriad flowers bloomed with unparalleled beauty, and Hao was extremely thrilled, wandering the earth and admiring the diverse beautiful landscapes.
After countless eras, Hao felt loneliness once more. In this vast Domain, he was the only one, and in such solitude, Hao began pondering about finding a companion to accompany him.
He broke off a tree branch, buried it into the earth, and sat cross-legged at the place where the branch was buried, imbued it with his breath, and nurtured the branch. After countless ages, the branch came alive.
It was an elongated creature with horns, where the horns were the original forks of the branch, and its short legs were the newly sprouted tender buds.
"Hiss!"
The elongated creature coiled around Hao's wrist, making a hissing sound. Hao was filled with excitement, stroked the creature, and said, "You'll be called Chi!"
Hao and Chi lived together on this vast earth, and Chi grew larger. Hao rode Chi, traveling across the sky and the earth, enjoying freedom, but over time, the feeling of loneliness reemerged.
Looking at the Domain he had created, it was still too empty and too solitary. So, Hao secluded himself again, trying to comprehend how to populate this Domain with more living beings.
Through countless seclusions and expansions of the Domain, eventually all living beings multiplied. The Domain grew larger until finally, beings in human form like himself emerged. Hao was elated and began imparting knowledge and the Path of Cultivation.
The Domain became more complete with countless living beings. Hao looked upon this Domain with a sense of accomplishment, residing high above and observing the earth's transformations, until one day he saw a beast preying on a human. He wanted to intervene but hesitated.
At that moment, the rules and the ultimate truths of the Domain surfaced in his heart—his insight into the essence of the Domain's operations. He silently watched without intervention.
Soon after, those who had achieved cultivation and gained strength began hunting beasts, consuming them and garnering benefits, accelerating their cultivation and growing stronger.
Various forms of predation emerged throughout the Domain as if each thing restrained another, with many things feeding on others. Humans were the most clever, adept at cultivation and creation. Hao felt something within and seemed to understand something, leading him once more into seclusion.
Upon waking from his meditative state, the Domain's diversity had increased. Cultivators grew ever stronger, and the number of Human Clan tribes multiplied, leading ultimately to conflicts and annexations between clans, culminating in the establishment of a nation.
Those who had been taught the Cultivation Methods by Hao became his disciples and were among the founding ancestors of the Human Clan. They were exceptionally powerful and aspired to ascend to the heavens to meet their revered master.
"The Domain is greater than I am, so let's call this Domain Taihao."
Hao named this Domain.
As time passed, the Domain expanded, and more beings ascended. Strong individuals from all clans appeared in the sky, and at some point, someone discovered the Creation Tree, broke off a branch, and refined a Divine Artifact, wreaking havoc and becoming the strongest under Hao.
Ambition was born at that moment, prompting more powerful beings to seek the Creation Tree to forge Divine Artifacts. Initially, Hao did not stop them, as breaking some branches would not impact the Creation Tree.
After another period of seclusion, upon awakening, he was shocked to find that a third of the Creation Tree's branches were broken, and those people wielded Divine Artifacts made from Creation Tree branches, wreaking havoc and annexing each other.
The first great war among the myriad clans erupted, splitting the earth and shaking the heavens. Witnessing this, Hao was stunned. This was his creation, so why was it filled with chaos and slaughter?
A sudden thought of annihilating everything, reverting to the original void and experiencing supreme mystery in solitude, arose in his heart. This fleeting notion dissipated quickly. Hao sighed and, with one hand, subdued his disciples, confining and reprimanding them, forcing them into seclusion to reflect.
Simultaneously, he commanded Chi to guard the Creation Tree, forbidding anyone from approaching or breaking branches.
The first great war among the myriad clans concluded.
Once the subdued disciples admitted their mistakes, Hao released them, instructing them to maintain the Domain's clarity and order. After the disciples left, diligently maintaining order, Hao observed for a long time, ensuring no further chaos before preparing to delve into understanding the Grand Path.
Before this, he instructed Chi to diligently guard the Creation Tree, ensuring that no one broke the branches. Then, Hao entered seclusion with peace of mind.
Taihao entered a golden age of cultivation, with prodigies emerging from all tribes. Those ancient ancestors, wary of Hao's warning, dared not act recklessly. However, due to benefits and preexisting conflicts, tensions gradually deepened until a vendetta among juniors reignited enormous tensions.
First, one of the Human Clan's ancestors had a particularly beloved and talented descendant—one of the Clan's widely acclaimed prodigies, hailed for potentially reaching the ancestor level—was besieged and killed by prodigies from three other clans.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1170 - 1170: Extra Story: Taihao and the Apocalypse Evil Thoughts_3
chapters.content:
In the eyes of the Human Clan, these three tribes had conspired to encircle and kill the Human Clan's chosen one out of fear of their might, and thus war erupted. The Human Clan initiated a war of revenge, and the other three tribes, unable to resist, went to persuade the other great clans that should they fall, the next to suffer would be those other great clans.
Consequently, various clans joined forces to pressure the Human Clan into ceasing the war. Faced with the situation, the Human Clan could only temporarily halt the war. However, unwilling to leave matters at that, they planned to secretly steal a Creation Tree Branch, refine it into a powerful Divine Artifact, and suppress the other clans. Yet the Creation Tree was guarded by the Chi, whose strength was immense, and no one dared to offend it.
The Human Clan, however, spent more than a thousand years coaxing the Chi, causing it to let down its guard and bribing it with all kinds of delicacies. The Chi, short-handed by the food it received, softened its heart for a moment, allowing the Human Clan to break off a branch and refine it into a Divine Artifact.
War erupted once again, with the Human Clan pitted against several other clans, and they gathered some smaller clans to their side. In just a short thousand years, they had trampled two great clans underfoot. The rest of the great clans, sensing the crisis, also came to steal Creation Tree Branches. The Chi refused them, but the ancestors of the various clans wept bitterly, claiming that if not for the Chi's mistake, none of this would have happened, and there must be a balance between the clans to avoid a catastrophic disaster, lest the Chi be blamed.
Seeing this, the Chi could do nothing but turn a blind eye, allowing the ancestors of the clans to break off branches. Thus, the real great war began, Divine Artifacts clashing, the land shattering, and the Firmament cracking; the entire Domain suffered severe damage, and Hao was roused from his seclusion.
Hao, awakened while contemplating the great Dao, saw the brutal war and the damaged Domain, which filled him with extreme fury. Violent thoughts surged in his heart: that the Domain should not exist, that he should be left alone to quietly comprehend the Dao undisturbed.
Enraged, Hao struck mightily, suppressing all his disciples and subjecting them to severe punishment, making them endure constant pain, feeling the misery of the despair of all living things, as a warning to them of the importance of peace in the Domain.
It took a long time for Hao to smooth over the broken Domain. Gazing at the Creation Tree, now missing several branches, he stood silently for a long while, while the Chi, like a child who made a mistake, hung its head low.
Looking at this being - the one who had accompanied him for the longest time and was also the first creature he had created - Hao ultimately could not stay angry. He knew the Chi was too simple-minded and so patiently taught it for some time.
As the ages passed, the ravaged Domain flourished once again. Hao felt great joy and an immense sense of accomplishment for the Domain he had opened up.
He went to see his disciples, who, after such a long period of suppression, had recognized their errors and been warned. Hao released them. The disciples knelt and kowtowed sincerely, promising to follow their master's footsteps in the future, to pursue the subtle intricacies of the Dao, and asked for their master's guidance.
Hao was pleased and imparted cultivation instructions to his disciples, teaching them the ways to comprehend the Dao. The disciples took their leave and returned to their own clans, no longer meddling in worldly affairs, focusing solely on understanding the Dao.
Seeing this, Hao entered seclusion again. However, having learned from past lessons, he would awaken from time to time to check on the Domain and his disciples.
Every time he awoke, his disciples were diligently cultivating in seclusion, working very hard. Hao was finally reassured. Watching the place of origin and the passage of time, a new era had arrived.
Hao did not know how many eras had passed since he had opened up the Domain. After all, the passage of time was beyond his perception when he was in seclusion, even sometimes spanning an entire era; he had no interest in exploring the past eras.
This seclusion was lengthy and yielded great rewards. Hao once again came close to touching the indistinct and profound Dao, comprehending even more of the ultimate truths of the Domain and all living beings.
As time passed, one era followed another. Since the opening of the Domain, it had been slowly expanding, with lightning flickering at the edges of the Domain, slowly breaking through the void. The present Taihao had already grown much stronger.
One day, several figures emerged from the Domain and began to expand in the void, wishing to enlarge the Domain, breaking through the emptiness. Hao, seeing this scene, inquired with his disciples.
Several disciples expressed their willingness to contribute to the Domain, to follow in their master's footsteps to create a larger Domain, to make Taihao more grand, and to bring more prosperity to all living beings.
Hao was very pleased and gave guidance to his disciples. From then on, Hao's disciples began to break through the void outside of the Domain, cultivating outside the Domain, and their strength increased with each passing day.
Taihao grew larger and larger, and as Hao entered a long period of seclusion, the Chi guarding the Creation Tree coiled upon the tree and dozed off. One day, Hao's disciples came to the Creation Tree, bringing delicious food for the Chi, claiming it to be a treasure imbued with Spiritual Charm uncovered during their expansion into the void.
The Chi immediately became wary, refusing the bribe. Hao's disciples claimed it was an apology for past sins, for the errors once made, advising the Chi not to worry about them coming with conditions.
Seeing their sincerity, the Chi accepted the food, and as such a long period had passed, these people had indeed changed their ways.
In the years that followed, Hao's disciples continued to bring delicious treats to the Chi, all as an apology for past wrongs.
The Chi was delighted; the food was too scrumptious, and since these people did not impose any conditions or attempt to break the Creation Tree, it accepted all the offerings.

chapters.title: Chapter 1171 - 1171: Extra Story of Taihao and the Apocalyptic Evil Thoughts_4
chapters.content:
He must have eaten too much, content and satisfied, and guarding the tree became too tedious; Chi dozed off, gradually falling asleep. After he slept, a group of people arrived.
"An aeon of agony, an aeon of torment, he was our master. Are a few tree branches really worth torturing us like this?"
"You're right, since he is not merciful, we need not be dutiful."
"We too have contributed to this Domain!"
"Can we really kill him? The old man is too powerful."
"This Creation Tree is the most powerful Divine Artifact; if we join forces and launch a sneak attack, we can surely kill him!"
Hao's disciples' faces twisted with ferocity. They began to cut down the Creation Tree, refining it into a peerless Divine Artifact and ambushed Hao!
Engulfed in meditation, Hao was suddenly jolted awake. He couldn't believe that his disciples, creatures he had created and taught, who owed him a great debt, were actually trying to kill him, and the Creation Tree had been cut down!
"You all deserve to die!"
At this moment, Hao was born of ferocity and evil thoughts, unprecedented desires to annihilate the Domain, returning it to nothingness, crazily proliferating. All he wanted was to quietly comprehend the Dao.
Disturbed time and again, his world shattered time and again, this Domain should not exist!
Even the Creation Tree, they had the heart to cut down!
Boom!
A great war erupted. Even though Hao's disciples joined forces and wielded Divine Artifacts crafted from the Creation Tree, they were still no match for Hao and were completely annihilated by him.
Yet, in the war, the Domain fractured, leaving only a sparse land that still thrived in beauty.
Gazing at the unconscious and sleeping Chi, Hao, red-eyed with rage, grabbed him and chained his body to the tree roots, then walked across the Domain. He wanted to take another good look at it before it was destroyed.
He saw it, a group of innocent, lively children helping an old man who had fallen. Watching such a scene, Hao felt something stir inside him, and his evil thoughts were surpressed.
"Why are these evil thoughts born? Are they a problem that arose from being disturbed during this meditation?"
Hao muttered to himself.
Looking at the shattered Domain, looking at the severed Creation Tree, Hao closed his eyes, seeming to have an epiphany.
"Such is the nature of the world; I was too fixated. The extinction of one species and the birth of another, are but the natural order of all living beings in the Domain. With the Domain so beautiful, how could I destroy it? Taihao! Taihao! The Domain is greater than I, I cannot destroy it."
Hao attained enlightenment at this moment, yet deep in his heart, there was a faint whisper of an evil thought, tempting him, convincing him that only by destroying the world, eradicating all living beings, and returning to nothingness, where he could peacefully comprehend the Dao alone, would be the true path!
He suppressed this whisper, and then Hao began to reconstruct the Domain. He realized that the strong could not mix with the weak, and that there must be a path for the ambitious to constantly strive upward.
Thus, the Thirty-Three Heavens of Taihao were created, and the branches and leaves of the broken Creation Tree transformed into the sun, moon, and stars, and a vaster Taihao Realm appeared.
Hao, releasing Chi from his chains, withdrew to meditate with him.
As time passed, people ascended to the peak of Taihao in the Thirty-Three Heavens, one proclaimed himself the Taihao Heavenly Emperor and ruled over the Thirty-Three Heavens. Countless aeons later, the Taihao Heavenly Emperor was besieged, and Taihao fell into chaos.
Hao emerged from his meditation and, seeing this scene, felt evil thoughts begin to wildly sprout again, urging him to annihilate the world. This time Hao realized that a great problem had arisen within him.
Thus, he extracted the evil thoughts and withdrew to meditate anew.
The evil thoughts found a young boy who was bullied, oppressed, and filled with hatred for the injustices of the Domain and the world. An unparalleled demon was born, manipulating people's evil thoughts, amplifying their darkest desires. He founded the New World Sect, to destroy and create a new world.
The Thirty-Three Heavens welcomed their second ruler, who was known as the Taihao Demon Emperor. Countless righteous warriors were slaughtered by him, and the Taihao Realm overflowed with malice, reduced to nothing but slaughter. Multiple strong forces allied together, but all were defeated by the Taihao Demon Emperor.
The Taihao Demon Emperor grew ever stronger, the world brimming with malevolence. Hao, in his meditation, was suddenly awakened and only upon emerging from his secluded spot did he discover the great turmoil of the Taihao Realm.
"You must be purged!"
Hao acted, extinguishing the Taihao Demon Emperor, beginning to restore the Taihao Thirty-Three Heavens. It took a very long time before the Taihao Realm recovered.
Before entering another meditation, Taihao entrusted Chi to maintain the Taihao Realm, ensuring that a disaster like that caused by the Taihao Demon Emperor would not occur again. With Chi patrolling, Hao went into meditation with peace of mind.
As time passed, an aeon surpassed, and the Taihao Thirty-Three Heavens indeed witnessed constant battles, dynastic changes, and the rise and fall of Sects, but these were all the natural laws. Chi did not interfere; its mission was to prevent the emergence of a second Taihao Demon Emperor.
Hao, too, occasionally emerged from meditation to look upon the Taihao Realm. He was very pleased with it and thus continued his meditation, feeling himself drawing ever closer to the elusive, profound Dao, seemingly within reach yet still unfathomably distant.
"If the Dao were like a book, directly observable, how wonderful that would be."
Hao lamented in his heart.
In the First Layer Heaven of Taihao, there sat a figure, cross-legged, whose face was indistinguishable from Hao's, the only difference being it bore a hint of ferocity, looking upon everything with an intent to destroy.
"This should never have existed, Hao, you are too deluded. To meditate in tranquility is the true path; everything belongs solely to one person. I will destroy it all to return you to the right path."

chapters.title: Chapter 1172 - 1172: Extra Story: Taihao and the Apocalypse Evil Thoughts_5
chapters.content:
Hao, who was in seclusion, was completely unaware that the evil thoughts he had extracted had not vanished, but had grown stronger instead. Its power had almost reached his level, and its malice and thoughts of world destruction had grown increasingly terrifying.
The Taihao Realm had been slowly breaking through the void, growing gradually stronger. The vast and boundless Thirty-three Layer Heaven, where countless races competed and numerous beings thrived, saw the emergence of prodigies.
Era after era, the Thirty-three Layer Heaven finally saw the rise of new forces. Under the control of Chi, these forces achieved a balance rather than having a single ruler dominate the entire Taihao Realm.
Boom!
Suddenly, the Taihao Realm trembled. The First Layer Heaven was enveloped in rolling dark mists, as if to destroy everything. The heavenly powerhouses descended to suppress the dark mists but were corrupted by them, turning violent and bloodthirsty. The Taihao Realm faced another great turmoil that affected all Thirty-three Heavens, sparking a fierce battle between the righteous and the evil forces.
Chi, sensing that something was amiss, appeared to suppress the dark qi but then saw "Hao," who stopped him, claiming this calamity was needed for the realm to be truly perfected.
Seeing this, Chi no longer intervened. However, as the battle between good and evil intensified, more than half of all life had perished, with half of all races wiped out, gradually realizing something was wrong.
But why didn't Hao intervene?
Chi, feeling uneasy but unsure what was wrong, not until only thirty percent of life remained and Taihao was filled with desperation did Chi inquire when the calamity would end and why it needed to occur.
"From the void we come, to the void we return, and then reborn; this is the right path."
Hao said with a smile, "Chi, you don't understand, just watch."
At that moment, Chi showed a look of terror, realizing that the "Hao" in front of him wasn't the real "Hao." This Hao seemed filled with malice, embodying all the world's evil.
"You are not Hao!"
"I am. I am the real Hao!"
"You... you are..."
Chi, in terror, vibrated with power around him and woke Hao up from his seclusion. Sure enough, another Hao came out from the seclusion.
Hao stared at the evil thought, his expression solemn.
"You should not exist!"
"If I didn't exist, how could you? I am you, none of this should exist!"
"I will destroy you today!"
Hao took action, sparking a truly exceptional cosmic battle. The evil thought of destruction held no reservations, but Hao did, fearing the complete destruction of the Taihao Realm. Throughout the lengthy battle, Hao defeated the malicious thought time and again, but it quickly recovered.
"You can't kill me. As long as Taihao harbors malice, I am immortal. Unless you destroy Taihao, only then can you truly kill me. Quickly, destroy Taihao."
Hao, pained, could not bring himself to destroy Taihao. Watching the broken realm and the shattered remnants of the Creation Tree's roots, he closed his eyes slightly and acted once more.
"Ha-ha, if you won't destroy the world, I'll help you!"
The world-ending evil thought laughed wildly as the realm of Taihao collapsed amid thunderous booms, and the battle site turned into chaos. The Imperishable Qi from the ground spread out, forming a realm of Chaos.
"Master, I'll help you!"
Chi roared, burning all of himself, joining the battle. Hao took a deep breath, burning his own path, and looked up to the ethereal realm with a sigh.
"If only the Dao were like a book, how wonderful that could be, to fully comprehend the great Dao."
After sighing, Hao used all his might to break open a realm of void between the chaos and the broken Taihao, casting the evil thought of destruction into it.
"Hao, you're mad, you're actually killing yourself, but you can't kill me, you can't defeat me, I will return to this world and destroy it!"
The world-ending evil thought roared.
Roar!
Chi furiously burned itself, aiding Hao, and looked back at its master for the last time, seeing its own birth and a drop of its last blood falling into the chaos.
Hao's figure faded more and more, ready to vanish at any moment as he looked at the shattered Creation Tree Root, scattering it across the broken Taihao Realm. The largest piece of root, like a piece of unmatched beautiful jade, fell deep into the ground.
The ethereal figure smoothed over the post-battle Taihao Realm, reshaping the Thirty-three Layers of Heaven, realizing with all life gone, the largest and most intelligent beings, laden with thoughts—the Human Clan—stood dominant. Hao glanced at himself, revealing a reluctant smile; he was, after all, the ancestor of humanoid beings, all influenced by him.
"Taihao is greater than me, the world is beautiful, why destroy it? May the world endure forever."
Hao murmured to himself, sighing once more, now so close to the profound Dao but never able to glimpse it again.
"If only the Dao were like a book for me to study, but could the Dao ever be like a book?"
Hao sighed, arriving at the land where he was born, quietly dissipating there, completely vanishing.
Years changed, eras remained the same. Following the great battle, the Taihao Realm once again entered a flourishing era, distinct from the original Taihao Realm—with the Land of Chaotic Imperishable beyond the Taihao Thirty-Three Heavens.
Powerhouses rose and fell, each leading their era, and another epoch began. A prodigy rose, obtained the Taihao Divine Object, refined the Indestructible Divine Armor, established the Indestructible Divine Palace, and proclaimed himself the Indestructible Divine Master.
In the Taihao First Layer Heaven, in a desolate place, a young man emerged, unknown to all, this deserted place was the very land where Hao had dissipated.
The young man's talent and artistry were unparalleled, hailed as the greatest prodigy Taihao had ever seen.
His name was Taicang!

chapters.title: Chapter 1173 - 1173: Extraordinary Tales of the Great Wilderness Universe
chapters.content:
```
The Taihao Realm had already vanished, and even the Land of Imperishable was gone; only the Great Wilderness remained. As Xu Yan traveled the path, slaying the Destructive Malice, a part of the Taihao Realm and the Land of Imperishable, which had been devoured by the Destructive Malice, suddenly exploded, rippling into the void.
Though the Destructive Malice had disappeared, the remnants of the Land of Imperishable and the Taihao Realm were not destroyed. This was intentionally left by Xu Yan.
A thousand years after the Destructive Malice was vanquished.
"Hurry, quick! Put some effort into it and devour all of these."
Tian Zi excitedly shouted, controlling the Great Wilderness Heavenly Path, devouring the remnants of the Land of Imperishable and the Taihao Realm. The Heavenly Dao swept across the four directions, the Great Wilderness continuously expanding.
"Everyone, work a little harder! Indestructible Divine Master, you bastard, stop torturing your enemies and quickly channel your power into the Heavenly Dao to speed up the devouring!"
Tian Zi was busy, shouting for everyone to lend a hand.
Taicang no longer wielded the Heavenly Dao. He stood with his hands clasped behind his back, watching as the Destructive Malice disappeared, seeing the Taihao Realm and the Land of Imperishable, which had been devoured by the Destructive Malice, reappear, feeling a myriad of emotions within his heart.
"Black Chi King, do you still want to stay in the Great Wilderness? Put in some effort; don't blame me for not looking after you later if you don't put in the work now."
Tian Zi glared at the Black Chi King and said.
"The Destructive Malice is gone. The Heavenly Dao can slowly devour it. What's the rush?"
The Black Chi King looked helpless, but with Tian Zi's youthful nature, always liking to stir things up, if he didn't put in some effort, he'd surely be targeted later. So, he could only continue with the hard labor.
"The Gargantuan Gluttonous King indeed has foresight; he started working without needing my urging."
Tian Zi was very satisfied with the performance of the Gargantuan Gluttonous King.
In the Great Wilderness, many mighty ones were channeling their power into the Heavenly Dao, enhancing the devouring speed of the Heavenly Dao. The Great Wilderness was expanding rapidly, but to reach the scale of the former Land of Imperishable was not something that could be achieved in a short time.
Even if they devoured the Land of Imperishable and the remnants of Taihao that were expelled by the Destructive Malice, it would still take considerable time to digest.
"Yu Yao, stop munching on your delicate sprouts and help out quickly!"
Tian Zi glared at Yu Yao and said.
Yu Yao's face immediately turned livid with anger, glaring at Tian Zi. "Tian Zi, what nonsense are you spouting!"
Wu Tianan looked utterly embarrassed.
"Did I say anything wrong? Yu Yao, come on, finish up quickly, then you can whisper sweet nothings with your tender little sprout."
Tian Zi widened his eyes and said.
"You bastard! Talking nonsense!"
Yu Yao nearly exploded with rage, shouting, "I'll go find a teacher! You're talking nonsense and insulting me, Tian Zi!"
"I didn't insult you. I'm just stating facts. How old are you, and how old is Wu Tianan? Isn't he your delicate sprout?"
Tian Zi retorted defiantly.
"You deserve a beating!"
Yu Yao swung a hand to hit, and Tian Zi muttered, "You woman, dare to do it but dare not admit it," then quickly fled.
Finally, he told Wu Tianan: "You too, stop clinging to the mountain of gold all day; you've got strength as well, hurry up and help out!"
Damn!
Wu Tianan grimaced, but he had to comfort the angry Yu Yao. Yet, the more Yu Yao thought about it, the angrier she got. This whole "eating tender sprouts" phrase was originally something the Seductive Witch said.
"Seductive Witch!"
Yu Yao disappeared from the scene to confront the Seductive Witch, who was busy in the Great Wilderness Netherworld. As soon as Yu Yao arrived, she angrily cursed, "Seductive Witch, you've gone too far!"
The Seductive Witch looked bewildered. "Yu Yao, I haven't provoked you!"
"If it weren't for you spreading rumors about me eating tender sprouts, Tian Zi wouldn't be spouting such nonsense!"
The more Yu Yao thought about it, the angrier she got, and she started fighting with the Seductive Witch.
The Seductive Witch didn't back down, while countering, she said, "Did I say anything wrong? Not wrong at all. Besides, what's wrong with eating tender sprouts? It's your blessing. If it weren't for Wu Tianan, the tender sprout, how would you have become one of the Daoist Ancestor's disciples? I, the Seductive Witch, wouldn't mind eating tender sprouts, but I don't dare!"
Yu Yao was shocked and said, "Seductive Witch, you're such a wanton woman. Are you really pining for Xu Yan?"
Hearing this, the Seductive Witch's face turned white with fear and she shouted, "Yu Yao, you wicked woman, what nonsense are you spouting? Who's pining for Xu Yan? Don't slander me!"
Scary as hell!
If this got out, wouldn't Xu Yan destroy her?
Even if Xu Yan didn't care and just laughed it off, Yun Miaomiao and Du Yuying, who were around Xu Yan, were not to be messed with; they would definitely come knocking.
What's more terrifying was Ming Yu, a more powerful presence. Though she was just Xu Yan's close friend, if this rumor reached her ears, she would definitely stand up for Xu Yan, her close friend.
Seeing the Seductive Witch's face go white with fear, Yu Yao felt smug, raising her eyebrows and said, "Don't deny it. You are indeed pining for Xu Yan. Well, Seductive Witch, you wanton woman, to think of hitting on the Daoist Ancestor's true disciple! Quite bold."
"You're spouting nonsense!"
The Seductive Witch shouted vehemently, "Yu Yao, you vicious woman, don't slander me!"
"Heh, slander? Besides Xu Yan, which other tender sprout would you be interested in? You wanton Seductive Witch, stop denying it!"
Yu Yao sneered repeatedly.
Tian Zi watched Yu Yao and the Seductive Witch fight with excitement, like a bystander enjoying a spectacle.
The Seductive Witch's face grew paler. She noticed several onlookers appearing, including Du Yuying and Yun Miaomiao, and cold sweat started beading on her forehead.
Dangerous! Very dangerous!
"Why, cat got your tongue? Heh, I knew you were a wanton woman with bad intentions to dare to yearn for the true disciple of the Daoist Ancestor!"
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1174 - 1174: Extraordinary Tales of the Great Wilderness Universe_2
chapters.content:
Yu Yao couldn't stop snickering. "Let's see how pitiful you are this time, you Seductive Witch!"
"No wonder it's Brother Xu!" Xie Lingfeng watched the spectacle unfold with amazement.
"You're talking nonsense! Stop slandering me!" the Seductive Witch retorted, trying to sound fierce but failing.
"I'm talking nonsense? Then why don't you tell me who that fresh meat you have your eye on is?"
"I am not!"
"Just now, you were saying how you envied me, wanting to indulge in fresh meat. Now you're denying it? Feeling guilty, aren't you?"
"Stop slandering people!"
"When have I slandered anyone? If you're not feeling guilty, just say it. You, Seductive Witch, have always been thick-skinned. What's stopping you from speaking up? If you say it, I'll be the first to support your bold pursuit. How about that?" Yu Yao sneered.
"You..." The Seductive Witch was infuriated.
"Don't dare to say it, feeling guilty, so I am right. You do indeed have your sights set on the Daoist Ancestor's true teachings!" The Seductive Witch's forehead broke out in a cold sweat. This was dangerous, extremely dangerous! At that moment, she sensed an air of danger.
"Yu Yao, you little wench, you're truly malicious. What do I, the Seductive Witch, have to fear saying? I'll say it straight out. My sights are set on Young Master Xie Lingfeng!" huffed the Seductive Witch, raising her voice.
Poof! Xie Lingfeng staggered, staring at the Seductive Witch in disbelief.
What the heck! How did this end up involving me?!
The others were just as stunned, then turned to Xie Lingfeng with strange expressions. Yu Yao was also taken aback. She glanced back at Xie Lingfeng in the distance, bewildered. The Seductive Witch had her sights on Xu Yan?
No way! She simply couldn't admit it!
"You..." The Seductive Witch interrupted before she could speak again. "I, the Seductive Witch, am self-aware. How could I set my sights on the Daoist Ancestor's true teachings? The second person in the Sword Dao under the heavens is Xie Lingfeng. What's wrong with me fancying him? He's a close friend of Young Master Xu, a disciple of the Daoist Ancestor. What's wrong with me fancying him? Do you have a problem with that?"
Yu Yao was left speechless.
Xie Lingfeng, with a dark expression, turned and quickly left. Damn it, these two women had unbelievably thick skins!
He found Wu Tianan to complain: "Dean Wu, your sister really let me down. How did I get dragged into this!"
Wu Tianan looked embarrassed. "An accident, purely an accident. But I think the Seductive Witch seems to..."
"Stop it. There is only the sword in my heart, not a woman!" With that, Xie Lingfeng held his sword high and left gracefully.
Wu Tianan's lips twitched.
"Why is the Seductive Witch fancying Feng'er? It's said her Charm Power is extremely strong. If she charms Feng'er, disrupting his sword heart, what will we do?" Xie Lingfeng's mother, Fu Yun, said to Xie Tianheng with a worried expression.
"As things stand, to protect Feng'er's sword heart, as his father, I can only shoulder all of this for him," Xie Tianheng said solemnly.
"Huh?" Fu Yun gaped. "How will you shoulder it?"
"I will face the Seductive Witch directly and bear her Charm Power for Feng'er!"
Xie Tianheng said with a look of resolve.
"Xie Tianheng, is there something on your mind? It's amazing you have your sights on that fussing woman!" Fu Yun shouted angrily.
"Madam, listen to my explanation. I didn't mean that!"
"You still want to argue?"
"No, I didn't mean..."
Suddenly, chaos ensued.
In the void, the Great Wilderness Domain was breaking through the void, expanding relentlessly, but it still had quite a distance to reach the vast scale of the Land of Imperishable.
Time flew by. Another two thousand years passed in a blur. The Great Wilderness had undergone significant changes, with numerous strong cultivators, and the Heavenly Domain had been elevated to the fifth level.
"Where's Xu Yan?" Tian Zi looked around at the gathering, only to find Xu Yan absent.
"Tian Zi, just say whatever it is. I'm sure Senior Brother will know," Meng Chong suggested. He had perfected the Primordial Realm, but achieving the path would require more time to settle, though not much longer.
"Okay, the reason for gathering everyone is to brainstorm how the Great Wilderness should continue to develop. Having only one Domain seems a bit monotonous," Tian Zi remarked, scratching his head.
"How about continuing to expand the void and letting the Great Wilderness keep growing?" Meng Chong suggested, rubbing his head.
"It's just too monotonous," Tian Zi lamented.
"Then what do you want?" Su Lingxiu asked.
"I want all of you to help come up with ideas on how to avoid monotony," Tian Zi said helplessly. If he had any ideas, would he need to gather everyone for a discussion?
"Do you see the sun, moon, and stars?" Xu Yan appeared, pointing to the celestial bodies. Three thousand years had passed since he slew the world-destroying malice, during which he had been traversing the path. In three thousand years, he had only traveled three miles along the path. Xu Yan was unsure whether this was fast or slow, but he profoundly realized the difficulty of traversing it.
"What about the sun, moon, and stars?" Tian Zi asked curiously.
"Make the Great Wilderness the center. Each star is a Domain. Domains revolve around the sun and moon, with Yin Yang Reincarnation permeating them..." Xu Yan explained.
Taicang pondered and then added, "Friend Xu is right. This idea is excellent. I won't reside in the Great Wilderness anymore. I'll open up a star as my abode, and other strong cultivators can do the same."
Hearing this, the others couldn't help but have their eyes light up. The Great Wilderness was the center, the core, and they each had a Cave Heaven in the Great Wilderness. But they could also open up celestial bodies, establishing Sects.
"A myriad of stars forming a Star Domain, a myriad of Star Domains revolving around the Great Wilderness. Within the Heavenly Dao, countless suns, moons, and stars shall exist. Over the long years, all living beings will thrive, cultivators will traverse the Star Domain, and their ultimate goal in cultivation will be arriving at the Great Wilderness in pursuit of the most powerful transcendence."

chapters.title: Chapter 1175 - 1175: Extraordinary Tales of the Great Wilderness Universe_3
chapters.content:
```
"The level of the Heavenly Domain needed to be elevated, and only upon arriving at the Great Wilderness could one break through to the Heavenly Domain. After all, it was here, the origin of the Heavenly Dao, that one could understand the true essence of the Heavenly Dao.
"Though there are different paths in Martial Arts, the Martial Arts system of the Heavenly Dao could flourish even more. Ultimately, it all culminated in reaching the Heavenly Domain level..."
Xu Yan began to narrate.
Upon hearing this, everyone's eyes lit up. As the Heavenly Dao advanced, these earliest Heavenly Domain powerhouses, the warriors who fought for the Great Wilderness, were all sheltered by the Heavenly Dao. Their strength continuously grew with the advancement of the Heavenly Dao, which in turn promoted the ascent of the Heavenly Dao.
Each had their own insights into the Heavenly Dao and unique thoughts about their Martial Arts. They could establish schools and pass on their Martial Arts, as each person's insights and practices in Martial Arts Techniques were different.
Even if they all practiced the Great Wilderness Martial Arts, each person's understanding and practice of it varied significantly.
"Yes, let's do it this way!"
Tian Zi clapped and said.
Then, looking at Xu Yan, he said, "Xu Yan, how long have you been walking the path? I feel like the Heavenly Dao is still not as good as you!"
"Walking the path is difficult, really difficult!"
Xu Yan sighed.
"The Heavenly Dao is only second to the Great Dao. Although the Heavenly Dao now doesn't yet possess the might of the initial path, it wasn't far off. Once the Land of Imperishable and Taihao's legacy were absorbed, it could be raised another level and attain the initial might."
Xu Yan, being a path practitioner, naturally could discern with one glance the current power of principles of the Heavenly Dao. This was the Heavenly Dao passed down by his master, and now was the era of the Heavenly Dao. It continually advanced, ultimately second only to the rules of the Great Dao.
Apart from his master and his senior and junior fellow apprentices, there were no other existences on par with the Heavenly Dao.
"You all practice the Heavenly Dao. Eventually, you will have to walk the path, but it is the path of the Heavenly Dao rather than the Great Dao. Above the Heavenly Domain is walking the Heavenly Dao."
Xu Yan looked at several people from Taicang and smiled as he spoke.
Taicang was rather special; he was not merely walking the Heavenly Dao, but had the possibility of walking the Great Dao.
"Senior brother, have you seen master?"
Su Lingxiu asked curiously.
"No, I couldn't even see master's shadow!"
Xu Yan shook his head with a sigh, "Master's strength and the distance of his path are unimaginable. I even suspect that, in some sense, he might have surpassed the Great Dao."
No one was surprised by this. The profundity of the Daoist Ancestor was beyond their imagination.
"Are the sun, moon, and stars also called the Great Wilderness?"
Tian Zi scratched his head and asked.
"This..."
Everyone began to ponder.
Suddenly, it seemed as if some mysterious meaning was conveyed, and everyone present seemed to have a common realization.
"The Great Wilderness Universe, perhaps! This is the center of the Great Wilderness Universe, where countless stars and star domains exist. The Great Wilderness is the center, where the cosmic origin is, and the birthplace of the Heavenly Dao."
Everyone said in unison.
As soon as they spoke, they were slightly stunned, "Was this a hint from the Daoist Ancestor?"
Tian Zi was overjoyed, "The Great Wilderness Universe, yes, let's do it, everyone put in the effort, work hard to achieve the Great Wilderness Universe as soon as possible! The stronger the Heavenly Dao, the stronger you will become. You will be the first batch of path practitioners for the Heavenly Dao, continuing to shine and contribute to it. You are the First Practitioners, fighting for the Great Wilderness, earning the Heavenly Dao's merit. Those who come afterward won't be as fortunate."
The Great Wilderness Universe, countless star domains, with the Great Wilderness as the center and the cosmic origin!
Everyone was extremely excited, but they also understood that it was a long process. The development of the Great Wilderness Universe could not be accomplished overnight. Not to mention countless star domains, even opening up a single star domain required a long period. The time required to develop the Great Wilderness Universe was calculated in terms of epochs.
Ever since the direction for developing the Great Wilderness was determined, the powerhouses of the Great Wilderness had been working towards this goal. The Black Chi King, Gargantuan Gluttonous King, and Master of the Jade Court were all making efforts for this.
"Does the void have a boundary?"
Looking beyond the Great Wilderness at the endless void, the Indestructible Divine Master curiously asked.
"Perhaps only the Daoist Ancestor knows."
Taicang laughed and said.
"Taicang, how is your strength now? How about a sparring match?"
The Indestructible Divine Master looked at Taicang, full of fighting spirit, and said.
"You're no match for me now."
Taicang looked at the Indestructible Divine Master, smiled, and said, "Among the six true disciples of the Daoist Ancestor, it's Taicang who is first."
"Really, I don't believe it!"
The Indestructible Divine Master was full of fighting spirit. "In the previous battle, you were no match for me. Do you not want to regain your honor now? How about a battle?"
Taicang smiled, "If you want to spar, then I will accompany you."
"Good, good, I want to see how powerful you are, the one praised as the greatest prodigy of Taihao from ancient times to now, who developed the Taicang Domain in the Land of Imperishable."
The Indestructible Divine Master took a step and instantly arrived on a star outside the Great Wilderness. The Indestructible Divine Armor instantly cloaked him, his aura erupted, and his powerful strength surged in all directions.
"Then let me show you how strong Taicang really is."
Taicang took a step and arrived in an instant, raising his hand to press down with a palm.
The contest between the Indestructible Divine Master and Taicang drew the attention of all the powerhouses to watch. The Witch Demon exclaimed excitedly, "Right, someone should give that indestructible idiot a good beating. If I were as strong as him, I'd have beaten him long ago."
"Exactly, he should be beaten to vent some anger!"
Ao Hong nodded.
Fen Yun was eager and said, "After Brother Taicang beats him, I'll take the opportunity to get a few punches in too and relieve some anger!"
```

chapters.title: Chapter 1176 - 1176: Extraordinary Tales of the Great Wilderness Universe_4
chapters.content:
He was, after all, the first to be killed by the Indestructible Divine Master. The Daoist Ancestor resurrected him and brought him back from the annals of time. He always wanted to find an opportunity to beat up the Indestructible Divine Master to vent his anger.
"I've wanted to hit him for a long time!"
Hong Ze nodded. The Indestructible Divine Master had left a shadow in his heart, one he hadn't fully escaped. After all, that battle was too tragic, and he was devoured and annihilated by the shadow form of the Indestructible Divine Master.
Boom!
The battle was extraordinarily fierce; the stars had long been shattered. Taicang's fighting style was domineering beyond compare, his figure towering like a giant of the Domain. Whether in momentum or fighting style, the Indestructible Divine Master was slightly inferior.
"Taicang is indeed very powerful, with some connection to Hao. Ultimately, they are different."
Xu Yan sighed and said.
Scenes from the past flashed in his mind—fragments of the battle he once witnessed in the Divine Realm. That towering figure was Taicang. Although Taicang's strength then was far less than now, their aura was identical.
"Taicang's strength is already comparable to a Primordial Realm Minor Achievement."
Meng Chong touched his head and marveled.
"The Indestructible Divine Master is also remarkable, already possessing Primordial Realm strength."
Fang Hao smiled gleefully, as the Indestructible Divine Master was about to get beaten.
"Junior Brother, when do you plan to traverse the path?"
Xu Yan looked at Meng Chong and asked.
"Soon, I'll accumulate a bit more and then ascend the Great Path and embark on it."
Meng Chong chuckled.
"I'm almost there too, Senior Brother, wait for me."
Su Lingxiu giggled.
"Senior Brother, where did Master go?"
Zhao Taiping curiously asked.
"I don't know."
Xu Yan shook his head, even though he traversed the path, he still couldn't find Master's shadow.
"Muxiao and Sister Cai Ling are both missing, presumably following Master, but the Red Cat stayed behind to strengthen the Demon Clan. It said it wants to establish a Great Demon Star Domain."
Su Lingxiu thought of the Red Cat, which liked to snuggle up to Mother Xu, acting like a chubby big cat, much to Mother Xu's delight.
With Master away, the clever Red Cat naturally knew which leg was the strongest, securing favor with Mother Xu, and thus clinging firmly to Senior Brother Xu Yan's powerful leg.
Speaking of the Red Cat, everyone couldn't help but smile.
"Taicang, don't hit the face!"
The Indestructible Divine Master's angry voice came through.
"How else can I vent if I don't hit the face? Hong Ze, come, hit his face!"
Taicang held down the Indestructible Divine Master and called Hong Ze over.
The Indestructible Divine Master brought this upon himself. Since he came looking for a beating, there was no sense in not accommodating him. It was a good opportunity to break Hong Ze's psychological shadow.
"Yes, big brother!"
Hong Ze was thrilled, raising his fist and punching it directly at the Indestructible Divine Master's face.
"Hong Ze, you..."
The Indestructible Divine Master regretted it. He shouldn't have sought a match with Taicang; wasn't this just asking for a beating?
The Great Wilderness was bustling, with more and more powerful figures. The spread and expansion of the Heavenly Dao accelerated, until at last, another ten thousand years later, it had completely swallowed up the remnants of the Taihao Realm and Land of Imperishable. The now Great Wilderness had fully replaced the Taihao Realm and Land of Imperishable and continued to expand.
Stars were opened up beyond the Great Wilderness, and the first small-fledged Star Domain appeared. This Star Domain wasn't large, nor were the stars, but it was all just the beginning.
That day, Meng Chong ascended the Great Path and walked the path. As he moved forward on the Great Path, he couldn't help but sigh, finally understanding the meaning of Senior Brother's words, "The path is difficult, the path is difficult indeed!"
Looking ahead, boundless, endless, and infinite was the Great Path. Just over ten miles ahead stood a figure, which was Senior Brother Xu Yan.
They seemed only a dozen miles apart, but Meng Chong knew he would never catch up; just not falling behind further would already be good.
A millennium after Meng Chong embarked on the path, Su Lingxiu followed.
Afterwards, Fang Hao, Jiang Buping, and Zhao Taiping successively embarked on the path.
"Today, I preach!"
In the Great Wilderness, at Qinghua Sect, Ancestor Fang Hao preached.
Qinghua Sect today was the foremost holy sect of the Great Wilderness, and Canglan Island was the first Holy Land. The Great Wilderness Martial Arts Academy was the premier Holy Martial Academy, while the Evergreen Pavilion was the first Holy Hall of Alchemy.
Fang Hao preached at the Qinghua Sect, and Su Lingxiu was excitedly preaching at the Evergreen Pavilion.
Xu Yan preached on Canglan Island, then with Meng Chong and Su Lingxiu, preached at the Great Wilderness Martial Arts Academy, as the Great Wilderness Heavenly Path era continued to flourish and thrive.
Epoch after epoch passed.
Beyond the Great Wilderness, a vast Star Domain emerged, encircling the Great Wilderness Domain like a guardian. Anyone wanting to enter the Great Wilderness from outside had to pass through this Star Domain.
The Heavenly Dao continued to spread, opening up the void, while the Way of Yin Yang Reincarnation also spread throughout. One star after another was continually opened, and the Great Wilderness Universe, to this day, was still but a fledgling form.
The void seemed endless, and the Great Wilderness Universe kept expanding, seeming never to rest or end. In the border wilderness of the universe, the newly opened regions were barren and cold. Only after countless years would stars be born.
However, though the universe's border wilderness was deep and cold, it also birthed some unique treasures, items derived when the Heavenly Dao split the void, invaluable to cultivators.
Of course, these derivative items were of no use to the top powerhouses of the Great Wilderness. Yet, they would occasionally bring some back for their sect disciples as resources.

chapters.title: Chapter 1177 - 1177: Extraordinary Tales of the Great Wilderness Universe_5
chapters.content:
```
The Great Wilderness was no longer what it once was. The powerful figures who once fought for it had all retired into legend, becoming the envisioned ancestors of various ancient factions.
These great figures were all comprehending the Heavenly Dao, assisting it in continuing to carve out the void, and further shaping the Great Wilderness Universe.
"Senior Brother, which way are you heading?"
Meng Chong asked as he looked at his senior brother.
"I'll head this way."
Xu Yan looked ahead and said with a smile.
"Then I'll take this side."
Meng Chong pointed to his left.
